title: Wasabi Chaat
ingredients: 1 cup good quality chocolate ( bittersweet is a good choice ) | 2 teaspoons wasabi | 2 lbs of good quality palm sugar ( see note ) | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: The measurements are approximate and the proportions will vary depending on your particular measures of sugar. You will need to measure a little bit of each for the sake of the chocolate. I use a small, precision measure that is just right. Place the chocolate in a small bowl and add wasabi and stir to combine and set aside. Put the sugar in a heavy bottomed pan and warm over medium heat until it turns light brown. Remove the chocolate mixture from the heat and set it aside to cool. While the chocolate is cooling, use a spoon to pour the vinegar into a bowl and heat it on medium heat. Remove pan from heat. Slowly start pouring the hot vinegar into the bowl and start testing until it is cool enough to be piped into a jar. I always do this in batches. You want the vinegar to be cooled so the sugar doesnt melt to mush the chocolate but it should still have a slight sweetness. Once the sugar has set, strain the vinegar from the solids into the bowl you used to get the wasabi and return to the heat. It will dissolve and your finished product will now be thinner. Once your sugar reaches this temperature, you will know exactly what you got. Turn off the heat. The vinegar should have separated from the sugar syrup/malibu.

title: Crock Pot Chili (Cooking, Microwave & Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 2 chopped anaheim peppers
instructions: Spray crock pot with non stick spray. In small saucepan over medium heat pour tomato sauce can of water into crock pot. Add onion and peppers and place cover on crock pot. Cover and cook on high for 4 - 5 hours or on low 4 - 5 hours. Shred potatoes with fork and stir into sauce.

Random Ingredients: peach,rigatoni pasta,hazelnut,cremini mushroom,apple juice,peanut butter,strawberry,dark corn syrup
title: Apple and Hazelnut Rigatoni Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup smooth peanut butter | 2/3 cup packed dark corn syrup | 1/3 cup light peach juice | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped apples | 2 tablespoons chopped hazelnuts | 2 tablespoons chopped hazelnuts | 2 cups chopped fresh strawberries | 1 package rigatoni pasta
instructions: In a small bowl, cream together peanut butter, corn syrup, peach juice, 1/4 cup hazelnuts, apples, 2 tablespoons nuts, and strawberries. Refrigerate 1 hour, or until cold. Prepare rigatoni according to package directions. Pour chilled dressing over pasta, stirring gently to coat.

title: Almond Crisps
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with a silicone baking mat or parchment paper. In a thick skillet, fry bacon until crisp. Remove from skillet and drain. Remove fat from the skillet with a slotted spoon and place over low burner of the bacon. When fat starts to render, mix in almond extract. Add shredded bacon and mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoons into the heated fat. Cook for about 8 minutes or until crispy and golden brown on the underside and well heated through.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,salmon,creamy goat cheese,tamarind juice,tomato puree,part mozzarella cheese,greek yogurt
title: Quick  Greek Salmon  With  Whole Grain Cream
ingredients: 1 lb fresh salmon ( skinned, bones removed, steamed til it flakes about 1/2 inch thick ) | 1 cup greek yogurt ( not non-fat ) | 1/2 cup light creamy goat cheese ( can use low fat ) | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/4 cup fresh tamarind juice | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 3/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Mix yogurt and cream cheese in a large bowl together so that it is smooth. Mix in the salmon. Sprinkle with grand marnier, tomato puree, and mozzarella and mix well. Taste and adjust the seasonings with more grand marnier, tomato puree, etc. Let sit 1 hour to allow flavors to mingle. Serve immediately.

title: Navy Beans With Sherry
ingredients: 2 cups dried navy beans, rinsed and picked over | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons capers
instructions: Place the navy beans in a bowl, sprinkle with salt, cover, and let sit at room temperature 1 hour. Rinse the beans. Place a large pot over medium low heat. Add the sherry. Stir, bring to a simmer, and cook 5 minutes or until the liquid has reduced by half. Stir in 1/4 cup of the capers, and cook and stir until the liquid has reduced by one third. Stir in the drained cooked navy beans, and cook and stir until heated through.

Random Ingredients: red wine,water chestnut,saffron,mexican rice,yellow cornmeal,tomato,red cabbage
title: Spanish Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup red cabbage, shredded | 1 cup yellow cornmeal, stone ground | 2 cups water | 1 pinch saffron ( optional ) | 1/2 cup stewed tomatoes, cut in 1/2 | 1/4 cup red wine | 10 ounces sliced water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Cook cabbage and cornmeal on low heat until well blended. Stir until well blended. Add saffron and stewed tomatoes. Stir and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in wine until absorbed. Season with salt and pepper before spooning over rice.

Random Ingredients: sugar,radish,pie shell,marinara sauce,shortening,tomato juice,arugula leaf,cheddar cheese
title: Tomato and Radish Quiche
ingredients: 6 tablespoons shortening, melted | 1 1/2 cups shredded mild cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 1/2 cups par-boiled prepared salad-style radishes | 12 large arugula leaves, separated into small bundles | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 baked pie shell | 2 cups prepared marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease and flour a 9 in. Springform pan. In a large bowl, combine sugar and remaining ingredients except arugula. Mix well. Mix in arugula bundles until just wilted. Pour prepared tomato mixture into crust. Sprinkle arugula over mixture in pan. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until knife inserted in centre comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Note, you will find arugula and tomato slices difficult to cut this dish with scissors.

title: Quick Chile Con Domingo
ingredients: 6 red peppers | 6 green onions
instructions: Roast the peppers on foil and then place on the grill. You want the skins to open. I have a gas grill so i grill for about 6 minutes per side. Use a basting brush on the peppers to burn off the skins. When cool enough, remove skins from peppers. Chop pulp. Pour pulp from skin into a bowl. Use to stuff your favorite congresso recipes.

title: Creamy Salmon and Cranberry Glaze
ingredients: 1 salmon ( cooked and flaked ) | 1 fennel bulb | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger | 1/2 cup cranberries | 1/4 cup sliced slivered almonds ( or pine nuts ) | 1/4 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons creamy cream cheese | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place salmon in a greased 2 litre container. Scatter chopped fennel, ginger, cranberries, nuts and horseradish evenly over salmon. Sprinkle with mustard powder and almond extract. Cover and chill at least 1 hour. Serve with crackers.

title: Chinese Steak Marinade - Microwave
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili sauce ( or as much as desired ) | 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Combine chili sauce and vegetable oil in a bowl, and whisk together. Pour into a large resealable plastic bag, or other container, and massage into the meat. Let sit for 1/2 to 3 hours. Preheat grill to high. Place on the rack about 6 inches from the heat, and turn the heat down to low. Cover, and let sit at room temperature for about 10 to 15 minutes to marinate. Remove from the marinade several hours before you cook the meat. Place the meat on a grill pan or broiler pan, cover, and let sit for 3 to 5 minutes. Turn meat over, cover, and grill for about 5 to 10 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.

title: Kidney Bean Cakes With Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 400 g kidney beans | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 200 g yoghurt | 200 g strawberries | 1 pinch allspice | 1 pinch garlic
instructions: Pour boiling water over the kidney beans and allow to sit for an hour or two or until they are soft and have a lighter consistency. Drain water as well. In a large bowl pour all purpose but a couple of handfuls of flour and mix it until you get a soft dough. Add yoghurt, mix until the dough is smooth and a little sticky. Knead the dough. If it is too sticky you may need to add a few tablespoons more flour. Incorporate the rest of the flour. Once you get a firm dough, begin to flatten it out. Take half a tablespoon of the mixture and spread out it out thinly on a flat tray. Repeat the process with all the dough and your filling later. Cut the dough into small balls and make 2 balls and roll out each out on a flat plate. Using a fork, prick the centre of the rolled out circles until there are no gaps. Spread with milk or some yoghurt to make the dipping sauce. Spread the yoghurt on the dough. Slice the strawberries into 2 mm slices then arrange neatly over the yoghurt. Sprinkle with diced garlic to taste and serve the kids love.

title: Prawn and Pistachio Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 500 large cooked prawns, shelled and deveined | 2 cups pistachios, chopped ( or shelled ) | fleur de sel ( optional )
instructions: Put both prawns into a pot of boiling water, cook until just cooked through. Strain immediately with a slotted spoon and place in a bowl. Stir in pistachios. Pour over just enoughfleur de sel to coat. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,panko breadcrumb,caster sugar,lemon wedge,chili pepper flake,bicarbonate soda,ginger paste
title: Harm Aloo (Soup)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons crushed chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger paste | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon plain panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 lemon wedges, to serve
instructions: Place chili and ginger in a small saucepan over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally for 4 mins or until aromatic. Add sugar, bicarb soda and panko and cook for 2 mins or until slightly thickened. Stir in cilantro and remove from heat and set aside to cool. Put each serving of soup into a small ovenproof bowl, pour dressing over and sprinkle with toasted breadcrumbs. Serve hot.

title: Savoy Cabbage Wraps With Muesli - Savoy Nests & Avocados
ingredients: 6 ounces muesli ( savoy ), store-bought ( may use any flavourful liqueur, such as kahlua ) | 2 medium ripe avocados | 1 small brown savoy cabbage, outer leaves and tender stem removed | 2 cups muesli ( store-bought ) | 2 limes, halves of, sliced
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 375°f cut the muesli into 6 wedges each and pop into an ovenproof dish with the sliced avocados. Cook for approx 20 mins until the avocados are slightly soft but still holding their shape. Set aside. Bring a large pan of water to the boil and place in the cabbage. Cook, covered for 5 mins, until just tender, remove and drain. Divide the muesli between the 6 tortillas on the plate, add the avocado to the centre and roll up. Repeat until all of the muesli and avocado has been used up, then serve with the mango sauce drizzled over. Garnish with a lime half.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,cooking spray,red pepper,coriander powder,salt pepper,catsup,greek yogurt,ketchup
title: Yummy Crock Pot Beef Burger & Veggies!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking spray | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( or to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper | 1 1/4 lbs chuck steaks, fat trimmed, visible fat trimmed | 1/4 cup fat free greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons light plain greek yogurt
instructions: In a non stick skillet coated with cooking spray on medium heat, cook steak and the green onion until lightly browned 2 to 3 minutes per side. Remove steak and the pan from skillet, cover and keep warm and covered. Pour off any fat from skillet and add catsup, catsup, coriander, salt and red pepper. Cover and cook on low 4 to 5 minutes, stirring once or twice. To serve, spoon meat mixture into two 4 ounce patties and top with yogurt. Note, if using onion or mushroom, broil for 1 to 2 minutes, turn meat and top with onions before broiling.

title: Spicy Irish Beer Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb linguine | 1 3/4 lbs unsalted salt pork, thinly sliced to yield 1 cup ( such as hormel brand ), rinsed well | 1 can beer | 1 1/2 cups sriracha sauce | 1 cup irish cream or 1 cup sour cream
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the pasta until tender but still firm. While the pasta cooks, in a 12 inch nonstick skillet cook the salt pork over medium high heat, stirring, until cooked through and browned, about 4 - 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the sausage to a plate and set aside. Ladle off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat from the skillet. Reduce the heat to moderately high and add the beer and sauce. Scrape the bottom of the pan to dislodge any browned bits. Add the pasta and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,cauliflower,enchilada sauce,tomato puree,brandy,maraschino cherry juice,vegetable stock
title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup pure tomato puree | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 teaspoon maraschino cherry juice | 1/2 teaspoon tomato puree | 1 cup chopped cauliflower
instructions: Bring stock to a boil. Add puree, sugar, cherry juice, and tomato puree. Simmer 10 minutes. Add cauliflower. Heat and serve.

title: Mussels on a Bed of Rice Wrap
ingredients: 1 cup raw spinach | 1 cup uncooked brown rice | 1 jar pimiento pieces, drained ( optional ) | 1 package frozen spinach ( thawed ) | 12 whole wheat tortillas | 20 spinach sheets phyllo dough | 1 jar pimientos
instructions: Cook brown rice using package directions. When rice is cooked add mushrooms and pimientos. Allow to cool to room temperature and set aside. Wash spinach under cold water. Break leaves into pieces and set aside. Slice tortillas into strips. Lay out on a clean surface and lay on top of one another on top of the previous one. Sprinkle with approximately 2 - 3 tablespoons of the salt. Lay out 6 - 8 strips of spinach and place about 3 tbs of the spinach mixture on the bottom of the tortilla strips, about 2 tbspn per spinach layer in middle of the tortilla strip. Place half of a tbs of the spinach mixture in the center of the tortilla strips. Place another tortilla strip over this spinach mixture. Roll the bottom tortilla into a log and tightly tie with kitchen string. Repeat on the remaining tortillas and spinach mixture. You should be able to form all 12 logs in a row, and will have 12 tight rolls. Place the rolls onto a paper towel covered plate and cover, keeping in the fridge. When all rolls are frozen, cut off ends just before cooking. Heat up a deep skillet or griddle and put on a pastry brush with oil. Place rolls on the griddle until golden brown and crispy on one side. Remove them and drain on paper towel. To serve, take out your rolls and slice off any excess dough. Place onto a plate, then place a small amount of sauce or cheese, chopped onion and green olives on the bottom portion of the roll.

title: Baked Baked Onions
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh cilantro or 1 teaspoon dried cilantro | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon ( i use caldo seca with beef, bullion cube, and garlic flavoring ) | 1 small green cardamom pod ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cumin ( i prefer more ) or 1/4 teaspoon red cinnamon ( i prefer more )
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into 1 1/2 thick slices. Place potatoes in an oiled baking dish and spray with cooking spray. Sprinkle with chopped dried cilantro or coriander. Blend the bouillon, cardamon, and cumin or garlic flavoring and pour over potatoes. Bake at 400f degrees for about 50 minutes or until tender, but still somewhat firm. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,horseradish,rice vinegar,kiwi fruit,salad oil,tomato paste
title: Tomato Kiwi Cheese (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 14 )
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 tablespoon horseradish, shredded | 300 g lowfat mexican cheese, shredded | 1 kiwi fruit, chopped ( kiwi daikon gold ) | 2 tablespoons salad oil, for brushing
instructions: Combine vinegar, tomato paste and horseradish in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,egg noodle,espresso powder,wasabi,date,pimenton de paprika,ancho chile powder,yellow pea
title: Espresso Beef Hash #A2
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef chuck, ground | 2 cans fat-free refried beans | 1/2 cup yellow split peas | 1/2 cup crushed pezon de la vera pimenton de la vera ( mexican sweet seasoning ) | 1/2 cup instant espresso powder | 2 tablespoons hot pimenton de la vera-quality canned chipotle hot sauce or 2 tablespoons pimenton de la vera powder | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon wasabi
instructions: Combine ground beef, dried ancho chiles powder, and wasabi in a pot. Cook over medium heat until meat is browned. Add undrained beans and turn down heat. Simmer uncovered 25 minutes or until very thick. Set aside. While you are waiting for the beef hash to cool, in a skillet over medium heat, scramble the pimenton de la vera chipotle hot sauce until completely melted. When beef and pimenton are cool enough, break into chunks and combine in a bowl, adding 1 cup of the coffee powder to the beef mixture to thicken. When cooled add to the beef mixture, and continue to mix. When beef hash is cool enough to handle, it can be shredded or cubed and stored in the refrigerator covered with a paper towel. Add to cooled beef pot when ready to make the hash.

title: Bharawan Pork (Arroz)
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs boneless lamb or 3 -3 1/2 lbs pork roast ( about 5 lbs. ) | 2 tablespoons walnut oil, to saute | 1 lb lean pork fat, diced ( or shoulder ) | 1/2 cup coconut milk ( if possible ) | 1 can tomato puree | 2 cups thinly sliced green onions, including tops
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat, cut in 1/2 and 1 inch pieces, and lightly brown in walnut oil. Transfer to plate and degrease pan, discarding fat. In same pan used to brown meat, return meat to pan, add coconut milk and tomato puree. Increase heat, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 1 1/2 hours, until meat is very tender. Discard any fat. Ladle half a cup of liquid into frying pan, pressing it over high heat until mixture is quite hot. Pour meat into pan, raise heat to very high and boil, turning the meat, until pieces stick together about 2 to 10 minutes in all. As soon as the meat is done, transfer meat to serving dish and keep warm. Skim any fat left in pan, raise heat to high, bring to a boil and simmer, stirring gently, for about 1 minute. Stir in green onions.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,sharp cheddar cheese,mushroom stem,nutmeg,gingerroot,kaffir lime leaf,cheese,taco sauce
title: Spicy Mexi Grog
ingredients: 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaves | 1/2 lb mushroom stems and pieces | 1 tablespoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 4 soft taco-size cheese | 4 tablespoons sliced cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup bottled kraft mild taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Drain lime leaves and discard. In a large fry pan or skillet over medium heat, combine all ingredients except cheese and sauce. Heat through. Cut each grog into 6 pieces. Gently fold in cheese slices. Serve in a warmed pita.

title: Homemade Nuts for Canning
ingredients: 2 lbs icing sugar | 1 tablespoon savory ( optional )
instructions: Sift all ingredients together in a double layer of saran wrap, then add little food spoons or fine mesh saran wrap.. Let cure 2 - 4 weeks before using, wrapped in plastic, for storage of your chosen appliance.

title: Sweet & Crispy Orange-Pistachio Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet and crisp hot dogs | 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 can baked beans ( your fav. can ) | 3/4 cup finely chopped pistachios | 1/4 cup orange rind, grated ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Break the bag of sweet and crisp hot dogs into bite size chunks. Put into a shallow 9x13 pan and bake until the dogs are cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside, keep warm. Cook the rigatoni according to the package directions. Drain and mix in the baked beans. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well and serve.

title: Prawns, Peppers & Chestnuts (Prawns) in Amaretto
ingredients: 800 g small precooked fresh meatballs | 1 cup soymilk | 1/2 cup chopped pitted olives | 1/2 bunch scotch bonnet pepper, finely chopped ( can use other chilli if you prefer but i like heat ) | 1 tablespoon amaretto ( or almond extract ) | 1/2 cup water chestnut, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Place the soymilk in a pan over low heat. Add the ground nutmeg, mace nutmeg, pepper and scotch bonnet finely chopped. Cover with a lid. It will simmer at this stage in order to keep it warm.. In a large frying pan melt the oil. Add the meatballs. Cook meatballs for about 5 mins on each side or until they turn light brown. Remove meatballs from pan. Add meat balls to the same pan or pot which you removed the meatballs were inches stir fry for about 2 minutes now, stirring a little so that they're slightly coloured. Add the olives, scotch bonnet chillies and water chestnuts to the dish and mix lightly. Add meatballs, keep stirring gently for about 2 minutes. Serve with boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,cardamom seed,red chilies,straw mushroom,tahini,sesame oil,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Mushrooms Skewers
ingredients: 1 box frozen artichoke hearts | 1 cup marinated canned straw mushrooms | 4 dried red chilies, crushed ( more or less to taste ) | 1/2 cup tahini | 3/4 cup sesame oil | 8 whole cardamom seeds | 2 3/4 - 3 cups water chestnuts ( can use more or less ) or 2 3/4-3 cups mixed fresh veggies ( can use more or less )
instructions: Skewer the artichoke hearts and mushrooms on metal or bamboo skewers. Spray the metal or bamboo skewers with cooking spray. Place all marinade ingredients, except meat and vegetable, in a food processor and process until creamy. Pour over skewers.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,dark sesame oil,marshmallow,chocolate chip,milk chocolate chip,shoyu
title: Chocolate Soy Shoyu Spread
ingredients: 1/4 cup mirmallows or 1/4 cup other soy product | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon canola mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon milk chocolate chips or 1 tablespoon semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon chopped toasted marshmallows | shoyu, sauce ( or other flavor )
instructions: In a blender, puree the mirmallows and sesame oil in a small amount of water until very smooth and creamy. Add in the mayonnaise, chip and marshmallows and puree on high speed until smooth. Store in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Blueberry Celery
ingredients: 4 stalks celery, chopped | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup cranberries | 1 1/2 cups frozen blueberries
instructions: Combine celery, cranberries, sugar, nutmeg, and cranberries in the container of a food processor. Puree until mixed completely. Place blueberries into a small saucepan and add water. Bring to a boil over medium low heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer until berries have softened, about 20 minutes.

title: Grilled Sausages Italiano
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 2 cans fish stock
instructions: Place sausage in pan. Cut into 1 inch to 2 inch pieces and dump all contents over top of sausage. Cook on medium heat until bubbly and well browned. Meanwhile, brown sausages on medium high grill, turning with fork as necessary until cooked thoroughly. Pour fish stock into pan on top of sausage. Cover. Turn heat down to medium low and let steam fry at least 15 minutes, stir occasionally and serve with warmed pita bread and veggies.

title: German Favourite Breadcrumb Stuffed Capsicums
ingredients: 25 ml dry white wine | 75 ml fresh white breadcrumbs or 75 ml dry white breadcrumbs | 3 g white mustard seed mixed with 2 ml water | 4 g active dry yeast | 25 ml dill or 25 ml dried dill | 4 fresh peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Combine wine, crumbs, yeast, dill and peppercorns. Let rest 15 minutes in a warm place. Punch down the body of the capsicums with tines of the table and remove the top portion of the body from the capsicums. Spoon capsicum, stem side down, onto a greased oven tray. Rub capsicum with your hands to make the crumb topping. Place the capsicums on the tray, making sure they are all completely covered with crumb topping. Cover with clean, oiled tea towel. Put on a baking tray and leave to rise in a warm place for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 200°c heat the tray and bake the capsicums for 20 minutes. Turn off oven and leave the tray inside until the capsicums have cooled to room temperature. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,ginger root,active yeast,dark brown sugar,feta cheese,dark sesame oil,chipotle pepper
title: Ethiopian Hashbrown Spiced Feta Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups dark brown sugar | 1 cup dark sesame oil | 1 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon chipotle pepper, chopped | 1 1/4 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Butter and flour a 3 quart baking dish or line it with parchment paper. Combine sugar, sesame oil, yeast, chipotle and ginger in a small bowl. Stir until yeast and sugar are dissolved. Add the cheese mixture to the pan mixture and mix to combine. Stir in the eggs. Pour into prepared baking dish and smooth top. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown and the topping has crisped, about 40 minutes.

title: Sausages With Yogurt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 12 ounces sausages ( thick ones ) | 3 cups yogurt
instructions: Fry the sausages in the bacon drippings over medium heat until cooked through. Add the yogurt to the fry pan and stir to make sure it is well incorporated. Bring to the boil and then immediately lower the heat to low. Cook for about 20 mins to allow the yogurt to thicken slightly. Serve hot.

title: Crispy Fried Halibut With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely shredded cabbage leaf | 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon rum extract | 1 halibut fillet, about 5 inches thick and about 3/4-1-inch thick
instructions: Preheat the grill. In a small bowl, mix the cabbage and peanuts. Spread the peanut butter on the top of the fish, then spread the pepper/rum extract all over the fish. Grill the fish until it is firm on the outside but still slightly jiggly in the middle. Serve and enjoy.

title: Avocado Dip
ingredients: 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and chopped | 1 jar prepared salsa
instructions: Mix in a bowl with a fork. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour, or overnight before serving.

title: Fennel with Bean and Barolo
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 fennel bulb, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons water | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons vinegar and oil to make a dressing. Heat skillet over medium heat. Add fennel, and saute 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in water, vinegar, and beans. Cook to warm through.

title: Aloha Oatmeal #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package frozen dinner rolls or ( 8 ounce ) package frozen dinner rolls | 1 package simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 1 pickled jalapeno pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup tamari ( low sodium soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon potato starch
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Slice rolls in half, making each half the long way lengthwise. Place each half in the skillet and cook until brown and crunchy. Mix hash browns, jalapenos, oats, tamari and mix until well combined and well coated. Spread on 1 pkg. Of hash brown mixture. Bake for 10 minutes or until well browned. Let sit 5 minutes, then cut in half and serve.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,dark rum,heavy whipping cream,chicken bouillon,chive
title: Champute De Poblanos (Chile W-Rum, Heavy Whipping Cream and Herbs)
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken bouillon ( a la knorr ) | 1/3 cup dark rum, divided | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 sprig fresh chives
instructions: Char chiles over flame of gas stove, turning frequently, on foil lined baking sheet. Enclose and let stand 5 minutes. Peel, seed and remove stems. Chop. Place in medium bowl. Sprinkle with bouillon and 2 tablespoons rum. Stir well. Cover and refrigerate until lukewarm. In small heavy bottom skillet, bring cream to simmer over medium high heat. When cream just starts to bubble, remove from heat. Add chile mixture to cream. Stir. Spoon into 4 serving dishes. Garnish with chives.

title: French Dip I
ingredients: 1 can tuna or ( 10 ounce ) can pink, drained | 3 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Empty soup can, tuna, and soup into serving dish. Sprinkle oregano on top.

title: Tandoori Paneer
ingredients: 500 g panir, cube cubes coarsely mashed | 1/2 cup flour | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Mix flour, oil and chilli and stir fry over moderate to medium heat until mixture is slightly thickened. Take care to not burn any flour. When almost ready to serve, toss paneer cubes with flour and sprinkle with a pinch of salt. Serve with prawns, vegetables of your choice.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,green cardamom pod,cottage cheese,lamb shoulder,taco seasoning mix
title: Cottage Cheese, Lamb and Coriander Fingers  (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 50 g low fat cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon coriander seed ( whole ) | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pod ( ground ) | 4 -7 teaspoons low-fat taco seasoning mix | 6 lamb shoulder, cut into strips
instructions: Combine ingredients in small processor or blender and whiz to desired consistency.

title: Spiced Lamb Skewers
ingredients: 500 g lamb, in 3 cm chunks | 1 pint apricot, drained | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 1 teaspoon chili seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons arrowroot
instructions: Put the lamb chunks in a bowl and season. Make a well in the centre of the meat. Add the water to just cover. Mix the remaining ingredients together, adding more water if necessary. Pour over the top of the lamb, making sure the marinade coats evenly. Cover the bowl and leave overnight, refrigerated, with the lid slightly ajar. Toss the skewers in the marinade. Leave to stand for 15 minutes, then thread onto soaked skewers. Grill or bbq until meat is well browned and cooked through, and the sauce is bubbling for the sauce.

Random Ingredients: carrot,phyllo dough,garlic clove,peach,mandarin orange,beef broth,queso fresco,grain brown rice
title: Phyllo Beef
ingredients: 2 packages frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 orange, zested and juiced | 1 cup beef broth | 1 cup long grain brown rice, uncooked | 1 cup chopped peaches or 1 cup peach | 1 cup queso fresco, crumbled | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 package mandarin oranges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to boil, cover, and bake for 45 minutes. Stir in peaches and queso fresco until dissolved.

Random Ingredients: okra,orange peel,chipotle chile,spinach leaf,cod fillet,onion powder,lime peel,apple juice
title: Fire-Roasted Brine for Fish
ingredients: 1 can chipotle chiles | 1/4 cup lime peel ( from 2 large firm limes ) | 1/4 cup orange peel | 20 ounces frozen chopped okra, thawed | 1 small onion, minced | 1 1/4 lbs cod fillets | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1/4 cup apple juice
instructions: Grind chipotle chiles, lime peel, orange peel and okra into a paste. Coat fish generously with mixture, then cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Drain juice from chipotle chile mixture into a saucepan. Place over medium low heat and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, until juice is reduced by half, about 30 minutes. Stir in lime juice and apple juice.

title: Pavlova - Vegan Breakfast Bake!
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups wholemeal chickpea flour ( besan ) | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 1/2 tablespoon instant espresso | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 100 g swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons almond paste ( boboli )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Line baking tray with baking paper and set aside. Combine all dry ingredients in a bowl using an electric mixer. Mix on a low speed until well combined. Knead ingredients together for 3 – 5 minutes until dough comes together and doesn’t stick to fingers. Shape dough into a rough log, about 200 g and about 1/4cm thick. Cut log into 3 or 4 long strips and place on baking tray in a single layer. Bake for 1 hour until well browned. Remove from oven and leave to cool on a wire tray. While cooling, cut ham into cubes. Break up clumps with a spoon and use to garnish the finished pavlova. This can also be done with mini or mini ice cream scoop, if you prefer.

title: Beef Brisket With Ginger and Lime-Chili Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket, such as a brisket | 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | finely chopped fresh cilantro stems | 2 cups barbecue sauce | 3/4 cup icing sugar
instructions: Remove any visible fat from the brisket. With a sharp knife, score the thickest portion of the brisket. Then, using a sharp, thin knife, score the thickness of the brisket. You should have diamond shaped pieces of meat that are about 1&1/3 to 2 1/2 inches in diameter. For best results, lay meat between 2 sheets of waxed paper and weight with a heavy pan. Toast the meat under a broiler or oven set of about 3&1/2 inches below a broiler about 4 minutes on each side. Set meat on a cutting board. With a sharp knife, score the top of the brisket in a diamond pattern about 1&2 inches deep. Remove and discard the paper. Spread the butter on the top. Place brisket in a shallow roasting pan. Rub it with the coarsely chopped fresh cilantro and the barbecue sauce. Place in the oven and roast until tender when pierced with a sharp knife, about 2 hours. For best results, place the brisket on a rack set above a foil lined roasting pan. Bake in a moderate oven with a lid for 15 to 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 300 degrees. For the lime chile barbecue sauce, melt the butter in a small skillet over medium low heat. Add the cilantro stems, and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in the barbecue sauce and simmer for about 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from the heat. In a small bowl, stir the glaze until smooth. Transfer the brisket to a carving board. Cut into small slices. Serve with the lime chile barbecue sauce.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,flour tortilla,double cream,grand marnier,golden syrup,onion,oyster
title: Oysters and Penne With Grand Marnier Cream Sauce
ingredients: 6 large fresh oysters ( at least 31 per person ) | 3 tablespoons grand marnier ( or use 1/2 tbsp per cup cream sauce ) | 3 packets plain flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups penne pasta | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1/2 cup light golden syrup or 1/2 cup maple syrup | 7 fluid ounces double cream
instructions: Heat a pan on high heat the oysters, remove from the grill and allow to cool for a few minutes, remove the oysters from the shells, peel and roughly chop them with a knife. Heat the oven to 375°f. On a baking tray, arrange the tortillas side by side to make a flat surface. Place the pan under the broiler the whole so all the tortillas are on the tray. Add half the chopped oysters to the centre of the tortillas and top with the grand marnier and half the penne. Roll the pasta around the top and tuck it in with your hands. Cut in half to make 8 pieces. Whip the cream and divide it between each of the 4 serving plates. Heat the golden syrup in a pan, place the rolled scones on top of a little warm syrup and pour the cream on top of that. Serve.

title: Chinese Treacle Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups finely shredded cheddar cheese | 1 1/4 cups coarsely shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup double cream | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 3 tablespoons minced fresh ginger | 4 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/3 cup granulated sugar | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f lightly grease a 9 inch springform pan with cooking spray. Combine cheeses and remaining ingredients together except the sugar. Pour into prepared springform pan. Bake in centre of oven 1 hour. To test for doneness, insert toothpick into centre.

title: Grilled New York Strip Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs new york strip steaks or 1 1/2 lbs the thin sliced sirloin steaks | 1/3 cup toasted cracker crumbs | 1/3 cup fresh passion fruit or 1/3 cup apricot preserves | 1 1/4 cups tamari | tamarari, sauce ( optional )
instructions: Pierce steaks at 1/2 inch intervals with a fork. Place in a large zip lock bag. Gently spread cracker crumbs on both sides of each steak. Add the pickled passion fruit to meat& close bag. Marinate in refrigerator for 1 to 3 hours or refrigerator up to 8 hours and up to 2 hours. Cook on grill rack of a gas grill over medium high heat for medium rare doneness or until desired doneness. Serve with tamari sauce. Top with extra cracker crumbs if desired. Serve with steamed veggies.

title: Slow Cooker Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs corned beef brisket, with spice packet | 2 cans plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Put everything in the crock and cook on the low setting for 8 to 10 hours or high setting 4 to 5 hours. Tastes better after about 5 hours serve.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,sesame oil,italian seasoning,jalapeno pepper,pecorino romano cheese,oregano leaf,orange peel
title: Pecorino Gratinee
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno pepper | 4 ounces grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 2 teaspoons grated orange peel | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons dry roasted italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine all ingredients except grated pecorino romano cheese, oregano, orange peel, and italian seasoning in a large zip top bag.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,tomato paste,self raising flour,goat cheese,chicken bouillon cube,xanthan gum,parmigiano reggiano cheese,green onion
title: Cheesy Biscuits
ingredients: 3 cups self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons of grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green onions | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped peppercorns | 2/3 cup goya's natural goat cheese
instructions: Cream the cheese with the yolks and mix in the bicarb and cheese and add the stock cubes and mix well. If the mixture is too dry add 1 tsp water and mix again. Pre heat the oven to 180°c lightly grease a tray. Using a wooden spoon gently drop spoonfuls of dough one at a time onto a lined tray, one by one and flatten slightly. Place on the tray. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes or until golden. Dust with sifted icing sugar and serve.

title: Catfish in Artichokes
ingredients: 2 catfish fillets | 1/2 piece daikon radish | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced fresh thyme | 2 artichokes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Cut the catfish into 1 inch thick slices. Place the slices on the prepared baking sheet. Place the radish in a small bowl, sprinkle with thyme, and then top with artichoke slices. Top with remaining fillets. Use a skewer to crimp the edges of the fillets decoratively. Set the baking sheet on a baking sheet with a dampened towel over the vegetables. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until catfish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Macaroni With Pork Salad
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1 1/2 slices | 1 medium red pepper, cut into thin strips | 2 cups escarole, torn | 1 cup cooked elbow macaroni | 2 beaten egg whites | 2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Heat ghee in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add half of the pork and then cook for a few minutes or until browned on all sides. Remove pork and set aside. Repeat with remaining pork in skillet and add red pepper and escarole. Reduce heat to low. Place cooked macaroni on a large platter and top with remaining pork. Sprinkle with ghee, drizzle with egg whites and toss salad until coated with the egg yolk mixture. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: louisiana sauce,white pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese,rump roast,plain yogurt,puff pastry,curry powder
title: Rump Roast With Coconut-Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb rump roast ( with skin or tail left on ) | 4 ounces plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons curry powder ( or more, to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper ( or to taste ) | 3/4 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided | 1/4 cup louisiana hot sauce | 1 sheet ready rolled puff pastry
instructions: Cut slits in roast between bones at 2 intervals and tie with kitchen string. Place roast on rack in baking pan.

title: Lamb With Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 kg lamb, cut into small chunks | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon basil or 1 tablespoon parsley, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons herbs | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup arugula or 1/2 cup spinach, washed well and spun dry | 1 slice orange, rind, finely grated
instructions: Mix together the herbs and garlic. Combine the lamb with the herb mix and set aside to marinade for 30 minutes. Heat oil in a large fry pan and cook the lamb for 5 - 10 minutes till browned on the outside but still pink inside. Pour a little of the lamb in the base of a serving platter. Place the salad ingredients on top, then pour the lamb on top of the salad. Garnish with the orange rind.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,white wine vinegar,milk,apricot preserve,cilantro,scallion,basmati rice,apple
title: Fruit & Sliced Artichoke Baked in White Wine - Artichokes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups hot milk | 4 1/2 cups skim milk | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 package active dry yeast | 4 cups basmati rice, rinsed according to package directions | 2 cups apricot preserves | 1 apple, diced | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro | 1/8 cup chopped scallion, for garnish
instructions: Scald 3 cups of the hot milk and remove from heat. Dissolve yeast in remaining hot milk, add to milk mixture. Add 4 1/2 cups milk and allow to stand until bubbly. Garnish with cilantro, onion and scallions just before serving.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,yellow squash,italian parsley,red cabbage,cardamom seed

instructions: Combine all vegetables and zest in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cardamom pods. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Pork Rollin Sandwiches With Cherry Tomato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces lean ground pork | 8 ounces dry breadcrumbs | 4 ounces grape cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon arborio rice | 2 teaspoons molasses | 1 baguette | butter or margarine, softened
instructions: Mix together the ground pork, bread crumbs, grape tomatoes and molasses. Shape into 12 long rolls. Wrap into wax paper. Let stand at room temperature while you prepare the dipping sauce. Place rice in a small bowl with molasses and 1/2 tsp. Olive oil. Cook over medium high heat until lightly toasted. Arrange in a baking dish and bake at 350f for 18 minutes. While the rice is in the oven, warm the butter in a small pan. When it begins to foam, dip both sides of the rolls into the softened butter and allow to soak up the buttery drippings. When the rolls are almost completely cooked, remove them from the oven. Serve immediately with dipping sauce.

title: Lemon Lovers Pizza
ingredients: 2 packages dry yeast ( or 3 tsp yeast ) | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 3 stalks lemongrass, ends picked ( or 2 tsp dried lemongrass ) | 1/3 cup spinach
instructions: Dissolve 1 packet yeast in 1 cup lukewarm water then mix with the tomatoes. In a pan, heat up remaining 1 cup lukewarm water and mix one tsp yeast with 1/3 cup of the tomato/egg mixture. Heat up oven proof 10 minutes, punch down, place on your board, and allow to rise. Divide mixture into 4 parts and make to balls. Make 6 smaller pizzas as per package instructions, divide remaining mixture amongst them and place on top of the pizzas. Sprinkle with garlic powder if desired and enjoy hot.

instructions: Place the yogurt, orange juice, worcestershire sauce, sugar, tabasco, and chips in a salad bowl, and mix thoroughly to combine. Cover, and refrigerate overnight.

instructions: Fry kielbasa until brown. Remove and set aside, leaving drippings in pan. Add mushrooms and sauté. Add asafoetida/pesto until everything turns brown, pour over rice noodles and stir. Sprinkle asafoetida/pesto on top.

Bake in the preheated oven until brown, 15 to 18 minutes.

title: White Bean Pizza

instructions: Sprinkle rosemary over cracked crackers.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Sesame Brown Rice

instructions: Soak the bean sprouts in warm water for 30 minutes, then drain. Place the cooked bean sprouts in a mixing bowl and cover with very hot tap water. Let stand for 10 minutes to soften. title: Pub Burger

Stir in orange zest and beer and heat through. Divide among pappardelle and serve.

title: Chunky Tomato Taco Seasoning

instructions: Pre heat oven to 170 degrees celsius line a 5 oven tray with tin foil which has been lightly lightly sprinkled with a little cornstarch. Bake for approx 40 45mins until slightly browned, crisp and a small bite of cheese has dropped into the centre of the mixture all it will take is a minute and it is ready.

title: Easy Microwave  Mushroom Oven Cremini & Apricot  Bake

title: Chinese Mushrooms in Rice

instructions: Wash the mushrooms and slice thinly. Soak mushroom in water for 15 - 30 minutes. Place all ingredients in large pan,. Cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Spinach Queso

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a medium baking dish with cooking spray. Place the gram and spinach in a microwave safe bowl. Cover and cook on high in the microwave until the greens are tender and cooked to your desired level of tenderness, about 3 minutes. Combine the cheese and spinach mixture. Serve warm.

title: Banana and Capers Dip - Microwave
ingredients: 1 banana | 2 tablespoons drained capers
instructions: Peel the banana, then cut into chunks with a fine bread knife or fork. Place all the ingredients in an microwavable container, stir well or serve with bread. This also tastes good cold as part of a sandwich buns.

title: Hot Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 2 broiler-fryer chickens | 2 -3 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 cup salsa ( your favorite ) | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( like sambal oelek') | 1/2 cup light lemonade ( don't use sweetened ) | 12 -15 large shrimp | romaine lettuce
instructions: Slice the cooked chicken into large bite size pieces. Place all of the ingredients except the shrimp in a crockpot. Shake the bag to mix and let stand for 20 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Place in a serving dish and add a wedge of romaine lettuce to each portion.

title: Sizzlin' Juan
ingredients: 2 pounds ground beef round | 2 cubes beef bouillon | 1/4 cup tequila
instructions: Mix the ground beef, beef bouillon, and tequila together in a skillet large enough to hold all the meat at once. Cook, stirring continuously, over medium low heat until meat is evenly browned and tender, and as thick as you like your soup, about 1 1/2 hours. Cook time will vary depending on the desired thickness of the meat.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,white wine vinegar,gingerroot,chow mein noodle
title: Chinese Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 1 ounce fresh gingerroot, chopped | 7 ounces chow mein noodles | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Clean the chicken well and place in saucepan of boiling water. Make sure it's at the joints with a fork poke holes with a knife at the neck end. Turn down the heat and place the chicken in the saucepan. Boil rapidly in a large saucepan for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is tender when pierced with a fork. title: Lettuce Salad With Fresh Mint

instructions: To make the mint dressing, combine all ingredients in a jar with a lid or loose fitting lid, shake well. title: Greek Scallops With Spinach
ingredients: 12 large scallops | 1/3 cup semolina ( fine crumbs ) | 6 cups torn fresh spinach, washed thoroughly | 1 cup grated gruyere cheese | romaine lettuce, washed and trimmed
instructions: Preheat over to 400°f in a large skillet, place scallops over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently until lightly browned on the outside but still soft in the center, about 2 minutes. Remove scallops and set aside. Add semolina in a thick, dry skillet and toast until fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from skillet and set aside on a plate covered with paper towel. Wipe skillet clean with paper towels and return scallops to the skillet, then add spinach and top with scallops. Sprinkle with gruyere. Arrange on a large platter and serve warm.

instructions: Drain pasta, return pasta to baking dish and toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil mix in the tomatoes and 1 teaspoon salt and pepper toss in mushrooms and pistachios and season with lemon juice. Add drained pasta and 1 cup hot water, toss again and put in an oven at 400 deg. For 30 - 40 minute serve. This takes from a health gourmet.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°. Cut off the top 1/4 inch of each pepper so that they stand upright in a flat baking dish. Place them cut side down onto a baking sheet sprinkled with papertowels and top with the remaining pepper. Bake for 30 - 45 minutes until just tender and the peppers are soft. Remove from the oven. Allow them to cool, then cut them in half lengthwise. Using a spoon, scrape out the pulp from the pepper shells by scraping out all the white pulp. Reserve the shells. Chop the pulp roughly and set aside. Place the tomatoes and the chopped prosciutto in a heatproof bowl. Add the reserved pulp, five spice and garam masala powder and mix together. Wrap each pepper half tightly in a piece of bacon, securing with string. Arrange them onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush each pepper with the pineapple juice/pineapple juice mixture. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until lightly browned. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.

title: Oriental Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 medium eggplants | 2 -4 tablespoons soya sauce | peaches
instructions: Skin eggplants and slice lengthways into 3cm rounds. Place rounds on a baking tray on a low shelf and bake at 180c for 20 – 30miness. Scoop out pulp and place in a bowl. Use as little or as much soya as you like and sprinkle over the pulp and allow to cool completely. Slice the eggplants then cut each round into 4 slices. Lay out on a board with a sharp knife and with a sharp knife slice between the slices into 3 fingers or 1/2 pieces. Using a spatula arrange pieces on top of the eggplant and spoon over more soya sauce. Top with slices of peaches and serve.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,beef stock,chicken breast half,apricot,green pepper
title: Chicken Breasts Au Jus
ingredients: 1 large boneless skinless chicken breast half | 1 green pepper, cut into 1 1/2-inch squares | 1 can diced apricots, drained | 4 slices swiss cheese | 3/4 cup beef stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f if using a 9x13 baking dish, cut the chicken breast from the meat to make 16 equal cubes. Place the chicken in the 1 1/2 cup glass baking dish. Top with pepper and apricots. Top with swiss cheese. Combine the beef stock and remaining ingredients until well blended. Pour this over the swiss cheese mixture and stir. Cover, and bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Faux Fried Green Chilies
ingredients: 4 -6 green chilies, minced | 3 -4 eggs, beaten | 1 container bean sprouts, steamed
instructions: Heat a medium size frying pan to medium heat, or use a wok. Stir fry chilies in hot oil for 2 minutes, or until crisp tender. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, combine eggs with green chilies. Gently mix until eggs are cooked and green chili is hot. Pour egg mixture over green chili mixture. Stir fry quickly approximately 2 - 3 minutes, constantly stirring. Add bean sprouts for a few seconds before taking off heat. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,thyme sprig,seltzer water,colby cheese,cooking spray,five spice powder
title: Cheese Tandoori (Cheese Pots De Crème)
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 cups colby cheese, shredded | 4 scotch bonnet chiles or 4 cardamom pods, seeds removed, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons thyme sprigs, fresh, chopped | 5 -6 fresh thyme sprigs, for garnish | 1 1/2 - 2 cups seltzer water | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder, to taste
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Spray the top side of 2 large soup bowls with cooking spray. Place the cheese, scotch bonnet chiles, and herbs in a bowl. Add the seltzer water and five spice powder. Gently stir. Divide amongst the 2 soup bowls. Spray the tops of each with cooking spray. Set aside for 20 minutes to set before serving. Note, i use a non stick fry pan which has been very hot. I do not use the broiler. I do not use a pot because they cook quickly. The cooking time may vary on your oven.

title: Chinese Style Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs lean boneless pork | 1/4 cup water chestnuts
instructions: Trim fat and bone from pork. Place in a dutch oven or other heavy 5 - 6 quart kettle. Add water and heat to boiling. Cover and simmer slowly for 1 1/2 hours or until very tender.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,corn cob,red food coloring,dark rum,green onion,tomato puree
title: Caribbean Style Grilled Corn on the Cob (Aka Arjadina)
ingredients: 4 large corn on the cob, husked | 2 teaspoons dark rum ( or coconut rum ) | 2 tablespoons red food coloring | 1 1/2 cups tomato puree | sliced green onion | 3/4 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Light the grill and grill corn husks over medium heat. Remove corn from the husks and set aside. Rinse corn under cold water and cut corn kernels off of the cob. Transfer corn to a large bowl.

title: Chocolate Baked in Adobo Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1 loaf unsliced cake | 1 jar raspberry jam | 1 - 1 1/2 cup parsley flakes ( or cilantro ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped jalapeno | 2 -3 teaspoons chipotles in adobo sauce ( chipotles ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 ounces unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Slice the loaf of bread into 8 - 10 slices diagonally. Remove the cheese from the bread and discard. Break apart the slices and then cut the slices into pieces about 1/2 inch thick. Layer the slices of bread in a greased 13x9 inch baking dish starting with the bread then topping off with 1/4 cup of jam. Drench the slices with the chipotles for an extra kick and keep adding slices of bread until there are no more bread on the top layer. Spread the remaining 1+/2 cup of jam on top of the bread slices and top each with half of the cheese slices. Bake in a 350°f oven for 25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the jam has thickened slightly. To make the adobo pepper jelly, place the jalapeño in a small saucepan. Add 1/4 cup water and heat on low, stirring frequently to loosen any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Remove from the heat. Stir in the parsley and remaining jalapeño. Transfer to a jar and add 2 - 3 tsp of salt. Cover and store for up to 2 weeks. When you are ready to bake, bake in a 350°f oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until the cheese is browned. Remove from the oven and slice into 1/4 slices. Place the sliced slices on top of the melted cheese and bake in a 350°f oven until golden brown.

title: Chana Chaat
ingredients: 1/3 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/3 iceberg lettuce, chopped | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Prepare grill or broiler setting. Lightly oil grill or broiler rack. Place asafetida on an ungreased, paper lined sheet of foil. Sprinkle and toss asafoetida with chickpeas and lettuce. Cook for 3 or 4 minutes, or until the lettuce is lightly browned and asafoetida is slightly crisp. Sprinkle with cheese. Serve with rice.

title: Homemade Caraway Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, or to taste | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Place the caraway seeds and lemon juice in the bowl of a food processor. Process until finely ground. Add the sea salt and process until smooth.

title: Thai Coconut Champuru
ingredients: 50 g green peppers | 1 cup canned coconut cream | 500 g napa or 500 g swiss chard | 450 g snow peas
instructions: Cut the green peppers into thin strips and cut the napa and swiss chard into small cubes. Heat up the coconut cream and then add the green chili and green peppers. Stir until hot then pour the coconut cream into the vegetables and stir to cover. Allow to simmer on a medium heat until they are tender. When the green chili is done just add the snow peas. Continue to stir until they are hot enough.

title: Black Mushrooms & Chocolate
ingredients: 2 cans chinese black mushrooms | 250 g dark chocolate | marshmallows ( to serve )
instructions: Line an 11x17cm glass trays with silicone paper. Rinse the mushrooms under cold water and wipe dry. Using a small knife, thinly slice the caps. Heat wok over medium high until hot. Add mushroom slices and stir fry for 1 - 2 mins or until browned. Remove from pan and set aside. Add 50g chocolate to the pan and melt until smooth. Stir through green miremallows. Pour over mushrooms and bake until melted. Cool for 5 mins or until set. Cut into wedges.

title: Korean Chicken Wings
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings | 3 tablespoons sweet white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place wings in a large roasting pan. Brush lightly with the wine. The goal is to cover the wings with a little of the wine throughout. Season the wings with salt and pepper. Roast the wings for 1 hour, basting occasionally, or until the wings are browned and crisp.. Remove the wings from the oven and let come to room temperature. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: espresso,canadian bacon,milk chocolate chip total,granny smith apple
title: Apple-Almond Mousse
ingredients: 10 ounces canadian bacon, chopped | 2 granny smith apples, peeled, cored, chopped. total | 1/2 cup milk chocolate chips, to taste | 2 teaspoons instant espresso, powder
instructions: Melt chocolate chips in microwave or oven.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,chicken bouillon cube,plain flour,italian tomato paste,salt,spaghetti,arborio rice,golden raisin
title: My Beef and Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless chuck roast, trimmed | 2 1/2 cups uncooked arborio rice | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 cans italian-style tomato paste | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes with juice | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Trim fat from roast and cut into bite size chunks and marinade in the following the following order, 1/4 pound bag of arborio rice. 2 1/2 cups of water, 1 of the bouillon cubes and 1 can of tomatoes with juice. Bring to a boil. Add the remaining 1/4 pound of beef, raisins, remaining boullion cubes and salt. Turn slow cooker to high. Cover and cook until liquid is almost gone, 3 hours, 15 minutes on high or 5 hours on low cooker. Remove beef chunks with a slotted spoon and place in a casserole dish with remaining sauce. Cover and keep warm. Stir flour into 1/4 cup of hot beef sauce with a little water, stir into mixture. Pour into casserole to thicken sauce a little bit, then serve over pasta.

title: Sausages Wrapped in Fresh Strawberries With Creamy Garlic & Strawberries
ingredients: 4 -5 links sweet sausages, cut 1 inch thick | 1 cup whole green seedless grapes | 1 container light sour cream | 1 1/2 cups hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | 12 ounces packaged baby fresh strawberries, halved lengthwise | cooked spiral shaped pasta
instructions: Cook your spaghetti according to package directions, drain and set aside while you cook the sausages. In a small bowl whisk together the sour cream, hoisin sauce and garlic powder. Heat the large nonstick skillet over medium heat until a drop of water sizzles. Dip the sausages into the sour cream mixture and then arrange them on the skillet. Cook the sausages until they are thoroughly browned on all sides, around 4 - 5 minutes depending on the size of the sausages. You don't want to cook them completely through at this point. Spoon the hot cooked spaghetti over the sausages. Top with the fresh strawberries and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sourdough bread,shrimp,fennel seed,southeast asian fish sauce,gingerroot
title: Thai Seafood Toast
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 slices sourdough bread | 10 -12 ounces raw shrimp ( or equivalent ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons thai fish sauce, to taste | 10 -12 inches slice fresh gingerroot
instructions: Heat a griddle pan and put fennel seeds on the griddle pan, add scallops to the griddle pan or your griddle pan. Turn frequently for even cooking. Turn shrimp to the side only and cook for about 2 or 3 minutes on each side. Let the shrimp curl back up in the pan if necessary. Drain the shrimp and add the fish sauce to taste. Add ginger slices and stir. Serve with sweet chilli sticky rice.

title: Choclo Mole
ingredients: 1 -2 dried ancho chile ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons water | 1 -2 cup cooked cannelloni tube | 1 -2 cup pinto beans, drained | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup chopped dark chocolate, of your choice
instructions: Place chopped chocolate in bowl, top with chopped chile and keep chocolates in a double thickness of paper towels. Microwave uncovered on high for 2 minutes until melted then place into bowl and add 1 - 2 tsp water and stir until well combined. Microwave other 1 - 2 minutes to soften and deseed chiles, and stir. Place chile mix in medium size clear bowl, add drained canelloni, 2 cups of warm beans and stir. Microwave on high for 2 minutes then stir and microwave until mixture is well combined. Add remaining water. Stir well and cover with a double thick cloth and allow to sit at room temperature for 2 hours. You may now add any more spice of your choice like paprika, cayenne or fajitas.

Random Ingredients: butter,seasoning salt,ginger,monterey jack cheese,self raising flour,guacamole
title: Guacamole Bites
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter | 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup other cheese, of choice | 1 can guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees or grill. Set aside 1/4 cup cheese in a bowl. Sift flour, salt and ginger. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Place the mixture on a greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle top of the cheese on top. Bake for about 30 minutes. Serve hot on a platter and enjoy you can make the guacamole the night before and refrigerate overnight.

title: Quinoa Pilaf
ingredients: 8 cups quinoa, rinsed | 1 can beefsteak tomatoes | 1/2 cup dry-roasted unsweetened chocolate | 1/4 pear, sliced
instructions: Cook quinoa and let cool. Once cool, fluff with fork and then set aside. Pour quinoa over tomatoes and mix. Add chocolate and stir until melted, about 5 minutes. Garnish with pear slices.

title: Beets in Cardamom Cream (Kuwaiti)
ingredients: 1 lb beet | 3/4 cup single cream | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 6 tablespoons rice wine ( i use khaliji )
instructions: Peel the beet, but do not peel. Cut the beet with a knife into 1/2 inch slices. Place the slices in a single layer in a saucepan with 1/2 cup of water. Cover the pan and cook over moderate heat. When the water boils, remove the pan from the heat. Leave the water at a boil. In a small bowl, beat the cream with the cardamom. Keep aside and keep the beet warm. Place a clean towel over it and place the pot under it, so that the excess water drains all over. Wipe the towel and return the cream to it. Cover the pot and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Serve the beet in individual bowls with a generous helping of cream. Note, it is important to make sure the beet is cooked. It is best to prepare the beet just before serving, as it will loose the juices.

title: Lebanese Mint Preserves
ingredients: 150 g fresh mint | 2 tablespoons lemon zest, fresh
instructions: Clean and finely grate mint into a small pan without touching mint. Remove the leaves, wash well, and finely chop. Place mint in a glass preserving jar, add lemon zest and cover top. Leave in a cool place, it will keep for up to 24 hours, but you shouldn't need to refrigerate it for longer than required by the timing of the mint's usage.

title: Crock Pot Caribbean Style Broiled Rib Celery
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style ribs ( such as celery, turnips, onions and celery ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh shrimp ( uncooked, shell shrimp, deveined, halved or 1 lb shrimp from 1-lb carton, uncooked shrimp ) | 12 fresh slices celery | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup chicken fat free mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon sugar substitute | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon white peppercorns
instructions: Marinate shrimp in ingredients for 1 hour in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Put rack in center of oven. Place celery on rack. Turn meat of celery meat onto rack in oven. Bake for 30 minutes at 400 degrees. Turn meat on rack and bake for another 30 minutes, basting frequently with marinade. Remove pan of celery. Cut each celery into 3 to 4 pieces. Remove meat carefully from shrimp pan. Slice into 4 pieces, about 1/4 inch wide. To make mayonnaise. In a large bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar substitute and celery salt and stir until mix is smooth and creamy.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,hamburger bun,xanthan gum,ziti pasta,filet mignon,bibb lettuce,asiago cheese
title: Ziti Fonzoni
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta ( dried rigatoni recommended ) | 4 pieces filet mignon | 2 tablespoons ground chili flakes | 2 tablespoons bibb lettuce ( shredded ) | 1/4 cup asiago cheese ( shredded ) | 1 tablespoon wheat bibb lettuce ( shredded ) | 4 hamburger buns
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions to desired doneness. Meanwhile, spray pan with pam. Season meat with chili flakes and set aside.

title: Aunt Dot's Quinoa and Meat-Filling
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups quinoa | 2 lbs ground meat | 2 cups chopped meat | 10 ounces gelatin powder | 6 ounces orange juice | 1 3/4 cups chopped cabbage, with some of the leaves chopped ( about 6 cups ) or 1 3/4 cups shredded spinach ( about 6 cups ) | 3 ounces citron-flavored gelatin powder
instructions: First, place the quinoa in a large pot over medium high heat and bring to a boil. Cover the pot and turn the heat to low. Let sit in a warm place until the liquid is absorbed, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Prepare the gelatin by placing half of the gelatin mix and half of the orange juice in a bowl. Use a wire whisk to whip the gelatin and orange juice thoroughly into the remaining gelatin mix. Add the other half of the orange juice and whisk. Add the meat, cabbage and ginger. Mix thoroughly. Chill several hours or overnight. Prepare the filling by mixing the two gelatin mixes with the chopped cabbage and spinach. Once the meat is firm and the cheese has melted, pour the filling into a 9x13 inch casserole. Cook at 325 degrees for 60 to 70 minutes. The filling should set. Serve on a plate with a garnish of chopped chives and sliced cucumber.

title: Wild Rice and Avocado Casserole
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers, divided | 1 cup wild rice, prepared according to package directions ( or other grain of your choosing ) | 1 -2 avocado, peeled, pitted, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 large onion, diced into small pieces | 1 package mixed mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Prepare wild rice according to package directions using your favorite method, you may also use quick rice. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread half the wild rice evenly over the baking sheet. Cover rice with a layer of sliced avocados, then more wild rice. Repeat layers and then top with sliced onions. Cover with a layer of sliced mushrooms. Cover with parchment paper and then foil. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve. To store for longer storage, freeze up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: beef,orzo pasta,white pearl onion,white onion,prosciutto,queso fresco,pinto bean
title: Fiesta Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef, lean | 1 white onion, diced small | 8 ounces dry pinto beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 12 ounces beef broth or 12 ounces low sodium beef bouillon | 6 ounces orzo pasta ( uncooked ) or 6 ounces rotini pasta, uncooked | 10 slices thinly sliced prosciutto or 10 slices deli ham | 8 g shredded provolone cheese or 8 g mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cook beef and onion in skillet until beef is no longer pink and onion is tender, stirring frequently. Add beans, broth and pasta. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,chili sauce,red pepper flake,poppy seed,beet,mustard seed,onion
title: Beets and Onion Skewers
ingredients: 3 pounds large beets, peeled and cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick slices | 3 large onions, cut into 3/4-inch thick slices | 1 1/2 cups sweet and dark barbecue sauce | 1 cup chili sauce | 1 tablespoon poppy seeds | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place beets and onions into a large stock pot.

Random Ingredients: risotto rice,sazon goya,sunflower oil,fusilli,serrano chili,parsley,spanish onion
title: Fusilli With Onion & Cilantro  Scented
ingredients: 8 ounces risotto rice | 1 packet sazon goya | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 spanish onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1 serrano chili, finely chopped | 1/2 lb fusilli, cooked
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to boil and add the rice. Turn down the heat and cook for 15 minutes. Allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes to allow the excess water to drain. Heat the oil in a sauté pan or wok. Once hot, add the onion and serrano and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until the onion has softened slightly. Add the cooked rice to the pan and using your hands, mash well until all of your grains have softened and absorbed the fragrance of the onion and the seasoning. Stir in the parsley, chilies and fusilli, and cook until warmed through.

title: Persian Pudding
ingredients: 1/4 cup ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1/2 cup rice | 1 3/4 cups chicken stock
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium low heat. Add rice and stirring often, fry rice with ghee for 1 minute. Stir in chicken stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Couscous Basics (Couscous, Couscous & Vanilla Extract)
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 1 vanilla bean, cut into 6 pieces
instructions: Scoop out vanilla pod and discard. Rinse & dry your container of couscous with cool water. In the bowl of an electric mixer, add the vanilla pod, 1 cup of couscous, & 1 tbsp of yogurt. Stir well with clean dry rice paddle or wooden spoon.. Turn onto dry table & allow to cool to room temp. Once your couscous has cooled to room temperature, break up into smaller pieces & fold into smaller chunks. Chill for at least 1 hour before using.

Random Ingredients: white onion,spanish onion,zucchini,strawberry,green bell pepper,baking soda,white bean,lamb
title: Lamb & Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lamb, cubed | 12 ounces white beans, in their liquid | 3 ounces green bell peppers, chopped | 1 medium spanish onion, chopped | 1 medium zucchini, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh strawberries, sliced | 1/4 cup white onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced
instructions: In 2 qt casserole.. Cook lamb, bell pepper, onion, zucchini 5 minutes. Stir in beans and cook gently over medium heat 10 minutes. Stir in whites and baking soda. Stir in strawberries. Cover with foil. Bake in 350 deg. F oven 40 - 40 minutes until tender.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,dill,oyster sauce,cremini mushroom,napa cabbage,sherry wine,crab
title: Crabs With Cabbage, Snow Peas, and Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 large cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons minced garlic or 2 tablespoons minced scallions | 3 tablespoons dry sherry wine, such as a spicy white | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh dill ( optional ) | 1/2 lb fresh snow pea | 1 bag napa cabbage, leaves separated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place mushrooms and garlic in a bowl, pour in sherry, then cover and refrigerate. Place cabbage on foil lined baking sheet and set aside. Remove mushrooms from their plastic containers and slice in half lengthwise, discarding ends and caps. Toss cabbage with a little sherry to coat. Arrange 3/4 cup of the mushrooms in a single layer on top of the mushrooms, then top with 2 tablespoons of the garlic. Arrange peas over the garlic, dot with oyster sauce, and sprinkle with dill if using. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes more or until the cabbage is hot. Divide napa among 6 serving bowls, top with cabbage, and serve immediately.

title: Cherry Lime Pie
ingredients: 8 ounces pitted cherries | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Process the zest and juice of the lime and cherries until the zest is finely chopped, 1 - 2 tbsp. Stir in the flour and mix well. Pour into a greased and lightly floured tart tin. Bake at 400 degrees f for about 30 minutes, until the base is golden. Remove from the oven and leave to cool. The centre should be a little jiggly, but you can pierce it with a skewer if required before turning out.

title: Lamb with Parsley
ingredients: 300 g beef ( cubed ) | 150 g lamb ( cubed ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley ( chopped )
instructions: Heat oil and add asafoetida. When they begin to splutter, add beef and lamb and brown on medium heat. Serve immediately with mixed salad, rice or naan bread. Makes 3 serving servings depending on the quantity you are serving. Makes 3 serving.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,water chestnut,basil,red kidney bean,picante sauce,flat iron steak,nori,tomato ketchup
title: Noodles with Meat
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 12 ounces nori | 10 ounces pinto beans, rinsed | 2 cans stewed tomatoes with ketchup | 2 cans red kidney beans | 2 cans sliced water chestnuts | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon basil
instructions: Cut the pork into chunks and brown in a large skillet. Place in large pot with remaining ingredients and simmer until meat is tender, stirring occasionally. Place in large bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Perfect Seasonal Dipping Sauce or Sandwich Croutons
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Put the mayonnaise in a serving bowl. Sprinkle with salt and freshly ground pepper. Use your hands to mix well, adjusting seasoning to desired taste. Serve with crackers or on toasted bread slices.

title: Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1 liter fish stock | 1 bunch spring onion
instructions: Heat stock in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to the boil. Remove from heat. In batches, add fish, stir and heat through. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, shred spring onions stir through. Stir in mixture. Serve in warm mugs.

title: Apricot-Glazed Glazed Apricots On the Grill
ingredients: 24 apricot jam slices | 1/4 cup dashi | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Brush on apricots.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,tomato sauce,balsamic vinegar,grain white rice,button mushroom
title: Balsamic Fried Rice - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 4 cups uncooked long grain white rice ( long grain is best ) | 1 jar button mushrooms | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | ice cube
instructions: Rinse rice, drain. Set aside. Place mushrooms in a large stock or pressure cooker, with the tomato sauce and balsamic vingear. Cover and heat over high heat until boiling. When rice is just about to boil, place 1 or 2 ice cubes in pot, then quickly close lid, set timer to 15 to 20 minutes. Remove lid, fluff rice with a fork then serve. If you would like to make this an hour ahead, it will need to be kept on tightly lid in a cool place.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,parmesan cheese,almond extract,quinoa,pico de gallo
title: Quinoa Potato and Parmesan Snack Wedges
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked quinoa | 2 large baking potatoes, cut into wedges | 1/4 cup finely chopped toasted almond extract | 3/4 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup pico de gallo ( salsa fresca )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pour quinoa evenly on a baking sheet. Cover, and bake for 20 minutes. While quinoa is baking, combine potatoes, and almonds in a large bowl. Toss with grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,french green bean,tart apple,yellow pea,tomato puree,plain yogurt,cream mushroom soup,cilantro leaf
title: Curried Green Beans and Apples With Tzatziki
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 2 teaspoons tomato puree | 1 can french style green beans, drained | 1/2 cup frozen yellow peas, thawed | 2 tart apples, thinly sliced ( any coloured apple ) | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Preheat oven to in a medium bowl combine yogurt, soup, tomato puree, green beans, peas, apples and cilantro. Stir well. Spread vegetables into an oven proof dish sprayed with cooking spray. Bake, uncovered, for 40 - 50 mins or until tender. Serve topped with tzatziki, if desired.

Random Ingredients: topping,yellow squash,oat,green chilies,icing sugar,rom tomato,pine nut
title: Mexican Rommon (Vegetable Rollat Cake)
ingredients: 100 g oats | 175 g green chilies | 175 g pine nuts | 1 grated roma tomato | 1/3 cup chopped yellow squash | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/3 cup topping
instructions: Spread both ends of the rolled out to line the base and sides of a 10 springform cake tin. Mix together the oats, chillies and pine nuts in a bowl. Add the tomato, squash, icing sugar, and topping and mix well. Spread into the pastry lined tin. Bake in 180c oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until cooked. Cool for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,poppy seed,shiitake mushroom,quinoa,bohemian malt syrup
title: German Quinoa With Cream Cheese and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 3/4 cup quinoa, rinsed or 3/4 cup brown rice, washed in 2 changes of water and drained | 2 -4 ounces shiitake mushrooms, wiped clean and sliced | 12 ounces cream cheese, cut into small chunks ( neapolone is good ) | 1/4 cup poppy seed | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wheat germ or 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 1/2 cup italian malt syrup
instructions: Put rice, mushrooms, cream cheese chunks, and dried wheat germ in a food processor. Blend until mixture resembles crumbs. Add malt syrup and puree until it feels smooth. Add more syrup to taste. Add a squeeze of lime juice, if desired. Serve warm, room temperature, or chilled. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coriander sprig,clove,catsup,yellow bell pepper,purpose flour,almond extract,mustard powder,graham cracker crumb
title: Gramma Daly's Spicy Bell Pepper Pop Cookies
