ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder ( divided ) | 1/3 cup unsulfured catsup, divided | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/3 cup sliced almonds or 1/3 cup slivered almonds | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 1 coriander sprig, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, stir together the flour, cloves, mustard powder, 1/3 cup catsup and ½ cup of almonds or slivered almonds. Stir in the remaining ingredients and the pepper. Using your hands, form the mixture into small, uniform balls and place on the parchment lined cookie sheets. Using a small, sharp knife, make an indentation in the center of each ball. Bake on cookie sheets until the edges of the cookies are pale gold, 8 to 12 minutes. Remove from the oven and transfer the pop to a wire rack to cool.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,tart apple,celery,ginger,tomato paste,tomato puree,pork loin roast
title: Apple-Glazed Pork Loin
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 2 large tart apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 1 lb eggplant, peeled, sliced | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 cup finely chopped celery | 1/2 cup ginger, minced
instructions: Lay the meat on a rack in a roasting pan and roast uncovered until the meat is cooked to your preference. Allow to rest to at least 15 minutes before carving. Remove the meat from the pan and brush off any fat from the pan. Set aside. Boil the apple and eggplant slices in lightly salted water until slightly softened. Drain and set aside. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Spread the tomato paste evenly over the pork loin roast. Add the sliced apples and eggplant. Toss well. Arrange in a roasting pan. For the topping, heat the oil in a large saucepan over high heat. Saute the celery and ginger for 1 more minute. Pour over the chops. Cover the pan with aluminum foil. Bake for 2 hours or until the pork is fork tender.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,coriander,ricotta cheese,icing sugar,dark sesame oil,flat leaf italian parsley,water chestnut,cooking brown rice
title: Melt in Mouth Rice Balls With a Kick!
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain white cook in rice ( brown rice, white basmati, jasmine rice ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 200 g ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1/3 teaspoon coriander or 1/3 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 600 g dark unsweetened chocolate, melted
instructions: Cook rice according to packet instructions and set aside. Meanwhile, heat a wok or large frying pan over medium heat. Add 2 tablespoons of sesame oil and the water chestnuts and stir fry for 5 minutes or until water chestnuts are lightly cooked and drain. Remove the wok from the heat, add remaining oil, remaining sesame oil, ricotta cheese and chopped parsley. Stir fry for a further 2 minutes. Stir in the rice, mix well and taste seasoning, adding more sesame oil if it seems dry. Cover and set aside in refrigerator for 20 minutes. Stir fry the chillies for 2 minutes or until just piping hot. Dip hands in melted chocolate and scoop rounded teaspoonfuls of rice mixture. Use the back of a spoon to flatten them as you go. Leave the rissel rice balls to cool for a while. Place in an ovenproof dish and set aside, allowing room for spreading later. Pour remaining melted chocolate into a small saucepan and add remaining sesame oil and the icing sugar. Cook over medium low heat until smooth. When chocolate is melted, spoon onto centre of rice balls. Serve and enjoy this dish should serve around 5 to 6 people depending on desired levels of sweetness.

title: Homemade Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, washed and trimmed | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Fill medium pot about half full with water. Place cauliflower in the pot. Turn heat to medium low. Cover the pot and set aside to steam and steam for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally. If cauliflower starts to darken, raise the heat so the water doesn't burn. Once the cauliflower is tender, drain it very well. Place cauliflower on a large plate. In a salad bowl, toss cauliflower with lemon juice, garlic powder and olive oil. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,mace,honeydew melon,cauliflower,red pepper flake,tomato juice,bay leaf,hoagie
title: Bergie's Roasted Hawaiian Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 large maui-style beef stew meat | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 can sliced baby carrots | 2 cups cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup honeydew melon ( peeled and sliced thin ) | 1/4 cup red pepper flakes | 2 bay leaves | 10 hoagie rolls, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the beef, tomatoes, carrots, cauliflower, honeydew melon slices, red pepper flakes and bay leaves into a large non stick baking pan. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour or until the beef is tender and falling off the bone. To serve, spread the hoagie halves with the tomato mixture. Place beef and vegetables on rolls and top with remaining hoagie halves.

Random Ingredients: ham,oil,cauliflower,sirloin steak,ketchup,tilapia fillet,yellow bell pepper,graham cracker crumb
title: Baked Beef and Cauliflower Crust
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, rinsed and chopped | 1 lb sirloin steaks ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1-inch squares | 1/4 lb shaved ham | 1/4 lb shaved deli-style smoked ham | 1/4 lb ketchup | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Cook cauliflower in boiling water for 6 minutes until tender crisp, drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer cauliflower, meat, bell pepper, ham, smoked ham and ketchup in the greased baking dish, and top with graham cracker crumbs. Drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Mexican Phyllo Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mexican rice ( or other local grain ) ( optional ) | 2 -3 teaspoons coriander seeds ( or cilantro ) | 12 sheets phyllo pastry ( frozen ) | 12 cups brussels sprouts, trimmed
instructions: Bring water to a boil, add the rice, season to taste with salt, cover and reduce to low. Cook for 20 minutes, stir in the coriander and set aside until the liquid has been absorbed.. Preheat the oven to 450°f. Line a baking sheet with foil on the bottom, then arrange phyllo on top. Cut each sheet in half to form two long sheets. Cover with overlapping foil to prevent drying out. Place each sheet on the baking sheet, about 5x3 inches. Cover with plastic wrap. Bake for 15 minutes then uncover the phyllo and bake for an additional five minutes. Sprinkle the cooked rice over the pastry while still slightly hot, allowing it to bubble over. Place the sprouts over the top of the pastry and bake for another 3 minutes, or until the sprouts are tender and crispy.

title: Chinese Beef
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 2 -3 tablespoons oyster sauce | pepper
instructions: Slice steak crosswise in narrow slices. In bowl, mix well. Add oyster sauce and pepper to taste. Marinate for 1/2 hour. Serve.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,coffee powder,bacon grease,madeira wine,iceberg lettuce,chicken broth
title: Spanish Madeira Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup bacon grease or 1/2 cup olive oil | 6 cups chicken or 6 cups vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons madeira wine ( use good quality madeira wine, if available ) | 1 tablespoon instant coffee powder | 6 teaspoons guacamole | 1 small iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat until hot.. Add broth and madeira and simmer until liquid is reduced by half. Stir in coffee. Stir in guacamole. Cover and cook over low heat until soup is thickened and flavors have blended, about 10 minutes. Serve topped with shredded lettuce.

title: Chinese Cabbage and Stuffing
ingredients: 1/2 pound small head cabbage | 1 package stove top stuffing mix | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese | 1/2 cup fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Mix stuffing mix and romano cheese in a large bowl. Slice cabbage in half lengthwise slices. Gently place a cabbage slice down the center of a stuffed cabbage slice in the baking dish. Squeeze the stuffing mix into the cabbage slivers. Drizzle stuffing over stuffing and sprinkle with romano cheese. Cover baking dish tightly with foil. Bake for 50 minutes. Uncover, and continue cooking for 5 minutes, or until stuffing is hot and cabbage is tender.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,nacho cheese flavor doritos,corn tortilla,self rising flour,flat leaf parsley
title: Nacho-Rice Snack Wrap
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 2 cups nacho cheese flavor doritos, chips | 1/2 cup corn tortilla, strips | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f in medium bowl, combine barley, doritos, tortilla strips, and parsley and mix well. Place 1 tablespoon of barley mixture in center of each corn tortilla. Roll up and place each wrap, seam side down, on ungreased baking sheet. Bake about 25 minutes or until bread is crunchy.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,tuna water,pear,crabmeat,sage leaf,white wine,onion powder
title: Crock Pot Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 can tuna in water | 3 tablespoons dry white wine | 4 tablespoons fresh sage leaves | 3/4 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 can sliced pears, drained but not rinsed | 1 teaspoon crushed dried crabmeat
instructions: Heat the tuna and wine in a saucepan, stir in the sage, lemon pepper, onion powder, pears and crab/pears. Cover and cook on low for 3 to 4 hours, stir the salad occasionally, and continue to cook on high for 15 to 30 minutes, or until the tuna mixture is crunsy and the pear slices have begun to break down and curl.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,dill pickle,almond paste,spring onion,black mushroom,corn niblets,lime zest,chicken stock
title: Coconut Balls With Smoked Mushrooms, Corn Noodles, Dill Pickles & Almonds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coconut oil ( not olive ) | 1 bunch spring onion, cut into 8 pieces | 1 fresh dill pickle | 2 teaspoons fresh lime zest | 2 tablespoons almond paste ( may substitute 2 tsp. of dried sesame seeds, finely chopped ) | 2 cups chicken stock ( may substitute light brown ) | 3 tablespoons canned corn niblets, drained | 1 tablespoon sliced black mushroom
instructions: Warm coconut oil, add spring onions and chopped pickle and stir fry for 5 minutes or until spring onions are transparent. Remove from heat and add almond paste. Add chicken stock, bring to boil, simmer for 5 - 7 minutes or until spring onions are soft. Add canned corn niblets, return to boil, stirring gently. Drain nuts, stir into mixture. Stir in sliced mushrooms and chill for at least 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,kidney bean,vanilla pod,beer,vegetable broth
title: Red Bean Smoothies (Guiness)
ingredients: 1/2 cup beer or 1/2 cup ale, good quality | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon orange juice or 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 vanilla pod, seeds scraped
instructions: Whisk together beer, beans, broth, orange juice and vanilla pod. Place in blender or food processor with vanilla and blend until smooth. Transfer to pitcher. Serve with ice cubes.

title: Lobster's Green Bean and Crab Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh green beans, cut in 2 inch pieces | 1/2 lb imitation crabmeat, picked over | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons dates, slivered
instructions: Place beans in a pot with water to cover and boil for about 5 minutes. Do not overboil. Drain if necessary. Combine crabmeat and confectioners sugar in a bowl. Toss with hot beans to coat. Pour over cheese mixture and top with dates. Serve warm.

title: Hungarian Pasties
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork | 2 ounces ground veal | 1/2 cup semolina | 1/2 cup fresh fruit, chopped finely | 6 tablespoons sugar snap peas | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 teaspoon raw sugar ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except the peas and honey, well and shape into thin roll about 8 x 8 inches. Cut rolls lengthwise into 4 equal sections. Braid pasties with peas and honey. Bake at 180°c for 45 min, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,onion powder,red curry paste,dark chocolate,durkee onion,soy sauce
title: Spicy Beef in Black Pepper!
ingredients: 250 g brocolli, minced very finely | 250 g frozen chopped broccoli | 1 tablespoon instant red curry paste ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground dark chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine minced beef, broccoli and other ingredients in a microwave safe dish. Cover securely, microwave for 5 minutes power. Stir to combine.

title: Creamy Salsa Filled Breakfast
ingredients: 2 slices bread, toasted | 1 1/2 cups natural yoghurt | 1 tablespoon hot salsa | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 cup fruit, your choice | 1/4 cup blue cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Chill until ready to use.

title: Sukiyaki Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans bamboo shoots | 1 cup textured molasses | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast
instructions: Drain and rinse the bamboo shoots and reserve the liquid. Place the shoots in a plastic bag with liquid, vinegar, molasses, catsup, and nutritional yeast. Add your soy sauce and mix. Serve over jasmine rice or other grain of your choosing.

title: Caper Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets, with skin | 2 ounces capers
instructions: Mix the capers and chicken with the capers. Preheat oven to 400°f put the chicken in a baking dish, skin side down, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook in oven, skin side up, for approximately 20 minutes, until the skin and chicken starts to brown. Turn chicken, skin side up, and spoon the remaining sauce over before covering with foil and cooking in the oven for 20 minutes. Turning the chicken breast once.

title: Creamy Mango Fruit Salad
ingredients: 8 medium firm ripe mangoes, peeled and diced | 9 ounces ripe bacon, cooked and crumbled | 10 ounces marinated bamboo shoots, drained and sliced | 1/8 cup raisins | 1 cup heavy cream | 5 ounces angel food cake, cut into pieces
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cake in large bowl. Place in serving dish.

title: Chinese Sausage and Noodles (Oriental Style)
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen udon noodles, thawed and drained | 1 1/2 cups orange frozen pudding mix or 1 1/2 cups instant vanilla pudding mix | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Combine all ingredients, stir. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot and top is slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: mexican corn,summer squash,herb,red cabbage,chili pepper flake,coriander seed,almond flavoring
title: Mexican Corn & Vegetable Salad With Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup corn or 1 cup green beans, cooked | 6 cups red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup summer squash, thinly sliced | 3 -4 cups of your favourite mexican-style vegetables ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander seed | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon almond flavoring ( optional )
instructions: Toss all vegetables in a large salad bowl. Sprinkle with the almonds and the spices, if using. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,sun tomato oil,mango chutney,confectioner ' sugar,chipotle powder,beef stew meat
title: Mexican Beef Kabobs (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 can pomegranate-infused mango chutney | 1 package deli corned beef stew meat, cut into 1/3 in cubes | 2 tablespoons pure sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, cut into slivers | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except pomegranate concentriczine in crock pot, set to high. Stir to mix well. Cook on high for 3 hours.

title: Italian Broccoli - Mushrooms and Zucchini
ingredients: 2 large zucchini, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 large portabella mushrooms, sliced in 1/4 inch thick slices | 6 eggs, beaten | 1 tablespoon pickling salt | 3 heads broccoli, cut into florets | 3/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint
instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange zucchini and mushrooms on a large baking sheet. In a bowl, stir eggs and pickling salt until well beaten. Place the broiled vegetables under broiler and cook until tender and browned, about 7 to 10 minutes. Arrange the vegetable and egg mixture in a single layer in a 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle on basil and mint. Bake in a preheated 375 degrees f oven, basting once or twice, until eggs are set, 10 to 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: The Only Roast  Chuck-O
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs eye of round roast | 1 -2 cup kaffir lime leaf
instructions: If your roast is large, it is easier to remove the strings. If you are small, the meat will need to be sliced in between the skin and the fat. Remove all of the white membrane but leave 1 - 2 tsp of allspice for a milder taste, such as cinnamon and cloves. Place a few slices of meat, or enough, on a skewer, allowing about 3 tbsp of skewer per slice. Insert some more kaffir lime leaves into each piece. If using skewers, make sure to wear gloves and a dish towel to protect them from drying out. Place the meat on the rack in a shallow baking pan and cover with aluminium foil. Place the pan in the oven and allow it to reach a temperature of 115°f on a thermometer. This is where you'll want to baste. Turn the grill down to its highest setting, and set the oven timer for about 7 minutes, or until the meat has become medium rare. After you insert the skewer in the thickest part of the skewer, use the skewer to check that the meat is cooked. If the meat has gotten to medium rare and is reddish brown in spots, lower the oven temperature by about a 1/3 to 1/2 turn the heat down further during cooking. After 7 minutes, remove the roast from the oven and allow it to sit for a few minutes. Carefully remove the top slice of roast and slice into 3/4 to 1 inch slices on a slight diagonal. You will need about 2 to 3 large slabs of beef. Transfer the meat to a platter and cover with foil. Allow to rest another few minutes before serving. Skim excess fat from the juices that rise to the surface and serve with rice or cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,boston lettuce,pasta,oregano,orange juice,self rising flour,swiss cheese
title: Sweet and Sour Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 head boston lettuce, chopped | 8 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 3 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 1 1/4 cups self rising flour | 3/4 cup pasta, cooked, drained & cooled
instructions: Prepare pasta and set aside. In a large bowl, toss together lettuce, cheese, orange juice & oregano. Fold in red curry paste. Set aside 1/4 cup of the mixture. In another bowl, sift flour with reserved liquid/oil, and add pasta. Pour liquid mixture over pasta, stirring until well combined. Cover and chill remaining mixture for at least an hour.

title: Simple Green Curry Fish and Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Whisk curry paste and worcestershire sauce together in a small bowl.

title: Amaretto Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons amaretto | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 cup tomato sauce, warmed
instructions: Stir together the amaretto, oil and tomato sauce. Allow the sauce to warm to serving temperature.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,wonton wrapper,sherry wine,coconut cream,spanish onion,mandarin orange,tomato sauce
title: Oaxacan Fish Dumplings(Oaxacan Style) #5FIX
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fully boneless skinless cod fish fillets | 3/4 cup spanish onion | 1 package wonton wrappers | 2 medium tomatoes, small | 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 chipotle chiles, chopped fresh, if desired | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine
instructions: Remove bone and skin from fish and cut into chunks of 1/4 to 3/8 inch size. Cut reserved fish meat from bones into 1/2 inch bite sized pieces. Cut off any large, long green bits that float to the surface and slice thin crosswise. Peel and quarter peeled onion.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,okra,fettuccine pasta,chicken bouillon,swiss cheese,snow pea,beef tenderloin
title: Beef Tenderloins with Okra
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup warm chicken stock ( or enough for a thicker sauce ) | 1 1/2 lbs low-russeradish beef tenderloin, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 3 packages frozen okra, thawed | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon ( preferably pacnamino ) | 3/4 lb swiss cheese, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 1/2 cups pappardelle noodles or 1 1/2 cups other small macaroni | 1/2 cup frozen okra | 1/2 cup snow peas ( or any other green vegetable ) | 1/4 cup crumbled 2 % low-fat swiss cheese or 1/4 cup colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm stock and set aside. In another large bowl, combine okra, bouillon, remaining sour cream, and the yeast mixture. Cut briskly about 2 inch from center of beef. With a sharp knife, cut slices in half across the grain and into a 1/2 inch wide strips. Add to the liquid and let stand about 15 minutes to allow flavors to develop. Add okra and cheese to the meat mixture and mix well. Drain noodles and add to the meat mixture and mix in well. Grease a 4 to 6 1/2 quart slow cooker with lard or shortening. Spread the beef with noodles and sprinkle with mozzarella/jalapeno pepper and cover. Set on low heat and cook about 5 hours or until the noodles are tender. Serve over noodles. Make ahead, cooked noodles can be frozen or refrigerated up to 1 week. Serve meat and okra with other ingredients as desired.

title: Baked Chicken Kiev
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken breast, boiled and sliced thin or 12 slices chicken | 2 teaspoons dill weed | 1/2 lb ground beef or 1/2 lb veggie crumbles
instructions: Roll chicken and place in a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. Combine the dill weed and ground meat and spread over the chicken. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 to 25 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Basil Pesto French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup basil pesto | 2 tablespoons italian breadcrumbs | 2/3 cup ice water | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Combine pesto and bread crumbs in a medium mixing bowl. Slowly add water until absorbed. Sprinkle allspice in mixture and add bay leaf. Chill bread in refrigerator. Serve bread slices out on a platter covered with plastic wrap.

title: Pasta with Ginger and Watercress
ingredients: 1 cup hot water | 1 teaspoon olive tapenade | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 2 cups shredded pasta | 1/2 cup chopped fresh watercress
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the hot water, olive tapenade, ginger, and pasta. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and cook until pasta is tender, 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Hot and Sour Beef Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs beef round steak, cut 3-inch thick | 8 drops green chili, if desired ( see description ) | 3 drops red food coloring ( optional ) | 3 -6 drops green chilies, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Cut steak into serving size pieces or you may cut the steak in half if you wish, cutting across the grain into thin slices. Place on a platter. If using the chilies, sprinkle them lightly with red food coloring. If desired, add the food color for a pinkish color for a brighter color. Sprinkle with green chilies, if desired.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,sriracha sauce,breadcrumb,hot green chili pepper
title: Thai Sweet Chili Pepper Dogs(Napa Dave)
ingredients: 2 hot green chili peppers ( fresh or pickled or no-sugar-added ) | 1 thyme sprig | 1/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | sriracha sauce
instructions: Place peppers & thyme in a blender & puree until smooth. Add bread crumbs & process until crumbly. Shape meat mixture into 24 chips & refrigerate until ready to use. Brush with sriracha sauce just before serving & sprinkle with crescents.

title: Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 2 eggplants | 1 can sliced peaches
instructions: Cut eggplants into 1/2 inch slices. Bake on a baking sheet about 6 inches under. Bake at 400 degrees f. For about 30 minutes. Cool. Scoop out pulp and skins, discarding skins and seeds. Slice eggplants into 1/2 inch rounds. Dice peaches. In a bowl, mix eggplant pulp, peaches and salt. Cover. Let mixture marinate for at least 1 hour.

title: White Bean Pasta
ingredients: 400 g white beans, cut in half | 1 kiwi, peeled, split and grated | 25 g parmesan cheese, shaved | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 cup plain flour
instructions: Combine beans, kiwifruit, parmesan, rice wine and flour in a large pot. Simmer over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes until sauce thickens and is smooth, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and serve with warm pasta.

title: Meat & Potato Balls
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 lb potato starch | 1 lb stewing beef | 1/2 cup potato starch ( for coating the meat ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine the salt, pepper, and the seasoning in a small bowl. Dip meat into potato starch and then coat the meat with a solution of the seasoning mixture and potato starch mixture. Brown meat thoroughly in a large skillet. Add more salt if needed and cook on low heat just until browned and all visible fat has disappeared. Add meat to your favorite gravy and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: apricot,bean sprout,red cabbage,garlic oil,blueberry,cream celery soup,cardamom,ginger paste
title: Indian Creamy Yogurt Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 package mixed beans sprouts | 1 cup sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger paste | 1 tablespoon garlic oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup chopped red cabbage | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricots
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Blanch the mixed beans sprouts for about one minute, then immediately remove with a slotted spoon to a bowl of ice water.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,fenugreek seed,sherry wine,white sugar,pecan half,monosodium glutamate
title: Pecorino Pecorino
ingredients: 4 cups dry white sugar | 1 bunch fenugreek seeds, crushed | 1/2 cup dried, chopped pecan halves | 1 whole pate de sherry wine, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons monosodium glutamate ( msg ) | 4 ounces grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the sugar, fenugreek, pecans, and sherry. Stir in monosodium glutamate. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring continuously. Once the mixture reaches 238 degrees f on a tabletop, remove from heat and pour into a 9x13 inch square pan to cool completely, about 1 hour. Let sit at room temperature for at least 1 hour before serving to cool completely. Spoon into ice cube trays, sprinkle evenly with grated cheese, and serve with cool fruit, crackers, or crudites.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,dark soy sauce,rigatoni pasta,pizza dough,apricot jam,palm sugar,cayenne pepper,mango chutney
title: Mango Rangoon Pie
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup paprika & curry paprika flakes | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 cup chopped fresh mango chutney | 3/4 cup apricot jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large pot combine the dark soy sauce, paprika, brown sugar, cayenne and onion flakes and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Once the sauce comes to a boil add the pasta and stir.

title: Easy and Delicious Oven Beef
ingredients: 5 lbs stewing beef | 2 -3 cans picante sauce | 1/2 cup of shredded mexican cheese | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Spray crockpot with cooking spray or you can just dump the mixture into crockpot and cook on high 6 hours. Shred beef with fork. Tear apart cheese with fork to make 1/2 inch squares or smaller. Note, if you have leftover corned beef and chop them up for a party, just don't throw all the pieces back into the crockpot. Note, the amount of spices can be omitted if you are using leftover corned beef that has been refrigerated the night before. If using canned beef, just drain all the juice and the liquid back into crockpot. Note, if you have leftover beef, just shred it with a fork, throw in the beef slices and stir to mix. Add picante sauce and mix. Add 1/2 the cheese. If you are using leftover cheese, just add a little of the cheese to the meat mixture. If you are making a huge omelet, just add the mixture to the leftovers. Add 1/2 the cheese and stir. The top should be a little crusty.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,cream tartar,romano cheese,ham,baby spinach
title: Ham and Spinach Focaccia Bake
ingredients: 3/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 cup cooked ham, cut into 12 pieces | 1 cup baby spinach, cooked and chopped | 1 tablespoon freshly grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray large cookie sheet pan with cooking spray. In medium bowl combine flour, cream of tarter and fontilla cheese and the ham. Mix well with a fork or fingers. Add spinach and mix well. Pour into prepared pan evenly. Sprinkle with cheese on top. Bake 22 to 22 minutes, until golden brown.

title: White Clamato
ingredients: 12 clams in shell, scrubbed well | 1 ounce white chocolate, chopped | 1 head radicchio, chopped ( celticchio can be found in specialty stores ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Place clams in water with salt & bring to boil. Remove from heat & reserve. Set clams aside. Chop chocolate. Sautee radicchio in a small amount of olive oil till lightly browned & set aside. When clams have drained, place them in the large bowl with browned cheese, chocolate & radicchio & toss. If desired, add red pepper flakes & toss.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,taco sauce,seasoning salt,meat,chicken leg quarter,beer,lemongrass
title: Lemongrass Chicken and Beer
ingredients: 12 bone-in chicken leg quarters | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 quart beer ( a stout beer will do ) | 1 tablespoon chopped lemongrass ( fresh or frozen, not the powdery side only ) | 1 can taco sauce | 1 package quick-cooking oats ( not instant, not instant ) | 1/2 lb ground meat ( can use turkey or chicken )
instructions: Put chicken in a plastic bag. Sprinkle with seasoning salt. Let sit 10 minutes in the refrigerator. Heat beer until bubbling. Stir in lemongrass, taco sauce and rolled chicken. Cook slowly on the bbq, or on medium heat until chicken is cooked and tender. Turn a couple times during cooking to avoid burning the sauce. If any sauce spills out, stir it back into the pot. Serve over rice with plain boiled potatoes and chopped onions sprinkled on top.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,queso fresco,beef tenderloin,jumbo pasta shell,green cardamom pod,masa harina,yellow squash
title: Guacamole Crusted Beef Tenderloin With Yellow Squash
ingredients: 4 medium beef tenderloin | 3 teaspoons pure masa harina | 16 ounces queso fresco, shredded | 0.5 can white mexican beer, room temperature | 4 small jumbo pasta shells | 1/8 teaspoon green cardamom pod, slightly crushed | 3 large yellow squash, halved lengthwise and sliced crosswise into about half moons
instructions: Position a rack in the center and preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a 14x10x1 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add the tenderloin and when it comes out of the water, transfer it to a cold water bath. Cover and transfer it to the baking dish to keep warm. Place the pan of water back on the stove. Add the masa harina and transfer to the baking dish. Return the tenderloin to the pot. Stir the queso fresco, mexican beer, jumbo shells and the cardamom pods into the batter. Place the steaks on top of the batter. Press the sides of the steaks to compress the batter. Set aside on a rack. Spray a 12 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set over medium low heat. When the pan is very hot, place 2 steaks and 1/2 cup water in the pan. Cook until the meat is cooked through and the sauce is slightly thickened, 5 to 10 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f. Turn the steaks. Spread 1/2 cup of the sauce over each warm steak. Top with the yellow and squash, then cover and bake in the oven until the squash is tender and sauce is slightly browned, about 25 minutes.

title: Italian Turkey Linguica
ingredients: 1 package large shell pasta | 2 tablespoons dried poultry seasoning | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 pound ground turkey
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the shell pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, leaving 1/2 inch of room for the noodles to steam through. Place the cooked pasta into a large bowl, and set aside. Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat, and stir in the dried poultry seasoning and red pepper. Cook and stir until the seasoning is fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in the ground turkey, and cook until the turkey is heated through and evenly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Mix in the cooked pasta, and serve at once.

title: Fresca Chipotle French Fries
ingredients: 6 1/2 ounces of canned chipotle chiles in adobo | 4 -6 ounces your favorite angel food cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the angel food cake into fries. In a small bowl mix, chipotles, adobo, and oil until well blended. Arrange fries in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake @ 400 degrees for 5 - 10 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,cornmeal,saffron,tangerine,cardamom pod,beef stew meat,pita bread,mozzarella cheese
title: Moroccan Beef Pitas
ingredients: 10 -12 pita bread | 8 -12 tangerines ( see note ) | 3 ounces boneless beef stew meat ( i've found that it's about four or five pounds ) | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 6 cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon saffron, crushed | 1 cup colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 cup mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Heat large skillet over high heat and add beef. Cook till meat is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Drain fat. Stir fry the meat over medium heat till lightly browned, about 6 minutes. To the meat add cornmeal, cardamom, saffron and cheddar cheese. Stir till cheese is melted and blended. Divide the mixture into 8 patties. Place on baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the sandwiches, if desired,. Preheat broiler. To assemble, slide one side of each pita bread into a shallow bowl of hot water for 15 seconds or less until limp but not falling apart. Turn out onto a plate. Place the remaining patties on the broiler pan, leaving about 1/4 inch between the patties. Broil the patties for 15 to 25 seconds or until the tops of the patties are puffed up slightly. Remove from heat. Sprinkle each pita with the mozzarella cheese and close up the sandwich with a toothpick. Slice into 4 pieces. Serve with yogurt sauce. Note, to make pita bread, cut pita into wedges. Cut a hole in the center and insert a tangerine into the center, keeping 1/8 inch of zest in the center. Place wedges in individual serving bowls. Note, if you are serving the sandwiches this way, you can place the wedges in small pieces of waxed paper instead.

title: Cavender's Italian Herb Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 2 teaspoons rubbed saffron | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing
instructions: Mix the poppy seeds, lemon peel and saffron in a small bowl. Stir in the dressing until just mixed, then refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,gruyere cheese,apricot jam,baking soda,dill pickle,cream celery soup
title: Dressed up Pepper & Apricot Spread
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 jar apricot jam | 1 large yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons finely chopped dried dill pickles | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Place soup in a 2 to 3 quart bowl or crock. Add jam.

Random Ingredients: mustard,apple juice,cashew nut,mozzarella cheese,onion soup mix
title: Apple Cheese and Cashew Spread
ingredients: 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup chopped cashew nuts | 1 can condensed apple juice | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium bowl, blend the onion soup mix, cashews, apple juice and mustard. Stir in the mozzarella cheese just until mixed. Transfer to a lightly oiled 9x9 inch baking dish and spread evenly. Bake, uncovered, in the preheated oven 25 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,pecorino romano cheese,pepper,greek yogurt,steak
title: Grilled Beef Steak With Peppercorns
ingredients: 1 lb boneless top round steak, cut into 3/4 inch thick slices | 2 teaspoons pepper | 1/2 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon greek salad dressing or 1 tablespoon fresh italian dressing | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Light the grill. Arrange sliced meat on a foil lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with pepper, mustard seed, and greek dressing. Wrap foil around steak and grill over indirect medium heat, 4 minutes, turning once. Top with cheese, and continue to cook until cheese is melted and steak is well cooked and serve. Note, for even grilling, allow 2 seared steaks at a time under a hot broiler. When cooked to desired doneness, turn and cook to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,yellow bell pepper,pinto bean,ra el hanout spice mix,dill pickle
title: Tuscan Beef and Pork Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steaks or 1 lb top round roast, trimmed and cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 red yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup seeded and finely chopped dill pickle | 2 -3 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | additional hot sauce | hot sauce
instructions: Toss all the ingredients with enough hot sauce to taste. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 8 hours. Stir ingredients and serve.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,mustard seed,green bell pepper,bocconcini,chocolate chip
title: Cheats Chocolate-Dipped Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 cups portabella mushrooms | 4 green bell peppers, thinly sliced | 8 ounces bocconcini | 1/2 cup chocolate chips or 1/2 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: In an oven proof casserole dish, layer the mushrooms, bell peppers and bocconcini.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,whipping cream,halibut,creme de cacao,grape tomato,cod,fennel,italian bread
title: Creamy Halibut (Or Cod) With Fennel Fonduta
ingredients: 1/3 cup whipping cream ( light is fine ) | 1/3 cup creme de cacao ( or other sweet dessert liquor ) | 1/2 cup minced fresh mint leaves | 1 1/2 lbs halibut ( cod, or salmon may be used ) | 12 grape tomatoes ( about 3 large ) or 6 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup thinly sliced fennel, leaves ( fresh or frozen ) | 12 slices crusty italian bread, cut into small cubes ( about 1/8-inch thick ) | 3/4 cup sweet italian cornstarch or 3/4 cup wondra flour
instructions: In a small bowl, beat the cream with the crème de cacao until blended. In a large pot, scald the cream. When it begins to bubble, add the mint, and cook without covering for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove the mint leaves and stir. Set aside to cool. Remove tail and fins from fish. In a large heavy skillet, heat cream and cream over medium high heat. Stir occasionally, making sure to scrape the bottom of the pan. When just barely beginning to boil, add the chopped mint. Continue to simmer for about 5 minutes, or until the cream thickens. Season with salt and pepper. While still warm, toss with tomatoes, fennel, and bread cubes. Dissolve the cornstarch in a little cold water to make a paste. Add this mixture to the sauce in the skillet. Cook on medium high heat for 2 or 3 minutes, stirring well. Season with salt and pepper, to taste, if desired. Serve with pasta, or let individuals add the fonduta at their discretion as desired. Enjoy.

title: Kielbasa and Beans With Ham (Cebollas Al Ajilloar)
ingredients: 10 slices serrano ham | 3 teaspoons dried mesclun | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1 can baked beans, drained
instructions: Place ham slices in an 11 x 4 inch baking dish.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,green chili paste,monterey jack cheese,salt black pepper,pepper,vanilla,dark raisin
title: Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 10 garlic cloves, peeled | 1/2 cup dark raisin | 1 tablespoon green chili paste, plus | 1 teaspoon green chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup emmenthaler cheese, grated
instructions: Place the garlic cloves in a saucepan. Mix in the raisins, then add the chile paste, sage, salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat and cook, stirring, for about 1 minute to cook the raisins slightly. Stir in the cheese and continue cooking until the cheese is melted and the raisins are coated with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chili,ginger,saffron strand,water chestnut,red chilies,garlic powder
title: Hot Sambal
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh anaheim chili | 1/2 cup saffron strand | 1 cup water chestnuts | 2 dried red chilies | 2 teaspoons ginger | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Wash and seed the chillies, garlic, and ginger thoroughly. Crush the chillies into thin slices. Remove the seeds of the red chillies and slice them. Heat a pan, add oil and put in the chilies. Add the ginger garlic powder. If you can wait, now is the time to cook. Put on the lid, turn down to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve hot. This goes really well with rice. I serve this with red thai pita bread.

Random Ingredients: penne,rhubarb,coffee,heavy whipping cream,dark soy sauce,vanilla essence,white onion
title: Spiced Rhubarb & Vanilla Penne
ingredients: 100 g thin short penne | 1 large white onion, finely minced | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 large stalk rhubarb, minced | 2 teaspoons ground coffee
instructions: In a large pan, cook the penne according to directions. Drain pasta but reserve some cooking liquid. Set pasta aside when cool enough to handle, add to pan the onion, cream, soy sauce, vanilla, rhubarb and coffee. Stir well until combined. Add the cooked drained pasta and stir just to combine.

title: Chunky Home Fries
ingredients: 2 red sweet bell peppers | 2 yellow sweet peppers | 1 1/4 tablespoons caraway seeds | 1 cup salsa, your favorite | 1 1/4 cups thousand island dressing ( i like kraft singles )
instructions: Slice tops off bell peppers and remove seeds, membrane and any loose bits. Seed the peppers by removing the membrane, or cutting them into thin strips. Lay them all on a paper towel lined cookie sheet under a broiler and toast briefly, turning frequently, until skin is blackened and blistered. Place peppers in a plastic bag and cover tightly. Let sit in the sun for 15 minutes. Remove peppers from bag.

title: Chokolate Noodle Fonduta
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried cannellini beans, soaked overnight | 8 ounces chocolate, chopped | 1/4 cup dried parsnips | 1/3 cup green onion, chopped | chili oil, to taste
instructions: Put all ingredients except chili oil in an iron frying pan over a fairly low heat and simmer until the chocolate is melted. Serve in warm bowls.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,red kidney bean,zucchini,ice,hot chili pepper,chickpea
title: Italian Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 cup canned chickpeas | 1 medium zucchini, chopped | 1 can whole italian-style tomatoes | 1 can red kidney beans | 1 large hot chili pepper | ice
instructions: Add all ingredients to a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Cook until heated through. Remove from heat, and serve.

title: Chili Powder - South American Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1 cup coriander powder | 1 canned chipotle chile in adobo | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried tomatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,oyster sauce,bay scallop,heavy cream,puff pastry
title: Chilled Seafood Parcels
ingredients: 20 sheets puff pastry, thawed | 1 can bay scallops, drained | 2 teaspoons light cream | 200 g puff pastry, thawed | 1 bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200c/400f/gas place puff pastry on a baking tray and bake for 5 minutes. Place scallops in a bowl and pour cream over and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Set aside and let sit, covered, for 10 minute meanwhile, roll out puff pastry on a floured surface to form a rectangle about 25cm x 25cm. Spread mushroom mixture over puff pastry on both sides. Sprinkle finely chopped pepper over mushrooms and scallops. Bake for a further 15 minutes or until pastry is golden.

title: Baked Okra
ingredients: 1/2 lb baby bokra, cleaned and cut into 2-by-1/8-inch pieces | 1 small bunch of chopped basil | 1 small bunch spring onion | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place the stem end of your fresh okra into the oven on low, for about 20 to 30 minutes. Then, carefully remove the stem from the okra, wash the okra thoroughly under cool water and pat dry with paper towels. Spread some of the oil into a round glass or metal baking dish, and arrange the okra, cut side up, on the dish. Sprinkle with a bit of the basil and minced onion and mix well. Cover and bake the okra for 30 to 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is tender. Transfer the okra to a platter and spoon as much excess liquid as possible from the dish and toss it with confectioners' sugar. Serve hot, with bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: white bread,hot pepper sauce,extra virgin olive oil,raspberry,grapefruit
title: Elegant Raspberry French Toast Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 pint fresh raspberries or 1 pint strawberry | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | hot pepper sauce | 4 slices country white bread | 8 -10 teaspoons fresh raspberry-flavored grapefruit
instructions: Combine raspberries and oil in a small saute pan, heat until warm. Remove from heat. Slice bread lengthwise and arrange on plates with slices of pickled fruit and a few drops of hot pepper sauce.

title: Spiced Caper and Lemongrass Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces lemongrass ( bruised but intact ) | 4 tablespoons caper | 25 peppercorns, cracked | 8 cups vegetable stock or 8 cups chicken stock
instructions: Remove and discard tough outer layer of leaves on lemongrass stems. Slice caps finely. Combine half of capers with 5 cups stock and 5 tbs coarsely crushed peppercorns. Cover with lid or plastic wrap and simmer gently for 30 - 40 minutes until lemongrass is tender. Discard capers. Place remaining 2 cups stock or stock in sauté pan and keep at a low boil. Place lemongrass in a pan of boiling water and boil 10 minutes, until tender and just softened. Drain. Finely chop 1 cup finely. Add capers and stir. Serve hot. Note, if this soup is served hot, you may want to cover with aluminium foil after it has cooked 10 minutes.

title: Papa Drexler's Espresso Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup light coconut rum | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1 dash seasoning salt
instructions: Stir all ingredients together until well blended. Pour over poultry, vegetable or beef, whatever strikes your fancy.

title: Baked Chicken Wings with Noodles
ingredients: 12 whole chicken wings, tips discarded | 1 cup turbinado sugar | 3 ounces pimento stuffed olives, sliced | 1 teaspoon dried basil | cooked pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken wings in a 9x13 inch baking dish and toss with the sugar, olives and basil. Cover the dish with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Remove from the oven and stir in the pasta just before serving.

Random Ingredients: oregano,double acting baking powder,shiitake mushroom,mustard seed,spinach
title: Spinach and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon double-acting baking powder | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 10 ounces fresh spinach, washed and trimmed
instructions: Place dried shiitake mushrooms in a bowl, cover with warm water and soak 30 minutes. Drain and squeeze the water out, squeezing out excess moisture. Place mushrooms back in the bowl and cover with warm water.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,corn tortilla chip,head cabbage,poppy seed,bell pepper
title: Kielbasa and Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 large head cabbage | 1 sweet bell pepper | 1 package kielbasa | 3 poppy seeds, divided | 1 bag corn tortilla chips, crushed
instructions: Chop cabbage, sweet bell pepper, onion, kielbasa, and 1/2 a box of crushed tortilla chips. Saute vegetables with the kielbasa and drain off the excess liquid. Mix with the rest of the crushed tortilla chips. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: baking cocoa,chicken,peanut oil,salad green,half,baby spinach leaf
title: Taste of Bridge (Vegetable Cheese Chicken)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 bag baby spinach leaves | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 4 tablespoons baking cocoa | 10 ounces salad greens
instructions: Boil the chicken about 20 minutes or until cooked through. Let cool, remove and debone. Slice. Add the peanut oil in a pan. Put spinach in and cook till just wilted. Add half and half. Cook until heated through. In a bowl combine chicken and cocoa, stir and let sit a few minutes. Put salad greens in a serving dish, put some of the chicken on top of that and pour salad on top.

title: Caramelized Rum (Tay)
ingredients: 4 ounces dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric ( optional )
instructions: Place rum, turmeric and if using it, in a small heavy skillet over medium heat. Cook 2 - 3 minutes or until the rum is heated through. Cool down on a dish towel and leave in refrigerator for 2 - 3 days before using. Store in a glass bottle or jar in the pantry.

title: Sausage, Potato, and Cabbage
ingredients: 6 whole cloves, or more to taste | 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and grated | 2 pounds lean ground pork | 2 heads cabbage, cored and sliced
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Place cloves into a baking pan.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,soy sauce,crescent dinner,radish,turmeric powder,snow pea
title: Vegetarian Kebab (Spinach and Snow Peas Kebabs)
ingredients: 50 ounces frozen spinach leaves ( thawed and drained ) | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup radish, sliced ( i use pre-sliced julienned ones ) | 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1/2 cup fresh snow pea ( or 1/2 cup snow peas cut in half )
instructions: In the container of a blender, combine spinach leaves, soy sauce, turmeric, and radish slices. Puree until spinach is finely diced. Divide mixture evenly among the rolls. Preheat electric skillet to 350 degrees. Unroll dough and separate into 6 pieces. Roll each piece into a 6 inch long log, with a long side facing you. With the tips of your hands, press down on the kabab to form a log. Place the log on a nonstick baking sheet, seam side down. Brush the kab log with egg wash, and bake for 20 minutes or until it's light brown. Remove from oven, and brush again with egg wash as it bakes. Cool for 5 minutes. Carefully flip over. If using snow peas, spread the frozen bits in a pan with a bit of water and just cover with cold water. Heat the pan over medium heat, stirring occasionally until boiling, about 2 minutes.

title: Mexicali Rice With Mushrooms, Crabmeat & Mozzarella
ingredients: 400 g dried orecchiette ( about one 9oz package ) | 100 g dry crabmeat | 2 cups barilla plus whole walnut halves ( about 8oz. of uncooked barilla ) | 300 g button mushroom | 1 jar picante sauce, i use pace picante ( about 3/4 cup or a bit less )
instructions: Cook orecchiette according to package directions. When it is cooked, stir in crabmeat, breaking it into flakes. Cook orecchiette over medium heat for about five minutes. Stir in mushrooms and cook for about three minutes. Spoon mixture onto plates and top with walnuts and additional picante.

title: Spicy Indian Toasted Bread, Aromatic-Style
ingredients: 2 slices bread | 1 tablespoon curry leaf, finely chopped | 3 asparagus spears, trimmed
instructions: Heat an ungreased griddle or frying pan over medium. Spread curry leaves on top of bread. Toast bread under hot grill until just softened, 3 - 5 minutes on each side. Cut toast into 2 - 3 triangles. Serve with asparagus.

title: Chinese Restaurant Bread Rolls (Banh Phad Chua)
ingredients: 75 g white bread flour | 1/3 teaspoon chili paste
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220 degrees celsius. In a bowl sieve out dry ingredients to make a fine dry mixture. Combine the flour and chinese chili paste in another bowl. Make a well in the centre of the dry ingredients and add the dry mixture, mixing thoroughly to form a firm, rather stiff dough. Shape the dough into walnut sized balls and place on lightly greased oven trays. Score a cross into the top of each balinese roll with a sharp knife. Bake on middle rack of oven for about 5 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on rack and store in airtight containers..

Random Ingredients: pork,onion soup mix,molasses,okra,yellow onion,corn tortilla,olive,dark brown sugar
title: Sweet and Savory Pork and Okra Tacos
ingredients: 1 package yellow onion ( cut into chunks ) | 1 package fresh okra, cut into thirds | 1 -2 tablespoon molasses | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/2 lb ground pork | 1/4 cup olive ( sliced thin ) | 1 package onion soup mix | 8 corn tortillas ( fajita size )
instructions: Make the onion soup mix by combining the oregano, brown sugar and molasses, stirring until dissolved. Brown the ground pork and set aside in a large bowl. Brown the onion and okra in a skillet then drain. Saute the ground pork and okra with the spices with the remaining onion soup mix. Heat the tortillas according to package directions, or to desired doneness.. Pour the meat and soup mix among the tortillas and serve.

title: Italian Inn Pepper Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust, pre-made ( i use pepperidge farm pizzaties in the grocery store ) | 1 small diced green pepper | 1/2 cup of your favourite bottled vodka ( or other favorite brand )
instructions: Place pepper in a ziploc bag. Add a few drops of oil to taste and mix. Pour over the pre made pizza crust. Slice dough up and add some cheese. Top with a little salt if desired. Enjoy it with a side of garlic toast.

title: Shrimp, Fennel and Green Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable juice | 1/2 lb fresh farfalle ( bow tie ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 1/2 lbs raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 medium yellow onion, halved and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons fennel, minced | 1 package fresh straw mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup mixed greens with spinach
instructions: Heat vegetable juice in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add farfalle.

Random Ingredients: topping,onion salt,penne,rice flour,black tea,dark brown sugar,hot sauce
title: Baked Cinnamon Rolls, Easy & No-Stick!
ingredients: 1 package penne or 10 small shells | 1 cup rice flour | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 cup instant black tea, brewed in 2 or 3 t cold water | hot sauce, to taste | fresh sweet pickled onion salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine all ingredients except pasta, and pour into greased 9 x 11 pan. Bake about 1 hour or until knife comes out clean when inserted in center. While cooking, cut rolls into 1 slices. Sprinkle with onion salt. Serve with fresh sweet pickled onions, if desired.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,stewing beef,mustard powder,white rice,french bread,blueberry,linguine
title: Linguine Beef Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef ( cut into 1 inch cubes, about 1 lb ) | 1 package stoneware linguine | 1 cup uncooked white rice | 1 lb fresh brussels sprout | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 cup blueberries, for garnish ( or frozen ) | 1 cup shredded french bread
instructions: Brown stew meat in a large skillet, stirring frequently. Meanwhile, cook linguine until tender. Cook beef cubes, stirring frequently, 1 - 2 minutes less than add cooked pasta. Remove beef from skillet and add to skillet with cooked linguine. Add rice, stir to combine. Dry brussels sprouts, cut in half. Add to beef mixture and stir until coated with the mustard. Top with blueberries and bread. Variation, you could add a whole ramekin of baby carrots to this dish before tossing.

title: Broiled Lamb Fillets
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken stock or 2 tablespoons broth | 1/4 cup wheat pastry flour | 3/4 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1/4 teaspoon dried herbes de provence | 2 lamb fillets | 14 bamboo skewers
instructions: Combine marjoram and broth until well blended.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,dark rum,american cheese,butter,garlic salt,tomato,salmon fillet,bean sprout
title: Baked Chilean Salmon
ingredients: 4 -6 medium salmon fillets | salt | 1 1/4 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pods | 1 1/2 cups light-colored american cheese, divided | 1/4 cup unsalted butter | 1/4 cup dark rum | 2 cups bean sprouts
instructions: Place the salmon fillets on a baking sheet. Season with garlic salt and black cardamom. Spread 1/2 cup of the cheese over each salmon fillet. Bake 12 - 18 minutes at 400 degrees. Let sit for 5 minutes, before turning the fish. In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Stir in the rum and add the beans and cook 3 - 5 minutes. Top each salmon fillet with 1/2 cup of the bean sprouts and 2 slices of american cheese. Place in a baking dish and place in the oven at 220 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve the remaining bean sprouts on the side.

title: Homemade Molasses Lemon Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemons, rind of, grated | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1 cup unsweetened ice water
instructions: Combine the molasses, cream, lemon peel and oil, beat in egg substitute until dissolved. Slowly incorporate the ice water, and then beat at medium speed until thick. Scoop into 2 desert dishes, and refrigerate until set. This can be topped with a bit of crushed red pepper flakes if desired.

title: Shuck - Beef or Clam Lasagna
ingredients: 1 boneless beef rump roast, cooked and sliced thin | 1 can diced clams, with juice | 1 package cream cheese | 1 container ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 1 1/2 cups corn, frozen or canned
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly butter 13x9x2 inch glass, metal, baking dish. Lay out beef and slice. Spread cream cheese over beef slices, then sprinkle over chesse. Spread ricotta evenly over cream cheese. Lay corn over cheese. Spread cream cheese over corn. Sprinkle with capers. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until top is golden brown and bubbly. Serve with garlic mashed potatoes or rice.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya coriander annatto,dill weed,cashew nut,half,pesto sauce,pecan,penne pasta
title: Cashew Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta, uncooked | 1 package sazon goya with coriander and annatto | 1/2 cup cashew nuts | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill weed
instructions: Heat large non stick skillet. Add cashews and 1/4 cup pesto. Stir and fry for about 3 minutes, or until they soften. Add cashew nuts and remaining ingredients. Stir to combine and transfer to a serving bowl. Note, cashew nuts can be substituted with other nuts.

title: Mexican Red Rice
ingredients: 2 cups red wine | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup capers
instructions: Combine red wine, taco seasoning and graham cracker crumbs in a large bowl. Stir in capers. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Easy Chipotle Cream
ingredients: 20 slices fresh chipotle chiles in adobo | 8 -12 ounces whipped topping ( such as cool whip or cream ) | 3 1/2 cups unbleached white flour, sifted
instructions: Remove the seeds from the chipotles. Slice chipotles cross ways into thin rounds. Spread 1/2 of the chipotles onto a greased cookie sheet. Top with 1 1/2 of the whipped topping. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the adobo slices. Continue layers. Top with remaining whipped topping. Let stand for 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place baking sheet in oven and bake for 15 minutes. Remove baking sheet. Let cool 3 - 5 minutes. Remove chipotle cream from oven. Slice and serve immediately with remaining hot sweetener or cool whip whipped topping.

title: Smoky Chipotle-Cashew Nut Spread
ingredients: 1 cup cashew nuts, lightly toasted and chopped | 1 cup dry-roasted salted cashews | 1/2 teaspoon dried seafood seasoning | 2 tablespoons walnut oil
instructions: Blend nuts, salted cashews, seafood seasoning, walnut oil, and chipotle chile together in a blender until smooth.

title: Sangri Lentejas
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork loin, sliced in thick strips and then separated with bone in ( or lamb if you prefer ) | 8 ounces green lentils, washed | 1 large eggplant, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices ( medium to large ) | sea salt | fresh ginger, grated | 1/2 cup pineapple, chunks | 1 beer ( stout )
instructions: Rinse and drain the lentils. Soak the meat in cold water with some sea salt for 2 hours. Drain. Combine all ingredients with the meat and let sit for an hour. Serve with boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,peanut oil vegetable,beef,chicken stock,peanut oil,kaffir lime leaf,egg noodle
title: Asian Beef and Noodle Soup (Stir-Fry)
ingredients: 600 g ground beef or 600 g ground chicken | 1/4 cup chicken stock ( or water ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil ( dark ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil ( vegetable, canola ) | 4 kaffir lime leaves ( dried ) | 100 g fresh egg noodles | 2 tablespoons peanut oil ( vegetable, canola )
instructions: Heat a wok on its highest heat and stir fry the ground meat for 3 - 4 minutes and remove from the wok with a slotted spoon and set aside on a paper towel. Use the same wok and heat the remaining 1 tbs. Of peanut oil and when hot add in the kaffir lime leaves and stir fry for a minute or two until they aromatic and have changed colour. Add in the noodles and the beef and stir fry for another minute or two. Add in the noodle mixture with the stock, return the beef to the wok and stir fry for three more minutes. Serve.

title: Hot Chili Oil
ingredients: 6 -12 hot red chiles | lemon wedge
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Peel the chilies and cut them lengthwise into 6 or 8 pieces. Heat the oil in a cast iron skillet or heavy cast iron skillet about 10 minutes. Add about 1 teaspoon of the chilies and fry, stirring constantly, for about 3 minutes. When the chili is golden in color, turn the heat down a little. Pour in a little oil, stir, and fry the remaining chilies, stirring constantly, for another 3 minutes. Transfer the chili to a dish and pass it through a sieve. Serve at once with lemon wedges.

title: Mexican Sweet Tomato Molasses Molasses
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet ripe tomatoes or 1 1/2 lbs tomatillos | 1 1/2 cups molasses | 2 -3 lime wedges or 1 lemon wedge, to serve
instructions: Wash vegetables to remove some of the moisture. Remove tomatoes and husks. Cut tomatoes in half and place, cut side up or standing on a baking sheet with some of the husks removed, or in a roasting rack. Place tomatoes on rack and bake at 500 degrees for 20 minutes, turn and bake at 500 for 15 minutes more, until blackened and soft. Turn often. Allow tomatoes to cool to room temperature, then place in a seal able container. Use on it's own, or on hot cereal, in sandwiches, to spread extra on top of toasted bagels or toast.

title: Ethiopian Pasta and Chickpeas Stew
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons harissa, divided | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 lb rotini pasta | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Combine chickpeas, 3 t. Of harissa, and 1 t. Of the beef in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Cover with remaining 1 t. Sauce and refrigerate 2 hours. Pre heat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine pasta, remaining harissa, remaining beef, remaining beef, and 1/2 t. Of the cheese in large bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes or up to 2 hours. Uncover and bake 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbling and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper adobo sauce,splenda granular,chili oil,orange,italian parsley,broccoli floret,butternut squash,yellow bell pepper
title: Sweet Thai Summer Squash With Red Pepper and Chipotle
ingredients: 1 medium butternut squash, seeds, peeled and cut into 1/8-inch slices | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 teaspoons splenda granular ( granular ) | 1 orange | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons snipped italian parsley | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh chipotle pepper in adobo sauce ( add more if you desire ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons snipped fresh chile oil ( add more if you desire ) | 2 teaspoons orange rind, grated | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1 large sprig fresh italian parsley, leaves only
instructions: Place a steamer insert into a saucepan fitted with a steaming rack and set the cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bring the water to a boil over high heat. Add the squash and cook them 5 minutes. Turn the squash over, cover and let it steam 5 minutes longer. Transfer the squash to an ice water bath to cool for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Meanwhile, trim off all of the peel and very thinly slice along with the squash. Cut the orange in half. Squeeze the juice out of the peel and pith and discard. Cut the orange into 1/8 inch thick slices and reserve. Zest one of the oranges by cutting the zest in half down one side, then cutting crosswise into 1/8 inch wide strips. Transfer both the zest and orange strips into a mixing bowl and fold in the orange zest, orange juice, pepper, chili oil, parsley and chipotle. Place the squash in the refrigerator and let it marinate at least 1 hour but overnight also. Prepare the vegetables using the same method as for the squash, except keep the vegetables in the hot water and let the mixture boil until almost all of the liquid has been absorbed, about 10 minutes. Drain well.. Place the cooked squash directly onto the hot steamer rack. Gather up the sprigs from the parsley and discard. Arrange the squash in the center of a large platter and carefully surround with the sauteed orange zest and orange slices, sprinkling each serving with a little chile oil to finish, if desired. Serve immediately. Cook's notes, to prepare the sauce, heat the 2 teaspoons of chile oil and 1 teaspoons of orange rind in a heavy large skillet over high heat until the oil is quite hot but not smoking. Add the chile oil to a medium nonreactive saucepan and set it over moderately high heat. Add one tablespoon of orange juice to the pan and turn the heat down to low and let the mixture simmer 5 minutes. Add half an orange and a whole or two of the parsley leaves and stir to heat the oil. Add more oil if the sauce looks dry. Ladle the hot sauce over the squash and remove the pan from the heat. Let the mixture rest 1 to 2 minutes to allow the juices to settle. Remove the orange rind using a slotted spoon and set aside. Serve the cooked squash warm.

title: Fennel Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushroom or 1 lb baby portabella mushrooms, washed, stemmed, and sliced | 1 teaspoon fennel, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Divide the fennel mixture among four medium sized porcelain dishes or one 12 by 8 inch nonstick skillet.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,tomato sauce,heavy whipping cream
title: Spanish Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl combine the tomato sauce and cream. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the cream comes to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and continue cooking approximately 20 minutes, or until reduced by half. Stir in the green pepper, and simmer for five more minutes, then serve warm over your favorite hot pasta.

title: Artichoke Heart Bars
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dark chocolate | cooking spray | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill | 30 graham crackers, crushed
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f and spray a 13 x 9 baking dish with cooking spray. In a bowl, combine artichokes, chocolate, dill and crackers. Press mixture into prepared baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: pork sparerib,pork sausage,salmon fillet,double cream,flour,sharp cheddar cheese,beef rib
title: Baked Smoked Beef and Smoked Sausages (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 3 thick pork spareribs, each weighing about 12 ounces, skinned and scored | 2 smoked salmon fillets, about 15 to 18 ounces, each skinned and scored | 2 smoked smoked smoked salmon fillets, each weighing about 12 ounces, skinned and scored | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 teaspoon soft peak double cream | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 6 fresh sprigs fresh double cream or 6 fresh sour cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Scrape off any excess fat from the spareribs and arrange them side by side in a 5 to 6 ovenproof dish. Scatter the slices of smoked salmon over the bones. Sprinkle with flour and scatter with the grated cheese. Pour the double cream on top and bake until the top is golden brown and the salmon is cooked, about about 30 minutes. Uncover the dish, stir to combine, then lift out the smoked salmon and smoked salmon with a slotted spoon. Arrange the smoked sasages, smoked salmon and smoked salmon slices on top of the double cream. Serve with freshly ground black pepper.

title: Santa Fe Sweet Potato Chips
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread the grated potato on the baking sheet. Drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with salt. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove, and cool for 5 minutes, then stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,white sugar,cod,beef bouillon cube,kielbasa,chicken fillet
title: Cafe Rio Corned-Fish (Cacalao)
ingredients: 1 can chicken fillets, drained and patted dry | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup chickpea flour | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 piece kielbasa, pounded to 1/2 inch thickness | 2 cups water
instructions: Combine chicken, bouillon, chickpea flour, sugar, and kielbasa in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: okra,red wine,fenugreek leaf,chow mein noodle,demerara sugar,karo syrup
title: Lori's Chow Mein Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb chow mein noodles | 12 ounces demerara sugar ( or brown sugar if you prefer ) | 1 cup red wine | 1 cup okra, sliced | 1/2 cup karo syrup ( corn syrup is optional but preferred here ) | 4 ounces okras, slices chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek leaves ( optional )
instructions: Boil the mein noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside. To serve and to keep fresh, put the noodles under a cold tap, and then coat them with sesame oil. In the meanwhile, preheat the broiler so the noodles won't stick together and cook them under warm broiler until they are browned, but not burnt, and tender. To serve, place a generous amount of noodles on a plate and top with a generous amount of noodles. Sprinkle about 1/4 cup of demarara or brown sugar, red wine or okra, and sliced okra over the noodles. Sprinkle more sugar if you wish, and a little fenugreek leaves. Serve hot..

title: Karela's Butternut Squash With Chilli Vegetables
ingredients: 3 butternut squash | 1 small red chili pepper | 20 fresh pepperoncini peppers | 1 can chopped vegetables, with juice
instructions: Cut all the squash in half along the equator and carefully remove the top layer of the squash in the middle. Scoop out the seeds, cut the squash flesh into cubes and put those into a deep oven proof dish. Peel away the seeds and finely dice the pepperoncini peppers. Add the chopped pepperoncini to the dish and roughly chop the chili. Add this to the dish. Pour over just enough water to cover the squash. Add the chopped sweet onion and mix. Cover tightly with aluminium foil and cook at 180c for 20 minutes. Remove, stir and leave to stand for another few minutes to cool. Serve garnished with chopped coriander or parsley.

Random Ingredients: cheesecloth,turmeric powder,ra el hanout spice mix,couscous,toast,chili seasoning mix,jalapeno juice,brie cheese
title: Sali's Spiced Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup couscous, any variety ( i use quick cooking over brown rice in the microwave ) | 2 cups cheesecloth ( or plain white cloth ) | 1 -6 teaspoon pure chili seasoning mix | 4 tablespoons goat cheese or 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 -10 pickled jalapeno, slices, depending on your taste preference | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 4 slices fresh cheese ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strands or 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional )
instructions: For couscous, add 4 cups water in saucepan. Bring to boil and cover and remove from heat. Let sit 10 minutes covered. Meanwhile, wrap the cheesecloth, then using cheese cloth, wring out excess moisture so that it's easy to squeeze out, then shred it with your fingers or by hand. For cheese mixture, add all ingredients to cooled couscous and stir well, then set aside covered. For salad, combine all topping ingredients except saffron, cover and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Turn down to low and keep at a low boil until mixture thickens. Add saffron, adjust heat to low if necessary to ensure that the saffron doesn't burn and the cheese is melted. Add cheese and stir thoroughly to combine. Serve topped with sour cream. It does turn into a pretty bowl.

title: Cafe Rio Hot Chocolate - Mexican Mix for Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups hot cocoa powder ( i use hershey's hot chocolate ) | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 3 cups cocoa, approximately
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except the chocolate in a large bowl. The dough will have been sticky so you can knead it a bit more. Set aside and let it rest at room temperature. Take a 1 1/2 1 1/2 oz. Package of hot chocolate and roll it in your favorite nicoise, like feathers or chocolate cookies. Place nocolates on a baking sheet and set side by side until chocolate sets up. Once set cool down 2 hours. Break into pieces and serve.

title: Korean Cabbage
ingredients: 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 1/2 cups napa cabbage, shredded
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in tepid water. Add it to bread crumbs and toss. Add cabbage and toss until well coated. Spread in a 9x9 inch baking pan. Cover and let sit in the oven 20 minutes.

title: Warm Zucchini and Plantains
ingredients: 2 zucchini | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts ( roughly chopped ) | 1/2 cup chestnut ( roughly chopped ) | 3/4 cup orange juice ( or more ) | 1/2 medium plantain ( peeled and thickly sliced )
instructions: Place zucchini, hazelnuts, chestnuts, orange juice and plantain strips on a plate, and chill until serving time. Heat vegetable oil to 180 c, or until a piece of brown paper is crisp, and fry zucchini strips, over medium heat, for 2 - 3 minutes until crisp and golden. Serve with yoghurt on side.

title: Red Lentil Spread
ingredients: 1 lb red lentil | 1/2 lb mixed nuts | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Boil the lentils slowly with a splash of water until they are soft and mushy, about 40 to 50 minutes. Allow them to cool down to room temperature. Put the lentils into a food processor with a pinch of salt and process until fine but not quite smooth. Add the nuts and the chili oil. Process or mix well until well blended. Enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Tagine
ingredients: 5 lbs skinless chicken wings ( i use thighs ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 cups grape juice
instructions: Trim and clean the chicken wings. Place them in a large resealable container. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon or enough of chicken bouillon into the chicken pieces to cover them evenly. Pour the grape juice over. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for 8 to 10 hours, turning the chicken over occasionally. Preheat the oven to 425°f. Bake uncovered for about 50 to 60 minutes, basting once with the chicken juices.

title: Grilled Pineapple Fried Eggs
ingredients: 12 eggs | 4 slices yellow mustard | 4 slices bell pepper | 4 slices eggplants | 20 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: Grill or broil eggplant until soft. While eggplant is grilling cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and slice very thin with a mandolin. Place into bowl of cold water to cool. Coat the inside of a large sauté pan with oil and heat over medium high heat. Add pepper and eggplant and fry until eggplant is lightly browned, stirring occasionally. Remove eggplant and set aside. In a small bowl beat together the eggs and mustard. Add to the pan and fry over medium heat until done. Heat the olive oil using the pan add a few tbsp of sunflower oil to help in frying the eggs. Remove from heat and fold into eggplant. Add to your favorite pasta dish and top with your favourite salad and add grated cheese and a bit of pineapple juice.

Random Ingredients: black bean,jalapeno chile,fine semolina,parsley flake,pecan,romaine lettuce,tarragon,cabbage
title: Black Bean, Cabbage & Herb Salad
ingredients: 1 lb cooked black beans | 1 cup finely shredded cabbage | 1 cup chopped fresh parsley flakes | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1/2 cup fine semolina | 1 romaine lettuce, washed in cold water and drained | 1 jalapeno chile, coarsely chopped | fresh tarragon, snipped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all the ingredients except the lettuce and the jalapeno. Toss with the salad. Season to taste. Serve chilled.

title: Cranberry-cardamom Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups freshly chopped cranberries | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Combine the cranberries and whipping cream. Pour mixture into a buttered 4 cup mold and sprinkle cardamom over it. Place mold in freezer until firm.

title: Creamed Asparagus and Ham Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh asparagus, woody stalk ends snapped off | 3 teaspoons saffron threads | 1/2 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 12 ounces smoked ham | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts or ( 2 lb ) jar marinated artichoke hearts, undrained | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup wine ( any variety )
instructions: Trim asparagus of woody stalks. Cut asparagus diagonally into 1 3/8 inch slices. Bring a large saucepan of water to boil. Add saffron, pecans and ham, stirring to coat. Reduce heat, and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until nuts are lightly brown, about 6 minutes. Cool to room temperature, then transfer ham to a bowl. Combine artichoke hearts and mayonnaise. Fold in ham. To serve, place mixture on a large platter, and top with artichoke hearts, if desired. Serve hot.

title: Iraqi Tomato Sauce (Muhammarra)
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried currants | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1 cup tomato puree
