instructions: Soak the currants in hot water till soft remove them after 1 minute then drain. Place all ingredients in a food processor and process till smooth. Alternatively just place all in a saucepan and add enough water to bring it up to just below boiling point. Simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and blend in a mixer on low for 1 minute to thicken.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,red chile,chicken thigh,roasting chicken,papaya,mandarin orange,white breadcrumb,liquid honey
title: Papaya Chicken & Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 papaya, peeled and diced, for about 1/2 cup pepitas | 2 tablespoons chicken thigh, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons fat-free liquid honey | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained well ( see note below ) | 1 roasting chicken, cut up into chunks | 4 chicken thighs, skinless, boneless, skinless, with bone in ( about 1-1/2 pounds total ) | 4 -6 slices white breadcrumbs | 4 dried red chilies ( optional )
instructions: To make the papaya, combine the papaya, chicken, honey, and oranges. Toss lightly. To make the skewers, preheat the oven to its lowest setting. Pour about 1/4 cup of the marinade and honey mixture into a baking dish large enough to contain the chicken. Add the chicken. Marinade at least 2 hours, but preferably 3 hours or overnight. Cut up the chicken and chicken into chunks, removing as much of the skin as possible. Thread the chicken, breast up, onto 4 skewers. Set meat beside the food or use as a baste.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,shortening,bamboo shoot,watermelon,rice wine,cardamom seed,stewing beef,hot red chili pepper
title: Dolmades (Stuffed Bell Peppers)
ingredients: 1/2 large stewing beef | 1 chicken breast, split horizontally but not to far enough in thickness | 2 -3 large dried hot red chili peppers | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1/4 cup rice wine | 4 tablespoons shortening ( optional ) or 4 tablespoons coconut oil ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds ( optional ) | watermelon ( optional ) or pears, chopped ( optional )
instructions: If using bamboo shoots, soak for 20 minutes. If using watermelon or pears, peel the fruit by smashing with a fork. Chop the fruit into small pieces, place in blender and puree the puree with the shortening or coconut oil through a chute setting. Set aside. With a sharp knife, cut a slice off the top of all the peppers. Reserve and discard the black portion for later use. Fill each pepper with about 1/4 cup of the reserved puree, packing tightly. Using a large spoon, roll 1 or 2 pepper shells in the puree to coat the tops. Arrange the stuffed peppers, tops and bottoms, stuffed side down, in a baking dish. Pour 1 or 2 t. Water into baking dish or pan to reach 2 or 3 in depth. Bake at 350°f for about 45 minutes. Do not open oven during this time or the peppers will dry out. Note, if using canned bamboo shoots you may wish to boil the peppers until partially cooked, then drain and place in colander. When finished, the pepper may be sliced into thin strips and baked in batches on a serving platter. Be sure to spoon the pepper into a paper bag or strainer so that each person can squeeze the juice and enjoy the pulp in the pepper. If making fresh watermelon, remove the peel and cut into segments and place in a bowl of cold water to cover. Rinse if necessary. Drain when ready to serve.

title: Rigatoni Allo
ingredients: 1/4 cup bacon grease | 1 pound rigatoni pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 cup minced beet | 1 can peas
instructions: In large saucepan, over medium heat, add beets and peas. Stir. Heat until peas are warm and flavors are blended, 5 - 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green olive,beef stew meat,almond extract,spaghetti,penne,salad green
title: Crock Pot Spanish Beef and Pasta Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 jar sliced green olives, drained | 16 ounces penne ( about 2 1/2 quarts ) | 1 jar salad greens | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 package dry spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients except spaghetti in crock pot. Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours or until meat is tender. Stir in spaghetti and cook 15 - 20 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,white rice,red chili pepper,nonfat yogurt,shallot
title: White Risotto With Yogurt, Shallots and Chillies
ingredients: 3 cups nonfat yogurt | 4 tablespoons minced shallots | 1 red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 cup white rice | 1 1/4 cups fresh ricotta cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Mandazi
ingredients: 1 package shelled edamame | 6 ounces peanut oil | 2 pounds chicken wings, cut in half and tips discarded | 1 teaspoon ground mace, or to taste | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place edamame in a large pot with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes, then drain. Place oil in a skillet over medium heat, and warm the oil. Cook and stir the chicken wings in the hot oil until they are lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Place an Aldi press into a large resealable plastic bag. Sprinkle the edamame with mace and vanilla, and close the bag with a kitchen towel. Seal the bag, set aside, and refrigerate until the oil is set, at least 1 hours. The longer the period left in the bag, the more flavor the food will absorb. Cut several slits into the bag at the table.

Random Ingredients: green pea,meatball,cake flour,cayenne pepper,sriracha sauce,cabbage,beef sirloin
title: Filipino Skordalia (Beef and Cabbage) Stew and Dumplings
ingredients: 1 lb meatballs | 2 cups shredded cabbage | 1 1/2 lbs meatballs | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper or 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup finely cut green pea ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 cup cake flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons sriracha sauce
instructions: Put the meatballs in a saucepan of salted water. Simmer over medium to low heat until the meat is tender. Drain. Chop the cabbage and green peas. When meat is cool, cut it into about 30 slices and refrigerate. When ready to work with, add half of minced garlic, cayenne and meat and mix the flour together. Roll the meatballs a few at a time into the flour mixture to coat. Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil. Add half the dumplings and return to a boil, skimming the foam. Cook until dumplings float to the surface in a few seconds. Drain the dumplings and rinse with cold water. Drop one at a time into the dumplings. To cook in batches, add the cabbage, green peas and meatballs to the pot and mix thoroughly until all dumplings are covered. Add salt to taste. Pass a few tablespoons of sriracha on the side and serve. You may also pass fresh hot pepper flakes. Note, you can also add a touch of japanese mayo to the stew, but i would never stir this step.

title: Simple, Easy, Crispy Noodles
ingredients: 1 package wide egg noodles | 1/2 cup shortening for frying
instructions: Heat the shortening in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 350 degrees f. Prepare the noodles according to the package directions. Drain. While the noodles are still hot, place them in a glass bowl with a cover. Cover the bowl with a kitchen towel and let them steam for about 5 minutes to loosen the skin. Drain the butter from the bowl of noodles and add them to the noodles. Using a small knife or pastry blender, cut the thin slices of shortening into the noodles and mix together. Add the coated noodles to the hot oil with a sprinkling of water, a pinch of salt and a sprinkling of cayenne pepper to taste.

title: Pimientos
ingredients: 2 cans sliced pimientos, drained ( canned ) | 1/2 lime
instructions: Remove the peel from the lime and cut in half. Open the two cans of pimientos and dump the water into a large skillet. Bring to a boil and allow it to boil for 3 - 4 minutes. This is when you could throw in a little crushed ice and watch it carefully because when it starts turning the pimientos, they have a higher heat in the skillet. Once the pimientos have cooked for a few minutes, stir in the lime juice. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,cake flour,red wine vinegar,green cardamom
title: Lebanese Achaari Bread (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cake flour ( or all purpose flour ) | 1 cup chicken bouillon granules or 1 cup chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom, crushed
instructions: Place oven rack in middle of oven and preheat oven to 325°f. In bowl, stir 1 cup of flour into bouillon.

title: Portuguese Bread and Butter
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, finely chopped | 1 package small banana leaves, thawed if frozen ( available from german grocery store ) | 2 -3 tablespoons raisins ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl combine the onions, thawed banana leaves, and raisins. Mash the banana leaves slightly with a fork or potato masher, until the mixture is a nice paste like consistency like mashed potatoes. You might not need to refrigerate this mixture, you do want to gently stir to combine all ingredients. Pour into a small bowl and set aside. Variation, i sometimes use a smallish amount of sugar instead of the raisins. I also add a little minced fresh garlic to the mixture as well.

title: Easy  Potato and Tomato  Bisque (Vegan Irishman)
ingredients: 2 large yukon gold potatoes, washed, peeled and grated | 1 cup cream or 1 cup milk | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 teaspoon rock salt, coarse ground
instructions: Grate potatoes. Heat cream in a 4 qt saucepan. Stir cream and tomato juice into potatoes. Bring to a simmer. Cook over low heat just until potato is cooked and milk has melted. Add salt and rock salt.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,green capsicum,oregano,ginger garlic paste,potato starch,lime juice
title: Ginger Capsicum Steak
ingredients: 500 g lean steak ( i use 1/2 of each ) | 1/2 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste ( or 1/2 of each ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 teaspoons potato starch | 400 g sweet potatoes, in pear shape | 1 green pepper, sliced into strips | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Trim fat from steak, slice into 12 portions. Score steak in lines that cover meat. Mix remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into steaks. Marinate at least 30 minutes or up to a day. Place steaks on grill tray. Grill for 12 - 14 minutes, basting frequently with marinade.

title: Spicy Thai Bread
ingredients: 1 whole wheat ciabatta, loaf | 100 g spinach | 1 large red bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 small squash, sliced | 1 small onion, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon crunchy peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups grated cooked spaghetti
instructions: Cut the ciabatta into 1 inch cubes. Set aside. Bring a pot of water to boil. Stir in squash, pepper and onion. Cook on low medium until squash is tender. Drain. Spread peanut butter evenly on a surface. Sprinkle with ciabatta and spinach.

title: Mexican Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice or 1 cup long grain rice, cooked | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup fruit preserves | 4 cups hot cooked rice
instructions: Cook jasmine rice, rice and salsa in a covered saucepan over medium heat, stirring frequently, until rices are melted and rice is hot. Transfer to bowls and top with fruit preserves.

title: Chilli-Lipped Earl Grey Tea
ingredients: 3 dried red chili peppers, halved ( such as red bell peppers ) | 3 tablespoons earl grey tea, freshly brewed
instructions: Heat a small frying pan over a medium heat. Add the chile halves, split side down. Cook until the skin has blistered and blistered on the underside and the chile has darkened, 10 to 15 minutes. Place the chile on some kitchen paper towels and rub them with the tea. Cool. This keeps, tightly covered, away from light and air, for up to 2 weeks. To use, add a few drops of water and stir.

title: Quick Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon ground whole cloves
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the beans and the ground cloves. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook until warm, about 5 minutes.

title: Kiwifruit and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon red wine | 1 kiwi fruit, washed and sliced | 1 1/2 cups farfalle ( bow-tie ) pasta, cooked
instructions: Combine rice vinegar and wine. Place kiwifruit slices in a glass bowl with water to cover. Microwave on high power for 3 to 4 minutes, or until just barely soft. Drain kiwifruit, cool and cut into chunks. Place farfalle pasta in a serving bowl, and toss with dressing.

title: Roasted Honey Mustard
ingredients: 2 teaspoons liquid honey | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons olive oil
instructions: Measure honey into a bowl. Place vegetable bouillon cube into a small container and drizzle with olive oil until dissolved completely. Sprinkle honey mixture into honey mixture to form a paste. Cover tightly and set aside at room temperature stirring once or twice during toasting. When ready to eat remove onion and discard. Brush mustard with olive oil and broil until brown and bubbly.

title: Crostini Gasiovi
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 2 cups marsala wine | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1/4 cup orange-flavored liqueur | 2 cups shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 12x8 inch baking dish. Melt butter in a pot over medium heat. Cook and stir 3/4 cup of marsala wine in the hot butter for about 2 minutes. Pour in 1/4 cup of liqueur, mix well and set aside. Combine 2 cups cheese and pepper flakes in a bowl. When the mixture is cool, stir into bowl with sauce. Sprinkle cheese over mixture in baking dish. Cover with remaining 1/4 cup of marsala wine. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Turn oven off and leave in oven for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit 10 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,wonton wrapper,lamb shank,fine breadcrumb,fennel bulb,marinara sauce spaghetti
title: Stuffed Greek Dumplings
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lamb shank | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 tablespoons finely diced marinara sauce with garlic and herbs | 1/2 cup fine fresh breadcrumb | 40 wonton wrappers | 1 small fennel bulb
instructions: Combine lamb shank, coarse dry bread crumbs and marinara sauce in a bowl, mix well. Place 1 tbsp filling onto the center of each wrapper, brush 2 tbsp water around the filling and roll up each wrapper into a cylinder about 10 x 15 inches. Place rolls seam side down onto a baking sheet. Cover with foil and bake at 450 on a baking sheet for 35 minutes. Serve with tomato basil vinaigrette and mint pesto.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,purpose flour,thai red chili pepper
title: Thai Chili Oil Cookies
ingredients: 1 lb ground walnut oil | 1 red chili pepper | 1 cup all-purpose flour or 1 cup gluten-free all-purpose flour
instructions: Add all ingredients together and mix with hands lightly until well combined. Use small pieces of dough and roll into thin cookies or other shapes.

title: Steak au Pistou (Steak With Pea, Pe andher)
ingredients: 4 swordfish steaks | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon shallot, minced | 1/2 cup peas | 2 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Place steaks and herbes de provence in shallow dish and sprinkle with shallot. Pour cream over steaks and turn in cream. Cover and chill to marinade. Cook peas under the preheated broiler for 15 minutes, turn and continue to cook for an additional 15 minutes or until just cooked through, turning steak once. Remove steaks and peas to plates and serve.

title: Tomato, Raspberry, and Rosemary Almond Salad
ingredients: 2 medium vine-ripened tomatoes, sliced thinly | 1 cup fresh raspberries or 1 cup frozen raspberries, drained | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves, crushed | 1/4 cup lightly toasted almond meal | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage or 1/2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Combine all ingrdients in a pretty serving bowl, and toss lightly. Top with berries and mint leaves if desired. Serve at once. Variation, substitute spinach for the tomatoes, etc.

title: Zucchini Cocktail
ingredients: 1 zucchini ( cut in long sticks ) | 1/2 ounce gin ( i use certoreau-pino )
instructions: Cut zucchini in long sticks. Place all ingredients in a highball glass or cocktail shaker half filled with ice. Shake vigorously to blend. Serve over ice in a cocktail glass.

title: Ajwain Alfredo Sauce Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 30 ounces alfredo sauce | 1 1/2 ounces quick wened alfredo sauce
instructions: Heat alfredo sauce and wipped alfredo sauce in a saucepan over a gentle heat. Remove from heat. Stir in the alfredo sauce until the alfredo sauce is blended well with the alfredo sauce. Serve over pasta or use to make lasagna.

title: Chocolate Lighter Rigatoni
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta ( short tubs ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, ground | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup chocolate chips | 2 lemons, juice of
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c, and grease a 30cm x 20cm ovenproof serving dish. Boil rigatoni to al dente stage, drain, and set aside. Place hazelnuts in a small baking tin, and spread over the bottom and sides of the baking tray. Roast hazelnuts in the oven for 5 - 6 minutes, or until lightly browned and soft. Remove from oven and cool. Using a food processor, roughly chop hazelnuts. Add breadcrumbs and chocolate chips, and pulse until combined. Add lemon juice, and pulse until combined. Drain the rigatoni and toss with hazelnut filling mixture. Pour into pan and bake, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes.

title: Simple Microwave Chicken (Biryani) Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless chickens | 2 cups good quality basmati rice ( basmati is a long, slightly sticky rice )
instructions: Prepare basmati rice as instructed on package. Drain water out of rice, and place chicken on top of the rice. Cover, and cook on 100% power for 10 minutes. While doing this, place some paper towels over the chicken, wrap, and set on a rack. Place the rack onto a cookie sheet and in the freezer, it will become hard so watch carefully. After 10 minutes, you will feel the difference. Use a sharp knife to cut the chicken at an angle, into pieces about 1 1/2 to 2 long. Set aside.

title: Italian Fennel & Fennel Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 2 teaspoons florida fennel seeds | 2 teaspoons italian-style salad dressing mix ( wildtree italian salad dressing mix )
instructions: Combine the fennel seeds and salad dressing mix in a plastic bag and shake well to combine. Store in refrigerator. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 4 cups low sodium broth, prepared according to package directions ( v8 or 1/2 cup ) | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds
instructions: Mix the kinder ingredients. Add ingredients to your soup pot and bring to a boil. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,red chile,thai fish sauce,cremini mushroom,pizza sauce
title: Thai-Style Pizza
ingredients: 16 ounces pizza sauce, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 red chile, seeded and minced | 1 lb cremini mushroom, sliced ( about 5 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 500° f. Combine half the sauce and cornstarch in a small bowl. Set aside. In a large, ovenproof skillet, heat remaining sauce and chile until hot. Add mushroom and fish sauce. Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid. Arrange mushrooms over sauce. Sprinkle with remaining sauce mixture. Bake at 500 degrees f for 30 minutes or until crust is browned.

title: Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Put one tortilla on a clean baking pan. Put egg yolk in a small bowl. Use the small bowl to beat the egg yolk into the egg yolk. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Dip the fried tortillas in the egg yolk until crispy, then place them on a piece of foil. Bake for 20 minutes, or until golden. Remove and cool on a wire rack.

title: Braised Beef Turnips
ingredients: 2 lbs peeled small turnips | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom | 2 lbs stewing beef or 2 lbs round steaks
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 f degrees. Rinse and dry the turnips and cut into small uniform pieces or you can use whatever size. You can either peel the meat off the lean top and then slice across and then put into a baking dish. Place in the oven and roast as directed. Remove turnip and set oven temperature to broil. Broil turnip and turnip for about 2 or 3 minutes per side. Remove from oven, cover loosely with foil, and let cool while you prepare your gravy. Place the meat in a separate plate and take the meat off the bones. Add the broth, salt, and pepper to taste. If serving immediately, reheat the broth while adding the meat to the beef and turnip mixture. If serving later, keep the meat warm so you can eat it while it's still warm.

title: Mushroom Crusted Fish
ingredients: 10 cremini mushrooms | 1 stalk celery | 1/2 lb smoked fish fillet | 3 slices bacon | 1/2 cup peas ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 medium onion | salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons flour | breadcrumbs, for coating the fish
instructions: Heat oven to 350°. Rinse mushrooms. Cut into quarters with cleaver. Slice celery and mushrooms into thin slices. Cut the bacon into small pieces. Remove the meat of the fish and cut into thin strips. Place the strips of fish in a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. Slice the onion into thin rings, then slice into rings. Place the mushrooms, celery, bacon, peas, chopped onion, salt, and pepper in a separate bowl and set aside. Mix flour and seasonings in a small bowl and set aside. Coat the fish in the flour mixture. Coat the fish in bread crumbs and then coat with bread crumbs again. Repeat until all the fish is coated. Place on top of the vegetables. Cover with foil and bake for about 50 minutes. Note, the meat should be flakey when taken out of the oven.

title: Nana Jude's Simple Cheesy Sour Cream--Cheese Dip for Pasta
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375º f. Mix cream cheese and soup together. Place in baking dish. Bake 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Orzo Pilaf(Orzo Pilaf)
ingredients: 1 bag orzo pasta | 1/4 cup orzo-small pieces orzo | 1/4 cup sliced scallion | 1/2 lb lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon of your favorite spice
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions. While that cooks, brown ground beef in a large nonstick skillet on medium heat until cooked through. Drain beef and set aside. In the same skillet, cook orzo until it is no longer translucent. Drain but do not rinse. To dry, add the orzo and the rest of the ingredients to the meat. In a 5 to 6 qt saucepan, combine all ingredients. Heat over medium heat until the broth comes to a boil and thickens, about 5 - 10 minutes. Don't let boil too quickly or moisture in the broth will be absorbed. If a thicker sauce is desired after a few minutes of cooking, you can either place orzo mixture in water and cook until tender. If the sauce is too thick, cook until it is thinner, then add more orzo. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,red chilies,oregano leaf,parmesan cheese,poblano chile
title: Chile Enchiladas (St. Kitts)
ingredients: 10 poblano chiles, halved | 4 ounces red chilies, deveined | 1 cup coconut cream | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: To prepare the chilies, in a nonstick skillet, toast the chilies over moderately high heat, shaking the pan, until the skin is crisp and the stalk is beginning to blacken, about 5 minutes. Rub the chilies with a dry paper towel to remove some of the liquid. Let cool. Remove and discard the burned skin and stems. Place the chilies in a bowl. Heat the coconut cream over moderate heat in a medium saucepan until just barely simmering. Remove the pan from the heat. Stir the coconut cream and the oregano into the chilies, then stir in the cheese. Spread about 1/3 cup of the filling in a small, nonstick skillet. Heat the tortillas over moderate heat, in batches, until barely browned, about 3 minutes. Transfer the tortillas to plates, top with chilies, and serve with the remaining filling for dipping.

Random Ingredients: date,balsamic vinegar,shortcrust pastry,sunflower oil,baby corn,head lettuce,plain flour
title: Corn & Date Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 small cos lettuce | 2 tablespoons baby corn, chopped | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh dates, chopped | 1 pinch plain flour | 1 sheet shortcrust pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line a baking tray with baking paper. Heat oil in small saucepan over medium heat. Add lettuce, corn and balsamic vinegar to saucepan.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,cayenne pepper,chili oil,spanish onion,broccoli,vinegar,rump roast
title: Rump Roast with Veggies
ingredients: 4 lbs rump roast | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 1/2 cups spanish onions | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/2 cup garlic, paste | 3 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees and place on greased pan. Mix cayenne pepper, marinara sauce, onions, vinegar and garlic paste together and pour over roast, turning to coat all sides. Cover with lid and bake at 250 degrees for 5 hours. Remove roast and vegetables to serving platter. Serve on fresh green beans, if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 4 large escarole - washed, dried and chopped | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves ( optional )
instructions: Bring black beans, escarole, and fresh basil to a boil in a large skillet. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until green leaves are crisp tender, 4 to 7 minutes. Remove from heat, and let sit until cool enough to handle, about 1 minute. Pour cooled black bean mixture into a serving bowl, and gently toss to blend. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,corn,green serrano chilies,white pepper,serrano pepper,olive,chipotle chile
title: Shrimp in Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 12 -18 shrimp, fresh | 14 -16 ounces corn, fresh | 2 -3 serrano peppers, chopped | 1 dried chipotle chile, chopped into chunks | 3 cups olive, with skin removed ( can add a bit of oil ) | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper ( optional ) | 1/3 cup green serrano chilies ( optional )
instructions: Clean and devein the shrimp. In a sauce pan, fry the corn with the serrano over medium heat until the corn has some color with some stickiness and some of the pepper bits showing. This makes a crispy, dark colored corn.

title: Cheesy Cheese Appetizer Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs american cheese, cubed | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Put cheese, garam masala in a food processor and grind until it becomes a fine powder or paste. Spread cheese mixture on a baking sheet lined with waxed paper. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Golabki
ingredients: 250 g meat | 12 ounces roast beef | 8 ounces spaghetti | 1 bunch arugula | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 2 slices roast chicken
instructions: Start by preparing your golabki. This is the order given, you will start with the meat, then go on to the spaghetti. Cook your meat until it is very dark brown.. Once you have reached the golden color, remove it from the heat and cover. Leave it for about 45 minutes, and then remove everything from the pan.. If you don’t like the color, you can cut the meat as you like and it will taste like dark meat. When you are ready to cook your golabki, remove the lid and cook your spaghetti according to the package's instructions. While cooking the spaghetti, heat the olive oil in a skillet and sauté the roasts for about 6 minutes until it starts to brown. When you are done, drain the excess fat and set the meat aside, leaving the liquid in the pan. If you feel any pink or blood from the meat, cook it. If not, drain the liquid. Put the meat back back on the grill and cook until it gets slightly brown. Meanwhile, combine the arugula leaves with the olive oil, and toss into the meat mixture. Serve over the cooked spaghetti.

title: Date and Cheese Stuffed Dates
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour or 1 cup gluten-free flour | 2 cups breadcrumbs, divided | 80 g graham cracker crumbs | 200 g dates, chopped | 3/4 cup shredded lowfat mozzarella ball | 100 g breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 cups whole meal bread, crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.

title: Chinese Olives and Star Anise
ingredients: 1 can mixed green olives | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/8 teaspoon ground star anise
instructions: Open olives. Combine the olives, ketchup, and anise in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: ginger,part ricotta cheese,lamb shank,date,graham cracker crumb,tilapia fillet
title: Lamb Shank & Cheese Crumb Gyros
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb shank, trimmed | 1 1/2 lbs part-skim ricotta cheese, drained & dried | 1/2 cup dates, pitted & chopped ( optional ) | 4 fresh ginger, peeled & grated | 3 ounces fresh dates, pitted & chopped ( optional ) | 1 lb frozen pitted dates ( optional ) | 1 package fat-free graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven broiler. In a 12 inch nonstick skillet or a small casserole dish coated with cooking spray, brown lamb shank in hot cooking spray on both sides. Transfer lamb to a plate, place bones in the same skillet & cover with foil. Place in oven & broil for 15 minutes or until darkly brown. Remove from skillet & tent with foil. When oven reheats to broil, remove from the oven & drain any fat from skillet. Set aside covered with foil. In a bowl, mix ricotta cheese, dates, ginger & dates, if using. Spoon half of cheese mixture into the center of gyro, then top with half of the bread crumbs. Roll up & pinch the edges tightly. Repeat with remaining mixture & bread crumbs. Place in a 9x13 baking dish & cover with aluminum foil. Place baking pan on a rimmed baking sheet & bake for 20 minutes or until heated through. Remove from oven & cut in half.

title: Sponge Baskets # Ramen
ingredients: 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/4 cup sweetened dried basil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.

title: Fruited Curried Nappa
ingredients: 2 small napa cabbage ( about 1.5 pound total ) | 4 radishes, each about 3 inches long | 1 mango chutney ( about 1/4 cup plus 2 whole tablespoons ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 ripe avocado, halved and pitted | fresh cilantro stem ( to garnish )
instructions: In a bowl, toss the napa with the radishes and mango chutney. In a bowl, mix the ketchup and avocado. Divide the cabbage mixture between 4 plates or small bowls. Top with the avocado mixture and the cilantro sprigs, if desired.

title: Baked Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpeas, soaked 15 minutes, rinsed ( can be frozen, thawed ) | 1 container buttermilk
instructions: Put chickpeas in a 9x13 pan or a casserole dish. Stir chickpeas with buttermilk to coat bread and bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes.

title: Pear and Savory Pear Roast
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried beef or 3 tablespoons dried pork, chopped | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 24 peeled pears
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for whole pears in crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 5 - 10 hours or until meat is tender.

title: Crunchy Bacon Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 1/3 cup crispy bacon ( i use crisp bacon )
instructions: Spread bacon onto one side of each slice of bread. Place on a baking tray, and cook in the 450f oven for about 5 mins until just lightly crisp.

title: Easy Italian Zucchini Soup
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, thinly sliced | 6 cups chicken broth | 4 cups diced lettuce
instructions: In a large soup pot, combine vegetables and broth. Heat to boiling, and cook until tender. Serve warm over lettuce.

Random Ingredients: olive,coffee,garlic powder,bamboo shoot,bell pepper,chicken breast half
title: Beef Kabobs or Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cubed | 1 can sliced olives | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 large bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 cup hot coffee
instructions: Place chicken, tomatoes with green pepper, olives, bamboo shoots and bell pepper in a large bowl. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Drizzle coffee over all. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator 3 hours or overnight. Thread meat onto skewers, basting several times with marinade. Grill or broil over medium coals 10 minutes, brushing with marinade 2 minutes per side, or until done.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,vanilla pod,sugar cube,peel,pear,red bell pepper,kale
title: Kale and Pear Covered Kale With Confectioners' Sugar
ingredients: 3 lbs kale, stemmed and washed thoroughly | 1 1/4 cups red bell peppers | 1 1/4 cups mixed peel | 1 vanilla pod, split open and folded | 1 1/2 cups sugar cubes | 1/4 cup granulated sugar | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cook the kale in a covered saucepan of boiling water over moderate heat, uncovered, for 12 to 15 minutes or until leaves are very bright green and tender. Drain well in a colander and transfer to a heavy bowl. Meanwhile, combine the peppers with 1/4 cup of the confectioners’ sugar and set aside. Using a mandoline, slice the vanilla pod crosswise and scrape the seeds into the oil at a 45 degree angle. Scrape as many seeds as possible out of the pod and add to the skillet, along with the rest of the confectioners’ sugar. When the sugar is dissolved, remove it from the heat and set aside for at least five minutes to allow the flavors to combine. Cut the kale into 1 1/2″ long pieces and transfer it to the bowl with the sugar. Add the remaining 1/2 cup confectioners’ sugar and toss. Using your hands or a large spoon, mix the greens evenly. Using a floured knife, slice the pepper and garlic crosswise in a crosshatch pattern, then arrange on top of the beet mixture in a diamond pattern. Pour about ½ cup of boiling water over the greens and gently toss with a fork to distribute the greens. The greens may be eaten right away. The greens may be used immediately, but they will keep in the refrigerator for up to six days.

title: Beef Banana Leaves
ingredients: 4 medium bananas, each banana cut diagonally into 8 wedges | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place banana leaves on waxed paper and cover with foil and a lid. Let sit for 1 - 2 hours. Preheat oven to 225 degrees. Add half of beef and parmesan to baking dish. Bake at 225 degrees for 15 minutes. Turn bananas over and bake for 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: black olive,lemongrass,fast rising yeast,thai fish sauce,baking potato,nam pla
title: Thai Potato and Olive Bread
ingredients: 1 cup peeled and diced potato | 1 1/4 cups pitted and sliced black olives, drained ( such as gaeng heeng ) | 1/2 cup nam pla | 1 1/2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 4 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 ounce thai fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon minced lemongrass
instructions: In a large bowl, combine potatoes, olives, 1/2 cup fish sauce and yeast. Stir well. If you want to make your dough the freshest you can, let your yeast prove in a warm place, about 20 minutes. Knead in remaining fish sauce. Divide dough in half and form into loaves. Place on prepared pans. Let rise in middle of a preheated 350 oven for 40 minutes, then turn loaves upside down. Bake uncovered in preheated 350 oven for an additional 20 minutes. The internal temperature can be slightly off on the top, but the bread should be golden brown by this time. Remove loaves from oven and let cool on rack 10 minutes. While loaves are still warm, brush loaves with more fish sauce and sprinkle with remaining 3/4 cup fish sauce. Return to oven on wire racks for an additional 5 minutes, or until light brown and crisp.

title: Cauliflower With Banana (Or Other Vegetables)
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, broken into florets ( or other veggie ) | 1/4 cup shortening | 1/4 cup honey | 1 -2 teaspoon anise seed ( or 1/4 tsp. turmeric ) | 1 medium cucumber, chopped into julienne sized pieces ( or equivalent chopped tomato or spinach ) | 2 slices bananas ( or other cooked vegetables ) | 2 sticks celery ( or equivalent chopped celery leaves )
instructions: Boil cauliflower for 3 minutes in a pot of lightly salted water. Then steam for 10 minutes. Drain well. Preheat oven to 400°f. Place drained cauliflower in a well buttered baking sheet and rub cauliflower with shortening. Bake for 20 minutes until crisp tender. While cauliflower is cooling, toast anise seeds and turmeric over medium heat, stirring until they begin to darken slightly. Turn off heat and add honey. Stir for about 15 seconds or until honey is mostly absorbed, and remove from heat. Stir in aniseed seeds, cucumber, banana or other veggies just until mixed. Spread this mixture onto a hot serving tray. Sprinkle top with anise flavoring if using it or add anise seeds of your choice to the honey. Note, you may add nuts or other raw vegetables. You may stir more than the vegetables themselves, or you may leave it as is and you may stir more than the vegetables themselves. I like to keep some whole almonds in for presentation, but personally i do not care for them.

title: Simple Salmon Gravy
ingredients: 1/4 kg fresh salmon | 2 tablespoons homemade garlic sauce
instructions: Remove skin and bone of salmon. Chop finely. Put fish in a bowl, pour over garlic sauce and toss to coat. Leave in fridge for a couple of hours to marinate. You can either put it in the fridge or leave it in the freezer till required.

title: Spam® Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1 pound cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 pound imitation crabmeat, flaked
instructions: Place white wine vinegar into a saucepan, and stir in cornstarch until smooth. Place cauliflower into a skillet and cover with water. Bring to a boil, and cook over medium heat until thickened. Stir in imitation crabmeat and cook until liquid has been absorbed. Serve over cauliflower.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,prosciutto,tomato juice,red wine,cremini mushroom,cinnamon,extra virgin olive oil
title: Mushroom, Prosciutto, and Tomato Smothered in Tomato Wine
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil, divided | 1 lb cremini mushroom, sliced | 10 ounces cherry tomatoes ( or grape tomatoes ) | 3/4 lb prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 2 cinnamon sticks | 1 can stewed plum tomatoes, with juice
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until they're cooked through. Remove the mushrooms with a slotted spoon, leaving the oil in the skillet. Pour the rest of the oil into the skillet and add the prosciutto. Cook until golden. Add the wine, red, cinnamon and remaining olive oil. Stir to combine. Return mushrooms to the skillet. Reduce the heat to low.

title: Lebanese Beef Strudels
ingredients: 20 ladyfingers | 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange peel | 1 lb packaged frozen phyllo pastry | cooking barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper. In a bowl, combine the chuck, orange peel and parsley with your hands. Mix well with your hands until evenly combined. Cut 16 equal lengthwise slits lengthways with scissors. In a separate bowl, place your frozen phyllo pastry and place a table fork along one edge and side of the pastry. Take the long edge of each pastry strip and pull it up to make a long strip. Roll the pastry strip with your hands, one at a time, into a sausage size cylinder, about 1 - 1 1/2 inches in diameter, then take the short edge and bring it up over the sausage meat in the pastry strip. Take the other end of the pastry and pull it up, and roll it up, folding from the short end toward and across as needed, so that you have a long, thin cylinder. Repeat until you have a total of 18 slits. With a sharp knife, carefully cut each roll into 8, 4 inch long strips. Arrange the strips, cut side up, on the parchment paper lined cookie sheets, and cover with foil. Bake for 20 minutes, then uncover and bake for 20 more minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,lasagna noodle,dark chocolate
title: Easy and Simple Chocolate Lasagna
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dark chocolate | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 9 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler over simmering water. Remove half of the chocolate with a slotted spoon and then drizzle it over the chocolate. Brush the remaining half with oil and place in a cold bowl. Heat a large oven proof frying pan over a medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Tip in half of the lasagna noodles and spread them out across the base of the frying pan. Ladle approximately 1/3 cup of the melted chocolate in the centre of each noodle and then top with another layer of noodles, a third of the melted chocolate and the remaining half of the chocolate. Using a spatula, fold the noodles over the other ingredients. Put the frying pan under a preheated hot broiler until the top is golden.

title: Peachy Beef
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb beef roast | 1 package frozen sliced peaches, thawed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup reduced sodium soy sauce
instructions: Place roast in a slow cooker. Add peach slices. Add soy sauce. Cover and cook on low setting setting for 10 - 12 hours or on high setting for 4 - 5 hours. Shred roast with two forks and serve on lettuce or hot rice.

title: Dynamite-Marinated Black Beans and Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup dry english-style mustard | 2 whole chickens wings, separated from skin on and washed
instructions: Prepare an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. In a bowl, mix well the beans and mustard. Place the chicken wings on the preheated grill, and season with salt and pepper. Cook, turning once, for about 20 to 30 minutes, or until lightly browned and no longer pink inside when pierced with a fork.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,corn kernel,peanut,black cardamom pod,mustard powder,dark chocolate,peanut oil,cayenne
title: Thai Pork With Spicy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin roast | 1 cup dry-roasted unsalted peanuts | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 10 ounces corn kernels ( frozen corn will do ) | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 4 1/2 fluid ounces peanut oil | 4 teaspoons coarsely crushed black cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons coarsely crushed cayenne | 1 ounce dark chocolate, melted
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon peanut oil in skillet over medium heat. Toast peanuts in skillet until golden, about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove peanuts from skillet using a slotted spoon. Add remaining peanut oil to the same skillet, swirling skillet to coat sides. Reduce heat to medium low.

title: Green Chile & Leek (Escabeche)
ingredients: 2 lbs leeks, trimmed and washed | 1 teaspoon chopped green chili pepper
instructions: Cut leeks crosswise into 2 in pieces, then slit lengthwise about 1/8 on each side. Remove tough outer tough skins from leeks.

title: Agua De Espinaca
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon achiote paste ( aji amarillo ) | 50 ml coffee powder | 8 fluid ounces agave nectar | 3 tablespoons cornflour or 3 tablespoons arrowroot | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 cup wine or 1/2 cup water
instructions: In a small bowl combine aji amarillo with coffee powder and agave nectar. Let stand 15 minutes to allow flavors to soak. Mix the cornflour with the water and add to food processor until smooth.

title: Veal Baked in Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 pound ground veal | 1 can catsup
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place meat in a large baking dish, and add enough water to cover meat. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until no longer pink. Drain, and allow meat to cool. Place meat on a large heat proof bowl, and cover with catsup. Cover, and simmer 30 minutes. Allow to cool. Slice, and serve.

title: Sloppy Giuseppes
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 lb ground veal
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except the ground sirloin. Form into 2 inch patties. Grill over hot coals, brown over medium coals. Serve with sauteed vegetables and cheese.

title: Mexican Stuffed Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 cup mexican blend cheese | pimento-stuffed peanuts
instructions: Cut each chicken thigh lengthwise 1/2 inch high. Scoop out the center of the thigh attached to the bone, leaving 1/2 inch of meat attached. Set aside. Using the back of a knife, carefully poke the meat in the thickest area until it has been roughly flattened. The easiest way to do this is to put the meat in between your fingers to pull the skin away from the bone. Continue to pound, using the tips of your fingers to pull out the skin, until the meat is about 1/2 inch thick. Spread the cheese all over the entire back of each thigh. Insert the rounded teaspoonful of stuffing into each meat. Place the thighs onto a plate and allow to rest about 1 hour or more. Preheat the broiler. Remove the meat from the plastic wrap and sprinkle with the pimentos. Arrange the thighs on a baking sheet. Broil 5 inches from the heat 7 to 10 minutes or until the tops are golden brown and crispy. Remove from oven and cut a 1/4 inch deep slit into each chicken thigh. Drizzle with a little more cheese. Broil the chicken with the remaining cheese over medium heat until the cheese is melted, 4 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rib beef,cremini mushroom,jaggery,sugar snap pea,parmigiano reggiano cheese,black pepper
title: Filipino Rib-And-Pea Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon finely grated pecorino parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 8 slices thin-cut rib-and-pea thick-cut beef | 1 1/2 cups sliced cremini mushrooms ( shiitake ok ) | 1 bag sugar snap peas ( ends trimmed ) | fresh ground black pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons jaggery, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cut the beef into thin slivers.

title: Jhangora-Style Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried beans | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 3/4 cup chopped white onion | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon beer | 2 tablespoons chopped nuts
instructions: Rinse beans and place in a small pot with enough water to cover over medium heat. Bring to boil, then reduce heat.

title: Chinese Pork Rolls
ingredients: 8 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed according to package directions | 4 1/2 cups pork sausage ( i use johnsonville's brand ) | 2 1/2 lbs beef round rump roast or 2 1/2 lbs chuck roasts | 2 packages frozen string bean, thawed | 5 tablespoons cashews, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Unfold each sheet of phyllo on a lightly floured board. Place in baking pan. With a small sharp knife, make a cross in the center of phyllo sheets to make an x. Fill the x with some sausage, then some string beans and some cashews. Place in center of the phyllo sheet, trim hanging at the sides. Roll up, beginning at the short side. Cut rolls into 1 inch squares. Spoon filling into a shallow baking dish. Bake, covered, for one hour. Uncover, and sprinkle with any remaining cashews.

title: Lazy Stomach
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork belly | 1 can cream of celery soup
instructions: Boil belly bones and take out. Cut into slices and into small chunks or pieces. Strain soup and put in a large sauce pan. Put pork belly into pot. Cover and simmer, about 1 hour or until tender.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,dark soy sauce,coffee,italian seasoning,eggplant,yogurt,chili paste garlic,extra tofu
title: Tofu Eggplant Rollups
ingredients: 1 eggplant, about 2-3 | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | coarsely 2 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese or jarred mozzarella cheese, sliced 1/4 to 1/8 inch thick | 2 cups plain yogurt or 2 cups low fat greek yogurt | 4 ounces extra firm tofu, drained and pressed | 2 teaspoons light hot coffee | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce ( such as braggs ) | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f generously coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Cut ends off the eggplant, then cut out the center. Cut into thick slices and toss slices with chili paste. Arrange slices on the prepared baking sheet and sprinkle with mozzarella and bake in the center of the oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes, turning slices over halfway through. Let cool, then spread each slice with half each of yogurt, tofu and the coffee syrup, to taste. Serve with remaining half of yogurt and some other garnishes, such as cilantro and red onion.

Random Ingredients: coconut,cream mushroom soup,hot paprika,button mushroom,graham cracker crumb,macaroni,french bread
title: Macaroni and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 lb french bread, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 1 lb medium button mushroom | 1 cup chopped macaroni | 1 cup flaked coconut | 1 tablespoon hot paprika
instructions: Cook macaroni until al dente. Drain. Combine soup, macaroni and half the coconut. Fold in the macaroni. Spoon into a greased 2qt casserole. Cover with bread slices and mushrooms. Sprinkle with remaining coconut. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes. Serve with sour cream & green peppers if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Swedish Gravy
ingredients: 4 ounces plain yogurt | 1 1/2 cups beef gravy, any flavor, i recommend my homemade | 4 ounces of chocloate chopped bittersweet chocolate ( i like to cut this up or a lot )
instructions: Put the yogurt, gravy and half the chocolate in a saucepan on medium heat and bring to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat. Stir, cover and set aside. Serve.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,bamboo shoot,fruit,white wine vinegar,lemon peel
title: French Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 french onion soup, can also be made as a french onion soup | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 can mixed dried fruit, drained | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 2 slices of toasted peeled lemon peel
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, including the lemon peel. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: sauce,roast beef,sazon seasoning,beef,ginger root,chili oil,turmeric powder,parmesan cheese
title: Ranch Beef
ingredients: 1 small roast of beef, sliced thin | 1/4 cup sliced ginger root | chili oil | 3 -4 drops hot sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon sazon seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 1 dash ground turmeric powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pour chili oil in a roasting pan to about 1/2 inch deep. Lay the sliced roast on the oil, spreading it evenly. Sprinkle the roast with a lot of the ginger. Sprinkle on another tablespoon of minced ginger root, chili oil and hot sauce. Sprinkle the rest of the ginger, chili oil, hot sauce and turmeric. Add a dash of turmeric and a dash of parmesean cheese. Bake at 400 degrees f for 30 to 45 minutes, until it is done.

title: New England Meatball and Macadamia Nut Slice
ingredients: 1 packet frozen meatballs, thawed | 1 cup red cabbage, shredded ( about 200g ) | 1/2 cup macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup irish cream ( light mayo type ) | 125 g chicken meat, roughly chopped | hot cooked rice
instructions: Place meatballs, cabbage, nuts and irish cream in a large bowl and stir to combine. Spoon mixture into a 20x29cm slice tin. Bake in a moderate oven, uncovered, for about 50 mins or until meatballs are cooked. Serve with rice.

title: Tuna Stuffed French Fries
ingredients: 16 ounces tuna packed in oil, drained | 8 large potatoes, peeled and cut into half-moons | 6 ounces swiss cheese, cut into thin strips | 1 cup sushi rice | 1/4 cup margarine ( optional ) | 1/4 cup red burgundy wine
instructions: Drain tuna and discard the liquid from the tuna. Cut the tuna cheese into thin strips and then into strips. Set aside. Cut the potato halves into wedges and then cut each wedge into 4 equal wedges. Cut the potato wedge into thin strips and then cut each wedge into 6 pieces. Set aside. Place the potato pieces on a baking sheet and bake at 375°f for about 15 minutes to brown. Remove from the oven and brush the potatoes with margarine. Place a piece of tuna on each potato strip, then top with a strip of cheese. Place the french fries on top of the tuna and sprinkle with the red burgundy. Bake the french fries at 375°f for about 15 - 15 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

title: Passionfruit Rum Balls - Hon. Overnight
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 1 tablespoon light rum | 1 small passion fruit | 1 green onion, 1 - 1 1/2 cup finely chopped | 1 sheet nori, cut into 10 x 2 cm sheets
instructions: Mix cornmeal & light rum together & divide into 3 equal quantities. Dip the nori into a mixture of the sifted flour & cornmeal. Dredge in flour mixture to coat. Heat a 12 inch frying pan over a medium heat & cook the balls until brown. Remove and place on absorbent paper to remove excess oil while the balls are still warm. Sprinkle hot balls with a little extra rum if you wish. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coconut,red chile pepper,yellow bell pepper,lemon zest
title: Spicy Coconut Pepper Slice
ingredients: 2 teaspoons grated fresh lemon zest | 1 can flaked coconut | 1 1/2 heads red chile peppers, finely chopped | 1 yellow bell pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees f. Place lemon rind, coconut flakes, chile peppers, and yellow bell pepper in a small baking dish, and coat well with the coconut mixture. Bake slice in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes, until crisp and golden.

title: Sesame French Fries
ingredients: 6 slices white bread, crusts removed, cut diagonally into 2 inch squares | 6 tablespoons sesame oil | 6 tablespoons ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 340 degrees f. In a mixing bowl, add the bread squares to 1 cup water and soak for 10 minutes. Remove the bread from the water, squeeze and dry on paper towels. Set aside. In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil on medium high heat. Sprinkle in the ground black pepper and cook for about 10 seconds, stirring constantly. Dip each piece of bread in the dry sesame oil and fry on both sides, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,san marzano tomato,jalapeno pepper,beef bouillon cube,salt pork,green lentil,cashew,self rising cornmeal
title: Tex Mex Chili
ingredients: 2 beef bouillon cubes, crumbled | 2 bunches green lentils | 2 cans san marzano tomato-based whole peeled tomatoes | 2 jalapeno peppers, halved | 1 package salt pork | 6 cups vegetable stock | 8 cups self-rising cornmeal | 1/2 cup roasted crushed cashews
instructions: Place the beef bouillon cubes, the dried green lentils, the 2 cans of San marzano tomatoes, the jalapenos, and salt pork in a blender until the mixture is smooth. Set aside. Bring the vegetable stock to a boil in a pot.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,lime juice,pizza dough,okra,potato,dark chocolate,sesame seed
title: Sweet Potato Pizza Okra and Okra Wedges
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1 package prepared thin pizza dough, thawed | 1 can frozen okra, drained | 1 cup simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1/4 cup plus 2 tblsp. sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Spray a 10 x 17 baking dish with veggie spray. In a bowl, mix together the melted chocolate, lime juice and salt. Set aside. Unroll the pizza dough and gently roll it into a thin circle, about 1 inch thick. Place the circle onto a baking sheet. Spread the okra over the dough leaving an 1/2 inch border around the edge. Roll up the dough into a tight spiral about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Brush with the melted chocolate mixture. Sprinkle the potato slices with minced, seeded potatoes and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake for 15 minutes or until the crust is golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Olive Spread (Canned for Gifts)
ingredients: 1 lb ripe olives, of good quality such as parma | cooking apple | asiago cheese, grated
instructions: If a can of olives is not available, drain the liquid from the olives to remove as much of the liquid as possible. Slice the olives into thin slices then mash them well. Mix the olives and the liquid in a bowl and add grated cheese. Refrigerate until ready to use. Can be refrigerated for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: french onion,coconut cream,taco seasoning mix,cashew,herbes de provence,chili oil
title: Creamy Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 3 cups roasted cashews ( unsalted ) | 1 french-fried onion, ( or sweet onion ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package fiesta creamed coconut cream ( low milk ) | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence ( i used dried ) | 3/4 - 1 tablespoon hot chili oil, to taste
instructions: Place cashews on a large, microwavable dish. Top with French fried onion, breaking and coating every couple seconds with the oil. Microwave and stir until the onion is soft and the cashews are lightly browned. Set into a large bowl. Add taco seasoning, creamed coconut cream, herbes de provence and chili oil. Mix until well incorporated. Stir until mixture is well blended. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight, stirring every once in a while. Allow to rest for 20 - 30 minutes, still moist. Stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,chipotle pepper,celery seed,macadamia nut,italian salad dressing,salt pepper
title: Di's Italian Shredded Celery
ingredients: 1 can chipotle peppers | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon italian salad dressing | 1/8 cup dried macadamia nuts ( i prefer the brown type ) | salt and pepper
instructions: In a mixing bowl, add celery, chipotle chilies, garlic powder, italian dressing, nuts, salt and pepper. Mix well until desired texture is achieved.

title: Apple Vegetable Pastina
ingredients: 1 package uncooked wagon wheel fresh beets or ( 8 ounce ) package frozen beets ( 8 ounce ) | 1 medium sweet onion, quartered, quartered | 1 medium apple, cored and chopped | 1 box dry pastina | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Cook onions and apples in 3 tbsp oil in large pot for 15 min or until they are tender. Add beetroot, apples, spinach and pasta. Cook covered on low 10 - 15 min, until pasta is cooked as directed on box. Stir occasionally. Add vanilla.

title: Cheese With Green Peppers
ingredients: 8 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 16 green peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Lay out a 9 x 12 inch baking dish that has been sprayed with a non stick cooking spray. Place the green peppers on the baking dish. Cover the top of the peppers with shredded mozzarella cheese. Bake about 15 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes before slicing. Serve hot.

title: Lamb Chops with Rigatoni
ingredients: 4 lamb chops, boneless | 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar syrup | 2 cups uncooked rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees, and lightly oil a baking sheet. Place chops between 2 sheets of wax paper, and flatten with a meat pounder or other heavy skillet to a 3/4 inch thickness. Cut a long slit down the center of each chop. Dip each piece in sugar syrup, then in rigatoni, covering completely. Fold in sides of tortillas, ensuring each is completely covered. Bake in preheated oven until meat is cooked through, about 15 - 20 minutes, and the rigatoni is firm and browned, but still firm inside.

title: Spanish Onions
ingredients: 12 green tomatoes, sliced lengthwise | 1 spanish onion, peeled and sliced lengthwise | 6 tablespoons grainy mustard
instructions: Arrange tomato slices in a nonstick frying pan. Bake, turning occasionally, at medium heat until onion is caramelized and slightly charred, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat to cool slightly. Place onion slices in a bowl, and coat with mustard. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mexican corn,garlic paste,vegetarian bean,thai basil,mustard powder,water chestnut
title: Spicy Vegan Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can vegetarian refried beans | 1 can mexican-style corn | 1/4 cup chopped canned water chestnuts | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 2 sprigs fresh thai basil
instructions: Mix refried beans, corn and water chestnuts in large mixing bowl. Stir in garlic paste for 1 minute. Add dry mustard powder and basil.

title: Ketchup Macaroni
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups ketchup | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 4 tablespoons white vinegar or 4 tablespoons water | 1 tablespoon kosher pickling spices
instructions: Cook macaroni until al dente or firm. Drain and rinse with hot water till cool under cold water before adding to sauce.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,worcestershire sauce,mayonnaise,tonic water,ginger garlic paste,egg noodle,mint,flat bread
title: Bread Salad With Mint Butter
ingredients: 1 egg noodle | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint or 1 tablespoon coriander | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh flat bread, torn into small pieces | 1 teaspoon grated pickled ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 cup tannmirisian tonic ( soured cream ) or 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( soured cream )
instructions: Place noodle in a large saucepan, cover with boiling water and leave to swell for 7 minutes. Drain and run under cold water to cool the noodles slightly. Drain well and set aside. Place the remaining ingredients, except the tonic or cheese, in a large glass bowl and mix together using a fork. Toss the noodles with the dressing, adding the tonic or cheese just before serving. Note, check seasoning before service, adding salt if necessary.

title: Baked Sausage and Potatoes with Kielbasa
ingredients: 5 large russet potatoes | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice potatoes lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Scrub potatoes and place in medium mixing bowl. Cover potatoes with cold water, approximately 1/2 inch, stirring gently once during to prevent sticking. Drain and place in single layer on large sheet pan with sides. Bake uncovered for an hour and 15 minutes. Remove from oven and turn off oven, leaving for an additional 10 - 15 minutes. Allow sausage to cool slightly before slicing into pieces.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,basil pesto,icing sugar,courgette,tomato juice,curry leaf,baby corn,mexican cheese
title: Tippy Curried Vegetables
ingredients: 1 package mixed baby corn | 1/2 cup frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 2 tablespoons finely shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 tablespoon finely shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup tomato juice or 1/4 cup juice | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaf ( optional ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh basil pesto | extra icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Place the baby corn on a microwave safe plate with the frozen orange juice concentrate in it. Cover and microwave on high power for about 3 minutes or until bright green and the corn is tender, stirring half way through cooking. When the corn is almost done, mix in the monterey jack cheese and mexican cheese until melted. When the corn is just ready, add in the tomato juice, curry leaf, and pesto. Mix until well blended. Serve warm, sprinkled with extra icing sugar.

title: Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dry black beans | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings ( i like more because it has a bit of flavor ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Cook beans over medium heat for about 10 minutes, until soft, but not mushy. Stir in the drippings if desired and stir until it has melted. The beans will thicken as it sits at some point. The temperature of your skillet will probably be a bit higher, so be sure to stir it often. It will also give you some oil. Serve immediately. Variation, sometimes i saute a little celery on top of the beans. This is great with a dollop of sour cream and some fresh herbs or other garnishes.

title: Easy Spinach Potatoes
ingredients: 2 cups spaghetti sauce | 3 cups frozen mixed baby spinach leaves | 1 package instant potato flakes ( optional ) | 1 bag ice | 1 bag frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. When done, add spaghetti sauce and frozen washed spinach. Cook for an additional 5 minutes or until spinach is slightly browned and ready to serve. Add instant potato flakes if using.

title: Cranberry Basil Pesto & Bacon Appetizer
ingredients: 1/3 cup spiced rum or 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh lemon zest | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil pesto | 3/4 cup toasted cranberries | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil ( i used a mix of parsley and chervil and omitted mint ) or 1 tablespoon dried chervil ( i used a mix of parsley and chervil and omitted mint )
instructions: Rinse, drain and dry the cranberries and place in a bowl. Stir together the rum or wine vinegar, lemon zest, pesto, cranberries and fresh basil and mix well. Spoon into serving dish or jars. Chill for at least two hours. The longer this sets, the better it gets.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,cream chicken soup,turnip,celery salt,ginger paste,sauce,farfalle pasta
title: Vegetable Pasta Delight
ingredients: 1 package sauerkraut with prawns | 4 cups heavy cream | 1 cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 cup farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, cooked, drained and kept warm
instructions: In large saucepan over medium heat, combine sauerkraut with prawns. In medium bowl, mix whipping cream, cream of chicken soup, ginger paste, celery salt and hot sauce. Pour whipping cream mixture over sauerkraut and stir. Cover and cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Drain pasta and serve mixture over hot pasta.

title: Sauerkraut - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs sauerkraut | 2 large spring onions, julienned | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon dried chives
instructions: Put sauerkraut in crock pot. Cut spring onions and stir well. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon chopped chives. Stir. Place in crockpot and cook on low for 7 hours turn to high. Stir well, turn crockpot to high and cook for 2 hours.. Serve over egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,yellow onion,copha,orange juice,tomato jalapeno,golden syrup,black pepper,onion powder
title: Churros
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup chopped tomatoes ( jalapenos ) | 1 tablespoon chopped yellow onion | 1 tablespoon chopped pisco or 1 tablespoon cointreau liqueur | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon dried onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | cooking spray | copha
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine orange juice, tomatoes, chopped onion, pisco and dried onion. Cover and simmer over medium low heat for 10 minutes or until very low. Remove from heat and stir in pepper. Stir until mixture is well mixed, set aside. Heat a nonstick large nonstick skillet over medium heat for 1 minute then spray with cooking spray. To test if your pan is hot enough, drop 2 tablespoons of churros in the pan and cook 2 seconds on each side. Remove from pan and serve.

title: White Bean and Pork Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin or 1 lb other boneless country-style veal | 8 ounces cannellini beans, drained, rinsed, and cut in chiffonade | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons white wine | 1/2 cup margarine | 12 ounces cooked macaroni or 12 ounces cooked linguine
instructions: Chop meat into thin 1/4 inch cubes, about 3/4 inch cubes. Pour 1/2 a cup water in heavy large pot to depth of 2 inches. Add pork. Bring to boiling over high heat. Add beans to boiling water with one tablespoon dijon and stir well to coat beans. Cook beans for 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp tender. Remove pork and beans from pot. Drain beans. Return pork and beans to pot. Stir in remaining 1/2 a cup water, the shallots and mustard. Return beans with their liquid to pork and pork. Cover.

title: Tropical Soft Taco Shells
ingredients: 15 large lettuce, hearts of | 1/4 cup molasses | 5 cups cold cooked bonito flakes
instructions: Chop the lettuce, then set aside. Warm up the molasses in a saucpan until it starts bubbling, then add the meat. Squeeze the meat until it's soft and pour onto refried beans, stirring continuously. Top with the bonito flakes.

title: Roasted Apples, Basil & Garlic
ingredients: 5 lbs unsweetened apples or 5 lbs unsweetened apples | 2 tablespoons dried basil leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place the apples in a large roasting pan. Sprinkle well with dried basil. Cover and roast in preheated oven until very tender and dry with a darker crust, 15 to 40 minutes. Cool slightly and slice. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Greek semolina
ingredients: 1 cup ground whole semolina | 10 large fresh mint sprigs
instructions: In a medium bowl, thoroughly mix the ground semolina and mint. Use a fork to break up any lumps. Place the crushed semolina onto a floured surface and knead it briefly until it is firm and no longer grainy. Shape the dough into a ball. Cut into 8 equal portions. Roll each piece into a 2 inch diameter circle. Place, with the rounded end facing you, onto a greased baking sheet. Use an ice cream scoop or dull knife to press each circle into 8 wedges. Cover the loaf with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Heat a grill pan or a cast iron skillet on high heat. Cook each wedge of bread on both sides for a few seconds or they will burn. Remove from the grill and transfer to a serving plate. To serve, stack the wedges of bread onto a platter or individual plates. Garnish with mint sprigs and serve at once.

title: Chinese Tuna Patties
ingredients: 1 pound tuna, drained | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, crushed | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Cut several slits in each tuna steak. Rub both sides with fennel seeds. Place into a nonstick wok, and stir fry over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Pour in the dark soy sauce, and stir quickly. Remove from heat, and set aside until completely cool to the touch. Press each tuna steak into mashed potato, and wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight, for flavor to blend. Serve cold.

title: Sea Scallop and Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 16 -20 ounces uncooked rice noodles | 8 ounces sea scallops ( thawed if frozen )
instructions: In a large bowl, cover noodles with boiling water.

title: Lebanese Meat & Vegetable Platter
ingredients: 350 g lamb or 350 g pork | 200 g aubergines | 50 g pea | 1 medium aubergine | 1 bunch fresh rosemary leaf | 250 g greek yogurt | 5 tablespoons pistachios | 3 tablespoons pistachios, finely chopped | 1/2 preserved lemon, rinsed and finely chopped
instructions: Cut the meat into small cubes. Grill all the sliced meat until lightly charred. Add the aubergines and pea pods, cook until soft. Cut the aubergines into short thin slices, remove the skin and cut in half lengthwide. Clean the rosemary and tear into even lengths. Add enough greek toyghurt to moisten and mix. Chop lemon and pistachios into pieces, soak in a little warm water. Sprinkle with pistachios and place the meat on one side. Cover the meat with the sauce. Place the pot on a heated grill and cook until the meat is browned. Add more tosy oil to the pot, and place the pot over a high heat. When the oil is smoking, place the aubergine slices on the surface facing the oil. Serve with salads, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,penne,corn,celery,pillsbury crescent dinner,vanilla,rom tomato,garlic powder
title: Pasta and Corn Pies
ingredients: 1 can pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 can pillsbury reduced-fat crescent dinner rolls | 1/2 cup cooked penne | 2 roma tomatoes, chopped | 1 can creamed corn | 1/4 cup chopped celery | garlic powder, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda, to taste
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. In large bowl combine 1st 3 ingredients. Separate dough into 8 biscuits, each 3/4 cup of mixture and 1/4 tsp. Of garlic powder. Place on greased cookie sheets and cut each biscuit diagonally into 8 squares. Brush tops of biscuits with garlic oil to brown the tops. Sprinkle the tops with garlic powder. Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,taco seasoning,roasting chicken,coconut milk,mozzarella cheese
title: Tasty Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 can coconut milk | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Poke holes in the chicken with a fork, and place the chicken breast side up on a roasting pan. Rub taco seasoning into the chicken, and sprinkle coconut milk and cheese over the chicken. Bake in the preheated oven for an hour. Remove chicken from pan, and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar to serve.

title: Wontons for the Ravioli
ingredients: 30 wonton wrappers | 1 quart grape leaves
instructions: Place a little cheese in each wonton wrapper in a zigzag shape. Bring 1 inch of salted water to a boil in a deep saucepan. Place filled ravioli into the water and bring back to a boil. Cook the ravioli for 3 minutes. Drain the ravioli and remove the cartilage and cartilage. Using a small, knife or scissors, make a slit in the center of each ravioli and fill the slit with water. Bring water back to a boil.

Random Ingredients: white pearl onion,vegetable oil cooking spray,tomato green chilies,picante sauce,baking soda,red chilies,tomato ketchup,cilantro
title: Guatemalan White Pearl Onions
ingredients: 4 white pearl onions | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained ( i prefer fire roasted ) | 1 can tomato ketchup | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro | 2 fresh red chilies, stemmed seeded & cut crosswise into 2-inch lengths
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place onions in greased 13 x 9 ovenproof baking. Coat with cooking spray. Bake about 30 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan combine undrained tomatoes with ketchup, tomato ketchup, picante, diced tomatoes and chiles with their liquid, baking soda and cilantro. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer 3 minutes. Spread tomatoes over bottom of a 6 x 5 x 1 inch baking dish to cover. Arrange cooked onions over sauce. Sprinkle with remaining chiles. Bake 25 minutes or until hot.

title: Tandoori Popsicles ( Indian Breaded Meatballs)
ingredients: 250 g yogurt | 1 3/4 teaspoons white sugar or 1 3/4 teaspoons brown sugar | 1 3/4 cups breadcrumbs
instructions: Stir all ingredients together until evenly combined. Let stand 10 minutes at room temperature. Shape mixture into 24 balls. Place on oiled baking tray, cover and refrigerate until solid, about 1 hour. Heat oil to 180c, then gently roll balls in flour. Deep fry meatballs in batches, removing as they cook, until golden. Drain, serve hot with naan bread or ketchup.

title: Easy Black Beans (Black Beans)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat until hot. Pour in the black beans. Sprinkle with lime leaves if using, and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,malt vinegar,double cream,serrano pepper,buttermilk,port wine
title: Portuguese Steakhouse Style
ingredients: 1/2 cup port wine | 1/2 cup double cream | 2 teaspoons malt vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons dry bread crumbs | 4 serrano peppers, seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat an oven to 500 degrees f. In a small bowl, blend the port, cream, and vinegar. Pour the mixture over the sirloin steaks and toss to evenly coat. Arrange the steaks on a rack in a shallow pan and bake the steaks in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, turning once, or until cooked to desired doneness. Remove the steaks to a plate, cover loosely with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest for 5 minutes. While the steaks are resting, sprinkle bread crumbs over the top of the meat and return to the oven to toast. Serve the steaks warm.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,wine,flat leaf italian parsley,lebanese cucumber,rosemary,cooking oil,lime wedge
title: Salsa Fresca With Peppered Rosemary
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 1 lime wedge | cooking oil | 400 g lebanese cucumbers, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise to yield 1 cup | 2 cups dry white wine | 2 tablespoons sweet rosemary, chopped | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped and loosely packed
instructions: Heat broiler. Place the chilies on foil or parchment lined baking sheet. Rub chilies with 1 lime wedge and broil, turning until charred all over, 7 - 8 minutes. Remove chilies to a bowl. Wipe the skins off the chilies, cut into half and remove the seeds and ribs. Cut the chilies into 1/2 centimeter pieces and place in a bowl and add 1 cup cold water. Set aside. Prepare the salsa,. Wash the peppered rosemary in cold water and pat dry with paper towel. Set aside. Combine the cucumber, remaining lime wedge, wine, rosemary and parsley in a food processor and puree in batches. Transfer to a medium bowl.

title: Mexican Style Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh lime juice, or to taste | 1/2 cup fresh dill seed, or to taste | 12 pounds boneless rib eye steaks, pounded thin | 6 cups dry whole-grain bread, broken into pieces
instructions: Mix lime juice, dill seed, and 2 quarts water in a large, heavy pot. Add beef, and let brak over medium heat, stirring occasionally, about 60 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool.

title: Spanish Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup raw brown rice, rinsed | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried sage, crumbled | 1/2 cup ham, chopped ( or sausage ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Rinse the rice in a colander until the water runs clear. Place the rice in a large serving bowl, add all remaining ingredients, and stir to combine until all ingredients are well distributed. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours and up to 6 hours, stirring occasionally to mix evenly. Serve with warm bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,vegetarian bean,golden syrup,part mozzarella cheese,cucumber,tomato
title: Fen Nasturtium Pizza With Paneer
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetarian baked beans ( vegetarian is good for you, but not necessary ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup ( light is ok ) | 1 small tomato, diced | 1 small cucumber, diced | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds ( or to taste ) | 3 tablespoons shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, preferably freshly grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line two heavy baking sheets with foil. Place beans in a small bowl. Stir in syrup, tomato, cucumber, fenugreek and 1 1/2 ounces of the mozzarella. Distribute evenly among the prepared baking sheets. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until crisp on top and filling is warm and bubbly. Allow to cool slightly before slicing into 4 rounds.

title: Greek Meatball Soup With Tomato
ingredients: 2 onions, finely ground | 200 g ground fat ( you can substitute half lamb or beef or veg etc. ) | 1 can tomatoes | 1/4 cup fresh oregano leaves | 1/4 cup fresh coriander | 1 oranges or 1 lemon, juiced
instructions: In a medium sized saucepan, mix the onions, and enough water to cover the meat. Cook over medium heat until the meat is cooked through and no traces of blood remain, about 30 minutes.
