Drain the meat in a colander and set aside. Heat the remaining butter in a small pan and add the tomatoes. Cook over medium heat until the tomatoes break down and the tomato juices start to release to the saucepan. Add the oregano leaves, coriander and orange juice. Simmer gently for 10 - 20 minutes, until the seasonings have become fragrant. Using a mortar and pestle, mash the tomatoes and seasonings. Return the meatballs to the pan. Heat through.

title: Cheddar and Saffron Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 16 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded ( or more if you prefer ) | 2 heads iceberg lettuce ( or other leaf, lettuce leaf, or other salad leaf ) | 1/4 cup saffron, plus | 1 teaspoon saffron | 4 tablespoons iceberg lettuce
instructions: Shred cheddar cheese. Mix together cheeses and shredded lettuce. Place on serving plate and top with saffron mixture. Serve with flatbread.

title: Nairobi Pepperon (Sweet Pepperoncini Dip)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups tahini | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 bunch thai basil, sliced
instructions: Stir together the tahini, seasoned salt, and thai peppers in a bowl. Serve into hot pepper filled pita breads.

title: Tajine (Iranian Lamb Dessert)
ingredients: 1 lamb, fat, 1/2 inch cubes | 1 french-style ladyfinger cookies
instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons tajine on medium heat. Add lamb and cook until brown on all sides. Remove from heat and transfer on a plate. Add remaining tajine on the fat in the pan. Cut french style ladyfingers into 2 inch lengths. Dip half of the french style ladyfingers into tajine, coating both sides and letting excess juices drip back into pan. Gently place in the pan. Bake in moderate oven 30 to 35 minutes until crisp and brown on top. If cooking in a skillet, brown on both sides.

title: Tea Bags
ingredients: 2 -3 dried beets, cleaned, boiled, and chopped ( approx 6 cups ) | 3 ounces tea bags ( i keep these in my fridge, this is just the time i put in the bag ) | 1 cup prepared mustard greens | 1/3 cup lettuce leaf, torn | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | orange slice | freshly scrubbed ginger or shaved hard boiled egg ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook the beets in boiling, salted water for 20 minutes until they become very tender. Drain and reserve the cooking water. Place the beetroot with a little of the cooking water into a colander over a bowl and add the tea leaves, chopped greens, a sprinkling of italian herbs, and a squeeze of freshly squeezed orange juice. Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately, with the remaining cooking water sprinkled on the bag, garnished with the thinly sliced ginger and orange slices.

title: Tunisian Rogan Josh
ingredients: 600 g beef mince | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh coriander
instructions: Combine the mince and coarsely chopped coriander in a large, dry bowl. Turn the mixture into a food processor and pulse just until it forms mincemeat. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate and use as required. Use as required.

title: Simple Pasta
ingredients: 1 box penne pasta | toothpicks
instructions: Start the water for cooking the pasta according to the box instructions. While waiting for the water to boil, make a few slits in the pasta with a kitchen knife. Drain the pasta, rinse in a colander, and place into a pan with plenty of room enough water so it covers the pasta. When the pasta is almost ready, remove from the water and throw it into a colander. Pour about 1/4 to 1/2 cup of pasta water into a large skillet and bring to a boil over medium heat. Add 1/4 to 1/2 a tsp of salt, depending on the saltiness of the salt.

title: Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 1 bag chicken tenders, trimmed | 1/2 cup honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a shallow aluminum baking dish, toss the chicken tenders with the honey. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and sauce is slightly toasted.

Random Ingredients: lipton onion soup mix,gruyere,cream mushroom soup,chipotle chile adobo
title: A Different Chipotle Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 cans of condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 package lipton dry onion soup mix | 4 -6 chipotle chiles in adobo, seeded and finely minced ( canned ) | 5 -6 cups gruyere, grated
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 2 or 3 quart crockpot. Turn on low. Let cook for 4 hours. Serve over noodles, as a dip, or with your favourite veggies.

title: Falafel Using Beans
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas | 1 can kidney beans | 1 cup pinto beans | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Drain and rinse all ingredients. Add flour. Form into small balls. Place on cookie sheet with lip. Bake for at least 10 - 15 minutes, to form crust. Enjoy.

title: Clams & Green Bell Peppers on Spagetti
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork | 1 package spaghetti sauce | 2 medium green peppers, seeded and sliced | 2 tablespoons salsa | 1 container nonfat plain yogurt | 1 1/2 cups bottled clam juice or 1 1/2 cups bottled clam juice, strained
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef over medium heat. Remove from heat and drain. Stir in sauce, peppers and salsa. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Stir in cooked and drained hamburger. Heat spaghetti according to package instructions. Drain. Serve with yogurt sauce. Note, to freeze, bring to room temperature just before serving. Cover and chill up to two days.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepperoncini pepper,salsa verde green,oregano,pea,coriander powder,baking soda
title: Mexican Pea Baked Peas
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas, thawed | 1 jar salsa verde ( green salsa. i like herdez ) | 1 package jalapeno pepperoncini peppers, finely diced | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon crushed coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to in a 1 1/3 to 2 quart casserole dish, toss drained peas, salsa verde, jalapenos, oregano, coriander and baking soda. Cover and bake on bottom rack in oven for 30 minutes and then stir. After 30 minutes serve on top of warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: half,mint,chili flake,balsamic vinegar,margarine,dark red kidney bean,dark chocolate chip,onion soup mix
title: Spicy Hot and  Nutty Rocky Road
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 cup dark chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon dry hidden valley's chili flakes | 2 packets garlic and herb soup mix ( mccormick brand in the can ) | 1 teaspoon dark red kidney beans ( chopped and drained, i use the red beans which are soaked in hot water ) | 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons finely grated dark red chocolate chips
instructions: Add all ingredients in a bowl. Beat with a fork. Pour into a covered bowl and chill to set. Serve at room temperature drizzled with melted dark chocolate chips.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,white bread,serrano chile pepper,vanilla essence,cooking oil,maraschino cherry
title: Lebanese Melon Balls (Akkara)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh maraschino cherries, pitted and coarsely chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 8 serrano chile peppers, lightly crushed ( about 1 cup, split in half ) | 2 slices firm white bread, crusts removed | cooking oil ( for frying ) | ground nutmeg
instructions: Place the cherries in a small bowl using a spoon and smash them into small bits with kitchen shears or the back of a spoon. Add the vanilla and the chile peppers to the cherries. Pour the mixture into a bowl and set aside for about 5 minute while you prep the dough. Cut the crusts off the bread, break apart and reserve them. Using about a dozen or so balls, scoop out the centers, leaving all the balls and bread shell intact in rounded cubes. Place the shells in the mixing bowl and using your fingers, mix in the reserved cherries. Add the reserved shells and mix together. Heat oil in a skillet. Roll each ball in the beaten egg to coat. Place on the hot oil and fry on each side until firm and cooked through, 3 - 4 minute. Remove on paper towels to drain. Sprinkle with freshly grated nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: red wine,almond extract,cauliflower,orange,espresso coffee,cilantro leaf,apricot jam
title: Red Wine Cauliflower With Cinnamon-Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 orange, zest and pith removed | 2 tablespoons apricot jam, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/orange-jelly-with-cinnamon-apricot-amaretto-298286 '' > orange jelly with cider-apricot jam < /a > | 9 cups cauliflower, sliced diagonally | 1/2 cup brewed espresso coffee or 1/2 cup strong coffee | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Dot a large dutch oven with cooking spray and heat to medium. Add the red wine, almond extract and orange zest. Stir and cook until reduced to about 2 tbs/ syrupy, about 3 - 5 minutes. Add the orange juice and apricot jam and heat to just warm. Remove from the heat and set aside. Warm the cauliflower on foil in the microwave for about 1 - 2 min, then toss with the glaze mixture. Sprinkle with chopped cilantro.

title: Spanish Olive Salad (Arrabbiata)
ingredients: 3 garlic cloves, cloves separated | 1/2 cup freshly shelled pitted kalamata olive | lime wedge
instructions: Place the garlic in a small skillet and cook over medium heat until golden and fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Drain on paper towels. While the garlic is cooking, bring a small pot of water to a boil. Remove from the heat and add the olives. Drain and set aside. When the garlic is cool enough to handle, rub the garlic cloves out with your hands using slices of garlic. Place the garlic, olive water and lime wedges in a serving bowl and add the olives. Toss to coat.

title: Aussie Sausage With Ginger
ingredients: 14 ounces pork sausages, sliced | 6 ounces genoa salami, diced | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, diced | 6 ounces egg substitute | paprika
instructions: In a medium size bowl, add all ingredients except paprika, mix well. The longer the mixture is in, the hotter it becomes. Pour mixture into a frying pan and cook for about 10 minutes until browned, flipping the sausages halfway through.

title: Sauci Canapes With Black Beans & Tomato
ingredients: 3 tablespoons black bean sauce | 6 ounces italian-style tomatoes, chopped | 1 orange, zest and juice of | 2 tablespoons heavy cream ( or milk )
instructions: Combine everything except cream and spread evenly on a large dinner plate, using an open face glass of nonstick or similar. Swirl a fork or two of cream into the sauce to lightly coat all ingredients evenly. Garnish with strips of orange zest and serve right away.

title: Chipotle Creamy French Fries
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chipotle chiles, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons shallots, chopped | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 40 ladyfingers, cut in half lengthwide | ladyfinger, garnish
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the chiles, shallots, salt and pepper until well blended. Place a quarter teaspoon or so of the mixture into each finger cavity, then brush top edges with some of the chipotle mixture. Reheat a small heavy skillet over medium heat and add oil. When it's hot, add 3rd of the french fries. Sear the french fries until golden, about 3 minutes. Transfer the french fries to a large plate to drain excess grease. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Italian Pepper Steak (Diabetic)
ingredients: 4 large red bell peppers, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 1 lb thinly cut round steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Brush pepper slices with oil.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,flour,basil,broad bean,shrimp paste,beef stock cube,tomato green chilies
title: Aussie Style Shrimp and Broad Bean Soup
ingredients: 5 beef stock cubes | 1 teaspoon shrimp paste | 400 g diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 tablespoon sweet basil | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 4 tablespoons flour | 3 tablespoons sweet basil
instructions: Heat a splash of oil in a large pan and fry the shrimp paste until fragrant. Add the tomatoes, sweet basil and lime rind, stir and bring to the boil. Serve in the china bowls with chunks of chilled cucumber and chopped fresh basil.

Random Ingredients: molasses,lentil,puff pastry,extra virgin olive oil,head cauliflower,peppercorn,tortilla chip,yam
title: Molasses Sammies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon unsulfured molasses | 1 teaspoon dried whole peppercorns | 1 head cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 1 yam, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 package dry lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 package tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch pan. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat, cubed | 1 pound chayote, cubed | 1 package frozen peas, thawed | 1 package frozen small phyllo dough, thawed and risen
instructions: Place beef stew meat, chayote, and frozen peas into a large pot and cover with enough water to cover the meat and vegetables. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from heat, season with salt and black pepper, and let cool for about 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with phyllo dough. Remove any excess phyllo dough. Fill a pot with water and bring to a boil. Place phyllo dough onto a floured work surface, keeping 1 inch from the edge. Roll or press dough until sheets of phyllo dough are about 15x12 inches. Cut a slit in the top of the phyllo dough as you make the cut, so that 1/3 of the phyllo dough is lying at the bottom end of the phyllo dough. Place 4 sheets of phyllo dough in the center of the baking dish. Cover with the remaining phyllo dough, and place it on top of the phyllo. Cover with remaining phyllo dough. Pour water from the cooking dish into the baking dish. Cover the dish with a tightly fitting lid or aluminum foil tightly enough to completely seal the lid. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Remove the lid for the last 15 minutes of baking to brown the top. Allow to cool before slicing.

Random Ingredients: honeydew melon,ricotta cheese,balsamic vinegar,macaroni,egg noodle,lime zest,greek yogurt
title: Greek Stuffed Melon
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni, uncooked | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons grated lime zest | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 egg noodles | 3 medium honeydew melon ( honeydew ) | 1/4 cup honeydew honeydew smooth sweet pickle relish | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Grease broiler pan with a thin coating of olive oil. In a large pot, cook macaroni in boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside. Preheat broiler. In a large bowl, combine ricotta, lime zest, and yogurt. In another large bowl, add egg noodles, honeydew melon, and sweet pickle relish. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Divide filling among macaroni. Place stuffed macaroni in the broiler. Broil for 12 - 15 minutes just until slightly bubbly.

Random Ingredients: rice,green onion,baking powder,flat leaf italian parsley,nutmeg,nori
title: Yoshida's Baked Rice (Bengali)
ingredients: 1 cup flat-leaf italian parsley ( not dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1 green onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 green onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon baking powder | cooked rice, as accompaniment
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Soak chopped parsley well in warm water to cover while preparing other ingredients. Drain before using and reserve soaking liquid. If using fresh italian parsley, cut in half or chop. Combine chopped parsley, chopped green onion, and finely chopped black pepper and grated or finely chopped nuts if using. Mix rice with 1 heaping teaspoon of reserved soaking liquid. Place rice mixture in a shallow pan or baking pan just large enough to accommodate the liquid. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Sprinkle 2 - 3 tablespoons of reserved soaking liquid over rice and place pan on middle oven rack. Heat to approximately 350°, then remove oven from oven and place pan in oven. Bake rice for approx 20 minutes or according to package and time required by the package, basting once with reserved soaking liquid if dry. Remove and let rice cool until warm, about 10 minutes, then place in a serving bowl. Garnish with finely chopped parsley, green onion, and crumbled green onion if using. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,guajillo chile,cotija cheese,green chili pepper
title: Chile Con Queso (Green Chile Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 3 1/4 lbs firm white cheese, such as velveeta, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 2 1/2 lbs fresh guajillo chilies, stemmed, halved, seeded, and deveined ( about 5 cups ) | 2 1/4 lbs fresh green chili peppers, stemmed, roasted, peeled, seeded, and deveined ( about 5 cups ) | 4 cups fresh cotija cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cut cheese into 8 equal sized chunks. Heat chiles in a heavy 3 to 5 quart saucepan over moderate heat, turning, just until browned, about 5 minutes. Transfer chiles to a bowl. Heat a 10 inch sauté pan over moderate heat until hot, but not smoking, but add a layer of cheese and a dozen or so chiles.

title: Chinese-Style Yogurt
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken legs | 1 cup milk | 1 tablespoon chinese sweet chili paste | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Make several cuts in the chicken legs and remove any visible organs. Rub a lot of salt onto the skin. Place chicken legs in a large pot and pour water over the legs. Bring to a boil, then simmer over low heat for 20 to 30 minutes, or until cooked through and tender. Remove chicken from water and set aside. Remove chicken legs from pot and set aside to cool enough to handle. Cut legs into small pieces. Heat milk and chinese sweet chili paste in a skillet over low heat, stirring occasionally until the mixture begins to boil. Reduce heat to low, and mix in chicken. Continue cooking for about 15 minutes, until mixture thickens about 10 minutes. Stir in honey before serving.

title: Spicy Ricotta Baked With Pepperoni
ingredients: 10 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 tablespoon honey | pepperoni, sliced thin
instructions: Drain the ricotta cheese into a small mixing bowl. Add the marjoram and thyme, and mix well with your hands. Add the minced garlic, a pinch of pepper, and honey, and mix everything together with your hands. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicon baking liner, and set aside for 30 minutes. After 30 mintues, turn the oven on to 400 degrees. Place the ricotta, and any extra marjoram/thyme on a cutting board or wax paper lined baking sheet. Sprinkle each piece of ricotta with about 2 tablespoons of marjoram/thyme mixture. Bake the ricotta for 20 - 25 minutes, or until slightly puffy and golden. While the ricotta bakes, cut a few slits on the top of the ricotta and drizzle the basted side. Serve with a crisp, green salad.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,green bell pepper,creme de cacao,avocado,london broil beef,thyme
title: Grilled Beef and Creme De Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb london broil beef, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 large avocado, cut into thin wedges | 1 green bell pepper, halved, deseeded and cut into strips | 2 tablespoons creme de cacao | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 2 cups rye flour | canola oil ( for frying )
instructions: Place beef across the grain in a shallow dutch oven. Place in a single layer on top of the beef. Combine avocado, pepper, creme de cacao, and thyme in a small bowl. Spread over beef. Cover pan tightly with foil. Bake in a 350 degrees f. Oven for 40 minutes. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,stir fry vegetable,chervil,salmon,onion powder,cream wheat,kosher salt,baking chocolate
title: Irish Chocolate Salmon Pie
ingredients: 6 1/2 ounces baking chocolate, preferably 70 percent cocoa solids | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1 pinch salt | 2 lbs skinless salmon, cut into 12 slices each | 3/4 cup mixed stir-fry vegetables | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup whole wheat yogurt, room temperature | 1 teaspoon baileys irish cream | 1 tablespoon fresh chervil, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f line 13x9 inch baking pan with parchment paper. Put the chocolate in an electric food mixer fitted with a whisk attachment and set aside to soften. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add onion powder and salt to the hot chocolate. When it’s bubbling, add the salmon and stir fry 3 minutes. Transfer the salmon to the prepared pan, spreading evenly. Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Place mixed vegetables in a medium bowl. Add sour cream and baison’s irish cream and mix until blended. Scrape into a medium bowl and sprinkle with chervil. Toss gently to coat the vegetables with the sour cream. Place half the salmon on the bottom of the prepared baking pan and add vegetable mixture, spreading evenly. Top with remaining salmon. Sprinkle half the chocolate over the salmon and top with remaining chocolate. Bake in oven 30 minutes or until browned and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,puff pastry,ginger garlic paste,pineapple rum,coriander powder,chili paste,chicken leg quarter
title: Pineapple Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken leg quarters | 1 large sheet puff pastry | 1/2 cup pineapple rum | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | chili sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander powder | 2 teaspoons chili paste
instructions: Place chicken legs in a large dish. Combine rum, ginger garlic paste, coriander powder, chilli paste, chilli sauce and pour over chicken legs. Sprinkle with fresh coriander and chilli paste. Cover and refrigerate for approx 4 hours, or overnight. Preheat oven to 180°c. Remove chicken pieces from marinade. Bake 35 - 45 minutes, until chicken is cooked. For a sauce, combine marinade ingredients and bring to boil. Simmer for 5 minutes. Serve with basmati rice.

title: Zucchini Side Dish
ingredients: 6 zucchini, sliced on an angle | 2 tablespoons chipotle powder ( or to taste ) | 1 small white onion, chopped ( about 3 tablespoons for me )
instructions: Cook the zucchini by covering with hot water. Add a 1 teaspoon of salt. Cook, covered, on medium high heat for 4 minutes or until tender. Cool. Heat the cooking oil over medium high heat in a large skillet. Add the zucchini and onion. Cook until tender, about 12 minutes. Pour the zucchini and onion into a colander to drain. Sprinkle with salt to taste. Serve warm.

title: Hot Dessert Beans
ingredients: 250 g dried beans, soaked overnight | 2 whole cloves | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil. Add the beans, cloves and salt, and return to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium, cover, and simmer for about 1/2 hours or until tender. Strain, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Heat the cream in a small pan over high heat until steaming, and serve the hot beans on a plate with a slotted spoon alongside. Sprinkle with toasted pine nuts, if desired.

Random Ingredients: margarine,baby corn,hamburger,sun tomato oil,stock,kernel corn,parsley leaf
title: Southern Fried Corn on the Cob (Aka Corn Salad)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 cup baby corn, cooked | 1 cup kernel corn, canned | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, minced | 8 ounces smoked steak, thinly sliced ( i use extra lean hamburger ) | store bought hamburger bun, cut into 6 pieces | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Melt margarine. Add corn, sun dried tomatoes and spinach in skillet. Stir fry over low heat about 10 minutes until spinach just wilts. Serve hot with hamburger and bun pieces. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Cabbage Pea Kebab
ingredients: 1 can brussels sprouts | 1 can canned peas | 8 cups diced green cabbage | 2 cans tomato puree | 2 cups whole-milk natural yogurt | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon ground coconut, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh mustard greens, or to taste
instructions: Blend brussels sprouts, peas, cabbage, tomato puree, yogurt, mustard powder, cloves, and coconut in a blender until fully combined. Taste and toss with greens.

title: Pigs in a Bagel
ingredients: 3 cups bagels, cut in half | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef flank steak | 3 cooked chicken breasts | 3 cans soup, undiluted
instructions: Place both bagsels halves on a cookie sheet in a preheated 300 degree f oven for two hours. Cool and refrigerate any leftovers. Cut cooled bagsels into 6 inch matchstick sized pieces and place in freezer to harden. Remove the meat from both bagsels halves, separate and discard leftovers. Thaw meat and chop up into bite sized pieces. Place the two bagsels halves back into freezer on a plate and freeze for later. Before serving, remove any meat from the freezer and place on a plate and discard marinade. Dice up or shred your chosen meat and place on bagels. Add soup to bagel chips and mix well. Note, soup can be made ahead. To reheat, place leftovers in crock pot, add to bagels just before serving.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,cider vinegar,currant,pineapple juice,lard,french bread,apricot preserve,graham cracker crumb
title: Fruit Sausages
ingredients: 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup lard, melted | 2 tablespoons dry apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 can pineapple juice | 1/2 cup grape preserves | 1/2 cup currants
instructions: Combine crumbs, lard, apricot preserves, dill weed and vinegar in a large mixing bowl. Stir in pineapple juice and grape preserves until well blended. Stir in currants and mix well. Form mixture into sausages. Grill sausages over hot coals or gas flame, turning occasionally, until cooked through, about 10 minutes.

title: Artichoke-Asafoetida (Spicy Artichoke Puree)
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts - drained with juice ( one 15 oz can or equivalent ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor. Blend till smooth. Transfer to an airtight container and store for up to 3 days or freeze up to 4 months.

title: Salmon Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces salmon | 1 cup cooked white rice | 1/2 cup ham | 1 tablespoon fennel bulb | 1/2 cup celery | 4 -5 beetroots ( optional ) | 5 -10 ounces rice noodles
instructions: Cook rice in water and chop vegetables. Saute salmon with salt, pepper and fennel, about 1 minute. Add fish with seasoning and cook noodles. Add rice and ham. Mix well.

title: Puchero Criolla
ingredients: 1 lb shelled squid | hard-boiled egg
instructions: Clean and prepare the squid, removing the heads by rubbing the eyes with a clean cloth or rubbing the insides with a little water. Slice the tentacles from top to bottom, remove and discard the beak. Slice the squid thinly into rings, lengthwise, and sprinkle with crushed yolks of hard boiled egg. Fry the squid rings in olive oil and serve hot.

title: Potato Alfredo
ingredients: 1 bag frozen hash brown potatoes | 4 -6 ounces alfredo sauce ( i prefer newman's own alfredo sauce ) | 2 tablespoons jarred alfredo sauce
instructions: Thaw potatoes in refrigerator. Cook bag of hash brown potatoes in the microwave for 8 to 10 minutes until potato is just soft. Pour a small amount of alfredo sauce into a 9x13 baking dish. Spread the mashed potato into baking dish, top with alfredo sauce. Spread remaining alfredo sauce on top of alfredo sauce. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 15 - 20 minutes. Let cool. Cut into squares and serve with parmesan cheese for dipping.

title: Lefse Livers
ingredients: 1 lb beef liver, sliced paper thin | icing sugar | 2 3/4 cups vegetable broth | 12 ounces uncooked linguine
instructions: Cook lasagne according to instructions.. Drain and save enough broth to make 3/4 cup sauce. Sauté liver slices until brown. Stir in gravy and remove from heat. Add pasta and coat well with sauce.

title: Cannellini Beans & Cheese (Quick)
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 3 slices processed cheese, cut into 3x7 pieces
instructions: Open can of cannellini beans and drain. Over high heat, add a few tablespoons of evoo to a heavy skillet or frying pan, if using. Add the beans with the cheese and stir. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,self rising flour,potato,tarragon,egg,self raising flour
title: Potato Gnocchi
ingredients: 2 lbs boiled potatoes | 1/2 lb self rising flour | 12 ounces grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Pare the potatoes and place into a large pan with plenty of water to cover. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until tender, drain. Cool slightly and mash with all the other ingredients until smooth. Grease a bowl and press a handful of the potato mixture onto the bottom. Roll up and cut into long, thin sticks. Roll one at a time and place on a well greased baking tray. Spread with the rest of the potato mixture. Sprinkle with fresh tarragon. Bake at 425°f/190°c for about 20 minutes until golden.

title: Low Fat Baked Sirloin With Raspberries
ingredients: 3/4 cup fresh raspberry | 1/2 cup shredded beef ( sirloin, stew meat or pork work best ) | 1/4 cup cider vinegar or 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. Place whole berries on a sheet of parchment paper. Drizzle on almond extract. Sprinkle parsley on top. Roll up jelly roll style starting at each end. Place rolls in a single layer on baking sheet. Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until berries are just tender. Bake in oven for 5 min to warm through. Note, if using ground beef, brown thoroughly. If using pork, cook until done. Remove rolls from oven. Place on baking sheet, drizzle with additional almond extract. Serve warm with raspberry sauce. Note, if you're using leftover meat, place in freezer for at least 1 hour, or overnight. It should thaw in the refrigerator overnight. If using leftover roast beef, then heat to very hot and add the leftover meat. It doesn't need to be frozen, and tastes great reheated too..

title: Quick Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken wings | 2 cups beef stock | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 slices fresh whole wheat bread
instructions: Heat stock to boiling in large skillet. Add pepper and marjoram. Boil chicken wings for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove, rinse and drain, place chicken wings in a casserole dish. Mix beef stock, pepper and marjoram. Pour over chicken wings. Top with whole wheat bread, coating the bread with a layer of extra virgin olive oil to cover. Bake at 375 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli and Squash
ingredients: 1 pound medium broccoli, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 pound yellow squash, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup chopped dried cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil. In a large bowl, mix together broccoli, squash, graham crackers, and cherries. Arrange the broccoli mixture on the baking sheet. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned and tender and edges are golden.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,blue cheese,lemongrass,black bean,double cream,cheddar cheese,orange juice concentrate
title: Black Bean and Blue Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans black beans | 1 can frozen concentrated orange juice concentrate | 3 tablespoons lemongrass, chopped | 200 g shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 200 g reduced fat cheddar cheese | 0.5 can tomato sauce | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c. Spray a 1 cup capacity ovenproof dish with cooking spray. Place black beans, frozen orange concentrate, lemon grass, chopped cheddar and reduced fat cheddar cheese all together in large pan. Toss gently to combine. Pour contents of orange juice concentrate can in on top of black bean mixture. Arrange the mixture in the prepared dish. Pour the tomato sauce evenly over top of casserole. Bake with the lid on for 50 minutes. Take the lid off and bake with the lid on for 10 minutes longer remove lid from dish. Sprinkle top with reduced fat cheddar cheese and bake for further 5 minutes, or until it golden.

Random Ingredients: tomato,sea salt,cauliflower,cream mushroom soup,pearl barley,apple juice,cinnamon
title: Easy Apple & Cauliflower Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 bag frozen cauliflower, thawed and drained | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup apple juice | 3/4 cup apple juice, from cooking apple | 1 tablespoon sea salt or 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 cup pearl barley
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, simmer covered until cauliflower is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Quick and Easy Pastrami
ingredients: 1/2 pound sliced deli pastrami | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, minced | 1 tablespoon crumbled dried sun-dried tomato | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 8 slices bread, cut 1/2-inch thick, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spread pastrami slices with sun dried tomatoes.

title: Simmered Mexican Beef
ingredients: 1 lb lean sirloin steak, cut into strips | 1 1/2 cups sugar | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/4 cup cocoa powder
instructions: Brown meat in a large skillet, about 5 minutes per side. Move meat to a slow cooker crock. Stir in sugar. Sprinkle taco seasoning, tomato paste, and cocoa powder over meat. Cover, and cook on low for 8 hours. Note, low sodium taco seasoning can cause the meat to dry out. If you like a thicker sauce, cook on high 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Macronatha (pork with eggs)
ingredients: 2 links pork roast | 1 large shell pasta | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place pork shread in a large oven safe saucepan with enough water to cover. Cover and cook in the preheated oven until the fat has rendered and turned pink, 20 to 25 minutes. Cool. Remove pork shread and set aside in a large bowl. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in pasta, and return the saucepan to a boil. Place the cooked pork shread in the boiling water, and cook until it flakes easily with a fork. Stir the pasta frequently during this time to prevent the pasta from sticking to the bottom of the pot. When the pasta is almost cooked, add the pork shread, and stir to reheat the pasta. Transfer the pasta with a slotted spoon to a baking dish, and place into the preheated oven to keep warm. Cook the remaining pasta in the boiling water until al dente. Drain, and serve with the warm sauce.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,shell pasta,pecan,gruyere cheese,brown mustard seed,lime wedge,chocolate chip,egg wrap
title: Nacho Cheese Sticks
ingredients: 1 package egg roll wraps | 1/4 cup pecans or 1/4 cup walnuts | 3/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino cheese | 1/2 cup semisweet chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons finely chopped toasted pecans or 2 tablespoons walnuts | 1 1/3 cups dry small shell pasta, shells | 1 tablespoon coarse grain brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon grated gruyere cheese | 1 lime wedge
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients except wrappers. Separate wrappers from dough.

Random Ingredients: oregano,canadian bacon,dill weed,habanero pepper,velveeta cheese,yellow bell pepper,farfalle pasta
title: Hot Caviar Pasta W- Canadian Bacon Cheese
ingredients: 1 box farfalle pasta | 1 lb velveeta cheese | 1 lb canadian bacon | 1 medium yellow bell pepper | 1 habanero pepper | parsley & oregano | dill weed
instructions: In skillet cook bacon & dice. Dice peppers. Cut velvetta cheese into small chunks. Bring water to rolling boil and boil farfalle according to directions on packaging. Drain. In large bowl, add velvetta cheese cubes, bell peppers, habanero pepper, herbs and bacon. Chop cheese into chunks. Add to cheese mixture. Stir. Serve topped with a salad of chopped fresh tomatoes, celery or other nice fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,marinara sauce,italian salad dressing,half cream
title: Sesame Flavoured Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/3 cup marinara sauce | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons italian-style salad dressing
instructions: In a small skillet over medium heat, toast sesame seeds until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour marinara sauce into a glass jar with a lid. Fill the jar with sesame seeds. Cover tightly with a lid, and shake until the seeds release their aroma, about 2 minutes. Stir half and half and italian style salad dressing into the sesame mixture. Pour the dressing into the jar with the sesame seeds. Cover, and shake until well combined, about 5 minutes.

title: Thai Bread Crumbs for Roasted Vegetables (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut in half lengthwise and then again lengthwise and crosswise for a total of 3 3/4 cups slices | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste ( vietnamese style chile paste, or more )
instructions: Place the bread cut side up on an oiled and floured pizza pan that has been sprayed or lined with pam, sprayed with cooking spray. Lightly score a cross in the center from the long side.

title: Peas  'n' Things (A Simple & Simple Microwave
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups frozen peas | 2 teaspoons liquid honey | 1/8 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Place peas & honey in microwave safe bowl & stir to combine. Microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring after 3 minutes, then on low for 15 more minutes. Remove from microwave & stir in cornstarch to thaw peas & reheat in a microwave safe bowl, or heat in a microwave oven, stirring after 15 minutes if needed, until peas are hot & bubbly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: milk powder,green bell pepper,chicken bouillon granule,bread flour
title: Crispy Spanish Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 2 1/2 cups milk powder | 1 large green bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Combine the flour, bouillon and milk powder together in a bowl. Stir in the bell pepper, stirring well. Roll into walnut size balls. Arrange on a cookie sheet and brush with melted butter. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,salad green,horseradish,baking powder,chicken,thyme leaf,pace picante sauce,peanut
title: Honeydew Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1/3 cup chicken, chopped | 14 ounces egg noodles, cooked drained | 1 cup salad greens, mixed | 1 tablespoon horseradish or 1 tablespoon lime soy sauce | 1 tablespoon pace picante sauce | 2 teaspoons honeydew sour cream or 2 teaspoons sour cream, if desired | 1 teaspoon baking powder | peanuts, coarsley chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a large oven proof pan sprayed with cooking spray, cook chicken over medium heat until lightly browned. Stir in noodles & then next 3 ingredients. Stir to coat. Sprinkle with peanuts, if using. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes, stirring once.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,egg,potato starch,cabbage leaf,corn syrup
title: Fried Sweet Potato Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup corn syrup | 1 cup orange juice, juice and zest of | 3 lbs cabbage leaves, shredded | 6 eggs | 2 cups potato starch or 2 cups corn flour
instructions: Preheat electric wok and put over medium heat a potato starch coated it with butter. Beat eggs in a bowl, add corn syrup. Add potatoes starch to egg mixture. Stir well until smooth, and add to wok. Add cabbage leaves. Spread batter into a thin layer on the pan. Flip when a light brown color appears. Sprinkle on orange zest.

title: Clams Shreds
ingredients: 3 1/2 pounds baby carrots | crushed clam shells | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook carrots in boiling water until al dente, about 5 minutes. Drain. Drain, and return carrots and juice to the pot. Season with salt and pepper. Mix shrimp with the shrimp, return to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,extra virgin olive oil,basil pesto sauce,portobello mushroom,thai red curry paste
title: Wild Mushroom Pesto Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/3 cup basil pesto sauce for roasted portobello mushrooms | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Pesto, mix red curry paste, worcestershire sauce and olive oil. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve. Wild mushrooms, wash and dry mushrooms. Slit the mushroom caps and remove loose stems from center. Slice mushrooms and add to pesto. Drain any excess water from mushrooms and gently mix with other ingredients. Serve with assorted bread or assorted crackers.

title: Cashew Crackers
ingredients: 2 cups cashews ( shelled ) | 1 1 cup cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups cornflour | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley ( chopped )
instructions: Grind cashews with 1 cup cornmeal, salt and 2 cups cold water. Form into little balls and roll in remaining cornflour. Deep fat fry in hot fat until golden brown.

title: Noodles With Peas
ingredients: 1 lb lean roast beef, sliced into thin strips | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, minced | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package wide egg noodles, cooked | 4 ounces frozen peas, thawed
instructions: In nonstick skillet, cook meat and ginger until lightly browned, stirring frequently. Stir in beans and noodles. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat.

title: Turkish Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh dill | 1/4 cup of fresh mint | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( optional )
instructions: Prep all ingredients in blender or food processor. Cover container with plastic wrap and shake until ingredients are mixed and distributed evenly. Cover container again and shake again until ingredients are evenly distributed throughout.

title: Golden Raisins
ingredients: 3 cups golden raisins, rinsed well ( or 1 1/4 cups sultanas ) | 2 tablespoons almond extract
instructions: Soak raisins in hot water until plump, about 20 minutes. Drain and blot well with paper towels. Combine the raisins, almond extract and 1/4 cup water in a medium saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, about 5 minutes to 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,sesame seed,rice wine,kiwi fruit,blood orange juice,macaroni,soy flour,tia maria
title: Macaroni with Blood Orange Syrup
ingredients: 400 g macaroni | 1 cup dried blood orange juice | 1/4 cup rice wine | 5 -8 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons chopped kiwi fruit | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 2 tablespoons light soy flour | 3 tablespoons tia maria
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water for 7 mins or until tender, drain and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients and set aside. Drain macaroni and place in a large bowl. Add macaroni, macaroni dressing and kiwi fruit. Toss well and spoon onto serving plates.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 2 medium lobsters | 2 medium parsnips | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Wash lobster and parsnips in cold water, making sure both sides have been cleaned to remove any sand or dead lobster. Dry in hot oven until tender, and remove to bowl. Wash and chop parsnips into bite size pieces. Spray a large frying pan with non stick spray and place on medium high. Lightly toast pine nuts, and when they just start to sizzle, add parsnips and lobster. Toss and fry on med heat until cooked through, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,lemon zest,tabasco sauce,bell pepper,pepperoni
title: Pepperoni Salad
ingredients: one pepperoni | one bell pepper | one kaffir lime leaf | one lemon, zest of | 3 fresh kaffir lime leaves | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Take pepperoni, kaffir lime leaf and lemon and lime zest, juicing one half. Take both zes, peel them and cut one half from the pepperoni. Then cut it in half and then cut each half again using the pepperoni piece. Take the two pepperoni halves and put them in dressing, with the pepperoni zes. Shake the jar of dressing in the fridge until ready to eat. Take pepperoni halves and cut each half into 1/4 cubes and you have what looks like salad.

title: Apple Smoke Cream
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated light cool whip | 2 granny smith apples, pared and sliced | 1 -2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Unroll the dough log onto a floured surface. Using a rolling pin, flatten into the shape of a 5 inch circle. Place 1 - 2 tablespoons of the apple slices onto the center of the circle. Fold the dough in half, forming a half moon. Carefully remove the dough from the circle, leaving a half circle of dough hanging over the edges and the edge of the circle. Warm the cream over medium heat until it reaches a low simmer.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,cocoa,hot pepper,pork tenderloin,cardamom seed,pinto bean,rice noodle,celery rib
title: Pork and Rice Noodle Haystack
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut in small bite-size pieces | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed & drained | 4 celery ribs, diced | 1/8 cup rice noodles | 1/2 teaspoon crushed black cardamom seed, toasted | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Toast 1/8 cup black pepper under broiler. Remove and let cool. Chop coarsely and set aside. Combine meat, beans, celery, rice noodles, cajun seasoning, cardamom, cocoa, worcestershire sauce and paprika in large bowl. Bring to boil over high heat, stirring frequently. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, or until pasta is well done and heated through. Combine noodles with meat mixture. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Uncover and stir. Divide pasta among 4 plates.

title: Candied Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1 quart milk | 1 package pumpkin seeds
instructions: Place milk and pumpkin seeds in a large roaster fitted with a rack in the center of the oven. Bake at 300 degrees f until the milk mixture is just beginning to bubble, 5 to 8 hours. Set aside to cool in the roaster. Turn the oven off. Do not lift the cover, as the seeds can suddenly expand to the top of the roaster and destroy the roasting pan and other roasting method. Allow the milk to cool and stir in 1 teaspoon salt. Store in an airtight glass bowl for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,halibut fillet,sugar,lemon juice zest,acorn squash
title: Grilled Halibut and Squash with Aloha (Sweet Potato) Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 whole halibut fillets | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar | 1 teaspoon lemon juice and zest | 1 small acorn squash, cut into 2-inch chunks | 3 tablespoons light-colored liqueur or 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Score fish with a sharp knife into several 1/2 inch crisscross slashes along the cut surface and at least 1 inch apart. Combine sugar and lemon zest in a small plastic bag, add orange blossom water to bag.

title: Thai Dumplings With Fish Sauce
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 24 fish sauce ( nam pla )
instructions: Place about a tablespoon of filling in center of each wonton wrapper. Sprinkle around the outside edge with a little salt and a little bit of the fish sauce. Fold one edge over and pinch to seal. Set aside covered in refrigerator for 45 minutes to an hour to rise the filling. Fill a wok or dutch oven one third full with boiling water. Place dumplings in and move around a little until they float to the surface. To test whether they float, press a drop of water. If they float the water doesn't move the dumplings at all. They should float at least once to the surface. Remove from water with slotted spoon and place in a colander. Serve with fish sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,baby carrot,chicken bouillon,white vinegar,pandan leaf,pepper
title: Baby Shreds in Vinegar With Peanut oil (Tirk Teok Kwa)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon paprika ( hungarian preferably ) | 1/4 teaspoon pepper ( ground ) | 2 -3 pandan leaves ( cut in long narrow strips ) | 4 chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 bag baby carrots
instructions: Rinse baby carrots and cut in half, wash and boil for ten minutes in lightly salted water. Drain, dry, and set aside. Heat oil in large heavy skillet. Add paprika and pepper and stir constantly, as it crackles, add the carrots. Stir fry until carrots start to soften. Add bouillon, vinegar, and the baby carrots, and continue stirring. Remove and serve immediately.

title: Fassoulia Me Fassoulia Tunisiya (Turkish Fassoulia Bread)
ingredients: 1 loaf french beans, cut into 1/4 inch slices | of fresh mint leaves, chopped | fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place a large baking sheet or pizza tray in the oven at 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Arrange the bread on the baking sheet. Sprinkle with mint and parsley. Put the bread on the oven shelf. Bake until browned, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apricot,malt vinegar,onion powder,italian dressing,ginger ale,coconut,hungarian paprika,pork
title: Sweet Russian Pork
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork, cubed | 1 cup chopped sweet onion | 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika | 1 cup german sweet paprika | 4 tablespoons instant minced ginger ale | 1 cup coconut | 1 cup dried apricot, chopped | 1 1/2 cups italian-style salad dressing
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Mix all of the ingredients in a medium baking dish. Cover and bake for 2 hour or until the pork is tender. Serve with cooked rice and noodles.

title: Oven French Onion Breakfast
ingredients: 4 egg whites | 1 package lipton dry onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Combine the egg whites and onion soup mix in a large bowl. Brush on egg whites, then sprinkle with nutmeg. Spread egg mixture on the prepared cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, then turn the oven off. Leave door slightly ajar to allow steam to escape during baking. Allow to cool for 15 minutes, then break off pieces of bread with a long toothpick. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: semolina,garam masala,lentil,pork roast,peppercorn,vegetable oil,kalamata olive,banana pepper
title: Banana Pepper Lamb With Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 1 3/4 lbs boneless pork roast | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | kalamata olives, chopped | peppercorn | 2 tablespoons semolina | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 banana peppers, seeded and cut into strips
instructions: Soak lentils in 3 cups cold water for 1 hour. Cut pork in strips of about 2 inches long or into 1/2 inch wide strips. Brown lamb with oil. Remove and cool slightly. Discard oil. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large heavy skillet. Add chopped banana peppers. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Saute until softened, about 3 minutes. Add lentils and remaining oil. Heat until boiling. Cover. Reduce heat. Simmer 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Spread split peas out in an open baking dish. Spread lentils, pork, and vegetables evenly over the split peas. Sprinkle with semolina. Sprinkle garam masala. Place bell pepper strips on top. Drizzle with remaining oil. Cover and bake in a preheated 450f oven 8 to 10 minutes, or until browned and liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: scallion,sea salt,white corn kernel,bibb lettuce,cottage cheese,chicken leg,broth,white wine
title: Bibimbap
ingredients: 3 whole chicken legs | sea salt | boiling white corn kernel | 2 cups low fat cottage cheese ( i use reduced fat ) | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 cup low-fat broth | 2 teaspoons dried english parsley leaves | 4 leaves fresh bibb lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken legs in a shallow pan. Sprinkle both sides with a bit of sea salt. Pour enough water in pan to cover. Bake, uncovered, in upper third of oven for about 1 hour or until tender. Cut up chicken and place in a medium sized bowl. Heat a large pot over medium high heat. Add the cottage cheese. In 2 batches, stir the cheese until it is the consistency of melted sand castle. Add the wine, broth and parsley leaves and stir well. Remove the chicken from the pan and place in a baking dish. Pour the cheese mixture over the chicken pieces and bake, uncovered, for about 25 minutes or until chicken is completely cooked. Remove from the oven and cool. Remove all except 4 leaves of the bibb. Serve the chicken with the cheese mixture and garnish with remaining parsley leaves.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,self rising flour,dark brown sugar,picante sauce,salsa verde green,coriander seed
title: Mexican Green Salad Dressing
ingredients: 15 ounces salsa verde or 15 ounces green salsa | 6 ounces canola oil | 2 1/4 cups self-rising flour, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped coriander seeds, about | 12 ounces can dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup picante sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350â°f. Mix salsa verde, 6oz canola oil, flour, coriander and brown sugar together. Spread dressing into a 12x18 inch jelly roll glass baking dish. Spread dressing over salsa verde mixture. Bake for 45 minutes. Spread picante sauce over dressing evenly. This dressing can then be made by adding 1 1/4 cups canola oil to 1 1/4 cups canola oil. Set aside.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,chili flake,yellow hominy,kosher salt,water chestnut
title: Guadalajaran Posole and Chips
ingredients: 2 cups yellow hominy, drained | 2 1/2 cups water chestnuts, drained | 1 1/3 cups malt vinegar | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt ( optional ) | water, as needed
instructions: Place quinoa in a large stainless steel bowl. Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil over moderately high heat, scraping the bottom of the bowl with a wooden spoon. Cook, uncovered, stirring until the mixture thickens slightly and the flavors blend, about 2 minutes. Add the cooked quinoa and toss. Remove from heat, cover and let sit at room temperature 30 minutes. Form the quinoa into a 1 x6 rectangle on a parchment lined baking sheet, and cool at room temperature, adding water as needed, about 30 minutes. Store the cooled quinoa in an airtight container for up to six months.

title: Apricot & Mustard Dijon Bites
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup apricot, pitted, chopped very fine | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees centigrade, 190 degrees celsius / 300f / gas grease a baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine apricots, mustard and some of the dijon in a bowl. Spoon into tray sprinkle over remaining dijon to serve.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,chicken bouillon cube,mix,kiwi fruit,canola oil
title: Saucy Kiwi & Kiwi Guacamole
ingredients: 1/2 cup onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled & sliced | 1 chicken bouillon cube or 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup hot prepared prepared mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients except hot prepared mix in blender, and blend well until smooth. Spoon into a bowl, cover. Allow to sit at room temperature for approximately 1 hr to allow flavors to blend.

title: Sparkling Cherry Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 pint french vanilla ice cream ( the ice cream in the dairy flavor is so cheap it makes the top layer sound melter. don't know the flavor. ) | 2 large red cherries
instructions: Using a sharp paring knife slice each cherry into 1/2 inch wheels and place on a tray. Dry roast the cherry chips. When ice cream is ready to be served melt it on low in a pan or microwave using a double boiler. When all the cherries cut into quarters add them to the pan, stirring with a fork constantly. Do not allow this to catch on the bottom. Then spoon the ice cream mixture onto the cherry halves. I know now you can garnish this with a whole red juicy cherries if you like. Enjoy.

title: Cabbage (Shreds)
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon raisins
instructions: Place shredded cabbage in casserole dish. Sprinkle with raisins, cover with ketchup. Heat oven to 350°f bake covered 1 hr and 30 minutes until slightly brown.

title: Spinach With Walnuts and Filling
ingredients: 1 lb spinach, washed and chopped | 1 bay leaf | 8 tablespoons walnut halves or 8 tablespoons cashew pieces | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the spinach in a large pan with about 2 - 3 tablespoons water, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes remove from the heat and squeeze the water out. Place the spinach in a food processor and blend until finely chopped and smooth. You can use an immersion blender, but be careful not to over process. Set aside. Combine the bay leaf and nuts in a small pan with a little of the water and heat until hot and stir over the heat for about 15 seconds watch for it to be very hot and this will burn quickly remove from heat and stir in the confectioner's sugar. Add back the spinach to the pan and stir again. Divide into four equal portions and shape into patties. Heat the remaining olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Fry the patties for 5 - 6 minutes on each side until crispy and browned. Serve with salad or bread slices.

Random Ingredients: fine sugar,pear,tomato puree,beef bouillon cube,spaghetti,cabbage,cheddar cheese,clam juice
title: Spaghetti Pronto
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fine sugar ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons tomato puree ( optional ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 cups beef broth or 2 cups water | 4 ounces uncooked spaghetti, broken into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 head cabbage, cored and cut into 12 wedges | 1 cup finely shredded cheddar cheese | 2 cans finely chopped clams with juice, well drained ( i like the latter )
instructions: In a non stick, heavy pot, add the sugar. Cook stirring constantly, until it is light golden in color. Stir in tomato puree.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,ra el hanout spice mix,tamarind pulp,pinto bean,cayenne pepper
title: Kashkali
ingredients: 4 medium zucchini, shredded | 2 dried pinto beans, soaked overnight in water and then drained | 2 teaspoons ground cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 can tamarind pulp, drained
instructions: Place the zucchini in a colander and squeeze out excess liquid. Place the zucchini, beans and salt in a large saucepan. Boil gently for 10 minutes until heated through. Add the cayenne and ras el hanout and discard any bits from the bottom of the pan. Pour the tamarind pulp into the pan, stir and cook over low heat for 1 hour. Add more salt, black pepper or tamarind juice if desired.

title: Swiss Bliss
ingredients: 1 red onion ring | unsweetened cocoa ( for coating ) | salt & pepper
instructions: Slice red onion almost in half and then cut the slice half again to make 8 wedges. Spray non stick baking spray with the 2 teaspoons of unsweetened cocoa.. Coat onion wedges in the 2 teaspoons of cocoa. Spray large cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 10 - 15 minutes, watching for the edges to be browned and be dark. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,cucumber,egg yolk,gin,bean dip,mexican oregano,lemon juice zest,chicken bouillon cube
title: Mexican "drunken"
ingredients: 1 pint bean dip ( homemade or prepared ) | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/2 cucumber | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup gin | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Cut in half, and slice cucumber lengthwise. Remove seeds and pulp with a spoon. Toss with juice, add oregano, lemon zest, and salt and pepper to taste. In a small bowl, combine the soup and bouillon and microwave for about 1 minute. Pour over drained beans and cucumber and stir. Chill about 5 minutes. Add sour cream and stir. Stir again.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,hot sauce,russet potato,picante sauce,chunk pineapple
title: Sassy Boatman's Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 small russet potatoes, cut in half | 1 can chunk pineapple, drained | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 bottle malt vinegar | 1 hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Place potatoes and chopped pineapple in a large bowl. In a jar with a tight fitting lid combine picante sauce, vinegar and hot sauce. Cover tightly and shake until ingredients are well mixed. Pour mixture over potatoes and pineapple and toss lightly. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Grilled Lobster Stuffed With Plantain
ingredients: 1 whole lobster ( about the pound of shell ) | 1/4 lb guajillo chilies | 1/4 lb plantain ( about 3 plantains ) | 2 slices bread | 1 lemon, sliced, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Remove head from lobster.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,self raising flour,apple cider,cointreau liqueur
title: Chorizo Applesauce
ingredients: 8 chorizo sausages | 1 cup self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1 cup apple cider or 1 cup apple juice
instructions: Boil chorizo until it has cooked through add the flour, cointreau and apple cider to the oil. Add the chorizo and cook over medium heat for 2 - 3 miunte until bubbling. Serve straight away with custard or cream.

title: Barbecued Salmon With Beans
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 1 zucchini | 1 can pinto beans or 1 can kidney beans, drained | 2 tablespoons marmalade
instructions: Remove fins from salmon fillets. Cut zucchini with diagonal slices on a cutting board and chop coarsely. Blend or process zucchini or beans with marmalade until you have a paste. Place salmon and marmalade paste in a shallow baking dish. Preheat broiler. Bake in oven for about 15 minutes or until the salmon is cooked.

title: Chile Watercress
ingredients: 1 cup watercress | 1 -2 canned chipotle chile
instructions: Cut off the top stem part of the chile and discard. Place watercress leaves inside a mortar and crush with a rolling pin or other pestle. Remove the top spubs. Place about 1 - 2 tablespoons of chile watercress in a serving bowl and cover with the remaining 2 tablespoons of watercress watercress. Stir well. Can be served alone or served with fresh bread slices.

Random Ingredients: bread,ranch dressing,marjoram,pineapple juice,beef brisket,curd cottage cheese,ricotta cheese
title: Pineapple-Cottage Cheese Stuffed Corned Beef Brisket
ingredients: 4 slices bread ( white or wheat ) | 2 cans small curd cottage cheese | 1 1/2 lbs corned beef brisket | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram ( optional ) | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Place one slice bread in each of two shallow soup bowl. Place 1/2 the cottage cheese in each bowl. Sprinkle corned beef generously with bread crumbs and marjoram. Cover with bread crumbs. Top with remaining cottage cheese. In the container of a blender combine dressing with about 1/2 cup cheese mixture. To marinate, place corned beef in one bowl, cheese mixture in another. Wash and dry corned beef. Cut off ends and use kitchen shears to cut off the center piece of meat and stuff with stuffing in stuffing. Rinse meat with cold water and wrap each in plastic wrap. Place each sandwich in a deep baking dish in a single layer. Pour salad dressing over sandwiches. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake until meat is tender and stuffing is browned in 30 - 45 minutes.

title: Tasty and Easy Japanese Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons flour | 2 cups vegetable stock | 5 lettuce leaves
instructions: Sift flour into a mixing bowl, slowly add vegetable stock to form a fairly thick paste. Cut four large paper towels and arrange them over a lettuce leaf. Spoon 1 tbsp or a bit of the paste onto the lettuce. Serve with rice or fried rice sticks.

title: Tasty Sun Dried Tomato and Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint plain yogurt | 2 -3 tablespoons a.1. original sauce ( a.1. or equivalent brand ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil ( packed not oil packed in this, not dried! )
instructions: Mix all ingredients into yogurt, blend well and serve over your favourite salad, vegies, bread, pita, or patties.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,marinara sauce,lamb,poblano chile,raisin,sage leaf,red pepper
title: Lamb Stuffed Chiles
ingredients: 1 lb fresh ground lamb | 8 medium poblano chiles | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup chopped dried sage leaf | 1 jar marinara sauce | 2 1/2 - 3 cups peanut oil ( for frying ) | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper
instructions: Roast chiles under broiler, cut top and top off with a paring knife so they are flat in a sml uniform ring around the pit. Place chilies in a roasting pan, about 6 - 8 inches in diameter, and cook over medium heat, turning once, for about 8 min, or until blistered on top and starting to blacken, and turn black in spots. Place chiles in a plastic bag and seal, leaving chiles in bag to steam for 20 min, until chiles are soft enough to pierce with a spoon. Remove all chiles from bag, leaving some marinara sauce remaining in pan. Place oil in skillet. Saute the raisins and sage in hot oil for about 2 min. Drain fat and discard. Season with crushed red pepper. Set aside. Preheat oil. Place a chile on a clean work surface with some flour on one side, turn and lightly coat with oil. Then gently squeeze excess flour from side to side of chile, making sure it is free of moisture. Place 2 or 3 chiles in oil. Fry until lightly browned on both sides and cooked through, about 2 minutes per side. Drain on paper towels. To assemble, place 1 - 2 tbsp of filling on top of chile, and sprinkle with some raisins, sage, and any left over marinara sauce. Serve with remaining chile drizzled with any remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,okra,rump steak,wheat tortilla,marsala wine,orange juice concentrate,heavy whipping cream
title: Steak and Okra Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 lb rump steak, cut into thin strips | 2 packages frozen cut okra, thawed ( or 1 cup thawed frozen and thawed but original package don't thaw ) | 3 tablespoons orange juice concentrate | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine ( or more, amount to taste ) | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 whole wheat tortillas or 2 other tortillas, cut into 4 inch strips
instructions: Place flour in a shallow pan large enough to accommodate a standing steamer basket over 1 inch of water. Dredge steak in flour on both sides and set aside. Add oil to a large skillet over medium heat. Add remaining ingredients and simmer about 5 - 6 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened. Set aside to cool slightly. To heat a separate large skillet over medium heat, place 3 to 4 tortillas in skillet, overlapping as needed, taking care not to overload. Spread some of the okra mixture along one side of 3 tortillas, then top with 1/4 of the steak strips. Fold other half of tortilla over and press with a spatula to make a half circle. Repeat with remaining 3 tortillas. Add oil to skillet and heat over low heat, then brown quesadillas in batches. Serve immediately with sauce.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,rice noodle,mirin,chipotle powder,rice,stewing beef,cool whip,fast rising yeast
title: Chipotle Beef on Rice Noodle Sandwich Pockets (Rice Cookers)
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice noodles ( i like to use yellow or red noodles ) | 1/4 cup quick-rising yeast | 1 cup warm water | 10 ounces stewing beef, cubed | 1/2 cup pepperoni, sliced | 1/2 cup crispy rice stick noodles | 8 ounces cool whip, thawed & slightly beaten | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder
instructions: Add ingredients to rice cooker bowl and set to rapid. After 3 minutes, press the start button on the rice noodles. When the rice noodles are tender, the rice noodles should feel slightly mushy. Carefully remove the noodles and drain on paper towels. Allow noodles to cool a few minutes, then crumble in a food processor or use a hand held mixer and mix together. Spoon small amounts onto the cooked rice noodles, leaving about 1/4 cup for each filled noodle. Allow noodles to dry a couple minutes before popping the next one on. Allow noodle filling to cool completely before cutting in half diagonally.

title: Sardine With Chilies and Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 1 lb fresh sardine | salt and pepper | 1 -2 sprig coriander sprig | 2 fresh green chilies
instructions: Remove and discard the beaks from the intestines. Rinse the sardines under cold water. Drain. Cut them into halves with your knife. Place them in cold water and bring to the boil. Lower the temperature and simmer very gently for about 20 mins or until they are tender, keeping a close eye on them so they don't catch. Drain, remove as much water as possible and pat dry with paper towels. Cover them with cold water and bring to the boil again, then lower the heat and simmer gently for about 5 mins or until the dauphine are just cooked but still very firm at the inside. Drain and cool slightly. Remove the skins. Peel and finely chop the chillies. Cut each half into very thin slices with a sharp knife. Place it in an ovenproof dish and arrange alternate layers of chopped chillies and fresh coriander, beginning and ending with chillies. Cover the dish with foil and place in a roasting tin. Pour boiling water over it just right to steam. Place in a moderately slow oven and roast gently for 2 hours. When ready to serve, remove the foil and place the dish under the hot broiler until they are cooked through. Remove the chillies and coriander and serve hot.

title: Simple Easy Crock Pot Chicken
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 10 ounces plum sauce ( or your favourite plum paste! ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | herbs, according to your tastes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in your crock pot, stir. Cover, cook on low heat for 8 hours. Serve with crackers or with your favourite meal.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,french baguette,baking potato,hot water,spanish onion,dark chocolate,rice,sherry
title: Champinones Maduro Maduros (Colombian Rice Burritos) (Rice and Hash Brown Version)
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups long-grain rice ( or white spanish rice, but preferably basmati rice would work ) | 1/2 - 1 large baking potato, peeled, diced and slightly dusted with | 1 1/2 - 2 cups hot water | 2 large spanish onions, diced ( i like onions on my hands and not so tight that i have to use them ) | 2 tablespoons sherry ( to taste ) | french baguette, cut into 4 equal halves ( or other bread if not the french baguette, the bread should be nice and crusty ) | 1 box good quality dark chocolate | hot water, as needed for spreading | additional chocolate, for drizzling over top
instructions: Start the rice, or simply boil it. If using rice using basmati rice, add it to a large pot of iced water and bring it to a boil. Drain the pot and set aside. In a medium baking dish, combine rice, potato, water, and 1 1/2 large onions.

title: Yogurt Chicken Wraps I
ingredients: 1 carton plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano or 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh oregano, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 8 large burrito-sized cooked egg noodles | 4 large leaves boston lettuce, torn into 2 inch pieces | 8 slices tortillas
instructions: Combine yogurt, flour, oregano, and vanilla. Stir in salt. Add noodles and stir until well coated. Place 1 - 2 t. Of filling on each tortilla. Roll up tightly and set aside. Repeat with remaining filling, placing each roll in the refrigerator until ready to cook. To grill, line a charcoal grill rack w/ tin foil. Grill rolls 4 - 5 minutes each side or until golden brown. To serve, arrange on a platter and drizzle with yogurt sauce. Garnish with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,kirsch,worcestershire sauce,milk,soy sauce,veal,celery salt
title: Classic Veal Chops with Carmalized White Wine
ingredients: 3/4 cup skim milk | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons kirsch | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 2 lbs boneless veal cuts, well trimmed
instructions: Whisk together first six ingredients in medium bowl. Pour into casserole dish. Add veal, coating on both sides evenly. Cover and chill at least 12 hours. Preheat oven to 350°f bake covered 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer or until meat thermometer registers 160°f top should be golden brown and meat thermometer registers 145°f remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes. Transfer to cutting board and cut into thin slices. Arrange in shallow baking dish. Bake covered 20 minutes longer or until heated through and tender. Serve with white wine. Makes 8 servings. Serves.

title: Matzo-Mango Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs roasting chickens, cut up | 4 -5 cups mangoes, sliced ( or you may fruit chutney ) | 2 cups matzo meal ( you may need more or less, depending on how soft you like your matzo to be ) | pepper
instructions: Place the chicken pieces in a deep baking dish. Make sure that you turn them regularly. I usually do this several hours ahead of time if making mango chutney. Mix the mango slices with the matzoh meal and pepper. Sprinkle over the chicken. Cover with plastic wrap. Let marinate for at least 6 hours and up to a day. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove chicken from refrigerator and bake for 45 minutes or until cooked.. This really depends on the amount of chicken pieces.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,french onion,tequila,coconut cream,part ricotta cheese
title: Irish Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 small french of sweet onion | 1/2 cup shredded coconut cream | 1 package part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/8 cup tequila | 1/2 cup canola oil
instructions: Cut french onion into chunks and saute with coconut cream in a large skillet over medium high heat until onions are very tender. Drain, then turn out onto a plate and let cool in the pan. In a bowl, mix ricotta cheese, tequila, and canola oil.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,parmesan cheese,adobo seasoning,vegetable stock
title: My Favorite Hot Pepper Sauce for Chicken or Pork
ingredients: 6 tablespoons creamy peanut butter ( creamy if you prefer ) | 2 tablespoons adobo seasoning ( add more if you're a spice fan or a bit looser, i use 1 t and 1/2 ) | 1 3/4 cups hot vegetable stock | 1/4 cup coarsely grated parmesan cheese ( don't go for the parm )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the peanut butter, adobo seasoning and stock until smooth. Add more stock if necessary, to make a very thick spreadable sauce. Stir until all the peanut butter and pepper are blended. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate for up to 4 hours. This sauce is great for drumsticks and chicken, especially chicken breasts too.

Random Ingredients: darjeeling tea,cottage cheese,confectioner ' sugar,granny smith apple,stout beer,tilapia fillet,tarragon
title: Dee's Irish Dubliner Beer Tilapia
ingredients: 12 ounces beer, such as stout beer | 1/2 lb tilapia fillet, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick slices ( or white fish fillets ) | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped candied tarragon | 1 granny smith apple, finely grated medium | 1 round day-old danish-style mountain roll ( such as danish-style ) | chopped fresh tarragon ( for garnish )
instructions: In large nonreactive bowl or resealable plastic bag, combine beer, tilapia, and sugar. Add the cottage cheese, tarragon, apple, and onion. Close bag, and refrigerate at least 2 hours, turning bag occasionally. Transfer harvey's soda can or mugs to rimmed baking sheet. Surround with several slices of cheese. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to overnight. Serve with crackers and sprigs of fresh tarragon.

title: Spaghetti with Marsala Syrup
ingredients: 16 ounces thin spaghetti | 3 cups marsala
instructions: Fill a pot about 4/5 full with water. Heat to boiling over high heat. Add spaghetti and cook according to package directions. Combine with enough marsala to coat.

title: Quick and Easy Tuna and Bean Manicotti
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained and flaked | 1 can cornichons, drained | 1 jar of marinated cannicotti, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1 package taco seasoning | 20 manicotti, uncooked | 1/4 cup flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix together the tuna, cornichons, cannicotti and pine nuts. Mix in the taco seasoning and pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread the manicotti over the tuna mixture and place in the oven. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the pasta is soft and the stuffing is hot and bubbling. When the meat is no longer pink in the center, sprinkle the parsley over the pasta, and sprinkle the cranberries over the pasta.

title: Nordic Mushrooms
ingredients: 100 g chestnut flour | chat masala
instructions: Mix chestnut flour with one table spoon chaat masala. Pinch off a ball of dough about the size of an ice cream ball. Keep aside for 15 - 20 minutes. Heat 1 table spoon oil in a pan. Toss the mushroom ball in the pan. Fry till browned on both sides. Remove and keep aside for 5 minutes. Remove the cooked ball from the pan. Pour 1 table spoon oil. Dip the mushroom balls in the oil and fry. Drain them on paper towel and serve hot. Enjoy.

title: Normandy Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | 2 large firm ripe apples | 1/2 cup chicken fat and 2 tbsp applesauce or 1/2 cup port wine | 1/4 cup port wine or 1/4 cup apple juice | 3 tablespoons bread flour | 1 medium bunch celery, chopped | 2 teaspoons grated or coarsely grated fresh apple
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Bake chicken in oven for 45 minutes. Peel and chop apple and set aside. In a large skillet or roasting pan combine all marinade ingredients and boil for 10 minutes. Add chicken and cook until meat is nicely browned and tender. Remove from oven and add apple and celery. Baste with the sauce periodically until coating is lightly browned. Serve right away.

title: Mirj's Sauce on the BBQ. Also called Sriracha or Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup picante sauce | 3 tablespoons chili paste ( sriracha powder )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and use to marinate any meat of your choice while barbecuing.

title: Barley and Cheese Burger
ingredients: 3 tablespoons bacon fat | 1/2 lb ground turkey | 1 medium white onion, finely chopped ( vidalia or spanish ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried barley | 6 8 ounces queso fresco or 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 1 english muffin ( 4 1/2 inch slices )
instructions: Prepare the hamburger according to package directions. Set aside. While the meat makes its delicious hamburger stir the bacon fat and 1/2 lb ground turkey in a saucepan over medium heat until the fat is light brown, about 4 minutes. Stir in the onion. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring to ensure onion doesn't brown. Stir in the barley and cook for 2 minutes more. Stir the queso fresco or feta cheese into the meat mixture. Turn up heat to medium and lightly toast the english muffins. Lightly spray your face with non stick spray and spread the bread with the queso fresco spread on one half of the toast. Top with a second bread half, spraying it with non stick spray. Grill until the cheese melts and begins to turn golden, about 2 minutes on each side. Place the cooked hamburger on each half of the bun.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,nonfat milk,zucchini,gruyere cheese,pineapple chunk juice
title: Low Cal French Zucchini Zucchini
ingredients: 4 zucchini | 1 cup nonfat milk | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 can pineapple chunks in juice | 2 teaspoons soft medium-fat cheese
instructions: Preheat stove top grill on medium. Remove zucchini from their peels and cut into cubes. In a large nonstick skillet add oil and saute zucchini until tender. Add pineapple juice, zucchini and soft cheese.
