Random Ingredients: lentil,caster sugar,pistachio,quinoa,squash,kosher salt black pepper,green cardamom,cooking oil
title: Rice Pudding With Veggies (Vegan)
ingredients: 500 g quinoa ( i prefer white rice ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 500 g squash, ends trimmed | 1 liter spring lentil | 8 green cardamoms | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup pistachios, roasted | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Place the lentils in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil and simmer for about 30 - 40 minutes, until the lentils are well cooked and soft. Place the quinoa in a heatproof bowl. Heat the oil in a heavy based saucepan over a medium high heat and add the cinnamon and sugar. Cook the sugar until it's golden and fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add the quinoa and fry for about 10 seconds, stirring to coat all the grains with the oil and sugar. Add the cooked lentils and stir to combine. Transfer the rice mixture to a baking tray. Put in the oven and bake for about 45 minutes, or until the rice has turned translucent and crunchy and the lentils have absorbed some of the liquid. Allow to cool before serving, as the quinoa will become dry. Serve warm with pakistani coffee and a dollop of hummus, garnished with pistachios. If necessary, put up to two tablespoons of water to boil if it becomes too thick. To re heat the cooking option in a microwave oven, place one layer of rice in the bottom of a microwave safe bowl, then pour half the lentils in. Cover with half the squash and half the pistachios. Repeat using remaining ingredients. Cut into cubes. Serve drizzled with more sweet and sour yoghurt, and fresh mint leaves on top.

title: Cambodian Melon Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/4 cup cantaloupe, diced | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper
instructions: Cut fish and salmon into chunks. Mix fish and spices in a small dish. Marinate salmon cubes and fish for 4 - 7 hours. Broil on a bbq or bake on a baking sheet until the fish is just cooked. Remove fish, cut into chunks and serve topped with the marinade.

title: The Real Sage Scented Red Onion for Canning
ingredients: 2 lbs red onions | 2 packages dried sage
instructions: Cut a small slit at one end of each onion to release the soft, somewhat acidic juice. Place each onion piece into the sink with your fingernail and fill with water to cover the onions.

title: Crispy Steamed Grapes
ingredients: 2 cups watermelon, cut into small pieces | 1 cup uncooked rice flour | 1 teaspoon black cumin seeds | 5 cups mesclun
instructions: Pour the watermelon, rice flour, and black cumin seeds in a blender and process until the mixture resembles bread crumbs. Divide the mixture into 5 inch balls, and press each one firmly around the outer circumference of a bamboo steamer. Place the bamboo steamer in a pan of lightly salted water. Cover, and place over high heat. Steam over high heat until the edges start to curl away, about 3 minutes. Cover, and steam for 5 minutes more. Reroll the grapes, and unmold on a platter. Sprinkle each piece of grapes with salt. Serve immedeatly. Tips, you can easily replace grapes with other types of vegetables, like zucchini, carrots, cauliflower, and eggplant.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour tortilla,chili flake,olive oil,crescent dough,coriander seed,cider vinegar
title: Seared Fish Tacos #RSC
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent roll dough | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon chili flakes | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Heat oven to spray baking sheet with cooking oil spray. Unroll crescent roll dough on baking sheet and press flat into 5 x 6 inch rectangle. In small bowl, add coriander seeds, chili flakes and flour tortillas. Stir fry in 1 tablespoon of the olive oil until fragrant. Add cider vinegar and mix well. Brush mixture over dough rectangle and spread evenly in circle. Brush on remaining olive oil and sprinkle with coriander. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: meat,alfredo sauce,apple cider,lime wedge,chili pepper flake,celeriac,creamy peanut butter,ice cube
title: Apple Alfredo
ingredients: 2 cans apple cider | 8 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 3 cups cubed cooked meat | 3 stalks celeriac, chopped | 16 ounces alfredo sauce | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 handful ice cube
instructions: Mix apple cider and peanut butter in a bowl. Mix in ground meat, celeriac, alfredo sauce, chili flakes and cubes of ice.

title: Spiced Cucumber Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup sesame oil | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 tablespoons cilantro, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 6 slices bread, toasted
instructions: Combine oil, mustard, cilantro and mace in small bowl. Add toasted bread and drizzle with oil mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mango,cannellini bean,roquefort cheese,chili powder,pepper sauce,pork tenderloin,red chili,salmon fillet
title: Pan Seared Salmon With Spicy Caribbean Dip
ingredients: 2 ounces cooked cannellini beans ( about 4 ounces ) | 2 ounces salmon fillets, skin removed | 2 ounces country-style pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( or more, to taste, i used jalapeno because i'm a purist-cooking type lover ) | 1 tablespoon mangoes or 1 tablespoon papaya, diced in small cubes | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper sauce, optional ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried red chili, crumbled ( optional, to taste ) | 1 teaspoon roquefort cheese, crumbled ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl combine beans, salmon, and pork. Sprinkle the chili powder over and mix. Toss in mango with hot pepper sauce. Top the salmon with the bean mixture and the crumbled cheese.

title: Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 125 g chuck steaks, cut in strips | 1 large orange bell pepper | 180 g snow peas | 6 tablespoons sweet potato traditional australian sweet potato tamarind paste
instructions: Dice the orange bell pepper into strips, trimming ends, about 8 slices. Heat 2 tbs of oil over high heat, add chinese sweet potato, stir fry until fragrant, add the chilli, continue stirring for 1 minute or until softened. Remove from heat, stir in sweet potato tamarind paste, pour over steak and vegetables.

title: Mashed Zucchini and Lentils
ingredients: 1 lb small spaghetti or 1 lb other spiral shaped pasta, preferably long, stubby ends, not large, broken into 3/4-inch squares | 3 tablespoons olive oil or 3 tablespoons unsalted butter, plus more for drizzling | 1 1/2 cups brown lentils or 1 1/2 cups green lentils, picked over, rinsed, and drained ( 1 3/4 cups ) | 1 large zucchini, cut into 1/4-to 1/2-inch slices | 3/4 teaspoon ground turmeric powder, plus more for sprinkling
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to boil in medium saucepan. Add pasta and boil 3 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. Heat oil or butter in a 5 - 6 qt saucepan over medium heat. Add lentils and sauté 2 minutes. Stir in zucchini and 1/4 t. Turmeric and cook 2 minutes longer. Add pasta to saucepan with lentils and simmer 6 minutes. Sprinkle with 1/4 t. Turmeric. Remove from heat and toss in about 1/2 t. Turmeric. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Smoked Salmon and Amaretto Lasagna
ingredients: 32 ounces smoked salmon fillets, chopped | 1 cup cheese, grated | 1/3 cup amaretto | 2 teaspoons thyme | 16 ounces lasagna noodles, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,black pepper,pork tenderloin,sunflower oil,lime wedge,thyme leaf
title: Spicy Thyme Pork Tenderloin Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/4 cup fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 8 -10 slices rye bread | 4 slices pork tenderloin | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees. Mix the oil, thyme and pepper in a small baking dish. Arrange the bread slices, one on top of each other, in a single layer. Heat the oil mixture in a frying pan, taking care not to burn. Place the pork slices in the centre of bread. Roll up the bread, using the seam sides and the excess bread to secure the rolls. Slice each roll into quarters, each slice having about 4 per person. Place the rolls in the oven and cook for 10 - 15 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and golden. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,pork chop,maple syrup,oil,garlic clove
title: Crispy Maple Pork Cutlets With Honey Syrup
ingredients: 4 pork chops, 2 inch thick | 2 tablespoons oil | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 3 teaspoons orange blossom water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. In a large ovenproof pan, heat the oil and fry the pork chops until browned on both sides. Pour off the oil, add the maple syrup and orange juice and stir in the crushed garlic. Cover the meat with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 45 minutes or until the internal temperature of the pork is 160 degrees. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: date,wheat tortilla,chicken tender,mustard powder,soya sauce,vegetable broth,ice water,beef broth
title: Beef Tortilla Soup With Date-Dipped Boneless Chicken
ingredients: 4 cups beef broth | 2 1/3 cups reduced sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon soya sauce or 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dry mustard powder | ice water | 20 whole wheat tortillas | 1/2 lb boneless chicken tenders | 1 cup chopped dates
instructions: In a small pan, combine the broth, soy sauce, mustard and salt and pepper to taste. Heat and bring to a boil. Place tortillas in a shallow heatproof bowl, pour hot broth over and let stand 3 to 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels, sprinkle each with salt and pepper and let stand 30 minutes. Heat broiler. Place chicken in a broiler safe 3 quart casserole. Broil 6 to 8 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Remove and serve.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,thai red curry paste,cooking spray,parmesan cheese,pork tenderloin,cake flour,cream chicken soup
title: Kris' Thai Pork Kebabs
ingredients: cooking spray | 10 ounces pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/3 head green cabbage, finely shredded
instructions: Trim fat from pork and cut into 6 equal portions. Place on a plate, sprinkle evenly with flour, and coat with parmesan cheese. Toss coated pork with curry paste and let stand 30 minutes. Blend soup, cabbage and pork in a bowl. Divide soup mixture among pork and cabbage mixture. Gently form pork slices into logs. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat grill to high. Place on grill and cook, turning, until meat thermometer reads 165 degrees f, 15 to 25 minutes. Serve.

title: Vanilla Radishes Tea - Radish & Canola Oil
ingredients: 2 teaspoons canola oil | 2 ounces heavy cream | 1 teaspoon ground vanilla essence | 2 fresh radishes, trimmed & washed ( or frozen )
instructions: Heat the oil in a non stick saucepan over a low heat until very hot but not smoking. Remove from the heat and whisk in the cream, vanilla, freshly grated rind, if using. Grate the radishes or cut into thin strips. Pour the mixture into a tea ball pitcher or jug and serve immediately, or store in an airtight container in the freezer for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: caper,red curry paste,parmigiano reggiano cheese,sugar snap pea,rye flour,yellow pepper,tomato puree,phyllo pastry
title: Spinach, Tomato and Pea Pie With Crispy Triangles
ingredients: 1 lb phyllo pastry ( store bought or home-made, approx. 12 sheets ) | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, cut in half, deseeded, cut julienne into 1 | 3 tomatoes, cut in 6 slices | 1 teaspoon drained capers | 2 teaspoons tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1/4 cup tasty cheese or 1/4 cup tasty provolone cheese, grated | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f lightly grease a baking sheet. Line the 4 sheets neatly with parchment paper, shiny side down. Place the sweet pepper in a small saucepan with water just slightly covering, bring to a boil, drain and then steam for 30 seconds. Rinse under cold water to remove skins and stems, drain well and set aside. Meanwhile, combine the sweet peppers in a small bowl with all of the remaining ingredients and season well. Cut the sheets into 2 rectangles and stack them loosely over each other. Spoon 1/2 of the filling mixture into the bottom of each pastry sheet and fold over into a triangle with a sharp knife tucking the edges into the pie to make an envelope. Place onto the baking sheet with the seam side down. Paint the tops of the pastry with water and bake for 25 minutes until golden or about 40 minutes in all. Serve at once, sprinkled with the grated cheese.

title: Pork Bavarian
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork roast | 6 tablespoons roast fat, rendered | 1 tablespoon roast fat, rendered | 5 tablespoons kirsch | 3 tablespoons lager beer | double cream
instructions: Cut the roast into 2 by 2 or similar sizes. Place between sheets of plastic wrap and pound 1/2 ounce of fat into the fat. Remove as much fat as possible from the roast fat and place in cold water. Wipe the fat off meat with moist paper towel and place on one side of a heavy dutch oven or heavy roasting tin. Add the 1 tablespoon rendered roast fat, 1 tablespoon kirsch and 1 tablespoon lager. Bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and cook very slowly, covered, until roast is very tender, about 2 hours. Remove from pan and leave to stand, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Remove fat from pan and wipe the fat from the surface with moist paper towels. Increase heat and boil rapidly, uncovered, for about 10 min, stirring to keep bottom of pan very slightly bubbly. Spoon off as much fat as possible from the bottom of the pan and discard. Return liquid to oven and cook for another 5 minutes. Skim off any fat that rises to the surface. Allow to cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for 2 - 2 1/2 days. To serve, take a piece of meat and pick it up with a knife and pull meat apart into shreds. Place shredded meat into a serving platter with a slotted spoon. Spoon some of the bavarian fat from the gravy over the meat, leaving at least 1/2 inch on the meat and at least 1/2 cup for another use. Serve remainder as gravy.

title: Chile Balls (Shallow Con Carne)
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups chopped onions | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: In the microwave, microwave chocolate until melted. Set aside to cool slightly. Drain onions and combine in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with dark chocolate. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

title: Lentil and Chiles Tea
ingredients: 4 liters cooked lentils | 2 teaspoons whole clove | 3 dried szechuan peppercorns | 4 tablespoons dried cilantro or 4 tablespoons parsley | 3 cups chinese white tea
instructions: Remove the skins from dried herbs. Bring 4 liter water to the boil in a large pot & add the szechuan peppercorns, cilantro & soaked spices. Cover & boil slowly for 20 minutes. Cool & reserve. In a blender or food processor puree the soaked lentils along with the 3 cups of broth and strain the liquid into the 4 liters. If you want the strong brew feel free to strain. Cool completely, then store in the fridge until needed. To serve, pour tea into a large crystal & top with the lentil mixture.

title: Indian Yellow Squash with Preserved Ginger
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash, cleaned, cut lengthwise into half moons | grapeseed oil, or as needed | 1 tablespoon garlic paste
instructions: Fill a pot with enough water to cover the squash completely. Add ginger garlic paste and bring to a boil. Cook squash in the boiling water until easily pierced with a fork, about 20 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl. Stir in grapeseed oil until evenly mixed. Toss the squash in the oil until well coated. Transfer to a platter and serve.

title: Chicken Sour Cream Soup
ingredients: 28 fluid ounces chicken broth or 28 fluid ounces homemade chicken stock | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1/2 cup grated carrot ( about 8 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream, about | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest or 1 teaspoon freshly grated lime zest
instructions: Whisk together broth and mustard in large saucepan. Bring to boil. Add carrots, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Add sour cream and zest.

title: Roasted Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 18 asparagus spears ( woody side up ) | 3 -4 cups portabella mushrooms | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Wash asparagus and slice into 1/2 inch lengths. Place all in a large bowl and toss with the sherry. Toss well. Sprinkle remaining sherry over mushrooms and toss again to coat. Put on a baking sheet and bake 20 - 25 minutes or until all are tender and the mushrooms well browned.

title: Quick and Easy Chinese Vegetable Wrap
ingredients: 1 head lettuce leaf | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and sliced
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add bamboo shoots, stirring gently so they brown evenly, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Poke holes in the lettuce leaves with a fork and wrap with a damp towel, then set on a serving platter to keep warm. Place a bamboo slice in the center of the wrap and cut diagonally into wedges. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,tofu,sauerkraut,flat leaf parsley,beef sirloin steak,pecan,plum tomato
title: Sauerkraut Tofu and Beef
ingredients: 300 g firm tofu, cubed | 300 g sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 150 g beef sirloin steaks, trimmed and cut into thin strips | 2 medium sized green capsicum, sliced thinly | 4 plum tomatoes, chopped coarsely | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley or 1/4 cup coriander, chopped | 1/4 cup pecans, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the tofu and sauerkraut in a large heatproof bowl and pour over enough water to come halfway up the side. Cover and set aside. Add the beef to the boiling water and boil for 3 minutes or until the beef is cooked and the sauerkraut is warm. Add the beef and capsicum to the sauerkraut, and stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes, or until the beef is just cooked through. Add the tomatoes and simmer gently for 3 - 4 minutes or until the tomatoes are soft. Transfer the mixture to a platter, add the pecans and half the parsley, and scatter with the rest of the parsely. Serve with boiled new potatoes.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,green pea,poblano pepper,lettuce leaf,baby spinach,caster sugar,prawn
title: Baby Spinach in Crispy Peanut Crisps
ingredients: 250 g fresh baby spinach, washed and well drained | 150 g green peas, washed and ends trimmed | 225 g prawns, shelled, thawed and deveined | 2 large poblano peppers | 2 large bunches lettuce leaves | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 cups caster sugar
instructions: In a large frying pan over medium heat heat sauté prawns until just opaque, turn and sauté other side. Once both sides have turned a rich green, remove from pan and set aside. In the same pan add the peas and prawns and toss and turn and cook for a few minutes. Place lettuce leaves on a dinner plate and cover with a slice of prawn. Sprinkle with a little baking soda. Place one of the crisps on top of the prawns, fold it and then serve. Serve with salsa and lemon wedges on the side.

Random Ingredients: pepper,ice,monterey jack cheddar cheese,farfalle pasta,beef broth
title: Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | pepper | fresh cheese, grated ( optional ) | 3/4 cup beef broth | 1 box farfalle pasta, cooked and drained ( bowtie ) | crushed ice ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat in a skillet and drain. Add beef broth, cheese and crushed ice. Bring to boil and cook until cheese is melted and sauce is warmed. Serve over warm bowtie pasta.

title: Ginger Broccoli
ingredients: 2 pounds broccoli florets | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the broccoli florets in the pot, and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain the broccoli, and set aside. In a small skillet over medium heat, combine the ginger and sliced green onion, and saute until the onion is golden brown. Pour about half of the hot sauce into the bowl of a blender, and blend. Return the pureed broccoli to the pot, and toss with the rice and vegetable. Cook about 5 minutes, before serving.

title: Tastes Especial
ingredients: 2 firm, ripe, ripe tomatoes | 4 fresh tomatillos, husked and washed | 1/4 cup finely sliced red bell pepper ( optional ) | 1/3 cup crumbled cotija cheese ( optional ) or 1/3 cup feta cheese ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons tamari or 1 1/2 teaspoons regular soy sauce | 1 lb fresh crabmeat, picked for cartilage and shell fragments
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicon mat. Cut top of tomatoes off, and gently scoop out seeds. Scoop tomatoes into a small bowl. Slice tomatoes into six wedges each. Place tomatoes in a large bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients. If using canned crab, add to bowl.

title: Artichoke Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 6 artichoke hearts ( i use fresh ones ) | 14 ounces marinara sauce ( i use newman's own ) | 1 chili, i like a little heat | 1/4 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Cut the artichoke hearts into 5cm lengths. In a bowl, mix the marinara sauce with the chile, sage and set aside. Lay the torn artichoke leaves out onto a chopping board and cut them into slices. With a paring knife, remove the centre of the leaves. Using a rolling pin, roll the leaves to form a rectangle shape, then cut those in half. Repeat with the remaining artichoke, using a pizza cutter, cutting until all the leaves are rolled up into a cylinder of approximately 8 - 8 pieces. Repeat this process with the remaining tortillas, placing them onto a lightly oiled baking dish. Spread the sauce evenly over the rolled up leaves, cover and bake for 30 minutes or until the sauce is bubbling and the bread is crispy. Serve with your favourite pasta sauce and a green vegetable of your choice such as shredded red onion and parma ham.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,active yeast,spinach leaf,pork loin chop,cremini mushroom,cardamom pod,red pepper
title: Sikarno (Pork & Spinach Kebabs - South African)
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 3 - 3 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin chops, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups cremini mushrooms, diced or 6 ounces capsicums, thickly sliced | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod | 10 -15 fresh spinach leaves, washed and coarsely chopped | red pepper, to taste
instructions: Dissolve yeast packages in 1 cup boiling water. In a large bowl, stir together pork with spices, mushroom and spinach. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes until all ingredients are heated through. Pour into a buttered 8x8x2 inch oven proof baking dish and bake at 300ºf for 20 - 25 minutes or until well browned on top.

title: Baked Grape Leaves with Garlic
ingredients: 1 whole green grape | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wash, dry, and tear grape leaves from the central stem. In a medium bowl or a medium zip top bag, combine the grape, oregano and garlic powder. Stuff the unused leaves with the grape mixture.

title: Irish Cream Brownie Chowder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped celery rib | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 1/3 cups irish cream | 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate chips
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine celery, cayenne, tomato sauce and irish cream. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer gently for about 5 minutes or until celery is tender. Remove from heat, but do not boil. Pour into a blender, add chocolate chips and blend until smooth.

title: Walnut Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup walnuts, skinned, chopped fine | 1 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons light vegetable oil
instructions: Place the walnuts in a bowl. Add the breadcrumbs. Add the oil. Mix well. Pour the mixture onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake 350f degrees for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,black cardamom pod,amarula cream liqueur,pimiento,orange
title: Anarula Cream
ingredients: 2 ounces pimiento | 3 ounces amarula cream liqueur | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange rind | 1 dash green chili pepper ( to taste ) | 12 black cardamom pods ( remove seed for a darker colour )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Note that the arula cream will keep for up to 6 months in the refrigerator in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,brown gravy mix,jumbo pasta shell,lemon zest,flat leaf parsley,fish stock
title: Clam Soup
ingredients: 15 jumbo pasta shells, cooked and drained | 2 cups clam juice | 1 ounce brown gravy mix | 2 teaspoons fish stock | 1/8 teaspoon lemon zest, grated ( or zested from 1 lemon ) | 3 tablespoons parsley, chopped
instructions: In large saucepan combine clam juice, gravy mix and fish stock. Over medium heat, bring to boil and simmer until reduced by half, about 3 minutes. Add in pasta shells and stir to coat. Top with parsley. Heat through. Serve with lemon slices.

title: Matzoh-Sauper
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( about 5 ) | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, undrained | 1/2 cup matzo meal
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Butter a 5 by 8 inch oval cake pan with 1 teaspoon of the onion powder. Place the cubes of meat in a large saucepan and cover with about 3/4 cup water. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 45 to 50 minutes, until the liquid has reduced and the meat is very tender. When the meat is almost tender, stir in the rest of the onion powder and 1/2 cup water. Add the tomatoes and matzoh meal. Continue to simmer until the sauce has thickened and is very smooth. Transfer the matzoh meal to a large bowl and coat the meat cubes well. Place in the prepared pan and bake for 1 1/2 hours, until the matzoh meal is browned and crusty around the meat and vegetables. Serve warm.

title: Chipotle Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french baguettes, sliced | 1 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place the bread slices in a baking dish, and spread with the chipotle pepper. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Switch the broiler setting, and broil for 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: pea,bread flour,lamb shoulder,beef bouillon cube,farfalle pasta
title: Lamb and Farfalle Stew With Farfalle (Bow Ties)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder | 1 -2 beef bouillon cube | 2 -3 cups dried farfalle pasta ( bow ties ) | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas ( optional ) | 6 -8 cups bread flour, for dusting
instructions: Place meat in crockpot or large pan with 1 - 2 boullion cubes, enough water to cover meat and bring to boil. Cover and cook on high for 2 - 3 hours. Remove meat from crockpot or pan and set aside. Make farfalle according to package directions. I use a whole wheat pkg but can be made any size and it always goes well. Meanwhile cook farfalle according to package directions. Slice meat and set aside. Pour off most of the cooking liquid and set aside. In a large bowl, combine 2 cups of flour and 1/2 cup cold water and whip well until flour is fully incorporated. Add the farfalle and peas and mix well to thoroughly blend. Transfer the meat and flour mixture to the crockpot. Add the meat and any liquid and mix well to combine. Dump the farfalle mixture into a large bowl, cover and cook on high 4 - 5 hours or until pasta is tender.. Discard water and discard vegetables. Remove meat mixture from crockpot or stew pot, if you find any, then remove the meat and flour. Add salt and pepper to taste. This goes great with a salad and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cod,chili bean,salad green,feta,celery,egg white,beef blade roast
title: Beef & Cod Burgers With Chili Dressing
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef blade roast, with bone | 2 -3 cups cooked baked beans, any type | 3/4 cup feta, crumbled | lettuce leaf, for garnish | 4 -6 tablespoons chili beans, with juice, for dressing | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper or 1/4 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: To make bean ragout, slice beef roast into 1/2 inch slices on the bias. Place in a crock or serving container. Add beans, feta crumbs, lettuce leaves, and chili. Mix thoroughly. Place egg white in a small bowl. With an electric mixer, beat the yolk, and salt and pepper together until frothy. Gradually beat in half the beaten egg white. Pour over bean mixture. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 12 hours. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Pittsburgh Football Dip - Michael Chiarello
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 head napa cabbage, cut in wedges ( about 8 cups ) | 1 package sliced prosciutto, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f combine the mayonnaise, catsup, picante sauce, marjoram, and napa cabbage in a 9 by 5 inch glass baking dish and toss well. Place the prosciutto on top of the mixture. Bake in the middle of the oven for about 20 minutes, or until the prosciutto is light golden brown and bubbly. Allow to cool to room temperature. Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Italian Pepper-Crusted Jicama
ingredients: 2 jicama, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup instant tea | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 2 teaspoons italian herbs | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon candied lemon, finely chopped
instructions: Place the jicama in a 9x13 inch baking dish, arranging them in a uniform, circular pattern. In a small bowl or jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the teabag, lemon peel and parsley. Stir well to mix. Pour over the jicama in the dish, spreading evenly. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Uncover and spread the cocoa evenly along the surface. Sprinkle the chopped candied lemon evenly over the cocoa. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the jicama are tender and the cocoa is golden brown.

title: Cheesy Wontons
ingredients: 20 wonton wrappers | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 6 slices feta cheese | 1 tablespoon double cream, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake wontons in preheated oven until they begin to turn golden brown, about 5 minutes. Set wontons on a plate and drizzle with about 1 tablespoon of cream. Sprinkle with feta cheese. Bake wontons in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes, then remove from oven.

title: Bread & Butter Pudding
ingredients: 5 ounces white bread flour | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons canned chickpeas, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients and knead until smooth. Turn onto lightly floured surface and knead again for 2 minutes. Roll out to about 1in thickness and cut into 2cm squares. Place in a lightly oiled 2in x 1in steam tins. Bake uncovered in a moderately hot oven for 40 mins, or until lightly toasted. Serve warm or cold with custard for breakfast.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,active yeast,coriander,vanilla ice cream,onion soup mix
title: Red Pepper Vanilla Ice Cream - Crock Pot
ingredients: 3/4 ounce active dry yeast | 3 cups vanilla ice cream | 3 slices yellow bell pepper, roasted | 1 small onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons ground coriander
instructions: Place the ice cream in the crock pot with the dried yeast. Sprinkle the roasted yellow peppers and onion soup mix over top. Pour in the vanilla ice cream. Cover and cook on low for 5 - 7 hours. Add coriander during the last 15 minutes.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Peasy Rigatoni
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, undiluted | 2 cups frozen cooked turnips | 1 jar marshmallow creme | freshly crushed pepper
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Prosciutto Risotto With Peanuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs prosciutto, sliced | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1/4 cup sweet vermouth | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon sweet paprika | sea salt, to taste
instructions: Begin by cleaning the rice, place it in a bowl and pour in enough cool water to cover it. Leave to soak for 30 minutes, drain and set aside. In a large saucepan or rice cooker, heat half of the oil over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Add the rice and then, stirring, fry, stirring until the grains have begun to soften, about 2 minutes. Increase the heat to medium high and stir in the vermouth, rice, remaining oil, lemon juice or lime juice and sweet paprika. Cover the pan, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, or until the rice is tender and creamy. Season to taste with salt. Serve, passing the prosciutto slices separately.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,ladyfinger,chipotle chile,yellow cornmeal,seashell pasta,fryer chicken
title: Chipotle Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 1 fryer chickens, cut into pieces | 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal, coarse, sifted | 1 pinch of cajun spice blend dried chipotle chile | 12 ladyfingers, split | 1 can chipotle chiles, chopped | 1 ounce seashell pasta, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to spray a 9 inch non stick fry pan or skillet with cooking spray. In a mixing bowl mix together first 4 ingredients. Dredge chicken pieces in 1/4 cup cornmeal. Arrange chicken in pan. Pour remaining 1/2 cup cornmeal mixture on top of, ensuring that pieces are standing upright throughout. Sprinkle with cajun spice blend, then drizzle chipotle chilies around chicken. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or till chicken is cooked thoroughly. Meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions. Pour noodles into bowl and mix together with remaining 1 oz. Chipotle chilis& pasta.

title: Cured Beef Brisket With Mint
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped of fresh mint, plus | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped of fresh mint, leaves for garnish ( optional ) | 2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed
instructions: Combine marjoram and 1/2 cup mint leaves in small bowl. Rub 1/2 cup mint mixture on surface of brisket, rubbing it lightly around edges. Place brisket on rack of foil and roast at 140 degrees f. Wrap remaining 2/3 cup mint leaves tightly around meat, securing with pricks if desired. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup mint leaves if desired.

title: Pomegranate Pork Chops
ingredients: 1/2 cup pomegranate juice | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 8 pork chops, with all fat removed | 1 -2 large shallot, finely sliced ( use white and purple parts for extra flavour ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Combine the pomegranate juice, cornflour, salt, sugar and shallot and mix thoroughly. Pour into a large bowl. Add the pork chops and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours. Heat the grill. Cook the chops over indirect heat to desired doneness, brushing with juice every 1/2 or so minutes. The meat should register 140 degrees when cooked thoroughly.

title: Spiced Sweet Potato and Parsley Pasta
ingredients: 8 medium sweet potatoes | 4 tablespoons honey | 1/2 orange, zest of | 1 lb penne pasta | 7 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup arrind cheese | 1/2 cup italian parsley | 8 medium pears
instructions: Cut sweet potatoes into cubes cut zest into slices then wash with cold water and boil until just tender, peel. In a large pan heat honey to simmering and add orange zest, cook for 5 minutes, transfer to bowl add sweet potato, penne, butter and cheeses. Cook until pasta is al dente and pour into bowl toss and serve.

title: Quick Pecan Cakes - Goi
ingredients: 4 teaspoons sesame oil | 4 teaspoons pecans, finely ground | 1/2 - 1/2-1 teaspoon dried red chili, crushed ( if using hot red chili, do not over heat )
instructions: Mix all ingredients and shape into a small ball.

Random Ingredients: taco flour tortilla,pinto bean,philadelphia cream cheese,blueberry,kosher salt pepper,cocoa
title: Blueberry and Nacho Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 -4 tablespoons taco flour tortillas or 2 -4 tablespoons fajita flour tortillas | 2 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, chopped | 1 teaspoon unsweetened dutch's light cocoa | kosher salt and pepper | 1 can pinto beans, drained ( about 3/4 of a 14 ounce can ) | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, washed and patted dry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the cream cheese over one side of each tortilla, being careful not to get it to stick. Spread the beans over the cream cheese. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Scatter the cheese over the beans and top with the blueberries. Place the quesadillas on a large baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f for 8 - 10 minutes, or until lightly browned on the bottom, and bubbly. Cut into wedges and serve hot, with sour cream and guacamole. This recipe works best when made the day before. It is also a great warm spread on your favorite mexican meal.

title: Chinese Broccoli Fried Eggs
ingredients: 4 -8 medium size broccoli, stems removed | 2 teaspoons chicken stock powder | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 3 egg whites | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce
instructions: Clean and cook broccoli as indicated on package. Cool and cut into bite size pieces. Heat fry pan on medium heat. Add oyster sauce and lightly brown. Add egg whites and allow to lightly brown the whites. Add the soy sauce and mix lightly. Add the broccoli and mix together. Cook for 5 - 6 minutes on medium high heat.

title: Curried Cod With Red cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb cod, cubed | 5 ounces uncooked porcini mushrooms | 1 cup red cabbage, chopped | 3/4 cup beef broth | 5 ounces low-sodium chicken broth | 1 teaspoon curry
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 3 quart saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cover.

title: Moroccan Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini | 1 teaspoon dried coriander powder | corn oil
instructions: Trim ends off zucchini and cut in half lengthways. Slice very thinly. Dry the zucchini with kitchen paper, or leave it on the skin side on. Wash and lightly dry all over with kitchen paper. Combine all ingredients in a large, non stick frying pan. Stir fry over medium heat until zucchini is just tender, adding corn oil as necessary. Transfer veggies to plate lined with paper towel. Sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander.

Random Ingredients: gelatin powder,mango,fenugreek seed,pork rib,tarragon vinegar,tomato puree,croissant,red wine vinegar
title: BBQ Pork Croissants in Sweet Red Wine (Paneer) & Molasses
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs country-style pork ribs ( fat trimmed for cooking purposes, use a smaller bbq or a large ridged pan ) | 1 teaspoon unflavored gelatin powder | 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup mango puree ( from frozen is fine ) | 1 tablespoon figural tarragon vinegar | 2 teaspoons tomato puree | 2 teaspoons ggelatin powder | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 2 -3 plain croissants
instructions: Pour 1 quart water in a small nonstick frying pan and set over medium high heat. Add the pork and gelatin and stir until the gelatin has dissolved. Add the wine, mango puree, figural tarragon vinegar, tomato puree and gelatin mixture and cook, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, for 10 minutes or until the mixture is slightly thickened and the gelatin has dissolved. Add the fenugreek seeds if using, and cook, stirring regularly, for 1 more minute. While the mixture is heating, toast the croissants and cut into thick slices. Spread 1 tablespoon of the mixture inside the croissant, top with another croissant, and press lightly to compact the cheese mixture. Baste or brush the top with water. Serve with a garnish of yogurt and tomato sauce if enjoying.

title: Italian Sausage or Kielbasa Soup
ingredients: 1 package italian sweet sausage links or 2 links kielbasa ( 1 large piece ) | 1 jar chironji or ( 16 ounce ) jar lite spaghetti noodles, reserve one package for seasoning | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 package fresh spinach, washed, dried, and chopped | salt ( for soup )
instructions: Cut sausage in half, or slice into 1/4 inch slices lengthwise and slice lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Place sausage or kielbasa in soup pot, or in crockpot. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Turn off heat, cover and let stand 2 hours. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,bacon dripping,chipotle paste,cheese,navy bean,mango chutney,lime,bean
title: Quick & Easy White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 cup dried navy beans | 1 1/2 teaspoons oil or 1 1/2 teaspoons bacon drippings | 1 large onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon chipotle paste | 1 can baked beans | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1 tablespoon lime rind, grated | 1/2 cup finely shredded cheese
instructions: Combine beans and onion in a 1 qt oven proof dish. Sprinkle with oil. Heat in microwave about 10 minutes. Heat and stir about 5 minutes, until hot, but not soggy. Remove from oven and turn on oven to broil. Spread bean mixture evenly over bean and top with baked beans and chutney. Sprinkle lightly with lime rind. Place under broiler until bubbly and bubbly, about 5 minutes. Top and serve hot. If you've turned the broiler on too high, it will cook all the way to the top. Serve with chips.

title: Mexican Dates and Raisins
ingredients: 3 cups raisins or 3 cups dates | 1 1 tablespoon chili seasoning mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 3/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried ginger | 1/2 teaspoon chili seasoning, powder
instructions: Mash raisins or dates with a fork. Mix remaining ingredients and mix with raisins. Place in a baking dish. Bake at 350°f for 50 minutes or till the edges are light brown, and the filling is hot.

title: Japanese Spinach and Anchovy Rice
ingredients: 3 cups sushi-style rice | 1 tablespoon bacon, chopped | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1 package fresh spinach, rinsed and dried
instructions: In a large saucepan bring 3 cups of the rice to a boil. Cover, remove from the heat and let sit for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a skillet over medium heat fry bacon until crisp. Remove bacon, leaving the drippings in the skillet. Add remaining rice to the hot skillet.

title: Spicy Chickpea Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 cup dry chickpeas | 1 cup ripe green beans | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots
instructions: Cook the chickpeas over med low heat until soft.

title: Easy Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 4 tortillas ( optional ) | 3 -4 cups non dairy milk or 3 -4 cups soymilk | celery salt
instructions: Cut tortillas into 1 inch cubes. Place in a saucepan and cover with water. Simmer over medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes or until tender. Drain water and set aside. Meanwhile, boil milk in a saucepan. Add vegetables, cook over medium heat for 30 minutes. Pour into a blender, add tortilla cubes. Blend until smooth, stir and heat through.

title: Grilled Orange Peel With Coconut Oil and Coconut
ingredients: 1 orange | 2 teaspoons coconut oil
instructions: Grill the peel. Cut peel into long strips of paper thin strips. Keep your orange peel covered with plastic so it doesn’t touch your peel.

title: Persian Poppy Seed Chicken
ingredients: 12 chicken drumsticks | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup flour | 1 head garlic ( not cloves ) | 1 red onion ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | rice or flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Wash chicken and place on a rack in a roasting pan. Cook 30 minutes or till they are done. Let cool. Skin and slice into strips. Slice garlic and onion and place in pan. Cook 20 minutes. Sauté poppy seeds in 1 cup of water 30 seconds. Take 3/4 cup of water and set aside until needed. Pour the rest of the water into the pan with the poppy seeds. In a bowl, blend the mayonnaise and flour. Dip the chicken in the mayonnaise and then in the poppy seed mixture. Place the chicken in the roasting pan. Slice onion and sprinkle with poppy seeds. Bake at 375°f for 1 1/2 hours, till chicken is browned and crisp.

title: Spicy Mexican Asparagus
ingredients: 3 lbs asparagus | adobo sauce | 500 g meat, chopped
instructions: Blanch asparagus for 2 minutes and then slice on the bias into 1 1/4 inch slices. Place meat, a few pieces at a time, around the asparagus. Cover with water and simmer until tender, approx 20 minutes total. Serve with rice and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: lime,phyllo dough,red chilies,pack bean curd,orange zest
title: Taste of the Islands Banana
ingredients: 3 cups pack bean curd, drained | 4 canned red chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup finely grated orange zest | 2 tablespoons finely grated lime zest | 1 1/2 cups solid pack frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 inch jellyroll pan with parchment paper. Combine beans curd and chiles in a small bowl. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high 2 minutes, stirring 2 - 3 times, until heated through. Stir sugar and orange zest into bean curd mixture, then stir in lime zest. Lay pastry in ungreased 9x13 inch baking pan. Microwave 2 minutes, stirring, until phyllo begins to color. Spread bean curd mixture evenly over the pastry. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high 4 minutes, stirring every 3 seconds, until pastry is puffed and golden. Remove plastic wrap. Turn over pastry into oven. Bake 25 - 35 minutes, until pastry is golden.

title: Cauliflower and Sour Cream Rounds
ingredients: 1 package fast rising yeast | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower, drained
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in 1 cup of the warm milk. Add the cream of tartar, and stir. Add the rest of the scalded milk and stir until mixture is thick and creamy. Stir in the cauliflower. Grease a 9x13 pan and spread a little of the cauliflower mixture in the bottom of pan. Let rise until doubled in size. Cover with a layer of sour cream and sprinkle top with additional shredded cheese. Bake at 350 f oven for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coriander,mustard seed,cardamom powder,chicken stock,queso fresco,dark sesame oil,fontina cheese
title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 5 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 cup dry queso fresco, crumbled | 1/2 cup heavy cream or 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 cups fontina cheese, coarsely grated ( or mozzarella ) | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan, bring stock to a boil. Meanwhile, using a cheesecloth, twist together cheese, sesame oil and coriander until well mixed. Using a slotted spoon, skim off any foam that rises to the surface. Add cheese mixture to boiling stock.

title: Chickpeas & Filo Pie
ingredients: 425 g canned chick-peas, rinsed and drained ( garbonzo beans ) | 1 package frozen phyllo dough | 3/4 cup diced smoked salmon ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Mix the dry chickpeas and smoked salmon together in a bowl. Put into a small ovenproof dish or 2 greased pie dishes. Cut sheets of phyllo dough in half, so you have 6 rectangles. Brush each one with a little oil, and then layer on each piece of phyllo and filling. Repeat this process until you have used up all the phyllo. Put into a preheated oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until golden and puffed up.

title: Mashed Potatoes Brittlesticks
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant minced garlic | 1 1/4 teaspoons baking potatoes, granules | 1/4 cup coffee liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Mix all ingredients thoroughly with hands to make a dough that pulls away of the sides of your hands. If you feel it is sticky add a little more cornmeal. Roll into balls about a ¼ inch in diameter. Place in a pan lined with parchment paper. Bake on a baking sheet for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,bow tie pasta,green curry paste,grapeseed oil
title: Curried Bow Ties
ingredients: 12 ounces bow tie pasta, cooked and drained | 2 teaspoons grapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons green curry paste
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in curry paste. Saute garlic paste 1 minute. Stir in cooked bowtie pasta and toss lightly with curry paste to coat. Serve with additional warm curry flakes and additional green curry.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,mustard,cottage cheese,salt pork,yellow bell pepper,oregano,green bean
title: Italian Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/2 lb prosciutto, sliced thin | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 green beans, trimmed | 1/3 lb medium-dry mustard | 1/2 lb mild fat cottage cheese | 3 tablespoons dried oregano, crushed
instructions: Cook beans with 1 cup water in heavy large saucepan over medium heat, uncovered, stirring occasionally 2 minutes. Add prosciutto and bell pepper.

Random Ingredients: brown rice flour,black mustard seed,bean sprout,kidney bean,irish whiskey,turkey
title: Smoked Irish Turkey and Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground turkey | 1/4 cup prepared black mustard seeds or 1/4 cup yellow mustard seeds | 1/4 cup brown rice flour | 2 tablespoons fermented beans ( drained ) | 1 can kidney beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey or 2 tablespoons other dark liqueur | 6 -8 cups bean sprouts ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Combine the ground turkey, mustard seeds, flour, beans, and whiskey in a large skillet or wok. Stir often while cooking until it has a fine, slightly thick consistency about 2 minutes. Spoon into a 2 quart casserole and top with the bean sprouts. Broil in preheated 375 degree oven about 5 minutes or until they are tender crisp and lightly toasted. Serve immediately.

title: Spice-Baked Beef
ingredients: 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons ground roasted chilies | 2 teaspoons chinese cabbage | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic instant coffee granules | 2 lbs chuck ( i use top round )
instructions: Combine mustard seeds, chilies, and cabbage in an ovenproof dish. Cut beef into 1 inch cubes. Dissolve instant coffee granules in 1/2 cup of hot water. Pour spice mixture over beef. Cover dish and roast at 300&#8260.

title: Fried Red Onions
ingredients: 2 large red onions, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 2 teaspoons fish sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the onions and sesame seeds, and leave to stand for 30 minutes. Heat oil to 180°c and shallow fry onions. When crisp turn over and deep fry, 2 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Serve as a accompaniment with satay satay.

title: Homemade Harissa Sauce (North African Recipe)
ingredients: 2 cups chili flakes, deseeded | 1/3 cup harissa
instructions: Mix the harissa into the hot liquid and leave to stand until cool. Store in an airtight jar or spice container. The sauce can also be left in a cool, dark place.

Random Ingredients: egg wrapper,chunky salsa,saffron,pecorino romano cheese,manchego cheese,plain flour,liquid smoke
title: Mexican Cheesecake
ingredients: 12 ounces manchego cheese, finely grated | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 12 ounces chunky salsa, mild | 4 free range egg roll sheets, approximately | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 2 cups plain flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 4 ounces egg roll wrappers
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line & grease the base & sides of a 20cm round loose based cake tin w/parchment paper. Using a food processor or blender, process cheese & salsa till smooth & mixed. Set aside to cool. Using your fingertips, rub the saffron into the flour till well combined. Stir in liquid smoke. Place a tablespoon of the cheese mixture on the center of the roll, then roll it tightly & pinching the edges with your fingers or a fork so the cheese will be able to spread it onto the dough. Place the cake in the tin & bake for approx 45 min or until golden & springy to the touch. Remove the cake from the oven & allow to cool slightly before carefully taking it out of the tin. Serve with chunky salsa & a wedge of cheese.

title: To Tofu & Vegetables
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu, drained of oil in a bowl and cubed | 1/4 cup chopped marjoram | 1/2 cup chunky salsa, of your choice | 1/4 cup chickpeas, soaked in water for 10 minutes, drained | 250 g firm tofu, drained of oil and cubed | 3 tablespoons marjoram, chopped | 3 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1/4 cup chunky salsa, of your choice | 1/4 cup cherries or 1/4 cup chocolate
instructions: Combine the marjoram with half the chunky salsa in a bowl, add the chickpeas and stir to combine. Spray an oven proof dish with oil and arrange the tofu over the top. Pour the marjoram salsa over and bake in an oven for 15 - 20 mins or until heated through. Combine the remaining salsa and cherries or chocolate, pour over the tofu and bake for another 5 - 10 mins or until set. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sirloin roast,lamb,marjoram,kosher salt black pepper,saltine cracker,rice noodle,pasta sauce,marshmallow
title: Lamb Lover Friendly Steak
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 lbs boneless sirloin roast | 1 package saltine crackers | 1 jar pasta sauce | 1 teaspoon kosher salt and black pepper ( to taste ) | 2 cups leftover steak marinara sauce from the roast | cooked and dried rice noodles | marshmallows | fresh marjoram
instructions: In a large crock, toss the saltines with 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Cut the beef diagonally across the grain for 4 to 5 slices. Place beef in crock. Add jar of marinara sauce and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours, or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork. Remove meat, let cool slightly and slice. Serve on a bed of rice noodles, topped with shaved hot marshmallows and marjoram.

Random Ingredients: cherry,red chile,white onion,red wine,yeast,serrano chile pepper,ice,vanilla pudding mix
title: Ravioli
ingredients: 1 cup ice | 3/4 cup dry red wine, divided | 1 tablespoon yeast | 1/2 cup white onion, diced | 1 can cherry or cherry pickles, drained and diced | 4 dried red chiles | 2 serrano chile peppers | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix
instructions: In a saucepan, combine 1/4 cup red wine, the yeast, onion and 1/4 cup of the cherry orcherries. Heat to boiling, stirring to dissolve yeast. Stir in remaining 1/2 cup cherry orcherries, chiles, serrano chiles and the remaining red wine, reserving the remaining juice. Pour into a fluted ring mold. Arrange the cherry orcherries in decorative pattern, alternating with the remaining cherry orcherries. Cover and chill for 2 days. After chilling, slice and serve on a chilled platter.

Random Ingredients: white pearl onion,monterey jack pepper cheese,cider vinegar,graham cracker crumb,yeast,orange juice zest
title: Pizza Crust
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 2 cups white pearl onions, minced ( see directions ) | 1 3/4 cups monterey jack pepper cheese or 1 3/4 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Mix the yeast and 1/3 cup of the cheese together in a large bowl. Stir in the orange juice until it is well blended. Put the onions in a separate container and pour in the rest of the cheese. Stir the yeast and cheese and 1/3 cup of the orange juice together in the bread machine on the yellow/white cycle. Add the remaining 1/3 cup orange juice and mix well. Put the dough on a lightly floured surface and knead it a few times. The idea is to make sure the dough gets into the bowl and doesn't stick to the bowl. Cover and let rise in a cool place until doubled, about 45 minutes. When the dough is doubled, punch it down and divide in half. Flatten into 2 inch rounds and put on a lightly floured pizza pan or stone. Cover the crust with some waxed or plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 15 minutes.. For the crust, roll each dough round into a tight ball using a rolling pin. Sprinkle the dough with the remaining cheese and spread evenly. Fold the dough into half circles and pinch the edges of half the circles together to seal them. Place the dough on a lightly floured pizza pan or stone, cover and let rise until doubled, about 40 minutes. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. After the 20 minutes, spread the remaining orange marmalade on the crust. Bake for 5 - 7 minutes. Remove the from the oven and brush the edge of the crust with the remaining marmalade. Cut six slits in the crust with a long, serrated knife. Brush the crust with the remaining marmalade. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Return to the oven and bake for 8 minutes. Cut each pizza into six wedges. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,green curry paste,bacon,sherry wine vinegar,ginger paste
title: Chendi's Indonesian Sate
ingredients: 2 slices bacon | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 250 g queso fresco or 250 g mozzarella cheese | 3 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Remove the rind from the bacon, and cut the fat bacon into small pieces. Place the bacon into a frypan, and sprinkle with oil. Cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently and scraping with a wooden spoon, until it starts to smell. Add the ginger and curry pastes, and brown until it comes together as evenly as possible. Remove from the heat, and set aside. In a separate pan, add the cheese, and brown for a few minutes, stirring until it has melted.

title: Taco Mates (Taco Bell Home-Style Mix)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 large banana
instructions: Pre heat grill to medium heat. Place taco seasoning mix in blender. Run banana over medium/high heat to break apart. Mix in with taco mix, making sure to scrape bottom of bowl. Cover, and set aside for 10 minutes, or until bananas are very soft and start making popping sounds to come out of the bowl. Taste, and add more seasoning if desired.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,plain flour,grape,apricot preserve,broccoli rabe,bean sprout
title: Broccoli Rabe and Beans Sprouts
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup broccoli rabe, stems trimmed | 3/4 cup seedless grapes | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | plain flour, pastry dough recipe for your favourite pastry dough
instructions: Boil the broccoli rabe and grapes gently until it is all cooked, but not soft. Cool and chop coarsely. Sift 1 cup flour into a bowl and stir in just enough cold water to mix. Add the vegetable oil to a large saucepan. Dump the chopped broccoli rabe and grapes into the flour and mix. Fold in enough water to just make a little over 1 cup liquid. Put on a floured surface and knead for 5 - 10 minutes. Put the mixture in a bowl with a little flour underneath and knead lightly, just enough to make a smooth dough. Preheat the oven to 180°c. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured workbench until about 5mm thick. Cut out 4 rounds of parchment paper. Working quickly, cover the base of a baking tin with dough, then spread with a little apricot preserves. Put 1/4 of the bean sprouts in and spread out with a fork. Sprinkle with a little flour to prevent sticking. Repeat until all the bean sprouts are used. Using a round cutter put out 2 rounds of parchment paper and flatten each round slightly. Cover the tray with another 2 large round paper. With two knives or a knife, cut the rounds into 12 wedges. Repeat with remaining rounds and trimmings. Turn the bread triangles out onto the paper and cut out more cookies from each one. Place the star shaped bread triangles onto the tray. Cover each triangle with a tea towel to prevent drying out. Bake the bread triangles in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until they are golden and crispy. Cool on a wire rack. Serve warm or cold.

title: Dilly and Macaroni Meatballs
ingredients: 1 package dill picky-style frozen meatballs | 1 container small macaroni | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill
instructions: Prepare dill pickle style frozen meatballs according to package directions. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook meatballs for 3 minutes or until thawed. Drain. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add macaroni and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Spiced Cremini Mushrooms and Peaches
ingredients: 4 ounces cremini mushrooms or 4 ounces other fresh mushrooms | 1 medium peach preserves, drained and sliced | 12 ounces cooked noodles ( i prefer the mini ones, but any noodles will doexcept macaroon ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 garlic, minced
instructions: If using fresh mushrooms, remove and save stems, cut caps on caps into half. Slice mushrooms diagonally in half. Set aside. Place 2 tablespoons of butter in a small microwaveable bowl on medium high in 1 tablespoon of water. Heat until butter is bubbling, about 30 seconds. Add mushrooms. Cook, stirring, 1 to 2 minutes. Add preserves. Cook 2 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: premade puff pastry,lettuce,salt pepper,rice vinegar,hazelnut,feta cheese,catsup
title: Greek Rolled Puff Pastry
ingredients: 2 lbs premade puff pastry | 1 1/2 cups hazelnuts or 1 1/2 cups almonds, finely chopped | salt and pepper | 1/2 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 head of soft lettuce | 4 -8 slices feta cheese or 4 -8 slices gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix nuts with seasonings using a food processor. Roll out pastry on a lightly floured surface and cut into approximately 2 circles. Place a spoonful of nuts on one side of each circle, leaving a 1/2 inch margin on each side. Roll out two opposite edges together to seal. Place the pastries on a heavily floured baking sheet, and brush each with catsup and vinegar, and top with the lettuce and cheese. Fold up the pastry over the filling to form a half moon, press the edges together, and place back on the baking sheet. Brush with more catsup if desired to crisp the edges. Bake in 425 degrees oven for approximately 15 minutes or until the top is golden. Allow to cool on wire racks. Serve with more catsup or vinegar on the side.

title: Puerto Rican Blackberry and Apricot Jam
ingredients: 2 quarts apricots, pitted and chopped, peels removed | 1 lb fresh apricot, pitted, cut from the core, removed | 6 ounces kkelp ( raw gelling sugar ) | 20 whole cloves | 1 large green chili pepper, finely chopped ( such as serrano ) | 1 tablespoon dried celery leaves
instructions: In a large stainless steel pot, combine the chopped apricots and diced green chilies. Pour water over the mixture and then add the cloves. Bring to a boil over medium heat, skim off any foam from the surface and let boil 2 min, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in the gelling sugar, scraping up the fond on the pot. Taste and adjust the sweetness with more sugar if necessary. Let the mixture sit a few minutes before serving. To use, remove from heat and let the jam cool. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 2 days. The flavor will improve if the mixture has a chance to soften a bit before storing in the refrigerator.

title: The Easiest and Best Burger
ingredients: 4 hamburger buns, split | butter | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley leaves | 1 tablespoon instant tea | 2 slices stale bread
instructions: Brush the inside of each bun with butter. Toast the hamburger buns for 3 - 5 minutes. Place the cooked meat equally between the buns and top with parsley. In a cup, mix instant tea with bread crumbs. Brush toast with tea. Squeeze some hot tea onto the bread if unsure. Put burger mixture on top of bun.

title: Bake Phyllo Rounds
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach or ( 10 ounce ) package chopped fresh spinach, thawed well | 1 jar roasted sweet red peppers, drained and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove any excess moisture from the frozen spinach. In a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, mix all ingredients together. Cut into 12 squares and place on parchment lined baking sheet. Bake at 350 f for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Chipotle Slices
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama ( about 12 ) | 1 packet mccormick chipotle chiles | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Peel the jicama, cut off the top third of the jicama and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Trim off any dark green sections. Cut the jicama into 1 inch chunks. If your jicama won't use all of the green sections, skip this step. Place the pieces in a large microwave safe bowl. Sprinkle in 1 t chipotle chile adobo. Microwave for 30 seconds. Sprinkle the rest of the chipotle and 1 t seasoning salt over the top of the jicama. Microwave for another 30 seconds or so.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,green bell pepper,serrano pepper,chorizo sausage
title: Spanish Sausage Rolls With Puff-Cuff and Chorizo
ingredients: 7 ounces chorizo sausage, casings removed | 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded and finely diced | 1/2 serrano pepper, seeded, de-seeded and finely diced | 1/3 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place sausage in a skillet over high heat with a medium amount of cooking spray, about 3 or 4 tablespoons per side. In a small bowl, combine chorizo and green bell pepper. Add chorizo and green bell pepper mixture to the skillet and toss to coat with cooking spray. Turn sausage mixture over and add vanilla essence. Transfer sausage mixture to oven and bake for 40 minutes. Turn sausage mixture again and bake an additional 10 minutes.

title: Brandy Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 5 tablespoons brandy ( or other flavor )
instructions: Combine in a jar with tight fitting lid. Shake until well blended. Taste.

title: Dessert Fudites
ingredients: 4 slices breadcrumbs | 1 cup sunflower seed oil | 1 cup fresh mozzarella cheese, grated or 1 cup mozzarella cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill | 2 tablespoons toasted chocolate chips ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat the sunflower seed oil in a very large pan and cook together the cheese, dill, and toasted chocolate chips until melted and combined. Pour 1/4 of the cheese mixture onto each slice of bread and roll up. Serve with more toasted chocolate for sprinkling.

Random Ingredients: red snapper fillet,chicken broth,bread flour,baby spinach,sun tomato oil,cornstarch,corn tortilla
title: Grilled Corn Fish Tacos With Spinach
ingredients: 2 teaspoons stone-ground cornstarch | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and cut in thin strips | 9 corn tortillas, warmed and warmed | 8 slices country bread, toasted | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh spinach, stems removed | 2 red snapper fillets, 4 ounces each
instructions: To make the sauce, heat the broth and sundried tomatoes in a small saucepan to boiling over high heat.

title: Frijoles Paradisosos (Beans in Cream)
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 2 cups heavy cream | pinch sage leaf, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the beans and pick off any dirt and sand that tends to float to the surface. Place about 2 cups of cooked beans in a small bowl then ladle cream on top to cover beans. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour. Before garnishing, stir a handful of leaves from the top of the cream, add a tiny pinch of sage and serve in the center of a warm pita.

Random Ingredients: semolina,vegetable bouillon cube,salt pepper,dark rum,sea salt,pineapple juice
title: Grilled Sweet-Nuts (Sweet Syrup)
ingredients: 2 cups semi-sweet semolina | 3 tablespoons vegetable bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 can unsweetened pineapple juice | salt and pepper, to taste | 2 -3 tablespoons dark rum ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring water to a boil. Meanwhile, soak the semolina in it for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add bouillon cubes, sugar, and pineapple juice. Stir well and cool to room temperature. Season with salt and pepper. Let stand for at least an hour, then mix again and serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: mango,port wine,water chestnut,grain rice,chicken wing,parmigiano reggiano cheese,oyster sauce,bread
title: Chicken Wings With Chocolate Sauce & Rice (Pokkien Tom Yum)
ingredients: 2/3 cup port wine | 1/3 cup water chestnut, in 1 inch dice | 8 chicken wings | 1/2 cup long grain rice | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mango | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Place the port wine and 1/3 cup water in a small pan, place on high heat, and bring to a boil. Add the chicken wings and turn once or twice until browned and completely cooked, about 10 minutes. Remove the chicken and put in a bowl. Add the rice, mango, 1/4 cup butter and oyster sauce to the pot and cook over medium heat until sauce is absorbed. Add the parmigiano reggiano cheese. When the sauce is heated through add the chicken wings back in and remove from the heat. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Dried Whole Wheat Chili Powder (Masa Con Noc
ingredients: 4 tablespoons canning salt | 2 tablespoons canning salt | 15 cloves crushed dried chili | 2 eggs | 7 cups whole wheat flour, approximately
instructions: Place the canner and 1 t salt in a small bowl, fill with warm water and allow to sit 30 minutes. Drain water from canner and add dried dried chili powder. Allow dry chillies to sit 10 minutes. Stir the salt into eggs and add flour to the eggs. Beat until blended. Set aside to rest 5 - 10 minutes. Roll the mixture into small balls, and roll in additional flour to coat the balls. Transfer to a lined baking sheet, leaving a ¼ inch border on all sides. Garnish top with sliced red onion, chopped scallions, or other desired toppings. If making chili in a crock pot, set crock pot on high, bring to low heat for approximately two hours, or until mixture forms fine threads when pinched with your finger.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,dark brown sugar,baking potato,chinese five spice powder,cocoa
title: Sweet Potatoes in Brown Sugar
ingredients: 6 medium baking potatoes | 1 1/2 cups light brown sugar | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 5 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1/2 cup cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f / 220c / gas mark scoop peeled sweet potatoes into medium sized baking tin. Using hands rub sugar on inside of tin. Place sweet potatoes on top of sugar and push sugar in gently. Mix brown sugar and five spice powder and pinch of baking soda. Bake for 25 - 30 mins until golden brown and crisp. Remove from oven and allow to cool for five mins before eating.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,saffron thread,browning sauce,cream chicken soup,turnip,honey,breadcrumb,clear honey
title: Slow Cooker Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1 pinch saffron thread | 1 soup bone | 1/2 cup browning sauce ( such as kikkoman ) | 3 cups mixed breadcrumbs | 2 turnips
instructions: Rub tenderloin with saffron. Place in 4 - 4 1/2 5 qt slow cooker. Mix together the rest of the ingredients. Spread mixture over beef. Cover slow cooker. Cook on high 5 hrs. Turn to low, and cook 6 - 8 hrs. When tenderloin is almost done, turn slow cooker to low. Strain liquid into large saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, and boil 1 minute. Remove from heat, and cool for 5 hours or overnight. Slice thin, and serve with turnip sauce.

title: Peach Coconut Bubble Tea
ingredients: 1 can peach slices | 1/2 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1 can coconut milk | 10 lime wedges | 2 packages brussels sprouts
instructions: Combine the peach slices, limeade concentrate, coconut milk, and lime wedges into a pitcher. Stir and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Strain the liquid into a large pot and add brussels sprouts. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until sprouts are easily pierced and heated through, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,raisin,vodka,lemon peel,wheat flour,red apple,flat leaf parsley,cheese
title: Irish Cabbage Brik II
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 3 teaspoons grated lemon peel | 2 teaspoons dried sweet butter | 2 tablespoons grated cheese | 1/2 cup raisins or 1/2 cup sultana | 2 large red apples, cut into thin wedges | 1/4 head cabbage | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Mix flour, lemon peel, butter and cheese in large bowl. Stir in raisins or sultanas until coated. Add apples and cabbage.

title: Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 1 tablespoon red thai chile, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups oil
instructions: Sift the flour into a bowl, mix in all remaining ingredients. Add seasoning to taste. Cover and chill until required. Roll out the dough till about 8mm thick. Heat 1cm oil in a deep pan, and fry 4 - 4 mins till light brown specs appear on the top side. Serve with ketchup or chutney. Variation,.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,hard egg,vegetable broth,baby spinach leaf,cranberry,hot italian sausage,basmati rice,avocado
title: Spinach, Avocado & Chiles Paella
ingredients: 1 cup cooked basmati rice | 1/2 lb hot italian sausage, cut in 1/4 inch slices | 1 avocado, cubed | 2 hard-boiled eggs, thinly sliced | 1 red chili pepper, minced | 3 cups mixed baby lettuces leaves | 1 cup veggie broth | 1/4 cup fresh cranberries, chopped
instructions: Place rice in a casserole dish. Sprinkle sausage over rice then top with avocado, eggs, chili, lettuce lettuce, and broth. Cover and bake at 400 degrees, turning occasionally for 10 - 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Hominy Stew
ingredients: 2 cups hominy | 1 can beef consomme | cooking wine ( optional ) | 1 can dashi
instructions: Soak hominy overnight. Put into pot with broth, wine and dashi. Simmer for at least an hour, stirring occasionally. Serve in bowls, with rice.

Random Ingredients: ancho chilies,velveeta cheese,green bean,cantaloupe,chicken drumstick,thyme,hungarian paprika,seasoning salt
title: Sopa De Tripura (Cheese Paprika Chicken With Chickpeas)
ingredients: 1 -2 chicken drumstick | 5 -6 ounces mexican velveeta cheese or 5 -6 ounces other cheese | ancho chilies ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons hungarian paprika | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme, chopped ( may use dried ) | seasoning salt | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed | 1 can cantaloupe, cubed | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Brown the chicken in a large nonstick fry pan then sprinkle with paprika until it is completely black and crispy. Remove from pan and reserve. Drain any remaining fat in the pan. Slightly crisp the croquettes if necessary and add to the fry pan. Cut velveeta into cubes. Spray the fry pan with pam and brown the cube of velveeta slowly until it is slightly brown. Add the chickpeas, thyme, salt and seasoning and sauté until everything is heated through. Add the green beans and reheat gently until warmed through. You can also add any other desired meat like beef or pork. If you are unable to find dandies to serve as a side dish, or have a hungry friend, make a homemade tripura mixture of your choosing and let them set for an hour or two. After an hour, serve with crusty bread on the side.

Random Ingredients: beef stock cube,wheat wrap,pork chop,coffee,french bread,toothpick,recaito,bell pepper
title: Sopa De Espinaca
ingredients: 1 pork chop | 1 can french bread | 4 slices whole wheat wrap | 1 bell pepper, thinly sliced | 4 leaves recaito | 2 beef stock cubes | 6 tablespoons instant coffee | toothpick
instructions: Cut bread and wrap in cheese cloth according to instructions on package. Pound with mallet or rolling pin until thin. Cut bread into 2 to 3 strips. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Put pork cutlets in and brown on both sides. Place bread strips in food processor. Add chopped pepper, recaito, broth cube, coffee, and enough water to cover the bread pieces. Blend until pureed, adding water if thicker. Remove from heat. Wrap bread strips around pork mixture, or place in casserole dish. Place atop bread strips in casserole dish. Cover and bake in 350°f oven for 45 minutes. Serve with bean soup.

title: Quick and Easy Okra and Okra Saute
ingredients: 18 jumbo pasta shells | 1 small package frozen cut okra | 1/4 cup mayonnaise ( i use miracle whip ) | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dry ginger | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Boil the okra for 10 minutes to soften a little. Cut the okra in thirds diagonally. Then cut them in slices about 1 inch long. Cook the jumbo pasta shells according to the packaging, until they are barely tender. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and then add the okra to the oil. Saute, stirring, until just tender. Add the mayonnaise, soy sauce, ginger, and celery salt. Mix well, cover, and let chill for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,red chile,chipotle powder,active yeast,semolina,sushi rice
title: Chipotle Sushi Rolls (Yoshinoya)
ingredients: 3 1/4 cups sushi-style rice, well rinsed | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup white semolina ( farfel ) | 1 tablespoon ground chipotle powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle chile, minced | 1/4 cup shaved shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Sauce, toast semolina in a skillet over medium low heat until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Remove cereal from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside. Sauté yeast in remaining 2 t. Sauce over medium high heat, 2 minutes. Stir in remaining 3 1/4 cups hot water and rice until absorbed. Cover and set aside at room temperature for 15 minutes. In a small bowl, combine rice mixture with semolina, chipotle powder, and chiles. Let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Preheat an oven to 450°f. Roll sushi mat onto a large, even surface. Using a floured rolling pin, lightly push rice mixture into the center. Roll rice mixture into an 18 inch long log, about 1/2 inch thick. Press the rice log firmly around rice. Cut into 3 or 4 equal pieces with a 3 or 4 inch cookie cutter. Roll each piece of log into a rope about 21 inches long and about 6 inches in diameter. Line a baking sheet with parchment. Cut rope into 2 inch segments and arrange on the prepared parchment sprinkled baking sheet. Bake until crust are pale and deeply browned, about 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes and serve. Sushi mat mat can also be stored in an airtight container for up to 7 days in the refrigerator. Uncooked sushi mat can also be frozen for up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: chicken,mascarpone cheese,ouzo,muenster cheese,plantain,baby beet,tomato juice,salmon fillet
title: Roasted Plantain Smoked Salmon With Bleu Cheese, Tomatoes & Ouzo
ingredients: 800 g baby beets | 3 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 150 g muenster cheese, soft in the oven | 300 g smoked salmon fillet, sliced into 24 slices | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 1/2 cup ouzo | 1/4 cup mashed plantain, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Cut 5 cm cubes from beetroot. Place beetroots and mascarpone in a roasting tin. Wrap roast in foil and roast in oven for 40 50mins until tender. Cut muenster into 24 slices. Combine mascarpone and remaining ingredients and spoon over beetroot slices. Wrap foil around the beetroots and roast in the top of the oven for 12 - 15 mins until the juices run clear.

title: Turkish Coffee
ingredients: 1 can strong coffee powder | 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt, plain or 1/2 cup curds
instructions: Pour the coffee powder into a microwave safe dish. Add yogurt and stir to combine. Microwave on high for 2 to 3 minutes until the liquid has mostly evaporated, then stir again. Serve hot, or refrigerate.

title: Coriander Paste
