ingredients: 1 cup fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup bitter apple | 1/4 cup ginger paste | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed
instructions: Place cilantro, bitter apple, ginger and aniseed into a blender. Puree to a fine paste. If a paste is too thick, add some water. If too thin, add more water. Variation, instead of achiote, sprinkle in 1 tbsp ground fennel seeds before grounding the aniseeds.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,italian sausage,egg,thyme leaf,dark sesame oil,currant,cherry tomato,chicken meat
title: Italian Stuffed Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 12 stalks asparagus | 3/4 lb sweet italian sausage or 3/4 lb hot italian sausage, casings removed | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 4 sprigs thyme leaves, preferably fresh | 1 cup dried currant, soaked in warm water | 8 firm cherry tomatoes, halved | 4 hardboiled egg, peeled, halved, if desired | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Trim the asparagus ends, then cut stalks in half at the stem end. Cut stems in halves, and cook asparagus in boiling salted water until just tender, not crisp. Drain. Cut asparagus into 1/2 inch slices on a diagonal. Lightly oil nonstick frying pan, add sesame oil and heat until sesame oil is fragrant. Add sausage and cook over medium heat, breaking up until no longer pink. Drain sausage, and tear into bite sized pieces. Return to pan over low heat until sauce is almost dry, not dark. Add thyme, currants and remaining ingredients. Mix well, and heat until warmed through. Spoon into 4 small serving bowls to serve.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,beef stew meat,peanut butter,fish,sharp cheddar cheese,stewing beef,crescent,pimiento
title: Philly Cheesesteak Pizza
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cans refrigerated crescent rolls | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can pimientos, drained and sliced into thin wedges | 8 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 can green chili peppers, chopped | 1 jar pickled vegetables, drained ( use green onion with `` or '' white part of a jar of each ingredient, drained ) | 1 can light cream of mushroom soup ( regular or low-fat ) | 1/2 - 1 cup peanut butter
instructions: Brown beef cubes in a 9x13 glass dish. Drain off any fat. Return beef to pot, add remaining ingredients. Simmer for 1 - ½ hours.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,kale,oregano leaf,elbow macaroni,pasta shell,onion juice,german chocolate cake mix
title: German Style Kale
ingredients: 1 german chocolate cake mix, thawed | 2 tablespoons onion juice | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves, minced | 1 tablespoon fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped | 3 cups chopped kale | 1/2 cup uncooked elbow macaroni | 12 ounces cooked medium pasta shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil an 8x8 inch glass baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine the chocolate and onion juice. Sprinkle on top of the cake mix, followed by the oregano and parsley. Spread the kale over the mixture. Top with macaroni. Bake, covered, for 40 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,flat leaf italian parsley,heavy whipping cream,pecan,rye bread,lemon juice
title: Crunchy Pecan French Toast
ingredients: 1 package six-grain rye bread | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon toasted ground pecans ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Preheat the broiler, setting the oven rack 3 inches from the heat source and the rack set 6 inches below the element. Lightly coat the inside of a baking dish with cooking spray. Cut the bread in half horizontally. Place the bread slices on top of the remaining slices. In a shallow bowl, whisk the cream with the lemon juice and five spice powder. Add the pecans if using. Turn the soaked bread slices in the cream, 1 slice at a time, to coat, and transfer them to the prepared dish. Broil for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until just toasty. Serve warm, at once or set the dish aside for up to two hours before serving. Sprinkle with parsley, if desired, and serve with toasted rye crackers and a side of salsa.

title: Asparagus-Basmati Rice Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed | 1 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 24 spears fresh asparagus, stemmed | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry
instructions: Place rice in a 2 cup measure.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,onion,black peppercorn,white vinegar,italian seasoning,taco seasoning
title: Famous Pub-Style Baked Pretzels
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups warm distilled white vinegar | 3 1/2 tablespoons instant minced onion | 1 1/4 teaspoons salt | 2 ounces taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon freshly ground black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: In the container of an electric mixer with the dough hook attachments, combine the vinegar and minced onion. Beat at moderate speed until soft, about 2 minutes. Add the salt, taco seasoning, peppercorns and italian seasoning until well blended. Transfer the mixture to a 2 quart bowl and cover with plastic wrap or a clean towel. Let the mixture stand at room temperature for 1 hour or refrigerate overnight in the refrigerator. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. With the palms of your hands, divide the pretzel dough in half and shape each half into a pretzel shape. Wrap each pretzel in parchment or aluminum foil and place on the prepared baking sheets. Place the pans on top of each other and let the pretzels rise in the warm oven until they are about 1 1/2 times their original size, about 40 minutes. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops of the pretzels have lightly browned, about 12 to 18 minutes. Transfer them to a wire rack to cool for at least 5 minutes. The bread can also be made in a 9x9 inch glass baking dish, if you like.

title: Sizzling Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g ground meat | 2 teaspoons caster sugar ( or superfine sugar ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 3 tablespoons ice water | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix with your hands until well combined. Form into walnut sized balls and place flat on a tray or on a flat griddle that has been sprayed with oil. Cook until crisp and brown around the edges.

Random Ingredients: udon noodle,phyllo pastry,celery salt,chicken breast fillet,taco seasoning mix,mint leaf
title: Chicken Fillet and Noodle Casserole'
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets, skin removed, skin scored and chopped into 2cm pieces | 1/2 cup taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 300 g fresh udon noodles, prepared | 40 g fresh mint leaves or 1/4 cup coriander leaves, finely chopped | 300 g phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line a 12 hole 4cm loose bottomed, 25cm x 10cm baking tin or pie dish with baking paper. Blend together first 4 ingredients in a food processor and set aside. Combine noodles and mint in a large mixing bowl and toss to combine. Place a layer of chicken mixture over base and sides of tin. Top with a layer of noodles. Repeat with a layer of chicken and noodles and a layer of noodles. Place one sheet of phyllo pastry on top of each layer of chicken. Using a sharp knife, score into 3 5cm wide x 6cm squares, each cutting into 4 diagonal squares. Use a sharp knife to mark off 12 squares of pastry and place on top of pastry. Cut pastry into 24 squares and place all squares on top of pastry. Using a pastry brush, lightly brush pastry with remaining beaten egg. Place baking paper between squares on a wire rack over a tray and weigh down with a tin. Bake for 45 minutes or until pastry is golden. Allow to cool for 5 minutes. Serve with fresh mint dipping sauce or dipping sauce of your choice.

title: Chinese Beef and Baked Noodle Soup
ingredients: 100 g rice noodles | 800 g sirloin steaks | 1 bunch chives | marshmallows | fresh spinach | beets or red apple | black beans | 3 cups broth | 1 bunch spring onion
instructions: Put noodles in boiling water for 2 mins. Rinse, drain and leave to cool. Boil steak in broth for 15 mins. Slice and brown steak in fry pan. Add chopped chives and a couple of leaves of chives. Add sirloin to broth and simmer for another 25 mins. Add rest of ingredients and noodles. Cook as per your macadamia n’s. You may need more or less beef and broth per your taste.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,golden syrup,cod,lard,radish,bicarbonate soda,bacon dripping
title: Cod, Radish and Chilli Batter
ingredients: 2 cod, fillets | 2 teaspoons lard | 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 3 -4 radishes, finely cut | 1/2 teaspoon sweet chili pepper flakes | 6 -8 slices bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Wash the cod very well in cold water. Leave it for 4 to 5 hours to purge the water and impurities. Cut away any thick skin or bones. Break the fish into chunks and boil in water seasoned with the lard and sugar until the fish is cooked through and tender. Remove the cod from the bones and chill under running water. When ready to serve drain off the water and set it aside. Dry fry the lard and then cut into small cubes the radishes and chilli flakes in the fat until they are crisp and golden. Remove the chilli from the heat with a slotted spoon and discard. Dry fry the bacon drippings in a pan until they are a dark brown colour, but not burnt. Toss the radish, bacon and chilli mixture together. Arrange half the radish mixture on the plate and top with the cod chunks.

title: Red Cabbage Salad With Tomatoes and Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 cucumber, peeled and chopped | 1 plum tomato, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 small red cabbage or 1 small kale, shredded
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cucumber, tomatoes, parsley, and cabbage. Sprinkle with salt, if desired.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,chicken stock cube,cremini mushroom,cheddar cheese,prosciutto,artichoke heart,tortilla,water
title: Mushroom & Tortilla Parcel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 1 chicken stock cube | 150 ml chicken stock ( fresh ) | 75 g cremini mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1 cup artichoke hearts ( sliced ) | 8 -12 slices prosciutto, cut into thin strips | 2 -3 cups cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 1 -4 tablespoon water ( depending on how much water you put on the plate ) | 20 -25 tortillas
instructions: Place yoghurt, stock & cube in a small pot & cook until it thickens. Add mushrooms & artichoke hearts & continue cooking. Take off the heat. Place 1 tbsp on a tortilla and top w/2 tbsp of the cheese & mushroom mixture. Fold tortilla over filling to form a Parcel, roll up the parcel & place in a serving dish. Repeat till all your ingredients are used. Top with remaining cheese & water. Allow to sit for 15 minutes & serve.

title: Chocolate Steak Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 cup instant chicken bouillon | 1 lb flank steak, sliced | 2/3 cup sliced cremini mushrooms or 2/3 cup button mushroom | 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 lb whipped cream or 1 lb whipped cream, whipped | 4 sheets ladyfingers
instructions: Place the bouillon in a zip lock bag. Add the steak and refrigerate for 2 hours. In a wide, shallow dish, combine the mushrooms, tomatoes, and cocoa. Remove steak from the marinade then add to the marinade. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Remove from marinade and place on a wire rack. Bake 20 minutes then flip, spray with cooking spray again and bake an additional 5 minutes until cooked through. Cool 5 minutes or longer then slice between thick pieces of waxed paper into strips. Dip each piece of flank steak in the mixtures, coating well.

title: Carnival Baked Spicy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 2 ounces spicy pork sausage | 2 ounces hazelnuts, chopped | 2 cups crushed ice
instructions: Crumble the ground sirloin& pork into a large bowl. Toss throughly. Add the hazelnuts& serve immediately. Recipe from lucid food to post,.

title: Pumpkin and Spinach Soup
ingredients: 1 lb butternut pumpkin | 3 inches fresh spinach, leaves picked | 10 fluid ounces white wine | 8 whole cloves
instructions: Trim the pumpkin of all excess fat, peel, and slice into 1/2 inch dice. Tear the spinach into strips long enough to add to soup. Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil, add the pumpkin, and cook for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, add the wine, the cloves and cook for 5 minutes or until warmed through. Remove the squash and put into a blender, and process for an additional 15 seconds so that it's pureed. Return to the pan, add the spinach and heat through. Serve hot or cold. Variation, substitute 2 cups sliced pumpkin for the butternut, use a potato masher, or a little more salt to help squash cook through.

title: Tender Onion Rings (Lazy Tong)
ingredients: 2 large yellow onions | 1/3 cup caster sugar
instructions: Peel away as much skin as possible from the white of your onions and cut them into very finely thick slices. Place onions in a bowl and sprinkle with the caster sugar. Wash and dry well. Cover bowl or plastic wrap with paper towels and place in the fridge to marinate overnight. Heat a large non stick frying pan over a medium heat. When hot, add onions and cook for 2 minutes, turning constantly until the onions soften. Carefully remove onions from pan and continue to cook onions until they are caramelized, turning them in the caramel with a skewer, until caramelised all over. Store in an airtight container. Serve very cold as an accompaniment.

title: Paneer Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans pinto de pinto and new mexico dried pico de gallo | 1/3 cup vegan sour cream | 1/4 cup dried fenugreek leaves, and | panna dolmatti cheese or vegan fenugreek flavored crumbled bacon, to top
instructions: Drain pinto and new mexico de jane cheese. Place cheese and pinto in a blender container with 1/2 cup of your sour cream and blend until smooth. Stir in fenugreek leaves and pulse several times to combine. Sprinkle mixture over cheese and mix well. Chill for at least 15 minutes after serving. Enjoy.

title: Artichoke Roast
ingredients: 7 artichoke hearts | 1 clove garlic paste | 1 can corn, drained
instructions: Remove and discard artichoke heart stalks, and chop artichoke hearts into wedges. Cut slits lengthwise, and stuff with garlic paste. Place wedges in a roasting pan, and roast at 400 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes, or until tender. Remove from oven and drizzle roasting pan with olive oil. Sprinkle garlic over the tops, and return pan to oven. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 minutes, or until roasted and hot. Drain artichoke heart, and serve warm.

title: Stuffed Chutney Shrimp (Low Fat)
ingredients: 300 g shrimp, cleaned, devained and coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup plain flour | 1/4 cup celery salt | 1/3 cup mango chutney | 4 -6 dill pickles, finely chopped
instructions: Combine the flour, celery salt, chopped mango chutney and chopped dill pickle in a bowl and mix well. Place the shrimp in a microwave safe dish. Add the flour mixture to the shrimp along with the marination and mix well together. Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring the contents occasionally until thickened. Serve with crackers.

title: Chinese Steamers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw sirloin steaks | 4 medium scallions, cut crosswise into 3 inch lengths
instructions: With a sharp knife, cut 3 inch lengths of about 1/4 inch long. Using kitchen scissors and scissors, cut pieces to separate scallion pieces. Place scallions, overlapping, on a cutting board and toss lightly to coat. Remove each piece from scallion and place in a shallow dish. Repeat with other scallions and meat. Press scallions briefly to coat and let stand 20 minutes. Drain scallions, reserving marinade, and steam steaks. Arrange about 3 pieces on each of 2 plates. Spoon scallions on top of steaks and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,flat leaf parsley,demerara sugar,red curry paste,nacho chip
title: Spicy Beef Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 jar nacho chips, drained | 1/3 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons demerara sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Heat the nacho chips in a microwave on high for 2 minutes until warm and soft. Mix the oil, curry paste, sugar and chopped parsley together in a salad bowl. Pour the noodles in over the oiled mixture and toss with the dressing until the noodles turn golden and coated with oil.

title: Scallop Potatoes with Yellow Squash
ingredients: 5 medium baking potatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 package thawed fully cooked, peeled whole scallops | 1 cup whole-grain whipping cream | 1 tablespoon chopped, no-calim seasoning mustard | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow squash | 16 toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Brush a 9x13 inch baking dish with vegetable oil cooking spray. Place sliced potatoes in a large pot of cold salted water. Bring to a boil and cook until tender. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, place seafood, cream, mustard and squash in a large bowl and mix well. Arrange shrimp on top of potatoes. Dot seafood with a mixture of 1 tablespoon mustard and 1 tablespoon butter flavored oil. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon reserved potatoes onto a large plate. Garnish with remaining mustard and butter herb butter butter. Serve warm.

title: Blueberry and Cheese Chocolate Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 tablespoons reduced-fat colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 4 tablespoons dark chocolate or 4 tablespoons milk chocolate chips ( about 3 tbsp ) | 2 tablespoons fresh blueberries ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons frozen blueberries, cut in half ( optional )
instructions: Spray nonstick griddle or large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. In medium bowl, whisk together cheeses and nuts. With spoon, spread mixture on griddle. Add 2 tablespoons blueberries and pinch of salt, if desired. Place under medium heat and cook 2 minutes, until heated through. Remove from pan. Spread cheese mixture evenly over each of 4 to 6 cradons. Fold in half lengthwise, pressing together lightly. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,loaf french bread,beef broth,milk,flour,chili paste,chili garlic sauce
title: Kathleen's Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin steaks or 3 lbs top round sirloin steaks, cut into 1 inch pieces | salt and freshly ground pepper | flour | 2 cans low sodium beef broth | 1 can chili-garlic sauce | 1 1/2 cups whole milk | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Cut the beef into cubes. Season each piece of beef with salt and pepper, and dredge with flour. Brown in a medium saucepan over medium heat, about 5 minutes, or until browned nicely. Add beef broth, hot sauce, milk, and spices. Heat to boiling. Lower heat and simmer over low heat until meat is tender, about 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Pour off any excess liquid, uncover, and cook 10 to 15 minutes longer. Serve over hot cooked french bread, sprinkled with a little melted butter and fresh chopped scallions, if desired. Note, this is a thick and rich dish. I prefer mine a little thinner than a regular one and use a bit of the beef flavor broth for dipping into the sauce.

Random Ingredients: garlic,rice wine vinegar,island dressing,cajun seasoning,tarragon leaf,kale,nigella seed
title: Nigella's Steamed Cajun Kale Bowls
ingredients: 4 small kale, stemmed and chopped into small pieces | 4 teaspoons nigella seeds | 1/4 cup thai island dressing | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced
instructions: Wash greens and remove white membrane from stems. Coarsely chop. Combine greens and nigella seeds in a medium bowl. Add thai dressing, rice wine vinegar, cajun seasoning, tarragon leaves and garlic. Toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate at least one hour.

title: Saffron Filled Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large red potatoes, quartered lengthwise and thinly sliced | 200 g zucchini, coarsely chopped | 200 g cornflour ( corn starch ) | 1 tablespoon saffron | 2 cups breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon tamari | 20 fried dinner rolls | tamari
instructions: Cook the cubed potatoes in a very large pot filled with plenty of boiling water. Meanwhile, soak the saffron in just enough water to cover. Add the corn flour to a small bowl or plasece in a strainer. Dip the cubed potato slices in the rice flour, shaking off the excess. Dip the coated potato slices in bread crumbs, shaking off excess. Then toss in the saffron soaked potato slices in a pan containing a bit of tamari. Cover the skillet and continue frying with tongs, turning over and shaking the potato slices once, until all the slices are golden brown and crisp on both sides, about 10 minutes. Serve warm with spanish rice, beans, fried british breadsticks, and a few spanish spoons of tamari on the side.

title: Pancakes for 2
ingredients: 4 lbs hamburger | 1 cup cake flour
instructions: Preheat oven. Mix 1/2 cake flour and 1/2 of the browned hamburger with a bit of water to form a thick paste. Shape into balls. Place on baking sheet, and coat with remaining browned hamburger. Cook until browned, then place on paper towel to absorb excess grease. You can serve them immediately, or they can keep well for a day.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,marinara sauce,lemon peel,red wine vinegar,red onion,greek yogurt
title: Greek Beef for 1
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut in bite-size chunks | 3/4 - 1 cup marinara sauce | 1 -2 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/2 - 1 cup red onion, chopped finely | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped lemon peel
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Place in crockpot. Cook on low for 8 - 12 hours. Serve over cooked noodles or rice. Also good with rice or roti.

title: Indonesian Butternut Squash and Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 350 g butternut squash, peeled, deseeded, and coarsely cubed | 50 g creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup cider or 1/4 cup water | 1 tablespoon yeast | 50 ml coconut milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c/375f. Place the squash in a roasting tin and add some water. Leave to soak for 10 minutes and drain. Place the peanut butter in a heat proof bowl and add the cider or water, yeast and coconut milk. Stir to combine, then leave for 30 minutes or longer until the flavours combine. Add the drained butternut to the peanut butter mixture and leave to sit, loosely covered, for 20 minutes, stirring the mixture every so often. Remove the sponge from the oven and beat vigorously for 5 minutes until smooth. Leave to stand for 10 minutes to develop a creamy texture and to allow the flavours to combine.

title: Chocolate Pizza (Pain Au Chocolat)
ingredients: 20 ounces marinated artichocs | 2 cups pineapple juice | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, finely grated | 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 16 ounces chopped nuts, cashews, hazelnuts, peanuts | 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme, crushed or 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Put the marinated artichocs and 2 cups of the pineapple juice in a food processor. Add the remaining ingredients and process until well combined. Transfer to a greased bowl and let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour. The dough can be used in small loaves or large, flat pizza bases as well. Let rise for 1 hour, then turn out onto a lightly floured board and knead for 10 minutes. Brush the pizza base with some of the reserved marinade. Roll out the dough to 1/8 thick on a lightly floured surface. Cut 3/4 rounds with a pizza cutter or sharp knife. Lay the rounds on the base on the pizza base in thin slices. Brush the tops with some of the reserved marinade. Bake at 400° f for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Blackberry Sesame Slice
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen fresh blackberries | 2 teaspoons instant limeade concentrate | 1 cup cocoa | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Place berries into an oven proof bag. Top with limeade concentrate, sprinkle with cocoa, and close bag tightly. Let sit at least 8 hours, stirring occasionally to ensure even browning. Just before serving, sprinkle with sesame seeds at once.

title: Thai Sweet and Sour Stir Fry Pasta
ingredients: 500 g penne pasta | 3 tablespoons green curry paste ( to taste ) | 600 g cooked squash ( small peeled, cubed ) | 125 g hearts of palm ( small ripe )
instructions: Cook pasta as per packet instructions. Drain and return to pad. In a large frying pan, over a medium low heat, add the green curry paste and stir fry for 5 minutes until aromatic. Add in the squash, hearts of palm and mix together. Increase heat to medium and add pasta and stir fry for 2mins. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Creamy Beef Ragu
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef stew meat, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 can fat-free chicken broth | 2 cans diced tomatoes, undrained | 8 ounces soymilk
instructions: Place beef and broth in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting setting for 2 - 4 hours. Add tomatoes and 1/2 cup water. Cover and cook on high setting for 45 minute remove lid. Add soy milk and blend well. Cover and cook 30 minutes more.

title: Honey Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 -2 lb steak | 1 -2 tablespoon honey
instructions: Mix honey and honey together in an oven bowl place the beef in the bread bowl and cover with the honey mixture to let it soak for 15 minutes. Preheat your oven to 275 - 450 degrees. Bake uncovered, turning a few times until the honey is caramelized on a piece of meat for about 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Nougatine (Greek Oregano Spread)
ingredients: 2 cups hazelnuts ( skinned and hulled hazelnuts ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried oregano ( or 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano flakes ) | 1/2 cup lemon marmalade or 1/2 cup apricot preserves, warmed
instructions: Remove the hard shell of the hazelnuts, and grind very fine in a food processor. Add the remaining ingredients and pulse to blend, adding a teaspoon or two of water if it's too thick. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Beer Canning for Canning
ingredients: oil | 4 -6 cardamom seeds | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon sage | 1/2 cup beer
instructions: In canner, pour 1 or 2 tbls. Shallots into hot oil. Drop cardamom seeds onto canning tip. Cover and cook 30 - 45 minutes until very light brown.

title: Spicy Savoury Spareribs
ingredients: 8 spareribs | 2 cups curd cottage cheese | 1/2 cup minced serrano pepper | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | ice
instructions: Place spareribs in a large saucepan and add water to cover on the ribs by about 1 inch. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 1 hour, occasionally skimming any scum that rises to the surface. Drain ribs, reserving some of the cooking liquid. Allow ribs to cool enough to handle and cut into pieces about 1/4 inch thick or thinner. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread cottage cheese on a cutting board, top with a few pieces of shaved short rib meat and sprinkle with one of the seeded and minced serrano peppers and coriander seeds. Place the remaining ribs in the center of the cheese and top with a few more shaved ribs to cover. Bring the pan liquids to a boil and cover. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and the cheese is browned and crisp, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,oxtail,meal flour,butter bean,thai red chili pepper,meat
title: Oxtails, Yellow Peppers and Beans in White Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs oxtails, cut in 2-inch pieces | 1 lb meat | 4 -6 yellow bell peppers, sliced | 12 -15 thai red chili peppers, sliced | 1 can butter beans, drained | 1 tablespoon whole meal flour
instructions: Brown meat in large pan. Add all peppers, butter beans, and flour. Simmer for 2 - 3 hours on low heat until vegetables are tender.

title: Beef with Barley
ingredients: 2 slices bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 can sliced peaches, drained and liquid reserved
instructions: Place the bacon in a large, deep skillet and cook over medium high heat until evenly browned, 7 to 10 minutes. Remove bacon to paper towels. Stir the barley and mustard powder into the bacon drippings and pour into the skillet. Pour 1/2 1 cup of the liquid into the skillet and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, 20 minutes. Drain the skillet slices over paper towels and place in a serving dish. Sprinkle with the chopped peaches and serve.

Random Ingredients: pinot noir wine,wheat germ,dark corn syrup,phyllo dough,rice
title: Black Treacle Rolls
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups whole black treacle or 2 3/4 cups dark corn syrup, warmed | 2/3 cup pinot noir wine or 2/3 cup sherry wine | 13 sheets phyllo dough, thawed ( store-bought or homemade ) | 7 cups hot cooked rice | 1/4 cup wheat germ
instructions: In a small saucepan, stir the treacle or corn syrup with the noir on low heat, the wine and the rice until the mixture is warm and the liquid is hot. Remove from the heat and let stand until cool. To make rolls, remove 1 sheet of phyllo dough at a time from a dampened surface and lightly brush with melted butter to dry. Place a second sheet of phyllo, on a clean dry surface, and cover with a dampened towel. Using a 2 - 3 inch round cookie cutter, cut into 4 pieces. On the same cut side of each piece place 2 tablespoons of the cooled treacle mixture and 2 tablespoons of the rice mixture. Take a piece of phyllo dough and lay it on top of this one. Using the palm of your hand gently stretch the phyllo dough, taking care that it does not become overworked. Roll the dough into a cylinder about 5 inches in diameter. Repeat with remaining sheets and filling. Lightly brush the rolls with melted butter and dust with wheat germ. Place the rolls on a baking sheet and bake at 400°f for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Spinach and Raspberry Jam Salad With Cilantro (Zwt-8)
ingredients: 5 tablespoons raspberry jam | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves, minced ( or 1 tsp chopped fresh cilantro leaves ) | 5 large spinach leaves, washed, dried and chopped ( or 4 cups coarse chopped spinach leaves ) | 1 -2 tablespoon mixed spice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl and mash with a fork until it forms a course paste. Store in an airtight container, refrigerate to allow flavors to blend.

title: Puerto Rican Steamed Cheese
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 5 lbs. cheese ( your choice ) | 1 can limeade concentrate | 3/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: If using a large bowl, fill it 2/3 full with cheese and pour limeade and half and half into bowl. Add seasoning salt and stir to blend with other cheeses. Place large steamer over bowl with lid on tightly. Steam 20 minutes. This may also be necessary if using a large saucepan. To test whether the cheese is done steaming, dip in bowl in water and then in opposite direction for a few seconds then place bowl in steamer to dry for 5 minutes. Remove bowl and let cool. Place on serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,cabbage,coffee,bread crumb,chili oil,cooking spray,rice wine vinegar,pizza sauce
title: Thai Tomato Cabbage Wraps (Low Fat, High Protein)
ingredients: 1 medium napa cabbage | low-fat cooking spray | 2 cups cooked shredded cabbage | 1/4 cup dry-roasted rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chili oil | 1 tablespoon skim-milk coffee | 1 tablespoon reduced-fat dipping sauce | 1/4 cup reduced-fat bread crumbs | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,orange juice concentrate,jalapeno chile,sun tomato oil,baking potato,cumin powder
title: Southwestern Beef Roast With Onions
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chuck roast | 1 can orange juice concentrate | 1 package jalapeno chiles, sliced thinly | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking potatoes, i use yukon gold | 1 teaspoon baking potatoes, i use yukon gold | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Place beef roast in a dutch oven or stockpot. Combine orange juice concentrate and the jalapeno.

Random Ingredients: french,beef bouillon cube,oyster,cocoa powder,penne,no salt tomato paste,peanut oil
title: Spicy Noodle & Pesto
ingredients: 3 tablespoons no-added-salt tomato paste | 1 tablespoon oyster ( or other small dried canola ) | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 10 ounces penne | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 french roll, sliced into 1/8-inch-thick slices
instructions: Whisk together all tomato paste ingredients and set aside. Cook pasta until al dente and drain in a colander. Heat oil over medium high heat in a large skillet and stir fry the pasta until they begin to brown, about 4 minutes. Transfer cooked pasta to a warmed serving bowl. Add tomato paste to the skillet, add broth cube, cocoa powder, and salt and pepper to taste, and stir to combine. Divide pasta between 4 plates, ladle sauce around it, and sprinkle with toasted ground black peppercorns.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,clove,splenda sugar substitute,white bread,broth,feta cheese,anaheim chili,pork rib
title: Garides Stewed in Feta
ingredients: 2 loaves white bread, cut in cubes | 2 lbs country-style pork ribs | 2 cups vegetable broth or 2 cups chicken broth | 3 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute or 3 tablespoons sugar | 1 green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 anaheim chili, stemmed seeded and coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cut the loaves of white bread into cubes and place in crock pot. Cut up the pork into 1 inch pieces and set aside. In a stockpot, combine the broth, splenda, green pepper, anaheim chili, cloves and meat and cover. Turn crock pot on high and set crock pot for 6 hours or until meat is tender. Shred meat with two forks and stir into broth. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve with crumbled feta cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,macadamia nut,cayenne pepper,black sesame seed,granny smith apple,beef
title: Kebab
ingredients: 600 g beef, minced | 200 g pork ribs | 150 g macadamia nuts | 4 granny smith apples | 2 teaspoons black sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper
instructions: Grind macadamia nuts into a fine paste using a mortar and pestle. Add beef, pork, coriander, sesame seeds and cayenne pepper until beef is completely coated with the paste. Stir until ingredients are well mixed and combined. Refrigerate the mixture for 3 hours to allow flavours to develop. Serve chilled with bread or steamed vegetable salads.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,mozzarella cheese,sherry wine,self raising flour,salmon fillet,nonfat milk
title: Smoked Salmon & Cherry Tomato Muffins
ingredients: 3 1/2 tablespoons self raising flour | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 7 ounces smoked salmon fillets | 7 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved ( about half a tin if fresh, use fresh tomatoes or tin tomatoes if tin tomatoes are not available ) | 1 ounce mozzarella cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons sherry wine ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f butter muffin pans with 1 tbsp of the melted butter. Sieve the flour into a mixing jug, add the milk, whisk the mixture until smooth. Add the salmon, mix again to coat well. Spoon mixture into the prepared muffin pans, top with cherry tomatoes, making sure you leave a 2½cm border along the sides of each spoon. Sprinkle with a little of the mozzarella cheese. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes or until a skewer comes out clean. Stand for 15 minutes before serving. Serve with a tossed salad or vegetables and extra butter or a light lemon.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,salad oil,kiwi fruit,active yeast,celery,cardamom pod,limeade concentrate
title: Cheese and Kiwi Jam Rollups
ingredients: 1 pound mozzarella cheese | 1/3 cup salad oil | 2 teaspoons limeade concentrate | 1 teaspoon dried kiwi fruit, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 3 cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash mozzarella with a fork. In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, limeade concentrate, kiwi fruit, cardamom, and yeast. Combine cheese mixture, and kiwi fruit mixture together. Cover dough with a towel and allow to rise in a warm area 10 minutes. Divide the dough into two portions. Form each portion into a ball. Place each ball on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Cover with towel and allow to rise until doubled in size. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut a deep slash across each roll from the top to the bottom of the roll. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Allow to cool slightly.

title: Salmon & Ginger Gravy
ingredients: 600 g salmon fillets | 1 glass half-and-half | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Place all ingredients in a roasting/sauteing/frying pan and stir to combine. Cook for 10 minutes over a hot, medium heat stirring occasionally. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,water chestnut,serrano chile pepper,salt pepper,veal,poblano chile,basil leaf
title: Veal Poblano
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless veal, diced into 1 inch cubes | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 small fresh poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 1 serrano chile pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and chopped | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place beef cubes, water chestnuts, basil, poblano pepper and serrano chile in a slow cooker. Season with salt and pepper. Cook on high until onions are translucent and peppers are tender. Reduce to low and cook for 1 1/2 hours or on low setting for 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,cream mushroom soup,cumin seed,onion soup mix,grape,vanilla bean
title: Smokin' Easy Beef Ribs
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, toasted | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 vanilla bean, split and scraped | 2 pounds beef ribs | 2 pounds grapes, halved
instructions: Spread the cumin on a large baking sheet with the tips of a sharp knife. Bake in the preheated oven until fragrant, about 1 hour. Mix the onion soup mix, cream of mushroom soup, vanilla bean, and pork ribs with the cumin seeds and remove from the oven. Place the ribs into 9x13 inch glass baking dish and pour in the soup mixture. Cover, and bake in the preheated oven 3 hours, basting occasionally with the soup mixture. Remove the cover and bake until the ribs are tender when pierced with a fork, and a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the ribs registers 150 degrees f, about 1 hour longer.

title: Homemade Spiced Tea
ingredients: 8 ounces vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 5 1/2 cups hot brewed tea, chilled, room temperature | 1 -2 allspice berries ( optional )
instructions: Cut the shortening into pieces with a 3 or 4 pound biscuit cutter, cutting in little bits with a pastry cutter, until pieces resemble small peas. Pour cooled tea into a large, heavy pot, and bring it to a simmer over high heat. When the tea begins to boil, pour in the orange zest, cover the pot, and remove from the heat. Allow the tea to sit until room temperature for about 10 minutes before serving. Stir in the allspice berries. Cool in the refrigerator until cold, at least 1 week.

title: Angel Food Cupcakes
ingredients: 4 ounces angel food cake | 1 can kernel corn tortilla chips | 1 tablespoon oil | 2 cups oil for frying
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup of oil in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 375 degrees f. Pour 2 cups of oil into a small bowl. Dip a tortilla into the bowl of the oil, letting cool on paper towels. Shake off excess and then press into hot oil. The tortillas will become golden and crunchy. Place on paper towels to remove as much extra oil as possible.

title: Acci's Fantastique Sausages
ingredients: 8 hot italian sausages | 8 slices focaccia bread | 8 large mushrooms ( optional )
instructions: Spray a large, deep skillet with cooking spray. Arrange the sausages in the skillet. Scatter the mushrooms over the top and close the skillet with a kitchen tent. Cook over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the sausages are cooked through and no longer pink inside. Serve hot.

title: Anchovy, Paprika and Dried Anchovies
ingredients: 2 -8 anchovies | 2 3 tablespoons sweet paprika or 2 tablespoons hot paprika | 3 cups veggie stock
instructions: Take 6 pieces of anchovies and place in a frying pan with the paprika and some veg stock and cook over medium heat without boiling for 5 or 10 minutes, until the anchovies are well coated and beginning to swell, stirring every so often. Be very careful not to burn the garlic. Pour the anchovis into a large, warmed serving dish and serve alongside other accompaniments.

title: Strawberry Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 french baguette, or | 2 large strawberries | 1 cup strawberry oil
instructions: Cut baguette diagonally into 1/4 inch slices. Slice strawberries into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange strawberry slices on top of sliced bread, drizzle with a bit of strawberry oil, and let stand for 5 minutes while you work with the bread. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange bread on a baking sheet, or place on the counter right side up, and bake in preheated oven for 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,avocado,yellow onion,chicken breast half,cannellini,spring onion,sausage
title: Aussie Chicken (Or Sausage) and Bean Salad
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup light mayonnaise | 2 avocados, very ripe | 1/4 cup spring onion, finely chopped | 1/2 small yellow onion, finely diced | 2 tablespoons sweet smoked sausage, chopped | 1/4 cup bean capsicum, chopped | 1 cup canned cannellini
instructions: Cut chicken in bite size pieces, if desired. Place in baking dish. Using fork, mix together light mayonnaise and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Make a bed of chopped spring onions over chicken. Add chopped sweet onion, chopped chia or paprika, and sweet smoked sausage. Pour over bean capsicum. Bake, uncovered, in 350 degree oven for 25 - 30 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are soft.. Serve warm or cold. Note, for an additional kick of flavour dimension, the avocado can be sliced thinly and dipped into the salad prior to adding the salad before adding it. Note, for mild flavours, the mayonnaise can be mixed with a little curry powder, adding at least one teaspoon of curry powder to the mayonnaise before adding it to the salad.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,yellow squash,milk,golden raisin,thai red curry paste,egg
title: Sweet Red Curry Squash Curry
ingredients: 8 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 lb egg, beaten lightly | 2 tablespoons milk | 2 tablespoons grated fresh gingerroot | 1 lb yellow squash, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat a small skillet over medium high heat. Add curry paste and cook until fragrant, about 15 seconds. Whisk in the eggs and milk. Add ginger and squash and raisins, if using. Transfer to a large ovenproof baking dish. Heat about 2 or 3 tablespoons of oil in a medium nonstick pan over medium high heat. Pour milk mixture over the top of the squash mixture and bake in a 400°f oven until the milk sauce is thick.

title: Marmalade or Dipping Sauce for Veggies
ingredients: 1 cup mini semisweet chocolate chips or 1 cup finely chopped chocolate | 1/2 cup chopped ripe mango | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds or 2 tablespoons yellow mustard seeds | 1 1/2 cups of leftover maraschino cherries ( fresh or dried ) | crushed ice | 1 -2 tablespoon crushed mangoes ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons broken up maraschino cherries ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Put the chocolate in an appropriate glass dish and pour the hot mixture immediately into each. Add remaining ingredients. Stir or shake everything to mix them well. Chill until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,mexican cheese,ice cube,cocoa,peach,tomato sauce,red curry paste
title: Frozen Peach Dip
ingredients: 1 fresh mango | 1/2 can peach slices, drained | 1 1/4 ounces red curry paste | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese, finely grated | 1/3 - 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese, finely grated | 1 -2 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 2 -3 ice cubes
instructions: Peel the mango, remove the pit and remove the fruit. Halve it, remove the fruit, and finely chop it. In a food processor or blender add the mango, curry paste, half the mexican cheese, half the cocoa, and the ice cubes. Chop until smooth, about 30 seconds or so. Transfer to a glass container and freeze it for 4 to 6 hours for best results. Serve with assorted tortilla chips while it is chilling.

Random Ingredients: corn,pizza crust,apple pie filling,green onion,jalapeno pepper,water,chicken leg,crab
title: Corn Chicken Calianca
ingredients: 1 jar refrigerated pizza crusts | 1 can corn, drained | 1 can tomato pie filling | 1 green onion, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh jalapeno peppers | 1 cup chopped fresh chicken legs | 3/4 cup water | 2 cups shredded cooked chicken thighs
instructions: Drain pizza crust and place on a baking sheet. In a medium bowl, combine the corn, tomato pie filling, green onions, jalapeno peppers, and chicken. Stir in the water until well blended. Spread evenly over the pizza crust. Top with the remaining pizza crust. Bake in a preheated 375°f oven for 30 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: black bean paste,okra,serrano chile pepper,bacon,chunky salsa,rum,pimiento
title: Portuguese Okra and Black Bean Salsa
ingredients: 2 packages frozen cut okra | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup red bell pepper, minced | 1/4 cup pimientos, minced | 2 serrano chile peppers, minced | 1/2 cup spanish chunky salsa | 1/4 cup light rum | 2 tablespoons black bean paste
instructions: Prepare okra, thaw completely and boil in water for 8 - 10 minutes. Drain well. In a microwave safe casserole, saute bacon until crisp. Remove bacon to paper towel lined plate. Cook okra in bacon grease over medium heat, stirring occasionally until the okra is golden brown, about 10 minutes. Remove okra to a bowl. Add bell pepper, pimientos, serrano peppers, salsa and rum to bacon drippings in pan, and stir frequently over medium heat until hot, about 5 minutes. Add okra and saute for an additional 3 - 5 minutes. Stir in black bean paste, cover and cook over medium low heat for an additional 3 - 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oil,wheat flour,tuna olive oil,green bell pepper,tomato sauce,szechuan peppercorn,sage leaf
title: Chinese Steamed Whole Wheat Pearls With Tuna
ingredients: 1 lb fresh tuna in olive oil | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 -3 sage leaves ( you may use 2 t dried sage leaves if you have no leftovers ) | 1/4 cup tomato sauce or 1/4 cup chinese chili sauce, according with the brand name | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup oil | 1/8 teaspoon crushed szechuan peppercorns
instructions: Slice off the top of the tuna by pressing the knife down along the length. The tiniest portion should be at least 5 1/2 deep to make 5 - 5 shells. Remove the lower shell and leave about 1/4 in shell. Rinse the tuna well with cold water and dry. Place tuna in a bowl and toss with one of the onions, 1 tablespoon oil, the chili sauce and some of the sage. Toss well until the tuna is coated evenly with sauce. Spray a baking pan with cooking spray and set aside. Toss the shrimp with the remaining tablespoon oil and set aside if using. In a medium saucepan place the 1/4 cup water and the remaining sage. Bring to a boil and add the sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: plum sauce,garlic clove,ginger,green onion,parsley root,red pepper flake,heavy whipping cream,brown rice
title: Ginger Fried Rice With Plum Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 4 plum sauces | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1/2 bunch green onion | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 teaspoon ginger | 2 -3 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley roots
instructions: Brown rice per recipe directions. While rice is cooking, start a large skillet over medium heat. Saute green onions, garlic, and ginger in pan approximately 2 minutes. Pour in plum sauce, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in cooked rice. Top with cream and cook 1 additional minute. Stir in green onions, garlic and ginger. Simmer another minute and serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,red potato,popcorn,garlic sprout,green chili pepper,red chilies,corn
title: Spicy Potatoes and Sprouts
ingredients: 3 red potatoes | 1 cup corn | 6 ounces popcorn | 8 ounces chopped roasted spring green chili peppers | 1 package garlic sprouts | 2 dried red chilies | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Wash and scrub potatoes and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400f for 30 minutes. Add corn and cook an additional 5 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Cool and add popcorn and garlic sprouts. Mix well and then add dried chilies. Break potatoes into pieces and place on a plate. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes. Serve hot with ketchup or a salad of your choice.

title: Veal With Basmati Rice, Vegetable & Prosciutto
ingredients: 4 ounces medallions veal cutlets | 4 ounces penne ( or other long pasta ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon provolone cheese or 1 tablespoon ham, chopped | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/2 cup mixed vegetables, chopped and drained ( broccoli, carrots & cauliflower ) | 1 cup basmati rice, cooked
instructions: Cook veal, according to package directions, using 1/4 cup water for each batch. Meanwhile, cook pasta in large pot of boiling water until just tender.

title: Aquarra Sauce
ingredients: 500 g roasted mixed fruit, chopped | 2 teaspoons arrowroot, paste | 125 ml chicken broth | 3 slices lemongrass | 1 tablespoon demerara sugar, dissolved in | 4 ml warm chicken broth
instructions: Process the fresh fruit in a blender, then add half the arrowroot paste and 2 t vegetable broth. Pulse until smooth. Stir in the remaining arrowroot paste and the lemongrass. Season with the granulated sugar and cook over a medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring continuously, until slightly browned. Serve hot with cooked rice.

title: Parsley Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable, such as corn, frozen veg, chopped | 1 lb red potatoes, chopped ( about 9 medium ) | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: Place vegetables in 3 1/2 quart saucepan, cover with water, bring to boil, cover and reduce heat. Simmer until vegetables are tender. Cook potato until tender, drain, cool under running water, drain well. Discard vegetables. Return vegetables to saucepan, add oil and water. Heat to boiling, serve.

title: Swiss Chard With Coriander and Chard
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard | 1 bunch coriander leaves, loosely packed
instructions: Wash the swiss chard and remove the base and outer leaves. Cut the stalks from it and cut a small bunch off, taking care not to cut too small or it will lose it's bright colour. Bring the leaves to the boil, removing any excess stalks after 8 to 10 minutes and removing the leaves from the stalks. Remove the leaves with a slotted spoon and place on a plate to collect any cooking juices. Wash the chard, then boil it for about 1 minute. Drain well. Place the swiss chard in a serving bowl and top with the coriander and some warm water. Sear it gently until wilted. Serve right away.

title: Pepperoni Sammies
ingredients: 1 pound red potatoes, peeled and cubed | 14 ounces tomato sauce | 1/4 1/4 cup tamari or other soy sauce | 3/4 teaspoon fresh grated nutmeg | 1 package pepperoni | 1/4 cup crushed nuts
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water.

Random Ingredients: challah,hot water,zucchini,poppyseed filling,soy sauce,arugula,orange zest,thai fish sauce
title: Crunchy Thai Veggies
ingredients: 8 ounces zucchini, sliced | 1/4 cup hot water | 2 ounces frozen poppyseed filling | 1 tablespoon finely chopped orange zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 2 slices challah | 1/4 cup arugula, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. In shallow baking dish, combine zucchini, hot water, and pastry filling. Sprinkle zucchini with orange zest. Combine fish sauce and soy sauce, and sprinkle evenly over zucchini. Bake about 20 - 25 minutes, until lightly browned and tender. Sprinkle with arugula.

title: Apple and Coffee Granola
ingredients: 6 granny smith apples, peeled, cored and sliced into thin wedges | 1/2 cup sugar-free syrup, such as honey | 3 tablespoons strong coffee | 1 tablespoon sugar-free hot coffee, such as kahlua
instructions: Combine syrup, coffee and sugar in a small saucepan, then heat until almost simmering. Set aside to cool. Serve garnished with a couple of grated apple wedges.

title: Mushroom Cream Sauce - Paula Deen
ingredients: 1 package cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan and stir over medium heat until soup thins out. Stir cream if using a medium size bowl.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,onion,tomato sauce,chipotle chile adobo,steak,lemon juice zest,virgin olive oil,salad oil
title: Carne Chipotle - An Authentic Mexican Grill Style Steak
ingredients: 5 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 cup virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup salad oil ( i like to use crisco ) | 1 medium thinly sliced onion | 1 cup cilantro stem, loosely packed | 1 small chipotle chile in adobo, seeded and finely chopped ( or 2 to 3 teaspoons canned chipotle in adobo ) | 12 ounces flank steaks, trimmed and thinly sliced | store-bought low-sodium v8 salad oil
instructions: For the marinade, in a medium mixing bowl, blend tomato sauce with lemon juice and pour over steak. Cover and refrigerate for 4 to 8 hours. For the vinaigrette, in a medium nonreactive skillet, toast finely chopped onion and cilantro. Stir in the chipotle with adobo and saute until the cilantro is just wilted. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. Season the marinade lightly with salt and pepper, to taste. Grill steak over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, or until medium rare. Let rest for 5 minutes. Transfer to cutting board, slice thinly, and serve with warm vinaigrette.

title: Prawns in Gravy (Pigs in Vine)
ingredients: 1/2 kg cleaned prawns | 1 1/2 cupsroyal icing
instructions: Remove heads from prawn heads. Rinse heads thoroughly with cold water. Boil heads in water until tails leave shells on. Remove heads from shells. Drain and reserve heads. Cut heads in two with cleaver. Blend heads and heads thoroughly. Place in shallow tin dish. Pour about half fill of marinade over. Cover. Refrigerate overnight or up to 2 days. Turn over skewers. Brush with half marinade, baste and marinate in remaining marinade for at least 2 hours. Preheat charcoal barbecue. When ready to cook, lightly oil grate. Place prawns on skewers. Place 2 skewers on each grid and spoon 1/4 cup of warm marinade over each grid. Close with skewers. Cook on oiled griddle about 5 6mins, turning and basting frequently. Serve on individual plates with sweet onion salad. Enjoy, d.

title: Potatoes and Snow Peas With Snow Peas and Vegetables
ingredients: 4 small red potatoes, quartered | 2 tablespoons corn oil ( preferably canola ) | 20 g snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange the potatoes on a baking tray. Brush with the oil. Broil the potatoes for 4 mins on each side. Turn and broil for 2 mins more. Tip, this can be made a couple of days in advance and placed in an airtight container.

title: Okra and Chickpeas Stew
ingredients: 1 lb okra | 1 can chickpeas | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon green chili pepper ( depending on your taste )
instructions: Wash okra under running water. You can remove the ends if desired. You want the okra to be somewhat limp to the mouth, but tender. Remove okra carefully from water, drain well, and remove the skins. Mix okra, chickpeas and green chili with fingers or a fork. Bring to boil, reduce heat and cook for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: citric acid ph canning,iceberg lettuce,cranberry,red potato,trout,icing sugar,urad dal,self rising flour
title: Baked Trout in Ginger Dressing
ingredients: 1 small red potato, cubed | 2 sheets iceburg lettuce | 200 g dried mulato radish | 1 head chickerel lettuce | 4 tablespoons self-rising flour | 50 g cranberries ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 4 teaspoons citric acid ( can be found in asian food stores )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade line a deep sided baking tin with baking paper. Place potatoes, cabbage and turkish herbs in a large bowl and add 250ml water. Bring back to the boil and leave to soak for 5 minutes, drain and dry. Place 1 tablespoon of the potato starch in a jug. Add 200ml water to the remaining water and stir until a smooth paste forms. Pour half of the mixture into a plastic food bag along with the fish. Seal and shake until the other half is coated. Add the remaining potato starch and water. Shake until the mixture is smooth. Add the cranberries and mix well. Place on the lined tray and bake in a preheated oven for 20 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Remove from the oven and set aside for 10 minutes. Add the icing sugar to a bowl, stir, and add the remaining cranberry mixture. Serve the fish with the salad and the salad, garnished with the crispy potato cubes and chopped cilantro.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,cucumber,large shrimp,cardamom,green bell pepper,egg white
title: Shrimp-Garam Masala With Egg White
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 large egg whites | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 medium cucumber, cut into very thin half moons | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom, ground
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the shrimp, egg whites, bell pepper strips, and cucumber in a large bowl. Add all the ingredients and combine thoroughly. Pour into an oven safe, heavy baking dish and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until shrimp are just cooked through and most of the liquid has evaporated.

Random Ingredients: sultana raisin,pepper sauce,baby potato,worcestershire sauce,tomato puree
title: Aussie Potato Salad
ingredients: 6 baby potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 150 g sultana raisins | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Boil potatoes for around 7 mins until tender, drain well and toss with raisins. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve warm.

title: Spinach and Chicken  Wraps
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 1 can rotisserie-cooked chicken, drained | 1 corn, drained ( optional ) | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix spinach, chicken and corn. Spray a skillet with cooking spray and lightly coat pan with cooking spray. Arrange mixture in 2 even layers in a shallow baking dish. Add 2 more pans of spray and bake for about 20 minutes, or until heated through. Remove from oven and slice with a pizza cutter and dip each roll in spinach mixture.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,red potato,sesame oil,self rising flour
title: Sesame Potatoes
ingredients: 8 small red potatoes, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 tablespoons italian dressing | 1/3 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Place the potatoes on to a parchment lined baking sheet. Mix the olive oil and dressing together and brush over potatoes. Bake at 400 degrees f for 45 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Serve warm. Note, if you want to bake the sesame potatoes as directed, brush and brush and bake on top of the potatoes with sesame oil while the potatoes are still warm.

title: Wild Rice and Raspberry Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 loaf country-style white bread | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar | 2 cups wild rice, cooked
instructions: Toast the white bread. Combine the rice with the vinegar. Stir in the wild rice. Spread on top of the hot bread.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,pastry,baby pea,chili paste,sparkling water,bread,olive oil
title: Baby Peas Pastries
ingredients: 1 cup frozen baby peas, thawed if frozen | 1 pastry for double-crust deep-dish bread | 3 tablespoons sweet mango chutney | 6 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 1/3 - 1/2 cup sparkling water | 1/2 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 cup warm spiced water | 1 -2 tablespoon mango chutney | toasted bread, slices, for serving
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together all the ingredients except the spiced water and olive oil. Roll chilled dough into a ball, place on a cold cutting board and with floured hands, press to a thickness of about 1/4 inch. Using a 3 round cookie cutter, cut out circles. Working with 1 ball of dough at a time, gently press out a circle into a 6 inch circle. Repeat with the remaining dough and the remaining balls. If using a 6 inch diameter cookie cutter, cut out circles and place them on a baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven for about 9 minutes, or until just beginning to brown. Cool on a rack. Spoon 1/2 cup chili sauce over each serving and top with toasted bread slices.

Random Ingredients: beetroot,lasagna noodle,garbanzo bean,rice wine vinegar,sesame seed,french onion dip
title: Beetroot and Garbanzo Spread
ingredients: 2 cans garbanzo beans, drained | 1 can french onion dip | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup sesame seeds ( optional ) | 1 package shredded cooked beetroots | 1 package lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Combine beans, onions, dip, vinegar, sesame seeds.

title: Vietnamese Roasted Currants
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried currants | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 2 cloves garlic, pressed
instructions: Place currants in a skillet 1/2 inch deep.

title: Shoyu Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 6 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 medium zucchini, thinly sliced lengthwise | 1 medium jicama, peeled and thinly sliced | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons currants | 1/2 cup picante sauce ( or salsa )
instructions: Whisk together the oyster sauce and salt and pepper in a small bowl. Toss zucchini, jicama and currants with the sauce. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: anise,cream mushroom soup,dark soy sauce,white bread,raspberry,apple,white vinegar,cornflour
title: Apple Raspberry Sour Cream French Toast
ingredients: 1 sour cream, container | 2 tablespoons white vinegar ( white wine vinegar is not recommended ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon anise, seeds ( optional ) | 2 slices white bread | 2 slices apples, cored and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Whisk together sour cream, 2 tablespoons of white wine vinegar, 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce, anise seeds, bread and apple. Pour half of the french toast in the bowl, top with the sour cream mixture and top with the rest of the french toast. Combine the cornflour, 1 tablespoon of white wine vinegar and 1 tablespoon of dark soy sauce and whisk well until mixture comes together. Pour over the french toast and toss to coat. Heat a frying pan on high heat. Lightly spray with cooking oil or spray the butter flavored cooking spray. Place french toast in the pan and flip the fry until golden brown on both sides. Serve with a side of fresh fruit.

title: Teriyaki Dipping Pinwheels
ingredients: 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish-flavored olive oil ( olive oil may be substituted ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 quart fresh oyster, shucked ( or 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables, thawed ) | prepared filling ( i like onion dip )
instructions: For the oysters,. Blend all the ingredients in food processor until smooth. Refrigerate until serving. For the pinwheels,. Rinse and drain the oysters.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,green bean,plum jam,coconut milk,lettuce leaf,blueberry,heavy whipping cream,lemon zest
title: Lettuce Green Bean Salad  (Salad Ma Llor Na Vinak Kike)
ingredients: 1 cup canned plum jam, well drained | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated lemon zest | 16 plumi jam ( available at international specialty food shops, specialty stores, and many supermarkets in the ethnic aisle ) | 3 large heads lettuce leaves | 3/4 lb green beans | 1 pinch saffron thread, lightly crushed | 16 lettuce leaves | 1 cup fresh blueberries or 15 strawberries, sliced
instructions: For salad, mix plum jam, cream, zest, and 1/ 2 t. Of the hot cream in a medium bowl stir in lettuce leaves until well coated. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.. For garnish, lightly toast saffron in a small skillet over medium heat, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Pour saffron infused cream mixture into skillet and boil, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in remaining cream. Tear lettuce leaves and divide among four dinner plates. Cover and spoon over hot greens. Garnish with saffron mixture, remaining hot cream, and berries.

title: The Whole Wheat Pizza Crust
ingredients: 5 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 1 teaspoon dried oregano, crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f mix the flour, oregano and seasoning in a large bowl. Place the dough on a prepared pizza stone or baking sheet in a thick layer. Press the dough out evenly. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until the crust is browned.

title: Tomato Concasse (Tomato Gravy)
ingredients: 2 kg ripe tomatoes | 1 kg pickling spice | 3 kg tomato stock | 2 tablespoons good quality cocoa ( i use dutch process cocoa ) | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder
instructions: Peel the tomatoes, and put them in a large saucepan with the pickling spice and enough water to cover them. Simmer until the tomatoes are soft and the water is reduced by about half. Drain the tomatoes well in a sieve, and put the tomato pieces into a clean saucepan, cover, and simmer for about 1½ hours. Add a little extra water to get the desired consistency. While the tomatoes are simmering, make the gravy, in a small frying pan, melt the cocoa with the five spice powder in 2 tbsp boiling water. Stir to create a paste. Pour this into the simmering tomato sauce, add the cocoa paste, and bring to the boil. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly before stirring occasionally so the flavors can meld. Remove 1 tbsp of the tomato liquid and store in a glass jar. Add enough remaining sauce so that the mix becomes slightly thinner.

title: Beef Roast - 5 Net Carbs
ingredients: 1 beef roast, trimmed | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/2 cup oyster sauce, for sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine 1/2 cup oyster sauce and 1/2 cup oyster sauce in a shallow dish. Rub roast thoroughly with oyster sauce mixture. Wrap roast in aluminum foil. Bake at 425 degrees f for 3 1/2 hours or until outside is golden brown. Serve with cooked pasta. Overnight is best.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,stock,maraschino cherry,kielbasa,pickle juice,flat leaf parsley,white miso,taco sauce
title: Quick Calzones With Kielbasa
ingredients: 5 large tart apples, peeled, cored and cut into 1/2-inch chunks ( such as dutch jonagold, mcintosh, red delicious, granny smith, etc. ) | 1 kielbasa, fully cooked and cut into 1/2-inch slices ( such as hillshire farms or smithfield farms, the recommended kind on kookos.com recommended 2 ounces per apple, but use whatever kinds you like ) | 1 bunch flat leaf parsley, chopped ( about 1/2 cup or per apple ) | 1 can pickles in juice, drained | 0.5 bottle taco sauce ( not salsa of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons pickle juice | 1/4 cup stock | 2 tablespoons white miso, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Combine apples, kielbasa and parsley. Spray a baking sheet lightly with nonstick cooking spray and arrange the apple mixture evenly over the tops. Bake in the middle of the oven until the apples are caramelized, about 25 - 30 minutes. Watch out, because the apples tend to be quite tender and chewy, not mushy. Meanwhile, mix taco sauce, pickle juice, stock and miso in a small saucepan. Set over very low heat. Simmer until liquid is reduced by about 1/ stir all the hot sauce mixture into the caramelized apples. Serve warm with calzone, if desired.

title: Wok Sausages
ingredients: 3 links pork sausage | 1 bunch english lettuce, washed and chopped | 1 spanish onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons ghee | 1 1/2 inches gingerroot, peeled and finely chopped | 2/3 cup double cream | 3 tablespoons mixed mushrooms, finely chopped ( optional ) | 3 teaspoons fermented whole-beans, cooked for 5 minutes or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Prick the sausages with a fork in several places and set aside. Fry the sausages in the oil until browned on each side and cooked through. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Wipe out the wok and any fat from the pan. Heat 1 tbsp of oil and fry the onions gently until they turn golden brown. Add the ginger and stir fry for 1 minute. Add the mushrooms and stir fry for 1 minute. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Stir the cream into the wok and add the sausages, lettuce and the cooked mushrooms. Mix thoroughly, coating all the ingredients well. Heat to boiling stage, then add the cooked mixed beans and cook for another minute or two. Serves about.

title: Baked Beets With Rice and Spice
ingredients: 5 medium beets, scrubbed, trimmed, about 1 1/2 pounds | 1 jar picante sauce | 16 fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, leaves picked from stems
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Place beets on aluminum foil in a roasting pan.

title: Apple and Olive Oil Salsa
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons apple juice | cilantro leaf, for garnish
instructions: Blend all the ingredients in an electric blender or food processor until smooth.

title: Venison Jerky
ingredients: 2 pounds venison | 2 cups vanilla sugar | 2 pounds vanilla sugar
instructions: The night before, place the venison into a large bowl containing enough water to cover. Soak overnight. Remove and discard the venison from the water, and cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Set aside until the next day. In a medium size bowl, stir together the 1/2 pound vanilla sugar and the 2 pounds of vanilla sugar until thoroughly mixed, and set aside. Remove the venison from the water, and cut into 1 inch cubes. Place into the bowl with the vanilla sugar and vanilla sugar and set aside. Add the venison into the bowl with the vanilla sugar and vanilla sugar and stir until thoroughly mixed. Cover, and allow to marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Remove the cover, and allow the meat to sit in the marinade until firm.

title: Easy Yummy Squash
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 2 small yellow squash, peeled, cut into chunks
instructions: Beat egg yolk, egg white, and chopped yellow squash together in a bowl on low for 15 minutes, until the squash becomes soft. Stir together with chopsticks if desired.

title: Udon - Braised Lamb Shoulder
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shoulder, cut into 6 chunks | 1/4 cup sake | 1/4 cup apple juice | 50 ml dry sherry | 1 cup double cream | cooked rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/450. In large shallow baking dish, mix the lamb with the sake and apple juice. Cover and marinate in the fridge for 1 hour. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium high heat. Lift the meat marinade out of the marinade, reserving the marinade. Cook for 6 minutes, then add the sherry and cream, stirring as you go until the cream has been nearly absorbed and the sauce slightly thickened. Preheat your broiler. Brush the lamb with sherry/cream mixture. Broil until the lamb is cooked.

title: Sirloin Focaccia
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless beef sirloin, trimmed of excess fat, cut into 1 1/2 in cubes | 1/2 cup brandy, i used a 50/50 pbr and 50/50 c brandy | 2 cans low-sodium low fat-free chicken broth | 1 1/2 unpeeled citrus peels, coarsely chopped ( i used only 2 ) | 5 -12 refrigerated but unpeeled biscotti
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and preheat oven to 375 degrees. Heat brandy in heavy large pot over medium high heat until almost evaporated, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in broth and lemon peel and bring to boil. Add meat and season with salt and pepper. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until meat is very tender, about 30 minutes.. Meanwhile, place biscotti on ungreased baking sheet and, using fingers or fork, prick each in 2 or 3 places with fork. Bake until golden, 12 to 15 minutes.. Meanwhile, warm brandied mixture over medium high heat until warm and reduced slightly, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir 1 cup hot beef broth into warmed brandy mixture and simmer until sauce is slightly reduced, 3 to 4 minutes. Spoon meat and sauce into baking dish and bake until puffed and golden brown, 14 to 16 minutes. Serve with biscotti.

title: Cousin Pete
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dried arborio rice | 4 lbs pork sausage or 4 lbs ground pork | 1 jar apricots, with juice ( optional ) | 8 teaspoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Cook the rice as directed by the package directions. When done, drain well. Cut the sausage in thick half down the center and break apart the meat with your hands, working quickly and evenly. Drain and put the meat back into the pot with the rice and apricots, if using. Add the vinegar, stir and bring to a boil. Cover and let simmer over lowest heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the meat is done.

Random Ingredients: brown gravy mix,yellow mustard,canola oil cooking spray,seasoning salt,eggplant,chipotle powder,sugar
title: Smoky Chipotle-Arib Bites
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 packet brown gravy mix | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 cup canola oil or 1/4 cup cooking spray | 3 -4 teaspoons chipotle powder ( depending on taste ) | 2 teaspoons yellow mustard ( or more, for the chipotle flavour )
instructions: Preheat oven to coat a cookie sheet with cooking spray. Arrange slices in a single layer in a single layer and spray each slice with cooking spray. Spray the eggplant lightly with cooking spray and place into oven. Bake about 45 minutes. It will be very tender. Use the same method as for the eggplant.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,provolone cheese,seasoning,fish sauce,red chili pepper,black pepper
title: Spicy Thai Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh sweet red chili peppers, minced or 2 tablespoons finely minced canned chili peppers | 1 teaspoon fish sauce or 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon cracked black pepper | 4 ounces shredded crisp provolone cheese ( about 2/3 cup ) or 4 ounces shredded thai pepperjack cheese ( about 2/3 cup )
instructions: Mix mayonnaise, chilies, fish sauce, seasoning and pepper in medium bowl to blend. Place 1 cheese slice on work surface. Spread sauce over cheese. Top with 1/2 cheese slice, pressing to seal if desired. Place remaining 2 cheese slices in bowl. Spoon on chilies mixture.

title: Black Beans Snack Mix
ingredients: 32 ounces dried black-eyed peas, washed | 35 fluid ounces herb flavored black tea
instructions: Follow package directions for dry black beans. Drain and allow to soak in 4 cups of hot water for 30 minutes. Combine peas and tea and store in airtight container.

title: Cauliflower and Snow Peas With Mango Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup catsup | 1 package cauliflower florets ( about 2 small heads ) | 12 whole canned mushrooms | 1/2 cup finely chopped mango | 1/2 cup toasted cracker crumb | 1 cup fresh snow pea, trimmed
instructions: Place catsup in small bowl. Add 1/4 cup water. Let stand 20 minutes. Add cauliflower and mushrooms. Toss lightly. Spoon cauliflower mixture into 8 or 9 inch glass pie dish. Top with mango sauce. Sprinkle crushed crumbs over dish. Broil until fragrant and starting to brown, about 5 minutes or so. Spoon remaining sauce over each serving.

title: Punjab Colcannon (Punjab Rice, Nuts, and Other Stuff)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter | 1/2 cup chopped fresh angelica ( optional )
instructions: Heat margarine on medium low heat, stirring constantly. Add remaining ingredients and stir together. This should be served warm or cold.

title: Tarragon and Mint Chicken Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 tablespoon tarragon, and basil seasoning blend | 1 tablespoon chinese rice wine | 2 teaspoons of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Place the chicken breasts between 2 sheets of wax paper or plastic wrap and pound with a meat pounder or other mallet until they are about 1/8 thick. Combine the tarragon and rice wine and add the chicken and marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour or up to 3 hours. Thread the chicken onto skewers and grill, turning frequently, until cooked through, about 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Sriracha Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces dry udon noodles | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 16 ounces spicy mild chunky salsa | 10 ounces kidney beans
instructions: Cook the udon noodles, uncovered, in boiling water until al dente.

title: Aebleskake (Kaseskake)
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, very finely chopped | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/3 cup milk | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 4 teaspoons fresh coriander or 4 teaspoons sage, finely minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f/190°c. Put the onion slices in a large, heavy bottomed, ovenproof frying pan. In a separate bowl, add the bread crumbs, milk, cream, and majoram or oregano. Beat with a fork or a spoon until well mixed. If needed, add a little extra milk, just a little more. Season the mixture with salt and pepper and cook over high heat, turning constantly, until the crumb mixture has turned a golden brown crust. The crumbs will have begun to stick to side when done. Be sure to keep stirring as the mixture begins to brown. Transfer to a serving platter and serve immediately. You can also transfer the cake mixture into an oiled baking dish, spread the sauce on top, and cover with foil. Bake in the middle of the oven for 30 - 40 minutes, making sure the liquid doesn't boil over.

title: Easy Mango Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin | 1/2 lb pork loin | 2 large mangoes or 2 medium mangoes, roughly cut | 2 teaspoons dried sage leaves | 1/4 cup mild hot sauce, such as sriracha
instructions: Cut up pork and add to crock pot. Wash and cut mango and add to crock pot. Squeeze out as much excess liquid as possible. Add all the other ingredients including the sage. Cook on low for 7 - 10 hours or high 3 - 4 hours. Serve over plain rice, or as a protein mixture.

title: Grainy Cracker Pasta
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 clove crushed graham cracker crumbs | 2 cups ice, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through yet firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Quick  Broccoli and Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 3 cups blanched broccoli | 1/2 cup coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese ( parmesan or other good pecorino regato ) | 1/4 cup cumin seed, crushed | 1/4 cup white mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Cut broccoli into bite sized pieces. Place broccoli in a bowl. Sprinkle with cheese, cumin and chopped mushrooms. Toss well.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,kosher salt black pepper,purpose flour,cardamom seed,rom tomato,cherry,plum tomato
title: Blueberry Salsa
