ingredients: 1 pint fresh blueberries | 2 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, diced | 1 medium plum tomato, diced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh green cherries | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place the fresh berries into a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let the berries soak in the refrigerator at least 30 minutes. Pour a cupful of blueberries into a food processor with the diced tomato, plum tomato, cherries, flour, cardamom seeds, and salt and pepper. Process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,coriander,coffee,ra el hanout spice mix,beer,dark brown sugar,italian seasoning
title: Moroccan Beer and Spice Smoked Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup brewed medium-strength coffee, cooled slightly and reserved | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 package shredded smoked turkey ( 1 1/2 ounces or reduced-fat ) | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 1/2 cups coarsely crushed tortilla chips ( 1.5 ounce or less ) | 2 teaspoons raita el hanout spice mix
instructions: In bowl of standing mixer fitted with paddle, combine coffee, corriander, brown sugar, turkey, tumeric and italian seasoning. Mix on low for 1 minute. Add tortilla chips, mix on low for another 5 minutes. Transfer to serving bowl.

title: Homemade Korean Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon minced garlic paste | 2 tablespoons freshly ground black pepper | 1 pound boneless beef chuck, trimmed of excess fat
instructions: Using 2 tablespoons of sesame seed and 2 tablespoons of minced garlic paste, spread a single layer on the grilling rack of the grill. Place the beef on the rack so that the heat is about 10 degrees f. Grill the beef until the outside is nicely browned and the most of the fat shows, 8 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with black pepper and drizzle with remaining sesame seed oil. Serve hot. Make sure that you have the grilling rack about 5 inches from the heat source as it produces smoke.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,tuna,tomato paste,macaroni,catsup,chicken breast half,liquid sweetener,salt black pepper
title: Simple Sweet Potato Caccitos
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked macaroni | 1 can tuna, drained and flaked | 1 cup fat free sour cream | 1/4 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons liquid sweetener | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 1/2 cups broccoli, chopped | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain and cool. Place the tuna, sour cream, catsup, liquid sweetener, tomato paste, and broccoli in a bowl. Toss lightly to coat.

title: Vegetable Satay
ingredients: 3 - 4 cups mixed veggies | 1 cup nuts ( any kind really ) | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 -2 tablespoon red chilies ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries
instructions: Grind nuts in grinder to fine consistency. In wok put peanut oil or other non stick frying pan, on high. Stir fry veggies until soft. Add rest of ingredients. Serve with satay.

title: Sailors' Tongues (Curried Spices)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cilantro, leaves picked from stems | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seed ( optional )
instructions: Soak the cilantro leaves in hot water until pliable, about 30 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: riesling wine,iceberg lettuce,parmesan cheese,pepper sauce,alfredo sauce,walnut
title: Quick Pasta Salad with Roasted Walnuts
ingredients: 8 ounces alfredo sauce | 1/3 cup riesling wine | 3/4 cup toasted walnuts | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed | 1 cup shaved parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine alfredo sauce, riesling wine, and walnuts in a 2 or 3 quart glass casserole dish. Cover and marinate for 1 - 5 hours in refrigerator. Cook lettuce until crisp. In medium bowl, combine lettuce with sauce. Serve topped with parmesan.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,sirloin tip roast,deli ham
title: Easy Crock Pot Pan-Fried Roast Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 -2 lb deli ham, sliced very thin ( i use oscar meyer )
instructions: Place roast in crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 9 hours. Turn it once or twice. Remove roast. Cut it up and place on serving platter. Add ham slices to meat. You can make a gravy like gravy or use as horseradish sauce. Enjoy with fresh bread.

title: Homemade Indian Seasoning
ingredients: 1 package ranch-style seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 slice bacon
instructions: In a small mixing bowl mix all the dry ingredients together until well blended. Pour over bacon and gently mix. Store leftovers in an air tight container.

Random Ingredients: pecan,white wine vinegar,spring onion,lime juice zest,serrano chilies,banana,aubergine
title: Grilled Aubergines (Eggplant) Salad
ingredients: 2 medium aubergines, cut in 1/4 inch rounds | 2 red fingerling bananas, sliced lengthwise | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 small bunch spring onion, sliced thinly into 2 inch lengths | 2 serrano chilies, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons pecans, toasted chopped | 2 tablespoons green white wine vinegar
instructions: Prepare the grill. Preheat the grill. Place the aubergines on a grill basket over a drip pan and grill until golden brown. When cool enough to handle, remove from the bag, slip off the skins and cut into slices. Brush the aubergines with lime juice and zest. Sprinkle with the spring onions, chilies and nuts. Pour over the dressing and toss. Serve with crusty bread slices.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,mango chutney,turmeric,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Moroccan Chocolate Chutney Dip (Vegan)
ingredients: 2/3 cup mango chutney ( korma brand mango chutney may also be used ) | 2/3 teaspoon turmeric | 1 1/2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix or 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/2 ounces semisweet chocolate ( coarsely grated )
instructions: In a food processor blend chutney with tumeric and chutney until smooth. Fold in chocolate. Serve on your favourite pita. Or for a sweeter dip, you can chill the dip in the fridge to serve cold.

title: Mexican Hominy With Mushrooms and Lettuce
ingredients: 3 cans hominy, drained | 1 lb cremini mushroom, sliced thin | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 lettuce leaf | 1/4 cup lettuce leaf, chopped fresh
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine hominy and mushrooms and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Set the lid slightly ajar and continue simmering for 5 minutes until the hominy mixture thickens. Remove from heat and set aside for 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Steamed Oysters for Two
ingredients: 4 steamed oysters | 2 -4 pieces beef tenderloin
instructions: Open the oysters and place in individual heatproof bowls. Drain the liquor and add the beef tenderloin. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside 10 - 15 minutes for the steaming. Remove the plastic wrap, place a clean kitchen towel between each shell and secure with a couple of skewers or toothpicks. Place under a hot grill for 3 - 5 minutes. To serve, remove the rolls from the steamer and serve on a bun.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,worcestershire sauce,anaheim chilies,baby carrot,orange zest,cherry tomato,salt,lasagna noodle
title: Chunky Corn Lasagna
ingredients: 14 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce ( or vegetarian worcestershire sauce ) | salt | 3 baby carrots | 1 small fresh anaheim chilies or 1 small jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes or 1/4 cup grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Butter 9 x13 baking dish. In a medium bowl mix worcestershire sauce, salt, carrots, onions, chilies, corn, tomato, and orange zest together. Spread half the corn mixture evenly in the bottom of a greased 13 by 9 in baking dish, arrange noodles over the top, and then sprinkle with remaining corn mixture. Bake, covered, for 45 minutes. Uncover and continue baking, covered, for 30 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: sugar,pimiento,liquid smoke,bay scallop,parsley sprig,red cabbage,fine breadcrumb,fennel bulb
title: Spicy Marinated Seafood
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bay scallops | 2 tablespoons finely chopped parsley sprigs | 1 tablespoon minced fennel bulb | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 tablespoons dry fine dry breadcrumbs | 6 -8 pimientos | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 1/2 cups chopped red cabbage | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Prepare a marinade recipe by mixing all of the ingredients together except the cabbage, sugar and liquid smoke in a bowl. Add the cabbage and toss thoroughly, to coat in the liquid. Marinate the seafood, preheat an oven to 450°f place the seafood on a foil lined baking sheet. Sprinkle the sugar over the top of the seafood. Bake in the oven, just until the seafood is opaque, about 8 - 10 minutes, depending on the thickness of the fish. Be careful not to overcook or the seafood will be tough. Spoon the cabbage over the top. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,white wine vinegar,hazelnut,hard egg,lamb shank,serrano chilies,ziti pasta
title: Chile Lamb and Macadamia Baked Ziti
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs ( or hard-boiled egg substitute ) | 2 serrano chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 14 ounces goat fat or 14 ounces cow fat | 2/3 cup hazelnuts, toasted and finely chopped | 1/2 cup good-quality dry white wine vinegar | 8 cloves garlic, chopped | 7 ounces ziti pasta or 7 ounces penne pasta
instructions: Melt the goat fat in a 2 - 4 qt ovenproof casserole, preferably cast iron. Fry the chopped chiles in the hot fat until they're soft and beginning to colour. Add the hazelnuts to the chiles in the oil. Pour the vinegar over, raise the heat to high and cook, stirring constantly, until the vinegar evaporates. Add the garlic and continue frying for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain the ziti, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Bring the pasta water to a boil and add it to the sauce. Stir the sauce vigorously. Reduce the heat to medium. Add the ziti to the sauce and cook, stirring until most of the water has evaporated. Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the nuts and egg substitute. Transfer to a warmed serving dish and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,swiss cheese,channa dal,sugar,dark chocolate,salt,french mustard,peach
title: French Peaches, Swiss Cheese and Peach Dip With Baked Mustard
ingredients: 6 large ripe peaches | 3 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 6 tablespoons channa dal | 1 teaspoon salt | 4 tablespoons french mustard | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, room temperature | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f. On the cookie sheet spread out the channellized peaches. Slice the peaches in half, stone them if desired. Arrange the whole peaches on the cookie sheet and bake until the edges of the peaches begin to brown a little, 3 - 5 minutes. Turn the peaches, slice the cheese and place them, cut side down, on the bottom of a baking dish. Spread the sargento five spice powder over the cheese. Spread the mustard over the mustard followed by the chopped chana dal and the salt. Pour the butter evenly over the mustard followed by the sugar. Place the peaches under the broiler and bake for 5 minutes or until the bottom of the peach is set. Turn over the cheese top, place the baking dish under the broiler and broil another 5 minutes or until the cheese is bubbly and golden, 3 - 5 minutes more.

title: Guajillo-Stuffed Chilies
ingredients: 8 fresh guajillo chilies ( or 3 or 4 regular ones ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter, softened | 1 cup light sour cream or 1 cup light yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla vodka
instructions: Prepare the slit open the chili pods lengthwise and place about 2 inches apart on non stick nonstick baking sheet. Broil until blackened and beginning to blister, stirring frequently for about 10 minutes, or until they soften a bit and blister. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Place chilies in a blender or food processor and add peanut butter, sour cream, and vanilla until well blended. Chill. To serve, cut open tops of chilies and remove seeds. Spoon mixture onto a plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,bok choy,dark soy sauce,shrimp,button mushroom,chili flake
title: Szechuan Fried Shrimp (Cantonese)
ingredients: 8 large shrimp, thawed and peeled ( shrimp can be substituted for � prawns ) | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 bok choy, cut into thin slices ( or substitute shiitake ) | 1 lb shrimp ( can substitute shrimp in syrup, if available, may substitute crab or shrimp ) | 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon chili flakes ( optional )
instructions: In a hot wok or large saucepan, stir fry the shrimp and mushrooms until the shrimp are pink and the mushrooms are tender, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir fry the bok choy until just wilted, about 3 more minutes. Add the pineapple juice, chili flakes and shrimp. Season to taste with salt and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,leaf thyme,snow pea,four cheese mexican,ladyfinger,head cauliflower,lime juice zest,filet beef
title: Filet of Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs filet of beef | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice, from 1 large lime | 2 teaspoons dried leaf thyme | 1 cup canned tomato sauce | 1/2 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 medium head snow peas, strings removed | 3 ounces fresh curly-leaf taco fixings or 3 ounces mexican blend shredded four cheese blend | 2 packages dry ladyfingers
instructions: In small bowl, mash together lime juice, lime zest and thyme with fork. Score 3/4 of the meat at 3/4 intervals, then insert 1/4 of the lime juice mixture into the center of the piece of meat with the knife or toothpick. Starting at one end, slice 2 1/2 wide strips from steak to make 1/2 wide strips. Insert 1/2 of the taco seasoning into 1 strip of steak. Starting at outside edge of steak, slice through the steak lengthwise into 1/4 of the wide strips, cutting at 1 1/2 intervals. Discard remaining taco seasoning. Cover beef with plastic wrap, pressing to remove excess moisture. Let steak sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. In a large dutch oven, pour tomato sauce and water over beef and bring to a boil. Add cauliflower and snow peas and cover. Cook over medium heat until just tender, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, in a 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish, spread meat with taco seasoning and arrange in a decorative pattern. Pour about 3/4 of tomato sauce mixture over the top, then sprinkle with about half of taco sauce mixture. Arrange ladyfingers on top of sauce and cover with remaining tomato sauce mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Bake covered at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until top is nicely browned.

title: Bitter (Chinese Egg Islands)
ingredients: 5 eggs | 1 can baked beans
instructions: Heat oven to 280 or when your finger reaches the center of the eggland it should start to feel set when the finger hits the yolk. Remove it and set aside. Combine the eggs, beans and bitters in a bowl and beat with a wire wisk until smooth. Turn the mixture into a roasting dish. Roast in the oven for 3 hours. Serve hot.

title: Baked  North American Ke Avocadoes
ingredients: 2 ripe hass avocadoes | 1/4 lb lean ground lamb | 1 can italian tomatoes ( or a small can of chopped tomatoes ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( to taste ) or 1/8-1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( to taste )
instructions: Mash avocados in a bowl with a fork til creamy and smooth. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f and grease 2 baking sheets. Mix lamb and tomatoes in a bowl, add hot pepper and cayenne if using. Mix well and spread 1/2 of meat mixture into each of the prepared baking pans. Sprinkle some of the avocado mixture on top of the meat mixture. Then top with remaining meat mixture. Bake 20 to 30 minutes. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,pepperoni,italian sausage,jicama,sugar snap pea,worcestershire sauce,pepper,walnut
title: Pepperoni Sausage and Nuts
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 lb hot italian sausage ( may use mild, more spice if desired ) | 1 package pepperoni | 1 bag frozen pepperoni | 1 bag frozen italian cheese blend | 1 bag frozen sugar snap peas | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chopped walnuts | 2 -3 tablespoons dried mexican spices ( may use fresh, to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Slice sausages into 1/4 inch rounds with a knife. Cook sausage links and cut off ends of links. Remove casing and add to sauce pan over low heat. Slice pepperoni into 1/4 cubes. Mix all meat together, and cook and stir. Drain. Set aside. Cut frozen peppers into bite size pieces. Remove the stems and seeds. Cut each pepper into 1 inch squares while the sausage is cooking. In a medium sized mixing bowl, combine the first four ingredients. Layer the sausage mixture and the pepperoni on top of the pepperoni, and then top the mixture with the cheese mixture. Sprinkle the walnuts over mixture. Place in a 375f degree oven for 20 minutes, and remove from oven once it has melted. Note, sometimes i sprinkle some dried mexican spices over the top in this dish.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,beef sirloin steak,coconut milk,hoisin sauce,yogurt,topping,phyllo dough
title: Bola Mee
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 3 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons hoisin sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 pound beef sirloin steaks, thinly sliced | 12 sheets phyllo dough | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fresh goat cheese, divided
instructions: Pour coconut milk into a small bowl, and stir in yogurt, hoisin sauce, turmeric, and 1/2 cup of the beef broth from the can into the coconut milk. Set aside. Layer 3 sheets of phyllo dough in a separate small layer on a flat surface, and cover with a damp cloth. Place a second sheet on top, and then cover this with damp cloth. Set a third sheet of phyllo on top, and cover with a damp cloth. Set a fourth sheet of phyllo on top. Cut phyllo into strips that are 2 inches wide. Place a strip of phyllo into each of four soup bowls, and cover with 1/2 cup of beef broth from the can. Bring 5 cups of water to a boil in a medium pot, and stir in 1 tablespoon salt. Working with 3 phyllo at a time, brush 3 or 4 sheets of phyllo with water, and lay it over the boiling water. Boil for about 3 minutes, then remove with a slotted spoon, and stack them on a plate covered with a towel. Repeat until all nine sheets have been layered in the bowls. Place a generous 1/2 cup of shredded beef on top of each phyllo stack, and spread evenly, to seal in the beef. Repeat until all three stacks have been used.

title: Artichoke Stuffed With Mustard and Paprika
ingredients: 12 artichokes, cleaned and outer leaves removed | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1 pinch paprika | 2 teaspoons red fat or 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon coarse grain mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Wash the artichoke and dry with paper towels. Place artichokes in roasting pan. Place the red onion around artichoke slices. Sprinkle paprika over all. Combine the oil and mustard powder. Drizzle over the artichokes. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Skirt Steak Rub
ingredients: 5 -6 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 tablespoon fresh savory, chopped
instructions: Rub all over steak and allow to sit about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with savory and grill until desired degree of doneness is achieved.

title: Ginger Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 1 1/2 teaspoons cooking spray | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, minced
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. Spread oil on an oven proof serving platter. Sprinkle the ginger over oil. Use a knife to spread the ginger in an even layer over the top of the oil. Roast, uncovered, for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve with bread, vegetable sticks, raisins, etc.

title: Red Beans Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 cup dried red beans ( i use white or yellow ) | 1/2 cup white flour or 1/2 cup rice flour | 2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: Rinse the beans and cover them with cold water.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,mexican cheese,sage leaf,cucumber lengthwise,chervil,garlic powder
title: Mexican Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces mexican cheese | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 12 -15 sage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon mexican blend cheese ( or mozzarella cheese ) | 1 teaspoon dried chervil ( or to taste )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir 1 tablespoon of garlic powder and both tablespoons of caster sugar until the sugar is dissolved. Pour into a hot griddle or frying pan. Quickly stir with a fork. Cook on both sides. Remove griddle from stove. Use the remaining garlic powder for a few more minutes to coat griddle. You might have to do this in batches. Cut cheese into 1/4 slices and arrange on the griddle. Sprinkle with chervil, salt and freshly ground black pepper. Cover griddle and cook on low heat 4 - 5 minutes or until cheese is brown and melted. Cut in half, spread with a pastry brush, brush on melted cheese and fold half, spread on top and sides of other. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,pesto sauce,half,udon noodle,graham cracker crumb,bacon,soy sauce
title: German Salad
ingredients: 1 package crumbled or shredded dark udon noodles | 3 slices bacon | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 1/2 cups shredded red cabbage | 1/3 cup plain graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, omitting fat and fat. Stir bacon, half and half, pesto, and soy sauce together in a large bowl. Add cabbage, and toss to coat. Place noodle mixture into the bottom of a greased, microwave safe dish, pressing noodles slightly. Drizzle on pesto. Sprinkle with graham crackers. Cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high power for 2 minutes. Flip, cover the dish, and microwave an additional 3 to 5 more minutes to brown crisp cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Sweet Chile
ingredients: 1 pound red chile peppers | 1 cup marsala
instructions: Heat grill for direct heat. Wrap the peppers in aluminum foil and place on the grill. Cook 5 minutes on each side, or to desired tenderness, brushing with marsala as desired.

title: Sticky Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 beef tenderloin
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees f. Brush surface of tenderloin with cayenne. Place tenderloin on rack in broiler pan, fat side up. Roast in deep pan 15 minutes, basting once with pan juices.

title: Kathyama Beef & Rice
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef | 200 g fresh green grapes, halved | 400 g rice ( khaboos ) | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | pepper
instructions: Cube stewing beef into small pieces and cook in large pot with a little water until meat is almost cooked. While meat is cooking add fenugreek and pepper to meat and cook 1 minute more with little water. Then add rice and mix, cooking until rice starts to stick to the bottom. Add green grapes and mix thoroughly. Place lid on pot and let stew simmer till meat starts to stick to the bottom of stew. Turn heat to lowest setting and let stew continue boiling for 2 hours. Serve with flatbread, chapatis or flat breads. Also great with plain yogurt and lemon wedges to dip a spoon into.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,alfalfa sprout,butter,cream cheese spread
title: Nacho Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese spread | 1 package alfalfa sprouts, washed and drained | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Place cheese saucemaker into the food processor. Add the cream cheese spread to it. Add enough water to get a spreadable consistency, mix well. Microwave for 30 seconds or so stir it continuously until it is thick enough to spread on tortilla. Spread on your favorite hot roll. Top with colby cheese. Serve topped with sour cream, lettuce, tomato, salsa, etc. Enjoy.

title: Aquagrill's Cayenne Kaffir Lime Salt
ingredients: 4 kaffir lime leaves, leaves from an 8-oz bunch, rinsed of water drained and chopped ( can also use fresh limes ) | 2 teaspoons coarse salt
instructions: Pour lime leaves into mixing bowl, and cover with a cupful of ice. Let sit for about 15 minutes, shaking a few times to get all the kaffir lime leaves out. Strain lime mixture through a colander through a coffee filter lined with cheesecloth. Squeeze lime juice to get all the juice from the kaffir lime leaves, discard lumps. Measure juice and measure 2 teaspoons for each lime. Transfer juice mixture to bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, stirring once or twice. Note, an 8 to 10 oz jar will work, but it's likely that you will have to shake a few of the limes, because the ice freezes. After straining the lime mixture, pack it in to the jar, covering the top. Seal jar tightly, and refrigerate for up to two weeks before using.

Random Ingredients: pecan nut,yellow pepper,onion,plain yogurt,baby spinach,focaccia bread
title: Spinach Peppers and Cheese Grilled Bread
ingredients: 4 large yellow peppers, cored, seeded and halved | 1 lb fresh baby spinach | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 1/2 cups crumbled pecan nuts or 2 1/2 cups pecan nuts, lightly toasted | 1 1/2 lbs thick-grain focaccia bread | 1 large sweet onion, halved, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat grill. Remove stems from peppers, cut in half lengthwise, devein halves, then cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Place on a foil lined broiler pan. Place under broiler, skin side up. Broil about 3 from heat for 3 to 4 minutes or until browned, turning once. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine spinach and remaining ingredients, tossing to blend. Spread spinach mixture over bread halves. Preheat grill to high. Place bread on grill 3 to 4 inches from heat. Grill, bread side down, for 3 to 5 minutes until lightly browned. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,tarragon,jerk sauce,green bean,jalapeno jack cheese
title: Jerk Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, trimmed of tips with 2 inches of the stalk on each | 6 ounces shredded jalapeno jack cheese | 2 tablespoons coconut cream | 1 dash of prepared jerk sauce | 4 dashes tarragon, to taste
instructions: Cook beans to desired tenderness. Sprinkle with cheese. Sprinkle with jerk sauce. Garnish with tarragon.

title: Traditional Miso Soup Base
ingredients: 6 cups dashi kombu ( dried kombu ) | 2 cans rotel diced tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups instant dashi kombu ( fish sauce )
instructions: To prepare instant dashi using 2 cups of water dilute the kombu with about 1 tablespoon of kombu soaking liquid. Dashi can be boiled, dissolved in 2 cups of water and boiled, then refrigerate until needed. When kombu has dissolved, dilute with 1 1/2 to 2 cups of water. Add rotel and stir. Add instant dashi to taste. This is not a great miso soup though.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,baby spinach,rye flour,chili powder,pecan,vodka,hash brown potato
title: Potato, Spinach, and Pecan Pierogies
ingredients: 1 bag frozen hash brown potatoes | 1 bag fresh baby spinach | 1/2 cup roughly chopped pecans | 1 cup rye flour | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 cup vodka, chilled
instructions: To make potato pierogies, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add potatoes, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and allow to cool completely. Wash spinach well, remove and discard tough stems, and finely chop spinach. Place spinach in a colander, and squeeze out excess water. Drain potatoes, return potatoes to pot, and mash with a potato masher until smooth. Gently mix in pecans and rye flour, then mix in chili powder, salt, and pepper. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Divide spinach mixture into 4 equal portions. Flatten spinach into disks about 2 1/2 inches in diameter. Place about 1 tablespoonful of spinach mixture onto center of each disk, and sprinkle the top with some of the paprika mixture. Roll disks around the filling, and press edges together with fingers. To make a half moon, place a disk on a flat work surface, and pinch edges together with fingers. Repeat with remaining disks. Brush tops of pierogies with a little vodka or olive oil. Cut into wedges, and transfer wedges to baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until crispy and golden brown, about 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Yummy and Fudgy English Chicken
ingredients: 8 ounces yeast | 2 tablespoons pomegranate syrup, plus extra | pomegranate syrup | 2 cups cooked chicken, cut into 3/4 inch dice | 1 1/4 cups mixed nuts, such as cashew nuts, almonds, pistachios, pecans, almonds, hazelnuts or cashew nuts | 1/2 cup red onion, chopped | 1/2 red sweet pepper, finely chopped | 8 cherries, quartered if liked
instructions: Dissolve the yeast with the pomegranate syrup in a large mixing bowl and set aside for about 5 minutes to bubble. Put the chicken, nuts, onion and sweet pepper into a large bowl. Using an electric mixer on high speed, gradually add the yeast to the mixture and beat until the chicken pieces are completely coated. Stir in the pomegranate syrup and mix on high for about 2 minutes, then turn the mixer down to low and leave the mixture to stand for about 30 minutes. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead it briefly until smooth, adding a little more pomegranate syrup if necessary. Lightly oil a bowl and cover the dough with a kitchen towel. Leave in a warm place until doubled in size. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead briefly again until the dough is elastic and smooth. Divide the dough into 16 portions, cover with a kitchen towel, and let rest in a warm place. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Divide the dough equally into 4 portions and shape into rolls about 3/4 inch in diameter. Place them on a lightly greased cookie sheet, spacing them well apart on the tray. Use the heels of the hands to flatten the dough slightly, and make indentations in the dough with your fingers if necessary. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove them from the oven, cut through the top bun, and serve warm with pomegranate syrup.

title: Spicy Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cashews | 1 long red chilies or 1 long green chilies
instructions: Toast cashewnuts either by the side of a cast iron or heavy based pan. Grind them until they are a fine powder. Pour the ground cashewnuts into a bowl. Take a heavy based pan, pour water and a tbsp. Of oil in it. Once the water comes to a boil, add the red chillies and allow to cook. Remove from heat. Sprinkle the ground green chillies over it. Garnish it with cashews. Serve imediately with your preferred breads.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,palm sugar,plain yogurt,white sugar,greek yogurt,coriander powder
title: Yogurt Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 cup white sugar, divided | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon palm sugar | spaghetti
instructions: Sauce, mix 1/2 cup of sugar, greek yogurt, plain yogurt, coriander and palm sugar. Set aside. Boil spaghetti or other pasta al dente. Drain. Mix into a sauce. Spoon onto plate.

title: Moroccan Burritoes
ingredients: 1/2 lb walnuts | 10 tortillas | olive oil ( to coat pan )
instructions: Cut the walnuts in half and set aside for a few minutes. Remove the husk and break up fine. You can do this with a mortar and pestle or you can do it by hand. Grind walnuts till fine. Brush oil on the tortillas and put a large scoop of walnut in center of it. Fold it over and roll in the nuts as you would burritos. Place on frying pan. Pour olive oil in the pan. Heat until it simmers. When it is almost ready, fry burritos in it. It should turn a little brown. You really don't want it to color, unless you put on one tortilla, it will. Let it sit for a few seconds on a plate while you fry the other.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,napa cabbage,dark brown sugar,green chile
title: Chinese Nappa Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground chicken wings | 2 bunches napa cabbage, cored and julienned | 8 ounces chopped green chiles | 1 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. In a large skillet over medium high heat, combine the ground chicken and napa cabbage. Cook and stir until the cabbage is softened, about 10 minutes. Place the green chiles in a small bowl and pour enough water over them to cover. Stir in the brown sugar and season with salt if desired. Fill the napa cabbage rolls with the chicken mixture.

title: Couscous for Zucchini, Onions, and Eggs
ingredients: 8 tablespoons couscous | 4 large egg yolks, beaten
instructions: Place couscous in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Place a strainer over another bowl and place a plate over the bowl. Pour a little cold water into bowl and set aside. Place egg yolks in bowl and beat until smooth and creamy. Turn off the oven and leave bowl in oven. Pour egg yolks mixture over couscous and stir in a little cold water until custard is absorbed. Pour into a serving bowl and set aside to cool, about 10 minutes. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,cayenne pepper,bay scallop,milk ricotta cheese,red bell pepper
title: Scallops in a Tomato Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 bay scallop, cooked and cut in half | 2 cans evaporated milk ricotta cheese, drained & shaken | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries, halved | 2 tablespoons red bell peppers, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and allow it to sit, covered, in the refrigator overnight. Before serving, serve with pasta of your choice.

title: Mexican White Cheese Spread
ingredients: 4 tablespoons white sugar | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 1 package shredded mexican cheese
instructions: Combine sugar, mustard powder, and garlic. Mixture will make lumpy. Sprinkle mixture over cheese before adding remaining ingredients. Refridgerate 3 hours. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,rosemary leaf,southern hash brown potato,teriyaki sauce,pork chop,flour tortilla
title: Teriyaki Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chop ( i use boneless pork chops ) | 2 teaspoons flour tortillas | 2 teaspoons light teriyaki sauce | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 3/4 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1 1/2 cups southern style hash brown potatoes
instructions: Brush meat with teriyaki sauce and sprinkle with baking soda and rosemary. Grill or broil, brushing with sauce, until desired doneness, about 10 minutes. Serve with hashbrowns.

title: Spinach with Ground Cumin
ingredients: 1 jar baby spinach, rinsed and drained | 1 cube chicken bouillon powder | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: Place the spinach, bouillon, and cumin into a microwave safe bowl. Heat in the microwave until the spinach is well wilted, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,chipotle chile,chunky peanut butter,heavy cream,rice wine,pearl barley,sea scallop
title: Spicy Peanut Barley Seafood Soup
ingredients: 2 chipotle chiles, chopped | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 4 cups heavy cream | 1/4 cup rice wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1 1/2 lbs medium sea scallops, thawed | 1/3 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/2 cup chunky peanut sauce or 1/2 cup chunky peanut sauce
instructions: Pound the chipotle chiles with a mortar and pestle or meat tenderizer until a fine paste forms. Mix the chunky peanut butter into the cream and whisk until smooth. In a large saucepan, bring the cream to a boil. Add the rice wine and chili sauce to a steady boil, whisking constantly. Add the scallops, return to a boil and then cover to keep hot. When ready to serve, spoon the hot soup into bowls, garnish with the crispy peanut sauce and serve.

title: Garlicky Oil (And Oil) Dip for Chips
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, coarsely chopped | 1 pinch dried red pepper flakes | 1 - 1 1/2 cup oil ( for frying, or use any good flavored oil you like, such as sunflower oil )
instructions: In a medium bowl, add all ingredients. Mix briskly with spoon or fork, breaking up chips with back of spoon or your fingers to make them into a uniform, uniformly sized dip. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and chill at least for 30 minutes, or until thoroughly cold. Keep refrigerated.

title: Rhubarb Turnip Pudding
ingredients: 1 lb turnip, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch dice for turnips that don't need to peel when peeled | 1 lb rhubarb, stems removed and cut into 1/4 inch dice for turnips that don't need to peel | 1 red pepper, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup garam masala
instructions: Place vegetables in casserole dish. Add chick pea flour mixed with cold water, about half a cup, or enough to make a very sticky batter of pouring consistency but not too thick.. Pour batter over vegetables. Stir. Sprinkle with garam masala. Bake in preheated 350f oven 45 to 60 minutes until top is lightly browned.

title: Green Chile Scones Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1 can diced green chiles, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease cookie sheets or line with parchment paper. In a large bowl, sift together the flour and green chilies. Gently stir in the green chilies. Drop scones by rounded tablespoon in a half inch circle onto the prepared cookie sheets. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until golden. Cool on cookie sheets for 2 minutes on the pans, then remove to wire racks to cool completely. Store in a cool dry place.

title: Beef Vindaloo
ingredients: 600 g filet of beef, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 100 ml chopped fresh basil | 1 teaspoon dried apricot jam or 1 teaspoon sunflower seed paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper | salt and black pepper | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla
instructions: Season the beef with salt, black pepper and a little water, place onto a hotplate and cook for 3 minutes each side until browned and cooked through. To make the vindaloo, heat the yoghurt and stir over a low heat until the yoghurt has dissolved. Stir in the basil, apricot jam, pepper and vanilla and serve with beef, rice or bread.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,cooking apple,italian tomato,poultry seasoning,egg substitute,beef,pastry shell,salmon
title: Baked Norwegian Meatball (Kartoflu Karry)
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced meat and poultry seasoning | 1 small cooking apple | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 cup quick-cooking apple ( grated ) | 1 1/2 cups dry-roasted wild pacific salmon ( diced ) | 1 package pastry shells
instructions: Add meat, poultry seasoning, grated apple, egg substitute, turmeric powder and poultry seasoning. Mix lightly together with pastry tips until completely mixed. Place in pan. Top with diced pacific salmon. Bake at 400°f for 40 minutes. Serve and enjoy.

title: Coriander Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, ground | 2 cups long grain rice ( arborio, carnaroli, or risso )
instructions: Wash the coriander in cold water to remove any sand or sand particles. Heat the coriander over medium heat until it begins to crackle. Pour the ground coriander into a shallow bowl. Put the rice in the bowl and use your hands to rub the rice with your hands. The rice can be used right away or put in the refrigerator until needed.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,self raising flour,grainy mustard,yellow pear tomato,lime juice zest,vanilla,crawfish tail
title: Mile High Pub Grilled Crab Dogs With Tomato and Fresh Lime Relish
ingredients: 4 tablespoons self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons yellow ripe pear tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon lime juice, zest of | tabasco sauce | 300 g crawfish tails, drained and well-trimmed | 1 teaspoon light grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Combine flour, tomatoes, lime rind and pepper in a large bowl. Stir in parsley. Add drained crawfish tails, mustard and vanilla. Using a teaspoon, gently stir together, until well mixed. Spoon into lightly greased ovenproof dishes. Cook under medium grill about 6 minutes for medium or until the seafood is cooked and the shrimp turns pink. Serve immediately. Store in fridge, covered tightly, for up to 3 days.

title: Lebanese Peppers
ingredients: 1 large green bell pepper | lemon wedge ( for garnish )
instructions: Roast green bell pepper for about 5 minutes, or until very soft. Test the skin by placing a sharp knife on an opening. If the knife is removed, the pepper will not be roasted. Remove skin and discard. Place pepper in a bowl and cover with water. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Drain peppers and discard the water. Place the peppers in a serving dish skin side up. Garnish with lemon wedge.

title: Green Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine or 1/2 cup water | 1 jar sliced green bell peppers | 1/2 cup finely minced habanero pepper
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium low heat, combine white wine and green pepper. Cook and stir 5 minutes or until heated through and slightly reduced. Add the peppers and the jalapeno.

title: Sweet Chili Jam (Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup cherry syrup ( not syrup liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon capers, chopped | 2 teaspoons dried leaf thyme, crushed | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small pot. Simmer until the sugar starts to melt. Remove from heat and cool completely before adding to the hot jam.

Random Ingredients: eggnog,chinese five spice powder,turbinado sugar,macadamia nut
title: Macadamia Nut Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup turbinado sugar | 1/2 cup macadamia nuts, sliced, toasted, peeled ( about 15 ) | 2 tablespoons chinese five-spice powder, divided | 1 eggnog
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small skillet, whisk 3 tablespoons sugar and 1 tablespoon macadamia nuts until well combined and sugar is brown. Transfer mixture to a bowl and stir remaining 1 tbsp sugar mixture. Spread remaining 1 tablespoon sugar mixture evenly over skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown. Add 5 spice and cook, stirring, 1 minute. Stir in nut mixture and cooked eggnog.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,orange juice,self raising flour,splenda sugar substitute
title: Orange Spritz Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1 cup sifted self raising flour | 1 cup orange juice, approx
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cream together shortening, sugar, and flour. Place in a lightly greased tray. Spread enough fruit juice or ice water to give a dough a glaze consistency. Refrigerate overnight. Roll dough balls to small diameter and cut out into desired shapes with cookie cutters, or with a knife. Bake on ungreased cookie sheets 5 to 6 minutes until they have just lightly browned. Allow to cool slightly on cookie sheet before transferring.

title: Rump Roast - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 teaspoons gingerroot, grated | 4 bone-in skin-on beef roast | 10 fluid ounces tomato puree | 2 -3 tablespoons lime zest | 4 large boneless chicken thighs or 4 chicken drumsticks, cooked from fat and chicken
instructions: Sprinkle gingerroot and 1/2 the tomato puree over the roast. Add the 2 tablespoons of lime zest and juice. Stir well to combine. Cover with non metallic clingfilm and leave to marinate for 6 to 8 hours for the flavours to develop. Remove the beef from the marinade and pat dry. Tie the remaining tomato puree and lime zest in a piece of cheesecloth about 4 cm wide and 12 cm long. Seal and put in the crockpot. Mix remaining tomato puree, remaining lime zest, and remaining tomato puree. Pour over the meat. Turn to coat. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. Remove the meat from the crockpot and keep warm. Skim off excess fat and cook over medium heat for a further 20 minutes or until the meat is tender. Serve with salad leaves. Note, can also be served with rice and other salad ingredients.

title: Margarita Meat Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup tequila ( a cuban condiment ) | 1 loaf focaccia bread or 1 loaf sandwich buns | 1/2 cup icing sugar
instructions: Chop beef and brown in a frying pan with the mayonnaise and tequila. Mix well and serve on hamburger buns with the crusty bread or sandwich rolls. Sprinkle with the icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,cannellini bean,portabella mushroom,star anise,cumin powder,cumin
title: Portabella and Mushrooms in Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 10 ounces portabella mushrooms, cleaned cleaned and caps cut into pieces | 1 star anise, peeled and smashed | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/4 cup canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat oil in a non stick pan on medium high heat. Add portabello pieces and saute until golden brown. Remove. Add spices and saute about 2 minutes. Add mushrooms and saute for 2 to 3 minutes or until slightly brown. Add beans and cook for 5 minutes. Serve hot with plain steamed white rice.

title: Spicy Fish Skewers (Skewers)
ingredients: 4 fish fillets, firm ( sirloin or snapper ) | 500 ml good quality hot chinese chili sauce, good quality | 1 tablespoon ghee | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 tablespoons of natural nutella, creamy ( sambal oelek )
instructions: First, mix the hot chinese chili sauce and oil, add the fish in 2/3 cup portions. Then skewer the fish with toothpick sticks and skewer it about 2/3 cm deep. Then, brush oil onto each side of the fish. Next, rub some sambal olek/natural nutella on your fish. Then, grill, bbq or barbeque your fish until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,beef bouillon,almond extract,lettuce leaf,cilantro stem,pecan,yogurt,cinnamon sugar
title: Mexican-Style Beef Salad With Cinnamon Sugar
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecans, toasted, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems | 1/4 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, trimmed of fat, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons triple sec or 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1 large cinnamon stick | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | lettuce leaf
instructions: In a medium skillet, toast pecans over medium heat, stirring frequently, until golden brown and fragrant, about 7 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. Sprinkle cilantro with almonds on a small plate. Top with almonds. In a nonstick skillet, heat 1 1/2 tspps. Flour over med hi heat, stirring constantly, until it begins to turn brown and smells fragrant, about a minute or two. Add the beef strips to the hot oil and saute until browned, no longer pink and cooked through, 5 - 7 minutes. Remove from heat and transfer to a plate. Add sour cream to skillet and stir to dissolve sour cream. Stir in triple sec, cinnamon stick, and almond extract and heat at a strong zest of 1/2 tspps. Stir often to loosen pan from caramelized bits on the bottom of the pan. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. To serve, arrange salad on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: white bread,rice flour,egg white,creamy peanut butter,adobo sauce,cilantro leaf,red bell pepper
title: Spicy Spicy Peanut Butter Rice Bread (Sopa De Peperoncino)
ingredients: 2 cups creamy peanut butter | 2 eggs | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup adobo sauce, from the can of chipotles in adobo sauce | 3 cups white rice flour | 3 egg whites | 1 red bell pepper, thinly sliced | 3 -4 cups crispy white bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In the bowl of a stand mixer, beat peanut butter for 2 minutes on low, until smooth. Add eggs and cilantro.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,onion soup mix,oyster sauce,water chestnut,parsnip,pepperoni,lettuce leaf,scallion
title: Pepperoni Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 large parsnip ( large ) | 1 1/2 lbs lettuce leaves | 4 scallions | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 tablespoon dried onion soup mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 2 cups crushed ice cubes
instructions: Cut parsnip in half lengthwise.

title: Yum Yum Salad
ingredients: 250 g jumbo shrimp, cleaned ( peeled or uncooked ) | 200 g bean sprouts, washed and drained | 150 g natural yoghurt | 1/3 cup salad dressing ( or to taste ) | 3 tablespoons walnuts, chopped | 1/2 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Devein and devein the shrimp. In a large bowl, mix the shrimp with the yoghurt and walnuts. Pour dressing over the salad and mix well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,bread crumb,celery salt,marsala wine,lemon,tomato puree
title: Italian Style Meat Pies
ingredients: 4 cups cubed, cooked meat | 6 tablespoons marsala wine | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon vegetable sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 2 1/2 tablespoons tomato puree
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Form into 6 patties. To cook in a medium hot skillet, brown pattys quickly on each side several minutes to seal. Reduce heat and cook slowly until no longer pink inside.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin pie spice,corn kernel,cashew,beefsteak tomato,beef consomme,vanilla bean,ginger paste
title: Beef, Tomato and Pumpkin Curry
ingredients: 5 beefsteak tomatoes, chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh ginger paste | 3 tablespoons pumpkin pie spice | 1 can condensed beef consomme | 1 cup corn kernel | 1/2 cup cashews, coarsely chopped | 1 vanilla bean, cut lengthwise in half seeds scraped out
instructions: In a medium, heavy saucepan, stir together the tomatoes, ginger paste and pumpkin pie spice. Over medium heat, heat the consomme, corn, cashews and sliced vanilla bean until warmed through.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,white vinegar,burgundy wine,pork tenderloin,grand marnier,creole seasoning,beef sirloin steak,savory
title: Chili Beef Steak With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 2 beef sirloin steaks, sliced thin | 6 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 6 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1/2 cup burgundy wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh savory | 1 tablespoon steak seasoning | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: Peanut sauce, combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Allow to cool slightly so sauce will cling to meat better. Peanut sauce can be kept refrigerated in a tightly sealed container for up to 3 days.

title: Clams for Two (Clams Con Tom Yum)
ingredients: 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 3 cans kidney beans, drained ( black beans ) | 1/3 cup tequila
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the sugar, salt, beans, tequila, 1/4 cup water, and 1/2 cup water. Over medium heat, stir until sugar is dissolved. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for one minute. Remove from the heat and leave to stand for 5 minutes, or until syrup is thickened if stored in the fridge.

title: Filipino-Brazilian Pork Skewers
ingredients: 4 pieces pork fillets, cut into thin sticks | 2 cups coconut milk
instructions: Place pork onto a flat surface. Spread the coconut milk into a bowl. Soak the pork in salt water for 5 minutes. Drain water well. Thread the pork onto the wooden skewers. Heat a heavy skillet over high heat. When it is hot, pour 1 cup of coconut milk into the skillet. Cook and stir the pork until it turns a dark brown color, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat to a serving platter lined with a damp paper towel to drain excess coconut milk. Serve the pork skewers hot. My note, i did not purchase any pork satay, but just used leftover meat from our grill. The coconut milk is a must for this and you really can't go wrong. I served the skewers with this sticky rice. I loved the suggestion of using piquillo peppers. I served these skewers with black beans instead of the green peppers. I would prefer to use the full 1 cup of coconut milk and use a coconut milk called coco lopez which is good for this recipe. The pineapple flavour was good and so refreshing. It was also good and so easy to cut into squares and serve cold. This is a very sticky fish so use the coconut milk that you didn't use for the meat. I used 5 spice for the spiciness of the pork and used 1/2 the spiciness of the pork for the coconut milk and 1/2 the spiciness of the coconut milk for the paprika. This is another recipe that will go well with fish, chicken, beef, shrimp, or shrimp. I served them over a red pepper flake in a hot bowl and they were delicious. The next day, i took a couple of steps. One of the steps i did next was to get rid of any excess coconut water and then i dipped the pieces of pork into the coconut milk. The first time i dipped the pieces the coconut meat was great. The second time after, i added the coconut oil. I had to dip each piece of pork in so the meat won't stick to the coconut milk/oil solution. I also coated the meat with paprika and browned it on each side. I took the advice of using a cast iron skillet which would make the meat soak up all the coconut milk better. The meat tasted better and then the coconut tasted a bit dry for my taste. The next day, i added 1/4 cup of chopped up julienned red peppers.

title: Rye Bread (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 lb rye bread, stale | 1 pint rye bread, slightly stale
instructions: Put the rye bread in the bread machine on setting 1st, then 2nd, and let rest for 1 hour to get a really hard crust. Preheat oven to 425°f. When it's ready, remove bread from bread maker and shape into a circle about 1/2'' thick. Slide a sharp knife around the edge of the circle and then, using a spatula, slice it in half across and across the circle. Repeat as many times as the bread machine goes and cut more slices into the circle, if desired. Spread bread, crust sides and top with rye bread. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until bread sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.

title: Italian Flag and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 4 medium ripe tomatoes | 1/2 cup peas, fresh | 1/4 cup amaretto | 4 oranges
instructions: Cut 1 orange in half and peel all the yolks. Place all ingredients on a plate and drizzle with the amaretto. Garnish with additional amaretto.

Random Ingredients: clove,head iceberg lettuce,sharp cheddar cheese,monterey jack cheese,shrimp,tomato puree,lemongrass,rosemary
title: Shrimp and Corn Chowder
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh rosemary | 1 head iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1 pound shrimp - peeled, deveined, and cut into bite-size pieces | 3 cans petite-size | 2 tablespoons lemon grass, finely chopped, or more to taste | 4 ounces chopped sharp cheddar cheese | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup tomato puree, or as desired
instructions: In a large stock pot, place the chopped rosemary and iceberg lettuce. Place shrimp in the pot, and allow the shrimp to warm up and the lettuce to wilt. When the shrimp are heated through, stir in lemon grass, cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, and tomato puree. Serve immediately.

title: Asparagus Wrapped in Provolone
ingredients: 3 lbs asparagus | 2 ounces butter | 6 large slices provolone cheese | icing sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Wash the asparagus and cut off and woody stems. Place a steamer basket into a saucepan of salted water and bring it to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes, then remove the basket and let it drain under cold running water. Drain the asparagus. Remove the tough bottom parts and break off the tips of the asparagus, reserving any cooking water. Place the asparagus in a baking basket or large oven proof dish. Melt the butter in a small heavy saucepan over low heat and cook for 3 minutes, or until slightly browned and fragrant. Carefully add the asparagus and cheese and stir to coat evenly with the butter. Bake in the preheated oven until the bread is golden and crisp, about 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 2 cups tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon horseradish | 3/4 cup shredded provolone cheese | 2 cups chopped cooked clam ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Stir quinoa, tomatoes and green chilies, horseradish, cheese and clam into 2 1/2 to 3 quart baking dish. Bake 25 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Hot Eggnog
ingredients: 2 cups eggnog | 1 teaspoon black vinegar | 1 teaspoon spice ( mixed spice ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients with ice.

Random Ingredients: matzo meal,green cardamom pod,sherry wine,blueberry,chicken breast half,baking potato,rice wine,beef chuck
title: Quick Beef Ganda
ingredients: 1/3 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup rice wine | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh beef or 2 tablespoons lamb, minced | 5 green cardamom pods | 1/2 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup red cooked ground beef or 1 cup leftover ground cooked beef, chopped | 1 jar large clusters of sliced butternut squash or ( 16 ounce ) jar grape-shaped baking potatoes, well drained | 1/3 cup matzo meal, sifted if necessary
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a medium bowl and marinate beef at least 3 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Add beef and marinade and toss to coat. Arrange potatoes in an 8x8 inch glass baking dish. Arrange meat in one layer over potato layer, beginning and ending with potatoes, brushing between each layer with a small amount of the cooking liquid. Bake at 350f degrees f for 30 to 35 minutes, or until potatoes are golden and crusty on top. Combine matzo meal and matzo meal.

title: Pommes De Coco (Potato Pancakes)
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes | 4 limes, zest of, grated | 1 tablespoon coconut flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400° fahrenheit. Peel the potatoes and cut into 4cm chunks. Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Add the potatoes and toss around until all of the potato pieces have been mashed. Remove from the heat and drain in a colander. Squeeze all of the potato excess water off of the potato pieces. Stir in grated lime zest and coconut flour. Serve immediately.

title: Lamb Salad With Raisins
ingredients: 3 racks of lamb, on both bone-in and frenched | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 3 tablespoons brandy ( or rum, or your favourite brandy ) | 5 leaves lettuce, chopped | 5 leaves fresh coriander or 5 leaves green lettuce | 2 tablespoons unbleached all-purpose flour ( or use more ) | 2 tablespoons unsalted peanuts or 2 tablespoons cashews, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate hot 400f degrees. Place lamb rack on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake 8 - 10 minutes or until just cooked through. Allow to rest 10 mintues. Remove the lamb rack from oven and let rest 10 minutes. Using your fingers, cut the lamb crosswise into 12 slices. Spread about 2 tblsp olive oil on a work surface. Arrange the lamb slices on the work surface, sprinkle with salt and pepper. Spread 3 tblsp brandy or rum over each slice. Divide the raisins among the lamb slices, sprinkle with 3 tblsp brandy and spread 3 tblsp olive oil over each. Spread the lettuce around the lamb, scatter with chopped coriander, and top with remaining slices. Spread the remaining brandy over the salads and sprinkle with peanuts. Note, you can also substitute chicken or beef for the lamb.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,kosher salt,white wine,yellow squash,garlic paste,olive oil,dark corn syrup,italian sausage
title: Stuffed Squash Boats (With Chili Conchiglioni)
ingredients: 5 yellow squash, large, washed, ends trimmed, and cut lengthwise into 3/8-inch slices | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1/4 cup dark corn syrup | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1/2 cup hot red chili pepper, chopped, seeds removed | 2 -4 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons white wine, hot ( i use pinot grigio ) | 2 tablespoons italian sausage, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Put squash with a scoop of water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 2 minutes. Drain. Toss in oil, corn syrup, garlic paste, chiles, and salt. Remove squash and toss in sherry. Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut a deep slit on top of squash and stuff with sausage. Bake on a baking sheet until squash is cooked through and stuffing is bubbling.

title: Nigerian Sweet Potato
ingredients: 1 sweet potato | 1 tablespoon sweet korean chili paste ( gochujang )
instructions: Peel and slice the sweet potato. Place the potato in a large pot with enough water to cover completely. Bring to a boil, and cook until nearly tender. Add the chili paste, and cook until the chili paste has dissolved. Remove from heat, and allow to cool slightly. Stir in the sweet potato, and let sit at room temperature for a few hours to serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,red cabbage,aubergine,almond,oil,bow tie pasta,chicken thigh
title: Chicken Na Nazi
ingredients: 8 ounces bow tie pasta | 1 onion | 1 chicken thigh | 2 ounces coconut milk | 2 ounces roasted almonds | 1 aubergine | 1 tablespoon oil | 15 g slivered almonds
instructions: Prepare the chicken, and allow to soak with salt in water for at least two hours. Rinse. Cut a cross from the base of one of the na Nazi's “gomasia”. Insert an x in the base of the da Nazi’s “glue” and fill ½” deep with coconut water. Bring to a boil, then stir in the meat, cover and let simmer. While the meat is cooking, rinse the aubergine. Peel the head and befor the body, keeping them whole. Cut diagonally into ½” chunks. Cut the onion in half and sauté in 2 oz coconut milk with half the sliced almonds. Remove from the stove. Boil, uncovered, until aubergine is tender. Meanwhile, boil water to cook pasta. Cook bowtie according to directions. Drain. Pour pasta with the meat into a bowl and stir to mix well. Add aubergine and onion alternately with the fried almonds. Serve with a sprinkle of orange zest if desired.

title: Swiss Chard With Pesto & Rose Wine(Diabetic)
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, leaves picked, cut crosswise in 1-inch pieces ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh rose wine ( about 1/2 cup ) or 1/2 cup dry white wine ( about 1/2 cup ) | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce, made using basil, sunflower oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Place chard in a large bowl and toss with wine, pesto and salt. Let chard sit, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes. Toss warm chard with pesto.

Random Ingredients: double cream,savory,blue cheese,tuna olive oil,papaya,cayenne pepper,self rising flour,wheat germ
title: Tuna Wreath
ingredients: 1 jar tuna in olive oil ( in the can, in any case ) | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 cup wheat germ | 1 tablespoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon dried sweet spanish papaya | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons double cream or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 4 ounces blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Heat oven to 400º f or 218ºc. Grease 2 large ovenproof dishes with oil, or line with parchment paper. Heat the tuna in olive oil in a frying pan. Make a well in the centre and add the flour, wheat germ, savory, papaya and cayenne. Beat the cream until you have a smooth consistency, then fold it into the dough. Divide the dough into 3 portions and roll each into ball. Place on a large baking sheet lined with baking paper and flatten slightly with the heel of your hand. Add 1/3 cheese and flatten more slightly. Make an x on top and sprinkle the top with the remaining cheese. Bake in the preheated oven, for 35 - 40 minutes, until golden.

title: Stuffed Beef-Wrapped in Feta
ingredients: 1 loaf ground sirloin | 1/2 lb sheep's milk feta | 1/2 lb lamb stock | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/4 lb mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Cut beef lengthwise in half. Scoop out and discard meat from cheese in center of loaf, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the meat. Wrap in aluminum foil and place on baking sheet covered with paper towel. Brush inside of beef with a little olive oil, set on plate, and broil until just cooked through. Set a 10 inch sauté pan over medium high heat. Add beef and brown. Mix feta, stock, sugar, and vinegar together and pour evenly over beef. Place sauté pan on a stove top or preheated medium setting and heat through. Remove beef from oven and top with cheese. Serves.

title: Quick Asparagus Soup for Pasta
ingredients: 1 package frozen asparagus soup | 1 can broth | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup mayonnaise, for topping
instructions: Thaw the fresh asparagus if frozen. Put frozen asparagus soup and broth in a microwave or saucepan, bring to boiling and continue boiling for 4 - 5 minutes or until asparagus is tender. Ladle into soup bowls, garnish with sour cream.

title: Sweet and Savory Hidden Veggies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons baking cocoa | 4 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Pour vegetable broth, ketchup, and guacamole in a large bowl.

title: Pistachio Crescents
ingredients: 1 bag shelled pistachio nuts | 1/2 cup dressing, miracle whip ( or salad dressing )
instructions: Pulse nuts in a food processor until they resemble small pecans. Stir in the dressing until a consistent paste. Roll candy in pistachios before serving.

Random Ingredients: salsa verde,cannellini bean,black pepper,marinara sauce,tamari,feta cheese,kernel corn,wheat germ
title: Lighter and Tasty Spicy Feta Bean Nests in Tomato-Salsa Verde Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tamari ( soy sauce, vegan may be used ) | 1 cup reduced-fat feta cheese, crumbled ( reduced fat ok ) | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 2 tablespoons salsa verde ( spicy )
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Line 4 small baking sheets with foil and spray with cooking spray, or line with parchment paper. In a bowl, combine 3 tablespoons tamari, feta, black pepper, beans, corn, wheat germ and salsa verde.

title: Basil Rice With Peanuts (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 -3 cups cooked basmati rice or 2 -3 cups other long grain rice | 1 cup chopped pimiento | 1/3 cup buttermilk or 1/3 cup low-fat milk | 1 tablespoon low-fat peanut butter | 2 cans tomato juice | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat and simmer until the liquid is reduced and the rice is cooked. Serve warm.

title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 3 cups unsweetened apple juice | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: In a medium baking dish, combine apple juice, celery seed, and 1 teaspoon salt. Pour into a jar with a tight fitting lid. Seal the lid, and shake until mixture is cloudy. Use, or refrigerate overnight to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,midori melon liqueur,chili oil,milk
title: Midori and Melon Cake
ingredients: 500 g self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon midori melon liqueur | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 2 -3 tablespoons milk
instructions: Grease a 23cm springform cake tin. Sift dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl, cut the mixture in half and fold each quarter into the batter. Mix in the midori and chilli oil. Make sure batter spreads evenly. Pour into tin. Bake in moderate oven for about 50 minutes or until the cake is set and cooked. Run a knife around the edge of the tin to loosen in the cake. Allow to cool in the tin before turn out onto a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,green bell pepper,baking potato,pea,red chile
title: Mile Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pound peeled and diced baking potatoes | 3 small green bell peppers, sliced | 2 fresh red chile, chopped - divided | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into cubes | 1 package frozen peas
instructions: Arrange the potato slices on a large platter and cover with aluminum foil. Place the green bell pepper slices atop the potato slices. Scatter 3/4 of the red chile slices, 1 tablespoon of green red chile, and 1/2 cup of the chicken cubes over the peppers and peppers. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon of green chile and red chile. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. The next morning, cover and refrigerate for at least an hour. Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Arrange a bamboo skewer or metal cutting board onto the work surface. Arrange the pepper slices atop the chicken and veggies. Roll the vegetables around and over until well coated with chile and chicken juices. Arrange on the cooking rack and broil for 5 minutes, or until the bread slices are lightly toasted.

title: Baked Hazelnut Barley-Harley Penne
ingredients: 1 can italian-blend barley ( or barley of choice such as pearl barley or barley of choice ) | 2 medium carrots, peeled finely shredded | 4 ounces pearl barley ( or grains of choice such as or orzo or rotini of choice ) | 1/3 cup roasted hazelnuts, coarsely ground | 1 lb penne, cooked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Place the barley in a food processor and pulse until it is finely chopped. Add the carrots and process until the barley is coursely chopped. Add the barley, and continue processing until the barley mixture comes together. Add the ground hazelnuts and pulse for 30 seconds. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon into a 2 quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes more, until the pasta is tender. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,italian breadcrumb,russian salad dressing,salt pepper,chunky salsa,pistachio nut,hazelnut
title: Rachael Ray's Tortas
ingredients: 6 tablespoons italian style seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons roasted pistachio nuts ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cilantro, chopped | 1 tablespoon coarsely-chopped hazelnuts | 1 cup chunky salsa, plus more ( store bought or homemade ) | 1/2 cup russian salad dressing | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Stir bread crumbs, pistachios and cilantro together in a small bowl then set aside. Combine salsa, salad dressing and salt and pepper in a small bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add hazelnuts and mix together. Roll walnut sized balls from bread crumbs and place on a baking sheet, lightly pressing them into the shape of crescents. Sprinkle top with more salsa if desired. Bake in a 400 degree oven about 15 minutes until golden brown. Serve.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,provolone cheese,white peppercorn,pork tenderloin,chili paste,herbes de provence,canadian bacon,beef bouillon cube
title: Smoked Canadian Bacon, Canadian Bacon or Canadian Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 6 slices canadian bacon or 6 slices smoked canadian bacon, cut into half | 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin | 12 slices canadian bacon or 12 slices regular pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup canadian bacon or 1/2 cup canadian bacon, sliced | 1/4 cup orange bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon dried herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns, cracked
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Trim all excess fat from tenderloins. Starting with all ingredients, wrap tenderloins in a single layer in foil. Place on cookie sheet that's been lined with parchment paper 1/2 inch thick. Smoke at 325 degrees until tenderloins begin to blacken slightly, about 25 to 30 minutes. Reduce oven to 325 degrees f and continue to cook until tenderloins are a deep caramel color, about 30 minutes. Transfer to cooling rack and allow to cool completely. Shred or slice meat and arrange slices on serving plates. Pour maple syrup over meat and top with sliced french or italian bacon. Garnish with crispy Canadian bacon slices. Serve with hot mustard.

title: Simple French Bread II
ingredients: 2 cups unbleached bread flour, divided with larger pieces of flour | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 3 -4 tablespoons shortening, cold, divided | 1 medium cucumber
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Mix 1 cup flour, tarragon vinegar and salt in a large bowl. Cut in shortening with fingertips until coarse meal forms. Fold bread flour mixture into dough. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead gently until smooth and elastic. Pat out to a rectangle 3/4 inch thick. Cut into 12 equal squares. Place on ungreased baking sheet, leaving 1/2 inch between each square. Score top of each square with a sharp knife. Cut a cross in the top with a serrated knife. Bake for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Anchovies and Chorizo Cheese Balls
ingredients: 12 ounces chorizo sausage, finely chopped | 12 ounces dried prunes, pitted and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 cup rolled oats | 1/2 cup yogurt | 1 anchovy, minced
instructions: Place chorizo and prunes in a food processor and process until finely chopped. Add rosemary, cumin, oats, yogurt and chopped anchovy. Process until mixture is smooth and moist. Cover and refrigerate for up to six hours before using.

title: Beer and Salmon Toss
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 8 dates, finely chopped | 300 g chopped smoked salmon fillets | 3/4 cup beer | 2 cups couscous, cooked and cooled | 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Heat grill to moderate. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Sprinkle salmon with salt and pepper. Grill, skin side down, until well marked, 3 - 5 minutes. Turn and grill until lightly charred and just cooked through, 4 - 5 minutes. Turn over and grill until lightly charred, 4 - 5 minutes more. Meanwhile, make couscous meanwhile, place the couscous and 1 cup water in a small heatproof bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and stand for 5 minutes or until it rises to the surface. Turn out onto a large board. Place the salmon fillets on top and carefully turn the fish over so the bones stick to the skin. Divide couscous among 4 small bowls or serving plates. Season salmon with salt and pepper. Spoon over the date mixture and spoon over smoked salmon mix. Finish with prosciutto if you like.

title: Avocado Beef Empanadas
ingredients: 8 ounces beef sirloin | 2 tablespoons garlic powder | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 8 inches refrigerated pie crust, at room temp | 1 large hass avocado, peeled, pitted and cut into small pieces ( optional )
instructions: Slice beef across the grain into thin slices. Place beef, garlic powder, and cilantro into a large resealable plastic bag. Shake to coat meat slices. Refrigerate for about 1 hour. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Unroll pie crust on a lightly floured work surface. Cut four circles with a pizza cutter. Place approximately 2 tablespoons of meat filling into the center of each circle, leaving 1/8 inch at the top. Fold over the bottom edge of each circle to form a half moon, pressing gently. Place each empanada in a lightly greased nonstick baking sheet, and bake for about 10 minutes or until golden. Serve with avocado. Note, if desired garnish with chopped fresh cilantro while hot.

title: Quick Vermicelli Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup tamari, or to taste | 1/4 cup pimento ( dried plum ), divided | 2 cans mandarin oranges, drained and rinsed | 1 package vermicelli | 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaves, shredded, or as desired
instructions: Place chickpeas, tamari, and pimentos in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Cover, and chill in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Remove chickpeas with a slotted spoon, and dice. Toss with noodles in a bowl, and sprinkle with kaffir lime leaves. Refrigerate, until flavors combine, about 30 minutes.

title: English Maboobs
ingredients: 1 ounce white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely ground white pepper
instructions: Put sugar in heatproof glass pan and put in microwave. Heat on high until the sugar is melted. Sprinkle white pepper over the sugar. Remove from microwave and put onto wax paper to cool. This is easy if you heat it in the microwave or oven. To speed this up, put wax paper between the wax paper and the microwave. Place the wax paper on a plate and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Take wax paper from freezer and place in refrigerator. Open paper and scrape up bits on wax, sprinkle with powder sugar and a little black pepper and continue to mix up. Break up the wax paper with a hammer or knife until the sugar is all incorporated and has become a fine powder. Store in airtight container until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,red bell pepper,black peppercorn,pork loin chop,porcini mushroom
title: Pork Chops with Mushrooms and Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | 2 tablespoons black peppercorns | 1/2 cup dried porcini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 red bell pepper, sliced into rings
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the chops into a large roasting pan. Spread the peppercorns into a shallow bowl. Stir together the porcini mushrooms and black mustard seed in the same dish. Brush all over the chops. Roast the chops in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Reduce the heat after 30 minutes so they cook evenly and cook through. Remove the chops from the oven, and cover to keep warm. Increase the oven temperature to 450 degrees f. Mix one cup of hot water with the reserved cooking liquid, and pour into the gravy. Cook until reduced by half. Serve the chops with the gravy.

title: Mexican Pulled Pork Tacos
ingredients: 1 package baby carrots, thawed | 1 small pork roast, meat pulled from the bones | 1 envelope gelatin, softened in 1/2 cup cold water | 10 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 12 corn tortillas, cut into 4 wedges, divided
instructions: Cook carrots in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain. Set aside. Place pork in a medium bowl. Sprinkle both sides of the tortillas with gelatin.

title: Fancy Easy Mexican Shells
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces grape tomatoes | 8 taco shells
instructions: Pour canola oil into a large nonstick frypan. Add tomatoes to frypan, breaking up tomatoes with the back of a spoon. Over medium low heat, cover and cook until tomatoes soften a bit and begin to burst. Remove tomatoes from heat, leaving pan on the burner. Quickly open package, about 10 times. Carefully drain tomatoes into a colander. Scoop out excess juice. Place a taco shell on a plate and place 1 tomato in the shell. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Artichoke and Olive Puree for Two
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa ( a hot sauce used in recipes, or use regular harissa ) | 1 cup low-fat milk | 8 ounces artichoke hearts, small | 3 tablespoons chopped pitted olives | 1 teaspoon dried thyme honey | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat until bubbling. Add harissa, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring. Whisk in the milk until smooth. Stir in artichoke hearts and olives. Season with thyme honey and cayenne pepper. Reduce heat to low. Simmer for 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Serve warm or cool.

title: Mint Chimichurri
ingredients: 1 jar cherry tomatoes ( about 10 ounces ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons arrowroot | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium bowl. Top with mint leaves, and press gently onto surface of tomato mixture to coat. Cover and chill at least 6 hours before serving.

title: Pickled Turnips
ingredients: 1 whole turnip | water | 1 jalapeno pepper, sliced | 1 sprig fresh thyme | rice wine ( optional )
instructions: Place the turnip and 1 inch of water in a large pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and cover.

Random Ingredients: honey,salsa,lemon peel,bean sprout,white wine vinegar,peanut butter,turnip
title: Turnip Dip - Microwave
