ingredients: 2 medium ripe turnips, about 600g each | 12 ounces bean sprouts, drained, rinsed | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 8 tablespoons salsa | 8 tablespoons peanut butter, smooth | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey, granulates can also be added or 2 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel, grated
instructions: Microwave turnips in uncovered microwave safe bowl on microwave, cook on high, uncovered, 1 to 3 minutes, stirring halfway halfway through cooking of turnips to ensure that they do not become mushy or over cooked. Scape bowl with wire spatula to allow moisture to redistribute, continue microwaving on high, covered with lid, until turnips are tender and most of the liquid is absorbed, 8 to 10 minutes more. In a bowl, combine the vinaigrette ingredients, spoon salad into serving bowl set over a large platter, sprinkle with peanuts.

title: Easy Pork Schnitzel
ingredients: 20 slices prosciutto | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 2 eggs ( can also use egg beaters ) | 2 cups croutons | 1 mango, cut in pieces | 2 tablespoons egg substitute ( optional )
instructions: Place pork shoulder on counter and remove fat. Chop into smaller pieces and lightly pound meat with mallet. You can also do a meat grinder on paper towels, this will make it much easier to work with. Mix 2 eggs with croutons. Put meat, croutons, mango, egg/egg mix and meat into food processor and mix until crumbly. Place on well oiled broiler pan and broil about 4 inches from heat 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,lipton onion soup mix,red lentil,blackberry jam,double cream,coconut milk
title: Lentil & Black Biscuit Pie With Chocolate Glaze
ingredients: 150 g red lentils | 400 ml beef broth | 1 packet lipton onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons blackberry jam | 150 ml double cream | 100 g grated coconut ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the coconut in a pan then warm on low heat, stirring occasionally. Simmer the liquid from the lentils to the soup mix in a bowl, add to the cooked lentils mixture. Mix well. Pour into a well greased pie plate and bake for 20 mins or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve hot with the chocolate glaze.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,baby spinach leaf,tortilla chip,sherry wine,nutmeg,serrano chilies
title: Baby Spinach Chips with Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach - stems removed | 2 lbs good quality fresh baby spinach leaves | 1/2 lb fresh serrano chilies, finely chopped | 4 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/3 cup sherry wine
instructions: Prep all your items. Place in a bowl and fill the rest of the jar with water. Allow to stand at room temperature for 2 days. After 2 days, drain the water. Combine the sherry and beef bouillon in a small saucepan over high heat, add the spinach and continue heating to a simmer. Add the nutmeg and simmer gently until the spinach is tender, about 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Zucchini Pizza
ingredients: 4 ounces muir glen greek yogurt | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, sliced | 1/2 cup frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 1 zucchini, sliced | 1/2 cup canned spanish olives ( or other green olives ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven according to package directions. Place zucchini on plate or pizza pan sprayed with pam. Cover with sliced olives and mozzarella. In a small bowl, stir yogurt, salsa seasoning, and molasses. Spread yogurt mixture over zucchini. Sprinkle with cayenne, and bake 15 minutes on middle rack, until cheese is soft.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,green bell pepper,ricotta cheese,mango,chicken wing
title: Chicken and Spinach Parcels
ingredients: 12 spinach leaves | 500 g ricotta cheese | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 kg chicken wings or 1 kg pork wings | 1 mango, cut into 2 cm cubes
instructions: Wash and remove any tough pieces of thick stalks from the spinach and cut them into bite sized pieces. Fry the spinach in a little oil until dark golden in colour. Drain on a paper towel and set aside. In a clean container, spread out the ricotta cheese, then mix in the mango. Wash, devein and cut the wings into pieces and fry in the same oil. In a large, flat dish, spread out the chicken pieces and coat the chicken well with the yogurt mixture. Spread out the spinach, then pour a third amount of the ricotta mixture onto the spinach. Add one third of the sliced bell pepper and continue to repeat making chicken and spinach layers. Sprinkle the remaining bell pepper over and layer on half of the spinach mixture. Spread on the remaining spinach mixture. Repeat, ending with chicken and spinach on the top. In a heavy bottomed pan, bring 10 cups of water to boil over a moderate heat. Add in the chicken, cover and cook for 40 minutes.

title: Easy Vietnamese Ouzo
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped onions | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee ( or substitute 1/4 c if you prefer. i use instant milk. )
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender or food processor. For a lighter texture, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate, covered, for up to 2 days.

title: Pigs in a Blanket (Sausages With Onions Filled)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped onions | 2 tablespoons finely chopped chives | 6 sausages ( of your choice )
instructions: Heat frying pan on medium. Add onions and chives. Saute until transparent. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Slightly warm the sausages on the rack or in a foil lined baking pan. Bake them in a moderately hot oven for about 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Polenta-Wrapped Turnips
ingredients: 1/4 cup quick-cooking spray | 2 cups shredded savoy cabbage | 1 cup chopped turnip | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons finely chopped dried parsley | 2 spring onions, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 lb bulk hot sausage
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f spray an 8x8 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, toss the cabbage, turnip, walnuts, parsley and spring onions with the cooled sausage. Using 1 teaspoon meat mixture per turnip, roll each turnip, starting on each end, jelly roll style, so that every roll is fully coated with sausage. Arrange the turnip, seam side up, in a baking dish. Pour any juices that have accumulated on the baking dish into a medium bowl. Sprinkle the top with 1 teaspoon salt, and drizzle the remaining 1 teaspoon of meat mixture over it. Sprinkle with the oregano. Cover the dish with foil, and bake until the turnips are tender and lightly golden on the top, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,green cardamom pod,plum tomato,tarragon,anchovy,vegetable juice,brown rice,meatball
title: Armenian Pot Sticker Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb meatballs, browned ( about 3 lbs ) | 6 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons vegetable juice | 1/4 teaspoon whole green cardamom pod | 4 anchovies, rinsed and patted dry | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 3 cups uncooked instant brown rice | 1 1/2 cups plum tomatoes, seeded and cut in 1/2-inch wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 450° f. Combine meatballs, 2 tbsp mustard, veg juice, cardamom pods, anchovies, tarragon, and remaining 1½ cups mustard in a 13x9x2 baking dish coated with cooking spray. Cover tightly and bake until meatballs are heated through and crisp on top, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, add remaining mustard mustard and remaining ¼ cup mustard to tomato juice in a small nonstick skillet. Cover and heat over medium heat until it is heated through, about 2 minutes. Do not allow mustard to burn. Toss rice with remaining ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Chilli Plum Mango Chutney
ingredients: 5 tablespoons dark raisins or 5 tablespoons brown sugar | 175 -180 g plums, halved, stoned and sliced ( or use 6 oz ) | 2 medium sweet red peppers, halved, deseeded and sliced finely | 125 -180 g mangoes, diced | fresh fresh cilantro
instructions: Combine raisins and sugar in a bowl or saucepan and microwave for 1 minute. Add plums and sweet pepper and microwave for 2 more minutes. Add mangoes and cilantro and stir.

title: Chickpea Fajitas
ingredients: 6 ounces dried chickpea flour | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 2 teaspoons molasses | 1 teaspoon dried herbs | 2 -4 slices smoked ham | 12 ladyfingers | 1/3 cup pepitas ( roasted peanuts ) or 1/3 cup crushed peanuts
instructions: Prepare the chickpea flour by emptying it into a large bowel. Add the salt, molasses, dried herbs and chopped ham and mix inches knead for a little more than five minutes until the mixture has nice and smooth consistency. Take pieces of dough and shape them into balls with your hands, slightly too small so they don't stick together, then refrigerate until ready to grill.

Random Ingredients: peanut,golden syrup,brown rice,chocolate coffee bean,cucumber,salt black pepper
title: Cucumber and Chocolate-Laced Peanut Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup cooked brown rice | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 cup unsalted peanuts, lightly salted, skinless, chopped | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1/2 pound semisweet chocolate chips ( optional ) | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet and line with parchment paper. In a bowl, stir together the cooked brown rice and golden syrup. Stir in the peanuts. Transfer to a platter. Spread the peanut mixture evenly to within 1/2 inch of the edges. Arrange the cucumber over the filling. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Gluten Free and Low Calorie Hamburger Helper
ingredients: 2 cups beef soup | 2 cups xanthan gum
instructions: Put everything in a bowl, blend well. Serve. May enjoy with ketchup or fries.

title: Lemony Sausages - Authentic Recipe
ingredients: 1 package sofrito sauce | 1/2 lemon
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut the fat from the lemon, slice it into thin shreds. Pour the sofrito into a skillet over low heat and warm it, stirring constantly. Stir in the shredded lemon peel. Add the sausages to the pan. Serve hot with cornbread.

title: Saudiya Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Arrange the chicken breasts on a broiler pan. Broil for about 6 minutes on each side, or until juices run clear and chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear. Mix together the mayonnaise, tarragon and garam masala in a small bowl. Spread the mixture over the chicken.

Random Ingredients: apricot half,peanut butter,chili oil,arborio rice,shallot,italian bread
title: Tasty Sweet and Salty Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 4 shallots, minced | 3 cups arborio rice | 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 2 ounces dried apricot halves | 1 loaf crusty italian bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir together 1 tablespoon peanut butter with 1 teaspoon chili oil. Drain the rice into a sieve, rinse with cold water, and add it to the peanut butter mixture along with the peanut butter mixture and apricots. Mix until the rice is evenly coated. The mixture will be sticky and hard to handle. Place the bread onto an oven safe pie plate. Spread the rice mixture evenly over the top. Bake for about 35 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the rice is tender and the stuffing browns somewhat. Remove from the oven, and let cool for a few minutes before serving.

title: Rice, and Pesto With Aromatic Veggies
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice ( arborio ) | 7 ounces pasta ( i used rotelle al dente ) | 1 teaspoon cumin
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring water to a boil. Add arborio rice and stir until the liquid has absorbed completely. Stir in enough water to cover and turn heat to very low. Simmer at least 20 minutes or until most of the water has been absorbed and the rice is completely cooked. Stir occasionally to prevent scorching. While rice cooks, steam your vegetable sticks. While your vegetable are steaming, saute cumin in a skillet along with a drizzle of olive oil over the rice, tossing the rice continuously, until you can smell them. Remove from heat when rice is completely cooked.

title: The Endive with Sweet Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried australian chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried endive | 1 packet orange marmalade
instructions: Mix chili pepper and salt in a shallow bowl. Set aside. Place the orange marmalade in a food processor and process until smooth. Add the onion mix and process to combine. Place onions onto a baking paper lined tray, sprayed with cooking spray, and bake for 45 - 1 hour at 180c, stirring every 15 minutes or so.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,blue curacao,pork,pea,picante sauce,marinara sauce
title: Pork Chops in a Slow Cooker
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 2 teaspoons blue curacao | 2 teaspoons pork fat, melted ( from a cube ) | 1 can pinto beans in a can, undrained | 1 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in the slow cooker. Cook on low setting for 7 hours. Serve on white rice.

title: Spicy Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g ground veal | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 3 tablespoons sweet-hot sauce | 1 tablespoon dried mixed fruit
instructions: Preheat grill if using a stovetop grill pan, and place on grill. Mix together veal, mustard, sweet pepper sauce and dried fruit until well blended. Shape mixture into balls about the size of a walnut. Cook in pan about 5 minutes, turning meatballs over occasionally and brushing with extra sauce, until cooked through and golden brown and heated through.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,cinnamon,bread flour,tofu,chicken stock,serrano pepper,romaine lettuce
title: Tofu Sandwiches (Sydney-Style)
ingredients: 1/2 lb firm tofu, drained and cut into small cubes | 8 slices whole wheat bread | 1 teaspoon bread flour | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon rice milk or 1 tablespoon chicken stock | 2 cups chopped romaine lettuce | 2 fresh serrano peppers, sliced lengthwise into rings
instructions: Place tofu in bowl of ice water and wring away excess moisture. Set aside to drain and pat dry. Cut crusts from the bread. Butter a flat dish with a little or no stickiness. Place half the bread slices in the dish and set aside. Toast the other half of the bread then set aside. Combine flour and cinnamon in a small bowl and set aside. Warm the soup base ingredients until steaming hot, usually about 10 minutes. Toast the tofu over a flat dry pan, flipping the cubes after 2 minutes so they brown evenly. Turn out cubes on paper towels to drain on paper towels. Place the rest of the bread slices on the bottoms of 4 plates. Put a tofu cube on each plate. Top with the yogurt, lettuce, and serrano in a few slits, as desired. Serve the sandwiches with a dollop of sriracha peanut sauce on the side or the garnish on the side.

Random Ingredients: red chili paste,salt black pepper,ziti pasta,yellow onion,picante sauce,green olive,cantaloupe
title: Picante Calpr
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 2 cans diced yellow onions | 1 lb cantaloupe, fresh, bite-sized | 1 jar picante sauce, medium-hot | 1 cup green olives, with liquid | 1 sweet red chili paste | salt and black pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Cook ziti according to directions on the box. Meanwhile, in a non stick pan, layer ziti, onions. And cantaloupe. Pour the picante sauce on top evenly. Cover and simmer till ziti is tender, about 30 minutes. Season to taste with salt & pepper and serve hot.

title: Chefs Taco Macaroni
ingredients: 12 ounces macaroni, uncooked | 2 packages taco seasoning mix | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup bran cereal
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to boil. Add macaroni, and cook according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Stir in taco seasoning mix. Add bay leaf. In a 13 x 9 inch baking dish, arrange macaroni, bran, and seasoning mixture. Pour 1/2 cup water around the outside, then pour rest of liquid over the entire dish of macaroni. Bake, covered, 25 minutes, then uncover. Bake 5 minutes, or until the bran is melted and slightly crispy. Serve warm.

title: Creamy Swedish Spaghetti Sauce With Crab and Coconut
ingredients: 1 lb crabmeat | 1 lb soymilk ( swedish-style preferred ) or 1 lb light cream ( swedish-style preferred ) | 1/2 lemon wedge | 1 teaspoon coarse ground cloves
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Let it chill in the refrigerator for an hour before serving as an it tends to curdle. Serve over egg noodles, rice, or mashed potatoes, or in the traditional manner.

title: Ouzo Cheese with Sage
ingredients: 6 ounces ouzo | 12 ounces extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1 small onion, chopped
instructions: Prepare ouzo. Remove any lumps. Combine ouzo, cheese, sage, onion and salt and pepper to taste. Chill until serving time.

title: Easy and Delicious Stuffed Cajun Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 jar marinara sauce, divided | 8 ladyfingers, or more as needed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese, divided | 1 cup cake flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Heat 1/2 jar of marinara sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.

title: Avocado - Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 1 avocado, ripe, peeled & cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons finely chopped onions | 2 tablespoons finely chopped tomatoes or 2 tablespoons canned tomato salsa | 2 lettuce leaves
instructions: Serve avocado on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,monterey jack cheese,blueberry,rice noodle,green chile pepper,cilantro,egg
title: Blueberry, Rice Noodle & Green Chile Nests
ingredients: 6 eggs, lightly beaten | 2 cups plain flour | 2 cups chopped fresh blueberries | 2 cans chopped green chile peppers | 3 cups cooked rice noodles | 1 cup mild chopped fresh cilantro | 1 1/2 cups grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease baking sheet and set aside. In a large bowl combine eggs, flour, blueberries, chili peppers, noodles and cilantro. Using an electric mixer on medium speed, mix until well blended. Spread batter in 3/4. Bake in preheated oven until puffed and golden, about 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese to serve.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,fish fillet,italian turkey sausage link
title: Italian Sausage and Fish Fillets
ingredients: 500 g italian turkey sausage links | 400 g thick & chunky salsa | 300 g skinless fish fillets
instructions: Grill the sausages until cooked.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,pineapple tidbit,ricotta cheese,carrot,parsley leaf,balsamic vinegar
title: Pineapple Pesto Dip
ingredients: 1 jar marinated pineapple tidbits, well drained | 3/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup shredded carrot | 1/2 cup shredded parsley leaves | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 container ricotta cheese
instructions: In medium size mixing bowl combine pineapple tidbits, peanut butter, carrot, parsley and vinegar. Stir to combine. Add cheese and mix well. Transfer to serving bowl and let cool to room temperature before serving.

title: Småskål (Swedish Chocolate Balls)
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup framboise liqueur | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Mix flour, liqueur and almond extract together in a bowl with your fingers until dough becomes crumbly. Roll dough out on a floured surface until it reaches 1/8 inch thickness. Cut dough into 4 - 6 small balls. Let dough rest for 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray cookie sheets with non stick cooking spray. Roll 1/4 inch balls into 2 inch circles on the cookie sheets. Do not crowd them. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve hot or cold. Note, to make 1 cookie per half pound of dough, heat 1 1/2 tablespoons of butter or margarine. Roll each circle in the mixture and use as a finger cook.

Random Ingredients: szechuan peppercorn,lasagna noodle,french onion soup,flat leaf parsley,japanese eggplant,chipotle chile
title: Gingered Japanese Eggplant Lasagna
ingredients: 1/4 french onion soup | 4 ounces japanese eggplants, sliced crosswise into 1/4 inch-thick rounds | 2 -3 chipotle chiles, seeded to taste | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns, lightly toasted and ground | 9 -10 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 2 1/4 - 2 1/2 tablespoons fresh flat leaf parsley, minced | 6 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, minced
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Bring 2 to 3 cups of rapidly boiling water to a boil. Meanwhile, combine the soup and pepper in a bowl and set aside. Place the eggplant slices in a saucepan, cover with water, and over moderate heat poach eggplant until tender, just barely tender. Drain and set aside. In a large, deep pan, combine the chiles, parsley and 1/4 cup water. Bring to a boil, add noodles, and cook until pasta is tender, about 3 to 5 minutes. While cooking the noodles, heat remaining 2 t. Of water in a nonstick skillet. Add the chile mixture and stir until heated through. Preheat broiler. Divide a layer of noodles, 1/3 of a soup mix and a sprinkle of cheese sauce on each of the prepared lasagna noodles followed by more noodles. Repeat layering until all ingredients are used. Top with remaining soup mix, top with remaining cheese sauce and sprinkle with a pinch of cheese. Broil about two inches from broiler until top is brown and bubbly, about three minutes.

title: Agua De Noche (Mexican Black Cherry Preserve)
ingredients: fresh black | 1 cinnamon stick, 6 to 8 inches long | 3 dried chipotle chiles | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and chopped
instructions: Place the black cherries in a blender jar with 6 cups of cold water.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,broccoli,self raising flour,italian sausage,spinach leaf
title: Italian Sausage and Broccoli Pie
ingredients: 1 cup broccoli, washed and cut into small pieces | 1 bag frozen or fresh spinach leaves, cleaned and thawed | 1/4 lb italian sausage, browned ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups self raising flour | 1/2 lb monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. Line a 10 inch pie pan with aluminium foil. Spread the broccoli and spinach over the bottom of the prepared pie pan. Remove all but a few pieces of the sausage from the casings of the sausage. Roll and layer the sausage over the spinach. Sprinkle the cheese over the sausage and broccoli. Place in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted. Cut the pie up and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,red wine,chicken breast fillet,almond meal
title: Creamy Rice
ingredients: 500 g long grain rice | 1 liter red wine | 4 chicken breast fillets | almond meal, for coating ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the rice in a cloth under cold water until the water runs clear. This will make them easier to roll into little balls/mexican shape. Drain thoroughly. Put rice in ovenproof casserole dish or shallow bowl and top with a layer of chicken breasts and/or with a mixture of the almond meal and red wine. Bake in preheated 450 degree f oven for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,ziti pasta,basil,rice wine vinegar,brown rice,cilantro stem,balsamic vinegar,pine nut
title: Crispy Baked Ziti
ingredients: 16 ounces ziti pasta or 16 ounces penne pasta, uncooked | 3 cups thinly shredded cabbage | 1/2 lb brown rice | 1/4 cup minced cilantro stem ( from a sprig ) | 1/4 cup minced fresh basil | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ziti pasta and pasta and cook until al dente or tender but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes. Drain pasta and remaining ingredients. Transfer to a large baking sheet and spread evenly. Combine vinegar and balsamic vinegar and brush onto pasta. Bake for 15 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,bell pepper,golden delicious apple,pork sausage,dark soy sauce,red wine
title: Grilled Sausages
ingredients: 4 lbs pork sausage | 1 bell pepper, diced | 1 golden delicious apple, diced | 1 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup red wine | 2 teaspoons cinnamon
instructions: Preheat grill to high.

title: Noodles & Rice
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles | 2 cups water, divided | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to directions on package, following package direction. Drain, rinse with cold water and set aside. Heat 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring to dissolve any browned bits off of noodles. Stir in thyme. Add noodles and remaining water to the noodles and place the pan over medium heat. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until water is absorbed, about 5 minutes.

title: Homemade Pecans, Mexican Style
ingredients: 300 g fine, dry-roasted ground pecans | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh red chilies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175c/350f/gas grind the pecans coarsely in a food processor or mini chopper. Add the chillies and process until fine. If ground pecans become too fine, you can add some milk, or some extra egg. Add more salt to taste. You can make a slit in the top of a cheese grater for the filling to allow the steam to escape. Spoon the pecan mix onto a greased cookie tray and bake for 5 - 10 minutes, depending on the size of the grates used. Cool on the graters with a spatula. Variation, replace the ground pecans with 2 c of ground oaxaca, or 1/4 c of crumbled feta and 1 dl spanish smoked paprika mixed together. Store in airtight container at room temperature.

title: Asparagus Feta Salad
ingredients: 1 bag pre-washed prepared coleslaw mix | 2 cans fava beans, drained | 3 cups chopped romaine lettuce | 1/2 bunch spring onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 can asparagus, drained and chopped, drained | 1 can sliced ripe romaita olives or ( 12 ounce ) can pitted ripe kalamata olives, drained | 1 lb asparagus, cooked asparagus tips removed and sliced into rounds
instructions: Mix together coleslaw mix, favas and 3 cups lettuce.

title: Easy Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cans condensed golden mushroom soup | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: Heat soup in saucepan to boiling. Reduce heat.

title: Lucky Six
ingredients: 8 ounces dried lentils | 14 ounces canned tomatillos, drained | 14 ounces guinness stout | 4 1/2 ounces superfine sugar | 1 cup chocolate syrup ( preferably dark chocolate ) | 8 guajillo chiles, stemmed ( mexican pickled chiles ) | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the lentils and 4 cups of water and bring to a simmer. Add the tomatillos and cook over moderate heat until the lentils are soft, 20 or 30 minutes. Transfer the water to a blender or food processor and puree the soup. Transfer this to a saucepan and heat to a boil. Remove from the heat and whisk in the guajillo chiles, sugar, chocolate syrup, 1 cup of the soup and the nutmeg. Simmer for 20 minutes over low heat. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground pepper. Serve hot, warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,kiwi fruit,plum tomato,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Sherry Kiwi Rice
ingredients: 1 cup short grain brown rice | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled, halved, and quartered | 2 plum tomatoes, cut into eighths | 1 sprig flat-leaf italian parsley ( optional )
instructions: Place the rice into a large, deep skillet. Add the cold water and the kiwifruit. Place the tomatoes in the skillet over medium high heat. Bring to a boil, and cook until the tomatoes are softened, 15 to 25 minutes. Remove from heat. Remove the kiwifruit from the heat. Cover, and let stand for 10 minutes. Strain the rice. Serve rice with kiwifruit and tomatoes on top, sprinkle with parsley.

title: Portuguese Beef Sandwiches (Sugolizinho)
ingredients: 1 chuck roast, about 2 pounds | 3/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon lemon zest ( zest only if using frozen ) | 1 teaspoon white vinegar
instructions: If using meat thermometer, use the point where the point reaches 160 and the lighter reaches 140. Heat large cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Trim away excess fat from meat. Insert meat thermometer into center of meat, and set aside in oven. When temperature is warm, place the meat thermometer in the hot skillet. Bread loaf should be a deep, golden brown color, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,ranch dressing,cayenne pepper,cayenne,chicken rice soup
title: Creamy Fried Ranch Chicken
ingredients: 6 skinless chicken tenderloins or 6 chicken thighs | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 ounce ranch dressing | 1 can chicken & rice soup ( undiluted ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( or more to taste ) or 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( or more to taste )
instructions: Place chicken pieces in a freezer bag. In a medium size skillet, heat oil. Brown chicken on both sides. Add ranch dressing. Mix well. Serve, or refrigerate for later use.

title: My Pickle Dip
ingredients: 1 cucumber, peeled and seeded | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish
instructions: Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise. Using a vegetable peeler, remove the peel in thin strips. Slice the cucumber thinly. In a large glass bowl, stir the cucumber shreds with the chopped cucumber. Stir in the pickle relish. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,bulk pork sausage,extra virgin olive oil,whipping cream,rye flour,cream
title: Sausage in Creamy Smoked Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons smoked paprika powder ( or 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika ) | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup rye flour | 1/2 lb bulk pork sausage | 2 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: In a small bowl, mix paprika and whipping cream, and set aside. In a medium bowl, mix sour cream with flour until smooth. In a large skillet, cook pork sausage over medium heat for 8 - 10 minutes, or until evenly browned. Drain, break apart, and stir in ketchup. Slowly stir sour cream mixture into skillet, until thickened.

Random Ingredients: bourbon,vegetable stock,grain brown rice,asparagus,white vinegar,white wine
title: Asparagus and Brown Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock | 1 bunch asparagus, chopped | 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 1 tablespoon bourbon | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 3 cups cooked long grain brown rice
instructions: Warm stock. Bring to boil over high heat, then simmer for 5 minutes. Add asparagus and cook for a further 5 minutes. Pour in wine and bourbon and stir well. Add vinegar. When soup returns to boil, stir in rice. Remove from heat, cover loosely and let stand for 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Macaroni Cheese-Chestnut Pizza
ingredients: 1 pound fresh sliced macaroni | 1 cup grated mozzarella cheese | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup granulated sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain, and spread on a large baking sheet. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the macaroni, and place a few slices on the cheese. Combine the water chestnuts, bread crumbs, sugar, and cardamom in a bowl. Layer a couple of ladyfinger tops on the pizza crust, and cover with 1/2 of the nut crumb mixture. Sprinkle the final layer of crumb mixture, and top with remaining slices of cheese. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Red Bell Pepper Almond Burgundy
ingredients: 4 cups burgundy wine or 4 cups merlot | 2 tablespoons almond extract | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | 4 slices toasted almonds ( optional )
instructions: Combine remaining ingredients in a medium heavy bottomed saucepan over medium heat. Cover and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered and stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to stand until the wine has reduced to half, about 10 minutes. Stir in the almonds and serve. Note, can be served on fresh cedar skewers, but be sure to soak in fresh water to remove most of the salt, otherwise the flavor will not soak into as much as desired.

title: Roasted Capsicum
ingredients: 1 large red capsicum
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees centigrade/400°f. Cut the tops and the skin off all the capsicums and discard. Brush the capsicum with oil and place into hot cooking tray. Roast for 45 minutes. Remove the tray from the oven and brush the capsicum with a little oil. Return the tray to the oven and cook for 3 - 5 minutes until the capsicum is roasted but still retaining some of its shape. Serve as a snack or as a meal with warm bread.

title: Vegetable Teriyaki Scrolls
ingredients: 5 ounces frozen mixed vegetables | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 teaspoon low sodium dark soy sauce
instructions: Cook vegetables and soy sauce in microwave on high for 2 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds. Pour mixture into a shallow dish and set aside while keeping warm. Preheat oven to 200°c. Heat oil in a large non stick frying pan over medium heat, spray with oil. Add prepared vegetables, cover and cook for 4 - 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender and slightly golden. Remove vegetables from heat and allow to cool. Spoon vegetables onto baking tray, top with teriyaki sauce and bake, covered, for 10 - 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Quinoa & Mexican Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 250 g penne rigate | 1 cup quinoa | 1 - 1 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling water with a little salt. When cooked, remove from the heat, but do not rinse with cool water. While that cooks, heat olive oil in another pan and stir fry quinoa over a medium heat for a minute to develop its aroma. Add quinoa & cheese. Stir to incorporate, then serve.

Random Ingredients: elbow macaroni,jalapeno pepper,chicken stock,beef bouillon cube,double cream,cranberry
title: Macaroni and Cranberry Soup
ingredients: 400 g fresh cranberries | 500 ml chicken stock | 300 ml double cream | 375 g elbow macaroni | 1 pinch of sazon goya instant minced chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper
instructions: Dice the beef in 1 inch cubes. Boil 5 cups of water and add some salt. Meanwhile, place the cranberries in the soup bowl and cover with a lid. When the skins come open, the cranberries have popped, so you may want to peel them off the stems. When the cranberries have popped, add the cream in 4 increments, stirring after each addition. The goal is to make a thick soup, with a consistency that is easy to pour once cooked. If you feel you need a bit more of the cream, add a few drops of lemon or lime juice. Add the dried chili. Add the sazón goya. Bring the soup to a simmer. Add the macaroni and mix with a fork. Cook until done. Stir in the sazon. If the soup is too thick, add water. Serve and eat with grated parmesan.

title: Fry Bagels
ingredients: 1/4 cup saffron thread | 1 pinch garlic salt ( optional )
instructions: To check if your saffron is medium, make a small dent with your finger. If it sizzles, it is fine. A pastry brush or a heavy skillet is good for this. Put a small plate on the work surface or in front of you to allow air to circulate around. Place the saffron onto the plate, about a thumb/size or so, and put a pinch of garlic salt if using. With your fingers, press the saffron into the bagels so that it is coated with the garlic salt. Fry in hot oil, until puffed. Serve them at once, as an appetizer with fresh vegetables, fish, and pita breads. To make the garlic salt in the bagels, use a small piece of garlic or finely chopped, fresh garlic from a whole bulb. You can also make the garlic in a blender or mortar and pestle and use it instead of saffron, but be careful with the garlic salt as it can become bitter. Garlic salt is not necessary. If you use garlic powder instead of saffron, the aroma will be weaker. For a milder flavor, you can make the salt out of the saffron by soaking it with hot water for about 1/2 hour, then shaking the pan until it gets the flavor out of the garlic. For a stronger flavor, add a pinch of garlic salt or a pinch of saffron water before frying. Note, in the original recipe, i never mentioned the amount of garlic salt. The salt amounts are merely estimates. I was trying to research a friend's recipe, and perhaps you could use up what is called for in the recipe. I found that the original recipe is 50 calories per pound of ground meat and 50 mill flour. It seemed like a pretty high fat pinch of garlic salt, but the recipe did not recognize it. Note, if you have a grinder or a food processor, do not add the saffron. This recipe produces a better, more mild tasting paste. Note, if you have a stand mixer with a paddle attachment, start to form patties the size desired, being careful not to over form. Cut or tear into bite size pieces as mentioned above.

title: Cheese Logs
ingredients: 12 -24 slices monterey jack cheese | 8 leaves lettuce | icing sugar, to dust
instructions: Place the cheese on each slice of cheese. Wash and dry lettuce. Drizzle with icing sugar and cut into four pieces each. Place on cookie sheet in single layer. Bake at 350 for about 10 - 15 minutes. Allow cheese to cool to room temperature. Serve or storing in a covered container with a piece of cheese attached to the edge to keep the cheese soft.

title: Arabian Chunk Powder
ingredients: 4 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds | 3 teaspoons garlic, crushed
instructions: Grind cardamom seeds into a fine powder using the following method.. First grind the garlic with a mortar and pestle. Mix the ground garlic into the powder until well mixed. Use as directed in some recipes.

Random Ingredients: egg,fruit juice,lasagna noodle,chicken bouillon cube,rigatoni pasta
title: Quick Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 7 eggs | 15 ounces pasta, any color | 16 ounces rigatoni pasta, any color | 0.667 chicken bouillon cube or 1/2 tablespoon chicken flavored seasoning, dissolved in | 1 cup fruit juice
instructions: Beat eggs. Cut pasta. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the noodles, and cook until al dente about 13 minutes. Drain. Add vegetables. Simmer for 10 - 20 minutes, add boullion or seasoning to taste and continue to simmer until heated through note, if you like extra vegetables, add more egg. Add some fruit juice, or a little bit of juice from the fruit or water.

title: Easy Kaffir Lime Prawn Cocktail - Longmeadow Prawns
ingredients: 200 g fresh medium-sized prawns - peeled, deveined and tails removed ( tails left on if desired ) | 2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | iceberg lettuce ( to garnish ) | fresh kaffir lime leaf ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the prawns in a shallow pan with the breadcrumbs. Place the prawns over a low heat. Stir gently so the prawns cook on both sides and the breadcrumbs absorb the excess water. Remove the prawns with slotted metal spoon and place on a tray in direct contact with the heat. Grill or fry the prawns, turning frequently for 8 - 10 minutes or until they are pink. If your prawns are still pink, leave to cook for a further 3 - 4 minutes. Serve immediately with lettuce leaves or slices of fresh lime. Variation, instead of breadcrumbs you can also make a meal of breadcrumbs and a little chopped mint.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,fine egg noodle,beef brisket,beef tenderloin,thyme,almond paste,marsala wine,sesame seed
title: Gorky Beef With Herb Wine and Marsala
ingredients: 8 1/2 lbs beef short ribs | 8 ounces fine egg noodles | 2 tablespoons almond paste | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds ( see tip ) | 3 tablespoons kosher salt or 3 tablespoons sea salt | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried rosemary, crushed | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 2 ounces beef tenderloin, cut into thin slices | 1/2 cup good quality extra virgin olive oil or 1/2 cup canola oil
instructions: If your short ribs have bone in, trim and scrape them. If your short ribs have bone in, cut them in half horizontally, then crosswise. This will take approximately 20 to 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Lightly oil a baking sheet, or use parchment paper, or line with parchment paper in a roasting pan. Rinse the meat with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut away any remaining fat and sinew from the beef, if using. If using a roasting pan, use tongs to hold the meat over the direct heat. Place the rack on the bottom of your oven and set it for 90 minutes, which will also be quite hot. Remove the beef to a board and thinly slice. Cook the noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain and transfer to a large bowl. Place the oil in a shallow dish or saucepan, and heat slowly, stirring occasionally, until it is of medium to thick, but pourable consistency. Keep warm. While the noodles are cooking, pat the sesame seeds dry on a large plate. Transfer to a clean plate and toss with 1 tablespoon chopped rosemary. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Using a spoon, lightly flatten the noodles with a rolling pin. Spread 1 teaspoonful of the almond paste on the noodles, leaving a 1 1/2 inch border along the edges and about 1/4 inch on each side. With a sharp knife, make vertical slits in the noodles and scatter 1 tablespoon of the sesame seed mixture in the center of each. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the salt, 2 tablespoons of the rosemary and 1 tablespoon of the thyme over the herb paste and continue sprinkling with 1 tablespoon sesame seeds mixture. Fold 1/2 of your beef slices in half and then the other side over the top, overlapping the slices slightly a little. Dab each piece lightly with a wet pastry brush dipped in water and then with more sesame seeds. You should have two layers of beef, with each of the sesame seeds and a little of the sesame paste. Place the tray in the oven and bake, uncovered, for 1 hour. Remove the meat to a serving plate. Heat the pan sauce together, scraping up the browned bits and bits from the bottom of the pan deposits with a wooden spoon. To serve place the meat in shallow soup bowls or plates and ladle on the heated sauce, then serve.

title: Mashed Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 fresh tomatoes | 1/4 lb feta cheese | 1/3 cup low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Wash tomatoes and slice down the side. When tomatoes are cut crosswise about 5 or 8, top each with 1 ounce feta cheese and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoons fresh ground black pepper. Mix yogurt with the rest of the mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,fennel seed,venison,chicken breast half,arborio rice
title: Venison and Rice
ingredients: 3/4 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/4 cup arborio rice | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, divided | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the chicken and rice on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon each of the fennel seed and the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of fennel seeds. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes. Remove from oven.

title: Griddle Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bread flour | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup dried apricot, diced
instructions: Preheat grill to high heat. Combine bread flour and salt together in a large bowl. Stir in vinegar and apricots and knead until dough is not sticky. Shape dough into balls, place on hot griddle and cook on both sides until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,cooking oil,dijon mustard,breadcrumb
title: Bread Crumb Dijon Fried Green Beans!
ingredients: cooking oil | 8 ounces fresh breadcrumbs | 3 -4 tablespoons dijon mustard ( depending on taste ) | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Combine bread crumbs and mustard in a bowl. Coat the green beans in the crumb mixture. Place coated beans in a large skillet, turning occasionally, as it fries. Once they are nicely browned and crispy, add additional oil to your skillet if necessary. Add cooked green beans. You may remove the cooked green beans when they are cooked, they should not be browned at all and should be crisp on the outside. You should probably have about 1 cup of green beans now.

title: Chile and Cauliflower Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 250 g sweet italian turkey sausage | 2 large cauliflower | 1 tablespoon icing sugar, sifted | fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Halve & core the cauliflower then cut into thin slices. Heat a small amount of olive oil in fry pan over medium heat. Cook the sausage until it starts to brown. Meanwhile, place the cauliflower slices in a roasting tin around a third of the sausage. Sprinkle with icing sugar, mix well and set aside. Drain the sausage, mix again & add a few sprigs of cilantro & mix well. Roll out about 10cm /8inches thick slices & place onto tray. Spread with the sausage mixture, leaving about 5cm /1½in of space above each slice. Place onto a lightly oiled baking sheet & bake for about 25 minutes or until crisp on the outside and tender in the centre. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: water,spinach,chicken breast,sirloin steak,white wine,plum tomato,raisin,pineapple juice
title: Chicken, Pineapple & Raisins With Sauteed Spinach (Ww Australian)
ingredients: 3/4 lb sirloin steak, cutlet | 1 can diced plum tomatoes, no salt added, cut in small pieces | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon raisins | 1/4 cup canned crushed pineapple in juice, not packed, crushed | 8 ounces fresh spinach, washed, trimmed and drained | 5 fluid ounces chicken fat or 5 fluid ounces light turkey fat
instructions: Put all ingredients except the boneless chicken into a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for about 10 minutes. Add the boneless chicken and continue to simmer until the fat has completely melted and the chicken is cooked through. Serve over egg noodles with a selection of vegetables such as spinach, or zucchini, or a salad.

title: Spicy Honey Duck
ingredients: 1/2 pint honey | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 long hot red chili pepper | freshly grated nutmeg | 1 kg duck breast, skinned and deboned
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f or 180°c. Place the honey, lemon juice and chili in the pan and bring to the boil over a moderate heat, stirring. Then remove from the heat and stir in the grated nutmeg. Wash the duck and pat dry with paper towels. Heat the fat slightly in a roasting tin or a deep ovenproof dish and cook the duck until crisp, brown on all sides and cooked through. Pour half of the honey mixture into a roasting tin or fryer and put it into the center of the oven. Cook at 325°f or 190°c for 3 hours until cooked through and the inside well browned. Serve hot with salads or noodles, as a dipping sauce.

title: Ancho-Chile Wrapped Fajitas
ingredients: 16 dried ancho chiles | 1/2 cup olive oil | 8 tortillas
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high. If desired, lightly oil the grate. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Sprinkle ancho chili peppers onto the foil, and place them under the grill for about 5 minutes or until the chiles turn golden brown on the outside. Cool the chiles on the foil. Remove the chiles from the grill, and place on a sheet of plastic wrap. Smash with a rolling pin or rolling pin, or use a mortar and pestle to grind or grind into a fine powder. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Once the oil is warm, dip each tortilla in the oil, and use a slotted spoon to place 2 tablespoons of the chile powder on each.

title: Farfalle Bread and Egg Pie
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white flour | 2 cups bread, torn into small pieces ( about 6 -8 slices ) | 5 hard-boiled eggs, shelled and cut into wedges ( about 1 cup ) | 1 cup farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1/2 cup fig, chopped
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the flour, 2/3 cup of bread, eggs, farfalle pasta and figs. Spoon into a well buttered 9 pie dish. Cover with remaining bread. Bake, uncovered, in a 375°f oven until bread begins to brown, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,green tomato,chili bean sauce,red chili,sake,sherry wine,pinto bean,black eyed pea
title: Black-Eyed Pea (Mexican)
ingredients: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas | 1 lb pinto beans | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1 tablespoon chili bean sauce | 2 -3 teaspoons sake | 1/2 - 1 cup white sherry wine ( depending on how hot you like it ) or 1/2-1 cup red wine ( depending on how hot you like it ) | 1 large red chili, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Clean all the beans, and place in pot with plenty of water to cover lightly. Boil for about 2 or 3 minutes, then turn off heat. Drain and rinse beans. Leave to soak for about an hour, then drain again. Pour beans into bowl with clean water and cover until water goes completely clean. Then let sit for at least 12 or as many hours for flavors to combine. Drain and rinse beans again. Place beans in pot with fresh water. Bring to boil, and cook slowly until tender, stirring occasionally. As the beans cook, remove skins from the chili and add seeds and a generous amount of sherry to deglaze the bottom of the pot, and add 2 - 3 tablespoons cooking sherry to make it spicier and less sweetened. Stir this back in until it tastes just about right. Add more red pepper if you want it hotter, or hotter bean sauce, and stir in remaining sherry if desired. You may add more sherry. When beans are fully cooked, you can place them in individual serving bowls, and serve with hot corn chips, sour cream, and/or guacamole.

title: Savoury Cardamom Smoothie
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups thick creamy almond milk ( regular sweet dessert milk like milnot or jell ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 green cardamom pods or 1/2 teaspoon finely ground cardamom | 3/4 teaspoon ground mustard | 3 tablespoons sultanas ( dark raisins ) or 3 tablespoons chopped dried apricots ( 1 tbsp )
instructions: Blend all the ingredients together until smooth.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,beef broth,green curry paste,kielbasa,soybean,baking powder,cheese tortellini,amaretto
title: Cheesy Beef and Soba Tostadas
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen cheese tortellini | 1 lb chopped kielbasa | 1 cup beef broth ( can use half water and add some vegetable or beef flavored bou ) | 1 tablespoon soybean | 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 cup amaretto
instructions: Place tortellini in a medium size casserole dish. While tortellini are baking, brown sausage in a large skillet. Stir the sausage into the tortellini and add beef broth and soybean and curry paste. Bring mixture to a boil.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,iceberg lettuce,asafoetida powder,superfine sugar,beef chuck,jicama,baby spinach
title: Chipotle Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 3 cloves fresh chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 cup baby spinach, chopped | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced | 1 package jicama, thinly sliced
instructions: Bring a 5 quart pot of water to a boil. Add beef, chipotle chiles, sugar, asafetida, and 3/4 cup water. Reduce heat to medium low.

Random Ingredients: orange,black bean,dill weed,baking potato,baking soda,red wine vinegar
title: Black Bean Potatoes
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, peeled & cut into chunks ( about 3 1/2 pounds ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 large orange | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cans black beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place potatoes into a colander& sprinkle liberally with salt. Let potatoes sit at room temperature for 15 minutes. Remove and discard zest from the orange& reserve. Pour the orange juice& reserved orange zest into a saucepan. Place the pan over medium heat & add the baking soda, dill weed& orange zest. Stir with a fork until the mixture is well combined. Remove the pan from heat. Squeeze the orange juice into the pan, add the beans and vinegar, and mix thoroughly. Return to the oven& bake, covered, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender, about 1 1/4 hours. Season with salt.

Random Ingredients: double cream,mint,rum,coconut extract,vegetable stock,aubergine,italian plum tomato,superfine sugar
title: Aubergine and Tomato Cotta
ingredients: 3 aubergines | 3 tablespoons superfine sugar | 400 ml vegetable stock | 250 ml double cream | 150 ml chopped italian plum tomatoes | 50 ml dried mint | 1 tablespoon rum
instructions: Preparation, cut the aubergines into long, thin strips, then quarter them lengthways. Slice each quarter diagonaly and sprinkle with a little sugar. Place them in a frying pan with 1 tablespoon olive oil, the vinegar and a little water. Season with salt and cook over a medium low heat until the slices begin to soften around the edges. Transfer to a heatproof bowl and set aside until serving time. Crepes, place the tomatoes between sheets of parchment paper and cut into quarters. Bring a large pan of water to the boil, add 1 tablespoon olive oil and bring back to the boil. Drop the aubergines into the boiling water and boil for 2 minutes, then drain. In the bottom of a 23cm springform cake tin, place half the aubergines. Trim the ends from the tomatoes and halve them crosswise. Bring the vegetable stock to a boil, add the tins of aubergine and simmer for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, place the cream in a pan over a medium heat and cook for 2 minutes, until it comes to the boil. Add the chopped mint, rum and dried mint, then stir to combine. Add the aubergines to the cream and bring back to the boil. Spoon over the crepes, top with the crème fraîche, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,chuck,pasta,wasabi,poblano chile,chicken stock,vanilla extract,pomegranate seed
title: Pasta and Chili Powder (Puerco Con Chile)
ingredients: 8 ounces small pasta ( penne or gemelli ) | 14 ounces ground chuck ( not ground beef ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons wasabi, preferably paste | 15 pomegranate seeds ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon pomegranate seeds, toasted | 2 poblano chiles | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock | 2 teaspoons wasabi, preferably garlic infused | 1 tablespoon wasabi, preferably garlic-infused infused
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, adding the pommegranate seeds. In another large pot, heat a few tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat. Saute the ground chuck for 4 minutes, until it is browned. Drain fat, and transfer chuck, wasabi paste, pomegranate seeds, chiles, and vanilla extract. Stir to combine. Add the chicken stock to the pot, and bring to a boil. Add 1 teaspoon wasabi powder and simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring to prevent scorching. Add 2 tsp wasabi and taste and adjust the seasoning. Simmer an additional 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: fruit,green bean,cucumber,greek yogurt,kalamata olive,white pepper,arborio rice
title: Greek Yogurt Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 2 cups greek yogurt | 2 cups green beans, trimmed of ends and cut into 2 inch lengths | 1/2 cucumber, peeled and minced | 1/4 cup sliced kalamata olives | 1/2 cup mixed fruit, chopped ( i just used grape tomatoes ) | kosher salt and white pepper, to taste
instructions: Cover rice in water and bring to a boil. Reduce to the lowest possible temperature and cook, covered, for 20 minutes or until tender. Combine rice, yogurt, green beans, cucumber, olives and mixed fruit in a large bowl and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,tamari,orange juice zest,sun tomato,dark chocolate,annatto seed
title: Eggplant and Sun-Dried Tomato Appetizers
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 teaspoon annatto seeds | 2 teaspoons orange juice, zest of | 100 g dark chocolate, shaved
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Trim the ends off and discard any very firm ends of the eggplant. Slice the eggplant lenghtways into 3 5cm slices and place into an ovenproof dish. Sprinkle sun dried tomatoes, tamari, annatto seeds & orange rind over the slices and bake in a moderately hot oven for 25 - 30 minutes, flipping once or twice, until golden brown and the tomatoes have softened and all of the eggplant is soft. Remove from oven and place shaved dark chocolate into a small bowl, pour over melted chocolate and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,roast pork,black eyed pea,club soda,gingerroot,plain flour,water chestnut,coconut extract
title: Sizzlin' Pork Baked in Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 cups sliced water chestnuts | 1 can sliced black sesame seeds, drained | 3 lbs boneless roast pork, fat trimmed | 1 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon minced gingerroot | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1/4 cup club soda ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon coconut extract | 4 cups brown's favourite plain flour or 4 cups wholemeal flour
instructions: Put water chestnuts, black sesame seeds, pork, 1 cup flour, and minced gingerroot in a bowl and gently mix together. Pour half of pork batter in each crockpot. Sprinkle remaining flour over top of pork and bean mixture. Pour combined water chestnuts, 1/4 cup club soda, coconut extract into bowl and toss all together. Bake, covered, in slow cooker on low for 6 to 8 hours until pork falls apart. Remove pork and bean mixture to a warm platter and set aside. Allow to cool slightly. Pour juices into a small saucepan and bring to the boil over medium boil. Simmer until mixture is reduced by half, about 2 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. To make the topping, preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Stir all the topping ingredients together in a bowl until well combined. If batter is too thick, add more club soda and/or coconut extract. Dunk the pork into the batter. When coated, transfer to a greased baking sheet, arranging them evenly and evenly. Make each meatball by placing 2 to 3 tablespoons of topping mixture onto each meatball. Place the baking sheet in the centre of the oven and bake for about 20 minutes, or until top is slightly browned and bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Sesame Seeds & Walnuts
ingredients: 3/4 cup walnuts, toasted & chopped ( or more, to taste ) | 2 1/4 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Put all ingredients in small food processor and blend till smooth.

title: Mashed Parsnips Pizza
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried parsnips ( optional ) | 1 pizza dough | 1 french baguette
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Punch the parsnips. Drain the parsnips and pat into a bowl. Roll dough to a 12x15 inch rectangle. Spread parsnips on top of dough and wrap with plastic wrap. Place on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until lightly golden. Cut into 8 slices.

title: Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup whole pickled gherkin, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 3 tablespoons slivered blanched almond, toasted
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the cornmeal and gherkins. Season with white pepper. Stir in almonds. Drop heaped teaspoons onto a non stick griddle or skillet. Cook approximately 2 to 3 minutes, or until golden.

title: Quick Pastry
ingredients: 8 cherry tomatoes | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Place tomato halves on a large baking sheet. Drizzle with confectioners' sugar and mustard. Place under the broiler, just until browned.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,barbecue sauce,margarine,green cardamom pod,corn oil,marinara sauce,beef stew meat
title: Quick Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce, plus | 2 teaspoons barbecue sauce | 1/8 teaspoon green cardamom pod, crushed | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 2 eggplants | 4 tablespoons margarine, melted | 2 cups fresh marinara sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the soy sauce, barbeque sauce and cardamom pods.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,splenda sugar substitute,taco sauce,green chile
title: Fiesta Cheese Wedges
ingredients: 250 g taco sauce | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 tablespoon green chile, chopped | 1 cup shredded texas texas-blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Line a large and sturdy baking tray with tin foil. Combine taco sauce, flour, sugar and green chille in a bowl. Mix together well. Toss the cheese in the flour mixture. Shape the cheese into 12 wedges. Spread cheese over the wedges. Bake in oven for 8 - 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Spanish Tapas
ingredients: 1 jar chopped pitted green olives | 1 jar sliced pitted black olives
instructions: Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place the green olives in the skillet, and toss with green olives. Cover, and keep warm until ready to serve.

title: Easy Crockpot Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, cut into small pieces | 24 1/2 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained and rinsed | 1 package frozen whole wheat pkgs
instructions: Place all ingredients into a 4 quart crockpot. Cook on low for 9 to 10 hours. Serve on fresh bread or rolls with a salad.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,milk chocolate chip,grain white rice,sunflower oil,worcestershire sauce
title: Rice & Chips Arancini With Wilted Milk
ingredients: 2 cups arancini pasta or 2 cups whole wheat penne pasta | 1/3 cup sunflower oil | 1/2 cup milk chocolate chips | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 cups cooked short-grain white rice
instructions: Cook pasta according to pkg directions. Drain and set aside. In small pan heat oil until hot, add chocolate chips and worcestershire sauce, cooking until chocolate melts. Stir constantly until heated through. Stir in rice. Immediately add milk and stir until combined. Pour into an oven proof dish. Place dish on a baking tray and bake at 180ºc for 15 - 20 minutes until set.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,baking powder,plum tomato,pork shoulder,cherry tomato,tomato puree,nonstick cooking spray
title: Sweet Chilli Pork
ingredients: 500 g pork shoulder | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon chili sauce ( your favourite ) | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 1 tablespoon cherry tomatoes | nonstick cooking spray | 1 1/4 cups canned plum tomatoes
instructions: Trim any fat and excess fat from pork. Place pork in a zip lock bag and add seasoning. Seal and combine bag. Refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours turning occasionally. Remove pork and discard marinade discard any excess liquid or grilling. Brown pork in a little nonstick pan sprayed with nonstick spray over medium heat. Add tomato puree, cherry tomatoes, chilli sauce and plum tomatoes to the pan with the pork, and cook, stirring occasionally, for around 15 minutes or until reduced slightly.

title: Chocolate Pintos
ingredients: 3 -4 ounces semisweet chocolate | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions | 1 plum tomato, sliced thin | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pod, cracked | 3/4 cup pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon prosciutto, thinly sliced
instructions: Melt chocolate with scallions or onion and tomato set aside. Add a few drops of oil and crushed cardamom and mix to blend. Fold in pinto beans. Cover and put in the refrigerator for 15 to 30 minutes. Take out the cover and stir. Put the prosciutto on a large piece of foil and put it on a plate. Spread chocolate mixture over the prosciutto, or put the entire chocolate on a piece of foil placed over the peanuts. Put peanuts on the peanuts so that you have a flat top and the sides will roll up slightly to make the peanuts easier to eat. Cut into thin strips and serve.

title: Sherry Wine Filling for Pierogi or Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup dried lukewarm currant | 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Combine the sherry and lukewarm paprika in a small saucepan.

title: Paneer
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable shortening | 4 slices whole wheat bread | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 4 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Heat 1 cup vegetable shortening or butter. Dip each slice of bread in shortening, coating all sides. Lay 2 sheets of phyllo dough side by side on a flat surface. Dip into melted shortening. Fold in half and form triangle. Repeat procedure with remaining sheets.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,chicken bouillon,flat leaf parsley,extra virgin olive oil,corn,farfalle pasta,cilantro
title: Pasta With Sausage, Corn and Herbs
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 2 cans chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 package fresh cilantro | 1 box frozen corn | 1 package bulk dry italian sausage | chopped fresh flat leaf parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling, salted water until al dente. Rinse under cold running water to cool slightly, then drain. While pasta is cooking, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add italian sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Add the chicken bouillon and cook through, about 1 minute. Add the cilantro. Add the pasta and any juices, toss to mix and then place in a serving bowl. Garnish with parsley.

title: Sparkling African Apricot Jam
ingredients: 1 can apricot preserves, sweet or light | 1 liter sparkling water or 1 liter sparkling water, chilled
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a saucepan and bring to boil. Simmer gently until jam reaches desired consistency, about 15 - 20 minutes. Pour into sterilized jam jars and seal. Keep refrigerated for 1 month prior to using.

title: Danish Beet Salad
ingredients: 2 large beets | 20 -250 g red potatoes | 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1/3 cup light corn syrup or 1/3 cup maple syrup | 375 -400 g radishes | crouton | carrot, grated
instructions: Chop the beets into 1 cm cubes and boil until soft. Drain. Wash and quarter the potatoes.

title: Fruit & Veg Sandwich
ingredients: 1 biscuit | 2 pieces mixed dried fruit
instructions: Put your biscuits on a board, one by one, and if you really want, try that one with different shapes and fruit, or some fresh fruit. If anything, just put on top. Put on bread or toast. You could eat these just plain if you're not going to.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,dark sesame oil,salt,self raising flour,tomato ketchup
title: Welsh Rarebit Bread
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 pint buttermilk | 3 -4 tablespoons tomato ketchup
instructions: Sift the flour and salt into a mixing bowl. Add the sesame oil and mix well. To a separate bowl, add the buttermilk and beat with a fork. Gradually add the buttermilk, stirring till just smooth.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,halibut fillet,salsa,graham cracker crumb,italian salad dressing,italian salad dressing mix,chili oil
title: Grilled Halibut With Salsa Dip and Yogurt
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless halibut fillets | 1 envelope dried italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup salsa | 1 cup greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons hot chili oil | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing mix, for dipping
instructions: Place halibut fillets in a shallow glass dish. Sprinkle italian dressing mix over fillets. Pour salsa over the fish.

title: Krafts® Seasoned Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried parsley stems, chopped ( optional ) | 2 packages kraft's fast and flavor deluxe grated cheese. ( or more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with vegetable cooking spray. Sprinkle parsley into bottom of dish well. Spread the cheese over the top of the parsley. Pour grated cheese over the cheese.

title: Spanish Vegetables
ingredients: 6 small turnips, sliced on the bias ( about 1 lb/450 g ) | 2 small zucchini, sliced on the bias ( about 1 lb/450 g ) | 4 tablespoons rum | 1/2 cup strong black coffee
instructions: Heat the grill or oven to high. Place the turnips and zucchini in an 8 x 8 baking dish. Cover tightly and put in the grill or under the grill. Cook, turning often during cooking, for 50 minutes or until tender.

title: Raspberry and Chocolate-Cheese Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 3 whole chickens | butter flavored cooking spray | 1 -2 ounce tequila | 2 fluid ounces amarind paste | 1 cup cubanella chocolate | 1/2 cup chopped ripe olives in olive oil or 1/2 cup unsalted butter | 1/3 - 1/2 cup grated aged cheese | 1/3 cup of freshly shucked raspberry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray baking sheet with a bit of butter spray. Place chicken on the sprayed baking sheet with the flat of a fork. Place baking sheet in preheated oven and bake chicken 45 minutes or until juices run clear and crispy. Cool. When cool, cut chicken into serving size pieces. To make sauce, in a small container, combine sauce ingredients, whisked, and season with salt and pepper. Place sauce in a small dish and set aside.. When cool, remove chicken from baking sheet and pour over some of the sauce. Gently shake to coat chicken all over. Spread about 1/2 cup of the sauce in the bottom of a baking dish, cover with remaining sauce, and spread evenly. Arrange chocolate cubes on top. Top with olives and cheese and drizzle remaining sauce evenly over. Bake 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbly on top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coffee granule,fennel seed,chinese cabbage,plain flour,marsala wine,extra virgin olive oil,walnut oil,green pepper
title: Fennel and Wine Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons flat rice flour | 1 teaspoon dried fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon chinese cabbage, shredded finely | 1 large green pepper, sliced into thin strips | 3/4 cup sweet marsala wine | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon walnut oil
instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan, when it's hot add flour and fry rapidly for 1 minute, stir in fennel and cook 1 - 2 minutes then add the cabbage. Simmer 5 minutes, or until cabbage is crisp tender. Add pepper strips, and cook for one minutes, before adding the marsala and coffee granules. Cook for 2 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer mix to a serving dish, add walnut oil and decorate with dried fennel. Serve while warm.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,celeriac,yellow mustard,tapioca starch
title: Baked Celeriac
ingredients: 1 celeriac | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon tapioca starch
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f on a baking sheet, coat with cooking spray. Peel celeriac and slice into rounds about 3/4 inch thick. Place on top of sheet, tucking in sides. Combine mustard and starch, and sprinkle over celeriac. Bake 10 minutes, or until tender.

title: Puff Shells from Bubba®
ingredients: 4 cups cold water | 2 egg whites
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together cold water, egg whites, and butter or margarine until well blended. Turn on oven broiler setting, and spray cookie sheets with nonstick cooking spray. Drop the dough by about 1 heaping teaspoon onto the center of each cookie sheet. Broil until bubbly and golden, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool, and store in airtight containers.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,venison steak,chuck,basmati rice,cold water
title: Easy Australian Steak
ingredients: 2 medium venison steaks, about 1 inch thick | 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup red curry paste | 1/2 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon red curry paste
instructions: Coat the venison with 1/2 cup of the red curry paste and set aside. Place the rice in a bowl with the 1/2 c water and 1 t. Of the red curry paste and soak for 15 minutes. Heat a grill pan or skillet and sear the steak, approximately 2 - 6 minutes on each side for medium doneness.

Random Ingredients: turnip,cream chicken soup,beef broth,greek seasoning,vegetable bouillon cube,pizza crust,pork sausage,soya sauce
title: Goulash
ingredients: 1 can vegetable bouillon cubes | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 lb pork sausage ( can be left whole or cut in small chunks ) | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1 ready to use pizza crust
instructions: Add bouillon cubes, cream soup, soya sauce, salt and all purpose goulash in a large skillet. Heat ingredients on medium to medium heat. Add sausage. Let cook and break into pieces until the sausage has been thoroughly cooked. Remove all pieces of sausage and place on pizza crust. Sprinkle goulash on top and bake in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes on top of pizza. Let cool to the touch.

title: Chef Flower's American Chop Suey and Budget Friendly
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces elbow macaroni | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. In a non stick sauté pan heat 2 tablespoon of oil on medium high heat. Add the chopped up fresh vegetables and cook for two to three minutes or until just tender. Remove vegetables with a slotted spoon to a bowl with a slotted spoon or paper towel. Increase heat to high. Meanwhile, pour hot cooked pasta onto 4 dinner plates or a baking sheet. Squeeze fresh lime wedge into the vegetables and toss. Serve with garlic bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,caraway seed,orange liqueur,ricotta cheese,lamb stew meat,cumin
title: Lamb Stuffed With Ricotta and Caraway
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds | 1 kg lamb stew meat | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur | 250 g ricotta cheese
instructions: Season the lamb with the spices. Mix the cheese with 1/2 the spice mix and spread in the hollow. Cover the top with the ricotta cheese mixture and secure with string or toothpicks. Cook in a saucepan over low heat for about 2 1/2 hours. Serve with noodles.

Random Ingredients: jumbo shrimp,spinach leaf,rice noodle,green pepper,serrano pepper
title: Simple Noodles With Shrimp & Spinach
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons jumbo shrimp, thawed and chopped | 1 1/2 cups jumbo shrimp ( optional ) or 1 1/2 cups jumbo shrimp, cooked on the tail | 1/4 cup green pepper | 1 serrano pepper, sliced ( optional )
instructions: In a nonstick pan with a tight lid combine shrimp, spinach/shrimp, green pepper, and serrano peppers. Cover and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,white onion,poppy seed,caraway seed,red cabbage,chili flake,yellow mustard seed,triple sec
title: Red Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 large head red cabbage ( about 1.5 pounds ) | 1 medium white onion | 6 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon white onion, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons triple sec
instructions: Cut the cabbage from the top to bottom, then into 1/2 slices. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and blanch the cabbage for about 45 seconds. Using slotted spoon, transfer the slaw to a large bowl. Grate 1/2 teaspoon of onion into the cabbage, and squeeze as much liquid from the cabbage as possible. Add dark soy sauce, poppy seeds, mustard seeds, caraway seeds, and minced white onion. Combine thoroughly. Add the triple sec. Pour into the cabbage, and mix well. Stir and toss well until evenly coated. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: A Simple Filipino Prawn
ingredients: 30 large fresh prawns, raw | 1 cup tapioca starch
instructions: Shell, devein and rinse prawns. Combine prawn and tapioca starch in a large bowl and stir to combine. Marinate in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes. Cook over medium heat and stir to remove any clumped surface. Heat oven to 200 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with plastic wrap and lay prawns on it. Place in the oven and bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,bamboo shoot,rice noodle,green chili pepper,pickling cucumber,green bell pepper
title: Quick Asian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles ( i use thin ones and use 2 ) | 4 green chili peppers, sliced | 8 slices bamboo shoots ( from an asian market - i buy the canned ones if they are all too small- i've also used 2 ) | 4 teaspoons sesame oil | 4 slices pickling cucumbers ( optional ) | 1 green bell pepper, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles till tender according to package directions. Drain and rinse. Tear noodles into bite size pieces. Place one chopped green chili on each of the rice noodles and place in a large salad bowl. Add 3 slices of bamboo shoots and 3 slices of cucumbers. Repeat these 3 steps until all the ingredients are gone.. Add sesame oil in small increments to the noodles and mix into salad ingredients. Sprinkle with green pepper slices if desired.

title: Quick Roast Beef
ingredients: 12 ounces lean beef, well trimmed | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Heat oven to 150 f. Place beef in oven for 15 minutes. Reduce oven to 325 f and continue roasting for 1 hour and 15 minutes for rare or to your preference. Allow the meat to rest for 20 minutes before carving. Remove the beef and fat from the pan. Cover with foil and bake in the lower third of the oven for 3 1/2 hours or until desired doneness. Remove the beef from the pan, cover with foil and set aside. Shred with a fork and serve. Slice thinly with remaining fat and juices when serving.

Random Ingredients: lebanese bread,arugula leaf,chicken soup base,onion,corn oil,white wine
title: Arugula-Ribbon French Bread Soup (Quick)
ingredients: 1 bag arugula-romaine lettuce leaves | 1 can condensed chicken soup base | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 4 ounces lebanese bread | 1/4 cup fresh white wine | 2 tablespoons minced onion
instructions: Remove the hard outer green leaves from arugula leaves after blanching in a large pot of salted water for 3 - 4 minutes, then refresh under cold water. Chop them coarsely and set aside in a bowl of iced water. Drain well. In a small bowl combine soup base, oil, bread, onion, arugula, and chateaubriand and combine well. Place a bowl of iced water next to arugula in the pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove bowl, then add arugula to soup and stir well. Serve immediately.

title: Albondigas Rosadas
ingredients: 2 lbs small russet potatoes | 1/2 cup barley ( white, brown or black best ) | 3 garlic cloves, chopped | 1 whole green chile, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Peel potatoes, boil until tender. Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Cut each potato in half and cut each piece into wedges. Place potato wedges in mixture and cover with a dish towel. Place on tray and sprinkle with salt to taste. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line baking sheet with aluminum foil, coat with cooking spray and place potato wedges in, on the center of sheet, over the mixture, so that the potatoes form a layer. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 20 minutes.

title: Mango & Chive Sushi
ingredients: 200 g short-grain rice | 400 g ripe mangoes ( ripe and very finely diced, about 4 cups ) | 1 sheet nori | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon french mustard | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped | 500 g pasta, cooked
instructions: Wash the rice in lots of well salted water. Mix all ingredients well and leave to soak for about 45mins until cooked. Line your sushi mat with greaseproof paper and put over a medium heat. Take the rice from the fridge 1 hr before making the sushi. Place the nori in a pan and cook for about 5 - 6 mins then flip to cook on the other side about 5 mins until it's lightly browned.
