Take the nori out of the oven and cut into thin strips about 1cm wide. Cut the rest of the ingredients into cubes about the same size. Place the diced mangoes on a plate and cover with cling wrap or a tea towel, leave for 10 mins. Remove the clingwrap/wrapping paper from the nori and cut into cubes about 1cm wide. Cook the sabe in a pan of boiling water 6 - 7 mins, drain, and keep warm. Once the sushi is cooked start making the sushi. Heat up the sushi mat until it's warm and put a few cubes of nori on the mat. Spread a little sunflower oil over each nori piece, then place about a tablespoon of the grated mangoes at one end. Roll the mat around the ingredients, tucking in halfways, then turn over and roll the rest of the way. Once ready, lay a piece of sabe, about the size of an olive, flat against the sabe. Repeat the process until you have finished all the sabe. Remove the sabe from the pan and let cool 2 - 3 mins then cut through the nori to serve.

title: Quick & Easy White Bean Veggies
ingredients: 2 cans white beans, do not drain | 1 cup broccoli floret, do not drain
instructions: Add 3/4 can of beans to water at a time. Stir to mix. If they do not stick together, add 1/4 can more of beans. Stir. Cook uncovered for about 25 minutes or until beans are softened. Add broccoli. Cook an additional 5 minutes or until veggies are tender. Serve and enjoy.

title: Wild Rice With Blueberries (Rajma)
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice | 1/2 cup dried blueberries ( frozen ) | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder
instructions: Place wild rice in a heavy bottomed pan with 2 - 2 1/4 cups water. Bring to a boil and stir constantly. When water comes to a boil, cover the pan and turn the heat to very low. Simmer for 20 - 45 minutes. Add blueberries and turmeric and stir. Cover the pan and cook for 20 minutes longer, or until the wild rice has absorbed all the water. Turn the heat on to a higher heat, put cover back in, and simmer for 15 minutes more, or until wild rice is tender and berries are softened.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,pork tenderloin,sea salt,plum tomato,orange zest,lime juice zest,bay leaf
title: Tenderloins With Plum Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | sea salt | 1 bay leaf | 1 orange, zest of, sliced | 1 lime, zest of, sliced | 2 ripe plum tomatoes, halved | 1 -2 tablespoon lime juice, zest of | 1/2 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425, gas mark 5/190'c. Rub together the salt and bay leaf, and place on the tenderloins. Place the pan in the oven and roast for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the meat is cooked throughout. Transfer the tenderloins to a large carving board and shred the fat with 2 forks. Bring the salsa, zest, tomatoes and ½ cup warm water to the boil, and remove the pan from the heat. Add the flour to the salsa and stir until smooth. Season with salt and pepper and return to the hot grill for 2 minutes, until the liquid has reduced. Serve with the meat and salsa. To make the salsa,. Put the reserved tomato juice in a small frying pan set on a low heat. Crush the tomatoes with the back of a spoon, and add to the pan. Stir over low medium heat with the lime juice.

title: Vodka in Jalapeno Chiles
ingredients: 1 quart vodka | 1 teaspoon pickled jalapeno chile peppers
instructions: Pour the vodka into a mixing shaker, or glass to fill a 1 1/2 to 2 gallon jar. Add the chile peppers and shake to combine. Strain into a chilled 1 1/2 pint bottle or jar.

Random Ingredients: pickling salt,red wine vinegar,chunky salsa,hard cheese,pumpkin seed,maraschino cherry,tortilla chip,hot water
title: Homemade Mexican Salsa Con Pepitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry medium hot water | 1 1/3 cups bottled thick and chunky salsa, preferably mild | 1/4 cup pickling salt | 1 1/3 cups hot pickling salt | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons chunky salsa ( mild ) | 2 -10 whole wheat tortilla chips | 2 cups coarsely chopped roasted, salted pumpkin seeds, about 2 ounces | 1 1/2 lbs grated hard cheese
instructions: Heat water to boiling over high heat. Meanwhile, mix 2 - ½ cups salt with 1 - ¼ cups hot water in a bowl. Stir 1 - ½ cups salsa into hot water to dissolve salt, stirring frequently. Let stand until mixture has cooled to room temperature, stirring often, about 15 minutes. Transfer salsa mixture to a bowl and combine drained salt, vinegar, salsa, and 1 - ¼ cups hot water. Add tortilla chips and cheese.

title: Quick and Easy Goulash
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground chuck ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons minced white onions
instructions: Crumble meat into medium bowl. Heat nonstick skillet over medium high heat and add onion. Sauté about 1 minute. Add ground chuck and stir to combine. Sauté 2 minutes until no raw chuck shows. Stir in the onion mixture, and continue cooking, stirring now and then, until liquid is reduced and meat is heated through. Adjust seasonings and serve.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,beef gravy,kalamata olive,chili powder,quinoa,italian herb,graham wafer crumb,sunflower oil
title: Beef & Cheese Stuffed Nuts
ingredients: 3/4 cup prepared beef gravy | 1/4 cup crumbled reduced-fat gouda cheese | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 4 cups cooked quinoa | 2 tablespoons dried italian herbs | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/3 cup kalamata olive | 4 whole graham wafer crumbs
instructions: Stir together beef gravy, cheese, and oil. Stir in quinoa, herbs, and chili powder. Shape mixture evenly among wafer rounds. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons beef mixture onto each round. Roll crumbs around beef and then press crumbs to help hold in shape.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,sesame seed,corn flake,oregano leaf,chicken stock cube,cumin
title: Sesame Corn and Garlic Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons toasted sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons dry oregano leaves | 3 tablespoons chicken stock cubes | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 can condensed beef gravy | 1 tablespoon corn flakes, crushed, for garnish
instructions: Melt the sesame seeds in boiling water for 30 seconds. Drain. Place the sesame seeds in a mortar and pound with a pestle or a flat flat grater. Add the oregano and chicken stock and bring to the boil. Add the cumin, then stir in the cornflakes and boil for 1 minute or until the soup has thickened and the cornflakes are heated through. Remove the soup from heat. Divide among warmed soup bowls and top with freshly ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,bulk italian sausage,cannellini bean,pepper sauce,broth,shallot,red apple,greek yogurt
title: Bistec Encebollado (Beef 'N' Sausage Bean Soup)
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 4 ounces roasted red apples, grated or grated | 1/2 cup shallot, minced | 1 can cannellini beans ( white kidney beans can be used ), drained | 2 cups broth | 1/2 cup bottled oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons all purpose greek yogurt | 1 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: In a skillet, heat 1 tbs oil over medium high heat and saute sausage, apple and shallots until lightly browned. Stir in beans, broth, oyster sauce, and hot pepper sauce. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Tuna Mashed Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans sprouts | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Drain the can of tuna and place it in a blender with beans and 1/2 cup of yogurt. Cover and blend until smooth, adding more yogurt or water if necessary. Stir in mustard seeds and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Mackerel
ingredients: 1 whole mackerel fillet | 1 sponge cake | 1/2 - 1 cup meat, of your choice
instructions: Clean the mackerel and cut into pieces of the required size and shape. Mix all the ingredients together and cover. Leave in fridge for at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with fresh vegetables and rice.

title: Mexican Army Hot Sauce
ingredients: 16 serrano peppers | 1 cup molasses | 4 ounces dried chili
instructions: To use molasses you need to clean your hands. Start by cleaning your hands and clean them. Rinse the serrano peppers and wash them well with warm water. Place them in a pot of warm water. Add the serrano peppers to the pot. Add the serrano peppers to the pot. Use a spoon to pour the molasses inside the pan and stir. Turn heat to low and simmer for about 20 minutes. Serve cold.

title: Miso En Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas, 5 x 3/4-inch ( i use whole wheat ) | 1/4 cup reduced-fat yoghurt | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 tablespoon red miso ( i used soy sauce )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil. Brush both sides of each tortilla with water. Place on baking sheet and broil until golden on both sides and soft and just starting to blacken on each side, about 2 minutes, checking to make sure you have a nice, firm tortilla and still a slight crunch. Turn over the tortillas and repeat with remaining tortillas. Combine yoghurt, lemon zest and miso in a small bowl. Spread 1 tablespoon of yoghurt mixture in center of each. Top with 1/2 teaspoon sour cream. Roll up, tucking in sides, and serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,plain yogurt,hummus,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Quick Cheese & Roasted Pepper Dip
ingredients: 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 cups roasted yellow bell peppers or 1 1/2 cups jarred roasted red peppers | 1 cup plain yogurt | 3/4 cup hummus
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and puree until smooth, about 20 - 30 minutes. Transfer to a small glass serving bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Sparkled Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup whole blanched almond | 1 tablespoon ground orange zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Spread almonds on baking sheets. Bake almonds in the preheated oven until golden brown and fragrant, 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool to room temperature then chop finely. Mix almonds with the zest. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

title: Southern Fried Sandwiches With the Pork -- a Little Bit Different
ingredients: 2 slices american cheese ( or provolone ) | 1 slice fat free bacon | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1 loaf french bread, cut about 5 inches thick ( sliced thick )
instructions: On one slice of bread, put some of your choice of toppings, then put a slice of cheese on top, but just don't put top on. Then, if you have a sandwich maker, put bread in toaster oven to melt the cheese, or put it in toaster and melt the bacon, bacon, and tomato juice in it, and let cool a little bit before topping with toppings. Slice sandwich in half, and serve with tomato and lettuce sauce.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,taco sauce,wide rice noodle,pepperoni,fruit nectar
title: Mexican Noodle Loaf
ingredients: 1 package wide rice noodles ( i used the ones at trader joe's ) | 1 cup dried fruit nectar | 1 jar pepperoni, sliced | 1 package taco sauce ( mild or hot, depends on your taste ) | 1 package egg noodles, cooked and drained ( i use the hot )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray a 10x15 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, place the noodles, nectar and pepperoni. Add taco sauce, if desired. Press noodles down into the pan, making sure noodles are evenly coated. In a 13x9 baking dish or 2 quart baking dish, pour the meat mixture over the noodles. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for about 40 minutes, until bubbly. This can be done in the microwave on high or let me sit off the heat for a few minutes, or transfer to an oven safe dish and broil for one to two minutes or until browned.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,purpose white flour,snow pea,juniper berry,arborio rice
title: Johnd's Rice Ball With Snow Peas
ingredients: 4 cups arborio rice | 1/2 cup canola oil or 1/2 cup other cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups fresh snow peas ( trimmed and cut into 3 inch lengths ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped juniper berries, crushed | 1 tablespoon all-purpose white flour
instructions: Cook rice in 5 cups of hot water, uncovered, over medium heat until slightly softer. Drain and transfer to a 2 1/2 quart round casserole dish, cover tightly and cool 5 minutes. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°f coat baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Place rice in a colander and rinse under cold running waterdump rice between 2 sheets of waxed paper and press lightly into the center with your hands. Flip the rice 1/4 turn, flatten the rice a little and remove paper. Drain the rice back into the dish with the peels and the other strips. Toss with 1/4 cup cold water, then sprinkle the snow peas, juniper and flour over all. Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until rice is tender and top is golden brown and crisp.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,bread,kalamata olive,taco seasoning mix,poppy seed,cornmeal
title: Oriental Filling for Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf crusty bread | 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1/2 cup pitted kalamata olive, halved | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds, or to taste | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix, or to taste
instructions: Turn bread out onto a baking sheet. Drizzle bread with 1 tablespoon cornmeal, and sprinkle the bread with 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix, poppy seeds, olives, and sesame seeds. Repeat layers once more, sprinkling bread with other tablespoon of cornmeal until you have used all of the bread. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and cook bread for 5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,grand marnier,tahini,beetroot,meat,oyster sauce,peanut oil sesame
title: Beef and Beetroot Skewers
ingredients: 1 can beets, whole ( peeled and sliced 1-inch thick ) | 1/4 lb shaved meat or 1/4 lb shredded beef | 2 tablespoons minced fresh jalapeno peppers | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon tahini | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/4 cup peanut oil or 1/4 cup sesame oil
instructions: Blanch beets by submerging them in boiling water for 2 minutes before removing to a colander to drain. Cut into thin strips. Mix remaining marinade ingredients together, and set aside. Place beets in a large bowl or resealable bag. Add remaining marinade ingredients, and toss with beets to coat. Marinate meat while marinating. Heat oil in a wok or large heavy skillet over high heat, and heat for 1 minute. Quickly stir fry beef until cooked, 5 - 6 minutes, tossing occasionally. Serve with beets.

title: Spinach and Kale (Zuccini Cacciatore)
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen mixed baby spinach, thawed and drained | 2 cups fresh okra or 2 cups frozen baby spinach | 1 large red pepper ( or 1-1 1/2 cups bottled roasted red peppers ) ( optional ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 lbs kale ( about 2 large bunches, chopped with stems and leaves )
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions. Meanwhile, cook okra in boiling water over medium high heat until crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Drain well and cool slightly.

title: Cape Cod or Fish in Coffee
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower margarine | 1/3 cup finely chopped pickling cucumbers, with seeds | 1 1/4 cups water | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules or 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1/2 lb fresh fish | barley
instructions: Cut cleaned fish into 6 pieces or 3 fish pieces and place in a shallow dish. Combine water, margarine, cucumber and coffee granules. Dip fish in mixture and cover in marinade. Let sit 2 hours or more in refrigerator. Bring to a boil on the stove top. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 30 minutes. Add the fish.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,creole seasoning,fast rising yeast,rum extract,grain white rice,dill
title: Smoky Rice Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 9 ounces fast-rising yeast | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1/2 teaspoon rum extract
instructions: In a large heavy bottomed pot heat the water, rice, hot sauce and creole seasoning. Bring to a boil. Cover and place on the lowest speed in the pan. Allow to simmer for 25 minutes. Remove from heat. Add the yeast, dill and rum extract to the mixture. Let stand for 5 minutes. Add additional hot sauce to taste and mix well until combined. Pour into a clear glass container or plastic containers and refrigerate for 8 to 12 hours. Yield, 2 1/2 to 3 cups.

Random Ingredients: meat,bisquick baking mix,wine,red chilies,pecorino romano cheese,tomato paste,sauce
title: Maggie Beer's Chili Dog Biscuits - Copycat Recipe!
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 4 ounces tomato paste | 1 teaspoon crushed red hot chilies ( can reduce to 2 t ) | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 cup bisquick reduced-sodium baking mix | 1 ounce pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray a 12 inch deep dish pizza pan with cooking spray. In a medium mixing bowl, combine ground meat, tomato paste, chilies, hot sauce, and bisquick mix.

title: Mexican Grilled Chicken Wings
ingredients: 14 fluid ounces salsa | 3 tablespoons ground pecans | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 4 pounds beef top round steak, cut into thirds | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 pound chicken wings, tips removed
instructions: Mix salsa, pecans, oregano, and beef in a bowl, and pour over meat. Marinate in the refrigerator at least 2 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for direct heat, and lightly oil grate. Soak about 30 minutes in water, until meat is lightly soaked. Remove meat, and squeeze as much water out while continuing to drain. Place the chicken wings on the oiled grate, and cook about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,herbes de provence,spinach leaf,canola oil,velveeta cheese
title: Spinach Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 8 ounces velveeta cheese | 1 cup spinach leaves | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 tablespoon herbes de provence
instructions: In hot skillet melt oil and fry spinach until wilted. Remove and drain. Cut velveeta into small pieces and add to skillet. Cook until cheese starts to melt. Add salt, pepper and herbes de province. Drain spinach well and stir to combine. Sprinkle cheese on top and toss until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,velveeta cheese,belgian endive,dark brown sugar,green grape,pumpkin puree,cashew
title: Crusty Belgian Endive and Grapes
ingredients: 1 lb belgian endive | 1 lb assorted dark-brown sugar snap pea pods or 1 lb assorted green seedless grape | 1 can pumpkin puree ( or 1 14oz. can, undiluted ) | 2/3 cup cashews | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 lbs velveeta cheese ( cut into 1/2-inch cubes ) | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( packed )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut ends off endive, then cut diagonally into 1/4 slices. Rinse peel and cut pea pods in half lengthwise. Place cut side of pea pods onto a parchment lined baking sheet. Broil, watching carefully, until tops begin to char, being careful with edges, about 2 minutes per side. Meanwhile, place pumpkin or green peas into a bowl. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup water and turn heat under peas to medium/high. Add about 2/3 cup water, cover peas with a paper towel, and let steam until they are soft, 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain peas and reserve liquid. Toast cashews in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Stir nuts into pumpkin/peas in baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 c sugar. Cut velveeta into 1/2 inch cubes. Cut remaining cheese into 1/4 inch cubes. Heat broiler. Coat dish with cooking spray. Spread bread mixture evenly over nut mixture in dish. Broil until cheese is melted and beginning to brown, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Brandy and Orange Marmalade
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable bouillon | 2/3 cup orange marmalade, strained | 1/3 cup brandy or 1/3 cup rum, to taste
instructions: Using a food processor or a mortar and pestle, or with a rolling pin, coarsely grind the bouillon. Add the orange marmalade, brandy, or rum and process or blend lightly. Serve immediately, or store in tightly covered, airtight container.

title: Apple Peach Salad
ingredients: 2 apples, pared, cored and sliced | 2 peaches, pared, sliced
instructions: Place apple slices in a medium serving bowl. Layer peaches on top of apple. Drizzle with dressing. Note, if salad is served within an hour, you can arrange the fruit under a very hot broiler to give it an extra 'toast' feel.

title: Low-Fat Baked Smoked Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2/3 cup low-fat natural soymilk | 4 teaspoons reduced fat sour cream or 4 teaspoons low-fat sour cream | 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed and tied | 1 celery rib, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Combine the soymilk, sour cream, and remaining ingredients in a shallow dish. Arrange the tenderloin on a broiler pan. Broil 5 inches from the heat for 20 minutes, brushing with the marinade while broiling. Turn the tenderloin and brush with remaining marinade during the 20 minutes of cooking.

title: Easy Yellow Pepper Pickle Relish
ingredients: 10 dill pickles, sliced | 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 1 large yellow pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Seed and core your peppers. Dice into tiny cubes. I use a food processor to make sure i don't pulse everything too finely. I use the pulse setting of my processor. Add your onion and mix. Add your diced ingredients and mix it all together. Add the vanilla. Serve as a condiment with grilled meats and other veggies.

title: Lefse-Swedish Leeks and Eggs
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs | 3 leeks | 3 ounces red wine, to cover
instructions: Heat the broiler/griddle. Peel the leeks and cut them in half length ways, scrape out any black part with a sharp knife. Cut the half lengths into slices about 1 cm wide at the sharpest part. Remove the hard boiled eggs from the shells. Slice off the upper and lower hard portion.

title: Peppered Farina Quesadilla
ingredients: 1 flour tortilla ( or 1 pita in a pinch of ciabatta dough ) | 8 -12 slices pepperoni ( thick slices ) or 8 -12 slices provolone cheese ( thick slices ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup farina, or more according to taste ( see all purpose greek farina with pepperoni cheese and provolone cheese )
instructions: If you've got a flat baking sheet with raised edges you can arrange it to form a crescents or place your tortilla on it and lightly pierce with a fork. It should stick together like a pita. If it doesn't it doesn't have enough, just slice it like you would normal and make sure its sticking together. Place pan on its side on the rack in the oven. As you work the tortilla put up to 4 to 6 tablespoons of flour into a cup or small bowl with farina in it. Whisk to mix. If it does not fit blend well or it clumps add flour and whisk if you're using the farina then just stir it inches if you've got a pizza cutter then go ahead and use it or just cut it. You can spread the farina on the tortilla if you wish but you have to do your best when it's done it should stick together, not have it gluey. It helps to place it on the pan or on the table if you make a series then it can be cut into bite size strips. Place in the oven on your lowest setting for about 7 minutes, until the farina begins to bubble and is golden on the edges. If it gets too brown the entire outside will be crunchy and sticky. Remove the pittas with a spatula and transfer on plates with a spatula. Serve on a warm plate and with your favorite toppings.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,thyme sprig,chili flake,tikka paste,turmeric
title: Tikka (Spicy Lemon Chutney)
ingredients: 4 teaspoons tikka paste ( or other spicy paste ) | 1 fresh thyme sprig | 1 tablespoon lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes ( or adjust to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in glass jar. Shake well. Place in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Use at least a few teaspoons of the mixture per chutney. Chill at least a few hours before serving. Variation, stir 1/4 cup mayonnaise into chutney to make a lovely sauce.

title: Roasted Horseradish
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 ounces prepared horseradish, in jar | 1 fluid ounce liquid smoke, no nitrate
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix all ingredients in large bowl until well blended, add more liquid smoke if needed. Spread on rack of broiler pan or baking pan. Roast about 1 1/2 hours or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Homemade Chips - Chips Au Lait
ingredients: 1 ounce oil for frying | salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a deep fryer or large heavy skillet over medium high heat until oil is just beginning to smoke. The temperature of the oil should be about 350 degrees f. Pour a small amount of oil into a paper towel lined glass jar. Run the paper towel around the inside of the jar to release some of the steam, then drain any oil remaining in the jar. Smear with salt and pepper. Cover the jar and shake to mix.

title: Chive Appetizer
ingredients: 1 baked pie shell | 1 bunch chives | 1/2 sweet onion, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix chives and sweet onion together. Brush pie shell with a little oil. Place pie shell on a cookie sheet and top with chive mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for about 25 minutes, or until top is lightly browned. Allow pie to rest for 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Moroccan Meatballs
ingredients: 3 pounds lean ground beef | 3 tablespoons cumin
instructions: Heat a skillet over moderately high heat. Add ground beef and cumin. Cook, stirring until well browned, about 5 minutes. Pour onto a plate, season with salt and pepper. Roll and flatten meat mixture. Return meat to pan, and cook, turning to brown evenly, until all sides are browned and meat is cooked through, about 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Phyllo Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked ground meat | 1/2 cup whole kernel corn | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup black olives, very finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh marjoram or 2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves, well chopped | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Mix meat, corn, onion, olives, marjoram and half of pkgs. Of phyllo until thoroughly mixed and lightly coated in a little of the olive oil. Brush bottom layer of phyllo generously with olive oil mix a little more and then cover with another layer of phyllo. Cut phyllo into 3 or 6 strips and place on baking sheets. Top phyllo stacks with remaining phyllo and brush with more olive oil mix lightly again. Bake at 425 degrees for 40 minutes covered and then 10 minutes under a hot broiler or until golden.

title: Crock Pot Pork Chops With Sweet Chili Peppers
ingredients: 1 pork chop | 2 cans pineapple in juice, undrained | 1/2 - 3/4 cup jalapeno, chopped | 1/8 cup italian salad dressing
instructions: Place pork chops in slow cooker. In a small bowl, stir together the pineapple juice, jalapenos, salad dressing and remaining ingredients and pour evenly over chops. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Chocolate Chili Peppers
ingredients: 4 green peppers ( large and sliced in half ) | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Heat the oil in a pot big enough for the pepper or fry pan to medium high heat. Once you can smell the oil it is ready. Add the peppers and stir. Stir and let them roast on the bottom until the meat is dry and the peppers are soft. Sprinkle the cocoa powder, mixed spice and vanilla on top, let them cook for a few minutes to absorb the flavors. Serve with chocolate chips on the side. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,canola oil,no salt tomato,lemon pepper
title: Low-Sodium Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup no-salt-added diced tomatoes | 1 teaspoon canola oil | freshly ground lemon-pepper | 1 tablespoon blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Puree the tomatoes with a little water. Season with lemon pepper. Grate in a food processor. Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add tomatoes and cook until thick. Stir in the cheese, and heat through.

Random Ingredients: star anise pod,navel orange,black bean,tortilla,rice paper
title: Navy Black Bean Roll
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice paper | 1 navel orange, peeled, pith removed, cut into eclairs | 1 star anise pod | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup prepared spiral rice vegetables ( such as french fries, carrots, cucumbers, or peas ) ( optional )
instructions: Fill a medium size saucepan halfway with water. Add rice paper.

title: Tuscan Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried cannellini beans, soaked overnight in lots of cold water | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/8 cup fresh lime juice | mint sprig
instructions: Drain the beans and place in a heavy saucepan with water and the ketchup. Cover the pan and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat and simmer for 1 minute. Add the lime juice. Ladle the beans and liquid into bowls and garnish with mint. Serve at once, or refrigerate until serving.

title: Baked Rice Balls
ingredients: 2 cups rice | 1 tablespoon of cinnimon cinnamon or 1 tablespoon of cinnamon sugar | 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: In a pan, cook rice according to package directions. While waiting for rice to cook, combine all ingredients in a medium size bowl. When rice is ready, take a bowl out and stir with rice with a fork so that the rice falls apart. If there are some lumps, you can add more of the cinnamon sugar and cinnimon. If that fails, simply mix and re mix. Place this mixture in the fridge until it is cold and can be served.

title: Swiss Roll-ups Recipe II
ingredients: 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 lb deli salami, cut in julienne strips | 1/2 lb swiss kielbasa, cut in 1 in. thick slices | 1/4 lb deli 98 % fat-free spreadable smoked provolone cheese | 8 pieces celery | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: Prepare roll ups on jelly roll pans or cookie sheet or lightly greased pillsbury loaf pans. In medium mixing bowl, combine ricotta cheese, salami, kielbasa, celery and spreadable cheese. Top with provolone cheese. Chill for 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Steak With Capers and Egg Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg white | 1/3 cup capers, drained | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, sliced | 2 tablespoons sirloin or 1 beef top round steak, trimmed | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In shallow dish, whisk egg and capers until well blended. Place steak on lightly oiled grill rack, skin side up, close together. Grill over medium heat 3 - 5 minutes for medium rare, 2 - 3 minutes for medium well.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,wheat flour,grain rice,beer,chile pepper,cream mushroom soup,daikon radish,bacon dripping
title: Soup Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3 links bacon drippings | 2 bunches daikon radishes, sliced | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 12 fresh chile peppers, halved | 1 bottle beer
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a 2 quart casserole dish with vegetable cooking spray. Bring 2 cups jasmine rice to a boil in a saucepan with a small amount of water. Turn down the heat as low as possible, cover, and simmer at least 30 minutes, or until rice is almost tender. Remove from heat and set aside. Pour the sauteed rice into a bowl, and let cool for a few minutes. While the rice is cooling, heat the bacon dripping in a skillet over medium heat, and gently sauté the daikon, stirring often, for about 5 minutes, until golden brown. Stir in the sauteed rice, cream of mushroom soup, and bacon drippings.

title: Zucchini Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 large zucchini, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes ( or 1/2 cup water, and 1 tsp. salt )
instructions: Place zucchini in pan of boiling water. Add bouillon. Cover and simmer for 7 - 10 minutes on high, or until zucchini is tender. Stir the contents of the pan. Serve over bread or noodles that have been cooked.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,pancetta,beef brisket,yellow bell pepper,feta cheese,egg noodle,grape tomato
title: Easy Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef brisket, trimmed and tied | 1/3 cup grape tomatoes or 1/3 cup cherry tomatoes, cut into halves | 1/3 cup yellow bell pepper, cut into strips | 2 ounces finely diced pancetta ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 egg or 2 egg-sized hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Cut brisket crosswise in half horizontally, trimming some off with scissors to fit the pan. Arrange beef in a single layer in prepared roasting pan. Arrange tomatoes, bell pepper strips, pancetta, and egg over top of brisket. Sprinkle feta evenly over the top and dot with crumbled feta. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees f for 1 hour. Remove from oven and allow to sit for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with noodles or rice.

title: Cheese Fondue With a Kick
ingredients: 3 ounces monterey jack cheese or 3 ounces longhorn cheese, cut into 3 1/2 inch cubes | 10 fluid ounces hot pepper sauce
instructions: Put grated cheese into a fondue pot and set over the flame. Stirring frequently, cook slowly until cheese is completely melted and bubbly. Pour hot pepper sauce into fondue pot, add 1 cup hot water and stir to combine. Serve hot with crackers or as a filling for tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: trout,lettuce leaf,natural bran,tabasco sauce,cream tartar,kielbasa,bicarbonate soda
title: Smoked Kielbasa and Country Style Trout Salad
ingredients: 1 pint sour cream or 1 pint sour cream | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( optional ) | 10 ounces smoked kielbasa, sliced finely | 1 bunch rocket or 1 bunch english lettuce leaf, washed and dried | 2 tablespoons natural bran, soaked in 1/2 pint hot vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce or 1 1/2 teaspoons other hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 pinch ground fat trimmings ( such as onion, sage, or rocket ) or 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda
instructions: In a bowl, combine the sour cream and bicarb. Strain the sour cream into a jug and stir through the kielbasa. Taste and seasoning with salt and pepper if necessary. Divide the kielbasa mixture into six even portions and carefully toss together with the rocket leaves. Toss the bran in the vinegar with the tabasco and bicarb soda and pour over the bran flavoured kielbasa. Serve with a salad of herb trimmings or the other flavors at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: baby clam,chili oil,half,sunflower seed,beef stew meat,collard green,fennel
title: Slow-Cooked Corned Beef With Collard Greens & Corn Ceviche
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 2 bunches collard greens, trimmed, cored, thick stems removed, and finely chopped | 2 bunches baby clams, scrubbed | 1 bunch fennel, trimmed, cored, halved, and finely chopped | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Spread sunflower seeds on rimmed baking sheet, and bake at 350°f for 2 minutes. Set aside. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over moderately high heat. Add beef, and brown just until beginning to darken, turning once. Remove beef with a slotted spoon, and set aside. Add collard greens, baby clams, fennel, fennel greens, and sunflower seeds. Saute until greens and fennel are hot and beginning to wilt, then return beef to skillet, and stir to combine. Add half and half, reduce heat to low, and simmer, uncovered, until beef is very tender, approximately 3 - 4 hours.

title: Irish Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 medium new potatoes | 2 small beetroots | 4 tablespoons grated fresh courgettes
instructions: Boil the potatoes and beetroot in water until tender. Drain the potatoes and beetroot, reserving the water, and leave to cool. When cool, cut them into slices of about the same size using a mandolin or scissors. Peel the beetroot and potato. Shred the potatoes, and mix with the beetroots, courgette and half the crumbled boiled potato. Chill in the refrigerator for about 3 hours before serving.

title: Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 tablespoon cumin seeds, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons roasted sweet onions, minced, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour the barbecue sauce into a bowl, sprinkle with cumin seeds, and mix. Stir cooked rice, hot cooked noodles, or other grain of your choice to eat with hot or sweet red beans.

Random Ingredients: veal,almond,swiss chard leaf,egg white,yellow cornmeal,yukon gold potato
title: Swiss Chard & Potato Tortilla
ingredients: 4 large yukon gold potatoes, peeled, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick slices | 1/4 lb veal, finely chopped | 1 medium egg white | 2 tablespoons yellow cornmeal, plus additional | 1 teaspoon yellow cornmeal | 6 large swiss chard leaves, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water, uncovered, for 20 minutes or until tender.

title: Rio Bravo! Grilled Cheese (Quesadilla)
ingredients: 3/4 lb monterey jack cheese or 3/4 lb gruyere cheese, shredded ( 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 cup romano cheese, finely grated and packed into a measuring cup
instructions: Using a grater attachment on a food processor, grate the cheeses by pulsing the process once or twice. You want the mixture to be a fine, even powder. If it seems dry, add a few tablespoons of water. This process can take as few seconds as a minute or two so keep the processor running and adjust cooking power if necessary. Place the grated cheese into a bowl, and add 1/4 cup romano. Add the rest of the romano to the cheese, and fold in carefully.

title: Crock Pot Coq Au Vin
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1/4 cup self raising flour | 1/4 cup marsala wine
instructions: Place the chicken in the crock pot. Mix in the flour until it's completely covered and then pour over the chicken. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours, low for 4 hours, and then remove chicken from the saucepan, place in a warmed oven and bake at 150c for 6 hours. Serve with a nice sauce and crusty bread.

title: Homemade Cajun Sausage (Tray Coating)
ingredients: 1 lb ground jalapeno pepper ( i use a mix of green and white jalapenos ) | 1 lb celery ( i like the celery with a mix of yellow and green, both of these sauteed ) or 1 lb green onion ( i like the celery with a mix of yellow and green, both of these sauteed ) | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried ancho chili ( go hotter or use chili powder )
instructions: Prepare jergies and place in food processer to get very finely minced. This stuff can be left in the refrigerator for a while as the flavors of the dried can change. To prepare crumbled sausages, in a bowl, mix ground jalapeno, celery and onion. I make 2 batches and freeze or dry the last batch and then rinse it. Use as desired in your favorite dry meats, or just use for sandwiches. You can mix it up to suit individual tastes. May also be added to the sauce a few hours or so later to make it more moist. This stuff can be frozen to bulk up a small batch and freeze or add to a container. If using all of the above ingredients in a jar, add to small bags of sausage. Keeps forever.

title: Ginger Sprouts
ingredients: 2 cups bean sprouts, washed and drained | 1 tablespoon sambal paprika | 2 tablespoons ginger paste, fresh
instructions: Combine the bean sprouts, ginger pulp and sambal in a salad bowl. Let it stand for 5 minutes minimum. Sprinkle paprika on top. Shake the bowl in between your palms to distribute the garam masala. Serve warm.

title: Simple Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 package frozen enchilada sauce, from one of your cans | 3/4 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon roasted garlic
instructions: Take the enchilada sauce and put in blender. Put in flour and stir. Take 1/2 jar of enchilada sauce in a small pot, cook at medium heat until it's thickened, usually 2 - 3 minutes add to the flour and stir until smooth, add the crushed garlic stir. Serve with cheese and sour cream.

title: Cheese and Taleghi Wrap
ingredients: 6 small whole wheat tortillas | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon or 2 tablespoons fresh savory, chopped | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Place tortillas on baking sheet. Bake 7 - 10 minutes or until they are hot. Cut each tortilla into 6 triangles. Spoon 2 tbsp of cheese onto 2 tortillas, top with each with a small dollop of tarragon and 1 tbsp of honey, then the remaining tortillas. Bake 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Homemade Italian Pot Roasted Parmesan - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup stock | 1/3 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Dissolve the liquid smoke in stock. Combine all ingredients in your pressure cooker. Secure with one long piece of double heavy duty aluminum foil. Cook in pressure cooker over med high heat 4 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes. Release the meat from the foil, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black bean,white grape,sea scallop,red cabbage,bread,burrito flour tortilla,white pearl onion
title: Big John's Big Beef and Vegetable Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 slices bread, diced | 1 large white pearl onion, chopped | 1 lb ground round | 1 bag frozen white and green grapes, thawed and divided | 1 lb sea scallops | 2 cups vertically sliced red cabbage | 12 burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. In a medium bowl, combine the beans, bread, onion, 6 slices of the cheese, 1/2 the scallops, red cabbage and the remaining 2 slices of cheese. Place a tortilla in a large saucepan large enough to hold both tortillas and beef and bake for 5 minutes, or until crisp and lightly browned. Spread some of the bean mixture along the bottom of a 13x9 baking dish. Top with 1 layer of enchiladas. Spoon 1/2 the remaining bean mixture over the enchiladas and top with remaining 3 enchiladas. Top with remaining cheese and top with remaining scallops. Bake for 20 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serve with hot spanish rice and red onion salsa.

Random Ingredients: wooden skewer,malibu rum,barbecue sauce,garlic salt,avocado,grape,white sugar,ginger garlic paste
title: Baja Grill Guacamole
ingredients: 2 avocados - peeled, pitted, and sliced | 4 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger garlic paste | 1 bottle malibu rum | 5 wooden skewers, soaked in water, for 30 minutes
instructions: Mix avocados, barbecue sauce, sugar, garlic salt, and ginger in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,plum sauce,cheese,bean sprout,monterey jack cheese,ketchup
title: Cheesy Plum Sauce & Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package frozen cheese | 2 cans mixed plum sauce ( i usually use muir glen spicy ) | 2 cans sliced plum sauce | 1/4 cup ketchup ( or ketchup if you don't like ketchup, but if you want it sweeter, add more ) | 2 -3 tablespoons cumin powder ( to taste ) or 2 -3 tablespoons chili powder ( to taste ) | 2 cups sprouts
instructions: Mix the ketchup and cumin together, and heat in microwave or in a saucepan over low heat. Mix together cheese, sprouts and tomato mix, and heat through. Taste and adjust seasonings, and serve over rice or noodles. Store covered in fridge for up to 6 days.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,self raising flour,fish sauce,chocolate,chili flake,red wine,white wine vinegar,citron peel
title: Prawns Yum Yum!
ingredients: 750 g self-raising flour | 120 ml dry white wine vinegar | 80 ml light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 80 ml sweet white wine vinegar | 40 g dried chili flakes | 40 g dried citron peel, finely chopped | 100 g chopped chocolate | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Whisk first 7 ingredients together. Dredge prawns and put into bowl and toss mixture lightly. Stir through chillies, citron and chocolate. Sprinkle over the chopped chocolate and put into fridge/freeze for 30 minutes to set. Serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: fruit,cream celery soup,yellow onion,cheese,pie crust,phyllo pastry,penne pasta,soy sauce
title: Easy Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 3 -6 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup ( i actually had to prepare this as well... just not the whole packet ) or ( 8 ounce ) can light cream of chicken soup, undiluted ( i actually had to prepare this as well... just not the whole packet ) | 1 small yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 jar dried fruit,, well chopped ( i cooked my own, in a can ) | 1/2 cup shredded tasty cheese, from my deli | 1 cup cooked chicken or 1 cup steak | soy sauce | 1 refrigerated pie crusts, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare pie crusts according to instructions. While crusts are cooking, make the filling. In a bowl, mix the soup, onion, fruit and cheese. Spread this mixture over the piecrust crusts. Roll the pastry up towards the outer edge and cut in half. Serve with sweet mustard, a green veggies and/or a salad for a complete meal.

title: Chicken and Brown Pepper Cabbage
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter or 1/4 cup margarine, melted | 1/2 lb whole wheat flour | 1 large yellow pepper, diced | 2 -3 lbs chicken wings, cut up
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine melted butter with flour, add pepper and enough water to make a thick, spreadable batter. Dip chicken in batter, place in 9x9 inch glass baking dish or two quart size casseroles. Bake uncovered 25 minutes, turn and bake 15 minutes longer. Baste and cook 15 minutes longer. Serve with mashed potatoes for sauce.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,black pepper,self rising flour,vegetable oil,pepperoni sausage
title: Bread Machine Pizza
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour | 1/3 cup vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon cracked black pepper | 1 package pepperoni sausage | 3 tablespoons coarse grain mustard
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Whisk together the flour, oil, pepperoni, and mustard. Spread onto a pizza peel. Place pizza peel in oven. Bake for 15 minutes. Turn the pizza peel to ensure even cooking.

title: Refried Bean Sprouts With Pecorino and Fresh Mint (Ricciarelli Di Esparagemini E E Fagioli)
ingredients: 3 cups fresh bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint | grated pecorino romano cheese, for serving
instructions: Wash the bean sprouts and set aside. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add in the mint and cook for 20 seconds. Place the bean sprouts in a large bowl and add about 2/3 cup water and stir in the pecorino romano cheese. Cover, remove from heat and let sit until the mixture cools. Once cool, toss them in some of the bean sprouts to coat them completely. Serve immediately in a shallow bowl, garnished with grated pecorino romano.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,turmeric,pineapple juice,water,vanilla extract,basmati rice,splenda sugar substitute
title: Caribbean Sprouts & Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 2 cups basmati rice or 2 cups jasmine rice, uncooked | 6 cups peeled sliced brussels sprouts | 6 cups water | 2/3 cup canned pineapple juice | 5 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine sprouts, water, pineapple juice, splenda sugar substitute, vanilla extract, and turmeric. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat or bring to a boil over low heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until vegetables are tender and water is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes, then stir. Gently fluff with fork.

title: Gingersnap Spiced Candy (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 2 lbs gingersnaps, finely crushed
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f sift gingersnap coarsely into an ovenproof dish. Mix the gingersnap crumbs with the crushed gingersnap. Press mixture into a large baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake for 25 minutes approximately until crackly in texture.

title: The Best Tea in the Whole Wide World
ingredients: 1 package dry vegetable soup mix | 1 cup yogurt | 2 cups brewed tea
instructions: In a 2 quart, heat proof bowl, combine the soup mix, yogurt and the tea. Cover with plastic wrap, and let stand in the refrigerator 1 to 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,pork loin,sherry wine vinegar,egg yolk,strawberry,olive
title: Strawberry-Pepper Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin, cut into 1-1/2 by 1-inch slices | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke flavoring, such as mccormick montreal steak sauce | 2/3 cup sliced ripe olives | 2 large egg yolks | 1 large bunch fresh strawberries, divided | fresh strawberries or other fresh fruit, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Prepare a 10 by 8 or 9 by 2 inch loaf pan. Arrange the pork slices in the bottom of the pan. In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar and liquid smoke with 1 tablespoon water. Pour over the pork. Sprinkle with the olives. In a medium mixing bowl, whisk the egg yolks with the remaining 1 tablespoon water until thick and creamy. Drizzle the egg mixture over the pork. Cover with foil. Bake until the pork is well browned, about 50 minutes. Transfer the pan to a cooling rack. Using a slotted spoon, remove the pork onto serving plates. Make ahead, the pork can be baked and reheated a day or two ahead. Let stand at room temperature covered. Garnish, spoon the pork mixture into a serving bowl. Add sliced fresh strawberries.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,yellow pepper,cumin,lime wedge,beef broth,filling,wheat flour,saffron
title: Spiced Meatball Tikkas
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground yellow pepper | 3/4 lb ground sirloin or 3/4 lb ground lean ground round | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 6 cups beef broth ( for beef broth, if you have it ) | 1/3 teaspoon saffron, dissolved in | 1 1/4 cups beef broth | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/3 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons lime wedges or 2 tablespoons lemon peel | 1/2 cup yellow sweet pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup vertically sliced yellow sweet pepper | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 1/3 cups beef broth | 1/4 cup saffron
instructions: Toast the pith & rub spices over the meat. If using meatballs, coat meat with flour & refrigerate 1 - 24 hrs to allow mixture to infuse before browning on all sides. Place meat lightly oiled grill pan over medium heat & sear meatballs 5 - 6 minutes on each side, for approximately 10 minutes, to make them more brown & crisp. To cook and remove, set aside on plate lined with paper towels to drain any grease & to keep them moist while preparing the meatballs. To make the meatballs, heat broth in large pan, along with liquid & saffron. Stir in sugar & spices & simmer until syrupy & tender. To make the meatballs & serve, preheat oven to 350°f. Shape meatballs in small balls, approximately 1 1/2 inches in diameter & place on a greased baking sheet.. If using meatballs, flatten them somewhat during cooking. Brush the balls with a little egg and bake 20 - 25 minutes. To serve, place a meatball on flatbread & top with a generous helping of browned sweet peppers & onion slices. Repeat with meatballs & meatballs with remaining ingredients.

title: Roasted Okra - Primavera
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra, thawed | 1 head cabbage, chopped | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 cup beef broth | 1 bunch fresh parsnip, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place okra in a saucepan with 1/2 cup of water. Bring to a boil and cook until just tender, about 10 minutes. Drain okra, removing stems, then cut into quarters. Place cabbage in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour a small amount of marinara sauce over the cabbage. Layer okra over sauce, then top with remaining sauce. Sprinkle parsnips on top and bake about 40 minutes in the preheated oven. Serve warm.

title: Fenugreek Olive Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup black olives, chopped | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds ( khabees ) | 1 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a low boil. Cook for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: allspice,pepperoni,soya sauce,cremini mushroom,rye bread,monterey jack cheese,beef steak,grain white rice
title: Beef Rissoles #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb beef steak | 1 package rye bread | 8 ounces of sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 1/4 cups sliced ramps and top round mushrooms | 10 round allspice | 1/2 cup sliced monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1 dash ground pepperoni
instructions: Cut steak lengthwise into 1/2, then crosswise into 1/8 dice. If not using all the meat, chop the meat thinly. In a large skillet add a little oil or butter and brown meat on all sides. Remove meat into a bowl. To the skillet add a little more oil if necessary and brown the mushrooms. Season all with a little pepper. Remove mushrooms from skillet and put into a paper towel. Remove the excess oil from the skillet by wiping your skillet clean. Add the allspice to the skillet and cook for about one minute. Return steak to skillet and add the mushrooms so that the allspice coats the meat. Place the meat into a 9x13 casserole dish and top with the monterey jack cheese. Combine the soy sauce and pepperoni. Spoon over bread mixture and bake at 350°f for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes before cutting into squares. This serves.

title: Roasted Squash With Creole Seasoning
ingredients: 1 red sweet potato | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning
instructions: Wash and pierce the sweet potato in several places with a sharp knife. Place the sweet potato on a roasting pan or tray. Drizzle with the creole seasoning. Broil or grill at 230 c for 1 to 1½ minutes per side, or until tender and brown. When cool enough to handle, cut the squash lengthways into 4 thick wedges, drizzle with the pan juices and serve.

Random Ingredients: pepper onion,white onion,trout fillet,fenugreek seed,russet potato,broccoli floret
title: Thai Baked Trout
ingredients: 3 medium trout fillets ( about 1/2 inch thick ) | 1/4 small white onions or 1/4 small walla walla onion, sliced thin | 2 medium russet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 6 broccoli florets, sliced | 1 can sliced pepper onions ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds ( or more, if desired ) or 1 tablespoon garam masala ( or more, if desired )
instructions: Oil baking dish. Dry fish and arrange on top of vegetables, if using. Sprinkle with cumin and/or garam masala then spread fenugreek seeds/garam masala on the fish. Bake at 425°f for 20 - 25 minutes then sprinkle additional fenugreek on top.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,coffee granule,garam masala,basil leaf,mint sprig,mustard seed,egg white,onion flake
title: Basil Chiffon Mix
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 cup finely chopped fresh mint sprig | 1 tablespoon instant minced onion flakes | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons boiling water | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 2 egg whites
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 500°f, and line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. For the chiffon mix, combine all of the ingredients in a bowl and mix until blended. Pour the mixture into an 8 inch square glass pan and place in the oven. Turn on the broiler to high and broil for 3 to 5 minutes, or until the mixture is hot and slightly darker in color. Cool the chiffon slightly before removing from the pan. Serve with salad, bread, or indian style cookies.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,bacon,creole seasoning,tomato juice,garlic,guava jelly,grain rice,turkey breast
title: Baked Turkey Breast With Tomato & Guava Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs turkey breast | 1/2 lb bacon ( chopped or sliced ) | 1 can tomato juice | 1 can guava jelly | 1/2 cup applesauce | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 2 cups long grain rice
instructions: Brown turkey breast in skillet. After browning turkey completely, add 1/2 to 1 cup of water, bacon, onion, and garlic. Cook until onion is clear. Combine all ingredients for sauce and cook on stovetop for a few minutes. Pour over turkey. Place turkey into casserole dish and bake 375 for about an hour till heated through or until done.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,celery,cream tartar,mango chutney,garam masala
title: Tasty Mango Chicken
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon celery, powder
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients. Use half of mixture to marinate chicken during chicken's cooking for as little as 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: The Best Cheese French
ingredients: 4 tablespoons of grated gruyere cheese | 4 tablespoons of finely chopped toasted pecans | 1 cup of real tomato ketchup
instructions: Put the cheese into a mixing bowl. Add the walnuts and pecans and stir. Add the ketchup and stir to mix into cheese until it is nicely blended. Cover and let sit for 8 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,tahini paste,cilantro leaf,saffron,tart apple,egg yolk
title: Apple and Saffron Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup tahini paste | 1 large egg yolk | 1 pinch saffron | 1 tart apples or 1 gala apple, grated fine
instructions: Preheat your oven to 300 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine all the ingredients. Shape the mixture into 12 meatballs. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet, and bake until meat is cooked through and juices run clear, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,dark soy sauce,cranberry juice,russet potato,kaffir lime leaf,tuna water
title: Creamy Tuna
ingredients: 2 cans tuna in water, drained | 1 bunch fresh basil pesto ( basil leaves ) | 1 small russet potato, peeled and diced | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 1 can sweetened cranberry juice, chilled
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the tuna, pesto, potato, soy sauce, and lime leaf until thoroughly combined.

title: Easy Arabic Chicken
ingredients: 1 frying chicken, cut up | 2 quarts chicken bouillon | 1 russet potato, peeled and cut in cubes | 1/2 cup shelled pistachios | 1 package frozen edam cheese
instructions: Place fry chicken in 9x13 inch baking dish in single layer. Bake at 400 degrees for 45 minutes. Shred chicken with 2 forks. Add bouillon in a small bowl. Pour into a saucepan. Heat on medium low heat, then bring to a simmer. Add potato to the broth in the baking dish, and continue to simmer 10 minutes to heat potatoes. Add pistachios and cook 2 minutes at a time. Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted.

title: Taco Salad
ingredients: lettuce, shredded | 1 package refrigerated taco blend cheese | 1/4 cup raisins ( optional ) or 1/4 cup chopped black olives ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together shredded lettuce, taco blend cheese and raisins. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: asian pear,taco seasoning,vanilla pudding mix,curry paste
title: Tacitos (Mexican Baked Pears)
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated classic vanilla pudding mix | 1/2 cup hot taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 12 asian pear halves, with peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400^f/200^°c. Prepare pudding mix according to package directions. Place the asian pear halves in a greased 9x9 baking dish. Top with taco seasoning. Pour prepared pudding mix over the pear mixture and bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Chili Shreds
ingredients: 1 large pie crust | 3 fresh serrano chili, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Press 2 crusts into the baking sheet. Cut 3 serrano chiles into long strips and remove seeds only. Place chiles pieces into a bowl of hot water, and let stand 10 minutes. Rinse chiles and remove and discard soaking liquid. Slice chiles in half lengthwise. Brush crusts with water and bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,ice water,red wine,chard leaf,jumbo shrimp
title: Champignons en Vino Ros (Chicken & Chard Soup)
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock, hot | 1 cup chard leaves, washed, dried and chopped | 1/2 cup red wine | 1 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | ice water
instructions: Heat stock. Add chard & wine. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add shrimp. Cover.

title: Gohan's Vegan Tiramisu
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons gelatin, softened in | 1 1/2 teaspoons cold water
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup of cold water into a glass bowl. Break up the gelatin with the back of a spoon and coat with 1 1/2 teaspoons water. Sprinkle the gelatin over the water. Cover and let set for 1 hr, stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from refrigerator and sprinkle with the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons water. Let cool completely. Enjoy.

title: Brazilian Coconut Milk Pudding
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups coconut milk | 2 large lime wedges
instructions: In a deep saucepan, combine the coconut milk and lime juice. Bring to a boil over medium heat, or the bottom of a heavy saucepan to a boil. Remove from the heat. Pour into a large bowl. Stir to combine and allow the coconut milk to settle to the sides of the bowl and set aside to cool for about 15 minutes. Stir the mixture again. Refrigerate pudding, covered, at least overnight. The longer it sets the better it is. Serve chilled, topped with lots of sugar and whipped cream as a side dish at a midday meal.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,baking powder,chick pea,lemon juice,jerusalem artichoke
title: Garlicky Jerusalem Artichokes
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas | 14 jerusalem artichokes, trimmed | 6 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 3/4 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Blend the chick peas, artichokes and lemon juice in an electric blender until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a large bowl. Stir in the baking powder and marinara sauce. Cover and refrigerate overnight until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,haddock,herbes de provence,dark cherry,pimento pepper,head cauliflower,egg yolk
title: Cauliflower Buffet
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 pound haddock or sea scallops | 2 tablespoons herbes de provence | 1 egg yolk | 6 pimento pepper pieces | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 can dark cherries
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the cauliflower, and return to a boil. Cook the cauliflower uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender but still firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain well in a strainer set in the sink. Place the herbes de provence in a small bowl, and dip the haddock into the egg yolk to soften. Slice the haddock into thin slices, then arrange on a plate. Squeeze the hot cauliflower from its florets into the bowl with the herbes de provence.

title: Creamed Spinach (21 Day Wonder Diet :day 1 )
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rye flour, plus extra to serve | 4 ounces bread, crusts trimmed | 8 ounces baby spinach leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees centigrade or 150 degrees c. Spread the flour on 4 slices of thickly sliced bread and sandwich them together with the bread and spinach leaves. Spray a baking tray with oil. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden and sticky.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,lemon peel,lime wedge,ginger,chicken drumstick,tomato green chilies,peanut butter
title: Sweet & Savory Crock Pot Chicken
ingredients: 6 skinless chicken drumsticks | 4 ounces thai chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup canned diced tomato with green chilies | 1 tablespoon grated lime peel | 2 teaspoons grated ginger | 1 cup arborio rice | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Put everything in the crock pot except the rice, and stir. Cover and cook on high 5 hours. Turn low and continue to cook for about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the grill. Cut chicken into chunks and thread onto skewers. Cook on a hot grill rack for 20 to 25 minutes, turning them as necessary. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Pork Stuffed Mini Italian Meatloaves
ingredients: 6 ounces pork tenderloin, 1/2-inch slices | 6 ounces lean ground beef | 4 ounces mozzarella cheese, coarsely grated | 10 fresh sage leaves, torn
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. On a baking sheet, spread the pork slices, leaving about ¼ inch thick at the edges. Bake the pork until well browned, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, and place 1/2 the chopped pork slices in the center. Sprinkle 1/4 of the grated mozzarella cheese over the pork. Place 3 sage leaves on top of the cheese, and roll up the meat in the cheese. Place them, seam side down, on the baking sheet. Bake until the juices run clear when the pork is pierced with a fork, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Buffalo Bread
ingredients: 1 lb white flour or 1 lb stone ground unbleached white flour | cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Sift the flour into a mixing bowl or use your fingers. Rub it in with your fingers. You will need to knead it a little. Cover with a film and let sit for 30 minutes at room temperature. Divide dough in half, shape into round loaves and place on a baking sheet. Allow to rest for at least 30 minutes at room temperature but not more than 20 to 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 f. Place loaves on a rack and bake 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Bread Sticks (Pigs With Port Wine)
ingredients: 1 cup port wine | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Bring port to boil in heavy small saucepan. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda and blend well. Dip candy sticks briefly, or dip them into sugar. Place, a few at a time, in hot syrup. When the stick are golden brown.

title: Easy Sauerkraut Filling for Danish Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 pound sauerkraut, drained | 1/2 pound ground veal | 1/2 cup cubed cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lay the sauerkraut out, and cut into about 1/2 inch squares. Place the ground veal in a skillet over medium heat, and sprinkle with the sauerkraut and cheddar cheese. Cook and stir until cheese is melted. Place the mixture onto a lightly greased baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until sauerkraut is lightly browned, about 15 minutes.

title: My Mom's Best Ever Chili
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb, cubed in 2inch pieces | 1 can pinto beans or 2 cans pork and beans
instructions: Rinse and sort beans to be sure there are no stones to the stew. If they sink to bottom, add 1/4 of a can of tomato sauce and bring to a boil. Turn down heat, and simmer until most of the water is gone and the lamb is falling off the bone. Turn heat off. Open pinto beans can, and put in pan. Cover with water from can. Bring to a boil. You may have to add more water. You may not use all of the pinto beans. They will thicken the liquid a little bit, so make sure you stir them. Cover and turn heat down to low. Simmer for 4 hours.

title: Takkavi (Indonesian Skewers)
ingredients: 2 lbs white onions | 1 1/2 cups nori | 1 cup sofrito sauce | 1 orange, zest of, grated, zested | 24 skewers
instructions: Slice 1 of the onions lengthwise into 1/2 slices and cut into 3/4 inch wedges, keeping the slices connected. Heat a small pot to medium high heat. Place all the onions and nori in the hot oil and grill until just browned. Remove and discard the onions. Cut the remaining onions into 1/4 inch wedges and stir into the pot along with 6 cups water. Continue to cook over medium low heat until the onions are completely caramelized, about 20 minutes, adding ice water to the pot during the last 5 minutes, if desired. Season with salt, stir again and let simmer until the liquid is reduced by half. Stir in the sofrito, orange zest and serve, garnishing with lemon wedges.

title: Rosti
ingredients: 1 ounce fresh apricot | 2 teaspoons fresh herbs ( such as dill or tarragon ) | 1 pinch hot sauce
instructions: Peel apricots, cut into small dice and place in a bowl. Sprinkle with herbs. Sprinkle with hot sauces and toss. Leave for a few hours, then shake the bowl and stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,self rising flour,cardamom powder,ice water,pesto sauce
title: Best Ever Garlic Pesto Biscuits
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( i use kewpie brand ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup cold ice water
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together in a small bowl with the pesto until thoroughly mixed. Add ice water slowly until dough is manageable. Cut dough in half for thicker thinner biscuits. Place cut side down on floured board for 10 - 12 minutes.

title: Coleslaw Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 6 cups packaged sliced coleslaw mix | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup baking powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Use your hands to thoroughly combine. Let sit 15 minutes before using. Use as directed on package.

title: Grilled Tilapia Wraps
ingredients: 1 pound tilapia fillets, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 slices miniature banana slices | 1 large piece rye bread
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Combine fennel seed and fennel seed in a bowl, and toss with tilapia until coated. Place banana slices on a piece of rye bread, and spread the fennel seed mixture on top. Place a slice of tilapia onto top, and close the sandwich. Wrap in a clean kitchen towel, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight. Remove the closed wrap from the grill. Place a few pieces of rye bread onto a flat surface, and place a tilapia onto the bread, then spoon a little bit of the rye mixture onto and around the tilapia. Fold the left and right edges of the rye bread over, and press the bread, tilapia, and tilapia gently together with the fingers. Place the uncooked side up on a plate, flip the tilapia, and carefully remove the plate. Slice into wedges, and serve.

title: Cuban Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken bouillon, divided | 1 jar picante sauce, divided | 1/2 cup dried ham, diced | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 2 limes, juiced | waxed lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Place 1 bouillon cube in a large bowl.

title: Indian Dry Nuts
ingredients: 4 packages almond paste ( or to taste ) | 1 cup mango, grated ( or you can use canned ) | 3/4 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Heat oil in heavy non stick pan. Saute groundnut, add mango and saute until soft. Sprinkle with coriander powder and toss until nuts are coated.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,onion salt,chicken bouillon powder,dark sesame oil
title: Easy Pesto-Glazed Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped onions | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1/2 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce, prepared
instructions: Place remaining ingredients except chicken in a 4 qt. Casserole pan. Add chicken and turn to coat well with sauce. Cover and bake at 400 degrees f. For 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Turn dish and bake for another 15 minutes. Baste with pan juices every 5 minutes and cook for an additional 15 minutes. Remove cover and cook for a few minutes until golden brown and serve.

Random Ingredients: red chili sauce,tomato green chilies,pineapple juice,pecan,green cardamom pod,rosemary leaf,pepperoni,broad egg noodle
title: Anticy Noodle Salad
ingredients: 100 g broad egg noodle | 1/2 cup fresh pecans, coarsely chopped | 150 g pepperoni, diced | 100 g pickled mushrooms | 4 green cardamom pods | 1 hot red chili sauce | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice or 2 tablespoons sherry wine | rosemary leaf
instructions: Cook the noodles and drain. Boil water in a small saucepan. Add broken noodles, nuts, pepperoni, mushrooms, cardamom pods, hot red chilli sauce, pineapple juice and rosemary. Toss. Serve hot.

title: Fried Eggs With Vegetables and Beans
ingredients: 3/4 cup pinto beans, boiled. drained | 2 large eggplants, peeled and cut into 4 pieces | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Place pinto beans and eggplant into separate large pot. Add the seasoning salt. Bring to boil over high heat, then reduce until vegetables are tender about 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Albondigas
ingredients: 16 ounces spaghetti or 16 ounces orecchiette | 2 cans beef consomme | 1 can corn, drained | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and chopped | 4 eggs | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon corn, for drizzling on top
instructions: Cook spaghetti or orecchiette until al dente, drain. Heat consommé over medium heat in a pot, add remaining ingredients. When everything is heated through, pour over cooked spaghetti or orecchiette. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,cocoa,tomato green chilies,cane sugar,beef bouillon cube,sherry,chicken broth
title: Sherry Marinated Brisket of Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs top round beef brisket | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup unbleached cane sugar | 1/2 cup dark sherry, divided | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies ( with green chilis ) | 1 cup beef broth, undiluted
instructions: Slice brisket across the grain into 3/4 thick slices, 1/4 thick. Coat beef and sliced vegetables with cocoa. Combine sugar, 1/4 cup sherry and boullion in large resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,italian parsley,beef stew meat,buttermilk,tabasco sauce
title: The Best Beef Skillet Ever
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in skillet. Stir to coat. Cover and cook 90 minutes, stirring twice.

title: Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cashew nuts | 1 tablespoon pine nuts | 1 tablespoon breadcrumbs
instructions: Grind cashews, pine nuts and breadcrumbs together.

title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 1 can pinto beans ( drained ) | 6 slices american cheese ( sliced into chunks ) | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spoon drained peas over each of the 6 slices of cheese. Dot with a little of the melted butter or margarine. Sprinkle with walnuts, if you wish. Bake in oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until hot. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Rice and Mint-Plate With Currants and Oranges
ingredients: 2 cups rice, short-grain ( white ) | 2 cups of fresh mint leaves, coarsely chopped ( cilantro )
instructions: Prepare rice according to the directions on the package. When rice is done cooking, remove from heat and place the mint leaves around the rice or the mint. Drain off any excess minty juices that may have accumulated, and gently toss the rice into the mint. Taste and add if necessary, a little additional mint or cilantro.

title: Lavender Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1 kg pumpkin, weighing approximately 200-250 ( if the pumpkin is very large, halve the pumpkin's weight and place it on a roasting tray. ) | 25 g lavender honey
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c/350°f/gas mark 4 for fan ovens. Peel and cut the pumpkin in half lengthways and remove seeds and stringy fibrous matter. Put the pumpkin flesh in a large roasting tin. Put honey in a small bowl with a fork and stir in a few teaspoons of warm water. Toss the pumpkin seeds over a medium heat in the honey and butter mixture. Pour the mixture over the top of the pumpkin. Season and roast for 60 minutes or until the pumpkin is nice and soft at the edges and the topping is crisp and golden.

title: Cardamom-Crusted French Bread
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 1/4 cup freshly ground cardamom pod | 1/4 cup freshly ground cardamom
instructions: Cut crusts of the baguette lengthwise. Combine cardamom, sugar, and pepper in bowl. Pour into a resealable plastic bag. Add baguette and shake to coat. Place in a shallow baking dish or plate. Dip bread into cardamom mixture. Sprinkle with additional sugar. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake baguette for 30 to 40 minutes, or until bread is lightly golden.

Random Ingredients: limoncello,red wine vinegar,halloumi cheese,plain yogurt,onion salt
title: Smoked Feta and Limoncello Grilled Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons limoncello | 1/4 cup white red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon onion salt, or to taste | 4 ounces crumbled halloumi cheese | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Whisk limoncello, red wine vinegar salad dressing, and onion salt together in a bowl, and set aside. Place the halloumi cheese in a baking dish, piling it slightly. Drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with onion salt. Broil in the upper 2 inches of the oven until the cheese is browned and bubbly, about 3 minutes. Roll cheese with a spatula after 1 minute of turning it and sprinkling with onion salt before serving.

Random Ingredients: green bean,beef stock,mushroom,basmati rice,dark brown sugar,green pea
title: Brown Rice, Green Beans, and Mushrooms
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1/2 pound fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup green beans, cleaned and sliced | 1 cup frozen cut green peas | 2 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: In a large saucepan bring the rice, mushrooms, beans, and peas to a boil. In a small bowl, mix together the beef stock and brown sugar and pour into the saucepan. Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes.

title: American Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 1/4 cups dry elbow macaroni, cooked | 2 cups sun-dried tomatoes, chopped or 2 cups tomatoes, drained, cut into wedges | 1/4 cup drained capers, drained | 1 cup baby mixed cherry | 1 -2 tablespoon guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Fry the bacon. Reserve 2 tablespoons of bacon drippings. Saute the swiss cheese for approximately 5 minutes, stirring regularly, until melted. Add to the cheese mixture the drained sun dried tomatoes, capers and bacon. Continue to stir until cheese is incorporated and mixture is well coated. Serve immediately in a shallow bowl. Garnish with the garnishes. Serve with additional guacamole or other desired accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,beef broth,lemon juice zest,peanut butter,cayenne pepper,lard,pistachio
title: Cajun Lamb with Pistachios
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground pistachios | 4 tablespoons lamb fat | 10 fluid ounces low-sodium beef broth | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, finely grated | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 1/4 lbs whole leg of lamb, cut into 4 pieces | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Toast the pistachios in a dry frying pan over low heat, uncovered, stirring, until golden. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool slightly. Set the oven at 400f degrees. Trim any excess fat and sinew from the lamb. Remove the meat from the bones. Cut into 1-inch chunks and place in a bowl with the pistachios. Toss to coat. Place the lamb in a roasting tin. Pour over boiling water and cover. Place in the oven and roast for 1 1/2 hours, basting twice during cooking. Stir in the broth, lemon juice and zest. Cover with foil and roast for another hour or until the lamb is tender. While the lamb is roasting, combine the peanut butter and 1 inch water in a small saucepan. Stir over low heat until smooth. Set aside to cool slightly, stirring occasionally. After half hour, remove the lamb from the foil and pour 1 inch of the peanut butter mixture onto the lamb, making sure that it is evenly coated. Return to the oven to brown the rest of the lamb. Serve lamb with the peanut sauce mixture on the side or on top.

title: Rajas Con Coco E Sal, Corn and Crab Meat.
