ingredients: 1 corn, cut in 4-6 slices each
instructions: Remove the corn kernels from the cob, put the corn in a skillet. Place a sheet of aluminum foil on top. Spray a flat dish or platter with nonstick spray. Place the corn around the foil. Using a meat mallet or the edge of a spoon or similar blunt object, tear off a 1 - 2 inch piece of the kernels from the cob that was torn into pieces.. Turn on the grill and cook until the corn is a little crispy and brown. Drain off moisture. Set aside. Wet your hands with water. Then, with clean hands, roll and press each piece of corn gently into the foil. Use the corn as a dipping sauce, or put the corn as a dipping sauce for fish and vegetables, etc. Enjoy note, this will serve 6 depending on how stuffed you want it to be.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,oyster sauce,maraschino cherry,ketchup,turmeric,sesame seed,splenda sugar substitute,red cabbage
title: Chinese Red Cabbage Salad (Diabetic Diet: Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, finely shredded ( about 5 cups ) | 2 cups red cabbage, cut into thin strips | 1/4 cup light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate soda | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute or 1/2 teaspoon other artificial artificial sweetener
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients, except splenda, and mix well. Sprinkle with splenda and toss to coat. Refrigerate until chilled. Sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.

Random Ingredients: cashew,allspice berry,oyster sauce,sambal oelek,tomato green chile pepper
title: Yummy Spicy Tomato and Green Chile Cashews
ingredients: 1 package cashews | 1 can crushed tomatoes with green chile peppers | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek | 1 teaspoon allspice berries, or to taste
instructions: Place cashews in a large skillet over medium heat. Bring cashews to a simmer.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,pepperoncini pepper juice,pumpkin,red pepper,stew meat beef,mushroom
title: Crock Pot - Pot Spicy Beef & Pumpkin (Beef)
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat ( beef, sirloin, pork, etc. ) | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 cup sliced pumpkin | 1 jar roasted red peppers, chopped ( i used jalapeno pepper and garlic peppers ) | 1 jar pepperoncini pepper juice ( i used peppepperi ) | 2 cans sliced mushrooms ( i used 1 can )
instructions: Brown meat. Add remaining ingredients except mushrooms and simmer on high for 5 - 7 hours. Strain beef liquid, discard onions and vegetables. Stir meat, mushrooms and spices well. Place roast or vegetables in crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 10 hours.

title: Cauliflower With Avocado and Corn
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into bite-size pieces, about 3 pounds ( about 4 cups ) | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped | 2 roma tomatoes, chopped | 1 lb cottage cheese | avocado, slices, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cook cauliflower and onion in boiling water for about 7 minutes, or until it is tender crisp and easily pierced with fork. Drain and cool slightly. While cauliflower and cauliflower are cooking, pulse roma tomatoes and cottage cheese until just about smooth, or pulse until combined. Toss cauliflower with tomato and cottage cheese mixture and toss to combine. Serve on plates topped with avocado slices.

title: Fettuccine Bolognese
ingredients: 300 g dry fettuccine | 4 tablespoons onions powder | 300 ml double cream | 200 g firm white chocolate | 3 can anchovy fillets | 2 cups dried apricots
instructions: Cook noodles according to pkg instructions. Heat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Meanwhile heat cream over low heat, stir in onions, stir fry for 2 minutes. Pour cream mixture over noodles and stir until thickened. In a food processor cook anchovy fillets and apricots in 2 tbsp of oil till nuts are golden. Drain noodles.

title: Easy Mushroom Egg Roll
ingredients: 5 cups sliced mushrooms | 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled ( optional ) | 1/2 cup agave nectar ( or to taste ) | 2 egg yolks
instructions: Cut up the cooked mushrooms. Melt the nectar in a small bowl in the microwave, stir in the egg yolks, until fluffy. Pour 1 cup of the egg mixture into each of the four cups of a double thickness plastic wrap so that the wrap is about 6 inches long. Roll each cup up lengthwise. Lay rolls into the plastic wrap. Refrigerate the rolls overnight. Remove the rolls from the plastic wrap on a plate in the refrigerator.. Let cool completely.. Slice the rolls crosswise into 1/4 thick pieces. You can also slice each roll in half horizontally. Arrange the pieces and smashed mushrooms in a single layer on a baking sheet, and allow to stand at room temeprature for 15 to 20 minutes. Place the sliced hard boiled eggs in a small bowl. Place the remaining egg yolk along with the agave in a medium bowl, and beat vigorously with a wooden spoon until well blended. Slowly ladle the agave mixture into the yolks, stirring often, until the yolk has been incorporated. Stir in the drained mushrooms. Cover the mushrooms with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for an hour to allow the flavors to develop.

title: Pumpkin and Cranberry Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 tablespoons yellow wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme | 1/2 orange, zest | 1 lb fresh pumpkin puree | 16 ounces fresh cranberries | 3 turnips, chopped | 2 tablespoons snipped parsley and fennel ( to garnish ) | 3 tablespoons bean sprouts ( to garnish )
instructions: In bowl combine the vinegar with the thyme, orange zest, pumpkin and cranberries.

title: Fish Stew (Steep for a few minutes to remove the foam from the sediment to the top )
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white fish fillets ( firm not fatty ) | 2 gallons hot water | 1 teaspoon savory | 6 ounces unsmoked beer or 6 ounces light beer
instructions: Soak the fish in cold water for a few hours and remove any bones. Place the meat into a large saucepan. Add the water, savory and beer or a little water to cover. Cover and simmer over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes to 1 hour or until fish is tender. Serve immediately or place fish in a crockpot. Serve hot with steamed collards and greens.

title: Jambon Braised Brisket
ingredients: 200 ml tomato juice ( tomato passata ) | 150 ml buttermilk | 1 beef brisket | 1 tablespoon thyme, chopped | 1 red capsicum, roasted and diced ( bell pepper ) | 125 g kielbasa, chopped
instructions: Put the liquid ingredients in a saucepan, and bring all ingredients to the boil. Boil rapidly uncovered for about 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and let the brisket stand in the liquid in a separate pan for at least 20 minutes. Preheat your bbq over about 20 minutes. Brush the brisket with oil, season it with salt and pepper, and cook it for 2 - 3 minutes on each side. Brush and cook the kielbasa the last 2 minutes. Serve the brisket with the sauce.

title: Veal Spetsicles
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs veal cutlets | 2 leeks | 1/2 cup chili powder | 1/2 cup of crushed black olives | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Cube veal into 5 inch cubes. Peel away outer leaves from leeks. Slice leeks thickly. Chop olives. Combine chilli powder, black olives and vanilla essence in a glass bowl or a small bowl. Add crumbs from the veal and mix well. Spoon mixture into your hands and mould into sticks approx 3 inches long. Heat the oil. Deep fry the veal for 2 minutes each side. Drain on absorbent paper and cool completely. You may need to deep fry the meat before each batch to ensure they do not stick together. You can also place them in plastic bag with cling wrap to keep turning. They need to chill for approx 15 minutes before removing from bag. Serve with salad and vanilla sauce.

title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 turnip, peeled and chopped | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 1 chopped green chili pepper, chopped | 10 ounces raspberries, drained and rinsed | 1 ounce unsweetened cocoa, to coat
instructions: Combine beans, turnip, celery, chile and raspberries in a medium skillet. Melt cocoa, stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and stir until melted.

title: Canadian Bacon Soup
ingredients: 6 slices canadian bacon, cut into 1-inch wide pieces | 4 cans fat-free chicken broth
instructions: Place 2 or 3 slices of fresh bacon and a can of chicken broth in a soup pot over low heat. Simmer until bacon is tender.

Random Ingredients: deli roast beef,italian sausage,rice noodle,topping,bay leaf,red curry paste,grenadine
title: Red Beef and Sausage Pho
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs deli italian-style roast beef, cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 3 ) | 1 lb hot italian sausage, casings removed | 1 can of chopped italian sausages or | 10 ounces frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/2 cup red curry paste or 1/2 cup kraft oriental curry blend, divided | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 cup grenadine, chilled
instructions: Spray a large skillet w/ nonstick cooking spray and set over medium high heat. Add beef, sausage, and 1/2 of the curry paste to skillet.

title: Grilled Italian Sausage Rollups
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk italian sausage | 4 thick slices bread, toasted | 1 cup cranberries or 1 cup raisins, soaked in hot water until soft | 3 cups low-fat milk | 1 lb fresh capellini | 1 cup shredded fresh cranberries or 1 cup raisins
instructions: In large nonstick skillet, cook sausage over medium heat, stirring frequently, until browned and crumbly, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain. Remove from skillet, breaking the pieces into small bits. Place bread slices into food processor. Add sausage and cranberries.

title: Yummy Herb Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup self raising flour | 1 teaspoon dried mixed herbs ( basil, chives, coriander ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Combine flour, herbs and seasoning in a bowl. Stir well with a fork. Lightly grease a 2lb loaf tin. Spoon mixture into tin and bake on the middle shelf of the oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, depending on your oven. Remove from oven. Place tin on a rack to cool. Serve slices and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,cilantro leaf,beet,grain white rice,sunflower oil,tea
title: Beet Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf | 1 -2 teaspoon chili paste ( or other chili paste ) | 500 g beets, peeled and thinly sliced | 3 cups jasmine rice | 2 -3 cups strong tea ( to taste ) or 2 -3 cups black tea ( to taste )
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan and fry the cilantro leaf and chile paste till golden brown. Add beet slices and fry till golden brown. Add rice and stir to coat. Pour in tea or water, bring to the boil, cover and simmer gently for 15 mins do not uncover until water is almost absorbed. Transfer to warmed serving dish and sprinkle top with a little fresh coriander.

title: Grilled Pork Filling for Enchiladas or Burritos
ingredients: dry phylonic or vinegar filling : | 1 1/4 lbs chicken fatback, sliced into 8 strips or cans pork fatback, cubed | 8 poblano chiles, stemmed and sliced | 1 head fresh broccoli florets | 1 bunch fresh edible flower | 2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Cook the pork fatback about 10 minutes until crispy and brown. Transfer the fatback onto a plate. Place the poblano chiles, broccoli, and herb leaves in the hot skillet. Season with thyme. Cook about 10 minutes, or until crisp and brown. Stir occasionally and remove from heat. Dip hot meat into the fondue.

Random Ingredients: pecan,vodka,garam masala,pepper flake,beef tenderloin,white fish,ketchup,ice cream
title: Indian Grilled Steak
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs beef tenderloin, filets ( or a cube, your preference ) | ice cream ( to serve ) | 2 -3 tablespoons good quality ketchup | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes ( to taste or adjust for your taste ) | 8 cups ice cream ( to serve ) | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 1/4 cup good quality vodka ( optional garnish )
instructions: Rub steaks with garam masala, salt, pepper, and hot pepper flakes. Add ice cream and ketchup and toss. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Cook steaks on a lightly oiled grill. When steaks are no longer pink inside, turn the steak over and cook for 3 more minutes. Turn steaks again and cook on the same same barbecue grill. The steaks will take about 3 - 4 minutes each side. Remove from grill and cover loosely. To serve, place steaks in a plate, top with a spoonful of ice cream, and garnish with chopped pecans. You may also add a splash of bbq sauce to your sauce, according to your taste.

title: Danish Wheaten Sandesh
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat bread, cubed | 1 cup kale ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract ( can be found in health food aisle )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix well with a fork.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 1/2 cup seasoned cocoa | 1/2 cup provolone cheese or 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese | sweetened shredded chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cut each chicken breast into 6 cubes. Wrap each cube around a cheese cube. Place the chicken in baking dish. Place the baking dish in the oven and bake for 60 to 90 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked. Turn the broiler off and turn the chicken in the baking dish again. Broil the chicken for 2 to 3 minutes per side, or until juices run clear. Serve with guacamole, sour cream, or salsa.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,spaghetti sauce mix,yeast,tubular pasta,romaine lettuce,gruyere cheese,coffee powder
title: Bubble Up (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 500 g dry tubular pasta ( tubular, not tubetti ) | 2 2 cups stale bread machine baked beans ( dry yeast, i 'd use homemade, but can make your own tomateie ) or 2 cups boboli doughnuts ( dry yeast, i've used homemade, but can make your own tomateie ) | 3 teaspoons instant yeast | 200 ml bottled hot coffee powder ( or a bit more-i've had to enter 1/4 of a packet. any kind you like ) | 150 -200 ml homemade spaghetti sauce mix | 3/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese ( i prefer using kraft singles or edam ) | 1 head romaine lettuce ( to roll out )
instructions: Put all the dry ingredients in your breadmaker and select the rapid setting. After the dough forms, remove dough onto a floured work surface and knead lightly to get the dough into your breadmachine. Place the dough back onto the floured work surface and form into a ball. Place dough into the bread machine and select the flat/normal/white/gray bread setting. When your machine turns the dough out onto the floured work surface, turn bread down to the normal/normal/normal/white/gray bread setting. While the dough is being formed, place the dough ball on your work surface. Once your dough has rested, place on top of a bowl of ice cubes and add about 1/2 cup of water. Cover the bowl, set in the freezer and wait about 1/2 an hour before your dough will be ready to be cut out.

title: Yellow Squash With Walnut Filling (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 2 medium yellow squash | 3/4 cup walnuts | 3 tablespoons maraschino cherries, finely chopped
instructions: Peel the peel off the squash, and cut into 1/4 dice. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the squash and cook for about 6 to 10 minutes until tender but still a little firm. Drain again. Place the walnuts and cherries in a food processor fitted with a coarse blade, and process until almost smooth. Add the peeled and cooled squash to the walnut and cherry mixture and mix well. If you want ice cream or just fill the walnut shell with this mixture, fill it with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Blueberry and Mushrooms in Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup white flour | 7 -8 large portobello mushroom caps | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 cups fresh blueberries, rinsed and drained | 4 -6 radishes, sliced
instructions: Combine flour and 2 tablespoons oil in a shallow dish, or plate, and set aside until necessary. Lightly oil an 8 to 10 inch frying pan, and set aside. Cut mushrooms into 3/4 inch pieces, and set aside. Place 2 tablespoon oil in frying pan over medium high heat, and put portobello mushrooms in it. Stir mushrooms, cook only until they release aroma and begin to lightly brown, but not brown, about 3 minutes. They should not be browned all the way through, and should be cooked through. Remove mushrooms to a plate, and set aside. Put oil in the same pan over medium high heat, and add mushrooms. Cook mushrooms 3 to 5 minutes, or until mushrooms are heated through and slightly browned. Remove mushrooms to plate and set aside. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in the pan, and add raspberry sauce. Cook for 30 seconds, and add blueberries. Cook a few seconds, and pour into sauce. Toss blueberries with sauteed mushrooms, and serve.

title: Easy Onion Garlic Bread
ingredients: 2 large french onion soup | 1 garlic clove ( i've never tried that, but love it. )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread onion soup onto a baking sheet or roasting tin. Use your hand to rub the garlic clove over top of the soup to keep it from burning. Bake at 375 degrees until the onions start to become golden and the garlic is beginning to crisp up. Cut the loaf into slices. Serve warm.

title: Steak and Bbq Appetizer (Pub Style)
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs round steaks, cut into serving sized pieces | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 8 ounces aged brie cheese, sliced | 16 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, sliced | 3 fresh figs, sliced
instructions: In a large frying pan, spread half of the ketchup over the steaks. Place one piece of brie atop the ketchup. Place a slice of cheddar and four slices of figs over the ketchup, making sure all the figs are covered. Add the remaining ketchup to the pan and stir to melt. Place steaks on a board, and turn when bubbles form on the surface. Remove the steaks and place into a lightly greased pan, and allow to finish cooking through. Repeat until all the steaks are cooked. Serve with fresh french bread and vegetables.

title: Tofu and Black Olives
ingredients: 2 cans black olives, including liquid | 1 package extra firm tofu, drained, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the black olives in a large bowl.

title: Curried Beef Roast
ingredients: 2 teaspoons curry paste | 1 pound beef eye round | sage, to taste | 4 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 cup wasabi | 4 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Brush the foil with water. Lay the roast out on a cutting board and poke several holes in it using a sharp knife, if necessary, to cut a small horizontal pocket. Insert a 1/2 teaspoon of curry paste into each hole. In a small bowl, stir together 1/4 cup of the nutritional yeast, 4 tablespoons of your remaining curry paste, and some sage. Slice the roast lengthwise almost all the way through, and stuff with the wasabi paste mixture until well sealed. Place meat on the prepared baking dish. Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven, or until it has deeply browned and is no longer pink in the center. Place remaining nutritional yeast into a small bowl, and stir in 2 1/4 to 1 1/2 tablespoons of water until creamy and the consistency is creamy. Slice the roasted beef thinly, and serve with the creamy glaze. A spatula would be a great way to do this or to lightly stir your potato into the glaze, which will also help bind the beef roast even more.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,pork tenderloin,poblano pepper,red chili sauce,water,marshmallow creme
title: Pork Chops and Poblano Jalapeno
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 1/4 cup red chili sauce | 1 tablespoon water | 1 teaspoon marshmallow creme | 1 poblano pepper | 4 cups beef stock | 1 1/2 cups water
instructions: Marinate pork with chili sauce, water and marshmallow cream. Cook on all sides in a heavy skillet, remove from heat and add pepper. Pour in beef stock and water. Place in a baking pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes remove from oven when internal temperature is 170 degrees. Let rest for 10 minutes slice and serve.

title: Chocolate Refrigerator Clone: Barbacoa
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon instant vanilla | 1 teaspoon garbanzo beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a coffee filter or mesh strainer until thoroughly mixed. Store in an airtight container.

title: Tres Leches
ingredients: 3 cans longhorn and chiles original mexican cheese blend ( i use manchego ) | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar ( or to taste )
instructions: In a heavy bottomed skillet, combine the chiles, cheese and vanilla sugar. Cover and heat on med high heat stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Take off heat. Stir in the hot cheese mixture. Cover and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Stir well and remove from heat. Let cool to room temperature. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Homemade Hot Brown (Porfez)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups pure tomato puree | 4 whole allspice berries | 4 teaspoons pure tomato paste with allspice
instructions: Combine the tomato puree, allspice, and 2 cups water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer until the solids are reduced to 1 cup, about 20 minutes. Strain the liquid through a cheesecloth lined sieve lined with several layers of cheesecloth into a clean bowl. Discard the solids. Mash the cooled tomato puree with an electric mixer until smooth. Stir in the tomato paste. Transfer to shallow containers, cover and refrigerate for at least 24 hours. Bring it to room temperature before serving.

title: Creamy Cabbage (Colcannon)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded ( about 3/4 pound total ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Pour the cabbage out onto the baking sheet. Spread any excess moisture out of the cabbage. Place the cabbage into the bowl of a blender, and cover with the cream. Cover, and pulse a few times. Chill the blender, covered, for 4 hours before serving, and serve in a pretty bowl along with some freshly ground pepper.

title: Rigatoni With Sausage and Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 15 ounces rigatoni pasta
instructions: Boil pasta as per directions on box. Slice sausage and cook in a skillet. In the last 10 minutes of cooking, sprinkle on italian sausage. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Yogurt Pie II
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | 1 can rotel | 2 tablespoons yogurt | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 cup grated confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place tortillas on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking oil. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 minutes, remove, and let cool. title: Vegan Miniature Chocolate and Beef Tacos
ingredients: 2 1/8 kg strong self-raising flour | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 packet cremini mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1 packet taco shells | 1 -2 tablespoon olive oil or 1 -2 tablespoon butter | 8 sheets unsalted butter-flavoured taco shells ( mini size ) | 100 g chocolate milk
instructions: Dough, sift the yeast into a big bowl. Add about half of the flour, about 1 tablespoon of the olive oil or butter. Add the rest of the flour and mix to a stiff dough. Do not over knead, as the yeast will make it extremely sticky. Turn out the dough onto a floured surface and knead until smooth. Do not over knead. You should have a soft dough which falls slightly into the bowl. If not, add a little flour. You should have a soft dough which rises and collapses lightly. You should have a thick but somewhat sticky dough which is pliable. Use a large glass, non stick pan or a large cookie cutter to push the dough down so that it is evenly spaced on the pan. Spray with the little non stick vegetable oil to avoid sticking. Place the tray into a warm oven for about 50 minutes or until almost set. Filling & assembly, to make the taco, spread a little of the taco milk on a plate. Roll the dough until it is quite thin. Cut in the smaller pieces by hand into slices. Line up the taco shells on a baking tray. Spread the filling in to the taco shells, leaving a good margin on the edge. Roll up the taco. Repeat with the remaining filling and filling to make a small tower or taco sandwich. Brush with beaten egg to seal the taco seam. Place on a baking tray seam side down. You should have 30 to 40 mini taco bases. Cover with plastic wrap and rest for about 20 minutes. Brush the mini taco with beaten egg, bake in a preheated oven of 400f for about 10 minutes they should be golden, but not brown. Remove from the oven, brush with melted chocolate and allow to cool slightly. Wrap in plastic wrap or cling wrap, place into the fridge, leave them to set for at least 1 hour before eating.

title: Dynamite Sauce

ingredients: 4 small eggs | 1 tablespoon olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 bag cherry tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat a large frying pan and add the olive oil. Swipe the pan around with a spatula so that the oil coats the bottom. Beat the eggs in a shallow bowl. Scatter half of the tomatoes over the hot pan and then pour eggs into the pan with the oil. Tap the pan to cook the omelette, then slide the omelette onto a baking paper lined tray. Repeat with the remaining tomatoes,. Bake for 10 minutes, or until eggs are lightly browned. Serve while hot.

title: Hot Peppers
ingredients: 4 large roasted sweet peppers | 6 ounces cream cheese, softened
instructions: Chop or dice the peppers and place in a medium bowl. Add the cream cheese and mix thoroughly with a fork. Spread onto a serving platter. Eat, or serve immediately.

title: Basmati Rice With Yoghurt
ingredients: 3/4 cup basmati rice ( washed ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons yoghurt ( low fat )
instructions: Rinse basmati rice with water. Drain. Soak for 30 minutes. Drain out water from the rice and keep aside. Wash yoghurt and cut in half. Add it to rice. Mix lightly. Now add a little water and mix again. Keep refrigerated for an hour or till the consistency of the rice is soft and consistent.

title: Okra With Tomatoes and Okras (Okra Snack)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs okra, ends trimmed | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Cut okra lengthwise into two 1/2 inch wide slices. Lay slices flat on two baking sheets. Sprinkle with worcestershire sauce. Bake at 400°f for 10 minutes, turning once. Bake five minutes longer or until okra is tender crisp.

title: Crispy Won Tons (Tamari Cookies)
ingredients: 1 package wonton wrappers ( found at asian markets ) | 1 tablespoon tamari ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb
instructions: First you want to prepare the won ton wrappers. Take one won ton wrapper, wrap closed and then with a toothpick poke about 1/2 holes in the wrappers a few times with a sharp knife. Place 2 or 3 wontons in a bowl and sprinkle wontons with tamari and bread crumbs. Dip each wrapper into remaining sauce and then in the bread crumbs. Then they are ready to cook in a large pot of salted water. Be sure to keep 2 or 3 on your hand when you do this and make sure the won tons are dry before you fry them.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,burrito flour tortilla,cilantro leaf,toothpick
title: Cilantro Chimichoke Rolls - to Just Like Your Dogs
ingredients: 2 burrito-size flour tortillas, 5 x 2 x 1 inch | 12 toothpicks | 2 tablespoons garlic-flavored fondue-mate chili pepper flakes, more to taste | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves, minced
instructions: Wrap a toothpick in cheese cloth and suspend it over the tortilla. Heat a griddle pan over medium high. When warm enough, sear the toothpick for about 30 - 45 seconds. Remove toothpick with tongs and spread tortilla out flat in skillet. Sprinkle tortilla with garlic chili flakes. Lay another toothpick on top of the tortilla closest to you and flip over. When the tortilla is slightly browned, remove from griddle. Sprinkle with minced cilantro. Serve with salsa, pico de gallo, guacamole. Served warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,cilantro,corn tortilla chip,balsamic vinegar,chili paste,turnip
title: Tikka Turnips Salad With Black Sesame Chips(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 small turnips, cut into 1/2 inch slices, washed, ends trimmed, and cut into 1/2 inch thick wedges ( about 5 pounds ) | 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 6 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro or 4 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 1 lb corn tortilla chips or 1 lb other crisp-cooked crumbled semi-firm white bread
instructions: In a large nonstick frying pan or griddle over medium high heat, combine the turnips and enough water to cover them by 1 inch. Bring the water to a simmer, and cook the turnips until very tender, about 20 minutes and the turnips can be pierced well with a spoon with a fork. They'll break up easily with a fork. Reserve 1 cup water. Drain the turnips and set aside them to cool slightly. In a small nonreactive mixing bowl, combine the vinegar, chili paste, cilantro and sesame seeds. In batches, season the turnips with salt and pepper to taste. Toast or toast a corn tortilla until just browned on both sides. Place the hot grilled turnips in a large serving bowl and spoon the dressing over them. Sprinkle with the black sesame seeds.

title: Beef, Kumara and Olive Stew
ingredients: 750 g beef, cut into 2cm, thick braising chunks | 250 g kalamata olives, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves ( or herb of choice ) | 1 baking potato, cut into 3cm, thick, thick and round slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 200. Grease a shallow ovenproof dish, and cover the base and part of the dish with the slices of potato. Cover with sliced beef, and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with curry powder and thyme. Cover with remaining potato slices. Put in the oven, and bake for 1 - ½ hours, or until beef and potato is cooked.

Random Ingredients: chocolate hazelnut nutella,gingerroot,greek yogurt,onion salt,mexican cheese,vegetable broth,kidney bean
title: Ribollita
ingredients: 1 can crushed kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 container greek-style yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped pickled gingerroot | 1 teaspoon grated onion salt | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 12 ounces mexican blend cheese, grated | 1/3 cup chocolate hazelnut spread with garlic or 1/3 cup nutella | 1 pinch salt ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl combine beans, yogurt, ginger, onion salt, and vegetable broth. Spread over a 10 or 12 inch metal or a glass baking dish. Top with cheese and hazelnut spread. Place under a broiler for 2 minutes or until cheese starts to bubble. Place under a hot grill for 3 minutes or until heated through. This is good served either hot or cold and the flavors meld together.

Random Ingredients: fryer chicken,ham hock,egg white,mint,parmesan cheese,teriyaki marinade
title: Fryer Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons teriyaki marinade | 2 pounds fryer chickens | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried mint | 1 egg white, lighted | 4 slices ham hocks
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together teriyaki, parmesan cheese and mint. Place the egg white and ham hocks into separate small, shallow dishes. Pour the teriyaki mixture over the ham hocks and marinate at least 1 hour, flipping occasionally. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place chicken on a baking sheet and top with the egg white slices. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, then turn off oven. Slice off pieces of the reserved ham hocks and serve on the ham hocks.

title: Aunt Gun-Supper Gorgonzola Delight
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sour cream with pimentos and cubed gorgonzola | 1 1/2 cups sweet spanish onions, sliced | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 -3 cup chili sauce | 1 cup chopped fresh mint
instructions: In a large bowl, mix sour cream, onions, cream of chicken soup, chili sauce and chopped mint. Divide gorgonzola and spread over individual servings of noodles. Serve with a sprinkling of chopped coriander leaves and cilantro.

title: Easy Italian Spinach With Chips
ingredients: 1 box baby spinach | 1 box mini chocolate chip | 1/4 cup fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pot or a large microwaveable bowl and microwave on high about 4 minutes or until hot stirring every minute. Stir with wood spoons.

title: Fiesta Beans
ingredients: 1 package pinto beans | 1 package sugar snap peas
instructions: Open the jar of beans, rinse, and place the beans in a saucepan. Cover, and bring the water to a boil. Add sugar snaps and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until tender, approximately 30 minutes. Pour off any excess liquid. Refrigerate overnight. The next morning, remove the skins from the sugar snaps, and slice the beans into bite sized pieces.

title: Crispy Salt Cod
ingredients: 5 lbs square dry-packed oyster-flavored cod fish ( not sure exactly how long or how thick to cut, depends on cut length of cod ) | 5 pinches mustard seeds | 1/2 red bell pepper, cut into thin diagonal slices | 1 lime, cut crosswise into wedges
instructions: Rinse the cod well under cold tap water several times. Drain well. Place in a shallow dish large enough for it. Place a heavy plate on top and turn over, repeating until the oil becomes saturated with white sandy goodness, about 10 hours. Drain and blot excess oil with a paper towel. Dry the salt cod well on a clean towel. In a small bowl, toss together mustard seeds and the pepper slices. Spread a thin layer of the mustard mixture evenly over the top of the cod. Lay the lime wedges on top of the mustard. Set aside for 30 minutes at room temperature or place in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,peach,chicken thigh,serrano chilies,rigatoni pasta,yellow bell pepper,basil
title: Grilled Chicken and Peaches Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 6 large green peppers ( about 8 oz size ) | 1 lb chicken thigh, skinned and boned | 2 large yellow bell peppers, seeded and sliced about 1/4 thick | 2 large serrano chilies, seeded and thinly sliced | 1/8 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1 package rigatoni pasta, cooked according to package directions, drained | 1 can sliced peaches, drained
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high and place chicken thighs in 2 - 9 inch metal baking dishes or pie pans. Cut a slit in each pepper a few times and place in dish. Sprinkle chilies and basil evenly over chicken. Insert a chicken thigh lengthwise into each pepper half. Place remaining peppers on top of chicken. Drizzle with oil. Place baking sheet with chicken and vegetables on grill and heat until pepper skins blister slightly and chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Garnish with peaches.

Random Ingredients: cod,oriental sesame oil,porcini mushroom,red capsicum,shiitake mushroom,romaine lettuce
title: Mushroom-Baked Cod With Sauteed Mushrooms for Two
ingredients: 1/2 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 6 medium shiitake mushrooms, stemmed, caps quartered | 1 small red capsicum, cut into thin strips | 4 heads romaine lettuce ( or other green leaf lettuce ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 1/4 lb cod, cleaned skinned and cut into strips ( preferably with large chunks )
instructions: Place the mushrooms and capsicum in a small saucepan, cover with 2 cups water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, until just tender. Drain the mushroom capsicum. Put the mushrooms and capsicum in a large bowl. Add the chilies, vinegar, and sesame oil. Set aside for 25 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the broiler rack in the middle of the oven. Arrange the fish on two baking sheets. Bake them until cooked through, about 8 - 10 minutes. Turn the fish over and move it around to roast an additional 3 - 5 minutes, until the fish is just cooked through. Meanwhile, warm the sesame oil in a small saucepan over low heat. Transfer the mushrooms and capsicum to a serving dish and top with the romaine leaves. Drizzle with the sesame oil and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,lime zest,baking soda,cardamom powder,spanish onion,self rising flour
title: Mango Chutney Bites (Cookies)
ingredients: 1 cup diced mango chutney | 2 chopped spanish onions | 1 teaspoon finely grated lime zest | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300°f grease/line a cookie sheet with baking parchment. Combine the mango chutney, onions, lime zest, flour, baking soda, and cardamom powder in a bowl, mixing using a fork until the dry ingredients are incorporated. Drop the mixture onto the oiled cookie tray and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the tops are pale golden brown and crisp.

Random Ingredients: green chili,coca cola,pork,phyllo pastry,dough,white mushroom,cavender greek seasoning,oat
title: Mushroom & Pork Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 3 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 1 can white mushrooms ( or 1lb. ) | 1 2 lbs pork or 2 lbs ham | 3 teaspoons cava cola or 3 teaspoons evaporated milk | 1 teaspoon cavender's greek seasoning | 1 teaspoon green chili | 1/2 cup rolled oats | 1/2 teaspoon grounded cappelle or 1/2 teaspoon grounded all-beef broth/water
instructions: Thaw phyllo and thaw phyllo sheets as directed on package. Slice ham into 2x2 pieces. Slice mushrooms into 1/2 inch pieces. Brown in frying pan til no longer pink drain off fat add pork or ham. Add seasonings. Mix well. Preheat oven to place thawed phyllo layers in a greased 9x13 dish or shallow casserole pan. Cover phyllo layers with all the white mushroom/ham mixture, brushing each layer with 2tbps. Dot with 1/2tsp. Oats, sprinkle with remaining oats, top with remaining mushrooms and then top with the rest of the oats. Cover phyllo layers with foil or tent with aluminum foil. Bake for 30 minutes remove foil and bake uncovered for another 5 minutes or just until phyllo is golden on top. Serve.

title: Palak Paneer
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 4 tablespoons chickpea flour | 4 spinach leaves, washed and chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil or ghee in a non stick pot. Once hot, stir in the garlic paste and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Add chickpea flour and mix well. Stir fry for 5 to 10 minutes until the mixture becomes dry and the oil separates from it. Add chopped spinach leaves and continue to stir to stir for 2 or 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,ginger garlic paste,italian plum tomato,cannellini bean,ginger
title: Quick and Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can italian-style plum tomatoes, drained and minced | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 package ramen noodles, broken | 1 tablespoon minced crystallized ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spread a layer of casserole sauce into the bottom of a 2 quart casserole dish, and layer the cannellini, plum tomatoes, ginger garlic paste, and ramen noodles. Repeat layers until dish is full, and top with crystallized ginger. Cover, and bake for one hour in the preheated oven, then remove cover, and bake for an additional 15 minutes.

title: Asian Style Hoisin Vegetables
ingredients: 4 cups pea carrots, cut diagonally in 1/2-inch slices | 1 cup bok choy, sliced into 1-inch strips | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons dressing, of choice | 1 maraschino cherry
instructions: Rinse and dry vegetables. Place vegetables in a large shallow serving dish. In a small bowl, whisk together the hoisin sauce and dijon dressing until well blended. Pour over vegetables and chill for at least 1 hour. Garnish with maraschino cherries before serving.

title: Danish Marinated Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: In a small jar, combine the vinegar, marjoram and pepper. Close, and shake well to combine. Use to marinate steaks as desired.

title: S.o.s. Fridays BBQ
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread | pam cooking spray | 10 tablespoons picante sauce | 10 tablespoons molasses | 1/2 cup celery
instructions: Preheat grill. Cut rashes in bread and place in a shallow dish. Coat with pam. Cook on both sides until browned, then remove with spatula. Place picante sauce, molasses, celery in a sauce pan, stirring to mix. Bring to boil. Pour over toast. Serve.

title: Refried Beans and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 20 ounces pinto beans | 5 ounces chopped hazelnuts, divided | 1/2 cup enchilada sauce
instructions: If beans are large, cut in half lengthwise. If using a blender, run chipotle chile in it. If you do not have a blender, chop up the chiles and place them in a microwavable bowl. Add 1 1/2 cups water, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power for about five minutes or until the water boils away, then remove the plastic wrap and cut in half. Save the chile. Rinse and drain the beans and put in a crock pot. Add in 1/2 cup of hazelnuts. Pour in enchilada sauce and remaining 1/2 cup of hazelnuts. Stir everything together. Add in water in small increments if necessary until beans are covered but not falling apart. Cover and cook on high power for 2 to 3 hours or on low for 2 - 3 hours. When served, turn off heat. You may want to add salt to taste. Enjoy.

title: Gingerbread II
ingredients: 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1 package yeast | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 5 pounds hamburger
instructions: Soak the hamburger in warm water for about 20 minutes, drain and add the ginger paste. In a large bowl, cream the cream and add the yeast to it.

title: Greek Seafood Pie
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried smoked sausage | 1 lb cod ( flounder weight ) | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 2 teaspoons chopped candied clove | 1/2 lb feta cheese | 1 unbaked 9- pie shell, pre baked
instructions: Place cleaned dried sausage in frying pan over med high heat until it is no longer pink, about 10 mins or longer. Drain excess fat. Cut into chunks and set aside. Rinse cod well and pat dry with paper towels. Place cleaned cod into a large pot of boiling salted water and simmer for 5 min or until fish flakes easily when tested with fork. Set aside. Remove any skin and bones from cod. Set aside. Break or coarsely dice cod into bite size pieces and set aside. Drain sun dried tomato oil from frying pan well and stir in sun dried tomato, parsley, and minced clove. Place drained cod, sausage chunks, and crumbled feta cheese into the mixing bowl with the sun dried tomatoes and egg mixture. Stir in chopped fresh parsley. Transfer into pre baked pie shell. Bake at 350°f for 40 - 45 min or until edges become brown. Serve over your favorite pasta and enjoy.

title: Veal Milanese
ingredients: 1 1 lb veal steaks, thickly sliced ( about 4-8 ounces ) | 3/4 cup bread flour | 2/3 cup white flour | 1 4/3 cups vegetable stock
instructions: In a large saucpan, heat 1/2 cup water and the veal until cooked through, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain the veal, reserving broth, and set aside to cool. Place the bread flour and white flour in separate paper plates or shallow, shallow bowls, and set aside. Place the stock in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart saucepan over high heat, add the stock and bring to a boil, scraping the bottom in the pan with a rubber spatula to loosen any flavorful bits of flour that cling to the bottom. Return chicken to pan and simmer for 3 minutes, turning to brown both sides. Serve with a nice creamy soup or noodles.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon sugar mixture,peppercorn,plain flour,five spice powder,icing sugar
title: Spiced Five-Spice Shortbread Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup icing sugar | 1 cup plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon sugar mixture
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c/fan 160'c line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Sift icing sugar into bowl and mix with flour, spice and peppercorns. Roll out and cut into 25 fingers. Place 5cm apart on trays and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until pale golden. Sprinkle with icing sugar once cooled, then cool.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,lamb shank,hazelnut liqueur,brown lentil,sage leaf,cane sugar,salmon fillet,mustard
title: Brown Lentils With Smoked Salmon and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets, skinned | 2 tablespoons mixed chopped fresh sage leaves | 1/3 cup pine nuts | 4 tablespoons brown lentils, washed and picked over | 2 teaspoons dried mustard | 2 teaspoons dried whole mixed pulses ( pindi, yellow lentils ) | 1 tablespoon unbleached cane sugar | 2 tablespoons hazelnut-flavored liqueur
instructions: Cut three diagonal slits into each salmon fillet and place them skin side up in a non metallic baking dish. Combine the sage and pine nuts in a small bowl. Set aside. Spread a little hazelnut paste over each salmon fillet, leaving about 2cm / 1/2 inch border at the top of each fillet. Top with 2 tsp dried pindi / dried whole mixed pulses and a generous layer of dried hazelnut paste. Sprinkle over the mustard and scatter over 2 tsp dried pindi / dried whole mixed pulses. Add 1 tsp ground mixed pulses/powdered mixed pulses and 2 tsp dried whole mixed pulses. Cover loosely and leave at room temperature for 2 - 4 hours. After 2 hours, remove the salmon fillets to a serving platter, arrange the salmon fillets in one layer over the lentils and sprinkle over the hazelnut paste. Dot over the hazelnut paste. Combine the cane sugar and the liqueur in a small saucepan over low heat, stir well. Once the sugar dissolved, remove from the heat and stir. Pour over the salmon fillets. Serve hot. Note, to make the hazelnut paste, preheat your oven to 375°f / 160°c. Place a piece of foil on the oven rack, top with 2 tbsp of hazelnut paste on each piece of foil.. Bake in a hot oven for approximately 30 minutes or until the hazelnuts have melted and the cheese is melted. Remove the foil and place the salmon on a serving platter. Pour the cheese sauce over them and serve on the side.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,cardamom,black bean,cream mushroom soup,coriander seed,yellow bell pepper,basil leaf
title: Creamy Indian Dip - Great on Fruit (Aka Fantastic)
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 yellow sweet bell pepper or 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon ground cayenne or 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1/2 - 2/3 cup basil leaves, chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely crushed cardamom ( more if you like it ) | 2 -3 anaheim chilies ( optional ) | 32 ounces black beans, drained ( optional )
instructions: In blender or food processor, combine soup, peppers, cayenne, cilantro, coriander, cardamom and basil, if using, and blend well. Heat in slow cooker on low setting, stirring often for at least 10 minutes. Stir in beans. Cover and cook on high 2 hours, stirring every hour. Enjoy note, any additional green chilies or a combination can be used, and it tastes great served with pita chips or crackers.

title: Spicy Mexican Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 5 cups unbleached flour | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 3 1/2 - 4 cups ice, divided | 3 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise | 1 1/2 tablespoons light balsamic vinegar, preferably aged black | 3 tablespoons dried rosemary leaves | 1 large poblano chiles or 1 large any mild red pepper
instructions: In food processor, pulse the 2 cups of each flour with the dry yeast. Add 2 cups water, 1/2 3 cups ice and 2 cups of remaining flour. Add the zucchini and pulse just until the dough holds together, but is not smooth. On floured surface, knead the dough by hand for about 5 minutes. Place in a well buttered bowl, cover and set in a warm spot to rise until doubled in size, about 1 1/2 hours. Punch down and divide into 4 equal sized portions. Lightly oil a large baking sheet, using a dough scraper. Place one piece of dough onto sheet and stretch down into a rectangle shape about 1 in length. Cover and set aside in a warm spot to rise until doubled in size. Repeat with the remaining dough. Place the remaining 1/2 cup ice in a deep skillet and melt over medium heat. Place the poblano in the skillet and cook, turning until blackened on all sides. Drain on paper towels and set aside. Turn the heat to medium high and add the vinegar to the hot skillet. Crack in the rosemary and cook, stirring, for about 30 seconds. Remove from heat and place the poblano in a warm bowl covered with cool water. Wipe out the skillet. Set aside. To make the topping, preheat the oven to 425°f. Roll each piece of dough into a ball, dip in flour and then the remaining ice. Place the ball on prepared baking sheet. Spread the remaining topping over and using fingers, spread evenly. Repeat with remaining pieces. Bake until crisp and lightly browned, about 25 minutes.

title: Baked Broccoli Flowers
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1 jar maraschino cherries
instructions: Break off florets from broccoli stems. Spray bottom of 9x13 pan with pan spray. Arrange broccoli flowers in pan, pour remaining sauce over top, sprinkle with onion and cook in preheated 350 oven for 40 minutes. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,white flour,bamboo shoot,tofu,black bean,chicken breast half,brioche bread,graham cracker
title: Black Bean and Yogurt Cheese Chicken
ingredients: 3 ounces baked brioche bread | 2 ounces tofu, drained | 15 ounces black beans, drained | 10 ounces white flour | sliced bamboo shoot, for garnish | 5 boneless chicken breast halves, cooked and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup graham cracker, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place brioche in an oven safe pie pan. Top with the tofu, then sprinkle with black beans. Mix the flour with water until moistened. Fold in the black beans and bamboo shoots. Spread the batter evenly over tofu, followed by the chicken. Sprinkle top with feta cheese and crushed graham crackers. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Allow to cool for a few minutes, then cut into small squares to serve. If desired, drizzle yogurt and a few chopped green onions over the chicken and black bean before serving.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,asiago cheese,chinese five spice powder,olive oil,chicken thigh,grain rice,serrano chilies
title: Arroz Con Pollo (Chicken With Rice)
ingredients: 1/2 cup asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 green chilies or 1 jalapeno chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno chile, seeded and finely chopped | 4 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs, cooked, halved lengthwise and cut into 1-inch pieces ( about 1 pound ) | 1 1/4 cups cooked long-grain rice or 1 1/4 cups uncooked medium grain rice, rinsed, drained | 2 teaspoons chinese five-spice powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f with 2 or 3/4 inch of water, lightly coat a large 13x9x2 glass baking dish with cooking spray. Combine cheese, oil, chiles and chile in a small bowl and refrigerate 1/2 cup cheese mixture in another small bowl, stirring until cheese is blended. Place chicken and rice in a large bowl. Sprinkle chicken mixture with spices and cheese mixture and toss to coat. Pour remaining cheese mixture over chicken. Bake, uncovered, until hot and chicken is cooked through, about 30 minutes.

title: Black Russian Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Mash all ingredients with a fork. Stir in to thicken as it sits and refrigerate well before using as an additional step along with poultry or pork.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,yellow squash,tequila,thai fish sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Spicy Yellow Squash With Tequila and Vietnamese Seasoning
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 large yellow squash, cut into 1/3-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce | 2 teaspoons tequila, divided | steamed rice wine ( optional ) or white wine vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Spray a 13x9 baking pan with cooking spray, set aside. Arrange squash in a single layer in prepared baking pan. Lightly coat squash with cooking spray. Broil in the preheated oven 35 - 40 minutes, or until squash is tender and begins to turn golden brown. Brush squash with fish sauce and set aside. Place 1 teaspoon tequila and 1/2 teaspoon rice wine in a small bowl. Stir well. Drizzle mixture over top of squash and serve immediately.

title: Blackberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 cup fresh blackberries
instructions: In a large glass or stainless steel bowl, stir together the heavy cream, vinegar and blackberries. Cook over moderate heat, stirring often, until reduced to about 1 1/2 cups, about 10 minutes. Stir in sugar to taste, remove from heat and let cool several minutes. Stir occasionally as sauce thickens. Store any leftover sauce in the refrigerator for up to 1 month in an airtight jar.

title: Sweet Indian Prune Jam
ingredients: 1 kg prune | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste
instructions: Remove the peel from the prunes by placing it in a large bowl containing water and letting it sit for about 10 to 15 minutes. Then drain. Discard the skins. Place half of the prunes into a large frying pan and cover with water. Bring to the boil and simmer for about 50 to 60 minutes or until the prunes have split. Remove from heat. Place over a low heat and stir the remaining prunes with the tamarind paste until they are mixed well. Return to the heat. Increase the heat to low and add the prunes. Cover with a lid or tightly seal with foil. Simmer for 10 minutes or until prunes have become very soft. Stir every so often to ensure they don’t catch. Once the prunes have cooked through, remove and place onto a serving plate. Serve with yoghurt or milk.

title: Tunisian Tiramisu (Tunisian-Middle East)
ingredients: 7 ounces ladyfingers | 1/4 cup ground herbs | 1/2 teaspoon harissa | 2 tablespoons mixed dried herbs ( basil, paprika, and oregano ) | 1/2 cup beef broth
instructions: Cut the ladyfingers into thirds lengthwise, but not too deeply. Arrange them neatly in the bottom of a large glass 9x9 inch glass or ceramic baking dish that will fit nicely inside. Sprinkle the herbs, harissa, and dried herbs over the ladyfingers. Pour broth over everything, leaving at least a 1 inch border on the ends. Cover loosely with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for up to two days, or overnight. Remove plastic wrap, and refrigerate for up to a week. Preheat over to 350 degrees. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake until the biscuits are golden brown, about 20 - 25 minutes, but still moist inside. Serve.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,pearl barley,accent seasoning,dark brown sugar,green bean,self rising flour,monterey jack pepper cheese,beef tenderloin
title: Tenderloin Applesauce Beef Rollups
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut in 1 inch cubes | 1 cup sliced green beans | 1 can dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup acent seasoning | 3/4 cup self-rising flour | 3/4 cup pearl barley | 3/4 cup mild applesauce | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.

Random Ingredients: lemon,mustard seed,napa cabbage,cooking oil,apple juice,brown mustard seed,pasta,cherry
title: Polish Christmas Salad
ingredients: 1 large napa cabbage | 1 apple - peeled, cored and chopped | 2 cups cooked pasta | 1 cup chopped dried cherries ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons mustard seed | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 5 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Remove leaves from the head of cabbage, and cut in half lengthwise. Place the leaf pieces in a large bowl. Tear off the thick stems and cut into about half inch pieces. Add the apple, pasta, cherries, and mustard seed to the cabbage mixture. Stir in the mustard seed and lemon juice until well mixed. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. When oil is quite hot, carefully drop the mixture by 1 tablespoonfuls into the hot oil. Cook 1 minute, turning once. Drain on paper towels, and sprinkle with additional salt before serving.

Random Ingredients: stilton cheese,bell pepper,orange,goat cheese,yellow bell pepper,peanut butter,ketchup
title: Stoofpe Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 150 g fresh soft goat cheese, crumbled | 150 g stilton cheese, crumbled | 150 g peanut butter, smooth ( i use reduced fat ) | 1 small tomatoes, finely diced ( optional ) | 1 small yellow bell pepper, finely diced ( optional ) | 1 small red bell pepper, finely diced ( optional ) | 1 small orange, zest of, finely grated ( if using orange, orange should be used to add colour to the salad ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Combine all ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,lemon zest,vanilla ice cream,table salt,cornstarch

title: Tamarind-Cashews and Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 cup tamarind paste | 1 cup cashews, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Place the beef in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish.

title: Savory Salt.
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon savory ( can be adjusted according to preference ) or 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh savory ( can be adjusted according to preference )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,spice,french bread,corn chip,red curry paste,apple cider vinegar,egg,amaretto
title: Apple Chip Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 2 eggs | 3/4 cup crushed corn chips | 2 cups dry egg noodles | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice ( or up to 3/4 tsp. chili powder, or cayenne pepper ) | french bread or baguette | 1/4 - 1/2 cup amaretto
instructions: Dressing, whisk together red curry paste, vinegar, eggs, and corn chips. Let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes or slightly warmer. Crumble 2 cups of cooked noodles, and toss with curry paste dressing as needed for a light, fluffy dressing. Slice french bread or baguette. Spread noodles on bread or baguette slices, top with amaretto, then lettuce. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,purple onion,dark chocolate,ghee,red wine,bean sprout,serrano pepper,french bread
title: Chokladbok (Indonesian Bread and Bean Sprouts)
ingredients: 1 cup french bread, stale | 1 bunch bean sprouts | 1/4 cup soft dark chocolate | 1 small purple onion, chopped | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup ghee
instructions: Soak bread in water. Drain. Mix all the ingredients and form into long thin cakes. Melt ghee in a pan. Fry the cakes on medium heat until golden brown on all sides. Serve as a side with a salad.

title: Cream Cheese Salad With Champagne And Nuts
ingredients: 100 g philadelphia cream cheese | 100 g peanut butter ( crunchy type-you 'll need more ) | 3 tablespoons champagne ( champagne we use one ) | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon pistachios ( optional ) or 1/8 crystall oat ( optional )
instructions: Process cheese, peanut butter and champagne with a machine in the order stated. Add anise seeds and mixed herbs or optional ingredients and process till mixed well, and then add the nuts, if using.

title: Chocolate, Yoghurt & Cocoa Rice Burritos
ingredients: 100 g sushi rice | 400 550 g natural yoghurt | 1 cup cocoa, sifted | 2 tablespoons cocoa
instructions: Rinse sushi rice under running water until water runs clear. Drain. Boil up some of your water, and stir the rice and water. Put the rice and a cup of yoghurt in separate bowls. Divide cocoa between bowls. Spread about 3 tbls of cocoa on the rice, and roll burritos. You can serve immediately, if it looks overly gooey, store it in the refrigerator in an airtight container for at least 8 hours before eating. If you want a chunkier meal, use 2 tablespoons of cocoa mixed with a little extra yoghurt.

title: Garlic andnanami Dip - Microwave
ingredients: 250 g nanami togarashi | 2 tablespoons garlic cloves, finely minced ( or pressed ) | 1 pinch cayenne ( or to taste )
instructions: Warm the nanami in the microwave for 4 minutes or until softened slightly and translucent. Add the garlic and cayenne and stir continuously for 5 minutes until the garlic and nanami are well incorporated into the dip. Serve with fresh bread or your favourite breadcrumbs.

title: Cream Cheese With Green Chilies and Herbs
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese ( i use light cream cheese ) | 2 tablespoons red chilies, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons thyme or 1 1/2 tablespoons rosemary, chopped | 1 large orange, zest and juice | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: In food processor blend cream cheese, chiles, thyme, orange zest and juice. If cream cheese has been mixed with onion or chiles add in nuts at this addition.

title: Kale & Halibut With Sauteed Halibut
ingredients: 1 halibut | 1/4 cup fajita seasoning mix ( i use orzar brand ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon almond essence | 2 cups kale ( i like kale in this ) | 1 lb penne | 1 lb flank steak, 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick
instructions: Cut steak into 1/2 inch strips. Season with fajita seasoning, oregano & almond essense to prepare marinade for fillet,. Bring water to a boil in a large pot for pasta. Meanwhile, preheat grill to high. Lightly coat grill pan with cooking spray & place steak in the pan. Cook 6 - 8 minutes, turning once, till done to your liking,. While steak is cooking, add kale & cook until it is cooked but not cooked through. Cook penne according to directions. Serve steak on top of penne or with greens & the sauteed kale. You can also use frozen kale and omit or add it to the steak before cooking.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,mayonnaise,kosher salt pepper,bouillon cube,phyllo pastry,hungarian paprika,lasagne noodle
title: German Style Basted Noodles from Kraft
ingredients: 6 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed ( or use a 1 1/2 lb. box ), thawed ( or use a 1 1/2 lb. box ) | kosher salt and pepper, to taste | 4 slices prosciutto, thinly sliced | 4 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings or 1 tablespoon lard | 1/2 - 3/4 cup mayonnaise ( optional ) | 1 bouillon cube, dissolved in | 3/4 cup boiling water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat 2 3/4 cup baking sheets with nonstick spray. Cut phyllo sheets in thirds crosswise, stopping once to fold over corners, and place about one third of sheets on sheet with the flat edge of a glass, allowing some of the phyllo to cover the bottom of the sheet. Brush with oil. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange half the prosciutto slices in a circle over the prosciutto. Sprinkle half the paprika over the prosciutto. Sprinkle half the bacon pieces over the bacon in a single layer. Arrange half the remaining prosciutto slices across the bacon mixture. Sprinkle with half the remaining paprika and half the bacon strips. Working from the short edge, fold the phyllo dough in half, then cut into 1 squares. Spread the phyllo squares out on a large baking sheet. Brush on the remaining oil over the sheets, then spread the remaining phyllo squares over the top of a baking sheet. Bake until golden in the center — about 12 - 15 minutes. Meanwhile, make the mayonnaise by mixing together, the mayonnaise, bouillon and boiling water. Pour over the noodles, and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Pizza Appetizers
ingredients: 1 cup pizza sauce | 1/3 cup brown ale or 1/3 cup apple juice, of choice
instructions: Pour the pizza sauce on a large platter. Place toppings in the order listed under 'Distribute' the toppings. Use the back of a spoon to spread the sauce over the pizza, if desired.

title: Italian Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 cup salsa | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup red onion, chopped
instructions: Crumble sausage into a medium bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients and mix until well blended.

title: Lemongrass and Raisin Satay
ingredients: 6 ounces dark rum | 6 ounces light rum | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube ( i use better than bouillon chicken base but any will do ) | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, minced ( not paste ) | 1 lime, juice of | 1/2 - 3/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: In a mixing bowl add all ingredients except raisins place in a plastic bag and crush, then add raisins and shake vigorusly. Pour mixture onto skewers on greased grill over medium coals. Cook for 10 - 15 minute or grill until desired consistency. Watch the grill to determine how many skewers it will take to cook skewer. Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Easy Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce mix | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3 cups drained pasta
instructions: Prepare spaghetti according to package directions. Drain. Mix spaghetti, soup, and cream together in a saucepan.

title: Banana Rice
ingredients: 2 cups bananas, chopped | 1 large celery root, peeled and diced | 1 cup chopped bean sprouts | 1/2 cup sweet marsala ( or orange juice )
instructions: Steam the bananas just until tender, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, saute celery root and sprouts in a skillet until soft. Transfer to a colander and rinse under cold water to remove any sand or extra moisture. Pat rice dry with a paper towel. Place in a large serving bowl. Add the potatoes, carrots, bean sprouts, and marsala.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,orange,phyllo pastry,mini chocolate chip,tikka paste,cherry,chili flake
title: Christmas Pasta
ingredients: 350 g rigatoni pasta | 1 cup semisweet mini chocolate chips | 1/2 cup semisweet mini chocolate chips | 2 1/2 teaspoons tikka paste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 teaspoons orange rind, grated | 125 g cherries, halved | 30 g log shaped phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup orange juice and 1/3 cup of orange juice, divided
instructions: Place the pasta on to boil in large saucepan of boiling water. Cook, uncovered, and stirring, for 6 - 7 minutes or until al dente. Drain. Set aside. Put chocolate chips in pan set over low heat, stirring until melted. Stir through zest and remaining sauce ingredients. Set aside. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain well. Return to pan, add pasta, coat with remaining sauce. Cover and cool for 4 - 5 minutes. Spray a shallow baking dish or pan with non stick cooking spray. Unroll phyllo sheets and arrange 7 - 10 evenly on the bottom of the dish. Top with phyllo sheets and brush with remaining olive oil. Bake in preheated oven at 190° c for 10 minutes until crisp. Cut into squares to serve. Add orange juice to drippings in pan and cook over medium heat until slightly reduced. Reduce heat to very low and stir into pan. Spread a small amount over each pasta cube. Serve with a drizzle of orange juice.

title: Easy Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1 cup soy sauce
instructions: Place rice in a bowl and coat with soy sauce. Let sit for 30 minutes or longer, covered, to absorb any excess liquid. Serve warm.

title: Hiyashi
ingredients: 1 cup bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons white miso ( fermented seaweed ) | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice
instructions: Blanch beansprouts in a pot of boiling water for just a few seconds just to soften them. Drain and then immediately immerse them in ice cold water. Allow to cool and then drain again until completely cold and ready to use. Mix miso with orange juice and transfer the salad to a bowl. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red apple,vinegar,picante sauce,taco seasoning mix,yogurt,amaretto,cheese,seasoning salt
title: Mexican Appetizer Salad
ingredients: 4 medium red apples, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 8 ounces picante sauce, medium | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 package processed cheese | 8 ounces yogurt ( low fat is ok ) | 3 tablespoons vinegar | adobo seasoning salt | 1 1/2 - 2 cups thousand island dressing ( i use newman's own, but if you use reg ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a medium bowl add apples, picante sauce, taco seasoning mix, cheese and yogurt. Note, i cut it and then i left the yogurt in the pan and just had them on the side.

title: Baby Bok Choy Soup
ingredients: 4 large tomatoes | 1 lb baby bok choy, well washed
instructions: Bring water to boil. Drop tomatoes by half. As soon as they are boiling lower heat and place the whole leaves into the water. When the leaves are soft and floating, add the bok choy. Boil until the bok choy looks like a flower. Remove the leaves, and chop as desired.

title: Potato Wedges With a Fresh Grapefruit Juice
ingredients: 1 ripe apple, peeled and finely cubed | 1 1/2 lbs potatoes, peeled, with the center cut out and cut wedges | 1/2 cup fresh grapefruit juice | 1 chopped ripe sweet apple, such as a pippin | fine breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place apples in a large baking dish. Place wedges between sheets of waxed paper and shape into 2 round cakes about 1 1/2 in diameter. Brush with grapefruit juice. Bake wedges about 50 minutes. Let cool then sprinkle lightly with bread crumbs. These are great served with a slice of fresh fruit for some toasted, crunchy crème fraîche or as an accompaniment to a hot soup. Variation, a french or italian bread roll goes well with this.

title: Chipotle Fish
ingredients: 400 g firm white fish fillets, cut into chunks | 1/3 - 1/2 cup dried roasted peppercorns | 1/2 - 3/4 tablespoon dried chipotle chiles, flakes | 125 g pickled green chili | 125 g green cherries
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c / 400°f. Using your hands rub the dried chili flakes in the fish. Place the fish chunks in a baking dish or roasting tin. Place the dried chipotle flakes and pickled green chillies around the fish. Pour over 500ml warm water and bake for 10 mins until the fish is just cooked through. Serve with rice, salad & vegetables.

title: Italian Sausage and Tomato Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 1 pound pork sausage | 3 cans stewed tomatoes
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine salad dressing mix with enough water to make the mixture moist but not watery. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. Remove casings from sausage, and brown over medium heat until the grease has run out of the sausage. Use the reserved grease to coat the bottom of a large baking dish. Place sausage in the dish, and cover evenly with the stewed tomatoes. Cover, and bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Apples
ingredients: 7 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 2 teaspoons horseradish | 1/4 cup light sour cream or 1/4 cup coconut cream | 3 green apples
instructions: Melt chocolate in top of double boiler, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in horseradish. Let cool slightly. Pare casseroles. Place apple wedges in casserole. Top with chocolate mixture. Place in 300 degree oven and cook 30 minutes, until hot in centre of oven. Cool.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,dill,baby spinach,cabbage,vital wheat gluten
title: Healthy Spinach & Dill Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup vital wheat gluten | 500 g baby spinach, washed ( if frozen, thaw in microwave ) | 200 g cabbage, washed ( or similar ) | 2 tablespoons dill ( fresh or dried )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees celsius in a large bowl, mix flour gluten and vital wheat mix. Add 1 1/2 cups of water to sieve, then sieve the flour mixture. Add the drained baby spinach and cabbage and mix well. Mix in the remaining 2 1/2 cups of water and dill. Mix well and place in a large well greased loaf tin. Mix remaining 1 1/2 cups of water and flour until smooth and pour into loaf tin. Bake for approximately 40 minutes, until the crust is golden brown. When removed from the oven, cut into slices with a very sharp knife. Serve warm with butter and pickles or your favourite veg.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,mint sprig,red snapper fillet,baby spinach,kosher salt,manchego cheese,lemon peel,sea salt
title: Broiled Red Snapper W-Spinach-Minted Manchego Cheese
ingredients: 4 red snapper fillets | kosher salt | 1/2 cup thinly sliced manchego cheese | 1 tablespoon finely shredded lemon peel | 1/2 cup baby spinach, chopped | 2 tablespoons minced mint sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon salt over each side of the fish. Place the fish in a glass baking dish. Top each fish with 1/2 cup manchego cheese. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate while making the manchego sauce. Preheat the broiler. In a small bowl, whisk together the mint sprig, cardamom, and salt. Sprinkle evenly over the fish. Place the dish under the broiler and broil 8 minutes. Turn the fish over and broil 4 - 5 minutes more or until the fish flakes easily.

title: Brie and Brie on Pretzel
ingredients: 1 cup liquid smoke ( your favourite brand ) | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 3 1/2 cups whole milk or 3 1/2 cups 2 % low-fat milk | 1/2 lb brie cheese, sliced or 1/2 lb other aged brie cheese
instructions: Warm the liquid smoke. In a medium saucepan of barely simmering water, mix 1 teaspoon active dry yeast with 1 cup or so of the warm liquid smoke. When dissolved, pour into a mixing bowl and let sit until foamy, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, place the slices of brie in to a bowl and pour in the cooled liquid smoke. Sprinkle the tops of the brie with a pinch each of salt and freshly ground black pepper. Allow to sit until soft, about 30 minutes or so. Drain excess liquid smoke off of the brie. Using a large, round baking dish, line the bottom of the dish with alternate cut side slices of the brie. Top with 1/4 of the drained liquid smoke over the top, and let sit until the liquid is absorbed, about 30 minutes. Place the cheese slices over top. Cover with plastic wrap directly on top of the bruschetta. Leave them in a warm place in a warm oven for at least an hour, or preferably overnight. Let rest a few minutes, then serve with the pretzel.

title: Green Curry Veggies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 1/4 pounds kielbasa, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sweet basil | 3 tablespoons unsalted peanuts, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 20 small ears fresh mixed vegetables
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium heat. Stir fry the kielbasa until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Mix in the curry paste, parmesan cheese, basil, peanuts, paprika and vegetable seasoning. Mix in the vegetables. Increase heat to medium high.

title: Spiced Chicken and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek | 3 1/4 lbs chicken wings, tips and tips discarded | 1 bunch cilantro leaf, leaves only
instructions: Rinse quinoa in a sieve and run it under cold water for 2 minutes, or until the water runs clear. Shake the quinoa in a cloth or strainer to remove excess water. Meanwhile, put the chicken wings in a saucepan or large pot with about 3/4 cup of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, but not overcooked. You can cook up to 90 minutes in the microwave. Drain chicken and reserve the cooking liquid. When the quinoa is cool enough to handle, shred it with your fingers or a fork. Add about 1/3 cup of the reserved cooking liquid and the fenugreek.

title: Blueberry and Broccoli Pie
ingredients: 2 cups fresh broccoli | 3 eggs | 1 cup self raising flour ( or half and half flour ) | 3/4 cup ketchup | 1 cup blueberries | 3/4 cup baby cabbage ( about 4 large handfuls ) | 3 slices prosciutto ( thin slice ) | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped
instructions: Cook the broccoli in boiling water for 8 - 10 minutes or until tender. Drain well, cut the broccoli in half if it isn't big, and peel the leaves off if it isn't big. Heat oven to 160c/fan 160c. Lightly grease a deep ovenproof dish. Beat together the eggs, flour and ketchup in a bowl. Add the broccoli, cabbage and blueberries and gently fold them into the mixture. Pour the mixture into the dish and scatter with the slices of prosciutto or some chives. Bake for about 30 - 40 minutes, or until the filling is browned and risen. Serve with jam and fresh fruit or cream.

title: Creamy Curry Cashew Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( available as asian curry paste ( also called curry powder ), or more to taste ( available as asian curry paste ) | 1/4 cup roasted cashews
instructions: Mix curry paste with cashews. Bring to a simmer in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,zucchini,onion soup mix,fish sauce,dark brown sugar
title: Sugar and Vegetable Saute
ingredients: 1 zucchini, chopped | 1 head cabbage, sliced | 1 can sliced okra or ( 1 1/4 ounce ) can any other dark soy bean, drained | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Saute the onions over medium heat for 3 minutes in a microwave safe dish coated with oil. Combine all vegetables, mix well. Remove the top of the cover, sprinkle the fish sauce mixture over, and let heat through.

title: Chocolate Stove Top Beef
ingredients: 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 12 ounces stew meat, i like to use chuck roast | nut, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Mix in baggie.
