title: Enchilada Green Salad
ingredients: 6 green olives, coarsely chopped | 1 cup pitted green olives, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon orange peel | 1/3 cup chopped fresh red chile peppers | 1/4 cup shredded romaine lettuce | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 pinch ground red chile pepper | 3 bananas, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 ripe hass avocado - peeled, pitted, and sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, mix olives, green olives, orange peel, red chile peppers, and romaine lettuce. In a small bowl, stir together enchilada sauce and ground red chile pepper. Spoon mixture over salad, and sprinkle with avocado slices. Serve warm.

title: Dill Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 cup canned bean, with liquid, drained | 1 piece lemon peel ( small ) | dill ( for garnish )
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a food processor. Process to a paste, or process until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,cider vinegar,raisin,peanut oil,chunky salsa,chinese cabbage,milk,beet
title: Chinese Corned Beef (Beets) Salad With Raisins
ingredients: 2 large beets | 1 lb chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 jar chunky salsa | 2 -3 tablespoons raisins | 1/3 cup milk | 8 tablespoons vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Wash the beets and cut them into matchstick size pieces. Scrub and dry them and place in a large pot with enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil then turn off the heat and let them sit for about 30 minutes to soften. Remove the beets and mash them with a potato masher. Put them in the bowl with the shredded cabbage. Next add the salsa, raisins, milk, vinegar, vegetable stock, and oil in a blender and mix well. Pour the dressing over the salad, and toss until thoroughly coated. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: stout beer,white miso,lemonade,baking soda,cellophane noodle,fish stock,mace
title: Steamed Noodles With Miso and Beer
ingredients: 14 ounces cellophane noodles | 4 ounces fresh boneless fish or 4 ounces steamed prawns ( 4 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup white miso, plus | 2 tablespoons brown miso ( about 2 tablespoons ) | 3 1/2 cups fish stock, or hot | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | stout beer ( to serve )
instructions: Place fish and mace in a colander over a bowl, and sprinkle with the miso. Set under cold water to wilt the miso. Place the fish and mace into a saucepan along with the fish stock. Bring to the boil, reduce heat to low and simmer, partially covered, for 10 minutes, or until cooked through. Drain the pasta. Pour the warm miso into a large heat proof bowl. Add the hot fish with mace. Place the bowl in a large saucepan, bring to the boil, then cover, and remove from the heat. Remove the fish from the miso. Allow to rest for 10 minutes. Add the miso to the noodles and stir until well mixed and coated. Cover and set aside. Place the saucepan over a high heat. When starts to smoke, remove the dish from the heat. Add 2 teaspoons of baking soda and 2 tablespoons of warm water.

title: Fried Oatmeal
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oatmeal | 1 tablespoon dill weed ( finely chopped fresh dill ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Fry oatmeal in skillet. Add herbs, cumin and mix well. Fry in fat until nicely browned and crispy.

title: Cumin Turkey Sausage
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turkey sausage | 8 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Pierce turkey with a fork and make deep cuts into it and rub inside with spices, pressing perforate into meat. Brown sausage and drain. Add cream of mushroom soup and simmer for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,corn oil,tart apple,flat leaf parsley
title: Roasted Apple Cakes
ingredients: 1 lb tart apple, peeled and cored | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/2 cup corn oil
instructions: Position an oven rack in the highest oven and heat the oven to 400f degrees. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Toss the apple in the curry paste until coated. Spread the coated apple evenly over the baking sheet. Roast for 45 minutes, stirring carefully every 20 minutes with a spatula when the apples are done. Remove the baking sheet from the oven and increase the oven temperature to 400f degrees. Continue to roast until evenly colored, about 15 minutes longer. Tear off 1 piece of parchment paper about 2 inches wide. Using a spoon or slotted spoon transfer the apples to a plate. Scrape up any browned bits. Cool 1 minutes, then add the parsley and 1/2 cup of the oil.

title: Jerk Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked angel hair pasta | 1 1/2 cups reduced-fat cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup low fat light sour cream | 2 tablespoons sugar substitute | 2 teaspoons light jerk sauce | 1 teaspoon paprika | 2 teaspoons leeks or 2 teaspoons scallions, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Reserve 1/2 cup of hot water. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine soup, sour cream & splenda. Set aside. Drain pasta, rinse and return to pot. Add mushroom soup, sour cream, sugar substitute, sauce, and paprika. Mix in leeks. Pour over hot pasta and mix well. Heat and serve.

title: Italian Spinach and Spinach
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh spinach | 1 box vermicelli ( angel hair pasta )
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on box. Mix spinach in large microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high about 1 minute, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Serve heated bowl of spinach on the side.

Random Ingredients: coffee,corn tortilla,chicken thigh,prosciutto,strawberry,red snapper fillet,lasagna noodle
title: Snapper Lasagna Rollups
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless chicken thighs, skin removed | 12 ounces red snapper fillets, skin removed | 12 ounces frozen strawberries ( halved if large ) | 12 ounces prosciutto, sliced and then cut pieces into strips | 1 1/2 cups hot brewed coffee | 16 lasagna noodles, fresh | 12 ounces frozen strawberries | 12 ounces shredded provolone cheese ( may also use mozzarella )
instructions: Place chicken meat and snapper fillets in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer. Partially cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes, skimming any scum from the top as it rises to the surface. Drain chicken, remove all the fat from the fish and keep the fillets warm in an ovenproof dish. Place the mushrooms in a separate dish. Cook in the hot coffee. The mushrooms should be just tender, not mushy. Preheat the oven to 325°f in a small bowl, place the prosciutto strips, then fold them together with 2 tablespoons of the hot coffee. Arrange a few strips of the cheese on top of each lasagna roll. Layer the noodles around the noodles. Place an even 2 tablespoons of the mushroom mixture on each piece of cheese. Add a few slices of the snapper over the mushrooms. Top with a few slices of snapper and a slice of the sliced strawberries. Cover the lasagna with more slices, mushrooms and provolone. Dot with 1/2 inch of cooking spray. Cover with foil and bake for 30 to 45 minutes, until the cheese is golden and bubbly. Let sit for 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Crock Pot Spicy Beef Brisket
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs beef brisket | 1 tablespoon dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons tahini
instructions: Combine onion soup mix, and remaining ingredients in a slow cooker. Stir until well mixed and well blended. Place brisket in slow cooker and cover. Cook on low setting for 7 to 9 hours or on high setting for 4 to 4 1/2 hours. Remove meat and place on a carving board. Slice it against the grain if desired and serve on kimchee or hoagie roll sandwich rolls.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,string bean,parsley leaf,kaffir lime leaf,corn kernel,mint leaf,sage,apple juice
title: Sara's Apple Spiced Mashed Green Beans
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh string beans, trimmed and cut in half | 4 tablespoons fresh sage, finely shredded | 4 tablespoons parsley leaves or 4 tablespoons basil leaves, finely shredded | 3 tablespoons mint leaves, finely shredded | 1 can corn kernels, drained | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons kaffir lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Put the string beans in a large pot and cover with cold, salted water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain and cool. Put the sage, parsley, mint leaves, corn kernels, apple juice, worcestershire and lime leaf in a large bowl and blend until well combined. Season to taste with salt and pepper if desired. Add the cooled green beans to the bowl and mix well. Transfer to a serving bowl or serving platter and serve.

title: Shrimp and Lentils Wrapped in Bar
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sugar | 2 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 8 scallops | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1 lettuce leaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl. Heat pan on low heat. Sear scallops in pan, on both sides, for 5 seconds each side. Remove from heat and place on a kitchen towel to drain. In a small bowl, mix ketchup with a tablespoon of water. Brush onto the cut side of a lettuce leaf, serve on a plate. Place a small quantity of the shrimp on each lettuce leaf. Drizzle with the sauce. Garnish with fresh cilantro.

title: Lamb and Bacon Filled Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings or 2 tablespoons melted lard
instructions: If you are using 1 lb lamb, cut it across the bone into 1/2 inch to 1 inch long strips. Thread the strips through a double thickness of butcher twine or skewers, and then hang the pieces of meat on the skewers, alternating the pieces. Cover and allowThreading the lamb onto the skewers. This method of making the skewers is simple and quick. Preheat your oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Pour a half cup of water into a baking dish and place the skewers on it. Drizzle the bacon dripping onto the lamb and drizzle the remaining oil into the dish. Set the dish in the oven. Turn the oven off and cover the dish with aluminum foil and place the cover on it. Allow to sit for at least 1 hour before proceeding with recipe, preheat the grill. Remove from the oven. Brush the lamb with the remaining oil and grill it over direct medium heat, turning occasionally so it does not burn the edges. The internal temperature should be between 145 degrees fahrenheit. Cut into squares. Serve hot or at room temperature with plenty of room to garnish.

Random Ingredients: egg white,soy sauce,scallion,dark sesame oil,bacon,white cake mix,red wine vinegar,peanut butter
title: My Kung Pao
ingredients: 8 tablespoons peanut butter | 4 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 egg white | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 8 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons finely chopped scallions | 1 package white cake mix | 8 tablespoons finely chopped peanuts
instructions: Prepare the cake mix according to package directions, using only 1/4 cup of the peanut butter, but not all of the sesame oil. Set aside. In a large bowl, mix together all of the ingredients until well combined. Add one cake mix at a time, mixing on a high speed until all of the cake mixture is incorporated into the mixture. Reserve 1/4 cup of the peanut butter mixture for sprinkling, and add more if needed. Stir in the peanuts, adding more to taste. Spoon into a piping bag with a large star tube or serrated scissors, and press through the cake mix. Chill the cake for 30 to 45 minutes before cooking.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,cider vinegar,red wine vinegar,chicken seasoning,cheese,white flour,cumin seed,rice noodle
title: Baked Chicken Noodle Chimichangas
ingredients: 350 g rice noodles | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 cup shredded cheese ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons chicken seasoning | leftover hamburger, chopped up ( optional )
instructions: Place noodles in a large pot of boiling water. Cook for 7 minutes or until tender. Drain well and rinse in cold water, drain well. Meanwhile combine flour, cheese, vinegar, poultry seasoning, cumin and red wine vinegar in a bowl. Stir in chicken seasoning. Drain noodles and add to cheese mixture. Mix well. Put mixture in a greased ovenproof dish or on a tray. Smooth over top with a spatula if desired. Place in a moderate oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Champagne
ingredients: 100 g chicken stock or 100 g vegetable stock | 50 -100 g maraschino cherries
instructions: Sieve the maraschino cherries and boil them with the stock just till they are reduced to the paste consistency you like the texture. Serve with toast, vegetables and cream.

Random Ingredients: orange section,mint leaf,cooking spray,collard green,self rising flour,onion,white cake mix
title: St. Patrick's Day New York Rollups
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 cups collard greens - rinsed, chopped | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 package white cake mix | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves | 4 tablespoons orange sections, juiced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. In a bowl, mix collard greens, onion and flour. Mix well until well blended. Turn dough onto work surface and roll out to 1/4 inch thickness. Using 1/4 cup of the vegetable mixture for each roll, roll each lengthways up from the long side. Roll each end with the remaining vegetable mixture to seal. Arrange rollups on the prepared baking sheet with seam side down. Mix the cake mix and mint leaves in a medium bowl. Add the orange sections. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of juice over each roll. Sprinkle mint mint and orange sections over the rollups. Bake in preheated oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,pandan leaf,english pea,asadero cheese,serrano pepper,sunflower seed,mango chutney,lipton onion soup mix
title: Spicy Indian Pea & Mango Chutney Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen english peas | 1 cup nonfat milk | 1 packet lipton onion soup mix, powder | 1 cup mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon serrano pepper, finely minced | 12 slices serrano peppers | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 1 teaspoon english pea ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon black beans ( optional )
instructions: Combine peas in medium saucepan, cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low. Simmer, partially covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add onion soup mix, mango chutney and serrano pepper, stirring just until incorporated. Remove from heat. When peas are just cool enough to handle break into smaller pieces and stir into soup. Cover and chill. Just before serving, stir in sunflower seeds or black beans and spoon over salad.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,parsley leaf,baby carrot,parmesan cheese,orange juice,napa cabbage,lime wedge
title: Easiest Vegetarian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces napa cabbage | 1 lb baby carrots | 8 ounces hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves | 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Remove very thinly sliced cabbage sticks from outer leaves, and cut away any large tough outer leaves, then cut in half crosswise. Cut out the core and thinly sliced leaves from the cabbage, and cut them in half crosswise. Using a mandolin or other hand held slicer, slice the cabbage coarsely. Crack the eggs into small bowl and beat well to break it up a little bit with your other hand. Dressing, mix the orange juice, parsley, parmesan, and lime juice in a small bowl. With a slotted spoon, take about half the egg mixture and lightly coat the back of each cabbage stick in the dressing, then shake off any excess oil. Set aside. Gently pat the cabbage dry with paper towels. Arrange the cabbage on a platter and top with the prepared egg slices. Garnish with the remaining egg slices and chopped hard boiled eggs. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: collard green,flour,extra tofu,beef rib,swiss cheese,baby carrot
title: Broiled Swiss Cheese and Tofu Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 lb extra firm tofu, crumbled | 1/2 lb boneless beef short ribs, thinly sliced | 3 ounces baby carrots ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 lb swiss cheese, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 3 tablespoons flour | 20 slices swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine tofu, short ribs, carrots, and cheese, tossing well. Spread tofu mixture evenly over bread and broil until cheese is bubbly, 2 to 3 minutes. Slice sandwiches crosswise into quarters. Serve with remaining bread.

title: The Ultimate Red Chili Ice Cream!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mascarpone or 1 tablespoon cream cheese | 1 whole red chilies, deseeded and finely sliced
instructions: Beat together the mascarpone and finely chopped red chillies. Cover the surface of a lined 20 cm/21 cm oven tray with baking paper. Spread the mixture onto the tray and spread it out evenly, so that it's about 4 cm/1 inch thick on all sides. Press the chillies into the mixture using a plastic or the back of a spoon, or lightly brush the surface with water. Use a small knife to cut through the mixture until you have a nice smooth and airy texture, and stop before the mixture has an awful texture when the chillies are ready, refrigerate for up to 2 days, then freeze for up to 1 month. Freeze the ice cream for up to 1 month and up to 2 weeks until it's convenient. Store in an airtight container in the freezer.

title: Orange Peel Jam
ingredients: 1 kg white flour, unbleached ( about 6oz if using a flour bag ) | orange peel, of about 8 | 10 drops red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 160°c and grease a 23cm ring tin with a silicon baking mat or lightly oil the baking paper. Using the sieved flour, mix the peeled strips of orange peel well with enough red food colouring to make them stick to the base. Pour the flour over the orange peel and roll dough with your hands until sticky. Break off small pieces of dough and roll into balls roughly 5 cm in diameter. Place each in the prepared ring tin. Press a few red lines through the dough, then press more red food colour into the top. Put the jam in a roasting tin for about 20 minutes until set. Serve immediately, or store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. The jam can also be frozen and reheated from frozen, defrosted. To reheat, run the tip of a knife around the base of the jam jar and loosen. Re glaze with orange essence while jam is still hot before serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,hot green chili pepper,wheat flour,celery rib,cognac,red onion,extra virgin olive oil,cucumber
title: Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 3 medium cucumbers, cut in half and pitted | 3 medium celery ribs, sliced | 2 medium red onions, sliced | 3 cups mixed vegetables, such as baby carrots | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons cognac | 2 2 tablespoons cracked wheat flour or 2 tablespoons whole wheat tortillas, to sprinkle the cucumber salad if desired | 1 hot green chili pepper, seeded and finely minced ( optional )
instructions: Place the cucumbers and celery in a serving bowl and sprinkle with onion and toss well. Whisk together the remaining ingredients and pour over salad. Toss well to combine. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate.

title: Guava and Avocado Smoked Chile
ingredients: 1/2 habanero peppers, seeded or 1/2 regular habanero pepper | 1 can beef broth | 2 avocado, sliced into four slices, for garnish
instructions: Rinse the habanero pepper under cold water. Peel the seeds from the habanero pepper. Place the habeneros and 3/4 cup water in a small saucepan and stir in the beef broth. Simmer the beef mixture until it reduces to half, about 15 minutes, about 15 minutes. Spoon the reduced beef mixture into a small ovenproof serving bowl or individual serving dishes and top with avocado slices. Serve immediately.

title: Tomatillo-Tomatillo Sauce
ingredients: 5 tomatillos, husked | 4 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Place tomatillos in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes. Drain, rinse with cold water, and place in a blender with 4 tbsp cake flour until smooth. Add more flour, if necessary, to achieve desired texture. Bring to a boil, then stir in tomatillo salsa and adjust seasoning. Transfer to a covered container and refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: turbinado sugar,pineapple juice,cheddar cheese,penne,graham cracker crumb
title: Cuornos
ingredients: 2 pints cranberry juice | 2 packages shredded cheddar cheese | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup turbinado sugar | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, combine cranberry juice, cheddar cheese, graham cracker crumbs and turbinado sugar. Stir in crushed pineapple with juice. Heat to boiling, stirring often. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes to blend flavors. Spoon into individual baking dishes. To freeze, place in freezer bag and freeze, stirring once, at least 8 hours. To reheat, place in medium low oven and warm, 15 minutes. To serve, place sauce under broiler and toast 2 - 4 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,garlic paste,raisin,salt black pepper,olive oil
title: Raisin Spice Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 cup raisins or 1/4 cup currants | 3 tablespoons olive oil or 3 tablespoons butter, melted | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 2 teaspoons parsley flakes | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place the raisins & currants in a bowl & cover with boiling water, cover & refrigerate for 20 minutes. Drain the raisins & currants. Stir in the olive oil or butter. In a food processor, combine the garlic paste, parsley flakes & 1 tsp salt & then process until it forms fine crumbs. Turn pesto or blender into raisin mixture & process just until it is well mixed. Spoon into individual serving dishes & pass at once.

title: Apricot Shortening
ingredients: 2 packets dried apricots, finely chopped | 2 cups vegetable shortening
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the apricots, vegetable shortening, and salt until well blended. Shape into small balls, and roll in sugar. Wrap in waxed paper, and refrigerate for 3 days. Makes 20 balls.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,heavy cream,sushi rice,italian breadcrumb,extra wide egg noodle,carrot
title: Baked Sushi Roll
ingredients: 1 package extra wide egg noodles, halved vertically | 1 package extra-wide egg noodles, halved vertically | 1 1/2 cups low-fat heavy cream, divided | 1 cup reduced-fat italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup drained canned chickpeas | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil | grated carrot ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine 1 package egg noodles, 1/2 cup cream, bread crumbs and chick peas in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: masala,leg lamb,orange,tomato paste,ancho chile powder,ladyfinger,rice,tomato ketchup
title: Arroz Con Costenco (Lamb, Orange and Lamb Tagine)
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs leg of lamb | 2 lbs ladyfingers | 1 cup rice | 1 can tomato paste | 20 ancho chile powder ( depending on your taste preference ) | 3 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 3/4 cup dry masala
instructions: Wash the lamb and put it into a large pot. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of chile powders and enough lard to cover the lamb. Add some water to cover. Cover and simmer over medium low heat until very tender, about 3 hours. Turn the lamb over a few times during cooking. When it is well browned, remove the lamb, place it on a cutting board and cut into 8 serving sized chunks. Keep warm. Wash the rice several times and drain in a fine mesh sieve. Rinse thoroughly, drain, and spread the ladyfingers out flat on the counter and spread out them out slightly. Put one piece of lamb in each ladyfinger section, spoon one to three tablespoons of tomato paste on top, and sprinkle generously with a little dry masala. Roll the ladyfingers up like jelly rolls, and tie with string. Spread a small amount of rice onto the bottom of the tagine. Put enough liquid from the pot to cover the rice, cover with 2 - 3 layers of soaked ladyfingers with some of the liquid. Pour 1 can tomato ketchup over them, top with a little more liquid if necessary. Cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Remove, remove string, and serve with rice and beans.

title: Mexican Bread II
ingredients: 6 slices white bread | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Lay the slices of bread onto the foil, and toast in the preheated oven until the bottoms are golden brown, about 5 minutes.

title: Lentil Crock Pot Pasta
ingredients: 7 cups spaghetti sauce | 300 g floury lentils, drained | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon lard, melted | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 pie shell, baked, cubed
instructions: Put the olive oil together with the baking oil in a pan. I usually just use a skillet, or a large microwave oven. When the pan is hot pour in the spaghetti sauce. Mix the flour, baking powder and liquid smoke in a mixing bowl, and add the lentils. Stir well. Take a bite of the mixture it will be a bit crumbly in texture and shape. Place it in the pie crust, and spread on the pasta sauce. Bake on a pan lined with parchment paper, in the oven on a lower shelf at 250 degrees for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,garlic paste,caster sugar,mozzarella ball,orange peel,red bell pepper
title: Slowcooking Beef Roast for Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast, cut into serving portions | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon orange peel, finely grated | 1 red bell pepper, thinly sliced | 2 1/2 lbs mozzarella balls, sliced
instructions: Combine sugar, garlic paste and orange peel in a large bowl. Brush roast with mixture. Place in slowcooker, cover and cook on low for 4 hours. Remove roast from cooker.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,salad oil,red kidney bean,cooking oil,spinach,white tequila,radiatore
title: Mexican Spinach With Roasted Red Chilies - Rick Bayless
ingredients: 15 -20 small dried red chilies | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 8 cups loosely packed fresh spinach, rinsed and chopped | 1/2 cup salad oil | 1/3 cup mexican white tequila | 1/2 cup chopped radiatore | 7 tablespoons roasted red kidney beans
instructions: Remove and stem ends of chilies. Using a slotted spoon, remove and discard seeds and ribs from chiles. Roast chiles under broiler until they darken slightly. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chiles and oil to paper towel lined plate and let drain. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place chiles on a shallow baking sheet and season with salt and pepper. Roast chiles 15 - 20 minutes or until dry. Transfer to a large bowl and add the spinach. In a medium saucepan, heat 1/4 cup salad oil. When hot, add the chiles and sauté until crisp. Add remaining 1/4 cup salad oil and tequila to skillet. When the oil is hot, add the drained chiles and toss to coat. Add radiatore and red kidney beans and toss to coat. Dish and serve with chile salsa.

title: Chipotle Ranch Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar roasted fennel with chipotle peppers | 4 cloves garlic, crushed | 2 tablespoons dried crushed adobo fenel | 2 tablespoons minced chipotle peppers | 1 cup water chestnuts, chopped | 1 cup ranch-style salad dressing | 1/2 cup water with a splash of vinegar
instructions: Drain the roasted fennel and mash it in a blender. Meanwhile, combine all ingredients except dressing and water in a saucepan and heat until warm. Taste for heat and add more chipotle if desired. Combine sauce and fennel with drained chipotle. Cover and refrigerate until needed. Serve on hot bread or noodles.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile,cumin powder,curry powder,tamari,pepper,italian parsley,guacamole,tamarind paste
title: Spicy Tofu
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu ( about 8oz ) | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh basil or 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chile, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/3 cup bottled guacamole
instructions: Place half of the soy, tamarind, basil, cumin, curry powder, ancho, pepper and remaining soy in food processor or blender. Blend until combined well. Pour into a resealable freezer bag. Add remaining soy and tamarind. If freezing in a freezer bag, seal bag and place on dinner plate. Place plastic wrap directly on freezer bag. Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove plastic wrap. Microwave bag on high power about 1 - 2 minutes or until bag is warm. Remove from microwave and stir. Microwave bag on high power for 30 - 45 seconds or until bag is warm. Do not microwave for more than 1 minute. Remove bag to a cookie sheet. Slice bag 1/2in or so thick, but not totally solid. Sprinkle slices lightly with cumin powder and bake for 12 - 14 minutes, or just until lightly crisp. Cool slightly, then store in freezer. Note, can be frozen for up to 2 hours. The original package is 2 pkg. And was 3 - 4 pkg. Of the tamarind liquid already stirred and the liquid was heated.

title: Smoked Trout and Chorizo Skewers
ingredients: 1 jar pickled red chorizo sausage, sliced into 1-inch dice | 3 bunches fresh or frozen beetroots | dill weed | chipotle puree ( optional ) | 1 can smoked trout, drained
instructions: Cut the chorizo sausage into 1 inch pieces. Cut beetroots into 1 inch rounds. Soak chorizo in a large bowl of cold water for at least 10 minutes. Drain. Cut off the stem ends of the beetroots and cut into 1 inch slices. Place 1 inch cubes on a metal skewer. Sprinkle with dill and chipotle puree. Place slices onto a preheated grill on medium high heat. Cook 10 minutes or until the beets curl. Turn with metal spatula, and cook 10 minutes more.

title: Simple Shrimp Sambal
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 package green curry paste | 1 pound medium shrimp - peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon ground mixed spice
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise with the curry paste. Place the shrimp in a large skillet over low heat. Pour the blended mayonnaise over, stirring gently, and cook until the shrimp are no longer opaque at the center, 3 to 5 minutes. Mix in the shrimp and mixed spice. Cover, and continue cooking 30 seconds to 1 minute more, until shrimp are hot and lightly browned on the edges.

title: Faux Stuffed Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 tablespoons lemon or 3 tablespoons lime juice | 6 -8 tablespoons finely shredded romaine lettuce | 1 canned green chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Slice eggplant lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Cut a slit through the stem into 1/2 inch wide strips. Remove and discard stem. Slice strip in half lengthwise. Place slices in a colander and sprinkle with garlic salt. Toss to coat. Place on cookie sheet, close lid and toss again. Sprinkle with lemon juice or lime juice.. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, tossing occasionally. After 1 hour, toss again. Garnish with romaine lettuce and chiles.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,salt black pepper,jumbo shrimp,cherry tomato,shallot,coffee,tortilla,chocolate coffee bean
title: Spooky Tortilla Chili - Food for Lobs
ingredients: 1 1 lb jumbo shrimp or 1 lb peeled deveined cooked shrimp | coarse salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup finely chopped peeled cherry tomatoes | 1/2 shallot, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant coffee, dissolved in enough hot water to measure 2 cups | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh cilantro stem | 8 tortillas | 1/2 ounce semisweet chocolate-covered coffee beans, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine shrimp, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Toss tomatoes with shallot. Toss with shrimp mixture. Cover tightly and refrigerate 30 minutes. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer about 5 minutes. Place shrimp mixture in a food processor and pulse until shrimp are coarsely chopped. Stir in 2 tablespoons coffee and 2 tablespoons cilantro. Fill tortillas with chili. Roll up and place on plates. Sprinkle with chocolate covered coffee beans on top. Serve with bread or crackers of your choice.

title: Cornstarch Beet Chips
ingredients: 12 medium raw beets | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Using a sharp knife cut the stem from the beets, using the peeler. Slice each piece in half. The length will depend on the size of the beet. Heat a skillet with a touch of oil on medium heat. Add a handful of raw beets. Cook for 3 minutes. Turn and cook for an additional 3 minutes. Turn and cook a minute longer. Drain the beets on paper towels. Place the remaining beet chips in the center of a warm serving plate. Place beet chips on top. Serve while warm.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,self raising flour,mexican tomato jalapeno pepper
title: Johnny Jalapeno's Salsa Fresca
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes with jalapeno peppers | 3/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Put the flour into a bowl and make a well in the centre. Add the tomatoes with jaleños, cream and half and half, mix well. Add flour a bit at a time so the mixture will cling together but not become too dry. The mixture will have crumbly looking chunks and dough like you’re doing a salsa. Add more cream if necessary to bring it all together. Leave in fridge for at least an hour to allow the flavors to combine before using. This makes the flour taste more floricky. You could use a food processor to make the recipe smoother but the results will be quite a bit bready.

Random Ingredients: green bean,french onion soup,turnip,lemon juice zest,clove,corn tortilla
title: French Onion Soup and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 medium turnip, peeled and cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 -2 bunch green beans, trimmed | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, divided | 2 teaspoons finely minced french onion soup | 24 small corn tortillas | 1 pinch ground cloves
instructions: Steam the turnips until just tender enough to dice. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until vegetables are tender. Serve warm and garnish with a squeeze of fresh lemon.

title: Beef and Beet Soup
ingredients: 1 lb beet, large, trimmed, halved ( i used 2 bunches as it was just shy of a pound. ) | 3 large beets, trimmed, halved, halved | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons poultry seasoning | 1/4 cup dates, pitted, chopped | 6 soft tortillas | 5 cups spinach, chopped
instructions: Rinse the beats in a large pan and slice into chunks. Place in with the beets and stock and bring to the boil and simmer until the beats are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove the beetroot from the stock and let cool to room temperature. Remove the beets and beets to a food mill and puree into a thick paste with a little of the stock. Return the puree to the soup. Add the reserved stock and poultry seasoning and simmer gently until thickened slightly, about 10 minutes. Add the dates and continue to simmer until most of the soup, including the stems, is absorbed. Meanwhile, heat the tortillas, one at a time, in a dry pan until just beginning to crisp, then remove each one with a slotted spoon onto paper towels and drain. Serve the soup with a few tortillas for each diner to add as they wish.

Random Ingredients: peach,nori,curd cottage cheese,spanish onion,clear honey,peanut butter,jicama
title: Yum Yum Party Pies
ingredients: 2/3 cup low-fat spanish onion, finely chopped | 2/3 cup reduced-fat curd cottage cheese | 2 pints small curd cottage cheese | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 4 tablespoons clear honey | 1 jicama, peeled, cut into 8 wedges | 2 tablespoons chopped mixed dried fruit ( or dried fruit of your choice ) | 1 sheet nori, toasted, finely chopped
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl and mix well. Press mixture into 12 muffin holes in a lightly greased 20cm square tin. Refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours. Make honey glaze, combine peanut butter, honey and fruit if using. Brush glaze over top and sides of pies. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Brush assembled pies with honey glaze and sprinkle with nori. Bake pies for 25 minutes or until golden and set.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,sesame seed,catsup,chili powder,tart apple,liquid honey
title: Sesame Seed Sauce For French Fries
ingredients: 3 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds, divided | 3 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 3 teaspoons chili powder | 2 cups diced tart apples
instructions: In a small bowl, mix toasted sesame seeds with catsup, honey, oil, chili powder, and apples. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,lime wedge,provolone cheese,chicken bouillon granule,yellow onion
title: Easy Queso Dip - Copycat
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup pickled jalapenos, sliced thin | 3/4 cup grated mexican blend cheese or 3/4 cup provolone cheese | lime wedge
instructions: Place chicken bouillon granules in medium saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Add jalapenos, cheese and stir to melt. Serve with fresh lime wedges.

title: Curry Chicken and Spinach (Aka Curry With Ground Beef Meal)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken thighs or 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 16 ounces white mushrooms or 16 ounces mushrooms | 3 1/4 cups nonfat sour cream | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/3 cup cooked spaghetti | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 lb frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instructions: Slice chicken into thin strips. Place into bowl with nonfat sour cream. Mix together with other ingredients. Pour into large shallow dish. Refrigerate for at least 1 to 6 hours. Spoon over curry and gently mix together. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Cook in preheated 350 degree oven for 45 minutes or until done to your liking.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,beef bouillon cube,iceberg lettuce,key lime,coconut rum,sauce,yellow bell pepper
title: Kelsey's Malaysian Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/4 cup sweet and sour sauce | 1/4 cup coconut rum | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup zucchini, chopped | 1 tablespoon key lime, chopped | 4 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/4 cup fresh key lime, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Blend ingredients in your blender, except lettuce. Cover and chill at least 1 hour or over night. Place lettuce in serving bowl, add beef and lime, or eat on the same day.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,cocoa,herb,celery salt,water chestnut,baking powder
title: German Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 6 tablespoons water, divided | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring ( i use liquid smoke )
instructions: In a 2 quart bowl, stir together the 3 tablespoons water, baking powder, and cocoa. Stir in water chestnuts and seasonings. Pour into three 2 1/2 inch round cake pans. Place in oven and bake for 15 minutes, or until centers are firm. Remove from pans, and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Turn onto a rack, and allow to cool completely before covering and storing in the refrigerator.

title: Mint Syrup
ingredients: 1/2 cup of fresh mint, chopped | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice ( or more, to your taste )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine mint, sugar and allspice. Increase heat until mixture begins to boil. Boil 3 minutes. Pour syrup through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl, and discard mint. Cool to room temperature. Store at room temperature for 1 week in refrigerator.

title: Tortilla Chip and Okra Dip
ingredients: 1 package tortilla chips, any flavor | 1 cup frozen baby peas ( thawed ) | 2 packages frozen okra, thawed | 1 teaspoon chili | 1 teaspoon salt ( optional )
instructions: Put the frozen peas on the bottom of a crockpot and cover with the tortilla chips. Next add the frozen okra, and add the chili. Add salt and sprinkle with the crushed tortilla chip crumbs. Cover and cook on low for 3 - 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,lime,fajita seasoning mix,coriander leaf,heavy whipping cream,pearl barley,self raising flour
title: Fajita Nachos With Pearl Barley
ingredients: 150 g pearl barley | 200 g roasted anaheim chilies | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 150 ml heavy whipping cream | 100 g self raising flour | 2 tablespoons coriander leaves, washed and chopped
instructions: Firstly, place the pearl barley in a medium sized bowl and add all the ingredients except coriander leaves. Mix everything well and leave for five minutes or until the pearl barley is cooked. Add the coriander leaves. Stir well. Roll into thin snakes. Heat a pan using medium heat. Fold and cook until the nachos are crispy on the outside. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Japanese Curried Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 chinese mushrooms | 1 piece cardamom | 1 bunch peas, cut diagonally | 2 tablespoons mild curry powder | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Remove seeds from mushrooms, and slice fine. Place in a bowl with sliced mushrooms. Sprinkle with cardamom, and mix. Heat oil in skillet, and add curry and fry until fragrant, then add 1/4 cup water. Add peas, mushrooms, and a pinch of salt. Cook about five minutes until vegetables are tender. If the vegetables seem dry before you think they are, add more water and cook. Add more water. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green chili,mint leaf,zucchini,chicken thigh,chicken broth,sage leaf
title: Chana Gosht
ingredients: 2 cups chicken broth | 2 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 4 zucchini, halved lengthwise | 2 teaspoons mint leaves, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 green chili, seeded, minced
instructions: Simmer broth and chicken thighs in medium saucepan over medium high heat until chicken is cooked and meat is falling off the bone, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cut zucchini lengthwise into 4 thick slices. Transfer zucchini to a large serving bowl, season with salt. Add mint, sage, and green chilies.

Random Ingredients: pigeon pea,pineapple,green cardamom,curry powder,tomato green chilies,egg noodle
title: Curried Chicken Noodle Curry
ingredients: 1 bag egg noodles, dried | 2 cans of mild chopped tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can pigeon peas, undrained and rinsed | 8 cups of cooked chicken on the bone, chopped | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 green cardamoms or 1 yellow cardamom
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile add everything except for the curry in a large sauce pan and bring to a boil. Turn heat to low and cover. Simmer for approximately 5 minutes. Drain noodles and add back to the sauce in the pot and stir well. Cover and simmer for 1 hour to allow the flavors to blend. Serve over hot cooked white rice.

title: Shchiha (Sweet Potatoes With Tamarind)
ingredients: 2 large white potatoes, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped walnuts, toasted in a dry pan until golden | 1/2 cup dressing, such as miracle whip
instructions: Place potatoes into a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, cool slightly, and cut into 1/2 inch slices. In a medium bowl, mash tamarind paste with a fork. Stir in cardamom, walnuts, and 1/2 cup dressing.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,beef mince,greek yogurt,kiwi fruit,flat leaf parsley,italian salad dressing,mint,cider vinegar
title: Spiced Grilled Kiwi Meatballs With Yoghurt
ingredients: 375 g beef mince | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup of fresh mint, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar or 1 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon tomato puree or 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 -2 kiwi fruit, peeled and finely chopped | 3 tablespoons italian salad dressing
instructions: Combine mince with yoghurt, parsley, mint, vinegar and tomato puree. Add kiwi fruit and mix well. Use a slotted spoon to transfer mixture to a bowl and keep on one side. Place kiwifruit on a medium serving plate. Spoon beef mixture into the centre, ensuring each is covered. Drizzle with salad dressing and serve with bread, vegies or grilled beans or roasted vegies, or steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: parsley,chili garlic sauce,semolina flour,red pepper flake,parsnip,herb
title: Spicy Parsnips
ingredients: 4 large parsnips ( i use approx 4 large ones ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs ( fresh or dried ) | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce ( i use a mix of both ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional, if you dare ) | 1 tablespoon semolina flour | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 deg celsius. Use any baking peel, such as a regular circle oven peel or large square. Use a large cookie scoop scoop or sharp scissors to cut a cross about 5 cm deep length ways. Trim the parsnips of any membrane, leaving a large, thick tail end of the parsnips. Cut large parsnips into wedges approximately 1cm wide, and stud both sides with the herbs and chili garlic sauce. Mix the crushed red pepper with half a tbsp of water. Sprinkle over the parboiled parsnips, cover with a sheet of tin foil, and bake uncovered for 1 hour 45 mins, or until tender. Transfer to serving bowls and sprinkle with parsley.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,chocolate coffee bean,plain yogurt,golden syrup
title: Bircher Helper Chocolate Rarebit
ingredients: 1 plain yogurt ( you may not use sweetened, but you may add 1 oz. yogurt ) | chocolate flavored coffee beans ( see note below ) | sea salt, a few drops of | coarse sea salt, extra, about
instructions: Using an electric mixer, cream together yogurt and coffee beans. Add coarse sea salt and a few drops of grated chocolate flakes to taste. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes or as long as overnight.

title: Marmie's Mexican Barley Bread
ingredients: 12 ounces marmite | 4 ounces barley flour | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: In the container of a food processor make your marmite sauce. Mix the marmite/mace into the barley flour in the sauce till the flour is combined well. Put the mixture into your food processor and process until a fine mixture forms. If you like you can break it into smaller pieces. Pour into a 9” loaf pan, sprayed with cooking spray. Cut into 2” slices when completely done, sprinkle additional mace on top then bake at 425 for 20 minutes.

title: Wasabi Bread (Shredded Oysters)
ingredients: 12 slices bread, very firm ( about 1/2 inch thick ) | 4 teaspoons wasabi ( optional ) | 1 jar picante sauce | fresh coriander
instructions: Using small sharp knife, slice each slice of toasted bread 1/8 thick. Spread each slice with wasabi if desired. Place on a serving plate, and top with desired amount of picante sauce. Sprinkle with coriander. For a more substantial amount of wasabi flavor place in refrigerator until ready to use. Note, you may use any type of wasabi. This recipe makes more wasabi than you'll need for 1 serving.

Random Ingredients: head white cabbage,farfalle pasta,herb,crabmeat,sherry,caraway seed,plain yogurt,jalapeno pepper
title: Cabbage With Crab, Sherry and Herbs
ingredients: 3/4 cup dry sherry | 2 small head white cabbage, cored and cut into 2 inch pieces | 4 ounces dried crabmeat, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh herb | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1 medium jalapeno pepper, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Place the sherry and cabbage in a large skillet.

Random Ingredients: spicy chili pepper flake,egg substitute,asparagus,vanilla sugar,beef tenderloin,stilton cheese,pumpkin puree
title: Low Fat Stilton Beef Fillet With Asparagus on Weck Rollups
ingredients: 2 cups cooked beef tenderloin, cut into large chunks | 1 can ready to eat vegetarian pumpkin puree | 1/2 cup dried beef-style angel hair pasta or 1/2 cup uncooked wild rice mix | 2 tablespoons spicy chili pepper flakes | 4 ounces stilton cheese, grated | 3 medium eggs | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a medium baking sheet. In a medium bowl whisk together pumpkin puree, cooked beef, and chili flakes. Place cheese, eggs, nutmeg, and 1/2 cup of beef sauce into a small bowl, breaking up larger pieces of cheese as necessary. Spoon about 1 1/4 tablespoons of pumpkin filling onto center of each piece of the beef fillet. Beginning on one side, roll up each piece of beef until well stuffed. Place meat, seam side down, in a well buttered 12 inch deep glass baking dish or an 11x7x2 inch pan. Brush meat with remaining 1/2 cup of beef sauce in the dish. Sprinkle cinnamon sugar on top. Bake until fork tender, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,kalamata olive,ginger,flour tortilla,taco seasoning,button mushroom,white rum,chunky salsa
title: Jungle Enchilada Lasagna
ingredients: 8 flour tortillas, cut into 1 inch lengths, or as needed | 1 can chunk-style sliced mushrooms, drained | 1 can button mushrooms, drained | 1 can white rum | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger | 1 jalapenos or 1 serrano pepper, chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1/2 cup salsa | 2/3 cup shredded kalamata olives ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange tortilla squares on sheet, overlapping as needed. Spray mushrooms with cooking spray, and top with a few slices of the sliced fresh mushrooms. Combine rum, ginger, jalapeno or serrano pepper, taco seasoning, and salsa, and pour over mushrooms. Bake on middle rack in oven until top is dry, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese, and top with olives if desired. Serve with green beans, salsa fresca or guacomole.

Random Ingredients: white onion,spring onion,beef broth,canola oil,flat leaf italian parsley,italian breadcrumb
title: Quick-Fix Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 lb top sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup minced white onion | 1/3 cup low sodium beef broth | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: In medium skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add beef.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,cucumber,egg noodle,saffron thread,white bread,thyme sprig
title: Gramma's Egg Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked medium egg noodles | 8 medium cucumbers, quartered | 4 eggs | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1 pinch saffron threads or 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs or 1/4 teaspoon fresh thyme, finely snipped
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. While noodles are heating, thinly slice cucumbers, about 1/4 inch thick, lengthwise, lengthwise. Toss with warm water to cool. When noodles are done, drain well, and rinse with cool water. Drain well again. To serve, top with cucumber mixture, then drizzle with whipping cream, saffron, and fresh thyme. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,bicarbonate soda,enchilada sauce,savory,turkey,bread crumb,caraway seed,head broccoli
title: Spice Turkey Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey | 1 head of broccoli, chopped, cooked, and cooled | 2 poblano peppers, chopped, canned in adobo, drained | 1/4 cup bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon caraway seed, crushed | 1/8 teaspoon savory | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the turkey, broccoli, peppers, crumbs, and caraway seeds in a bowl. Add savory, bicarbonate of soda, and enchilada sauce. Mix together evenly and divide into 8 portions. Shape into patties, and place on an oven pan. Bake for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Corn
ingredients: 2 cups whole kernel corn | fresh ground pepper | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 2 teaspoons dried mint leaves | 4 teaspoons fried frying oil
instructions: Put the corn, pepper, and mint leaves inside a small frying pan. Pour the oil over the corn.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,white sugar,malt vinegar,yellow squash,habanero pepper
title: Spicy Pickled Squash
ingredients: 4 -5 yellow squash, depending on size | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 habanero pepper, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees farenheit. Remove the stems and seeds from the squash. Cut squash in half and scoop out the flesh leaving just a few seeds. Roughly chop squash, place in an oven proof dish, and sprinkle with the caster sugar. Pour malt vinegar over the squash. Sprinkle with the white sugar and habanero pepper and toss to coat. Cover the dish with foil and bake for 1 hour, shaking the dish occasionally. Serve warm.

title: Pumpkin Tomatoes and Banana Stew
ingredients: 3/4 lb green turnip ( approx ) | 6 firm ripe tomatoes | 3 ripe bananas | 3 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Peel and rinse the turnips and cut into 2 inch chunks. Peel and cut the firm bananas into small chunks. Peel and cut the tomatoes into slices. Remove the skin from the tomatoes, and then chop the flesh roughly. Put the chopped tomatoes and bananas in a large saucepan and add enough water, to come to just below the level of the tomato mixture with a layer of tomato and plantain skins. Bring to the boil, and then simmer gently, for approx 50 min or until the turnip is very tender. Peel and slice the firm bananas crossways into 4 - 5 sections. Then slice the bananas diagonally lengthwise. Ladle out the stew into bowls, and serve with the chopped vegetables. Variation,. Cut the tomatoes into chunks rather than peeling them. Cut the bananas into rounds and slice the bananas crossways into thick slices and then slice both. Remove the tomatoes and bananas from the water and add them to the stew, and add 1 can of tomato puree. Add the green chilies. Variation,. Place the bananas in the stew. Add the diced tomatoes to the stew. Add salt and finely chopped coriander for an extra spice kick. Variation,. Pour the contents of the can of tomatoes and mashed bananas into a large saucepan, and cook over a medium heat for approx 10 minutes or until the bananas are very tender.

title: Artichokes and Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 2 1/2 cups corn oil | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 1 large tomatoes, peeled, seeded and diced | dough
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/4 inch slices. Over medium high heat, saute sausage with 1/4 cup corn oil until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Add artichoke hearts, tomato and remaining 1/4 cup corn oil. Cook, stirring occasionally, until most of the liquid is absorbed and sausages are hot. Transfer mixture into a bowl, saving oil and pan juices. Pour all ingredients from pan back into pan. Stir well, cover and simmer gently for 1 1/2 hours to thicken slightly. Remove skillet from heat and stir in additional corn oil and juices.

title: Champagne Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 tablespoons mixed herbs, chiffonade | 4 tablespoons mushrooms, sliced | 4 liters vegetable stock
instructions: Use a mushroom cloth or a muslin cloth to remove the soft stalks or gills. Tie 2 - 3 pieces of heavy duty aluminium foil tightly around the mushrooms to steam. Stick 2 - 3 strips of string or twine around the mushrooms to hold in the steam. Pour the herb chiffonade into the thickest part of a saucepan and bring to the boil. Skim from the surface as necessary without burning the sediment and add 5 litres of vegetable stock. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Wrap the ends of the foil securely and return to heat. Stir until boiling and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes more. Remove from the heat and allow to sit for 5 minutes to cool slightly. Cut into 3cm wide slices and serve with lavender, blueberry or other green tea flavoured with garlic.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,tuna,garlic red chile paste,purpose flour,french bread,gouda cheese,green chilies,vegetable stock chicken
title: Garlic Roasted Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable broth or 1/2 cup chicken stock | 4 -5 green chilies, diced | 1/4 cup minced garlic or 1/4 cup minced garlic | 4 -5 tablespoons garlic and red chile paste ( i use a taste of garlic and a red chile paste ) | 1 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined ( tails intact ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 slices shredded gouda cheese, to taste ( optional ) | 1 loaf stale french bread, toasted and cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Bring broth and chiles to a simmer in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Stir in garlic. Cut shrimp in half lengthwise and arrange on a baking tray. Cook until lightly pink, about 3 - 5 minutes. Stir into broth mixture. Spoon shrimp mixture onto toasted french bread cubes, sprinkle with cheese, and top with remaining toasted bread cubes. Bake 10 minutes longer or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,sherry wine vinegar,green chili pepper,daikon radish,natural yoghurt,green
title: Gyoghurt and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 pint natural yoghurt, greek style | 1 bell pepper, seeded and sliced into circles | 1 green chili pepper, chopped into rings | 1 medium daikon radish, grated | 1 -4 green chili pepper, sliced into rings | 1 -2 green chili pepper, chopped into rings
instructions: Place all the ingredients in the blender, except for the yoghurt and pepper, and blend to a smooth consistency, adding the yoghurt gradually. Taste and adjust the seasonings, if necessary. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Plum Smoked Potato & Smoked Tomato Jam #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 2 jars refrigerated persimmon pulp ( 3 cups ) | 8 ounces plum tomatoes, chopped ( 1 cup volume ) | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 cups crushed ice or 2 cups crushed ice
instructions: Prepare simply potatoes diced potatoes to taste using the package directions, then place in a microwave safe bowl. Mush plum tomatoes on top of tomato puree, then add in liquid smoke, mix well and cover for 30 seconds. Dice potato with onion, then add to tomato mixture along with salt, pepper and ice and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain from refrigerator before serving.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,parsley,white pepper,lemon peel,pumpkin pie spice,banana,italian parsley
title: Pumpkin Paradise French Feasts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh mixed ripe pumpkin, peeled and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1/4 cup minced fresh parsley
instructions: Place the mixed ripe pumpkin in a large bowl, and add the parsley, 2 tablespoons of italian fresh parsley, olive oil, lemon peel, white pepper, and pumpkin pie spice, tossing to thoroughly combine. Lightly oil griddle or frying pan over medium heat. Spoon small amount of the french feasts into the center of the griddle, and cook until heated through, flipping once. Serve french feasts hot with remaining 2 tablespoons of fresh parsley on top for dipping.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Dipping Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a small saucepan. Add the sun dried tomatoes and soy sauce. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and cool completely. Serve at room temperature over your favourite pasta.

title: Cheese With Zuchini (Zucchini  With Beef)
ingredients: 5 zucchini, sliced | 3 slices american cheese | 1/4 lb thinly sliced sirloin ( or other beef ) | 1 tablespoon flour | 1/4 teaspoon orange flower water | 1/4 teaspoon flour
instructions: Slice zucchini very thinly. Arrange in 1 layer on paper towels and sprinkle with sea salt to prevent browning. Preheat oven to 350°f. Place cheese slices in a single layer on a baking tray. Bake till slightly crumbly and starting to melt, about 5 minutes. When zuchini slices are completely cooked, brush outside of zucchini with 1/4 tblsp. Flour and drizzle over cheese. Bake till zuchini is golden, about 10 minutes. Transfer zuchini to serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,asiago cheese,russet potato,snow pea,chicken,extra beef
title: Karyn's Real Southern Asiago Burger
ingredients: 2 pounds lean ground beef | 1 package frozen whole russet potatoes, thawed | 1 pound fresh snow peas, trimmed | 1 pound extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese | chopped fresh dill pickle slices
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. In a medium bowl, mash potatoes together with beef, cheese, and pickles. Form into 4 patties. Grill patties and potato side by side on the heated grates until the cheese has melted and is bubbly, about 5 minutes. Top with pickle slices and serve.

title: Jamaican Beet Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups rice flour | 1/3 cup coconut rum | 1/3 cup coconut rum | 1 1/2 lbs fresh beets, about 2 medium ( about 5 medium ) | 1 large green onion, white and tender green parts kept separate and bulbs cut in half ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 habanero pepper, finely chopped | 2 kaiser rolls, split, toasted and cut in half
instructions: Cook the rice per the package directions, omitting the salt and fat, until almost tender and creamy, about 10 minutes. Add the cajun rum and coconut rum and simmer for 5 minutes. Set aside for 5 minutes. Drain the beets. Cut a thin slice from the base of each beet to remove all the tough green ends. Cut a slit into the root end of each beet, remove the seeds and core. Cut each beet into 1/8 inch slices. Place the beet slices in a bowl. Toss with about 1/4 cup of the rice. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Spoon into toasted rolls, cover with plastic wrap, and chill in the refrigerator for about 20 minutes.

title: Easy Black-Eyed Peas With Chili Powder
ingredients: 2 teaspoons black-eyed peas, uncooked | 1 whole clove
instructions: Drain black eyed peas. Place black eyed peas in a medium bowl and stir in the whole cloves. Spray the inside of a medium saucepan with cooking spray. Heat just enough water to cover the black eyed peas. Bring the water to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until peas are tender, about 3 hours. When ready to serve, place peas in a large bowl. Heat chili powder in saucepan over medium heat until fragrant.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,philadelphia cream cheese,mango chutney,breadcrumb,pepperoni,stewing beef,graham cracker crumb,red wine
title: Beef & Chutney Stuffed Baked Stuffed Pies
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crusty graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup finely shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup finely shredded monterey jack cream cheese | 1 jar sliced pepperoni, chopped | 1 jar mango chutney | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup red wine ( optional ) | 1 lb stewing beef, cooked and cubed | 24 crusty bread rounds | 1 jar sweetened condensed cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the cracker crumbs in a medium sized bowl and set aside. In a medium sized bowl, mix together cheese, sour cream, pepperoni, mango chutney, cream of mushroom soup, and red wine. Remove the crusts from the graham cracker crumb mixture. Fill each shell with the cheese mixture and top with a crust round. In a small baking dish, combine the cooked beef, sour cream, and mango chutney. Pour the filling over the filled crusts and bake for 30 minutes or until heated through and bubbly. Place the bread rounds on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and pour the meat mixture over the bread rounds, and return to baking sheet. Sprinkle with more of the cheese crumbs, and bake for another 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Figs - Fennel Chicken Wings
ingredients: 10 chicken wings | 1/2 cup crouton ( home made preferred ) | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 6 -10 figs, fresh ( about 10 )
instructions: Bring a large enough pot of water to a boil. Add the whole wing of your choice, cover and simmer until the wings are just tender, about one hour. Drain the wings and save the stock. Remove the wings and reserve the stock. Put the reserved stock back in the pot and add the crouton and fennel seeds. Simmer a few minutes. Add the drained wings and simmer a few more minutes and serve.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 12 -16 pieces sharp cheddar cheese | 12 -16 cardamom pods
instructions: Cut cheese into 12 slices or smaller depending on size. You may also slice it to fit in your blender. Put cardamoms in the blender so they can stick. Heat oven on broil on high setting or if you use a cookie sheet turn on broiler for a few seconds before putting in cheese into the oven while it's heating up. When cheese has reached your desired darkness take out of oven and let it sit for a few seconds before removing it to a plate. Serve with butter and fresh fruit if desired.

title: Asparagus Risotto
ingredients: 250 g arborio rice | 500 g asparagus, trimmed | dates
instructions: Cook 3 liters of water in plenty of salted boiling water until tender. Drain the asparagus, reserving a few stalks, and cut it into 3cm lengths. Place the washed and cleaned asparagus in an ovenproof dish. Sprinkle over a little more salt if desired. Pour in some of the rice's cooking water, and stir. When the water comes to the boil again, stir, then return to the boil and cook uncovered over a gentle heat until all the water has been absorbed. Keep adding the water until the rice has been absorbed into the rice and asparagus are tender, about 10 minutes. Do not stir. Transfer to clean large heatproof bowl, scatter the dates around it and finish off with a little more salt.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,colby monterey jack cheese,jalapeno chilies
title: Apple Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese or 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 tart apples ( peeled, cored and diced ) | 3 pickled jalapeno chilies, minced ( canned is fine )
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Spread 2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture on each tortilla and then cover with remaining tortillas. Heat a griddle or large nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Place 4 servings on the griddle, turning once. When golden and slightly browned on the bottom, turn and continue cooking until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,vanilla extract,allspice,salt pork,olive oil,ear corn cob
title: Roasted Hatch Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 3 ears corn on the cob, shucked | 1/2 cup olive oil | salt to taste | 2 tablespoons red chile peppers, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 pinch vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and place the corn on the sheet. Mix the oil, salt, chilies, allspice and vanilla in a resealable plastic bag. Add the corn and shake to coat evenly. Place on the baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the corn is tender. Serve hot.

title: Oude Dame: Belgian Christmas Roast Cake With Almonds
ingredients: 1 kg aubergine | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 350 g chopped apples | 200 g chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Boil the aubergine in 1/4 cup of the sherry until soft. Remove from the heat, then mash with a fork. Remove the aubergine flesh and cut into thin strips. Place chopped apples in a bowl, add remaining sherry and almond extract. Mix well. Spread the aubergine mix into an ovenproof dish. Arrange the apples over the top of the aubergine mixture. Melt chocolate over the top, and allow to set to set. Chill for 1 hour to set completely before cutting and eating.

title: Blue Cheese Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces blue cheese | 1 large lemon
instructions: Cut lemons in half on the smallest side. Squeeze the juice of the halves of the lemon into a small bowl. Dunk the blue cheese in lemon juice. Place the swiss cheese in the cheese bowl and dig inches. Let macerate for a couple hours. When the swiss cheese is solid, toss it into the bowl and put the bowl in the refrigerator. This will make it a bit more liquidy.

title: The Best Garlic Bread
ingredients: 2 pounds whole head garlic | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne, or more to taste | 1 loaf white bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Cut top off garlic cloves, being sure they are completely removed only after removing outer skin. Place cloves in a skillet with a lid, and fill the skillet with water. Bring to a boil, and immediately remove from heat. Place a plate on top of the heads of garlic to keep them submerged. Place in a deep baking dish, and pour water over the cloves. Drizzle cloves with cayenne pepper, and cover the house. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, stirring occasionally. An instant read thermometer inserted into the cloves after 20 minutes should read at least 50 minutes. Remove heads and cool, then slice. Serve warm, though.

title: Pasta Florentine
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, sliced | 1 small sweet pepperoni ( can use more ) | 1 can coconut milk | 1 can light cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 cup spanish sweet breadcrumbs ( you can use any type you like ) | 12 ounces rotini pasta, cooked
instructions: Heat large pot of water to boiling and add penne pasta. Cook until al dente, about 7 - 8 minutes, then drain. Return pot to stove and add sliced onion. Saute until onion is soft, about 10 minutes. Add sweet pepperoni and continue to saute. Place drained pasta into 4 serving bowls. Add soup, coconut milk, and catsup to vegetables and bring to boil. Add cooked pasta and mix well. Top with bread crumbs. Garnish with additional bread crumbs if desired.

Random Ingredients: pear syrup,large mushroom,beef chuck roast,chicken leg,steak,mozzarella cheese
title: Chicken Rose (Or Beef)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck roast, cut into 1 '' cubes ( with meat bone ) | 1 boneless chicken leg | 6 small round pears | 1 can large mushrooms | 1/3 cup peach syrup | 1/3 cup mozzarella cheese
instructions: In crock pot, place all the ingredients, except for the cheese, and stir to combine. Place the chicken in, and add enough water to cover the meat. Cover and cook for 9 - 10 hours on high. Remove the chicken bone, and shred. Place on a plate, cover with the sauce and refrigerate. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: stout beer,red kidney bean,ladyfinger,farfalle pasta,red curry paste
title: Easy Low Fat Red Kidney Bean and Stout Lamington Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces red kidney beans | 12 ounces red curry paste ( maesri brand is recommended ) | 12 ounces ladyfingers | 12 ounces guinness stout beer | 4 ounces farfalle pasta, cooked
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. While cooking, drain kidney beans and put into slow cooker. Add curry paste and lamington. Mix well. Add beans. Turn setting to high for 5 minutes. Turn to low, cover and let sit for 5 hours. To serve, let diners open through the door, add toppings. You can add fresh herbs to the salad if desired. These can also be eaten on the side.

title: Nori Onigiri (Pastry With Pecorino Cheese and Raisins)
ingredients: 3 cups cold water | 2 lbs fresh shell pasta or 2 lbs other pastas | 1 package frozen golden raisins, thawed ( use 2-3 packages ) | 1 pie crust | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Cook pasta according to box directions, or until al dente. Drain well. Meanwhile, to make crumb topping, stir raisins and 1/2 cup parmesan together in a bowl. Add pasta and toss to evenly coat. Sprinkle cayenne over topping. Cool and cut. Crust, preheat oven to 350 f. Line 4 1/2 5 inch or 9 inch pie pans with parchment paper. Press pie crust into the bottom and up the sides of each pan. Press crumb topping evenly into each pie crust. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup parmesan over top of crust. Bake in 375 f oven until golden around the rim, and golden tipped around the edges, about 18 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pans.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,cod,sugar,tomatillo,brown mustard seed,white wine,dark soy sauce
title: Thai Tomatillo Beans With Cod and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb broccon or 1 lb cod, cut into 3 x 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce, kikkoman is really nice and high quality | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1/4 cup white wine | 6 tomatillos, husked and diced | 1 1/2 lbs fresh tomatoes, chopped | 2 teaspoons sugar
instructions: In a medium glass bowl, stir together sauces and set aside for 30 minutes. Stir fry fish in small batches in oil or ghee over high heat approximately 5 minutes or until just cooked through. Remove fish from the pan, set aside and keep warm. Stir fry tomatillos in the same pan used to fry the fish. Add sugar and cook stirring constantly until it dissolves. Pour sauce over the fish and toss to coat. Enjoy.

title: Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 3 lbs lean chuck | 3 tablespoons mixed italian herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Remove chuck roast from bones or skin, but leaving the bones in large chunks, and place in a large, heavy roasting pan or dutch oven. Sprinkle with mixed italian herbs, stir well to coat all the meat. Add water, being sure to coat the roast. Cover, place in the oven, and bake for 6 to 7 days. Remove from oven, and refrigerate overnight. Serve with your favorite sauce and fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: vinaigrette dressing,lemon zest,ketjap manis,mustard,green chile,pea,taco seasoning mix
title: Spicy African Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 packages frozen peas, thawed, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup vinaigrette dressing | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon dried hot green chiles, chopped | 4 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest
instructions: Combine peas, ketchup, salad dressing, mustard, hot green chilies, taco seasoning, and lemon zest in a bowl.

title: Hot   Green  Beans With         Tarragon  Vinegar  &    Lemon Peel  (Pepperoni Style )
ingredients: 1 lb fresh string bean, washed well | 3 -4 slices fresh lemon peel | 3 -4 slices fresh tarragon | 2 -3 slices fresh lemon slices or 2 -3 slices fresh lime slices | 16 -20 hot pepperoni, sliced
instructions: First rinse your string beans in cold water and put them in a large pot of water with enough water just below the bean line but not so high that they float. Bring to a boil then simmer on medium heat for about 20 minutes or until the string beans are cooked but not mushy or dry. While your cooking beans check on them and if they need to be, remove them from the heat and place them in another pot. They will be cooked after about 20 minutes. They shouldn't be mushy because there might be some. Drain your beans and rinse them well. Cut the fresh lemon peel into quarters and put them in a clean, dry jar or plastic bag.. Slice all the lemon slices, zest of 1 lemon, and put them in the jar. Add 1/3 cup of water to the jar to loosen the rind from the lemon.. Pour the strained orange juice mixture over the green beans and stir to mix well. Pour in your hot vinegar and stir well.

title: Herb and Olive Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup black olives, sliced | 3 ounces basil chiffonade
instructions: Dip olives in olive oil.

title: Capers and Cilantro Pasta
ingredients: 250 g medium seashell pasta | 200 g fresh cilantro | 500 g vanilla sugar | capers | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | lime wedge
instructions: Put sea water on to boil for pasta. While waiting for water to boil, combine cilantro in a blender. Put pasta in bowl and add remaining ingredients. Blend until creamy. Transfer to a bowl and garnish with a few limes or other spices if desired.

Random Ingredients: white bean,green chilies,onion salt,mirin,balsamic vinegar,golden syrup,parmesan romano cheese mix
title: Spicy  White Bean Hummus
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained | 1 cup finely chopped onion | 2 cans chopped green chilies, drained | 1 envelope balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 box miracle whip or ( 4 ounce ) box soy yogurt | 2 tablespoons minced parmesan-romano cheese mix
instructions: Mix beans, onions, chilies, vinegar, and golden syrup in a large serving bowl. Sauce, mix 1 cup yogurt with the 2 tbsp minced parmesan cheese. Spoon mixture into a greased 3 quart casserole. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 350 for 1 hour until hot. Serve with rice cakes, as a topping for vegetables.

Random Ingredients: splenda granular,curry powder,doritos,green olive,serrano chilies,mexican cheese,anise seed
title: Spicy Baked Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package soft-shell doritos ( about 2 c ) | 1/4 cup green olives | 1 chipotle pepper serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno, seeded, minced | 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed | 2 large tablespoons splenda granular | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 cup mexican blend cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine all ingredients except cheese. Spread 1 1/2 cups sauce in the bottom of a 9 x7 glass dish, breaking pieces of the doritos as they are broken down into pieces, so they are broken up into pieces evenly. Lay 2 sheets of reynolds wrapable plastic wrap over sauce and spread in a thin layer.. Cover tightly. Bake at 400°f for 20 - 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly, stirring occasionally. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 5 additional minutes or until sauce is slightly bubbly.

Random Ingredients: habanero pepper,swiss cheese,onion,curry leaf,flax seed oil
title: Spicy Swiss Fritters
ingredients: 1 large sweet onion | 4 teaspoons flax seed oil ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon curry leaf, crushed | 1 1/2 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 2 habanero peppers, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a large baking sheet with half the oil. Peel and finely chop the onion, then toss with the flaxseed oil and curry leaves. Add the cheese, and toss to coat. Arrange the fritters on the prepared baking sheet. Bake until the cheese melts and bubbles, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Sauce for One
ingredients: 1 can of your favorite spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup of pre cooked brown rice or 1/2 cup cooked white rice
instructions: Bring pot of water to a boil. Add the uncooked brown rice. When it comes to a boil reduce heat to simmer. Prepare sauce and add to mixture. Heat up for 1 hour. Serve over your favourite pasta.

title: The Best Dipping Sauce For Lamb Roast
ingredients: 1/3 cup tahini | 3 lemons, juice of | 1 -2 cup plum sauce
instructions: Mix ingredients together and stir well. Chill for 2 hours. Take out of fridge once a day to allow the flavors to develop.

title: Ensalada De Manzanilla (Paleo Ensalada) #539656
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 10 jalapenos, julienned | 1/2 lb gouda cheese | 10 small lemons, juiced | 3/4 lb of canned mushroom, sliced | 8 slices fresh jalapeno peppers, thickly sliced | 4 loaves tortilla | 4 cans canned tuna in vegetable oil
instructions: Meat. Brown hamburger, drain off fat and mix with grated cheese. Add mushrooms, jalapeños, and lemon juice. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes until cheese is completely melted. Place the lemon slices in the bottom of a crock pot, overlapping them slightly and covering them with a layer of mushrooms. You can then place in another crock pot or a crock pot on a low to medium heat. After you have covered the meat, add the cheese mixture and continue on high until the cheese is fully melted and the sauce is thick. Add another layer of lemon slices on top, cover, and set over low to low heat until cheese is melted. After that, take two pieces of bread and place them on top of one another on top of the filling, cover, and allow to melt and harden, about 2 hours if you leave them out of the skillet too long.
