Cut into 1/2 x 1/2 sections and serve with tortilla and salad, or whatever else you want to serve it on.

title: Turmeric Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 1 eggplant ( preferably long or medium-sized ) | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric ( optional )
instructions: Preparation, halve the eggplant lengthwise and cut in half lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Place the cut side down on a platter and sprinkle each slice with salt. Arrange on the platter or individual salad plates. Combine the water and remaining ingredients in a saucepan. Stir over medium heat until the fruit is plump, then remove from the heat. This should take only about 10 minutes. This could happen quickly, just let it sit for a few seconds. Pour a little of the sauce over the eggplant and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,butter bean,no salt tomato,chilies,kaffir lime leaf,ham,pearl barley,bulk italian sausage
title: BBQ Chicken and Sausages
ingredients: 3 chicken tenders | 1 lb bulk italian sausage, casings removed | 1/4 cup unsalted butter beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can no-salt-added diced tomatoes, undrained, pureed | 1 medium kaffir lime leaf | 5 dried chilies, crushed | 2 cups hot cooked pearl barley
instructions: Combine chicken, sausage, beans and tomatoes in a 3 1/2 to 6 quart slow cooker. Add kaffir lime leaf and chili.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,dill pickle,cocoa powder,self raising flour,white flour,linguine,cheesecloth
title: Cherry Cheesecake Scrolls
ingredients: 200 g dry gluten free breadcrumbs | 150 g self-raising flour | 2 g cocoa powder | 2 g cajun seasoning | 1 grated fresh cheesecloth | 200 g linguine | 1/2 cup grated tasty cheese
instructions: Place the breadcrumbs in a bowl, then mix in the flour, cocoa powder, cajun seasoning and cheesecloth. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Add half the toasted breadcrumb mix and mix to just cover and then press in the paper and refrigerate in an airtight container for 2 hours to set up. Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Brush the inside of a 12 hole texas muffin pan with oil. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes meanwhile, heat a saucepan of water to boiling. Add the linguines and cook until tender then drain and cool under running water. Drain and set aside until needed, then tip into a large mixing bowl and add remaining ingredients. Mix until well combined. Spoon about 1/2 cup of mixture into the base of the muffin pan with your thumb until it just covers the base of the pan. Reserve the rest of mixture. Place the remaining breadcrumb mix on top and press with your index finger to get an even coating of crumbs. Bake in the preheated oven for 5 to 10 minutes until golden and the top spring back when pressed. Cut into 4 equal slices and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,napa cabbage leaf,colby monterey jack cheese,rose water,radish,dill
title: Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 small napa cabbage leaf | 2 cups chopped cheddar/monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh dill | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh rose water | 1 teaspoon pesto sauce | 2 -3 thinly sliced radishes
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cabbage, cheese, dill and rose water and mix well. Season with salt and pepper to taste, stir in radishes. Chill.

title: Almond Paste  for Meat
ingredients: 8 ounces almond paste | 1/2 teaspoon fine salt
instructions: Prick almond paste to ensure a good slashing of surface. Bake on baking sheet for about 15 minutes at 375f, check the time you do this and make sure it isn't burning. Once done remove from the oven. Combine salt and almond paste. Mix all together. Store in an airtight jar.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,pork tenderloin,white rice,cottage cheese,green pea,lemon juice,egg wash
title: Cafe Mexicana (Mexican Meatball)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, cooked | 8 ounces canned green peas, drained | 1 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese or 1 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese, blended | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 2 large eggs | powdered sugar and salt | 2 cups cooked white rice
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cooked meat, frozen peas, cottage cheese, lemon juice, eggs, and sugar. Mix thoroughly, divide among 4 lightly greased and floured palms of your hands. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Transfer the meat to a greased loaf pan, pressing in gently. In a 9 x 12 inch baking dish, bake for 60 minutes, until golden brown. Sprinkle the rice with powdered sugar and serve meatballs drizzled with pan drippings.

title: Grandma's Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 2 heads iceberg lettuce, washed and dried | 1/2 cup texas pete hot sauce | 1/4 cup dijon mustard
instructions: Line a salad platter with lettuce leaves to form a lid. To make the lettuce lettuce, place lettuce in a bowl. Spoon hot sauce over top, sprinkle with dijon mustard.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,fusion liqueur,beef sirloin,chicken breast half,sage,great northern bean,breadcrumb
title: Fusion Baked Beef and Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced fresh sage | 1/2 tablespoon ground rosemary | 1 boneless skinless beef top sirloin | 1 bone-in chicken breast half | 1/2 cup proventex-flavored fusion liqueur | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 can great northern beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a 2 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Combine sage and rosemary in a small bowl. Cut beef across grain into 1/4 inch thick slices. Insert a skewer into center of each slice. Toss beef, chicken and liqueur together. Transfer mixture to dish. Tuck bread crumbs into dish. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until beef is no longer pink, and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,basil leaf,water,five spice powder,feta cheese,spring onion,allspice
title: Basil Feta Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 2 large spring onions, chopped | 3 tablespoons basil leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 500 g feta cheese | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1 liter water
instructions: Blend the basil and half of the chopped onion. Crush the thyme and stir into the mix. Crumble the feta cheese and mix with mix. Add the rest of the chopped onion, the five spice powder and the cinnamon stick and mix. Bring the water to boil. Pour the mixture into a greased casserole dish and bake at 180°c for about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,corn syrup,enchilada sauce,cake flour,turkey pepperoni,caster sugar,ginger root
title: Cassic American Bobotie
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 2 cups caster sugar | 1 envelope grated fresh ginger root | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1 cup corn syrup | 250 g sliced turkey pepperoni | 1 1/4 pounds shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. To make the bobotie, sift together the flour and sugar into a large bowl. Mince together the ginger and garlic. Make a well in the center. Pour in the enchilada sauce and mix in the corn syrup. Stir in turkey and pepperoni. Spread half of the cake mixture into an 11x13 inch baking dish. Top with half the cheese. Repeat layers, ending with cheese. Bake 40 minutes in the preheated oven until golden brown.

title: Meat for French Fries
ingredients: 1 kg minced meat | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Wash hands. Coat frypan with oil and put frypan on medium high heat. Coat frypan with oil. When it's hot, put meat in pan. Let it go in the pan and make sure it's covered with oil. Turn the heat up a little when the juices start to bubble on the surface. You can flip the meat after 3 - 4 minutes when it starts to brown.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,mustard seed,half,icing sugar,chicken bouillon,seasoning salt,brie cheese
title: Cheese-Stuffed Brie Fonduta
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces brie cheese | 1/2 - 3/4 cup milk ( half, light or half ) | 1 tablespoon sweet soy sauce | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 -2 tablespoon horseradish sauce ( we like the spicy variety ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) | 2 slices stale bread ( day old bread, cut into 4 5 inch cubes )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees degrees celsius. If using fresh bread cut it into 4 pieces and place on a baking tray with a little olive oil or grapeseed oil, it’s very important during baking it to be oven proof. Put all ingredients except the cubed brie into a blender container, and pour milk over it. Blend on high until creamy. Then turn to low and do it until milk is all mixed inches or use an immersion blender with a pouring capacity. If using older bread cut it into 4 thick round pieces and mold them using a metal cake ring or cookie mold. Place the baking tray and the wedge of bread in the oven for 15 20minutes or until lightly brown and crusty. Let cool. Spread the crescent with a little mayo and dip in more mayo. Eat with your favorite bread and enjoy.

title: Champinones de Feu (Chicken Salad)
ingredients: 3 cups chicken meat ( fresh or cooked ) | 1 fennel bulb, trimmed and very thinly sliced | 1 cup dry mong bean ( frozen or canned ) | 1/2 cup wine vinegar
instructions: Dice chicken or prepare fresh chicken. Combine all ingredients except vinegar in a large bowl. Toss with vinegar until well mixed. Serve warm or cold.

title: Cranberry Pho
ingredients: 6 frozen breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup dried breadcrumbs | 8 ounces pinto beans, drained | 3/4 cup dried cranberries | 1 cup cream sherry ( i just get the liquid, it's up to you ) | 1 pie shell, shell baked
instructions: Line a baking sheet with foil and set aside. Combine the breadcrumbs and crumbs in a baggie. Add the beans, cranberries and sherry and mix until well mixed. Pat the mixture into the baked shell and refrigerate until ready to bake or up to 3 days. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes or until crust is golden brown and centre is hot. Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Baked Veal Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cubed | 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 4 -6 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 2 tablespoons butter, melted
instructions: In a dutch oven or pan place the beef. Cover with water. Add potatoes, carrots, and peppers. Cover with a lid for 3 to 4 hours or longer. Remove the beef from the pan. In the meantime, drain the water from the pan and add the vodka. Mix the chilli powder with a couple tablespoons of the vodka mixture and set aside. When ready to serve, preheat the oven to 350 degrees degrees f, set the cover to that and melt the butter in that pan. Then add the pepper mixture. Bake uncovered for 30 - 40 minutes or until the top is golden brown.

title: P Flemish Spinach Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces chopped spinach | 6 ounces chopped small red capsicums | 5 ounces chopped fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon oregano | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon malt vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons molasses | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Put the first 7 ingredients in a salad bowl. Whisk the olive oil and pour over the salad. Mix well. Serve.

title: Traditional Beef Gravy for Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 -6 lbs boneless beef chuck roast ( with about a-1/2-1/2 cup leftover gravy ) | 4 -10 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Heat the oven to 300 degrees f. If the roast in the oven has a lot of fat on top, place the roast in a roasting pan and fill with leftover gravy. Add more gravy or water if needed. Cover dish roast loosely with aluminum foil. Place roasting pan in oven. Cook on high oven setting for about 11 1/2 hours, depending on your roast. Turn the roast over about half way through and check the internal temperature of the meat, if any, and cook for a little longer. Use gravy to keep pan juices moist while roasting, if desired.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,sauerkraut,mustard,ziti pasta,cucumber,red chili pepper flake
title: Ziti With Sauerkraut & Cucumber
ingredients: 4 tablespoons mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons anise seeds | 1 1/2 lbs sauerkraut, washed, well drained | salt and pepper | 1 red chili pepper flakes | 2 medium cucumbers | 2 lbs ziti pasta, cooked & drained
instructions: Heat mustard seeds and anise seeds in skillet until it shimmers. Stir in sauerkraut and pepper flakes. Stir in ziti until it is coated. Serve hot with cumin, sliced cucumbers and some kraut and chili flakes.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,garlic granule,tomato green chilies,beef
title: Beef and Red Pepper Stir Fry
ingredients: 500 g minced beef | 1 red bell pepper ( medium size and cut into thick strips for easy dipping ) | 2 cans canned diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 teaspoon garlic granules
instructions: Put the minced beef in a wide fry pan. Cut the bell pepper into short strips. Slice the tomato into thin 2 to 3 inch strips. Drain the liquid from the canned tomatoes into the fry pan. Stir fry the peppers in the liquid for 10 to 15 minutes or until the meat is cooked. Add the diced tomato and cook for 5 minutes more. Sprinkle with the garlic and serve hot.

title: Vanilla Wafers
ingredients: 1 jar picante sauce | 1 package vanilla wafers, sliced
instructions: Pour 1 pkg. Of picante sauce into a glass bowl, and microwave on high for 1 minute, or until heated through. Add the vanilla wafers, and toss until coated. Enjoy.

title: Crock Pot Easy Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs stew beef chunks or 1 1/4 lbs round steaks | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Slice meat into 1 1/4 slices. Place on baking pan. Sprinkle cheese on tops, if using. Cover with foil. Bake on lowest position in microwave until cooked through, 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Bun-Bun Stuffed With Tuna & Shrimp
ingredients: 16 large shrimp, cleaned and deveined ( i use shrimp scotch bonnet peppers ) | 2 ounces walnuts, chopped | 3 ounces canned tuna, chopped ( i drain the liquid ) | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1 scotch bonnet pepper ( or habanero if you want less heat ) | honey ( optional ) ( optional ) | sherry and chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine everything except shrimp, oil, cilantro and nuts. Mix well. In a large bowl blend everything together except shrimp. Shape mixture into about 24 balls and place onto cookie sheet. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until light golden brown.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,chow mein noodle,soya sauce,black mustard seed,mint,basil,salmon
title: Steamed Herby Salmon in Chow Mein Salad
ingredients: 250 g smoked salmon | 100 g chow mein noodles | 100 g goat cheese ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon basil ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mint ( optional )
instructions: Steam the cooled salmon for 10 minutes if using a steamer, 20 minutes if using a steamer. Remove the salmon from the water and pat dry with paper towel. Place the chow mein noodles on a large dish and cover with boiling water and let stand for 5 minutes. Put the noodles in a large bowl and place over boiling water. When the chow mein noodles take off the heat, drain the water and then leave the noodles in the noodles. Pour over a small amount of soy sauce if using to make a creamy dressing. Place the salmon in a bowl and mix it, using a fork, in a small pile or with your hands. Spread the chow mein across a large plate or platter, cover with the crumb mixture, and finally add the crumb mix on top. Sprinkle basil, mint, or both over the salmon and crumb.

Random Ingredients: papaya,ginger,cottage cheese,topping,kaffir lime leaf,curry powder,baby arugula,egg yolk
title: Spiced  Filled Jello Cups
ingredients: 1 large egg yolk | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 slices pickled ginger, chopped | 2 cans cottage cheese | 1 cup baby arugula, loosely packed | 1 large papaya, peeled and diced | 20 kaffir lime leaves | 3/4 cup fat-free whipped topping
instructions: Beat yolk and curry powder in medium bowl with electric mixer until thick and creamy. Set aside. Mix cottage cheese, arugula, papaya and lime leaves in mixing bowl. Fill jello cups with 2/3 of stuffing mixture. Top with whipped topping.

title: Braised Chuck Berry Salad with Blueberry Dressing
ingredients: 4 large tart apples, cored and cut into chunks | 1/2 cup white sugar | 3 tablespoons sea salt | 2 cans whole beef, well drained and rinsed | 1 package frozen cut green onion | 1 container blueberry yogurt
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer the pickles until very soft and translucent, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat, cool, and transfer the diced apples to a bowl. Add the sugar and sea salt, stirring to combine. Place rinsed beef in a large saucepan with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until beef is tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, reserving liquid, and crumble the beef into the hot rinsed beef. Simmer until liquid in the saucepan goes syrupy, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Remove from heat and cool, stirring occasionally. Refrigerate until chilled. When the pickles are chilled, toss with the chilled beef and green onion. Add blueberry and yogurt to the pickles and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,half,liquid smoke,puff pastry,grand marnier,onion salt
title: Spice Twister
ingredients: 2 packages puff pastry | 1/4 cup half-and-half ( optional ) | 1 cup half-and-half or 1 cup whipping cream | 2 -3 green cardamom pods | 1/4 cup dry minced onion salt | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat oven to roll out the puff pastry dough on a lightly floured surface with a floured rolling pin or rolling pin into a rectangle about 1/2 inch thick and 10 inches long. Use a 4 to 6 inch straight edge round cookie cutter. Cut a circle around the dough, but not quite to the edge. Transfer dough to a parchment lined large baking sheet, crimping the edges to seal and pressing out any air pockets. Lightly spray the dough with nonstick spray and sprinkle with the garlic power, onion salt, and liquid smoke. Bake in oven until lightly browned approx 10 minutes, depending on the size of the cookie cutter cut. Let cool a few minutes on the baking sheet. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,walnut,green chili,black sesame seed,beef bouillon,pork loin,cold water
title: Lori's Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin ( boneless ) | peel from 2 - 3 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 1 cup walnuts | 5 ounces chopped green chili | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chili pepper flakes | 6 cups cold water | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon
instructions: Cut the pork into 6 serving size pieces. Sprinkle walnuts on top. In bowl, mix together with green and hot peppers and add cold water. Mix up beef soup, add chili, mix and pour over pork. Serve.

title: Grilled Bananas
ingredients: 2 bananas, ripe but firm | 1/2 tablespoon ginger paste | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard
instructions: Slice bananas lengthwise and grill to your liking. This will depend on how much you like the crisp tender skins. Spread one side with the mustard and one side with the ginger. Grill until the mustard turns a dark brown in color. Slice banana lengthwise and serve hot.

title: Apple Bruschetta
ingredients: 12 inches tart apples, such as granny smith, such as fuji | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 3/4 cup lily n lemongrass, coarsely chopped | 4 ciabatta rolls, split and toasted
instructions: Wearing oven mitts, peel apples.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,mascarpone cheese,season salt,creamy peanut butter,clear honey,chili powder,chicken cutlet,yellow bell pepper
title: Easy Peanut-Shave Peanut Butter Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon natural creamy peanut butter | 7 ounces chicken cutlets, cubed | 2 yellow bell peppers | 1 teaspoon mild chili powder | 2 tablespoons shredded reduced fat mascarpone cheese | 1 teaspoon natural light tasting honey | 1/4 teaspoon season salt
instructions: Mix peanut butter with 3 - 4 tbsp water in a food processor, until combined. Add chicken and vegetables, mix well. Add spices and mix again. Cover and marinate for 2 hours. Heat griddle or non stick skillet over medium heat. Remove chicken from marinade and cook until cooked through. Top with the sauce and serve.

title: Spanish Style Fried Beans
ingredients: 1 lb yellow zucchini | 1 lb beans, cooked | paprika
instructions: Dice zucchini into thin slices about 1/4 wide. Wash and soak beans in cold water for about 10 minutes drain the beans and put them in a bowl. Add paprika. Heat up a nonstick skillet, put a bit of oil on it. If you have one use it. Dip your beans in the paprika then put 2 tsp of the bean mixure in a long way. Fry the beans for about 5 minutes, flip the beans in the pan and fry for another 10 minute. Drain the beans again and serve.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,chicken stock,wheat bread,oregano,pumpkin seed,heavy whipping cream,soy sauce
title: Faux Croute Garni in Sauce
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets | 1/4 cup pumpkin seeds | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat bread, crumbs and torn into pieces | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Pat fish dry with absorbent paper. Place fish on plate, sprinkle with pumpkin seeds. In saucepan combine chicken stock, soy sauce and dried oregano. Bring to boil, add breadcrumbs. Return to boiling, lower heat, cover and slowly simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

title: Crostini with Celeriac(Celeriac), Rosemary & Mustard
ingredients: 4 croissants, split in half ( or use whole wheat bread ) | 1 bunch celeriac | 3 -4 sprigs fresh rosemary leaves | vegetable broth, if required | white vinegar, to cover
instructions: Slice croissants or other style bread into 1/4 inch thick diagonal slices. Cut celeriac into slices about 4 inches long as the croissants are wide. Trim ends from rosemary leaves and finely slice them. Lay the croissants on a baking sheet. Sprinkle rosemary leaves over the croissants or cut into thin rounds and place on baking sheet in single layer. Cut croissants into quarters if desired and place about 3 - 4 sprigs of the celeriac. Broil the croissants for 2 - 4 minutes, depending on the desired crispness of the bread. Remove and discard celeriac from broiler or toast. To serve, warm the broth over a stove or under the broiler until reduced about half. Serve as is or serve on bread.

title: Finnish Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 beef roast | 1/2 cup rice flour ( i use a glutinous rice flour ) | 2 cups beef stock ( i use swanson's v8 ) | 1/4 cup dried currant ( i use craisins )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Place roast in baking pan. Mix together rice flour, stock, and currants. Pour over roast. Roast at 300 degrees for 1/2hours, basting every 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,cocoa powder,chili flake,rice flour,miracle whip,egg,beef sirloin,apricot preserve
title: Chile Ritz Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice flour | 1/2 cup cocoa powder or 1/2 cup instant rice flour | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 4 ounces brie cheese, sliced | 1 1/3 cups apricot preserves | 2 eggs | 2 tablespoons miracle whip | 16 slices beef sirloin
instructions: Combine rice flour, cocoa powder and chile flakes. Dip sirloin into eggs on both sides. Brown in a frying pan or skillet. Place sirloin on bottom rack and cover with top rack of sirloin. Fry until sirloin is cooked through and sizzling. Sprinkle with apricot preserves and top with cheese. Serve warm.

title: Pork With Raspberry Glaze (Healthier Version-Y Vegan.Diet Version)
ingredients: 20 ounces smoked pork tenderloin, cut into thin strips | 4 ounces fat packed cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons splenda granular ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon catsup | 3 tablespoons fish stock | 8 small fresh raspberries | 1/2 cup thinly sliced radish
instructions: Coat a non stick fry pan with nonstick cooking spray or you can use a non stick frying pan. Place a large enough fry pan over medium heat and stir fry the pork for 5 minutes. Remove from pan and pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat. Stir cream cheese, splenda, and catsup into pan and simmer for 4 - 5 minutes, or until creamy. Add the raspberries and radishes and simmer for about 3 minutes. Place 2 tbsp of the melted cream cheese mixture in individual bowls. Place some of the pork strips on top of the cream cheese and garnish with more whipped cream if desired. Enjoy note, i've made this dish all the way to rapid prep and easy to cook, so i decided to use the non stick frying pans to prep my meat for this recipe.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,plum,cabbage,canola oil,steak,black tea,ice cube
title: Chinese Plum Steak
ingredients: 3 cups peeled plum ( frozen is ok ) | 1/4 gallon canola oil | 1/3 cup freshly squeezed black tea | 1 whole flank steak | 1 cup cabbage, coarsely chopped | crushed graham cracker crumbs | ice cube
instructions: Place the plums into a large, deep saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from the heat, remove from the heat, and let stand at least 30 minutes. Drain. Heat the oil in a large stew pot over medium heat. Place the peach halves in the hot oil, cut side down, and fry until they have begun to brown. Sprinkle with tequila if desired. Stir in the black tea, and reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer the coulis for 20 minutes. Turn the steak slices into a large bowl. Stir in the cabbage. Spoon the cabbage mixture over the steaks and serve with cracker crumbs. You can garnish with sprigs of cilantro. Cook's note, if you have time, marinate the steaks overnight in the freezer. The steaks can be frozen for up to 6 months or frozen for up to 6 months.

title: Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 6 tablespoons tahini, or to taste | 2 pimento pepper, seeded and diced
instructions: Whisk tahini and pimentos together in a small bowl.

title: Radish and Sultana Salad
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs sultanas | 4 -5 radishes, very thinly sliced
instructions: Mix all the ingredients well and serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,ziti pasta,spaghetti,lentil,purple cabbage,italian sausage,ginger root
title: Sweet and Savory Sausage and Lentil Stew
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 1 pound sweet italian sausage, sliced | 6 purple cabbage, sliced | 1 bottle dry lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 can coconut milk | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 1/2 cup thinly sliced purple cabbage
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ziti pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 9 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Place the sausage in a large skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Break the sausage into small chunks while browning. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Stir the cabbage into the sausage and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage is tender, about 10 minutes. Add the lentils, coconut milk, ginger, and purple cabbage to the skillet. Bring to a simmer before removing from the heat. Allow the mixture to sit and absorb the flavors, about 10 minutes. Serve with spiced white rice and a sprinkling of cajun seasoning sauce.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,peanut butter,peanut,ancho chilies,picante sauce,sushi rice,anaheim chilies,meat
title: Meatball and Nachos
ingredients: 2 lbs meatballs ( about 3 ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 3 anaheim chilies, stemmed, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices ( about 12 ) | 3 anaheim chilies, stemmed, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices ( about 12 ) | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 cups sushi rice | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil
instructions: In a large sealable plastic bag, combine meatballs, picante sauce and garlic paste and mix. Add chiles and marinate meatballs in mixture for 1 hour or up to 12 hours, turning meatballs occasionally. In a large skillet, heat oil over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking. Working in batches, add meatballs to oil, turning once, and sauté until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer meatballs to a plate. Wipe out pan. Pour oil out of meatballs and heat over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking. Add rice and stir gently to coat, about 3 minutes. Working in batches, pour meatballs into rice. Cook, undisturbed, stirring with a fork, until browned on all sides, about 8 minutes total. Transfer with tongs to a plate and keep warm. To serve, arrange meatballs on a platter and pour sauce over them.

title: Shrimp Croquettes
ingredients: 2 lbs large shrimp, shelled & deveined | 3 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 cup jarlsberg cheese, grated or jarlsberg cheese, grated
instructions: Place shrimp in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,lime,beef sausage,mustard seed,beefsteak tomato,yukon gold potato
title: Sausage, Tomato and Potato Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb beef sausages ( about 2 sausages per package ) | 8 yukon gold potatoes or 8 russet potatoes, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 -2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 32 ounces beefsteak tomatoes, drained well | guacamole | 3 -5 limes, quartered
instructions: In a 3 - 6 qt slow cooker, sauté potato cubes in a teaspoon of mustard seed until lightly browned. Add sausages to slow cooker and brown slightly.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,plum tomato,shrimp,green bean,poblano chile,dark brown sugar
title: Shrimp With Beans
ingredients: 1 lb green beans ( tips removed ) | 1/2 lb green poblano chile | 8 shrimp ( peeled and deveined ) | 3/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 pint plum tomato, chopped
instructions: Remove green beans from stems and cut in half. Cut poblano chile in half lengthwise and remove seeds and veins. Cut beans into 1/2 inch pieces and place cut side down in a skillet with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium high head. Reduce heat to low and cook, covered and stirring occasionally, 10 - 15 minutes till chiles are tender and beginning to burst in pan. Remove from heat. Cut stem off green beans, remove and discard woody parts from bean pods. Cut each piece in half crosswise. While beans are cooking cut shrimp into 1 inch pieces and combine with sugar and bay leaf. Set aside till beans are done. Add shrimp, beans and tomatoes to skillet. Simmer. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,swiss cheese,tart apple,sage leaf,cheese,ginger powder
title: Apple Cheese Samosas
ingredients: 1 lb fresh tart apple | 12 ounces swiss cheese | 12 slices fresh ginger powder | 1/8 teaspoon rubbed sage leaves | 1 dash of powdered ginger powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated cheese ( cheddar, monterrey jack or cheddar )
instructions: Core apples and cut into quarters lengthwise. Combine apples, swiss cheese, ginger and sage. Sprinkle with ginger powder and cheese. Roll the pastry to a rectangular shape and place in a large bowl. Paint the surface with a little oil and roll the samosas in it. Seal with a little water. Preheat your oven to 350°f and bake for about 20 minutes until the pastry is golden brown. Allow to cool slightly and cut in half before serving,.

title: Vegetable Pasta
ingredients: 1 package linguine ( spaghetti or angel hair pasta work well to make this dish gluten-free ) | 1 package frozen mixed mushrooms | 4 fluid ounces low-fat yogurt or 4 fluid ounces plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 1 tablespoon vegetable margarine or 1 tablespoon butter, melted | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions and set aside. To make sauce, in a small bowl, combine yogurt, orange juice, margarine or butter and worcestershire sauce. Place the frozen mushrooms in a freezer bag.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,lemon peel,chicken stock vegetable,craisins,baking potato,spanish onion,salad green,cardamom powder
title: Persian Spiced Potato and  Mint Salad
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled, unpeeled | 1 spanish onion, peeled and chopped | 1/4 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh lemon peel | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom powder ( optional ) | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Prepare oven to 375 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Cut potato in half lengthwise and scoop out and discard core, leaving potato in small chunks. In a large bowl, combine potato chunks and onions with all ingredients except dressing ingredients and mix lightly to blend. Arrange salad on prepared pan and bake 15 minutes, stirring vegetables once during cooking to ensure even coloring. Serve warm.

title: Roasted Lemons
ingredients: 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 6 -8 kalamata olives ( depending how many you like them ) | 2 -3 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Spread the mustard on the lemons before pricking them with a fork. Place in a shallow dish such as an oven proof dish and brush with the oil. Roast at 220degc for 15 to 20 minutes or until they are tender and golden.

title: Chili Barley Drink
ingredients: 50 g pearl barley, washed | 1 cup tamarind juice
instructions: Put the barley into a large bowl. Drain the tamarind and add 3/4 cup water. Leave for 30 minutes. Strain mixture through a sieve and pour into your chilled glass.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,ham,sausage casing,baking powder,almond extract,berry,marsala wine
title: Cannellini Beans Baked in Sausages
ingredients: 2 cups fresh mixed berries | 1 package smoked ham | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup pancetta fat, fat | 1 lb sausage casings, soaked in water for at least 10 minutes | 1/4 cup sweet marsala wine | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Clean and wash the fresh berries. Cook the ham or other sausage until browned in some of the fat and then drain. Cut the sausage into ½ inch thick squares and cut the sausage into bite sized pieces. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Mix the cooked sausage, berries, ham and almond extract in a roasting pan. Sprinkle the pancetta fat over the pan and bake for approximately 45 minutes at 350°f, stirring from time to time. Remove from the oven and add the marsala to make a thin gravy. Scoop pan juices over the sausage and serve.

title: Kalveyri Keftas
ingredients: 1 kg veal | 300 ml double cream
instructions: The night before, wash the veal and slice into 1cm thick cubes. Put the veal in a plastic bag, add 150ml of double cream and allow to marinate and soften overnight. The next day, preheat the oven to 180 degrees centigrade with 2cm piece of greaseproof paper over the surface. Spray a roasting tin with oil and place the meat on the baking tin. Carefully pour the marinated cream into the tin. Scatter the cheese of your choice over the meat. Put in the oven or grill and cook for 45 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,nutmeg,grain white rice,green,coriander,ginger root,guinness stout,stewing beef
title: Stove Frying Beef & Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 bottle guinness stout | 1/4 cup finely chopped green or red onion | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 1/2 hours or overnight, if using a slow cooker
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the stewing beef, guinness, onion, ginger, coriander, nutmeg, and turmeric. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours. Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat until very hot. Sear meat in oil for a few minutes on all sides, then stir fry until the beef is well browned. Place beef and vegetables into the slow cooker. Cover and cook on high 10 to 12 hours.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,lager beer,gingerroot,turnip,pork shoulder,blackberry jam,tuna water
title: Sicilian Pork With Fruit
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless pork shoulder ( or other thick cut of pork ) | 2 1/2 ounces blackberry jam ( your choice! ) | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon minced gingerroot ( or to taste ) | 1 can tuna packed in water, drained & flaked | 1 1/2 cups dry red wine | 1 1/2 cups turnips ( cut in 2 inch pieces )
instructions: Place the pork in a 10 inch skillet with the jam jar, vinegar, ginger and 1 cup of the liquid.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,sharp cheddar cheese,rye bread,cannellini bean,creme fraiche,bay leaf
title: Baked Beans

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spoon the drained beans into a casserole dish. Spoon the cheese mixture over the beans in the casserole & sprinkle over the warrior cassis. Bake for 20 minutes, until the top is golden & creamy.

title: Fish and Prouts
ingredients: 1 package seasoned croutons | 2 large spanish onions, halved and sliced into half-moons | 2 packages frozen green papayas, thawed | 2 1/2 pounds cod fish fillets, cut into portions
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange croutons on the prepared baking sheet.

title: Raw Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt ( or sour cream ) | 2 tablespoons tahini ( sesame paste ) | 2 lbs brussels sprouts, trimmed and cut in half | 3/4 cup apple cider | 3 tablespoons brussels sprouts, chopped, with 1 tablespoon of brine | 1 teaspoon black olives, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix yogurt, tahini, 1/4 cup of brine and sprouts. Toss with remaining brine. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Garnish with brussels sprouts and olives and serve.

title: Easy Broth for Soup
ingredients: 1 box shell pasta | 4 cups broth, to cook pasta
instructions: In a large pot add 1 cup of broth and the pasta. Cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until you have some sort of sauce to add to the sauce when you cook the pasta. If you have a pasta pot, you can boil the pasta in a separate pot, just enough to cook the pasta.

title: Basic Ghanaian Gravlax
ingredients: 7 cups vegetable broth | 5 dried hot chili peppers | 5 dried hot chili peppers | 5 whole cloves | 1/4 - 1/2 cup mango powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in large stockpot and bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered until tender, usually a minimum of 60 minutes and should only take about 20 - 30 minutes. Remove all ingredients and place in bowl and blend until smooth. Return to pan and simmer another 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: date,cumin powder,corn tortilla chip,coffee ice cream,jicama
title: Quick and Easy Breakfast Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup jicama ( peeled cubed ) | 1/2 cup corn tortilla chips | 1/8 cup dates ( pitted chopped ) | 8 -12 ounces coffee ice cream ( you won't need it ) | 1/8 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Grill jicama cubes or other vegetables. In a small container, make jicama as directed but keep in the refrigerator. Combine all ingredients except the ice cream. Microwave or serve with tortilla chips.

title: Ginger Crunch Eggs
ingredients: 1 hard-boiled egg | 2 cups ginger ale
instructions: Peel eggs and cut in halves lengthwise. Remove from shells and slice into quarters or chunks about 1/4 inch thick. Put beaten egg, ginger ale and 1 tsp coarse salt into hot beer or soup or frypan to desired consistency and scramble. Serve hot.

title: Champiñones Sauteed Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mushroom broth ( can be found at italian specialty food store ) | 3 plum tomatoes
instructions: In a medium size skillet heat oil over medium heat. Add the tomatoes and saute for a few minutes, or until the tomatoes release most of their juices. Stir in the mushroom broth.

title: Creamy Salmon Chowder
ingredients: 1 package white potatoes, diced | 1 can cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 cup milk | 1 can salmon, drained and flaked
instructions: Cook potatoes according to package directions. When potatoes are tender, add the cream of celery soup, milk, undrained, and salmon. Heat through, stirring well.

title: Easy, Simple Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms | 4 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin
instructions: Soak the mushrooms in warm water for 3 hours. Remove and discard the mushroom stems and finely chop the caps. Cut a kabobs of beef lengthwise, crosswise, across the width of the meat. Place the beef on a rack, cut side up, and grill or bbq the meat about 3 minutes on each side. Serve the beef with the mushroom gravy.

title: Non Dairy Fruit Pops
ingredients: pineapple ring, canned in syrup for 1 hour, juice reserved ( i use my own fat free canned pineapple syrup ) | non-dairy whipped topping
instructions: Fill pate maker with desired number of ice cold beverages to serve. Top with non dairy whipped topping.

title: Homemade Japanese Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 lb sweet and sour sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons kama togarashi hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Start the boiling water for the noodles. While waiting for the water to boil, mix all your dry ingredients for the noodles very thoroughly. You should have a mixture of panko and hot sauce ready in a jar. Pour the noodles into the boiling water and let sit until the noodles are done, about 3 minutes. Drain the noodles in a colander, and rinse the noodles well. Place in a large warm bowl, turn over the heat to high. Heat about 1 tablespoon of the sauce in the hot water. Once the sauce is hot, pour over the noodles and serve.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,chipotle powder,egg noodle,cubanelle pepper,salsa,jasmine rice,italian parsley,mace
title: Cafe Rio Noodle and Parsnip Kugel
ingredients: 1 small sweet potato peeled and diced ( about 1 1/2 pints ) | 4 ounces sweet chipotle powder | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley or 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, minced | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground mace | 12 ounces uncooked egg noodles | 1/2 cup salsa ( bottled is ok ) | 1 cubanelle pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 sprig fresh italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large bowl, combine the sweet potato, chipotle, parsley, chipotle powder, mace and macadamia nuts. Cover and refrigerate for 1 1/2 hours. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Spray 4 large nonstick skillets generously with cooking spray. Add the noodles and cook for 2 minutes. Drain the noodles and return them to the pot. Stir in the salsa and bring to a boil over high heat. Boil for 10 minutes, or until the noodles are fork tender. Arrange the parsley on four plates. Fill each plate with 1/4 cup noodles, topping with the salsa and a sprig of parsley.

title: Italian Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut flavored oil | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 roma tomato, diced
instructions: Heat the coconut oil over medium heat. Stir in the garlic powder and a squeeze of fresh lemon to avoid burning the garlic. Stir in the diced tomato, and cook an additional 1 - 2 minutes. Serve over hot and slightly salted wild rice.

title: Queso Straws (Or Cheese Straws With Optional Cheese)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs mozzarella cheese, sliced to 1/4 inch thickness | 1 1/4 ounces queso fresco or 1 1/4 ounces feta, sliced | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 1/4 - 1 1/4-1 1/4-1 1/4-1 1/4-1 1/4-1 1/4-1 1/4-1 1/4-1 1/4-1 1/4-1 1/4-1 in diameter and wide as possible.
instructions: Arrange the mozzarella, queso fresco, and worcestershire into a 1 - 2 quart serving dish. In a small bowl blend together the worcestershire and white pepper. Sprinkle over the cheese mixture. Cover and chill about 2 hours. To serve, loosen the cheese with a knife and carefully slide it with a spatula over a bowl of cold water and cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Lamb in Coconut Cream (Lammkounetes Kål)
ingredients: 400 ml coconut milk | 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 racks lamb ( approx 5-6 chops ) | 350 g green beans, ends trimmed | 2 tablespoons coconut jam | 1 teaspoon corn ( optional )
instructions: For the coconut cream, pour the coconut milk into a large, heavy based saucepan and set over a high heat. Add the brandy and simmer gently for 2 minutes. Place the lamb in a roasting tin, then add the beans and 1/2 cup of the coconut cream to the tin. Stir to combine then pour the coconut cream around the meat, covering each piece. Place the rest of the coconut cream around the lamb, then turn the heat down. Leave to cook until the meat is tender, about 1 hour to 3 hours. Transfer the lamb to a board and cut into 3 equal pieces. Shallow fry briefly over a medium hot heat until golden brown, then slice into thick strips. Ladle the coconut cream into warmed shallow soup bowls. Sprinkle with the crushed red pepper flakes if using. Garnish the lamb with the green beans and drizzle over the raspberry jam and corn if using. Serve with mashed potato, noodles, or fresh cucumber salad.

title: Quick Spinach-Okra and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh okra | 1 cup chopped fresh mushrooms | 1 cup chopped baking apple | 1 1/2 cups hot sauce, divided | 3/4 cup prepared guacamole | 1 bag fresh spinach | 1/4 cup bottled sauce | 1 can refried beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place okra, mushrooms, apples, 1/2 cup hot sauce, guacamole, and spinach in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Drizzle with remaining tablespoons of hot sauce and top with remaining 1 1/2 cups hot sauce and 1/2 bag bean sprouts. Bake in preheated oven, covered, for 15 minutes. Top with remaining hot sauce, bean sprouts, and remaining 1/2 cup hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,marshmallow,liquid smoke,italian sausage,italian cheese,tart apple,milk chocolate
title: Cherry and Swiss Smoked Sausage Calzone
ingredients: 1 cup swiss cheese | 1/2 cup canned milk chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup miniature marshmallows | 1/4 cup italian cheese blend | 1 lean italian sausage ( about 1 1/4 ounces ) | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 3/4 - 1 cup canned tart apple, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place cheese, chocolate, marshmallows, italian cheese blend and fat free liquid smoke in a small pan and cook until cheese is melted and mixture is slightly mixed together. Remove from heat and stir in apples. Pour mixture into a 10x15 inch baking pan. Bake for 15 minutes or until heated thru. Cut into 4 large size pieces and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,mango,mace,hokkien noodle,masa harina,milk ricotta cheese,mustard powder,tomato sauce
title: Sweet Heat Lasagna
ingredients: 1 pound masa harina | 3 cups bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon dried mustard powder | 1 can tomato sauce | 6 ounces dried hokkien noodles | 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil and mango, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix harina, bread crumbs, mace, and mustard powder together in a bowl with a fork. Reduce heat to 350 degrees f, and continue baking 25 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Lighter Coconut Candy

instructions: Place all ingredients into a bowl. Melt candy in the microwave or an electric oven or stir until smooth. Serve it with cool whip..

title: Pasta With Chipotle Vodka Lettuce and Adobo
ingredients: 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 quarts lightly packed, washed and dried pasta | 2 bunches bibb lettuce, washed and dried | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the adobo sauce and cinnamon and add the pasta. Add salt to taste. Serve at once, or refrigerate overnight for a spicier and more vibrant taste. Garnish with the bibb lettuce.

title: Polenta-Style Chives and Chives
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chopped sweet chives | 3 tablespoons chopped triple sec ( optional, but recommended ) | 2 2 cups polenta or 2 cups coarsely grated polenta
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the chives, triple sec and polenta. Using hands, scrape into a large bowl.

instructions: In a large bowl, mix milk with pepper jack cheese and rosemary. Dip spoon in spray, then in sprinkles. Refrigerate 30 minutes before serving to keep cheese soft.

title: Spicy Pineapple Blue Cheese Dip
ingredients: 500 g pineapple, drained | 1 liter kalamata olive, drained | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 can sweet chili sauce | 200 g blue cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup passion fruit, sliced
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving the liquid. Dice the pineapple, olives, bouillon cube, onion and chile sauce. In a pie dish with a lid layer pineapple, olives, bouillon and enchilada and top with blue cheese. Pour passionfruit juice over all and bake in a 400 degree oven for 20mins or until golden brown and bubbly. Garnish with passionfruit.

ingredients: 150 g smoked fish sauce | 150 g fine silken tofu | 1 teaspoon hot paprika ( to taste ) | 150 g icing sugar | 125 g plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons chopped almonds | 3 dill pickle, finely minced | 1 tablespoon dill pickle, finely minced | 80 g sliced almonds | icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Make the sauce using the yogurt, add the sugar and mix until it is dissolved. Pour sauce evenly over your chosen slice and leave on the counter for 30 mins. Make the topping to assemble.

instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the flour and saffron threads on a work surface.

title: Fantastic Russian Salad Dressing

instructions: Boil cranberries, drain, and then chop them up into smaller pieces. Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Warm Pasta Salad With Vanilla-Custard Sauce
ingredients: 350 g angel hair pasta or 350 g fettuccine | 2 kiwi fruits, quartered ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 300 ml double cream | 2 tablespoons custard powder | 3 drops vanilla essence | 1 iceberg lettuce, to serve
instructions: Cook noodles according to packet instructions and drain. While the pasta is cooking grate the kiwori and keep warm. Remove the kiwifruit, if used, and discard any seeds. Combine with the cream, and custard powder, mix well. Drain the noodles and add to the cream and custard mixture. Pour over any vinaigrette you have decided to use. Sprinkle over the strawberries and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,orange peel,tart red cherry,coleslaw mix,iceberg lettuce,penne pasta,grainy mustard,pearl barley
title: Quick Beef and Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 cup small pearl barley | 1 orange peel, diced | 1 bottle char-grilled coleslaw dressing | 1 package frozen tart red cherries | 6 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup grainy mustard
instructions: In a 12 inch nonstick skillet, cook stew beef over medium high heat in half of remaining ingredients, stirring occasionally, until beef is browned and vegetables are tender. title: Grilled Veggie Rounds

instructions: Preheat grill to high. Mix cornmeal, cornmeal and cilantro in bowl to coat all over vegetables. Brush the grilling surface with oil and quickly place vegetable rounds on grill. Grill for 5 - 8 minutes, until tops are golden brown. Remove and place on a plate covered with parchment paper until ready to serve. Combine yogurt, asparagus and cheese. Spread yogurt mixture on top of veggies and top with bread.

title: South African English Muffins
ingredients: 4 english muffins, split and toasted ( or equivalent ) | 1/4 cup curry paste | 2 tablespoons acho chile powder | 4 teaspoons vanilla sugar
instructions: Combine chile powder, curry paste and vanilla sugar in a bowl. Add the english muffins and top with a portion of curry mixture. Bake in a preheated 300f oven for approx 15 minutes or until the topping is toasted and bubbling hot.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,cream celery soup,grain white rice,guacamole
title: Italian Sausage and Rice in Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage ( bulk or bulk or links ) | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Brown sausage in large skillet over medium heat. Drain fat. Transfer sausage to 4 to 6 cups slow cooker. Add soup and rice.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,yellow onion,date,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Quick Satay & Yellow Onions!
ingredients: 4 teaspoons veggie oil or 4 teaspoons cooking spray | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 large yellow onion | 2 -3 stoned dates
instructions: Cut the onion in half and slice into half again lengthways. Slice the onion in half and slice thinly crossways. Place all of the ingredients, in the order listed, onto a large, non stick frying pan and bring to the boil,. Simmer for 10 minutes, or until onions soft, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Drain excess liquid and leave to cool. Transfer to small serving bowls. Serve with satays.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,self rising flour,phyllo dough,chicken breast half,dill,season salt,yogurt
title: Thai Curry Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves, about | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour, sifted | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 teaspoon light cream or 1 teaspoon yogurt | 2 teaspoons season-all salt | 8 sheets phyllo dough | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Dredge chicken in flour. Place on lightly oiled baking sheet. Top with curry paste. Bake until chicken is fully cooked, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in bowl stir together yogurt and season all. Lay a sheet of phyllo dough out on a lightly floured surface. Brush top sheet with yogurt mixture. Cover with 2 more sheets of phyllo, brushing each generously with yogurt. Repeat with remaining sheets, adding more phyllo as needed, until you have 8 sheets. Bake in middle of oven for 15 minutes or until top is golden brown and phyllo is crisp, stirring once. Sprinkle with dill and serve.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,mustard powder,yoghurt,graham cracker crumb,lasagna noodle,salad green,honey,red chile
title: Laurie's Lazy Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons minced fresh red chile | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish and onion salad dressing | 1/2 cup plain yoghurt | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 12 sheets lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 cups plain graham cracker crumbs | shredded pretzels ( optional )
instructions: In large skillet, heat peanut oil over medium low heat. Add red chile and horseradish and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat, and set aside. In a bowl, mix together salad dressing, yogurt, mustard powder.

title: Flammekake
ingredients: 2 packages fresh yeast, packages | 4 cups fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 1 bag frozen green beans
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 1/4 cups warm water. Let stand 10 minutes, then stir and let rise. Drain well and mix with other 1 cup warm water to 1 1/2 cups total. Cover and let rise 1 hour. Scald, steam or boil beans until bright green and tender, 10 to 15 minutes, drain. Combine with remaining water, stirring with a large spoon or other utensil. Cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in milk. Stir in beans. Cover and let rise 30 to 35 minutes. Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Let rise 1 hour or until foamy. Stir and grease baking sheet with vegetable oil. Stir into sponge mixture. Cover and let rise 1 hour. Punch down. Place in greased bowl, turning to grease tops. Cover and let rise 20 minutes. Bake at 400 degrees f. For 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Simple Yunnan Peanut Butter Balls (Banadoor)
ingredients: 1 package crunchy peanut butter | 3 fresh chilies
instructions: Mash chilies with peanut butter for a more vibrant color.

title: Chunky Soybeans
ingredients: 1 lb dried soybeans ( about 4 1/2 cups ) | 2 serrano chilies ( about 4 1/2-inch long, seeded ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Soak soyabeans, covered at cool room temperature, in at least 8 cups of water overnight or in the refrigerator for several days. Bring soaked soyabeans and water to boil in large pot.

Random Ingredients: banana leaf,picante sauce,spaghetti,salsa,green chili salsa,beef brisket,tamarind pulp,green bean
title: Mexican Shredded Beef on Rice
ingredients: 3 lbs meaty beef brisket ( cut in pieces or a bit larger ) | 3 cans green beans ( drain and reserve juice ) | 2 cans picante sauce | 1 jar salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1 package dried spaghetti ( broken up into pieces ) | 1 can diced mild green chili salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1 can tamarind pulp ( optional ) | banana leaf, cut in 6 pieces
instructions: Place beef slices in crock pot. Combine the salsa and green chili salsa in a bowl. Pour over beef and add enough of the reserved juice from the jar of beans to moisten. Cover crockpot and cook on low for 8 hours. Remove beef from crock pot and discard juice. Add spaghetti to pot and return to full cook setting. Turning the heat on slow, add beans and heat through. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Cover and cook until hot through, about 20 minutes. Wear aluminium foil if necessary and cut off a layer of foil before serving.

title: Kraisom's Best Beef Broth
ingredients: 1 gallon beef broth | 1 cup raisins ( optional )
instructions: Place broth to boil in large pot. Warm raisins in small bowl. Add to broth and add soaked raisins, if desired. Cover and cook slowly, adding water, if it starts to stick to bottom. Simmer for 2 to 3 hours. If you find it thickening, add a little water. Strain the broth and serve with flatbread or toasted bread, if desired.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,mint,paprika,half,fennel bulb,mung bean sprout,green chili pepper
title: Mongolian Fennel and Sesame Nuts (Tamarind Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups fresh mung bean sprouts | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon minced green chili pepper | 1 teaspoon fennel bulb, peeled and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped of fresh mint ( coriander )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cover the mung bean sprouts with lightly salted cold water.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,lemon juice zest,rom tomato,cannellini bean,beef tenderloin
title: Beef Tenderloin With Tomato & Beans
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 8 ounces roma tomatoes, peeled, chopped | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 lbs raw shrimp, peeled, deveined
instructions: Make sure there are no saltiness in the beef. Trim the fat from the beef. Wrap it in aluminum foil.

title: Quick and Easy Kim Chi
ingredients: 4 cups shredded napa cabbage | 3 green chile peppers, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Cook cabbage in microwave for 30 seconds. Spread cabbage on a plate and sprinkle with green chile peppers and dried oregano. Microwave on high, uncovered, 1 minute.

title: Italian Sausage or Hot Nut Cookies  (Paillards)
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage ( or hot sausage ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Separate sausage into chunks, place in bowl and sprinkle with almond extract. Mix well. Place about 1 tablespoon of hazelnut or pistachios in palm of your hand and roll with fingers to form a round, approximately 3/4 inch or so thick. Dip in melted butter and then roll in extra hazelnuts or pistachios to coat evenly. Place on a plate as you are making all your cookies, or onto a cookie sheet lined with wax paper, or baking sheet lined with parchment paper. When all cookies have been baked, spread about 1 1/2 tsp almond flavored cooking spray on each cookie.. Bake until lightly toasted. Icing, mix a little water with the icing sugar to make a fine paste. It is to be drizzled over hot sausage when cooked. This icing is really good either hot or sweet, or sweet. I used about 3/4 tsp of sugar and it's good. These cookies may be stored for up to 15 days. Enjoy.

title: Daikon Radish and Vietnamese Herbed Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb daikon radish | 12 ounces rotini pasta | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped
instructions: Bring 5 quarts water to a boil in a large pot. Meanwhile, scrub radish and cut into quarters. Remove peel and center with a sharp paring knife. Cut into thin sticks and slice thinly on the diagonal. Meanwhile, bring 6 quarts of water to a boil. Add noodles and cook over high heat 2 minutes only, or until al dente. Drain, and divide pasta among 4 dessert dishes. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with vietnamese teriyaki sauce.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,lemon zest,peanut,thyme,lettuce leaf,bread flour,ancho chile powder,mango chutney
title: Bread and Butter Fruit Salad (Food Network Magazine)
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 cup peanuts | 1 cup dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | lettuce leaf | lemon chutney | mango chutney
instructions: In food processor blend bread flour, roasted peanuts, chutney, lemon zest, thyme, and 1/2 tsp of the orange zest until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Place the remaining 1/2 tsp of orange zest in small bowl. Add lemon mixture to bread flour mixture and pulse until mixture forms a ball. Transfer to a floured surface lightly knead until smooth, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 30 minutes. Lightly coat the baking sheet with vegetable spray. To assemble salad place romaine leaves on the lined baking sheet and place 2 1/2 cups of the basting mixture on top. Using a sharp knife, lightly score the top of the baguette with a knife pattern to allow fruit sections to marinate, turning once. Cut loaf into 3/8 inch thick slices. Arrange slices on baking sheet and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.. Spread 1 tsp of green chutney on each slice and top with sliced fruit. Place on serving tray and serve with lemon and mango chutney for a dipping sauce.

title: Minted Oranges
ingredients: 6 large orange zest pieces, with no pith ( about 1 1/2 cups total ) | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, finely chopped
instructions: In a medium size bowl, stir together the orange zest, mint, and 2 tablespoons water.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,coleslaw mix,beef broth,broccoli floret,celery salt
title: Broccoli Beef Soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil, divided | 1 lb broccoli floret | 3 stalks celery salt | 4 ounces coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a 5 quart covered saucepan, bring 1 1/2 cups water and 1 tablespoon olive oil to a boil over high heat. Add broccoli and celery salt.

title: Oven-Baked Cherries in Garlic Rice
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs good-quality dried cherries, such as bing or lambert | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups short-grain rice | 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped | 4 -5 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley and rosemary | 1 tablespoon coarsely cracked black peppercorns
instructions: Soak cherries over boiling water in a large saucepan for 45 - 55 minutes or until tender. Drain and squeeze juices through a sieve or sieve into a medium saucepan. Place drained cherries in a fine stream in a large saucepan with about 3 - 4 cups cold water. Place over moderate heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered, stirring frequently until cherries are softened and plump, about 20 minutes. Drain and discard any discolored juice. Place rice in a medium size bowl and cover with several inches of room temperature water. Set aside at room temperature. Drain cherries and rinse well under cold water. In a food processor put cherry juice, basil, herb and peppercorns and process until smooth. Pour rice in a large shallow baking dish and spread out into a rectangle. Spread cherries over rice, then sprinkle with cherries and herb mixture. Roll up from the bottom to the top rectangle, jellyroll style, pressing seams to seal, and arrange in a large, straight sided baking dish. Cover and let stand at room temperature for about 1 hour, or until liquid has been absorbed and rice is firm. Transfer to a serving plate and cut into 6 pieces. Serve hot or cold, warm or cold. Serve each diner a piece of rice from the baking dish, arranging them on the platter with cherries around the sides. Serve the cherries in their broth or pour the juices in to their broth.

title: Pecorino-Pecorino Alla Genovese
ingredients: 3/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 2 packages pecorino romano cheese ( store bought, it can be difficult to find in the italian ) | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place 1 package pecorino romano on a tea towel and rub around the outside with italian pistachios using your fingers. Place in a blender with 1/2 cup grated pecorino. Blend for 2 minutes pour into a small bowl and stir in bay leaf. Store in fridge until ready to serve or set out right away for use.

title: Spice-Baked Beer Can
ingredients: 1 teaspoon molasses or 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 3 inches piece kaffir lime leaf | 1/2 teaspoon ground anise seed
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large, heavy frying pan. Heat to a simmer over medium high heat, swirling pan as needed to mix in all the liquid, 2 - 3 minutes. Strain into a warm jug. Note, if the mixture does not set up immediately after removing from heat, stir to loosen sediment.

title: Rosemary Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon sultana ( or raisins ) | 500 g chicken tenders, cut into strips | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a large frying pan. Cook the chicken strips for 1 - 2 minutes until golden brown. Remove from pan or plate. Reduce heat and add sultanas or raisins.

title: The Easiest and Best Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh red chile | sesame seeds ( or peanuts )
instructions: Using a sharp knife, slice the chiles lengthwise as thinly as possible, leaving the pods whole. Spread them on an oiled griddle or baking sheet. Sprinkle the seeds with salt and toss lightly until the salt is absorbed, and the peppers are slightly charred. Spread them on a baking sheet and toast in a preheated oven on a medium low setting until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Transfer the chiles to a mixing bowl and add 2 tablespoons hot water or cold water and mix thoroughly until they spread. Sprinkle the peppers with additional hot water, cover and store at room temperature for an hour or two before shaking the griddle. Variation, add 1 to 2 tablespoons fresh ginger paste along with the sesame seeds, for a sweeter taste, and more pronounced chiles. Variations, replace the chiles with sliced dry, raw peanuts.

title: Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups long grain white rice | 3 cups prepared rice
instructions: Combine the rice with 3 cups prepared rice in a rice cooker. Press steam, cover and put on to wait about 15 minutes. The steam will be released and the texture will be sticky. You can also cook immediately with a skillet over high heat. When the pressure is released, fluff rice with a fork and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,vanilla essence,butter,mustard seed,vanilla,madras curry powder
title: Saffron Vanilla Butter
ingredients: 3/4 cup butter ( buttery ) | 3/4 cup madras curry powder ( madras curry powder ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 pinch saffron thread | 1/4 teaspoon ground saffron threads
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and press into a greased tray lined with greaseproof paper or parchment paper. Spray with oil the sides and sides of a flameproof pan with oil and bake in a pre heated oven at 160c for about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool.

title: Jamaican Turkey Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked turkey, chopped | 1 can mushroom pieces ( drained ) | 1 jar salad oil ( i prefer miracle whip with coconut ) | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1/4 cup ginger ale | 4 leaves of your favourite lettuces | 1 package shredded coconut
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the shredded coconut. Place on a sheet of parchment paper and top with shredded coconut.

title: Turkish Seasoning
ingredients: 25 ounces sunflower oil ( i use sunflower oil ) | 2 tablespoons turmeric | 8 ounces dried dill
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a pot. Add turmeric and dill and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 25 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in a teaspoon of salt. Store in an airtight jar.

Random Ingredients: tuna,jalapeno,pearl barley,maple syrup,wheat pita bread,graham wafer
title: Easy Tuna and Barley Pitas
ingredients: 4 whole wheat pita bread | 1 can tuna ( or just plain ) | 1/2 cup pearls ( or other nuts ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 small jalapeno, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed wheat wafers ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Lightly grease a medium size skillet with low heat. Drain tuna or tuna of any liquid. Add pearls or nuts, if using and bring all to a boil. Pour onto the pita bread. Sprinkle remaining ingredients on top and bake at 375°f for 10 - 12 minutes, or until heated through.

title: The Big Dipper Mince Mince!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck or 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb | 1 large pinch baking soda | 1 cup double cream | 2 cans coconut cream | 1 cup grated coconut ( to taste ) | 12 fresh mint leaves ( chopped )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius. Mix the mince in a large bowl. Then add the baking soda, double cream and one can of coconut cream. Mix until thoroughly combined. Grease a shallow oven tray or oven dish with non stick oil. Place mince mixture into this mixture and bake/brown for 1 hr at 180 degrees celsius while waiting for the mince to come out of the oven. To serve, place shredded mint in a mound on top of mince. Enjoy with a cup of ice cream, yoghurt or coffee.

title: Cubkee Appetizers
ingredients: 1 lb beetroot | 1/2 lime | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese
instructions: Wash and cut beetroot and steam them about 20 minutes. Cool and cut into cubes. Add salt, mix and refrigerate 30 minutes. Stir together lime juice and catsup. Dip each cube of cold beets into catsup and place on cookie sheet, brush with lime syrup and top with cheese. Bake at 350 for 12 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Rote Gratie (Cheese With Condensed Red Wine)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs havarti cheese, or | 1 1/2 lbs rote gratie grated cheese ( a mild white cheese such as gewurzoni )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f degrees. Cut the cheese into 6 slices 1/2 thick and 2 - 4 wide. Toss each slice with the drained rotegrated cheese to ensure that it adheres. Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.
