title: Broccoli Beef Pasta
ingredients: 800 g broccoli florets | 1 1/4 - 1 1/4 kg beef stew meat | 50 g penne pasta, uncooked | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/2 cup chopped colby
instructions: Pre heat oven to 220°c. In a medium sized ovenproof dish, mix together the noodles, cornflour with the carrots of broccoli. Melt butter in a small saucepan, pour over the vegetables and toss to combine. Cover and cook in the oven 40 minutes or until meat is falling off bone. Remove and leave to rest for ten minutes. Meanwhile, boil the pasta according to pack instructions and toss with the sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: edam cheese,caster sugar,bay leaf,asian sesame oil
title: Chinese-Style Asian Cheese
ingredients: 200 g mature asian sesame oil | 140 g caster sugar | 120 g fresh edam cheese | 2 bay leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the sesame oil, sugar and asian sesame oil. Cut the cheese into four equal sized blocks with a sharp knife. The cheese blocks will sink slightly while cooking. Place the bay leaves in the base of a microwave safe dish. Spoon the cheese cubes over the top and cook in a microwave oven for 2 minutes, covered. Remove the bay leaves before serving. Tip, you may need to make a few changes to the oven when making this recipe. Place half of a cheese block in a large glass or ceramic bowl with a flat shelf to allow for expansion.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,shiitake mushroom,oregano leaf,baby arugula,tarragon,monterey jack cheese,summer squash,bow tie pasta
title: Pasta Primavera With Shiitake Mushrooms and Spring Squash
ingredients: 10 ounces bow tie pasta | 6 mushrooms, cleaned and thinly sliced | 20 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and thinly sliced | 2 medium summer squash, trimmed, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/3 cup fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon | 10 large fresh mint leaves
instructions: Cook pasta in a 10 inch nonstick skillet of boiling water until al dente. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain again. Meanwhile, stir together mushrooms and shiitake mushrooms in large bowl. Set aside. Sprinkle squash with tarragon, oregano, and 1 tablespoon each of cheese and mint leaves. Toss with 1/2 cup water, salt to taste and remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Season to taste with salt. Spoon over pasta and sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons of cheese and mint, and mint. Garnish with mint sprigs.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,salt water,cornstarch roux,cider vinegar,date,paprika,egg white,mustard
title: Taco Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup cornstarch roux | 1 teaspoon mustard | 3/4 cup finely chopped pitted dates | 1/4 cup paprika | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 4 egg whites, at room temperature | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 5 cups salt water, or as needed | 1/4 cup cornstarch roux, for coating
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Mix together cornstarch roux, mustard, dates, paprika, and taco seasoning in a small bowl. Place egg whites in a separate shallow bowl using a metal spoon. Mix cornstarch roux into the egg whites, about 1 tablespoon at a time, until mixture begins to hold stiff peaks. Stir about 1/2 of the egg whites into the batter to lighten the whites. Continue to stir in the remaining egg whites, scraping any yellow or brown bits from the sides of the bowl. Bake muffins in the preheated oven until tops are nicely firm and muffins are deep golden brown, about 15 minutes, then remove from oven.

title: Fiery Tomatoes (Beefsteak and Tomato)
ingredients: 3 -4 large ripe beefsteak tomatoes ( sliced thinly or sliced in half ) | fennel seed, lightly crushed | 1 stalk fresh celery, sliced thinly
instructions: Using a sharp knife or mandolin slice the tomatoes very thinly. Place a tomato half slice on the bottom of each slice of tomato. Sprinkle the fennel seed over the tomatoes and then place the slices of celery over the tomatoes. Wrap a toothpick around the edge, tie with kitchen string and hang slowly over a bowl for 1 hour. Leave for a further 1/2 to 1 hour before eating.

title: Raspberry Minted Pork Roast!
ingredients: 1 lb fresh raspberries or 1 lb frozen raspberries | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork butt, tied at intervals with kitchen twine | 1 tablespoon yoghurt | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 2 teaspoons chili flakes
instructions: Combine the mint and thyme in a mortar, add pork and pound well. Place pork in an ovenproof dish. Place in a medium preheated oven, 200°c, for 30 to 40 minutes or until cooked through. Combine yoghurt, white pepper and the chilli flakes in a small bowl, stir well. Ladle pork into a jug and stir to combine, then pour over a little yoghurt mixture to finish. Transfer to a preheated serving dish or plates. Surround with raspberries and sprinkle with mint sprigs. Serve with roasted raspberries and drizzled with mint sauce.

title: Rigatoni Con Pollo (Rigatoni Pasta With Chicken and Turkey)
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1 lb raw chicken and turkey
instructions: Heat a large pot of water to boiling. Add pasta and cook till al dente. While pasta is cooking cut the raw chicken into chunks and cook in the hot sauce till the pieces are cooked and the skin on the outside is crisp.

title: Apple and Coriander Powder
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg apples | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh coriander powder
instructions: Peel apples and cut into thin wedges using a special mandolin. Remove core, cut in half and scoop out the cores with your finger. Place apples in a deep glass. Sprinkle with coriander and sprinkle over some coarsely ground black pepper. Place in low oven and set aside for about 8 hours or until apples are cooked. Serve with pappadums or any curry leaves. Store in a covered container.

Random Ingredients: white wine,peanut butter,cheddar cheese,ranch dressing,meat,black sesame seed,apricot,sauerkraut
title: Sauerkraut Salad
ingredients: 1 lb dried apricot, halved | 3/4 cup peanut butter | 2/3 cup ranch dressing | 2/3 cup dry white wine | 1 can sauerkraut, undrained | 1 lb smoked meat | 2 teaspoons black sesame seeds | 2/3 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: In large mixing bowl, combine apricots, peanut butter and ranch dressing, stirring until smooth. Stir in wine, sauerkraut and remaining ingredients except cheddar. Cover and chill several hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,grape leaf,green cardamom pod,curd cottage cheese,tamari
title: Grape Leaf Rollups(Chilling for Kala Chai)
ingredients: 1 cup small curd cottage cheese | 3 tablespoons green cardamom pods, crushed | 3 tablespoons tamari, spice | 1 pinch splenda sugar substitute | 2 -6 fresh small spring roll leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 degrees celsius or slightly lower. Line a tray with aluminium foil and place a large piece of clingfilm in it to make a lid. Take a small spoon and push the cap of a grape leaf and a little of the tamari spice into the center. Place the spring roll leaves on it so that it fits the mould easily. Fill the middle with the cottage cheese mixture.

title: Mexican Style Garlic Pesto
ingredients: 1 bunch flat leaf parsley | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Wash, pat dry and remove the stalk and leaves from the parsley if damaged. Slice the parsley into thin strips. Combine the parsley strips with the chili powder and store in the refrigerator until needed.

title: Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 6 ounces sugar snap peas | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 2 large eggs, lightly beaten
instructions: Steam the peas for a minute or two, until just crisp tender. Run a knife around the pan to loosen the peas, and slice across the grain into bite size pieces. Toss with desired amount of prepared syrup.

title: Horseshoes
ingredients: 2 lbs jumbo shrimp | 1 1 cup cranberry sauce, bottled
instructions: Place shrimp in a large baking dish or bowl. Mix the cranberry sauce and spread over shrimps. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes or until shrimp are just firm. Serve with your favourite greens.

title: Guacamole Dip
ingredients: 4 ripe avocados, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup grated cheese ( i used cheddar or a combination of both ) | 1/2 - 1 cup sour cream | 1/4 - 1/2 cup tomato puree ( or a bit more ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/4 cup water | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 -2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/3 cup grated cheese ( optional )
instructions: In medium mixing bowl mash together avocados, cheese, sour cream, tomato puree, sherry, water, balsamic vinegar, and lemon pepper. Transfer to bowl and place in refrigerator to meld flavors. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,lima bean,plain flour,bicarbonate soda,salad oil,turkey breast
title: Mama Bennions Turkey Fritters
ingredients: 400 g plain flour | 125 g mixed salad oil | 125 g turkey breast, chopped | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 125 g frozen lima beans or 125 g frozen curd beans | 1/8 cup yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Put the flour in a bowl. Make a well in the middle. Add the oil, turkey, and bicarbonate soda. Fold through the beans and then stir in the yogurt if using. Drop the fritters into the hot mixture, a few at a time. Cook to your liking.

title: Kielbasa, Red Curry Bread & Kielbasa Appetizers
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread | 1 -2 lb kielbasa, cooked, cut into 1/2 inch pieces ( spicy ) | 1 cup half-and-half | 2 -3 tablespoons red curry paste ( kikkoman curry paste )
instructions: Prepare the slaw using the instructions on the packaged mix it with the half and half and red curry paste. Cut the bread into 1 inch thick slices and arrange them on serving plates. Arrange the kielbasa meat over the bread and pour the curry mixture over all.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,hoagie,chili powder,mango,leg lamb,spring onion,canadian bacon
title: Grilled Lamb Sandwiches With Mango and Spicy Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs leg of lamb | 3 -5 slices canadian bacon ( thin slices ) or 3 -5 slices of lean maple bacon ( thin slices ) | 1/2 cup canadian bacon, chopped finely or 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 tablespoon chili powder ( or more if you like spice ) | 2 tablespoons spring onions, chopped finely or 1 teaspoon dried spring onion, flakes | haggis ( optional )
instructions: Trim fat from lamb. Slice lamb on 1/8 inch thickness. Grill lamb on preheated grill for 15 - 15 minutes per 500g degree oven or until juices are clear. Meanwhile, stir canadian bacon into remaining ingredients. Cover and chill for several hours or for up to 12 hours. Remove lamb from grill. Place lamb on cutting board, cut it across the grain in very thin slices. Cover with warmed bacon mixture. Add any additional toppings if desired. Cover with a heated oven proof serving dish, such as a large pan of hot coals or steamers. Bake at 150 150°c/375°f for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Turn off oven and let it sit. Cut into thick slices across the grain.

title: Aubergine
ingredients: 1 -2 eggplant, sliced lengthwise | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 ounces feta cheese | feta cheese, crumbles ( optional ) | chopped fresh dill ( optional )
instructions: Fry eggplant in lots of oil in frying pan until limp, about 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Mushroom and Lavender Pate
ingredients: 25 g porcini mushrooms or 25 g other mixed dried mushrooms | 225 g flat leaf parsley | 225 g of fresh mint leaves ( not dried ) | 25 g cognac or 25 g dry white wine
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender or food processor and process until smooth. Transfer to a glass bowl or an airtight jar and refrigerate overnight.

title: Cumin Seeds
ingredients: 4 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Rinse seeds with a strainer and place in a small baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 5 minutes. Cool and grind them in a spice grinder with a little water. Or put them in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Add some water if needed. Store in an air tight jar.

title: Lemongrass Lemongrass Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces lemongrass, sliced in 3-inch lengths | 6 cups heavy whipping cream ( whipping cream may be substituted ) | 1 tablespoon tamari | 6 ounces dry curds ( or soy yogurt ) | 1/4 cup lemongrass, minced ( use fresh lemongrass if not available )
instructions: Wine reduction, place 6 cups of water and 6 tbspn of lemon grass in a 1 quart saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to 1/6 inch. Simmer for 40 minutes.

title: Tami Chicken Rollups
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded turkey tenderloins ( or equivalent amount of cooked chicken breasts ) | 1 package cream cheese | 1/4 tamari
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and roll into 1 inch balls. Put on baking sheet and bake at 375f for 15 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Kerevartoffel
ingredients: 2 ounces broad egg noodles | 8 ounces lean ground lamb
instructions: Boil the noodles in plenty of water for 5 minutes drain and put back into the pot, with the lamb. Cook very slowly, stirring, until the noodles have given off a lot of water. It should be thick, creamy sauce. Season with pepper to taste, and serve over some freshly baked bread.

title: Easy Black Beans and Zucchini
ingredients: 1 can black beans or ( 16 ounce ) can romano beans, drained and rinsed | 1 small yellow zucchini, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 red new mexico chile, deseeded and thinly sliced ( or other jalapeno ) | 1 stalk celery, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain beans well. Add black beans and zucchini. Toss well to combine. Cook vegetables on medium low in a non stick skillet. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender, stirring frequently. When vegetables are tender, remove skillet from heat and serve immediately.

title: Easy Tuna Fish Ceviche
ingredients: 200 g tuna, drained, flaked, fresh not canned if canned | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and stir well with a fork to blend.

title: Spicy Baby Carrots & Onions (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 21)
ingredients: 1 lb medium potato, washed, peeled and each cut into 3cm lengths ( about 4 ) | 1 large spanish onion, sliced thinly ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried herbs ( such as sage, thyme, rosemary, savory or oregano ) | 3 cups baby carrots, cleaned and cut diagonally into 3cm lengths
instructions: Place the potato and onion in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil and simmer until just tender, about 10 to 15 minutes drain, cool, then transfer to a large bowl. Add the olive oil, rice vinegar, herbs and carrots to the potato/onion mixture and stir to combine. Season to taste.

title: Sorrel Sauce
ingredients: 5 ounces sorrel | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 2 tablespoons shallots, minced | 1 pinch saffron thread, crushed
instructions: Combine sorrel, salsa vermouth, shallots and saffron. Makes enough sauce to coat back of spoon.

title: Barbecue Asparagus, Italian Style
ingredients: 2 medium spears fresh asparagus, trimmed to 4 - 5 inches in length | 3 drops tabasco sauce, to taste | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves or 1 teaspoon fresh oregano
instructions: Trim all woody ends from the asparagus and cut into 2 inch lengths. Place asparagus in medium glass bowl with tabasco. Toss gently. Sprinkle with oregano and toss again. Coat grill rack coated with cooking spray and place asparagus on the rack. Grill until tender, about 5 - 6 minutes. Turn asparagus halfway through grilling and press with tongs or spatula to break apart. Serve warm. Enjoy.

title: Chinese Style Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 packages coleslaw | 1 bottle of your favorite hot pepper sauce | 2 boxes macaroni, cooked
instructions: Place the coleslaw in a casserole dish. Pour the entire contents of 1 bottle of hot pepper sauce over the coleslaw and stir in. Cook until desired doneness. Add the macaroni just before serving.

title: Moroccan Baps
ingredients: 2 cups self rising flour | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon thyme leave
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c. Mix all ingredients together. Knead lightly on floured surface. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Spread out mixture on baking sheet. Mark tops of biscuits with a fork. Cook in oven for 15 minutes, turn, cook for another 5 minutes or until golden and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: green bean,olive oil,nonfat milk powder,bacon bit
title: Creamy German Green Beans
ingredients: 1 package frozen green beans | 1/2 cup low-fat bacon bits | 1 1/2 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: In a saucepan, combine beans and enough water to cover. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: radish,pecan half,vegetable oil,flour tortilla,baby carrot,cherry tomato
title: Cheapy Vegetable Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed baby carrots | 1 cup quartered cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 8 small flour tortillas or 7 -8 small corn tortillas | vegetable oil, for frying | 1 tablespoon unbleached flour | 1 teaspoon ground mixed arabic herbs or 2 teaspoons crushed dried cherries
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the carrots and cook for a few minutes more. Drain and let cool. Peel carrots using a peeler and cut carrots into thin strips. Wash them well under cold water and set aside. Drain the carrots and pat them dry. Dip the tortillas or corn tortillas in the oil and set them on paper towels to drain of any excess oil. Heat just enough oil to cover the bottom of a deep fryer. Take one tortilla and dip it into the hot oil briefly, then fry on each side until golden. If the tortilla is torn out of the oil, use two forks. Remove from the oil and place on paper towels to drain. When you take the tortillas out of the oil, place them in a bowl with a bit of oil to keep them soft. Place the lettuce leaves into the bowl with the tortillas and mix well. Spoon the veggie mixture into the center of one tortilla and top with a few cherry tomatoes or crushed cherry tomatoes. Add the other tortilla and pinch closed with the toothpicks. Repeat with the vegetables and toothpicks until all the vegetables, etc are used, are filled. When your fried tortillas are finished, stack them in a warm bowl and serve. The burritos can be stored in the refrigerator.

title: Mint and Fennel Taquitos
ingredients: 1 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon dried mint, divided | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 3 corn tortillas
instructions: Mix sugar, mint, and half teaspoon of celery salt together in a bowl add tortillas and toss to coat completely. Heat a 10 inch skillet over hot guisado on the stove top. Roll up two tortillas to make a triangle. Fry in the hot pan, turning once to cook both sides. Store tortillas to cool. Heat remaining sugar and celery salt over low heat until syrupy, about 10 minutes.

title: Striped Spinach Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach | 1 cup dry red wine
instructions: Wash and dry spinach. Place in a colander. Cover with fresh water. Tie with kitchen string and place in the sink. Bring to a boil over medium high heat and cook 5 minutes. Drain. Toss with wine to coat. Serve.

title: Huitlacuse - Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 8 -10 large chicken leg quarters | 12 -16 ounces tomato puree | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 12 large portabella mushrooms | 3 carrots, 1 inch thick | 1 medium tomatoes | 8 -10 large broccoli | 10 hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Wash, peel, and cut the chicken legs into 1 - ½ to 2 - ½ inch squares. Place the chicken legs and tomato puree in a medium sized saucepan. Add horseradish, and bring to a boil until liquid is reduced to half. Add mushrooms and turn off the heat. Place fish on metal grill in the saucepan and grill for about 7 minutes on each side until the chicken is cooked through. Remove fish and cool slightly. Slice onion and mushroom slices. Remove skin from the tomatoes and puree using immersion blender or vinaigrette. Wash, peel and coarsely chop the broccoli. Place the broccoli in a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. Add to the mixture along with the nuts and tomato puree. Cover and refrigerate the tomato mixture for several hours or overnight. Cooking time will vary depending on how thick your mushrooms are.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,extra virgin olive oil,prosciutto,orange,vanilla bean
title: Pissaladiere Du Terre Lyonnaise
ingredients: 1 whole vanilla beans, split lengthwise | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 ripe orange, cut into wedges | 2 slices prosciutto, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 bouquet garni, or other dried bouquet garni
instructions: Split the vanilla beans using a sharp knife, and make sure they scrape out any seeds or juices inside of the vanilla bean pods. Heat 2 teaspoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat, and cook the scrapings in hot oil until browned, about 2 minutes. Stir the orange wedges into the skillet, and fry for 1 minute, then turn the pieces over. Add the prosciutto and bouquet garni, and cook until they are tender and hot, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, and transfer the skillet to a serving dish. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,snow pea,caster sugar,white bread flour,bay seasoning,beef stew meat,bouillon cube,celery rib
title: Sticky Beef With Snow Pea Breading
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 2cm pieces | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 bouillon cube, dissolved in | 60 ml beef broth | 1 slice white bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1 teaspoon french onion soup | 200 g snow peas | 2 celery ribs, cut into 5cm pieces
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except snow peas and celery, in a large oven proof casserole dish or stew pot. Cover and shake to combine. Arrange meat on top, cover and bake in a moderate oven for 2 - 2 1/2 hours, until meat changes colour. Add peas and celery during the last 30 minutes. If using stew meat, stir through.

Random Ingredients: green tomato,panir,black soy sauce,yellow squash,chocolate,pasta sauce,large shrimp
title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black soy sauce | 4 tablespoons panir, cubed | 2 tablespoons sweet potato noodles or 2 tablespoons yellow squash, cubes | 4 tablespoons chocolate square | 1 green tomatoes, diced | 1/2 cup pasta sauce ( or your favorite pasta sauce ) | 1 box large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Pour about 2/3 cup of the pasta sauce into a large non stick skillet. Place panir over medium heat and stir. When the cubes of cheese have begun to release their natural color, add the shrimp. Brown the shrimp and shrimp for about 2 minutes on each side. Add chocolate squares to the pan with oil. Stir the mixture together until melted cheese has begun to melt. Add the tomatoes and green salsa. Add the pasta to the pan and stir to coat. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,tea,garlic clove,red food coloring,bay leaf,graham cracker crumb,extra beef
title: Beef Balls in Broth
ingredients: 6 ounces extra lean ground beef | 1/4 cup pico de gallo ( may sub other favorite hot sauce ) | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon dried red food coloring | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 2 bay leaves | 2 teaspoons instant tea
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the beef, pico de gallo, cracker crumbs, food coloring, garlic, and bay leaves. With wet hands, shape the mixture into 1 inch balls. Set aside 15 minutes or refrigerate at least 30 minutes until fully cold. Meanwhile, in a small pot, bring water to a boil. Place the meat balls in the pot, and cook for 2 - 4 minutes. Remove balls with a slotted spoon, and place onto a cutting board. Ladle the cooking liquid into a bowl, and stir in tea. Serve warm.

title: Green Fruit Curry With Hazelnuts and Ginger
ingredients: 500 g mixed dried fruits | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 piece ginger | 50 g hazelnuts | 50 g peaches or 50 g pears, pared | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 500 g bok choy or 500 g greens
instructions: Cut the fruit in small chunks using a blender or mandolin. Toast the coriander and ginger over a medium heat until fragrant. Add the nuts and allow to fry briefly. Add the pears and coriander. Grind the spices lightly, taking care to leave a little moisture. Transfer to a blender and add the oil. Pulse until the mixture is smooth, add some water if necessary and process again. To serve, place the greens on a serving platter with the curry. Place the curry on the table.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,half,ginger garlic paste,hot green chili pepper,mace,garlic clove,vanilla extract,saltine cracker
title: Pork Cracklins
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cubed ( or use pork tenderloin ) | 5 garlic cloves, chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 hot green chili peppers, chopped | saltines crackers ( optional ) | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Cut pork into 1 inch chunks and discard fat. Place in a 3 cup glass bowl and sprinkle with chopped ginger garlic paste, green chili peppers and saltines.

title: Cherimoya Beans Sprout
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans with their liquid thawed | 2 tablespoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons peach liqueur | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f combine bread crumbs, 3 tablespoons of the liqueur, and cilantro. Spray pam and 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place bean sprouts in the baking dish, then spoon over the bread crumbs. Bake for 45 minutes, or until bubbly. Serve and enjoy.

title: Lazy Limas
ingredients: 6 -8 medium frozen lima beans | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Put limas into a saucepan with water to cover. Bring water to boil, and when boiling, reduce heat and simmer slowly until limas are just tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. Place all ingredients into a large dish. Mix well. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator at least 3 hours, or overnight.

title: Hot Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 50 g sweet roasted cashews | 1 packet chicken-style dry tea leaves ( such as maggi ) | 250 g dried egg noodles | 500 g chinese mushrooms, sliced into thin | 4 egg whites, lightly beaten
instructions: Put all the dry ingredients into a large mixing bowl, mix well and add the egg whites. Heat a large non stick frying pan, spray it lightly with sunflower or cooking oil, pour in the egg mixture. After the egg starts to set on the top, put the lid on the pan. Cook for 10 minutes or until the lid starts to go light brown.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,ginger garlic paste,flour tortilla,chicken wing,cornstarch,oregano,tabasco sauce
title: Easy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 quart chicken wings | 1 fresh lime, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dried oregano, crushed | tabasco sauce, a few drops | 8 small corn tortillas
instructions: Combine ingredients for marinade in saucepan and bring to a boil. Add chicken wings and cook 5 - 8 minutes, turning often. Place in refrigerator and marinate 10 minutes. Grill until done. Serve with tortillas.

title: Hot Apple Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs apples, peeled, cored and diced | 8 cups meat stock | 1 dried chilies, soaked ( optional )
instructions: Place the apples in a large heavy saucepan, add water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook until tender, about 1 hr. Remove the apples from water and place them in a food processor or mash until smooth. Add the stock and chilies to the soup, season to taste with salt and pepper and simmer for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,roasting chicken,serrano pepper,oregano leaf,bulk pork sausage
title: Real Italian Sausage or Chorizo
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens or 1 other large white turkey | 1/2 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 1 ounce dried chorizo bulk pork sausage or 1 ounce smoked chorizo sausage, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, loosely packed | 2 teaspoons minced fresh serrano peppers, or to taste
instructions: Rinse the chicken well under warm running water to remove any sand and dirt.

title: Black Olive and Chickpea Breakfast Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup black olives, coarsely chopped | 1 can chickpeas, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped | 2 whole wheat tortillas | 1/4 cup barley flour
instructions: To make the filling, put the chickpeas, 1/2 of the chopped cilantro, and the chopped black olives into a medium sized bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste, and mash them together with your hands til the mixture becomes smooth and creamy. Toast the tortillas, about 20 seconds on each side in a medium size pan. Drain the tortillas on paper towels and sprinkle them with flour, about a tablespoon at a time.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,pasta,sharp cheddar cheese,yeast,arugula,dark beer,pepper sauce,chicken bouillon cube
title: Irish Art Cheddar Pizza
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked bread ( i prefer artisan bread ) | 4 tablespoons dry yeast | 1/2 - 1 cup dark beer | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 1/2 teaspoons pepper sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( i like hot sauce or tabasco, depending how hot you want it ) | 1 tart apple | 1/2 head arugula | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Dissolve yeast in beer. Add 1 1/2 cups bread and enough flour to make a soft dough, adding 1 teaspoon of flour if needed. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead briefly. Return dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover and let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour or until doubled. Punch dough down, knead it a couple times, and roll it out on a lightly floured surface. Slice up the crust, and place it on a pizza pan. Spread crust with the apple slices. Distribute the arugula over the arugula. Spread dough with cheese. Bake in a 400 degree oven for 12 - 14 minutes or until crust is golden brown and cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,vinegar,bailey irish cream,kaffir lime leaf,rom tomato,grand marnier,self rising flour,orange bell pepper
title: Sweet Onion Pizza Slice
ingredients: 1 egg-free self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 tablespoon orange bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, finely chopped, for garnish | 2 tablespoons vinegar, for drizzling | 2 tablespoons baileys irish cream, for garnishing
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c / fan 160c / gas line a 26cm x 18cm slice tin with baking parchment, or line with baking paper. In a bowl mix all dry ingredients together in a separate bowl mix all other incredients together. Fold egg/flour mixture in with dry ingredients just until well combined. Bake in oven for 10 minutes, or until golden brown and a tester comes out clean. Drizzle with Baileys and leave to set, then drizzle over hot caramel topping or serve with your favourite fruit topping.

title: Asparagus With Rice and Basmati (Mujadarra) (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs asparagus ( ends trimmed and cut in 1-inch pieces ) | 1 cup basmati rice
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Asparagus should be just tender and bright green. Boil for 3 to 5 minutes. Reserve 2 inches of asparagus cooking water in bowl or measuring cup. In the meantime, heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add asparagus, reduce heat to medium. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 6 to 9 minutes, or until rice kernels turn light brown. Stir in 1 cup water, rice and reserved asparagus. Heat through, then serve or refrigerate until cold. Enjoy.

title: Currant Jelly
ingredients: 50 g shredded thai basil | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 50 g dried currants | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Place all of the ingredients into a heat proof jelly pan. Stir well. Stir to combine. Cover and leave to stand over slow heat for two hours or until jelly is thick and syrupy.

title: Green Salad With Apple and Yogurt
ingredients: 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 3/4 cup salsa | 3 tablespoons shredded lemon peel | 2 lbs mixed baby greens | 1 cup finely chopped apple | 1/2 cup finely chopped sweet onion ( such as vidalia )
instructions: To prepare the salad, mix all the ingredients gently but thoroughly. Toss with the salad greens to taste.

Random Ingredients: paprika,plain yogurt,kalamata olive,red capsicum,collard green,aleppo pepper
title: Collard Greens
ingredients: 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1/2 teaspoon aleppo pepper | 2 2 lbs fresh collard greens or 2 lbs frozen collard greens, chopped | 3/4 cup yellow curd plain yogurt | 3 small red capsicums ( capsicum ) | 4 -6 pitted kalamata olives, sliced
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients in a nonreactive bowl, cover, and refrigerate. Add remaining ingredients to the choped collard greens, stirring to coat. Place the greens in a steamer or over boiling water, cover, and steam over high heat, turning once, until greens are hot.

title: Nancy's Salmon Pie
ingredients: 2 pounds prepared graham cracker crust | 4 pounds salmon fillets | 1 cup chili paste | 4 cups chopped nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange 1 piece of salmon in the bottom of the graham cracker crust. Repeat layering with remaining pieces of the salmon and fillings. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tortellini,vanilla essence,grape leaf,iceberg lettuce,plum tomato,beef chuck
title: Aussie Beef Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces cooked beef chuck | 3/4 pint grape leaves ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/2 pint tostitos scooped out small pickled grape leaves | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 ripe plum tomatoes, cut into wedges | 4 1/2 ounces fresh tortellini ( cooked ) or 4 1/2 ounces other pastas | cramp iceberg lettuce, to serve
instructions: Combine the beef, grape leaves, tinned tomatoes, and tortellini in a large bowl. Mix well. Spoon the prepared beef mixture onto the beef leaves and roll up each leaf to enclose the filling. Serve with freshly grated parmesan cheese and a light salad.

Random Ingredients: purpose white flour,chinese five spice powder,sauerkraut,bacon dripping,blueberry,orange marmalade,bamboo shoot
title: Sauerkraut-Blueberry Biscuits
ingredients: 1 jar sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 3 cans sauerkraut, drained | 2 2 tablespoons bacon drippings or 2 tablespoons ghee | 3 cups all-purpose white flour | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 1/2 cups blueberries ( approx. 1 pound ) | 3 tablespoons orange marmalade
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f mix bacon grease or ghee into flour until absorbed and mix in seasonings. Add vinegar and mix well. Press mixture into an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Divide mixture evenly into 24 equal parts. Add blueberries, to each half and roll into a log. Cut into 1 inch slices. Place on cookie sheet and bake approximately 15 - 20 minutes, until lightly browned and crispy on the edges.

title: Peachy Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 boneless pork roast, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 2 medium red potatoes, scrubbed | 2 cans slices peach, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a roasting pan over medium heat, combine pork, corn, potatoes and peaches.

Random Ingredients: strawberry jam,arbol chile,brown rice,cocoa powder,rose essence,beef bouillon cube,liver pate
title: Chiles Stuffed With Rice, Beef Pate & Honey
ingredients: 1 lb liver pate | 4 cups cooked brown rice | 1 teaspoon dried rose essence | 8 ounces cow bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup cocoa powder | 4 tablespoons strawberry jam | 3 -4 dried arbol chiles
instructions: Soak dried chiles in hot water so they are soft. Drain any excess water. Remove stem from chili pods and slit them lenghtwise so they open. Mix rice, beef bouillon cubes, rose essence and cocoa powder. Fill each chili with meat mixture, and secure with toothpicks. Place stuffed chili in a lightly greased ovenproof bowl and bake in a preheated 375f oven for about 20 minute.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,jalapeno pepper,seasoning salt,yeast,beef gravy
title: Real Spanish Beef for Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package yeast | 3 lbs top round beef gravy, warm | 2 cups white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pickled jalapeno peppers ( do not drain! ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: In the bowl of a medium heavy bottomed saucepan, combine the beef gravy, vinegar, jalepenos, seasoned salt and white wine vinegar and stir to combine. Cover, and refrigerate for several hours or up to 24 hours. Transfer to the refrigerator 24 hours before cooking to allow the flavors to blend. Heat oven to 425 degrees f and grease or line baking sheets with parchment paper. Drain off the water. Make a well in the center of the gravy mixture with the flour and add the yeast. Stir to mix. Place the dough in the pan and turn the dough over in the center several times. Cover with lukewarm water and allow the dough to rise, about 90 minutes. Oil a heavy 5 quart baking dish. Turn bread upside down. Working with 3 pieces at a time, carefully place the dough into the oiled baking dish. Let rise to double in size, 3 to 4 minutes. Sprinkle the top with paprika. Bake 25 minutes or until the bread is lightly browned.

title: Swedish Caramel Cream
ingredients: 1 cup cooking oil | 2 cups heavy whipping cream, whipped
instructions: Heat frying pan on medium high. Carefully begin pouring in the oil and swirl around constantly. When all the oil is incorporated, increase the temperature to high until it begins to smoke. Pour in the whipping cream, and stir continuously. When cream begins to foam, it will be thin enough to coat the back of spoon. Pour mixture into a metal bowl, cool slightly, then refrigerate until the cream is ready, 1 to 2 hours.

title: Amaretto Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 lb fresh snow pea, trimmed | 1 medium head cabbage, cored and sliced
instructions: Steam snow peas over boiling water for 2 minutes or until crisp tender. Place cabbage and snow peas in a large mixing bowl. Toss to coat evenly with dressing. Sprinkle with reserved slaw.

title: Anchovy Baked Beets
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 pound small beets, scrubbed | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon lard
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Place beets in a microwave safe dish with water sloshy close to the water. Cook in the preheated oven, turning occasionally, until tender and starting to brown, 25 to 30 minutes. Drain. When cool enough to handle, peel, and cut each into 2 pieces. Set aside. Place anchovy paste and lard in a bowl and mash together. Stir beet mixture into paste.

title: Beef and Bread Burger
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 1/2 loaf crusty italian bread | 1 teaspoon kosher salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius heat a pan of olive oil in the oven. When hot and starting to sizzle, add mince and brown on all sides. Season well with salt and pepper. Put bread on kitchen towel and rub over with olive oil and then put under grill. Take care as the bread can burn easily. Serve with a burger or bolognaise sauce alongside.

title: Blueberry Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts | 1 kg beef roast | 2 slices pork loin | 1/2 liter fresh blueberries | 1 lemon grass | 2 teaspoons ground lemongrass | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients for the basting sauce together and place into the fridge for an hour or more to allow flavors to combine. Remove mixture from fridge and set aside until needed. Slice the breasts. Take out most of the inner part of each breast half, leaving just enough to wrap over the top, and place it into a roasting tin or baking dish that has been covered with foil. Pour the basting sauce into the tin or dish, placing the chicken breast on top of the sauce. The basting sauce will be used as a dipping sauce for the roast. Wrap each chicken breast in a slice of pork loin, securing the ends with kitchen string. Spoon some basting sauce over the chicken breast, ensuring that the pork has a good coating of sauce on each piece. Top with blueberries over the top and pop in the oven on 200ºc for approximately 35 - 40 minutes, or until browned.

Random Ingredients: nutella,ricotta cheese,arbol chile,beef chuck,apple,chicken bouillon cube
title: Apple-Ricotta Beef Chili
ingredients: 1 beef chuck, 3/4 pound | 6 tablespoons fat-free ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons fat-free fat-free fat-free berry dip or 2 tablespoons apple-flavored gelatin | fresh arbol chile, minced ( optional ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 apple, cored and diced | roasted nuts ( optional ) or plain yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large nonstick saucepan over medium heat. Add ground chuck and brown, breaking up with a wooden spoon as it cooks, 2 minutes per side. Add ricotta cheese and berry dip. Cook until combined, stirring frequently, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in chiles. Transfer mixture to slow cooker. Add diced apple and nuts and process until smooth, 10 to 15 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in broth if to spicy. Cover and cook on low 5 to 6 hours.

title: Chipotle Mushroom Appetizer
ingredients: 12 -15 mushroom stems, cleaned and dried on a dehydrator ( i get them from costco for about $ 7-8 pans from the deli ) | 1 -2 chipotle chiles ( or more depending on how much you want to go with it. i use about 2 or 2 and they are all good )
instructions: Dry off mushrooms and discard stems. Place stems in your dehydrator. Add a small to medium sized frying pan. Put the chipotle chiles in and grill them over medium low heat until they are popping or popping lightly and have a little bit of chile showing which they are sweet. Remove peppers from the oven, take a handful of mushrooms and smash them up with a fork. Add them back to the pan and sprinkle a small amount of chipotle chiles over them. They do not need to be completely covered. Place the dried mushrooms onto a baking sheet and place them in the freezer in a freezer bag for about an hour or two. After they have chilled in the freezer, slice them open and remove the stems and throw away the stems, saving the stems for another use. They can be frozen for about a week, thaw and then use in your recipe. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,mozzarella cheese,kaffir lime leaf,cardamom seed,thyme sprig,brown rice,iceberg lettuce
title: Indian Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 cups cooked brown rice | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef roast, sliced into thin strips | 4 frozen kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | fresh thyme sprig | 12 cardamom seeds | iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. In a 1 1/2 quart baking tray spread out the browned rice. Layer the shredded cheese and sliced meat over the rice. Spray a large heavy nonstick skillet with cooking spray and place over medium heat. Quickly crack cardamom pods into the skillet, then toss the pods in the oil. Sear the beef about 4 - 5 minutes per side. Add the lime leaves in the last minute. Remove from heat. Place 1 bag of iceburg lettuce leaves in each leaf, then tear into strips. Fill the lettuce leaves with the meat. Wrap the meat loaf tightly in the lettuce leaves and secure with toothpicks. Place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Apricot Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot, drained
instructions: Mix together the breadcrumbs, salsa, apricots, and crumbs. Refrigerate in an airtight container for two hours. Serve with your favorite vegetable side dishes.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,chicken thigh,tilapia fillet,kaffir lime leaf,pasta shell,chili pepper flake,tart apple,red potato
title: Lily Kwok's Thai Fish Stew
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets or 4 sirloin steaks, 4 ounces each | 2 medium red potatoes, cleaned and cut into 2 1/2 inches thick bite size cubes or | 6 -8 medium red potatoes or | 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons sambhoon chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons hot red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | pasta shell | 3 -4 kaffir lime leaves, torn into small pieces ( for garnish ) | 1 tart apple, peeled cored and cut into thin wedges ( for garnish ) or ( 6 inch ) can mandarin oranges ( for garnish )
instructions: Heat a large frying pan or wok over medium heat. Cut out and discard any muscle attached to the meat, and cut the meat into 3/4 inch cubes. Brown the potatoes in the frying pan or wok. Add the meat with the potato pieces and cook on medium heat, stirring constantly, for another 4 - 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Meanwhile, make the chili paste. Place the hot pepper flakes into a small bowl. Drain the water from the kaffir lime leaves.

title: Ginger Bean Paste
ingredients: 14 ounces fresh ginger, peeled, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces dried beans | 1 cup fresh orange blossom water
instructions: Put the ginger pieces in a mortar with 2 oz of fresh orange blossom water. Pound the ginger until fine. Add 3 tablespoons of the ginger paste and pound it again until smooth. Put the beans in a food processor or blender and grind to consistency of fine paste. Pour the paste into a sterilized jar. Add the remaining ginger paste and any orange blossom water. Cover with plastic wrap and leave in the fridge for 2 or 3 days before using. Use as directed in moroccan recipes or with other dishes or bread.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,veal shank,vegetable broth,spaetzle noodle,tomato juice,mustard,cinnamon
title: Zurie's Swiss Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon fresh ground mustard | 2 small veal shanks | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 leaves spasetzle noodles
instructions: In a large skillet over medium low heat, combine the broth, mustard, and fennel seed. Bring to a simmer.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,cream milk,cherry tomato,jicama,rye bread,range chicken
title: Mama-Meeta's Creamy Jicama Filled Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 3/4 lb free-range chicken | 8 -10 ounces sour cream or 8 -10 ounces plain low-fat sour cream and 2 tablespoons skim milk mixed with 1/4 cup of each | 1 1/2 cups low-fat alfredo sauce | 4 -6 slices rye bread | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes
instructions: Cut the chicken in half. Put the pieces into a mixing bowl with the sour cream, milk/sour cream mix and a sprinkling of salt and pepper. Stir to combine. Add the alfredo sauce. Coat the chicken in mixture. Wrap the chicken in four slices of rye bread. Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Pour enough alfredo sauce into a shallow baking dish on the side you're going to baste your chicken with during the cooking process. Place in the oven and bake at 375° for 10 - 12 minutes or until the chicken is cooked inside and the bread is toasted and bubbly. Top the chicken with cherry tomatoes.

title: Scottish Sauté, Lamb Shank & Whipped Cream
ingredients: 1 lamb shank, in loose skin ( for around 10 days at room temperature ) | 250 ml whipping cream
instructions: The usual method, the shank is to cut it into 4 slices. Then cut off either side of the thick fat that covers the meat. This is best done at about 1 - 3 times it will help keep the meat moist. It is possible to have the hanging strips of lamb hanging from the outside of the shank. Using a sharp knife, peel the fat from the shank and discard any trimmings that drain out as much as possible. Cut the slices widthways into around the shank slices from where the fat was hanging from.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,sausage,flat leaf parsley,chinese five spice powder,bamboo skewer
title: Chinese Five-Spice Sausages W- Sausages
ingredients: 4 large sausages, chinese style | 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon finely chopped cilantro | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 bamboo skewer, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and rub mixture over the sausages. Cover the barbecue grill and grill sausages on a moderate heat for about 10 minutes, depending on your grill, turning occasionally, until cooked to your requirements. Serve with rice. To make the extra rub, make a well in the centre of the sausages. Using a teaspoon rub the extra rub into sausages.

title: Spinach With Salsa
ingredients: 1 -2 pasilla chile | 1 bunch spinach, stems removed | 1/2 - 1 cup chili-garlic sauce ( like classico )
instructions: Heat the grill or grill pan. Remove the seeds from the chiles and slice in half in long lengths crosswise. Rinse and cut into large chunks, about the size of a pea. Place the spinach, chili garlic sauce and sliced chile into a large bowl and toss well to thoroughly coat. Spread the spinach mixture on skewers and place on grill. Cook for 15 minutes or until the salsa is warmed through and starting to wilt.

title: Broiled Sirloin
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin, trimmed | 1/2 cup sesame oil | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, crushed | 2 ounces provolone cheese, thinly sliced
instructions: Cut sirloin into 1 inch strips, 3/4 inch x 3 inch wide and 2 to 3 inches long. Combine the oil and fennel seeds, spread over both sides of each strip and layer in a shallow pan. Broil 3 to 5 minutes, turning once until lightly browned. Remove from heat. Preheat broiler. Arrange sirloin strips, overlapping to cover in a single layer. Broil 4 to 5 minutes, turning once, until sirloin is barely rare or registers 160 degrees f. Transfer to a warmed platter and sprinkle with cheese. Serve at once. Note, may be served with noodles or rice.

title: Black-Eyed Peas, Cannellini Primavera and Cherry Pudding
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas | 1 cup heavy cream | 8 ounces maraschino cherries
instructions: Empty the black eyed peas into a saucepan with just enough water in the can to cover it. Cover and cook over low heat until tender, about 40 minutes. Drain and reserve the soaking liquid. In a small saucepan, combine the heavy cream and cherries. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook until mixture is hot but not boiling. Stir the cream mixture into the black eyed peas and cook until heated through. Cool to room temperature if using the refrigerator.

title: Spicy Curried Hummus
ingredients: 2 packages creamy prepared hummus | 2 ounces kahlua | 1/2 tablespoon ground ancho chile pepper | 1 pinch turmeric
instructions: In a small microwave safe bowl or microwavable dish, mix the hummus, kahlua, ground ancho chile pepper, and turmeric. Cook in the microwave or on the stovetop until warm, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tahini,plain breadcrumb,salmon fillet,hard egg,beet,chili pepper flake
title: Baked Salmon Bites
ingredients: 2 cans salmon fillets | 1 bunch fresh beet | 1 pinch of crushed chili pepper flakes | 3 hard-boiled eggs, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup tahini ( sesame seed paste )
instructions: Place the salmon into a pan and cover with water. Bring to the boil and skim off any scum that rises to the surface. Simmer on a medium heat for about 8 minutes. Roughly chop the eggs and add to the beet with the breadcrumbs mix to combine. Season with salt and pepper and mix well. The mixture will be quite wet, so use some gentleness here. Spoon the mixture onto a lightly floured surface and roll into a sausage shape about 12cm long x6cm wide. Repeat with the remaining fillet mixture. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until cooked through and golden brown. Cut the salmon into large cubes and serve with the beet mixture.

title: Easy Chunky Barbecue Sauce

Cut or pull apart into chunks about 1/4 inch wide and 2 inches long. Transfer the chunks to a deep casserole. Preheat grill for medium heat. Place pork on grill, close lid, and cook 15 minutes. instructions: Mix everything together. Serve with hot seafood.

title: Ginger & White Chocolate Sushi

instructions: In a medium sized mixing bowl, stir together greek yogurt, corn starch, nonfat yogurt and sugar. Heat canola oil in a skillet. Roll into sushi sized balls. Cut an x in the top of the sushi to allow steam to escape, and roll the sushi until it is completely covered with a wet, sticky coating. Cut into three or four pieces and serve.

instructions: Soak noodles until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water. In a bowl mix the chipsotches of dry chow mein noodle and the crispy noodle seasoning. Dredge in the crispy noodles and eat.

instructions: In a medium low saucepan boil the half and half and mushrooms for 10 to 15 minutes over medium heat. Meanwhile preheat a griddle or large, heavy skillet. Spread about a tablespoon of the mushroom mixture evenly over the bread. Top with 2 or 3 slices of the soaked bread and 3 or 4 slices of the mushrooms. Top with remaining slices of the bread, making more sandwiches. Pour about a 1/2 tablespoon of taco seasoning over the layered sandwiches. Cover the griddle and cook the sandwiches over medium heat until bottom is lightly browned and the top is golden and crispy. Spread 2 tablespoons of the oyster sauce over the top of one sandwich and another to make a sandwich if desired. To freeze for future use, place in the freezer for about 20 minutes. Slice into 1/4 inch slices and serve immediately.

title: North Croatian Pumpkin Soup (Salat Kufta)
ingredients: 2 lbs winter squash or 2 lbs zucchini, sliced | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 lbs beef tips, cut into bite sized pieces | 2 tablespoons fresh grated romano cheese or 2 tablespoons fresh mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons harissa | 1 tablespoon tuscany seasoning | 1/4 cup dried currant
instructions: Rinse and remove the seeds and fibers from the squash. Cut the squash into 1 inch strips. Mix together with remaining ingredients. Soup can be prepared 2 hours ahead. Serve soup with chopped green and red onion flavored croutons and toasted pita bread.

title: Cherry Bombs (Pistachio Baklava)

instructions: Place a sheet of phyllo in a muffin tin. Place in the freezer until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 400° and position the rack at center. Unwrap and then place 1 phyllo sheet on a flat work surface or counter top. Using a sharp knife snip away the excess phyllo from the base as much as possible. Cut phyllo sheets into 10 equal pieces and stack on a flat work surface. Repeat above steps and transfer sheets to a flat baking sheet. Brush phyllo cookies with melted or pam cooking spray. Bake 10 minutes and remove from oven. Remove and allow phyllo to cool slightly. Remove pistachios from pan and set aside to cool completely. Finely chop pistachios using food processor, chop chilies or jalapeno and combine with cooking spray. Combine dipping sauce with pistachios. Spoon 2 tablespoons into the bottoms of the cooled phyllo cookies. Gently roll phyllo cookies up from the wide end. Place cookies on a baking sheet. Brush tops with the remaining 2 tablespoons of melted dressing or pam cooking spray. Bake 10 minutes or until golden.

title: Gerry's Glute Carrots
ingredients: 1 pint fresh carrot, shredded | 1/3 cup cold water
instructions: Place a cloth on the sides of your kitchen towel and place in the sink. Place the shredded carrot into the strainer and let the liquid drain for 2 to 3 hours. Use the potato's water, or more if necessary, to rinse the carrots.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,farfalle pasta,cake flour,angel hair pasta,cauliflower,rye flour
title: Spaghetti Bolo With Cauliflower and Rye
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 lb rye flour | 1/2 lb cake flour | 1 can pinto beans | 1 lb angel hair pasta
instructions: In a large pot, combine the rye flour with the baking soda, set aside. Pour about 10 or 12 ounces of water into the large pot of salted water, and bring to a boil. Add all the cauliflower florets and stir to coat with the brine. Cook until the cauliflower is just beginning to soften, about 10 to 12 minutes. Then drain and rinse. Rinse beans under cool water and drain well. Combine the flour and cauliflower florets, and mix well with the rye batter on low heat. Continue to stir until all of the ingredients are mixed. Bring to a boil and cook, stirring often, until the farfalle is cooked al dente. Stir in the sauteed drained cauliflower and allow to reduce until all of the liquid has been absorbed, about 5 minutes. Remove to warm deep pasta bowls and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: club soda,red chili,oyster sauce,coffee,red potato,ricotta,red bell pepper
title: Potato & Chilli Mini Cranks
ingredients: 400 g red potatoes, thinly sliced | 120 g creamed coconut | 1 tablespoon roasted red chili, shredded | 1 medium red bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 125 ml club soda | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 200 g ricotta
instructions: Place the sliced potatoes in a large bowl with all the spices, mixing well. Cover and leave to stand for 1 hour. Heat the oven to 200c/gas heat the crumb topping in a frying pan over med heat and add the crumbs and stir quickly until golden brown. Remove from heat and place in the refrigerator for 15 minutes before using. Place a large spoonful of crumbs into a mini muffin tin, pressing the crumb mixture lightly in the tray. Spoon a little of the banana mixture into each crumb hole. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,golden caster sugar,cabbage,chili flake,banana pepper,margarine,cocoa powder,cornmeal
title: Fruit and Cabbage Griddle Rolls  (Cook)
ingredients: 150 g cornmeal | 150 g margarine | 150 g golden caster sugar | 200 g cornstarch | 4 banana peppers, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes ( or less if you want your heat level to be less hot ) | 600 g cabbage, sliced | 1/4 cup cocoa powder | 75 g cremini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Mix cornmeal, margarine, sugar and stir until well combined. Add chillies and cabbage. Stir until well mixed. Heat griddle on medium. When hot, brush with olive oil cooking spray. Brush egg roll sheets with oil and place 1 tablespoon of filling on top of each slice, roll up and place on hot griddle when they start to bubble. Turn griddle and brush oil. Let roll cook until filling is bubbling and golden brown. Serve with your favourite fruit, jam and cinamon or whipped cream.

title: Italian Carrots
ingredients: 8 baby carrots, peeled | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Place carrots, salt, seasoning and dill weed in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, and cover. Reduce heat, and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat, and let stand.

title: Cajun Plantain Roast Chicken
ingredients: 4 large green plantains, peeled and cut into 1-inch slices | 1 cup lemon juice | 2 pounds chicken tenders
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place 2 plantains into a large baking dish. Pour lemon juice over plantains.

title: Koulourakia (Greek Yogurt Filled Dessert)
ingredients: 600 g greek yogurt ( strained, from large curd cheese, strained to remove as much liquid as possible and 'koulourakia') | 1 large egg white | fat ( for shallow frying, for frying, a bit or two )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Place the mixture into a non metallic container. Cover with cling wrap and let sit for an hour. Serve with a bit of your favourite flat bread, for example. Note, if a thinner consistency is desired, a tablespoon of flour can be added to the yogurt before mixing. Koulourakia is traditionally eaten within a day or two, as it will thicken more as absorbed by the yogurt. Note, use as little or no fat as possible, but more yogurt may be needed, or else the mixture may be too thin.

title: Roasted Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade | 2 tablespoons fresh orange marmalade
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Place asparagus on a piece of foil which has been brushed with olive oil. Wrap tightly in the foil. Place asparagus on a baking sheet. Drizzle with marmalade. Roast for about 15 - 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Let cool. When cool, refrigerate until well chilled.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,chili powder,tamari soy sauce,enchilada sauce,vanilla extract,greek yogurt,brown sugar,cottage cheese
title: Healthy Stuffed Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/2 tablespoon chili powder | 1 jar enchilada sauce
instructions: Mix cottage cheese, brown sugar, chili powder, yogurt, tamari, garlic and vanilla extract together. Pour into small saucepan and simmer 2 to 3 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spoon cottage cheese mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon enchilada sauce over cottage cheese mixture in dish. Spread out to edges with a moist cloth or paper towel. Bake about 30 minutes in the preheated oven until light brown.

title: Quick and Easy Flaky Whole Wheat Pastry (Dough Only)
ingredients: 600 g whole wheat pastry flour | 1 1/2 pints cider vinegar
instructions: Heat oven to 150c/gas mix dry ingredients together and roll out. Use as directed in recipe description.

title: Japanese Phyllo Balls
ingredients: 3 packages frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 3 cups ketchup | 3 cups dashi ( japanese-style soup stock )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place a piece of plastic wrap on the work surface and roll the phyllo dough into a rectangle about 30 inches long and 1 inch thick. Layer the phyllo dough in the baking dish as follows, following the phyllo dough layer, pouring a thin layer of ketchup over the top. Lay a third of the phyllo dough in an even layer over the ketchup layer. Use the second phyllo dough over the ketchup layer. Continue building until all of the layered phyllo dough, ketchup, dashi and a second layer of phyllo dough and ketchup as necessary to make two layers. Continue to layer the phyllo dough dough, ketchup, dashi and extra ketchup in this manner, finishing with a phyllo layer. The layered phyllo will yield about 20 sheets. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes, or until the phyllo dough turns a golden brown color.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,cumin,white vinegar,italian salad dressing mix,plain yogurt,amaretto,brandy,currant
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Cumin Yogurt Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix | 1 can plain yogurt | 1/4 cup currants ( optional ) | 14 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 tablespoon grated fresh parmesan cheese or 1 tablespoon pecorino cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Cover tightly and chill in the refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight. To serve, add yogurt to bowl, add dressing mix and toss. Serve with grilled chicken grilled on foreman type bbq.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,cold water,baby green,beef bouillon,picante sauce,feta
title: Picante Green Beef Strips (No Beef)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lean sirloin steak, cut 3/4 in thick | 4 1/2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seed | 1 can reduced sodium beef broth or undiluted beef broth | 1 1/4 cups frozen green giant fresh ceserole picante sauce ( about 1 cup ) | 3 cups cold water | 20 1/2 ounces baby greens
instructions: Trim fat from beef. Cut beef into 2 x 1/2 lengthwise slices. Combine beef, bouillon, anise and 1/2 teaspoons salt. Press 1 1/2 teaspoons on all surfaces of beef. Place beef in heavy nonstick skillet. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoons salt and any remaining salt. Cook and stir over medium high heat until brown edges of beef are browned. Remove beef. Add picante sauce, 1 cup water and 1 cup of greens to skillet.

Random Ingredients: stove stuffing mix,italian plum tomato,cauliflower,baking apple,lemon juice zest,irish cream,feta,confectioner sugar
title: Capside Scrumptious Roasted Caponata
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cauliflower | 1/4 cup sour cream | 3 tablespoons irish cream | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, zest of | 1/2 cup chopped canned cauliflower, drained | 1 package stove top stuffing mix | 4 large baking apples, peeled, cored, quartered | 3/4 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, cauliflower, sour cream, irish cream, lemon juice, cauliflower and stuffing in a large bowl and stir to combine. Place the apples on a baking sheet and bake them at 400 degrees f to toast them. Turn them over now and bake for 30 minutes more. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Barley Mustard Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thigh ( bone in or off cut ) | 1 1/4 cups pearl barley ( fresh or from packet ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 pinch saffron strand | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds ( dark ) | 1 1/4 cups macaroni, cooked
instructions: Pour boiling water over the chicken breast, leave to soak in the fridge for about 25 - 30 minutes. Remove the chicken from the fridge, peel off the skin and roughly chop into bite sized pieces. Place chicken in a casserole dish and sprinkle with the coarsely ground mustard seeds and saffron strand. Add the barley, bring to the boil, then cover and cook in the oven in a medium heat for about 1 1/2 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. Stir the macaroni into the chicken, and leave to soak for 15 minutes until heated through. If you prefer your dish less creamy, return the chicken to the oven at around 160c/375f/gas 4 for 15 minutes. Serve sprinkled fresh chopped parsley on top.

title: Simple Mango Tomato sauce
ingredients: 2 mangoes, peeled, cut in half | 1 cup tomato sauce
instructions: Place mangoes & tomato sauce in blender & puree till smooth. Pour over rice. Serve over your favourite veg.

title: Red Cabbage Mashed Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb ham or 1/2 lb country ham, lean | 1/2 lb red cabbage, cored, cubed | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon red currant jelly | 1/2 lb american cheese, cubed
instructions: Toast ham until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,orange peel,corn chip,purpose flour,dill,cheddar cheese,rosemary
title: Gordita Chicken
ingredients: 9 bone-in chicken legs | 2 large sprigs fresh rosemary, leaves stripped and leaves left on | 1 whole sprig fresh dill, leaves stripped | 1/2 pound grated cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup finely chopped orange peel | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill | 1/4 teaspoon crushed corn chips
instructions: Place chicken legs in a deep pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer, and simmer for 4 to 5 hours or until the legs are cooked through but tender enough to pierce with a fork and the juices run clear. Remove chicken legs from the stock, place in a large bowl, and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Melt cheddar cheese in a bowl in the microwave on high power setting until the cheese has melted and is warm. Stir flour, orange peel, dill and crushed corn chips into the melted cheese and stir until well blended. Pour cheese mixture over chicken, and serve at once. For best results serve in a bowl with romaine lettuce leaves alongside as the garnita.

title: Mexican Steak with a Kick
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | 1 large spanish onion | 1 can tomato juice | 1 bunch fresh thyme | 4 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Mix the tomato juice with some of the thyme and lime leaves and pour over meat. Marinate in the refrigerator overnight. Place in an oven proof pan and top with remaining thyme and lime leaves. Bake at 170°f for 1 - 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ginjal With Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 3/4 - 1 cup peanut oil | crushed ice | crushed iched whole seaweed
instructions: Steam the cauliflower over boiling water until tender enough to cut in half, 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Cheese, Pear & Swiss Salad (Tirkamontillos En Rabadar)
ingredients: 4 medium pears | 5 ounces cheese, grated ( swiss or gruyere ) | 1/3 cup black olives ( halved ) or 1/3 cup green olives, chopped ( halved ) | 1 small swiss cheese, grated | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 6 cardamom pods, bruised
instructions: Core the pears and cut them into 1 chunks. Place them in a microwavable bowl, cover and microrowave on high for 6 minutes or until almost crisp tender. Transfer to a bowl and mash with a potato masher. Preheat the broiler to medium low. Mix the cheese, olives, and swiss cheese in a bowl. Sprinkle the italian seasoning, turmeric and cardamom. Add to the cheese mixture. Toss to coat. Heat 1 tsp of oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the pears and 1/2 tsp water in a circular motion. Cook until lightly browned on both sides. Be sure to brown the pears evenly and crisp for this recipe. Arrange the pears onto a serving plate.

title: Mango Chutney Spread
ingredients: 1/3 cup kalamata olives, chopped | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Stir all ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Italian Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Crise fennel using a mortar and pestle. Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoons of fennel seed over a teaspoon of ground fennel or other hot spice mix. Mix in 1/4 teaspoons of fennel seed. Store in an airtight container.

title: Minted Hot Walnuts
ingredients: 1 cup dry mixed beans | 1/4 cup sliced walnuts | 1 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | 2 drops tabasco sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons palm sugar | 2 slices lime, rind removed
instructions: Cook the beans over low heat in a small amount of boiling water for about 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and pat dry with paper towel. Spread all the ingredients out in a bowl and let sit for about 10 minutes or until they are room temperature. Serve with hot pita bread, pita chips etc.

title: Hummus Balls
ingredients: 1 cup instant rice | 1 1/4 cups hummus | 2 tablespoons rock sugar | 3 -5 sage leaves | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Soak rice in water for 30 minutes. Drain and place in small bowl. Mix in remaining ingredients and roll into small balls. Store in airtight container and let mellow for up to 2 days.

title: Cajun Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 pound sirloin, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup chopped cremini mushrooms | 1/4 cup ketchup
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together 1/4 cup ketchup, sugar, and beef. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 6 to 8 hours. Preheat grill for high heat. Remove lid and kabobs from marinade. Brush with 1/4 cup ketchup. Sprinkle with mushrooms. Lightly oil grill grate. Grill kabobs about 4 minutes per side for medium rare, turning once.

title: Texas Beef Pie
ingredients: 1 pastry for double-crust deep dish pie | 1 pound ground beef chuck | 1/2 cup dark beer, or more if desired | 1/2 cup sweetened whipped half-and-half
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Roll out half the dough into a circle about 12 inches in diameter and 1/8 inch thick. Place the circle on a baking sheet and spread it out with the back of a spoon. Repeat rolling with the remaining dough, filling, and making sure that you have all the filling and pastry lined up in an even layer. Brush the surface of the dough with water and place the baking sheet on the preheated oven rack. Cook the pie crust on the preheated oven until golden brown, about 45 minutes. Use a sharp boning knife or slotted spoon to cut the pie into wedges and serve.

title: Noodles Wrapped Up
ingredients: 3 -4 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1 jar chow mein noodles | 1/4 - 1/3 cup farmer cheese
instructions: Break eggs into small bowl and set aside. Break chow mein noodles into small bowl and set aside. Spray fry pan with cooking spray and heat on medium heat. Dip 1 - 2 egg whites into egg yolks and then into noodles until coated. Place noodles and noodles in fry pan and cook about 1 - 2 minutes or till egg whites are golden. Turn noodles and place other 3 noodles over noodles to make a sandwich. Top with farmers cheese and sprinkle with lemon juice. Serve in a wide soup bowl with a dipping sauce of your choice like soy sauce, tamari, bam ga.

title: Mexican Bread (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons yeast | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 cup pinto beans
instructions: Place all ingredients in bread machine.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,serrano pepper,gelatin,mushroom,yellow bell pepper,onion salt,orange zest,white fish fillet
title: Fish Kremos With a South American Seasoning
ingredients: 2 lbs thick-cut white fish fillets, cut in 1/2 | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into bite-sized strips | 2 serrano peppers ( or one red ) | 1 package fresh mushrooms | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon gelatin | 1 onion | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon orange zest | 1/2 tablespoon white salt
instructions: Arrange the fish on two lightly greased and parchment lined baking sheets. Sprinkle with the onion and the salt. Broil and brown, watching carefully, about 5 - 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and spread the roasted onion on a sheet pan to cool. Scrape into a bowl and set aside to cool at least 30 minutes before serving. Soak the mushrooms in 3 tablespoons of water in a small pot for about 10 minutes. Drain, saving the water used to keep the mushrooms submerged, and chop with a potato masher or a knife. Sprinkle the mushrooms lightly with the zest of 1 orange and salt. Cover and chill at least 15 minutes. Serve the grilled fish with the roasted onion and roasted bell pepper strips on the side.

title: Spiced Pakoda
ingredients: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 dash dried chipotle powder | 2 teaspoons curry paste
instructions: Whisk flour, kosher salt, and dried chipotle powder together in a bowl to form a paste. Add curry paste and mix well. Spray pakoda molds or small freezer safe containers with cooking spray. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot. Use slotted spoon to drop dough into oil and fry until pakora puff up, 3 to 5 minutes per side or until pakora are puffed and browned and crisped, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,chinese cabbage,linguine,hard egg,feta cheese,pecorino cheese
title: Omanic Cabbage Salad With Parsley Croutons
ingredients: 2 large hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1/4 teaspoon lemon juice and zest | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup finely shredded chinese cabbage | 1/4 cup finely shredded pecorino cheese | 1 lb linguine, cooked according to package directions ( i use spaghetti )
instructions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/8 inch slices.

title: Jicama Spinach Loaf
ingredients: 250 g fresh spinach | 300 g french bread, loaf | 1 jicama
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 c. Mix the fresh spinach with the jicama in a large bowl. Cut the french bread in half, then cut diagonally in half. Spread the spinach mixture on both sides of each half loaf. Place into the top part of your oven, bake for 20 minutes, until it is a golden brown colour.

Random Ingredients: hot mustard,apple,red curry paste,semolina flour,fine breadcrumb,ginger garlic paste,mango chutney,snow pea
title: Curried Mango Chutney Bread
ingredients: 1 kg fine dry breadcrumb ( approx ) | 225 g fine semolina flour | 115 g ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons hot mustard ( i use 1/8 tsp ) | 150 g red curry paste ( i use sharwood's curry paste ) | 1 large mango, diced ( i use 2 small ones ) | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 large apple, chopped ( optional ) | 150 g snow peas, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients, and knead until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. The dough is fairly soft but should not stick to the hands. Put the bread crumbs onto a piece of baking paper, and press it firmly into the holes. The dough should be slightly wetter than crumbly. Bake in a moderate oven for approx 40 –45 minutes or until golden brown. Leave to cool on a tray. Sprinkle with icing sugar and serve warm or cold, with yoghurt or chutney.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,soymilk,plum tomato,asparagus,deli ham,sirloin,vegetable broth,oat
title: Beef-Potato Panini With Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, trimmed of most fat, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 12 large plum tomatoes, sliced into thin wheels | 3/4 lb yukon gold potato, unpeeled, cut into 1/2-inch rounds | 2 lbs asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 lb deli ham, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup low sodium soymilk or 1/2 cup low-sodium milk | 1 tablespoon rolled oats | vegetable broth or water, as needed
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange the slabs of beef on 1 rimmed baking sheet or broiler pan with a little fat. Broil 2 to 4 minutes on each side. Arrange on a platter and cover loosely with foil. Broil the 4 tomatoes, tomatoes sides up, and 2 to 3 minutes longer. Meanwhile, steam the potatoes and asparagus until just tender, 15 to 20 minutes, turning occasionally. Transfer the potatoes and asparagus to a bowl. Stir in the ham, soy milk, and oats. Stir and heat until warm. Remove the foil if the beef begins to brown. Heat the broiler, and arrange the roasting pan on a baking sheet. Add about 3/4 cup of the broth or water to the pan. Arrange the potato and asparagus mixture on each of 4 plates. Place the ham slices over the tops of the potatoes and asparagus and broil 2 minutes longer. Serve the sandwiches warm.

title: Low Fat Aubergine
ingredients: 12 small aubergines | 8 ounces low-fat feta cheese | 10 ounces dark chocolate | 1/2 cup dry onion flakes | 1 egg noodles | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350'f. Boil water in a pot. Peel aubergines and cut them in half lengthways. Boil gently the rest of the way in boiling water, then peel and cube them into bite sized chunks. Melt the dark chocolate in the microwave with the dried onion flakes, and mix it into the chocolate mixture. Drain the aubergines and add to the chocolate mixture. Pour the mixture into a bowl and add sugar, until well blended. Line a large oven dish with aluminium foil. Place aubergines in layers in the dish, top with cheese mixture. Place foil over the top and bake for 30 mins, covering with foil if the cheese starts to turn brown. Let stand for 5 mins then cut into thin strips to serve.

title: Twice-Baked Yams W-Pooze Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 large yams | 2 cups polenta ( i use the # 3 setting on my placemix. ) | 1 cup icing sugar | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons enchilada sauce
instructions: Cut yam in half lengthwise. Rinse and rinse well. Cut each half lengthwise into 8 wedges. Place yams in microwave safe bowl. Cover with water. Microwave on high for about 3 minutes. Remove from microwave and place yams on plate with a plate covered with foil. Microwave uncovered on high for 15 - 20 minutes, or until yams are tender. Drain well. While yam are still warm, gently mash the yams with a fork. Combine all ingredients, mixing well. Pour sauce in oven safe baking dish. Place yams on top. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 3 minutes. Remove plastic wrap. Continue to microwave on high 5 minutes, or until yams are slightly thawed. Drain well. Serve with enchilada sauce.

title: Quick & Easy Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces wide egg noodles, cooked | 2 large plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 cup raisins | 1/2 cup dried cranberries, crushed
instructions: Mix all together in a bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,black bean,beef bouillon,saffron,curry powder,cake flour,chuck roast,tequila
title: Crock Pot Curry Beef
