ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast | 1 can browned beef bouillon, undiluted | 1 cup tequila | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 1/2 teaspoons brown instant cake flour | 1 can black beans, rinsed | 1 - 1 1/2 cup prepared guacamole or 1 -1 1/2 cup prepared sour cream
instructions: Place chuck roast in crock pot. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over roast. Cook for 6 hours in crock pot. Turn off crock pot. Cool, then shred. Serve as is or with prepared salsa and sour cream. This recipe works best if you leave a few hours out and reheat as directed in a saucepan. Serve over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Mexican Bar-B-Q Lamb
ingredients: 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb, trimmed of fat | 1 box instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 small ripe tomatoes, chopped, for topping | 1 jar roasted salami, sliced into thin strips | 1/4 cup prepared salsa
instructions: Combine celery salt and salt into a glass dish. Dredge lamb.

title: Aromatic Fish in a Gram Flour Sauce – Can Be Canning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons white peppercorns, crushed | 2 cardamom pods, crushed | 3 tablespoons salt ( himalayan will do but i omit it )
instructions: Heat oil, add turmeric powder and fry for a minute or two till it turns dark brown in colour, this will take a very short time.. Add white peppercorns and fry for 20 seconds, the seeds will crackle and pop. Add cardamon, fry for a minute, then add salt and leave aside for 2 - 3 minutes. Cut fish fillet into 1/2 inch pieces if necessary. Fill sterilised bottle/container with this fish. Close lid and refrigerate for 3 - 4 weeks.

title: Refreshing Cranberry Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mushrooms | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 -2 red chilies, minced ( depending how hot you like it ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dried cranberries, crushed
instructions: Steam mushrooms until they are tender. Strain water and keep liquid. Throw away the stems. Cut mushrooms into quarters and throw away the stems. Place mushrooms in a casserole. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and stir in sugar, crushed chilies, picante sauce and cranberries.

Random Ingredients: adzuki bean,puff pastry,vanilla ice cream,lime,brownie mix,beet,celery seed
title: Adzuki Beet and Vanilla Pie
ingredients: 1/2 package brownie mix | 9 ounces frozen peeled beets, thawed ( or fresh or canned beets ) | 1 container vanilla ice cream | 1 tablespoon lime rind, grated | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 3 tablespoons adzuki beans ( kimaguriko sweet soy bean flour or white bean paste ) | 5 frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Cook brownie mix according to package directions, about 20 minutes. Set aside. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut beets into 3/4 inch pieces and place in saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat until tender.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,white mushroom,olive oil,snow pea,red bean
title: Italian Herbed Red Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh white mushrooms | 8 ounces fresh canned red beans, drained | 1 cup italian breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup olive oil | 1 package snow peas
instructions: Soak mushrooms in boiling water until tender, about 15 minutes. Slice mushrooms, and boil whole mushrooms in water for 5 minutes. Discard water. Drain mushrooms, reserving 1/2 cup of liquid. Tear mushrooms or save liquid, stir in reserved mushroom liquid, bread crumbs, and olive oil. Mix well. If dough is too wet, add 1/2 cup more of bread crumbs, a little at a time, but not too dry. Sprinkle peas on top. Let sit for 15 minutes. Form into 3 inch long rolls. If dough is too dry, add a little more bread crumbs. Cut rolls into 3 inch pieces and fry in hot olive oil, 2 at a time, until nice and crispy, about 1 minute per side.

title: Leek, Leek and Meat Rub
ingredients: 1/2 lb leek, sliced | 4 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Mix leek with liquid smoke. Refrigerate for a minimum of 4 hours before use.

Random Ingredients: pastry dough,ancho chile,red chili pepper flake
title: Ancho Chile Pie #2
ingredients: 1 pastry dough | 1 red chili pepper flakes | 2 ounces ancho chiles
instructions: Cut chiles into small pieces and fry till they begin getting soft and fragrant. Remove chilies and discard the seeds. Remove chili skins, wash and destemm chop. Roll out pastry dough into a 10 x 1 inch circle. Dip each chile pepper into a thin coat of chili oil and place on the pastry dough. Prick the bottom of the shell with a fork. Bake at 475 degrees at 375 degrees for 12 minutes, then reduce heat to 450 degrees, add hot red chili flakes and bake for an additional 5 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,celery rib,beef bouillon cube,baking soda,apple cider
title: Cabbage, Apple and Beef Risotto (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 4 cups uncooked arborio rice or 4 cups long grain rice, rinsed, drained, and cooked according to package directions ( i use short grain ) | 1 beef bouillon cube, crumbled or 1/4 teaspoon instant minced onion | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 large celery ribs, finely chopped, with leaves | 3/4 cup apple juice or 3/4 cup apple cider
instructions: Combine all ingredients in rice cooker. Set rice cooker to cook and wait for rice to be ready. Remove from cooker when cooker is ready to serve.

title: Asian Peach Salad
ingredients: 8 firm peaches | lettuce leaf | 1/4 cup mirin | 2 tablespoons sweet chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Peel the peaches, remove the pits and slice thinly. Place the slices and lychees in a bowl with the lettuce and season with mirin or sweet chili sauce.

title: Nacho's
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 4 ounces sliced pimiento, drained | 1/2 cup seasoned dry bread crumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 2 fresh mozzarella balls
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line baking sheets with aluminum foil and grease with no stick cooking spray. In a medium bowl mash beans. Stir in pimento, bread crumbs, turmeric, and mozzarella balls. Bake for about 10 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly on top.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,apricot jam,agave nectar,stewing beef,chicken stock
title: Spicy Apricot Beef
ingredients: 300 g stewing beef | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons agave nectar | 1 tablespoon chopped dried red chili pepper | 2 teaspoons apricot jam
instructions: Cut beef into thin slices. Combine all ingredients except jam and beef in slow cooker, cook on high for 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender. Stir from time to time. Serve in shallow soup bowl with rice.

title: The Easiest Raisin Spice Breadcrumb Mix Yet!
ingredients: 2 -3 cups breadcrumbs | 1 bunch fresh rosemary, washed, dried and chopped ( use sprigs of rosemary for extra flavour ) | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup blood orange juice | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Preheat oven to mix all ingredients togther in a large bowl in the following order, raisin mix, dried rosemary, whole rosemary branches and bread crumbs mix. This recipe will not make a dough, but it will make a large loaf. Pinch off pieces of the loaf the size of a walnut and place on a baking tray for use later. Bake at 375 for 30 mins untill golden, then turn the oven up a notch and bake for another 15 minutes or so and remove from oven. Serve hot, warm or cold and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,passion fruit pulp,balsamic vinegar,panko breadcrumb
title: Pebre (Sweet Potato ) Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 440 g canned tomatoes with juice | 250 g panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons passion fruit pulp ( about 1/2 cup )
instructions: Drain the tomatoes in a colander over a bowl. Put the pulp in another colander over a bowl. Put the breadcrumbs in another bowl. Stir the vinegar into half the panko. Add to the panko to the panko mixture. Drain the remaining tomato juice from the canned tomatoes. Add half the juice to the panko mixture. Toss in the pulp. Add the juice of passionfruit. Stir in the pebre. Place in a small ovenproof pan. Cook at 190°c or until golden.

Random Ingredients: chocolate graham cracker,nonfat cream,catsup,balsamic vinegar,garlic,baby spinach,walnut
title: Chocolate Chutney Baby Spinach
ingredients: 1 box fat free chocolate graham crackers | 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped | 1 - 1 1/2 cup baby spinach | 1 cup nonfat sour cream ( if desired ) | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 clove crushed garlic
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees farenheit, or preheat your oven broiler. In a microwave safe casserole dish combine, walnuts, and spinach until well mixed. Mix in the graham cracker crumbs, making sure they are mixed well. In another bowl, mix the sour cream, catsup, vinegar, and garlic. Dip one side of each graham cracker crumb in the sour cream mixture until covered. Place in the bottom of a shallow baking dish. Top with spinach mixture. Dip other side of graham cracker crumbs in the sour cream mixture until covered. Place on top of the spinach mixture until it is completely covered. Sprinkle with additional walnuts, and bake in preheated oven for about 10 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and bubbly. Note, to be sure, do not put the lid on the dish while it is baking. It will bubble and burn on the bottom.

title: Shrimp with Bell Peppers and Cream
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream | 8 shrimp, uncooked | 2 bell peppers
instructions: Heat cream in medium skillet. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,pesto sauce,ramen noodle,thyme,avocado,chicken wing,milk chocolate chip,french onion soup
title: Avocados
ingredients: 1 avocado ( peeled, sliced, and scooped out of the peel ) | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 2 fluid ounces bottled pesto sauce | 1/2 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 package ramen noodles ( seasoning according to package directions ) | 1 bag milk chocolate chips | chili oil ( to coat a skillet, if desired )
instructions: Place noodles in the bottom of a greased pan and coat evenly with chili oil. In a blender combine cream of mushroom soup& paprika and process to blend. Add soup& pesto and process until smooth. Stir into the soup and add the avocado, stirring to combine. Transfer to the pan. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight.. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving. Remove the avocado from the pan and scrape off any excess water. Toss with noodles. Top with chili oil and stir to coat. Garnish with parmesan cheese.

title: Aniseed Baking Powder
ingredients: 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 3 cups oil
instructions: Combine the aniseed, vanilla essence and celtic soda in a large bowl. Add the oil slowly until the mixture is thick. Spread into a greased & floured fry pan on medium heat. Use a wooden spoon to stir until it starts forming a ball. Remove from heat & leave to cool on the pan. When it is thick, stir the mixture with a wooden spoon. Leave on one side to cool completely. Heat oven to 200 c or a fan forced oven of 180 c. Place one heaped teaspoon on the greased and floured frying pan. Spread with 1 teaspoon the anise seed and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of aniseed powder. Place in the oven and bake 10 minutes or until light brown and crisp. Allow to cool for a few minutes. Variation.

title: Baked Pancetta Fajitas
ingredients: 1/2 cup pancetta, minced | 2 tablespoons jalapenos, minced | 4 cups cabbage leaves, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon mango powder or 1/2 teaspoon powdered mango powder | 1 package refrigerated fat-free italian cheese blend | 12 flour tortillas, warmed and slightly warmed
instructions: Cook pancetta in a small skillet over medium heat until crisp. Remove pancetta from skillet and drain on a paper towel. Stir jalapeno and cabbage into pancetta. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in mango powder. Spray an 8 inch square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and pour tomato mixture evenly over the top. Sprinkle evenly with the cheese blend. Place the tortillas on top of the mixture in an even layer. Dot the top with the back of a fork and bake at 400 degrees f. For 45 to 50 minutes or until crisp on top. Let stand until just warm, about 5 minutes. Cut into 20 smaller fajitas. Serve with desired toppings.

title: Panna Cotta With Cocoa
ingredients: 125 ml heavy cream ( whipping cream ) | 8 -10 teaspoons sweet cream ( double whipping cream ) | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 -4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa ( dutch preferably )
instructions: Beat cream, cream of tartar and cacao until stiff. Cover top with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight to let cream soften some. Invert cream onto a large heatproof bowl and refrigerate until ready to use. Remove a tablespoon of cream onto flat surface and with your hands form layers with the softened cream to resemble a puddle. Working quickly, place 1/3 of the panna cotta on the bottom of a shallow dish and carefully turn the panna cotta over. Repeat two times. Repeat two or three times. Place cocoa in a bowl and then dip the panna cotta into the cocoa, then let the panna cotta drain on paper towels for 10 minutes. Transfer to a warm serving plate and serve piping hot.

title: Homemade Arabic Bbq Powder
ingredients: 5 egg yolks | 2 teaspoons ground baharat, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Place egg yolks and the baharat in a medium bowl and stir with a whisk until light and fluffy. Gently mix in sugar. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Use as a rub on meat, vegetables and chicken.

Random Ingredients: almond,lamb shank,tarragon,pineapple tidbit,greek yogurt,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Lamb Shank Skewers With Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 12 lamb shanks, approximately | 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt, whisked until creamy | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 fluid ounce dried pineapple tidbits | 1/4 cup toasted slivered almonds | 1/2 cup greek yogurt, stirred
instructions: Soak 30 skewers in water. Meanwhile, place lamb shanks in a medium sized bowl. Pour yogurt over lamb and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: green peppercorn,rice wine vinegar,spinach,extra virgin olive oil
title: Green Peppercorns and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried green peppercorns | 1 tablespoon green peppercorns, cracked | 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach, washed, stems removed | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Soak the dried green peppercorns in hot water for about 20 minutes. Drain and crush them lightly on your cutting board. If they are so dry they will crack the blades. Combine with the remaining ingredients. Serve at room temperature.

title: Jicama Toulouse
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 pound jicama - peeled, seeded, and cut into 3/4 inch slices
instructions: Place the chicken breasts flat in a large, heavy skillet. Cut slits along the top of the chicken breasts using a meat tenderizing mallet, and pound into 1/4 inch slices, working in batches if necessary. Spoon slices onto a plate, leaving at least 1 inch between each chicken slice. Cover with plastic wrap, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 30 minutes, or overnight, turning frequently. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Transfer marinated chicken to a baking dish. Sprinkle each breast with slits. Cover with more plastic wrap, and return to the refrigerator. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. Chicken will be slightly firm when cool. While the chicken is baking, boil the jicama in a skillet with a splash of water until tender, about 3 minutes. Drain. Arrange chicken pieces onto a warm serving platter, and drizzle with the jicama dressing. Serve.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,lime,saffron thread,tea,peanut oil,chicken breast half,napa cabbage,poblano chile
title: Chicken and Chiles in Adobo Rum
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped peanuts or 1/4 cup olive oil, divided | 6 tablespoons light tasting peanut oil | 1 teaspoon saffron threads | 8 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch-thick strips | 3 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 1 1/4 cups shredded napa cabbage | 2 limes | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: In a bowl, combine 1/4 cup peanuts or olive oil, 1 teaspoon oil, and saffron. Add chicken strips and sauté until done. Remove chicken and set aside. Add remaining 1 teaspoon oil, chiles, cabbage, and lime juice. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 20 - 30 minutes. Stir in saffron. Serve over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,pork,romano cheese,plantain,cornflour,red curry paste,arborio rice
title: Red Curry Pork With Fruited Plantain and Risotto
ingredients: 400 g pork, trimmed and diced | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon grated romano cheese | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese | grated ginger paste | 2 ripe plantains, peeled, halved lengthways, blanched and sliced into 1cm lengths
instructions: Mix together, in a large bowl, the red curry paste, red curry paste, cornflour, 1 tablespoon of romano cheese and the grated ginger paste to make a paste. Pour half the marinade onto the pork mix and mix well to coat. Cover and leave in the fridge, turning occasionally for 3 hours or so. Heat a well oiled griddle pan. Dredge the potato slices in the red curry paste and cook a few at a time until golden on all sides. Drain on paper towel. Repeat with the remaining slices. Place the plantain slices on the griddle and cook for 2 - 3 minutes each side or until golden. Serve the pork on warmed plates.

title: Smoky Sweet-Hot Mexican Hominy
ingredients: 10 cups hominy | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup tequila | 2 tablespoons french mustard | 2 tablespoons minced garlic, from jar | 4 tablespoons masala | 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f put the hominy in a large dutch oven. Add the salt, tequila, mustard and garlic. Bring to boil. Cover and place in the oven. Cook for 45 minutes remove lid and simmer for 15 minutes. Break up the prosciutto and stir into the soup. When soup is about to boil, add the masala. If desired, heat through uncovered for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,garlic powder,lemon wedge,corn tortilla chip
title: Lemon Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 1 chicken breast | 8 taco flavored corn tortilla chips, crushed | 1 dash garlic powder | lemon wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut chicken breast into 6 slices.

title: Pizza Crusted Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 16 ounces refrigerated fully cooked beef tenderloin steaks ( 1 lb ) | 3 tablespoons garlic salt
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f. Place tenderloin steaks on cutting board. Using a sharp knife, score deep slits lengthwise 1/2 inch deep, cutting 3/4 inch deep deep with sharp knife marks. Rub garlic salt evenly over surface. Place on rack in broiler pan. Slice steaks about 2 1/2 from top of tenderloin. Broil 10 minutes. Turn once. Broil 10 minutes longer or until desired doneness.

title: Greek Feta  Appetizer
ingredients: 4 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup apple, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Mix the apple, cheese, cloves, apple juice, and pineapple juice in a serving dish and serve the appetizer.

title: Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen hash brown potatoes | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Combine potatoes and garlic salt.

title: Macaroni and Saffron
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni, uncooked | 250 g barbeque sauce | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 pinch saffron | 1 pinch white pepper
instructions: Simmer enchilada sauce in microwave 1 minute. Drain macaroni. Put into pan, add barbeque sauce and sauce. Cover and cook on high heat 4 minutes until heated through. Add poppy seeds. Season with salt and white pepper.

title: Vegetable Oil(For Frying)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 4 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil
instructions: In a small bowl, combine 1 1/2 tsp vegetable oil with the sliced mushrooms. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a nonstick frypan. Fry the mushrooms for 2 minutes or until browned.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,vinegar,sirloin,cocoa powder,mexican cheese,stir fry sauce,sugar,yogurt
title: Beef Steak With Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar stir-fry sauce | 1 lb top sirloin, trimmed | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 1/3 cup vinegar | 1 cup balkan natural yogurt, drained | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: In medium bowl, combine stir fry sauce, beef, sugar, chinese five spice powder, vinegar and yogurt.

title: Spicy Baked Apricots
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 pinch cayenne | 2 ripe olives
instructions: In a large bowl, mix pumpkin, jam and cayenne with a wooden spoon. Spoon mixture into a greased 8 inch square metal baking dish. Top with olives. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, or until browned.

Random Ingredients: raisin,apple juice,pistachio,seasoning salt,chili oil,lemon juice zest,mandarin orange,american cheese
title: American Muffin Appetizers
ingredients: 17 ounces mandarin oranges, drained | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 2 -3 tablespoons apple juice | 1/2 lb american cheese or 1/2 lb farmer's cheese | 1 pinch seasoning salt
instructions: Cut the cheese into chunks. Mix all of the above ingredients together. Using a pastry brush or your fingers, apply a small amount of the fruit mixture all over the top and sides of the cheese. Sprinkle additional seasoning salt on top. Heat in oven or on grill, until cheese slightly melted and bubbly.

title: Ziti Con Gruyere
ingredients: 2 lbs ziti pasta | 1/2 lb gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 bunch green onion, white and light green parts only, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon cheesecloth
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the ziti until al dente, stirring occasionally. Drain, and immediately rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process. Drain well, and return to the drained pasta bowl. In a large bowl, mix the cheese, green onions, cardamom and warm water. Add the ziti pasta and toss to coat. Serve right away, or refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: biscuit,dark brown sugar,tahini,chinese rice wine,russet potato,batter,baby corn
title: Chinese Sweet Potato and Corn Melt
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes | 1 whole baby corn, ends trimmed | 1/3 cup dry tahini | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup chinese rice wine | 1 teaspoon thick-sour baking soda | 1 tablespoon thick-sour baking soda | 1 tablespoon coarse dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dark-brown sugar | 1/2 cup tahini | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup baby corn
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking sheet with olive oil. Peel the potatoes if desired, and cut them into 1/4 inch slices. Place them on a baking sheet with a side, and set aside. In a saucepan cover the baby corn with water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and allow the corn to separate. When cooled, transfer the corn to a bowl. Cut off and discard the ends, leaving just a few whole. Cut the corn kernels in half from top to bottom, then set aside. Scoop out the white vein with kitchen shears, leaving about 1/2 inch of kernels intact. Place the corn in a bowl, and toss with 2 tablespoons tahini, 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar, 1/4 cup rice wine, and 1 teaspoon thick baking soda until evenly coated. Spread the corn and baby corn into a single layer in the prepared baking sheet, and sprinkle evenly with coarse sugar. Bake the corn until beginning to brown on top and tender on top, about 25 minutes. While the corn is cooking, remove the corn from the oven and drizzle with 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar. Sprinkle evenly with 1/4 cup tahini, and mix well. Slice the corn kernels, and serve warm.

title: Yogurt Surprise
ingredients: 1 gallon chilled yogurt | 1/2 lb salami ( or other spicy meat ) | finely grated ginger | 1 1/2 cups red wine or 1 1/2 cups beer | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut the salami into ½ inch rounds, about ½ inch squares, preferably using a small, sharp knife. Chop the ginger thoroughly. Place the yogurt in a large bowl, add salami, and stir all together. Add 1 - ½ teaspoons of grated ginger and mix. Taste, and set aside. Put the second ½ cup of beer in a small saucepan. Add 1½ teaspoons of grated ginger to the yogurt. Bring to a boil, watching for curds to form a sauce. The consistency will thicken further as this happens. Add 1 - ¼ cups of yogurt to the yogurt and stir to blend well. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Borean Pork Shashlyk
ingredients: 1 pork roast | 2 slices gingerroot
instructions: Marinate pork with ginger and salt for an hour or more inside a covered roasting pan. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Paint the top of the roast with a mixture of marinade and vegetable cooking spray. Place roast into roasting pan. Roast in preheated oven for 90 minutes, basting often, until a crusty, deep brown crust forms. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees fahrenheit and continue cooking, basting occasionally, until internal temperature reaches 145 degrees fahrenheit. Transfer roast to a dish and reduce oven temperature to 325 degrees fahrenheit, placing roasting pan on oven rack. Place a small dish of ice in the pan to catch drippings, or place in sink. Place meat on rack on baking sheet or baking rack. Brush with cooking oil.

title: Yukon-Style Roast Lamb
ingredients: 4 pieces leg of lamb | 5 medium yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place potatoes in a large roasting pan. Cut lamb leg into smaller pieces if necessary. Bake at 300 degrees f for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until cooked to your taste. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the lamb should read 130 degrees f. Let cool, then serve.

Random Ingredients: red wine,red curry paste,vanilla bean,white flour,dark brown sugar,tempeh,parmigiano reggiano cheese,greek yogurt
title: Vegetable Pancake With Tempeh
ingredients: 8 ounces tempeh, cut into 1 x 1 x 1/2 inch sticks | 1 pint greek yogurt or 1 pint sour cream | 4 tablespoons red curry paste, to taste | 1/2 cup white flour | 4 tablespoons dark brown sugar, finely packed | 1/3 cup good red wine ( cabernet sauvignon or cabernet sauvignon ) | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 vanilla beans or 1 small red pepper, cut into 1 inch squares
instructions: Cut tempeh sticks into 1 inch pieces, then cut them into 1 inch pieces. Combine yogurt, curry paste, and brown sugar in a large bowl, and beat well until smooth. Pour in wine and add tempeh and yogurt mixture, stirring gently until incorporated. If you have 3 cups of yogurt, stir in enough brown sugar to reach your desired texture. Pour into 6 - 8 nonstick skillets, then cook according to package directions on the pancake, but cook about 8 - 9 minutes, or until crisp and browned, and filling is hot. Drizzle additional curry, if desired, over the pancake before removing it from the skillet. Sprinkle with cheese and let rest a few minutes, then serve with a swirl of red pepper on top.

title: Homemade Chile Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb cottage cheese | chile powder, to taste
instructions: If you have cheese that has a chile powder, skip this step. Place the cottage cheese in a large bowl. Sprinkle the chili powder over the cottage cheese and stir to combine. Serve chilled.

title: Italian Dressing Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal | 4 tablespoons walnuts, finely chopped | 1 can taco sauce | 1/4 cup mild italian dressing ( i use kraft ) | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon salt | salt and pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a big bowl. Mix with hands and roll into little balls. Place balls on cookie sheet and place pan on cookie sheet, sprayed with pam. Bake at 375°f for 12 - 15 minutes, checking for doneness once done.

Random Ingredients: chicken soup base,curacao,kale,penne,buttermilk,sun tomato oil,pecorino cheese
title: Sicilian Kale With Sun-Dried Tomatoes, Kale & Cacio E Pecorino
ingredients: 1 package penne | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and cut in half crosswise | 1 tablespoon curacao ( optional ) | 3/4 cup buttermilk | 1/2 cup pure dried kale ( about 6 ounces ) or 1/2 cup kale, stems discarded, leaves sliced crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick cross-wise | 2 teaspoons chicken soup base | 1/2 cup crumbled pecorino cheese
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, stirring occasionally. Drain. Place drained pasta, tomatoes, curacao, buttermilk, kale and soup base in large bowl. Add drained pasta and toss to coat the pasta evenly. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Cashew Egg Curry
ingredients: 5 slices bacon, diced | 1 cup mushroom soup | 1/2 cup finely diced hard-boiled egg | 4 -5 curry leaves | 1/2 cup cooked cashews, chopped
instructions: Fry the cashews in a skillet. Drain on paper towel. Cook curry leaves until they start to wilt. Mix in the spam and the bacon. Cook for 3 minutes or until the curry is slightly crispy.

title: Scallops in Soy Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces scallops, about 36 per pound | 6 egg whites | 1/8 cup dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Cut scallops in half lengthwise, and remove excess muscle, but leave intact muscle attached. Slice strips about 1/4 inch wide about 1/4 inch wide, and set aside. Place egg whites in a clean medium bowl, and using a clean glass or metal spatula, lightly beat with a whisk until frothy. Gradually add half of the dark sesame oil, and beat until whites are shiny and glossy, 1 to 2 minutes. With a rubber spatula, gently fold in half of the sesame oil. Turn one half of the egg whites into the skillet, and cook, working quickly to ensure an even, white color, until white barely begins to set, 1 to 2 minutes. Set aside. Heat remaining sesame oil in a wok or small saucepan. Remove scallops from the egg whites, and place in a single layer on a plate. Spoon about 1 tablespoon of the sesame oil over half of the scallops, and let it sizzle for a few seconds. Daint the scallops with egg whites, and then place them into the oil. Cook, turning once, until the scallops are golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Remove scallops from the oil with tongs or a slotted spoon, and drain on paper towels. Serve immediately.

title: Rosemary-Scented French Fries
ingredients: 4 rosemary sprigs, stems removed | 3/4 cup orange infused vodka | 1 teaspoon cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the rosemary sprigs with the orange infused vodka. If you want the sprigs as decorative as possible, remove them before serving.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,red wine vinegar,tomato puree,cilantro leaf,beef bouillon cube,meatball
title: Fassoulakia ( Meatball and Tomato Stew)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 beef bouillon cube | 7 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped | 1 package frozen precooked cooked meatballs | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the tomato puree, bouillon, parsley, cilantro, and hot pepper sauce.

title: Sweet Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sour cream, divided | 1 1/2 cups salsa
instructions: Toss 1 1/4 cups sour cream and 1 1/2c salsa together in a serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate up to 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: apricot,chicken wing,yellow pepper,orange zest,egg yolk,mustard oil
title: Persian Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs chicken wings, separated at the joint from drumsticks | 1 tablespoon orange zest, finely grated ( or 2-8 tbsp. fresh orange juice ) | 1 teaspoon mustard oil | 2 teaspoons orange zest ( divided finely ) | 2 teaspoons yellow peppers, finely chopped | 2 egg yolks, beaten | 1/2 pint apricot, sliced | 1 cup dry paprika
instructions: Trim excess fat off each wing separately from drumsticks, and discard wing tips. Place wings on a clean surface and sprinkle with the orange zest. Sprinkle the mustard oil over. Place in a large bowl and turn to coat, then leave in the bowl for 2 hours at least, or overnight. Preheat oven to 300°f. Wash the outside and inside of the wings, and leave at least 30 minutes. Using tongs grasp and separate all the wings separately from the drumsticks. Place two pieces of breast side by side in a roasting pan. Using a wooden spoon, poke holes in the skin of the chicken wings at 2 joints, starting at joints. Then poke an indentation in the skin of each breast, adding more to depth of chicken, 1/4 inch between each, making sure there are no protruding spots of skin and chicken. Sprinkle both sides of each breast with salt. Place in the oven, and roast for 1 hour. Turn wings over every 30 to 45 minutes to brown the skin and continue to cook throughout the roasting time. While the chicken is cooking, place egg yolks in a saucepan and add the apricots and paprika. Bring to the boil, stirring constantly until thick, then pour this over the hot chicken in the pan. Remove the chicken from the oven and let rest for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and serve immediately. Tip, if you're cooking this in advance, cool off and then store the sauce under the cloth while it's cooling, covered.

title: Creamy German Cucumber Dressing
ingredients: 4 medium cucumbers, peeled, and chopped | 1 lb maraschino cherry ( about 10 per cent cherry ) | 1/4 cup butter, softened | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup tartar | lettuce ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: In a large salad bowl stir together cucumbers, cherries, and butter.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,puff pastry,beet,panko breadcrumb,chocolate chip,thai red curry paste
title: Thai Beef Turnovers
ingredients: 1/4 cup thai red curry paste | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 4 tablespoons chocolate chips | 1 lb ground sirloin steak ( or other beef ) | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | ice cube
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Blend red curry paste, panko, and 3 tablespoons of the chocolate in a bowl until mixture forms a paste. Cut beef into 1/2 inch strips and then stir into curry paste mixture. Place pastry sheet on baking sheet. Coat with ice cubes and cut pastry into 6 triangles. Place each triangle on top of a piece of pastry. Brush edges of pastry with water and transfer to a baking sheet. Cook in oven for 30 minutes or until pastry is puffed and golden.

title: Rice Noodle and Potato Kugel
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spaghetti or 1 1/2 lbs linguine, cooked per package directions and then cooled | 3 cups greek oregano, rinsed and dried well | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 teaspoons ground cloves | 2 teaspoons crushed cardamom | 3/4 teaspoon allspice | 1 bottle light beer or ( 440 ml ) bottle dark beer, at room temperature or can of beer | 6 -8 cups potato starch, for dipping noodles
instructions: Mix together the oregano powder, cumin, cloves, cardamon, beer or dark beer in a small bowl, leaving some for later. Pour the beer over the pasta. Stir well to mix. Dissolve the potato starch in about 3 1/2 tablespoons water. Dip the kugels in the dough. Let set for 1 hour in fridge. Heat some oil or a frying pan on medium high heat. You can add more oil as needed later. Fry kugels until golden. Drain on paper towels and serve with the kugel sauce. Note, you may substitute any meat for the kugel.

Random Ingredients: cashew,green pepper,napa cabbage,beef stew meat,lime juice,spaghetti squash
title: Beef With Cashews, Green Peppers & Limes
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat ( about 3/4 of a 7-ounce can ) | 3/4 cup lime juice, divided | 1/4 cup cashews ( or peanuts! ) | 1/2 lb spaghetti squash, cut into 1-inch wedges | 1 head napa cabbage, cored, halved, and thinly sliced ( about 2 pounds total ) | 2 green peppers, seeded, cut into strips
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a shallow bowl and marinate meat for about 30 minutes or longer, turning once. Cook spaghetti squash in boiling water until tender, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,apricot,active yeast,beef tenderloin steak,frangelico,canola oil,vanilla pudding mix,red grape
title: Apricot Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks | 1 package dry instant vanilla pudding mix | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 cup dried apricot, chopped | 1 ounce frangelico | 1/2 teaspoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 375°. Sprinkle yeast and 2 teaspoons soy sauce into bowl and set aside 5 minutes. Mix remaining 3 teaspoons soy sauce and beef in large bowl with 1/4 cup cold water and set aside. Combine pudding mix and oil in large bowl with yeast mixture and apricots. With fork, gradually blend in rest of cold water. Stir until moistened. Stir in frangelico. Turn out dough onto lightly floured surface and pat into rectangle 1/2 inch thick. Cover and refrigerate 5 - 6 hours or until dough is cold. Slice 1/2 inch thick and arrange on large baking sheet. Bake 18 to 22 minutes or until crust is lightly browned. Remove from oven and brush with remaining glaze. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Luby's Indian Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup lentils, cleaned and washed | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon beef stew meat or 1 tablespoon bacon, chopped | 1 1/2 cups ziti pasta, uncooked
instructions: Soak lentils overnight or bake in a 350° degree oven for 90 minutes or till tender. Drain and place in pot. Cover with water. Bring to boil, then turn down to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or till tender. Stir occasionally. Drain excess water. Add turmeric. Simmer til liquid thickens. Add more salt or broth as desired. When water is boiling, cook ziti in a pot of boiling water till tender. Drain well. Stir in lentils and cook for 3 minutes. Pour hot liquid over ziti and toss well to coat.

Random Ingredients: nonfat cream,red pepper powder,white wine vinegar,sirloin,turnip,oregano leaf,chili powder
title: Beef With Turnips(Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 turnips, peeled and cut into 1 `` | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon red pepper powder | 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves, dried
instructions: Place beef and turnips in crock pot. In a bowl, combine chili powder, pepper powder, vinegar, sour cream and oregano. Pour over beef.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,chicken leg,pecorino romano cheese,italian breadcrumb,yellow mustard
title: Simple Italian Breaded Chicken
ingredients: 6 -8 chicken legs | italian seasoned breadcrumbs | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated ( a generous handful ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla | yellow mustard
instructions: Take the chicken legs and pull off the excess skin and funk them up using your fingernail. Put legs in a bowl. Stir together the bread crumbs, cheese, vanilla and mustard. Sprinkle a little bit of bread crumb mixture all over the chicken and roll up firmly. Repeat with the rest of the bread crumbs. In a heavy saucepan, place the chicken on a foil lined pan and set in a shallow pan containing lots around it. Pour enough hot water over the chicken so it barely just reaches the top of the chicken. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 40 minutes. The water should be evaporating a bit during this time.

Random Ingredients: coconut flake,red potato,matzo meal,walnut,self raising flour
title: Matzoh Snackers
ingredients: 1 cup matzo meal, whisked | 1 cup coconut flakes | 250 g red potatoes, sliced in half and sliced thinly | 150 g walnuts, chopped coarsely | 500 g self-raising flour
instructions: Place the matzoh mix into a large bowl, add chopped walnuts. Whisk the flour into the mixtur and add to the dough with a dash of milk. Make sure all the dry ingredients are combined. The dough is not sticky just firm enough to hold together, with small bubbles between each addition. If you work the dough, your hands should come out clean. Roll out your dough on a floured surface to about 1/4 centimetre thick. Cut into squares and place in baking paper lined muffin tins and bake at c for about 30 minutes on middle shelf of oven. These are delicious served warm, but can be eaten fresh with ice cream. Variation, if you have no filling ingredients, just chop the raw potato and add to the dry ingredients. The mixture should be thick enough for you, so add more flour if necessary to make it a soft dough without much liquid at the final stage. If you used a vegan cheese you can add some other vegetables, such as chard or spinach. Enjoy.

title: Taco Bell Style Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 3/4 cup salsa | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 -2 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients. Mix well, breaking up tomatoes into large chunks. Serve in bowls with crackers.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,basil leaf,pecorino romano cheese,vegetable,caraway seed,peanut
title: Pesto in Vegetables
ingredients: 3 medium vegetables, your fav | 3 tablespoons parboiled unsalted peanuts | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon crushed basil leaves | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Pesto,. Put all ingredients in a medium saucepan& simmer until the vegetables are tender. Drain& stir. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,vegetable,salmon fillet,golden syrup,texas toast bread,fig,lemon peel
title: Maple-Glazed Fresh Fruit With French Toast
ingredients: 1 fresh fig, sliced | 1/3 cup golden syrup | 1/8 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1/3 cup chopped canned mixed vegetables | 2 teaspoons minced lemon peel | 6 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup fat free plain fat-free evaporated milk | 12 slices texas toast thick bread
instructions: Place fig slices in a small microwave safe bowl, drizzle light golden syrup over, and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high power 1 minute or until just warm. Remove plastic wrap, and stir to loosen fig compote, taking care not to break up fig mush. Set aside. Place 1/3 cup of chopped fig compote mixture in small bowl and sprinkle with 1/3 cup of minced lemon peel. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power 1 minute or until heated through. Remove plastic wrap, stir, and set aside. Whisk yolks, evaporated milk, and lemon peel in a medium bowl until smooth, about 2 minutes. Stir in lemon peel until combined. Pour one third of the hot french toast batter into a lightly greased 15 x 10 inch jellyroll pan. Top with one third of the french toast batter. Repeat layering 2 more times, ending with the french toast batter, reserved fig compote mixture, and reserved french toast batter. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove plastic wrap, and bake in the preheated oven 20 minutes, or until golden brown and firm to the touch. Let stand 5 minutes, then cut into 6 pieces. Serve warm.

title: Tandoori Powder - the Secret Ingredient for Making Pho (For Tandoori Recipes)
ingredients: 2 cups dried fenugreek seeds ( known as khus-khus-khus-ku urad or chug-garam masala ) | 1 1/2 cups lime wedges
instructions: For the tandoori powder, place dried fenugreek in a spice mill or coffee grinder and grind to a fine paste/dough consistency.

title: Hearty Baked Sauerkraut and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 loaf fresh seaweed, trimmed | 2 cups sauerkraut, rinsed | 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 package cream-style mascarpone cheese | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1/2 bunch fresh broccoli, chopped
instructions: Cut the seaweed in half lengthwise, removing the hard choke. Starting at the base of the seaweed, place the halves, cut sides down, on a cutting board. Starting at the base of the seaweed, slice across the seaweed into several pieces, creating one total piece. Cut a 1 inch lengthwise slit down the center of each piece of seaweed. Place each slice in the center of a 9x1 inch square of heavy aluminum foil. Top with sauerkraut, tomatoes, mascarpone cheese, half and half, cilantro, and baking soda. Wrap aluminum foil with remaining seaweed halves, pressing lightly on top of the cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove foil, and bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Baste the sauce with remaining half and half.

title: Beet Quinoa Balls
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( arborio ) | 1/2 cup milk chocolate candy bar | 1 beet ( chopped )
instructions: Boil water with quinoa until water is just cooked. Add chopped beet or beetroot and mix. Allow to cool for 15 minutes. Add milk chocolate candy bar. Roll into small balls and bake at 350 degrees for ten minutes or until brown. Enjoy your delicious beets.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,nutmeg,kipfler potato,pasta,kaffir lime leaf,fruit,garlic paste
title: Puerto Rican Sweet Potato and Anise Sambal Soup
ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato, halved and skinned | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 4 small kaffir lime leaves ( small fresh leaves ) or 4 small lime pieces ( small fresh leaves ) | 2 teaspoons kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | kipfler potatoes ( optional ) | 12 cups beef stock or 12 cups cooked pasta | 2 dashes of freshly grated nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: For the broth, wash sweet potato and poke small holes through the pulp using a sharp knife. Place in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Set over medium low heat and cook until a knife easily pierces the skin of the potato. Remove the potato with a slotted spoon, peel and mash with 2 tsp of garlic paste, 1 tsp of kaffir lime leaf or lime pieces, potato, and a little bit of broth or water. Pour the potato back into the pot. Repeat until all ingredients are used. For the soup, bring beef stock or water to a simmer in a large saucepan or pot over medium high heat. Add 1 teaspoon garlic paste, chopped fresh lime leaves or lime pieces, kepihla, the pinch of nutmeg, and a few drops of nutmeg. Simmer until flavors are well combined, about five minutes. Add hot water or stock just enough to cover. Bring soup back to a boil, reduce heat to low, and cook until flavors are well combined, about 30 minutes. When soup is simmering, remove and discard lime leaves. Serve immediately with a sprinkling of freshly grated nutmeg and aniseed for garnish.

title: Homemade Liquid Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup hot sauce ( to taste ) | 1 cup clear liquid carbonated beverage, such as sprite
instructions: Stir together hot sauce and 1 cup carbonated beverage. Store in air tight container for up to 3 days.

title: Roasted Chiles With Blue Cheese
ingredients: 2 poblano chile | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Roast chiles either in 400 degree oven or in broiler until charred on all sides. Slit peppers longways and rub off skins. Place chiles on parchment lined tray. Sprinkle each with cheese. Roast in low oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Beef Rolls
ingredients: 4 lamb or 4 veal steaks | 1 cup plain yogurt ( low fat is ok ) | 8 ounces beef rolls
instructions: Place lamb or veal steaks on a board. Using a sharp knife make two cuts about an inch deep across. Insert meat or vegetable truss in the cuts. Put a few spoonfuls of yoghurt into the cuts and tuck the tips under. Wrap in greaseproof paper and tie with string. Place in a tray and bake at 350 degrees until tender.

title: Baked Parsnips and Kielbasa
ingredients: 4 large parsnips, peeled and sliced as thin as possible | 1 can light cream | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 2 -3 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 -2 drop kielbasa or 1 -2 drop other sausage, sliced thinly | 3/4 cup sour cream | minced parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Mix all ingredients except sour cream and garnish in a 2 qt casserole dish. Make sure bread gets a nice golden color. Bake uncovered in oven for 30 minutes or until parsnips are tender. Remove from oven, and stir sour cream evenly over top, and scatter with minced parsley.

title: Crisp Rosemary Baked Eggs
ingredients: 6 -8 large eggs | 1/2 cup cinnamon sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, beat all 4 ingredients together. Put mixture into a small pan. When the mixture puffs up on the top, turn over and stir around on the wall. This should look like your lid. You will eventually begin to crack the eggs, but not break them. Set the egg on a baking dish or shallow baking pan in a single layer. Allow the uncooked egg to set before you fry it in the hot pan. It will sizzle, but it does not change anything. Once the egg mixture is set and cooked, carefully remove it from the hot pan and slice into two or three pieces. Do not let the butter burn.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,cream,mascarpone cheese,mayonnaise,cremini mushroom,rice noodle,rice wine,cooking apple
title: Wild Rice Salad With Mushrooms and Apples
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice noodles | 1/2 cup thinly sliced cremini mushroom | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( or dry sherry ) | 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1 cup chopped cooking apples | 1/4 cup pickle slices, minced ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except pickles and apples. Cover and chill, preferably overnight.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,white wine,tomato soup,garbanzo bean,grain white rice,orange juice,mint powder
title: Crazy Rice
ingredients: 4 cans condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/3 cup dried garbanzo beans, soaked and drained | 1/3 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 6 tablespoons chopped fresh mint powder | 3 cups cooked long-grain white rice, drained
instructions: In a 4 quart slow cooker, combine tomato soup, orange juice, wine, garbanzo beans, sun dried tomatoes, mint, and rice. Mix well, cover, and cook on low setting until heated through, about 30 minutes. When ready to serve, fluff rice with a fork.

title: Brown Sugar Corned Beef Brisket
ingredients: 8 ounces corned beef brisket | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Place corned beef brisket in a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Combine brown sugar and 1/4 cup water in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,hummus,asafoetida powder,white bread,zucchini lengthwise,penne pasta
title: Asafoetida Scrolls
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 3 zucchini, halved lengthwise | 1 tablespoon hummus | 1 jar prepared hummus | 3 bread rolls
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once water is boiling, stir in the penne, and return to a boil. Cook pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,passion fruit,ginger juice,greek feta cheese,pea,white bread
title: Cheese and Onion Loaf
ingredients: 3 ounces dry smoked white bread | 1 ounce peas | 1 teaspoon ground ginger juice | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup greek feta cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon finely diced fresh passion fruit ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Cut a 10 hole square of foil.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,baby corn,pumpkin,cauliflower floret,heavy cream
title: Roasted Corn, Crab and Pumpkin Dauphinoise
ingredients: 1 can crushed baby corn | 1 can pumpkin | 1 cup cauliflower floret, broken into florets | 1/2 cup heavy cream ( optional ) | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix the corn, pumpkin, cauliflower, cream and red pepper flakes until thoroughly coated. Transfer the mixture to an unprepared shallow baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes, turning the dish after 10 minutes. Cool, remove cover and cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,mango chutney,italian herb,bread,goat cheese,basmati rice,flat leaf parsley
title: Mango Chutney Rice Crumble
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked basmati rice, rinsed | 1 container mango chutney, cut in 1/2 inch pieces | 12 slices country bread, cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 1 bunch fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 cup fresh snow pea, julienned | 1/3 cup goat cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped italian herb blend, such as mccormick's montreal brand
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add mango chutney, bread, parsley and snow peas.

title: Mexican Lasagna(Copycat)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dry lasagna noodles ( approx. 5 x 9 rectangle ) | 1 cup catsup | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 2 serrano chilies
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. Remove stems from chiles. Place chiles in a skillet with 1 cup water and bring to a boil. Let chiles turn black and black until very soft, about 15 - 30 minutes. Remove chiles from the skillet and place in plastic bag. Let peppers devein and peel off black skin. Remove stem and seeds from chiles and discard. Place chiles in a mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: savory,hoagie,duck,marsala wine,pita bread,pinto bean,chocolate chip,dark rum
title: Da Best Chili
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 duck, cut into 6 pieces, or more to taste | 1/4 cup dark rum | 8 hoagie rolls, split | 1 teaspoon minced savory | 4 pita bread rounds, split | 1 1/2 tablespoons marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place drained pinto beans in a 2 quart baking dish and cover with water. Bring to a simmer and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, reserving liquid. Place duck pieces in a saucepan over medium heat with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until the duck pieces just begin to brown, about 5 minutes. Remove duck from the poaching liquid and place into a bowl. Bring bean liquid and duck to a boil while stirring constantly. Remove and discard the duck bones. Stir in rum and simmer until the liquid has reduced to about 1 can. Set pita bread on a baking sheet sprinkled with a little rum while breading. Fill pita bread halves with the bean mixture.

Random Ingredients: red wine,irish cream,sausage,arrowroot,almond extract,aburage,purpose flour,chicken wing
title: Irish Eyes Attack
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 1 ounce irish cream, whipped | 1 ounce slivered almonds or 1 ounce slivered almonds | 1 ounce aburage, rolled sausage | 1/2 ounce all-purpose flour | 1/2 fluid ounce arrowroot | 3 fluid ounces red wine or 3 fluid ounces white wine | 1 teaspoon ground irish cream | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Skin all fat from the chicken then cut it up into bite sized pieces. Pour a little wine into a small fry pan and put a good drop of oil into it. Put in the chicken pieces and fry on all sides, shaking the pan occasionally until they are light and golden brown, then drain on paper towels. Add a pinch of ground oats into the same pan. Turn down the heat a little and put in the whipped cream. Turn on the flames, scrape away any extra fat. Stir in the almond extract, the remaining slivered almonds and the sliced sausages. Cook for 10 minutes. Scoop the chicken pieces out of the pan and put into a serving dish. Pour a small amount of gravy into the pan and warm through. Pour gravy over the chicken to serve. It tastes best made one day in advance. Serve on warmed platter with the remaining gravy poured over the top.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,chili seasoning mix,sea salt,meatball,black sesame seed
title: Chess Balls - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb frozen meatballs ( about 4 ) | 1 cup frozen black-eyed peas, in the jar, defrosted | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds, lightly toasted | 1 teaspoon chili seasoning mix, heaping | 1 -2 teaspoon chili seasoning mix, from a package of japanese-style saudagas | sea salt
instructions: Place all ingredients except salt, in the crock pot on low for 3 - 4 hours, stirring every 30 minutes. Add salt to taste.

title: Spanish  Braised  Beef  (  Loosely  Soused  Skillet or  Hot  Chuck. Eye )
ingredients: 2 lbs fully lean boneless beef chuck ( or other leaner, like 1-inch by 2-inch meat in a chuck roast ) | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin diagonal slices | 1 spanish onion, sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f lay beef fat side up in 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish and place on rack in roasting pan. Sear beef in 2 batches, in 2 batches if necessary. Set aside. Scatter bell pepper, onion and a pinch of salt over beef and pour remaining beer around the meat. Dot with butter. Place dish on sheet pan with beef fat side up. Bake covered at 325f about 3 hours, basting now and then and adding a small amount of water as necessary. Baste once or twice during last hour or so.

Random Ingredients: ice cream,chicken breast half,celery,romaine lettuce heart,dijon mustard,mint leaf,horseradish,oregano leaf
title: Greek Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into strips | 1 cup finely shredded romaine lettuce hearts | 1/4 cup finely shredded romano-reggiano cheese blend | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup ice cream, heated | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish, drained | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chicken, romaine, cheese and mustard. Toss to combine. In another bowl, combine ice cream, horseradish, oregano and mint. Add the bread mixture to the chicken mixture and carefully stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Italian-Style Tofu
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 2 tablespoons lard | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 2 large red cabbage, shredded | 4 anchovies, chopped, optional ( optional )
instructions: Slice tofu in half lengthwise, then crosswise to make 2 triangles. Heat lard in large skillet over medium high heat. Brown tofu until golden brown and crisp, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer tofu to a plate. Pour broth into skillet.

title: Beef and Jicama Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces lean boneless lean beef chuck, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons grainy mustard | 3 tablespoons jicama, julienned | 1 small turnip, thinly sliced ( about 1 cup )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss beef with mustard and cut in julienned turnip. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour, or overnight. In a large salad bowl, toss salad with beef and turnip slices.

title: French Onion Jam Relish
ingredients: 2 lbs french-canadian onions ( the roots and the beak ) | 2 cups sherry wine ( i like good cabernet sauvignon ) | tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Peel off the onions and slice them into thin strips. Place them in a saucepan that is covered with sherry and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, stirring frequently for 45 minutes, or until onions are transparent. Pour in the tabasco, if using. Transfer to a sealable jar and store in the fridge, shaking the jar until the onion mixture is cold and jammy. Note, the idea is to put the onions in a container and mix around with your hands. Variation, you can add a dash of ground walnut nuts for each serving if desired.

title: Sweet Soyed String Beans
ingredients: 400 g string beans, trimmed | 150 ml filtered water from the washing beans or 150 ml fresh water | 10 -10 black cardamom pods | 1/4 teaspoon white miso
instructions: Soak all the dry beans in cold water for half an hour. When you are ready, drain the beans by placing on the kitchen counter and then using your fingers, press all the water from the beans through a colander it takes 5 to 10 minutes to drain the beans. Repeat with the remaining water. After removing the beans from the water, pat dry the soaked beans using a paper towel. Place the beans on an upside down plate, cover with another plate so that the bean doesn't break while you are going to cook it. Set on a tray and refrigerate till the water runs clear, approximately 30 minutes. Heat up a saucepan then add the filtered water and cardamom pods to it and bring to a boil then turn down the heat and simmer for about 10 minutes. Turn the heat up to medium, add the miso paste then bring to a boil. Add the beans and mix well to coat the beans with the miso paste and to combine. Cover and gently simmer for about 20 minutes or until beans are soft and heated through. Transfer the hot beans to a serving bowl and serve immediately.

title: Chive and Broccoli Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 8 cups chopped fresh broccoli | 8 large turnips - peeled, cored and chopped | 6 dried chives, or more to taste | 6 cardamom pods | 4 teaspoons grated horseradish
instructions: Grease a 12x4 inch baking dish. In a large stock pot, melt cornmeal on low. Increase heat to medium and cook and stir 1 minute. Add broccoli, turnips, and chives, and stir to mix thoroughly. Cook 1 minute. Transfer to prepared baking dish, sprinkle with cardamom, and stir well. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Bake in the preheated oven until brown and bubbling, about 1 hour. Sprinkle with horseradish before serving, if desired.

title: Broccoli and Ground Beef Vegetables
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed vegetables ( or broccoli ) | 1 lb ground round
instructions: Cook ground beef in frying pan. Drain. Add frozen veggies and remaining ingredients and cook until heated through and serve. Serve hot. The beef will be very hot and you may want to add a little more salt and/or garlic powder.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo salsa,feta cheese,sherry,baking powder,green bell pepper,golden raisin,chicken stock
title: Spicy Tomatillos, Raisins, and Green Peppers
ingredients: 4 medium tomatillos salsa or 4 medium tomatillos | 4 green bell pepper | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 4 -6 tablespoons chicken stock | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f/120°c. Place the tomatillos in a small saucepan with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, immediately reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain. Halve the green peppers lengthwise and remove seeds and ribs. Cut all the peppers lengthwise into 1/4 wide strips and place in a bowl with lime juice. Dry the peppers and set aside. Place flour in a food processor or blender or a plastic bag. Add the baking powder and pulse about ten times, cutting down the process if necessary. Add the onion, pepper strips, sherry, and raisins and process a few times until everything is just combined and mixed inches now add the tomatillo salsa and process three or four or five or six times or until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Transfer 2/3 of the mixture to a baking sheet lined with foil. Sprinkle the top of the tomatillo cream with about 3 tbls. Of the feta cheese. Bake for 20 minutes, until the center of the thickest portion of the tomato appears dry and the topping has turned brown. Spoon the tomatillo mixture onto a serving platter and serve immediately with extra salsa.

title: Tahini (Honey) Batter for Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini, sesame paste to cover | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, zest of | 4 teaspoons caster sugar | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Line a colander with a good length of muslin. Place all the ingredients and mix well with a steel spoon. The mixture should form a soft paste. Pour over fish pieces ensuring all parts are covered. Rinse well and drain off any excess water. Arrange on a plate and pour the olive oil over it before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg wrapper,almond extract,salmon,bay seasoning,green onion,green olive,oyster sauce,cardamom pod
title: Almond Fish and Green Olive Sambal
ingredients: 2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 teaspoon green onion, chopped ( about 1/2 a tablespoon ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons canned sliced oyster sauce | 1/4 teaspoon prepared bay seasoning | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1 -2 slice salmon or 1 -2 slice cooked shrimp | 3 whole green olives, to taste ( optional ) | powdered egg wrapper, heated ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl stir together first 11 ingredients. Coat fish and vegetables lightly with spice mixture and let stand 30 minutes. Lay two salmon slices in the bottom of a lightly oiled 7x11 inch baking dish. Top with two stuffed olives, if using. Using your thumb, press down on top of each piece to press out some of the liquid. Cover surface with slightly moistened plastic wrap and chill 1 hour. Carefully remove plastic wrap when ready to serve and dust with flour. Serve with sesame seeds, mayonnaise or just eat with a spoonful of prepared sweet pickle. You really don't need a plastic wrapper or plastic bowl in this recipe, just brush a little of the paste on the fish and serve.

title: Lebanese Baked Bread
ingredients: 3 slices bread, day old | 1/2 cup lemon zest or 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cut out 2 x 2 inch squares of waxed paper. Place bread on baking sheet. Mix all remaining ingredients together and mix well with electric mixer. Sprinkle bread with lemon or lime zest. Bake at 350° for about 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown, and juices run clear when inserted into the center.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,chipotle chile,apple cider vinegar,rice flour
title: Fried Applesauce - New Zealnd Restaurant Copycat Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice flour | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar ( unseasoned ) | 3 canned chipotle chiles, chopped ( or canned ) | hot sauce or sriracha hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Place the rice flour, apple cider, chilies or sriracha hot sauce or sriracha in a plastic baggie and shake to combine. Seal and put one half baggie in the freezer for 5 hours. The other half baggie for another 30 - 45 minutes. Keep it cold until ready to use. Serve with your favorite ice cream or other dipping sauce.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Couscous and Gruyere
ingredients: 12 ounces steak, cut 1 1/2 inch thick, trimmed of excess fat | 1 1/2 cup gruyere, shredded into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon season salt | 6 ounces couscous | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 stalk celery, cut into 1-inch slices
instructions: Cut the steak diagonally across the grain into 1/2 thick slices. Place one slice of steak in each of 6 shallow, foil lined shallow bowls and top with 1/4 cup cheese. Sprinkle with season salt and toss to combine. Spread couscous on a dinner plate. Combine remaining 6 tablespoons cheese with grand marnier and arrange over couscous in bowls.

Random Ingredients: bourbon,celery rib,caster sugar,parsley,baking potato,baby bok choy
title: Baby Bok Choy with Whiskey Brown Butter
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, such as desiree, halved | 8 baby bok choy, cleaned and washed | 4 tablespoons whiskey brown butter | 3 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Place the potatoes and bok choy in a pan, cover with cold water, bring to the boil and cook for 12 minutes then drain. Melt the butter in a pan, then stir in sugar, parsley and baking soda and then add the potatoes and bok choy and cook until soft. Serve.

Random Ingredients: hot water,skor english toffee bit,tortilla,eggplant,dark soy sauce
title: Soy Eggplant (Aubergine) Burritos
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant ( approximately 2 medium-size ) | 2/3 cup hot water | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 4 soft tortillas, 8- to 10-inch | shredded asian toffee bits
instructions: Cut eggplant in 1/8 inch thick slices, then slice lengthwise into half moons of equal thickness. Spread 1 tablespoon hot water into each tortilla, then fold in half moon slices. Wrap each in two pieces of heavy duty aluminum plastic wrap, then refrigerate for 30 minutes. Prepare grill or heat broiler. When ready to use, place eggplant on grill or broiler pan, with one fourth inch of water on each side. Grill until just barely tender, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Allow eggplant to cool for about a minute then remove to an ice bath. When cool enough, remove eggplant to colander, then press excess liquid out. Cut each eggplant diagonally into 6 - 8 pieces. Arrange eggplant in a single layer on baking sheet, with water between each piece. Spray generously with vegetable oil. Broil until charred all over and tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Serve warm. Note, if desired, sprinkle with toffee bits before baking.

title: Parmigiano Reggiano Cheese (Fromage Fort)
ingredients: 4 ounces freshly grated italian pecorino cheese or 4 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/8 teaspoon anise
instructions: Place 1 ounce cheese in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade and process a few seconds till finely grated. Scrape the mixture into a bowl, add the aniseed, and process a few seconds more. Then add back into the processor and process till well blended. Spoon the puree into a shallow bowl. Use to stuff cheeses, or as a garnish to pasta, and sprinkle with a little more anise. Note, the aniseed is a very fine substitute for the anise. Goes well with meats, risotto, etc.

title: Easy Cheesy Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine ( a knob or two ) | 4 boneless chicken thigh fillets | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 4 slices mexican blend cheese
instructions: Lightly brush a griddle or frying pan with a little oil and place it over medium heat.. Season chicken on both sides with coriander, coriander and lite salt. Brown both sides and place cooked chicken on the hot surface. When chicken is browned, spread 2 tbs of margarine over the entire dish. Top with another tbs of margarine. Place a slice of cheese over the cheese and cook until the cheese melts and lightly browns. Top with the lime juice and fresh coriander and a squeeze of lime juice on top of the cheese as desired.

title: Fajita Salad
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup green olives, chopped | 1/8 cup feta-flavored crumbled bacon | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek | 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix and olives in a salad bowl. In a small bowl, combine crumbled bacon, basil, fenugreek, cheese and parmesan.

Random Ingredients: bing cherry,beef consomme,meat,swiss chard,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Swiss Chard & Meat Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stew meat, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | vegetable oil cooking spray | 8 cups swiss chard, coarsely chopped | 1 can beef consomme, undiluted | 3/4 cup fresh basketged bing cherry, halved
instructions: Line 1 1/2 inch deep baking dish with 2 large sheets of heavy duty foil with heavy duty foil.

title: Baked Peaches With Italian Parsley
ingredients: 4 large ripe peaches, halved | 2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley, leaves ( or 1 1/2 tbsp. fresh ) or 2 teaspoons fresh flat leaf parsley, and 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes | chopped cilantro, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Remove peel and seeds from peaches and cut in half crosswise and then crosswise, making 3/4-1 inch thick slices. Line baking sheet with foil and set peaches side by side, cut side down in baking dish.. Stir parsley and ground dried parsley with fork into melted butter. Sprinkle peaches with herb mixture. Bake about 45 minutes or until peaches are tender and sauce is slightly thickened. Turn peach slices, cut side up, and place on serving platter.

title: Tomato-Stuffed Zucchini
ingredients: 2 small zucchini, halved lengthwise | 1 pound fresh snow peas, trimmed | 3 tablespoons italian stewed tomatoes | 2 teaspoons salt pork, finely diced | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 egg yolk, beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cook zucchini halves for 10 to 15 minutes in lightly salted boiling water, or until tender.

title: Fennel and Olive Oil Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs fresh fennel | 1 1/2 cups plain dried white breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup dried white breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup olive oil ( or more ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Quarter or slice fennel very thinly or very thinly and place in a food processor fitted with the blade. Blend the fennel very thinly and gradually add the 1 1/2 cups of breadcrumbs until the mixture is the consistency of breadcrumbs. Sprinkle in 1/2 cup of the bread crumbs and blend until fully mixed. Turn the dough out onto a piece of waxed paper or paper towel and pat out into a disc. Cover lightly with plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature until it's time to use. Heat a 1 1/2 to 2 quart heavy pot over medium heat. When the oil is very hot, scoop about 2 tablespoons of fennel bread stuffing into the hot oil, taking care to leave the breadcrumb mixture behind that if you place on top of the bottom of the pot, it will swell up. You want the fennel to be as flat as possible. Cook the fennel until it begins to change in color around the edges but is still a bit crisp in the center, about 2 minutes. Carefully remove the fennel and allow to cool slightly. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked fennel onto a platter and immediately sprinkle with a little coarse sugar. Serve warm. P. S.. If you don't wish to use the bread crumbs, you can use the breadcrumbs in a small bowl of butter and vanilla and toss in to thicken up the oil and flavor.

title: Raspberry Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ripe plum tomato, halved lengthwise ( ripe-donnoisse ) | 2 -4 tablespoons sliced raspberries ( raspberries will also do ) | 1 -2 slice bacon, cooked crumbled
instructions: Spread bacon in an 8x8 glass baking dish and place in oven. Cut tomatoes into quarters and arrange over bacon. Place raspberries over tomatoes, then top with crumbled bacon. Bake at 375 degrees f for 15 - 20 minutes until raspberries are bubbly and bacon is crispy.

title: Spinach, Pineapple, & Beef Broth

instructions: Drain marrow from can and discard marrow bones. Mash marrow in plastic bag with a fork, then stir in pineapple, spinach, and whipped topping. Cover soup and refrigerate 4 hours.

title: Corn With Herbs

instructions: Rinse the corn well, removing the husks.

instructions: In a large non metal skillet over moderate heat, heat the oil. Add the green peppers, olives, fennel seed and hot sauce. Cook, stirring, until hot, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat. Pour hot pepper mixture over the scallops and serve.

title: Easiest Ever French Toast

Serve with salsa and a side of guacamole.

instructions: Combine all the burger ingredients and mix well. Form into 4 - 6 patties. Heat a griddle or large nonstick skillet over medium heat, medium high heat. title: Cousin Petechers 2007
ingredients: 200 g dried apricots | 1/3 cup pesto sauce ( i used homemade )
instructions: Using a food processor or blender, whizz apricots until finely chopped, but they should not be pureed. Turn onto a clean plate or tray, adding the pesto sauce. title: Australian Sticky Bacon and Thyme Oat Sausages
ingredients: 8 slices streaky bacon, chopped | 8 ounces beef eye round, sliced thick | 4 ounces spinach leaves | 4 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 chile peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | cooking oats
instructions: Place bacon in a large, shallow nonreactive roasting tin large enough to hold rolled oats in a single layer. Using a sharp knife, slice streaky bacon into thin strips, about 1½ inches long. Sprinkle over bacon and beef. Using a vegetable peeler or the tip of a sharp knife, make diagonal cuts about 2½ inches deep at 1½ inch intervals on beef and pork to allow for shrinkage during cooking. Arrange spinach leaves, thyme, chile peppers, marjoram and oat strips on top and gently push the bacon down into mixture. Cover and chill in fridge for 4 hours. Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook bacon and beef in a large heavy based frying pan over medium heat, turning often, until browned, 5 - 6 minutes. Transfer to baking paper lined baking tray. Repeat with remaining ingredients to make 6 sausage sandwiches or 6 each. Serve each sausage topped with the fried bacon and oats.

title: Steamed Herring Salad (Zwt-8)
ingredients: 1 can whole wheat bread crumbs | 1 lb strawberry ( hulled and quartered ) | 1/2 cup margarita mix ( store bought ) | 14 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 8 ounces marinated herring fillets | 1/2 cup red onion ( minced ) | 1/4 cup amaretto ( or more if you really like it extra sweet and sour )
instructions: Mix breadcrumbs with margarita and bread crumbs in a medium sized mixing bowl. Tear off a few sections of strawberries and cut off the stems until you can roughly chop them up. Put the milk ricotta into a small bowl. Add corn oil and marinate the herrings. Pour olive oil around the inside of a wok/pan. Remove the marinated herring from the marinade. Put the herring pieces into the wok, coating each piece with the olive oil. Pour most of the olive oil into the wok while it's heating to make sure the herrings have a nice pink and crispy crust. Carefully add one tablespoon of the leftover marinade into the wok, mixing well. Continue to add a cup of the warm milk ricotta until it is at the consistency you desire. This step may not seem as thick or thin as it should be, but you should have some liquid left. When you are happy with the consistency of the cheese mixture, put 1 tablespoon or two of the ricotta mixture on each piece of herring to coat then top each breast of herring with another tablespoon of the ricotta mixture. Continue making the cheese and herring sandwich until it is all gone. To serve, put cheese sandwich on a plate, or cut sandwich in half and put a little bit of the cheese and syrup on top. Enjoy.

title: Mushroom Sauce for Pasta

instructions: Heat a medium saucepan containing just enough water to cover the mushrooms. Heat to boiling. Remove from heat and let stand until water is absorbed 5 minutes. Heat to boiling and cook until the vegetables are tender, stirring often. Remove from flame and stir in cream and serve immediately.

title: Greek Kicked Eggs

instructions: Cut the eggs into halves, peel. Slice the egg yolks into halves and set aside. Beat the egg whites until stiff in a large mixing bowl with a dash of milk and yogurt.

instructions: Heat oven to 400°f coat baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Combine liquid, coffee, baking powder, rind and celery. Pour liquid with coffee mixture into ungreased baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap. Bake 30 minutes or until tender. Remove plastic wrap.

title: Cannellini Bean Pie
ingredients: 200 g cannellini beans | 1 kg sirloin | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 2 cups vegetable stock | 5 sheets frozen rolled pie shells, ready-rolled | 3 ice cubes
instructions: Place the beans and beef in a large saucepan. Cover with water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer covered for 1 hour. Drain. Place the pastry on a baking tray and spread the beef over the pastry. Place in the oven and bake for 20 minutes or until the beef comes away from the bone. Remove from the oven. Place the remaining stock, cannellini beans and sirloin in a pan. Cook over medium high heat, mashing until smooth. Simmer until heated through. Take half the pies and fill with the bean mixture and return to the oven. Top with the remaining pastry. Crush the ice in a plate or bowl and pour over the filling. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden. Serve with a vegetable gravy or a vegetable accompaniment.

title: Pistachio Chips
