title: Spicy Sour Soup (Yataklete)
ingredients: 2 1/2 pints hot chicken stock or 2 1/2 pints hot beef stock | 1/2 lb biscuit dough ( use a log ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander powder | 2 -3 -4 small tomatoes | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1/4 cup plain rice milk | 1/2 cup key lime juice | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Bring stock to the boil. Remove from heat, add biscuit dough, and sprinkle with coriander powder. Remove dough from the refrigerator and leave for 10 to 15 minutes, depending on the thickness of the biscuit dough, the amount of dough left, and the size of the soup. If your dough is very wet you may need to add a little more water. Roll a small piece of dough out on a floured surface until it is less than 1/4 inch thick. Cut dough into strips about 1 1/2 wide, about 2 to 3 long. Make sure the strips are at least 1/2 inches long, with enough space between them so they can spread out evenly, and will not stick together in the soup, or the filling won't have enough room. Drop into boiling soup, reduce heat, and continue to simmer for 1 1/2 hours. While the soup simmers, prepare the topping. For this step, heat a small frying pan together with a few whole coriander leaves, or a small amount of dried mint. Take care because of the coriander's fragrance. Turn off heat for the first 3 - 6 minutes only, so the leaves don't burn. Remove coriander, add lime juice, and cool slightly. When soup is finished, add the topping ingredients. To serve, line a medium sized bowl with some warmed slices of bread for dipping. Top the bread with about 2 tablespoons of the topping, and place a couple of the coriander leaves on top. Serve hot.

title: Cheese Stalk (Spanish Style Stalk)

title: Bergie's Beef Noodle & Pesto Kugel
ingredients: 1 boneless beef roast | 12 ounces egg noodles | 1/2 cup prepared pesto sauce, plus more for drizzling
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f, spray one 8x8 inch or larger baking dish or roasting pan. If using a large, shallow roaster, pour enough water into the pan or roasting dish to come 1/4 inch up sides of the meat. Insert beef roast into the roasting pan if using a small saucepan. Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef to a paper towel lined plate. Discard the drip pan dripping. In a large saucepan of boiling water, cook rice noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, drain the noodles and add the pesto to the broth to make up one cup. Serve noodles, noodle mixture and gravy with additional pesto for garnish.

title: Roast Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 small deli roast beef | 12 ounces small egg noodles | 1 container cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 -2 jelly roll ( i like kraft brand ) | 1 teaspoon jelly
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions, but do not rinse under hot water, just undercooked.

Random Ingredients: white bread,almond flour,romaine lettuce,red chile pepper,lebanese cucumber,raisin
title: Tortilla Eton Mess
ingredients: 4 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1/4 cup almond flour | 1 lebanese cucumber ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 small red chile pepper, finely chopped | 2 large romaine lettuce, shredded
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the bread on a baking sheet. Combine the almond flour with the grated cucumber or lemon peel. Spread the mixture over the bread slices and evenly spread with the red chili and romaine lettuce. Broil for 2 to 3 minutes, or until golden.

title: Chickpea and Poblano Stew (Bolivianno Gulyas Na Papad)
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/4 teaspoon dried yeast | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger root | 3 large poblano chiles - sliced | 1 large head cabbage, cut into 2-inch wedges, cored | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 4 sprigs fresh raspberries ( optional ) | 2 fresh pasticano chile, sliced
instructions: To make the stew, stir together the peas with the yeast and ginger until dissolved. Place vegetables in a large pot over medium heat. Cover and allow to heat until very warm, about 5 minutes. Add the hot poblano peppers and cook and stir until evenly cooked, about 3 minutes. Place the cabbage wedges on top of the stew. Pour about 1/4 cup of water into the pot. Stir to blend the water with the yeast and add to the pot. Bring to a boil, then place over medium low heat, cover, and allow to cook until tender, 30 to 45 minutes. Stir in the chickpeas, return to a boil, then remove from heat. Allow to cool. Place 1 or 2 ramekins on a wire rack to cool. Wearing rubber gloves, place one or two slices of piscochos on top of the stew. Ladle hot stew into each ramekin, and garnish with whole pasticano chiles.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,beef stew meat,flat leaf italian parsley,salmon,white bread flour,jumbo shrimp
title: Sliced Fish, Norwegian Style
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh jumbo shrimp | 1 lb fish fillet, such as cod or 1 lb salmon, cut into thick slices | 16 slices firm white bread flour ( approximately ) | 4 cups strong white bread flour | coriander seed, to taste | 2 cups roughly chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Put the shrimp in a bowl and cover with cold water. Leave to soak for at least ten minutes. Rinse well under cold water and drain briefly. If the shrimp are bright pink on the outside and the tail is clear on the body, you’ll need to clean them immediately. Put the fish in a wide ovenproof dish. Cover all but the tail with the fish slices. Put together the bread flour and coriander seeds. Toss the bread flour and coriander seeds with half the parsley. Taste and mix more seasoning, if necessary. Dust the fish with remaining parsely. Put it in the oven and cook, uncovered, for thirty to forty minutes at 375°f keep an eye on that it doesn’t burn. It’s done when the top crust of the fish is crispy and the topping is a slightly crisp brown color, which should take about ten minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,ginger garlic paste,red currant jelly,cornflour,green onion
title: Sweet and Sour Corn Tortillas With Ginger
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 green onions, sliced | 1 tablespoon red currant jelly | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger ( or 1/2 tsp. dried )
instructions: Prepare the ginger garlic paste by grinding ginger and garlic into a fine paste with the cornflour and a little water. Coat the corn tortillas with the ginger garlic paste and roll in cornflour. Heat a frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the tortillas in batches for 1 - 2 minutes each side or till golden brown. Drain on a paper towel or kitchen towel. Keep warm in a low oven. Pour the red currant jelly on the corn tortillas. Place back on the heat. Sprinkle ginger and green onion on top. Serve hot or cold.

title: Saucy Potatoes and Beef
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 lb lean hamburger ( can use cooked hamburger if you prefer )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Cook and stir potatoes according to package directions, drain well. While the potatoes are still hot, mix in the vanilla, thyme and brown sugar. Set aside. Place the hamburger in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray and brown, stirring well, over medium heat. Add the potatoes and hamburger to the skillet, cover and bake for 10 minutes, or until heated through. Turn the pan and bake for five minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: white rum,chicken bouillon granule,butternut squash,ketchup,cottage cheese,nori,brown rice vinegar
title: Korean Broth
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice vinegar | 1/2 cup white rum | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 butternut squash, peeled, quartered and julienned | 1/3 cup ketchup | 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1/2 cup cottage cheese
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine rice vinegar, rum, and chicken bouillon granules. Add squash and stir in ketchup. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until squash is tender. Remove from heat and cool for 10 minutes. Spoon rice among serving bowls, top with cottage cheese, and garnish with nori seaweed pieces.

title: Brown Rice With Chiles and Jalapenos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1 medium jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup brown rice ( uncooked ) | 3 cups crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon cube,cherry,unsulphured molasses,taco seasoning mix,mint
title: Taco Bell Molasses and Mint Dip
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package unsulphured molasses | 2 vegetable bouillon cubes | 1/3 cup dried cherries | 1/3 cup chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Prepare taco seasoning according to package instructions, except add molasses and bouillon cubes. Combine remaining ingredients in a 2 quart sauce pan.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,green bean,grapefruit,lemon wedge,scallion,curry powder,beef tenderloin
title: Beef With Grapefruit and Scallion Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 lb grapefruit, peeled and roughly chopped | 4 teaspoons curry powder | 1 boneless beef tenderloin, 1-inch thick, sliced crosswise | 4 green beans, trimmed | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, snipped | 2 tablespoons scallions, thinly sliced | lemon wedge, and to serve
instructions: Heat a heavy nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Add the grapefruit zest and curry powder and cook until the zest starts to soften, about 1 minute. Add the beef and cook until seared, about 3 minutes or until golden, turning once. Transfer the beef to a plate and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Add the beans to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let stand for 5 minutes. Remove the beef and beans to a platter and tent with foil. Add the sun dried tomatoes and scallions to the pan. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until the tomatoes are plump. Stir in the sauce and drizzle with the juice from the lemons. Serve with lemon wedges. Enjoy.

title: Shrimp Bruschetta (Bread and Cheese Sandwiches)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh shrimp, cleaned deveined | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried mixed herbs | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1 cup pecorino cheese | 8 slices crusty french baguettes ( about 3/4 inch thick )
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil. Add shrimp.

title: Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 3 -4 large bell peppers, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 - 1 1/2 cup spanish onions or 1 -1 1/2 cup red onions, in slices | 1 1/2 cups salsa | 1/2 cup white wine
instructions: Cook peppers under a hot broiler, turning occasionally if a little charred, or bake in a 375 degree oven until they become very black all over. Transfer peppers to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Allow to cool enough to handle. Using your hands, roll the peppers into a roll about the size of a dinner plate. You don't want a lot of space, so be prepared to roll it thinly. Place the rolls under a broiler and fry, turning often, until evenly browned. Set aside on a plate and cover loosely with foil. Use tongs to hold the rolls. Add onions and sauté over medium heat until they are carmelized and browned and soft, about five minutes on each side. Add the spanish salsa and wine. Keep warm.

title: Peppered Pecans
ingredients: 2 lbs pecans, shelled | 3 tablespoons peppercorns | 1/3 cup vodka, preferably absolut bertoli | 4 tablespoons dry sherry wine
instructions: Preparation, crush the pecans to a coarse powder using your hands. Grind the toasted peppercorns into a fine powder using your hands. Add enough of the vodka to make a good mixture and stir until well blended. Stir in the peppercorns and sherry and store in the refrigerator. Tips, you can easily make this one day in advance and heat up in the microwave until the peppercorns melt.

title: Blue Cheese and Almond Spread (France)
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond meal ( not instant ) | 1 ounce crumbled blue cheese | 1/2 jar pimientos, cut into quarters
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover, store at room temperature for 1 hour or until thickened and cold.

Random Ingredients: blade steak,dark chocolate,chicken broth,mango chutney,green bell pepper
title: Mango Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 225 g premium premium blade steak | 450 ml chicken broth | 1 mango chutney, halved | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 2cm squares ( seeded and finely chopped ) | 225 g roasted mango chutney | 2 ounces dark chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place steak, broth, mango chutney and green pepper in a non metallic bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 10 minutes. Heat a high-hot non stick frying pan or wok over high heat. Add the beef and cook, stirring, about 3 minutes or until just cooked and tender. Stir in the chutney and serve with the roasted chutney.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,green capsicum,beef stock,red wine,swordfish steak,pine nut
title: Broiled Sea Salt Crab Eye Trout and Shrimps
ingredients: 1 pint beef stock | 1 small green capsicum, seeded & diced | 2 ounces pine nuts, toasted | 1 1/2 lbs swordfish steaks, raw | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 3 teaspoons dry red wine
instructions: Heat the beef stock in a heavy based saucepan over high heat until boiling. Lower to simmer. Add the capsicum and pine nuts and continue to simmer over low heat for 30 minutes. Meanwhile brush the steaks with a little olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Heat a small pan over high heat, add the fish and cook, turning once, for 5 - 6 minutes until cooked through. Transfer the steaks and capsicum to serving dishes and pour over the reduced stock. Serve with bread and salad greens.

title: Oven-Roasted Spinach Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust, split | 8 -10 ounces fresh baby spinach, washed | 18 sage leaves, washed
instructions: Sprinkle the spinach with salt and allow it to come to room temperature. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Unfold the pizza crust onto a work surface. Turn the crust over onto the spinach. Using a pizza brush, lightly spread the herb leaves across the top of the crust. With both hands, carefully lift the crust from the pizza base. Lay out the spinach on the pizza base, using a knife to cover the kale as much as possible. Sprinkle the sage leaves over the spinach. Lightly press the spinach into the dough. With a sharp knife, peel off the excess crust from beneath the spinach. Slice the pizza into 12 equal pieces. Place onto a baking sheet and bake for 5 - 10 minutes, or until the crust is crisp.

Random Ingredients: catsup,soy sauce,corn oil,cream celery soup,pine nut
title: American Pesto Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 16 ounces cream of celery soup | 16 ounces cream of celery soup | 8 ounces catsup | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1/8 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Mix together in bowl and refrigerate until ready to use or put in a jar in fridge for up to 2 weeks.

title: Grated Brinjal on Skewers
ingredients: 15 fresh brinjal | 1 jar brinjals, drained | 2 tablespoons pickling vinegar | 1/2 cup shredded low fat ricotta cheese
instructions: Cut off tips of brinjals and discard. Halve brinjal lengthwise and remove stem. Place brinjals cut side down in nonmetal bowl. Place brinjals with seeds and vinegar on top of brinjals. Cover bowl and marinate in refrigerator 2 hours. Prepare grill. Remove brinjals from bowl, thread onto skewers and discard marinade. Place brinjals in pan. Grill 5 - 7 minutes, turn and grill until cooked through, and brinjals are brown and tender. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Seasoning
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning blend | 1/4 cup prepared italian salad dressing mix, divided
instructions: Prepare and preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare the dry italian envelope according to package directions. Separate 1/4 cup of the italian salad dressing mix from the package of contents and stir to dissolve the seasoning with 2 tablespoons of the prepared italian dressing mixture. In a small bowl, whisk 1/4 cup of the prepared italian dressing mix with the other 1 tablespoon of the prepared dry italian dressing mix until well combined.

title: Baked Salmon Covered in Chocolate
ingredients: 4 lbs salmon | 1 teaspoon lawry's seasoned salt, divided | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce, divided | celery flakes | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup bittersweet chocolate, cut into small pieces
instructions: Line jelly roll pan with waxed paper, set aside. Rub salmon with 1/2 teaspoon lawry's seasoning salt. Place on prepared pan. Sprinkle generously with 1/4 teaspoon black pepper and spread evenly with chocoholic's mixture. Sprinkle with celery flakes and spread evenly with raisins. Cover with a second sheet of waxed paper. Starting at the narrow end, roll each salmon fillet into a tight cylinder. Place rolled fish on paper lined jelly roll pan. Repeat process with second salmon. Bake at 450° for 10 - 15 minutes or until salmon is cooked and tender. Remove from oven and set aside for 15 minutes before serving. Cut into thin slices and serve.

title: Smoked Bratwurst
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 ounces smoked bratwurst sausage, sliced | 4 ounces chutney | 1 tablespoon fruit pectin or 1 tablespoon fruit vinegar
instructions: Mix the cornstarch and a little water until a thick paste forms, then stir into the hot bratwurst. Serve with your favourite vegetables or burgers.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,dark rum,portobello mushroom cap,rump roast,italian bread
title: Grilled Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 portobello mushroom caps | 1 cup light rum | 12 slices rye bread | 1 loaf italian bread | 1/2 lb rump roast
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Remove mushrooms from stems, leaving about 1/2 inch of stems on mushroom caps.

title: Hot Italian Sausage
ingredients: 8 links bulk italian sausage | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Remove casing from sausage.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,vanilla extract,cracker,dark brown sugar,guacamole,grape tomato,braising steak,chili pepper flake
title: Guacamole Braised Steaks With Tamarind
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chile pepper flakes | 4 teaspoons hot sauce or 4 teaspoons chili paste | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 bag grape tomatoes | 1 lb trimmed braising steak or 1 lb steak | 1 cup tamarind paste | 1/2 pint grape tomatoes | 4 cups low-fat guacamole
instructions: To marinate, combine chilli, hot sauce, sugar, vanilla and tomatoes in heavy duty zip lock freezer bag and marinate steak for at least 2 hours or overnight. Remove steak from marinade. Arrange steak on a shallow backing dish and refrigerate for 20 minutes to allow marinade to soften a bit.

title: Tamarind and Chocolate Bliss
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups tamarind paste | 2 cups mini chocolate chips | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained
instructions: Boil the tamarind in an iron pot over a medium heat for 15 minutes until they are a light brown color. Allow them to cool before breaking them open with a spoon. In a microwave safe dish, combine the tamarind and chocolate chips. Microwave on high while stirring for an additional 5 minutes, making sure to stir every 30 seconds or so. Place the drained cherries in a plastic bag. Place a candy thermometer in the center of the jar. Set the timer for 10 minutes and check that the chocolate is melted. Spread the melted chocolate over the cherry, then swirl into a ball.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,chili sauce,malt vinegar,coriander powder,pineapple chunk,bacon dripping,carrot
title: Spicy Sweet & Sour Carrot Chips
ingredients: 2 medium carrots, grated | 200 g pineapple chunks, juice squeezed from pineapple | 2 tablespoons low-sodium spiced bacon drippings or 2 tablespoons drippings, from canned pineapple | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon malt vinegar ( can be replaced with white vinegar ) | 1 teaspoon chili sauce ( red or green )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c. Place grated carrots, canned pineapple, pineapple juice, bacon drippings and curry powder in a casserole dish or roasting tin. Season with coriander and chilli sauce. Cover and bake 20 - 25 minutes or until tender. Serve warm with a crisp green salad, rice, egg biscuits or crisp bread.

title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1 boneless skinless chicken breast | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 garlic clove ( minced, depends on taste and amount of patience )
instructions: In a pan combine, sugar, water, creole seasoning and garlic. Bring to a boil and then turn down heat.

title: Irish Golden Raisin Bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups golden raisins | 2 bunches fresh dill, trimmed, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine raisins and dill in a glass baking dish. Spread mixture on top of raisins. Bake bread in preheated oven 45 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,apricot,pecorino romano cheese,chocolate syrup,marjoram,green chili pepper,golden mushroom soup
title: Easy Slow Roast Lamb Shoulder Chili
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 1/2 cup dried apricot, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup golden mushroom soup | 1 - 1 1/2 lb lamb shoulder or 1 -1 1/2 lb leg of lamb, tied | 1 jar chopped sweet green chili peppers ( drained ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: In a small bowl or 2 cup measuring cup combine the chocolate syrup and apricots.

title: Fantastic Tastes the Saddest!!!!!!
ingredients: 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup tasty cheese | 1/8 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon chives | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: To prepare, sprinkle cheeses with chives. Spread ketchup on top and sides of grated cheeses.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,apple cider vinegar,white onion,dark chocolate,pear,extra virgin olive oil,green leaf lettuce,rutabaga
title: Mile High Pears and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb dark chocolate, bar | 1/2 lb rutabagas, rutabagas, rutabagas, rutabagas, rutabagas | 5 ounces dark chocolate, bar | 4 small firm pear | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 white onion | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 6 green leaf lettuce
instructions: Cut the chocolate bar into six equal pieces. In small, heavy saucepan melt the chocolate with the olive oil. Cook the onion over low medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until transparent. Turn off the heat. Peel the pear, core and grate on a fine, small grater or grater. Using your hands, peel the pear and cut it into 2 3/4 inch cubes. Set aside. Cut the green leaves of the lettuce into a cross on the bias. Put the cheese in a wide saucer or serving dish and set aside. Chop the apples into thin slivers. Arrange the pear slivers and apple slices in overlapping rows over the cheese in the dish. Pour over the melted chocolate sauce, and set aside in a warm place for about 15 minutes to allow the apples to warm up.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,apple cider,corn oil,onion powder,plum tomato,serrano chilies,red chilies
title: Mexican Red Hot Sauce
ingredients: 12 plum tomatoes ( chopped ) | 6 serrano chilies ( sliced thin ) | 2 lbs onions ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons red chilies | 8 teaspoons corn oil ( for frying ) | 1/2 cup apple cider ( optional ) | 12 lasagna noodles ( cooked )
instructions: Remove seeds from tomatoes, tomatoes and chilies and chop. Heat oil in large skillet and saute each ingredient until onion is translucent. Add tomatoes and chilies and mix well. Cover and cook for 15 minutes. Serve as part of an mexican meal with pasta sauce.

Random Ingredients: hash brown,white wine,thai basil,vanilla,bitter melon,black peppercorn,dark chocolate,flat leaf parsley
title: Peppered Goat's Belly Bons
ingredients: 20 pieces bitter melon | 200 g dark chocolate, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thai basil | 1/4 cup chopped white wine | 1 teaspoon dark rum ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon dark rum ( optional ) | 10 whole black peppercorns | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Line a large baking tray with baking paper and set aside. Place the bitter melons in a large saucepan. Over a high heat, bring to the boil the chocolate, parsley, basil and wine. Turn off heat. Remove from heat. Dip the bitter melons in the chocolate, then peel off the bitter melon skin. Place in a single layer in the tray and cover with aluminium foil. Place the filled bitter melons in the centre of the preheated oven and cook for 15 minutes or until lightly charred and tender. Remove the bitter melons and cool in a colander. Cut into wedges. Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Yoghurt Dipping Sauce for Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup yoghurt ( smooth ) | 2 tablespoons fish sauce ( nam pla )
instructions: Mix yoghurt, fish sauce and yoghurt together. Serve with vegetables.

title: Lentils, Orange and Sour
ingredients: 1 cup french lentil | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Soak lentils overnight. Drain well. Bring to a boil in a large, heavy saucepan. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 25 minutes, or until lentils are tender. Stir in orange juice. Cover. Simmer 5 minutes. Mix flour into hot lentil mixture. Cover. Cook 5 minutes, or until thickened.

title: Spicy Broccoli
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs broccoli, trimmed | 1/4 cup pomegranate molasses | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup chopped scallion | 1 tablespoon minced rosemary leaf
instructions: Steam broccoli until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Combine pomegranate molasses, apple juice, scallion, and rosemary in medium saucepan. Heat over medium heat. Bring to a boil. Cook, stirring often, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Transfer to serving bowl. Serve broccoli over sauce.

title: Walnut and Citrus Salsa
ingredients: 2 medium tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 3 tomatillos, husks removed and chopped | 1 medium orange, peeled, halved, seeded, and cut into segments ( about 1/2 cup pithy sections ) | 1 -2 garlic clove, pressed | 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup walnut halves
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a bowl and stir to mix with a wooden spoon. Note, i like to chill an orange half and a clove of garlic with the salsa, to infuse flavors into the dish. Note, i sometimes make a batch of these and freeze them for a week or two before serving, or i put them on a baking sheet, cut side up, and bake them at 375 degrees for 20 minutes, or until warm. Note, i use a serrano chile pepper with the sauce instead of the orange.

title: Sugtortillas De Calabaza
ingredients: 5 large eggplants | 4 slices white bread | 1 peach | 1 teaspoon cumin powder ( we like lots of ) | 1 -2 teaspoon corn oil
instructions: Cut eggplants into large chunks. Take off the skin and dice the eggplant until the pieces are about 1/4 inch thick. Put oil in bowl. Add the peaches and cumin powder and coat the eggplants. Add a bit of water if they are being used for flavor, and stir. Add the diced eggplants to the oil and cook them until they're tender. Drain off excess water, slice and toast the bread. Serve with a sprig of mint, tomato leaves and salsa on side.

title: Nutty Walnut Margarita
ingredients: 2 cups walnuts, crushed | 2 cups margarita mix | 1 box ice, crushed
instructions: Combine margarita mix and ice in a blender. Blend until smooth, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,yellow cake mix,chipotle chile adobo,white wine vinegar,yellow potato,rom tomato,beef bouillon granule,potato
title: Spicy Beef Potato Bake
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant minced garlic or 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons beef bouillon granules | 2 -3 lbs small yellow potatoes, cut into small chunks | 5 lbs medium red potatoes, cut into small chunks | 6 roma tomatoes, quartered | 4 ounces sliced jalapenos or 4 ounces hot pepper sauce
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Meanwhile, in large bowl, whisk together vinegar, 2 tablespoons of the garlic powder, 1/2 tablespoon of the bouillon granules, and 1 tablespoon of the flour. Add potatoes and tomatoes to bowl. Toss lightly to coat. Add 1 teaspoons of the garlic powder, remaining tablespoon of bouillon granules and the rest of the flour mixture to bowl. Mix well. Do not over mix. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Oil a 9 x 12 baking pan. Spoon half of batter into prepared pan and spread to cover the entire surface. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of hot pepper sauce and 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder. Repeat layering twice. Cover and continue layering until all layers are used up. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder. Cover pan tightly and bake approximately 1 1/2 hours until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Vegetable Pudding (Panna Cotta)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs veal, minced | 2 lbs baby spinach ( washed well ) | 4 1/2 tablespoons vanilla sugar or 4 1/2 tablespoons artificial sweetener
instructions: Place your veal in a pot you should have plenty of space for it to be completely submerged, preferably glass, or a non reactive pan. Sprinkle a little 1/2 teaspoon of the vanilla sugar onto the ground meat. Then place the spinach over it and allow to soak for about 3 to 4 minutes. Sprinkle the rest of the sugar on the meat and cook slowly on the stovetop until it bubbles vigorously around the meat and the spinach turns dark/brown, about 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from the heat, place in a serving bowl, or place in individual ramekins. Let it cool a bit. When it's set, stir it up with a wooden spoon until it starts to look a bit messy. Chill it in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours or overnight. You can have your veal cold, then, once its cold, remove from the refrigerator.

title: Stir Fry Oysters
ingredients: 12 oysters | 3 -4 tablespoons ketchup | 3 -4 teaspoons tom puree | 1 -2 teaspoon ginger | 1 can water chestnuts
instructions: Place all ingredients except for the water chestnuts in a large saucepan. Stir to combine. Add the water chestnuts and cook until golden brown.

title: Toulet (French Fried Turnips)
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips | 1 garlic clove | 1 tablespoon meat ( or poultry bacon )
instructions: In a pot, fill 2/3 inch with water.

Random Ingredients: licor,head garlic,tomato juice,egg noodle,lite olive oil,shallot,aluminum foil,swiss cheese
title: Noodle and Cheese Boulettes
ingredients: 5 cloves garlic | 3 shallots ( or a few pats of garlic on the inside of the boulettes ) | 2 cans diced tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup lite olive oil | 11 ounces egg noodles ( dry weight ) | 16 ounces shredded swiss cheese | freshly sliced aluminum foil | lillet lite olive oil ( optional, or use sunflower oil )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In 6 cup measure, crush the garlic cloves with the flat of a table knife on your counter. The cloves will make a nice little mess on the inside of your boulettes. Put garlic, shallots and tomatoes into pan and stir to combine. Stir in 1/2 cup of broth from the can on the side. Place lid on pan. Heat for 5 minutes. Transfer boulettes to oven and bake for 30 more minutes. While the boulettes are cooking, cook your egg noodles in a large pan of boiling water so noodles don't get mushy. Drain and divide noodles among 4 dinner plates. Cover with shredded cheese, ladle broth and noodles over noodles. Add a dash of olive oil if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1/3 cup olive oil or 1/3 cup vegetable oil | 1 medium chopped onion | 2 lbs lamb shoulder, cut into 6 pieces or 2 lbs ground beef | 29 ounces cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 26 ounces tomato sauce | 1/3 cup dark molasses | 1/3 cup frozen frozen peas, thawed
instructions: Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and lamb and brown well. Reduce heat if needed to brown meat. Stir in beans and tomato sauce. Mix in molasses and peas. Let simmer, covered, about 20 minutes until beans are tender.

title: Chinese Sesame Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 2 cups coarsely ground peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine the sesame seeds with the peanuts toasted sesame seeds. On a sheet of parchment paper, toss the nuts together forming a coarse layer. Place in a large mixing bowl and sprinkle with a pinch of salt. Sprinkle a layer of nut mixture on top, making sure all is evenly covered. Continue layering and sprinkle with remaining nut mixture, using more peanuts. Cover the bowl loosely with waxed paper or parchment paper and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured board and cut into large squares. Serve warm or cool.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,italian sausage,wheat breadcrumb,pearl barley,orange peel,basil
title: Scotch Eggs With Italian Sausage and Pearl Barley
ingredients: 10 italian sausages, each 1in | 1 cup light pearl barley | 3/4 cup uncooked whole wheat breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup dried basil | 1 tablespoon orange peel, finely chopped | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut sausages into 1in pieces, then split them into 2 halves. Place cut halves on greased cookie sheet and bake in a moderate oven for 10 - 25 minutes, or until cooked and browned, turning them as necessary. Meanwhile, cook barley in 6 cups of water. Cook for 15 minutes, then add sausages. Cook for an extra 8 minutes over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, or until heated through and most of the liquid has cooked away. Serve the cooked barley, whole wheat breadcrumbs, basil and orange peel on plates in small increments, with sausage and barley on the side. Serve warm. This also goes well with a green vegetable such as pumpkin seeds, cabbage wedges or zucchini.

title: Beef Liver in Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 500 g beef liver | 500 g bean sprouts ( fresh )
instructions: Heat up the frying pan. Slice liver into strips. Heat up the frying pan and add the liver strips. Add beans sprouts and fry for 5 minutes, turning constantly. Serve over mashed potatoes.

title: Crock Pot Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 1 boneless sirloin tip roast | 1 - 1 1/2 cup honey | 4 medium ripe apples, cored, sliced | 2 medium purple onions, sliced | 1 bag of stewing beef
instructions: Place the meat into crock pot. Sprinkle with 1/2 amount of honey. Top with sliced apples, onions. Mix remaining 1/2 the honey with the remaining honey. Pour over everything in crock pot. Add rest of honey and onions. Add salt and pepper. Cook on low 8 to 10 hours or high 4 to 6 hours. Remove from crock before serving.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,cashew nut,rice vinegar,bread crumb,cool whip,watercress,pineapple juice,parsnip
title: Pineapple Parsnip Rice Salad - No Dairy
ingredients: 1 large parsnip, peeled and sliced diagonally in 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 lb asiago cheese, minced | 1 jar crushed pineapple in juice, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup pineapples, juice reserved from can | 1/2 cup dried bread crumbs | 1/4 cup cool whip, for topping | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, minced
instructions: Combine together all ingredients in a large bowl or serving container. Stir in the pineapple juice until evenly coated. Let sit for at least 10 minutes to allow flavors to combine. Pour over salad just before serving.

Random Ingredients: tofu,water,vegetable oil cooking spray,chicken breast chickien strip,greek yogurt
title: Quick Greek Yogurt and Chicken Tofu
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 3/4 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon water | 1/2 lb firm tofu, drained and cubed | 1 box frozen chicken breast and chickien strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare grill, or line pan with cooking spray.

title: Chinese Steamed Vegetables
ingredients: 3/4 lb rutabaga, peeled and sliced into matchsticks ( about 1/4-in. thick ) | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Tie the rutabaga slices at 1 inch intervals with kitchen string. Place in a steamer basket or pot and push to one side of the steamer and set aside to steam over high heat for 5 minutes. Repeat for the remaining carrots. Sprinkle the vegetables with the five spice powder and serve hot.

title: Grannys
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 2 lbs sea scallops, drained
instructions: Grease an ovenproof dish. Put the flour in a large bowl. Make a well in the centre. Drop the sea scallops into the well. Knead with your fingers until the mixture is smooth. Make a well in the centre. Drop the mixture into the dish. Cover with a lid or oiled plastic wrap. Bake in a preheated oven at 170c/350f/gas mark 3 for 30 minutes. Allow to cool for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: cranberry bean,cooking couscous,goya sofrito sauce,kahlua,cooking oil,anaheim chili
title: Cranberry Beans and Chili With Couscous
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried cranberry beans | 1 3/4 cups quick-cooking couscous | 1 small anaheim chili, chopped fine | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chili or 1 teaspoon cayenne, to taste | 1/2 cup kahlua or 1/2 cup other coffee-flavored liqueur | 2 tablespoons sofrito sauce ( can sub soy sauce )
instructions: Pick through and remove any fragments or damaged beans. Bring beans to a boil in a large pot of boiling water and cook for 2 minutes. Cover, reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 5 minutes, or until beans are tender. Remove beans with a slotted spoon and reserve cooking liquid. Strain beans and cook them back into the pot for a minute or two, until tender. Meanwhile, cook couscous according to package directions. Stir in the peas, chile, and any remaining cooking liquid. Add the sofrito sauce and simmer for 5 more minutes. Pour into bowls, sprinkle generously with some of the reserved beans and serve.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,mexican chocolate,herb,vol au vent case,cabbage,chicken bouillon
title: Cabbage &  Herbs Stuffed Vol-Au-Vents
ingredients: 8 vol-au-vent cases ( vol-au-vent cases ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded cabbage | herbs ( i use mexican seasoning, see list ) | 5 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 250 g mexican chocolate ( preferably in chunks ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Use a large oven proof, ovenproof frying pan large enough to hold vol au vent cases in one layer. Mix together shredded cabbage, 5 teaspoons chicken bouillon, chopped mexican chocolate chunks and cornflour in a large bowl. Spoon over a little cabbage mixture, sprinkle remaining cabbage mixture on top. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chile Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb yellow potato, scrubbed, halved, washed | 1/4 cup grated cheese | 2 ounces fresh bacon ( if using salted bacon, finely chopped ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder | 2 pinches garlic, crushed
instructions: In a saucepan, boil potatoes covered in water until tender, about 12 minutes, then drain. Combine cheese, bacon, chili, garlic and salt and pepper to taste, adding cheese mixture. Toss potatoes with cheese mixture. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,ricotta cheese,white bread,white pearl onion
title: Ancient Roman White Bread and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 3 cups grated or shredded stale white bread | 8 cloves garlic, peeled, or to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom pod, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place the bread in a bowl. Toss in 1 c garlic, 1/2 c parmesan cheese and cardamom pods. Serve with other accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,white sugar,green chili pepper,scallion,mandarin orange,seasoning,salsa,orange juice concentrate
title: Mandarin Popcorn
ingredients: 4 green chili peppers, minced | 1 scallion, minced ( green onion also works ) | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1 can cream of pumpkin or 1 can cannellini beans | 3 tablespoons salsa | 1 tablespoon orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1/3 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a greased 2 quart casserole dish and bake for 30 minutes or until the casserole is hot. Topping, mix the sugar with the bread crumbs and sprinkle over the hot popcorn while it is warming up.

title: Watermelon, Bean & Grapes on the Skillet
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil or 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 2 cups watermelon, sliced into thin 2- to 4-inch chunks | 2 cups beans, cut in half | 1/2 cup green seedless grape, halved
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over moderately low heat until hot but not smoking, then saute the 1 cup bean, 1/2 cup watermelon and 1/2 cup grapes in the hot oil until hot, about 3 minutes.. Using tongs, transfer the bean mixture to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,chili bean,head cabbage,lemon juice zest,kidney bean,fenugreek seed,jicama
title: Honduran Red and White Cabbage Spread
ingredients: 1/3 cup dry kidney beans | 2 cans chili beans, rinsed and drained | 2 medium head cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/4 cup dried fenugreek seeds | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 1/2 lbs grated czech-style fenugreek pilaf or 1 1/2 lbs yellow lentils, rinsed | 8 ounces focaccia bread, sliced thin
instructions: Cover the dried beans with water at least 12 inches in a 3 to 4 quart saucepan, bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender, about 2 hours, and drain. Place the chili beans, cabbage, fenugreek seeds, lemon juice, and zest in a large bowl. Roughly chop the bean mixture and whisk it into the cabbage mixture. Cover and let stand until the flavors combine, about 10 to 15 minutes. Add the pilaf and mix. Spoon into bread rounds and garnish with a sprinkling of fennugreek leaves. To freeze, cover and refrigerate up to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: summer savory,vanilla extract,chili oil,kalamata olive,semolina flour,cardamom,rye bread
title: Egyptian Bread and Butter Pizzas
ingredients: 1/4 cup semolina flour or 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 ounces rye bread, crusts removed | 2 tablespoons dried grated smoked kalamata olives | 1/4 teaspoon summer savory | 1/4 teaspoon dried cardamom | 1 teaspoon chili oil, extra virgin | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix all ingredients well. Place mixture onto a parchment round baking sheet. Bake at 400° f for 10 minutes, until golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Stewed Beef Noodle Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1 cup vermicelli | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: In a large kettle of boiling, salted water, brown meat on all sides. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 1/2 hour. Remove meat. Remove water and stir in remaining ingredients. Return meat to kettle. Heat.

title: Navy Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup dried navy beans | 1 carrot, pared skinned and diced | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Wash beans in cold water until the water runs clear. Drain. Place beans and carrot in a container, cover with water, and set aside. Chop lemon zest finely. Place zest in a bowl of cold water to soften and dry the carrot. Drain the carrots and place into the bowl of cold water. Add lemon juice to the water and mix. Drain the beans and place them in a bowl. Toss with lemon zest and add the dressing. Stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,pastry dough,pumpkin puree,peach,chicken thigh,chocolate ice cream
title: Pumpkin Banana Chicken Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut in bite size pieces | 1 can pumpkin puree | 12 ounces miniature chocolate ice cream | 2 tablespoons bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon fresh grated chocolate ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dry bread crumbs | 1 can peach slices in syrup
instructions: Place chicken in a large frying pan, and spray lightly with oil then sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook on medium high heat for 5 minutes, then set aside to cool. Drain pumpkin, and mix with 2/3 can of the ice cream in a medium bowl. Spread the mashed pumpkin into the bottom of a non stick pizza baking dish. Top with half of the chicken and half of the crumbs. Top with remaining chicken and crumbs. Top with a layer of chocolate ice cream, then cover with pizza topping. Top with remaining 1 1/2 can of ice cream and sprinkle with dry bread crumbs. Cover with pizza pan plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Quick & Easy Burritos
ingredients: 3 cups cooked low-fat fideo pasta ( i use barilla's ) | 2 cans kidney beans ( drained liquid reserved ) | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika | 7 cups hot cooked quinoa
instructions: Stir the quinoa with the beans until everything has mixed well. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Cover and cook on low heat until quinoa is tender.

title: Baked Chimichangas
ingredients: 1 large egg white | 5 -6 ounces flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Pour an inch or two of water in the bottom of a 13 x 9 inch pan. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add 1 teaspoon olive oil, swirling pan to distribute oil. Sprinkle half of the tortillas over the bottom of the pan. Turn heat to low and cook until lightly puffed, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a large plate and cover to keep warm. Repeat process with remaining oil, tortillas and tortillas. Sprinkle remaining 2 teaspoons oil over top. Bake at 425 degrees, until golden and crisp, about 15 minutes. Cool slightly before cutting.

title: Bratwurst With Crackles
ingredients: 1 lb fresh bratwurst, trimmed | 1/2 cup dry-roasted unsalted dry-roasted cashews or 1/2 cup pepitas ( 1 1/2 tbsp ) | 2 tablespoons catsup | 4 teaspoons liquid smoke, preferably sweetened to taste | 1/2 teaspoon table salt or 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Cook bratwurst in boiling salted water just until crisp tender, approx 3 - 4 minutes. Drain on paper towels, sprinkle with catsup and set aside. Microwave cashews for 3 - 4 minutes until toasted and fragrant. Spread nuts on serving plate, drizzle with oil. Season with table salt and cracked black pepper and serve with bratwurst.

title: Cajun Dressing
ingredients: 1 stalk celery, minced | cooking spray
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir celery in hot skillet until tender, about 5 minutes. Spread celery in a shallow bowl.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,taco seasoning,salad oil,green chilies,baby portabella mushroom,brown rice
title: Brown Rice With Mushrooms & Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 package baby portabella mushrooms | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 cup brown rice, cooked | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 -4 tablespoons mild green chilies, chopped | 1 ounce sour cream
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and slice the chiles, using a very sharp knife. You need 2 or 3 slashes for each slice. Put the mushrooms and chiles into a bowl and add 1 tablespoon of salad oil and mix well until mixed. Add the 2 tablespoons of taco seasoning. Mix again then add the brown rice & mix well. Add 1 ounce sour cream to each bowl or serving plate and top with mushrooms chile mixture. Enjoy.

title: Pot Sticker Soup
ingredients: 32 fluid ounces beef stock | 1 teaspoon whole peppercorn, cracked | 1 lemon, thinly sliced | 8 -10 cherry tomatoes, cut in quarters | 8 -12 ounces fresh egg noodles or 8 -12 ounces egg noodles, cooked | 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns, ground ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon ground dried chili-garlic paste, to coat bowls if desired
instructions: Warm stock.

title: Spanish Creamy Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh asparagus | 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped | cayenne pepper
instructions: Snap off and discard the tough stems of the asparagus. Slice off the tips of the stems at the tips and discard. Cut off the woody ends from the asparagus leaving 4 - 6 long pieces of asparagus. Wash the asparagus well under running water. Cut the tips apart on the tips. Remove any remaining white tough stalks or flowers such as small as cauliflower or parsnips. Place the pieces into boiling water and then leave to cook until just tender. Rinse under cold water and drain thoroughly. Heat the oil or butter in a frying pan and add the papettes and asparagus. Season to taste with the cayenne pepper and cook gently until the asparagus is heated through. Serve warm or at room temperature. Delicious served with rice or with pasta.

Random Ingredients: chicken,egg yolk,italian dressing,french bread,caper,brown mustard seed,red wine vinegar,lard
title: Zippy Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chickens | 2 cups sliced cooked chicken | 1/3 cup italian dressing | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons capers | 2 beaten egg yolks | 8 slices french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the chicken, french bread, and the cooked chicken in a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Spoon the salad dressing over the chicken, and then sprinkle with mustard seeds, capers, and egg yolks. Bake, covered, at 400 degrees f for 20 minutes, then uncover, and bake an additional 5 minutes, or until chicken is a bit dry.

Random Ingredients: pork,puff pastry,tortilla chip,egg noodle,tomato juice,bamboo skewer
title: Chef Burt Reynolds Beef Enchilada Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry sheets | 16 ounces boneless pork, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( or you can use deli pork, if you can find it ) | 12 ounces egg noodles | 1 can petite diced tomatoes, undrained | 12 ounces chopped bamboo skewers | 1/2 cup tomato juice, for thinning ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Prepare a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray. In a large oven proof skillet over medium heat, add pork cubes. Cook, stirring often, until pork is browned. Drain excess fat. Remove pan from the heat and set aside. Cook egg noodles according to package directions, drain and rinse with cool water. Drain well and set aside. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Remove pork mixture and place in prepared pan. Top with noodles, then add reserved pork mixture, tomatoes, bamboo skewers and tomato juice. Cover and bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with salt and pepper mixture.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,lemon zest,green onion,golden raisin,plum sauce
title: Green Onion Pie
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 3/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 teaspoon ground lemon zest | 1/3 cup plum sauce or 1/3 cup plum jam | 2 -3 green onions | powdered green onion, extra for garnish
instructions: Roll out pastry shell and cut into four circles. Place one circle on large piecrust. Combine raisins, lemon zest and plum sauce and spoon over pastry and smooth the top. Sprinkle with extra green onions. Place second pie pastry circle on top and crimp around the edges. Brush tops with egg white. Bake in 200 °c 180 °c oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Cut into 8 wedges and serve hot. Serves 4 as an appetizer.

Random Ingredients: lemonade,dill,lettuce leaf,mexican cheese,saffron thread,tomato clam juice cocktail
title: Pasco Saffron  Salad
ingredients: 4 large lettuce leaves | 2 cups chopped fresh tomatoes and clam juice cocktail | 1/2 cup lemonade | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed and crushed | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/8 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Line 3 large salad bowls with lettuce leaves, tearing or serving slices as needed. Arrange tomato slices, clam juice cocktail, lemonade, saffron, cheese and dillweed on the lettuce leaves. Top with fresh bread if desired.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,liquid honey,monterey jack cheese,russet potato,mango chutney
title: Potatoes Monterey
ingredients: 1/2 lb russet potato, rinsed and sliced | 1/2 tablespoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1/2 cup reduced fat monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup mango chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place potato slices in a medium size cooking pot. Sprinkle with turmeric.

title: Vodka-Thyme Braised Chinese Cabbage With Herbs
ingredients: 1/4 cup sake | 2 teaspoons grated gingerroot ( about 1 inch ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 8 cups chinese cabbage ( about 2 large head ) | 2 1/2 fluid ounces vodka
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 - 3 qt heavy bottomed pot over high heat and bring to boil, covered. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is barely wilted, about 1/2 hour. Cover and raise heat to high and boil until cabbage is just tender, stirring once at a time, about 45 minutes total. Remove from heat, cover and keep warm until ready to serve.. Cut cabbage into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,sage,vegetable oil cooking spray,maple syrup,tahini
title: Chewy Sage & Maple Glaze
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon maple syrup or 1 tablespoon honey | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 teaspoon sage ( optional ) | olive oil or vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Combine all ingredients in a bowl & mix well.

title: Easy Beer Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup gluten-free flour | 1/4 cup pumpkin puree | 1 1/2 cups beer | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste ( see note ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly in bread machine. Set to 2 to 3 cups. Remove and put back in breadmaker. Bread should be on when desired crustness is met. If bread is too wet afterbreading cool, i usually cool completely before putting into bread mold.

title: Basic Beef, Lettuce, and Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs beef bones or 1 3/4 lbs beef tips | 1/4 cup seafood-based seasoning ( or other seasoning ) | 14 3/4 ounces beef stock or 14 3/4 ounces chicken stock | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Combine broth and beef and seasoning in a crockpot. Cook on high for 4 hours, then reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 3 hours, stirring from time to time. Remove soup from the crockpot. Serve piping hot on a bed of fresh lettuce and dipping sauces.

title: Lamb & Melon Skewers
ingredients: 200 g lamb, diced | 3 green chilies, seeded and chopped ( i used 2 small ones for the skewers ) | 1 honeydew melon, cut into cubes
instructions: Thread lamb, green chillies and melon cubes onto skewers. Brush with honey.

title: Spicy Indian Burritos (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese, cubed | 1 cup uncooked white rice | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot. Turn crock pot on high and cook for two hours. Remove from crock pot and serve in flour tortillas with shredded cheddar cheese. Makes four servings.

title: Saffron Arrachera (Chinese Barbecue Rice Balls)
ingredients: 4 cups glutinous white rice, uncooked | 1/4 lb catsup or 1/4 lb spicy red pepper | 1/4 lb saffron | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 12 sheets lasagna noodles
instructions: Prepare rice mixture as directed on box, using water and sugar to equal 3 cups. Rinse rice in cold water until water runs clear. Drain completely. In saucepan, add raw rice, catsup/salsa, saffron and simple syrup. Bring to boil over medium high heat, cook stirring occasionally, until ingredients are well combined and rice mixture is tender. Remove from heat. In greased 13x9 baking pan, layer 1/8 of noodles in rows, and cover with layer of rice mixture. Repeat layering with noodles, rice and rice mixture. Cover pan with wax paper, and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator and let stand 20 minutes or up to 2 hours before serving.

title: Texas Roast Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb deli roast beef | 1 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: Slice roast beef and place on one slice of roll. Cover with pepper sauce and then top with remaining roll. Slice into 6 wedges.

Random Ingredients: caper,habanero sauce,szechuan peppercorn,chicken breast half,chili pepper flake,plain flour,bay scallop,red radish
title: Spicy Chicken Scallop With Charmoula
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves | 1 lb bay scallop | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 habanero sauce | 1 red radishes, sliced thin | 1 chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup drained capers, chopped | 3 -5 teaspoons szechuan peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Coat with flour. Cook in frying pan sprayed with vegetable oil until golden brown all over, turning once. Drain on paper towles. Meanwhile, heat the chilli pepper and capers in a small saucepan for about 15 minutes, then pour into a mortar. Add the spiced chicken and stir well. Add to the pan, along with the drained capers. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the chicken is just cooked and the sauce is thickened.

title: Spicy Seasoning (Paprika)
ingredients: 1/3 cup water | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine ingredients in small bowl. Store away from direct sunlight.

title: Pinchsoo
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, sliced into 1/2 inch thick slices | bamboo skewer
instructions: Poke holes with a sharp fork all over the beef slices. Rub with the skewer. Place skewers on a rack in a shallow pan. Cover with plastic wrap and grill, turning once, until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.

title: Sweet and Tart Turnips
ingredients: 2 1/2 large turnips, peeled and cut in half ( can use any sweet potato that will hold together ) | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 lime wedge | 7 egg yolks | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper, plus more for sprinkling | 1/4 ounce bittersweet chocolate ( or other good-quality, melting-safe lard ) or 1/4 ounce semisweet chocolate, grated ( or other good-quality, melting-safe lard )
instructions: Bring a kettle of salted water to boil. When it is boiling, add turnips and cook, 1 minute. Turn off the heat and let stand 5 minutes, then pat with paper towels to remove excess water. Remove turnips with tongs or tongs and immediately transfer to a bowl. Set aside while preparing the remaining ingredients. Prepare the béchamel sauce by combining the egg yolks and half the cayenne pepper and whisking in the melted chocolate. Stir in the remaining cayenne pepper. Set aside. Place the turnips into a large pot with boiling water. Cover the pot and bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately remove the lid, return to the boil and cook, covered, until very tender, about 25 to 30 minutes. Drain the turnips well and serve hot, with the béchamel sauce and drizzled with a little parmesan cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,apple cider,chocolate square,black pepper,amaretto,tequila,ham,cottage cheese
title: Mexican Ham Parfait
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsweetened apple cider | 2 tablespoons light sour cream | 1 tablespoon mascarpone cheese | 1/2 teaspoon honey or 1/2 teaspoon agave nectar | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated black pepper | 1 lb ham, shaved | 2 chocolate squares, melted
instructions: Combine cider and sour cream in a small saucepan and heat to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Add mascarpone, honey, amaretto and black pepper, and simmer until the cream is reduced by a little and thickened, about 3 minutes. Place ham in shallow, buttered casserole dish. Pour the warm cream/cabbage mixture over the ham. Drizzle chocolate pieces over the top of the ham, spreading to cover evenly. Bake at 325° for 25 - 30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the top is lightly browned.

title: Danish Countryside Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 4 thick boneless pork loin | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves | 4 button mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon distilled white vinegar
instructions: Trim fat from loins. Cut into 1 inch cubes. Cover and marinate at room temperature 30 minutes or refrigerate overnight. Slice mushrooms into 1 inch pieces. Drain marinade from pork cubes. Remove pork and set aside. Thread pork onto metal skewers. Place on hot grill and cook about 7 minutes on each side, or until done. Transfer from skewers.

title: Burgami
ingredients: 2 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1/2 cup prosciutto di parma | 1 package bacon wrapped burritos di parma with prosciutto
instructions: Fry the burritos until a light golden brown on both sides. Take out when it is browned, and slice into strips. Wrap each burrito with the prosciutto. Fry one side of each burrito until golden brown, and cut in half to serve.

Random Ingredients: paprika,self raising flour,green cabbage,grand marnier,sea salt,onion
title: Golden Colcannon (Bunuelos)
ingredients: 1 medium onion ( or 1 cup or 1 cup if preferred ) | 1 cup green cabbage ( or 1 cup or 1 cup in combination ) | 1/2 cup grated raw onion | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1 tablespoon grand marnier ( or to taste, i've use 2-4 drops a good brand ) | 1 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a large frying pan soften onion in olive oil or butter. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Arrange the coated pieces in an ovenproof casserole dish and top with brown sugar on top. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve warm or cold. Note, if not using right away, leave in fridge until needed.

title: Cheese Soup
ingredients: 4 teaspoons cornflour | 4 1/2 ounces queso fresco, crumbled | 1 1/2 2 cups cold water or 2 cups low-fat water
instructions: Mix cornflour with cold water. Pour into a bowl. Stir in cheese and stir until combined. Pour into 4 individual 4 ounce crocks or soup tins. Cook in a slow oven until bubbling and the cheese is lightly browned, 45 min to 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,fontina cheese,strawberry preserve,rosemary,bread crumb,sherry,dark corn syrup
title: Strawberry Fondue
ingredients: 1 can dark corn syrup | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 8 cups fontina cheese, shredded | 2 cups fresh strawberries and fresh rosemary, washed and chopped | 1 1/2 cups dry bread crumbs
instructions: In a small saucepan on the stovetop, bring the corn syrup, sherry, and vinegar to a boil. Lower the heat, and simmer slowly for about 15 minutes. Remove from the heat, stir in the fontina cheese, and cool to room temperature. Mix in the fresh strawberries and rosemary, and transfer to a fondue pot. Cook over low heat for about 1 1/2 hours, adding bread crumbs as necessary to keep from sticking to the bottom of the fondue pot.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,flour,bulk italian sausage,corn tortilla chip
title: Homemade Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes ( rinsed and sliced ) | 1 lb bulk italian sausage ( crumbled ) or 1 lb mild italian sausage, i have my butcher slice it thinly | 1/2 teaspoon flour ( heaping ) | corn tortilla chips
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender drain and set aside. Spray a frying pan with non stick spray and heat up. Stir in sausage and cook until brown. Set aside and mix in flour. Drain potatoes and add in flour mixture all at once and stir. Sauté chips in oil and toss. Put in to a large well buttered baking pan. Spread some chips onto chip slices. Spread with sausage mixture. Sprinkle with additional chips. Bake at 400 degree for 15 minutes.

title: Easy Garlic Clam Dip
ingredients: 2 cans sliced clams with juice | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Cut baguette in half lengthwise. Place the loaves on a baking sheet. Cover with foil so that the bread doesn’t touch each other. Place in a 375º oven for about 15 minutes or until bread is toasted. Meanwhile, drain juice from cans of clams with juice and drain excess juice from crackers. Spoon the garlic cloves on toasted side of french bread. Serve with clams crackers.

Random Ingredients: red bean,hot paprika,mirin,chocolate,green enchilada sauce,hamburger,cool whip,maple syrup
title: Cajun Style Red Beans Chili
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mirin ( sweet soy sauce ) | 2 tablespoons hot paprika | 1 lb hamburger ( leaner ground beef may also be used ) | 2 cans red beans ( drained ) | 1 pint cool whip | maple syrup | red beans ( garnish ) | green enchilada sauce ( garnish )
instructions: Over medium high heat, lightly brown hamburger and drain. In large pot, combine evaporated can of red beans with the other can of red beans with liquid. Simmer on low heat for one hour. While beans are simmering, whip cream in large bowl. Add a few drops of maple syrup to cream as desired. When beans are done boiling, add cream and a few drops of warm paprika to cream.

Random Ingredients: tequila,corn chip,red cayenne pepper,saltine crumb,plum tomato,black bean,parsley,peach
title: Spicy Black Bean and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can black-bean rinsed and drained | 1 can pimento-stuffed peaches, drained and cut into matchstick slices | 3 plum tomatoes, thinly sliced or quartered | 1/2 cup finely diced fresh parsley | 1/3 cup tequila | 1/2 cup dry corn chips | 1 teaspoon saltine crumbs
instructions: Mix the black beans, pimentos, tomatoes, parsley, tequila, corn chips and saltine crumbs together in a large bowl. Chill before serving.

title: Quick Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin roast | 1/4 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup orzo pasta or 1/2 cup other small pasta, such as ditalini
instructions: Cut pork loin in 4 pieces. Mix flour and orzo in separate medium bowl in a shallow dish and dredge pork pieces in flour. Place pork in skillet and brown on both sides. Pour off any fat. Cover and simmer on low heat about 1 hour until pork is tender and pasta is tender.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,coriander seed,cayenne,tomato green chilies,swiss chard,puff pastry,bean sprout,yogurt
title: Chard & Bean Sprout Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup swiss chard, chopped | 1/2 cup bean sprouts | 1 can diced diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 teaspoons cayenne ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon low-fat yogurt ( optional ) | 250 g puff pastry | 4 -5 ice cubes
instructions: Cook the swiss chard, bean sprouts & tomatoes with all the seasonings in a saucepan on low heat until the liquid has boiled off. Stir often, so you don't burn your mouth. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Line a pie plate with your pastry, trim the edges and then poke 3 - 4 holes with a sharp knife until you have a border of pastry. Pour the bean sprouts & tomato mixture in your pastry and sprinkle the berries on top. Pinch the edges of the pastry to seal the filling. Cook the pie on a baking sheet in a preheated oven 375&#260.

Random Ingredients: papaya,garlic,sauerkraut,green chilies,yellow pepper,sugar snap pea,thyme sprig,beef rib
title: Spicy Beef Ribs
ingredients: 1/2 cup sauerkraut | 3 tablespoons yellow sweet pepper, chopped | 6 green chilies, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1/2 cup sweet papaya, peeled, chopped | 1/2 cup sweet potato, peeled, chopped | 1/4 cup sugar snap peas | 1 medium fresh thyme sprig
instructions: In medium bowl, combine raisins and peppers. In blender or food processor, blend sauerkraut, peppers, chilies, garlic, papaya and sweet potato until smooth. Stir in sugar snap peas and thyme.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,red chile,lime wedge,peanut oil vegetable,tomato,green pepper,cardamom,dark brown sugar
title: Fiery Red Chile Nuts
ingredients: 1 green pepper, seeded and sliced | 1 large red chile, seeded and chopped | 2 ounces dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup mixed roasted peanuts or 1/2 cup roasted cashews, chopped | 2 medium tomatoes, chopped | 2 green cardamoms, cracked open | 4 small green cardamoms, split lengthwise | 2 teaspoons peanut oil or 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Make slits in the pepper with finger length and width of knife. Bake peppers on a rack in a 450 degree f oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, cool, and dry peel away black peels. Dip peppers into sugar and place on paper towel lined rimmed cookie sheet. Bake at 450 degrees f for 10 minutes. Remove pepper from oven and set aside to cool slightly. Stir peanuts and remaining ingredients into sugar and place in small saucepan. Stir over medium heat until heated through and remove from heat. Pour mixture into a large heatproof bowl. Arrange peanut mixture on top of nuts and set aside to cool. When serving, garnish with sliced lime wedges.

title: Hot Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 bag fresh ramen noodles | 1 bag fresh mushrooms | 1 bag fresh red beans, cut in half | sargento choy pickle | coriander sprig
instructions: Soak ramen noodles in hot water for 10 minutes, till softened. In a large bowl mix the noodles, mushrooms, beans, pickles, and coriander. Put on a hot grill or cook under a broiler till bubbling.

title: Sausages With Dill
ingredients: 3 ounces mild sausage, cooked but not chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh dill sprigs, plus extra dill sprigs, to garnish | 1 ounce sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f / 220°c /gas rub the chook or baking paper with a little oil and sprinkle over the salt. Arrange all the ingredients in the following order, sage, cheese. Top with the dill sprigs. Close, using the end of a table knife to make neat recesses on the surface of the sausages. Put the sausages on a shallow ovenproof dish. Bake in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes, or until golden and cooked through. Serve warm with butter, if desired.

title: Pickled Garlicky Dried Beef
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 1/2 cups rice vinegar
instructions: Combine oregano and vinegar. Pack beef into a glass jar. Add oregano mixture on top of the beef, close jar tightly and refrigerate for at least 1 week before using.

title: Torshi - Eggs
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, shelled and peeled | 6 slices ham | 1 - 2 teaspoon garlic pepper seasoning ( or to taste )
instructions: Cut the eggs in half lengthwise. Remove the yolks, cut off the whites, and cut the yolks into small slabs. Cut the ham slices into thin strips. In a bowl mix the egg slabs with the garlic pepper and black pepper over medium heat. Dip the ham strips into the beaten egg, and continue to sauté for another 2 - 3 minutes. Serve hot with lots of kool or chappati.

title: Pumpkin Pears With Fresh Grape
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh grapes | ground black pepper | grapes or fresh edible zucchini | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Remove grapes from stems or remove stones. Wash grapes thoroughly with a fresh wash and dry with a dry towel. Make sure to remove any seeds from the grapes. Place grapes in a medium hot skillet. Add black pepper and black zucchini. Cook on medium heat for approximately 5 - 10 minutes. Add the vanilla and continue to continue to cook. After about 5 - 10 minutes, taste and adjust seasonings. Serve in individual plates, sprinkling grapes, fresh edible zucchini or raw nuts over top.

title: Korean Potstickers
ingredients: 1 bag ketchup | 1 cup instant rice noodles
instructions: Add ketchup to 1/2 cup water in saucepan and bring to boil over med heat while stirring and stirring until smooth. Stir in 1 cup rice noodles and place on waxed paper. Let cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,mint,tahini,red curry paste,tomato green chilies,horseradish,turkish bread
title: Chilli Artichoke Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup tahini | 1/3 cup prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon finely chopped of fresh mint | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 10 -12 slices turkish bread, cut crosswise in half | 20 marinated artichoke hearts
instructions: To make the dressing, whisk the tahini, horseradish and mint together. Season with curry paste, if desired. For salad, arrange bread on small serving platter or individual serving plates. Top with artichoke hearts, drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,blueberry,pecorino romano cheese,grape,cooking spray,guacamole,rice vinegar,shrimp
title: Faux Seafood Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup grape vinegar | 1/4 cup finely grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 8 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 cups canned crab-flavored farfalle pasta | 1 cup halved cranberries | 1 package fresh blueberries | 2 tablespoons minced seeded sun-dried tomatoes ( optional )
instructions: Stir vinegar mixture and 1/4 cup cheese together in a small dish or skillet and set aside. Spray large skillet with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,red kidney bean,tilapia fillet,gruyere,raspberry syrup,pecan
title: Tilapia Florentine
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets, approximately 1 1/2 pounds total | 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can pineapple juice | 1 package frozen chopped pecans, thawed and drained | 1 1/2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons raspberry syrup
instructions: In large skillet, combine beans, pineapple juice, pecans, and gruyere cheese. Heat over low heat, stirring occasionally. Place fish in a lightly greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Drizzle with raspberry syrup. Bake covered at 375 degrees f for 10 minutes until lightly browned. Uncover and bake 5 more minutes until fish is cooked. This dish can be baked ahead and refrigerated overnight. Reheat before serving.

Random Ingredients: currant,ginger ale,marinara sauce,white wine vinegar,berry,flat leaf italian parsley
title: St. Patrick's Day Berry Relish
ingredients: 2 cups mixed berries ( your choice - strawberries, blueberries, raspberries or blackberries ) | 1 cup white wine vinegar ( red-wine vinegar is best if you can get it ) | 1/2 cup mixed currants | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate. Keeps well for several days. Keeps well for 2 days.

title: Artichoke Squash Gratin
ingredients: 8 -10 medium squash, halved and deseeded | 14 ounces artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 cups double cream or 1 1/2 cups cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut the squash in half lengthways. Slice the halves in half crossways, then into 2cm slices. Place the strips in a baking dish. Sprinkle over the chopped artichoke hearts. Divide the cream between the two baking dishes, making sure it's at least 1 cup/pieces.

title: Hoisin Glazed Bacon
ingredients: 5 lbs bacon, rind removed | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1/4 cup liquid honey
instructions: Prepare a large roasting pan by lining it with plastic wrap. Bring a pan of water to a boil. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the bacon, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown. Drain the bacon slices, reserving the drippings, and transfer them to the roasting pan. Bake at 350°f about 20 minutes or until nicely browned. Drizzle the drippings from the skillet over the bacon and sprinkle the hoisin sauce and honey over it. Continue baking, basting with the drippings, until the bacon pieces are tender and have a crisp texture, about 1 hour longer.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,mace,peanut butter,red chilies,pork tenderloin,sumac,onion flake,irish whiskey
title: Spicy Pork Gyros
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup dried onion flakes | 1/4 cup dijon-style dry mustard or 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 1/2 cup finely chopped dried maraschino cherries | 1 lb lean pork tenderloin, membrane cut from 1- 2 inches in length ( or use 2 lbs boston butt pork tenderloin, cut from 1- 2 inches in length ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 6 dried red chilies, sliced 1/4 inch thick
instructions: Whisk together peanut butter, one/2 cup dry mustard or whisky, cherries, and remaining dry mix ingredients in a large bowl until blended. Add pork.

title: Hot Italian Pea Salad (Puerco Com Molcajete)
ingredients: 200 g frozen peas | 1/2 cup cotija cheese, grated ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup honey ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 can italian-style chopped tomatoes, with juice | 2 slices prosciutto ( optional )
instructions: First, boil the peas with about 2 tablespoons of water for about 5 minutes until almost cooked but you still have a bit of resistance. Then, drain them and take out any remaining liquid. Chop the peas up the peas until you have 4 equal sized pieces. Combine the cotija or feta crumbles and the honey in a bowl. Taste the mixture and if it is mild or sour you can gradually add sugar, but i prefer it pleasantly tart. Add the vanilla essence and tomatoes. Mix well, until it is a fairly thick consistency. Remove from the heat and chill. When ready to serve, just before serving, remove the peas from the refrigerator and chop them up. Tear the prosciutto into small pieces and put in a microwavable dish. Add about 2 tablespoons of the syrup from the can onto the prosciutto, and microwave on high for about 1 minute to soften the cheese. Add to the sauce and mix well. Transfer to a serving bowl, add some remaining syrup and serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bouillon,olive oil,pork loin,vanilla syrup,hazelnut,poblano chile,chili sauce,vanilla
title: Spanish Pork Loin With Chili and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 lb boneless pork loin, tied | 1 1/4 cups prepared sautéed hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 poblano chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1 cup chili sauce | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla | 1 teaspoon instant bouillon | 1/3 cup prepared vanilla syrup
instructions: In a large skillet over high heat, warm the olive oil. Season the pork with salt and pepper. Add the pork and sauté for about 3 minutes or until evenly brown. Transfer the pan temporarily to a cutting board. Turn the heat down slightly. Add the hazelnuts and poblano pepper and cook, stirring often, for 5 minutes or until the pepper just starts to soften. Add the chili sauce, vanilla, and bouillon and stir until combined. Scrape the bottom of the pan with a spatula to remove any browned bits from the surface of the pan. Add the remaining nuts. Transfer the mixture to a warmed serving dish and serve immediately.

title: Low Fat Yogurt Salad
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 cup water chestnut, drained | 1/2 cup skim milk ( or almond milk )
instructions: Put the water chestnuts in a blender, chop and puree. Add the yogurt and puree until it's smooth. Add as much milk or almond milk as you want this makes it more creamy and has a thicker consistency. Refrigerate for at least half an hour before serving to allow flavors to blend.

title: Chocolate Oranges
ingredients: 50 g unsweetened chocolate | 6 oranges bell peppers | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Break off the ends of the oranges and remove the peel from about 1/3 of the membrane. With a sharp knife, slice them in half lengthwise. Place the cut peel into a bowl, melt the chocolate in a dry saucepan over low heat, stirring until smooth. Stir in the orange sections, and the remaining chopped nuts. Serve the oranges immediately.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,peanut,dark soy sauce,garlic salt,vanilla,lemon peel
title: Dry Apricot Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts | 2 tablespoons dried apricot jam, melted | 1/4 teaspoon dried lemon peel ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon fresh lemon juice ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender and pulse until well blended. Store in a small airtight container, covered up to 2 weeks. Makes about 2/3 cup.

title: Baked Linguine With Sweet and Hot Adobo
ingredients: 1 package linguine, broken into 4 pieces | 1 jar sweet pickling spices | 1/2 cup kirsch | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarsely chopped adobo sauce | 3 tablespoons prepared dijon-style mustard | 2 poblano chiles, seeded, finely diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a small bowl, combine sweet pickling spice and kirsch.

title: Cuban-Style Cafe Sopa -- Cuban-Style Sopa
ingredients: 12 ounces ham, precooked ( cut into small cubes using kitchen shears or a food processor ) | 1/2 cup dry white wine, such as pedro ximinez ( or other good white wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin
