instructions: In a large skillet, brown the ham in the wine. When the cooked ham cubes are nicely browned, stir in the cumin. Serve hot.

title: Pan-Fried Pork Tenderloin with Pineapple-Chineapple Sauce
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel, divided | 1 jar sweetened condensed milk | 1/2 cup milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place pork tenderloins on a baking sheet and lightly season with 1 teaspoon lemon peel. Bake in preheated oven until pork reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees f when measured with a meat thermometer, about 20 minutes for medium rare. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees f, 12 minutes longer. When ready to serve, pour sweetened condensed milk and 1/2 cup milk into a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and reduced to 1 1/2 cups, about 25 minutes. Place saucepot over medium heat and continue cooking until heated through and remove from heat.

title: Garlicky Rice With Silverbeet (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1 )
ingredients: 1 small silver beet ( about 150g weight ) | 1/2 cup long grain white rice, washed & drained | 1/3 cup lettuce, leafs, washed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Cut the silverbeet into thin slices and place in a saucepan with water to cover. Bring to the boil over a high heat and cook, covered, until the silverbeet is tender. Drain well. Place the rice in a large casserole dish. Add the silverbeet slices, rice and lettuce. Cover and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until cooked.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,pepper,cayenne,green bell pepper,cinnamon,farfalle pasta,red chili
title: Farfalle With Pineapple-Hot Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1 red chili, minced | 1/4 cup chopped green bell pepper, seeded | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boiling. Add pasta, and cook until al dente, about 6 to 8 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, combine pineapple, 1 green bell pepper, red chile, green bell pepper, cinnamon, and cayenne in a large saucepan. Bring just to a boil, and boil for 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat, and stir in pasta and sauce. Cover, and place in the oven for about 30 minutes, or until pasta has absorbed liquid, stirring occasionally.

title: Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1/2 cup pickle relish | 2 packages kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Place rice in a bowl, stir in salad oil and relish. Set aside. Place kielbasa in a bowl. Drain rice mixture, pour over kielbasa, tossing to coat. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,banana pepper ring,grapefruit juice,chicken broth,white tequila,pineapple juice
title: Peruvian Orzo and Fruit Soup
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 4 cups chicken broth | 1 cup white tequila | 3 banana pepper rings, canned in water, cut into thin strips | 1 can sliced pineapple with juice, drained | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed grapefruit juice
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add orzo pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Vegtable Ginger Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 3 -4 tablespoons ginger powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pot. Bring to a boil, stir, cover and simmer until the liquid is absorbed, about 20 - 25 minutes. Serve immediately. This can also be cooked on the stove top and served with fresh vegetables and rice.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,vegetable broth,kellogg corn flake crumb
title: Pamela's Fudge
ingredients: 1 package kellogg's corn flakes or 1 package corn flakes | 4 garlic cloves, peeled | 2 cups vegetable broth ( vegetable or chicken flavor if you prefer )
instructions: Place corn flakes and garlic into a food processor. Pulse until finely ground, about 30 pulses. Add vegetable broth. Process until smooth. Pour into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: butter,ketjap manis,green pepper,plain flour,white vinegar,bartlett pear
title: Peppered Pear Fritters
ingredients: 4 bartlett pears, peeled, stalks removed | 1 green pepper, finely sliced | 3 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon sweet butter | 3 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1 tablespoon white vinegar
instructions: Melt half of the butter gently in a small saucepan and stir in the flour. Remove from heat and gradually whisk in the ketjap manis. Place the pepper and pears into the saucepan. Cover and simmer over a low heat for 5 - 6 minutes until soft. Dip each pears in the thickened butter and then into the flour mixture. Heat the remaining butter in a non stick frying pan. Add the pears and fry quickly until golden. Serve with plain boiled rice.

title: Spicy Capsicum raisin and Raisin Salad
ingredients: 200 g golden raisins | 1 red capsicum, sliced | fresh ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place the raisins in a small roasting tin or bowl. Slice the capsicum coarsely. Place the raisins and capsicum slices over the raisins. Drizzle with olive oil and black pepper.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,sun tomato,radish,green chili pepper,broccoli floret,liquid honey,italian sausage,coffee
title: Spicy Italian Sausage, Veggies, and Chili
ingredients: 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 green chili pepper, chopped | 1 bunch broccoli floret, chopped | 1 small radish, sliced | 8 large sun-dried tomatoes | 1 cup roasted red peppers or 1 cup canned diced green chili peppers | 1/3 cup brewed coffee | 8 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Place honey in a medium nonstick frying pan. Stir fry sausage 6 to 8 minutes or until cooked through. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender, stirring occasionally. Serve.

title: Sweet and Sour Beef Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef roast ( i used sirloin tip ) | 1 tablespoon dark raisin | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup fresh fish sauce ( i used nam pla ) | 1 cup ice ( to make the noodles and sauce, i used the plastic box, just slightly flattened into the noodles, then pushed them flat into a bowl ) | 4 cups ice ( for the bowls, i used a plastic bag, just slightly flattened into noodles )
instructions: Cube beef, if frozen. If frozen, just use 2 tbsp cold water and set aside. Combine raisins with cayenne, fish sauce and water. Add noodles to a large bowl and toss until coated. You can also use up to 4 cups of the ice and noodles. Serve with the dipping sauce. Note, i cooked mine in my electric coffee maker, draining the strings and wiping away any residual water. Then i placed the cooked noodles on a plate with my hands. I took the beef and raisin sauce, covered, and refrigerated overnight at about the 11pm mark i turned off the maker and worked as written, the meat was cooked. If necessary, add 2 tsp of water while waiting for the noodle bowls.

title: Spinach and Smoked Salmon Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cooked salmon | 1/2 cup sliced cherry tomatoes, halved | 3 cups baby spinach | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 3 tablespoons dry red wine | lemon wedge ( optional )
instructions: Toss salmon salad with tomatoes, spinach, and 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning. Garnish with lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: catsup,creole mustard,phyllo dough,asparagus,pork shoulder,sirloin steak,tamarind pulp
title: Caribbean-Style Crispy Pulled Beef and Asparagus
ingredients: 2 beef flank steak | 10 ounces asparagus, trimmed | 1/2 lb boneless pork shoulder | 3/4 ounce tamarind pulp | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon creole mustard | 10 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boiling. Trim the ends from the beef flank steak, if desired. Slice the steak crosswise into very thin strips. Soak asparagus in boiling water for 3 minutes, then remove from the water. Cut the flank steak into long, thin strips and set aside. Trim the asparagus and cut into thin sticks. Slice the pork shoulder into very thin strips. If not using a steak slicer, it will be easier to cut against the grain with a meat cuter. Slice the tamarind pulp into thin pieces and stir into the beef. Heat a 12 inch heavy skillet over high heat until very hot. Lay 1 sheet of phyllo in the skillet, brush it with some of the oil, then lay 1 sheet on top of the other. Spread about 1/3 cup of the scalloped beef and asparagus strips on top of the phyllo, then cover with overlapping pieces of the meat and vegetable. Lay a second sheet on top, then brush with more oil. Repeat with the second 10 sheets. When the first 3 sheets are done, top with the thawed phyllo to form a ‘sandwich’ effect. Place 3 sandwiches on top of each sandwich, pressing down with the back of a spatula. Spray the top of the sandwiches with oil, then cook for about 3 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve with additional tamarind sauce for dipping.

title: Vegetable Rollat (South Beach Diet Friendly)
ingredients:
2 tablespoons fat free mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon green tea leaf ( or 1/4 tsp. white ) | 1/2 white onion ( finely sliced lengthwise ) | 1/2 small red potato ( peeled & thinly sliced ) | 1/2 small red cabbage ( finely shredded- 2 cups ) | 1/4 cup roasted green ( or green ) 
------------------------
instructions: Spread the mayo on a piece of waxed paper or plastic wrap. Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp. green tea/ice if using. Top with the onion, potato, cabbage and roasted green. Cover with another piece of waxed paper or plastic wrap & press down lightly. Repeat with the remaining ingredients, placing each on a board. Refrigerate until serving time. This rolls may be made up to a few days in advance. Variation, for a party, double the recipe for a red cabbage and onion roll and add half of the cooked vegetables for each filling.

title: Hot & Spicy Corn Dip
ingredients: 3 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 1 package frozen sweetened corn, thawed, drained | 2 cans mexicorn, drained | 4 tablespoons evaporated milk | 2 tablespoons purple onions, chopped | 3 maraschino cherries
instructions: Place the cheese, corn, mexicorn and milk in a 2 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle the onions on top. Garnish with the cherries.

title: Mushroom Hotpot
ingredients: 3 slices button mushrooms, wiped clean and dried | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons hot pressed lemon or lime juice
instructions: Combine the mushrooms, lime juice and hot pressed lemon juice in a small bowl. Serve hot. Variation, make a smaller amount of hot pepper paste with 1 tbsp hot pressed lime juice.

Random Ingredients: portobello mushroom,cranberry juice,cauliflower,beef stew meat,canadian bacon,coconut powder,lime zest
title: Crock Pot Beef Carnitas with Cranberry Glaze
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 can cranberry juice | 1 cup portobello mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup canadian bacon, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest ( i do not use ) | 2 teaspoons coconut powder | 1 cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Place beef in crock pot. Mix cranberry juice, portobello mushrooms, bacon, lime zest. Pour over beef. Cook on low for 10 to 15 hours. Turn heat and stir in coconut powder and cauliflower. Cook on high another hour and serve.

title: Korean Style Nori
ingredients: 2 nori ( seaweed sheets ) | 3 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup diced orange or 1/2 cup kiwi fruit | 1 teaspoon onion powder | onion flakes, to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place nori sheets on a flat surface, shiny side down, and lightly spray with nonstick cooking spray. Stack nori sheets, and cut across width once or twice with scissors or scissors. Spread the nori across the nori leaving a 2 inch border on all sides. Divide the lettuce among the nori shells, and place about 1 tablespoon of the fruit on each. Sprinkle with onion, and season with onion flakes, if desired. Fold in the border around the filling. Press the edges with a damp cloth, so that the nori is pressed together as much as possible. Seal the edge by pressing the edges together using your fingers. Place a heavy frying pan over medium high heat, and reduce the heat to medium low. Cook for 4 minutes. Remove from heat and transfer to a plate lined with parchment paper. Let cool a few minutes, then slice thinly into triangles.

title: Linguine With Scallions and Olives
ingredients: 7 large egg yolks | 1/3 cup matzo meal | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted and chopped | 1/3 cup scallion, thinly sliced | 1 cup kraft cheddar cheese, shredded | 16 ounces linguine
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray and heat the oven to 325 degrees. In blender or food processor, combine egg yolks and matzo meal. Process 30 seconds or until mixture comes together. Stir in olives and scallions. Prepare linguine and drain. Put in a large baking dish. Cover. Bake 25 minutes or until set. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Tequila Beef Burger Fajitas
ingredients: 1 cup masa harina | 1 cup golden tequila | 1 cup sweet peas | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1 tablespoon coconut ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks or 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 2 tablespoons cocoa
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat. Combine first 5 ingredients and chill until ready to grill. Grill steaks 2 to 3 minutes per side for rare. Transfer steaks to cutting board and let it rest 5 minutes. Cut into 3/8 inch thick strips and divide evenly among four plates. Top with the spicy peas and sprinkle with cocoa before serving.

Random Ingredients: baking apple,beef chuck,andouille sausage link,salt,tamari soy sauce,monterey jack cheese,red potato,salmon fillet
title: Seattle-Style Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless beef chuck, trimmed | 3/4 teaspoon salt | 1 pinch salt | 1/2 pound andouille sausage links | 1/2 pound fresh salmon fillet, cut into portions | 1/2 pound fresh tuna fillets, cut into 2-inch chunks | 2 large baking apples - peeled, cored and cut into 8 wedges | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce
instructions: Place chuck into a large pot, and cover with water. Add 3/4 teaspoon salt, and pinch of salt. Cover, and simmer over medium high heat until meat falls off bones, about 2 hours. Let meat rest in the liquid while preparing the meats and other ingredients. Meanwhile, pat potatoes dry with a paper towel. Cut into six 3x1 inch thick slices. Place a steamer insert into a saucepan, and fill with water to cover the bottom of the steamer. Bring water to a boil, and cook potatoes until softened, about 5 minutes. Drain potatoes, and set aside. Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Spray 2 baking sheets with cooking spray. Season tuna with salt, and arrange on baking sheets. Bake potatoes in the preheated oven until the surface is firm, a few speaks will crack, and the tuna will flake easily.

title: Homemade Espresso Poached White Posole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 1/4 cup cilantro | 2 tablespoons dried whole cilantro | 3 cans white hominy, drained | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Place peppercorns in a small bowl. Add cilantro and cilantro to the bowl and place in refrigerator. Combine hominy and vanilla bean in a large saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until hominy is softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in onion pepper. Add peppercorns. Cover and simmer until hot, about 5 minutes.

title: Cranberry and Napa Cabbage Saute
ingredients: 1/2 head napa cabbage | 1/2 cup cranberry juice
instructions: Prepare a medium hot charcoal grill or oven grill on medium heat. When it is heated, oil the grate or place a cast iron skillet on the rack. Slice the head of napa cabbage lengthwise, leaving just enough to be about ½ inch thick. Place into a heavy duty bowl. Pour the cranberry juice over the leaf. Cover the bowl and let sit for 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer the napa cabbage to the grill and let dry until it turns dark green and shrinks away from the edges of the bowl, 8 to 10 minutes. Slice diagonally and serve warm.

title: Hungarian Spice Mix
ingredients: 4 teaspoons sweet paprika ( szeged hungarian ) | 4 teaspoons ground cloves | 4 teaspoons salt
instructions: Sift the spices and salt together in a bowl. Store in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place. A good measure of sodium will fill a jar within 5 lbs. It may also be needed to balance salt to ensure a good flavor.

Random Ingredients: penne,saffron,plain yogurt,absolut citron vodka,parsley stem,jalapeno pepper,cilantro,espresso
title: Penne With Saffron and Olives
ingredients: 1/2 lb saffron | 1 cup fresh parsley stems, chopped | 1 jar absolut citron vodka ( absolut citron-flavored liqueur, made with 2 t. orange blossom water ) | 1 quart hot water | 3 -4 fresh cilantro sprigs or 3 -4 fresh flat-leaf parsley sprigs | 1 bunch fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 lb dry penne or 1 lb tagliatelle pasta noodles | 1 container plain fat-free yogurt
instructions: Combine saffron with 5 cups of the parsley stems and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Pour olive oil into a small pot and heat over medium high until very hot but not smoking. Put one tablespoon of saffron into the hot oil and turn off heat. Stir. Repeat with remainder. When the oil is nearly smoking and the saffron is infused, stir in saffron infused parsley stems and 1/2 cup of the hot water. Set aside for about 1 hour. Taste and add salt if necessary. When the oil is very hot but not smoking, add the remaining 1/2 cup of hot water when the oil is very hot. Stir in cilantro and jalapenos, then cook 1 minute. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in boiling water until al dente, using 3 to 4 minutes or just until tender but firm to the bite. Drain and return to the pot. Turn off the heat, and stir in the drained pasta with a large spoon, adding the yogurt and reserved saffron. Place the linguine, hot saffron, and yogurt in a serving bowl with a light sprinkling of the remaining parsley. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: gherkin,tomato sauce,coriander powder,peanut oil,italian sausage,soy sauce,corn oil
title: Spicy Sausages With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon corn oil | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 3 lbs hot italian sausage, sliced | 8 ounces peanut sauce ( spicy tomato & peanut sauce ) | 3 tablespoons chopped gherkins
instructions: Heat oils in skillet over medium heat. Stir fry sausage until browned. Drain off excess fat. Add soy sauce and corn oil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer until sausage is warm and liquid is absorbed. Add coriander and gherkins. Simmer for 5 minutes before serving. Serve on platter with vegetables.

title: Macaroni Cheese with Cardamom and Cardamom
ingredients: 100 g macaroni | 1 tablespoon cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling, salted water until done, approximately 6 - 8 minutes. Drain and mix with other ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Kebabs Skewers With Pea-Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 400 g skinless chicken thigh fillets, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon masticha | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup frozen peas
instructions: Cut the chicken thigh fillets into about 5 pieces, and toss in the peanut butter, cranberries, masticha and tabasco sauce. Thread the chicken onto the skewers, and allow to stand for at least 20 minutes. Grill or broil the kebabs, skin side down, for about 3 to 5 minutes, or until the chicken just begins to colour. Turn half the skewers, brush with the peanut sauce and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the stuffing has begun to wilt away.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,active yeast,eggplant,italian sausage,wheat bread,whipping cream
title: Slow Cooker Chicken Parmesan
ingredients: 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 eggplant, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 pound hot italian sausage | 1 cup chilled whipping cream | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 loaves whole wheat bread, cut into 1-inch chunks
instructions: Place the whipping cream and yeast in a saucepan, and bring the mixture to a simmer. Place the eggplant in a large bowl, and pour boiling water over it. Cover, and allow to soak until the eggplant is tender, about 1 hour. While the eggplant is soaking, place the sausage in a skillet over medium heat, and brown until evenly browned. Remove sausage, and cut into 1/2 inch chunks. Pour about 1/4 cup of the cream mixture into the skillet, and stir to loosen the sausage pieces. Spread the mixture evenly over the bread chunks, and top with the rest of the cream mixture. Cover and let sit on the bottom rack of the slow cooker for about 5 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Uncover slow cooker, and place the soaked bread chunks on the bottom rack of the oven. Cover, and continue cooking in the preheated oven until the bread is crisp and golden brown, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,cornstarch,white wine,beef sausage,green bean,rice vinegar,russet potato,heavy cream
title: Sausage and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb beef sausage | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar or 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 ears fresh corn kernels ( cut on the cob or buy frozen kernels ) | 3 russet potatoes, sliced and quartered lengthwise | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Cut the sausage into 1/16 inch slices. Sprinkle with cornstarch and shake off excess. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat and saute the sausage for 10 minutes, stirring often. Drain off fat and set sausage aside. In a small bowl, combine the vinegar and salt, bring water to a boil and add to the cornstarch mixture. Whisk mixture until bubbly and thickened, about 2 minutes. In a large bowl, combine the potatoes, corn and wine, bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Whisk in the cream, cornstarch and cream, cook until a slightly thickened sauce is formed. Stir in the sausage, adjust seasoning.

title: Chinese-Spiced Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable broth or 3 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Cook the broth in a saucepan until bubbles form on top. Add hot sauce, garlic and tabasco, bring to a boil. Remove from heat and allow soup to stand for 5 minutes, then strain.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,cardamom seed,coconut flour,garlic,buttermilk,white onion,cayenne,pecorino romano cheese
title: Coconut-Onion Biscuits
ingredients: 1 large white onion, sliced in thin rounds | 3 3 cups organic buttermilk or 3 cups skim milk | 4 cloves garlic, minced | 1 cup coconut flour or 1 cup coconut cream flour | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2 teaspoons cayenne | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated ( see note below )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, whisk together all ingredients to form a wet dough. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove dough from refrigerator and roll out to about ¾ inch thick. Cut out biscuits cut out pieces of dough and let rest at room temperature for 30 minutes. In a sauté pan, heat the reserved oil over medium heat and saute the onions until golden brown. Remove the onions from the pan and set aside for 15 minutes.

title: Spiced Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning mix ( 1 envelope ) | 1/2 tablespoon bottled hot pepper sauce ( such as tabasco brand ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 2 cardamom pods
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in taco seasoning. Let stand 10 minutes to let flavors develop and flavors combine. Ladle into a resealable plastic bag.

title: Sour Corn Salad With Crunchy Cranberry Juice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cranberry juice | 3/4 cup frozen corn kernels | whipping cream or ice water
instructions: Add the cranberry juice and the corn to a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds to prevent the kernels from thawing, or until the liquid in the bowl has been absorbed. Set aside to cool to room temperature, then stir in the cream or ice water and serve.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,oregano leaf,rice noodle,green cardamom pod,apple cider
title: Easy Passover Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles, broken into 1/2 inch pieces | 2/3 cup apple cider | 1 lb plain low-fat yogurt | 1 -2 green cardamom pods, cracked open ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves ( optional )
instructions: Place noodles in a large pot of boiling water and cook until tender but not mushy. Rinse with cold water and set aside. In a small bowl, combine cider and yogurt. Whisk until combined, then slowly whisk in cardamom pods and oregano. Drain noodles and top with cider/yogurt combination. Refrigerate several hours.

title: Oven Roasted Kumara and Potato (Japanese)
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes | 1 medium onion | 1 1/2 tablespoons kikkoman soy sauce
instructions: Pierce peeled potatoes with a sharp knife and brush lightly with soy sauce. Cut onion in half and cut slices into half again lengthwise and finally crosswise. Wrap potato halves in plastic wrap and refrigerate. Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Remove the potatoes from the fridge, place on a cutting board and cut into 5 inch pieces. Arrange them evenly on an oiled baking pan. Sprinkle with half the kikkoman soy sauce. Make sure they are evenly distributed across the whole pan. Roast for 45 mins/high, stirring every 15 mins/low heat during the last 5 mins/pieces. If baking at 200 degrees, bake at 400 for 30 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. If baking at 425 for 30 mins/pieces, turn the oven to broil for 1 minute and broil for 5 more mins/pieces. Slice potatoes and serve.

title: Basque Semolina Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 1 3/4 1 3/4 cups panko breadcrumbs or 1 3/4 cups any other breadcrumb, seasoned with salt may be used | 1 1/3 cups semolina flour | 1/2 teaspoon serrano chilies, seeded and finely minced or 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper flakes, to taste | 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated or 3/4 cup packed fresh parmesan cheese, coarsely grated | 2 tablespoons semolina flour | 4 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs or 4 tablespoons other breadcrumb coating powder | vegetable oil or nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 200°f line 2 sheets heavy duty foil with 3 layers of foil, spray foil with cooking spray, sprinkle evenly with 1/3 cup panko or other purpose flour, then evenly with breadcrumbs. Press chilies down on foil with the side of a cleaver or the blade of a knife, rotating panko crumbs in several places to prevent sticking. Sprinkle panko over panko and top evenly with cheese. Fold foil over cheese and crimp with your fingers. Bake until cheese is golden, about 25 minutes. For best results, bake with foil for 20 minutes, or remove foil and broil to crisp top and darken crust slightly. For best results, let stand for 10 minutes before baking loaf.

Random Ingredients: parsley,ancho chile powder,beer,lettuce leaf,onion powder,black pepper,pepper
title: Beer and Pepper Dipping Sauce for Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 cup beer | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 4 lettuce leaves | 1 pinch pepper for tops
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the beer, parsley, onion powder, ancho powder, black pepper, and lettuce leaves. Mix well. Serve on the side of your favorite taco salad.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,grape tomato,yukon gold potato,process american cheese
title: Cheesy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup process american cheese, cut into small pieces
instructions: Prepare potatoes according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, cover tomatoes with water.

title: How to Make Molasses
ingredients: 1 cup molasses | 2 cups caster sugar ( aka superfine sugar )
instructions: Combine the sugar and molasses in a small non metallic bowl. Set aside. Bring 3 cups hot water to boil and pour into the molasses mixture. Turn off the heat. Let stand until syrup thickens slightly, about 30 minutes. Stir gently every 5 minutes, then cool completely. When completely cold, beat vigorously until smooth and creamy.

title: Curried Onions
ingredients: 2 teaspoons curry paste | 3 -4 medium red onions | 2 -3 cups currants | green food coloring
instructions: Cut the onions in half and lengthwise. Place onions and currants in a food processor or blender. Add enough green food coloring to give about a 1 color of green.

title: Crispy Mayo Balls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon minced garlic salt | 1 pound lean ground meat ( chicken, pork, turkey, beef, beef ) | 1 bag salad style frozen meat balls, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon dried rubbed sage | 1 leaf lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Forces, combine worcestershire sauce, garlic salt, and meat in a bowl. Form meat mixture into 2 inch diameter balls. Place meatballs in a layer of reynolds wrap baking dish. Sprinkle evenly with sage. Bake meat balls in prepared dish in the preheated oven for 4 to 5 minutes or until meatballs are browned. Remove dish from oven and spoon off drippings. Immediately, pile meat balls and any accumulated drippings into lettuce leaves. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,mango chutney,extra beef,garam masala powder,onion powder,meatball,jalapeno pepper,chocolate syrup
title: Mango Sausage with Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound extra-lean ground beef | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 3 tablespoons minced onion powder | 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced | 2 teaspoons ground masala powder | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 8 precooked meatballs, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the ground beef, mayonnaise, chocolate syrup, mango chutney, onion powder, jalapeno peppers, masala powder, and garam masala. Place the meatballs on the parchment paper, and flatten to approximately 1/4 inch thickness. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Cook for 10 minutes more, or until meatballs are browned.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,coriander powder,coriander leaf,lima bean,baby spinach leaf,mint,lemon pepper
title: Green Gramala(Chickpeas) and Spinach
ingredients: 2 cups fresh garbanzo beans, halved ( chickpeas ) | 1/2 cup fresh lima beans ( new baby spinach ) | 10 baby spinach leaves | 1/2 cup fresh coriander leaves | 1/4 cup fresh mint, chopped | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Soak garbanzo beans for 1 hour in 4 1/2 cups of water. Drain well. Heat a non stick pan on medium high heat. Add 3 tbsp of oil. Add chopped spinach and cook until it starts leaving the oil. Add garbanzo beans and lima beans. Add chopped coriander leaves and baby spinach leaves. Stir fry for 3 minutes or until spinach is just wilted. Add lemon pepper and dry coriander powder. Stir fry for 2 minutes or until spinach is just starting to turn bright green. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lamb,lard,sourdough bread,heavy whipping cream,black lentil,asiago cheese,gingerroot,active yeast
title: Lamb and Sourdough Pudding W- Lentils and Asiago
ingredients: 1/2 ounce active dry yeast | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 8 -12 cups assorted sourdough bread | 4 1/2 lbs lean ground lamb | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese or 1/2 cup fontina cheese | 1 tablespoon grated gingerroot | 3/4 cup lentils, rinsed well | 1 cup pitted black lentils, rinsed well
instructions: Soak lentils in hot water for 30 minutes in a bowl of water to cover for at least 10 minutes, or overnight. Drain. Put in large bowl. Beat 1 1/2 cups water, or if needed, more cream to soften. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm sourdough cream and set aside. Add bread to water in bowl. Cover with moist cloth and let rise in warm place till dough is doubled in volume, about 30 to 40 minutes. Butter 8 inch square or oval baking dish or pan and set aside. Preheat oven to 475°f. Stir together lamb and cheese until blended. Add yeast mixture. Stir in rinsinsed 1 cup lentils and 3/4 cup bread mixture. Beat well, then set aside. Cover and let rise til dough is almost doubled in volume, about 45 minutes. Bake in oven for 25 more minutes, or until golden, tinged with brown.

title: Aussie Sausages
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 teaspoon sage, finely chopped | 700 g ground turkey | 150 ml double cream
instructions: Place coriander seeds and seasonings in a food processor or blender and process until coarsely ground. In a large bowl, stir turkey, cream and freshly ground seasoning until throughly combined. Using clean hands, shape mixture into 12 sausages. Refrigerate sausages for 5 to 10 minutes. Barbecue sausages over a moderate heat for 7 to 10 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Serve with toasted bok choy.

title: Faux-Easy Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 pre-baked pizza crust | ground pecans or almonds
instructions: Spread the crust with the cheese filling and season with pepper. Sprinkle the nuts on top. Let rise for 5 minutes. Bake in the oven at 450ºf. Let cool for 5 to 10 minutes and serve.

title: Caramelised Rye Bread
ingredients: 225 g light rye bread | 7 tablespoons palm sugar | 2 teaspoons oil ( you may add a little brown sugar to the olive oil at this stage )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c/425°f spread the bread slices evenly. Place the bread slices on an oven tray with the palm sugar in the centre of each slice. Bake bread for 10 mins or until golden. Remove from oven and pour oil over the bread until absorbed.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,chive onion cream cheese,flax seed,margarine,chicken broth,garam masala
title: Garam Masala Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 small pico de gallo, minced | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh chives ( or green onion ) | 1 package flax seed roll creamed chives, spread ( kikkoman brand ) | 2 packages cream cheese, cut into cubes ( kikkoman brand )
instructions: Combine margarine or butter and pico de gallo. Stir in garam masala, chives and cream cheese. Cover and chill at least 1hour or overnight. Stir once or twice during chilling time to blend flavors. Serve on top of crackers that have been crushed with a fork, garnishing with additional chives or green onions.

title: Mexican Gouda Cheese Spread
ingredients: 4 1/4 ounces gouda cheese, shredded | 4 1/4 ounces greek olives, coarsely chopped ( kalamata olives ) | 1 tablespoon mccormick's taco seasoning
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients. Mix well. Cover and chill at least one hour or overnight for the flavors to marry together. Note, if you use a tube type container, mix together 1 1/2 cups shredded gouda cheese and 1/2 cup cheese in a small mixing bowl until well blended. Stir in the jar of taco seasoning. Shake or stir to mix well but not entirely smooth. If using a tube type container, stir in 1 cup of crumbled feta cheese and 1/2 teaspoonfuls of gouda cheese, 1/2 teaspoonfuls of shredded taco cheese and 1/2 teaspoonfuls of gouda cheese mixture. Cover and chill at least one hour or overnight for the flavors to blend.

title: Red Hot Broccoli Chapati
ingredients: 2 cups fresh broccoli, trimmed and cut into florets | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 3/4 cup whole white tomatillos, with husks removed | 3/4 cup packed light capers | 2 tablespoons garlic-infused capers | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh garlic cloves
instructions: Put the broccoli in a pan of barely cold water and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat and let sit in water to steam until tender, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the stuffing. Drain the broccoli, reserving any cooking water. Discard the stems, then coarsely chop. Put the tomatillos, 3/4 cup of the capers and the 2 tablespoons of infused capers into a small skillet over medium high heat and dry roast the garlic lightly for 3 - 4 minutes until the aroma is roasted. Add the broccoli and simmer, stirring, for 3 minutes. Add the remaining half cup of capers, the garlic infused capers and remaining 1 teaspoon of salt. Simmer until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from the heat, stir in the remaining half cup of capers and let sit 15 - 20 minutes to allow the flavors to develop.

title: Wild Rice With Madeira Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice ( see note in recipe description ) | 1 stalk celery | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 1/4 cup prepared mustard
instructions: Bring 1/2 cup wild rice and celery to boiling in a saucepan. Cover and simmer for 25 - 30 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir in remaining rice. Cool slightly, stirring occasionally. Stir in madeira and mustard. Serve warm to your taste.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,marinara sauce,chicken wing,green chili pepper,dill leaf
title: Spicy Wings
ingredients: 24 chicken wings | 1/4 cup dill leaves, chopped | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup marinara sauce | 1/2 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted
instructions: Place chicken wings in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Top each with dill, green chilies, marinara and pine nuts. Cover and bake, basting once every hour, until marinara is slightly bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,cider vinegar,salmon fillet,pork butt,white vinegar
title: Mexican Sweet Pork and Beer Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs bone-in pork butt | 2 cans red enchilada sauces | 1 1/2 cups white vinegar | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 cup cider vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork butt
instructions: Rinse and trim pork and prick with a fork. Place the pork in a large dutch oven or other large baking dish and cover with enchilada sauces. Scatter the pork butt on top. Scatter the remaining ingredients over the top. Cover and bake at 300 degrees for 5 hours. Shred to serve.

title: Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1 package sliced italian sausage | 2 tablespoons minced garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place sausage in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix garlic and sausage in a bowl.

title: Cardamom Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 1 lb pork loin | 6 cardamom pods
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut a pocket in the center of the pork. Insert a slice of cardamom pod into each slit. Baste pork with remaining oil. Let stand at room temperature 2 hours or refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 325°f. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray.

title: Hawaiian-Style Condiment (Use Non-Vegetarian Option Included)
ingredients: 1 cup drained pineapple tidbits | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds or 2 teaspoons other hot spice | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh parsley, for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Stir. Cover with plastic wrap, let stand 30 minutes. Flavor with salt, pepper or lime juice if using. Serve with bread or fried or toasted pita.

title: Clams Cheese Oatcakes
ingredients: 4 cups oatmeal ( quick cooking ) | 1 package cheese, of your choice or ( 7 ounce ) package neufchatel cheese | 3 garlic cloves ( mashed and chopped ) | 2 cans of chopped clams, drained well | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crumbled blue cheese | vanilla ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Combine well the oatmeal, salt and garlic and set aside. Combine the cheeses and stir well with a fork, until the cheese and oatcakes are well distributed throughout. Add the can of clams and mix together. Make the ice cream topping just as you would a large scoop of ice cream, if you would like to make it into balls, roll each ball between a dampened towel in your hands until completely covered. I like to cook them on a greased griddle over medium heat for about 5 minutes on each side, or until they are a bit crispy and browned. You may also like to turn them over in the pan for a few moments on the second side, or simply eat them straight up, spread the oatcakes over the ice cream and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,liquid honey,sugar cube,italian salad dressing,corn niblets,okra,coriander seed,lime wedge
title: Baked Okra Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/2 green mexican herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1 teaspoon sugar cube, dissolved in 1/2 cup boiling water | 2 fresh okra, cleaned and ends trimmed | 1 tablespoon italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 6 tablespoons chopped fresh italian salad dressing | 6 lime wedges
instructions: Roast the coriander over medium heat until aromatic, about 2 minutes. Rinse coriander and crush coriander in mortar with pestle until fine. Add 2 teaspoons italian herb seasoning, honey and 1/2 cup water. Heat until boiling. Cook over medium heat until water evaporates. Remove from heat. Allow okra to sit 10 minutes, then drain on paper towels. Using the same heat, roast okra until soft and slightly charred on all sides, about 4 minutes total. Cool okra in water to room temperature. Peel and seed okra, then cut into 1/4 to 1/2 inch slices. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine okra and 1/2 teaspoon italian herb seasoning. Place okra in an oiled 9 inch square baking dish. Place in oven. Roast okra in oven about 10 minutes, until heated through and lightly browned, stirring at least once. Turn oven off, and cover okra with 1/4 cup of Italian salad dressing. In a small dry skillet, lightly toast coriander seed until fragrant and dark brown, about 10 minutes, or until fragrant. Transfer to a small bowl. Drain okra and rinse well, then coat with 1/4 cup italian salad dressing. To serve, drizzle remaining salad dressing on top.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,taco seasoning mix,yeast,red onion,cayenne pepper,orange soda,pancetta,turmeric
title: Smoked Apricot French Bread
ingredients: 1 can orange soda ( 1 1/2 tablespoons ) or ( 15 ounce ) can beer | 1 package dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 2 large red onions, diced | 10 ounces smoked pancetta, diced | 1 package taco seasoning mix, dry | 1/2 cup apricot preserves
instructions: Dissolve taco seasoning in beer until it looks like small apple juice, or until desired consistency is achieved. Scrape into 9x5 inch loaf pan with an even layer of onion and pancetta. Cover and let rise until doubled. Heat up smoker and set for 5 to 7 hours. Stir every 15 to 20 minutes to ensure even browning on the top. When loaf is almost completely doubled in size, cut a slit lengthwise and put a spoonful of preserves inside. You can save some of the jam and preserves for another use or just leave it on if you want. Bake at 400 degrees farenheit for 20 to 30 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing. The loaf can be frozen on the day of baking.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,seasoning salt,sugar snap pea,chilies,red potato
title: Sweet 'n' Savory Indian Pea & Potato (Serve with Salsa Fresca from Food For Pixie)
ingredients: 1/4 lb red potatoes, cut into 3/4 pieces | 1 1/2 cups sugar snap peas | 4 fresh bird's eye chilies | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Boil red potatoes until tender. Rinse and drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Boil snap peas until tender. Put in pan with peas, chiles, coriander, and salt until chiles become fragrant. Serve warm or cool and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: oat,picante sauce,butter,cream,kiwi,corn oil,almond extract like coconut glaze call
title: Kiwi & Cream Oat Crusted Rounds
ingredients: 3/4 cup light cream | 3/4 cup corn oil | 3/4 lb kiwi | 3/8 cup raw almonds, chopped | 3/8 cup unsalted butter | 2 teaspoons almond extract ( like coconut glaze ( i have the kind that just calls for almond flavour ( i don't know what this is - a hint-i use one of those ) or 2 teaspoons almond extract ( like coconut glaze ( i have the kind that just calls for almond flavour ( i don't know what this is, a hint-i use one of those ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup picante sauce | 2 packages of quick oats
instructions: Make sure all the kiwi is clean & finely chopped. In a large skillet heat the cream, oil & almonds until bubbles begin to form on the edges of the oil. Lower the heat, add the kiwis & cook 2 - 3 minutes. Add the cream mixture, stir to combine & cook for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat & pour onto a cookie tray lined with parchment paper. Allow to cool completely. Mix the almond extract & tbsp of picante in with the 2 tbsp of picante & spread over the top. Sprinkle with the 2 tbsp of rolled oats & chill in the fridge until firm. These are best if allowed to sit at room temperature until ready to last at least an hour or up to 24 hours.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,sesame seed,stew meat,yellow potato,coffee,grain brown rice,salad dressing
title: Easy Sesame Potatoes in Rice
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1/2 cup salad dressing ( i used salad dressing ) | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 -4 medium yellow potatoes ( i used red ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 2/3 cups cooked long-grain brown rice | 2 cups instant coffee
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake covered at 350 degrees until beef is browned. In pan add dressing and sesame seeds and simmer until sesame is golden. Remove from oven and add meat and potatoes. Mix all ingredients except the instant coffee and rice. Add to crock pot. Cook at the bottom until potatoes are tender. Turn cooker to high, stir, serve or let people help themselves if they like.

title: Prawn With Ricotta
ingredients: 4 large ripe prawns | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Shell and devein prawns. Rinse prawns and shake out any excess heads. Place in a bowl with the ricotta cheese and rice vinegar, mix well. Add the flour, little by little, until a thick paste is formed. Add shrimp, mix together well. Heat a medium sized nonstick frying pan. Dip prawns in the paste and cook on both sides until shrimp are opaque throughout. If necessary, keep in mind that prawns shrink a little while cooking. Serve with prawns.

title: Apple Covered and Chocolate Baked
ingredients: 2 ounces good dark chocolate | 6 tablespoons unsweetened apple juice or 6 tablespoons apple juice mixed with a pinch of sugar
instructions: Melt down chocolate in microwave, pour in the apple juice and stir, coating the whole thing. Place in fridge to chill, then cut into 1 cubes. Place in small glass container or small foilware dish, and refrigerate to set before serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,ice water,taco seasoning,baby green,chocolate,white kidney bean
title: Taquito Salad
ingredients: 1 can white kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 3/4 cup hot vegetable stock | 1 ounce bittersweet chocolate, such as lindt | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/4 cup ice water | 1 bag mixed baby greens
instructions: Drain the juice from the canned beans into a large bowl, and reserve. In the same large bowl, whisk the vegetable stock, bittersweet chocolate, and taco seasoning together. Pour the strained bean juice, about 1 cup to 1/2 cup, over the beans, and gently fold in to combine. Chill before serving over greens.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,sauerkraut,vinegar,raspberry,guacamole,green chilies,margarine,grand marnier
title: Raspberry and Sauerkraut Spread
ingredients: 1/3 lb dried sauerkraut, washed | 1/3 cup margarine ( i use olive oil ) | 1 1/2 cups brown sour cream or 1 1/2 cups guacamole | 6 green chilies ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped seedless raisin ( optional ) | 1/2 cup grand marnier or 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 jar sweet pickled raspberries ( drained ) or ( 15 ounce ) jar pineapple tidbits, drained ( drained ) | 1/4 cup grenadine or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Soak sauerkraut overnight in water to cover. Drain sauerkraut. Place rinsed sauerkraut in a saucepan and cover with water.

title: Crock Pot Chicken Legs
ingredients: 2 bone-in chicken legs, skin in | 1 can mexican-style corn, drained | 12 ounces dark rum ( i recommend bacardi black )
instructions: Place chicken legs in crock pot. Cut 1 can of corn in half, then cut each half in half again so it will equal 8 sections. Add rum to crock pot. Add remaining can of corn, half of rum and 1/2 the remaining rum. Cook on low for 8 hours. Stir once or twice during cooking. Serve over rice.

title: Italian Style Spaghetti and Ground Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb beef short rib, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 cups cooked whole wheat spaghetti | 1/2 cup greek yogurt ( optional )
instructions: In a 12 x 7 inch pan over high heat, combine the short ribs and mustard seeds and cook, stirring, until no longer pink, about 3 minutes. Add half of the spaghetti and the beef and any yogurt. Cover with remaining pasta and sprinkle with remaining meat. Cover and cook until heated through and hot, 5 to 7 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes, cut into wedges and serve.

title: Avocado and Baby Carrots
ingredients: 1 avocado ( small ) | 1 bag baby carrots
instructions: Peel and slice avocado in half and remove pit. Place carrots in a large bowl and toss with avocado and the bag of baby carrots. Season to taste with salt and paprika. Eat now or refrigerate for a few hours to allow flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,island dressing,dark sesame oil,milk ricotta cheese,cardamom seed,spaghetti,allspice,salt
title: Low Calorie Spaghetti With Spicy Maple Nut Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans low fat milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup low-fat thousand island dressing ( or to taste ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup shredded low-fat canadian cheese or 1/4-1/2 cup fat-free sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/3 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Stir all ingredients together until well blended. Taste. Adjust seasoning if necessary. Serve at room temperature or chilled. Will keep at least 2 weeks.

title: Pistachio and Shiitake Mushroom Melt
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup light beer | 1/2 cucumber, peeled and mashed | 1/2 cup chopped cremini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 cup chopped pistachios
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the cream of mushroom soup with beer and tarragon. Stir in the mashed cucumber, mushrooms, and ricotta cheese until well blended. Spread into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with pistachios. Bake for 35 minutes in the preheated oven.

title: Herby Tuna Burgers
ingredients: 1 can canned tuna, drained | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 2 tablespoons herbs ( basil, mint, chili peppers, marjoram leaves, basil leaf, etc. ) | 2 tablespoons tandoori paste, spice paste | 400 g mixed mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons unbleached cane sugar | 1 chipotle chile, chopped ( optional ) | sliced rye bread ( or bbq )
instructions: Mix the tuna with all the seasoning ingredients and shape into 4 patties. Grill the burgers over an medium to medium high heat for about 5 minutes each side, or until cooked through. Serve topped with the spicy soy barbecue sauce.

title: Chinese Style Ground Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 500 g lean ground beef ( grass-fed ) | 3 cups broccoli ( raw peeled ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a large pot, mix the beef in with the salt and pepper. Leave for a few minutes and drain well. Add the ground meat back in with the broccoli, mix in on a high heat for a few minutes and turn down the heat and allow to simmer for 40 - 50 minutes or until all the meat is cooked. You won't be able to cook broccoli as long as it has room in it and you should feel the aroma of the beef. Leave for a few minutes before serving as it will make your teeth spongy. Serve with plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,spinach leaf,string bean,icing sugar,part mozzarella cheese,mint leaf
title: Spinach and String  Roll up Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces string beans | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 1/4 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 8 ounces spinach leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place beans on ungreased jelly roll pan and place in preheated oven. Bake for 8 minutes or until beans soften slightly. Transfer to bowl. Blend icing sugar with spinach in mixer. Add mustard and 1 cup of cheese. Beat well. Spread on hot beans. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and mint. Roll up jelly roll style and place seam side down on 2 serving plates. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Melt In-Your-Mouth Peas
ingredients: 4 chocolate candy bars, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen peas | 1/2 cup cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a bowl place frozen peas and microwave it for 1 to 2 minutes on high power. Drain peas and stir into melted chocolate. Sprinkle cornmeal over the peas and chocolate mixture.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,salt pepper,beef stew meat,sugar,red chili pepper,asian chili sauce
title: Korean Braised Pork with Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder | 1 tablespoon salt and pepper | 2 red chili peppers | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1/2 cup asian sweet chili sauce | 1 can beef stew meat, drained and cut into 1 inch chunks
instructions: Trim fat from the pork and discard the membrane and other pieces of lean fat. Slice the pork, including the skin, into 1/4 inch thick slices, leaving the skin on the tail if necessary. Place the pork slices in a dish large enough to hold them in 1 layer. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and mix well to coat all the pork with salt and pepper. Preheat oven to 450°. Line two rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper. Place the red chili peppers, sugar, sweet chili sauce, and beef in the food processor and process until finely minced and the vegetables are minced. Add the pork mixture and process again until combined. Transfer pork mixture to a nonstick 10x6 inch baking dish. Top with remaining pork slices. Pour the chili sauce over pork and bake for 12 minutes. Serve with steamed white rice.

title: Almond Crisp Sandwich
ingredients: 4 hamburger | 4 tablespoons reduced-fat peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | fresh thyme sprig, for garnish
instructions: Heat a large frypan over medium. Dry fry hamburgers for 3 - 5 minutes per side depending on your preference in size. Remove from pan and keep warm. Return frypan to stove over low heat and add remaining ingredients. Heat through. Remove thyme sprigs if using.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,chicken thigh,rice vinegar,nonfat beef broth,beef oxtail,porcini mushroom,pear,monterey jack cheese
title: Rachael Ray's Baked Oxtails
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs bone-in chicken thighs | 8 ounces dry porcini mushrooms, stemmed and coarsely chopped | 2 large pears, peeled, cored, and coarsely chopped | 1 cup nonfat beef broth | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup dark rum ( optional ) | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 1/2 tablespoons coarsely chopped pepferino romano cheese | 3 lbs trimmed beef-oxtails
instructions: Prepare a dutch oven or soup pot large enough to hold your chicken, over medium high heat. When hot, put broth, mushrooms, and pears in pot and bring to a boil. Transfer contents of pot to bowl of ice water. Cover and set aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place chicken in dutch oven then fill pot with 1/3 of the chicken broth and porcini/parsley mixture. Cover with remaining broth mixture and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. While broth simmers, prepare oxtails. Remove excess skin from oxtails. Cut each oxtail to three inch lengths using a paring knife. Arrange on a platter and cover. Place a heavy skillet or 12 inch round pan on top and over high heat. When hot, put in oxtails and brown on all sides about 2 minutes. Remove from pan and keep warm. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix cheese with remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons water or broth and pour over oxtails. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until meat is cooked through. Serve over rice, if desired.

title: Tortilla Pig Meat
ingredients: 1 jar hot picante sauce | 1 pinch dried thyme
instructions: Pour hot picante sauce into a shallow bowl and season with thyme. Tear off pieces of meat and put in bowl. Refrigerate until cold, about 1 to 2 hours.

title: Superfine Sugar Powder
ingredients: 1/2 cup superfine sugar, or superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons ground aniseed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sugar, anise, and aniseed. Beat in the sugar. Enjoy.

title: Weight Watchers Chicken and Parsnips
ingredients: 2 cups old fashioned oats, uncooked | 1 cup pumpkin seeds ( roasted or roasted and salted ) | 1 cup cauliflower floret | 2 teaspoons tamari | 2 teaspoons tahini | 1 teaspoon sage leaf, chopped | 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts ( about 11 ounces each ) | 1 medium parsnip, peeled | 1 medium tomatoes, quartered
instructions: Toast the oats and pumpkin seeds in a large dry skillet over high heat, stirring constantly, until the seeds are dry and fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer roasted/roasted raisins to a small bowl and set aside. Place cauliflower, pumpkin seeds, cauliflower and tamari in a blender or food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped and well mixed. Add tahini, sage and oats and process just a few seconds to mix. Place chicken on a board and cut into 4x1/2 inch slices. Cut parsnips into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange chicken in a single layer on a lightly oiled broiler pan. Broil until the tops are firm and the chicken has a good char, about 8 minutes. Arrange the parsnips around the chicken and pour the tomatoe tomatoe mixture over them. Set the broiler pan on the middle rack set at lowest angle and, keeping the oven on, broil until the chicken is thoroughly cooked, about 10 to 16 minutes longer. Garnish with remaining parsnips, serve immediately.

title: Shrimp and Anise Milk Soup
ingredients: 1/2 ounce arugula | 1 large ripe tomatoes | 4 -6 ounces large shrimp | 1 cup broth | 2 tablespoons buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1/4 cup of fresh mint or 1/4 cup parsley, chopped
instructions: Remove shrimp from shells & rinse under cold water and pat dry. Cut tomato in half & remove the seeds. Bring broth to a boil, then add the shrimp & arugula. Simmer for 5 minutes. Puree soup and add the shrimp, onion, pistachios, & another dash of anise. Place soup in small soup bowls and garnish with a sprig of mint. Variation, instead of onion you can substitute with 1/2 teaspoon of caraway seeds. Garnish each bowl with additional mint or parsley.

title: French Chocolate (Aussie Blondie)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chocolate syrup | 1/2 cup sherry wine ( or dry red sherry )
instructions: Combine and mix well. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Wild Rice Breakfast Bake
ingredients: 200 g wild rice ( or just white rice, not short grain ) | 200 g cooked rice | 600 g chopped ripe pears | 150 g raspberries ( or currants ) | 80 g rolled oats ( or wheat bran, oats ) | 2 teaspoons golden syrup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c or 400 degrees f / gas 6, or 200c if your oven is fan oven. Cook the wild rice, rice and pear in boiling water for about 30 to 45 minutes. Allow to cool before removing from the pan. Place the raspberries and oats in a bowl, and spoon the brown rice mixture over them. Stir to combine. Top with the golden syrup. Allow to cool before serving, although if you feel like eating too soon, allow 30 minutes to set before cutting.

title: Hawaiian Steak Sandwiches in My Crockpot
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs chuck steaks | 2 cans pineapple tidbits | 1 can beef stock or ( 8 ounce ) can vegetarian broth
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot. Cook on low 7 - 8 hours. Serve on buns with slices of meat.

title: Easy and Yummy Curry Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | 1 tablespoon mild curry paste | 1 tablespoon grenadine
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl, then turn into a bread machine and bake at medium heat for 40 minutes. Use the full 25 minutes for quick, chewy bread.

title: Curried Chicken Stock
ingredients: 4 chicken wings | 1 bunch leafy greens | 1 cup peas or 1 cup brown rice | 3 -4 curry leaves
instructions: Rinse greens under cold water and soak for 10 - 15 minutes. Trim wings of excess membrane but do not remove skin. Place washed chicken wings and greens in a large pot and cover with about 4 qts. Water. Cook over medium heat for about 3 or 4 hours until chicken wings and greens are tender. Remove chicken from pot and set aside to cool. Add 1/4 cup water to stock and bring to boil. Rinse chicken until water runs clear. This step can be done several hours before serving. Strain stock through a fine mesh sieve over a large bowl. Add stock to stock and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil again. This step can take up to 3 or 4 hours depending on how hot the water gets. Remove from heat and stir in curry leaves just long enough to heat through. The stock can be stored in the refrigerator for several days and even up to a month. Enjoy.

title: Minty Italian Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 16 ounces ricotta cheese or 16 ounces cream cheese | peppermint extract | freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well. Place in refrigerator until serving time. Note, you can either leave the shredded cheese as is or add 2 - 2 tablespoons of dried mint.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,vegetable broth,black pepper,winter squash,blue cheese,parmigiano
title: Frozen Squash
ingredients: 2 lbs winter squash, halved and seeded | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup vegetable broth, hot | 1/2 cup crumbled blue cheese | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano or 1/4 cup romano cheese
instructions: Cook squash in boiling water 6 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: white button mushroom,dark rum,red wine,cellophane noodle,bread flour
title: Sauce Croustades (Portuguese Bread Rolls)
ingredients: 8 ounces cellophane noodles, such as portuguese ladyfinger biscuits | 8 ounces small white button mushrooms | 8 ounces red wine, such as burgundy | 1 1/2 cups bread flour, or as needed | 2 tablespoons dark rum, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add noodles, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until al dente.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,cayenne,vegetable oil,lima bean,pita bread,coriander powder,green pepper
title: Nama's Harakali Naan
ingredients: 2 cups lima beans, frozen | 4 -5 pita bread, cut in half and cut into 6 -8 pieces | 3 tablespoons chopped cilantro leaves | 1 red green pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | vegetable oil, for frying
instructions: Put frozen lima beans and 2 cups of water into a large pot, and bring to a boil. Let cook for an additional 5 minutes until thawed. When the lima beans are thawed, remove the pot from the heat and add the pita pieces, cilantro, red and green pepper. Mix the vegetables well, and allow to sit for 5 - 10 minutes until the beans cool slightly. The mixture should be somewhat soupy. Remove the mixture from the heat. Heat oil in a nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Add the mixture to the hot pan and fry for about 3 - 5 minutes until golden brown and crisp on the outside. Serve warm with warm greek yogurt or low fat sour cream for dipping.

title: Greek Yogurt Marinated Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 kg frozen asparagus | 5 tablespoons greek yogurt | salt
instructions: Place all ingredients in large sealable plastic bag. Seal and place in a refrigerator. Allow to marinate at least 30 minutes or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving. Serve cold.

title: Beef  - Roast
ingredients: 3 sirloin steaks | 100 g peas | 50 g smoked pork belly | 1 ounce hazelnuts | 1 ounce ice
instructions: Wrap sirloin steaks in cheese cloth. Place in baking paper and put into oven. Preheat oven at 180 degc, 180 degc if using the 2lb range, 175 degc is preferred.

Random Ingredients: hot chili pepper,prawn,green chilies,red pepper powder,rice brown,lettuce leaf,feta cheese
title: Rice Fried Prawns
ingredients: 600 g prawns, raw | 3 green chilies | 1 cup rice brown, uncooked | 1 hot chili pepper | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 cup lettuce leaf | 1/4 cup crushed red pepper powder
instructions: Boil prawns until pink in water. Wash the rice in cool water and drain. Slice prawns on the diagonal and cut strips. Heat oil in a non stick pan on top of stove. Add prawns and fry until prawns turn pink. Remove from heat add green chilles, rice, pepper and feta and mix well. Place lettuce leaves on a plate. Place prawns on the lettuce leaves. Sprinkle crushed red pepper over the prawns.

title: Raspberry and Black Pepper Crumble
ingredients: 6 raspberries or 6 black raspberries, fresh or frozen | 8 ounces bocconcini or 8 ounces frozen raspberries, thawed, pitted, and chopped | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 tablespoon panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 teaspoon crushed black peppercorns or 1 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Place thawed raspberries into a bowl and toss with the flour, parley, oil, and black peppercorns. Fold in the bocconcini or frozen raspberries. Spoon the mixture into a bowl or a casserole dish and bake at 180 degree c for 15 - 20 minutes or until browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,shallot,shrimp,hazelnut,red bell pepper,heavy cream,olive oil cooking spray
title: Creamy Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons minced onions or 2 tablespoons shallots | 1/3 cup finely chopped red bell pepper | 1 cup grated or shredded italian cheese blend | 1/2 lb cooked shrimp, shelled and deveined | 2/3 cup heavy cream | 1/3 cup minced walnuts
instructions: Spray a 6 skillet with cooking spray. Saute onions or shallots for 3 minutes. Add bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes. Transfer skillet to the oven and bake at 400°f or until tender, 10 to 15 minutes more. Stir cheese into the shrimp. Add cream and nuts and stir to warm through 3 to 5 minutes. Serve immediately over pasta of your choice.

title: Fried Peanuts
ingredients: 4 cups dry roasted peanuts | 1 large onion, finely chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Heat 2 1/2 inches of oil in a deep saucepan. Remove peanuts from the bowl and pat dry with paper towels. Fry peanuts until light brown. Remove peanuts to a paper towel lined plate and serve hot or cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Mint Chutney
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon mint leaf | 1/2 cup garlic and butter
instructions: In a large nonreactive saucepan, stir together sugar, sherry, vinegar, mint and garlic.

Random Ingredients: ice water,orange peel,provolone cheese,jasmine rice,romaine lettuce heart,bay leaf,tart apple
title: Wonderful Rice Salad With Orange Peel
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed and drained | 2 tart apples, chopped | 12 slices provolone cheese | 4 romaine lettuce hearts, torn into bite-sized pieces ( about 1.5 oz ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped orange peel | 2 tablespoons ice water | 1 bay leaf
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together rice, apples, cheese, lettuce and orange peel. In a small small bowl, stir together water and ice. Pour into a small, shallow glass container, close lid, and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: sugar,grain white rice,green olive,jumbo pasta shell,golden mushroom soup,yellow bell pepper,kaffir lime leaf,ouzo
title: Jambalaya Me Kachumbaya (A Stuffed Jumbo Shell)
ingredients: 1 box jumbo pasta shells | 2 cans condensed golden mushroom soup ( campbell's healthy request preferred ) | 1/2 can condensed yellow bell peppers ( campbell's healthy request preferred ) | 1/2 cup fresh green olives ( stuffed green olives ) | 1/4 cup quick-cooking ouzo | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 tablespoon fresh kaffir lime leaves | 1 dash 1/2 cup ouzo
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove shells from box. With a spoon, scoop out the centers of the shells, leaving about a 3/4 inch shell.. Set shells aside. In a bowl, combine the soup, peppers, olives, ouzo, sugar and lime leaves. Place 1 cup of rice in each of the shells. Pour the soup mixture into each shell. Place the filled shells on a jelly roll pan or cookie sheet. Bake for 30 minutes. Serve remaining soup over the top of the shells.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,green chili pepper,celery rib,yellow squash,celery salt,cumin seed,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pineapple chunk
title: Chile Pesto With Summer Squash, Pineapple Skordalia (Chef John's Recipe)
ingredients: 1 cup green chili pepper | 3 celery ribs | 1 yellow squash, halved and cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1/2 cup fresh pineapple chunk | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 handful finely grated provolone cheese | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon cumin seed
instructions: Preheat grill rack to high. Combine 1 cup green chili pepper with celery, squash, pineapple, parmigiano reggiano, provolone, celery salt, and cumin seeds. Use a blender or food processor to combine the ingredients. Pour prepared pesto into a large bowl. Add 3 teaspoons sea salt and 3 teaspoons pepper.

Random Ingredients: brown gravy mix,black bean,meat,hamburger,farfalle pasta,salt pork,lemon peel
title: Ham and Garlicky Black Bean Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 18 ounces black beans | 1 package brown gravy mix | 4 slices lemons, zest of or 1 lemon | 1 pinch salt | 1 package farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 lb salt pork, cubed
instructions: Brown hamburger over medium heat. Drain liquid off cooked meat and place meat in casserole dish. Add dry mix, garlic, lemon peel and salt. Cover with foil and cook slowly until the flavors meld and the pasta is cooked. Stir in pasta. Sprinkle with diced salt. Cook the farfalle, drain and rinse under running water. Put farfalle in boiling water for 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,cardamom seed,lime juice zest,syrup,rom tomato
title: Baharat Aka Iranian Tomato Salad (Zainab's)
ingredients: 3 roma tomatoes, washed, peeled, and halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon light syrup
instructions: Cut roma tomatoes into half. Using a very sharp knife, pierce each half three or four times. Drizzle 1 tablespoons dark sesame oil into each hollowed out tomato. Place on serving dish and scatter a teaspoon of crushed cardamom seeds over each tomato. Add a little finely grated zest and light tasting light syrup. Serve with basmati rice or arabian chapatis. Note, to prepare a different color tomatoes, rinse tomatoes. Slice a half and coat with a little dark sesame oil before sprinkling this on top of them.

title: Sweet Chilli and Coriander Torte
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornflour | 1/2 cup red wine, such as red currant ( about 1/2 cup ) or 1/2 cup orange juice ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 2 tablespoons finely sliced coriander leaves
instructions: Mix the cornflour with the wine until smooth, gradually adding the mascarpone cheese. Season with salt and pepper, then fold through the coriander leaves. Cover and refrigerate for 6 hours, to allow the cheeses time to macerate. Serve with cream or custard or toast.

title: Tea Sandwiches With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes | 5 cups strongly brewed tea | 4 kaiser rolls | 1/4 cup apricot jam
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Place in a large saucepan with enough water to cover potatoes. Place over high heat and bring to a boil. Cook covered until potatoes are tender with fork, 15 - 20 minutes depending on desired texture. Drain and leave to cool slightly and then mash with potato masher. Return to pan and add tea, stirring until heated through. Heat a pan to medium and place 3 tablespoons of the ham on each bun. Top with tea mixture and drizzle with the jam.

title: Sunflower Seed and Parsley Cream Truffles
ingredients: 1 cup sunflower seeds or 1 cup sesame seeds | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 bunch fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Place the sunflower seeds in a mortar and pestle or food processor with the mascarpone in a large bowl. Add the chopped parsley, mix well. Form the mixture into balls of about the size of a large cherry and press down firmly so they stay together on your hands. Leave on one side to firm up. Store in an airtight container. Keep in the fridge until needed for up to 4 weeks.

title: Cheese Ravioli With Oranges
ingredients: 1 orange | 2 cups fresh corn | 3 cups cheese ravioli | chili pepper flakes
instructions: Cut the orange in halves and then half again. Juice the orange halves add the juice to the orange halves and stir. Slice the zest from the orange and add to the lemon juice stir. Put all the ravioli in a pan of salted boiling water, add the chile flakes bring to the boil and cook. Plate them and drizzle a good helping of sauce over the top of each one.

title: Mexican Pinto Beans and Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup pinto beans | 3 ounces uncooked raw shrimp, peeled
instructions: Rinse and drain beans. Place beans in medium saucepan with water and bring to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer, covered, 20 minutes, or until tender.

title: Pasta With Sausage and Plums
ingredients: 500 g penne rigate | 1 bunch plums, pitted and cut into quarters | 1 small jalapeno pepper, halved and seeds removed | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 300 g lean ground pork | crouton
instructions: Cook pasta according to pack instructions, drain and place aside in a large bowl. To make sausage, place the chilli and flour in a large frying pan over medium to medium high heat and cook, stirring and scraping with a wooden spoon. Add the pork and cook stirring constantly until it releases it's pink colour. Drain the pasta and chill. When it is ready pour over the beef and pork mince, stirring until just blended. Top with croutons and serve,.

Random Ingredients: arugula,walnut oil,cocoa,basil,butter,sea salt,butternut squash,italian salad dressing
title: Vegetable Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 1 lb butternut squash, peeled, seeded, and sliced | 2 cups arugula, divided | 1 1/2 cups toasted walnuts in oil, divided | 3 tablespoons cocoa | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon butter | 2 teaspoons minced fresh basil | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Toss the squash with 1 cup arugula and nuts. In a small bowl, stir together cocoa, salad dressing, butter, basil and sea salt. Pour over the squash and toss to combine. Let sit for 30 minutes to finish chilling.

title: Chinese Nuts
ingredients: 1 pound sesame oil, divided | 1/2 pound large waxy potatoes
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil in a skillet over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: pastry dough,hamburger,table salt,taco shell,ice cube,red onion
title: Tacos in a Snap
ingredients: 9 inches pastry dough, thawed, see recipe | 1 pinch table salt | 1 1/2 cups shredded smoked hamburger, i used leftover deli ham and it was about 3/4 cup, i didn't use extra lean meat | 1/3 cup red onion, diced | ice cube | 1 envelope taco shells, slightly warm
instructions: Preheat an oven to 450 degrees. Unroll the pastry dough and line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a floured foil. Roll out the pastry dough on a lightly floured work surface and cut the dough into 9 squares. Line the square with the pastry. Fold the corners of the pastry over the meet, leaving about ¼ of an inch at the top. Brush the edge of the pastry dough with a small film of water. Place a small amount of the smoked ham, red onion, and a pinch of salt on the center of a pastry square. Fold in the corners and top with the rest of the pastry square, sealing together the edges as best you can. Place the taco shells on another baking tray and bake the tacos for 3 minutes. Cut in small triangles with kitchen shears and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,chipotle powder,lime leaf,zucchini,sunflower oil,thyme leaf,ranch salad dressing
title: Zucchini Stuffed With Chipotle Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 2 large zucchini | 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 4 tablespoons ranch salad dressing ( or my homemade ranch-style ranch dressing ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 garlic clove, crushed ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla bean
instructions: Slice each zucchini in half lengthwise, and hollow out just the center. Scoop out the pulp from the zucchini leaving some shell to place inside for a nice look on after. If using, cut the zucchini at an angle into 1/2 thick slices using a very sharp knife.. In a large bowl, mix the oil, ranch dressing, and spices. Drain the zucchini, and toss the slices back in to the bowl. Add more oil if needed from time to time, and toss lightly to coat. Cover, and refrigerate. Heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with tin foil, and place the zucchini in the middle, overlapping the slices slightly. Bake, uncovered, until tender when pierced with a fork, about 30 minutes. Uncover when cool to the touch, and let stand until cool enough to handle, about 10 minutes. Slice zucchini, and scoop out seeds with a spoon. Strain dressing through a sieve into a bowl. Return zucchini to the bowl, add remaining ingredients, and stir. Add reserved zucchini and mix. Transfer to serving dish, or spread on toast, and serve with warm tortillas as a garnish.

title: Pudity
ingredients: 2 cups soymilk | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 bell pepper, sliced | 1/4 cup golden raisins
instructions: Pour soy milk into a pan on medium high heat. Add tomato paste to the pan and stir until blended. Add bell pepper and raisins. Stir until warmed through. Enjoy.

title: Crunchy Kale Chips
ingredients: 4 cups kale | 1 1/2 cups corn flakes | 1 ounce corn flakes, crumbled | 3 tablespoons salami | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Separate kale leaves and separate stems from leaves. Rinse leaves. Break or chop leaves into large pieces, place in colander or sieve for several seconds and then drain. In a bowl, combine the coarsely crushed corn flakes, salami, baking powder and cinnamon. Add the chopped kale leaves and mix well. Dry the chips on a cloth covered surface and let dry before storing in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: bulk sausage,half,hungarian paprika,yellow squash,white vinegar,whipping cream,graham cracker crumb
title: Naked German Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1 lb bulk sausage | 4 medium yellow squash, halved lengthwise ( about 5 cups ) | 2 cups whipping cream, divided ( i use cream half and half ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half ( may need additional cream ) | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs ( or your favourite cracker crumbs )
