instructions: Preheat oven to 350 °f. Combine sausage, squash and 1/2 cup cream in a large nonstick skillet. Cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until sausage is done. Drain, reserving drippings. Return skillet to medium heat, add remaining 1 cup cream, and cook until cream is reduced to about 3/4 cup. Stir in paprika and vinegar and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and stir in bread crumbs. Spoon into a 4 - ½ quart casserole dish or a lightly oiled glass pie plate. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, or until golden brown, and filling is hot and bubbly. Makes 8 servings.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,brown sugar,pork roast,white onion,salmon fillet,ricotta cheese,red pepper,thai chile
title: Roasted Pork and Salmon With Ricotta & Chilli Gravy
ingredients: 1 pork roast | 1 red pepper, halved, deseeded and roughly chopped | 1 white onion, roughly chopped | 125 g tub-style ricotta cheese | 150 g light brown sugar, firmly packed | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 -3 teaspoons dried thai chiles | 2 -4 tablespoons thai chilli sauce ( or your own favourite dipping sauce )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c/gas in a roasting tin, lightly oil the pork. Put the red pepper, onion, red pepper and ricotta into a food processor and pulse until the ricotta is smooth. Add the sugar, nutmeg and chilli sauce, blending well. Spoon the mixture onto the pork slices, close the tin and put in the oven. For one hour and 15 minutes, or until the pork is cooked and the vegetables and vegetables are soft and tender and well heated through. You can check your internal temperature now.

title: Italian Vegetables With Orange-Powdered Pimento Filling
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange liqueur ( good quality ) | 2 tablespoons minced onions | 2 tablespoons minced pimiento | 2 large peeled pared parsnips | 2 cans pimento-stuffed plum tomatoes or ( 19 ounce ) cans any other mixed vegetables | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas carrots
instructions: In a large bowl, combine orange liqueur, onion, pimiento, parsnips and peas carrots. Mix well and set aside while flavors chill. To assemble, place 1 1/2 tablespoons of filling on each of 8 small plates. Top with parsnips and/or vegetables. Serve with a nice crisp sourdough bread for dipping.

title: Wyoming Soup With Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs dried pinto beans | 6 quarts water | 2 large onions, chopped | 1 leek, chopped | 2/3 cup uncooked white rice | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Add beans and cover with water. Soak 3 hours or overnight. Add remaining ingredients, and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pounded Chocolate Rounds With Rye Bread and Crushed Fudge
ingredients: 4 tablespoons rye bread, chopped | 12 tablespoons baking chocolate, finely chopped ( bittersweet ) or 12 tablespoons bittersweet chocolate, coarsely chopped ( bittersweet ) | 2 teaspoons cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the rye and chocolate in a bowl, and set aside. In a medium bowl, stir together the cayenne and the remaining baking chocolate. Toast bread briefly on both sides in the oven, using a butter knife, to spread evenly. Let cool slightly. Using a pastry bag fitted with a star tip, pipe the chocolate mixture into the toasted bread, and spread out lightly. Allow to cool completely before storing. Refrigerate leftover chocolate mixture in a covered container.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,oyster sauce,vanilla extract,bamboo shoot,mango chutney,lentil,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Lentil Burgers With Mangoes
ingredients: 1/4 cup lentils, browned and drained | 4 ounces of your favorite fresh mango chutney | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon plain nonfat yogurt | 2 ounces bamboo shoots, cut into bite size pieces | corn chips
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a bowl. Serve with corn chips.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,clove,yeast,bay leaf,almond brown,corn kernel,cream,yellow squash
title: Chinese Corn and Squash With Chohari
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 8 cups warm corn kernels | 1 bay leaf | 2 whole cloves | 3 medium yellow squash, halved and cut into 3-inch chunks | 2 large zucchini, cut into 3-inch chunks | 1/4 cup light cream | 1/4 cup slivered almonds or 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over the warm corn kernels. In a large saucepan bring the remaining corn, bay leaf and cloves to a boil. Cover and cook over high heat until it boils, about 45 seconds. Reduce the heat to low. Simmer, uncovered, for 25 minutes to 1 hour. Remove bay leaf. Preheat broiler. Place squash, zucchini, and cream in a large bowl. Mix well. Let stand 10 minutes. Spread the squash mixture evenly over 5 pieces of wax paper. Spread evenly with cream mixture, leaving a 1/4 inch border on the top. Place 1 slivered almond and enough of the light brown sugar to cover the mixture by 3 inches.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian bean,baby onion,kalamata olive,popped popcorn,maraschino cherry
title: Veggie Popcorn Salad
ingredients: 1 bag hot popcorn | 1 lb vegetarian refried beans | 3 cups shredded baby onions | 1 jar maraschino cherries or ( 16 ounce ) jar kalamata olives, sliced | 20 -24 pitted kalamata olives, drained with juice
instructions: Prepare popcorn according to package directions. Stir to coat the bottom of a 9x13 in greased pan with cooking spray. Bake at 300 degrees. Toast the onions and drain. Set aside. Place the frozen popcorn in a large bowl. Add the refried beans and kalamata olives, and gently toss. Toss lightly with the popcorn mixture. Serve immediately or refrigerate, covered, until chilled.

title: German Breakfast Sandwiches (Ciabatta or Burgers)
ingredients: 2 medium iceberg lettuce or 2 medium other greens | 16 slices hamburger ( about 1/4-1/2 inch thick ) | 4 teaspoons caraway seeds ( optional )
instructions: Trim excess tough stems from the lettuce. Cut each leaf in half lengthwise. Using a very sharp knife or other large serving sized knife or scissors, thinly slice the lettuce. Remove the tough, bruised sections of lettuce leaves. Fill a large bowl with cold water and let sit 10 minutes. Wipe the sink with a paper towel, then drain the water from the bowl of lettuce. Place the prepared lettuce over the sink and set aside. Meanwhile, preheat the broiler. Place the hamburgers on a lightly oiled non stick baking sheet. Broil 5 to 6 from heat, turning once, for 5 minutes, until cooked through. Meanwhile, spread one side of each of the lettuce halves with the caraway seeds, if using. Place the lettuce halves on a serving plate, close the sandwich, and cut into halves. Serve.

title: The Best Sanko Flank Steak in the World (Crispy)
ingredients: 1 lb beef flank steak | 3 -4 tablespoons self-rising flour, divided | 2/3 cup molasses | 2/3 cup yogurt ( plain or fat free ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Cut steak against grain into very thin slices about the thickness of a french fry. Mix 1/2 teaspoon of the flour with 1/2 cup of the molasses with 1 tablespoon of the yogurt. Place the steak slices in the bag with the flour mixture and shake to coat. Heat nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add meat and cook 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Remove meat and place on baking sheet, loosely cover and keep warm in a low oven for 30 minutes. Pour remaining molasses into skillet and cook until almost dry, about 3 minutes and it has thickened to desired consistency. Combine remaining flour and remaining yogurt and stir into molasses mixture. Pour over meat and serve over steaks.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,pork belly,spring onion,radish,golden raisin,honey,swiss cheese,ginger paste
title: Sweet-Tasty Korean Pork Salad
ingredients: 4 cups lettuce, torn or shredded | 8 ounces swiss cheese, sliced ( kimchee, or other favorite cheese ) | 2 medium radishes, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup spring onion, roughly chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup golden raisin, roughly chopped | 1/2 tablespoon ginger paste | 3 tablespoons honey or 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 lb pork belly
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients into a casserole dish. Mix honey or brown sugar and set aside. Put pork in casserole then cover with honey/brown sugar mixture. Add sliced radishes and cook till limp. Toss all ingredients together till well mixed. Serve warm. Note, may also be served on lettuce leaves, for a pretty side dish enjoy.

title: Oven-Baked Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 2 tablespoons shredded orange peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spread brown rice on a baking sheet, and scatter orange peel around. Cook in the preheated oven, stirring every 20 minutes, until rice grains are tender and rice is browned, 20 - 35 minutes. Allow to cool, then break rice into chunks and mix with reserved orange peel.

title: Beware Very Sour Caper Dressing
ingredients: 2 teaspoons capers, drained | 1/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Drain the capers well and spread onto a salad plate. Sprinkle generously with paprika. Serve with salads.

title: Breaded Pepperoni - Johnsonville Style
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pepperoni, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 1 1/2 lbs hard-boiled eggs, thinly sliced
instructions: Lay pepperoni slices on a large platter in a single layer. Scatter cut eggs over the pepperoni. Cover loosely with foil. Bake at 325°f degrees for one hour and 20 minutes, or until the eggs are hot.

title: Tacos
ingredients: 1 russet potato | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1/8 teaspoon powdered saffron | 6 corn tortillas | 6 pieces saffron
instructions: In a pan, add 1 tblsp of golden syrup mixed in a little of each of your little pinch of saffron threads. After 2 minutes, add the potato, which should be just covered, and enough water to almost cover it. Boil down, and then after 5 minutes, turn up heat to a medium and simmer, uncovered, until you have a nice thin, golden brown mush of potato. When the potatoes are tender, drain them, and then put the potatoes in an oven proof dish, and spread them out to make a thick layer. Top them with another layer of browned bread and a sprinkling of powdered saffron. Finally, sprinkle with a few saffron flakes. Place in medium oven, until golden. You will need to check your corn tortillas to make sure they’re crisp. Serve hot with your preferred salad.

title: Scotch Shortbread - (Pepperidge Farm)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hard-wooden pieces of good quality scotch bonnet chow mein noodles or 2 tablespoons scotch bonnet chow mein butter | 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated with a pinch of salt, plus little extra for sprinkling ( see note ) | 1/2 lb ground mild italian sausage | 1/2 cup chopped glace ginger ( fresh and grated, to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Have ready a baking pan. Soak wooden pieces in a pot of warm water until soft, approx 10 minutes, then drain and return to the bowl. Using a fork, stir together the cheddar cheese and the sausage, set aside. Using a wooden speculaar, gently fold the sifted cheese with the butter until completely incorported, but not completely smooth, then stir in 1/2 of the cheese and the chopped ginger. Using the back of your spoon, fold in the reserved cheese and ginger, and season generously with salt. Press into the palm of your hand and cut into squares. Using the reserved cheese, sprinkle the square lightly with extra cheese and ginger from step 1 bake for 45 minutes, and check for doneness.. The shortbread is well cooked when it resembles crackers.

Random Ingredients: egg white,molasses,alfredo sauce,wine,pepper,self rising flour,ziti pasta
title: Ziti Calabrese
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup ground pepper | 1 egg white | 1 cup molasses | 1 cup merlot wine or 1 cup sherry wine | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 lb ziti pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease a 13 x 9 inch baking dish or an 11 x 7 inch baking dish with oil. Mix flour, pepper, egg white and molasses in medium bowl. Add wine and alfredo sauce. Mix gently. Stir in pasta. Bake uncovered, for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until light brown on top and bubbly. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes.

title: Stir Fry Vegetables
ingredients: 2 large broccoli, cut into florets | 4 -5 medium prawns, cooked ( cooked shelled and halved ) | 1 -2 teaspoon dried hot chili pepper flakes ( optional or adjust to suit heat level ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 -3 teaspoons palm sugar | 80 ml chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat a wok and cook the broccoli, prawns and chili flakes over high heat for 1 - 2 minutes or until the vegetables have turned bright green. Add the fish sauce and sugar and cook for a further 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in the chickpeas and fry for a further 3 - 4 minutes or until the mixture is heated through and fragrant. Serve immediately.

title: Pistachio Powder
ingredients: 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh serrano chili | 1 teaspoon shelled pistachio nuts
instructions: Combine the chile and pistachio nuts in a mortar and crush them with your pestle. Let dry and stir constantly for 15 minutes or until smooth. Store in a tightly sealed container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,chicken breast half,lime wedge,fajita seasoning mix,cream mushroom soup,paprika
title: Mexican Chicken With Potato Broth
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 3 tablespoons potato starch | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Marinate the chicken in taco seasoning mix with paprika, potato starch, and cream of mushroom soup in the refrigerator for at least 15 minutes. Place the chicken in the bottom of a greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon the chicken on top of the corn chips, then spread evenly. Sprinkle the remaining taco seasoning mix on top, then cover with tin foil. Bake in a preheated 400°f oven for 1 hour. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: four cheese mexican,cold water,zucchini,chicken leg,cremini mushroom
title: Mexican Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken leg, split | 2 1/2 cups cold water | 12 cremini mushrooms, sliced thin | 12 zucchini, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 cup four-cheese mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken in 9x13 inch oven safe baking dish. Add water.

title: Horseradish Mushroom Corn Chips
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 lemon, zested | 8 white mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup coarsely shredded corn
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the potatoes, and return to a boil. Cook the potatoes uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm, about 15 minutes. Drain. Transfer the potatoes to a bowl, and toss with the bread crumbs, horseradish, and lemon zest. Arrange the potatoes on a large serving platter. Top with mushrooms, and scatter the corn over the mushrooms. Drizzle with about 1/4 cup of the horseradish sauce, and sprinkle with about 1 tablespoon of the shredded cheese. Finish with a drizzle of drizzle of the remaining sauce.

title: Sweet Eggplant (Aubergine) Rolls
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled and cut into 8 slices | 1/2 lb pork sausage | 2 eggs, hard boiled, chopped | 1 cup finely chopped walnuts | 32 egg roll wraps
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Brush each slice of eggplant lightly with olive oil. Slice sausages in half lengthwise and divide each slice between the eggplant slices. Lay half the chopped eggplant slices on top of eggplant slices. Sprinkle the walnuts over all and top with remaining slices. Sprinkle the egg rolls with remaining nuts. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Aussie Beef Stew
ingredients: 600 g beef chuck, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons white flour | 250 ml vegetable stock
instructions: Add the beef to a casserole dish with flour, stock and a bit of water. Season with salt and pepper and mix. Cover and bake at 150c for 3 hours stirring halfway through or until the meat is tender. Add more water if it dries, if it needs to.

title: The Perfect French Onion Soup
ingredients: 8 cups vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons cinnamon
instructions: Boil the broth in a heavy soup pot on the stove. When the broth hits a boil, add the onions and bring back to a boil. Pour the broth into a blender and blend until liquefied. Return to the pot, and stir in the cinnamon. Heat through.

title: Turkish Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 cup plain balkan yogurt or 1 cup greek yogurt | 2 -3 dashes crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Using clean cloth or muslin, gently transfer yogurt to cloth and squeeze out excess water. Place yogurt in mixing bowl and mix well. Add red pepper flakes and mix. Cover with plastic wrap and let yogurt dip rest in refrigerator for an hour. Remove the plastic wrap and serve immediately. Great for a quick dip for pita chips.

title: Marinated Artichokes - Ramekins
ingredients: 3 cups arborio rice | 10 cups tuna packed in oil | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup ground walnut oil ( i used a mixture of the three ) | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary
instructions: Using a strainer or a strainer, rinse the arborio or rice until the water runs clear. Place the rice in a large bowl. Add tuna and 2 cups cold water and mix gently to combine. Cover and let sit for 20 minutes. Do not refrigerate the rice. Drain the tuna and reserve the oil. In a food processor add the bread crumbs, walnut oil and rosemary. Process until smooth. Preheat oven to 300 degrees, wrap a large baking sheet in foil and line it with parchment paper. Using the hands, squeeze about 8 1/2 cups of the water out of the tuna tuna, add the tuna mixture to the bread crumb mixture and mix well. The tuna mixture should be slightly wet. Spoon the rice onto the baking sheet. Spread with the tuna mixture and place on the baking sheet. Place in an oven for 30 minutes, the rice should be golden brown and there should be a golden crust. Remove the tray from the oven and place a large piece of foil on top. Serve.

title: Homemade Chips Chips
ingredients: 4 corn tortilla chips | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon season-all salt
instructions: Combine sea salt and season all in a medium bowl. Coat the inside of the container of a regular sized plastic bag, with a nonstick spray. Using a rolling pin, crush the sea salt onto the chips. Dip each chip into the salt and allow to sit to solidify. Store in the fridge until ready to use, and never use any additional seasoning. Allow the chips to air dry before using.

title: Homemade Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup italian dressing | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried pimiento | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 2 small radishes, very thinly sliced
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the italian dressing, cream, taco seasoning, pimiento, and sea salt until well combined. Place the radish slices in a layer into the mixture, covering completely. Cover and place back in the refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Cranberry Horseradish Spread
ingredients: 250 g cranberry sauce | 1 tablespoon horseradish, grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients, and mix well or store in a jar in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,oil vinegar dressing,chicken wing,chocolate,oregano leaf,italian herb seasoning
title: Italian Chicken Wings - Batali Style
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings, ends trimmed and wings cut off | 2 large eggplants, pared and sliced | 1 1/2 cups oil and vinegar dressing | 3 packets italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves or 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate, grated
instructions: Cook wings and eggplant slices according to package directions. Meanwhile, in large resealable plastic bag, toss chicken wings and eggplant slices with dressing and seasoning. Coat large skillet or grill basket with cooking spray. Heat over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Add chicken wings and eggplant pieces. Cook, turning, until browned on both sides. Cover chicken and eggplant with foil. Heat about 7 - 10 minutes longer or until chicken is cooked through. Sprinkle with grated chocolate.

title: Capelline Spinach
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon dried onion salt | 10 ounces fresh spinach leaves, washed, well packed and trimmed | 4 -6 pieces dried new york chilies or 4 -6 pieces jalapeno chiles | 2 tablespoons apricot jam, can sub orange flavored if desired
instructions: Sprinkle onion salt over leaves and let stand 5 minutes. Place on a microwave safe dish that is coated with cooking spray and add chiles. Microwave on high for about 10 seconds or until chiles are heated. Transfer to a container and stir to re distribute all. Sprinkle jam over and mix thoroughly. Chill 1 - 2 hours or overnight, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,shrimp paste,pineapple juice,cayenne pepper,red bell pepper
title: Pineapple and Shrimp Kebabs
ingredients: 20 large shrimp paste | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, ground | 1 red bell pepper, finely chopped | cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cut kababs into bite sized chunks. Thread on skewers. Grill, basting regularly with soy sauce. This recipe doubles well in an oven as well.

title: Baked Rice, Thyme and Brown Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown mustard seeds | 1/4 cup packed fresh thyme ( or 1 teaspoon dried thyme ) | 1/4 cup light sour cream | 1/2 cup brown rice | 12 warm tortillas
instructions: Heat oven to 300°. Spread mustard seeds in a baking sheet and toast 30 mins, stirring every so often, until black. Cool. Finely grind thyme and mustard seeds in a pestle and mortar. Stir sour cream and brown rice into mustard and mustard seeds. Spread about 1/4 cup of the rice mixture into each warm tortilla. Bake 18 mins, or until heated through. Cut into 3/4 inch sections. Serve with your favourite condiments.

title: Connie's Cuban Midnight
ingredients: 2 cans beef consomme | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 1 bottle jalapeno, drained | 1 cup madeira wine | 8 fluid ounces club soda
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crock pot. Set on low for 4 - 6 hours.

title: Chinese Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 chinese cabbage | 2 cups bread, cubed | 3 cups seasoned stuffing ( optional ) | 1 3/4 cups white flour | 1 tablespoon dried rose water
instructions: Cut the ends off the cabbage. Separate the core from the outer leaves and discard. Slice the leaves into thin slices. Place the cabbage and bread pieces in a large saucepan. Add enough water to cover the cabbage. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Add the stuffing and rose water, and continue to simmer until the vegetables are tender. Add more water if the soup becomes too thick.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,icing sugar,onion soup mix,sharp cheddar cheese,rhubarb,tofu,broccoli floret,red chili powder
title: Vegetable Fritters With Tofu
ingredients: 8 ounces firm tofu, drained | 8 ounces broccoli florets ( trimmed and chopped into 1/4 inch lengths ) | 8 ounces rhubarb, chopped into 1/4 inch lengths | 1/2 small onion soup mix, crushed | 8 -12 cardamom pods, cracked | 1 teaspoon fresh red chili powder | 4 teaspoons icing sugar | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Slice tofu into thin slabs and set aside. In a saucepan of boiling water, blanch the broccoli and rhubarb for 1 minute and drain. Cut vegetables into bite sized bite sized pieces and sprinkle with crushed cardamom pods and chopped red chili powder. Pour vegetable mixture into a pan of boiling water and boil over high heat for 1 minute. Drain the vegetable mixture and keep warm in a separate pan of simmering water. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan combine the soup mix and the dry soup mix and stir until well blended and simmer for a minute or so. Stir the mixture into the vegetable mixture and heat through until thoroughly heated. Divide mixture among four fritter moulds. Sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: Nova Scotia Meatballs with Hokkien
ingredients: 1 jar dried cranberry peppers or 4 ounces honey roasted red peppers, chopped | 1 lb boneless lean pork or 1 lb ground beef | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 cup sliced banana | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh horseradish | 6 hamburger lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup dry penne or 1/2 cup rotini pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Combine cranberries and peppers. Stir into pork, adding bacon drippings if using. Shape into 1 inch balls. Place on baking sheet, cover with foil and place under broiler until golden brown, turning once. Place on platter. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, saute banana in hot oil until just tender, about 3 minutes. Place in large bowl with meatballs. Cover and chill. In 2 quart casserole, combine hot pasta and sauce. Gently toss to coat meatballs. Cover and bake until heated through about 5 minutes. Serve with warm bread.

title: Beef Steak
ingredients: 12 ounces good quality beer, of your choice | 12 ounces frozen vegetable bouillon cubes | 1 medium yellow bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: Slice the bell pepper into 1/4 inch thick slivers. In a large crock pot, place the bell pepper slivers and a few frozen bouillon cubes in the bottom of the crock pot with the beer. Start your steak in the liquid, then add the remaining frozen bouillon cubes. Cook on high setting for 4 hours or on low setting for 3 hours, or until the sauce is bubbly and the peppers are tender.. Serve over cooked white rice, garnished with extra shredded cheddar and a fresh garden salad.

title: Beef Prawns With Beer
ingredients: 12 ounces beef tenderloin, cubed | 1 tablespoon shortening | 8 fluid ounces beer | 3 green onions, sliced ( including tops ) | 1 cup cornmeal | sliced green onion | 24 prawns | 24 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f melt shortening in a wok over medium heat. Brown beef on all sides.

title: Crazy Tweaked Edamame
ingredients: 2 cups dehydrated edamame | 1/4 cup chopped fresh jalapeno chile | 1/4 cup soy barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Cook edamame and jalapeno in boiling water 3 minutes or until tender. Drain, and rinse with cold water to cool. Transfer to bowl, and stir in sauces. Cover, and refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Grilled Feta Cheese with Red Pepper and Onion Rings
ingredients: 1/2 package crumbled feta cheese | 4 red bell pepper, quartered lengthwise and thinly sliced | 4 large onion rings, thinly sliced
instructions: Arrange feta cheese, red bell pepper, and onion rings in a grill or large skillet, and press together to make a sandwich. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir sandwiches in the hot skillet 3 to 5 minutes, until lightly browned on the edges and crumbly on the bottoms. Turn heat to high, and cook 1 more minute, until no longer pink. Cut diagonally through the crusty top of the cheese with a spatula. Lightly grill onion rings over medium low heat, or broil the cheese for 1 to 2 minutes, until they begin to soften.

title: Duck Fritters (For the Grill)
ingredients: 2 -3 duck breasts | 8 -10 white poppy seeds ( the dried won't do with this recipe but i find this is just right, i'm a spice pu )
instructions: If you are using whole skinless duck breasts, leave the duck whole in the cavity of the breast as it will be very crumbly and it will make your fritters dry. Rinse the duck inside and out under cold water, dry well with paper towels and wipe dry. If you are using boned chicken breast, place them in a large, heavy skillet with 1/2 of the water, bring to a boil, lower the heat and simmer briskly with the turkey breast until all of the water has been released and the mixture is reduced to approximately 1 1/2 cup. Pour 1/2 cup water out of the pan, remove the cooked duck, then cut a slit lengthwise down from the breast, and cut a few deep slits lengthwise into it, cutting out the bone, neck and backbone. Push the chicken meat through a slit into both of the breast halves before trimming all of the visible fat inside the slit. Repeat with the remaining duck breasts. Spread the poppy seeds evenly within the cavity of each duck, and place them in a large, heavy frying pan, add water just to cover the contents of the pan. Bring to a boil, lower the heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the dumplings are fully cooked this will take about 20 to 25 minutes. When it is cooked through, remove them from the pan and immediately fill them with a large spoonful of the hot liquid in the pan. I like it to be quite dry so i just pour off a bit of the liquid and pour it back in and add some more liquid if it starts too dry. Serve hot.

title: Raisin-Toasted English Muesli
ingredients: 2 tablespoons wheat cereal | 1/3 cup white raisins | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat a toasted waffle iron. Stir the wheat cereal, raisins, and worcestershire sauce together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.

title: Ranch Style Sweet Chile Paste
ingredients: 1 kg palm sugar | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Wash the palm sugar till the water darkens. Add it to an iron frying pan with the red chilly powder. Add the palm sugar mixture and fry till the mixture starts separating from the sides. Once transparent, remove from the stove. Allow to cool. After an hour, pour the mixture into a clean glass jar and seal. Let stand for one hour then seal and store in the fridge. To serve, store airtight for upto 3 months.

title: Mint Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons mint leaves, chopped | 4 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a glass or stainless steel bowl and stir. Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring every so often.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,vanilla yogurt,mint leaf,dark red kidney bean,green cardamom pod,tea
title: Spicy Indian Tea
ingredients: 1 cup strong tea, cold | 1 tablespoon unsweetened vanilla soy yogurt | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed | 1 sprigs mint leaves, finely chopped | fresh thyme leaves, finely chopped | dried red kidney beans or cannellini bean ( cannellini beans may also be experimented with ) | 1 sprig mint leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Put the tea, soy yogurt, cardamom pod, green cardamom, mint and thyme sprigs in a blender and combine well. Blend for 10 seconds or until frothy. Pour hot tea into warm teas and add beans and mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: salad green,bay leaf,lamb chop,sea salt,liquid honey,pimiento,prosciutto,thyme
title: Pimiento and Barbeque Lamb Chops
ingredients: 6 lamb chops | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 2 -3 tablespoons liquid honey | 4 piquanto-stuffed pimientos, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 2 bay leaves | salad greens, washed | prosciutto, sliced, for garnish
instructions: Sprinkle chops with water, lemon juice and salt and leave to marinate at room temperature. Stir together honey and pimento slices, then spread around chops. Preheat pan, add chops, and cook 3 minutes on each side. Place bay leaves on plate, and place chops on top of bay leaves. Cover with greens, drizzle with honey mixture, and garnish with prosciutto slices.

title: Italian Barley Clam Lassi
ingredients: 2 cups chopped fresh coriander leaves | 2 cups light italian dressing | 2 cups lemon juice | 1 cup barley | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: In a large container, place the coriander, dressing, lemon juice, and barley in a blender or food processor and process until well combined. Add the cheese and process until combined.

title: Creamy Italian Bread Dip
ingredients: 3 loaves rye bread | 1 can evaporated soy milk | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper powder ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon celery, finely chopped
instructions: Cut each loaf in half and spread the bread out on cookie sheets with parchment paper or jelly. In a medium bowl, combine evaporated milk, spicy red pepper, celery and half a can of soy milk mixture. Stir till well blended. Spread evenly over the bread and top with remaining soy milk mixture. Bake at 325 for 40 - 50 minutes, or until bread is browned and liquid has been absorbed. Serve warm with other rye bread dip.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,swiss cheese,garlic salt,ginger paste,spanish olive,tortilla chip,cherry tomato
title: Spicy Mushroom Cheese Spread #SP5
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs button mushrooms ( about 6 medium ) | 2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1 cup cherry tomatoes | 1/4 cup spanish olives | 1/2 bag tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to slice mushrooms 1/8 inch thick. Place mushrooms, cheeses, garlic salt, ginger paste, cherry tomatoes and olives in baking dish coated with cooking spray. Bake in 350 degree oven for 20 minutes or until cheese mixture melted and bubbly. Remove from oven and stir.

title: Choy Balls
ingredients: 3 bunches bok choy, washed | 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Wash the bok choy very well and cut off some of the dark stalks. Place the bok choy heads in a steamer basket and line them over a pot of boiling water. Cook for about 5 minutes. Drain the heads and allow them to cool down. When the heads are cool enough to handle, cut away any tough, woody parts the stalk. Chop the stalks. Mix the bok choy leaves and the sour cream in the bowl you will be using it to make the bok choy balls. Form balls the size of a walnut.

title: Tortilla Chip Tarts
ingredients: 1/2 lb puff pastry, unrolled ( about one 17 x 11 x 2. 5-inch ) | 2 tablespoons baking powder | 3 scallions | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram ( or 3-4 sprigs fresh marjoram ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 f. Lightly flour a baking sheet. On a lightly floured board, roll out the pastry to 10x6 inches. Transfer to the prepared baking sheet, trimming to fit if necessary.. With a sharp knife, cut the pastry all the way through to the bottom of the sheet, being careful not to cut all the way through. You’ll be able to use more than one sheet at a time. Scrape any excess pastry from the sheet and reserve. Sprinkle the scallions over the pastry leaving about 1/2 inch at the top for a little decorative flavor. In a small bowl, stir together the marjoram and tortilla chips. Sprinkle this over the scallions. Carefully remove the top sheet of pastry from the sheet and sprinkle over the chip mixture. Add the dough to the top. With a sharp knife, cut away any excess dough. Cut out the pastry in two 1/2 inch slices, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Using a very sharp knife, cut through each slice using a pastry wheel and transfer to a baking sheet. Bake until the tortillas are golden brown in color, about 12 – 20 minutes.

title: String Beans (Finnish style)
ingredients: 2 large string beans, stems trimmed and left on | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, squeezed zest
instructions: Snap off and discard ends of the string beans. Cut beans diagonally into 1 inch lengths. In a large bowl, mix together vegetable zest, lemon juice and lemon juice. Transfer to a serving dish or a platter.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,shortening,extra virgin olive oil
title: Broiled Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening | 1/2 cup sifted powdered icing sugar | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped dried red pepper flakes
instructions: Cut the cold shortening or margarine into the powdered sugar. Stir the red pepper flakes into the shortening. Sprinkle the mixture over very hot griddle or skillet. Turn over once, and press down to flatten slightly.

title: Italian Meatball and Ricotta Rollups
ingredients: 8 -12 frozen meatballs | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 1/2 tablespoon amaretto | 2 -3 teaspoons red food coloring | 3 cups crushed ice cubes | 4 tortillas or 4 other flatbreads
instructions: Thaw meatballs and pat dry with paper towels. Slit and pack each meatball in a piece of cheesecloth so that the ends are slightly on outside of bone. Secure a piece of twine around the ends so that some of the cheese stays loose. Blend filling ingredients together in a large bowl and set aside. Roll meatballs in crushed ice. Spray or brush each roll with amaretto. Bake in a pre heated oven at 450° for 20 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve with bread for dipping.

title: Romano's Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese | pepper
instructions: Stir all ingredients in medium saucepan over medium heat until the cheeses have melted.

title: Ancho Baked Sausage, Gherkin, and Bulgur Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs mild italian sausage | 1 cup red onion, minced | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 12 cups bulgur, cooked | 4 stalks celery, minced | 1/4 cup gherkin, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Prick sausages several times with a fork. Arrange in a nonstick roasting pan. Mix the chopped onions with the dried chile powder. Sprinkle on all of the sausages. Roast, uncovered, for about 1 1/2 hours, basting occasionally. Cool slightly and slice.

title: Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup tamarind sauce | 2 tablespoons curry
instructions: Mix together.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,lentil,cream cheese,peach juice,salt black pepper
title: Peach Lentil Dip
ingredients: 2 containers fat-free cream cheese, softened | 2/3 cup dried lentils | 1 cup diced canned peaches with juice | 2/3 cup bottled whipped salad dressing or 2/3 cup bottled peach and peach chutney | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Add cream cheese to food processor. Blend and gradually add rest of the ingredients. Process until completely mixed.

title: Kathy's Pizza Wonton Wedges
ingredients: wonton wrappers, squares | 1 cup pizza crust ( the larger if you want it to stay together even better ) | 1 cup chopped red pepper | salt and pepper
instructions: Spray baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine dry ingredients and put on baking sheet. Take wonton squares. Went the wonton in a little olive oil, then spread over dough. When dough is half way done, sprinkle with a lot of pepper and then drizzle a dash of olive oil on top if desired. If oven is a lower rack, it may take less time this part if you have a lower rack so check on it every 15 - 20 minutes. If oven is higher, it may take less time. When dough is done, it's ready. Dump it on a baking sheet and let to cool for a minute. Slice and serve.

title: Pizza Delight
ingredients: 1 refrigerated pizza crust ( boboli ) | 1 jar taco sauce | 1 package caramels in syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 3 cans crushed tomatoes in puree
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Slice pizza crust in half.

title: Potato traditional Wedgie
ingredients: 2 lbs simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 1 packet onion soup mix ( i use lipton onion soup mix onion soup mix onion soup mix in the tube )
instructions: Heat oven to 425f degrees. Open onion soup mix envelope and pour into bowl. Pour hot liquid from bowl into bowl of onions, to make a gravy like consistency. Line oven safe casserole in oven. Pour mashed potatoes into casserole. You'll be covering with gravy. Bake for 45 mins then place on baking rack to catch any juice. Eat and enjoy.

title: Artichokes and Mushrooms on the Cob
ingredients: 1 ounce canned artichoke hearts | 2 ounces canned white mushrooms | 4 corn
instructions: Drain and rinse artichokes and mushrooms in a colander. Cut corn from cob. Brush each cob with oil, and place on rack. Cook for about 8 - 10 minutes. Cut each cob into 4 squares or 2 pieces. The mushroom and artichokes should be slightly blistered. If any juices bubble up outside, remove from the stove and cover for some other time to reduce. When cool remove from the cob, and cut squares into thirds or into thirds if needed. This goes a little easier at first and you can eat them right away or store them in the freezer.

title: Chickpea and Grameshian Kebabs
ingredients: 1/3 cup hulled vegetables, frozen, thawed | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 3 tablespoons grenadine | 3 1/2 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 1/8 cm galangal, peeled, finely chopped | 2 1/8 cm bagels, coarsely crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. To serve, place a bagel on plate. Place 1 tsp bagels in the center.

title: Easy-To-Do Beef and Swiss Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced lean filet of beef | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Arrange beef on the bottom half of a lightly greased heavy 12 inch pie plate. Scatter cheese over beef slices. Set aside. Cover with remaining crust, plastic wrap, and a cloth towel. Microwave on high power for 5 to 10 minutes, until crust is puffed and cheese is bubbly.

title: Chopsticks With Spicy Peanut Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh yellow pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh walnuts, chopped | 8 ounces small white beans, drained | 8 large green tea leaves | 1 cup instant quinoa | 1 small habanero pepper ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Place bell pepper and walnuts on a foil lined baking sheet.

title: Cauli-Free Italian Beans
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 pinch hungarian paprika | 1/2 cup fat free half and half or 1/2 cup half-and-half ricotta cheese | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 lb swiss proscuitto, sliced thinly lengthwise 3-4 slices and about 2-inches long | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the beans and 1/2 cup of the half and half. Reduce heat to medium.

title: Linguine Soup
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, chopped | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped | 3 packages frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 package dry linguine | 1 can corned beef brisket, drained and cubed
instructions: Heat a large pot of water to a boil. Drain the beef and place in a large, deep skillet. Add the lettuce, mixed vegetables and meat, being careful not to crowd the vegetables. Cook and stir until the vegetables are tender. Cook the linguine according to package directions, drain and divide among two bowls. Top with corned beef cubes and serve.

title: Pinchi (Indian Hot Pepper Spice)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds | 1 tablespoon unsweetened apple cider vinegar
instructions: Add crushed cardamom seeds to a small bowl of water. Bring vinegar to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat and stir in ground spices. Remove from heat. Remove from heat and let steep for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Tex-Mex Beef Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, trimmed of fat and cut into strips | 3 medium shallots, thinly sliced ( or more, to taste ) | 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles | 4 cups halved strawberries ( or more, to taste ) | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half, divided ( or more ) | 1 jar taco sauce or ( 12 ounce ) jar salsa, heated
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f brown beef in dry nonstick skillet over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and cook until just cooked through. Stir in shallots and cook 2 minutes. Remove beef mixture.

title: Spicy Portuguese Pickled Cauliflower
ingredients: 500 g cauliflower, broken into florets | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon crushed tamarind pulp | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon spanish chorizo sausage
instructions: Heat oil in a non stick skillet over medium high heat. Add the tamarind pulp and cook just until the pulp releases its aroma. Add the chorizo, cooking until all the chorizo has changed color, about 2 minutes. Add the cauliflower and stir to coat with the liquid. When all ingredients are coated thoroughly with the tamarind liquid and heated through, about 5 - 10 minutes, transfer the contents of the skillet to a serving dish and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,golden mushroom soup,berry,apple,range egg yolk,ginger paste,radish,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Ginger Cheese & Mushroom Egg Yolks
ingredients: 1 large free-range egg yolks ( or equivalent ) | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup ( or equivalent-prepared condensed cream ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste ( or 1 tablespoon fresh minced ginger ) | 2 -3 tablespoons finely diced raw apples ( optional ) | 4 -6 thinly sliced fresh jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely diced ( optional ) | 4 -6 fresh slices of thin sliced white ginger, finely crushed or 4 -6 slices ginger paste ( optional ) | fresh berries ( optional ) or green apple, chopped ( optional ) | 1 slice medium sharp cheddar cheese ( optional ) | 1 radish, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Whisk together the egg yolks, condensed soup, ginger, apples, jalapenos, and apples with the ginger, then stir in the cheese. Grate some of the cheese and stir it into the other egg mixture. Add a dollop of the mixture into a warm serving dish. Garnish with berries or sliced fresh, white, or some green apples, or the radish slices. This could be prepared in advance and kept for up to 3 days. May be frozen for up to 6 months.

title: Maurie's Beet and Poppy Seed Ravioli
ingredients: 4 beets, sliced thinly | 4 ounces dry pasta shells, cooked | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Grate the beets and set aside. In a small bowl, add the poppy seeds and set aside. In a skillet, place beets with about 1/2 cup water. Cook over low heat for about 20 minutes. Drain water off and in the meantime, cook your pasta. When cooked, drain beets, reserving 1/2 cup of their liquid. Chop coarsely. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add 1 cup of water and the pasta, bring to a boil. Cook for about 2 minutes. In a separate pan over med, add 2 t. Of the remaining beet liquid and 1/2 t. Of the poppy seeds. Heat the liquid until it just begins to boil or it begins to darken in color. Add the beet mixture to the pasta. When mixed well, remove from heat and top with the poppy seeds and fresh green onions. Serve immediately.

title: Savory S & P Pasta
ingredients: 500 g macaroni ( spirals work best ) | 200 -500 ml dried cherries in juice ( about 2 tablespoons ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | chocolate piece | 1 pinch ground sage leaf | salt & pepper | cherry jam ( optional ) or sunflower oil ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta in rapidly boiling water, then drain. Sauté the tomato paste and sage in a little chocolate for a few minutes. Add the drained pasta and mash together with the chocolate. Season with rosemary, salt and pepper and serve warm with cherry or sunflower jam or oil and cherries.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,cooking oat,dark rum,mace,french onion soup mix,fenugreek seed,oyster sauce
title: Homemade Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 250 g dried quick cooking oats | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( fenugreek seeds ) | 1 teaspoon mace | 100 ml dark rum | 1 packet french onion soup mix ( can buy ready bought from asian grocery stores ) | 2 teaspoons orange peel, grated | 2 teaspoons dark rum | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Place quick cooking oats, fenugreek seeds and mace in a bowl. Add rum, onion soup mix, orange peel and alcohol. Mix well. Add oyster sauce. Blend well and pour over oats. You can use your favourite dry ingredients, like instant coffee granules or stevia powder, or a spice mill or mortar & pestle. Let soak in a cool place for 6 - 8 hours. I have successfully tried other flavors and found that this is the best to use to cook eggs/steaks before cooking. You might need to experiment and tweak to achieve your preferred results.

title: Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 package fresh arborio rice | 2 cups miniature marshmallows | 1 package miniature dry breadsticks or ( 16 ounce ) package sherry wine glasses | 7 ounces miracle whip | 2 cups fresh arborio rice
instructions: Cook and stir arborio rice and marshmallows in a small saucepan over low heat for 15 minutes or until marshmallows are tender. Cut breadsticks or sherry glasses in half, horizontally. Remove rice mixture from heat and stir in miracle whip.

title: Cardamom Rye Bread in Microwave
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon, cut into 1/2-inch piece ( or other fat ) | 8 slices rye bread | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed cardamom powder ( the real stuff ) | 1/2 cup white sugar ( optional )
instructions: Put bacon in a large microwave safe bowl then put in the microwave. Set the dish aside. Put rye bread slices in microwave safe bowl then pour sugar over slices. Place microwave on full power for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the microwave then stir, and return to microwave. Microwave on full power for another 2 - 3 minutes or until the bread is warm to the touch. Turn off the microwave then leave for a minute or two to let the bread absorb the syrup. If you prefer, you can stir in crushed cardamom powder.

Random Ingredients: red bean,hot chili pepper,thyme sprig,plain yogurt,white pepper,vanilla essence
title: Red Beans - Bean Soup
ingredients: 4 cups red beans, washed, picked over | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 hot chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 2 drops red-hot chili essence | 1 teaspoon white pepper, ground | freshthyme sprig, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large food processor or blender. Add fresh thyme. Process well until coarse puree forms. Refrigerate until chilled and well chilled. Garnish with the thyme sprigs to serve.

title: Dutch Mincemeat Rolls
ingredients: 2 large chicken thighs | olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 lb hamburger | 2 1/2 cups cold water
instructions: Remove skin on thighs. Rinse. Sprinkle with freshly ground mace. Saute in a pot of boiling, salted water for about 5 - 6 minutes. While the mace is working mix the mincemeat mixture with the cold water until smooth. When cool and the meat is all cooked take it and roll into sausage. Fry over medium heat until cooked through and browned. Serve with kippered onions and hard boiled eggs. Can take any type of bread and dip into it. This makes a tasty roll.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,caraway,gingerroot,bay leaf,tomato basil pasta sauce,cooking spray,cream chicken soup,phyllo dough
title: Beef and Pork Strata
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pound ground sirloin | 1 pound shredded frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil pasta sauce | 1 teaspoon ground caraway | 5 bay leaves | salt and ground gingerroot to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir sirloin in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,cumin powder,sherry,apple cider,chicken bouillon granule,curry leaf,pea
title: Curried Rice With Peas and Apples
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 teaspoon curry leaves | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup peas ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Wash rice well and drain. Add rice, stock and spices to rice cooker and stir to combine. Insert two toothpicks into each toothpick. Add apple cider and peas and stir to mix. Close lid, and steam for 8 - 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Hot Voodoo Rolls (Mock-Taki)
ingredients: 3 -4 ounces cooked sausage ( or pork sausage of your choice ) | 3 -4 tablespoons sake | 2 -3 teaspoons cinnamon ( or to taste ) | 2 -3 teaspoons rosemary ( or to taste ) | 1/2 tablespoon cider vinegar ( or to taste )
instructions: Mix all together. Roll into small balls or small patties and freeze in a freezer bag for about an hour or so to firm up. If using pork, heat up a skillet and when it gets really nice and hot fry them, turning at least once before serving so they don't burn and get crispy and brown on all sides. Add to hot dip and eat with toothpicks enjoy.

title: Pumpkin Seed Tortilla With Avocado Oil and Fresh Tomato
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin seeds | 2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 4 roma tomatoes | 1 medium ripe avocado oil | 1 head iceberg lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: In a bowl, combine the pumpkin seeds and ricotta cheese.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,risotto rice,curry paste,yeast
title: Risotto With Curried Artificial Curd
ingredients: 8 -10 cups cooked risotto rice or 8 -10 cups cooked short-grain rice | 1 package dry yeast | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix ( homemade or commercial ) | 1 teaspoon curry paste
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water to about 105 - 120 degrees fahrenheit. Combine salad dressing mix with curry paste. In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together and knead until dough forms a very light, soft, and elastic dough. Place dough in an oiled bowl and cover with a clean and waxed towel. Allow to rise until light, about 1 1/2 hours. Turn dough onto lightly oiled surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Dough should not be sticky or elastic. Place dough on a floured surface. Turn dough occasionally and poke holes all over the top of the dough, using a fork. Place dough on a greased baking pan, cover with waxed towel, and refrigerate 8 hours or more but no more than 4 hours. Place rice in a large bowl, cover, and allow to rise 15 - 20 minutes. Punch down dough, and roll out to a 1/8 inch thickness. Cut into 5 - 6 rectangles 3 inches wide. Place on parchment lined baking sheets. Cover immediately with clean waxed cloth for the last 10 minutes of rising. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Bake about 15 minutes or until delicately browned, puffed, and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,reynolds wrap foil,tomatillo,lemon peel,roast pork
title: Roast Pork and Potatoes #RSC
ingredients: 2 large loaves reynolds wrap foil | 2 lbs roasts pork, cut into 1-inch cubes ( may buy more, depends on size for pan ) | 1/2 cup fresh tomatillo, chopped | 1/2 cup raw lemon peel, pith removed and sliced | 1 teaspoon fine sea salt
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450°f. Place the pan that will be used to cook your pork in to oven over medium coals. When you see some serious splatters around the pan, throw a dinner bell out of the oven. Cut two of the roasts of pork in half onto two long metal skewers. Place the meat on the skewers and season evenly with salt. Roll them up and secure with two toothpicks. Repeat with the other half of the loaf. Place into an ovenproof skillet. Add the tomatillo, lemon peel and salt to the tomatoes and place into the oven. After 45 minutes, remove from oven and remove toothpicks.

title: Stuffed Vegetables
ingredients: 3 ounces goat cheese | 1/8 cup canned cauliflower, rinsed and drained | 1/4 teaspoon sugar snap pea | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary leaf, finely chopped | 1 slice bread, crusts removed and cut into chunks | 1/8 teaspoon mixed italian herbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400ºf, lightly flour a baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,rosemary,rib eye steak,wild rice,tarragon,juniper berry,cream
title: Beef Roulades
ingredients: 2 rib eye steaks | 1 cup wild rice | 1 bunch fresh tarragon | 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 4 whole juniper berries ( optional ) | 2 loaves sour cream | 4 sprigs fresh tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place steaks on a sheet of aluminum foil with side toward the outside of the roasting pan. In a large bowl combine the wild rice, 1 tablespoon of tarragon, 3 whole juniper berries, 1 whole rosemary sprig, and the remaining 1 teaspoon of tarragon. Spread the rice mixture over each of the steaks. Wrap the foil tightly around the steaks and place in the oven. Bake for at 400 degrees f for 25 to 30 minutes to 2 hours. Allow to cool slightly after removing the foil. Once well cooled, remove the steaks and cut them into thin slices. Serve with sour cream, chopped fresh tarragon and other herbs as desired.

Random Ingredients: file powder,grape tomato,caster sugar,beef,turmeric,cajun seasoning,corn tortilla
title: Taquitos in Grape Sauce
ingredients: 500 g ground beef or 500 g ground turkey | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon granulated caster sugar | 2 tablespoons corn tortillas, finely shredded | 200 g fresh grape tomatoes, halved if large | fresh ground black pepper and salt to taste, to taste
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, melt the meat, stirring so any clumping will be apparent. Increase heat to high, and cook, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the tomatoes are softened. Season with pepper and salt. Transfer to a serving platter and serve immediately.

title: Shrimp and Black Olive Queso
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 tablespoon green shrimp paste ( or more to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups velveeta cheese ( or other full-fat cheese ) | 3/4 cup canned black olives ( drained and coarsely chopped ) | 1 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Coat a nonstick skillet with cooking spray.

title: Herb-Pesto Stuffed Wild Mushrooms

instructions: Mix the yeast with a pinch of salt in a large bowl. Add the molasses and cream.

title: Chutney With Chutney and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh gingerroot | 4 large parsley sprigs | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 cups cubed goat cheese | 1/4 cup reduced-fat mango chutney, warmed until warm | 1 3/4 cups cooked barley, chilled | 6 cups cooked kale, coarsely chopped
instructions: Stir first 7 ingredients in medium bowl to blend. Press mixture over top of bowl to form chutney, then divide among 6 chilled bowls. Add chutney and warm barley to bowls. Sprinkle with kale.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,mustard seed,red chilies,fontina cheese,fig,iceberg lettuce,pecan nut,almond meal
title: Mixed Greens Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch iceberg lettuce, washed and well dried | 1 bunch fresh figs, chopped or 1/2 lb dried fig | 1/2 cup toasted pecans or 1/2 cup other nuts | 1/2 cup slivered almonds ( i usually grind them a bit at a time and then add to salad before chopping ) | sugar-free mustard seeds or grain free brown mustard, if desired | 1 fresh red chilies or 1/2 chili paste | 1 cup alphhaler cheese or 1 cup fontina cheese, grated
instructions: Chop all the fillings in small pieces, or chop them to measure only about 1/4 cup. Toss lettuce through salad dressing until coated well.

title: Kumara and Rassoulie Grilled (Skewered Beef Meatballs)
ingredients: 500 g chuck ( very lean ) | 1 red seedless grapes | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon kumara ( dried kumara )
instructions: Prepare the grill or grill pan according to the instructions on the packet, using a high temperature. Cut the beef into 6mm/ 3/8 inch thick/4 inch/long chunks. Put the meat and grapes into a food processor with the nuts and the cardamom.. Grate the peel from the kumara onto the board with a knife tip, then add to the grinder. Add about 1 tablespoon of the grated nut mixture to the meat and process until it is finely chopped. Shape into 1 inch meatballs, or about 6 8mm/1 inch/8 inch in diameter, and set aside. Grill or grill the meatballs under medium heat, turning as necessary until well browned all over, turning to cook all sides. Alternatively, place them on a piece of foil or tea towel and place under a grill or grill pan to cook as desired. Serve while warm, with warmed thick cream and mustard.

title: Tori Goreng
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and sliced very thinly | 1 large apple, peeled, cored and chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, peeled and grated | 8 ounces spaghetti, broken into 2-inch lengths | 8 ounces italian tomatoes, sliced thick | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 -2 tablespoon honey | pickled radishes, for garnish ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring the potatoes to boil in plenty of salted water and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes or till tender. Drain and set aside. When cool enough to handle, slice the peeled and sliced apples, placing them in a large bowl. While they cool down slightly, place the grated ginger in a bowl with the chopped apple, mustard seeds and olive oil to coat well. Set aside. Pre heat the grill or place the spaghetti in a saucepan of boiling water and cook according to packet instructions. While the spaghetti is cooking, toss the sliced and unripe tomatoes with the mustard seeds, honey and ginger mixture. Place a portion of the spaghetti on a heatproof plate, top with the potato slices, then spread the tomato mixture over. Sprinkle with pickled radishes.

Random Ingredients: spice,white button mushroom,cauliflower floret,turkey,wheat spaghetti,lettuce,mascarpone cheese,deli roast beef
title: Roast Beef in Pasta
ingredients: 8 slices turkey | 8 white button mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon trident mixed spice ( or other spice blend ) | 7 ounces turkey bacon or 7 ounces turkey sausage | 8 ounces deli roast beef, sliced | 1 1/2 cups sliced cauliflower florets | 8 ounces cooked whole wheat spaghetti | lettuce | 1 1/2 cups mascarpone cheese, room temperature
instructions: On the stove top, heat sauté pan over medium heat. Add turkey bacon and mushrooms with trident mixed spice. Sauté until mushrooms are soft. Slice turkey into 1/4 1/2 inch thick slices, then add to mushroom mixture along with roast beef.

title: OAMC Barbecue Beans
ingredients: 1 pint baked beans in sauce | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb ( about a teaspoon of this can be made with dried bread ) | 1 bottle hot barbecue sauce, your favourite variety
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f mix beans, bread crumbs, and sauce in a bowl. Spoon into an 8 cake pan or muffin pans. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Chinese Pizzelles
ingredients: 10 whole cloves, or more to taste | 1 pound vanilla shortening for frying | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Melt shortening in a heavy skillet over medium high heat.

title: Spanish Rum Balls
ingredients: 1 cup polenta | 2 tablespoons dry minced onion flakes | 2 cups white rum ( not quite reaching the rim of your drinking glass )
instructions: Combine dry minced onion flakes and rum in large bowl and set aside. Preheat broiler. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Pour rum and onion mixture into bread machine pan and place on the cookie sheet. Press the baking sheet down a couple of times. After the second pressing, flip the pan the recommended fashion. After 6 - 9 minutes, check and make sure the dough feels tacky on the bottom, and doesn't feel sticky anymore. If it seems as dry you can give it a 1/8 teaspoon spoonful of rum and work it into the dry rice with your hands until everything's well combined. Add your rice to the rum mixture in the bread machine pan and mix thoroughly. Put mixture in a 9x13 pan and spread out into another 9x13 pan. Let the cake cool until it's about half firm or until it's about 1 1/2 thick. Cut into squares. When you are ready to serve, dip in the rum and onion mixture. If you want a really good rum flavoring, add 1/4 teaspoon of rum and 2 tablespoons of lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,brown rice,yellow pepper,fenugreek seed,peppercorn,rice flour,white sugar
title: Pancake-Style Green Chile, Yellow and Red Pepper Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 cup chopped yellow sweet pepper ( about 1 red-orange ) | 1 cup chopped green chilies | 10 peppercorns | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: In a bowl, combine the brown rice, sugar, yellow sweet pepper, green chiles, peppercorns, and rice flour. Stir to mix. Cover and let stand 30 minutes. Remove the seeds and stems from the green chiles. Cut into thick slices and stir into the rice mixture along with the fenugreek. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: clove,chicken stock,spaghetti sauce,chicken leg,lemon juice,english cucumber
title: Spicy Chicken and Noodles
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, cut up | 2 chicken thighs, cut up | 7 ounces spaghetti sauce | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Place chicken legs in 9x13 glass baking dish. Add spaghetti sauce. Stir to combine. Place chicken on top of chicken. Pour remaining sauce over chicken. Cover and refrigerate 2 hrs to overnight. Bring to room temperature before cooking, and bake covered at 350 for 45 minutes. Turn on broiler. Remove chicken and place on foil covered broiler pan. Broil uncovered over high heat 3 - 5 minutes or until crisp. Remove chicken and let cool. Reserve 1 cup of sauce for sauce. Return to pan. Stir remaining sauce with reserved chicken broth until blended. Drizzle over cooked chicken.

title: Homemade Onion Chips (Low-Fat Whole Onion Rings, 2-Qt. Pressure Cooker, Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 lb vidalia onion | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup xanthan gum
instructions: Cut the onions and peel into ½ inch sections using a vegetable peeler. Lay the sections into the slow cooker. Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper. Pour in xanthan gum to cover all of the sections. Let the pressure drop by itself as soon as the pressure drops come up on the table. Close the lid of the cooker. Turn on the cooker on high and set your timer to high, then set your timer for 10 minutes. Remove the lid.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,wheat flour,black pepper,lamb,duck,caster sugar,tomato sauce
title: Crock Pot Duk Kway Teow
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb, cubed | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 3 tablespoons black pepper | 100 g duck fat, roughly rendered | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 300 g thin rice noodles, washed according to packet instructions | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Place lamb in crock pot, then sprinkle flour and pepper evenly over, then add duck fat, tomato sauce, noodles and sugar. Set to high and cook on low for 5hrs. Turn to high and cook another 2 hours. Remove from crock pot and stir gently for 2 minutes to loosen any grit. Serve by itself or over rice noodles.

title: Creamy Swiss Baked Striped Beef
ingredients: 1 meaty veal shank, rolled | 3/4 cup cream or 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup ranch salad dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Rinse meat and pat dry. Place in oven bag. In a small bowl, combine all remaining ingredients. Pour over meat. Toss with hands to coat evenly. Place on rack in roasting pan lined with a piece of parchment paper. Insert toothpicks through the top of the meat to secure tight. Bake about 3 hours or until meat thermometer registers 150 170°f.

title: Spiked Apple Onion and Nectarine Tart
ingredients: 1 frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup nectarines, diced into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 spanish onion, thickly sliced
instructions: Roll out dough into a 14x11 inch rectangle. Arrange nectarines, apple juice and onion on pastry. Cut in half horizontally, forming triangles.

Random Ingredients: green olive,queso fresco,baguette,extra virgin olive oil
title: Cheese and Olive Toasts
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut in 3/4-inch slices | 1 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 cups grated queso fresco ( or mexican queso fresco, 3 tbsp. shredded ) | 20 medium green olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 425^f. Arrange baguette slices on 2 baking sheets lined with parchment paper, and brush both sides of each with 1/4 cup of the olive oil. Spread the grated queso fresco on one side of each of the bread slices, then spoon a small amount of the queso fresco filling into the bread and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake in the oven until the cheese melts, about 18 minutes. Place the olives on a cutting board and with a knife, coarsely chop them. Remove bread from the oven and let stand 5 minutes, then transfer to a serving platter and cut in 1 inch slices. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,pork loin roast,tomato green chilies,celery rib,french lentil,basil pesto,iceberg lettuce
title: Gestrone
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 4 celery ribs | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried basil or 1 1/2 tablespoons other basil leaves | 2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes | 32 ounces french lentils or 32 ounces brown lentils | 2 large iceberg lettuce | french lentil
instructions: In slow cooker, place celery, tomatoes, basil, parsley flakes and season lightly with salt and pepper. Place pork roast on top, cutting it crosswise across it. Cover and cook on high setting 3 1/2 hours stirring twice. Remove pork from slow cooker. Let rest. Place lettuce in the slow cooker. Cut into 3 rows across. Place pork on lettuce. Cover. Cook 2 hours on high or 8 hours on low. Remove the pork and lettuce from the slow cooker and discard the juice. Pull meat and lettuce apart. Pull shreds of pork and lettuce and return to slow cooker. Cover and cook 30 minutes. Serve with crusty french bread.

title: Beef Birds & Gravy(Paleo)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons boiling water
instructions: In a shallow glass or plastic bowl, place beef and water. Cover tightly, pressing out excess water. Marinate in refrigerator 3 to 6 hours or overnight. Drain beef cubes, reserving marinade. Cook, uncovered, over high heat in a large cast iron or other heavy skillet until meat is brown on all sides, 7 to 10 minutes. Return skillet to heat. Stir in reserved marinade and cook, uncovered, until thickened slightly, about 5 minutes. Serve sprinkled with chopped fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: matzo meal,apricot,nonfat plain yogurt,papaya,corn flake,oyster,lemon peel,tomato juice
title: Pan Bataka
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry corn flakes, crushed | 3 tablespoons matzo meal ( see note ) | 1/2 cup light-colored agave nectar ( not low-sugar ) | 8 ripe medium tomatoes, chopped | 1 large ripe papaya, peeled, deseeded and finely chopped ( should be about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 jar of marinated oysters, including liquid | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 1 cup fat-free plain yogurt
instructions: Combine corn flakes, matzo meal and agave in a medium size bowl. Dab tomatoes into mixture to coat and set aside. Preheat grill pan to medium/medium high, add oysters and heat until oysters are just turning opaque. Remove oysters from pan and let cool for 10 minutes. Combine 1/2 cup of the marination liquid and the chopped papaya and stir. Seed and dice tomatoes and add to papaya mixture, along with the remaining marinating liquid, lemon peel, and salt to taste. Stir in yogurt and spoon into shallow baking dish which has been sprayed with cooking spray. Bake, covered, in a 400 degree oven for 5 - 8 minutes, then turn out onto a plate. Serve warm or let cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: celery,anchovy paste,vegetable oil,flat leaf parsley,plain nonfat yogurt,peppermint extract
title: Anchovy Dip for Veggies
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced flat leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon peppermint extract | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon celery, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon smooth mixed pepper ( i usually use dried parsley )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and use as required.

title: Lobster-Mushrooms With Plantains, Chillies and Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lobster, in a shell | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 6 mushrooms, washed quartered | 8 ounces canned button mushrooms | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 jalapenos or 1 serrano chili, minced
instructions: Cut the lobster into pieces. Wash the mushrooms and set them aside, or let them dry the mushrooms by soaking them in water for a few hours. Put the oil on a skillet, put the lobster pieces in and cook them until they turn dark in color. Put the mushrooms and the water from the mushrooms and crab on a paper towel to drain away excess moisture. Take out the lobster meat and cut the crab into pieces. Put the lobster meat in the skillet. Add the chopped chili, cream of tartar and mix well. Cook the lobster meat in a pan on the skillet until it turns a light color. Drain the excess oil. Remove the lobster meat from the skillet and set aside. Serve the lobster mushrooms on the side, or just use the mushrooms and crab. Top with sour cream and some chopped cilantro.

title: Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, cut up | 1/2 cup milk | 1 jar mandarin orange sections, drained | 1/2 cup wondra flour
instructions: In dutch oven, brown steak on all sides, remove and set aside. In saucepan, stir together milk and cornflour, stir over moderate heat until well blended. Add undrained mandarin oranges.

title: Stuffed Chilies
ingredients: 15 anaheim chilies | 1/2 mango, peeled, diced | 2 ounces capers | 1 can crescent dinner rolls | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 5 cups cold water
instructions: Soak chili peppers in water to cover about 30 minutes, drain and pat dry with paper towels. Place chilies on a foil lined baking pan, leaving about an inch between them. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven 15 to 20 minutes, or until blackened. Turn peppers over and bake for another 15 minutes until blacken and beginning to blister. When done, run skins under cold water to remove all of the moisture. Remove stems from peppers.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,sherry,star anise,spinach leaf,vegetable shortening,vanilla extract
title: Jamaican Spinach
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach leaves, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup pineapple chunks, drained | 3/4 cup hot dry sherry | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 star anise, seeded and crushed
instructions: Place spinach, 1/2 cup of the shortening, pineapple, hot sherry, vanilla, and star anise in a large wok or skillet and heat over high heat, stirring until hot but not smoking, approximately 2 minutes. Pour contents of skillet into a serving dish and sprinkle with remaining shortening.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,cider vinegar,lemon juice zest,purple onion,table salt,herb,brown rice,kosher salt black pepper
title: Brown Rice Salad (Kosher-Grilled)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 1/2 cups packed fresh purple onions, rinsed and very thinly sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mixed herbs ( such as tarragon, dill, parsley or dill pickles ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Put the onion and lemon zest in a mini processor and process to mince coarsely. Add the onion mixture, vinegar, herbs, salt and pepper and process until very dry and just about smooth. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: French Daboobs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck ( with or without spice packet ) | 1/4 cup orange extract, divided ( preferably orange infused ) | 1 bottle dry sherry
instructions: For each cup of beef juices, combine beef and 1/4 cup orange extract. Stir well to combine. Strain and reserve juice. Refrigerate overnight. For each cup of beef juice, pour remaining orange extract on top and stir well to combine. Pour beef juice over top. Using a small wire wisk, strain out solids.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,spinach,cornflour,bread,mandarin orange,chayotes,vegetable oil cooking spray,baking powder
title: Mandarin Sweetcorn Bread
ingredients: 2 slices bread, crusts removed | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | peanut oil, for frying | 3/4 cup mandarin orange rind | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed, squeezed dry and chopped | 6 chayotes, quartered lengthways and cut into chunks | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Place 2 slices bread on flat work surface. Using a 5cm cube biscuit cutter, flatten each slice until it is 6cm or less thick. Place 2 triangles each on a lightly floured work surface. Place 1 tablespoon cornflour, 1 tablespoon peanut oil and 1/4 cup mandarin oranges in a blender and process for 10 seconds, or until combined. Toss spinach, chayote and remaining 2 tablespoons cornflour and baking powder in a bowl. Heat 2 teaspoons of vegetable oil in a non stick deep non stick frying pan over medium heat for 1 minute. Add sweetcorn mixture and fry for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat when mixture resembles puffs, and transfer to a lined baking tray. Spray tops with cooking spray. Spoon sweetcorn filling mixture into sweetcorn cases and bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes, until golden.

title: Seafood Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces wide egg noodles, cooked drained | 12 ounces mixed seafood, cooked, drained and chopped | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 5 juniper berries | spices
instructions: Mix all the seafood including the berries and spices. Spread over the noodles and chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Chickpea Salad with Bacon
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cooked, crumbled | 3 cans chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger brew, such as hymett's | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | lettuce, shredded | tomatoes, sliced for garnish or sliced into strips for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, cook bacon until crisp and browned, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels and crumble when cooled. Drain and rinse chickpeas, squeezing out excess liquid. Meanwhile, combine the ginger brew, remaining taco seasoning and ground cardamom in a small bowl. Pour into a salad bowl. Add bacon bits, if using. Toss with bean mixture until thoroughly coated. Arrange lettuce, tomato slices and bacon bits on a platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: butter margarine,tamari,cardamom pod,lemon verbena leaf,ancho chile powder
title: Spiced Butter
ingredients: 2 ounces unsalted butter, soft | 10 tablespoons tamari | 2 teaspoons lemon verbena leaves, chopped | 1/3 teaspoon dried lemon verbena leaves | 1/8 teaspoon ground carob powder ( optional ) or 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a heavy bottomed skillet over medium low heat and bring to a gentle simmer. Remove from heat and let the mixture cool until warm, stirring the mixture a few times with a wooden spoon.

title: Jicama-Alpine Mocha Farfalle W-Coffee Cappuccino
ingredients: 1 lb jicama, julienne cut into 1/3 inch slices | 1 1/2 cups frozen corn, thawed ( i prefer fresh corn ) | 1 cup brewed espresso or 1 cup strong coffee | 2 tablespoons dried espresso beans or 2 tablespoons strong coffee | 1 tablespoon instant malachetto | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom or 1/2 teaspoon anise | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning or 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee | 1/2 lemon, zest of
instructions: Preparation,. Place the jicama and corn in a sauce pan, add water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes then drain. Return the corn to the pan and toss with the 2 tbsp espresso/coffee and cover. In a small sauce pan, place the ground espresso, the dried espresso beans or coffee, the cardamon/anise and the zest of the lemon and place it over medium heat. When the espresso is very warm stir in the spice mixture and remove from heat. Allow to cool 1 - 2 minutes then transfer to a small bowl, cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Cooking,. To cook the fabe pasta in boiling water, bring 6 cups of water to a boil and add the farfalle pasta. Cook for a 9 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Thai Sweet and Sour Stock (Um)
ingredients: 1 liter good quality stock ( just from beef bones or made from cow bones ) | 1 stick lemongrass | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Heat the stock in a saucepan and add the lemongrass and white pepper. Cover and simmer for 2 hours, or until the liquid has reduced by 50%.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,shrimp,cream mushroom soup,mango chutney,angostura bitter,date,topping,cream tartar
