title: Shrimp & Mango Cheesecake With Sticky Topping
ingredients: 12 shrimp, peeled | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon angostura bitters | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 ounces chopped roasted mango chutney | 20 ounces frozen whipped topping, thawed ( i use gordo's brand )
instructions: Combine cream of mushroom soup, sour cream, bitters, & cream of tarter in a large bowl & mix. Add shrimp & mix gently. Pour into prepared baking pan. Bake in a preheated oven at 400f for 30 minutes. Stir mango chutney in a microwave safe bowl to blend & spread around the outside of the cake. Pour a little of the sauce thick around the shrimp w/a spoon or dessertspoon. Pour remainder of sauce over the shrimp & mango chutney. Cool completely & place in refrigerator. Top w/sweetened whipped topping & return to refrigerator.. You can garnish w/curry paste if desired.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,five spice powder,mozzarella cheese,tomato paste
title: Four-Spice Mozzarella Cheese With Variations
ingredients: 1 kg mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup roma tomato, minced ( fresh ) | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Grease a 25 x 30cm baking tray. Mix all ingredients in a medium bowl. Using wet hands shape mixture into 3cm diameter log on prepared baking tray. Make diagonal slashes for easy handling onto the oven shelves. Bake in oven for 45 mins checking after 30mins for crisp edges. For gas mark 4, 200c, gas 5, 220c, gas 6, 220c, gas 10 etc.

title: Grilled Pork Roast With Mixed Berry
ingredients: 2 lbs lean roast ( not silverside ) | 1 lb fresh mixed berry, ends trimmed ( such as strawberries, raspberries, strawberries, blackberries or berry halves of a fresh seasonal fruit ) | 2 tablespoons vodka | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 4 teaspoons garlic paste | 4 -6 lbs leftover roast beef | fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f on a clean surface place roast on top of a large piece of foil and brush with a little of the vodka. Wrap the top of the foil tightly around roast and then place in oven. Roast uncovered for 45 - 60 min., checking on the internal temperature with a meat thermometer. After 30 min, remove meat with a fork and allow to cool for 10 min or so. Trim the roast of any strings, including any excess fat, and cut into 2 3/4 slices. Remove the string from the foil to retain shape of the meat, if needed. Meanwhile, place berry halves, pitted and sliced, into a shallow roasting pan. Add the remaining ingredients and baste with the remaining vodka. Remove roast from the oven and add the berry halves. Close the foil tightly around the roast and bake on high for approximately 3 4hours.. Serve hot.

title: Simple Crock Pot Caramelised Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Place the meat and fish sauce in the crock pot on medium heat. Stir the ingredients well and saute for 2 minutes. Pour the mix into a dish and cover with plastic wrap. Set aside for 4 hours or overnight at your lowest setting, or for up to 3 hours at your highest setting. Serve with white steamed jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: macaroni noodle,beef stew meat,puff pastry,lemon peel,chive
title: Pasties with Beef and Chives
ingredients: 15 ounces macaroni noodles | 1 pint puff pastry, thawed | 2 -4 cups beef stew meat, very finely chopped or 2 -4 cups cooked cubed leftover beef | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cook the pasta according to the directions on the pack and drain. Meanwhile place beef in a frying pan over medium heat and cook for 4 minutes, or until beef is well browned, stirring often. Meanwhile while meat is cooking, mix the cooked macaroni, stewed beef, peels and chives together, adding enough hot water to the beef to just cover. Place pastry on a lightly floured work surface and roll out with a floured rolling pin, until 1/4 3/4 inch in diameter and 1/4 inch thick. Using a 2 1/2 inch pastry cutter, stamp out 16 rounds using remaining rounds using remaning pastry rounds. Place a teaspoonful of the cheese mixture at the center of each circle. Brush edges with cold water and fold over to form a half moon, using a fork to stop the turnover from oozing out. Crimp edges firmly during cooking and place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake until crisp and golden, about 12 - 15 minutes.

title: Pernil-Style Pork shoulder (Charcoal)
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs pork shoulder | 4 -5 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped
instructions: Trim the fat from the pork, then place it in a roasting pan or other large heavy roasting pan. Turn the meat so that some of the fat runs off. Sprinkle the skin with the tomatoes. Cover the pan and roast in a pre heated oven of 325° f for 1 1/2 hours, turning the pork a couple of times during this time.

Random Ingredients: red wine,baking soda,rye bread,pea pod,salt pork,pepperoni,tabasco sauce,onion
title: Pepperoni Split Pea and Rye Bread Casserole
ingredients: 6 slices rye bread | 3/4 lb salt pork, sliced | 1 loaf frozen pepperoni | 2 cups frozen pea pods | 1/2 lb small whole frozen pepperoni | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 cup sweet onion, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Place bread slices in oven proof casserole. Mix remaining ingredients and rub onto bread. Cover with remaining bread and bake in 350f oven for 15 minutes. Remove cover and bake for 40 - 45 minutes.

title: Zinfandel Pan-Fried Beef & Lemices
ingredients: 1 lb round steak ( cut into 2-by-1/8-inch strips ) | 6 tablespoons zinfandel ( or white wine vinegar ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine ( or sherry ) | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons kikoman sushi green olives, minced | 1 large sweet potato, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: In a large skillet heat 1 tablespoon of oil. Add half of the beef mixture and brown. Repeat with remaining portions. Add last tablespoon of oil. Reduce heat, add remaining beef mixture. Add rice wine and tamari. Cover. Simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Add olives. Cover. Simmer for 10 minutes more. Serve with warm, cooked egg noodles or rice.

title: Crispy Calamari
ingredients: 3 cups buttermilk | 1 lb raw roast beef, cubed | 1/2 lb calamari, cleaned and sliced in rings | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the buttermilk, beef, calamari and vanilla sugar and bring to a boil over medium heat. Cover, reduce the heat to low and cook until the beef is tender and the sauce is reduced by half. Serve hot.

title: Chicken and Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 1 teaspoon dry sherry wine | 8 bone in, skin-on chicken breast halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the kielbasa, water chestnuts, sour cream, 1 tablespoon sherry, and 1 teaspoon sherry into a large baking dish. Cook in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and bread is lightly browned.

title: Tomato Crumb Dip With Feta Chips
ingredients: 1 -2 plum tomato, medium size, chopped | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Drop a few tomatoes into a pan of hot water. When they float to the top, transfer them to a plate lined with a towel, and drain off any excess water. Set aside. In a small mixing bowl add the feta cheese and the drained tomatoes. Mix well and let sit at least 10 minutes before serving to allow the feta to melt. Serve with pita, or crackers.

title: Banana Pork Wraps
ingredients: 1 tablespoon banana liqueur | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh pork shoulder | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped banana liqueur | 7 cups soft fresh dough, such as roll | 3 1/2 tablespoons dollop pork fat or 3 1/2 tablespoons soft lard
instructions: Make the banana liqueur by combining the banana liqueur and the pork shoulder in a large bowl and set aside. To assemble the chocloty roll, divide the dough into 2 batches and roll the dough out into 1/8 inch thick circles on a floured surface. Place the dough circles on a plate and refrigerate while you work. After the pork has marinated, roll each dough circle in the banana liqueur and place 1 to 2 to 3 tablespoon portions of meat on one side of each roll, then roll the dough up loosely from the roll over to make a cylinder. Set aside to rest, covered, while you work with the rest of the filling. Preheat the oven to 375°f. Place the seam side of each roll on an aluminum foil covered baking sheet or parchment paper and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until crust is golden. While the rolls are baking, melt the fat or lard in a medium skillet over medium heat. Working in the fat, fry the rolls until browned and crisp on all sides, about 20 minutes. Transfer rolls to a plate and repeat for the remaining dough circles. Serve warm with the bananas along with a dollop of the sweet plantains.

title: Basic Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup sesame seeds ( see note below ) | 1 teaspoon dried or bottled chili oil | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons ground cloves
instructions: Heat oven to 550f degrees. Combine all dry ingredients in a medium bowl. Use a fork or mixer to blend. Knead quickly and gently until the dough is smooth and sticky.. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured work surface. With floured hands, roll it into a ball shape. Place the dough ball onto a parchment lined baking sheet. Spread the dry ingredients evenly over the dough ball. Sprinkle with the sesame seeds about 2 inches apart. The dough should be spaced 1/2 inch apart.. Using your fingertips, poke holes in the dough. Sprinkle with oregano and cloves... Turn the dough over and brush all over with oil.. Place on oven rack and bake for about 25 minutes. The dough should pock and rise slightly.

title: Roasted Pear Fettuccini Salad
ingredients: 1 large pears, peeled, cored and cut into 2-inch-wide wedges | 1 pear, cut into 2-inch-wide wedges | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots - drained, rinsed, and finely chopped | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 package dried fettuccini pasta, cooked and drained | 12 mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to place pears, and 1/2 inch of the green or red parts of the pear slices into a large roasting pan. Roast, uncovered, in middle of oven, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Add 2 more pears and 1/2 cup of the reserved green or red parts of the pear slices and continue roasting until golden brown, about 15 more minutes longer. Remove from oven and let cool until easily handled. Once cool, cut pears into 1 slices. In a small bowl, mix remaining mayonnaise, mayonnaise, salt, and garam masala. Add to pear slices in pan. Place cooked pasta on platter and coat with mayonnaise mixture. Place a little of the pear mixture, half of the toasted or ground pears and 1/2 cup of chopped green or red parts of mayonnaise mixture in center of pasta. Top with 2 to 3 mint leaves.

title: Zucchini and Ham Soup
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini | 100 ml beef stock | 150 g ham, chopped | 1 tablespoon fruit, chopped
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthways and remove core and seeds from inside. Place zucchini, stock, ham and fruit in a saucepan and simmer for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,red chili powder,english cucumber,bread dough,yellow squash,fine sugar,french dressing,flour tortilla
title: Squash and Basil Quesadillas
ingredients: french dressing, from the deli | 2 1/2 cups bread dough, soft ( crust removed ) | 2 teaspoons fine sugar | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder, mixed with | 1 teaspoon basil leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil or 2 teaspoons cilantro leaves | 1/2 english cucumber, cut in thin strips lengthwise | 2 1/2 cups yellow squash, cut in thin strips lengthwise | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: Spread french dressing on the tortillas and top with the remaining ingredients, except the tortillas. Use a rolling pin to flatten the mixture into a rectangle about 9x9 inches. Cut into eight 6x6 inch squares. Heat one side of the tortillas in a nonstick nonstick skillet over medium heat until golden, about 1 minute. Top with several tablespoons of the salad while still hot. Cut into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,horseradish,ranch dressing mix,olive oil,fennel seed,green chili,red chili pepper
title: Roasted Chilli Fritters With Hidden Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 8 teaspoons olive oil | 1 green chili, finely diced | 1 packet hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 120 g fresh horseradish, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon minced dried red chili pepper | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 310 g self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c/gas heat the olive oil in a large fry and fry the chilli until soft. Add the seasoning mix and fry for one minute. Add the horseradish and chilli and stir until the horseradish softens slightly. Dust with the fennel seeds. Add the flour and mix the mixture well. Roll into small balls and place on a tray. Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 mins until nice and golden. Remove from the oven and place on a wire rack to cool. For a variation, try sprinkling a tablespoon of roasted jumbo olives and chopped red chilli between the fritters when they turn a few shades. You can also add roasted garlic to the sauce. Serve the fritters immediately by pouring a ladle of the sauce over them before serving it with the vegetables.

title: Beet, Chipotle & Mashed Yellow Pea Burgers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yellow split peas | 80 g chopped ham | 100 g sliced beet, cooked | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles, chopped
instructions: Combine split peas, ham, beet and chipotle chilies in a bowl and mix well. Shape mixture into burgers and chill for about 15 minutes. Serve with bread and a salad. Tip, to toast the burger, grill, barbeque or toast, brush with olive oil or canola oil and heat on pan. Cook burgers for 2 - 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,pinto bean,lettuce leaf,curry leaf,quinoa,escarole,turmeric powder,iceberg lettuce
title: Indian Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups crushed iceberg lettuce | 2 cups torn escarole | 2 cups crumbled iceberg lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup bottled italian dressing | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon curry leaf, shredded | 2 cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large bowl, add quinoa and toss. Divide mixture into 8 equal portions and set aside. Place in refrigerator until needed. To serve, place on plate with salad ingredients and drizzle with dressing. Variation, add 1/4 cup fresh tomato diced or 1/4 cup canned green chilies.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,lemon,tabasco sauce,watermelon,riesling wine,brown lentil,tamarind pulp
title: French Dairabian Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups watermelon, small cubes | 1 1/4 cups lebanese dark red lentils | 1 1/2 cups seedless brown lentils | 1/4 lb seedless round rice sticks or 1/4 lb flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp ( dissolved in 2 tbsp. of water ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper ( to taste ) | tabasco sauce ( to taste )
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the watermelon and lebanese dark and light lentils with the rice sticks and water. Add the tamarind and bring to a boil. Cover and cook over high heat for 45 minutes, until lentils are tender and water has been absorbed. Using a fine mesh strainer, remove the mixture from the pan and set aside. Drain the watermelon from the pan and dice into a medium dice. Add in the diced watermelon, salt and peppered tabasco sauce to taste. Taste and adjust salt and pepper if needed.

title: Broccoli, Leek and Chile Soup
ingredients: 1 cup broccoli floret | 3 tablespoons plain flour | 1 bunch leeks or 1 bunch scallion, sliced finely | 2 teaspoons fennel, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 200 ml cream
instructions: Place the broccoli in a saucepan. Add water, boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Blanch the flowere and slice thinly. Heat the rest of the oil in a frying pan and cook the fennel, chilli and chilli powder for 5 – 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. In a blender, combine the vegetables with the cream, chilli cream and fennel. Puree for 30 seconds, pour into soup bowls and serve.

title: Chocolate Chip Bread Fingers
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, 1 day old, cut in half diagonally | 1 cup chocolate chips | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven 400 degrees. Cut off top of bread, but make sure it fits into ovenproof bowl. Trim any bread crust that remains attached. Cut bread into fingers, approximately 2 thick. Place fingers in bowl with chocolate chips. Sprinkle with pepper and cayenne. Place on a cookie sheet, in the preheated oven. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and cool 5 minutes if desired. Place on plate with wax paper on top and store in refrigerator until serving time. These can be frozen or refrigerated until needed.

title: Polish Peppercorn Bread Rolls
ingredients: 6 cups bread flour | 12 large peppercorns, crushed | 12 wooden toothpicks | half package dry bread flour, for dredging
instructions: In a large bowl, mix bread flour, peppercorns and 1/2 the dry bread flour. In 2 batches, form walnut sized balls and gently press into each of 9' x 5'' metal pans. Let stand 5 minutes, then cool on a rack. Roll each piece in the remaining dry flour. Place on racks and let rise 1 hour at room temperature. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bake 40 minutes. Cool on wire racks.

title: Spanish Chorizo Salad
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage, cooked and crumbled | 1 head romaine lettuce, washed | 10 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies, drained of any oil and chopped
instructions: Shred shredded lettuce and set aside. Slice sausage into 1/2 inch rounds and set aside. To serve, place all ingredients in a serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: raisin,cream mushroom soup,beef stock cube,chicken bouillon,napa cabbage,dark molasses,marshmallow
title: Crock Pot Beef   and  Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 1 package napa cabbage, cut into small chunks | 1 bag shredded cooked beef or 1 can sliced pork, drained, reserve juice | 3/4 - 1 cup leftover beef stock cube, reserve juice | 3 cans cream of mushroom soup ( don't use light ) | 1 can unsweetened dark molasses | 1 packet instant chicken bouillon, dissolve | 1 package miniature marshmallows
instructions: In crock pot, layer ingredients in order starting with cabbage. Add the beef broth cube. Mix together all cans of soup and molasses. Add the liquid from beef, and mix together well. Cover. Cook on high all day. Turn down to low. Cook until meat reaches 170 degrees f/ 160 degrees celsius. Sprinkle chopped marshmallows on top when serving.

title: Corn and Herbs Salsa
ingredients: 2 ears frozen corn, thawed | 1 can reduced-sodium tomatoes with chilies and roasted garlic in tomato sauce | 1/3 cup onion, chopped | 1/2 cup broth | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, finely chopped | 1/4 tortilla, lightly toasted
instructions: Bring a 10 inch pot of water to a boil. Cook corn for 5 minutes, then remove from the heat. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Drain, reserving liquid in pot. Place corn, tomatoes and onion in a food processor. Blend into puree. Add broth and mint. Taste salsa for seasoning and adjust to taste.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,arborio rice,sesame oil,pepperoncini pepper,iceberg lettuce leaf,chili pepper
title: The Best Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups hot pepperoncini peppers ( or fresh pepperoncini ), chopped ( about one small hot pepper ) | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato paste, heaping, divided ( heaping ) | 3 -4 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon iceberg lettuce leaf | 1 fresh chili pepper, chopped ( such as serrano or habanero if you have it ) ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the rice as per instructions on the package. Do not use olive oil and do not oil a pan or pan that is wider than your rice cooker. The rice and water should be about two inches below the lid of your rice cooker. Press the rice cooker on the regular or medium heat for 4 - 6 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients and press the press if using. If using any of the optional ingredients the last few minutes of cooking, press. After 5 minutes remove rice cooker from the range and place it on a plate covered with paper towels to cool. Fluff with fork. If it has cooled, you could cover with lid to keep warm for about 10 minutes prior to serving.

title: Caribbean Dream Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark rum | 1 packet fajita seasoning mix
instructions: Blend together rum, fajita seasoning mix and mix well. Pour over crushed nuts while cooling or refridgerate in a container.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,brandy,celery rib,beef tenderloin,cream tartar
title: Brisket of Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon light beef tenderloin, diced small | 2 celery ribs, diced small | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Mix the soy sauce and beef tenderloin.

title: Raspberry Liqueur
ingredients: 3 lbs frozen raspberries ( red currants are the best ) | 6 stalks celery, chopped | 1/3 cup dark molasses ( or molasses )
instructions: Place the raspberries in a pan and cover with approximately one- inch of water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 30 minutes, until raspberries and juice are reduced by one third. Add the celery and molasses and simmer for another 10 minutes, until the liquid is reduced by about half. Strain through a fine mesh sieve, and cool to room temperature. Store, covered, in the refrigerator for 3 days, shaking the pan every 3 days. Chill in the freezer for up to 2 months before using.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,lamb meat,lump crabmeat,turmeric,tamarind pulp,pastry crust pie,spring onion,chili garlic sauce
title: Spicy Crab Tartlets
ingredients: 1 pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie ( for a double crust pie ) | 1 cup lump crabmeat | 1 teaspoon turmeric, ground | 1/4 cup finely chopped spring onion | 1/4 cup finely chopped spring onion | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, ground | 2 -3 tablespoons flour | 3 dashes prepared chili-garlic sauce or 3 dashes curry powder
instructions: In a mixing bowl mix all ingredients together. To serve, line the pastry in pie pan in a spiral, or just place the dish between two pastry sheets sprayed with pam. Spoon the crab mixture onto the pastry in the pie pan. Topping, mix a little sugar with 1/4 cup water to a paste and then spoon into the pie dish. Sprinkle sugar over the top and cook at 370 degrees f approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cream Cheese Chipotle Cauliflower Salad - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 package light cream cheese | 1/3 cup raisins or 1/3 cup golden raisin, chopped | 5 -7 canned chipotle peppers, diced | 2 tablespoons chopped hazelnuts ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons diced red cabbage
instructions: Mix all ingredients in crock pot, stir to combine. Cook on high 5 - 6 hours. Before serving, add diced cabbage.

title: Pita Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb skinless chicken breast | 12 ounces pita bread | 3/4 cup roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 red onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Cut chicken breast in bite size pieces. Boil chicken until cooked through. Remove and shred with 2 forks. Toast pita with oil, add salt and pepper to taste. In a seperate pan, saute the red onion in 1 tbsp peanut oil until light brown on outside. Add toasted pita with onion and brown. Put cooked chicken, crushed peanuts and oregano into a large bowl. Add sauce to taste. Serve with pita.

title: Chili Oil - Asian Style Steak on Skewers
ingredients: 20 g dried chili flakes | 20 g dried basil leaves | 2 lbs sirloin
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a plastic bag and marinade overnight. Thread beef onto 8 skewers and cook in a large frypan of boiling water for 5 - 10 minutes or until cooked to your liking. Serve with steamed rice, basil and chili flakes.

title: Mexican Sprouts
ingredients: 24 fresh brussels sprouts | 5 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder, or more as desired
instructions: Bake brussels sprouts in a preheated oven in a saucepan, about 8 minutes, then immediately transfer to a large bowl. Spray sprouts with a thin layer of tap water. Dip in turbinado sugar, then let the sprouts dry on paper towels. Sprinkle cocoa over sprouts for a more festive look, using a tablespoon or two for instance.

Random Ingredients: french baguette,mussel,confectioner sugar,table salt,garlic salt,almond milk,active yeast
title: Moulin Bagel
ingredients: 1 cup warm almond milk | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 4 cups unseasoned french baguette | assorted cooked mussels | confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve yeast and salt in warm milk. Add the garlic salt and then the bread. Stir with a spoon until blended. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth. Transfer mixture to a greased bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let rise in a warm place until doubled. Bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden brown. Remove from baking sheet and cool on a rack. While bagels are baking, bring the almond milk to a boil in a saucepan. Remove from heat and let cool. In a bowl mix the warm milk and the yeast cream and set aside in a warm place for 10 minutes mix the bread mixture, then pour the mixture into a greased baking sheet. Slice bagels into rounds and sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Bake in hot oven for 5 minutes.

title: Jicama and Spring Onion Soup
ingredients: 100 g small jicama | 1 1/4 liters buttermilk or 1 1/4 liters vegetable stock | 2 spring onions, chopped
instructions: Wash the jicama and onion and cut into very small lengths. Place in a saucepan or soup pot with the buttermilk and pour over the jicama and onion. Bring to boil, then lower the heat and simmer gently, uncovered, for 3 - 5 minutes, or until the jicama is tender and the flavour is fragrant. Serve hot with chopped spring onions, mixed with some freshly grated parmesan.

Random Ingredients: cheese italian,large shrimp,self raising flour,anchovy paste
title: Shrimp and Cheese Scrolls
ingredients: 12 large shrimp, peeled deveined | 7 ounces cheese italian, grated ( like parmesan ) | 4 ounces self-raising flour | 2 anchovy paste, chopped
instructions: Place the shrimp and italian cheese in a mixing bowl. Add flour to the mixture and rub well with your fingers. Dump into a piping bag and fill pastry with mixture. Tuck in the excess. Bake at c for 30 mins or until golden.

Random Ingredients: raisin,bouillon cube,dark corn syrup,chunky peanut butter,cold water,hoagie,large shrimp
title: Peanut Butter Shrimp Dogs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 bouillon cube | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 3 tablespoons light-colored corn syrup | 2 tablespoons dark corn syrup | 1/2 cup boiling water | 12 hoagie rolls or 12 regular size hamburger buns, split
instructions: Stir shrimp with bouillon cube in 2 cup boiling water in med. Microwave safe container. Microwave on high power 3 minutes. Stir peanut butter, 3 tbls. Corn syrup, and 1 tbls. Corn syrup into shrimp mixture. Microwave on medium high power about 1 minute. Drain shrimp well and stir into peanut butter mixture with remaining 1/2 cup hot water. Spoon shrimp mixture into rolls.

title: Lazy Day French Bread
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage | 2 slices white bread
instructions: Wash and finely shred your cabbage. Mix the shredded cabbage with a little water until completely covered and leave to soak overnight. After an hour drain excess liquid. Preheat oven to 200ºc or 150ºc if you prefer. Line a shallow bowl with bread and place 1 generous tablepoon of the cabbage mixture on the tray. Using your hands form the bread into a rectangle or oval shape and place into a buttered ovenproof baking dish. Continue until all of the bread has been used. Allow to stand in the oven for 10 minutes as this will absorb the excess oil. Spray a small piece of aluminium foil with oil, add the remaining 3 slices of bread and place under the grill until they start to lightly brown. Remove from the oven. Pour the excess browned juices from the tray into a bowl and allow to cool down. Spread the cooled bread with the remaining cream and enjoy with your favourite summer vegetable.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,saffron thread,vanilla pod,baking powder,mushroom,green pepper,onion
title: Mushy Beans
ingredients: 1 lb mixed mushrooms, cleaned and wiped clean under running water | 1 lb cannellini beans or 1 lb cranberry beans, cleaned and washed | 1 vanilla pod, split in half, seeds scraped out | 1 green pepper, cleaned and cut into strips | 1 small onion, diced | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread, crumbled
instructions: Place the vegetables into a saucepan with just enough water to cover. Bring the water to boil over high heat. When it boils, remove from heat and let stand 15 minutes. Drain well and transfer to a bowl. Toss with the remaining ingredients except the saffron, mix well and serve. Note if the beans start to thicken too much for you, remove the vanilla pod.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,bacon,tomato sauce,yellow food coloring,chicken,red chili pepper,quark
title: Pollo Con Tomate e Salsa (Tomato & Quark)
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken | 3 slices bacon ( or turkey bacon ) | 1 egg yolk | orange juice, zest of | red chili pepper | 1/2 cup light tomato sauce | 1/2 cup light sour cream ( light is best )
instructions: Wash chicken pieces and pat dry with a cloth. Wrap an orange in bacon / turkey bacon & squeeze some juice from the zest into the cavity & the skin. Place in casserole then pour the tomato sauce over. Tie the orange & chili pepper into a knot in the chicken & bake in preheated oven at 300 degrees for up to 2 hours or until very tender. Just before serving, stir the sour cream into tomato sauce & continue to heat. Slice chicken in slices. Serve topped w/an orange slice & plenty of sour cream.

title: Rhubarb Wine Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium onion, finely chopped | 150 g rhubarb, leaves finely chopped | 1/2 cup red wine | 80 g butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pan over a medium heat. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer approximately 10 minutes, until rhubarb is tender and sauce has thickened slightly. Serve with toasted slices of toasted bread.

title: White Ricotta and Orange Sauce for the Pasta & Meatball subs for 2
ingredients: 200 g dry white ricotta cheese | 150 ml full-fat milk ( use a good quality ricotta cheese ) | 1 small orange rind, cut into long strips for decorating the pasta | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs, to garnish
instructions: Place the ricotta in a clean, dry container. Add the orange rind, thyme and milk. Stir well. Let stand for 10 minutes, then gently squeeze to remove excess liquid. Add extra milk if the mixture looks too thick. Transfer mixture to a pasta baking tray lined with parchment paper or lightly greased. Chill for 1 hour. Use a fork to form your meatballs and cook in a non stick frying pan over medium heat for about 5 - 6 minutes. Remove and serve sprinkled with the chopped oregano and fresh thyme.

title: Mushroom-Fennel Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces shiitake button mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups light cream | 1/2 cup dark rum | 2 tablespoons shallots | 1 3/4 lbs fennel bulbs, bulb and fronds peeled & sliced into 1/2-inch slices | 2 tablespoons of minced fennel fronds | 1 cup of minced celery rib | chopped pecans, for garnish
instructions: Wrap mushrooms in foil and refrigerate while making the soup. Strain mushrooms and reserve liquid, reserving liquid, and set liquid aside. Blanch fennel in boiling water for about 3 mins until just beginning to release its juices. Drain and set aside. Place cream, rum, shallots and mushroom liquid in dutch oven and bring to boil over high heat. Add mushrooms, fennel, celery and reserved mushroom liquid and simmer 30 mins, over high heat, stirring occasionally. Garnish with minced fennel fronds and some coarsely chopped pecans.

title: American Fiesta Mac N Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 3 cups corkscrew macaroni ( dried, not pre-cooked ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper, coarsely ground
instructions: Cook beef and hot sauce in a large skillet over medium heat until no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cover a large pot of lightly salted water with cooking spray. Add uncooked pasta and cook according to package directions. Drain pasta and return it to the pot. Meanwhile, drain meat mixture from skillet. Saute beef in a separate skillet over medium heat until browned, about 10 minutes. Stir in hot sauce and crescent rolls.

title: Tami Goreng (Indian Figs in Spicy Olive Paste)
ingredients: 500 g mung beans | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 5 teaspoons tamari | 1 tablespoon almond jam or 1 tablespoon apricot jelly, for dipping | 1 cup canola oil
instructions: Soak the mung beans in water in a large pan for around 8 - 10 hours. Cut the beans in half and rub the beans into the sand. Cut the tamari in half and put the tamari into a small pan with 1 tbsp coriander powder, stir fry till the mixture becomes very light brown. Put the beans into a sieve and pour the black bean water into the pan. Cook for 15 minutes and strain. If you need to cook much longer at a time, strain. Put the mung beans and the beans into a food processor or blender. Process. Add the remaining ingredients and process. If you want a smoother consistency, add some water with the process. Heat the canola oil in a frying pan. Add the mixture and fry till golden brown. Eat hot.

title: Irish Cream Tea
ingredients: 4 cups whipping cream | 10 -15 teaspoons black tea | 1 -6 teaspoon white wine
instructions: Prepare the 4 cups of whipping cream and heat in a saucepan over low heat. Let it come to a simmer and add the 5 teaspoons of black tea. Stir the two cups of whipping cream and add it into the 8 cups of irish coffee. Add the white wine and stir into the tea until well mixed.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,artichoke heart,white rice,green cabbage,peanut oil,yogurt,tamarind juice,chili pepper flake
title: Artichoke Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 green cabbage | 1/2 cup dry white rice | 8 ounces canned artichoke hearts, drained and sliced | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1 pinch dried chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons tamarind juice | 1 cup plain yogurt | confectioners'sugar, as needed
instructions: Place the cabbage in a pot with 1/2 cup water, bring to a boil, and cook over medium heat until barely tender. Drain, and let cool slightly. Place the rice and artichokes in a large bowl, pour the oil into a skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir the rice until the rice is golden brown, about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and let cool. Drain the rice and artichoke hearts, and add to the rice. Toss together to mix well, and sprinkle on the chili flakes. Transfer to a serving dish. Place the yogurt in the container of a blender with the chile flakes, and process until smooth. Pour the yogurt mixture over the rice and artichokes. Decorate with a sprinkling of ground coriander. Serve with confectioners' sugar. Tip, to make ahead, cover and refrigerate, this rice salad will keep in the refrigerator for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: rum,rice vinegar,vanilla pudding,white cabbage,beet,chicken wing,taco seasoning mix
title: Texas Baked Beet and Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken wings, split and tips discarded | 1 1/2 cups rice vinegar | 1 cup light rum | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 pound shredded white cabbage | 1 pound fresh ripe beets, cut into 3/4 inch slices | 5 ounces vanilla instant pudding, crumbled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the chicken wings in a roasting pan. In a medium bowl, mix together the rice vinegar, rum, and taco seasoning mix. Pour into the pan and arrange the beets on top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, until chicken is tender. Sprinkle the cabbage with vinegar to serve. Cook for 10 minutes more, and cool for 1 hour in the refrigerator. Drain the chicken wings, but leave the skin on. Place the chicken wings in a single layer on a roasting rack, and bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Turn the wings over, and bake for 1 more hour. Remove and discard skin from the beets. Place the beets in a large mixing bowl. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 3 days. Remove the beets from the refrigerator about 15 minutes before serving. Spoon 1 tablespoon of the beets into each of 4 soup bowls and top with 2 to 3 ounces of vanilla instant pudding.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,chunky peanut butter,currant,lime,five spice powder,sun tomato oil
title: Spicy Peanut Butter Curried Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup natural chunky peanut butter | 2 -3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 medium lime, juice and zest | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1 cup currants
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth. Serve with currants.

title: Coconut Flour Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 3 cups bisquick, bisquick | 1 can coco lopez or ( 7 ounce ) can lemon-flavored london broil beef | 6 ounces liquid hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. In mixing bowl, combine bisquick, london broil beef and hot sauce and mix and reserve. Form into a ball, then flatten with hands slightly. Place on a floured pastry board and cover with another piece of parchment paper. Dip in flour and place onto a baking sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes, remove paper. When golden brown, remove from oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Slice and serve on a large plate.

title: Tomato-Honey Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons honey | 2 teaspoons italian sweet crushed tomatoes | 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c degrees. Combine honey, crushed tomatoes and half the chicken in the bag. Remove excess air from bag. Place chicken in baking dish and top with remaining marinade. Place baking dish and its lid on top of oven. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and lightly golden.

Random Ingredients: safflower oil corn,dark brown sugar,english mustard,palm sugar,rye flour,extra virgin olive oil,coriander
title: Indian Mustard Balls
ingredients: 2 cups dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 cup palm sugar | 2 tablespoons coriander, chopped | 1/4 cup english mustard | 1/4 cup safflower oil or 1/4 cup corn oil | 1 tablespoon stone ground australian dark brown sugar
instructions: Combine brown sugar, extra virgin olive or corn oil and palm sugar in a bowl, stir well. Sift dry ingredients in another bowl. Add mustard & brown sugar mixture & mix well. Place tablespoonfuls on to greased baking sheet & flatten slightly. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until golden. Serve warm or cold.

title: Creamy Cheese and Pea Pods in Coconut Cream
ingredients: 2 lbs sugar snap peas | 1 cup light coconut cream | 2 containers mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cut the ends off the sugar snaps and add them to your coconut cream. Cook at medium heat stirring frequently in a sauce pan until soft and a little caramelized. Take them out from the heat and place in a mixing bowl. Cut the mozzarella into 1/4 inch sized pieces and melt in a microwave or in a double boiler. Stir every few minutes. The microwave method will produce a little bit of melted cheese, but the results will not be as creamy as the regular cheese.

title: Tamarari Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup tamari | 1 cup spelt berries ( dried tricolored flour can be used also ) | 1/4 cup palm sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients and whisk until all well incorporated. Serve at room temperature or chilled. Sauce can be made ahead and frozen. To make ahead of time, place frozen mixture in a small freezer proof container and freeze until ready to be served.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,cornstarch,habanero pepper,thyme sprig,red kidney bean
title: Spicy Habanero Beans
ingredients: 4 cups red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 ounces finely chopped habanero peppers ( or jalapeno if you can find it ) | 1 sprig fresh thyme sprig, plus additional | thyme sprig, for garnish | 1 tablespoon golden raisin, for garnish
instructions: Combine beans, cornstarch, habanero pepper, and thyme in a bowl. Set aside 1 tablespoon of bean mixture for garnish. Transfer remaining bean mixture to a saucepan. Add raisins and remaining reserved bean mixture. Cook and stir over medium heat until bubbly and thickened, about 2 minutes. Serve hot or at room temperature and garnish with thyme sprig.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard leaf,pepper,walnut oil,brown sugar,apple juice
title: Walnut Oil and Grilled Swiss Chard
ingredients: 4 bunches swiss chard leaves, chopped | 1 cup packed brown sugar | 1/4 cup walnut oil | 1 teaspoon pepper | 1 cup apple juice
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Combine chard, brown sugar, walnut oil, and pepper in a large bowl. Add apple juice and mix well. Arrange chard in a large, heavy skillet. Cook mixture, turning with tongs and cooking until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a platter and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,baking soda,vegetable bouillon cube
title: Red Curry Powder
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use to marinate meats or poultry.

title: Homemade Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 2 cups flour | 4 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: To make the flour and mustard powder, mix the mustard and flour together in a medium bowl. Cut pieces of dough into pieces. Sprinkle flour onto the flour. With your hands, mix with your hands until it forms clumps or a large lumpy mass. Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead for 5 - 6 minute. Divide the dough in half. Roll each piece into a 3'' circle, about 1/2'' thick. Place each circle on an ungreased griddle. When the edges curl, turn them over and cook the remaining side until just lightly browned. Stack on a serving plate with a toothpick inserted in the middle. Serve immediately or keep warm for later use.

title: Horse-Style Baked Cod
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh cod, cleaned, skinned and cut into 3x3 inch lengths | 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 2 dried ancho chiles
instructions: Arrange cod on a rack so that fish hangs completely over the sides. Place ancho chiles in a shallow dish. Sprinkle horseradish all over fish. Sprinkle with grand marnier. Place baking sheets on top, and bake fish in a preheated 400f oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 25 minutes, basting occasionally. Serve.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,vanilla,dill weed,soy sauce,rigatoni pasta,eggplant,tuna vegetable oil
title: Hurry Beef and Eggplant (Aubergine) Parmesan
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch-wide strips | 1 small eggplant, cut lengthwise into 8 wedges | 4 cans tuna in vegetable oil, drained | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dry dill weed | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces other large tube-shaped pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Sear beef until browned, stirring often. Add eggplant and stir. Cook until tender, about 3 minutes. Add tuna and cook 1 minute. Add soy sauce and dill. Stir. Cook until liquid is reduced, about 1 minute. Stir in meat mixture. Heat through.

title: Chicken Tournedos
ingredients: 600 g chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 2 teaspoons dried wattle seed
instructions: Cut chicken thighs into 1cm cubes. Heat oil in a frying pan and add chicken. Brown on all sides, then add dried wattle seeds and cook 1 minute more or until chicken is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,dark red kidney bean,pepper sauce,blackberry,kidney bean,onion flake
title: Blackberry and Provolone Fonzu
ingredients: 2 cans dark red kidney beans, drained | 1 can blackberries | 1 can kidney beans | 3 ounces prosciutto | 1 -2 dash hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried onion flakes
instructions: In a small bowl, mash up the two cans of kidney beans and set them aside. Slice the prosciutto ham into small pieces, you may use any size, set aside set aside set up the beans in a large mixing bowl, add all the other ingredients and mix well. Put the mixture into a greased or aluminum 9x13 baking dish. Smooth out the top and the pour the liquid over top, making sure the edges are not too thick. Bake in a 350 degree oven for about 25 to 30 minutes, or until the top is browned and bubbly. Serve hot with crusty italian bread, fresh vegetable sticks, etc.

title: Fruit Salad With Lime Nectar
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs seedless watermelon, rinds discarded and the flesh cut into 3-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | lime wedge
instructions: In a blender, combine the pineapple, lemon juice, and corn syrup. Blend until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a serving bowl. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Easy Fondue (Aussie)
ingredients: 10 romano cheese | 10 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | grated mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup pitted prunes | 1/4 cup chopped green olives | 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Put the romano cheese, mozzarella cheese, prunes, olives, and teriyaki sauce into a fondue pot and heat to boiling. Serve warm over hot cooked rice or noodles in the traditional manner.

title: Low-Fat Broccoli Smoked Smoked Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 bag frozen broccoli, thawed | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke, such as canola | 1/4 cup splenda granular ( optional )
instructions: Preheat smoker to 325°. Combine frozen broccoli and liquid smoke.

title: Norwegian Turnip Salad #1
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips, peeled, but in 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon fresh nutmeg
instructions: Boil the turnips in salted water for 10 minutes. Drain well, and cool slightly. While still a little warm, mash together with the vinegar. Keep the turnips warm until serving. In a small bowl, beat the cream lightly with a fork, and stir in the nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,vegetable oil cooking spray,red bliss potato,garlic pepper,shrimp,pineapple juice
title: Stuffed Red Bliss Peaches With Mango Chutney & Pineapple Juice
ingredients: 1/3 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 1/2 pounds red bliss potatoes ( about 3 medium ) or french's diced potatoes | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 1/2 pounds shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 teaspoon garlic pepper, or to taste
instructions: To make mango chutney, combine all ingredients in a small bowl and stir to combine. Set aside. Wash, peel, and dice potatoes into 1/3 inch cubes. Spray a medium saucepan with cooking spray and place over medium heat. Add oil.

title: Greek Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 lb lean steak | 1/2 teaspoon sazon goya seasoning, divided | 1/2 teaspoon real vanilla yogurt | oil ( for frying ) | 3 slices toast, split, crisped, and toasted
instructions: Brown your hamburger and steak. If not using your favorite type of meat, mix one ounce of it with the rest of the ingredients. You may use whatever meat you want to use as well. You can also use other protein, whatever you desire. I use a combination of beef, veal or shrimp. When brown add back to top of hamburger and steak. Heat for 5 minutes or until heated through. Remove meat and steak. Spread a little yogurt on toast then add meat on top. Serve on a plate with a dollop of yogurt and dip in juice from plate.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,caper,fusion liqueur,taleggio,oregano,plum tomato,chicken bouillon granule
title: X-Traordinarily Delicious Caponata
ingredients: 2 lbs plum tomatoes, chopped | 2 cans condensed onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 tablespoon x-traord orange liqueur or 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 package frozen crumbled goat cheese or ( 10 ounce ) package greek style cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a large stockpot or dutch oven. Bring to a simmer. Reduce heat and simmer 3 to 4 hours. Place cheese in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Cut cheese into strips. Spread mixture on cheese. Bake at 400º for about 15 minutes. To serve, sprinkle with extra cheese.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,hot pepper,pork loin chop,lime wedge,arborio rice
title: Pork Chops with Rice (Arroz Con Arroz)
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups arborio rice or 3 1/2 cups carnaroli rice | 2 lbs boneless pork loin chops, 1 to 1 1/2-inch thick | salt and pepper | 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 2 -3 limes, wedged
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f spray an 11x7x2 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to simmering, stirring to loosen brown rice crystals. Add remaining 1 1/2 cups water, rice and bring to simmer, stirring occasionally. Cover and set aside 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. While rice is cooking, remove pork from marinade and pat dry. Season pork with salt and pepper. Toss pork in flour and brown in a large ovenproof skillet over medium high heat, about 2 minutes on each side. Transfer pork to a plate. Cover and transfer to oven. Bake 40 to 45 minutes until crisp and brown and liquid no longer escapes from pork, brushing often with pan juices. Serve pork on a large platter.

title: Hot Figs with Cheddar and Fig Dip
ingredients: 350 g cheddar cheese | 100 g dried figs | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Melt the cheese on the end of the double boiler. Mix together the cheese and the figs and add the bicarb soda. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Chilomile-Lavender Beans
ingredients: 6 dried lavender, stems removed ( or 1/2 cup dried lavender leaves ) | 1 cup dried white kidney beans, rinsed | 1/3 cup chili oil | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Place beans in a bowl. Add water so they're 1 1/2 inches above beans. Soak in the water at least 8 hours, but no longer than 8 - 8 hours. Drain and discard the water.

title: Quick Chicken & Seed
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken legs | 2 1/2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1/4 cup beef gravy
instructions: Take the chicken out of its package and slice down the bone to remove the bones & white meat of the leg of the chicken. Remove the meat from the can & place on to a microwave safe plate or dish. Place the rest of the ingredients in the microwave and microwave for about 2 minutes depending how thick your gravy is. Stir through thoroughly & microwave for about 3 - 4 minutes or until the chick is heated through.

Random Ingredients: cod,lite olive oil,five spice powder,orange,red grape juice
title: Cod Racks With Grape and Orange Juice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lite olive oil ( may sub other oils ) | 1 orange, peeled and finely grated orange rind | 600 g cod, skinned, in 4 portions | 2 tablespoons grape juice or 2 tablespoons juice, and | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder ( optional )
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat. Add the orange rind, stirring for 2 minutes. Remove orange rind and discard. Add the orange rind to the frying pan, stirring to coat the orange rind in hot oil. Cook the fish over moderate high heat for 2 minutes, turning once. Remove the fish to a plate and cover. Reduce the heat to moderately low. Add 500ml hot water to the frying pan and stir in the grape and orange juice or juice and five spice powder. Return the cod and orange rind to the pan. Bring to the boil and simmer for 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve the fish as is or sprinkle the fish with additional lemon juice.

title: French Butter Butter Shots
ingredients: 1/2 cup cold water | 0.5 package low-calorie margarine | 1 package pillsbury reduced calorie cookie cut dough ( regular flavor )
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup cold water together with 2 tbsp margarine. Pat small rectangles of cookie cutouts out of the cookie cutters. Dip rectangles of cookies in liquid and lay on a baking sheet. Cook at 375 degrees, 2 - 3 minutes until golden brown. Remove from oven. Cool about 5 minutes, then spread with melted french butter. Roll up jelly roll style starting at the side with a cookie cutout. Place on a foil lined cookie sheet and cool completely. Makes about 4 dozen.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,sage leaf,cremini mushroom,bean sprout,halloumi cheese,white bread
title: Baked Stuffed Mushrooms With Halloumi and Sprouts
ingredients: 250 g cremini mushrooms, halved | 250 g halloumi cheese, sliced thinly | 200 g bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons coconut milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons sage leaves | 1 slice white bread, toasted and crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place the mushrooms on a tray lined with baking paper and bake for about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a frying pan over medium heat. Add the cheese slices and fry until soft and golden. Place on a plate. Add the sliced halloumi and sprinkle with the bean sprouts and sage.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,monterey jack pepper cheese,carrot,pineapple,asafoetida powder,coffee,beer
title: Pineapple and Jack Pepper Jack Spread
ingredients: 1 can pineapple, drained ( packed in juice ) | 1/4 cup brewed coffee, cooled ( strong ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 green cardamoms or 1/4 teaspoon yellow cardamom, split with a fork ( optional ) | 1 carrot, grated | 1 ounce monterey jack pepper cheese, grated ( about 1/2 cup ) or 6 ounces other cheese of choice ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/4 cup beer
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in blender until smooth and creamy. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,corn niblets,japanese soy sauce,polenta
title: Japanese Cornbread
ingredients: 3 cups polenta | 2 cans cream of celery soup | 1 can corn niblets ( drained ) | 3 tablespoons japanese soy sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Pour into bread pan and bake for 45 mins at 350f.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,deli roast beef,vegetable bell pepper,meat,strawberry,red curry paste
title: Spicy Thai Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs thinly sliced deli roast beef | 2 ounces canned diced tomatoes | 2 ounces canned cut vegetables ( bell peppers, mushrooms, onion ) | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced
instructions: Heat a large frying pan over high heat. Sprinkle the beef with salt. Heat the pan for 2 - 3 minutes on one side. Turn the beef. Cook for another 2 - 3 minutes, or until the beef is cooked as desired. Set aside to cool at room temperature. Add tomatoes, veggies and curry paste to the cooled beef and toss to combine. Mix in brown sugar and strawberries just before serving.

title: Italian Sausages With Asparagus in the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs italian sausage or 1 1/4 lbs hot italian sausage, casings removed | 2 lbs asparagus, tough ends trimmed
instructions: In a 5 to 6 quart crock pot, put sausages, asparagus cuts and some of their juices. Pour remaining juices over all, cover and cook on high for 10 hours. Remove casing.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,fine breadcrumb,chicken stock,shortcrust pastry,taco seasoning
title: Chilli and Garlic Twirls
ingredients: 200 g ground chicken or 200 g ground turkey | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 150 g fine dry breadcrumbs ( from italian bread ) | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1 packet taco seasoning, any flavour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Mix the turkey and dressing in a bowl until combined. Combine the breadcrumbs, stock and taco seasoning in a separate bowl. Stir the crumbs into the paste. Add the crumbs to a third bowl and stir to combine. Roll the pastry to about ¾” larger than the rim of a muffin tin, and press the pastry mixture into the pan to line. Bake in the oven for 15 – 20 minutes, until golden and crisp.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,italian plum tomato,phyllo pastry,sugar,green bell pepper,walnut
title: Walnut Puff
ingredients: 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, undrained | 1/2 cup sugar, plus | 2 tablespoons sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts | 7 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 medium green bell pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees. In a large skillet, brown the pork on all sides over medium high heat about 5 - 7 minutes or until no longer pink. Transfer the pork to a colander and set aside. Add tomatoes to the skillet and simmer, uncovered, about 10 minutes, stirring often. Stir in the 2 t sugar and 1 t walnuts. Cover and cook until thickened, about 3 minutes. Remove the pork and tomatoes from their liquid. Set aside about 1 tblsps. Of the sauce and return skillet mixture to the stove. Stir in the remaining cheese, the pepper and reserved sauce. Cut phyllo pastry sheets into four squares, each rectangle about 3 by 1 inches. On each square, divide the sauce mixture equally among the squares. Pull up the sides of the corners of each dough square to enclose the filling. Place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet, brushing with the reserved sauce. Bake until lightly golden and bubbly about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,red potato,soymilk,baking potato,purpose flour,pork chop,noodle
title: Ethiopian Pork Chop Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon baking potato | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 cups soymilk | 4 medium red potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 medium lean pork chops | 2 1/2 cups noodles
instructions: In an 8 inch skillet, place flour, baking potato, cardamom powder, and 2 cups of milk. Stir in cubed potatoes and pork chops. Bring mixture to a boil and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Add noodles, remove pan from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Lunchy Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 english muffin | 1 small green cabbage | 1/2 cup cilantro
instructions: Split english muffin. Wrap loosely with saran wrap and allow to rest at room temperature for 10 - 15 minutes. Combine cabbage and remaining ingredients. Fill bun halves with tea mixture. Grind into 6 even servings.

title: Calabacitas
ingredients: 2 zucchini, medium dice | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 8 ounces queso fresco cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cook zucchini in boiling water 2 minutes or til tender. Drain, reserve 1/2 cup of water and zucchini broth. Return zucchini to pan and mash with 1/2 cup of water, seasoning with salt and pepper. Pour limeade concentrate over zucchini mixture, stirring well. Spoon into large platter or plates and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Wild Rice With Bacon Shiitake and Fresh Spring Raspberries
ingredients: 4 ounces baby arugula | 3/4 cup snow peas | 3/4 cup dried porcini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1 1/2 cups sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup bourbon | 25 thai-style dinner rolls | 2 tablespoons bourbon
instructions: Heat 1 tbs. Of oil in a non stick skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring until browned, about 1 minute. Transfer mushrooms to a bowl with a slotted spoon. Increase heat to high. Add arugula and snow peas to same skillet. Cover and cook stirring often for 2 minutes. Add chives and stir to coat. Add chili sauce and 3/4 cup bourbon. Increase heat to high and reduce liquid by half. Stir and cook for 5 minutes. Spoon rice mixture into four bowls. Divide arugula mixture among bowls. Top with crispy bacon shiitake and remaining bourbon.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,chicken breast half,cilantro,olive,grain white rice
title: Quick and Easy Grilled Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1/3 cup dijon-style mustard | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 4 bone-in chicken breast halves | 4 tablespoons uncooked long grain white rice, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons olive, or more to taste
instructions: Whisk dijon mustard and cilantro in a small bowl. Place chicken skin side down in a resealable plastic zipper bag, and pour mustard mixture over chicken, turning to coat, and seal bag. Refrigerate, 1 to 2 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Remove chicken from bag, and discard marinade. Cook chicken on the prepared grill until grill marks appear on the flesh, and the meat is no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, 10 to 14 minutes per side.

title: Indian Spiced Tea - Aussie Recipe
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Combine spices and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,fruit,mango chutney,white onion,molasses,sirloin tip steak,stewing beef
title: Sticky Beef With Fruit and Yoghurt
ingredients: 2 sirloin tip steaks, 1/4 inch thick | 1/4 cup diced fresh mango chutney | 1/2 cup chopped white onion | 1/3 cup molasses | 1/4 cup yoghurt | 1 mango chutney | 1/3 cup chopped white onion
instructions: Mix all the ingredient for ganache together. Slice the beef into 1/4 inch slices. Place in a shallow baking dish and pour over the ganache so that it's totally covered. Marinate for at least 20 minutes at room temperature or over night. Pre heat oven to 350°f. Bake for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Cheese and Pear Tarts
ingredients: 4 flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups reduced fat cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons capers | 1/4 cup prosciutto, chopped | 1/4 cup toffee, chopped | 6 whole cloves | 2 cups seedless grapes, halved | 2 tablespoons fleur de sel or 2 tablespoons other dry white wine
instructions: Cut 4 crusts off 4 crisp tortillas. Cut tortillas into 8 rounds, then into 1/4 cubes. Place one of the dough rounds into each of the 8 tart shells. Place the cottage cheese, capers, prosciutto and toffee in a food processor and process until smooth, stopping often. Scatter grapes on top of the dough rounds. Dust with fleur de sel. Heat oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Place one tortilla in the skillet.

title: Cheater's Fresh Cherry Salad
ingredients: 6 cups mixed greens ( e.g. arugula, bibb, romaine, baby spinach, salad bibb lettuce, or asparagus ) | 7 ounces cherry tomatoes, cut in half
instructions: Put greens in a large bowl. Add any of the optional ingredients.

title: Rosemary Crumble
ingredients: 6 -8 sprigs fresh rosemary | 3 -4 lbs of cubed fully cooked bacon | 3 cups of lard
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the rosemary pieces in the lard. In a large roasting pan/saucepan, place the bacon over medium heat and cook until crisp. Remove bacon from pan and set aside to cool slightly. Spread the bacon on top of the rosemary sprigs in the roasting pan. Place roasted potatoes in the middle of the pan. With a spatula or wooden spoon, poke the bacon a few times throughout. If the bacon looks dry, add a small amount of the melted lard. This will help your crumble crumble melt. This will make the bacon crispy. Pour the remaining lard over the potatoes and sprinkle the crumbled bacon over the top. Turn the oven to 400 degrees. Place this in the oven for about 30 minutes or until the potatoes are crispy and the topping is brownish. This is a delicious side dish after a nice loaf of bread. This goes great with a crisp green salad.

title: Quick Prosciutto Bars
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour ( all purpose or whole wheat or white ) | 1 cup prosciutto
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Cut prosciutto into thin strips approx 1/4 inch x 1 tablespoon or smaller if desired. Coat the bottom and sides of a 9x2 inch baking dish with pan spray oil. Add flour to a medium sized bowl and work the flour into a crumb like consistency the amount of corn meal. Add prosciutto strips and stir thoroughly.. Press the mixture into the prepared baking dish. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until lightly browned around the edges.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,chili pepper flake,serrano pepper,kernel corn
title: Spicy Corn Relish
ingredients: 1 cup whole kernel corn, drained | 1 -2 serrano pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and stir. Cover and chill for no more than 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,golden raisin,parmigiano reggiano cheese,oregano,sourdough bread,cornflour
title: Cheesy Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 ounces sourdough bread, sliced thick | 2 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet with non stick cooking spray. In a medium bowl, blend the soup, corn flour, cheese, and oregano. Add sourdough slices, 1 cup at a time, and mix well. On the baking sheet, spread out the bread, about ¼ cup and a half, and top with the tomato mixture. Sprinkle the top with additional grated cheese. Bake for 15 - 18 minutes or until golden and bubbly.

title: Fresh Snow Peas(Denmark)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh snow pea | 2 teaspoons fresh dill weed
instructions: Cover snow peas with very hot water and bring to a boil over high heat.

title: Rum-Braised Lamb Cutlets
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb cutlets, each weighing approximately 1-1/4 inches thick | 24 sprigs oregano sprigs | 1/2 cup dark rum | 2 leeks, sliced lengthways
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500f degrees. Place the lamb in a large roasting tin and set aside. Place the oregano sprigs and 2 tablespoons of rum in a roasting tin, cover and roast in a hot oven for 40 - 50 minutes, until the lamb is well browned on the top. Meanwhile, place the leeks in a steamer over a saucepan of boiling, salted water and cook for 5 minutes, until just tender. Add the leeks to the pan and cook for 5 minutes, until glazed. Drain the lamb and leave to rest. Return the juices to the pan and simmer gently for 5 minutes, until reduced by half. Strain the sauce and return it to the pan. Bring back to the boil and boil for one minute. Serve the lamb and leeks with the gravy.

Random Ingredients: edible flower,kalamata olive,curry leaf,grain rice,green pea,beef,carrot
title: Yummy Persian Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice, long or brown | 1/2 cup carrot, diced | 1/2 cup green peas, shelled | 1/2 cup fresh edible flower, finely chopped | 14 curry leaves | 1/4 cup kalamata olive | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs ground beef
instructions: Cook rice in a separate pan, when rice is just about to 'lightly' cooked, stir and cook 2 to 3 min. While rice cooks in other pan, cut carrots, peas, and mint in half if large. Cook peas in boiling water for a few min. While peas cook, brown ground beef. When rice is done cooking, drain ground beef and set aside. When rice is done, drain water and stir in beef with any other pan juices into rice mixture. Add curry leaves and olives. Cook until rice has absorbed beef flavor. You may add other vegetable of your choice and/or spices if desired.

title: Italian Vegetable Saute
ingredients: 1 teaspoon anchovy, finely chopped ( or to taste ) | 2 ounces mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup green beans | 2 tablespoons cauliflower florets, chopped ( or use spinach ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 medium banana pepper, sliced
instructions: Heat skillet. Saute anchovies and mushrooms till softened and mushrooms release their juices cook vegetables until no more moisture remains and cauliflower and/or green beans are tender crisp drain on paper towels and add remaining ingredients tossing to mix well.

title: Berry Oven Bake
ingredients: 1 cup whole berries, frozen | 1 small yellow onion, quartered | 1 package stove top stuffing mix | 1 can stewed tomatoes, undrained
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Place berries in a bowl. Add onion, stuffing mix, and stewed tomatoes.

title: Puffed Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 portobello mushrooms | 2 puff pastry sheets, thawed on counter top to make 2 sheets
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450'f with a pizza peel or other large non stick baking sheet. You don’t want the puff pastry to get too soggy or the puff pastry should be too stiff. Wrap each portobello mushroom in pastry dough, tucking ends under, and place on the pizza peel or baking sheet. Sprinkle with a bit of salt and pepper, or to taste, and bake until the mushrooms are tender and the bottoms are just starting to turn golden brown, about 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shallot,rice wine vinegar,corn chip,white vinegar,thai red curry paste,harissa,kidney bean,date
title: Korma Salad
ingredients: 32 ounces kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 4 ounces shallots, finely diced | 12 ounces chopped preserved dates ( i prefer dark and green medjool ) | 1 teaspoon harissa | 4 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 8 ounces corn chips, crumbled
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, stir well. Cover and refrigerate 1 - 2 hours, tossing well before serving.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,linguine,gin,tomato green chilies,oyster mushroom,pepper,apricot jam,button mushroom
title: Cocktail
ingredients: 1 jar apricot jam | 1/2 lb fresh oyster mushroom | 1/2 lb fresh button mushroom | 1 jar diced okra and artichoke hearts | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 can artichoke hearts | 8 ounces linguine | pepper, to taste
instructions: Drain the water from the jar of apricot jam, place in a saucepan, and add the oysters, mushrooms, okra and artichoke hearts. Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Pour the tomato and green chilies over the top, and continue to cook and stir for 3 minutes. Do not overcook the mixture, it should be heated through. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the package directions. Drain the pasta, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta liquid, and toss with the sauce. Sprinkle with pepper.

title: Swiss Chard Saute
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard, washed and stalks removed | 1/4 cup unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1 loaf turkish bread, sliced 1/4-inch thick
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place swiss chard stalks on a baking sheet and toss with 1/4 cup cocoa.

Random Ingredients: mustard,turkey meat,wine vinegar,udon noodle,green lentil,button mushroom
title: Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 cups green lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1/4 lb lean ground turkey meat or 1/4 lb ground veal | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dry mustard | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/2 cup button mushroom | fat-free low-sodium worcestershire sauce
instructions: Combine lentils and meat in a large saucepan.

Random Ingredients: pickling spice,hungarian paprika,beer,plain flour,water,onion powder,kosher salt black pepper
title: Easy Beer Battered Fish for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh fish, cleaned and scaled ( i use a thick skinned flounder or whiting, but any firm, white-fleshed fish will do ) | 5 tablespoons hungarian paprika | 2 teaspoons dried onion powder | 2 teaspoons kosher salt and ground black pepper | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1/8 cup pickling spices ( see my note or recipe id # 247978 or recipe id # 2479 ) | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Rinse the fish well. Pat dry with paper towels and place in the bottom of the crock pot. Put the paprika, onion powder and salt and white pepper in a coffee filter or fine sieve and crush them into a fine paste. Add the flour to the bag and add to the bowl, making sure the flour is in chunks. Mix well and coat the fish really well with the flour mixture, coating the fish well and shaking off the excess. Do not use your hands. Cover the fish with plastic wrap and set it on a plate with some plastic on top to refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight, shaking off the excess flour. Do not leave the fish in the crock pot until you are finished, remove the plastic wrap and discard the fish and set it aside the day you are going to serve it. Add the pickling spice bundle to the beer you are going to use and mix well, or put in a jar with a tight fitting lid and shake well. Add enough water to just cover the fish, and heat the beer over medium high heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 20 - 30 minutes until the fish is tender and the liquid is reduced by almost one third, or until your taste is really good. If the water seems inadequate, increase the heat to medium high and cook for 5 - 10 minutes more, or until you feel the fish is very tender. If the liquid seems inadequate, add more water. Serve this fish as is, or with a crusty bread alongside and over cooked rice or buttered noodles.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,cardamom,coconut rum,cilantro leaf,chunky peanut butter,guacamole
title: Thai Peanut Sauce (Yum Yeem Koong)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups heavy cream | 1 tablespoon unsweetened coconut rum | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter or 2 tablespoons cream cheese, softened | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cilantro leaves, packed | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon guacamole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store refrigerated in a tightly covered container. To serve, mix with crushed ice and serve with rice.

title: Gado ("Fried Fresh Ouzo") (Fish Stew)
ingredients: 1 can fried beans sprouts ( i got ours in ca but they are not pre-made or made ) | 1/2 cup fried fish ( i bought them canned and they were fine ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons olive | 1/2 cup fish stock, for sauteing
instructions: Start by making the fried beans sprouts, then pour a small pile of the hot bean sprouts in the blender or food processor with a small amount of fish stock.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,soy sauce,yellow pepper,five spice powder
title: Baked Yellow Sweet  Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb yellow sweet pepper ( or red, green or a combination of the two ) | 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1/2 tablespoon five-spice powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Wash, peel and slice the sweet pepper. Place on a lined oven tray and scatter sliced peppers evenly amongst the pepper slices. Mix jam, soy sauce and five spice powder, to taste and drizzle a little over the peppers. Bake 20 minutes or until peppers are crisp and lightly browned and glazeed..

title: Lemon Chocolate Ribs
ingredients: 2 1/3 pounds country-style pork ribs | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 4 squares semisweet chocolate ice cream
instructions: Place ribs in a shallow dish. Pour in fresh lemon juice over ribs. Cover, and marinate in refrigerator at least 1 hour. Place chocolate ice cream in a heavy bottomed pot. Cook, stirring frequently, over medium heat until smooth. Drain ribs, reserving marinade. Brown chops in reserved marinade over medium heat, stirring constantly. Arrange on a serving platter, pour melted chocolate over, and serve.

title: Basil Shrimp Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, peeled & deveined | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1/8 cup basil pesto, drained | shredded basil tortilla | shredded jarlsberg cheese ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tortillas in a large bowl. Toss to coat. Warm tortillas and fill with mixture. Note, i use my hands, so there is no excess water. This recipe is very flexible, so i use my hands in combination with the other ingredients when making the corn tortillas.

Random Ingredients: apple,ancho chile powder,broccoli,ricotta cheese,meyer lemon,green curry paste,yellow cornmeal
title: Apple and Coconut Curry Cornbread
ingredients: 2 cups plain yellow cornmeal | 3/4 cup cream-style corn | 3/4 cup unsweetened ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup green curry paste | 3 tablespoons chopped ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon chopped meyer lemon | 1 medium apple, cored and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine cornmeal, cream style cornmeal, and cream style corn in a large bowl. Combine ricotta cheese, curry paste, ancho chile powder, and lemon in a separate bowl.

title: Sazon (Savory Sazon Salt)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yellow onions, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons sazon goya ( see note )
instructions: Place onion in bowl with 1/2 teaspoons sazon, stirring well. In a small pan, add 2 1/2 to 3 tablespoons hot tap water. Stir to combine. Bring to boil. Once boiling stop heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes.. Use chopsticks or a wooden spoon to fluff and break up the onion. Serve immediately with rice, salad and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: char siu sauce,tuna water,buttermilk,honey,tabasco sauce,asafoetida powder,triple sec
title: Char Siu (Char Siu Dessert)
ingredients: 12 ounces char siu sauce ( available at specialty grocery stores ) | 2 quarts buttermilk | 6 tablespoons honey ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon triple sec ( to taste ) or 1 tablespoon amaretto ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 can frozen tuna, in water ( optional ) or ( 7 ounce ) can alpine tuna, drained ( optional )
instructions: Combine char siu sauce, buttermilk, honey, triple sec or amaretto or amaretto, and tobasco, in a saucepan. Heat until it begins to bubble. Remove from heat and add asafetida to stir. Pour in the tuna/asafetida mixture slowly, stirring well until heated through. Serve warm or cold. Note, use any combination of items to make char siu, or use the sauce for salads, soups, or as a filling for sandwiches.

title: Crockpot Arroz Con Gandules (Rice and Beef With Nuts)
ingredients: 4 lbs lean stewing beef | 1 1/2 quarts beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cube | 1 1/2 tablespoons cumin powder | 1 1/2 ounces long grain rice, jasmine variety or 1 1/2 ounces basmati rice, jasmine variety
instructions: Brown beef and meat and set aside. Put beef, meat juices and seasoning into crock pot. Mix and cook on high for 3 hours or on low for 8 - 10 hours. Cook for 3 - 4 hours, stirring every 20 minutes.. Serve rice in deep bowls over thick hot red cabbage.

title: Fruit and Pork Stew
ingredients: 4 pork cutlets | 3 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 1/2 cups mixed dried fruit ( raisins, dried cranberries or sultanas )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large pan and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until the pork is tender. Alternatively, heat a grill to high. Remove the pork from the pan and place on a plate. Cover and cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until cooked through. Remove the meat from the pan. Discard any juices that have accumulated in the pan. Serve with a nice sauce, such as yoghurt.

title: Fried Beansprouts w- Pear Sauce & Apricots
ingredients: 1 can bean sprouts | 1 ripe pears, cut into eighths | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 teaspoon caraway | 2 cups hot water | dried parsley
instructions: Blend ingredients in a blender until smooth. Heat oil in a large non stick skillet over medium heat until hot, add beansprouts and stir fry until crisp, about 2 minutes. Transfer beansprouts to a plate and spread to cool and drain oil. Reheat oil in pan and add pear slices, a few pieces at a time, and stir fry for five minutes.
