Return beanprouts to pan and toss with sauce until heated through. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley.

title: Empanadas
ingredients: 1 package softened cream cheese | 1 package shredded crescent | 2 tablespoons dried black olives | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix together cream cheese, crescent dough, black olives, and seasoned salt.

title: White Beer and Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 12 ounces cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces irish cream | 5 ounces light beer | 1 teaspoon crushed cinnamon
instructions: Place the chicken on a baking tray and bake at 325ºf for 1 hour. Remove the chicken, cover with foil and leave to rest in a warm place for 5 minutes. Meanwhile place the beans and cream in a saucepan over medium low heat. Stir to combine and heat through, about 10 minutes. Stir in the beer, heat through, about 1 minute, then set aside for 25 minutes. Transfer the chicken and cannellini beans to a serving platter. Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve with the orange sauce.

title: Roasted Norwegian Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped white onion | 1/4 cup finely chopped finely chopped fresh sage | 3 lbs salmon fillets or 3 lbs other white fish | 2 tablespoons finely chopped white onions | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh sage | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh sage | 1 cup finely chopped finely chopped onion | 6 slices ham
instructions: Mix 1/4 cup finely chopped onions, 3 tablespoons finely chopped sage, salmon or fish, 2 tablespoons finely chopped onion, and 2 tablespoons finely chopped sage together well. Place in shallow roasting pan on oven rack set at lower third of oven.

title: Sauce Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 -4 large ripe tomatoes or 10 medium fresh tomatoes, preferably vine ripened and ripe | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( i like red hot ) or 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | picante sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Cut tops off tomato and discard. Scoop out seeds and core with large spoon. Cut out core and stem from tomatoes then roughly chop. Using a teaspoon, gently crush the tomatoes. Drizzle oil and hot sauce over tomatoes. Sprinkle thyme over tomatoes. Place on baking sheet and bake for 10 to 15 minutes, basting frequently with pan juices. The tomatoes will open up while warm but will retain their shape when they are completely cooled to the touch. Note, for a vegetarian version, if using picante sauce, substitute vegetable oil for the olive oil.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,corn tostada,beef broth,chicken meat,dark chocolate,green,white bean
title: Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 2 cans white beans, drained | 1 cup canned corn ( drained ) | 1 can green chilies, chopped | 1 lb chicken meat, cooked | 2 cans low sodium beef broth | 1 cup dark chocolate, chopped | 10 soft corn tostadas
instructions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients except tostadas. Transfer to 8x8 inch baking dish and bake uncovered until hot and cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Crock Pot Succotash
ingredients: 1 package dry farfalle pasta | 10 ounces kidney beans, drained well
instructions: In the crock pot, bring 3 cups water just to a boil. Add farfalle noodles and stir. Add refridgerator of kidney beans and cover. Cook on low heat for 7 hours.

title: Cornmeal Lasagna With Yogurt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 3 cups bread ( i used ciabatta ), 1/2 crusts removed | 3 1/2 cups lukewarm yogurt, drained ( or 2/3 cup low fat sour cream ) | 2/3 cup whole wheat flour | cornstarch, for coating | 12 lasagna noodles, preferably a 12x16-inch type
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yeast, 1 1/2 cups bread and 3 tablespoons yogurt. Allow to soften for 5 minutes or so. Add flour and knead until the mixture becomes smooth and elastic. You can use a stand mixer or stand mixer with a dough hook attachment. Put the dough in a large greased bowl, cover and let rise until doubled in bulk, about 40 minutes or so. Preheat oven to 400°f. Using a large baking dish or pizza stone, spread about half the dough evenly on the bottom of the dish. Spread a small amount of yogurt or sour cream on top of the dough. Place 4 lasagna noodles on top of the yogurt and spread with the remaining yogurt or sour cream. Top the layers with any remaining bread or yogurt. Place the 3 lasagna noodles on top of the yogurt and spread the second layer evenly on top. Cover and allow to rise until doubled in bulk, about 40 minutes. Cut into 6 pieces and serve with lots of bread.

title: Favourite Dipping Sauce for Veggies
ingredients: 1 pint plum tomato, diced | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted, shelled and pureed ( or peanuts or any other nuts ) | 2 cloves | 2 -3 gherkin
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a frying pan or saucepan and stir or stir constantly, until the tomatoes are cooked and the cashew nuts are mixed with the mixture. If it's still hot when you take it off the heat, it should be. Sauce is ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,vanilla bean,monterey jack cheese,paprika,tomato puree
title: Baked Ratatouille
ingredients: 1 yellow squash, halved and seeded | 1 medium tomatoes, sliced into strips | 3 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1/2 vanilla bean | 2 tablespoons shredded monterey jack cheese or 2 tablespoons cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a shallow baking dish with aluminum foil, and spray with vegetable cooking spray. Place squash in a nonreactive baking dish and top with tomato slices and tomato puree. Sprinkle with paprika. Place a strip of cheese over each layer, then spread squash mixture over all. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender throughout and cheese is golden. Serve immediately.

title: Lime and Onion Steak (Mark Bittman)  Steak Marinade for Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1/3 cup beef stock | 1 tablespoon fresh ground coriander ( or 1 tsp. dried coriander ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: In a large zip top plastic bag, combine the limeade concentrate, stock, coriander and vinegar. Place in freezer for at least two hours or overnight. To marinate, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove air from bag. Remove meat from marinade. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper. Place meat in a large dish. Coat tightly with marinade. Turn meat and marinade around in the bag in the marinade. Cover tightly with foil. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 45 minutes. Do not overcook.

title: Tomato and Black Cherry Chili Sauce
ingredients: 32 ounces hunts tomato sauce | 32 ounces cherry tomatoes
instructions: Put all ingredients into a crockpot or large pot.

title: Tahini Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon prepared yellow mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 head lettuce leaves or 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Place tahini on large platter.

title: Chinese Cabbage (Shredded)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon green onion, finely minced
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan. Remove from heat and stir fry green onions. The green onions are not burnt.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,vanilla,pumpkin seed,thyme,chuck roast,sage leaf,yellow cornmeal,yellow onion
title: Pumpkin Seed Stuffed Beef Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast | 1 cup canadian bacon ( cooked bacon bits with rind removed ) | 2/3 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 large yellow onion, peeled and sliced | 1/4 cup paprika | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spread pumpkin seeds in a 9 x 9 inch baking pan or lightly oil the inside of the roasting pan. Place the roast in the center of the pumpkin seeds. In a skillet, combine the bacon bits, onion, cornmeal, paprika, sage, thyme and vanilla and brown the roast on all sides. Place the roast in the roasting pan. Bake at 350°f for 1 hour. Remove roast from pan.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,onion powder,fish fillet,topping,zucchini,orange zest,anise flavoring,romaine lettuce
title: Crunchy Goat Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced into 1/4 -inch slices | 1 package fresh goat cheese, cut into 1/2 to 1/3-inch slices | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed until warm ( divided use ) | 4 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 1/4 teaspoon anise flavoring | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 4 tablespoons minced sweet onion tops ( i like italian but you could use frozen chopped onion, if you want ) | 4 leaves romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: Place zucchini on a baking sheet and bake at 375 degrees f 4 - 5 minutes. Or until just tender when pierced with a fork, and set aside to cool. Cut zucchini slices into 1/4 slices. Place in a medium bowl with goat cheese slices and 1 tbsp each of the orange peel, anise, and onion powder. Mix well and set aside. Place remaining 1/2 tspn orange peel, anise, onion powder, and goat cheese into a medium bowl. Mix well. Toss lettuce leaves with salad dressing mixture and the zucchini and cheese mixture. Chill for several hours, if desired. If chilled ahead, cover and put in fridge until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,allspice,red chilies,oriental sesame oil,sun tomato oil,catsup
title: Spicy Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground round | 1 tablespoon mustard or 1 tablespoon spicy brown sugar | 1 tablespoon crushed red chilies | 1 tablespoon unseasoned roasted oriental sesame oil | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 tablespoon catsup | 3/4 cup rye flour
instructions: Mix dry ingredients with hands or in bowl. Form into four patties, about 1 1/2 inches thick. Spray a nonstick pan with nonstick spray. Set aside. Heat skillet over high heat, then add beef patties. Cook about 4 - 5 minutes per side until cooked through. While burgers are cooking, make the sauce. Combine the catsup and rye flour in a small bowl. Dribble over the finished burgers as desired. Serve. Note, i prefer this over steamed coleslaw or baby carrots. For best results, chill several hours then place them on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: cream,dark sesame oil,bay leaf,artichoke heart,pork loin,gherkin,celeriac
title: Artichoke-Sour Pork With Celeriac Puree
ingredients: 350 g pork loin, cut in 1. 5cm thick slices ( cut in thin slices ) | 3 tablespoons cream | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 bay leaves | 1 celeriac or 1 savoy cabbage, roughly chopped into 1 cm wide wedges | 1/2 gherkin, chopped into 5 cm lengths | 1 jar artichoke hearts
instructions: Pour 1 tablespoon of cream into a saucepan with 2 tablespoons of dark sesame oil, set over a low heat and simmer for 10 minutes add 1 tablespoon of cream, and simmer for 5 minutes over a moderate heat, until reduced by half. Stir in 1 tablespoon of cream and the bay leaves. Remove bay leaves, then cover and set aside. In another saucepan, combine the remaining cream with the celeriac or savoy cabbage wedges and gherkin and simmer over a low heat for 20 minutes, or until the celeriac is cooked but the cabbage still retains a little of it's crunch and crunch. Place a pork slice on each of the plates, pour the celeriac puree over and serve with the garnish and a few artichoke hearts on the side.

title: Onion (A French Kiss) Dip
ingredients: 3 large spanish onions, peeled and seeded ( about 3 1/2 cups ) | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | food coloring
instructions: Melt cheese in a saucepan over low heat. Add onion to cheese.

title: Coconut Peanut Shreds
ingredients: 1/4 cup coconut milk | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1/2 cup golden syrup | pepperoni | chili pepper | peanuts, chopped
instructions: Stir coconut milk, peanut oil and golden syrup in large saucpan until well mixed. Heat through, reduce to low and cover with lid. Cook for 20 mins over gentle heat until coconut becomes tender. Spoon out onto plate, garnish with pepperoni and chopped chillies.

title: Swiss Radish Cookies
ingredients: 1 pound unsalted butter | 10 ounces confectioners'sugar | 12 pounds fresh radishes, washed
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, cream together the butter and confectioners' sugar until smooth and creamy. Cut in strips about 1/2 inch wide and 1/2 inch thick. Cut a hole in the center of each radish and stuff with radish fingers. Place radishes in a greased medium baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees f until lightly browned, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,lime juice,white sesame seed,ladyfinger,prune,ricotta cheese,yeast
title: Italian Sweet Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast, active dry | 2 cups puy puy ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice | 3 tablespoons white sesame seeds, toasted | 1/2 - 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed ( see note ) | 16 medium ladyfingers, split | 1/2 cup pitted prunes
instructions: Note, i only use pearl barley, i have no problems with other types of white sesame seeds that i can get in the ingredient section. Sprinkle the beans with white sesame seeds and toss in with the yeast. Set aside in a warm place until the yeast is foamy and slightly bubbly, about 15 minutes. Mix the ricotta and lime juice in a bowl and stir together. Add the yeast mixture and half of the sesame seeds and stir well. Put the 2 1/2 cups of puy and pearl barley in a large bowl and combine with the yeast mixture. Work out the dough by adding extra water by tablespoons at a time until the dough starts to pull away from the sides of the bowl. Transfer to a bowl and cover with a cloth or towel, set aside for 30 minutes. Divide the dough into 24 equal portions depending on the size of your rolls. Roll each portion to a 1/2 thick round. Use more dough if necessary. Place 1 heaping teaspoon of ricotta mixture at the bottom of each round. Spoon 1/2 2 tbsps of the remaining sesame seed mixture over the top of the ricotta mixture, roll up lengthwise and place in a greased 9 pizza pan, seam side down. Pinch the seams of the bottom and top of the rolls together and then add the remaining sesame seeds and the remaining 1/2 cup barley, sprinkle with the remaining sesame seeds and bake in a 425 degree oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool in pan for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove and serve hot as desired.

title: Spicy String Beans
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh string beans | 2 ounces hot pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Wash the string beans and snap off any hard strings along the length they include the ends or the tip of your string. In a large saucepan, simmer the green beans on medium heat for about 20 minutes until the beans look clear and the meat is cooked. The string beans will also look nice and tender after cooking, but should not be cooked all the way through. When the string beans are done, remove them from the heat and let the beans rest, covered for about 5 minutes. Drain out any excess hot fat from the saucepan and add the hot pepper flakes if using, then serve.

title: Beef Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 cup chinese mustard | 1 cup sherry wine ( specifically harvey's bristol cream ) | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 2 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: Prepare a roasting pan by brushing with vegetable oil. Combine all ingredients and marinate the meat for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator. Grill the meat on an outdoor grill or broiler set to high heat. Cook the meat for 10 minutes to your liking. Be sure only to overcook it. If the meat is too dry after 10 minutes, add a little more water to the pan. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pistachio pudding mix,chicken cutlet,icing sugar,green chili pepper,pancetta,godiva chocolate liqueur,lime zest,veal
title: Yummy Baked Veal With Chili Pudding
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken cutlets, pounded to 3/8 inch thick slices ( or you could use the chicken breasts ) | 8 1/2 ounces pancetta, chopped | 2 ounces goat cheese or 2 ounces soft goat cheese ( crumbled ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons lime zest, finely grated | 1 -2 green chili pepper, crushed | 1 1/2 tablespoons godiva original chocolate liqueur ( optional ) | 2 1/2 ounces pitted godiva chocolate liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix the filling ingredients together. Put a small layer of filling in the bottom of a nonstick baking sheet. Bake at 400°f for about 10 - 15 mins or until the fill is firm. When cool, mix filling, chili pepper and godiva with a spoonful of the filling mixture. Poke holes all over using a cookie cutter or a fork. Sprinkle with icing sugar. Cool and set.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,gin,orange,rice noodle,clam juice,salad green,lentil,cardamom seed
title: Garam Golumkis (Indian Chicken Salad Soup)
ingredients: 1/2 lb chicken breast, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon rice noodles, broken in half | 2 cups mixed salad greens | 1 cup dried lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1 head fresh clams, well cleaned | 2 medium oranges, sliced in long pieces | 4 tablespoons gin, such as hendrick's | 4 cardamom seeds, crushed
instructions: Arrange chicken in a small bowl. Pour enough water in the salted pot to almost cover the chicken. Add noodles. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 minutes or until noodles are tender. While noodles are cooking, rinse and pick out clams. Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Add clams and return to a boil. Lift out cooked clams, and place in a large bowl. Drain stock and skim off any foam that rises to the top. Stir the soup and reserved clam juice, and refrigerate for 3 hours or longer. Just before serving, stir in oranges and gin to taste and serve garnished with cardamom. Variation,. Place chicken on a serving platter, and top with lettuce, lentils, and clams, if desired. Garnish with orange slices and serve with cocktail sticks or cocktail forks, if desired.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,lipton onion soup mix,mace,parsley sprig
title: Prawn Croquettes
ingredients: 2 cans peeled king prawns or 2 kg king prawns | 1 packet lipton onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon sweet fish sauce | fresh parsley sprig ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large saucepan and simmer for 30 mins stirring occasionally.

title: Ragu Sauce - Indonesian Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs hot beef sausage or 2 lbs other hot fat | 7 tablespoons kitchen bouquet ( indonesian stock, if available ) | 1/4 cup chili paste ( kha, if available )
instructions: In a large pot heat the water or broth up to boiling. When the water boils remove the sausage or sausages from the casings and saute them in the heated water until they are well browned. Remove the sausage from the pan and place them in a bowl. Cover the bowl with boiling broth. Pour the cooking broth through and into the simmering sauce. Stir the mixture. Return the sausage to the simmer and simmer very gently. Add in the kitchen bouquet and chili paste. Simmer very gently until the sauce is at the optimum temperature. Let cool completely then transfer to a jar or refrigerator and keep refrigerated in the fridge and use within 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,halloumi cheese,thyme,red cabbage,chocolate,lime wedge,puff pastry
title: Lime & Herb Strudel Sandwiches With Halloumi
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons lime wedges ( fresh, to taste ) | 1 tablespoon garlic powder ( or more to taste, about 1 tsp. ) | 8 ounces halloumi cheese ( or other hard italian cheese ) | 8 ounces red cabbage ( shredded, or use shredded or shredded cabbage of choice ) | 1 sprig fresh thyme (, leaves only ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped unsweetened chocolate | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry ( thawed )
instructions: Preheat broiler and set a baking sheet in the oven. Line a cookie sheet with foil and set aside. Sprinkle the inside of a nonstick pan or nonstick fry pan with the lime wedges, if using. Put the garlic powder evenly on the surface of the haloumi and evenly distribute. Place the lettuce on the slice of haloumi. Then sprinkle over the red cabbage. Sprinkle the thyme over the entire top. Drizzle the chopped chocolate all over the top. Set aside for about 20 minutes. Remove pan from oven, spread frozen pastry sheets on top, and press out excess pastry to cut off a sheet of pastry. Put on a baking sheet, in the oven and broil for about 2 minutes, or until lightly browned and puffed. Flip the bread over and broil until golden, about 1 minute more. Remove to a cutting board and cut into 8 equal pieces. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lamb loin chop,egg,baby spinach,macadamia nut,grain rice
title: Macadamia and Lamb Chops
ingredients: 1/2 cup macadamia nuts, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped mixed baby spinach, about 6 ounces | 2 lamb loin chops, cut into thin strips ( about 1 1/4 inch in length ) | 1 large egg, beaten lightly | 1/2 cup uncooked medium grain rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f toast macadamia nuts in preheated oven for 8 minutes, stirring often, until golden brown and fragrant. Place the spinach in a bowl, and add the lamb, stirring to coat over all of the pieces of lamb. Add the egg and stir to combine. Place the bag of macadamia nuts among four large shallow baking dishes. Spread the rice on top of the nuts. Dividing evenly, drizzle a little melted butter over the rice. Place in the oven and bake until the rice is warmed through and the lamb is hot and bubbling, about 15 minutes.

title: Cherry Crusted Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon zest ( canela ) | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup paprika, sweet paprika preferred | 2 lbs cabbage | 1 1/4 lbs shredded reduced sodium sweetened cabbage | 1 mango powder | 1 cup canned sweetened cherries, drained
instructions: Heat oven to 375° and unfold crescent roll wrappers into a 12x7 inch rectangular baking pan.

title: Moroccan Spicy Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb chopped bamboo shoot | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Brown the chopped bamboo, cut it in 3 or 4 pieces and sprinkle with the baking powder. Stir it with a fork to coat it evenly in the powder. Add hot pepper, harissa and salt to taste. Mix or shake to mix it all up and bake at 350°f, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes. Add any of the following, broccoli, mushrooms.

title: Chilled French Green Beans With Shrimp
ingredients: 3 tablespoons french style green bean, frozen | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/2 lb uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Dry green beans with a paper towel. Cook green beans in boiling water until crisp tender, about 1 minute. Drain on paper towels. Place frozen green beans in a large stainless steel sauté pan over low heat. Scatter shrimp over the green beans, then scatter cumin seeds over the shrimp. Sauté until shrimp turn pink, about 3 - 4 minutes. Transfer cooked green beans to a serving plate. Toss remaining ingredients in a small bowl with a little salt and pepper until thoroughly combined.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,saffron,caribbean jerk seasoning,cilantro,lime wedge,beef stew meat
title: Goat Cheese and Caribbean Jerk Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 package goat cheese | 1/4 cup cilantro, chopped | 5 -6 tablespoons caribbean jerk seasoning | 2 lbs center cut beef stew meat | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon saffron, crushed | 8 -10 lime wedges ( optional )
instructions: Rinse lamb well. Place lamb in bowl of a food processor with the goat cheese, cilantro, jerk seasoning and saffron. Pulse to combine. Add 1/4 cup water and pulse to mix. Pour marinade into large resealable plastic bag, add meat and toss to coat. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours before grilling, or up to 3 to 4 hours. Lightly oil grill and preheat barbecue to medium low heat. Lob of lamb is a must for this dish. Cook on grill for about 3 - 5 minutes per side to desired doneness, or to your degree of doneness, or desired doneness in desired tenderness. Serve with lime wedges if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Curry Broth
ingredients: 2 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth | 2 green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 1/8 teaspoon curry ( optional )
instructions: Combine broth, cardamom seeds and curry in pan.

title: Bell Pepper-And-Tahini Dip
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup tahini | 1 - 1 1/2 cup white sugar ( to taste ) or 1 -1 1/2 cup artificial sweetener ( to taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons simple syrup or 2 -3 tablespoons lemon juice | chopped yellow bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in an electric blender. Blend, blend, repeat 1 - 2 minutes or until desired consistency is achieved. Place in a covered container. Chill in refrigerator at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with bread.

title: Chinese Peas
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups fresh peas | 2 tablespoons ground szechwan pepper | 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 leaf cilantro stem
instructions: Blend peas, szechuan pepper and shortening in a blender or food processor until mixture forms a very thick paste. Add cilantro and pulse several times until cilantro is a coarse chop.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,thai red curry paste,green onion,macaroni,apple cider
title: Coconut Curry Browned Macaroni
ingredients: 1 package macaroni, ( browned macaroni will do ) | 12 ounces canned coriander leaves | 1/2 cup green onion, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup apple cider, divided ( i like apple cider ) | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste ( to taste )
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions, not until al dente in water. Drain and rinse thoroughly with cold water. Set aside. Put cornstarch in a small bowl. Dip green onions into the cornstarch, then coat with cornstarch. Set aside. Drain coriander and rinse under cold water. Toss with macaroni, half the green onions, remaining green onion, and apple cider. Serve and enjoy.

title: Tabbouleh in a Jar
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 whole clove, crushed
instructions: Wash and remove thick stems from cauliflower. Break up head of cauliflower into tiny florets. Place in medium bowl and cover with boiling water, just to soften. Drain and reserve clear water. Add crushed clove and 1/4 cup fresh water. Cover with towel and set in microwave or refrigerator for 6 minutes or till tender.

title: Creamy Spinach Dessert Crepes
ingredients: 1 package frozen creamed spinach | 2 1/2 tablespoons soymilk, divided | 6 tablespoons finely chopped red onions or 6 tablespoons shallots | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper, divided | 2 cans baby sweet potatoes ( drained ) | 3 cups crumbled filling | fresh cracked black peppercorns, for garnish
instructions: Place ricotta in a medium bowl and mix in the 1/4 cup liquid. Sprinkle evenly with onion and pepper. Coarsely chop the potatoes in a food processor and toss to coat. Spread about 1 heaping tablespoon of the sweet potato mixture on the bottom a 5 cup crepe pan, about 1/4 inch thick. Arrange 3 spinach leaves in a horizontal line along the center of the spinach mixture. Cover with about 2 tablespoons of the spinach mixture. Top with about 1 tablespoon of the potato mixture followed by 1 tablespoon sweet potato mixture. Fold in remaining spinach and finish with sprinkling with cracked black pepper. Spread with remaining 1 cup of sour cream. Repeat the filling in all three directions until finished.

title: Mock Swiss Filler for Bread Machine
ingredients: 2 cups water | 2 teaspoons yeast or 2 teaspoons bread machine yeast | 1 can water chestnuts | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Put all ingredients in bread machine on the order suggested by the manufacturer. Set to white crust. I prefer the bread for the best texture, but you can add whatever you like. I bake mine at 350f for approximately 25 - 30 minutes on my bread machine.

title: Olive Garden Grilled Bananas
ingredients: 3 lbs hamburger buns | 1 medium orange
instructions: The secret is to mix well, using all your ingredients well. You want the hamburger to be well blended.

title: Ginger-Rusted Trout With Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb smoked pork shoulder or 1/2-3/4 lb jamaican shoulder roast | 3 large whole roma tomatoes ( about 1 pound ) | 1/2 - 3/4 lb smoked smoked turkey, preferably organic | 3 tablespoons fresh ginger, minced | 2 cans rotel tomatoes ( 1 1/2 cans )
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the turkey with paper towels. Spray the inside of a dutch oven or heavy pot that has a tight fitting lid with pam. Rub the turkey out into the pot or into the lid. Cut off any excess fat from the turkey by trimming all visible access fat, or throwing it away. You do not need to use anything else for the salting. Cut the tomatoes into 1½ inch slices. Slice both tomatoes into 1½ inch thick slices. Cut a slice of the ginger in half and place in a small bowl. Add 2 cans of rotel to the tomatoes. Place the turkey in the pot and add water to just cover the turkey. Add water to just enough to cover the turkey. Place the bird in the pot. If there is none of the tomato liquid and liquid in the pot, add enough of the water by boiling it down in a potful of ice cubes. Cover and simmer very slowly for 2 hours, stirring occasionally until the turkey is very tender. If the turkey falls off the bones and the water starts to boil out, place the lid back on the dutch oven, put a cover on and simmer until most of the liquid evaporates. Scoop out the turkey and save any juices.

title: Savory Spanish Rice Bake
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups vegetarian worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 7 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 4 teaspoons red pepper flakes ( about ) | 1 cup sunflower oil or 1 cup hazelnuts, toasted, skinned, and coarsely chopped | 1 cup shaved provolone cheese or 1 cup cheddar cheese | 2 -3 -4 tablespoons jalapenos, juice of ( about 1 tsp )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Rinse rice well in several changes of cold water, drain well and set aside. In a lrge mixing bowl combine rice with worcestershire sauce, garlic powder and red pepper flakes. Place chicken in a 5 - 6 quart casserole or baking dish. Coat chicken with marinade. Set aside half of the marinade.

title: Bread Salad With Fresh Mussels
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 6 ounces fresh mussels | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 6 tablespoons shortening | 1 medium yellow onion ( vidalia onion )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Cut bread loaf lengthwise in half. Remove the crusts from the bread. Break the loaf into pieces approximately 1 - 1 1/2 1 wide by 2 long. Open the mussels and scrub lightly with a knife or fork. Remove top shell of shells. Place shell side down on baking sheet. Brush inside of shell with tamarind paste. Bake until bread is toasted and aroma is toasted, about 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. Place shortening in a skillet. Add onion and cook over medium heat until golden. Add oysters and cook just until slightly opaque. Remove from heat and add bread in large handfuls, reserving the liquid. Squeeze bread of excess liquid. Cut bread into small pieces approximately 2 1/2 long and about ¾ inch. Toss bread, mussels and chopped onion in dressing. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Japanese Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh boneless center cut tilapia or 1/2 lb salmon | 2 tablespoons dark miso paste, dissolved in | 12 fluid ounces hot water | 2 teaspoons honey | 2 teaspoons garlic paste
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes prior to skewering. Cut fish into strips 3/4 inches long. Place skewers in a shallow bowl of cold water, and place on a large sheet of wax paper or plastic wrap. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Preheat grill. In a small bowl, mix miso paste and water until smooth. Pour over fish and marinate 3 hours. To remove any excess liquid, soak in hot water for 1 hours, or until softened. To make honey glaze. Heat grill. Discard water used to soak fish. Place fish on grill rack and cook 6 to 8 minutes, turning once, basting with glaze as necessary. Serve warm.

title: Puerto Rico Marinated Capicola
ingredients: 1 lb capicum, diced | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, rubbed | 1/3 teaspoon peppercorn, crushed
instructions: Toss the cap with the oreganoregano and peppercorns. Place in plastic bag and add pepper solution. Marinate at least 2 hours, turning once a day. Keep in fridge.

title: Jamaican Jerk Powder
ingredients: 3 cups lard or 3 cups vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon allspice, ground
instructions: In a clean bowl, make 2 1/2 to 3 dashes of lard with the allspice. You can use other flavoring oils if you like a more pronounced jerk flavor. Heat the oil in a 10 inch to 12 inch heavy skillet. As the oil is heating, work the lard with a fork, to form a crumbly mixture. It should have no lumps. Stir the lard a few times while the oil is heating to keep it from burning or sticking. When the oil is too hot, it will crackle and spit on the sides of the pan as it cooks. Use a slotted spoon to remove the lard from the hot oil. Allow the oil to cool. Use in place of store bought jerky, or as a snack, or on rolls.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,green cardamom pod,sake,chicken bouillon granule,scallion,cocoa,onion soup mix
title: Fried Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 24 slices | 4 large green cardamom pods, whole | 2 tablespoons onion soup mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 tablespoon instant chicken-flavored bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons sake | chopped scallion, for decorating | scallion, for decorating
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, saute the green cardamom pods for about 5 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove the cardamom pods with a slotted metal spoon and set aside. To the same skillet, add onion soup mix, cocoa, bouillon granules, and sake. Saute for about 5 minutes, or until the mixture has reduced slightly and thickened slightly. Add the pork slices, coating each piece with the sauce, and saute over medium heat until tender, 4 - 5 minutes on each side. Garnish with chopped scallions and/or scallions. This can be prepared in advance and frozen.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,salt,arborio rice,currant,margarine,golden syrup,tomato paste
title: Baked Risotto (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 500 g arborio rice | 200 g margarine, room temperature | 60 g tomato paste | 175 g currants | 150 g peanut oil or 175 g vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | salt
instructions: Peel the rice while it is still hot and leave it to drain. Cut up your vegetables and place them into the rice bowl. Sprinkle over half of the salt then spread the rice on your rice roller. Use a fork to push the rice down the rice until it is level with the level of the margarine. Spread the rice in an even layer. Use a knife to cut it in a diagonal pattern. Continue until your rice cooker has drained all the mixture. This will take approximately 5 times. Spread the rice with a large spoon as you go, making sure that it does not touch each other. You should end up with a large sheet of rice on your cooker. Sprinkle a little of the sugar over the rice. Cut the rice sheets in half, so that you have a total of 40 pieces. Keep in mind that each grain will contain approximately a little oil, less will be needed and it will need a little space depending on the size of your cooker. Spread the rice on the tray in a single layer. Add a touch of light tasting oil onto the rice, then make a shallow indentation on top of it with your finger. Place it into a deep baking dish or deep baking dish that is suitable for cooking the rice. When the rice has drained, put the oil into the baking dish or deep baking dish and heat up over a medium heat. Place one of the rice sheets on top of the oil and fry for about 3 minutes, being careful that they do not burn. Use a slotted spoon to remove the rice to a clean sheet. Cut the rice into squares and serve, with the extra syrup if desired.

title: Korean Radises(Yom din)

instructions: Peel and dice lime and drop it in a large bowl. Cut sesame oil into 4 quarters and place the quarters in a small saucepan with about 2 inches of water. Set over medium high heat and bring to a boil.

instructions: Combine the tuna and tomato in a bowl. Add sherry and whisk to combine. Place the canola oil and mirin in a skillet and heat over medium to medium high until it boils. Drop in the noodles and let them cook about 10 minutes, until they are hot and beginning to soften. Turn noodles out onto paper towels. Drizzle with the warm sauce. instructions: Prepare all ingredients, cutting off stems and ends of parsnips before peeling off peppers and removing seeds. Roasting chickens can be used as well. Remove stems and seeds from chiles. title: Shrimp and Scallops With Guacamole and Mint Sparklers
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons guacamole | 1 1/2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1 1/3 lbs large scallops, drained ( can use 6 8 oz ) | 1 1/3 lbs small yellow sweet peppers | 1/3 cup water chestnut, chopped | 4 green mint sprigs, chopped ( i use a mix of scallions, basil, basil and tarragon ) | 3 cups broth ( can use fish stock ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Rinse the shrimp under cold water, under cold water and pat dry. Place the shrimp in a food processor with the cointreau and whiz until smooth. title: Spicy Sausage With Mango Muesli

instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a broiler pan with foil or parchment paper, and preheat to high. Place the corn on a baking sheet with the cut side up. instructions: Brown veal and string beans until just browned. Remove string beans. Cook pasta according to directions on package. Drain pasta and veal and put in a large bowl. Combine other ingredients, and mix well. Place 1/2 cup mixture on each noodle, and fold in sides. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Remove from oven, and let stand 10 minutes.

title: Nana's Ultimate Pumpkin Soup

instructions: Rinse and drain the cooked beans and pumpkin pieces. Place the potatoes and dill in a medium bowl, add enough cold water to cover, and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer gently for about 15 minutes or until pumpkin is tender. Puree the soaked beans and pumpkin in a blender or food processor until smooth. Add the soup, and cook for 20 minutes or until well blended and soup is thickened.

title: Papaya-Pineapple Smoothie

instructions: Into a blender, add diced papayas, pineapple juice, and smooth out. Serve in a tall glass over ice cubes.

instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Rinse immediately in cold water. Drain. Rinse with cool water and drain, then combine with taco seasoning in large bowl. In separate bowl, combine cornmeal and miso. In separate bowl, lightly grease grill. Oil grate lightly. Cook noodles until just done, about 3 minutes on one side, about 1 minute on the other. Cut into strips. Place 2 noodles on each rack of a baking sheet and sprinkle with corn meal mixture, cooking one shelf down. Repeat until all noodles are used up, or bake at 450° in a lightly oiled 9x13 glass baking dish, until dry and golden brown, about 25 minutes.

title: Wonton Curry

instructions: Cut mince in half and rub it into 4 - 8 wonton skins. Bring a kettle of water to boil and add the mince. Boil and boil mince until desired thickness of sauce is achieved.

title: Hot Pepper Balls

instructions: Mix chickpea flour, red chili powder, peppercorns and mix. Add some jam and mix. Roll in water if required. Let the mixture rest in a cool, dry cloth for 1 - 2 hours. Make little balls with the mixture. Bake on a hot pan or flat griddle.

title: Sweet Red Wine

instructions: Cut the peppers in half on the diagonal. Place the cut side of the chile down on a heavy skillet with the stem end facing you. Lightly brown them over high heat. Turn them and brown on the other side. Remove the chiles from the skillet and add the red wine to the skillet. Reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer until the wine is very dark, about 20 minutes. Add the fish sauce and bourbon. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture is very thick.

title: Spicy Thai Peas And Peas
ingredients: 1 lb frozen peas | 1 jar diced pimiento | 1 jar thai red curry paste | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1 -2 tablespoon spice ( try my own mix of all-spice and almond )
instructions: Heat up your first 3 ingredients together in large sauce pan together. Boil. Reduce heat. Keep it as low as it can go on until the peas are tender and juicy. Add the curry paste. Simmer 15 - 20 minutes. Stir in the orange liqueur. Serve in bowl with plenty of steamed rice.

title: Oaty Snack Mix

title: Poblano Casserole

instructions: Preheat broiler and place 6 poblano chiles on the foil or a cookie sheet. Spread poblano slices onto foil, place on cookie sheet and broil until lightly browned. Put the split french bread slices over the poblanos and broil for about 1 minute. Sprinkle 1 tbs. Of the parmesan cheese over the toasted poblanos. Spread about half the bean, cornmeal mixture in a rectangle on the top of the french bread. Top with slices of the remaining onion and broil for another 2 to 3 minutes till cheese is browned and bubbly. Sprinkle on the remaining poblanos and serve with pico de gallo, sour cream, salsa or whatever else you want.

title: Baked Cinnamon Soup

instructions: Set oven heat to 180°c. In a microwave safe bowl, combine the stock and cinnamon. Microwave until mixture comes to the boil.. Serve hot.

title: Beer-Sausage Casserole

instructions: Saute the sausage, breaking it up or until it is no longer pink, and drain well. Pour soup into a large bowl with the sausage, the spices, and the beer. Add the sour cream and mix it. Cover the dish with more waxed paper, and use a spatula to roll up the sausage into a cylinder. Make the roll, place all the remaining ingredients in a slow cooker and mix them together until it is well blended. Place the sausage, seam side down, in a lightly buttered casserole dish and cover. Cook on low setting for 4 hours.

instructions: Whip yoghurt with milk ricotta. Add a few dashes of jam, if desired.

Add enough water to cover. Add the watercress leaves. Toss to coat well. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
