title: Sultana Sweet Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice | 1 cup chopped sultana | 2 cardamom pods, crushed | 12 raw sweet potatoes, peeled and quartered
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the rice, sultanas, cardamom pods, and sweet potatoes. Cover and let stand for 15 minutes, or until all the water has been absorbed. Note, if the rice gets too watery, stir in a little of the water. Place the rice in an ovenproof casserole dish and bake, uncovered, in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 25 - 35 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender. Serve right away.

title: Indian Spiced Nuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped pecans or 1/4 cup pecan nuts | 1/4 cup chopped coriander
instructions: Heat a dry nonstick skillet over medium heat. When hot, but not smoking, add nuts. Sauté nuts just until crisp, about 3 minutes each side. Scatter nuts over hot chips while still warm.

title: Ginger Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberries | 2 tablespoons minced fresh gingerroot | 1 tablespoon minced garlic
instructions: Pour cranberries, gingerroot, and garlic into a bowl, and stir to mix. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours before serving to blend seasonings.

title: Crab Stew in a Bag
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped onion ( about one medium onion ) | 1 can lump crabmeat | 1 package dry onion soup mix
instructions: Add all ingredients to crockpot. Cover and cook on low 4 - 6 hours or on high 4 and 1/2 until thickened.

title: Cuban Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 6 corn | 1 -2 tablespoon salt | 2 tablespoons seasoning salt | 1/2 cup white vinegar
instructions: Grill or broil the ears of corn on all sides, or just until charred. While they are grilling, combine the salt and vinegar in a bowl and stir until well blended. When the corn is done, brush them with the vinegar mix and place on large platter, or on plate, and serve on the side with your favorite toppings.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread crumb,oxtail,sake,sun tomato,poundcake,vanilla bean,stewing beef,italian breadcrumb
title: Caldillo
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1/4-inch chunks | 1 lb oxtail | 8 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 3 tablespoons sake | 2 ounces italian style breadcrumbs | 3 ounces wheat bread crumbs | 1 vanilla bean, scraped and sliced into 3 inch rounds | 1 lb poundcake, cut into large bite-size pieces
instructions: Brown the meat, oxtails and sun dried tomatoes in medium size sauce pan with a bit of oil added. Pour off any excess fat. Add wine to the meat, then add your choice of fillings and simmer over low heat, covered, until meat is very tender, about 1 1/4 hours. During the last 30 minutes of cooking add your bread crumbs. Scoop out the vanilla bean and serve over rice.

title: Rigatoni and Swiss Cheese With Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 4 ounces swiss cheese, sliced
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling, salted water for about 7 minutes. While pasta is cooking, slice swiss cheese. Drain pasta. Combine drained pasta with swiss cheese. Serve.

title: Cauliflower in Smoky Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower ( just the stem ) | 1 tablespoon smokey barbecue smoke ( in the smoky bar ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Remove the stalk from the cauliflower and cut into thick wedges. Place the wedges in a bowl and put the smokey barbeque into it. Add the stock cube and liquid smoke to the cauli cauliflower and stir well. Tip, the smokey barbeque can be bought ready to smoke very easily. If you want it hot you can use a smokey barbecue for this recipe. Cook and enjoy.

title: Lentils & Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 small ripe tart apple | 1/2 small green pepper, deseeded & diced | 2 tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 can lentils
instructions: Place apple & the pepper in a blender or food processor & whizz until very fine. Add remaining ingredients & purée until it is smooth. Pour into a dish lined with greaseproof paper. Cover & chill for at least 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: habanero pepper,ice cube,pesto sauce,thyme sprig,cooking barley,chili sauce,french bread
title: Lebanese Beef Stoup
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless top sirloin steaks or 2 lbs top round roast | 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking barley | 1 cup chili sauce | 1 cup spaghetti sauce, commercial or homemade | 2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 4 ounces store-bought pesto sauce | ice cube | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Cut into 6 pieces and rub with seasonings. Let stand at room temperature 2 hours or refrigerate 30 minutes. Place in a 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 quart slow cooker. Add all the remaining ingredients. Cover. Cook on low 3 hours. Turn meat into large skillet. Drain off any fat. Serve in soup bowls with crusty french bread.

Random Ingredients: pea,orange pepper,cherry,black bean,pesto sauce,vinegar,sunflower oil,red chili pepper
title: Aussie Pea, Pistou and Pistou Salad in a Jar
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pesto sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh orange pepper ( minced ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh red chili pepper ( minced ) | 1 medium red chili pepper ( minced ) | 100 g mixed baby peas ( frozen in accordance with packet instructions ) | 100 g black beans ( freshly cooked in accordance with packet instructions ) | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Prep and rinse peas. Remove the seeds and membrane from the chilli. Grind the chilli with the pesto, orange pepper, red chili pepper and chilli powder into a smooth paste. Heat the sunflower oil, and vinegar until warm and stir in the ground pesto mixture. Cook the peas until tender then drain in a colander. Mix well with the other pesto seasonings and place in a decorative jar with the peas. Leave in the fridge and shake well. Toss with the salad before serving.

Random Ingredients: ice water,white wine vinegar,peppercorn,stewing beef,chili garlic sauce,cumin seed,arrowroot,cream cheese
title: Beef and Cream Cheese Stew
ingredients: 2 teaspoons whole cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 3/4 cup ice water | 4 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 tablespoon arrowroot or 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 8 ounces stewing beef, cut in small pieces | 2 tablespoons peppercorns
instructions: Place the cumin seeds and vinegar in a dry non reactive saucepan over medium heat. Allow to toast for 1 minute. Add the chili and garlic sauce. Add water just before serving. Place the cream cheese and arrowroot in a medium bowl. Pour the cream and cream into the bowl and whisk until blended. Add half the beef and half the peppercorns. Pour into serving platter with the remaining beef, peppercorns and any remaining vinegar mixture. Serve with green beans and rice, if desired.

title: Easy Pavlova
ingredients: 1 lb heavy whipping cream | 4 teaspoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Bring cream to a boil in a large, heavy skillet over high heat. Stir confectioners' sugar into whipped cream until dissolved, about 1 minute. Slowly pour cream into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/4 inch star tip, and pipe cream into rounds on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in the preheated 325 degrees f oven until golden and beginning to wrinkle, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool to room temperature. Whip confectioners' sugar into warm whipped cream a few at a time, until thickened and the color is light. Spread meringue onto cooled meringue rounds, and refrigerate until cold, at least 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,rye bread,garlic clove,black pepper,coconut,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Cream Cheese and Garlic Bread Pies
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 2 garlic cloves, diced | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/4 cup sour condensed milk yogurt or 1/4 cup philadelphia cream cheese | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 8 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Lightly spray eight 1/2 cup ramekins or custard cups with nonstick spray. In medium saucepan, combine first 9 ingredients. Bring to a boil and cook about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: lime leaf,pimento olive,scallion,espresso,oatmeal,thai curry paste,poblano chile
title: Thai-Spiced Oatmeal With Pomegranate-Olive Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cilantro | 2 scallions, including green tops sliced thinly, green parts thinly sliced | 3 poblano chiles, cored, seeded, cut into 1-inch squares | 1/4 cup oatmeal, unsifted, toasted | 1 tablespoon instant espresso | 2 pomegranate-o-infused espresso beans, soaked for 12 to 15 minutes ( or 1 tsp. boiling water and 1/4 tsp. sugar ) | 1 lime leaf, cut into thin strips ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the cilantro, scallions, chiles and oatmeal in 1 to 2 tablespoons of brewed espresso, covered, stirring constantly, until the mixture is hot. Immediately transfer mixture to a blender. Grate the remaining 1/4 cup oatmeal on a large piece of wax paper, and pulse in the chipotle puree. Transfer to the skillet and add the remaining brewed espresso, 2 pomegranate seeds and 1/4 cup water. Stir gently to mix the ingredients in the skillet until everything is well blended. Garnish with lime slices and serve.

title: Fiesta Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried great northern beans, cleaned | 10 cups mixed frozen berries ( or 1 pound each frozen fruit and beans ) | 1 1/4 lbs dry lentils | 3 tablespoons lard or 3 tablespoons masa corn flour | 1 -2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( optional )
instructions: Place beans in large saucepan along with other ingredients. Bring to boil, cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer about 1 hour, stirring occasionally until beans are tender.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,lettuce,jicama,black olive,vanilla essence,egg noodle,club soda,cabbage
title: Jalapeno Bites
ingredients: 250 g egg noodles | 1/3 cup pickled cabbage, chopped finely | 1/2 cup jicama, chopped finely | 6 -8 black olives, chopped finely | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 12 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 cup chopped lettuce | club soda
instructions: Boil the noodles and jicama in lots of water until the noodles are cooked. Drain and cut into smaller bits. Mix with noodle, cabbage, olives and essence. Spray a little olive oil in a frying pan. Place half of the pastry sheets on the pan and brush with olive oil. Place the rest of the pastry sheets on top of it. Fold pastry over them and roll into long strips. Repeat until you have 5 strips. Heat a non stick pan and spray with pan spray. Place the pastry on a paper towel to blot off the extra oil and cook the strips until golden brown. Set aside. Fry the lettuce a couple minutes in the same pan you made the first pieces. Remove from pan and drain on an oven paper plate in the oven. Repeat until all 4 strips are cooked. Put the noodles back in the pan and mix with lettuce and a glass of club soda. Serve.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,farfalle pasta,pork shoulder,raspberry,onion soup mix
title: Slow Cooker Holiday Pork Pasta With Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb boneless pork shoulder | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/2 lb raspberries or 1/2 lb frozen raspberries | 2 cups hot cooked farfalle pasta
instructions: Remove fat from pork and cut pork into 1 inch cubes. Place pork into the slow cooker. In a medium bowl combine soup mix and egg substitute. Pour over pork and top with raspberries and season with salt and pepper to taste. Cook on high for 4 - 6 hours or on low for 8 to 10 hours. Turn crock pot to high setting and cook farfalle as directed on box.. Serve over hot cooked farfalle pasta.

Random Ingredients: chinese cabbage,rum,soya sauce,coriander,taco seasoning,egg wrap,phyllo dough,pork mince
title: Pork and Egg Rolls (Pies)
ingredients: 500 g ground lean pork mince | 150 g cabbage, finely chopped | 1 egg roll wrap ( egg white beaten with a little bit of water ) | 1 teaspoon dry soya sauce | 1 teaspoon dried coriander | 1/4 teaspoon chinese cabbage ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon chinese cabbage leaf, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce, to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon chinese spices ( aromat or anu ) | 1/4 teaspoon rum ( any ) | 1 slice coriander | 1 -3 teaspoon taco seasoning
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Use the back of a large spoon to flatten the mixture slightly. Divide meat into smallish balls and roll in the coconut oil mixture. Roll between your palms in egg white wash and coat with a few drops of coconut oil. Place on a baking sheet and bake for about 15 minutes. Meanwhile saute cabbage, adding herbs to the left over water and cooking liquid if required. Add soy sauce and heat through. Roll up and set aside on a baking tray. Take all the meat balls and roll in the coconut paste as it is done. In a separate pan fry the meat balls until dark. If using anu it is only necessary to drain oil. Pour the pan over the meat balls mix and place on a baking tray, cover with aluminium foil and leave for about 30 minutes. While still hot roll the egg roll parcels and place on the tray along with the meat balls. Add a little more oil. When oil has been in the pan, fry the egg rolls in the remaining oil on each side until golden. Serve with sauce or rice.

title: Finnish Lahmiya(Laos) Chicken Base
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup ground cardamom pod
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a sauce pan. Turn down the heat to medium and simmer until the gravy has reduced by about half. You could also stir occasionally. Serve hot.

title: Angel Hair With Chilies and Creamy Chicken
ingredients: 1 bag thin uncooked angel hair pasta ( about 12 oz. pasta ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup ( undiluted ) | 1 can chilies ( mild or hot-not quite, the heat depends on how hot you want it ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package. Drain, return to skillet. Add all ingredients, and heat to desired thickness.

title: Real Mexican Creamy Hot Pepper Ramekins
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 6 ounces self raising flour ( or breadcrumbs, and a little extra flour if they're too thick ) | 5 tablespoons sour cream, at room temperature | 2 fresh jalapeno peppers, deseeded and finely diced or 2 other peppers of your own choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Line a tray with baking paper leaving a little overhang to allow the hot pepper flavour to penetrate. Place the vegetable stock, flour and sour cream into a blender or processor and whiz to a fairly smooth puree. Add jalapeños and blend lightly to blend the hot pepper flavour and chill for a further 5 minutes. Grease 12 muffin tin and line bases with paper cases to make a circle shape, then spoon hot cream into centre of each. Place in a cool place and leave to set for 30 minutes or until set. Slice and serve whilst hot. I think it would be wonderful when eaten with a dollop or some chunky salsa fresca.

Random Ingredients: banana,turmeric powder,pepper sauce,fontina cheese,yellow tomato,flat leaf parsley,basil,rice wine
title: Yellow Spicy Tomato Breakfast Plate
ingredients: 4 medium yellow tomatoes | 1/4 cup fresh flat leaf parsley | 3 tablespoons basil | 5 tablespoons rice wine | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce ( such as tabasco or your favorite hot pepper sauce ) | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 125 g fontina cheese or 125 g provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/200c fan forced. Cut tops off tomatoes, leaving just a little of the base intact. Place on a baking tray. Place tomatoes in the oven for 20 minutes. Once cool, remove skin and slice, discarding the seeds and stems. Remove tomato flesh and cores. Wash dry and coarsely chop tomatoes. Strip leaves from parsley. Place all ingredients, except fontina or provolone cheese, into a food processor or blender and whiz until smooth. Add the fontina or provolone to the tomatoes and combine well. Spread tomato mixture on toasted plates or serving platter or serve on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,chicken stock,chili oil,bun,purpose flour,kosher salt black pepper
title: Mexican Fried Chicken on the BBQ
ingredients: 2 bunches cilantro | 8 12 slices of kosher salt-free black pepper grill chicken, skin and fat removed ( or chicken breasts, skinless ) | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 3 teaspoons chili oil ( preferably canola ) | 3 cups chicken stock | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Remove stems, seeds and membrane from cilantro. Tear large leaves off cilantro using kitchen shears. Place leaves on a platter and sprinkle with salt. Cover and keep warm. Heat grill pan over medium high heat. Arrange half the sliced chicken breast in pan and brush with chili oil. Cook 6 minutes and transfer to another platter. Repeat with remaining slices of chicken. When all of the chicken has been grilled, spread flour on a clean towel to remove as much flour as possible from chicken. Spread flour and chicken on towel. Sprinkle salt and pepper on chicken to taste. Wrap each chicken breast in a bun half and refrigerate until ready to use. Grill chicken for 2 minutes on each side, until cooked through and juices run clear. Top chicken with onions and salsa if desired. Note, you can also make a fried chicken by frying chicken in a non stick frying pan for about 5 minutes until lightly browned, flipping over, and flipping again once.

title: Stuffed Rice Balls
ingredients: 3/4 cup short grain rice | 1 cup watercress | 1/4 cup shredded coconut | 1/4 cup crumbled gorgonzola
instructions: Stir rice, watercress, coconut and gorgonzola together until thoroughly mixed.

Random Ingredients: ancho chilies,amarula cream liqueur,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,basmati rice,cinnamon,taco sauce,lasagna noodle
title: Chipotle-Ancho Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 8 ounces chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped | 1 tablespoon amarula cream liqueur | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce, from chipotle peppers and can | 1 tablespoon pure ancho chilies | 1/3 cup low-sodium taco sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Cook noodles according to pkg directions. Place noodles in a large bowl and set aside. Heat chilies and adobo sauce in a small saucepan. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 min, stirring occasionally. Pour hot sauce over noodles and toss. Add taco sauce and cook an additional 1 min, stir and serve.

title: Bhindi (East Indian Yoghurt Soup)
ingredients: 1 liter chicken stock or 1 liter vegetable stock | 4 green cardamom pods, powdered powdered | 1 tablespoon yoghurt
instructions: Put the chicken or vegetable stock in a pot and fill 2/3/3 cup water. Boil until it almost all evaporates leaving only a bit of water in it. Add in the cardamom powder. Bring to a boil and simmer with the lid on until the liquid has reduced a bit. Take a filter out of the pot and filter the remaining water. Pour this back into the pot and bring just to the top of the water. Stir well. Remove the lid. Sprinkle in the yoghurt and serve.

Random Ingredients: veal,plum tomato,hamburger bun,apple cider,chicken cutlet,lemon juice,cooking oil
title: Sauerkraut & Meatballs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 chicken cutlets, finely diced | 600 g plum tomatoes, finely chopped | 300 g ground veal | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons apple cider or 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 hamburger buns, toasted
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium high heat, add the chicken, tomatoes, veal and lemon juice. Cook, stirring until lightly browned. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly. Return the pan to the heat and add the cider or red wine vinegar. Cook, stirring, until the mixture thickens. Cut the hamburger buns into halves, cut the halves in half. Place half the meat mixture on the bottom half of the bun and top with the remaining meat mixture, making sure to cover it entirely. Serve with mustard or horseradish on the side.

title: Toffee Biscuits
ingredients: 2 lbs leftover hash brown potatoes, shredded ( i use leftover potato grated ) | 1/2 cup pastry flour ( all purpose flour can be used if required for rolling out pastry dough )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line 9x13 inch baking tin with parchment. In a large bowl, combine potatoes and flour. Shape dough into 2 balls and place 1/2 inch apart on prepared baking tin. Bake for 30 minutes, until edges are golden and crispy. Remove from oven, then cool on wire racks for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,ramen noodle,flour tortilla,white bread flour,black vinegar
title: Quick Noodle Samosas
ingredients: 2 slices white bread flour | 2 tablespoons flour | 4 large eggs | 1 package top ramen noodles, broken apart | 1 can tomato puree | 1 1/2 cups white bread flour
instructions: Put 1 cup white bread flour and 2 tablespoons flour in a mixing bowl and make a well in the center. Break 2 eggs in to the well. Add 2 tablespoons roen noodle juice. Mix with your fingers until evenly moist. Put into a warm bowl or into a zip lock bag and let cool for 15 minutes. Dredge each side of the bag into one of the following, 1 1/2 cup of the white bread flour, 1/2 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon olive oil. Roll the bag around, tucking in any excess flour. Heat a little oil on medium heat, then turn the heat right down. When the oil is heated up to medium or it will sizzle at the edge. Make sure you don't burn the outside of the bag. You want them to be pretty much crispy. It will take about 10 to 12 seconds on each side. Put 2 to 3 bagels into the heated oil and cook for about 2 or 3 more minutes, until the bagels are lightly browned and slightly crispy. Remove from the pan, then with a fork, break through the bagels into shreds and place in a medium bowl. In the same pan saute a little more oil and add 1 1/2 cups tomato puree and bring to boil for about 2 or 3 minutes so it gets a little thinner. Once it reduces, remove from the heat. Coat the tortilla strips with the sauce. Garnish with sour cream and serve with a little jalapeno if you want.

title: Baked Beef Steak Strips
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb beef stew meat, chopped | 1 envelope grenadine, flavoring ( not powdered ) | 1/2 cup suet ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. In a bowl mix all ingredients with hands until well blended. Pour mix into a 9 x 9 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 1 1/4 hours, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,mango chutney,barbecue sauce,chile pepper,turmeric,beef bouillon cube,sherry
title: Smothered Mangoes
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground beef round | 1 can tomato juice | 1 cup chopped fresh mango chutney | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh chile peppers | 1 tablespoon barbeque sauce | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 3 1/2 or 4 quart slow cooker with aluminum foil. Line the inside of the meat crock with one layer of foil. Mix the ground beef, tomato juice, mango chutney, ground chile peppers, barbeque sauce, turmeric, and bouillon cube together in a mixing bowl. Gently pack mixture into the slow cooker. Top with the remaining foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature registers 160 degrees f, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Navy Beans and Cinnamon With Amaretti
ingredients: 2 cups dried navy beans | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 -2 tablespoon sweet paprika ( try penzey's ) | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup amaretti ( miniature mini cookies )
instructions: Rinse the navy beans. Put 1 cup of the beans and all other ingredients in a pan. Cover and simmer on low until beans are tender, about 1 hour. Towards the end of cooking, stir occasionally to prevent beans burning. The idea is to mash the beans slightly and stir them a few times to prevent sticking.. You can add about 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoons of water to help mash. Serve with bread slices, crackers, or a fresh crusty bread loaf.

title: Penne With Onions and Honey (Penne With Onions)
ingredients: 8 -9 cups cooked penne ( depending on type of servings ) | 2 vidalia onions, chopped | 1/4 - 1/3 cup honey ( to taste )
instructions: In a large pot cook pasta to your taste then drain. Heat the chopped onion and honey to boiling point in a large frying pan on med. Heat until onions are golden brown. Then add the cooked penne to onions & allow to cook. When finished adding the pasta, add salt to taste as this will bring out more of a serum in the onions & pasta. Enjoy.

title: Cabbage and Apricots Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons abobo seasoning, sauce concentrate | 1 lb cabbage leaf | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, diced | 2 tablespoons smoked ham or 2 tablespoons ham, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried shiitake mushroom, thinly sliced | sifted cottage cheese
instructions: Combine marinade and cheese in a small bowl. Place cabbage in a baking dish.

Random Ingredients: pear,kosher salt,ice,wheat flour tortilla,romaine lettuce,extra tofu,grain white rice
title: Pear Wrapped Wrapped Tofu Wraps
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, drained | 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1/4 cup light extra-virgin olive oil or 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | kosher salt, to taste | 3 cups shredded romaine lettuce, preferably romaine | 1/4 ripe pear, peeled, halved and sliced into small wedges | 8 large whole wheat flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Slice the tofu into 1/4 inch thick x 1/4 inch half moons. Drain the tofu on a paper towel lined plate and squeeze out all excess water. Cut tofu into strips about 1/8 inch thick and divide the pieces among tortillas. Roll up the tortillas and place on baking sheet. Brush with a little olive oil and bake for 7 minutes or until crisp and browned. Remove to a plate. Meanwhile, prepare the garnishes. To make a dipping sauce, mix the extra virgin olive oil, salt and rice. Spread rice on the center of each tortilla. Place a tofu slice on the rice and then spoon on the rice mixture and then drizzle over the pear wedges and serve.

title: Shrimp, Squash, and Shrimp on the Barbie
ingredients: 1/4 lb uncooked shrimp, peeled | 6 large thin slices squash or 6 large littleneck shrimp, about 1/4 inch thick, of any size
instructions: Arrange the shrimp on a small square of double foil. Sprinkle with the shrimps as many as will fit loosely. Set a piece of squash or littleneck shrimp on top of the shrimp, pressing them against the squash lightly. Top with several large spoonfuls of bottled clam juice or red wine.

title: Peanut Butter Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin, sliced ( or beef tenderloin cut in 2-inch cubes ) | 1 can of whole chunky peanut sauce ( i prefer chunky peanut sauce ) | 1 cup thick & chunky peanut butter ( i use the creamy peanut butter ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, or to taste | 1 teaspoon salt, or to taste
instructions: Cook beef cubes in peanut sauce in a skillet over medium high heat, stirring to cook all sides. Remove from heat. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients, including rosemary. Heat to boiling, then lower heat. Cover and simmer for at least 30 minutes, or up to an hour, stirring frequently.

title: Savory Caribbean Vegetables
ingredients: 1 can rotel | 1 can pumpkin | 2 large baby carrots | 1 can red bell peppers | 1 package macaroni
instructions: Drain rotel, and add carrots, red peppers and pumpkin. Add macaroni to skillet. Simmer on low heat for 30 minutes, or overnight if possible.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,liquid seasoning,breadcrumb,orange peel,yellow squash,french,red chili pepper
title: Hot Mexican Pork Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs pork shoulder or 1 1/2-2 lbs boneless pork butt | 1 -2 teaspoon liquid seasoning, for meat | 1 teaspoon orange peel | 1 pinch of grated red chili pepper or 1 pinch green chili pepper | sourdough french roll ( optional ) | dry breadcrumbs | 1 yellow squash
instructions: Slice the meat against the grain into very thin pieces about about 1 inch diameter and 1/4 inch thick. Marinate in the liquid seasoning for several hours or leave in fridge. Thread the meat onto skewers starting with the long side on the skewer in opposite directions. Broil or grill to your liking. I recommend using a metal broiler basket for the best results. The meat will take approximately 15 to 20 minutes to cook. Serve hot with your favorite mexican dish.

title: Cran-Gruyere Gratin
ingredients: 1/2 cup cranberries | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine the cranberries and cheese in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Spread the mixture in a gratin dish and bake in a preheated oven about 20 minutes, or until set.

title: A Unique Mac 'n' Cheese
ingredients: 4 cups cooked mac 'n' cheese | 1 cup chopped canned peaches | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaf | 2 tablespoons sliced walnuts | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove 1 cup of cheese from bag and stir in olives, basil, basil and walnuts. Spread 1/4 cup of hot sauce on the bottom of an oven proof casserole dish. Spread 1/4 cup of hot sauce on the outside of dish, then place the remaining cup of cheese and olives and sprinkle with 1/8 teaspoon of cayenne pepper. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Chile-Biscotti
ingredients: 5 serrano chilies, seeded and halved | 1/4 cup masa harina | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside. Place the chiles in a bowl with 1/4 cup warm water.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,cauliflower,rye bread,fennel bulb,oregano leaf
title: Quick and Easy Grilled Cauliflower (Swiss Chard) Salad
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into 1/2- to 1-inch squares and cut into 1- 1-inch florets | 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 head fennel bulb, thinly sliced on the diagonal | 2 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet sprayed lightly with nonstick cooking spray, cook cauliflower in the vinegar for 2 to 3 minutes or until tender crisp. Remove from heat and stir in oregano. Place the fennel on the toast. Scatter with the cauliflower. Drizzle with some of the sauce.

Random Ingredients: vegetable seasoning,taco seasoning,plum tomato,red cabbage,bay leaf
title: Spinach Cabbage Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, shredded | 1 can plum tomatoes, drained | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 packet dry taco seasoning | 1 bay leaf | 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable seasoning
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the cabbage, tomatoes, taco seasoning, and dry taco seasoning. Place bay leaf in a teflon coated skillet over medium high heat. Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low.

title: Refreshing Beets With Strawberries and Parmigiano Cheese
ingredients: 1 can thin sliced beets | 1 container fresh strawberries | 1/3 cup shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh strawberries
instructions: Cut stem out beets and scrub well. Wash and dry beets, cut in half lengthwise and sprinkle each with 1/4 cup of shaved parmigiano. Place 2 halves of the beet halves on each of the beets, cut side down. Sprinkle each with about 1/2 teaspoons of shaved parmigiano and press into the beets. Place 1 strawberry half on a beet halves, with the other half on the beet.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,chicken stock,english cucumber,ancho chilies,chicken bouillon cube,baby portabella mushroom,beer
title: Chicken and Black-Eyed Peas & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 english cucumber, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch wide slices | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 can black-eyed peas | 1/4 cup fresh beer | 2 dried ancho chilies, seeded and crushed | 1/2 - 1 lb baby portabella mushrooms
instructions: In a small saucepan or dutch oven, combine the stock and bouillon cube. Bring to a simmer and immediately add the green and black eyed peas. Reduce the heat and simmer for 2 minutes or until the beans are fully cooked and the liquid has almost all evaporated. Add the beer and chili and cook until liquid has reduced. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Garnish with the cukes, mushrooms, and/or a dollop of sour cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,polenta,shaoxing wine,catfish fillet,coriander powder,shrimp paste
title: Green Curry Catfish
ingredients: 1 package polenta | 1 tablespoon whole coriander powder | 1 teaspoon shaoxing wine | 1/4 teaspoon shrimp paste | 2 green curry paste | 1 lb catfish fillet
instructions: Slice fillets into 1/8 inch pieces across the width and into 2 inch pieces. In a large nonstick skillet or wok, heat shao hsing and wine over high heat. When the shao hsing boils, add fish and green curry paste. Stir and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Stirring, add the fish and continue cooking for 3 - 5 minutes. Serve hot on rice with red chilli.

title: L'orange-Pear Compote (Marinara)
ingredients: 1 large ripe pear | 1 teaspoon orange zest
instructions: Peel, core & dice the pear into 1/2 inch chunks. Place the pears in a large pot over moderate heat & add 1/2 teaspoons water. Bring to a boil & simmer gently until the pears have softened, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from the heat & stir in the orange zest, pour the compote into an oven proof serving dish & chill for at least 1 hour before serving. Serves note, to remove the seeds from the orange, cut off the top skin, but use a sharp knife to slice the peel off a thin layer of membrane at the top end of the pear. This will give the compote a striped effect & adds enormously to the flavour of the dish. To serve, pour compote into wine glasses with a spoon & serve straight from the pan. Variation, substitute 1 tsp ground cinnamon for the orange zest.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,mint sprig,rice,chicken breast half,veal
title: Pate'ya Bi Lahanas
ingredients: 1/4 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast halves cut into bite-size pieces | 1/2 pound boneless veal cut into bite-size pieces | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon rice, or as needed | 2 large mint sprigs, stemmed and cut into 1/4-inch-thick wedges
instructions: Place chicken, veal, brown sugar, and rice into a large skillet. Cook over high heat until mixture begins to foam. Reduce heat to low.

title: Beef, Spinach, Macaroni Soup
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut in small chunks ( you may use chuck ) | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1/8 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/8 teaspoon ground chipotle powder | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf, crushed | 1 lb fresh spinach | 1/2 lb macaroni
instructions: In large soup pot, mix all ingredients except tomatoes. Simmer 15 minutes on very low heat, stirring often. Stir into soup and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and spinach and simmer 8 - 10 minutes. Serve with sliced baguette or french bread.

title: Spicy Japanese Beet Slices
ingredients: 1 beet | 3 dried chinese mushrooms, soaked in water until softened, then drained | 30 g chinese mushrooms, sliced into 1 cm thick half-round slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Halve each beet lengthways. Peel away the top and bottom root, and cut into slices. Place the slices into a baking tin and bake for 45 mins, then turn and bake for a further 10 - 15 mins until the beet slices have browned slightly. Set aside and keep warm. Place the soaked mushrooms into a food processor with 2/3 cup water and blitz for 30 secs or until finely chopped. Add the mushrooms and puree in batches until mixture forms a rough paste. Spread the beet mixture over the top of the beet slices, sprinkle with the ginegar and grate it in to the beet mixture to serve.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,hazelnut,red pepper flake,chorizo sausage,shallot,cauliflower,self rising flour,red chile pepper
title: Hazelnut Sausages With Chorizo Fritters
ingredients: 3 links chorizo sausage | 2 shallots, chopped | 2 tablespoons ground hazelnuts, divided | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried crushed red chile pepper | 1 pinch red pepper flakes, or to taste | 2 cups cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Cook and stir chorizo or turkey sausage links in a skillet on medium high heat until evenly browned, about 5 minutes. Set aside as needed. Spread ground hazelnuts in a small plate. Place flour, baking powder, chile pepper flakes, and red pepper flakes in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: ice cream,salmon fillet,cardamom powder,margarine,walnut,taco seasoning mix
title: Crispy Walnut-Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 16 ounces salmon fillets ( boneless, skinless ) | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 2/3 cup walnuts | 1/4 cup margarine | 1/4 cup unsalted margarine | 3/4 cup ice cream ( i use the fat free ones ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt or 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a baking dish and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Remove salmon fillets from marinade and place on a rack over a baking sheet. Bake at 425 degrees f for approximately 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. While the salmon is cooking make the sauce. Combine ingredients for the sauce except for the fish. Heat butter, margarine and ice cream in a saucepan. Turn the heat on the sauce just a little bit over a medium heat and stir until butter melts and smooth. Add fish, season with cardamom powder if desired and coat well. Serve with rice.

title: Grilled Yellow Squash With Chocloate
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light molasses | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped chocloat american cheese | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped celery | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped yellow squash | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped crispy toasted chocolate
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium sized bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. For each round, cut into 8 triangles. Place a slice of toasted chocolate onto each square. Grill for about 1 minute. Serve.

title: Irish Goose
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh asparagus | 6 hardboiled egg yolks | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 3 ounces ginger beer | fresh sage leaf
instructions: Cut the asparagus into 1 inch pieces and boil until tender.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,whipping cream,chicken leg,green pea,fire tomato,coffee
title: Spanish Chicken Legs and Peas
ingredients: 6 chicken legs, thigh, and drumsticks, trimmed | 4 ounces coffee or 4 ounces vodka | 3 ounces whipping cream | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1 cup frozen green pea ( i prefer fresh ) | 1 small diced fire-roasted tomatoes, seeded and chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for chicken in a large pot and cook slowly for 1 - 1½ hours, skimming fat as required. Remove chicken and vegetables, reserving sauce, and return pot to fire. Add reserved sauce and cook on low heat for about 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Serve with white rice.

title: Baked Chicken Breast Risotto
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups uncooked arborio rice | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place each ingredient in a zipper bag and shake to thoroughly coat the chicken pieces with the mixture. Arrange the chicken in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center, 15 to 20 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,rum,red chile,lea perrins worcestershire sauce,semolina
title: Spicy Semolina and Peppercorn Candy
ingredients: 12 ounces semolina | 6 ounces palm sugar or 6 ounces turbinado sugar | 4 ounces lea & perrins worcestershire sauce | 2 ounces spay red chile | 2 ounces rum ( optional )
instructions: In a heavy bottomed pan, heat the sugar, butter and chile until the sugar melts, but do not burn. Stir frequently, as it will make it quite bitter. Turn the heat down and continue to stir until the mixture becomes dark brown. Take off the heat. Add the semolina and give it a few stirs before continuing to stir until all the grains are mixed in well. Stir in the rum if using, and sprinkle the rum around the outside of the pan and on top of the semolina. Keep stirring as the mixture will harden quickly. Turn the heat back up, and boil rapidly for 10 minutes. Serve the snack immediately, with warm airy coffee.

title: Sushi Crab
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds dungeness crabs, cleaned if large | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup golden raisins, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Wash the crabs well, and pat dry. Scrape the insides into a large bowl. Slice the body into rings. Mix the crab, rice wine vinegar, and raisins together in a bowl. Let marinate in the refrigerator at least 3 hours, preferably overnight. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Arrange the crab rings in the boiling water, and remove from the heat. Place a large serving plate on top of the crab, and hold it slightly over the bowl so the crab can breath easy. Slice the crab into strips, and serve warm. Variation, stir together 1/4 cup hot pepper sauce, 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar, and 1/2 teaspoon sugar in a small bowl to make a dipping sauce.

title: Coconut Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1 package cannellini beans, undrained | 3 pounds boneless chicken breasts, cut into cubes | 1 cup coconut cream | 3 cups chicken broth
instructions: Put the cannellini beans into a large pot, pour in enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Boil for about 20 minutes, drain, and let stand for about 10 minutes to dry out some of the liquid. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken breasts in a large casserole dish or roasting pan. Spread coconut cream evenly over the chicken.

title: Beets With Beef for Two!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck roast | 1 1/2 lbs beetroots, fresh ( about 2 or 3 large ) | 4 tablespoons double cream | 1 lb pasta
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f peel beets and halve lengthwise. Wash well. Cut into chunks about 1/4”. Cook in salted water for 20 minutes until tender. Drain, and slice. Add cream and heat through. Cook pasta in boiling salted water until tender. Drain. Combine beef, beetroot, cooked pasta and sauce. Place in a buttered oven proof dish with beets on top. Cover and bake, covered, for one hour. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes longer, or until beef is browned and sauce is bubbling.

title: Oyako Donburi - Japanese Donburi Balls  Omelette
ingredients: 1/4 cup fat, clarified butter ( gyoza ) | 2 tablespoons lard ( gyoza ) | 2 cups oatmeal ( plain old-fashioned ) | 1/3 cup milk chocolate ( semisweet or dark, chopped ) | 3 tablespoons dashi stock | 12 fresh basil leaves
instructions: Heat the clarified butter and gyoza in a frying pan over a medium heat. Add both, stirring and cooking until the gyoza is melted, 3 - 5 minute add the oatmeal and stir until the oatmeal is absorbed and the oatmeal is lightly toasted in color. Add the stock, chopped chocolate and lime zest, stirring to combine. Cook for 2 minutes, remove from heat and allow to cool on a cookie sheet or a plate. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving, although up to six hours is preferred, chilling can hasten the cooking of the omelette. Use 1 tblsp of the melted gyoza in the middle of a piece of toasted bread and break the bread into 3 - 4 chunks. Serve with the basil and a dollop of oatmeal. Enjoy.

title: Cashew Nuts With Irish Cream
ingredients: 2 cups cashews | 1/2 cup frozen bamboo shoot, thawed | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 4 fluid ounces irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. Spread cashews onto a rimmed baking sheet and toast until golden, stirring regularly, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. When cashews are cool, remove from cashew bag, leaving 1/2 inch of headspace. Rinse the cashews in a large pot of boiling, salted water, transfer to a bowl, and let cool to room temperature. Rinse the bamboo shoots under cold water and drain. Place in a small bowl and cover with boiling water. Let sit for 30 seconds, then drain the water and remove the shoots from the skin. Pat the skins dry. In a food processor, combine the cashews, cashews, bamboo shoots, worcestershire sauce, and irish cream and process until the mixture is creamy and smooth but not smooth. Place in a large bowl and serve.

title: Bombay Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 cup instant mashed potatoes chip ( potato flour ) | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds
instructions: In a medium size bowl, place mashed potatoes, mustard and mustard seeds. Mix until well blended. You may need to adjust the amount of potato flour in with the amounts of potato and mustard seeds to get the right mixture, adding more or less if desired. Spread mixture into a lightly greased casserole dish. Cover and bake at 400 degrees for 7 to 9 minutes.

title: Applesauce Ham Pies
ingredients: 12 ounces applesauce ( unsweetened ) | 2 cups cake flour | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs serrano ham ( or other lean cured ham, cut into squares ) | soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Use 1 teaspoon of batter per pie. Spray or fry your pies on a preheated grill until the bottoms just start to brown. Turn and bake for 15 minutes. Place on a warm cookie sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown and heated through.

title: Spanish Seasoning Mix for Kazakh Fowl
ingredients: 3 -4 green cardamom pods | 24 -25 leaves fresh thyme
instructions: Place all ingredients into the jar with the cardomom pods and shake well until all spice has been incorporated into oil. Will keep for up to 5 days in the refrigerator.

title: Kielbasa
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 2 cloves garlic paste ( see kielbasa garlic paste ) | 3/4 lb ground veal | 3/4 cup boursin cheese, shredded | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Cut wings in half from tips. Cut each wing in half again from tips to tips, leaving the tips open a little. Preheat oven to 450°f. Rub garlic paste all over meat. In a large bowl, knead meat with veal, then mix in cheese and cayenne pepper. Place meat on oiled rack of a roasting pan that has been lined with foil. Roast, turning as needed until meat is tender, about 1 hour 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,beef sirloin steak,horseradish,salt black pepper,tart apple
title: Apple-Mountain Beef Steak
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared horseradish, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin steaks, 1 inch thick | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a small bowl combine the horseradish and thyme. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Spray a large nonstick skillet or griddle with nonstick spray. Set over medium high heat. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper and turn once. Remove beef from heat and brush with horseradish mixture. Transfer sirloin steaks to a plate and cover with foil. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add steaks and cook for 4 minutes per side or until desired doneness. Cut each steak diagonally across the grain in 1/2 inch thick slices. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: wheat hamburger bun,anchovy paste,italian tomato,chicken broth,pumpkin seed,mayonnaise,peanut,cocoa powder
title: Pumpkin Seed French Toast With Italian Tomatoes and Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 2 italian tomatoes, sliced ( or 1 whole pkg ) | 1/3 cup fat-free chicken broth ( or 1/4 cup fat-free vegetable broth ) | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste ( you can sub sambal oelek, a spicy paste that makes it spreadable ) or 1 tablespoon anchovy paste, drained and finely chopped ( you can sub sambal oelek, a spicy paste that makes it spreadable ) | 2 tablespoons fat-free mayonnaise ( i used low fat, light ) | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons toasted shelled crushed peanuts | 4 whole wheat hamburger buns, toasted | 1/2 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Toast the bread if you prefer, in a shallow bowl, stir together the mayo and cocoa powder to make the sauce. Spread the mayo onto the toasted slices of toast, then top with the drained tomatoes. Top each with a few spoonfuls of the the sauce and spread evenly. Top with the nuts. Drizzle the remaining sauce and cocoa over the top and serve. Yum.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,banana,raspberry,black tea leaf,french bread,lime,green olive,broccoli floret
title: Thai Black Tea Bananas With Broccoli and Strawberry-Lime Salsa
ingredients: 4 tablespoons black tea leaves | 3/4 cup fresh broccoli florets or 3/4 cup frozen broccoli florets | 2 tablespoons fresh sliced bananas | 3 tablespoons sliced green olives | 1/4 cup chopped fresh raspberries | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped red pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons fresh lime rind, finely shredded | 4 slices crusty french bread, toasted or 4 pieces rustic rustic country bread, cut diagonally 1-inch thick
instructions: Preheat the broiler and set a rack 6 inches from the heat. In a small bowl, mix 3 tablespoons of the tea with the broccoli florets. Brush the vegetables with 1/2 tablespoon of the tea mixture. Arrange the bananas on a baking sheet. Broil 15 minutes. Turn the bananas and broil 2 minutes until lightly browned and tender. Remove from the oven or broiler. Top the bananas with remaining ingredients. Serve at once.

title: Noodles With Japanese Eggplant (Eggplant)
ingredients: 1 japanese eggplant, sliced | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 1/4 cup molasses | 8 ounces sweet chinese noodles, cooked
instructions: Place whole eggplant into a bowl with the lemon juice. Add rosemary, molasses and hot water to cover. Let sit for 10 minutes. Drain eggplant and arrange on a serving platter. Cover and keep chilled. Add noodles to sauce and remove rosemary and lemon. Place in a serving dish and garnish with fresh rosemary.

title: Crock Pot Swiss Onion and Lime Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 cup swiss cheese, grated ( about 4 ounces ) | 3/4 cup unsalted dry breadcrumbs, soft bread | 1/4 cup granulated sugar | 2 limes, juiced | 1/2 cup beef bouillon, packed | 3 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Combine cheese, bread crumbs, sugar, lime juice, bouillon and lime juice in large bowl. Add wet ingredients to cheese mixture. Stir just enough to combine. Using 2 forks, mix until all mixture is combined. Shape into 1 1/2 inch meatballs. Put on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. You may wish to stir once or twice during cooking time.

title: Irish Whiskey Lime Soda Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 4 tablespoons irish whiskey
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Combine dry ingredients in large bowl. Pour liqueur over all. Mix with spoon until the mixture resembles a rough ball. Turn onto a lightly floured board and knead gently 5 times. Place dough on a lightly buttered oven tray, lightly floured. Bake in a preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, until puffed and golden. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,pimento olive,ciabatta,virgin olive oil,chili pepper flake,chicken breast
title: Peruvian Sopaipillas
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1/2 cup cornflour | 1/2 cup virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons fresh pimento stuffed olives, chopped | ciabatta
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c spread chicken breast fillets on a baking tray and brush liberally with a little oil. Sprinkle with chilli flakes, pour 1 tablespoon of oil over, and bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through. Meanwhile, combine corn flour with a little water and add to the remaining oil in a jug. Stir until thick. Add olives and chili pepper flakes and heat through. Cut the bread into 2 cm slices and dip into the corn flour mixture. Place on serving plates and top with chicken.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,vanilla extract,cocoa,green enchilada sauce,pork loin,soymilk,meat,salt
title: Chile Verde (Chile Pork) Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 12 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and chopped | 2 lbs ground pork loin | 3 cups soymilk | 4 tablespoons cocoa | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Place pork, chiles, soy milk, cocoa, salt, and vanilla in a blender and puree until smooth. Pour into 1 - 6 quart enchiladas and simmer over medium low heat until ready to serve. To freeze, cover enchiladas with plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Bring to a boil a large pot of water, simmer until thawed, about 30 minutes, depending on firmness of beans. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. Heat 2 tablespoons cocoa in a saucepan over medium heat and stir in remaining 1/2 cup cocoa. Pour into a shallow baking dish. Place enchilada shells on the cocoa and cover with a towel. Freeze until solid, at least 2 hours. Use a slotted spoon to remove shells from frozen water. Discard any remaining shells. To serve, reheat the enchilada sauce over low heat in a saucepan. Serve enchiladas with sauce.

title: Baileys Eggs
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 3 ounces baileys irish cream ( approx ) | 4 cardamom pods
instructions: Peel the eggs, put their shells side by side in a large bowl. Peel if desired. Halve the yolks and scoop the whites into the egg yolks as gently as possible. Beat the egg whites until they are thick and glossy and fold them in. Gently stir the egg yolks into the egg whites. Pour the baileys into a large, clean jar and cover immediately with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for up to two weeks. When ready to serve, pour the mixture into the egg whites and gently stir well. If the mixture is too thick, stir in a little water. Chill at least for a couple of hours. When ready to serve, shake the jar of ingredients to ensure that all of the egg yolks are squeezed. Sprinkle a handful of the mixture into each egg white. Gently stir the egg whites, taking care not to break them into stiff peaks.

title: Red Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar sweet red chili peppers | 1 bottle pineapple juice
instructions: Place chilies in a sauce pan and fill with enough water to cover all of them. Bring to a boil and boil for three minutes. Remove the chili peppers from the water. Using a slotted spoon, remove the chilies from the water and place in a bowl. Reserve the water. Place all of the remaining ingredients in a pan and heat over medium to medium high heat. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Lebanese Dhal
ingredients: 1 cup dried chili sauce | 1/2 lb brown lentils
instructions: Soak the lentils in warm water for 2 - 2 1/2 hours, or until soft and mushy enough to work with. Drain. Place lentils and chili sauce in blender or food processor, and pulse until smooth. Add more water if consistency is too thick. Store in covered glass container at room temperature. Makes about 2 cups.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,sourdough bread,coffee granule,italian seasoning,oil,ancho chile powder,walnut oil
title: Quick Chili Oil
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coffee granules | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon oil | 1 teaspoon walnut oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili bean paste or 1 1/2 teaspoons soybean oil | 1 dash italian seasoning | 3 slices sourdough bread, toasted
instructions: Mix coffee granules, chili powder, stock, oil, walnut oil& italian seasoning. Heat to boiling & simmer for 1 minutes. Add soup, stir until boiling. Add bread & enjoy.

title: Beef Belly Loaf
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces active dry yeast | 1 pinch sugar syrup ( sugar free ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 4 1/4 cups lbs bottom round roast, cut in half | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, sprinkle dry yeast with sugar and dissolve. Stir in garlic and balsamic vinegar. Place meat into greased container, cover and let rise for approximately 1 hour in a warm place. Punch down meat. Roll into 9 x 11 inch rectangle and cut into 24 equal pieces. Place in a bowl, coat with marinade. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 30 minutes. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until meat temperature reaches 160 degrees. Let stand 10 minutes prior removing from oven.

title: Carrabba's Famous Queso Fundido
ingredients: 1 pint tomato sauce with mushrooms, chopped fine | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: In bowl mix all ingredients and enjoy.

title: Granola® Garnola’s Crumb Mix
ingredients: 20 ounces peeled and trimmed parsnips | 1/2 cup dry graham cracker crumbs | 10 ounces olive, drained, halved
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the parsnip with the graham cracker crumbs. Stir in the olive halves. Drop by heaping tablespoons onto a greased baking sheet. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Remove from sheet and cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Bengali Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 2/3 cup catsup, your favourite kind | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds ( optional )
instructions: Place sugar in a small bowl, put in the catsup and fenugreek. Sprinkle on the remaining fenugreek seeds, if desired.

Random Ingredients: black olive,beer,water,garam masala powder,black tea,poppy seed,yellow onion,sausage
title: Oaxacan Spiced Sausages
ingredients: 1/2 cup beer, mexican style dark | 4 teaspoons poppy seeds | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 teaspoon black tea, powder ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons sausages, cut into thin julienne | 1 yellow onion, cut into thin julienne slices | 1 teaspoon water | 12 black olives, pitted and sliced or 24 whole black olives
instructions: Pour beer into small bowl. Add poppy seeds, masala powder and black tea powder. Mix well to mix. Add sausage. Stir to coat lightly in mixture. Let stand 5 minutes. Spoon mixture onto skewers that have been soaked in water for at least 20 minutes, preferably an hour, in an air tight container. Arrange in the centre of pre heated grill. Barbecue over medium hot heat, turning frequently, until sausage is cooked. Garnish with white onion slices and olives. Serve in warmed pita bread wedges or on bread pieces with warm spiced yogurt and salsa. A side dish of greek yogurt is also very nice.

Random Ingredients: white bread,vanilla extract,feta cheese,farfalle pasta,turmeric,stewing beef,cumin powder
title: Middle Eastern-Style Macaroni and Beef
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef or 1 lb flank steak | 1 box farfalle pasta or ( 16 ounce ) box ziti rigati ( 1 lb ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 slice white bread, toasted | 1/2 - 2/3 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°f. Lightly oil a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a large skillet or wok heat up the meat until the outside is browned and crumbly. Add the beef and brown the meat on all sides. If the beef does not brown at all, drain well. Drain any excess oil if necessary. Season with the turmeric, cumin, vanilla extract and bread. Cover and cook about 10 minutes, until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle on the feta cheese and stir, cooking about 5 minutes. If the dish is dry, add about 2/3 cup water and cook one minute or two longer. Serve over your favourite cooked pasta.

title: Ragu Macaroni & Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground round | 1 jar pasta sauce
instructions: Brown meat in frying pan. Add sauce and simmer for half an hour. Serve over noodles/rice.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,espresso coffee,ginger paste,dijon mustard,lime juice zest,prawn,beef broth
title: Beef and Prawns in Spicy Espresso
ingredients: 500 g prawns, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons lime juice and zest, from 2-3 limes | 1 tablespoon instant espresso coffee | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon ginger paste, in paste | 600 ml beef broth | 2 tablespoons fresh broccoli, chopped, to garnish
instructions: Place prawns in a bowl and add lime juice, zest, espresso and dijon, and mash well. Heat your wok over high heat. Add ginger paste, stir fry for 30 seconds and add the sizzling broth. Add the beef and prawns. Cover, and cook for 20 minutes or until prawns are cooked through. Sprinkle with chopped broccoli and serve immediately, garnished with chopped mint leaves and serve with crusty french bread.

title: Apple Cider Vinegar Chips
ingredients: 8 ounces tortilla chips | 1 apple, peeled, cored, and sliced | 2 cups apple juice | 2 tablespoons grated fresh chives
instructions: Arrange about 1/4 cup chips on a plate. Over medium heat, combine the apple, cider vinegar, and chives.

Random Ingredients: wheat tortilla,yogurt,cajun seasoning,crisp bacon,bean,yellow squash,sea salt
title: Warm Curried Bean Wrap
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole wheat tortillas | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1/2 cup crisp bacon, diced | 1/2 cup yellow squash, diced | 1/2 cup diced mixed beans
instructions: Mix together the yogurt, salt, cajun seasoning, bacon, yellow squash, and mixed beans. Spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the mixture on each tortilla. Wrap tightly in plastic. Serve warm.

title: Traditional Moroccan Sifted Pancake
ingredients: 1 shallot | 1 1/2 cups sorghum flour
instructions: Prepare your flour and set aside in a mixing bowl. Clean and peel the shallot. Dice it to a paste with a mortar. Take a small mixing bowl and add the paste to it. Add the sorghum flour gradually, until everything is fully incorporated into a smooth sauce. The sauce will be very thick, and will be thinner at the end of the mixing process. Heat over low heat while stirring, ensuring that you do not burn the mixture. When the mixture bubbles and the top of the mixing bowl, it is ready to ladle over your favorite vegetable or fruit dish.

title: Spiced Rum Balls (Aka Mojito)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons madras curry powder | 2 inches rum
instructions: Simply grind the curry powder in an electric spice grinder, then mix both ingredients together well. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,mint,caster sugar,black pepper,goat cheese,green chili,snow pea pod
title: Wild Pea Pods (Wild Mushroom or Grilled Cheese Salad)
ingredients: 1 kg green chili | 3 -4 tablespoons goat cheese | 3 -4 tablespoons gorgonzola cheese | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 350 g wild mushroom or 350 g english pea pods, trimmed | fresh mint ( to garnish )
instructions: To prepare the green chilli, slit the stem and scrape out the seeds, removing the seeds from the chillies if possible. Roughly chop the chillies. In a large bowl, mash the goat cheese with a fork. Add the chillies, gorgonzola cheese, pepper and sugar and mix well. Gently fold in the chilli seeds. Place the mixed leaves on to a serving plate and decorate with edible flowers. To make the puddings, place the mushrooms in a clean, dry frying pan, sprinkle with a little oil and sauté gently for about 5 minutes. Place on to a serving plate and slice thinly then divide among serving plates and garnish with a sprig of mint.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,vegetable oil,cayenne pepper
title: Chinese Five-Spice Powder
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 2 cups vegetable oil
instructions: In a small cup, mix the five spice powder and cayenne pepper together. Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or skillet over medium heat, then stir in the spice mixture and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Do not let the spices burn. Pour in enough hot water to cover the entire surface of the pan. Do not stir. Do not stir for 10 minutes or the mixture could boil over.

Random Ingredients: stuffing mix,green apple,paprika,red wine vinegar,nori,chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Apple Nori Rolls
ingredients: 1 3/4 ounces prepared stuffing mix | 1 green apple, grated into large dice | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 -2 sheet nori | 1 -2 tablespoon red wine vinegar | paprika, to sprinkle
instructions: Place the stuffing mix, grated apples and chili flakes in a bowl and combine. Cover and set aside for about 15 minutes. Separate each sheet of nori sheet using 3 - 4 thin sheets of nori. Brush each sheet lightly with the vinegar. Take one sheet of nori and place on a board. Take a small spoonful of stuffing mixture and roll into a log about 3 - 5 long and 1 1/2 thick. Roll in the nori to coat well. If it resists the rolling pin, place a second sheet of nori on the board. Place the rolled nori on a large baking sheet. Repeat until all filling and nori are used up. Sprinkle over paprika, to sprinkle on each roll before serving. Cut into small slices. Serve warm with a spicy chili sauce or dipping sauce that goes well with this dish.

title: Vegan French Bread
ingredients: 4 cups green beans, trimmed ( ~10oz. box ) | 1 medium chayotes, peeled, thinly sliced ( ~3/4 cup ) | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 3 -4 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour or 1 1/2 cups bread flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Place all the ingredients in the pan of the bread maker in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Let bread maker run on its own. If the model doesn’t agree, plug a gas light/brown bread and start. If the bread machine still runs, don’t turn it to warm or it will become greasy. Remove bread to a wire rack, drizzle with melted vegan butter and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,swiss cheese,pea,ice,kalamata olive,currant,lemon zest,kaffir lime leaf
title: Frozen Maple Leaf Pudding With Fresh Olives
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas | 1 cup swiss cheese, sliced | 1/4 cup currants ( optional ) | 2 kaffir lime leaves, sliced thinly | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 cup ice | 2 tablespoons fresh lemons, zest of, peeled and grated | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted and sliced length-wise
instructions: Using a food processor, process the swiss cheese and currants until the cheese is finely chopped and the currants plump, about 10 seconds. Transfer the cheese mixture to a large casserole dish. Cut the lime leaves into thin strips lengthwise and spread them around the cheese dish. Place the frozen peas on top of the currants and lime strips in the casserole dish. Cover and freeze until the beans are firm, about 6 hours, or overnight. While the peas are chilling, place the ice cubes, lemons and olives in an ice bath. When the 6 hours are up, remove the dish and stir the lemon zest and olives through the ice. Serve in the dish with some of the pea mixture and the rest of the pea mixture.

Random Ingredients: mushroom soup,rice flour,walla onion,cardamom powder,curry paste,flour tortilla,cracker crumb,beef bouillon granule
title: Quick 'n Easy Beef Rind Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh mushrooms, sliced ( any type ) | 4 large crusty crackers, crushed into small pieces ( about 1/2 cup ) | 4 tablespoons rice flour | 3 tablespoons curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant beef bouillon granules or 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom powder ( or 1/2 tsp. cayenne ) | 1/2 cup ground round | 4 10 inch flour tortillas, cut in half
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the beef broth granules, curry paste, cardamom and ground round with a fork. Add mushrooms and stir until evenly coated. Transfer the mixture to a nonstick pan. Over medium heat, gently melt the cayenne. To assemble the rind roll ups, spread 1 tablespoon of the rice mixture in the center of each roll up. Beginning at the wide edge of the roll, roll up the roll and use your fingers to seal the roll closed. Secure with a toothpick. Repeat with the remaining rind roll ups, rice mixture, and flour tortillas. Bring 4 quarts of water to the boil. Working in batches, add 2 rind rolls to the boil and cook until tender. Using slotted spoon, transfer rind rollups to a platter lined with paper towels and drain.

title: Cranberry Grilled Salmon for Two
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet, skin on | 1 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Remove skin from salmon fillet and place on a well oiled grill rack. Cook on medium heat only for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes per side or until internal temperature of salmon reaches 180 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: flour,sugar substitute,vanilla bean,beef bouillon cube,blueberry,lasagna noodle,currant,white onion
title: Blueberry Cheese & Beef Lasagna
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles or 8 ounces cornelloni, cook as directed on package. | 1/2 cup dry currants, coarsely chopped | 1 small white onion, finely chopped | 3 packages beef bouillon cubes | 1 pint fresh blueberries or ( 8 ounce ) package frozen blueberries | 1/2 cup white onion, 1-inch slices, 1/2 inch slices | 1 tablespoon sugar substitute | 1 teaspoon vanilla beans or 1 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: In lg skillet, cook 1/2 cup chopped onion over medium heat until beginning to soften, add bouillon cubes. As soon as bouillon cubes dissolve, add blueberries. Boil until juices form, stir occasionally. Meanwhile cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain. Place 1/4 cup chopped onion in lg skillet with 1/4 cup of currants, about 4 slices of 3/4 to 3/8 cup of blueberries, about 1/4 small onion, about 2 1/4 cups minced beef broth, and a teaspoon of sugar substitute. Cover and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Remove from heat if desired. Preheat broiler. Spray 10x15x2 inch jelly roll pan with nonstick cooking spray and spread 1/2 cup of your white sauce. Lay 3 sheets of plastic wrap over and 1/2 cup beef broth on the table. Place 6 noodles over sauce. Spread 1/2 cup of your white sauce on noodles, 1/2 cup of blueberries, 1/4 small chopped white onion, 1 teaspoon sugar substitute, and 1 tablespoon of your lemon extract. Lay 3 noodles over blueberries, repeat with 1/2 cup of white sauce. Top with 1/2 cup of your white sauce. Place 3 noodles over blueberry mixture and spread with 1/2 cup of white sauce. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of your white sauce, 1/2 cup of blueberries, 1/4 small diced white onion, 1 teaspoon of sugar substitute, and 1 tablespoon of your lemon extract. Top with 3 noodles over blueberry mixture and spread with 1/2 cup of white sauce. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the white sauce. Top with 3 noodles over blueberry mixture and spread with 1/2 cup of the white sauce. Cover and cook for 30 minutes or until top is brown and bubbly. Serve hot with custard.

title: Pecan Praline With Hoisin Sauce
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon pecans, coarsely chopped, roasted ( not unsalted )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Butter baking sheet and sprinkle with 1 teaspoons coarse salt. Whisk hoisin sauce and broth in small bowl to blend.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,hazelnut,seasoning,ice cube,self raising flour,golden syrup,corn flour
title: Apple and Hazelnut Slice
ingredients: 3 large baking apples ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/4 cup golden syrup or 1/4 cup light golden syrup | 2 1/2 cups wholemeal self-raising flour | 3/4 cup corn flour | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | maggi seasoning, to dust
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f, lightly grease a 10 x 6 x 1 1/2 inch loaf tin and line with baking paper. Peel the apples and cut into chunks, about 1 pound. Place into a large bowl with the golden syrup, and mix together. Sift the flours into a bowl, and stir in the nuts. Pour into the prepared tin. Dump any excess batter over, and mix well until all of the apples are moistened. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 - 40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and crisp and the apples feel crunchy. Cool the slice on a wire rack. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,ancho chile powder,chili pepper flake,steak grain,apricot brandy
title: Furikake
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chopped fresh apricots or 2 teaspoons apricot brandy | 1/2 teaspoon ancho chile powder ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder ( optional ) | 1 lb flank steak or 1 lb other steak, sliced across grain
instructions: In a small bowl, combine chopped apricots, brandy, ancho chili powder, pepper flakes, and ancho chile powder until well blended. Add thinly sliced meat and stir to coat. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 24 hours and up to 48 hours. Thread meat onto metal or soaked wooden skewers. Grill meat over hot coals or under high broiler 5 to 7 minutes per side. Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Napa Dave's Duck Cocktail
ingredients: 1 turkey body, dressed | 1 bunch fresh cilantro and key lime juice | 1 canned jalapeno pepper, chopped | iceberg lettuce, broken into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Place turkey in a mixing bowl, and stir in lime juice, cilantro, and jalapeno peppers. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Fast and Easy Rice and Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 bag philadelphia cream cheese | 2 cups long grain rice, cooked and drained, or as needed ( optional ) | 2 cans chicken broth, or as needed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh fruit, such as berries, prunes, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 3 quart casserole dish. Beat cream cheese in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer until smooth. Stir in rice and enough soup broth to make the mixture soft and smooth.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,white breadcrumb,walnut,onion powder,tofu,vegetable stock,sherry,cauliflower
title: Mushroom Tofu
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, sliced | 4 sheets tofu | 6 tablespoons dried white breadcrumbs | 150 g cauliflower, chopped | 1/4 cup walnuts, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder | 100 ml dry sherry
instructions: Bake tofu abatt 1 minute at 180°c. Remove from oven and break into bite sized pieces. Dry off excess moisture. Spray with oil and cook chicken until browned on all sides.
