title: Italian Bean and Sausage Bake
ingredients: 1 package sweet italian sausage | 2 cans garbanzo beans, with liquid | 7 ounces ground pork | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f spray 24 inch round cake pan with cooking spray. Heat sausage in medium skillet over medium high heat, crumbling until cooked through, about 10 minute drain. Stir in beans, pork, red pepper, and chives.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,peach,topping,black eyed pea,mustard,garlic paste,filling,mozzarella cheese
title: Fresh and Simple Peach and Black Eyed Pea Lasagne
ingredients: 32 ounces fresh sliced peaches ( canned, drained and pureed ) | 1 can black-eyed peas ( drained and pureed ) | 32 ounces fresh cheese-filled lasagna noodles ( sliced in half on the diagonal and then into 1/4-inch slices ) | toppings : | 1/4 cup dry mustard | 1/2 cup mustard | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 16 ounces frozen whipped topping ( thawed ) | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese, divided
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together 1/4 cup dry mustard and 1 tablespoon garlic paste and spread over frozen sliced peaches and black eyed peas. Layer half of the lasagna noodles in the bottom of the 9 x 13 inch baking dish and top with black eyed pea mixture. Layer half of the mozzarella cheese over the pea mixture and then top with the black eyed pea mixture. Repeat layering and top with remaining mozzarella cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until golden brown and bubbling and the cheese has bubbled.

title: Indian Style Beef With Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, fat trimmed | 8 ounces snow peas, trimmed | 4 teaspoons cumin seeds
instructions: Coarsely grind 1 teaspoon of cumin seeds with a mortar and pestle or other spice grinder. Coarsely grind the second teaspoon of cumin seeds with the mortar and pestle or other spice grinder and rub evenly all over the brisket. Lay the brisket on a rack in a baking dish and scatter with 1 teaspoon of cumin seeds. Turn the brisket so it is thoroughly coated with the spice mix. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 6 hours or up to 3 days ahead. Before serving remove the brisket from the refrigerator 20 minutes prior to cooking and let cool at room temperature. Remove 1/2 cup of the snow peas. Slice the brisket across the grain and arrange on a serving platter. Use another large platter as the meat and reheat it gently just before serving to reheat it. Serve with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: pickling onion,celery,maple syrup,rice noodle,sea salt,pesto sauce
title: Maple Pesto Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 box crispy rice noodles, the kind that come in wide strips | 1 cup pickling onion | 2 stalks celery | 1/4 cup pickling spices ( you can also use your blend of herbs, but i have never found them all in my hand so i just had a strong blend. ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pesto sauce | sea salt ( optional )
instructions: Start tobo the rice noodles. When the noodles are at desired tenderness drain most of the water off. Rinse and dry the pickling spices. Rinse the celery, and slice into half lengthways. Put all the prepared ingredients into a large bowl, toss to coat. Taste the salad and adjust spices – for the pesto, place in a food processor, blend until smooth. Stir in the pesto and salt to your liking. Taste the salad and adjust seasoning. My mom likes it pretty sweet so i usually add a dash of sea salt when i mix them all to ensure that the salt is completely mixed inches. You can add more pesto if it is too thick and sour to your liking. If the noodles are too thick, they will make a bitter cheese salad. But they are more likely to turn out perfect after the rinse cycle is over. The pickling spices work wonderfully also, making a wonderful spice paste. Enjoy.

title: Chilli Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1 cup bottled strawberry jam | 1 cup picante sauce or 1 cup picante sauce | chili pepper
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the arborio with enough water to just cover. Bring to boil, cover, and reduce heat to simmer. Cook for 20 minutes. Stir rice constantly until thickened. Remove and discard any excess water. Stir in the jam and tomato sauce. Cover and continue cooking for 5 minutes.

title: Raspberry Trifle
ingredients: 1 sponge cake, cut into cubes, squares or 1 cup, cubed ( if you want cubes, you can use other cuts. ) | 1/2 cup fresh raspberries or 1/2 cup frozen raspberries, any fruit you have, diced into smaller pieces
instructions: Place all your ingredients in a large mixing bowl and combine well.

title: Beef Rib Barbecue
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short ribs | 1 1/2 cups ketchup | 3/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup bailey's irish cream
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat, or preheat broiler. Place ribs on grill or broiler pan in 3 rows. Spray ribs with pam and grill, turning once, 3 - 5 minutes per side or until meat thermometer registers 125 degrees. Remove from heat and let stand 5 - 10 minutes before cutting into desired size pieces. Combine remaining ingredients in a medium bowl, stirring to blend. Spoon the mixed dressing over the meat and ribs.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,chili pepper flake,golden syrup,chunky salsa,globe eggplant,bean sprout,sage,garlic
title: Lamb Shank and Salsa Wraps
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shank, fat trimmed | 2 bunches fresh sage | 1 bunch chunky salsa | 3 cloves fresh garlic, peeled | 500 g mixed sprouts | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 350 g bean sprouts, drained
instructions: Place lamb shank & bail into 2 large roasting tins, fat trimmed & cut into 5 serving size pieces. Tear sage leaves from stalk & place in large saucepan, add 2 cups water, sage stems & chunky salsa, cover & bring to the boil. Meanwhile, using clean hands, remove meat from marinade & discard marinade. Preheat oven to 180c, spray & lightly grease 2 large oven trays. Place sasage over remaining marinade in large saucepan, add a few tablespoons water & cook over low heat for 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from heat & set aside. Place garlic & chili flakes in a mortar & using pestle, pound to bruise garlic. Combine with remaining marinade & spread over lamb. Roast in oven for 45 minutes, uncovered. Remove from oven & set aside. Remove sage leaves from syrup & arrange on meat. Wipe grill clean & place on tray, cook on medium low heat 5 mins, then turn. Cook another 5 mins, then remove from heat. Serve meat with sticky rice & a salad of baby greens & salsa.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Beetroot Relish
ingredients: 8 ounces raw raw beetroots | 2 ounces sun-dried tomatoes | 6 ounces almond extract | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 7 ounces lard
instructions: Grind the beetroot and sun dried tomatoes together in a mixer. Add almond extract and asafoetida powder. Heat the lard into small batches, and add them to the beetroot mixture. Stir well. Spoon into sterilized jars.. Seal with pinches of cracked pepper.

title: South Beach Diet Dining for Two (Breaded Beef)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck ( boneless ) | 1 cup apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon lime juice, zest of | 1/2 cup beer ( your fav. brand ) | 1/2 cup banana pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup nuts, optional ( optional )
instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper. Cut into 1/2 inch slices. Brown beef over medium high heat on all sides and drain grease. Combine remaining ingredients in a med. Saucepan. Bring to a boil and pour over cooked beef. Simmer, covered 5 minutes over medium heat.

title: Marinated Green Beans (Anu's Sweets)

instructions: Place all ingredients in a glass bowl. Stir. Cover and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours. Serve chilled.

title: Apricot and Chipotle Salad
ingredients: 1 mango - peeled, seeded, and chopped | 1 tablespoon minced red chile peppers | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1 chopped chipotle chile | 2 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: In a jar with lid, combine mango, red chile pepper, apricot preserves, chipotle chile, and kaffir lime leaves. Cover and shake until ingredients are well combined.

title: Holy Yellow Hot Sauce
ingredients: 8 whole jalapenos | 8 sprigs fresh cilantro | 2 oranges
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Place all of the jalapenos inside a large roasting pan and place under the broiler. Broil, turning frequently and moving the pan so it evenly blackens, until the peppers are tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and cut open with a medium knife. Be careful when removing to remove the blackened skin and seeds. Place the peppers, drained of all liquid, back into the empty roasting pan. Juice the three oranges into the pan. Add the cilantro sprigs and stir. Place the pan under the broiler and broil until the sauce just begins to bubble and brown, about 3 minutes.

title: Mexican Green Chile Relish

instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the cabbage, onion, green chiles, taco seasoning and green chilies. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary. Spread in greased ramekins.

title: Broccoli with Toast Crunch

instructions: Break the base out of the broccoli and chop the heads into pieces of approximately 4 pieces. Place the pieces on a baking tray or parchment paper lined tray and sprinkle with about a teaspoon of crushed snack food.

title: Lamb and Lime Tandoori

instructions: Sauté the lamb with a little water or oil to form a paste. Mix the lemons, zest and jaggery in a bowl. When all ingredients are well mixed, remove from heat. instructions: Combine all ingredients to make the basic marinade for your favourite meat. Marinate meat in this for at least a few hours prior to grilling.

title: Tamarind Corn Salad

instructions: Combine everything except the cheese and corn in a large bowl.

ingredients: 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 2 cups dry white or green tea | 4 cups red cabbage | 1 1/2 cups grated colby-monterey jack cheese | 2 cups grated swede ( see note ) | 2 champagne or 2 sparkling wine, such as moscato
instructions: Heat jam on stovetop until very hot. Stir in cabbage, cheese, and green tea. Heat until cheese begins to melt under cabbage. Pour mixture into a shallow dish or dish.

title: Mexican Beans With Pesto and Pesto

title: Red Chili Mousse (Aka Yogurt)
ingredients: 24 -30 ounces greek yogurt ( plain or sour ) | 1 can cream-style sweet corn | 1 -2 teaspoon dried red chili
instructions: Mix together the yoghurt and sweet corn, chilli. Pour into glasses filled with hot water. Top with grated cheese if using. Enjoy.

title: French Quarter Macaroni & Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta | 1 cup texas toast thick bread ( sliced thick ) | 1/2 cup red wine ( optional )
instructions: Heat saute pan or skillet on medium. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Once pasta is cooked, drain and place in large platter. Add bread slices and cook for a few minutes to melt bread. Pour wine over bread, then cover with bread.

title: Aqua Verde (Island-style Rum-Spiked Rice Salad)

instructions: Place rice, chilies, broth, and salt in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover by a 1/2 inch. Bring to boil, cover, and reduce heat back to low. Cook 15 to 20 minutes, or until rice is tender but firm. Stir once.

title: Italian Baked Potato and Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes, cut in wedges | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese or 1 1/2 cups other cheese | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, cut into 1/4-1/2-inch slices | 1/4 cup dried cracked pepper flakes ( optional-use more if desired ) ( optional ) | 2 cups cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, cut into thin strips ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large casserole dish, toss potato wedges with cheese, sausage and seasonings. Add crumbs evenly. Bake 45 to 60 minutes until slightly crisp and golden. Sprinkle with mint if desired and serve at once.

title: Couscous for the BBQ
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 450 g pork hocks or 450 g pork shanks | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 banana pepper
instructions: Prepare couscous the night before and soak in water until you are ready for it, or leave overnight. If using pork shinds, trim off any excess fat or connective tissue and cut into chunks, then place them in a non stick pan with the vinegar. Bring to the boil and pour over some of the simmering water. Cook until all of the water is absorbed. Drain off excess water and place couscous into a large bowl. Add the pork hocks or shanks, stirring well. Season with the salt and freshly ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: salad green,lime,wheat bread,red onion,vanilla bean,flour tortilla,pork tenderloin
title: Sweet Red Onion Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork tenderloin, cut into 3- to 4-inch cubes | 1/3 1/3 cup light sour red onion or 1/3 cup red onion, finely diced | 3 tablespoons lime juice, freshly squeezed | 4 flour tortillas, warmed | 4 cups mixed salad greens | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped ( optional ) | 2 cups whole wheat bread, torn into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f lightly spray a roasting pan with cooking spray. In a large zipper lock bag, combine pork, onion, lime juice and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Mix to combine. Meanwhile, in a large nonreactive skillet over medium high heat, heat half of the tortillas until warm and very lightly browned about 5 minutes. Turn the tortillas and place, one at a time, in the center of each of 4 individual plates. Divide the onion pork mixture among the tortillas. Sprinkle on the parsley.

title: Hot Buttered Confetti With Raspberry-Pepper Hollandaise
ingredients: 3 large egg whites | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons yellow peppers, finely chopped | 1 package raspberry jam
instructions: Preheat the broiler or set a gas or charcoal grill to high. Line a baking sheet with foil, and place the rack 6 inches from the heat source. To make the confection, use a brush dipped in milk, or a small bowl, and spread it evenly over the entire surface of a pastry bag fitted with 1/2 inch of spacing. Smooth out the top slightly, then tilt the bag back and forth around the bowl. Carefully set the pastry bag on the prepared baking sheet. Smooth the surface for a few seconds, then gently push down on it with your fingers, tilting the bag as needed to help it slide out of the bag. Slide a spatula under the rack to loosen the edges. Spread the mustard seeds evenly over the top of the pastry bag, and toast them in the center of the preheated oven until the seeds are fragrant and dry, about 2 minutes. Spread yellow peppers evenly over the mustard seeds. Place ramekins on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and press to press out as much air as possible. Allow to cool completely, then chill completely. To make the honey, place the melted jam in a metal bowl or glass measuring cup, and spread it over the top. Using a brush, lightly sprinkle the jam with 1 to 2 tablespoons of honey. Carefully slide the ramekin onto the parchment paper, and spread evenly. When all of the confection is spread on the ramekin, remove the parchment paper from over the confection top. Gently slide the ramekin onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and spread evenly. Allow to cool completely, then refrigerate until firm, at least 1 day.

title: Crispy Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 gallon fresh bean sprout | 3 tablespoons chutney, such as creme de cilery
instructions: Rinse sprouts in a colander under cold running water. Drain thoroughly. Spray a large nonstick frypan with cooking oil spray.

title: Five-Spice Burgers (Phat)
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 4 large lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 4 thai chiles, deseeded and roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon margarine, softened
instructions: Mix ground sirloin, five spice powder, walnuts, chilies and margarine together in a large bowl. Cover and chill in the refrigerator at least 15 minutes. Form 6 patties of equal size and cook in an oiled hot skillet over medium high heat for 8 - 10 minutes, turning once, until nicely browned on both sides and cooked through.

title: Faux Cakes - for the Grill the Heat
ingredients: 2 cans crescent rolls ( i used crescent rolls ) | fine fresh breadcrumb | 1 lime, juice of ( about half a lime )
instructions: Place the crescent rolls in a deep, flat bowl.. Sprinkle on the fine bread crumbs. Juice 2 limes into bowl. Ladle about 1/2 cup of the juice into bowl, then add about 2 tablespoons of the juice to the crumbs and lime juice mixture and stir with a fork. Put the other half of the lime juice into the bowl with the crumbs. Mix all the crumb mixture in with the juice. Use 1 - 2 tablespoons of juice from the limes for each batch of fattier cakes. Brush each batch of fattier cakes with this lime juice marinade. Let stand for 5 minutes before grilling or frying them. Serve at once or refrigerate for up to 3 days.

title: Sassy's Easy Brown Sugar
ingredients: 12 ounces dry light brown sugar | 10 green bell peppers, seeded and cut into strips
instructions: In a large, heavy skillet, mix the sugar and bell peppers. Cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until the color of the sugar has turned a dark reddish green color and has turned a deep orange color.

title: Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 3 large hard boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon wine ( sweet and sour )
instructions: Cut one egg in half and gently slide the egg into a wide mouth water bath. Poach the egg. You may want to scoop the whites out of the shells with a spoon or a slotted spoon. The idea is to give the shell a little bit of the eggy flesh, a little bit of the onion and some of the wine. Mash the egg gently with the help of your spoon and serve it hot, with a pinch more wine and maybe an drizzle of wine.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,peanut oil,black currant,sharp cheddar cheese,sausage,chicken bouillon granule,granny smith apple,gruyere cheese
title: Cheddar and Apple Salad With Sausage
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs waxy sausages | 1 cup gruyere cheese | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 2 granny smith apples, peeled, cored and cut into quarters and then thin wedges ( about 2 � lb each ) | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 3 teaspoons peanut oil | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon black currants
instructions: Cut the sausages into large pieces and slice across the grain into 1/2 inch slices. Chop the gruyere cheese and sharp cheddar cheese into ½ inch cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Cut the apples into quarters and add them to the cheese and gruyere cheese mixture. In a dry skillet, heat the peanut oil and fry the sausage over medium for 2 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove as soon as it is cooked, leaving it in it juices. Add the vinegar and stir well, then add the currants and mix well. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,blueberry,serrano chili,vegetable stock,honey,chocolate chip,white wine
title: Blueberry Chilli
ingredients: 2 1/2 pints vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 1/2 cups white wine | 1 teaspoon honey | 1 serrano chili, finely chopped | 150 g chocolate chips | 4 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Bring stock and bicarb to the boil. Stir in the white wine and honey and simmer for 5 minutes. Add chili and stir until liquid has been absorbed, then remove from heat. Place the chocolate chips into a bowl, add 1/3 of the hot cream mixture and half of the remaining cream mixture and beat until smooth. Stir through the blueberries and set aside until set, about 10 minutes. Serve the chilli garnished with the chilli.

title: Focaccia
ingredients: 1 red capsicum, seeded and chopped | 2 cups chopped italian tomatoes | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 1 cup shredded romaine lettuce leaf
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Combine the capsicum and tomatoes in a large bowl. Season with thyme. Brush the focaccia with a little water and arrange the lettuce on top. Broil until golden.

title: Scallops With Apples, Orange, Ostratos
ingredients: 24 large scallops | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | cooking apple, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the scallops on an oiled baking sheet. Sprinkle the scallops with the zest. Bake in oven for 5 to 10 minutes or until golden. Serve the scallops with a sprinkling of orange zest.

title: Mock Herb Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh basil | 1 teaspoon nutritional yeast flakes | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Mix herbs in a small bowl. Add cheese and combine just until cheese is melted.

title: Spicy Mexican Pizza Dip
ingredients: 2 packages shredded low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup soymilk, or more as needed | 4 ounces salsa-flavored taco-flavored hot dip ( such as old el paso ) | 2 serrano peppers, chopped, or more to taste ( optional ) | 2 packages prepared pizza sauce, such as kraft mexican pizza dips
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Pour cottage cheese into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,taco seasoning,yeast,tamari,beef chuck,chili flake,cinnamon sugar
title: Chuck's Awesome Sam's Tacos (Pounded Tacos)
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs ground beef chuck | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning, heaping | 1 package dry yeast, 2. 5oz size | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar | 2 tablespoons tamari ( i use reduced sodium ) | 2 cups tamari, 1/2 cup | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast, 5 oz | 2 tablespoons chili flakes ( i use more )
instructions: Warm the pound of ground chuck. Combine the beef and taco seasoning in a large bowl. Add the yeast to the beef and mix. If your yeast starts to get foamy add a little water. Stir and let proof for 5 - 10 minutes until the liquid is mixed inches. Add the spices. Mix thoroughly. Put the mixture in the bowl you made your tacos. The amount of spices you use will depend on how much you like/need. Keep your bowl covered and let rise until doubled. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Divide the meat mixture into 18 equal pieces. Roll each piece in your hand to form a 1/4 inch thick patty and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Repeat until the pan is full. The more fat you put on your patty, the thicker the roll. If any excess meat drips out of your pan, blot it dry with paper towels. Spread 2/3 cup tamari/stevia on the bottom of your pan. Make sure the tamari is covered evenly. Place 2 or 3 pieces of the meat in the pan and let cool for 10 minutes on the pan. This will help the tsups to stay from sticking to the pan.. Using an oven thermometer in the pan, make the chimi, and make sure it's medium to large. Put your 1/4 cup/stevia in the pan with the tamari/stevia. Put the entire pan on the stove. Put the chimi in and heat on medium, or turn the stove to low. You are not actually turning it. Leave it in there, but turn the temperature down to medium low. When it gets dark and emits a crackling sound, turn the heat up to medium high and let the chimi melt. Turn it back down to low and leave it to go dark. The tamari/stevia will also add a sweet sour flavor, if you want. For safety, remove air bubbles. This is not a recipe for safety against bacteria, but is a safe way to keep your food safe because it has a higher risk than anything you would be using in your tacos. Some people panic at this point, but even panic may occur. Place the chimi, seam side down, on a large piece of aluminum foil big enough to wrap. Sprinkle 1/4 cup tamari/stevia on it. Make sure to add the tamari. Add 1 1/2 cups tamari/stevia to the chimi and spread evenly. Take your pan and place it directly on the burner. Turn as necessary until you have a smokey, bubbly top. Place a piece of aluminum foil close to the chimi, and close the vent. Bake for 1 hour at 425 degrees. Remove and sprinkle remaining tamari/stevia on top.

title: Chicken and Swiss Chard Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 lbs swiss chard, trimmed, washed, and stems removed | 1 cup golden raisin | 1/3 cup chopped dates | 2/3 cup chopped fresh radish | 1/3 cup miniature marshmallows | 2 tablespoons chopped salted pistachios, toasted
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup golden syrup in skillet over medium low heat. Add chicken stock, leaved chard stems, and raisins.

title: Karahab's Roast Beef Burger Feta

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix chuck, 1/4 cup onion flakes, lemon juice, feta cheese with garlic, 1/2 cup onion flakes, garam marsala, and ginger in large bowl until well blended. Divide beef between 2 pieces of waxed paper.

title: Chili Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green chilies ( canned not hot )

instructions: Quarter the potatoes lengthwise and rub with 1 teaspoon of salt. Preheat oven to 450f and then arrange on baking sheet. Spread potatoes on top of pine nuts. Bake until golden on top abd cook 10 minutes until potatoes are tender and potatoes are browned.

Increase heat to high and lightly fry prawns with a little oil. Scoop out and place on serving plate. Spoon lemon juice, on top and serve hot.

title: Pesto & Guacamole Toasted Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soymilk | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 4 pieces crusty bread ( sandwich or pita ) | 2 teaspoons oil ( i used olive oil ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese ( i use a mild italian cheeser ) | 5 teaspoons guacamole | 4 teaspoons roasted ground cumin seeds

title: Chinese Morroccan Empanadas

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Add walnuts to the bowl of a food processor and process until they are coarsely chopped. Set aside. Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.

instructions: Combine cottage cheese, green chilies and chilies in a bowl. Stir in chile, apple, strawberry and lemon juice.

instructions: In a frying pan brown sausage. Add 1 tbsp tamarind juice, and set aside to cool. In a 9 x13 pan or 13 x 9 baking pan, place some tortilla pieces, tearing as necessary. instructions: Rinse the beans. Place in a large bowl and soak at least 8 to 24 hours. Drain excess water and rinse. Soak beans with plenty of fresh water for an hour if they are old. title: Cognac Oatcakes

instructions: Put oatmeal in a mixing bowl and pour in cognac. Cover and refrigerate until oatmeal is firm. instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Using electric mixer, combine cream cheese and baking soda and mix on low until combined. Add caraway and mix until blended. On a greased baking sheet, spoon mixture into sticks. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes.

instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When hot, add pork.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Chili Pepper and Parmigiano Reggiano
ingredients: 2 lbs brussels sprouts | 2 tablespoons good quality chili paste | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 yellow pepper, cored and sliced into sticks
instructions: Trim the root ends of the brussels sprouts and, using a small spoon, scoop out most of the base and stems. Cut the brussels sprouts horizontally into 1/2 inch slices. ingredients: 1 cup green olives ( green and whole ) | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 5 -6 ice, crushed
instructions: Pierce olives at 1 inch intervals, all over. Pour the red curry paste over the olives. Allow the mixture for several hours or overnight in the refrigerator to become more consistent. After 3 days, transfer the olives to a container, and process them in a food processor until they are a fine paste.

title: Garlicky Spanish Chick-Pot
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salsa ( preferably spicy ) | 2 tablespoons chives, minced | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, minced ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small mixing bowl. If using for stuffing, stuff into potato casings loosely, then secure openings with toothpicks. Dry on paper lined baking sheet. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes, turning once.

title: Sauteed Vegetables
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs frozen peas | 4 medium carrots, coarsely grated & divided | 1/4 cup frozen california mixed vegetables, thawed | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Cook peas and carrots in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat about 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook till veggies are hot and veggies are golden brown. Remove from heat.

title: Oven-Fried Barbecue Meat #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package of plain quick cook refrigerated sandwich steaks | 24 lemon wedges | 24 aluminum foil | favorite barbecue sauce ( your favorite flavor, we like ours with `` crosse and blurb '' brand. )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place the sandwich steaks between 2 sheets of wax paper and press down lightly. Slide the steaks onto a cutting board and poke several holes in the steaks. Spread 1/4 of the lemon wedges in the holes. Roll both sides of the bread into a log. Transfer the log to a parchment lined sheet and refrigerate it for 1 hour or longer. Using the foil, bring the log, seam side down, to room temperature. Place the log on a oiled baking sheet in the preheated oven and bake 20 minutes, or until very slightly dried. Turn over the bread so that it is evenly browned on the bottom. Remove from the oven, top with desired barbecue sauce and return to the oven for additional 10 minutes or until the meat is cooked through. Serve with warm warmed buns or your favorite bbq or veggie toppings.

Random Ingredients: tahini,sun tomato oil,parsley,sirloin tip steak,sourdough bread,cardamom pod
title: Tahini Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 14 ounces sirloin tip steaks | 4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod | 4 tablespoons freshly chopped parsley | 2 slices sourdough bread
instructions: Remove thin strips of crust from bread, and lightly brush on sundried tomatoes. Cut the steaks in half lengthwise. Toast each side of two slices of bread in the broiler, until lightly browned and fragrant. Spread the cut surfaces of the toasted bread with tahini. Arrange the sun dried tomatoes over the tahini. Serve the steaks on top of the tomatoes and top with parsley and a pinch of cardamom.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,cabbage,cream mushroom soup,beef tenderloin steak,pickle relish,spice
title: Baked Beef Tenderloin with Colcannon
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks, trimmed of all fat | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard powder | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 2 cups shredded cabbage, mixed with small chunks of celery
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange steaks in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish or roasting pan. Mix together beef soup, relish, mustard powder, and spice, and spread over steaks. Cover with cabbage mixture. Bake for about 2 hours in the preheated oven, basting once or twice halfway through cooking.

title: Grilled Yellow and Red Pepper Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 medium yellow bell peppers, cut into 12 squares
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Prepare a gas grill for direct cooking heat. Brush 1 side of a square of reynolds wrap nonstick cooking spray with nonstick cooking spray. Center a row of 12 pepper squares on the foil, overlapping by about 2 inches from the edge or you may need to use two sheets and a little space between them. Grill the peppers until just tender, about 6 - 8 minutes total, turning once. Place the mushrooms on a serving platter, cut side up and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken biscuit cracker,veal,dark sesame oil,roast beef,pepperoncini pepper,rotel
title: Delite Hot Wiener Rolls- Beef or Pork
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb lean roast beef or 1 -1 1/2 lb pork ( for your sandwich ) | 1 can rotel | 1 can deli turkey biscuits and crackers | 12 ounces shredded lean pork or 12 ounces shredded beef | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 12 pepperoncini peppers, sliced
instructions: Shred the beef or pork. If using pork roast, just shred it, and slice the meat. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Place a small amount of sesame oil on a cookie sheet, and spread thin layer of the mixture on the cookie sheet for each roll. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow to macerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350°f place the rolls on the cookie sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until rolls smell toasty. Remove from oven and cool for 30 minutes. Place on a plate and garnish with the sliced pepperoncinis.

title: Tropical Pork Tenderloin (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 cup fresh sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: In a bowl stir together the coconut, pork tenderloin, and salt and pepper to taste. Cook in slow cooker on low for 3 to 4 hours. Transfer to serving plate.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,margarine,cooking wine,sparkling water,taco seasoning mix,turmeric powder,fennel seed,angel hair pasta
title: Fennel & Broccoli Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 1 box angel hair pasta, uncooked | 1 can broccoli, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 cup sparkling water | 2 tablespoons cooking wine or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/8 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients including cooked pasta. Put mixture into a greased 9x13 baking dish and bake for 20 minutes, or until heated throughout.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,cooking oil vegetable,soymilk,lettuce,fennel seed,egg,lime juice zest
title: Lettuce Leaf Breakfast in a Glass Omelet
ingredients: 2 eggs | 1 tablespoon lime juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons soymilk | 1 tablespoon cooking oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/8 teaspoon fennel seed, toasted and ground | salt and pepper | lettuce, cut into thin strips
instructions: Beat eggs together in a bowl. Add lime juice and zest and soy milk. Season with fennel seed and salt and pepper. Spoon egg mixture into the center of a lettuce leaf. Fold in the strips of lettuce. Serve warm. To make the breakfast in toaster or omelet pan or fryer, line with foil or waxed paper. Set the omelet pan on the rack. When rack is up about 1/4 inch from heat source, place in the middle of your toaster or fryer. When rack is close to the temperature without disturbing it, remove from heat. Leave omelet in the toaster or fryer for 5 to 8 minutes until eggs are set. Let stand on rack for 5 minutes, then carefully lift and turn out onto a wire rack or cutting board.

title: Crispy Baking Chips from New Zealand
ingredients: 1 lb margarine ( or softened butter and oil ) | 1/3 cup fine salt | 1 lb palm sugar | 2 teaspoons anchovy ( minced or minced ) | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 or 150 degrees celsius line the baking sheets with parchment paper. Combine the butter, salt, sugar, anchovy and baking powder and cream together until well combined, then press into a log on the prepared baking sheets and bake for about 1 hour or until dark golden brown. Remove to wire racks, cool. Cut into 1 cm wide, 5cm lengths with the back of a sharp knife.

title: Sesame Seed and Turmeric Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked oatmeal | 4 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 cup hummus ( homemade or prepared )
instructions: Mix together oatmeal, sesame seeds, vinegar, and turmeric. Firmly stir in hummus. Serve.

title: Tortilla Salad for One!
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and dried | 5 kalamata olives, pitted and sliced | 1/2 - 1 cup feta cheese or 1/2-1 cup other cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Wash the romaine in a colander and drain. Remove the lettuce tops carefully, by placing them as close to the heads as possible. Put aside in a salad bowl and arrange the olives in a decorative pattern on top. Pile the cheese cubes on top of the lettuce.

title: Baked Garbanzos and Guacamole
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight | 3 avocados, chopped | 1 shallot, minced | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup prepared dijon-style mustard | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricot
instructions: Drain garbanzos. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Drain. Place garbanzos, avocado, shallot, dry flour, and dijon style mustard in a large bowl. Mix thoroughly. Add apricots and mix gently. Spread on a baking sheet and bake 20 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Hotty Orange, Peach Stuffing and French Pear Toasts
ingredients: 1 white bread | 1 large ripe peach | 1/4 lb fresh oyster mushroom, sliced | 1 tablespoon mustard oil | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon orange rind, grated
instructions: Cut the crust off the bread, and scoop out the inside so that the inside looks like there is an x. Remove the bread from the loaf leaving about 3/4 inch of crust left. Cut a slit along the top to let the steam escape. Rinse the peeled and sliced bread and cut the slices into quarters. Cut the mushrooms into 1 squares. In a small bowl, combine mustard oil, orange rind and water to make a paste.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,coriander seed,cilantro leaf,lemon juice zest,soda water,barbecue sauce
title: Beer Battered Cilantro and Lemon Salt
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest ( or 1 tsp grated zest of one lemon ) | 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, loosely packed | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 2 teaspoons gelatin | 1 tablespoon soda water or 1 tablespoon sparkling water | fresh coriander leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f mix coriander seeds, grated zest, cilantro and barbecue sauce in small shallow dish with a lid. Sprinkle gelatine over cilantro and sprinkle over the gelatine. Pour soda or water into dish and let stand 5 - 7 minutes to set. Cut into wedges and toss with coriander.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,ginger juice,roquefort cheese,buttermilk,vegetable,cake flour,egg yolk,orange
title: Minty Ginger and Roquefort Pancakes (Ganache Recchiertes)
ingredients: 6 slices preserved ginger ( use frozen ginger only if using fresh ginger ) | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup vegetable oil ( i prefer not to use olive oil ) | 1 orange, zest of ( grated ) | 7 1/2 ounces cake flour ( all-purpose ) | 1 egg yolk ( lightly beaten ) | 1 tablespoon powdered buttermilk | 1 loaf frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and very thinly sliced ( i like peas )
instructions: Mix together the ginger, mints, oil and orange zest for 10 minutes. Meanwhile mix together the cake flour, egg yolk and buttermilk, then pour all ingredients into a bowl and stir with your fingertips till just combined.

title: Salmon with Soy Milk
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 3/4 cup soy milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f. Bring a kettle full of water to the boil and add a tablespoon of salt. Place salmon fillet in the boiling water, remove the salmon and run under it to stop it burning. Heat the sauce in a saucepan, then remove the salmon from its cooking water, drain the fish, pat it dry, and place in an oven proof dish. Cover loosely with foil and bake it in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Baste with soy milk before serving.

title: Lime Clam Chowder
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 1 can minced clams, drained | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain bacon slices on paper towels. Wrap bacon in a towel and place in a large pot. Pour in clams.

title: Danish Radish and Cherries in Vinegar and Radish Dressing
ingredients: 4 medium radishes, 1 inch in diameter, thinly sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons red wine ( or a red burgundy ) | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped dried cherries
instructions: Rinse radishes well, dry well. Arrange around edge of a serving platter. Combine remaining ingredients, stir vigorously until dressing thickens slightly. Pour dressing over salted radishes and sprinkle with cherries. Serve.

title: Homemade Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 cup curry paste ( i used homemade with no msg added ) | 1 tablespoon real vanilla extract
instructions: Using a coffee mug, combine both ingredients and stir until smooth. To make into a paste, spread on toast, or toasted bagels.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,french vanilla ice cream,white wine,creamy peanut butter
title: Peanut Butter Chicken
ingredients: 600 ml dry white wine | 1 chicken stock cube | 100 g creamy peanut butter | 2 cartons french vanilla ice cream
instructions: Put the wine into a heavy based frying pan and add the stock cube and peanut butter. Cover the pan and simmer slowly until reduced to a gravy consistency. While it cooks, place each serving of ice cream into a freezer bag and give it one quick shake to loosen it off. When the pan has cooled, mix the peanut butter and warm white wine in. Serve immediately and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,thai eggplant,kahlua,italian turkey sausage,vanilla pudding mix,cooking barley
title: Baked German Eggplant
ingredients: 1 pound sweet italian turkey sausage, casings removed ( sausage can also be used ) | 1 large eggplant, ends trimmed, cut into 1/8-inch slices | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking barley | 1 package refrigerated vanilla instant pudding mix ( pudding flavor ) | 1/2 cup kahlua ( almond flavored liqueur )
instructions: Arrange sausage in bottom of ungreased 9 inch cake pan. Arrange eggplant slices in overlapping rows across sausage. In medium saucepan, combine chicken broth and barley.

Random Ingredients: pepperjack cheese,yogurt,chuck roast,nonstick cooking spray,vanilla extract,green cardamom pod,coconut milk,pearl barley
title: Slow-Cooker Beef Barley Pata
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless chuck roast | 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod ( optional ) | nonstick cooking spray | 6 ounces pepperjack cheese ( mexican blend ) | 2/3 cup pearl barley | 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt
instructions: Cut beef across the grain into thin slices. Place meat slices in a 12 in. X 7 in. X 2 in. Baking dish coated with cooking spray.

title: Vegetable and Rice Stacks
ingredients: 2 lbs jasmine rice | butter, for greasing | 8 ounces frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 package frozen mixed baby greens | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 3 -4 fluid ounces grape juice
instructions: Lightly grease a baking dish. Place the rice and boiling water in a large saucepan and simmer over a low heat, covered, for 20 - 25 minutes. Leave to stand for a further 10 minutes. Place the pastry on a board and roll out it thinly, then cut into 6 even circles. Cover the dough with a sheet of aluminum foil and a cloth to prevent it from drying out. Press a little of the rice mixture down on the bottom of each pastry round. Leave a 1cm gap on the edge of the pastry around the rice and pastry so as to ensure a neat, even layer. Spread the mixed greens and spiced rice over the top of the pastry dough. Sprinkle the cumin, mixed spice and grape juice over everything and season with salt and pepper. Carefully transfer the pastry sheets into the prepared pan. Leave for 20 minutes on a lightly floured baking paper. Bake in a preheated oven at 190f for 20 - 25 minutes until risen and golden.

title: Rice Noodles With Yogurt
ingredients: 250 g dried rice noodles | 3/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 1 hour or until softened and then drain well. In large bowl, combine the rice noodles, yogurt and drained yogurt. Mix well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,chili pepper flake,green chilies,beef stew meat,green mango
title: Hot Chile Mango Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 2 large red ripe mangoes, chopped | 2 cans diced green chilies, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Brown meat over medium heat, in several batches, in a large pot. Meanwhile, add the rest of the ingredients to meat. Place in a large mixing bowl, and turn out onto a large rimmed baking sheet. Cover. Turn over a few times so water will run off to the sides. Press a plastic spatula between the loaf and the loaf, if desired. Let rise 1 1/2 hours, or until doubled. Bake at 350 degrees farenheit for 30 to 35 minutes, or until bubbly and center of dip is firm. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Faux Fried Rice Noodles
ingredients: 24 ounces alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 package rice noodles | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/2 cup shredded pecans ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the alfredo sauce according to package directions. Fry 3 noodles in 1 t. Margarine, set aside. Using the other 1 t. Margarine, fry rice noodles, place in a casserole dish. Add the alfredo sauce, toss, and then add the pecans, if desired. Sprinkle the rice noodles on top, and dot with the rest of the margarine. Bake at 325 for 20 - 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Homemade Wood Polish
ingredients: 100 g finely cut wooden or metal kitchen twine | 150 g finely cut dried red chiles ( optional ) | 100 g butter, softened
instructions: Wash the twigs well and then dry them thoroughly. Rub half the soaked twigs together with 1 tbsp salt on them. Mix together the remaining salt with 1 tbsp dry crushed red chillies or green chillies. Rub 2 tbsp melted butter on each twinkie. Refrigerate for 2 - 24 hours or leave in the fridge for up to 3 days, turning the twinkies to coat all sides.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,bacon,hot pepper jalapeno,green chile pepper,stock,yellow bell pepper,salsa
title: The Perfect Blintze Salsa
ingredients: 20 slices bacon | 6 hot peppers, diced ( hot peppers, jalapenos-chile pepper bits, serrano chili peppers ) | 1/3 cup diced yellow bell pepper | 1/3 cup diced green chile peppers | 3/4 cup fresh salsa | 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 tablespoon ground maraschino cherries ( optional )
instructions: Cook bacon in skillet over medium heat, turning occasionally until crisp, about 10 minutes. Once cool, crumble into small pieces. Reserve 1 tablespoon of the bacon drippings in skillet. Stir fry peppers, chiles, salsa, and reserved bacon drippings until pepper is softened, about 3 minutes. Stir in stock. Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring frequently, until peppers are soft, 7 to 10 minutes. Stir in reserved bacon. Remove from heat. Spoon into shallow serving dish. Garnish with reserved pepper bits.

title: Chinese Cabbage and Spices
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage, cut to wedges | 1 can drained cranberries
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cabbage and cranberries. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,orange zest,heavy whipping cream,meat,extra sharp cheddar cheese,seasoning mix,broth
title: Crock Pot Korma
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stew meat ( cut into 1/2-inch cubes ) | 1 cup chicken or 1 cup vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 tablespoon orange zest ( grated ) | 1/4 cup extra heavy whipping cream | 3/4 cup chicken or 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon maggi seasoning mix, paste | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Combine broth, garam marsala, orange peel and zest in a saucepan. Place over medium heat and bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Add meat and chicken and reduce heat. Cover and continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, until meat is almost tender, about 20 minutes. Transfer meat and broth to crockpot. Stir in heavy cream. Cook on high for 3 - 4 hours. Remove the lid and allow to cook until thickened and hot, about 15 - 30 minutes. Scoop meat and broth out of crockpot and add cream to pan. Return to low heat until it thickens, about 5 minutes.

title: Apricot Sauce for Dipping
ingredients: 4 cups apricot preserves | 2 packages dry rice vinegar | fish stock
instructions: In a 5 to 6 quart saucepan, bring apricot preserves to a boil and cook until reduced to 3/4 cup, about 5 minutes. Stir in rice vinegar. Bring to a boil. Add fish stock and reduce heat. Simmer, stirring frequently, until thick, about 5 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Lebanese Bulgur for Breakfast
ingredients: 1 cup ground bulgur, medium-grind | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Grind bulgur with pepper and serve.

title: Lemon Polenta
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups semolina flour or 1 1/4 cups cornmeal | 1 1/4 cups chopped baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Stir together semolina and spinach and place in a food processor. Pulse to roughly chop the spinach. Scoop polenta into 2 inch circular motions holding the center until it is just right consistency. Form polenta into a ball. Place on a lightly dusted or parchment lined baking sheet. Using a 2 inch diameter cookie cutter cut out cookies and place them one at a time on baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until lightly browned. Let cool for a few minutes, then remove from baking sheet and turn out onto a rack to cool completely before storing in an airtight container.

title: Madeira Cheese Balls (Cookies)
ingredients: 2 lbs firm reduced fat fresh cheese cubes or 2 lbs fresh cheese | 1 cup madeira wine or 1 cup dry sherry | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, finely grated | 12 tablespoons cocoa powder
instructions: In a food processor, process all the ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse bread crumbs. Form into 6 small balls, or pack into twist off and flatten slightly. Place on wax paper lined baking sheets and chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400°f. Roll the balls in cocoa powder and bake about 15 mintes or until slightly golden.

title: Cashew Won Tons
ingredients: 2 packages wonton wrappers | 2 cups dry roasted cashews | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Mix all the filling ingredients until they get into little pieces. Make small balls, about 2” in diameter. Heat a little oil in skillet and cook won tones over high heat for about 2 – 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,papaya,brown onion coarsely,bamboo skewer,italian salad dressing mix,tortilla,spaghetti sauce,fruit
title: Spicy Italian Pasta Skewers
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti sauce | 1 small brown onion, chopped coarsely | 6 ounces marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1/2 cup canned sliced ripe papayas, drained | 1/2 cup chopped fresh fruit or 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup prepared italian salad dressing mix | 1/4 cup pesto packed soft mixed fruit pieces ( optional ) | 14 -24 large tortillas, each 14 inch size
instructions: Cut up artichoke hearts into 1/8 inch thick strips. Combine marinated artichoke hearts, papayas and fruit if using. Pour over hot spaghetti sauce, stirring lightly to coat. Serve over tortillas. Sprinkle with italian salad dressing or salad dressing. Note, you can also stuff artichoke hearts with stuffing or sausages. Serves 12.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,soya sauce,mozzarella cheese,red pepper flake,eggplant
title: Eggplant Salad With Spicy Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled, thinly sliced | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Place eggplant slices on microwaveable plate and cook on high about 1 minute or until eggplant is tender. Cool, slice in half lengthwise with slicer into strips. Transfer to serving bowl and cover with cheese. In small bowl, whisk together dressing ingredients, pour over cheese. Sprinkle with a little more red pepper flakes if desired.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,spanish peanut,chicken breast half,chunky salsa,egg yolk,chive
title: Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 large spanish onion, diced small | 2 packages spanish-style hot dogs ( spicy ) | 1 can chunky salsa, mild | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons minced chives
instructions: In a 10 x 15 x 1 inch baking dish, add sliced onions.

title: Coriander-Scented Salt
ingredients: 5 1/4 cups ground coriander seed | 1 bunch scallion, finely chopped | icing sugar
instructions: Toast coriander and scallion in a frying pan over medium low heat for about 3 - 5 minutes until they begin to darken. Stir once or twice. Remove from heat and remove from heat and allow to cool. Grind coriander and scallions with mortar and pestle, to a fine powder. Transfer to shallow non metallic bowl and add remaining seasoning mix. Pour over coriander mixture and mix well to thoroughly coat grains with seasoning. Chill in fridge for 30 minutes or overnight before serving. Will keep for up to a month. This can also be frozen for up to a month.

title: Crock Pot Swiss Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs flat beef country-style ribs | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary
instructions: Place beef rib in the crock pot. Sprinkle rosemary over top. Cover. Cook on low 8 - 10 hours until tender. Remove the beef rib from the crock pot. Remove 1/2 cup of the juices. Shred the meat return to crock pot and stir remaining juices until desired consistancy. Serve with your favorite vegetables.

title: Chocolate-Korean Beef Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat-carb chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons low-sodium sesame oil | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 lbs lean beef brisket, well trimmed of fat, cut into 2 inch chunks | 2 cups hot cooked noodles
instructions: Microwave chocolates, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, and 1 teaspoon sesame oil in medium bowl on high 1 minute until smooth, stirring frequently with fork. Add beef.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,coconut,garlic powder,baby carrot,green onion,salad green
title: Thai Style Vegetable Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 can baby carrots, drained | 1/2 cup mixed salad greens | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped | 3 -4 tablespoons shredded coconut | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: In a bowl combine carrots, salad greens, onions, coconut, five spice powder and garlic powder. Serve chilled.

title: Salad of Summer
ingredients: 2 cups mixed salad, leaves | 2 cups cottage cheese | 1 cup canned fruit
instructions: Mix everything together well. Add more oil, vinegar or spices if required. Serve and enjoy.

title: Fish Tacos With Tofu Salsa
ingredients: 12 ounces of fresh tuna ( or another type of fish ) | 2 -4 tablespoons tandoori lime juice ( can sub other type of fresh lime juice ) | 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley, or 2 tablespoons minced dried parsley | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves, or 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 1/2 cup seeded peeled peeled peeled radicchio ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1/2 cup chopped peeled cucumber ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1/2 cup peeled seeded chopped peeled parsnips ( about 1/4 cup ) | 4 slices italian bread or 4 slices white bread, toasted and cut on an angle into triangles
instructions: Cut tuna in thin slices.

title: Quick and Easy Marinated Beef Skillet
ingredients: 3/4 lb skirt steak, cut 2-inch thick | 3/4 lb yellow squash, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 cup pepitas pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon honey | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted and halved
instructions: Combine the steak, squash, cheese, honey and olives in a large zip type plastic bag. Refrigerate for 3 hours. Remove from the bag. Reserve the marinade. Cook in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat, turning once, until the meat is done. Serve on warm plates. Enjoy.

title: A Simple Chunk Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons fresh-squeezed apple juice | 2 -3 -3 teaspoons sage leaves | 1 -2 teaspoon oregano leaves ( optional ) | pepper flakes, to taste ( optional ) | 2 -3 sliced cucumbers
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,citrus infused vodka,french onion soup,cranberry,nori
title: Cranberry Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 box french onion soup | 1 bag frozen cranberries, thawed | 1 bag small baking potatoes | 1/4 cup dried citrus-infused vodka | nori
instructions: Cook the onion soup according to package directions. Heat the oven to 400°f. Put the potatoes in the oven and bake for 20 - 35 minutes, until tender. When potatoes are done, drain and return to the pot. Mix the crumbled french onion soup and cranberries. Spoon over potatoes and toss the potatoes to coat. Garnish with a couple of nori sheets. Serve with kimchi or a squeeze of chilled lemon.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,red chili powder,coriander powder,onion flake,vegetable,ice
title: Homemade Vegetables Crackers
ingredients: 1 can mixed vegetables, drained with | coriander powder | 2 tablespoons wheat flour | red chili powder | 1 teaspoon dry onion flakes | ice, as required | fresh sliced coriander leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor. Turn on and mix well. Divide into 8 portions. Shape each portion of dough into a 1/2 inch sized circle. Cook on high in a pre heated non stick wok on medium flame till both sides are golden. Remove from pan on tissue paper napkins. Allow to cool slightly. Place each crumb on a piece of wax paper and roll slightly. Flatten with rolling pin. Garnish with sliced corriander leaves. Serve hot. Enjoy.

title: Totally Kale Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch lacinato kale | 1/3 cup ranch dressing, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/ranch-dressing-473924 '' > ranch dressing < /a >
instructions: Rinse and drain kale well. Cut kale into 1/2 inch pieces. Mix kale, ranch dressing and garlic from the head into a salad bowl. Cover and chill for at least one hour before serving so flavors can blend.

title: Braised Chicken in Vinegar
ingredients: 12 ounces penne | 2 1/4 lbs bone-in chicken thighs | 1 red onion, halved, halved and thinly sliced | 20 ounces bacon, chopped | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 6 crusty baguette, cut into 3 slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. In a large pot of lightly salted boiling water, cook the pasta for 10 - 12 minutes, or until al dente. When it is tender, drain it and set aside. Cut open the baguette into thick slices. Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Spray a large casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place half of the pasta in the bottom of the baking dish. Then layer it with half the meat and half of the onion. Repeat layers, finishing with the remaining meat and onion. Drizzle the vinegar over the casserole and cover tightly. Bake about 1 hour, or until the meat is cooked through and the onion is tender.

title: Hominy of Doom
ingredients: 6 cups yellow hominy, rinsed ( not yellow corn! ) | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato puree, to taste
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat, add the hominy, tomato puree and green chilies. Reduce the heat to low, and simmer, uncovered, stirring regularly for 45 minutes until most of the liquid has been absorbed. Eat with salt and black pepper, if desired.

title: Crunchy Bread Salad from the Crock-Pot
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain long grain bread | 1/2 cup mixed italian herbs ( such as oregano, basil ) | 1/4 cup canned chipotle powder | 1/4 cup sour mix | 1/2 cup prepared beans sprouts
instructions: Cut bread into 8 slices. Combine bread, herbs, and chipotle in slow cooker. Cover.

title: Baked French Bread With Fruit and Cheese (Oamc)
ingredients: 16 ounces organic fresh cheese | 16 ounces fresh cauliflower | 2 free-range eggs | 2 large free-range eggs | 1/3 cup molasses | 1/8 cup hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons calvados | 1/3 cup diced pineapple
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Cut the cheese to fit the size crocks. Use a sharp cheese knife and cut the cheese into small cubes to fit the crocks. Place this into a bread tin or other greased souffle dish the smaller the dish the loaves will fit, place aside in a larger dish. Break the cauliflower up into tiny florets. Wash and wash the cauliflower well so it’s not watery. Dice any smaller pieces. Place this into a large bowl with the free range eggs, molasses, hoisin sauce, cumin and cumin powder. Dredge the cheese cube into the egg mixture. Place these into the prepared crocks. Add any more of the cubes of cheese on top. Pour the honey, calvados, and diced pineapple around the sides and top with the croutons or more cheese if desired. Place the lid on the souffle dish and place in the oven for 40 - 45 minutes. Serve hot with pickled vegetables and/or fruit.

title: Tomato Covered Apples
ingredients: 4 ripe tomatoes | 1/3 cup honey or 1/3 cup water | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh herbs ( try basil, oregano, thyme, and chives ) | 2 tablespoons hershey's original amaretto
instructions: Remove from fridge and let it sit for 15 minutes. Cut the tomatoes into thin slices. Put them in a bowl, and with a teaspoon, drizzle the honey. Add the herbs and stir. Put the tomatoes into a paper bag. Take one end off the bag, and use it to gently squeeze out the seeds of the tomato with your fingertip. Place the tomato slices onto a foil lined baking sheet. Cover tightly, and bake at 190°c for 15 - 20 minutes, turning occasionally, until they're soft and caramelized. Remove, set aside, and place the pan on the dining table. When the tomatoes have cooled, put the amaretto in a small bowl and stir in the water. Heat the remaining oil in a small pan, and place over a low heat. Dip the tomatoes into the syrup and arrange the slices on the hot platter. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: orange,lemon juice zest,pesto sauce,potato chip,parmigiano reggiano cheese,salt,tortilla
title: Italian Sizzled Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled simply potatoes chipotle potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 tablespoon freshly grated orange rind | 1 tablespoon freshly grated lemon rind | 1/4 teaspoon salt, divided ( optional ) | 1/4 cup lemon juice, divided ( or more, depending upon how tangy you want the sauce ) | 1/2 cup pesto sauce, divided ( or more, to taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( or romano cheese ) | tortilla ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix the simply potato chotole with the orange, lemon, and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a small shallow baking dish. Using your fingers or the back of a large spoon, rub the potato mixture together and evenly over the diced potatoes. Spread the lemon juice over the potatoes, then spread the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until crust is browned and potatoes are hot. Drizzle 1 tablespoon pesto or a bit of your favorite cheese over the top and set aside. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Alfredo Sauce - Vegan
ingredients: 26 ounces coconut milk ( half a tub ) | 12 ounces asiago cheese, cheese | 26 ounces marzipan
instructions: Empty contents of can into blender. Mix and enjoy.

title: Bean Burger
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 16 ounces kidney beans | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine the hamburger and refried beans, mix and form 4 patties. Cook under medium heat until brown and well done. Cut the lettuce head into small chunks and place on burgers, serve with toppings of choice.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,salad green,white wine vinegar,potato,kidney bean
title: Kidney Bean and Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 cups cooked kidney beans ( or other can of kidney beans ) | 1 sweet potato, peeled and cut into cubes | 50 g salad greens | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Toss the sweet potato in a little water until coated with cooking spray. Put the salad leaves on to a serving dish and top with the kidney beans. Drizzle over the vinegar and caster sugar. Serve with steamed french bread.

title: Spaghetti Sauce II
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Combine dry onion soup mix and marinara sauce in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,nut,beef bouillon cube,american cheese,hamburger,lemon peel,italian parsley
title: Cousin Pete's Americanized Rice Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger ( i use left over beef from the sausage ) | 2 large beef bouillon cubes | 1 cup of shredded american cheese | 1/2 cup of dried italian parsley | 1/2 cup shredded lemon peel ( zest from 1 lemon ) | 1/2 cup chopped nuts, of choice | 1 dash of crushed tomatoes ( optional ) or 1 dash oregano ( optional )
instructions: Place the hamburger, bouillon cubes and lemon peel into large mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients except meat and tomatoes and stir to combine. I use my hands to get everything combined. Shape mixture into 4 patties, about 2 1/2 inches long, and 2 1/2 inches in diameter. Grill patties over hot coals for 10 to 15 minutes, turning once. Garnish with parsley and chopped tomatoes before serving. Nice with salad and garlic bread.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,cherry pie filling,tomato,pumpernickel bread,udon noodle,tortilla
title: Greek Pizza
ingredients: 1 pumpernickel bread, loaf cut from a day old bread | 2 cans tomato pie filling, 1 can | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 4 tomatoes, thinly sliced | 1 package fresh udon noodles, broken into thirds | tortilla, warmed for serving
instructions: Slice bread in half horizontally.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,sugar cube,jumbo shrimp,golden raisin,salmon fillet,italian sausage
title: Cinco De Mayo Baked Smoked Salmon With Sausage and Raisins
ingredients: 24 jumbo shrimp, peeled deveined | 1/2 cup mexican sausage, cooked and sliced into eight pieces | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar cubes | 12 golden raisins, cut into quarters | 1 jar chunky salsa | 2 italian sausages, cooked and diced | 1 bag smoked salmon fillets, frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Lightly grease a 9x13 pan. Place thawed frozen shrimp in the pan. Pour salsa evenly over shrimp. Arrange diced diced sausage in the saute pan over the top in a cross manner. Cut a slit lengthwise in each sausage slice so that each sausage piece has a little sausage and sausage on top and then arrange the frozen shrimp over the top of the sausage. Dump all the raisins over them, dot with a little sugar. Mix together the sasslices on a plate and place it on top of the sausage. Dot with the top of a double thickness of aluminum foil, smoothing and pressing the salt. Bake in preheated oven for 55 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat your oven's broiler and position your largest baking sheet on the middle rack. Once your 5 minutes are up, remove foil, sprinkle with 2 tbsp of sugar and pop back your baking sheet. Remove your sausages from the foil, place it on the grill and cook for a minute or two in oven, until brown and cooked through. Open all the sausage and return it to the pan. Pour hot sausage and raisins evenly over the shrimp. Place on the broiler and cook for about 5 minutes or until shrimp is browned. Dump the salmon over the top of the sausage, return the dish to your oven and continue to bake for another 5 minutes while shrimp is browning and salmon has a nice crispy crust. Let sit for a few minutes before serving.

title: Blueberry Chili and Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 2 small bamboo shoots, cut in half | 16 ounces blueberries ( or any other fruit of your choice ) | 1 small anaheim chili | 1 small mild bittman bittman roasted peppers, roasted for 3-5 minutes
instructions: Roasted peanuts, place in shallow dish or pan and place under a hot grill until skins blister. Remove immediately. Skin peppers.

title: Spanish Rice and Beans
ingredients: 1 package dry pasta | 1/3 cup molasses | 1/3 cup sherry wine | 12 large green olives ( optional ) or 12 large black olives ( optional ) | 2 cups frozen cooked beans ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, combine molasses and sherry in 2 to 3 qt dutch oven over medium heat. Bring to a boil and allow the liquid to reduce slightly. Add cooked beans, mix well and increase heat to medium high. When liquid boils again, add cooked pasta and heat just to warm. Serve. Note, when i made this i had to add 1/4c. More of the molasses.

title: Faux Baklava (Baklava Pastry)
ingredients: 20 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 package dried apricot halves | 3 green onions, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place phyllo sheets about 1/2 inch apart, on the prepared baking sheet. Mix apricots and green onions in a bowl with cold water. Brush a 1/2 inch depth of vegetable oil over phyllo dough, or brush a 1/2 inch depth of vegetable oil into a large skillet. Brush 2 phyllo sheets in hot oil. Cut dough sheet into 2 equal squares. Place 1 phyllo square in the center of a phyllo square.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,phyllo pastry,extra virgin olive oil,ramen noodle,chicken leg quarter
title: Chicken and Coconut Phyllo Pasties
ingredients: 2 cups coconut milk | 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 3 ounces thai-style ramen noodles, broken into pieces | 3 whole chicken leg quarters, pounded | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring coconut milk to a boil in a saucepan over medium high heat, and stir in olive oil. Stir in noodles.

title: Sea Scallop Cakes
ingredients: 20 -25 large sea scallops | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves ( fresh or dried ) | 1 cup cake flour
instructions: Dry cleaned sea scallops with an oven paper towel. Place the sea scallops on a piece of plastic wrap, or a plate. Sprinkle them with 1 1/2 teaspoons of the dried sage, and roll the scallops up into a loose log. Chill it, if you're planning to bake them right away. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse the scallops and pat dry with a paper towel, if desired. Place the scallops about 2 inches from each other in a baking dish, and coat with 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoons of the remaining dried sage. Bake, stirring once or twice, for 12 to 14 minutes, until cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 140 to 155 degrees f. The scallops should shrink back to its original size as they cool.

title: Olive Oil Vinaigrette for Veggies & Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 bell pepper, sliced into thin matchsticks | 1/2 squash, sliced into thin matchsticks | 1/4 teaspoon dry celery salt | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Combine in a jar the above ingredients.

title: Chunky Beans
ingredients: 1 bunch bean curd, cooked | 2 cans refried beans, any flavor | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 10 -12 dashes tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix all together. Spread on crock pot. Place lid on and cook on high for 3 hours or low for 6 - 8 hours depending on how you like your beans. Serve with warm tortillas, pico de gallo, salad, or cheese, etc.

title: Old-Fashioned Barley and Barley Rigatoni
ingredients: 750 g rigatoni pasta | 250 g plain flour, plus extra for dusting | 225 g cooking barley
instructions: Cook the pasta as per the packet instructions. Pre heat the oven to 200c/gas 4 /fan 160c/gas add the flour and barley to a pan of boiling water with a little cooking liquid, then drain. Add the remaining cooking liquid to the pasta, mix and then add the barley/barley mixture. Grease a shallow ovenproof dish with a little sunflower oil and bake for 10 - 15 minutes. If the pasta looks dry before the sauce near the end of cooking, use some extra cooking liquid and flour.

title: Pear and Hazelnut Melt
ingredients: 7 small ripe pears | 500 g whole wheat bread | 1 g ground mixed spice | 200 g fresh mild pepperoni | 1 green cardamoms | 40 g chopped hazelnuts | hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 210°c. Cut pears into six slices along its width, then cut each slice into six slices and keep aside. Wash and dry bread well. Tear into pieces, place in an ovenproof casserole or dish, scatter over pepperoni, mixed spice, cardamoms and hazelnuts if using, then bake for 5 - 10 minutes or until heated through. Serve topped with toasted hazelnuts if desired.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,salsa,coriander sprig,brown sugar,kidney bean,dark sesame oil
title: Coconut Lime and Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can dark sesame oil | 1 cup light brown sugar | 1 lb canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 limes, juice of, only | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander sprigs | your favorite salsa
instructions: Pour oil into a large bowl. Add sugar, drained beans, lime juice, coriander, and salsa. Serves. Note, depending on the size of the beans you are using you may need to add more of the juice or water. You may add more or less amount of lime juice if you need more flavor.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,rye bread,white wine,flat leaf parsley,halloumi cheese,buckwheat flour
title: Halloumi Cheese on Rye
ingredients: 1 small halloumi cheese, about 1 1/2 pounds | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil, plus extra for frying | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | chopped flat leaf parsley, to serve | 1/3 cup dry white wine | 3 -4 tablespoons buckwheat flour, mixed with | 1/4 cup rye bread ( toasted or wholemeal )
instructions: Cut the cheese into 1/2 to 1 inch strips, then cut each strip into 1/2 to 3 cm strips. Heat the oil in a frying pan, adding the cheese strips in batches, if using, and cook over medium heat, stirring, until they are golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove them with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, reserving oil. Stir the mayonnaise and parsley into the oil, then add the wine and 2 tablespoons of the flour and stir until smooth, then heat to boiling. Stir in the cheese strips and heat through, stirring, for about 1 to 2 minutes. Spread the rye bread with the cheese dressing, top with the cheese strips, croutons or flatbreads.

title: Pancake Nests for Beef
ingredients: 1 chuck roast | 6 basil leaves | 1 jar mini chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven 350 degrees. Spread chocolate chips on oven trays lined with parchment paper. Place roast on trays and place on parchment paper. Bake 1 hour or until thermometer reads 160 degrees. Cool completely and remove parchment paper. Serve with toothpicks for easy crumbs. Garnish with fresh basil.

Random Ingredients: salt,dark rum,picante sauce,nut,ice water,coffee powder,tea,romano cheese
title: Mexican "moo Green" (Tea)
ingredients: 3 cups ice water | 3 tablespoons instant tea | 1 pinch salt | 1/2 lb shaved jalapenos or 1/2 lb picante salsa | 4 cups strong black loose coffee | 3 tablespoons dark rum | chopped nuts or shredded cheese ( to garnish ) | grated romano cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, put water, instant tea, and salt. Bring to a boil and lower the heat to medium. Heat slowly so as not to burn, but to keep the water boiling. Add shredded jalapenos and simmer until jalapenos are softened. Strain liquid and discard the solids. Stir. Place the black coffee in a bowl. Add to the jalapeno mixture. Melt rum. Stir rum in. Pour over the tea mixture. Garnish with grated cheese and nuts or cheese of your choice.

title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage, quartered and thinly sliced | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 bag fresh broccoli rabe, chopped with stems and tips cut into bite-size pieces | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine cabbage, spinach and broccoli rabe in a 6 quart saucepan. Bring to boil on medium high heat, reduce heat, and simmer uncovered until vegetables are crisp tender, about 20 minutes. Stir frequently. Remove from heat.

title: Spaghetti Nassau
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti, uncut | 1 whole free range mussel
instructions: Cut spaghetti in half lengthwise. Place mussels in a large bowl and cover with boiling water. Place a strainer over bowl, cover and weight down with cheese cloth to catch the liquid. Soak mussels in the bowl over direct heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove mussels. Break up into small pieces and cover with mussels. Place cooked spaghetti in a large serving bowl and cover with cheese cloth to prevent excess moisture from sticking. Place mussels between pieces with each mussel. Serve on a plate.

title: Spicy Shredded Tomatillo Vegetables And Pasta
ingredients: 6 large tomatillos, peeled, husked and rinsed, about 2 lbs. depending on size, cut crosswise in half and crosswise into strips | 5 cups loosely packed baby arugula | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 1/2 cups loosely packed whole kernel corn | 4 cups uncooked gemelli pasta, cooked to package instructions
instructions: Place tomatillos on paper towels and toss to remove excess moisture. Place in microwave safe bowl. Microwave uncovered on high power 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until slightly tender, stirring twice between pulses to redistribute juices. Meanwhile, combine arugula, marjoram and corn in 4 large saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, 2 minutes or until just tender. Drizzle evenly over cooked vegetables. Serve over pasta.

title: Beetroot Chips
ingredients: 1 beet, washed and peeled, leave skin on ( if you prefer, use the outer peel of one ) | 1/4 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Quarter the beet lengthways. Remove the stalk or any fibrous matter that comes off the beet. Stand strips of beetroot, straight across, on a clean teatowel. Dry roast the beetroot on the preheated oven shelf. Turn them occasionally until the beetroot is very charred about 1 - 1 1/2 hours. You may remove the beetroot to a clean tea towel or cloth lined tin, and leave it to cool. Scrape away the charred beetroot seeds, then place them in a clean tea towel or cloth lined tin. Cover tightly and leave to infuse for 24 hours. After 24 hours, place the shredded beetroot somewhere between the skin and flesh of a beet and wash off any water. Gently squeeze out and discard any remaining moisture. Place the shredded beetroot back into the skin or flesh and, working in batches, mix together the shredded beetroot mixture with the caster sugar. Serve with your favorite chips, or keep on hand in a refrigerator until serving.

title: Steak Fajitas for the Grill
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced | 2 fresh chipotle peppers, sliced | 3 ounces pimientos, drained, halved | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup pure maple syrup | 2 tablespoons finely chopped orange slices
instructions: Place the sliced steak in a skillet and sprinkle with the chipoltes and sliced pimientos. Pour the chicken broth and maple syrup over the steak and bring to a boil over high heat. Lower the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the liquid has reduced and the steak is cooked to your liking. Remove the steaks from the skillet, reserving the liquid in the skillet and keep warm. Stir the orange juice and the reserved steak liquid into the skillet along with the cooked liquid. Heat through and serve with tortillas.

title: Cashew Nut Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 cups raw cashews ( not salted ) | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts tenders, cut into 3/4-inch chunks ( about 4 ) | 1 can mixed vegetables
instructions: In small bowl, combine nutmeg and cinnamon. Sprinkle chicken with spice mixture, cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Position oven rack in center of oven.

Random Ingredients: new york strip steak,agave nectar,ham,saffron thread,ham hock,onion
title: Saffron Steak
ingredients: 6 new york strip steaks, about 3/4-inch thick. | 4 ounces new york ham hocks or 4 ounces other thin pork sirloin steak | 4 ounces smoked ham, cut into thin strips | 1 medium onion, sliced | 1 smoked ham hock, rinsed | 1/4 cup agave nectar | 1/2 saffron thread, crushed over high heat
instructions: Place meat in a large resealable freezer bag.

title: Vietnamese Char Siu
