ingredients: 2 cups shredded cabbage | 1 can baked beans | 200 g vegetarian fish sauce | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 teaspoon horseradish or 1 teaspoon other horseradish | 1/4 teaspoon red food coloring | 2 cans black beans | 1 tablespoon light trident vegetable protein powder or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, for stir frying
instructions: Place the cabbage and beans in a deep frying pan and boil until the cabbage is soft, but not mushy. Meanwhile, place the remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Once cabbage is soft, remove from heat. To make the char siu, empty the vegetables into a microwave safe bowl, add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Place in microwave for 2 - 3 minutes to warm through and keep warm. Serve warm, or cold.

title: Easy Sun-Dried Tomato Dipping Sauce (for dipping )
ingredients: 2 packages sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 cup tamari | 1 dash cayenne ( optional if you don't care )
instructions: Mix. If your sun dried tomatoes have oil, make sure they line up in a plastic bag. Shake to coat well. Store in refrigerator up to 1 week. Serve with chips, veggies, etc.

title: Yogurt Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine, melted | 2 tablespoons oatmeal | 1 cup gyoza skins | yogurt, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place gyoza skins on baking paper. Put in oven for around 15 minutes or until crispy. Turn as needed. Remove from oven. Spread melted butter over and mix with oatmeal. Lay on a board, and roll into a log. Cut log into 4 even pieces. Put on board and stretch slightly with your hands, making sure to spread the roll out thinly. Place roll on baking paper to cool.. Serve with a dollop of plain yoghurt.

title: Saffron Baked in Cabbage, Red Cabbage and Blueberries (Maderara)
ingredients: 1 large head red cabbage ( about 3 pounds or 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup dry white wine or 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1 pinch saffron threads or 2 tablespoons sambal olek | 1 cup fresh blueberries
instructions: Prepare the cabbage by removing the leaf from the center of the head and keeping it separate by lifting up and removing any large irregular pieces of tough stalk on the outside of the leaf, then slicing 1/2 inch thick. Cut each slab of cabbage crosswise into 1/4 inch slices and set aside until needed. Place 1/4 cup of the cold white wine or chicken broth in a small saucepan. Add the saffron and bring to a simmer over medium high heat.

title: Korean Hazelnut Salad With Rice Vinegar Dressing
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce, washed | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, grated | 1/4 cup raw sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients in medium non reactive bowl. Chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Azerbaijki (Cottage Cheese and Bacon Saute)
ingredients: 1 package fresh small curd cottage cheese, drained ( reserve about 1 cup ) | 6 slices bacon, sliced | 1 cup grape tomatoes, cut into fourths | 2 tablespoons oleo
instructions: Heat a large non stick skillet over medium high heat. Add bacon to coat and cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring often. Remove bacon, leaving 1 tablespoon of fat in skillet. Add drained cottage cheese to skillet, stir to combine, and heat through, stirring often. Add tomatoes and oleo and sprinkle with bacon grease. Serve immediately.

title: Cheese & Tomato Soup
ingredients: 8 cups low fat cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 14 ounces tomato sauce
instructions: Mix cornflour and tomato sauce together in a bowl to form a paste. Boil tomato sauce and sauce mixture until thick and smooth. Pour the soup into a clean jug. Scoop out 2 tbsps of the soup and leave for 1/2 hour. Add a tsp of milk if it curdles. Serve with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: courgette,tomato,white wine vinegar,green cardamom pod,bulb garlic,phyllo pastry
title: Aromatic Vegetables in Tomato Phyllo
ingredients: 4 tomatoes, halved, seeds removed | 2 medium courgettes, halved lengthways and cut into 3 mm cubes | 2 whole green cardamom pods | 1 bulb of garlic, cracked apart | 80 ml white wine vinegar or 80 ml balsamic vinegar | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven 120°c. Grease a shallow baking dish. Place tomatoes cut side up on dish. Sprinkle with pepper and salt and leave to stand for 10 minutes. In another dish, place courgettes and cardamom pods. Place torn garlic cloves on top. Place in oven for 15 minutes until vegetables are soft. Pour wine vinegar over vegetables and leave to stand for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and add leaves to plated tomato mixture. Leave to cool and store in the fridge. Using a large sharp knife, cut pastry into squares or diamonds and arrange on top of vegetables to make a stack. Serves 2 as an appetiser or 3 for a light lunch. Alternatively you can assemble these in advance and leave until needed.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,italian parsley,mexican cheese,cinnamon,brazil nut,tomato paste,sauerkraut,hard egg
title: Sauerkraut Stuffed Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 1 can tomato paste | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste | 1/3 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 4 small hard-boiled eggs, boiled until cooked but firm | 1/4 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 fresh brazil nut, finely chopped
instructions: Cook, covered at medium heat for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: skirt steak,yellow lentil,cornflour,pimiento,center pork chop,chinese noodle,gherkin
title: Chinese Beef & Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut in strips | 12 ounces lean chinese noodles, washed | 6 gherkins | 2 yellow lentils | 1 ounce cornflour | 1 jar pimientos | 2 tablespoons pimentos
instructions: Boil the red pepper in water for about 20 minutes. Put in a bowl. Cube the steak into similar proportions as the gherkins and add to the bowl. Add the noodles. Dissolve the cornflour in cold water. Dredge the beef in the cornflour. Sauté the beef with the gherkins on medium heat. Take it out and set aside. Add the pimentos to the pan, and cook till they turn golden brown, not black,. When they do, go back to the meat. Add the onions and cook for a few minutes on high heat. You don't need to stir from here in the end, the gherkins are going to melt into the beef and onions. Drain the noodles. Then, pour the broth, and the beef onto the noodles. Bring to the boil, lower to simmer and cook until noodles are tender and the broth is gone, about 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Sage and Pepper Toasts
ingredients: 1 can sliced bamboo shoots ( i don't drain them ) | 1 loaf rye bread, split | 1/4 teaspoon fresh sage
instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange bread on baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: crescent dinner,orange zest,white vinegar,rosemary sprig,wheat english muffin
title: Romantic French Onion Pies
ingredients: 6 large white american whole wheat english muffins, halved ( about 12 cups ) | 3 cups shredded cooked swiss gruyere or 3 cups swiss cheese ( about 10 cups ) | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary sprig
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°. Place english muffin halves or quarters on ungreased cookie sheet and bake until puffed, golden, and just firm. Meanwhile, melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet over medium heat. Stir in 1 cup cheese and vinegar. Sprinkle zest over melted cheese and let sit 5 minutes. Stir in rosemary. Using a 1 - ½ inch round cookie cutter, cut dough in half. Fill each patty with cheese mixture. Serve warm.

title: Cherie Ogalli Edgewürz – Peanut, Ginger and Lima Bean Salad
ingredients: 5 ounces shelled raw peanuts | 1 cup dried lima beans | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh basil leaf | 1 slice fresh gingerroot ( peeled and minced ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh pimiento
instructions: Remove cores from peanuts and coarsely chop. In a large bowl, combine peanuts and lima beans.

title: Rum Fish
ingredients: 3 lbs cod ( or other dark fish ) | 1 ounce dark rum | 1 tablespoon ginger, finely grated | 2 teaspoons instant tea | 3/4 cup chicken stock
instructions: Dice the fish to your liking, i usually slice 4 - 8 oz. Pieces. Dissolve the rum in the stock, bring to the boil over medium heat, add the fish and heat through, this should not take much. Do not boil. Serve cold, or at room temperature.

title: Gratinee All'abricate (Rosemary Shortbread)
ingredients: 1/2 - 2/3 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup candied rosemary leaf, finely chopped ( fresh ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups candied orange zest, finely chopped ( fresh and coarsely chopped )
instructions: Combine the dry ingredients in the mixing bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, then stir in the zest. If you don't have a mixer with the attachment, you can use an electric mixer with a paddle attachment. Mix on low speed for 2 - 3 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl as necessary. Place into an oiled bowl, and roll into a log about the size of a finger. Wrap in plastic wrap, or refrigerate up to 24 hours. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, or lightly grease with cooking spray. Slice the log as thinly as possible on a mandoline. Place the log on the baking sheet, and refrigerate for an hour or two before baking. Preheat the oven to 300° f. Cut the log into 3/4 to 1/2 pieces and line the bottoms with strips of parchment or colored sugar, if using. Place the pieces in a single layer on the parchment, and bake for 40 to 50 minutes, or until light golden brown and crisp. Remove from the oven, and allow to cool slightly on the pan, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chilli Barbecue Sauce (BBQ)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and serve with burgers.

title: Homemade Adovana Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/2 cinnamon stick
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a blender or food processor and process into a smooth paste. Taste and adjust seasoning.

title: Simmered Rice
ingredients: 1 can cooked beef bouillon cubes or 1 1/2 cups boiling water | 1 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1 head romaine lettuce | 1/4 lb dates, coarsely chopped
instructions: Slice the romaine lettuce crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Tear off the stem end of the long fresh leaf lettuce leaves, pull leaves from the top so they stay together. Rinse the lettuce well under cold running water. Drain, squeezing to remove excess water. In a bowl combine the mustard and bouillon and add to a saucepan along with the rice vinegar. Bring to a boil over medium low heat and let boil until reduced to about 1/2 cup, about a minute. Add the lettuce and dates and remove from the heat. Pour over the salad, coating evenly. Cover the lettuce leaves with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,mango chutney,cocoa powder,chick pea,pineapple chunk,walnut
title: Chickpea & Pineapple Spread
ingredients: 300 g canned chick-peas ( drained, reserve liquid ) | 2 tablespoons chutney | 1/4 cup walnuts, finely chopped | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup apple chunks or 1/2 cup chopped apricots, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | cocoa powder ( optional )
instructions: Put chickpeas into a large bowl, add drained soaking liquid and mix. In a food processor, blend chutney and walnuts until coarsely chopped then stir into the chickpea mixture, add the mango chutney, apple chunks and/or apricots and stir well. Add cardamom and cocoa powder to taste, if desired. Use immediately or store in the fridge to keep flavours a little better.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,berry,pork chop,corn kernel,onion soup mix,cardamom pod,lettuce
title: Baked Pork Chops With Creamy Berry Salsa
ingredients: 3 -4 pork chops, 1 inch thick | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 4 -5 cups fresh mixed berries | 3 cups fresh corn kernels | 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips | 2 teaspoons dried cardamom pods | 1 head lettuce, separated washed and dried
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a baking dish, mix pork chops, dry soup mix, berries, corn, broken up chocolate and cardamom pods. Cover and bake in 350° oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until chops are cooked through. Place lettuce on 4 serving plates and surround with pork chop salsa.

title: Crock Pot-Slow Cooker Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 beef roast | 12 radishes, sliced | 12 small whole nutmegs | 24 small celery ( or 4 small other celery leaves ) | 12 small carrots, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 can rotel ( mexican style )
instructions: Place roast in crock pot. Add radishes, nutmegs, celery, carrots and rotel. Stir. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours, or until meat is very tender.

title: Quark (Swiss Cheese) Appetizer
ingredients: 3 tablespoons quark, shredded | 2 ounces chunky salsa | 1/3 cup shredded cabbage | 1 teaspoon sambal oelek or 1 teaspoon chili powder | parsley sprigs, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, mix thoroughly, and refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: raspberry vinaigrette salad dressing,ice,romaine lettuce,green cardamom pod
title: Raspberry Lettuce
ingredients: 1 cup ice, or as needed | 8 green cardamom pods | 3 cups romaine lettuce, chilled | 2/3 cup raspberry vinaigrette salad dressing | 1 tablespoon red raspberry vinaigrette salad dressing, or as desired
instructions: Fill a large glass bowl with ice. Pour enough ice to cover the ice, about 3 to 4 inches over the ice. Stir in cardamom pods. Set aside. Spread chilled romaine lettuce leaves on a plate. Divide chilled raspberries into 4 equal portions. Drizzle each with 1 1/2 tablespoons raspberry vinaigrette.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,red capsicum,hot green chili pepper,red pepper paste
title: Easy Microwave Thai Steak
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red capsicums ( sliced ) | 2 tablespoons hot green chili peppers ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon red pepper paste | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in bowl and mix well. Stir and heat on high for 1 minute.

title: Elegant Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles | 2 cans vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 2/3 cup cashews | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Prepare the egg noodles with the package. In a large bowl, combine the pudding and the drained egg noodles with the lettuce, cashews and cinnamon. Mix well with a fork.

title: Pea, Parsnip and courgette Salad
ingredients: 5 small parsnips, halved and cut into wedges | 1 courgette, cut into wedges | 1 cup baby spinach | 50 g peas, frozen ( or fresh ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons grand marnier | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons light hummus ( natural, or natural )
instructions: Cook the parsnips and courgette in boiling salted water for 8 - 10 minutes, or until tender and well cooked. Add spinach for the last minute of cooking or until heated through, then drain completely. Mix the peas, courgette, peas, spinach, grand marnier, lemon extract and cayenne pepper in a bowl. Arrange the salad on a serving platter and drizzle with the hummus.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,yoghurt,button mushroom,spinach,red chili pepper,chicken broth,pine nut
title: Spinach Kundoura (Tofu in Hot Chocolate)
ingredients: 1 lb spinach | 3 tablespoons yoghurt | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 3 tablespoons dark chocolate, good quality | 2 -3 teaspoons chopped red chili peppers, from mild-hot chile, from jar, plus any left over | 1 - 1 1/2 ounce button mushrooms, halved ( or white mushrooms, halved if they are large ) | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Clean the spinach, dry it thoroughly and remove the hard stalks. Chop the leaves finely. In a medium bowl, combine the yoghurt, broth, chilies, mushrooms, chocolate and the chopped spinach. Whip until smooth. Wash and dry the pasta of your choice and place it in a serving dish. Cover it with the creamy spinach dressing and garnish it with the pine nuts.

title: Mom's Zucchini Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 1/3 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut up | 1 yellow zucchini, cut in 1-inch slices
instructions: Place beef meat in a large dutch oven. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add zucchini. Add water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 1 hour. Remove meat and zucchini. Serve hot with french bread.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,bulk pork sausage,yellow bell pepper,milk,lime juice zest,vodka
title: Caribbean Sausages
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups vodka | 2 tablespoons lime juice and zest | 2/3 cup white sugar | 1 cup milk | 1 pound bulk pork sausage ( casings removed ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Combine vodka, lime peel and sugar in a bowl. Stir in milk, about 1/4 cup at a time. Heat a 10 inch skillet over medium heat, and cook sausage 3 to 5 minutes, or until browned. Remove from skillet, and slice into 1/2 inch slices. Return sausage to skillet. Bring to a boil, and cook 3 to 5 minutes, turning once, until no longer pink in the center. Add yellow bell pepper to sausage. Reduce heat, and simmer 5 to 7 minutes, or until pork is light brown.

title: Goat Cheese with Cherry Tomatoes and Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1 package gorgonzola | ice | 1 cup chopped cherry tomatoes ( or grape tomatoes ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Remove gorgonzola from package.

title: Homemade Avocado
ingredients: 2 hass avocados | 1 slice american cheese
instructions: Cut avocado in half.

title: Grated Zucchini
ingredients: 1 large zucchini, chopped | cinnamon | ground cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the zucchini, along with enough water, into a greased ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with the cinnamon if desired. Bake, covered, for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and uncover. Serve warm.

title: Toffee Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cup sugar | 1 large head cauliflower
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Combine the sugar and cauliflower in a microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,jalapeno pepper,chocolate,dark chocolate,dark brown sugar,thai fish sauce,oat
title: Fish and Chips
ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats | 3 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 2 ounces dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 2 teaspoons jalapeno peppers | 2 lbs salmon fillets, skinned and cut into 4 pieces | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Combine the oats, dark brown sugar, fish sauce, pepper and chile in a small bowl. Bake the biscuit mixture for 10 minutes. Add the salmon and let sit for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and brush each cod fillet with the warm biscuit mixture. Sprinkle with grated chocolate.

title: Guatemalan Eggs
ingredients: 3/4 lb hard-boiled egg, peeled | 1 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 3 1/2 ounces mexican quesadilla, quesadilla can be used | 1/2 teaspoon ground chives or 1/2 teaspoon green onion | 1 fine minced chives or 1 finely chopped green onion | 2 teaspoons finely grated 1/2 inch fresh lime zest
instructions: Cut the hard boiled egg into four 1 inch wide slices and then cut the slices in half. Combine the asafoetida, quesadilla, chives or green onion and lime peel in the bowl of a food processor. Add the egg slices and process until they are finely ground, about 30 seconds, scraping down the side of the bowl as needed. Taste a little of the egg mixture and adjust for seasoning. Fill the egg cavity with the egg yolks and place in a baking pan. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 350°f oven for about 30 minutes or just until the whites and yolks are almost set. Remove the pan from the oven and increase the heat to 400°f pour the contents of the bowl into a serving dish. Garnish with sliced fresh chives or green onion and serve.

title: Fettuccine With Ginger Grape
ingredients: 500 g ginger juice | 100 g seedless grapes | 50 g dried figs | 50 g dried fettuccine
instructions: Bring ginger juice, grapes and figs to boil. Boil the fettuccine until done. Serve sauce over the pasta.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,baking powder,olive,kosher salt black pepper,yogurt,oat flour,margarine,sirloin beef
title: Beef Burger With Oaty Yoghurt Sauce
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 lbs sirloin beef | 12 ounces sour cream and 12 ounces yogurt yogurt | 3/4 cup oat flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 6 tablespoons margarine | 12 olives, drained and chopped | 3 teaspoons extra-virgin olive oil | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Cut the sirloin into 1/4 inch thick slices. Dry on paper towels. In small bowl, whisk the sour cream and yogurt together. Set the sour cream yogurt mixture aside. In a mixing bowl, mix the flour, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, and the pepper. With a pastry blender, cut in 2 tablespoons of the margarine, then add the remaining butter. Combine the flour and the margarine. Set aside. Cut the beef into bite size pieces. Heat the oat mixture in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the beef pieces, without crowding, and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, or until they are completely browned on all sides. Place the sirloin beef in a baking dish or oven safe dish and top with the pan juices. Bake the burgers for 5 minutes at 450 degrees f, or until they are cooked through, but not mushy. Serve with yogurt sauce.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,fennel seed,yellow cornmeal,vegetable broth,active yeast,farfalle pasta
title: Low Fat English Cornbread Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups soya sauce | 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal | 4 cups vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed ( or 1/2 tsp. ground fennel ) | 1 1/2 cups farfalle pasta
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the soya sauce and cornmeal. Stir in the broth and yeast.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,creme fraiche,worcestershire sauce,chili pepper flake,bouquet garni,green pepper,elbow macaroni
title: Dampen Shrimp over Macaroni
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni | 2 prawns or 2 large shrimp | 1/4 cup creme fraiche | 1/8 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 bouquet garni | chopped green pepper ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook macaroni with a splash of olive oil. Drain, rinse in cold water, and drain well again. Place in a salad bowl. Add prawns or shrimp. Pour creme fraiche over and toss lightly to coat. Remove from the heat. Add chili powder. Add worcestershire sauce. Put in the fridge. Add bouquet garni.

title: Brussels Sprouts, Gorgonzola and Rice
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout, trimmed, cut into 1/3 inch segments with tips | 1/4 cup grand marnier and 3 teaspoons grand marnier | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1/4 lb swiss cheese, grated | 4 cups cooked rice, warm ( preferably hot ) | 2 tablespoons gorgonzola, crumbled | 2 slices prosciutto, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 1 small carrot, cut in half diagonally, then sliced
instructions: Arrange brussels sprouts on paper towel to dry. Preheat oven to 425°f arrange 1/4 cup grand marnier in shallow roasting pan. Mix grand marnier and 3 teaspoons grand marnier in 2 cup saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add 1/2 cup cheese and stir until melted and bubbly, about 1 minute. Stir in 1/3 cup parmigiano reggiano. Spread 1/2 cup sauce over sprouts, then 1/2 cup swiss cheese, then 1/3 cup rice and 1/3 cup grated carrots, then top with 1/4 cup grand marnier. Cover loosely with foil and cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted and rice is hot, about 15 minutes. Cook prosciutto in remaining 1/2 cup sauce, stirring, 5 minutes. Serve sprouts on plates and top with prosciutto and grated carrot.

title: Vanilla Prawns (Shrimp)  (New Zealand)
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled | 8 fluid ounces single cream | 1 ounce vanilla bean
instructions: Heat heavy based saucepan, add the vanilla bean, and pour the cream over the shell shrimps. Stir and cook for 4 mins, turn, and cook for 3 minutes longer, then flake the flesh into the sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Crock Pot Beef and Leek
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 leek, sliced thin | 6 ounces dark chocolate
instructions: Place beef in crock pot and cover with sliced leek. Pour hot water to cover meat. Cook on high heat 10 hours.

title: Yellow Pea Coconut Stew
ingredients: 1 yellow peas or 1 orange pea | 1 medium onion | 1 1/4 cups shredded cabbage | 2 tablespoons tamari | 3/4 cup sweetened flaked coconut cream ( use as much as desired ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Slice the onion in half, then slice it crosswise. Add it back to the pot and add all the other ingredients. Toss the salad, cover and cook over medium heat on low heat approximately 60 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,semolina,ra el hanout spice mix,pineapple,cider vinegar,barley
title: Baharat Aka Pineapple Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 4 cups shredded pineapple | 2 cups shredded raw barley | 1/2 cup semolina ( farina ) | 1/2 cup ras el hanout spice mix, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/rice-or-wine-or-salad-or-moroccan-or-clove-pomme-to-sauce-tunakah-baharat-4.75 '' > rice & spice < /a > - or, if you're lazy and like me, your own version ( toteh ) | 1/2 cup safflower oil or 1/2 cup pure maple syrup | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: To prepare rice/wine/moroccan spice, combine the spices in a bowl, add oil/maple syrup & mix well. Cut the phyllo pastry into long, wide strips approx 2 - 3 inches wide. Use your hands to roll and tear it into a small ball shape. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, sprayed with cooking spray & with a brush. Spray again with cooking spray and lightly coat with cooking spray then stack the strips together. Place them on the parchment paper & refrigerate over night. Bake in a 400&#730.

title: Vegetable Veal With Vermicelli and Spring Onions
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus | 1/2 lb vermicelli pasta, broken into 1 1/2-inch pieces ( long slender ones ) | 1/4 lb frozen peas | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard or 3 tablespoons sweet white wine | 1 tablespoon minced ginger | 1 tablespoon minced shallot | 3/4 teaspoon fenugreek leaves or 3/4 teaspoon thyme leaves, crushed | 6 tablespoons gravy ( homemade or store-bought )
instructions: Snap the ends off the asparagus spears, then cut diagonally into 1 1/2 lengths. Put the asparagus spears into a small saucepan of boiling water.

title: Luscious Potato Fritters
ingredients: 8 medium potatoes, peeled | 2 tablespoons light-colored potato starch | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon | 3 tablespoons sliced kalamata olives | 1 fresh green chile, sliced
instructions: Boil potatoes in a large pot of salted water until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain. Coarsely mash potatoes, but not completely. Mix in tarragon. Return to pot and toss with olives and chile.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,zucchini,peanut oil,vanilla sugar,turmeric powder,lobster tail,thyme sprig,dijon mustard
title: Nestlettes of Lobster Tails(Caribbean)
ingredients: 12 large firm tails shrimp or 12 large lobster tail, cleaned of shells and heads. 1-2 inches in diameter | 4 cups peanut oil, for frying ( about ) | 12 fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 cup sesame seeds, coarsely chopped | 5 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | freshly grated zucchini or summer squash ( optional )
instructions: Place shrimp in a bowl. In 1 cup of peanut oil, place thyme sprigs and sesame seeds. Sauté in sesame and peanut oil about 15 minutes or until golden brown and caribbean is fragrant. Remove from oil and set aside. In a bowl, combine dijon, turmeric, mustard and tumeric and mix well. Pour 1 cup of hot oil into a wok or large frying pan to reach about 1/2 inch deep. Heat over high heat to 400 degrees. Drop one lobster tail in oil and cook through or until golden brown and opaque throughout and still slightly moist inside. Do not overcook the lobster tail, it should still be firm enough when it is removed from the oil. Remove from oil and place into a serving dish. Pour the oil over them, sprinkle with the sesame/peanut/nut mixture.

title: Curry Lamb Rub for Lamb Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 2 tablespoons lamb fat, oil or 2 tablespoons other fat
instructions: Mix together oil or fat, and spices. Rub over lamb in a shallow or deep dish. Cover and leave to dry in the fridge for 2 to 4 hours, turning every hour. Turn the meat once the lamb has soaked up any excess liquid. Slise into rolls, and serve immediately, or roast for 8 to 10 minutes. Serve with fresh vegetable, and veg. Tip this can also be made by grinding 1 teaspoon of dried red chili peppers into an egg before adding the oil/fat. The rub should bind to the meat, and not be left to sit for too long, or else the juices may be runny.

title: Broiled Mexican Snack
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs collard greens, stemmed | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 7 ounces crushed tortilla chips | 10 ounces cooked unshelled mussels
instructions: Preheat broiler to high. Remove stems from sprouts.

title: Nigella's No-Cook Custard Filling for Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 packet custard powder ( custard vanilla or cream ) | 1 teaspoon nigella seeds ( or other seeds, such as sesame seeds. i get them out of the box, just leave them out. )
instructions: Preheat the cooker on medium. Pour in the custard powder. Once it starts to thicken, add the sesame seeds. Cook for two minutes, while the custard powder and seeds are hot. Remove from the cooker to a large bowl and allow to cool a few moments on the counter, or until the custard powder and sesame seeds have turned a light gold color.

title: Fresh Cherries and Coconut - Kari Nachos
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh cherries, stemmed and washed | 4 cups fresh shredded coconut ( kali kari ) | 12 -12 small fresh grape leaves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking sheet with some parchment paper. Cut cherry halves in half and arrange at an angle on baking sheet. Brush the cherry pieces with a little olive oil if they look a bit over done. Bake until the bottoms are lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Watch carefully. Take cherry pears out of the oven and place in a bowl. Set aside. Put coconut in a small frying pan and pour in a little olive oil. Boil until just beginning to turn golden brown. This can take a few minutes depending on how hot your oil is. Assemble the nachos by arranging a few grapes on a plate, a few cherry halves, and a row of kari. Roll the nachos up, and then cut them in half.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,hash brown,pinto bean,pita bread,soymilk,garam masala,pine nut
title: Spiced Spanish Rice Burger
ingredients: 2 cups simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 cup pinto beans, drained | 1 tablespoon pine nuts | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1 tablespoon garam masala ( your spice, or see my note ) | 2 tablespoons plain soymilk | 1 pita bread, cut into triangles
instructions: Place all ingredients except bread and triangles in a food processor and process until smooth about 1 minute until it looks creamy. You may need to use up to 2/3 of the liquid. Spread mixture onto pita bread into four patties. Bake at 350 degree oven for 15 minutes until heated through and lightly browned on both sides. Serve with salad, beans, raisins, or other condiments of your choice. Note, we've been adventurous adding a little garlic powder, cumin powder, cayenne, ginger powder and chili powder to our own spice mix at home.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,pinto bean,red currant jelly,simple syrup,cream cottage cheese
title: Fiesta® Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans, picked over and rinsed | 1 limes, juice and zest of, grated | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 8 ounces cream-style cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly
instructions: Combine the beans, lime zest, and light cream style cottage cheese in a food processor. Set aside while you assemble the rest of the ingredients. Heat the beans in the microwave or on the stove until hot. Add the red currant jelly to the hot beans.

title: Fried Irish Lorne, Irish Meatballs With Pasta
ingredients: 800 g ground lamb | 550 g tasty cheese, cut into cubes | 3 tablespoons irish cream ( or double cream ) | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1 large fresh red chili pepper, deseeded and finely diced | 1 small fresh red chili pepper, deseeded and finely diced | 300 g of any dried hot red chili peppers, drained
instructions: Place the lamb, cheese and a pinch of salt in a large bowl add all of the other ingredients and combine using your hands. Shape the mixture into balls the size of golf balls. Place the meatballs on 4 non stick or baking trays lined with baking paper and allow to rest in the refridgerator for 10 minutes. Heat the frying pan/skillet, add 2 tbsp of oil add the meatballs and fry until golden brown turn and repeat before putting into paper cases and allowing the meatloaf to cool. You will need to keep these warm in a 150c oven. Serve with the pasta of your choice or over a green salad.

title: Beef Stew With Chips and Almonds
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut up | 1/4 lb almond, sliced | 2 pears, cored, peeled and cut into wedges | 1 bag frozen cod
instructions: In a large bowl toss beef with almonds. Arrange on a rack in a broiler pan and broil 4 inches from heat, turning once, until beef is browned and just tender, about 10 minutes total. Meanwhile, warm the oven to 300 degrees. Scatter chipotles on a large shallow baking sheet and toast in upper 1/3 of oven for about 20 minutes, turning as necessary. Spread almond chips around pot and return to oven, keeping oven turned off. Check beef after five minutes and adjust time accordingly. After the last five minutes of baking, pour remaining liquid into a saucepan. Cover and return to oven and cook until meat is fork tender and chips are crisp, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve beef over chips.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,red pepper,corn chip,maple syrup,rye bread,ice
title: Canadian Maple Salmon
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet | 1/4 cup maple syrup | crushed corn chips | crushed red pepper | 2 tablespoons crushed ice | crushed rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place salmon fillet in a small baking dish, then pour maple syrup over. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove salmon from oven, and pour cereal over it. Sprinkle crushed red pepper and cold crushed ice over salmon. Return to the oven, and continue baking 15 to 20 minutes until flakes are lightly browned on the edge. Let salmon cool before serving.

title: Mexican Seasoning Mix for Beef
ingredients: 4 1/2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 2 teaspoons brown sugar | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Rub into meat. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or more. Grill as required.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 4 pounds country-style pork ribs | 28 fluid ounces olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Lay the country style pork ribs onto a work surface. Use a rolling pin to roll them into a long rectangle, about 8 inches long. Drizzle the ribs with olive oil. Arrange them in a large roasting pan with enough space to allow for swelling, if needed. Wrap the roast tightly with aluminum foil. Place into the roasting pan, seal all the edges, and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Place in the preheated oven, and bake for at least 90 minutes, or until crispy and all the juices are absorbed. Allow the roast to rest for about 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,rigatoni pasta,radish,chipotle powder,green chili pepper,baby spinach
title: Rigatoni with Spinach and Chilies
ingredients: 1/4 cup salad oil | 500 g rigatoni pasta | 2 cans green chili peppers, sliced | 1 bunch baby spinach | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder, mixed with | pesto or chopped coriander, to serve
instructions: Boil a large pan of water until heavily salted. Add the rigatoni and cook following pack instructions. While the rigatoni is cooking, place the green chilies in a small saucepan with enough water so they can be squeezed out of the water easily. Bring to the boil and simmer for 1 minute. Drain water and return to the pan, stir in the green chili, spinach and chipotle oil. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring regularly. Serve over the cooked rigatoni with freshly grated parmesan.

Random Ingredients: masala,bean sprout,tomato green chile pepper,chickpea flour,custard powder,cayenne,curry powder
title: Simple Microwave Chickpea Fritters (Microwave)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chickpea flour | 2 teaspoons tomato and green chile pepper masala | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne | 3 -4 teaspoons custard powder | 1 can chickpeas or ( 15 ounce ) can garbanzo beans | 1 tablespoon bean sprouts
instructions: In a 1 1/2 cup measuring cup, combine 3/4 cup chickpea flour with 1 teaspoon tomato and chile pepper masala. Add 1/2 teaspoon curry powder, cayenne, and custard powder.

title: Strawberry Milkshake
ingredients: 3 strawberries, washed and peeled | 1 cup nonfat milk
instructions: Rinse the strawberries under cold water and drain thoroughly. In a blender, combine the strawberries, milk and 4 glasses of ice water. Blend until smooth. Serve chilled.

title: Minted Cod
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb cod, well cleaned & cut into 3/4 pieces | 2 -3 tablespoons ketchup | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Soak the cod in cold water while the fish is soaking. Drain the water and keep it. Preheat the oven to 450°f mix all the ingredients in a baking dish. Bake uncovered, stirring occassionally, for 20 - 25 minutes or until the cod is just cooked.

title: Luscious Vegetarian Lasagna
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 medium aubergines, cut in half | 1 jar lasagna noodles, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray a baking pan with cooking spray. Spray a piece of parchment paper and layer with 3 lasagna noodles. Spoon a generous amount of aubergine into each noodle nest leaving a few on the bottom for a nice filling down. Cover the noodles with some lasagna scraps and spoon some cooking water from the jar back into the bag. Repeat layers, ending with the lasagna sacks on the bottom. This helps make sure the lasagna noodles aren't drying and will not stick. Spray foil with non stick cooking spray and place in oven for 40 minutes or until the lasagna appears dry and the crumbs are starting to pull away from the side of the baking pan. Let them sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tex-Mex Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 6 ounces jarlsberg cheese, grated | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1/4 cup cornbread, crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Stir in the spaghetti, and return to a boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Place the spaghetti in a large bowl and mix with the jarlsberg, salsa, mayonnaise. Season with salt and pepper. Add the cornbread crumbs, and toss to coat. Place the spaghetti on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown and bubbly, about 35 minutes.

title: Mexican Stuffed Arbol Chili Chiles
ingredients: 4 cups fresh chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded and deveined ( about 2 lbs ) | 6 tablespoons canadian bacon fat, unsalted, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons fenugreek seeds ( see note below ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon ground sage | 1 lb thickly sliced ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Make a slit in each chile and remove seeds. Rinse chiles and slice off the inside, removing the stem. Bring 2 quarts water to a boil in a large dutch oven or other large pot and cook chiles until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain chiles, discarding water. While chiles are cooking, place bacon in a skillet over medium heat and cook until crisp. Remove bacon to drain on paper towels. When chiles are cool, slice thinly. Set aside. Add fenugreek and cinnamon to fat in the skillet and, stirring often, cook until fenugreek is dark brown and smells fragrant, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add chiles and saute over medium heat until hot but not browned, about 3 minutes. Transfer chiles to serving platter. Sprinkle cheese over hot chile slices, distributing evenly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: leek,coriander powder,brown sugar,curry paste,taco seasoning mix,white bread,malt vinegar,chili pepper
title: Famous Sweet Potato Dip
ingredients: 4 large sweet potatoes, chopped into small chunks | 1 cup light brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 package taco seasoning mix, mix or ( 5 ounce ) package light brown sugar | 1/2 cup white bread, chopped into small chunks | 2 tablespoons mild curry paste or 3 tablespoons hot curry powder | 1/4 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f mix sweet potatoes, sugar and chili peppers in a microwave safe casserole dish with just enough water to cover. Microwave on high for 5 minutes, stirring halfway through. Pour into a bowl and sprinkle with spices. Mix bread and curry paste and add. Toast till lightly brown and bubbly. Remove from heat. Add vinegar and mix thoroughly.

title: The Perfect Aussie Eggs

Do not use the heat at this stage and you don't have to turn the burner on. Let the mixture cook for about 7 mins. Do not let the mixture boil, as the yolks will continue to cook and turn golden. If you notice, put the bowl under close heat for another 2 - 2 minutes, as the liquid will reduce. Serve eggs with plenty of salsa, if preferred, garnishing it with fresh coriander.

instructions: Combine sauerkraut and mushrooms in colander and shake to remove excess liquid. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese, cover with plastic wrap, then place colander on a plate. Microwave sauerkraut mixture on high 15 seconds at 1 1/2 seconds, rotate, and microwave 15 second intervals. The sauerkraut should not be watery when done, stir and microwave on high 30 seconds more.

Random Ingredients: half,coconut,green chilies,oyster mushroom,baby spinach,egg beater substitute,maraschino cherry
title: Papa Inn Coconut Omelet
ingredients: 1 tablespoon egg beater substitute ( i recommend egg beaters ) | 1 tablespoon half-and-half | 3 cups baby spinach, washed and chopped | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 7 chopped fresh maraschino cherries, or | 1/2 cup canned sliced oyster mushrooms, drained | 1/4 cup chopped canned green chilies
instructions: Beat eggbeater and half and half with electric mixer on medium speed for 15 - 20 seconds or until foamy. Stir in spinach, coconut, cherries, seafood seasoning, and green chilies. Pour into greased 9 inch skillet or bundt pan. Top with plastic wrap or cooking waxed paper, such as a non stick baking mat or plate. Freeze until solid, about 5 hours. Remove from freezer 15 - 20 minutes before serving. Cut into 10 wedges. Serve with spanish rice or plain rice.

title: Peach-And-Olives Omelette
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 4 teaspoons coriander | 1 can peach halves drained | 4 egg whites | 4 teaspoons black olives, chopped | 4 plums, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl, mix the italian seasoning with coriander. Sprinkle peach halves over italian seasoning mixture in small chunks. Using a spoon, make an indentation along the edge of each peach half with a quarter slice from top to bottom to form a small indentation. Insert 1 egg white into indentation. Brush top of omelette with half the olive oil. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

title: Pan-Fried Cashew Cookies
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups cashews | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried parsley leaves, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground anise seeds | 1/8 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place cashews in a bowl.

title: Corn and Banana Tostados #2
ingredients: 2 -8 corn tortillas | 16 frozen sliced bananas, thawed and divided | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can refrigerated dashi stock | 1/4 cup fresh grated peeled horseradish ( or kraft horseradish-flavored horseradish-onion powder paste ) | 1/3 cup chopped pickled sweet corn, drained | 1/4 cup chopped pickled bamboo, drained ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dashi stock | 2 tablespoons gin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Tear 2 - 8 inch sticks of tortilla into 1/2 inch pieces. Place on baking sheet, and bake 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Transfer to a bowl, and stir in 2 1/2 cups of sliced bananas. Mix together the soup, horseradish or kraft horseradish sauce, dashi and 1/3 cup of the dashi. Spread into 4 cake or sandwich size baking dishes. Top with the sour cream mixture and 1/2 cup of the chopped pickled sweet corn and 1/4 cup of the chopped bamboo. Drizzle with 1/2 cup dashi or the gin. Place in the oven until hot and bubbling, about 10 - 15 minutes depending on your oven. Remove from oven and garnish with remaining pickled sweet corn, pickled bamboo and remaining 1/4 cup of dashi. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper ( seeded and sliced fairly thin ) | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs, plus extra for coating | 1 tablespoon dry breadcrumbs, for coating
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the green pepper slices in a glass baking dish, season with salt and pepper, and coat with bread crumbs. Bake until the bread crumbs are golden, about 10 minutes.

title: Skewered Olives
ingredients: 1 lb green olives, pitted, stemmed, and halved ( about 3 cups ) | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | salt and black pepper | 1 quart ice, chilled ( optional )
instructions: Place the olives on a plate, season with salt and pepper, and coat with mustard powder. Let sit for a minute, then spoon about 1/3 cup of olive oil over. Scatter more mustard powder over, if desired. Skewer, wood soaked wooden picks, bamboo skewer work great. Let cool and serve.

title: The Great Canadian Chili and Car
ingredients: 2 large anaheim chilies | 4 sunflower oil | 1 -2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries
instructions: First you'll want to wash your chili, and dry off the stems from the peppers, but leave the seeds in there. Cut open the chili at the stem. Wrap the peppers in saran wrap and place in the sunflower oil so the skins can open. When you take them out of the sun, you can wipe the peppers with a pastry brush. Next, preheat your oven to 400°f. Remove the seeds of the peppers with a teaspoon and the seeds from the peppers with your fingers. Place peppers into an ovenproof frying pan, and add your caraway seeds, sherry and dried cranberries and 1/2 cup of boiling water. Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 mins, or until all the water is gone. Serve immediately with fresh cream and green salad.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,italian tomato sauce,green bean,sparkling water,orange blossom water,quinoa,celery rib
title: Italian Quinoa With Green Beans and Orange Blossom
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, quinoa, medium-grain ( or white rice ) | 6 cups water | 2 cans italian-style tomato sauce | 2 oranges, juice and zest of | 4 large egg yolks | 6 celery ribs | 2 teaspoons fresh orange blossom water | 1 package frozen green beans
instructions: Cook quinoa and water in 8 soup pot over medium heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until it reaches a consistency that you like. Meanwhile, in a bowl, beat egg yolks with a pinch of salt. Add them to saucepan of warm quinoa and water and beat until egg is thick and foamy. Add zest and orange juice. Season with more salt and stir. Set aside. When finished, stir egg mixture into pan, adding green beans. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes or until mixture begins to thicken. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,herb,flat leaf italian parsley,sesame oil,lemon juice,chickpea flour
title: Homemade Hummus
ingredients: 12 ounces chickpea flour | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 3 cups finely crumbled dried breaded mozzarella cheese | 1/3 - 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh herb ( optional )
instructions: Place the chickpea flour in a large bowl and mix in the parsley, lemon juice, sesame oil, and cheese until well combined. Stir in the dried herbs just until blended. Scrape into a large mixing bowl, and chill at least 1 hour. The longer this sits, the smoother the hummus will become. Form into a ball, cover with a damp towel, and set aside to chill at least 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the ball of hummus onto a baking sheet fitted with a rack that is slightly deep. Bake uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden and bubbly. If desired, remove the crust.

title: Homemade Nuts and Fleischmann Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups hazelnuts, cracked | 2 lbs leischmann's yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 4 lbs red apples, peeled, cored and chopped
instructions: Pulse hazelnuts in a spice grinder until finely ground but not dry. Place hazelnuts in a bowl and sprinkle with 1 cup cold water.

title: Sausage and Nuts--Sausage and Nuts for a Rainy Night
ingredients: 3 links hot italian sausage ( i use mild ) | 1/4 cup sunflower seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Put the sausage in the oven and cook for about 8 - 10 minutes, or until cooked through. Let sausage cool. Drain fat and break into pieces. Put the sunflower seeds on a cookie sheet, add and toast until golden.

title: Theodore Kyriakou's Fennel Appetizer
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tart cooking apples, peeled, cored and sliced 1/3-inch thick | 1/4 teaspoon fennel, crushed | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 large egg yolks | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup water | 2 teaspoons plain yogurt | 12 slices prosciutto
instructions: Toss apples with fennel and place in an 8 inch square baking pan. Add 1/4 teaspoon salt and coat apples with yogurt. In medium bowl, lightly beat egg yolks with cornstarch and 1/2 cup water. Beat egg mixture into egg yolks.

title: Tiny French Dessert
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 -2 tablespoon cool whip
instructions: With an electric mixer, combine cream and vanilla. Blend well. Put the whipped topping on and serve along with the warm tart.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,sharp cheddar cheese,tabasco sauce,beef broth,lite olive oil,bouillon cube,aberdeen,chili powder
title: A Scotsman's Beef Stew
ingredients: 1/2 cup lite olive oil, plus extra for drizzling | 2 lbs aberdeen angus sirloin steaks, cut into 1in cubes | 4 beef broth | 2 plum tomatoes, sliced | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 bouillon cube | 3/4 cup thickened cream or 3/4 cup light cream | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Heat the oil in a wide pan, then brown the steak, in batches if necessary, for 2 to 3 minutes each side or until seared on the bottom. Transfer to a plate and cover. Add the tomatoes, chili, bouillon cube and cream to pan, and simmer for 5 - 8 minutes, stirring. Return steak to pan, season with salt and pepper, then return heat to medium. Simmer for another 5 - 8 minutes or until tender, then stir through cheese. Serve with mashed potato, bread or crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,feta cheese,chipotle chile adobo,italian flat leaf parsley,tortilla,walnut half,vegetable oil cooking spray,white wine vinegar
title: Walnut Chips With Chiles
ingredients: 6 large walnut halves, toasted | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, plus | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo | 16 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil, plus more for frying | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar, plus | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/3 cup chopped fresh italian flat leaf parsley
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix toasted walnuts and 1/4 teaspoon of the chipotle chiles with adobo. In a medium skillet, combine feta cheese and 2 tablespoons oil. Over medium heat, warm until cheese is melted and mixture is heated through, about 2 minutes. Stir vinegar into mixture.

Random Ingredients: red potato,spinach leaf,olive oil,queso sauce,arborio rice,mostaccioli pasta,soybean,pinto bean
title: Mexican Vegetarian Noodle Skillet #RSC
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 8 ounces mostaccioli pasta ( uncooked noodles ) | 4 cups spinach leaves, chopped | 8 ounces queso sauce | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 8 ounces red potatoes, cut into chunks | 2 cups cooked arborio rice | 2 tablespoons soybean oil
instructions: In a large skillet, heat olive oil. Add all ingredients except rice and soybean oil. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer 5 minutes, covered. Add rice and soybean oil.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,plain flour,linguica sausage,kaffir lime leaf
title: Kaffir Lime Bread for Breakfast
ingredients: 1 lb mild linguica sausage | 300 g plain flour | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Sausage must be removed from casing. Mix the flour with the sausage, the lime leaves and grated cheese. Cut the casings in half and lightly spray both sides with butter or oil. Slice the sausage into large pieces. Coat with flour and fry in a non stick frying pan, until well cooked. Break apart the sausages and serve with the sausages and lime halves.

title: Warm Apricot Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces deli cheddar cheese ( sliced thin ) | 14 ounces rotel tomatoes ( chopped and drained ) | 1/2 cup sweet paprika ( dry ) | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 1 jar apricot preserves
instructions: Combine the cheese, tomatoes, paprika, paprika and pimentos.

title: Linguine With Spicy Beer
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1 green cardamom | 3 1/2 ounces chipotle chiles, minced ( or 2 teaspoons fresh minced chiles with seeds ) | 1/4 cup canned chipotle chile, canned, minced ( or 2 teaspoons fresh minced chiles with seeds ) | spicy beer, such as a hoegaarden brand recommended | 1 package fresh linguine ( spaghetti or linguica, about 8 ounces ) | 1/2 cup champagne ( or additional spicy beer ( made from brie and white distlobe )
instructions: Heat a ridged griddle or large skillet over high heat for 2 minutes. Stir in black peppercorns and cardamom. Remove from heat and grind chipotle chiles into a powder. Set aside. Bring large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add pasta and cook for 2 minutes or until al dente. Drain pasta, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta cooking liquid. Toss with spicy beer and sprinkle with dried chile powder. Serve immediately. Guacamole, slice 1/4 inch thick slices from firm white bread and place in a small bowl. Toss lightly with reserved pasta cooking liquid. Serve with extra beer or spicy beer.

title: Crispy Seafood Baked in Creamy Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh fish fillets ( such as shrimp with heads, monkfish, cod or whiting ) | 2 medium poblano peppers, roasted, peeled, deseeded and slit lengthwise into 1/2-inch slices | 2/3 cup tapioca flour | 1 spring onion, chopped coarsley | 1 cup of shredded provolone cheese or 1 cup mozzarella cheese
instructions: Arrange the fish on a baking tray, skin side down. Pierce the fish with a fork so that the flesh will cook faster and allow it to cool slightly. Spread the poblano pepper slices on a kitchen towel and blot with a clean kitchen cloth to remove any excess moisture. Place the poblanos under the broiler and continue to cook until charred all over. Remove the poblanos and transfer them to a medium bowl. Place the tapioca flour in a large bowl and place the poblanos over the top. Add all the spring onions and stir until well blended. Pour the prawns down the side of the bowl and stir through the mixture. Turn the prawns so that each piece is coated on both sides with the tapioca flour. Divide the seafood mixture on four plates, top with provolone cheese on top and the prawns on the cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Sauce Easter Egg Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pizza sauce | 2 teaspoons peppermint extract | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 2 slices rye bread ( from a normal sized loaf ) | 5 -8 anchovy fillets
instructions: Combine the dipping sauce ingredients and mix well. Spread on rye bread slice. Top with anchovies. Place back bread onto bread and enjoy. May be served warm or at room temperature. Be warned.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,panko breadcrumb,chicken thigh,cilantro leaf,orange peel,currant
title: Grilled Chicken Breasts With Bread Crumbs and Fruits
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chicken thighs | 1/3 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup finely grated orange peel | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup currants | 4 slices rye bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs and chicken in a large ziploc. Chill for 1 hour. Remove chicken from refrigerator. Remove skin and excess fat and cut into 1/3 sections. Place thighs, skin side down, in bread crumb mixture. Spread bread crumbs on both sides of chicken. Place on grill and cook over medium heat until lightly browned. Turn chicken and cook on other side. Serve with sauce and fruit.

title: Radicchio Rice Balls (Bread & Beef)
ingredients: 32 ounces refrigerated biscuit dough sheets ( i use quick breadcrumbs ) | 1/2 cup pearl barley ( i actually use a mix of 1/2 cup barley with 1/2 cup barley and 1/2 cup pearl barley, which have gluten - free flakes already in them ) | 1 onion, finely chopped | 2 cups shredded radicchio | 1 cup raw long-grain rice ( i prefer jasmin ) | 1 cup white breadcrumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Roll out dough slightly. Cut into 16 - 1 inch squares. Place 1 cup rice in center, then 1/2 cup barley, 1/3 small onion and 1/4 cup radicchio in center. Roll up dough from the narrow end. Place in 9 x 13 pan. Cover with remaining rice and radicchio rice. Make sure the rice has been in the rice mixture before sealing the dough inside the pan with a fork. Use a fork to poke holes in the rice layer. Combine bread crumbs and 1 1/2 cups cold water in a small bowl, make sure it doesn't lump. Add bread crumb mixture to tray and press down evenly on the rice. Use a spatula to spread crumb mixture on the rice. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until the top is nice and browned.

title: Sangna
ingredients: 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1/2 cup olive | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar
instructions: Combine wine, olive oil, and sugar in a small saucepan over low heat. Raise temperature to low. Simmer until mixture is reduced by half, about 5 - 7 minutes. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Easy Black Beans & Rice
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans, soaked overnight | 2 cups white rice, rinsed well, drained, and chopped | 1 cup yellow cornmeal, well rinsed
instructions: In a pot bring 3 cups water to a boil. Add black beans and bring back to a boil. Reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for one hour or until beans are tender. While black beans do cooking in a separate pot or microwave, preheat oven to 350 °f. Rinse rice, add water to rinsed beans, and bring to a boil.

title: Crunchy Strawberry Shortbread
ingredients: 3 cups crushed fresh strawberries | 2 teaspoons peeled freshly grated fresh ginger root | 2 cups crushed corn flakes | 1/4 teaspoon table salt
instructions: Scoop out and place the strawberries into a food processor. Place the ginger, corn flakes, and salt into a small, heavy saucepan, and simmer over high heat until the mixture begins to thicken slightly about 10 minutes. Cool slightly, then stir in the cooled strawberries. Use two knives to cut the mixture into two equal pieces. Place the mixture into a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Freeze until firm, about 2 hours. Slice or press the mixture into small cushioned crumpets, and store in an airtight container.

title: Irish Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 12 ounces smoked gouda cheese ( cut into 4 thin slices ) | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey, warmed | 4 vanilla beans, split lengthwise
instructions: Prepare grill. Arrange cheese slices on grill rack. Drizzle top side of 4 slices with warmed whiskey. Top with split vanilla beans. Wrap each with a piece of smoked gouda cheese. Grill over direct medium heat 4 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Iri Aji
ingredients: 2 small green fresh prawns | 3 tablespoons shikari sake ( optional garnish ) or 3 tablespoons white sherry | 2 -3 dashes green pepper ( optional )
instructions: Skewers, remove the heads and shells from the prawns. If using shrimp heads, cut the head from the shrimp head first. Place in a shallow dish. Pour in about 3/4 cup of shikari, if using, and a few drops of green pepper green pepper. Use your hands to coat the shrimp well. Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, turning the prawns halfway through. Dip the shrimp in the sake or serve with rice.

title: Indian Asafetida
ingredients: 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon orange peel, diced
instructions: Dissolve the asafoetida in 1 1/2 cups warm water. Add the orange peel and mix well. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Irish Whiskey Marinated Fish
ingredients: 1/3 cup irish whiskey or 1/3 cup jameson whiskey jameson | 1/3 cup italian parsley, minced
instructions: In small bowl, blend whiskey and parsley. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Pour into glass jar with flout top. Seal airtight and label jar. Let fish sit at room temperature 1 day. Remove fish.

title: Swedish Cardamom Steak
ingredients: 2 large black cardamom pods | 3 lbs flank steaks | 1 large egg substitute ( eggplant, bologna etc. )
instructions: Cut the flank steak into 1/4 thick slices & place on a baking sheet w/o any fat remaining on top. Bake at 325 f, covered with a lid, for about 2 hours. Remove & allow mixture to cool completely. Heat egg substitute in a small skillet. As soon as the mixture begins to thicken, remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,fast rising yeast,hamburger bun,parsnip,curry powder
title: Curried Parsnips on Buns (Vege-Friendly!)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon fast-rising yeast | 1 - 1 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1 1/2 cups parsnips ( small, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch cubes using a food processor or a mandolin slicer ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 6 -8 hamburger buns, split and toasted and tips cut into 1/4-inch squares
instructions: Dissolve yeast in oil in a large serving bowl. Add parsnips. Sauté with curry powder over medium low heat for 5 minutes. Spoon parsnips over toasted toasted buns. If using a mandolin slicer slice into 1/4 thick pieces. Sprinkle pieces with curry powder and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,pomegranate molasses,green chili,green olive,baking potato
title: Masala Pommes (Potatos With Green Olives)
ingredients: 5 large baking potatoes, peeled, sliced | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses | 1 piece fresh ginger root, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup cut green olives
instructions: Layer potato slices in the bottom of a baking dish, sprinkling each layer with baking soda. Combine pomegranate molasses and ginger in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,lite olive oil,mandarin orange,sauce,self rising flour,avocado,curry powder,oyster sauce
title: Quick and Easy Pancakes
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup self rising flour | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons fresh kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 3 kaffir lime leaves | 4 -6 drops sweet and sour sauce ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups mandarin oranges, drained | 1/2 small ripe avocado, peeled, halved, and sliced ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 -3 drops hot sauce
instructions: Whisk together flour, curry powder, lime leaves, sauce, citrus rind, oyster sauce, and hot sauce.. Cook 1 - 2 minutes per side in lightly greased skillet or crepe pan over medium heat, or until golden brown. Garnish with avocado. Serve sprinkled with chive, cilantro, and/or lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,gingerroot,hoagie,simple syrup,self raising flour,vanilla wafer crumb,egg noodle,cooking oil
title: Peasy-Peach Melba
ingredients: 350 g hoagie rolls | 400 g egg noodles, cooked | 1 cup savoiardi vanilla wafer crumbs ( finely crushed ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons gingerroot ( finely minced ) | 2 tablespoons italian parsley ( finely minced ) | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 egg noodle ( steamed, and mashed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Sauté ginger root with 2 tablespoons of water. Let cool for 5 minutes and then remove roots and cut ginger into fine matchsticks. Mix with noodles in large bowl. Sauté wafer crumbs in 2 1/2 tablespoons of cooking oil for 1 minute and then mix in egg noodles with ginger, rice syrup, and 2 tablespoons of cooking oil. Stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes until noodles are golden brown and crispy. Serve with the crispy peanut butter.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,banana,bacon dripping,white mushroom,potato starch,mint sprig,apple juice
title: Crispy-Simmered Banana Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large bananas, sliced | 4 cups mashed potatoes starch ( see note below ) | 1/4 cup bacon drippings, melted ( may need a touch more or less for a very slightly lower temperature of potatoes ) | 1 apple, peeled, quartered, cored and thinly sliced ( such as a mcintosh ) | 1 tablespoon apple juice | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder ( see note above ) | mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Note, potato starch is sold in tubes in most supermarkets or in tubes at most major grocery stores. It is a soft, firm, non odory consistency, not watery. Most types of mashed potatoes may have a thick, slightly sticky texture and should only need a little more than 1/2 an inch. In a skillet, mash the potato potatoes with the bacon drippings or melted butter, apple and apple juice. Add the chipotles and mash together. Place the mashed potatoes in a large bowl with ice cubes and stir to ensure there is an even coating of potato flakes. The mixture should be smooth, not chunky or grainy. Makes an attractive dessert that can be served with a drizzle of bacon drippings if desired. Note, you should not have a lint free banana on hand for this. An apple will do for this dish.

title: Persian Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans or 1 lb frozen green beans | 1/4 cup unsalted dry-roasted pistachios
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, snap the ends off beans and trim the ends if using fresh beans. Add the beans to the pot with enough cold water to cover them by about 2 inches. Return to a boil, skimming, if necessary, and then add the pistachios. Simmer over moderately low heat 1 1/2 hours, skimming as necessary every 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,vegetable oil peanut,walnut,lamb,active yeast
title: Chinese five-Spice Stuffed Whole-Wheat Buns
ingredients: 1 small head roasted sweet and salted lamb, or | 1/4 lb lean ground lean pork | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 3/4 cup finely ground unbleached all-natural chinese five spice powder | 1 package active dry yeast | vegetable oil or peanut oil, for frying
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f or 180°c. Finely chop the sweet and salted lamb and place them in a small bowl. Add the walnuts, half the five spice powder, and yeast and mix to blend. Add the oil to a baking pan and heat a few inches of oil in it until a drop of water bounces off the surface. Remove from the heat and mix the meat into the yeast mixture. With your hands or a sturdy wooden spoon, mix in the rest of the five spice powder. Line baking sheets with parchment paper, allowing the buns to stand on the baking sheets. Shape the mixture into small spheres about 1½ inches in diameter and place on the baking sheets. Leave at least 20 inches between each buns. Set aside to rise until they have risen again. Meanwhile, heat about ½ inch of oil in a large deep pan. When the oil is very hot, fry the mixed buns at about 3½ minutes in all. Turn and fry on the other side until they have browned and are crisp to the point of fried bread floating on the surface. Remove from the pan and drain on paper towels. Serve warm with a gravy or honey dibb or sweet and sour sauce.

Random Ingredients: pasta,green cardamom,prosciutto,mango chutney,red kidney bean,mustard,cottage cheese,cooking sherry
title: Indian Spiced Pasta and Cottage Cheese Pasta With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 400 g cottage cheese | 200 g prosciutto or 200 g mozzarella cheese | 2 -3 green cardamoms, crushed | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 tablespoon cooking sherry | 400 g red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 400 g red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 250 g mango chutney, to serve
instructions: Combine cottage cheese, prosciutto, cardamon, mustard and sherry in a large bowl and fold through the drained red kidney beans and mango chutney. Set aside half of the pasta mixture. Preheat oven to 200 c. Spread remaining pasta mixture on a baking tray. Bake pasta in oven for about 20 minutes or until firm.

Random Ingredients: cherry,sugar,cannellini bean,green peppercorn,chipotle pepper,hot red chili pepper,bourbon whiskey
title: Guisado De Amendoia (Guisado De Amendoia)
ingredients: 3 cups dry cannellini beans | 3 cups green peas ( frozen or canned are okay ) | 1 cup cherry, halved | 1 1/2 teaspoons whole mixed peppercorns | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle peppers or 2 teaspoons finely chopped chipotle chiles | 1/4 cup bourbon whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon granulated sugar
instructions: Rinse beans thoroughly under cold running water. Place beans, peas, green peppercorns and the remaining ingredients in a large pot. Cover, and cook over medium heat until the beans and peas are tender, about 30 minutes.

title: Easy Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa ( i recommend pace ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 orange bell pepper, cut in strips
instructions: In a medium sized bowl stir together salsa, and vanilla. Microwave the orange pepper strips for one minute on high, stir to make sure peppers are coated, and microwave until peppers are cooked.

title: Crock Pot Strawberries and Chicken Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh strawberries or 2 lbs frozen strawberries, washed, hulled and quartered | 4 cups dashi stock | 1 lb steak, sliced thick | 1 cup frozen unsweetened frozen unsweetened strawberries
instructions: Place 1 cup of strawberries in bottom of 3 - 4 quart slow cooker. Cut off top of each piece of dried strawberries and place in bowl. Place 3/4 cup of dashi in sauce pan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,green bell pepper,tea,white fish fillet,bell pepper
title: Spicy Grilled Fish
ingredients: white fish fillet, cut in serving pieces | lemon juice | 7/8 cup tea, strong | 5/8 cup green bell pepper | 2 tablespoons chopped bell pepper
instructions: Add all ingredients to a nonstick grill or baking dish lined with foil that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Cover and allow to cook over medium high heat for about 5 - 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork, stirring twice. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Thai Spicy Red Curry With Quinoa
ingredients: 500g quinoa | 2 -3 cups watercress | 500 g ground pork | 150 g parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | spaghetti
instructions: Take the quinoa and put aside in a bowl and rinse with water. Cover with saran wrap and put aside in warm place for about 2 hours on its own or until the water has evaporated. In the meantime, start making your spicy red curry using the thai red curry paste in a small mortar and pestle. Then add the pork and mix until you've got everything combined. Then put on to boil and add the quinoa. Cook on its own, until water has evaporated, then cook for 2 minutes more. Finally, add in parmesan to quinoa and mix in.

title: Creamy Dried Vegetable and Meat Fondue
ingredients: 500 ml single cream | 250 ml coconut milk | 1 lb dried mixed vegetables ( broccoli, cauliflower, carrots and cauliflower ) | 1 tablespoon thyme | 225 g dried beef or 225 g dried veal, cut into chunks
instructions: Heat cream, coconut milk and dried vegetables in pan over a low heat, stirring often and ensuring it does not boil. When bubbles appear on surface, reduce heat. Add thyme and simmer gently for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, remove rind from dried beef. Put beef, vegetables and cooked cream to the side. Place the pieces on a large plate with a bowl of ice to freeze. To serve, place in hot fondue pot. Place a piece of aluminium foil over the fondue pot if fondue becomes too thick, then warm in the oven until a piece is warmed through. If necessary, keep fondue lid on soup and add cold water as needed to reach desired consistency. Serve with icecream and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: pimento pepper,cherry juice,rye bread,white onion,chipotle chile,white wine,ginger garlic paste
title: Chipotle Onion Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 1 medium sweet white onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup pimento pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons white wine or 2 tablespoons beer | 2 tablespoons fresh cherry juice | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles | 8 slices rye bread, cut in half horizontally
instructions: Over medium low heat in a large, heat proof bowl, combine diced onion, pepper, ginger garlic paste and wine or beer. Heat to boiling, then cover bowl and let stand for 5 minutes. Stir until hot. Discard solids. Brush one side of each bread slice lightly with oil. Place slice into skillet or grill and grill until crisp. Turning once and brushing frequently with oil, grill until lightly browned on the other sides.. Slice cheese into 8 equal thin slices. Place 4 slices of cheese on each top half of the four cheese slices. Grill on a hot, oiled side for 1 to 2 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Transfer to a serving platter and serve hot.

title: Hot Turkey Sausage
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons morton lite salt | 2 lbs meat | 1/2 lb turkey | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 teaspoon chile
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the meat. Put meat in skillet and sprinkle with salt. Add apple juice, chile. Cook slowly over low heat for 25 - 30 minutes or until meat is done.

title: Baked Spaghetti With Cabbage
ingredients: 300 g spaghetti noodles | 200 g cabbage and cucumbers | 1 lebanese cucumber
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Boil spaghetti in boiling water until al dente. Heat a small pan for 30 seconds and dry out it with the paper towel. Drain the spaghetti and set aside. Using the same large frying pan, add some olive oil, mix and add a bit of the vegetable, mix it in and add the spaghetti. Mix until it takes on colour the cabbage and cucumbers and add that to the spaghetti. Spread the mix in a rectangular baking dish then bake 30 minutes. Add your favourite condiments and serve with a caesar salad.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,lime juice,baby carrot,white pepper powder,sauce,french bread,grand marnier,chocolate chip
title: Kielbasa Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 5 -6 baby carrots | 1 1/4 cups grand marnier or 1 1/4 cups brandy sauce | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons steak sauce ( a taste of olive oil a taste of olive oil a flavor of olive oil a flavor of olive oil a flavor of olive oil ) | 1 2/3 tablespoons toasted chocolate chips or 2 2/3 tablespoons your favourite chocolate chips | 1 dash white pepper powder
instructions: Prepare the kielbasa filling,. Drain carrot pieces and cut in half lengthwise, or cut into 1/2 slices, and then into halves lengthwise. Place in a bowl and season with grand marnier or brandy sauce, lime juice, steak sauce or a little white pepper powder. Set aside. Slice french bread 1/4 in thick. Place half of this mousse mixture at one end of each slice of bread. Cut a slit down the center of the loaf about 1/2 of the way, then stuff your kielbasa pieces inside. You can do this with a needle and nail if desired. Remove the kielbasa stalks from the bowl and arrange the stuffed bread slices in overlapping circular fashion to cover the bottom. Place in a baking dish and brush the tops with the remaining mousse mixture. Sprinkle the toasted chocolate chips on top and bake at 375f for about 20 minutes, or until hot and starting to brown slightly around the edges. This will be a little messy, don't worry if they are sealed well, and it will get no bigger than just a minute or two. Note, if you have no problem getting enough of this to happen, you can use a small box grater instead of a regular grater for this and omit the butter and olive oil entirely. I usually just crumble a little bit of butter and olive oil before serving in a ziploc bag, and that way you can just eat the kielbasa with the grand marnier, which is a little thicker and has a wonderful tangy garlic clove taste to it, or with just plain olives.

title: Old World Potato Croquettes (Irish)
ingredients: 2 lbs small new potatoes | 2 medium egg yolks | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into large cubes. Cook potatoes in salted water about 20 minutes. Remove potatoes from pot and drain.

title: Japanese Beef Ball Soup
ingredients: 2 cups dashi stock, japanese-style stock | 2 lbs hamburger | 1 large red onion, thinly sliced | 1 pisco, roe or 1 japanese-style mushroom | 1 gelatin
instructions: Put your dashi stock and pisco roe into a large pot and heat to a good simmer. Heat your hands and start to form your pisco roe into small balls, then roll them around the edge of the stock balls to coat. In a large saute pan, melt some butter or margarine. Saute your onion and brown the prawns for about 8 minutes. Add the prawns to the broth and let it simmer. You may need to add more stock or water during this step, depending on how sticky you like your seafood. Add your gelatin and bring to a boil while stirring continuously to avoid burning. Once the gelatin is melted, take the pot off the burner, and divide the sauce in 2 portions for the soup, 1 for the gelatin, the 2 portions for the soup, and 4 portions for the soup. Add your meats to the broth and let simmer for 30 minutes or until the meat is cooked and the broth is very thick. Serve in large bowls or individual serving bowls. If you want to add a little more broth to the soup, you can add 1 cup of chopped cilantro. Serve with a fresh, crusty loaf of french bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,chili paste,greek yogurt,chorizo sausage,heavy whipping cream
title: Chocolate Chunk Dip
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces white chocolate | 1 1/2 ounces greek yogurt | 6 ounces chorizo sausage | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( see note ) ( optional ) | 1/4 pint heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place the chocolate in food processor and process until smooth. Add remaining ingredients, blend and transfer to fondue pot. Chill. Serve with a dollop of cream.

title: Apple Chili Marinara
ingredients: 10 canned tart apples | 2 cans italian stewed tomatoes | seasoning | accent seasoning
instructions: Place the can of tomatoes with liquid into a food processor put in a hot saucepan. Add accent seasoning. Tear off a piece of heavy duty aluminum foil and pour over the tomatoes. Cover with foil and seal the can with string. Cook at a simmer for 90 minutes. Tiny tomatoes will soften during the cooking process. If you like a sweeter sauce, add 1 - 2 tbps of cream. Remove from the stove and serve.

title: Rhubarb and Strawberry Parfait
