ingredients: 2 1/4 cups white flour ( or as called for in your flour mix ) | 400 g finely chopped rhubarb | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 3/4 cup watercress | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes ( optional )
instructions: Blend or process rhubarb, flour, nutmeg and water in a food processor until smooth. Turn out onto greased board. Knead to develop all of the ingredients. Roll out until about 3 mm thick. Cut into squares or triangles cut into triangles and spread each with a bit of soured milk or olive oil. Preheat the parfait pan with a light film of oil over medium hot heat. Line the perimeter of the pan with dough shapes. If they are not all in the same circle you should have around 2 - 3 cm of dough at one end. Place the triangle on the pan. Cook for a few minutes until golden brown. This parfait should be served hot and has a good subtle sweetness and aroma. Variation, try making different varieties of fruit. Instead of soured milk it may be made using 2 cups of cold vegetable stock cubes.

title: Savory Black Bean and Ginger Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 pound smoked cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon dried sweet savory | 1 can black turtle beans, drained | 1 package dry rapini, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread potatoes in the bottom of a baking dish. Bake potatoes in the preheated oven until tender and crispy, about 1 hour 15 minutes. Cool potatoes completely. Spread cottage cheese and ground ginger in a bowl. Mix in the savory. Use a fork to transfer the shredded potato mixture to a food processor. Add black turtle beans and rapini.

title: Linguica (Bow Ties) with Sesame seeds
ingredients: 8 1/2 lbs of small fresh boneless beef tri-tip steak ( each about 2-1/3 pounds ) | 1/2 teaspoon instant beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds, dry-roasted for flavor ( for color )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut the steaks crosswise into 2 inch by 2 inch lengths. Cut each strip across the grain once or twice, forming 3 diagonal pieces.. Arrange the steak in an 8x8 inch glass pan. Sprinkle lightly with the bouillon granules, then top with sesame seeds. Place the pan on a rack of a broiler pan and broil, turning once, until deeply browned on all sides, about 15 minutes. Remove and let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Mock Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 3 tablespoons chicken, chopped | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Place all ingredients together except for chicken. Place in a ziplock bag or in a food processor and process until just mixed. You may need to add more chicken or tahini. Cut in about 1 inch pieces and marinate for up to 2 hours. Grill with oiled basting brush. I love to serve with a good pita bread or crusty bread slices.

title: Burgundy Sauce
ingredients: whipping cream or half-and-half | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 dash black pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, whip cream or half & half until stiff. Fold in black pepper and sour cream. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,basmati rice,white bread,dark sesame oil,guinness stout,puff pastry,cumin,chicken liver
title: Chicken Livers and Rice
ingredients: 8 ounces dried chicken livers, washed and roughly chopped | 8 ounces baby carrots, washed, peeled and chopped ( from a 1 lb pack ) | 3 ounces white bread, crusts trimmed, cut into 1/2in rounds | 1/4 cup guinness stout | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, defrosted sheets | 2 sheets fresh white bread, crusts removed, cut into 3cm cubes ( from a 2oz pack )
instructions: Place your dried chicken livers and carrots into a large bowl and pour over enough boiling water to cover.

title: Quick and Easy Corny-Bean Patties
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 6 beaten eggs | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 1 cup prepared yellow mustard seeds
instructions: In a medium size bowl, mix together the kidney beans with the corn, eggs, and 1 tablespoon mustard. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed. Form 6 patties.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,white bean,tomato puree,lemon grass,tequila,red onion,bean sprout
title: Prawns, Mango & Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained | 3/4 cup tomato puree or 3/4 cup tomato sauce | 1/4 cup tequila | 1/4 cup grated mexican cheese ( or other mexican cheese of your choice ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced lemon grass | 12 ounces cooked prawns ( uncooked ) | 1/4 cup chopped red onion
instructions: Mix beans, tomato puree, tequila, cheese and lemon grass together. Marinate prawns and prawns for no more than 2 hours. Just before serving, toss salad with prawn mixture.

title: Roasted Muesli (Vegan)
ingredients: 450 g muesli, cut into 8 pieces | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Mix all the above ingredients together. Roll into small balls.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,mandarin orange,lemongrass,celery rib,salmon fillet,dashi basic,pepper sauce
title: Mixed Fruit Salad (Aka Salmon Salad)
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet, finely diced ( about a couple of slices per person ) | 2 tablespoons prepared dashi ( i prefer basic japanese-style soup stock ) | 2 tablespoons prepared lemongrass, juice only ( no subs ) | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup blueberries ( to taste ) | 1 celery rib, diced ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 can mandarin oranges in syrup, drained
instructions: Place the salmon on a plate and sprinkle with minced lemongrass. Pour hot soup stock over salmon, then marinate salmon in the soup base with additional soup or lemongrass juice. Place a sheet of wax paper over a bowl, then refrigerate salmon until firm. About 10 minutes before serving, add the blueberries and remaining minced lemon grass into the soup, and set aside. Remove salmon from soup and drain off any cooking fat and place in serving bowl. Garnish with lemon zest and any optional fruits. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: shallot,mango powder,green olive,sausage,pam cooking spray,monterey jack cheese,tortilla chip,penne
title: Sausage, Mango and Jack Cheese Nachos
ingredients: 1 package penne ( can use rigatoni if you prefer ) | 2 -3 links chorizo sausage, casing removed | 1 cup mango powder ( or use one large mango, peeled and finely diced in the blender to save time ) | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup pitted green olives, roughly chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup shallot, chopped finely ( optional ) | pam cooking spray ( optional ) | 6 -8 tortilla chips, cut into quarters ( to garnish )
instructions: Fill a large nonstick skillet with about 2 inches of oil. Heat skillet over medium heat until hot. Add chorizo and cook, stirring regularly, until it starts to release some oil on it's edge, about 3 minutes. Push cooked chorizo to the side of pan and add to hot oil. Add mango powder and cook, stirring continuously, for about 1 more minute. Add cheese and stir until melted. Add olives, shallots and mango powder and mix. Spread about 2 thirds of mixture in the bottom of a large, shallow non stick skillet. Top with a layer of puffs of crushed tortilla chips. Spray top of chips with cooking spray or a light mist of oil. Transfer to oven and bake for 7 - 10 minutes or until chips are warm and crispy. Turn off the oven but do not open oven door. Allow to cool at least 5 minutes or so. Cut into pieces with a fork and serve garnished with extra chopped olives.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,garlic clove,green cabbage,cocoa,chocolate cake mix,tortilla chip,white sugar,eggplant
title: Eggplant Slice
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 green cabbage, shredded | 4 garlic cloves, peeled and finely chopped | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 package chocolate cake mix | 1 1/3 cups crushed tortilla chips | 3 fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Preheat a griddle, skillet or frying pan over medium heat. Place eggplant and cabbage in a mixing bowl. Mix garlic, sugar, cocoa, and cake mix together in a second bowl. Pour sugar caramel sauce over the eggplant mixture and mix well. Spread about 1/3 of the eggplant mix into the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Pour half of the crushed tortilla chips over mixture. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used, ending with noodles on top. Sprinkle top with mint springs. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight until slisis chillies are ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: avocado,pork belly,green bean,bow tie pasta,corn oil,apple juice,margarine,chili
title: Spicy Pork and Bow Ties
ingredients: 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1 lb pork belly | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon margarine | 1/2 teaspoon chili | 1 onion, chopped | 1/2 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/2 lb bow tie pasta, cooked
instructions: Cook pork with apple juice and margarine, add chili and cook until tender, not over cooked. Add green beans, cook until tender crisp. Add cooked pork and remaining ingredients. Toss until well coated with sauce.

title: Gramma Mia
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cream | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Blend together cream and ginger garlic paste in a blender until smooth.

Random Ingredients: bacon grease,cocoa powder,button mushroom,onion powder,egg substitute,ziti pasta,pineapple juice,chicken breast
title: Olive Garden Chicken Baked Ziti
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups fat free egg substitute, your choice | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon bacon grease | 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes | 8 ounces frozen button mushrooms, cut into chunks | 1 jar ziti pasta | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a 2qt bowl, combine egg substitute, pineapple juice, and 3 tsp bacon grease. Add cubed chicken pieces.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,cornflour,marsala wine,red potato,chicken breast meat,japanese eggplant,broccoli,grain rice
title: Chicken and Rice With Japanese Eggplant and Broccoli
ingredients: 3 skinless chicken breast meat | 2 japanese eggplants | 1 cup broccoli | 1 cup chicken breast meat | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 4 cups cooked long-grain rice | 2 tablespoons rye bread
instructions: Cut chicken breats into cubes or bite sized cubes. Wash eggsnaps. Wash potatoes and brocche with vegetable oil, drain on paper towel. Cut up eggplant into 1cm/ 5 mm cubes. Wash broccoli and cut into florets. Cut up chicken breasts into 1cm/5 mm slices. Heat 1 tablespoons of oil in a saucepan. Stir fry chicken, eggplant and broccoli for 30 seconds, tossing the chicken frequently, but not allowing it to brown. Stir in chicken broth, rice and marsala and bring to boil. Cover tightly and cook over very low heat for 10 minutes. Arrange on serving platter. Garnish with rye bread. Makes, 10 servings.

title: Linguine
ingredients: 1 box linguine, with lines | 1 package sweetened cherry candy bars, chilled | 1 bell pepper, cut into rings
instructions: Cook linguine pasta in salted boiling water, until al dente according to package directions. Drain pasta and set aside. Place frozen sweetened cherry candy bar in a plastic bag or a ziploc bag and add chilled chicken breast meat. Let bag or chicken rest a moment, then remove top bag of chocolate. Cut remaining chocolate into small pieces and add to bowl. Dip warm pasta into chocolate mixture. Gently toss to coat with chocolate. Place on a plate.

title: Mexican Chocolate & Hominy Soup
ingredients: 1 cup hominy | 1/4 cup whole kernel corn | 1/4 cup chocolate, chocolate cut in half | 1/4 cup brewed coffee ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl & let sit for 15 minutes.

title: Pasta with Chiles and Pesto
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( tiny ) pasta | 2 cans sliced bamboo shoots, drained and rinsed
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Place the pasta in the pot, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked but still slightly firm, about 8 minutes. Drain, and reserve the cooking water in a pitcher, or ice water, if needed. Drain any excess water from the bamboo shoots. Stir the drained and rinsed bamboo shoots into the cooked, drained pasta. Place the flavored pasta into the refrigerator until serving.

title: Tabbouleh on the Half Shell
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bulgur | 1 tablespoon parsley | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 tablespoon rye bread, crumb or 1 tablespoon other hard crusty bread
instructions: Break open the bread or eat bread finely. Pour boiling water over bread until it is entirely submerged. It will probably take up to 15 minutes, depending on size. Place bread in bowl, pour bulghur over, and stir gently until liquid has soaked inches. Sprinkle bread with cumin into liquid. Mix well. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,rom tomato,cake flour,purple cabbage,farfalle pasta,chicken bouillon cube
title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 cup farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 3 cups purple cabbage, 1/2 inch cube, 1/2 inch cube | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 package dry rice noodles ( can use short cut ) | 1 roma tomato, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon cake flour
instructions: Cook pasta per package directions, according to package directions. Meanwhile, place cabbage in strainer and wash thoroughly. Remove leaves from cabbage.

title: Picked Leeks
ingredients: 100 g leeks ( white part only ) | 1 liter stock or 1 liter broth | 1/4 teaspoon chili oil | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | cayenne pepper
instructions: Cut off the tops from leeks until only the white part, remove the stalk and white part. Cut off the white ends and trim off the green parts. Cut the tips from the leeks, wash them and dry them well. Put them in a pan with the broth and cover with a lid. Cook in medium heat, until the leeks are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove and discard the lid. Mash the contents with a potato masher or a stick blender. Add mustard and caraway. Stir well. Replace the lid, bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Remove from heat, fluff with fork, garnish if desired and serve hot. Makes about 3 and 1 - ½ servings.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,citrus peel,whiskey,grape leaf,sherry wine,barbecue sauce
title: BBQ Steak
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh spinach leaves, washed, stems removed | 8 grape leaves | 1 ounce fresh citrus peel | 1 teaspoon whiskey | 1 ounce barbecue sauce ( tabasco ) | 2 tablespoons sauvignon blanc wine
instructions: Wash spinach and remove and pat dry. Cut stems off grape leaves. Coat spinach with bbq sauce and marinate in refrigerator for about 10 minutes, drain off excess marinade. Barbecue, grill or broil spinach.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,yellow mustard,alfredo sauce,fuji apple,eggplant,mango,grain white rice
title: Lola's Hawaiian Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice ( jasmine is best! ) or 2 cups cooked short-grain white rice ( jasmine is best! ) | 2 large fuji apples | 2 green bell peppers, cut into 3/4-inch dice | 1 container prepared alfredo sauce | 1 eggplant, chopped | 1 jar mild mangoes, drained ( fresh or canned ) | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard ( or vegetarian, of choice )
instructions: Toss all ingredients together with enough prepared alfredo sauce to coat all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: tamari soy sauce,lime juice,raspberry,vegetable oil,cider vinegar,white peppercorn,chicken thigh
title: Lime & Soy Glazed Chicken With Raspberry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs frozen raspberries ( thawed ) | 5 tablespoons tamari soy sauce ( i used bragg's amino acids ) | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon white peppercorns ( crushed ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 ounces frozen white trimmed chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Combine ingredients, except chicken, in a shallow dish and let marinate. Dry chicken and place in the bottom of a 2 qt roasting pan. Pour marinade over chicken. Cook about 40 - 45 minutes, or until juices run clear when thigh is pierced. Remove from oven and tent with foil. Let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, remove twine from chicken. Cut into 1 1/2 in pieces.

title: Lentil & Chile Pilaf  Fritters (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown lentils, rinsed | 2 cups quick cooking oil | 2 tablespoons rice | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( maize cornflour cornstarch ) | 1 small fresh chile, minced | 1 teaspoon canola oil
instructions: Cook the lentils in a large pan of boiling water in a little oil. Cook the rice until just tender. Stir to stop it sticking together. When the rice is tender, drain well. Place in a bowl and add all other ingredients except canola oil, stirring to combine. Heat the canola oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the rice mixture and mix well. Cook the mixture for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool the mixture slightly.

title: Hot Dogs
ingredients: 2 hot dogs ( recommended -- hillshire farms ) | 2 ounces slices lemon peel ( lemon size )
instructions: Wash your knife through the hot dog, removing the hard stem and excess fat from the top side of each hotdog so it will not peel more easily. Spread the lemon peel on the hot dog. Roll the hot dog in the lemon peel. Wrap each dog in heavy plastic wrap. Allow to sit 15 minutes to marinate before serving.

title: Mogul Cheese Ball
ingredients: 4 cups greek yogurt | 1/2 lb asparagus spear, tough ends snapped off and ends coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped greek shallots or 2 tablespoons leeks | 2 tablespoons chopped citron or 2 tablespoons rind, finely shredded | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 2/3 cup chopped dates | 1/4 cup grated aged asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Butter a 9 inch pie pan. In a medium bowl, add the yogurt and stir. Stir in the asparagus, shallots, citron and mustard powder. Add the dates and stir to break them into smaller pieces. Spread mixture into pie pan. Sprinkle cheese and asiago cheese evenly over top. Bake in oven until browned and slightly bubbly about 15 - 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Chipotle Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 medium green chili, canned | 1 chipotle chile | 1 cup gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Heat chilies in a frying pan, stirring all the while until they're soft, but not browned. Drain on paper towels. Remove the chili from the heat, and put in a bowl with all the chipotle. Rub the chipotle into the hot chili from the frying pan. Put the pasta in a pasta pan and add the chili, cheese and crushed ice. Stir through. Eat warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,red curry paste,salad green,olive,slightly egg white,dark sesame oil,hard egg
title: Thai Red-Cooked Eggs with Salad Greens
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 6 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon sweet chili-garlic sauce | 2 leaves basil, thinly slice into 1/8-inch thick strips | 4 tablespoons olive, sliced thin | 4 cups mixed salad greens | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Using a food processor, pulse eggs, curry paste, chili garlic sauce, and basil until well combined, stopping occasionally to scrape down the sides. Transfer mixture to a 2 quart bowl. Add olive and toss to combine. Divide greens among 4 serving plates. Drizzle with sesame oil.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,ham,ramen noodle,dill weed,chicken breast,beef bouillon cube,chickpea
title: Chicken and Ham Ramen Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb chicken breast, cut into strips | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/2 lb ham, cut into strips | 1 1/2 quarts low sodium vegetable broth | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons dried dill weed | 1 package ramen noodles
instructions: Place chicken, chickpeas, ham, vegetable broth, and chicken bouillon cube in a large stockpot.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,half cream,soy sauce,beef bouillon cube,button mushroom,red potato,lemon zest
title: Roasted Leg of Lamb With Mushrooms and Lemon
ingredients: 5 lbs red potatoes ( peeled weight ) | 1 lb ground leg of lamb | 1/2 lb butter ( cold & cut into small pieces ) | 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream ( milk ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes ( instant ) | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place whole potatoes in pot, cover with water and bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium and cover pot, cook 20 minutes or until tender. Drain, return potatoes to pot, set aside. Meanwhile, brown lamb in butter until almost cooked.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,yellow lentil,baby bok choy,honey,graham cracker crumb
title: Lentil and Bok Choy Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained ( about 24 ) | 4 baby bok choy, leaves cut into 2-inch lengths with tips left intact | 1 cup yellow lentils, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place the noodles in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,pearl barley,celery salt,palm sugar,navy bean,grainy mustard,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Bean & Cheese Chowder
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 2 teaspoons dried breadcrumbs ( from a baggy, round and spicy baggie ) | 1 package frozen pearl barley ( regular or quick-cooking type ) | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup shredded celery salt or 1 cup salt-free salt-added celery-carrot mix | 1 teaspoon celery salt or 1 teaspoon season-all celery salt | 1 tablespoon sweet grainy mustard
instructions: To make the spice mixture, in a small bowl, combine the chopped ham and italian sausage.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,back bacon,red pepper paste,nonfat milk powder,pea corn,marshmallow creme
title: Sweet and Sour Pea Corn and Bacon Cakes
ingredients: 12 slices back bacon, diced | 1/4 cup frozen peas and corn, thawed | 36 marshmallow creme | 1 1/2 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 1/2 cup red pepper paste | 1/2 lime, zest of
instructions: Crumble bacon. Set aside. In microwaveable bowl, combine peas and corn and microwave on high until just softened, stirring once. Add marshmallow creme and creme brulee to peas and corn mix. Stir until combined and microwave for 1 - 2 min, until just warm. Stir in red pepper paste and zest and transfer to small plate to cool. When corn mixture has cooled to room temperature, stir together. Form 2 cakes, 2 inch diameter, onto greased and floured cookie sheets. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze until firm, about 3 - 4 hours. To serve, slice each cake diagonally and bake in a 375 degree oven for 3 - 4 min, until lightly browned on top. Let cool slightly and transfer cakes to individual plates. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Chilean Fennel
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh fennel | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 poblano pepper | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves
instructions: Preheat grill. Sprinkle fennel with turmeric. Grill fennel for about four minutes on each side or until they begin to turn brown. Allow fennel to cool and remove skin. Remove and discard stems. Peel and discard fennel core. Cut fennel into thin slices. Wash peppers and remove stem and seeds. Devein and chop. Combine fennel, pepper and cocoa in a bowl. Add mint leaves and stir until blended. Spoon fennel mixture into bowls. Serve immediately.

title: Citrus and Chiles on Skewers
ingredients: parsnips ( peeled in pieces ) or parsnips ( peeled in pieces ) | carcass scotch bonnet pepper ( or habanero ) | 2 ounces dark chocolate | 1 cup freshly grated pecorino cheese or 1 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat the grill to moderately hot. Soak the parsnips or parsnips in water for about 5 minutes and remove and set aside. Bring 1 1/4 cups of water to boil in a medium saucepan, then throw in the scotch bonnet or habanero and boil briskly, stirring a few times, until the meat has changed color from light to dark. Drain the meat and chop into 1/4 inch chunks. Return to the saucepan and heat to boiling over very high heat until a little of the water forms a shaggy skin. Turn the heat down and add the chocolate, scraping it in along the bottom of the pan with the wooden spoon or a wire whisk. Simmer for 1 minute without stirring, and stir briskly for about a minute to melt the chocolate. Taste for seasoning and divide between 4 serving glasses. Garnish with crumbled cheese and drizzle with some of the melted chocolate if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Crispy Rigatoni With Ham, Serrano and Scallion on the Grill
ingredients: 2 lbs rigatoni pasta or 2 lbs fettuccine | 1 lb cubed ham | 1 bunch scallion, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped peanuts | 2 pinches serrano peppers or 2 green jalapeno peppers, minced | 1/2 cup tequila
instructions: In a large pot, combine pasta, ham, scallions, peanuts, peppers and tequila. Stir well and bring just to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer gently. Break up rigatoni into bite sized pieces. Keep warm until pasta is done. Garnish with chopped tomato, avocado and cilantro. Serves 6.

title: Cranberry Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 100 ml yoghurt | 3 tablespoons cranberry sauce | 1 teaspoon kahlua
instructions: Mix in a blender to make yoghurt smooth. Enjoy immediately or pack into clean wine glass. Add other ingredients, including the kahlua.

title: Dulce De Leche Tuna
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained | 1/3 cup dulce de leche
instructions: Open the can of tuna and drain. Open the can and drain the tuna. Place tuna onto a plate or bowl. Sprinkle tuna with dulce de leche. Serve cold.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin | 20 ounces frozen mixed frozen vegetables | 1/2 cup dry yeast ( rapid rise ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Spray a 10x15 inch jelly roll or roasting pan with cooking spray. Cut pork into 1 inch cubes. Layer pork and frozen vegetables in the pan, beginning and ending with frozen vegetables. In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Sprinkle yeast over the top. Cover with a towel, and let stand for five minutes. Uncover the pan and place in the oven to bake for 40 - 50 minutes, or until browned.

Random Ingredients: ha avocadoes,bisquick,garlic clove,cranberry,cherrystone clam,italian sausage link,feta cheese
title: Italian Sausage & Clam Mini  Clams in Feta Cheese Crispy Foil
ingredients: 4 italian sausage links | 1 cup bisquick | 300 g cranberries | 2 hass avocadoes | 2 garlic cloves | 20 cherrystone clams | 200 g feta cheese
instructions: Bake your clams until just set in the center. While waiting dice up the sausages. Put flour & baking crumbs in a bowl and mix thoroughly till crumbly. Dice up avocados into small pieces. Mince up garlic. Dice clams up into larger pieces. Dice up the cherries & set aside. After clams open them up & sprinkle with cheese. Place sausages on top of cheese. Using a paper lined cookie sheet pan, begin rolling your clams into a large rectangle. Make sure the cheese & clam mixture doesn't leak out the shell. Take a piece of aluminum foil approximately 10' x 7'. Place one clam, clam side up, on top of each other and roll it up placing the open end first. When you have rolled you should have a large circle, so put the casserole on a cookie sheet pan & bake in a 450 oven till cheese is melted. Remove pan from oven & lay on your remaining cheese. After your cheese has melted take your whole clams out of the shells & place with the cheese on top of the cheese, place under broiler to melt. If this is too much for your taste then take your casserole out & place in a 150 oven for anther 30 - 40 minutes then enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,chili pepper,date,nicoise olive,plain flour,pistachio nut,honey,pepperoni sausage
title: Mushroom, Pistachio and Hot Pepperoni Pizza
ingredients: 400 g prepared pizza dough ( or prepared ) | 150 g bran-free wholemeal flour | 200 g chopped cremini mushrooms | 150 g chopped hot chili peppers | 200 g chopped prawns ( shrimp ) | 200 g sliced pepperoni sausages | 100 g chopped pistachio nuts | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 cup roughly chopped nicoise olive
instructions: For the pizza bases, place a pizza tray on a rolling pin or board. Lightly flour. Place dough on pizza tray. Prick base with a fork. Add pizza base ingredients to a food processor or blender. Pulse until mixture resembles bread crumbs. Transfer dough to a bowl and chill for 1 hour. Roll out dough slightly and place onto oven tray. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove biscuits from oven and cool. For the salad, combine the pesto ingredients in a small bowl. Thinly slice peppers. Thinly slice sausage. To arrange, place cheese slices on pizza base. Remove base from oven. Place hot pepperoni sausage, pesto and pepperoni. Top with a sprinkling of pistachios. Bake for 1 - 2 minutes or until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,chili sauce,blueberry,orange juice,lime wedge,garlic clove,red curry paste,sherry wine
title: Easy and Fast Thai Curry Chilled Blueberry & Chive Tango Soup
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh blueberries ( depending on size ) | 1 quart vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 4 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/4 - 1/3 cup fresh orange juice | chili sauce ( to garnish, sriracha is recommended )
instructions: Place blueberries in a bowl with a tight lid. Pour broth over in bowl until all berries are submerged and have popped. Add curry paste and garlic. Mix well. Set aside to marinate for 1 hour or up to overnight. For best results refrigerate overnight. Toast the chive shells a minute or two at a time under a broiler, or place on a tray in the oven for just a few minutes. Set aside to cool. Combine in a large bowl, and stir in lime juice, sriracha, orange juice and chili sauce. Serve hot, garnished with sprigs of cilantro if desired.

Random Ingredients: spelt flour,single malt scotch whiskey,orange juice,salad oil,red chili,apricot,cumin seed
title: Smoky Beer & Apricot Smorgas
ingredients: 3/4 cup mixed spelt flour | 2 tablespoons single malt scotch whiskey | 1 orange, juice of | 5 spiced smoked spelt scotch whiskey | 1 medium red chili | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | sea salt, pepper, and vinegar taste | 3 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: To make the marinade, combine the flour, Whiskey, orange juice, chili, cumin and a pinch of salt and pepper and orange zest, whisk well until smooth before adding the oil. Add a few drops of olive oil if the batter feels dry, otherwise stir in a tablespoon of scotch. Cover and set aside in a cool place overnight, until thick enough to pour over fried meat.

title: Fettuccine With Mexican Dressing
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dry fettuccine pasta | 4 ounces cremini mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1/2 cup fresh shaved radish | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 1/2 large lemon ( zested and sliced thinly )
instructions: Cook fettucine in large pot in slated water till just to the package directions. While the pasta cooks, rinse mushrooms and slice thinly. Drain pasta, then set aside. Remove mushroom slices from strainer set over bowl, reserving liquid. Slice mushrooms. When the pasta is done, drain and toss with reserved mushroom liquid, mushrooms and radishes. Add oregano and fresh lemon zest and toss. Serve warm or cold.

title: Coconut Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili, minced | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger ( i use fresh ginger root cut into smaller pieces ) | 1 lb ground beef chuck | 1 package dried kielbasa, cut into 2-inch pieces ( or substitute 1 lb. turkey sausage ) | 1 cup shredded fresh coconut
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f combine all ingredients in large bowl. Roll into 1 inch balls about the size of an ounce of meatballs. Place on baking sheet with about 1 inch between each mound. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until meat is cooked through.

title: Shrimp Apple Teacakes
ingredients: 24 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 can apple pie filling | 3/4 cup strong tea
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook shrimp in hot water to cover 3 minutes. Dipping sauce, combine apple pie filling and tea.

title: Norwegian Oven-Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 10 russet potatoes, cut into rounds | 1 cup buttermilk ( or milk of 1/2 - 3/4 cup ) | 10 slices lean pork
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Spread the potatoes out on a baking sheet or baking pan in a roasting pan. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until done, turning about 8 times. Set aside to cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,banana leaf,white fish fillet,onion,cherry tomato,feta,bechamel sauce,stock
title: Mediterranean Fish With Anchovies & Feta Soup
ingredients: 8 anchovies fillets | 8 ounces firm white fish fillets, skinned ( boneless ) | 3 cups stock | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 cans cannabel hot bechamel sauce | 8 cherry tomatoes ( use halved ) | 1 large onion, chopped | 8 ounces spaghetti, broken ( uncooked )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Drain anchovies reserving liquid. Place anchovies in a shallow baking pan and broil 3 - 4 minutes, or until lightly browned. Coat fish with 1 tbsp oil and reserve for garnish with a little of the anchovies. Bake fish uncovered for 10 minutes. Meanwhile heat remaining oil in a large saucepan. Add tomatoes and onions and cook uncovered 8 - 10 minutes until tomatoes are soft and sauce is thickened slightly. Stir in anchovies and simmer gently. Meanwhile cook spaghetti for 8 - 10 minutes, or until just tender. Drain. Drain. Add anchovies, reheat gently. Place tomatoes and onions in the bowls of a large heated soup tureen. Top with anchovies. Add hot bechamel and warm noodles. Garnish with cherry tomatoes and onions.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Mango and Onions
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 medium spanish onion, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup mangoes or 1/2 cup other tropical fruit, chopped | 2 tablespoons rigatoni pasta, uncooked, kept warm
instructions: Heat large sauté pan over high heat. Add pork tenderloin and sear on all sides, about 1 minute per side. Remove from pan, reserving pan juices. Add onion and deglaze pan with pan juices, about 3 minutes. Stir in mango and cook until tender, about 1 minute. Cook pasta according to package directions. Add pork to pasta mixture. Cook over medium heat until pork is tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in warm rigatoni and heat through.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,oyster sauce,chili flake,cream,red snapper,plain flour,lemon orange peel
title: Red Snapper With Chilli
ingredients: 2 lbs red snapper | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1/2 cup light cream | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon dried chili flakes | 1 tablespoon candied lemon orange peel, grated | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Place snapper on foil, skin side down, on oven tray. Brush with flour, bake at 400°f for 15 minutes. Turn. Brush with oil. Remove foi browned skin. Brush with oil. Season to taste. Combine remaining 3 ingredients and pour over fish. Season well with salt & pepper. Bake at 400f for 15 - 20 minutes or until flesh is light brown. Sprinkle with parsley.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,chutney,tomato puree,tomatillo,red chilies,greek yogurt,green cardamom pod
title: Tomato Masala(Tomato Chutney Chutney Dip)
ingredients: 1 lb tomatillo, husked and washed | 2 fresh red chilies, deveined | 3 whole green cardamom pods, deveined | 1 1/2 cups thick greek yogurt | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/2 cup chutney
instructions: Remove and discard husks from tomatillos.

title: Cashews (Cashews Must Love!)
ingredients: 1 cup peanuts, raw, shelled, lightly salted, skin left on | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder ( available at middle eastern markets ) | 1 tablespoon dark rum ( available at middle eastern markets ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cashews, roughchopped, to cover nuts ( can be mixed nuts )
instructions: Place peanuts on a plate. Pour hot water over peanuts until they are cool enough to handle. Dry peanuts on a paper towel. Dry nuts on a clean plate. Mix together turmeric and rum in a glass jar with a tight fitting lid. Pour rum mixture over dried nuts. Cover jar and store in a dark place, shaking the jar often to mix. Note, to store in this way, place nuts in a plastic bag when ready to use, and store well away from direct sunlight.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,baby green,chili pepper,halibut,chili paste,egg white,vermicelli,palm oil
title: Lebanese Chicken and Dumplings
ingredients: 1 lb skinless halibut, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup vermicelli, broken into short noodles | 1 medium chilies, chopped or 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 2 egg whites | 1 cup baby greens | 2 tablespoons palm oil | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon dried chili peppers
instructions: Boil water in a 2 quart saucepan. Add broken vermicelli noodles and boil for 4 minutes longer. Drain with a slotted spoon and set aside. In the same saucepan, add vermicelli noodles, chopped chilies or chili paste and stir to coat. Cook over low heat 2 minutes until tender but not dry. Add egg whites, greens, palm oil, marjoram, and chili peppers and stir to combine. Add cooked noodles and toss to combine. Put in a large baking dish lined with wax paper or aluminum foil. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes, until noodles are tender and golden.

Random Ingredients: grain brown rice,chicken breast half,cake flour,italian breadcrumb
title: Italian-Style Chicken Cutlets
ingredients: 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup italian-style breadcrumbs | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, pounded to 1/8 inch thickness | 5 tablespoons cake flour | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Combine 3/4 cup cake flour and 1/4 cup bread crumbs. Dip chicken into flour mixture, then press in bread crumbs to coat. Place chicken on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 375f degrees for 35 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. While chicken is baking, combine 1/4 cup cake flour and 1/2 cup bread crumbs in a small bowl. Heat a skillet over medium heat.

title: Chile Cheese (Chile) Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon chile chile paste, paste ( available at asian market ) | 12 ounces hamburger buns, toasted
instructions: Heat chile paste in small skillet, stirring often, until fragrant and starting to brown, about 20 seconds. Brush cut sides of toasted buns with chile paste.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,scotch bonnet pepper,ladyfinger,lemon pepper,fenugreek seed
title: Chile Pepper Girl's Ring Dainties
ingredients: 1 teaspoon black greek seeds, ground | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 1/3 cup corn oil | 1 1/2 pounds chile pepper ladyfingers, split in half horizontally | 1/4 cup lemon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Toast black greek and fenugreek seeds in a dry skillet over low heat until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Remove skin from chile peppers. Cut into small chunks. Spread 1 tablespoon chile powder into the bottom of an 8 inch tart or ring mold.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,rosemary,cumin powder,greek yogurt,cornstarch,angel hair pasta,chickpea,vegetable oil cooking
title: Moroccan Beef With Chickpeas and Pasta With Yogurt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 cups canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 package angel hair pasta, broken into bite-sized chunks | 1 cup greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: In large skillet, heat oil over med heat. Add beef.

title: Fried Harissa
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable shortening, or as needed | 4 teaspoons harissa
instructions: Break the shortening into a bowl with the harissa paste by pouring it through a sieve lined with a rubber filter. The mixture will be soggy. Cover in a dry skillet over medium heat until the surface is covered, and allow to simmer, stirring occasionally, until the mixture turns a deep golden brown color. This could take up to 15 minutes and could take up to 10 minutes with a pot holder, to ensure even coating on the bottom. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly, then break into small pieces.

title: Italian Cheese Pie
ingredients: 12 ounces italian tomatoes ( not sweetened ) | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 cup cashews ( toasted and chopped ) | 2 unbaked pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Mix together the diced tomatoes, cream corn and cashews and place into a bowl. Pour into the pie shell. Bake for 1 hour or until set. Cut into slices and serve.

title: Greek Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground sage | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle sage with mace.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,gold tequila,chili pepper flake,yukon gold potato,golden syrup,broth,baby spinach,clove
title: Korean Potato and Spinach Stew
ingredients: 1/2 ounce gold tequila | 12 ounces baby yukon gold potatoes | 4 tablespoons golden syrup | 4 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup broth | 12 ounces frozen spinach, defrosted and squeezed dry | 1 tablespoon fresh minced garlic | 1/2 fluid ounce bourbon or 1/2 fluid ounce kern's golden syrup
instructions: Start the fire, if using charcoal. You can also burn your gas grill. Put a small amount of olive oil on a fry tray and grill korean potatoes on it turning as needed until soft and well browned on both sides. Remove potatoes from heat and peel. Cut into bite size chunks. In a saucepan, heat 1/2 ounce gold tequila with 1/2 ounce baby yukon gold potatoes. Turn down the heat, stir in the golden syrup, chili flakes and chicken stock, cover and simmer until potatoes are just tender. In a large mixing bowl, combine frozen spinach, garlic, and bourbon. Add the hot potatoes and spinach mixture to the pan and simmer for 5 minutes over medium heat. Serve the pan with steamed rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,rigatoni pasta,salt,ginger garlic paste
title: Rigatoni Ala Raygan
ingredients: 2 pounds rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1/2 pound ginger-garlic paste, or more to taste | 1/2 cup minced red chile peppers | salt to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rigatoni, and return to a boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Place the rinsed out pasta into a serving dish, and toss with 1/4 pound of ginger garlic paste, red chili peppers, and salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,celery,wheat bread,portabella mushroom,paprika,ice cube,yellow bell pepper
title: Portabella Mushroom Health Lovers
ingredients: 2 cups soymilk | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 9 large portabella mushrooms, cleaned and thinly sliced | 2 yellow bell peppers, julienned | 2 stalks celery, sliced into half inch thick slices | 4 cups ice cubes, or more as needed | 3 large yellow bread slices, cut in half horizontally, and cut diagonally to desired thickness
instructions: Place soymilk in a glass bowl, and mix in paprika. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. Stir soymilk mixture, mushrooms, peppers, and celery into the soymilk mixture until well incorporated. Refrigerate 5 minutes, or until peppers are softened. Pour into an ice cube tray, and freeze for about 1 hour to firm, stirring every 10 minutes. When ready to serve, remove from the tray, and slice horizontally into desired thick slices. Strain soymilk soup, and serve with bread slices.

title: Mushroom and Garlic Baked Beans
ingredients: 4 lbs cremini mushrooms | 1 head garlic, separated into cloves and peeled or 1 head garlic | 1 tablespoon minced sumac | 2 lbs baby spinach  mixed with 1lb of cooked beans ( see below ) | 4 lbs ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar or 1 1/2 cups brown sugar, packed
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300°f. Slice mushrooms in half if any stems are large. Put mushrooms and garlic in baking dish and sprinkle the sumac over them. Make the basting sauce, put mushrooms and garlic in bowl and cover with cold water. Drain any salt from water in bowl. Dry off any excess moisture and put to the side. Make the beans bake, wash and slice spinach in half if large. Put the beans in a pan of boiling water and let cook until just softened, about 5 minutes, depending on the size of the spinach. Drain well. Put sugar and remaining 2 garlic cloves in frying pan and stir. Cook for about 30 seconds on low heat until you can smell the garlic oil. Quickly stir in spinach mixture. Cook for about 5 more minutes stirring to ensure that leaves are separated. Drain the basting sauce on the spinach. When ready to serve, put the noodles in individual oven proof casseroles. Put the spinach mixture on top of the noodles. Put in oven for 10 minutes or until basting. When serving, put a dollop of olive oil on top of the beans.

title: Green Beans With Chocolate (Microwave)
ingredients: 12 1/2 ounces french style green beans | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 1/4 cup ice water
instructions: Microwave beans on high power for 6 minutes, uncovered. Stir. Add chocolate water. Cover tightly. Microwave on high for 7 minutes. Stir. Microwave on high for 2 minutes, uncovered. Stir. Cover tightly. Microwave on high for 2 minutes, uncovered, on high power.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,bicarbonate soda,poblano chile,kernel corn,cottage cheese
title: Mexican Popcorn
ingredients: 100 g cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 poblano chiles, finely diced | 2 tablespoons whole kernel corn
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 180 degrees celsius. In a food processor, grind the cottage cheese into crumbs or powder. Stir in the soy sauce, bicarbonate of soda and diced poblanos then add the corn and mix well. The result should be a slightly sticky batter. Spray a small oven dish with cooking oil. Spoon 1 tablespoon of mixture into dish then bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until topping is golden and crisp.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,ortega chile,white hominy,curry powder,tahini,brown sugar,cooking oil,kosher salt black pepper
title: Santa Fe Pork Stew
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds bone-in rump roast | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 1 package ortega chile | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 can white hominy, drained | 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed | 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rub the roast with the quickcooking oil, sprinkle the roast with salt and pepper, and place it in a roasting pan. Cut an opening in one side of the meat, and stuff it with Ortega chiles, skin side up. Combine the water and tahini in a container with a lid, stirring to blend. Pour over the meat. Roast in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the roast triples to 400 degrees f. Remove from oven, cover, and allow meat to sit at room temperature for 15 minutes. Turn out the roast, reserving liquid, and set aside in a separate roasting pan. Place the chile in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside. Strain the chile cooking liquid through a strainer into a saucepan and discard the solids. Rinse and discard solids and place chile solids in a saucepan. Place over medium high heat, and cook until the chile is fragrant and dark red in color, about 20 minutes. Pour in the hominy and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: chutney,seasoning salt,button mushroom,heavy cream,jalapeno pepper,beef roast,bicarbonate soda,pancetta
title: Lazy Beef Roast with Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg beef roast | 200 g pancetta, strips finely chopped | 1 bunch fresh button mushrooms ( shiitake or baby bellas are good choices ) | 4 tablespoons chutney, thick and tangy, to serve ( we used red onion salsa ) | 4 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda ( optional ) | seasoning salt | 1 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped, to garnish
instructions: Cut beef into thick slices. Sprinkle with salt and bicarbonate of soda. Place in roasting pan and brown under a high heat. Put pancetta strips, mushrooms, chotela cheese and cream into a pan and pour over beef. Cover tightly and bake in a moderate oven for 3 - 3 1/2 hours or until tender and tender when pricked with a skewer. Garnish with hot chutney and fresh jalapeno as desired. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Swedish Melted Cheese Cubes
ingredients: 12 tablespoons softened american cheese | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | hot paprika
instructions: Mash the butter into a soft paste using the back of a spoon or your hands. Sprinkle or stir in the chives. Place the cubed ball of butter between 2 or 3 cubes of wax paper which have been dipped in hot paprika. Press lightly. Arrange the cubed melted cheese cubes in a single layer on a plate. Place in a slow oven. The cheese should be melted. Serve with assorted crackers.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,sherry wine,white breadcrumb,brandy,red potato,pork rib,baguette
title: Pork Spareribs (Portuguese Pork With Potatoes)
ingredients: 8 -10 pork ribs ( with bone ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 4 tablespoons white breadcrumbs | 2 large red potatoes | vegetable oil | 1 baguette
instructions: Trim excess fat from ribs. Remove skin from pork, cut off and reserve 3 ribs for garnish. Cut remaining ribs into 1 1/2 slices. Place on plate and cover with a plate. In shallow dish, pour brandy over pork and turn to coat. Allow to marinate for at least 30 minutes overnight in refrigerator. Remove pork from marinade, drain and discard the marinade. Place ribs on plate and discard marinade. Prepare grill to medium. Grill pork, brushing with reserved marinade for 5 minutes per side. In 10 inch skillet heat reserved pork fat over medium high heat turning several times. Transfer pan to grill. Serve pork in a warm shallow bowl with bread crumbs. Garnish pork with potato slices. Drizzle with sherry, turning gently until potatoes are glazed well. Serve pork with pork.

Random Ingredients: turnip,peanut oil,apple cider,extra sharp cheddar cheese,veal,red chile pepper,salsa
title: Pork Cheddar and Turnip Hash
ingredients: 1 whole turnip | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 red chile pepper, chopped | 1 cup shredded extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 2/3 cup salsa ( optional ) | 2/3 pound ground veal
instructions: Place turnip on a paper towel, and sprinkle with salt, and let sit for 10 minutes. Peel turnip, and cut lengthwise into 1/3 inch thick slices. Set cut side down on a lightly oiled baking sheet, and cover with another paper towel, and pat out the excess water until no more water remains. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle the turnip with salt, and saute until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Set the turnip aside and stir in the chile pepper. Remove the turnip when golden brown on the edges, and sprinkle with cheddar cheese. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer the turnip and chile mixture for about 10 minutes. Stir in salsa, and continue to simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes more.

title: Lizard Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 8 -10 ounces extra firm tofu | 1/3 cup fresh raspberries ( or more ) or 1/3 cup blueberries ( or more ) | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | ice cube | lime wedge
instructions: Cut tofu into four pieces lengthwise and cut into 1 chunks. Combine teriyaki sauce, tofu, raspberries and ginger. Pour into shallow glass casserole dish and let sit 2 to 3 hours while the tofu is marinating. Drain mixture well and serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: coconut rum,black cardamom pod,leek,yoghurt,rice,porcini mushroom,salsa,fennel seed
title: Baked Rice With Mushroom & Coconut
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice, raw ( not instant ) | 1 liter of good quality coconut rum, good quality ( e.g. coco rico ) | 2 fresh black cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 small leeks, white part only, cleaned and washed | 4 tablespoons fresh salsa | 1 tablespoon porcini mushroom, sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon light yoghurt
instructions: Place the coconut rum and black cardamom pods in a non aluminum saucepan, bring to a boil over medium heat. Lower the heat and simmer without turning up the heat to medium. Watch this carefully so that the rum does not burn. Add the fennel seed and leeks to the coconut rum mixture and cook for about 5 minutes or until the leeks have softened and begin to wilt. Remove from heat and allow to cool for an hour or two. Pre heat the oven to 150 °c. Place the rice into a bowl, cover with boiling water, leave the rice in the water and add salt and plenty of sea salt to taste when the rice is done, drain and add it to the hot coconut rum mixture. Place a baking sheet into the oven and turn the heat to 200 °c when the baking sheet has become hot turn off the oven and leave the baking dish inside. Place a glass bowl on top of the baking dish and invert to transfer the baking dish. Place the baking dish back into oven for a further 15 - 20 minutes to warm through. Remove from the oven after the 15 - 20 minutes and leave until cool. When cool set, cut a circle or rectangle by working from the center outwards, using a knife. Slice the circle from the center outwards, using a knife, cutting the mixture down from the central to the middle, then into the same shape as before. Place this mixture into the serving dish and scatter some more porcini mushrooms on top of the rice. Place some yoghurt into a small bowl with some water, and the rest of the coconut rum to add a little sweetness. Spoon this mixture over the top of the rice and stir gently so that everything blends into the rice and ingredients. Cover the dish tightly with foil and keep in the fridge for at least six hours, or overnight, for best results before serving.

title: Hard-Boiled Egg Toast
ingredients: 4 large hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 2 slices baguette
instructions: Cut egg yolks in half and slice thin. Arrange egg slices in a small, flat dish, or a casserole with bread in a single layer. Sprinkle egg yolks over, and gently press with fingers to coat egg whites and ensure each egg is evenly stuffed. Cover the dish or casserole tightly with the lid the weigh. Peel the baguette. Cut baguette into 3 slices, or sandwich them together with the egg yolks. Warm in a 450f oven just until bread is warm and toast is slightly crisp.

title: Quick Beef and Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 1 package uncooked lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 lbs rump roast or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1 can petite yellow sweet peppers, in water, drained and cut into strips | 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup chopped fenugreek
instructions: In a dutch oven, brown meat. Stir in teriyaki sauce, peppers and fenugreek.

title: Chili Oil
ingredients: 1 pound beef or 1 pound lamb, cubed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large skillet and simmer over low heat until meat is tender, about 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Chipotle and Watercress Soup
ingredients: 1 cup water | 2 dried chipotle peppers | 1 bunch fresh watercress leaves | 2 1/2 tablespoons tapioca
instructions: Place the water into the bowl of a blender. Break each chipotle pepper into chunks with a spoon. Pour into the blender with the water and begin blending until you have a small bit of chunky sauce consistency. Add your peppers to the blender and blend for about 15 seconds or until the peppers have a tiny bit of chunky sauce. Scrape your blender bowl in with the chipotle watercress. Pour in the tapioca and blend it until it looks creamy. Heat over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until boiling. This soup can also be served with rice, pasta, meats, poultry or meat loaf lunches. If you find the tapioca too thick, stir it in with the broth, or gently add the tapioca to the stew before serving.

title: Couscous With Broccoli Rabe and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 3 ounces fresh gingerroot, peeled and thinly sliced | 5 ounces broccoli rabe, trimmed, chopped | 2 cups peeled parsnips, peeled, sliced diagonally into 1/2 inch slices | 1 1/2 cups couscous | 4 ounces fresh button mushrooms, stemmed, washed, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup amaretto liqueur, warmed
instructions: Set rice cooker to 'warm' setting. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add ginger and cook stirring frequently, about 3 minutes. Add broccoli rabe, parsnips and mushrooms.

title: Indian Spiced Rub for Beef
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 lb trimmed trimmed and trimmed sirloin steak ( cut into 4 equal portions )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Rub mixture all over the meat.

Random Ingredients: orange,chicken breast meat,ginger,red cabbage,fettuccine pasta,orange zest,chickpea flour,currant
title: Orange Fettuccine With Chicken
ingredients: 1 orange | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon chopped preserved ginger | 1 3/4 lbs red cabbage, thinly sliced | 2 cans chickpea flour | 1 pound chicken breast meat, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 cup dried currant | hot cooked fettuccine pasta, to serve
instructions: Whizz the orange zest, orange zest, ginger, and cabbage in a blender or food processor until pureed and smooth, 1 - 2 minutes. Transfer to a large, non reactive bowl, add the chickpea flour, and stir to combine. Add the chicken, currants, and orange zest mixture and mix well to combine. Set aside 20 minutes. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain the pasta and toss with the sauce to coat. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sauce,beef broth,kidney bean,olive,beef,picante sauce,part mozzarella cheese
title: Cheesy Baked Beans
ingredients: 6 ounces ground beef, cooked and drained | 1 can ready canned kidney beans, drained ( not drained ) | 1/4 cup bottled hot sauce, divided ( i use tabasco ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 2 cups low sodium beef broth | 1 cup frozen cut olives | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine all items except the mozzarella cheese and top with cheese. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over top just before serving. Bake uncovered, 30 minutes at 375°f.

title: Korean Broiled Wings
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, or to taste | 2 pounds chicken wings
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Place sesame seeds on a plate or small bowl sprinkling some sesame seeds over the surface. Place chicken wings on the sesame seeds. Spray grill with cooking spray or brush with oil. Place the bags on the grill, close lid, and place in the preheated grill. Close grill lid and cook wings 15 minutes, or until chicken is very tender. Turn bags over during cooking. Remove from grill and cool slightly. Stir sesame oil and serve.

title: Capellini
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup fat free chicken stock or 1 cup low sodium broth | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Coat a shallow nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat over medium high heat until hot. Saute chicken until it is no longer pink. Transfer chicken to a plate. Add broth to meat in skillet. Heat to boiling and reduce liquid until it is mostly syrupy. Drizzle chicken with reduced fat liquid. Sprinkle parsley over top. Serve at once.

title: Crab Sandwich Like Swiss Steak With Anchovies
ingredients: 4 slices swiss cheese | 1/4 lb fresh crabmeat | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste | 4 ounces crabmeat
instructions: Lay 1 slice of swiss cheese on the bread, spread with 1/4 pound of the crab meat. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon anchovy paste. Close bread and cut in half or quarters.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,nonfat plain yogurt,french vanilla pudding,celery leaf,romaine lettuce,heavy cream
title: Gourmet French Vanilla Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1 package french vanilla instant pudding | 1 container heavy cream | 4 stalks celery & leaves, julienned | 1 medium cucumber, cut into thin julienne strips | 4 cups romaine lettuce
instructions: Add 1/2 cup of nonfat plain yogurt to 1 cup of nonfat plain yogurt. Add 2 pkgs. Instant vanilla pudding. Whisk and set aside for 30 minutes. When ready to serve, add the remaining 1/2 cup of nonfat plain yogurt and mix well. Serve over romaine lettuce.

title: Peas and Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon oil | 1 small eggplant, sliced | 2 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks or pieces | 2 ounces leeks, sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaf, roughly chopped | 2 cans butter beans, well rinsed
instructions: Heat a few tablespoons of butter, oil, celery or potato in a large skillet with over high heat until browned, 1 - 2 minutes. Add eggplant and leeks. Reduce heat and cook, stirring often, until eggplant is soft, about 10 minutes. Add sage and cook for 2 minutes. Add 1 to 2 cans of butter beans and heat through.

title: Fried Olives
ingredients: 12 large black olives | 4 tablespoons sake
instructions: Wash olives and dry with kitchen towels. Score with knife in horizontal lines. Set aside. Heat 1 tbs. Oil in deep fryer to 375°f or until drops of water dance on its surface. Pour a tsp. Of the oil slowly into the oil. When the oil is hot, deep fry the olives in batches as they brown, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate to drain. Sprinkle with sake. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,golden raisin,cornflour,phyllo pastry,arborio rice,tabasco sauce,maple syrup,jumbo pasta shell
title: Bourekakia
ingredients: 450 g uncooked jumbo pasta shells | 8 cups fresh broccoli florets | 100 g golden raisins | 50 g cornflour | 100 g arborio rice or 100 g carnaroli rice | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 200 g phyllo pastry | 3 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 c, lightly grease a large baking dish. Place the pasta shells in a large pot of boiling water over high heat. When they soften, remove with a slotted spoon. Drain and set aside. In a large bowl, place the broccoli, raisins, cornflour and rice. Mix gently so the rice does not break apart and separate. Once the noodles are cooked, drain and place the noodles on a kitchen towel to wipe dry any excess water. In a second bowl, place 1 cup of water and 2 tbsp of maple syrup and mix carefully to make a batter. To build, lay 1 sheet of phyllo pastry on a board. Brush it lightly with some melted butter on half sheet, then lay another sheet on top. You should have a rectangle about 1/8 of an inch thick. Take a second sheet, spread it lightly with more melted butter and top that with the first, then spread to make a half sheet. Repeat till you have a second half sheet and 7 sheets of phyllo stacked, brushing each with butter. Once the first 5 layers are layered, spread 1/2 cup of rice or carnaroli rice on top. Then place a third sheet of pastry on top then lay on top so it should end up with a pastry rectangle and the amount of filling you plan to make. Cut the squares away from each other in half and brush the pastry with remaining melted butter so the cubes don't stick to the pan. Place a generous tablespoon of the filling evenly over the rice. Fold that corner over like a flag and tuck it underneath. Brush the triangle with a small amount of melted butter, make 5 air holes in the square and repeat with the remaining pastry and filling. Brush the triangles with some melted butter and place the triangles on the baking dish. Bake for 40 mins on the middle shelf, until golden brown. Serve hot. Chef's tip, if made with rice instead of rice it may be easier to make. You can cook rice with the maple syrup in the pan without adding cornflour, which has been treacle. Alternatively, you could use an extra cup of boiling water to make a paste and stir into the rice before adding the cornflour. You may also use a slightly more concentrated rice, but be careful not to add too much at first.

title: French Bread
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 envelope active dry yeast, divided
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together 1/2 cup arborio rice and yeast. Let sit until yeast has dissolved, about 10 minutes. Stir in 1/2 cup water. Allow to stand 5 minutes. Stir to blend. Transfer to two bread pans lined with parchment paper or waxed paper. Allow to rise in a warm place until dough doubles in size, about 1 hour. Punch down dough, knead and let rise again until about 1/2 the original size. Punch down again and knead. Place in bread pans, cover and allow to rise 1 hour more. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake in preheated oven until bread is golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,italian salad dressing,ham hock,dijon mustard,sugar,cumin powder,red potato,mango nectar
title: Lamb-Lh-Tenderloin Sandwich for Two
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs pork tenderloin, fat trimmed | 8 -12 slices fresh ham hocks | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons mango nectar | 3/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon sugar | 3 medium red potatoes, boiled, peeled, quartered
instructions: Place the pork tenderloins on a cutting board and place under a hot broiler or in the toaster. Turn once to brown all sides. Place pork tenderloins in a single layer on a platter and cover loosely with foil. After about 20 minutes, remove foil and raise heat to 350°. To make dressing, combine dressing, mustard, mango nectar, cumin and sugar in a small bowl. Pour dressing over pork and sprinkle with potatoes. Serve and enjoy.

title: Lime and Hot Milk
ingredients: 1 cup lime juice ( or orange can ) | 2 cans reduced-sodium chicken broth ( or vegetable broth ), undiluted
instructions: Combine all ingredients in one large nonreactive bowl. Cover and chill 1 hour to blend flavors. Use for flavoring, vingishing up or adding cream to sauce. Add to your favorite salsa. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,phyllo dough,brandy,chocolate,chestnut mushroom,cardamom pod,asafoetida powder,mango chutney
title: Churros With Mango Chutney (Paneer Khurma)
ingredients: 1 cup chestnut mushrooms, sliced | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon dry mango chutney | 2 teaspoons brandy | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 12 sheets phyllo dough | 2 tablespoons chopped bittersweet dried unsweetened chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Toast mushrooms in the oven, until tender and liquid released. Drain, and set aside with 1 cup of the mushroom soaking liquid. Mix ricotta with chutney, brandy, cardamom, chestnut mushroom, and salt and pepper to taste until creamy and smooth. Stir into the churros, then set aside. Cut sheets of phyllo into four squares. Place each square, 1 inch apart, on a parchment lined baking sheet. Brush the tops of each square with a generous tablespoon of the reserved mushroom soaking liquid. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of chocolate, if desired. Cover with more phyllo, and repeat with more phyllo and chocolate. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for about 18 minutes, or until the phyllo has absorbed the margarine and becomes crisp and toasted.

title: Macaroni Noodle Beef Soup
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni noodles | 2 cups beef broth
instructions: Cook macaroni noodles until tender, drain and reserve. Combine with broth into crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours. Serve with garlic bread, grated cheese or crouton.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,celery rib,chicken stock,salmon fillet,cold butter,pineapple chunk,chicken bouillon,pecorino romano cheese
title: Smoked Salmon Pecorino
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 500 g fresh smoked salmon fillet, skinned, cut into strips | 3 celery ribs, very thinly sliced | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained, rinsed and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup soymilk | 3 cups chicken stock | 2 cubes chicken bouillon | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated ( reserve a few extra slices )
instructions: Melt the butter and gently cook the salmon pieces, stirring frequently, until lightly browned. Remove from the pan and keep warm. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and leave to stand, covered, for 10 minutes, then remove the lid and bake at 250°c until the juices rise to the surface. Scatter over the cheese and serve accompanied by the pecorino romano.

title: Choklad - Mint Green Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mint leaves, packed | 1 lb dried green beans, washed
instructions: Combine mint leaves & beans in a medium bowl, then cover with hot water.

instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, until al dente drain and rinse under cold water. Combine the flours with salt and pepper to taste. title: Taco Casserole

title: Irish Bread Crumb Mix

title: Italian-Mocha Truffles

title: Prawn Salad With Pineapple

title: Cheese and Grainy Noodle Salad

title: Mexican Finger Loves

instructions: If using texas style fingerlings, wash and clean before cooking. You want to prevent the sauce from forming into finger lumps, or it may not take long to cook. instructions: Cook pasta and drain. Put aside in bowl. Add remaining ingredients except for pasta cooking liquid and ice water in food processor. Process until combined. title: L'ocs Baked Salmon with Mushrooms and Lettuce
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs sea trout, headless whole | 2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 2 lemons, zest of | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 2 cups sweet marsala or 2 cups sweet dessert applesauce ( sweet dessert applesauce ) | 12 raw mussels, scrubbed clean | 1 bag confit fresh mushrooms | lemon slice, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare a large roasting pan with cooking spray. Place fish head side up on a baking sheet and scatter over the fine sea salt on top. If using whole fish, preheat oven to 425 degrees f. If using heads of fish you may need to cut them down to make them fit. Otherwise, cut fish into chunks. Remove and discard giblets and heads from fish. Place the fish onto a cutting board and using a sharp, damp knife, cut slices 1/4 thick and then into 1/4 lengths. Repeat with remaining fish. Place a roasting pan on the broiler and put the rack in the middle position. Place the mussels on a cookie sheet and broil just until the tops open, 2 or 3 minutes. Immediately remove from oven and carefully remove any beards. Add the fish to a serving platter, spooning some of their juices into the pan. Set aside. Remove the fish heads from their shells. Discard any shells that have not opened. Place the mussels in a bowl. Add the wine to the empty pan and bring to a boil over high heat, scraping the bottom to loosen any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Boil until reduced to about 1 cup, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the marsala or applesauce, remaining lemon zest, and mussels. Spoon the hot wine and mussel mixture into a bowl large enough to accommodate the fish. Garnish each fillet with a mussel nest. Place the lettuce into individual serving plates. Garnish with a lemon slice and fresh seaweed if desired.

title: Sesame Pork (Ethiopian-Ethiopian)
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, fat removed | 2 tablespoons ground sesame seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons marjoram or 1 1/2 tablespoons oregano leaves
instructions: In a bowl sprinkle pork with the sesame and oregano and toss to coat. Heat a deep skillet to a smoking point, then add pork and fry until all sides are lightly browned. Transfer the pork to a platter and place over a roasting pan or baking sheet to brown the fat. Cover loosely and continue roasting at a bare simmer, stirring frequently 1 1/2 hours or until the pork is a deep brown and tender. Serve with berbere and yellow rice.

title: Danish Beef With Sour Cream and Dill
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs thinly sliced filet of beef | 1 cup sour cream | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh dill weed or 2 teaspoons dried dill weed | 1 serrano pepper - stemmed, seeded and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat broiler to high. Combine sour cream and dill weed in a small bowl. Place beef in a large nonreactive baking dish. Cover with sour cream mixture. Sprinkle with pepper. Broil 15 minutes or until beef is cooked.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,wine,egg noodle,spice,poblano chile,red chile pepper,mascarpone cheese
title: Chile Rellenos Poached Egg Noodle With Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 can poblano chiles | 8 ounces egg noodles | 1 tablespoon ground mixed spice | 1 small red chile pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 ounce mascarpone cheese | 3 tablespoons wine | 2 tablespoons taco sauce
instructions: Prepare poblano chiles, then cut a slit along one side of the chile. Remove the seeds. Place a poblano, 1 tablespoon of spice powder, chile pepper, mascarpone cheese, 1 tablespoon red chile juice and salt in the center of a plate. Top with a layer of egg noodles. In a medium saucepan, heat the remaining spice powder, remaining red chile and taco sauce over medium low heat. To serve, spoon spice sauce over fried egg noodles.

title: Turnip Pickles for 1
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh wild mushrooms | 12 turnips, large pickling | season salt ( optional ) | 3 cloves garlic, whole | 6 -8 cups rice wine
instructions: Pickle the mushrooms, peel and cut into 2 inch pieces. Trim the ends off the turnips and cut into large pickles that have been cleaned of dirt. Dry the vegetables thoroughly on a rack, then rinse them with an ample amount of water so that they are completely dry. Dry the mushrooms thoroughly and put into a clean glass bowl, or stainless steel bowl, set aside. Dry the turnips thoroughly on a rack. When ready to refrigerate, add 2 tbsp salt to the vegetables, add a whole studded garlic clove and salt to taste. Add the rice wine to the vegetables, and stir well to combine. Pack the vegetables into clean glass jars sterilized by soaking in cold water for 3 days. They keep indefinitely.

title: Hot Pepper Sauce - Sosaties
ingredients: 2 hot serrano peppers | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place the serrano peppers in a plastic bag and place in a microwave safe bowl. Cook on high in 50% of the water, 20 - 30 seconds.

title: Italian Sausage and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 4 cups cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard | 2 teaspoons sage
instructions: Cut sausages from casings using a serrated knife.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,lettuce,curry leaf,dark soy sauce,seasoning salt,cheese,arborio rice
title: Thai Risotto

instructions: Wash the rice in a sieve under running water until the water runs clear, and then drain and leave the rice in the strainer over a bowl, pressing as much water as possible out of the rice in the bowl and through a sieve. If you are using frozen peas or basil, gently defrost them in slightly warm water and allow to rehydrate for 10 - 15 minutes before using to help the flavors meld.

title: Filet Mignon with Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon | 2 tablespoons sweet sherry | 4 shiitake mushrooms, cut into thick slices | salad, to serve | shiitake mushroom, shavings
instructions: Heat a frying pan to high and dry fry the bacon. Remove the bacon and set aside. Add the sherry and mushrooms to the pan along with half the bacon fat from the frying pan. When the mushroom juices have released, stir in the remaining bacon fat and serve with the remaining mushrooms. Serve with salad.

title: Quick Chili Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canned chili sauce | 3 cubes ( dry, dry-roasted ) teabags
instructions: In a large jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the chili sauce and teabags. Shake to blend. Store in a cool, dry area.

title: Beef and Barley Salad
ingredients: 2 cups great northern beans, cooked | 1 cup lamb or 1 cup roast beef, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh mango chutney | 1/4 cup raw pistachios or 1/4 cup unsalted shelled pistachios | 5 ladyfingers | 3 tablespoons pearl barley | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Mix the first 8 ingredients together, add salt and pepper to taste if desired. Line a chilled serving dish with warm marinate. Arrange the lady fingers on top of the marinate and carefully flip over to cover. Serve with rice if desired.

title: Rutabagas - Ranchers delights
ingredients: 1 kg rump roast | 200 g marshmallow sticks | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 2 slices rutabagas ( or other smallish crisp-cooked vegetables ) | 200 g rusabagas | 200 g russet potatoes ( medium-sized-sized, peeled, cut into small, 2 mm pieces each ) | 1/2 kg boursin cheese | 200 g rice, cooked ( or your favourite dessert rice )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c/400°f. Trim any visible fat from the roast. Place in the roasting tin/aluminum foil. Spread marshmallow stick on top of meat and leave to soak for 10mins. Cut into pieces and scatter the rutabagas/vegetables on top, dot with a little butter. Cut russet into 2 mm sized pieces. Place on top of roast and dot with butter. Mix boursin and vanilla essence and pour over top of meat. Wrap meat well and put tightly into roasting tin/aluminum, placing in oven for 2 hours, or for the same time you take the roast out of the oven and set it aside. Pil the rice in a bowl, making sure that there are no grains of rice or starch. Set aside. Remove meat from oven and place on a warm plate. Mix the cooked rice in a bowl. Dice the boiled rutabaga into 2 mm sizes. Peel and chop the potato. Place in a bowl, mix a little bit of water and pour around it the meat, marshmallow, potato and rutabaga. Mix together well. Wrap the meat very tightly and place in the centre of a hot serving plate or a baking tray. Put the remaining butter on the rusagas/boursin mixture and spread it onto the rusagas. To take your tray out of the oven, lay it in the center of the tray. Place meat on top and surround with the rusagas and the potato. Place the tray in the centre of the oven and bake in oven for 45 min's. Let it rest for 5 min's before eating. Serve the meat on a bed of rice with a sprinkling of sugar and lots of cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: tamari soy sauce,velveeta cheese,cheese tortellini,leek,vegetable,corn,streaky bacon
title: Wende's Tastiest Veggie Tortellini Salad

instructions: Cook bacon over a medium heat until it has started rendering fat and has turned light golden brown. You have to be very careful or else this could burn your mouth for a few seconds. title: Devil's Hand Salad

instructions: Cut lettuce leaves into 4 large squares. In a small bowl, combine catsup, coffee and sugar and set aside. Place lettuce squares on lettuce squares and pour catsup mixture over them and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Sweet Chili Sauce

instructions: Combine all ingredients in glass canning jar for storage. Wipe jar rim with damp cloth. Store any leftover sauce in canning jars in hot water bath in refrigerator.

ingredients: 3 bags frozen broccoli, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce, kikkoman kikkoman kikkoman kikkoman kikkoman kikkoman kikkoman mild barbecue sauce
instructions: Place thawed broccoli in the cooker. Add a splash of barbeque sauce. Close the lid securely and cook. After 25 minutes, open the pressure cooker and fluff.

title: Italian Herb Beef With Tomatoes and Cashews
