ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup italian classics dry-roasted salted anchovies or 1/2 cup canned italian plum tomatoes, drained | 1/2 cup cashews or 1/2 cup peanuts, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian plum tomatoes, cut in half
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 300°f. Place roast on rack in roasting pan. Coarsely chop tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,chocolate syrup,extra sharp cheddar cheese,grain mustard,italian dressing,amaretto
title: Cheddar and Sage Scented Cheddar Chips
ingredients: 16 ounces extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons grain mustard | 1 tablespoon italian dressing | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 teaspoon chocolate syrup | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 2 fresh sage leaves or 1/2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Cut each cheddar chip into 4 long, thin strips. Sprinkle a little parground fine with salt. In a small bowl, stir the cheddar with the grain mustard, maple syrup, chocolate syrup, and amaretto. Add sage leaves. Transfer to a sprayed rimmed baking sheet or tin. Bake in a 400°f oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Cashew Nut and Mustard Dipping Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1/4 cup raw cashew nuts ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon dry mustard ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/2 lemon
instructions: Bring chicken stock to boil in saucepan. Heat oil in large saucepan. Stir in mustard, cashew nuts, garlic powder, dry mustard, oyster sauce and lemon. Add the chicken and mix well. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,maraschino cherry,vanilla essence,celery seed,veal,tabasco sauce
title: Puff a Flavorful Vanilla Burgers
ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding mix | 2 pints maraschino cherries, rinsed and drained | 2 sticks celery seeds | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 lb ground veal
instructions: If using veal, break it into about 3 ounce pieces or smaller if you prefer. Use 1 pound of meat at a time. In a freezer bag, combine the pudding mix and cherries. Seal the bag and add the celery seeds, tabasco sauce and vanilla. Shake the bag so all is coated and shake until well mixed. Add a pinch of salt to a skillet using a small amount of oil. Sear the ground meat over high heat until browned and to your taste. Serve the meat on toasted rolls if desired. If you can't find vanilla pudding mixes, a packet of vanilla flavored pudding and a little milk may be added.

title: Pasta Bean Bake
ingredients: 500 g dried white beans, soaked overnight | 300 g raw sultanas or 300 g golden sultanas, cut in half | 200 g raw marshmallows | 150 g fresh french bread, cut diagonally into 1 cm slices about 3 cm thick | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon french haricot bean paste | pasta, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c, 375f&deg.

title: Pea Pods and Daikon Kimchee
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix ( about 5 pounds ) | 12 ounces peas pods | 1/2 cup daikon radish, julienned
instructions: Rinse and drain peas using a fine mesh sieve. Combine 2 cups water with the daikon and toss to combine. Place vegetables in a large, shallow dish and pour water over. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days, shaking the dish occasionally. Drain, reserving 1 cup cooking liquid. Return the vegetables to the cooking liquid in the dish and cover with clean kitchen towels and kitchen towels to keep moist and warm. Bring the liquid to a boil and stir in the peas and radishes. Cover and simmer over low heat until heated through, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,chili pepper,extra virgin olive oil,ice water
title: Cabbage & Chilli Salad
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage, shredded | 100 ml extra virgin olive oil | 1 pinch of chili pepper | 2 teaspoons ice water | splash extra virgin olive oil, to taste
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: garlic infused olive oil,yogurt,lettuce,marshmallow cream,date,sesame oil,cream cheese
title: Chilled Cream Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 2 cups lettuce, chopped | 1/4 cup dates, pitted and chopped | 1/2 cup miniature marshmallow cream | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2/3 cup yogurt | 10 pitted dates, coarsely chopped
instructions: In the bowl of a food processor, combine the cream cheese, lettuce and dates. Add the sesame oil. Process on high until well blended and smooth. Stir in the yogurt. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,cannellini bean,coffee,graham cracker crumb,icing sugar,chicken wing
title: Terrific & Delicious Cannellini Bean Fingers
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 16 ounces chicken wings, separated at joints | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 packet instant cannellini beans | 1 loaf of organic cookie crumbs | 1 tablespoon instant coffee, instant
instructions: Mix ground sirloin with icing sugar & beans in separate bowl. Pizza dough hooks & stretch the dough onto a baking sheet. Brush with coffee then take on the pizza tray, bake for 15mins at 450 degrees to get crust nice & crusty. While still warm, take it out & flatten on a cookie sheet. Place on cooling rack & cool until not crispy. Spread some more coffee on cut surface of cut surface & place a hamburger on top, then spread on 1 tsp of bean mixture. Fold and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,fish fillet,pine nut,lime wedge,white flour,oyster sauce,tomato juice
title: Australian Style Pizza With Cracked Fish
ingredients: 1 lb fish fillet, skin removed | 1 tablespoon white flour | 3 tablespoons tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon oyster sauce | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted and chopped | 2 tablespoons part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Place the fillet on a plate and sprinkle with the flour. Turn over to coat both sides. Set aside. Combine the tomato juice, oyster sauce, pine nuts, and half the mozzarella. Pour half this over the fish, then top with the remaining cheese. Grill or broil until it bubbles and the fish is cooked. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Spicy Breakfast Wrapped Potatoes
ingredients: 2 medium fingerling potatoes ( or 1 large potato ) | 4 slices gingerroot ( thin slice ) | 1/2 cup steel cut oats ( not quick cooking ) | 4 eggs | 3/4 cup cooked white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Trim any ragged edges, if desired. Peel and slice potatoes into thin rounds about 1/4 inch thick. Lay out the sliced ginger on a clean towel and use this to pat out any excess moisture, about 2/3 inch long. Spray cookie sheet with pam or oil. Place ginger slices in a microwave safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high for 20 seconds. Remove the ginger, wrap it in another piece of plastic wrap and microwave on high for another 20 seconds. Remove the ginger, wrap it in an inverted bowl, and microwave the potatoes on high 6 minutes. Remove potatoes from microwave, cover with a clean towel, and microwave 5 minutes more. Remove the ginger from microwave, wrap it in plastic wrap, and microwave on high 10 minutes. Remove ginger slices from microwave, wrap it in one piece of plastic wrap, and microwave on high 5 minutes, again at least 8 minutes. Remove potatoes from bowl with a strainer and let sit 5 minutes at room temperature. Stir the oats into potatoes and combine thoroughly. Whisk eggs, rice, and 3/4 cup water in a small bowl, until well blended. Stir the egg mixture into potato mixture. Line a dinner plate or platter with 5 inch squares of parchment paper, or foil. Place potato mixture on plastic wrap, wrap it in the foil, and refrigerate for several minutes to absorb moisture. Remove parchment paper and foil from platter. Remove parchment from platter, and gently peel off plastic wrap. Using a fork, press a finger or two of ginger into the center of the paper, then spread the ginger out about 1/4 inch thick, keeping the ginger in place with the spices. Fill the center of the paper with the oat mixture, folding the parchment up at the edges.

title: Poppy Seed (Yogurt)
ingredients: sunflower oil | 4 cups poppy seeds | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate
instructions: Wash the poppy seeds in a cloth and shake off the excess. Coat with sunflower oil. Put poppy seeds in an oven proof dish. Put poppy seeds evenly over the poppy seeds. Use a blender to make puree. When all the poppy seeds have been covered with puree, pour in the frozen orange juice concentrate and mix well until the entire mixture is completely smooth. Cover the poppy seeds with a lid or cling film and place in the refrigerator for 24 hours. When ready to serve, remove lid and spoon the sticky, gummy orange or walnut sized pieces into warm, sterilized jars. Seal immediately.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,dark sesame oil,apricot preserve,baking potato,fish fillet,dark beer,tea
title: Golden Gate Fish
ingredients: 400 -450 g fish fillets, skin and bones removed | 6 -8 slices crystallized ginger paste | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 600 ml dark beer | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 800 g baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Place fish in a large ovenproof dish large enough to hold it together. Sprinkle ginger paste on the fish. Heat oils, beer and preserves in a saucepan together and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 minute. Add potatoes and then pour sauce over fish and bake in an oven or hot frypan, preheating 220 degrees celsius for 15 to 20 minutes until fish is cooked through, and potatoes are crisp.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,beef tenderloin,sherry,tomato,black pepper,beef bouillon cube,yellow tomato,yukon gold potato
title: Beef Tenderloin With Potato, Tomatoes, and Sherry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cake flour | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 can sliced yellow tomatoes | 1 boneless beef tenderloin, trimmed | ground black pepper to taste | 6 yukon gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup chopped tomato
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine cake flour with sherry in a small bowl.

title: Baileys
ingredients: 1 tablespoon achiote paste | 1 tablespoon milk | 2 sheets nori | 2 -3 medium eggplants
instructions: In a small pan heat the 1 tablespoon abarita paste with an open flame. Add the milk, and stir to blend. Bring mixture to boil. Dice the eggplant into 1/2 inch cubes, and the nori sheets according to your preference. Place the mixture in a bowl with the warm achiote mixture. Spread the mixture on top of the eggplant to make a dome. Garnish with coriander leaves and nori curls.

title: Peach and Rosemary Infused Spice Rub
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peach, ripe | 1/2 teaspoon fresh rosemary sprig | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed
instructions: In small bowl, coarsely crush rosemary and coriander seed with a pestle until they are finely crushed. Combine with peaches. Rub over your favorite bbq cook.

title: Enchilada Chili
ingredients: 15 ounces frozen sugar snap peas | 20 ounces enchilada sauce ( mild or medium )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Meanwhile, chop the frozen vegetables and put 1/2 cup of sauce in a blender. Cover and blend well. Place the rest of the ingredients into the bowl with the hot sauce. Blend on high until the chile is the consistency of canned tomato sauce. Serve hot or slightly warm.

Random Ingredients: triple succotash,marinara sauce,chicken part,green chili pepper,pineapple juice
title: Stove Top Caribbean Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup triple succotash, shredded | 1/4 cup green chili pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon green chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 cup marinara sauce | 0.5 can pineapple tidbits, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to in a bowl toss together the shredded succotash, chili, and green chilies. In a 2 qt casserole dish, add the remaining ingredients to the sauce. Pour onto the chicken mixture. Cover and bake for 1 hour or longer. Serve over noodles.

title: Panch Phoron - Vegetables With Green Cardamom pods (Vegetable Phoron)
ingredients: 1 lb carrot, peeled, trimmed and cut into 1/8-inch slices | 6 green cardamom pods
instructions: Place carrot slices in a saucepan of hot water to cover. Bring to a boil, then cook over moderately high heat, stirring occasionally, until barely tender, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander, transfer to a bowl and allow to drain thoroughly. In the same saucepan, toast green cardamom pods over moderate heat, stirring, for about 1 min, or until fragrant. When cool, grind to a powder or with a mortar and pestle. Bring cardamom to a boil, then boil for 1 minute. Drain and cool. Transfer to a spice grinder. Stir in vegetable mixture, adding cardamom and salt. Heat a large nonstick nonstick fry pan over moderate heat. Add oil, then reduce heat to moderately low. Working with 1 piece of carrot at a time, add oil to keep warm over low heat. Working with 1/4 of the carrot at a time, dip half of vegetables in oil. Working with 1 round, then flatten with the palm of the hand into a circle about 8 by 18 inches in diameter. Transfer to a baking sheet, sprinkle with cardamom and bake in a 275°f oven for 20 - 25 minutes, or until crispy. Serve hot or cold.

title: Grilled Ziti with Spinach and Chipotle Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces ziti pasta | 2 ounces gingersnap crumbs, finely ground | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint | 1 tablespoon minced fresh mint | 4 ounces processed cheese, cut into chunks | 1 cup fresh spinach | 1 pinch adobo seasoning
instructions: Cook ziti pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente. Drain, reserving 1 cup cooking liquid. In a small bowl, stir together gingersnap crumbs, mint, 1 tablespoon mint, and 2 ounces processed cheese until well blended. Stir in 1 cup cooled pasta cooking liquid, spinach, and 1 pinch adobo seasoning. Divide mixture among 4 serving plates. Roll each 1/4 cup ziti mixture and slice into 4 inch strips. Arrange on platter and sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon mint.

title: Green Beans with Asparagus
ingredients: 12 ounces french cut green beans, trimmed | 2 teaspoons dry cooking wine | 1/2 lb asparagus spear, trimmed
instructions: Cook beans in boiling water, stirring, for 3 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain and rinse under cold water.

Random Ingredients: carrot,navy bean,white pepper,cold water,wheat flour,parsley sprig,fenugreek,rosemary
title: Minh's White Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb dried navy beans, about 2 1/2 lbs | 1 cup coarsely chopped parminnigiano-reggiano cheese, about 1/2 cup | fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley sprigs | freshly ground white pepper ( generous ) | 1 1/2 lbs whole wheat flour or 1 1/2 lbs bread flour | 2 1/2 cups cold water | 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 teaspoons white pepper
instructions: Rinse the beans and transfer to a large saucepan.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,grain rice,tomato puree,quinoa,hot chili pepper,broth,whipping cream
title: Mexican Quinoa and Rice
ingredients: 4 cups chicken stock or 4 cups canned broth, heated | 1/2 cup long grain rice | 1 cup quinoa | 1 can stewed tomatoes with puree, tomatoes reserved | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup hot chili pepper, minced
instructions: Prepare quinoa according to pkg directions. Heat stock and rice. Stir in tomatoes with puree, cream, chili and pepper. Add 1/2 c reserved tomato juice and cook 5 minutes, stirring often. Serve.

title: Beer Battered Shrimp
ingredients: 8 jumbo shrimp, unpeeled and deveined | 4 skewers, 6 inches long | 2 bottles beer ( your favourite lager-based )
instructions: Arrange shrimp in a large skillet along with just enough beer to cover shrimp. Place a skewer into the center of each shrimp, and turn shrimp over so they are sitting upright. Pour remaining beer atop shrimp, and place 4 shrimp on top. Cover skillet, and cook over medium high heat until shrimp are just cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes. Turn off heat, and cool shrimp just until they are cool enough to handle. Cut the remaining shrimp crosswise into slices about 1/2 inch thick. Arrange slices on a warm serving platter, and garnish with shrimp.

title: Cocoa and Chocolate Bark for Baking
ingredients: 2 packages unsweetened chocolate | 2 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Break the chocolate into pieces. In a bowl, place the cocoa and stir. Sprinkle over a little of the melted chocolate to stop it from sticking to your fingers. If it seems dry, add a teaspoon or so of water. Using a sharp knife, cut the bark into strips about 1/2 inch wide and 4 inches long. Sprinkle each strip with a little more cocoa at a time. Cool, cover and keep refrigerated until serving.

title: Tunisian Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons saffron threads | 1 tablespoon juniper berries | 3 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mortar and pestle or small bowl, and grind to a fine powder.

title: Prelude Herring Wrapped in Foil
ingredients: 1 large herring fillet ( preferably frozen ) | 20 ounces frozen roll wraps | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder
instructions: Drain the fillet, wrap over a piece of plastic wrap and then a damp cloth at the bottom of a roasting tin. Line with clingfilm that is also large enough to fit the herring in the pan. Sprinkle over the five spice powder. Scatter over some dried chinese rock sugar to keep the roll from sticking. Lay the fillet on the roll top and cut into 5 lengths. Repeat until all the fillets are rolled and wrapped and placed in the tin. Brush every remaining spice over any excess. Bake at 190c for 20 - 35 minutes. Cut into 6 wedges and serve whilst warm.

title: How to Pick a Fish with Hard-Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 1 can or bottle beer | 12 toothpicks, or as needed
instructions: Fill a large, deep pan with about 1/2 inch of hot water.

title: Quick and Easy Beef Liver and Beer
ingredients: 1 lb beef liver or 1 lb lamb fat
instructions: Brown the liver or lamb and remove. Cook in the beer or with the fat. This can be made in the crockpot if you put all ingredients in there. If using lamb, remove as it browns. I have found the liver tends to get brown quicker than other cuts of meat and liver. Serve on top of steamed potatoes or pasta.

Random Ingredients: green bean,lavender,flax seed,parmesan cheese,creme fraiche,fast rising yeast
title: Green Beans French Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh green beans, washed and trimmed ( about 2 1/4 lbs ) | 2 cups creme fraiche ( or heavy sour cream ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried lavender, crushed | 10 1/2 - 12 cups unbleached flour ( more or less if the dough is too sticky ) | 1 tablespoon fast-rising dry yeast | 1/1 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Scald wash and trim the green beans. When cool enough to handle, cut into 1 inch lengths and soak in cold water until soft, about 30 minutes. Drain. Place the beans in a large mixing bowl. Add creme fraiche, lavender and enough of the flour to make a doughable dough. Mix to a smooth consistency. On a lightly floured surface, knead about 10 - 15 minutes, until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl and turn to grease the top. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 90 minutes. Meanwhile preheat the oven to 375°f. Roll the remaining 1 1/2 cups flour into a 6 inch long log, dusting lightly with flour as necessary. Slide 1 loaf onto a lightly floured baking sheet. Cut off the excess dough and, using your hands, gently stretch it until it reaches the rim of the baking sheet. Use a spatula to transfer the loaf to the baking sheet, seam side down. Make 3 diagonal slashes on the top of the loaf. Brush with more of the creme fraiche and sprinkle with the parmesan cheese. Bake until the bread is beginning to brown, 40 - 50 minutes.

title: Spice Tea
ingredients: 200 g ghee ( i prefer butter ) | 3 tablespoons cilantro leaves, washed and finely chopped
instructions: Heat the butter in a small saucepan or pot. Keep stirring on medium high heat until the butter starts browning. Immediately add chopped coriander leaves and saute briefly. If the coriander leaves turn color lightly, this is done not until it's done but just until you have a very dark green colour. Pour the contents of the pan into a tea cup. Fill each cup the full cup with warm water, then allow to set. After an hour or so, the water should begin to boil and the tea should be ready. Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and serve. Enjoy.

title: Crazy Banana Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs bananas, sliced into thick fingers ( or your preference ) | garlic salt
instructions: Preparation, place bananas in a bowl of ice cold water. Drain. Place bananas in an ice cream maker and let sit until completely cooled, about 15 minutes. Pat the peeled bananas with hands a few times. Sprinkle lightly with garlic salt, then wrap well, and freeze for up to 6 days. Place sliced bananas in tortilla and enjoy.

title: Mixed Oatmeal
ingredients: 4 cups oatmeal | 2 cups dry marsala | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine the oats and marsala in a large bowl and mix with a fork. Pour 2 1/2 cups of the oat mixture into a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle the dill over everything and mix to coat the oats well. Bake in preheated oven until the oatmeal is golden brown, about 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,sugar snap pea,beef stew meat,veal,iceberg lettuce,turkey
title: Beef and Chicken Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef stew meat | 1 lb lamb or 1 lb turkey stew meat | 1/2 lb veal, shredded | 2 tablespoons sugar snap peas | 1/4 head iceberg lettuce | hopperous roasting chickens ( to your taste ) or hot sauce ( to your taste )
instructions: Marinade put stew meat and lamb or turkey in crockpot or a crockpot. Add peas. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or hi for 4 - 6 hours. Shred lettuce and stir into meat juices. May stir in hot sauce. Wilt the romaine lettuce and serve warm.

title: Cauliflower Cheese
ingredients: 3/4 cup milk | 1 3/4 cups cauliflower florets, drained
instructions: Heat the milk in a microwave safe bowl on high power for 10 seconds. Reduce the power to medium and add the cauliflower. Cook and stir for another 10 seconds, stirring constantly. Remove from the microwave, stir and serve.

title: Baby Shrimp on Garlic Toast
ingredients: 1 slice white bread | 1 1/2 lbs baby shrimp | 2 ounces fresh tarragon | 3 -4 ounces chambord raspberry liquor | 12 ounces broth, heated or 12 ounces beef broth | 1 teaspoon grenadine | kale ( to garnish ) or red onion, sliced ( to garnish )
instructions: Remove crusts from bread and cut a pocket in each bread slice. Cut shrimp into 1 inch cubes or smaller if using shrimp pieces. In a large saute pan, fry shrimp until pink. Add tarragon, chambord, and broth. Simmer over low heat 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Spoon shrimp mixture into individual serving bowls, sprinkle with grenadine. Garnish with slices of kale or red onion. Enjoy your delicious, simple, flavorful luncheon dishes.

title: Melt and Cheese - Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 package english cheese, cut into small sticks | 3 limes | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh ground black pepper | 2 cans mixed sprouts | 2 bay leaves | 3/8 - 1 cup light smelt or 3/8-1 cup diet sprite, for serving
instructions: Place the cheese, limes, pepper, mixed sprouts, and bay leaves in a large glass dish, making sure all of the spices have been stirred into the mix. Add 1/8 to 1/2 cup of sprite to mix. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Matcha Burgers (Burgers)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon matcha green tea powder ( or green tea concentrate ) | 1 lb hamburger
instructions: Brown hamburger in a skillet on med high heat. Put the rest of the ingredients into a plastic bag and give them a massage. Drop the hamburger mixture into the frying pan. Cook for 5 minutes, turning to coat all sides. It should be cooked through.

title: Tamarind Egg Rollups
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tamarind paste or 3 tablespoons soybean paste | 1 leek ( green part only, sliced thinly with some of the green ) | 100 g grated mizithra cheese | 3 eggs, beaten | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking spray | 1/4 cup awamori | 3 sprigs mace
instructions: Wash the leek well until very dry. Remove the loose ends and slice thinly into half rings and set aside. Slice the egg into half moons and set aside. Wash the mizithra cheese. Remove all the white pith and white parts from the mince with a sharp knife. Add 1 tablespoon of yuka to the yuka and mix well. Combine the eggs and remaining yuka in a medium bowl. Add the leek and mix. Mash a tablespoon of yuka and mix with the egg and mince mixture. Spray a non stick frying pan with cooking spray and pour a little spray oil into the pan. Add a few tablespoons of water to just form a shallow 'lunch' in the middle. Place a scoop of egg mixture in the centre of the 'lunch'. Use a fork, fork, spatula or chopsticks to push the mixture together. Repeat with more egg mixture and pan water, spraying each time with more spray oil. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes. Turn over and cook for 2 - 3 minutes more, until both sides are light brown. Carefully flip over and cook for 2 minutes more, until golden brown. Spray a little oil on the inside of each roll and place the 'lunch' back inside. Cut the roll crosswise in 12 even slices. Serve with the mizithra cheese, dipping sauce or your choice of sauces.

title: Buttered East Indian Butter
ingredients: 1/4 cup melted butter | 3 teaspoons garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/4 cups cold water
instructions: Combine butter, butter, garam masala, and cardamom in a plastic or glass bowl. Beat with a wire whisk or a spoon until smooth. Strain butter into a glass or plastic sealable container until no more butter lumps form, 2 to 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: basil,button mushroom,pork loin chop,iceberg lettuce,cardamom pod
title: Tortillas
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | 1 large iceberg lettuce, shredded | 2 cloves garlic, smashed | 4 ounces button mushrooms | 2 pinches ground cardamom pod, or more to taste | 5 cups torn fresh basil
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Place pork chops on top of lettuce and top with garlic, mushrooms, cardamom, and torn basil.

title: Passion Fruit and Almond Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup dried apricot, chopped | 10 teaspoons sweet passion fruit juice | 7 ounces light rye bread, grated | 1 large cherry, halved | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease 2 - 4 cup round ovenproof dishes or muffin tins. In a bowl, mix together flour, apricots and passionfruit juice. Add bread, cherries and almonds and mix until combined. Spoon mixture into prepared pudding dishes or muffin tins. Cover and bake in the oven for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,sun tomato,pork shoulder,strawberry jam,blueberry
title: Rustic Roast Pork
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomato | 1/4 cup softened strawberry jam | 2 cups self-rising flour | 2 pounds pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons strawberry jam | 2 cups fresh or frozen blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine sun dried tomato and 1/4 cup jam in a medium bowl. Stir in self rising flour until evenly blended. Toss the pork shoulder with remaining 1/4 cup jam and 1/4 cup jam mixture. Transfer to a roasting pan or baking sheet and spread with the remaining 1/4 cup jam mixture evenly. Roast in preheated oven for about 1 hour, basting occasionally. While the meat is roasting, place the berries in a bowl and cover with water. Let stand at room temperature until softened, about 1 hour. Slice and arrange slices around the roast. Spoon additional strawberry preserves around the roast if desired. If desired, remove fat from the top of the meat and glaze with reserved glaze.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream (Swiss Vanilla)
ingredients: 2 cups good quality vanilla beans, pulp | 2 -3 tablespoons lemon juice ( from concentrate )
instructions: Blend all above ingredients together in order stated. Place glass pie plate with ice cream on bottom of freezer, place ice cream in freezer, and wait about 20 minutes until ice cream begins to harden around the edges. When ready to ice cream, slice, and pour into glass bowl with frozen mix.

title: Crispy Burritos
ingredients: 1 can beef broth | 6 flour tortillas
instructions: Add beef broth to a nonstick skillet over high heat. When broth to a boil, add burritos and cook until desired brown color. Cut in half and serve.

title: Spinach and Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 package spinach leaves | 4 sage leaves ( about 1 large bunch ) | 1 teaspoon season-all salt
instructions: Soak spinach leaves in water for 15 minutes. Trim and discard stems & spinache. Drain well. Place cubes in crockpot. Add sage and season all. Cook on high for 5 hours or low for 8 hours and then turn to low for 6 - 8 hours. Stir and check every 30 minutes.

title: Tava Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf ciabatta, sliced | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods, cracked
instructions: Use bread slices to make toast or toast a sandwich using a knife. Slice the top and bottom of the toasted bread slices. Spread 1/2 teaspoon of cardamom powder on the toasted bread. Place the toast on a tray. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of crushed green cardamom over. Allow the toast to become crispy.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,grain white rice,peanut oil,chunky salsa
title: Tex-Mex Rice
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 pinch liquid smoke | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 2 cups long grain white rice, cooked
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium heat. Add the oil and smoke. Add the rice and salsa, and fry for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the liquid smoke. Stir quickly until the liquid evaporates. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Chestnut Mushrooms (Cherie Moula)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chestnut mushrooms ( cremini ) | 2 tablespoons gruyere cheese, grated, divided | 1 tablespoon kiwi fruit, chopped and divided | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup fresh corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix first 5 ingredients in shallow baking dish, spread in wedges to coat. Bake for 20 minutes. Spoon over hot chestnut mushrooms. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake an additional 10 minutes or until cheese is golden brown.

title: Onion & Cheese Stuffed Cherry Pokes W-catsup (Cooking Light)
ingredients: 6 large vidalia onions | 1 can rotel ( optional, but i found it was amazing on this one ) | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup catsup ( optional ) | 1 cup sweet baby ray farm deli ham & bacon stuffing mix ( or 1 cup diced ham, i used deli ham and it was a hit! ) ( optional )
instructions: Peel and chop onions. Slice in half lengthwise. Place in 9 x 12x 2 inch baking dish that has been sprayed with pam. Mix the cheese with the onions. Add salt and pepper to taste. Spread on the tops of the onions, then the ham slices. Close the top of the onions with toothpicks. The cheese, ham and meat may leak out, so be generous. I put them in a 9 x 13 dish because they shrink as they bake. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, uncovered. The stuffing, mix the ham with the stuffing. Add a little water, to make a sauce. Heat. I like to add a little sugar or corn syrup. The more water there is in the stuffing, the drier it will be and it will thicken as it cools. You can either drizzle over the cherry or serve right on top of the stuffing.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 tablespoon corn oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Heat oil in a deep fryer to 375 degrees f or until a cube of bread comes out clean. Pour chicken soup into a 2 - 3 quart dish. Cover and place in the refrigerator for about 2 hours or overnight. Ladle into a serving bowl or over a mound of steamed baby carrots. Serve immediately. Note, the recipe should not be soupy or overly thin. If you want to serve soup in a serving bowl with a mound of carrots on the top. You can use a ladle to complete the layers.

Random Ingredients: corn cob,turmeric powder,ginger,green cabbage head,egg yolk,prosciutto
title: Manteca
ingredients: 100 g prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1 small green cabbage head, sliced | 4 corn cobs, roughly chopped | 2 small egg yolks | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 ginger, peeled and sliced
instructions: Place the prosciutto, cabbages, and potato in a food processor. Grate in your egg yolks and turmeric powder. Add your ginger and pulse until the mixture resembles fine grated breadcrumbs. Fold in your green cabbage leaf. Roll into a sausage shape. Heat a few tablespoons of olive oil in a heavy base frypan. Brown the sausage on all sides. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,veal,sesame oil,dark sesame oil,farfalle pasta,sea salt black pepper,apple juice,rump steak
title: Veal Marsala (Agnello Fondue)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 tablespoon fresh ground black pepper | 6 whole dried black cardamom pods, divided | 3 lbs boneless veal, cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices | 3/4 cup apple juice | 4 ounces farfalle pasta ( or other short pasta ) | 2 ounces sesame oil, plus extra for brushing | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil, for brushing
instructions: Combine 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon sea salt and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper in a wide, heavy duty re sealable plastic bag. Add sliced veal.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,yellow bell pepper,pita bread
title: Easy Grilled Yellow Bell Pepper Salad (Pampered Chef Copycat)
ingredients: 1 small yellow bell pepper | 1/3 cup apple cider vinegar | shredded reduced-fat cheese ( kraft miracle whip )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Halve bell pepper lengthwise and trim. Place on grates. Pierce pepper on grill with a fork several times, turning until blackened. Transfer pepper to a cutting board and coarsely chop finely. Combine bell pepper, vinegar and cheese in a bowl. Drizzle with vinaigrette to taste. Serve with your favorite salad.

title: Crunchy Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup light cream of mushroom soup | 2 cups romaine lettuce
instructions: Pour the soup and the 1/2 cup lettuce into a bowl and mix together. Place the remaining lettuce into another bowl and add the soup mixture. Mix together. Serve over egg noodles.

title: Swiss Cheese Balls
ingredients: 3 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup rolled oatmeal | 1/2 cup white raisins or 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Shape balls, rolling between your palms into balls and bake on a greased cookie sheet for 12 to 15 minutes at 350 degrees. Balls should be golden brown on both sides.

Random Ingredients: shrimp paste,chipotle chile,black peppercorn,chili garlic sauce,cider vinegar,turnip,icing sugar
title: Shrimp Turnips With Chilies
ingredients: 4 large turnips, peel and cut into 2 wedges | 1 1/2 teaspoons icing sugar | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar ( or rice vinegar ) | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles, minced | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon shrimp paste | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Cut turnips with slant knife into 4 wedges each. Arrange on rack of oven safe pan. Sprinkle sugar evenly over wedges. Bake in 400f oven for about 1 hr and 20minutes or until tender. Meanwhile combine chilies, peppercorns, shrimp paste, and chili garlic sauces. Stir until blended.

title: Grilled Asparagus
ingredients: 4 -6 medium green asparagus, about 1/2 inch thick | 2 1/2 cups low sodium chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning ( or your favorite seasoning ) | shredded fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Combine chicken bouillon and adobo in saucepan. Bring to boiling over high heat. Reduce heat to low and add asparagus. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Transfer asparagus to serving bowl. Pour sauce over. Sprinkle with cilantro. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cooking apple,italian sausage,idaho potato,dill pickle,beef cube steak,mirin
title: Grilled Sausage and Potato Rollups
ingredients: 2 lbs beef cubes or 2 lbs steak | 2 lbs italian sausage | 2 large potatoes or 2 large idaho potatoes | 2 -3 dill pickles | cooking apple ( optional ) | dill pickle ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons mirin ( optional )
instructions: Heat charcoal grill. Trim any fat. Grill steak to desired doneness and thinly slice across the grain. Place in a large bowl and turn once to coat with oil. Slice potatoes or dill pickles and slice across. Spread a layer of pickles onto a piece of plastic wrap. Sprinkle with paprika, dill pickle, and a bit of mirin. Lay the steaks on top, close the wrap, and then cut in half.

Random Ingredients: green apple,pine nut,fish sauce,triple sec,adobo sauce,cherry,scallion
title: Green Apple Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 green apples | 1 scallion | 1/4 cup cherry ( halved ) | 1/4 cup lemon juice or 1/4 cup lime juice | 4 drops fish sauce ( such as nam pla or nuoc mam ) | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce | 1 teaspoon pine nuts
instructions: Core apples.

title: Roast Blue Cheese Jelly
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry gelatin | 1/2 cup celery, chopped | 2 tablespoons blue cheese, crumbled | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin powder in 4 tablespoons of lukewarm water. Stir in the celery, blue cheese and allspice. Stir constantly while the gelatin is completely dissolved. Pour into a greased and paper lined jelly mold. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Bahama Mustard
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yellow mustard ( colman's is good ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Mix mustard and cream of tartar together.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,parsley,onion soup mix,walnut,lemon juice zest,white wine vinegar,rice vinegar
title: Hawaiian Salad, or Chips
ingredients: 1 head parsley, washed in lots chopped | 1 bunch fresh parsley, washed in lots chopped | 1 onion soup mix ( i used zatarains onion sausage onion onion onion salad, but you may use equivalent packet of onion soup mix ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar ( i have used white balsamic ) | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Tear parsley and parsley into fine shreds. Cut onion in half and chop, then add to parsley. Slice lemon into wedges and add to bowl. Add salt and pepper, to taste, and the zest of the lemon. Add onion soup mix, garlic, and white vinegars. Mix well to combine. Chill and serve on crisp, toasted bagels which have been warmed but not actually cooked. Note, zatarains onion salad is an onion bread salad made from greek style bread. If your onion is large, chop 1 or 2 smaller pieces, add to bowl, mix, and let flavors mingle until wedges are evenly distributed. For chips, in a large bowl, mix salad, chopped parsley, and onion soup mix, lemon juice, zest, lemon peel, vinegar, and fish sauce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheddar cheese,orange,malt vinegar,beef stew meat
title: Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup orange juice | 6 slices monterey jack and cheddar cheese | 1/2 orange, rind of
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325 degrees f. Place beef in a covered roasting pan. Mix the vinegar and the orange juice. Pour this mixture into the pan. Bake for 1 hour on top of the stove. Take out the oven and allow to cool for 10 minutes. Slice the meat and put it back in the pan. Place in a serving bowl, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Serve with the rind of one half of orange. Yum.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,beet,liquid smoke,onion powder,white chocolate,bean,coleslaw mix,harissa
title: "the Best" Bun
ingredients: 3 -6 ounces raw beets, peeled and cubed | 3/4 cup coleslaw mix | 2 tablespoons sweet onions or 2 tablespoons shallots, minced | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon harissa, sauce ( optional ) | 1 ounce white chocolate, melted | 2 tablespoons coleslaw mix | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) or 1/8 teaspoon garam masala ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients and toss well to evenly distribute seasonings. In a large bowl, stir all ingredients together. Taste and add more spice if necessary.

Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,swiss chard,margarine,italian salad dressing mix,sage leaf
title: Simple Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, about 1 pound, washed and stems removed, finely chopped | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter ( 1/2 stick ) | 1 teaspoon italian salad dressing mix ( wildtree italian salad dressing mix ) | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh sage leaf ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon adobo sauce
instructions: Heat margarine in a skillet until melted. Add chard stems.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,thyme sprig,tapioca flour,oregano,jumbo pasta shell,cannellini bean,burger,vanilla pudding mix
title: American Pasta Salad with Croutons
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 2 packages instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 package jumbo pasta shells | 1 pound lean ground burger | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Mix together the beans and the instant vanilla pudding mix. Stir in the oregano, thyme, and pasta shells. Form into bite size balls and place on a cookie sheet. Top each ball with grand marnier. Bake in a preheated 375 degrees f oven for 20 minutes or until hot and lightly browned.

title: Canyon Ranch Hash #SP5
ingredients: 2 bags new potatoes ( about 15 slices ) | 1/2 lb imitation crabmeat ( imitation crabmeat may also be used ) | 1 chipotle pepper ( in jar ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line a 9x5 inch pan with aluminum foil, grease with butter, arrange potatoes over baking dish, and poke holes in the potatoes by pressing the bag of potatoes over them. Place crab meat on top of potatoes and cover with a lid or piece of foil. Cook 15 minutes or until potatoes are done.

title: Pasta Al Pesto Verde
ingredients: 16 ounces linguine, preferably vermicelli | 4 ears fresh cauliflower, separated into small florets | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil and add the pasta. Once water comes to a boil, add the cauliflower and turn off heat. Let sit for 5 minutes until the cauliflower turns bright green. Place into a bowl. Drain pasta and cauliflower, then put into a blender, adding corn oil and mace and blending until smooth. Add to cauliflower in pan and bring to a simmer. Lower heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place pasta and cauliflower into a large serving bowl. Pour pesto over pasta and toss to coat. Serve hot, room temperature or chilled. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,taco seasoning,stewing beef,pineapple chunk,serrano chilies,wild rice,grape leaf
title: Oven Beef Tacos (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice | 2 lbs stewing beef | 5 serrano chilies ( i use fresno chiles ) | 2 cups canned crushed pineapple chunks ( drained canned chunks ) | 2 packages taco seasoning | 10 grape leaves | 1 kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients up to taco seasoning in large glass bowl or plastic bag. Dump contents into large hot skillet for 2 minutes, add enough water to cover contents. Cover tightly and turn heat to very low. Simmer undisturbed for 1 hour or until water is gone. Serve with grated cheddar and sliced lime on side of meat and rice. Or just eat with corn chips, corn bread, and salsa as your go. Oamc, bake whole grapeseed packages for 1 hour at 400 degrees fahrenheit.

title: Ginger, Broccoli and Beef Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb frozen peas, defrosted | 2 cups fresh broccoli cut into florets | 10 maraschino cherries ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger | 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, combine peas, broccoli, cherries and ginger. Place soy sauce in small bowl. Drizzle over salad and toss.

title: Couscous, Onions, and Couscous
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups couscous or 1 1/4 cups dried couscous | 3 large vidalia onions, peeled, very thinly sliced
instructions: Prepare your couscous according to package directions and set aside. In a deep skillet set over high heat, add onions and cook, stirring now and then, until onions are limp. Pour couscous into a mixing bowl. Pour onions into couscous, stir, and serve with fresh bread.

title: Kiwi Mousse
ingredients: 3 kiwi fruits or 3 other firm-ripe fruits | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons tomato puree
instructions: Cut the flesh of the fruits into thin slices or cubes, and place in a bowl. Place the cream on a microwave safe plate, and heat it at 100% power. Spread about 1 tablespoon of the hot cream onto the surface of the berries, and stir quickly to blend the cream with the fruit and cream. When the cream starts to run, remove the plate from the microwave. Stir in the tomato puree or pass it through a sieve into a measuring cup so its liquid is clear. Pour this through a sieve, and stir in the pureed cream. Cover tightly and refrigerate until served.

title: Easy Basic Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 5 tablespoons olive, or more if needed | 5 tablespoons tomato sauce, or more if needed | 1 tablespoon caraway seeds
instructions: Combine olive oil, tomato sauce, and caraway seeds in a bowl. Allow dough to rest for 10 minutes. Roll dough out on a floured surface to 1/4 inch thickness.

title: Chocolate Lime Glaze
ingredients: 10 ounces bittersweet chocolate | 1/4 cup grated lime juice ( from 4-5 limes ) | 2 scallions, including green tops, finely minced
instructions: Finely chop half the chocolate. Heat the remaining unsweetened chocolate, lime juice, and scallions in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the chocolate is completely melted, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, whisk in the chocolate and let cool to room temperature, then whisk it again until smooth.

title: Cottage Cheese Balls
ingredients: 12 ounces cottage cheese, drained ( full cream or low fat ) | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Line a colander with a few layers of damp cheese cloth or cheesecloth. Place the drained cottage cheese in the cloth and wash until the water runs clear. Drain the cottage cheese in the cloth and place back in the cheese cloth. Mix the turmeric with 1/2 tablespoons of water. Sprinkle this mixture over the cheese. Tie the cloth with kitchen string over the cottage cheese and allow to sit, refrigerated, for about 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, squeeze the cottage cheese in your hands to remove the excess water. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,black tea,cauliflower,purpose flour,anise seed,cream mushroom soup,chicken bouillon cube
title: Quick and Easy Chinese Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 gallon green cabbage, shredded | 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 1 package cream of mushroom soup | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3 teaspoons anise seed | 4 cups brewed black tea
instructions: In large saucepan, combine all ingredients. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 3 minute take out aniseed seed and place all ingredients in soup pot and heat through. Do not boil. Serve warm and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheddar cheese,bean sprout,red chilies,seasoning salt,penne,graham cracker pie crust,chili sauce,vanilla
title: Baked Creamy Chilies Penne Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili sauce, i 'll double this for a kick | 1 can of diced peppers, drained | 1 1/4 teaspoons chili sauce | 1 can bean sprouts, drained | 6 red chilies, chopped, use whole if you have them | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 1 can refrigerated graham cracker pie crust | 3 -4 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Heat the chili sauce, peppers, bean sprouts, and chiles in a large saucepan over medium heat, stirring often until hot and slightly boiling. Turn heat down to slightly lower the heat. Sprinkle with cheese and season with seasoning salt. Pour into preheated pie crust and bake at 375 for about 30 minutes, and top with whipped cream or vanilla and chilli sauce. Let cool and serve warm or reheat when hot.

title: Wasabi Yellow Squash With Celery
ingredients: 2 celery ribs ( with leaves ) | 1 large yellow squash or 1 large zucchini | 2 teaspoons wasabi powder
instructions: Wash and peel the vegetables, chopping into 1/2 inch lengths. Cut the pieces into long thin matchsticks, trimming off the ends if desired. Arrange the vegetables on a platter which has been sprinkled with wasabi powder as you wish. Arrange the wasabi on top for effect. Serve with steamed white rice.

Random Ingredients: bulk sausage,mozzarella cheese,lettuce leaf,peppercorn,cider vinegar,wheat pastry flour,beef stock,marsala wine
title: Sausage & Marsala Wraps #2
ingredients: 3/4 lb bulk sausage | 1 teaspoon whole wheat pastry flour | 3 -4 large lettuce leaves, washed and dried | 2 tablespoons butter | 2/3 cup beef stock | 1/3 cup dry marsala wine | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray cookie sheet lightly with cooking spray. In a skillet, brown the sausage.

title: Bacalhau
ingredients: 1/2 whole orange, zest of | 2 cups pork shoulder, boned if possible | 1 lb salt cod fish, soaked and cut into 1 1/2-2-inch pieces
instructions: Heat a frying pan or skillet over medium heat. When pan is very hot, add whole orange and pork, then season with salt. Using a slotted spoon or fork, transfer to a large baking dish. Cover loosely with foil, place in a warm oven. Heat for about 20 minutes until pork is cooked through at about 165 degrees f. Remove bacon and orange from bone, then slice into strips. Serve with fresh, crusty french bread for dipping, or serve separately.

title: Barley Snack Mix
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 1/2 cup lemon peel | 2 teaspoons garlic powder ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and stir to mix. Store in refrigerator.

title: Lamb, Cornichon and Tomato Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 can cornichons | 1 package fresh corned beef briskets
instructions: Trim most of fat from brisket and cut meat into 1/2 x1 1/2 x4 inch sized pieces. Place in slow cooker. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook for 7 hours on low or until meat is very tender. Cook on high 30 minutes or on low for 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,self raising flour,yeast,currant,turkey pepperoni,kaffir lime leaf
title: Pub Turkey Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 500 g self raising flour | 250 g turkish pepperoni | 4 kaffir lime leaves | 1 pinch red chili pepper flakes | 200 g currants | 1/2 teaspoon yeast
instructions: Sift flour into bowl and make a well in the centre. Add peppers and lime leaves. Mix the yeast with 2 tblspn water and pour into well. Add more flour if needed to make a stiff dough. Knead until smooth but workable. Place mixture in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise until double. Add more flour if dough is too dry. Knead and work dough until smooth. Form into two balls. Cover and let rest 15 minutes. Cut into 4 pieces. Place on greased oven trays and cover. Let rise 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 200°c. Slice all off the top with a serrated knife. Slice through top once to break bread into 4 wedges. Bake 12 - 15 mins or until golden.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese,coconut milk,stevia,cooking oil,water chestnut
title: Stevia Rice
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk | 1 teaspoon stevia ( stevia powder ) | 2 teaspoons cooking oil | water chestnuts, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped jalapeno pepper ( more or less to taste ) | 3/4 cup grated low-fat parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 1-1/2 cups )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine coconut milk, stevia, and oil. Set aside a few water chestnuts and one jalapeno pepper. Set aside remaining pepper for garnish. In a medium size saucepan, combine rice, water chestnuts and cheese. Drizzle coconut milk mixture over rice mixture. Cover saucepan and cook on medium heat for 5 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: peach,green onion,mexican oregano,mango,watermelon,red pepper,olive oil,self rising flour
title: Peachy Mango Pizza
ingredients: 1 mango, peeled and cut into small cubes | 1 watermelon, cubed | 1/4 cup sliced green onion | 1/4 cup finely chopped red pepper | 2 tablespoons dry mexican oregano | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 cups self rising flour | 1 cup water | 1/4 cup finely chopped peeled ripe mango
instructions: Place the mango cubes in a bowl with the watermelon, onion, red pepper, oregano, olive oil. Cover and let stand about 20 minutes. Mix the flour, water and mango in a food processor until smooth. Transfer the mango mixture to a lightly buttered 10 cake pan. Bake in a preheated 400 degrees f oven for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,turmeric,chicken,sugar snap pea,grand marnier,white onion
title: Filet in Caramel
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs filet of beef | 3 medium white onions | 1/2 cup sugar snap pea ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 10 fluid ounces grand marnier | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Remove the meat from the refrigerator. Place the slices of meat on a solid platter and trim. Using your fingers, push a piece of plastic wrap directly on the meat, trying not to tear it. Place the sugar snap peas on the platter. Slice the onions thin, and place in the platter. Cut a cross in the top of each slice, making sure the cross stands down to retain its shape. Place the meat slices on top of the sugar snap peas, then place the sliced onions around the meat. Sprinkle the meat with the turmeric and grand marnier. Serve with plenty of crusty french bread. Serves.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,salt black pepper,saffron strand,nonstick cooking spray,taco seasoning mix,french bread,bicarbonate soda
title: Homemade Baking Powder - Crock Pot
ingredients: 4 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda ( baking soda ) | 4 teaspoons salt or 4 teaspoons sea salt | 1 lb french bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 cup nonstick cooking spray ( eg : corn, rice or soy bean canes ) | 1 1/2 cups nonstick cooking spray | 5 teaspoons taco seasoning mix ( or to taste ) | tiny pinch saffron strand ( optional )
instructions: Spray the inside of your crock pot with cooking spray. Place all dry ingredients into a small bowl. Mix the two types of cooking spray and use as the rub in the mixture, to coat the bread well. Spray a small dish, spray with cooking spray and lay the bread cubes in with half the dry ingredients. Spray half your empty crock pot with cooking spray and spray and sprinkle the other half of the dry ingredients over the bread cubes to make sure the bread is evenly coated. Spray the crust of the bread using the empty crock pot and place the bread on the crock pot. Turn the crock pot on low, leave door slightly ajar for a few minutes, and turn back on again to low.

title: Guacamole for Chips, Chips, Chips and Meats
ingredients: 1 cup guacamole | 2 1/2 tablespoons italian seasoning
instructions: Heat the grill, or heat the oven to 500 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the guacamole and the italian seasoning. Spread guacamole onto several large, well buttered baking sheets. Use a cookie cutter to cut out circles or circles. Bake until the edges are a rich golden brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white wine,cream tartar,dijon mustard,orange peel,canola oil
title: Mustard and Dijon Oil
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely grated | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the white wine, mustard and orange peel. Whisk in the oil. Set aside. In small bowl, combine the cream of tartar and tahini. Place the mixture in a small bowl, and mix it with a fork until smooth. Add the cream of tartar to your mustard oil as desired.

title: Papaya Salad
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper ( seeded and cut into bite sized pieces ) | 4 hard-boiled eggs ( peeled and chopped )
instructions: Place the two bell peppers and chopped eggs in a salad bowl, stir to mix well, then refrigerate for at least an hour before serving.

title: Okra and Swiss Chard Saute
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh okra ( about 1 1/4 lbs. ) | 1 small white onion, diced | 1 1/2 cups swiss chard, diced, stems trimmed | seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons dry mustard powder
instructions: In saucepan, cover okra, onion, and chard with water. Bring to boiling.

title: Pineapple Pear Jam
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned crushed pineapple with juice | 3 pears, quartered, cored and divided | 2 serrano peppers, seeded and sliced thinly | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: In a heavy 8 1/2 10 inch skillet over medium heat, combine pineapple, 2 pears and serrano peppers, reserving 2 ounces of juice. Stir juice mixture and reserved juice mixture to loosen browned bits from pan. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,pumpkin puree,lemon juice,chipotle powder,red chile,chinese five spice powder
title: Pumpkin Spice Mixture!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 2 cans pumpkin puree | 1/4 teaspoon chipotle powder
instructions: Mix everything together. Leave in refrigerator for up to 1 week for flavours to meld.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,purpose flour,clove,flat leaf italian parsley,chili powder,head cauliflower,romaine lettuce leaf,plantain
title: Tortilla With Caramelized Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, cut in florets | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 5 cloves | 4 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 16 slices flat-leaf italian parsley, divided | 16 slices large smoked plantains, each slice about 1/8 inch thick ( about 2 cups ) | 8 romaine lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. In a medium saucepan of boiling water, cook the cauliflower until bright green and tender crisp, about 5 minutes.

title: Sharlotka
ingredients: 4 tablespoons corn oil | 4 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a jar and shake until the corn oil is thoroughly incorporated into the mixture. Refrigerate for several hours, shaking occasionally. Pour sharlotka onto a pastry board and cut into small squares or triangles.

title: Mousse Fondue
ingredients: 250 g milk chocolate, finely chopped | 1/2 lime, zest of | 4 tortillas, toasted until golden
instructions: In a frying pan over low heat, melt chocolate until smooth and creamy, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in lime zest to coat. Preheat oven to 180°c. Spread a generous amount of chocolate onto the toasted tortilla, place the tortilla back into the pan and scatter with lime filling evenly over the tortilla and spread out evenly. Repeat with remaining tortillas. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: brandy,heavy whipping cream,red wine,honey,tomato puree,dill,french bread
title: Tomato Cream and Dill Bread Pudding
ingredients: 3 ounces unsmoked french bread, cubed | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato puree | 3 1/2 tablespoons brandy | 2 tablespoons honey | 3 1/2 pints thickened whipping cream or 3 1/2 pints heavy whipping cream, divided | 1 ounce fresh dill, chopped plus extra sprigs to garnish | 2 tablespoons good-quality red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove the crusts from bread. Line a 2 inch deep, deep baking tin with wax paper and set aside. Place the bread cubes in a food processor and blitz it until it becomes coarsely ground. Add all of the tomato puree, brandy, honey and 3/4 cup cream and process again. This should form a fine paste. Place the bread mixture into the centre of the pan and press the mixture in lightly. Pour the remaining cream over the bread mixture. Cover the pudding mixture and bake for 30 minutes or until the top is light brown. Sprinkle with dill, garnish with remaining dill and serve.

title: Pei Fruttes Ala Rolow E Nogane (Persian Hard-Boiled Eggs With Nuts)
ingredients: 8 eggs, hard boiled and peeled ( about � lb ) | 1/3 cup unsalted pistachio nut, roasted and ground | 1/4 cup celery, finely minced | 3 tablespoons brandy or 3 tablespoons whiskey
instructions: Peel eggs and cut in half lengthwise. Remove all shell. Set shell in a bowl. Grate pistachios using a meat grater or a hand grater on the coarse side of a box grater fitted with a finely grating blade. Reserve pistachio nuts for another use. In a separate bowl, lightly beat 6 egg yolks with 1/4 cup pistachios and 1/4 cup celery. Add brandy or whisky to egg yolks and beat well with a whisk. Season mixture with salt and pepper to taste. Gently drop the egg half into the egg yolk mixture one at a time, then turn the omelet over into the whites. Scatter remaining pistachios evenly over the omelet and serve immediately.

title: Almond Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 scallions, trimmed | 180 ml almond milk or 180 ml almond cream | 250 g icing sugar
instructions: Bring an oven proof pan of water to the boil. Meanwhile, trim the scallions and chop finely. Heat the almond or almond cream in a pan and stir constantly until it changes colour and the cream starts to thicken up. Add the scallions and boil for another 2 minutes. Spread out on a baking tray and sprinkle with the icing sugar. Allow to cool. When cold, transfer to an airtight container.

title: Linguine With Sesame Seeds and Cheddar Quesadillas
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1/4 cup reduced-fat cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon fresh rosemary, minced | 1/4 teaspoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Cook linguine 8 - 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again. Combine cheeses and seasoning in a small bowl. Dredge prawns in seasoned cheese to coat. Spray a non stick frying pan with cooking spray and heat to med high. Place oil in pan. Quickly turn prawns and cook 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Sprinkle prawns with sesame seeds, serve immediately. I like to use my zesty garlic and add a bit of fresh basil to the cheese mix.

title: Crusty French Toast
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb of good quality white bread, sliced into 1/4 slices | 2 tablespoons half-and-half ( to moisten )
instructions: Fry the bread on both sides in butter, add to a plate until ready to serve. Add half and half to fry pan to desired darkness. Serve immediately.

title: Macaroni With Pine Nuts, Onion & Chilli
ingredients: 1 cup macaroni | 1 onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sweet chili oil | 1/4 cup red wine | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Boil the macaroni in salted water until al dente. Drain well, and return to pot. In a frying pan heat the oil and fry the onion until soft. Add the wine and sugar. Sauté for 2 minutes. Add the drained macaroni and the hot sauce. Turn into a large pan with a lid, and cook for 3 minutes on a low heat.

Random Ingredients: white flour,anaheim chilies,cheddar cheese,cherry,italian herb,peppercorn,poblano chile
title: Chilies and Cheese
ingredients: 12 anaheim chilies, roasted, peeled and seeded | 12 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and seeded | 1 cup cherry, whole, halved | 1 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon dried italian herbs | 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn | 1/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place roasted chilies and poblanos on a cookie sheet and roast for 10 minutes, until they are starting to blacken. Remove to a colander and let cool. Once cooled, scrape any seeds from the chilies and place in a food processor and pulse for a few seconds until they are finely chopped. Add the cherry, flour mixed with spices and cheddar and pulse until mixture resembles coarse meal. Remove seeds from the roasted peppers by immersinging them in water or boiling water for about 2 - 3 seconds and drain. Remove the stems and seeds and pat dry on paper towels to remove excess moisture. Cut chilies in half lengthwise, cut off stems, halve the chilies and put the halves in a greased baking dish. Add the peppers and remaining ingredients to the baking dish and bake for 30 - 45 minutes.

title: Beef & Veggie Pancakes
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, pounded thin | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 3 cups soymilk | 1 small white onion, finely chopped | 8 cups assorted burrata cheese or 8 cups gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup veggie oil or 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: Dredge beef in flour and set aside. Measure soymilk and set aside. Saute onion in veggie oil approximately 5min. Add meat, stirring constantly until nicely browned, 2 3min. Transfer meat and onions back to pot or wok. Add soy milk, and bring to a light boil. Pour over meat and egg mixture. Add cheese and stir until melted and warmed through. Serve warm.

title: Korean Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 1 cup ketchup | 1/2 head of cabbage, shredded | 1/2 yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 1 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Slice steak into long thin sticks about 1/4 inch thick. Cook and stir fry steak over medium heat in a wok or deep skillet until no longer pink, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in ketchup, and vegetables. Serve over julienned kimchi.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,beef consomme,cream cheese,peanut butter
title: Chipotle Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups beef consomme
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve in a glass or plastic serving dish and chill until required.

title: Raspberry and caster sugar syrup
ingredients: 300 g raspberries | 5 teaspoons caster sugar
instructions: Put the raspberries into a bowl, sprinkle over 2 teaspoons of caster sugar and stir to combine. Cover and leave to marinate in the fridge for 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 140 degrees celsius. Remove the raspberries from the fridge, remove the shells, and cut into quarters. Place the raspberries in a roasting tin and scatter over the remaining sugar. Bake for 35 minutes, then remove from the oven, sprinkle on the remaining caster sugar, and return to the oven. Increase the oven temperature to 140 degrees celsius and bake for further 30 minutes, or until just beginning to soften and caramelise. Serve while still warm. Variation, add 4 to 5 teaspoons of caster sugar per 500g of raspberries after making the syrup.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,midori melon liqueur,deli roast beef,mushroom,cream
title: Aussie Beef
ingredients: 1 ounce midori melon liqueur | 1 ounce light cream | 12 slices deli roast beef | 12 canned mushrooms | 12 fresh mushrooms ( to garnish )
instructions: To serve, place two sliced beef on each plated plate. Dip in midori/midori mixture and roll beef up.

title: Cafe Rio Stewed Vegetables
ingredients: vegetables | 1/4 cup walnuts, chopped | 0.5 can diced fire-roasted vegetable juices
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan, microwave walnuts for 5 to 10 seconds or until heated through, not browning. Transfer walnuts to a small bowl.

title: Shoulder Lamb Chops with Blackberries and Oregano
ingredients: 6 shoulder lamb chops, 6 inches in diameter | 1 cup fresh blackberries or 1 cup frozen blackberrie | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 cup white sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar | 2 tablespoons vodka or 2 tablespoons vodka | freshly chopped oregano leaves ( garnish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f or 150°c. Place the chops between waxed paper and pound the meat until it is thin. Add the blackberries and oregano. In a small bowl, dissolve the sugar with the vodka if using. Sprinkle the mixture over the chops and rub in extra oregano. Place a piece of foil over a shallow roasting pan. Place the chops on the foil and rub the tops lightly with the rum/wine mixture. Wrap tightly in foil and place the pan in the oven. Bake, uncovered, for 3 hours or until the meat is a tender, moist and brown. Remove from the oven and remove the foil, garnish and serve with freshly chopped oregano.

title: Painted Olive Tapenade Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup green olives, chopped | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce
instructions: In cocktail shaker, place the olives and worcestershire sauce and shake. Then pour mixture into a bowl and let sit for 20 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sherry,coconut milk,green pea,double cream,green mango,mace,italian seasoning
title: Green Mango Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups green peas | 8 large green mangoes ( peeled, flesh left intact ) | 2 cups coconut milk | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 2 cups double cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: Remove and discard seeds from mangoes, cut into quarters. Puree peas, mangoes and coconut milk in a blender. Blend pureed mango mixture with sherry, cream, seasonings, and mango pea mixture until smooth. Freeze 1 1/2 hours, or until solid. Serve hot.

title: Easy Beef 'n' Cheese Sandwich #5FIX
ingredients: 1/2 lb cooked beef round steak, cut into thin strips | 3 cups frozen mixed hash brown potatoes, thawed | 1 cup fresh raisin, chopped | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine beef, potatoes, raisins and lettuce in a large bowl. Serve with your favorite topping.

title: Pesto Beef Steak
ingredients: 5 teaspoons pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons beef steak, trimmed
instructions: Combine the pesto sauce and the beef steak in a shallow dish. Cover and place in fridge for at least 30 minutes. Heat grill to high. Place steaks on grill tray and place under low medium heat for around 5 minutes each side for rare or longer for medium. Serve with the pesto sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,anchovy,fontina cheese,cream,mango chutney,coriander seed,red wine,bread
title: Savoury Crumbed Crackers With ananas
ingredients: 3/4 cup good quality mango chutney | 3/4 cup good quality red wine ( dry ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds, cracked and crushed | 1/2 tablespoon whole coriander seed | 2 1/2 ounces fontina cheese, cut into chunks | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander | whipped cream, for dipping, if desired
instructions: Put the chutney and the wine in a deep saucepan and simmer over low heat, stirring, for about 10 mins, then remove from the heat. Add the remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Pour 3 tbsp of the chutney mixture into a small baking dish. Dip the bread in the chutney mix and shake off the excess. Arrange on a tray lined with plastic wrap or lined with baking paper, then freeze for 2 hrs or until firm. To serve, run a knife around the edge of each tray to loosen and then transfer onto serving plates, allowing room for spreading. Serve with whipped cream or as a crumb topping alongside, if desired.

Random Ingredients: spice,ranch salad dressing,scallop,coriander powder,mussel,oyster mushroom,cherry tomato
title: Sailors Seafood Platter
ingredients: 1/2 cup scallops | 2 lbs fresh oyster mushrooms ( sliced thin ) | 1/2 cup small cherry tomatoes | 1/2 cup ranch salad dressing | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1 teaspoon spices | 1/2 teaspoon ground mixed spice
instructions: In a large bowl, mix 1/4 cup of the salad dressing, 1/4 teaspoon of coriander, 1/4 teaspoon of spice and 1/2 teaspoon of mixed spice. Add the scallops and mushrooms and coat evenly in the salad dressing, tossing everything well and breaking up the larger pieces of fish. Arrange on serving plate in alternate layers. If desired, decorate with additional coriander. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,orange zest,fish fillet,sea salt,orecchiette,green bean
title: Lamb and Fish Nests
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean lamb shoulder, boned and diced | 12 ounces green beans, trimmed | 1 orange, zest of, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 1 teaspoon dried orecchiette ( nouc ) | 2 1/2 cups cooked orecchiette
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and add all of the diced lamb in one layer. Cook until the lamb is tender and has begun to brown, about 10 - 15 minutes meanwhile, cook the beans in boiling salted water until tender. Drain well.

Random Ingredients: green olive,monterey jack pepper cheese,lime,arborio rice,beef stew meat,parsley,hard egg,button mushroom
title: Aussie Risotto With Beef and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef stew meat | 1 can green olives, drained and finely chopped | 1 cup arborio rice, cooked | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1/3 cup parsley, chopped | 1/3 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 3/4 cup button mushroom, sliced thinly | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Brown the beef and stir in the olives, rice, eggs, parsley, pepper jack cheese, and mushrooms. Heat through. Top with a squeeze of lime juice.

title: Chipotle Guacamole
ingredients: 3 avocados ( ripe, peeled and mashed ) | 1 chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: Place the avocados, chile, and adobo in a bowl. Stir, then enjoy.

title: Guinness Corn Relish
ingredients: 1 can guinness stout | 1 cup fresh corn kernels | 2 yellow onions, chopped
instructions: Drain guinness and place in a large nonreactive bowl. Add the corn kernels, onions and mix to blend. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour, but overnight works great on this.

title: Spaghetti and Meatball Skewers for Two
ingredients: 450 g lean hamburger | 20 toothpick sticks ( or 15 small ones ) | 400 g chickpeas | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 teaspoon basil | 1 teaspoon saffron, soaked in a cup of warm water
instructions: Soak the soaked chickpeas overnight. Drain them. Combine the chickpeas, meat balls, basil and saffron and marinate the meatballs for at least one hour. Thread the meatballs decoratively onto the skewers. Pour the warm water around the skewers. Place on wooden skewers. Cook over medium heat for about 12 minutes or until cooked. Serve hot with french breads or pita.

title: Roasted Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 3 large eggplants | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: If you use a roasting pan, put a rack in the centre of the oven and preheat the oven to 225 degrees f. Wrap the eggplants tightly in aluminum foil and put in the pan. Prick with a fork, then rub a small piece of roast fat between them. Roast for 1 hour, then roast until the skin is golden brown and the tender insides are completely soft but still holding their shape. Remove from the oven, transfer to a bowl and allow to cool slightly. Peel the foil and discard. If you don't have a roasting pan, you can put the eggplant pan inside a roasting pan. Preheat the oven to 390 degrees f. Using a paring knife, tear off a thin slice off either side of the eggplant, so that the flesh can easily slide out. Place the slices on a tray and place in the oven to roast, stirring frequently, for about 45 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the sugar and a drizzle of olive oil in a small saucepan. Heat, stirring, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture starts to bubble and bubble. Stir often while this is happening, so that the honey caramelizes on the eggplants. Turn off the oven. Pour the caramelized sugar mixture into a shallow dish. Put the whole eggplant pieces on top of the caramelized sugar mixture. Cover with more sugar and bake for 30 minutes, then remove from the oven, set aside to cool and set.

title: Canned Rum Apple & Caper
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup dry sake | 2 tablespoons fresh capers | 1 teaspoon wasabi | 1 half-and-half or 1 half-and-half
instructions: Pour all the ingredients into a large pitcher over ice, and chill for 2 hours or as well as overnight. Serve.

title: Pear, Walnut and Peach Kabobs
ingredients: 10 fresh peaches, halved lengthwise and peeled | 2 large portabella mushrooms, stems trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon raisins | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup finely chopped toasted walnuts
instructions: Thread peaches and mushrooms onto skewers. Grill kabobs over hot coals or medium direct medium distance for 8 minutes or until hot and tender. Combine raisins with turmeric and lime juice. Place nuts on a serving platter and top evenly with kebabs.

title: Cilantro (Cilantro) Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried cilantro | 1 -2 dried red chili pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Use as a rub for chicken, chicken chops or vegetables to marinate.

title: Black Olive Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa | 1 cup black olives in juice, drained
instructions: Pour salsa into a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: clove powder,romaine lettuce,shallot,ladyfinger,tomato basil pasta sauce,sage leaf
title: Tomato Basil Rolls
ingredients: 1/3 cup basil pasta sauce | 3 -6 fresh sage leaves, finely chopped | 1 large shallot, finely chopped | 1 pinch clove powder | 16 ladyfingers, halved lengthwise | 3 ounces romano lettuce
instructions: To build the rolls, place basil leaves on work surface. Top with sage. Sprinkle with onion, shallot, and cloves. Roll up and pinch the ends, trimming as necessary. Arrange them side by side on plate. Spoon a small amount of sauce over each roll. Garnish with basil leaves, serve with additional sauce on the side.

title: Easy Tamarind Bread
ingredients: 500 g bread ( i've used all purpose bread and it works great ) | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 25 g peanuts ( i've also added sesame seeds to this bread. ) | 1 packet fresh yeast
instructions: The night before you need to use the bread for this recipe, place the yeast in a small bowl with about 50ml warm water. Leave to stand about ten minutes or until the yeast is frothy start the oven to grease an oven tray. Slice the bread into 1cm slices. Put the slices in the oven about 6 - 7 minutes or until golden brown. Add the butter and spices. Put back in the oven and bake until very soft about 25 - 50 minutes on a low/medium heat. You can eat this with anything and it's even better the next day as long as you let them sit so it's really, really undercooked, and the yeast gets all water out, you can even cook the yeast in a pan. You can also leave it in the oven for about 10 - 15 minutes, but then it will get very dark as that. Serve with coffee, tea or coffee cream.

title: Quick and Easy Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 package beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 package prepared quick mix | 2 tablespoons prepared fat-free margarine and 2 tablespoons nonfat dry milk | 8 ounces uncooked spiralized or jumbo fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 package penne, twists
instructions: Remove crust from beef. Slice into thin strips. Combine 1/2 cup of milk and curry powder in a small bowl, stir until blended. Pour over beef in a shallow pie dish. Cover and refrigerate 15 minutes. Heat remaining half of milk, nonfat dry milk and 2 tablespoons of nonfat dry milk in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir beef in hot milk mixture 1 minute, until browned. Turn a large spatula over the beef. Reduce heat to medium high and stir in curry mixture and margarine. Spread beef over noodle strips. Cook and stir noodles 3 to 5 minutes, until noodles are heated through. Serve.

title: Balsamic-Roasted Tomatoes
