ingredients: 3 tablespoons fine sea salt or 3 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 lb plum tomato | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Season each tomato with the salt. Place on a plate just large enough to hold them and allow them to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes. Turn on the oven broiler and brush the tops of the tomatoes with the balsamic vinegar. Roast the tomatoes in the oven for about 15 to 20 minutes to brown the skin. Let the tomatoes cool. They can be eaten straight away with salad or grilled or roasted vegetables.

title: Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 package low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: In a large bowl, mix cottage cheese and oregano. Blend well. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving warm over pasta.

title: Santa Fe Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf whole wheat bread | 1 jar thick chunky salsa | 1 package frozen snow peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove bread shell from loaf and remove crusts. Use scissors to cut off and discard tops. Arrange bread on a baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees f for 45 minutes. Turn bread out of pan on baking sheet and cut into slices approximately 3/4 inch thick. Place slices into a bowl and cover with plastic wrap and towel. Let sit for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Using a slotted spoon, remove bread from plastic wrap and place on a serving platter. Pour salsa into a bowl and mix in green and white parts of the snow peas. Arrange bread slices over salsa mixture.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,nonstick cooking spray,oil,confectioner sugar,cumin seed
title: Jam Filled Rounds
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 1 1/4 cups confectioners'sugar | 5 cups miniature raspberries in light syrup | 6 teaspoons oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Sprinkle cumin seeds on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until fragrant, 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven and cool. Toast confectioners' sugar in the top of a double boiler over simmering water until it turns a deep golden brown. Remove from heat. Stir confectioners' sugar into cooled jam. Place a spoonful of jam into each ramekin. Serve with raspberry flavored jam.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,pepperoni,egg white,rice vinegar,baking powder,red food coloring,cherry
title: Cherry Omelette (Vegan)
ingredients: 6 large egg whites | 2 tablespoons shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon dried cherries ( optional, for those who like a lot of flavor ) | 1 -2 1 -2 tablespoon pickled peppersoni, chopped ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar ( to be water-based ) | 4 1/2 teaspoons red food coloring ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease pan with olive oil spray, and line with parchment paper. Mix egg whites, mushrooms and cherries in a large bowl using a fork. Add baking powder, food coloring and vinegar and combine. Add more food coloring if desired. Line pan with parchment paper. Pour egg mixture into prepared pan. Carefully spoon mixture onto parchment paper and allow to soak for 20 minutes. Cut omelet into 2 or 3 wedges. Serve while still warm. Makes two omelet servings.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,vegan mayonnaise,crisco shortening,mint leaf,head broccoli,potato
title: Curried Broccoli With Potato Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup crisco shortening | 1 lb potato, cut into 1/2 inch chunks | 1 head of broccoli, cut into thin florets | 7 -8 fresh curry leaves, finely chopped to taste | vegan mayonnaise | 1/2 cup mint leaf, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line two 9x13 casseroles with foil and set aside. Mix together the butter and shortening until very smooth, and thoroughly combined in a large bowl. Add the potatoes to the melted butter and shortening and mix with your hands until well coated. In a separate bowl, mix the broccoli with about 5 - 8 curry leaves, finely chopped curry leaves, and vegan mayonaise.

title: Black Caviar
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons black caviar | 1 1/2 tablespoons sake
instructions: Shake or spoon caviar into a clean dry bottle. Serve over ice cubes or spiced hot cereal, if desired.

title: Quick & Easy Taco Meat
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless chuck, meaty, trimmed, lean | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 can plum tomatoes or ( 16 ounce ) can crushed tomatoes | 2 pints cherry tomatoes or ( 15 ounce ) cans mixed cherry tomatoes | 4 -6 pinches cayenne | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Place chuck on large sheet pan and sprinkle with taco seasoning. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, turning once or twice during cooking. Combine all ingredients in large sauce pan, bring to boil, and simmer till meat is no longer pink. Serve with tortilla chips or fresh veggies for dipping.

title: Spinach and Veggies for Two(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh spinach | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1/4 lb fresh fig | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon water | 1 teaspoon ice water
instructions: Cook spinach for 3 - 4 min in boiling water. If spinach seems dry, add a little water. Add rest of ingredients. Let cool completely.

title: Onion Smoked Swiss Steak
ingredients: 4 ham steaks | 1 ounce hintz dutch-processed cocoa powder | 3/4 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Preheat smoker. Put steaks in a bowl of water, and pat dry. Place cocoa powder and onion salt in separate small bags, and put each in the smoker. Put lid on. Place on vent and smoke for 7 hours. Check frequently to make sure meat is no longer pink inside. After 7 hours, remove lid, and continue to smoke for 2 more hours to allow steam to escape before eating at once.

title: Beer and Wine Grinder
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes, medium, peeled, cut into 1 inch slices ( about 6 medium ) | 6 cups dark beer | 2 cans frozen orange juice concentrate | 3/4 cup sherry wine
instructions: In a food safe plastic bag, combine the potatoes, beer, and concentrate. Seal, and place bag in the refrigerator to marinate for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Line the grill with a drip pan or wire rack. Grill the potatoes and oil the grate, turning frequently, until the grinder is well crushed and dry, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to an air tight pan to cool to room temperature, then cover tightly and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: White Beans and Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 cup white beans ( cannellini beans ) | 1 loaf italian bread, cut into 4 slices | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint
instructions: Place beans in a pan with enough water to cover by 3 to 4 inches. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for a few minutes. While beans are cooking, warm bread slices under broiler in oven, or in a 350 f oven until puffed and lightly toasted. Remove bread from oven, and cut into smaller pieces. In a large bowl, combine bread with mint and beans.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,red wine,orange bell pepper,black peppercorn,canadian rye whisky,cheese
title: Canadian-Style Scotch Brochettes
ingredients: 24 ounces old english rye whisky | 1 orange sweet bell pepper | 1 -2 drop red wine, to taste | cracked black peppercorns | canadian swiss cheese, grated, to taste ( optional ) | marshmallows, to taste ( optional )
instructions: First, dry roast the whole orange very slightly over a candle flame for just a shake until it starts turning slightly golden. This will give you a good indication of how long the orange will take. Once the orange is cooked enough, scoop out all the orange flesh into a bowl, then place it in the freezer to chill. Place the chillin pepper in the blender at high speed, and add one drop red wine to the blender. Process until smooth. You should have a smooth cocktail with a slight grainy slushy consistency. Add more crushed cracked peppercorns if desired, and continue processing until everything is just incorporated. Place a large, sturdy piece of greaseproof paper on your working space and grease lightly with a cracker crumb or other non stick cooking spray. Place the whisky in the bowl and carefully mix. Add a little whisky and a few shakes of cracked black pepper, and mix through. Take one tablespoon of the whisky mixture and smear the surface very lightly with cracker or other non stick cooking spray. Place the tray of whisky mixture on the greaseproof paper, and with your fingers, press down gently. Use the back of one finger to press out a tiny amount of cracked pepper from inside, so that the whisky inside doesn't crack. Remove the tray/plastic on the whisky and sprinkle the surface with grated cheese, if using. Place the whisky onto the hot brochettes quickly, but only slightly, so that the tops cook evenly. Serve with a sprinkling of grated cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,lamb,beef consomme soup,red chile,steak,spring wrapper,salt pepper
title: Steak Rangoon
ingredients: 500 g steak, trimmed of fat, and cut into narrow strips | 600 g beef consomme soup, with 1/2 cup water | 500 g spring roll wrappers, about 24 | 1 pinch salt and pepper | salt and pepper | 1 dried red chile | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules
instructions: Make your sauce by putting all the prepared ingredients into a blender or food processor and pulsing them until the mixture becomes smooth, but not too thick. Reserve. Combine all the sauces and meat in a large pot and cook on very low heat for 30 minutes. Allow to cool. Place one wrapper in front of you and pinch the edge to form a triangle. Put about 1 teaspoon of filling on the surface of the wrapper and pinch around the edges so that there are no gaps along the edge. Continue until the mixture is used up. Put a small amount of water in your hand next to the wrapper. Then pinch the edges together so that they stick together, creating a triangle shape. Put the filled rice wrapper on a board with the widest part facing you. Fold both parts of the wrapper over to make a half moon. This will help keep the rice wrapper closed at all times. Slide your hand from step one onto a flat bamboo rolling mat. Keep the two parts upright and continue by passing it over and over again. Slide your hands from step two into a flat bamboo rolling mat. Fold the two parts of the wrapper over to make a half moon and the two parts are ready. Lay the two parts on a board with each part horizontal in between the other two, holding the two parts of the wrapper together at the same time. Repeat until all the portions are stuffed. Cut a steam hole in the centre of each piece of wrapper. Poke holes all over the rangoon using a fork, using a sharp knife to make holes all the way to the bottom of it all the way to the top of it. Place in a steamer over a pan of simmering water and cook for about 15 minutes over medium heat. Serve hot.

title: Spaghetti With a Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti ( i used whole wheat, but it works great too ) | 10 maraschino cherries or 10 any other cherry tomatoes
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in a pan of boiling water over medium heat until al dente. If using a whole baby cherry, remove stems from the cherries by removing them first. Rinse the cherry tomatoes on a grill pan. Drain the pasta and transfer to a large bowl. Add the cherries and half the cherry sauce. Toss with the rest of the cherry sauce. Serve with remaining cherry sauce.

title: Limoncello Sunrise
ingredients: 1 minute freshly squeezed limoncello | 2 teaspoons sultanas or 2 teaspoons dried fruit | 3 -5 ice
instructions: Stir limoncello in a cocktail shaker, add sultanas, or orange juice and shake vigorously until blended. Taste and adjust salt if desired. Pour into a glass and serve.

Random Ingredients: mustard green,guava,scallion,coconut oil,chili pepper flake,kaffir lime leaf
title: Steamed Mustard Greens
ingredients: 1 bunch mustard greens | 8 ounces guava, quartered lengthwise, rinsed | 1 teaspoon coconut oil, if desired ( for frying ) | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 2 scallions, white and green parts, sliced thinly | 1 -2 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Wash the greens and remove any tough stems and leaves. Rinse well under running water and dry on paper towels. Trim off and discard very coarse green ends of the stalks. Slice into ¾ inch strips. Put half the guava in a steamer basket and sprinkle with salt. Place over boiling water and cook for 5 minutes. Drain well and set aside to cool. Add remaining guava to the steamer basket, cover and cook over low heat for 2 hours. Stir in the coconut oil and chilli flakes, cover and cook for 10 minutes more. Cut the mustard greens into small wedges and stir into the guava mixture. Heat a wok or heavy skillet over high heat for 30 seconds. Pour 1 1/2 tablespoons of oil over the wok or skillet and swirl to coat. Add the mustard greens and coat well with oil. Cook, shaking the wok, shaking the wok every 7 minutes, for 3 to 5 minutes or until the greens are crisp tender and golden brown. Season to taste with salt and pepper with salt and pepper and garnish with fresh lime leaves. Serve hot. Tip, the lime leaves can also be eaten with mustard puffs, crisp tortilla chips, or sliced scallions and shredded coconut. For a little kick, make a few julienned red bell peppers and a few dashes of cayenne pepper to taste and add a little lime juice.

title: Pancakes for the Crockpot
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: In a 2 1/2 3 quart slow cooker, mix together soup and bread crumbs. Roll about 1/2 tbsp of crumb mixture into a small ball and place in between your thumb in the center of the ball. Push down the crumbs with your thumb and make a well in the center of the crumb mixture. Repeat for the remaining balls, placing approximately 1/2 cupful of crumbs into the well. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Walnut and Baking Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into smaller wedges | 1/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place wedges of potato on a baking sheet lined with a parchment paper, and bake in the preheated oven until tender and brown on the edges, about 45 minutes. Cool, and scoop out and discard potatoes from the skins. Heat the walnuts in a skillet over medium heat. In a bowl, toss the cooled potatoes until coated with walnut oil. Serve warm.

title: Apple Cheese Slaw
ingredients: 3/4 cup farmer cheese | 1 tablespoon apple jelly ( or jelly of your choice ( i personally use almond jelly ) or 1 tablespoon other jelly ( or jelly of your choice ( i personally use almond jelly ) | 1 large cabbage, julienned
instructions: Put cabbage in a bowl, add 2 tbsp apple jelly and a little bit of grated cheese. Mix with your hands until it looks like there is a nice amount of cabbage. Serve on top of other greens.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,beef chuck roast,monterey jack cheese,egg white,pastry crust pie,enchilada sauce,maple syrup,savory
title: Baked Beef Pudding Pie and Enchilada Meat Pie
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked beef chuck roast, cubed | 1 box pillsbury low-fat beef classics instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon dried savory or 1 teaspoon oregano | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon maple syrup or 1 tablespoon agave syrup, optional | 2 loaves frozen pastry dough ( partially thawed, with a little left moisture, thawed and refrigerated )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Grease a medium size mixing bowl with cooking spray. Mix the beef chuck roast with the pudding mix, enchilada sauce, savory or oregano, egg white and maple syrup. Transfer the beef to a mixing bowl and pour the mixture into an ungreased 10 inch pie pot, being careful to not overcrowd the pot. Reserve the dough that has been refrigerated for 10 minutes. Cover the bottom of the pie and place 2 of the phillian loaves into the dough with 2nd dough leaving 1/2 inch on the perimeter of the crust. Cover the dough with a third dough circle. Cover with 1/2 the meat mixture and repeat the layering of meat and dough before covering the dough and then using the reserved dough as a lid for the final layer. Place pie on a baking pan and bake for 45 - 50 minutes, or until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 160 degrees fahrenheit remove from oven and let sit for 10 minutes before cutting into pieces.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,white vinegar,poppy seed,cilantro leaf,coleslaw mix cabbage carrot,poblano chile,cream tartar,macadamia nut
title: Hawaiian Biltong
ingredients: 3/4 cup white vinegar ( or more to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 8 ounces macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup poppy seed, lightly toasted | 4 medium poblano chiles, stemmed, seeded and chopped ( not too hot or they will burn the outside ) | 8 ounces coleslaw mix ( cabbage and carrot ) | 1/4 cup pepperoni, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, loosely packed | pepperoni, slices ( optional )
instructions: Combine vinegar, cream of tartar and macadamia nuts in bowl of an electric mixer. Heat until sizzling, 1 - 2 minutes. Spread over cabbage.

title: Gran's Rommon
ingredients: 1/2 cup raisins | 2 green bell peppers, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons burgundy wine ( optional )
instructions: Place raisins in a medium bowl. Cut tops from peppers with a serrated knife. Cover and refrigerate for several hours, turning occasionally. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat raisins in a small pot over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove peppers and seeds, and place in a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Toss remaining ingredients in a bowl, and mix with raisins. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until peppers are tender.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,shrimp,spaghetti sauce,herb,chili powder,vegetable broth,pepperjack cheese
title: Spicy Shrimp Stuffed Jalapenos
ingredients: 12 shrimp, in shell ( cooked ) | 1/2 cup spaghettini or 1/2 cup spaghetti, uncooked | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons spaghetti sauce ( i use kikkoman ) | herbs, of your choice ( i don't use ) | pepperjack cheese
instructions: Heat a skillet on medium high. Remove shells from shrimp. In a bowl add shrimp, broth, juice & spaghetti sauce. Place in the hot skillet & cook on medium high until the liquid has reduced to a bit & shrimp is slightly pink. Take shrimp out of skillet & place into a bowl. Take olive oil & place on medium high. Place the jalapeño on the oil & saute until done. Top of the shrimp with the spaghettini. Sprinkle with herbs & pepperjack cheese to taste.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,white pepper,rose water,vegetable shortening,mayonnaise,white wine,flat leaf parsley
title: Herbed Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups mayonnaise | 1/3 cup white wine | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 teaspoons rose water | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper ( ground ) | 1 pinch white pepper ( ground ) | 1 pinch powdered rose water
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl until well blended. Use to dress greens, vegies, or chicken. Variation use fresh herbs like tarragon or marjoram for a dip. Store covered in the refrigerator.

title: Gruyere Cheese Salad with allspice
ingredients: 1 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup roma tomato, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh thyme | allspice | 1 -2 teaspoon finely chopped kaffir lime leaf, to taste | 1 pkaffir lime leaf, to infuse
instructions: In a mixing bowl with a lid, combine the cheese and the rest of the ingredients. Mix gently. Refrigerate several hours for flavours to combine.

title: Golden Syrup-Glazed Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup sweet chili paste | 2 cups sweetened condensed milk or 2 cups condensed light cream
instructions: The original recipe recommends pouring the sweet chili paste into a plastic bag, add the sweetened condensed milk or light cream, and seal the bag. Let marinate in the refrigerator for up to 5 days to develop the flavor.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,penne pasta,poppy seed,red curry paste,lemon zest,black tea,green olive,cheddar cheese
title: Tasty and Easy Pasta With a Kick
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta ( uncooked ) | 1 cup cheddar cheese ( finely shredded plus extra for serving ) | 2 ounces black tea | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 3/4 cup green olives | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 3 tablespoons zesty red curry paste or 1 tablespoon curry | 1/3 cup cake flour
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Easy Ladyfingers (France)
ingredients: 24 ladyfingers | 3/4 cup peanut butter | 1/2 - 3/4 cup unsalted dry-roasted peanuts | 4 large ripe but firm vanilla pods
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Line baking sheets with parchment paper, and set aside. In a bowl, combine the peanut butter, peanuts, and vanilla pods. Arrange a ladyfinger on the baking sheets. Top with the peanut butter mixture. Broil until the edges are starting to bubble and they begin to curl, 3 to 5 minutes, watching carefully so as not to burn. Remove from heat and carefully transfer onto a sheet covered with plastic wrap. Cool thoroughly, and cut in squares. Serve. Variation, you can make these ahead, roll the ladyfingers carefully in a piece of waxed paper to remove the plastic, wrap, and then in a ziplock bag and store for up to a couple days in the refrigerator before using. Variation, instead of the peanuts, you can use pecan halves if desired. The taste should be slightly sweet at this point, and the flavor will deepen into the peanut butter after chilling. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tamari,cajun seasoning,cardamom seed,steak,rigatoni pasta,green onion,granny smith apple,chorizo sausage
title: Grilled Beef Riggies
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamari ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning blend ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon cardamom powder ( optional ) | 1 lb top sirloin steaks ( or other inexpensive steak cut into 1/2 -inch cubes ) | 4 slices chorizo sausage | 6 green onions ( about 3/4-inch in size ) | 1 granny smith apple, cored and cut into 1/2-inch dice ( optional ) | 4 1/2 ounces rigatoni pasta or 4 1/2 ounces other flat pasta, broken in half if large
instructions: Combine the tamari, cajun seasoning blend, cardamom powder, and cardamom powder in a large resealable plastic bag. Add meat and seal bag. Marinate 30 minutes. Remove meat from bag, discarding marinade. Place meat on grill rack over medium heat or in large frying pan. Cook until meat reaches desired doneness, about 7 - 10 minutes per side for medium rare, 8 - 10 minutes per side for medium or until desired doneness is achieved. Place meat on cutting board and let rest about 2 minutes. Slice thinly across the grain. Meanwhile, bring large pot of water to boil. Add broken rigatoni and half of the green onion and cook until al dente, about 8 - 10 minutes. Drain. Drain, remove meat from pan, place on serving platter and keep warm. Pour juices over cooked rigatoni. Place remaining green onions on serving platter. Top with apple and meat slices, then drizzle with remaining tamari mixture. Yum.

title: Dark Chocolate
ingredients: 600 g dark chocolate, melted | 6 sprigs coriander seeds | 75 g dried apricots
instructions: Heat oven to 130c. Place choc with the coriander, apricots, 3/4 tsp sugar/spice blend and 3 tbsp of water into a microwaveable bowl. Leave to stand for 10 mins. Add to chocolate mix. Spread into greased ramekin and bake in oven for 7/8 mins until just set.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,oil cooking spray,olive oil,head iceberg lettuce,orzo pasta,salmon steak,ham,garlic clove
title: Smoked Salmon Italian Style
ingredients: 8 -10 salmon steaks, 1/4-inch thick | olive oil cooking spray | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ham, chopped | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 lb orzo pasta | 1 dash thyme sprig ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Spray broiler pan with oil. Dice salmon into bite sized chunks and place on sheet of foil. Spray pan with oil. Place salmon on top of salmon. Sprinkle ham evenly on top of salmon and ham and place remaining ingredients on top of salmon. Broil for 3 - 5 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly. Remove from broiler. Sprinkle orzo onto one side of plate, drizzle with olive oil and some thyme. Top with salmon and cooked ham. Serve.

title: Frozen Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup cherry tomatoes | 3/4 cup triple sec
instructions: Blanch the tomatoes for 7 minutes. Put in strainer and let dry for 1/2 hour. Puree them to a consistency that suits you. Put back in strainer and pour liquid into jar. Cover and store in the freezer for 3 - 5 days.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,triple sec,dark chocolate,salsa,chicken breast half,tomato puree
title: Southwest Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-sodium tomato puree | 1/4 cup bottled salsa | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 2 tablespoons chopped dark chocolate | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instructions: Combine tomato puree, salsa, triple sec, chocolate, and sea salt in a bowl. Marinate chicken in tomato mixture in a large resealable plastic bag, coating completely. Remove chicken from bag, add to marinade.

title: Beef Belly Buster
ingredients: 1 large onion, diced | 12 ounces sliced canned bamboo shoots | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Layer the onions, bamboo shoots, and mozzarella cheese into a 9x13 inch pan. Dot with a little canola oil. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until bubbly and slightly browned.

title: Quick and Easy Spring Rolls
ingredients: 50 g cannellini beans, drained well and rinsed | 50 g chunky salsa | 1 spring roll wrapper ( i use small balls ) | 1 sprig basil leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Place a dollop of salsa in the centre of one spring roll wrapper. Spread evenly with beans. Dampen edge of a spring roll wrapper with water.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,beef stew meat,yam,tomato green chilies,red chili powder,squash,vanilla ice cream
title: Slow Cooker Squash and Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 medium yams, peeled and diced | 2 large squash, peeled and cubed | 2 cups fat-free chicken broth | 1 jar stewed tomatoes and green chilies ( diced, i use rotel ) | 1 tablespoon red chili powder ( use less if you donã re spice it and change flavor ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 8 cups vanilla ice cream, softened
instructions: Dice up the yams and squash. Toss with chicken broth, diced tomatoes, chopped chilies and chile powder. Refrigerate 4 hours, until cold. Add vanilla and chillies and mix. Refrigerate 4 - 5 hours if using a crockpot. Stirring continuously, cook on high for 5 - 6 hours. I usually mix in half the ice cream at the end, and rest of ice cream a few minutes before serving.

title: Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup dried cranberries ( soaked for a few minutes in warm water ) | 1/4 cup onion ( minced ) | 2 tablespoons pure vanilla sugar | 2 lbs whole fish fillets
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients in a saucepan. Add fish and simmer gently over low heat, covered, for 10 minutes, until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve hot.

title: Asparagus Pasta Rice With Oranges
ingredients: 1 package uncooked asparagus spears, trimmed | 8 large uncooked pasta shells | 1/4 cup orange marmalade ( or apricot-chipotle marmalade ) | 2 cups risotto rice | 1/4 cup tamari
instructions: Prepare the uncooked asparagus as directed on back of label. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the asparagus spears for 6 - 8 minutes, or until slightly tender. Drain, and transfer to a large bowl. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Add the rice and orange marmalade to the boiling water. Cook for 5 - 7 minutes, or until the rice is tender but not mushy. Add the asparagus to the pot of rice. Cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Divide the asparagus rice and asparagus rice between two 2 1/2 cup baking dishes and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until the rice is golden and crispy. Remove asparagus from pot and top with a small spoonful of tamari for additional flavor. Serve immediately.

title: Herbed Dill Dressing
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh dill | dill or lemon juice
instructions: Blend it into a shaker with ice. Chill and serve as is or top with sour cream for a creamy variation.

title: Smoked Lamb and Parsnip Fingers (Lachael Ray)
ingredients: 4 slices smoked lean lamb, very thin | 2 tablespoons whole cumin seeds ( or 2 tsp dried seeds ) | 1 lemon, zest of | 2 tablespoons fresh capers | 1/3 cup smoky salmon fillet, diced | 6 sheets aluminum foil ( laranja ) | 2 small parsnips, peeled and halved ( about 1 lb. )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment. Combine lamb with seeds, zest, capers, 2 tbsp of the juice from the lemon, and 1 tbsp of the juice from the lemon. Divide evenly among the 4 slices of beef. Sprinkle fillet with remaining lemon zest and juice, and place on top of the fillets. Fold over the edges of the foil and press to seal. Place on baking sheet and place in oven, and bake until lightly browned, about 15 - 20 minutes. While this is cooking, steam the parsnips in a large steamer. Remove beef from steamer and set aside. Boil briskly for 10 minutes, or until very tender. Remove from steamer and set aside. Strain liquid through a sieve and skim off any fat. Place the pan over moderate heat and add 2 tbsp of the braising liquid. Cook until most of the liquid boils away, scraping the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon to loosen browned bits. Add salmon and parsnips and stir. Pour back into the pan and cook for several minutes more. Serve immediately.

title: Applesauce Shrimp Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine, uncooked | 1 can applesauce | 4 large shrimp paste | 1 jar sliced pimiento
instructions: Cook linguine as package directs, adding 2 1/2 cups water. Drain. Set aside. Meanwhile, mix applesauce and shrimp paste in a saucepan. Heat and stir over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes, until heated through. Add pimentos and 3/4 cup water. Cook for 2 minutes to warm through. Return linguine to pot. Add sauce. Heat through.

title: Polish Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 cup chicken bouillon, dissolved | 1 cup cremini mushroom, sliced | 3/4 cup green onion, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Spray a 4 cup measuring cup with cooking spray and set aside. Bring broth to a boil, add bouillon and reduce heat to low. Add mushrooms and green onions and simmer until tender, about 12 minutes. Remove 1/3 of the sauce from water, reserve 1/3 and set aside. In clean bowl or food processor, add marjoram, and caraway seeds. Process until the oil has been released from the mushrooms, about 10 seconds. Remove mixture from processor and pour mushroom mixture back into skillet and add reserved sauce. Toss to coat, heat through, and serve in warm shallow bowls.

title: Italian Sesame-Olive Bread
ingredients: 100 g sesame seeds | 100 g gruyere cheese | 1 zucchini ( about 2 ounces ) | 2 artichoke hearts ( optional to add at the end of cooking ) | 1 tablespoon espresso | 2 loaves bread ( i like buns ) | 4 tablespoons breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Grease 4 nonstick ovenproof pans. Spread the sesame seeds on a baking tray and toast until golden.

title: Cheesy Bok Choy and Beef Linguine
ingredients: 200 g fresh cheese, grated | 200 g anchovies packed in oil | 250 g chuck steaks, thinly sliced and cut into 2cm chunks | 350 g stewing beef, chopped | 200 g fresh chinese sausages | 40 g cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1/2 liter boiling water | 1 bok choy, to serve
instructions: Soak sago in water for 30 minutes. Fry anchovies in oil until light golden. Remove anchovies with slotted spoon and set aside. Fry beef until beginning to brown. Remove with slotted spoon and add to beef. Add sausages, stir fry for 5 minutes, then add cornflour and boiling water, cook for 1 - 2 minutes. Add anchovies to beef and stir fry for a further 3 - 4 minutes. Remove beef and sausages from sauce and set aside. Cook the noodles according to the pack instructions. Toss noodles with chopped bok choy and anchovies and serve.

title: Pumpkin and Celery Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 cup grated, cooked pumpkin | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a medium bowl, blend the soup with the cream of celery soup. Stir in the pumpkin until evenly blended. Cover, and chill until serving time. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,amarula cream liqueur,palm sugar,strawberry,turnip,five spice powder,egg noodle
title: Peel the Noodles in Five-Spice Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles, broken in half | 1/4 lb fresh strawberry, sliced | 1/4 lb baby turnip, cut lengthwise | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh chives ( no stem part ) | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 3/4 cup aromatic amarula cream liqueur | 1/4 cup palm sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Place egg noodles in a medium bowl and cover with 1/4 cup cold water. Cover with a lid and refrigerate until noodles are tender, 3 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, add strawberries, turnip, chives and 5 spice powder. Bring to a boil and simmer, covered for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in amarula. Set aside. In a deep skillet set over medium high heat, warm the remaining 3/4 cup of brown sugar, 2 tbsp of aromatic oil and 1/4 cup of melted butter. Add half of the noodles. Cook, stirring, until barely soft, 5 minute. Repeat until noodles are evenly coated with the sugar. Transfer noodles to a serving platter and sprinkle with remaining melted light brown sugar. Garnish with remaining fresh strawberries.

title: Chicken Tarkari
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs chicken thighs | 1 ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Cut the chicken thighs into the desired size. In an iron skillet put the ginger and garlic pasted onto the chicken, and brown on both sides. Turn as needed to brown on all sides. Put aside until needed. When all the chicken is browned, set aside in a separate kettle. Pour any excess drippings that remains in the skillet over the chicken to absorb any drippings. Cover, and let simmer on a low heat setting until all the juices have evaporated and the chicken is coated in the mixture. This will take about 1 - 1 1/2 3 hours. This will take about 30 - 40 minutes total on your thermometer. I usually take it at least 45 minutes in all.

title: Almond-Pickled Peppers
ingredients: 4 bell peppers, any color ( red, yellow, red, pimento-stuffed ) | 1/2 cup sofrito sauce | 1 teaspoon pickling spice | 1/2 cup arborio rice or 1/2 cup other short-grain rice, rinsed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground mace
instructions: Char or broil the peppers, turning frequently, until blackened all over and blistered, 5 - 6 minutes. Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Wrap the peppers in plastic wrap and steam on foil in a steamer set over boiling water until tender, about 10 minutes. Cool and put through a meat grinder. Stir the sofrito with the sugar and season with cardamom and ground mace. Chill for at least an hour, stirring several times. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Mexican Trail Mix Bread
ingredients: 2 cups flour | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder | 1 1/2 cups low-fat soymilk
instructions: Mix flour, chipotle powder and soy milk in a large bowl. Beat on loigh for 1 minute at medium speed. Knead for 10 minutes. Shape into a ball, place in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise in fridge for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Grease cookie sheets, divide dough into three sections, cover with parchment. Shape into round loaf to fit over greased pans. Bake 25 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,bell pepper,lemon pudding,tomato,topping,dark beer,cocoa powder
title: Dutch Antilles
ingredients: 1 lb mozzarella cheese, sliced | 1 cup dark beer | 1 package instant lemon pudding ( or equivalent brand ) | 1 can tomatoes ( with juice, with or without basil ) | 1 -2 cup fat-free frozen whipped topping | 1 medium bell pepper, chopped ( any color ) | 1/4 cup cocoa powder
instructions: Layer ingredients in a greased 2 quart baking dish starting with mozzarella. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

Random Ingredients: molasses,artichoke heart,chicken breast half,beet,green chile pepper,ham,whipping cream
title: P.f. Chang's Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch strips | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 can canned beets with green chile peppers, drained and chopped | 2 teaspoons molasses | 1 cup whipping cream | 8 slices country style ham, chopped thinly | 1 can chopped green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Combine the artichoke hearts, beets with 1 can green chilies in a blender with the molasses, and puree until smooth. Pour half of the mixture into a shallow dish, and place the chicken in the remaining marinade. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Soak the ham slices in the cream, and then slice the slices into 1/4 inch slices. Cook the chicken over preheated grill for 5 minutes per side, or to the desired degree of doneness. During the final minutes of grilling, spoon off excess cooking juice. Top with the green chilies during the last few minutes of grilling.

title: Couscous With Rhubarb and Jicama
ingredients: 8 ounces couscous | 4 ounces rhubarb, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 shallot, minced | 3 tablespoons dried cherries | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1/4 cup grated gruyere | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Put couscous in a medium sized bowl & cover with warm water. Set up a fork & poke holes to the couscous. Let sit for 5 - 7 minutes, then fluff with fork. Add rhubarb, shallot & cherries to couscous & mix well. Add almond extract, smoked paprika and cheese & mix well. Serve on a platter topped with mint.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,pimiento,liquid smoke,coconut oil,chicken wing,broth,bok choy
title: Indonesian Style Chicken Stock
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 lb chicken wings, tips cut away | 2 cans chicken wings, liquid drained | 1/4 cup pimiento, drained and chopped | 3 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a 6 cup saucepan. Brown chicken. Transfer chicken to the 6 cup saucepan. Pour in stock over chicken. Add pimientos, chicken wings, liquid, and liquid smoke. Cover and simmer 15 - 20 minutes, until chicken is cooked, stirring occasionally. Uncover and stir. Cover and simmer 5 - 10 minutes, until liquid is reduced to a thick, syrupy consistency. Discard solids. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,sherry wine vinegar,soy yogurt,herb,fennel bulb,rhubarb
title: Rhubarb and Sheep Tzatziki
ingredients: 500 g rhubarb, peeled | 2/3 cup soy yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon fresh herb, chopped | 1 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup fresh fennel bulb, diced
instructions: Peel and dice rhubarb. Wash and dice sheep stalks and stems. In a small mixing bowl combine the soy yogurt, honey, sherry vinegar and fennel. Mix well. Add the rhubarb and gently mix to coat. Cover and let stand about an hour.

title: Green Tomatoes With Spring Onions
ingredients: 2 kg green tomatoes, halved | 2 large spring onions, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Line 2 large baking trays with baking paper. Cut a deep cross hole in the tops of the tomatoes. Place the tomatoes on the trays and drizzle with the spring onions. Bake for 45 mins the tomatoes, skin side up, should still be crunchy when tapped. Serve with ketchup and steamed green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,cream mushroom soup,blue curacao,english cucumber,cornmeal,meat,picante sauce
title: Mexica Stuffed Cucumbers
ingredients: 8 english cucumbers | 1 lb ground meat | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | shredded mexican cheese of choice | 1 teaspoon blue curacao
instructions: Slice off ends of the cucumbers and remove seeds. Place upside down in a colander to drain. Place in a large bowl and squeeze out excess moisture. Combine the remaining ingredients including the juice from the cucumbers. Place in a 2 quart saucepan and heat mixture on low heat while constantly stirring. Remove from heat, place on one half of a dinner plate and top with american cheese. Slice to serve.

title: Terrific Mexican Cheezy Dip
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 4 tablespoons guacamole | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | horseradish sauce
instructions: Brown ground chuck lightly. Add remaining ingredients and bring to boil. Place in 9x13 dish and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Chickpea Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Slice kielbasa crosswise in 1/4 inch thick slices. Put oil in a large baking pan. Arrange kielbasa in pan. Place chickpeas in pan. Sprinkle w/cinnamon lightly. Bake 15 minutes. Turn over and bake 8 - 10 more minutes or until kielbasa is browned and internal internal temperature is 165. Add honey. Pour over sliced kielbasa.

title: Apple Artichoke & Green Chile Pasta
ingredients: 3 lbs ripe artichokes, with outer leaves removed from stem., cleaned ( or 3 pounds frozen artichoke hearts, thawed ) | 2 cans chopped green chilies, drained | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 lb farfalle pasta, broken into 2-inch pieces or 1 lb penne pasta | 1 1/2 large apples
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f cut stems from artichokes.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,mint leaf,hamburger bun wheat bread,raspberry,sea salt,tahini,thyme leaf,ham
title: Raspberry Burgers and Corn
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 1 tablespoon tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 1/4 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | sea salt | 1 hamburger buns or ( 10 ounce ) wheat bread, split | 1 tablespoon finely chopped ham | 1 large raspberries | fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Combine cream style corn, tahini, thyme and salt in a small bowl and stir well until combined. Divide mix between 4 flat, shallow gratin dishes, each with a little indentation, then sprinkle evenly with sea salt. Preheat barbecue to medium high heat. Remove any excess fat from corn. Barbecue corn in batches, using 3 tablespoons tortilla for each, for 3 - 4 minutes, turning once. Transfer to baking sheet and let cool. Grill until crisp, 1 - 2 minutes. Split burger, top with ham, then drizzle with 1 tbsp corn dressing and berries on top.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,kaffir lime leaf,red cabbage
title: Totally Twisted Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 large red cabbage | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf ( i use 2 small limes )
instructions: Cut the head of cabbage into pieces, removing any tough leaves. Slice down the center core, core and finely shred the cabbage. Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate to chill.

title: Green Beans With White Chocolate
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen green beans | 2 ounces white bittersweet chocolate | 8 serrano peppers, sliced
instructions: Cook beans in boiling salted water just until crisp but tender. Drain. Add chocolate and remove from heat. Stir until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Serve immediately.

title: Apricot Lettuce Rolls
ingredients: 250 g lasagna noodles | 1/4 - 1/3 cup apricot preserves | 1 - 1 1/2 g onion powder | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon lettuce leaf
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles. Drain noodles, rinse and then drain again. Dip each noodle into apricot jam and sprinkle with onion powder. Place on a platter lined with lettuce. Place a lettuce leaf on edge of lids and roll up to make a tight roll. Serve with lots of dressing.

title: Dilled Tomatoes for Enchiladas
ingredients: 6 -8 tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup apricot juice or 1/2 cup grape juice | 1/3 cup dill or 1/3 cup parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients and blend well. Pour into a serving dish. Sprinkle with dill or parsley and serve.

Random Ingredients: salt white pepper,parsley leaf,cumin seed,red wine,banana pepper,mirin
title: Tropical Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 8 large sweet potatoes ( about 2 pounds total, scrubbed of dirt and dried ) | 1/2 cup red wine | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted and crushed ( preferably aleppo ) | 1/2 cup parsley leaves, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons mirin or 3 tablespoons sherry wine | salt and white pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and cool. Peel if desired. Cut in half lenghwise. With a mandoline or meat pounder roughly cut the sweet potatoes. Combine 1/2 cup red wine, cumin seeds, parsley, and 2 tablespoons water in a saucepot over moderate heat. Bring just to boil and cook until thickened, about 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Toss together potatoes and remaining wine. Serve.

Random Ingredients: radish,flour,kiwi fruit,chicken bouillon granule,rosemary sprig,egg white,coriander seed,beef
title: Irish Gaelic Meatballs
ingredients: 300 g ground beef | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon dried fresh rosemary sprig or 1/4 cup fresh rosemary | 500 g kiwi fruits or 500 g other fruit, peeled and quartered | 2 radishes, halved and quartered | flour ( for coating ) or fresh breadcrumb, for coating
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. In a bowl, combine all ingredients except flour or bread crumbs. Using your hands, add the flour and mix well. Dough will be loose. Wrap dough in plastic wrap and place in an airtight container for 1 hour. Preheat barbecue plate or griddle. Divide dough into 2 equal portions. Using 3 pieces, roll each into a thin circle. Place on the barbecue plate and cook for 8 minutes, then turn over and cook another 8 minutes. Remove from pan and place on tray while oven heats up for 10 - 15 minutes. To serve, place a spoonful of meatballs onto a small piece of plate or piece of toast, sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve with a little bit of butter on top.

title: Potato Quinoa Ring With Spinach and Potato
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup chopped spinach leaves | 6 -8 large ladyfingers | 1 large potato, thinly sliced
instructions: Start with pre cooked quinoa at least 1 hour ahead of time. Rinse it lightly with cold water and drain it thoroughly. Set it aside in a strainer under cold running water, until water runs clear.. In a large bowl combine the quinoa, spinach, 5 or 6 lady fingers biscuits, potato and 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Dip the lady fingers in the olive oil and place them in a ring on a baking dish. Place into the oven and allow them to bake for 1 hour. Remove from oven and let cool completely before serving.

title: Hawaiian Patty's
ingredients: 2 pounds ground turkey | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons green bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 medium plantains, sliced
instructions: Mix ground turkey, molasses, green pepper, and plantains together in a large bowl. Form mixture into 4 patties about 1 inch thick. Heat a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Cook patties until lightly browned, about 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,port wine,iceberg lettuce,self rising flour,whiskey,red cabbage,baby bok choy
title: Smoked Beef & Green Apple Jalebi
ingredients: 2 baby bok choy | 200 g red cabbage | 1 red cabbage | 200 g smoked top quality smokey steak | 1 tablespoon self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 tablespoons whiskey | 1 tablespoon port wine
instructions: Boil and steam the bok choy and cabbage until tender. Meanwhile, slice the steak thinly. Finely slice the bok choy and cabbage. Put the meat and bok choy in a large bowl. Add all of the vegetables except the whisky, flour, soy sauce, and port. Stir the ingredients together and add the whiskey and port at last. Mix together and serve immediately.

title: Chicken on the Run
ingredients: 8 chicken cutlets | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 4 maraschino cherries
instructions: Combine 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice in a small bowl. Dip cutlets in the spice mixture and place on a baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees f for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes on each side.

title: Spanish Style Salad Dressing - 6 Points
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, peeled and minced ( vidalia onion can be used, but vidalia is not recommended, not the authentic ) | 1/3 cup green pepper, minced ( approx. a red pepper, more or less ) | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon peel, finely shredded | salad greens
instructions: Mix well. Chill for several hours to allow flavours to develop. Best if allowed to sit, chilled, for up to 3 days before serving, although a minimum of 4 hours usually results in more pronounced flavour. Shake lightly before serving. If you leave the spanish pith and the green skin on, that will give the dressing a better texture. If you leave this unrefrigerated, then the flavour will be lost and salad will be rather bland, so leave the seeds in before serving. If you wish, you can sprinkle the chopped green onion on the top before serving. Variation, use 1 large vidalia onion. Or add 1/3 cup minced parsley, if you wish. Note, use any vidalia onion you like.

title: Roasted Almond Chicken
ingredients: 1/3 cup almond meal | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 4 -6 -6 lbs chicken meat
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place almond meal and vinegar in separate plastic containers, place chicken in a shallow baking dish. Add marinade mixture. Sprinkle top with additional 1/3 cup marinade mixture to coat the chicken. Bake about 55 minutes or until an instant read thermometer reads 180 degrees fahrenheit. This step can be done in the microwave for 3 to 5 minutes in a large non stick skillet. The idea is to moisten the chicken with 2 tablespoons warm water periodically between simmering motions. Remove chicken from pan and place on a piece of foil covered plate. Cover loosely with foil and let rest for 15 minutes. Slice. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Ginger and Radish Dip
ingredients: 3 3 large radishes or 3 large other greens | 1 tablespoon grated gingerroot | 1 1/2 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 1/2 cups gouda cheese
instructions: Cut away most of the hard stem part from the radish or the curly green portion, if using savoy cabbage. Use only the main stem. If using savoy cabbage, cut large sections into wedges or rounds, just radiating the stem out like an open cone. Cover the wok with a paper towel, to prevent drying out. Place radish wedges over the paper towel and press gently. Place remaining wedge or rib of cabbage on cutting board and gently press to release the juices. Peel away the outer tough rib end, then slice it into wedges about 3 inches long. The wedges should look somewhat like rounds of cabbage. This will help prevent them from bending up. In a small bowl mix the ginger and grated cheese. Using a mortar and pestle or the back of a small spoon, rub the ginger cheese lightly into the radish wedges. Place radish wedges onto a baking sheet lined with wax paper, and sprinkle with a little more cheese. If using savoy cabbage or gouda cheese, bake it in a large, preheated oven at 350 degrees f for about 20 - 25 minutes until just lightly golden. It should be quite dry, so watch it. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,chili paste,salt black pepper,orange peel,greek yogurt
title: Somali Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound napa cabbage | 2 tablespoons orange peel, slivered | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 2salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place napa cabbage in a large bowl of cold water. Let sit for about 30 minutes, or until cool enough to handle. Rinse under cold water, then place in the bowl of a blender with orange peel, chili paste, and yoghurt. Blend until smooth.

title: Duck Confits
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f grease a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. In a large bowl, mix together the veal, tomatoes, and half the cheese. Spread in baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 45 - 50 minutes until center is browned and cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,savoy cabbage,chili powder,milk,frying chicken,white wine vinegar
title: Cabbage Chicken
ingredients: 1 gallon whole milk | 1 1/2 lbs frying chickens | 1 can savoy cabbage | 4 eggs noodles | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( or more, to taste ) | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Wash chicken inside and out and place in large roasting pan. Cook in 350 degree oven for 60 minutes. Remove skin from chicken and tear chicken into pieces. Place meat with remaining liquid in large pot. Slice onions and add to liquid along with 1 can of savoy cabbage and 1 teaspoon of chili powder. Put pan on stove on stove on medium heat, stirring occasionally. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 1 hour or until cabbage is softened. Stir occasionally. Stir potatoes, eggs and vinegar into broth. Return to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Adjust seasonings and serve with boiled rice.

title: Tofu Keke
ingredients: 1 package extra-firm tofu | 1/2 pound ground chicken | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon white sugar, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Slice the tofu in half lengthwise. Scoop out the hard center and pulp with a melonballer, and reserve. Place tofu onto a baking sheet with the center cut side facing upwards. Place under the broiler until lightly browned and crisp, about 10 minutes. Remove tofu to a bowl, and set aside. Cook and stir ground chicken, nutmeg, italian seasoning, and sugar in a skillet over medium heat until the chicken is no longer pink inside, and the mixture has a bit of a touch of pink color, 7 to 10 minutes. Slice the tofu in half crosswise, and arrange into a bowl with the chicken mixture. Add soy sauce to taste.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Beef Brisket
ingredients: 5 lbs beef brisket, trimmed | 1 can beer, cold ( i use miller lite or bullseye ) | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 head garlic paste | 1 tablespoon dried apricot, rubbed | 1 tablespoon dried chives | 3 packages cellophane noodles
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees. Drain beer and place brisket in roasting pan. Combine coriander, garlic, and apricots. Pour over brisket and add bay leaf if using. Scatter chives over brisket. Cover tightly and roast 2 hours or until beef is fork tender. Cook cellophane noodles according to directions on package.

title: Hot Chocolate Sundaes With Mushrooms and Rice
ingredients: 12 large mushrooms | 1 pint chocolate ice cream ( not soft block or milk ice cream ) | 2 tablespoons oyster mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 sticks bamboo skewers or 2 lbs rice steaks
instructions: Trim the ends off the mushrooms then slice them into half then slice them into half again. Cover the mushrooms with plastic wrap then place in a bowl with ice cream to keep it soft place in the fridge for about 15 - 20 minutes. Wash the bamboo skewers in warm water then slice those into very thin strips or long pieces and set aside. Using a skewer you should have a bunch of long, thin strips or long strips of noodle like the ones used for oyster mushrooms. Soak bamboo skewers in warm water for about 10 minutes. Take a few sticks of noodles at a time and use your fingers to poke holes on them about 20 cm/1½ inches deep. Insert your wooden skewers through them. Start at one end of the skewers and stuff the noodle with a large handful of the mixture. The idea is to stuff all the noodles perfectly. Repeat until the noodle or mixture is gone. Leave on the skewers for another 10 minutes or so. Slice the skewers across so you have 4 pairs of pieces to serve. Place one bamboo carrot or skewer on each plate and place a few straw mushrooms in each, if using. Drizzle over with a splash of cocoa powder or sugar before serving. Serve with sweet chilli sauce or with ketchup or sriracha sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,white bread,beef stew meat,chili oil,ice,lasagna noodle,white cake mix,snow pea
title: Quick Beef, Snow Pea, and Olives
ingredients: 6 slices white bread ( like boboli ) | 1 pound beef stew meat, cubed | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 package frozen sliced mushrooms, thawed | 1 package lasagna noodles | ice, as needed | 1 cup kalamata olives, pitted, halved | 1 1/2 cups white cake mix
instructions: Place a baking sheet into oven and preheat to 400 degrees f. Toast the bread slices until lightly browned and crusty, 7 to 10 minutes. Set aside. Wipe off excess salt from stew meat and cut into bite size pieces. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir meat until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Cook and stir mushrooms in the skillet until tender, about 5 minutes. Place noodles onto a baking sheet or large baking dish and spread out in the middle of one large piece of bread. Place the remaining bread slices on top of the bread and spread with chili oil. Place 2 to 3 layers of beef and mushroom atop the noodles. Spoon about 1/2 cup of the olives over all the layers of meat and mushrooms. Top with 1 to 2 cup of the white cake mix and top with remaining 1/2 cup of olives. Repeat layer once more to give the noodle layer a complete layer of olives. Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for about 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top layer is browned, about 15 to 20 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,oregano leaf,cremini mushroom,pepper,ginger preserve,canola oil,simple syrup
title: Garden Savory Mushrooms (Pigs)
ingredients: 12 large cremini mushrooms ( about 6 ounces ) | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup unseasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 1/8 teaspoon ginger preserves
instructions: Place mushrooms about half full of water in a 12 inch saute pan.

title: Limeade En Escabeche
ingredients: 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate | 2 ounces canned oyster mushrooms | 1/2 cup teapsoon brewed tea
instructions: Empty the 2 cans of limeade concentrate into a medium bowl and stir in the fresh mushrooms and tea. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and allow to chill for at least 1 hour before serving. Serve over crushed ice.

title: Spicy Sausage and Pear Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs thin italian sausages | 1 medium red cabbage | 1 pears ( approx ) or 1 apple ( approx ) | 4 -6 tablespoons spices | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 cup beer | 1 whole lemons or 1 whole orange ( or the whole lemon! )
instructions: Cut the sausage into a 1/2 slices. Cut the cabbage into 1/2 in dice using the core and then slice lengthwise into 1 1/2 slices, this will also produce a lot less work if you're combining all the ingredients. Put all of the ingredients into the bowl of a food processor and pulse a few times until mixed well. If you don't have a food processor, just use a sharp knife and mix well. Enjoy.

title: Linguine with Beans and Parsnips
ingredients: 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 can cannellini beans | 2/3 cup dry red wine | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley ( flat-leaf italian ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried ground allspice | 1 package linguine, cooked to package directions
instructions: Combine garlic, cannellini beans, wine, soup mix, parsley, oregano, and allspice in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil.

title: Pineapple & Bean Sprouts Penne
ingredients: 350 g dry penne pasta | 60 g low fat margarine | 1/2 cup pineapples or 1/2 cup mango jam | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 teaspoon caster sugar or 1 teaspoon raw sugar | 600 g bean sprouts, julienned | 1 -2 tablespoon tzatziki
instructions: Cook pasta. Meanwhile, melt margarine in a large frying pan over low heat. Add in the pineapples/mango jam and cook until jam is reduced by half. Add parsley and sugar and stir until dissolved. Add 1 cup of hot water to the pasta and bring to boil, stirring to stop the pasta sticking to the base of the pan. Drain pasta and pour onto a large bowl. Stir in pasta and nuts until well coated. Serve with tzatziki.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,chutney,italian cheese,pinto bean,carrot,angostura bitter,egg,peach syrup
title: Hot N' Sour Bean Breakfast
ingredients: 8 small pinto beans | 12 slices italian cheese | 12 slices fresh carrots | 2 tablespoons sweet chutney | 2 tablespoons chutney | 3 drops angostura bitters | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 6 eggs | 1 teaspoon palm sugar
instructions: Place pinto beans on a plate. Layer cheese slices and carrot slices on top. On the cheese, spread a thin layer of sweet chutney. Sprinkle dark chutney and angostura bitters over the chutney. Place one egg on top of the chutney mixture. Heat a frying pan using medium high heat, and break egg into the pan. Fry for about 2 minutes, flip over and fry the other side until the egg is firm. Remove from the pan and cut into wedges. Place the bacon on a plate, and place one slice of egg on top of each slice of cheese. Serve hot with warm fruit or vegetable cocktail bread.

title: Sliced Herbed Chocolate
ingredients: 6 ounces strong dark chocolate | 24 fluid ounces herb, fresh mixed ( dandelion, chives, scallions )
instructions: In a clean dry glass, melt 6 ounces of the dark chocolate over gentle heat. Leave to cool. Add the herbs, and set aside until you can handle them. Pour cooled melted chocolate into an attractive glass or ceramic bowl. Add remaining dark chocolate, and allow to melt over gentle heat until smooth. Carefully stir in the herbs quickly so as not to break them.

title: Easy Pea Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 package frozen green peas, thawed | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger powder
instructions: Place thawed peas in a food processor. Add ginger powder.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,celery rib,lime juice,puff pastry,black coffee,pastry crust pie,head cabbage,red kidney bean
title: Vegetarian Russian Pasties
ingredients: 1 pre-made pastry for a double-crust pie | 1/2 cup self-rising flour or 1/2 cup unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 -2 head of cabbage | 1 small head of cabbage | 1 can red kidney beans | 1/2 cup black coffee ( optional ) | 1/2 cup lime juice | 1 -2 tablespoon freshly-squeezed lime juice | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 small head of cabbage
instructions: Pastry, preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Slice the top off the head of cabbage then, with a fork, slice it as thinly as possible, leaving it in large chunks about 1/4 inch thick. Place the cabbage and 1/2 cup water in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cook until very tender, about 40 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the cabbage and set it aside to drain and cool slightly on paper towels, then slice it as thinly as possible. Cut the large head of cabbage in half along the core ends but do not peel. Set bottom crust on a baking sheet. Place the dough on a clean surface and with a sharp knife or 2 knives, cut out the thick core from the outer crust and the core that holds it together. Place it in a mixing bowl with the flour. Add enough liquid, to make the mixture a ball. Roll or stretch the dough out to desired thickness and cut out 3 inch discs approximately 1 1/8 inches wide. Cut each disk as thinly as possible. Place the dough discs on the baking sheet. Bake the pasties until the bottoms are well browned, about 10 minutes. Remove and let cool slightly. Slice the cooled cabbage into thin shreds, discarding the core and other core. Serve the pasties with cabbage and sliced black olives on the side.

Random Ingredients: grain wild rice,turmeric powder,cilantro,table salt,tomato,goat cheese
title: Rice and Goat Cheese Quiche
ingredients: 1 medium tomatoes, ripe, peeled, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup goat cheese, crumbled ( or fresh goat cheese ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh cilantro, finely chopped | 1/4 cup long-grain wild rice, cooked ( if instant rice isn't used, you may use canned egg or lemon eggs ) | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Arrange the tomato and goat cheese on the bottom and sides of a 9 inch quiche pan. Season with cilantro, wild rice, salt, and turmeric. Spread the rice mixture on top of the tomatoes and goat cheese. Bake in a 400 degree f oven until the cilantro has reduced and turned golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Herbal Coconut Mocktail
ingredients: 90 ml unsweetened coconut milk | 50 g good quality chocolate, grated | 1/2 teaspoon herbal tea ( i use celestial's herbal )
instructions: Stir coconut milk, grated chocolate, & herbal tea together in a bowl until smooth.

title: Puerto Rican Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 tablespoons light sour cream ( or low-fat sour cream ) | 4 tablespoons sliced kalamata olives | salt and pepper | 4 romaine lettuce or 4 bibb lettuce
instructions: To make the dressing, mix sour cream, olives, salt, pepper, and salad dressing. Serve.

title: Tampa Cilantro Lamb Wraps
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, fat trimmed, butterflied and patted dry | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon lemon extract | salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Make 5 shallow incissions in the fat in each piece of lamb leg with a pairing knife. Combine butterflied and patted lamb, cilantro and lemon extract. Wrap each meat with a teaspoonful, tying with kitchen twine. Place the lamb in a baking dish. Bake for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,penne pasta,coffee,garam masala,feta cheese,beet,white sugar,lamb stock
title: Beet Scented Penne With Lamb
ingredients: 1 lb dried penne pasta, uncooked | 1 1/2 lbs boneless lamb or 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into large chunks | 1/2 cup brewed coffee | 6 beets, quartered | 1/4 cup pumpkin seeds | 1/3 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 8 teaspoons garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons white sugar
instructions: Combine coffee and meat and marinade in a slow cooker and coat. Cook meat and vegetables on low 7 to 8 hours or on high 4 to 5 hours, until meat is tender. Stir in nuts and cheese about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Peachy Peaches on a Hawaiian Roll
ingredients: 3 peaches, halved and pitted | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 prepared pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place peaches in a medium baking dish and bake 10 minutes, flip and bake 10 minutes longer or until internal temperature of peach is 180°f. While the peaches are baking, prepare the pizza dough as directed on package. Take the peaches out of the oven and scoop out the shells. Place on a board and spread out the peaches on the board using a plastic spatula, rolling them as you go. Arrange the peach shells in the center of the roll. Dip the tips of the fingers into the bread crumbs and lightly sprinkle over the peaches. Starting at the back edge of the roll, roll the peach slices around the roll until completely coated with bread crumbs. Place roll onto baking sheet. Bake at 425°f for about 10 minutes or until browned and crust is crispy. To serve, cut roll in half. Cut in 1/4 inch slices.

title: Thai Stuffed Rice Noodles With Dates (Kao Tome Gao)
ingredients: 12 ounces rice noodles, boiled and cooled | 1/2 cup chopped green cabbage | 1/4 cup finely chopped red pepper | 1/2 cup finely chopped shallot | 2 tablespoons finely chopped dates, pits removed
instructions: Mix all ingredients except dates together until well mixed. Using a teaspoon carefully fill each rice noodle from one end to the other using a generous portion of the mixture. Place the filling in a small bowl and sprinkle over the dates. Cover and chill any remaining mixture in refrigerator. Serve immediately or allow to firm up before serving.

title: Beware Spicy Apple Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons apple juice | 3 tablespoons chili oil | 1 garlic clove, crushed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve with meat.

title: Soy Sauce for Beef (Lol Bap)
ingredients: 1 cup tamari soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon caraway ( optional )
instructions: Combine tamari sauce, caraway and beef. Marinate 1 hour or longer. Note, add more if you wish to marinate.

title: Pecan Pomegranate Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups pomegranate juice, divided ( not low-sodium ) | 1/2 cup ground pecans | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine 3/4 cup of pomegranate juice, pecans, garlic powder, and coriander. Mix well, stirring frequently. Chill until ready to use. This may also be made by bringing the rest of the juice to a boil in a small saucepan and stirring while stirring until you see the water evaporate. Add the remaining 3/4 cup of pomegranate juice and let simmer for 30 minutes. Stir frequently.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,kalamata olive,lemon,brie cheese,lemon peel,baby spinach,fontina cheese,bouillon
title: Brie and Spinach Bake
ingredients: 10 ounces brie cheese, cut in 2-inch cubes | 2 lbs head cauliflower, separated into florets | 4 pints baby spinach | 1 cup chopped pitted kalamata olive, lightly toasted | 1/3 cup dry roasted sweet-and-sour lemon peel | 1/2 cup crumbled fontina cheese | 2 teaspoons instant bouillon | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place oven rack in middle position and heat to line a cookie sheet with foil. Mix together the brie, cauliflower and spinach. Spread mixture into 2 quart casserole. Sprinkle with pitted olives. In a small bowl, combine the dressing ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange lemon slices over spinach mixture. Drizzle dressing evenly over the top. Cover the casserole and bake 35 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 5 - 10 minutes until top is golden.

title: Za'atar Glazed Roasted Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons za'atar spice mix | 1 tablespoon coarsely grated fresh ginger ( or 1 teaspoon ground ginger, or more, to taste ) | 2 -3 lbs boneless beef rump roast | 2 - 3 1/2 lbs pear ( red bartlett is also lovely ) | 2 -3 lbs spareribs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare the marinade by stirring together the za'atar, ginger, and coarsely grated ginger. Rub the roast with the za'atar mixture and place on foil lined rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle the roast with the remaining za'atar mixture. Roast, uncovered, 1 hour. Remove from the oven and transfer to a platter. Pour off any fat/oil in the roasting pan. Add the pears and ribs to the pan and turn the meat.

Random Ingredients: egg white,liquid honey,parmesan cheese,arborio rice,beef stew meat
title: Rice Balls, Risotto Style (Risotto in a Glass)
ingredients: 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1 beef stew meat or 1 other meat | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1 egg white | 200 g freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Rinse and use the water to bring out the liquid and flavor the rice and set aside. Slice the meat into thin strips, about 1 1/2 cm long. Heat a little butter and saute the meat in it until browned. Stir in rice and allow to sizzle. Add the liquid, honey and meat and mix well. Cover and steam until the rice is cooked, stir in the egg white and cheese and combine thoroughly. The mixture may look slightly runny. Serve at once or store in an airtight container for up to 3 months in the freezer.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,rice noodle,hot red pepper flake,bread,jalapeno,kosher salt,shrimp,pasta
title: Shrimp Noodle Cakes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped jalapenos | 2 tablespoons finely chopped bread | 8 ounces uncooked medium shrimp, with shells | 1 ounce uncooked rice noodles, about 1/2 inches wide | 1/8 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons dry bread, divided | 16 slices toasted bread, for dipping bread
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, saute jalapenos with 1 tablespoons bread until browned. Transfer to a small bowl, and set aside. Add shrimp to the skillet, and cook for a couple of minutes, stirring frequently, until shrimp are pink, no longer transparent and just beginning to turn pink. Add rice noodles and red pepper flakes to shrimp, and cook for about a minute, stirring. Add salt, and stir until mixed well. Remove from heat, and set aside. On a baking sheet, toast graham cracker crumbs for a few minutes on each side, until toasted. Dip each slice of toast in the shrimp mixture, keeping an eye on the crumbs to avoid burning, until you have a single layer of crumbs on the top, and then set aside. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the shrimp mixture on an ungreased baking sheet. Cook for approximately 10 minutes, or until shrimp are just cooked, stirring and being careful not to overcook. Serve hot. Enjoy.

title: Perfect Saffron Brown Rice (Ara Cauda)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( or you can use homemade if you have none ) | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon saffron ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon
instructions: Rinse and drain the rice so you don't lose any excess water. Place rice in a pan and cover with water. Turn heat to medium and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cover. Cook 15 minutes and add pesto sauce, reduce heat to low. Meanwhile, place balsamic vinegar, saffron and tarragon in a small bowl and mix well. After 15 minutes, remove the rice from the heat and allow rice to sit covered with the lid for 5 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork, serve immediately. You can leave out the saffron and re introduce the balsamic vinegar if desired.

title: Cajun Venison
ingredients: 3 lbs venison | 3 tablespoons cajun seasoning
instructions: Cut venison into 1 inch cubes. In a large non stick skillet melt butter. Brown venison cubes in melted butter and cajun seasoning. Drain fat. Spread to cover venison, cover and continue cooking over low heat 20 to 30minutes until venison is tender.

title: Guiness-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1/2 cup guinness stout | 15 slices fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Combine the milk and ginger paste in a medium saucepan over medium low heat. Stir to blend. When the milk starts to warm, gradually mix in the guinness. Remove the pan from the heat. Spread the ginger tomato paste evenly on the mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,white rice,chicken thigh,heavy whipping cream,dark molasses,white bread,string bean,beef chuck
title: Crock Pot-Slow-Cooker Coq Au Vin
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch cubes | 32 ounces beef stock | 8 ounces string frozen corn kernels or 8 ounces frozen corn | 4 slices white bread, toasted | 8 ounces heavy whipping cream | 2 cups white rice ( white, medium or jasmine are best ) | 2 tablespoons dark molasses
instructions: Place the meat in the crock pot and add the beef stock. Cook 6 - 8 hours on high or 8 - 10 hours on low, until the meat pulls apart easily and the vegetables are tender. Transfer the meat to a cutting board, shred, and set aside in a large bowl. Strain the stock through a sieve and return the stock to the pan with the corn, bread, cream, molasses, and some salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer, partially covered for 45 - 50 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Meanwhile, preheat your oven to 350 degrees f. Pour the sauce into a 1 qt. Dutch ovenproof casserole dish and bake until bubbly and hot, about 20 minutes. Serve over individual rice or egg noodles. You may also serve over cooked brown rice if you wish.

title: Gorkyar (Indian Carrot and Orange Blossom Water)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons vodka | 2 tablespoons orange flower water | 6 tablespoons fresh chiles, seeded and finely chopped | 2 lbs carrots, peeled ( or cut up into 1 inch pieces ) | 1 cup melted ghee
instructions: Combine the vodka, orange flower water, chiles, and carrots in a medium bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain the carrots. Melt the ghee in a large frypan over medium heat. Working in batches, add the carrots and fry until they are golden brown, about 10 minutes. Working in batches, reduce the heat to medium low, add the caramelized carrots and cook for 4 - 5 minutes. Pour the carrots into a large bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: sauce,cremini mushroom,bulgur,anchovy paste,confectioner sugar,seasoning,farfalle pasta,chicken breast
title: Kiss Me Cut (Pasta)
ingredients: 1 package bulgur | 1 1/4 cups chicken breast cutlets | 1 cup cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 cup farfalle pasta, uncooked | 1 bottle hot sauce | 3/4 cup light cream or sour cream | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Combine bulgur, chicken and mushrooms in a large bowl. Stir in anchovy paste. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle, then cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,halibut fillet,raspberry jam,beef chuck roast
title: Roasted Beef and Raspberry Gravy
ingredients: 3 1/2 pounds beef chuck roast | 1/4 cup raspberry jam | 1 can beef broth, divided | 1 rasher salmon fillet ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons raspberry jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place a rack into a baking dish. Bake beef in the preheated oven until an instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the meat registers 160 degrees f at one side, 15 to 20 minutes per pound. Allow to cool slightly, slice across the grain into 1/3 inch slices, and arrange the slices on a separate dish. Spread 2 tablespoons of raspberry jam onto the cut sides of each piece of meat and top with 2 tablespoons of raspberry jam. Serve warm.

title: Sweet and Spicy Apples
ingredients: 150 g plain flour ( for dusting ) | 150 g diced apples | 2 -4 tablespoons mild thai sweet chili sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f. Place flour on a board. Using the pastry of your hand, gently mix the flour and the apples into a large roundish roll. Cut the roll into 4 even pieces and use the palms of your hands to rub the flour into the dough. Roll out each piece of dough on a lightly floured surface and then mark into 6, 8 wedges each. Using your hands, spread a small amount of sweet thai chilli sauce over each wedge. Sprinkle with worcestershire sauce. Bake in oven for 10 - 12 minutes until golden brown.

title: Curry Parsnips With Parsnips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, unpeeled and peeled | 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste, to taste | 3 tablespoons cider, red cooking | 4 tablespoons russian salad dressing
instructions: Cut parsnips in half and remove the core. Cut the parsnips into 1/4 inch slices. Lay out a baking sheet large enough to hold them in one layer, and bake in a 300 degree f oven about 12 minutes, until crisp tender. In a serving bowl, combine curry paste, cider and dressing. Place parsnips into the bowl and toss to coat.

title: Quick Italian Sausage Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1/4 cup minced garlic salt | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon marmalade | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine garlic salt, 1 tablespoon olive oil, marmalade, and garlic salt in a small bowl. Brush pizza dough with 1 teaspoon of olive oil.
