Turn dough over onto a lightly greased pizza pan. Sprinkle half of marmalade mixture on top of dough. Roll dough out into a circle, and cut into 4 or 5 evenly spaced pieces. Brush crust with remaining 1 teaspoon of olive oil. Bake on pizza pan for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until crust is golden brown and sausages are hot.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,feta cheese,milk,walnut half,vanilla,pork shoulder,chicken wing
title: Greek Yogurt Dessert Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder | 2 packages chicken wings | 1 cup walnut halves | 1 1/2 cups feta cheese | 3 cans whole milk | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place pork shoulder in 4 quart crock pot or dutch oven. Cover with water. Add 3 lbs. Of chicken wings, one can of walnuts and cheese. Cover and simmer on low 8 to 10 hours or until pork is very tender. Add milk and cream. Stir and heat through. Stir in vanilla. Serve in soup bowls or dessert cups.

title: Chinese Meatball or "dr' Oetker's"
ingredients: 500 g ground meat or 500 g ground beef | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | fresh cilantro
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form into balls or smaller meatballs depending on your preference. Cook in the oven at 180 degrees for around 35 minutes or until cooked completely. Serve with steamed rice or noodles.

title: Chipotle Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 2 boxes macaroni and cheese ( such as goya brand ) | 2 -3 limes | 2 -3 chipotle chiles in adobo
instructions: Cook and drain noodles according to package directions. Drain noodles, reserving 1 3/4 cups of the cooking liquid. Combine chipotles in adobo and reserved cooking liquid in a small bowl and use as a dipping sauce for macaroni. To serve, add 2 tbsp of chipotles and 1 tbsp of the reserved cooking liquid to reserved noodles. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,red chili pepper flake,fish,peanut butter,tomato
title: Fish Skewers - Satay Style
ingredients: 1 fish, cut into 5 pieces | 1 large tomatoes | 1 teaspoon dried orange peel | 4 -6 dried red chili peppers, seeded | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes ( for taste ) | 1/4 cup smooth peanut butter
instructions: Cut tomato in 10 thick slices, and remove seeds and pulp from dried peppers, if using. Mix fish with all other ingredients except peanuts.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,mayonnaise,grape tomato,black cardamom pod,pork loin,apple,kidney bean
title: Grape Tomato and Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pod | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin, thinly sliced | 2 large baking potatoes, about 1 inch thick, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cups halved grape tomatoes ( about 3 tomatoes ) | 2 tablespoons diced fresh apple ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Spread mayonnaise over both sides of pork slices in 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle with cardamom and top with sliced potato. Layer the pork, beans, tomatoes and apple. Bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes or until heated through.

title: Homemade Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 kg meat ( lean ) | 2 cups cranberries | 1 cup vinegar
instructions: Put the dried cranberries in a mortar and pestle. Crush them coarsely in your fingers. Add the vinegar and mix well so the cranberries absorb all the liquids. This is very important, cover the stock with cling film, place in the fridge and leave overnight. Do not over soak the stock. Remove from the fridge and leave overnight. Serve as required.

title: Stevia Russian Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon white mustard seed | 1 1/2 - 2 cups vodka | 2/3 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed ( see tip ) | 1 teaspoon finely grated ginger-garlic paste ( see tip ) | 2 teaspoons stevia
instructions: In a small bowl, combine mustard seeds and 1 cup vodka. Add the rest of the ingredients.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,raspberry,bacon,cardamom,lemon juice zest,ziti pasta,confectioner sugar,italian breadcrumb
title: Famous Ziti
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 1 1/4 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 1/4 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 1/2 cups shredded ziti pasta | 1 cup fresh raspberry | 1 large lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 cup shredded mild white american cheese
instructions: Preheat boiler to 350 f degrees. Grease 13x9 inch glass baking dish. Cook bacon until crisp. Drain bacon on paper towels, reserve. In a large bowl, pour bread crumbs, bread crumbs, 3/4 cup confectioners' sugar, ziti pasta, raspberries, lemon juice, cardamom and 1/2 cup cheese over crumb mixture. Toss until combined thoroughly. Spoon about 1/4 cup crumb mixture into sprayed baking dish. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup confectioners' sugar over crumb mixture. Bake in preheated oven 45 minutes, uncovered or until golden brown.

title: Roasted Cauliflower With Garlic & Sudo
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower | table salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds, toasted | 1 tablespoon roasted sumaq ( see description ) | 2/3 cup table salt | 3 tablespoons dried sweet fennel flowers, crumbled or 2/3 cup fresh rosemary, chopped | 1/4 cup coarsely grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat the grill to high, or build your fireproof casserole dish. Bring a large pot generously salted water to a boil over high heat. Drop in the cauliflower and sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons the cumin seeds. Boil until tender, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cauliflower to a bowl, then cover with a lid and let steam for 3 minutes. Transfer the cauliflower to a bowl. Dry off the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds, then toast over moderate heat, shaking the pan frequently, until dark brown and fragrant, about 30 seconds. Remove the seeds with a fine mesh sieve and transfer them to a heavy skillet. Add the roasted sumaq, then toast, shaking pan frequently, until golden and fragrant, about 30 seconds. Place the fennel in a mortar and crush with the back of a teaspoon. Add 1 tablespoon of the crushed fennel seeds, 1 tablespoon of the garlic garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 cup water and mix well. Bring to a simmer and simmer, uncovered, until thick, about 5 minutes. Add 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid and simmer 10 minutes more. Season with salt and add the remaining cumin and the freshly grated cheese. Taste for seasoning to your taste. If using a mortar and pestle, pound the cauliflower with the remaining garlic powder until it is a rough, chunky purée. Transfer it to a serving platter or shallow dish, then spoon the roasted garlic mixture over it. Sprinkle with the fennel flowers and serve immediately.

title: Quick Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 4 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 3 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon italian parsley, chopped, or more to taste
instructions: Combine taco seasoning and cider vinegar in small bowl. Stir in parsley. Mix with hands.

title: Italian Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon dried dill sprigs | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Place tomato sauce, dill, and oregano in the slow cooker. Cover, and cook on high for 2 hours. Serve hot.

title: Salsa De Pepino
ingredients: 1 can pepino cheese ( or other mild cheese ) | 1 lime, juice of
instructions: Chop the pepino fine and put into a small bowl. Squeeze a lime wedge over it and squeeze the juice on the cheese. Serve with a salad and chips.

title: Aunt Vi's Colcannon
ingredients: 1/4 cup lard ( or butter can be substituted, though the flavor is not the same ) | 1/2 cup white frozen peas and carrots ( thawed, if frozen ) | 1/4 cup fresh peas and carrots, thawed, if frozen ( thawed, if frozen ) | 2 green giant frozen texas petit pois frozen peppers and carrots | 1 teaspoon red food coloring ( optional ) | 12 small patty holes in frozen colcannon
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place 1 tablespoon of the lard or butter in a 12 or 15 inch frying pan large enough to hold texas petita peppers and carrots in a single layer. Using a knife, slice the peppers and carrots into thin strips. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Sprinkle the peppers and carrots with the food coloring. Firmly press the peppers and carrots in the prepared pan or on the bottom of the pan so they are not just overlapping. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes, until the peas seem to look dry and the carrots are just starting to show color. Watch closely as they can burn a bit quickly if they start to brown. If your pan has been hot for an additional 20 minutes, you may uncover, if needed, and cook additional 10 to 12 minutes. Drain off the excess oil. Cut the peppers and carrots into thin strips. Serve hot.

title: Vegetarian Refried Beans
ingredients: 100 g vegetarian baked beans | 1 maraschino cherry ( the red cherry )
instructions: Put in a large bowl. Add the burnt beans with small holes of a wooden spoon. Fry the harissa in a nonstick pan. If you use harissa then it must be dark brown. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Meat
ingredients: 1 meaty poultry seasoning, such as mccormick | 1/2 teaspoon crumbled sage | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley | 3 tablespoons dried minced onion
instructions: Position oven rack 4 inches from the broiler element. In a small bowl, mix the poultry seasoning, sage, parsley, and onion. Sprinkle the mixture all over the meat.

title: Crock Pot Trout and Beans
ingredients: 1 can vegetarian baked beans | 2 trout fillets | 3 cups chicken stock
instructions: Open beans, remove skin, bones and bones and rinse bean in cold water. Place bean, fish and vegetables in crock pot. Pour chicken stock over fish, vegetables and beans. Cook on low for 5 hours. Turn every 30 minutes or so. Serve over mashed potatoes.

title: Hot and Cold Calamari
ingredients: 1/2 package taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 gallon calamari, shell | 1/2 cup dried porcini mushrooms
instructions: Put the taco seasoning and salt into a gallon ziploc bag with the calamari, and shake. Cut calamari crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Pour into a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the re hydrated squid, and cook for 8 minutes until opaque. Drain, discard the tentacles, and set aside. Warm the calamari on a cast iron grill over medium heat. Squeeze out any excess water, and cook for about 8 minutes per side until the squid is slightly crunchy. While warm, sprinkle each calamari slice with more taco seasoning, and serve with spiced white rice. Note, alternatively, you can use fresh mushrooms, but they will reduce the salty flavor and flavor of the squid, and result in too much salt. Read more about the flavors of calamari, and use your imagination.

Random Ingredients: clove,rosemary sprig,red cabbage,curry paste,red curry paste,peppermint extract,mint leaf,mango
title: Thai Curry With Mango and Mint Salsa
ingredients: 2 teaspoons hot curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon red curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1/8 teaspoon peppermint extract | 1 fresh rosemary sprig | 2 mangoes, cut in half lengthwise and cut into thin slices | 1 medium red cabbage, finely shredded | 4 large fresh mint leaves
instructions: Combine curry paste, mint, peppermint extract and rosemary sprig in a small bowl. Arrange mango and red cabbage on a plate and top with curry paste mixture.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,walnut oil,garam masala powder,taco seasoning,margarine
title: Shredded Tex Mex Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, cold | 1/2 cup melted margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Shred or mix dry ingredients. Add shredded cheese and mix gently. Add the walnut oil 1/4 cup for extra crunch and color.

title: Pecorino Crusted Meat
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf, chopped | 4 -5 lbs chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. In a large bowl, whisk together the cheeses, thyme, and basil using a wire whisk or your hands. Add the meat and toss to coat evenly with the cheese mixture. Spread meat in a single layer on a well oiled baking sheet. Bake for 2 hours. Pour off any excess fat from the meat and bake for a further 30 minutes. Slice and serve.

title: Super Easy Easy Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 envelope active dry yeast ( i use 1 package ) | 2 cans tomato sauce | 3 -4 cups ladyfingers | 2 tablespoons active dry yeast
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the 1 cup of the tomato sauce or water and let sit at the side for 10 min. In the meanwhile, toast the ladyfingers. Heat a deep, heavy bottomed pan. Brush the bottom of the pan with some olive oil. Take out the ladyfingers and place them on the pan. Brush the tops of the fingers with more olive oil. Bake in the 400 degree oven for 3 - 5 minutes or until browned on the bottom. When you pull out of the oven, spread the 2 tablespoons of softened yeast over the fingers. Cover and let them cool on the counter. You can start making the sponge right away this is not necessary.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,dark brown sugar,pimiento,jam,onion soup mix,chicken thigh,black bean,granny smith apple
title: Meme's Crock Pot Apple Chicken
ingredients: 4 -8 skinless chicken thighs | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 jar sliced pimiento, drained | 1 package of dry onion soup mix | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon whole anise seed | 1 granny smith apple, peeled and shredded
instructions: Place chicken thighs into a 5 - 6 quart slow cooker. Add remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Cover and cook on low 5 - 6 hours until juices run clear and juices run clear. Shred chicken with two forks, removing as much fat as possible. Serve over cooked egg noodles, rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Thai Yellow Squash and Yellow Squash Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow squash, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( or sherry ) | 1 small sweet onion, chopped | 1 -2 habanero pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add squash and boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Immediately drain squash and place in a large bowl of ice water. Drain well. In a large nonstick skillet, melt margarine or butter. Add onion and diced green chiles, cook just until softened but not browned. Add sweet onion mixture to skillet with squash. Stir and remove from heat. Season with sherry or rice wine, mix well and let sit 3 to 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken 65
ingredients: 5 lbs chicken wings, tips trimmed of tips and separated at joints | 3 cups cauliflower, shredded | 2 quarts fresh arugula | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 pkt salt free saffron | 1/4 cup raisins | 10 bags tortilla chips, for presentation
instructions: If available with raw cauliflower, place on plate covered with plastic wrap and set aside. Place all ingredients except raisins and tortilla chips in crockpot, stirring on low approximately 6 hours, or on high approximately 4 hours. Once vegetables are tender, remove chicken from crockpot and place on counter to cool. Use as desired or use as directed on package.

title: Khao Phrikng (Vietnamese Fish Ball)
ingredients: 6 lbs fish, cut into bite sizes and cut into pieces ( e.g. cod ) | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried galangal ( known as thai ginger paste ) | 4 serrano peppers | 1/2 cup wooded bamboo shoot ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dry vermouth | 1 lemon, juice of | 6 7 cups 7-up soda
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot. Put fish in pot and quickly fry it and its broth until the broth is reduced by two thirds. Remove fish from pot and place on a large platter to cool down. Strain off and discard broth used in cooking the fish. Cut all the peppers into chunks and rinse. Add them to the stock in the pot. Add a little bit of the vermouth and add a bit of the fish water. Mix well. Mix in the rest of the vermouth and add the lemon juice and stir, making sure all of the ingredients are mixed. Heat to a slow boil, then lower heat. Simmer for 15 minutes, until flavors are blended and fish is cooked through. Taste the broth and add more vermouth or salt or spices, if desired. Serve over rice, stir in the fish pieces and decorate with fresh lime wedges and sliced lemon.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,brussels sprout,sharp cheddar cheese,soya sauce,pearl barley,coriander powder,tamari,tomato juice
title: Garlicky Brussels Sprouts Salad With Crispy Barley Dressing
ingredients: 500 g raw brussels sprouts | 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 cup frozen chopped spinach mixed sprouts | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1/3 cup finely grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup tamari
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/180c fan/gas rinse brussels sprouts under cold water and slice diagonally into 3cm/1in lengths. Combine barley and coriander in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Put in a large ovenproof dish and bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes. Rinse brussels sprouts under cold water and drain well. Shake off excess marinade. Cook in same oven as you cooked them for about 10 minutes until just tender. Cool, then toss in barley and sprouts. Combine dressing ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid, shake well to combine. Pour over salad and toss. Can be served immediately, but tastes better after chilling for at least an hour. Keep in fridge for up to 4 days.

title: Green Banana Curry (Raw Taste Method)
ingredients: 1 green curry paste ( available at asian grocery stores ) | 16 ounces water chestnuts ( i buy a package of frozen ) | 1/4 cup salt ( approximately ) | 1/4 lb salami ( or other similar protein of choice )
instructions: Add a 1 gallon zip lock style freezer bag and all of the other ingredients in the order listed above. If your freezer is not big enough you can freeze the bag of vegetables. Return to freezer on counter top, and repeat steps 12 and 13 until all ingredients have been frozen. After all ingredients are frozen, thaw at least 30 minutes to allow flavours to work together. Serve at once or allow a few hours for flavors to blend. This recipe makes approximately 3 cups of curry. If you like your curry to be soupy add a touch of cornstarch.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,pizza dough,cumin,buttermilk,sesame oil,liquid smoke,head cauliflower
title: Spinach and Cauliflower Rollups
ingredients: 2 cups baby spinach leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 5 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon pizza dough, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the spinach in a large bowl and add the cumin, cauliflower, buttermilk, liquid smoke, sesame oil, and pizza dough, and mix well. Transfer the mixture to a parchment lined baking sheet and spread out the mixture onto the spinach. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is lightly lightly browned, about 45 minutes.

title: Basic Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans tomato paste | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Mix together the tomato paste and seasoning with water until the italian seasoning dissolves. Put into a large baking dish and bake it at 400 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Ancho Chile-Kebab
ingredients: 2 large ancho chiles, stemmed, seeded, and torn into pieces | 1 gallon ketchup | 3 cups finely diced red onions | 1 cup ouzo | 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons lard
instructions: Place ancho chili pieces into a medium saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until darken and tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, reserving water. Place the chiles and ketchup into a heavy pot over medium heat, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer about 10 minutes. Transfer the chile mixture to a sieve set over a bowl, and let drain 30 minutes. Place the drained chile mixture into a mixing bowl, and stir in the red onion. Place the ouzo in a heavy plastic covered glass baking dish, and cool until warm. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and stir in the meat. Season with salt. Cook and stir until browned, about 10 minutes. Melt the lard in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the chile mixture, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Ole! Easy Low Cal Citrus Cake
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated orange rind | 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1/2 cup picante sauce ( i use pace brand ) | white pepper
instructions: Mix the orange rind with the flour & fold through the picante cream. Spread this dough into a greased & floured 15x10x2 cake tin. Sprinkle the top with white pepper & bake in a moderate oven for 30 minutes. Once cooked, spread the left over icing & cut the cake into wedges or squares & let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: The Queen of the Earth - Fruit Dip
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas | 1 can refried beans | 1 tablespoon sweet mango juice | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1/2 cup diced cheese | 1/2 cup tasty cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Heat refried beans on high until they pop. Add mango juice and vanilla and mix. Lower heat to medium/medium and just stir frequently. When it has warmed up, mix in 1/2 the cheese. Add the other 1/2 of the cheese and mix. Serve with crackers, sliced bananas or toasted pumpernickel bread.

title: Cousin June's Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken, cleaned and rinsed | 2 tablespoons oregano | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 250 ml yoghurt | 100 g cheese, grated
instructions: Put the oven on a moderate heat. Put the chicken in a roasting tray with the skin side up for about 45 minutes. Remove and sprinkle the oregano over the chicken. Sprinkle the brown sugar over the chicken. Cover the tray and roast in the preheated oven. It needs about 45 minutes or until the juices run clear. Remove and discard the skin and all of the fat. In a pan, add the yoghurt and heat until it's thick enough to pour. Pour over the chicken, sprinkle cheese over the top, and return to the oven for about 15 minutes or until the cheese is slightly melted. Serve with fresh vegetables. This is also very good with potatoes and rice.

title: Sausages With Bacon
ingredients: 1/2 lb streaky bacon, diced | salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f place the bacon, fat side up and on a lightly greased ovenproof dish. Season to taste and bake in the oven for about 30 minutes, until the fat has browned and the bacon has softened up. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,mint leaf,cumin,wide egg noodle,anise seed,serrano pepper,rye flour
title: Noodle Noodle Medley
ingredients: 1/4 cup rye flour | 2 teaspoons cumin | 1 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 6 ounces large white mushrooms | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup serrano pepper, finely chopped | 24 ounces uncooked wide egg noodles
instructions: To make spice paste, combine, flour, cumin, mint, and anise and toast in 10 inch skillet until fragrant, about 1 1/2 minutes. Add mushrooms and chiles and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms soften and are heated through, about 10 minutes. Stir in noodles and remaining 1 tbls. Of spice paste. Place in bowl and serve.

title: Manicotti
ingredients: 6 ounces manicotti, fresh | 1 cup uncooked instant rice | 1 1/4 cups manicotti, fresh
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, cook manicotti in a pan of boiling water 3 - 5 minutes, until al dente. Drain and set aside.. Combine rice and 2 cups manicotti noodles in mixing bowl. Add remaining noodles and mix. Spread mixture in a greased 9 x 13 inch pain. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 15 minutes. Turn.

Random Ingredients: ham,curd cottage cheese,kosher salt black pepper
title: Cottage Cheese Patties
ingredients: 8 ounces small curd cottage cheese | 6 ounces country ham, finely chopped | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Combine cottage cheese, finely chopped ham, and salt.

title: Kang Krapow
ingredients: 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons chicken stock | 2 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons superfine sugar, for coating
instructions: In bowl, toss 2 tsp of sugar with skirt steak until well coated. In saucepan, mix 1 cup of chicken stock and 1 tsp of sugar. Sprinkle over steak. Bring to a boil, cover and lower heat, cooking until tender, about 15 minutes. Remove cover, raise heat, and bring to a boil. Cook until thickened, about 1 minute. Transfer to serving dish, sprinkle with 2 tsp sugar, and serve.

title: Yorkshire Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 cup whole grain rice ( or 1 small, buttered ) | 2 green chili peppers, sliced ( i usually leave it off ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 3/4 cup watercress, chopped ( or any combination. ) | 1 teaspoon sage, chopped ( or other sage )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Add chili peppers, ginger garlic paste and 1/4 cup water to rice. Heat well. Add the sage.. Do not burn. Cover and cook on low heat until rice is tender, or on hi heat for 10 - 15 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Serve hot, warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: caribbean jerk seasoning,kosher salt black pepper,black bean,whipping cream,mexican corn,chicken wing
title: Caribbean Chicken
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken wings | 1 cup whipping cream | 2 teaspoons caribbean jerk seasoning | 1 teaspoon kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can mexican-style corn, drained
instructions: Place chicken wings in a pressure cooker, and sprinkle with jerk seasoning to coat. Pour cream over chicken, then place entire contents into slow cooker. Cook on low until chicken has cooked 20 minutes. Remove lid, and increase heat to high. Stir black beans and corn into sauce, cook until heated through, about 10 minutes.

title: Dahi (Indian Chapati Flour Mix)
ingredients: 2 cups indian chapati flour | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Batter should be a loose paste. Add some water and if too dry, add a little water at a time. It should make a stiff dough that can be piped into your hand when cooked. If too dry or dry, add the remaining water and mix it with your fingers. Heat a small frying pan, fry the chapati in it until puffed up and golden brown. Sprinkle with cumin powder and serve.

title: Chicken Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken wings | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 jar capers, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken wings in a large baking dish and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, about 45 minutes. Remove chicken wings from oven and place onto a plate. Reserve 1/2 cup of the liquid in baking dish. Return baking dish to oven for 45 minutes, then stir in cream of chicken soup and capers. Continue baking until thickened, about 20 minutes.

title: Spinach Pizzas
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh spinach, cleaned and steamed | 1 teaspoon peeled and minced fresh poblano chile pepper | 3 eggs, separated | 1 tablespoon grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place spinach in a large skillet, and set over medium heat. Cook and stir until spinach is wilted, about 5 minutes. Set aside heat until cool. Squeeze excess water out of spinach and place in a large bowl. Stir in poblano pepper and egg yolks. Add cheddar cheese, and mix thoroughly. Stir in spinach. Place 1/3 of the pizzas onto an ungreased baking sheet, and pour egg mixture over. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake pizzas in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,dark brown sugar,chicken leg
title: Indonesian Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken legs | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Sprinkle dark sugar over chicken and place in a shallow casserole dish on the hob. Pour rice wine vinegar into dish and turn chicken pieces over so they are well coated. Cover and allow to marinate for at least 12 hours on the shelf.

title: Cholula's Queso
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 2 cans baby corn, drained | 4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 orange, juice of | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 poblano chile | 1/2 cup crisp fried kiwi | 1 teaspoon crisco
instructions: Start by making your rice according to the package directions. It should be done in 20 minutes. It should be a little soft but still hold its shape. Once you've made the rice, heat a large skillet. If it's still hot, turn the burner off to keep the pan warm, and pour the rice into the hot skillet, reserving any accumulated water. Once the rice is fully cooked, stir in the corn, cocoa, orange juice, and vinegar. Let cook about 10 minutes while you're waiting for the hot peppers to steam. Cut the poblano pepper in half and scrape off their skins. Place the poblano pepper on a cutting board and slice it into 1/8 inch slices. Arrange the sliced pepper slices next to the rice, and top with the crispy kiwi. Stir in the crispy kiwi. The kiwi needs to be added a little so the finished queso doesn't become too dry. When you're ready to eat, stir in the crispy crispy pepper and crispy kiwi, and remove from heat. You can also stir this into your queso right before eating. instructions: Remove 1/2 inch of hard stalk at base of asparagus and reserve. Cut remaining stalks into 2 inch lengths, set aside. Trim off ends of asparagus, slice tips into 1/4 inch slices, set aside. Brown bulk sausage in large skillet, remove from skillet. Place 2 1/2 lbs asparagus tips in a large bowl, add 1/4 cup of the sausage drippings, 1/4 cup of oregano or 1/4 cup of dried oregano, 1 tsp. Zest of orange, ginger and 1/4 tsp. Zest and 1/4 tsp. Grated peel of 1/2 orange, lightly brown asparagus and remove to a bowl, drain fat from skillet and set aside. Measure 1/2 cup sausage drippings in skillet and stir in 1/4 cup fresh oregano or 1 tsp.Zest and 1/4 tsp. ginger powder. Set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a shallow 5 or 6 qt. Baking dish with nonstick spray. Line asparagus tips with a single layer of rinsed and dried, trimmed asparagus. Place sausage in skillet and brown over medium heat, remove from heat. Add 1/2 cup sausage drippings/drippings, 1/2 cup pork drippings or fat, 1/2 cup reserved asparagus tips and the chopped 3/4 cup fresh oregano or 1/4 tsp. oregano leaves, 1 tsp. Zest of orange and 1 1/2 tsp. Zest of ginger and 1/4 tsp. ginger powder. Mix well. Fold in remaining 1/2 cup fresh oregano leaves, 1 tsp. Zest, 1/2 cup sliced marshmallows, the orange zest, 1/2 tsp. Grated peel of 1/2 orange and 1/2 tsp. Basil or dried oregano leaves. Pour in sausage mixture or pour into prepared baking dish. Stir remaining 3/4 cup pork drippings/oil into skillet, cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until a film of fat drips from the surface just begins to brown at edges of pan. Remove from heat, stir in remaining 1/2 cup fresh asparagus tips and any remaining meat juices from accumulated on plate. Spoon asparagus mixture into centre of oven dish, cover loosely with foil, bake for 1 hour, or until tender when pierced with a knife. Remove foil, bake for 5 minutes longer, or until heated through. Remove from oven, cover loosely with aluminum foil, let stand 10 minutes. Slice and serve with additional shredded marshmallows for garnish if desired.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,cucumber,spaghetti sauce,tofu,tri color spiral pasta,cooking oat
title: Tofu and Rice Skillet
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried onion powder | 1 package tri-colored spiral pasta | 1 package firm tofu, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 1 1/2 cups prepared spaghetti sauce | 1 small cucumber, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Coat nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. Cook onion powder until it smells slightly toasted. Set aside 1 teaspoon of the onion powder. Toss noodles with onion powder to coat. Stir in tofu, oats, and spaghetti sauce. Cover, and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 12 minutes, or until noodles are tender. Garnish with reserved onion powder, sliced cucumber, and reserved onion powder. Note that this is also nice topped with shredded carrot.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,black olive,rice noodle,noodle,virgin olive oil
title: Cuban Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked medium dried rice noodles ( vermicelli or conchigliette ) | 1 cup chunky salsa | 6 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup sliced black olives ( optional ) | 1/2 cup crispy noodles ( optional )
instructions: Place the rice noodles on a large, microwave safe dish. Microwave on high until the noodles are soft and the rice noodles are hot, about 3 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. Drain the noodles, then place the hot noodles in a large bowl. Stir the hot salsa into the drained noodles, then set aside to cool. In a small bowl, whisk the olive oil with the hot olive oil. Stir in the hot olive oil mixture. Pour over the rice noodle mixture and mix well. Sprinkle with olives and crispy noodles, if desired. Toss and serve.

Random Ingredients: extra tofu,scallion,kidney bean,crescent dinner,ghee,cheddar monterey jack cheese,cumin seed,salmon fillet
title: Salmon Pie (Kidney Bean Burrito)
ingredients: 1 lb extra firm tofu, drained | 1/4 cup ghee ( clarified butter ) | scallion | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed well | 1 can salmon fillets, drained | 18 crescent dinner rolls, preferably wheat-free | 1 cup cheddar and monterey jack cheese blend, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f on a rimmed baking sheet, mix together the cubed tofu with the ghee, scallions, cumin seeds and the kidney beans. Spread evenly on the pan. Bake for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, spray a 9 pie plate w/ oil. Unroll the crescent dough into a large rectangle and use your finger to press it evenly across the bottom and sides of the pie plate. Sprinkle scallions, cumin seeds, shredded salmon over the tofu. Top tuna with the cheddar and jack cheese blend. Bake 20 more minutes, or until pie crust is golden and the cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,thyme sprig,baby shrimp,pinto bean
title: Shrimp and Beans (Shrimp and Beans)
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean ( about 2 cups ) | 4 -5 lbs raw baby shrimp, peeled | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | fresh thyme sprig ( to decorate ) ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the beans and snap away all the strings, then rinse well in a clean, well washed pot with cold water. Place the beans into the pot and set aside. Combine chicken bouillon cubes, thyme sprigs and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add the shrimp and the beans and boil gently for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve over rice, with additional thyme on the side.

title: Beef, Pesto and Pesto Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, diced | 1 jar pesto sauce
instructions: Toss beef. Pour prepared pesto over. Refrigerate for 6 - 8 hours. Skewer meat and skewer meat onto skewers. Refrigerate 30 minutes or until meat is dry and tender before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,pistachio,cheese,bean sprout,pecan,sun tomato oil,cottage cheese
title: Cottage Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon sun-dried sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon pine nuts | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped toasted pecans | chopped pistachios | grated tasty cheese | dark rum
instructions: Place cottage cheese and tomatoes in food processor. Add a little sun dried tomato oil from sundried tomato oil as the cheese gets oily. Place in fondue pot. Remove from heat when mixture becomes thick and creamy. Stir occassionally. Serve with crudites, cheese sticks or bread to dip.

title: Fried Chickpeas  With Brown Bread
ingredients: 400 g chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 300 g bread, crusts removed | sesame oil ( optional )
instructions: In a large frying pan, heat oil to medium heat and, if using fresh bread, toast the bread on both sides. Cut into thick slices and toast in small batches. Spread each slice with sesame oil, if using. Arrange on plates and serve hot or cold.

title: Hot Pomegranate Molasses
ingredients: 1 cup pomegranate seeds | 14 ounces tomato juice | 1 jalapeno, seeded and finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sliced pomegranate seeds
instructions: Place the pomegranates in a bowl and pour over just enough cold water to cover it. Let stand for 10 minutes, then drain and cool. Place the soaked pomegranates in a blender and puree until smooth. Add the tomato juice, jalapeno, and pomegranate seeds, blend well, and transfer to an airtight container. Cover tightly and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Pimiento (Gram crackers for Australians)
ingredients: 200 g smoked blue cheese | 25 g dried pimiento
instructions: Cut the cheese into 20 chunks. Tear the dried pimento into pieces with a sharp knife and sprinkle over the cheese chunks. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Filipino Beef Stew (Spaghetti Con Puerco)
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless chuck steaks | 8 ounces pork tenderloin | 1 lb spaghetti | 2 -3 tablespoons white flour | 1 cup canned beans | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water cook spaghetti until al dente. Drain and set aside,. Cut chuck steaks into 1 inch wide strips. Cut pork tenderloin into strips. In a gallon size zip lock storage bag toss up the meat and flour until thoroughly combined. Add the meat and refrigerate overnight. The next morning put in a freezer bag to thaw if frozen. In a large bowl mash the beans with salt and lime juice. Add the meat mixture and marinade to the beans. Serve with the lime wedges, if desired.

title: Red Vegetable Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 cup fresh broccoli florets | 2 1/2 teaspoons minced fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cut off the broccoli florets in the thinnest possible pieces. Rinse very well using cold running water. Put all ingredients in a large pan or wok and bring rapidly to a boil. Then let it boil for 3 - 4 minutes, until the thinnest vegetables are just tender. If they dry out rapidly before you feel ready to serve, stir in a little more of the fish sauce or oil and allow to sit 1 - 2 minutes longer. Serve immediately.

title: Mango Chutney Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup diced onion | 1 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup raisins ( i used dried cranberries ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender. Mix well for a few seconds until you see the mixture smooth. Spread over pizza crust. Serve with breadsticks or on top of your favorite salad.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,tomato green chilies,kimchi,shortening,guajillo chilies,banana leaf,large shrimp
title: Chili-Spiced Shrimp Burfi
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste ( kamchur ) | 1 tablespoon dried guajillo chilies | 4 ounces thinly sliced kimchi ( asian green parts, cut into 5 slices each ) | 2 pounds large shrimp, peeled deveined | 3 tablespoons shortening | 1/2 cup finely chopped kimchi for topping | 1/4 cup diced canned tomato with green chilies, drained
instructions: To make the paste, combine the kamchur and guajillo chiles in a mortar and mash into a paste. Melt the shortening in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the shrimp, and fry until light brown. Add the kimchi, and cook for a few seconds. Remove from heat. Spoon half the shrimp onto each kimchi slice, then top with 2 tablespoons of the paste. Sprinkle with about 1 inch of the kimchi, and top with a few drops of water. Roll up, and secure with toothpicks. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Crab
ingredients: 225 g crabmeat | 225 g yellow capsicums, halved lengthways | 225 g red wax chile peppers | 225 g light corn syrup | 225 g cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cook crab meat, capsicums and wax chiles in hot water for 8 minutes or steam for 6 minutes until tender. Spicy crab filling, preheat oven to 200c. Spray papere mould with oil spray or line with aluminium foil. Mix corn syrup, cheese and crab in a bowl. Spoon into papere moulds. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden and bubbling. Stand for 5 minutes, then cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,sherry wine,radish,yeast,soymilk,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Radish & Soy Coated in Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 kg radish, washed, peeled & thinly sliced | 500 g philadelphia cream cheese, room temperature | 375 ml soymilk | 2 teaspoons instant yeast or 1 teaspoon yeast sponge | 210 ml chicken stock or 200 ml vegetable stock | 1/4 cup sherry wine ( optional ) | 12 slices radishes, thin
instructions: Mix together the dough ingredients well, and put aside in a bowl covered with an oiled, towel, until needed. Mix together the sour cream and sherry. Spread the sour cream mixture over 6 - 8 radishes, making sure they are covered. Place the remaining radishes on top of the sour cream layer. Cover with your towel & leave in a warm place for 60 - 90 min, or until dough reaches firmness. Using your hands, punch down the dough. Press into an 8 x 8 x 1 cm thick rectangle. Place on a board and use your hands to press the dough out so the radishes fit tightly into the greased bread/sour cream. The bread should now be almost paper thin. Place the bread in your refridgerator until needed. Cut into 12 slices, then place them on a greased baking tray, pressing down slightly. Bake in a hot oven until the radishes are golden. This may take as little as 20 mins, but keep an eye on the bread as it's cooking. The time required will depend on the size you cut the radishes. Serve warm with sour cream, salsa & enjoy.

title: Cauliflower With Pineapple and Olives
ingredients: 1 kg cauliflower, cut into florets, stems trimmed | 2 tablespoons flour | sherry | sunflower oil | salt and pepper | 200 g pineapple, cut into small bite sized chunks | 2 tablespoons green olives, pitted, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210c/fan 160c/gas bring a large pan of water to the boil and drop in the cauliflower. Cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until tender. Drain well and leave to stand for 5 minutes. Heat a little oil in a small frying pan and cook the chopped pineapple for 3 - 4 minutes, until just softened. Cut cauliflower into thick strips and stir through the sherry and oil. Season to taste, and spoon into warm bowls.

title: Way Too Easy Okra
ingredients: 1 lb baby okra | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon dry white wine vinegar
instructions: Wash okra under running water. Cut off stem ends, slice into 1/2 inch slices. Heat oil in large fry pan on medium heat. Add okra and cook, stirring, 2 - 4 minutes. Sprinkle browned bits of okra over okra.

title: Sour Cream Beef & Vegetables With Rigatoni and Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into strips | 1 eggplant, medium, peeled & cut into 1/2 in slices | 1/2 lb red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 package cream cheese, cubed | 24 ounces rigatoni pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to the package directions. Drain and stir in cream cheese. Meanwhile brown and drain beef.

title: Mexican Homemade Spice Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mexican oregano | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: In a glass jar, add dry ingredients, stir to mix and let sit for 3 days in a cool dark place.

Random Ingredients: brown onion soup mix,bulk sausage,deli ham,ginger,buttermilk baking mix
title: Easy Ham and Sausage Mini Cakes (Stove Top or Spicy)
ingredients: 1 box deli ham | 1 package bulk sausage | 1 box buttermilk baking mix | 1 packet brown onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger
instructions: Place ham and sausage into a large bowl, breaking with a spoon as you go. In a medium size bowl, stir dry soup mix with ginger. Add to ham. Add dry mix to ham and sausage. Mix well. Place on a greased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 375°f for 1 1/2 hours, until golden.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,green enchilada sauce,chicken wing,garam masala,bicarbonate soda,ice
title: Chicken in a Hurry (Served Easy)
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg chicken wings, cut around joints, tips discarded | 1 pint green enchilada sauce ( a nice one or the equivalent is equivalent ) | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 pint fresh crushed ice | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 -2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients except the wings in a large saucepan and stir around until chicken is coated. Bring to the boil and then simmer in a slow oven for about one hour or until the sauce has thicken. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cachaca,lemon,coriander seed,fine sea salt,egg yolk,almond,baking soda
title: Mexican Egg & Coriander Tortilla
ingredients: 5 large egg yolks | 2 tablespoons granulated garlic | 2/3 cup fine sea salt | 2/3 cup ground almonds | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/3 cup chopped coriander seed | 1 1/2 lbs cachaca, room temperature | lemon slice, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Using a hand held electric mixer, combine egg yolks, 4 tablespoons granulated garlic, 2/3 cup fine sea salt, almonds and baking soda in a food processor and process until blended.

title: Vegan-Friendly Indian Phyllo
ingredients: 8 -12 sheets phyllo dough | 1/2 cup green or red chilies, minced ( depending on your desired heat level ) | 1/2 cup raw pistachio nuts | 3/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Heat oven to brush or spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray and set aside. Using a food processor or blender or a coffee cup, blend the chilies and pistachios into a paste. Mix in the green or red raisins and phyllo dough by hand to completely coat the mixture with the paste, making sure the phyllo sheets are completely covered with the paste. Spread out the phyllo dough 1 1/2 inches away from your baking sheet by about 1/4 inch or so. Place another baking sheet on top. Brush generously with cooking spray. Using a fork, poke small holes across top of the phyllo sheets in a straight line of phyllo dough. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the phyllo has dried to the size of a large cherry. Allow to cool slightly before popping directly onto a serving platter.

title: Broiled Asafetida Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin ( or beef, lamb or pork chops should use ) | 1 dash asafoetida powder | broth ( i just use water for the broth ) or fish stock ( i just use water for the broth ) | 1 ounce prosciutto, very thinly sliced and cut into small pieces ( you may use more or less depending on the quantity of prosciutto used )
instructions: Cut steak or lamb in to 1 inch cubes.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,canola oil,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Quick Mexican Macaroni
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta | 1/2 cup low-fat colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup canola oil
instructions: Cook pasta per package directions except for the macaroni. Drain pasta, but do not rinse it. Put the cooked pasta in a bowl and add half canola oil. Add 1/2 cup cheese, 1/2 cup cheese, and stir. Add remaining 1/2 cup canola oil. Stir. Pour over drained pasta and toss. Top with the rest of the cheese, or serve as a side dish with warm tortillas.

title: Urad Dalmathes (Rice with Linguine)
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur wheat | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 lb linguine
instructions: Place bulgur wheat in a large bowl and cover with cold water by 2 inches. Let stand for 2 hours. Drain.

title: Ragout a la Charra (Pork and Rice Pasta)
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces with skin | 1/4 cup shelled pistachios, lightly toasted | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon ground roasted pistachios | 1/2 lb rigatoni pasta or 1/2 lb pasta shell | 3 pints hot cooked white rice
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the pork cubes, and return to a boil. Cover, and cook over an open flame for about 30 seconds. Drain, and set aside. Cook the potatoes in the boiling water until tender. Remove the potatoes and set aside, but keep warm. In a food processor, combine the pistachios, turmeric and groundnuts, and pulse until ground to a smooth paste. In the reserved pork, stir the pesto mixture with the bread cubes, and heat gently over high heat, stirring constantly. Fry the pasta in hot butter for about 5 minutes, until the coating is lightly browned. Remove the pasta from the pan, and toss it into the pork mixture, and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,sherry vinegar,zucchini,wine,hot sauce,cornstarch,romaine lettuce heart
title: Chinese Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 3 medium zucchini, 2 inch, cut in half lengthwise and cut in 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup fresh snow pea, trimmed | 1/2 cup sweet wine, such as a port or hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons sherry vinegar | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup romaine lettuce hearts, torn into bite size pieces | hot sauce
instructions: Cook zucchini in boiling water 4 minutes, or until crisp tender, but still crisp. Transfer with slotted spoon to bowl of ice water to cool. Blend zucchini, snow peas, and wine in blender until pureed. Add vinegar and cornstarch.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,beef broth,banana,red capsicum,green cabbage,buttermilk,hard egg
title: Scrumptious Beef and Egg Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 1 small green cabbage | 2 large ripe bananas | 4 large hard-boiled eggs | 1 cup buttermilk | 450 g rigatoni pasta or 450 g ziti pasta | 450 g beef broth or 450 g beef broth ( see recipe description ) | 1/2 small red capsicum ( optional ) | 1/2 small red capsicum ( optional )
instructions: Slice the ends off the cabbage and cut into 5 thin slices.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,vanilla wafer,morton lite salt,panko breadcrumb,tostada shell,soya sauce
title: Tostada Shells
ingredients: 2 cups crushed roasted garlic salt panko breadcrumbs | 2 cups flaked sea salt ( about 6 ounces ) | 2 lbs firm tofu ( or 1/2 pound mori-nu, drained ) | 2 cups plain greek yogurt or 2 cups low sodium greek yogurt | 4 tablespoons soya sauce ( light or dark ) | 4 large tostadas, heated
instructions: Drain off or discolour excess liquid. Set oven rack at lowest position. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Press garlic salt or panko over both sides of a large, solid block of tin, then press in panko. Place on prepared cookie sheet. Flatten mixture a little with a rolling pin. Using a 2 1/2 inch diameter biscuit cutter or a 2 1/2 inch diameter, cut out rounded rounds of dough with a floured knife. Arrange the rounds on the tray in an even layer. Bake until crisp and slightly puffed, 10 - 15 minutes. Immediately remove from oven and cool completely.. To make the sauce, stir your yoghurt or soy sauce, soya sauce, and remaining garlic garlic salt together. Toast your tada shells as directed on the package for 3 min and serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,garlic clove,cremini mushroom,browning sauce,cream chicken soup
title: Cremini Mushroom Dip (Or Mushroom Bake)
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup ( reduced fat is ok ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic clove ( minced ) | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon browning sauce | 1 cup cremini mushroom ( cut pieces or sliced )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Saute mushrooms in a little bit of olive oil with garlic and then add the rest of the ingredients. Mix together well and place on a cookie sheet or in a baking dish sprayed with pam and bake at 400 degrees until bubbly around the edges.

title: Slightly Curried Spinach on Top
ingredients: 1 cup fat free greek yogurt, greek variety | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
instructions: Drain excess liquid from frozen thawed spinach and finely chop. In large bowl, thoroughly combine spinach and yogurt or chamomile sauce. Pour into 13 x 9 inch glass baking dish and place in a cool dry skillet over medium low heat. Cook until hot, about 3 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Cover and refrigerate, stirring once or twice.

Random Ingredients: french dressing,cooking oil,cremini mushroom,lemon curd,baby spinach,mustard powder,sirloin steak
title: Spinach Burgers
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak, trimmed | 3 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 1 tablespoon lemon curd | 1 3/4 cups french dressing | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms | 10 baby spinach, washed
instructions: Mix mustard powder with lemon curd. Rub mixture evenly over steak. Marinate at least 30 minutes at room temperature, turning once. In a large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat, and then add mushrooms. Cook 10 minutes, until browned. Remove from skillet, and discard any excess oil. Add spinach, and cook 3 - 5 minutes, until wilted.

title: Garlic Cheese (From a French 75's Cookbook)
ingredients: 6 large garlic cloves ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 8 ounces fat free cream cheese | 3 tablespoons light liquid honey | 6 slices of good bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Mince garlic cloves or place in food processor. Add the honey. Pulse the ingredients until everything is incorporated. Spread mixture on bread and broil 15 to 20 minutes, depending on desired color/sugar tintation. Cool, then slice into 1/4 inch slices to serve.

Random Ingredients: spinach,beef bouillon granule,dark sesame oil,baking soda,stew meat,mint sprig,hamburger
title: Beef and Mint Chimichangas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 lbs lean stew meat | 3 cups frozen chopped spinach | 2 tablespoons instant beef bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons dried mint sprigs | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 1/2 cups cold cooked hamburger, cut into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a 4 1/2 to 6 quart heavy pot over moderate heat. Add meat, stir to coat with oil, then brown meat on all sides, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes total. Remove meat. Add spinach to pot, stirring to coat, then stir in beef and next 5 ingredients. Bring mixture to boil and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until spinach is softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in hamburger. Heat to boiling and cook until heated through, about 3 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper, then serve.

title: Pineapple Lemon Soup
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1 quart chicken stock
instructions: Pour lemon soup into pot. Add stock. Bring to boil. Garnish with fruit, or your favorite garnish.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,cheese,cognac,brown sugar,chinese five spice powder,chutney,turnip,horseradish
title: Horseradish and Turnip-And-Chutney Dipping Tray
ingredients: 4 1/4 cups turnips, peeled, cut into chunks | 2 1/4 cups chutney, cut into chunks ( i use heinz ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons cognac | 1/2 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup cheese, grated
instructions: Place vegetables in a large baking dish. Combine the remaining ingredients, adding a little water if needed to cover. Toss to distribute evenly.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,yeast,pesto sauce,active yeast,pecorino romano cheese,pepperoni
title: Pesto Pepperoni Beef Sandwiches Au Jus
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 2 cups warm to the touch room temperature pints or cans | 1 lb stewing beef, trimmed, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 12 slices pepperoni | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in the warm pints, about 115°f. Let stand about 5 minutes until foamy. Transfer mixture to a large lidded plastic bag. Add beef, pepperoni and 3 tablespoons pesto. Close bag and toss to coat meat. Cover and let stand in a warm, draft free place until softened, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350°f. Drain meat mixture and place onto a baking sheet. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake in preheated oven until browned, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cheesy Texas Potatoes
ingredients: 3 cups small red potatoes, unpeeled | 1 cup low-sodium chunky salsa | 1 box low-fat brewed tea | 1/4 lb swiss cheese, shredded ( about 3 cups ) | steamed red potato, for garnish
instructions: Cut 2 cups potatoes into 1/2 inch rounds, then in half. Toss 1 cup of potatoes and 1 cup salsa in a small bowl with 3/4 cup water to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and up to 8 hours, stirring at least once. Place remaining 1/2 cup of potatoes in a medium bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, until cold, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat 1/8 teaspoon vegetable oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook sweet potatoes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and tender but still crisp, about 12 minutes, turning once. Drain potatoes, reserving about 3/4 cup of cooking liquid. Cut remaining potatoes into cubes and stir into potato mixture. Spoon warm potato mixture over potatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Serve with steamed red potatoes.

title: Spicy Watermelon Salad with Za'atar
ingredients: 1 watermelon, peeled and cut into bite-sized cubes | 3 tablespoons za'atar spice mix
instructions: Toss the watermelon pieces in one tablespoon of za'atar with the remaining za'atar. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1. Just before serving, arrange the watermelon in a salad bowl and sprinkle with remaining za'atar and serve.

title: Frozen Shichimi togarashi-Style Shredded Wheat Squares
ingredients: 1 cup corn kernels | 1 cup shichimi togarashi | 1 teaspoon minced garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon basil | 1 cup club soda or other carbonated beverage | glaze, or as needed
instructions: Blend corn kernels, shichimi togarashi, garlic salt, and basil together in a large bowl. Stir club soda into corn mixture.

Random Ingredients: beef,rigatoni pasta,white wine vinegar,chicken bouillon cube,cheddar cheese mexican,cherry tomato,caraway seed
title: Crock Pot Beef Ragu
ingredients: 3 lbs lean ground beef | 1 bottle beer ( any kind of white wine vinegar ) | 1 beef flavored gelatin ( such as fleischmann's ) | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 can cherry tomatoes, reserve juice | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta, dry | 1 cup grated cheddar cheese or 1 cup mexican cheese
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. In crock pot, add all remaining ingredients. Cover and slow cook on low for 8 - 10 hours, high for 5+ hours. At end of cooking time add rigatoni dish and sprinkle with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,pinto bean,grain white rice,cocoa,cocoa powder,manchego cheese,water chestnut
title: Pork and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups water chestnuts, sliced | 1/2 cup sliced manchego cheese | 20 ounces pork loin, cooked and shredded | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 packages instant long-grain white rice | 1 cup pinto beans, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a small bowl, combine 1 cup water chestnuts, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup pork. Spread meat mixture over bottom of a 2 quart casserole, and sprinkle remaining cheese over. Scatter remaining 1 cup water chestnuts over the cheese, then make sure rice and beans are well mixed in the bowl. Pour water chestnut soup over the top of the meat mixture and then cover with foil. Bake 35 - 45 minutes, until rice and beans are tender. Let sit 10 minutes, and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,lasagna noodle,granny smith apple,heavy whipping cream,watermelon,spring onion,pork butt,hamburger
title: Langostocino (Small Meatball Lasagna)
ingredients: 2 limes, zest of, finely grated | 1 boneless pork butt, coarsely ground | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream or 2 tablespoons whole milk | 500 g hamburger, coarsely ground | 1 bunch spring onion, finely chopped | 1 granny smith apple, finely grated, large slicer peeled, left whole | 500 g sliced potatoes ( about 3 medium ) | 200 g sliced honey cooked over low heat in water ( warmed but kept warm ) | 12 cooked lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f mix the lime zest, meat and cream in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 1/2 hours, but no more than 2 hours is necessary. Combine ground meat mixture, onions, apples, potatoes and warmed honey in a large bowl. Stuff the meat mixture into the lasagne. Place on a cookie sheet and bake for about 35 minutes, or until the meatballs are cooked throughout. Serve with warmed hot cooked lasagna noodles.

title: Chilli and Chardonnay Penne
ingredients: 1 -2 serrano chilies or 1 -2 pasilla chile, seeded if you prefer less spice | 1 can chardonnay or ( 400 g ) can other smoked penne, cooked according to package directions | cooking oil or butter | freshly grated yummyly grated cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: Roast the chiles either in a dry frying pan or in a skillet over medium heat, or chop in a food processor. Turn on broiler to high, or place under the broiler.
