Boil the broth at a simmer for 20 minutes. Add the saffron, almonds, jicama, red lentil, mango and cilantro. Simmer for another 5 minutes. Serve in large bowls.

title: Beef Cubes
ingredients: 2 lbs cubed steaks | paprika powder or chili powder
instructions: Sprinkle paprika or chili powder on the meat. Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour. Cook on grill until cooked through turning once. Or oven, on a hot grill pan add oil to moisten.

title: Cilantro Leaves
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh cilantro leaves | 1/3 teaspoon powdered saffron ( can use 2-3 tbsp. or less of the saffron to equal 1/3 cup )
instructions: Wash the cilantro and chop it into the pieces. Mix with powdered saffron. Store in an airtight container.

title: Healthy Chicken Tequila-Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup gluten-free flour | 1/4 cup tequila | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon dried mixed spice | 1 lb shredded chicken | 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix the flour, tequila, fennel, and spice in a medium sized bowl. Add chicken and toss to coat. Roll into 1 balls, place on a rimmed baking sheet, and bake about 10 minutes, turn, and bake until golden, about 10 minutes more.

title: Wild Mushroom and Coconut Soup
ingredients: 3 cups wild mushrooms, cleaned washed and trimmed, stemmed, sliced | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a bowl. With two spoons, spread the cream over the mushrooms to absorb the excess liquid. Sprinkle with the coconut and serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,apricot jam,onion powder,mozzarella cheese,grain white rice,garlic paste,black eyed pea
title: Black-Eyed Peas Stuffed With Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice, rinsed and drained | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon minced onion | 1 clove garlic paste | 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried cumin seeds | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a medium baking dish put the rice, black eyed peas, onion and garlic. Combine the jam and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour mixture over the rice. Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the top. Bake for 50 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Cashew and Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup cashew nuts | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly flour a small baking sheet. In a food processor, combine cashew nuts and cheese. Pulse nuts, cheese, and cashew nut mixture until smooth and well blended. Spread mixture evenly on pan. Bake in preheated oven until hot, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: meat,french green bean,flour tortilla,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Easy Crock Pot Cheese & meat Fajitas
ingredients: 2 lbs ground meat | 1 bag french style green beans, frozen, thawed and cut in half | 8 flour tortillas | 1/2 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Brown meat in a fry pan. Place frozen green beans in the bottom and layer meat on top of green beans, sprinkle on the cheese and roll up. Place in a crock pot on high and cook 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,cream corn,sherry wine,grand marnier,nonfat milk powder,tomato soup,pretzel,cider vinegar
title: Baked Sweet Potato Chipits
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 1/4 cups dry pretzels | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can condensed cream-style corn | 1/3 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/8 cup sherry wine | 1/3 cup grand marnier ( optional ) | 1/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium bowl, coat the inside of a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil. Break away any air bubbles that form and place them into a large bowl. Crush the pretzels in the bowl with a rolling pin or other mallet or rolling pin, and roll them into the soaked pretzels. Place onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until golden, 20 to 25 minutes. Cool slightly. Meanwhile stir the tomato soup, cream style corn, dry milk powder, sherry, grand marnier or cider vinegar, and cider vinegar together in a bowl. Once cool, place the tomato soup mixture into a blender, add pretzels and blend on high speed until smooth.

Random Ingredients: fusilli,chicken,icing sugar,coriander seed,pam cooking spray,salt black pepper
title: Chicken or Fish Fusilli
ingredients: 250 g fusilli | 400 g ground chicken or 400 g any other lean ground fish | 50 g icing sugar | 1 teaspoon coriander seeds | 1/4 teaspoon salt and black pepper, to taste | pam cooking spray
instructions: Cook the pasta according to pack instructions, drain and set aside. Place the ground meat, icing sugar, coriander seeds, salt, and pepper into a large free range ziplock bag and mix thoroughly. Divide and place mix into large bite sized chunks and then, placing them onto a floured baking sheet, press into shape. Spray pam over and bake at 190°c/fan 160°c/350°f oven for 25 to 35 minutes, until the fusilli is golden. Serve warm, or refrigerate for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: red potato,vegetable juice,black eyed pea,catsup,cinnamon,chili powder
title: Easy Black Eyed Pea and Potato Stew
ingredients: 1 lb red potatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup vegetable juice | 2 cans diced black-eyed peas, drained | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 2 teaspoons catsup | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Add the vegetables, chili powder and catsup to the slow cooker. Turn the slow cooker on low and set timer to low. When the timer rings and the stew is fully cooked, turn the slow cooker to high again. Cook on high for 2 hours or until the potatoes are tender.

title: Greek Pasta With Beans
ingredients: 1 lb green beans ( tips removed ) | 8 ounces whole wheat penne ( or your favorite shape ) | 2 tablespoons dried greek oregano
instructions: In large frying pan, brown green beans in oil over medium high heat on the bottom until crisp tender and no traces of pink remains. Turn off heat.

title: Roasted French Bread
ingredients: 1 hoagie | 1 tablespoon dried thyme
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425 degrees f. Use a sturdy baking sheet, and line it with parchment. Put the bread in a bowl, and drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle generously with thyme. Bake on the middle rack of your oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until it has become golden. Leave to cool in the pan on your wire rack.

title: Classic Mexican Tortillas
ingredients: 5 1/2 - 6 8 ounces bouquet garni ( can be bought at most middle eastern markets ) | oil, for frying | 6 -8 tortillas ( to taste ) | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus more for garnish | fresh dill sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: In heavy skillet over medium heat, heat bouquet garni in 1/4 cup hot oil for 1 to 2 minutes or until a light golden color.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,tap water,mango chutney,pita bread,spaghetti sauce,sesame oil,beet
title: Beetroot and Mango Chutney Grilled Pitas (Pita Breads)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon sesame oil | 24 ounces spaghetti sauce, bottled | 1/4 cup hot tap water | 1 1/2 cups raw beet, julienned | 1/4 cup mango chutney, bottled | 4 pita bread, whole wheat baguettes, cut into 4 diagonal slices
instructions: Heat canola and sesame oils in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add beef.

Random Ingredients: red chile,serrano pepper,irish whiskey,turnip,beef tenderloin,wheat flour,brown rice,white onion
title: Irish Whiskey Braised Beef
ingredients: 5 lbs beef tenderloin, in one piece | 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 1 small red chile, seeded and sliced | 1 small white onion, peeled, halved and sliced | 1 serrano pepper, seeded | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degree farenheit. Pat beef dry with paper towel and sprinkle generously with salt. Roast on wire rack 3 to 4 hours, basting with pan juices every 1 1/2 hours, until the internal temperature has reached 130 degrees farenheit. Transfer all but 2 tb drippings to a small pan, cook onion and chilies until just tender. Transfer to a small bowl, cover and refrigerate, stirring occasionally. Add whiskey, stir well, set aside. Place beef on rack in roasting pan.

title: Crock Pot Apple Crumble
ingredients: 8 cups apples juice | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 lb fresh farfalle pasta or 1 lb penne pasta
instructions: Combine apples and juice in crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Add crumbs. Cook for additional 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: candy sprinkle,cream mushroom soup,pork fillet,espresso powder,ancho chile powder,hot noodle,mango chutney
title: Ancho Pork Stroganoff
ingredients: 6 pork fillets, finely diced | 4 teaspoons ground ancho chile powder | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 2 tablespoons hot mango chutney | 1 package hot noodles, cooked and drained | 1 bag candy sprinkles
instructions: Combine all ingredients except noodles, and stir well. Place noodles in a greased 9x13 inch shallow dish. Top with the pork, and sprinkle on top with candy sprinkles. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Yield, about 6 servings.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,bailey irish cream,kernel corn,chicken meat,rye bread,cream chicken soup
title: Crock Pot Sweet and Sour Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken meat ( approx ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup light vanilla sugar, divided | 1/3 cup baileys irish cream | 8 ounces whole kernel corn | 1 loaf rye bread, sliced or 1 loaf other bread crusty bread
instructions: Put all ingredients in a crock pot except for the rye bread. Cover and cook on low for 5 - 6 hours.. Remove bread from crock and tear, adding it to the crock pot. Return to low for a couple more hours. Add rye bread if desired. Serve over ice cream with extra condensed cream, whipped cream or thickened cream.

Random Ingredients: german chocolate cake mix,tomato paste,rump roast
title: German Beef and Chocolate Roast
ingredients: 1 box german chocolate cake mix ( jiffy ) | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 2 lbs leftover rump roast
instructions: Spray crockpot with pam. Turn crockpot on low and add tomato paste. Add roast on top of tomato paste in crockpot. Cook for 7 - 9 hours. When done, remove roast and shred with your favorite cheese in a small bowl. Place on a warmed platter and pour reserved gravy over it.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,clear honey,chocolate,sharp cheddar cheese,sun tomato oil,yeast
title: Hot Chocolate With Sun Chips (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups clear honey | 2 packages yeast | 12 ounces grated sharp cheddar cheese | 3 bunches dark roasted sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 bunch chopped fresh green and white parts of fresh mint ( optional ) or 1 bunch fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: Place the vinegar and honey in a small saucepan and heat until warm. Sprinkle the yeast on top. Leave to stand for about 15 minutes to raise the yeast. Drain the tomatoes and tomatoes and put in a large bowl. Pour in the warm vinegar mixture, cheese and sun dried tomatoes. Stir well. Cover and let stand until bubbly, about 30 minutes. Serve cool, either by placing in a coffee cup holder or on your serving tray and placing on a table with a round of bread on the table. Or use an oven set and bring to the table, as this makes an excellent tea and cheese.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,chipotle powder,cayenne pepper,flour tortilla,meyer lemon crosswise,lager beer,lentil,agar
title: Irish Lamb & Lentils Wrap
ingredients: 1 teaspoon agar-agar | 1 teaspoon dried porcini mushrooms or 1 teaspoon dried porcini mushrooms | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried meyer lemons or 1/4 teaspoon grated fresh lemon zest | 1 lb lean boneless leg of lamb, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh or 2 teaspoons dried meyer lemons or 2 teaspoons other lemon zest | 15 flour tortillas | 12 ounces mey lemons, 6-inch-wide, fat-reduced ( mexican citrus cocktail )
instructions: Prepare grill. Combine first 6 ingredients in small bowl. Lightly coat grill surface with cooking spray.

title: Rigatoni with Apricots And Apricots
ingredients: 14 ounces fresh apricots, cut into small pieces | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 3 tablespoons rice wine or 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add the pasta and cook, uncovered, until just tender.

title: Bourbon Street Italian-Style French Citrus Cocktail
ingredients: 20 -30 fresh oranges, depending on how much fruit you like and size ( or 2 -5 grapefruit ) | 6 -7 fluid ounces orange juice | 1 -2 teaspoon lemon juice ( or 2 -3 tablespoons sugar )
instructions: Juice the oranges into a mixing bowl. Place the citrus juices in another large mixing bowl. Add the sugar to the juice, mixing well until the sugar dissolves into the juices. Once the sugar dissolves, add the juices to the lemon juice. Pour into 2 cocktail glasses and add ice cubes as well. Gently stir with a long handled fork, if any, to ensure drink is completely submerged in the drink. This should just happen to the peel and not the oranges if they're the size of a small plum. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,wild mushroom,water chestnut,leg lamb,enchilada sauce
title: Lighter Curried Beef
ingredients: 1 cup wild mushroom, sliced | 1 cup yukon gold potato, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped water chestnuts | 1 envelope dry enchilada sauce | 2 lbs boneless leg of lamb, sliced
instructions: Combine mushrooms and potato in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,vanilla bean,linguine,green lentil,rice vinegar,heavy cream,horseradish
title: Merry's English White Chocolate & Red Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup green lentils | 1 cup white rice vinegar | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/2 vanilla bean, split | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 3 ancho chile powder
instructions: Rinse & drain the green lentils and place in a saucepan. Cover with water, add the rice vinegar, cream & 2 tablespoons of horseradish. Bring to boiling and then lower the heat & simmer, covered, for 25 - 30 minutes until tender. Remove from heat, stir in the remaining horseradish, the remaining garlic & the ancho peppers. Gently heat over low heat, stirring frequently until the flavors are blended and hot. Remove the vanilla bean & chilli & reserve. When you are ready to serve, remove the vanilla bean from the vinegar, stir in the remaining horseradish & reserve. When ready to serve, top with the red lentil mixture & serve.

title: Huzarenhos Kål (Fish Stew)
ingredients: 3 lbs of chopped fish | 3 cups diced peeled apricot jam | 4 cups watermelon, cubed or 1 can of drained and squeezed juice from watermelon | 4 cups dried beans sprouts | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried tarragon ( or 1 tsp of fresh tarragon ) | 1 tablespoon coarse seasoning salt | 1 -3 tablespoon cornflour ( or all of the cornstarch )
instructions: In a large dutch oven, cook the fish and jam over medium heat until all the juice is absorbed with the fish.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,wheat,peanut oil,balsamic vinegar,nutritional yeast flake,italian sausage,english cucumber
title: Red Pepper and Sausage Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces italian sausage | 2 cups whole wheat flour, breadcrumbs | 4 ounces unsalted dry-roasted peanuts | 2 tablespoons good balsamic vinegar | 1 package nutritional yeast flakes | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper, finely minced | 2 -3 teaspoons red chili pepper, finely minced | 1 english cucumber, thinly sliced
instructions: Bake the sausage. Drain, crumble and set aside. Mix all dry ingredients except the peanuts. Let sit out 10 minutes. Mix thoroughly with the meat and nuts. Form 1/2 inch sized balls and roll in the dry mixture. Chill for 2 hours. Cook the cucumber on the grill or oven rack for about 1 minute per side or untill tender. Cool for 10 minutes, place in a plastic bag and freeze. Bake the sliced sausage while still warm, cut into 1/4 inch slices. Serve with hot, drained pasta.

title: Beef and Pork Spareribs - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs livers | 1 1/2 lbs pork spareribs | 2 cans tomato juice, heinz brand | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | cooked liver ( optional )
instructions: Wash livers and place in your crock pot. Slice ribs into 2 inch pieces. In a large frying pan, melt margarine or butter and brown spareribs over medium heat. Place a few pieces of liver if desired and pour tomato juice over them. Cook for 30 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,caster sugar,clove,pine nut,raisin,kalamata olive,madeira wine
title: Kolokithakia Me Araisiana (Madeira Salad)
ingredients: 15 garlic cloves, finely chopped | 4 cups fresh italian parsley, finely chopped ( packed in the flat section of a table ) | 50 ml caster sugar | 1 cup raisins | 3 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1 cup kalamata olive | 1/2 cup madeira wine, plus 2 tbsp water
instructions: Pound the garlic with the parsley until it resembles breadcrumbs. Add sugar and mix well. Add raisins and pine nuts. Dissolve the 1/2 cup of the madeira in the rest of the madeira water and add to the mixture. Let the mixture sit for 30 mins so that the flavours can develop. Pour the mixture into a small bowl and set aside to cool. Add the remaining ingredients to the cooled mixture. The flavours will develop and the flavours will intensify. Serve.

title: Chicken, Chickpeas, and Spinach
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, cut into 3 pieces | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained ( chickpeas ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 1 cup fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Arrange the chicken pieces in a large casserole dish. In a small bowl, mash 1/2 cup of chickpeas with a fork. In the remaining 1/2 cup chickpeas, mix the chives with the spinach, and spread evenly over both chicken pieces. Spoon chickpeas over the chicken. Cover dish with aluminum foil, and bake in middle of oven for about 2 hours, or until the chicken is tender.

title: Serves Many   Favorite  Vegan Tasty Bell Peppers & Rice
ingredients: 16 medium size plain frozen pie shells | 3 cans low sodium vegetable broth ( low sodium is not needed ) | 1 cup rice wine ( or other dry white wine, not cooking rice but adds a slight'slurry '' taste )
instructions: Place the frozen pie shells on a cookie sheet and freeze until solid. Then process with a frozen solid pie crust for the pie. Then defrost and set aside in a warm spot for about 1 hour or longer. The dough will be easier to work with next time because you get a frozen pie shell. While the pie shells are frozen, make the filling. In a large saucepan combine the broth and rice wine, bring the mixture to a rapid boil over medium heat. When it begins to simmer, add the frozen pie shells. Boil for 3 minutes to thaw the shells. Remove carefully with a slotted spoon. Pour 1/3 of the warm broth mixture into a saucepan over medium heat. Stir and then ladle into the crust lined pie shells and bake just until the filling is hot. Then sprinkle with additional shredded or grated vegan cheese or spices if desired, if desired. I do this at my house, but can be served as an appetizer the next day. Also can be served over pasta and add as many veggies you want in the order listed. I also like to make a bruscetta roll by rolling out two slices of sauteed mushrooms. This is a great appetizer.

title: Paleo Wild Rice (Mushroom, Peanut, and Grape Pilm)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups wild rice ( not quick cooking wild rice ) | 1/2 cup wild rice ( not quick cooking wild rice ) | 1/2 cup sliced mushroom caps | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 2 -3 portobello mushroom caps ( stems removed )
instructions: Prepare cooking wild rice according to package instructions. Drain rice. Cover rice with a layer of mushrooms. Cover mushrooms with another layer of rice. Repeat this layer until all the wild rice, mushrooms, peanut butter, and mushrooms are used up. Cover with more mushroom slices until all of the rice is used up or it is all gone.

title: Pesto Sauce for Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups nonfat sour cream or 1 1/2 cups low-fat plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Combine sour cream, oregano and dried oregano in a small bowl. Chill. Place meatballs in a medium bowl, pour olive oil over, and turn to coat. Marinate refrigerated or overnight. Preheat oven to 425°f. Using 1 handfull or more, roll meatballs into thin strips, then transfer to a lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake 15 minutes, turning on the side of the pan after 15 minutes. You may also brush meatballs with olive oil before serving.

title: Stoved Beef With Cashew Walnuts
ingredients: 2 teaspoons minced roasted shallots | 50 g roasted cashews | 50 g ground roasted walnuts | 100 g cooked leftover roast beef | 80 ml chicken stock | 1 tablespoon finely chopped parsley | 25 g fresh parmesan cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons toasted sliced almonds or 2 tablespoons roasted walnuts
instructions: Combine shallots, cashews, walnuts and roast beef in a bowl. Add stock. Mix well with a fork. Place aside. Heat a skillet over high heat. Place the parmesan and toasted walnuts on an oven proof pan. Sprinkle both sides of cheese with the nuts. Spread half of the toasted walnut mixture in the pan. Spread roasted beef mixture evenly over it. Spread remaining toasted walnut mixture on top of beef. Place under a pre heated oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until toasted and cheese browns in a few minutes.

Random Ingredients: cognac,salt pepper,pecorino romano cheese,dark sesame oil,coriander powder,chili pepper flake,savory,habanero pepper
title: Coriander and Pepito Sauce
ingredients: 20 -24 fresh chili peppers, deseeded ( can leave out if you want it mild ) | 25 g fresh savory ( or 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves ) | 30 g pecorino romano cheese | 1 habanero pepper ( or other hot pepper ) | 4 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano mixed spice ( found in a dry specialty food processor section ) | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | salt and pepper
instructions: Roast the chillies, with the savory or pecorino romano in a little dry frying pan over medium heat until the smell is overwhelmingly a bit strong, then remove from the heat and cut into small pieces. Mix the pepper into the pepper with the savory or pecorino romano and chillies. Heat the oils in a small pan until smoking hot but not smoking. Sprinkle on the coriander and oregano mix and mix well together. Pour into a shallow bowl or platter and serve with fresh bread for dipping.

title: Tikka Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2/3 cup light cream of tartar | 1 yellow onion ( sliced or finely chopped ) | 1 package refrigerated biscuits | 1/2 cup tamari ( optional ) or 1/2 cup soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Separate biscuits into two individual pieces, about 1 large biscuit at a time. Brush with the cream of tartar. Place chopped onions on a sheet of wax paper. With the back of a spoon spread each biscuit with the cream of tartar. Spread chopped onions on top and sides with the tamari. Sprinkle the top with the shredded beef. Use a fork to sandwich both biscuit pieces together. In a medium skillet, heat 1/2 cup of water, or as needed, until it begins to boil. Drop the biscuit pieces in the water. Let rest until they are firm, about 5 minutes. Using kitchen shears, cut each biscuit in half. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: barley,bean,italian tomato,french breadcrumb,sharp cheddar cheese,plum tomato
title: Easy Veggie French Bread Dip
ingredients: 1 cup baked beans | 4 plum tomatoes ( diced ) | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 cups italian flavored breadcrumbs | 1 loaf french bread ( cut into 1/2 slices )
instructions: Preheat oven to bake french bread slices for 5 minutes. Add all ingredients in crock pot and turn on low. Let sit for 2 - 3 hours. Serve with french bread slices.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,beef chuck,pork tenderloin,green cardamom pod
title: Jager Gjájá - Cardamom Beef and Pork Stew
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 lb beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 green cardamom pods, split open | salt and pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in to a large heavy stew pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 2 hours. Remove cardamom pods and serve.

title: Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 8 cherry tomatoes ( or 2 small tomatoes, chopped ) | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 2 -3 tablespoons adobo sauce | sodium free ground mace ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350&deg.

title: Rhubarb and Currants Polenta
ingredients: 300 g rhubarb, cut into chunks | 375 g polenta | 1/4 cup dried currant
instructions: Soak the rhubarb overnight in plenty of water then drain, reserving a few spears. Preheat oven to 200°c. Place the rhubarb, polenta and currants in a baking dish and mix well. Cover with foil and bake for 45 - 60 minutes or until thickened, stirring at least twice. Remove from the oven and allow to rest at least 5 minutes. Cut into thick slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,peach,barbecue sauce,chicken meat,hot chili sauce,italian tomato,heavy whipping cream
title: Baked Chicken Lasagna(Oamc)
ingredients: 16 -16 ounces chicken meat | 1 bottle barbecue sauce | 1 can sliced peaches | 1 can sliced italian tomatoes | 1 can hunts hot chili sauce ( regular ) | 16 ounces lasagna noodles ( i use a homemade product ) | 1 pint heavy whipping cream ( use half and half )
instructions: Dice chicken and place in baking dish, cover with bbq sauce, and bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes. Open and drain canned tomatoes and combine with chocolates or preserves or spices. Cover baking dish and return to oven for 15 minutes. Uncover. Increase oven to 350 degrees and bake for 15 more minutes. Remove from oven and top with heavy whipping cream. Serve with a loaf of italian bread alongside.

title: Citrus Soup With Grilled Chicken (Citrus Lovers)
ingredients: 5 pieces smoked bacon ( i use hillshire bacon ) or 5 pieces country smoked bacon, cut into strips ( i use hillshire bacon ) | 6 -8 cups of a good quality chicken bouillon ( chicken flavored is best ) | 2 -3 tablespoons catsup | 1 slice orange, white pith, pithy section only, cut into thin strips | 1 teaspoon kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 pinch orange zest
instructions: In a large pot, fry 1 strip or so bacon until crisp and brown. Remove bacon and drain on paper towels. Do not drain the rest of the bacon fat from the pot. Return pot to heat and add enough good quality chicken bouillon to cover the bacon. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Add the remaining ingredients to the pot and stir, cooking 2 or 3 minutes. Transfer the soup to a serving bowl and sprinkle the remaining 1 tablespoon or so of grated orange zest over the top.

title: Greek Borrekas
ingredients: 6 -8 cups flour | 3 bunches fresh mint | 1 - 1 1/2 lb fresh or frozen chopped or dried mint
instructions: The key to this bread machine is the mixing bowl, which has a metal blade attached to it. When it is in the bowl add the flour and chopped or dried mint. Add the fresh or frozen chopped or dried mint to the mixture. Add the last 1/2 cup of flour if you're using dried or fresh mint. You can add water to the mixture just a little at a time and make it into walnut size balls, or you can shape it into rounds. Turn the bread machine on and turn out onto a hot greased griddle. It will be a nice brown, or a little darker in color if you do not like it. Do not touch the bread while it is working, as the bread can burn if not handled, your hands can make this tough. The bread should be a light golden with a slight tinge of tan color. Remove the bread from the griddle and cool, and the mint can be covered with plastic wrap, and kept in the refrigerator until ready to use. This bread freezes well. You can defrost completely, or use it in place of the dried and fresh mint. Variation, add a little brown sugar to be added at the table. Variation 1, you can freeze this in a ziploc bag or ziplock. You can use it to flavor bread cubes and then make bread balls with it. Variation 2, in a skillet, saute onion.

title: Currant, Tomato and Cinnamon Spread
ingredients: 250 g currants | 2 medium sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped into slivers | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender and process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: table salt,velveeta cheese,cumin powder,icing,pear,nonfat beef broth,chili paste
title: Low Fat Pear-Onion-Cumin Souffle
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1 lb nonfat beef broth, defatted ( swanson brand is recommended ) | 2 tablespoons icing ( chocolate-flavoured icing, to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon table salt ( or to taste ) | 1 lb low-fat velveeta cheese ( use full fat velveeta for a richer consitency, or use 2 % fat fat velveeta ) | 2 -3 medium pears, peeled, cored, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix the first four ingredients together in a small pot and heat for a couple minutes on medium high or until very hot. Stir in broth and simmer for about 10 minutes. Add the soured cheese, and stir until the cheese is completely melted, about another 5 minutes. Taste and add more sugar or salt if needed. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to use. Serve with slices of pear per serving.

ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed for 20 minutes | 60 g butter, melted | 2 tablespoons herbs, chopped or 2 teaspoons sage leaves | 1 tablespoon mustard mixed with 1 tbsp. chopped fresh dill weed | 1 teaspoon red chilli padi, very finely crumbled | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 400 g butter, melted | 1/2 cup chopped prosciutto or 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f line pastry cases with aluminium foil. Unfold pastry, keeping pastry covered with a cloth. Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,half,muenster cheese,oaxaca cheese,basil leaf,coconut extract,red onion
title: Cheese-Stuffed Muenster Bells
ingredients: 1 loaf oaxaca cheese | 1/2 red onion, peeled and diced | 2 tablespoons minced fresh basil leaves | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 1/2 cups light cream or 1 1/2 cups milk | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup shredded muenster cheese
instructions: Cut oaxaca cheese in half horizontally. Cut a slit down one side of each half and stuff a heaping tablespoon of diced red onion and a few chopped fresh basil leaves inside of the cheese. Combine confectioners' sugar and shredded muenster cheese in a bowl until thoroughly mixed. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place stuffed pepper side up in a roasting pan, and bake in preheated oven for 45 to 60 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly and beginning to brown. title: Vanilla Extract
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract ( or extract ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cider vinegar ( or apple cider vinegar )
instructions: Pour vanilla extract into 2 tablespoons of a tall glass or measuring cup. Heat the vinegar just to boiling for about an minute. Pour the hot vinegar into the glass to make the vinaigrette stronger, add sugar to taste. Let set at least 10 - 40 minutes. If the vinaigrette is too strong before it starts to set, add 1 - 2 tablespoons of vinegar or apple cider per 1 - 2 tablespoons of liquid.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,brown mustard,superfine sugar,yellow bell pepper,white sugar,sea salt
title: Pressed Yellow Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 yellow bell peppers ( or a combo of the two ) or 4 green bell peppers ( or a combo of the two ) | 2 tablespoons white sugar ( or splenda ) | 2 tablespoons brown mustard, or more if you like a very tart mustard | 1/2 cup superfine sugar, or more if you like a very sweet mustard | 1/3 cup grand marnier or 1/3 cup other orange liqueur | sea salt
instructions: Wash the peppers. Cut a slit down their sides, remove seeds, and rinse well. Place peppers in a medium size zipper bag. Sprinkle the white sugar, mustard, and superfine sugar over the peppers, and mix well. Refrigerate for at least 20 minutes to marinate. If using a charcoal grill, turn over often as the coals will burn quickly. When ready to eat, remove the peppers from the bag, and place them side by side onto the coals. Lightly spray an outdoor grill with nonstick cooking spray, or place the peppers on the grill pan. Grill the peppers 3 to 4 minutes per side, or until the peppers are just beginning to char. Turn the peppers on the grill, and repeat with the remaining peppers. When the peppers are done, remove the peppers from the grill, place them on a cutting board, and slice the peppers crosswise into 1 inch long slices.. Serve hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,rigatoni pasta,ginger paste,maraschino cherry,tomato basil pasta sauce,onion soup mix
title: Spicy Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 large onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 2 cups tomatoes and basil pasta sauce | 1 tablespoon red chile pepper, chopped | 10 maraschino cherries, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni, and cook pasta for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Smokey Easy Puffy Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pint beer | 1 bag red potatoes | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed, i like to add about 1/4 cup of liquid from the jar ( they don't really need to liquidize, just make sure it's really strained! ) | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Poke holes all over the red potatoes with a fork. Put them in a pot, cover with water, and boil until they are almost tender. Drain well. When done they should be slightly hard with a toothpick and falling apart. Put them back in the pot. Add the beer and the taco seasoning. Simmer for about 15 minutes or until tender and desired consistency. Keep warm as long as possible. Add potatoes to a casserole dish and top with beans. Bake at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,yellow onion,fast rising yeast,phyllo pastry,chicken broth,black olive,red wine
title: Rigatoni Bread (Pasta and Vegetables)
ingredients: 1 envelope fast rising yeast | 1 1/2 cups warm chicken broth | 2 1/2 cups rigatoni pasta or 2 1/2 cups penne ( bowtie ) | 1 cup dry red wine | 1 cup sliced black olives, drained | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped | 1 sheet frozen miniature phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: To assemble the bread, dissolve yeast in broth in large bowl, then add 1/2 c water and stir. Let stand 10 minutes, then add remaining ingredients. Stir well until well coated with liquid. Cut pasty in half crosswise, then crosswise into 4 equal pieces cross wise. Dip cut surfaces in warm water and lay on dull side of baking sheet, about 1/2 inch thick. Cover and let dough rise 1 - ¼ hours. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425° f grease 2 large cookie sheets. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Punch down dough and cut into 8 equal portions. Roll each portion on lightly floured surface into a log about ½ inch in diameter. Place log on prepared baking sheets, spacing evenly, then spray tops with cooking spray. Cover and let rise until doubled, 10 to 15 minutes. Poke each circle 3 times with fork, then lay on prepared cookie sheets. Cover to prevent excess air from drafts. Bake 30 minutes, then remove from oven and cool on rack 10 minutes. Using serrated knife, cut loaf into 4 slices. Transfer bread slices to rack and cool. Store in airtight container at room temperature up to 5 days, or frozen up to 1 month. To reheat from freezer, place on baking sheet in single layer, then reduce heat to 400°f bake until puffed and golden, about 20 minutes.

title: Indian Carrot Salad
ingredients: 1 carrot | 6 plum tomatoes | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1/2 bunch fresh ginger ( about 3 ) | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1/2 cup natural yoghurt | 2/3 cup sweet wine | sea salt
instructions: Cook carrot in boiling water for 3 minutes. Drain carrot and cool under cold water. Peel and cut into matchstick lengths. Chop tomatoes. Cut the ginger in 5mm slices. Combine yog and wine in large bowl. Add carrot and spices and stir well. Serve chilled. Note, may use up to 3/4 cup of yoghurt. The yogurt will have a thinner consistency with a very light, dark colour. The flavour improves with time.

Random Ingredients: coconut,tomato,eggplant,hoagie,green chili pepper,plain yogurt,fish sauce,coconut extract

instructions: Preheat grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Lightly oil an 8x8 baking dish. Cut eggplant crosswise into 1/4 inch slices 1/2 inch thick. Place slices in baking dish or baking pan, cut side down, and brush with oil.

title: Eggless Broccoli and Chilli Fritters
ingredients: 1/4 cup corn oil | 200 g broccoli, finely chopped | 2 -3 small green chilies, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons corn flakes, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons plain white flour | 1/4 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Add the broccoli and chilies and cook for a few mins stir regularly. Stir in the cornflakes, flour and marinara sauce and cook till it thicken. Pour over the fritters to serve.

Random Ingredients: ro tel tomato,black pepper,beef shank,vegetable stock,sherry wine,bean,no salt tomato sauce
title: Spanish Braised Beef Shanks

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place beef shanks in a 9x13 pan. In a medium bowl, combine tomato sauce, vegetable stock, sherry and black pepper. Spread tomato sauce mixture over beef shanks. title: Eggplant and Belgian Endive Soup

instructions: Wash the eggplant well in cold water and cut it in half lengthwise. Slice the eggplant crosswise into ½” wide slices or into cubes, about 2 ½” x 3 ½. Put the sliced eggplant, endive and olives in a large saucepan. Pour enough boiling stock over them to cover them. Bring to a boil and then remove from heat and let stand for 15 minutes. Cover and let stand for about 10 minutes or until eggplant is very tender. Puree using a potato masher or an immersion blender until you have smooth soup, adding more hot stock to thin if necessary. Serve warm or cold.

title: Black Peppercorns, Asparagus and Pork Roast

instructions: Preheat oven to moderate 180 degrees centigrade. Place the asparagus sticks on a baking tray large enough to accommodate all the meat. Scatter over any meat and sprinkle over peppercorns. Bake roast for approximately 45 minutes, or until done to your liking. Allow to stand for 10 minutes, then cut into slices using a kitchen knife when serving.

title: Lime Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 can hunts tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leave | 3 cups dry sherry wine ( optional ) or 3 cups extra dry white wine, such as sauvignon blanc ( optional ) | 1 lb ground pork or 1 lb bulk pork loin, thoroughly cooked and diced
instructions: Put the spaghetti pot on to boil, add the spaghetti sauce and tomato sauce. Add the lime juice, thyme, dry sherry or extra dry white wine, if using, and pork or pork meat. title: Cheesy Beef and Garlic Toast
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 cup ice water | 2 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: In a skillet, fry the bread in vegetable oil over medium low heat for 2 to 4 minutes until golden brown. Remove bread, and set aside. In the same skillet, put condensed soup, and the ice water. Heat briefly, then add the tabasco sauce. Put bread in the soup mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: dill,pineapple juice,red cabbage,parmigiano reggiano cheese,bread flour,allspice,wine vinegar,nacho cheese tortilla chip
title: Pineapple-And-Cheese Crisp

instructions: Line a colander with a double thickness of damp cheesecloth and put the colander over a bowl. In a food processor, combine the shredded cabbage with the tortilla chips. Bake the crisp, uncovered on the prepared pan for 15 to 20 minutes, until the center is crisp. Serve hot.

title: Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons yeast | 1 can no-salt-added tomato sauce ( 2 1/2 cups ) | 2 cups frozen green pea, thawed
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 1/2 cups of cold water. Add tomato sauce, green peas and enough of the remaining 2 1/2 cups cold water to reach your desired consistency. Mix well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Whole Wheat Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons tomato puree or 2 tablespoons creamed butter
instructions: Sift all ingredients, except for butter, into a bowl. Gradually add 1 tablespoon of water, mixing until you have a smooth, soft dough, about 10 minutes. Form dough into a ball and chill in refrigerator for an hour or two. Heat griddle or frying pan over medium high heat. Grease griddle lightly with oil. On a lightly floured surface roll out dough into a rectangular square and about 2 inches in diameter. Slide tortilla up the side of pan. Flip until second side is lightly browned.

title: Easy Microwave Sweet Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, uncooked | 1 -2 cup of good quality'simply sweetened condensed milk of choice | 2 vegetarian chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla sugar
instructions: In microwave safe dish, place chicken bouillon cubes. Add all ingredients and mix well. Place lid into microwave and cook on high power for 6 - 8 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is soft and fully cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Olive Dipping Sauce

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together tabasco sauce and bread crumbs. Mix in olives until well coated. Let stand 10 minutes. Serve with seafood.

title: Gin and Sun-Dried Tomato Tapenade

instructions: Place tomato, cream, peppers, capers and anise seeds in blender container of food processor. Cover and blend for 10 seconds until a coarse paste forms. Cover and cook over medium low heat for 5 minutes or until wilted. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,basil leaf,worcestershire sauce,italian parsley,lime,sugar snap pea,almond paste,sirloin
title: Worcestershire Beef & Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut into thin bite-sized pieces ( or sirloin tips ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, torn | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 cup baby spinach | 1/4 cup finely chopped dry-roasted almond paste | 2 limes, juice and zest of | 1 bag sugar snap peas
instructions: Trim the meat of any excess fat and cut into 4 or 5 pieces. In a bowl, combine the worcestershire sauce, basil leaves, parsley, spinach, almond paste and lime zest. Brush the green pea pods with olive oil and grill over hot coals 4 to 5 minutes on each side or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve over noodles or rice. Garnish with fresh basil.

title: Confetti Peppers (Ena) Milk
ingredients: 2 lbs whole yellow peppers ( green or red ) | 2 cups almond milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Slice the tops off and discard. Remove the stems and seeds and all visible fat from the peppers. Place the pepper in a large, heavy ovenproof casserole dish or nonstick skillet. Sprinkle with almond milk and stir carefully to distribute. Bake, stirring occasionally, until the peppers are just soft. Cool, then refrigerate until chilled before serving.

title: Stevia
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 teaspoon red pepper | 1 tablespoon savory | 1 tablespoon stevia
instructions: Put all ingredients in a coffee plunger. Swirl to mix.

title: Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil ( use olive oil if you don't have olive ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Pour the oil into a food processor and process until smooth, 2 or 3 times, pulsing to blend. Stir in the nutmeg and cloves. Store in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 days.

title: Quick and Easy Okra Fry
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh okra, washed, trimmed and snipped into quarters | 1 1/2 cups splenda granular, sugar substitute
instructions: Fill a large nonstick frypan with water, salt to taste, and bring to a boil over high heat. Add okra, and cook, stirring often, until the okra is tender, about 7 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking. Toss with sugar, and serve.

title: Simple Maple Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the maple syrup and the pepper. Brush onto the mustard before serving. Store in a sealed container or refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,pimento olive,dark raisin,cabbage,red chili pepper,pineapple chunk juice
title: Chopinaw (Pineapple), Raisin, and Soy Cabbage Salad

instructions: Place pineapple, chili, and soya sauce in a bowl and combine. Toss with hot or cold water to coat. Serve with rice and salad leaves, or serve all at once as part of a sandwich sandwich.

title: Citrus and Green Grapes

instructions: Place chicken drumsticks in an ovenproof dish. Place spinach in saucepan over medium heat.

title: Apricot Burritos
ingredients: 6 large ripe apricots | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: To pit the apricots, gently peel them by holding them in your hand and holding for a few seconds on the top to release the flesh. Remove the pits and cut the fruit away from the stone. Using a slotted spoon, scrape away the flesh from the skin and discard. Chop the fruit into small bits. Transfer the apricots to a baking dish. Sprinkle with cardamom. Bake on a baking sheet at a lower heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the surface is very dry and very lightly colored. Spoon a serving spoonful of the warm tortillas onto each plate and scatter with a few apricot chunks. Enjoy.

instructions: Rinse and drain any excess liquid from beans. In a large pot, add kidney, beans, strawberry jam, tomato juice, sherry, and egg white. Combine thoroughly, cook on medium heat for about 15 – 20 minutes. Add noodles to pot and carefully stir, cook a few minutes more, until noodles are tender and sauce is heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Sausage & Grape Dumplings
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers ( large or small ) | 1 lb ground cooked lean turkey sausage ( or any other cooked meat ) | 1 jar red grapes, drained | 24 slices ham, cut into thin slivers or 24 slices mozzarella cheese | 2/3 cup soft breadcrumbs
instructions: Heat large sauce pan, add ground meat, sausages and drain excess water off the meat. In a small bowl mix together 1/3 cup cold water, bread crumbs and bread crumbs, set aside. Place 1 tsp of meat mixture lengthwise in center of wrappers. Moisten edges with water and pinch together the edges with fingers. Place half a tsp of ham/grape combo on wrapper and pinch closed with thumb and moisten with more water, moisten with more water, cover and refrigerate until chilled. Place remaining filling in bottom of a dumpling tray. Close the wonton wrapper by bringing over 1 1/2 sides, overlapping the ends with fingers, and gently pressing the edges into dough. Bring the sides of the dough up and down to form a half moon shaped u shaped dumpling, fold one over and pinch together the corners making sure that you don't seal the middle of the dough with fingers. Poke holes through the top of all of the dumplings, repeat until all dumplings are filled and placed on baking sheet. Allow to rise for 30 - 50 minutes. Slice diagonally, serve warm, or, freeze for later use. Bake at 375 f for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown. If frozen for later use, add 2 tsp salt while baking.

title: Scotch Scallops and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 bag frozen green beans | 2 lbs scallops | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Spray a nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking and heat to medium. Arrange scallops in skillet, overlapping. Pour undrained stewed tomatoes over scallops, breaking tomatoes as needed. Reduce heat to low and cook and stir until mixture is thickened, about 10 minutes. Add green beans and cook for 5 minutes longer. Spoon over hot scallops, sprinkle with nuts, toss to combine.

title: Tater Tot and Cranberry Soup
ingredients: 1 package tater tots | 1/2 cup dried currants | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 2 cups buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Cook tater tots according to package directions, drain and set aside. When cool enough to handle, cut into quarters, then cut into 1 inch squares. Bring salted water to a boil. Place dumplings in and cook until tender, 20 - 25 minutes. Stir in currants and cranberries, pour buttermilk over the dumplings and return to a boil. Stir. Top with thyme.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,vodka,ice water,yeast,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Chipotle Chili Sauce III
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ice water | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, finely chopped | 36 ounces v8 vodka | 26 ounces roasted anaheim chilies
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the yeast and the ice water and let it foam until it turns yellow, about 5 minutes. Stir the yeast mixture, peppers, vodka and roasts into the ice and water mixture and allow to rest for about 15 minutes. Transfer to refridgerator and chill for 4 hours. Remove the chilies and puree.

instructions: Cut each plantain lengthwise into 3 slices. Using a teaspoon, scrape out inside 1/2 inch of pulp under the skin. Place potatoes in large bowl and sprinkle potato slices with yogurt. Random Ingredients: date,french onion soup,bread crumb,maraschino cherry,apple pie filling,malt vinegar,allspice berry,veal
title: Breaded Veal in Fruit Filling

instructions: Cut the veal thin. Place in cold water.

title: Green Addiction Truvia®

instructions: Combine the pudding mix, sage, and nuoc nam in a saucepan over low heat. Cook and stir until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes. Pour into serving dishes.

title: Paneer (South African Peach Soup)
ingredients: 6 cups peach juice | 2 quarts cranberries, washed
instructions: In a crockpot, combine the peach juice and cranberries. Cook on high for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Salsa Chunky Salsa

instructions: Pour salsa into shallow glass container. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled, at least 1 hour. Serve in tall glass atop crushed ice.

 1 1/2 cups sparkling water, such as cappelle ( one 16-ounce bottle ) | 1/4 1/4 cup lemon peel, shaved or 2 tablespoons grated zucchini rind

title: Spicy Pasta Meatballs With Pumpkin Seeds

instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth but not completely smooth. Drain pasta and put back in your pot. Bring to the boil on high heat stirring often. When you serve it, serve it straight from the pot with grated parmesan cheese, or over your favorite pasta. To cook it in a pan, mix the left over olive oil, put back on fire on high heat and make it smokey. Put pasta with the meat in a bowl and pour olive oil over it. Leave to roast on high heat in the oven or on a griddle, turning the meat as necessary, until browned.

Random Ingredients: white onion,orange,granny smith apple,pork sausage,chicken thigh,roast
title: Crockpot  Stew
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage, diced | 1 white onion, sliced | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and diced | 1 -2 roast, bone in ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 orange, cut into eigths
instructions: Place sausage in frying pan and cook over a medium high heat until lightly browned. Remove from heat and set aside until cool enough to handle, then slice into 1/4 inch to 1/4 inch thick rolls. Mix sausage, onion, apple, and roast in crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 5 - 6 hours or on high for 4 - 5 hours. Discard bones. Add orange segments, stir, and serve. Also makes excellent gifts, makes a very large quantity and keeps well in the refrigerator for several days.

title: Clammy Broth
ingredients: 2 cups clam juice ( about half a can ) | 1/2 cup clam juice ( about half a can ) | 1 cup clam juice | 1 teaspoon rosemary | 3 cups broth | 4 ounces crimini mushrooms ( about two medium, cleaned ) | heavy cream, chilled | rosemary
instructions: Pour clam juice into the pot, clam juice and rosemary and simmer 10 minutes, depending upon how much clam juice has been used. Set aside. Serve chilled and with extra rosemary for garnish. Heat half a can of clam juice in sauce pan. Remove foam forming and then pour over the clams and clam juice. Simmer 5 - 1 min or until cooked through. Transfer to serving bowl. Add the broths. Whip and serve chilled with rosemary.

title: Grilled Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 large boneless pork chops, about 3-inches thick | salt | garlic salt | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Place the pork chops between two sheets of wax paper and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Sprinkle both sides of the pork with salt and garlic salt and allow to rest for 20 minutes. Heat a grill pan on the stovetop. Grill the pork, turning once, until the outside is nicely charred and crusty and the meat is well browned about 5 minutes total. Transfer to a serving platter. Heat 1/2 cup of chickpeas in a small saucepan over medium high heat until hot. Spread the remaining can of chickpeas over the pork and sprinkle with hazelnuts. Spoon on the pork and serve. Enjoy.

title: Tandoori Masala
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pods | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan over medium heat. Mix flour and cardamom in a bowl and add oil to make a thin paste. Add a little water, enough to make about 1/2 cup of the mixture. Add to the mixture and stir. Bring the mixture to the bubble and turn down the heat. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes. Cool completely and store in refrigerator.

title: Beef and Bean Tostada
ingredients: 500 g rump steak | 400 g kidney beans | 2 teaspoons dried dill | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon tomato juice | 2 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Cut the steak into thin strips. Fry the steak strips in oil until cooked, drain fat. Combine with remaining ingredients. Let stand 30 minutes serve.

title: Fennel Powder - Indian Spice Blend
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and store in an airtight tin.

title: Tomato and Pepper Spread
ingredients: 2 cups diced romano cheese | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup hot pickle relish
instructions: In a bowl, toss romano cheese and tomatoes with warm pickle relish until thoroughly mixed. Transfer to a small bowl, cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,hot pepper sauce,chicken broth,green salad leaf,sea salt,cheese,garlic paste
title: Mock Chicken Nests
ingredients: 1 cup low-sodium chicken broth | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 4 tablespoons vanilla ice cream, well drained | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce | 6 green salad leaves | 12 large cheese slices, toasted
instructions: Bring broth to boiling in large saucepan over medium high heat. Add garlic and salt.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla strip,dill,chocolate chip,oregano leaf,yellow pepper
title: Chip and Pepper Filling for Baked Tacos or Taquitos
ingredients: 2/3 cup yellow sweet pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup sweet corn tortilla strips, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, snipped | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup good-quality semisweet chocolate chips, melted to glaze
instructions: Mix all the filling ingredients together and refrigerate for 1 hour to allow the flavors to develop. Using a pastry brush, brush the melted chocolate over the hot tortilla mix and spoon 2 tablespoons of the filling onto the hot shortbread and carefully flatten with your palm. Let cool for 5 minutes then remove from the tray and allow to sink slightly and then shape into desired shapes. Keeps for up to 2 weeks in an airtight container at room temperature if stored well sealed.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 2 pounds gruyere cheese, shredded | 2 pounds monterey jack cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Mix cheeses together in a large baking dish. Drain fondue sauce in a container to coat hands. Place mixture in warm fondue and serve hot.

title: Easy Chinese Spring Rolls
ingredients: 24 large fresh figs | 60 egg roll wraps | 1 package snow peas
instructions: Cook figs in 4 qts boiling water until tender and then chop into bite size pieces and add to fig mixture, along with eggroll wrappers. Slightly cook peas in 2 qt hot water until tender, drain, and stack with snow peas onto each wrapper until they are covered loosely. Bake in 375f oven until spring rolls are light brown around the edges but are still soft and hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,jalapeno pepper,chinese five spice powder
title: Sausage
ingredients: 1 can ro-tel diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 teaspoon jalapeno pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Add all ingredients together and stir until combined well.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,feta cheese,bicarbonate soda,bean,cornstarch,lime juice,hungarian paprika
title: Cheesy Feta Bean Snack
ingredients: 400 g refried beans | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika ( sweet brand ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed black cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 150 g feta cheese, cut into 1cm cubes | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: In a small bowl, gently combine the beans, cornstarch, paprika, and all the other herbs. Place the mixture in a large bowl, add the cheese and olive oil and mix well. If you wish, spoon over chips and serve.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,ricotta cheese,coriander,tomato puree,irish whiskey
title: Heavenly Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 can concentrated tomato puree | 1 teaspoon dried coriander | 1 teaspoon irish whiskey | 1 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: First prepare the tomato puree, pour ½ can of tomato puree into a mixing bowl, and combine with the coriander, whiskey. In a saucepan, combine the remaining 1/2 can tomato puree and the red sauce. Stir to mix, and then add the tomato mixture to the saucepan. Reduce heat to lowest possible point, and allow the remaining puree to simmer on low heat while you prepare the cheese. Once the sauce has simmered, add the ricotta cheese. Mix together with a wire whisk, and set aside to cool slightly. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. When the sauce is slightly cooled, pour into an 8x8 inch baking dish, and top with the red enchilada sauce. Bake for about 30 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Mexican Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 3 cups quinoa, cooked | 2 cups tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup canned pineapple chunk, drained and juice squeezed
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions, drain and cool. Place in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and toss.

title: Homemade Noodles & Harissa
ingredients: 5 medium potatoes, peeled and quartered | 2 carrots, peeled and minced into small chunks | 1 can tomato paste | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 teaspoon all-purpose seasoning | 1 fresh serrano chili, stemmed and finely chopped, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon tamari, paste for coating the noodles
instructions: Place potatoes and carrots in a large pot with water to cover.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetable Burritos
ingredients: 1 can baby carrots, drained | 1 can poblano chiles, drained | 1 package corn tortillas
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium high heat. Place the baby carrots, poblano peppers, and tortillas in the skillet. Heat until warmed through and tortillas soften slightly, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Rabbit Casserole
ingredients: 1 rabbit, rinsed and patted dry | 1 cup chopped assorted fresh vegetables, such as onion, celery, and parsley | 1 can beef brisket, well drained | 1 can applesauce, such as applebee's | 1 cup whole grain rice | 1/4 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pat rabbit dry with paper towels. Place rabbit breast side up in a baking dish. Cut remaining rabbit into bite size pieces. Add vegetables to rabbit. Cut brisket crosswise in half if necessary. Place in dish. Pour applesauce over. Cover and bake in preheated oven 30 minutes, until rabbit is tender. If liquid smoke appears on pan, cover loosely with foil. Stir rice and rice in a large bowl. Cover with plastic wrap. Allow to stand 5 minutes. Remove meat from pan. Rinse drippings, discarding vegetables and drippings. Spread rice mixture evenly over meat. Sprinkle top of rabbit with rice mixture. Cover and bake 25 minutes, until rice is cooked and liquid is absorbed.

title: Strawberry and Strawberry Panna Cotta
ingredients: 3 cups strawberries, hulled and sliced | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 1/4 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Place the strawberries and cream in a large bowl, and cover with water. Let sit 20 minutes, or according to package directions. Drain. Combine the yeast and 1/4 cup flour in a small bowl, and allow to stand until frothy, about 5 minutes. Pour into the bowl with the strawberries, and stir to combine. Cover with a cloth, and allow the mixture to rise until doubled, about 3 hours depending on how thick you want the top to be. Pour the mixture in a thin layer into a bowl. Set the bowl on a towel in a warm spot, and let rise until doubled. This will take 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Thai Basil and Date Spread
ingredients: 200 g low sodium dates | 1/2 bunch fresh basil | 1 pinch coarse salt
instructions: Start by chopping up your fresh fresh basil leaves. This can be done by hand or in a mortar and pestle. If you are using a food processor, pulse the leaves into a coarse powder, then push the mixture inches. Once basil is torn or cut into the leaves, add some coarse salt and mix inches. If you would like to make this as a dessert, you can add as little or as much of a pinch of coarse salt if you would like. You can also put in as little or as much as you think you like. Enjoy your fresh basil and dateless variety. Store in an airtight container.

title: Easy Swiss Steak for Two
ingredients: 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In an ungreased 8 inch square baking dish, combine all of the ingredients and stir to blend. Sprinkle remaining cheese for topping. Bake in the preheated oven for approximately 30 minutes, or until heated through and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,parsley leaf,cocoa powder,creole seasoning seasoning,pizza crust
title: Chile Con Queso (Mexican Pizza)
ingredients: 1 crust, baked | 2 cups cooked shredded pork or 2 cups cooked chicken | 1/4 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon parsley leaves or 1/4 teaspoon cilantro leaf | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | crushed cocoa powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line baking sheet with waxed paper or lightly grease parchment paper. Spread pizza crust bottom with a thin layer of engholada sauce or prepared guacamole. Line crust with waxed paper so it covers the entire pizza crust surface. If you don't plan ahead of time, store pizza crust in freezer for up to 2 days. Combine pork, creole seasoning, parsley, confectioners sugar and some crushed cocoa powder to make the chile con queso. Sprinkle on pizza crust. Bake until crust is light brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Curried Wild Rice and champagne over wild rice
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, rinsed well | 1 teaspoon curry ( or curry powder ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups dry red wine
instructions: Combine wild rice, curry and vinegar and chill. Cook wild rice mixture over medium heat until wild rice is tender and thick, about 20 minutes, then fluff. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,chicken bouillon granule,white wine vinegar,pistachio nut,liquid seasoning,spice,queso fresco,wheat flour
title: Stuffed Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted shelled pistachio nuts | 1 lb shrimp, cleaned | 1/3 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/3 cup whole wheat flour | spices | liquid seasoning | 1 cup grated queso fresco
instructions: Preheat over to 375 degrees f. Place pistachios on lightly greased baking sheet and toast, shaking every minute or so, 4 minutes or so until golden and fragrant. Remove to a paper towel lined plate to drain. Remove shells and devein, leaving 1/2 inch to 1/3 of shrimp in each shell. In a mortar, pound pistachios with a pinch or two of salt until finely ground. Remove pistachios to a medium bowl and set aside. With fingers, toss shrimp with wine vinegar, bouillon granules and about 3/4 cup pistachios. Sprinkle with more pistachios and toss gently. In a shallow bowl, blend flour, spices, and shrimp with reserved pistachios. Shape mixture into 6 patties. Place patties on baking sheet and bake 10 minutes, then turn on broiler. Broil patties about 10 minutes, until shrimp are pink and firm but still holding their shape. Sprinkle with grated cheese and return shrimp to broiler until cheese has melted and just begun to brown. Note, the shrimp usually stays with the shrimp in the shrimp. Shrimp cookers may require a long time to cook.

title: Hot Dog Filling for Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot dog | 2 ounces fontina, grated
instructions: Preheat your pizzelle iron according to manufacturer instructions. Spread 1/4 lb of hot dog cheese on each warm dog. Sprinkle the grated fontina over the cheese. Place the pizzelle iron in the oven for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Feta Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 1/2 cups beef broth | 1/4 cup crumbled feta
instructions: In a large saucepan, cook the cabbage and dried onion flakes in the oil over medium low heat. Stir in the broth and bring to a simmer.

title: Real Russian Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb dried chinese noodles, preferably thin | 8 cloves garlic granules, crushed | 1 cup vodka | ham
instructions: If you have an old, clean pillow that fits inside a large pot, fill it with a good quantity of dried noodles. Cover and refrigerate overnight of maximum of 24 hours drain all the liquid you can from the noodles. Put a handful of noodles on the counter and place a couple of cloves of crushed garlic granules at the top of the noodles. Drizzle a good splash of vodka over the noodles. You can also add chicken slices or ham slices as well. Wrap the pillow with plastic wrap, place in the refrigerator and let set up for 30 min after it gets started to set up. You will need to take the cheese cloth off the pillow.

title: Chocolate Tamarind Rocchi
ingredients: 3/4 bag biscuits mix | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp ( i use 3/4 cup, but i usually just use enough for the dough to go everywhere ) | 1/2 ounce chocolate, shavings
instructions: Cut out the tops of the coconut and discard shells and husks. You should also have 2 ramekins. You want the tamarind pulp to absorb the water and the water to be able to bind the dough together, i don't even know the size of the bag. It's a matter of about 3/4 of an inch total. Put the coconut in a food processor, pulse a few times and process until fine. Put this aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Pour 3/4 of a cup of liquid into a small saucepan, add the drained tamarind pulp and bring on medium heat, stirring regularly. When the liquid is bubbling, let it boil for a bit, remove from heat, add the melted chocolate and stir. Line two baking trays with parchment paper. Take one dough piece and roll it out until thin, about the size of a cookie. Add the dough to each ramekin. Press the dough into a shape you like. You should have a circle about 12 inches wide, and you should have about 12 biscuits that will fit if you fill each ramekin. The ramekins should cover the entire surface of a large baking tray. You may have to use more or less water for this. Place on the tray and bake for 18 to 20 minutes. I like to add a little bit of peanut sauce or maybe some chocolate chips after baking. You can also try doing this with the tamarind pulp, just take a piece of waxed paper and take the slices and cut them into small chunks then combine them in the sauce and simmer, stir a bit, until they start to come to room temperature. If you would like more spice, add some ground nutmeg or a teaspoon of tamarind pulp. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: saffron,corn cob,fig,celery,green chili pepper,breadcrumb,balsamic vinegar,cremini mushroom
title: Moroccan Fig Mushrooms and Corn Crescents
ingredients: 1/2 lb cremini mushroom | 1 teaspoon saffron | 4 slices breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon chopped celery | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers, chopped | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 24 small dried figs ( see note )
instructions: Combine mushrooms, saffron, breadcrumbs, celery, chilies, garlic, vinegar, and figs. Divide mixture into equal servings and place in baking pan. Broil at 400 degrees fahrenheit until mushrooms are just tender, about 2 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,seasoning salt,jicama,onion powder,orange zest,sugar,chinese noodle,chicken stock water
title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock ( or water ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 lb asparagus, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 package chinese noodles ( thin ) | 3 tablespoons shredded jicama
instructions: Combine chicken stock, salt, onion powder, sugar, and zest in a nonreactive bowl.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,saffron strand,mostaccioli pasta,rice vinegar,pepperoni,bread flour,coffee powder
title: Pepperoni Focaccia
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand | 3/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 lb pepperoni, sliced | 1 cup rice vinegar | 1 bell pepper, cut in 3/4 inch dice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine flour, instant coffee, saffron, pepper and rice vinegar. Roll dough out on a lightly floured board to cut into 3 inch squares. Place pepperoni in center of each square. Sprinkle tops of pepperoni with rice vinegar. Bring two opposite edges of dough together and tightly roll up to form a large log.

Random Ingredients: cooking wine,belgian endive,vegetable juice,tomato green chilies,red apple,pearl barley,black coffee
title: Vegetable Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 package pearl barley | 4 cups vegetable juice | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 red apple, chopped | 1 belgian endive, chopped | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking wine | 1 teaspoon black coffee
instructions: Combine barley, vegetable juice, diced tomatoes with chilies, apple, endive, wine and coffee in a large stock pot or crockpot slow cooker.

title: Easy Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled and cubed | 1 russet potato, peeled and cubed | 1 beef chuck, cut into 3 pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place eggplant cubes in a large roasting pan. Bake on high in the preheated oven until tender and tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Drain eggplant and potato. Set aside. Season beef chuck pieces with salt and pepper. Heat a large, ovenproof skillet over medium high heat. Brown beef pieces on all sides.

Random Ingredients: fish,fennel seed,yellow onion,jalapeno seed,bay leaf,lime,black pepper,rack lamb
title: Fish and Rack of Lamb (Fernil Island)
ingredients: 1 cup dried shrimp or 1 cup dried shrimp ( about 1/3 lb ) | 2 lbs racks of lamb | 1 large yellow onion, thinly sliced | 1 dried bay leaf | 1 1/2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 tablespoon jalapeno seeds | 1 lime, cut crosswise into 4 thin slices | ground black pepper
instructions: Bring a large quantity of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat, then add the shrimp, crab, and lamb, then turn off the heat. Leave on the lid while you work with the lamb so the water will soak up the spices. Wrap each rack in aluminum foil along with some string. Heat oven to 300°f put a rack of lamb onto a rack in a roasting pan and place in oven. Roast for about 1 hour. Meanwhile, put the onion, bay leaf, fennel, jalapeno seeds, and lime slices in a small skillet with a little water. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until tender. Remove the lamb from the oven, cover loosely with foil, and put on a serving platter. Strain the liquid through a sieve set over boiling water, discarding the solids. Return the liquid to the pan. Place a serving plate on top, then add 6 thin slices of lamb apiece. Pour over the juice and enjoy.

title: White Beans and Ricotta Cheese With Browned White Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 teaspoons white sugar ( or to taste -- or use splenda ) | 1 pound white beans | 1 cup ricotta cheese, room temperature
instructions: Prepare beans. Place the beans in a large pot of water. Bring to a boil, then cook until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain and set aside. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Saute the sugar until golden, about 5 minutes. Add the beans, reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender, about 5 minutes more. Stir in the ricotta cheese, cook until the ricotta has melted and is warmed through. Remove from the heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,green capsicum,lemon juice zest,shiitake mushroom,tortilla chip
title: Chile, Mushroom & Picnic Nachos
ingredients: 3 large poblano chiles | 150 g shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 green capsicum | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, from lemons | 1 tortilla chip, to serve
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place poblanos on a baking tray and place in the oven for 3 - 5 minutes until skin blister. Turn on the broiler. Halve the poblanos and remove any seeds and coarse fibrous bits. Using a knife, remove the chiles, remove the charred outer skin. Slice the flesh into matchstick sized pieces. Cut the capsicum into thin strips and place these into a bowl. Add the zest of half a lemon and all the drained poblanos, mushrooms and capsicum strips. Stir to combine. Place the lemon juice in a nonstick frypan and simmer on high heat for 1 minute. Turn pan off. Place the nachos into a serving dish. Pour the warm pomegranate infused juice over the nachos so they are covered. Top with the tortilla chips to serve.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,pepper,plain nonfat yogurt,salad dressing,wasabi,olive oil,maraschino cherry
title: California Yogurt Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 1 )
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low-fat plain nonfat yogurt | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon wasabi | 1 cup mixed salad dressing | 1/4 cup coriander leaves | 2/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 cups fresh shaved arabic mixed salad dressing | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: Combine yogurt, 1 tbsp olive oil, wasabi and remaining tbsp olive oil in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,ricotta cheese,fruit,cabbage,salmon,vanilla yogurt,green chili pepper,stewing beef
title: Savoury Salmon and Veggie Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 500 g stewing beef, diced | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla yogurt | 500 g ricotta cheese | 200 g mixed dried fruit | 1 green chili pepper, deseeded and chopped | 100 g cabbage, finely shredded | 200 g light sweetened soya sauce
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together except the filling. Make sure you have enough mixture to fill the rolls. Take half the fillings from the filling, roll up with the other half to make 2 rolls. Poke a hole in the center with a fork, place on a tray covered with greaseproof paper.

title: Grilled Mango Chutney Popsicles
ingredients: 1 mango chutney | 1/2 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 tablespoon lemon zest, grate
instructions: In small bowl, mix together the chutney and sesame oil. Stir in the lemon zest just until evenly distributed. Cut the mango chutney into 8 squares. Brush a grill basket with a thin layer of the chutney mixture to prevent sticking. Place mango chutney patties on the grill basket. Close lid and grill or broil over medium high heat until the mango is slightly softened. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: butter,yellow bell pepper,red onion,chicken stock cube
title: Hot Bell Pepper Butter
ingredients: 2 red onions, sliced | 1 yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 small chicken stock cube, eg. packet, can be left out | 1 tablespoon butter, melted
instructions: Place drained peppers, onion and stock cube into a saucepan, heat, stir for 10 minutes. Add butter. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Roasted Eggplant (Aubergine) With Chiles
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 red chili, deseeded and sliced | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 225°c. Roast the eggplant on an oiled baking tray until soft and mushy.. Transfer the roasted eggplant to an ovenproof dish and scatter with chile slices. Roast under the grill for 10 - 15 minutes until roasted and fragrant. Stir through the cheese and warm through to serve.

title: Scallions
ingredients: 8 scallions, ends trimmed | 1 tablespoon capers, drained
instructions: Wash greens and dry them well. Place them in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,brown gravy mix,peach,spanish onion
title: Slow Cooker Peach Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 package beef stew meat | 1 can sliced peaches | 1 can reduced sodium brown gravy mix | 1 spanish onion, sliced
instructions: Mix beef, peaches, gravy mix, and onion together in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 4 to 6 hours.

title: Dolmas ka Halwa (Veal Buns)
ingredients: 1 lb veal | 4 whole wheat hamburger buns, split | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 2 teaspoons tamari | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Toast split bun,. Toast hamburger buns. Slice off a piece of veal corner, like a sharp piece of meat. Rub lamb fat, if using, on both sides of meat. Heat a small saucepan filled with 1/4 cups water, add the meat and salt, stir. Cover and cook over medium heat until meat is nearly tender, about 10 minutes. Remove meat from pan and drain off the fat, remove the lamb fat as much as possible. Mix meat with cream, tamari, cinnamon and asafoetida in the same skillet. Slice the meat thinly and serve with meat.

title: Roasted Broccoli and Rice Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arborio rice, prepared according to package directions | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 bag frozen cut broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a 9x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a mixing bowl, stir together rice and preserves. Stir in broccoli until well mixed. Pour into baking dish and bake for 35 minutes or until golden and fluffly.

title: Easy Low Calorie, Low Cal, Fluff Pizza
ingredients: 1 lemon pepper seasoning | 1 1/4 cups fat-free ricotta cheese | 12 slices low fat barley ( i like whole wheat ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup ice
instructions: This recipe is a low carb version of this delicious barley pizza, but you'll get the nutrition facts and the fat if you like. To get the lemon pepper seasoning, combine 1 1/2 cups water or lemon juice and 1/3 cup low sodium water in a saucepan. Add barley so it can soak up the flavor in the water before it goes from raw to creamy, as well as toasting it. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until barley is tender. Add cheese and continue simmering until cheese is melted, stirring constantly. Put on a plate and top with crust.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,sticky rice,wheat tortilla,rigatoni pasta,cardamom,turmeric powder,apricot preserve,sherry wine
