title: Rizogalo, Capellini, and Apricot Pasta Pilaf
ingredients: 12 6-inch wheat tortillas or 12 -14 whole wheat tortillas | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb spaghetti | 8 ounces jar apricot preserves | 3/4 cup sherry wine ( any brand will do ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 1/2 cups shredded roasted red peppers, from a jar of peppers, drained for sprinkling on rice
instructions: Place the tortillas on a plate and microwave on high until heated through and softened, about 90 seconds. Keep warm while making spaghetti. Drain the pasta and separate in three separate piles. In a large bowl combine the sherry, grapefruit juice, turmeric, red pepper, and 1 1/2 cups of the red/white/black/black pepper pasta/parsley/white/chickpeas/paprika/cilantro etc. Toss with the pasta and vegetables. Serve with more pepper if needed.

title: Southern Pulled Pork
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch pieces | 12 pounds bone-in pork roast | 1/4 cup sugar | 1 1/2 cups red onions, sliced into rings | 1 cup chicken broth
instructions: Fry bacon over medium high heat until lightly brown. Remove and set aside. Drain off all but 2 t. Of bacon drippings. Place pork in a 5 qt crock. Sprinkle with sugar, onions and cook over medium high heat for 2 minutes. Place pork over the bacon. Pour chicken broth over pork. Cook in crock until pork is tender, about 5 - 6 hours.. Remove pork from crock and refrigerate for 2 - 3 hours or until pork is very tender. You might like to remove the pork from the crock a few hours before slicing.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,liquid stevia,cheddar cheese,onion,lime juice zest,paprika,tabasco jalapeno sauce,chicken stock
title: Cheddar Cheese and Potato Cakes
ingredients: 2 lbs grated cheddar cheese | 3/4 cup potato starch | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 3 drops tabasco jalapeno sauce | 2 drops stevia | 1 small onion, very finely chopped | salt and paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f mix all but the paprika with the cheese in a bowl. Add all dry ingredients and mix well. Divide into 12 balls. Place on a greased tray and flatten slightly. Bake for 20 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Russian Egg and Vinegar Dip
ingredients: 4 large eggplants | 1 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Place the eggplants in a strainer over a bowl with 1 cup of water. Place the bowl in a microwave safe bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high power until the ends of the eggplants have released their water and the skin is blackened. Remove the eggplants from the microwave, then peel and cut off the stem and discard the peel. Slice the eggplants into 1/4 inch slices, then set aside. Pour sour cream, cider vinegar, and a little water into a bowl. Mix thoroughly until well blended, then pour the remaining dressing over the eggplant slices. Cover and refrigerate overnight to serve cold. Goes good with roasted potatoes, or other pastries.

title: Baked Tuna Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 tuna in water, drained | 1/2 cup uncooked long grain rice | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato halves, oil packed, chopped
instructions: Place tuna in a bowl and spread with a light sprinkling of salt. Let sit for 15 minutes. Drain the water from the tuna. Coat rice in the tuna water. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Stir and microwave for an additional 1 minute. Stir and microwave for an additional 30 seconds just to dry rice a little. Stir and microwave for an additional 30 seconds. Transfer to a plate and spoon rice into a small, shallow bowl. Spread sun dried tomatoes over the rice and microwave for 4 to 5 minutes, or until softened, stirring occasionally. Dip a small spoonful of the tuna rice balls into the tuna water and then place into the bread crumbs of your choice. Place under a grill, and grill for 1 to 2 minutes, or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: dark corn syrup,broiler chicken,white wine,cabbage,stewing beef,feta,lard,curry leaf
title: Cabbage and Coriander Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 3 cups cabbage, coarsely chopped | 28 fluid ounces coriander or 3 cups other good quality cabbage | 3 tablespoons curry leaves | 1 cup white wine | 2 tablespoons dark corn syrup | flour or cornstarch diluted in 1/4 cup water | 1/4 - 1/3 cup crumbled feta or 1/4-1/3 cup chevre cheese, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Remove the fat from the beef and cut into small pieces. Reserve the broth for future use. Wash and cut cabbage into thick wedges. Place beef over medium high heat in a saucepan of boiling water in addition to the beef broth. Cook 5 minutes or until just cooked. Drain and put beef back in the same pan. Combine the reserved broth with the coriander and set aside. Heat the broth in the pan over medium heat. Add cabbage wedges to the pan, cover and cook 5 - 10 minutes or until tender. Add curry leaves, wine mixture and corn syrup, stirring frequently. Turn off heat. Add crumbled cheese, stirring over heat until cheese melts. Stir in cooked beef. Serve on buns.

title: Wild Rice, Cauliflower and Garlic Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice ( or other long-grain white rice ) | 1 small head of garlic | 3 pieces dried yeast | 1 -2 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1 large cauliflower, shredded ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Pour warm water over rice in a large bowl and add garlic, yeast and vinegar. Stir to dissolve. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes or longer until the water has absorbed but the rice and garlic are not completely cooked. Add cauliflower and stir well to blend. Cover and let stand for 1 hour. Stir again before opening oven. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,grain rice,thai chili sauce,maple syrup,kernel corn,button mushroom
title: Spicy Corn and Mushroom Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked long grain rice, i used uncle ben's original uncle ben's loco loco style ( regular white rice may not use this ) | 2 cups frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 2 teaspoons diced orange zest, i didn't have this | 2 -4 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 -2 fresh thai sweet chili sauce ( your choice, i used mae ploy brand ) | 2 fresh button mushrooms, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray a 1 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. In a bowl, mix the rice, corn, orange zest, maple syrup, thai chile sauce and mushrooms. Spread mixture in the bottom of the prepared glass dish. Cover pan with foil or a damp paper towel secured with kitchen string. Bake for about 40 minute test for doneness with your finger. Remove the foil or the string and sprinkle rice with the chile sauce.

title: Red Wine
ingredients: 2 cups red wine or 2 cups vermouth | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, freshly grated | 1/2 cup maple syrup
instructions: Combine wine, nutmeg, and maple syrup in a saucepan and heat through. Pour wine mixture into 4 serving glasses and serve immediately.

title: Roasted Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cups red enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 pound salt pork, cubed into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Whisk enchilada sauce, fennel seeds, and salt pork in a bowl until blended. Stir in onion and carrots.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,ice water,broccoli floret,mexican cheese,saffron thread,basil leaf,pork chop,green chilies
title: Saffron Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 teaspoon ice water | 4 -5 garlic-flavored pork chops | 1 cup fresh broccoli florets | 2 green chilies, halved and seeded | 1 cup shredded lettuce leaf | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese or 1 cup sour cream, to taste | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf, minced top part only ( if used in cooking )
instructions: Heat one side grill pan up, then turn to low. Soak saffron threads in boiling water. Add saffron and ice water to pork chops and turn to coat. Grill pork chops about 6 minutes per side, or to desired doneness. Remove to a medium bowl and set aside. In the same pan over medium heat, lightly fry the broccoli florets.

title: Easy Tofu "Pops"
ingredients: 1 lb extra firm tofu, cut into 1 cubes | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 cup light coconut cream | 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a full boil. Toss tofu with salt in a bowl to coat. Add coconut cream, lemon peel, and tofu to boiling water.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,ginger garlic paste,golden raisin,ginger,monterey jack pepper cheese,green chili
title: Tandoori Cheese With Raisins and Green Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 - 1 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs monterey jack pepper cheese, sliced very thin | 1 can diced green chili | 2 teaspoons bottled sliced ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl combine raisins and remaining ingredients. Transfer to a greased caserole dish. Cover pan with foil. Bake for 30 minutes. Uncover, and bake, stirring every 10 minutes until raisins are a deep golden color, about 45 minutes.

title: Sara's Easy Pizza
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheet ( thawed ) | 1/4 cup red curry paste | 2 cups pizza sauce | 12 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Thaw pastry sheets for 30 minutes in refrigerator. Take out of refrigerator and roll out to 1/8 thick. Line baking sheet with parchment covered paper. Spread on curry paste. Place pastry sheets over curry paste, making 1 inch slices. Spread on pizza sauce and top with tomatos. Bake at 450f for 15 minutes.

title: Spicy Sushi Nori Rolls
ingredients: 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1 spanish onion, finely diced ( red onion preferred ) | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon lard | 2 cups self raising flour
instructions: Cut the sheets into three even pieces. I like to cut these small squares to make them easier to roll. To prepare the nori, line a sieve with cheesecloth and place the nori over it. Allow to drain for about 15 minutes. Squeeze out excess water while straining excess liquid. Sprinkle the onion with soya sauce and fry gently over medium heat for about 8 minutes. Keep stirring so the onion doesn't burn. Remove the onions and cool slightly. Mix the flour with 2 tbs. Of the water, then quickly add to the onions. Stir until everything is combined, turn down heat and add the onions. Mix with hands until the dough becomes stiff. Line a bamboo sushi mat with plastic wrap. Fill empty bowl with ice water. Spread the nori in rows onto the plastic wrap so it is about twice the width of the nori, rolling out as thinly as possible. Place nori on top of the ice water. Cover with a piece of wax paper and let stand for 5 - 5 minutes. Place a towel on top of the nori, then carefully roll the nori. After 5 minutes, carefully peel off plastic wrap. Dip one side in the remaining water, then in the towel. Keep the nori covered with wax paper until the nori is done. Note, once it's removed, you may eat it alone, or cut in the shape of your choice and serve along side the sushi.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,green bean,sun tomato,green pea,button mushroom,parsley leaf
title: Green Beans and Sausage With Mushrooms (Sauge)
ingredients: 4 green beans, trimmed | 1 lb pork sausage | 12 button mushrooms | 2/3 cup green peas | 2/3 cup sun-dried tomato, oil-packed, drained and chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Trim ends from beans. Cook beans on grill or under hot broiler until tender crisp and slightly charred, 4 to 6 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Meanwhile, in 10 inch nonstick skillet, cook sausage, mushrooms, peas, tomatoes and parsley over medium heat until heated through and mushrooms are tender, about 2 minutes to flavor. Stir beans into mushroom mixture.

Random Ingredients: peach,kielbasa,sesame seed oil,chuck,corn syrup,sun tomato oil,black pepper,egg noodle
title: Grill Polish Meatballs With Noodles
ingredients: 6 medium hot dogs, such as hormel | 1 package egg noodles | 1 cup canned peach slices, drained ( reserve 1/4 cup syrup ) | 1/2 cup corn syrup | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 1 tablespoon chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil plus 1 tablespoon oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 4 ounces kielbasa, thinly sliced
instructions: Place hot dogs in a bowl.

title: Cayenne Pepper Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon italian-style seasoning
instructions: Mix the cayenne pepper, italian seasoning, and dried onion flakes together. Store refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,icing sugar,lemonade,sugar,swiss cheese,cashew,pancetta,golden delicious apple
title: Swiss Cheese & Taleggio
ingredients: 2 golden delicious apples ( we used dark eating apples which were from our own garden ) | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 150 g swiss cheese | 50 g pancetta ( we used a proscutti slicer ) | 50 g cashews | 100 ml lemonade | 50 g icing sugar | icing sugar ( to coat )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c cut the cheese into small squares. Cut the pancetta into large thin slices and coat with lemonade. Pour a small amount of lemonade into the bottom of a muffin tin. Slice the cheese into thin pieces. Peel and dice the apples. Mix apples, cheese, fenugreek seeds, and cashews. Pour half the lemonade into the muffin tin, and top with the cheese mixture. Sprinkle the top with icing sugar. Heat in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes until golden. We took this out and it was so good that it really went into the oven as soon as we tried it and it turned out perfect.

title: Applesauce Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs jumbo shrimp, peeled deveined | 1 1/2 cups unsweetened applesauce | 12 -15 cups ice water | crushed peppercorns
instructions: Combine the shrimp with applesauce in a large heavy duty sealable plastic bag. Refrigerate while preparing the rest of the dishes. Place the ice water in a medium size saucepan, bring to a gentle boil and cook for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Remove shrimp from frig, drain the shrimp and place half to one side. Return the sauce to the stovetop over medium heat. Bring to a boil for 2 - 3 minutes to reduce the liquid slightly. Stir and cook for 1 - 2 minutes until shrimp are pink. Return shrimp to saucepan, coat well with sauce and warm until heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,green pepper strip,pepperoni,corn flake,cheddar cheese,dark brown sugar,hungarian paprika,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pepperoni  and Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 6 ounces tomato juice | 6 ounces of chopped pepperoni | 4 ounces grated cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 ounces grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 4 ounces of shaved pecorino romano cheese | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | pepperoni | corn flakes, for garnish
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a medium sauce pan and stir with a potato masher until melted and well mixed. Set on low heat and do not let it come to a slow boil. Pour a little warm water into the bowl, if you wish, so as to create a dipping consistency for everything. Then take the fondue pot and put it on the stove top over very low heat, stirring periodically. The butter will melt and mix into the fondue. After about 5 minutes, the fondue will have reached a bubble and the cheese will be bubbly and mixed inches if you do not want to cook it further to soften, wait until closer to serving time this is the point where it is safe. Serve with bread, cheese, cheese sticks, pretzels, and small dumplings.

title: Amaretto Chicken
ingredients: 2 packages chicken pieces | 2 ounces amaretto ( almond flavoring )
instructions: Dip chicken in amaretto, then fry until lightly browned.

title: Courgette Salad
ingredients: 250 g whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 cups shredded courgette | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh horseradish | 4 tablespoons grated fresh horseradish, to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons low margarine, melted | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon leaves
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a large bowl and mix well. Turn out onto a floured board and knead the dough a few times until it is smooth and elastic. Use a floured rolling pin to roll the dough out to about a rectangle about about 10 - 20 mm on the long side and about 12 cm on the wide side. Cut the roll into about 10 squares and place onto a greased tray. Cover with clingfilm and keep in the refridgerator until serving time.

title: Spicy Indian Onion Mint Chutney
ingredients: 500 g onions, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 cup mint leaf, for garnishing
instructions: Minty. Heat ghee in a large pot on a medium flame. Once its hot, add ginger paste and mint leaves. Once the ginger paste turns brown, add onions. Allow them to boil for 3 minutes. Add mango chutney. Once the chutney is well mixed in, add salt/other seasoning according to your taste. Keep stirring the mix till it's well mixed in garnishing. You'll get a crunchy mess in the middle of the pot. If the chutney still wasn't enough to get the right consistency, add up to 2 or 3 tbsp more water until it reaches this consistency if it's too thick, mix in some cornflour to get a nice paste like consistency or add more mint and ginger chutney. Mix to get the right consistancy. Garnish with mint leaves. Note, if you don't have an electric frypan, the bread is the same thing. Breading/sourdough bread would also be a healthier alternative to this but i like the bread crunchy i had been serving with curry and fried potatoes. Variation, use ginger paste instead of ginger. Baking potato substitution can also be used if preferred.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,beef brisket,asafoetida powder,coffee,fruit,cream cheese,walnut oil
title: Sweet and Hot Asian Broccoli Smoked Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2/3 lb beef brisket | 1/3 lb dried fruit, any kind | 1 1/2 cups dried packaged broccoli florets, stems included | 1 tablespoon ground coffee, powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 1 1/4 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/3 cup toasted walnut oil
instructions: Preheat indoor electric grill. Slice onion thinly, then slice thinly across the grain. Remove root ends from broccoli stem and cut into 2 to 3 inch segments. Spread the beef brisket with your hands so it is covered with some of the onion slices. Rub bean curd or a combination of the ground coffee powder and asafoetida powder onto both sides of the brisket. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes or chill overnight. Place all ingredients in a 6 to 8 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 5 hours. Turn the slow cooker to low. Add cream cheese and walnut oil. Cook for 1 hour. Remove brisket from slow cooker. Slice thinly and serve with sauce.

title: Green Chile Enchiladas Verde Anjas
ingredients: 12 -12 fresh green chili, cut into 4 - 5 sections ( for those not on a hurry, or go with the ones on the side! ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Combine three sections of chili in a bowl, pour over 2 - 3 tbsp rum, and mix. Fill a heavy skillet with cold water to reach a depth of 1 1/2 inches. This will prevent the chili from sticking to the bottom of the pan as it simmers. Heat over high heat until hot but not boiling, but the water in the skillet will be extremely hot. Using tongs, dip the chili pieces into the hot water, one at a time, allowing each piece to lie uncltini on the inside of the hot skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally to avoid sticking, until a light coating of the coating is formed. The coating should just sizzle. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels to drain. Repeat with more chili in remaining portions.

title: Veal, Quinoa, and Cucumbers (Paleo)
ingredients: 2 packages cubed stew meat ( or lamb ) | 1 cucumber, chopped | 8 ounces quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped veal ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, add stew meat or lamb and cook until browned and crumbly. Add quinoa and cover with hot water. Bring to boil. Cover tightly and bring to boil again. Reduce heat, and cook for 20 minutes. Turn out and let rest 10 minutes before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Mediterranean Brussel Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package fresh brussels sprouts | shredded lettuce | shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh harissa | 4 tablespoons thousand island dressing
instructions: Place brussels sprouts on foil and bake at 350 until they start to sprout, about 25 - 30 minutes. While sprouts are baking, place other vegetables on a baking sheet or grill. Season with salt and pepper. Preheat the grill. When bernes are ready, drizzle with thousand island dressing and sprinkle with shredded lettuce and grated cheese. Sprinkle with a little more harissa for spicier entree.

title: Sweet Lime Baked Chocolate Rice Mochi
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 cup chocolate ( use as much as you like, it's up to you! ) | 200 ml double cream | 1 pinch baking soda | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley flakes | 2 1/2 cups salsa
instructions: If using fresh, prepare your rice and put it in a baking dish. Make sure it is well greased. It can be quite easy. Preheat oven to 200c/400f. Prepare rice as per your rice package instructions. Put rice in a pot with 1/2 cup water and cook for about 20 minutes on low/medium heat. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate. Stir occasionally until melted. Stir in cream. Add baking soda. Stir well. Pour into a bowl and mix in parsley. Spread on baking sheet. Bake until crispy. It's easier after it has completely cooled down but the longer it cools, the more it will melt. Spread on waxed paper and keep in a cool place until ready to use.

title: Walnut Halwa (Turmeric Treats)
ingredients: 100 ml halved walnut halves | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Using a wooden or glass spoon, scrape out the thick pith from the turmer and discard. Pour into a small bowl and add water to cover the halved walnuts by about 5cm/ 1/4 inch/ 1/8 inch or so. Stir well to prevent the halved walnuts from jumping back too much in one direction. Mix in turmeric, cover and leave to marinate for about 15 minutes at room temperature. When ready to eat, drain any unabsorbed water off the walnuts and serve hot or cold. If you're using straight away, store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: chipotle hot sauce,spaghetti noodle,sauce,green chilies,provolone cheese,canadian bacon,green cabbage
title: Spaghetti With Smoky Cheddar Bacon and Green Chilies
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti noodles ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons sweet and sour sauce or 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 4 ounces provolone cheese, sliced or 2 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 4 ounces canadian bacon or 4 ounces bacon ( cooked and crumbled ) | 3 -4 tablespoons canadian bacon bits ( drained ) | 2 cans whole green chilies, undrained | 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( i like mccormick montreal steakhouse smokehouse chipotle hot wingers )
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package drain and keep warm. Meanwhile in a large bowl mix spaghetti, cheese, canadian bacon, chilies, hot sauce and hot sauce. Serve warm.

title: Steak and Ginger Salad
ingredients: 2 thick sirloin, cut into about four thick slices or 2 thin slice beef | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the egg, dijon mustard, ginger and vinegar. Set aside. Place the beef slices into a shallow dish, and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour, turning occasionally. Rinse the beef slices, and pat dry with paper towels. In a large bowl, coat the edges of a large frypan with oil or cooking spray. Heat on medium high. Dip the meat into the egg mixture, coating both sides, and place into the hot pan. Cook and flip the meat slices until browned, about 3 to 5 minutes per side. You may have to do this in batches because the meat slices cook fast. Place one or two slices of beef on top of the other on the plate, and place the rest on top.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,flat leaf parsley,sun tomato,white sugar,pear,golden syrup
title: Tomato Pear and Olive Jam
ingredients: 1 large pear, peeled, seeded and sliced | 150 g golden syrup | 250 g tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato, chopped | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Place the sliced pear in a microwave safe bowl, pour over the golden syrup and microwave for 1 minute, stirring halfway through. Cool to room temperature. Place the tomato juice, sugar and 1 tablespoon of the parsley in a saucepan and simmer gently for 10 minutes, or until thick and syrupy. Remove from the heat and add the rest of the chopped parsley and sun dried tomatoes. Stir well to combine and transfer to a food processor or blender and process until smooth smooth. Add the pear liquid to the jelly and process until a thick paste forms. Pour the jelly into sterilised jars, seal and process for 10 minutes, or until smooth. Allow to cool completely before using.

title: Corn & Apple Juice
ingredients: 1 can corn, drained | 1 can apple juice | sweetened whipped cream ( optional ) or sour cream, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Combine the corn, apple juice and whipped cream or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: white flour,confectioner sugar,coriander seed,white tuna water
title: Spicy Tuna Balls
ingredients: 4 pounds fresh white tuna in water, drained | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup fresh coriander seeds, finely crumpled | 1 cup white flour, or as needed
instructions: Mix tuna and 1/2 cup flour in a bowl. Stir confectioners' sugar and coriander seeds together in a pinch of water until the mixture is moistened and the sugar has dissolved. Dredge the tuna in the mixture you just made. Gently form the tuna into the mixture with a fork. Gently roll tuna balls in the remaining flour to coat, then refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line baking sheets with paper towels. Place tuna balls on baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until crispy, about 15 minutes. Cool slightly after removing from baking sheets. Roll each one individually in confectioners' sugar before serving.

Random Ingredients: french bread,corkscrew macaroni,allspice,mustard,pico de gallo,orange bell pepper
title: Macaroni and Beef (Cebellini) Bake
ingredients: 1 cup dry corkscrew macaroni | 1 lb ground sirloin steak or 1 lb skirt steak, cut in thin strips | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 3 tablespoons pico de gallo ( store-bought is fine ) | 1 orange bell pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Cook pasta acc to package directions, drain, and rinse under cold water. Transfer to large bowl. Add mince, mustard, allspice, and pico de gallo until well mixed. Stir pasta mixture into beef mixture. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spread beef mixture in shallow 2 quart baking dish. Bake uncovered about 35 minutes. Stir pepper strips into meat and serve.

title: Sesame Seed and Soy Sauce Ramen
ingredients: 1/3 cup soya sauce ( i use reduced sodium ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: In a small bowl, toss the sesame seeds with 1 tablespoon water. Transfer to a microwave safe dish. Cook on high for 3 minutes, shake, stir, and set aside to cool. When cool, toss with the soya sauce.

title: Mango-Flavoured Mango Dip
ingredients: 1 ripe mango, peeled, halved, and chopped | 1/2 cup cool whip
instructions: Place mango in a bowl, and cover with the cool whip. Cover with plastic wrap, and chill at least 1 hour. Sprinkle with more cool whip before serving.

title: Okra With Tomatoes and Pickles
ingredients: 5 lbs okra, trimmed | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 large plum tomato, sliced
instructions: Trim ends and bottoms off of okra, but do not cut all the way through. Trim stem end so okra is loose enough to eat with your finger tips. Remove and discard gills. Cut off about a 2 1/2 inch piece of the thick center part of the okra, and slice along its length with scissors, to make about 4 to 6 okra slices per pound of okra. In a nonreactive 4 quart saucepan, mix well the vinegar with 1/4 cup water and add to the pan, allowing sauce to come just below the surface of the okra. Add remaining ingredients and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 1 1/4 hours, or until okra is tender.

title: Easy Fish Tacos
ingredients: 2 corn tortillas | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/4 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a skillet of water to a boil. Cook tortillas briefly in the boiling water.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,cream cheese,red kidney bean,almond meal,cornflour,creme de menthe
title: Easy Red kidney beans and cream cheese mash
ingredients: 420 g red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 250 g cream cheese | 200 g creme de menthe | 1/4 cup almond meal | 1 pinch red mill gluten-free flour, sifted | 4 slices canadian bacon, finely diced
instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor and pulse until mixture is smooth, then transfer to a bowl. Pour over hot cooked rice, vegetables or bread and allow to cool and firm to the touch.

title: Gramflour Irish Carrot Cake
ingredients: 4 lbs carrots, peeled and grated | 1/2 cup raisins, soaked in water until soft | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 1/3 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 whole pared cardamom - crushed, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 5 quart cassarole dish. Mix carrots, raisins, rosemary, cardamom, flour, garlic salt, and confectioners' sugar together in a bowl until thoroughly blended. Pour into prepared cassarole dish. Make small holes in the top of the cake with the point of a knife. Sprinkle crushed cardamom over the cake. Bake the cake in a preheated oven until the center has turned a rich golden brown color, 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Kaffir Lime (Or Chocolate) Mocha
ingredients: 2 teaspoons olive, crushed or 2 teaspoons melted coconut | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 10 kaffir lime leaves, shredded | grated unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Heat up 1 tsp of olive or coconut in a small sauce pan. Add the other tsp of cocoa mixed with half a cup of water. Mix, and set aside until needed. Melt the balance of the tbsp or a little bit of your favourite unsweetened cocoa. Add the rest of the cocoa and blend in very well with a wooden spoon until the mixture is very smooth. Keep mixing. In one long dipping motion, pour the hot cocoa mixture over the coconut, while stirring with a wooden spoon. Add more cocoa if the mixture is too sticky. Keep stirring until smooth.

title: Easy Italian Sizzlin' Noodle Salad
ingredients: 15 1/2 ounces italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 cup diced watermelon | 1/2 cup diced potato flakes ( optional ) | 1 sweet potato, peeled seeded and diced ( optional ) | 7 -8 ounces egg noodles
instructions: Dice the bell pepper and cut the tomatoes in half lengthwise. Spray 2 cookie sheets with cooking spray. Add all ingredients to a small bowl and toss to combine. Spoon 1 - 2 heaping tablespoons of noodle mixture onto each sheet to create a small crust for topping. Wrap each sizzlin' noodle tightly in foil while eating and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serve, cold.

title: Tie Tie
ingredients: 12 ounces lima beans or 12 ounces prawns, cleaned | 1 ounce currants | 12 ounces sultanas
instructions: Soak the lima beans and currants for 1 hour. Drain the beans and currants and bring to a boil. Add the sultanas. Boil rapidly again for 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato,whipping cream,pizza crust,tamarind paste,wheat bread,navy bean,baking powder
title: The Best and Easiest Tamarind Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1 cup tomatoes, sliced thickly | 1 can navy beans, drained | 1/2 cup bread, cut into cubes | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 package refrigerated pizza crusts, chilled
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir together tamarind paste, whipping cream, and tomatoes. In a separate bowl, stir together navy beans and bread cubes. Pour tomato sauce into a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Spread bean mixture evenly over a pizza crust. Spoon tomato sauce over the bean layer. Sprinkle with baking powder. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: white wine,onion salt,mozzarella cheese,asparagus spear,prosciutto,fast rising yeast,cider vinegar,chicken bouillon cube
title: Crazy Asparagus Rollatini
ingredients: 24 asparagus spears, trimmed | 12 slices prosciutto | 12 ounces fresh fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced in 1/2 inch slices | 12 slices fresh smoked salami ( or use salami ) | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules ( or to taste, i use instant no msg ) | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking sheet with parchment paper. Place asparagus spears on parchment and lightly flour. Place one slice of prosciutto, 1 slice of mozzarella, one slice of salami, and one slice of prosciutto in a row on the parchment. Roll up the asparagus spears and secure with toothpicks. Repeat until all the asparagus spears have been used. Spread each roll with the cider vinegar, chicken bouillon, white wine, onion salt, and remaining bread slices. Place on the prepared baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven 5 to 8 minutes or until golden brown on the tops. Cut in quarters to serve.

title: Citrus Fruit Salad (Karela) (Porraka)
ingredients: 500 g cassava ( cassava ) | 4 small mango chutney | cayenne | liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon vanilla or 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Peel the cassava, reserving the cassava for garnish. Cut it like fries but with the peel still on. Cut the chutney in chunks or small little squares. Cut the fruit into big chunks. Add spices, salt, pepper, mango chutney and liquid smoke to taste. Mix and serve as a first course with drinks for breakfast or for fancier desserts. Variation, for dessert, serve 1 cup of pure maple syrup or 1 cup of apple juice for each serving.

title: Fennel Shrimp and Orange Soup
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, halved, cored and thickly sliced | 6 medium shrimp - peeled, deveined, and sliced | 1 orange, juiced | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 1/4 teaspoons fennel seeds
instructions: Place the fennel bulb slices in a large pot over medium heat. Add shrimp, and orange juice, and season with tomato paste. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,baking potato,italian sausage,taco seasoning mix,vanilla soymilk,chive,lasagna noodle
title: Noodle-Sausage Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausage | 1 lb baking potato, peeled and diced | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 12 wonton wrappers | 3 cups low-fat vanilla-soymilk | 4 cups low-fat italian sausage ( may be substituted with a combination of both ) | 1/2 cup snipped fresh chives ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 375 degrees. Cook the sausage, potatoes, and taco seasoning in a large skillet over medium heat until the sausage is cooked through and the potatoes are soft, about 10 - 15 minutes. Spread 1/2 cup of the soymilk into a 9x13 casserole dish. Dip 1 wonton wrapper in the remaining 1/2 cup of soy milk and place it in the pan. Dip the edges of the wrapper in the milk to cover and place a second wrapper on top. Repeat until all the wrappers are used. Add 1/4 cup of the soy milk to the sausage mixture, and continue cooking over medium heat until the sauce is reduced by half, around 10 – 15 minutes. Mix the chives into the meat mixture. Scoop all of the meat and potato mixture into the prepared pan. Arrange the wonton wrappers over the meat mixture in an even layer. Pour the remaining soy milk over all of the pasta, and top with the last wonton wrapper. Cover the pan loosely with foil and bake until the dish is heated through, about 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Easy and Tasty cannellini Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( drain and rinse, add in juice ) | grated orange zest
instructions: Add the cannelini beans into a small soup pot. Add the orange zest and juice and heat on medium low, stirring frequently until the soup is hot but not boiling. Enjoy.

title: Rice Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 2 1/4 cups short-grain rice ( i used brown rice, but use what you like, like! ) | 1 1/4 cups plain flour | 1/4 - 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius & lightly grease 2 - 5 x 5 c fan forced ovens. Roughly chop the rice in to the flour. Put rice & shredded mozzarella in a bowl & mix. Add salt & gently stir in. Use your hands to roll mixture into ball, then flatten with a rolling pin. Roll out on a floured surface to a 7 inch round & press the edges slightly with your fingers again before popping into a non stick grated or oiled baking tin which has been sprayed a little with oil before adding the toppings, then bake for 15 - 20 mins or until puffed up & slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,cumin powder,red cabbage,navy bean,custard,pinto bean,guinness stout,semolina
title: Mexican Red Cabbage and Bean Salad
ingredients: 9 cups shredded red cabbage | 3 cups navy beans, cooked ( or can red kidney beans ) | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce ( or any good brand, i really like my tomato based sauce ) | 1 1/2 cups pinto beans, cooked | 1 -2 cup homemade cumin powder, heaping ( or use regular cumin ) | semolina | custard ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cumina and mix thoroughly. If the mixture looks too dry, add more water. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator with lid for up to 2 months. If too wet, add more semolina. If too dry, add more cabbage and/or bean filling. Refrigerate any leftover salad for about a week. Serve in bowls alongside a nice glass of cabernet sauvignon blanc and some hot cream. Note, if you are using a recipe for tomato based bean salad, you may refrigerate this salad for 1/2 hour before serving just to warm it up. If you are using dry beans, add just enough water in to come 1/2 the way up the side of the dish.

title: Beer Baked Reuben
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can sauerkraut | 10 roma ( plum ) tomatoes with green chilies, chopped and drained | 1 can salmon, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix together the cream of mushroom soup, sauerkraut, tomatoes with green chilies, and salmon in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven, uncovered, for 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,yukon gold potato,grape tomato,hard egg,crescent dinner,white cheese,vegetable bouillon granule,pork sausage
title: Easter Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 2 containers reduced-fat crescent dinner rolls | 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, cooked and diced | 1/2 lb hard-boiled egg, diced | 1/3 lb smoked pork sausage, grated | 2/3 cup low-fat white cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules, powder | 2 teaspoons vegetable bouillon granules, to taste | 1 1/2 cups grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: In a large skillet, cook potatoes in boiling water until tender, but not mushy.

title: Lavender Wine
ingredients: 24 fluid ounces white wine ( such as fendant ) | 2 tablespoons dry lavender | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | cayenne
instructions: Blend all or most of the ingredients and pour into a clean glass jar. Leave in the fridge for at least 3 weeks or up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,water artichoke heart,kidney bean,chinese rice wine,brown lentil,savory
title: Mennonite Rice and Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 cans of laver beans | 2 cans of laverkid beans | 5 ounces brown lentils | 1 tablespoon savory | 1/2 cup chinese rice wine or 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 cups water-packed artichoke hearts
instructions: Put the oil in the pot and when it just begins to shimmer up, add the beans and cook until they are golden brown. Add the lentils, savory and rice wine. Turn off the heat. Cover the pot and let the rice sit for an hour or so. You want the rice to be mushy. If this appears to be too dry, add more water. If it seems too dry, add more rice wine or vinegar. I do not recommend using a sweet rice. After an hour or two, stir well and add the artichoke hearts. Taste and add more savory if desired.

Random Ingredients: white bread,dijon mustard,soy sauce,cajun seasoning,vanilla extract,self raising flour
title: Grilled White BBQ Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 - 1 1/3 cup light soy sauce | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons white bread, crushed | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | cajun seasoning
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Gradually add soy sauce and mix thoroughly. Place bread in the mixture and pat into an 8 square or square pan. Sprinkle with cajun seasoning. Bake at 180 180oc for 35 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: sticky rice,red pepper,hot red chili pepper,basil,turnip,anchovy paste
title: Cali - Turnip Rice-A-Roni
ingredients: 1 small turnip | 1 -2 hot red chili pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 -2 tablespoon hot red pepper ( or less, depending on how much heat you like ) | 1/2 teaspoon basil | 1 cup sticky rice
instructions: Peel and chop turnip. Chop red chili and small hot peppers. Toss with anchovy paste and sweet red peppers. Cook slowly, stirring so as not to burn or burn on the bottom. Add rice. Turn heat so as rice doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan. Cook about 15 - 20 minutes, or until all the rice is well cooked. Serve warm note, you can add other vegetables to this, as carrots, mushrooms, cabbage, scallions serve hot. Note, i use the turnip with the same vegetables in the original recipe, and it is well liked. Variation, you can also use other vegetables that you like. I use carrots, and turnip cubes rather than the turnips or peppers. Note, the original recipe does not say this, but it is what is in the original recipe, so it is to your own personal palate. Note, if you make this in the conventional oven, then you will have to cook it in pressure cooker instead of frying.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Beer
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups water | 2 tablespoons dried yeast | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 3 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: Place ingredients in bread machine in order suggested by the manufacturer. Select dough setting or press start. Remove dough from bread machine when cycle is complete.

title: Grilled Kebabs With Smoked Salmon on the Grill
ingredients: 1/6 - 1/2 head of fresh kale ( can use a bun of frozen kale, thawed ) | 1 1/2 lbs smoked turkey ( i used left over cooked turkey pieces ) | 3 -4 lbs of your favorite lean ground lamb ( ( any ground meat will also work ) | 1 head of your favorite lean ground beef ( or ground chicken with a bit of jalapeno )
instructions: Wash your kale and spin off excess. Cut the kale into ribbons, approximately 1/4 inch wide. Cut the turkey into 1/4 to 1/2 inch pieces, about 3 inches long and 1/8 inch thick. Combine the turkey, kale, meat, and jalapenos in a bowl along with the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Set aside 2 tablespoons of each, rubbing your hands, into the meat mixture. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour or up to 8 hours. Take 1/2 cup of the mixture and press into a meatball shape, about 1/2 inch thick. Cook on a hot grill for 10 - 15 minutes per side depending on the grill heat. Serve with your choice of sides and asparagus. Or, if you want to save any leftovers, you can roll a handful of the leftover meat mixture in tinfoil and place in an ovenproof skillet/casserole dish or pie pan. Spread the remaining paste over the top and finish on the top. Note, if you want to serve it with pasta, heat 1 cup of water to boiling. Add the pasta and cook according to package. As mentioned, i cooked my pasta, which was already cooked. They cooked quickly and i served them hot. These meatball sandwiches freeze well too.

title: Chorizo and Baked Clementines
ingredients: 1 pound chorizo sausage, thinly sliced | 8 clementines, cored and sliced | 1/2 cup beef broth, or as needed | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking dish with waxed paper. Sprinkle chorizo slices in a circular motion onto the waxed paper, and set aside. Arrange clementines slices in a circular motion on the waxed paper. Layer the clementines into the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle chorizo slices over the clementines. Pour beef broth and dry mustard over the chorizo slices. Bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the chorizo has reached 165 degrees f, about 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Poblano Brunch Cake
ingredients: 1 package of cassava ( pumpkin ) | 24 cherry tomatoes | 3 poblano chiles ( roasted, peeled and sliced thinly ) | 2 lbs of crushed graham crackers ( or cracker ) | candied ginger ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the crushed graham crackers in a small bowl. Spread each slice of cassava with about 1 cup of crushed graham crackers. Spread 1/2 of each the cherry tomatoes and poblano chiles on each cassava slice so that they are close together in long strips like you would a cigarette. Spread one third of the chopped poblano chilies on the cassava slices, then top the filling with another layer of sliced cassava slices and place the tops on. Top with ginger if using. Bake at 375 degrees f for one hour and 10 minutes. Allow to cool. Eat. I prefer this toasted so it can be sliced and spread onto a piece of plastic wrap for a nice chew. Can also be served with spanish rice for a great lunch.

title: Pomegranate Salad With Orange
ingredients: 1 pomegranate syrup ( if no pomegranate syrup available, use 1 tsp. pure orange syrup.if using pomegranate syrup, omit this ingredient )
instructions: Stir sugar and pomegranate syrup together until well blended and pomegranate syrup is absorbed. Serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy One-Pot Salmon
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet | 2 ounces ham, sliced | 1 tablespoon sugar free catsup | 2 fluid ounces heavy cream
instructions: Place the pan on a stovetop, and bring to the boil. When it looks like it's just turning slightly blonde, take it off the stove. Meanwhile, heat a skillet on high heat. Place the salmon fillet in the pan, and cook until it is just cooked through, and beginning to flake it.

title: Truffles
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg spareribs ( single single bones ) | 1 tablespoon arrowroot | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 package instant vanilla pudding | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( corn starch is healthier ) | 1 tablespoon creme de cassis ( optional ) | seasoning
instructions: Make a wash in a sink that will accommodate clean cold water. Place the spareribs in the solution. Use a meat mallet to hit the side of your bone, pound the spareribs to a thickness of 1 inch, pound them slightly. This allows for easier, tenderizing of the meat. Heat up the oven to 220 deg c/440 deg f/gas. Mix the arrowroot with the turmeric in a small bowl. Dip the spareribs in the arrowroot and place them in the hot oven. Fry them at 200 deg c/400 deg f for 3 to 4 minutes or until they are brown on the outside. Turn the meat around in the oven, adding more oil as needed if necessary. Remove from the oven, spread crème de cacao on the spareribs, scatter over a few drops of creme de cacao. Return to the oven, bake for 10 - 15 minutes until the crème de cacao has melted. Leave to stand for 5 minutes before removing and placing on a warmed platter. Sprinkle with creme de cacao mix to serve.

title: Radishing Egg Mayonnaise- Substitute (For Deviled Eggs)
ingredients: 8 egg yolks | 2/3 cup radish, sliced in rounds ( about 6 radish buds ) | 2 teaspoons lemon zest
instructions: Place the egg yolks in a medium saucer and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, add the radish buds and stir to remove their liquid. Once the radish buds have softened, remove with a slotted spoon and place into a bowl of ice water to halt the cooking process. Drain and place in the sink. Cover the egg yolks with the cold water in an ice cream maker, and keep the motor running. With the machine running, add the radishes in small batches and keep them until they are all desired consistency. When the radishes are complete, remove with a slotted spoon and place in the bowl of ice water. Place the egg yolks and lemon zest into a small bowl and mix well. Scoop the egg mixture onto plates and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rack baby back pork rib,anise seed
title: Italian Grilled Ribs
ingredients: 2 racks of baby-back pork ribs | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed
instructions: Lightly coat the ribs lightly with oil. Sprinkle the anise seed over each rack of ribs. Place on a grill rack and cook until very dark brown, about 4 minutes per side.

title: Mexican Parsnips
ingredients: 5 parsnips, peeled and cut about 5 mm thick
instructions: Wrap the parsnips with aluminum foil and heat them in a pan to boiling and simmer for 10 minutes or till tender. Cool, then peel and mash. Fill a pan with boiling water and bring to a boil over medium heat. Add the drained parsnips. Remove the foil, add the lime juice to it, and serve.

title: Kraut and Salami
ingredients: 36 slices salami | 1 jar sauerkraut, drained and mashed | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Arrange salami slices on a cookie sheet. Combine the sauerkraut and cracker crumbs in a small bowl. Spread the rue onto the salami slices. Cover with the remaining salami slices. Spray a 9x9 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Refrigerate overnight for best results. Slice and serve.

title: Crock Pot Cojita Chicken
ingredients: 4 -5 boneless chicken drumsticks | 1 can green chilies | 1 lb cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Place drumsticks in a crock pot. Spread chiles on chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Pour remaining sauce over chicken. Cook on high for 4 to 6 hours or low for 8 to 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: tamarind juice,rhubarb,chili,ricotta cheese,green bean,cumin seed,rice noodle,water
title: Rhubarb and Ricotta Hot Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs rhubarb | 1 package rice noodles | 12 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup chopped green beans | 14 ounces tamarind juice | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 whole chili | 2 cups water
instructions: Cut rhubarb into 1 inch pieces. Boil in lightly salted water until thouroughly tender, about 40 minutes. Reserve rhubarb water. Drain and reserve liquid. Chop rhubarb, discarding tough ends. Cut remaining rhubarb into 1 inch pieces. Place in large bowl. Add rice noodles and stir to coat. Cover with very hot water and set aside for 15 minutes. Drain well and spread over rice noodle mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and let stand for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,watermelon,date,ra el hanout spice mix,pine nut,prosciutto,tart cherry,white pepper
title: Date and Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 4 tart cherries | 4 seedless watermelon pears, halved, pitted, cored, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices | 12 slices prosciutto, thick slices cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1 -2 tablespoon chocolate syrup | 1 -2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 pinch white pepper | 1/2 - 3/4 cup pine nuts, toasted ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped toasted pine nuts, toasted in a dry pan ( optional )
instructions: Place cherry halves, pears, and proscuitto onto the cut side of a large platter. Arrange prosciutto on top. Add wine or beer, chocolate syrup, and spices to the bowl. Toss gently to coat evenly. Divide mixture evenly among the 4 platter.

title: Quick Red Snapper
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skinned red snapper fillets | 1/3 cup shredded unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/3 cup cream cheese
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the snapper. Dust the snapper with the cocoa powder. Grill or grill over high heat 3 minutes on each side for medium rare. Let flake with a fork and remove.

title: Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 1/2 lb golden raisins, soaked in water | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Place raisins in a bowl, cover with cold water, and let drain until no longer saturated.

title: Homemade Salmon “Grilled Salmon ”
ingredients: 1 packet ouzo ( greek dressing ) | 1 salmon, cut into pieces | 1/4 teaspoon smoked savory | 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon peas, or as needed
instructions: Combine ouzo and salmon in a bowl.

title: Jim's Baked Jalapenos
ingredients: 6 whole jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup spanish rum or 1/4 cup rum | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place peppers in a shallow baking dish. Combine creme fraiche, rum, and baking soda in a small bowl. Sprinkle mixture evenly over peppers. Bake 20 minutes or until peppers are tender. Sprinkle with cilantro before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,chicken stock,barbecue sauce,catsup,half,flat bread,grain rice,lavender honey
title: Quick Honey Chicken With Rice and Lavender
ingredients: 6 skinless chicken thighs | 4 tablespoons unsalted chicken stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons basil and flat-leaf parsley dry-leaf marjoram seasoning blend | 1 tablespoon lavender honey, plus additional | lavender honey | 1 tablespoon catsup | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1/4 cup hot barbecue sauce | flat bread
instructions: Preheat oven to in a small bowl, combine chicken with marjoram, honey and catsup.

title: Pear Soup
ingredients: 4 medium pears | 4 1/2 cups cooked catfish
instructions: Remove peel off pears and dice the pears. Boil 5 cups water. Put the pears, 3 1/2 cups soup, and fish in the 6 and mash with a potato masher or fork. Cook 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pod cardamom,tamari,sazon goya con culantro y achiote,gingerroot,red chili powder,salmon,broccoli floret
title: Tikil Fish in Broccoli and Carrots
ingredients: 6 ounces salmon, with bones, skinned | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder | 2 teaspoons sazon goya con culantro y achiote | 1 pod cardamom | 1 pinch ground gingerroot | 5 1/4 cups broccoli florets | 3/4 cup tamari
instructions: Place the salmon in a heat proof dish. Sprinkle on the chili powder, sazon, cardamom, ginger, and 1 cup of water. Cover with plastic wrap and plastic wrap and put something lid on the pan. Steam for 15 minutes or until the salmon is opaque. Remove the fish and wrap it in a piece of foil. Steam for another 15 minutes or until cooked through. Meanwhile, cook the broccoli until tender and drain. Drain the vegetables and set aside. In a saucepan over low heat, combine the tamari and 1 cup water and bring to a boil. Stir in the vegetables and cook for about 5 minutes or until heated through. To serve, plate and drizzle with tamari sauce. Goes well with basmati or jasmine rice.

title: Asian Beef and Rice Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1 can canned chili peppers, in liquid | 1/2 cup seasoned rice vinegar ( n'substitute, not white vinegar )
instructions: Spray slow cooker with cooking spray. Place meat in slow cooker.

title: Homemade Exported Vegemite Biscuits
ingredients: 12 ounces vegemite | 24 small fresh ancho chilies ( or substitute 1 teaspoon dried chile powder )
instructions: Open the oven on its own. Place the ancho chilies on a cutting board. Place them on the cutting board with the side of a cleaver as close to the blades of a knife as possible. Do this 2 or 3 times, moving around with the blade until the chilies and blades of a knife come out with the same thickness of anise. Remove the chilies using a flat bladed spatula. If the chilies are not very close in size, add ancho chile powder to the remaining 3 ounces of ancho chile powder. Heat one biscuit in the microwave for 2 or 3 seconds on high, until it is pliable. Remove the biscuit from the microwave and use the biscuit to shape the other biscuit. Place on a greased wire rack and refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Hazelnut Strawberries
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh strawberries, hulled | salt and pepper | 4 tablespoons hazelnuts, finely grated
instructions: Combine the hulled strawberries and salt, pepper and enough ice water to cover. Mix well and remove rinds from strawberries with sharp knife. Add hazelnuts and toss to combine.

title: Watermelon Pastries
ingredients: 100 g watermelon, cut in half, cored and sliced | 1 tablespoon cream cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup bread flour | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod, cracked | 2 teaspoons water
instructions: In a bowl mix together the watermelon, cream cheese and bread flour. Stir in the cardamom pods. Divide into 8 equal portions and shape them into round, flat cakes. Heat oil in a frying pan and fry cakes until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: thyme,yellow onion,green chilies,green pea,beer,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Mexican Green Peppers and Cheese
ingredients: 4 medium yellow onions, sliced thin | 2 cans whole green chilies, cut into 1 inch pieces ( about 10 oz ) | 2 teaspoons dried thyme or 1 tablespoon fresh thyme | 12 ounces shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 cup frozen green pea | 1/3 cup beer ( or enough to cover cheese )
instructions: Place onion slices and green chilies in non stick skillet. Sprinkle with thyme, cover and cook and stir on medium until lightly browned 2 to 3 minutes or until softened. Sprinkle cheese over chilies, cover and heat over medium heat until melted. Spread mixture evenly in skillet. Stir in pea mixture and pour on beer. Cover and cook over medium low heat until heated through 4 - 5 minutes. Cover and cook for 2 minutes more or until heated through.

title: Spicy Italian Sausages and Fruit (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon gelatin | 2 cups pineapple, cubed | 4 cups bulk italian sausage, chopped | 1 cup cornflour
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over pineapple in a bowl. Sprinkle sausages onto gelatin. In a saucepan, simmer sausage in boiling water until soft. Drain excess grease from sausage. Sprinkle gelatin over sausage and set aside. In a medium size saucepan, melt cornflour in a little water. Add gelatin mixture and stir until well combined. Cook over gentle heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir through hot sausage. Leave to stand for 15 minutes.

title: Cajun Chipped Dust
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds coarsely chopped sausage ( i prefer johnsonville ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seed | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped mustard seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the sausage, 1/2 teaspoon mustard seed, ground cayenne pepper, and 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped mustard seed. Shape into 1 inch thick rounds. Coat an 11x12 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Transfer chipped, round side up, to baking dish, placing baking dish near rim of dish. Cover dish with plastic wrap, and gently push chipped topping into side of chipped stuff. Cook in preheated oven until sausage coating is no longer pink, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,milk ricotta cheese,tortilla,cardamom seed,cherry,apple,white onion
title: Parmigiana Chicken Filled With Yogurt
ingredients: 300 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 150 g cherry tomatoes ( red ) | 3/4 cup chopped white onion | 3/4 cup sliced white onion | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed, crushed | 12 tortillas or 12 pita wraps | 1 cup diced chicken breast ( frozen )
instructions: Mix together the ricotta and yogurt. Set aside. Preheat your oven to 350°f. Layer the tortillas first in your baking dish on a clean workspace, then fill into the dish with yogurt. Top all the torillas with the cheese on top. Next, layer everything before putting in the oven. Bake approximately 2 hours until done. Serve with chips and salad.

title: Baked Bean and Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 3 pieces pepperoni | 2 teaspoons sweet pepper | 2 teaspoons coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line two large baking cups with foil. Put 3 slices of pepperoni on foil and top with cannellini beans. Sprinkle pepperoni and 1 teaspoons coconut. Repeat with remaining ingredients, and put on baking sheet. Bake until heated through and cheese melts about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,rice flour,bean sprout,coffee granule,red wine,san marzano tomato,ketchup,vanilla
title: Instant Mojo Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups instant rice flour ( can be bought already cooked and seasoned ) | 1/2 cup ketchup or 1/2 cup other jam, your choice | 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules or 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 cans san marzano tomatoes, strained | 1/3 cup red wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in the instant coffee granules or coffee granules. Stir in well and set aside to chill in the fridge for an hour. For best results, chill the beans for an hour or two before serving. Serve with bread or as a snack. Note, i have seen other brands of bean sprouts that have been mis stirred, added, stirred, etc.

title: Sausage With Baked Yogurt
ingredients: 4 -6 small sausages | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1 pint vanilla ice cream | 2 tablespoons yogurt
instructions: For the sausages, cut each sausage into four pieces, lengthwise. Put in a small saute pan with the vinegar. Cook gently over medium, until most of the liquid goes away. Meanwhile, warm the yogurt in a small pan. Drain the sausages. Add them to the yogurt and coat well with the yogurt. Place on a cookie sheet and bake at 150c/300f for 20 minutes, turning occasionally. They will get browns on the underside. When ready to serve, place the sausages on a serving platter and pour the hot yogurt on top.

title: Quick Vietnamese Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can navy beans, drained | 3 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine navy beans with fish sauce. Mix well. Cover and chill 2 hours.

title: German Charred Bacon
ingredients: 1 slice bacon | 1 maraschino cherry
instructions: Cook bacon in a frying pan on medium high heat until it starts to brown. Add cherry, cover and let it steam about 10 minutes. Watch carefully to make sure it doesn't burn. Slice into thin strips. These can also be stored in freezer bags and eaten right away. It's all a personal choice enjoy.

title: Maryland Style Crab Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 package lump crabmeat - drained and cartilage removed | 1 can refried beans | 1/2 cup ranch dressing, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix the cream celery soup, crabmeat, colby cheese, and ranch dressing together in a bowl. Transfer bean mixture to a 2x9 inch glass baking dish. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven.

title: Chinese Fried Beans Sprouts
ingredients: 4 cups bean sprouts | 2/3 cup shortening
instructions: Cut bean sprouts in thin strips. Melt shortening over medium heat in large heavy skillet. Add sprouts.

title: Hungarian Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb meatballs | 4 fluid ounces lemon or 4 fluid ounces lime juice | 300 ml beef stock | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 7 tablespoons double cream, warmed
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Heat a little oil in a frying pan on the hob. Add meatballs and cook until browned all over. Turn the meatballs so they brown evenly all around while cooking. Place meatballs and any meat juices that have collected in the crockpot into a casserole dish. Add remaining ingredients and stir well. Cook in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve with pumpernickel loaf bread, spaetzle or rye pumpernickel.

Random Ingredients: butter,soy sauce,gravy,arugula leaf,vegetable stock,maraschino cherry,mexican cheese
title: Cheesy Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb top-round steak ( or other inexpensive steak and cut into 1/2-inch slices ) | 8 -10 large salad leaves | 1/2 cup leftover gravy, warmed | 8 teaspoons sour butter, divided | 8 slices mexican blend cheese ( about 1/2-inch thick ) | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | maraschino cherry, garnish
instructions: In a 9x13 inch baking dish, scatter the mushroom slices over. Pour the warmed butter over all and set a small plate to hold the warm pieces of meat. Layer half the the cheese slices over the mushrooms and top with the remaining cheese, making 4 sandwiches. Heat the sandwich maker. Brush the sandwiches evenly with about 1 t. Of the butter.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,pea,mushroom,orange zest,rotel tomato,avocado,gouda cheese,maple syrup
title: Mushroom, Avocado, and Gouda Grilled Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 6 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 teaspoons orange zest, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 2 cups sliced mushrooms | 1 cup frozen cooked peas | 1/2 cup shredded gouda cheese | 1 firm ripe avocado, peeled and sliced into 1/4-inch slices | 6 large slices roasted sweet gouda cheese
instructions: Brush 2 tablespoons maple syrup on grate of grill. Sprinkle with orange zest evenly over grate. Grill until orange zest begins to lightly brown in 10 inch ovenproof skillet over medium high heat, 3 or 4 minutes per side. Transfer skillet to oven and spray it with nonstick cooking spray. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons maple syrup in skillet over medium high heat until shimmering, about 1 minute. Add mushrooms and sauté until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir peas into mushrooms and sprinkle with cheeses. Transfer skillet to oven and bake until cheese melts, about 10 minutes more. Cut avocado into 1/4 inch slices and serve with remaining 2 tablespoons maple syrup.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,phyllo pastry,asafoetida powder,onion salt,raspberry,vanilla,baby spinach
title: Roasted Asafetida-Raspberry Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 12 sheets filo pastry, thawed | 1 package frozen fresh baby spinach, thawed | 1 medium onion, chopped | 3/4 cup fresh raspberries | 2/3 cup unsweetened vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/8 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine caraway and 1 1/2 teaspoons water.

title: Cajun Style Red Beans
ingredients: 500 g red kidney beans ( drained ) | 2 lbs pancetta ( diced ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon yeast | 6 teaspoons vodka | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 -2 cup alfredo sauce
instructions: Rinse and clean the beans, throw away bad ones. Place the beans into a container of plenty of water and let stand, or leave for up to half an hour. Drain the beans. Fry the pancetta in a pan until it's crispy and the fat has run out. Remove and set it aside. You can leave the fat in the pan, or turn the heat to very low. Sprinkle the cornflour over the pancetta and fry for 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Drain the beans and add to the pan. Add vodka, cayenne pepper, and yeast extract. Mix and cook another 2 - 3 minutes, or until mixture is spongy. Turn heat to high, and cook for 5 - 7 minutes. Taste to see if it's right for you. Tip, make sure you don't let the liquid boil. If you've tried to thicken the sauce with a cornflour and vodka mixture, that's why the yeast didn't activate correctly. Pour the sauce over the beans in the pan. Add a little bit of your favourite alfredo sauce and stir well. Turn the heat down and let stand for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Teriyaki Baked Beets (Beetroot)
ingredients: 2 large beets | 3 tablespoons dry, chopped or canola oil, for grilling | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried red sage | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns | 1 cup cold water | 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce | pimiento ( garnishment ) ( optional )
instructions: To grill beets, preheat grill. Cut off peel. Cut beets crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Set the beets whole at top of a piece of reynolds aluminum foil and add the stem end, stem ends side down. Sprinkle beetroot with salt and pepper or add salt and pepper to taste. Tie with kitchen string. Grill, turning with tongs, beets occasionally, until they begin to blacken on the edges, about 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels, and cool to room temperature. When cool, slit beets vertically into 1/8 inch thick rounds. Preheat broiler. Place beets on oiled broiler pan or rack and broil on topside until beets blacken on the edges and beginning to char, about 10 minutes. Turn beets over. Brush beets with remaining oil and sprinkle with dried red chilis, black peppercorns, and enough cold water to cover. Broil, uncovered, until beets are blackened, 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from broiler. To cook on oven rack, preheat oven to 450°f remove beets with tongs and place on the baking sheet. Put baking sheet under the broiler for a few minutes to brown the tops. Turn beetroots and baste with oil. Continue cooking and turning beetroot until all sides are nicely charred and tender, about 15 minutes more. Transfer beets to a baking dish and tent loosely with aluminum foil. Bake beets for 45 - 60 minutes, or until the juices from the beetroot have begun leaving the beetroot. Let stand 10 minutes in a bowl of iced water, drain well. When beets are cool enough to handle, peel and carefully grate into beetroots with a hand grater. Serve hot. For a dipping sauce, heat canola oil in a sauce pan over medium heat. Add in the onions and saute, stirring, until onions are pale translucent, about 4 minutes. Add in the sage, peppercorns, and salt and pepper to taste. Reduce heat to low and add teriyaki sauce, stirring until sauce is heated through. Serve in bowl, garnished with chopped pimiento.

title: Easy Lemon Rice Noodles - Fast!
ingredients: 3 3 cups rice noodles or 3 cups spaghetti | 1 1/2 3 1/2 cups lemonade or 1 1/2 cups lemon liqueur
instructions: Put all of this in a sauce pan. Put on low heat for 10 minutes stir often so rice noodles don't stick. Let cool. Note, if you like a thicker sauce like a little bit of sugar, add some water or cornstarch until this time you need to cook it.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,pork sparerib,icing sugar,ice,yellow bell pepper,maple syrup
title: Maple Fried Spareribs
ingredients: 6 ounces pork spareribs, cut into 1-inch-thick pieces | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1-inch squares ( optional ) | 1 cup crushed ice
instructions: Add 1 1/2 cups of water to a large skillet and bring to a boil. Add the pork and maple syrup, stirring to coat. Remove from heat and allow to cool. In a small bowl, combine the icing sugar and oyster sauce and spoon a quarter of this sauce over each rib. Place on a plate and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving. Remove ribs from the refrigerator one hour before frying. Heat an oiled and seasoned griddle or heavy skillet. Test one piece of pork for medium doneness with a slotted spoon, brushing with some of the maple syrup mixture, for 1 minute on each side, or until golden brown. Spoon remaining sauce over ribs, sprinkle with a little more icing sugar, and serve.

title: Chinese Bread
ingredients: 3 slices rye bread, cut 1in thick | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: Spread chili sauce on both sides of each slice of bread. Place slice between plastic wrap and place under a hot grill for 3 mins, or until crisp and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,self raising flour,celery,salmon fillet
title: Scarfies (A Summer Treat) - Salmon & Celery Scones
ingredients: 1 kg self raising flour | 200 g cooked salmon fillet, chopped | 4 stalks celery, chopped finely | green food coloring
instructions: Pre heat oven to 220°c. In a bowl sieve flour. Add salmon, stirring to get well mixed, and season with a green and white food colouring of your choice. Knead mixture well. Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface. Cut into 2 3cm rounds with a pizza cutter and place on a lightly greased oven tray. Brush tops with a little melted butter as you join dough together so that it will bake up in the oven. Turn over when base is golden, and cook for about 8 - 11 minutes. Serve cold or hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray,cannellini bean,onion soup mix
title: Quick and Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( can use canola or other spray ) | 1 box dry onion soup mix | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Heat oven to heat oil, soup mix and beans over medium heat. Stir frequently as soup mixes will tend to burn during cooking. Mix the beans and soup mix in a 5 x 11 inch pan sprayed liberally with cooking spray. Bake 25 minutes or until bubbly. Mix cannelini beans and tomato sauce in a bowl. Stir until dissolved.

title: Pine Nut-Potted Beef for Two (Puerto Rican-American)
ingredients: 1/2 lb top round, diced into 1/4 inch cubes | 16 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup pine nuts, coarsely crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl except for cheese. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add beef and toss until evenly coated. Transfer beef to a baking sheet lined with waxed paper. Spread pine nuts on a baking sheet and toast until brown and fragrant, about 12 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Duck Breast Au Jus
ingredients: 4 duck breast ( the skin is the bottom of the breast ) | 5 white pearl onions, peeled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Place a duck breast on the flat part of the breast and cut off the skin and around the breasts to a 1 1/2 inch thickness. Slice the breasts into 1 inch pieces, and arrange around the breasts. Wrap the pearl onions around the pieces and place on a baking sheet with a well fitting lid. Roast for 20 minutes. Reduce the heat to 325°f and roast for an further 20 minutes until the duck is cooked and the juices run clear.

title: The Irish Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups red lentils, rinsed and picked over | 2 cups iceberg lettuce, torn into bite size pieces | 2 cans solid white tuna, drained | 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 2 cans sliced jalapeno peppers, drained | 1 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Combine the lentils and enough water to cover in a saucepan over medium high heat. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Stir in the lettuce, tuna, whiskey, and jalapenos. Heat through, and gently stir in the shredded cheese in 1/3 of the hot mixture. Serve warm.

title: Cherry Chili Catfish
ingredients: 2 fillets catfish | 1 can hominy, drained | 1/2 cup crouton | fresh hot pepper ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons caster sugar
instructions: Put catfish and hominy into large pan and bring to boil.. Simmer for about 20 minutes or more until catfish is cooked. Sprinkle with croutons, peppers and sugar. Serve with hot tortillas, corn chips or other favorite accompaniments.

title: Cauliflower & Chocolate Bark
ingredients: 2 medium roma tomatoes, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3/4 lb mexican blend cheese, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3/4 lb cauliflower, cut into 1/2 to 3/4 inch florets, cut crosswise into 1 1/2 inch lengths | 1 teaspoon mexican chili powder | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, coarsely grated
instructions: Arrange tomato slices on rimmed baking sheet, then sprinkle with cheese. Bake, covered, at 375 for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted, stirring and turning dish halfway through cooking. Sprinkle with chili powder, toss to coat. Sprinkle with chocolate.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,purpose flour,puff pastry,beef brisket,port wine,vanilla,coconut milk
title: Beef Coconut Brisket
ingredients: 1 1/3 tablespoons peanut oil | 8 ounces beef brisket, trimmed of all visible fat and cut into 2 - 3 inch cubes | 6 ounces coconut milk | 6 tablespoons port wine or 6 tablespoons merlot | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 12 ounces frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the brisket, and fry until lightly browned on all sides, about 3 minutes. Transfer the brisket to a plate and set aside. Add the coconut milk to the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping to loosen any bits of food stuck to the bottom of the pan, and scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Add the port wine or merlot, and reduce for about 1 minute. Sprinkle on the flour and vanilla and return the brisket to the skillet. Simmer, uncovered, over low heat until the brisket is tender, about 3 - 4 hours, basting and stirring halfway through. Remove from the heat. Cool before slicing.

title: Nam Jim
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen spinach leaves, microwaved, and strained | 1 small purple onion, finely chopped | 1 green chili, sliced into small squares | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 1 g brandy | 2 tablespoons dry crushed green chili
instructions: Put the spinach with the onion, green chili, tamarind paste and brandy in a bowl. Mix well using your hands. Cover, and keep aside to marinate for 15 minutes at room temperature. Heat the same for 1 minute. Pour the marinade evenly over the spinach.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,herb,iceberg lettuce,blue curacao,onion soup mix,italian parsley,lardons
title: Steak Roll Ups (Lola)
ingredients: 1 can condensed onion soup mix | 1/4 cup blue curacao | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley or 1/4 cup regular parsley | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 12 tablespoons lardons or 12 tablespoons bacon drippings, divided | 12 leaves iceberg lettuce ( about 8 oz each ) | chopped fresh herb ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine soup mix, curacao, herbs and beef. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or up to 3 days. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before roll ups. Heat 1 tablespoon lard or bacon drippings in 12 inch nonstick skillet over high heat until just smoking, about 30 seconds. Stir fry meat until browned on all sides, about 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from skillet and keep warm. Repeat procedure with remaining lardons or bacon drippings. Arrange lettuce leaves on baking sheet and drizzle with soup mixture. Place meat on top of lettuce. Sprinkle with cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,salsa verde,parmigiano reggiano cheese,peach,pancetta,white fish fillet
title: Prawn and Peach in Creamy Pesto
ingredients: 400 g shrimp, with shells | 400 g white fish fillets | 500 g peaches, halved, skinned, sliced finely | 60 g pancetta, sliced | 60 ml water chestnut salsa verde | 50 g parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shaved
instructions: Shell the prawns with the tails left on, then remove the meat from the head and heads using kitchen scissors or a large knife.

title: Beef Stew (Simmered)
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 cups fresh asparagus, cut up | 8 tablespoons baking soda
instructions: Cut beef, asparagus pieces into lengths approximately 2 1/2 inches long. Put into colander. Drain well, place in a bowl. Remove all solids except one tablespoon of the cooking liquid. Cut off any remaining beef chunks. Place a heavy skillet over high heat. When it is hot enough to smell burning, add half of the meat, brown. Add asparagus and the rest of the cooking liquid. Simmer for an additional 20 minutes. Turn off heat. Allow to stand for 15 minutes.

title: Vegetables in Spicy Semolina
