ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons yellow squash ( roasted or pre-pilled variety ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons white onion, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon semolina | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Preheat oven to 300ºf and line baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine all the above ingredients in a blender. With the motor set on high speed add the semolina and turmeric powder and blend mixture for 3 - 4 seconds. Scrape mixture into a small bowl and let sit until cool. Place in an airtight container and give a giftcard. Note, this recipe can also be made with red squash, yellow squash, orange squash, pepigia or all three sweet squash varieties.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,pickling salt,grain white rice,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Perfect Microwave Rice
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 4 cups long grain white rice or 4 cups short-grain brown rice, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup pickling salt ( optional ) | vegetable oil cooking spray, for a large microwave oven
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 9x5 or 6 cup microsafe casserole dish, cover and microwave on high 8 minutes, stirring halfway through. Transfer to a serving bowl. Cover and vent 24 inches of hot water in microwave. Microwave on high 12 minutes, stirring halfway through. If rice is getting too dark before all the water is absorbed, cover loosely with foil to prevent over cooking.

title: Grilled Sausages With Radish and Kimbe (Sausages for Canning)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh kielbasa, trimmed and cut crosswise into 12 pieces | 1 1/2 lbs daikon radishes, peeled and cut crosswise into 12 pieces | 3 fresh juniper berries, smashed | 2 tablespoons corn niblets ( optional )
instructions: Pierce sausage all over with a fork. Prepare grill. Add sausage on rack. Place over medium heat. Grill until meat is brown on all sides, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cut radish lengthwise into 6 thin slices. Cut slices crosswise into 12 slices 3/4 inch thick. Place radish slices on grill over medium heat. Cook, turning once, until lightly charred, about 10 minutes. Spread on paper towels to drain excess grease. Remove sausage from grill. Combine salt with corn niblets.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,lukewarm milk,lime peel,plain flour,prosciutto,white breadcrumb
title: Grilled Vietnamese Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup lukewarm skim milk | 4 slices prosciutto | 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded, finely sliced | 1/2 lime, cut into 6 wedges | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 2 tablespoons white breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped lime peel
instructions: Warm up the milk in a small bowl and set aside. Place the prosciutto, bell pepper and lime in a medium bowl. Toast the breadcrumbs in a preheated medium sized griddle on a medium heat, using just enough to moisten them. Place in a bowl and use a spoon to break the bread into smaller pieces. Remove from the bowl and toss with the breadcrumbs. Sprinkle on the lime peel and serve with the warm milk.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,aubergine,fennel seed,orange zest,provolone cheese,quinoa,lemon zest
title: Aubergine Gratinee
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemons or 1 tablespoon orange zest, grated fresh | 4 teaspoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1/2 cup finely diced aubergine | 1/2 cup finely diced frizz provolone cheese | 2 teaspoons finely grated orange zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked quinoa
instructions: Rinse the cooked aubergine well under running water. Drain. Place aubergines, frizzarella cheese, orange zest, fennel seed and orange zest in a small bowl. Toss quinoa with lemon or orange juice to moisten. Store in the fridge until ready to serve. Drain all but 1 tablespoon of the cheese water from the bowl. Add the cheese water to the mixture, and stir thoroughly. Serve the salad cold accompanied by chunks of the cooled quinoa. Note, alternatively, the grains can be left in the bowl in a warm room until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: mango powder,green bell pepper,ghee,pearl barley,beef broth
title: Barley Beef-Stuffed Pricks
ingredients: 32 pearl barley | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1/4 cup diced green bell pepper | 2 cups beef broth ( preferably beef flavoured ) | 2 tablespoons mango powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Drain the pearl barley from the rinsed bag and discard any damaged or damaged grains, barley and/or barley bits. Using a mortar and pestle mash the pearl barley with the ghee and ground green bell pepper until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stuff some of the mixture into each prick's cavity with some of the mixture. Set in a roasting pan or dutch oven. Mix beef broth with mango powder and pour over the pricks. Season with black pepper and paprika. Bake for 3 to 5 hours, basting once more when pricks are tender.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,gelatin,part mozzarella cheese,mozzarella cheese,celery rib,lime juice
title: Mangorian Chicken Bundles
ingredients: 300 g shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 150 g shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 150 g shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon gelatin | 1 lime, juice of | 3 teaspoons gelatin | 3 celery ribs | 1 cup snow peas
instructions: Dissolve 1 tbsp gelatin in 3 tbsp boiling water, then pour over the mozzarella and mozzarella to coat. Dissolve 1 tbsp gelatin and 1 tsp gelatin in another cup of boiling water. Bring to the boil, then remove from the heat. Sprinkle with a mixture of the mozzarella and gelatin. Chill in the refrigerator for 15 minutes. Unwrap the celery, then slice in half width ways. Spread a layer of gelatin onto a cold flat plate, then sprinkle with a little of the carrot for garnishing. Put a layer of snow prawns on the base, then with a layer of the chicken. Drizzle with a little of the lime juice and cover with the mozzarella and mozzarella and smooth out the layer with the mozzarella again. Cut the remaining mozzarella into small, even sized cubes. Spread cheese over top of the cheeses and top with the remaining carrot, snowpeas and bamboo sticks. Chill until firm, around 45 minutes or longer. Turn onto a cutting board and slice into small pieces about 25 x 4 cm. Arrange on a foil covered baking sheet. Place in the freezer for around 15 - 20 minutes until soft and set.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,chili powder,carrot,star anise,ice water,five spice powder
title: Frozen Vegetables
ingredients: 300 -400 g frozen whole carrots | 1 small onion soup mix | 1/3 cup five-spice powder | 1/2 tablespoon chili powder | 1 star anise | 2 cups ice water
instructions: Thaw the frozen mixed vegetables. Slice the onion and put it in a small sauce pan with just enough water to cover the onion. Bring to a boil and add the dry onion soup envelope, five spice and chilli powder. Add the star anise. Cut the carrot into rounds or pieces and add them to the pan with the dry onion soup. Put the ice in a pot and cover to keep on a rolling boil. After 3 min or if your microwave starts to run at 4 min 1, cook on high for 6 min or if your microwave is at 5 min 1. The mixture should get brownish on top and thicken a bit in the 10 minute period. Put the vegetables on a hot plate and serve them with the rest of the dry onion soup envelope and plain yogurt on the side.

title: Low Fat Nuoc Leo's
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, softened | 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Combine butter, splenda, and sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Form into balls. Roll in extra Splenda.

title: Gobayh
ingredients: 1/2 cup sultana raisin | 1/2 cup mixed carrots, grated | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 cup couscous
instructions: Combine sultana and mixed carrots, mustard and couscous in a heavy medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until couscous is tender, about 4 minutes. Stir through raisins and serve.

title: Fajitas Chips
ingredients: 1 package tempeh, sliced into very thin strips | 1 package tortillas
instructions: To make the fajitas chips, spread the tempeh strips onto the toasted side of each tortilla and roll up. Cook in a dry skillet on medium heat for approximately 10 minutes or until warm.

title: Sirloin Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1 chicken stock cube, dissolved in | 3 -4 tablespoons warm water
instructions: Rinse mushrooms thoroughly, dry with a paper towel. Chop fine. Mix and use as required.

title: Piri Piri Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 small white onion | 1/4 teaspoon coriander
instructions: Finely chop the onion. Crush coriander in the mortar with a pestle and add to the minced onion. Blend this with your hands in a bowl with plenty of juice. Pour through a strainer to remove any residue of coriander. Cool before storing in a glass jar with a cap.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,arborio rice,savoy cabbage,ginger garlic paste,pine nut,chili sauce,ladyfinger,flour
title: Rice & Cauliflower Risotto With Pine Nuts and Chilies
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, cut into florets | 150 g arborio rice or 150 g short-grain rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 - 1 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 200 g savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 package ladyfingers, split | 1/2 cup fresh shaved savoy cabbage, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Place rice in a large saucepan and cover with boiling water, add 1 tablespoon of flour and set on a lid to keep water hot. Add ginger garlic paste and chilli sauce to the rice. Leave uncovered for 5 minutes then drain well. Bring a pot of water to the boil and add half of the rice and cauliflower florets. Boil for 2 minutes then drain, then quickly add the cabbage to the water in the pan and stir well. Cover lid and bring back to the boil then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 mins, stirring every 10 mins or so for even cooking. Place the shrimp in a bowl or serving cup and keep hot. To serve, spread the rice and cauliflower on plates. Arrange the ladyglasses on top. Scatter with shaved savoy cabbage and drizzle with sweet chilli sauce.

title: Onion Dip,  for the Microwave
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese | 4 tablespoons finely chopped sweet onions
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well with a fork. Serve with assorted crackers.

Random Ingredients: lima bean,marjoram,green chili pepper,cayenne pepper,teriyaki sauce,mint
title: Green Chile & Lima Beans Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lima beans ( shelled and de-strained ) | 1 ounce fresh green chili pepper ( minced ) | 1 ounce marjoram ( minced ) | 1/4 ounce fresh mint ( minced ) | 2 ounces teriyaki sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 pinch dried mint
instructions: Soak the tender stalks in cold water. Remove and discard the hard stalks of the lima beans.

title: Easy Shredded Mexican Meat Pies
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 can diced hot green chili peppers | 1 cup salsa ( any variety, i use pace mild )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Roll out pastry as if you were making a regular pie crust. Cut out 12 circles. Transfer pastry circles to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and place on oven rack. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until slightly puffed and browned. Remove from oven and cool. Spread a thin layer of salsa on the inside of each dough circle.

title: Quick Indian Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash | 2 teaspoons cumin powder ( ground to a paste ) | 16 ounces frozen fat free frozen margarine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Slice squash lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices, then into 1/2 inch slices. Place squash slices on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray, and sprinkle with cumin. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until tender and golden brown. Cool. Place frozen margarine in a food processor or blender, and process until creamy. Add hot squash and process well, just until hot. Store in refrigerator in a plastic container for up to a month.

title: Eggplant with Pistachio Cream
ingredients: 1 eggplant, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 jar beef gravy | 1/2 package shelled pistachio nuts | 1 package alfalfa sprouts
instructions: Place eggplant slices in a large saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes. Drain excess water and set aside. Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Spoon gravy into the bottom of a baking dish. Stir pistachios into gravy. Arrange the eggplant over the pistachios. Sprinkle alfalfa sprouts over the top. Bake in the preheated oven until vegetables are hot and bubbly, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Yucatan Chipotle Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chipotle chiles ( canned in adobo sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Combine chipotle chiles and black pepper.

title: Greek Oranges
ingredients: 12 oranges, peeled, segmented, and cut lengthwise in half
instructions: Arrange the peel and sliced oranges on a dessert dish. Pack the orange slices in a single layer. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze overnight to solidify. The next day, transfer the oranges to a serving dish and serve with freshly crushed or broken kabobs.

title: Hajar's Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1 tablespoon dill, finely chopped
instructions: Drain pineapple chunks into a serving bowl, then spoon pineapple chunks into a small serving bowl. Use a fork to mash pineapple pieces into the bowl, sprinkle with dill and refrigerate several hours, or overnight, before serving.

title: Spicy Radish, Crab  Dip or Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh shucked radishes ( or 2 large ones, such as rainbow ) | 4 -5 pieces spring onions | 4 -8 tablespoons olive juice | white pepper | 1/4 cup light coconut milk
instructions: Wash and thinly slice radishes, rinse thoroughly under cold water and drain. Slice spring onions crosswise along centre of radish. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve with crusty french bread, bread rolls or toast.

title: Grilled Baked Salmon & Strawberry Scented Goat Cheese on a Bed of Toast for 2
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs rainbow goat cheese ( or your choice of goat cheese ) | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 lb medium thick-beetled wild mushroom fillet, quartered | 4 medium thick slices challah ( you can use other varieties as well ) | 8 large fresh strawberries, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place 1 tablespoon oil in the bottom of a large baking dish and swirl it around to coat the bottom and sides. Place it in a warm oven and melt the goat cheese in the microwave for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove it from the oven, set it on a dry tray, and spread it across the center of the dish. Heat 1 to 2 tablespoons oil in a separate skillet over medium heat. Pat the goat cheese into 4 large, thick slices, making sure there is just enough of it to cover the goat cheese. Dip each slice first in the oil, then in the cornstarch, and finally the bread slices. Place the soaked side of your bread in the baking dish and bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese is lightly browned. Top with fresh strawberries and serve.

title: Mexican Pecans (Alamo or Black)
ingredients: 12 tablespoons pecans, shelled, finely ground | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Drain raisins, mix in nuts. Roll walnuts on baking sheet and bake at 120 degrees celsius for 5 minutes, remove from oven. Spread with butter.

title: Linguine With Pina Colada Pina
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 package linguine | 1 container crushed cashew cookies | 1/3 cup flaked coconut flakes | 6 tablespoons shredded provolone cheese | 1 dash ground nutmeg
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain, and stir in pineapple juice until pasta is coated. Reserve 1/3 cup of pasta cooking liquid. To the reserved pineapple juice, stir in the macadamia biscuit crumbs and coconut flakes. Spoon the macadamia biscuit mixture into the cooked linguine. Sprinkle provolone cheese and nutmeg over all. Return to simmer until pasta has absorbed the sauce and is heated through.

title: Chocolate-And-Ribbons-Espresso Bread Pudding
ingredients: 3 cups heavy whipping cream, divided | 12 slices firm-textured white bread | 1 cup shaved radish | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 teaspoon instant espresso
instructions: In a large bowl, whip 1 cup cream to soft peaks. Fold the whipped cream into 1 cup whipped cream until well mixed. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange bread slices in a single layer on 2 baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 7 minutes. Remove slices and let cool. In a medium bowl, mix 1 cup whipped cream with radishes, allspice, espresso and remaining cream. Divide radish cream mixture evenly among bread slices. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,chili pepper,apple cider,apple,plain flour,red chili powder
title: Apple Gratin
ingredients: 3 apples, peeled, coarsely grated | 1 -2 tablespoon chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 1/4 cups gruyere cheese, grated ( or use emmenthaler cheese ) | 250 g plain flour | 125 ml apple cider | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c and line a shallow ovenproof dish with nonstick baking paper. Place grated apples in a large bowl, sprinkle with chili and half the cheeses and mix gently. Sift the flour and red chilli powders over top and scatter over the cheese mixture. Roll out the remaining cheese and flour and cut into 3cm pieces. Spread over the top and scatter over the remaining grated cheese on top of the cheese. Mark into squares with a sharp knife and bake in the oven for 45 minutes until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,cherry tomato,margarine,white vinegar,italian breadcrumb,louisiana sauce,chicken leg quarter
title: Chicken Legs with Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 chicken leg quarters | 1/4 cup margarine | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons louisiana hot sauce | 1 can whole cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Combine the margarine, vinegar, hot sauce, and tomato paste in a bowl.

title: Beef  Patties With  Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, lean | 1 medium egg substitute | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot | 2 tablespoons canned parsnips, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh asparagus | 1 tablespoon buttermilk
instructions: Trim excess fat. Trim excess fat from meat. Combine egg substitute, accent, and ginger in medium bowl. Add meat, parsnip, asparagus, and vegetables. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 8 hours. Form mixture into 8 patties. Cook on hot griddle or large skillet until well browned on both sides.

Random Ingredients: red table wine,parsley leaf,garlic bread,marinade,green food coloring,baking soda,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Bread
ingredients: 6 slices garlic bread, buttered | 2 -3 artichoke hearts, blanched ( optional ) | 1/4 cup red table wine ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon marinade, plus a little marinade and | green food coloring | 4 -5 drops red table wine ( optional ) | fresh parsley leaves, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place butter on baking sheet. Arrange bread slices buttered side down on baking sheet. Sprinkle with food colouring and a little of the marinade and artichoke hearts if using. Bake at 400°f for 10 - 15 minutes or till golden and crisp. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Homemade Orange Zest Filling
ingredients: 4 oranges, zest of | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Finely grind 1 orange and 1/2 tsp mace. Place in small bowl. Wash and pierce remaining orange with sharp knife. Brush 1 tsp mace on each strip. Bake at 180 degrees c for 15 - 20 minutes until dry but not burned. Remove from oven and cool completely. Strain mixture into clean jar.

title: Famous British Brandy Biscuits
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 cup cake flour | 3 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Put the hamburger and flour in a bowl with a fork and mix well. Make sure the flour doesn't stick to the side of the bowl. Add the brandy. Dip the hands in cold water and form the bambert mixture into small balls. Coat in bambert flour and then cook on a hot griddle or heavy frying pan over high heat until coloured evenly. Turn and cook on other side. Eat with anything.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,italian salad dressing mix,oil,grand marnier,poblano chile
title: Poblano Chile Roasted Chile
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles | 2 tablespoons dried italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 teaspoon dried italian salad dressing mix | 2 teaspoons grand marnier
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Remove stem and seeds from chiles, being careful not to pierce flesh all the way to the bottom. Cut chiles lengthwise into strips about 2 inches wide. Place chiles on a paper towel, and pat dry. Coat chiles with herb seasoning, shaking off any excess. Wrap the chili strips around the peppers, and secure with toothpicks. Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium high heat. Roast chiles, turning occasionally, until golden brown, about 15 minutes. Remove toothpicks. Stir prepared seasoning into chile puree, cooking and stirring constantly until flavors blend, about 10 minutes. Remove chiles from pan, and keep chiles warm in a 200 degree f oven while preparing roasted vegetable mixture. Sprinkle each roasted chile with hot italian dressing mix, and garnish with grand marnier.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,coriander,nutmeg,asiago cheese,self raising flour,onion,brown sugar,sugar
title: Pigs in a Blanket
ingredients: 8 ounces self-raising flour | 8 ounces white sugar | 1 large onion ( grated ) | 1 ounce dried coriander | 1 ounce brown sugar | 1 ounce palm sugar ( ground ) | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 3 1/2 ounces grated asiago cheese
instructions: Grease a 24 kilner basket. Mix flour, sugar, onion, coriander, brown sugar, nutmeg and cheese in a large bowl. Add enough liquid from the drained fruit so as to just fit in the centre of the mixture. Pour mixture into the greased basket. Bake at gas mark 3 for 1 hour, or temperature of 180 degrees for gas 4 - 30 minutes. To serve, cut out the centres with a sharp knife and lift out the fillings carefully. Place the fillings into a warmed sterilised jar with a tight fitting lid and leave in a cool dark place for 3 days to age. This will mellow the flavour. Serve with butter and jam or jam ice cream.

title: Quickie Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato-based taco sauce, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon low-sodium v8 vegetable juice | 1/2 teaspoon minced imitation sweet harissa ( or more ) | 1/4 teaspoon cocoa powder | 12 shiitake mushrooms, stems discarded. | 2 teaspoons low-sodium taco sauce, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Blend tomato based taco sauce, v8 juice, harissa, and cocoa powder in a bowl. Brush mushroom stems with more taco sauce, if desired. Sprinkle mushrooms with sugar if desired. Melt 2 teaspoons of taco sauce in a dry nonstick skillet over medium heat, swirling to coat. Cook mushrooms, stirring, until tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir sauce and mushrooms into tomato mixture until heated through. Continue cooking until liquid is no longer cloudy in the skillet and mixture coats mushrooms, 2 to 3 more minutes. Stir in remaining taco sauce.

title: Homemade Margarita
ingredients: 24 leaves cabbage, rinsed and dried | 24 fluid ounces fresh triple-sec ( margarita, or other flavor )
instructions: The best way to do this is to prepare a 9x13 inch glass dish, a cookie sheet, or a glass bowl that you can place the prepared margarita in as close to the heat of your microwave as possible. As soon as the margarita begins to melt and begin to bubble, carefully lower in the lid, so as not to let the margarita smoke, and cook on the high setting for exactly 2 minutes, or until the entire contents of the plastic container are about half submerged into the margarita. Be sure the margarita does not burn. Carefully remove the lid and continue to cook for 2 more minutes, or until the margarita has become very slippy and slightly crispy. Slice into 1/2 inch rounds or rectangles, and pour into a bowl filled with ice cubes. Serve with salsa, ceviche, and/or guacamole mixed with lemon wedges.

title: Korean Seasoned Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans condensed milk half-and-half cream | 4 ounces red serrano peppers, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup sake ( optional )
instructions: Combine the half and half, serrano peppers, and 1/3 cup sake in a large saucepan over medium high heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until reduced by half, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the remaining 1/3 cup sake. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Salsa Cheesecake
ingredients: 3 cups of shredded iceberg lettuce | 12 ounces farmer cheese | 1 jar thick & chunky salsa | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup grand marnier or 1/2 cup orange liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a large bowl, place shredded iceberg lettuce. In a blender container, place the farmer cheese. Add 1/2 cup of salsa, olive oil and salt and pepper to taste. Blend until smooth. Place this mixture together in a medium sized, shallow baking dish that has been coated with nonstick spray. Sprinkle cheese mixture on top. Bake in preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until cheese is slightly browned and bubbly. If it's browning too quickly, stir in some water until smooth. Remove cheesecake from oven and spoon remaining salsa over it, keeping warm. Top with shredded iceberg lettuce, and continue to bake until set. Let the cheesecakes rest for a few minutes, then cut each one in half. Serve with fruit and/or whipped cream.

title: Nori
ingredients: 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon white miso | 3/4 teaspoon juniper berries, crushed | 1 tablespoon peanuts
instructions: Place the vinegar, miso, and juniper berries in a small, stainless steel frying pan over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,broccoli floret,garbanzo bean,red food coloring,tomato paste,cocoa,thai red curry paste
title: Quick & Easy Masaman Curry (Diabetic Friendly)
ingredients: 1 jar thai red curry paste | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained or 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can tomato paste | 6 ounces unsweetened coconut-flavored chocolate-covered sun-dried tomatoes and sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 20 -25 minutes red food coloring
instructions: In a bowl combine the curry paste, beans, tomato paste, coconut, 1/2 cup water, chocolate, sun dried tomatoes and 1 teaspoon cocoa. Mix well, cover and refrigerate for 10 minutes or up to 4 hours. To serve, add an additional ½ cup water to thin if mixture becomes too thick and starts to dry out. Spoon curry into tall wine glasses or dessert cups that have been coated with cooking spray. Top with an orange wedge or a sprinkling of chopped fresh fruit.

title: Veal Satay With Peanut
ingredients: 375 -600 g boneless veal ( thighs or breasts ) | 175 g dark sesame oil | 100 g unsalted peanut butter | 2 bottles beer
instructions: Preheat a grill to about 150c or 220c. Cut your veal into thin strips about 3cm long or 2cm wide. Combine the dark sesame oil and peanut butter in a bowl and mix well. Slice the pork into thin strips and add this to the peanut butter mixture and mix together with your hands. Rub the satay mixture into the meat about 2 cmx1 cm or 3 cm by 3cm long. Place in a plastic bag or clingfilm and freeze for 30 minutes. Remove from the bag or clingfilm and transfer to a shallow dish. Allow to reach room temperature. Drain the meat and dry well.

Random Ingredients: arugula,green bell pepper,cremini mushroom,liberty hop pellet,walnut
title: Arugula and Walnut Crusted Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs cremini mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed | 1 small green bell pepper, finely diced | 1 teaspoon delarsely chopped walnuts | 2 lbs arugula, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon delarsely chopped walnuts, for garnish | 1 teaspoon delarsely chopped delarsely choppedliberty hop pellets, for sprinkling top
instructions: Heat oven to 350ºf. Place mushrooms and bell pepper in a large mixing bowl. Set bowl aside. Sprinkle walnuts onto mushrooms. Stir mushrooms and bell pepper into bowl. Drizzle with walnut mixture. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon. Sprinkle with 2 more tablespoon. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon. Mix.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,italian herb seasoning,white chocolate,taco seasoning mix,purpose flour,cumin
title: Taco Biscotti
ingredients: 1 package white chocolate | 1 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Place the white chocolate in a microwave safe bowl, and microwave on high power until melted, 2 to 3 seconds. Stir in the flour and taco seasoning mix. Stir in the cumin and italian herb seasoning. The tortilla dough should have the consistency of heavy cream lukewarm biscuit dough. If it seems dry, stir in a teaspoon of warm water. If it begins to dry out, stir in 1/2 teaspoon of water. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead until smooth and elastic, about 3 minutes. Form dough into a disc, and place it onto a lightly floured baking sheet. Wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for 10 minutes. Cut the reserved piece of plastic into 8 pieces, and set aside. Dust the remaining plastic with 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch. Roll each piece of dough into a 1/2 inch thick rope, and cut each rope crosswise into 1 inch pieces. Place the biscotti onto the baking sheet, and bake for 33 minutes, or until the biscuits are lightly browned. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: mussel,star anise,italian cheese,yukon gold potato,parsnip,red chili pepper,spanish peanut
title: Mussels in Chili Peanut-Spice Crust
ingredients: 1 lb mussels, scrubbed | 1 yukon gold potato, peeled and quartered | 2 parsnips, peeled, quartered then cut diagonally into 1/4-inch slices | 1 red chili pepper, seeded if desired | 1 star anise | 3 ounces spanish peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1 ounce parmesan rind, grated ( or shaved with a vegetable peeler )
instructions: Scrub mussels and remove beards if open. Wash, and remove any mussels that have cracked or cracked hulls, if any that haven't done so. Place in a wide, shallow pan with a lid. Cover with cold water, and bake at 120degc for 30 minutes to make the shells open a bit. Rinse mussels under cold water. Transfer to an oiled, high sided casserole dish and cover with water. Cover and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and cook for about 5 minutes or until open. Remove from heat and discard any mussels that haven't opened. Drain and discard any that haven't opened, and cool shells over a bowl of ice water for 1 hour. Transfer shells to a serving platter. Strip away and discard any loose mussels that haven't opened. Discard shells. Cut remaining shells into smaller pieces. Toast the chile in 1/2 inch of hot oil over high heat 1 to 2 minutes, just until fragrant. Dip each mussel into hot chile, shake off excess, and remove with a slotted spoon or tongs. To serve, place 2 pieces of mussel on each plate and spoon over chili mixture. Sprinkle each piece of mussel with chopped prawns, peanuts, parmesan rind, if using, and more chili, or to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Black Bean Bruschetta
ingredients: 10 roma ( plum ) tomatoes | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 24 slices white bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spread roma tomatoes onto baking sheets and top with black beans. Sprinkle with grand marnier. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, until tomatoes are softened. Remove from oven and cut a slice from each slice of bread. To serve, remove and discard rind from black beans.

title: Lek and Fava Bean Dip
ingredients: 4 medium stalks leeks, white and light green parts only, sliced | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 cup fresh corn kernels | 14 ounces fava beans, drained and rinsed ( can also use 2 cans )
instructions: Heat oil in a large frying pan, add leeks and saute until soft.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,maple syrup,black olive,apple cider vinegar,hot paprika,flour tortilla,bacon grease
title: Black Apple Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bacon grease | 1 1/2 cups sliced, yellow apples | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower, cut into 1-inch florets | 6 whole pitted black olives, cut into halves | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon hot smoked paprika | 1 package flour tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Heat bacon grease in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in onions, apple, cauliflower, and olives, and bring to a boil. Stir in maple syrup, vinegar, and hot smoked paprika.

title: Pistachio Cheddar
ingredients: 1 box gouda cheese | 6 tablespoons coarsely chopped pistachios
instructions: Grate or shred cheese into fine breadcrumbs. Spread onto a baking sheet. Sprinkle pistachios on top and let it stand for 20 minutes. Break into pieces. Variation, for a very moist biscuit/curd, you can sprinkle with pistachios before baking, sprinkling with red or white sauce first.

title: Iraqi Style Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons cauliflower, finely chopped small | cardamom seed, lightly crushed | 2 tablespoons fresh cardamom seeds, lightly crushed
instructions: Cook the cauliflower in boiling water for about 10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cauliflower to a salad bowl and allow it to cool for about 30 minutes. To the cauliflower add the cardamom and the whole spices. Drain the cauliflower and add it to the bowl with the other ingredients. Mix well until the ingredients are completely mixed. Serve chilled.

title: Crispy Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed ( garbanzo beans ) | 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 1 fresh hot peppermint extract | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 7 ounces roasted salted peanuts
instructions: Place all the ingredients except peanuts in a food processor and process until well mixed. Spoon into a shallow glass or ceramic baking dish. Sprinkle with the peanuts. Press the peanuts onto the top of the chickpeas. Bake at 400°f/200°c for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Chipotle Marinade and Chips
ingredients: 2 chipotle peppers | 1/4 cup mirin ( korean sweet wine )
instructions: Roast the peppers on a cookie sheet or broiler pan until blackened. Cool and remove seeds. Pound the pepper with a meat mallet until very fine. Add chipotle puree and mirin.

title: Amaretto Fondue Variations
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup amaretto liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon ground sage leaf | 1 tablespoon olive, finely minced, or more to taste
instructions: Whisk heavy cream, amaretto, sage, and olive together in a bowl to make fondue. To serve, dip fondue spoon into desired amount of fondue.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,spring onion,bamboo shoot,corn,pecan,lime zest,picante salsa
title: Tex-Mex Party Pops
ingredients: 20 -25 medium corn on the cob | 1 can sliced water-packed water-packed bamboo shoots | 1/4 medium green spring onion, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup low-fat picante salsa or 1/4 cup reduced fat salsa | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, minced | 1/4 cup chopped pecans or 1/4 cup walnuts ( optional ) | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, cut into thin wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Insert sharp knife in centre of each corn on each cob. Drain juice from water spritzer into measuring cup.

title: Foul Mudamama (Mixed Fava Beans)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dried fava beans, soaked overnight | 3 tablespoons harissa or 3 tablespoons tibetan hot chili paste | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons fresh coarse ground seasoning salt | 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch wedges | 1 1/4 cups crushed ice
instructions: Cover dried fava beans with cold water and soak overnight. Next day drain all the water from the beans and discard beans. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Next day, drain beans and place in the bottom of a serving bowl or other large serving vessel and drizzle over harissa. Just before serving, sprinkle fresh, fresh black pepper over the top. Drizzle 1/4 cup of crushed ice over the top and garnish with red pepper wedges.

title: Sweet Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 cup baby corn, canned or frozen ( thawed ) | 1 avocado, peeled and cubed | 1 cup fresh raspberry vinegar | 1/2 cup dry chilis ( recommended ( texas ) | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup walnuts or 1 cup peanuts, chopped | marshmallows, slices ( optional ) or other decorative candies ( optional )
instructions: Place the corn and avocado into a large bowl. In a separate bowl, mix the raspberry vinegar, chile sauce, bay leaf and walnuts/pies. Add a little of the hot mixture to the vinaigrette. Dice in the remaining hot mixture or serve in salad plates with the assorted decorative candies or marshmallows if desired.

title: Kibbee's Easy Brown Rice (For One)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek | 2 cups brown rice, washed
instructions: Bring stock and sambal oelek to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add rice. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until rice is tender and liquids have been absorbed, about 30 minutes.

title: Couscous
ingredients: 4 cups couscous | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Stir together couscous and flour. Rub mixture into a baking paper lined 20cmx30cm swiss roll tin. Cook in microwave on high for 5 - 6 minutes, or until top is dry, stirring once, allow it to cool on the sheet on absorbent paper. Mark into squares with a knife. Place in a bowl, leave to cool for 1 - 2 hours, then break into pieces with your fingers. Store in an airtight container.

title: Grilled Halibut Steak with North Indian Spices
ingredients: 4 halibut steaks | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Lightly coat a rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. Spread cardamom on the cut side of fish. Sprinkle with cilantro. Use a small spoon to place fish onto garlic flavored baking sheet. Grill for 5 to 7 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,red chilies,peanut oil,raisin,palm sugar,sun tomato oil,limeade concentrate
title: Chilled Strawberries With Raisins
ingredients: 1 cup fresh strawberries, peeled | 2 red chilies, seeded | peanut oil | 2 tablespoons frozen limeade concentrate | 1 tablespoon grated palm sugar | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 tablespoon raisins, dried
instructions: Cut the strawberries in half and remove the seeds and white pith. Place in a bowl. Cut the tops off the chilies. Halve the stems and coarsely chop. Heat the oil in a wok or deep skillet on high heat. When ready to make, add the strawberries, chilies, limeade concentrate, and sugar. Stir fry for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Pour syrup over the strawberries and chillies. Stir fry for 1 minute. Stir in the sun dried tomatoes and raisins. Serve immediately.

title: Potato, Plant and Roasted Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 small red onion | 5 medium yellow potatoes | 2 lbs cherry tomatoes
instructions: Peel and halve the onion, and then slice into thin half moons. Cut the ends off the potatoes, peel and cut quarters. Using a small knife or melonballer, slice up the center of each potato into 1/2 inch thick slabs about 6 inches long with 1 inch each. Slash each slab on the horizontal, and into 3 or 4 slabs. Place potatoes and onion slices in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and leave to marinate for about an hour. Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Place potato wedges on a tray. Spoon about 1 tablespoon of oil on each, and then place the baking sheet in the oven. Turn the wedges now and then and rearrange them so that they cook evenly. Roast until crusty, golden brown, and crisp, 10 to 12 minutes. The potatoes will be golden brown, with darker brown crust on the outside, and will be tender, slightly crispy inside. Remove from oven and place on a tray to cool. When cool, transfer to the serving plate, and set aside. Serve warm.

title: Baked Ziti
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vodka | 3 tablespoons shortening | 1 pound dry ziti pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the ziti in the pot, and cook 2 to 3 minutes, until al dente. Drain, and transfer ziti to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir in vodka. Beat shortening and 1 cup water in a small bowl, until smooth. Spread ziti over the top. Cover with remaining topping. Cover, and bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,canola oil,vinegar,soya sauce,egg,broth,spanish onion,butternut squash
title: Soya-Vegetable Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/2 spanish onion, 1/2-inch dice | 1/2 butternut squash, 1/2-inch dice | 1 head bok choy, 1-inch dice ( about 4 cups ) | 3/4 cup low sodium chicken broth | 2 large eggs | 1/4 cup light soya sauce | 2 tablespoons dark soya sauce | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Heat skillet over medium high heat. Add oil. Stir fry 1/2 onion for 1 minute. Add squash and saute 3 - 4 minutes. Add 1/3 cup broth and bok choy, stir fry 2 minutes. In a small bowl, mash 2 eggs with a fork. Add eggs, 1/2 cup broth, soya sauce, vinegar, and remaining 1/2 cup broth. Beat well and add vegetables. Cook 3 - 5 minutes until eggs are set. Serve scramble rice topped with remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: parsley,green bean,green olive,tomato juice,shell pasta,heavy whipping cream,pecorino romano cheese,lemon peel
title: Green Bean and Olive Pasta
ingredients: 1 small green bean | 2 cans diced tomatoes with juice | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 1 package frozen small shell pasta ( small shells ) | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 3 tablespoons green olives, pitted, sliced
instructions: Break the beans into small pieces. Cook beans in large pot on medium heat till tender, about 6 minutes. Stir frequently to prevent sticking. Meanwhile, combine cream, lemon peel, parsley, drained pasta, green beans and olives in small bowl and chill. Just before serving, stir remaining ingredients except cheese and olives. Garnish with cheese and extra parmesan if desired.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,kirby cucumber,methi seed,beef brisket,cake flour,vanilla powder,tea,cremini mushroom
title: Cucumber-Mushroom Smoker Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 lb corned beef brisket, with spice packet | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, quartered | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 3 tablespoons instant tea | 3 cups cake flour, sifted twice | 1 1/2 teaspoons methi seeds | 2 tablespoons methi seeds | 2 tablespoons dried kirby cucumbers | 1/4 cup good quality light organic kirby vinegar | 2 tablespoons good quality vanilla powder
instructions: Preheat the smoker to 375°f or 200°c. Remove meat from packet, remove seasoning packet and rinse with cold water. Trim the brisket and any visible fat. Place beef brisket in a large roasting pan. Arrange mushrooms around brisket. Spoon cake flour into a flat bowl, then sift 3 1/2 cups cake flour, 1 1/2 tm oil, 1 1/2 tm methi, 2 tm seeds and 1/2 tsp salt on a sheet of kitchen parchment paper or aluminum foil. Working by hand, fold the two flaps of parchment or aluminum foil together to seal tightly for the brisket. Place brisket on the center rack of the grill, uncovered, over indirect medium heat. Cook brisket 2 to 3 minutes, until browned and crispy and the meat pulls apart easily with two fork or rubber spatula. Remove meat to a carving board, tent with aluminum foil, and let rest for five minutes.. Slice into thin slices across the grain. Serve with a side of cucumber raita and yogurt, recipe # notes,. Use a good strong coffee and tea for this recipe. The taste will deepen over 10 minutes, as it adds flavor to the mix. To save time and labor intensively to handle, place the brisket in the microwave.

title: Ziti With Salty Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 medium sweet italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced jalapenos
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions.

title: Feta Cheese Gravy (Crepes)
ingredients: 200 g feta cheese | 250 g plain flour
instructions: Mix the cheese with the flour and keep working until all the liquid is absorbed. Add salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: bean,plum tomato,lemon juice zest,icing sugar,phyllo pastry,red wine,virgin olive oil
title: Pasta & Bean Salad
ingredients: 350 g phyllo pastry, sheets | 250 g refried beans | 150 -250 g plum tomatoes, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons grated fresh lemon rind | 1 small lemon juice, zest of or 1 small lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup good quality red wine | 1/2 cup plus 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil | 1 cup icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Place the phyllo sheets on the board and cut in half. Brush with a little oil and lightly sprinkle each with icing sugar. Place a spoonful of the refried beans on top of each and spread to cover. Arrange tomato slices over beans and sprinkle with lemon rind. Sprinkle with lemon juice and red wine and drizzle with the extra virgin olive oil. Cover the dish with a layer of phyllo pastry sheets brushing each with oil. Repeat until the dish is full. Bake in a preheated oven, 180c, gas mark 5 for 30 minutes or until crisp on top. Allow to cool for a few minutes before cutting into squares, and icing with icing sugar to serve.

title: Pasta With Broccoli Sprouts
ingredients: 500 g broccoli stem ( florets ) | 5 tablespoons pasta, shapes ( or your favourite shapes of broccoli ) | 3 tablespoons frozen corn | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence or 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Boil your pasta and drain them, then toss them through a sieve. Seed your bean, chop or tear your vegetables and put them in a large pan. Stir everything around until it starts to stick and caramelise. Add a bit of water, mix well and put on low. Stir every so often until it starts to break down, stir well and allow it to bubble in the residual water. Once it is simmering away reduce down to minimum until it is completely dry. Stir every so often as it thickens, stir through another little bit of water, if you have to. Continue to stir, cook for another 2 minutes. Taste and add more vanilla/ground flavour if you want.

title: Rump Steak With Fig Sauce
ingredients: 500 g lean rump steak ( cut into 2cm cubes ) | 2 tablespoons flour | 400 ml tomato puree | 4 dates, chopped | 125 g chopped figs
instructions: Mix flour and 2tsp water in a bowl with a metal spoon. Roll meat in mixture. Sauté in a lightly oiled frying pan. Reduce heat to medium and cook about 3 - 5 minutes each side or until golden. Remove from the pan and keep hot. Add the remaining ingredients including dates to the pan and cook for further 3 - 4 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,yellow squash,cooking oil,sausage,poppy seed,phyllo dough,hard egg
title: Koulourakia
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 12 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 2 medium yellow squash, sliced ( about 1/4 inch thick ) | 1 small piece unpeeled poppy seed | 1 cup brown rice ( not instant ) | 6 sheets phyllo dough, frozen, thawed | 1 small sausage, cut in thin slices | cooking oil
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the 3 hard boiled eggs, squash, poppy seeds, and 1 cup rice. Stir to combine. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 20 to 25 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350°f. Place the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Wet your hands with cold water, and dip half of the frozen phyllo sheets in the water. Cut into 4 squares. Place the phyllo squares, overlapping, in the oil and cook for 30 seconds, or just until golden brown on the edges. Remove from the oven to a cutting board and use them to remove the phyllo squares from the oil, leaving them on the baking paper. Drain the extra oil. Remove the hard boiled eggs from the oil and place in a bowl with the rice and the sausage. Wet your hands with cold water, and place half of the sausage in the center of each phyllo square. Top with a tablespoon of the egg mixture, then wrap the phyllo around the sausage. Place the phyllo triangles on a flat surface and pinch the edges of the triangles together to seal. Brush tops with cooking oil. Bake the koulourakia in preheated oven until golden brown and crisp, about 30 minutes.

title: Nagar Shtoo (Rice and Cheese Nags)
ingredients: 350 g plain rice sticks ( pigeon pea ) | 300 g frozen pigeon peas, thawed
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 190c. Wings can be bought from middle eastern or indian food stores. Pour 1 - 3 liters of water into a large saucepan, place it over high heat, and bring to the boil. Rinse the pigeon peas in a strainer and pour into the pan. Stir well to keep the rice sticks from sticking together. Bake for 10 - 15 mins, stirring occasionally, until the rice is cooked. Serve the noodles in individual bowls or use as finger sandwiches.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Rice With Carrots & Pine Nuts (No Boil)
ingredients: 8 ounces prosciutto, cut into 1/4-inch by 1/2 inch pieces ( about 20 slices ) | 3 cups glutinous ( uncoarse ) white rice, rinsed of excess water ( preferably organic ) | 1/2 cup dry sherry or 1/2 cup grape juice | 1/2 package chopped carrots, 1 inch pieces ( about 16 carrots ) | chopped fresh parsley ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | salsa ( optional )
instructions: In a large, wide bowl, toss the rice with the ham and spread the mixture out in the center of a baking sheet or 3x3 inches. In a small skillet, warm the sherry or grape juice over medium heat until hot, about 1 minute, scraping up any browned bits. Transfer to a large bowl. Working quickly, slice the carrots, taking care to keep them separated from the rice. Drain the rice and arrange 6 slices on the bottom of the bowl. Spoon about 1 1/2 tablespoons of carrots over the rice and 1 1/2 tablespoons of rice over. Scatter the parsley. Drizzle the sauce over the rice. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight. Transfer the rice onto a platter and surround with the sliced carrots and pine nuts, if using. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: edamame,swede,celery rib,cornstarch,coriander powder,prune,red pepper,granny smith apple
title: Fruited Granny Smith Apples With Edamame
ingredients: 1 large gherkin ( chopped ) | 2 carrots ( chopped ) | 1 large swede ( chopped ) | 1 -2 granny smith apple ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon red pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 8 pitted prunes
instructions: Prepare the vegetables in a bowl and mix the first six ingredients together. Put them in a microwave safe dish, with the cornstarch mixture. Microwave for a few minutes, ensuring that the cornstarch does not burn or it will be too liquid. Add the prunes and microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until heated through or to your liking. Serve immediately or cool.

title: Japanese-American Crescent Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Line a cookie sheet with foil and set aside. Combine all ingredients. Shape into small balls. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes. Let cool on a wire rack.

title: Corned Beef and Gorgonzola Soup
ingredients: 4 corned beef brisket, well trimmed | 2 ounces gorgonzola cheese, grated | 1 pint half-and-half cream
instructions: Place brisket in large pot of water, add just enough water to cover completely and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until meat is tender approximately 2 hours. Drain and discard liquid. Slice brisket into 1/2 inch slices. Place slices in soup pot, cover and return pot to medium heat.

title: Sweet Lentils and Corn
ingredients: 2 cups brown lentils | 1 can mexican-style corn, undrained
instructions: Pour lentils, corn, and vegetable juice into a slow cooker. Cook on high 6 hours, or low to medium setting for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,beef tenderloin steak,beverage,herbes de provence,baking soda,pistachio,baby bok choy,peanut butter
title: Beef on Beet Bok Choy
ingredients: 3 beef tenderloin steaks | 3 tablespoons herbes de provence | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 3 tablespoons herbes de provence | 1 bag baby bok choy ( baby bok choy ) | 1 can sliced beets ( optional ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter, smooth, creamy or 1/2 cup butter ( a good quality brand ) | 2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 4 -10 chopped pistachios
instructions: Dissolve 1 tablespoon herbes de provence in 1/2 cup of warm water. Cut steaks into 1/2 inch cubes. Sprinkle both sides of each steak with 1 tablespoon of herbes de provence. Place in baking dish. In medium sauce pan, add the rest of herbes de provence and peanut butter, stir until blended. Add both cans of beet greens, bring to boil. Bake uncovered @ 400 for about 3 to 5 minutes or until tender and cooked through. To serve, lay beef on top of beet green mixture, sprinkle with remaining nutella and chopped pistachios.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,cream mushroom soup,nonfat cream,baking powder,apple juice
title: Apple Chicken Gravy
ingredients: 1 can reduced-fat cream of mushroom soup | 1 can nonfat sour cream | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce ( more or less according to personal tastes ) | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Mix soups and sour cream, mix well. Beat in apple juice, chili, and baking powder. Pour into lightly greased 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered in oven at 375 degrees till bubbly, about 25 minutes or till bubbly and heated through. Serve over rice if you have it.

title: Fried Macaroni in Garlic and Pepper
ingredients: 1 package macaroni noodles | garlic salt
instructions: Wash dry, very well. Cook macaroni noodles in very little water, until tender, about 2 minutes less than package directions. Drain, very well. Stir in a dash of garlic salt to taste while the noodles are still hot. Serve immediately..

title: Pasta With Ouzo and Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups creamed coconut milk | 1/4 lb prosciutto, chopped | 1 japanese vegetables or 1 cauliflower, chopped ( 8oz ) | 1 small green pepper, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons ouzo | 2 tablespoons double cream | 3/4 lb uncooked linguine
instructions: In medium saucepan, heat coconut milk over medium heat until it shimmers. Add proscuitto and cook about 5 - 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until prosciutto is fragrant. Add vegetables and cook until cauliflower is tender crisp, but crisp tender, but not mushy. Stir in chili flakes. In a deep 2 - 3 qt sauce pan, heat ouzo over medium heat until hot, but not smoking. Meanwhile, bring cream just to boil on high. Stir in cooked pasta and return to boil. Toss hot pasta thoroughly with cream mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,cilantro,oregano leaf,walnut,kosher salt black pepper
title: Greek Yogurt-Free
ingredients: 2 cups 1 % low-fat greek yogurt ( i recommend rippon's ) | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons packed fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons crushed walnuts or 2 tablespoons toasted walnuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: In a medium sized mixing bowl, combine yogurt, oregano, salt and pepper. Gently stir in finely chopped cilantro, chopped nuts, if using, and mix well. This can be served warm or at room temperature.

title: Kielbasa and Sautéed Water Chestnuts
ingredients: 1 package pasta, of choice | 8 ounces kielbasa | 8 ounces water chestnut | 12 small whole wheat tortillas ( or use more ) | 2 small red chiles, chopped ( or to taste )
instructions: Put about 3/4 cup of water in a deep skillet. Add pasta, kielbasa and water chestnuts. Set on high heat until the water boils. Turn down heat and let simmer. Meanwhile, warm tortillas. Cut in half and serve kielbasa, water chestnuts, and red chilies inside.

Random Ingredients: chile adobo sauce,onion soup mix,flat leaf italian parsley,seasoning salt
title: Homemade Beef Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 cup minced onion ( about 6-8 onions ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt ( can use more depending on your tastes ) | 1 cup dried chile in adobo sauce ( or more, to taste )
instructions: If using dried chile in adobo, soak for 20 minutes. Heat oven to 250 degrees f. Rinse the chiles, dry them on paper towels, and finely chop the flesh. Combine the finely chopped chiles, finely minced onion, seasoned salt, and seasoning salt in a small bowl. Stir until the seasoning mix is thoroughly combined. Spread the seasoning mix onto an ungreased baking pan, or in a resealable plastic bag. Insert a 1 1/2 inch round piece of waxed paper into the top of parchment. Cover the pan securely with plastic wrap, and press out air bubbles and excess moisture. Bake the seasoned dry chiles for 5 hours. Remove it from the oven, and after 15 minutes, sprinkle the top with a bit more chili powder or salt.

Random Ingredients: bacon grease,bell pepper,kielbasa,white pepper,lamb shoulder,worcestershire sauce
title: Gourmet Polish Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bacon grease | 1 pound kielbasa, sliced | 1 pound boneless lamb shoulder, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 small bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat the bacon grease in a large deep skillet over medium high heat. Brown the kielbasa in the bacon grease, and cook until the crumbly brown pieces have begun to stick on the bottom of the pan. Stir in the lamb, and season with worcestershire sauce, and white pepper. Transfer the meat mixture to a large casserole dish, and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven until tender, about 2 hours. Sprinkle the bell peppers over the kielbasa, and continue baking in the preheated oven until meat is hot and beginning to brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,vegetable oil cooking spray,brown rice,mirin
title: Baked Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup cooked brown rice | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 2 tablespoons mirin ( or other sweet soy sauce )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray an 8x8 inch baking dish with veg. Coat with cooking spray. In a large bowl, stir together rice and beans. Stir in mirin. Bake for about 40 minutes, stirring often, until lightly toasted.

title: Cremini Mushrooms in Orzo
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups orzo pasta or 1 1/2 cups other small pasta | 1 3/4 lbs fresh cremini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Add orzo and cook, stirring often, until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a 10 inch skillet, heat 1 t butter over medium heat. Add and cook mushrooms. Cook until liquid evaporates, about 3 minutes. Add pasta and heat through. Serve with a dollop of yogurt, if desired.

title: Beer and Smoked Sausage Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 14 ounces turkey sausage | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can beer | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice wine or 1 1/2 teaspoons shao hsing rice wine vinegar | 8 ounces firm tofu or 8 ounces firm tofu, drained ( can also use vegetarian if you wish )
instructions: Brown ground sirloin and turkey sausage in separate skillet, drain. Stir in soup, beer, rice wine and tofu. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally.

title: Pork in Pepper Pot
ingredients: 1 -2 lb pork ( boston butt ) | 1 red bell pepper
instructions: Cut meat into 1 and 1/2 inch slices about 1/2 inch thick. Set aside. Place the pepperpot upside down on a large heavy duty baking dish. Turn and brown evenly around the outside. Set aside. Insert a fork into a slit in the pepperpot and insert a slice of pepper into the hole. Insert the whole thing firmly into the hole. You don't have to make it into the hole. Cover the baking dish and bake in a 250f oven overnight.. Remove the bay and discard. This goes perfectly if you serve it in the manner described above. I also like to cook my meat the day before, covered and refrigerated and then put over night and bake in a 250f oven. This will last years.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,graham cracker crumb,grain rice,kale,tomato sauce,ginger root
title: Tomato Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1 tomato, chopped | 5 leaves kale, chopped | 1 cup prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh ginger root | 2 cups uncooked short-grain rice | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine tomato sauce, tomato, kale, horseradish, and ginger in a bowl. Add rice. Mix well. Place 1/2 cup rice mixture in the bottom of a shallow baking dish. Top with 1/2 cup rice mixture. Top with remaining rice. Combine crumbs and remaining 1/2 cup rice mixture and sprinkle over the top. Bake in the preheated oven until brown, about 50 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chinese egg noodle,shiitake mushroom,chicken breast half
title: Chinese Chicken Noodle Kugo
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into strips | 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, cleaned and sliced
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the egg noodles and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander set into a bowl. While the noodles are cooking, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in the chicken strips, and return to a simmer. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the chicken has cooked through, but is no longer pink inside, about 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander set into a bowl. Place a serving spoonful of noodles into a warm skillet, and sprinkle with shiitake mushrooms. Top with the chicken strips, and simmer over low heat until the mushrooms have softened and turned a rich brown color, about 2 minutes.

title: Cabbage and Crab Filled Tacos
ingredients: 1 -2 small savoy cabbage, depending on your taste | 1 -2 ripe plum tomato, seeded and diced | 12 -16 canned lump crabmeat, drained and flaked | salad leaves | 1 -2 teaspoon guacamole ( my personal taste )
instructions: Remove leaves, shred cabbage finely, rinse in cool water and let drain for 15 - 20 minutes. Place 2 tablespoon of filling in center of a napkin, fold the sides in and pinch firmly to seal. Serve with taco sauce, salsa, salad, mexican rice, cheese or guacomole.

title: Spanish Sausage With Onions and Cream
ingredients: 4 -6 sausages | brown onion, sliced | 1 small spanish onion, sliced | 2 teaspoons a.1. original sauce | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 cup rolled oats
instructions: Place sausage in 9 x 9 baking pan and cover with onion and remaining toppings. Bake at 350° for apprx. 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: saltine cracker,tomato sauce,rice wine,milk chocolate,ice water,salad green,wheat bread,italian
title: Mock Crab and Rice (Sinang Na Romana)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain whole wheat bread, crumbs | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 package milk chocolate, chopped | 3 tablespoons salad greens, chopped | saltine crackers, crushed | 2/3 cup unseasoned rice wine | 3 cups ice water ( or use 1/2 cup tomato juice )
instructions: Crush the bread cubes in an electric bowl or food processor. Add the rest of the ingredients except water. Mix thoroughly using only enough water to form wet bread dough. Refrigerate overnight. Roll dough into a ball about the size of a small walnut. Flatten to 1/4 inch thickness, then cut with a cookie cutter. Place in a shallow metal baking pan. Set aside. Heat 1 cup of water. Add the remaining 1 cup of tomato sauce. Heat until boiling. Turn off burner off, set aside, and keep warm. Bake in a 300 degree f oven for 20 minutes, or until golden.

title: Hazelnut Crumb Pie Topping for Salmon With Fruit and Pineapple
ingredients: 1/3 cup hazelnuts | 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup crushed saltine crackers | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained with juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread hazelnuts on a baking tray and bake in oven for about 10 minutes or until toasted, shaking the tray every 5 minutes to crack the nuts. Pour onto a plate and set aside. In blender or food processor, or using wire whisk, blend the pineapple juice, orange juice and crumb crumbs until well combined. Scrape into a small bowl. Add the drained fruit and stir until evenly distributed. Place in a pie plate and place in oven for 20 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and serve with chilled topping.

title: Rice Flour Tortillas With Chilli or Jalapito Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 2 jalapeno chiles, sliced | 1/4 cup roasted sweet red pepper flakes
instructions: Mix rice flour, jalapeno chilies and pepper until well blended. Spread mixture evenly on griddle. Allow to cool to room temperature. Shape mixture into an 8 inch tortilla. Roll tortilla in flour. Place tortilla, seam sides down, on baking sheet. Bake tortillas in 400° oven for 5 minutes. Cut into 12 slices.

title: Quinoa and Snow Peas (Namoura)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed | 1 pound snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the quinoa, and toast until it turns light brown, about 5 minutes. Stir in the snow peas, just until coated.

title: Peanuts
ingredients: 1 lb shelled raw peanuts ( i use 2 cans of roasted peanuts. ) | 1 yellow pepper, sliced
instructions: Rinse peanuts under cold water and set aside. Heat a non stick skillet or a griddle over medium high heat. Add a few teaspoons of peanut oil to coat the pan or griddle and toast the yellow pepper until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Set half of the peanut pieces aside and toss them with the pepper in the hot skillet. Repeat with the remaining peanuts, coating the rest with the oil. Sprinkle with remaining peanuts, reheat and serve.

title: Sausage With Polish Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 4 tablespoons peppercorn powder | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 4 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Trim the sausage, and cut the kielbasa into rounds. Sprinkle round the peppercorns with caster sugar, and bake at gas mark 4 for 25 - 30 min at 200c/400f/gas 6 until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,dark red kidney bean,beet,tahini paste,vanilla sugar
title: Tahouseitos
ingredients: 3 cans dark red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup tahini paste | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon crushed peppercorn | 1 jar sweetened beets, drained and halved
instructions: Put kidney beans into a large bowl and mash them with a fork. Stir in remaining ingredients. Taste and adjust seasoning, if necessary. Let stand for 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,red pepper,balsamic dressing,spring onion,asafoetida powder,rice noodle,tapioca flour,baby bok choy
title: Chargrilled Spring Onions on Spicy Noodles & Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic dressing | 4 spring onions, trimmed, halved, white and green parts sliced across | 200 g rice noodles, packet | 4 medium asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 red pepper, cored, deseeded, thinly sliced across | 4 medium asafoetida potatoes or 4 medium red potatoes, quartered | 2 bunches baby bok choy
instructions: Combine the dressing and green vegetables in a bowl. Place the noodles in a large heatproof bowl and pour over enough boiling water to cover.

title: Ricciarelli II
ingredients: 2 cups cannellini beans, rinsed | 1/4 cup sifted confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 1/2 pound lasagna noodles, or as needed
instructions: Pour cannellini beans into a bowl with enough water to cover. Let sit for 30 minutes. Drain. Rinse beans under cold water. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna noodles and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until barely tender. Drain. Transfer noodles to a bowl. Stir sifted confectioners' sugar into noodles until well blended.

title: Beef Potatoes With Marsala Dribs
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 3/4 cup marsala wine or 3/4 cup marsala wine | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 1 teaspoon finely chopped dried thyme | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to cut each potato in half crosswise and scrub. Arrange potatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet. Brush with oil. Broil for 5 minutes. Turn over, basting with olive oil, and broil again for 5 minutes longer. Remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes. Pour wine away from the skin and discard. Place potatoes over a baking sheet in a single layer. Heat olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add thyme and thyme and cook for 1 minute, stirring to heat through. Pour hot sauce over potatoes.

title: Italian Sausage Patties II
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed ( casing removed ) | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Prepare the baking sheet by spraying with nonstick spray. Cut the sausage into 1 inch cubes. In a medium bowl, soak the sausage cubes in the water for about five minutes. Mix in the bread crumbs and cocoa powder until just combined. Add the mixture to the sausage and mix well. Divide the mixture into twelve, slightly flattened, round balls. Wrap each patty in wax paper and allow to cool at room temperature for at least an hour or overnight. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Place the patties on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Salsa Verde Aka Puy De Papaya & Papaya Jalapeno Appetizer
ingredients: 1 papaya
instructions: Peel the papaya if it's a bit tough. Slice into bite sized pieces and put in an appropriate size jar with a tight fitting lid. Wash your salsa verde and put in the microwave. Take the jar and give it a quick squish to make sure it's the right dose of salt. Leave on the counter a while to let the salt start to run then shake it all around again. This will cause the papaya to turn a little bit translucent but that's exactly what it looks like. Take a plate or your small bowl and a fork and dip the papaya into the salsa verde on one of the large plates. Once all the papaya has been shaved off, you can lay it out on a kitchen towel to dry in the sink. Once dry, transfer to your recipient of the jar and set in the microwave. Once the salsa has drained out, transfer back into the jar and mix around until totally coated and ready. Place all you can do next is serve it with your favorite mexican foods. If you can't find mexican food you can use canned jalapenos. However, you can do this to any good mexican restaurant, pabas, tacos or other salsa.

Random Ingredients: coriander,swiss cheese,walnut,phyllo pastry,mozzarella cheese,cauliflower,chipotle chile adobo,cream chicken soup
title: The Great Phyllo Pizza -- Like Mama Used to Make
ingredients: 8 phyllo pastry sheets | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 can chopped sweet peppers with chipsotle chilies ( i like ortega brand ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded cauliflower, cooked and drained | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 teaspoon dried coriander | 1/3 cup walnuts or 1/3 cup pine nuts
instructions: Blend all ingredients at medium speed 5 minutes. Transfer to large bowl. Cover and chill 1 hour. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Dump one sheet of phyllo into a lightly oiled 9x13 baking dish. Repeat with remaining sheets. Cut phyllo sheets in half crosswise. Spread each half generously with cream of chicken soup, topping with swiss cheese, peppers with chipsotle, cabbage, and cilantro. Top with remaining layered half sheets of phyllo. Brush pastry with cream of chicken soup. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover, top with mozzarella cheese and bake until cheese is melted, about 10 minutes more. Let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,cocoa,chicken bouillon,chili powder,pumpernickel bread
title: Chili Con Carne Bread Dip for Dogs
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon powdered instant chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 cup pumpernickel bread, chunks | 1 ounce unsweetened cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Spray a frying pan with cooking spray. Sautee the chili flakes and powdered bouillon in the frying pan. When the chili flakes and bouillon are cooked add the chili powder. Cut the pumpernickel into slices and dip into the chili mixture.

title: Asian Asparagus and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 package rice noodles or ( 8 ounce ) package egg noodles | black pepper
instructions: Rinse asparagus and snap off tough ends with scissors. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium to high heat. Add asparagus and cook 10 minutes, or just until tender.

title: Sorrel Porridge(Iceland)
ingredients: 250 ml rice | 250 ml milk | 1 bunch sorrel, finely chopped
instructions: Bring milk to boil. Add sorrel and rice. Cover. Cook until rice and sorrel are cooked.

Random Ingredients: leek,shrimp,caster sugar,gruyere cheese,active yeast,penne,savory steak seasoning
title: Gruyere Penne
ingredients: 500 g penne, dry | 4 large leeks, chopped into 2cm lengths | 150 300 g shrimp ( large or small ) | 1 teaspoon savory steak seasoning | 2 teaspoons soft leeks | 150 g gruyere cheese | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon active dry yeast
instructions: Put the pasta ingredients to the boil, then turn down the heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes till pasta is tender. Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes. Turn out cooked pasta and mix in the leeks. Divide pasta between 4 serving bowls. Add cheese, sugar and yeast to the leeks. Stir over very high heat till cheese and leeks have dissolved. Pour over the pasta and serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,hamburger,soymilk,pork roast,head cauliflower,liquid pectin,asafoetida powder
title: Apple Smoked Pork Hamburgers
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground lean pork | 1/2 small head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1/2 pound fully-cooked smoked hamburgers, cut into 4 slices | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup soymilk | 2 fluid ounces liquid pectin | 1/2 teaspoon liquid pectin | 1 pound dried tart apples - peeled, cored and cut into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: Combine the lean pork, cauliflower florets, and hamburgers in a large, deep skillet. Sprinkle the sausages with asafoetida powder. Cook over medium high heat until pork is evenly browned and cauliflower is tender crisp, about 10 minutes. Mix together soy milk, liquid pectin, and pectin in a small saucepan, and bring to a boil. Turn off the heat. Place the drained apples into a large mixing bowl for dipping. Pour about 2 tablespoons of the simmering sauce into the egg and toss to coat. Pour the pork and cauliflower mixture into the bowl with the other ingredients and stir. Cover, and refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to blend. Serve hot with french fries. If you don't like your burgers quite spicy, you can mix turkey or beef with the pork mixture and serve with french fries.

Random Ingredients: lemon,bean sprout,almond,curly endive lettuce,chicken part,egg noodle,rose water
title: Basque Chicken Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 6 1/2 - 7 lbs chicken parts | 2 large eggs noodles | 1 teaspoon rose water | 1 1/2 cups curly endive lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup bean sprouts | 1 large lemon, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Place chicken legs in a large frypan. Cook over high heat, turning occasionally to brown evenly, about 12 to 15 minutes. Break eggs in a wide, shallow bowl or platter. Crack noodles into large pieces and stir in rose water and 1/3 cup salad dressing. Transfer cooked chicken legs to a cutting board and carefully cut through them so that each piece is attached to a separate serving portion, beginning at the wide end. Drain noodles and return to fryingpan. Return chicken pieces to pan. Add 2 cups salad dressing to sauce mixture in frypan. Heat to boiling. Cook noodles rapidly, stirring constantly, until noodles are barely tender, about 4 minutes. Transfer noodles to serving or individual serving bowls. Top with remaining salad dressing, bean sprouts, lemon slices and almonds. Serve immediately. Note, can be made 8 hours in advance, covering chicken in dressing. Cover and freeze. Before serving, cook until chicken is cooked through, 15 to 20 minutes. If chilling, cover and refrigerate. Remove chicken from bones before serving.

title: Spanish Rice with Beans
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain rice, uncooked | 1 cup green zucchini, coarsely chopped | 6 slices bacon, crisp-cooked and crumbled | 1 can cannellini beans or ( 19 ounce ) can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons pineapples ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375°f in a large, deep skillet, combine the rice, zucchini, and bacon. Stir in the beans and the pineapple, if using. Transfer to a casserole dish. Cover and bake 20 minutes, until the rice is tender and the edges of the filling are beginning to brown.

title: Mochaccott'Magic Bullet' #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package dark chocolate, chopped ( i use hershey's ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Line a 6 x 4 loaf pan with waxed paper. Coat the bottom of the pan with non stick cooking spray so the water can drip up into the pan. In a small saucepan over low heat, melt the chocolate, stirring often with an oven mitt or spoon, until it's melted. Stir in the cajun seasoning. Spoon into the prepared loaf pan, spreading as evenly as possible.

Random Ingredients: squid,beef bouillon cube,granny smith apple,red chili pepper,venison,wild rice,nut
title: Venison, Squids & Wild Rice over Rice
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground venison | 4 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes, reconstituted in 3/4 cup boiling water ( i prefer knorr brand ) | 2 fresh green mild red chili peppers ( you can add a jalapeno or two if you prefer ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper ( optional or to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups wild rice | 1 medium granny smith apple ( i prefer granny smith ) or 1 medium other sweet apple ( i prefer granny smith ) | 3/4 cup fresh mixed chopped nuts ( i use walnuts )
instructions: Brown the venison very lightly, in a large frying pan or even in batches if the meat is lean and a little browned. Drain any excess fat if necessary. Set the meat aside. In the hot pan or fry pan, dissolve the bouillon in the boiling water. Add the peppers, cumin and salt and pepper to taste. Add the venison, cover and simmer for 15, 25 minutes, until tender. Add the rice and stir until well coated in the broth. Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the fruit and nuts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust,penne,hot green chili pepper,gruyere cheese,chinese cabbage
title: Chinese Cabbage Pastry Bake
ingredients: 1 ready made pastry crust | 3 cups shredded chinese cabbage | 1 can sliced hot green chili peppers, drained | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese
