instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a large bowl, toss together cabbage, chiles, and 2/3 of the cheese. Layer pastry in a 9x13 inch baking dish with cabbage mixture. Top with remaining 1/3 of cheese. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden.

title: Manicotti
ingredients: 12 medium manicotti | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup white onion, chopped | 1/2 cup romano cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 cup brewed black tea
instructions: Cook manicotti according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine catsup, onion, romano cheese, allspice, and tequila in small bowl. When manicotti are done, drain and place them in a colander. With the tip of a spoon, crush and separate them into smaller pieces. When you are all done, drain and place a small amount of catsup mixture and a sprinkle of cheese over the top then put a napkin on top. Serve with your favourite salad enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white potato,beef stock,whipping cream,marinade,cream chicken soup
title: Creamy Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup beef stock | 2 tablespoons sour cream ( or low fat ) | 1/4 cup marinade ( i used homemade ) | 2 lbs white potatoes, peeled and diced
instructions: Place diced potatoes in a pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. Simmer until the potatoes are soft. This can take anywhere from 4 hours to overnight, depending on your method of preparing potatoes to your liking. After the potatoes are soft to the touch, transfer the potatoes to a large bowl and let drain excess liquid. Combine all ingredients and season with salt and pepper. Pour into bowls and serve.

title: Ricotta and Corn Bake
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 package frozen corn kernels, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup green pepper, chopped | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly oil a 9 x 13 inch nonreactive baking dish. In a large, nonstick skillet, cook the hamburger over medium heat.

title: Yogurt Cheese
ingredients: 300 ml natural fat-free yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves
instructions: Heat yogurt in an oven proof bowl in the oven and leave at 140c for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with thyme and serve with crusty bread pieces, or slices of fresh fruit or vegetables.

title: Winter Blossom - Pineapple Salsa
ingredients: 1/3 cup pineapple chunk, drained or 1/3 cup chunk pineapple, fresh | 1 small spring onion, finely chopped
instructions: Chop the pineapple and onion in a food processor, then mix in as much of the drained pineapple as you like. Serve over greens, with chips.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,active yeast,vodka,taco seasoning mix,spanish onion,pork roast
title: Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package chocolate-coated taco seasoning mix | 1 envelope active dry yeast | 3/4 cup vodka | 2 1/2 cups spanish onions, grated | 3/4 cup taco seasoning mix
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together roast cubes and taco seasoning mix, with vodka, stirring until liquid is absorbed. Cover with greased plastic wrap and rest for 10 - 12 hours at room temp until thickened. In a large, heavy skillet, heat onions over medium high heat for 5 - 6 minutes, stirring occasionally. When the onions have turned translucent, add pork and 1 cups of taco seasoning mix. Stir to mix and cook 5 minutes or until pork is browned. Place onions into a large, oven safe pan. Spread about 1 cup of taco seasoning mix over the onions. Then spread 1 1/2 cups of taco meat on top of the taco seasoning. Cover and bake at 400°f for 45 minutes, then uncover and bake an additional 45 minutes at 400°f, or until the internal temperature of the meat is 165°f.

title: Sweet and Savory Pho
ingredients: 5 cups cold steamed rice noodles | 2 cans whole oyster sauce | 1/2 cup rice vinegar, or | 1/4 cup oriental rosemary | 1 tablespoon garlic salt
instructions: Place noodles and 1 can of the oysters in a large plastic bag and pour in 1/2 cup of the water. Cover tightly and shake to mix. Allow to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Remove noodles from bag and set aside. In a small bowl dissolve garlic salt and remaining oyster sauce together. Set aside. Rinse off excess salt. Preheat oven to 325°f. Place noodle mixture into a 9x13 inch glass baking dish, and surround with the noodles. Pour soy sauce mixture over the noodles, and bake for 45 minutes, or until heated through. Note, cook time does not include marinading time.

title: Quick Chicken Dogs
ingredients: 4 -6 pieces chicken thighs | hamburger buns
instructions: Grill chicken until very done and crispy. Meanwhile, roll up each piece of chicken and fry in a non stick frying pan. Serve with the hamburger buns.

title: Spicy Indian Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup oatmeal | 3/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup dried onion | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 1/2 ounces gin
instructions: Combine oatmeal, breadcrumbs, onions, turmeric and sherry in a large bowl and mash together. The mixture should look like fine breadcrumbs. Stir in the gin until it is totally distributed evenly, taking all of the air out. Shape into a loaf and place into a foil lined ovenproof dish and place in a moderate oven till the bread is well browned. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly.

title: Tarragon-Crusted Steak
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1 pound flank steak, trimmed | 1 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup minced fresh tarragon, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot coffee-flavored mayonnaise
instructions: Place the instant coffee granules in a wide, shallow bowl and toss lightly to dissolve the powder. Add the flank steak, cover the bowl, and marinate at least 15 minutes. Preheat the grill for high heat. Prepare a heavy, clean baking pan with 2 inch sides with nonstick cooking spray. Drain the flank steak and pat the excess water out onto the outside of the pan. Turn the steak and marinade side down onto the prepared baking pan and spray lightly with cooking oil. Grill the steak, uncovered, on the preheated grill for 5 minutes per inch of thickness, brushing with 1 tablespoon of the prepared coffee powder. Turn the steak and grill until cooked to your liking, about 12 minutes per inch. While the steak is grilling, prepare the topping for the spicy mayonnaise by combining 2 tablespoons of the hot coffee and 1 tablespoon of the tarragon in a bowl. Spread the mixture on the steak and sprinkle lightly with the remaining tarragon. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Asian Hot Dogs
ingredients: 2 cans of seasoned marshmallow cream | 2 small carrots, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor in small batches. Pulse until well mixed. Use to stuff hot dogs.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,star anise,english mustard,yellow food coloring
title: Romaine Lettuce with Mustard and Star Anise for Valentine's Day
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, rinsed | 2 cups yellow food coloring ( pixie food coloring is best ) | 1/4 teaspoon english mustard | 1 star anise
instructions: Line a baking sheet with plastic wrap and set aside. If using a regular oven cook oven to 250 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut off the top 1/2 inch of the green stalk and discard. Wash the outer light green portion of the anise, then break off both ends and set aside. Slice the remaining green stalk in half, removing the peel. Trim away all loose white parts of the white stalk and set aside. Cut the stem end off the star anise and scrape the seeds from the interior into a small bowl. Combine the mustard and anise in a small bowl. Brush the inside of the romaine lettuce with the mustard mixture and lightly sprinkle with the salt. Roll the romaine lettuce until it is evenly coated. Repeat until all the lettuce is used. Place the coated lettuce on the prepared baking sheet, then bake for 20 minutes at 250 degrees f, tossing and turning until evenly colored. Remove from oven, sprinkle with sugar while still warm and serve.

title: White Pepper Shortbread
ingredients: 1 lb white flour | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: In a bowl, mix together flour and black pepper. Cut in with a knife until it reaches a fine breadcrumb consistency. Roll into a log about 1 inch in diameter and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Preheat oven to 325°f. Place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake for 50 - 60 minutes. Remove from oven and cool 5 minutes before removing. Wrap in foil and store in a dry, cool place for up to 2 weeks. Makes about 8 - 10 slices.

title: Smoked Saskatoon Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 4 ounces bread flour or 4 ounces all-purpose flour | 1 lb fresh lean ground meat or 1 lb smoked salmon, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 pear, cored, seeded and finely minced | 3 cups mixed saskatoon berries | 1/4 cup of freshly brewed tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f using a mortar and pestle, crush the dried thyme into a paste. Add the turmeric and mix well. Add the thyme paste and mix well. Add the bread flour, mix well, then add the meat, pear, apple, saskatoon berries and tea. Stir well, and divide the mixture in half and shape each half into a round or oval shape. Put on a rack over a baking pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 - 25 minutes, but check to make sure that it bakes evenly.

title: Moroccan Style Saffron Turkey
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron threads | 12 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 1/2 cups cold cuts, cut into quarters or small cubes | 2 pounds fresh ground turkey
instructions: Break the saffron threads into 1 tablespoon pieces. Heat the oil in a large skillet. Use the saffron threads to coat turkey pieces on all sides. Reduce heat to low, add the turkey and saute until turkey turns golden brown and turkey is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon remove turkey, drippings and dates from skor. Serve turkey and dates in large shallow serving bowls, with drippings spooned over, or use as a gravy over cooked rice.

title: Preserved Lemons
ingredients: 1 kg lemons or 1 kg other citrus fruit, peel and pith removed | 1/4 cup saffron strand
instructions: Cut fruit into 2 cm cubes and sprinkle with the saffron. Leave for 1 hour to marinate. Cook in boiling water until tender, then drain and cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Cashew and Pepperoni Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups cashew nuts | 125 g chopped pepperoni | 25 g grated fresh nutmeg | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1/4 cup fat-free yoghurt | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place cashew nuts in a food processor and whiz or process to form fine crumbs. Transfer to a large bowl and add pepperoni, nutmeg, garlic, yoghurt, bicarb soda, and salt. Mix well. Divide mixture among 8 x 4cm capacity greased ovenproof dishes. Place on a baking tray. Bake at c for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,pinto bean,pie shell,watermelon,coconut,mascarpone cheese,dijon mustard
title: Pinto Bean and Watermelon Pie
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shell | 1 cup canned pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cups diced watermelon | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 container mascarpone cheese | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the pie base with a little dijon mustard. Sprinkle beans, watermelon, cheeses and coconut over the mustard. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes. Let cool. Cut into wedges.

title: Tuscan Citrus Flowers
ingredients: 2 cups fresh baby spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons orange flower water ( optional )
instructions: Bring 3 - 4 cups water to a boil in a saucepan. Add the spinach and return to heat. Reduce heat and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, pressing out excess water. Add the orange flower, stir and continue to cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat and cover. Let stand until cool enough to handle. Slice the cooled spinach leaves and arrange on a serving platter. Spoon flavored ice cream on the leaves.

title: Turkish Delight Soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon turkish delight | 1 cube beef bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/4 cup frozen peas | 1/4 cup frozen raspberries | 1/4 cup galliano
instructions: Make the bouillon cube, place the bouillon cube, turkish delight and cardamom in a saucepan with enough water to cover the cubes by 1 inch and bring to a boil over moderately high heat. Reduce the heat to moderately low. Simmer, partially covered, for 10 minutes. Add the chili powder and hot sauce and simmer, partially covered, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute. Add the peas and raspberries and cook until heated through, about 1 minute. Ladle into soup bowls and serve at once, dusted with confectioners' sugar.

title: Tomato and Avocado Canapes
ingredients: 1 slice day-old white bread | 1 avocado, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh sage | 1 tablespoon prepared cheese sauce | 1 tablespoon instant muscovado or ground turkish porcinnatto. powder | 1 tablespoon prepared semolina ( rice flour ) | 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Cut the bread into 1cm slices. Place bread in a small glass mixing bowl. Mash together the avocado, sage, cheese and turkish pices using a fork. Add 1/2 cup water, then sprinkle over the bread with the nut mixture. Sprinkle with the semolina and sun dried tomatoes. Using hands, shape the mixture into little round balls. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium high heat. Cook the canapes for 1 minute each side or until crisp and lightly golden. Serve hot, room temperature or chilled. Variations. You can cut the canapes into strips or triangles. Place strips or triangles on a plate. Roll up the canilla. You can serve the canapes individually or serve them later on top.

title: Simple Miso Tempura
ingredients: 1 cup white miso | 1/4 cup green pepper ( finely diced ) | 1 cup white flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let sit at room temperature for a few hrs to allow the flavors to meld. Slightly flour a work surface. Scoop a little of the sticky mixture into your index finger and thumb and roll to form a roll about 1 1/2 inches long and 2 inches in diameter. Repeat with all but a few short end pieces until you have about 1 inch or more left. Roll in remaining sticky mixture coating well. Refrigerate for 15 minutes then dip with cold water to stop the from sticking. Heat a pan like this. It's easier when you coat the bottom with olive oil. Cook a few pieces at a time until it's light brown on one side and the bottom just beginning to turn brown. You don't want to brown all the way through. It should only have a few little flecks underneath. Drain on a paper towel and serve.

title: Asparagus in Sage
ingredients: 1 can asparagus, drained | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup sage, shredded
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a greased 9x13 pan. Bake at 350°f for 45 - 60 min until heated through.

Random Ingredients: loaf bread,hot green chili pepper,mustard seed
title: Hot Green Chile Hot Bread
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons dry mustard seeds | 4 cups shredded loaf bread | 2 hot cooked green chili peppers
instructions: Combine mustard seeds and remaining ingredients in a large skillet, bring to a boil. Cook over medium heat for 1 minute. Transfer to a bowl and pour hot dough into bowl. Roll dough into a loaf shape. Cut into pieces using a cookie cutter, knife or pastry wheel. Sprinkle with salt if desired. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg wrap,raspberry,self raising flour,lemon juice,red enchilada sauce,double cream
title: Raspberry and Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons triple cream | 1/2 cup raspberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup self raising flour | 2 eggs, large | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 2 sheets egg roll wraps
instructions: Heat oven to 200c. Spread enough enchilada sauce into one of the prepared oven proof dishes, to cover the base of the dishes, to just cover the base of the dish entirely. Scatter raspberries over enchilada sauce. In a separate bowl pour the self raising flour over the raspberries. In a small bowl beat the eggs yolks and lemon juice. Stir eggs mixture into raspberries. Dip 1 wrapper at a time of one direction into the egg mixture and then roll the wrapper up like you would an egg roll, using the wrappers as an option. Place egg roll, seam side down, in the prepared dish. Cover with remaining enchilada sauce. Bake for about 30 minutes until browned. Serve with refried beans.

title: Chili Cheese Samosas-Prikas
ingredients: 2 -3 green chili, chopped | 1 package phyllo dough, thawed in cold water ( approx 4 sheets ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Place thawed phyllo sheets in a single layer on a baking sheet. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 425 degrees fahrenheit for 15 to 25 minutes and remove from oven. Spray one sheet with nonstick cooking spray and spread in a single layer. Sprinkle generously with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Repeat with second sheet of phyllo and continue on with spraying with more spray, until all sheets are used. Bake, spray top with nonstick cooking spray and continue to bake for an additional 5 to 5 minutes. Remove from oven and immediately brush top layer with remaining spray. Allow samosas to cool slightly before removing sheet from the baking sheet. Keep in mind this is a very thin layer of butter. Slice and serve hot, or refrigerate. Alternatively, you can use fresh green chili, chopped but not dried. However, the original recipe states to thaw phyllo sheets in the pantry.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,green bean,red pepper sauce,cream celery soup,tofu,wonton,buttermilk
title: Beef and Tofu Casserole
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 container crumbled vegan sour cream or ( 10 ounce ) container fat free sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 3/4 cup buttermilk | 3/4 cup red pepper sauce, and other flavors | 2 lbs fresh green beans, cut into 1-inch pieces | 20 -36 square wonton pieces, warmed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray a 9 x13 inch casserole dish with non stick cooking spray with cooking spray. Combine tofu and sour cream and spread in even layer over bottom of pan. Combine soup, buttermilk and red pepper sauce and pour over bean mixture. Cover and bake until heated through. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven, uncover, and bake for an additional 15 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Sprinkle with green beans.

Random Ingredients: white flour,whipping cream,extra virgin olive oil
title: Pasta Flour Soup
ingredients: 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 tablespoons white flour | 5 cups whipping cream
instructions: Make the flour in the bowl of a blender or food processor. While the machine is running, add all the butter and oil in a steady stream, starting with 1/3 cup at a time, processing well after each addition. The dough can be stored in the refrigerator for about 2 weeks, adding the remaining 2/3 cup of oil in the bowl 2 to 3 times. When all the butter is incorporated and the dough forms a ball in the processor, transfer the dough to a work surface and knead briefly until it is smooth and elastic. Wrap the dough in an oiled cheesecloth and refrigerate for about 30 minutes. The dough can then be frozen for upto 1 month.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,curry,mint jelly,cream soup,savoy cabbage,caster sugar,white pepper powder,hamburger
title: Indian Cabbage Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry | 2 hamburger, chopped | 1 cup savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 can condensed cream soup | 1 teaspoon white pepper powder | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 leaf lettuce, to use as required
instructions: Combine curry, hamburger, cabbage, soup, 1 tsp sugar and white pepper powder in wok. Bring to the boil and simmer for 5 - 6 minutes. Place on plate and top with lettuce and hot sauce.

title: Chilled Pesto for Two
ingredients: 2 cups chicken broth, low sodium | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: In a food processor or blender, process the broth and pesto until well blended. Add baking soda and pulse to mix. Transfer to a glass container or freezer bag and cover container. Refrigerate for up to 3 days. Transfer to containers and store in fridge.

title: Portuguese Madeira Ladyfingers
ingredients: 36 ladyfingers | 1 cup madeira wine | 1/2 cup lemon juice, fresh | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, preferably freshly ground
instructions: Prepare all ingredients. Brush one side of each ladyfinger with some of the madeira sauce. Sprinkle with about 3 tsp of the cardamom powder, roll in remaining paste and lightly press edges with spatula. Wrap in wax paper, return to freezer until firm. To serve, run a toothpick through each roll, loosening if necessary, and invert onto a platter. Serve with remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,lemon,splenda granular,peach,dark sesame oil,cocoa,basmati rice
title: Peachy Peach and Fresh Herb Brownie
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup splenda granular | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 2 medium lemons, juice and zest of | 2 small peaches, sliced | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350&deg.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,potato,fontina,cayenne,cream mushroom soup,hungarian paprika,asiago cheese,simple syrup
title: Potato and fontina Soup
ingredients: 1 pound potatoes, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese | 1/2 cup grated fontina | 16 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon greek sweet hungarian paprika | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring the water to a boil, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and set aside. Mix in Asiago cheese, fontina cheese, sour cream, paprika, and cayenne pepper. In a separate pot heat the olive oil, and cook the potato mixture until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

title: Chipotle Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice | 1 can diced chilies, drained | 1 bunch romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into pieces
instructions: In a large skillet with enough water to cover rice, cook rice until tender, but still firm, about 20 minutes. Drain but do not rinse until cool. Transfer rice to a large bowl. Add chilies, romaine lettuce and cooked rice.

title: Scallops on the Half Shell
ingredients: 1 pint coconut cream, softened | 1 1/2 lbs scallops | 3 ounces fresh raspberries
instructions: Make the grated coconut cream. Drain the raspberries and reserve. In a hot pan, heat the cream, and bring to a boil. Add the scallops and cook for about 2 or 3 minutes or until well cooked. Toss the raspberries over the scallops/scallops and place on a platter. To serve, pour the grated coconut cream over and serve.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,olive oil,beef sirloin,paprika,chicken breast,ranch dressing mix,whipping cream
title: Baked Stove Top Smoked Paprika and Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin or 3 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | olive oil | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 3 cups whipping cream | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika | 2 teaspoons celery ribs ( i used garlic powder because my sirloin was so generous )
instructions: Cut beef or chicken into very thin slices. Heat oil to medium high in dutch oven. Drain bread crumbs from meat and dredge in paprika. Brown meat on both sides in hot oil. Transfer meat to platter. Add whipping cream to dutch oven and bring to boil. Add cream and whipping cream. Return meat to dutch oven and add ranch seasoning and smoke paprika. Simmer, covered, over low heat 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until meat is very tender. Serve with hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chili,turnip,dark mexican beer negra modelo
title: Drunken Turnip
ingredients: 2 turnips | 80 ounces dark mexican beer ( negra modelo ) | 1 teaspoon ground annatto dark mexican beer
instructions: Peel turnips and slice into 1/4 inch rounds. Rinse then place cut side down onto a broiler pan. Put a layer of turnip slices on top. Sprinkle with a little bit of dried ancho. Drizzle the beer over the turnip slices. Broil until browned, about 25 minutes, turning over with a fork or toothpick.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,cherry tomato,celery seed,orange juice,phyllo dough,fenugreek,italian herb seasoning,dark sesame oil
title: The Secret Sauce #6 - Microwave Recipe
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cocoa | 8 cherry tomatoes, cut in half ( garnish ) | 12 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Combine all ingredients and microwave on high 6 minutes or till slightly thawed. Add cherry tomatoes and stir. Allow to cool. In a bowl combine cocoa and herbs, stir and let sit till it's well mixed. Add more cocoa and herbs if desired for garnish. Place 1 sheet of phyllo on a bamboo pan. Brush top with melted butter and sprinkle generously with sesame oil. Cut 4 sheets of phyllo crosswise, then spread with some cocoa mixture on the sheet. Brush 1 sheet lightly with butter and sprinkle with sesame oil. Continue this til all 4 sheets are gone. Cut the end off four sheets, then cut diagonally into 1/4 inch wide strips. Repeat. Sprinkle with paprika to taste. Keep covered with a damp paper towel. Repeat till all pieces are cut. Cut the remaining phyllo sheets and stack in one pile. Spread 2 tbsp on top of phyllo. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Remove, add 1/2 tsp cocoa, and repeat until all sheets have been added. Microwave on high for 2 minutes or till the sauce is very hot, adding more as necessary. Serve immediately. If time permits, add a little water to help thicken, then microwave on high for 2 minutes. Place on a wire rack for 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,flour tortilla,chicken bouillon cube,corn tortilla chip
title: Better Than Best Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cup frozen corn tortilla chips | 1 cup flour tortilla chips | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 cups chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Preheat over to 350 degrees and grease or spray a 9 x 13 pan. In medium bowl, toss the corn tortilla chips with the cocoa, then dredge them in the entire bag of the tortilla chips in the hot cocoa mix. Transfer to the sprayed pan. Sprinkle with the remaining ingredients and bake for 20 - 30 minutes. Note, although this recipe does not really make a smooth, easy to spread, the sauce is fantastic for dipping into enchiladas.

title: The Best Barbecued Ham
ingredients: 8 thick slices ham | 3 tablespoons hot pepper sauce
instructions: Brush generously on both sides of the ham with the hot sauce, then place ham on a hot, greased grill. Cook about 3 minutes on each side.

title: Lemony Smoked Round Steak
ingredients: 5 lbs round steaks, cut 1 inch thick | 10 ounces enchilada sauce | 3 green cardamoms, crushed | 1 lemon, juice of, freshly squeezed
instructions: Remove the excess fat from your steak. Lightly butter your grill and arrange the meat on the grill. Sprinkle with crushed cardamom. Grill for 5 minutes on each side or until done to your liking. Serve with sauce. Top with fresh lemon juice to the side.

title: Pueblo Recipes
ingredients: 1/2 pound beef roast, coarsely chopped | 6 slices american cheese | 6 hamburger leaves
instructions: Place the beef into a skillet over medium heat. Cook the beef for 5 minutes.

title: Beef Brisket With Corn and Pork
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1 can creamed corn
instructions: Place brisket in 3 - 3 1/2 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, fat side up. Sprinkle salt and pepper on brisket. Pour corn over. Cook on high setting 1 1/2 hours. With an electric carving thermometer, carefully make deep cuts around brisket. Turn meat over.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,mustard seed,bell pepper,deli roast beef,shiitake mushroom
title: Shiitake Mushroom Pot Roast
ingredients: 4 cups sliced shiitake mushrooms | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 can refrigerated mustard seeds | 1 1/2 lbs sliced deli roast beef | 2 large bell peppers, cut into strips
instructions: Coat 13 x 9 inch rectangle pan with nonstick cooking spray. Cover mushrooms with 1/4 cup water. Place in microwave, venting 1 minute on high. Microwave for 6 - 6 minutes or until tender. Cover mushrooms with 1/4 cup water. Microwave on high for 8 minutes or until water absorbed. Drain mushrooms. Sprinkle flour over mushrooms.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Grapes
ingredients: 3 cups greek olives ( can use black ) | 1 package sugar snap peas
instructions: Toast sugar snap peas in a dry skillet over medium heat until they are soft and golden, 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Squash, Mango & Mango Fool
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango, diced | 1/4 cup squash, diced ( fresh or frozen for easier blending, try mango mango daiquiri or try jazzy fruit salad for a different flavours try ) | 2 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Place all ingredients into a medium size pot and heat gently until the cream starts to bubble. It will thicken up a little but dont allow it to boil. Strain and serve with fresh mango dip.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,chicken breast half,coriander powder,poblano chile,green olive,tarragon,coconut
title: Grilled Chicken Breasts With Green Olives
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced fresh tarragon | 6 -8 garlic cloves, peeled and crushed | 2 tablespoons minced fresh sage leaves | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup shredded coconut ( optional ) or 1/4 cup manzanilla olive, drained | 2 poblano chiles, stemmed and seeded, and cut into 3/4-inch rounds
instructions: Combine the tarragon, garlic, sage, and coriander in a shallow bowl. Dredge the chicken in the spiced mixture, then add it to the bowl of tarragon mixture. Cover, and refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to 48 hours. Heat a grill pan or griddle over medium high heat. Grill the chicken, turning once, until lightly charred on both sides, and no longer pink in the center, about 20 minutes total, depending upon the size of your chicken. Transfer to a cutting board, and tent with foil. Allow to rest, loosely covered, at least 10 minutes before slicing thinly.

title: Quick Taco Meat
ingredients: 12 taco shells, warmed | 2 cans mexican-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 pound ground beef | 1/2 cup brewed coffee | 1/2 cup milk | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking spray | 1/3 cup chopped or crumbled feta cheese | 3 tablespoons guacamole for topping
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Mix diced tomatoes, beef, coffee, and milk in a large bowl. Spray a large cooking dish with cooking spray. Arrange the taco shells on the hot grill. Reduce heat to medium. Place the beef mixture in the center of each taco shell.

title: Yams With Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 1 yam ( about 300g ) | 1/2 cup slivered almonds | 1 -2 teaspoon sesame seeds, toasting between layers of griddle
instructions: Start by trimming the ends of the yams, leaving the root on for easy removal. Rinse the root and use a little of the water to wash away any sand or dirt from the yam. Using a sharp knife, make cut in half lengthways and then cut 1/2 inch at intervals, again making a cross. Repeat until the cuts are 3 inch thick. Cut the tops off and place the yams in a baking dish with the slivered almonds and sesame seeds. Drizzle with a little of the sesame oil. Sprinkle with black pepper and bake at 400f degrees for 25 minutes or until tender, and dry. Makes about 2 pints.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,farina,blue curacao,green onion,rotel,garlic clove,tortilla chip,red potato
title: Mexican Grill Chilli  Potato Salad #RSC
ingredients: 2 red potatoes | 2 poblano chiles | 3 garlic cloves | 1/4 cup of jalapenos or 1/4 cup pepitas ( if you can find it, jalapeno-cumin powder can be substituted ) | 1 large green onion | 1/4 cup farina | 1/2 cup blue curacao | tortilla chips, for dipping
instructions: Boil the water for the potatoes and chilies until slightly tender. Remove potatoes, but do not rinse with cold water. Cut the potatoes and chilies into 1/4 inch dice. Peel the garlic clove if not using garlic. Dice the poblano and roughly chop the green onions. Dice the garlic, if not using garlic, and add it to a salad bowl. Add the diced poblanos, green onion and garlic powder to the salad bowl.

title: Kathy's Spicy Swiss Steak
ingredients: 500 -600 g raw swiss steak, sliced thinly | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 2 tablespoons rosemary, leaves and | 1 kg ham, sliced thinly | 750 g deli roast beef, in diagonal slices
instructions: Heat chili oil in a frying pan, add the cheese and rosemary. Stir for a few minutes, then add the ham and turn over. Add the swiss steak and cook until cooked to your requirements, adding water until it reaches desired consistency. Serve right away, or allow to chill in fridge for upto 3 days.

title: Ethiopian Red Lentils With Zucchini and Syrup
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentils or 1/2 cup yellow lentils ( 1 1/2 inch diameter ) | 2 -4 green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon ground kebe ( optional ) | syrup
instructions: Place the lentils and cardamon pods in a saucepan of boiling water and let them become tender. When tender, drain and rinse the lentils, pressing out as many of the excess water as possible. Place the lentils into a large serving bowl and set aside. Place the cardamom pods in a mortar and smash with a back of a spoon. This should leave your mortar a little ajar. Remove the cardamom pods from the mortar and mash finely with a pestle. Return the pestle and mortar to the pan and add the zucchini, nut oil and kate. Add a little hot water if it seems a little dry. Heat and stir until the mixture is hot and the zucchini mixture is very warm. Serve warm or cold and refrigerate.

title: Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 white mushrooms | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 3 1/2 ml frangelico | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning mix ( or use a mixture of french and colman's ) | 1 slice brioche bread
instructions: Wash mushrooms and discard sand or dirt. Cut off stems. Trim ends and remove sand or stems. Slice caps lenghtwise. In a frying pan, heat the oil, add mustard seeds and mushrooms.

title: Salsa Dip - No Boil
ingredients: 8 ounces chunky salsa ( you can use a mild salsa for this ) | 8 ounces pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 can tomato-garlic flavored refried beans ( i have used homemade & it is good for this too )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine salsa, cheese & refried bean. Pour into a pie plate, or loaf pan and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or over night to blend the flavors. This is even better the next day, but we prefer an hour or so before serving.

title: Baioche & Coconut Noodle Medley
ingredients: 1 medium sized bagliatelle pasta noodles | 2 cups freshly grated coconut | 250 g fresh tea bags | grated nutmeg
instructions: Boil water, drain, and set aside. Add the macaroni noodles to the boiling water and cook according to packet instructions. Drain and return to bowl. Add the coconut to the noodles. Toss well to combine. Place in a large serving bowl and sprinkle with nutmeg. Serve warm with a side of yoghurt or chopped fresh herbs.

title: Avacado
ingredients: 3 large avocados ( use large-halved, peeled and pitted ) | 1 tablespoon chourico haricot kirsch | 1 teaspoon fresh tarragon vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 4 lbs chicken wings | 3 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut off and discard tips and wings that are attached at the joint. Use toothpicks to hold the avocados until ready to use. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Remove avocados from shells and mash. Stir in kirsch, tarragon vinegar and mace. Skewer the wings along the drumsticks. Place in a baking dish and add enough water to come halfway up the wings. Cook for 45 minutes, then raise the temperature to 400°f and continue cooking for another 45 minutes. Mix together the breadcrumbs and remaining marinade.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,brown sugar,vegetable broth,chicken bouillon,salmon,brown rice
title: Smoked Salmon Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 2 cups vegetable broth | 1 can salmon ( i use flounder ) | 1 serrano pepper, finely diced | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: Add salt, pepper and chicken base into pot. Add brown rice, add broth, cook on med low about 20 minute drain liquid onto paper towel until well mixed. You may add some liquid at this point as your broth is going off, but i'm not sure how much it will absorb. Taste to see if rice is well flavored. Add green pepper & fish sauce.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,chicken broth,beef steak,vegetable oil,lump crabmeat
title: Sue's Famous Slow Cooker Crab
ingredients: 1 pound boneless beef top round steak, cut in strips | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 can lump crabmeat, drained | 1 can condensed chicken broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Over high heat in a large skillet, fry steak until browned on all sides. Remove and set aside. In slow cooker, combine reserved meat and 1 can condensed chicken broth and worcestershire sauce. Add the crabmeat and mix well. Add meat back to slow cooker. Place lid on cooker, and cook on high for 30 minutes, or until sauce is thickened.

title: Easy Pita Chips
ingredients: 2 whole wheat pita breads, toasted | 2 3/4 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 teaspoon mirin | 1 -2 lemon
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cut the lemon on top to make an x shape on the pita as well, and dip into soy mixture before eating. These are best served plain.

title: Gramma's Bok choy Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs firm bok choy, trimmed well and shredded | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup yellow onion, diced | 4 1/2 tablespoons cashew nuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Heat grill to high, place bok choy on heat. When water almost starts to boil, lightly spray grate with cooking spray. Cover and grill 4 minutes or until tender. Drain and let cool slightly. Shred or cut into large pieces. Place all ingredients in a large bowl and toss till combined. Refrigerate overnight to blend flavors.

title: Moroccan Mint Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice concentrate | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon dried mint ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients in blender and blend well. Store in airtight container. Note, can be stored up to 3 months in refrigerator.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Pita Bread Pizzas
ingredients: 1 pita bread, cut in half | 1 sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler. Cut each pita half into 3 pieces. Open each strip of sun dried tomato with a knife. Place a slice of sun dried tomato in the preheated oven, close the oven, and broil until golden golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Pasta a la Conchilada (Pasta with tomato-adobo sauce)
ingredients: 500 g pasta | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 400 ml tomato puree or 400 ml light cream
instructions: Cook pasta for about 50 minutes under boiling water. Add adobe and tomato puree. Simmer for at least 45 minutes or even up to 3 hours. Serve with extra sauce.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,cilantro leaf,chicken tender,rice vinegar,soba noodle,garlic salt,self rising flour
title: Foil Wrapped Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders or 1 lb chicken tenderloins | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 12 ounces soba noodles
instructions: Slice chicken crosswise into 1/4 inch thick strips. Place in bowl and toss with sesame oil, garlic salt and cilantro. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Heat 1 t oil in 6 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Remove chicken from marinade and discard marinade. Cook until lightly browned, 2 - 3 minutes per side. Set aside. Meanwhile, cook soba noodles according to package directions and drain. Drain well and pour 1/4 cup of noodles into a large bowl. Add 1 t oil and garlic salt, to taste. Stir with a wooden spoon to combine. Add chicken and stir to coat. Combine soba noodles and 1/4 cup noodles in another large bowl. Add to bowl with chicken and remaining noodles and toss together to coat. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,active yeast,cantaloupe ball,white wine,couscous,rotel tomato,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Spanish Oranges and Couscous
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup warm 2 % low-fat milk ( about 90 degrees f ) | 5 cups unbleached all-purpose couscous | 1 1/2 teaspoons white wine | 3/4 cup frozen cantaloupe ball | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms
instructions: Place yeast in a lrg mixing bowl. Pour in 1/4 cup of warm milk, stir to dissolve yeast. Let stand 5 min, then stir in remaining milk, couscous, wine, cantaloupe, cheese, & mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,chicken breast half,pork tenderloin,tomato puree,nut,turkey sausage,sunflower oil,dill
title: Lennie's Turkey and Lean Sausage Loaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, halved | 1/2 pound pork tenderloin, diced | 1/2 pound turkey sausage, casings removed | 1 can tomato puree | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with aluminum foil. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Slice the chicken breast half into 1 1/2 inch slices, and place in the pan. Cook and stir the chicken until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 2 to 4 minutes. Set the chicken in the skillet, and set aside. Mix the pork tenderloin, sausage, tomato puree, 1 tablespoon dill, flour, remaining dill, and sunflower oil in a bowl.

title: Rum Flavoured Plum Jam (Prassor)
ingredients: 400 g plums, quartered | 400 ml dark rum ( or rum extract )
instructions: Line a large bowl with kitchen paper. Over a double boiler, bring half a cup of water to the boil. Remove the plums from the bowl, add the rum and leave to cool. Add the plums to the bowl and using your finger tips, make a dent in each half. Pour the water into the pan and bring to the boil. Cook for 1 minute and remove from the heat. Place the plums in the prepared bowl and store in the fridge.

title: Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 2 cups breadcrumbs | 2 egg whites | 1/4 cup plain flour | 3 - 3 1/2 cups broth
instructions: Mix bread crumbs with egg whites with flour. In a separate baking dish line bread cubes with bread crumbs and add enough broth to moisten crumbs evenly. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Place in oven on 140 degrees celcius until lightly browned.

title: Simple Italian Bread
ingredients: 6 slices of italian bread | 1/2 cup light flavored italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and put it in the broiler. Toast the bread in the broiler about 5 minutes on each side. Remove from broiler and sprinkle with italian seasoning. Let the bread cool before serving.

title: Lebanese-Style Scallion Relish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely minced scallions | 2 tablespoons finely minced fresh ginger | 1/4 cup finely minced fresh basil | 2 teaspoons lemon juice and zest
instructions: Combine scallions, ginger, and basil. Use with a fork to mix. To store, store in the refrigerator for up to 6 months.

title: Pumpkin Bean Dip
ingredients: 500 g canned chick-peas | 500 g ricotta cheese | 2 cups broth ( or your own )
instructions: Drain the canned chick peas, rinse well and then put in a bowl. Add the ricotta mix. Heat the chick pearls up in the microwave, add in the liquid. Serve cold with bread, fresh fruit or other things. This recipe can also be cut into smaller pieces instead of serving them.

title: Italian Pesto Appetizers
ingredients: 3 tablespoons basil pesto | 1 tablespoon dry crushed red pepper, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Stir basil pesto, red pepper, and red pepper together in a bowl to make a sauce.

title: American Steamed Whole Fish and Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs whole fish, cleaned | 1 tablespoon shallot, finely minced | 8 ounces chicken stock | 4 ounces whipping cream, whipped | dashi, to taste ( optional ) | 4 anchovies, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Soak the fish in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain off the water and pat the fish dry. Remove all excess liquid. Remove fillets from the bones or skin and coarsely chop. In a shallow microwave safe dish, mix shallots, chicken pieces and cream and pour over fish. Add an anchovy and microwave uncovered on high power until the cream is reduced by half, about 2 minutes. Place the fish in a steamer and cover with another dish. Add enough water to the steamer to reach about 3/4 above the fish. Make sure steamer is deep enough to completely submerge the contents of the dish. Cover the steamer and allow to steam for 18 - 20 minutes, depending on the thickness of your steamer. When done, remove fish to a serving platter and pour the sauce over the fish.

title: Chinese Mint Chutney
ingredients: 500 g pasta, i like whole wheat but it can also be bought in the asian section in blocks | 1/2 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 200 g fresh mint leaves | 1 1/2 tbsps chinkiang vinegar
instructions: Boil water in a pot. In another pot boil noodles. When noodles are cooked, drain and rinse well with cold water. Leave in cold water to keep the noodles tender. Drain well and set aside. Place all ingredients except mint in a blender and combine. Pour into a saucepan. Stir well. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until mint is soft and hot. Stir through the chinkiang vinegar. Keep over low heat till it thickens and coats noodle. Cool and serve. You can prepare this as you desire. The idea is to use all of the ingredients before preparing the chutney to help it thicken.

title: Papa Suey's Kielbasa, Raisins, Peppers and Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs smoked kielbasa, sliced | 1/3 cup chopped olive | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoni, minced | 1/2 teaspoon ouzo ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( to garnish )
instructions: Boil kielbasa for 5 minutes. Dice into bite size pieces. Brown kielbasa and onions in a large skillet over medium heat. Once kielbasa is browned remove kielbasa and onions to a bowl. Saute sliced olives and beef bouillon just until they are a bit browned. Once kielbasa and onions are browned add sautee mixture, raisins, pepperoni, if using, ouzo and soy sauce. Simmer on low heat and serve hot over your favorite pasta.

title: Chicken Lollies
ingredients: 8 ounces tortillas | 1 3/4 cups instant chicken or 1 3/4 cups tofu, fried or thinned with water and drained | 3 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 cups crispy chicken or 2 cups roasted chicken | 1 large zucchini, sliced finely or 1 large summer squash, cut lengthwise | 1/2 graham cracker crumb
instructions: Prepare the lollies, either by microwaving, putting a rack in the pan and placing a large pan underneath it for a few seconds, or in a muffin tin. Using a sharp knife, slice through the tortilla shell to make four lollies. This will help to make the lollies. Remove the toothpicks and the small slice from the center of the lollies, make a slit along the slit along one side you are going to use to stuff the lollies, and lay the lollies flat in the pan. They will absorb the flavor from your first truffle if you don't leave them long enough to soften, then you can fill the opening with whatever extras you prefer, the idea is that they will fit into shape once they are all stuffed. They make a mess of the tortillas because they are very hard and make frequent fillings for this dish. Dunk your tortillas in cold water for just a couple of seconds, they should absorb a lot of a lot of the hot liquid, and drain immediately. Once they're all in the pan, add the remaining ingredients, or use what is handy, i don't usually measure, but i'll make sure it is roughly right. Using a silicone spatula, spread about 1 tablespoon of the prepared dressing into a cup and layer on each lollie.. I like to bake them on a cookie sheet at 350 degrees for about 15 minutes, then take them out and spread them around the pan on dinner plates. You can serve the lollies on the side with salsa, tortillas, etc. Or you can serve each dinner as is or with hot sauce. This is a delicacy that you can't go wrong in this recipe, but is equally tasty. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,celery salt,sea salt,golden syrup,salmon,chinese five spice powder,beef chuck,honey
title: Smoked Sausage With Honey Glazed Salmon
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked salmon | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon green tea leaves or 1 tablespoon dark sesame paste | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1 pinch sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Remove the rind from the smoked salmon with a sharp knife. Cut each rind at the thickest edge into 8 slices. Lay the salmon slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment and roast in the oven for around 15 minutes or until cooked. Remove the salmon from the oven and let cool off in the pan for a good while. Remove the skin and fat from the smoked salmon. Cut into slices with a sharp knife. Put all the ingredients in a microwave safe bowl and mix well. Smear the smoked salmon with the glaze and bake in closed oven till the glaze is just starting to set up. Take out and enjoy either with steamed rice or with potato wedges.

title: Tortell Romana (Pork Roulades)
ingredients: 1 kg pork, with skin | 1 liter veal stock | 200 g frozen orange juice concentrate | 4 bunches baby spinach | 1 chopped chili
instructions: Slice your pork into strips about a centimeter or 2 inches long. The easiest and easiest way to do this is to just slice into the skin lengthways. Place all ingredients in a large pot and add enough water to just cover the meat. Let simmer for about an hour, making sure it becomes tender and the water is getting reduced. The more water i take the water out of the meat the milder it will be. If you take the meat out of the liquid, strain it to get rid of all the sticky bits. This is one of those recipes that can easily go on to a boil or your meal. Cook for around 1 1/2 hours. This is usually when the meat is cooked for about an hour after it is removed and a bit of fat has solidified to the meat. The meat can also be cooked over a medium heat for about an hour before it is ready and then serve on toasted italian bread. Note, you may also do this with beef or any type of meat in the process. I've even cooked this in pressure cooker or even a traditional pot, although you may make it without that or cook it in a pressure cooker before its cooking time. This method will also allow you to cook this in the pressure cooker. So, if you are using something other than ground meats, don't use this method.

Random Ingredients: white rice,garam masala powder,apple juice,red chili powder
title: Tarda's Apple Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice or 1 cup brown rice | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 2 apple lumps ( optional ) | 1 -3 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 -3 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Put in a large pot or casserole, cover with water and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium low and continue to cook on low until all the water has been absorbed. When all water is absorbed, remove from heat and let sit for 10 minutes. After 20 minutes, fluff rice with a fork or spoon. When well fluffed, add remaining dry ingredients and mix well. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,chili powder,white pepper,liquid honey,white wine
title: Homemade Sausages, for the grill!
ingredients: 500 -600 g white meatballs ( sausage ) | 1 tablespoon pure white vinegar | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | ground white pepper
instructions: Put the meatballs and mix together. Add white wine and vinegar. If the mixture is watery, add in more white wine, honey, and pepper. Make sure the mixture coats all of the meatball. Let the mixture rest for a few hours or overnight. Cook on the grill, brushing with a mixture of vinegar and sugar. These are not good as they don't necessarily need to be turned constantly.

title: Cantonese Pork Baked Beans Sprouts
ingredients: 500 g boneless lean pork, cubed | 350 g bean sprouts | icing sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c. Line a shallow ovenproof dish with baking parchment. Wipe the pork out in a clean dish with your fingers and rub the pork with salt and pepper. Place the bean sprouts on a baking tray and bake for 30 minutes, until soft. Pour the pork and seasoning into the prepared baking dish and stir until well coated. Bake for 3 or 4 mins until the pork is cooked and crisp. Remove from the oven and stir.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,cream chicken soup,red wine vinegar,cilantro
title: Hot Sour Cream and Cilantro Soup With Onion (Chamoura
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar ( not seasoned ) | kosher salt | 1 bunch fresh cilantro ( or 1-2 t. dried cilantro )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in medium stock pot. Bring to a low boil and cook for 30 minutes. Taste soup and adjust seasonings, if necessary. Serve warm topped with grated cheese.

title: Baked Semolina With Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canadian bacon, finely diced | 2/3 cup semolina ( not wholemeal ) | 2 -3 tablespoons boiling water | 1 jalapeno | ice water
instructions: Place the jalapeno in a miniature casserole dish that has a tight lid that fits snugly close to the casserole dish. Drizzle around with about 1 - 2 tablespoons of canadian bacon grease. Place over medium high heat, stirring frequently. Add salt, stirring frequently until it's nicely browned on the bottom. Watch out for burning.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce heart,chocolate,lettuce,caraway seed,red chili pepper,black bean,strawberry
title: Spicy Mexican Flag Salad
ingredients: 0.5 container strawberries ( can sub purple kiwi, drained ) | 8 fresh strawberries ( can sub purple kiwi, drained ) | 1 carrot ( can sub 2 small peeled, thin sliced carrots ) | 0.5 can black beans, drained and rinsed ( can sub pinto beans ) | 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup shredded lettuce | 1/2 cup shredded romaine lettuce hearts
instructions: Mix together the first five ingredients in a large serving bowl. Toss with a small amount of vegetable oil to prevent a skin from forming. Top the salad with the romaine and garnish with extra berries. Makes 4 servings.

title: Spicy Cheese Tofu
ingredients: 20 ounces firm tofu, drained and cut into 16 pieces | 12 ounces mushrooms, chopped | 1/2 cup quark | 1/2 cup arbol chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon oregano | 8 napa cabbage, sliced
instructions: Place the tofu and mushrooms in a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Mix quark, chilies, oregano, and chile pepper together and sprinkle over tofu and mushrooms. Bake at 350°f for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,green chile,celery rib,coriander,tomato sauce,iceberg lettuce,cardamom pod,oxtail
title: Coco’s Oxtail Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 gallon iceberg lettuce ( frozen can be substituted ) | 2 lbs oxtails | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 green chile | 2 teaspoons cardamom pods, capsules | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 2 teaspoons coriander | 2 teaspoons celery ribs, minced
instructions: Cook oxtail by first bringing water to boil. After a few minutes add the oxtail and salt and continue to boil. Cook until the shells are half done. Once oxtail is fully cooked, drain water, then place in colander. Allow to drain while you prepare taco and other toppings. While oxtail is draining, cook green chilies till they turn dark red or a bit brown. Immediately place the entire contents of the can of tomato sauce in a saucepan and bring to boil. Stir in green chili, cardamon, garlic powder, coriander and celery. Slice oxtail and serve in taco shells.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,cranberry sauce,chickpea,orange zest,chicken thigh,ice water,mango,egg yolk
title: Cranberry-Gorgonzola Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup ice water | 2 cups sweetened goat cheese | 1 cup frozen cranberry sauce, thawed | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1 teaspoon grated mango | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the water and half of the cheese. Simmer over low heat 5 minutes, mashing the cubes with a spoon. Add cranberry sauce, 1 egg yolk, orange zest, mango and chickpeas.

Random Ingredients: butter,italian salad dressing mix,phyllo dough,caraway seed,swiss cheese,chicken stock bouillon
title: Easy Cheesy Swiss-Cheese-Caraway Baklava
ingredients: 2 packages phyllo dough | 7 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 1 -2 cup unsalted butter, melted | 1 -2 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon crushed chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Thaw phyllo dough according to package directions. Place 1 sheet of phyllo dough in a 13x9 inch baking pan. Brush each sheet liberally with butter or margarine. On top, then top with about 2 tablespoons swiss cheese. Repeat this method until all ingredients are used up. Sprinkle with remaining swiss cheese in strips across the cheese and top with remaining phyllo phyllo dough. Cut a few slits into the sheet to prevent bubbling. Sprinkle top dough with remaining 1 to 2 teaspoons of caraway seeds, if desired. Bake in preheated oven for 25 - 30 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Russian Pumpkin Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces root beer ( such as corona ) | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried dill weed, and additional or other desired spices ( see description below ) | 2 cans pumpkin puree ( not pumpkin pie filling )
instructions: In a dutch oven or deep skillet set over medium high heat, mix all ingredients until well combined. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture thickens slightly and begins to brown, about 1 - ½ to 2 hours. Keep warm until ready to use. If you are using ice cream, allow to thaw in refrigerator about 5 to 10 minutes. Enjoy immediately. Note, the mixture can be made ahead to this point and frozen for later use, but be sure it is completely defrosted in the refrigerator before using.

Random Ingredients: grain dijon mustard,purpose flour,enchilada sauce,dark beer
title: Beer Mustard Chili
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dark beer, such as modelo negro | 4 cups all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon deluxe deluxe dijon mustard ( see directions ) | 1 can enchilada sauce, such as enchilada verde
instructions: Heat the beer in a large, wide saucepan. Meanwhile, combine the flour and dijon in a large bowl. Gradually stir in enough beer to the paste form a stiff dough. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth, about 45 seconds. Lightly oil your rolling pin and turn the dough onto the oiled surface. Gently flatten to form a disk, about 1/2 inch thick. Slide the dough onto the hot surface about 30 seconds a side. Use a round bladed knife to cut a few slits in the dough. Cook the chili on the hot griddle for 3 to 5 minutes a side or until puffed and golden. Remove from the griddle, spread the enchilada sauce on and sprinkle the chili with cheese. Note, if you like really spicy chili sauces with cheese, you can substitute one of the following for the dill.

title: Peanut Butter Parsnips
ingredients: 2 large parsnips, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/4 cup chunky peanut butter ( low-fat or fat free ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Coat medium size saucepan with cooking spray, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Add parsnips.

title: Beef Feta
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck steaks ( about 1-1/2 pounds ) | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 large onion, sliced thinly | 2 quarts hoisin sauce
instructions: Cut beef into slices about 1/4 inch thick and 1/2 inch wide. Place in a large dish and put in enough boiling water to cover. Turn heat to low and let simmer for 3 hours. Drain, reserving 1 cup broth. Skim fat from beef juices, if any.

Random Ingredients: home brown rice milk,pie shell,lard,red chili powder,pea carrot,basmati rice
title: Mexican Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 box home baked brown rice | 2 cups basmati rice, washed and washed | 3 tablespoons oil or 3 tablespoons lard | 2 tablespoons red chili powder | 2 cups frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 1 unbaked pie shells, partially baked
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare the rice according to package directions. Let sit to cool slightly before adding salt. Prepare the peas and carrots in a large bowl, toss with a little of the oil to coat. Heat the remaining oil and chili powder in a skillet over medium heat. Add the peas and carrots to the skillet and saute until the carrots are crisp, about 2 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Stir the brown rice into the skillet. Sprinkle the bottom of the bottom of the pie shell with half the rice. Scatter the meat mixture over the uncooked rice. Spread the leftover brown rice evenly over the meat mixture. Top with peas and carrots. Top with remaining rice. Spread the butter over top. Bake until crust is golden brown and the filling is hot, 30 to 35 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Lettuce Leaf and Asparagus Salad With Lemonade
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus spear, fresh and young | 1 carton plain yogurt | 1 lemonade ( use 2-6 tbsp with ice ) | 1 teaspoon fresh fenugreek leaves ( or 1/2 tsp. dry fenugreek leaves ) | 1 bay leaf | lettuce leaf ( as a garnish )
instructions: Rinse asparagus and snap off woody ends. Slice tips and set aside. Cook asparagus tips on low heat in boiling water with lemonade and bay leaf until the asparagus is tender crisp. Place asparagus in a bowl. Add 1 tbsp yogurt and mix. Spoon some of the lemonade over the asparagus and serve, garnished with fenugreek leaves and a bay leaf. If you do not have lemonade, this will also serve as a lovely dipping sauce.

title: Red Cabbage and Tomato (Stir Fry)
ingredients: 2 medium red cabbage | 1 cup tomato ketchup, heinz ketchup or heinz ketchup
instructions: Separate the leaves of the cabbage and then cut down along the length. Take a wok and pour in the ketchup. Heat and then add the sliced cabbage slices. If they are not crisp yet, they can be squeezed in the air while frying. Serve hot.

title: African Chili Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 1 tablespoon chicken stock
instructions: Put the cumin powder in a small bowl. Add half a cup of water and mix it with your fingers until the mixture is smooth and free of any lumps. Add one tablespoon of chicken stock and mix everything. The paste will keep in the fridge for 3 - 3 months. Strain the paste through a coffee filter or a cloth lined sieve for a further 3 months or leave it in the fridge. Keep in cool dark and dry jars. Shaves can be bought from health food stores and some supermarkets, depending on the size you are looking for.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,egg,dashi stock,green cardamom pod,sun tomato oil,bean pinto,fine breadcrumb,sesame oil
title: Shish Tawook
ingredients: 2 beef ribs | 3 eggs, beaten until mixture is white and fluffy | 2 ounces fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dashi stock | 3 green cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil | bean pinto, drained
instructions: Score into diamond shapes with a sharp knife with the blade of a knife. Broil in oven until they have a slight crust, not burned, but a nice crust to them. Take out of the oven and let cool. Trim off all excess sinew and membrane from the ribs. Score the top of meat with a sharp knife or cross cut, resulting in diamond shape. Beat the eggs with the bread crumbs, oil, dashi and green cardamom in a separate bowl. Dip the meat into the egg mixture. Coat with bread crumb mixture and place on a plate. Place a pan on medium heat. Add sun dried tomato oil to pan and fry meat. When browned, drain excess fat. Serve with hot beans on the side. Note, if serving as an entree then the meat can be cooked in this recipe.

title: Gluhwein
ingredients: 12 teaspoons anise seed | 3 lemons, zest of
instructions: Grind the anise seeds in a mortar and pestle with the zest of the lemons to form a fine powder.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,meat,phyllo pastry,tomato green chilies,parmesan cheese,lamb chop,carrot
title: Chile-Braised Lamb & Beef Pies
ingredients: 1 meaty round ground sirloin steak, rass steak, approx. 21/2 oz, ground beef | 1 lamb chop, approx 1/2 oz, ground lamb | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup fresh tomato and green chilies, diced | 2 carrots, peeled, finely grated | 1 phyllo pastry sheet, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. In a large bowl, lightly mash the ground sirloin with your fingers, using your hands. Mix in the parmesan, chili, carrot and meat, reserving the other tbsp of the cheese for sprinkling during the baking. Lay the phyllo pastry sheet over a work surface with one seam on top. Spread the beef mixture evenly across the phyllo sheet. Top with a layer of sauce. Roll the pastry into a large log and place ontop of the meat and vegetables. Trim the edge of the pastry so it will lay flat. Cut 3 diagonal slices from the pastry with a sharp knife. Bake 30 mins until golden.

title: Lamb and Bean Burros
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 3 cans navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 lime wedge
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, brown the ground lamb and drain fat. Stir in the beans, lime juice and rind. Cook until heated through, about 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter and serve with tortillas and salsa.

title: Yogurt Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat vanilla yogurt | 1 1/4 teaspoons coriander, powder | 1/4 teaspoon vinegar | 4 low fat flour tortillas ( corn tortillas or regular size cut them in half ) | 3 fajita flour tortillas, medium size
instructions: Mix yogurt, spices and vinegar until well blended in a bowl. Cut tortillas crosswise into fourths or fourths and place on a plate. Brush tortilla with olive oil or cooking spray then place on a medium high heat and sear each side on 1 side, remove from heat and place on a foil lined baking tray and finish by lining the tortillas with the warmed individual pieces of tortilla and rolling them up. Repeat this process until all four burritos are rolled up. When all you have done and have rolled them, place the wraps in a tray, cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or more. Preheat oven to 375°f remove wraps from the tray and place in a single layer on baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until they are just starting to crisp up. Let rest for 1 minute and carefully slide onto a hot plate to serve.

title: Roasted Cauliflower With Chorizo and Fresh Herb Rub
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into 2-inch florets | 40 ounces chorizo sausage, 1/3-inch dice ( smoked if you can � t find it ) | 2 cups mixed fresh herbs, including fresh rosemary, basil, oregano, cilantro, and flat-leaf parsley, plus additional chives, for garnish | 1 cup chopped mixed spice ( like cayenne pepper, salt, and fresh or dried, use the combination of both ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh nutmeg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. In a roasting pan, combine the cauliflower and chorizo, breaking up the chunks as it melts. Sprinkle on the chopped herbs. Cover the pan and roast the cauliflower for 45 minutes, adding the chorizo and herbs during the last 25 minutes of cooking time, or until the cauliflower is tender. Top with fresh herb flakes, nutmeg, and salt.

title: Genoa Salami
ingredients: 1 genoa salami | olive
instructions: Slice salami as directed on package. Place warm genoa salami on a warm platter and cover with olive oil. Sprinkle with dryed onion, sliced marinated tomatoes with sliced black olives.

Random Ingredients: masa harina,prosciutto,pork shoulder,self raising flour,green onion,french onion,pecorino romano cheese,raisin
title: Pork Piccata
ingredients: 1 lb veal shoulder or 1 lb pork butt | 1/2 cup self-raising flour | 12 slices prosciutto | 2 tablespoons raisins | 4 green onions, chopped | 4 ounces fresh pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1 ounce french-fried onions ( fritos ) | 1 cup sifted masa harina
instructions: Cut the roast into 2, 1/4 to 1/2, inch, cubes. Mix together the flour, salt, and pepper. Coat the pieces with the flour, shaking off any excess. Place the meat onto a dry cloth or paper towel lined baking sheet on the rack of your roasting pan, cover with plastic wrap, and place it in the freezer until very cold. Peel off the string from the roast. Sprinkle the rasins and raisins over the meat, and scatter over the green onions and cheese. Preheat the oven to 325°f. Line the rack of the roasting pan with a double layer of foil. Place the oven shelf just below the middle of the oven and put the oven back into the preheated oven. After 20 minutes, remove the pan from the oven, spread the masa over, and stir until mixed well with the meat. Bake for 2 hours, until the internal temp of the meat has reached 140f on an instant reading thermometer. Remove meat to a platter. Turn up the heat to 350f and roast for 10 minutes, or until slightly crunchy hot and crusty on the outside.

title: Sausage & Chili Sausages
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage | 2 cups salsa ( i use homemade, i have used a mexican ) | 1 1/2 cups gluten-free self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c place sausage in a frying pan and pan fry until completely cooked then remove, place onto a cloth lined sheet.. Paint the underside of each sausage with soured chili and sprinkle with salsa then bake 20 - 25 minutes until sausage is crispy on the outside and hot inside & golden brown. Serve with cornbread or pumpernickel buns.

title: Rice With Onions and Wine (Easy)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb white pearl onion, peeled and sliced thin | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or to taste ) | 4 cups white pearl onions ( approx. ) | 1 cup wine | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice
instructions: Heat the large non stick skillet over medium heat. Add the onions and seasoning salt and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Add one cup of the cooking liquid to rice and allow to dissolve. Cook for an additional 4 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is cooked, stirring several times. Pour the rice into a casserole dish, top with remaining 1/2 cup liquid. Place casserole in pre heated 475 degree oven and bake 20 to 25 minutes or until top is lightly browned at edges. Serve hot or cold, with any remaining cooking liquid on the side.

title: Hogao (Red Beans and Lamb)
ingredients: 800 g dried red beans | 1 lamb shank
instructions: Wash and sort the beans, ensuring there are no stones and debris around them. Soak overnight, or the lamb can be sliced and threaded onto skewers if you wish.

Random Ingredients: corn,guava shell syrup,italian salad dressing mix,cauliflower,yoghurt
title: Corn in Guava Broth
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into small florets | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing mix | 3/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1/2 cup corn | 1/2 cup guava shell syrup
instructions: In a large deep pan, combine cauliflower, salad dressing mix, hoisin sauce and corn. Bring to simmer while adding guava shell syrup. Reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered, 8 minutes. Serve.

title: Italian Wedding Soup
ingredients: 4 cups cooked and cubed beef | 4 cups cooked and cubed pork or 4 cups chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 lb ground veal ( optional ) | 1 package orzo pasta | 6 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 -4 bunch fresh chinese parsley, for a garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend thoroughly. Strain soup through a sieve. Adjust seasoning and use as directed.

title: Pasta With Black Olives and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta | 3/4 lb red potatoes, diced | 8 ounces black olives, sliced thin
instructions: In a saucepan cook farfalle according to package directions. Drain, add olives and potatoes with a dash of salt and pepper, tossing to coat. Drain pasta well and return to pot. Serve.

Random Ingredients: broad bean,tomato soup,dijon mustard,brussels sprout,pine nut,beef chuck
title: Beef, Brussels Sprouts, and Pine Nut Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs coarsely ground beef chuck | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 lb brussels sprout ( i prefer to cut them up and steam them for about 5 10 min. after cooking they are ) | 1 can broad beans ( drained ) | 1/3 cup toasted pine nuts, toasted ( see note )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook beef mince, stirring and breaking up meat with a wooden spoon until nicely browned, about 6 - 10 min. Drain meat and set aside. Return pot to heat. Add tomato soup and mustard and stir well. Add brussels sprouts, drained broad beans and pine nuts. Simmer for 2 - 3 minutues or until brussels sprouts are tender. Taste and adjust seasoning with more dijon if desired. Transfer to a 2 to 3 quart casserole and top with toasted pine nuts and toasted pine nuts. Note, to toast pine nuts, place in pan in high heat and toast and stir frequently with a fork until nuts are dark brown and the toast is crisp. Note, to toast pine nuts, toast them in a 425 degree oven until brown and crisp, 3 - 5 minute. Watch them carefully, as pine nuts burn easily. To toast peppercorns, place in pan on medium heat. Turn heat down to low, cover and keep warm. When meat mixture is done, remove from heat and mix in about a cup or 2 of prepared broad bean tomato soup or can of drained broad bean sauce.

title: Easy Grape Soup
ingredients: 2 cups red seedless grapes | 3 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Wash grapes. In a 6 cup canning jar shake grapes so that all the grapes are covered with water. Boil the bouillon down until it is clear and starts to dissolve. Pour into large pot. Fill with water that will cover grapes. Place on stove and simmer 15 minutes or until grapes become bright green and they can be picked off the stem. If you notice the bottom of they get too dark place lid on pot and let simmer for 5 more minutes. Serve in large bowls and top with your favorite fillings such as sour cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,green bell pepper,scotch bonnet pepper,lamb
title: Cambodian Hamburgers
ingredients: 2 lbs pork or 2 lbs beef, cut into bite sized chunks ( ask your butcher to do this! ) | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 inch fresh scotch bonnet pepper | 1 green bell pepper
instructions: Cut up the meat of your choice, leaving just about any fat in the meat. Mix the garlic paste with the scotch bonnet pepper. Coat each piece of meat with the paste mixture. Leave some space on the meat. Barbeque or grill for at least four hours, turning the meat and basting frequently. The meat should be pink inside and tender inside when done.

title: Real French Onion Toasts
ingredients: 16 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1 package shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place bread slices on a clean, dry surface. Evenly spread 3/4 of the swiss cheese onto bread. Evenly spread more swiss cheese on top of swiss cheese. Starting with the bread on the right side of each slice, place the bread slices in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,tart apple,skewer,sherry wine,cider vinegar,asparagus spear,brown rice
title: Apple Asparagus and Skewer Pilaff
ingredients: 2 stalks of asparagus spears | 2 teaspoons sherry wine | 2 firm tart apples | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 3/4 cups warm chicken stock | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 6 skewers
instructions: Heat grill to medium. Cut tips off asparagus tips, then cut 1/2 thick. Trim and slice across the base just under the core. Place on skewers and brush with wine. Heat a wok over high heat and add 1 tablespoon olive oil. Add the asparagus. Fry for 2 minutes. Remove. Add 2 teaspoons sherry and apple slices. Sauté for 2 minutes. Add stock and vinegar. Mix well. Bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat to very low. Simmer for 20 minutes. Lift out the skewers and place on serving plate. Top with sauce. Serve with sautéed asparagus tips.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,rosemary,new potato,artichoke heart,cooking spray,red chili powder,grapefruit,pinto bean
title: Tropical Potatoes With Artichoke and Pit Roasted Beans #5FIX
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 cup peeled grapefruit size fresh red grapefruit, peeled ( about 15 ) | cooking spray | 8 ounces small new potatoes | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder, divided | 2 cans quartered artichoke hearts, rinsed and drained
instructions: Spray 2 quart shallow baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Place grapefruit in small bowl, cover with boiling water, and let stand 10 to 15 minutes or until almost tender.

title: Braised Chicken in the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, jointed | 6 slices apple, skinned | 10 leaves napa cabbage | 2 ounces bread flour, plus extra to dust | 1 1 tablespoon white wine or 1 tablespoon sake | 1 1/4 cups chicken stock
instructions: Put the chicken in the bottom of a 4 - 5 litre crock pot. Cover the chicken with apple, cabbage and a few slices of the napa. Tie the flour and wine or sake together. Pour over the chicken and cover. Cook on high for 3 - 4 hours until the meat changes colour and is tender. Remove the chicken and rest for 15 mins before carving. Serve over your favourite pasta, topped with cheese, chardonnay or parmesan and salad leaves.

title: The Best Sausage and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs of fully-trim off lean pork shoulder ( i use the butt of shoulder but it does need to be trimmed of the fat and very finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs ( or dried herbs ) | 1 teaspoon mango powder, available from any good international delicatessen ( can be found at oriental specialty grocery store or www.oxfam.com ) | 2 cans sliced beets or 2 large beets, each cut into quarters
instructions: Place all the sausages, stuffing side up in a casserole dish, preferably one that’s about 3½ inches in diameter. Pour mango powder over all. Cover with sliced beetroot or beets, cover and cook in a preheated 350 degree oven for 2½ hours or until done. Serve with bread or crackers.

title: French Pea With Black Truffles
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs split peas, from 1/2-lb. split peas | 1 1/2 lbs black truffles
instructions: Preheat a heavy skillet over medium high heat, add split peas, and cook until puffed or golden brown.. Watch closely for foam or other signs of burning. Reduce heat, and continue cooking, stirring and stirring every 10 minutes, until a little of the liquid has been absorbed. Cook 3 to 5 minutes more, until the peas are cooked. Transfer the split peas to a shallow serving dish and set aside. Place the truffles under the hot griller of the skillet, and slice them into 1/8 inch thick pieces.
