Cook until the truffles are crisp and lightly brown. When the peas have been drained, transfer them to the serving dish and serve.

title: Spicy Mexican Pizza Salad
ingredients: 1 lb short-grain and wild bulgur ( see note ) | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained, but not rinsed | 1/3 cup chickpeas, drained, but not rinsed ( see note ) | 12 ounces uncooked medium shell pasta, such as mini macaroni or 12 ounces pizza dough | 1 teaspoon sriracha sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 1/3 cup coarsely crumbled soft low-sodium plain yogurt ( see note ) or 1/3 cup regular greek yogurt ( see note ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh chives or 1/2 cup green onion, such as snipped fresh chives
instructions: Note, a regular 8 round baking tray is used for this recipe. Combine bulgur and garbanzo beans and spread evenly in baking pan, spreading evenly over bulgur. Combine chickpeas and chickpeas in food processor and process until smooth, or pulse a few times with the machine running. Scrape chickpea mixture into small bowl and reserve in refrigerator. In another bowl, stir together the pasta, sriracha sauce, and cayenne. Toss with pasta and vegetables.

title: Garlicky Soup
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 2 bunches italian parsley
instructions: Pour the vegetable stock into a soup pot. Bring to a boil, and lower the flame once it begins to simmer. Stir the parsley into the soup, and continue cooking until the soup is the consistency of soft noodles. Do not boil.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,creole seasoning,chilies,chicken thigh fillet,white bread,thyme sprig
title: Grilled Chicken Breasts With Chilies
ingredients: 8 chicken thigh fillets, about 1-1/2 inches thick | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 2 -3 chilies, chopped ( hot or mild to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig, plus more for garnish | 4 slices crusty white bread, buttered and toasted | 2 -3 fresh thyme sprigs, for garnish
instructions: Combine chicken, creole seasoning, chilies, and thyme in a bowl. Add bread and turn to coat. Marinate at least 1 hour. Remove the chicken from the marinade and arrange on a foil lined baking sheet. Preheat bbq. Grill chicken about 6 - 9 minutes per side, or until chicken is cooked through and tender. Garnish with thyme, and serve.

title: Tomatillo Bacon Lovers Egg 'n' Cheese Loaf
ingredients: 500 g italian cheese blend, diced ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup soft italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons instant yeast ( or 1 1/2 teaspoons dry yeast flakes ) | 3 bacon, slices chopped | 100 g mixed salad greens | 2 tablespoons tomato based pizza sauce | 3 egg yolks, lightly beaten
instructions: Mix cheese with breadcrumbs in a medium bowl. Fry bacon in a large heavy frying pan over medium to low heat, turning over once, until browned on all sides. Pour bacon fat out into a large bowl, reserving fat. Break bacon into small pieces and place in bowl with cheese. Stir yeast and breadcrumbs into fat. Let mixture bubble over low heat until mixture thickens and rises a little, approx 5 minutes. Remove cheese mixture from heat and stir in bacon, then stir in greens and 1 tbsp tomato based pizza sauce. Beat egg yolks until pale and frothy. Stir egg mixture into cheese mix, allowing mixture to cool slightly. Shape into loaf in desired shape. Place in an 11 x 7 cake tin lined with baking paper. Cover with plastic wrap or towel, then refrigerate for 1 hour. To bake loaf, preheat oven to 180 degrees c. Place baking paper on an oven tray. Brush pan with reserved fat and pour reserved tomato based pizza sauce into the pan. Place loaf on baking tray, then bake for 45 - 60 minutes or until golden. Remove from oven and leave to stand for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Feta With Pumpkin and Strawberry
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 14 ounces broccoli | 10 ounces strawberries | 2 teaspoons oil | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup of crumbled feta
instructions: Slice peppers in half and slit open. Blanch broccoli for 2 minutes. Remove stems and cut into pieces. Cook chiles in boiling water for 6 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain. Heat oil over medium heat. Cook chili, garlic and turmeric for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add chiles and chard and stir to blend. Place in serving platter and sprinkle with feta. Serve with a variety of crackers.

title: Steamed Vinegar Kebabs(ATK)
ingredients: 30 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes before use
instructions: Make your steamer for this, first line the bottom and side of your steamer with a single layer of the soaked bamboo skewers. Arrange your bamboo skewers in a cone fashion, and place them over the top of the bamboo skewers in the steamer. Close the cover, and allow the bamboo skewers to heat for 90 minutes to a 1/2 hr.

title: Garlicky Basil Tomato Salad
ingredients: 8 plum tomatoes, cut into chunks | 1/2 head lettuce, washed and separated into leaves | 1 medium carrot, cut into medium dice | 1 cup basil | 1 -2 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: Wash and cut your lettuce into bite size pieces. Steam or dry fry the tomato chunks until they are done. Set aside. Chop the basil and carrot into julienne strips, about 1 2mm/3cm/1 inch. In a small bowl place basil and carrot then pour just enough boiling water over them to cover it. Let sit for about 10 minutes to absorb the water and then drain in a sieve. Chill the basil and carrot slices. Tear up the tomatoes and add them to the basil and carrot. Toss well. In a small saucepan cook the oil until you can stick a toothpick through the basil easily. Use only enough oil to coat the tomatoes and let the tomatoes absorb the excess oil and get crispy. If the tomatoes aren't crisp when you touch them, you may want to add water or milk. This will stop the oil seeping into the tomatoes. Remove the toothpick and then dip the tomatoes in the oil so they don't stick and then transfer them to a serving bowl. Chill the tomatoes before serving enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,banana liqueur,cremini mushroom,asiago cheese,lemon juice zest
title: Banana and Asiago Mushroom Rollups
ingredients: 1 cup asiago cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons low-fat cremini mushrooms, sliced very thinly | 4 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 teaspoons lemon juice and zest of, grated | 1 tablespoon banana liqueur | 5 cups hot cooked asiago cheese, thinly sliced ( about 1 pound )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degress f.

title: Ricotta and Vegetable Bake
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup corn on cob, cut from cob | 1 small parsnip, cut into chunks | 1 small zucchini, cut into chunks | 1 cup whole milk ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In a bowl, combine the stewed tomatoes, corn, parsnips, and zucchini. Season with salt and pepper to taste. In a bowl, blend the ricotta with a fork. Pour mix into a lightly sprayed 2 quart casserole to cover bottom. Cook in oven about 60 minutes. Serve over pasta.

title: Curried Tomato
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 can tomato paste
instructions: Heat the oil. Add the curry powder, stir. Add the tomato paste. Reduce heat to low, stir frequently until the tomato is heated through and the oil is absorbed. Variation, you can make the sauce the night before and leave on the side to let it simmer overnight. When ready to serve, reheat, stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: herb,lemon zest,grand marnier,red grape,spanish chorizo,hoisin sauce,wheat flour
title: Spicy Citrus Spanish Spice Cookies (Herb Snack)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 1 tablespoon finely chopped spanish chorizo or 1 tablespoon bacon | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 3 tablespoons grand marnier ( or other spicy orange liqueur )
instructions: Place the flour, herbs, chorizo and rind in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until very finely chopped. Add the hoisin sauce and grand marnier or other orange liqueur and pulse until the mixture forms a slightly grainy dough. Form the dough into a ball. On a floured surface, roll it out to a roughly 20 inch round. Cut out with a 2 inch cookie cutter using the 2 inch cutter. Repeat with the remaining dough. Cook in a frying pan over low heat for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Make sure they do not crack during that time. Cut out the biscuits as soon as it is cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Sweet & Savory Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas ( or any good beans you can find ) | 2 tablespoons kikkoman sweet soy sauce | 1 tablespoon dark rum ( i use kikkoman's real sweet soy sauce ( not imitation ) ) | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas carrots
instructions: Place all ingredients in a sauce pan and cook on low heat, stirring occasionally, until heated thoroughly.

title: Lemon Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon zest, finely grated | 1 packet ranch dressing mix
instructions: Put all ingredients in a jar, shake and put in a salad bowl covered with wax paper.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,vanilla bean,pasta,chocolate,red potato,bicarbonate soda,flat leaf parsley
title: Sweet Potato and Pineapple Pasta
ingredients: 250 g red potatoes, cut into 1 cm cubes | 200 g ripe pineapple in juice, cut into 2 cm chunks | 1 1/4 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 4 tablespoons fresh flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 100 ml pineapple juice | 2 cups hot cooked pasta | 200 g low-fat chocolate, finely chopped, for lining baking trays
instructions: Place the potatoes and pineapple in a saucepan with 2 cups cold water. Bring to the boil, cover, simmer 15 minutes. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Using a vegetable peeler, scrape off all the peel and any flesh from the skin. Add half the bicarb and mix with the parsley to remove any bitter juices. Place the split vanilla bean in a small saucepan with the water. Bring to the boil over medium high heat and simmer, stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Add the softened vanilla bean and stir. Pour the pineapple and potato mixture over the potato mixture and stir to combine. Divide the mixture among the prepared baking trays. Freeze in the freezer for 20 minutes or until firm. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Place the remaining bicarb in a saucepan with the pineapple juice. Split the vanilla bean lengthwise. Pour over 100ml freshly made orange juice. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer, turning down the heat, until reduced by half, around 5 to 7 minutes. Cool slightly, then stir through the remaining half cup of orange juice. Spoon the filling into the baking trays and scatter over half of the chopped chocolate. Pile up the cooked pasta and top with the chocolate. Return to the oven for 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Mexican Chocolate Frosting
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup all-purpose flour ( i use whole wheat ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 -4 teaspoons instant coffee powder
instructions: Mix all ingridients together using electric mixer. You may have to adjust to get spreading consistency. Use to spread on cake, in tacos, on sandwiches, etc.

title: Broccoli and Chickpeas Dip, 291c
ingredients: 4 cups broccoli florets | 1 large stock cube | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg, freshly grated | 50 g guacamole
instructions: Steam the broccoli until just just tender. Place the broccoli, stock & nutmeg in a microwave safe bowl. Cover & cook on high for 3 - 4 mins, stirring once or twice, to heat through.

Random Ingredients: avocado,tomato green chilies,plum tomato,chunky salsa,salt black pepper,cream tartar,mushroom
title: Simple Mexi Dip
ingredients: 1 can chopped plum tomatoes | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 can sliced mushrooms, drained | 1 container sour cream or ( 10 ounce ) container light sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 avocados, peeled, pitted and sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl and mix well. Transfer to medium serving dish and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Serve with tostito chips. The dip can stay refrigerated for up to 2 days.

title: French Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup non-fat powdered milk | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend on highest speed for 30 seconds.

title: Raspberry Jam Flavored Gravy & Gravy for Steaming
ingredients: 1 beef stock cube | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 tablespoons raspberry jam ( raspberry flavour )
instructions: Pour the stock cube into a pan, add the raspberry jam and gently heat it through. Pour onto steaming hot fish or steamer trays and set the steaming tray on the hob above the pot. Heat for about 3 minutes or until bubbles all over and a cube of bread turns slightly brown.

title: Mom's Favourite Beer Crusted Crispy Potatoes
ingredients: 1 jar regular cream of chicken soup | 3 cans dark beer, heated ( just a little bit less ) | 1 tablespoon dark beer ( optional ) | 12 toothpicks ( or 12 -14 small balls of assorted shaped potato stick ) | 1/4 cup crushed peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Using a wire strainer, drain soup cans into a large bowl. Mix in 3/4 inch beer and the dark beer, if desired. Taste foe salt. If you want to serve, spread the mixture onto a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper or waxed paper, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least an hour. Heat oven to 400°f. In prepared bowl or resealable bag, place toothpicks or balls of assorted shaped potato stick, about one third of the way up. Carefully toss or shake each piece in the beer and soup mixture until coated thoroughly. Place into a single layer on cookie sheet, close the door, and bake until toothpicks are browned and crisp, about 40 minutes. Remove from oven and top with crushed peanuts. Serve with toasted pita chips.

title: Korean Pancakes-Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter, for frying | 1 tablespoon minced shallot | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh lemon rind | 4 bananas, peeled and sliced ( about 6 oz. each ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Melt margarine or butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add shallot and cook until softened. Add lemon rind, bananas, lime juice and cornstarch.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,flour tortilla,edible,peanut oil sunflower,baking powder,enoki mushroom
title: Beef & Pork Soft Taco Fritters
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 4 ounces jar enoki mushrooms | 8 flour tortillas | 4 ounces dry roasted peanuts or 4 ounces sunflower seeds | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | prawn and edible mixed vegetables or chutney
instructions: Cut the pork tenderloins lengthwise into half inch long strips. Remove the tenderloins skin side down onto a piece of reynolds wrap aluminum foil and fold the edges of the foil into a parcel. Place each strip on the foil. Cover each side with a small piece of shavings of roasted or roasted peanuts or sunflower seeds. Sprinkle with the sesame seeds, and fold the foil in half to completely enclose the piece of tenderloin. Fold up the foil in half and pinch the edges together to seal. Place on a plate under a hot grill and cook, turning once, for 10 to 15 minutes or until the beef has turned an even, opaque color. Cut into small strips while still warm and serve with the toppings on the side. For chutney, place all ingredients in a heavy saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring to mix occasionally. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered for 30 minutes or until all the liquid has reduced. Remove from heat and stir in any excess liquid until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Spicy Garlic Toast
ingredients: 2 slices bread ( thick slices ) | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 teaspoon orange rind ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon tamari ( optional )
instructions: Lay bread on the work surface and spread with water and vinegar until completely covered. Using a rolling pin, pound the bread flat into a rectangle about the size of a large egg, about 5x4 inches long.

title: Mock Lavender Truffles
ingredients: 150 g milk chocolate, melted | 150 g lardo, liqueur ( about 100g ) | 1 teaspoon dried lavender | 1 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Line baking trays with baking paper. Combine chocolates, lavender and tamari in a small bowl and mix well. Using clean hands, roll 1 tablespoon of the mixture into balls the size of a walnut. Flatten each ball with the palm of your hands, about 1 inch thick. Leave a space between them. Place on the baking tray with the trays and bake in a preheated oven at 160 degrees c fahrenheit for 10 minutes or until lightly browned and chocolate is melted.

title: Lemon-Sweet Corn Chips
ingredients: 2 cups corn tortilla chips | 1 1/2 cups frozen lemon-flavored sweetened sweetened tomatoes puree | 1 lemon
instructions: Fill a medium size bowl with ice water and place it in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the sweetened tomatoes, about 4 tablespoons of lemon flavored sweetener, and half of the lemon juice. Spread the sweetener mixture onto each of the corn tortilla chips. instructions: Put all ingredients through a food processor or blender. You can either do this by hand or in a food processor. Store in an airtight container.

title: Ziti With the Chilli
ingredients: 400 g dry ziti pasta or 400 g rotini pasta | 400 g light brown sugar | 1 large yellow chile, deseeded and finely sliced
instructions: Cover the ziti in water and add 150g sugar. Keep this overnight. Cook the ziti according to the directions on the pack or according to the pack. When it's cooked, drain and put in a mixing bowl. Add the chilli to the ziti and mix. Place the bowl over a pan of boiling water or alternatively you can leave it for up to two hours at room temperature before serving to allow the flavours to develop.

title: American Style Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1/2 cup dijon-style mustard
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water. Heat the oven to 350°f. Mix the mustard with the spaghetti and toss to coat.

title: Crunchy Vegetable Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 ounces crunchy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 clove | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Place the peanut butter in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 3 minutes and stir. Add the balance of the ingredients and stir. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,chicken drumstick,sesame seed,red capsicum,swiss cheese,pecorino romano cheese,lamb shoulder,parsnip
title: Stuffed Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-sodium lamb shoulder, chopped | 1/2 cup parsnip, chopped | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 40 large chicken drumsticks | 60 g reduced-sodium beef and pork giblets reserved from pork ( recommended ragu bologna ) | 1/2 red capsicum, thinly sliced | 2 1/2 cups hot cooked basmati rice, drained
instructions: Place all ingredients except chicken in a heavy based saucepan and bring to the boil. Cover and remove from heat. Meanwhile place drumsticks in a single layer in four 6 ounce microwavable ramekins. Spray with cooking oil spray and place in microwave. Cover and microwave on high power for 3 minutes. Turn onto a plate and leave to cool. Meanwhile, drain giblets from pork. Drain excess fat from capsicum. Cut away skin and any excess fat from chicken. Place 1 tablespoon of mince and 1 tablespoon reserved garlic into the cavity of each drumstick and tie with a piece of string to secure. Place ham and pork mince into a large bowl and combine with cooked basmati rice. Spoon rice filling into the chicken flesh cases, packing any excess filling into the cavity of the chicken. Seal with foil. Repeat process with mushroom capsicum and reserved garlic. Place chicken on a baking tray and bake in a moderately hot oven for about 50 minutes or until chicken is cooked. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,cocoa,pine nut,pecorino romano cheese,cannellini bean
title: Salsa Di Fresa Con Endogio E E Fagioli
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 8 large green cardamom pods | 5 -6 ounces parmentino-romano cheese, grated ( about 1/2 cup ) | 2 -3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 -4 tablespoons toasted pine nuts, very coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the bean and cardamom pods in a food processor. Add the cheese, 1 tablespoon of the cocoa, and half of the pine nuts. Process for about 2 minutes until smooth. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of cocoa and the remaining pine nuts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,water chestnut,leek,kidney bean,tarragon,spinach leaf,tamarind juice
title: Tamarind Smoothie
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamarind juice | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh spinach leaves or 1/2 cup fresh cabbage, finely chopped | 1 small tart apple | 1 small leeks or 1 stalk leek, finely chopped | 0.5 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Remove the seeds from the apple using a vegetable peeler or a vegetable peeler. Peel by cutting a small slice from the top of the apple and removing the skin then halve lengthwise. Slice the apple vertically into about 1/8 thick slivers. Combine the lemon juice, tamarind pulp and water chestnuts in a blender. Chop apple and leeks coarsely, then add to blender. Cook spinach or cabbage in 1 t water until tender, then remove it and set aside to cool. Remove the inner core and any soft white stem from the tarragon. Add the tarragon to blender and whirl briefly to release the spiciness. Chop the lemon or leek into about 1/2 inch pieces. Add to blender and whirl briefly to combine. Serve immediately. Store the tamarind puree in the refrigerator for up to a week. The texture of tamarind should be slightly acidic.

title: Sizzlin' Pork Tenderloin-Apricot Kale Salad With Smoky Rub
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1/2 teaspoon whole szechuan peppercorn | 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon guacamole | 6 ounces kale ( about 2 cups-cut off rib ends )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f rub pork with pepper. Arrange on rack in roasting pan. Roast 20 - 25 minutes or until meat thermometer registers at least 165°f. Uncover.

title: Bok Choy Hot Dogs on the Barbie
ingredients: 6 bok choy ( remove leaves from hard stalk ends and scrub away outer leaves from the stalk ) | 1/2 cup leftover cooked meat, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon dried rose water | 50 g cheddar cheese
instructions: Remove the stalk from the bok choy and use a sharp knife to score the top of each leaf until it looks like you’ve started a small flower. Place 1 1/2 tbsp. Of the meat and the rose water into a small saucepan and bring to the boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes or until the liquid has reduced – this has to be very thick because of the high baking heat. Place 6 bok choy leaves on a plate and spread 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture with one end of the leaves or cut off the tips of the 2 stalks of bok choy, use a little more than a tablespoon if using a whole leaf. Spread half a tablespoon of the remaining meat mixture on each leaf and top each hot dog with cheese. Place on baking sheets. Place 4 - 4 hot dogs on each plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: kumquat,italian seasoning,egg yolk,olive,pineapple juice,white wine vinegar,red onion,nonfat milk
title: Kumquat Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 2 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon olive | 1/4 cup minced kumquat | 1/8 cup finely diced red onion | 1/4 cup crushed pineapple with juice, drained | 1 tablespoon chopped italian seasoning
instructions: In a small serving bowl, whisk together the vinegar, milk, egg yolks, and olive until smooth and creamy. Stir in the kumquat, red onion, pineapple, Italian seasoning, and vinegar mixture. Chill the dressing for 1 hour before serving.

title: Cajun Tuna Salad
ingredients: 2 cans tuna | 1 jar chunky salsa | 4 -6 slices cooked rice | 1 can sliced peppersoncini peppers, drained | 1 teaspoon crushed anise seed | 1 teaspoon rubbed sage | 1/2 cup diced pickled pepperoncini pepper
instructions: Remove the tuna from the water, and flake it with a fork. In a large bowl, stir together the tuna, salsa, peppers, anise, sage, pepperoncini, rice, and mix well. Cover, and chill overnight.

Random Ingredients: oregano,golden raisin,beef liver,beef cube,char siu sauce,blue cheese,jumbo shrimp,sea salt pepper
title: Caramel Beef Liver #RSC
ingredients: 24 ounces boneless beef cubes, trimmed | 8 ounces uncooked jumbo shrimp, peeled de-veined | 8 ounces char siu sauce, such as sriracha | 1/2 cup golden raisin, chopped | 4 ounces beef liver, thinly sliced | 1 pinch dried oregano | sea salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon freshly rendered beef drippings or 1 tablespoon melted butter
instructions: Place the beef cubes on the counter and set aside. Place the shrimp in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Allow shrimp to stand at room temperature for about 30 minutes. Peel the shrimp, discarding the heads and tails, and cut off the shell and reserve. If you are making your carne asada, peel the shrimp by immersing in a bowl of hot water for a few seconds, and then transferring to a bowl of cold water. Shake shrimp just until completely coated. In a large, hot skillet, saute the beef, shrimp, and shrimp in the sriracha for 3 to 5 minutes, or until the shrimp are cooked and slightly browned. Remove the beef on to a heated serving plate. Add the raisins, beef juice/drippings/butter and oregano to the skillet. Return the beef and shrimp to the skillet and heat for a minute. Top with the caramelized beef mixture.

Random Ingredients: potato flake,vanilla yogurt,ranch bean,herb,seasoning salt,chili powder
title: Tastebuds
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes ( peeled and cubed ) or 2 lbs yams ( peeled and cubed ) | 1/2 cup ranch bean | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( or paprika if you like spice ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or salt instead ) | 3/4 cup lowfat vanilla yogurt | fresh herbs ( chopped, your favourite ) or fresh herb ( chopped, your favourite ) | chili powder, to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the beans and potatoes and cook until just tender. Drain the potatoes and toss with seasoning salt until coated. Combine yogurt, herbs and a few chili powder in a bowl. You could also add whatever else you might like.

title: Curry Pork
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs boneless center cut pork chops, 3/4 '' thick | 10 1/2 ounces curry paste | 3/4 cup ice water
instructions: Place the pork between 2 pieces of plastic wrap and pound with a mallet to a even 1/4 inch thickness. The plastic should just come up to cover the pork. Using a sharp knife, slice the pork crosswise into very thin slices. Remove the plastic from the meat and lay on a plate in a slightly overlapping pattern. Set aside. Using a small saucepan, stir together the curry paste and 1/4 cup of the water. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Drain the curry paste from the pan and set aside to cool to room temperature. Place the pork in a large frying pan and add about 1½ cups of the liquid from the pan. Using a slotted spatula, transfer the pork to a medium bowl. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator approximately 2 hours. Remove the pork and curry mixture from the refrigerator about 20 minutes before cooking. Using your fingers, remove the plastic and discard the liquid in the pan of meat from the marinade. Reserve 2 tbsp of the liquid in the bowl and refrigerate. Cook the curry paste in 1 cup of the reserved liquid over a medium heat stirring constantly, until the liquid is reduced to a slightly thick, syrupy glaze. Stir in the reserved liquid. Heat 1/2 4 tbsp olive oil in a heavy large skillet and sear the chicken, over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until nicely browned. Divide the cooked meat among warmed plates and spoon hot curry mixture over. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,red curry paste,cane sugar,cardamom pod
title: Sweet Curry Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings or 2 lbs chicken drumsticks, cut into thirds | 2 large cardamom pods, finely crushed ( use black if possible ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( or more to taste ) | 3 tablespoons light cane sugar or 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: If using chicken wings, make several cuts along the bone attached to the wings at the joint to make them easier to peel the wings. If using drumsticks, trim off tips, and discard. Place in a large stainless steel saucepan of boiling water, and bring to a simmer. Add the crushed cardamom pods, curry paste, and sugar. Simmer gently for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has reduced and thickened. Taste and adjust the seasoning with more sugar, curry paste, or water if needed, and simmer for a further 10 - 15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked to your liking. Remove from heat. Drain the wings, returning all the sauce, and any remaining sauce liquid to the pot. Serve at once. Note, prep time includes overnight soaking and marination. The longer you marinate and cook the chicken, the hotter the flavour will be. Some times it is necessary to add 1 teaspoon of curry paste mixture to the sauce, but you can also add up to 1/4 cup of chicken stock and 1/4 cup of chicken stock as needed to keep the wings moist as desired.

title: Hot Bacon Kielbasa
ingredients: 1/2 lb kielbasa, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 3 slices bacon, cut into 2 inch pieces | adobo sauce, to cover
instructions: Mix the adobo, and put it in a fry pan, set in a 400°f oven. On the bottom of the fry pan, layer the kielbasa and bacon and drizzle with the leftover adobo sauce. Stir constantly until the bacon is crisp and beginning to brown on the entire outside but is not crispy and dry, about 3 - 4 minutes.

title: Pork Medallions
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons finely shredded orange peel | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Mix sour cream, orange peel and mushroom soup together and chill overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut tenderloin into slices 1/2 thick. Place in shallow, 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle evenly with nutmeg. Bake uncovered in preheated oven 35 to 40 minutes, or until no longer pink in center and juices run clear.

title: Classic Granola
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden brown sugar, packed | 1/4 cup beef stock, made with salt | 4 cups quinoa, washed
instructions: In a 5 to 6 qt saucepan over medium heat, combine the sugar, stock made with salt and quinoa. Bring to a boil, stirring continuously. Reduce heat to low and cover. Cook for 10 minutes. Transfer mixture to a bowl. With a slotted spoon, remove any grains that may be sticking to the bottom of the saucepan and place in the pot. Add more liquid if needed or, with a handheld potato masher, gently mash the quinoa to thicken the sauce. Return pan to stove and cook, stirring, over medium heat till mixture has absorbed the sauce, about five to six minutes. Pour the sauce into a 2 cup measure, and stir in the sugar. Serve warm or cold.

title: Barbecued White Beans With Smoked Bacon and Mushrooms
ingredients: 400 g white beans, drained | 4 slices bacon, sliced | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | bamboo shoot ( optional ) | fresh rocket
instructions: Lay the bacon and mushrooms into a hot frying pan or griddle. Sauté for 10 - 15 mins, turning until the bacon is cooked and lightly browned. Leave to one side only. Put the drained beans into a large bowl, add enough cold water to just cover them. Heat a griddle pan over a medium heat. Squeeze the juice into the pan and cook for 2 minutes, until syrupy and syrupy. Whisk and set aside. Put the bacon and mushrooms onto a hot greased griddle pan or griddle. Add a dash or so of extra lemon zest, and a good sprinkling of lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,pear,guinness stout,basil pesto,white pepper,red cabbage,red snapper fillet
title: Guinness Battered Fish With Basil Pesto Salad
ingredients: 1 bottle low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 cup basil pesto, fresh garlic-flavored ( see note ) | 1/2 cup guinness stout | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 lb fresh red snapper fillet | 1/4 cup thinly sliced red cabbage | 8 large thin to medium pears
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 450 degrees. Mix yogurt and pesto in a medium bowl and set aside. In a second medium bowl stir white pepper into beer until melted, about 1 minute. Sprinkle mustard and pepper mixture evenly on both sides of fish. Wrap fish in foil and bake until fish is just cooked and flesh flakes easily when tested with a fork, about 15 minutes. Remove fish from oven and set aside to cool off. While fish is cooling, transfer lettuce to serving platter. Arrange fish on lettuce and pour 1/4 cup of pesto over. Top with sautéed cabbage and 2 pears.

title: German Onion Rings
ingredients: 6 slices rye bread | 1/4 cup dried onion flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the bread with the dry minced onion flakes. Spread approximately 1 3/4 teaspoons of the dried onion flakes onto each slice of bread on each slice. Place bread onto nonstick baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for about 10 minutes, or until bread is toasted.

title: Cornish Game Hens and Cornish Cakes
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken, cut into 6 serving size pieces | 1 cornish hen, cut into 6 serving size pieces | coarsely chopped shisho bushel sesame oil | ice water
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, place the cut up chicken, hen, sesame oil, and ice water. With your hands, work the mixture together making sure that the chicken is thoroughly coated with the mixture. Add more if necessary. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 - 24 hours. Remove the plastic wrap and turn the mixture over several times. Toss to coat evenly. Repeat until desired color is achieved. Remove to a large platter and serve with kimchi or other dipping sauce.

title: Beer and Canned Fish Tacos
ingredients: 3 gallons seafood cooking liquid ( commercial fish can also be used ) | 20 dill pickled ginger beer | taco sauce, your choice
instructions: In a large, heavy stockpot, heat the seafood liquid until quite warm. Turn heat down to a very gentle simmer. Using tongs, dip the cans of fish in the liquid until drained well and then into a large plastic zipper bag, coating evenly. Place in a large bowl and pour the beer over the fish. Allow to stand at room temperature for approximately 1 hour or better, stirring carefully every 15 minutes or so to insure even distribution. When ready to serve, heat up a large skillet so as to form a 'head'. Heat the oil on low medium heat. Remove the fish from the marinade and place in the hot pot. Sprinkle with taco powder and garnish with dill pickles.

title: Lime Cilantro Limes
ingredients: 18 limes, cut into quarters | 2 quarts chicken bouillon
instructions: To serve, pour a little water into a bowl, add the limes half way through, and allow the limes to absorb the lime juice. Drain the lime quarters, transfer them into the bowl, and add the stock. Taste, if necessary, and add more lime juice, but be careful not to overwhelm the lime flavor. Taste and adjust as needed.

title: Black Forest Cherry Chilies
ingredients: 2 cups dry shucked cherries | 16 red chili peppers, seeded with no seeds | 4 cups water | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried mexican oregano
instructions: Drain the cherries and chop coarsely. Discard any remaining cherries, reserving the liquor. Place the cherries in a large bowl, and add the chiles, water, vinegar and oregano. Toss well to mix, cover and refrigerate overnight to blend the flavors. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: vodka,poblano chile,celery leaf,scotch bonnet chile pepper,swiss cheese,black coffee,garlic clove
title: Smokin' Hot German Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 2 -3 poblano chiles | 2 -3 scotch bonnet chile peppers ( seeded if desired ) | 1/4 cup chopped celery leaves | 3 tablespoons chopped garlic cloves | 3 slices swiss cheese ( halved or quartered ) | 3 tablespoons espresso or 3 tablespoons strong black coffee | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Roast the chilies on an ungreased baking pan in oven for about 7 - 10 minutes, until skin loosens and blackens. Remove from oven and split open lengthwise. This is a easy method to get rid of the pepper skins. Immediately place open chilies in a plastic bag and pound gently to remove seeds. Peel off skins and roughly chop peppers. In a blender or food processor blend chilies, cilantro, garlic, cheese and the espresso or coffee until well mixed. Pour mixture into a shallow baking dish. Insert sliced chilies on top, cover and bake 45 - 50 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Remove from oven and allow to sit 30 minutes before serving over cooked egg noodles. Stir well and drizzle with more liquid..

title: Mandarin Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 8 cups chicken broth | 3 tablespoons finely chopped shallots | 6 mandarin oranges | 1 1/2 cups short-grain rice
instructions: Stir broth and shallots in large saucepan until shallots are translucent, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,bay leaf,lasagna noodle,stewing beef,thyme sprig,caper,irish cream
title: Carnitas
ingredients: 12 ounces stewing beef, cut into 1 � pieces | 1/4 cup fresh thyme sprig | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon coconut oil, or as needed | 8 slices irish cream | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 package lasagna noodles
instructions: Place beef into a bowl with thyme, bay leaf, coconut oil, and irish cream. Let marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes. Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread a layer of lasagna noodles over the baking sheet. Spread 1/2 the beef mixture over the noodles, top with 1/2 the capers, and top with another layer of noodles. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients. Bake in the preheated oven until meat is bubbling and noodles are tender, about 45 minutes.

title: Aussie Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 500 g beef tenderloin steaks | 300 ml double cream | 1 pinch liquid smoke | 1 -2 teaspoon tomato | 2 tablespoons double cream, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 c, 425f or gas mark cut steak into 4cm cubes. Arrange the beef in a shallow baking dish or roasting tin, placing in the oven along with the tinned cream and liquid smoke. Cook in the oven for 35 minutes turn and rearrange the meat if necessary. Once cooked, remove from the oven and allow to rest, uncovered for 15 minutes. Heat the oven to 200c / 400f / gas mark remove the beef from the oven, and sprinkle on all but a little of the remaining cream. Return to the oven for a further 10 minutes or so, until the meat is just tender and well glazed. Taste and add salt if required depending on the saltiness of the beef. Serve with salad and bread.

title: Ginger Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, finely chopped into thin peices | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 kg corned beef brisket, trimmed
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/fan 200c/gas mark 3/160c/gas rub the roast with the ginger, sugar, salt and pepper. Cover the roast with foil and place the roast in a roasting tin. Pour the half and half over the meat, spread to coat all around and roast for about 2 hours. Turn down the oven to 140c/fan 160c/gas mark 3/160c/gas mark 3/160c/gas mark 5 and continue to cook, with the lid on, in the oven for another 1hr 40 minutes. The meat should be well cooked and the juices should fill a jug with gravy or vegetables. Note, i usually set my roaster on the middle shelf to make a hot gravy, in which case you may have to turn the oven down a bit after the first 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,garlic clove,purpose flour,onion,french bread,pickling spice
title: Easy French Onion Bread for Beginners on Escargot Toasts
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces french bread, day old | 2 large onions | 1 cup apricot preserves, divided | 1/4 teaspoon garlic clove, minced | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon pickling spices
instructions: Cut 2 thick slice from top of french bread and remove thick slices, leaving 1/2 inch thick shell at edge of loaf if using metal. Working 1 at a time to avoid crowding the bread, dip each slice of bread in melted butter and lay flat on parchment paper. Using fingers or sharp knife, make slit on top of bread about 2&1/2 inches deep at narrow end of loaf. Arrange 1/2 cup apricot preserves in each slit. Sprinkle garlic over preserves. In a small bowl, combine remaining apricot preserves with flour and pickling spice. Dip bread again and spread with preserves mixture. Arrange on a buttered baking sheet. Bake under preheated broiler or in a 375° oven for 15 minutes.

title: Filet of Beef with Capers
ingredients: 1 cup canadian bacon, diced | 2 ounces bok choy, thinly sliced | 1 small bok choy or 1 small swiss chard | 1/2 cup fresh vegetables, chopped, such as zucchini, spinach, and/or zucchini, rinsed and trimmed of tough ends | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Mix bacon, bok choy, and chard in a small bowl with capers, bay leaf, and remaining 1/4 cup water. Taste and adjust seasonings.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,black tea,simple syrup,cherry tomato,phyllo dough,cake flour,lemon juice,italian tomato
title: Tomato-Chianti Tart
ingredients: 18 inches square round frozen phyllo dough | 3/4 cup cherry tomatoes, finely chopped | 1/3 cup sweet italian tomato, chopped | 3/4 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 4 tablespoons cake flour | 1/2 cup strong black tea, hot | salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons italian-style canned tomato juice ( optional )
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough onto an ungreased baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate while preparing the filling. In a small bowl, combine the cherry tomatoes, tomato, lemon juice, and syrup. Set aside. In a small mixing bowl, add the flour, black tea, salt and pepper. Combine until a dough that forms easy to work with. Remove the pastry from refrigerator and unroll it onto a floured surface. Pat it into a 3/4 inch thickness on your baking sheet. Using a floured knife press the pastry into the tart mold. Spread the topping over the pastry, leaving a 1 inch rim around the edge of the crust. Make a slit in the center of the crust, and pipe the filling into the slit. Brush the tart with water. If desired, line the pie tin with another 2 inches of pastry, brush with water and bake on a cookie sheet at 375°f for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and remove the tray from the oven, brush the top with water, and let it sit for 15 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board and cut into wedges. Let cool, then slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream,steak,french vanilla pudding mix,green cardamom pod,chicken
title: Panko-style Grilled Beef (Sinangas Al La Naan)
ingredients: 1 packet french vanilla pudding mix or ( 4 ounce ) package jello instant vanilla pudding mix, with cinnamon, vanilla extract, and sugar and salt to taste | 1/2 cup sour cream, at room temperature or 1/2 cup milk | 1 teaspoon ground green cardamom pods or 1 teaspoon orange essence | 2 lbs of sliced flank steak, well trimmed of excess fat | 1 bag french-style frozen french-style sliced vegetables, thawed
instructions: Prepare pudding according to package directions. Cool to room temperature, stir in sour cream. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 5 hours. Prepare beef by slicing crosswise across the grain into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place the beef slices in a resealable plastic bag and pour 1/2 cup of the prepared sour cream mixture over them. Seal the bag and marinate in refrigerator for at least 8 hours, or overnight turning the meat once. Prepare grill per manufacturer's instructions. Grill the meat over high heat until it is cooked to your liking, about 7 to 10 minutes per side.

title: Bengali Dahi Kebab | Aloo Baigan
ingredients: 3 medium aubergines | 1 inch piece french bread | 4 green chilies | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | salt | 1 teaspoon salad oil
instructions: Slice aubergines and french bread. Grill/broil them until it is lightly browned on both sides. Remove from grill and cut them into small pieces. Mix turmeric powder with oil. Dip kababs in oil and sprinkle salt. Place the pieces of fried aubergines on it. Enjoy with pickle. Please keep them refrigerated.

title: Steamed Spicy Fish Stew
ingredients: 14 ounces medium to large tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 14 ounces asparagus, cut in 2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup chopped fresh asparagus tips | 4 small baking potatoes, quartered | 3 anaheim chilies | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce or 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 teaspoon tamari
instructions: In a large bowl combine first 5 ingredients.

title: Gruyere Baked Chocolate
ingredients: 100 g high quality dark chocolate | 150 g gruyere cheese, coarsely grated | 12 water chestnuts, very finely chopped very finely
instructions: Put the grated gruyere in a medium frying pan and set over a very low heat. Stir constantly so as that it does not stick to the pan. When the mixture starts to bubble and gives off a slightly sweet smelling, you will see chocolate starting to melt around the edges of the pan. Pour in a steady stream, stirring frequently. The mixture will begin to solidify and form into small balls. Put the water chestnuts in a small frying pan and cook over a medium heat, stirring continuously, for about 10 minutes until just warm and still slightly chewy to the touch. Remove the pan from the heat and, using a small teaspoon, dip each ball into the grated gruyère and set the balls in an ungreased 5 cup or 1 1/2 pint ovenproof bowl or tin. Turn the bowl so that all the greases are distributed evenly between the chocolate balls and the bowl. Turn the oven up to 220 c on the lowest shelf of the oven, then turn the heat down to 120 c as soon as the balls are set. Leave the bowl in the oven and leave the door slightly ajar, which should be ready shortly, when the butter has melted and coloured to your liking. Leave the bowl to stand upright for a couple of minutes or so, to cool off. Once the chocolate has set, carefully remove a small piece of foil from the bowl or tin, spread it evenly on a flat surface. Use a knife or flat spoon to scrape off all the excess melted ghee from the bowl or tin, then place it on top of the chocolate and break it into pieces with your finger. Use a sharp knife to cut off pieces of the cheese at the same time, trying to leave a circle of goate across the bottom of the bowl. Place each circle into a large slice with the pointed edge propped up from one edge. Repeat this until the cheese has been used up. Store the cheese circles in the fridge between wax paper in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,sugar,bibb lettuce,french bread,spanish olive,palm sugar
title: Slices of Mojo
ingredients: 4 heads french bread, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 3/4 cup olive | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 14 ounces french haricot vert lettuce, cut into 4 pieces | 1 cup irish cream | 1 cup powdered sugar
instructions: Toast sliced bread in toaster oven until golden brown. Remove & place each slice on a large plate. Sprinkle bread with 2/3 cup olive oil. Heat large sauté pan over high heat. Sauté until a golden crust forms on the bread. Combine the rest of the ingredients and pour over bread slices. Serve warm.

title: Chinese Steamed Fish Roll
ingredients: 1 packet puff pastry, thawed if using puff pastry sheet | 1 packet cherry tomatoes ( with liquid ) | 1 tablespoon chinese wine | 1/2 cup bisquick | 1/3 cup chinese wine
instructions: Preheat barbecue plate to medium high heat. Unfold pastry sheets from a package onto a work surface and roll out sheets so that they are 2 inches in diameter. Cut out 4 squares of pastry. Place cherry tomatoes into a bowl of water and add 1 tablespoon of chinese cooking wine. Place the pastry squares in an 18 inch square baking pan. Brush the edge of each pastry rectangle with a pastry brush. Place 2 tablespoons of cherry tomato liquid and a pinch or two of salt in the center of each pastry square. Press the pastry square into the liquid. Brush edges with a little of the wine/wine mixture and pinch the top edge and the seams together to seal. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Bake fish roll on the preheated pan, with pastry dough on one side for 10 minutes, and turn over. The tomatoes will steam and get a nice golden edge to them. When the time is up, remove from pan and serve. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,no boil lasagna noodle,lobster meat,cream cheese,russet potato,onion
title: Lobster Lasagna
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 8 russet potatoes, peeled and sliced | 3 cups crushed no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 can or bottle white beer | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 container drained lobster meat
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir beef, onion, and potatoes in hot skillet until meat is browned and vegetables are tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove and set aside. Layer hot biscuits in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread about 4 ounces of cooked meat mixture over biscuits. Layer noodles over top of meat mixture. Layer cream cheese over noodles, and sprinkle with lobster. Repeat layers. Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive,seasoning,portabella mushroom,parmigiano reggiano cheese,meatball,pepper sauce,sea scallop
title: Pampered Chef Seafood Casserole
ingredients: 1 bag dried seafood cocktail meatballs | 1 jar spanish olives, italian olives | 1 can of peeled sauteed portabella mushrooms | 1 jar good quality fresh pepper sauce ( go for 1/2 a jar ) | olive salt | spanish sweet seasoning ( to your taste ) | shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Brown seafood on all sides in a good quality sauté pan. Drain water from the mushrooms if using fresh ones. Put the meatballs in casserole dish. Add peppers and olives, mix evenly. Cover the whole dish with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake in preheated oven at 350°f for 30 - 40 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Czech Cacik - Khom Szebokke - Cucumber Drink in Coffee (Niehtyta Cebola)
ingredients: 3 lbs cooking apples, peeled | 3 medium cucumbers, peeled | 2 cups coffee ( decaf ) | 3 cups sugar
instructions: The day before, slice the apples into pieces so that they get a little bit chunky. Cut the cucumbers into slices, approximately 1/8´´´´´´´´´´´´thick. Dissolve coffee in a cup, add sugar, and heat over low flame, stirring, until it dissolves. Keep stirring until you can smell a little sweet. Remove from flame. Chop the apples into pieces. Put half of the soaked fruits into a bowl, add half the coffee and coffee solution and mix thoroughly. Serve hot, and garnish with chopped sprigs of parsley.

title: Saffron Rice With Pork (Nepalese, Nepalese)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork shoulder, cut in 1-inch cubes | 4 serrano peppers, sliced in rounds | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 1/8 teaspoon saffron ( dissolved in 2 tbsp. cold water, then dissolved in 2 tbsp. cold water ) | jasmine rice | green chilies
instructions: Soak the saffron in 2 - 3 tablespoons cold water till soft enough to take in a mortar and pestle. Dry roast the chiles in a small frying pan till the skin changes color, and then remove from the pan and slice or grind the chiles to a paste. Basting the rice with the saffron water in intervals, for 3 - 4 minutes, while browing the pork. Place the pork in a bowl, cover with water and set aside. Place the remaining 2 - 4 tablespoons of oil and the peppers in the same pan and saute for 3 - 4 minutes. Add the herbs, saffron water and the rice and stir until just mixed. Cover and keep on a low heat for about 20 minutes. Serve with chopped chiles. Sugar substitute, 2/3 cup cornstarch mixed with 1/4 cup cold water, 1 cup sugar or rice flour.

title: Homemade BBQ Chips (Hot Dog Dip)
ingredients: 24 small chili-flavored chili-flavored chili dogs | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine chili dogs, shredded cheese and chili sauce in a medium size mixing bowl. Spoon dip into lightly greased or parchment lined medium size baking sheets. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: prawn,cornstarch,key lime juice,tomato green chilies,flour tortilla,sauce,hot dog bun
title: Prawn Tacos from the Pastor Food Network
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup key lime juice | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 2 lbs peeled prawns, thawed, tails left on | 8 -10 hot dog buns, split | flour tortilla
instructions: Combine first five ingredients. Place prawns in large bowl and add lime juice and hot sauce. Marinate 30 minutes. Thread prawns onto metal skewers. Season with salt and pepper. Grill over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes or just until opaque. Serve warm with tortillas.

title: Blueberry Scones
ingredients: 1/2 cup sugar cube | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon prepared english mustard | 1/4 cup butter | 2 tablespoons instant coffee ( instant expresso powder ) | 1 can blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place all ingredients except the blueberry in a bowl and mix with a spoon. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper/greased aluminum foil. Bake 35 - 40 minutes, until set. Top with blueberries.

title: Spicy Asian-Spiced Green Curry
ingredients: 2 cans solid mango chutney | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons green curry paste ( can increase to 1/2 tsp if desired ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons honey | 2 cups asparagus, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 large plum tomato, diced
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together mango chutney, cornstarch, curry paste, garlic and honey. Add asparagus and tomato.

Random Ingredients: fennel,cake flour,sherry wine,chow mein noodle,cocoa powder,rice
title: Chow Mein
ingredients: 250 g chow mein noodles | 1 cup cake flour | 250 g rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon fennel | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Cut the chow mein noodles into about 15cm squares and then into a sieve. Put the flour, cocoa, sherry, and 1 tablespoon water in a bowl. Add 2 cups of water and beat with a whisk until well combined. Put a little more mixture in the sieve and mix to make a thin paste. Pour flour paste into a large bowl and fold in chow mein noodles until the dough is too stiff to hand. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead in any leftover flour paste. Heat wok over medium high heat to hot and add 2 tablespoons of oil. Quickly, pour in noodles and spread batter into the wok. Cook for 2 minutes or until golden or turn over in a warm oven. Repeat with the rest of batter.

title: Italian Steak Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 -2 lb sirloin steak, cut into 2 pieces | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking sherry | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Mix sugar and sherry in small bowl. Place lettuce in shallow baking dish or on dinner plate. Toss steak with sugar sherry mixture. Cover and chill about 10 minutes. Preheat broiler. Remove steak and marinate steak for about 30 minutes. Broil steak 4 to 5 inches from heat 5 minutes on each side, or to desired doneness. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cauliflower Pork and Tofu
ingredients: 4 ounces firm tofu, cut into chunks | 14 ounces pork roast, finely diced ( preferably with bone in ) | 2 tablespoons creamy soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarsely ground almonds meal | 1 tablespoon finely chopped chicken | 1 cup cauliflower floret, florets only | 2 tablespoons coarsely ground semolina | 1/4 cup light cream
instructions: Boil pork until just cooked and set aside. Combine soy sauce, almonds meal and chicken in a small bowl. In a large bowl mix tofu and pork. Mix in cauliflower. Place in refrigerator. Place all ingredients in a crock pot, on low. Cover and cook 10 - 20 minutes, stirring 2 - 3 times during cooking. Stir cream into soup. Cook an additional five minutes, stirring continuously. Serve warm in warm bowls and enjoy notes, if serving the soup cold or warm, they can be covered and reheated in a microwave.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,whipping cream,chipotle chile adobo,gelatin powder,shallot,white wine,kielbasa
title: Chipotle Cream
ingredients: 1 pound fresh kielbasa, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 tablespoons unflavored gelatin powder | 4 spring onions, white parts kept separate | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chipotle chiles in adobo | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon minced shallots, white parts kept separate
instructions: Dissolve gelatin powder in warm white wine.

title: Sweet Chilli Crusted Scallops With Molasses
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 medium red chili peppers, seeded, chopped | 1 lb scallops
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Bring molasses and vinegar to simmer to thicken. Add chilies and scallops. Cook, uncovered, until scallops are crisp and cooked through, about 3 minutes. Serve on a bed of rice.

title: Rpe With Burgundy and Mushroom Filling
ingredients: 4 ounces mushrooms, thickly sliced | 1 1/2 lbs fresh tripe, cut into 2 x 2 inch strips | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup fresh rosemary leaves | 1/4 cup baking powder, sifted
instructions: Combine ingredients and coat tripe. Shape into 1 inch patties.

title: Macaroni and Cheese for the Free Cooker
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni | 1 tablespoon mixed peel ( optional and see note ) | 1 teaspoon macaroni peel ( optional and see note ) | 1 teaspoon chervil ( optional and see note ) | 1 -2 tablespoon coconut milk ( optional and see note )
instructions: Note, you can substitute or substitute half milk coconut milk for whole milk. For more sweetness, add a little tbls lemon juice to sweeten the coconut milk. You could also use fresh chervil stems for extra flavor. Cook macaroni according to package directions. When done, drain and place in a large bowl. Dry with paper towels and sprinkle with mixed peel. Note, if using dried chervil, add now, too. Dry on wax paper, or cloth. To make macaroni, drain pasta and rinse with cold water. Drain well, either on paper towel or cloth towel. Drain off excess water. Transfer macaroni and cheese to the bowl containing dry macaroni and sprinkle with the mixture of mixed peel, chervil, and coconut milk. Note, you could also substitute or omit coconut milk and chervil stems for the chervil. Note, do not substitute olive oil. Note, you might also substitute 1 1/2 cups of milk for 1 cup of sour cream, 1/3 cup for 1 cup of sugar, 1/4 cup of grated orange rind, 1/2 cup for 1 cup of honey, 1/8 cup for 2 eggs plus 1 egg white, 1/2 cup of flour, 1/4 cup of grated citric acid and 1 cup of raisins or walnuts for a nutty nutty taste, all combined.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,mustard seed,chicken bouillon cube,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Salmon With Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 3 teaspoons mustard seeds | 3 chicken bouillon cubes, maggi & knorr | 1/2 lb salmon fillet | romaine lettuce leaf
instructions: Heat a small pan to medium heat, add mustard seeds. When they start popping, stir in the chicken cubes and let them roast a few minutes, stir and let the water evaporate.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,radish,italian bread,red cabbage,bulk italian sausage,thyme sprig,dressing,balsamic vinaigrette
title: Italian Subs
ingredients: 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | 1/2 lime, juice of | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 head red cabbage, sliced or chopped ( 16 leaves ) | 2 -3 sprigs fresh thyme, leaves picked | 6 -7 radishes, sliced ( optional ) | 7 -8 cups bottled balsamic vinaigrette
instructions: Cook the sausage, crumble and drain set aside if needed. Combine the lime juice, lime juice, thyme and chopped cabbage and marinate overnight. To serve, put the sausage and cabbage mixture in the bottom of a large saucepan and arrange the radishes on the cabbage. Drizzle with the dressing.

Random Ingredients: almond,beer,sage,graham cracker crumb,burrito flour tortilla,soda water,fish sauce
title: Big Al's Beer Chips (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 2 cups soda water ( or soda ) | 6 -8 garlic cloves, crushed | 3 tablespoons fish sauce ( or soy sauce of choice ) | 3 -4 tablespoons ale or 3 -4 tablespoons beer | 1 -2 teaspoon dried sage ( optional ) | 3 dozen small round burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Pour soda into a large bowl, stir in graham cracker crumbs, garlic, fish sauce, ale/barley sauce, and sage. Taste and adjust as needed, making sure the salt level or flavor is right. Pour meat into a shallow bowl or casserole dish and top with tortilla chips, placing each one over the chips so they don't stick together. Cover and chill overnight if possible, and up to a couple days before serving. Variation, you can replace the fish sauce with a small splash of rice vinegar, or a small splash of hoisin sauce.

title: Liptauer Groenlangkaal (Liptauer-Swiss Style Red Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 small head cabbage, chopped | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion
instructions: Cook and stir cabbage and onion in a large skillet over medium heat until the cabbage is tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Simple and Low Fat Pork Roast for Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs pork loin roast | 4 -6 small cherry tomatoes
instructions: Place pork roast in a shallow roaster or heavy duty baking pan, making sure the sides are covered with as much of the liquid as possible. Mix the tomatoes with 1 1/2 cups cold water and brush over the roast. Cover with foil and put in the refrigerator for about 6 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 300°f. Bake the roast until it is cooked to your liking. Internal temperature should be at least 145°f for safety purposes.

Random Ingredients: natural peanut butter,sherry,champagne vinegar,pine nut,hot chili powder,cake flour,peanut oil,cubanelle pepper
title: Sizzling Peanut Shortbread
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 1/4 teaspoon hot chili powder | 1/4 cup cold butter | 1/4 cup natural-style peanut butter | 3 tablespoons chinese rice wine vinegar | 2/3 cup pine nuts ( toasted if you like ) | 1/3 cup peanut oil | 2 large seeded and thinly sliced hot chile peppers, rings | 1 small pared and seeded cubanelle pepper ( optional )
instructions: Using an electric mixer, beat the cake flour, chili powder and butter until well blended. Add the peanut butter, rice wine vinegar, pine nuts, oil & chile rings. Mix well. The mixture may look fairly crumbly at first but the chile is soon to come together. Turn onto a floured surface. On a lightly floured board, roll out the dough until 1/8 thick. Cut out a 7 inch circle using a 2 to 3 inch round cutter, about 3 inches in diameter. Place into a lightly greased 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with the toasted pine nuts, pressing them gently not to cover them. Prick with a fork. Bake in a 350f oven until the edges are beginning to brown, approximately 25 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from the dish. When cool, cut into wedges and serve. If making a snack, break into pieces and serve.

title: Pear and Onions
ingredients: 1 quart white pearl onion | 1 quart catsup | 2 large pie apples, peeled and chopped
instructions: Fill a large pot 2/3 full with water. Add onion to water in a large pot and bring to boil over high heat. Cover and cook slowly for 20 minutes. Drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the peeled and chopped apples into oven proof dishes in a roasting pan. Cover with wine or apple juice, cover and bake for 1 hour, or until the apples are tender. Mash apples with back of spoon. Serve at once from the ramekin dishes.

title: Spicy Garlic Mushrooms in Souse
ingredients: 24 button mushrooms | sweet sriracha sauce
instructions: Wash and dry the mushrooms as best you can. Wash and dry the caps and remove the stems with kitchen shears. Place the caps and the mushroom stem on a non metallic platter. Pour enough hot water in the mushroom to just cover it, place a clean cloth over the base of the platter, and cover with foil. Place under a very hot broiler. After 15 minutes, remove the foil in the mushroom using a skimmer or slotted spoon and place the mushroom caps onto the platter with the soft and tender stems. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Wood Polish
ingredients: 4 cups white flour | 1 teaspoon finely powdered peppercorn | 4 scallions, with tops finely chopped
instructions: Combine flour and peppercorns. Add scallions, stir. Dough may be stored for up to 1 week. Roll dough on a well floured work surface until 1 1/4 inch thick. Cut with a 3 inch round cutter. Transfer to a baking sheet covered with cooking spray sprayed with oil. Score top with knife, then brush with oil. Bake in a preheated oven 325 degrees f for 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Cut with a 1 inch round biscuit cutter. Let cool. You can store them in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,saltine cracker,beef bouillon cube,graham cracker crumb
title: Easy Cheese Crumb and Garlic Soup
ingredients: 1 -2 beef bouillon cube | 1 -2 lb graham cracker crumbs | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups vegetable stock | saltine crackers, crushed or finely crushed
instructions: Melt the stock with the bouillon cube. Mix the graham cracker crumbs and cracker crumbs with the crushed bullion, mix thoroughly. Add some of the stock to the soup and stir well. Bring to a boil and boil for another 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Vegan Ciabatta Pizza
ingredients: 7 -8 medium tomatillos | 6 -8 medium rhubarb | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | 1 cup vegan par-boiled tomato sauce | 4 teaspoons light miso | 2 teaspoons crumbled blue curacao | 1 package prepared pizza crust | 1 large fresh tomato, quartered
instructions: Combine the tomtoes, rhubarb, peppercorns, and vegan par boiled sauce. Spread onto the pizza base evenly with the miso paste. Top with tomato slices, then cover with vegan par boiled sauce. Bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 10 minutes.

title: Balsamic Vinegar Pastry Rolls
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Wrap a 30cm long strip of the pastry over a piece of greaseproof paper, and cut the pastry into 12, using a 4cm round cutter. Spray a shallow, 12 hole tart tin with non stick cooking spray. Roll a pastry dough circle out to about 6cm in diameter, and place on the prepared tart tin. Brush the edge of the pastry with a little water, top the pastry with another circle of pastry, and repeat. Trim the edges, cut steam holes in the pastry if desired. Bake for about 10 minutes or until golden. While the pastry is baking, heat the remaining balsamic vinegar in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring frequently. Brush the water chestnuts with the vinegar. To serve, loosen pastry from tin and slice with a fork.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,salsa,lime juice,olive oil,orange zest,simple syrup,grain white rice
title: Cuban Baked Rice
ingredients: 3 cups cooked short-grain white rice ( or brown rice ) | 1 orange, zest of | 3 limes, juice of | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 4 tablespoons simple syrup ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 jar salsa ( or to taste )
instructions: Prepare an oven at 350°f/180°c. Heat a grill pan or a dutch oven to medium heat. Arrange the rice on the grates and let the rice steam for 5 minutes. Transfer all the liquid from the rice to a bowl and let set about 30 minutes. Reserve the liquid and place the cooled rice in the refrigerator for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, place the orange zest in a small bowl, add the lime juice, oil and half of the simple syrup and mix well. Stir the rice into the lime juice mixture and set aside. Preheat the oven to 375°f/180°c. When the rice has about 15 minutes left to cook, arrange it on a rimmed baking sheet and bake for about 10 minutes. Transfer the rice to a platter and drizzle with the remaining simple syrup before serving.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,red pepper flake,tomato paste,italian parsley
title: Italian Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 6 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 teaspoons instant red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup minced italian parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer 10 minutes. Use as you would any tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,thyme sprig,curd cottage cheese,garlic,green bean,spanish onion,button mushroom,deli turkey
title: Mushroom Cottage Cheese Turkey Deli
ingredients: 6 -12 garlic, gloves, peeled and slit in half | 3 lbs small curd cottage cheese | 6 tablespoons green beans, drained or 6 tablespoons fresh peas | 2 large spanish onions, chopped | 6 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 -6 lb deli turkey, sliced lengthwise | 2 cans sliced button mushrooms ( optional ) | 4 -6 jalapenos, seeded and minced ( optional )
instructions: Cut slits in cottage cheese horizontally from top to bottom and place a slice of garlic inside each slotted half. Wrap cottage cheese over and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. In a medium sized baking pan, place drained cottage cheese, green beans, onions, thyme and turkey. Cover and bake at 325 degrees fahrenheit 40 minutes. Remove from oven and uncover to brown the top of the turkey. Mix onions, mushrooms, jalapeno or cajun seasoning in a small bowl. Place turkey in the center of the turkey slices and pour cottage cheese mixture over the top. Cover with foil, return to oven and bake 2 minutes, basting often.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,bean sprout,apple juice,kaffir lime leaf,thyme leave,black eyed pea,pork sausage
title: Big Sausage and Beans
ingredients: 3/4 lb smoked pork sausage | 1 cup dried black-eyed peas, soaked in water overnight | 1 small red cabbage, cut into thin wedges | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves ( or 1/2 t. fresh chopped thyme ) | 4 kaffir lime leaves, torn into wedges | 1/4 lb bean sprouts, rinsed and drained
instructions: Slice sausage in half lengthwise, then crosswise into 1/4 inch pieces. Place sausage in a 4 to 6 quart slow cooker and add the soaked beans, apple juice, chopped thyme and lime leaves. Stir. Cover and cook on low setting with the lid on for 8 to 10 hours or on high setting for 3 to 4 hours. Add bean sprouts during the last 30 minutes of cooking. Discard kaffir lime leaves before serving.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,chuck,horseradish,cucumber,green pepper,sharp cheddar cheese,vegetable stock chicken,serrano pepper
title: Cheddar and Pepper Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 - 1 1/2 lb ground chuck | 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock ( or chicken stock ) | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup horseradish | 2 -4 serrano peppers, minced or 2 -4 jalapeno peppers | shredded sharp cheddar cheese, to top ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta, drain. In a large pot, heat stock over medium heat. Add meat. Cover and simmer until meat is no longer pink. Drain grease and add pepper, horseradish. Cook till hot. Add drained pasta and heat thru. If sauce is too thick, thin it with some of the cooking water. Serve over hot, buttered noodles, if desired.

title: Kaffir Powder
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour ( all purpose ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons habanero peppers or 1 1/2 tablespoons jalapeno peppers | 1/2 teaspoon dry fry spice ( optional- i use 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes if you don't have any )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. On ungreased baking sheet, combine flour and chili flakes. Add peppers and fry spice to flour and pepper mixture. Work quickly into a dough. Dip a ball of dough into boiling water to form a circle 1 1/2 inches thick. Use fingers to pinch the top to make slits in the dough to allow steam to escape. Transfer the dough to a parchment covered pan. Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown and crisp. Cool on wire rack.

title: Homemade Cucumber Focaccia (Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded and finely diced | 3 tablespoons hot mustard ( the good stuff ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon ketchup | 4 teaspoons tom ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary sprig | 1/2 teaspoon cake flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and shape into patties about 2 inches across & 1/4 inch thick. Bake at 400°f for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: korean red pepper powder,avocado dip,salmon,cayenne pepper,large shrimp,pineapple orange juice,corn tortilla,celery
title: Grilled Gyoza Tacos
ingredients: 2 pounds large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cup pineapple-orange juice | 1 cup avocado dip | 1/2 cup korean red pepper powder | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3 stalks celery, coarsely chopped | 8 corn tortillas | 1 1/2 pounds shredded cooked salmon, or to taste
instructions: Place shrimp, pineapple orange juice, avocado dip, korean red pepper powder, cayenne pepper, celery, and tortillas in a resealable plastic bag.

title: Vermicelli Chips
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon sesame seeds | 2 cups vermicelli | 1 -2 tablespoon guacamole | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon ( optional )
instructions: Combine mustard, turmeric and sesame seeds. Set aside. Soak vermicelli in water for 10 minutes. Drain in towel. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until tender. Drain well, rinse well. Mix in mustard mixture and toss. Place chips on a serving platter and top with guacamole, tarragon, if desired.

Random Ingredients: tamarind juice,tart apple,savoy cabbage,pita pocket,baby pea
title: Cabbage and Apple Pitas With Tamarind
ingredients: 14 ounces tart apples, peeled, roughly chopped | 12 ounces savoy cabbage, cored and finely shredded | 40 g baby peas | 2 tablespoons tamarind juice | 8 pita pockets, to serve
instructions: Whiz the apples and savoy cabbage to a coarse puree in a food processor. Toss the peas with the tamarind juice in a microwave safe bowl, pour over the salad and scatter the sprouts around the top.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,cayenne,corn,apricot jam,cauliflower,kidney bean,grape tomato
title: Pecorino and Cauliflower Rabe
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower, trimmed | 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved | 1 cup dry kidney beans or 1 cup pinto beans, rinsed | 1 cup fresh corn, cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Cook cauliflower and tomatoes in boiling water to cover over high heat until just tender. Drain, reserving liquid. Chop cauliflower and tomatoes. Toss cauliflower with reserved bean liquid. In a blender or food processor, puree remaining ingredients until smooth. Add the pureed vegetables and tomato mixture and stir into pasta. Serve.

title: Aussie Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 400 g hamburger | 1 cup cooked chopped hamburger | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Pour into greased casserole dish and bake in oven at 160 degrees celcius for 20 to 25 minutes, or until lightly brown on top.

title: Granola Flour
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 1/2 cups cake flour
instructions: Combine golden raisins and sifted cake flour.

Random Ingredients: asian sesame oil,okra,mint leaf,cider vinegar,olive oil,elbow macaroni
title: Macaroni and Okra Salad
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni | 1 package frozen cut okra | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup olive oil | 2 tablespoons asian sesame oil | 1/4 cup minced fresh mint leaves
instructions: Place the macaroni in a large bowl and cover with lightly salted cold water. Let soak until the pasta is tender, about 7 minutes. Drain and cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, remove the stems from the okra and cut into 1/4 inch slices. In a jar with a lid, combine the vinegar, olive oil, sesame oil and mint. Shake the jar with the sesame oil mixture and refrigerate for about an hour. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and salt, stir to separate the pasta, and cook for 5 to 8 minutes, until al dente. Drain and cool to room temperature. Toss the pasta with the reserved vinegar dressing and serve. Pass the mint at the table.

Random Ingredients: rice,baby carrot,jalapeno jack cheese,bread flour,yellow pepper,apple juice
title: Tasty Mexican Stuffing
ingredients: 3 cups fresh bread flour ( or can sub all purpose wheat, whole wheat, sourdough flour, etc. ) | 1 cup rice, such as arborio or 1 cup carnaroli, dry | 3 medium jalapenos, coarsely chopped, seeded in for less heat, seeded if desired, and chopped for less heat | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 1 -2 1 -2 cup baby carrots
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, sift dry ingredients. Stir in diced peppers. Add juice, carrots and apple in small increments until dough feels like it is made from a stuffing. If too dry to get everything incorporated, add a little water and knead to make a firm dough.. Divide dough into 4 portions, and roll out as you would your favorite stuffing. Cut into desired shapes.. Place stuffing on baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 25 or 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,guinness stout,double cream,dark corn syrup,cayenne powder,yellow food coloring,yellow squash,balsamic vinegar
title: St. Patrick's Day New Zealand Squash Soup. (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 5)
ingredients: 1 lb yellow squash, halved, deseeded and cut into 1-inch chunks ( about 3 to 3 1/2 ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 6 ounces guinness stout ( just use another half if you're using regular guiness-will really add flavour to the soup ) | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark corn syrup | 1 pinch cayenne powder | 1/2 cup double cream, plus extra for whipping | 1/2 teaspoon yellow food coloring, for sprinkling
instructions: Steam the squash chunks until just tender and tender, about 6 - 10 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and transfer to a food processor or blender. Add the salt, guinness, vinegar, corn syrup and cayenne and process until smooth, adding a splash of cream if necessary to give a smooth consistency. Transfer the soup to a bowl and stir in the colouring. Divide between 4 individual serving bowls and chill in the fridge 4 hours, covered.

title: Grilled Jalapeno Pepper Patties(Mexico)
ingredients: 1/4 1/4 cup finely chopped pecans ( i use a mixture of both ) or 1/4 cup walnuts ( i use a mixture of both ) | 3 finely chopped jalapeno peppers | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Heat grill or grill pan. Mix the vinegar, sugar, & turmeric, then add the jalapenos. Divide between the 4 patties and brush on a little bit of oil. Grill or broil them, grill side down, until grill marks appear at each side or they turn a bit blacken. Place in a warm oven, and let raise temp to 425°. These can be served hot or cold.

title: Anchovy and Pecan Crumble
ingredients: 300 g pancetta, diced ( i use lean bacon ) | 2 anchovy fillets, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup parsley sprig, finely chopped ( i use parsley flakes, chopped ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 cup pecans, coarsely chopped
