instructions: Cook the pancetta in a heavy based frypan, uncovered, over a gentle heat, stirring, until it begins to soften, then add the anchovies and parsley and cook, stirring, for a further minute or two, then pour in the ketchup and increase the heat. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until all the liquid has evaporated, about 15 - 20 minutes, then increase the heat to high. Turn the heat down and cook, uncovered, for about 15 - 20 minutes, until the topping is golden brown and crisp and crumbly and crisp again. Remove from the heat. Transfer the topping to a bowl and allow to cool slightly. Tip the crumble mixture into an ovenproof frypan and spread the crumb topping evenly with a palette knife. Allow to cool before eating.

title: Taco and Wild Rice (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs wild rice, rinsed under cool water | 1/3 cup dry sherry wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning ( mild or hot )
instructions: Place wild rice in a large bowl and rinse under cold water to remove any debris from the rice. Combine remaining ingredients in a 4 qt. Heavy bottomed saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, uncovered, skimming the foam that rises to the top. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes, fluffing with a fork. Serve.

title: Nelly Rollups
ingredients: 1 jar creamy peanut butter | 1 1/2 drops green food coloring
instructions: Place peanut butter in a large plastic bag. Cut a slit in the top to see if the inside of the bag contains prawns in it, do not remove them from the bag, just remove the plastic bag. Dip the prawns into the yellow food coloring, shake off excess and place prawns onto a paper towel lined tray. Refrigerate for at least one hour.

title: Oven-Bake Scallops
ingredients: 16 sea scallops, rinsed | 1 head cabbage, cored and cut into 6 wedges | 1/3 cup dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the scallops on a baking sheet, sprinkle with salt, and toss to coat evenly. Bake scallops, uncovered, in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, until just firm. Arrange the sliced cabbage in a 9x13 inch baking pan. In a small bowl, mix together the rum.

title: Spicy Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup thai red curry paste ( sambal oelek ) | 1 tablespoon jam or 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1 small green chili, chopped | 4 -8 leaves fresh rosemary, washed and finely chopped or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the curry paste and jam together. Thin with water slightly if desired. Stir in chili, or chillies. If using fresh rosemary, remove the seeds prior to serving and gently stir in as desired.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,red chilies,banana pepper,spinach leaf,sesame seed,barley,serrano chili
title: Korean-Spinach Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked medium barley | 1 serrano chili | 1 red chilies | 3 bunches spinach leaves, stemmed | 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 3 bananas peppers ( optional ) | sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain the barley. Place in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until the barley is tender. Drain. Remove from heat, add the serrano, red chilies, and the spinach. Cover, and set aside to steam for 10 minutes. Remove the chilies, and drain. Remove the seeds from the bell peppers. Cut into thin slices. Set aside. Spray a skillet with oil. Place over medium heat for 2 minutes. Add the bananas and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Add hot barley to the pan, and mix. Remove from heat. Spread rice on a plate. Place the spinach and peppers on top, and sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,ladyfinger,malt vinegar,radish,pumpkin seed,egg,thai chili sauce
title: Nepalese Pumpkin Seeds Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 package of honey-glazed ladyfingers | 2 cups of shelled cooked yellow bell peppers | 3 eggs, lightly beaten or 2 tablespoons egg substitute | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup thai sweet chili sauce | 1/3 cup of roasted pumpkin seeds, ground fine | radish, slices ( optional )
instructions: Place a cookie sheet in italian oven to preheat to 200°f. In a large bowl, combine the honey cookies, peppers, eggs, vinegar, thai sweet chili sauce, nuts and radish leaves & mix well so they are mixed throughout. Spoon a heaping 1/2 cup onto cookie sheet, leaving room for spreading all the way around, as if making cookies for a traditional roll up dough.

title: Lorne Crab and Seafood Stew.
ingredients: 2 cups of shelled shelled green peas | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 -2 lb crab meat | 3 -4 lbs lorne crabmeat ( cooked ) | 1 medium pork hock
instructions: Crack the crab meat into the crabmeat & hock & remove the bones. Cover & refrigerate until ready to use. To serve, thaw the frozen peas, then drain. Cook with the crab, hock & peas in a steaming pot. To serve, slice the lorne crab meat & serve on the side.

title: Kale and Capsicum
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped kale leaves | 1 green capsicum
instructions: Simply remove the zest from the green capsicum with a sharp knife, remove the white membrane then chop finely. You now have 8 portions that can be rolled up and rolled individually before chilling. Place the capsicum on the kiltiges. Gently roll the lekkis over and tuck the ends under. Place on a tray and chill for about 30 minutes. Once firm, unwrap and cut into very thin slices with kitchen scissors, serve chilled.

title: Eggless Cheese Balls
ingredients: 2 ounces emmenthaler cheese | 1/2 teaspoon mixed herbs ( i used basil, parsley, and chives. ) | 8 ounces oat | 1 tablespoon italian dressing
instructions: Mix cheese, herbs, and oatmeal together in a bowl. Shape into balls. Cook on a griddle over medium heat until lightly browned. Allow to cool until room temperature, then refrigerate until set.

Random Ingredients: green olive,red pepper,vanilla bean,pork sparerib,walnut half,breadcrumb,red bell pepper
title: Spareribs (Italian Style)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork spareribs, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1/2 cup chopped roasted red bell pepper | 1/4 cup walnut halves, chopped | 1/8 cup stuffed green olive, chopped | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup seedless red pepper | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean, scraped
instructions: Place spareribs in a large nonstick pan or dutch oven. Sprinkle pepper over all and toss to coat. Cover and cook over low heat until meat starts to pull away from bone, about 20 minutes. Uncover and cook over high heat until mixture is almost dry, stirring often, about 10 minutes longer. Stir in bell pepper, walnuts and olives. Remove cover and simmer over moderate heat until bell pepper is tender and mixture is slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Combine bread crumbs and vanilla bean pulp in a small bowl. Stir into meat mixture. Pour over vegetables and stir to coat. Spoon mixture into an 8x8x2 or round serving dish to form a 3 level layer. Cut reserved 1/2 inch slice from edge of dish. Garnish with red pepper. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight.

title: Cheesy French Bread
ingredients: 8 slices white bread | 1 package cream cheese, softened
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Place the bread slices in a shallow baking dish. Beat the cream cheese into the softened cream cheese. Spread the cream cheese over the slices of bread. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until brown.

title: Spicy Carrots
ingredients: 2 large baby carrots, sliced into 1/4 inch thick rounds | 2 tablespoons chopped onions | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the carrot rounds on the baking sheet, and bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven until they're tender. Remove from the oven, and coat with the onion. Sprinkle with cardamom seeds. Sprinkle with the cheddar cheese. Return to the oven, and bake for an additional 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Veal
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cubed | 2 cups cherries, cut in half | 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Toss veal with salt and brown sugar to coat. Cook in oven for 45 - 50 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 170 degrees f or internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. Cool and serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: apricot,cream chicken soup,pineapple juice,feta cheese,asafoetida powder,chow mein noodle,bread flour,salmon fillet
title: Asafetida Fishcakes (Pan-Fried Salmon With Apricots & Pineapple)
ingredients: 1/4 cup bread flour | sour cream ( reduced fat works best ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 1 can chow mein noodles | 1 lb salmon fillet, cut into bite sized pieces ( i have used white fish fillet as well ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preparation. Place bread flour in a shallow dish. Stir in 1/4 cup sour cream until mixture resembles meal meal. Turn batter into a lightly greased 8 inch square pan. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes. While the bread is hot, place the soup, pineapple juice and asafoetida in a saucepan. Heat over medium until combined, about 10 minutes. Prepare noodles. Stir the cream of chicken soup in a small bowl into soup mixture until blended. Cook salmon until just starting to flake. Drain well. Thinly slice salmon. To serve, top each piece with noodles, salmon, feta cheese and a few crumbled feta cheese.

title: Creamy Hominy Con Carne
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh hominy | 1/4 head of cabbage, shredded | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: In a large saucepan cover the hominy with cold water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer. Cover and cook for 1 - ½ hours. Drain the hominy and place it in a blender jar or food processor with 1/3 cup of the cooking liquid and process for 2 minutes. Pour the liquified milk and hominy into a saucepan and stir. Bring to a boil. Add the cabbage and simmer for 15 minutes. Meanwhile whip the cream with the icing sugar. Add marjoram and stir well. Pour over the hot cabbage mixture. Cover and chill. To serve.

title: Lebanese Lahmi (Chile-Yogurt Sauce)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 small bunch whole fresh serrano chili | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup honey | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1/8 teaspoon mace
instructions: Combine garlic and chili in a small saute pan and toast over medium low heat until fragrant, about 3 minute. Do not burn. Set aside. Place yogurt, honey, chicken broth, and mace into a blender. Blend until smooth. Set aside. Heat skillet over medium heat until it begins to smoke. Pour in the yogurt mixture, reduce heat and cover. Cook until flavors combine, 3 - 4 minute stir occasionally. Cool about 5 minutes. Add chile mixture.

title: Sizzlin' Blueberry Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 inches flour tortillas, 6 inches in diameter | 18 ounces diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 cup crumbled blueberries | 1/3 cup dry white wine or 1/3 cup sherry wine | 1/3 cup crumbled blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Spray an 11x7 inch baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Arrange 1 tortilla on each plate and spread evenly. Sprinkle with 2 tbls. Of tomatoes, 1 tbls. Of chiles, 1/4 cup of the crumbled blueberries, and 1/3 cup of the wine. Bake at 450 for 15 to 25 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,red kidney bean,white pepper,orange,italian parsley,broccoli floret
title: Italian-Style Salmon With Broccoli (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1 orange | 4 broccoli florets, ends trimmed | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup italian parsley, chopped, plus extra | fresh italian parsley, for garnish | white pepper, to taste
instructions: For the salmon, remove the zest from a quartered orange, using your hands and a vegetable peeler. Rinse the orange in a clean towel until no blood runs and slice the flesh into chunks 1/2 inch thick. Line the bottom of a medium size nonstick frypan with reynolds wrap 18” heavy duty aluminum foil or parchment paper. Place the foil over the foil on one of the foil and arrange the salmon in the center. Wash the fish under cold running water and pat dry with a paper towel. Arrange the broccoli in the center of the salmon, with their tops side up. Cut a slice off the orange peel and remove the white pith. Cut the peel lengthwise into 1/4” wide, wide strips and reserve. Cut each strip crosswise into ¾ inch wide strips and set aside. Squeeze juice from orange and reserve juice. Place orange peel, remaining orange juice and broccoli chunks on top of fish. In a small dish, cover the bean and parsley with boiling water and set aside for 30 minuites to 1 hour. Drain and rinse. Remove rind, skin and all visible white pith from salmon. Cut crosswise into 1/4” strips. In a small bowl, combine reserved orange peel, orange juice and parsley. To serve, place 3 – 4 oz. Broccoli florets on each plate. Spoon over fish. Top with the beans and parsley. Serve with additional parsley.

title: Potato & Dill Wedges
ingredients: pastry dough | 1 yukon gold potatoes or 1 yukon gold potato, in wedges | 1 tablespoon fresh dill weed | 3 tablespoons lettuce, shredded | salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 550°f. Lightly oil an 8 square baking dish or pizza pan. Mix potato, dill weed and salt to taste and place on baking sheet. Bake 20 minutes or until crisp and tender. Place potato wedges on top and bake 6 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: rum,provolone cheese,watermelon,hot chili pepper,white flour,egg substitute
title: Spicy Eggplant Rollups
ingredients: 2 cups egg whites | 1/2 cup white flour | 1/4 cup water | 1/2 cup light rum or 1/2 cup cognac | 1/2 cup chopped seedless watermelon | 2 packages shredded provolone cheese | 2 sprigs hot chili peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a small bowl, combine egg whites and flour. Stir in water until blended. Shape into balls, and roll each one in rum or cognac. Place on a jelly roll pan. Bake 12 - 15 minutes, or until lightly browned and cooked through. Remove from oven, and turn over. Sprinkle on melon, then roll up. Place back in oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until melon is melted and sauce is bubbly. Top with provolone cheese curls and chilis, if desired.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,white rice,green bell pepper,plum tomato
title: Plum Tomato Rice Pastries (Cajun Style)
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 small green bell pepper, seeded, deveined, and finely chopped | 1 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup uncooked white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Thaw pastry sheets completely, then roll between two sheets of waxed paper into 12 x 10 inch rectangles. Transfer rectangles to a baking sheet. Repeat with remaining pastry. Mix bell pepper and plum tomato in a medium bowl and stir in rice. Spread mixture evenly over pastry rectangles. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 40 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,vegetable stock,veal,yeast,pesto sauce,tomato green chilies,rice vinegar
title: Pesto Veg Balls
ingredients: 900 ml vegetable stock | 12 ounces fresh yeast, in | 900 ml boiling vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 bunch mixed pesto sauce | 8 ounces veal, cut into bite size pieces | cooked rice vinegar
instructions: Pour the boiling vegetable stock into a large bowl. Add the yeast and allow to soak for 1 - 2 minutes. Place 1 cup of the stock into another large bowl, add 1 teaspoon of garlic paste, the rest of the pesto, half the veal pieces and the rest of the pesto. Mix ingredients together and add to the hot stock, stirring until dissolved. Stir in the rice vinegar just before removing the bowl from the heat. Allow mixture to cool. Add the rest of the veal and stir, breaking up any lumps. Cover and leave to marinate in a warm room. Preheat the oven to 375°f place the mixture into an oven proof bowl in the centre of the oven and bake in the oven for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Allow to cool in the bowl, remove from bowl and remove any fat. Remove the bowl with the veg and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil peanut,poblano pepper,white pepper,cocoa,colby jack cheese
title: Poblano Cheese with Cocoa and Queso Content
ingredients: 12 poblano peppers | 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1 tablespoon cocoa ( optional ) | ground white pepper, to taste | 1/2 cup shredded colby-jack cheese or 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese
instructions: Seed peppers by cutting down the top with a serrated knife. Cut peppers lengthwise into rings, then cut the strips down the center on the back. Slice the peppers thinly on the diagonal. Cut the strips on the diagonal. Put the oil in a large non stick frying pan or cast iron skillet over very high heat until you feel the oil starts to smoke. Add the pepper strips, and cover. Cook at medium heat for 1 - 2 minutes. The peppers should still be soft and the onions and peppers translucent. Add the cocoa and pepper. Keep cooking for an additional 2 minutes. After 2 minutes, spread the cheese over the top of the peppers. Continue cooking, stirring the cheese occasionally, until the cheese melts and the pepper strips are well coated. Serve on a bed of rice pilaf, or use as desired. This is wonderful fried items with refried beans as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: fruit,water,gingerroot,chicken broth,marinara sauce,cooking oil,sherry wine,onion powder
title: Onion-Ginger Marinara
ingredients: 3 1/4 cups chicken broth | 1/2 cup diced onion | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh gingerroot ( or grated fresh ginger ) | 1 cup mixed dried fruit, diced ( your choice if they are small, the whole, 1/2 cup is a good size ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil ( or corn oil ) | 1/2 cup water | 1/2 cup sherry wine ( the sweet sweet kind you can find at your favorite grocery store ) | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: In a soup pot, cover all ingredients with water and bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat, simmering for 15 minutes and stirring often. The liquid should be thick and simmering but not boiling. Add the sherry and onion and mix. Simmer for 2 - 5 minutes. Serve over cooked rice, and serve immediately. Variation, in the winter you may also add a few tablespoons of saffron to the broth or marinara sauce.

Random Ingredients: cream,asafoetida powder,serrano pepper,large shrimp,cayenne,pie crust,italian sausage
title: Spicy Italian Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 pound sweet italian sausage | 1 teaspoon cayenne, or to taste | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder, or more to taste | 1 pound large shrimp with shell | 2 1/2 cups sour cream | 2 small serrano peppers, minced | 1 package refrigerated pie crust, chilled
instructions: Bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook and stir sausage in the boiling water, Cayenne pepper, and asafetida powder until the sausage is cooked, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain the sausage, reserving the sauce, and set aside. Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Heat a small skillet over medium low heat.

title: Steamed Clams
ingredients: 12 clams in juice, scrubbed | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, fresh ground | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce
instructions: Pierce a few clams with a knife in several places. Steam for two minutes just until warm, opened. Drain juice from clams and place in measuring cup. Place a small, heavy frying pan over high heat and add the black pepper and soy sauce. Stir well. When hot, pour hot clam juice over clams, cover and steam for about 20 - 30 seconds, or until clams open slightly. Discard clams. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,dark sesame oil,red currant jelly,garbanzo bean,tomato sauce,ginger
title: Garbanzo Beans with Currant Jelly
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dried garbanzo beans or 1 1/2 lbs garbanzo beans, washed and picked over | 1 1/2 lbs canned tomato sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 ounces ginger, grated and peeled | 1 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | dark sesame oil ( optional )
instructions: Soak the chickpeas overnight. The next day, remove any excess soaking water. Cover with water.

title: Garlic Rolls
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles, broken in half | 9 baby carrots, halved | 1 1/2 teaspoons white peppercorns | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place noodles in a pan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook 8 to 10 minutes, or until tender.

title: Simple Easy Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 -2 large red chili pepper | 1 -2 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Dice and clean your chili pepper. Once you are done, put it in your crockpot. You can add a cube to dissolve the bouillon. Add all other ingredients. Cook for about 8 - 12 hours. Serve over rice. Serve with your favorite mexican dishes.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,red bell pepper,taco seasoning mix,salsa,date
title: Cheesy Roasted Red Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients: 2 large red bell peppers ( roasted, peeled and sliced ) | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 8 ounces dates, chopped ( or more, to taste ) | 1/2 cup salsa ( mild, medium or hot - i like mild and adjust to taste ) | 16 ounces taco seasoning mix ( or a little more as desired )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Pour jar of salsa into a 9x13 baking dish or roasting pan. Arrange peppers in the pan. Sprinkle with chopped dates. Mix the ingredients. Top with remaining salsa. Bake, uncovered, for 25 - 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Hoosier Version of Feta
ingredients: 250 g ground feta cheese | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Combine together the feta and chili sauce until well combined. Chill in the refrigerator before using as it will become too crumbly. To serve, cut with a serrated knife along the grain.

title: Kittencal's Easy Rice Pilaf (Arroz Con Gandules)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons calrose rice | 6 kalamata olives, chopped | 12 tortillas, cut into strips ( approximately 3x1. 75-inch )
instructions: Spread rice evenly into a microwave safe dish, and cook over high power in microwave on high for 1 minute, to heat throughout, but do not boil. Add kalamata olives, and stir to mix. Heat tortillas in microwave for about 30 seconds to soften, and then transfer onto platter. Pour rice over tortillas over olives, and serve immediately.

title: Chile Colorado Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 16 ounces enchilada sauce, divided | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 8 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 2 cups cabbage, shredded | 8 -10 cups ice cubes
instructions: Combine 1 cup of the enchilada sauce and mayonnaise, stir to blend. Set aside. Place sirloin strips in shallow dish. Mix remaining enchilada sauce and mayo and pour over sirloin. Refrigerate at least 5 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Spread a thin layer of cheese sauce on a large baking sheet, sprinkle with remaining cheese, cherry tomatoes and oregano. Bake till cheese mixture is melted and bubbly. Serve over rice, if desired.

title: Guests Cheese With Asparagus & Quark
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 12 ounces monterey jack cheese, at room temperature | 1/2 cup dry quark | 1 tablespoon cognac | 1 avocado | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: To steam the asparagus, in a large pot, blanch asparagus for 3 minutes and place in ice bath to stop the cooking process. Immediately slip off the tough outer layer and cut asparagus diagonally into 1/4 pieces and set aside. Place the asparagus on a sheet of foil and drizzle with olive oil. Flatten the asparagus with a rolling pin and place on a preheated ridged grill. When the aspragus is about 6/8 inch from the coals, turn and repeat on the other side. The goal is to burn the asparagus and keep turning the asparagus to avoid burning. When the asparagus is halfway cooked, remove the aspragus from the grill and transfer onto a plate to cool slightly. Peel off the hard outer layer of the asparagus, keeping the tips of the tips attached to the tips. Cut asparagus diagonally into 1/4 inch pieces and set aside. Heat the reserved asparagus oil in a pan and add the asparagus, chopped olives and cognac. Cook on both sides briefly but do not boil, remove to a warmed platter. Cut cheese in 1/2 inch thick slices, place on the asparagus and serve with slices of asparagus.

title: Chiles in Pear Juice
ingredients: 2 cans diced pears, in their juice ( the firm ones ) | 2 -4 dried red chilies ( optional )
instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in the skillet. Pour the pears & chilies into the skillet. Serve & enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,szechuan peppercorn,broccolini,orange flower water,tomato puree,white bread
title: Szechuan Peppercorn Toast
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, crusts removed and slices lightly toasted | 2 tablespoons cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 2 teaspoons orange flower water | 1/2 teaspoon ground roasted szechuan peppercorns | 1 lb broccolini, leaves only
instructions: Place bread into a food processor or blender and process until fine. Add soup and puree then add water. Add peppercorns and process until mixture is smooth. Spread mixture onto toast and sprinkle with orange flower water.

Random Ingredients: field mushroom,onion soup mix,coconut,rice wine,plum tomato,yellow onion,creamy peanut butter,rump steak
title: Prawns with a Spicy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon creamy peanut butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic and crushed red pepper paste ( from international food section ) | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 500 g rump steak, thinly sliced | 1 medium yellow onion, thinly sliced | 4 ripe plum tomatoes, peeled seeded, finely chopped | 125 g field mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 400 g reduced-fat canned tomatoes, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Heat a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat and add peanut butter. Cook, stirring for 1 - 2 minutes and then add crushed red pepper paste and onion soup mix. Stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes until onion is soft and onion is golden. Add sliced beef and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until beef is thoroughly cooked. Add tomato, mushrooms and rice wine and stir fry for an extra 2 - 3 minutes. Pour mixture into a shallow ovenproof dish. Cover with lid or foil and bake for 20 - 25 minutes until prawns are cooked through and sauce is reduced and thickened.

title: Eros De Tortilla
ingredients: 1/2 cup assorted frozen fruit | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 can fat-free refried beans
instructions: Rinse and drain fruit. Place all ingredients into saucepan along with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally until thickened.

title: Pita Bread & Swiss Cheese Dip on Flat Iron Griddle
ingredients: 1 pita bread | 3 tablespoons tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 375 g swiss cheese, grated | 300 g smoked swiss cheese, grated | 200 g green capsicums, chopped into small pieces | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill pickle
instructions: Heat the barbeque to medium. Place the pita bread on the barbecue and lightly toast it until it's crunchy and has turned a light brown colour.

title: Stew Beef in Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 2 cans bamboo shoots | sour cream
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f. Cut meat as specified on the packet. Place the bamboo shoots into a pan with boiling water. Cover and cook on high for 5 mins or until tender. Drain. Place beef in oven bag. Sprinkle with a little more salt and return to oven. Cook for 1 2hrs. Turn to low.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,horseradish,iceberg lettuce,irish cream,sesame oil,honey,cornflour,pinto bean
title: Baked Chicken and Bean Salad (Ngow Num
ingredients: 1 -2 cup cooked pinto beans | 2 -3 lbs chicken wings | 3 tablespoons coarse cornflour | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon horseradish or 1 tablespoon horseradish powder | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 -2 tablespoon grated horseradish | iceberg lettuce | 2 tablespoons irish cream ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons whipping cream ( optional )
instructions: First, make the dressing and set aside to allow time to thicken. Place the beans in bowl with the cooked pinto beans. To make the dressing, combine the cornflour, sesame oil, honey and grated horseradish or horseradish. Stir to combine. Place chicken wings on ovenproof or greased baking tray. Bake for about 30 minutes at 400°f, basting frequently, or until cooked through. Cut the chicken in pieces. To serve, arrange the chicken on a bed of iceberg lettuce and top with the dressing. Garnish with cream or horseradish sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: tomato,cardamom seed,breadcrumb,sugar snap pea,colby monterey jack cheese,peanut oil
title: Cheese and Pea Brunch
ingredients: 2 cups sugar snap peas | 2 cups colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded ( about 3/4 of 3/4 cup ) | 4 tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Cut snap peas in half lengthwise, then split lengthwise into thin slices. Place peas in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, then top with 1/4 cup and 1/2 cup cheese. Arrange tomato and remaining 1/2 cup cheese over cheese. Mix bread crumbs thoroughly in a small bowl.

title: Filipino Meatball
ingredients: 1/2 pound salt pork, cubed | 4 hard-boiled eggs, coarsely chopped | 2 ounces white chocolate, chopped | 2 cubes beef bouillon cubes | 1 onion, sliced | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Place salt pork, eggs, white chocolate, bouillon cubes, and sliced onion into a mixing bowl. Pour hot water over all. Mix until all vegetables are coated with the salt pork mixture. Let stand 30 minutes. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Bake meatballs 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the browned and crisp on the outside.

title: African Style Curry Powder (Sambharam)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground coriander ( or more ) | 2 teaspoons ground onions
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Use as you would any curry. Can be stored, in an air tight container.

title: Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon capers, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 tuna oil
instructions: Rinse capers in a sieve and drain well. Add remaining ingredients and toss. Garnish with extra scallions. Variation, instead of scallions, use green onions.

title: Filling Arroz Verde
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 2 packages yeast | 1 can tomato sauce | 4 tablespoons filling or 4 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: In a saucepan, bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Add the rice and stir. Return to a boil.

title: Ester's Saltimbocca
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hot italian sausage | 1/2 cup instant malted milk powder | 1/2 cup skim milk | 12 slices prosciutto, halved horizontally | 1 1/2 cups crushed ice
instructions: Turn a broiler rack 3/8 of the way up onto the rack. Arrange the sausage in the broiler pan. Sprinkle the hot malted milk powder over the sausage and drizzle the cut sides of the prosciutto around the sausage. Broil, turning with tongs, until the prosciutto is browned, about 3 minutes. Spread the instant malted milk powders over the sausage and broil, turning once, until browned. Transfer to a platter and keep warm. In a large, shallow saucepan, combine the milk and remaining prosciutto. Cook over low heat until heated through but not boiling. Remove from heat and stir in the crushed ice. Transfer to a platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,marjoram,chunky salsa,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,hungarian paprika
title: Seared Chipotle Salsa
ingredients: 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1 cup medium chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice and zest | 1 teaspoon crushed dried marjoram
instructions: Place chipotle peppers in a small metal bowl or saucepan and cover with water.

title: Sesame Capicola
ingredients: 1 package capicola, thinly sliced | 3 cups firm ripe pears, peeled and thinly sliced | 3/4 cup light corn syrup | 5 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Combine pears, syrup, and oil in a large skillet. Bring mixture to boil, stirring frequently, and cook 3 to 5 minutes to loosen syrup. Serve warm over capicola.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,beet,bacon dripping,sunflower oil,italian herb
title: Red Vine Ripened Beetroot
ingredients: 12 large fresh beets, cooked | 2 1/2 ounces sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 ounce fresh mixed italian herbs
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan, add the curry paste, stir fry for a minute or two until aromatic. Add the beetroot and italian herbs and stir fry for a further 1 to 2 minutes. Reduce the heat and simmer uncovered until tender when pierced with a skewer. Cut into wedges or strips and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,jelly,spaghetti,hot water
title: Chipotle Jelly Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups spaghetti | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon hot water | 2 tablespoons jelly | 3 -4 canned chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped, seeded and divided ( more if desired )
instructions: Cook spaghetti to desired tenderness.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,white crab meat,pork rib,herb,coffee,sage leaf,corn kernel
title: Cappuccino
ingredients: 500 g black bean pork ribs, chopped | 500 g ground white crabmeat | 2 large fresh sage leaves | 500 g corn kernels ( canned ) | 1 -2 tablespoon instant coffee | chocolate shavings of your choice | 2 -3 tablespoons cocoa
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well using your hands. Put in a freezer bag and freeze in freezer until required. Remove from the freezer once its cold. Break into small pieces and mix with your hands until well mixed. Shape into small balls. Heat a small non stick frying pan over medium high heat. Add half of the coconut mixture to the pan. Cook for a few minutes until golden and crisp then flip and flatten with hand dipped in coconut.

Random Ingredients: green bean,maple syrup,kosher salt,pecorino romano cheese,fettuccine,celery seed,canadian bacon
title: Fettuccine With Canadian Bacon and Green Beans
ingredients: 12 ounces dry fettuccine ( about 16 oz ) | 1/3 cup canadian bacon, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons light mayonnaise or 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 cup finely diced celery seed | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | kosher salt, coarsely sprinkled
instructions: Cook fettuccini to desired doneness according to package directions, or until tender but firm to the bite and drain. Immediately toss cooked fettuccini with bacon bits, celery seeds, cheese, and salt. Drain fettuccine briefly and serve.

Random Ingredients: white miso,flour,kombu,beer,green mango,ancho chile,lettuce leaf,chicken stock
title: Ancho Chile and Mango Soup
ingredients: 1 cup canned ancho chiles, drained | 3 tablespoons miso, plus | 2 tablespoons miso | 6 -8 cups chicken stock | 32 ounces beer | 6 dried kombu, soaked in boiling water for 15 minutes, drained | 20 large leaves lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup flour
instructions: Finely mince the chiles. Add the kombu and the remaining 3 tbsp miso to a food processor or blender and process to make a fine paste. Add the stock and beer and process until a smooth, thick paste is formed. Wash the lettuce and drain. Add to food processor or blender one handful at a time, pulsing constantly, to produce long strips. Divide the mixture into 4 to 6 balls. Roll each ball between your hands to form a ball, then press into the flour to coat. Shake off excess flour and cut into cubes. Tear or cut the mache into bite size bits and drop in with the soup. Heat through and serve at once.

title: Spicy Nachos - Party Bites
ingredients: 6 -12 ounces shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup red curry paste ( i prefer kikkoman brand, but if you can't find kikkoman, you can use colby jack or even a combination ) | aluminum foil, for the buns
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium. Lay out a piece of aluminum foil about 2 inches long and 2 inches wide. Place all 6 oz. Cheddar cheese on the foil. Spread about 1 cup of the red curry paste on top of cheddar cheese. Using a finger, spread it evenly over the cheese and curry paste. Fold the foil over the cheese. Grill on the grates, turning frequently, until cheese is melted, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Creamy Rice and Beans
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1 cup cooked rice | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup pitted black olives ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice, let it cool, stir occasionally. Mix everything together and refrigerate it for 30 minutes or longer. Serve with pita bread and lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,serrano chilies,shallot,jasmine rice,red curry paste
title: Crispy Red Curry Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 4 cups red curry paste ( depending on taste ) | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 shallot, finely minced | 1 -2 serrano chilies, finely minced ( depending on taste ) or 1 jalapeno, minced ( depending on flavor )
instructions: Start rice. Soak chilies in hot water for at least 15 minutes. Place chilies in a blender jar with as many as you like, including the water they soaked inches pulse several times, until small bits come out of the chilies and start adding to the blender with the rest of the water the chilies were soaking in. If you have a mortar and pestle, you could use that first. If not, add more water. Blend well until it forms a reasonably smooth paste, but not pureed. It should be a little grainy, but not quite mushy and a little bit pasty don't overprocess. It might even clump up like a paste, but this is the way it should be. This step is optional but i think it gives it a good kick. This is your recipe, so if you make it ahead and freeze it for later use, you will need to do it, because you will be using it straight out of the refrigerator. It is not safe in microwave and you will have to repeat this if you wish. Place the rice in a saucepan and pour hot water so it is covered. Bring rice to boil and then remove from heat. Cover and let sit for 5 - 7 minutes. Then drain the rice and add it to your food processor or blender. In the food processor, if it has been in the blender for at least 10 - 15 seconds, blend it while you are slowly pouring in a thin stream of curry paste and continue to blend. You will need 1/4 cup of paste for each serving. To serve, spoon rice on a platter. Top with a curry base. Garnish with green onions and jalapenos.

title: Korean Grilled Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 cabbage leaf, cut into 1/2-inch slices ( i use a mixture of the large and the very small leafy variety ) | chili seasoning mix
instructions: Prepare grill by spraying grill with cooking spray. Arrange cabbage on the grill rack. Spray the cabbage lightly with cooking spray, just like you would for a bbq. Grill vegetables over medium heat on the grill until tender, about 5 minutes per side for white and 15 - 20 minutes for dark green leaves. Slice cabbage crosswise, fanning it out a little. Serve hot.

title: Ham & Olive Surprise
ingredients: 200 g ham | 200 g green olives | 200 g sun-dried tomatoes | 1 teaspoon roux
instructions: Cut ham into small square cubes. Cut sun dried tomatoes into small squares. Heat the roux in a wok or medium sized frying pan until it starts bubbling. Pour the roux into the pan and stir constantly until it starts to turn golden add ham and mix well. Add the olives and sun dried tomatoes. Place in oven at 230c for approximately 25 minutes. The mixture should be quite moist. When cooked, serve and enjoy.

title: Spinach, Pineapple and Hawaiian Swiss Fondue
ingredients: 2 cans pineapple chunks, drained | 1 package provolone cheese or ( 9 ounce ) package cheddar cheese, grated | 2 packages frozen strawberries
instructions: Put the pineapple, cheese and frozen strawberries into a crock pot. Top with the dry crusty bread to fit on top. Do not remove cheese unless you want to serve right away. Cook on high for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,balsamic vinegar,mint sprig,molasses,active yeast,russet potato
title: French Quarter Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice, chilled | 3 tablespoons molasses, chilled | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 5 cups russet potatoes, cut into 1-inch-thick rounds, 1/2-3/4-1/2-inch thick | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 20 fresh mint sprigs, plus more for garnish
instructions: Combine the orange juice, molasses, and vinegar in a medium size mixing bowl. Stir in the potatoes. Cover and refrigerate the bread for 12 to 24 hours. Add the yeast, stir, and set the bread aside to rise for 2 hours. When the dough has risen, preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Grease a round 8 or 8 inch square baking pan. Divide the bread dough into 12 portions, flatten, and then shape each portion into a circle about 6 inches in diameter. Bake the bread in the upper third of the oven for 25 minutes or until pale gold. While the dough is baking, heat the syrup ingredients, either as directed, with a little water, in a saucepan until the butter is melted. Remove the loaves from the oven, and spread them over the warm syrup. Return to oven and bake until lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, garnish with mint, and serve warm. Variation, instead of orange zest, stir in 1 tablespoon grated orange rind.

title: Vermicelli With Amaretto Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces vermicelli pasta or 8 ounces linguine | 2 tablespoons amaretto or 2 tablespoons almond-flavored liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, in a small bowl stir together amaretto or almond flavored liqueur and 2 tblsp. Water. Stir until sugar dissolves. Pour over pasta and toss until warmed. Sprinkle with additional sugar if desired. Keep warm on low heat until serving.

title: Agua De Coco
ingredients: 2 bunches spring onions, chopped | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Place the onions into a blender or food processor with a bit of water to thin them. Blend them together with the coconut milk. Pour the mixture into a frying pan over medium heat. When it starts boiling, lower the flame and simmer for about 30 minutes, until it thickens slightly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sherry,serrano chile pepper,sea scallop,white rice,baby lima bean
title: Scallops and Lima Beans With Rice
ingredients: 1 pound fresh baby lima beans, washed and picked through | 4 serrano chile peppers, chopped | 3 cups fresh white rice | 5 tablespoons dry sherry | 10 ounces sea scallops
instructions: Place lima beans in a large pot and cover with about 5 quarts of water. Bring to a boil and add chiles. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until beans are soft. Stir in rice and continue simmering, uncovered, until liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes. Season scallops with sherry before serving.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,feta cheese,italian parsley,cumin seed,onion soup mix
title: Mimi's Mediterranean Pesto Dip I
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 5 cups fresh basil, chopped | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1/2 cup minced italian parsley | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor or blender. Process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,blueberry,rotini pasta,cajun seasoning,bulk italian sausage,lime juice
title: Pistachio Sausage and Blueberry Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 box rotini pasta, cooked al dente according to package directions | 1/2 lb bulk italian sausage, hot | 1/2 cup finely chopped pistachios, unsalted | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice, freshly squeezed | 1/4 cup cajun seasoning, eyeball it | 1 3/4 cups crumbled blueberries ( about 1 pound )
instructions: Cook linguini in a large pot of boiling water, for about 7 - 9 minutes, or until al dente. Drain pasta and set aside. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook italian sausage over medium heat, stirring and breaking up sausage, until lightly golden, 5 - 7 minutes. Drain well, remove and cool, then crumble into 1/2 inch pieces with a fork or fingers. Stir parsley, lime juice, and cajun seasoning into cooled sausage. To assemble salad, sprinkle pasta and blueberries evenly over the top of the sausage mixture, then pour the sausage and/or blueberry wine mixture over the top. Serve immediately. The salad can also be served cold or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,golden syrup,grapeseed oil,shrimp,garam masala,taco seasoning mix,cumin
title: Taco Shrimp (Camarones a La Pina)
ingredients: 1 pound medium shrimp - peeled, deveined, and tails left intact | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher garam masala | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 package dry taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Place shrimp in a colander in a sink, and sprinkle enough paprika onto the shrimp to cover. Let stand 30 minutes, then pat dry with paper towels. Heat 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Heat shrimp with 1 teaspoon oil and the dry taco seasoning mix. Pour into the skillet, cook 5 minutes, then flip over and cook 5 minutes longer. Drain shrimp, and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil and 1 tablespoon golden syrup in a skillet over low heat. Cook shrimp 2 to 3 minutes, or until pink. Remove from heat, transfer to a serving platter, and let stand 5 minutes. Spoon hot sauce over shrimp, and serve.

title: Beer Batter for Vegers for Fish and Chips
ingredients: 250 g spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons oil | 150 ml beer | 1 can coconut meat | 150 ml whole milk
instructions: Mix together sauce, gum, mace and oil. Simmer for a few minutes but don't let it boil or you could burn your mouth or your noodles. Pour over vegetables, and toss to coat. Serve alongside vegers.

title: Cod With Parsley & Parsley Aperolakia -Cod in Parsnip Sauges
ingredients: 4 cod fish fillets | 1/2 cup parsley ( fresh flat-leaf, italian parsley, fresh coriander ) | 2 cans peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons onions, chopped ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons kirsch ( scandinavian red spicy pepper jelly ) | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed
instructions: Place fish in a large, heavy skillet and sprinkle with salt.

title: Dried Celery and Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 stalks celery, with leaves | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Trim celery with leaves. In a 2 to 4 quart slow cooker, mix celery leaves, cream of chicken soup and condensed soup. Cover.

title: Nova Scotian Corned Beef and Macaroni Stew
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1 pint sour cream | 3 tablespoons buttermilk | 2 tablespoons stock, broth or 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, crushed plus extra for grilling | 1/2 lb macaroni | 2 ounces smoked macaroni or 2 ounces other long stick sliced potato
instructions: Trim brisket, remove any fat and sinew and trim any fat back from it if necessary. Cut into 5cm lengths and place in roasting pan with the remaining ingredients, except the grated ginger, cover and cook at 160ºc/fan 160ºc/gas 4 for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove and discard the ginger and cut vegetables into small wedges. Return the fat to the pan and stir in the beef and its juices. Cook on a low heat for about 45 minutes, or until well glazed and browned. Serve from a warmed dish or into a warmed bowl and top with the grated ginger.

title: Beef With Pepper & Leek
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round steaks | 1/4 cup kitchen bouquet | 1 tablespoon salt | 2 lemons, juice only | 1/3 cup lemon juice | 2 medium yellow bell peppers, roasted or 2 medium green bell peppers, roasted
instructions: Cut meat across grain into thin slices. Sprinkle meat with kitchen bouquet. Place in roasting pan and cover with water. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour. Remove meat and keep warm. Stir fry peppers in 1/2 cup of water for about five minutes or until tender. Remove from pan. Remove all but one tablespoon of the juice. Stir in lemon juice. Return meat to the pan juices. Cook on low heat to desired tenderness, about 1 1/2 hours. Note, the meat may also be browned under the broiler. The browning will give a nice brown crust to the meat. Remove meat from the oven, sprinkle with freshly ground pepper and serve with rice.

title: Apple Bread and Butter Spread
ingredients: 4 - 6 ounces stale italian bread, cut into 1-2-inch chunks | 4 -6 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
instructions: Set oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Mix butter and bread in a bowl. Spread butter over bread mixture and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until golden brown and crisp on the bottom and the moisture is evaporated.

title: Lemon Flower Soup (Lebanon -- Middle East)
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon lemon extract
instructions: Heat the oil and lemon extract into a large, heavy saucepan over medium heat. When hot, but not smoking, add the vegetable stock. Add the strained stock. Bring the soup to a full boil, then reduce the heat. Cover and let simmer for 45 minutes, or until a knife can pierce the base of the soup easily. Remove the pan from the heat and allow the soup to sit covered for 10 minutes. Remove the lemon flower from the soup and serve at once.

title: Baked Rocket & Chocolate Bark (Barszcz)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh rocket | 6 teaspoons espresso powder | 6 ounces chocolate-covered chocolate syrup | 10 teaspoons wooden stick bark
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f and line a large baking tray with parchment. Wash rocket leaves quickly and gently. Cut into 1/2 inch thick slices and arrange in circles on baking tray. Scatter over coffee powder to coat surface of rocket leaves. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden and base of rocket is crisp. Remove from oven and drizzle over chocolate syrup. Remove from oven and carefully transfer to wire rack. Keeps well in cool place for at least 2 - 3 weeks but can be eaten immediately.

title: Tuna Donbursts
ingredients: 1/2 - 2/3 lb of any size tuna can | 1/2 - 3/4 lb of any size beef | 1.5 cans catsup | 1 tablespoon of old bay seasoning
instructions: Take the tuna the whole and cut into slices. If you are doing just about anything else, this is enough to make about 4 or 5 slices of tuna. Cut the meat into thin slices. You can do all these things in advance and let the juices solidify. I do the same for beef and fish. Combine catsup with old bay seasoning. Put tuna slices on skewers in a pan big enough to hold all the ingredients in a single layer. Spread the meat over the top and make sure the tuna is completely coated with catsup. Add 1/2 cup or more of water, cover, and cook on low heat for 1 hour. There should be about 1 1/2 to 2 cups of liquid from the tuna. You may need to add more water when cooking. The last few minutes of cooking the tuna or the liquid will separate. I like to set the tuna onto a piece of warm paper towels to absorb the extra liquid.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,onion salt,ice water,beef broth
title: Cheesy Beef Soup I
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Brown and ground beef in a skillet. Drain. Stir in onion salt and beef broth and cook for five minutes. Place water in a skillet, and melt the butter on low heat. Sprinkle cheese on top and continue to simmer gently for 15 minutes until cheese is melted. Note, i use a large deep frying pan for this. Use a large spoon, scoop out and place into a large soup dish lined with a very thin layer of butter or margarine on the side.

title: Cheesy Picante Fritters
ingredients: 2 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, diced | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 cup cottage cheese
instructions: Place the roma tomatoes, sugar, picante sauce, thyme, cottage cheese, and salt in a bowl and toss gently. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Drop spoonfuls of fritter batter 1/2 inch apart onto hot skillet. Cook, stirring carefully until browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,cheese,white corn,irish cream,white bean,cranberry sauce
title: White Bean Dip
ingredients: 15 ounces white beans, drained | 8 ounces frozen italian style corn, thawed and drained | 1 1/3 cups light irish cream | 3/4 cup dried cranberry sauce or 3/4 cup cranberry cranberry sauce | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese | 1/2 cup italian parsley
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the beans, corn, irish cream, cranberry sauce and cheese. Spread into an 8 inch serving dish. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with toasted or julienne raw vegetables, if desired.

Random Ingredients: gluten flour,no boil lasagna noodle,mustard oil,vanilla essence,rotel tomato
title: Lazy Tomato-Veggie Lasagne
ingredients: 12 ounces no-boil lasagna noodles ( or your favourite ) | 1 tablespoon mustard oil | 1 1/2 - 2 cups gluten-free flour, blend ( i use gluten free ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Boil water and cook the pasta. Drain the pasta and return to saucepan, add dry ingredients and stir. Heat through until the flour has cooked off. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix together lightly. Place in the refrigerator until required.

title: Traditional Hollandaise
ingredients: 12 slices white bread | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Cut 6 slices of bread into 1 inch cubes. Place the lemon juice in a glass bowl and dip one side of each slice of bread into it. Place bread cubes in a plastic zipper bag and toss with the lemon zest. Chill or serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,dark rum,bell pepper,blueberry,white sugar,ranch dressing mix,dark soy sauce
title: Rum & Roasted Bell Peppers With Blueberry Dressing
ingredients: 1 lb fresh blueberries | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 1 tablespoon granulated white sugar | 2 medium bell peppers ( red, yellow or orange )
instructions: Prepare the sugar according to instructions for your bottle of sugar, or according to the recipe on the bottle. Peel bell peppers, and slice about 1/4 thick. Place the halved peppers in the sugar. Place the blueberries in a medium bowl and add 1/4 cup of the oil, dark soy sauce and rum. Taste and add more of the sugar if you prefer a sweeter dressing. Let sit for about an hour or two for the flavors to be ready. In a small bowl, blend the ranch dressing mix and other 1/4 cup of oil. Pour over the blueberries and peppers and stir to coat all the berries. Chill at least 30 minutes or up to 1 day. Preheat a grill. Slice peppers lengthwise and place in a bowl of ice water to soak for a few minutes to loosen the skins. Remove skins, and cut them into long slices, then slice crosswise into 1/4 wide strips. Place the peppers, cut sides down, in a single layer on the rack set at the highest setting and grill, turning occasionally, until the peppers are softened but still slightly resistant to the tooth, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add additional oil if the peppers begin to stick. Dressing, combine the remaining 1/2 cup of oil, cornstarch, sugar, and 1 tablespoon of the rum in a small bowl. Stir until the sugar has dissolved, then whisk or stir the mixture until emulsified. Pour over peppers and toss.

title: Homemade Chipotle Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup chipotle chile, chipotle | 1 teaspoon pureed chipotle chile | 2 allspice | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients with a spoon, crushing the lumps as they form, adding more of your chipotles if you want more flavor. Store, covered, in the fridge up to 3 months. Use for flavoring. Variation,. Use 1 teaspoon pureed green chiles instead of the chipotle chiles. Variation,. Place 1/3 cup pureed canned chiles in a glass bowl or a freezer bag. Add 1/3 cup chipotle puree. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze. Note, i use 2 chipotle puree or 3 jalapeno chiles. I can't remember how many servings this makes depending on my mood. Variation,. Add 1/3 cup pureed green chiles into a glass bowl or freezer bag.

title: Fried Tomatoes - Michael Chiarello
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces canned italian plum tomatoes | 4 tablespoons flour | 5 -7 ounces red bell peppers, coarsely chopped or 5 -7 ounces green bell peppers | chopped fresh coriander leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Drain tomatoes and toss with flour in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Toss in peppers and coriander. Heat a non stick frying pan or griddle and fry the pieces of tomato until evenly browned. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,tomato green chilies,cocoa,rice wine,white chocolate,arborio rice
title: Rice-Grilled Chiles & Chiles
ingredients: 3 ounces white chocolate, cut into chunks | 2 fresh tomatoes and green chilies, cut into strips | 5 1/2 ounces raspberries | 3 1/2 ounces arborio rice, cooked | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 tablespoon cocoa
instructions: Prepare grill by preheating coals. Place chilies in a medium bowl with some ice and water to cover. Let sit for about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the chilies in half lengthwise, and remove the seeds. Cut into strips. Place in a small bowl with some ice the water from steaming the chilies and rice and stir together. Set aside for five minutes. In a separate bowl, stir together the sauce ingredients. Place rice and chilies in a large saute pan over low heat and saute for ten minutes. Remove from heat and place in a large bowl. Toss with the sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green olive,beer,cocoa,half cream,red curry paste,pork shoulder
title: Pork and Beer Curry
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 1/2- & quot, chunks | 1 bottle light beer, such as negra modelo | 1 package red curry paste | 7 fluid ounces half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 2/3 jar pitted green olives, drained | 1/4 cup cocoa
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cocoa, cocoa, & olives in a heavy saucepan over high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is thickened. Remove from the heat. Return saucepan to the stove. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until pork is tender, 30 - 45 minutes. Stir in cocoa and stir well. Serve in large soup bowls with a small sprinkle of cocoa and a green olive for garnish if desired.

title: Bread & Butter Paneer
ingredients: 14 ounces condensed tomato soup | 1/8 cup green cardamom pod, crushed | 2 1/4 lbs ground pork or 2 1/4 lbs ground chicken | 1/2 cup instant pistachios or 1/2 cup peanuts, coarsely ground | 12 tablespoons orange juice | 2 slices bread ( or a large loaf of hearty bread )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl, combine the soup, cardamom pods, and ground pork. Stir in the peanuts and orange juice. Transfer to a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for 20 to 25 minutes, or until top is golden brown. Cut into squares with diagonal cuts. Serve warm.

title: Beer Bean and Sausage Filling
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage | 1/2 cup guinness stout | 1 tablespoon dried old bay seasoning, crumbled | 1 can kidney beans | 2 tablespoons tepid tequila | 1 ounce beer
instructions: Brown sausage over medium heat until mostly cooked through. Drain on a paper towel. Combine guinness stout with old bay seasoning, kidney beans, tequila and beer and mix well. Pour mixture into a greased 9x13 baking dish and bake in 400°f oven for 20 minutes. Let cool, slice 1/4 inch thick and place on plates.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,ice cube,cumin,flour tortilla,plum tomato,red cabbage
title: Sausage Pork Tacos
ingredients: 4 tablespoons imitation pork sausage | 6 flour tortillas | 1 small red cabbage, cored and finely shredded | 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | ice cube
instructions: Place the sausage in a dry frying pan and cook over a medium heat, breaking into small pieces with the back of a spoon, for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Drain well and set aside to cool slightly. When cold, roughly chop the sausage, mix with the cabbage, tomatoes and cumin and stir through the shredded cabbage. Roll into large, wet, wet taco shells and place on a tray lined with paper towel. Drizzle with a little sunflower oil and sprinkle generously with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. Grill under medium hot grill for 3 to 4 minutes each side or until crisp. Alternatively, slice into rounds and serve with warm tortillas. Sauce, combine the ingredients in a small pan and cook over a medium heat, stirring frequently. Continue cooking for 2 minutes or until sauce has thickened and the cabbage has softened. Spoon the mixture into a serving dish and serve with warmed tortillas.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,cumin seed,peach,cheese curd,tomato sauce,lime,red chili pepper
title: Cheese & Tomato Kebabs
ingredients: 2 kabocha cheese curds | 1 medium tomatoes, firm | 1 small lime | 125 g lamb shoulder, trimmed and cut into 2 x 1 cm cube | 1 medium red chili pepper, deseeded and very finely chopped | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 can of chopped peaches, drained ( optional )
instructions: Using a melon baller, scoop out half the kabocha cheese curds to make a base and layer it with the tomato, cheese, lamb, chilli pepper & cumin. Repeat with the rest of the kabocha mix & tomato mixture. Cut the kabocha mixture into quarters and skewer. Barbecue for 5 minutes until beginning to brown on all sides.

title: Hot Pizzaatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 cup chopped red onion | 2 lbs small red potatoes | 1 ounce chopped fresh oregano | 1 can plum tomatoes, diced, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large mixing bowl combine onions, potatoes, oregano and tomatoes. Mash potatoes until you have a chunky texture. Spoon into a 9x13 glass baking dish or casserole, spreading evenly, or pour pizza sauce evenly on top and bake 30 - 40 minutes or until golden tipped.

title: Beef Filet for Two
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steak | 1 ounce oat | 1/2 teaspoon turbinado sugar | 1 small pimento-stuffed green olive | 1/2 medium black olives | 1/4 cup pimiento, drained and chopped
instructions: Cut 1/4 inch slice from top of filet and place on a cutting board. Cut away all the excess fat from the meat. Remove steak from bones and pound to 1/4 inch thickness using the flat side of a box grater or other large cutting tool. Cut the oat into 1/8 inch slabs and then roll the pieces in the sugar lightly tossing so you are evenly coated. Spread the nuts out on a baking sheet and toast in hot oven for 7 to 10 minutes or until they just start to turn golden and you smell them. As soon as the nuts are toasted spread the meat on the nuts and cut in half if you have two, spread the meat, cut side down, on the oats to cover and on top of the meat. Serve with mashed potatoes and green vegetable salad.

title: Curried Lamb on Lettuce
ingredients: 1 lamb, cut in 1 inch pieces | 1 slice ginger, thin sliced | 8 apricots, cut in quarters | 4 carrots, large cut in 1-inch chunks | 1 star anise | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/2 teaspoon curry | 1 romaine lettuce
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Place lamb in a pan flat on cutting board with the edge facing you and brush with oil. Turn over once until lightly browned on all sides and remove from pan. Add spices and butter to pan and scrape up the browned bits from the bottom. Cover and place meat, with remaining butter and onions in an oven proof casserole dish. Cover lightly with foil. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove foil, remove lamb and onions and spread onions, cooked lamb, carrots and dried apricots on top of lamb. Bake for an additional 20 minutes or until meat is no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,kaffir lime leaf,cumin seed,fruit,coriander,asparagus,oregano leaf
title: Spiced Asparagus With Green Peppers (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 2 ) And
ingredients: 14 ounces asparagus, ends trimmed | 1 green pepper, deseeded and cut into 6 slices | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 8 fresh kaffir lime leaves or 2 tablespoons fresh lime zest, grated | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Place the asparagus in a large saucepan with just enough water to cover. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer over a medium heat for 2 minutes or until the asparagus is just tender. Drain. Meanwhile place the coriander, cumin, lime leaves or zest, oregano and half the lime juice in a dry frying pan. Cook over a low heat, stirring for 3 minutes or until the asparagus starts to crisp. Stir in the cooked asparagus mixture. Serve in shallow bowls.

title: Rhubarb and Chocolate
ingredients: 2 lbs rhubarb | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c. Wash and dry the rhubarb, cut in slices about 3 in long or 2 cm wide. Spray the grill with cooking spray. Put the rhubarb and a few tsp of water in a ceramic or glass bowl. Cover with cling wrap and put in the oven. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring twice. Remove the lid and bubble again for a further 3 - 4 minutes until it is brown. Cover and leave to cool in the tin, then chill in the refrigerator overnight. When ready to serve, place the rhubarb on a serving dish and cover with plastic wrap or foil. Tear off a piece of plastic and put under the top of the rhubarb and serve.

title: Fassoulada De Fuba
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, or to taste | toothpicks
instructions: Combine the cannellini beans, kidney beans, lemon juice, garlic, and saffron in a blender. Blend until fully liquefied. Chill until serving.

title: Japanese Dressing for Spring Rolls, Chilled, or Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon allspice berries, ground | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons chicken stock or 3 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon mirin ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except your rice vinegar in a jar and shake vigorously. When it becomes cloudy, remove top solter and pour over rice vinegar. Stir well to combine. Can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,cumin seed,hoisin sauce,ginger,balsamic vinegar,orange peel
title: Ginger Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh ginger, peeled & cut in thin matchsticks | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon honey ( use 2 tbsp honey if you wish ) | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated orange peel | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin seed
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients and blend well. Refrigerate in tightly covered container for 1 hour. Stores well.

title: Cranberry and Lentil Dressing
ingredients: 5 tablespoons fresh cranberry juice | 1/2 cup light brown lentil | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms ( stalks discarded and caps thinly sliced ) | 6 tablespoons raisins | 1/2 cup palm sugar or 1/2 cup golden syrup mixed with 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: Rinse & pick over the lentils & rinse them under running water. Place them in a medium saucepan with just enough water to cover & simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, depending on the size & type of lentils you are using. Drain and set aside. In a small bowl, whisk the cranberry juice & sugar until well blended. Set aside. In a large, shallow ovenproof dish, arrange the mushrooms and raisins & nestle the lentils in the caramelized cranberry and sugar mixture. Pour the cranberry and sugar mixture over the lentils and mushrooms & then stir in the remaining cranberry juice & sugar mixture. Cover tightly & bake at 350f for 45 - 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils & mushrooms are tender & the stuffing has absorbed the liquid.

title: Cauliflower and Beef Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, frozen | 1 head cauliflower, florets and stem chopped | 1 cup cranberry sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place frozen turkey in roasting pan. Cover and bake until meat is falling apart, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, combine cauliflower, cranberry sauce and seasoning mix in a bowl and toss with meat. Place meat and cauliflower on top of cauliflower. Cook roast and cauliflower for an additional 25 minutes.

title: Irish Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 400 g shredded cabbage | 400 g stock
instructions: Scoop out about 3 cm from the top of your cabbage and reserve. Place back on the cabbages. Cover tightly and cook at high for about 30 minutes, or until tender. Remove the lid, stir and cover. Cook over low heat for another 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat. This will depend on the type of cabbage used. Remove the seeds from the cabbage and cut into small square pieces. To serve, place portions of cabbage in a bowl and pour stock over, stir. The cabbage should resemble a choclate. This soup freezes well.

title: Garlic Cheese Veggies
ingredients: 1 2 lbs yellow squash or 2 lbs zucchini | greek seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Cut squash into pieces about the size of your index finger or parrotate between layers of wax paper. Sprinkle all over with lots of greek seasoning. Put in a plastic zipper bag. Chill for about 4 hours or overnight. Heat oil in a skillet and place on medium high heat. When pan is hot put a paper towel on top and put in all the sliced vegatables. After about 2 min, turn vegatables and continue cooking until browned on both sides. Dish up and enjoy great with pita bread and a vegetable dip.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,salmon fillet,chicken breast meat,black sesame seed
title: Black Sesame and Almond Chicken
ingredients: 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast meat | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon black sesame seeds | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread the chicken breast meat onto a cutting board, and slice into bite size pieces. Place the salmon into a large, glass baking dish with the almond extract, black sesame seeds, and slivered almonds. Place the pieces in a single layer on top of the almond extract, and sprinkle the top with a little bit of water. Bake in the preheated oven until the chicken is no longer translucent, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. An instant reading thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees f. Remove and let stand for at least 10 minutes before serving.

title: Lebanese Baked Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup brown mustard seeds | vanilla pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f/190c, or gas mark spread mustard seeds in a greased tin you will then be cooking the pudding later. Using a baking tin with a shallow base or ramekin tray, lightly spread the mustard seeds in 1/2 inch thick around the edges, and bake for about 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the oven, and allow to cool, then break the mustard seeds into small bits with your spoon. Allow the baking tin to sit for 5 minutes on the counter. Pour the hot mustard onto the mustard, and spread evenly over the hot pudding with a knife. Slice the pudding in half lengthways, and spread the remaining mustard, mustard seeds and sliced pudding onto the top.

Random Ingredients: onion,turmeric powder,extra virgin olive oil,pork tenderloin,green plantain,sesame
title: Upside Down (Pork Stew)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 lb green plantains ( yellow ) | 2 large onions | 1/4 - 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon ground turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon sesame ( optional )
instructions: Cut ends off plantains, peel then cut into 3/4 inch slices lengthwise and cut slices 1/2 inch thick. Slice all 3 onions thinly but not all the way down the center. Heat extra virgin olive oil in deep pot over high heat until it just starts to smoke. Sear pork pieces, working around the pan so the brown bits don't stick, for about 4 minutes. Reduce heat to medium high, cover, and cook uncovered for 2 hours. Mix turmeric, sesame and remaining olive oil in bowl, pour over pork chunks, stir. If desired add more sesame, to taste, and serve with rice or potatoes. Great with hot buttered toast.

title: Chinese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 quart vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 10 chicken wings
instructions: Place the stock and flour in a saucepan. Bring to the boil and boil for 1 minute. Add the wings and return to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,lemongrass,red chilies,red kidney bean,red cherry,pea carrot
title: Fresh Vegetable Mix With Chilli and Maraschino
ingredients: 2 small red chilies, coarsely chopped | 1 stalk lemongrass | 1 red cherry | 1 small maraschino cherry | 8 small fresh red kidney beans, halved | 8 small fresh peas and carrots | 1 red chilies, deseeded and chopped | 1 stalk lemongrass, thinly sliced
instructions: Place chillies, lemon grass and cherries into the bowl of a food processor and process into a fine paste. Place in a small bowl. Place beans and peas in separate small bowl. Cut remaining lemon grass and lemongrass into 5 cm lengths. Place all the vegetables in a large bowl, then add the chilli paste. Toss gently together, then cover and chill for several hours or overnight. Serve with steamed rice and steamed greens on the side.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,udon noodle,white tequila,brown sugar,canola oil,pepper sauce,cumin,mint leaf
title: Totally Twisted Mexican Noodles
ingredients: 20 leaves torn fresh mint leaves ( no stems ) | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 1/3 lbs yellow udon noodles | 3 -4 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 tablespoon canola oil | 1 teaspoon pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon red hot pepper sauce | 1/3 cup mexican white tequila | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. Drain noodles, rinse with cool water, and set aside. In medium bowl, combine oil, pepper sauce, and tequila. Set aside. Heat 1/4 cup of margarine until hot in non stick fry pot over medium high heat. Remove from heat. Drain noodles well and toss with dressing. To serve, arrange noodles on serving plate. Divide noodle and sauce mixture between the 8 bowls.

title: Spicy Mexican Leek Relish
ingredients: 6 large leeks | 8 large dill pickles | 1 chipotle chile pepper
instructions: Cut leeks lengthwise into 1 inch pieces no more than 1/4 inch thick. Cut a slit down the length of each to within 1/2 inch of the root end. Then cut diagonally across the bottom into 1 inch lengths, exposing the core. Place each leek in a large pot of water to cover and bring to a boil. Simmer for 12 minutes or until tender. Drain, rinse in cold water and drain again. Place in an airtight jar and cover with a thin layer of pickling sauce. Seal tightly. Keep refrigerated after opening. The relish can be eaten at room temperature or chilled.

title: Poached Lemons
ingredients: 5 cups peeled, cored and coarsely chopped tart apples | 4 apples - peeled, cored and coarsely chopped leeks | 6 bananas, sliced, or more to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped leeks | 1 fennel seed, or to taste | 1 pear, chopped, or more as desired | 1 1/2 pounds shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Place the apple cores and coarsely chopped leeks into a large pot. Add the bananas, apples, leeks, fennel seed, and pear. Season to taste with salt. Bring to a boil over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,brie cheese,bacon dripping,white fish fillet,american cheese
title: Bacon-Wrapped White Fish Fillets
ingredients: 6 thick slices bacon drippings | 6 white fish fillets, skin removed | 12 slices american cheese | 12 slices brie cheese | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. On baking sheets, lay out 6 bacon slices per fillet. Fold the tops of the fillets over the tops so they overlap the fish slices slightly. Cover the tops with slices of american cheese and a slice of brie cheese. Place the remaining 2 fillets onto two pieces of aluminum foil, shiny side up. Wrap the foil around each fillet, securing it to the foil tightly, and seal tightly with a tooth pick. Bake for 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Pumpkin Seed Filling for Dipping foods
ingredients: 1 cup shelled pumpkin seeds, dry roasted | 1 cup canola oil
instructions: Mix the pumpkin seeds together in a food processor or blender. Add the canola oil to a deep frying pan or deep sesame seed fryer, and set to medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the pumpkin seed mixture, and fry to a golden brown, about 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Beetroot Chips (Kababies-Persian-Iranian Version) #5FIX
ingredients: 8 medium beetroots, peeled and halved | salt and pepper | 1 pinch ground savory | corn oil ( for frying ) | 3 ounces unsalted cashews, chopped
instructions: Grate beetroots. Mix with salt, pepper and savory in a bowl. Heat oil to 400 degrees fahrenheit coat deep fryer dish with corn oil. Place beetroot on oiled surface, being sure not to touch the skin. Fry, turning occasionally, for about 20 minutes or until chips are golden brown on the edges and crisp on the outside. Drain on paper towels. Remove cover with paper towels and allow to cool 5 minutes. If you like you can sprinkle cashews on top before eating. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator up to 6 months.

title: Mixed Shrimp in Spicy Yoghurt
ingredients: 2 cups yogurt | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1 lb baby shrimp, cleaned and deveined ( about 2.5 lbs ) | 4 tablespoons chopped peaches, or | 1 teaspoon chat masala
instructions: Combine the yogurt, 2 teaspoons of vanilla sugar, and the shrimp in a bowl, stir to coat. Cover and refrigerate the rest of the ingredients for 30 minutes. Cook prawns and peach slices in boiling water for 1 minute or until cooked through and prawns are pink. Drain and keep warm. Pour the spiced yoghurt into a serving platter, arrange the shrimp on it, sprinkle with the peaat nuts, and pass the chat masala.

title: Smoked Salmon With Ginger
ingredients: 4 cups organic fresh salmon, skin on | 1 tablespoon dried gingerroot, grated | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | olive oil or vegetable cooking spray
instructions: Place the salmon skin side down in a roasting pan, or other large flat pan that has been coated with oil spray. Sprinkle with about 2 tablespoons of water from the salmon pack, then sprinkle the dried ginger over the top and scatter a few drops of water on top. Cook in a preheated oven at 375 f or 200 c for 35 minutes, or until golden brown on the top. Cut open and serve with a salad and lots of crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: lamb,pork loin chop,butter,bay scallop,pineapple tidbit,heavy cream,onion soup mix,poblano chile
title: Hawaiian Lamb and Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 2 envelopes dry onion soup mix | 1 pound bay scallops | 1/2 pound boneless lamb, cut into bite size pieces | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 1 can pineapple tidbits with juice, drained
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Pour in the cream and onion soup mix.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,penne,salsa verde,french bread,orange peel,onion soup mix,chili,phyllo pastry
title: Pastel De Piso (Spicy Pastries and Salsa Verde)
