ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 can condensed onion soup mix | 1/4 cup finely chopped orange peel | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 12 ounces salsa verde | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons french bread, finely chopped into large pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Spray a large baking sheet with oil cooking spray. On lightly floured work surface, place a half sheet of phyllo onto the prepared baking sheet. With a fork, spread 2 tablespoons of soup powder over the phyllo to cover the bottom of the sheet. Cover phyllo stack with 3 more sheets of dough and top with 3 more sheets. Repeat with the other half of mixture and phyllo in different ways. Spread 1/4 cup of orange peel, diced onion, and chili over the pastry, leaving the edges free and free of the filling. Carefully roll up the pastry, stretching it as necessary, and place on baking sheet. Repeat until all pastry and filling are used up. Spread salsa verde over tortillas. Cover with remaining phyllo sheets, again stretching the dough as necessary, and cover with parchment paper. Cut slits in the top and sides of the pastry about 1 1/2 inches deep. Bake in preheated oven until the top is golden and bubbling, about 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,teriyaki sauce,clove,oyster,navy bean,pecorino romano cheese,chicken bouillon cube
title: Chef-Boy-I-Be Illinois' Navy Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 bag navy beans, cooked | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( i use chicken base ) | 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 pinch powdered saffron strand | 1 pinch powdered cloves | 1 tablespoon of grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 bag of shelled fresh oysters
instructions: Shake navy beans well in a pan of boiling water and then take off heat. Rinse. Place beans and all the other ingredients in the blender and mix at high speed for 2 mins, stopping occasionally to scrape down sides while adding liquid to avoid the beans sticking. Chill for 1 hour or longer to allow flavors to blend. Serve with fresh, warm bread or your favorite bread.

title: Linguine With Sweet Corn
ingredients: 2 cups corn kernels ( fresh or frozen ) | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 1 lb linguine or 1 lb fettuccine pasta
instructions: Using a medium saucepan over high heat, stir corn and garlic in hot barbecue sauce until corn is hot, about 3 minutes. Heat a large pot of water over medium heat. Add pasta and cook until just tender, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red onion,ginger garlic paste,cooking spray,canadian bacon
title: Canadian Bacon and Onions (Cookies)
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup thinly sliced red onion | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 lb shredded canadian bacon
instructions: Spray a nonstick frying pan with cooking spray. Add onion to pan.

title: Simple Lasagna
ingredients: 8 no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 jar sake | 1 - 1 1/4 cup dry sherry
instructions: Boil and drain noodles. In large bowl combine the dry sherry and the sake, then add the noodles. Spread about 1/2 cup sauce on top. Cover with lightly buttered plastic wrap and let stand 30 - 45 minutes. Uncover and cook for about 10 minutes over medium heat or until bubbly..

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,pineapple chunk,lemon lime beverage,golden syrup,sun tomato
title: Tangy Pineapple Lassi
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup lemon-lime beverage | 1 tablespoon chopped sun-dried tomato | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel
instructions: In a blender combine crushed pineapple, golden syrup, lemon lime beverage, sun dried tomatoes and grated lemon peel.

title: Egg Noodles With Snow Peas and Snow Peas
ingredients: 4 ounces egg noodles | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 4 ounces snow peas
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the noodles and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until tender. Drain.

Random Ingredients: raisin,sugar,brown rice,ice cube,extra virgin olive oil,beer,self rising flour
title: Raisin Crusted Molasses Rice Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice, cooked and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups raisins, soaked in warm water and drained | 2 1/2 cups self rising flour | 1 cup orange beer ( i use laben's light orange juice but any brand will do ) or 1 cup light beer ( i use laben's light orange juice but any brand will do ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 8 -10 ice cubes | 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Bread,. Preheat oven to 250f and lightly oil a large cookie sheet. Combine rice, raisins, flour, 1 1/2 cups of the oil, and 3 ice cubes in a large bowl. Using a rubber spatula, stir to mix evenly. Stir in remaining rice and raisins. Toss to mix. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. With a pastry bag or 2 large star tip shaped lids, pipe rice mixture evenly over the parchment paper, making sure to not fill the center of the bread. Add 1 - ½ tablespoons of sugar. Use the back of a spoon to press mixture firmly into the paper. Bake about 1 hour, or until knife inserted into center comes out clean. Cool, but transfer the bread to a rack and let harden.

title: Fried Saffron
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cornstarch | 1 pinch saffron threads
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the cornstarch and saffron and mix well with a fork. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a pot over medium high heat and drop the cinnamon mixture in at least a tablespoon a quarter at a time, stirring it in until it is browned lightly, about 1 minute per side. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate juice,puff pastry,ale,millet,red currant jelly,chicken thigh
title: Paleo Chicken Tarte De Volail
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ale | 8 chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon pomegranate juice | 250 ml evaporated milk | red currant jelly | puff pastry
instructions: Combine pomegranate juice and milk in a frying pan. Place over a medium heat, add chicken breasts and cook until juices run clear. Remove chicken and set aside for 5 minutes. Place pomegranate mixture into saucepan with cooked chicken breasts. Pour remaining pomegranate juice mixture into saucepan and bring to boil. Spray a 9 x 11 oven proof dish with non stick cooking spray and pour pomegranate mixture into dish. Cover with pastry, slash to vent steam, place in pre heated oven.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,nacho cheese flavor doritos,pork loin roast,baking potato,grand marnier,whipping cream
title: Sweet Potato-Lorrie Burritos
ingredients: 3 lbs baking potatoes, peeled cut in half and then thinly sliced | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 2 cups nacho cheese flavor doritos
instructions: Microwave the sliced potatoes on high for 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Using 2 forks toss the pork in a shallow dish and mix with grand marnier, lemon juice and zest. Heat oven to 300 degrees. Spread the potato slices in the bottom of a large baking dish and cover with the slices of pork. Repeat layering until all the potates, finishing with a layer of potato. Pour the remaining sauce over the top and bake in the oven for about 3 – 5 hours or until well browned and bubbly. To serve, warm doritos over hot paparoscan heat for about 2 – 3 minutes. Ladle the warm burritos with some of the remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,yellow food coloring,dark chocolate,rice,walnut,flat leaf italian parsley,pineapple juice
title: Italian Hot Chocolate Sundae
ingredients: 5 ounces dark chocolate, finely chopped | 1 cup pineapple juice | 2 cups sweet rice sticks, such as arborio or 2 cups sweet rice sticks | 1 1/2 cups walnuts, coarsely ground ( about 2 tbsp. ) | 1/2 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 2 drops yellow food coloring | 2/3 cup parmesan cheese, grated ( preferably a good quality, freshly grated variety )
instructions: Combine unsweetened pineapple juice and dark chocolate in a microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,corn,extra sharp cheddar cheese,ricotta cheese,coconut,champagne
title: Coconut Mousse Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice, cooled | 1 cup frozen sweet corn, thawed | 1 cup shredded low-fat ricotta cheese | 1 carton low fat cottage cheese | 2/3 cup dry champagne | 1/2 cup shredded extra-sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the rice, corn, ricotta cheese, and cottage cheese. Add champagne and mix well. Gently stir in the cheddar cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight, at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,canadian bacon,cream chicken soup,tamari,yoghurt,italian seasoning,taco seasoning
title: Low Fat Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1/4 cup fat free sour cream ( fat free or low fat ) | 1/2 cup yoghurt | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon soyy cream cheese | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 tablespoon canadian bacon ( diced ) | 1 small poblano chile
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In blender mix sour cream, yoghurt, taco seasoning, soy cream cheese and italian seasoning. Chop poblano chile and set aside in bowl. Pour mixture in oven safe dish. Top with diced bacon. Bake until the cheese is melted.

title: Beef Salisbury Steak
ingredients: 1 lb raw haddock | 1 teaspoon molasses | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1/2 cup apple juice, from the apple | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs ( i used gluten-free bread crumbs seasoned with a ) | 2 teaspoons fresh turmeric | 2 cups bean sprouts
instructions: Mix the breadcrumbs, turmeric and apple juice in a small bowl until the mixture is evenly spread. Cut the haddock into 4 equal sized pieces, about 1 1/2 inches wide. Spread a teaspoonful of molasses on the fish, then layer the fish on top. Spread the remaining paste on top. Sprinkle with additional 1 tsp of turmeric. Cover loosely and keep refrigerated for at least 2 hours or as long as 3 hours. Remove the cover and grill for 8 minutes per side. Flip the fish over and spread some molasses on it. Cook a minute or two longer. Serve with a sprinkling of breadcrumbs on top.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,stone mustard,chicken meat,thyme,butter margarine,oyster sauce
title: Pound Chicken & Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken meat, with bone and skin on | 2 tablespoons plain steel-style mustard | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 3/4 cup unsalted butter or margarine, melted | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Mix the mustard together. In a shallow dish, mix chicken with the mustard mixture. Put melted butter, salt and white pepper in another dish. Dip chicken pieces into melted butter mixture and then into the white pepper. Cook at 375f for approximately 20 minutes or until no longer pink inside.

title: Chickpeas With Chickpeas
ingredients: 3 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 -3 cans artichoke hearts, drained and rinsed | 6 tablespoons lime juice | 8 medium sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons seasoning, preferably homemade ( or store-bought, such as tony chachere's )
instructions: Rinse the chickpeas well. In a large bowl, mash the beans, artichokes, and lime juice until well combined. Add the cheese and seasoning.

title: Asparagus Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive, or to taste | 2 bunches fresh asparagus, trimmed | 2 cups vegetable stock, or as needed | 1 can blueberry pie filling | 2 tablespoons dried minced asparagus, or as needed | 1 tablespoon creole-style crushed olives, or to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat.

title: Raisin & Walnut Candies
ingredients: 1 cup raisins | 3/4 cup palm sugar | 3/4 cup walnut pieces
instructions: Soak raisins in hot water until soft, about 30 minutes, then drain. Crumble the raisins. Add palm sugar and walnut pieces into a dry nonstick skillet that can be covered with a tight lid. When the mixture starts to foam, lift it out of the skillet and stir vigorously until the sugar dissolves. Drop candy into 250 degree oil or candy trays and drop into hot oil. Let candy bars become brittle and dark. Remove with a spoon. Store in sterile ziploc bags for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,thai red chili pepper,clam juice,brown rice,celery rib
title: Spanish Style Red Rice
ingredients: 1 cup red rice ( can use short grain but preferred grains will do ) | 2 cans of whole clams, juice reserved ( in can ) | 3 stalks celery ribs, cut into 1/4-1-inch slices ( can use any celery you like for vegetarian ) | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix | 2 thai red chili peppers
instructions: Start cooking your rice according to package directions or when you need to. In a large deep, heavy skillet, add enough cold water to cover. Add the clams and bring to a boil. Turn the heat down to medium or low. Drain the clams well and pour into skillet with rice. Turn heat down to medium low. Add the celery, ras el hanout and chilies. Stir and cover. Simmer gently for about 10 minutes. If rice is too dry, add ice cubes and/or water. Note, if sauce is too thick, add more water to moisten.

Random Ingredients: green bean,iceberg lettuce,pesto sauce,shallot,creme fraiche,cocoa,chicken bouillon cube
title: Green Bean Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 cups torn iceberg lettuce ( packed ) | 1 green beans, thawed if frozen | 1 ounce fresh basil, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh pesto sauce | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 can chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1/4 cup low-fat creme fraiche
instructions: Cook green beans according to package directions except, remove from heat. Boil green beans until just tender. Drain water, add green beans, basil, pesto, garlic and bouillon to salad bowl. Toss until combined. Place 2 tablespoons of filling on the back of each tortilla, roll and put the filled tortilla on a plate and cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Chili Pepper Spice Rub
ingredients: 1/4 cup ground chile pepper, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon grated nutmeg | 1/3 cup dark chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Mix chile and nutmeg together in a bowl. Stir together chile pepper mix and chile nut mixture until combined.

title: Pinto Beans and Smoked Oi-Chari
ingredients: 8 ounces dried pinto beans, picked over, rinsed, soaked ( 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup smoked oi-chari tea ( la yu fun ) | 2 fresh shiitake mushrooms ( about 6 ounces )
instructions: Cover beans with water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat, and simmer until tender, 5 to 8 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup soaking water. Mash potfuls of beans with reserved bean cooking liquid, and stir in tea. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Red Chili Sauce Soup
ingredients: 5 -10 dried red chili, chopped | 5 cups chicken broth | white pepper
instructions: Chop chili and put thru food grinder/blender until a rough paste forms. I chop mine with my mortar and pestle. You can substitute with chicken stock or water also though. You can also substitute chili powder with either red pepper flakes. Pour sauce in a large pot.. Bring to a boil. Simmer until soup thickens up and is like thin, green sauce. Stir well. Add a dash of white pepper and mix well. Soup can be eaten immediately or chilled.

title: Mediterranean Edamame Bake
ingredients: 2 cups edamame | 1 lb portabella mushroom, fresh, sliced thinly | 1 red onion, thinly sliced | 2 scallions, sliced thin | 2 teaspoons fresh dill, chopped | 1 cup peach juice | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, shredded | 2 teaspoons pickled jicama, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a 9x13 baking dish, layer the edamame, mushrooms, onions, scallions, dill, peach juice, parmesan cheese and jicama slices. Bake uncovered 30 - 40 minutes or until heated through.

title: Dole Salad - Mexico Style
ingredients: 2 lbs dried pearl barley | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder ( in a double boiler ) | 10 -15 cups lettuce, in bite sized pieces | 8 -10 cherry tomatoes ( optional )
instructions: Soak pearl barley until tender.

Random Ingredients: salmon,scallion,bicarbonate soda,chipotle chile,romaine lettuce,vanilla extract,cardamom seed
title: Smoked Chipotle Salmon
ingredients: 500 g smoked salmon | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 tablespoons crushed dried chipotle chiles | scallion, sliced | romaine lettuce, torn | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
instructions: Cut all excess fat from the smoked salmon and skin. Dry it on all sides and pat dry with paper towel. Cut the smoked salmon into 2 equal pieces. Place the smoked salmon in an airtight container, and add the cardamom seeds, bicarbonate of soda, chiles, scallions and paprika to it. Cover the container and store for 10 days, turning once each time. Add the dried chipotle and shake the container so that the chipotle is evenly distributed. When you are ready to serve, place the smoked salmon on a heated platter and top with the chipotle and paprika mixture. Serve with romaine lettuce.

title: No-Stick Coffee Fondue
ingredients: 16 ounces coffee granules, 1-2 cups | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 2 serrano chili, minced | salt | pepper, freshly ground | 12 slices pepperoni, 1/4-inch slices | 12 dried cherry tomatoes ( or grape tomatoes if you don't like grape tomatoes ) | 1 cup dried sour cherries, halved
instructions: Dissolve the coffee in a cup of warm water. Add the garlic, serrano chiles, pepper and salt and pepper and let the mixture stand for 20 minutes. Strain the mixture through a sieve or coffee filter into a small bowl. Strain through the sieve, pressing on the solids with a rubber spatula to force out the lumps. You should have about 2 cups drained liquid. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate the fondue for up to one week. When ready to serve, remove the fondue from the refrigerator and heat on low, stirring occasionally, until thickened slightly but chunky. Taste and adjust seasoning. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Spoon into hot and go easy serrano fondue or coffee pumpernickel. Garnish with tomato slices and chopped cherries.

title: Slow Cooker Turnips "n" Tuna
ingredients: 2 pounds turnips, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 can of anchovy-style tuna, drained | 1 can high-fat beef broth
instructions: Preheat your slow cooker on low heat. Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium high heat, add the olive oil and cook the turnips for 5 minutes on each side until golden brown. Remove the turnips from the slow cooker. Open the can of anchovies and drain them well, reserving the oil. Add the tuna and beef broth to the slow cooker and place the turnips on top of it. Cover and cook 2 1/2 hours on high. Let cool for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Honey-Honeyed Ice Cubes for Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/3 cup honey | 1/3 - 1/2 cup ice, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil for 3 - 5 minutes, or until mixture is reduced to 1 cup or so. Pour into a greased pie plate. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: dill,white pepper,pine nut,cumin seed,bulk pork sausage
title: Pigs of the Sausage Spread
ingredients: 1 pound sliced mild bulk pork sausage | 2 tablespoons minced fresh dill | 1 tablespoon minced fresh dill | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | ground white pepper to taste | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Place the sausage in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until evenly browned, about 8 minutes. Drain, crumble, and set aside. Mix the dill, ground cumin, and white pepper in a small bowl. Place the pine nuts in another small bowl. Set aside. When cooled, process the sausage, pine nuts, and dill spice mixture until smooth. Transfer the mixture to a jar, or a large cheesecloth lined bowl. Refrigerate for at least 1 day.

title: Pesto Souffles
ingredients: 1 egg white, at room temperature, plus | 2 tablespoons of pesto sauce, divided | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, divided | cooking spray
instructions: Position a rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 450°f beat together the egg white and 2 tablespoons pesto with 2 tablespoons salt in a small bowl to blend, then stir in more salt until fully incorporated. Lightly spray 4 individual ramekins with cooking spray and pour 1/4 cup pesto mixture into each. Ladle about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the hot mixture into each ramekin and cover loosely with foil. Bake in the middle of the oven until the puffles just start to turn golden around the edges, about 15 minutes. Run a knife around the edges of the pan and tip them out onto a baking rack, let cool slightly, and break into pieces with a fork.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,bread,stilton cheese,anise seed,bulgur,ranch dressing,black peppercorn,cumin seed
title: Monte Cristo Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur | 4 slices toast | 6 ounces monte cristo stilton cheese, sliced | 1 kiwi fruit, sliced, for garnish | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorn | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon ranch dressing
instructions: Soak bulgur in 1 cup of hot water over medium heat, 8 to 10 minutes, or until moistened. Drain, and mash in a bowl with a fork. Add the grated cheese and mix well with bulgur and kiwifruit. Stir in dressing and sprinkle with anise seeds, peppercorns, cumin seeds, and ranch dressing.

title: Beer-Braised Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/2 head of cabbage, shredded | 1/2 head of fennel, sliced | 4 ounces dark beer | 1 1/2 lbs chicken, quartered | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup oil | 1 tablespoon cilantro, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: In a large bowl, place the shredded cabbage, fennel, beer, and chicken pieces. Let sit for 30 minutes while the cabbage marinates. When the cabbage is done marinating, stir in the mayonnaise, oil, and seasonings. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Turn oven to 400 degrees. Bake for 45 minutes. Add the chopped cilantro for serving.

title: Sri Pintu - Japanese Coconut Liver
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1 small yellow onion, finely chopped | 4 lbs beef liver, cubed | 1/4 cup coconut cream, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in wok or large frying pan and saute onion until just browned. Add liver, stir and cook over high heat.

title: Sauce Alentejana
ingredients: 3/4 cup canola oil | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1/4 cup cognac | 4 tablespoons flour | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, very finely grated
instructions: Heat canola oil and garlic in a small sauté pan over low medium heat just until hot. Add cognac. Remove garlic and reserve. Whisk flour with baking powder and lemon rind in a bowl. Add oil/garlic mixture to pan and stir quickly to incorporate. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Serve immediately. Stir before serving.

title: Coconut-Mushroom Temptation
ingredients: 300 g sliced button mushrooms | 1 small ripe peach | 2 -3 kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dry dill pickle, finely chopped | 1 small sweet potato, finely diced ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon unsweetened dried shredded coconut ( to garnish )
instructions: Note, you can purchase a variety of varieties of mushrooms available in any supermarket of any ethnic aisle of the food store. Cut the mushrooms in half if they are large. Grate the peachy fruit and peel the pit off the mango if it is still a little on the pit. Chop the mango roughly and finely dice the sweet potato. Heat up a frying pan, or char grill on a grill pan, over medium heat, until crispy on the outside. Using your fingers or potato peeler, peel off any peel you see in the pan then coarsely chop the fruit. Mix the chopped mango, sweet potato, peaches and pickle in a bowl add the coconut, mix to combine. To serve, arrange a piece of the banana on your plate then spoon some of the coconut mixture over the top. It should be served with any tropical fruit.

title: Mexican Stuffed Tomatillos
ingredients: 16 tomatillos, husked and rinsed | 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 packages frozen chopped phyllo dough, thawed ( about 10 sheets ) | 1 jar chopped pecans | 3/4 cup uncooked converted rice noodles, separated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine tomatillos, 1 cup of rice, and oregano in a medium bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator. Cook rice and nuts in water to cover, stirring occasionally, until rice is softened and creamy, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare phyllo dough. Place 2 sheets of phyllo dough in a large bowl, brush with melted butter, and lightly brush 2 more sheets with butter. Working with one piece at a time, brush both with melted butter and sprinkle 1/2 cup of rice mixture. Lay 1/3 of the phyllo sheets, with sides touching each other, on the long sides of a sheet of phyllo dough over the rice and pine nuts. Place another piece of phyllo dough, about 1/4 inch from the edges of the sheet, and brush with melted butter. Repeat process twice. Using a sharp knife, cut 10 more pieces of dough to make 15 total layered phyllo dough. Lay 12 tomatillo stuffed tomatoes on top of the layered phyllo sheets, brushing each with melted butter and sprinkling with rice mixture. Repeat with 5 more phyllo sheets and remaining tomatillos, placing each on top of the tomatillo stuffed tomatoes. Cover with foil. Bake until tops are golden brown, about 40 minutes.

title: Roasted Sage Leaves
ingredients: 1 cup whole fresh sage leaf | 1 cinnamon stick, broken into about 2-inch lengths | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Lay the sage leaves out onto a rimmed baking sheet with a large scattering of cinnamon over the leaves. Sprinkle the sage with salt or pepper and toss around evenly. Roast for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until lightly browned. Turn and continue roasting until the cinnamon is well browned on the top of the leaves, about 10 minutes. Turn the sage leaves over and continue roasting until the leaves are blackened on the bottom, about 10 minutes longer. Sprinkle with salt or pepper. Remove the cinnamon from the oven and use a sharp kitchen torch to crush the cinnamon with a mortar and pestle or a wooden spoon.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,yellow onion,graham cracker crumb,semolina flour
title: Mom's Easy No Kiddingly Ricotta Pie
ingredients: 28 ounces italian stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 small yellow onion, diced | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup semolina flour, or more if needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix stewed tomatoes, yellow onion, graham cracker crumbs, and semolina flour with a spoon until well combined. Divide batter into four baking dishes, or as needed to fit the four individual ramekins.

title: Pesarattu (Baked Onion)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 2 tablespoons savory
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place ginger paste in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour to develop flavor and to mellow. Place savory in center of a piece of parchment paper. Place parchment paper on oven rack. Place parchment paper in oven. Cook for 15 minutes and then turn heat off. Allow to cool until dry.

title: Pistachio Manicotti
ingredients: 12 manicotti | 1 cup white sugar | 1 cup blue curacao | 2 tablespoons dry pistachio pudding mix, or as needed
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with water and bring to a rolling boil. Cook the manicotti shells in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Remove them from the water, drain and place in a bowl of ice water until all of the shells are cooled. Remove and discard the shells, but save the cooking water. Pour 1 cup sugar into a bowl, and stir in the curacao and pistachio. Mix well to blend, then set aside. Place remaining sugar in a separate bowl, and pour the remaining curacao into a small bowl, and fill the remaining saucepan with water to about halfway fill the original halfway level of the manicotti shells until all shells are full. Bring the water to a boil, and place the filled manicotti over the boiling water. Boil the shells for about 1 minute, just to soften them a little. Drain the shells in a colander, and place in a bowl of ice water to cool. Once shells are cool enough to handle, stuff them with half of the pistachio and sugar mixture, and return them to the saucepan. Cover, and refrigerate until the manicotti are cold, about 6 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, and set aside. Bring noodles to a boil in the boiling water, and cook for 5 minutes, or until tender yet firm to the bite. Place noodles in a large bowl, and toss with cold cooking water to cover. Spoon the noodles into 3 9x13 inch baking dishes, and spread in an even layer. Top with remaining pistachio and sugar mixture, and spread evenly. Uncover the manicotti, and spread evenly with orange juice. Bake in the preheated oven until the filling is hot and bubbling, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Tomato and Garlic Damper
ingredients: 4 -5 medium firm ripe tomatoes, peeled | 2 cups self grated unbleached self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c for a fan forced oven. Cut tomatoes into 12 wedges. Place onto a baking tray with a pinch of salt. Drizzle tomatoes with the juice and stir to coat all the skin. Place in the oven for 20 mins, or until tomatoes are tender. Remove the tomatoes from the oven, put to one side and cool slightly. Remove skin and roughly chop. Sift flour into a large bowl and gradually mix in cherry tomatoes until a soft dough forms. Turn onto a lightly floured surface. Knead lightly until just smooth. Turn onto a floured surface. Roll a few times to prevent dough sticking to your fingers. Roll out again to ease into a square about 12in/7 in/1 in wide. Arrange tomato halves on top and brush lightly with water. Bake for 30 mins or until damper begins to brown and filling is set. Allow to stand for 5 mins then transfer onto a wire rack to cool.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,green olive,pimento olive,chocolate,penne pasta,rectangular brioche bread,lasagna noodle
title: Rice Nests
ingredients: 3 cups dry penne pasta, cooked until just tender but firm | 1/2 cup diced pimento-stuffed olives | 4 3/4 ounces grated yves parmigiano-reggiano | 4 ounces rectangles of brioche bread, cubed ( approx. 6-12 slices ) | 2 tablespoons chopped green olives | 3/4 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 4 sheets frozen lasagna noodles, broken crosswise
instructions: In a bowl, toss together the pasta, olives, parmigiano reggiano, bread, and green olives. Divide the mixture among the 4 bread triangles on a platter and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoons of the confectioners' sugar. Lay the noodles on a baking sheet and bake at 400°f for 5 - 7 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and arrange the noodles on top. Sprinkle the remaining confectioners' sugar over the noodles. Serve immediately.

title: Cheese Whipped Cream - Microwave--------
ingredients: 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine all except parmesan cheese. Microwave on high for 2 minutes to soften cream slightly. Mix in parmesan cheese after 2 minutes. Cool.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,salmon,cashew,egg,dark soy sauce,dill weed,grain white rice,spice
title: Artichoke-Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain white rice, rinsed | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill weed | 4 ounces salmon, chunks | 1 container marinated artichoke hearts | 8 ounces cashews | 1 egg | spices
instructions: Cook rice in 3/4 cup water over medium heat until tender, then let stand 10 minutes. Drain well and rinse and set aside. Place dark or regular soy sauce and dill weed in a food processor and process until misun. Slice salmon lengthwise into 4 rings and place into soy sauce mixture. Cut artichoke hearts into wedges and place into soy sauce mixture along with cooked rice. Mix well. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Butter a 2 quart casserole dish. In a bowl, whisk together egg and remaining soy sauce mixture, then combine with rice mixture. Pour into casserole dish and arrange cashews on top. Bake 35 minutes, until it begins to brown.

title: Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 cremini mushrooms | 2 packages dried cremini mushrooms, thawed
instructions: Rinse mushrooms, removing any tough stems. Place the cleaned mushrooms in the bottom of a mixing bowl. Dry the mushrooms as much as possible, then add to bowl. Add about 10 tablespoons rum or other flavoring liquid, to taste, and mix well to combine. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 3 to 5 days, stirring now and then. Taste, and adjust sugar to your taste. Can be served as is or with some whipped cream or coffee.

Random Ingredients: almond meal,chilies,lime wedge,taco seasoning mix,sage leaf
title: Sage-Raisin Mexican Wedding Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons ground sage leaves | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons ground chilies | 3/4 cup almond meal | 2 limes or 2 lemons, juice of
instructions: With a fork, mix the sage, taco seasoning, chiles and almond meal. Gradually add the juice, mixing in until incorporated. Form mixture into 1 1/2 inch logs and place upright on a tray lined with parchment paper. Chill 30 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400°. Remove the paper from the log and break into 1/2 inch pieces with a fork. Roll pieces in sugar if desired until slightly golden brown. Store dough in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week. Note, you may also bake these on a regular sized cookie sheet aswell and then sprinkle about a third of the ground sago on top each cookie. Bake 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Green Beans in a Chili
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili paste | 4 -5 packages fresh green beans, trimmed and snapped in half. | 1/2 cup catsup ( any type )
instructions: In a small saucepan heat the chili paste over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes until fragrant. Add beans and cook 3 - 4 minutes until just barely softening. Meanwhile combine the catsup and 1 tablespoon hot sauce. To serve, ladle over the beans and serve.

title: Chinese Chicken Eggs in Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 hard-boiled egg, peeled and sliced in half lengthwise | 1 cup chicken broth
instructions: In a 4 to 5 quart enameled or stainless steel pot over medium heat, melt the chicken broth. Stir in the sliced egg. Cover pot and cook egg until egg is just set, about 10 minutes. Tilt the pot and shake pot to distribute the egg and scrambled egg in the eggs. Do not stir the eggs or the liquid will cook off. This can also be made in a deep fryer or a deep fryer that has been coated with oil. Transfer finished eggs into a bowl of cold water. Cover the bowl and refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: creme de menthe,beef bouillon granule,bisquick,hard egg
title: Creme De Menthe Crusted Beef Strips
ingredients: 2 cups bisquick | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 egg, beaten | 4 ounces creme de menthe
instructions: Mix bisquick and bouillon. Dip beef strips in egg, then roll in creme de menthe. Refrigerate until firm, about 10 minutes. Bake 375 in 2 quart casserole for 20 to 25 minutes, or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,table salt,chipotle chile,greek yogurt,red pepper flake
title: Chipotle Dressing
ingredients: 2 chipotle chiles, seeded, halved, stems and seeds removed | 2 tablespoons dried red pepper flakes ( i prefer fresh piquillo pepper chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon table salt ( can use reduced sodium salt ) | 1/4 cup low-fat nonfat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Grind dried peppers in mori to a powder. Transfer to mortar and pestle or spice mill and crush. Add remaining ingredients. Note, i use the pre mixed chipotle chile seasoning with piquillo peppers and garlic powder to make this dressing.

title: Spiced Corn on the Cob with Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups fresh corn kernels ( from 3 corn cobs ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and sliced into 1/2 inch rings | 1 tablespoon moroccan spice paste, of your choice ( see description )
instructions: Place corn kernels in a food processor or blender. Add the bell pepper and 1 tablespoon of moroccan spice blend and process until smooth.

title: The Shrimp and Asparagus Encrusted With Chili Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger or 1 lb ground beef | 1 package frozen asparagus, cut in 4 pieces | 2 -3 slices emmenthaler cheese, for topping | 1 can chipotle chiles, chopped, for topping | 1 large bay leaf | 1 package uncooked small shrimp ( optional )
instructions: Heat skillet, on medium heat,. Brown hamburger or crumbled beef in skillet until browned.

title: Cauliflower Crabe
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg cauliflower florets | 2 liters oil ( for frying ) | 200 g cod, in small chunks
instructions: Boil water in a pressure cooker on high heat. Add cauliflower and steam lightly. Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Then add the fish and stir gently. Cover and cook on low heat for 3 minutes, then fluff with a fork until cooked through. If you have to thick it just boil it uncovered, then remove lid and cook 10 minutes. You can serve it with a variety of dishes. We normally serve it with rice.

title: Buckwheat Pancakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 3/4 cup fat-free puffed buckwheat flour | 2/3 cup fat-free refried beans ( i also use the canned beans. ) | 1/4 cup branston pickle ( fiber fiber biscuits ) | 6 large tortillas ( i use the crispy tortilla chips ) | 4 teaspoons maple syrup or 4 teaspoons light molasses | 15 ounces canned artichoke hearts, drained and finely chopped ( not marinated ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon | 2 -3 teaspoons white sugar
instructions: Preheat a pancake griddle or medium frying pan to medium high heat. In a small bowl, combine the molasses and 1/3 cup flour. Stir the hot batter into the molasses mixture. Transfer the batter to the frying pan to spread evenly. Let cook 1 to 2 minutes, then flip. Cook until a golden crust forms, flipping only once. While the pancakes are cooking, spread 2 teaspoons maple syrup on one side of each tortilla. Spoon about 2 spoonfuls of batter onto each tortilla and top with 1/4 1 1/2 tsp branston. Then sprinkle with remaining branston. Fold up one tortilla over the pancakes to make a semicircle.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,red cherry,romano cheese,halibut,red curry paste,prosciutto
title: Tiger Baked in Red Curry for Two
ingredients: 2 salmon, fresh | 1/2 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon romano cheese | 1 cup diced firm white fish | 1 cup halibut, cooked al dented
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f and line an ovenproof dish with aluminium foil. Cut two 5cm lengths of foil to fit the foil parcel, and put them on a tray. Cut a small slash at the 2 inch intervals along each side of each fillet, then use a sharp knife to slash two 3cm lengths through each fillet. Sprinkle the red curry paste over the fish, add the sugar, mix together and then scatter evenly with romano. Put the fish on the foil parcel, seal both sides and then put the tin foil parcel under the fish for 10 minutes. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 - 40 minutes or until cooked. While it's baking, steam the fish in a steamer over boiling water for 15 - 20 minutes or until just cooked through. Slice the fish into thick slices and toss with the sauce to serve. Serve with a green vegetable and roasted vegetables.

title: Lebanese-Style Noodles
ingredients: 1 package cellophane noodles, broken in half | 1 red onion, halved and thinly sliced
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water has boiled, stir in the noodles and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have turned a rich golden brown color, about 10 minutes. Drain well on paper towels. While the noodles are cooking, heat a heavy large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the sliced red onion.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,mustard seed,cream tartar,cornstarch,coconut rum,red bird eye chili
title: Indian Corned Red Chili Rice with Coconut Rum
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups basmati rice, rinsed | 2 1/2 cups sour cream or 2 1/2 cups greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon cayenne red chile ( or more, to taste ) | 1 teaspoon cornstarch, mixed with | salt and water ( for steaming )
instructions: In small saucepan on high, add the mustard seeds, cook stirring until they start to pop and smell dry. Crush them with a mortar and pestle with coarse blade or a rubber spatula, add in rice and stir just until they begin to dry out. Stir in sour cream, cream of tartar, chile and cornstarch mixture, stir until the mixture is smooth. Add in water if a thick liquid is desired. Cover and set aside to stand for 30 minutes before serving. It can also be made in a rice cooker. After it is standing, rice can be made up to 2 days ahead of time and kept covered according to your recipe.

title: Stuffed Hotburgers
ingredients: 3/4 lb hamburger | 1/2 cup sweet yellow pepper, diced | 1/2 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup fresh carrot, shaved | 3 tablespoons cranberries | 1 tablespoon caraway seed, flake | 1 1/2 cups cabbage, shredded | bitter melon, for garnish
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Dip your bitter melon in water. Carefully fill each bitter melon with meat mixture. Place on grill. Grill until meat is cooked through, about about 10 minutes or so turning once. Serve hot, garnished with cherries and/or dill.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,panko breadcrumb,italian salad dressing mix,yellow cornmeal,ice water,radish,tomato paste
title: Italian Cornbread II
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup white cornmeal | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 can tomato paste | 1/4 cup water | 2 -4 tablespoons cold unpeeled radishes, chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons ice water
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Mix panko bread crumbs, cornmeal, italian salad dressing mix and tomato paste in medium bowl.

title: Budget Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs leg of lamb, cut into chunks | 1 can hominy, drained | 2 lbs floury potatoes, cubed | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo
instructions: In crock pot, mix ingredients together and cook on low for 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: salmon,carrot,plain yogurt,orange peel,navy bean,peanut oil vegetable,egg noodle
title: Spicy Hanukkah Salmon and Noodles
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces boneless skinless salmon | 4 1/2 ounces dry navy beans | 1 cup low fat plain yogurt | 4 tablespoons oil or 4 tablespoons vegetable, such as pam | 1 egg noodles | 1 carrot, shredded | 1/4 piece orange peel, about 2 teaspoons
instructions: Place the beans and the salmon in a mixing bowl and mix all the dressing ingredients in a small bowl for about 5 minutes or until combined. Cut the salmon fillet into chunks and add it to the marinade in the bowl. Let stand, covered, in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Boil water in a large saucepan and cook the noodles according to the package directions. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again. Set aside. Slice the carrot into matchsticks. Toss and set aside. Drain the yogurt and let stand until thickened, about 1 - 2 minutes longer, then stir into the noodles. Put the marinated salmon on a plate, cover and refrigerate for at least one hour. Dry the noodles in a bowl and add them to the salmon. Pour the dressing into a small bowl and stir until combined. Pour the noodles into serving bowls and top with the salmon and carrot slices, adding some salad dressing over each bowl when serving.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,white vinegar,ranch dressing,chili pepper flake,red potato
title: Potatoes Sour Cream & Chilies Cheese
ingredients: 6 small red potatoes, halved lengthways | 1/3 cup mild cheddar cheese, grated | 1 -2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons white vinegar ( optional ) | 1/2 cup ranch dressing, of your choice
instructions: Cook the potatoes in boiling water for 5 - 7 minutes or until tender. Drain and return to the pan, add the cheese and chili flakes. Add the vinegar and salt as required. Add the dressing and mix well.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,philadelphia cream cheese,pistachio nut,date,baby spinach,grain rice
title: Spinach & Pistachio Rice Ring Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 bag baby spinach | 1/4 cup roughly chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 1/3 cup chopped pistachio nuts | 1/3 cup philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f, using a sharp knife, finely chop rice and spinach. Mix remaining ingredients on medium high speed in a mixing bowl. Add rice mixture and mix well. Spoon into a ring mold or a glass dish. Cook ring until browned, about 1 hour, and cool on a wire rack.

title: Noodles With Mango Chutney and Orange Peel
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 5 ounces mango chutney ( not supermarket brand ) | 1 ounce finely grated orange peel
instructions: Cook linguine in boiling, slated water for 12 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Meanwhile, combine chutney, orange peel, and some of the juice from the oranges in a small bowl. Add remaining juice to the chutney, stir. Transfer the linguine to plates, top with chutney mixture and add the orange peel.

Random Ingredients: hickory barbecue sauce,corn oil,cantaloupe,chicken tender,lamb,self raising flour
title: Lamb, Cantaloupe and Honey Crumble
ingredients: 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1/2 cup corn oil | 400 g cooked lamb, cubed | 4 -10 ounces prepared honey barbecue sauce | 1 1/4 cups cantaloupe, cubed | 2 lbs frozen cooked chicken tenders, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c. Lightly grease a 10 x 15 cm round tin. In a large bowl, sift the sifted flour and corn oil into a separate bowl. Add the lamb, honey barbecue sauce, cantaloupe, meat mix and the tenders and combine. Pour the mixture into the prepared tin and bake in the oven for 45 - 60 minutes, or until the curry is golden and the meat is cooked.

title: Pork Loin
ingredients: 2 lbs pork loin, cut in half crosswise ( about 5-6-oz. each ) | 1/2 cup wheat germ | 1 tablespoon orange rind, grated | 1 tablespoon garlic paste
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and marinate, covered, 2 hours or overnight. Bake, covered, in a 350°f oven for 1 to 1½ hours, basting periodically with juices.

title: Greek Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/3 pounds chicken thighs, cut in half | 2 pounds cooked hamburger buns, cut in half | 2 cans or bottles light italian-style beer | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cup hazelnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken thighs, hamburger buns, and beer in a large, deep, heavy pot. Cook over high heat, stirring often, until breadcrumbs start to form on the bottom, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer chicken thighs and hamburger buns to jelly roll pans, fill with enough bread crumbs to make coating on top, and layer with shrimp. Sprinkle hazelnuts on top, and cover pan with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven until hot and bubbly, about 45 minutes.

title: Blackberry Fennel
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb | 3/4 cup fresh blackberries | 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Remove and discard stem from fennel bulb. Cut fennel bulb and discard fronds.

title: Chile Carrots
ingredients: 5 cups grated carrots | 20 small dried red chiles | celery salt
instructions: In medium size bowl, combine carrots, chiles, and celery salt. Let stand for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with a little celery salt before serving.

title: Scottish Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried onion | 1 1/4 lbs stewing beef | 3/4 cup white rum | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Sprinkle the chopped dried onion on top and cook until the onion is tender. Trim all visible fat from the beef. Place it in a heavy pot or roasting pan, sprinkle the rum over it, add the dried dill and bring to a boil over medium heat.

title: Mock Devonshire Cheese
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cheddar cheese soup | 1/2 cup instant coffee powder
instructions: In 3 1/2 ounce canning jars with lids, place 1 soup can and 1 soup can of the soup. Heat with water until bubbly around the edge. Run a knife along edges of jars to loosen and tighten a little. Wipe rims of jars with a clean, damp paper towel. Ladle hot coffee into clean jars to about 1/2 inch below the tops of the cans. Top with remaining 1 soup can. Wipe rims with a clean, damp towel.

Random Ingredients: tamari soy sauce,pasta,grain brown rice,bean sprout,allspice
title: Chinese Rice Bowl
ingredients: 3 cups short grain brown rice | 15 ounces fat-free refried beans, drained | 1/2 cup tamari soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 cups fresh rice, cooked
instructions: Coat a large nonstick frypan with cooking spray. Add rice to frypan in a single layer. Cover and cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove rice from heat and set aside. In a bowl, combine beans, tamari, and allspice. Pour bean mixture over rice, then allow grains to absorb liquid, about 2 minutes. Serve rice mixture in bowls.

title: Hot & Sour Corn
ingredients: 2 lbs corn, cut out from the cob | 2 tablespoons stock | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 pint chopped canned peaches or 1 pint peach | 1 tablespoon dried apricot
instructions: Cut kernels from corn, wash well then boil for 8 minutes. Meanwhile boil stock up a little and pour over hot corn. Heat through a little. Place in ovenproof bowl then cover. Cook for 10 - 15 minutes at 180° c, then leave to stand for 5 minutes. Remove corn then toss through other ingredients.

title: Nif's Mediterranean Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package caiabatta, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 can artichoke hearts, packed in water, drained, and quartered | 2 cups chopped canned peaches | 1/4 cup dried currants | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon, crushed | 4 cups mixed thinly sliced garden fresh vegetables such as artichoke hearts, broccoli, cauliflower, spinach or parsnip | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish, or other hot sauce
instructions: To cook pasta, in a large pot of salted boiling water, cook caiabetta until crisp, about 5 minutes. Pour off excess fat. Drain on paper towels. Drain artichoke hearts and reserve liquid. In a large bowl, mix pasta, artichoke hearts, peaches, currants, tarragon, coriander, and crushed tarragon. Pour in enough dressing to coat. Toss to coat. Cover.

title: Italian Breadsticks for One
ingredients: 1 package dry english muffins | garlic salt
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Lay the muffins open, and cut each slice in half, horizontally, to make two sticks. Place half of the stick on a cookie sheet, and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon of garlic salt. Place the baking sheet with the stick on the preheated broiler. Broil 4 to 6 inches from the heat source until the sticks are lightly browned, about 5 minutes, turning once. Allow the stick to cool before removing from the cookie sheet.

title: Easy Baked Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup tahini
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spread soup on the bottom of a 9x10 baking dish. Sprinkle with tahini. Place mushrooms back into the oven and bake for 30 minutes or until mushrooms are tender and cooked through.

title: Rice Griddle Bread for Breakfast or Sandwich Filler
ingredients: 8 ounces rice flour | 1 3/4 cups nonfat milk or 1 3/4 cups nonfat powdered milk | 1 -2 tablespoon ketchup ( sweet pickle )
instructions: Mix flour and skim milk together in a mixing bowl. Add ketchup, stir well and set aside. Dough will be very thick. Dough should be firm and puffy, which means it will have a thinner consistency. If dough is still lumpy, divide into 2 pieces. On griddle or frying pan, stretch out dough and form into a rectangle, about 3 to 4 inches in diameter. Batter should be about 1 inch thick. Place on greased griddle or frying pan until golden brown on both sides, about 5 minutes on each side. Let stand 10 minutes. Slice with sharp knife before serving.

title: Spicy Stuffed Crabs......
ingredients: 2 cans crabmeat | 1 package currants, drained | 1 can vegetable broth | 1/4 cup pine nuts | ground coriander seed | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Put all ingredients except the crabmeat into a soup pot and heat until the pine nuts are golden. Stir in the crabmeat and crabmeat, and simmer over a moderate heat for 5 minutes. Spoon the crabmeat mixture into small individual dishes or individual ramekin dishes and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,muenster cheese,yellow squash,batter,soya sauce,feta cheese,vanilla ice cream,heavy cream
title: Quinoa Pizza Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 yellow squash ( diced ) | 1 green zucchini ( diced ) | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup light soya sauce | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 4 ounces feta cheese | 1 tablespoon ajou ( optional ) | vanilla ice cream or yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Prepare pan as follows, spray with cooking spray for ease of cleanup. Combine quinoa, squash, soy sauce, cream, soya sauce and nutmeg. Add another circle of quinoa and repeat layers. Add rest of cream. Top with ajou and bake in oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and top with yogurt, if desired.

Random Ingredients: coriander,chicken broth,red curry paste,chinese five spice powder,margarine

instructions: Trim excess fat from meat. Remove meat from bones. Cut crosswise into 3 x 1/4 inch strips and arrange in a shallow baking pan. Mix lime juice and shortening with small amount of lime juice mixture. Pour over meat. Cover tightly and bake in a pre heated 350°f oven for 2 hours. Remove meat and pour remaining liquid. Bake for a further 15 minutes. Slices from roast and serve.

instructions: Line two baking tray with parchment paper. Arrange peppers and curry paste on two baking sheets and season with coriander, pepper, and salt. Place flour on another tray. Use paper to make patties about 3 inches in diameter.

instructions: Put buttermilk in microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high 8 - 10 minutes until buttermilk is starting to thicken slightly, remove from microwave, add spring onions. title: Annie's Baklava

instructions: In a large pot add beans, apples and molasses. Cover.

instructions: Arrange zucchini and sage on plate. Sprinkle with splenda. In small bowl, whisk together splenda, vinegar and sage. Pour over zucchini mixture.

instructions: Combine everything except capsicum and pecans in a bowl. Add capsicum and mix well.

Random Ingredients: fillet salmon,chicken breast,irish cream,greek seasoning,marjoram,superfine sugar,shell pasta
title: Easy Stove Top Crusted Salmon With Pasta
ingredients: 1 can of cooked small shell pasta | 1 tablespoon greek seasoning or 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram, chopped | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon bottled chicken breast, chopped | 1 tablespoon chicken stock or 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon bottled greek salad dressing or 1 teaspoon your favourite salad dressing | 2 1/2 ounces fillets salmon, in 2. 5 oz portions
instructions: Put the pasta in the fridge for 10 minutes to help the cooking start. Meanwhile, put the greek seasoning into a dry frying pan and toast for a few minutes, taking care not to burn it. title: Date and Anchovy Spread (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 6 -8 medium pitted dates | 1/8 teaspoon anchovy paste ( optional )
instructions: Slice and core the dates. Place all the ingredients in a medium sized bowl. Using your hands, mix thoroughly. The mixture should look and feel like an almost paste like consistancy to this mixture. Cover the surface of the mixture loosely with plastic wrap and store in the refrigerator for about 20 minutes or up to 2 days.

title: Beef Loin and Cashew Butter Open Faced Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh beef top sirloin, thinly sliced | 1/2 pound pork loin, thinly sliced | 1/2 pound cashew butter | 4 tablespoons sweet vermouth | 4 slices white bread | tzatziki
instructions: Mix the beef and pork slices with the cashew butter, sweet vermouth, and the crusty side of a cocktail shaker until well combined. Heat a skillet over medium heat.

title: Grilled Sausage and Smoked Beef Sandwich With Prosciutto and Smoked Rutabaga
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons cooking oil | 4 -5 lbs lean ground sirloin | 2 large rutabagas, halved lengthwise and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 lb baby portabella mushrooms, halved | fresh chili, cut into 3, 2-inch wedges lengthwise | 1/2 lb prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1 -2 teaspoon baking powder | 4 kaiser rolls ( or homemade ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to about 375 degrees. Combine 1/4 lb. Of the salt pork, the remaining 1/4 lb. Salt pork, and the beef in a large bowl and lightly mash together. Toss with the onions and mushrooms. Shape into 4 patties. Brush the patties with some oil, and sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 lb. Salt. Place the patties on the grill and grill on both sides until nicely browned, about 10 minutes, turning once. Let the patties rest for 5 minutes, then slice into 1/2 inch slices. Serve on toasted buns with the smoked rutabaga and the smokey beef.

title: Cucumber Yogurt
ingredients: 300 g yogurt ( greek is my choice as a whole product ) | 1 teaspoon flour | 3 fresh thyme sprigs ( i use dried, crumbled or chopped fresh sprigs. not dried. ) | 1 english cucumber, peeled, seeded, peeled, and roughly chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the yogurt and flour until smooth and creamy. Add the thyme, cucumber, and mix to mix through gently so that all the ingredients become coated in the yogurt. Cover, and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight before serving cold.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,white sugar,butter,gruyere cheese,japanese eggplant,coriander leaf,oregano leaf
title: Pancetta Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg small japanese eggplants, peeled | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/4 - 1/2 cup coriander leaves, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh oregano leaves, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 500 g stewing beef, grated
instructions: Cut a cross in the skin of the eggplants. Sprinkle with salt, rub over the bitter white inside and cut 1/2 cm deep slits across the top and bottom. Boil until soft. Drain off the bitter white that remains on the eggplants. Place them on paper towels to drain. Cut a cross in the top of each eggplant and place inside a shallow pot of water. Add the sugar and 3 cups of cold water to the eggplants and place a plate on top to keep the eggplants submerged. Bring water to boil and place the eggsplants in a pot of boiling water. Cook the eggplants for approximately 20 minutes or until soft. Remove the cooked eggplants and drain on paper towels. Remove shells and place in a bowl of cold water. Dice the cooked eggplants into small, bite sized pieces, place into the bowl with the chopped eggplants. Combine the chopped coriander, oregano and gruyere. Mix thoroughly. Place the eggplants on a hot, greased griddle, brown the mixture lightly, and serve immediately and keep hot. Note, it is important, to heat a non stick non stick griddle over very low heat and not to burn the eggplants. A few seconds later sprinkle on the cheese so that it melts and the outside turns crusty. Another alternative is to place the eggplants in a pan of boiling water. Cook the eggplants for about 30 seconds then plunge into iced water. The eggsplants may be kept hot for two hours or more, cooked but not overcooked. Place the cooked eggsplants in a bowl and sprinkle with a little grated cheese. Serve the cooked cheese on a large, round plate, sprinkle with coriander and oregano and serve the boiled eggplants with a glass of iced tea.

title: Lobster Tail
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 4 small heads cabbage, cored and cut into wedges | 6 pounds cooked chicken thighs, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Sprinkle pork chops with mace, and place in a shallow roasting pan. Add cabbage wedges. Roast in the preheated oven, turning, until pork is cooked through, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: reynolds wrap foil,mozzarella cheese,frosting,english muffin,cornflour,german sauerkraut,vanilla extract
title: Frosted German Sausage Rolls #RSC

instructions: Prepare the potato rolls. In a bowl, mix sauerkraut with english muffins and corn flour, set aside. Prepare the cheese rolls. Roll each potato lengthwise into a long sausage, cut a slit in each, leaving a 1/2 thick shell. Brush top of potato with melted butter, and roll up like a jelly roll, pressing down as needed to seal. In a casserole, layer sausage rolls, and spread on german saurkraut mixture. Cover with cheese, and bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cheese begins to turn golden brown.

title: Easy Mexican Tiramisu

Add the sweet pickling spices and mix well. Cover and set aside. Line an 8x8x2 inch glass baking dish with plastic wrap. Prepare a 9x3 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Place the lady fingers in a wide bowl or strainer. To each lady finger, spread 2 tablespoons of sweet pickling spices over the fingers. Top with 2 tablespoons of the sweet pickling cucumber mixture. Arrange on top of the pickling cucumber mixture. Cover with a lid and set aside for 2 to 3 days.

instructions: Cut the peppers in half and remove seeds and membrane. Place peppers in a large bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave for 20 minutes. Drain well and then peel and chop the flesh. instructions: Heat oven to 180c.

title: Pasta Fish

instructions: Place the fish, flour and water in a large saucepan with just enough water to cover, and bring to the boil. Reduce heat, cover and cook for 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside. title: Cauliflower Calabrese With Yeast and Tomatoes (Abm)

title: Spanish Corned Beef With Apples, Onions and Peppers
ingredients: 4 lbs corned beef brisket | 2 small spanish onions ( the lighter yellow you can get in the grocery store ) | 6 red bell peppers ( the smaller green are easier ) | 12 hard-boiled eggs | 1 cup yellow peas | 16 cups unsalted wine vinegar | 12 medium peeled tart apples ( i've found that a `` fresh '' apple won't do )
instructions: Place all the ingredients, except the brisket, in a crockpot and cook on high for 4 hours,. Remove the brisket from the crockpot and shred it by hand. Taste and adjust for salt and pepper. Put the shredded brisket back in and stir it through the stew. Don't forget to serve this with some crusty bread or a crusty bread loaf. The finished stew can be frozen with the beef back in.

Random Ingredients: crouton,chocolate chip,egg,milk chocolate chip,pearl barley,red chili pepper,asiago cheese
title: Red Chile Pepper Roulades for One!
ingredients: 1 cup red sweet chili peppers ( i just use a can of whole chile peppers ) | 1 cup pearl barley ( i use barley pearl barley ) or 1 cup zucchini barley, rinsed and drained | 1 cup asiago cheese, shredded ( or cheddar cheese ) | 12 eggs | 1/4 cup milk chocolate chips | 1 cup crouton
instructions: Rinse and drain chili peppers. Combine peppers and barley in a saucepan. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Place eggs in bowl. Place remaining ingredients in a pan, and beat well. Over low medium heat, melt chips and pour into pan. Heat just until bubbly. Turn heat off.

title: Thai Spiced Chicken
ingredients: 1 roquefort cheese, cubed | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon soyster sauce | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon ginger, grated
instructions: Toss cheese and oyster sauce in large bowl. Add bread crumbs, soy sauce, and lime juice and mix well. Add ginger and toss again. Line baking sheet with foil. Add mixture to dish, bake at 350 for 25 - 35 min, or grill, and serve.

title: Spanish Cabbage and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb spanish chorizo, thickly sliced bacon or 1 lb mild italian sausage | 1 medium head cabbage leaf | 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 -2 teaspoon pickling spices
instructions: Place the bacon or sausage in a large nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Cook, stirring, until the fat starts to render, then reduce the heat to medium. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the bacon or sausage to a paper towel lined plate. Drain the fat from the pan, leaving about 2 tablespoons. Return the heat to high, then add the cabbage leaf and cook, stirring, until lightly browned. Stir in the beans and seasoning and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,peanut oil,cubanelle pepper,hot red pepper sauce,spinach
title: Spinach and Peppers With Ginger
ingredients: 10 -11 ounces fresh spinach | 4 cubanelle peppers | 1/3 cup peanut oil | 4 fresh hot red peppers, sliced | 1 1/2 inches piece fresh gingerroot
instructions: Wash and separate the spinach leaves.

title: Kiwi Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry | cooking spray | 4 kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced | catsup ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or griddle over medium high heat. Arrange 1 sheet of phyllo in skillet. Spray with cooking spray, and brush with 1/2 kiwifruit slices. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon catsup, if desired. Fold in half lengthwise, then roll into a half moon shape. Spoon 1 to 2 tablespoons catsup onto edge of roll, covering entirely. Place rolled rolls onto griddle or skillet, and cook until crisp and golden brown, about 1 minute. Brush tops with remaining catsup, or if desired, and cook 4 to 5 minutes, or until crisp and lightly browned on one side.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,chow mein noodle,romano cheese,chocolate shaving,marjoram
title: Sour Chocolate Crunch Noodles (Chinese Style)
ingredients: 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate shavings, chopped | 1 package dry chow mein noodles | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | freshly shredded romano cheese or parmesan cheese
instructions: Place chocolate in a small bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator. Add chow mein noodles to the bowl and mix until coated with chocolate. Transfer 2 tablespoons noodles to a piping hot wok and stir until hot.. Spoon 1 rounded teaspoonfuls of noodles onto a warm noodle and spread out. Sprinkle with romano cheese or parmesan cheese and marjoram and top with a few more noodles.

Random Ingredients: pepper,red wine,bok choy,sage leaf,eggplant,green cabbage,sharp cheddar cheese,rice vinegar
title: Bok Choy and Eggplant Cakes
ingredients: 1 eggplant, medium | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons red wine | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage leaves | 250 g bok choy, shredded | 300 g green cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup chopped fresh pepper | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Slice eggplant on the diagonal into 1cm chunks, removing seeds if they are bitter. Brush a non stick frying pan with peanut oil, add eggplant and cook over a medium heat for about 10 minutes. Whilst the eggplant is cooking mix together the soy sauce, wine, and sage and keep warm. Place bok choy, cabbage, and pepper into a medium size bowl. Stir over a low heat until cabbage is wilted. Serve with the soy mixture and vinegar.

title: Cheaters Seafood Loaf
ingredients: 500 g fresh fish, cut into 4 segments | 300 g sour cream | 300 g chopped fresh seaweed ( about 12 medium ) or 300 g sesame seeds ( about 12 medium ) | 300 g french bread or 300 g italian bread | 1 packet ramen noodles ( or more )
instructions: Prepare the seafood in advance. Combine sour cream, seaweed, bread, and noodles ingredients together thoroughly. Pour into a loaf pan lined with tinfoil or greases clingfilm. Bake 1 hour at 200°c.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,sugar,lasagna noodle,pimento olive,maraschino cherry,white wine
title: Maraschino Riggi
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked al dente | 1 cup dry white wine ( i use vermouth ) | 1 cup pimento stuffed olives, sliced | 1 cup maraschino cherry, halved | 1 teaspoon sugar | 12 -16 ounces whole-milk chocolate lasagna noodles
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to package directions, drain and combine with white wine, olives, cherry halves and sugar. Spoon into 4 - 5 cup baking dish or 2 1/2 quart ramekins and bake at 400 for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Note, to make ahead, prepare the noodles ahead. Dump the cooked rigatoni into an even layer on top of the cherry halves, cover with plastic wrap then refrigerate up to 3 days. Bring to room temperature before continuing. Bring to room temperature before removing from the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: sea salt pepper,pepperoni,chow mein noodle,parsley leaf,cocoa powder,ginger root
title: Cha Cha's Noodles
ingredients: 1 package chow mein noodles | 1 tablespoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1/4 pound pepperoni, diced | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, minced | 1 tablespoon grated ginger root | sea salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the chow mein noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still slightly firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. While the noodles are cooking, coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Spread a light coating of nonstick cooking spray on the prepared baking sheet. Place the pepperoni in a plastic zipper bag, and pour the water from the bag over the pepperoni. Squeeze out the air, and seal the bag. Place the pepperoni in the bowl with the noodles, and combine. Mix in the parsley, ginger, and enough seasoning to coat the noodles. Continue grating a few times, stirring frequently, until the noodles look creamy, slightly chunky, and coated with the chunky peanut butter mixture. Transfer the noodles to a serving dish, and serve with chai sauce poured over.

title: Accent Seasoned Dry Rub
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sherry | 2 tablespoons accent seasoning
instructions: Place all in a clean, dry jar. Store in a cool, dry and dry place. Use the salt evenly on all surfaces.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,onion soup mix,chipotle chile,corn flake,louisiana sauce
title: Fried Cakes With Spicy Chipotle Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon instant minced onion ( or 1/2 tsp. ) | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1 large chipotle chile | 2 cups corn flakes | 2 tablespoons louisiana hot sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk the onion soup mix with minced onions. Add the curry powder, chile, and cornflakes, mixing well. Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat. Drop the chipotle in the pan, using tongs to pull up and submerge them in the batter. Cook for 4 or 5 minutes or until the top begins to bubble. Remove from heat and serve hot with chips.

title: Grilled Beef With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brewed tea | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks ( about 1 1/2-ounce each ) | 1 large mango, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 lb kale, stemmed and torn into bite size pieces
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk the tea, vanilla, cayenne and 2 tablespoons of the oil. Place about 1/4 cup of the beef in the center of a sheet of foil. Drizzle with the chutney. Place the meat on top and pinch to seal. Place the wrapped piece of meat on the foil, fold the foil half way around and pinch to fold the edges up. Place in a resealable gallon freezer bag and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Remove from the freezer and discard the foil half piece way around. Light a gas grill or heat a gas grill to medium high or preheat a grill pan to medium high. Remove the meat from the packet and slice into strips, about 3 to 4 ounces. Place on the grill and cook 1 minute per side, or until cooked as desired. Remove the meat from the grill or heat the meat to your preferred doneness, about 5 minutes per side for medium rare. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 130 degrees f or so.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,fontina cheese,avocado,tortilla chip,coconut extract,garam masala,asiago cheese
title: Bombay-Style Breakfast Nachos Salad
ingredients: 1 avocado | 2 tablespoons shredded fresh coconut or 2 tablespoons shredded coconut flakes | 1 teaspoon roasted garlic mashed garam masala | 1/8 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 carton tortilla, coarsely crushed | 1 cup shredded fontina cheese | 2 dashes garam masala | 1 cup shredded asiago cheese | tortilla chips
instructions: Cut avocado in half lengthwise. Scoop and discard flesh from pit with spoon. Slice flesh into large bite size pieces. In a small bowl, combine avocado and next 5 ingredients. Place in refrigerator for at least 1 - 2 hours. Break up tortilla into bite size pieces. Place in a bowl. Toss with cheeses. Garnish with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,alfredo sauce,pie shell,beef steak,yellow pepper,serrano pepper
title: Spicy Beef Tenderloin Pie
ingredients: 1 box refrigerated pie shell | 1 lb beef steak, thinly sliced | 1 cup chopped yellow sweet pepper | 1 fresh serrano pepper, sliced into thin, long strips | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, cubed
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare pie crust according to package directions. Drain on paper towels, return to oven and bake until golden brown on top, about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, mix beef, sweet pepper and serrano pepper in a large bowl with one cup of the alfredo sauce. Spread the meat mixture evenly into the prepared pie crust. Spread cream cheese onto the top of the beef mixture. Bake in preheated oven 30 to 45 minutes or until beef is no longer pink, and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,vanilla extract,rice noodle,serrano pepper,beef stock,malt vinegar,cardamom seed
title: Dairy Free Beef-Free Noodle
ingredients: 16 ounces rice noodles | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1 medium serrano pepper, chopped | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Prepare noodles according to the package directions and drain. In a microwave safe bowl mix the vinegar, stock, picante sauce, vanilla and cardamom seeds. Add the noodles and stir to coat. Serve with the grated cheese.

title: Italian Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup oatmeal | 1 cabbage, shredded | 2 mandarin oranges | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups double cream | 0.5 box frozen chopped spinach leaves, defrosted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl, mix together the oatmeal and shredded cabbage. Core and slice the mandarin oranges in half lengthwise, so the long slice remains intact. Lay the orange slices out in the centre of each piece of cabbage and top each one with a mandarin orange slice half. Fold the pieces into a roll with the length of the cabbage on the outside of the roll. Place the rolls in an oven safe baking dish. Set aside. Drain the juice from the mandarin oranges in a saucepan. Add the italian tomatoes. Heat over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,red chili pepper,cake flour,frito corn chip,extra beef,bean,sea salt
title: Mexican Floyed Flour Tortilla
ingredients: 5 large flour tortillas | 14 ounces extra lean ground beef | 1 red chili pepper | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 3 ounces frito corn chips | 1 lime, zest of | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Brown ground beef with chili pepper, and drain. Cool on paper towel and crumble the excess fat. Set aside. Add flour to the beef, mix well. Add the frito, lime zest and sea salt. Mix well. Divide the meat mixture between the tortillas. Roll up like a burrito, then secure with skewers or tooth picks. Fry for 5 mins each side at 350 and serve with salsa and sour cream and guacamole.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,pickle relish,monterey jack pepper cheese,chicken bouillon cube,pork tenderloin
title: Pork Tenderloin Rollups
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin ( the thinner the meat, the better ) | 3/4 cup monterey jack pepper cheese or 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon pickle relish | 1 beef chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees. Mix pepper jack cheese and sweet pickle relish together. Slice tenderloins crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place a slice of cheese on each slice of the tenderloin, then place the slice of pork in a shallow 1/2 inch x 3 inch strip of cheese on top of the pickle. Secure a boullion cube with toothpick if necessary. Stuff the cheese strip around the tenderloin, securing it with tooth picks. Coat the slices of meat with the cream of tartar. Place in a foil lined or sprayed shallow roasting pan. Bake 40 minutes or until internal temperature registers 160 degrees. Turn oven off, but allow to remain in oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer pan to serving platter. Serve with assorted condiments such as sour cream or ketchup or mayo.

title: Baked Clams and Cheese With Cream
ingredients: 20 clams | 8 slices round processed cheese | 200 g thinly sliced salami | 1 large vanilla bean, split lengthways | 300 ml double cream | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce
instructions: To make the base, fill a large saucepan with water and bring to the boil. Using the broad side of a knife or kitchen knife carefully scrape the base of the pan. Using a flat bladed knife, slash the surface of the base of the clam shell in a criss cross pattern all over. When the water boils, add the clams. Lower the heat, cover the pan and steam the clams for 2 minutes then drain. Preheat the oven to 180ºc /350ºf /gas mark make the cheese topping, in a bowl, blend together the cheese, salami, vanilla bean, cream and fish sauce using a wire whisk. Spread the top of the clams with the cheese mixture, and bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until the base is golden and the cheese has melted. Serve immediately. Serves note, if you want to serve on a hot day.

title: Panir
ingredients: 1 can canned tomatoes | 2 medium celery ribs | 2 ounces pancetta, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Put tomatoes and celery pieces into blender, drizzling with vodka and poultry seasoning. Blend all together until smooth, about 20 seconds or so, adding more vodka if necessary to form a chunky puree. Pour into a shallow dish. Let stand at room temperature for at least an hour before serving.

title: Portuguese Fried Chicken Appetizer
ingredients: 1 frying chicken, cleaned and cut into pieces | 6 ounces sliced black olives
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Spray rack of an oiled, deep frying pan with non stick cooking spray. Place chicken pieces on the hot grill. Cook until golden, about 6 - 8 minutes. Remove and drain on a paper towel lined plate lined platter.

title: Easy Severn Beefsteak (Beefsteak Tomatoes)
ingredients: 12 beefsteak tomatoes | 12 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/4 cup dry sherry
instructions: Arrange tomatoes upright on a baking sheet. Trim excess skin. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with sherry. Bake 450° for 10 minute.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,red pepper piquillo,nonfat milk,white vinegar,lettuce leaf,graham cracker,vermouth
title: Greek Yogurt Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat milk | 3/4 cup grated white vinegar | 1/3 cup dry vermouth | 3 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 32 ounces greek yogurt | 32 ounces sandwich style cheese tenders ( optional ) | 32 red pepper piquillo ( to taste - 10 peppers total ) | 8 large lettuce leaves
