instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat milk over medium high heat. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk the 1 cup vinegar with vermouth and 3 tbsp of the white vinegar until blended. Slowly whisk in the 3 tbsp of vinegar until smooth. Whisk in the yogurt one at a time until blended, stir in 1/3 cup of cheese per bowl, and set aside to cool slightly. Place the remaining cheese into the refrigerator until ready to use. Remove cheese from refrigerator when cool, but not until it starts to set, 1 to 2 hours. Drain cheese on paper towels. Transfer cheese to a serving bowl, and top with the warmed piquillo peppers and a couple of lettuce leaves. Serve warm with a few pickled red pepper flakes remaining on the side.

title: Ziti with Fava Beans
ingredients: 1/2 pound ziti pasta | 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 2 egg yolks, beaten | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup cornstarch
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ziti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat the oven's broiler. Grease a 9x9 inch baking dish. Stir together the cornmeal and mayonnaise in a bowl. Beat in the beaten egg yolks, dry sherry, and 1/2 cup water until smooth. Dump the ziti into the baking dish, stir the sauce, and spread it into the prepared baking dish. Broil the ziti until the top is golden brown and the filling is bubbly, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,chocolate curl,loaf french bread,sherry wine,brussels sprout
title: Grill Glaze
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, unsliced | 2 lbs brussels sprouts | 1 inch gingerroot, finely minced | 1/2 cup sherry wine | chocolate curls
instructions: Wrap the bread in aluminum foil and roast at 450 degrees for 20 minutes. Remove and cool 5 - 10 minutes. Chop the sprouts and grate the ginger. Put them in a large bowl. Sprinkle the bread with ginger and sherry. Toss well and spread on foil covered grilling surface. Cut with long, thin serrated knife. Place under hot grill until golden brown. Turn with a spatula, brown other side. Cut the glaze into strips and arrange around the loaf.

Random Ingredients: ranch bean,cream corn,cream,cider vinegar,black eyed pea,pickling spice,shortening
title: Creamy Corn-Bean Relish
ingredients: 1 can ranch-style beans | 1 can black-eyed peas | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 teaspoon pickling spice | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup shortening
instructions: In a saucepan, combine beans, peas liquid from corn, mustard and pickling spices. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat. In a small pan, combine cider vinegar and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,nutmeg,za'atar spice mix,mexican chocolate,corn oil,eye roast
title: Spiced Eye of Round Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin | 2 tablespoons za'atar spice mix | 6 ounces mexican chocolate | 1 large cauliflower floret | 2 ounces corn oil | 1 can whole eye of round roast
instructions: Combine cumin, za'atar, mexican bittersweet chocolate, whole cauliflower floret and corn oil in a microwave safe container. Cover and microwave for 2 minutes using 600w on high.. Let stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Carve crosswise into 3/4 inch thick slices and serve with whole grain tortillas.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,italian parsley,bread crumb,milk chocolate,dark rum
title: Rum and Chocolate Baked Onions (Giant Alondigas Al Vino Blanco Con Cipolle)
ingredients: 4 large onions to medium onions | 8 ounces milk chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup italian parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 1/2 cups bread crumbs | kosher salt
instructions: Slice onions into thick slivers, about 1/8 inch thick. Wash them in ice cold water until all of the water is gone. Lay out a few onion slivers at a time on a towel and gently pat them dry. Place the onions in a colander to drain, about 15 minutes. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil to weigh them down. In a medium heavy bottomed saucepan over medium low heat, melt the milk chocolate until smooth about 7 minutes. Stir in the parsley, rum, bread crumbs, and a pinch or two of salt until mixture is thoroughly blended. Keep beating the mixture with a wooden spoon until the mixture is shiny and slightly lumpy and well blended, about 3 minutes. Transfer the caramelized onions to a bowl and place in the refrigerator to melt the chocolate completely. In a small skillet over medium heat, melt the remaining chocolate. Keep warm while you work with the onions. Preheat oven to 350 f. Warm the caramelized onions in the oven until they are dry. Arrange the onions and, stirring or shaking the pan occasionally, pour a small amount of caramelized onions over the tops of the baked onions. Continue heating until all of the caramelized onions are covered by the white sauce, about 30 minutes total. Place the onions on a foil lined tray lined with parchment paper. When they are cool, transfer them to a storage container, cover and freeze overnight or until needed. To bake, remove and let onions stand at room temperature for about 1 hour or until the caramelized onions are dry. Place a wire rack over an ovenproof serving pan so that it is about 1/2 inch high, and heat to 300 f while oven is heating. Place the onions on the rack and bake until golden brown and fragrant, turning frequently, for about 45 minutes. Remove from oven, let cool slightly, and serve immidiately.

title: Steak and vermicelli With Crispy Vermicelli
ingredients: 1 lb steak, cut into strips | 8 ounces vermicelli | 1/2 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 8 ounces asadero cheese, sliced thin on diagonal
instructions: Prepare rice vermicelli by soaking them in water overnight. Drain. When ready to serve, cook steaks or vermicelli until browned and heated through, about 2 - 3 minutes on each side. While steaks are cooking, fry vermicelli in a large skillet until lightly browned, about 2 - 3 minutes per side. Reserve 1/2 cup of the noodle water. When noodles are fried, use a slotted spoon to drain noodles on a paper towel. When beef is cooked, remove from skillet and drain well. Set 1 tablespoon noodles on each plate. Add a few slices of cheese on each plate, and place remaining 3 noodles alongside the cheese. Serve with additional lime or reserved noodle water.

title: Punjabi-Roasted Herb Broth
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat a heavy 12 inch saute pan. Pour oil into the hot pan and toast corriander seeds on high heat, shaking the pan, for 1 minute. Add the broth and bring to a boil over high heat. Simmer covered for 10 minutes. Transfer to a greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Let cool, then cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: anaheim pepper,hard egg,pecorino romano cheese,amaretto,fig,ginger garlic paste,pork roast
title: Roasted Grilled California Meatloaves
ingredients: 1 lb moose roast, trimmed and cut lengthwise into 1-inch-wide slices | 1 lb fresh fig, trimmed and cut into quarters | 4 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 4 fresh ripe pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 anaheim pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup amaretto
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Arrange pork slices and figs on grill.

Random Ingredients: risotto rice,pineapple juice,beef stew meat,anchovy paste,lemon peel
title: Risotto con Carne over Basins
ingredients: 2 lbs cubed beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste or 1 tablespoon anchovy powder | 1/8 cup orange marmalade or 1/8 cup pineapple juice, warmed | 2 tablespoons lemon peel, shaved | 1 1/2 lbs risotto rice
instructions: Bring beef stock to a boil. Add anchovy paste and boil until meat is just cooked through. Add juice, sugar and lemon peel. Cook until heated throughout, about 3 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Cauliflower Beer
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, cut into florets | 3 bottles beer | 1/4 teaspoon fine salt ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon fine salt ( to taste )
instructions: In a large pot, bring water to a boil. Add chopped cauliflower and simmer until just tender, approximately 10 minutes. Drain and reserve. In another large pot, heat remaining beer over medium heat. Add the fine salt, lemon zest and fine salt. When the beer is well blended and starting to foam, lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Pour hot beer into cauliflower and stir gently with a kitchen wooden spoon, making sure the cauliflower is covered. Continue to simmer until cauliflower is tender. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Easy Mexican Chocolate Sausage Patties
ingredients: 2 links chorizo sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices, or more to taste | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 can almond filling | 1 package chocolate-flavored tortilla chips
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir chorizo sausage in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Spread chunky salsa over the bottom of a medium bowl. Place almond filling into the bowl with the chorizo.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,bay leaf,green chili pepper,bicarbonate soda,soymilk,pomegranate seed,new potato
title: Pomegranate Potato Salad
ingredients: 8 medium green chili peppers ( canned ) | 2 large bay leaves | 1 lb unpeeled tiny new potatoes, cut into quarters | 2/3 cup soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda or 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup pomegranate seeds | 1 bunch spring onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f line a baking sheet with aluminium foil, to prevent sticking. Arrange peppers and bay leaves in a large roasting tin. Scatter over the potatoes and pour over enough soymilk to just cover. Bake in a preheated oven about 20 minutes or until just tender, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, prepare the dressing. Place the pomegranate seeds in a dry frying pan and toast on a medium low heat for a few minutes until golden. Cool for a few minutes then crush with a mortar and pestle or in a food processor until fine and then return to the bowl. Add the remaining soymilk, the bicarbonate of soda, the seeds and the onions then stir until combined. Pour over the salad and toss to coat. Transfer to a wire rack and keep warm. Serve cold or warm.

title: Quick  Challah
ingredients: 1/2 cup ghee ( clarified butter ) | 2 -3 tablespoons mustard powder | 2 -3 whole pitted prunes ( chopped fine ) | 1 loaf rye bread ( cut into 3-inch pieces )
instructions: Heat ghee in skillet on medium high heat. Once ghee is hot add mustard powder and prunes. As soon as they start to brown add bread and cook on medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occassionally. Serve while warm with kate's favorite raita, tabouli, sourdough bread and tabouli. For more fragrance add a little honey mustard in sauce.

title: Italian Cannelloni
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 vanilla beans, halved | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Cut the ends off the vanilla beans and scrape out the seeds and pods. Place in the microwave. Add 1/4 cup water, cover and microwave on high for 1 1/2 minutes. Rinse the beans under cold water and drain in a strainer. In a microwave safe dish, warm the beans until warm, about 5 minutes, in between. Remove the vanilla beans from the microwave. Dab a few drops of water across each lasagna noodle. Top with a dollop of cannelloni, about 1/3rds of the parmesan, and about 1/4 cup black pepper. Cover and microwave on high for a few seconds, just until the cheese melts. Stir once, then serve.

title: Sausage Gratin With Smoked Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sweet peas | 1 medium smoked turkey sausage, cut crosswise into 4 equal pieces | 300 g gruyere cheese, grated ( about 5 slices )
instructions: Preheat a grill pan over high heat until very hot. In a medium bowl, mash 1 tablespoon sweet peas with a fork and add the sausage. Spread the mixture evenly over both sides of the sausage. Sprinkle with half the cheese and grill the sausage, turning, until the sausage is cooked through, about 5 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetarian Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne rigate | 1 cup carrot, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon dill weed
instructions: Cook the ziti according to package directions, and drain when just tender. While ziti cooks, saute the carrots with the dill weed in a little olive oil until tender. Drain ziti and add to the carrots with other vegetables, tossing until thoroughly combined. You may need to add more olive oil or a little cream to give it a bit of a crunchy texture, but you want the pasta to taste flavorful.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,red chilies,cocoa,madeira cake,flat leaf italian parsley,cherry tomato
title: Chile, Roasted Salmon and Madeira Cake With Cherries
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, skin on | 3 large ripe cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 2 teaspoons dried red chilies | 2 madeira cakes, split and toasted
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Spray foil with cooking spray and add salmon to the center of each fillet. Spoon mixture evenly over the salmon. Place fillet on foil on a tray and bake in 400f degrees oven for 8 minutes or until salmon is cooked through. Serve with a salad of crisp baby greens, cherry tomatoes and a drizzle of cream.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,pork loin roast,russet potato,baby carrot,baguette,rom tomato,half
title: Chicken Stew Provencale
ingredients: 3 lbs bone-in chicken breasts ( with the bone in ) | 2 russet potatoes | 4 russet potatoes | 1 tablespoon half berry ( can sub a whole bottle of pricked pricked pricked pricked pricked olives, as well ) | 3 packages country bread and butter baguette ( or substitute a day old baguette ) | 1 can whole baby carrots ( drain liquid ) | 1 cup fat-free half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Rinse chicken under cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. Place russet potatoes in a saucepan, and pour in enough water to cover potatoes. Bring to a boil, and cook until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. When potatoes are done, drain, and set aside. Place chicken in a large dutch oven or oven safe pot, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, and add russet potatoes, carrots and the country bread baguette. Reduce heat, and simmer 1 1/2 hours. If using a baguette baguette, preheat oven broiler. Remove chicken from the simmering broth and set aside. Discard broth, then add cream to the broth and mix well. Return chicken to the simmering broth, and cook 30 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: ro tel tomato,dripping,beef broth,kiwi fruit,molasses,ramen noodle,hoisin sauce,garlic salt
title: Somerset Kiwi Dipping Sauces (OAMC)
ingredients: 1 cup thinly sliced kiwi fruit | 1 cup beef broth | 1 teaspoon molasses | 2 teaspoons hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon minced garlic salt | 1/4 cup drippings, from kikkoman noodles | 2 packages ramen noodles, cooked according to package ( oamc )
instructions: In large bowl, toss kiwifruit slices with beef broth, molasses, hoisin sauce, garlic salt, and hot pepper sauce.

title: Grilled Plantain Chips  (Tiganon Caipirinhas)
ingredients: 1/3 cup ketchup | 3 large plantains, peeled, sliced on diagonal into 1/2-inch thick pieces | 1 3 tablespoons sesame seeds, stirred to blend with | 1 teaspoon fresh ground coriander seed | 1 tablespoon fresh ground thyme sprig ( or 1/2 teaspoon dried ) | 1 teaspoon granulated garlic paste | fresh thyme sprig ( optional for garnish )
instructions: In medium bowl, whisk ketchup until well blended. Set aside. Heat griddle. Brush plantain pieces all over with ketchup mixture, then sprinkle with sesame seeds, coriander seeds, and thyme. Grill until golden, about 5 - 8 minutes on each side. Serve warm. May also be made in the oven with the onions and/or bell peppers, as accompaniments.

title: Beer Marinated Chilli Onions
ingredients: 6 small indian chillies ( such as cayenne, halved, deseeded, and cut ) | 400 ml light beer ( bombay sapphire )
instructions: Place chillies and beer in a large, deep frying pan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until chillies are aromatic. Remove from heat and cover. Leave in refrigerator overnight to develop the flavours. Drain excess liquid off, uncover, and serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: mango,eggplant,beef brisket,swiss chard,sultana,italian salad dressing mix,bay seasoning
title: Cassic Style Brisket With Mango, Green Beans and Swiss Chard
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, fresh | 3/4 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1 -2 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 3 mangoes ( ripe ) | 1 eggplant | 1/2 cup sultana | 2 stalks swiss chard ( or 3-4 tablespoons dried chard flowers )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Wrap beef brisket in aluminum foil or aluminum foil and place in large roasting pan. Mix italian dressing mix with old bay powder, stirring well. Brush half the dressing mix over the meat. Place the mango on top of the brisket. Mix the eggplant, sultanas, and chard in a bowl. Slice brisket across the grain into thin rings. Insert slices of eggplant, mango, and swiss chard into the raitons and then place in a roasting pan. Place the pan in the oven and cook for an hour or so, until meat is tender. This meat should also be cooked by now. Remove vegetables, add remaining dressing mix and return to oven. Cook an additional 20 - 25 minutes until the sauce is warm throughout and the fruit is wilting a bit. The pan juices may have been reduced slightly since the meat was fresh and served in the initial recipe.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,almond extract,white mushroom,sage leaf,taco shell,yellow pepper
title: Shredded Taco Shells
ingredients: 20 taco shells | 12 fresh sage leaves | 1/4 cup slivered almonds or 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 1 large yellow pepper, diced | 1 package dry sauerkraut, rinsed and drained well | 1/2 teaspoon white mushroom diagonally sliced ( or sauteed kimchi ) ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Toast taco shells according to package directions. To prepare taco shell, place one or two taco shells in each of 4 dishes. Place a sage leaf on each taco shell and sprinkle evenly with half of the almonds. Spoon 2 tablespoons of sauerkraut cheese mixture on top of the slivered almonds and sprinkle with remaining almonds. If desired, sprinkle with sliced yellow pepper. Combine the remaining 2 tablespoons sauerkraut cheese mixture and the remaining almonds in a small saucepan, sprinkle with the white mushroom diagonally sliced. Heat over medium heat until cheese melts and starts to turn golden. Place sauerkraut in a medium bowl, pour melted cheese mixture over and stir well. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,spicy mustard,pizza dough,fine sea salt,italian sausage,panko breadcrumb
title: Spicy Italian Sausage Calzone (Kartoffelkuchen)
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 cups pizza dough, cut ( or 4 1/2-ounce package ) | 1 lb hot italian sausage, sliced ( about 3/4 pound ) | 1/4 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1/3 cup finely chopped panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup spicy mustard ( such as a-1 ) or 1/4 cup plain french-style mustard ( such as a-1 )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425 degrees f. Brush the work surface with the vegetable oil cooking spray. Place your pizza on the oiled surface. Turn a few times to evenly coat the pizza with the oil. Sprinkle in half the sausage, half the panko, and 1/2 teaspoon each of salt and the mustard. Sprinkle on last the other half of the sausage, sprinkle with a bit of the remaining salt, and top with the rest of the panko. Using wet hands, press the dough out to the size of sausages and top with the remaining sausage. Bake the czones in the middle of the oven until the crust is beginning to brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Cut into wedges and serve warm.

title: Spicy Tomato & Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb fresh, chopped tomato puree | 3/4 lb carrot, coarsely grated | 1/2 teaspoon chopped lemon peel | 10 ounces dry enchilada sauce | 3 bulbs of garlic, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large heavy pot and mix well. Simmer, covered over medium heat for about 20 minutes. Uncover and reduce heat. Simmer, stirring frequently, for about 15 - 15 minutes. Remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,ginger ale,chinese five spice powder
title: Steamed Five-Spice Suts for the Steaming Party! (Mixed Spices)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons coarsely ground chinese five spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger ale
instructions: Pour the ground spices into a clean, dry & dry coffee mug. Mix them together with a little of the ginger ale or brandy & set aside to soak for approximately 30 minutes. Pour the remaining ginger ale or brandy into a wok & bring to just the boil, scraping any sediment from the surface of the drink with a wooden spoon. Add the toasted sesame seeds & allow to bubble vigorously. Strain the drink, then pour the sesame seeds into a tea baller & crush lightly with the back of a spoon to mix. When the drink has been strained, pour it & into a pudding bowl lined with oiled plastic wrap. Let sit for 5, 10 minutes before removing the wrap. Seal the ends by pouring some water into the sink & swishing around the bowl. This allows the flavours to develop, allowing you to add more flavour to the drink. Serve it at once, or store it in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Greek Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup vine-ripened tomatoes sauce | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 2 tablespoons sour cream ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pitted kalamata olive, halved
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and puree to a smooth creamy consistency. Refrigerate.

title: Clam Shake
ingredients: 3 tablespoons of minced garlic veal or 3 tablespoons ground chicken | 2 tablespoons of minced herbs ( such as sage, mustard, cayenne, etc. ) | 1/2 tablespoon curry powder | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 1/3 cup lemon vinaigrette or 1/3 cup brandy | 1/2 cup chilled bottled clam juice or 1/2 cup bottled clam juice | 1 cup chilled frozen mixed vegetables or 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables | whipped cream or ice cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients except garnish and serve in a glass over ice cream.

Random Ingredients: veal,baking powder,pork,plain nonfat yogurt,chili powder,beef chuck,chili sauce,white sugar
title: Southwestern Pork and Veal
ingredients: 3 pounds ground beef chuck | 3 pounds boneless pork | 6 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon chili paste with garlic | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 jar chili sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil. Mix ground chuck and pork together thoroughly in a large bowl. Press pork mixture into the prepared pan to form a thick crust. Mix yogurt, chili paste, sugar, and chili powder into the meat, until thoroughly combined. Bake in oven at 350 degrees f for about 1 1/2 hours. Baste meat occasionally while cooking.

title: Quick and Easy Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 3 -4 jalapeno chiles, seeded and finely chopped | salt and pepper
instructions: Place the stock and chilies in a saucepan, and bring to boil. Reduce the heat, and simmer until the chilies are very soft.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,italian seasoning,italian bread crumb,poblano chile,chicken sausage,garlic salt
title: Flamenco Con Queso...  Me!
ingredients: 1/2 pound hot chicken sausage | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning, or to taste | 1 cup italian-style seasoned bread crumbs | 1 jar roasted poblano chiles, drained | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lay the hot chicken sausage onto a work surface. Combine the garlic salt and italian seasoning in a small bowl.

title: Easy Delicious Sauce No One Likes This Anymore
ingredients: 1 can italian stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Heat tomatoes and cheese in pan stirring until cheese is melted. Serve over any type of pasta you want.

Random Ingredients: bread,baguette,clear honey,red chilies,white wine vinegar,coconut oil,coriander leaf,white flour
title: Aniseed Bread
ingredients: 3 lbs bread, breadcrumbs | 2 lbs unbleached white flour | 2 lbs clear honey | 1 lb coconut oil | 3 red chilies | 5 tablespoons clear honey | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | fresh coriander leaves, to garnish
instructions: Toast the breadcrumbs in a dry frying pan over a low heat for 10 minutes remove and place them in a shallow bowl. To make the marinade, peel the chillies and cut the flesh into fine strips. Bring the honey and vinegar to the boil in a saucepan. Turn the heat down and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes, or until the honey is reduced by half. Remove from the heat and stir in the chillies and the coriander.

Random Ingredients: oil,ancho chile,apricot,basmati rice,part ricotta cheese,coffee,balsamic vinegar
title: Cappuccino Dessert
ingredients: 8 -10 almonds ( or whole flakes ) or 8 -10 hazelnuts ( or whole flakes ) | 1 cup dried apricot ( or any dried fruit of your choice ) | 2 cups basmati rice, cooked ( not quick cooking ) or 2 cups pinto beans, cooked ( not quick cooking ) | 1/3 cup whole fat or 1/3 cup non fat soy yogurt | 1/2 cup oil | 1/3 cup strong coffee | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place the nuts in a food processor and whirl until very fine, not grainy. Spread on paper lined cookie sheets to dry. If using whole almonds, toast them, if using hazelnuts, in a toaster oven. If using hazelnuts, place in a dry skillet over very high heat and toast for 2 – 3 minutes or until toasted. Allow nuts to dry on wire racks. Drain and toss apricots with rice, toast nuts in blender, or in a food processor. In a small mixing bowl, combine yogurt and oil and mix well.

title: Chef John's Potato Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 medium dried new potatoes | 1/2 cup gin | 1 1/2 cups diced cooked boneless skinless chicken-filled egg noodles | 1 large egg noodles | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Combine the potatoes and 1/2 cup of gin in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and cool slightly. Transfer the potatoes to a large serving bowl. Add the chicken cooked egg noodles, and toss to combine. To serve, garnish with lime wedges.

title: Grilled Corn Truffles
ingredients: 1 cup corn tortilla, coarsely chopped | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: In a small bowl, toss the tortilla with the poblano pepper, and spread evenly onto 4 pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil. Evenly distribute the ground turkey mixture over the tortilla pieces. Place on a medium low grill, and cook until evenly browned, about 10 minutes.

title: Bacon, Beans & Turkey
ingredients: 1 lb smoked ham or 1 lb turkey, cut into 1/2 pieces | 1 lb white beans, washed | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon sprigs | 1/2 cup turkey fat ( i have used bacon drippings instead ) | 2 teaspoons a.1. original sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons pearl barley
instructions: Put all ingredients in crockpot. Set on low heat. Cover and cook in crockpot for 3 hours, turning to high after 15 minutes.

title: Dolci Kafta (Stuffed Sticky Buns)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2/3 cup warm plus 1/4 cup warm water | 1 teaspoon bacon drippings or 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil, rendered, plus extra drippings for brushing the outside surface of the dolci kafta, plus 2 tablespoons | 1 pound of very soft fresh chickpeas ( preferably the sudanese ones ) or 1 pound canned chickpeas ( preferably the sudanese ones ), drained | 3 tablespoons chickpea-stuffed candied mace | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed to room temperature ( such as cool whip )
instructions: Soak the chickpeas in a bowl of water for about 5 minutes. Drain, then squeeze, reserving 1/2 cup of the soaking liquid. Combine 2/3 cup warm water, yeast, and 1/2 teaspoon bacon drippings, stirring well with a whisk or fork, and set aside. Put the chickpeas in a food processor or blender, and process. Add the reserved soaking liquid, 1/4 cup at a time, and process until smooth. Put the soaked chickpeas in a bowl, pour in the mixture, and toss to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate covered at least 1 hour or overnight. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Stir the leftover soaking liquid into the chilled bread mixture just until moistened. Form 16 small saucer sized dolci balls with the rounded ends of the dough, and place them on the parchment paper. Cover lightly with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour and 1/2 hour. Mash the mixture into a smooth ball, adding additional soaking liquid if necessary. Transfer to an oiled bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and let rise until doubled in bulk, about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Divide the cooked dolci loaf dough into 10 portions, and roll each portion into a 12 inch circle. Place 2 apart on the prepared baking sheets, and brush with about 1/4 cup chickpea flavored oil. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of ground mace to distinguish the flavors, and top with a heaping teaspoon of whipped topping. Bake 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the tops just turn a shade of brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: avocado,cooking apple,minestrone soup,chili paste,beef rump,poultry seasoning
title: Smokin' Hot Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 cup minced cooking apple | 1 can condensed minestrone soup | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 2 cans minestrone soup, undiluted | 1 tablespoon dried poultry seasoning | 1 lb boneless beef rump
instructions: Preheat oven to 300, line a roasting pan with aluminum foil. Set aside. Cook and stir apple and 1 1/2 cans of remaining soup, the chile paste, and poultry seasoning in a large pot over medium heatuntil heated through, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove pot from heat. Place beef in the prepared pan. Stir remaining soup into the soup mixture. Cover and bake in oven until beef is tender, 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Gomen (Beef-Laced Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 4 scallions, minced | 1 1/2 lbs filet of beef, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 large head of cabbage, cored | 1 cup hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet.

Random Ingredients: meat pork,cheese,tomato green chilies,havarti cheese,dill,onion flake,cornflour
title: Chili Con Queso (Chile Con Queso)
ingredients: 420 g ground meat or 400 g ground pork | 420 g diced tomatoes with green chilies | 420 g havarti cheese ( i use a log ) | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes, mixed with | 2 teaspoons cornflour or 2 teaspoons potato starch | 1/2 cup grated havarti cheese ( use a log ) or 1/2 cup cheese ( use a log ) | 1/4 cup dill ( optional )
instructions: Cook meat and drain fat from pan if using beef or pork. Add chilis and tomatoes and heat through. Add cheese, onion and cornflour or potato starch and mix well. Add cheese mixture into bowl and refrigerate at least an hour. This tastes better if left to stand for about 15 - 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,self rising flour,ramen noodle,saffron thread,self raising flour,black peppercorn,basil leaf,orange
title: Christmas Ramen Cake
ingredients: 1 packet saffron threads | 10 -12 basil leaves, chopped | 6 black peppercorns | 1/8 teaspoon saffron strand | 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 bunch maraschino cherry | 1 -2 orange, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons chopped basil leaves
instructions: Place saffron strands into a small frying pan with a small amount of water over a low heat, cook until the water turns a light brown colour. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. In a large bowl add the soaked saffron, chopped basil leaves, sugar and black peppercorns. Make a well in the centre and add remaining chopped basil leaves, then gradually add the flour until the batter is smooth. Do not over mix stir in the saffron. Pour 1 cup cold water into the well, add 1/2 tablespoon of the batter and mix well. Fold in the maraschino and orange zest, followed by 2 tablespoons of the remaining batter and mix well. The mixture should not be too stiff. Pour into a greased 20cm springform tin. Place in a pan with a large round of greaseproof paper on either side of the cake tin. Bake in a pre preheated oven for 50 - 60 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the centre of the cake comes out clean. Allow the cake to fully absorb the juices while you prepare the topping. Remove from oven, sprinkle lightly with basil leaves and serve warm with whipped cream.

title: Chinese Lemonade
ingredients: 1 can lemonade | 1 green capsicum | 3 tablespoons chili paste | 2 tablespoons turmeric
instructions: Place all ingredients in a container. Mix and store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: grape,red wine vinegar,chile garlic sauce,jumbo shrimp,sherry wine,corn oil,balsamic vinegar
title: Grilled Shrimp With Chiles and Garlic
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs jumbo shrimp | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | corn oil | 1/3 cup grape juice or 1/3 cup grape juice, for dilish | 1/2 tablespoon garlic chile-garlic sauce, for basting | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Pound the shrimp in a mortar or spice grinder.

title: Green Cabbage Wraps
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage | 4 cans tortillas | 1 cup distilled white vinegar
instructions: Wash and remove outer leaves of cabbage. Cut off any tough stem, then slice cabbage into thin strips and place cut side down on a cloth or muslin lined plate. Sprinkle cabbage with salt and let drain for 10 - 12 hours. Drain well and refrigerate. In a small bowl, combine vinegar and salt. Slice cabbage thin and place on a plate. Top with some vinegar mixture and roll each slice with a tortilla. Enjoy.

title: Grilled Eggplant (Aubergine) Filling
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 2 small eggplants, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 cup cornstarch | 3 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the garlic and eggplant. Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a skillet. Dip half the eggplant slices in the cornstarch, then toss in the eggplant. Let stand 5 minutes. In a wok, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat. Cook the eggplant slices 2 or 3 at a time for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove the eggplant from the pan as soon as they are crisp on the edges, adding more oil if needed. Pour off the oil and place the fried eggplant slices on a platter.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,fish sauce,chipotle chile,shortening,red wine vinegar,salmon fillet,parmesan cheese
title: Smoked Salmon Chips
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet, skinned and boned | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 -2 chipotle chile, chopped ( canned chipotle in adobo sauce, chopped small ) | 2 tablespoons shredded parmesan cheese ( or cheddar ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon oil or 1 teaspoon shortening | 2 tablespoons pickled whole green chilies
instructions: In a nonreactive bowl, combine fish sauce, chilies, and parmesan or cheddar cheese. Add 1 1/2 tbsp water, and stir to blend. Set aside. Heat oil to 375° and place salmon fillet fillet in pan. Brown fish fillet on both sides and take fish out. Add more oil to the pan. Add the chipotle/cilantro mixture, and cook 3 - 4 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and fish has crisped up a bit. Pour sauce over the fish and toss to coat. Sprinkle salmon chips over the top, and serve, or put in the refrigerator and cook.

Random Ingredients: white wine,onion,mesclun,cornflour,pineapple juice,lasagna noodle,green chili pepper,cumin
title: Award Winning White Chili Lasagna
ingredients: 5 lbs mesclun, leaves | 1 green chili pepper | 1/2 lb lasagna noodle ( the brand name isn't quite enough, so i don't usually measure just throw it up for about 8 mins. ) | 1 small onion, chopped | 32 ounces unsweetened pineapple juice | 12 ounces white wine ( a red if you want it sweeter ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup cornflour | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in crock pot and cook on low for 3 hours. If it's still freezing, place it on the counter for at least an hour and give it a whir in the crock pot. It will be nice and thick as it is, but will be fine every time it's gone. To serve, place a few cornflour slivers on a piece of lasagna and spoon about 2 tbsps of the chili sauce on it. Then place a piece of a piece of monteray jack cheese on top of the chili sauce, and put the rest of the sauce on top as a bed for noodles or wrap up the lasagna with foil.

title: Ritz Crackers
ingredients: 3 cups ritz crackers, coarsely crushed | 2 cups thai basil, coarsely chopped | 12 large soft tortillas
instructions: Place crushed crackers on paper towels and roll in crushed crackers. Place in a baking dish and cover with thai basil. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 - 15 minutes or untill crisp and golden. Wrap in warm tortillas and let sit and cool.

title: White Chocolate Gorgonzola Rice Balls
ingredients: 3 cups white chocolate with chunks | 3 cups low-fat gorgonzola cheese | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 cup basmati rice
instructions: Melt the white chocolate over easy fire. It melts very fast so don't stir it too much. Mix in the mustard powder. Mix in rice. Stove top, put on lid. Let it stand for 20 minute. Turn off burner. Let cool down to room temperature with waxed paper on top. When cold you can make the balls without making an ice cream cone in a freezer bag for about 5 to 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: cheese,green chili pepper,apricot jam,beef sirloin steak,malt vinegar,cream cheese,pineapple juice,salsa
title: Australian Sirloin Roll
ingredients: 1 beef sirloin steak | 1/2 cup apricot jam ( or jelly crystals ) | 1/2 cup barbecue style salsa | 1 cup cream cheese ( block or neufchatel cheese ) | 1/3 cup chopped green chili pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 cup prepared mustard or 1/4 cup mild salsa | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar ( or cider vinegar if you prefer )
instructions: Place meat in a 9x12 inch dish or pie plate. For sauce, mix jam, salsa, cream cheese, chili powder and vinegar to blend. Pour over meat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, preferably overnight. Remove cover from dish and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour 20 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips or vegetables.

title: Yogurt Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 150 g spelt flour | 600 g greek yogurt | 150 g chilled melted butter | 1 cup enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 175°c. Mix spelt flour and 2/3 of the remaining melted butter, and set aside. Place mixture in a large bowl and mix in yogurt. Use an ice cream scoop dipped in melted butter to scoop the mixture onto the baking paper. Sprinkle top with rest of melted butter. Mix well and place on a baking tray. Bake approximately 20 minutes or until firm. Allow to cool completely before wrapping in plastic wrap and placing in freezer bag for freezing. Defrost overnight. Place all ingredients into a food processor and blend until smooth. Spoon into an airtight container, freeze for about 2 hours, or until solid. To serve, place one tablespoon of the filling on a cheese creole roll, roll up and place seam side down on a plate.

Random Ingredients: arugula,soymilk,rice wine vinegar,udon noodle,catsup,barbecue sauce,american cheese,chipotle chile adobo sauce
title: American Kitchen Classic Japanese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 7 ounces uncooked udon noodles ( japanese rice vermicelli noodles ) | 3/4 cup soymilk | 4 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons catsup, or to taste | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo sauce ( minced ) | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce, or to taste | 1/4 cup cubed american cheese | 1/4 cup chopped arugula, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rice vermicelli noodles and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Rotel and Orange Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 can orange juice or ( 16 ounce ) can lemon juice | 1/2 cup corn syrup | 2 tablespoons harissa
instructions: Heat all ingredients until boiling and reduce to simmer for 10 minutes. Stir occasionally for a thicker sauce. Serve over your favourite grain.

title: Pepperoni Tingles
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch wedges | 1 package pepperoni | 1 bottle guacamole | 1 bottle tangerine juice | 1 can brown sauce ( or juice )
instructions: Boil parsnips until tender, drain. Drain, saving 2 cups cooking liquid. Place all ingredients, except sauce, in a mixing bowl, mix well. Spread mixture in a 9 x 13 inch dish, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Remove plastic wrap from dish and invert on serving platter. Spoon sauce over hot pepperoni slices. Serve warm.

title: Spaghettini With Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 12 ounces spaghettini | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Cook spaghettini, following package directions, until just done.

title: Italian Sizzling Tilapia
ingredients: 1 lb tilapia fillet | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1 yellow pepper, diced
instructions: Clean and wash tilapia fillets. Cut into halves lengthwise, then crosswise into 1 inch pieces. Place the flour on a plate, mix with a pinch of salt and pepper, and coat the tilapia fillets evenly with flour. Heat a skillet and add about a 1/4 cup of water. Sear the fish in batches, and then place onto the water. As the fish cooks, add more water. When the fish is finished, remove to the plates or serving plates and add the diced pepper, remaining parsley. Top with additional minced parsley.

title: Sweet-Creamy Cardamom Mutton
ingredients: 4 large mutton, pieces | 1 cup green onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 1 3/4 cups prepared salsa | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Wash the mutton and soak in water to cover for 30 minutes. Heat oil in a frying pan on high heat. Fry the mutton until golden brown on all sides. Remove the mutton to a bowl. Fry sliced onions in the same pan for a few minutes. Add the rest of the ingredients and cook for a few minutes to blend everything together. Serve with your favourite bread, rice, curd or rotis.

title: Ema's Steamed, Peanut Butter, and Sangria Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup marjoram ( fresh mint ) | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 1/2 cups frozen shelled edamame
instructions: Cut rind off sausage, and pound with a meat mallet until 1/4 inch thick. Cut crosswise into 1/4 slices on a diagonal. Place sausage in a colander, and sprinkle w/marjoram, sherry, peanut butter, and marsala over all. Reserve marinade for sauce. Steam sausages, uncovered, over high heat, turning once, until cooked through, about 10 minutes, basting with reserved marinade as needed. Serve schnitzel in individual soup bowls, or slice in half horizontally across the length. Garnish with chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: panir,chicken breast half,tomato juice,onion salt,lima bean,soymilk,sea scallop
title: Creamy Scallops
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped onion salt | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, sliced | 1 cup chopped tomato with juice | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/2 cup low-fat soymilk | 1 cup chopped fresh lima beans, thawed | 1 1/2 pounds fresh panir, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Mix onion salt and chicken in a bowl. Spread chicken mixture evenly into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Combine tomato and tomato juice in a separate bowl. Pour tomato tomato mixture over the chicken.

title: Easy   Mozambique Hot Wings
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 -2 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 -2 teaspoon chili bean, crushed | 1 can marshmallows | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Marinate the wing. Mix all ingredients together. Put mixture in a ziplock bag or deep dish, close, and marinate up to 3 days. To make the sauce, put all ingredients in saucepan with a large cover, bring to boil then let simmer, covered until sauce has thickened. Remove and serve on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,greek vinaigrette salad dressing,oil,veal
title: Veal With Red Pepper Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 lb veal, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 1 tablespoon greek vinaigrette salad dressing | ground red pepper flakes | oil ( for frying )
instructions: In a skillet heat oil to 375 degrees. Fry veal, turning to brown all sides evenly, approximately 1 minute. Drain on paper towel, reserving oil in skillet. Mix with vinaigrette and sprinkle with pepper flakes.

title: The Midsummer Night's Dream
ingredients: 1/2 cup light coconut milk | 1/2 cup dark rum or 1/2 cup rum | 1 can baked beans | 1 beer, such as modelo
instructions: Place the coconut milk, rum and baked beans in a blender bowl and blend until smooth. Pour into 2 tall chilled glasses, pour in the beer or rum and stir the drink.

title: Duck Confit (Turkey Confit) for Beginners, Lazy Days, New Year's Day
ingredients: 3 lbs whole duck | 3 lbs turkey fat ( can be replaced with fat and salt, to the extent of salting the meat and fat ) or 3 lbs sauteed fat ( can be replaced with fat and salt, to the extent of salting the meat and fat )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°f. Wash and dry your turkey. You cannot wash it because it will take over 30 days, cooling the turkey in the oven overnight and skimming off excess water as necessary. When you have a fresh turkey, trim most of the fat from the neck, then rinse and dry the bird inside and out. Pat dry with a paper towel, then stud inside and out with the neck, trussing several times as you work, with salt and the meat. Place turkey in a roasting pan and roast the bird for 3 1/2 hours, or until it is golden and the temperature reaches 110 - 115 degrees f. Allow bird to rest for 20 - 30 minutes before carving. It may even take longer, depending on the relative humidity, depending on the degree of tenderness you require. While the bird is resting, heat a small amount of duck fat or sauteed fat in a frying pan. You can skim very easily when it starts to foam. This will take about 10 minutes.

title: Cafe Rio Refried Beans (Refritos)
ingredients: 2 cans fat-free refried beans | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: Dump the beans into a small pot, pour enough water to cover the beans and stir. Turn the heat down and let simmer on medium heat for 1 hour, stir often and cover until the beans have absorbed the water. Allow to cool and then transfer to a bag or container, add a pinch of crushed red chilies, and refrigerate for 1 hour. After it has marinated, heat the refried beans in the microwave on high for 20 - 45 seconds, stirring a couple times while heating. The beans should be heated by the time the refried beans are ready to be eaten. This should not take long.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce leaf,ice cube,tart apple,cashew,red chile,tahini,tomato paste
title: Apple Toss
ingredients: 2 tart apples, such as granny smith, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 cup shredded romaine lettuce leaf | 6 ice cubes, divided | 1/4 cup plain smooth tahini | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 hot dried red chile, finely chopped | 1/4 cup cashews
instructions: Place apple slices, lettuce leaves in a large salad bowl. Sprinkle with 1/3 cup lettuce, cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 15 minutes. In a medium bowl, whisk tahini and tomato paste until blended. Stir in red chile, remaining lettuce, remaining 1/3 cup lettuce and 1/4 cup cashews. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 head sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: In a serving bowl mix cheese with vinegar. Serve.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,cumin seed,parmesan cheese,jam,five spice powder,pearl barley
title: Baked Barley & Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 can italian tomatoes ( undrained ) | 8 tablespoons parmesan cheese ( grated ) | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder ( or more, to taste ) | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon jam ( your favorite )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a casserole dish mix all ingredients together and bake uncovered 40 - 50 minutes or until beans are tender. Cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,irish cream,parmigiano reggiano cheese,grapeseed oil
title: Irish Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 cup long grain rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 1/2 cup irish cream | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Warm the oil in a medium saucepan and add the rice.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,tabasco sauce,green bell pepper,potato,lettuce
title: Spanish Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 large potatoes, sliced ( idaho size are best ) | 4 tablespoons green bell peppers, finely diced | 4 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | lettuce, shredded
instructions: Place potato slices in a large bowl. Add onion, red bell pepper, tomatoes, tabasco and salt and pepper to taste. Mix well. Sprinkle with shredded lettuce.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,polish kielbasa,tuna steak,stewing beef,green curry paste
title: Linda's Tuna Curry Pockets
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef, chopped into chunks | 300 g polish kielbasa | 1 tablespoon brown's green curry paste, paste ( or a thai thai hot paste ) | 1 pita bread, large, cut into 1 cm pieces and split into half | 800 g canned tuna steaks, drained and roughly chopped
instructions: Put meat in a bowl and add the spice paste. Leave to marinate in the fridge for at least 10 minutes, or at least 2 hours. Preheat the oven to 160c or 140c fan forced. Place each pita half on a baking tray and spray with a little cooking oil. Put about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in a little packet and top with some tuna. Spray one side of each pita with cooking oil and put 2 - 3 heaped teaspoons of cooked mixture inside each pita half. Cut three diagonal slits in the top of each, but don't leave a gap. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until pita starts to brown slightly. Serve with plain couscous if desired, and steamed green vegetables.

title: Quick Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh vegetables, such as potatoes, carrots, baby corn, zucchini, etc ( like bok choy ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons orange juice, freshly squeezed | 2 1/2 cups alfalfa sprouts ( optional ) or 2 1/2 cups green sprouts, cut into 1-inch pieces ( optional )
instructions: In large bowl, stir together orange juice and sprouts. Cover tightly and chill thoroughly. Serve chilled.

title: Blueberry, Herb and Crisco Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups fresh blueberries | 2 cups green peppers, cut into strips | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 4 1/2 cups bottled strained canned low-sodium canned low-fat trifle spargies | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Puree blueberries and peppers in food processor or blender until smooth. Add bouillon and 1 cup of trifle liquor and blend again until mixture is well combined. Transfer mixture to medium saucepan, stir in remaining trifle liquor. Heat, but do not boil. Add thyme and remaining trifle liquor to saucepan, cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the liquid is reduced and sauce is slightly thick. Transfer to bowl and let cool to just room temperature. Stir in remaining trifle liquor and serve immediately. Note, store unused portion of trifle liquor in refrigerator up to a week.

title: Pumpkin Mint Chips
ingredients: 1 small russet potato, cut in 1/4 slices | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint leaves
instructions: Microwave potato on high for 20 seconds to soften. Stir. Microwave in microwave for about 10 seconds until softened. Set aside to cool. Add mint, orange peel, garlic salt, and dried mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: raspberry vinegar,oregano leaf,pineapple juice,lavender,kernel corn,mint leaf,cream chicken soup
title: Lavender Infused Creamy Corn and Pineapple Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend the cream of chicken soup, corn, raspberry vinegar, pineapple juice, mint leaves, oregano, and mint leaves until smooth.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,green onion,thyme,black mustard seed,pea,feta cheese,eagle brand milk,lamb chop
title: Black Rachael Ray Lamb Chops With Mango-Feta Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped green onion | 1/4 cup reduced-fat feta cheese | 1/3 cup reduced-fat mango-chutney | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/8 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/4 cup reduced-fat eagle brand condensed milk | 4 lamb chops, 1/2 inch thick | 1/4 cup chopped frozen peas
instructions: To prepare sauce, stir all ingredients together for dipping sauce. To serve, spoon 1/2 cup of dipping sauce on each plate.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,pork,turkey breast,corn oil,rice vinegar,phyllo dough,sun tomato oil,chicken bouillon cube
title: Sesame Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon beef sirloin steak, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/2 cup water | 1/4 teaspoon corn oil | 8 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 cup ground cooked turkey or 1 cup ground pork, lightly browned and drained
instructions: Combine first three ingredients. Whisk in water and bouillon cube. Brush a 24x18 inch baking pan with corn oil. Lay 4 phyllo sheets in pan, brushing each with more oil as needed. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the meat mixture evenly over sheets. Top with 7 more phyllo sheets, brushing each with oil, then filling with more meat mixture. Top with 4 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with oil. Top with 8 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with oil. Top with 8 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with oil, and spreading with meat mixture. Top with 8 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with oil, and spreading with meat mixture. Cover with 8 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with oil. Top with 8 sheets of meat, brushing each with oil, and spreading with meat, and spreading with meat, and spreading with meat. Top with 8 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with oil. Cover with 8 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with oil, and spreading with meat, and spreading with meat, and again brushing each with oil. Cover with 9 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with oil, and pressing down with spatula. Fold each corner toward the center to form an open cone, like a turnover. Cut cone in half crosswise to create a circle with a large opening that will allow steam to escape and make for steam. Repeat procedure with remaining phyllo sheets, filling and filling steps 6 and 7, brushing each once again with oil. Place turnover over a large heatproof platter, and bake, covered with aluminum foil, in a preheated 375°f oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes, or until phyllo is crisp.

title: Easy Avocado Taco Shell Copycat
ingredients: 2 avocados | 3 teaspoons chipotle powder
instructions: Cut avocados in half, remove pit and scoop out soft center. Cut avocados into 1/2 inch sticks. Add chile powder, mixing well. Form shells using an appropriate size for shells. Cook on stovetop until heated through, drain on paper towels and serve with your favorite queso.

title: Pastry for Wood Flooring and Wood Flooring
ingredients: 1 pastry for a 9-inch double crust pie | 3 ounces dried cellophane noodles | 1 1/2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar
instructions: Cook the cellophane noodles in boiling water for about 20 minutes, until tender. Drain immediately then allow to dry slightly. In a small bowl mix the vinegar with a teaspoon of salt until dissolved. Add the cellophane sauce to the noodles in the bowl and stir to combine. Set aside to cool to room temperature. Press 1/2 of the cooled noodles onto each of two sheets of parchment paper in the form of a fluted crust. Spoon 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons of the noodle mixture into the center of the crust. Top with the remaining noodles and spread evenly. Brush with the vinegar mixture. Top with the remaining noodles. Fold the two sheets of parchment paper over the filling. Set in the refrigerator overnight to firm. Remove from the refrigerator and enjoy.

title: Kraft Easy Four Cheese Loaf
ingredients: 1 package fresh yeast | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 cup cajun seasoning | 8 tablespoons cajun-style roast cheese | 1 1/3 cups shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Lightly grease loaf pan with butter. Place all ingredients except provolone cheese in a mixer pan and beat at medium speed for 5 minutes. Stir in the provolone cheese. Cover and set in a warm spot to rise overnight. Bake at 400 degrees f for 45 minutes or until light golden brown. Remove from pan and cool on rack. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Spicy Spicy Cornmeal
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 can green tomatoes, chopped coarsely | 1 habanero pepper, minced | 1/4 cup peanut butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan and line with parchment paper. In a large bowl, whisk cornmeal together with tomatoes, habanero and peanut butter. Add liquid all at once to cornmeal mixture, stirring until a sticky batter forms. Cover loosely in parchment and let rest at room temperature for about 1 hour. Bake 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,pimiento,milk ricotta cheese,beef bouillon cube,cherry,mozzarella cheese,bicarbonate soda
title: Cherry Beef Rollups
ingredients: 500 g boneless beef steaks | 1 liter milk ricotta cheese | 500 g mozzarella cheese | 200 ml pimento stuffed olives, coarsely chopped | 5 beef bouillon cubes | 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 300 g cherries, pitted and split into halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c / 350 degrees. Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat and spray with oil. Put beef in pan and stir to coat with oil. Add a splash of water and cook, stirring occasionally, until meat is well browned on all sides. Transfer to a bowl. Cook and stir the ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, olives, bouillon, bicarb, and half the cherry into the pan. Bring to the boil, stirring often, then transfer to a greased and heated rectangular or oval, or 2 1/2 x 2 1/2 loaf tins. Brush top with remaining oil. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and leave inside for 10 mins then remove foil and bake for 30 minutes to brown top and cook through.

title: Southern Pulled Pork Sausages
ingredients: 1 pound pork sausages, sliced into strips | 2 cans pumpkin | 1 jar capers, drained | 1 package confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Put the sausages, pumpkins, capers and confectioners' sugar in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Serve on a bed of spaghetti squash or on toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,sage leaf,brown sugar,red bell pepper,thyme sprig
title: Herb and Pepper Mix Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coriander powder | 6 tablespoons red bell peppers, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs, chopped | 1 bunch fresh sage leaf, torn
instructions: Mix well with clean hands and store in airtight jar. Add all other dry ingredients to the food. Process in food processor until mixture is a coarse paste. Cover with clean tea towel and rest for 1 hour or more. Serve with fresh fruit salad and fresh veggies for a more substantial meal.

title: Vegan Savory Rice Pilaf!
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, washed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely chopped savory, or more to taste
instructions: Place rice and savory into a medium size, nonstick frying pan. Cover the pan and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Fluff rice with fork. Variation, instead of savory, you can use cumin, cajun seasoning, or even dried sage and/or thyme instead.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,linguine,red onion,grain rice,onion flake
title: Linguine Rice Italiano
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1/4 cup grain rice | 1 container refrigerated seasoned graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Cook red onions and drain any excess liquid.

title: Taco Treats
ingredients: 1 package ground beef jerky | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 can mexicorn | pesto sauce | 4 slices canned tomato ( optional ) | 3 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs ( optional ) | 1 lb rolled oats ( not quick cooking )
instructions: Brown ground beef jerky in frying pan with taco seasoning and taco seasoning. Remove from heat and drain excess grease. Add mexicorn, pesto, a slice of tomato and thyme to the ground beef mixture and mix. Let cool and add rolled oats. Roll into balls and serve.

title: Garlicky & Spicy Corn Chips!
ingredients: 310 g pico de gallo mix ( not salsa mix ) | 310 g sweet red peppers | 1/3 cup celery, diced ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Mix pico de gallo ingredients together well. Pour into a glass dish and chill in the fridge. When ready to serve, dust with corn flour.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,asiago cheese,creamy peanut butter
title: Peanut Butter Spiced Creamy Dip
ingredients: 1 package creamy peanut butter | 1 packageasiago cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Combine peanut butter, grated asiago cheese, and ginger garlic paste in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,garam masala,fine sea salt,cream chicken soup,galangal,romaine lettuce
title: Indian-Spiced Dressing
ingredients: 10 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 bunch romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon coarse sea salt | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated fresh galangal or 1 1/2 tablespoons ground ginger | 1/2 cup coffee-infused espresso powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and pulse to incorporate, adding water as needed to blend. Shake well before serving.

title: Basmati & Aubergine Toast With Basmati Rice
ingredients: 1 aubergine, sliced into 2cm thick rounds ( can use other vegetables ) | 2 cucumbers, sliced | 2 slices white bread | 1 -2 slice white bread | 200 g uncooked basmati rice | 2 teaspoons lemons, rind of, grated | 1 liter italian salad dressing | 2 cups cauliflower, chopped
instructions: Boil the aubergine and cucumbers in a saucepan of boiling water for 2 minutes or until tender. Drain well and set aside. Cook the white bread pieces in a frying pan in a little oil, adding a pinch of salt and seasoning, for about 2 minutes on each side. Meanwhile, fry the basmati rice with a little oil, half a teaspoon of salt & half a teaspoon of lemon rind. Set aside. Fry the cauliflower until crisp and drain. Place the slices of bread on the work surface with the basmati rice and cover with the sliced aubergines and cucumber. Place spoonfuls of rice in middle, then scatter over the cooked cauliflower, cucumber and italian salad dressing.

title: Apricot Bread Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dried apricot ( about 2 cups ) | 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 1 small brazil nut, finely chopped and lightly packed | 2 slices day old bread | 1 large bay leaf
instructions: Soak the apricots a little. Pierce them with a knife several times with a sharp knife and rub them with some salt in a sieve. Place the soaked apricots in a heavy 3 - 5 quart pot and add the broth. Bring to a boiling point over moderate heat, skimming frequently. Lower the heat, partially cover, and simmer for 40 minutes. Remove the pot from the heat and let stand 30 minutes. Break the bread into small pieces and stir into the soup about 3 minutes, then divide between two bowls. Remove the bay leaf and add just enough water to cover the bread. Remove about 1 cup of the liquid from the soup, reserving about 2 tablespoons. Stir the bread bread, a few pieces at a time, into the soup and boil over high heat until soup is thickened, about 20 minutes. The soup may be served warm or at room temperature, stirring once or twice.

title: Creamy Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 quart heavy whipping cream | 2 1/2 cups sour cream | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: In the top of a double boiler or in the top of a double boiler over boiling water, whisk the cream and sour cream until the sour cream has dissolved. Add the chopped cilantro just before serving.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,bay leaf,pork fillet,graham wafer,purpose flour
title: Pork Fillets
ingredients: 550 g all-purpose flour | 500 g pork fillets | 1 cup sweet chili sauce | 35 graham wafers | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 2 bay leaves
instructions: To make the dough, sift the flour into a large bowl. Place your pork fillets in the bowl, add the chili sauce and mix well. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow a little bit of the water to absorb. To make the topping, toast your wafers by brushing with olive oil. Place them on a tray, cut side up. Spread with 1 tsp chili sauce, the remaining sauce and the bay leaves. Bake in a moderate oven until the biscuits are pale and starting to harden, 10 to 15 minutes, depending on your oven. Serve and enjoy.

title: Pressed Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1 1/2 cups cold water | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard
instructions: Place chicken tenders in a shallow dish. Combine remaining ingredients, pour over chicken and marinate in refrigerator overnight. Preheat grill to moderate 350 degrees f. Place chicken on grill, bake 20 - 25 minutes or until done.

title: Pecan Triangles, Mexican-Style
ingredients: 2 limes, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 cup white sugar | 1 lb phyllo pastry, defrosted
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f degrees. Combine limes and zest, 1 tbsp of sugar, and 3 tbsp of sugar in a 1 quart saucepan. Cook over low heat 1 minute each time, until sugar is dissolved. Pour over lemon mixture. Add remaining sugar 1 tbsp at time. Cook, stirring, until sugar is dissolved. Place bottom pastry sheet on clean surface. Remove 1/3 of the mixture onto it. Reserve remaining dough for later use. Wrap tightly in plastic and place in fridge. When ready to use, preheat oven to 400°f. Take pastry dough from fridge and roll to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut in squares or diamonds. Place in 9x13 cake pan, seam side down. Continue until layers have been used up, ending with the last layer of pastry dough to brush on top. Bake the pies until golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Low Simmed Fat Pumpkin Shrimp
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 pounds fresh pumpkin | 1 teaspoon ground mixed spice | 1/2 cup amaretto, or more if needed | 6 ounces icing sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the shrimp in a large bowl, and sprinkle with the spice mix. Pour amaretto over shrimp, and turn to coat. Spread pumpkin onto the prepared baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until tender and well browned, 20 minutes. Once shrimp are cooked, remove from oven and add shrimp to pumpkin. Return to oven, and bake for 20 minutes, or until shrimp have turned pink in the center and pumpkin has warmed through. Stir in icing sugar just before serving. Serve cool, or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: almond,cherry tomato,lasagna noodle,chicken wing,vegetable broth,chicken bouillon,asparagus
title: Chicken Asparagus Lasagna II
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 can condensed chicken broth | 2 cubes chicken wings, separated | 1/2 ounce dried asparagus | 1/4 cup almonds, chopped | 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add lasagna and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,egg,garlic paste,raisin,thai red curry paste,italian sausage,garlic powder,vanilla bean
title: My Curry Egg Balls
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 -2 tablespoon thai red curry paste ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 dash curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground indian hot curry powder | 1 egg, slightly beaten
instructions: Preheat grill. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick spray. In a large bowl, combine the sausage, vanilla bean split lengthwise, red curry paste, raisins, garlic powder, garlic paste, curry powder and ground indian hot curry powder. Beat the egg slightly and add to mixture. Mix well. Shape mixture into 3 inch diameter balls with lightly wet hands. Cook each meatball 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until browned. Transfer the cooked meatballs to a plate lined with paper towels. Toss 1/2 to 1/2 of the meatballs back into the frying pan and drippings. Fry over gentle heat. Add some of the hot oil back to the skillet, then add the cooked meatballs back into the frying pan with the rest of the hot oil. Cook 5 minutes over low heat or until brown and bubbly. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white flour,cumin,chili without bean,chicken stock vegetable,lime,wine
title: Hot Chili Con Carne (No Oil)
ingredients: 1 liter chicken stock or 1 liter vegetable stock | 3 -4 tablespoons chili without beans ( optional ) | 3 -4 tablespoons white flour | 2 limes, wedged | 150 g white wine or 150 g vermouth ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Heat a saucepan and bring the stock to a simmer. Add the chili without beans or chilli if using and continue to stir. Add the flour to the hot stock and stir continuously. Continue cooking until the mixture thickens. Add the lime wedges and wine or vermouth and stir through or cover. Add cumin. Taste and adjust seasonings and serve. Variation. Stir fry beans or chillies in oil for a few minutes.

title: Baked Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs boned chuck | 2 tablespoons shortening | 5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Rub the meat with shortening and place into a large roasting pan. Rub the meat with the salt and pepper. Bake slowly in oven for 3 hours. Use an electric mixer to reduce the salt, then brush the chicken with the flavored oil. Bake until the meat is cooked through and richly browned. The meat can be frozen for up to 5 days. The longer it is kept, the better the flavor.

Random Ingredients: onion,sun tomato,chickpea,beef broth,mexican cheese,french green bean,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Southwestern Beef and Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 cup chopped onion | 1 package frozen french-cut green beans, thawed and drained | 1 can fat-free low-sodium beef broth | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato and oil packed sun-dried tomato salad dressing | 7 ounces chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 8 ounces shredded reduced-fat mexican cheese blend
instructions: In dutch oven, heat oil over medium high heat. Add onion.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,cooking oil,sherry wine,tabasco sauce,cream mushroom soup,tomato puree
title: Stove Top Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1/8 cup cooking oil | 1 can tomato puree | 1 tablespoon sherry wine or 1 tablespoon vermouth | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Put all ingredients in sauce pan and cover. Simmer for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: star anise,orange juice concentrate,red pepper flake,red capsicum,jam
title: Spicy Citrus Salad With Jam and Star Anise
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice concentrate | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 star anise | 2 medium red capsicums | 1/4 cup jam
instructions: Combine the orange juice concentrate with the crushed red pepper & star anise in a small saucepan, bring gently to the boil & simmer for 15 minutes or until reduced by half. Remove from heat & cool slightly, discard star anise anise paste, leave to cool. Cut capsicums into thin half moons, rinse & dry them under running water. Cut reserved anise flavour into thin slices. Slice the jam into thin shards, combine with 1 - 2 tbsp of the reserved anise flavour & season. Mix everything well, pour into serving bowl & sprinkle with the rest of the anise flavour.

title: Cantonese Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 10 1/2 fluid ounces apple juice | 6 fluid ounces almond milk | 3 tablespoons catsup | 10 1/2 fluid ounces limeade concentrate | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 tablespoon raisins | cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the pasta according to the package directions. Drain the drained spaghetti and place it back in the pot. Stir the apple juice, almond milk, catsup, limeade concentrate, chili sauce, raisins and cilantro into the spaghetti and mix well. Serve immediately.

title: Skirt Steak Salad, Italian Style
ingredients: 1 bag of chopped mixed greens with spinach | 1/2 cup vinaigrette dressing ( italian dressing, to taste ) | 1 small tomatoes, sliced thinly
instructions: Prepare salad and let sit. Heat up a grill pan or broiler. Spread salad on plates. Place steak on salad and drizzle on salad dressing. Top with tomato slices.

title: Lettuce Sprouts (Lettuce Wraps) in Olive Oil
ingredients: 1 bunch celery, trimmed | 6 green olives, stoned and halved | 4 cans refried beans with chilies | 20 -30 leaves lettuce, washed and finely shredded
instructions: Finely chop the celery. Strain the olives and cut the olives in quarters. Stack the lettuce leaves vertically on a plate, spread the olive oil on their sides and place them in the center of this row. Sprinkle the chopped celery over the sprouts. Gently mix the vegetables and lettuce together. Place 4 - 5 toothpicks through the outer layers of lettuce to hold the shape in shape. Stand the toothpicks in place of the toothpicks for presentation.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheddar cheese,vanilla extract,chicken soup,garlic paste,asafoetida powder
title: Chicken Asafoetida (Bok choy)
ingredients: 1 can condensed chicken soup | 2 teaspoons butter | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 3/8 cup shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, melt butter, add garlic and cook for a minute or two. Next, stir in chicken soup and the remaining ingredients, except the cheese. Simmer 15 minutes until the cheese is melted.

title: Turnip Salad - Authentic English Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb turnip, peeled and cut into large chunks | 1/4 cup mint sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl. Pour the mint sauce over the top and toss well to mix.

title: Faux Olive Oil and Honey Comb Bites
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1/4 cup clear honey | 7 1/2 ounces fontina cheese, finely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix together oil and honey. Add salt and pepper to taste, then stir in fontina. Drop rounded spoonfuls onto greased oven proof tray and bake for about 15 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,green pepper,mini marshmallow,quark,cannellini bean,water,red onion,cilantro leaf
title: Mushroom and Quark Cannellini Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 green pepper - stemmed, seeded and chopped | 2 cups chopped button mushrooms | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 teaspoon dried quark | 1/2 cup water | 1/2 cup mini marshmallows
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the beans, green pepper, mushrooms, red onion, cilantro, quark, and water. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Baked Cauliflower Leaves-Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 can cauliflower florets, drained | 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1/2 teaspoon coriander
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or spray with cooking spray. Combine cauliflower and rice in a large bowl and toss to coat. Stir in coriander. Spread cauliflower mixture in the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until tender and rice is browned, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,dark soy sauce,chicken thigh,corn syrup
title: Sweet Soy Chicken
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( use 2 cans ) | 3 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 2 lbs skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Cut each chicken thigh in half, then pound out the fat. Place the beans, corn syrup, soy sauce, and 4 tbs water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil until reduced to about 1 1/2 cups, about 15 minutes, stirring to prevent scorching. Cut slits on one side of each thigh, in 2 1/2 opposite direction, and insert a piece of chicken. Return chicken to saucepan and heat through, about 3 minutes. Note, if the sauce is thick, you may need to add more water.

title: Rigatoni with Cheddar and Tarragon
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon
instructions: In a medium saucepan of boiling water, cook rigatoni uncovered until just tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Drain pasta under cold water. Grease a 1 quart casserole dish. Spread hot pasta evenly in bottom of dish. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese. Sprinkle with tarragon. Repeat layers, sprinkling cheddar cheese on top of cheese until dish is full. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate remaining dish, chilled, 3 days, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,chicken bouillon,red wine,kalamata olive
title: Simple One-Pot Moroccan Barbecue
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine with pimento strips | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon ground black cardamom pods | 1/2 cup halved kalamata olives
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Stir wine, buillon, and cardamom pods in the skillet until liquid is absorbed, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mint,flat leaf italian parsley,ketchup,pork chop,red bell pepper
title: Grilled Pork Chops with Minted Sweet Peppers and Peppers
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 3 firm red bell peppers | 1/2 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon finely chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Combine peels from chilies, parsley, ketchup and mint in a bowl and pour over pork chops. Marinate chops in the refrigerator for 2 to 24 hours before grilling. Grill pork over hot coals or broil on high, turning, until cooked through but slightly pink in the center and slightly charred, about 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Tomato Zucchini and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini ( about 3-1/2 inches long ) | 1/2 teaspoon grated lime zest | 2 large shiitake mushrooms, stems removed, caps quartered | 1 medium tomatoes, quartered | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon lowfat yogurt
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Place zucchini slices in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with lime rind. Add mushrooms, and combine.
