Transfer the mixture to a bowl, and stir in the tomato, lime juice and yogurt. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes before serving. Serve cold or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,strawberry,amaretto,flour tortilla,pecan,red cabbage,apricot preserve,green bean
title: French Flag Tortilla Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 large flour tortilla | 2 tablespoons amaretto, divided | 8 ounces frozen cut green beans, thawed | 1 1/2 cups sliced red cabbage | 1 cup shredded saskatchewan cut strawberry | 6 ounces thawed frozen pecans, chopped, divided | 1/2 cup apricot preserves, divided
instructions: Whip cream in a medium bowl with an electric mixer on high speed until peaks form, 1 - 2 minutes. Divide whipped cream evenly among 4 plates. To make french toast, warm tortilla on a medium oven rack until light brown, 2 - 3 minutes. Spread a scant 1/4 cup of amaretto on a hot tortilla. To assemble salad, lay tortilla on a cutting board and cut into 1/4 inch wide strips. Spread 1/4 cup amaretto on a hot, clean dinner plate and cover with some of the sliced green beans & red cabbage. Cover with more shaved green beans & red cabbage, then some sliced strawberries, half the pecans, and remaining amaretto. Top with more shaved green beans & red cabbage. Top with remaining slices of shaved saskatchewan strawberries and pecan halves.

title: Hominy With Baked Chocolate and Toasted Sops (Pioneer Woman)
ingredients: 3 quarts hominy | 2 celery ribs, sliced ( about 1 cup ) | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 8 ounces baking chocolate, chunks | 1/4 cup lemonade ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup honey
instructions: Cook hominy in salted, medium saucepan until tender but not mushy, about 1 hour. Drain in colander and rinse thoroughly. Discard broth. Melt the chocolate chunks and add to broth along with the raisins. Simmer, covered, for 5 minutes. Blend mixture. Mix in reserved broth with honey and stir.

title: Orange Spice Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 1 1/2 cups orange juice or 2 1/2 cups juice from oranges | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees celcius. Spray a loaf pan with pam. In a mixing bowl, combine orange juice, baking powder, cinnamon. Measure the orange juice mixture into the loaf pan. Bake for 50 - 55 minutes or until a skewer inserted comes out mostly clean. Remove from oven and cool for 5 minutes. Cut into slices on a diagonal. Serve with fresh cream or ice cream if desired. Note, if freezing, wrap loosely with foil to prevent a skin from forming.

title: Tropical Macaroni Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package macaroni | 4 scallions, sliced thinly | 1 brown onion, chopped | 1 1/4 cups brown instant coffee, hot | 1/4 cup thickened cream topping, any flavor | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | french baguette, cut into 4 1-inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare the macaroni according to package directions. Drain. In a small bowl, combine the scallions, the onion, the brown instant coffee and cream topping. Slice the baguette slices. In a small saucepan, combine the hot coffee and cream topping. Pour over macaroni and vegetables and toss to coat. Spoon one cup of the macaroni and macaroni mixture onto each slice of bread and top with the cream topping. Serve at once.

title: Lavender-Honey Glaze for Breakfast
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon tarragon leaves, crushed | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon yellow cornmeal | 1 tablespoon strong coffee | 1 tablespoon lavender flowers | 1/8 teaspoon honey
instructions: Mix the mustard ingredient together in a small bowl. Mix all the glaze ingredients together in a small saucepan. Bring the honey to a boil, remove from heat and slowly pour into the mustard. Add the honey mixture to the mustard in small increments until the glaze is the consistency of thin custard. Cool and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,head cauliflower,chestnut,ancho chile powder
title: Beef and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless beef top sirloin steak | 2 bags fresh cauliflower | 1 jar chestnuts, drained | 1 pound fresh anchos chiles, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place beef in a skillet with cauliflower, chestnuts, and anchos. Season with chile powder. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until beef is cooked through and cauliflower is tender, about 40 minutes.

title: Ww 5 Points - Carnation Pork Ribs and Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb pork back ribs | 16 ounces fresh spinach, washed and drained | 2 tablespoons mrs. dash seasoning salt | 8 -10 ladyfingers
instructions: Heat bbq on high. Remove as many rib racks as possible from the grill. Cook the ribs until it is no longer pink or the bone in. They are done when a meat thermometer insterted reads 140 to 155 degrees. Let ribs rest. Pull ribs apart, and slice cross grain. You will need to cut down on the ribs with kitchen shears. They get very soft, and may start to lose crispness. When you squeeze them, they should be able to break apart somewhat. While they are cooking, cut up spinach into 1/2 inch cubes. Place on cookie sheet and refrigerate. When ribs have cooled, remove from refrigerator and cut into bite size pieces. You will need 2 ribs each. Mix 2 tbsp of pork seasoning. Spread seasoning on both sides of each piece of meat and roll up in the spinach. You need 4 servings, and 4 ladyfingers.

title: Spicy Shrimp
ingredients: 2 pounds large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place shrimp in a slow cooker with enough water to cover. Cook on low setting for 8 hours. Stir in hot pepper sauce during the last 15 minutes of cooking time, or cover and keep warm while shrimp cook, stirring frequently. Cook shrimp in a skillet over medium heat until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,cornflour,chicken breast half,parmesan cheese,red onion
title: Crazy Garlic Chicken
ingredients: 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 small red onion, finely chopped
instructions: In a bowl, mix the cornflour with 1/2 cup of the parmesan cheese and garlic powder. Set aside. Dip chicken in the remaining parmesan cheese mixture. Heat a large skillet. Cook the chicken over a high heat until lightly brown. Turn when necessary to brown evenly on both sides.

Random Ingredients: tuna water,white vinegar,spinach,hot italian sausage,lime juice zest,grain rice,ladyfinger
title: Tuna and Spinach Rolls (Tuna Rice Balls)
ingredients: 16 1/4 ounces spinach, thawed frozen thawed drained, squeezed dry | 2 tablespoons white vinegar or 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 8 -10 small hot italian sausage, casings removed | 24 ladyfingers | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice or 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 8 ounces tuna in water, drained and flaked | hot cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Combine spinach, vinegar and sausage, stir until spinach is coated. Remove from heat, refrigerate until needed, about 10 minutes. Arrange 3 ladyfingers on each plate, cover with 2 tbls. Of the spinach mixture, roll up the mixture, and tie with kitchen string. Arrange rolled rice balls on a platter, sprinkle with lime or lime juice, serve.

title: Quick Oatcakes
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons rose water | 1/4 cup chopped fresh radish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the oats, flour and rose water. Mix in the radishes with more flour if desired. Use a wet spoon to scoop the batter into mini muffin cups. Let sit for 15 minutes. Bake in the preheated oven for 12 to 20 minutes, until the tops are firm and golden.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens ( may use 1/2 of a chicken breast ) | 1 roasting apple, sliced | 1 asian pear, sliced | 18 leaves of green | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 lb fresh asparagus | 1 lb sirloin steak, chopped into bite sized pieces then shredded ( may use other steak ) | 1 cup fresh cherries, to decorate ( may use a handful of cherries to decorate )
instructions: Prep all the ingredients. Clean the chicken inside and out from any soil that may have developed inside. Remove any organs except the breast. The chicken should be completely stuffed, not more than the size of the whole bird. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. The next day, preheat the oven to 375 degrees, then place the chicken on a large roasting pan and lay out the apple slices and pear slices in an even layer. Pour the mayonnaise on top of the apple and pear mixture. Place the green asparagus, sirloin, cherries and the chopped steak over the chicken. Place the breaded chicken breast onto the top of the breaded chicken. The breaded chicken should be completely covered. Cook for 30 - 40 minutes at 375. When the chicken is cooked through and deliciously cooked, the breaded meat should be easily pulled off the bread bone. Remove from the oven, and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes before removing the chicken breasts carefully from the pan.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,rocket,date,monterey jack cheese,self rising flour,green food coloring
title: Lupita's Cheese Slice!
ingredients: 200 g shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh rocket | 1 tablespoon chopped dates | 1 teaspoon green food coloring | 2 teaspoons self-rising flour | 1/4 of a cabbage
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix all the ingredients. Cut into 3 - 4 squares place on a plate or biscuit tray and bake in a hot oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,flour tortilla,suet,chinese five spice powder,butter,fish sauce
title: Tasty Chips With Coriander and Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 1/2 slices thawed suet ( fresh cheese with a hint of graininess ) | 2 thin flour tortillas | 1 tablespoon butter | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder, blend ( or your own favourite curry powder ) | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/2 cup tasty mexican blend cheese, sliced
instructions: Place the crisco, worcestershire sauce, and curry powder in a small saucepan and simmer until all of the liquid has evaporated. Drain off any excess oil. Place the crisco, five spice powder, and fish sauce in a shallow tray and shape the chips into long 'cigars' on 2 microwave safe plates. Microwave at medium for 1 minute. Place 1 tablespoon of coriander and a little cheese on one side of the 'cigars' and serve immediately, with the crispy chips on the side. Alternatively, you can serve the chips straight from the microwavable plate, or microwave them on high for 2 minutes, turning once, until crispy, golden brown, and heated through.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,coconut oil,guinness stout,barbecue sauce,bourbon whiskey,broccoli,beef bouillon cube,cottage cheese
title: Smokin' Irish Beef and Broccoli Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 4 frozen broccoli, cut up, as per package directions, and cut up as per package directions | 1 beer | 6 beef bouillon cubes, undiluted and dissolved in about 3/4 of the beef broth | 4 ounces campari buffalo flavor irish stout beer | 2 packages uncooked ramen noodles, broken and do not rinse | shredded cheddar and/or parmesan cheese can be added to the pot for additional flavor
instructions: In a large pot, heat the 1 tbs. Of coconut oil on medium heat. Add the ground meat and cook for 5 minutes, or until browned and cooked through. Set aside and keep warm. Add the remaining oil to the pot. Add the frozen broccoli and cover, lower heat and continue to simmer for 10 minutes. Add the beer and beef broth and continue to simmer for a minute or two, until the vegetables are tender, but not mushy, but still soupy. Add the noodles and simmer until they are heated thru, adding a little beef broth at a time if the soup is dry enough. Add the borr de to the finished soup. Stir well and simmer for a few minutes to allow for flavors to mix. Ladle into nice bowls and top with shredded cheddar and/or parmesan cheese can be added to the soup for additional flavor if desired.

title: Maple Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups chopped pork or 2 cups ham | 1 1/2 cups chopped toasted maple syrup | 1/4 cup prepared marinara sauce | 2 2/3 cups cake flour
instructions: In a medium bowl, add 1 cup of chopped pork or ham, maple syrup, marinate, maple syrup, and flour. Mix until a dough is formed. If necessary. Remove the dough from the bowl and knead it again briefly. Using waxed paper, press the dough into a greased bowl. Cover with waxed paper. Refrigerate until use. This may take as long as 2 hours for the dough.

title: Pumpkin Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup pumpkin puree | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon triple sec
instructions: Mix the pumpkin, white pepper and triple sec together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,chinese noodle,french bread,breadcrumb,cherry tomato,tofu,lime juice,prosciutto
title: Chinese Tofu Noodles With Mushrooms and Prosciutto on Rye Bruschetta
ingredients: 500 g fresh chinese noodles | 250 g thin fried tofu, thinly sliced | 100 g button mushrooms ( i used cremini ) | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 12 slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes ( i used papperi ) | 1 1/2 cups sweet breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 limes, juice of or 1 1/2 lemons, juice of | 1 tablespoon french breadcrumbs
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil. Add the noodles and cook for 6 - 8 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside. Roughly chop the tofu, mushrooms, and prosciutto. Transfer to a bowl and toss with breadcrumbs. Roll the noodles in the breadcrumbs until completely coated. Brush the breadcrumbs onto the base of the breadcrumbs. Bake on a baking tray for approx 10 minutes or until the breadcrumbs are crisp. Remove from the oven and slice diagonally. Toss in the tomato, mushrooms, and prosciutto. Drizzle the lime juice and lemon juice over and toss well. Place the sliced french bread into the tray and toss lightly with the breadcrumbs. Bake on the top shelf of the preheated oven for about 3 - 5 minutes, or until lightly golden.

title: Crab Pie II
ingredients: 2 unbaked pie crusts | 2 cans condensed beef broth | water | 24 ounces frozen crabmeat, thawed | 2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to in 4qt saucepan, pour beef broth into small bowl.

title: Spanish Limeade
ingredients: 6 cups grape juice | 1 1/2 inches piece lime zest | parsley, minced, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place 6 cups of grape juice and freshly squeeze the lime zest into a bowl. Mix in the lime juice with a fork until well combined. Serve in glasses over crushed ice, garnish with parsley or other desired garnish.

title: Oven Beef for Two
ingredients: 2 lean rump steak, cut into 1 inch squares | 1/4 cup tea | pepperoncini pepper or fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix the tea & pepperoncini. Lightly grease a baking dish or baking sheet. Place the steak over the dish. Bake for 10 minutes, turn over & baste with the tea concoction. Continue cooking for a little more time, then serve hot or bbq over brown rice, noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Tandoori Green Masala
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except chaat.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,pork loin chop,green bell pepper,green cardamom pod,basil
title: Vietnamese Pork Chops and Rice
ingredients: 6 pork loin chops, 1-inch thick | 4 green bell peppers, seeded and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup fresh basil, cut into thin strips | 4 green cardamom pods | warm basil ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups uncooked basmati rice
instructions: Arrange the pork chops and green bell peppers in the slow cooker. Pour half the basil and cardamom pods over the pork. Sprinkle with half the basil and season with salt and pepper. Pour the remaining basil and cardamom pods on top. Cover and cook on low 8 hours until pork is tender. Serve with rice. Garnish with remaining basil and cardamom.

title: Sweet Red Curry Paste (Vegan)
ingredients: 1/3 cup red curry paste | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) or 1/2 cup dried cranberries ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve curry paste in 1/4 cup boiling water. Add raisins, if using.. Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: apple,italian parsley,yellow onion skin,chili paste,wheat cereal,star anise
title: Sesame Bread (Broiler-Cook)
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion, chopped ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh chili paste, such as sambal oelek | 1 whole star anise | 2 1/2 cups whole wheat cereal | 1 cup apple, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,taco seasoning mix,lemon zest,chicken wing,kimchi
title: Korean-Style Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 cups chicken wings, separated | 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 cup kimchi, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, freshly grated | 1/2 cup tomato sauce
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the chicken wings, and return to a boil. Cook the chicken wings to your desired degree of doneness, about 5 minutes per side. Remove the wings, and set aside to cool to room temperature. Once chilled, fold the wing tips under to separate the tips and separate them. Slice the tips and tail off the wings at thickest parts, and cut back into pieces. Heat the tomato sauce in a skillet over medium heat, and stir in the kimchi, until well combined. Cook and stir until heated through and lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Mix the chicken wings into the vegetable sauce.

title: Paprika and Bacon Wrapped in Breading Appetizers
ingredients: 1 bacon, sliced into 8 thin slices ( i like to use scissors at this point since they are thick ) | 1 pizza sauce ( i like a blend of your favourite pepper )
instructions: Line two cookie trays with aluminium foil. Remove the bacon and slice it in half crossways, leaving enough space around it to make an even base for the pizza. Brush the bacon slices with your favourite pizza sauce and set aside. Wipe any bacon bits with a paper towel and scatter over the remaining slices of bacon. Bake at 180 c for 10 - 15 minutes or until the bacon is crisp and crisp and the toppings are golden and sticky. Serve with your favourite toppings. Note, this can also be made without the pizza sauce and it's delicious as an asian meal served with pita, pita bread and pickles.

title: Madeira and Madeira Stew for Soup
ingredients: 6 dried chinese mushrooms | 2/3 cup madeira wine or 2/3 cup liqueur | 2/3 cup dried citron peel
instructions: Rinse and dry mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,saltine cracker,rice wine vinegar,white onion
title: Italian Sausage with Rice Crumbs
ingredients: 3 pounds sweet italian sausage, casings removed and meat cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 large white onion, chopped | 1 cup rice wine vinegar | 6 saltines
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the dry sausages on the prepared baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven until cooked through, 20 to 25 minutes total. Remove from oven and let cool. Remove skins from sausages, and chop meat. Place the coarsely ground sausage into a large, heavy saucepan. Pour in rice wine vinegar and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cook and stir until the vinegar has been absorbed. Drain the sausages, and gently toss with onion. Spread hot sausage mixture onto the cracker crumbs, and top with the reserved hot sausage meat mixture.

title: Spicy Oranges With Peas (Hara Sada Kebec)
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg small brown or white pea beans, such as lima beans, soaked for 2 hours | 2 oranges, juice of | 4 tablespoons yoghurt | 1 small hot yellow chile, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Drain the peas and rinse in fresh water. Drain and pat dry a large non stick frying pan or flat pan. Heat up the pan/frying pan over a medium heat. Squeeze the juice of the oranges well into the pan. Add the peas and cook for a few minutes, until just tender, stirring, then set aside. Add yoghurt to the pan with the chilli. Season to taste and heat through, taking care not to boil the sauce. Serve on warm plates and with plenty of turkish bread or bread forks.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt pepper,hot red chili pepper,parsley,silken tofu,topping
title: Frozen Tofu
ingredients: 1 package silken tofu or 1 lb firm tofu, drained | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped ( or 2 tsp dried or chopped ) | 1 teaspoon finely grated hot red chili pepper | 2 tablespoons nonfat milk or 2 tablespoons soymilk | kosher salt and pepper
instructions: If using soft tofu, drain off excess water but leave tofu on the kitchen counter. In a food processor, combine the cubed tofu with parsley and hot pepper. Blend to a smooth, moist paste. Add a little milk or soy milk if needed. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Take out of the refrigerator 15 - 30 minutes before serving.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa, cut in 1/4 inch slices | 3/4 cup heinz pickle relish | 1/4 cup beer or 1/4 cup water, to thin
instructions: Arrange kielbasa over a bed of chopped cooked vegetables and top with the pickle relish. Add the beer or water to thin sauce.

title: Easy Mexican Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1 can salsa ( any kind ) | 1 can mild picante sauce
instructions: Add all ingredients into crock pot and stir to mix. Cook on low for 5 to 7 hours enjoy.

title: Tofu
ingredients: 400 g pork tenderloin | 3/4 red onion | 1/4 cup tamari
instructions: Cut pork tenderloins into thick slices. Dice red onion, wash and slice tamari into pieces of varying size. Combine all ingredients in a deep non metallic ovenproof dish. Turn on grill. Grill on high to dry out some of the liquid but not to burn it. Turn once during grilling.

title: Mexican Wild Rice with Pine Nuts and Cream
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Place rice in a large pot with water to cover.

title: Spicy Italian Slaw
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 3 italian sausages, sliced crosswise 4 x 1/2 inches each | 1/2 head red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a lrg nonstick skillet set over med. High heat, saute meat w/sausages & cabbage till meat is brown and onions are translucent.

title: Tuna Burritos
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained | 12 corn tortillas ( the mild variety ) | 1/2 jar sweetened condensed milk or 1/2 jar apricot preserves, drained
instructions: Spread some of the tuna on one side of each tortilla. Spread the sweetened condensed milk or preserves over the tuna and tortilla. Roll up to make burritos.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,quinoa,red chile,portobello mushroom cap,sauce,tortilla chip,beer
title: The Best BBQ Nacho Bowls Ever!
ingredients: 1 jar of your favorite barilla chips, about 3-4-inches ( any good nacho flavor will do ) | 1 bottle beer, any type will do | 1 -2 teaspoon a.1. original sauce ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon dried red chile, crushed ( optional ) | 1 can portobello mushroom caps | 3 cups cooked quinoa
instructions: Pour beer into the bottom of a large bowl and stir to loosen chips from bowl to the bottom. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes to overnight. Heat grill pan, cast iron, or electric frying pan on stove on medium high heat. Drain chips from beer in the bowl and transfer beer to bowl. Add a1, garlic powder, dried red chile, if using and mushrooms to beer in bowl. Stir till mixed well. Remove chips from beer mixture in bowl and set aside. Add quinoa into bowl along with 1 cup cooking water and mix well. Add the chicken chip mixture to bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 hour or till quinoa is cooked and liquid absorbed. Serve with spanish rice or guacamole.

title: King of Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs beef round roast ( or other beef stew ) | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 can red peppers, sliced | 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 tablespoon fresh dill | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram | 1/2 tablespoon dried dill or 1/2 tablespoon dried dill | 6 lbs stewing fish
instructions: Combine soups, marjoram, marjoram and dill in crock pot. Add beef, and stir to coat well. Cover and cook on low heat 7 - 8 hours. Add fish and cook 15 minutes. Note, you may add sliced chicken to the casserole before serving. Stir to coat. Variation, you may also use carrots, peppers or potatoes for stew.

title: Beer and Rice for a Healthier and Cereasing Lunch
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups long grain white rice | 2 bottles beer ( your favourite brand, such as negra modelo )
instructions: In a large pot, bring just enough water to cover the rice. Over medium heat, bring just enough water to cover the rice. Bring to the boil and immediately lower the heat. Cover and cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until rice is tender. When rice is done, fluff with a fork and leave for about an hour. While still hot, gently pour off the water and reserve. When the rice is cool enough to handle, stir in the beer. When cold, transfer to a clean, dry bowl and leave to cool to room temperature. To serve, divide the rice between four plates, topped with some of the meat and sauce.

title: Tropical Green Beans
ingredients: 1 package pre-washed beans | 2 -3 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1/4 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Boil water in a medium sized pot. Add the beans while stirring to keep them from burning. You don't want to cook them long, so keep an eye on them and keep an eye on them so you do not overcook. Add the mango chutney, sugar and coconut in the boiling water. Stir gently and make sure the sugar is dispersed throughout the beans. Cook on medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until the beans are tender. Turn off heat and stir well. Cover and stand for 10 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed. Note, do not stir at this time. Instead of bean soaking, you can add a couple to two cups of water to the pot. Mix carefully so the flavors don't fall out. Add more to taste, to your taste. The idea is that the coconut does the job here.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,rotel tomato,beef tenderloin,irish cream,grain white rice
title: Crock Pot Beef Tenderloin With Browned Tomato Risotto
ingredients: 4 ounces whole grain white rice or 4 ounces white basmati rice, uncooked | 1 lb beef tenderloin | 4 tablespoons unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder, divided | 1 can mexican-style canned rotel tomatoes | 4 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Brown rice as directed on package. Reserve 1/4 cup of the sauce. In crock pot, place remaining sauce, rinsed rice, beef and cocoa powder. Cover. Cook on high for 6 hours or low for 5 hours. Slice. Serve topped with reserved tomato sauce and irish cream.

title: Auld Alliance:  Dumplings and Crisp
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces suet | vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Slice suet finely and place in a tea towel or a mixing bowl. Dip fingers in warm water and wet them with a teaspoon, or in a bowl of plain flour mixed with a little oil. Mix together with suet. Grease and line a large oven tray or tin. Drop tablespoons of the mixture onto the tray, spaced evenly apart. They should be spaced very loosely in a single layer. If you use the suet lightly press in a teaspoon. Bake in heated oven for 40 minutes, turning once until golden brown.

title: Chinese Pork Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons garlic salt | 2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Cut tenderloins into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place in bowl with garlic salt and pour over water to cover. Marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature or overnight the longer the better. Drain the meat and pat dry with paper towels. Heat ghee in skillet over medium high heat. Add the meat and stir fry until dark brown on all sides, about 3 minutes. Add the marinade and stir fry until meat is no longer pink outside, 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in sauce.

title: Ouzo
ingredients: 2 teaspoons yellow mustard seeds | 1/2 lemon, juiced | 1/2 teaspoon lemon, zested | 1 pinch old bay seasoning | 8 ounces ouzo
instructions: In a small bowl, combine mustard seeds with lemon juice, lemon zest and old bay seasoning. Fill a jar with ouzo, then pour in the mustard paste. Cover the jar, and store in the refrigerator.

title: Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
instructions: In the top of a double boiler over gently simmering water, stir cream and mustard seeds together. Remove from heat and cool.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 box farfalle pasta | 4 cups shredded gorgonzola | 1/4 cup vegemite | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | pecan halves
instructions: Prepare fondue and set aside. Drain and rinse out the pasta and set aside. While the pasta is boiling, thoroughly mix the gorgonzola, vegemite and spices together. Set aside a small amount of the parmesan cheese for the base of the fondue pot and then set it aside to use as topping later. Place the drained pasta in a food processor and process until very smooth. Pour the contents of the food processor into the fondue pot and let cool. Sprinkle the fondue pan base with the pecans to serve immediately.

title: Wasabi Crusted Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 teaspoon wasabi powder | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Slice loaf in half, 1 inch slices. Spread wasabi on both sides of each loaf. Place half of meat in each cut loaf. Sprinkle with cinnamon sticks. Refrigerate and marinate for 2 - 3 hours. Broil to desired temperature.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,fenugreek seed,vegetable stock,orange peel,cannellini bean,white breadcrumb
title: Baked Bean Burgers
ingredients: 240 g cannellini beans, drained if canned | 400 ml vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 5 1/2 ounces white breadcrumbs | 1 orange peel, finely chopped | hamburger bun, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line 2 baking trays with foil and place the beans in a food processor. Pulse until finely chopped. Add the stock, fenugreek, breadcrumbs, orange peel and some seasoning. Process to form a coarse mixture. Divide into 2. Form 2 patties on tray and brush with oil. Place on the baking trays and bake for 20 minutes. Serve immediately with toasted arugula or baby greens.

title: Broiled Prosciutto (Antioque Seco) for Two
ingredients: 8 ounces prosciutto, deli thinly sliced, rind discarded ( about 16 slices ) | table salt | 2 fresh jalapenos, halved and seeded
instructions: Heat broiler. Wrap each slice of prosciutto loosely around a pepper half and secure with a toothpick. Sprinkle with salt and broil 2 1/2 minutes or until edges are darkly browned, and peppers are bubbling. Watch the prosciutto carefully.

title: Mango Chutney Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 18)
ingredients: 180 g mango chutney | 1 -2 teaspoon salsa | 1 iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Combine chutney, salsa and lettuce in a small bowl. Serve immediately to accompany.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,chickpea,cheese,red onion,pistachio nut,gruyere cheese,rice vinegar,stewing beef
title: Cheese-Stuffed Beef With Chickpeas
ingredients: 300 g gruyere cheese, finely grated ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/4 cup pistachio nut, chopped | 1/4 red onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, leaves chopped | 300 g stewing beef, cut into strips | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 50 g chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190°c combine gruyere, pistachios, onion, parsley, beef and vinegar in a bowl. Put the chickpeas in a microwave safe bowl and heat in the microwave for 1 minute, or until hot. Add chickpeas and 2/3 of the chopped parsley to bowl with cheese mixture. Toss to combine. Divide remaining cheese mixture between 4 medium oven proof dishes, and sprinkle evenly with remaining chopped parsley. Cook for 35 - 35 minutes. Serve with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,guacamole,angel hair pasta,shallot,apple juice concentrate
title: Homemade Noodle Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 shallots ( minced ) | 120 g guacamole | 100 ml apple juice concentrate ( canned in a container ) | 225 g plain flour | 225 g angel hair pasta
instructions: Cook noodles according to instructions on pack, drain well and set aside. Heat oil in a frying pan, and saute shallots until soft and translucent. In a large bowl, mix guacamole and concentrate with shallots. In a separate bowl, mix flour on high speed with a pinch of salt, then add to guacamole mix. Place warm noodles in another bowl or plate, then pour over guacamole mix. Add noodles to other bowl, then toss with salad dressing. You can either serve immediately or place in fridge to cool for a few hours before serving, as it will set in the fridge and have a great unique flavour.

title: Roasted Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 3 red bell peppers | 3 tablespoons riesling wine or 3 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 550 degrees. Wash the peppers. Insert a small sharp knife into the bottom of each and carefully remove the seeds without breaking the skin. Slice up the peppers using a medium sized sharp knife, so they are about an inch from the stem. Place in an ovenproof dish with the peppers and any juices. Rub the wine over the peppers. Cover with aluminum foil or a lid, and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the foil or lid and bake for another 10 to 15 minutes, until the peppers are tender, a glaze.

title: Creamy Canadian Bacon and Barley
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup fresh canadian bacon, thinly sliced
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, place barley in a bowl of ice water, and allow to soak until completely soaked. Drain and transfer barley to a blender with a little of the canadian bacon fat, and puree until smooth. Return to the remaining canadian fat and add barley. Blend until fully incorporated, stopping to scrape down sides of bowl as needed. If mixture becomes too thick, slowly add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until desired consistency is achieved. Enjoy note, can also be left out of the canadian bacon fat in the recipe for a thicker version.

title: Hamburger Roulades
ingredients: 2 pounds hamburger | 2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: In a large, deep, heavy skillet, brown hamburger. While browning, combine flour and salt. Roll hot hamburger mixture into ropes about the size of a tennis ball. With the tips of your hands, press two ropes together to form roulades. Repeat with remaining dough. Place roulades in the freezer for at least a few hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake roulades until crisp and nicely colored, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: French Pear Pasties
ingredients: 1 sheet ready rolled puff pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Spray pastry with cooking spray. Place pastry sheet between two sheets of greased pizza peel or similar sized baking parchment paper. Prick pastry with a fork and bake in 400 degree f oven for 5 to 10 minutes until golden brown. Remove pastry from oven and reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f. Spoon 1/2 tablespoon of vinegar into each pastry case, being careful not to dislodge the pastry. Return to oven and bake for about 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Variation, this recipe can be made with a mixture of tart cherries, black currant juice and peach jam. Or you may substitute other berries for the vinegar.

title: Easy Shredded Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs shredded sirloin | 1/2 lb shredded kasuri methi ( dried fenugreek leaf ) | 1/2 pint sour cream
instructions: Cook the shredded beef and kasuri methi in a pot for 3 hours or longer, stirring often. Add the sour cream in an oven dish and stir well with a fork until it is completely mixed well and the sour cream is evenly mixed in the skillet. Bake in a preheated oven 350f degrees for at least 1 hour.

title: Cherry Braised Pork Chops
ingredients: 6 pork loin chops | garlic powder | 1 can red beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can pitted cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place pork chops side by side in a 9x13 inch dish. Sprinkle garlic powder over pork.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,red kidney bean,baking potato,jalapeno pepper juice,button mushroom,red chilies,egg yolk water,green cardamom pod
title: Jaffrey's Kidneys & Eggs (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 red chilies ( or ajwain seeds and ribs ) | 5 small baking potatoes, peeled and boiled ( about 4 ounce ) | 2/3 cup malt vinegar | 1/3 cup tomato-flavored pickled jalapeno pepper juice ( to taste ) | sliced green cardamom pods ( to garnish if desired ) | 6 hardboiled egg yolks ( for garnish, from another person or a platter/casserole ) | 1 can red kidney beans | 2 red chilies ( optional and to taste ) | 2 tablespoons sliced button mushrooms ( optional and to taste )
instructions: Put the dry chile in a small frying pan and place over medium heat. When it starts to turn dark red, add a little water and scrape it off the bottom of the pan with a slotted spoon. When liquid boils, turn off the heat and allow the chile in liquid to cool, about 15 minutes. Scrape off burnt seeds from chile and discard. Scrape seeds from chile. When it cools, crush the chile coarsely. Chop it into small pieces and stir it into the mashed potato. You can make this vegetarian by adding the tomatoes, jalapenos, green cardamom pods, etc. Or, if you like the idea of pushing the eggs under the potato layer layer, put a little tomato paste/seed mixture into a blender or processor. Blend to get tomato juice. This recipe is a little labor intensive, but worth making in advance and keeping in mind.

title: Avocados With Beef and Coconut
ingredients: 6 large hass avocados, peeled, pitted, and cut into six wedges each | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/2 cup crumbled oatmeal | 1 lb boneless sirloin steak or 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups raw peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a shallow bowl, mash the avocados with a fork and set aside. In a shallow serving dish, add the bread crumbs, coconut, and oatmeal. Add meat, tossing to coat with crumbs. Place avocado mixture into the dish and cover with papertowels. Chill until ready to serve. Add peanuts to the top and serve.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,monterey jack pepper cheese,breadcrumb,cider vinegar
title: Cheesy Corn Chips (Not Fried) or Fried Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 2 cups corn oil | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 6 cups breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 cups pepper jack pepper cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix the corn oil, vinegar and bread crumbs together in a bowl.

title: Swiss Cheese and Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 250 g swiss cheese, grated | 100 g spinach leaves, washed and stems removed
instructions: Blend all ingredients well in a food processor and divide into 10 equal portions to make the filling. Use a 10 x 5 cm tray to make rolls of approximately 10 x 3 inch each. Place on foil lined baking sheet and bake at 180c for 10 - 15 minutes or until nicely browned. Serve warm with salad.

title: Easy and Delicious Tzatziki Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces plain yogurt | 5 ounces savory-infused olive, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon savory
instructions: Place zesty yogurt in a container. Tilt the container to coat the bottom.

Random Ingredients: green chili,salmon fillet,chicken bouillon cube,spice,raisin,yellow pepper
title: Jamaican Green Fish (Spice Snacks)
ingredients: 4 skinless salmon fillets ( about 1 1/2 lbs. ) | 3/4 cup seedless raisin | 1/2 cup yellow pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons mild green chili, diced | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 1 chicken bouillon cube, blended with | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Place the fish in a lightly oiled medium skillet. Cover and cook over medium heat, turning once, about 6 minutes per side. The fish must be completely cooked so it will not overcook. Remove fish from pan and keep warm. To make the sauce, combine the raisins, yellow pepper, diced chilies, mixed spice.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,ginger garlic paste,turnip,cream celery soup,mustard,pernod
title: Celery Chow Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turnips | 8 ounces cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup pernod | ground ginger and garlic paste | 1 tablespoon dried mustard | 1 teaspoon ground dried chipotle chiles
instructions: Peel turnips and cut into wedges or small cubes. Bake in a 400 degree oven until done. Drain. Combine the celery soup with the pernod, ground ginger, garlic paste, mustard and chilies in a large bowl. Add the wedges and turnips. Pour into greased, pre greased 9x5x2 pans. Cover and bake in a preheated oven for 35 minutes.

title: Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 4 tomatoes, cored and chopped | 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
instructions: Place tomatoes, apple cider vinegar and hot water in a blender. Puree until smooth. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yellow lentil,basmati rice,potato,pumpkin puree,green cardamom pod,beef bouillon granule,salsa,vanilla ice cream
title: Mughlai Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb potato, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups yellow lentils ( yellow masoor dal ) or 2 cups red lentils ( yellow masoor dal ) | 2 cups basmati rice | 2 green cardamom pods | 32 fluid ounces good quality pumpkin puree | 4 teaspoons beef bouillon granules or 4 teaspoons salt | 8 fluid ounces salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 8 -10 fluid ounces vanilla ice cream
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan. Pour in enough water to cover the potatoes and bring to boil. Cover and turn down to simmer over medium low heat, but not touching, for about 15 minutes until the potato cubes are just tender. Drain the potatoes, return them to the pan, and add the lentils. Pour the stock into the pan. Add the spices, stir to combine and simmer gently, uncovered, for 35 - 40 minutes until all the liquid has been absorbed. Check and stir about every few minutes to make sure the mixture and lentils are cooking evenly. When the lentils and potato mixture have absorbed enough liquid to make your kabab, you may need to add a little water if the mixture is dry or wet. Add more rice and/or salsa, if necessary. Serve hot, warm or at room temperature, with lots of shredded coconut. To serve cold transfer your kab into a plastic container and freeze. When ready to serve, defrost, but stir or shake in some ice cream and garnish with lots of chopped nuts if desired. This goes well with bread and a glass of cabernet sauvignon.

title: Easy Shredded Beef for Two
ingredients: 4 pounds beef chuck | onion salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Pound stew beef with the flat side of a large, heavy skillet for about 5 minutes. Place in a container with a lid, and coat with the onion salt. Place the lid onto the dish, and cook until heated through and tender. Slice into 1/2 x 1/2 inch cubes, or as desired.

title: Spanish Peas and Peas
ingredients: 1 cup peas ( pods, pods, or frozen pea pods ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil ( more if needed ) | cayenne pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add peas to the pan and turn until golden brown all around, about 8 minutes. Add cayenne pepper and cook about 10 seconds.

title: Dynamite Chili Beans
ingredients: 4 cans chili beans, drained | 1 cup pearl onion | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | glace cherries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Blend all ingredients in an electric blender or food processor until smooth. Pour into a 3 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with remaining glace cherries for a garnish and serve. Cook's note, chili beans can be eaten immediately, but are more likely to turn into a greased, caramelized stew if refrigerated uncovered. Be careful when removing from the oven. It can also be eaten after rinsing it and added to meat.

title: Coconut Kiss
ingredients: 1 bottle italian salad dressing | 1 container flaked coconut extract
instructions: Pour italian dressing into a small bottle with a lid, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Before serving, mix in the coconut extract. Use as a garnish with some fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,ladyfinger,heavy cream,date,elbow macaroni,egg yolk
title: Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni | 2 egg yolks | 3/4 cup finely chopped dates | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh red chile peppers | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Baked Beet Bites
ingredients: 4 large whole boiled beets, peeled ( about a pound ) | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 lb chuck, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven 375°f. Cook the beets in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain, and set aside. Remove the beets from the water and pat dry completely. Turn them over, and, using a slotted spoon with a few holes on the tops, put them in a bowl. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil and toss to coat. Place them on a foil lined baking sheet. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil in a deep, heavy sauté pan over medium heat. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon oil to the hot oil and heat for 30 seconds. Add the beets and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes, then add the ketchup and cook for 2 minutes. Transfer the beets to a large baking dish. Add the chuck, turning to coat. Pour the beet mixture over the beets, and bake for 1 hour, or until the cubes are tender.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,shiitake mushroom,sun tomato oil,chicken bouillon cube,rigatoni pasta,hamburger,kidney bean
title: Chile and Tomato Ragu
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 small onion, chopped | 2 cans sliced shiitake mushrooms ( or any other dark mushroom ) | 1 can kidney beans ( drained ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 package rigatoni pasta
instructions: Brown ground meat, onion, mushrooms and spices in a large frying pan. Pour contents of the cans into a crockpot. Cover and set slow cooker on high for 5 hours. Serve over cooked pasta and garnish with cheese. I like it with pico de gallo and sour cream.

title: Pork Tenderloin with Pepperoncini Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 12 pepperoncini peppers, drained and cut lengthwise in half
instructions: Arrange the tenderloin in a large baking dish, and sprinkle generously with pepperoncini slices. Place the two halves of the tenderloin flat side up on top of the pepperoncini slices. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator overnight, turning the tenderloin once or twice during the marinating process to insure all sides of the tenderloin are coated.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,chicken tender,chili powder,white flour,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheesy Chicken
ingredients: 1 packet chicken tenders | 1/2 cup self raising flour | 3/4 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cut the chicken tenders into strips approximately twice their length. Sift the self raising flour and chili powder into a large bowl. In a non stick frying pan on the stove, melt the butter over a low heat. Add in the grated cheese. Once the cheese has melted, add the chicken tenders. Slightly toss them around to coat in the butter and cheese. Place the chicken tenders into the frying pan, ensuring they don't overcrowd, and cook for about 7 - 10 minutes on each side or until they are cooked through.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,chinese five spice powder,savory,frying oil,olive,feta,tomato ketchup,white vinegar
title: Savory Feta Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup olive, washed, chopped | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 1/3 cup heinz chili sauce or 1/3 cup ketchup | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon dried tomato ketchup | 500 g feta, cubed | pouring oil
instructions: Blend all above ingredients with fingers. Add the cubed feta cheese and toss well. Serve immediately. Note, this recipe can easily be rolled up on a rolling pin and it can also be rolled up and cut into pieces and stored in airtight containers in the fridge. Note, can also be rolled up into balls, and stored in air tight container after defrosting. This creates a great marinading/serving tip for vegetables.

title: Yogurt and Canadian Bacon Wraps (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 15)
ingredients: 125 g ground veal | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons greek natural yoghurt | 60 g canadian bacon, diced | 1/2 cup walnut pieces, finely chopped | 1 cup hot water
instructions: Combine well. Add all other ingredients and mix until the ingredients are combined. Form into rolls and wrap in non aluminium foil. Seal each into a ball and place on a tray covered with lightly oiled cling film. Freeze for 3 hours or until well chilled, serve on toast.

title: Potato, Mushroom and Joram
ingredients: 4 large red potatoes, cleaned well, scrubbed, halved lenghtwise | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried methi seeds | 2 ounces fresh pimento | 1 cup shredded gouda cheese, divided ( about 6/8 oz ) | 24 unpeeled shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add potatoes, return to the boil and cook, partially covered, until tender, 18 - 24 minutes. Transfer potatoes with a slotted spoon to a bowl of cold water and let cool. Dry out the potatoes with a paper towel, then coarsely chop. Add pimentos, 3 tblsps. Of the cheese and the methi seeds. Toss with a spoon until cheese is absorbed. Transfer potato chunks to a bowl and spread evenly on a sheet of hot cheese cloth. Sprinkle over the remaining 1/4 cup cheese and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, until cheese is just firm.

title: Homemade Tortillas
ingredients: 1 lb tortillas | 1 -2 bay leaf
instructions: Heat your pan of oil to hot. In a bowl, mash up small tortillas. Sprinkle some paprika on the tortillas, then put a generous handful of the hot oil into the middle of them in desired shape. Spread 1 - 2 tbs of water around tortilla. Fold the edge over the top, and seal shut. Fry for a minute or 2, then flip over to brown other side and fry a second side until the tortilla is crisp. Serve hot, warm, or cold.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,dill weed,pumpkin puree,corn oil,green chili,vinegar
title: Pumpkin-Flavoured Chutney - a La Diabetics' Delight!!
ingredients: 2 cups pumpkin puree | 1/2 cup vinegar | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon dill weed | 2 -3 finely ground green chili | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a deep pot and bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook till the mixture thickens and will form medium thick puffs on the surface. This has to be done carefully. Turn off the heat and allow the mixture to cool. Once cooled, mix a spoonful of this mixture into equal sized balls of green chutney. Keep in mind, as the pumpkin curd dough contains no other liquid in it. Make them smaller as they will be hard boiled if not mashed. Store in an airtight container and keep for upto 2 weeks at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,rice vinegar,baking potato,scotch bonnet pepper,baking powder,passion fruit,pea
title: Potato Sambol
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, peeled, with the peel on | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp, soaked in | 1 teaspoon boiling water | 2 scotch bonnet peppers, seeded | 1/2 cup sweet peas | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Bring the potato's peel to a boil in boiling water. Drain, then place back in the pot. Smash the potato with a fork.

title: Rabrisse Bolognese
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen precooked meatballs ( about 1 lb ) | 1 leek, sliced thickly ( white and light green part only ) | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place meatballs and leek in a roasting pan. Pour 1 1/2 pints of water into pan. Sprinkle over the mace, cover and bake, stirring occasionally, for 45 minutes. Remove meatballs from the pan and reserve. Pour off the liquid in pan. Return pan to oven uncovered. Roast bolognese for 45 - 50 minutes, until meat is cooked. Allow to rest at room temperature for 15 - 20 minutes. Break meat meat up and serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,heavy cream,beef sirloin steak,white flour,peanut oil,pimento olive
title: Adobo-Free Beef Strips (Cuban Style)
ingredients: 1 pound boneless beef top sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1/2 cup pepsi or other salad dressing, divided | 1/4 cup heavy cream, divided | 2 tablespoons chopped pimento stuffed olives, to taste | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: Toss together the meat with 2 tablespoons of the dressing. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Heat a skillet to medium high, and add the remaining dressing to the skillet. When the oil is hot, add the beef. Cook and stir until no longer pink. Remove from the skillet, and set aside. Heat the skillet to high, and add the olives. Cook and stir until they are just beginning to brown, and then add the beef strips back to the skillet. Reduce the heat, and pour in 1/2 cup of the cream and stir well. Continue to stir, and add the remaining cream. Bring to a boil, then cover, and reduce the heat to medium. Simmer for 30 minutes, or until everything is hot.

title: Faux Italian Sausages-Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausage, casings removed | 2 tablespoons red fresh dill, chopped, packed | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. In a large ovenproof skillet, cook the sausage over medium heat for 5 minutes, or until evenly browned on both sides. Transfer to a plate. Drain the sausage well, reserving the drippings. Return the drippings to the skillet. Reheat the skillet over medium high heat. Add the dill and white pepper and cook 3 to 4 minutes, or until heated through, stirring. Spread sausage on top of the sausage.

title: Chinese Style Vegetable Juice
ingredients: 1 cup boiling water | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1/2 cup ice water | 1/2 cup chopped turnip | 1/2 cup chopped carrot | 1/4 teaspoon instant coffee | 1/4 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Pour the boiling water into a large glass or ceramic mixing bowl and add the instant coffee and water. Add the carrot and turnip and stir. Cover and microwave on high power for 2 minutes. Stir and let stand for 2 minutes more. Stir and microwave for 1 minute more. Stir in the oyster sauce and serve.

Random Ingredients: harissa,chili pepper flake,bicarbonate soda,tamarind paste,radish,chicken stock cube,beef sirloin
title: Lebanese Beef Satay
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin, cut into strips | 2 tablespoons harissa | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 chicken stock cubes | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 3 ounces trimmings from canned chick-peas, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons sliced radishes
instructions: For the satay marinade, combine tomato puree, chilli powder, stock cubes, harissa, soda and stock. Mix well. Place the meat in the marinade and toss to coat. Leave overnight in the fridge. For the sauce, combine all ingredients and stir until dissolved. Remove all of the meat and reserve for later. Thread the meat strips onto skewers leaving a 1/4 inch slice on each end. Put the meat strips on a well oiled rack and brush with remaining marinade. Set the barbecue on medium high heat and grill meat until cooked to your preferred texture. Serve on a bed of rice with a sprinkling of chopped radishes to be alongside.

title: Sausage in Fajitas
ingredients: 8 ounces prepared sausages | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 16 corn tortillas, cut into 6 inch pieces
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. In skillet, cook sausages about 15 minutes or until done.

title: Pumpkin Seeds With Brandy
ingredients: 1 lb raw pumpkin seeds | 1/2 cup raw cashew nuts or 1/2 cup raw pecan nuts | 1 1/2 cups fresh spinach ( or other greens ) | 3 tablespoons brandy ( i sub honey ) or 3 tablespoons sherry wine ( i sub honey )
instructions: Grind pumpkin seeds to a powder. Combine ground spices and greens in a large bowl set over a pot of boiling water, stirring regularly until it leaves the sides of the bowl. While greens wilted, melt the brandy over low heat and blend in the nuts until thoroughly coated. Immediately add the brandy to the greens and mix well. Place greens in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour and up to 24 hours. When ready to serve, toss well and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,sherry,bacon,bouillon cube,cauliflower floret,extra virgin olive oil
title: Rice Noodles With Cauliflower
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked rice noodles | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 4 slices thick cut bacon, chopped | 2 teaspoons bouillon cubes | 4 cups cauliflower florets, broken apart ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup dry sherry
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to boil in large pot. Cook rice noodles in boiling water until tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, heat oil in large nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Add bacon.

title: Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup pine nuts | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried thyme, crushed
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a food processor, and process until it is a rough paste. If necessary, keep stirring so it doesn't stick to the bottom. Let stand one hour before serving, to allow the flavors to mix.

title: Spicy Nuts
ingredients: 1 small star fruit | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Put the star fruit and chili in a small frying pan over a medium heat. Scrape the bits from the bottom and bits of starfruit into another small frying pan, if necessary.

title: Quick Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 2 cans diced tomatoes with juice | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Unroll phyllo dough on baking sheet and cut into 24 squares. Spread with diced tomatoes and kidney beans. Roll up each square and place on the center of the baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until phyllo is puffed and golden brown, 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Fenugreek Peach Tempes
ingredients: 1 cup diced peach ( fresh or canned ) | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced celery | 1/3 cup dry mustard seeds | 1/4 cup fenugreek | seasoning salt | crushed cayenne pepper | 1 package tempeh
instructions: Brown tempeh in a large skillet, then crumble when cooked. While tempeh is browning, combine all of the ingredients in a bowl. Add the mixture to the skillet and stir. Saute about 5 minutes until the mixture begins to thicken and vegetables are tender. Serve topped with additional mustard and cayenne pepper. If desired, you may serve with pita pockets.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt pepper,yellow pepper,white wine vinegar,new potato,tomato,brown rice
title: Spanish Potato and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 2 large red potatoes, about 1 1/2 pounds, peeled, halved lengthwide and sliced 1/8 inch thick ( about 1 lb. ) | 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1 medium yellow pepper, chopped ( about 1/8 cup ) | 8 medium tomatoes, skinned, seeded, and coarsely chopped | kosher salt and pepper | cooked brown rice, for serving
instructions: Arrange potatoes in 3 - 4 quart microwave safe casserole. Microwave on high, uncovered, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir potatoes and vinegar in medium bowl. Microwave on high 30 seconds. Stir in chile, tomatoes and salt and pepper, and warm over medium heat. Cover.

Random Ingredients: mustard,littleneck clam,monterey jack cheese,sirloin tip roast,spaghetti,celery,red chilies
title: Linguica Con Sirloin
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast | 2 stalks celery, cut into 1-in. chunks | 2 large red chilies, chopped | 2 cans littleneck clams, drained and chopped | 8 ounces spaghetti, broken into thirds | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 package shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350º f. Place the roast in a large roasting pan and bake for 2 hours. Combine the celery, chiles, and littlensters in a skillet.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,chili oil,broth,curd cottage cheese,beef brisket
title: Cashew Beef and Corn With Corn Soup
ingredients: 2 corned beef brisket | 1/2 cup thickened curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup unshelled cashew nuts | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1 cup hot stock or 1 cup broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Cut brisket across the grain into six even pieces and arrange pieces in a small roasting pan or large casserole. Combine cottage cheese, nuts and chili oil. Spread on top and sprinkle evenly with beef mixture. Transfer to oven and roast uncovered, basting periodically, until beef is very tender and the cashew mixture is brown and crunchy and beef is dark brown in color, about 2 1/2 hours. Remove beef and any accumulated juices from roasting pan and skim off any fat from pan juices.. Discard fat and season with salt and pepper. Serve with sliced corned beef and boiled new potatoes or baby carrots.

title: Polish Kielbasa and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 1 package frozen cherry rolls | 1/4 cup lemonade concentrate | 1 cup quinoa
instructions: Boil kielbasa and drain. Add cherry rolls and lemonade. Simmer 10 mins or until kielbasa is cooked through. Serve over quinoa. Variation,. Add more cherry rolls, lemonade concentrate and/or preserves to kielbasa mix. Add sauteed mushrooms, or green onions, as desired.

title: Spinach and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Put spinach and rice in a saucepan. Cover with water and bring to boil over high heat. Turn down heat and simmer, covered, until the rice is tender and the water is absorbed meanwhile, break the bundle of air from the spinach. Put the spinach and rice into a serving bowl and set aside. Drain the spinach well and add the hot water, chili powder, if using, and cover. Let sit for 5 minutes.

title: Sweet Corn Chilli (Noklode, Namul)
ingredients: 500 g sweetcorn ( i normally use fresh in the tin which is usually sold as it has never had any moisture outside ) | 1 1/2 dashes advieh mixed spice ( i normally use 3-4 teaspoons of spike and 1 1/2 tsp of nahve ) ( optional ) | 2 -4 drops sweet asian chili sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cut the corn in pieces, so the kernels are about half an inch long, but not too small. Poke several holes in the corn. If the corn sticks, tie it by holding the corn with kitchen twine and make a slit. This will make it easier to remove with your knife when removing the kernels from the cob. Add corn and 3 3/4 tsp each of advieh and optional sweetener to the corn. Toss well. Leave it in the fridge for 30 minutes to soften up slightly. If using the chilli sauce make sure you don't miss any seasoning after it's had been sitting for about 20 mins so it will soften up some.

Random Ingredients: olive,topping,strawberry,chocolate pudding mix,vegetarian beef,cannellini bean,ear corn cob
title: Strawberry and Bean Casserole with Nacho Dip
ingredients: 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 packet instant chocolate pudding mix, powder ( optional ) | 6 ears corn on the cob ( fresh or frozen, thawed ) | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can crushed ripe olives | 1 package frozen strawberries ( thawed ) | 2 -4 medium fresh strawberries ( chopped )
instructions: Place thawed sweetened whipped topping on an 11x7 inch pan, spreading evenly to cover and chill. Filling, place frozen corn cob in the bottom of one of the prepared casseroles. Top with other two ingredients, following with a third of the chopped strawberries. Repeat with the second half of the filling and last third of the filling. Top with remaining chopped strawberries and remaining 1/4 cup of prepared whipped topping. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,caster sugar,taco seasoning mix,fillet,red raspberry jam,tomatillo
title: Taco Grill Freckled Fish
ingredients: 4 fish fillets | 1 packet soft taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon red raspberry jam | 1/2 cup fresh tomatillo, chopped | 300 g wild rice
instructions: Preheat grill to high/low / set the grill to high. Place the fish on a shallow, greased baking sheet & coat with taco seasoning. Brush the fillets with the jam & sprinkle with sugar. Cook fish for 4 - 5 minutes each side or until fish is cooked to your liking. Meanwhile heat a large pot of water with sugar & remove from heat. Add wild rice and cook for 5 minutes or until tender, then transfer to a serving bowl. Place the fish on top & spoon sauce over. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,salt black pepper,paprika,parsnip,french bread,garlic oil,garlic paste
title: Southern Garlic Soup
ingredients: 6 cloves garlic oil, or more as needed, divided | 2 pounds parsnips - peeled, halved, and thinly sliced | 2 large scotch bonnet peppers, stemmed and coarsely chopped, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons scotch bonnet pepper, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon paprika | salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 inch cubes, or as desired
instructions: Heat 2 garlic cloves and Scotch bonnet pepper in 2 to 3 cups of water in a large pot over medium heat until a drop of water sizzles from the tip of a sharp knife sprinkled onto the surface of the top just bubbles. Add minced parsnips, and simmer until fork tender and bright green, 5 to 8 minutes. Stir smoked paprika into the soup, about 2 tablespoons for every serving.

title: Zucchini and Zucchini Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini, trimmed and very thinly sliced | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon all purpose italian seasoning
instructions: Coat a 5 quart pressure cooker w/cooking spray.

title: Frozen Crabmeat
ingredients: 2 cans crabmeat | 2 cans diced green beans
instructions: Put all of the ingredients in a large freezer bag and freeze. After about 1 hour, make sure there are no pieces frozen in the bag. Throw the bag out, put it back in the freezer, and return it to the freezer overnight. The following day, remove the bag, and throw it back in the freezer. Keep it in the freezer until it is thawed, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,onion soup mix,sesame oil,greek yogurt,vegetable shortening,banana
title: Lazy Hot Banana Patties
ingredients: 2 slices sliced bananas, very ripe | 2 tablespoons minced onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil | 1 tablespoon whipping cream | 1 tablespoon greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon vegetable shortening
instructions: In a large serving bowl, beat together banana slices and onion soup mix. Spread the sesame oil over the bananas. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 hours. Serve over flour bread, or crackers. For cheese, melt shortening in a small saucepan. Stir in the cream and yogurt. Set aside to cool, then add cheese, stir until well blended.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,onion flake,beef broth,ginger garlic paste,orange zest,bell pepper,beef liver,sunflower oil
title: Beef Liver With Bell Peppers and Onions
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef liver | 1 1/2 lbs bell peppers ( red, yellow ) | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1/4 cup low sodium beef broth
instructions: Trim and halve bell peppers. Tie with kitchen string or kitchen twine. Cut into 1/2 inch pieces, or until no more blood seeps out. Cut bell peppers into quarters. Heat oil in 6 quart pot over medium high, then fry liver until browned. Remove liver from pot. Add onions, ginger garlic paste, dried onion, chile pepper, orange zest, and beef broth and stir. Add bell peppers and onions. Cook over high heat, stirring once or twice, until peppers and onions are tender. Boil down mixture until syrupy, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chili,white sugar,stilton cheese,mace,kiwi,bacon,anchovy fillet,canola oil
title: Welsh Kiwi Poached Spinach
ingredients: 6 kiwi, chopped | 60 ml canola oil | 120 g streaky bacon, chopped | 1 small green chili, chopped | 8 anchovy fillets, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 150 g stilton cheese, crumbled | 1 pinch white sugar
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 180c. Heat the oil in a small frying pan, fry the kiwi until they turn a light golden color. Remove from the pan and place under a foil to keep warm. Heat the bacon and chilies in the same frying pan over a medium heat and add the anchovies.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,brie cheese,mango chutney,beer,taco shell,bean sprout,malt vinegar,mace
title: Tunnibolas Tacos
ingredients: 1 package taco shells | 2 packages brie cheese | 1 package mango chutney | 1 package beer | 1 package papertowels, cookies | 1 jar pimiento | 1 can refried beans with sprouts | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Pour beer into the bottom of a 13 x 9 baking dish. Smooth cheese evenly over beer and beer. Mix papertels, pimento, bean sprouts, and mace together in a small bowl until well blended.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,apple juice,vanilla essence,tart apple,red wine vinegar
title: Apple Penne Salad With Temptation of Australian Apple
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 6 cooked tart apples | 3 tablespoons apple juice | 1 lb penne pasta
instructions: Put the vinegar, vanilla and apple juice into a small pan, melt over a moderate heat and allow the liquid to thicken slightly. Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling water until aldente. Drain and toss immediately with the apple/aubergine mixture. Season and toss again before serving.

title: Quick Oriental Linguine
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine ( or spaghetti or chunky pasta ) | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Start boiling water for pasta. While water is coming to the boil, heat soya, flour and fry up the bread in 1 tbs butter add to soya and stir. When pasta is cooked, drain and add to soya flour mixture. Serve when pasta is heated.

title: Simple and Easy Sweet Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 ripe mango, peeled and diced | 3 whole cardamom seeds | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled and sliced into thin matchsticks
instructions: Place the mango, cardamom seed, and ginger into a pot over high heat. Allow to cook until the mango is warmed through and beginning to turn brown, about 5 to 10 minutes. Turn off the heat, and allow to cool. Transfer to a blender, and blend until the mango and cardamom seeds form a smooth paste. Store in an air tight container in the refrigerator.

title: Prawn and Broccoli in Tomato-Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, trimmed and cut into 5cm lengths | 1 bunch bok choy, trimmed and cut into 5cm lengths | 1 small red onion, chopped | 300 g shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 cardamom pod | 150 g cauliflower, halved and cut into rough 1cm florets | 3 tablespoons grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Steam Broccoli and bok choy until just tender. Meanwhile, heat a little oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Swirl oil around the pan, swirling to coat the base and sides. Stir fry the onion for 1 minute, then add the prawns and stir fry for a further 1 minute. Add the chipotle sauce and 1/2 cup of water and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Stir in the cauliflower until just tender. Stir in the pecorino and serve with prawns and/or boiled or steamed rice.

title: Mango Chayote Salad
ingredients: 2 chayotes, cored and cut into chunks | 2 large mangoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 can sweetened cannellini beans, drained | 1 jar mandarin-style diced tomatoes | 3 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | 1/4 cup lemonade
instructions: Toss together the chayote, mangoes, cannellini beans, mandarin style diced tomatoes, mustard seed and lemonade in a large bowl. Chill in refrigerator at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,chunky peanut butter,onion salt,anaheim chilies,gingerroot,scotch bonnet pepper,white miso,club soda
title: Mexican Peanut Butter Dip (Copycat)
ingredients: 20 ounces white miso | 2 large onions, peeled and diced | 2 cans chunky salsa ( medium, hot or mild ) | 1 tablespoon finely minced gingerroot | 3 large anaheim chilies, peeled and seeded | 1 tablespoon club soda | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons chopped scotch bonnet peppers
instructions: In a large bowl mash the onions and chilies together with a potato masher or fork. Add in the salsa. Stir to combine. Add in the ginger, club soda and chunky salsa. Stir all to combine. Add in the scotch bonnet peppers and remove from heat. Cover and chill thoroughly in the refrigerator.

title: Clams on the Run
ingredients: 2 lbs clams | 1 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Wash clams thoroughly under cold running water. Run each clams through a sieve or with scissors until all of the sand has run out. Remove any that don't close to the shell, then place in a casserole dish. Bring the clams to the boil in their shells, then pour on the brown sugar. Cover with a lid and cook for 2 hours at 350°f stirring gently once or twice. Check for seasoning and serve in warmed sterilized jars.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed,beef broth,walnut oil,orange zest,turmeric,bread,lemon juice zest
title: Beef Broth W- Sunflower Seeds and Walnuts
ingredients: 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1 orange, zest of, grated | 2 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 1 cup walnut oil | 1 1/2 cups homemade beef stock or 1 1/2 cups low sodium beef broth | finely ground bread, for serving
instructions: Combine the lemon juice, zest, turmeric and ground meat in a bowl and mix well with your hands. Shape into 4 1/2 to 5 balls and place on an aluminum foil lined baking sheet. Combine the worcestershire sauce and broth and pour over meatballs. Cover and chill for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f place the walnuts on baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, until lightly browned. Remove from oven and sprinkle with ground walnuts. Allow to settle for 10 minutes, then transfer to serving bowls or scatter with toasted bread to serve.

Random Ingredients: crisco,kosher salt,lasagna noodle,garlic paste,tomato puree,dijon mustard
title: Simple Garlic Cracker Lasagna
ingredients: 25 uncooked lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 tablespoons garlic paste | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon crisco
instructions: Spray a 12 x 9 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, place the lasagna noodles in a large bowl. Cover with ice water. Soak until softened, about 5 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl. Repeat with the garlic paste, salt, tomato puree, mustijon mustard and crisco. Stir until well blended.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,horseradish,currant,pork shoulder blade roast,cranberry,lime wedge
title: Carnival Pork with Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder blade roast, trimmed | 6 slices horseradish | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 4 tablespoons dry currants | 1 tablespoon minced fresh lime juice
instructions: Place pork shoulder in shallow dish. Sprinkle with horseradish. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes, turning once. Drain off liquid. Preheat oven to 325°f brush pork with tomato sauce and place on rack in roasting pan. Roast 35 to 40 minutes until well browned, basting once. Remove from oven and cover with foil. Return to oven. Bake about 25 to 30 minutes. Remove plastic wrap from top and brush pork with remaining sauce. Place pine nuts and currants in small food processor. Cover and process until finely ground. Stir in lime juice. Slice pork crosswise into thin strips.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,celery rib,za'atar spice mix,pesto sauce,serrano pepper,poppy seed
title: Roasted Beef and Pesto(Algerian Bisteeya)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round roast ( a chuck roast would work in a pinch ) | 1 -2 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 3/4 teaspoon khaliji za'atar spice mix | 6 serrano peppers | 1 celery rib, sliced thinly
instructions: Cut each roast of the same size using a heavy knife or cleaver. Rinse well and pat dry. Place the meat in a large glass casserole dish or roaster. Pour the jar of pesto over the meat. Cover tightly and marinate in the refrigerator overnight if desired. When ready to cook, remove the meat from the marinade and dry the meat on paper towels. If you like your cheese well done, remove the meat from the refrigerator 1 hour before cooking. Heat oven to 375°f. Place a roasting rack or a baking pan in the lower third of the oven. Roast for about 1 hour. Turn the oven off and let sit for about 25 minutes. Remove the roast and set aside in a large bowl. Add the za'atar to the meat and toss well with the meat. Taste and adjust seasoning, spoon sauce over meat and serve.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,shiitake mushroom,cream chicken soup,pecan,icing sugar,peanut butter,beef broth
title: Aunt Alma's Easy Beef and  Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 3/8 cup low sodium beef broth or 3/8 cup beef consomme, undiluted | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 1 - 1 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup dried shiitake mushroom ( optional ) | 1 cup pecans, toasted and finely ground ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine soup, broth, icing sugar and peanut butter in a medium bowl.

title: Fish Cooked in White Sauce
ingredients: 2 pounds white fish fillets, cut into portions | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Season both sides of fish with salt and pepper. Arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven, turning once, until fish are easily flaked with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,oregano leaf,walnut oil,white pepper,white bread,chickpea,white zinfandel wine,pickle
title: Zinfandel-Ribollita
ingredients: 6 tablespoons walnut oil, divided | 1 cup chopped white zinfandel wine, such as beaujolais-style ( or white burgundy ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 3 cans chickpeas, drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 6 slices white zinfandel ( for garnish ) | 6 bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( for bread )
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a heavy small skillet over moderate heat. Add the zinfandel, oregano, pepper and chickpeas and brown over moderately high heat and stirring often, until warmed through, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the remaining tablespoon of oil in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over moderate heat. Add the bread and cook over moderately high heat until lightly golden brown on both sides, about 2 minutes. Transfer the toasts to a work surface and sprinkle lightly with salt.

title: Pumpkin Stacks
ingredients: 3 cups canned tomato sauce | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup parmesan cheese | 3 tablespoons pumpkin seeds
