instructions: Heat tomato sauce in a saucepan, over medium heat. Cook until warmed through, do not boil. Spread 1/2 cup of cheese in the bottom of a 9x9 inch baking dish. Spread 1/3 cup of tomato sauce into a 2. 5 inch patty like patty. Top with 2nd patty and sprinkle with 3 tblsps. Of pumpkin seeds. Repeat with remaining patty, tomato sauce, and stuffing. Top with remaining cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pepper,tarragon,cream chicken soup,rotel,fennel bulb,green onion,italian plum tomato
title: Italian Plum Spaghetti
ingredients: 6 -8 italian plum tomatoes, diced | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can rotel | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 2 tablespoons chopped green onions | 1 pinch ground fennel bulb | 1 pinch ground pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Cook spaghetti in a saucepot until desired doneness.

title: Jicama Chips
ingredients: 500 g jicama, slices with peel | 1/4 cup sugar cubes, crushed ( to taste )
instructions: To peel jicama, cut off peel with a melon baller. Place on a plate and sprinkle sugar. Microwave for 5 minutes on high setting.

title: Spiced Swiss-Style Beet and Pineapple Bake
ingredients: 4 large beets, trimmed and halved | 4 tablespoons dry red wine | 5 tablespoons orange marjoram, pulp | 1 cup arborio rice ( arborio ) | 1 cup red wine | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup grand marnier, plus | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Lightly oil a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Pierce the beets with a toothpick, or poke a few holes in them with a paring knife. Sprinkle the cut sides with the marjoram, then cover with red wine. Place in the refrigerator to marinate. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring marinade, pineapple juice, and grand marnier to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add beets and return to a boil. Bake in the preheated oven for about 1 hour, until tender and sauce thickened. Remove from heat and let stand for 10 minutes. Place in a food processor and pulse until smooth. Serve with warm sauce.

title: Red and White Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 small red onion, roughly chopped | 1 bunch shallot, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon of chopped lemongrass | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 tablespoon dried passion fruit, chopped fresh
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and process until a smooth paste forms. Soup the curry paste with any curry paste ingredients if you fancy, or with food processor, and transfer to a large heavy bottomed pan with a lid so that the paste doesn't form a film over the top. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat. Simmer gently for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, and adding more water as needed. Pour over your chosen veg after steaming.

title: Vegetarian Tomato Triangles With Phyllo and Fresh Fruit.
ingredients: 24 sheets phyllo pastry | 6 plum tomatoes, cut in half | 1/2 cup vegan fruit-flavoured yogurt ( to thin this if you're using plain yogurt ) | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast ( to sprinkle on top at the table )
instructions: Boil the tomato halves until just soft. Set aside and drain. Place the phyllo pastry sheet on the clean work surface, on one side. Spread two tablespoons of yogurt on the top of one sheet of phyllo, and sprinkle it with nutritional yeast, to taste. Place 2 tablespoons of tomatoes cut side up onto the yogurt, and put back on phyllo with a spoon so it's covered,. Roll the sheets and repeat. Cut into half while the phyllo is still wet to prevent drying. Sprinkle more nutritional yeast on top if desired, and serve.

title: Homemade Masala Bread for Breakfast
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs bread, dry | 1 can tomato juice, canned ( i use muir glen organic ) | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder or 1 tablespoon rosemary | 1 can fat-free half-and-half
instructions: In a loaf pan lay out the bread. In a blender add tomatoes, turmeric and half and half mix till smooth. Add enough masala paste to cover the bread. Allow to marinate for at least 1/2 hour. Wrap bread in foil. In a 300 degree oven bake for 1 hour till bread is crusty.

title: Gnocchi II
ingredients: 600 g gnocchi ( about 12 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg, freshly grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c line a baking tray lightly with baking paper. Cook the gnocchi in boiling water for 3 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water and drain again. In a large bowl, combine the gnocchi and oregano. Sprinkle with the nutmeg and mix thoroughly. Put into baking tray lined with baking paper and bake for 15 minutes, until golden and heated through.

title: Spinach & Carrots Au Gratin
ingredients: 16 ounces french bread | 1 package baby carrots | 8 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1 1/2 cups sweet & sour sauce | 1/2 cup margarine, cut into pieces | 2 teaspoons hot sauce, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Place bread slices on a cookie sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Top each piece with baby carrots, leaving 1/2 inch around the edges. Bake for 3 minutes. Remove from the oven and brush with margarine to make the crust lightly brown, about 2 minutes. Put spinach in a colander& press with a spoon to get out excess liquid. Set aside. Arrange the spinach on a plate, sprinkle with the sweet& sour sauce& hotsauce& drizzle with margarine to finish.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,lemon juice,red chili pepper flake,wheat bread crumb,lentil,bay leaf,tomato,zucchini
title: Lentils and Zucchini Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lentils | 1/3 cup dry whole wheat bread crumbs | 1 small zucchini | 1 spanish onion | 1 large tomatoes, chopped | 2 teaspoons red chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Pour boiling water over lentils in a medium pot. Stir until water is cloudy, cover and set aside for 1 hour. Meanwhile, place bread crumbs in a food processor and process to form a fine breadcrumb consistency. Trim zucchini and dice into 1 inch pieces. Trim onion and chop into 1 inch pieces. Coarsely chop tomato and add. Cut chili flakes in half and add to lentils. Add remaining ingredients and mix well just before serving. Serve on warm bread.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,salt,broccoli rabe,golden raisin,gruyere cheese,ginger,heavy cream
title: Broccoli Rabe Gratin
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 12 ounces broccoli rabe, trimmed and cut in half if thinner than 1 1/2-inch | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. In heavy 1 cup microwave safe bowl, combine cream, ginger and salt.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,rice vinegar,cashew,phyllo pastry,green onion,cocoa,cannellini bean,lime juice
title: Costa Rican Baked Bean and Rice Pie
ingredients: 12 frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup finely chopped green onion | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup chopped and toasted cashews | 1/4 cup chopped sweet bell pepper, any color
instructions: Preheat over to 375º and spray a 15 x 10 inch baking pan with nonstick spray. Unroll each phyllo pastry sheet, place seam side down in prepared pan. Repeat with another 1 sheet, spraying each with more spray. Spoon drained beans evenly into pastry sheets. Combine remaining ingredients in a container and toss in the cashews. Spoon evenly over beans. Bake about 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Gelatin Potatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs yukon gold potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 sweet purple onion, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 2 1/2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place potatoes and onions in a large bowl. Combine the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Spoon the mixture into a greased jelly roll pan. Cover and bake for 45 - 50 minutes, until potatoes are tender and golden.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,pecan,pineapple juice,belgian endive,harissa,center pork chop,butter
title: Grilled Pork Chops With Harissa-Caramelized Endives
ingredients: 8 large center-cut pork chops, about 2 1/2 inches thick | 1/2 cup freshly made harissa | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, sliced in 4 pieces | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 1 belgian endive, cleaned and thick green parts split in half lengthwise | 1 tablespoon harissa | 3/4 cup pecan pieces
instructions: Preheat your grill to high. Lightly oil the grates of your grill. Slice the ribs into very thin slices and place on the grill. Cook them until well browned, the internal temp of the meat reaches 155°f remove the pork chops from the grill and place on a platter. Keep the grill warm. Remove the butter pieces from the pan and melt them in the pan. Add the harissa in a slow stream, stirring constantly, until the mixture has slightly thickened. Add the pork and turn over, cooking each side until well browned on the outside. Spread the finished chops with the harissa sauce, garnish with the toasted pecan quarters, and serve.

title: Ganache Powder
ingredients: 12 ounces unsweetened chocolate squares, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Heat chocolate over medium low heat for 2 minutes and then stir in brown sugar and fennel seeds. Stir until the sugar has completely melted. Pour into an airtight container, and store in the freezer until needed.

Random Ingredients: plum,grenadine,vanilla,pigeon pea,green onion,kaffir lime leaf,taco chip
title: Tikka Plaka
ingredients: 2 bunches green onions, including tender green tops cut on half | 20 kaffir lime leaves ( fresh lime only ) | 20 plums, halved pitted and peeled | 3/4 cup canned pigeon peas, drained | 2 tablespoons light grenadine | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cup crushed taco chip, for topping
instructions: Place the onions in a microwave safe bowl and sprinkle with lime leaves and kaffir lime leaves. Cover and microwave, uncovered, on high for 2 minutes or until the onions are slightly tender, then stir to coat. Microwave on high for 3 more minutes or until slightly tender. Mash the plum with the grenadine and vanilla in a bowl and stir to combine. Spread about 1 to 2 tablespoons of the plum mixture onto the taco chips. Place the plaka on a plate and top with the remaining plum mixture.

title: Spicy Buffalo Mozzarella Applesauce
ingredients: 24 ounces blue curacao | 4 ounces unsweetened applesauce ( apple brand preferred ) | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules, dissolved | 1 lb sliced fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Heat the broiler and then prepare a 9x13 baking dish with oil spray. Pour apple sauce over the cheese. In a mixing bowl, mix cheese with bouillon until it becomes thick and creamy. Pour half of cheese mixture over the cheese. Pour remaining cheese mixture over cheese, then spread evenly. Put in the oven and broil until golden brown, and hot.

title: Quinoa and Barley With Sun Dried Tomatoes and Pearl Barley
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 3/4 cup mixed salad green ( i use greens with red onion ) | 1/4 cup mirin | salad greens, to serve
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in just enough water to remove most of the sand from the quinoa and let it drain in a large bowl. Dry the tomatoes, if using them, and place them in the salad bowl. If you like your salad with some extra crunch, drain the barley before serving.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,plain flour,peanut butter,lamb,chicken soup,taco seasoning,onion,rye bread
title: Sue's Gyros

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jug and whisk well until they are incorporated into a smooth paste. Place a slice of bread on a heat proof plate. Place a spoonful of the mixture onto the bread then sandwich until it has a ball shape. Roll the bread around the meat to coat. Serve on a tray or serve in a warmed pita with dips or soy sauce.

title: Chipotle Beef Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 chipotle chile ( optional ) | 1 cup small cauliflower floret | 1 cup club soda ( optional )
instructions: Combine cornflour and rice wine in bowl. Add beef. Add chipotle chilli, florets, and 1/4 cup club soda if using, if using. Mixture will look lumpy. Let stand 5 minutes. Divide mixture between serving plates.

title: Scotch Spaghetti and Bananas

instructions: Combine creole seasoning and warm water. Set aside. Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil for the linguine. Immediately toss the linguines into the warm creole sauce and toss to coat. Remove the pancake mix from the heat and set aside for now. In large bowl, toss the bananas with 1/4 cup of the reserved pasta water. Sprinkle the anchovy paste over the banana mix and marinate for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in the cream just until reheated. Drain the linguines, reserving 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid. Divide and spread 1/4 cup of the reserved pancake mix inside the bean sauce. Top with 1/4 of the linguines and the remaining beans. Repeat with the rest of the reserved sauce and reserved bean mix. Top with chocolate shavings. Serve in bowls.

title: Fettuccine W-Thai Shredded Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 lb fettuccine pasta | 3/4 cup shredded dark soy sauce | 1 bunch fresh cilantro stems | 6 ounces bread, sliced into small cubes
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions.

title: Fruity Vegetable and Artichoke Soup
ingredients: 4 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into quarters | 1 1/2 cups chestnut puree | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and halved | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts | 3 tablespoons dried fenugreek leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 32 fluid ounces water | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Place onions in a small to medium sized saucepan and cook over medium heat, covered, stirring frequently, until golden, about 10 minutes. Increase heat to medium and add potato slices along with chestnut puree and artichokes.

title: Sweet and Sour Salmon With Ginger Beer
ingredients: 6 salmon fillets, 3/4 pound each ( skin on ) | crushed ice cube, for ice cubes | 3 slices turkish bread | 3 cups grapes | 1 tablespoon pickled ginger ale | 1 teaspoon bottled chili oil | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Arrange salmon fillets in single layer on a tray and sprinkle with salt on both sides. Allow excess salt to drip off. Place in freezer for 30 minutes. Top each round with about 2 tablespoons ginger beer from an ounce can, grapes, and a few rounds of bread to serve. To serve, place one salmon fillet on top of each of the plates and spoon the remaining ginger beer on top. Serve immediately.

title: Smoky Hot Chocolate Dip
ingredients: 1 medium caramels, peeled, broken into pieces | 1 teaspoon pure chipotle chile, finely diced | 9 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Line the bottom and sides of a 4 sided sheet pan with caramels, breaking in pieces, if not using immediately. Stir chipotle into the caramel and place in oven on the middle rack. Roast until the caramels turn a pale golden colour and caramelize slightly, stirring once or twice. Take pan out of oven and place on a large plate. Sprinkle with shredded sharp cheddar and return to oven for several minutes. Serve dip or dip.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,cheddar cheese,molasses,cooking spray,korean red pepper paste,green cardamom pod,crab meat

instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place cookie sheet with parchment paper on work surface. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. title: Cheesy White Beans and Marsala
ingredients: 1 can baked beans | 1/2 cup mirin | 3 tablespoons dry marsala wine | shredded cheddar cheese or mexican cheese
instructions: Heat the beans and mirin in a small saucepan until just beginning to simmer. When it's about to boil, add the cheese and stir well. Heat until just melted. Drain the beans, reserving the liquid. Put them back in the saucepan and add the wine. Stirring well to coat the bottom of the skillet. Remove from the heat, stir in the beans, cover and leave in a warm room. Serve at once. The temperature is probably around 200 degrees.

title: Homemade French Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 8 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 1/2 cups water
instructions: Mix together in your mortal and pestle or blender. Serve on day 2 of fermentation cycle.

title: Broccoli Pizza With Vodka and Basil
ingredients: 10 ounces pizza crust | 1 can broccoli florets, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1/2 cup light vodka | 1/2 cup cola flavored vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/3 cup chopped fresh basil leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spray pizza pan or cookie sheet with cooking spray. Press broccoli florets, coriander seeds, and hot vegetable oil into dough. title: Garlic & Sun-Dried Tomato Mac and Cheese With Macaroni

instructions: Place macaroni, sun dried tomatoes, garlic and currants in lightly oiled, non stick cooking pan with a lid, over medium high heat and stir often with a large metal spoon for 8 - 10 minutes or until the macaroni becomes golden brown and tender. Serve with a green salad.

ingredients: 3/4 lb button mushrooms | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/3 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cook mushrooms in water to cover over very low heat, uncovered, until they are mushy but still mostly liquid. Drain all. Mix in drained mushrooms and raisins. Cover over low heat, stirring often. Heat through on high stirring occasionally. Remove from heat, stir in yogurt and cardamom. Spoon into a serving bowl, sprinkle with nuts.

title: Taco Cookies
ingredients: 36 pitted prunes | corn oil | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning
instructions: Open the jar of prunes. Slice off the top of each docusse at the prunes so that the pulp can drain as you go. Then scoop out the pits so that you can remove most of the pit. You should get 12 - 8 prunes depending on size. You should end up with 12 - 10 pit ones depending on size of jar. Fill the jar with oil. It is important that it is extremely cold. If this is the case the oil is too hot it will harden and crackle. It usually does. If you scoop out the pit you will make 8 small balls. Place them on a flat tray and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. After you have removed the pit, take a dozen or so balls from the fridge. Dip each ball in corn oil and then roll them in the taco seasoning. Put them on a baking paper or parchment paper and refrigerate. These are very hot and can be frozen.

title: Easy Beef Roast

instructions: Trim excess fat from steak and place in plastic bag. Sprinkle with thyme, and salt. Pour vinegar over, coating the meat. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

instructions: Bring the broth to a boil over medium high heat.

instructions: Soaking the ginger and lemon peel in a coffee grinder or food processor for about 10 seconds on a high setting makes the coffee powder a little darker by leaving the coffee powder in a little ziplock bag. Mix all ingredients.

title: Moose & Kiwi Meatballs on Spicy Tomato-Lentils
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried brown lentils | 1 can meatballs or ( 400 g ) can pineapple-cooked lentils | 1 can spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar or 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute | 1 tablespoon grated mace or 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled & thinly sliced
instructions: Place lentils in sauce pan with enough salted water to cover.

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. Wash prunes and remove stem ends. Wrap each prune, overlapping slightly, in a thick slice. Remove from oven and sprinkle top with shredded coconut as desired.

title: Penne Pasta Sauce

instructions: Bring cream to a boil in medium saucepan over medium high heat.

instructions: Combine all ingredients except cottage cheese and apples in medium bowl. Stir. Add cottage cheese, stirring to combine. Heat electric skillet over medium heat, about 2 minutes until warm.

title: Garlicky Capers
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried and chopped | 1/3 cup large capers
instructions: Place the lettuce into a large bowl, and toss with the capers. Chill or serve immediately.

title: Turnips With Vodka- Parsley Sauce
ingredients: 1 turnip | 1 teaspoon dried parsley
instructions: Boil the turnip with the parsley in the water until soft, about 15 minutes. Remove turnip and discard the parsley. Remove the turnip and boil it until it is cooked, about 10 more minutes. Remove from the heat and add the vodka to the liquid. Allow it to return to a boil and then taste for seasoning. Serve the turnip with the parsley sauce.

title: Nacho Olive Spread
ingredients: 4 tablespoons grated cheese | 4 tablespoons snipped green olives | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Place cheese, olives and parsley in food processor and blend until smooth. Serve with pita, baguette pieces, bread or crackers, or as a dip.

ingredients: 150 g uncooked linguine | 400 g prawns, small, uncooked | 120 g broccoli florets | 45 g water chestnuts | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded & finely sliced | 4 tablespoons water-packed sun-dried tomatoes or 4 tablespoons tomato sauce diluted with 2 tbsp water
instructions: Cut prawns into large chunks & fry in a little olive oil. Stir in broccoli, water chestnuts & heat through. Cook linguine according to package instructions. Tip on sundried tomatoes & sauce, toss through & serve immediately.

instructions: In an 8x8 baking dish, arrange the scallops in an even layer, then cover with the cheese slices. Heat the chicken broth, tamari, oregano, 1/4 t salt and 1/4 t pepper in a small to medium saucepan until warm to the touch, but not boiling. In a small bowl, combine the dipping sauce ingredients. Spoon the sauce over the cheese and scallops, cover and let it set in the refrigerator for about 10 minutes. Transfer the dish to a hot ridged grill, or preheat a broiler to high. Cover the grilling surface with foil, and grill the scallops, uncovered, 3 - 4 minutes. Turn the scallops over just before serving.

title: Antipasto Potatoes and Sopressata

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake potatoes in a baking dish in the preheated oven until easily pierced with a knife, 10 to 15 minutes. Peel potatoes, remove the skin, and mash potatoes with 1 tablespoon of the adobo, 1 jalapeno pepper, chipotle, and red pepper flakes. title: Grilled Mahi Mahi With Avocado Butter

instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Sprinkle cumin seed over fish. Lightly toast cumin and grate over grates. Arrange mahi mahi on a grill rack. Grill fish until firm to the touch and just barely opaque in the center, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from grill.

title: Onion Ice

instructions: First, prepare the ice cube. After a couple of minutes, remove from freezer and place it in a container with a lid. After 15 minutes or so, put ice in container and wait two minutes to melt, then place lid back on. Add onion powder and oregano and stir. Enjoy.

title: Chile Salt
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh parsley, stems removed
instructions: Place the parsley in a saucepan and cover with about 1 inch of water. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes or until the water is just tender. Drain and transfer the parsley to a large bowl and stir in 1/4 cup hot water. Pour the chile salt through a fine mesh sieve into the lime juice, discarding the solids. If desired, season with salt and lime zest before serving.

title: Easy Beef Mint Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 cup of fresh mint, chopped | 1 tablespoon ground roasted peanuts
instructions: In large bowl, combine salt and pepper, add beef.

title: Grilled Halibut With Nacho Dip #RSC

instructions: Prep your oven. Preheat your grill to high heat. Place the halibut on a foil lined sheet tray and lightly oil the top of the fillets with cooking spray. Sprinkle fish with pepperoni and nacho chip and grill for 3 - 5 minutes per side, or until fish is cooked through. Let the fish set up for 5 minutes, then cut each fillet in half crossways. To serve, place a piece of fish on a warm flour tortilla that has been lightly warmed up for 5 minutes. Top with a piece of the fish.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,beer,vanilla bean,basmati rice,celeriac,hazelnut,sugar cube
title: Celeriac Chicken With Hazelnut Beer
ingredients: 8 ounces celeriac, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 8 chicken breast halves | 2 1/4 cups unsalted dry-roasted chopped hazelnuts | 1 vanilla bean ( scraped and scraped and scraped ) | 2 tablespoons sugar cubes, finely chopped | 4 fluid ounces beer | 7 cups hot cooked basmati rice, lightly toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f cook the celeriac with a pinch of salt in a heavy saucepan over the coals of an open flame until it becomes golden, about 5 minutes, then transfer to a colander to drain. Cut the chicken into bite size pieces. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper. Spread the hazelnuts out on the baking sheet and toast in the oven until blackened on all sides. Let cool completely. Remove the skin and seeds from the vanilla bean. Cut the vanilla bean into thirds crosswise. Split each of the halves in half and discard. Scrape out the inside of the vanilla bean with a spoon, add to the skillet with the sugar, mushrooms, and 1 vanilla bean scraped from the other. Add the beer to the skillet and scrape the bean into the skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Transfer to a shallow baking dish, cover, and refrigerate until cold about 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 350°f scatter the toasted hazelnuts over the hot rice and bake until fragrant, about 10 minutes. Transfer the toasted hazelnuts to a sieve. Set aside some of the hazelnut broth to use as a dipping sauce.

title: Banana Pepper & Cabbage
ingredients: 2 large egg whites | 2 medium red cabbage | 2 medium banana peppers
instructions: Thinly slice the cabbage. Set aside. In a large bowl beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form. Gently fold in the beaten egg whites. title: Mexican-Style Chicken and Veggie Salad

title: Tortilla Chips (Alle)

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together sage and 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Microwave tortillas on high for 10 seconds to soften slightly. instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl, mix well with your hands. Dive the salmon slices into thirds, add to the dry ingredients. instructions: Place the corn on metal or gas skewers and brush with oil. Rub the grilled corn all over with the chipotle pepper. instructions: Microwave sweet potatoes on high until tender. Drain on paper towels. Dice fine, and toss with dashi. Sweet potato and mirin dressing blend together and toss with chips until all is coated. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Mushroom Cheese and Poblano (Mexican Stew)

instructions: Peel and finely chop the mushrooms and chilies. title: Mexican Corn & Pasta Salad

instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Chill.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375f and lightly grease a 9 inch springform pan or spray with nonstick cooking spray. Combine the cake mix with half of the lime peel and 1 package of the cheese. title: Jasmine Rice and Horseradish Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 cup shredded mixed vegetables or 1 cup green pepper | salt and pepper | 1/2 cup shredded horseradish | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 16 flour tortillas or 8 corn tortillas
instructions: In a large saucepan, simmer rice and vegetables for approximately 30 minutes. Stir in horseradish and vinegar, and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Spoon rice mixture and a dash or two of water into tortillas, roll up and secure with toothpicks. Garnish with grated cheese, sour cream, tomatoes, if desired. Makes 16 burritos.

title: Grilled Mushrooms on a Salad Roll
ingredients: 1/4 cup saffron, cracked | 12 lettuce leaves, cut in half | 12 portobello button mushrooms | 3/4 cup bottled hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium high. When the grill is ready, lightly oil the grates, then place the mushroom halves on the grill and grill for about 3 - 5 minutes on each side, or until tender, flipping once. While the mushrooms are grilling, place a small plate on the grill. While the mushrooms are grilling, combine the saffron and pepper sauce. After the mushroom are cooked, allow them to cool enough to handle and slice off the stems. Dice the mushrooms and place them on a serving plate. Top with the saffron sauce and garnish with lettuce leaves. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: key lime juice,wine,kosher salt,herbes de provence,chicken breast half,salad oil,peppercorn
title: Lime Marinated Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1/3 cup lime juice | 3 tablespoons kosher salt | 4 tablespoons salad oil | 1/4 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/4 teaspoon crushed peppercorns | 1 cup dry white wine | 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instructions: Whisk lime juice, salt, oil, herbes de provence, and crushed peppercorns together in a bowl. Sprinkle chicken with the lime mixture, coating completely.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,dark soy sauce,hazelnut,sazon goya coriander annatto,chunky salsa,shallot,chili powder,italian salad dressing
title: Hazelnut Salsa Poblano
ingredients: 1 medium poblano chile | 2 shallots | 1 ounce hazelnuts | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon sazon goya with coriander and annatto | 1/4 teaspoon italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon chunky salsa
instructions: Roasted hazelnuts, put the hazelnuts on a baking tray and to toast in a 400f degree oven for 10 minutes. Heat the grill, remove the skin and stem from the poblano. Cut it in half, remove the seeds and devein it, place in a food processor chop nuts and return to baking tray. Sprinkle with chili powder, sazon, italian dressing and hazelnut pieces. In blender blend the ingredients over high for about 10 seconds until it is finely pureed and then transfer into a bowl add chunky salsa. Refrigerate overnight and serve.

title: Queso Fresco Wrapped Wrapped Chicken
ingredients: 3 quarts lettuce, washed, dried and coarsely chopped | 3 quarts queso fresco, melted | 3/4 cup pecorino cheese, coarsely grated | 1/2 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: In a blender, combine the cheese, bouillon and pecorino and process until smooth and creamy. Pour the dressing into a bowl and add the chopped lettuce. Wrap in the cheesecloth and refrigerate overnight before serving. Slice into 1/2 inch slices. Note, if you want to make this up to 3 days ahead, use the same amounts of pecorino, feta and chicken bouillon.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,orange juice,asafoetida powder,cayenne,snow pea,topping
title: Easy Snow Pea and Asafoetida Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh snow pea | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 red chili pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Clean snow peas. Rinse and drain. Place in a microwave safe container with asafetida and cover. Microwave on high 5 - 10 minutes until softened. Drain water completely. Whisk in orange juice, lime juice and cayenne. Add the snowpeas, mix well and refrigerate for 4 - 5 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,orange zest,hot paprika,egg substitute,tomato paste,green bell pepper
title: Spanish Potato Chip Omelet
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled and cubed | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 2 1/4 teaspoons hot paprika | 2 tablespoons minced green bell peppers | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 4 tablespoons egg substitute
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place potato, orange zest, paprika, bell peppers, tomato paste, and egg substitute in a food processor.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,green pepper flake,filling,salt,thai fish sauce,red cabbage,midori melon liqueur
title: Spicy Spring Rolls
ingredients: 4 cups red cabbage ( thinly sliced ) | 1 1/2 cups baby carrots ( cooked ) | salt | 1/4 cup green pepper flakes | 4 tablespoons midori melon liqueur | 2 -4 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Combine all the filling ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix well until the mixture is creamy. Lay out 2 or 3 cups of cabbage in one even layer on a flat surface. Place the filling on the cabbage. Beginning at the wide end of the cabbage, begin rolling to be closer to the middle of the cabbage. Continue rolling with the wide ends. Continue rolling until the filling has fully encorporated into roll. Cut roll into 1 inch slices and serve immediately.

title: Crock Pot Turkey Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 box deli turkey breast ( about 1lb/800gram ) | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: You will need 12 rolls on this recipe. Put all ingredients in crock pot. Turn on crock pot on low and cook for 8 – 10 hours. Serve on rolls and top with cheese if desired. Or you can put turkey mixture in a loaf pan to make sandwiches of your choice.

title: Amaretto Dipping Sauce for Fish
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 1 cup chopped drained canned salmon | 1 cup garam masala
instructions: Drain the pimentos, and place them in a microwave safe dish. Cover with a microwave safe lid, and cook on high 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender. Remove from the microwave, and place in a bowl to cool. Stir in the amaretto, salmon, and garam masala. Chill, and shake well before serving, or refrigerate.

title: Chef John's "meat " En Papillote
ingredients: 1 pound ground meat | 2 cans stewed tomatoes | 1 can tomato paste | 1 bunch fresh chives, minced | 2 tablespoons dry crushed red pepper ( piquillo seeds ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 cups shredded mix ( store-bought or store-bought )
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add ground meat, and cook, stirring often, until meat is browned, and no longer pink. Mix in tomatoes, tomato paste, chives, chile piquillo seeds, and flour. Stir well, and then cook 10 minutes to absorb the flavor. Serve over cooked pasta, or rice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,chicken breast half,globe eggplant,baby spinach leaf,white bread,tomato green chilies,salt pork
title: Chicken Salad in Creamy Green Chile Sauce
ingredients: 1 package chicken breast halves, skinless, boneless | 3 teaspoons salt pork, fat-free grated | 1/4 lb mixed baby spinach leaves | 1 large globe eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices ( can substitute smaller eggplants ) | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies ( hunts ) | 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 2 pita bread rounds, each cut on a diagonal cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with salt pork and set aside to marinate while preparing the eggplant. If using smaller eggplants, cut in half lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices. In medium bowl, combine eggplant slices, brussels sprouts, chiles and garlic to form a thin layer. In microwave safe bowl, stir together tomatoes with green chilis and shortening. Cook on high 30 seconds. Stir mixture and pour over chicken. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Pimentos Con Le Pimentro (Pimentos and Parmesan)
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spread pimentos onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 20 to 30 minutes. Mix pimentos and parmesan cheese together in a bowl. Spread pimento mixture over the pimentos.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,lime,marie biscuit,green salsa,chihuahua cheese,ham,chocolate
title: Chunky Ham and Chihuahua Muffins
ingredients: 1 bag marie biscuits | 6 ounces shredded chihuahua cheese | 2 cups shredded cooked ham | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 4 ounces chihuahua cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup green salsa | 2 tablespoons chopped chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease 12 muffin cups. Line the bottom of a 2 quart glass measure with some bread crumbs. Place 1 baggie of marie biscuits on a work surface and layer the remaining bread crumbs, chihuahua cheese, ham, vinegar, chihuahua cheese, green salsa and chocolate in between each layer of crumbs. Make 12 small holes in each muffin about 1 1/2 inches thick. Bake in the preheated oven 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,chinese five spice powder,onion flake,lemongrass,caster sugar,monterey jack cheese,cilantro leaf,romaine lettuce
title: Chinese 5 Spice Salad
ingredients: 2 romaine lettuce, washed and dried well | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon lemon grass, finely chopped | 1 medium onion, finely chopped | 1 cup monterey jack cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese, freshly grated | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf ( optional )
instructions: Cut the lettuce into a large salad bowl. Combine all the ingredients and mix well. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: sage,thyme sprig,onion mushroom soup mix,parmesan cheese,savory,red bell pepper,pomegranate
title: Pomegranate Herb and Mushroom Roasted Red Pepper Relish
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers | 1 envelope onion and mushroom soup mix | 1 -2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 -2 tablespoon parmesan cheese, dried
instructions: Roast red peppers under broiler for a few minutes or until blackened. Turning once only. Remove from broiler. Remove the stems and pith from the peppers with a slotted spoon and cut them into 1/2 inch chunks. Place them in a bowl and cover with a dish cloth or plastic wrap. Let stand 30 minutes. Rinse off the skin and excess moisture. Stir in the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Chill 2 hours. Spread out the mixture in a single layer in to the palm of your hand. Place the red peppers on a tray and roll the trimmings into a cylinder shape. Skewer the red peppers on the tray. Bake in a preheated oven 225°c/475°f for 12 hours, rolling occasionally for about 12 or 15 minutes, turning them as necessary.

Random Ingredients: sauce,pearl barley,maraschino cherry,manchego cheese,heavy cream,raspberry jam,topping,iceberg lettuce
title: Bean Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed pearl barley | iceberg lettuce | 1 cup shredded manchego cheese | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, halved | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese or 1/4 cup crumbled goat cheese | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Cook barley for approximately 20 minutes, stirring once or twice. Drain and rinse under cold water, drain again. Combine the rice, lettuce, cheese and cherries in a large bowl with the jam, mascarpone cheese, cream and hot sauce. Just prior to serving, stir in the barley and serve.

title: Asian Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 lb snow peas | 1 red chili, finely chopped
instructions: Remove strings and strings from snow peas. Cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch wide lengths. Scrape out and discard woody base. Repeat process using remaining ingredients. Sour cream or yogurt, if desired, may be added to snow peas, as desired, to coat.

Random Ingredients: parsley,red chilies,orange zest,fennel seed,kaffir lime leaf,pineapple,butternut squash,cod
title: Thai Baked Cod With Parsley and Scented Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 butternut squash, small dice | 1/2 zucchini or 1/2 butternut squash, medium dice | 1/2 red chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 orange, zest of | 1/2 orange, zest of | 3 kaffir lime leaves | 1 tablespoon crushed fennel seed or 1 tablespoon crushed arugula | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f, 180c or gas mark grease a 5 litre ovenproof frying pan with oil and line with baking paper. Bake for 15 minutes, turning the pan halfway through. Remove the baking paper and paper before replacing the paper. Place the squash on a baking sheet lined with baking paper. Cook, uncovered for 15 minutes. Stir in the zucchini and chilies and cook, turning, for 5 minutes. Remove the zucchini and chilies from the oven and stir in the orange zest, orange zest, lime leaves, fennel seeds and kaffir lime leaves. Remove the mixture from the oven and set aside until ready to serve. Remove the bakestones from the oven and arrange them on a serving platter. Spoon vegetable mixture around each and scatter over freshly chopped parsley. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,gingerroot,kalamata olive,red wine vinegar,paprika,orange marmalade,chicken broth,ricotta cheese
title: St. Brenden's Italian Chicken
ingredients: 12 ounces ricotta cheese ( can use more if desired ) | 3 tablespoons orange marmalade | 1 teaspoon kosher paprika ( or black ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1 -2 cup chicken broth ( see note ) or 1 -2 cup turkey broth ( see note ) | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar or 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 yellow pepper | 1 can sliced kalamata olives
instructions: Note ~ it doesn't matter if the marmalade is a little salty, the spices will help bind it together. In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese, orange marmalade, paprika, ground ginger, and chicken stock. Using 2 forks or your hands, make one big slurry. Drain and put in a bowl. Dice pepper into 1 inch pieces. Cut olives in half with a sharp knife. Pour 1/2 cup white wine vinegar or red wine vinegar over ricotta mixture and toss. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving, stirring occasionally. Note ~ if making in advance, cover and refrigerate the ricotta mixture for up to 1 week. Note ~ when tasting the chicken, stir the slurry to make sure it mixes well with the sauce. Note ~ the amounts of chicken broth and wine vinegar don't really matter, if possible, because the zaar robot slapped it into the slurry at a high setting for about 15 - 20 minutes with the addition of the wine vinegar. The longer your chicken simmers the longer it simmers, the more flavor will become. Serve sliced chicken on a bed of white or wheat greens, topped with sauce. Also, the olives can be placed on top of the chicken. Note ~ add more vinegar, if desired and the vinegar tastes acidic. Note ~ if making in advance, cover and refrigerate the ricotta mixture for up to 1 week.

title: Spinach With Almonds & Sage (Palomolotti)
ingredients: 1 -2 lb fresh spinach ( washed well ) | 1/4 cup slivered blanched almond ( about 1/2 cup blanched ) | 1 tablespoon dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Remove stems and any large leaves from the spinach. Place on a baking sheet and drizzle with a little olive oil. Bake on the center rack, uncovered, until lightly browned and crisp, about 30 minutes. Cool and chop coarsely. Place finely chopped spinach in a large serving bowl. Sprinkle chopped almonds over spinach. Sprinkle with sage. Mound spinach mixture in one or other small, heavy bowls. Serve warm with crackers.

title: Taste of Thai Sweetcorn
ingredients: 4 sweetcorn | 1 lemon or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 200 g frozen sweetcorn, defrosted | 300 g double cream | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c. Cut the fresh sweetcorn into small pieces and cook as for pie. Mix the rest of the ingredients and add the sweetcorn. Stir well until heated through. Put in a shallow oven dish and bake 40 - 45 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Pork Roast Italian Style
ingredients: 4 lbs beef chuck roast or 4 lbs pork shoulder | 1/3 cup seasoning salt | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Rub all over roast. Place roast in roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: ham,plain flour,lettuce,red currant jelly,pastry dough,leek,soya sauce
title: Warm Soya Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 75 g ham, chopped | 1 large leek, washed well and chopped | 2 1/2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 package pastry dough, thawed | 1/2 cup red currant jelly | 1/2 cup lettuce, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Heat all the sauce ingredients together in a saucepan, stirring until well blended and hot. Cool slightly. On a lightly floured surface roll out half the pastry to make a circle large enough to line a large 30cm loose bottomed tart tin. Spoon half of the gravy mixture into the pastry shell, then cover with half of the ham, then scatter over half the leeks and half the flour. Roll out the remaining pastry to make a round top, then cut into four 10cm squares. Place in the bottom of the tart tin and press down lightly. Prick the rim of the pastry with a fork, then prick holes in the center with the fork. Pour the jelly over the pie so that it just covers it, then trimming any excess pastry to fit. Place the pastry on a baking sheet and prick with the fork again. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until pastry is golden and filling is hot. Leave to cook for 20 minutes. When pie is cooked, remove and serve warm with salad or fresh greens as suggested in intro.

title: Italian Porcini
ingredients: 1 cup dry porcini mushrooms, reconstituted | 2 cups zucchini, peeled | 1 1/2 cups unsweetened coconut milk | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning, crushed
instructions: In skillet, simmer mushrooms for 1 minute. Add zucchini, simmer for 1 minute. Stir in coconut milk, bring to boil.

title: Easy Elegant Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 14 ounces cannellini beans | 10 serrano ham, slices
instructions: Open cannellini beans with a knife and add 10 slices of ham and some water to cover. When mixture comes to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until mixture has thickened a bit and cannellini beans are heated, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,mint leaf,scallop,green chili pepper,olive oil,protein powder,cream tartar,baking potato
title: Scallops and Potato Pizza With Mint & Chiles
ingredients: 8 ounces pizza crust | 1 1/2 cups reduced-fat sour cream or 1 1/2 cups soy yogurt | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 green chili pepper | 3/4 cup chopped of fresh mint leaves | 1/2 teaspoon protein powder | 1 large baking potato
instructions: To prepare crust, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place pizza crust on a greased baking sheet. Combine sour cream, baking powder and oil. Spread over crust. Place chile over the sour cream mixture. Top with mint and yogurt. Bake for 20 minutes until crust is crisp and topping is crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,pecorino romano cheese,amaretto,cherry,tomato,ancho chile powder,vegetable oil peanut,chicken bouillon cube
title: Algerian Alino Gourmet Shake-Doll
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce or 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons amaretto ( or other almond-flavored liqueur such as amaretto eau-de-vie ) | 1/2 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons amaretto or 1/2 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons amaretto or 2 tablespoons anise-flavored almond-flavored liqueur | 2 tablespoons pecorino-romano cheese, grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried cherries, dried, crushed or 1 1/2 tablespoons cherries, finely chopped ( or other cherry ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh ancho chiles or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In the container of a blender, combine the oil and tomato sauce. Blend briefly so as not to liquefy. Stir in the amaretto or almond liqueur. Add the bouillon, 1 tablespoon of amaretto, cheese and cherries or other dried cherries. Stir. Cover and keep refrigerated until ready to use. Store leftovers in an airtight glass jar in the refrigerator for up to a week.

title: Spicy Veggie Salad
ingredients: 6 scallions, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon ground cumin or 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 -2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons raw shelled sunflower seeds, toasted | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel | 2 ounces mixed vegetables | 6 -8 leaves lettuce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Toss gently.

title: Kielbasa and Beans
ingredients: 3 ounces kielbasa, casings removed | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 4 dried hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup prepared tapioca
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease an 8x8 inch baking dish. Place sausage in a skillet.

title: Grilled Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 japanese eggplants, halved lengthwise ( or other large eggplant ) | 1 -2 head napa cabbage ( about 1 pound ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pitted kalamata olives
instructions: Brush eggplants lightly with oil and grill, turning occasionally, until eggplant is cooked through and soft, about 20 minutes. Place the eggplant in a colander to drain and cool to room temperature. Cut cabbage in half lengthwise. Carefully scoop out the hard center, leaving about 2 inches of shredded or whole leaves remaining. Trim off coarse center stem. Slice the leaves lengthwise. Discard ends and cut the quarters crosswise into 1 inch chunks. Set aside. Cook cabbage, covered, in a large pot until it barely begins to wilt, about 6 to 8 minutes. Reserving enough water, add the cilantro, olives and cooled eggplant to warm cabbage and season with salt and pepper. Toss and serve.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,salt black pepper,orange juice,oyster,cucumber,onion powder,graham cracker crumb
title: Monkeyboy Sandwich With Orange Peel
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh orange juice | 1/4 cup oyster liquid ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon onion powder | 1 pinch salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs thin slices prosciutto or 1 1/2-2 lbs salami, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 1 seedless cucumber, halved and cut into 4 to 6 pieces ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups dry graham cracker crumbs
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the orange juice, oyster liquid, onion powder, salt and pepper until the salt and pepper are dissolved. Fold in half the prosciutto or salami with 2 pieces of cucumber, if using. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Form 6 ramekins or sandwich shaped patties about 1 inch thick. Spread about 1/2 cup of cracker crumbs on a clean work surface. Dip the patties into the cracker crumbs, shaking off excess. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Cook the patties over medium hot coals for 6 to 7 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crisp and golden brown. The patties should register 125 degrees fahrenheit in the center of the meat. Serve drizzled with orange peel juice.

title: Gundruffle
ingredients: 1 lb arborio rice or 1 lb valencia romano rice, rinsed well ( one box ) | 3 -4 cups jasmine rice or 3 -4 cups valencia romano rice
instructions: Wash and rinse the rice in a sieve under cold water, place in a large deep saucepan with about 1 1/2 2 inches of the water. It needs to sit in a swig down. Rinse well and drain. Add the rice to the water and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and cover. Cook for about 25 minutes. The water should be absorbed, but not waterlogge. Don't worry about that. You don't want to steam it. You will be reducing the water when most of the water is cooked off. After 25 minutes, remove from heat and leave covered or else the rice will stay on the bottom overnight.. The next day, you must cook the rice using a pressure cooker and keep its water in the pan. This will make your gundruffle water cloudy. Turn to the rice cooker at 15 minutes while it simmers, bring 1 3/4 cups of water to a boil. Boil it rapidly for about 25 - 30 minutes after 30 minutes. After the 30 minutes, skim off any foamy rice water and keep the water on the stove. Cover the rice with aluminum foil, place on the stove and simmer, for 15 mins, fluffing it up with a fork during that time. This should have about 3 cups of liquid. If it seems like there isn't enough, drain 3 - 4 cups of the liquid before adding, this should take only 20 minutes to cook and rice, but it's not going to be anywhere near this point. You can also try other recipes you can try this with other ingredients like this, if necessary.

title: North African Dukkah (Parsley Sauce)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seed, crushed ( optional ) | 1/2 cup harissa ( north african dukkah )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and let sit at room temperature for 15 minutes before using. Serve alone, or with toasted bread.

title: Chinese Mushroom Cream
ingredients: 1 ounce dried chinese mushrooms, soaked in warm water for 30 mins and then rinsed | 4 cups heavy cream | 1 package mixed vegetables | 1/2 - 3/4 cup raisins
instructions: Place mushrooms in a large serving bowl. Place cream in a saucepan, heat and stir. Add vegetables and raisins. Stir until vegetables are cooked but not dried out.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,asiago cheese,dill,beef stew meat,vegetable oil cooking spray,yellow onion,focaccia bread
title: Beef Stromboli
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in 1/4-inch slices | 1 loaf focaccia bread, split in half horizontally | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup shredded asiago cheese | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1 chopped yellow onion | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill or 1/2 cup basil
instructions: Spray a 12 inch nonstick skillet with vegetable spray. Line an ungreased baking sheet with foil. Arrange the meat slices in a single layer. Cut out 12 - 12 inch shaped pieces from each piece of bread.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,kaffir lime leaf,garlic paste,tomato paste
title: Pork Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs thick-sliced pork loin ( loin of the butcher ) | 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaf, cut into very thin strips ( about 8 kaffir lime leaves ) | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon garlic paste
instructions: Place pork slices in a large, heavy skillet. Scatter lime leaves over pork. Sprinkle with tomato paste and garlic sauce. Cover and set over very low heat to let the meat marinate. The meat and marinade should simmer gently for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally. Do not drain. Serve with white rice.

title: Easy Tasty Pork Cutlets
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 2 eggs substitute | 2 teaspoons curry paste ( i use penzey's curry paste curry powder )
instructions: Lightly beat eggs into a measuring cup. Add 2 tablespoons curry paste powder to egg/curry mixture.

title: Gratin Savoyarda - Beef Bagel in a Cup
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast | 50 g mushrooms ( canned ) | 1/2 swedes ( peeled ) | 1 yellow pepper ( peeled ) | 8 cherries | 12 bagels ( baguette )
instructions: Pre cook the bagel, if you have any, and slice open and remove from the outer edges as much as possible. Cut up in four equal sized pieces. On one half of the bagel, layer, 1/2 of the mushroom and 1/2 of the swede. Place one piece of the roast on top of this mixture. Top with 1/2 of the bagel halves. Sprinkle cherries over everything. Top with the other half of the bagel. Place under a pre heated grill for approximately 10 minutes. Leave to rest for 3 to 5 minutes or longer. Cut the bagel into six even sized pieces. Place on a plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: texas toast bread,sugar vanilla pudding mix,pork loin roast,onion,cottage cheese,soymilk,green olive,cayenne pepper
title: Mexican Pork Loin Sandwich
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin roast | 16 ounces fat-free cottage cheese, thawed | 1 tablespoon sugar free vanilla instant pudding mix | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup light soymilk | 1 teaspoon chopped green olive | 2 slices texas toast thick bread | 2 tablespoons sliced reduced fat pickled onions
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place pork roast in a roasting pan and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Allow to cool slightly and slice into 1/4 inch thick slices. In a medium bowl, combine cottage cheese, sugar substitute, pudding mix, pepper, soy milk, olives and onions. Spread on cut surfaces of 4 slices of bread and top with sliced pork. Top with other 4 slices of bread and cut into pieces. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,camembert cheese,red onion,corn oil,salt,chicken thigh,tomato puree
title: Pan-Fried Chicken With Tomatoes and Bacon
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, skinned | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( available from specialist canning jars ) | 1 small red onion, finely chopped | salt, to taste
instructions: In a wok, heat the oil, then add the chicken thighs, skin side down. Cook over high heat until lightly browned, then turn and cook for a further 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the tomato puree, and season with the chili oil. Bring to the boil, then cover tightly and simmer over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Slice the onion thinly, then arrange on a serving platter with the chicken. Use the tomato sauce as a dipping sauce, and serve with the pan fried chicken.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,sun tomato oil,rice krispies,italian herb seasoning,red bell pepper,dark rum,mozzarella cheese
title: Tropical Krispies (Italian Cheese Balls)
ingredients: 2 cups rice krispies | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon minced italian herb seasoning | 2 tablespoons light dark rum | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Cook rice krispies according to package directions. Drain. Combine next five ingredients in large bowl.

title: Ricotta Soup
ingredients: 1 package whole milk and ricotta cheese | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup half & half
instructions: Rinse the cheese with warm water, rubbing it in the sink. Drain the cheese from the water and place both in a food processor, adding the half and half. Process until smooth. Sift through a clean saucepan and keep hot over low heat. Do not boil. Ladle hot soup into soup tureen bowls, ladle hot cheese sauce over, and serve.

title: Smoky Tapatio Chipotle Rub
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 chipotle peppers, canned with juice | 12 tablespoons demerara sugar
instructions: Add all ingredients in order into mixing bowl, mix well. Refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface. Kneed the dough or roll into desired shape. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet, cover with a towel and let rise until doubled in size, around 45 minutes. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown and cheese is toasted. Remove from oven, allow to cool and set a bit before cutting. Serve warm or toasted along with your favorite toppings.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,chili flake,grain white rice,dark brown sugar
title: Lenguza Con Piselli (Rice)
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups short-grain white rice | 2 teaspoons chili flakes | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon dried chili oil
instructions: Rinse rice with water and bring to a boil on high heat. Cover.

title: Broccoli Sprouts With Brandy
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli, cleaned, stems trimmed and broken in bite size pieces ( about 1 lb ) | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 1/4 cup oil
instructions: Break broccoli into bite size pieces, remove and discard tips of stalks. Stir fry broccoli with sugar, oil and vanilla sugar. Enjoy.

title: Dill Pickle
ingredients: 1 -2 cup vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 1 tablespoon dried dill
instructions: Place all ingredients in a jar with a tight lid. Shake until well mixed.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,beef chuck roast,bay leaf,chunky salsa,turkey bacon,water,tomatillo
title: Mexican Grilled Beef
ingredients: 3 cups tomato-based mild salsa | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 lbs uncooked turkey bacon, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups dry breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons bay leaves | 1 1/4 cups water
instructions: Prepare grill or grill pan. Combine salsa and 2 cups water in a medium saucepan. Bring to boil, reduce heat. Return saucepan mixture to medium heat and simmer gently for 3 - 5 minutes or until sauce is reduced slightly. Meanwhile, put bacon in a large, shallow nonreactive baking dish. Working with 4 pieces at a time, transfer meat to dish. Top with sauteed bacon, then remaining ingredients. Cover dish and cook in a low oven for 2 hours or until beef is very tender. Transfer to warmed serving dish and serve.

title: Quinoa With Roasted Shredded Beef and Kale
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon crushed hot pepper | 1 pinch saffron threads or 1 pinch other ground spices | 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks or 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 2 bunches kale
instructions: Heat a 1 cup measure or pottery jar with a tight fitting lid over medium heat. When it shimmers, add the cumin seeds and mustard powder and roast until the mustard seeds begin to pop and release their aroma, about 1 minute.

title: Raw Vegan Greek Dip
ingredients: 1 cup nutritional yeast | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon sea salt, to your liking ( optional ) | 1 cup dried mint, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in hot water until creamy.

title: Faux-Style Pasta and Beans
ingredients: 3/4 cup canned cannellini beans, drained | 2 pinches ground cardamom | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 quart boiling water, or more as needed | 1 jar sparkling water, divided | 1 tablespoon dried sweetened crushed mustard or paste with 1 tablespoon cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with a silicone baking mat. Mix canned cannellini beans, cardamom in a blender until smooth.

title: Canned Refried Beans - Great Foods
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup jarred capers, drained | 2 teaspoons pickling salt | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 can kidney beans | 1 1/2 cups beef stock
instructions: In large bowl stir together mayonnaise, capers, salt, cardamom, beans and beef broth.

title: Lobster Bisque
ingredients: 4 lobster tails | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon other light cooking oil | 4 cups cooked tiny white potatoes, cubed | 6 cups cooked mixed vegetables, ( such as chard, lima beans, snow peas ) | 1 tablespoon vodka ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon minced fresh thyme ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( optional )
instructions: Cook lobster tails and set aside. Heat the oil, and add the shrimp. Cook shrimp until it turns pink.

title: Italian Confetti Cookies with Broiled Corn and Orange Zest
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground dry corn | 3/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Roll a tablespoon of the corn into a log with a star shaped indentation in the center. Cut into 1/4 inch slices and arrange on an ungreased baking sheet. In a medium bowl, blend the confectioners' sugar, orange zest and a few drops of olive oil until blended. Add the remaining 1/2 cup of corn and mix well to blend. Spread a generous layer of the confectioner's sugar mixture onto each slice of the log. Place the baking sheet in the refrigerator and chill until ready to bake. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly brown.

Random Ingredients: wild rice mix,olive oil,process american cheese,garbanzo bean,egg white,salt black pepper,yellow squash,peanut butter
title: Soy's Peanut Butter Falafel Burgers
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked wild rice mix | 1 can garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup frozen peas with pimento and parsley | 2 egg whites | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/3 cup olive oil | 1 package process american cheese | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and stir in the wild rice mix. Cover and remove from the heat. Let sit until the rice is tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, reserving 3 cups of the liquid. Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Mix garbanzo beans, peas with pimento and parsley in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Whisk egg whites in a separate bowl and stir into the bean mixture. Drain any excess water from the rice mix, cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 20 minutes. Spread the rice mixture into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish and evenly distribute the cheese over it. Preheat an oven to 450 degrees f. Spread the Falafel and peanut butter mixture over the cheese and top with remaining cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is slightly browned, about 20 minutes.

title: Cheesy Beef
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 can chopped apricots | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 container buttermilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Brown meat and drain. Mix in cheese and apricots. Stir in buttermilk. Line a 2 quart casserole with foil or lightly oiled plastic wrap. Spoon meat mixture into casserole. Cover and bake 30 - 40 minutes, or until hot. Serve with rice and hot biscuits.

title: Broccoli and Blue Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 head broccoli | 4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 8 ounces blue cheese ( your favourite ) | 1 knob cooking oil
instructions: Cut the broccoli, taking the core out then cut the florets from the central stalk at the stalk end. Separate the florets and cut the stalks into bite size pieces. Mix with the mayo and spread over the broccoli. Place the blue cheese in a criss cross fashion over the broccoli and serve at once.

title: Peachy and Cherry Jam
ingredients: 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 7 ripe peaches, peeled, halved
instructions: Press the cherries and peaches into a nonreactive jelly roll pan. Top with maraschino cherries and a little bit of water. Cover with foil and seal. Place in center of a preheated 225 degree f oven. Cook until the jam jells and thickens slightly, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: thai chili sauce,cooking oil,lemon peel,white flour,sherry wine
title: Chinese Salt and Spicy Salt Cookies
ingredients: 250 g white flour | 120 g cooking oil | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 200 g chinese chili sauce | 3 tablespoons sweet sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 deg celsius. Combine flour, sugar, oil, lemon peel, chinese chili sauce and sherry in a bowl. Using damp hands, use your finger to mix well. Roll rounded tablespoons of dough in the mixture to cover the entire bottom of a non stick baking tray. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,chinese five spice powder,cherry tomato,yoghurt
title: Five Spice Yoghurt With Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup full fat yoghurt | 1 pinch chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon cherry tomatoes, halved, or | 1 tablespoon plain stoned tortilla chips, coarsely crushed
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a small bowl. Serve with plain yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,lettuce,balsamic vinegar,pimento olive,sofrito sauce,ginger root
title: Spinach in Spicy Soya Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 3/4 cup sofrito sauce | 2 tablespoons finely diced fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon chopped pimento stuffed olive | 10 leaves torn green lettuce | 1 pound baby spinach
instructions: In a bowl combine the balsamic vinegar, sofrito, ginger and olives. Place a bed of lettuce in the center of a large platter. Top with a bed of spinach. Pour the flavored sofrito mixture around the spinach. Garnish and serve at once.

title: Easy Chile Pepper Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces dry pasta ( i prefer farfalle ) | cooking spray | 3 ounces green chili peppers, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water according to package directions.

title: Quickly Elegant Raspberry French Toast
ingredients: 2 egg yolks | 1/2 cup raspberry jam | 3 cups quick-cooking oil for frying
instructions: Beat egg yolks on medium speed in an electric mixer. Whisk in jam.

title: Korean Beef Strips
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks | 2 tablespoons chili peppers, minced
instructions: Remove tips from steaks. Score each top 1/4 inch deep with sharp knife. Place steaks on baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle with chili peppers. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until done.

title: Simple Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 4 green ripe green tomatoes | 1 -2 tablespoon hot sauce | 2 -3 limes or 2 -3 lemons, cut into wedges
instructions: Remove the tops and seeds from the tomatoes. In a food processor or blender, combine the peppers, hot sauce, lime juice, or lemon juice, and puree til smooth. Pour into a glass measuring cup. Serve immediately, or chill. Garnish with sprigs of parsley.

title: Grilled Veal, Monsoverve and Walnut Pudding (Sopa Della Frutti Di Marmellata)
ingredients: 3/4 lb veal, cut into 4 pieces | 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup walnut pieces | 6 corn on the cob | 2 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup teabags
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f and butter a shallow baking dish. Season meat with salt and pepper. Lightly flour the meat and allow it to come to room temperature with the salt & pepper. Grind the meats and walnuts into a coarse powder. Dip all meat pieces into the flour & shake off any excess. Reserve any excess flour on your hands. Heat 1/4 cup of the cream in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Fry the meat for 5 minutes on each side, or until nicely browned. Place the meat on a platter with the walnuts and pine nuts and pour the cream over. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,crabmeat,bailey irish cream,dipping sauce,poblano chile
title: Baily's Famous Crab and Chile Scrolls
ingredients: 1/3 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 cup baileys irish cream | 1 can crabmeat, drained | 1 poblano chile, seeded and diced | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking tapioca's quick-cooking irish cream ( cream substitute ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c combine the flour, baileys, crab, poblanos and 1 1/2 tablespoons of irish cream together in a bowl. Using a knife, roll 2/3 of the mix into 12 x 5cm sticks. Cut sticks in half crossways. Place sticks about 1cm apart on an oven tray. Place tray in the oven, close the door and cook for 12 - 15 minutes. Alternatively, transfer tray to a tray and bake for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,garlic salt,oatmeal,cream chicken soup,spring onion,vinegar,dark beer,ladyfinger
title: Mary Killar's Irish Oatcakes
ingredients:
1 cup eggnog 
    - 1 cup quick cooking oats, plain | 1 teaspoon garlic salt ( or 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp dried garlic ) | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1/8 cup cream of chicken soup, light | 1 teaspoon dark beer ( optional ) | 4 -6 spring onions, finely chopped | 12 -16 ladyfingers ( if using ladyfingers, add more towards the end of the recipe ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the eggnog, quick cooking oats, salt and vinegar. Mix well. Add soup, beer and stir until combined. Stir in chopped spring onions, mix lightly. Place ladyfingers on a cake rack placed over a baking pan, brush with olive oil and bake in the centre of a pre hot oven for 15 - 20 minutes until golden.

title: Cheese Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans tomato sauce | 12 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1 pinch black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, cayenne powder and pepper. Mix together well. Spread over the dough, cover, and bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,meat,chicken broth,carrot,black olive,wheat flour
title: Easy Harira
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean meat, trimmed fat and cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 1/2 cups green cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 carrots, coarsely chopped | 1 can black olives, sliced in half | 2 cups chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Pulse cardamom pods in a mini processor till fine. Add flour and pulse 2 minutes, till flour resembles coarse crumbs. Add carrots and blend 3 minutes. Transfer mixture to 2 quart baking dish with lid. Add remaining ingredients except olives, stirring evenly with fingers. Spread evenly on meat mixture and bake 45 minutes in middle of oven. Let stand 15 minutes. Stir olives with tooth picks. Serve in shallow soup dishes or warm pita bread.

Random Ingredients: veal,chicken breast,kosher salt,anaheim chili,phyllo dough,fennel,meat,egg noodle
title: Peschetta Di Vitello
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | kosher salt, to taste | 1/2 cup minced fennel | 1/2 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb ground meat | 1 package phyllo dough | 12 ounces cooked al dente egg noodles, heated | 3 anaheim chilies, roasted, peeled, seeded and minced | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fennel
instructions: Wash chicken breasts and pat dry.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,turkey breast,sparkling water,hamburger,beer,cocoa,cream chicken soup
title: Easy Turkey Mole
ingredients: 1 lb boneless turkey breast, sliced in thin strips | 3/4 cup browned hamburger | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa | 4 tablespoons sour cream or 4 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup beer ( corona recommended ) | 1/4 cup queso fresco or 1/4 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated for topping
instructions: Brown turkey in skillet with 1 tbsp cocoa, add to crockpot. Brown ham and cook hamburgurger in skillet to desired doneness. To crockpot add to turkey in skillet stir together other ingredients. Cook on medium for 3 - 4 hours or low for 4 - 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,taco seasoning,peanut butter,asafoetida powder,italian breadcrumb,bulb garlic
title: Roasted Garlic & Asafetida Patties (Beans, Beans, or Tofu)
ingredients: 1 bulb of garlic | 1 can cannellini beans or ( 15 ounce ) can italian-style beans, drained and rinsed | 3/4 cup unsalted dry-roasted peanuts or 3/4 cup unsalted butter, slightly softened | 1 teaspoon mild taco seasoning | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( such as kebda brand, or kikkoman brand )
instructions: Line a broiler pan with foil. Place the garlic bulb skin side down under the broiler element.

title: Soy Spicy Chili Paste-Lite
ingredients: 2 green chili, seeded and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup soy sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the chili, soy sauce, and green chiles. Serve on the side of other indian dishes.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,thyme leaf,yukon gold potato,peanut oil,hot pepper,flour tortilla,pomegranate molasses
title: Baby Bok Choy Burritos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 cup baby bok choy ( washed, de-seeded, and cut into 2-inch lengths ) | 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses | 2 teaspoons thyme leaves | 1 fresh hot pepper, seeded and minced | 20 soft taco-size flour tortillas | 1 small yukon gold potato, halved and thinly sliced ( about 1 1/2 cups )
instructions: In a 12” nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium high. When hot, add bok choy.

title: Lemon Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1/4 cup rolled oats | 6 lbs chicken wings, separated with wings attached | 1/4 cup grated lemon zest ( fresh is best )
instructions: Combine the oats and remaining ingredients. Spread mixture on a greased grill over medium high to medium high heat and cook for 10 minutes, turning once, until golden. Let cool completely. When cool completely, arrange chicken wings directly on a bed of cooke, or serve as an appetizer with crackers.

title: Red Curry Cashew Nut Snack
ingredients: 2 lbs zucchini | 1 cup finely chopped shallots | 1/3 cup roasted cashew nuts ( nut nuts ) | 1 tablespoon red curry paste
instructions: Wash zucchini and remove stems. Cut ends from zucchini. Garnish with 2 - 3 large sprigs of shallots. Roast half of the curry paste in a dry pan over medium high heat for 1 minute. Turn off heat and stir in cashew nuts and rest of the curry paste. Spoon into serving bowls and top with remaining shallots and roasted cashew nuts.

title: Lemon Peel Balls
ingredients: 300 g self raising flour | 1/2 cup grated lemon peel | 12 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons strained fresh lemon juice
instructions: Place flour in a mixing bowl. Place peel on top and squeeze in juice. Mix with fingers until well mixed. Add more flour if too dry. Gradually stir in sauce to make a stiff batter. Drop small balls into hot sauce and fry a few at a time in hot fat for about 4 minutes, turning over and letting them cook for another 3 minutes. Serve hot, topped with hot tea.

title: Curried Steak
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown basmati rice or 1/4 cup jasmine rice | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: In a skillet or wok, saute the ginger and bell pepper for 2 mins on medium heat. In a small bowl, mix half the spices. Add to skillet. Stir until mixed well, cover, and cook on medium to low until pepper has softened somewhat. Remove lid and cook for about 7 minutes more. Serve with naan bread and raitas or other side dishes.

Random Ingredients: green bean,peach,thyme,wheat white flour,tomato green chilies,almond
title: French Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, washed | 2 medium tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 3 tablespoons whole wheat white flour | 1/4 cup sliced almond | 3 -4 canned chopped green chilies ( optional ) | 2 -3 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Cook beans in boiling water to cover 7 - 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Grilled Matzah
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, chopped | 4 medium mushrooms, sliced | 4 large cashews, toasted and chopped | 1/4 cup corn kernel, roasted | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 6 matzos meal, lightly toasted and coarsely grated
instructions: Heat grill.

title: Crunchy Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs potato wedges | 1 loaf whole wheat bread | flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut wedges into large pieces. Coat a baking sheet lightly with cooking spray. Drain wedges well. Arrange wedges on sheet. Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden brown and dry.

title: Beef and Barley Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin or 1 1/2 lbs lamb | 2/3 cup buttermilk | 1/3 cup tahini | 3 cups pearl barley, cooked
instructions: In a dutch oven, brown the meat well. Drain, add buttermilk and bring to a boil. Stir in barley. Cover and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until barley is tender.

title: Chard and Sage Soup
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard, rinsed and trimmed | 1 large yellow onion, chopped | 1/2 cup brewed tea | 1 bag maraschino cherries or ( 14 ounce ) bag mixed greens
instructions: Cut chard crosswise into 1 inch pieces. In saucepan, combine chard, onion, tea, and maraschino or collards. Cook over medium heat 3 - 5 minutes until chard is just limp. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,coconut flake,lobster meat,mozzarella cheese,mustard powder
title: Baked Lobster and Coco-Stuffed Mozzarella
ingredients: 6 lobster meat, cleaned and cored | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 cup shredded light coconut flakes | 1 cup tomato paste | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Cut lobster meat in half lengthwise. Remove tender meat from shells. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine cheese, coconut and mustard powder in bowl. Spread cheese mixture evenly over lobster.

title: Barley & Tomato Risotto
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice ( dry preferably ) | 5 cups cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Cook the rice and vegetables according to package directions. Remove the tomatoes from the marinade, then place the tomatoes over the rice and stir.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,coconut milk,cheddar cheese,vegetable broth,lamb,sesame seed
title: Thai Lamb Curry
