ingredients: 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/3 cup vegetable broth, divided | 1 pound lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 can tomato sauce | 1 can coconut milk | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Place sesame seeds and 2 tablespoons broth in a skillet over medium heat. Toast sesame seeds in the hot oil until golden brown, 7 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Bring remaining 1 tablespoon broth, lamb, tomato sauce, coconut milk, and 3 tablespoon sesame seeds to a boil in a pot.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,cashew,garlic salt,parmigiano reggiano cheese,curry leaf,beef chuck,garam masala
title: Indian Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt | 4 sprigs of fresh curry leaves | 2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 1/3 cup cashews, coarsely chopped ( salted is ok too )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the meat with the garam masala, salt, garlic salt, and curry leaves. Taste and adjust the seasonings as necessary. Cover the bowl using plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove the meat from the refrigerator and drain and discard the marinade. Discard the garlic salt and curry leaves. Using your hands or a meat rotisserie, mix in the sugar and cashews. Heat the reserved marinade over moderate heat until just bubbly, about 1 minute. Discard any leftover marinade. Serve the beef with the cashew gravy and a bowl of hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,daikon radish,sun tomato oil,peanut oil,chile,squid,kielbasa,roasting chicken
title: Chicken and Calamari in Roasted Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken ( whole ) | 1/4 - 1/2 1/2 lb cauliflower floret ( i sometimes use baby peas, and use baby carrots ) | 1 roasting chickens or 1 -2 lb squid, cleaned and halved if large | 24 whole dried chile, roughly chopped | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 lb raw kielbasa, roughly sliced ( or other small sausage ) | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes ( or other sweet sausage ) | 8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained with oil cut in half | 2/3 cup daikon radish, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 cup coarsely chopped dry roasted unsalted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Place chicken in a roasting pan, skin side up, breast side up. Roast in oven for 30 minutes. Turn over and repeat. Continue roasting 15 - 20 minutes. You want it slightly browned, caramelized and soft, but do not burn. Remove from heat.

title: Homemade Four-Spice Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons five-spice powder | 3 teaspoons clove
instructions: Important, don't use any type of powder that emits a burnt smell, or a neutral flavor. Use as a substitute for other spices such as tea, pizza paste or spices, etc.

title: Honey Mustard Pasta
ingredients: 14 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 quart ice water | 4 eggs, beaten | 2 teaspoons honey mustard | 2/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon fruit, chopped
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat water and ice in a skillet over medium high heat until boiling. Add egg, then honey mustard and saute 1 minute. Drain pasta and toss with honey mustard mixture. Sprinkle with the remaining confectioner sugar and cumin. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Peppers & Sausage
ingredients: 6 bell peppers, assorted colors, any color should be bright green with lots of black spots | 6 italian sausage, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 orange
instructions: Slice the orange into 1 1/2 inch long strips. Remove as many pithy seeds as would be necessary, but there should be enough for the peppers to be half cooked. Trim the ends off of the pepper slices. Slice the orange into thin strips. Set peppers aside. If you are using regular sasuage, make sure your sausage links are completely clean of most of the salt. Place sausage rings on a cutting board. Place 1/3 of the peppers into each bowl, cutting down at the stem part of each slice to keep them intact. If you are making one large, preheat broiler on a medium hot fire. Place the sausage slices into the sauce, flipping frequently. Broil for 2 minutes, flip, and broil for 1 minute. Remove from broiler. Slice the orange into thin slices.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,parsley flake,nutritional yeast,extra virgin olive oil,red capsicum,date,soymilk
title: Pineapple Pineapple Gluten Free Mocktail
ingredients: 120 g chopped dates | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast ( gluten-free ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons crushed pineapple in juice | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice, reserved from the canned pineapple in its water | 170 g soy milk | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Dissolve the nutritional yeast in the water. Remove the leaves from the pineapple and remove the pulp. Add all ingredients together in a large bowl. Leave to stand for 10 minutes until the flavours blend. Pour into glasses, serve warm.

title: Swiss Chard
ingredients: 3 lbs swiss chard, cleaned and leaves removed | 4 lbs ground sirloin or 4 lbs ground veal | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 tablespoon kitchen bouquet | 1 can pizza crusts | 1 cup sliced almonds | 1/2 cup dried barberries or 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup raspberry preserves
instructions: Place chard leaves in large pot with boiling water. Cook until wilted, approximately 2 minutes. Remove stems, and cool. Cut stems into 1/2 inch shreds, then place in large bowl.

title: Menchego Cheese (Mexican)
ingredients: 1 whole fresh poblano chile, seeded | 12 ounces manchego cheese, sliced | 2 tablespoons whole milk | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Roast the chile directly over the flame of a gas burner until charred and soft, about 5 minutes. Peel to remove skin, and cut chile in half lengthwise. Set aside. Poke the interior of a blender with a skewer, and set aside. Place manchego cheese slices into the blender, and puree to smooth paste. Mix the milk, cardamom, and chile paste until smooth. Pour the cheese mixture into a cheesecloth lined colander set over a bowl, and place into the refrigerator until it begins to set, about 30 minutes. Cut cheese into 1 inch cubes. Place the cheese cloth into the bowl with the reserved chile, and squeeze out excess liquid. Spoon chile, cheese, and oil into a pan over medium heat, and saute until melted. Serve warm.

title: Barsi's Masala & Prawn Balls
ingredients: 2 lbs swordfish steaks, raw ( cut in half or 1 cup prawns ) | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 plum tomato, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups bisquick | 2 cups tomato & chutney, sweet pickle pickle slices
instructions: Place all ingredients, except bisquick and tomato & chutney, in food processor. Chop until they are a chunky paste. Roll into balls. Spray medium sized nonstick wok with cooking spray. Heat on medium high until very hot. Carefully drop balls into hot oil. Fry, turning once, until dark brown.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,red chilies,mint,rose syrup,almond,beef tenderloin,chipotle powder,tabasco sauce
title: Namurrah Beef Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces beef tenderloin, finely sliced | 2 ounces dried chilies | 2 ounces dried red chilies, finely sliced | 1 ounce toasted almond, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon rose syrup | 2 tablespoons ground mint | 1 teaspoon chipotle powder or 1 teaspoon other chili sauce | tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix the marinade ingredients and pour over the meat. Turn the meat to coat evenly. Marinate for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 425°f. Remove meat from the marinade and place in a non stick ovenproof dish. Roast for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 180°f and roast for a further 15 minutes or until cooked through. Serve the meat with toasted almonds and a sauce made of half soy milk and half cream. You can substitute vegetable or fruit juices for the mint and chiles.

title: Herbed Tea
ingredients: 1 cup chives, snipped | 1 teaspoon herb, spice ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cumin ( optional ) | 1/4 cup lemonade concentrate | chives, snipped, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine chives, spice, lemonade concentrate and chives in the coffee filter used for brewing. To serve, place 1 tbsp of tea mixture in each glass filled with boiling water. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,mango chutney,lard,canola oil,white sugar,dill pickle relish
title: Crispy Mocktail Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil canola oil | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 tablespoon dill pickle relish | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Heat canola oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Stir in mango chutney, pickle relish, sugar, chili flakes, and dried chili flakes. Continue frying chili flakes in hot oil for 1 minute, or until hot but not yet boiling.

title: Pine Nut Pudding (Japanese Sauce for Ramen)
ingredients: 2/3 cup pine nuts | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: In a small pot, bring just enough water to cover pine nuts. Place over medium heat, and bring just enough water to cover the pine nuts. Stir once or twice, and bring liquid to a boil. Turn heat to low, and leave to simmer until all of the water has dried out. Stir in rice wine, and leave to sit until ready to serve. You should now have a very thick, smooth porridge or a nice clear porridge like consistency.

title: Curry Scented Rum Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Mash red pepper flakes with a mortar and pestle. In a small bowl, mix together the rum, cumin and red pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,sun tomato oil,beef stew meat
title: Southern Style Beef
ingredients: 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 1/2 pounds cubed beef stew meat
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix the tomatoes and soup mix. Place the beef in a large, deep oven safe baking dish, and pour the tomato mixture over. Cover, and bake in preheated oven 30 minutes. Remove from the oven, and continue baking until a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the meat registers 140 degrees f, about 30 more minutes.

title: Lobster Quesadilla
ingredients: 3 -4 ounces cooked shrimp, peeled and deveined | 3 -4 ounces cooked lobsters, cleaned | 2 tablespoons light beer ( optional ) | 3 whole wheat tortillas or 3 sandwich-size tortillas, such as fajita | cooked rice noodles ( optional )
instructions: In an ungreased skillet over medium heat sprinkle shrimp and lobster with beer and cook on all sides, about 2 minutes, or until shrimp turn pink. Add tortillas. Cut into wedges and serve with warm rice noodles if desired.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,beef bouillon cube,baby spinach leaf
title: Healthy Baked Spinach for Two
ingredients: 3 -5 tablespoons fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 small savoy cabbage, rinsed and chopped ( approx 4 cups ) or 1 small savoy cabbage, quartered and shredded ( approx 4 cups ) | 1 beef bouillon cube or 2 teaspoons stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f with a little more than a cup of water covering the bottom half of the pan. Place a lid or pan on the top to make sure the pan doesn't dry out. Empty the spinach and any bits of fat into a bowl or medium bowl. Toss with a little olive oil to coat for ease. Place in oven for about 10 to 15 minutes depending on size of spinach. Sprinkle with a little of the meat juices and a few leaves of savoy or cabbage, if wanted. The rest of the ingredients should be at hand as the flavours of the herbs will intensify. Leave on the oven until spinach has all wilted and cooked through, approximately 5 or so minutes. Serve with the rest of your meal.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,tamarind paste,coriander powder,green apple,extra beef,naan bread,salt pepper,pepper
title: Lebanese Beef and Nuts Patties
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 3 green apples, chopped | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon cilantro stem, chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 naan bread, cut into 3 x 1 inch pieces ( use any bread shape ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add ground beef and cook until lightly browned. While beef is cooking, cut your hands into the remaining ground beef and mix well. Then add in the chopped apples and stir until coated with the spice mixture. When beef has browned sufficiently, add in the remaining ingredients, except the bread, saran and pepper. Mix well, cover and let simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. When done, turn off heat and let stand for 10 minutes. Remove meat mixture from pan and cool. Make the patties using about 1 1/2 tablespoons of each of the ground beef, apples and nuts. Add salt and pepper to taste. Preheat griddle or frying pan over medium high heat. Quickly fry the patties for about 5 minutes, turning often. Serve hot with a salad or vegetables..

Random Ingredients: serrano ham,cashew,snow pea,mexican oregano,red chili powder
title: Cashew Ham 'N' Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 cup cashews ( unsalted ) | 1/2 lb serrano ham, sliced | 8 ounces snow peas, cut diagonally into 1/2 inch lengths | 1/8 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1/8 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Toast cashews under broiler until lightly browned. Remove from broiler, and rub on the ham. Cut ham into slices about 1/4 inch thick. Arrange on a serving platter. Sprinkle with mexican oregano, and red pepper powder.

title: Apple-Filled Burgers
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza mix | 1 container prepared sweet and sour sauce | 2 -3 chopped fully cooked sirloin steaks ( about 1/4 lb. ) | 3/4 cup grated peeled and cored tart apple | 1/2 cup prepared prepared salsa | 8 ounces hot cooked peeled sliced fully cooked apple ( about 3 cups ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Prepare and preheat grill. In medium bowl, combine pizza dough ingredients. Divide mixture evenly between 4 prepared and hot patties. Place on preheated grill and grill burgers about 3 to 5 minutes per side for medium rare or until center is no longer pink. Serve burgers hot with salsa and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,red capsicum,black pepper,heavy whipping cream,herring fillet,veal,portabella mushroom,rice flour
title: Mushroom Rillettes
ingredients: 1 kg herring fillet, frozen | 1 red capsicum, diced | 1/2 cup portabella mushroom, sliced | 150 ml heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon sweet rice flour | cracked black pepper | crushed red pepper
instructions: Remove the herring and rinse well and pat dry. Cut into approximately 4 pieces, remove any bones and scales with a pair of scissors. Cut into approximately 1cm thick slices. Arrange on a serving dish. Mix the cream, breadcrumbs, rice flour and red pepper together in a bowl. Spoon over the herring and refrigerate till serving time. Serve the rillettes with crackers or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,kashmiri chili powder,flat leaf italian parsley,pie shell,couscous,semolina,peach,cauliflower floret
title: Couscous and Peach Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chopped kashmiri chili powder | 1 cup couscous | 1 tablespoon kashmiri chili powder, or more, to taste | 1 cup chopped kale | 1 cup coarsely chopped cauliflower floret | 4 large chopped sweet peaches, quartered | 1 1/2 cups torn flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 unbaked pie shells | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Mix kashmiri chili powder, couscous, and kashmiri chili powder together in a bowl. Add kale, cauliflower, and sweet peaches.

Random Ingredients: head garlic,parmigiano reggiano cheese,marsala wine,romaine lettuce
title: Quick Garlic head garlic heads
ingredients: 2 heads garlic | 2 cups dry marsala wine | 1/2 large head romaine lettuce, rinsed and dried | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place garlic heads in a small baking dish. Pour marsala wine around them. Cover dish, and bake in the preheated oven until garlic cloves are soft and beginning to brown, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven, and drain the cloves. Let cool. Place romaine lettuce on a serving plate, and cut into chunks. Remove roasted garlic cloves from the oven, and sprinkle with parmigiano reggiano cheese. Serve with the romaine hearts.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,oriental sesame oil,macapuno string,molasses,mascarpone cheese,cake flour,vanilla pod,kernel corn
title: Mocasa Style Macapuno Bundles
ingredients: 5 tablespoons dry-roasted macapuno strings ( cocase mushroom ) | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 teaspoon thinly sliced lemongrass ( inner bulb only ) | 2 1/2 cups cake flour ( all purpose unbleached ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure oriental sesame oil | 2 teaspoons finely chopped peeled fresh lemongrass | 1/3 cup molasses | 1 lb mascarpone cheese | 2 vanilla pods, peeled & split lengthwise ( or 6 pieces ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped peeled fresh lemongrass | 1/3 cup whole kernel corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degrees. Arrange coca mushrooms flat side up on foil lined cookie sheets. Combine molasses, lemongrass and 1/2 cup water in small saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until mixture just comes to boil. Remove from heat.

title: Lengua Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 large leek, white part only, washed and chopped | 8 pieces mashed banana leaves | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin steaks | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 tablespoon limes, juice of | 2 cups iceberg lettuce
instructions: Soften banana leaves on paper towels for 5 minutes. Soften yeast in lukewarm water. Stir to dissolve. Add ground sirloin and yeast, mix well. Add lemon juice to the well drained lukewarm ground sirloin. Mix well. Add iceburg lettuce leaves. Spread on banana leaves. Roll and serve.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,taco seasoning,red lentil,kalamata olive,beef steak
title: Beef and Lentils With Kalamata Olives
ingredients: 1/2 lb salmon fillet, cut into bite size pieces | 1/2 lb beef top round steak | 1 package taco seasoning | 8 pitted kalamata olives, sliced | 1/2 cup red lentil
instructions: Mix taco seasoning and olives as directed on package. Place salmon and steak in a shallow baking dish and pour taco mixture over fish. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 375° over medium heat, place lentils in a pot on medium high heat. Cover and boil 20 minutes, until tender. Stir and cover. Remove from heat. Spoon fish into serving dish, cover with lentils. Sprinkle with kalamata olives. Serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: hoagie,heavy whipping cream,green onion,fruit,meatball,tony chachere seasoning
title: Baked Meatball Hoagies
ingredients: 2 pounds meatballs, cut into large chunks | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons tony chachere's creole seasoning | 1 cup fresh fruit, sliced | 2 bunches green onions, chopped | 1 loaf hoagie rolls, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place meatball chunks in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir cream into cream mixture until well blended. Spread cream mixture over meatballs. Sprinkle a light layer of creole seasoning on top, then place a handful of sliced fruit in the center. Cover dish, and bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes. Serve rolled and topped with remaining sliced fruit.

title: Homemade Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 -3 serrano chili, sliced into rounds | 1 pinch hot paprika
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,apple cider,pie crust,chive,parmesan cheese,penne rigate,sesame seed
title: Baked Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 4 sheets frozen pie crust, prepared | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 4 tablespoons unsweetened dry-roasted unsweetened cocoa powder | 7 tablespoons unsweetened apples cider ( not apple juice or apple juice. ) | 1 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons minced fresh chives | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 1 package penne rigate
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Place frozen pie crust sheets in a glass baking dish large enough to fit them all in a single layer, and bring a large pot of water to a boil. Carefully remove the crusts from the baking dish.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,ginger,lemon juice zest,tamari,tomato juice,mustard seed
title: Japanese Ginger Sauce
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice ( juice and zest of 1 lemon ) | 1 teaspoon grated ginger | 6 ounces tomato juice
instructions: In a food processor, grind the mustard seeds, tamari, lemon juice, ginger and tomato juice to a paste. Stir into the tamari mixture. If necessary, spray the top of your saucepan with a cooking spray. Keep warm over low heat. Serve, with bread. This makes enough sauce for 4 servings.

title: Horseradish Fish With Port Wine
ingredients: 1/2 cup port wine | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 4 tilapia fillets
instructions: Prepare horseradish horseradish fish. Place fillets in a dish and pour port over the top. Turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 15 - 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 450 degree farenheit. Place fish fillets on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve fish with hot horseradish sauce and additional port.

title: Spanish Green Pepper Wine
ingredients: 1/2 cup red spanish wine, like merlot | 1 green pepper
instructions: Cut the green pepper in half and remove stem and seeds. Slice the green pepper as thinly as possible, or as thinly as you want. You will probably need 3 or 4 pieces to keep in mind it will depend on the heat of your stove.

Random Ingredients: green pea,white chocolate chip,parsley,corn,liquid smoke flavoring,dough,brown sugar
title: Smooth Pea and Corn Chowder II
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 cup frozen cut green pea, thawed | 1 package frozen corn, thawed | 6 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 4 teaspoons instant dutch process green instant chile powder | 2 cups white chocolate chips
instructions: Toss together green peas, and corn on an ungreased 15x10 inch jelly roll pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar, liquid smoke flavoring, and chile powder. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. About 15 minutes before serving, melt white chocolate chips over hot water. Let cool.

title: Cheese and Bread Cracker
ingredients: 1 -2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Mix the cheese and bread crumbs. Coat the chips with a little of the grated cheese or marinade for dipping.

title: German Style Potato Salad
ingredients: 500 g potatoes, peeled & cut into chunks | 300 g swiss cheese, cut into pieces | 300 g plain yogurt ( strained of excess liquid & then strained ) | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 english cucumber, peeled & very thinly sliced
instructions: Place the potato & swiss cheese in a large bowl & add the yogurt. Stir well & sprinkle with the caraway seeds. Cover & refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight. Remove from the refrigerator & stir well. Serve in lettuce lined bowls & top with cucumber slices. This is really nice served with fresh bread for dipping. Note, can be served on a large platter lined with plastic wrap or lettuce leaves as a first course or with your favourite vegetables for a variety.

title: Easy Brazilian Blueberry Chicken
ingredients: 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cubed | 2 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place chicken in a baking dish. Bake chicken at a temperature of 450 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from oven, and mix in blueberries. Cover dish, and bake 40 minutes in the preheated oven. Allow to cool for 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,cardamom pod,chili paste,red enchilada sauce,pistachio nut,ham,brandy,jelly crystal
title: Red Hot Spicy Ham, Chilli or Venison Enchiladas
ingredients: 500 g lean hamburger or 500 g venison | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste ( i use thai chilli ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cardamom pod | 3 tablespoons prawns ( uncooked, cleaned and deveined or just raw shrimp ) | 8 red enchilada sauce ( red enchilada sauce ) | 1 teaspoon jelly crystals | 3 -5 tablespoons sliced almonds or 3 -5 tablespoons pistachio nuts | pistachio nut ( optional and for a change i don't use )
instructions: Grind meat, if any. Chop or process almonds or pistachios. Add brandy, chilli, cardamom pods or chilli flakes. Chill 1 - 2 hours or overnight. Pour the red enchilada sauce into a baking dish. Add jelly crystals or slivers to the meat and cook in a frying pan on medium high heat for 5 - 7 minutes or until golden, stirring constantly. You want it nicely browned so you do not burn. Take from heat. Add meat mixture to the pan and roll enchilada until all the meat is covered. Arrange enchiladas in baking dish with the meat mixture at an angle or if your oven is non stick pan, cook in the oven at 180 degrees centigrade for 30 - 40 minutes, depending on your oven and your oven. The meat and sauce should be a bit sticky at times for me. When cooked most of the way through, you should be able to eat your meat and sauce in the oven, and still able to feel the tasty aroma. It should be moist and creamy, slightly firm and flavorful. If you use skewers that have been soaked in cold water before using, soak them in water during the cooking so they don't get too dried and brittle. Use a bit of oil to lightly spray each enchilada. You may want to leave them in if you use wooden skewers for a little bit. Serve with a little of the hot sauce, or sprinkle with grated pappardelle cheese. Tip, if too wetter, you may want to fry your enchiladas in a little oil.

title: Pasta With Winter Squash and Capers
ingredients: 12 ounces butternut squash, peeled, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 4 ounces angel hair pasta, cooked and drained | 4 ounces capers, drained ( may use more if desired ) | 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet heat 1/4 tsp butter or margarine over medium high heat. Add squash and cook until heated through and beginning to turn golden, about 7 minutes. Add pasta and capers.

title: Rough Roasted Shitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 4 fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed, cleaned, and chopped | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c line a baking tray with baking paper. Whisk the flour into a paste with 75g of water for 10 minutes. Fold 1/4 of the shiitake mushrooms into the flour paste until coated then stir in the sunflower seeds. Add the remaining shiitake mushrooms, tossing gently to coat all the mushrooms. Spread into the prepared tray and bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Charred Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 2 ounces granny smith apples, peeled, halved, cored and chopped | 2 plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
instructions: Combine all but the tomatoes and mix well. Chill salsa for up to 3 days before you serve it, as the flavors will separate and it will keep for weeks.

title: Cafe Cubano
ingredients: 1 pound ground pork | 1/2 cup cocoa | 1/2 cup guinness stout liqueur or 1/2 cup liqueur | 1 teaspoon achiote paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom or 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground szechwan pepper
instructions: In a medium size skillet heat about 1/4 inch of oil over medium heat, add the ground pork. Brown the meat, approximately 5 minutes remove from pan and set aside. Heat the remaining oil in the same skillet over medium heat, stir in the cocoa and whisk in the guinness. Once the cocoa is incorporated, stir in the guinness mixture, making sure to scrape the sides of the pan. Cook until the mixture starts to bubble. Add the anchiote powder, cardamom and szechwan pepper. Return pork to the pan with a tight lid and simmer on low for 30 minutes. Taste and test for seasonings, adding more if necessary adjust for your specific tastes serve with your favorite mexican dish, such as enchiladas, guacamole, sour cream or salsa.

title: Spinach Saute
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter or margarine | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 cardamom pods | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach leaves ( thawed )
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in salt, garlic salt, and cardamom. Stir in spinach. Cook until heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Rice with Hazelnuts and Green Peppers (Arroz a La Mexicana)
ingredients: 1/2 cup long grain rice | 6 tablespoons ground hazelnuts | 2 large green bell peppers, diced ( with or without seeds, about 4/10 cups )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 c of water to a boil. Add rice and hazelnuts. Return to a boil and reduce heat to simmer, covered. Cook until rice is tender, about 35 - 45 minutes. Stir in green onion.

title: Baked Chicken with Mushrooms and Avocado
ingredients: 100 g french bread | 2 teaspoons arrowroot | 500 g roasting chickens | 3 -4 medium portabella mushrooms | 3 -4 spring onions | 3 avocados
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c place bread on an oven tray. Place chicken on and cut the meat off the bones and put into a large roasting tin. Tear off the ends of the mushrooms so they stand straight together. Cut spring onions into long slices and place all ingredients into a large bowl. Put the chicken into the bowl with everything you set aside from the bread. Toss everything together until they're really well combined. Bake for around 20 minutes, testing that the chicken is done when it's cooked through. Take out of the oven and place onto a chopping board and take the bread out of the oven and place into the bowl with everything else already in the bowl. Mix everything together really well and put back in the oven for a further 20 minutes or so, until they're a crisp, golden brown colour on top.

title: Quick Pad Thai
ingredients: 4 tablespoons mild chili paste | 4 ounces dried flat rice noodles ( pad thai noodles )
instructions: Place rice noodles in a bowl. Heat a pot of water over medium high heat until boiling. Stir together chili paste and chili paste in a small bowl.

title: Molasses Dip for One
ingredients: 2 large poblano chiles | 4 ounces diced baked hamburger | 4 medium shallots, finely chopped | 8 ounces tomatoes with jalapenos, finely diced | 1 pimento pepper, finely diced | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/2 cup yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 500f. Line a baking sheet with foil and place the poblano peppers, cut side down, directly on the baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes, cut side down, until charred all over. Allow to cool. Place in a plastic bag and let them sweat for 5 - 10 minutes. Remove and discard skins and seeds. Cut peppers in half, then into 1/4 slices. Set aside. In a skillet over medium heat, fry hamburger and shallots in the molasses until meats are cooked through and the shallots are softened. Transfer to a bowl and mix in the roasted poblano chiles, diced tomatoes and the olives. Stir in the yogurt. In a large glass baking dish, spread the dip. Top with papertowels. Cover with foil, and bake for 15 minutes at 500f, then uncover and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until the top turns a little crusty.

Random Ingredients: onion,rigatoni pasta,turmeric powder,golden mushroom soup,white vinegar,meat,yellow squash,mint leaf
title: Ragout    With  Yellow Squash and  Meat
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs meat, stewing pieces ( beef, beef stew meat, poultry, beef, etc. ) | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 large onion, chopped | 2 ounces fresh mint leaves, chopped | 3 medium yellow squash, thinly sliced | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Start by boiling the rigatoni for 7 - 10 minutes until cooked, drain and set aside. Cut meat into 1 inch cubes and set aside. Heat oil over medium high heat in a dutch oven until it is to your preferred size. Add onions and cook until slightly transparent. Turn heat to medium and add meat. Cook until meat has browned. About 5 - 10 minutes. Add the meat, cinnamon, turmeric, bay leaf, water, mint, squash, soup and 2/3 of the cheese. Stir well and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 2 hours or until squash is tender and meat is well cooked. Remove the bay leaf. Taste and correct seasoning. Serve over hot rigatoni.

title: Polish Beet, Squid, and Sun Dried Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 whole bunch fresh beet, cleaned and trimmed | 8 fresh dill pickled bay scallions ( about 12 inches long ) | 5 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained ( not packed in oil ) | 1 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, blanch the beets until just tender. Remove the beets with a slotted spoon, and immediately immerse in ice water to stop the cooking process. Drain and pat dry with a paper towel. Cut off the tips from the corse and discard. With your fingers, scoop out the center of the beets, leaving just a little more than ¼ inch of greens around the outsides. Toss them with a little chicken bullion if you like. Place the beet greens on a platter, and mound the greens around them. Sprinkle on the scallions and sun dried tomatoes, and serve.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,chickpea,dough,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,israeli couscous,italian bread dough
title: Tuscan Chickpea & Chipotle Bread (Kirmizi Kafta) in Chipotle-Cous
ingredients: 4 teaspoons israeli couscous | 2 teaspoons sweet saffron threads ( about 2 tbsp ) | 1 1/4 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, finely chopped, about 2 tablespoons | 25 ounces chickpeas, rinsed, drained and cut into 1-inch chunks | shredded italian seasoned bread dough, for dusting | 1 -2 teaspoon crumbled chipotle pepper ( optional, to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Spray 2 large baking sheets with cooking spray and set aside. Place the couscous and saffron in a food processor.

title: Cold Pork Skewers
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 cucumber, cut into small sticks | 250 g white mushrooms, washed, ends trimmed | 100 g snow peas
instructions: Slice tenderloin in half lengthways. Remove strings or fat and cut into bite size pieces. Set aside. Slice cucumber sticks. Wash white mushrooms and cut into wedges. Place the meat and vegetables and brandy in a large container. Stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Thread the meat onto skewers. Preheat a barbecue to medium heat. Reduce heat to low. Simmer for 4 minutes per side for medium rare, or 20 minutes per side for well done. Serve immediately.

title: Warm Mexican Cheese Pops
ingredients: 1 gallon vanilla yogurt | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | taco seasoning | 1 -2 cup green, chilies | 1 carton vanilla ( or other flavor ) or ( 13 ounce ) carton whipped cream ( or other flavor )
instructions: Stir together yogurt, vanilla and taco seasoning. Pour into two pie dishes sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 300 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oat flour,coriander powder,dark soy sauce,black olive,tomato green chilies
title: Black Olive and Tomato Dip
ingredients: 50 g oat flour | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 100 g sliced black olives
instructions: Combine the first three ingredients in a food processor and puree. If too dry add a little water. Serve with fresh grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,purple cabbage,wheat germ,tahini,white mushroom,ricotta cheese,cherry
title: Chewy Baked Veggies
ingredients: 8 ounces white mushrooms, sliced | 10 ounces purple cabbage, sliced | 10 ounces white mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons wheat germ
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a bowl put tahini, ricotta and wheat germ and mix thoroughly. Spread in to shallow casserole dish. Put veggies in casserole dish. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper. Bake at 450 degrees until veggies are tender crisp.

Random Ingredients: tequila,chili bean sauce,taco seasoning,white flour,rigatoni pasta,sugar,oregano leaf,brandy
title: Cheese and Beer Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1 jar chili bean sauce | 3 cups light tequila | 3 cups sugar | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons oregano leaves | 1 cup white flour
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add rigatoni and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until cooked through. Meanwhile preheat grill. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the chili bean sauce, tequila, sugar, brandy, taco seasoning and oregano. Bring to a boil, stirring often, then remove from heat. When rigatoni is done, drain and place in a large bowl. Pour hot sauce over top.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,white,kidney bean,sirloin steak,garlic,blueberry
title: Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, sliced across the grain into very thin slices | 1 packet ra el hanout spice mix | 1 teaspoon chopped garlic | 420 g kidney beans, drained | 400 g blueberries, rinsed and dried | 1/4 pint fresh breaded redberry
instructions: Heat a griddle pan, fry the steak in the oil for 5 mins until rare. Remove the steak from the pan and put on a paper towel to drain. Add the garlic to the steak, cook for 1 - 2 mins until softened. Add the ra el hanout to the steak. Sprinkle over some of the crumbled roasted garlic, stir it all together and leave to allow the flavours to mingle. To serve add the blueberry to the steak and the ras el hanout and the chopped red berry.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,craisins,cumin powder,grain rice,wheat flour,double cream,thyme
title: Steak With Rice
ingredients: 3 lb sirloin steak, about | 1 cup uncooked long grain rice, washed | 1 cup craisins | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 3 cups double cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Place sirloin steaks in a 3 quart dutch oven, with any accumulated juices. Arrange craisins and thyme over beef. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 5 hours or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,root beer,sesame oil
title: Root Beer
ingredients: 8 ounces root beer | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon kosher salt black pepper
instructions: In a tall glass over ice, stir together the root beer, sesame oil, and salt and pepper. Pour the soda into the glass and let stand for 15 minutes to blend.

title: Dried Fruit Crumble
ingredients: 5 cups sweet corn flakes, crushed | 3/4 lb dried fruit, such as strawberries, prunes, cherries, peaches, apples, peaches
instructions: Preheat over to 400°f mix together cornflakes, fruit, and crumbs, tossing to coat evenly and thoroughly in oiled baking dish. Sprinkle top with remaining crumbs, and bake until lightly browned and bubbly, 1 1/2 hours and 15 to 20 minutes at 400°f. Remove and cool to room temperature, and store in airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: onion,rotel tomato chilies,black pepper,pita bread,nonfat milk powder,cannellini bean
title: Slow-Cooked Pita Pies
ingredients: 1 can diced rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 cup canned cannellini beans ( drained and mashed ) | 1/2 onion, finely chopped | black pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons low-fat nonfat dry milk powder | 10 pita breads
instructions: Combine the rotel, beans, onion, pepper, and milk powder in a slow cooker. Cook on low setting setting for 5 to 6 hours or on high setting for 2 to 4 hours. Turn slow cooker to high setting. Preheat oven to 400°f tear and separate the pita breads into pieces. Set up a large serving platter with pita pieces and pile on the tomato mixture in small stacks. Serve at once.

title: Simple Cheese Croutons
ingredients: 1 lb american cheese, cubed | 1/4 teaspoon dry instant chicken bouillon powder | 3 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place all ingredients in a food processor and process until all ingredients are mixed well. Drop by teaspoon onto a baking sheet and broil about 3 minutes or till cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Southern Yellow Squash Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 yellow squash, thinly sliced | 2 leaves lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces
instructions: In a large skillet, combine the vinegar and squash. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer 15 minutes or until squash is tender. Toss squash with lettuce and serve.

Random Ingredients: asian chili paste,salmon,pineapple chunk,serrano pepper,chickpea flour,mustard powder,harissa,cream chicken soup
title: Quick and Easy Samosas #2
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can chickpea flour | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon asian chili paste | 1 -2 serrano pepper, seeded and minced ( depends on taste ) | 1 can crushed pineapple chunks | 1/2 cup cooked boneless skinless salmon
instructions: Blend all the ingredients in a blender until desired texture and form a creamy paste. Pour into a deep soup or casserole dish. Heat in microwave or over medium heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Saffron Oat Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened rolled oats | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Microwave rolled oats and saffron pieces on high for 1 minute. Stir rice and spices into oats with cream. Microwave for 2 minutes and pour into a greased 8 inch square glass baking dish. Bake at 350°f for 20 minutes. Turn out of baking dish let cool on a rack and refrigerate 2 - 4 hours. Cut into 8 slices.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,rosemary sprig,bay leaf,duck,lemon juice
title: Marinated Roast Duck
ingredients: 8 ounces whole duck | 6 rosemary sprigs ( use for marination ) | 1/2 lb self-raising flour | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 4 bay leaves
instructions: Clean the duck. Place the duck inside a glass or ceramic oven roaster with the rosemary and coat with flour. Pour the lemon juice around. Add the bay leaves. Cover and leave at room temperature for 24 hours in a cool place, away from direct sunlight, for the best flavour of the meat. Turn at least twice daily. After two hours, remove from the oven and place on your carving board. Leave to rest for 10 minutes before carving.

title: Wild Turnips
ingredients: 1 large turnip | 3 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 tablespoon dried maraschino cherries | 3 drops raisins | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Peel turnip unless they're very old or older and cut larger chunks into chunks. Cover with cold water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Cover with cold water and soak overnight. Drain off liquid. Remove the turnip with a slotted spoon and place in large serving bowl. Cover with damp cloth and set aside to steam for 5 minutes. Using fingers press all water out of turnip and place into bowl with poppy seeds. Sprinkle with dried maraschino cherries, raisins and mirin. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,tamari,hot paprika,custard powder,thai red curry paste,pearl barley
title: Cassic Barley Barley - Microwave
ingredients: 225 g pearl barley | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 teaspoon custard powder | 1 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns
instructions: Place all the ingredients and whack the grains with a meat mallet or whack with the skewer. Cook on 100% power level for 10 minutes on a medium power level. Allow standing time of 2 minutes.

title: Linguine and Zucchini Con Carne
ingredients: 4 zucchini, cut into thin slices | 1 bottle guinness stout | 1 package linguine | 1 cardamom pod
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the zucchini slices for about 10 minutes, until they are tender. Stir in the guinness and cook for about 1 more minute. Meanwhile cook the linguine per package instructions until al dente. Drain. When the zucchini is almost tender, stir in the cardamom pods. Stir in the zucchini mixture. Remove from heat. Serve warm.

title: Canadian Bacon and Blueberry Bites
ingredients: 10 slices canadian bacon | 10 blueberries | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place 9 bacon slices into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with can of soup and can of vinegar. Cook until bacon is browned and breading is crisp. Remove from oven. Pour back into the baking dish and top with crumbled blueberries. Bake for 15 minutes or until melted and bubbly.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 3 tablespoons icing sugar ( sifted ) | 2 tablespoons orange juice, freshly squeezed
instructions: Mix the icing sugar, orange juice and sifted icing sugar until everything is well combined. Sift into a clean dry glass bowl. Refrigerate for a few hours, shaking the bowl regularly to stir and mix before using. Allow to set out for 20 - 30 minutes, then spread on toasted bread sticks for roasting.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,cardamom pod,oil,ranch bean,rye flour,beef broth,soy sauce
title: Rye-Style English Bread
ingredients: 3 cups bread flour | 1 cup rye flour | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1/4 cup oil | 1 tablespoon cardamom pod, lightly crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom pods | 1 carton beef broth | 1 can ranch style beans
instructions: Place all ingredients in the loaf pan in the order listed. Stir well. Let rise, refrigerate overnight. Roast at 400 - 350 until a toothpick inserted into the center registers 160 - 190 degrees f.

title: Loco Con Aceitun (Portuguese Bean Fish Stew)
ingredients: 1 package boneless pork hocks | 1 pound tuna steaks, cubed | 1 can chopped clams, drained | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Place pork hocks and tuna steaks in a skillet over medium heat, and pour in clam juice. Place the clams and raisins into the skillet.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,lentil,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,spaghettini,sun tomato oil,escarole,spanish onion
title: Spaghettini with Lentils and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 package spaghettini | 2 cups torn escarole | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 4 small spanish onions, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 small chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, seeded and finely diced | 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup lentils, rinsed ( may need more! )
instructions: Cook spaghettini according to package instructions. Rinse, drain and set aside. Meanwhile, in a separate large skillet or wok, heat oil over high heat. Add onions and sun dried tomatoes and heat until beginning to brown around the edges, stirring occasionally. Saute until onions are soft and beginning to color, about 2 minutes. Mix in the chipotle peppers and stir until fragrant, about a minute longer. Set aside. Rinse spaghettini and drain. Add to skillet with the onions and sun dried tomatoes. Stir to combine and heat through. Meanwhile combine the cornstarch and lentils and toss to combine well. Add cornstarch mixture to the skillet mixture and cook until the sauce thickens. The spaghettini should be thick but still slightly creamy. Serve mixture over pasta.

title: Fettuccini With Celery & Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine pasta
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling water until just tender. Drain pasta and return to pot. Cook and stir celery mixture over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Stir in fettuccini and remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: black bean,lemon peel,chow mein noodle,pineapple juice,asparagus spear,tabasco sauce
title: Asparagus Chow Mein
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus spear | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 cup low-fat pineapple juice | 4 drops tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 1 can chow mein noodles, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus and slice off the hard ends. Discard the stems and any tough outer woody stems. Steam or cook asparagus over boiling water for about 5 minutes. Drain water and set asparagus aside. In a skillet add the lemon peel and lemon juice.

title: Moroccan White Beans
ingredients: 5 cups white beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cups basmati rice | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place everything except rice in a crock pot except rice. Place rice on top and cook on high heat for 5 hours. Then cook on low for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Nepperoni Rice Nests
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked rice | 1 can fire-roasted tomatoes | 4 pepperoni slices | 1/4 cup moscatel vinegar | 2 cups shredded pepperoni
instructions: Place rice in a bowl, and pour in the tomatoes, pepperoni and vinegar. Toss lightly to mix well. Place on an attractive platter or individual serving plates, and pile some crushed pepperoni slices on top. Serve hot.

title: Mushrooms Stuffed With Truffles
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom, cleaned and stems removed | 2 cups fresh breadcrumbs ( or 1 loaf ) | 1/4 cup mineral water ( or 1/4 cup water and 1 tsp. lemon juice )
instructions: Cut the mushrooms in half, and take out the hard mushroom stems and stuff them with the stuffing of the mushroom. Add the bread crumbs and mineral water to the mushroom. Stuff and sew the mushrooms into little, but snugly, egg shaped pieces. Sprinkle with a little of the remaining bread crumbs. If any water remains on the pieces, soak them for an hour or two in the sun or in a very hot oven. Serve them as small as possible, drowned in butter with a little of the surrounding cheese and vinegar. They may be eaten hot or cold, as they are, or at room temperature.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian dressing | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 lb medium shrimp, unpeeled | 1/4 cup finely shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | rice or pasta, of your choice
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add shrimp and cook 3 to 5 minutes or until pink. Drain shrimp and set aside. Bring dressing, sugar and shrimp to a boil. Reduce to simmer. Cook 20 minutes or until shrimp are opaque and shrimp are cooked through. Taste and stir in cheese. Ladle into 4 wineglasses.

Random Ingredients: baguette,thyme sprig,peach,rice vinegar,herb,red pepper sauce,red potato,tomato puree
title: Potato, Tomato & Peaches Bruschetta
ingredients: 3 large red potatoes, cut into chunks | 3 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 ripe tomatoes, cored and chopped | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon good quality sweet red hot pepper sauce, such as sambal oelek | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 2 ripe peaches, halved and sliced | 2 slices baguette, halved and toasted
instructions: Place the potato pieces into a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to the boil over high heat, and then simmer for 20 minutes. Drain, and then stir through the thyme and tomatoes. Season to taste. Preheat the broiler, and position a rack 4 - 5 inches from the heat. In a small bowl, stir the vinegar, red hot sauce and tomato puree. Toast the baguette under the preheated broiler until golden and crisp, about 2 minutes. Drain, and place on serving platter. Spoon the tomato mixture over the toasted baguette, and sprinkle with the peach slices. Serve at once.

title: Veal, Fruit and Coconut Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb scallion, sliced thin | 1/2 cup white raisins or 1/2 cup sultana | 2 cups raw unsweetened dried shredded coconut
instructions: Cook ground beef or turkey or pork, till well browned. Set aside to cool slightly, chop very fine and then mix with all the other ingredients. Chill well. Note, for those of you who like more of this recipe, you can use 3 tablespoons of coconut paste to moisten the mixture and add some chopped raisins, nuts or whatever else you like.

title: Cremini Shroom Fried Rice Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces rice noodles | 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: In large bowl, stir together noodles and mushrooms. Stir in coriander. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Heat oil in 10 inch skillet. Drop noodles in hot oil in a slow, thin stream.

title: Green Cardamom Cheese
ingredients: 10 green cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 cup cheese, grated
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a small bowl and mix well. Spread the cheese onto a greased tray approximately 2cm thick. Broil the cheese until golden brown.

title: Skewers
ingredients: bread, cut into 5 slices | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, sliced | 2 -3 limes, juice of
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and lightly oil it. Put a piece of bread in a bowl with the yellow sweet pepper.

Random Ingredients: coleslaw mix,serrano pepper,brown mustard seed,bosc pear,pastry crust pie,pecan
title: Bosc Nachos
ingredients: 20 bosc pears, halved and cored | 3 serrano peppers, sliced | 1/4 cup brown mustard seed | 1 tablespoon finely ground pecans | 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Place the halved pecans in a single layer onto the baking sheet. Bake at 425 degrees f for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. Sprinkle dijon mustard seed and minced peppcans on the bottom of a cereal bowl. Spoon 1 tablespoon of the prepared mustard seed mixture on top of the mustard seeds in the cereal bowl. Add coleslaw mix, 2 tablespoons of reserved dressing, and 1/2 cup of the reserved pecans. Stir to combine. Remove pecan mixture from bowl. Place the top of the cereal bowl on your right hand, and the bottom on your left hand. Turn the cereal bowl and the left hand over. Press the left and right back together, and press the mixture onto the cereal bowl again. Sprinkle pecan mixture on top. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven. The pecan mixture should be puffed and lightly browned. You want it golden brown on the top. While the mixture is baking, prepare your crust. When the mixture is done, remove the pie from the oven, and cut in half horizontally. Use a slotted spoon to remove any bread pieces stuck to the bottom of pan. Spread 1 tablespoon reserved dressing on the crust. Place two large spoonfuls of pecan mixture onto crust, and spread evenly. Top with a second pie crust, if desired. Place a toothpick in the center to keep the bread out of the oven. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned and bread is warm. The nachos can be served warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,french bread,white miso,shiitake mushroom
title: Miso Mushroom and Red Pepper Saute
ingredients: 1 cup white miso ( fermented soybean paste ) | 8 dried shiitake mushrooms | crushed hot red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 loaves french bread, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to a boil in a large saucepan, then stir in the miso until dissolved. Stir in mushrooms and chiles. Bring to a simmer, then remove from heat. Stir in hot red pepper until fragrant or hot. Serve over freshly made french bread.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,chicken soup base,spinach leaf,heavy cream,courgette,cooking spray,nutmeg
title: Spinach Bake
ingredients: cooking spray | 600 g spinach leaves | 1 courgette, cut into slices | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 tablespoons chicken soup base | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat over at 180c/350°f. Line a shallow ovenproof dish with baking paper. Spray spinach with oil. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Layer the spinach over the spinach in the dish. Arrange courgette slices in the pan to cover. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Combine chicken soup base and cream in a jug. Spoon over the spinach. Sprinkle with nutmeg and bake in the oven for 40 - 45 minutes.

title: Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 6 medium baking potatoes | 8 small fresh peaches | 2 -4 tablespoons cornstarch | 6 -12 slices bread or 6 -12 slices thick sliced challah
instructions: Wash, peel and slice the potatoes until they are 2/3 of an inch think size. Place potatoes in a greased bowl. Slice the peaches into thin wedges if they are large. Toss with 2 tablespoons cornstarch and sprinkle on top of potatoes.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,sake,whipping cream,graham cracker,pesto sauce,coleslaw mix,beef
title: P.f. Chang's Beef Kabobs With Basil Cream Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs flank steaks ( or use sirloin tip if you can get it ) | 2 cups prepared japanese flavored pesto sauce | 1/4 cup sake | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1/4 - 1/2 cup grated coleslaw mix | 1 cup prepared guarnseye preserves ( can be found at asian market ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups garbanzo beans, canned | 3 -4 graham crackers
instructions: Wash flank steak well, using a meat mallow or other sawing utensil, and slice across the grain into 1/4 in wide strips. Remove most of the fat from the steak and wipe out as much as possible. In a food processor mix together all sauce ingredients and process into a thick paste. Taste for balance of flavors. Heat grill to medium high, then put a heavy cast iron or other heavy skillet on heat. You want heat to medium high. Place the steak in pan and cook, turning so they brown evenly. They should take about 15 minutes to cook to desired doneness. When cooked, remove from pan and keep warm. Pour a small amount of oil or butter into pan. Heat it until smoking, then add a few ladlefuls of sauce into it, making sure to coat the bottom of the pan. Stir in some minced lettuce and onions. Continue cooking until a few more ladles of sauce are evaporated and onions are browned. Toss in a few cooked garbanzos and some cooked steak cubes. Continue cooking until desired doneness of steak and flavors are blended. If any beef cubes are left on the steak add them back to the pan just once just to heat them. Serve the kabobs over warmed japanese white or brown rice. Garnish with fresh basil and fresh sliced peaches and a dollop of prepared guarnseye.

Random Ingredients: pepper,garlic clove,broccoli floret,dijon mustard,oyster sauce,scallion,active yeast,rotini pasta
title: Beef and Broccoli Lovers Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steaks or 1 lb top round steak, cut into about 2 inch cubes | 2 packages frozen broccoli florets, defrosted | 1 package rotini pasta, pasta | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 tablespoon dried scallions, including green tops | 1 -2 tablespoon active dry yeast
instructions: In a large dutch oven, on medium high heat, brown the meat in the dutch oven, using 1/3 cup of the oil. When the meat has browned for about 5 minutes, remove the meat with a slotted spoon to a paper towel lined plate. Add the remaining oil in the dutch oven to the drippings. Add the pasta to the oil and saute for about 3 - 5 minutes. Drain the pasta, set aside in a colander. Add the broccoli to the hot oil and saute until tender crisp, about 4 - 8 minutes. Push the broccoli to the side of the pan and add the rest of the sauce ingredients. Let them thaw slightly before stirring. Add the noodles to the sauce and bring to a slight bubble.

title: Stilton and Peppers With Onion Crust
ingredients: 4 ounces stilton cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons onion powder | 1 small yellow bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f degrees. Finely chop cheese, and stir in onion powder with the bell pepper. Spread the cheese mixture evenly in 2 baking dishes lined with parchment paper bake at 450 for 15 - 20 minutes while it's still hot and bubbly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,portobello mushroom cap,chili powder
title: Mexican Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms (Aka Stuffed Portobello Caps)
ingredients: 12 large portobello mushroom caps | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( or less if you have it ) | 1 red yellow bell pepper, halved, seeded and halved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. Place the mushroom caps on a piece of foil and sprinkle with the chili powder or both. Drizzle the mushroom mixture with one quarter of the olive oil and a pinch of salt. Place on the rack in the oven and bake for about 20 minutes. Remove and place on a warm plate. Place the bell pepper halves on top of the mushrooms and return the pan to the oven. Cook until the peppers are soft to the touch, about 10 minutes or so, depending on the size of the mushrooms.

title: Spicy Mexican Sausage Mix - Gift Idea for Home-Style Dogs #A1
ingredients: 2 cans chorizo sausage | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup sriracha sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees fahrenheit. Open cans of chorizo and drain on paper towels. Combine all ingredients in bowl and stir. Line a baking sheet with foil. Using a toothpicks, make a long slash in each sausage's center with 3 - 4 inch length of the sausage. Bake at 500 degrees fahrenheit for 7 - 10 min, or until cooked through. Allow to cool slightly and serve. If a gift idea just drop an hazelnut into the sausage for a cool appetizer or snack. For a quick snack, try dipping it into the sriracha sauce for a cold appetizer.

title: Baked Chicken Wings With Feta
ingredients: 1 package chicken wings | 1 medium onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon feta
instructions: Clean and dry the wings. Sprinkle them with salt and put them on a baking tray. Spray with oil spray, pour in the warm oyster sauce and sprinkle the onion and the salt and pepper over them. Bake at 350°f for 35 minutes, or until the chicken is tender and the onions have turned golden brown.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,soymilk,lime leaf,thyme,chinese five spice powder,arborio rice,purpose flour,veal stock beef
title: Thyme and Prawn Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 400 ml soymilk | 1 1/2 tablespoons chinese five-spice powder | 800 g king prawns ( raw peeled, deveined ) | 4 -5 fresh thyme ( chopped ) | 1 fennel bulb ( medium-large, chopped ) | 1 lime leaf ( fresh, washed, dried & chopped ) | 2 cups arborio rice
instructions: Sift the flour into a large bowl & place aside. Bring the soy milk to the boil & add the chilli & spice powder. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Add prawns w/the thyme & simmer for approx 3 minutes. Stir in the fennel & lime leaf and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,mango chutney,mace,white bean,pistachio,cauliflower floret,thyme sprig,baking soda
title: Indian White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained or 1 1/4 cups cooked white beans, rinsed and drained | 8 ounces of diced fresh tomatoes or 8 ounces canned diced tomatoes, drained | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon mango chutney or 1 tablespoon apricot jelly | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 large cauliflower floret, finely chopped | 6 fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon crushed thyme ( add more if using dried ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup of chopped salted pistachios or 1/2 cup chopped cashews
instructions: Heat white beans over low heat in small saucepan or microwave oven until heated through, about 3 to 5 minutes. Mix together. Add tomatoes, yogurt, chutney, baking soda, and mix until well combined. Add cauliflower, thyme, and nuts. Toss gently until everything is mixed together. If you have a thickener like a cornstarch, you can add in a little bit of hot water. Serve with toasted grated cheddar cheese, bread, crackers, etc.

Random Ingredients: mint,olive oil vegetable,blueberry,pork sausage,cream tartar,sandwich bread
title: Blueberry-Stuffed Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs pork sausage, casings removed ( or use ground beef or a mixture of both - i use turkey sausage ) | 1 can sliced ripe blueberries, with juice | 1/2 cup reduced-fat sour cream or 1/2 cup yogurt | 2/3 cup light olive oil or 2/3 cup vegetable oil | 3/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 12 sandwich bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper. Bring a large dutch oven or other deep skillet with a tight fitting lid to a boil over medium high heat. Add the pork sausage and cooked sausage to the pan with the juice and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in the blueberries. Remove from heat and set aside. In a small bowl, whisk together sour cream, oil, and cream of tartar. Pour over the filling in the pan. Return to a boil and stir until thickened, about 10 minutes. Spoon a scant 1/2 cup of the mixture onto each bread cube, and place on the parchment covered cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Crunchy Bread and Butter Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine, softened | 8 slices day-old bread | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro | 2/3 cup white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 1 loaf rye bread, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Coat an 8x8 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Spread margarine on one side of each slice of bread. Arrange slices in a single layer in pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place a cilantro leaf on top, and top with remaining slices, leaving a 1 inch border around the edge. Combine sugar, almond extract, and lemon peel in a small bowl until thoroughly mixed. Distribute sugar mixture evenly over bread mixture. Cut bread cubes into pieces, and arrange in a single layer on top of bread mixture. Cover the loaf with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until bread is lightly browned, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,tomato green chile pepper,shrimp paste,poblano chile,brandy
title: Rice Noodle Soup with Poblano Chile and Shrimp
ingredients: 1 poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup light tomatoes and green chile pepper sliced | 1/4 teaspoon shrimp paste | 1/2 cup brandy | 4 ounces rice noodles, rinsed and drained
instructions: Place poblano pepper, tomato, chile pepper, shrimp paste, and brandy in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. Break shrimp paste into small pieces with a spoon. Puree soup and shrimp paste in a food processor or blender until smooth. Reheat soup. Serve with noodles.

Random Ingredients: parsley,asafoetida powder,grain rice,pork bean,vegetable oil cooking spray,meat
title: Samyama's Crock Pot Biriyani
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 lb ground meat | 1 can pork and beans ( rinsed and drained ) | 1/2 cup long grain rice | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | fresh parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet and brown beef quickly. Add in beans and cook until done. Add in rice and spices. Cook on low 4 - 6 hours or on high 2 - 4 hours. Serve hot with fresh parsley.

title: Zinfandel-Turnip Polenta Wedges
ingredients: 2 lbs zinfandel wine, can be replaced with other mild red wine ( the traditional way to do this is just to reduce the alcohol content of the wine. but it can also be replaced with white grape syrup ) | 1 large turnip, peeled, cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks, but not too cut | 1/4 cup polenta | food coloring, to desired tinting ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: Put the zinfandel, turnip, and polenta into a large crock. Add food coloring. Stir to mix and let stand. The water should be boiling rapidly, and the polenta should be completely dissolved. Then stir again to dissolve and add water to cover. Cook on low for about an hour with no water at all. Turn off crock and let sit another hour until the polenta has absorbed all the water. The longer it stands, the water it produces will dissolve back into the solids a bit, allowing the sauce and polenta to be dense. Put polenta dough onto a plate, cutting off pieces, and refrigerate, covered, at least an hour and up to 1 week. Turn out onto 2 platters. Cut polenta wedge into 6 - 8 wedges. You can also make the wedges by slicing them horizontally through the center of the wedge, with a sharp knife, if desired. Some ideas, instead of polenta, instead of making the wedges, you can also make polenta dough with 3/4 tsp of salt, 1/4 tsp of garlic powder, and 1 tsp of cinnamon all in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,coriander seed,part mozzarella cheese,white wine vinegar,lemon peel,prawn,creme fraiche,cardamom pod
title: Torta de Prawn (Fried Prawns)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs prawns, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 cup coriander, coarsely chopped | 8 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 3/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Place prawns, fennel, and coriander seeds in a medium saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often. Drain. Place vinegar and 1 1/2 cups water in a small saucepan. Stir over medium heat until all the water has been absorbed, and simmer for 5 minutes to reduce.

title: Shrimp En Bleu - Shrimp on the Paper
ingredients: 2 sheets unsalted puff pastry | 1 lb shrimp, cooked ( peeled of all shell and veins )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Put shrimp on a sheet of parchment paper on your work surface. Divide shrimp between two sheets of pastry. Roll dough into a 12 inch circle, keeping the edges clean of the pastry with a rolling pin. Place 1/2 tsp of shrimp in the center. Roll the pastry around the shrimp. Wrap tightly in the paper and place on a baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining pastry and shrimp until all the shrimp are gone.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,sirloin steak,jicama,yellow pea,oregano leaf,mung bean sprout,raspberry,sugar
title: Beef Cubes With Jicama, Peas and Oregano
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin steak | 1 lb mung bean sprouts ( i used jicama ) | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves, chopped, divided | 1 lb jicama, peeled ( about 3 cups ) | 1 cup frozen yellow pea, thawed | 1/4 cup raspberry liquor or 1/4 cup strawberry jam | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/4 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: Place steak in a shallow laced dish. Combine 1 t of oregano with the chopped oregano, and toss well over steak. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Meanwhile, snap ends off of mung bean sprouts. Coarsely chop the beans, jicama, peas and tomatoes. Drain steak. Heat skillet over medium heat and grill steak until medium rare, about 7 minutes per side. Transfer steak to cutting board. Stir remaining oregano, jelly, remaining oregano and sugar into skillet. Cook until thickened, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Serve steaks with dressing for dipping.

title: Totally Deliciously Decadent Bulgur With Chocolate
ingredients: 1/4 cup bulgur | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 teaspoon grated cardamom pod | 1 1/4 cups low fat ricotta cheese | 1 -4 ounce dark chocolate, melted
instructions: First step you want to do is mix bulgur and the cumin. Second step you want to take the bottom of a double boiler, add boiling water to cover the bottom. Place a bowl on top of the double boiler and bring the water on top to the boil. If there is any sign of starting to clump just add water a teaspoon at a time. Stir once or twice until all is mixed and is a thick porridge like consistency. Meanwhile whisk the ricotta cheese until the texture is creamy. Remove the bowl from the double boiler and add melted chocolate. Mix until combined and then adjust seasoning. This should be a creamy consistency. When everything is combined well, place the bowl in a serving bowl and set aside overnight or for about 1 - 2 hours to allow the chocolate to really set. Enjoy.

title: Creamy Parsnip and Coconut Pancakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain soymilk or 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 400 g shredded parsnips | 600 ml coconut cream
instructions: Combine the milk and soymilk in a medium size bowl, stir till just warm.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,floury potato,green food coloring,vidalia onion,grape leaf,baking soda,coconut milk
title: Easy Baked Irish Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb small russet potato | 2 lbs small green fingerling potatoes | 16 ounces coconut milk | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup floury potato | 2 medium vidalia onions | 1 1/2 cups bottled grape leaves or 1 1/2 cups fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender, drain. Cool slightly and puree in blender or food processor until smooth. Cut fingerling potatoes in half crosswise, about 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 inches wide. Place cut side up in baking dish at least 1/2 inch thick and let stand about 30 minutes while prepping other ingredients. Drain grape leaves and rinse lightly from the water. Dice onions finely. Combine potato puree, onion and grape leaves in blender and puree until smooth. Stir in grape leaves. Stir in enough coconut milk to make the potato mixture moist but not too sweet. Pour into baking dish and bake in 350f oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until center appears set in middle. Serve hot with sour cream or chutney.

title: Cheese Fritters (Churrasco Fritters)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/4 ounces manchego cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan over a medium heat. Add cheese and cook for 2 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,cranberry juice,garbanzo bean,black olive,bread machine yeast,allspice berry,virgin olive oil,tomato
title: Cousin Cosmo (Paneer)
ingredients: 1/4 cup cranberry juice | 1 teaspoon allspice berries | 2 bread machine yeast | 4 1/4 cups peeled and diced tomatoes ( about 36 medium ) | 1/2 cup chopped green cabbage | 10 black olives, pitted and sliced -about 2 teaspoons, or to taste | 2 teaspoons virgin olive oil, divided | 1 1/2 cups garbanzo beans, drained
instructions: Line a baking sheet with a double layer of plastic wrap. In a small bowl, combine cranberry juice, allspice and bread machine yeast. Let sit 7 minutes. Add tomatoes, cabbage, 1 pinch salt and 1/2 cup water.

title: Portuguese Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon cubes | 6 -8 cups shredded cabbage
instructions: Mix chicken bouillon w/refried beans/ cabbage. In separate skillet with cover, cook cabbage until clear. Do not brown. Stir and add to refried beans. When heated through, mix. Serve on brown or white rice.

title: Cabbage, Mushroom, and Hamburger Bake
ingredients: 1/2 large head cabbage, cut into 2-inch wedges | 1 -2 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon | 2 cans sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1 lb hamburger | corn cereal | 3 -4 tablespoons breadcrumbs, or as needed ( optional ) | nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to broil. Arrange cabbage in a baking dish or 9x9 in baking dish. Sprinkle bouillon over cabbage.

title: Peaches and Peaches
ingredients: 1/2 lb peach | 1 teaspoon orange rind, grated | 1 tablespoon ice water
instructions: Boil water in a saucepan, add the peel and the orange rind and simmer for 10 minutes. Pour the boiling water over the peel and the peaches and stir gently. Cook for another 3 - 8 minutes, the fruit should be tender. Take the pan off the heat. Cover with a dish towel or a lid, and let the peaches sit in the hot water overnight, or at least for a few hours. The peaches will be dark in color, and soft and slightly mushy. Remove the peel and rind very easily from the peaches, and cut into halves or quarters.

title: Mandarin Butter Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 4 cans condensed chicken soup base | 1 can mandarin oranges ( with peel ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla flavoring | 1/2 cup fresh fruit
instructions: Place in large pot on medium heat, until butter melts. Stir in all ingredients except fruit.

Random Ingredients: sage,whipping cream,self raising flour,bean sprout,cream cheese,serrano pepper,vanilla extract
title: Chili Bean Sprouts Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups self raising flour ( depending on amount of flour used ) | 125 g cream cheese, room temperature ( or light cream ) | 15 ounces bean sprouts, in the jar, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh sage | 1/2 serrano peppers or 1/2 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f and grease 6 to 8 ramekins or custard cups. For the sauce, place cream cheese in a bowl and beat on medium speed until soft and fluffy. Add bean sprouts and sour cream, beat and stir until mixed well. Slowly add vanilla, sage and chile and beat for 3 or 4 minutes, or until smooth. Add flour gradually, and beat until smooth. You will need more than called for of the mixture. Divide batter equally among ramekins or custard cups. Place ramekins on a tray, and cook on the middle shelf of the oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until a skewer comes out practically clean when inserted inches.

title: Mexican Red Posole and Hominy
ingredients: 4 cups hominy, can use frozen or white hominy
instructions: Cover 1 1/2 2 cups of canned white or red onion with boiling water and bring to a boil. Skim off any impurities that float to the top. After 10 minutes, remove from heat and set aside to drain. After about 40 minutes, taste and add salt. Serve immediately, with corn tortillas, sliced green onions, cilantro, etc. Enjoy.

title: Burgundy-Style Cheese on Toast
ingredients: 2 slices part-skim mozzarella cheese, cut in half | 1/2 cup burgundy wine, such as burgundy style
instructions: On a cutting board, slice each slice of cheese 1/4 thick. Place a slice of cheese and a second slice of cheese onto one side of each slice of cheese and stack on top of previous two slices. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat using the cheese slice. When the cheese is just barely melted but not browned, use a spatula to transfer it to a plate.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,beer,soy sauce,asafoetida powder,apricot nectar,sesame oil,currant,bell pepper
title: Aceh Bali Burger
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 beer ( belgian endive ) ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dried currants ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon apricot nectar ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon asian herb seasoning | 1 bell pepper, washed, cleaned and sliced | 1 small red onion, washed, cleaned and sliced
instructions: In a small bowl combine a pinch asafoetida powder with beer and let stand for a few minutes. When the beer is nearly ready, add currants and apricot nectar and stir. Add the soy sauce, sesame oil and herb seasoning and stir thoroughly to mix well. Add the pepper slices and the onion and stir gently until they begin to wilt. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let flavors blend. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,chicken,salt pepper,cardamom pod,sage leaf
title: Chicken Pasanda (Chicken in Green Chilies)
ingredients: 6 ounces chicken, cut into 1 inch cubes for stir fry or chicken leg pieces for stir fry | 4 fresh chili peppers, washed, stems removed | 2 -3 fresh sage leaves or 2 -3 teaspoons dried sage | 2 cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: Wash and devein chicken pieces. Rinse with running water. Grind chicken to a coarse paste, using a mortar and pestle. In a large pan, heat oil. When hot, put in half the sage leaves, chillies and the remaining sage. Stir fry over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes. Add the chicken and continue to stir fry for 5 minutes. Add 2 to 3 tablespoons water. Cover again and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and cook gently, stirring occasionally for 15 minutes. Check salt. Simmer over low heat, stirring often until water has been reduced and gravy is thickened, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,shiitake mushroom,ricotta cheese,onion soup mix,raspberry,red wine vinegar
