title: Raspberry Cheese & Shiitake Mushrooms (Low Fat)
ingredients: 3/4 cup nonfat ricotta cheese | 3/4 cup shiitake mushroom ( shiitake caps with or without stems ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 lime, zest of | 1 tablespoon onion soup mix | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry
instructions: Soak shitake mushrooms in water 30 - 60 minutes then remove and reserve liquid. When they are dry, roughly chop them coarsely and stir in remaining ingredients. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Mexican Onion Spice Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon red chili pepper
instructions: Combine and store in the refrigerator. Stir before using as directed by recipe.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust pie,caraway seed,ginger garlic paste,peach,garam masala,american cheese
title: Peach and Cheese Samosas
ingredients: 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1 pound fresh peaches - peeled, pitted and sliced | 2 1/2 teaspoons caraway seed | 2 teaspoons ground ginger garlic paste | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 slices american cheese, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix lemonade, peaches, caraway seed, ginger garlic paste, and garam masala. Spray a baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Spread half the apple mixture in the bottom of the pastry and top with half of the cheese. Sprinkle with remaining apple mixture. Cover with remaining pastry and crumb topping mixture. Trim and cut four slits in top of each pie to vent steam. Bake in preheated oven until top crust is browned, 12 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sauce,shell pasta,puff pastry,beef rib,marjoram,hot chili sauce,date
title: Easy Beef Shortcrust Pasties
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets | 1/2 lb shortcrust sweet roll pastry | 2 cups beef ribs ( cooked & cut into small pieces ) | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh marjoram | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 3/4 cup shortcrust frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Place one sheet frozen puff pastry into a plastic bag and unroll, leaving 5 inch long strip of pastry on each sides. Cover with a second sheet of ice and lightly lightly flour, then gently pound pastry out onto a clean, flat surface. In a bowl, combine shortcrust and chopped marjoram, 2 tsp hot sauce, and 1 tsp hot sauce. Drain meat & beef, and mix with marjoram mixture. Pour into center of each pastry strip. Roll pastry edges inward to enclose meat mixture. Place on a baking sheet, seam side down, and chill for 15=20 minutes. Cut pastries into 8 equal pieces, or shape each piece into a ball. Roll out balls again into 8 equal pieces, pressing each piece on a lightly floured surface. Trace 1 short piece of pastry on each edge of each pastry ball and place one pastry ball on the short piece of pastry. Pinch edge of pastry to seal. Repeat with remaining dough & shortcrust pastry balls & shortcrust pastry, placing each pasty ball on the dough. Bake in a preheated 375f oven for 12 - 14 minutes, or until pastry is light golden. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,grape tomato,vanilla bean,mustard,white vinegar,brandy,self raising flour,raspberry vinegar
title: Raspberry Mustard - Low Fat!
ingredients: 500 g self-raising flour ( all purpose ) | 50 g fresh picked mustard ( dijon mustard ) | 100 g clear honey | 100 g white vinegar | 1 vanilla beans or 1 tablespoon vanille-vanilla essence | 140 g seedless grapes or 190 g cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon clear honey or 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 liter raspberry vinegar ( use fresh raspberry vinegar as needed )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c/375f/gas mark 8 / 200c. Place all ingredients together in a large bowl and beat vigorously until you have a soft dough. Turn the dough out onto a board lined with parchment paper or lightly flour. Gently press into a round approx 1cm thick. Using a rolling pin, roll the dough to about 5 cm/about thickness. Cut into 6 wedges, using a 2½ - 3 inch round cutter or a glass. Place on a greased and lined baking tray. Leave to cool for about 15 minutes before slicing thick. Prick the bread with a fork and glaze with brandy or raspberry sugar. To serve, cut the bread into wedges and pile on a platter. Drizzle with a little brandy or raspberry sugar and enjoy.

title: The Devil's Food Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces bourbon | 3 -4 drops green food coloring | 1/2 ounce chili paste ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 ounces sweetened rum
instructions: Dip cocktail shaker in water and put contents into shaker with enough rum to make 2 1/2 oz of liquid. Shake and strain into glass, add whatever extras you like and chill until well chilled. Keeps.

title: Pollo Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans tomato sauce ( one can will do ) | 3 -4 limes | parsley | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Heat up the limes. Throw in all the other ingredients. If you like your sauce to be sweeter add more of the sugar or sugar and adjust as needed until you have a balance for your taste. Serve over cooked pasta that is also sticky.

title: Eggy Ribbon
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 4 egg whites | 1 pimento | 1 tablespoon pesto, basil | 8 dried figs | 5 ounces bittersweet chocolate curls ( or shaved with a vegetable peeler )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cornstarch and egg whites. Set aside. Finely grate pimento with pepper grater. Heat pesto and chopped figs in microwave until hot, about 1 minute. Pour into egg whites, mix very lightly. Pour into a shallow tray, roll up like a burrito and put in fridge to cool. Cut into 1/2 inch slices. Chop 1/2 teaspoon basil, mix with pesto and set in the fridge. In a small pan, pour melted chocolate and warm remaining pesto or the shaved chocolate. Stir continuously to blend smoothly. Spread over the top of rolled up cookies and let chocolate harden. Cut into small pieces and serve with extra cookies.

title: Homemade Croutons
ingredients: 8 cups flour | 1 cup semolina ( fine ) | 3 - 4 cups fontina or 3 -4 cups grated fontina
instructions: Combine the flour and semolina in a large bowl. Add half the fontina or fontina, and 1 1/2 cups more fontina and 1 1/2 cups of grated fontina, mixing thoroughly. Add the remaining fontina and grated fontina, and mix thoroughly. Knead the dough briefly, and press into a ball. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and rest for at least 20 minutes. Heat a heavy ridged griddle over medium heat. Cut each dough into 2 or 3 inch croutons, and arrange on the griddle. Cook for about 8 - 10 minutes, turning the croutons over a few times to brown on all sides. Transfer to a rack to cool. Repeat with remaining dough, adding more fontina and fontina as needed, to make each crouton dough into 6 sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,taco sauce,dark sesame oil,parsnip,clear honey
title: Easy Mexican Parsnip Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons clear honey | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/2 cup taco sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the parsnips with the sesame oil, honey, corn oil & taco sauce.

title: Tasty Tuna
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tuna in water ( i use the brown tuna with good results ) | 1 1/4 - 2 smoked pork sausage links ( optional )
instructions: You may use any meat on the table. It helps keep it all the way submerged in the water. This tuna can be packed for up to two days in the fridge before eating because it has better absorption of the water. Drain and use as needed throughout the day, preferably over night.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese | 1 lb cotija cheese
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan and add velveeta. Stir until cheese is melted and combined. Add cheese and stir until combined. Serve on crackers and use.

title: Indian Mix Up Salad
ingredients: 1 package mixed salad greens | 1/2 cup frozen green pea | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt ( to taste ) | 3 tablespoons skim milk powder
instructions: Place mixed salad greens, peas and ginger in serving dish. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Mix together milk powder and enough cold water to give a thick dressing consistency. Drizzle over salad. Serve at room temperature.

title: Homemade Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 quart dripping ( can be bought frozen mozzarella ball ) | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Cut ball of mozzarella dough into 1/2 to 3/4 inches wide slices. Heat flour in a saute or skillet to a boil. Stirring frequently, boil until mixture begins to bubble. The dough will begin to form long strings. Lift dough from heat and remove string. Place dough on a clean dry surface. Sprinkle with italian seasoning. Fold long sides of dough toward the center to look towards the center, overlapping them toward the center. Fold them in about one third of a minute until they look like bundles of loose, slightly flattened noodles. Place on a cookie sheet with parchment paper between towels. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 15 or 20 minutes until tender. Slice and serve hot as a dip or as a topping to crusty bread or spread with a mixture of your favorite cheeses.

Random Ingredients: rice paper,red pepper flake,demerara sugar,yukon gold potato,cherry tomato,broth
title: Garlicky Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato | 4 cups broth | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 8 round rice paper sheets | 8 cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons demerara sugar, divided
instructions: Place potatoes in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then simmer, covered, 25 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for a minute or two. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Drain potatoes and return to pan. Cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and cover with a plate to keep warm while preparing remaining ingredients. Remove skin from potatoes, then cut into 1 inch dice and set aside. Place potato water in a 2 quart oven proof baking dish. Place rice paper sheets in a sieve set over a large bowl and pour hot broth over them. Turn rice paper sheets in broth until all are moistened. Rinse dish to remove any stray bread pieces, then spread about 5 tablespoons of potato potato broth over it. Drain cherry tomatoes then place tomatoes on top of potato water. Cover dish and bake 20 minutes. Remove cover and bake 6 - 8 minutes more or until bread is crusty and potatoes are tender.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,yoghurt,bamboo shoot,black tea,achiote paste,pea,saltine cracker
title: Japanese Vegetable Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 3 cups frozen peas | 2 cans bamboo shoots, chopped | 3 tablespoons minced achiote paste | 2/3 cup fat free yoghurt or 2/3 cup greek yogurt | 2 1/2 teaspoons saltine crackers, crushed | 3 tablespoons black tea
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain well. In a bowl, combine the cooked noodles with peas, bamboo shoots, achiote paste, yoghurt and saltine crackers. Garnish with black tea.

title: Sweet and Tarty Jicama Salad
ingredients: 500 g jicama | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar ( or honey ) | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Place the jicama in a large ziploc bag with a tight sealing lid to keep moist for up to 4 days for very tender slicing. Shake off excess water and slice the jicama into 1 cm/2cm/ long by 4 5cm/1 inch/1 inch/1 cm/1 cm/1 inch slices. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,epazote,parsley flake,couscous,white pepper,berry,red chili pepper
title: Couscous With Berries and Chili
ingredients: 1/2 cup couscous ( can use whole wheat if preferred ) | 3/4 cup mixed berries ( frozen mixed berries are fine ) | 1/2 cup dried epazote ( cilantro, optional ) | 2 -3 fresh red chili peppers ( optional ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon white pepper ( or any to taste, i use lots! ) | salt | pita bread, warmed
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine water, and if desired chopped herbs from dried fruit. Add couscous and allow to soften for about 5 minutes. Transfer to microwave safe bowl and cover, cook on high for 3 minutes. Let stand for 3 minutes. Stir in cooked fruit and re cover. Microwave for 2 minutes approximately.

title: Saucy Fried Beans
ingredients: 1 can baked beans with tomatoes | 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: Mix beans and stewed tomatoes in a large frying pan. Do not stir in until heated through. Serve over hot rice and enjoy. For vegetarian use vegetable broth.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Mexican Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped apple | 1 tablespoon shredded sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | tortillas, warmed ( i prefer corn or wheat )
instructions: Arrange the scallops in a medium size nonreactive baking dish. Combine the remaining ingredients, mix well. Pour over scallops. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to 2 days. Preheat grill to high heat and lightly oil the grate. Remove scallops from marinade and grill over hot coals, about 5 minutes for medium rare, or longer, depending on the thickness of the scallops.

title: Green Pepper and Corn Chowder
ingredients: 6 ears fresh corn kernels ( about two pounds ) | 2/3 cup green peas ( see note ) | 3/4 teaspoon annatto seeds, lightly crushed or 1/4 teaspoon ground annatto | 2 1/4 cups peeled whole green split peas
instructions: Trim kernels from the ear of corn or buy kernels cut from cob. You could also use a food processor, finely dice the kernels from the cob.. Place the corn kernels, peas, and seeds in a 3 quart saucepan. Add enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often. Add the greenpeas and continue to simmer for 5 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,ketjap manis,fettuccine,creme fraiche,salt black pepper
title: Short Ribs With Fettuccine and Kahri
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs country-style pork ribs | 2 teaspoons salt & freshly ground black pepper | 4 tablespoons creme fraiche | 6 teaspoons ketjap manis | 200 g fettuccine
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Put the rack in the middle of the oven. Using a sharp knife, cut a horizontal cut through the thick ribs lengthwise down to one side of them to within 1/2 of the bone. This will split the ribs in half, resulting in more of a diamond shaped rib shape. Using a sharp knife, make 3 diagonal cuts through the ribs lengthwise, resulting in a total of 4 diagonal cuts of rib. Repeat with the remaining ribs. Spread the crème fraîche and kijap manis all around the cuts. Place the ribs into a large roasting pan and fill with water, about 1 cm/3, then put the pan on the middle rack of the oven. Bake for 3 hours or until the meat is cooked to your liking. When ready to use, drain off any excess water. Toss the pasta with the kijap mani sauce and serve.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,guacamole,enchilada sauce,veal,chicken broth,hot italian sausage,water
title: Easy Cheesy Veal Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cubes | 1 1/2 lbs hot italian sausage, casings removed | 1 jar enchilada sauce, divided | 3 cans fat-free evaporated milk condensed milk | 1 can chicken broth | 4 -6 tablespoons instant guacamole ( optional ) | water
instructions: Brown veal and sausage in dutch oven or large saucepan. In blender add enchilada sauce, water and condensed milk/coconut milk mixture, blend on low for 20 seconds, pour in large baking dish, cover with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator overnight. This will make it easier to work with. The next day remove plastic wrap and bake in preheated oven with foil in a 375 oven for 1 hour, remove foil before covering with foil. When cool enough to handle, slice and cover with foil and place in freezer until ready to use. Preheat oven to 350°f. Pour enchilada sauce in to 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with foil. When sauce mixture is cold put plastic wrap on top of foil and set aside. Put a few spoonfuls of meat sauce mixture over the meat sauce and set aside. In small bowl combine soup and water mix well. Pour soup mixture over meat sauce mixture and top with cheese. Bake for 40 minutes at 350°f. Yield. 2 servings. If refrigerated, put in crock pot for at least 4 hours or on low 4 - 4 hours. Note, i usually make a couple of smaller lasagna sheets to save time and to freeze in individual freezer ziploc bags. This way i can let the ziploc bags and the sauce mix mix into the lasagna.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,swiss chard,corn kernel,orange juice,jalapeno
title: Grilled Mexican Sausage With Swiss Chard and Oranges
ingredients: 8 links mild italian sausage | 8 cups swiss chard, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups orange juice, freshly squeezed | 4 large jalapenos, seeded and finely chopped | 1 cup fresh corn kernels
instructions: Cook sausages in 2 cups of water or hot water til done. Remove and cool. Wash chard, chop coarse. Combine chard, orange juice, jalapenos, and corn. Pour over cooked sausage. Serve.

title: Beef Skirt Steak With Vegetables
ingredients: 3 lbs trimmed boneless beef brisket | 2 tablespoons fat-free glaze ( such as balsamic ) | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 6 ounces bamboo shoots, sliced | 6 ounces beef brisket | 1 medium carrot, cut into slices | 2 tablespoons shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: Score 4 - 6 inch thick slits into brisket. Arrange in a large nonstick skillet. Brush with glaze. Place pan with brisket in preheated 325 degree oven. Bake, covered, for 2 hours. Remove from oven. Trim fat from beef. Combine beans and bamboo shoots. Cover, cook 1 hour. Remove beef from pan. Place vegetables in a serving bowl or platter. Add beef. Spoon sauce over meat. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Cucumber Salad With Hazelnuts
ingredients: 2 medium cucumbers, peeled and grated | 2 spring onions, cut into long sticks | 45 large olives, halved ( you can make your own from marinated olives such as aebles ) | 1 jar pimientos | 1/4 cup icing sugar ( confectioners sugar ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped hazelnuts ( optional ) or 1 -2 teaspoon other nuts, to sprinkle on top ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the grated cucumber, sliced spring onions and chopped olives in a bowl. Gently fold in your icing sugar. Chill well and serve with grilled meat, vegetables or pasta. Delicious as a salad spread with some butter or chutney.

Random Ingredients: peel,almond extract,flour tortilla,chicken stock cube,mexican oregano,chipotle chile,quinoa
title: Chipotle Quinoa Burritos
ingredients: 4 cups cooked quinoa, well rinsed and drained | 4 tablespoons chopped chipotle chiles | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped dried california dried oregano | 2 chicken stock cubes | 2 1/2 teaspoons ground almond extract | 4 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 ounce shredded mexican oregano
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine the quinoa, chiles, oregano, stock cubes and almond extract. Process until thoroughly mixed and set aside. Heat the griddle to medium high heat and lightly spray with a nonstick cooking spray or butter flavored cooking spray. Cook the quinoa burritos in batches over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes each side, until golden and crispy on the bottom, well browned on the bottom. Remove the cooked burritos to a platter and sprinkle with oregano. Use a spatula to serve.

title: Quizzy Spanish Rice #RSC
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 hard-boiled egg | 1 package ramen noodles
instructions: Boil a small pot over a medium heat with the ramen noodles stirring occasionally until the noodles are hot. Mix the ramen noodles into the quinoa, stir well and then cover until the noodles are warm. Once the quiona takes on the mood add the hard boiled egg into the quiona, stir well, and serve. Enjoy tastes better every day.

title: Canadian Bacon Wrapped With Peanuts
ingredients: 4 slices canadian bacon | 1 cup dry roasted peanuts, skins pressed
instructions: Wrap each piece of Canadian bacon snugly around a peanuts. Wrap with peanuts.

title: Rice Stuffed Green Olives
ingredients: 24 medium green olives, cut lengthwise in half | 5 -6 ham hocks, about 1 1/2 lbs ( boston is best ) | 1 1/3 cups arborio rice | fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Arrange stuffed olives on small serving platter. Slice tops off ham hocks, leaving 1/2 inch on sides. Rinse olives and pat dry on paper towels. Place a toothpick through slit in bottom of each olive, then insert a ham hock in each half. Sprinkle lightly with salt and bake at 400f for 20 minutes, or until rice is white and lightly browned. Remove ham hocks, place on serving platter. Sprinkle with mint if using.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,sesame seed,pie shell,chili powder,yellow pepper,chinese vegetable
title: Chinese Faux-Cherry Empanadas
ingredients: 1 lb frozen mixed vegetables ( cabbage, carrots, mushrooms, potatoes ) | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon sesame seeds ( optional ) | 1 small chinese vegetables, sliced ( optional ) | 2 unbaked pie shells ( optional )
instructions: Place the frozen vegetables, rum, chili powder, sesame seeds, and chinese veggies in a blender and puree it. Spoon into two pie shells and spoon 1/2 cup of the empanada puree into the pie shell. Make sure to use waxed paper, and moisten the top. Heat oven to 375°f. Bake pie for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Cucumber Samosas, Get Tasting Irishman Style
ingredients: 1 cucumber, seedless | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon finely chopped onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 ounces lager beer
instructions: Cut the cucumber in half lengthways and scoop out the seeds. Slice into about 6cm slices, and put in a bowl. Put the seeds and cornflour in a cup, and, with a wire whisk, whip them together with the sesame, onion powder, garlic and a couple of teaspoons of salt. Add the beer and mix well. Put the cucumber in the centre of a platter, and pour over the dressing.

title: Italian Lamb Chops for 2
ingredients: 4 lamb chops, 1/4 inch thick | 4 -6 slices of sliced pepperoni | 4 -6 cherry tomatoes | olive, pitted | grated hot pepperoni ( your choice ) ( optional ) | garlic paste ( optional ) | margarine ( optional )
instructions: Brush pan with olive oil and melt with margarine, add a few shakes of garlic, and then add sliced pepperoni to pan. Drain olives, chop cherry tomatoes into quarters, cut slices of onion, and add to pan. Cover and simmer for 1/2 hour or longer depending on how cut you like your chops. Remove cover, and add a few shakes of pepperoni to sauce. Add another shakes of pepperoni, a few shakes of garlic, and a shake of garlic. Serve over your favorite pasta, or with grilled, chopped, or poached chicken.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,head iceberg lettuce,shallot,green chile pepper,shiitake mushroom,coriander powder,worcestershire sauce,prawn
title: Shiitake and Spinach Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 pound shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 bunch spinach leaves | 2 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 1 green chile pepper, chopped | 1/4 onion, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 pinches coriander powder | 2 small head iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried and dried
instructions: Fill an 8 quart pot with water and bring to a boil over high heat. While the water is coming to a boil, place the shrimp in the boiling water and cook until just cooked through, 6 to 8 minutes. Drain the shrimp and place onto a plate with a slotted spoon, leaving behind as much water as possible. Tear the spinach leaves into 3 separate pieces with scissors or scissors if desired. Place into a separate bowl and set aside. Place the mushrooms into the boiling water and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes. Drain well. Chop the spinach leaves into strips and stir into the shrimp. Add the chile peppers, onion, worcestershire sauce, coriander and cooked mushrooms and set aside. Line serving bowl with lettuce leaves. Serve the dish with the shrimp salad, including more lettuce on top.

title: Lentils & Potatoes With Rice over Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups brown lentils ( can use yellow ) | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/2 - 3/4 cup grand marnier ( optional ) | 4 red potatoes, peeled and diced
instructions: Cook the rice and lentils according to the directions on the bag. While the rice is cooking, mix mirin and grand marnier in a small bowl. If rice is still slightly to thick, add more grand marnier or mixture of your choice until consistency just right. Add potatoes to rice and mix. Serve immediately.

title: Moroccan Chicken Wings in Lemon and Lime Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings ( drumettes, thighs or wings with drumsticks attached ) | 1 lime, zest of | lemon and lime, juice and zest of | watercress ( to garnish ) or parsley sprig ( to garnish ) | saffron ( to garnish ) | turnip ( to garnish )
instructions: Rinse chicken and place in a large dutch oven or roasting pan. Pour lime zest over the chicken, rind side up and evenly sprinkle with lemon and lime juice as you go. Cover and place in a 350°f oven. Bake for about 45 minutes or until done. If the chicken is still on top of the liquid, turn it in the oven about 1/2 hour after baking for 15 minutes. Turn off the oven and remove chicken to a serving platter. Leave the sauce in the pan, scraping pan with a wooden spoon and spoon to dislodge the brown bits from the bottom. Replace the lid and cook over a moderate heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. If the chicken and sauce are still liquidy, return the pan to the stove and stir in juice from the lime zest. Continue cooking, turning as needed. Serve over cooked pasta, garnished with watercress or parsley sprigs, and accompanied by a slice of turnip.

title: Spicy Lime Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into cubes | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1 lime, zest
instructions: Mix chicken and 1 teaspoon lime zest in a ceramic dish. Add cayenne to taste. Cover dish with plastic wrap, and marinate chicken in the refrigerator at least 2 hours or overnight, turning the mixture once. Reserve remaining lime zest for another use. Preheat a grill for medium heat, and lightly oil grate. Remove chicken from the dish, cover with the plastic wrap, and let stand about 5 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate, and peel off the plastic. Season with lime zest. Heat the grill to high. Place chicken on the hot grate, and cook 3 minutes per side, or until juices run clear. Serve, and garnish with lime zest.

title: Strawberries With Ricotta and Strawberries
ingredients: 1 pint fresh strawberries, cleaned and sliced | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Place sliced strawberries on a serving plate. Sprinkle ricotta over the top. Serve immediately.

title: Apple Toast with Raisins and Raisins
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut into thick slices ( can be found at specialty stores, if you can't get them ) | 1 large apple, such as granny smith or 2 small apples, such as rome, sliced thin | 1 cup golden raisin, cut into 1/4-inch slices ( about 3-8 cups )
instructions: Cook apple slices on both sides over medium head in a skillet coated with cooking spray until very lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Cut baguette into thick slices. Divide raisins among slices. Top with apple slices, then sprinkle with raisins over all. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red grapefruit,herb,peanut butter,key lime juice,italian herb
title: Italian Key Lime Peanut Butter  Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon key lime juice or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon sweet pickled red grapesfruit, chopped | 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs | 1/4 teaspoon dried mixed herbs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill before serving.

title: Pimental Pimenton (Spicy Almond Candy)
ingredients: 2 cups slivered almonds ( you can use regular ground almonds ) | 1 cup granulated sugar syrup | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract, plus 1 tablespoon
instructions: Heat the almonds in a small skillet over medium low heat, stirring frequently, until lightly browned and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Place the almonds in a bowl. Stir the sugar syrup, almond extract and ¾ cup of the almonds into the remaining almonds. Stir until well mixed. Pour into a greased or paper lined 8 square pan. Dip the candy in the remaining ¾ cup of almonds and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment or foil or foil. Sprinkle with remaining sugar. Cool. The candy can be kept, covered, for up to 2 days in the refrigerator..

Random Ingredients: lettuce,harissa,vanilla extract,ice,hot chili sauce,orange,onion juice,spanish onion
title: Spicy Tunisian Naan Dip
ingredients: 1/2 large spanish onion ( or any of youf 'd like ) | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract or 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons harissa | lemon zest ( or 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes ) | 1 -2 teaspoon hot chili sauce ( or more ) | shredded lettuce, to serve | cracked ice ( to garnish )
instructions: Finely mince the onion and place in a bowl. Add the orange juice, vanilla or tamarind paste, harissa, lemon zest/dijon and chili sauce and mix together thoroughly. Add lettuce to taste, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,lemon,canadian bacon,fenugreek leaf,beef brisket,coriander seed,champagne
title: Smoked Beef Brisket With Mustard Nuts and Garlic
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek leaves | 1 whole chipotle chile, finely chopped ( canned ) | 1/2 cup mustard nuts ( about 7 ounces, i make my own from gourmet brand ) | 2 -3 lbs beef brisket, trimmed of as much fat as possible | 1 lemon, halved
instructions: Melt the gourmet bacon in a pan using a low heat. Mix in the coriander seeds, fenugreek, chipotle and chilie pepper. Spread the mixture thinly all over the brisket. Cover and leave overnight in a cool place. Preheat the smoker or gas grill to 225 degrees f. Pat dry the brisket and, using a meat tenderiser or sharp knife, score the beef all over. Remove the brisket from the smoker, spread the mustard nuts and garlic on the brisket and leave until ready to go. Place the brisket on the hot coals side down. Cook for about 15 minutes, then turn off the grill and leave all the residual juices in the meat. Leave to stand for 20 minutes. Remove the brisket to a carving board, cover and keep warm. Strain the liquid through a fine mesh sieve into a saucepan and reduce it until it has reduced by half. Serve hot.

title: Cumin Marinade for Steak
ingredients: 1 can plum tomatoes | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1/3 cup dry sherry ( you may substitute apple cider or chicken or vegetable broth ) | 2 tablespoons reduced-sodium marinade ( see note )
instructions: Prepare grill, lightly oil the grate and set the coals to high. Put the plum tomatoes, cumin, sherry, and marinade in a blender along with any liquid released by the tomatoes and blend on high just until smooth. If desired, transfer the tomato mixture to a zip lock baggie. Seal the baggie and marinade steak. Grill steak until desired doneness is achieved, about 5 - 7 minutes per side for rare, about 7 - 9 minutes per side for medium and about 12 minutes per side for medium rare. Brush steak with marinade while grilling and serve.

title: French Quarter Shrimp and Wings (Shrimp Cocktail)
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 8 tablespoons sherry, divided ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cognac, divided ( optional ) | 14 1/2 ounces chicken wings, well trimmed, tips removed | 2 cups lightly packed fresh blueberries | 2 cups lightly packed sweet italian rolls | 2 teaspoons finely chopped spanish onions ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs jumbo shrimp, in shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Place panko in a large shallow bowl. In a small saucepan, combine 1/2 cup panko with 1/4 cup cognac.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,cilantro,white onion,mussel,shallot,chinese five spice powder,basil leaf,artichoke heart
title: Chinese Blackened Mussels
ingredients: 8 large fresh mussels | 1/2 cup chopped white onion | 1/2 cup minced shallot | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves | 1/2 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 cup packed chopped fresh cilantro | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro with leaf | 1 3/4 teaspoons crushed dried artichoke hearts | 1/2 cup delmonte cooked turkey breast, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook mussels in boiling water for 4 minutes. Discard any remaining mussels. Shell and debeard mussels. Discard beards any mussels that have broken shells. While mussels are cooking, prepare marinade combine onion, shallots, basil, five spice powder, cilantro, cilantro and artichoke hearts. Place a wok or heavy skillet over medium heat and stir in turkey slices. Stir fry 2 minutes. Add marinade and vegetables and cook 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cooked mussels. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,banana leaf,chinese five spice powder,tamari,cilantro leaf,lemon,couscous,taco sauce
title: Lemon Cilantro Rice Cake (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 cup couscous ( whole grain or couscous ) | 1 lemon, juice of | 4 tablespoons taco sauce | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 5 firm bananas ( about 2 1/2-pound or small ) | 24 -30 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly oil your bundt cake mold or line it with parchment paper. To prepare couscous, place water to boil in a medium saucepan. Add rice and boil for 5 minutes. Cover and let stand 15 minutes. Pour couscous through a sieve, pressing down firmly with a rubber spatula to remove any excess liquid. Chill for at least 4 hours or overnight. Drain and discard liquid. In either your measuring cup or another measuring cup, combine lemon juice and tamari. In a mixing bowl, combine the couscous, lemon zest, taco sauce, cilantro, and five spice, stirring to mix well. Cut in bananas, using the large end of a small, sharp knife. Carefully mound about 1 1/2 tablespoons of couscous in the center of the cake mold. Place 1 banana leaf on top of couscous in a spiral shape. Lift cake from the pan into the pan and remove parchment. Brush top with a little melted butter. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 25 minutes or until top is light golden. Turn off oven and leave cake inside to rest on a rack for 5 minutes.

title: Vegetable Enchiladas
ingredients: 10 flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Whip soya sauce and nutmeg to a frothy consistency. Pour 2 tbspn tosh onto each tortilla and spread the rest to 1/4 inch. Roll and place on parchment paper to dry for approx 10 mins or cook on grill under the grill until golden brown. Dip in soya sauce and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds if you like.

title: Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1/2 corn on the cob, frozen with husks | 2 green chilies, chopped
instructions: Soak the corn in cold water for about 30 minutes, and then drain and wash the cob well. Cut the kernels off the cob, and place cob on a grill pan that is about 5 inches in diameter with the side of the fire directly on the fire. To turn the cob over carefully place another side of the fire up, to be on the same shelf of the fire. Cook until well charred on one side and other side. Place a piece of tin foil on the stove top and set heat to medium high. Spray with olive oil or cooking spray. Add the corn to the boiling water and mix well. When the corn is ready to soften open it carefully but quickly, the corn needs to be stirred in slowly with your fork or a spatula. Do this quickly, so as not to let the liquid boil, as the kernels curl and the cob can burn, this can happen very quickly. If you do, immediately turn the heat down, leave about one inch uncovered on the griddle. Remove corn with a slotted spoon. When it is cool enough to handle, separate the kernels from the cob with a knife. Place green chilies in a serving bowl, and add some chilies to each bowl of corn. Add some of the corn kernels as a garnish on top.

title: Sizzling Red Pepper Soup
ingredients: 1 bunch scallion, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick slices ( white and light green parts ) | 1 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes, crumbled ( more for sprinkling ) | 6 cups vegetable broth | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except stock in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Stir in stock. Boil for 2 minutes, then remove from heat, cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. This can be served hot or cold, as the red pepper flakes can be added if desired.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,heavy cream,monterey jack cheese
title: Ginata (Savory Cheese)
ingredients: 3 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine grated cheese and cream and stir together with a whisk until blended. Brush a 9x9 pan with oil and spread cheese filling into pan. Bake 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Butternut Squash and Oyster Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 3 ounces cellophane noodles | 2 1/2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 fennel bulbs, sliced
instructions: Place squash, noodles and oyster sauce into a microwavable bowl, toss and set aside. Heat a wok over high heat, add olive oil, add fennel and stir fry for 4 mins until beginning to soften. Remove with a slotted spoon, and add to fennel mix. Toss, then serve.

title: Tropical Mango Dip
ingredients: 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 1 can canned mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 4 cups cubed processed cheese, divided | 1 jar reduced-fat italian dressing | 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon minced garlic
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the mushrooms, mushrooms, 1 cup cheese, italian dressing, molasses, cumin, and garlic. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, at least 1 hour. Serve with corn chips, crudites, or as a vegetable dip with tortilla chips.

title: Slowcooking Italian Sausage
ingredients: 6 pounds boneless pork butt, cut into 2-inch chunks | italian seasoning
instructions: Place pork, sausage or any meat on a piece of wax paper and rub it inches. Sprinkle italian seasoning over pork. Roll up and tie the ends with butcher twine. Cook sausages in a crockpot until cooked through. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,tomato paste,vanilla ice cream,banana,taco seasoning mix
title: Mexican Banana and Cranberry Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried cranberries ( can also use raisins, currants and/or chopped dried cranberries ) | 1 ripe banana, cut into thin slices | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 3/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 3 cups vanilla ice cream ( or 2 full-cup pints of ice cream. )
instructions: Put the cranberries in a small bowl, cover with boiling water, and let sit 5 minutes. Drain well and set aside. Using a potato masher, mash the cherries to a puree. Add the bananas, tomato paste and taco seasoning. Mix well and set aside. In a large nonstick skillet, put about a tablespoon of oil. When hot, add the cranberry puree. Toss to coat evenly and let simmer about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in the ice cream until it's completely melted. Serve over the ice cream.

title: Spinach Balls
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh spinach | 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup grated fresh lemon zest
instructions: Wash and chop the spinach, and steam it for a few minutes in a large pot of salted water until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Place the spinach in a bowl. Pour boiling water over to wilt. Let cool, then squeeze most of the excess water out. Set aside. Mix the flour, cocoa, and lemon zest in a bowl. Stir in the spinach and spinach mixture until evenly mixed. Roll the mixture into walnut sized balls and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Set the pan on a flat surface. Place a few walnut pieces on top of each one. Bake in a preheated 450 degree f oven until brown.

title: Spicy Vegetable Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, uncooked | 1 cup red cabbage, shredded | 1 cup blueberries | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1 rotel, diced | 1/4 cup pomegranate juice | 1/2 lb cooked meat
instructions: Cook rotisserie meat in skillet with pesto. Remove meat from skillet, let cool a bit and dice into small bite size pieces. Wash and finely shred red cabbage. Combine veggies and rice in a large bowl. In smaller bowl, add pomegranate juice, pomegranate seeds, cooked meat, etc. Pour the pomegranate juice over the rice mixture and stir well to mix. Serve warm.

title: Cherry and Onion Plough Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry bread, crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1/4 cup chopped cherries | 2 tablespoons chopped orange rind
instructions: Combine bread crumbs with onion powder and cherries. Toss remaining ingredients together. Shape into loaf. Place on rack in baking pan and bake at 325 for 30 minutes. Stir with fork and serve immediately.

title: Aromatic Christmas Crumb Cake from the Auberge
ingredients: 500 g italian breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla essence | 600 ml italian breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Grease a 10 inch sized ovenproof pie plate. Place the italian breadcrumbs in a mixing bowl, with the vanilla essence. Using an electric hand mixer, stir until the mixture is well combined. The breadcrumb mix should form a fine paste. Stir in the two teaspoons. Pour the mixture into the pan and sprinkle with the cardamom. Place in a preheated 200 c oven and bake for about 45 - 50 minutes until the top has become golden brown around the edges.

title: Rice Salad With Dijon Honey
ingredients: 1 cup corn | 1/2 celery rib | 3 tablespoons honey | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 1/2 cups rice, cooked
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the corn, celery and honey. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium. Cook, stirring frequently, until celery is tender. Remove from heat. Cool. Add mustard and rice and stir until well combined. Cover. Let stand 15 to 30 minutes at room temperature to let flavors develop.

title: Spaghetti and Pancake Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 package mascarpone cheese or ( 500 g ) package cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/3 cup mayonnaise or 1/3 cup salad dressing | 1 large chili, seeded and chopped ( red or green, your choice ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and place in a buttered or non stick baking pan. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the pancake appears dry and crisp when you lift the pancake out of the oven.

title: Indian Diner's Chutney & Rice
ingredients: 400 g basmati rice ( washed and drained ) | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon mango chutney ( natural yoghurt ) | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon cider vinegar
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. Chill and serve over hot cooked basmati rice.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1 green chili | 1 lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut eggplant crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Place slices in a baking dish, and brush with a little olive or canola oil. Season with a bit more salt, pepper, and or chili powder to taste. Roast the eggplant approximately 40 minutes, or until the slices are soft and lightly browned. Transfer the slices to a serving platter, and top with green chilie. Cover with lettuce, and serve.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,broccolini,salt black pepper,flour,spice,ice cube,heavy whipping cream
title: Smorgastry - Traditional Scottish Boiled Fish
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 2 lbs fresh broccolini ( or other larger green salad ) | 1 tart apple, such as granny smith, such as fuzzetta or other firm textured vegetable | salt & freshly ground black pepper | flour, for dredging | 8 ounces thinly sliced smoked streaky spice fish fish such as smoked fish | 2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Cut ends off one or more large bunches of clean Broccolini and coarsely chop into 2 inch pieces. Bring large pot of water to boil and add salt. Trim stalks from fish and cut into 3 inch pieces. Remove stalks, and discard. Bring pot to a boil. Add chopped fish and stir to coat. Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until fish is just opaque but not cooked through, about 5 minutes. With a slotted spoon, remove fish from pot and place with cooked broth. Cut remaining bunches in half, then divide into sections. Gently add 1/4 cup stock to pot to loosen any bits of white on underside. Bring stew to simmer while adding remaining stock. Simmer until stew is flavorful, about 7 - 10 minutes. Add sliced apple and 1/4 cup reserved fish broth. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground pepper. If not at your taste just season with a dash of sea salt and freshly ground pepper. Serve with a sprinkling of smoked fruit, such as lingonberry jam or other jam, for a special twist on poached trout. Note, this fish is often made with raw fish that has been gutted and deveined. The traditional way of making this with raw fish, is, use an 800&#8243.

title: Thai Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/2 cup chopped fresh pineapple juice | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon jalapeno chile, chopped ( seeded, if you can find it ) | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, minced | 1 lb cabbage, coarsely shredded | 3/4 lb cooked spaghetti
instructions: Cook the beef in a non stick skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Remove beef from skillet. Stir in basil, pineapple juice, chili sauce, jalapeno and ginger. Bring to a boil, stirring often. Add cabbage, cover and simmer until cabbage is almost tender, about 10 minutes. Add meat to cabbage mixture in skillet. Serve with spaghetti.

title: Peach and Pistachio Scones
ingredients: 3 medium ripe peaches, peeled, pitted, cut into bite size pieces | 1/3 cup ricotta cheese | 6 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 tablespoon finely chopped shallots, divided | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pistachios, divided | 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons self raising flour | lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/220c fan forced. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Using a sharp knife, gently mash the peaches into a rough pulp with a fork. Combine with the ricotta cheese and cream. Using a fork, stir in 2 tblsps shallots. Place 1 tblsps shallot on a piece of lettuce and roll it into a sausage shape, then slice into 6 - 8 rounds. Place 2 scone rounds on one tray and repeat with remaining rounds and filling. Using a pastry brush, lightly brush scones with the ricotta mixture. Gently fold in half diagonally. Scone scone side and spread with 1tbsp ricotta to cover the surface. Repeat with remaining scone halves and filling. Place scones on preheated tray and brush tops with the remaining soured cream and spread remaining 1tbsp ricotta on top of the scone. Bake in the oven about 40 mins or until golden.

title: Sangkhayeb
ingredients: 1 cup green lentils | 1/2 cup uncooked dried okra ( or frozen okra ) | 3 1/2 cups ham stock | 1 1/2 cups chocolate-flavored syrup | 3 cups quick-cooking tapioca
instructions: Wash, pick over, and remove damaged lentils. Pick over and discard damaged lentils, if necessary. Rinse and pick over the okra. Rinse and drain the water out of the lentils. Bring the ham stock and chocolate syrup to a boil over medium heat. Drain the okra and put into the boiling yogurt. Boil the okra for about 8 minutes. Drain and put it back into the pot, along with the lentils. Slowly stir in the tapioca, then place lid on pot, and turn heat to simmer. Cook for about an hour, or until liquid is absorbed. Cool, and serve.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,maraschino cherry,radish,spring onion,arborio rice
title: Apple Risotto With Parsley and Radishes
ingredients: 3 large golden delicious apples, peeled | 2 bunches spring onions | 1/2 cup arborio rice ( i prefer risotto risotto bolitas but any risotto will do ) | 1 cup maraschino cherry | 5 ounces radishes, peeled | 1 bunch fresh greens, washed and trimmed
instructions: Peel the apples and peel the onions. Place them in a large saucepan with the spring onions and rice to cover. Add water to just cover. Bring to the boil over high heat. Reduce heat, cover and simmer very gently for 10 - 15 minutes. Then stir in cherries. Divide the risotto into three bowls. Stir radishes into each bowl. When the risotto has finished cooking, divide among the plates. Dampen the greens with a little cold water and scatter with radishes. Serve warm.

title: Greek Yogurt Pasta
ingredients: 2 containers plain yogurt | 3 green olives, pitted and sliced into half-moons | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 3/4 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Mix together yogurt with lemon zest and green olives in a bowl. Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until 'al dente'.

title: Chicken and Rice Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken legs | 3 cups dry rice | 1/2 lb tomatillo | 3 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Remove the chicken from the bones. Place the chicken in a large pot over medium heat. Add the rice, tomatillo, vinegar and enough water to just cover the chicken. Place the pot over medium heat. Let it come to a boil. Turn the heat down and simmer the soup for 45 minutes. The idea is that the liquid that you are not using can be used in another recipe.

title: Corn Oil Soymilk Shake
ingredients: 1 liter soymilk | 2 1/2 cups corn oil
instructions: Combine the corn oil and soymilk in bowl.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,farfalle pasta,black bean sauce,yukon gold potato,rainbow nonpareil,granny smith apple,lettuce,balsamic vinegar
title: Farfalle Apple Salad from Scratch
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked bow tie ( nonpareil ) pasta | 1 green medium yukon gold potato, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 large granny smith apples, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 can black beans in chili sauce, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon lemon juice and zest ( from 1 lemon ) | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | lettuce | 1 teaspoon dried multi-colored market girls all purpose dressing ( optional )
instructions: Cook the bow tie pasta, according to directions on package.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,sauce,apple juice,vanilla ice cream,coriander powder,tamarind paste
title: Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 3 medium yellow onions, peeled, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon sweet butter | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 quart vanilla ice cream ( optional ) or 1 quart yogurt ( optional )
instructions: In a separate saucepan, cover onions with water – bring to boil and boil 10 minutes. Drain onions and return to pan with sweet butter. Cook slowly, uncovered, over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. In a blender, add tamarind paste, apple juice, hot sauce and ice cream, if desired. Process thoroughly, stopping frequently to scrape down the sides of the blender. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 months.. This could also be prepared on the grill. Just follow the manufacturer's instructions, or use a steamer basket over simmering water and place lid on steamer. Place over medium low heat and cook until mixture begins to thicken, stirring occasionally, around 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,mozzarella cheese,bicarbonate soda,cream tartar,pecorino romano cheese,nutmeg,non dairy topping
title: Dairy-Free Filled Cannellini Bean Casserole
ingredients: 225 g cannellini beans, drained with 2 tbsp of liquid reserved | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 cup non-dairy whipped topping | 100 g mozzarella cheese | 100 g pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 c or 180°c using a pizza cutter, cut out the edges of the cassero. If you have a muffin tin, pour in the bean liquid, 1 tsp oil, bicarbonate of soda, cream of tartar, nutmeg and mix well, adding more liquid if necessary. Lay out the cannellini with flat surface on a flat tray or tray or tin and sprinkle the cannelloni with this mixture. Pour the remaining bean liquid and cream of tarter on top of the casserole. Bake in the oven for about 30 minutes or until warm and hot, but not dry. Remove from the oven and mix the topping ingredients together. Spread onto the casserole and allow to set slightly before cutting the casserole into 6 even sized squares.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,lime,cream chicken soup,pork chop,apple juice,pineapple chunk,linguine pasta,rice vinegar
title: Sloppy Bombay Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken drumsticks | 12 chicken drumsticks | 1 1/2 cups rice vinegar | 2 1/2 cups apple juice | 1 cup cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup lime, juiced | 1 package linguine pasta, cooked, drained and rinsed | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained
instructions: Combine the chicken and drumsticks in a large crockpot. In a medium bowl, combine the vinegar, apple juice, and cream of chicken soup until thoroughly blended. Pour the marinade into the pot. Cover and cook on high for 2 to 3 hours, or until the chicken is cooked. About 15 minutes before serving, stir in the lime juice. During last 5 minutes, remove the lid and continue cooking for 15 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened. Stir in the cooked linguine and pineapple. Serve over warm rice.

title: Chilli Verde
ingredients: 6 ounces smoked cured sichuan peppercorn | 3 ounces guanciale | 2 teaspoons sichuan chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons pure chili pepper flakes
instructions: Grind chichuan peppercorns coarsely in coffee grinder or with mortar and pestle. Mix with remaining ingredients and place in a sterilized 2 1/2 cup glass bottle. Cover and let stand in a cool dark place for 3 - 4 days. Store in refrigerator for up to 3 months.

title: Shrimp in Cream (Shrimp Kebabs)
ingredients: 20 -25 fresh medium shrimp | 1 pint heavy cream | 1/4 cup unsalted butter ( or ghee ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped peeled raspberries ( or a punnet of frozen, strawberries also known as riesling or kerry melba ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped toasted peanuts ( preferably pistachios, walnut or hazelnuts ) | 4 tablespoons finely chopped finely toasted nuts ( preferably pistachios, walnut-hazelnuts are also known as hazelnuts )
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp. Slice into 1/2 inch wide strips, leaving tail intact. Make the cream, heat cream and butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, stirring often. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in shrimp, return to a simmer, and cook until done, about 1 minute. Divide among large, shallow bowls. Top with 1 1/2 tablespoons of topping mixture, spreading evenly. Garnish with remaining topping mixture and 1½ to 2 tablespoon nuts. Serve immediately.

title: Crock Pot Swedish Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken tenders | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 cup half-and-half

instructions: Place a steamer insert into a saucepan and fill with water to just below the surface, and bring to the boil. While the steaming is happening, whisk together the vinegar and remaining ingredients adding some honey last to prevent burning. When the asparagus is cool enough to handle, roughly chop it and place in a bowl with the cabbage mix. Season to taste with salt and pepper. When the steaming completes, place 2 small slabs of ice cream and 1 or 2 tablespoons of clear honey in a large heatproof bowl, top half with a portion of sliced spring onion and rosemary. Cover with a lid and leave until the ice cream has melted. To serve, slice the steaks and arrange on top of the salad and serve.

Random Ingredients: milk,halibut fillet,chicken bouillon,orange bell pepper,chicken bouillon cube
title: Grilled Halibut
ingredients: 2 whole halibut fillets, cut in half | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 cups milk | 4 orange bell peppers ( optional ) | 4 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Preheat grill for low heat. Place halibut on grill rack in a large shallow roasting pan. Bring to high heat. When it starts to get very hot, pour in the stock.

title: Stretching Chayote Squares
ingredients: 8 large leaves bok choy, about 1 pound ( about 12 medium leaves ) | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 2 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 tablespoon stevia powder
instructions: Cut off and discard ends and green leaves of bok choy stems. Slice leaves about 1/5 inch thick and set aside. Blanch or steam leaves in boiling water for 2 minutes. Drain well and let cool. Using a 2 1/2 inch diameter heart shaped cookie cutter, cut out heart shaped shapes using heart shaped cookie cutter. Place 1 cup of the greens and 1/3 cup of the shortening in a medium size saucepan, heat over medium low heat. Add the remaining shortening, stir. When melted, add 1 cup of the half and half, stir well, heat just to the boiling point and stir in the stevia. Pour into a 13x9 inch pan. Top with remaining heart shaped greens. Combine remaining 1/2 cup of the half and half and brush over the layered tops of the layered chayote. Sprinkle on the grated romano cheese. Bake, covered, in a preheated 350f degree oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 10 minutes, until golden. This recipe can be frozen.

title: Pat's Easy Dutch Oven Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 pork roast | creole seasoning
instructions: Spray your a non stick frying pan with a light mistive of oil. Take the roast and rub the creole seasoning over the entire surface of the roast. Sprinkle the entire outside of the roast with plenty of the creole seasoning and cook on a 325°f oven for 90 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 155°f let cool, and let rest at least 10 minutes prior to slicing.

title: Sausage & Cashews
ingredients: 2 lbs bulk italian sausage ( i prefer bulk as this sausage is already sweet ) | 2 lbs chicken ( i use chicken tenders in the mix ) | 2 cups cashews ( you may substitute pecans ) | 1 1/2 cups peanut oil
instructions: Add cashews in to oil. Brown cashews. When cashews become to dry add chicken & italian sausage & cook until no longer pink. Drain all liquid & mix well. If using chicken you might want to add a tbsp of extra virgin juce or even olive oil. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,cocoa powder,cheese,puff pastry,saffron thread,part ricotta cheese,chicken breast fillet,baby portabella mushroom
title: Chicken Parcels With Mozzarella, Portabella Mushrooms & Saffron
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 4 skinless chicken breast fillets | 8 ounces baby portabella mushrooms or 8 ounces red capsicums, sliced | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed, left whole | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded, divided | 2 tablespoons amaretto or 2 tablespoons brandy, warmed ( or alcohol free liqueur )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees f. Combine the cocoa powder and saffron in a medium bowl. Add the chicken, mushrooms, and 1/4 cup of the mozzarella. Using 2 tablespoons of the mozzarella at a time, coat the chicken and mushrooms very well with the cocoa. Cut the puff pastry into 2 circles, 3 - 4 inches wide, and 12 - 14 inches long by 11 inches long. Arrange half the chicken mixture on each circle, leaving about an inch of pastry in the center for each circle. Sprinkle half the remaining mozzarella over the chicken, and then half the amaretto. Fold the pastry around the chicken. Pinch the edges so the folded pastry will partially cover the sides of the chicken. Set the turnovers on a greased large baking sheet. Place the baking sheet, dough side up, in the oven. Bake chicken for about 25 minutes, or until crispy and cooked through and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,horseradish,baby red potato,focaccia bread,chili pepper flake,chicken ramen noodle,beef,lime juice zest
title: Cousin Pete's Spicy Beef Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 jar chili peppers, with juice ( or any hot pepper you desire ) | 2 packages instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 loaf miniature focaccia bread | 1 bag fresh baby red potatoes, halved | 1 lb ground top-round beef | 5 ounces prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons lime zest, minced | 2 cups prepared horseradish-flavored prepared spice mixture
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°. In a large bowl combine the ground beef, hot pepper juice and instant vanilla pudding mix. Tear off a 1/2 pound piece of tin foil and place on top of a large plate. Place the bag of red potatoes on top of the beef and pour about 1/2 ounce of prepared horseradish and 2 teaspoons of dried chili flakes into the sack of noodles. Reserve 1/2 pound of noodles and hamburger mixture and place on top of the red potatoes, spreading evenly. Coat with 3 1/2 cups prepared horseradish flavored prepared spice mixture and place on top of the hamburger. Pound the remaining beef to 1/8 inch thickness and place on top of the prepared horseradish mixture. Repeat until all the horseradish and beef mixture is used, topping with remaining prepared horseradish and chili flakes. Place the prepared dish in the oven and bake for 25 minutes or until the top is browned. Take out of the oven and let sit for 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, loosen the bread from the foil and serve alongside the meat and the reserved horseradish mixture.

title: Anise Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 large egg yolk | 2 tablespoons ground coriander seeds ( or substitute cilantro ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds, crushed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander or 2 tablespoons cilantro
instructions: Put egg yolk in a bowl and whisk until thick and pale and creamy. Add all remaining ingredients and whisk together until well blended. Pour the dressing into a shallow ceramic dish or tray and cover well with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 30 - 40 minutes. Serve with your favourite foods or crackers.

title: Cafe Rio Stewed Clam
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh clams | 1 lb ground beef stew meat | 1 cup cilantro leaf
instructions: Clean clams well in cold water. Place cleaned clams in a large pot of boiling water. Cover and steam for 3 1/2 minutes. Drain clams and set aside. Combine ground beef, cilantro leaves and 1/2 cup of water in the clean pot. Add the cleaned clams. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer over low heat 4 - 5 hours.

title: Artichokes in a Flash
ingredients: 8 artichoke hearts | 1 large eggplant ( or a combination of both ) or 1 large yellow squash ( or a combination of both )
instructions: Cut your artichoke heart into 1 inch dice and place all ingredients in the microwave safe bowl. Microwave the artichokes for 1 minute on high and then open and stir. The artichoke can then be eaten immediately with tortilla chips as an asian snack or snack, or it's very good frozen for up to two months. Also great over fresh vegetables for an interesting look.

title: Quick Preserved Vanilla Sugar Powder (Kalsekorse)
ingredients: 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 pinch sesame seed oil
instructions: Make sure you have enough vanilla sugar power to make a paste that will coat the back of a spoon. Place the vanilla sugar into a bowl, and stir in the almond and sesame seeds oil. The flavor will develop. When the sugar is combined, stir in the rest of the vanilla sugar. Cover and refrigerate for 2 - 3 days. Break up some vanilla sugar with a spoon.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,jalapeno pepper,plum,kaffir lime leaf,snow pea,cream mushroom soup,salt,yogurt
title: Creamy Smoked Horseradish Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb fresh whole mushroom | 1 jar sliced mushrooms | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup yogurt, full fat, room temperature | 2 fresh or frozen kaffir lime leaves, thawed | salt | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper, chopped ( depending on your heat tolerance ) | 1 teaspoon horseradish
instructions: Clean mushrooms, remove and pat dry. Cut slits in mushrooms, and stuff with the cream of mushroom soup and yogurt. Stuff the mushrooms with this mixture. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour, and up to 24 hours. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: white onion,green enchilada sauce,saffron,bouillon cube,chard leaf,sharp white cheddar cheese
title: Cheese and Greens Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 6 cups swiss sharp white cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 1/2 cups fresh chard leaves ( about 25 stalks ) | 1 large white onion, peeled and diced | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 -3 tablespoons saffron | 16 ounces green enchilada sauce ( or homemade if you wish )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the chard leaves, onion, beef bouillon cube and saffron. Put in the soup. Cook, on low heat, for about 30 minutes. Stir in the green enchilada sauce.

title: Sauerkraut and Parmesan Wedges
ingredients: 4 pounds beef suet, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with paper towels. Arrange suet in a large dish. Stir soup mix into the suet, and sprinkle parmesan cheese over top of the suet. Bake in the preheated oven until tender and bubbly, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,egg substitute,ice cube,graham cracker crumb,green curry paste
title: Green Curry Cheesecake
ingredients: 7 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup egg substitute | 1 cup pecorino cheese, finely grated ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup green curry paste, to taste | 1 cup ice cube, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f place the graham cracker crumb and egg substitute in a large bowl. Mix well by hand with a fork. Add cheese and curry paste. Mix well. Pour into a well greased 8x8 inch baking dish. Bake for 45 - 55 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,grain mustard,soy sauce,red chile pepper,hungarian paprika,frisee lettuce leaf
title: German Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1 red chile pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon french's lettuce leaves, or as needed
instructions: Whisk ketchup, paprika, soy sauce, mustard, chile pepper, and lettuce together in a bowl until dressing is well mixed. Pour dressing over salad.

Random Ingredients: gemelli pasta,sun tomato,lime juice zest,sirloin steak,baking potato,chicken meat,whipping cream,beef stock cube
title: Steak With Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, 4 x 1in x 1in | 4 ounces gemelli pasta, cut into 2x8in sticks | 4 ounces boneless skinless chicken meat, cut in 4 x 1in squares | 14 ounces egg roll wraps | 2 cups whipping cream | 1 garlic, crushed | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 3 sun-dried tomatoes, very finely chopped
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Meanwhile, trim the steak of excess fat and sinew and remove any fat from the steak. Bring to the boil and add the sirloin. Cook, with a wooden spoon, for 2 - 3 minutes, or until just seared. Drain, then tip into a warm dish. Add the pasta to the pan and stir in the chicken, egg roll wraps and remaining ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Pea Salad with Oranges (Tirk Kosher)
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh peas, shelled | 1/2 small yellow onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 small roasted red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup cilantro, chopped | 1/3 cup orange marmalade | pickled jalapenos and cayenne peppers, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a serving bowl, combine the peas, onion, red bell pepper, cilantro, marmalade. Toss to coat. Season with jalapenos and cayenne pepper. Serve at once.

title: Sesame and Tequila Sorbet
ingredients: 4 cups sesame seeds | 1 cup tequila
instructions: Dry the sesame seeds on a baking sheet. Bake for 5 minutes at 400f then add tequila. Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,anise seed,romaine lettuce,white wine vinegar,grand marnier
title: Romaine With Mustard Seeds & Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon fresh orange or 1/2 teaspoon lemon, rind of, finely grated, divided | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2/3 cup plus 2 tablespoons sweet mustard seeds, divided | 1/3 cup plus 2 tablespoons grand marnier, divided | 4 heads romaine lettuce, heads separated
instructions: In a small skillet, toast mustard seeds about 1 1/2 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Transfer to a paper towel. Combine ¾ cup of reserved mustard seed powder with remaining 3 tablespoons mustard seed powder, vinegar, orange peel and ¾ cup plus 2 tablespoons sweet mustard seeds in a small saucepan. Over medium heat, bring to a simmer. Cook and stir until fragrant. Cool to room temperature. Drain lettuce and pat dry. Center a large dinner plate on a chopping board. Using two large forks, shred lettuce. Using two forks, pull apart remaining cabbage into large chunks. Using two spoons, place 2 tablespoons of reserved mustard seed mixture on top of shredded cabbage. Toss well. Transfer to a small bowl. Stir remaining 1/4 cup of sweet mustard seeds and ½ cup plus 2 tablespoons grand marnier into cabbage. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Spoon sauce over top. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of sweet mustard seeds.

title: Topping - Ensalad Green
ingredients: 1 package frozen topping, thawed | 3/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Prepare thawed topping as directed on packet. Sprinkle cheese over the tops of the tostados. Cover and refrigerate for up to 3 hours prior to serving to allow for the cheese to melt slightly.

title: Sultana Mushrooms for Baking
ingredients: 6 ounces cremini mushrooms or 6 ounces button mushrooms | 10 ounces sultanas | cicarbonate of soda
instructions: Gently cook mushrooms until softened, remove from heat and place to one side. Strain the liquid in a large bowl and add sultanas and sicarb soda to make a thickening cream. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: catsup,anaheim chilies,broccoli floret,cilantro,thai holy basil,jalapeno pepper,fruit,italian breadcrumb
title: Broke Guy's Chili Con Carne (Con Carne)
ingredients: 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup broccoli floret | 2 anaheim chilies | 10 -12 thai holy basil | 12 -15 stalks fresh cilantro | 4 pickled jalapenos ( i use 3 and 1 in the jar ) | catsup ( optional ) | fruit ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice anaheim chilies lengthwise into halves. Place peppers in small baking pan. Sprinkle with cilantro and jalapeños, if using and toss to coat. Spoon chili mixture into bread crumbs. Sprinkle italian seasoning on top and bake for 10minutes. Toss every few minutes until chili is bubbling and it crumbles. Cool and add catsup if desired. Toss, if desired, and serve over spaghetti.

title: Black Olives
ingredients: 1 can pitted black olives, drained | 1/4 cup ice
instructions: Place drained black olives in a blender or food processor.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,salt black pepper,romano cheese,coffee powder
title: Greek Orzo
ingredients: 2 cups orzo pasta | 1 1/2 tablespoons coffee powder | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place orzo in the boiling water, and cook until tender, about 11 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, dissolve coffee powder in the cream in a small bowl. Place orzo into a serving dish, and drizzle with coffee flavored cream.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,dark brown sugar,italian sausage link,beef broth,phyllo pastry,chicken wing,lime juice,scallop
title: Carnitas
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 lb italian sausage link | 10 ounces chicken wings | 5 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 1/4 cup beef broth | 6 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 16 -32 ounces fresh shrimp, peeled
instructions: Cut pork shoulder into 2 3/4 inch pieces. Place pork shoulder and sausage links in large skillet. Brown over medium heat. Drain, then cut into 1 inch pieces. Place wings, sugar, and rice wine in same skillet. Cook over medium heat until sugar is dissolved, cook about 5 minutes. Add pork, 1 tablespoon lime juice. Simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Lay frozen phyllo sheet on work surface and lightly spray with cooking spray. Lay 6 shrimp down center of phyllo sheet, overlapping by 1/2 inch. Cut each shrimp in half, lengthwise. Set aside. Spoon half of pork mixture in center of phyllo sheet. Layer with 10 shrimp halves. Place 6 sheets of phyllo sheets over shrimp. Spread remaining pork mixture on top. Bring up sides of pastry sheets and pinch together to form a circle about 1/2 inch in diameter. Top with remaining shrimp halves. Cut crosswise into thirds. Cut each quarter into 6 pieces. Repeat with remaining dough and shrimp. Arrange 2 pieces over shrimp in a circle on top of phyllo. Fold over shrimp to make a half moon shape. Repeat to make 2 more triangles, adding phyllo to pan for each end to fold before adding shrimp. Pour remaining lime juice over all. Cover.

title: Bun & Love -- Broccoli on Pita Bread
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 4 -6 pita breads
instructions: Preheat oven to 400° f. Place the broccoli on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake for about 20 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally. Drain the broccoli well, return it to the oven and bake until it is golden brown and cooked though. About 20 minutes. Remove and allow to cool for five minutes. Meanwhile, slice the pita bread. Slice into small pieces and place on a platter. Spread the cut broccoli onto the pita breads. Sprinkle with roasted garlic.

title: Blueberry and Squid in Nam Pla Sauce
ingredients: 1 sprig fresh blueberries | 6 medium squid, cleaned | 1 teaspoon nam pla | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup chopped fresh unsalted butter | 4 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Place the blueberries in a microwave safe bowl and add enough water to just cover berries. Cover bowl, and microwave on high power about 3 minutes, or until berries are tender but not mushy. Remove the berries from the microwave, and immediately cover the bowl with plastic wrap so they are not touching. Let stand 30 minutes to soften slightly. Remove the skin, and remove the eyes if desired. Remove the seeds and ribs from the squid bodies by slicing into 1/2 inch rings. Remove the white membrane from each squid ring, and cut tentacles from tentacles using a sharp knife. Remove the choke to make them easy to remove. Cut all remaining tentacles at half to make little tubes. Slice squid in half lengthwise, then cut in half crosswise. Remove and discard seeds and membrane. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the 1/2 cup of butter, and fry squid rings, turning them frequently, until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove the squid from the skillet, and spread 1/4 cup of butter evenly over each plate. Top with 1/4 cup of berries. Place a piece of plastic wrap across the plate, and invert the plate.

Random Ingredients: garlic,chicken bouillon,lettuce,farfalle pasta,tahini,butternut squash,tomato green chilies,pastry crust pie
title: Lettuce Wraps for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 pastry for a 9-inch double crust pie | 2 slices butternut squash | 1 teaspoon chopped garlic | 1/2 cup butternut squash or 1/2 cup pumpkin squash, pureed | 1/2 cup cooked farfalle pasta | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon canned diced tomatoes with green chilies, including juice | 1 dash chicken bouillon, if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place flour in a food processor.

title: Prawn Samosas with Artichoke in Phyllo
ingredients: 12 large cooked prawns, shelled | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 -2 ounce tequila | 5 sheets phyllo pastry | additional sweetcorn, for rolling | 10 sheets frozen ready roasted sweetcorn or 10 sheets fresh corn
instructions: Slice the prawns in two by 4'' strips, and set aside. Place the artichoke hearts, sesame oil and tequila in a small saucepan. Heat over a low heat, stirring regularly. Unwrap the phyllo sheets, and brush one with the sesame oil. Place one piece about 1'' above the palm of one hand. Place 2 or 3 - 3 tablespoons of prawn mix onto the pastry, brushing with the oil. Place 3 or 4 prawns in the center. Add 1 dollop of sweetcorn. Fold the pastry over the filling, tucking the sides in to make a packet. The pastry should not touch the other side of the samosa. Repeat for all the samosas and filling. Cut the packets and place on a non stick or oiled baking tray. Bake in a preheated oven at 180 ºc for 15 - 20 minutes, or until lightly golden. Serve hot. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,guacamole,kielbasa,green chilies,salmon,chickpea,apple juice,bulk italian sausage
title: Italian Sausage-Stuffed Artichokes
ingredients: 4 artichoke hearts, trimmed | 1/2 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 can chicken and beans seasoned with basil & garlic seasoning ( i use boca marinara ) | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 small apple, cored and diced small | 1 can diced artichoke hearts | 1 can chickpeas | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler and place artichoke hearts on baking sheet. Broil, turning once, about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, brown sauetta over medium heat in nonstick skillet. Remove sausage from skillet and add onion & chilies to drippings in skillet & saute till onion is translucent. Stir in beans & sausage. Remove artichoke hearts with tongs, leaving a 1/2 inch space at ease. Place artichoke hearts, sausage, chilies on a baking sheet. Pour chickpeas over artichokes. Broil in oven about 5 minutes or until beginning to buble. Remove from oven and spread artichoke hearts over s& p. Garnish with guacamole if desired. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,pesto sauce,pork loin,green peppercorn,fig
title: Citrus Pork Loin With Herbed Mozzarella Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin | 1 tablespoon green peppercorn | 1 cup light biancom pesto sauce | 2 packages fresh figs | 1 cup low-fat bailey's irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f and line the inside of a roasting pan with foil. Trim most of the fat from the pork and prick the top with a fork. Sprinkle the peppercorns over the pork fat and place in a shallow baking dish. Bake for about 3 hours or until the crust is golden brown and the meat is firm to the touch. Let pork rest 15 minutes, removing foil from the pan, and slice into thin slices. Pesto. Wash and remove the figs from the stems and cut into strips measuring a quarter inch wide. Bring a small pot of water to boil, add the figs and cook for 15 minutes, drain. Place the cream in a small saucepan and bring to just under a boil, boil 1 minute and then stir in the olives and mint. Drain pork slices and spread the pesto over and set aside. Serve.

title: Glazed Apricots-Ginger
ingredients: 4 -5 apricots ( or other dried apricots, halved ) | dark molasses | ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Clean and rinse apricots. Remove some of the papery pulp if desired, or just discard. Soak apricots in water for at least 4 hours, or overnight. After soaking, drain and discard the water. Add molasses or maple syrup, stir, and set aside. Place apricots in a greased baking pan. Sprinkle gingergarle/garlic paste over the top just enough to lightly cover the top. Bake in a preheated oven for 30 minutes, then turn off oven.
