Allow to sit for another 30 - 45 minutes, or until thick enough, stirring occasionally. Remove from oven and cool slightly before popping off pieces on a serving plate. Store in air tight container at room temperature for up to three weeks.

Random Ingredients: vegetable carrot,beef broth,vegetable broth,serrano chili,mushroom,watercress leaf,thyme sprig
title: Quick 'n' Easy Mexican Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 4 cups beef broth | 4 cups vegetable broth | 8 medium mushrooms, cleaned and dried cleaned and sliced | 1 -2 serrano chili, sliced thinly ( optional ) | 1 bunch watercress leaf | 1 bunch fresh thyme sprig | dried whole mushroom or regular mushroom, as desired
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the watercress and thyme in a large stockpot and bring to a rolling boil. Reduce heat and simmer.. Remove the thyme sprigs and watercress and discard. Add watercress and simmer additional 15 - 20 minutes or until watercress wilts. Add mushrooms and continue to simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat and enjoy.

title: Garlic Gravy
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 cups prepared gravy | 1 pinch garlic salt, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Warm the oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a small baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, gradually whisk gravy with the flour. Pour gravy drippings into a saucepan, and stir to combine. Season with garlic salt.

title: Black Bean Salad With Mushrooms or Caper Dressing
ingredients: 1 lb fresh snow pea, trimmed | 14 ounces canned black beans | 1 -2 tablespoon capers | 3 teaspoons yellow rice vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Rinse and drain beans, discarding any damaged beans. Slice the caps. Toss all ingredients in a bowl with a few pieces of the bean lettuce and garnish with some of the reserved caper.

title: Famous PA Dutch Chicken Livers Salad
ingredients: 4 cooked chicken livers | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh sage
instructions: Place chicken livers in serving bowl. Add half and half, and sage. Toss to coat and chill in fridge several hours or overnight. This salad is great served with roast vegetables.

title: Korean-Style Shredded Beef in Lettuce
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless beef chuck | 1 head lettuce, washed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 1 cup dried apricots
instructions: Place chuck in a large pot. Pour enough water into the pot to cover.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,baking soda,banana,cooking oil,dark brown sugar,mirin
title: American Bread With Cheese and Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 2 large ripe medium bananas | 6 slices american cheese, cut in half | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 cup dark brown sugar | 2 -3 teaspoons mirin
instructions: Peel and cut the bananas in half, lengthwise. Place the bananas in a microwave safe bowl and cover with warm water. Microwave, covered, on high power for one minute. Do not uncover microwave until the water is hot, and then let the banana slices steam for about 45 seconds. Remove banana and transfer to a plate, and let sit at room temperature until cool. Peel each banana half, removing the seeds and white membrane. Slice each potato about 1/4 inch thick, then arrange them on four serving plates. Top with 2 slices of the the cheese, and pour about 1/4 cup of the hot banana water over the cheese as your toppings. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet or griddle over medium high heat. Add the baking soda, and let it sizzle for about 30 - 45 seconds. Pour toasted brown sugar in a small bowl, and stir in mirin. Carefully remove the skillet from the burner for about 2 minutes, keeping a close eye on what type of sugar and oil is necessary. Sprinkle the bottom of the warm griddle with the topping, and sprinkle some of the green onions over the bottom. When a bead of bubbling water forms on top, lift the sandwiches out onto the griddle, sprinkle with the rest of the green onions, and cover with a cloth. Put the skillet back on the stove, and cook, turning once, until the bread is nicely toasted on the sides, and the cheese has melted and begun to melt into the bread. Remove from the heat, place on a serving platter, and let cool for a few minutes. Cut into 4 slices and serve with warm bread.

title: Torta Di Fagioli (Torta With Smoked Turkey )
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely diced smoked turkey | 1/2 cup chopped roasted potatoes | 2 tablespoons finely diced limes
instructions: Saute turkey in small pot until light golden brown and crumbly. Add potatoes to turkey, reduce heat, cover and saute until tender, about 5 mintues. Stir in 1 tbsp lime juice. This recipe can be made 1 day in advance and stored in the refrigerator covered with a tightly covered jar.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,french baguette,stock,pecorino romano cheese,sesame oil,brown lentil,broth
title: Brown Lentils with Toasted Crackers
ingredients: 1/3 cup light stock ( see note ) | 10 ounces brown lentils | 1 cup raw rice or 1 cup brown rice | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | 3 teaspoons dried rosemary | 1 french baguette, cut in 1/2 inch slices ( about 1 1/3 cups ) | 1/2 cup coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 3 t )
instructions: Rinse the lentils under cold running water.. Drain well and put into a large, heavy saucepan with 4 cups water. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Stir in the rice. Cover and simmer over low heat until the lentils are completely fork tender, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat. Toast the bread slices for 1 to 2 minutes on each side until golden. Remove bread from pan and arrange on a cutting board, then cut into 2 inch squares. Spread some sesame oil over each bread square. Stir the lentils, then rice together until well blended. Serve with toasted bread squares.

title: Pea-Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloins | 1 package sugar snap peas | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 baking pan with cooking spray. Place pork tenderloins onto pan. Bake uncovered for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Prepare sugar snap peas according to package directions. Cut into thirds. Arrange on a platter. Pour caramelized sugar snap peas over the top. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Pork Tenderloins With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon lime zest, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1/4 cup hot sauce ( to taste ) | shredded lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine lime zest and mango chutney in a small bowl. Rub lime glaze onto tenderloins, coating all sides well. Sprinkle with salt and allow to marinate in fridge for 30 minutes. Heat a grill pan to medium high heat. Lightly oil grill. Cook loins until nicely browned, about 6 minutes per side. Serve on a bed of lettuce and top with chutney.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,brown rice,dark sesame oil,graham cracker crumb
title: Grenadian Chocolate Soup
ingredients: 6 cups chicken stock | 1 cup brown rice | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 3 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Bring chicken stock to a boil in a large pot over medium high heat. Add rice. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Mix in oil and sesame oil. Cool to room temperature. Transfer to bowls and sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs.

title: Strawberry Mashed Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1/4 cup soymilk | 2 teaspoons season salt or 2 teaspoons salt | 1/4 cup salted roasted cashews, chopped | 2 ounces boneless salmon steaks, thinly sliced | 1 cup sweet potato, peeled & amp, diced | 1 cup fresh strawberries, quartered
instructions: In a large bowl mix simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion, soy milk& seasoned salt. Add salted roasted cashews and salmon steak and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Right before serving, combine the fresh strawberries with sweet potato.

Random Ingredients: tofu,table salt,lard,extra tofu,orange blossom water,wonton wrapper,half
title: Tofu Samosas With Orange Blossom Syrup
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu, pressed | 1 tablespoon lard | 12 ounces extra firm tofu, drained | 1 teaspoon table salt | 1 package wonton wrappers | 2 teaspoons orange blossom water ( to taste ) | 1 cup fat-free half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Thoroughly mix together the tofu, lard, and 1/4 tsp salt. Cut the tofu dough into 3 equal parts. Put each piece on a square of plastic wrap, moisten corners with water, and place them on a baking sheet. Brush the edges of the plastic around the surface of 1 piece of tofu with the orange blossom water. Make sure they are sticking together and do not crimp. Sprinkle 1 tsp of salt on the top of the tofu mixture. Cover loosely, and place in oven. Bake for 16 - 20 minutes, until golden brown and crispy on the edges. Remove from oven, and let cool. While the samosas are baking, pour the half and half into a large pot. Bring to boil over medium high heat, and lower the heat. Carefully, pour the entire contents of the pan into a bowl. Break up the plastic wrap into small pieces, and stir to dissolve. When the samosas are cool enough, cover and refrigerate. Once the samosas are out of the fridge, slice open a corner, and lay on a cookie sheet. Spread about 1 1/4 tsp of orange blossom syrup into each samosa. Place the samosas onto a cutting board, making sure to leave 2 inch to all sides of the triangle. Wrap a piece or two of tofu square in the corner, and then press the seams to seal with the syrup. Place each samosa, open end down, onto the syrup. Let sit over night and come to room temperature. Heat the remaining syrup. Serve warm over samosas.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,tortilla chip,cake flour,salt,chile pepper,saffron thread,fish sauce
title: Saffron-Roasted Fish and Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cake flour | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh chile peppers, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 pinch saffron threads | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 teaspoon fish sauce | 2 cups crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Mix cake flour, chile peppers, salt, and saffron threads together in a bowl.

title: Cheesy Chili
ingredients: 10 ounces mozzarella cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Mix the chili powder with the cheese and put it on a bun. If you would like a hotter chili, just use an ounce or two of chili power.

title: Artichokes with Zucchini (Artichokes in a Spicy Salt)
ingredients: 2 zucchini, peeled and cut into about 1/2 slices | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1 tablespoon salt | 1 package jerusalem artichokes, drained of excess liquid
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Stir in the salt and zucchini, and return to a boil. Cook the zucchini, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm, about 10 minutes. Drain, and slice into 1/2 inch cubes. Place in a serving bowl and drizzle with a little of the remaining oil.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,self rising flour,chicken thigh,vanilla sugar,beef chuck,spring onion
title: Traditional Swiss Chicken Piccata
ingredients: 450 g beef chuck | 450 g boneless chicken thighs | 2 -3 leaves spring onions ( depending on size ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese | 2 -3 teaspoons self-rising flour
instructions: If using large chicken thighs cut off any excess fat, and place in a large, sealable plastic bag. Crush the ends to remove air pockets. Slice the meat into 2 to 3 slices. Push one spring onion into the middle of the chicken. Sprinkle with a little vanilla sugar. Place the bag under a hot grill and grill for 2 to 3 minutes for medium rare or over the medium for well done. Turn and grill for a further 2 to 3 minutes, or until the meat is cooked, but not falling apart. Remove from grill. Place the reserved spring onion onto a serving plate and cover with foil. The chicken will not be cooked all the way through, so add the rest of the spring onion as you wish. Place the bowl of cold milk into a large measuring jug and put into the fridge to chill for around 2 hours. Meanwhile place the flour in another bowl, and add a little salt and cracked black pepper to taste. Drain the meat from the bag and cut it into thin slices. Place the chopped meat, spring onions, sugar and flour in a large, clean bowl, and mix with your hands. When everything is mixed well, add the chilled milk in a steady stream until you have a smooth batter, adding a little more milk if necessary. You can use a hand held blender to mix the ingredients.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,creole seasoning,kaffir lime leaf,chunky salsa,blue curacao,vegetable stock
title: Blue-Footed Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 large pork loin roast, with fat underneath | 1 bottle chunky salsa | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 cup blue curacao | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 3 kaffir lime leaves | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime essence ( optional )
instructions: Place the pork into a slow cooker. Stir the salsa, stock, blue curacao, creole seasoning, lime leaves, and kaffir lime essence together in a bowl. Pour over the meat.

title: Sausage and Shrimp With a Kick
ingredients: 1 -2 link mild sausages, any flavours | 12 medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1/2 cup chutney | cheese food or maple syrup
instructions: In a frying pan, add all ingredients into pan. Cook over a medium high heat stirring constantly. When it has turned into a thick, creamy, delicious looking consistency, pour into casserole dish, top with tasty cheese.

title: Simple Bisto Sauce
ingredients: 1 can canned italian-style tomatoes | 1 package bisto gravy mix | 1 jar sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 cup fish stock | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, or to taste | 1 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine tomatoes, gravy mix, mushrooms, fish stock, rosemary, and pepper.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,pepperoni,rice,chicken stock,fig,lump crabmeat,coconut cream,golden syrup
title: Feta Cheese & Crab Rice Ball Soup
ingredients: 1 cup rice, uncooked | 2 cups chicken stock | 2 ounces dried figs ( or any dried fig that has been soaked for 20 minutes ) | 4 ounces ground cooked chicken or 4 ounces crabmeat, drained | 2 ounces feta cheese | 3 ounces sliced pepperoni, chopped ( can use more ) | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 carton lump crabmeat | coconut cream ( optional )
instructions: Cook the rice according to the directions on the package. Transfer the rice to a bowl. Add the chicken stock, figs, meat, bread crumbs, cheese and pepperoni. Mix well with hands until well blended. Divide among 6 soup bowls. Serve with coconut cream, if using.

title: Creamy Chocolate-Chutney Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups dijon mustard | 1 cup mango chutney ( creamy type ) | 12 ounces baking chocolate, chopped
instructions: In a medium sized skillet, mix together the mustard and mango chutney. Pour the mixture into a jar with a tight fitting lid, then refrigerate while preparing the remaining ingredients. Once the mixture has chilled, pour into a medium sized dipping dish. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnite. Serve with the dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,jalapeno pepper,spanish olive,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,rice wine,yellow squash
title: Mexican Spiced Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 yellow squash, chopped | 2 tablespoons spanish olives, sliced | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 1 3/4 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine
instructions: In a large bowl combine beans, squash, olives, jalapeno pepper, chipotle sauce and rice wine.

title: Lebanese Crumbled Lamb
ingredients: 1 kg lamb chop | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour, plus extra for dusting
instructions: Rinse and dry the lamb. Sprinkle the lamb with flour and knead it well to ensure you roll the lamb out as thinly as possible. Cook in a medium heatproof casserole dish for about 1 hour or until brown on all sides and cooked as desired. Turn and cook on the other side for a further 30 minutes or until cooked to your liking. You will need to tent loosely with foil to prevent excessive browning. Serve with pitta bread and veggies.

title: Thai Caramelized Kale
ingredients: 2 teaspoons xanthan gum ( or other sweetener ) | 1 bunch kale | 1 can coconut milk | 6 ounces pancetta ( optional ) | 4 large fresh basil leaves
instructions: Prepare kale, and chop roughly. Place kale in a large bowl and sprinkle with about half teaspoon of gum. Add the other half teaspoon of gum, and stir with a large spoon to distribute the gum evenly over the greens. Heat a medium sized skillet over medium high heat. Add the pancetta and cook until the pancetta is slightly crisp and renders some of the fat. Add the kale to the skillet and toss with the pancetta. Add coconut milk and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook in the skillet for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the kale has absorbed the coconut milk and is steaming hot. Garnish with basil leaves and serve.

title: Gosht
ingredients: 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/2 cup green zucchini, cut in half horizontally
instructions: In a medium bowl, using an electric mixer on medium speed, combine the yogurt and zucchini.

title: Avocado Dressing
ingredients: 1 package dried fruit pectin ( such as orange lemon or pineapple concentrate ) | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted, and diced | 2 tablespoons diced mild green onion | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Place the dried fruit pectin in a small bowl, cover with cold water, and set aside to soften. Drain the pectin, and transfer to a blender. Add the avocado, black pepper, green onion, and thyme. Blend the mixture with a small funnel until smooth.

title: Chipotle Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup tahini or 1/2 cup tahini | 2 teaspoons canned chipotle chiles, minced | 1 lb fresh salmon, skinned, and cut into 2-inch chunks ( i've also used boneless skinless salmon, which seems to have the tougher bone in it and tastes just fine ) | 2 teaspoons wheat germ
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a blender, pour into a glass measuring cup and set it over a bowl of steaming water, and chill for 20 minutes. Boil salmon chunks in boiling water for 3 minutes, remove and drain as best you can. Return salmon chunks to saucepan, add cream, and heat through. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Rosemary Crock
ingredients: 10 ounces consomme | 4 teaspoons dried rosemary leaves | 4 cups warm broth | 2 packages rhodes frozen dinner rolls, thawed | paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine consomme and rosemary in a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Add broth. Bake for 20 minutes. Arrange frozen rolls around the consomme.

Random Ingredients: beef mince,active yeast,chicken thigh,coffee,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 1 ounce active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chiles in adobo, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 300 g minced beef mince | 2 -4 teaspoons dried beef mince
instructions: Dissolve the yeast and chiles in 1 tbs of coffee and the remaining coffee. Mix the mince until it is crumbly and add to the dry ingredients, mixing until the mixture forms a wet clumpy dough. Turn out onto a greased baking sheet, and cover with a tea towel. Let rise for about 40 minutes, or until doubled in bulk. Preheat the oven, gas mark grease a shallow ovenproof baking dish. Turn the mince on to the baking sheet. Cut a slit into the side of the mince with a small knife. Push down to make a slight indentation in the centre. Sprinkle on the dried beef. Bake for about 40 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Serve hot, warm or cold. Note, some add a touch of dried crushed garlic in place of the dried mince when browning.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,wheat lasagna noodle,pimiento,flat bread,saffron,self raising flour,baby spinach
title: Mushroom and Spinach Lasagne
ingredients: 375 g whole wheat lasagna noodles | 1 box baby spinach | 1 jar pimientos | 300 g self-raising flour ( for dredging ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1/2 cup rice wine ( or dry white wine ) | flat bread, slices, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Grease a shallow baking dish. Place noodles in a large bowl with a small layer of water until the pasta absorbs it. Repeat with noodles and water. Wash and pat dry. Drain the spinach, de-seeded if using, & roughly chop. Line a large bowl with baking paper, then lay out all the dry ingredient. Place some flour & saffron in a clean dish & add the rice wine or dry white wine, & stir to combine. Coat the spinach with the flour. Place a third noodle, overlapping in the same way as the spinach, on top of the dry ingredient. Spread spinach evenly on the noodle & lay a second noodle on top. Spread pine nuts evenly on top & then spread the tomato sauce over the noodles. Then bake for about 50 minutes, or until pasta is cooked & the sauce is bubbling.

title: Tunisian Grill Style Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 3 lbs beef sirloin steaks | 1 1/2 cups yoghurt | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 teaspoon chili, minced ( use less or more if you wish them hot ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Slice steak into very thin slices and discard fat and gristle. Place slices on lightly oiled grill rack 6 to 9 inches from coals. Turn frequently until grill marks appear on both sides. For best results, place grill rack 6 to 8 inches from coals until all is covered. About 30 minutes before cooking time, combine yoghurt, vinegar, minced garlic, chile and salt in a small bowl. Let sit 15 minutes, then stir well. When meat is done, transfer it to a medium bowl and stir in the yoghurt mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: salmon steak,cardamom seed,orange,horseradish,corn,tomato green chilies,parmigiano reggiano cheese,french bread
title: Seared Salmon Burgers With Tomatoes and Corn
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks | 1/2 tablespoon horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, lightly crushed | 1/2 cup canned diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup corn | 1 tablespoon grated orange rind | 2 french bread, bread cut into 4 slices on the diagonal
instructions: Remove bones, skin and flesh from salmon and slice crosswise into 4 equal portions. Rub each portion with horseradish. Place salmon on foil lined baking sheet or rimmed baking sheet and brush with the horseradish oil. Bake at 450 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Mix tomatoes with chilies, 1 tablespoon cheese, corn, orange zest and remaining cheese and set aside. Spoon tomato mixture onto french bread slices.

title: Sauce and Chips (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 1/3 green apple, cored and coarsley chopped ( i used a combination of different colors of apple ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped onions | 2 tablespoons mini chocolate chips | 2 cups prepared whipped topping ( i used trader joe's )
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine apple, onion, and chocolate chips. Mix well, and continue to stir until well blended. Stir in whipped topping until well incorporated. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Store covered in fridge for up to 7 days.

title: Easy Peasy Ginger and Garlicky Pasta
ingredients: 300 ml penne | cold water, for the cooking water | ginger-garlic paste ( from a jar )
instructions: Cook your pasta in the water according to the instructions on the box. Meanwhile, just make sure the water doesn't boil off, because if there does, it will cook longer. Add the ginger garlic paste and cook for 1 - 2 minutes at the same time your pasta is cooking. Put in the cooked pasta and stir to mix well, being careful not to burn the garlic paste. Enjoy.

title: Green Pepper - Capsicum and Cheese Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 teaspoons green chili peppers | 2 teaspoons crumbled fontina cheese | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Grill until cheese takes on the surface. Flip quesadilla, sprinkle on more cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,malibu rum,tomato paste,lamb,cannellini bean,coconut rum,tarragon vinegar,garlic powder
title: Tarragon Lamb Burgundy With White Beans & Spinach
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coconut rum | 2 teaspoons tarragon vinegar | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon malibu rum | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 600 g lamb | 600 g cannellini beans, rinsed | 100 g baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f combine rum, vinegar, tomato paste and garlic powder in a shallow ovenproof dish, add lamb and turn to coat. Place lamb in dish, drizzle with vinaigrette. Bake in oven for 1 hour or until cooked through. Remove lamb from oven, cover and set aside. Boil the cannellini beans, cover and cook over low heat for 8 - 10 minutes or until just tender.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,lemon,pine nut,arrowroot,hot italian sausage,pesto sauce
title: Capellini or Pesto Sauce With Sausages
ingredients: 4 hot italian sausages, split lengthwise | 2 large lemons, juice of | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( from tube foods ) | 1/4 cup hot chili sauce | 2 tablespoons arrowroot ( optional )
instructions: Dry sausages and place in baking dish. Squeeze and add lemon juice. Toss until coated. Spoon mix down the centre. Sprinkle pine nuts on top. Drizzle over pesto and mix. Sauce. Add chili sauce and arrowroot or chillies if using. Pour over the hot sausage. Cover lightly, bake in a preheated 350f oven for 1 hour.

title: Salsa and Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, drumsticks attached | 1 1/4 cups mild salsa | 1 1/4 cups rice vinegar | 3 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Place chicken legs, drumsticks, salsa, and rice vinegar in a resealable plastic bag. Seal bag and turn to coat. Marinate at least 4 hours at room temperature. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Transfer chicken legs and salsa onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 375 degrees f for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until cooked through and lightly browned. Meanwhile, stir chili powder into rice vinegar mixture, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: apple,pimiento,chicken leg,garbanzo bean,sharp cheddar cheese,tortilla chip,tarragon,couscous
title: Chicken Salad (Aubergine)
ingredients: 4 large chicken legs or 4 chicken thighs | 1 head garlic, peeled | 1 cup diced apple | 1 jar diced pimientos | 4 ounces chopped and drained sharp cheddar cheese | 1 box couscous | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon | 1 jar garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package tortilla chips ( i like frito to use )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place chicken legs in a shallow pan, breast side down. Add garlic, apple, pimientos, and cheddar cheese evenly over chicken. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 min., turning chicken over. Spray 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Stir cooked couscous, tarragon, and garbanzo beans into couscous and chicken mixture, adding enough water to cover. Spread contents evenly over chicken pieces. Bake, covered, for 30 min. Uncover, and bake 30 more. Remove cover and bake additional 10 minute if couscous is not yet firm or you prefer more liquid.

title: Spicy Roasted Fig (Zucc) With Szechuan Peanuts
ingredients: 1 lb fresh fiddlehead ( or other aromatic zucchini ) or 1 lb zucchini ( or other aromatic zucchini ) | 1 large rutabagas ( or other aromatic zucchini ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh figs | 1 cup unsweetened coconut ( not unsweetened ) | 2 teaspoons ground coriander ( or cilantro leaves and stems )
instructions: Wash and dry the fiddleheads or zucchini. Cut the stems off the fiddleheads and zucchini then place all the ingredients in a large roasting pan and roast in a 350f degree oven for 1 hour. Toss the pieces together and serve with boiled noodles, recipe #447327, or as a side dish with rice cakes and a vegetable or meat curry.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,iceberg lettuce,grain mustard,vegetable oil cooking spray,poblano pepper,ice cream,sausage meat
title: Smoked Salmon Salad
ingredients: iceberg lettuce | 4 ounces smoked sausage meat ( sweet, sausage ) | 1 poblano pepper, roasted, grilled and sliced into thin strips | 1/2 cup chopped mixed fresh vegetables ( such as broccoli, cauliflower, chard, and/or potatoes ) | 1/2 cup shredded smoked salmon fillet | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Line a large serving platter with lettuce leaves. Add a layer of sausage and poblano pepper strips. Drizzle with mustard. Add a layer of mixed greens. Place smoked salmon on top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with dollop of shredded cheese.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,curry powder,bamboo shoot,swiss cheese,taco seasoning,mint,egg yolk
title: Curry and Swiss Cheesecake
ingredients: 10 -12 ounces shredded swiss cheese | 1 1/2 lbs canned bamboo shoots, chopped | 1 package taco seasoning | 3 egg yolks | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Crush half of the swiss cheese in a large bowl. Drain the rest of the cheese but leave the last 1/2 of the swiss cheese in reserve and cut into small pieces. Mix the rest of the swiss cheese with all the ingredients. Put the mixture in a 9 springform pan or springform cake pan and bake at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes or until it bubbles and is golden brown inside.

title: Kaisersch
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter ( room temperature ) | 2 tablespoons sweet sherry | dried chervil, blossoms ( to garnish )
instructions: Melt the butter in a heavy medium pan over medium heat. Add in the sherry. Simmer until the alcohol has reduced to about 1 teaspoon and then add the chervil. Increase the heat and simmer until alcohol has reduced to thick syrup, about 30 seconds on high heat. Transfer the contents of the pan to a large platter or serving bowl. Garnish with the blossoms, if desired and serve warm. Also delicious as an accompaniment to roasted meats, vegetables, soups or toast.

title: Ciclon Chili
ingredients: 3 cans ciclon | 3 pounds beef stew meat | 4 dried red chiles, seeded and chopped | 1 cup white sugar
instructions: In a bowl, mix the ciclón, beef stew meat, dried chiles, and sugar. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 days before using, and then transfer to a slow cooker to serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,kidney bean,white rice,sauerkraut,ginger garlic paste,honey
title: Souper Rice Balls with Kidney Beans and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups prepared white rice | 1 cup sauerkraut, drained | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Cook the rice in 1 cup water, or as directed on the package. Drain in a colander. Cool the uncooked rice. Stir together the sauerkraut, shortening, ginger garlic paste, and beans. Set aside. Form rice mixture into balls, and roll in the honey. Chill in the refrigerator, about 1 hour, or until flavors blend. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Remove the rolls from the water, and place in the boiling water. Cook 10 to 15 minutes, or until the rice is tender. Drain, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,coffee,worcestershire sauce,baking soda,garlic clove,pork sausage,cherry
title: Coffee & Garlic Sausages
ingredients: 3 lbs pork sausage | 1/4 cup canola oil ( or more ) | 6 garlic cloves, minced | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup coffee or 1/4 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 12 -14 cherries, canned ( do not drain )
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Dice sausages or make sausage links by slicing lengthwise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Add garlic and worcestershire sauce.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,feta cheese,mango chutney,amaretto,cabbage,black bean,cream cheese
title: Feta and Mango Chutney Coleslaw
ingredients: 200 g feta cheese ( crumbled ) | 1/2 cup creamy cream cheese | 1/2 cup black beans ( drained ) | 1/2 head cabbage ( shredded ) | 4 leaves lettuce leaves ( torn in large ) | 4 tablespoons mango chutney | 3 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Combine cream cheese, feta and beans in a bowl.

title: Venison Patties with Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground venison | 1 cup cooked pumpkin or 1 cup butternut squash, chopped into medium pieces | 2 tablespoons peanut tahini | 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 1/3 cup hot water | 1/2 cup fresh thai basil | 1/2 cup pimento slices or 1/3 cup pickled jalapeno slices
instructions: Form turkey meat into 2 oblong patties. In shallow pan, mix together tahini, sugar and hot water. Add to tomato sauce.

title: Coconut and Goats Cheese Mix
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried shredded coconut, or to taste | 3 1/2 ounces goat cheese | 2 teaspoons instant coffee powder | 1/2 pound pepperoni pieces
instructions: Combine coconut, goat cheese, coffee powder, and pepperoni in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: plantain,white sugar,head garlic,parmigiano reggiano cheese,potato,jasmine rice
title: Bahian Sweet Potato Stuffed Plantains
ingredients: 4 plantains, tops removed | 3/4 cup jasmine rice | 1 whole head garlic ( optional ) | 4 sprigs fresh parsley | 1 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese for top
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Remove the leaves from the head of garlic and cut off a top half of the head. Scoop out the soft meat inside the small pulp and reserve, and place the pulp inside the cloves. Enlarge each piece out with a spoon. In a saucepan combine the rice, garlic, parsley, and 3/4 cup sugar. Bring to a boil. Place the plantains, 1 inch pieces of peeled garlic, and sprigs of parsley inside the rice mixture. Cover, and place in the oven. Cook for 45 minutes or until tender. Spread about 2 ounces of the parmigiano reggiano alongside each piece of plantain to distinguish the slices on the inside and the outside. Return the stuffed plantains to the oven for 5 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,oregano leaf,coconut milk,chicken breast fillet,taco seasoning,sesame seed oil,pork tenderloin
title: Fantastic Tropical Pork Tostadas
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin, fat trimmed, cut into 1/4 strips | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1/4 cup dry shredded coconut milk | 1/3 cup dry shredded, canned pineapple salad ( or any other tropical fruit salsa if you have it ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat a large baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Rinse the pork and pat dry with paper towels. In a large saute pan over medium heat, heat the sesame oil until it simmers very well. Add turkey slices and brown, about 6 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and cover to keep warm. Mix together the taco seasoning, coconut milk, pineapple salad, oregano, and salt in a large bowl. Stir in the pork. Spoon pork mixture into paper lined baking pan. Bake until the internal temperature registers 125°f and the meat is no longer pink in the middle and the juices run clear, 20 - 25 minutes. Serve the tropical fruit salsa.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,oil,white breadcrumb,chuck steak,tomato juice,cayenne,bread flour
title: Spanish Pizza
ingredients: 2 chicken breast halves, cutlets | 3 ounces white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons bread flour | oil, for deep frying | tomato juice | cayenne | 1 can sliced breadsticks ( with onion )
instructions: Place the chicken breast halves between 2 pieces of plastic wrap and using a meat mallet or rolling pin, pound the chicken to 1/4 inch thickness and then sprinkle with the breadcrumbs. Roll the chicken in the breadcrumb, then set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan and brown the chicken. Remove or reserve the chicken, then mix together the tomato juice, cayenne and remaining olive oil. Pour the mixture over the chicken, scatter on the sliced breadsticks and leave to marinate in the mixture for at least 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 200c/400f/gas fry the reserved chicken, then remove from the dish with a slotted spoon or slotted platter. Drain off the oil left in the frying pan, then add the sliced breadsticks and fry until crisp and golden.

title: Pineapple and Saffron Bread
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 3 slices bread | 1 pineapple ( optional ) | 1/3 cup coconut, shaken & chopped | 1/4 teaspoon saffron, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Spread pinto beans out on a plate and lightly toast the bread.

title: Polpettine (Or Fagioli) Pasta Salad With Mushrooms and Celery
ingredients: 8 ounces shell pasta, cooked ( or fagioli ) | 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms ( more if desired ) or 1 ounce dried cremini mushroom, soaked in hot water until tender, 10 to 15 minutes, then drained and sliced 1/8-inch thick | 1/4 cup pickle relish | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh marjoram or 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons chopped celery ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix cooked pasta and mushrooms and celery, adjusting seasonings if necessary. Top with relish and sprinkle on marjoram. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Peppered Rice With Prosciutto & Chocolate Syrup #RSC
ingredients: 4 slices prosciutto, cut thin | 1 1/4 cups cooked short-grain semolina rice | 1/2 cup choco-grape jelly or 1/2 cup chocolate syrup | 1/2 cup chilled leftover quinoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lay out the cheese slice on a piece of aluminum foil. Spread each slice of prosciutto across the prosciutto piece of foil. Pour jello or chocolate syrup over the prosciutto slices. Bake at 375 degrees f for 10 - 12 minutes, until the cheese has melted and is starting to darken. Take the piece out after 10 minutes. Spread rice on a large platter, drizzle with jello or chocolate syrup and serve with quinoa.

title: Tex-Mex Style Spiced Chorizo Tortillas
ingredients: 1/3 lb bulk chorizo, drained | 1 tablespoon instant masa harina | chocolate-covered coffee, for dipping | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Cut chorizo diagonally into 2 inch wide strips. Place chorizo in a bowl and pour boiling water over it. Let sit for 15 minutes. Drain. Using a fork, mash chorizo until evenly moistened. Stir in masa harina and chile and let sit for 10 minutes. Using a spoon, dip warm tortillas one at a time into hot chorizo mixture. Gently stir the tortillas to keep the bottom a little moist. Serve hot with coffee to soak up the excess. Sprinkle with lime wedges or green onion.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,tart green apple,honey,vodka,worcestershire sauce,pecorino romano cheese,clove,coffee liqueur
title: Apple-Crusted Grilled Fish
ingredients: 1/4 cup coffee liqueur | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup honey | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon dry instant coffee flavored liqueur | 1 whole clove | 2 lbs firm white fish fillets, split and cut into 4 portions | 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to moderate. Combine coffee liqueur, worcestershire, honey, vodka, fish sauce, coffee liqueur, and clove in a bowl. Add fish and turn to coat. Brush the fish fillets with the coffee liqueur mixture, and sprinkle with the cheese. Place on the grill, and cook approximately 3 to 5 minutes on each side.

title: Tagliatelle with Beef, Shrimp, Chives and Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb le prego rigati ground beef | 1 1/2 cups beef | 12 ounces medium raw shrimp, shelled & deveined | 2 tablespoons green mole | 2 teaspoons saffron, crushed | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons chives, snipped
instructions: Cook macaroni, drain. Boil shrimp till 'tender', about three minutes. Drain shrimp and keep warm. Meanwhile, cook beef in skillet till browned. Transfer to bowl and add shrimp, mole, raisins and green chives. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour pasta into bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,tomato puree,paprika,green pea,jalapeno pepper,table salt,curd cottage cheese
title: Spanish Bean Curd (Cottage Cheese)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons lard | 1/2 cup canned tiny green pea or 1/2 cup frozen green pea | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper | 1 1/2 cups small curd cottage cheese | 1 small can tomato puree, undiluted | 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 1/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Microwave peas on high for 3 minutes or until soft. Chop peppers. Reserve. Heat oil in a small saucepan on medium heat. Add peas and saute for 3 minutes. Add jalapeno, mix and remove from heat. Cover and set aside to cool. Combine dry ingredients in bowl. Add vegetables and stir until well blended. Microwave on high for 1 minute or until well blended. Stir before serving. This can be made ahead and reheated well.

title: Italian Veal (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground veal | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon black olives, sliced ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon green olives, sliced ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded lettuce leaves ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce. Shape into 8 patties about 3/4 of an inch thick.

title: Tarragon Paste.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 3 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon tarragon ( chopped fresh )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use as a seasoning for chicken, vegetables and potatoes.

title: Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 3 medium zucchini ( about 4 inches long ) | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Slice zucchini in half lengthwise, scoop out seeds, and slice diagonally into 1/8 inch thick slices, or cut each slice into 1/16 inch wide. Place the zucchini slices on a large baking pan, and bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Spray the tops with veggie oil spray. Return to oven and bake 12 minutes more, or until lightly browned and crisp.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,tea,coleslaw mix,bean,marjoram,green olive,vanilla pudding mix
title: Mexican Potatoes
ingredients: 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 1/2 cups coleslaw mix ( chopped ) | 1 can baked beans ( drained ) | 1 - 1 1/4 cup tequila-flavored coffee creamer ( such as hormel ) | 8 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese ( shredded ) | 2 tablespoons marjoram ( crushed ) | 1/2 cup green olives ( optional )
instructions: Spray 9 x13 baking dish with vegetable oil. Mix well. Add cooked meat, cheeses and marjoram. Mix well. Bake uncovered in pre heated 350f degrees oven for 45 - 55 minutes. Sprinkle evenly with green olives and serve.

title: Broccoli Guilt-free
ingredients: 3 cans broccoli, drained | 1 cup sweet hawaiian-style sauce ( hosberry )
instructions: Place broccoli in a large microwave safe bowl.

title: Angel Hair With Scallops and Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 8 ounces angel hair pasta | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds, lightly crushed | 12 ounces scallops | 8 ounces spaghetti, with lines ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 cup cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions, omitting salt, set aside.. Meanwhile, bring 5 qts. Water to boil. In small bowl with a wire whisk, mix caraway seeds and crushed red pepper. Dry scallops with paper towels. Cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Boil pasta until just tender but still firm enough to slice, drain and set aside. When pasta is done, combine with drained scallops and drained pasta. Season with salt and cream of tartar. Dot with butter. Serve at once.

title: Vegan Tomato Gravy for Marsha & Other Meat
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan, bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, or until thickened, stirring to prevent sticking. Serve over mashed or steamed basmati rice that has been cooked.

title: Oatmeal Wedges (Italian Mix)
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal | 1 tablespoon pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 1/4 teaspoon lime wedge ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke, or to taste
instructions: Combine the oatmeal, pecorino romano cheese, lime wedge, and liquid smoke in a bowl and stir well. Store in refrigerator until ready to use. Keep gyros chilled, but serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chervil,currant,black sesame seed,chicken bouillon cube,salad oil,baking potato,lamb,ketchup
title: Irish Curried Lamb or Pork Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salad oil | 2 1/2 lbs lamb or 2 1/2 lbs pork cutlets, sliced | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon black sesame seed | 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 teaspoons chervil | 1/2 cup dried currant | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cubes or 1 1/2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 2 large baking potatoes or 2 large peeled cut potatoes
instructions: Preheat oil in skillet. Fry lamb over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Remove as many pieces as possible and set aside. Reduce heat. In same skillet, add the black sesame seeds, ketchup and chervil. Cook over medium heat until the ketchup has thickened, about 10 - 12 minutes. Add lamb, stirring until well mixed. Return all meat to skillet. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and toss all together. Add currants to skillet. Cover and simmer until meat is cooked all the way through and potatoes are tender, about 20 - 30 minutes. Serve over prepared greens.

title: Sushi Vinegar
ingredients: 4 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger juice
instructions: Stir the soy vinegar, ginger juice and rice wine vinegar together. Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes before using.

title: Baked Kumera
ingredients: 1 kg kumara ( sweet potato ) | 30 g coriander | 20 g parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Wash kumera, peel off any bad looking skin and chop the flesh roughly. Place kumera in a roasting tray, sprinkle with the coriander inside and out, and toss well. Cover and put in a preheated oven at 200c for 40 minutes. Test that you can stand down and cook slowly and evenly. Check when the kumera is tender. When it has completely cooked, remove from oven, remove lid and cut in chunks, or place in a bowl and toss through cheese.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,lemon zest,molasses,grand marnier,serrano chili,anchovy fillet,courgette,italian sausage link
title: Sausage and Celery in Mead
ingredients: 2 ounces beef broth | 4 ounces sweet italian sausage links | 6 ounces creamed molasses | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 tablespoons chopped anchovy fillets | 1 tablespoon grated lemon, zest of | 1 fresh serrano chili, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Place all the ingredients in the base of the saucepan and heat gently, without boiling, for 5 minutes, to just blend and the ingredients are hot. Remove from the heat and cover, stirring occasionally. Keep warm. To serve, remove the rind with a knife before cutting the meat into thin strips of meat. Serve each diner with a slice of celery and a fried ramekin and a dollop of malt Scotch.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,red chilies,canola oil,yellow pepper,chicken broth
title: Chipotle Yellow Pepper Stir Fry
ingredients: 3 -4 medium yellow peppers ( or orange ) | 6 -8 large red chilies ( or more, adjust flavor to your liking ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth ( or water ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon finely chopped canned chipotle chiles in adobo ( or to taste )
instructions: Cut off tops, stem and seeds from peppers.

Random Ingredients: spanish rice,white wine vinegar,xanthan gum,cheddar cheese,rice
title: Spanish Rice (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 12 cups spanish rice ( regular rice is ok, but any variety ) | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese ( low fat is ok, too ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons xanthan gum ( can increase this if desired with more vinegar ) ( optional )
instructions: Rinse 1 cup rice until water runs clear. Drain. Place rice in rice cooker. Add cheese, vinegar, xanthan gum for a spicier dish. Close lid securely and add the water. Press the rice lid on the rice until all the water has drained out. Let sit for 15 - 15 minutes to steam the rice. Serve hot. Variation,. You might want to use extra cheese to flavor the dish.

title: Thai Salad
ingredients: 4 cups romaine lettuce, shredded | 3/4 cup sweetened coconut, with or without nuts | 1/2 cup palm sugar ( or dark rice syrup )
instructions: Rinse and drain lettuce leaves. Separate and cut into 2 inch strips, or divide between two salad plates. Top with coconut.

title: French Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grand marnier or 1 tablespoon orange liqueur | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mushrooms | 1 deli sirloin steak ( cut 1/4-inch thick ) or 1 deli top round beef steak, thinly sliced ( cut 1/4-inch thick ) | 12 hoagie rolls, split
instructions: Combine the grand marnier and mushrooms in a small bowl. Divide the mixture in half, spreading evenly over the cut sides of each roll. Top each with the steak and top with the remaining mixture. Serve hot.

title: Tamari Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamari, or more if desired | 1/2 cup water | 1/2 pound chicken breast, cut into large chunks | 1 pound frozen cooked meat, thawed
instructions: Combine the tamari and water in a skillet. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, and stir in chicken and the frozen meat. Simmer until the chicken is hot, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Melitzanes (Peaches) and Spicy Pear Mousse for Two
ingredients: 1 dozen green cardamom, split open | 1 cup marmalade | 12 peaches, ripe, halved and pitted ( or frozen pears )
instructions: Using a fine sieve, skim the cardamom seeds from the pods. Place the peaches and half the jam into a pan, cover with cold water and bring to boil. Cook for 2 - 3 minutes, or until tender. Drain and allow to cool until cold. Remove half the cardamom seeds from the seeds and reserve. Use a small sharp knife and split the rest of the cardamom pod. Place the remaining jam, reserved seeds and orange juice in a small bowl and gently stir in the jam, until smooth. Transfer to a serving dish, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until it's time to serve. Spoon over the reserved cardamom and garnish with the reserved cardamom. Serve warm.

title: Hot Peppers With French Onion
ingredients: 4 yellow peppers | 1/4 tablespoon dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon of dry minced onion | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Broil the pepper tops lightly on the grill to flame them. Remove from grill. Combine dry onion soup mix with brown sugar. Sprinkle half evenly over each pepper, and rub some of the brown sugar over. Broil on a large piece of foil, until the sweet peppers are hot and bubbly.

title: English Cucumber (Cucumber ) Tarts
ingredients: 1 english cucumber | 2 slices white bread, crusts trimmed | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 orange, juice of | 1/4 cup oil
instructions: The easiest way to do this is to cut away the thick and long ends of the cucumber and scrape out the coarse inner skin with a teaspoon into a colander. If you do this, the cucumber will be watery the easiest method. Halve the cucumber leaving one large section intact for the tarts. Cut out the seeds with a spoon or a knife blade. Cut the flesh with a knife into chunks of about 1 cm or 2 cm in size. Put the chunks into a large bowl and mix with the bread flour. Stir the orange juice into the mixture and then pour over the cucumbers and bread. Toss to combine. Divide into 8 portions and shape into balls, then leave to rest until needed. Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the balls for 1 minute each side, turning once. Drain when cooked on kitchen paper. Serve with yoghurt and mint sprityan.

title: Chutney and Broth Sweet Brochettes
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup sweet chutney | 1/4 cup teapot chutney | 1 small green pepper, diced | 3 cups ice
instructions: Pour cream and chutney into a saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. When cream is reduced by half, add teapot chutney. Stir in red pepper. Remove from heat and allow to sit at room temperature. Stir in 3 cups of the ice to a blender. Blend until smooth. Place 1/2 cup of the cream into each of 4 bowls, topping with some of the chutney. Pour a little chutney and cream over each plate and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,heavy cream,scallion,rosemary,sourdough bread,canola oil,baking soda
title: Sourdough Bread With Herbs, Serrano Peppers, and Scallions
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 -4 tablespoons heavy cream, warmed ( i use the low-sodium variety ) or 2 -4 tablespoons sour cream | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary ( or 1/2 t. dried ) | 2 pints sourdough bread, loafs sliced thinly crosswise ( about 8 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 6 scallions, minced ( green onions ) | 1 -2 serrano pepper, seeded, minced
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine oil, cream, rosemary, bread slices, baking soda, and scallions, and stir thoroughly to combine. Spoon mixture into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, and sprinkle top with minced serrano. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes or up to 1 day. Bake uncovered until top is well browned and crispy, 60 to 80 minutes. Variation, instead of the serrano peppers, you can use 2 - 2 serrano peppers and add them for more flavor.

title: Easy Beef Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks or 1 1/2 lbs skirt steak | 2 cups thinly-sliced italian parsley | 1/4 lb fresh orange zest, from about 3 oranges | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the flank steak, parsley, orange zest, paprika and nutmeg and store in the refrigerator for up to 2 days, turning periodically. Trim and discard all excess fat from the steak. Heat the grill to medium. Remove the steak from the bag and place on the rack in a shallow pan. Grill the steak for 3 minutes per inch of thickness or to desired degree of doneness, turning once or twice. Let stand for 5 minutes. Slice across the grain into thin slices. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,broth,chicken bouillon powder,cooking oat,vanilla pudding mix,date,maraschino cherry
title: Oatmeal Drop Soup With Dates and Squash
ingredients: 1 tablespoon quick-cooking oats | 32 fluid ounces strained broth ( or broth made from fresh broth or water ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried maraschino cherries ( optional ) | 1 large yellow squash, diced | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 12 ounces pitted dates, chopped
instructions: Prepare quick cookie oat cookie shape cookie crumbs. In a medium saucepan, add broth, oat cookies or water. Bring to the boil, then simmer until just thickened. Remove from heat. In a small saucepan, add cranberries or cherry juice to soup if using. Add 1 tbsp of chicken bouillon powder. Add more if desired. Add squash and cook 5 to 10 minutes. Add pudding mix and cook 5 more minutes. Add dates, stir well and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,lemon juice zest,white wine vinegar
title: Italian Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lb tomatoes and olive oil | 1/4 cup lemon juice or 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients, except the vinegar. Mix all the ingredients together.

title: Blueberry French Toast Sandwiches
ingredients: 12 slices sourdough bread | 1 1 cup broccoli | 1 cup yogurt | 1 bag frozen blueberries
instructions: Cut broccoli into small pieces and place in a baggie. Mix with yogurt and add frozen blueberries and mix together. Heat skillet over low and add bread, making diagonal slices, until slightly browned. Serve immediately on plates of soup.

title: Okra and Chicken Tarts
ingredients: 12 ounces okra | kosher salt | 5 cups canned chicken or 5 cups canned chicken broth | 2 cups sour cream ( sour cream is best ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Trim okra and cut into 1/2 inch rounds. Heat chicken broth over medium/high heat just until hot. Place okra in stock pot with just enough water to cover. Turn water to low. Set aside covered until okra is tender about 1 hour. Remove okra from broth and set aside while preparing filling. In a large bowl, mix okra, sour cream, and cream of tartar. Cover again. Remove okra from broth. Set aside for 5 minutes. Fill each flour or corn muffin tin about 3/4 full. Put cups of okra mixture in and mix. Pour about 1/4 cup reserved okra mixture in each muffin tin. Bake in medium oven until hot. Remove tin from oven. Cut a circle from top of muffin tin to let rest in the sides. Place muffini in the muffin tin. If using chicken, sprinkle with salt. If using chicken, cook meat for 20 minutes and add to the pot with rest of okra mixture. Cut in half and serve.

title: Tropical Currants On the BBQ
ingredients: 2 cups raw peeled currants ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup beer ( can also use other sweet lager beer, such as guinness ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon rice vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Place currants in a heavy medium size skillet or pot and cover with 1 cup water.

title: Beef & Spinach With Masala, Braised Onions & Mint
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 lbs boneless beef top sirloin, sliced across the grain into thin strips | 6 ounces baby spinach, packed | 1 medium yellow onion, cut into thin wedges | 3/4 cup psycaberry masala | 1/4 cup light soy sauce | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon cinnamon sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Toss sliced beef with half of 2 tablespoons of psycaberry masala mix and marinade for 30 minutes. Heat a large skillet over medium low heat and spray with cooking spray or set aside. Add half a large yellow onion, half of the sweet onion wedges, and half of the beef and saute for about 4 minutes. Remove beef and onions from heat. Stir fry spinach until wilted, about 5 minutes. Remove spinach from heat. Heat a heavy skillet over high heat add remaining oil, remaining sweet onion wedges, sweet onion and remaining sweet onion. Saute until onions are translucent and sweet onion are translucent, about 10 minutes. Add beef and onions back to pan and toss to mix meat with other ingredients. Arrange spinach on a baking sheet and drizzle with soy sauce and dark soy sauce mixture. Cover and bake for 30 minutes or until meat and onions are tender and sticky and heated through. Remove from oven and toss with mint. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,sea scallop,green,grain rice,plum tomato,pasta
title: Pasta and Seafood
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sea scallops | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 15 plums in heavy syrup ( not syrup ) | 6 plum tomatoes, quartered | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/sriracha-spicy-tomato-sauce-2499 '' > sriracha tomato sauce < /a > | 1 1 cup cooked noodles
instructions: Rinse the scallops well under running water and drain. Place in a non metallic bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until needed. Meanwhile, cook the rice in a large pot of boiling water, stirring frequently, until it is tender. Drain. Meanwhile combine the plums, tomatoes, and fish sauce in a large bowl. Add the cooked rice, scallops, drained plums mixture and fish sauce. Toss to coat. Serve sprinkled with sacha.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,grain rice,parsnip,goat cheese,raspberry,irish whiskey,sun tomato oil
title: Rough Rice and Goat Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 lb risotto rice ( short or medium grain, depending on the size of your grains, the rice will be creamy and sweet ) | 1 1/2 lbs goat cheese ( or other goat meat ) | 2 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, cut into strips | 1/4 cup goat cheese ( or other goat cheese ) | 3 tablespoons pistachio nuts, and roasted pistachio nuts, coarsely chopped ( or walnuts, finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey ( or cognac ) | 1 tablespoon fresh raspberry ( or frozen small raspberries, thawed if frozen )
instructions: Place about 2 inches of hot water on the bottom of a large, ovenproof, heavy bottomed nonstick skillet. Bring to a boil.

title: Classic Gratin of Gruyère
ingredients: 1 lb gruyere, sliced into 1 inch rounds | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/3 cup sherry wine | 5 lemons, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, chopped | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, freshly grated
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350°f and line the bottom and sides of a shallow ovenproof dish with a piece of baking parchment paper. Combine the wine, sherry, lemon peel and nutmeg in a bowl, stir well and set aside. Add the ginger and lemon zest and mix well and pour half into the prepared dish, top with the gruyère and bake, uncovered for approximately 45 - 50 minutes, until crust is golden brown and bubbly.

title: Pasta enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 6 quarts chicken stock or 6 quarts broth | 1 lb pasta, of your choice | 1/2 lb red enchilada sauce ( i like pace ) or 1/2 lb mild enchilada sauce ( i like pace ) | 1 jar of your favorite chili sauce ( or 2 tbsp. red hot ) | 1/4 cup heavy cream | pace ( to garnish ) or mace ( to garnish )
instructions: Prepare everything else, you can start off using a crockpot, but you can always cook it on high setting for the first 2 hours. Once pasta is ready, drain and put in bowl. Mix together sauce and cream, pour over hot pasta and mix. Add a little more cream to taste. Garnish with pace or fresh pace, and serve at once or refrigerate until time to serve for more lime or fruit flavor, if desired.

Random Ingredients: french onion,half,beef sirloin,irish whiskey,plum tomato,egg noodle
title: Beef and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh egg noodles | 4 cups half-and-half or 4 cups cream | 1 lb lean beef sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 cups peeled seeded chopped plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 1/2 cup chopped fresh french-fried onions
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water for 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking onion,cucumber,swiss cheese,porcini mushroom,lime wedge,egg yolk
title: Cucumber-Rice Balls (Puchero)
ingredients: 6 medium cucumbers, sliced | 1/2 cup sliced cooking onion | 4 ounces swiss cheese | 2 ounces porcini mushrooms | 4 large egg yolks, beaten ( optional ) | 12 large lime wedges, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the cucumbers, onion, cheese and porcini mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: wheat germ,maraschino cherry,red chili pepper flake,cauliflower,monterey jack cheese,flour tortilla,white cake mix,onion
title: Spicy Cheese Spirals With Cauliflower (Veggies)
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | 1 medium cauliflower, finely chopped | 1/3 cup wheat germ | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese ( or your favorite cheese ) | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons diced onions | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries ( optional ) | 12 large flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Spray a baking sheet with non stick spray. Stir together all ingredients in a medium bowl. On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough into a rectangle 12 by 16 inches. Transfer the dough to baking sheet and cut into 8x8 inch rectangle about 12 by 16 inches. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of red chile flakes over the top of the dough rectangle leaving about 1 inch at the edges. Sprinkle the shredded cheese on top of the red chile flakes. Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until edges begin to darken brown in color. Remove from oven and cut each crosswise into 8 slices. Transfer to a serving plate and place a cherry on top. Serve immediately.

title: Swiss Coffee Mousse
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coffee crystals | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 2/3 cups marshmallows | 1 shallot, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days, stirring before serving.

title: Spoon Pudding
ingredients: 1 kg plain flour | 300 g demerara sugar | white pepper
instructions: Sift the flour onto a pastry board and work the sugar into the dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly with the fingers or the side of a spoon. Once the mixture becomes more difficult to stir, knead for 10 - 15 minutes, until smooth and thick. Cover the bowl with a cloth and leave aside to rest in a cool place for an hour or two. Divide into six portions, roll out into balls with a rolling pin or floured spoon. Roll out each ball on a lightly floured board into a circle about 2 cm larger in circumference than the circle you are using. Using one piece of pastry with a diameter of about 10 cm, put a spoonful of jam into the middle and cover with remaining pastry, pressing the edges to seal. Place on a lightly oiled baking tray. Heat oven to 392°f / 190°c or gas mark 4, line a baking sheet with parchment paper, and place the baking tray on the tray with pastry. Press down carefully with the back of a spoon while you line it. If you have excess pastry in the bag, add it slowly to the baking sheet, this time over a medium heat until it starts to bubble. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until the pastry is golden and has a puffed appearance. Remove from oven and leave to cool slightly. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: paprika,water chestnut,green onion,yellow food coloring,walnut,yellow bell pepper
title: Muamba's Walnut Yellow Gooey Peppers
ingredients: 1 pound walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 pound yellow bell peppers, coarsely chopped | 2 green onions, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1 pinch paprika, or to taste | 2 drops yellow food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Place walnuts, yellow bell peppers, green onions, water chestnuts, paprika, and yellow food coloring in a blender. Blend until finely chopped, about 2 minutes. Drop by rounded tablespoons onto a bed of walnut pieces, and allow the pieces to dry for about 3 hours, before serving. Store warm in a dry, cool place.

Random Ingredients: english date nut bread,cannellini bean,heavy cream,rosemary,catsup
title: Savoury Sausage & Bean Dip
ingredients: 4 sausages ( spicy if you have to ) | 2 cans cannellini beans or ( 15 ounce ) cans navy beans | 1 1/2 tablespoons catsup | 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 2 1/4 cups heavy cream | 2 slices country style date nuts, toasted or 2 slices toasted sandwich bread
instructions: If using canned beans, drain and rinse. Bring about 3 - 2 cups of water to a boil then drain liquid into a saucepan and place in a large pot. Slice sausages into small 1/4 inch thick slices then add to boiling water and reduce to a simmer. Simmer for 5 - 6 minutes then remove sausages from the pot and set aside in a bowl to cool. Once cool, drain and add to cooked beans along with the rest of the ingredients except the toast or sandwich bread, and mix well. Slice toast to desired thickness then spread toast with the cream, top with sausagemeat or toast points and serve with the toast.

title: Mexican Green Beans & Lamb
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 10 ounces hot enchilada sauce | 4 ounces mild velveeta cheese | 2 cans green beans
instructions: Brown lamb. Add hot sauce and velveeta to meat. Simmer over low heat until cheese is melted. Add beans to pot. Add water for heat if needed and simmer until thickened.

title: Mader's Grape Leaves
ingredients: 2 packages fresh green grape leaves, washed | 1 cup fresh seedless grapes or 1 cup dried sweetened grapes, washed
instructions: Cut off the tips of the leaves, then use a sharp knife to trim off the white veins and stem. Place leaves into a medium size bowl and pour in enough water to cover them completely. Let stand for 1 hour. Drain and rinse. Cut each jar of grapes in half, giving you 6 pieces per leaf. Fill each jar with the grape leaves and add enough water to cover the bottom of the jar until it measures 2 inches above the top. Line up the grape leaves, one at a time, between 2 beds of hot tap water. Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon ice water | 2 - 2 1/2 lbs chuck, cut into 1 1/2- to 2-inch pieces | salt and cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the cocoa with the ice water, and pour over the meat. Sprinkle liberally with salt, cayenne, and paprika, and serve with toasted buttered toast or rye bread.

title: Classic British Cocktail
ingredients: 1 ounce cognac | 3 ounces lemonade
instructions: Shake with ice. Strain into a cocktail shaker half filled with ice. Shake very thoroughly, or just until chilled thoroughly. Pour into a glass filled with ice and add some lemonade.

title: Sauerkraut
ingredients: 500 g asafoetida powder | 100 g corn, frozen, whole kernels removed | 2 cups sauerkraut, raw, thawed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup lemon grass, finely chopped ( i used about 2 tablespoons ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sweet red curry ( read intro ) | 3 -4 tablespoons chinese wine or 3 -4 tablespoons dry red wine | parsley flakes ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: In a medium size mixing bowl, add frozen corn kernels and thawed sauerkraut. Mix until corn is well incorporated into sauerkraut and sauerkraut. If desired, add a little lemon grass to the sauerkraut. The secret is to mix it well so the flavors can blend and get distributed but are not mushy. Season to taste with spices or a couple of dashes of dark brown sugar as needed. Add 1 cup of chikke ki water or chicken stock and blend well. Transfer to medium size serving bowl and set aside. Heat non stick frying pan over medium heat. If using bamboo skewers soak for 1 to 2 minutes prior to using. Oil pan can be set aside or left to fry in the hot pan for 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer sauerkraut around to the pan on the rack. You will be dipping your skewers into the sauerkraut when they are ready. Strain off any excess oil remaining in the pan. This will help keep sauerkraut moist while frying. Place all meat into pan and sprinkle with lemon grass and add sauerkraut mixture. If desired, use sweet red curry for color and flavor, or use wine for a sweeter taste. Toss well to coat ingredients well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mini chocolate chip,skewer,scallion,salt pepper,heavy whipping cream
title: Bittersweet Chocolate Shish Kabobs
ingredients: 24 skewers | 1 container semi-sweet mini chocolate chips | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 3 -4 scallions, thinly sliced | salt and pepper
instructions: Lightly oil the grate. Place the chocolate chips in a small bowl. Heat cream, scallions and salt and pepper in a small saucepan until hot. Remove from heat, cool slightly and pour over the chocolate. Toss until evenly coated. Thread 1 piece of skewer onto each skewer. Grill or broil until golden and baste with cream while grilling or broiling. Serve with additional sour cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,venison,shrimp,agave nectar,dark brown sugar
title: Italian Venison Shrimp & Venison Fondue
ingredients: 1 lb ground venison | 1 lb cooked shrimp | 2 tablespoons light agave nectar, divided | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water over a medium high heat. Preheat barbecue grill for direct medium heat, lightly oil the grate. Add venison and shrimp. Thread venison and shrimp onto skewers.

title: Peach Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe peaches, peeled, pitted, halved, quartered | 1 vanilla bean, split | 1 1/2 inches gingerroot, peeled and cut into wedges ( about two 1 inch pieces ) | whipped cream
instructions: In a heavy small saucepan, combine peaches, vanilla bean pod and ginger half inch pieces, and bring to a boil over moderate heat, partially cover, and simmer until peaches are very tender and just beginning to get colored but still hold their shape, about 5 minutes. Set aside, and discard vanilla bean pod and ginger.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,heavy whipping cream,red bell pepper
title: Roasted Red Bell Pepper Ice Cream
ingredients: 3 red bell peppers ( roasted and peeled ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 pinch vanilla extract
instructions: In a saucepan, put the red peppers and their liquid into a blender and blend on high for 15 to 20 seconds. Pour into a bowl and whip the cream until stiff enough that you can hold a drop in your hand, and then fold into the peppers, blend again for 30 seconds. Pour into ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions. Let stand at room temperature for 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,baby spinach leaf,gruyere cheese,purpose flour,manchego cheese
title: Swiss Steak & Gruyere Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 8 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 8 ounces manchego cheese, shredded | 4 1/2 ounces all-purpose flour | 3 1/2 ounces baby spinach leaves, loosely packed | 1 -2 tablespoon coarse grain mustard
instructions: In a small bowl combine the grated gruyere, manchego and all purpose flour. In a medium saucepan melt the mustard on medium high heat. Whisk the mixture until it begins to turn golden. Turn off the heat, sprinkle the flour over and stir lightly with a fork to make a thick paste. Turn the heat up to medium high and add the mixture to the cheese and hot mustard. Whisk in the spinach until it is cooked through and well blended. Serve with french bread.

Random Ingredients: bread,pearl barley,cool whip topping cream,citrus peel,lime,red chile
title: Easy Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, day old, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup cool whip whipped cream | 1 teaspoon dried citrus peel, grated | 1 red chile, minced | juice of one lime
instructions: Combine sour cream, grape seed, peel, chillie and lime juice in a medium bowl and toss with bread cubes, barley and dressing. Cover and chill for approximately 30 minutes before serving.

title: Cashew Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 pound skinless, boneless chicken thighs | 1 cup cashews, soaked in warm water
instructions: Preheat oven and oven rack to 375 degrees f. Remove and discard excess fat and skin from chicken thighs. Pat cashews dry. Place chicken thighs in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour the cashews into a bowl, and mix in 1/2 the cashews. Spoon the chicken over the cashews, and sprinkle the remaining cashews over the top. Bake in the preheated oven 1 hour, basting with the warm marinade frequently. Serve.

title: Cheesy Biscuits
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat flour | 1/4 lb blue cheese, crumbled | 1 small onion, finely diced | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Mix all ingredients together. Take out one pat of dough at a time, place on your palm, flatten it a little thinner then roll. Put on cookie sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,pork baby back rib,bay scallop,shrimp,salmon fillet
title: Scallops and Pork for a Heartbeat Recipe
ingredients: 2 packages salmon fillets, cut into serving size pieces | 8 ounces shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 containers soymilk, or more as needed | 8 bay scallops, or more as needed | 1 1/2 pounds pork baby back ribs, cut into large chunks
instructions: Toss salmon, shrimp, and soy milk in a mixing bowl to coat thoroughly. Arrange scallops, salmon, shrimp, and baby back ribs in a deep, heavy skillet. Pour 1 cup water into skillet to cover salmon and shrimp. Reduce heat to medium low and cook mixture, gently tossing occasionally, until thickened, about 30 minutes.

title: Chicken and Corn Sauté
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | ice, as required | 6 boneless chicken breast halves, diced thinly | canola oil, as needed | 1 3/4 cups frozen corn kernels, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse chicken and dry thoroughly on paper towels. Cut into 2 inch pieces. Place chicken, breast halves and frozen corn on an oven safe gratin or baking dish and lightly oil the gratin or baking dish with canola oil. Bake chicken until just cooked, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from heat and tent loosely with foil. Sprinkle chicken with salt. Turn oven to broil, place chicken and corn on top of a broiler pan or under a broiler rack to heat, approximately 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,celery salt,canadian bacon,baking potato,bermuda falernum
title: German Potato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup canadian bacon or 1/2 cup canadian bacon, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup canadian bermuda falernum ( see note ) or 1/2 cup sweet potato, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( see note ) | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar or 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Note, bermuda falernum is the sweet potato from the supermarket with fruit. It is also known as sweet potato in the danish. It is a hard, sweet potato. If you do not like any fruit, you may substitute a combination of fruit, such as apples or peaches. Combine the potato, cheese and dressing and refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,vanilla bean,coriander,red chilies,dark brown sugar
title: Moroccan Party Spread
ingredients: 250 g sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthways | 8 red chilies, deseeded, chopped | 150 g dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut a shallow slice from the top of the cheddar, so that it makes it stand upright. Fill each half shell with about half of the cheese and gently squeeze the split vanilla bean over the cheese. Fold the chillies over the top, making sure the chillies are lying at the top of the cheese. Stir the sugar and coriander together until dissolved. Spoon the mixture evenly into the cheese shells and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Serve as is, or transfer to the refrigerator for upto 2 days. To serve, remove the chillies before serving.

title: Creamy Ziti
ingredients: 1/3 lb ziti pasta or 1/3 lb penne | 1/4 lb pine nuts ( salted if possible ) | 3 tablespoons linguine | 1 cup cream ( can use light ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder or 1 teaspoon cardamon | 1/4 cup coarse piloncillo ( brown sugar cane or other brown sugar packed brown sugar ) | 1 teaspoon cream
instructions: Cook ziti in plenty of boiling salted water until done but not overcooked, drain & toss with 1/4 cup cream. Put in serving dish & sprinkle the saffron, cardamon & piloncillo over top. The ziti can then be served hot over spaghetti or penne with the remaining cream.

title: Tara's Cherry Tree Taro Root Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs taro root, peeled | 14 -14 dried tart cherries, rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning ( spike ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 packet vanilla instant pudding, no boil
instructions: Cut taro root into 2 inch chunks. In a large pot, add taro root, cherries, seasoning, thyme and microwave for 1 minute. Then take pot off the stove and let sit for 20 to 25 minutes. Add vanilla pudding and mix, return to pot and allow it to cool for 1 hour or more before serving.

title: Thai Sweet and Savory Curried Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried red curry paste ( thai or indian style ) | 1/2 lb dried woodruff ( i use serrano, it's the kind of powder you get in asian ) | 1/2 lb dried unsweetened chili without beans, soaked overnight | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg, grated ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients except black pepper in large pot and bring to boil, turning down to low and simmering. Cook over low heat for 12 hours. Add hot pepper and simmer about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, discard spines and season with black pepper and a sprinkle of freshly grated nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,hot mustard,green tomato,baking potato,red cabbage
title: BBQ Potato Salad and Corn Chips
ingredients: 2 bbq large baking potatoes | 2 tablespoons hot mustard | 1 cup barbecue sauce, your favourite flavour | 1/2 medium red cabbage, thinly sliced | 4 green tomatoes
