instructions: Preheat barbecue grill to medium. Cut each potato into 6 wedges lengthways and place on lightly oiled grill tray. Cook at 200c for 50 - 60 minutes or until potato is tender when pierced with a knife and flakes easily when tested with a fork. Meanwhile, place mustard in a bowl and stir in hot barbecue sauce. Toss cabbage with the mustard dressing and divide between 4 plates. Top with tomato and potato wedges.

title: Habanero Smashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 teaspoon habanero pepper | 1/2 teaspoon vegemite | 4 russet potatoes, peeled and quartered
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Place the habanero pepper and vegemite in the center of each piece of potato. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 10 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,flat leaf parsley,canadian bacon,dark sesame oil,lemon zest,poblano chile
title: Pomegranate-Charred Pomegranate Chilies With Canadian Bacon and Parsley
ingredients: 3 red poblano chiles | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 12 slices canadian bacon | 2 tablespoons finely minced flat leaf parsley | lemon zest, freshly grated
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Roast chiles on grill, turning, until charred and blackened on all sides, 15 - 20 minutes, depending on the size of the peppers. Once cool enough, slit the skin from the chiles lengthwise, scraping out the seeds, and pull any membrane and seeds away. Cut chiles lengthwise in half, scrape out seeds, and set aside. Place chiles in a medium size heavy skillet. Pour sherry and dark sesame oil over chiles, and sprinkle with bacon and parsley. Heat over high until boiling, then reduce heat to moderately low and cook, covered, until chiles are tender, 9 - 10 minutes. Transfer mixture to a serving dish and garnish with lemon zest.

title: Ancho Chile Sauce for Baking Stone
ingredients: 1 can solo chile | 1/4 cup brewed coffee
instructions: Pour coffee into a coffee cup or other bowl. Add ancho chile and stir before using. Serve with other baking recipes.

title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 2 cans crushed italian-style tomatoes, or more as needed | 1 can tomato paste | 1 can hominy | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon dried thyme, or more to taste | 1 avocados, diced, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Spread the crushed tomatoes in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,lemon pepper,honey mustard,hot italian sausage,cilantro leaf,coffee granule
title: Grilled Hot Italian Sausages
ingredients: 2 tablespoons honey mustard | 2 tablespoons hot italian sausage, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon hot coffee granules | 2 drops lemon pepper
instructions: To make dressing, combine all ingredients, stir well. Chill. Grill sausages and spoon hot dressing over them, garnish with cilantro.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,kalamata olive,canola oil,pita bread,crouton,halibut fillet,wheel brie cheese,grape tomato
title: Halibut With Cardamom and Kalamata Olive Relish
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs halibut fillets | 1 cup crouton | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 cup grape tomatoes ( halved ) | 1/4 cup kalamata olive ( pitted chopped ) | 1/4 cup kefalotiri ( grated, about 1/4 cup ) or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese ( grated, about 1/4 cup ) | 2 large pita bread, cut into triangles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Score fish on the top and bottom of each cutlet horizontally so they lie flat on a plate. Place croutons on a baking sheet and arrange in a single layer without turning. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned. Combine oil, 1/4 teaspoon cardamom and remaining 1/4 teaspoon cardamom in a small skillet and cook 1 minute, stirring occasionally. Place a pita, then a half slice of halibut, in each bowl of crouton mixture. Dollop 1/4 cup relish over halibut and top with olives.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,black cardamom pod,pork loin,mexican cheese,plain nonfat yogurt,heart palm
title: Chef John's Crockpot Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, cut into 1-inch strips | 6 large bread or hearts of palm, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices | 10 -12 black cardamom pods, cracked open | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 cups shredded mexican cheese | 2 teaspoons crushed dry mexican spices, such as mccormick's black pepper
instructions: Set oven rack to middle position, and preheat to 500 degrees f. Place pork in a 2 1/2 or 3 quart or larger, 3 1/2 1/2 quart or larger dutch oven. Scatter the bread strips, cardamom and 3/4 cup of the yogurt over the pork. Pour over 1/4 cup of water, cover and roast until the pork is no longer pink in the middle, about 45 minutes. Cool slightly, then slice, removing the bone. To make gravy, combine the remaining yogurt with all of the balsamic vinegar, cheese and 1 teaspoon of the mexican seasoning.

title: Creamy Chinese Cashew Toast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soft white breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon tamari or 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 2 teaspoons cashew pieces, lightly toasted
instructions: Place bread crumbs in bowl. Sprinkle tamari or soy sauce over bread crumbs. Mix till well combined. Dip cashew pieces into mixture. Heat griddle and allow to cook till golden brown.

Random Ingredients: sausage,bread flour,green olive,zucchini,mexican oregano,flour,saffron thread,green chili pepper
title: Mexicasa
ingredients: 1 lb fresh sausage, casing removed | 6 large zucchini, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 cups flour | 1 large green olives, cut into quarters | 1 1/2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 2 tablespoons fresh minced green chili peppers | 2 tablespoons bread flour
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine sausages, zucchini and flour, adding more flour if needed. Using a rolling pin, roll into thin, even disks. Place disks on a flat baking tray. Sprinkle lightly with oregano, saffron and green chili peppers. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes or until golden. Remove from the oven and transfer to an assembly pan or flat grill. Allow to cool slightly then slice into 1/2 inch slices. Place slices back onto baking tray and bake 10 minutes or until crisp and golden. Serve warm with guacamole and salsa.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,cheddar cheese,cayenne pepper,grainy mustard,fine breadcrumb,roast beef,lemon juice,white onion
title: Hot Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb top round roast beef | 1/3 cup dry fine breadcrumbs | 1 lemon, juice of | 2 tablespoons prepared grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 cans rotel diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1/3 cup grated cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup white onion, chopped
instructions: Slice beef across grain in thin slices and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Using a fork, lightly rub and spread bread crumbs on top of beef.

Random Ingredients: milk,filling,back bacon,lemon pepper seasoning,white wine,guava paste,buttermilk
title: Guava Pastries
ingredients: 1/2 pound back bacon, chopped | 1 1/2 cups guava paste | 1 can evaporated milk | 1/2 ounce white wine | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1 teaspoon prepared buttermilk | 1 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir the bacon until evenly brown. Mix guava paste, evaporated milk, white wine, lemon pepper seasoning, and buttermilk together in a bowl. Roll 1 heaping teaspoon of the guava filling into 1 ounce balls, roll in confectioners' sugar, and place onto prepared toothpicks. Place a toothpick into the center of pastries to keep closed. The pastries can also be blanched on the grill to crisp.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,cider vinegar,hummus,hard egg,worcestershire sauce,chili powder,bell pepper
title: Nacho Salad
ingredients: 2 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 8 ounces fresh hummus | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1/4 cup walnut oil
instructions: Mix together egg, peppers, chilli powder, hummus and worcestershire sauce. Pour into serving bowl. Whisk in oil. Gently mix in remaining ingredients. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,pasta sauce,mix vegetable,monterey jack cheese
title: Queso Fresco
ingredients: 225 g pasta sauce ( i prefer macaroni & cheese ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 225 g monterey jack cheese | 225 g mixed vegetables
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, toss in the vegetables. Fry until soft, add the pasta. When it has cooked, add the cheese. Heat through and enjoy. Variation, instead of the oil i used an oil based quesadilla, like my son did.

title: Cheese Wrapped Spicy Swiss Bread
ingredients: 3 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 tablespoon herbs, chopped | 1 tablespoon cilantro, chopped | 3 maraschino cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In bowl, combine cheese, chili oil, herbs and cherries. Spread evenly on bread. Wrap bread with foil. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until cheese has melted and is bubbly. Slice into 1 1/4 slices.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,beef chuck roast,seasoning salt,stewing beef,baking soda,turmeric powder
title: Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 tablespoons dry cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons beef fat, melted | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 dash seasoning salt | 1/2 tablespoon ground turmeric powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir to blend well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Grill as usual.

title: Mustard Glazed Beef
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar ( not packed ) | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes or 1 lb lean stew meat, cut in 3 inch chunks | 1/2 teaspoon coarse mustard powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight, or at least 3 hours.

title: Smokin' Irish Rye
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 1/2 fluid ounces rye whiskey | 1 pinch cayenne powder
instructions: Stir soup with rye whiskey and cayenne powder until well blended. Spoon into a glass, and serve.

title: Blueberry Merlot Wine
ingredients: 1 cup merlot ( red wine ) | 1/2 cup blueberries | 2 teaspoons horseradish, drained
instructions: Combine merlot, blueberries, and horseradish in a wine glass. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato,lima bean,cream celery soup,tomato puree,red onion,okra,lime juice
title: Okra With no-salt Tomato and Lime Dip
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra | 1 tomato puree | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 1 teaspoon no-salt-added tomato puree | 1/4 cup light sour cream ( optional ) | 1 small red onion, diced fine ( optional ) | 1 can no-salt-added diced tomatoes ( i use hunt's tomatoes & basil ) or ( 16 ounce ) can stewed tomatoes, drained, chopped ( i use hunt's tomatoes & basil )
instructions: Cook okra according to package directions. Allow to cool completely, then transfer to a food processor or blender using fine blade or blender blade. Add remaining ingredients and puree. Serve cold or room temperature.

title: Fish and Beef Steak Sandwich - (Or Wrap)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef eye round, filets | 4 tablespoons horseradish, divided | 4 leaves boston lettuce, cut in half | 2 -16 slices bread ( or use your own sandwich roll )
instructions: Brush each piece of meat with ½ tsp horseradish. Grill until tender but slightly rare. Turn, brush with remaining horseradish, and continue grilling until done to your liking. While the meat cooks, place the lettuce on the cut side of both halves of the bread. Place fish on top. Top with remaining horseradish, then some hot pepper sauce. Broil or toast briefly to serve.

title: Homemade Seasoned Dry Guajillo Sauce
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 8 large dried guajillo chilies
instructions: Combine the oregano and chilies in a mortar and grind until fine. Add the remaining ingredients and grind everything together into a thick paste, working it in gradually. Allow about two hours for the flavors to blend. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: nori,natural peanut butter,raisin,gorgonzola,ginger garlic paste,corn tortilla,brown rice,plastic wrap
title: Rice Wrap Wrap With Peanut Butter, Raisins and Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1/4 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 20 soft corn tortillas | 2 cups raw brown rice, rinsed | 1 package crumbled gorgonzola | 3 cups natural-style peanut butter | 7 sheets plastic wrap, wrap | nori ( optional )
instructions: Bring 2 cups water and 1 tablespoon salt to boil in a large dutch oven over high heat. Add raisins and ginger garlic and stir fry one minute. Add rice.

Random Ingredients: white wine,greek yogurt,cream chicken soup,beef,sea scallop
title: Scallops and Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs shrimp, fresh ( about 8 shrimp ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can white wine ( such as cava ) | 12 ounces greek yogurt | 3/4 lb sea scallops, cut in 1/2 lengthwise
instructions: Cut the shrimp in half and rinse in cold water. Put the soup, wine and half of the yogurt into a wide mouth bowl. Stir to mix. The soup and wine should cover the shrimp perfectly. Add the rest of the yogurt and mix. Put half the shrimp in the soup mixture and half the scallops in the bowl. Add the rest of the shrimp. The soup and wine should cover the shrimp completely, but make sure they are well covered. Let sit in the fridge for at least an hour. Serve in a nice bowl or in a warm, room temperature bowl.

title: Wild Rice and Ham Rollatas
ingredients: 2 cups wild rice or 2 cups arborio rice | 1 lb lean ham | 1 inch cube gingerroot, peeled
instructions: Boil rice in a large pot for about 30 minutes. Cut ham into small cubes. Drain rice and set aside. In a large bowl, pour out rice and pour into ham/ham cubes and add ginger. Mix well. Roll into about 16 - 16 rollhats and place on a floured cookie sheet. Let stand 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bake for about 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Halibut Stuffed with Rum & Rosemary
ingredients: 2 lbs halibut fillets | 2 cups good quality dark rum | 8 sprigs fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 3 cups salted cashews, finely chopped | 1 cup beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil. Using a sharp knife, cut a pocket lengthwise down each side of fish to within 1/2 inch of backbone. Insert 1 rosemary sprig into each cavity. Pour rum over fish and marinate 20 minutes, or longer in the refrigerator. Stuff fish with cashews. Using your fingers, press cashew nuts into the sides evenly. Season fish with salt and pepper. Arrange fish in baking sheet. Pour beer around fish. Place an empty broiler pan on the top rack of oven, then pour liquid around the fish in pan. Roast fish for 45 minutes, until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork and no blood seeps out of the shell. Baste or baste with rum during the last 15 minutes of cooking.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,fine breadcrumb,creole seasoning,lemon juice zest
title: Fried French Bread Wedges
ingredients: 3 cups fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 cup creole seasoning, divided ( see note ) | 2 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Slices are good. You can keep them longer but you'll have to experiment with the yield.

title: Basmati Rice With Parsley and Parsley
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed, drained | 3 ounces flat leaf parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Put rice, parsley and salt in a bowl. Stir well. Fluff together with a fork.

title: Pork Kebobs--Pepperoni-Pepperoni
ingredients: 2 packages egg noodles | 1 - 1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin | pepperoni, slice | 8 medium strawberries, sliced
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Cut pork tenderloins in half lengthwise, then into 1/2 slices. Lay slices of pepperoni across the noodles, then top with strawberries. Cover with a package of egg noodles. Close bag and marinade for at least 1 hour, or overnight. Grill or broil until hot.

Random Ingredients: avocado,mint sprig,beef brisket,spaghetti sauce,artichoke heart,fish sauce
title: Avocado Spiced Brisket
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, well drained and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce, preferably heinz | 2 avocados, peeled, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 -3 large mint sprigs
instructions: Arrange brisket in a foil lined broilerproof dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over brisket. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and bake, in a 350 degree f oven, until brisket is very tender, about 3 hours. Transfer brisket to cutting board and let stand 10 minutes. Cut brisket across the grain into thin slices and serve.

title: Slow-Cooker Cauliflower Chicken
ingredients: 2 cans reduced-sodium chicken broth | 8 skinless, boneless chicken thighs | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 can diced tomatoes
instructions: Combine the chicken broth and cauliflower in a slow cooker. Cook on low for 8 hours, or on high for 4 hours. Place the chicken thighs and cauliflower over the cooked cauliflower mixture. Stir in diced tomatoes.

title: Chef John's Cherry Balls
ingredients: 1 kg pitted cherries | 4 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Mix the cherries with the soda in a bowl. Scoop out small balls of the mixture and roll between your palms to coat the cherry mixture with each. Store in a cool, dry place.

Random Ingredients: nori,heavy whipping cream,garam masala powder,coconut cream,flat leaf parsley
title: Tikka Masala With Masala Cream
ingredients: 8 ounces heavy whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 2 tablespoons grated coconut cream | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 3 nori, sheets toasted on both sides
instructions: Combine the cream, garam masala and coconut cream in a small nonstick pan and bring to a simmer. Cook the mixture over low heat, stirring, for 5 minutes or until reduced by half. Remove from heat. Stir half of the tikka masala into the cream. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the parsley and remaining tikka masala. Taste and adjust the seasoning, adding salt or more curry powder as needed. The cream mixture should be creamy and hot but still pourable. Place a nori sheet on a flat ridged surface. Drizzle the cream over the nori and roll into a log, 1 - ½ inches in diameter. Repeat with the remaining nori sheets. Cut the roll into 4 inch lengths. Serve hot, room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: baking cocoa,shaoxing wine,monterey jack cheese,serrano pepper
title: Qiao Ji Zhuwan(Singapore) - a Hot Buttermilk Substitute for ichuan Cheese
ingredients: 1/3 cup baking cocoa | 1/3 cup shaoxing wine ( dry chardonnay ) | 3 serrano peppers, stemmed, seeded, and cut into 1 1/2-inch matchsticks | 4 cups shredded monterey jack cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium bowl and mix until well blended. Stir in 1 1/2 cups cheese. Pour into a large baking dish or pie plate. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake until browned, about 20 minutes. Cool to room temperature.

title: Moroccan White Bean Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces dried navy beans | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1 can chicken breasts, cut up | 1 lb small red potato, peeled & cut in 1-inch cubes | 2 cups cold water
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight. Bring water to a boil, add beans, and let boil 1 hour or until tender. Drain any remaining water out of beans. Place potatoes in a large saucepan, pour in water, and bring to a boil. Cook until tender, about 20 minutes, adding more water if necessary. Drain. Place cooked beans, remaining water, harissa, chicken, and the spices into a food processor or blender, then process until smooth. Add the potatoes, simmer until heated through, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,cooking spray,white bean,salmon,taco seasoning mix,sirloin steak,allspice,gingerroot
title: Beef and Beans Wraps
ingredients: 4 sirloin steaks | 4 large tortillas, halved | 2 cans white beans | 2 tablespoons fresh gingerroot, chopped | 4 1/2 teaspoons dried spices ( sage, thyme, cumin, black pepper ) | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking spray | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( 1 cup ) | 1 cup canned smoked salmon, chopped, with juice
instructions: Pat steak dry with a paper towel. Cut into 6 serving size pieces. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Coat pan with cooking spray.

title: Lucky Cookies--Easy!
ingredients: 4 cups icing sugar ( sifted ) | 1 tablespoon instant bouillon | 4 cups plain flour
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f. Mix all ingredients except flour together thoroughly. Add flour one cup at a time to dry ingredients and beat well. Do this by hand. Roll dough into 1 inch balls. Place on greased tray and put in 200° oven for 15 minutes. Turn oven down to 150° and let cook 20 more minutes. They should be slightly darker than a golden. Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature. These cookies don't seem to last 2 - 3 weeks in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,canola oil,bouillon cube,au jus sauce,white breadcrumb,flour,lemon
title: Au Jus Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 1/2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 1/2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 1/4 teaspoons of knorr instant au jus sauce | 1 1/4 cups white breadcrumbs | 1 bouillon cube | 1/2 cup flour | 1 fresh lemon
instructions: Preheat oven to in a medium saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon oil on medium heat. Add 2 1/4 tablespoons rice flour and sauté until golden. Add 2 1/4 teaspoons of knorr instant au jus sauce, white bread crumbs, or 2 1/4 teaspoons of knorr powder, and bouillon cube. Mix up a bit. Add 2 tablespoons of oil to pan to lightly coat pan. Punch down dough. Turn out onto a surface and knead a few times. Cut off 1 tablespoon dough and use a rolling pin to stretch the dough out into a rectangle about 1inch thick. Cut the dough into 1 1/2 inch strips. Fold 1 strip over the middle of the strip, pressing until the dough sticks to the sides of the strip. Roll out until paper thin. Repeat with remaining dough and oil. Spray baking sheet with pam. Place strips in a single layer on baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes or until golden. Squeeze the squeezed lemon out while they are warm. Slice off some of the thin ends to make dipping sauce.

title: Zuccotto and Spinach
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles | 12 ounces fresh spinach leaves | 8 ounces gnocchi ( mini zucchini ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles as directed on the package. Drain, rinse with cool water, and set aside. Cover and set aside. Toss spinach with gnocchi in a large bowl. Bring water, gnocchi, and mint to a boil. Add spaghetti and cook for 1 minute. Scoop some of spinach mixture into hot water, stir to separate, and remove from heat. Scoop into serving bowls, pour cocoa over and serve.

Random Ingredients: red chili,almond extract,green apple,coconut milk,apple,red chili pepper flake,tomato green chilies
title: Thai-Spiced Apples
ingredients: 3 apples, cored and sliced into 1/4-inch slices | 1 can coconut milk | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 3 -4 small dried red chili peppers, seeded | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and mix well. Place apple pieces and tomato chunks in separate bowls. Serve with chutney on side.

Random Ingredients: celery,allspice,monterey jack cheese,beef bouillon cube,salad oil,cardamom
title: Aussie Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs monterey jack cheese or 1 1/2 lbs romano cheese, grated ( 6 cups ) | 3 tablespoons salad oil | 4 cups beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground celery
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a small bowl combine cheese and oil. Arrange cheese mixture evenly in ungreased shallow casserole. In lg saucepan heat bouillon, cardomon and allspice until boiling. Remove from heat. Stir 1/4c hot broth into bouillon mixture and set aside. Pour bouillon mixture over cheese mixture.

title: Whole Wheat Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat spaghetti | 1 orange, sliced
instructions: Cook your whole wheat spaghetti according to pkg directions. Remove from heat. Heat large pot until boiling on stove top. Add pasta and stir. Place a slice of orange on top. Serve on platter.

title: Lentil and Mango Chutney Cake
ingredients: 60 g butter | 1/2 large green lentil | 6 tablespoons double cream | 60 g chopped mango chutney | 1/3 cup extra light cream | 1 slice genoa salami
instructions: Melt the butter and cook the lentils in plenty of fresh water until tender. Drain well and set aside. Whip the cream and chutney together then stir into the lentils. Arrange the salami on the untoasted side of the cake, then top with cream to serve.

title: Banana and Manchego (Brazilian)
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger ( good quality ) | 12 banana slices lengthwise, cut in half crosswise | 1 can vegetable stock
instructions: Place one half of hamburger between wax paper and roll until it is very thin and round. Place on a piece of wax paper or in a large ziploc bag. Poke holes in hamburger with a fork, just in order of when it reaches a thickness of 1/3, insert toothpicks. Cook in hot non stick skillet until browned, on both sides. Add veg and stock to hamburger, mix well. Heat till boiling. Serve topped with slices of banana and a sprinkling of cheese or paprika if desired. Serves 2 people.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,honey mustard,chinese cabbage,salt,yellow pea,spanish onion,pimento olive
title: Green Chile Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup chinese cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup yellow split peas | 1/2 cup spanish onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, finely chopped | 1 medium green chilies or 1 medium red chili, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon honey mustard | salt
instructions: Chop green chilies and olives. Saute onions and bell peppers in olive oil until browned. Add remaining ingredients and stir together. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Japanese Style Shitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup mushroom water ( approximately ) | 1 cup mirin | herbs ( optional )
instructions:
Wipe the mushrooms with a damp cloth and slice them open, placing the stem end under, the stem end on one side of the mushroom cap, the bottom side on the mushroom top slice the open end with a knife, make a small slit, and remove the mushroom top 
    - she should end up with six mushroom caps. Wipe out the empty mushroom cap and discard it. Wipe the mushroom caps dry with damp cloth and clean up any dirt. If using soaking herbs, soak them in hot water for 5 - 10 minutes depending on taste. Put mushrooms in a saucepan and add enough water to cover, bring to a boil, lower heat to medium and let simmer for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,corn,thai holy basil,chicken liver,tomato soup
title: Quick and Easy Lumpia Wraps
ingredients: 1 package wonton wrappers | 1 package chicken livers | 1 jar sweet corn, drained | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 1 cup thai holy basil
instructions: Mix together the first four ingredients.

title: Easy Hot Mushroom Stock With Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 4 large mushrooms stems or 1 1/2 lbs mushroom caps | 1 1/8 - 1 1/4 liters hot stock
instructions: Clean mushrooms under running water until the stem part is clean. Trim stems using a sharp knife. Slice caps into 1/2 inch lengths. Heat a heavy based medium frying pan. Add mushroom caps and cook, stirring, until soft. Add heated stock and cook, uncovered, until reduced by half. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Mexican Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cut baguette diagonally into 1/4 inch thick slices. Spray a 9 x 13 baking pan with cooking spray. Spoon half the cheese into a large bowl, sprinkle with remaining cheese. Sprinkle with almond extract. Arrange the bread slices in a single layer over top and press with a spatula to slightly flatten cheese. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 400°f place the foil with bread in a small baking dish and bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned.

title: Tofu Satay (Approximately 2 Ingredients)
ingredients: 3 ounces soft tofu | 3 tablespoons orange juice concentrate | 1 teaspoon honey | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1 teaspoon ketchup | 1/8 teaspoon cumin powder | 3 cups ice water | fresh squeezed orange juice concentrate, for brushing
instructions: Cut tofu in cubes, place in freezer for 15 minutes. Break cubes in chunks with fingers. Drain tofu. Blend all other ingredients in blender until smooth. Place cubes into an oven safe dish and place in freezer 15 minutes. Remove from freezer. Using your hands, rub marinade over tofu cubes. Let sit at room temperature for about 1 hour or overnight, stirring occasionally. Place a piece of aluminum foil on the lowest rack of your oven. Preheat your oven's broiler. After the 15 minute interval, turn the tofu over and brush it lightly with some extra orange marinade. Broil until it is cooked and tinged with brown, about five minutes. While this is broiling, mix up fruit slurry and serve.

title: Agni-Fennel Powder
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fennel seeds | 2 teaspoons black peppercorns or 2 teaspoons whole cardamom
instructions: To a spice grinder or mortar and pestle, combine the fennel and black peppercorns and grind to a fine powder. Add the powdered spices and pound again to mix well. Store in an airtight jar and use immediately. Variation, to make a 1 1/2 oz cube of bread or 1 1/2 oz of melted ghee, combine a small amount of the cold ghee or butter with a cube of yogurt in a small bowl and mix well. Add this mixture to the cubed bread or ghee before serving. Variation, to increase the flavor of the powder slightly, use 2 tbsp of sunflower oil to coat the pan.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,plain yogurt,cream tartar,vegetable oil cooking spray,green cardamom pod,fillet tilapia,lime
title: Tandoori Fish Fillets on Creamy Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 tablespoon lime rind, minced | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking spray | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pod, crushed | 2 lbs fillets tilapia ( about 4 fillets ) | green cardamom pod, for garnish
instructions: Combine the cream of tartar, garlic, lime rind, oil, yogurt, and cardamom pods. Cover, and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight. Heat oven to 400º. Drain the tilapia fillets on paper towels. Bake or broil 4 - 5 inches from the heat for 12 - 15 minutes, brushing once with the yogurt sauce. Serve with the green cardamom sauce on the side. Makes about 8 servings.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,tortilla chip,chile pepper,chicken tender,onion soup mix,tomato juice,maraschino cherry
title: Tortilla Chicken
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chile pepper, crushed | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 cup diced onion | 2 cups diced rotisserie-cooked chicken tenders | 1 can tomato juice | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh chile peppers | tortilla chips, for garnish | maraschino cherries, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, add the pepper, onion soup mix, onion, rotisserie chicken, tomato juice, chile peppers and chili peppers to the onions and stir until blended. Transfer to an 11x7 inch baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power for 7 minutes. Serve the chicken mixture over tortilla chips, garnish with cherries.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,garlic clove,pie shell,radish,rosemary,blue cheese,romaine lettuce
title: Blue Cheese, Radish & Green Chile Parfait
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crumbled blue cheese | 1 cup shredded romaine lettuce | 1 green chilies or 1 red bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 -10 leaves fresh rosemary or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 garlic cloves, minced or 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 radishes, very thinly sliced | 4 crusty pie shells
instructions: Combine cheeses, and spread evenly into each pie shell. Sprinkle with lettuce and bell pepper and rosemary. Drizzle radishes and green chiles with the garlic, and sprinkle on top of cheese. Bake in a shallow 350 oven until lightly browned.

title: Pupusas
ingredients: 6 slices white bread | 1 cup masa harina | 1 cup white pepper | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Toast bread slices until golden, but not burnt. In a mixing bowl mix all of the dry ingredients, mix to the dry ingredients, adding warm water until dough forms a nice dough. If sticky, add a bit of water. Cut dough into two or three balls and set aside in a bowl for 1 hour to rise. Preheat oven to 550 degrees f. Form small patties about 1 inch in diameter with your palms. Place patties on a baking sheet and bake for 5 to 7 minutes on each side. Serve warm.

title: Easy Feta Cheese Wraps
ingredients: 4 feta | 3 tablespoons garlic paste | 1/2 cup walnut pieces or 1/2 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Make sure there is a fair amount of ventilation in the microwave oven. Combine your garlic paste and walnuts. Add cheese to walnut mixture. Stir with a spoon until well blended. Then fold in your cheese mixture. Take a sheet of foil and cut a slit in the middle of the wrap making sure it is sealed. Twist it open as if you have a book closing outwards. Put the top on the foil to keep warm. Take a tablespoon of feta cheese mixture and place it onto the top of your packet. Squeeze the packet to get the juices out and wrap. Serve.

title: Simple Baked Spicy Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 cups cooked strained stewed tomatoes ( or your favorite canned stewed tomatoes ) | 2 cups cooked liquid stock ( if using canned tomatoes ) | 0.5 can tomato paste
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375f degrees. Mix all ingredients well. Place in a baking pan sprayed with a nonstick cooking spray. Cover the baking pan with aluminum foil and bake about 45 minutes.

title: Tortilla Di Pignola
ingredients: 4 tortillas ( mini size ) | 4 tablespoons finely chopped scallions | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Heat a skillet.

title: Schweizer - Pork Chops With Kirsch-Pork Toast
ingredients: 8 center-cut pork loin chops or ( 3 inch ) loin chop, 1/4-inch thick | 1/2 lb kirsch | soft bread, toasted
instructions: Warm the kirsch. Grill the chops until they have a rich golden crust. Heat a skillet. Coat with soft bread or roll in the kirsch. Remove chops and add to the skillet. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve immediately.

title: Noodles that look like French fried rice, or as suggested in the intro
ingredients: 12 ounces small shell pasta or 12 ounces risotto rice ( or to taste ) | 1 dash nutmeg
instructions: Cook the rice the way you like. It might take a little time, according to the package directions, but be sure to stir until all the pieces have been well coated. When the rice is cooked, drain water, and set aside. Meanwhile, add the nutmeg to the drained pasta and mix with two forks until the noodles are separated and have turned yellow. Toss immediately with the hot noodles.

title: Steak Mint Studded with Dates, Green Sauce Mint
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried mint leaves | 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck or 1 1/2 lbs steak | green food coloring
instructions: Preheat broiler/gril. Place the mint leaves on a foil or waxed paper lined baking sheet. Place the meat on top. With meat tenderizing help melt the mint. Sprinkle the food coloring on. Broil for 5 - 10 minutes or until the meat is cooked to preference doneness. Cool/thop the mint and store any leftover mint in a jar and refrigerate. The mint will become gummy but keep the flavor. Serve with bread.

title: Noodles and Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces dry wide rice noodles, broken into 2-inch pieces or 8 ounces spaghetti | 1 1/2 tablespoons cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 7 ounces bean sprouts | 2 -3 medium potatoes, cooked and chopped
instructions: Drop the noodles into boiling water and cook until tender, about 2 minutes in a skillet. Drain well and drain well. Meanwhile, in the same skillet, add the cannellini beans and sprouts and cook until the beans are heated. Drain the drained noodles well and toss with the beans and sprouts. To serve, divide among small bowls. Garnish with a sprinkling of grated cheese if desired.

title: Peanut Butter Spread
ingredients: 3 cups crunchy peanut butter | 1/4 cup snipped fresh herb seasoning mix ( i used 1 teaspoon dried mixed herb mix and 1/4 teaspoon dried fennel spice blend that i could get together, 1 tsp. ) | fresh herb seasoned stuffing mix | cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon fennel, finely cut into thin strips ( optional )
instructions: Mix peanut butter, herb seasoning, and fennel spice in large bowl. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes to soften creamy consistency. Fold in stuffing and spoon into a 2 1/2 cup greased 2 1/2 inch cake pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Allow to cool completely. Cut into 1/2 inch slices, then garnish as desired.

title: Lebanese Seafood and Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 4 slices rye bread | 4 -6 ounces catfish fillets, cubed | radish, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cover lentils with cold water& soak overnight in large bowl of cold water. Drain lentils and squeeze out excess water. Cover lentils with cold water. Bring to boil, and cook for 8 minutes. Remove from heat, drain. Place rice in a serving bowl or platter, layer lentils around it. Slice fish into 1 inch wide cubes, arrange on lentils, and top with radishes. Variation, place lemon wedges around fish, serve with pita bread.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,milk ricotta cheese,cabbage,green chili pepper,madeira wine,egg noodle,ajwain,anchovy paste
title: Cabbage Rolls in a Madeira Sauce
ingredients: 6 ounces lasagna noodle | 6 ounces cabbage, shredded | 1 lb milk ricotta cheese | 3 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 -2 green chili pepper, minced | 4 large eggs ( or 2 small ones! ) | 1/2 teaspoon ajwain | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste
instructions: Prepping your noodles is no more necessary if you are using a large, deep pan. I find that a regular pot with a lid is easiest to peel the noodles from and leave them on. Rinse the noodles and place in your sink so their water drains off well. I then use my hands to mix the salted water into the noodles so they can keep their shape when they are cooked. Mix the garlic salt with the cabbage so it becomes a loose paste. Mix it into the ricotta cheese, breaking up any lumps with your hands. Put about 1/4 of the shredded cabbage into the bowl. Add maybe a tablespoon of the cheese mixture and some minced chiles, if you need it. Mix in the rest of the chiles. Beat eggs with a pinch of salt, ajwain or anchovy paste and a little milk. If you have any leftover cheese mixture, toss it with the bowl of noodle mixture until it's nice and dry. Coat the noodles with egg, then set them aside. Spray a skillet with cooking spray and add half of the noodles. Add a ladleful of the prepared filling mixture. Cover the noodles with cabbage and continue layering noodles and filling until the pan is full. Cover with another ladleful of the filling mixture. Let the layers of noodles and filling cook in the skillet for about 1 minute. The cabbage rolls will be slightly more or less done by lunch time. When the top layer is almost completely cooked, put on a small piece of reynolds wrap aluminum foil so they can be stuffed without breaking.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,penne pasta,almond extract,almond,pork shoulder,dark brown sugar,swiss chard
title: Chard and Scallop Pasta
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, coarsely chopped | 3/4 pound sea scallops, cut in half | 1 ounce sliced blanched almond | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3 cups dry penne pasta
instructions: Place the chard in a large, deep skillet. Cover with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Cook until the chard wilts, about 3 minutes, then drain and reserve. Remove the green tops and cut into 2 inch lengths. Squeeze out the water and set the chard into a small bowl. Trim the root end and ribs until the remaining stems are about 1/4 inch strips. Chop the leaves and slice the greens about 1/3 inch wide. Place the shrimp in the skillet with the chard and cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly with a fork, until pink. Stir in the sliced almonds and brown sugar and almond extract. Add the pork slices and the swiss chard, stir well and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the pork is cooked through and the swiss chard has softened, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the penne in a large pot of boiling salted water until just tender, about 12 minutes. Drain. Add the cooked pasta and warm through, stirring occasionally, about 2 minutes. Serve over noodles.

title: Mexican Parsnips and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, cut into 1/4 '' slices | 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, trimmed of any visible fat and very thinly sliced across the grain | 1 jar hot picante sauce, divided | 1/3 cup stock | 1/3 cup fat free evaporated soymilk | 1/2 tablespoon dark rum | 2 -3 slices jalapenos, from a jar, seeded and finely chopped | 1/4 cup queso fresco ( optional ) or 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Butter a 1 1/2 quart casserole and place the sliced parsnips into the bottom. Arrange the beef slices crosswise over the parsnips. Combine 1/3 cup water, picante sauce, and 1/3 cup of the water. Pour over the beef, parsnips, and beef. Sprinkle with rum. Cover and transfer into the oven. Bake until the meat is very tender, about 1 hour. Add the jalapenos and remaining 1/3 cup of water during the last 15 minutes of baking. Transfer to a serving plate, drizzle with the remaining 1/4 cup of picante sauce, and serve. This dish can also be prepared in advance and served warm.

title: Spanish Rice & Chorizo
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked white rice | 3 3/4 ounces spaghettini or 3 3/4 ounces linguine | 3 links chorizo sausage, thinly sliced
instructions: Cover the rice with cold water and soak 30 minutes. Drain the rice and rinse under hot water. Bring 3 c water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add rice and stir. Reduce heat and simmer until done, about 25 minute remove from heat and stir in the sausage. Transfer to a warmed serving dish and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Roasted Red Potatoes
ingredients: 8 red potatoes | 3 scallions, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Toss together potatoes and scallions. Place in a baking dish. Bake for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,tahini,mexican oregano,cake flour,balsamic vinegar,green chili pepper,white wine,pizza crust
title: Tahini Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon mexican oregano ( dried ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 pizza crust | 1/3 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup shredded mexican oregano | 2 large green chili peppers ( seeded and cut into 1-inch strips ) | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Mix the first five ingredients together in a bowl, and set aside. Place the crust on a lightly greased pizza pan that has been sprinkled with olive oil. Pile the tortilla mixture into the crust. Add the cheese. Add the chili strips on top. Drizzle the balsamic vinegar on top. Put in preheated oven 400 and bake about 20 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly, and the crust is lightly browned.

title: Spinach Beef Rollatini
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss steak or 1/2 lb sirloin tip steak | 4 ounces fresh baby spinach, packed | 1 leek, green part cut off and white part cut into 1/8-1/4-2-inch slices | 2 tablespoons sour raspberries or 2 tablespoons frozen raspberries | 1 tablespoon chopped radish | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 ounce crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Place beef on a cutting board and slice diagonally on the diagonal about 1/4 inch thick. Put spinach on a clean work surface, cover with plastic wrap and weight with a plate. Set aside to drain. Slice green parts of the leeks and add them with one tablespoon of the water from the spinach. Let them wilt for at least five minutes then pull them out with a slotted spoon. In a bowl, combine raspberries with remaining 2 tablespoons water. Squeeze out excess moisture from leeks and add them. Toss with spinach mixture, red pepper flakes, feta, and toss with a fork. If the beef seems to be browning too fast, pour in a bit of water. Heat a large non stick skillet over high heat until very hot. Lightly oil the pan. Put a meat roll in the skillet, skin side down, add the spinach, and place it in the hot skillet. Cook, turning once after 10 seconds, until bottom is golden brown. Turn it over with a spatula and brown the other side. Transfer to a warmed platter, cut into thin slices, and serve warm.

title: Creamy Irish Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 cup cacao or 1 cup rum | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 2 ounces irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f line baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice bread in half from top to bottom. Pile mixture into bread shells. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,baby carrot,maple syrup,thyme sprig,beef tenderloin,broth,greek yogurt,tarragon
title: Beef Tenderloin With Maple-Raisin Dip
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, 1 1/2-inch thick | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 4 teaspoons maple syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh tarragon, chopped | 8 large baby carrots | 1/4 cup fat-free broth | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup light maple syrup | fresh thyme sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Set 4 oven racks in centre of oven. Place beef on rack in shallow roasting pan. Sprinkle with cardamom seeds.

title: Cherry Rice in a Snap
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 dash cayenne | club soda | 1 dash cherry peppers
instructions: Clean the rice and drain the water. Place in a medium sized bowl.

Random Ingredients: lemon,pineapple juice,jalapeno pepper,ladyfinger,chunk tuna water,chili paste,brazil nut
title: Grilled Tuna Melon With Pineapple-Gambola Filling
ingredients: 1/2 lb chunk tuna in water | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 small jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons lemon rind, grated | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, grated | 1/3 cup pineapples in light juice | 1/4 cup brazil nut, toasted, finely chopped | 8 large soft ladyfingers
instructions: Drain tuna of any oil. Place all ingredients except for the ladyfingers and pineapples in a blender and process until smooth. Place tuna in a shallow nonreactive bowl. Top tuna with nuts. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Cut off ends of ladyfingers and carefully trim off any hard ends. Cut ladyfingers into 2 - 3 inch lengths and then lengthwise into 5 - 6 lengths. Brush with a light film of oil and grill on med/med heat for 3 - 5 minutes, turning once, or until golden. Serve with melon sauce, garnished with pineapple slices and nuts.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,asafoetida powder,orange bell pepper,bay leaf
title: The Best Orange Pickle Recipe
ingredients: 3 oranges - peeled, seeded, and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 bay leaf
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the orange juice, mustard, asafoetida, and bay leaf.

title: Hot Spanish Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili peppers | 1 teaspoon dried minced onion | 2 tablespoons pimiento
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Chicken-Stuffed With Smoked Walnuts and Cheddar-Pesto
ingredients: 1 turkey breast | 6 chicken thighs, or more to taste | 2 whole walnuts, toasted | 4 ounces cheddar cheese, cut into small cubes | 2 linguine, cooked and drained | 3 tablespoons dried chipotle pesto
instructions: Place turkey breast and chicken thighs onto a cutting board, and use a very sharp knife to trim the thick ends from the thighs completely. Place 1 or 2 walnut pieces onto half of each chicken breast, close to the spine. Gently pound the chicken with the flat side of a cleaver, being careful not to flatten it. Continue pushing the chicken flesh into the walnuts until it is completely encased and secured along the spine. Scoop the stuffing into a bowl, and stir in cheese and pesto. Place the remaining walnuts onto a baking sheet. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake in a preheated 325 degree f oven until the crumbs of the cheese will lightly brown. Remove the aluminum foil, and let cool for 3 or 4 minutes before removing the cheese from the cookie sheet. Cut each stuffed turkey breast into 2 or 3 pieces, and serve.

title: Pancetta Lamburgers
ingredients: 3 lbs ground lamb | 1 1/2 cups mexican blend cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dry smoked paprika | 1 tablespoon italian flat leaf parsley, minced | 1/2 jar sliced oysters | paprika
instructions: Divide all ingredients in half.

title: Baklava
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups semolina flour | 1 cup coffee | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 2 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 cups ground round textured firm tofu ( or gouda, can substitute ) ( optional )
instructions: To make the baklava, combine all the ingredients, except the phyllo, into a bowl. Sprinkle a work surface with a little water and start kneading until the dough is smooth and elastic. Form into a smooth ball. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray or line with parchment paper in a spray pan. Flatten the dough into a circle about 6 inches in diameter. Brush with oil. Spread the ground round with a little water. Place the pastry on the ground round and using your hands, roll it to an even thickness about 10 inches in diameter. Bake for about 10 minutes at 400 degrees, or until golden brown. Let cool for 5 minutes, then cut into squares. Keep warm until serving. For vegetarian use the tofu.

title: Salsa for St. Thomas Breakfast
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh tomato juice | 1 cup mango chutney
instructions: Mix tomato juice and mango chutney together in a bowl and set aside. Break open the mango chutney one last time you serve, or leave it as it is.

title: Herbs in a Blanket - Microwave
ingredients: 4 large eggs, separated | 3 large egg whites or 3 large egg whites, separated | 1 1/4 teaspoons thyme sprigs
instructions: Heat oven to 100?f/175°c mark sieve the egg yolks into a mixing bowl with a pinch of salt and thyme. Beat egg yolks with a few tablespoons of cream or cream until very light and creamy. Beat in beaten egg whites until well combined. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold egg yolk mixture into whites in 2 batches. Pour mixture into a lightly oiled or lined microwave safe tin. Cook in microwave on full power for 1 - 2 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes, then turn onto a paper towel or chopping board,. Cut into 4 pieces and sprinkle with cheese, herbs etc. Wrap in the foil and cook for a further 15 minutes on full power, or until golden and cooked. These are delicious served with salad and butter.

title: Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 12 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 9 ounces candied lemon peel, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together gruyere cheese, candied lemon peel and cheese mixture. Roll into puffs about 2 1/2 inches diameter. Bake 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until puffs have puffed and are lightly browned. Allow the puffs to cool before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetarian Cacciatore & Romano-Style Pasta Filling

title: Chile De Elote (Espanadito Nibbles)

Place the soy sauce, chiles, cheese, mustard seeds, and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt in a heavy small saucepan. Stir over low heat until melted and just warm. Add more oil, 2 teaspoons at a time, if dough is too dry to work with. The dough will have a crumbly texture. Roll or pat the dough about 1/8 inch thick and cut it into 1 inch thick diagonal slices. Place them on a buttered baking sheet, overlapping slightly if necessary, and bake them at 425° until golden, about 20 minutes. Cool them on a wire rack, about 15 minutes. Transfer the cookies to a platter and store in an airtight tin for up to 2 weeks, tightly covered, in the refrigerator. They can also be frozen in individual foil plastic bags.

title: Mango Muffins With Black Olive Scented Fries
ingredients: 2/3 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup mirin | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh orange peel | 2 large baking potatoes | 1 1/2 lbs ripe mangoes, halved lengthwise, pitted | 2 1/2 tablespoons black olives, drained and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. In a medium bowl, stir together brown sugar, mirin, orange peel and 2/3 cup cold water. Place the potatoes in a large resealable plastic bag. Pierce the tops with a fork, tapping out the excess air. Drain the potatoes in a colander or on a plate layered with plastic wrap, then place into a large nonstick frying pan. Pour the marinade/drippings over the potatoes, turning to coat them on all sides. Bring to a boil over moderate heat. Bake, uncovered, for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the potatoes are just tender and the tops are golden brown. Set aside to cool. Peel the potatoes and slice 1/4 inch thick. Place the mangoes and olives in a medium bowl and cut them in half lengthwise. Drizzle 2 tablespoons of the reserved marinade/drippings over the fruit, then toss to coat. Preheat the broiler. Fill a large, shallow dish a few inches deep with the potatoes. Sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons of reserved marinade/drippings, then place the bread in it. Broil, in 1 layer, turning once, until slightly charred on the tops, about 2 minutes. Set the fries on towels to cool. Serve the fries warm.

title: Shrimp Kabobs
ingredients: 1/4 cup paprika | 1/4 cup fish sauce garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 lime wedge
instructions: Mix paprika, fish sauce, garlic sauce, and garam masala together to make marinade. Add shrimp and toss to coat. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight. Thread shrimp onto skewers. Grill, broil, or bake in oven on racks set 4 to 5 inches from heat source, until meat turns white and shrimp are tender and lightly browned.

title: Beef Tacos
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can beef gravy | 1 package corn tortillas | 1/4 cup coconut rum | 1 cup chopped almonds | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: Place corn on the bottom of a 9 inch iron skillet. Mix gravy in a large bowl and pour over corn. Wet tortilla on top of gravy. Soak tortilla in the coconut rum for about 1 minute, flip over and soak on the other side. Slightly moisten each hand and roll up. Secure well with toothpicks. Arrange on a platter and serve with hot corn.

title: Chiles-Seared Smoked Salmon Bagels in Garlic
ingredients: 1/2 lb sliced smoked salmon | 1/2 lb thin sliced smoked roast | 1 small serrano chili, deseeded and finely chopped | 14 -16 plain bagels, split
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450 degrees f. Place the bagels onto a baking sheet. Place one sliced smoked salmon on each bagel. Mix the chopped chili with the chopped chile and sprinkle the mixture over the bagels. Bake approximately 10 to 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,mini chocolate chip,mix,cider vinegar,paprika,honey mustard
title: Chocolate Chip Mix
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen sour mix | 4 ounces hot pickled hot dogs ( i prefer `` hot '' or other brand ) | 1 package mini chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon honey mustard | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Mix together all the ingredients store in plastic bag. Use as a base for soups, salads, snacks, etc. To store leftover mix in fridge in a covered container.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,vidalia onion,cabbage,orange zest,kosher salt black pepper,lime,black coffee,greek salad dressing
title: Persian Colcannon Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb colcannon cabbage | 1 vidalia onion, roughly chopped | 2 ounces water chestnuts, cut in half | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, freshly grated | 4 green leaves vidalia onions, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1/4 cup strong black coffee | 1 tablespoon greek salad dressing | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: To prepare colcannon, remove and discard all leaves and excess fat from cabbage leaving only the core and leaves. Rinse and drain cabbage. Cut into about 1 1/2 inch lengths. Cook onion in a medium size pot, with the water chestnuts and freshly grated orange peel. Remove from heat. Mix onions and water chestnuts in a large bowl. Pour half of the greek dressing over cabbage mixture. Toss in remaining garlic dressing and adjust seasonings. Taste for seasoning. Pour colcannon into the bowl with the onion and water chestnuts. Chill for at least one hour.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,vegetable stock,grapeseed oil,salad dressing,clam juice
title: Langosteen Barbecue Clam Salad
ingredients: 3 large clams in shell ( reserve juice to 1 cup, discard shells andbeard ) | 8 tablespoons salad dressing ( bottled or home made type ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder ( or similar flavours depending on your taste ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil
instructions: Put the clam juice in a pan with enough water to just cover and boil, uncovered, for a couple of minutes. Do not overboil. Leave the clams in the boiling water for about 20 seconds or until they open. Do not shell the clams, leave the shells on the shell if using them. This will make them less likely to cook in your grilling. Rinse the liquid off the clams under cold water. Drain the clam juice in a clean pan and reduce for 1 minute. Put it aside and cool. Remove the shell ends from the shell, remove the sand sacs with any clams and then, using a clean knife, shell the clam until just past the head. Scrape out the coral, chop the clams well in your processor. Put the olive oil and seasonings in a screw top jar and mix them well.. Throw in the clam juice, clams and capers. Stir well until all the ingredients become blended and pour the olive oil into a pan lined wok. Do not get any oil too hot or it will boil if mixed excessively. Cook over medium heat for about 4 - 5 minutes. As soon as the oil starts smoking and the clams start to open, put the lid back on. When the lid is in place, leave it to cook for about 5 minutes longer or until the clams open. Taste the salad then if desired, cut in to 2 serving size pieces. Serve. You may serve this salad on it's own as a delicious and crusty side dish to your meal.

Random Ingredients: mint,kielbasa,spinach leaf,hard egg,broccoli floret,cardamom seed,mushroom,shiitake mushroom
title: Spinach, Fungus and Smoked Sausage #1
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh spinach leaves | 4 tablespoons kielbasa ( polish sausage ) | 1/2 lb smoked sausage or 1/2 lb smoky sausage | 1 hard-boiled egg | 1 pinch cardamom seed | 8 ounces mushrooms | 8 ounces mixed mushrooms | 4 ounces broccoli florets | 2 -4 sprigs fresh mint
instructions: Cut spinach into a large piece and remove thick stalks from spinach. If using sausage, drain casing off. Dice sausage into 1/2 inch pieces. Saute until sausage is dark brown and cooked through. If using wood chips, thread sausage onto wood chips, then fry briefly or grill for medium heat, or grill the wood chips. Drain fat from sausage. Add sausage, sliced water chestnuts, mushrooms, and broccoli to spinach in a 4 1/2 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 9 minutes. Remove chiken for stuffing.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,water chestnut,olive,black pepper,basil,reposado tequila,active yeast,chili garlic sauce
title: Peshawari's Fresh Mojo
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups warm water | 8 -10 teaspoons unrefined sugar-free active dry yeast | 2 large green cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon olive, chopped ( or kalamata ) | 1 teaspoon fresh coarse ground black pepper ( or to taste ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded fresh basil or 1/2-3/4 cup fresh parsley | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded tricolor-colored olives ( optional or to taste ) ( optional or to taste ) ( optional or to taste ) ( optional ) | 1 can chopped green cardamom pods | 1/2 - 1 1/2-3/4 cup reposado tequila ( or to taste ) ( optional ) or 1/2-1 1/2 cup tequila ( or to taste ) ( optional ) | asafoetida chili-garlic sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine warm water, sugar free yeast, and cardamom in the bowl of an electric mixer or a food processor. Cover and set aside for about 10 minutes, or until frothy. Add olive, black pepper and fresh basil or parsley. Beat on medium speed, scraping down the bowl often, until thoroughly mixed. Add 1/2 cup grated cheese, if using. Beat until a dough forms, about 5 minutes. Cover and set aside in a warm place to rise 1 1/2 hours. Stir occasionally. If desired, mix in additional 1 or 2 tablespoons of cheese at this time. The dough may get very tough, so be sure to scrape the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula when dough rises. If mixture is too stiff to stir, mix in a small amount of water or flour to loosen after kneading, about 5 minutes. Shape dough into a ball, place in an oiled mixing bowl, cover with a cloth and set over a baking sheet. Let dough rise about 20 to 25 minutes. Heat oven to 375 f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or grease with cooking spray. If desired, brush the tops of the mojo with chili garlic sauce. If desired, score a cross in top of the top of the dough. Brush with a little olive oil. Place on middle rack. Set oven about 550 f. Bake for approximately 20 - 25 minutes, or until tops crusty and lightly browned. Allow to cool in the pan on a rack for 5 to 10 minutes before slicing or serving, slicing into wedges or cubes. Best made warm, rather cool, and serve warm, room temperature, or room temperature.

title: Homemade Green Olive Paste
ingredients: 1/2 lb green olives, pitted, well drained | 1/2 cup horseradish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Place green olives in a food processor and process until finely ground. Add remaining ingredients and process a few seconds until well blended. Store in airtight glass bowl.

title: Corn and Parsley on the Cob
ingredients: 4 ears fresh sweet corn, kernels removed and discarded | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, loosely packed
instructions: Combine corn, parsley, and salt in a large bowl.

title: Flourless Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine | 1 cup raw sugar | 1 cup golden syrup
instructions: In saucepan, melt margarine, sugar, and golden syrup over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,vanilla bean,red chili pepper,pea,adobo seasoning,red wine vinegar,orange marmalade,wheat flour
title: Red Chile Peas With Oranges, Strawberries and Fresh Peanuts
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 2 tablespoons fresh red chili peppers, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup orange marmalade | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup strawberry, sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 1 cup frozen peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Lightly grease a shallow baking dish or roasting pan. Combine flour and 1 tsp adobo. Add chiles and vinegar. Combine the marmalade and remaining adobo. Make a well in center of the flour mixture. Add the fruit mixture and stir or stir just until blended. Pour the batter into the prepared pan. Cover and bake at 400° for 40 - 45 minutes or until the cake is golden and a toothpick inserted into the middle comes out clean. Let cool for 10 minutes on a wire rack and unmold onto a rack to cool completely.

title: Korean Beef   (Galbi Jjigae) My Way
ingredients: 1 cup ground beef chuck ( korean chuck is best ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mint ( optional )
instructions: Place chuck in a medium mixing bowl. Sprinkle the dried mint over the beef. Tightly pour just enough water so that the ground beef is moistened. Place beef in the freezer until firm, roughly 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the beef and drain excess liquid from the bowl. Using a sharp knife, slice beef as thinly as possible. Use a slotted spoon to gently press the meat with the mint into the meat to allow the mint to absorb as much liquid as possible. Do not drain before serving. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,simple syrup,black olive,kosher salt,green pea,olive
title: Tex Mex Veggie Fondue for Two
ingredients: 1 jar mexican-style cheese, drained ( recommended ( like velveeta ) | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 3/4 cup frozen green pea, thawed | 2 tablespoons olive, rinsed and patted dry | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt ( for serving )
instructions: In a food processor, process cheese to make a coarse, creamy consistency. Stir in olives, peas, olive rind, syrup, and salt until combined well. Transfer into a bowl and serve.

title: Cranberry-Grapefruit & Mint Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats ( not instant ) or 1 cup oatmeal ( not instant ) | 8 cranberries | 1/2 cup chopped spring onion, trimmed ( white & green parts ) | 1/2 cup chopped mint leaf | 2 tablespoons chopped mint leaves | 1/2 cup white rum or 1/2 cup brandy ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh strawberries, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f in a medium bowl, add the oats & combine gently. Add the cranberries and spring onions & stir. Add the mint leaves & rum if using. Pour into an ovenproof dish & bake for 30 minutes uncovered, stirring occasionally. Remove from oven & stir berries into the top of the crumble. Bake for 1 hour more or until dry. Serve with toasted baguette, fruit, cream or ice cream. Variation, instead of mint, add 1/2 cup dried mixed fruit for an additional kick. Remove from heat & allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: tofu,chili bean sauce,cognac,pork shoulder,red bell pepper,lime zest,taco seasoning mix
title: Slow Cooker Tofu Tacos
ingredients: 12 ounces firm tofu, drained | 1/3 cup cognac | 2 ounces chili bean sauce | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon maple sugar-free chili bean sauce | 1 lime, zest of | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning mix
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the cognac and chili bean sauce. Slice the tofu in half to make tacos it thinner. Lay the tofu out on cutting board or flat. Use a knife to slice the tofu diagonally into thirds or, if you want, a total of 24 slices. Place on a cutting board, place about 1 1/2 tablespoons of sauce mixture on each, and use it for flavoring the sauce. In a small bowl, combine the bell pepper and maple sugar free chili bean sauce. Stir and place in on the taco shells. Top with sliced tofu.

title: Pancake with Lamb
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 3 tablespoons simple syrup | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 cup dry pasta, such as spain or arborio | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: Trim excess fat, and any remaining fat from the lamb and cut crosswise into strips about 2 inches wide and 3/4 inch long. Toss the lamb with the 1 tablespoons of syrup and the cilantro. Arrange the lamb in the shape of a fat pancake and coat with a thin layer of paprika and a pinch of cardamom and scatter the remaining paprika over all. Fold the fat pancake over the lamb and cook, turning once, until the lamb is medium rare, about 20 minutes. Taste the lamb and adjust seasonings. Serve with hot cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,chicken breast half,harissa,plum tomato,shiitake mushroom,gravy,chipotle pepper,plantain
title: Grilled Chicken and Plantain Filling
ingredients: 2 chicken breast halves, bone-in, skin removed | 1/4 cup prepared gravy | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1/4 pound shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 pound fresh plum tomato, sliced | 2 chipotle peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 3 cloves garlic, minced
instructions: Remove skin from chicken. Cut into bite sized pieces and coat with olive oil. Place on grill over medium high heat or grill pan with the grill lid down. Grill until chicken is well cooked and no longer pink, turning once, about 6 minutes per side. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Meanwhile, mix gravy, harissa and mushrooms together in a bowl. Add the tomato, chipotles, and garlic and mix well. To serve, spoon chicken onto plate with tomato mixture and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.

title: English Toffee
ingredients: 1 box cake mix | 1 dash tarragon
instructions: Brown cake mix with tarragon and make a well in the cake mix. Dunk cake mix in well making sure each piece is covered. Cook in a non stick skillet or griddle/fryer on med high for 15 - 20 mins or until slightly browned but not too hard.

title: Coconut and Sultana Muffins
ingredients: 4 english muffins, toasted | 2/3 cup coconut cream | 2 tbsp sultanas or 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon extra light honey
instructions: Toast muffins in lightly oiled frying pan about 7 minutes or until golden brown. Drain on paper towel. In each muffin, combine coconut cream, sultanas and honey. Top with cooled and toasted muffins and serve immediately.

title: Banana Leaf Spoonets
ingredients: 5 -6 banana leaves ( approximately 100 ) | 1 lemon peel, cut into thin strips
instructions: Bring 10 cups water to the boil. Wash one banana leaf after removing loose leaves.

title: Chiles Colorado
ingredients: 2 red fresno chiles or 2 green chiles | 12 slices dry tequila | 1/4 cup unsalted smoked mozzarella cheese | 1 large ripe tomatillo | 1 medium orange | 1/2 teaspoon whole black peppercorns
instructions: Cut peppers into large chunks or slice into chunks. Remove seeds. Bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil with the tequila and salt. Drop tomatillos into ice water. Remove from heat after 4 - 5 minutes and let cool just until warm to the touch. Heat a grill pan over medium heat. Cut a slit down one side of each chile.

title: Spicy Spanish Prawns and Goat Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion | 1 lb large raw prawns or 1 lb large shrimp | 1 cup roasted pistachios | 1 medium sweet aromatic chipotle powder | 1 cup sun-dried tomato & herb chopped fine | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/4 cup taco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cut onion into wedges and set aside. Peel and wash shrimp removing all shells and heads. Cut pistachios into 8 segments. Soak pistachios for 30 minutes and remove seeds and grit from prawns. Dry fry on a grill till golden and pink and black on all sides. Mix nuts into prawns. Grill on the bbq about 3 - 4 minutes on each side or till cooked through.. Taste to check for salt. Note, i find this is where the flavor of the pestachio comes from. If it is a little bitter, add a touch of sugar if you want to. Skewer with goat' cheese, pistachios, pine nuts and the sauteed onion. If the skewers are soaked, thread them now.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,maraschino cherry,sage leaf,riesling wine,chocolate milk
title: Riesling With Sage and Chocolate Milk
ingredients: 4 tablespoons riesling wine ( not riesling ) | 4 cups red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup chocolate milk | 1/4 cup fresh sage leaves | 3 tablespoons freshly grated unsweetened chocolate, plus more for garnish
instructions: Sauté the cabbage in a large skillet until it begins to soften, about 5 minutes, stirring to redistribute the hot liquid around the cabbage. Add the wine, stir to coat, and cover. Set aside to rest until ready to use. When ready to serve, stir the chocolate into the cabbage mixture with the mint. Serve warm or at room temperature, sprinkled with more chocolate and more sage.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,dark brown sugar,chicken stock,bay leaf,chipotle powder,bread,mustard
title: Chipotle-Glazed Cornstarch Relish
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 chipotle powder | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 bay leaf | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 loaf round bread
instructions: In a saucepan over medium low heat add chicken stock, brown sugar, chipotle powder, mustard, and bay leaf. Cover, and cook until dissolved. Remove from heat, and slowly add cornstarch, stirring constantly until slightly thickened. Cut the round bread into slices, and coat with the syrup/sauce mixture. Place the slices in the bottom half of a casserole dish just right to cover. Place sliced toast on top of the toast. Sprinkle with a little more salt. Bake in oven at 350 for 15 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter and Herbs Skewers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 teaspoon dried mixed herbs | cooking spray
instructions: Place ingredients in a small bowl and lightly mix with a fork. Pour 1/3 of the mixture into a small, 12 cm x 5 cm slice tin. Tightly close with wet hands. Refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours. Heat an outdoor grill to medium, or prepare a gas grill and cook until skewers are charred on all sides and sizzling hot.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,mustard powder,bicarbonate soda,mexican cheese,scallop,chicken stock,raspberry vodka
title: Chef John's Steamed Seafood Soup
ingredients: 4 large scallops or 4 large lobster shells, shelled and cleaned | 125 g mexican-style cheese | 200 g cubed fresh mozzarella cheese | 600 ml chicken stock | 1 pinch mustard powder | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 125 ml raspberry flavored vodka, warmed
instructions: In a large deep saucepan of boiling water, place the scallops and half the cheese cubes. Cook, undisturbed, over a moderate heat for 3 - 5 minutes, until the scallops are just tender. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Meanwhile, place the rest of the cheese cubes in a bowl. Add the chicken stock to the cheeses and stir or place in the microwave oven on high for 1 minute. Remove the scallops from the hot saucepan and stir through the mustard. Pour over the cheese and scallops. Microwave on high for 1 minute and stir well to combine, then serve.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,mini chocolate chip,red wine,lamb,loaf french bread,chuck
title: Buckingham Palace Style French Bread With Lamb and Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 4 -6 lbs lamb, in cubes | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip | extra virgin olive oil or a combination of any oil and butter
instructions: Slice french bread into 1 thick slices. In a cast iron skillet sear lamb cubes in olive oil with the coriander seeds and red wine over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium and slowly cook for about 20 minutes or until lamb is browned on all sides. While lamb is cooking cut cheese into sticks about 4 in diameter. Tear cheese sticks into pieces about 4 in width, about 4 per loaf. Arrange cheese sticks on top of lamb in pan. Cover tightly and simmer 5 minutes to melt cheese. Transfer to a baking dish and bake at 375°f until cheese is melted.

title: Grilled Pork Phyllo Roll Ups
ingredients: 500 g ground pork | 125 g penne pasta, cooked | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, chopped | 2 tablespoons cheese, grated | 1 package frozen round phyllo dough
instructions: Combine ground pork, penne, lemon grass, and cheese. Spray an 8 x 8 pan with cooking spray. Spread 1 teaspoon of filling on each phyllo round. Roll up and wrap each one in plastic wrap, refrigerate for half hour. Pre heat grill to med. Brush with oil and grill until golden on all sides. Serve with lemon lime dipping sauce and lemon dipping sauce.

title: Hot Roasted Red Pepper Soup
ingredients: 4 medium red peppers | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine onions soup mix, crushed red pepper flakes and remaining ingredients in a large baking dish. Cover and bake for 40 minutes, stirring once. Cool and store in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Onion-Flavored Won Tons
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped vidalia onion | 3 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 pinch dried oregano | 1 pound wonton skins
instructions: Stir onion flakes and oregano together in a bowl. Place wonton skins in a sealable container. Place a heaping tablespoons of the onion mixture on top and press the skins all the way down. Seal bag and refrigerate for 2 days. Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place the won ton skins on a shallow, parchment lined baking sheet using the tip of the finger. Bake in the preheated oven until the skins are lightly golden, about 1 hour. Remove skins and transfer to a cloth lined plate.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,lime zest,cranberry,extra virgin olive oil,white wine vinegar,lemon thyme,sugar,baby bok choy
title: Cranberry-Lemon Nests With Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb baby bok choy | 1 bunch fresh asparagus, trimmed and woody ends coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons dried sweetened cranberries | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh lemon thyme | sugar | lime zest, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a large steamer, cook the bok choy and asparagus in boiling water just until tender, about 3 minutes. Drain, and transfer to a bowl of cold water to cool, about 5 minutes. Drain again. Pat the asparagus dry with paper towels, and cut off the woody ends. Snap off the tips and any tough part of the stalk, and thinly slice the asparagus. In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, oil, orange zest, sugar, and dried cranberries. Divide the asparagus among 4 plates, and mound the berries around the spears. Drizzle the dressing over the asparagus, sprinkle with lime zest, if desired, and serve.

title: Sliced Marshmallows and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package marshmallows | garlic powder, to taste
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, melt marshmallows over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,bouquet garni,heavy whipping cream,red bean,chicken wing,strawberry
title: Red Beans & Strawberries in a Creamy Bouquet Garni
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 1/2 lbs fresh strawberries or 2 1/2 lbs frozen strawberries | 1 lb cooked and shelled red beans | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh bouquet garni | 1 1/2 lbs frozen singckes or 1 1/2 lbs thawed thawed thawed frozen boneless chicken wings
instructions: Puree strawberries in blender until thick and smooth. Combine beans and cream in 2 quart saucepan. Over medium heat, warm bouquet garni until just simmering. Add wine vinegar and simmer, stirring occasionally, until mixture reduces to about 3 tablespoons. Gradually stir in bouquet garni.

Random Ingredients: kale,potato,thai basil,rock salt,green bell pepper,hershey chocolate kiss
title: Kale & Potato Chip Hash
ingredients: 600 g potatoes, boiled, scrubbed, peeled | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons hemp milk chocolate kiss, cut into 4 triangles | 1 tablespoon hemp seedless spreadable thai basil ( to garnish ) or 1 tablespoon mixed salad leaves, to garnish | 1 -2 tablespoon hershey chocolate kisses ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | rock salt ( to garnish, optional )
instructions: Heat a non stick frypan on medium high until very hot. Add potatoes and bell pepper and stir fry for 3 - 5 minutes or until potatoes are just soft and cooked through. Mash potatoes with cream cheese or choc chips until smooth. Add the choc chip mix and basil and blend well. Turn into a small serving bowl and garnish with toasted chocolate squares, toasted seeds, or whatever toppings you prefer.

title: Sausage & Cheese Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 box spiral pasta, cooked according to package instructions | 3/4 cup chorizo sausage, diced | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 15 ounces ricotta cheese, drained | 2 cans red chili, drained, and liquid reserved
