instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix together the chorizo, creole seasoning, garlic chourios and pasta. Spread mixture evenly in a 2 qt casserole dish. Top with remaining ingredients. Cover and bake for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,chicken bouillon granule,hazelnut,cream chicken soup,tamari,yellow tomato,bamboo skewer,turbinado sugar
title: Baked Tomato and Hazelnut Sausages
ingredients: 10 large ripe yellow tomatoes, halved, cored and cut into eighths | 8 bamboo skewers | 200 g roasted hazelnuts | 6 tablespoons good quality tamari | 150 g caster sugar | 200 g cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon turbinado sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Line the bottom of the tray with baking paper and spray it lightly with cooking oil spray so it sticks to the tray. Toss the tomatoes and nuts in the bowl of a food processor to coat. Place onto the paper and roll in the nuts. Place the sasages onto the tray and bake for 15 mins until dark brown and cooked through. Meanwhile, mix the tamari, sugar, soup, and bouillon in a non metal bowl. Bring to the boil, then add the turbinado sugar.

title: Rosemary Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup fresh rosemary
instructions: Combine cheese, rosemary and mix well. Spread on any kind of cracker.

title: The Haters Secret Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 1/2 cups frangelico
instructions: Put the mustard powder on the bottom of a medium saucepan. Stir in the frangelico. Cook on low heat just long enough to melt the frangelico.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chilies,green bell pepper,plain yogurt,creole seasoning,cherry liqueur,saltine cracker,anchovy paste
title: Creamy Jalapeno Spread
ingredients: 1 jar saltine crackers, drained | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste, or to taste | 1 can jalapeno chilies, drained | 1/4 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup cherry flavored liqueur
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together cracker crumbs, yogurt, creole seasoning, anchovy paste, jalapenos, green pepper and cherry flavored liqueur. Mash cracker crumb mixture into mixture to desired consistency.

title: Scotch Steak Salad
ingredients: 4 strips steak, cut 3/4 inch thick | 2 cucumbers, cut in half lengthwise and cut into strips | 2 bunches onions | 1/2 cup almond butter, softened | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except steaks. Place in a lightly buttered casserole, cover and bake @ 350 degrees for 15min. Remove cover and bake until done and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: manchego cheese,lemon peel,tarragon,sea salt,cayenne pepper,white rice,mexican cheese,chili sauce
title: Rice With Cheese and Smoked Manchego Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked white rice | 1 3/4 - 2 cups mexican blend cheese | 1 1/2 cups manchego cheese, shredded | 4 tablespoons fresh lemon peel, finely minced | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( or more ) | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Put rice in a fine mesh strainer and rinse thoroughly with cold water until water runs clear. Remove and drain well. Place in a bowl. Spread cheese slices on the rice and sprinkle with lemon peel. Scatter with tarragon, chili sauce, cayenne, and salt. Drizzle with olive oil and mix. Spread cheese on top. Broil, uncovered, until cheese melts, turning once. Watch carefully.

title: Roasted Green Peaches with Spicy Tacos
ingredients: 1 can sliced peaches in syrup ( about 3/4 of a 7-ounce can ) | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning ( or more ) | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic paste ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 long thin green chile ( optional )
instructions: In the bottom of a glass bowl, arrange peach slices. Sprinkle over 2 t taco seasoning, garlic paste and if using the chile, sprinkle over 1 - 2 more tsp. Tacos. Set aside. In a second glass bowl, arrange the rest of the brine of the peaches with the remaining 1 - 2 tsp. Tacos. Cover and refrigerate. You may add additional seasoning to your own tastes as you like. This tastes even better the next day after it soaks up the juices.

title: Homemade Spiced Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb breakfast sausage, casings removed | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried fenugreek seeds | 1/8 cup finely chopped celery salt | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let stand in refrigerator 2 hours. Preheat broiler. Place sausages on a foil lined broiler pan. Broil 2 to 4 inches from heat, turning often, for 10 minutes.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Mangoes and Currants Salad
ingredients: 1 large beef tenderloin | kosher salt, approximately | 8 fluid ounces bottled clam juice | 2 ounces mango chutney | 8 ounces salad greens, such as radish blossoms | 1 tablespoon currants
instructions: Preheat grill to high heat. Spray grill rack with nonstick cooking spray and place beef on grill rack. Cook for 4 minutes on each side for medium rare or 8 minutes for medium well or until medium rare. Let rest for 5 minutes, covered with foil. To serve, remove beef from grill and allow it to rest for 5 minutes before slicing diagonally across the grain. In a large bowl, combine clam juice, mango chutney, and salad greens. Season with salt. Slice beef thinly and arrange on top of greens mixture. Sprinkle with currants.

title: Pineapple Pizzas
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks | 3/4 lb manchego cheese or 3/4 lb monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Cut the pineapple spears into four, lengthwise, to make four 2 x 4 inch strips. Arrange the shrimp on a foil lined baking sheet and sprinkle with a little salt and allspice. Bake for 5 to 7 minutes, until the shrimp are done. Remove the foil and sprinkle cheese with allspice. Return to the oven for 1 to 2 minutes, until the cheese melts, stirring gently. Top pizzas with pineapple strips and serve warm.

title: Aloo Keema (Chana Dal With Chickpeas)
ingredients: 4 cups chickpeas, cooked, and shelled | 1 cup corn, cooked-free, drained, and finely chopped | 1/2 cup channa dal, cooked, cooked ( chickpeas, available from indian stores ) | 1/4 cup chopped black walnuts | 1/4 cup yoghurt, whisked | 200 g bread, cut into squares ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread and yoghurt in a pot. Bring to the boil, then simmer 10 minutes, till the mixture is slightly thickened and creamy. Season with salt and pepper, and keep warm until serving time.

title: Spit Stuffed Shrimp
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise, light mayonnaise is best | 3/4 cup pure maple syrup, i prefer maple syrup | 1 teaspoon lime ( optional ) | 4 jumbo shrimp, cooked, peeled, and deveined | 1 egg substitute
instructions: Preheat a non stick skillet over medium high heat. Dip each shrimp first in the egg substitute, then in the mayonnaise, mixing all the ingredients together thoroughly. Add more or less of any of the optional ingredients to the pan as desired. Saute until the shrimp are opaque but not cooked through. Slice into serving portions.

Random Ingredients: cherry pie filling,beef base,baby spinach leaf,pear,mustard powder,spaghetti,mirin,liquid smoke
title: Cherry Beef Pies
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 4 ounces baby spinach leaves | 1 ounce pear, drained and sliced | 1 ounce fresh corned beef, strips ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 3/4 teaspoon beef base | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions and cool. Drain. Meanwhile cook pear, steak and spinach over medium heat until meat is cooked. Drain. Mix with meat mixture and cool to room temperature, about half an hour. Stir together rest of ingredients in a small bowl. Spoon mixture into pastry lined 12x10 inch jelly roll pan sprayed with cooking spray. Freeze any leftover. Top with a little cheese if desired. Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes or until bubbly. Note, you may microwave for 20 to 30 seconds to melt the cheese.

title: P.F. Chang's Famous Singapore Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 boneless green bell pepper, halved lengthwise, plus additional
instructions: In a 1 gallon plastic bag, combine the sherry and a 1 pound piece of beef steak. Turn to coat. Refrigerate covered for 15 minutes, turning bag several times. Meanwhile, in a 12 inch non stick skillet, cook pepper halves, without onion or garlic, on high heat for 12 to 15 minutes or until browned on all sides. If necessary, rearrange meat.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,brandy,italian seasoning,grain white rice,chicken,chicken stock
title: Brandied Broth in Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 chicken, cut into 16 pieces | 1 yellow pepper, cut into 8 strips | 8 ounces chicken stock | 13 fluid ounces brandy | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons regular grain white rice or 1 1/2 tablespoons basmati rice ( 3 3/4 ounces for each serving )
instructions: Place the chicken pieces in a large, deep, nonreactive pressure cooker. Add the peppers and stock to the cooker. Break up the brandy with a fork.

Random Ingredients: msg,curry leaf,mexican cheese,silver beet,soya sauce,kahlua,baking potato,marjoram
title: Cape Town Curried Potato Bread
ingredients: 5 medium baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch chunks | 1/2 lb silver beet, thinly sliced ( or other winter squash ) | 2 teaspoons curry leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons kahlua | 1/2 teaspoon dry mexican spices ( or any other mexican spice blend you prefer ) | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional, but good ) | fresh marjoram, chopped for garnishing
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°f. Mix all of the ingredients in a large bowl. Place the potatoes in the oven and bake them for 20 minutes, until they are tender and golden brown.

title: Easy Caper Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 large fresh mushrooms | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup drained capers | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove stems from mushrooms. If using fresh mushrooms, remove stems. Rinse mushrooms and lightly press caps to remove excess moisture. Place all ingredients except mushroom caps on a baking sheet. Sprinkle cracker crumbs over mushrooms. Bake in preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until tops are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,cucumber,fish,sage,new potato,flour tortilla,poblano chile
title: Fish Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 pound skinless, boneless fish fillets | 12 large new potatoes, scrubbed | 12 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 bunch fresh sage, leaves crushed | 3 poblano chiles, chopped | 1 cucumber, chopped | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Place fish fillets in a large pot and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook uncovered until easily flaked with a fork. Drain and cool slightly. Cut potatoes into 1 inch pieces. Place enough potatoes to compensate for the fact that they are so thin, and that they are not too dry. Tear the fish fillets into 1 inch pieces and place in a bowl. Cover with boiling water, and squeeze out as much water as you can. Place the fish and potatoes in a large pot, and cover with at least 1 inch of water. Bring to a boil, and cook until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, and set aside until needed. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 13x9 inch baking dish. Place tortillas in a separate, oven safe skillet, and bake for about 15 minutes, until crisp. To assemble, stir fried potatoes, chopped sage, poblanos, and chopped cilantro into the fish.

title: Torta de Bleu (French Blankets)
ingredients: 2 cups packed torn leaf lettuce | 1 cup torn blueberries | 4 ounces crumbled roquefort cheese | 1/2 cup heavy cream or 1/2 cup whole milk chocolate drink ( may use milk chocolate for sweeter cookies ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Prepare lettuce according to package directions. Spoon blueberries evenly over lettuce, sprinkle with cheese and drizzle with cream or milk chocolate, if using. Wrap tightly in foil and chill before serving. To serve, sprinkle cocoa over the top.

title: Roasted Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 8 chicken thighs, skin removed | green pepper, deseeded and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place chicken in a large, ovenproof casserole dish. Cut a few slits in the top to vent steam and season with salt. Pour over just enough water to come halfway up the sides of the chicken. Cover loosely with foil and cook in the oven for 1 1/2 hours. Remove cover and bake for a further 40 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken from oven and place with peppers on top. Heat through. Serve.

title: Tea Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup black tea | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 pound flank steak
instructions: Mix black tea, chili garlic sauce, and flank steak together in a bowl. Cover bowl and let stand at room temperature for at least 30 minutes. Serve chilled, or at room temperature.

title: Swedish Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower ( approx 1 kg ) | 2 tablespoons veal fat | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Break up cauliflower into florets. Put it in a saucepan with the veal fat, ketchup, sea salt and allspice. Cover with cold water. Heat, stirring occasionally with a fork and bring to the boil gently for 5 minutes while the cauliflower is cooking. When the cauliflower is done, drain off excess water. Put the cauliflower in a bowl and add the rest of the vinaigrette ingredients. Mix everything together well. Serve with rice.

title: Orzards En Cote (Creamy Orzo with Gruyere)
ingredients: 7 tablespoons orzo pasta, orzo, prepared as directed on package and chilled
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, and cook orzo until al dente, about 2 minutes. Drain and set aside. To make the creamed orzo, put 3 tablespoons of orzo at a time into a bowl with hot water. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, stirring a few times, then drain and set aside. Place another 3 tablespoons orzo in a saucepan and heat over medium high heat. Keep a close eye on it until the color begins to deepen, about 3 to 5 minutes. Drain orzo and return to the pot. Stir in 4 1/2 tablespoons of the orzo, then stir in creamed orzo with a whisk. Continue to stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and cook until the cream is reduced and orzo is warmed through. Stir in orzo with a spoon, season to taste with salt and serve.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,provolone cheese,white wine,red bird eye chilies
title: Crispy Roast Red Chile and Cheese Skewers (Aussie Style)
ingredients: 12 baby red bird's eye chilies | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped chili peppers ( from a jar or 1-2 jalapenos, seeded, finely chopped ) | 1/4 cup dry white wine ( or water ) | 1/2 cup crumbled provolone cheese
instructions: Cut off the wing tips of chilies and discard the rest. Snap off the top and lower seeds with a melon baller or vegetable peeler.

title: Spicy Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 5 tablespoons thick lowfat yogurt | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 5 tablespoons low fat beef fat ( from a cube of beef ) | 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 2 -3 mushrooms stems ( capsicum )
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together in a bowl. Thread the beef onto the skewers. If using bamboo skewers, you may need to trim them off, etc.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,lemon twist,coriander powder,yellow squash,coriander seed,red chili powder
title: Coriander Vegetable Chip Chowder
ingredients: 1/2 cup coriander powder | 1 tablespoon yellow squash, diced | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 cup coriander seed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed lemon twists ( optional ) | crushed corn tortilla chips
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except crushed tortilla chips in a soup pan. Cover, bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Barley Pork and Black Olives
ingredients: 8 ounces pearl barley | 4 ounces boneless pork fillets, chopped | 1/2 pint black olives, sliced
instructions: Place the barley and pork into a large heatproof bowl. Drain the liquid into the bowl, reserving ¼ cup. Add enough cold water to the remaining liquid to just moisten. Add the onion and olives. Leave to soak for 2 hours, but no longer. Drain. Barley pork is best used on the day it is to be baked, but some roast meat can be substituted for onion and tomato. Breading, pour the reserved liquid into a pan and bring to the boil over high heat. Skim and stir off any scum that rises to the surface. Reduce the heat to low and stir until the liquid has become thick and syrupy enough to coat the back of a spoon. Stir in a can of chopped, drained black olives and pour into a baking dish just large enough to accommodate the pork fillets. Bake in a preheated oven for 1 hour 7 minutes, or until the rice begins to dry. Serve immediately.

title: Tapas Style Spiced Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup water | 1/8 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 boneless sirloin tip roast, trimmed of excess fat, and cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Combine water, anchovy paste, and beef in a large glass or ceramic bowl.

title: Low-Fat Onion-And-Vegetable Beef Kebabs (Low-Fat)
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons fat free cooking onion light powdered ( or any fat-free onion powder that you wish ) | 1 tablespoon low-fat soymilk ( skim before measuring ) | 2 teaspoons cardamom, crushed | 1 medium cooking onion, grated ( i used only 1.5 tbsp )
instructions: Slice beef into 1/4 thick x 1 1/2 long slices. Arrange meat on skewers.

title: Mini Samosas Recipe
ingredients: 4 egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground coriander seed | 3/4 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/3 cup chopped fresh tarragon leaves | 1/4 cup chopped green chili, drained | 1/3 cup chopped cooked ladyfinger
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f with rack in middle of oven. Brush a nonstick 12 cup muffin tin with egg whites and sprinkle with coriander.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,cardamom,enchilada sauce,bean sprout,crabmeat,flour tortilla,pecorino romano cheese
title: Crab and Pepper Enchilada
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas, cut into strips | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 cups imitation crabmeat, chopped | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 3/4 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 16 ounces bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray 13x9x2 dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place tortillas on a baking sheet coated with nonstick cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,kaffir lime leaf,orange juice concentrate,black pepper,mustard
title: Kaffir Lime Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces dark chocolate, finely grated | 6 ounces orange juice concentrate, defrosted | 6 kaffir lime leaves, grated | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Place the chocolate, orange juice concentrate and kaffir lime in a deep dish. Season with pepper.

Random Ingredients: ham hock,pumpkin pie spice,flour tortilla,beef consomme
title: Pumpkin, Ham Hock and Beef Burritos
ingredients: ham hocks | 1 cup fat-free beef consomme | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 8 -10 flour tortillas
instructions: Brown ham hocks in a dutch oven. Transfer to a bowl or resealable plastic bag. Add consomme and spice and stir until well mixed. Place bag over pan of simmering water. Continue cooking until soup thickens. Spoon hot soup into flour tortillas, dividing evenly. Top with ham hocks.

title: Pear Salad With Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 ripe pears, cored, peeled and diced | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon shrimp paste | 1 egg, hard boiled | pico de gallo, for garnishing
instructions: Combine pears and sour cream. Stir in the shrimp paste and egg.

title: Fruit Sushi
ingredients: 3 cups bread ( japanese bread ), cut in 4 - 5 slices | 1 1/2 cups dried apricots, cut in 1 '' lengths, seeds removed
instructions: Put 1 piece bread into a bowl and fill with enough cold water to cover. Soak for 15 minutes so that it is soft enough to tear with your fingers. Roughly chop and set aside. Put the second piece of bread onto the cutting board with the cut side down. Using the flat end of a meat pounder, tear the bread into the bread flour until it forms a fine, coarse textured loaf about 3 - 1 1/2x4''. Break apart the bread like glue between thumb, pointer finger and index finger and pound out as coarse bread as possible and set aside. Repeat with two more slices of bread. Bring 3 cups of water to a boil in a small pot. Drain the apricots in a sieve and place them in the boiling water. Boil until all of the water is gone, and the fruit is plump and brittle, about 4 - 5 minutes longer. Drain the fruit and set aside. Soak the apricots in hot water for a few minutes to soften them slightly. Heat a small skillet, cast iron, or griddle over high heat. Place 2 or 3 slices of bread on your work surface. Spoon half of the fruit and a couple tablespoons of the apricots onto each, spreading them evenly. Sprinkle more fruit and apricots, if desired. Roll into 4 equal thick log. Tie loosely with kitchen twine. Wrap in paper towels and keep warm in a low oven for about 20 minutes. Repeat with remaining slices of bread to make 5 more bundles. Serve either warm or cold.

title: Mexican Chocolate Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate or 4 ounces semisweet chocolate, finely chopped | 2 cups vegetable broth | 5 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 cups rich flavorful broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano, crushed
instructions: In small saucepan, melt chocolate and broth over medium high heat until smooth. Remove from heat. In separate saucepan, heat sugar, broth, and oregano over medium heat until the sugar dissolves, about 5 minutes. Bring broth mixture to a boil then stir in chocolate mixture. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,salad green,black olive,matzo meal,bing cherry
title: Greek Matzoh Salad With Black Olives
ingredients: 4 matzo meal | 1 can sliced black olives | 1 bag mixed salad greens | 4 tablespoons lemon pepper, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons bing cherries
instructions: Combine matzoh meal& olives. Toss& toss over salad greens. Sprinkle with lemon pepper& cherries. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,cherry tomato,celery rib,beef steak,seasoning salt,cajun seasoning,chili sauce,horseradish
title: Cherry Tomato Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef flank steak | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | seasoning salt | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 3 tablespoons bottled minced celery ribs | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 4 cherry tomatoes, halved | 4 hamburger buns, split
instructions: Trim fat from steak and cut into bite sized chunks. Sprinkle with cajun seasoning and lightly salt. Heat a grill pan until hot. Cook steak for 4 minutes on each side, turning once. Turn and cook 4 minutes. Set aside to cool. Stir together worcestershire sauce, horseradish, celery and horseradish. Place about 3 tablespoon meat on each of four cooked side of each bun. Top with a tomato and a sprinkle of worcestershire sauce.

title: Chicken Pesto over Basboos
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons quick-cooking spray | 1 package chicken tenders, cut in half | 4 teaspoons pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Pour oil in a skillet or wok over medium high heat. Place chicken tenders in skillet.

title: Anjou Pears in Yogurt
ingredients: 4 small fresh ripe medium ripe anjou pkg | 2 small carrots, peeled and diced | 4 dates, chopped | 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 1/2 cups broth | 15 g sliced carrots-
instructions: Rinse the anjou pears with cold water and dry. Toss them gently in a bowl with some of the olive oil and turmeric. Let them sit for 5 minutes in a warm room. Drain off any excess oil and add the pear mixture. Chop the pitted dates very coarsely. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan large enough to hold all the Anjou pears.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,chunky salsa,almond extract,basil pesto,plum jam,tart apple,horseradish,bami noodle
title: Horn's Chicken Noodles Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces albondigianna and kraft prepared horseradish horseradish deli-style noodles | 1 medium tart apple ( any variety works ) | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 4 ounces chicken thighs, cooked and thinly sliced | 3 1/2 ounces whole-grain thawed medium italian breadsticks or 3 1/2 ounces other sesame-flavored meatballs, cut into strips | 1 1/2 tablespoons plum jam or 1 1/2 tablespoons strawberry jam, drizzled with a little honey
instructions: Cook the noodles according to pkg instructions and drain. While noodles are cooking, combine apple, salsa, pesto, horseradish, almond extract and chicken in serving bowl. Arrange the salad on a serving platter and top with 1/2 of the meatball strips and 1/4 of the jam or jam. Serve atop the salad bowl, or chill for later.

Random Ingredients: chick pea,lime peel,onion soup mix,angel hair pasta,halibut fillet,lemon zest,white bean
title: Chick Pea Fettuccine With Lemon and Lime
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh small white beans, rinsed and drained | 2 medium onions, chopped | 6 halibut fillets | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup grated lemon zest | 2 teaspoons dried lime peel | 4 cups hot cooked chick-peas, drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the beans and 1/2 the chopped onion and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Stir in the halibut and soup mix, zest and remaining onion, and return to pot. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat until heated through, about 3 minutes. In a separate pasta pan, cook the pasta to package directions. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the pasta cooking water, then toss the pasta with the chickpeas. Serve immediately.

title: Chili Oil
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Heat oil over medium high heat. Add lemon zest and fry for 30 seconds, then stir and fry until the zest darkens and becomes reddish brown. Pour over ice and fresh salad greens and cut into bite sized chunks. Serve warm or chilled. Note, a couple of small chunks of canned jalapeno pepper may be added if desired during the frying process.

title: Spicy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb hot sausage, sliced | 1/2 cucumber, sliced | 10 radishes, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon stick | 1 hot red chili, sliced
instructions: Put sliced sausage over salad and mix together in medium hot skillet. Add sliced cucumbers and radishes. Fry on med. Heat until hot and flavors are mixed and cucumbers soft. Place on slices of warm bread and sprinkle with cinnamon and chili.

title: Teriyaki Deviled Eggs (Eggs in a Hurry)
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and julienne | 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup sweet taco sauce ( taco bell sweet taco sauce is the best, but any store bought sweet and sour sauce will work ) | 2 tablespoons chopped seeded jalapeno peppers
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the teriyaki sauce and taco sauce and set aside. In a non stick skillet over medium low heat, melt the egg yolks and stir in the teriyaki sauce. Add the onions and peppers and cook for a few minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly. Spoon the egg mixture into a bowl and serve immediately, while still hot.

title: Tomsmom's Plobodoro Platter
ingredients: 12 cantaloupe balls | 1 jar tomato basil pasta sauce | ground mace
instructions: Cut cantaloupe balls in half, scrape out the seeds and pulp, and dice flesh. Arrange a platter onto a platter, and coat with tomato basil and mace. This platter can be filled up with other platters as well.

title: Lime and Caraway Jack (Shrimp)
ingredients: 1 bottle limeade concentrate, or to taste | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon shrimp paste, or to taste | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds
instructions: Pour limeade concentrate into a large container with a lid. Stir in raisins, shrimp paste, and caraway seeds. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to blend flavors, at least 5 hours.

title: Feline Narny's French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs large french-fried onions or 2 lbs narny's frozen french-fried onions | 10 slices canadian bacon | 3 tablespoons flour | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules, reconstituted according to package directions | 1 pkt canadian bacon, in 1 tbs of fat, reserve 2 tbs of the drippings | 1 can condensed beef broth
instructions: For the french onion soup, heat oven to 400 degrees. For the french fried onions, preheat oven to 375 degrees. Lay frozen french fried onions in the bottom of a 2 quart baking dish, about 1/2 inch thick. Place bacon rashers into a large pot on a paper towel lined cookie sheet and drizzle with bacon drippings making sure the bacon is fully coated. Set aside. Drain most of the fat from the bacon. Place the 2nd set of french fried onions in the bottom of the baking dish and top with 3nd set of french fried onions. Repeat layers ending with onions. Pour beef broth into the bottom of the baking dish. Cover and bake for 2 hours.

title: Chicken Nibbles
ingredients: 1 cup mushroom, sliced | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 250 g ready to eat chicken wings | 125 g fontina cheese, grated
instructions: Mix cornflour with 1/2 cup water, add 1/2 cup water and keep cooking until thick. Add the chicken and mushrooms and cook until chicken is cooked and mushrooms are tender. Add the rest of the water and simmer until thick. Add the cheese and heat through. Serve with bread and salad.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,coffee,egg,chickpea,italian seasoning basil red pepper,extra virgin olive oil
title: Smokey Poached Eggs
ingredients: 1 cup canned chickpeas ( drained, rinsed ) | 6 small eggs | 1/4 cup coarsely-chopped prosciutto or 1/4 cup country ham | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning ( mccormick basil, crushed red pepper, dried italian seasoning mixed fresh herbs, dried shredded dried roasted peppers, dried shredded italian seasoning blend, salt ) | 1/3 cup espresso or 1/3 cup strong coffee | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Shell the eggs. Using a 4 - 6 inch diameter springform pan or a regular, lightly oil the bottom and sides of the pan. Carefully crack the eggs into the pan in a circular motion. Do not break them. The size of the shell may vary. Place the eggs in a medium saucepan and cover with cold water. Cover and bring the water to a boil over high headspace. Once the water comes to a boil, remove the pan from the heat. Immediately add 2 tablespoons of the oil to the water. Carefully crack the eggs into the water, using a flat bladed knife. They will not break. Cover and return the pan to the stove over medium heat. Heat the olive oil in a small skillet until smoking. Be sure not to let the oil smoke. Pour the contents of the pan into a medium bowl. Drain the chickpeas thoroughly. Cut the ham into four 1/4 inch slices on the diagonal. Place the ham and 2 tablespoons olive oil in the center of the ham slices and place the eggs in the center. Scoop the ham mixture of eggs along with 1 tablespoon of the italian seasoning onto the eggs. Serve at once. Aprox. 1 tablespoon of dried crushed red peppers may be added to the oil if it is necessary. Sprinkle the cheese mixture over the top of each egg. Repeat the procedure with the remaining eggs. If you refrigerate them for up to 3 hours, remove before serving.

title: Sizzling Party Rice Paper (No Eggs)
ingredients: 3 cups low-fat basmati rice, rinsed | 1/2 lb kielbasa, sliced into rounds | 4 1/4 cups cooked chickpeas ( about 2 cans or 6-8 ) | 12 slices dry mustard seeds ( thin ) | 9 sheets rice paper sheets | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 3 teaspoons sherry wine
instructions: Combine rice and 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan. Bring to boil. Cover, reduce heat to medium low. Simmer 15 minutes without removing from heat. Uncover.

Random Ingredients: paprika,red grape,cornmeal,kalamata olive,nutmeg,cooking oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pearl barley
title: Paprika and Barley Risotto
ingredients: 100 g pearl barley, rinsed | 40 g cornmeal | 250 ml cooking oil | 10 kalamata olives, pitted | 300 g parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 cup rinsed red seedless grapes ( or a mixture of both ) | 2 teaspoons smoked paprika | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Combine the barley and 1 cup water in a small saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer until the barley is tender, about 20 minutes. Drain the barley and set aside and reserve the liquid. Drain the barley and place it in a medium saucepan with enough oil to cover. Heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Prick the olives, then sprinkle with the cheese and half the paprika. Set aside. Wipe out the small saucepan with a paper towel and return to medium high heat. Add half the olives and mix in half of the rice. Cook, stirring frequently, the rice will start to turn golden. Immediately add the remaining olives and remaining ingredients and cook, stirring frequently, until the cheese has melted. When the risotto is cooked, pour the risotto into a large shallow dish and spread evenly. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Place under the grill until golden brown, about 4 minutes, stirring constantly.

title: Easy Plain Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 package regular dashi stock | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 can white corn tortillas
instructions: Boil dashi and vegetable stock for about 15 minutes. Cut corn tortillas into small chunks and put in to a blender, then process until finely chopped. Once soup is smooth, fill into an ungreased soup pot, cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until tortilla begins to soften. Serve warm with finely chopped lettuce and chopped tomato. For the garnish, when making the soup, stir in finely chopped coriander or green onion.

title: Dilled Salami Relish
ingredients: 1 package salami | 1/4 cup sour dill pickle, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place salami, pickle, and 1 tablespoon of the sour dill pickle into a mini muffin pan and drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of sour dill pickle. Bake 20 minutes, until browned and the pickles are tender.

title: Onion Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,sage,anise seed,caper,corn tortilla,pomegranate juice
title: Baked Chips With Pomegranate Sauce
ingredients: 8 corn tortillas, cut across the grain in 1/4 slices about 1/2-inch | 1 1/2 cups pomegranate juice, chilled ( about 2 1/2 teaspoons ) | 3 tablespoons capers | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, chopped | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh sage, or 4 tablespoons fresh parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f brush the tortillas with some of the pomegranate juice and arrange at least 2 rows of them on a baking sheet with a rim. Bake at 450f for 5 minutes, flip the tortillas and bake another 6 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter and let cool. Meanwhile, in a small saute pan over low heat, combine the remaining pomegranate juice with the capers, sun dried tomatoes, sage, and anise and bring to a boil. Boil for 5 to 8 minutes or until the sauce thickens. Spoon the warm sauce over the chips and sprinkle with chopped mint. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,taco sauce,pecorino romano cheese,jalapeno pepper,tortilla,apple cider vinegar
title: Apple Cider Vinegar Ropa Vieja
ingredients: 1 jalapeno pepper | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 cup prepared tapioca-stuffed tortilla
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Slice pepper lengthwise into halves lengthwise. Place pepper halves on a cookie sheet and roast under the preheated broiler for 1 to 2 minutes or until skins are charred. Allow peppers to cool to room temperature, then remove and discard the skin. Remove seeds and membranes and cut in half lengthwise. Mince pepper pulp in a food processor. Stir in the rice wine vinegar and pecorino romano cheese. Cut tortillas into wedges and arrange on baking sheets. Bake, turning once, until warm, about 5 minutes. Remove from the oven and drizzle with tapioca pearls. Scatter pecorino romano cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,rice wine,super,tortilla chip,white sesame seed,spaghetti sauce,flour,mexican oregano
title: Super Simple Spaghetti and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spaghetti sauce, good quality | 1/2 teaspoon white sesame seeds, toasted | 1/4 cup flour ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1 1/4 cups rice wine, white | 1 teaspoon superfine ( granular ) | 3 ounces tortilla chips, coarsely crushed, divided ( i use my mexican stale )
instructions: Combine salsa, sesame seeds, flour, cocoa powder, oregano, wine & superfine in a bowl & stir well. Put 1/2 of the crushed chips in the bottom of a 2 qt baking dish. Pour spaghetti on top. Spread with half of the sauce mixture and spread evenly. Sprinkle remaining crushed chips on top.

title: Habanero Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can italian stewed tomatoes with oregano and basil, undrained | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and diced
instructions: Combine cream of mushroom soup and stewed tomatoes in a large saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and cook until warmed through, about 10 minutes. Stir in habanero. Continue to cook and stir occasionally until heated through, about 10 minutes.

title: Coffee Balls
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, ground | 1 tablespoon prepared sweetener | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup walnuts, very finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder
instructions: Blend all ingredients together except the cocoa. Form into small balls and roll in cocoa. Allow to rest at least 30 minutes.

title: Pickled Red Vinegar
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: In a jar or glass jar, pour vinegar with cardamom. Cap tightly with vented lid. Let stand at room temperature for 24 hours.

title: Broccoli Linguine
ingredients: 350 g broccoli, tops removed | 350 g linguine | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons dijon-style mustard | 2 -3 chilies, hot peppers, deveined, seeded & chopped
instructions: Cut broccoli into short, thick pieces. Boil water, add noodles & cook for 10 - 15 mins, drain & toss with the prepared dressing.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,chicken leg,basmati rice,almond extract,cream soup,anchovy,heavy cream
title: Poulet Basque Chicken
ingredients: 3 -4 whole chicken legs with thigh, legs with thigh attached or 3 -4 chicken drumsticks | 2 cans cream of soup | 1 large sour cream or 1 large yogurt | 1/4 cup fresh minced basil ( or 1/4 cup old fashioned parsley ) | 1 teaspoon anchovy or 2 -3 finely minced anchovies | 2 -3 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 - 1/2 cup basmati rice or 1/4-1/2 cup other white rice
instructions: First, make your bouquet garni by bringing 2 - 3 inches of water to boil in a large, nonstick saucepan big enough to hold everything. In medium saucepan, pour cream soup and add the chicken. Place the entire chicken and soup on top of the water. Place cover on saucepan, and set it to authenic for 45 minutes in the refrigerator. Remove cover and turn up the heat so the chicken is simmering through about another 5 to 10 minutes, or until juices start to run clear. Remove cover and continue cooking 45 minutes to an hour, or until juices are reduced by half and chicken is just cooked through.. Add to soup, along with desired salt. Strain soup through a fine sieve through a fine mesh sieve. Pour through sieve into a bowl, pressing gently to strain as much liquid as possible out of the soup. Set soup aside. In a small bowl, stir together sour cream and basil and anchovis. Spoon sour cream mixture over soup and gently stir in the chicken meat. Cook on low heat just until heated through and slightly reduced. Add almond extract. Serve soup in deep bowls and sprinkle with reserved basil and/or anchovy. Note, if soup is too thick, add a bit of cream of mushroom gravy or beef consomme liquid in, mixed with your soup.

Random Ingredients: coffee granule,chili sauce,kosher salt pepper,pumpernickel bread,turkey breast tenderloin
title: Easy Chili-Glazed Patty Schnitzel (Slow Cooker Version)
ingredients: 1 turkey breast tenderloin, sliced into 4 slices | 1/3 cup chili sauce | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules | 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt and pepper | pumpernickel bread
instructions: Pierce turkey several times with tines of a fork. Rub chili sauce over turkey, turning to coat both sides. Place turkey, meat side down, in crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours. Serve on pumpernickel bread with chili sauce for dipping. Serve with desired toppings. Note, the amount of chili sauce in this recipe has been reduced to 1 t.

title: Faux Eggplant and Meatballs
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, peeled and cut crosswise into 1/8-inch thick slices | 1 pound boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2 inch wide strips | 12 spears fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut diagonally into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 jar pickled fat-free filling, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Place eggplant, beef, asparagus, and 1/2 the pickled jelly in the bottom of a large resealable plastic bag. Squeeze out excess air and seal bag. Toss to combine. Divide meat mixture evenly in half. Press 2 slices eggplant and one slice of beef into each piece of meat. Fold up sides of bag and secure shut. Refrigerate covered 8 hours or overnight. Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange half of the meat in a single layer on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake meatballs in preheated oven 15 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board. Let cool slightly. Repeat same procedure with remaining meat, arranging 6 meatballs in each of the remaining 3 baking sheets. Cut meatballs into 1 inch pieces. Bake meatballs in the top thirds of the oven 12 to 15 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Top with remaining pickled jelly. Cool completely and serve.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,red chilies,pork chop,fish bouillon cube,beer,splenda granular,oregano
title: Pork Chops in Hoisin Sauce
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 3 tablespoons fish bouillon cubes ( i like 2 ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 red chilies, finely chopped | 12 ounces light beer, room temperature | 1 tablespoon splenda granular | 1 ounce prosciutto, finely chopped ( i use fresh chipped ham )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degress f/160 deg celsius. Rinse chops and pat dry. Mix the fish cubes, oregano, chilies, beer and splenda in a bowl and spread over the pork. Place in a roasting tin or baking sheet and bake for 35 mins remove from oven. While the pork is cooking, slice the prosciutto into strips about 6 8mm long. Sear chops on all sides with a little butter until crispy, adding the ham about 5 mins before removing from the oven. Serve with a fresh green bean salad. To serve, spread a little honey and chopped parsley on a piece of string.

title: Homemade Charred Meat
ingredients: 10 lbs meat | 4 quarts ice water | 2 pinches five-spice powder | 6 small radishes
instructions: Place your bones in a large pot, cover with cold water and add ice. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat with lid slightly ajar to let the water boil away and stir. This will keep your bones covered for several days. When the water reaches the boiling point, remove the lid and add five spice. Return to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and leave to steep for 6 hours. Pour the meat into a clean container and store in the fridge. It will turn a beautiful, deep dark brown color.

Random Ingredients: french,ancho chile powder,bread flour,apple,dark rum,ice,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Ancho Rum Apple Bread
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 1/2 cups ice | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup french haricot vert or 1 cup green beans, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup shredded apple | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Toast bread flour in a 400 degree oven for 8 minutes. Remove and cool 3 minutes. Stir ice into bread flour in a large bowl. Blend bread flour, 1 1/2 cups ice, and cooking spray in a food processor. Add remaining ingredients and process until dough forms a ball. Turn dough out onto floured surface. Roll dough until it is ½ inch thick. Cut out 2 inch circles and let dry at least 30 minutes. Coat each dough circle with cooking spray and place in a lightly greased 9x5 inch loaf pan. Let dough rise until it is puffy. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool on rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Garam Golok Goong (Indian Chicken)
ingredients: 1 whole roasting chickens, cut into pieces | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled | 1 pinch ground white pepper
instructions: Heat a wok over medium heat. Add enough oil to cover the bottom of the wok.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,corn,coconut flake,egg substitute,ziti pasta,shrimp,spice,canola oil
title: Jaja-Style Maca & Shrimp With Coconut
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ziti pasta, uncooked | 1 large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and diced | 8 ounces corn, cooked | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 14 1/2 fluid ounces egg substitute | 16 ounces coconut flakes, drained ( see step 1 ) | 1 vanilla bean, split and scraped | 1/4 teaspoon spice
instructions: Cook ziti pasta in large pot of boiling water until barely tender.

title: Tomato Chip Crisp
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs plum tomatoes | 1/2 lb tortilla chips | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Cut the tomatoes in half lengthwise and drop into boiling water for 2 minutes. Remove and discard the seeds and then plunge into cold water to stop the cooking process. Dry the tomatoes on a paper towel lined cookie sheet for a minute. Cut each slice into 5 to 10 chip sized pieces, place a few chips into a small bag and shake. Add dark soy sauce and toss. Preheat your oven to 500°f line 2 baking sheets with foil and spray with oil. Place the tomatoes, a few chips at a time, on the pans and place back on the oven rack. Bake for 15 minutes or until crisp and warm.

title: French Style Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup french style lentils | 1 large yellow lentil
instructions: Wash yellow lentils thoroughly, then place in a pot in a large enough container that covers them. Fill with enough water to cover them and bring to a boil. Boil for 30 minutes. Remove from heat then drain. Cover lentils with water and continue to simmer for another 45 minutes, or until they are tender, but not mushy. Cover again.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,irish cream,topping,beef rib,beef stew meat,sirloin,wild rice,white mushroom
title: Beef and Wild Rice Beef Rolls (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, trimmed | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 cup sliced white mushroom | 1/2 lb sirloin, trimmed of fat and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 lb beef short rib, trimmed of excess fat and cut crosswise into 4 equal pieces | 2 cups hot cooked wild rice, left in tact for at least 15 minute before serving ( can be left out )
instructions: Place beef in one layer in crockpot. Sprinkle with vinegar.

title: John's Special Cheese With Sausages
ingredients: 24 dates, pitted and chopped ( not too soft ) | 6 ounces pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce
instructions: Take 3 - 4 cups of chopped fresh dates and mix with the cheese, making sure it is fairly spreadable. Spread one slice of the date over the top of the patty.

title: Hard-Boiled Eggs (Parsley, Egg Yolk and Lemons)
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs, shelled | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons of roasted italian spices, crushed | 2 teaspoons dried italian spices
instructions: Cut the eggs, and remove the whites and yolks. Peel away the hard yolks, cut the whites into thin, thin slices, and slice the hard boiled eggs into very thin slices, the lemon zest and the mixed dried spices. Place the egg whites in a glass and plastic bowl, and add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well. Let sit at room temperature 30 min, or chill several hours to develop flavor. Serve in small or thick mugs or a decorative martini glass. Note, these look good for 1/2 pound of eggs in the pound, and 1 large boiled egg yolk in the pound for garnish.

title: Fennel Seed Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 3 tablespoons fennel seeds
instructions: Heat preserves and fennel seeds in a skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove hot mixture from heat. Drop cookies by the cupful onto sheets of waxed paper. Cool well. Slice diagonally about 1/2 inch thick and place slices on the waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,kalamata olive,ham,baking soda,wheat flour,chipotle powder
title: Kumquat's Quick Pizza
ingredients: 5 cups whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 chipotle powder | 1 cup diced ham | 1 can sliced sundried tomatoes packed in oil | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted and sliced
instructions: Mix together the flour, baking soda and chipotle powder and set aside. In a skillet, heat a small amount of the bacon grease over medium heat. Add the ham and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned. Add the olives and sun dried tomatoes. Mix the ingredients well and set aside. Add the dry ingredients. Add a little more oil if necessary, until a dough forms. Let rest for a few minutes. Preheat the pizza stone. Using a large cookie cutter, cut the dough into three circles and place on a baking sheet, or on a pizza peel spread pizza sauce on the dough. Place the three pizzas on the pizza stone, close the door and bake for 5 - 7 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.

title: Hot Canadian Bacon and Canadian Bacon Sandwiches - Canadian Bacon Rolls
ingredients: 2 2 slices canadian bacon or 2 slices of smoked ham | 1 teaspoon mustard powder ( optional, or your favorite mustard ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1 tablespoon canadian bacon
instructions: Cut your bacon into six pieces. Sprinkle mustard onto the ham and bacon. Dot with bacon, adding the other bouillon if necessary. Wrap the ham and bacon in waxed paper and place in freezer for at least four hours until it's time to be served. Melt canadian bacon flavored liqueur or a splash of water with mustard powder until well blended and pour over hamburgers.

title: Meatball Bananas Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 packages precooked meatballs | 1 can spaghetti sauce | 1/4 fresh thyme sprig | 6 bananas, halved lengthwise, and seeded | 6 teaspoons butter
instructions: Cook the meatballs in boiling water until no longer pink then drain and set aside. Wipe out the saucepan and heat until almost boiling. Add the thawed meatballs, spaghetti sauce and thyme sprigs. Heat to a boil, then reduce and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, melt the butter in a skillet and add the bananas. Cook, stirring occasionally, until they feel just warm and coated with the sauce. Drain meatballs and arrange on a serving platter. Spoon sauce over and serve. You may like to substitute spaghetti with the meatballs and place a few of the bananas into each of the serving plates.

title: Sauerkraut Canapés
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons rum | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 - 1 cup cantaloupe, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix all ingredients except cantaloupe in glass baking dish. Cover dish and bake for 10 - 12 mins or until cantaloupe is tender. Serve in shallow bowls, topping with cantaloupe slices.

title: Chipotle Zest
ingredients: 1/4 cup coarsely chopped chipotle chile, seeds removed | 1/4 cup marsala wine
instructions: Combine the chile and marsala wine in a small, heavy nonreactive skillet. Cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until the chile dissolves, about 3 minutes. Increase the heat to medium and cook until the chile is aromatic, about 3 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a shallow baking dish. Cool the sauce to room temperature. When the skillet is dry, remove from the heat. Stir the chile mixture with a wooden spoon, scraping the bottom and sides with a spoon. Place the zest in a freezer plastic bag and press out as much air as possible. Refrigerate until serving time, at least 3 hours or as long as 3 days. Store in the refrigerator up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,chanterelle mushroom,pineapple,teriyaki sauce,basil,plain nonfat yogurt,baking soda,asparagus
title: Saucy Asian Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons prepared teriyaki sauce | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh basil | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, trimmed | 1 lb trimmed asparagus, woody ends snapped from woody stems | 1 package chanterelle mushrooms, stems trimmed | 1 large fresh pineapple, peeled, cored, cut into 1/2 inch pieces, about 8 ounces or | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a large bowl. Add meat.

Random Ingredients: shallot,chili powder,horseradish sauce,nonfat milk,boursin cheese,picante sauce,turnip,beef tenderloin steak
title: Grilled Beef With Horseradish Potatoes #RSC
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, 1-inch in diameter | 12 ounces picante sauce | 1 lb shallot, peeled & sliced into thin rings | 1 tablespoon horseradish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 3/4 - 1 cup nonfat milk | 2/3 cup nonfat dry milk | 8 ounces boursin cheese | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Heat grill. Place steaks on foil or a grill pan lined with heavy duty aluminum foil with the long edge of the foil pointing toward the fire. Bake indirectly over hot coals for 15 - 20 minutes, turn, and continue rotating them. Brush steaks with picante sauce and set aside. In a medium bowl, prepare horseradish sauce. Cut shallot into strips and toss with horseradish sauce, 1/2 teaspoons chili powder and 1/4 teaspoons salt. Cover& chill. When ready to grill, warm 1/3 cup skim milk and heavy dry milk, stirring constantly, over moderately high heat until hot but not boiling. Stir in 1/2 teaspoons chili powder, 1/4 teaspoons salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Set aside. When ready to grill, brush grill with picante sauce and heat for 10 to 15 seconds. Remove steaks from foil. Arrange steaks on hot grate alongside horseradish mixture and brush with picante milk mixture. Close grill and continue grilling until steaks turn brown and are medium rare, 12 to 16 minutes for rare, 12 to 15 minutes for medium well and 18 to 20 minutes longer for well done. Brush remaining 1/3 cup skim milk mixture over steaks when served and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,vanilla extract,chinese wine,spaghetti sauce,black bean,cod fish fillet,eggplant
title: Smoky Cod Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained | 1 1/2 lbs cod fish fillets, cut into chunks | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/3 cup chinese wine | 1 eggplant, sliced as thinly as possible | 1 jar spaghetti sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In bowl, combine beans, cod. Mix all ingredients together, but add more pasta sauce if too thick. Place in casserole dish and bake about 50 minutes or until it bubbles on top. Top with fresh parsley to taste.

title: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 5 ounces frozen soba noodles | 1 1/2 ounces fresh sliced pear | 1/2 lb thin sugar snap pea | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Cook soba according to package directions, adding sliced pear during the last 2 minutes of cooking. Bring large pot of water to boil and add soba. Cook 5 minutes. Serve while still hot in a bowl with a sprinkling of sugar and the raisins sprinkled on top.

Random Ingredients: rotel,rice flour,hazelnut,grain rice,szechuan peppercorn,yellow pepper,rye bread
title: Korean Spice Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup coarse grain rice flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole grain rice flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed szechuan peppercorns | 1 yellow pepper, peeled seeded and cut into 1/2-inch squares | 5 ounces rye bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 can rotel | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped
instructions: In a deep 9x5 inch loaf pan or other large shallow sided baking dish, mix grain salt, whole grain rice and crushed szechuan peppercorns. Arrange pepper squares atop rice mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350°f. Place rye bread cubes on top of pepper and bread cubes in the baking dish. Bake uncovered 50 - 60 minutes or until bread cubes are crispy and rye bread cubes are tender crisp. Serve with hot korean soup and/or rice kimchi, if desired.

title: Spicy Cajun Street Tacos
ingredients: 3 avocados, peeled and mashed | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 2 teaspoons thai sweet chili sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix cornmeal and sriracha together until smooth.

title: Greek Feta Roast
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cover beef roast with foil. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place beef roast into the water. Cook covered over medium high heat until the meat is fork tender, about 3 hours. Transfer beef to a platter. Skim fat from beef broth. Strain broth into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover beef with foil. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, 45 to 60 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Remove meat from the roasting pan, reserving broth.

title: Penne With Ginger and Spicy Spinach
ingredients: 200 f. dried medium-grain penne | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 lb spinach, fresh | 1 package wonton skins, frozen
instructions: Soak penne noodles in warm water for 20 minutes, then drain. Combine ginger garlic paste and spinach in a large bowl. Let this mixture stand for 10 or 15 minutes. In the meantime, bring 3 cups of water to boil. Add penne and cook according to package directions. To serve, drain mixture and toss with spinach mixture.

Random Ingredients: oil,extra virgin olive oil,pita bread,garlic paste,vegetable stock,coffee
title: Pita Bread Soup
ingredients: 2 pita bread | 2 cups vegetable stock | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 6 teaspoons garlic paste | 1/2 ounce coffee | 1/4 - 1/2 cup coffee, flavored with milk powder
instructions: Cut pita bread into pieces, then toast it in a baking sheet in the oven until lightly browned and crisp. Meanwhile, heat extra virgin olive oil over medium heat in a large soup pot. Add garlic paste, stir well, and add vegetable stock. Add pita bread pieces and coffee flavored coffee and bring to boil. Lower heat to low and simmer for about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let soup mixture steep, then puree in batches in a food blender or food processor to form a soup. Return puree to pot, and add more coffee in proportion to the amount of soup you just began. You can freeze the soup after freezing, refrigerate the soup in plastic bags for up to 2 days. Before serving, reheat soup, then add cold coffee.

title: Spanish Sausage and Tomatillo Stew
ingredients: 1 package hot italian turkey sausage links | 1 can tomatillos
instructions: Cut sausage links into 1/4 inch slices with a sharp knife, leaving sausage in the casings. Cut sausage into 1/4 inch pieces with a sharp knife, leaving 1/4 inch of sausage on each end. Stir tomatillos into sausage and let simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in a large pot over medium high heat. Add the rest of the sausage to the pot and simmer until sausage is cooked through.

title: Ahi Tuna Baked in Soymiso Sauce
ingredients: 2 ahi tuna or ( 1 1/2 lb ) haddock fillets | 1/2 cup soy miso ( red plum ) | 1 tablespoon toasted and ground sumac | 1 tablespoon soy miso ( roasted red miso ) | 1 cup boiling watercress | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f and put a rack into the center. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Rinse the fish under running water until the water is clear and the fish is easy to remove from the skin. Slice the fish into 3/4 inch thick slices. Arrange the slices on the baking sheet. Bake for 5 minutes, or until crisp and the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Turn the crab fillets, and return them to the oven for a further 2 - 3 minutes, or until cooked through. While the fish is baking, make your marinade.

title: Cajun Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 fresh cremini mushrooms | 1/4 cup unflavored gelatin | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 can chopped jalapeno peppers, drained
instructions: Slice mushrooms very thinly, then spread sliced mushrooms in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle gelatin over 1 cup water and stir to dissolve. Sprinkle lemon peel over gelatin and pour in water. Place mushrooms on top of the gelatin in a medium bowl and let stand 1 hour. Mix jalapenos into gelatin mixture and pour mixture into prepared pan. Place in refrigerator to set, about 3 hours. Stir gently before serving.

title: Zesty Beef and Quinoa Salad (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 1 can diced tomatoes | 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Cook beef in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat for 3 minutes or until brown or. Stir in undrained tomatoes, quinoa and lemon pepper until well mixed. Heat through, about 5 minutes. Fluff with fork and serve.

title: Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 bag frozen sour cherries tomatoes | 1 apple ( peeled cored and cut into 1 inch chunks ) | 1 package cool whip
instructions: Place tomato halves in a small saucepan with just enough water to cover. Bring to a simmer and cook until the tomatoes are bright red in color, about 5 minutes. Drain well and set aside. Place sliced cherry tomatoes between two sheets of waxed paper and let cool to the touch. Using your hands or potato peeler, peel tomato and cut into quarters. Place cherry tomatoes into a large bowl. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the cool whip. Spoon the sour cherries into a bowl and sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the cool whip. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 2 days, flipping the fruit a few times. Remove the chilled fruit and serve.

title: Limam Bean Ice Cream
ingredients: 250 g lima beans | 300 ml half-and-half cream ( low fat is okay, just do a taste test )
instructions: Boil lima beans for exactly 10 minutes or until they are just tender enough to mash easily. Drain and mash together the beans using a potato masher. While still warm, stir in the half and half cream until the texture is as creamy. Place in an ice cream maker and freeze according to your manufacturer's instructions. Once your ice cream maker becomes semi solid, gently shake the pan over the ice cream and quickly allow it to run over the back of the spoon. This exciting step arrests any ice formation and keeps frozen for several minutes. Once it is frozen, stir it in with the rest of the ice cream just before serving. Serve as desired with extra cream or fruit.

title: Borracho for Two
ingredients: 100 g garbanzo beans, soaked overnight in cold water | 150 g low-fat yoghurt ( to serve ) | 150 g dark beer
instructions: Drain the soaked bananas and rinse under tap water. Chop the bananas well and steam over a medium high heat for 12 minutes. Add yoghurt and mix well. Serve as an accompaniment to grilled or barbecued meats.

title: Yorkshire Bread
ingredients: 2 cups self raising flour | 1/2 cup marjoram, chopped, or | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary leaves | 1/2 cup red onion, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together flour, marjoram and rosemary. Stir in chopped onions, then beat together until mixture just barely holds together. Using a fork, gently stir in egg or milk until the mixture forms a dough. Knead on a floured surface for about 3 minutes until smooth. Divide dough into 6 equal portions, and place on prepared baking sheet. Using your hands, shape each piece into a circle. Press a wedge of bread on top of each bread to form a criss cross pattern. Bake in a moderate oven for 20 minutes, or until pale. Serve warm with marinara sauce or marinara.

title: Beef Patties With Eggplant and French Toast
ingredients: 300 g rump steak | 1 package french bread | 1 eggplant | 1 cup catsup | 2 -3 drops red food coloring | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Cut crosswise into 1 cm to 1 cm thick slices. Cut 3 cm long sticks of about the length of bread. Slices should not be wider than 1 cm. Coat slices lightly with catsup. Place slices in a bowl with a little cold water and set aside for 30 minutes. Drain well, and cut slices into pieces about 1 cm thick. Lightly fry bread slices on both sides in a dry frying pan. Drain on absorbent paper and keep warm. Repeat with eggplant slices and meat. Place a slice of eggplant on each of 4 pieces of bread, reserving a piece of bread for the tops of the sandwiches. Place each one on 4 pieces of toast. Spread 2 tsps. Of catsup over each pattie, and sprinkle with desired amount of food colouring. Place in a well buttered ovenproof dish. Bake at 220c for 15 minutes, or until meat is cooked, turning once. Divide yoghurt between plates. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,chili pepper flake,egg white,rice flour,fine sea salt,noodle
title: Danish Pasta Sauce (Noodle Fritters)
ingredients: 600 g plain noodles or 600 g other fresh pasta | 2 egg whites, beaten | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 1/2 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water until just tender.

title: Italian Style Spud
ingredients: 4 fresh hamburger or 4 middle eastern hamburgers | 4 slices parmesan cheese | 1 can refrigerated beefsteak tomatoes | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Brown hamburger or heat an 8 oz. Shallow fry pan. In a sauce pan, melt cheeses. Stir fry tomatoes in tomato sauce until soft. Add meat mixture and brown on both sides. Serve with rice for dipping.

title: Shrimply Shrimp
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee | 8 ounces baby carrots, julienned | 2 pints raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup currants | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large skillet on high. Add the carrots and fry for 3 to 5 minutes, until crisp tender and golden. Place the shrimp in the skillet, stir, then add the currants and cook, stirring frequently, for another 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in the vinegar and cook for 1 minute or until the sauce is piping hot.

title: Sole Normande
ingredients: 4 sole fillets, approx. 1 pound | 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese, freshly grated ( best quality ) | 2 green cardamoms, crushed | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil. Spread the parmesan cheese out on the foil. Lightly press the cardamom in a small frying pan and toast over a medium heat. Place the fish in the pan and cook for 3 - 5 minutes on one side. Turn over and cook for a further 3 - 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,french bread,daikon radish,heavy whipping cream,masala,plain yogurt
title: Kataifi
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 chipotle chiles, minced | 1/2 daikon radish, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup masala
instructions: Slice bread in half lengthwise. Spread cut surfaces with yogurt and cream. Sprinkle with minced chipotle peppers, radishes and masala. Wrap in foil, and bake at 350° for 5 minute.

title: Ocha Squares
ingredients: 1 pie shell, ready rolled | 1 1/2 cups chocolate, melted | 8 cherry tomatoes, halved | salt, to taste | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning ( optional ) | warm maple syrup
instructions: Prick the bottom of each pie shell or round with a fork. Put in a muffin tin, and place on a cookie sheet.

title: Tropical Shrimp Bake
ingredients: 1 package frozen enchilada sauce | 1 package frozen shrimp, thawed, and peeled | 1 can mexicorn, chopped | 1/2 cup red onion, chopped | 1/2 cup turbinado sugar, or more to taste | 1/4 cup beer, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread enchilada sauce into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Lay shrimp, enchilada sauce, and shrimp over enchilada sauce. Cover with red onion. Cover with turbinado sugar. Pour beer over top, and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,mushroom stem,monterey jack cheese
title: Quick Cheese With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup mushroom stems, coarsely chopped | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/2 cups grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: In the bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade, combine the mushrooms, salt and pepper and pulse until combined. Sprinkle the top with the cheese. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled, about 2 hours. Store covered in the refrigerator to keep, up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,herring fillet,red pepper flake,lemon peel,tomato green chilies,cremini mushroom,chocolate
title: Herring With Pasta (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 4 ounces rotini pasta | 4 ounces herring fillets | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced into thin rings | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons chopped chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse with cold water, drain and set aside. In bowl, combine herring, mushrooms, tomatoes and lemon peel, red pepper flakes and 2 tablespoons of the chocolate. Cover and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Baked Rosemary Rum Caribbean
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups light molasses | 1/2 cup coconut rum | 1/2 cup dijon mustard | 6 sprigs fresh rosemary | 2 slices peeled fresh ginger
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Combine rum, molasses, dijon, and rosemary in a small saucepan and heat over medium heat until blended, about 10 minutes. Pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish, and place over medium high heat to reduce. Pour rum mixture over the top, and place in the oven. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, until the top is rich and caramelized. Let cool about 5 minutes, then cut into squares. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,peanut oil,string bean,fish sauce,marinade,lamb
title: Chinese String And Beans
ingredients: 16 ounces string beans, soaked overnight in water | 1 1/4 lbs lamb, minced | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup marinade | 1/2 cup fish sauce
instructions: Saute meat and string beans in oil till meat is done. Add soup, marinade and fish sauce. Simmer till cooked.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,italian parsley,cornstarch,plum,grain white rice,salt pork,brown sugar,lychee juice
title: Rice-Fried Lychees with Plums
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked long-grain white rice | 8 plums, pitted, quartered lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon salt ( optional ) | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 lb fresh lychees, cut into thin slices ( about 5 cups ) | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Cook rice in a medium saucepan of boiling salted water until just tender, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Drain well. Arrange plums over rice. Sprinkle with salt. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 3 hours. Sprinkle with sugar. Meanwhile, stir cornstarch with lemon zest in a small bowl.

title: Creamy Spinach With Kielbasa
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa ( or you can use sausage ) | 1 lb fresh spinach, washed, trimmed and chopped | 1/2 cup raisins or 1/2 cup dried currant | 1/2 cup colby cheese, shredded | asiago cheese or fontina cheese, grated
instructions: Cook kielbasa and drain. Add spinach in 4 portions. Place in buttered baking dish. Sprinkle evenly with cheese. Sprinkle with asiago or fontina cheese. Bake, uncovered for 15 - 20 minutes, or until hot throughout.

title: Red Coleslaw Rollups
ingredients: 4 medium lettuces, washed and dried | 1 1/2 cups red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup heavy cream or 1/2 cup milk | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon artificial sweetener ( see notes ) | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut | soft tortilla ( optional )
instructions: To make tostada, mix all the dressing ingredients in a bowl. Pile the salad leaves on toasted nori sheets. Add the slaw mix to the salad leaves. Drizzle the dressing over the slaw and toss. Notes, mayonnaise can be purchased as suggested on the packet at any other supermarket. Sweetener can be replaced by a combination of light mayonnaise and sugar. Coconut flavoured salad dressing can be bought as an alternative to plain mayonnaise.

Random Ingredients: red bliss potato,salt pepper,cooking oil,chinese five spice powder
title: Five Spice Steampot Chips
ingredients: 12 -18 medium size red bliss potatoes | 1 - 1 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | salt and pepper
instructions: Place potatoes in a steamer, cover and steam for about 20 minutes. You can steam until slightly soft inside, or cook until done. Cut and remove crusts with a sharp knife. These can be baked in a deep fry pan at 400 degrees or deep fryer for about 3 - 4 minutes at 400 degrees. This helps them stay crisp in the oil and helps to spread the color evenly during frying. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,green capsicum,orange peel,chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Roasted Capsicum
ingredients: 8 large green capsicum, halved & seeded | 1 small orange peel, cut into thin strips | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 2 dried chili pepper flakes, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Place capsicums, orange peel & pepper in a baking tray, drizzle with a little of the oil & seasoning. Roast under the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Serve with your choice of salads & steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,egg white,corn oil,colby monterey jack cheese,salt pepper,chocolate syrup,sea salt black pepper,tart apple
title: Apple Cheese Fonduta
ingredients: 6 large tart apples ( such as granny smith, mcintosh, or granny smith ) | 2 slices of about 8 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese or 2 slices gruyere cheese ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1 pinch salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon hot chocolate syrup | 1 large egg white, whisked with | coarse salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pour cold water over cheese to cool. Grate apples to remove any excess juice. Place cheese into a large bowl, add remaining ingredients and toss well. Transfer cheese to a pastry bag fitted with a small star tip. Pour cheese into bread machine in increments of 8 and process until cheese is completely smooth, with no lumps. Transfer to a fondue pot that has been placed over medium heat, stirring constantly. When fonduta begins to bubble, add remaining ingredients. Turn fonduta off and allow to cool for about 20 minutes before serving. This also makes a nice dipping and appetizer with a tangy dipping sauce. Enjoy with warm pumpernickel or rye bread slices and fruit for dipping.

title: Roast Beef Potatoes & Shrimps (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter, melted | 1/4 cup beef fat, cooked and diced | 1 lb baby red potato, cut in 4 pieces | 1/2 lb deli roast beef, cut in 1 inch cubes
instructions: Spread butter on bottom of slow cooker. Mix butter, beef fat, and potato cubes in bowl. Layer ingredients with roast beef on top and bake covered on slow cooker on low 7 - 8 hours. Remove beef and shred with forks and serve onto platters.

title: Baked Peas
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh green peas ( about 8 peeks ) | 1/2 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Place peas in a medium mixing bowl. Sprinkle with harissa. Coat the top of peas with a little water and sprinkle a touch of olive oil on top of them. Bake for 25 minutes, or until they are crispy and just beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: cumin,yellow onion,mirin,onion soup mix,italian salad dressing,cocoa
title: Mexican Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 yellow onion | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 cup cumin | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1/4 cup mirin | 2 tablespoons instant rice-a-peri-peri or 2 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Chop the onion fine, then peel off the skin and place in food processor or blender. Add the dry onion soup mix, cocoa, mirin and cocoa powder. Blend until it becomes a liquid paste. Pour dressing over the onion paste and mix well. Chill for 2 hours to allow the flavors to blend better.

Random Ingredients: coriander,cooking sherry,cream chicken soup,cooking oil,snow pea,butternut squash,egg noodle
title: Cottageland Style Noodles
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | cooking oil | 1 can cream of chicken soup ( campbell's ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 chopped butternut squash | 1 bunch coriander | 1 can snow peas, chopped
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the omitting salt and fat. Drain and return to the pan. Heat oil in a frying pan and fry the soup, then stir in the noodles, squash, coriander, and snow peas.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,asparagus spear,sesame oil,soya sauce,maple syrup,spinach leaf,pistachio
title: Asparagus Spinach with Maple and Pesto Topping
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh asparagus spears, trimmed | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 lb raw spinach leaves, cleaned and torn into pieces | 1/2 cup shelled unsalted pistachios, toasted, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican-style cheese blend
instructions: Set out one sheet of parchment paper, the remaining sheets covered with plastic wrap, and a dinner plate covered with plastic wrap. Prepare the topping, in a large saute pan over medium heat, stir together the maple syrup, soy sauce, and sesame oil until the sauce is smooth and syrupy. Place the asparagus in a glass bowl, pour the maple syrup mixture over the asparagus, and allow to sit for 10 to 12 minutes. When the asparagus is done, drain the asparagus pieces, discarding any tough parts or tough ends, and set aside. To serve, divide the spinach among four salad plates. Top the greens with the asparagus and pour equal amounts of the maple pesto on the top, and sprinkle the pistachios over the top.

title: Kolab's Hot Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups guacamole, freshly baked | 1/4 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes or 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Using a mixer or food processor, mix all ingredients together until well blended. Serve at once or store in the refrigerator in small crock pots or heat up on low for up to 3 hours.

title: Moroccan Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1/4 cup good hershey's chocolate syrup | 1/4 package shredded lettuce leaf ( i like angel hair also for a change ( to taste )
instructions: Prepare cous couscous according to package directions using your favourite water. Let cool. In a large serving bowl add the couscous, and stir to combine. Add sugar, chocolate syrup, and lettuce. Toss until mixed well and desired sweetness is achieved.

title: Spicy Ginger Ale, Capsicum and Green Chilli
ingredients: 1/2 green chili pepper | 1/2 red capsicum | ginger ale
