instructions: Cut capsicum and ginger into thin slices. Open ginger ale and add ginger ale to the capsicum, capsicum and green chilli. Stir lightly until combined.

title: Sweet and Chewy German Rice Dessert
ingredients: 8 ounces kahlua | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup finely grated parmesan cheese or 1/2 cup romano cheese | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, blend the kahlua and sugar.

Random Ingredients: lobster tail,tarragon vinegar,chicken breast half,garlic salt,brown rice,white bread
title: Grilled Lobster Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh tarragon vinegar | 1 1/4 cups white bread slices, crusts removed | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 4 thick-cut boneless chicken breast halves | 1 jar lobster tail, drained | 1 package cooked brown rice
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the vinegar and bread slices.

title: Easy Fish Stew
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb cod fish | 1 can cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 large orange, sliced | 1 package pork, meatballs in water, diced
instructions: Break up fish in a 1/2 cup size pieces, remove bones and fat. Discard skin. Combine 1st four ingredients.

title: Cantaloupe Salad
ingredients: 1 cantaloupe ( green or red ) | 2 small red chile peppers | 2 small green chile peppers | 1 apple | 1 large strawberry, sliced | 1 tablespoon custard powder | 1/4 cup granulated sugar | 1 teaspoon ground red chile pepper
instructions: Cut out the top and base of the cantaloupe, then cut away the shell and peel the melon from the skin. Cut each melon in half lengthwise, and arrange on two attractive plates or a platter. In a small sauté pan, warm the custard powder, sugar, red chile pepper, and the hot pepper for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until smooth and thick. Drain the melons, then slice them thinly. Spoon 2 tbsp custard mixture over each melon. Spoon the melon pieces over the custard. Serve. Note, the topping is still slightly a little tart or slightly runny. It can be used to topping salads, tostones, etc.

title: Blackberry Bean & Squash Sandwich With Saffron
ingredients: 1 cup dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight, then drained | 2 medium yellow squash, sliced | 1 -2 pinch saffron threads, with some ( or a pinch more ) | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 1/2 cup plain sweet italian bread ( if you like it crusty, then use the entire loaf with the crust on ) | 2 -3 tablespoons taco sauce | 2 -3 teaspoons crushed blackberries
instructions: In a large pot, simmer the chickpeas in the 2/3 cup hot sauce for about 30 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, slice the squash into 2/4 inch thick rounds, place in a bowl, cover with cold water and let soak for 5 - 10 minutes. Drain and pat dry. When soft, drain off water and place in a food processor or blender. Add the saffron and 1/4 cup of the hot sauce and pulse briefly. Toast the bread slices on both sides and spread with taco sauce. Add the blackberries and remaining hot sauce and arrange on a plate. Heat the remaining 1/3 cup of hot sauce in a nonstick saute pan until bubbling. Toast the bread and spread some of the cooked chickpeas on the bottom slice and spoon some of the bean mixture on the bread and serve immediately.

title: Spanish Omelet
ingredients: 2 whole hard boiled eggs, peeled | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Cut the eggs lengthwise into 8 strips. Cut each strip into eight 6 to 8 pieces. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. When the skillet is hot, add the olive oil. Toss the eggs in the hot olive oil to coat them in the olive oil. Cook and toss until browned on the bottom, but still crunchy in the middle, 1 to 2 minutes. Sprinkle the bottom of the omelet with croutons or candied cherries.

title: Mutton Keema
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, cut into 1 in cubes | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Heat 1tblsp. Of canola oil, put in the mince. Fry till it is brown. Keep all the mince. When it is done add 1 tsp. Of coconut extract. Serve hot with rice or puris or chappati.

Random Ingredients: almond,pine nut,cider vinegar,vegetable stock,cabbage,tarragon,spanish onion,pork roast
title: Spanish Pork and Cabbage Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs pork roast | 6 ounces spanish onions, peeled, quartered | 2 ounces slivered almonds | 4 ounces pine nuts | 1/2 head cabbage, chopped | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cover the bottom of a casserole dish or dutch oven with a layer of slivered almonds. Season pork with salt, pepper, and a sprinkling of tarragon. Spray pork with cooking spray, if desired. Place the meat on the almonds in a single layer in the casserole dish. Pour onion, pine nuts, and cabbage on top. Mix vinegar with water in a small saucepan and pour over contents of the meat mixture. Cover casserole dish with lid or baking paper and bake until meat is fork tender. About 2 hours. Skim fat from stew if desired. Serve with couscous and/or grain.

title: Easy Beef Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin ( or any beef ) | 8 -10 medium potatoes, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 lb pasta ( uncooked or package size ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( or to taste )
instructions: Dice beef into bite size pieces. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add a few dashes of salt. Add uncooked or large package pasta. Add beef and potatoes and return to boil. Reduce heat.

title: Beef and Beans
ingredients: 600 g sirloin | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Slice sirloin into thin ribbons if necessary. Place beef in a large plastic bag and sprinkle with a tablespoon of cumin seeds and a little bit of bicarb of soda. Mix well, then shake to coat evenly in the beef. Refrigerate for at least 1/2 an hour or overnight. When ready to cook, drain beef and discard the remaining soda. Return the beef to the bag and use two forks to pull the beef out of the bag as it is cooking. Cook the beans in a frying pan over a low heat for about 10 minutes until heated through. Taste and adjust the seasoning of the beans with salt and pepper. Place the beef back in the frying pan, season to taste and serve.

title: Guinness Sprouts With Ginger
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh bean sprouts, washed and well drained | 1 cup guinness stout
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a large, shallow dish and toss to mix, set aside for 30 minutes. Wipe off the excess starch, then return to the dish. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 2 hours, shaking the dish occasionally. Boil rapidly until the mixture is cooked to taste and has lost most of its stickiness, about 1 1/2 hours. Variation, for an attractive presentation, garnish the finished speltters with ginger slices and green onion rings.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,thai red curry paste,garlic paste,alfredo sauce
title: Sauza Pasta (Baked Pasta)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roasted garlic paste | 2 thai red curry paste | 1 1/2 cups alfredo sauce, warmed to boiling | 1 lb rye flour
instructions: Cut four sheets of parchment paper about the size of the sheets.

title: Mexican Pork Medallions
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon minced fresh parsley | 1 navel orange | 10 ounces pork tenderloin | 2 pita breads, cut into pieces
instructions: Preheat broiler. Spray a large griddle with cooking spray. Sprinkle chili powder over tenderloins.

title: Prawn-Prawn Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs prawns, shelled and cleaned | 2 lbs rutabagas, peeled and sliced into medium size chunks | 1/2 cup chopped orange peel | 10 chicken wings, cut in half | 2 -4 teaspoons pepper
instructions: Peel and devein the prawns if desired. Peel and devein the rutabaga and thaw it if frozen. Mix the prawns, rutabaga and orange peel in a large bowl. Coat the chicken wings with pepper. Put the coated chicken wings in the bottom of a heavy kettle and add chicken wings, prawns and water to cover chicken and vegetables. Cover and bring to simmer. Cook until the chicken is cooked through about 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Indian Lumps
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cardamom seed ( not ground ) | 4 teaspoons curry powder, mild | 2 teaspoons icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar )
instructions: Add the cardamom seeds to a pan of boiling water. When soft, remove to a bowl and crush with a mortar and pestle. Add the curry powder to the pan of crushed cardamom seeds and stir until the mixture boils and becomes like a paste. Remove from heat and add the cardamom sugar to the paste. Put in a jar or a flat bowl and keep in a cool place. You may be able to gain this way. The lumps will harden as it ages.

title: Lazy Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 16 marshmallows
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna noodles until tender, about 8 minutes. Drain. Cut a slit in each lasagna noodle and fill with 1 tablespoon of marshmallow meat. Roll each one up and place seam side down in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Repeat with remaining noodles and meat. Sprinkle with additional marshmallows. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and beginning to brown, about 25 minutes.

instructions: Place chicken between two sheets of plastic wrap and using meat mallet, pound chicken with flat side of a cleaver until 1/4 inch thick. In a large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat until it shimmers. Cook chicken just until meat is white in center, and is just beginning to brown. Remove chicken.

title: Tomato, Herb and Anise Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 3 very ripe tomatoes, thinly sliced | 12 -16 large fresh lettuce leaves ( or a bundle of lettuce leaves ) | 1 tablespoon anise seed, roughly crushed ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence
instructions: Lay the lettuce leaves out, and sprinkle with aniseed and herbes de provence or herbes de provence mixed with enough water to cover them if necessary. Place 2 to 3 slices of the tomato on top of the lettuce leaf. On a sturdy work surface, place some of the grated cheese on top of the tomato and sprinkle with aniseed and herbes.

title: Rye Wheat Muffins

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f in a large mixing bowl, mix brown rice, rye flour, red peppers, cardamom, and hazelnuts together with a fork until thoroughly combined. Fill muffin cups about half full, and place on baking sheets with tops hanging over the sides of the muffin tins. Bake in the preheated oven until tops are lightly browned, about 15 minutes.

title: Chrusco Spice Mix

instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f toast the gingersnap cookies and 1 ounce parmigiano over a small pot of simmering water for several minutes, stirring constantly until the cookies are very soft. instructions: Cook peas and carrots in boiling water until tender crisp, about 8 minutes. Drain in colander and immediately squeeze out any excess water. Toss with olive oil, vodka and cheese. Sprinkle with parsley and garlic. Serve.

instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Top sliced rye bread with orange slices. Sprinkle cayenne pepper and additional cayenne pepper on rye bread in skillet. Turn heat up to high and cook 1 - 2 minutes per side or until golden brown serve with yogurt.

ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork tenderloin ( with bone in ) | 3 vegtable stock cubes | 2 tablespoons turmeric | 3 red wine | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 2 2/3 lbs chicken legs in sauce or 2 2/3 lbs chicken legs in thigh or thighs
instructions: Trim excess fat from your tenderloins or ask your butcher to do. Slice as thinly as you need them. Add all the ingredients into the crockpot. title: Grilled Salmon With Sweet Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup half-and-half | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons fresh gingerroot, chopped and divided | 1 firm boneless skinless salmon fillet | 2 tablespoons green onions, sliced | 1 banana pepper, sliced thinly
instructions: Combine vegetable stock, half and half, cream of tartar and 2 teaspoons ginger. Stir. Add salmon and stir. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Remove salmon from refrigerator.

title: Grilled Potatoes for Two
ingredients: 1 baking potato | 1 teaspoon grated lime zest | 1 lime, zested
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Cut a small slice from the side of the potato. Insert a knife into the cut until the knife goes straight through, and remove potato from the peel. Cut the potato into wedges or wedges. Place wedges on a nonstick baking sheet. Place potato wedges on the grill, close lid, and let bake on grill for 5 minutes. Rotate baking sheet so the potato wedges cook evenly. Remove from grill, close lid, and allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Kielbasa and Pepper Rounds
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 4 bell peppers, sliced | 2 cans cherry tomatoes, drained | 4 cups buttermilk biscuit dough | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place kielbasa and bell peppers in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange cherry tomatoes over kielbasa, and top with buttermilk biscuits. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, or until bread is warm.

title: Hreesa Bel Laban, Curried Lamb, Yellow Squash, and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs yellow squash | 2 lbs fresh cucumbers | 12 ounces fresh ginger paste | 12 ounces lamb ( or beef or pork ) | 2 garlic cloves, crushed
instructions: Cut all vegetables into uniform 1 squares, or any type that aren't close together. Place them all in a large bowl and toss with a little oil, salt and pepper. Serve and enjoy. Variation, try substituting green beans in the dish, or substitute brown sugar for the ginger in place of the lamb.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,vanilla yogurt,radish,broccoli,whiskey,balsamic vinegar
title: Brocche
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into florets | 1 cup plain low-fat plain yogurt ( greek or plain ) | 1/2 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla yogurt | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 radish, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Prepare frozen broccoli as directed on package and let cool completely. Strain broccoli. Combine yogurt, balsamic and vanilla and whisk in oil. Pour over broccoli and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Figs With Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh fig | 1/2 lb ham | 3 fluid ounces bottled clam juice | 1/2 cup chopped macadamia nuts | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 3/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Remove stem and lower end of figs if using and discard. Cut figs into quarters. Cut ham into 1/2 inch cubes. In saute pan heat 2 tablespoons of oil over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking. Add figs and ham and saute until figs turn golden brown in color, about 3 minutes. Add clam juice, macadamia nuts and vinegar and bring to a boil, stirring. Reduce heat and simmer until thick. Remove from heat and stir in the brown sugar. Serve immediately. The sauce can be made one day in advance to maintain flavor.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,chili sauce,saltine cracker,pecorino romano cheese,penne,peach,white sugar
title: Peppered Cherry Tomatoes With Crisped Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white sugar | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 package dry penne, cooked and drained | 4 fresh peaches | 2 packages cherry tomatoes | 1 cup freshly shredded pecorino romano cheese, divided | saltine crackers, for serving
instructions: Sprinkle sugar and chili sauce over cooked pasta. Cut peaches lengthwise in half and remove pits. Slice off the top 1/4 of each pepper, lengthwise. Cut each pepper in half crosswise. Arrange pepper halves cut side up on a platter. Sprinkle pecorino over peppers. Spoon reserved juice from tomatoes over peaches. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar and 1/2 tablespoon each of each of the reserved peaches and juice from the tomatoes. Serve the peaches with crackers.

title: Roasted Tomatoes and Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe tomatoes | 3 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: Cut a small slit in each tomato. Spread a generous amount of tomato paste inside each tomato. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Roast tomatoes at 300 degrees for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,garam masala,swiss chard,salt pepper,pea,double cream,cardamom seed,orange zest
title: Swiss Chard With Orange and Peas
ingredients: 4 cups swiss chard, stemmed and shredded | 2/3 cup peas, shelled ( see note below ) | 6 large oranges, zest of, grated coarsely | 1/3 cup orange juice ( not that expensive extra-virgin ) | 8 large egg yolks | 1 pinch salt and pepper, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place chard in a pan of boiling water.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,extra sharp cheddar cheese,white rum,palm sugar
title: Cuban Cheesecake
ingredients: 8 ounces extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup white rum | 1 lb extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon palm sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 325 fahrenheit. Place cheese and rum in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle evenly with 2 extra sharp cheddar and 2 monterey jack cheeses. Combine the 2 remaining cheeses with the sugar, sprinkle evenly over cheese. Place baking dish in a larger baking pan. Fill the larger pan two thirds full with hot water. Bake for 45 minutes. Do not remove a pan from the oven. Leave cheesecake in the oven for 2 minutes. Remove from oven and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,coriander,celery rib,fillet catfish,ricotta,black pepper,buttermilk,red rice noodle
title: Catfish and Rice Noodle Bakes
ingredients: 225 g red rice noodles | 225 g self-raising flour ( all purpose unbleached cane ) | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 2 teaspoons ground black pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh horseradish blend cheese or 1 1/2 teaspoons reduced fat cottage cheese | 4 fillets catfish | 4 celery ribs, roughly chopped | 200 ml buttermilk
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180c. Rinse the rice noodles and bring to the boil in lightly salted water. Add 1/4 of the flour and all of the coriander, black pepper. Stir to combine and cover with a lid. Place in the oven for 25 minutes. In a large bowl, beat together the cheeses. Set aside. Using 3 - 4 tbsps of the flour, mix the other 1 1/2 tbsps flour with 3 tbsptermilk. Using a floured knife, trim off any excess. Place your catfish fillets side by side in the bowl with the flour mixture. Toss this through the flour and milk so it coats each fillet and makes a slightly sticky roll. Place into an oven proof baking dish, cover with parchment paper and bake in the oven for 15minutes. Take the baking dish out, remove paper and leave on the stove top and reduce heat to 150c. Place the steaming noodles under a hot soapy broiler and allow to steam for a minute until soft, but not mushy. Plate up the noodles, cover with the cheese mixture and serve with the steaming noodles.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,poblano chile,baking powder,creme fraiche,orange roughy fillet,graham cracker crumb,salt black pepper
title: Orange Roughy
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 1 teaspoon orange roughy fillet, chopped | 2 poblano chiles, cut into strips | 1/4 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 pinch baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven's broiler and set rack about 6 inches from heat source. Lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Mix graham cracker crumbs, curry powder, and creme fraiche together in a bowl. Spread graham cracker crumbs onto the prepared baking sheet. Broil in the preheated oven until lightly browned and crackers are crisp, about 5 minutes. Flip poblanos over and continue cooking until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Melt black pepper in a small bowl. Season orange roughy fillet with black pepper and salt.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,swiss cheese,cold water,baby spinach leaf,baguette,anchovy
title: Sesame Roasted Swiss Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 8 slices baguette | 12 ounces swiss cheese, 4-oz., sliced on the diagonal | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 24 baby spinach leaves | 8 fresh anchovies, if desired
instructions: In a 12 inch nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of the sesame oil over moderate heat until hot but not smoking, then lay the bread slices in one layer. Top them with the swiss cheese, then top with some of the sun dried tomatoes in a thin layer. Top the cheese with the remaining sesame oil. Sprinkle the spinach over the top and cook over moderately high heat, covered, stirring from time to time, until it wilts, about 2 minutes. When the swiss cheese begins to melt around the edges, transfer it to a paper towel lined rimmed baking sheet to drain. Cut the remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil into thin strips and fry in the remaining sesame oil over moderate heat, stirring, for 1 minute. Add the anchovies. Arrange the sandwiches in a warm serving platter and serve with the sesame carrots.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,broccolini,herb,turmeric powder,lemon juice zest,bean,celery seed
title: Namibian  Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 small broccoli | 1/2 cup snow peas | 1/2 cup beans, soaked in water | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Wash the vegetables, and cut them in small pieces. Prepare the dressing by beating the lemon juice well with the turmeric powder, herbs and chillies. Put the vegetables in a clean container and cover with it. Marinate for a couple of hours at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator. Sprinkle with the celery seed to serve at room temperature, as a garnish.

title: Indonesian Peanut Sauce (Neejol Guisado)
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1 green bell pepper, sliced
instructions: Cut peanuts into pieces roughly 2 to 3 inches in size. Place in a small bowl and cover with cold water. Let sit for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse peanuts. Place peanuts directly on a rack and dry in a 250f oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and place in a heat resistant bowl or dish and cover with a towel. Let sit for 15 minutes. Uncover the bowl/pan and shake off any extra dry peanuts and place a large pan over medium high heat. Add oil to the pan and heat until it is smoking. Add green pepper slices and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring often. Remove pan from heat and serve immediately.

title: Clam Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb barley | 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa | 1 can red beans | 6 belgian endive | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 4 medium potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1/4 cup shallot, chopped ( use shallots for soup )
instructions: Soak the barley and beans overnight. Put the barley and beans in large pot and boil. Add the kielbasa and endive. Add the turmeric and continue to boil until tender. Add potatoes and simmer 5 minutes. Add chopped shallots for more flavor.

title: Homemade Polish Sausage
ingredients: 3 carrots | 1 pound ground pork
instructions: Rinse the carrot with cold water. Cut the carrots lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Spread the carrots in a bowl. Sprinkle the pork onto the carrots, and mix thoroughly with seasonings. Add some salt and black pepper to taste. Let sit in the refrigerator for a few hours to let flavors blend. The longer it stands, the better.

title: Randy's Awesome Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato juice | 1 can sweet relish | 4 jars lemonade concentrate, chilled | 4 1/2 cups superfine sugar | 8 cardamom seeds, crushed | 8 allspice
instructions: Combine tomato juice, sweet relish, lemonade concentrate, cardamom seeds, and ground allspice in a large saucepan. Stir in sugar over medium heat.

title: Beer Cream Corn on the Cob (Beer Can)
ingredients: 2 cans cream-style sweet corn | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup budweiser beer
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan and stir over medium heat until mixed. Cook and stir until the barbeque is thickened and the barley is heated through, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,thai red curry paste,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pork tenderloin,sugar substitute,lime yogurt,rye bread,parsley leaf
title: Thai Pork Cutlets
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean pork tenderloin | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 2 tablespoons fresh lime yogurt | 2 tablespoons fresh goat fat ( or 1/2 t of ghee or 1/2 t vegetable oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon sugar substitute or 1/2 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 1/4 cup tomato sauce ( optional ) | breadcrumbs ( optional )
instructions: Combine minced pork, parsley leaves, thai red curry paste, and lime yogurt. Shape into 12 patties and press with fingers to flatten slightly. Whip fat or ghee until stiff, add spice mixture, and spoon over tenderloins. Serve over bread crumbs if desired.

title: Couscous Kugel
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 1 1/2 cups whole canola oil | 2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, stemmed and coarsely chopped, divided | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place couscous and canola oil in a large dutch oven or similar small saucepan. Add yeast and 1/2 cup of chopped cilantro and let sit until yeast softens and begins to foam, 5 minutes. Bring to boiling, stirring until water is absorbed. Remove from heat and let cool until just warm to the touch but still liquid. Transfer 2 cups of couscous to a large bowl and stir in the cherry tomatoes. Let sit for 5 minutes to absorb liquid. Mold tomato mixture into a disc shape and transfer to a large, round serving dish.

Random Ingredients: process cheese sauce,shell pasta,poblano chile,buckwheat flour,vanilla pudding mix,italian parsley,lamb,cheddar cheese
title: Mama's Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb, cubed ( leg and shoulder works best ) | 1/8 cup buckwheat flour | 1 packet instant vanilla pudding mix ( pudding flavour ) | 1 bottle process cheese sauce ( thick ) | 16 -16 ounces canned poblano chiles | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley | 1/8 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 2 cups shell pasta
instructions: Cube lamb, and set aside 1/3 of the cooked meat. Brown lamb in a heavy skillet, adding 2/3 of the buckwheat flour in a small amount of oil. While browning the lamb add the packet of pasticano powder. Stir until well incorporated and then add the can of pudding and stir until well mixed. When mixture is well mixed pour into greased casserole dish. Pour the cheese sauce in a large bowl while mixing well, then add remaining 1/3 of buckwheat flour in the other bowl. When well mixed pour this mixture over the lamb mixture in the casserole dish. Dot the top with the remaining cheese sauce, and then add the chilies and parsley. You may want to sprinkle more cheddar cheese. Bake in a preheated 350°f oven for 1 hour, until top is golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,romaine lettuce,salsa,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Pork and Cheese Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 cup salsa | 2 slices colby-monterey jack cheese, cut in half | 1/4 cup shredded romaine lettuce | 1/4 pound boneless pork loin, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat salsa in a small saucepan over medium, until heated through. Place a lettuce leaf on the plate, then add a slice of pork. Spoon some salsa over, then fold in half and continue wrapping the edge of the roll with the lettuce leaf. Repeat with remaining slices.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,arborio rice,meat,thyme,rye bread,lime zest,liquid honey
title: Baked Risotto With a Honey-Lime Glaze
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 1 cup arborio rice | 500 g stew meat or 500 g lean ground turkey | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 500 g swiss cheese or 1 cup emmenthaler cheese, shredded | 6 slices thin rye bread | 1 zest from 1 lemon
instructions: Preheat oven to 180. Place honey in a saucepan and heat until it begins to bubble, then remove from heat and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to boil and then cook rice al dente. Drain all excess liquid and set aside. In a large ovenproof dish, add all remaining ingredients and blend thoroughly. Spoon rice into the dish and place in oven. Allow the dish to warm through. Turn the oven off. Garnish with sesame seeds and cilantro sprigs.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,marsala wine,lemon juice,yellow pepper,wide egg noodle,pizza sauce
title: Saucy Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 2/3 cup fresh lemon juice | 1 jar pizza sauce | 1 jar sliced pimientos | 1 jar yellow sweet peppers, drained | 1 jar sliced pimiento, drained | 1 jar fresh marsala wine | 8 ounces medium wide egg noodles
instructions: Prepare grill. Combine lemon juice, 2/3 cup pizza sauce, pimientos, yellow and sweet peppers, pimento stuffed olives, marsala wine and remaining 1/3 cup pizza sauce in a large resealable plastic bag. Cover and chill, away from direct sunlight, for at least 1 hour, or overnight. Thread beef onto metal skewers. Cook under preheated grill until browned, 10 to 12 minutes, basting with remaining 1/4 cup pizza sauce. Serve sprinkled with additional pepper, if desired.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,bean sprout,lemon pepper,monterey jack cheese,pesto sauce,salt pepper,white sesame seed,black bean
title: Creamy White Seitan Salad or Pan-Fried Black Bean Hummus
ingredients: 1 can refried beans with chilies | 2 cans black beans | 1/2 cup white sesame seeds | 2 bunches watermelon, cubed ( about 1 pound ) | 1/3 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | salt and pepper to taste | lemon pepper for topping ( optional )
instructions: Stir the beans with the chilies in a bowl. Set aside. Combine the sesame seeds with 1 tablespoon water in a small saucepan over low heat until very fragrant, about 3 minutes. Place the remaining watermelon in a colander and press with a rice stick to dry the seeds. Set aside. Sprinkle the black beans lightly with salt and pepper and set aside. Heat the olive oil in a skillet or medium pan. Add the sesame seeds and watermelon and cook over medium heat until the watermelon is very tender, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove the sesame seeds from the pan, drain on paper towels, and set aside. In a large bowl, toss the bean mixture with hot cooked sesame bean mixture, pesto, cheese, remaining sesame seeds, salt and pepper. Serve immediately, or let cool completely before refrigerating. Garnish with lemon and black pepper.

title: Easy Tofu & Apple Mole
ingredients: 1/2 white onion, finely chopped | 4 ounces firm tofu, drained and cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 tablespoons white dried apples | 1/2 cup chocolate morsel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. In a large bowl toss the onion, tofu and herbs, then mix well. In a small saucepan melt the chocolate morsel over medium heat. Stir continuously until the chocolate is melted and combined, be careful the chocolate does not burn. Pour the melted chocolate evenly over the tofu mixture. Bake for 30 minutes or until the chocolate is bubbly. Cut into pieces when cooled.

title: Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 1/4 cup balsamic vinaigrette dressing | 10 flour tortillas | 4 loaves french bread or 4 loaves french bread
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the vinegar and let sit for 10 minutes. Put the bread in a large container with the 1/4 cup of dressing and the rest of the ingredients. Dip and coat the loaves in the liquid and leave on the counter for 60 minutes. Bake in a hot oven 10 minutes.

title: Cashews With Ananas
ingredients: 2 ounces alder chilies, seeded | 3 ounces cashews | grated nutmeg
instructions: Place the cashews in a bowl with the ananas and knead well until they form a rough paste. Sprinkle with a little nutmeg and mix well.

Random Ingredients: dough,beef rump roast,half cream,icing sugar,snow pea
title: Snow Peas With Beef Rind
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless beef rump roast | 6 ounces snow peas, trimmed, strings removed | 1 cup icing sugar | 1/2 cup whipping cream or 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 -2 teaspoon cornstarch dissolved in a bit of cold water
instructions: Cut rind off of roast. Tie strings around outside of roast if desired. Bring pot of water to a boil, lower heat and maintain over low heat. Meanwhile season roast with salt, pepper and a little bit of chopped snowpear juice. Bring water back to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover and simmer until meat is tender, about 2 hours. Set meat aside and skim off any remaining foam, about 2 or 3 tablespoons of clear broth. Turn pot off heat and reserve broth in a container. To make rosettes, put 1 cup of the reserved broth into a saucepan, add the cream, snow peas and a little bit of cornstarch dissolved in water. Cook in pan over medium high heat until cream thickens slightly and snow peas are crisp tender, about 2 or 3 minutes. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary. Remove from heat and stir in reserved broth until well blended. Slice beef across very thin slices. Arrange the beef on a plate, sprinkle with icing sugar and drizzle with remaining coconut flavoured broth. Serve.

title: Sally's Pisteli Parsnips
ingredients: 3 parsnips, peeled and coarsely chopped | 50 ml sherry or 50 ml balsamic vinegar | 3 teaspoons coriander seeds | plain flour | 1 cup cake flour | 30 g chopped fresh cilantro stems | handful chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c, 400f or gas wash and peel the parsnips, then place in a saucepan with the vinegar and coriander seeds. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally until the parsnips are just tender and well softened. Allow to cool at room temperature. Sift the flour, cake flour and cilantro into a large bowl with the mint. Mix well before adding the parsnips. Add enough of the liquid to make a soft sticky dough. Press the mixture into greased miniature muffin tins or patty cases or muffin pans. Bake for 25 - 35 minutes or until golden around the edges and firm in the centre.

title: Ham and Swiss Pie (Diabetic)
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour ( all-purpose ) | 2/3 cup cool whip, slightly chilled | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/3 cup ham, cooked and diced | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Heat oven to 425° f. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. In bowl, combine flour and cool whip and stir until well blended. Stir in basil, sage and ham. In separate bowl, whip cream until stiff. Fold cream into flour mixture. Spread filling into 9 inch circle on baking sheet. Top with cheese. Bake 17 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Beef and Pear Stew
ingredients: 1 package dried pears - peeled, cored, and chopped | 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 can cut green beans, drained and rinsed | 1 orange, zest of
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, add the pears, meat, and green beans. Sprinkle with orange zest. Pour in enough water to cover the meat and vegetables. Cover tightly and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until the meat is very tender, about 3 hours.

title: Artichoke Peppers
ingredients: 20 small green pepper ( about 1. 5 pounds ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 3 cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crockpot, and stir to coat. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Avocado and Mint Salad
ingredients: 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and cubed | 1 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 plum, quartered, or more to taste
instructions: Place avocado and mint into a salad bowl. Garnish with plum pieces to serve.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,yogurt,white wine vinegar,self raising flour,cottage cheese,macadamia nut,rosemary leaf
title: Smoky Macadamia Biscuits - Gluten Free!
ingredients: 1 cup natural-raising flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/3 cup skim cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon whole raw cashew nuts | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 1/3 cup low-fat yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 deg c. Place the flour, baking powder, cottage cheese, cashew nuts, vinegar, rosemary and soy in a small bowl. Gently knead the dough until it forms a smooth, slightly sticky dough. Place on a lightly floured board. Roll out the dough to about ¼ inch thick. Using a 2 1/2 inch round cookie cutter, cut out rounds with a 4 inch biscuit cutter, or use a teaspoon for sprinkling top of a biscuit while baking. Place on a plate, cover with clingfilm and allow to rest in a warm place for 10 minutes. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Using a 2½ inch round biscuit cutter, cut out circles from the risen dough. Transfer biscuits to the prepared trays. Place 1 1/2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture in the middle of each biscuit. Roll biscuits over and seal by pressing edges with your fingers. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the biscuits are golden and a small amount of the cheese mixture has set. Allow biscuits to rest on the tray for 5 to 10 minutes before eating, or for longer cooking time, refrigerating completely.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,tomato paste,almond,plain flour,summer squash,watercress leaf,red cabbage
title: Spinach and Squash Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 small winter squash, halved cut into 1cm chunks | 1 small red cabbage, halved cored and thinly sliced | 150 g bean sprouts | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 2 teaspoons plain flour | 2 tablespoons watercress leaves ( optional ) | 1/4 cup raw almonds, roughly chopped
instructions: Spray a large bowl with cooking oil spray. Place first 4 ingredients in the bowl, add tomato paste and flour, toss, then divide between 4 serving bowls. Heat about 200ml water in a saucepan over a medium high temperature, bring to the boil, pour over vegetables and stir. Top with almonds, serve.

title: Cheesy Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 4 cups mexican blend cheese ( cheddar or monterey jack ) | 1 cup flour | 4 tablespoons cake flour | 1 can corn oil | 2 jalapeno peppers | 12 ounces penne ( or other tubular pasta ), cooked
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a batter, batter should be a bit lumpy. Dip the pasta into the sauce until coated. Melt the corn oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the pasta until all the sauce is gone and the pasta is al dente about 4 minutes per side, depending on the shape of the pasta. Drain the pasta and sauce well. Serve immediately.

title: Corn and Anchovy Spread
ingredients: 1 package frozen corn kernels | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste, or to taste
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Squeeze kernels from the corn kernels to remove excess moisture and salt. Arrange on prepared baking sheet. Scatter anchovy paste over the corn. Cook in the preheated grill until the dip is hot and bubbling, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,chicken cutlet,baking potato,iceberg lettuce
title: Chinese Chicken Cutlets & Chips (Szechwan Style)
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled | 1 head iceberg lettuce, rinsed | 4 medium red chili peppers ( i like jalapenos ) | 2 -3 lbs cutlets, thin | 1 1/2 liters chilled bottled chinese pickle juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Cut potatoes into long 2-inch by � inch wide strips. Put into a large bowl and cover with cold water by 2 inches.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,chili sauce,baking powder,red wine,kosher salt black pepper,garam masala powder
title: Indian Beef Roast
ingredients: 8 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 3/4 cup chili sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 2 teaspoons kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/3 cup baking powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f in a small bowl, combine 1/2 cup of the chili sauce with the remaining 1/4 cup of the chili sauce, the masala, and the wine. Rub both sides of the roast with the salt and pepper. Spray a roasting pan with cooking spray and place the roast on it. Mix the baking powder with the remaining 1/2 cup of the chili sauce and pour over the roast. Bake uncovered for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is fork tender. Remove from the oven and let stand for 15 minutes. Transfer the roast to a cutting board and cut into 1/4 slices. Serve the remaining sauce separately on the side.

title: Chunky Spinach
ingredients: 3 cups baby spinach | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Wash spinach thoroughly, then set aside. Melt the cocoa and buttermilk in a pan over low heat, stirring frequently. When mixture is warm, stir into spinach along with remaining ingredients. Serve warm.

title: Catalina Potato Salad
ingredients: 5 lbs small red potatoes, scrubbed and sliced | 1 cup catalina dressing ( or more to taste ) | 3/4 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped
instructions: Place potatoes and catalina dressing in a large, microwave safe bowl & microwave on high heat, uncovered, 1 1/2 minutes or until potatoes are heated through, stirring occasionally. Add basil & stir. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Note, the catalina dressing will also give the dish a nice crusty look, but will make your salad taste even better after chilling for up to 1 hour and a half.

title: Green Beans in a Muffin Bag
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, trimmed & cut crosswise into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup superfine sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine all ingredients in bag, and shake to mix. Insert a skewer or other decorative handle into each bag. Bake for 10 minutes at 425 degrees f, or until the sugar has turned a shade below the beans. Remove from the oven, cool, and enjoy note, cooking time is the process of making your own puff pastry.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,meat,canola oil,head cauliflower,red pepper flake
title: Cauliflower and Ground Beef "pasta"
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, thick and thin | 1 1/2 lbs ground meat ( leaner ground beef may also use ground turkey or shrimp ) | 1/4 cup minced onion flakes | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( to taste )
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a steamer basket and cover with 3 inches of water. Heat the steamer over medium high heat, in the preheated oven until just barely bubbling. Turn the cauliflower frequently and stir as it steams. Meanwhile, combine the meat, onion flakes and red pepper in a large skillet over medium high heat. Brown the beef well and drain off fat. Stir in the cauliflower and cook for about 3 minutes or until it is hot. Spoon the meat into a large serving bowl and set aside. Stir the onion mixture into the meat mixture. Sprinkle with salt and/or pepper. Mix well. Garnish with parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,corn tortilla chip,ham,corn,adobo seasoning,chinese wine
title: Ham and Corn Nachos (Pampered Chef Copycat)
ingredients: 4 -6 corn tortillas or 4 -6 corn chips | adobo seasoning ( or substitute equivalent cumin ) | 1/4 cup chinese wine | 4 slices cooked ham | 1 3/4 cups of shredded mexican cheese | 1 cup of cubed corn
instructions: Boil ham, corn, and cheese for approximately 5 minutes. Mix corn with ham mixture. Remove from heat and mix in seasoning. Sprinkle on chips and serve with salsa and sour creme as desired.

title: Stacked Italian Tortilla Appetizers.
ingredients: 4 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 2 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded or 2 ounces monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup amaretto ( i like almond flavored liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1 medium sandwich size sourdough tortilla, cut in half | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano | prepared prepared mix | water ( optional ) | fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: Prepare your sandwich by splitting the sides of the tortilla with your fingers. Place the sliced side down into a greased 15x10 baking pan. Sprinkle the cheeses evenly over the tortilla. In a small bowl, combine the amaretto, basil and oregano. Spread over cheese. Sprinkle the top of the cheese with the mozzarella cheese. Dot the top with the sourdough tops. Sprinkle basil over all. Bake at 350 for 30 to 40 minutes or until warmed through. Wrap up well. Garnish with fresh basil if desired, if desired.

title: Kalops (Veal in molasses) (Luby Baster)
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cut in 1-inch cubes | cooking oil | 1 green or white cabbage, shredded | 1 large red cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Add the veal and brown on all sides. Spread the cabbage shreds over the meat. Pour molasses over all. Cover with a lid and steam over low heat for about 30 minutes.

title: Champignon Fondue
ingredients: 1 jar champignon mushrooms, drained and sliced | 1/3 cup clam juice | 1/4 cup vinaigrette ( to taste )
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine champignon mushrooms and clam juice. Simmer until the liquid has reduced, about 5 minutes. Stir in vinaigrette. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Enogholen Dumplings
ingredients: 4 cups self rising flour | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Mix flour and chili oil. Add the mixture back to the flour, knead and work your way into a ball. Roll out, cut out 10 cm circles using a biscuit cutter or a glass. Put a spoonful of tea in the centre of each circle. Add water if you need it. Cook in a hot oven or on the stove top. Serve.

title: Squash & Caramelized Onions in Locatelli Cheese
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 1 tablespoon locatelli cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla pod
instructions: Peel the squash and cut into 1/2 inch chunks. Combine the squash and cheese in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is creamy. Add the vanilla pod. Cook a few moments longer.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,italian bread,pork rib,chili pepper,salmon,buttermilk,mexican chili powder,cider vinegar
title: Cubans Spiced BBQ Pork rib Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs country-style pork ribs ( cut into 3 pieces ) | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon mexican chili powder | 1 tablespoon mexican chili powder | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup italian bread, cubed | 2 teaspoons salt
instructions: For barbecue pork cut in half and then crosswise in 1/2 inch thick pieces. In large bowl combine vinegar, 1 tablespoons chili powder, coriander and mexican chili powders mixing well. Add ribs and turning only once to coat. Let stand at least 12 hours in fridge. Prepare grill or broiler. Remove ribs from marinade and discard marinade. Grill ribs in hot coals about 15 minutes, turning once, or bake at 375°f for 15 minutes or until meat is fork tender. Let cool. Cool ribs completely. To make dressing combine yogurt and remaining 2 tablespoons chili powder. Drizzle over ribs and toss gently to coat. Refrigerate for several hours before serving. Arrange salad on 4 plates, pour reserved marinade over top.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,enchilada sauce,dark rum,whipping cream,rice vinegar,cornmeal
title: Tex-Mex Rum Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal, plus extra | cornmeal | 2 cups chicken bouillon granules | 12 ounces dark rum | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/3 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Spray a 13 x 9 inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Over medium high heat melt cornmeal. Stir till cornmeal is browned in small grains and mixture is bubbly. About 1 minute. Do this while stirring. Immediately remove from heat. Stir in the bouillon and rum till liquid dissolves. Cool while preparing the filling. Pour filling into a large ziplock bag and refrigerate for 1 hour or till firm and warm. While filling is chilling, combine cream, vinegar and 1/2 c water in a small saucepan and on medium low heat cook till bubbles begin to form and reduce to a light syrup consistency. Immediately dip 2 chilled corn tortillas into sauce and place in a baking dish evenly. Pour hot filling over tortillas and bake at 400°f till enchiladas are warm throughout.

title: Tori No Rikyu
ingredients: 1 ounce dried enoki mushrooms | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 3 teaspoons finely chopped pimiento
instructions: Soak mushrooms in lukewarm water until softened, 15 minutes. Drain well and chop fine. Beat whipping cream with pimientos until stiff. Fold the mushrooms, cream, and salt and pepper into the mixture. Place at once on a serving plate and refrigerate 1 - 2 hours until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: ham hock,chipotle chile powder,comte cheese,chicken bouillon cube
title: Mexican Queso
ingredients: 3 lbs ham hocks | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons chipotle chile powder | 1/2 lb comte cheese or 1/2 lb queso fresco
instructions: Wrap ham shank in a double layer of foil. Pierce the ham with a fork several times. Arrange ham shank in single layer on hot rack of grill or broiler pan. Sprinkle with bouillon cube. Grill ham until brown and dry about 15 minutes and turn. Continue to cook until lightly brown on all sides and cooked through. Sprinkle with chile powder. Transfer ham to a cutting board and cover with foil. Let sit away from direct heat for about 20 minutes. Strain cheese into a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,cannellini bean,feta cheese,white flour,chive,red tomato,sirloin,provolone cheese
title: Italian Four-Bean Burgers With Feta
ingredients: 1 cup cooked cannellini beans | 1 -2 cup cooked crumbled sirloin ( or other lean meat ) | 4 slices provolone cheese | 1 container crumbled feta cheese | 2 -4 red ripe tomatoes, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fresh basil or 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh thyme, to taste | 1/4 cup minced fresh chives or 1/4 cup chopped green onion | 1 package prepared white flour | 2 -4 fresh small whole tomatoes | 1 can baked beans with chili, drained & rinsed
instructions: Drain and rinse beans, allow to dry thoroughly. Pat off any excess moisture. Place beans in a large serving bowl, add sirloin or other lean meat, provolone cheese and feta cheese. Toss lightly, then spread evenly over the bean mixture. Sprinkle tomatoes over meat. Sprinkle with basil and thyme. Spread the remaining mixture evenly over the tomatoes and top with the crushed whole green tomatoes. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Invert bread/crust onto a plate. Using a slotted spoon, remove any excess beans from the bean mixture. Preheat grill, panini grill, or pizza grill. Grill bread/crusts until the crumbs are lightly toasted, turning to toast evenly. Place on grill/panini grill or grill panini grill basket for about 3 - 5 minutes on each side to heat through. Cut in half and serve on a toasted bun with tomato side with sour cream, salsa, or lettuce.

title: Chilled Moroccan Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces pure maraschino cherry juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Combine the cherry juice, turmeric, and maraschino cherries in a blender.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,mozzarella cheese,espresso powder,steak,red chili pepper,prosciutto,vegetable oil
title: Italian Vienna Beef Roll-Em-Mu
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, sliced thin on the grain | 1/8 cup espresso powder | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder, divided | 1 medium-large red chili pepper, chopped fine | 16 slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and stir well. Brush both sides of all beef with espresso and spice mixture. Wrap each with cheese and secure with a toothpick. Heat a heavy skillet with a drop of vegetable oil. Add beef rolls and cook for 5 minutes per side or until desired doneness. If pan starts to smoke, remove. Cover loosely with foil to keep warm and serve with a green salad.

title: Hot Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1/2 cup napa cabbage, finely chopped | 1/3 cup pitted green olives, chopped | 1 teaspoon liquid honey
instructions: Melt the bacon drippings in a small skillet over medium low heat. Add in cabbage and olives and stir fry for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in a few drops of water if the cabbage browns too quickly. Garnish with honey and serve.

title: Stuffed Ham Hocks
ingredients: 6 lbs well trimmed ham hocks | 2 cups rice, medium grain is best ( short ) or ( 5 ounce ) | 2 cups ice water ( approximately ) | 1/4 cup poppy seeds | 2 2 tablespoons sesame oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil, can be used for stir-frying
instructions: Place hocks in saucepan and cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 4 hours or until the ham is falling off the bone. Strain the liquid from the ham and discard. Trim and discard the ham hocks, then discard the hock's inner thigh bone and neck cavity. Make slits in the hamhocks with a sharp knife in each ham half. Reserve the strained liquid and neck bones for serving. Rinse the ham with cold water and drain. Return the ham, skin side down, to the saucepan and add enough reserved liquid to make 3 1/2 cups of liquid. Simmer over low heat, covered, until the ham has the thickness of a very thick mayonnaise, 1 1/2 to 2 hours. When the ham is cool enough to handle, remove the neck and cut off the thin membrane in the center. Make the rice and set aside in a serving bowl filled with warm water to prevent browning. Drain the rice in a colander for 10 minutes, then shake and toss the rice to remove excess water. Spread rice on large platter and arrange the hamhocks on top. Using a slotted spoon, spread the poppy seeds over the cooked ham and rice. Drain the reserved broth and serve it separately.

title: Quinoa and Mango Chili (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 cup dry quinoa | 1 1/3 cups mango nectar | 2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 dash cocoa powder | 1 cup diced yellow squash | 1 cup cranberries ( optional )
instructions: Cook quinoa according to instructions. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Enjoy.

title: Chipotle's Asiago Pears Poached on Garlic
ingredients: 2 fresh pears, cored, cored, and sliced in half lengthwise | 4 tablespoons freshly grated asiago cheese | 1 tablespoon freshly grated asiago cheese | 2 large whole large fresh anaheim chile peppers, seeded
instructions: Peel pear halves, and cut each half into thirds. In a large saucepan with a tight fitting lid, add asiago cheese, asiago cheese, and whole chile peppers. Cover, and cook over moderate heat until cheese is melted and the sauce begins to thicken slightly, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cumin,pecorino cheese,tomato sauce,mustard seed,turmeric,port wine,sun tomato oil,nonfat milk
title: Spicy Tomato Baked Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 cup nonfat milk ( or soy ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, crushed or 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 3/4 cup port wine ( or viva madrid spanish chardonnay ) | 1 2/3 cups shredded pecorino cheese | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, finely snipped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place tomato sauce, milk, mustard seeds in a blender.

title: Brown Rice With Brown Beans (Yoshinoya)
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice | 1 1/2 cups white rice
instructions: Place the rice, brown beans and butter in a saucepan and bake in 450 degree oven until the rice browns and beans are tender, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Sausage Stuff
ingredients: 2 packages butter flavored cookies ( any flavor ) | 1 lb turkey, cut up ( or poultry )
instructions: On a floured board roll out two or three thin sheets of reynolds wrap foil. Place one cookie on each sheet and top with meat. Roll up tightly jelly roll fashion and fasten to foil. Repeat. Pour about 1 - 2 tbs of melted butter or margarine over the sausage. Bake at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes. These freeze well and can be reheated and leftovers the next day or place in freezer up to 3 months. One of my daughters likes them toasted so we have them sliced and served on bread.

title: Barley Coriander Barley Tea Blend
ingredients: 450 g barley ( i have deliberately not measured, but have deliberately used organic barley, and added 200 ml of water ) | 1/4 cup coriander ( i like a mix ) | 1/4 cup soy sauce ( i used light ) | 1 teaspoon frangelico
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and store in a sealed jar with a good lid. Use as required for tea, salad, savoury snacks, etc.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 cups soymilk, chilled | 1/4 cup peanut | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds, roasted ( or to taste ) | 3 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings
instructions: In a small bowl mix the soy milk with the peanut, poppy seeds, and lemon juice. Stir in the chicken wings to coat thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving or up to two hours before serving as desired.

title: Baked Mexican Watermelon Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package of thinly sliced watermelon | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 medium lettuce leaf
instructions: Place watermelon in a large bowl. Sprinkle cheese and garlic powder all over the top of the watermelon. Microwave for 3 to 4 minutes until cheese is melted and watermelon is pliable. Place lettuce on a serving board. Place sandwich on top of lettuce. Cut diagonally into 4 pieces.

title: Bamboo Shwarma (Korean Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza crust | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 package wonton wrappers | pineapple juice or water
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Slice the pizza crust into four wedges, and place on cookie sheet. Mix the bread crumbs, buttermilk, sugar and a pinch of salt and pepper. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange the triangles on a baking sheet in a single layer. Bake 12 - 14 minutes, or until crisp but not browned. Remove from the oven, and immediately take out of the oven and set aside. When the crust is done, place on a cutting board and using a metal spatula spread it onto a baking sheet. Top with a square of the pizza crust. Pour pineapple or water into the baking sheet, just enough to moisten the edges of the crust, and then drizzle the crust with a little more water. Place a triangle of fried dough on top, press with a flat, thin spatula or your fingers to flatten it. Slide onto top of the pizza crust, and then drizzle with more pineapple/tomato mixture. Sprinkle with a little more sugar if desired, and cut in quarters to serve.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,dark brown sugar,beef flavor ramen noodle,strawberry,sirloin steak,cashew,red bean
title: Beef and Cashew Noodles With Strawberry and Caramelised Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 beef-flavor ramen noodles ( without flavor packet ) | 12 slices sirloin steaks ( thinly sliced ) | 12 -16 strawberries ( sliced ) | 1 cup fresh shaved spinach | 1/4 cup cashews | 1/2 cup natural yoghurt ( or greek yogurt, to coat the meat )
instructions: Pour boiling water over the ramen noodle packets, and add a pinch of sugar to heat the water. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add meat and cook for 1 minute per side. Remove meat with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add 1 tablespoon of cooking oil to the pan, and swirl to coat. Slice one third of the strawberries and arrange on the skillet. Spoon the beef over the mushrooms and add any remaining toppings you want, such as fresh strawberries, pine nuts, honey or any other topping you like. Cook for 3 minutes or until the cheese has melted.

title: Chinese Style Grilled Chicken Recipe
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb chicken, thawed if frozen | 4 slices bacon, julienned | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Arrange chicken on lightly greased grill rack. Spray with cooking spray.

title: Shredded Strawberry Buckwheat Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried pinto beans | 1 small cucumber - peeled, seeded, and diced | 8 ounces strawberries or 8 ounces other berries, drained | 1/4 cup chopped parsley | 1 small chicken stock cubes or 1 small can pinto beans | 1 carton canned low-sodium broth
instructions: Combine beans, cucumber, strawberries and parsley in a dutch oven. Cover and cook over low heat until veggies are tender, about 45 minutes. Puree soup in blender or food processor. Reheat, if you want a thicker soup.

title: The Simplest German Salad Dressing
ingredients: 4 cups ice water or 4 cups cold water | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar ( or to taste )
instructions: Add the water and vinegar and mix well. Taste for sweetness and adjust to your desired sweetness.

Random Ingredients: baby portabella mushroom,chili pepper flake,green chili pepper
title: Baby Onions Confit Saute
ingredients: 4 heads baby portabella mushrooms, cleaned, ends trimmed | 1/2 cup chili pepper, chopped, with seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes, crumbled ( optional )
instructions: Remove the stems from the mushrooms if you want to use a separate mushroom for later use. Remove the stem and coarsely chop the mushroom tops. Using a paring knife or very sharp knife, core the tops and remove any tough outer layer attached to the caps if using larger pieces of mushrooms. Slice the caps thin, using a knife so that the caps have a thinner slice going in the center, and slice the strips crosswise into 1/4 inch strips. Reserve any remaining pieces of the mushroom. In a large bowl, mix the fresh chile pepper, chile flakes and the finely chopped mushrooms. Toss so that all of the vegetables are evenly coated. Heat the skillet over medium high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, or until hot. Add a tablespoon of oil and saute the marinated mushrooms until they begin to lightly brown in color. Be careful not to overcook or they will be tough. Serve the mushrooms hot, warm or at room temperature.

title: French Canadian Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: 20 ounces cherry brandy | 2 1/2 fluid ounces catsup | garlic powder
instructions: In a small saucepan stir together the cherry brandy, catsup and garlic powder. Heat until hot. Pour into a small bowl. Note, this recipe is not exact, just about combining the ingredients.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,pastry,red wine,chicken broth,blue cheese,arborio rice
title: Spicy Risotto With Blue Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups hot green chili peppers | 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1/4 cup chicken broth, warmed to boiling | 1 cup red wine or 1 cup vermouth | 2 tablespoons blue cheese, shredded | 2 cans ready-made pastry shells ( recommended ( pane toscano )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange chiles on a microwave safe plate and microwave 1 minute, or until chiles are softened. Transfer chiles to a small bowl. Microwave rice, broth, wine and chiles in 2 quart saucepan over medium heat until broth and wine is absorbed, about 1 minute. Stir in chiles and rice and heat just until warm. Spread 3 tablespoons rice with 1 teaspoon blue cheese in a pie plate. Place remaining 3 tablespoons rice on another pie plate. Microwave pastry shell on high 1 minute, or just until it begins to brown.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,plain flour,yukon gold potato,bacon grease,cream chicken soup,ham,lentil,tomato puree
title: Lentil and Bacon Casserole
ingredients: 8 medium yukon gold potatoes, peeled, cut into chunks | 3 tablespoons bacon grease | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 420 g cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 400 g chopped ham | 420 g diced tomatoes in tomato puree | cayenne, to taste ( optional ) | 1/4 cup light sour cream or 1/4 cup thickened cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 225c or 200°c. Melt bacon grease in a non stick frying pan over medium heat, add potatoes and cook gently stirring until tender. Turn off the heat and add flour.

Random Ingredients: oregano,oriental sesame oil,allspice,vegetable oil cooking spray,cardamom,oil
title: Chinese Hot Rub for Pork and Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon dry oregano | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod, crushed | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium high heat. Add cardamom, oregano, allspice, cardamom and dry spice. Mix well. Add pork and cook for 2 minutes or until done. Spray pan with no stick spray and rub rub oil mixture on chops. Serve either hot or at room temperature.

title: Spicy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 4 chilies | 2 cups maraschino cherries
instructions: Grill or broil chilies. Use the chilie or the pepper as a rub. Store in an airtight container up to 3 days.

title: Oaty Mushroom and Watermelon Filling With Meat and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup quick cooking oats | 4 cups button mushrooms, thickly sliced | 3/4 cup watermelon, diced into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup cooked lean lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients with the exception of the rolled oats in a bowl and fold until well combined. Form into 1 1/2 inch diameter balls and refrigerate for at least 8 hours and up to 1 day before use. Store refrigerated.

title: Poblano Chips
ingredients: 2 poblano peppers | 2 tablespoons chili paste
instructions: Peel the poblano chilies, and chop them into thin strips. Place the chiles on a baking sheet, and use the side of a spoon to mash them slightly to help keep smooth and uniform color. Sprinkle the peppers evenly with chili paste, and bake at 350 degrees f.  until dry, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sugar syrup,cornish hen,green peppercorn,cream tartar,snow pea,genoa salami,beef steak
title: Beef, Cornish Game Hens in Tangy Peppercorn Sauce
ingredients: 2 cornish hens | 2 beef steaks | 2 tablespoons green peppercorns | 1 tablespoon green peppercorn | 8 -12 sheets sesame seed ( approximate ) | 1/3 cup cream of tartar | 1 package genoa salami | 8 -10 ounces snow peas
instructions: Rinse hens inside and out under cold water and dry with paper towels. Place 1 sheet of sesame seeds in a shallow pan and set aside in the oven. Place a second sheet of sesame seeds in a third sheet of sesame seeds and set aside in the oven. Turn off the oven, remove the hens and drain off all but 1 tablespoon of fat from the pan. Rinse hisns then dry on paper towels. Coat each game hen inside and out with sesame seeds and the sliced steak. Slice the salami strips into 8 or 10 pieces and then in to bite size pieces. Place the salami and mozzarella pieces among the game hens, leaving a small empty space between the meat slices and the meat edge. Top with 3 peanut butter packets and place another chicken breast on top of the salami and mozzarella. Top with a thin layer of green peppercorns. Place the green peppercorns, green peppercorns, snow peas, and 1/3 to 1/2 of the peanut butter packets into a shallow pan and heat over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until a light film appears on the bottom and sides of the pan. Place one hen on top of the mozzarella and then turn the chicken over. Heat a heavy pan over medium heat and brown the outside of the game hens on each side until golden brown.

title: Caramelized Red Pepper Crisp
ingredients: 1/2 cup shortening | 2 ounces unsalted butter | 1/2 tablespoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1/2 lb finely chopped yellow pepper | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped sweet basil | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped green olive or 1/3 cup red pimento-stuffed green olives
instructions: Heat oven to 425f degrees. Line rimmed baking sheet with foil. In a bowl, combine shortening, butter, ginger, and grated pepper, and blend well. Gently fold together. Spread onto prepared baking sheet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Stir constantly, watching closely to avoid burning on the edges. When done, transfer to a wire rack to cool. When cool, use a large pastry cup or spoon to shape the cooled cherry pepper into small circular cutlets, about 2 inches high. To shape cherry pepper into an elongated cone, use a 1/4 inch round cookie cutter to cut cherry pepper into short lengths about 2 inches wide and 2 to 3 inches long. Arrange on parchment lined baking sheet. Using your fingertips, poke a point in the sugar to release steam. Cool completely. In a small bowl, combine all glaze ingredients until just blended about 1 minute. Spoon over cherry peels in rings, brush tops and sides of each ring with glaze until glaze is completely incorporated. Let stand at least 1 hour.

title: Potted Chutney (Chutney for Dogs, Cheese and Chips)
ingredients: 50 g pickled chilies, chopped | 1/4 cup coarsely grated swiss gruyere cheese ( or your favourite cheese ) | 1 tablespoon chutney, for dipping
instructions: Dip your chutney into warm, plain chutney. To serve, dip chutney into hot chutney to coat. Serve with toasted bread.

title: Basic Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup skim milk
instructions: Place the soup and milk in a medium saucepan, and bring to a boil. Stir to mix. Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 5 minutes, until the flavors meld together.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,vanilla ice cream,steak,red onion,white cabbage,bread flour
title: Beef and Cashew Nut Rolls
ingredients: 100 g cooked white cabbage | 100 g ground round | 1 -2 teaspoon sweet bread flour | 2 medium red onions | 1 -2 tablespoon cashew nuts, chopped | 100 g premium reduced fat vanilla ice cream
instructions: Finely grate the raw cabbage and set it aside. Cut the onion into very thin half rings and coarsely chop the halves. Heat a small amount of oil in a pan and dry fry the onion. Add the cashew nuts and cook for a few seconds until they are coloured. Stir in the flour and fry for a minute, then add the beef, egg and some water or milk if necessary to get a soft dough. Transfer to an oven proof dish, cover with the lid and bake in its own oven for 20 - 30 minutes at 200 degrees or in a fan assisted oven for 30 minutes at 220 degrees. Remove from the oven and pour in the ice cream. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: onion,cumin powder,rice vinegar,onion soup mix,superfine sugar,tzatziki
title: Yummy Tzatziki Dip (Canned)
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 1/2 cup onion | 1 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons fine light sugar | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons instant onion soup mix ( not powdered ) | 1/4 cup tzatziki ( i use plain yogurt dip ) or 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt dip ( i use plain yogurt dip )
instructions: Mix everything together in a medium bowl. Cover a medium size glass with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until ready to use. Put the tzatziki or greek yogurt into a container with a lid and shake. To serve, place ingredients into tzatziki dip size measuring approximately 50 millers, or use a 1/2 cup measuring scoop for a little less.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,linguine,channa dal,yellow bell pepper,cheese cloth,lime wedge,garlic salt,cashew
title: Kadai Phyllo Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 10 fresh cheese cloths | 2 bunches fresh cheese cloths | 2 cups channa dal, with channa dill added ( chickpeas flour ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 jar roasted cashews | 2 cups chopped fresh linguine | 2 tablespoons lime wedges | 2 teaspoons garlic salt ( to taste )
instructions: Place cheese cloths in a large pot and cover with water.

title: Aubergine and Pecorino (Aubergine With Bread)
ingredients: 1 aubergine, diced | 2 aubergines, diced ( eggplant ) | 3 tablespoons tahini | 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 14 ounces bread flour
instructions: Bring water to boil and add a touch of salt and butter then add the aubergines. Boil until they turn a beautiful grey colour but remove from heat after 5 - 10 minutes and keep warm. When they are cool off, add the pecorino and a little corn starch to flour and mix well then stir in the eggplant. Return to stovetop and stir over low heat for 5 - 10 minutes until a smooth paste has been formed and the mixture has thickened a little. Taste for seasoning and add salt if required before serving.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,thai fish sauce,beef chuck roast,ham hock
title: Baked Thai Ginger Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 cup packed brown sugar | 1 cup thai fish sauce | 1 cup sliced cooked ham hock ( optional ) | 1 boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix brown sugar, fish sauce and ham hock together in a bowl. Place beef in the bottom of the baking dish. Spread the sugar mixture over the beef. Cover with foil, and bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 140 degrees f, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven, and serve.

title: Macaroni and Prawns (Shrimp or Omelett)
ingredients: 200 g elbow macaroni at a time | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon coconut rum | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 tablespoon nori, seaweed ( nori seaweed powder )
instructions: Dissolve sugar in sugar water and put aside. Boil macaroni until soft but firm. While its cooking, mix soy sauce, coconut rum and nori. When macaroni is ready, mix in the sugar sauce and soy prawns. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Blueberries
ingredients: 24 blueberries | 2 tablespoons ghee | 1/2 teaspoon mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning or 1/4 teaspoon other seasoning | 3 -5 drops hot pepper sauce ( to taste ) | coriander powder | fresh rosemary, leaves ( optional ) or fresh parsley ( optional )
instructions: Place berry halves, cut side up on foil or baking sheet in a single layer. Heat ghee or other cooking oil until smoking in heavy pan over medium heat. Add steak seasoning and pepper sauce. When it begins to darken, add water to cover. Add berries to pan. Cover and cook until berries begin to wilt, 3 - 5 minutes depending on thickness of berries.. Spoon as much juice over berries as will lie on top while cooking. Sprinkle with coriander, if using. Serve while hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: pimento olive,fish sauce,bamboo shoot,chicken part,black pepper,grain rice
title: Vietnamese Chicken and Spicy Rice
ingredients: 2 ounces sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 3 boneless skinless chicken parts | 8 tablespoons fresh fish sauce | 1/4 cup pimento stuffed olive, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 2 cups short-grain rice
instructions: Wash the chicken, pat dry, and cut lengthwise into 2 inch pieces. Arrange chicken in a shallow large dish. Combine the remaining ingredients in a small bowl, and spoon over chicken. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours, tossing once. Preheat the grill. Place the chicken on the grill rack over medium heat, and grill for 5 minutes per side. Serves.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,smelt,half,green chili pepper,chicken thigh fillet,anise seed
title: Proscuitto
ingredients: 4 chicken thigh fillets ( about 2 1/2 to 3 inches thick ) | 4 slices prosciutto, cut 1-inch wide by 1-inch long | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers ( i recommend 2 green chile de-seeded ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup canned diced smoked spelt ( or other dark-flavored dark vegetable )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place one slice of prosciutto on each of 4 pieces of chicken. Sprinkle both sides of each piece with anise seeds and then place in a medium roasting pan. Arrange chicken in single layer. Add water to bottom of pan, cover tightly, and bake until prosciutto is golden and juices run clear, about 1 hour. While prosciutto bakes, heat a small nonstick frying pan over high heat until just beginning to smoke, about 30 seconds. Add chile deveined chiles and cook, stirring, 1 minute longer. Remove from heat and stir in half and half and spelt. Set aside. Drain chicken and prosciutto from pan and arrange on serving platter. Pour juices over chicken and serve.

title: Tortillas De Naya
ingredients: 1 package tortillas | 1/2 pound shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 pound shiitake dried black mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 pound fresh shiitake dried mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup thinly sliced, andly minced fresh galangal | 3/4 jar caramel-stuffed pimientos | 1 jar marshmallows, sliced paper-thin
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium heat. Place tortillas in the hot skillet, and cook about 5 seconds each side, or until slightly crisp. Serve on a plate with a side of mushroom, guava sauce, and marshmallows.

title: Guacamole from the Quesadilla Factory
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon guacamole | 1 fresh thyme sprig, chopped
instructions: Combine ¼ teaspoon of guacamole and ¼ teaspoon of thyme in small bowl. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,lemon zest,date,chicken tender,liquid honey,horseradish
title: Lemon Honey Roasted Honey Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup chopped pitted dates | 1 pound chicken tenders
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a medium bowl, beat whipping cream, honey, lemon zest, horseradish, dates, and chicken tenders. Spoon about half into a 9x9 inch baking dish. Toss chicken with remaining cream mixture in a resealable plastic bag until completely coated. Pour sauce over chicken, and place in the preheated oven. Bake in preheated oven until the sauce is bubbly and the chicken is no longer pink about 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wine,macaroni noodle,hot paprika,green chili pepper,vanilla extract,prosciutto,hard egg,corn oil
title: Mexican Egg Noodle Salad (Diet Version)
ingredients: 1 package macaroni noodles ( see # 4372493 '' or # 4372787 '' ) | 1/2 lb prosciutto, thinly sliced ( or a 1/2-inch piece of thin bacon ) | 1 can diced green chili peppers, drained | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 hard-boiled egg, cut into wedges and tossed with a little extra paprika
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, place some of the pasta water on your microwave safe plate. Heat up the dry pancetta slices in this microwave until crisp. Drain if preferred. Remove the pancetta, reserving the oil. Save the grease in a medium sized skillet. Heat up enough oil in the skillet to coat the bottom of the pan. When the oil is almost smoking, add the sliced garlic. Cook until golden, but don't brown garlic. Remove using kitchen shears, from the pan, to a bowl, allowing some of the drippings to drain from the pan. Add the chilies and wine. Heat over medium heat until the wine comes to a boil. Meanwhile, toss the noodles with the reserved oil and the other reserved oil. Add the green chili pepper and stir gently. Remove the noodles from the skillet. When the wine is almost at the boiling point, add the can of diced green chilies, drained of a little of the cooking juice, the corn oil and the vanilla. Stir, and add the hot paprika. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until heated through. Add the green chili pepper mixture, stir and remove from heat. Add the egg wedges. Place the noodle dish in two pretty serving dishes, then top them with the egg slices, and then drizzle with the reserved green chili oil. If you like a little heat, just let it simmer while you cook the egg wedges. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,orange zest,cashew,haddock fillet,chive,chipotle chile,pineapple chunk
title: Tropical Fish
ingredients: 20 -35 fresh pineapple chunks, with the stems on | 1 1/4 kg cod or 1 1/4 kg haddock fillets, thickly sliced | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted | 2 chives, chopped | 2 chipotle chiles, seeded, chopped | 1 teaspoon orange zest, finely grated
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the fish and marinate the fish in the fridge for 15 minutes. Lightly grill the fish on both sides until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,green curry paste,graham cracker crumb,asparagus,island dressing,peanut,cinnamon
title: Peanut Choy Pies
