ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 bags frozen peas and carrots | 2 cans no salt added diced and drained canned island style salted peanut butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 1 package frozen island style thawed peas and carrots | 1 cup thai green curry paste, such as knorr brand | 1 tablespoon toasted and chopped peanuts
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Add asparagus, carrots and peas, boil for 5 minutes. Drain vegetables well and transfer to a medium bowl. In a medium size bowl, mix peanut butter with cinnamon. Add half of peanut butter mixture, add thawed peas and carrots and mix well. Add curry paste and mix well. Add half of curry paste mixture and mix well. Stir in remaining peanut butter mixture, and mix well again. Drop into boiling water and cook 8 to 10 minutes until they float to the top. Remove from heat and transfer a dozen or five at a time to waxed paper covered wire racks to drain. Place 1 cup of the peanut peanut sauce on a warm plate.

title: Chinese-Style Tuna
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 4 tuna steaks, each about 3 inches long | 1 cup brewed tea
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat until very hot, about 30 seconds. Place the steaks in the skillet, and cook until slightly charred on the bottom. Turn, and cook for about 30 seconds before carefully turning the steaks. Place the steaks onto a plate, and carefully pour the brewed tea over them.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,farfalle pasta,tomato puree,fenugreek seed,tequila,apple juice,lettuce leaf,chinese cooking wine
title: Farfalle Pasta in Agrodolce (Sweet & Sour Pasta Salad)
ingredients: 250 g farfalle pasta | 1 red chili pepper, sliced thinly | 1 red chili pepper, sliced thinly | 1 teaspoon ground dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons apple juice | 2 tablespoons tequila | 3 tablespoons sweet chinese cooking wine | 3 tablespoons tomato puree ( concentrate ) | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Put the pasta in a large roasting tin and fill it with water to cover. Add the chili, fenugreek and apple juice and mix well. Cover and cook over a medium high heat for 10 minutes. Drain and add the tequila, sweet chinese cooking wine and tomato puree. Toss the pasta well to combine. Serve on a large platter with a bed of lettuce leaves.

title: Chia-Giordano Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 piece fresh apple ( about 1-1/4 inches in diameter ) | sea water ( enough to cover apple ) | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground hazelnuts
instructions: Peel the apple under cold running water to remove the white pith. Cut away the center part of the apple.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,turkey,yoghurt,dill weed,dark brown sugar,cherry tomato,cheese ravioli
title: Pretchers Greek Ravioli
ingredients: 1 package frozen cheese ravioli | 5 ounces shredded goat cheese or 5 ounces other shredded cheese, such as goat cheese | 2 tablespoons light olive oil or 2 tablespoons ghee | 1/4 cup low-fat natural yoghurt, such as lite or regular greek yogurt | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 2 teaspoons sifted fresh dill weed | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,margarine butter,pinto bean,cod fish fillet
title: Easy Baked Cod With Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 1 package pinto beans | 1 package splenda sugar substitute | 2 cod fish fillets
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. Boil 2 quarts of water with 2 tablespoon of salt. Place butter in a baking dish or roaster and mix in beans, heat for a few minutes or until butter has melted. While water is coming to a boil, put your fish in the crockpot. Melt your beans. Pour bean mixture over the fish and bake at 400 degrees f for 5 hours, or until fish is cooked through. Serve over your favorite salad.

title: Corn and Lemon Loaf
ingredients: 1 corn on the cob, cooked and peeled | 2 teaspoons lemon essence | 250 g fat-free bisquick | 1/2 teaspoon lemon essence | 2 tablespoons chervil
instructions: Drain the corn from the cob, then rinse well under cold water. Place the corn on a baking tray and bake at 190c for 10 - 15 minutes until the kernels have popped and coloured slightly. Allow to cool down slightly then press the corn kernels through a sieve. You may need to do this in batches. Place the lemon essence and zest in a small saucepan and heat gently until all the zest has dissolved and the flavour has really come through. Remove from the heat and stir in the lemon essence mixture. Set aside. In a separate bowl mix the bisquick and hot water. Place the corn on a baking tray and spread over the base of the pan. Spread over the zest flavoured zest and then with a spatula start spreading over the corn to cover. Spread over the chervil. Press with wet fingers to flatten and then smooth over. Cut into squares and serve. Great with a cold newcastle tea.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,peach,red wine vinegar,ketchup,part ricotta cheese,chili paste
title: Sweet Chilli Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup peaches, peeled, boiled | 1 3/4 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon cardamom, ground | 1 1/3 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 pinch sugar
instructions: Mash peaches, place in bowl and chill. Mix all other ingredients very well. Spread on top of chilled cheese. Note, this tastes great when eaten at room temperature too. Serves 2.

title: Fried Sourdough Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough bread | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Cut 4 thick slices of bread into 3 or 4 chunks. Mix golden syrup, rice vinegar, and sourdough pieces together in a bowl.

title: Steamed Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 6 ounces oyster sauce | 3 5/8 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns
instructions: Rinse cabbage completely and pick out the core leaving about 1/2 of a thick shell. Slice the larger and the thicker portions into 1/4 inch thick slices. Blanch in salted boiling water for 1 minute then drain in a colander. Put cabbage in a steamer pan with Oyster sauce, stock, the peppercorns and bring to a boil. Cover pot and simmer for 10 - 12 minutes until cabbage is well cooked.

title: Corn Chip Cakes-Dip
ingredients: 1 package dried sweet corn | 1 cup ranch dip, canned | 1 can creamed corn | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | adobo seasoning, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Soak the corn in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain and rinse the corn in sink. Add to a bowl and add the ranch dip, creamed corn, mixed herbs, adobo seasoning and baking soda. Mix thoroughly to combine. Form into balls. Roll in corn chips, or place on waxed paper that is paper lined with plastic wrap which has been applied with a no stick. Refrigerate for several hours to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,curry powder,chick pea,date,wheat flour
title: Curried Chana Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried chick-peas, picked over and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups stone-ground whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 cup chopped dates
instructions: Sort the chick peas into a large bowl of water and let them soak overnight. Drain the peas and place them in a saucepan. Add enough water to cover them by at least 2.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,broth,cream mushroom soup,buttermilk biscuit,rice vinegar,stout beer
title: German Peanut Stew
ingredients: 4 cans refrigerated buttermilk biscuits, crumbled | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can broth | 1 bottle creamy peanut butter | 1 cup irish stout beer | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Dump all except 1 can of beer into crock pot and stir. Cook on high for 10 hours. Add the last can of beer and stir. Put in baggie, can or seal, and refrigerate for up to 2 days. You can also just place in a baggie and shake, just like you would shake a shake. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,cumin powder,vegetable broth,chinese rice wine
title: Chinese Five-Treasure Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 3 tablespoons chinese rice wine | 1 1/3 cups vegetable broth | 10 leaves iceberg lettuce
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together cumin and rice wine. Pour over lettuce leaves in a serving bowl. Stir gently and serve.

title: Oysters With Wine and Grated Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb fresh oyster, shucked and with the tail attached ( or you can just leave in the shell ) | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar ( or balsamic ) | 1/4 cup grated mixed fresh herbs ( such as basil, parsley, etc. to taste ) | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, very thinly sliced ( or grana padano, for sprinkling on the top )
instructions: Heat a grill or broiler. Arrange the oysters, but leave some headspace around the shell. Drizzle with the sherry vinegar. Sprinkle with the herbs. Grate the cheese coarsely on top. Broil until the cheese is bubbly and lightly browned on top, about 5 to 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,half cream,italian parsley,curry powder
title: Curried Cream Sauce For Dipping
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white-roasted black sesame seeds, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian parsley, minced | 1 -2 teaspoon mild curry powder | half-and-half cream
instructions: Place 1/2 t. Of the sesame seeds in a heatproof bowl and stir in the parsley. In a small bowl, combine the remaining sesame seeds with the curry powder. Pour the remaining sesame seeds into a medium saucepan over medium low heat. Stirring constantly, cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Add the remaining 1/2 t sesame seeds and the half and half. Stirring constantly, cook about 5 minutes or until the cream begins to thicken. If desired, cook about 15 more minutes or until the sauce thickens.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,wide egg noodle,oyster sauce,salt pork,head green cabbage,garam masala
title: Oriental Noodle Wraps
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced salt pork | 1 package flour tortillas, cut into 4 inch pieces, divided | 1 medium head green cabbage, cut into thin wedges | 1 package wide egg noodles | 2 cups oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Heat a large pot of water to boiling. Place 2 tortillas and 2 pieces of salt pork in the boiling water.

title: Fried Indian Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salt-free vinegar | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 tablespoons sliced fresh mint leaves
instructions: Whisk together the vinegar, cardamom powder& mint leaves. Let stand for 5 minutes. Serve or refrigerate.

title: Mexican Corn Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 1 stalk celery, chopped | 3/4 cup sour cream
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the corn, celery and sour cream. Cover and chill until serving time.

title: Spanish Onion Soup
ingredients: 1/2 large spanish onion, thinly sliced ( use 1/2 of each, or red, green, or a combination ) | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon ( use chicken base if you can � t find a `` low salt '' flavor ) | 4 tablespoons half-and-half cream or 4 tablespoons light cream | 1 1 tablespoon triple sec or 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: In a large saucepan, caramelize the onion and bouillon in 1 tablespoon of the cream until they become golden, stirring frequently. Let them cool and then blend in the rest of the cream. Stir in the blended cream and reheat. Serve with more sugar.

title: Quick Beef Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut, desiccated | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, fat trimmed
instructions: Put a nonstick frying pan on a medium high heat. Dry the fat from the beef and cook the beef until nicely browned, adding more fat as needed. Add the coconut to the stew and stir well. Simmer over a medium low heat for about 2 or 3 minutes. Turn and stir. If it is a little spunky add a little water. Serve over brown rice.

title: Banana Pepper Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets and thawed | 1 package semi-frozen banana peppers | 1/4 cup chopped banana pepper, such as terra chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line the bottoms of 12 muffin cups with some thawed phyllo. Unfold one sheet of dough on a work surface, and cut in half diagonally on the diagonal until it forms a 2 inch long triangle. Place the triangles between sheets of plastic wrap, and gently roll into 1 inch balls. Place the banana peppers on half of the phyllo dough. Sprinkle with banana pepper. Add another sheet of phyllo dough, top with the final phyllo dough, and pinch together the two sheets of phyllo. Cut a slit lengthwise in each triangle along the length, taking the two long cut sides and placing one on top of the second. Place the phyllo triangles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

title: Nokedomaki -- Mushroom Filling for Kebabs W- Fried Onions and Fried Lemons
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shiitake mushrooms ( stems trimmed if extremely fresh ) | fine salt | 2 tablespoons fine salt | 1 lb dried lemons or 1 lb sour orange slices
instructions: Wrap mushrooms in a clean cloth and place on a plate. Sprinkle with fine salt. Let sit at room temperature for 6 to 8 hours. Rinse well to remove sand and salt. Cut stems off mushrooms and cut into strips. In a large shallow bowl, combine fine salt, lemons, and 1/2 to 1/3 of the kosher salt until well blended. Add mushrooms and stir to coat with salt. Cover bowl and marinate overnight. Drain mushrooms and discard marinade. Grill kababs over direct medium heat or until done, about 10 minutes each side.

Random Ingredients: salt,red tomato,water,yukon gold potato,nutritional yeast,white chocolate
title: Yukon Gold Potato and Tomato Pizza
ingredients: 250 g yukon gold potatoes | 250 g white chocolate ( semi-sweet ) | 10 1/2 ml nutritional yeast | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 5 1/2 ml warm water | 1 red ripe tomato, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c / 350f / gas mark grease an 18cm / 16 cm / 6’ deep, 19cm / 5 6” deep ovenproof baking dish with olive oil or butter. Peel and thinly slice potatoes. Place in large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to the boil over high heat & boil for about 20 minutes or until tender. Drain well, return to saucepan & keep warm. Place chocolate in bowl of an electric mixer and using an electric hand mixer beat on medium speed, add remaining ingredients. When combined, divide potato mix among prepared baking dish & spread around in a thin layer. Place tomato slices on top, pressing down firmly on slightly to ensure tomato slices get a little of the potato mix. Bake in preheated oven for approximately 45 minutes or until golden brown, and knife comes out clean. Check for doneness with a toothpick. When cool slice & serve with your favourite pizza toppings.

title: Fiery Cajun Spice Rub
ingredients: 1/4 cup red onion, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped brown onions | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 1 tablespoon brown onion, coarsely chopped | 16 whole cloves | 1 1/2 tablespoons dill weed, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the coarsely chopped red onion, the brown onion, cajun seasoning, ginger, brown onion, cloves, and dill weed. Lightly coat the outside of a clean, dry skillet with oil. Heat the oil over medium high heat. When the oil begins to shimmer, pour in the spice mixture, reduce heat to medium, and cook, stirring often, for 20 to 30 seconds, until the mixture has darkened to a dark, golden color. Transfer the fajita mixture to a resealable plastic zipper bag, and seal. To serve, transfer the spice mixture to a zip lock bag, and use to coat 1/2 pound of fajita meats.

title: Quick Chick Pea Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped yellow pepper ( red or green ) | 1 head green cabbage ( about 2 pounds )
instructions: Cut green cabbage into 1/4 inch thick slices. Separate leaves from head and cut leaves into 6 even quarters. Remove and discard core of cabbage. Cut leaves crosswise into 1 inch long pieces.

title: Indian Herb and Cardamom Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lettuce leaf ( i love the type with green parts in it ) | 2 teaspoons crushed cardamom seeds
instructions: Line a salad plate with the lettuce leaves. Sprinkle with cardamom powder and toss with the oiled fingers of a fork. I prefer to use my hands.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,gin,cayenne pepper,serrano chile pepper,red curry paste,savoy cabbage,coconut extract
title: Red Curry Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/4 head savoy cabbage, sliced into florets | 2 red curry paste | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 2 serrano chile peppers, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons gin | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon chopped pistachios
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add savoy cabbage and return to a boil. Cook uncovered for 4 minutes or until soft. Unceremoniously remove the cabbage from the pot. Reserve liquid and add 2nd measure of liquid. Heat the 2nd measure of liquid. Add 2nd measure of liquid and 2nd measure of red curry paste. Mix, and add red serrano chiles and 3 tablespoons gin or apple juice. Add coconut extract and cayenne pepper. Mix well. Add the cabbage to the remaining liquid, and stir. Cook uncovered for five minutes or until bright green.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,greek yogurt,chuck,red pepper,thai red curry paste,balsamic vinegar
title: Red Curry Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 lb chuck ( trimmed weight ) | 1 package tri-colored red curry paste ( more or less, to taste ) | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup triple sec | 1/3 cup drained bottled roasted red peppers ( bottled or in jar ) | 1 container soft greek yogurt
instructions: Cut meat into 1/4 inch thick slice.

title: Baked Chocolate Habanero Peppers
ingredients: 4 habanero peppers, halved lengthwise, stem tip removed | 3 ounces dark chocolate | 1 cup prepared salad dressing
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f coat a cookie sheet with cooking spray. Place honey, habanero peppers, and 3 ounces of the chocolate in a saucepan and bring to a hard boil. Continue to boil until the mixture begins to melt. Remove from heat and stir into the melted chocolate. Stir in the remaining 1/2 ounce of chocolate. Spread mixture evenly into the prepared cookie sheet, about 1/3 inch thick. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cool on a wire rack for at least 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,ice water,scallion,tandoori paste,black sesame seed,oreo cooky,coffee liqueur,skirt steak
title: Oriental Grilled Skirt Steaks
ingredients: 4 scallions, trimmed, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons black sesame seeds, toasted | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup coffee liqueur, such as kahlua | 1/4 cup brewed coffee, hot | 1 tablespoon italian-style prepared horseradish or 1 tablespoon coffee-flavored liqueur | 2 teaspoons scallions, finely chopped | 2 lbs skirt steaks
instructions: Preheat a gas or charcoal grill to a medium high, setting the rack just below the coals. Toss the scallions with the toasted sesame seeds. Combine the orange juice, coffee liqueur, horseradish and scallions in a nonreactive bowl, making sure each is coated. Season the steaks with salt and pepper. Grill the steaks for 10 to 12 minutes, or to desired doneness.

title: Broiled Red Wine and Garlic Sandwiches (Copycat)
ingredients: 3/4 cup dry red wine ( italian ish ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon instant minced garlic ( see directions ) | freshly ground garlic, to taste | 12 garlic roll ( about 24-inch )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Toast both sides of bread under broiler. Combine wine, garlic powder and minced garlic in small bowl and set aside. Place bread slices onto lightly greased baking sheet, and place on top rack of broiler. Broil 5 to 8 minutes or until lightly toasted, turning once, until golden brown. Watch carefully, as broiler can easily burn. Serve hot. Tips, red wine should only be allowed to be used, as it encourages the garlic to release its flavors.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,cardamom pod,rice wine,red onion,shiitake mushroom
title: Mushroom Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese, cut into small cubes | 4 -6 fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems discarded, caps thinly sliced ( canned mushrooms may also be used ) | 3 small red onions, very thinly sliced into rounds ( about 6 wedges total ) | 1 -2 medium cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: In a shallow ceramic or glass bowl or saucepan, combine wine and swiss. Allow liquid in bowl to become clearer. Add cheese and set aside until cheese is cold. Heat oil in large non stick skillet over medium heat. When oil is very hot, add mushrooms and onions and sautee until onions are slightly browned, about 3 - 6 minutes. Add wine/swiss mixture to cheese mixture. Stir to combine and bring to a boil, scraping the bottom of the pan to loosen bits of cheese sticking. The mixture may bubble a bit, but will thicken as you stir. As soon as mixture begins to bubble, reduce heat to low and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes or until mixture is smooth and well blended and heated through. Remove from heat, stir in cardamom, and serve as a side dish.

title: Toasted Flax Seeds in a Panch Phy(India)  (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flax seeds, ground | 6 tablespoons fresh basil, finely chopped | 3 -4 small lime wedges ( optional ) | flax seed, for sprinking on top
instructions: In a blender, combine ground flax seeds and 3 tablespoons basil. Puree until it is a fine texture. Transfer to a large bowl, add lime wedges and mix well. Add remaining basil, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Use the same amount of ground flaxseed if desired. Use as a garnish over pita bread. Can be served with fish, salads, etc. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: shell macaroni,pineapple ring,oyster sauce,asiago cheese,red chili powder
title: Pineapple Crab
ingredients: 6 medium shell macaroni, cooked | 1/4 cup orange roughy or 1/4 cup grated orange zest of 1 orange | 1 can pineapple rings, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 2 teaspoons chili powder | asiago cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Bring 3 qts. Boiling water to a boil. Add macaroni and simmer until almost tender, about 8 - 10 minutes. Drain. Immediately transfer macaroni to a bowl and toss with orange zest and remaining ingredients. Sprinkle with cheese and serve immediately.

title: Syrian Beef Pilaf (Nepalese)
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef ( trimmed if necessary ) | 5 tablespoons glutinous rice flour | 1/4 cup sweet onion ( minced ) | 6 cups cooked hamburger ( cubed ) | 2 tablespoons honey ( to taste ) | 3 tablespoons black white pepper ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons ground sumac ( to taste )
instructions: Cut the beef into large pieces. Combine the riceflour with the sweet onion and mix. Add the meat and brown lightly. Place the meat, onion, pepper and sumac and honey in a crockpot and cook on low for 8 hours. Keep an eye on the meat so it does not get fat when cooked.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,whipping cream,great northern bean,fennel,feta cheese,vegetable stock,arborio rice
title: Artichoke and Feta Risotto
ingredients: 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and drained | 1 can great northern beans | 2 tablespoons chopped frozen fennel | 20 1/2 ounces vegetable stock | 9 1/2 ounces arborio rice or 9 1/2 ounces valenciaio rice | 5 cups packed warm whipping cream | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to saute artichokes, onions, and celery in 1 tablespoons oil 2 to 3 minutes. Remove artichokes and set aside. If necessary to prevent sticking from bottom, cover with foil to keep hot. In another 2 tablespoons oil, saute arborio rice until lightly browned. Add rice mixture to saute and stir for 2 minutes. Add broth 1 cup at a time. Stir constantly until rice and broth are absorbed. Continue adding rice and broth in 1 cup increments until rice is tender and broth is absorbed. Stir in artichokes, spinach, artichoke hearts, and feta cheese. Transfer risotto to oven and bake 15 to 20 minutes until top is crispy and warm. To make risotto, remove risotto from oven and increase oven temperature to medium high. Stir in cream, stir gently, and pour into 8x8 baking dish. Bake 40 minutes until hot and bubbly.

title: Pork and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 3 by 1/8-inch strips | 1 lb marshmallows | 1 1/2 cups instant macaroni ( i use macaroni & cheese )
instructions: Heat oven to 200f/190c/gas cook pork, marshmallows and macaroni in large heavy duty oven proof casserole. Cover and bake for approximately 45 - 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until pork is cooked and noodles are tender. Serve with additional marshmallows on side.

title: Veal & Vegetable Schnitzel & Lemon Juice
ingredients: 750 g veal schnitzels ( approx. 200 x 5 mm ) | 2 lemons, juice of | 375 ml nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 small turnip, peeled & cut into 3cm wedges | 6 sheets lutefisk
instructions: Place the schnitzel on a board, cover with plastic wrap and weight with other heavy object. Leave them to stand for 20 minutes. Squeeze lemon juice over veal & turn the schnitzel to drain any excess juices. Combine lemons juice & milk in a saucepan. Bring to the boil over medium heat & cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Remove from heat & stir through cornflour & set aside. Place the cut turnip wedges on a board & lay flat. Drizzle the juice mixture over the turnips & continue to cook for 5 - 6 minutes. Cook schnitzels at 1 minute on the uncut side. Transfer to serving plates & serve with turnip & lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,topping,cumin seed,fillet tilapia,chinese egg noodle,leg lamb,cayenne
title: Lamb and Noodle Skewers With Shrimp
ingredients: 24 ounces chicken and-vegetable thin-cut beef stew meat, trimmed of any fat, chopped into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, toasted and chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 flank steaks ( such as new york strip or upper tail steaks, cut into 2-inch-thick slices, with the meat reserved ) or 1 strip of steak ( such as new york strip or upper tail steaks, cut into 2-inch-thick slices, with the meat reserved ) | 1 bag chinese egg noodles | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 2 large steaks ( such as new york strip, upper tail end trimmed of any fat ) | 1 bag frozen steak | 24 ounces thawed frozen frozen large shrimp, defrosted
instructions: Combine chicken, cumin, and cayenne in a large bowl with 1/2 teaspoon salt in the bowl. Toss until chicken is coated with spices. Add the shrimp and toss until just barely covered with the shrimp marinade.. Arrange 1/3 of the shrimp in a 13 by 9 inch baking dish and top with 1/2 of the beef. Repeat with the remaining shrimp, beef, and shrimp. Arrange the noodles and whipped topping in a large plastic bag with the steak. Place bag on top, pressing down on the bag to compact. Refrigerate for 3 hours. Preheat the broiler. Remove the skewer and skewer from lamb and shrimp just before serving. Garnish with the beef, noodles, and whipped topping. Serves.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,honey mustard,semolina flour,pectin,spanish onion,cream mushroom soup,egg noodle,ice
title: Semonable Onion Cake
ingredients: 1 package dry egg noodles | 1 cup honey mustard | 2 tablespoons powdered semolina flour | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3/4 cup sour cream | 1 large spanish onion, sliced very thin | ice | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, well drained
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, rinse under warm water and drain. In a large bowl, whisk together all the ingredients and mix well. Stir in noodles and mix well until thoroughly coated. Place baking dish on top of a larger piece of foil and heat on 400°f for 8 minutes. Remove the bundt dish from the oven and place in a larger baking dish. Spread the noodles evenly in the baking dish, making sure that they are not touching each other. Bake at 400°f for 30 minutes, or until noodles are puffed and golden brown and bubbly. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,broad bean,mustard powder,wine vinegar,veal stock,ajwain,saltine crumb
title: Deep-Fried Veal With Broad Beans and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 250 g broad beans | 1 1 lb veal stock | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon ajwain | saltine crumbs | 25 g goats cheese ( crumbled ) | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar
instructions: Cut the broad beans in half and set aside. Peel the string of the veal. Cube into 1cm pieces. Bring the stock to boil then add mustard and ajwain seeds. Add the broad beans and let simmer for 2 mins until the beans are just starting to fall apart. Strain. Remove the noodles from the heat and allow the stock to cool to room temperature. Meanwhile combine the crumbled goat cheese with the vinegar and set aside. Serve the crumbled goat cheese on individual plates.

Random Ingredients: pecan,vanilla pod,molasses,oyster sauce,italian sausage,peanut butter,jalapeno chile
title: Pecan Italian Sausage With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs sweet italian sausage ( bulk, hot or links ) | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts ( pecan, crunchy type, not unsalted ) | 3 tablespoons peanut butter ( i like smooth-sweet, but creamy type ) | 2 tablespoons molasses or 2 tablespoons dark molasses | 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce or 1/2 teapoon tamarind pod | 1 jalapeno chile, sliced lengthwise ( can use serrano ) | 3 slices fresh vanilla pod
instructions: Remove casings from hot sausages. Slice sausage into 1/4 inch slices. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add ground beef. Cook until lightly browned, stirring to crumble and cook throughly, about 5 minutes. Place cooked meat on a plate and set aside. In same skillet over medium high heat, add the peanut butter, molasses, soy sauce and chile. Stir to mix and cook until hot, about 1 minute. Add the sautéed meat to the peanut butter mixture and stir to combine. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Amaretto-Glazed Curhead and Vegetables
ingredients: 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/4 lb fresh cauliflower | 4 parsnips, peeled | 1/2 lb fresh mango, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 package peeled pearl barley | 3 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 1 tablespoon amaretto
instructions: In a large bowl, stir the maple syrup and sherry until the liquid is well combined. Add cauliflower, parsnips, mango, and pearl barley. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Preheat ove to 375°f. Stir the grated ginger into the liquid just before serving. Divide each serving into 4 servings. Spoon some of the glaze over each portion so it drips into the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: malibu rum,chicken wing,dijon mustard,single cream,sunflower oil,celery rib
title: Barbecued Chicken Wings with Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 500 g chicken wings | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 200 ml single cream | 1 celery rib | 2 tablespoons malibu rum
instructions: Lightly spray a large baking sheet with a little sunflower oil. Cut the wings at the joints into 3 sections, discarding the tips if the wings are too long. Put the wings in a mixing bowl and mix thoroughly so all the wings are coated in oil. Preheat the barbecuing barbeque plate on the middle shelf of the barbecuing bar, when the barbecuing bar is to turn the oven down to 200°c. When the barbecuing bar starts smoking, transfer all the wings with the mustard sauce to a baking tray. Put on the tray and turn the heat of the barbeque down. Spread the cream evenly on the chicken wings and bake for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove the tray from the oven when the chicken is cooked, and set aside to cool slightly. Make the mustard sauce by combining the mustard, celery and rum in a bowl, adding a little water to make a slightly runny consistency. Once cooled, transfer to a serving dish and serve.

title: Stir Fried Shrimps, Japanese Style
ingredients: 8 jumbo shrimp | soya sauce
instructions: Make sure your wok is really hot. Lightly coat wok with soya sauce, and heat on low heat. If you don't have a wok, place the spoons of shrimp on the flat surface, and make them into 8 - 12 tiny sticks about 2'' long. After about 10 seconds, you should have a golden shrimp or a white shrimp that looks like a bit of red meat on top of them. I prefer the shrimp, but use your discretion on what type of shrimp you use. Turn the heat off before you turn them. You have to keep stirring all the shrimp over the bottom of the wok to keep from sticking but not burn them. If you do it too soon, they will turn a little bitter. When all the shrimp are on the surface of the wok, toss the shrimp around to coat them with the sauce. If you keep stirring, the shrimp will get kind of tough, and you likely have to turn a little. You can serve the shrimp out to your guests as is, or as is or serve them out to your guests.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,puff pastry,chinese cabbage,kosher salt black pepper,turnip,dark red kidney bean,parmesan cheese,cream tartar
title: Chinese Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 box puff pastry, thawed | 1 packet dried chinese cabbage, finely shredded or shredded | 1 turnip, finely shredded | 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained | 1/2 cup dry curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | kosher salt and black pepper, to taste | grated parmesan cheese, to garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f degrees/190°c. Press all the mixture together into a pie dish that's a quarter of its size. Smooth out as much as possible. Layer with the cabbage, turnips and kidney beans. Dollop half of the cottage cheese over the vegetables and top with the remainder of the cottage cheese. Whisk together the sour cream and cream of tartar. Add salt and pepper to taste, and sprinkle cheese on top. Make sure the edges are clean and no cheese pockets show. Bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown, and the top is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,spaghetti sauce,red onion,dark rum,red kidney bean,turmeric
title: Mexican Red Kidney Beans & Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti sauce | 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 medium roma tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup diced red onion | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 teaspoons freshly ground turmeric ( optional )
instructions: Drain and rinse the red kidney beans and put them in a large saucepan. Pour in enough water to cover them by one inch in order to cover them by at least 2 inches. Bring to a boil. Lower heat to medium, cover, and simmer on low for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°f. In the meantime combine the spaghetti sauce, tomato and onion in a bowl. Stir in the rum and turmeric. Mix well. Pour the cooked red kidney bean mixture into a casserole and top with the spaghetti sauce mixture and the chopped tomato. Place in the oven for an additional 15 minutes. Remove from oven and serve at once.

title: Mexican Farro and Green Pepper Soup
ingredients: 2 cups cold farro, rinsed and drained | 1 medium green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 4 cups chicken stock or 4 cups broth | 1/2 cup diced hot dried chilies or 2 -3 tablespoons canned chipotle chilies | 2 -2 teaspoons finely grated fresh lemon zest
instructions: Place farro on foil lined rimmed baking sheet and cover loosely with foil. Cook in oven until just tender, 45 to 55 minutes depending on temperature, but check about 10 minutes after 25 minutes. Cool. Remove all but about 1/4 cup of water and discard. Drain farro, rinse with cold water and drain. Combine with bell pepper, chicken broth and chilies in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium setting and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally to keep any brown crusty bits from forming on top, approximately 10 minutes, or until vegetables are cooked but still firm. Remove from heat, stir in lemon zest and fluff with fork. Cool slightly, cover and refrigerate until cold, about 2 hours. Cut into 1/2 inch pieces and serve with warm corn tortillas for dipping.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,palm sugar,fruit,lemon juice zest,wheat flour,baby spinach
title: Green Goddess Bean and Spinach Hummus
ingredients: 1 cup dry great northern beans, soaked overnight drain and rinse beans but retain a cup of liquid | 1 cup baby spinach | 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit ( any dried fruit can be used ) | 1 cup baby spinach | 2 tablespoons dried palm sugar | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Boil the beans in salted water until just tender about 10 minutes. Drain and place in a large serving bowl. Set aside to cool off. This may take several hours or over night. If you would like a smoother hummus, leave out the almonds. Drain out any excess liquid, if the beans are a little dry. Combine beans with all the remaining ingredients except the flour and mix. Cover and chill thoroughly. The hummus will not set up if the beans have cooled down a little bit. Mix the flour with half of the reserved bean liquid to form a smooth paste that pulls away from the sides of the bowl.

title: Tortilla Chips (Homemade)
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon meat tenderizer ( or a little bit of your favorite salt )
instructions: If you are using salt, soak in water for 10 minutes drain thoroughly. If you use salt, leave in water for 1 - 2 hours to soften. Tortilla chips can be cooked in a skillet over medium low heat the entire time, or you can bake in a 450 degree f oven for 8 - 10 minutes in a 375 degree f oven, stirring and flipping halfway through heating. It should only be golden at first but will take 2 - 3 minutes to achieve the desired darkness. It can also be served cold..

title: Edamame Lentils
ingredients: 1 package frozen edamame, thawed or packages frozen peas | 3 cups dried lentils | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook edamame according to directions on the package. Then drain any liquid or water that may be floating in the pot. In a 9x13 inch baking dish place lentils and cover with enough water to submerge. Cover and bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 20 minutes or until lentils are tender and liquid has been absorbed. Cover and continue cooking for 5 minutes. Stir in graham cracker crumbs. Serve over hot cooked noodles or rice or with lots of cheese for a complete meal.

title: Gajar Ka Halwa
ingredients: 2 cups gajar ka halwa (gujarati alle ki halwa bread) | 1 teaspoon saffron ( optional ) | 1 cup white flour | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 - 1 1/2 cup agave syrup | ice
instructions: Mix together the saffron, flour, half and half and agave in a blender. Blend well. If the mixture is too dry, add water to obtain it to mix well. If it is too wet, add a few drops water to obtain it to mix well. Preferably use gajar's alleki kiwi gajar, you can also use any flavor food store like a kiwi ricer. It makes it a little bit smoother. Dip pieces of bread into the soured cream mixture and fry them either in the skillet or on the stove. For this option, you may heat a small pan on the stove with a little oil, then shallow fry all the pieces of bread. For traditional french cooking, arrange fried bread on toasted flat plate or on your plate. To serve, place some yoghurt on the side.

title: Oyster Rolls
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups marinara sauce | 1/3 cup brown rice flour | 1/3 cup thinly sliced fresh green beans | 4 hoagie rolls, toasted
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a medium bowl, mix the marinara sauce, brown rice flour, and green beans together in a microwave safe bowl. Place the cooked brown rice mixture onto a piece of plastic wrap. Arrange the plastic wrap on a clean surface and roll your bean mixture into a small log, about 4 inches long. Tear the roll into pieces and roll into cylinder shapes. Arrange onto a baking sheet. Broil the rolls 3 to 5 inches from the heat for 3 minutes. Brush rolls with a light coating of marinara sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,apple cider,pumpkin pie spice,baking potato,grand marnier
title: Pumpkin Potatoes With Wine and Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 tablespoon grand marnier ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons apple cider or 2 tablespoons wine | 1 tablespoon kosher salt and black pepper
instructions: Scrub the potatoes and prick them with a fork three or four times. Boil the potatoes in salted water until half cooked, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool thoroughly. Slice the potatoes 1/4 inch thick. Coat with potato cooking spray, sprinkle with salt and pepper. Spray a large baking dish with cooking spray and heat the dish until very hot. When the pan is very hot, add the potatoes to the pan, tossing them around so they get coated with the cooking spray. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once or twice, until deep golden brown and crisp. Turn the potatoes out onto a serving platter. Top with the wine and grand marnier and serve.

Random Ingredients: salad dressing,worcestershire sauce,lipton onion soup mix,fig,green bell pepper,nori,italian dressing
title: Fig and Green Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 package dried figs, cut in halves | 4 green bell peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 4 tablespoons prepared italian dressing | 4 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 4 teaspoons lipton dry onion soup mix | 4 sheets nori, seaweed | salad dressing
instructions: Prepare fresh figs, if desired, and place in paper bag. In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients, shake to combine and set aside. If serving immediately, pour cooled figs over dressing.

Random Ingredients: half,bean sprout,brown mustard seed,green enchilada sauce,broccoli,cornflour,cheddar cheese
title: Three Cheese Broccoli and Bean Sprouts Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 250 g frozen chopped broccoli | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1/3 cup green enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup chopped fresh vegetables ( see note in description )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Grease shallow, 18x28 cm casserole dish.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,chipotle chile adobo,superfine sugar
title: Easy and Delicious Chipotle Scented Apples
ingredients: 1 chipotle chiles in adobo ( canned with 1 adobo and 1 adobo ) | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Pulse the chilies in 1/4 to 1/2 inch frying pan on either side of the blade of a box grater to a fine purée. Heat the oil in a small saucepan over medium heat until it starts to shimmer. Add the purée and cook, stirring frequently, for 3 to 4 minutes, until the purée turns light brown. The chilies should also be very fragrant. Be careful, since they have oils in them. Remove from the heat and beat in the sugar. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,english cucumber,demerara sugar,red cabbage,beef tenderloin steak,white pepper
title: Beef Salad With Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 boneless beef tenderloin steak | 1 tablespoon white pepper | 1 english cucumber, sliced | 1/2 red cabbage, cored and sliced | 1/2 cup roasted beef tenderloin and deli-style pickles or 1/2 cup deli pickle sticks | 1 cup brown demerara sugar or 1 cup honey
instructions: Rinse steak with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with pepper and rub lightly with pepper. Place in 1/2 meat side of a 12x16 baking dish and refrigerate until chilled, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare vegetables using 2 medium carrots, 2 medium red cabbage, 1/2 red onion. Place beef, cucumber, and vegetables on top of salad and cover with sugar. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 3 days. Just before serving, remove from refrigerator and let sit for 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer to serving plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,scallion,bailey irish cream,graham cracker crumb
title: Bailes
ingredients: 12 graham crackers, crushed | 2 tablespoons scallions, finely chopped | 1/2 cup baileys irish cream or 1/2 cup other coffee-flavored liqueur | 12 lettuce leaves
instructions: Combine crackers, scallions, and baileys in a medium bowl. Add 1/2 cup cold water.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,white wine,basil pesto,oyster sauce,summer squash,chili pepper
title: Pepper Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 large fresh summer squash | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 cup white wine or 1 cup beer ( i used a sweet white wine ) | 1/2 cup basil pesto | 1 -2 chili pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons golden syrup ( optional )
instructions: First rinse and peel the squash. Cut the squash lengthwise into 4 - 6 wedges using the wedge marks you want the knife to make a straight line across the entire top of the squash. Slice the wedges crosswise at the same intervals as before. Heat the oil in a wok or deep skillet over medium heat. Add the squash and toss, heating gently for 3 minutes or until tender. Remove the squash wedges from the the skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the wine to the wok and bring to a boil. Add the pesto and stir quickly until it starts to thicken slightly. Add in the saute'd mixture and stir to combine. Next, add the peppers and heat through. Return the squash and any juices in the wok to the wok and heat through. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Chopped Green Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 green onion, white and light green parts only, sliced | 1 teaspoon salad dressing ( i used kraft miracle whip dressing )
instructions: Arrange the green onions in a salad bowl. In a small bowl add 2 1/2 tablespoons dressing. Stir. Pour dressing over green onions. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Nem Ran Dak Pla (Bok Choi)
ingredients: 4 bunches bok choy, trimmed and chopped into 1-inch size pieces | 2 teaspoons rose water
instructions: Place chopped bok choy in a bowl with the 2 teaspoons of chopped rose water. Stir to coat the greens with the water and coat with the oil, then refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Remove bunches from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking. Preheat an oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add bok choy.

title: Celtic Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups shredded swiss cheese | 3/4 cup mexican-style corn | 3/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish. In a bowl, combine all ingredients, except sprinkles, and toss well with hands. Spread mixture into prepared pan. Sprinkle the top with sprinkles. Bake in 400 degree f oven for approximately 15 minutes or until light brown.

title: Tofu Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces soft tofu | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 4 walnut halves, toasted | 4 teaspoons salad oil | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Blend the tofu finely with the rest of the ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Pineapple Lime Chicken
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 can pineapple juice | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor and whirl to consistency desired.

title: Boston Creamy Semolina-Crusted Black Rye Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread, cut into cubes about 1/2-inch in size | 3/4 cup light molasses | 12 ounces semolina or 12 ounces barley flour ( whole-milk ) | 1/2 - 1 cup low-fat milk chocolate | 2 limes, wedged and thinly sliced | coarse sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f in a large bowl, combine two thirds of the rye bread cubes, molasses and semolina. Using your hands, knead bread until mixture begins to hold together. Using your hands, shape 2 cups of the bread mixture into balls or loafs. Place onto a 9x13 inch baking dish. Using a fork, poke a thin hole in the crumb crust. Bake until slightly golden, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. In a medium saucepan, heat milk chocolate over low heat until melted, about 2 minutes. Remove chocolate from heat and whisk in milk chocolate. Set aside. Spread remaining rye bread cubes in the cooled pudding and place the loaf on top. Drizzle chocolate mixture over the rye bread and sprinkle with lime slices. Sprinkle with coarse sugar to taste. Enjoy.

title: Cream Cheese and Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, roughly diced | 200 g cream cheese or 200 g sour cream
instructions: Mix up the onions. Mash them, then mix and serve it as a spread in your favourite bread. If desired you can garnish with some freshly ground black pepper or chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: topping,parsnip,kielbasa,yogurt,chicken breast,extra virgin olive oil,marshmallow creme,mustard powder
title: Chicken Breast and Parsnip Salad With Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut in half | 1 piece kielbasa, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 cup fresh parsnip | topping | yogurt | mustard powder | parsley and a dollop of whipped cream or ice cream ( optional ) | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Put chicken and sausage on a grill plate on high heat. Grill until meat is done. Dice up parsnips add to meat, cover and let sit 10 to 15 minutes. Chop kielbasa add to chicken and sausage and let sit 5 minutes. Shred parsnips add to chicken mixture and mix well. Drizzle with good extra virgin olive oil. Top with whipped cream. Top with parsley. Serve as a side salad with rice or bread.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,chicken thigh,broccoli,curry powder,milk ricotta cheese,red wine,basil leaf
title: Easy and Tasty Baked Chicken With Broccoli and Garlic
ingredients: 500 g baby broccoli cuts | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 500 g boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 cup low fat milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup red wine or 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Bring a pot of well salted water to the boil. Add broccoli and cook for 2 minutes. Remove the broccoli from the pot, but leave the heads on. Place the chicken thighs and drumsticks into a large fry pan and cook until the skin starts to brown, turning once. Drain the excess fat from the pan, then add the chicken and broccoli and stir to coat with the fat. Pour in the red wine or stock and bring to the boil. Toss through the oyster sauce and then add the basil leaves to the sauce.

title: Green Beans With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb green beans | 1/3 cup apricot preserves | 16 ounces shrimp paste
instructions: Cut beans into 1 inch lengths.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,cream corn,ice cube,red chile,toffee bit
title: Twice Cream Crunchy Toffee
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 1 tablespoon lime juice, finely chopped fresh | 1 red chile, seeded and chopped ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons toffee bits | 1 can soft toffee bits
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.

title: Broccoli and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into bite size pieces | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Wash, stem, cut stems off broccoli into bite size pieces, and steam for 7 - 8 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain, and cool. Add broccoli and cheese salad to lettuce leaves. Cover salad with plastic wrap to prevent drying out, and chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Thai Brochettes
ingredients: 10 ounces mussels | 1 1/2 tablespoons peanut sauce or 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/2 tablespoon chili paste ( or less ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 cup rice cereal, broken | 4 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Scrub and rinse the mussels thoroughly. Trim and debeard the tops and beards. Place the mussels in a colander and sprinkle with the sauce mixture and stir well. Cover and refrigerate to marinate for at least 2 hours but as much as 8 hours, up to 6 hours. Heat a heavy frying pan or wok over high heat with the oil. Add about 4 tbsp. Oil and swirl to coat. When it is hot, add the mussels and stir, then cook, shaking the pan frequently, until the shells just begin to open, about 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from the heat and transfer the mussels to a large bowl. Discard any mussels that have not opened. Transfer about a dozen mussels to another bowl or platter and discard any discolored mussels. Spoon the broth through a fine mesh sieve or fine mesh strainer, into a large, high sided skillet, or heat diffuser and set over moderately high heat. Crush the rice cereal with a fork in a mortar and pestle or large bowl and add to the broth in batches. Add the remaining mussels, cover, and raise the heat to high. Cook for 2 - 4 minutes, or until the cereal is translucent, stirring frequently. Sprinkle with the cinnamon. Transfer the broth to a shallow bowl and let cool. Stir the rice cereal through a fine mesh strainer or a fine mesh sieve into the broth. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with some freshly ground black pepper.

title: Garlic Italian Muffins
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons cake flour | 3/4 cup grated strong mozzarella cheese or 3/4 cup reduced-fat mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary leaves or 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary | 1/2 cup toasted salted cashews
instructions: Whisk the flour, grated cheese, rosemary leaves and salted cashews together, then set aside. Using 2 teaspoon measuring cups, pour the batter evenly on the greased side of the muffin pans. Bake in a 350°f oven 15 - 20 minutes, or until the tops turn golden.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,floury potato,apple juice,mexican cheese,pineapple juice
title: Sweet Stuffed  Grilled  Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium scotch bonnet peppers | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese | 4 medium floury potatoes, peeled and cut into half
instructions: Preheat the grill. Turn the grill on low. Cut a slit in the side of each chile. Remove the seeds with a sharp knife and scrape out the inside of the chile. In a medium mixing bowl, stir together the apple juice, pineapple juice and cheese. Cut 6 1/2 inch circles from the potatoes and fill with about 1 tablespoon of the sweet mixture. Add 1 t. Of the spice mixture. Close the lid and grill for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,celery rib,crabmeat,green apple,banana pepper,bulk italian sausage
title: Italian Sausage and Apples
ingredients: 3/4 lb bulk italian sausage, removed from the casings | 8 cups peeled thinly sliced green apples, such as granny smith apples | 2 celery ribs, sliced thin on the bias | 1 can artichoke heart drained and quartered, liquid reserved | 1/4 cup canned roasted banana peppers, sliced thin | 1 cup drained canned crabmeat
instructions: Heat half the sausage, sliced apples, celery, tomato sauce and 1/2 the artichoke hearts in a large skillet over high heat until heated through, about 5 minutes. Add the remaining artichoke hearts and the banana peppers and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the remaining sausage and crabmeat. Transfer to a large serving bowl and set aside. Serve warm and with extra artichoke hearts and tomato sauce if desired.

title: Puerto Rican Molasses
ingredients: 1 gallon picante sauce | 12 ounces raisins | 10 black peppercorns
instructions: Combine the picante/raisins, raisins, and black peppercorns in a large resealable plastic bag. Seal the bag and shake to blend in the mixture. Allow the mixture to sit at room temperature for 1 hour, shaking the bag every 10 to 15 minutes. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium high heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture is reduced to 1 1/2 gallons of liquid. Remove from the heat and let stand overnight to thicken.

Random Ingredients: demerara sugar,salmon fillet,soymilk,white bread,metal skewer,cayenne,artichoke heart,grapeseed oil
title: Crusty Salmon Skewers with Artichokes
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces dried salmon fillets, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 2 ounces artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 3/4 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons soymilk | 1 tablespoon demerara sugar | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | coarsely ground white bread, crumbs to coat | metal skewers
instructions: Soak anchovies in water 15 minutes meanwhile, heat oil in skillet over moderate heat until just sizzling, then add fish and artichokes.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,wheel brie cheese,red bell pepper
title: Baked Brie
ingredients: 3/4 cup toasted pistachio nuts | 1 wheel brie cheese, halved | 1 large red bell pepper, halved, cored, seeded, and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Spread the pistachio nuts over the entire surface of the brie. Place the red bell pepper onto the pistachios and place onto a baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove brie from the oven and set aside to cool for 15 minutes. Cut into 12 slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,stewing beef,pork tenderloin,parsley sprig,cardamom seed,lemon twist,ketchup
title: Crock Pot Malaysian Pork
ingredients: 1 -2 lb lean stewing beef ( can use pork shoulder, butt, brisket or leg in a cut-up, about 2 cups ) | 1 -2 lb pork tenderloin, fat and membrane cut away | 2 -3 tablespoons ketchup ( can use tomato ketchup if you prefer ) | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds | 1 teaspoon crushed dried parsley | 1 lemon twist | parsley sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot. Cover with lid or tight fitting lid to make slow cooker easier to take out all of the junk. Cook on low for 8 hours, high for 3 - 4 hours. Serve over hot cooked noodles or rice.

title: Vegetable Curd
ingredients: 1 lb swede, peeled and cut into strips | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 can soymilk | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 cup dry panir
instructions: Cook and cube swede. Put it in a large casserole. Add other vegetables, and pour soymilk over top. Mix cornstarch and dry panir together and sprinkle over the mixture. Baking at 350f for 30 minutes, until thick.

title: Rhubarb Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup chopped rhubarb | 1 can bean, drained
instructions: Stir together the mayonnaise and rhubarb. Gently stir in the beans with a fork. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Teriyaki Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1 teaspoon minced fresh oregano leaves
instructions: In a bowl, mix spaghetti sauce, soy sauce, and pineapple. Garnish with oregano before serving.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,green olive,corn oil,cream mushroom soup,orange juice,hamburger bun,matzo meal,clove
title: Pigs in a Roundbag
ingredients: 4 hamburger buns, split | corn oil | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 12 large green olives | 4 slices orange juice | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 8 large ground cloves | ice cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix together first ten ingredients in a large baking dish. Cover with waxed paper and bake for 45 minutes or until onions are tender. Uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes or until meatballs are cooked through and liquid no longer seeps from meatballs.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,sun tomato paste,kale,green cardamom pod,ice,flour
title: Tasty Sesame Cabbage Saute
ingredients: 1 1/2 inches fresh gingerroot, peeled and minced | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato paste | 1/4 cup flour | 1 pint ice | 5 ounces kale, chopped fine ( or other green leafy greens )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine ginger and the crushed cardamom pods. Add sun dried tomato, then stir to coat. Add flour, stir and set aside until ice is firm. In a large nonstick saute pan or saute pan, bring water to boil. Add kale and cook for about 3 - 5 minutes or until bright green. Slightly cool down a little, then drain and place in ice cube trays to catch any fluid. Sprinkle with salt and toss in ginger.

Random Ingredients: gruyere,canola oil,clove,grain mustard,beef stew meat,almond extract
title: Mustard and Almond-Stuffed Beef Cubes
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely chopped toasted almonds | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons canola oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard or 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/8 teaspoon clove | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In a bowl, combine the almonds and beef. Toss with 1 tablespoons canola oil, the mustard, clove and almond extract.

title: Naked Cod in a Proper Summer Bowl
ingredients: 1 large lebanese cucumber | 5 ounces cod | 2 cups cooked long-grain rice ( i like to use jasmine )
instructions: Put a pot of water on to boil. Meanwhile, cut ends off the cucumber with a sharp knife. Cut cucumber lengthwise into half moons and scoop out the white stone. Discard the thick layer of white stone and cut the white stone out of the cucumber using a spoon, discard the stone. Cut cod into pieces and place in a bowl. Add the cooked rice, cucumber and fish pieces to the bowl. Toss well. Enjoy with a smile.

title: Scottish Tablet (Mock Tablet)
ingredients: 1 kg caster sugar | 4 tablespoons salt and white pepper
instructions: Bring the caster sugar, salt and pepper to near boiling point in a large heavy saucepan. Mix well, then set on a low heat and cook gently until the sugar has dissolved. Break the mixture into 5 individual round pieces of roughly equal size. Wrap each piece in wax paper, then chill for 3 hours or until solid. Once chilled, break the tablets into pieces and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: wood ear mushroom,veal cutlet,spring onion,biscuit,pistachio nut,peanut butter,anise seed
title: Veal and Parsley Scrolls
ingredients: 2 large spring onions | 2 teaspoons finely minced unpeeled wooden ear mushrooms ( about 1 cup ) | 1/3 cup plain peanut butter | 1 teaspoon finely minced peeled fresh anise seed | 4 large free range oven ready biscuits | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, toasted | 1 lb veal cutlet, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons sweet roasted pistachio nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line 2 baking trays with baking paper, allowing 2cm sides to extend over sides of tray. Place all spring onions in centre of tray, trimming and folding them over as necessary for even coating. Arrange mushrooms, peanut butter and anise seeds in a large bowl. Stir in meat, then top with biscuits and nuts. Using fingertips, press biscuit mixture onto trays, pressing biscuits into filling. Bake for 15 to 30 minutes, or until biscuits are slightly browned. Cool on baking trays for 10 minutes. Transfer to wire rack to cool completely. Store in airtight container, if not consumed immediately.

title: Champagne Sangria With Peaches
ingredients: 1/2 ripe peach, peeled cored, cut into eighths | 8 1/2 ounces sweet marsala wine
instructions: Fill a large saute pan with water. Add the peach slices and cook over high heat, stirring occasionally, until the peaches begin to soften, about 10 minutes. Immediately transfer the cooked peaches to a platter and keep warm over low heat. When the peaches are almost completely cool, carefully spoon 1/4 cup of the marsala into the hollow jar. Add the remaining 2 1/2 cups of marsala and stir to incorporate. Serve chilled over ice.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 2 cups caster sugar
instructions: Combine the grated zest of 1 lemon and the 1 cup of caster sugar in a bowl and mix well. Place the remaining 1 cup sugar in a clean, airtight container. Sprinkle the grated lemon peel on top and leave at room temperature for about 2 hours. Stir the mixture every so often until the granulatine thickens and becomes brittle. The sugar should not brown at all. Remove from the refrigerator, and leave until cool. Pour a small amount into a clean and airtight container, cover with a layer of greaseproof paper and store in a cool, dark place for 6 weeks or longer. If you can't wait, store your candy in an airtight container until you are ready to use. Refrigerate what you need now or after this period.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,rotel tomato,cream,wild rice,french baguette,egg noodle
title: Wild Rice Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh wild rice | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( i use 1 of those cans ) | 1 cup apple juice | 6 ounces egg noodles | 1 cup sour cream | french baguette, sliced, cut into 1/2 slices and toasted
instructions: Pour the rotel tomatoes and apple juice into a 2 quart casserole dish and set aside. Cook wild rice as directed on the package. Rinse rice under cool water to remove excess water. Stir in the cooked rice and spread in a layer over the bottom of the casserole dish. Top with egg noodles and sour cream. Sprinkle toasted baguette slices over the top.

Random Ingredients: leek,cream mushroom soup,channa dal,yeast,cream tartar,chicken bouillon cube,corn oil
title: Neevelicious Naan Bread!
ingredients: 1 large naan | 3 cups fresh cream of creamy mushroom soup ( can use low-fat ) | 2 teaspoons oil ( i do not use light olive oil ) | 1 can light cream of mushroom soup | 3 -4 leeks, sliced | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon yeast
instructions: Dissolve yeast with the 1 tb water. Mix all the ingredients in the bread pan. Cover and put in a warm spot till bubbling/hot. You can then enjoy with your favorite veggies. Enjoy. If you would like to make your own bread crumbs and bake these for breakfast, i recommend baking them for an hour and a half by my son.

title: Italian Hot Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 bag frozen peas | 1 jar water chestnuts | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 jar maraschino cherries
instructions: In a medium saucepan over low heat combine all ingredients together and warm through, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a bowl and refrigerate. Serve immediately.

title: Adobe Salad
ingredients: 7 ounces honey | 1/2 cup milk | 5 drops sweetened condensed milk | 10 ounces sliced honey | fresh cherries ( optional ) | 1/2 cup old fashioned oats | 1/4 - 1/2 ancho peppers or 1/4-1/2 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon adobo sauce ( from chipotle peppers in adobo sauce to taste ) | 8 slices cucumbers
instructions: To make your slaw, place honey and milk in a saucepan, and heat until it has turned a medium amber color. Stir in the chopped cherries, if using. Let the honey and milk cool slightly. Stir in the oatmeal and stir well. Let sit for 30 minutes before serving. While the honey mixture is cooling or chilling, cut the cucumbers into thin long strips that are 3/4 inch long and crosswise, then transfer to a medium bowl. Add enough of the adobe sauce to thinly coat the cucumbers. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Toss and serve immediately. Note, the salad usually seems to be served at room temperature to be spread onto the salads.

Random Ingredients: cracker,table cream,red wine vinegar,broccoli floret,sesame oil
title: Hot Broccoli and Pepper Spread
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret, trimmed | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 4 tablespoons table cream | cracker, for dusting ( optional )
instructions: Heat a grill pan, grill pan or skillet, add red wine vinegar and sesame oil. Let vinegar infuse and slightly brown broccoli. Remove broccoli from the pan. Whip cream with electric mixer. Add broccoli to the cream and season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve on crackers.

title: Artichokes in Refresher
ingredients: 4 artichokes, trimmed | 1 can pitted prunes, drained | 1 can black olives, drained | 1/2 cup chopped fresh edible fruit ( such as marjoram or d'esperol, chopped red grapes or cherry tomatoes )
instructions: Slice off the top from the artichokes. Cut a heart shape from each artichoke. Place a prune and olive slice in each artichoke heart. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap or heavy duty aluminum foil and place them in a bowl for one hour. Remove the foil or foil and discard the hearts by removing and placing them on a plate. Remove hearts from the bowl and serve immediately. Serve a small dish of fresh edible flowers and the cooking juices with the artichokes.

title: Potato, Dill Pickle, Ham and Prawn Fritters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry dill pickles, finely sliced | 1 large russet potato, peeled and cut into 2cm dice | 75 g fresh greek ham, cut into thin strips | 100 g raw king prawns, peeled and deveined | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper
instructions: Combine 1 tbs cooking oil and the pickle slices in a small bowl. Microwave the potato until warm 1 - 2 mins on medium high, turning once, then transfer to a large bowl of cold water. Set aside for 20 minutes. Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan. Add the ham and cook over a medium heat for 10 mins, then add half the pickle and potato and cook for 6 - 8 mins more. Add the prawns and prawn mixture, season with red pepper. Stir well to combine and cook for 5 minutes or until heated through.

title: Quick Italian Cornflake Rounds
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza crusts | 1/4 cup honey, or as needed | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 4 tablespoons corn flakes, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Press pizza dough onto the prepared baking sheet. Brush dough with honey and italian seasoning. Sprinkle corn flakes on top of dough. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned and crispy, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Lime Shreds
ingredients: 6 egg yolks | 2 limes, juiced | 2 pounds boneless beef chuck
instructions: Whisk the egg yolks and lime juice together in a large bowl. Reserve the lime juice, in a separate container. Add 1 pounds of meat to the lime juice mixture. With your hands, work the meat into the egg yolks and lime juice mixture until thoroughly coated. Allow about 2 minutes of simmering to help soften the meat. Return all the meat to the lime juice mixture, and wrap tightly in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 1 week. When ready to proceed, remove the wrap and grill on a hot grill until the meat shreds easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: couscous,saltine cracker,key lime juice,red enchilada sauce,greek yogurt,rigatoni pasta
title: Taco Bell's Easy Microwave Beef With Lemon Noodles
ingredients: 1 box instant couscous | 12 saltine crackers | 2 key limes, juice of | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 pint greek yogurt | 1 bag rigatoni pasta
instructions: Mix everything but the pasta together in 2 quart microwave safe dish. Cover tightly and microwave on high for 16 minutes on high. Remove lid and cook on high for 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Sausage and Blackberry Raita
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 2 cups soymilk | fresh blackberries | 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage
instructions: Grind coriander seeds, saffron and ground black seeds using a mortar and pestle. Add soymilk in large enough increments to make a thick paste. Mix well and set aside until needed. Crumble and cook sausage using a good, good quality sausage mince. Put meat into a pot with enough water to cook on medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes, until water evaporates and meat is well cooked. Add blackberries just before serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,italian salad dressing mix,margarita mix,chunky salsa,cooking spray
title: Spaetzle with Mexican Salsa
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup margarita mix | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix, such as mixi | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. To prepare salsa, combine the margarita mix, salsa and dry salad dressing mix in a bowl. Stir in the oil. Spread evenly in dish. Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, or until the center of the mixture has the desired firmness, or until lightly browned. Use a spatula to loosen the cooked pasta and to separate it into a flatter shape. Remove to a serving plate and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,saffron,vegetable oil cooking spray,corn tortilla chip,italian herb seasoning,tahini
title: Italian Nachos - Nachos Diabetic Friendly
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 3/4 cup patted greek yogurt ( low fat is great ) | 1/4 cup tahini | 2 teaspoons dried italian herb seasoning ( plus more, for sprinkling ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron ( more for sprinkling ) | corn tortilla chips, broken in 2 or 3 pieces for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly spray an 11 x 7 baking pan with vegetable oil. Combine yogurt, tahini, zest of 1 1/2 teaspoons of oregano, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and 1 1/2 teaspoons basil in a large bowl. Stir until smooth. Dip chips in yogurt mixture and arrange in baking pan. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 teaspoons oregano. Bake until nachos are lightly golden and crispy, about 14 to 16 minutes. Serve hot with warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,self raising flour,cinnamon,dijon mustard,red chili pepper
title: Baked Devil's Food Scones
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 2 teaspoons powdered cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, crushed
instructions: Sift the dry ingredients into a bowl and using a fork mix the mustard with the chili and set aside. Sift the dry mixture again into the dry ingredients, and mix well, adding flour as necessary. Turn out onto a lightly floured board. Knead for 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic. Roll out into 2 rounds. Using a sharp knife, cut into scone shapes. Place on baking tray, brush tops with a little oil or melted butter. Bake at 220 degrees for 12 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Simple Chicken Rice Flour Patties
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs chicken tenders ( or your favorite ) | 1/4 cup rice flour | 1/8 teaspoon cumin powder | 4 drops tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup hot tapasco sauce
instructions: The general directions say to season the chicken with salt & pepper on both sides. Dry chicken and set aside. In a food processor, combine the rice flour, cumin & tabasco. Process for 1 minute. Add the hot tapa or other sauce to taste and process 1 minute more or until all dry ingredients are incorporated. The marinade should not be lumpy but fairly sticky. Place chicken pieces in zip lock bag and pour in marinade. Refrigerate overnight. Heat grill pan over high heat. Oil grate and remove chicken from marinade. Cook chicken on both sides until lightly browned. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,red curry paste,icing sugar,pea
title: Namvu Podi (Sweet Pea Pancakes With Chiles)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red curry paste ( to taste ) | 1 can split peas, drained ( about 1/2 cup split peas ) | 2 -3 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 teaspoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped for garnish
instructions: Heat the curry paste in a frying pan until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Spread the split peas in a sieve to collect excess liquid. Scatter the peas over the paste and allow to sit for 5 minutes, then drain off any excess liquid. Heat a non stick deep frying pan over medium high. Add the icing sugar and spread out the mixture thinly. Using a pancake grater, scoop out the pices of the pancake, leaving a 1/2 inch thick pancake. Add the pancake and gently press with the back of a large spoon. Fry, turning the pancake frequently, until the underside is golden, about 3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the pancake to a plate lined with paper towels. Sprinkle with parsley and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red onion,basmati rice,prosciutto,mozzarella cheese,cumin powder,irish cream
title: Irish Rice and Avocado Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked basmati rice | 2 slices prosciutto, cut diagonally into 1/2 inch slices ( thick or thinly sliced ) | 2 tablespoons red onions, chopped | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/4 cup guinness irish cream ( or other irish cream ) or 1/4 cup irish whiskey ( or other irish cream ) | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Cook rice as instructed on package. Drain rice, cool on paper towels, remove & slice. Place rice & proscuitto slices on a serving platter. Top with onion & cumin, drizzle on guinness or other liquor, & top with mozzarella cheese. Note, if using guinness or other liquor omit the 1/2 cup cheese.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,icing sugar,italian bread,cucumber,chevre cheese goat,rigatoni pasta,pumpkin puree
title: Sweet Italian Bread Salad
ingredients: 10 -12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 12 ounces chevre cheese ( or other firm goat cheese ) | 2 cups cucumbers, diced ( preferably english or italian cucumbers ) | 1 cup pumpkin puree | 3 tablespoons white vinegar or 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 cup icing sugar | italian bread, cut into 1 inch slices ( such as italian flat bread or bounet )
instructions: Cook rigatoni per package instructions. Drain and let dry. Cut cheese into cubes. Grate cucumbers. Combine the cheeses, cucumbers, pumpkin and vinegar in a small bowl. Dress with icing sugar and serve over the rigatoni.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Chicken - OAMC
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves or 4 chicken thighs, bone-in | 2 vanilla beans
instructions: Using a grill pan or grill pan on the stovetop cook the chicken until it turns dark on the bone and the meat is cooked through. Allow to stand for 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,scotch bonnet pepper,tomato green chile pepper,potato flake,zucchini,horseradish,orange peel,golden syrup
title: Baked Zucchini Hash with Orange Peel
ingredients: 2 pounds potatoes, peeled and grated | 2 pounds zucchini, sliced | 1 cup shredded orange peel | 1 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 10 scotch bonnet peppers, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 3 tablespoons scotch bonnet pepper sauce, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the potatoes, zucchini, orange peel, golden syrup, shortening, scotch bonnet peppers, horseradish, and hot pepper sauce together in a pot until thoroughly combined. Place sausage links in a baking dish and pour in the hot dressing mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until hot, 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,jicama,italian seasoning,vegetable oil,jasmine rice,pomegranate molasses,spanish olive pimento
title: Jicama Beef Pot Sticker Bowls
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 4 equal pieces | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 cup jicama, peeled & cut into 3/4-inch-thick rounds | 1/2 cup pomegranate molasses | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/2 cup spanish olives with pimentos, pitted | 2 -3 cups jasmine rice, cooked
instructions: Place meat in a bowl with seasoning and italian dressing.

title: Authentic Authentic Mexican Red Rice
ingredients: 15 jalapanese anaheim chilies, seeded, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups white rice | 1 1/2 cups filtered water | 1 cup chicken broth
instructions: Mix the rice, water and chicken broth together in a pan. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to medium low. Cook 25 minutes until liquid is absorbed.

title: Corned Artichokes and Corn with Barley
ingredients: 1 package corpcrew macaroni | 1 can baby corn, drained, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup pearl barley, uncooked | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the corncobs over medium heat in boiling water until just tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Roasted Noodles and Feta Cheese
ingredients: 12 tablespoons crumbled feta | 1 lb lasagna noodle | 1 cup water | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 1 chili pepper flakes, optional. ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne or 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1 head lettuce, washed dry or 1 head cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Put feta in a bowl and toss with lasagna noodles. Spray a deep baking pan with nonstick spray. Bake in oven about 9 minutes or until hot. Drain, and add hot sauce and remaining ingredients. Toss well, adjust seasonings to taste. Serve on a bed of lettuce.

title: Italian Shiitake Mushroom Shish Kebabs
