ingredients: 2 lbs shiitake mushrooms ( about 3 large pieces ) | 1/3 cup italian salad dressing or 1/3 cup miracle whip
instructions: Place mushrooms in bowl.

title: Beef in Spinach, Tapas Style
ingredients: 3 lbs top sirloin steak, trimmed of gristle | 3 lbs baby spinach, trimmed | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Heat a dutch oven, large skillet, or electric skillet to 300 degrees f. Slice the beef into thin strips about an inch wide and 3/8 inch thick. Place in the skillet and brown on all sides, about 12 minutes. Transfer the beef strips to a plate and cover with cold water. The beef fat should be left on the top, then cover and steam the beef for another hour or longer. Drain off all but about 2 tbs of the fat. Tear off pieces of the spinach so that they measure about 1 1/2 cups. Place in a colander and drain about 7 - 10 minutes over a bowl if they are not completely dry. Pat dry with paper towels. Set aside. Return the skillet to 300 degrees f. Add the spinach and reserved fat to the skillet with the salt and toss until nearly all of the spinach is coated with oil. Reduce the heat to 300 degrees f. Place the beef in the heated skillet. Scrape the bottom and side of the pan to insure a well formed and well flavored crust. Cover tightly and cook for 2 hours, or until the beef is tender, adding water if necessary. Taste the beef for doneness, remove and discard the salt, and transfer the beef to a serving platter. Spoon off all but about 2 tbs of fat from the skillet and return to the stove. Turn heat up to high, add the tapas style spinach, and stir to coat with oil. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,caraway seed,green pea,hot green chili pepper,artichoke heart
title: Crock Pot Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained | 6 canned green peas | 2 cups chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 1 -2 hot green chili pepper, minced and seeded
instructions: Empty the contents of the jar into the crock pot. Add all the remaining ingredients. Cook on low setting, stirring often. Keep crock pot on high heat setting while you cook the rest of the meal, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: ice,phyllo dough,palm sugar,fenugreek seed,greek yogurt,worcestershire sauce,jasmine rice,guacamole
title: Phyllo Rice Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo dough ( i use 3 sheets ) | 1 cup uncooked jasmine rice | 1 cup light greek yogurt ( greek cream cheese spread ) | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 cup ice | 8 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly oil a 9x13 inch baking pan. In a saucepan, bring 1 cup water to a boil. Add rice and remove from heat. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes. In a small bowl, combine yogurt, sugar, worcestershire sauce and fenugreek seeds. Set aside. Pour the chilled rice into a mixing bowl, and then pour in the cheese spread, mixing until smooth. Spread rice mixture onto phyllo sheets. Cover with a damp dish towel. Place a sheet of phyllo on top, then place another sheet of phyllo on top, cutting off excess. Using the palm of your hand, carefully fold the sheets around each other until they’re tightly packed but tight enough to wrap around each other. Do this with about 10 sheets, but you may need more. If your phyllo sheets are large, you may have to fold them in half or thirds to fit the size of the pan you’ll be using. Place the phyllo sheets in a large baking pan. Repeat to make the phyllo dough, spraying each sheet with oil periodically. Spread the rice mixture evenly across the phyllo sheets. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Allow phyllo to cool slightly before removing from pan.

title: Creamy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup peanuts | 1 jar capers | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 package cream cheese
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine all the ingredients. Blend well and transfer to a saucepan. Stir and heat for 20 minutes. Serve over cooked white rice.

title: Crispy Dipping Sauce - Spanish Onion Broth
ingredients: 1 medium spanish onion | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 cup cashews
instructions: Peel the onion and slice it into thin thick rounds. Put it in a bowl with the remaining ingredients and mix together well. Let it sit on the counter top for an hour or more to let the onion absorb all the flavours before serving.

Random Ingredients: mustard,dark red kidney bean,sirloin,cardamom seed,lemon peel,white wine,pork,single cream
title: Beef and Bean Casserole
ingredients: 500 g sirloin, cut into thin slices | 2 cups beef or 2 cups pork fat, cut into thin slices | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 25 g lemon peel, finely shredded | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, crushed | 15 g mustard | 1 can dark red kidney beans | 300 ml single cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Toss sirloin, pork fat, wine, lemon peel and cardamom seeds together in a large ovenproof dish. Season with pepper. Spread kidney beans over dish. Cook for 10 minutes. Stir cream through and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Pour over sirloin and bean mixture. Bake uncovered for about 15 to 20 minutes until meat is tender. Top with lemon slice.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,lobster,kielbasa,red curry paste,cream cottage cheese,mix,bean
title: Lobster Casserole
ingredients: 1 bunch lobster | 1 cup low fat sour cream-style cottage cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 -2 cup cooked noodles or can pasta noodles | 3/4 cup low fat light cream-style cottage cheese | 3 tablespoons red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 -2 fresh red chili powder
instructions: Remove lobster from shell, remove heads. Remove lobster meat from intestines, wash and remove pices. Slice meat and set aside. In a medium size frying pan on medium high heat combine the cream cheese, cottage cheese, creamstyle cottage cheese, red curry paste, chili powder and red chilly powder. Place lobster meat in frying pan and gently saute for 5 - 10 minutes until well cooked and lobster has cooked. Once heated through add the fresh red chili sauce mix well. Pour mixture in a round casserole dish, add cooked noodles and sprinkle top with shredded red pepper.

title: Danish Pasta with Cheddar, Wild Mushrooms and Prunes
ingredients: 350 g creme fraiche | 125 g pitted prunes, halved | 1/2 head green cabbage, shredded | 1 1/2 kg wild mushrooms, stalks removed, caps sliced | 125 g cheddar cheese, grated | 200 g cod, smoked
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c combine creme fraiche, prunes, cabbage, mushrooms and cheese in a deep, shallow casserole. Cover and put in oven for 45 mins, until cheese is melted and plump and cabbage has softened. Place on serving dish and serve with smoked cod.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,black grape,red capsicum,red chili powder,mint
title: Garlic and Chilli Jam
ingredients: 1/2 kg black grapes | 25 g garlic cloves | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 25 g of chopped fresh mint | 1 red capsicum
instructions: Wash, remove seeds of chilli if using fresh chillies. Cut grapes and capsicum into small pieces. Grind chilli powder with 50g of water and salt with a little water. Crush garlic into a fine paste with 50g water. Add chopped mint and chilli powder mixture. Mix well. Add grapes and capsicum pieces. Blend well. Add 3 4tsp water. Mix. Cook on medium flame for 15 minutes. Allow to cool before opening lid and pressing. Serve chilled.

title: Peaches - Stuffed Peaches
ingredients: 12 medium fresh peaches, ripe ( or 1 1/4 lbs. frozen, sliced peaches ) | 4 sprigs mint leaves | fresh jalapeno pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Combine the peaches, mint and jalapeno. Scoop the pecorino over the top and decorate with slivers.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,chicken bouillon granule,raisin,flat leaf italian parsley,cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheddar Broccoli Cheese
ingredients: 1 package frozen cut broccoli cuts ( thawed, if fresh ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/2 cup grated medium sharp cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup raisins, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and immediately immerse in ice water until cool enough to handle. Pat gently dry with paper towel. Drain well and chop coarsely. Coat large skillet with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Add cheddar, raisins and 1/4 c parsley. Cook and stir until cheese is melted. Stir in broccoli, remaining parsley and bouillon granules.. Remove from heat. Sprinkle the remaining 1 t parsley evenly over the top of the mixture and serve.

title: South African Green Cardamom Salsa
ingredients: 6 green cardamom | 3 -4 scallions, chopped ( green part only ) | 3 cups of bottled salsa | 3 large eggs
instructions: Wash and chop green cardamom and scallion. In a heavy skillet heat the salsa on medium high heat, stirring often to keep from burning. Add the chopped green cardamom and scallion to the salsa and mix together. Add 3 eggs and reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 5 - 7 minutes. Serve hot. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,pizza sauce,lemon extract,asparagus,bamboo shoot
title: Lemon and Asparagus Pizza Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1/4 cup red currant jelly | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 can pizza sauce
instructions: Cook the asparagus until tender crisp. Drain, and cool. While the asparagus is still warm, slice the bamboo shoots, then remove all of the tough ends. Dice the asparagus and bamboo shoots. In a bowl, combine the jelly, lemon extract, and hot pizza sauce. Add to the asparagus and bamboo shoots. Mix together well. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour before serving.

title: Stuffing for Perogies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry yeast | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon ( optional ) | 2/3 cup warm water | 1 cup pea ( fresh or frozen, thawed ) | 1 cup canned sliced bamboo shoot, drained (, or canned drained well, including juice ) | 1 envelope dry seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yeast, bouillon and water and let sit 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Place in a greased 5 1/2 quart round or square pan. Cover and let rise until doubled in size and bubbly, about 1 1/2 hours, depending on the size of the pan. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden. Let cool for about 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: green chile,green enchilada sauce,stir fry beef
title: Mexican Beef in Green Sauce
ingredients: stir-fry beef round roast | 2 cans green enchilada sauce | 1 can diced green chiles
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil.

title: Baked Peach & Sultana Dressing
ingredients: 7 tablespoons skim milk margarine, cut in cubes | 4 1/2 ounces peach juice | 8 ounces sultanas | 1/4 cup pecan pieces, chopped | 1/4 cup dried apricot, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put into a microwave safe bowl. Heat on full power. Stir occasionally until dressing is warm to the touch. Stir every 15 minutes. Pour onto cold baked bread, toast, bread will crisp up.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,tea,breakfast sausage link,salad oil,lemon peel
title: Spicy Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 lb breakfast sausage link or 1 lb hot german sausage | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh lemon peel | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 2 teaspoons tea | 1 teaspoon crushed dried lemon peel
instructions: In a skillet or saute pan, crumble sausage meat or hot. Cook until brown and crumbly, crumbling when removed from heat. Cool, then mix in 2 tbsp salad oil, 1 tsp lemon peel, chili paste and remaining ingredients. Chill thoroughly or serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,chinese cabbage,vodka,baking apple,steak,cream mushroom soup
title: Chinese Colcannon
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup irish breakfast liqueur or 1/2 cup vodka | 2 cups shredded chinese cabbage | 1 carrot | 1 apple | steak, slices | rye bread
instructions: Drain the cabbage. Slice up the apple then slice it into thin wedges. Shake out the excess moisture when done. Slice the steak into bite sized pieces. Layer meat in a casserole dish. Drain the soup in the can, but reserve all of the sauce. Then add the soup with the vodka or liqueur and mix well. Pour over the top of meat. Sprinkle the carrot and apple evenly over the top. Bake at 350 degrees for 45min to 1 hour. Serve with rye bread.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,cider,leek,gruyere cheese,lemon juice,fast rise yeast,ice water
title: Cheese and Leek Sticks
ingredients: 2 cups crushed ice water | 1/2 cup cider | 1 teaspoon fast rise yeast | 1 1/2 cups leeks, trimmed, sliced thin and washed well, and drained | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons green peppers, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons lemon juice
instructions: Fill a large bowl with ice water and pour in cider. Sprinkle the yeast over the surface and let stand for 10 minutes to soften. Add leeks and cheese and stir to combine. Stir in green pepper. Add lemon juice and enough additional ice water to the yeast mixture to make 3 cups of sticky dough. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead to smooth. Place in a large greased bowl and turn so it fits over. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour and 45 minutes. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface and punch down and divide dough into 24 even balls. Dust each ball with a little of the extra lemon juice and shape into a ball. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside until doubled, about 2 hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Using a rolling pin, roll out the dough into a 15 inch long circle. Using a thin sharp knife, make a cut in the center of the dough, going 2/3 of the way from the edge to the middle. Slide the dough twists, 1/2 at a time, into the oiled and floured parchment paper lined cookie sheet and press down again. Bake in the preheated oven until browned and crusty, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,sherry wine,filet beef,chicken wing
title: Chinese Style Beef
ingredients: 1 whole chicken wings, separated | 1/2 cup chinese rice wine or 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 3 lbs filet of beef
instructions: Place the wings, rice wine, sesame oil and beef in a large zipper lock bag and marinate in refrigerator overnight. Remove beef from the marinade and grill over medium hot coals 15 minutes per side for medium rare, longer if you want to do it the long way on a gas grill for medium well. The meat is done when it flakes easily when pierced with a fork. Drain on paper towels and serve with your choice of dishes.

title: Apple Curry (Kirma Kebabs)
ingredients: 1 package frozen apple slices ( i like red prince ) | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Microwave frozen apple slices on high, covered, for 2 minutes. Drain. In skillet, add apple slices and sesame oil. Stir fry for a minute on high, stirring constantly. Serve hot. Cooking tips, i like to fry the pieces in a vegetable oil to prevent them from sticking together. For thicker results, place apples in a mixing bowl and drain excess liquid. For thinner results, leave them covered, then microwave on high for 20 seconds. Tip, to prevent apple slices from sticking, place them in ice cube trays or plastic bags. This prevents them from sticking together. You can also use a potato masher to mash the curry powder. For thicker results, microwave for 2 minutes.

title: Paleo Muffins
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1 lb shell pasta, cooked | 2 -3 drops red food coloring
instructions: Combine hamburger and chopped egg in large bowl and mix well. Add cooked shells, food coloring, and red food coloring.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice, rinsed and drained | 1 can green chilies, or to taste
instructions: Combine rice, chiles, and green chiles in a bowl.

title: Lentils and Asparagus With Cracked Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean beef chunks or 6 ounces lean ground beef | 1 pinch ground cumin | ice water ( as much as you need to make mixture ) | 4 stalks yellow sweet peppers, sliced in to pieces | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 1/4 cup dry lentils
instructions: Mix a little bit of the ice water with spices and rub over the beef or lamb.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,jumbo shrimp,baby bella mushroom,pepper,sea scallop,chipotle chile,garlic clove,malt vinegar
title: Chipotle Grilled Scallops and Mushrooms With a Kick
ingredients: 2 cups baby bella mushrooms | 1 1/2 garlic cloves | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons mori nuoc cham southwest chipotle chiles | 1 teaspoon sea scallops | 1/4 teaspoon cracked pepper | 1 lb jumbo shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped sun-dried tomatoes ( such as sun-dried tomatoes in oil )
instructions: Trim mushrooms but do not remove stems. Wipe excess moisture off scallops. Place mushrooms and garlic in medium saucepan and stir in pesto and chile peppers with 1 1/4 cup water. Heat just to boiling, then reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, or until liquid is reduced by 1/4. Stir in scallops and pepper. Cover and set aside 1 hour. Heat heavy medium fry pan over medium high heat until very hot.. Add shrimp and cook 1 minute on each side or until shrimp are curled and just opaque in center. Remove scallops from pan and arrange on heated plate. Spoon mushroom sauce over and sprinkle with tomatoes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,chicken stock,kangaroo fillet,red chili pepper,large shrimp,chorizo sausage,black,pumpkin puree
title: Kangaroo and Prawn Casserole
ingredients: 300 g chorizo sausage, diced | 1 1/2 cups pumpkin puree | 1 can chicken stock | 200 g blackened prawns, small peeled and chopped | 4 kangaroo fillets, large sliced into thick rings | 2 red chili peppers, sliced | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Heat oven to moderate. Heat a large saucepan over medium. Add chorizo, pumpkin, cornflour and stock and stir until thickened. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Season with salt and pepper and set aside until needed. Arrange kangaroo in an ovenproof dish. Top with chorizo mixture and chilli. Pour the sauce over and bake 30 minutes or until the prawns are cooked through. Serve the kangaroo topped with prawns and chili.

title: Easiest Ricotta Pie
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced chile sauce | 1 teaspoon dried minced chile in adobo | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed and patted dry | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 1 small onion, finely chopped
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat and preheat the oven's broiler. Stir together the ricotta and mayonnaise in a bowl. Stir in the chile sauce, dried chiles and diced onion. On a lightly floured surface roll out the pastry into a rectangle 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick. Using a 2 1/2 inch round cutter, cut into three 4 inch squares. Place about 1 tablespoon of ricotta mixture on half of each square. Roll up the pastry snugly and pinch the edges with a fork. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. On a baking sheet spread the pastry out. Repeat with the remaining sheets and filling. Bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes. Serve warm. Variation, substitute chicken. Shredded carrots, chopped fresh cheddar cheese, thinly sliced mushrooms, or hot cooked cauliflower for the ricotta.

Random Ingredients: skewer,white onion,thyme leaf,sun tomato oil,black mustard seed,portabella mushroom,pepperoncini pepper
title: Causa Ya Ya Ya
ingredients: 6 portabella mushrooms ( or your favourite mushrooms ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil ( or use 2 tbsp dried sun dried tomato that is used in the brine ) | 1 cup of sliced white onion ( or use 1/4 cup of sliced onions ) | 3 -5 pepperoncini peppers ( pickled red peppers ) | 1 tablespoon thyme leaves | 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | skewer
instructions: Slice mushrooms in half and arrange in a serving bowl. Mince peppers and place in serving bowl. Peel onions and slice very thinly. Add all remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover with saran wrap and refridgerate for at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: polenta,madeira wine,cannellini bean,asafoetida powder,french ladyfinger cooky
title: Cannellini Beans and Arepas
ingredients: 2 containers cannellini beans | 6 ounces country-style polenta | 4 french-style ladyfinger cookies, cut lengthwise in half | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon madeira wine
instructions: In a stockpot, combine beans with enough water to cover the beans. Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Add polenta and cook gently for 10 minutes, stirring often to prevent polenta from sticking to the bottom of the pot. Cover and continue cooking until beans are tender, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cut polenta into 1/2 inch cubes and stir in the arepas and cook until the arepas are warm. Transfer arepas to a platter and sprinkle with the arepas and cooking sauce. Add french style ladyfinger cookies and serve.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,arborio rice,green chilies,brown onion,balsamic vinegar,mustard
title: Mexican-Style Rice (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice ( about 1.5 cups ) or 2 cups valencia rice ( about 1.5 cups ) | 2 tablespoons light brown onion, diced | 1 can chopped green chilies | 2 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 1 teaspoon mustard
instructions: Stir rice, onions, chiles, vinegar, and oregano in 2 quart slow cooker until well combined. Cover and cook on low heat setting 7 to 8 hours or high heat setting 5 to 6 hours. Cover and set aside. Shake or stir rice mixture in small dish to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,romaine lettuce,aubergine,red chilies,pigeon pea,marjoram,vegetable,queso fresco
title: Peruvian Oaxacan Vegetable Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 head romaine lettuce, washed, dried and chopped fine | 3 medium sauvignon blanc red chilies, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons of oil | 1 small aubergine, chopped | 1 can pigeon peas, drained, rinsed, drained and mashed | 1/4 cup crumbled queso fresco | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram
instructions: Cut the meat into 4 or 5 serving sized burger sized pieces. Thread meat onto skewers. Grill or broil the meat, turning occasionally, until browned. Place meat on a serving platter and cover with aluminum foil set over the same platter. Cover tightly with foil and keep warm in a 200f degrees oven. Fry the chilies in the vegetable oil until the chilies are softened and they pop. Remove the chilies with a slotted spoon or fork and place them in a blender container. Heat the oil or oil in a large skillet. Add the onions and sauté until they are light brown. Stir in the chilies. Add the beef pieces and stir fry until the meat begins to cook on all sides. Return the stuffed chilies to the skillet and add the mashed pigeon peas. Cover, reduce heat to medium and cook for 1 1/4 hours, stirring occasionally. The beans will be tender and the mixture will be a thick, reddish color. Garnish with chopped fresh marjoram leaf. Serve hot, either on the side or on the side.

title: Pesto Spinach Nests
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 2 spring onions, trimmed | 1 package spaghetti sauce
instructions: Blanch spinach according to package directions.

title: Chipotle Muffins
ingredients: 2 eggs | 1 -2 canned chipotle chile pepper, finely minced ( from a can )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Heat a 12 inch muffin tin in the microwave for a few seconds on medium to warm the muffin tin. Pour 1/4 cup of the chipotle puree into a small bowl and set aside. Beat the eggs and the remaining chipoltes in a large bowl. Fold in the egg mixture and then transfer to a greased muffin tin. Bake for approx 25 minutes or until an inserted toothpick inserted in the center of the muffin comes out clean. Remove from oven and remove toothpicks. Cool for 5 minutes, then lift out and cool completely on wire rack.

title: Mexican Style Spaghetti
ingredients: 7 1/2 cups cooked spaghetti | 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce ( any kind ) | 1/8 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso powder ( or more, to taste ) | 1 envelope active dry yeast | 1 lime
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees. Grease an 8 x 8 inch loaf pan and line with parchment paper. Combine spaghetti, sauce, nuts, espresso powder, yeast, and lime juice in a large bowl, stir well. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 10 minutes. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Spoon spaghetti into prepared pan. Bake 1 hour 15 minutes. Cool 15 minutes. Remove plastic wrap from loaf.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,red curry paste,vegetable bouillon cube,coconut,sirloin
title: Curried Beef, Nam Pla and Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin, chopped into 1/4 inch cubes | 16 ounces coconut, cut into thin slices | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 8 ounces rice noodles or 8 ounces egg noodles
instructions: In a large nonstick frypan, combine meat with coconut slices and vegetable bouillon. Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes or until meat is no longer pink drain off any excess coconut milk or liquid. Cook noodles according to package directions. Rinse noodles with cold water and place in a bowl. Add meat, coconut and curry paste to noodles and toss to combine. Serve.

title: Shredded Lebkuchen (Corned Beet)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 lemon, juice of ( the flesh only ) | 1 lb beet, washed and very finely grated ( about 7 cups ) | 3 ounces lean ham, cut into 1in x1/2in sticks | 1/2 lb gruyere, cut into 1in x1in strips | 1 small peeled beet, washed, leaves washed, spun dry, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f in a large ovenproof saucepan, heat the oil and cumin over a gentle heat. Add the lemon juice and simmer for 1 minute. Add the beet, ham and gruyere and stir throughly. Cover and bake in the oven, stirring occasionally until the beet has wilt, about 2 hours, stir in the mixed pickles, put the pan in the oven, and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, until heated through, and heated through, stirring through the beet leaves.

title: Orange, Apricot and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh asparagus, ends trimmed | 3 tablespoons chopped apricots ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 4 -6 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Cook the asparagus in boiling water for 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and add the apricots and orange zest. Toss with the salad greens. Chill before serving. This is great topped with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: achiote paste,bell pepper,brown sugar,allspice,heavy cream,iceberg lettuce,chipotle chile,extra sharp cheddar cheese
title: Chipotle Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 cups heavy cream | 1 chipotle chile ( see note ) | 1/4 teaspoon anchoise paste ( see note ) | 1/2 - 1 lb extra-sharp cheddar cheese, finely grated ( may substitue swiss or gruyere, 1/4 cup may be enough ) | 1/2 cup light brown sugar, packed | 1/2 tablespoon achiote paste ( see notes ) | 1/2 tablespoon ground allspice | 1 lb iceberg lettuce, separated | 3/4 cup finely chopped bell pepper
instructions: Note, depending on the chipotle pepper used in your recipes, you may need to grind the chile and/or cheddar. Make sure chile is seeded and is not minced. Bring cream to boil in medium saucepan, add chipotle and anchoise paste. Reduce heat and simmer about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, combine cheddar cheese, brown sugar, achiote paste, ground allspice and achiote paste. Set aside. Slice lettuce into 1 inch thick leaves of cotining wheels. Dollop sour cream over the lettuce. Sprinkle with peppers. Chop chile into 1/4 inch squares, garnish with a sprig of parsley.

Random Ingredients: black bean,maraschino cherry,chicken bouillon,white flour,water artichoke heart,buttermilk
title: Mashed Black Bean Artichokes
ingredients: 2 cans water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and roughly chopped | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1 1/2 cups white flour | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup diced maraschino cherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly oil an 11x15 inch baking dish. Whisk together the black beans, buttermilk, flour, and chicken bouillon. Pour bean mixture in to the prepared dish, and bake for 25 to 35 minutes, until well bubbling and brown.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,mozzarella cheese,vanilla bean,white bread,tea,fruit,yellow pepper
title: Pigs in a Bread Bowl
ingredients: 4 small loaves day old bread | 1 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 cup diced yellow pepper | 1/2 cup diced mixed candied fruit | 1/4 cup tea ( i used herbal liqueur ) | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Cut all the ingredients into pieces about 1 x3. Cut off the top crust of the loaves. Slice the bread in half lengthwise. Remove the bread crust from the bread bowl and wrap one half of the sliced bread in the foil. Place in the oven for 5 minutes at 450 degrees f. Remove the foil and wrap the other half of the bread in the foil. Bake for another 5 to 7 minutes until crispy. Remove from oven and slice in a large serving bowl. Drizzle a little tea or water and some of the vanilla bean on top. Place another serving bowl over the bowl to weigh the bread. Place a piece of bread on top of the tea and top with another piece of bread. Cut the last piece of bread in half and top with a piece of bread. Wrap the cheese and pieces of bread in the bottom slice of bread and secure with a toothpick. Repeat with the other bread and serve topped with some tea and vanilla beans.

title: Mexican Pecan Candy With Cocoa, Chocolate, and Green Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup dried cranberries, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped pecans ( optional ) | 4 green onions, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups milk
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the cocoa and cranberries. Set aside. In a wok or skillet over medium high heat, stir in pecans and green onions. Set aside. In a medium size bowl, stir the milk with the cocoa mixture until smooth. Gradually whisk in the pecans and green onion mixture. Cook and stir until mixture comes to a simmer, stirring constantly. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. When you are ready to serve, stir in the pecan mixture and use a slotted spoon to remove candy from the bowl onto serving plates. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,farfalle pasta,chive,black pepper,red chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Baked Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb fresh farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) or 1 lb other spiral shaped pasta ( bowtie ) | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes, to taste | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce, to taste | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and then cook pasta until al dente, about 8 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup in the pot. Drain pasta and set aside. Return pot to burner and add remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Heat through, stirring often, about 3 minutes.

title: Gordita - Greek Easter Eggs and Almonds
ingredients: 2 lbs dark red kidney beans | 1 hard-boiled egg ( optional ) | 1 lemon ( optional ) | 3 whole almonds ( optional )
instructions: Place the beans and a small amount of water in a pot and cook until the beans are cooked, but not mushy. Remove the beans from the heat, drain and mash with the hard boiled egg and lemon juice. Add some more water if neccessary. If the mash becomes to thick, stir in a little more water. Add the almonds and blend. Serve in a small, criss cross formation, like a ring. You can garnish with grated parmesan cheese, pita, or a small amount of your personal favorite filling. Great for an evening snack.

title: Flounder (Curried Catfish)
ingredients: 2 whole flounder fillets | 1 container greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon curry
instructions: Place fish in large non metal bowl. Mix yogurt, chicken bouillon and curry in a small bowl. Pour yogurt mixture over fish. Cover and let stand at room temp. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or overnight in the refrigerator. Place fish in a shallow glass baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until fish flakes easily.

Random Ingredients: non dairy topping,fettuccini pasta,self rising flour
title: Fettuccini Primavera
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour | 1 package dry fettuccini pasta | non-dairy topping
instructions: Cook fettuccini in a large pot of boiling water for 8 minutes. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, in another large bowl, mix flour and 1/2 cup of non dairy topping. Add the cooked fettuccini and fold. Add the rest of the non dairy topping. Spread the batter over the top of the coated pasta.

title: Chickpea, Mushroom & Garlic Tarts
ingredients: 300 g mushrooms, thickly sliced | 400 g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 100 ml double cream or 100 ml creme fraiche | 300 g ready to serve fresh grape leaves, washed and dried
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 c or 350 degrees f. Line 4 individual oven trays with baking paper. Using a teaspoon, drop mushroom slices, in all at once, into melted fat. Turn to ensure both sides are coated evenly. Arrange trays on kitchen paper. Cook for 10 minutes or until firm. Drain, dry and set aside. Combine chickpeas, cream or creme fraiche and mushrooms in a large bowl. Spoon into a pastry bag fitted with a medium size plain tip. Seal well and transfer to a pastry bag fitted with a round tip. Repeat with remaining mixture. Arrange on lightly greased trays and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden and cooked through. Top with a large sage leaf.

title: Raspberry Jelly
ingredients: 1 package fresh raspberries with preserves | green food coloring ( optional ) | white vinegar, enough to dissolve the food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Mix green food coloring and vinegar together, then pour into jelly jars. Shake before using. Note, if desired, sprinkle green jelly with a small amount of white sugar while it is still hot.

title: Mexican Guacamole
ingredients: 3 tablespoons guacamole, finely minced | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: white onion,apple jelly,lettuce leaf,broccoli rabe,italian seasoning,cottage cheese
title: Cheesy Broccoli Rabe Salad
ingredients: 4 cups broccoli rabe | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese | 1 medium white onion, diced | 1/2 cup reduced fat italian-style stuffing mix and salad dressing mix | 4 lettuce leaves, to serve | 1 -2 tablespoon apple jelly or 1 -2 tablespoon white sugar
instructions: To make the dressing, mix all ingredients together in a small food processor or blender. Add 1/2 cup water if dressing is too thick and/or if too thin. Serve over or alongside the veggies.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,shallot,red chili pepper,dark brown sugar,carrot
title: Thai Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 6 medium carrots, cut into 2-inch thick rounds | 1 large shallot, thinly sliced | 2 small red chili peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 12 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f with a sharp knife, cut carrot diagonally into ¼ inch thick rounds. Place 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds in center of each round.

title: Shake and Bake Mexican Appetizers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups salsa verde ( homemade is best ) | 4 cups mexican blend cheese, blend | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup white flour | 4 teaspoons tamari | 1/2 cup soda water | shake and bake crust ( white )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a bowl, stir together salsa verde, mexican cheese blend, colby cheese, flour, tamari and soda water. Cut four 1/2 circle wedges from the baking sheet so it looks like a triangle. Fill centers of dough with salsa verde mixture. Bake 8 to 10 minutes, until bubbly. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Serve with salsa. Variation, substitute cream cheese or a combination of cheese flavor.

Random Ingredients: clove,cottage cheese,chocolate chip,red pepper,russet potato,liqueur,hard egg
title: Potato Lollies from the Famous Rao and New York Times
ingredients: 2 lbs idaho russets potatoes, scrubbed, peeling removes | 1 ounce good quality 80 % unsweetened chocolate chip | 1/2 ounce good quality liqueur ( try something with trident alcohol content ) ( optional ) | 2 -3 hard-boiled eggs | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper | 3 -8 ounces cottage cheese
instructions: Cut potatoes lengthwise into thirds, leaving a little of the peel intact. Cut each half into 1 chunks, or smaller in the proportions you want the lumpy bits of potato in the pan. Put potatoes into a colander and pour boiling water over potatoes to cover. Let stand 10 minutes, then drain. Cover potatoes with cold water by 1/2's and place in the refrigerator until ready to use. Cut eggs into 1 chunks and put into a bowl. Put 2 tablespoons of chocolate into a small saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly with fork, taking care not to burn the chocolate, until melted. Remove from heat and add liqueur. Break egg whites into separate bowls and whisk until stiff peaks form. Pour the melted chocolate mixture into a medium serving bowl and set over a pot of low, but not hot, simmering water, stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Drain and discard potatoes, then place the lollies in the bowl of egg whites and fold well. Pour milk, egg yolks and melted chocolate mixture over them. Mix lightly, adding more milk or more chocolate if it becomes too dry. Chill, covered, at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Spread cottage cheese evenly over the top of each lumpy potato layer. Refrigerate at least 2 hours, or overnight, stirring occasionally, until completely cold.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,wheat bread flour,aluminum foil,mint leaf
title: Mint Stuffed Bread
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat bread flour, can sub bread machine flour | 12 fresh mint leaves | 4 slices part-skim mozzarella cheese | aluminum foil ( optional )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine flour and mint leaves. Cut out a circle out of the center of each piece of bread dough. Make sure to take out all of the bread within the perimeter of the circle of bread dough. Gather up the larger pieces of dough and gently gather them in the bowl. Place mozzarella cheese on top of dough. Wrap bread around the cheese completely in a circle to keep cheese at the edges. Using a toothpick, pick up the bread around the cheese completely in the bowl. Place your bread on a cookie sheet. Place in the oven, bake in a preheated oven for 7 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Baked Tomatoes for Crockpot
ingredients: 2 lbs roma tomatoes, cut in half | 2 -3 3 -4 cups vegetable broth ( depending on how thick you want it ) | 2 -4 tablespoons ground beef ( optional ) | 1 hard-boiled egg, diced
instructions: If desired, slice or tear tomatoes into chunks if desired. Place in a crockpot. Add beef if using. If desired, add egg. Pour broth over tomatoes. Cook on low heat for 2 to 4 hours or high heat for 3 - 4 hours. Serve with white rice or bread.

title: Peach Peaches
ingredients: 6 ripe peaches | onion powder
instructions: Peel and pit peaches and dice into chunks. Combine peaches and onion in a saucepan. Add water to cover and simmer 5 to 6 hours over low heat. Stir several times during cooking so peaches don't stick. Add water to prevent sticking.

title: Grilled Gruyere
ingredients: 1 loaf gruyere, halved lengthwise, and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices | 6 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract, or to taste
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Place equal amounts of gruyere slices onto the prepared grill, close the lid, and cook to desired doneness, about 4 minutes per side. Whisk yogurt, horseradish, dijon mustard, and vanilla extract together in a bowl. Dip each piece of gruyere into yogurt mixture on both sides, then place onto a serving plate.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,seltzer water,pork,sun tomato,soy sauce,flax seed,bean paste,bacon dripping
title: Hazelnut and Sun-Dried Tomato Glazed Pork Strips
ingredients: 4 slices bacon drippings | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato paste | 1 1/2 cups sesame oil or 1 1/2 cups peanut oil | 1/2 cup seltzer water | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 3/4 cup finely chopped hazelnuts, toasted | 1 tablespoon flour | 8 lbs lean pork, thin slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lay 1 slice of bacon in a skillet. In small bowl, soak sun dried tomatoes in boiling hot water for 10 seconds. Drain, squeezing as much water from tomatoes as possible.

title: Bush Pizzal (Bush Candy)
ingredients: 4 tomatoes | 1 piece lemon peel | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1 tablespoon shortening | 2 tablespoons corn chips
instructions: Remove rind from tomatoes and cut into wedges to make four wedges. Place in a bowl. Add pineapples to tomatoes. Sprinkle with shortening. Roll candy around pieces with fingers. Refrigerate for at least one hour.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,mushroom garlic pasta sauce,roast beef,plain flour,feta cheese,red cabbage
title: Roast Beef and Pasta Sauce for One!
ingredients: 8 ounces dry mushroom garlic pasta sauce, warmed | 1 lb roast beef, thinly sliced | 8 ounces medium sliced red cabbage | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 4 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 1/3 cup plain flour
instructions: Boil water in a large pot, add in some salt. Add in the pasta sauce. Drain the meat of italian style, then return it to the pan. Add in the vegetables of your choice. Pour in the cream, stirring as you go.

title: The Best Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 5 large lettuce ( webb lettuce if possible, or boston lettuce if preferred ) | 1 1/2 cups hot coffee
instructions: Wash and dry the lettuce leaves. Split the leaves vertically, cutting into quarters, or cut them into 2 lengthwise slabs. Heat the coffee up to boiling over medium high heat, and remove from heat. Line two large, flat ridged or woody sandwich sheets with some towels, or line them with parchment paper. Fill with lettuce, and roll up. Put on a warm plate, and eat the rest as an accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: nori,chuck steak,curry paste,creamy peanut butter,cream mushroom soup
title: Quick Beef Satay Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb chuck steak | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup sour cream | 5 sheets nori, cut into strips
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat, cut into 1 inch pieces. Combine peanut butter, soups, and sour cream, stir in meat. Marinate at least 30 minutes. Preheat grill, broil or pan fry meat, about 3 minutes per side or to desired doneness, brushing with sauce every 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,red bell pepper,angel hair pasta,cream cheese,turmeric powder,red potato
title: Red Bell Pepper Salad With Sweet Potato Dressing
ingredients: 4 cups cooked red potatoes, chopped | 3 large red bell peppers, chopped | 2 packages cream cheese | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 packages angel hair pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients with desired amounts of dressing. Refrigerate 2 - 3 minutes before serving. This will thicken the dressing slightly and mix with the cooked sweet potato and red bell pepper.

Random Ingredients: bibb lettuce,sauce,oregano leaf,brown sugar,black pepper,red cabbage
title: Saurage and Black Pepper Slaw
ingredients: 1 head bibb lettuce | 1 red cabbage | 1 1/2 cups hot sauce | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Cut the top off the bibb lettuce and pull out most of the leaves and bleu. Pull apart the leaves and place in a large salad bowl, then place the torn bibb back into the bowl. Rinse the red cabbage under cool water, then remove the core. Cut into 4 large pieces and add to the bibb/ lettuce. Cut the green cabbage into 4 squares/slices and add to the bibb lettuce. Toss until mixed well.

title: Lobster Sticks
ingredients: 12 large pears, peeled, cored and cut in half | 1 teaspoon kosher salt, or as needed | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1/2 pound lobster meat, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine pears and salt in a bowl. Whisk olive oil until the dressing tastes like a brush. Stir lobster meat into the dressing. Let stand for 15 minutes at room temperature.

title: Mexican Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry biscuit mix | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup canned artichoke, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a large bowl, stir together biscuit mix, pinto beans and artichoke. Fill biscuit mixture evenly into dishes.

Random Ingredients: wasabi,lime,pepper,cooking oil,raisin,nonfat plain yogurt,sage leaf,cream coconut
title: Wasabi Ginger Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon wasabi | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 lime | 1 carton nonfat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon sour cream or 1 tablespoon coconut, yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | pepper | 1 package raisins, soaked in warm water
instructions: Combine wasabi and oil. Set aside. Finely grate zest of 1 lime into wasabi. Pour oil mixture into a serving bowl and squeeze juice from lime into measuring cup. Add yogurt and sour cream to bowl. Add pepper and sage. Stir to combine well. Spoon into serving dish, sprinkle with raisins, and serve immediately.

title: Pasta Tangerine With Tangerine & Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 350 g penne pasta, dry | 1 can chopped tomatoes | 3/4 cup mixed greens, chopped ( such as kale, sorrel, chard ) | 1 tangerine, zest of ( or 2 tangerines or equivalent zest ) | 2 teaspoons french mustard ( white ) | 2 teaspoons pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon allspice berry
instructions: In a huge saucepan with water, cook the penne al dente or penne as per package instructions. In a blender, whizz the tomatoes and zest to a puree, combine with the greens and season with salt, pepper to taste, dijon and mustard. Add pesto and then cumin mixed with the mustard. Toss with the penne pasta and the sauce. Garnish with a tangerine zest, a tangerine or two of your choice, and sprinkle with the allspice berries.

title: Chinese-Style Macaroni with Bacon
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni | 1/4 cup thinly slivered canadian bacon, chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger root | 1 dash sugar, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place macaroni in the pot, cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until al dente, and drain. Place bacon in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until evenly brown. Mix in the ginger, and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the macaroni and sugar. Serve at once.

title: Watermelon & Tomato Jam With Cream
ingredients: 1/2 large watermelon | 1 cup pesto sauce ( homemade or prepared ) | 4 cups dry baking powder | 3 cups tomato paste
instructions: Cut watermelon into cubes & wash until the inside of the watermelon shrinks away from the skin. Place in a saucepan & cover with 1/2 cup of water. Bring to boil & cook over low heat for a couple of minutes. Add the pesto & baking powder then the tomato paste & continue cooking for 10 minutes or until the mixture thickens. Place in jars & store in the fridge. Hot jam will keep for one month as is traditionally how you make it & doesn't burn when cooled.

title: Lobster Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless beef top sirloin steak | 1 can lobster chunks, drained
instructions: Place steak in a skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle with salt to taste and cook about 5 minutes per side, or to desired doneness.

title: Spicy Snow Pea Salad With Mustard
ingredients: 24 ounces snow peas | 2 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 2 tablespoons chicken broth
instructions: Wash frozen peas and snap them in 1 inch pieces. Blanche peas in boiling water for 2 minutes. Drain and drain well. In 2 quart microwavable bowl, mix vinegar, sugar and sour cream. Arrange peas in 3 rows on large platter. Pour vinegar mixture overtop and stir well. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours. If desired, sprinkle peas with dry mustard first. Serve cold or room temperature.

title: Capers and Green (Crisp Green) Saute
ingredients: 1 bunch spring greens ( preferably the green parts ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons capers
instructions: Trim greens of stems and blemishes. Cut a slit in the end of each leaf and scoop out the loose center. Wash away any remaining white veins. Cut the greens into 3/4 inch lengths and set aside in a bowl. Add the capers to the greens along with a little water and mix well. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt.

Random Ingredients: relish,lasagna noodle,philadelphia cream cheese,mascarpone cheese,italian sausage,thyme
title: Crock Pot Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 lb ground italian sausage | 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 tablespoon sweet relish | 1 teaspoon snipped fresh thyme
instructions: Cook sausage until browned.

title: Creamy Onion Soup
ingredients: 3 cups water | 1 pound frozen onions | 1 onion, chopped
instructions: Combine the sliced onions and water in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until the onions are tender, about 10 minutes. Pour soup into a blender, and process until smooth. Strain through a fine mesh strainer into a large saucepan. Place the pureed soup into the saucepan to reheat. Cook until hot, about 30 minutes.

title: Mama's Favorite Beans
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 1/2 cup white distilled vinegar | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon dried greek seasoning | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine beans, vinegar, sherry, greek seasoning and cheese. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,white asparagus,white tequila,caper,button mushroom,clam juice,prosciutto
title: Italian White Asparagus - Cactus
ingredients: 6 ounces white tequila | 4 ounces jarred green hot pickled asparagus, drained | 1/2 cup bottled clam juice | 1/4 cup drained capers | 1 lb thin asparagus tip, trimmed | 2 ounces thin sliced prosciutto | 8 whole baby button mushrooms
instructions: Place the tequila, asparagus, clam juice, capers, and prosciutto in a large, heavy skillet. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer until the asparagus is tender, about 10 minutes. Slice the asparagus tips on the bias, and set aside. Remove the stems from the mushrooms, and slice them thinly. Place the mushrooms on a platter, and arrange the asparagus on top of the tips and serve warm.

title: Ganache
ingredients: 3 ounces goat cheese | 3 ounces fresh szechuan peppercorns
instructions: Combine ingredients and shake. Store in a container covered with a good rub. Rub on meats and other vegetables. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,tarragon,black tea,baking potato,kosher salt,orange zest,cardamom seed,cooking spray
title: Tea-Roasted Baking Potatoes
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 large baking potatoes, scrubbed, cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon baking potato-flour blend ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/8 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/8 teaspoon orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/4 cup brewed black tea ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place potatoes on a baking sheet just large enough to accommodate them in a single layer. Bake in the preheated oven until nicely browned on the outside, about 30 minutes. Transfer to a bowl, cover, and let steam for 10 minutes. Turn potatoes again and coat with cooking spray. Let cool completely. Meanwhile, coat a kitchen towel generously with cooking spray. Roll the potatoes, 1 inch up, into the towel. Dry on paper towels and set aside. Spray the kitchen towel generously with cooking spray. Spread potatoes on a clean kitchen towel. Sprinkle with baking potato flour blend. Add cardamom, tarragon, orange zest, taco seasoning, and tea. Fold in the dry potatoes like you would for french fries, patting gently until coated. If potatoes seem dry at the edges, sprinkle a little water. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, until tender and crispy on the outside.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Beans and Beans
ingredients: 8 brussels sprouts | 8 ounces canned baked beans
instructions: Boil the brussels sprouts in water with 2 tbsp salt for 15 minutes. While the brussels sprouts are cooking, pour the beans in a pan and heat together with the brussels sprouts, and serve.

title: Beer Bread III
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1 cup white vinegar | 1 can beer | 1 container frozen whipped topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix cake flour and vinegar together in a bowl. Gradually stir in beer, stirring until batter is thick and smooth. Spread batter into an 8x8 inch baking dish. Top with whipped topping. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, about 40 minutes.

title: Homemade Sprout
ingredients: 1 head celery | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Trim greens and wash well and remove stalk ends and any hard or hard parts of leaf. Cut stalk diagonally 1/2 inch pieces. Cut a slit into the top and remove tough stalk and stem. Separate into individual pieces. Boil for 10 minutes and drain. Place them in a bowl with a tight lid and keep warm. Do not stir once boiled. When cool, place on a serving dish, sprinkle with red pepper flakes and marinate for 2 - 3 hours, or overnight for best results.

title: Muesli (Chicken and Corn Dip)
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets ( can use more or less for desired taste ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Cut the chicken into 4 pieces and boil them for 10 - 15 minutes. Drain the water from the chicken and place the chicken pieces in a food processor or blender with a little salt and blend until smooth, adding more salt or water as necessary. Add the oil and process again until it forms a grainy paste and no longer sticks to the processor. Transfer the mixture to a dish lined with a paper towel and place it in the fridge for at least 15 minutes. This can be kept hot in the fridge, covered, for up to 3 days.

title: Stuffed Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 medium red bell peppers, washed, cleaned and slit lengthwise | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 3/4 - 1 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Place the halves of the bell peppers on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with half of the cheese. Mix together remaining cheese and chili powder. Spread mixture over the peppers. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Sour Cream Cheesecake Dessert
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 scallion, chopped
instructions: Set out sour cream. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add sour cream and cream of tartar and mix. Fold in scallion.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,seafood stock,panko bread crumb
title: Red Curry Prawns
ingredients: 1 cup seafood stock, i used homemade | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 1/2 cups panko bread crumbs
instructions: Place a small frying pan over medium high heat. Add the seafood stock and curry paste. Let simmer gently for 5 minutes. While the curry is simmering, form the prawns into 1 1/2 inch prawns. Place prawns in a nonstick fry pan, sprinkle in the panko crumbs. Cook and gently cook for 2 minutes per side, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,jalapeno pepper,ranch bean,rye bread,lasagna noodle
title: Mexican Style White Bean Lasagna
ingredients: 8 ounces dry lasagna noodles | 1 can ranch style beans | jalapeno, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1/2 ounce fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain. Saute chopped jalapeno, drained jalapeno peppers and chili oil in separate pan.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,spring onion,fish sauce,italian pork sausage,squash,semolina
title: Grilled Sweet Italian Sausages (Nigerian Style)
ingredients: 4 sweet italian pork sausages ( about 4 ounces per side ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons shelled toasted pistachio nuts | 1 cup sliced raw squash ( about 1-2 ounces ) | 6 spring onions, minced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sweet chili peppers or 1 tablespoon sliced chile pepper ( such as red jalapeno, thai red pepper flakes, or to taste )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Combine all ingredients and cook sausage and vegetables on grilling rack until crisp and light brown, 3 - 4 minutes on each side.

title: Rich Double Cheddar & Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients: 15 ounces ricotta cheese or 15 ounces cottage cheese | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 6 tablespoons sherry ( optional ) | 3 drops rose water | 2 -3 semi-sweet chocolate shavings ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 deg f/180 deg c. Line a 9 inch springform tin w/greaseproof paper. In a large bowl mash ricotta, cheddar and sherry with a fork. Stir in rose water. Transfer to the prepared base & sides of the baking pan & spread evenly. Chill for about 45 mins or until set. Un mould the cheesecake gently with a paring knife & gently remove sides of the tin. Mark the cheesecake into 6 equal layers depending on their size & quotancy.

title: Sambal Shrimp With Eggplant (Aubergine) Rice
ingredients: 1 lb medium raw shrimp ( peeled and deveined ) | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1/4 cup sliced sambal oelek ( available in asian asian groceries ) | 2 cups vegetable stock | 2 medium eggplants ( peeled, cut into 1/4 inch cubes )
instructions: In a 12 nonstick skillet over medium high heat, add oil and shrimp and saute until shrimp just turn pink, about 1 minute. Using a fork, stir rice around shrimp to coat, 1 - 2 minutes. Add sambal oelek and vegetable stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 5 minutes. Cover and cook over low heat 3 - 5 minutes longer or until liquid is absorbed. Using a slotted spoon, transfer shrimp, cooked rice and eggplant to a baking dish and chill until cool, about 15 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,serrano chile pepper,french bread,icing sugar,salmon fillet,chili paste,red chile pepper
title: Spicy Salmon With Chilli Garlic
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 250 g skinless, boneless salmon fillets, cut into strips | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh chili peppers | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh red chile pepper | 1 french bread, cut into triangles | 1/4 cup chopped lettuce
instructions: Heat a little chilli paste and 1 tablespoon of icing sugar in a small, shallow pan over medium heat. Stir until the sugar becomes transparent and the chilli paste turns golden. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool. Place the salmon strips in a bowl and stir in the chopped chilli, red chilli, chilli sauce and remaining icing sugar. Place a piece of bread on a flat, flat plate. Spoon a tablespoon of fish mixture onto the bread and spread evenly. Top with a teaspoon of chilli garlic sauce. Serve with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,orange zest,mace,water,maraschino cherry,salt black pepper,hot dog,parsley
title: Sausages With Orange Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 7 hot dogs, whole ( spicy ones are best but any will do. ) | 1 jar sweet pimientos, drained | 1/2 cup water | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh parsley | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh maraschino cherries | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1 pinch ground mace | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: If using spicy dogs, make sure to wear rubber gloves. Trim hot dogs of excess fat and discard any membrane attached to the meat or exterior cavity of the hot dogs. Wrap each hot dog in foil and refrigerate for 1 hour, flipping the hot dog halfway through. Drain the hot dogs well, rinse them again and pat dry with paper towels. Meanwhile, in a saucepan combine pimientos, water, parsley, maraschino cherries, orange zest and mace. Bring to a boil, remove from the heat. Arrange the soaked hot dogs in a shallow baking dish. Pour the sauce over the hot dogs and bake at 350f for 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,rum,onion powder,mint leaf,red onion,french bread
title: Jasmine Rice Balls with Rum
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 2 teaspoons dried mint leaves ( or 1 tbsp fresh mint ) | 2 -3 tablespoons rum, to taste | 1 french bread, loaf | 1 large red onion, sliced
instructions: Cook rice and onion powder in a rice cooker according to the directions on the packet. Add mint and rum to the rice and stir. Let sit for 5 mins on low to allow flavours to mix. Spread rice on top of the bread and cut french bread into four pieces of long french bread, this depends on the size and shape of the bread pieces. Place a slice of red onion on top of each piece of bread and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,bean pork,prosciutto,kosher salt black pepper,brown sugar,cake flour
title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Fritters With Orange Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces refried beans ( i sometimes use canned pork, but you can use whatever kind of beans you prefer, i love the red ) | 8 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto | kosher salt and black pepper | 2 ounces brown sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 tablespoon orange juice ( from the jar is fine )
instructions: Lay the prosciutto out on a board that has been dusted with sugar. Roll it to coat the entire surface. Cut the prosciutto in half lengthwise at 1/2 inch intervals and then cut each half into about 12 pieces. Lay the pieces on the prosciutto and roll up tightly to wrap. Salt and pepper to taste. Heat oven to 425° or gas mark sprinkle the slices with salt and pepper on the baking sheet and place them on the hot rack, bake for about 20 minutes, then remove from the oven and cool. In a bowl, mix the brown sugar with the flour, mix well. Stir in the orange juice, then pour into a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, making sure the brown sugar has dissolved. When the sauce has boiled, simmer a couple of minutes. Take off the heat, and allow to cool. Put each piece of fritter in a small ziplock bag with 2 t. Of the sauce. Pour the rest into a freezer bag with the rest of the sauce. Keep in the freezer until ready to serve to keep the fritters frozen. After defrosting, spoon some sauce onto a plate. Serve the fritters warm with some more sauce, and enjoy.

title: Easy Baked Fish
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1 egg potato starch, powder | 1/8 ounce spicy brown mustard | 1 pint clam, chopped & dew | mixed salad ( see recipe above ) or fish ( see recipe below ) | julienned kiwi
instructions: Mix potato starch, brown mustard and clam juice in a bowl until the mixture is smooth and the batter is smooth. Coat salmon filets with potato starch and grill them over coals until they are cooked on the outside and well browned on the inside. Split fish and arrange the sliced filets and kiwi around each piece of fish in a deep platter. Drain any excess fat from the fish and decorate the platter with the hot potato starch mixture. If desired, drizzle some more mustard and top the platter with slices of bread.

Random Ingredients: almond butter,grain mustard,serrano chile pepper,coriander leaf,orange zest
title: Raj (Spiced Mustard Curd)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped and toasted hazelnuts in butter to make 1 1/2 cups | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh coriander leaves | 1 cup coarse grain mustard | 1/4 cup orange zest | 1 serrano chile pepper
instructions: Heat a griddle or frying pan over medium heat. When the pan is hot enough, spread the nuts out on the griddle or toasted pan. Turn and cook until lightly browned and fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer the toasted nuts to a food processor. Add the coriander, mustard and orange zest. Pulse until coarsely ground. Transfer to a serving bowl and season with salt and pepper. Chop the serrano chile and add to the mustard and the nuts just before serving.

title: Greek Sandwich-Patties
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 large egg, lightly beaten | lettuce, chopped ( optional ) | 1 large italian bread, halved lengthwise, cut in 8 thin slices
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the yogurt and egg. Spread half of the bread slices with the yogurt mixture then top with the remaining bread slices. Heat a nonstick frying pan or griddle over medium heat, and lightly oil the grill. Grill the bread about 2 minutes per side, or until just toasted. Remove from the pan and allow to cool slightly. Top slices with lettuce and other half of the bread slices.

title: Easy Oatmeal Beef
ingredients: 1 packet quick-cooking oats | 1 can refrigerated leftover roast beef
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, spread one side of each oats with the cooking spray. Stir the roast beef into 1 packet of oats. Pour half of the beef mixture into baking dish, spreading evenly. Repeat layers with remaining roast beef, oats and beef mixture. Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until beef is tender. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,red pepper flake,kalamata olive,pork rib,white breadcrumb
title: Mediterranean Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh ground pork and 3 lbs country-style ground beef | 3 tablespoons kalamata olives, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons white breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 2 1/2 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs | 8 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 2 packages roasted red peppers, drained and finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly coat a 13x9x2 inch baking pan with cooking spray. In a large bowl, mix together the ground pork, olives, bread crumbs, red pepper flakes and 2 1/2 tablespoons bread crumbs. With your hands, work 2 tablespoons bread crumbs in to the meat mixture to combine well. Line the bottom of the baking pan with 1 package of the roasted red pepper. Place 2 sheets of phyllo over the pepper. Using your clean hands, work the remaining 3 tablespoons of bread crumbs over the top of the phyllo and pepper stacks. Spoon the meat mixture into the center of the phyllo, making a 1/3 inch border. Top with 1/2 of the remaining red pepper slices. Make a 2 inch slit in the top and brush a 1/2 package of roasted red peppers with some of the butter and sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 of the bread crumbs. Wrap the phyllo with a clean kitchen twine and place on the top rack of the oven. Bake 45 minutes, basting every 15 minutes. During the last 15 minutes when the phyllo and meat loaves are done, sprinkle the remaining crushed red pepper over the top. Remove the twine using a sharp paring knife. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: egg white,lemon peel,natural bran,olive vegetable oil,black eyed pea,horseradish
title: Pea & Horseradish  Snack
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1 teaspoon lemons, peel grated | 12 ounces fresh black-eyed peas ( or frozen peas, thawed if frozen ) | 1 ounce natural bran, crumbled | 1/2 cup horseradish
instructions: Heat oil in small fry frypan. Mix egg white with grated lemon peel. Place peas & spran in shallow dish. Pour over egg & brush with oil. Bake on medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes, or until heated through. Remove peas from oven, drain, reserving liquid. Mix cream cheese with horseradish to make a creamy dip. Serve peas & horseradish as desired.

Random Ingredients: panko bread crumb,strawberry,rice noodle,lettuce leaf,phyllo dough,caper
title: Fried Phyllo Strawberries With Rice Noodles and Capers
ingredients: 4 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed ( or use defrosted frozen phyllo dough ) | 4 cups panko bread crumbs | 1 cup rice noodles, cooked and drained | 1/4 cup finely chopped large capers | 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced in wedges | 8 -10 small salad leaves
instructions: Thaw phyllo dough according to package directions. Drain rice noodles and capers, set aside. In medium bowl, combine panko crumbs and bread crumbs. Add noodles, capers and strawberries, mix well. Lay the phyllo sheets in a single layer on a clean, dry baking sheet. With lightly floured hands place a 2 - 3 inch stack in the middle of each sheet. Brush the top sheets with melted butter, then spoon some of the mixture onto the center leaving about 1/2 inch of margin space. Place a second sheet over the first, brush with melted butter, and sprinkle generously with bread crumb mixture. Fold phyllo over to form half moon shapes. Repeat with remaining phyllo and the remaining filling. Working with one sheet at a time, arrange 1 sheet phyllo at a time, brushing each with dry butter. Flatten with fork or lightly press with bottom of a glass, then turn and brush with butter. Fold in quarters and continue to fold in triangles. Repeat with remaining phyllo and filling, placing 5 or 6 triangles in a tight row across the length of the phyllo. Wrap each diagonally in plastic wrap and freeze overnight. Remove wrapper from freezer, uncover and re wrap. Remove all phyllo from freezer and cut each in half diagonally.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,orange zest,bay leaf,sesame oil,beef brisket,apple juice,cumin powder
title: Cured Beef Brisket, Apple-Soy Sauce Mix & Cumin Glaze
ingredients: 2 medium fennel bulbs | 1 1/2 cups orange juice, divided | 1/2 cup apple juice, divided | 1 tablespoon orange zest, minced | 1 bay leaf | 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 2 lbs large-ground beef brisket, trimmed of all fat | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Using the cut side of the fennel bulb and their pods, remove the fuzzy fronds from the fennel. Trim away the feathery fennel stalk and fennel pods and cut into 2 inch lengths. Discard remaining green fronds. Using a 6 to 8 pound beef brisket that has been trimmed of all fat, make slits about halfway down the meat's length. Insert a fine mesh strainer, 1/4 teaspoon to 1/8 teaspoon of salt into each slit, taking care to remove any excess salt. Tie the ends of the fennel pods tightly with kitchen twine. Place fennel fronds in a medium saucepan. Add 1/2 cup of the apple juice, 1/2 cup of the remaining apple juice and the orange zest. Bring to a boil over high heat.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,avocado,garlic powder,cornflour,baking powder,bread,corn kernel
title: Baked Avocado Fritters
ingredients: 2 avocados, ripe | 3/4 cup corn kernel | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon crushed sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 teaspoons cornflour, plus extra to dust | 2 teaspoons chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon cornflour, plus extra corn flour to dust | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated bread, toasted and toasted
instructions: Bake in a 200 degree c oven until a skewer inserted in the fritters comes out clean, around 5 minutes, depending on the temperature in your oven and oven fan. Meanwhile, pit and slice the avocados, then peel, remove and dice the flesh either with a knife or a coarse knife. Set aside. Combine the corn, sun dried tomatoes, cornflour, sun dried tomato oil, baking powder and garlic powder in a medium bowl. Add the avocados, toss well to combine, then season to taste with salt and pepper. Heat a large, oven proof frying pan until hot. Dust the fritters lightly with flour, dip in the egg and toss to coat. Then cook over medium heat until golden and crisp, about 4 - 5 minutes, turning once. Serve the fritters warm with a sprinkling of toasted sesame seeds and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Tomato-Nicoise Olive Egg yolks
ingredients: 12 large yolks | 2/3 cup dry sherry | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 1/3 cup nicoise olives
instructions: Combine the yolks with the sherry, tomato paste, cinnamon and nicoise olives in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,red capsicum,tomato green chilies
title: Quick Thai Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup thai fish sauce | 12 thai hot dark red capsicums | 1 can chopped tomatoes and green chilies
instructions: Prick capsicums 3 or 4 times with a fork. Place in microwave safe dish. Microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes until tender. Remove. Strain capsicums through a sieve into a large bowl and mash with a fork. Add capsicum mixture to tomato mixture and stir well. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,button mushroom,cherry,hungarian paprika,red lentil,potato,grain white rice
title: Lentil and Potato Bake
ingredients: 750 g red lentils, rinsed | 450 g potatoes, peeled & diced | 115 g button mushrooms or 225 g baby portabella mushrooms | 115 g bok choy, thick leaves removed ( or substitute 1 cup of baby green leaves instead ) | 15 g sweet hungarian paprika | 85 g cherry or 85 g baby green leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Place lentils in a large saucepan with a large quantity of cold water. Bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes, until tender. Drain well and return the lentils to the pan. Add the potatoes and mushrooms and mix well to combine. Pour into a large casserole dish. Add the paprika and cherries and scatter over the greens. Bake in the oven for 1 hour. Serve cold with some fresh baked bread.

title: Roasted Tofu, Chilli Style
ingredients: 100 g extra firm tofu | 1 teaspoon chat masala ( malaysian spice mix ) | 1/2 a glass white wine
instructions: Soak the tofu for at least an hour in water. Heat a pan with a knob of butter over medium heat and brush with some of the water from the tofu. Add the tofu and scatter over the spices. Add the white wine and cook for a few minutes until the tofu has wilted. You could garnish with a sprinkling of coriander or herbs.

title: Spiced Roast Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts | 2 tablespoons whole english mustard | 2 tablespoons coarse grain hing
instructions: Preheat a grill on medium heat. In a food processor or blender, combine hazelnuts, mustard, and coarsely grind the mixture until it forms a paste. Spread the paste onto a large roasting rack and bake, stirring frequently, until the hazelnuts are lightly roasted and fragrant, at least 30 minutes. Let cool. Store in a tightly covered container at room temperature. The hazelnuts will keep for up to 2 weeks.

title: Artichokes and Eggs
ingredients: 2 eggs | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped artichoke hearts, drained
instructions: Place eggs in a saucepan, and top with monterey jack cheese. Cover, and melt over medium heat until eggs are set, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with artichoke hearts, and continue cooking uncovered until cheese is melted and the tops darkens.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,rum extract,broccoli,cilantro stem,sugar,pork sausage link,pork steak,mace
title: Cuban Mango Sausage With Green Sauce
ingredients: 4 pork sausage links | 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless pork steak | fresh cilantro stems ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 pinch ground mace | 1 1/2 tablespoons rum extract | fresh broccoli ( optional ) | 1 -2 canned guacamole
instructions: Poke holes through sausages with a fork and sprinkle with mace. Lay out on a plate and let sit 20 minutes. Preheat broiler and line a cookie sheet with foil. In a bowl, mix rum and cilantro. Brush sausages with rum mixture and broil on cookie sheet 1 - 5 minutes or until just beginning to turn brown. Transfer to platter and turn out of foil. Slice into 1/2 inch thick slices. Lay sausages out on foil on a broiler pan and let broil in a 350 degree oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until cooked through, turning as needed. To serve, pile sausages on a serving platter and top with green sauce and salsa. Garnish with fresh cilantro sprigs and serve with mango slices.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,currant,buttermilk,marsala wine,water chestnut,corn oil,corn kernel,haddock fillet
title: Smoked Haddock With Creamy Currant and Marsala Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 425 g cannellini beans, drained & rinsed | 2 tablespoons currants | 400 ml buttermilk | 1/2 cup corn kernel | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 400 g haddock fillets ( skinned, boneless, about 4 1/2 ounces total, cut crosswise into strips ) | 1 tablespoon red currant | 2 -3 tablespoons dry marsala wine | 1 tablespoon pine nuts or 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1 tblsps corn oil in an 8 inch non stick pan over medium high heat. Place beans, currants & buttermilk in a blender & blend until smooth. Return to pan. Add remaining oil, haddock & pepper to taste. Cover & cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until fish just starts to flake. Remove from pan & keep warm. Heat the remaining buttermilk, corn oil & pine nuts in a pan over medium heat. Cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until heated through. Serve over the haddock. Serve with sauce.

title: Crispy Snack
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped broccoli floret | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant flaked cereal | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a small bowl and stir until the cereal dissolves. Serve as soon as it has been made or spread on the crackers.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,onion soup mix,greek yogurt,lobster tail,water,wine,custard powder
title: French Style Lobster Tails
ingredients: 1 package dried lobster tails | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and diced | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon custard powder | 1 cup greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons water | 1/2 package onion soup mix
instructions: Soak lobster shells in cold water for 30 minutes. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Saute poblano, onion, and chile until softened and hot. Drain lobster shells, chop and toss with poblano mixture and soup mix. Serve over cooked and buttered noodles.

title: Maple Syrup Dessert Tomatoes
ingredients: 24 cherry tomatoes | 2 cups maple syrup | 6 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Place cherry tomatoes on a parchment lined baking sheet. Drizzle with maple syrup. Sprinkle the sugar over the tomatoes. Cook at 450 degrees f for 20 minutes or until the top is slightly browned.

title: Tomato & Wooden Skewers
ingredients: 4 medium tomatoes | 1 1/2 tablespoons sake | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato juice
instructions: Slice the stem end off of each tomato& discard seeds. Tear off a 1&#8260.

title: Quick and Easy Rice Porridge
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice ( soaked in water for 15 minutes if using soaked rice ) | arrowroot ( optional )
instructions: Place the soaked rice in a tea pot, cover with water, bring to boil, remove from heat and let stand for another 15 minutes until the water is absorbed. After 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and add arrowroot if using. This can be served hot or cold.

title: Alfredo Zabaglione
ingredients: 1 package mascarpone cheese | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | espresso powder
instructions: Put mascarpone in bowl of heavy duty mixer. Add 1 tablespoon lemon zest and juice. Mix with a wooden spoon. Add espresso. Cover and refrigerate for 45 minutes to 3 hours. Cut into small slabs with a sharp knife.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,leg lamb,chinese five spice powder,tea
title: Roast Lamb with Chinese Hot Pot
