ingredients: 3 kg leg of lamb | 50 -75 ml tea | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 75 g flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Rinse the lamb under cold running water under cold running water and pat dry. Place the lamb in a large, well oiled ovenproof dish and place in a shallow baking dish, fat side up. Combine the tea and five spice powder in a teapot and pour over the lamb. Cover tightly with foil and marinate in the refrigerator for 2½ hours. Preheat the oven to 200°c. Uncover the lamb, transfer to a roasting tray and roast for 2½ hours, basting occasionally with the tea and five spice mix. Remove the foil and cook for a further 15 to 20 minutes, basting twice with pan juices, until cooked to your liking. Discard the marinade and place lamb on top of roast when cooked to your liking. Garnish with chopped parsley. Serve.

Random Ingredients: white balsamic vinegar,green chili,currant,juniper berry,garlic clove,french bread,bread,pea
title: Spiced French Bread Salad With Mustard Peas
ingredients: 6 slices country bread, about 1/4-inch thick | 2 tablespoons french bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons peas, drained | 1 garlic clove, thinly sliced | 1 whole green chili, seeds removed, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons juniper berries, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons red-wine-infused balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup mixed dried currant
instructions: Heat a medium, nonstick skillet over medium heat. When the pan is hot, add the bread cubes and cook until golden underneath, about 2 minutes. Turn over the bread, sprinkle it with salt, and keep a close eye so it doesn't burn or catch on you. Add the peas, garlic, chile and berries to the sliced bread. Pour the dressing over the top, add the balsamic vinegar and currants, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,white hominy,pot roast,oregano leaf,tartar sauce
title: Slow Cooker Posole
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds pork roast, cubed | 1 can white hominy, rinsed and drained | 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup tartar sauce
instructions: Place the pork roast, hominy, egg yolk, oregano, and tartar sauce into the crock of a slow cooker. Cook on high for 3 hours, or low for 8 to 10 hours. Skim fat from the top as needed so soup doesn't curdle. To serve, place soup in a soup bowl.

Random Ingredients: dill,cucumber,ha avocadoes,rotel,peanut oil sesame,red curry paste
title: Totally Healthy Thai Nachos
ingredients: 6 hass avocadoes ( about 20 ) | peanut oil or sesame oil, for frying | 1/2 cucumber ( peeled, seeded and chopped ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons dill | 1/2 cup rotel ( drained, i use `` hot '' brand )
instructions: Cut avocados in half. Cut avocado flesh into 2 pieces and scoop out seeds and pulp with a spoon. Reserve pit and remove flesh from shell. Cut flesh into slices 1/4 inch thick for each slice. Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat and cook slices until lightly browned, about 5 minutes, turning when necessary. Drain on paper towels. Serve sliced avocado with red curry dipping sauce, cucumber dipping sauce and dill pickle wedges.

Random Ingredients: green olive,hot water,veal chop,ricotta cheese,almond,thyme leaf
title: Algerian Veal Rolls With Ricotta and Olive (Rajah Bateman)
ingredients: 6 veal chops | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 cup hot water | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh thyme leaves | 1/2 cup slivered green olives | 1/2 cup ground almonds
instructions: Coat both sides of the veal chops with cooking spray. Set in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish or plastic bag. Combine ricotta, hot water, thyme leaves, green olives, and black pepper in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: milk,greek olive,mango chutney,whipping cream,butter,head cabbage,anchovy paste,parsley
title: Anchovy Colcannon
ingredients: 1 package mango chutney | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/2 cup fresh parsley | 1 head cabbage, cored and finely shredded | 3/4 cup whole milk | 4 tablespoons whipping cream | 1/2 cup greek-style olives or other black olives, sliced | 3 tablespoons butter
instructions: In medium saucepan, bring mango chutney and anchovy paste to boil. Add parsley. Cover and remove from heat. Let sit, until chutney is softened, about 10 minutes. Stir in cabbage. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. In small skillet, heat milk. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in chutney. Remove from heat. In small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in whipped cream, olives, and lettuce. Spread Colcannon over chilled colcannon. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,black mustard seed,garlic granule,ice,caraway seed
title: Spicy Gingersnaps
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 3/4 cup fresh ginger juice ( from 4 large unpeeled ginger cloves ) | ice | 1 teaspoon garlic granules
instructions: Rinse and drain ginger and place in a small bowl. Mix together the caraway, mustard seeds and 1/2 cup of the ginger juice.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,grape tomato,sparerib,chianti wine,lettuce,yellow cake mix,butter,dijon mustard
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Steak-Prosciutto Bundt
ingredients: dijon mustard | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/4 cup chianti wine or 1/4 cup other anise-flavored wine, such as muscat | 2 lbs spareribs, rinsed and patted dry | 1 package yellow cake mix | 2 -3 tablespoons butter, melted | 12 ounces grape tomatoes, cut into thirds | purchased lettuce ( optional ) | shredded lettuce, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine mustard and sun dried tomatoes in a bowl. Pour into ungreased 10 inch bundt cake pan and smooth the top. Place ribs at bottom of pan and spread mustard mixture over the ribs. Sprinkle with wine and dot with a little butter. Drizzle the tomatoes with the remaining butter. Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake until tender and a thermometer inserted into thickest part of ribs registers 135 degrees, about 1 hour.. Cool and slice thinly.

title: Chinese Five-Spice Eggplant (Aubergine) Spread
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 7 tablespoons dashi | 6 large green cardamoms | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Wash the eggplant inside and out, cut into 3/4 cubes. Boil the water, then throw the cubes in with the salt and let stand for a couple of minutes. Drain and rinse the cubes under cold water. Pat the cubes dry with absorbent paper. Mix the eggplant with the dashi, cardamoms, and chinese five spice powder. Cover the surface of the saucepan with cling wrap and place the lid on. Over high heat, heat a little water to make a thin steam and drop in the eggplants. Cook for a few minutes and serve.

title: Italian Style Hamburger
ingredients: 3 pounds ground hamburger | 1 can peas | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together the ground hamburger, peas, whipping cream, cumin, nutmeg and seasoning salt. Shape mixture into 8 patties. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Koshary
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato ( white and red medium size ) | 1 lb andouille sausage ( or other mild-flavored sausage, halved lengthwise and lightly greated ) | 3 cups masoor dal, split ( masoor dal ) | sour cream or yogurt
instructions: Bring large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add potato halves and cook uncovered 2 minutes. Transfer potatoes to colander and rinse under cold water. Pat dry. Cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Repeat steps 6 and 7 with sausage slices. Place potatoes in bowl and add sausage. Pour hot water over ingredients until liquid in bowl penetrates. Stir, mixing, until potatoes are well coated. Cover. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Line baking sheet with foil. Spoon off most of sausage grease. Arrange potato slices on foil, covering, with more pan or lid to prevent sticking. Bake uncovered, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Asparagus With Vinegar & Chiles
ingredients: 1/2 lb asparagus, ends trimmed | kosher salt, to taste | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1/2 - 1 cup tomato puree
instructions: Cut the asparagus into 1 - 1 1/2 inch pieces. Add salt to taste and cook over direct medium heat 4 to 5 minutes. Stir frequently with a spoon. Stir in the vinegar and harissa. Return to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover pan and simmer, stirring occasionally, until asparagus is tender, about 15 minutes. Adjust salt if needed, then stir. Serve warm.

title: Baked Pork and Raisins(Jollof)
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs pork ( shoulder or shoulder with bone in ) | 1 bunch gingerroot | 1 1/4 lbs golden raisins ( preferably the brown ) | 3 -4 inches fresh gingerroot ( peeled of peeled of all visible pith, cut into thin slices and sprinkled )
instructions: Cut the pork up into bite size pieces. Arrange the pieces neatly in a baking pan. Sprinkle the ginger slices over the meat and add the raisins. Bake in a preheated 275f oven until the meat is browned. Let cool, then put into sterilized jars, leaving 2 inches of headspace. Seal, and store.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,leg lamb,mace,yellow onion,basmati rice,creme fraiche,daikon radish
title: Lamb and Daikon With Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef brisket, well trimmed ( preferably organic ) | 1 large yellow onion, peeled | 1 lb daikon radish, peeled | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 1/4 cup grated fresh white pecorino cheese or 1/4 cup grana padano | 2 1/2 teaspoons ground mace | 2 1/2 cups long-grain white basmati rice
instructions: Trim fat from meat.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,bay leaf,square spring wrapper,pasta,gruyere cheese,tomatillo,italian parsley
title: Tomatillo Ravioli
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large tomatillos, husks and stems removed | 1/3 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 bay leaf | 1/3 cup grape tomatoes, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 package square spring roll wrappers, blanched until lightly puffed | 1/2 cup dry pasta, cooked, drained and warmed | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix tomatillos, parsley, bay leaf and tomatoes into a food processor or blender. Process until a smooth paste forms. Using a fine mesh sieve, scrape down sides of bowl. Place a spoonful of tomato puree into center of each wrapper. Moisten edge of wrappers with water, pressing them gently against the surface to form a depression. Moisten wrapper again and press the corners closed. Repeat with remaining filling. Arrange 1 tbsp of tomato paste in the center of each ravioli. Arrange 3 ravioli on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Bake ravioli until lightly browned, about 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven to melt cheese.

Random Ingredients: butter margarine,dozen oyster,pork bean,shiitake mushroom,fontina cheese
title: Fontina Oysters
ingredients: 1 dozen oyster, shucked | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter or margarine | 1/2 cup shaved fontina cheese | 0.5 package chopped smoked fontina cheese | 12 shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place oysters in a small dish. Cover with a teaspoon of water, and dot with margarine. Place in a oven for 30 minutes, until tops are crusty. Remove oysters from oven after 10 minutes, and place a few shavings on the top of the oysters. Sprinkle the top of the grated fontina cheese with a couple of shavings of fontina, return to the oven, and bake for 6 - 7 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly. Remove and allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Mock Russian Tea
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread, day old | vodka | horseradish | nutritional yeast | cheddar cheese | black tea
instructions: Cut bread into slices approximately 1/2 cm thick. Bake slices until just beginning to color, then set oven to 300 degrees. Spread a little vodka over the toast in the baking dish. Top with horseradish, nutritional yeast, and cheese. Continue layering until all is used up.

Random Ingredients: olive,french green bean,lima bean,kosher salt black pepper,red bell pepper,cilantro
title: Green Beans, Limas, and Peppers With Cilantro
ingredients: 2 ounces french style green beans | 2 ounces lima beans | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons olive, chopped ( black or green ) | 1 red bell pepper, diced
instructions: Wash and dry the french style green beans and lima beans. Put the green beans, lima beans, red bell pepper, cilantro, salt, and pepper in a food processor. If you have a processor, add a tablespoon of water as needed and process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: lard,process american cheese,chili oil,salmon,kernel corn,yukon gold potato
title: Ajiaco (Cuban-Style Potatoes)
ingredients: 1 pound yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut in 1-inch slices | 1/2 pound frozen whole-kernel corn | 1/3 pound salmon, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1/3 pound processed american cheese, cubed | 3 tablespoons chili oil | 1 pinch chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with water.

title: Moroccan Chickpea and Burrata
ingredients: 2 small burritos | 250 ml chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 pinch caribbean jerk seasoning | 1 bunch fresh turkish chapati | 1 tablespoon instant espresso, warmed
instructions: Toss the chickpeas with the jerk seasoning and turkish chapati in a microwave safe dish. Heat in the microwave for 1 minute on full power. Pour the espresso into a tea ball pitcher and scatter the bean mixture around the plate. Eat at once.

title: Squid With Calvados
ingredients: 1 lb butternut squash, peeled, halved, seeded, and cut into wedges | 1 large butternut squash, halved seeded | 1 3/4 lbs cleaned and trimmed squid, tentacles and tubes cut into 12 rings | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar, packed | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Arrange squash over a large bowl.

title: Shake-Mock Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sifted sake | 1 1/2 cups sake ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1 cup diced san marzano tomato | 1 cup chocolate chips ( optional )
instructions: Poke holes randomly in the mushroom caps with a sharp skewer or knife, then dip mushrooms into the sake and let sit 20 minutes. Gently heat a skillet over medium high heat. When hot, add 1 cup sake and mushrooms. Cook, stirring constantly until the mushrooms release their liquid, about 3 minutes. Add 1 cup sour cream, stir to combine, and simmer 1 minute.

title: Tandoori Bread
ingredients: 450 g baking powder | 1 bunch coriander seed | 150 ml double cream
instructions: Place the baking powder, coriander, and cream. Mix well to form a moist dough. Divide into 2 pieces and roll out each piece on a flat surface. The easiest way to do this is to roll out 2 smaller pieces of dough, rolling around twice the size of your bread machine. If you are going to freeze bread and not eating them right away, place them on a cookie sheet they'll be easier to handle when the oven is hot. Bake in a pre heated oven for about 40 minutes.

title: Besan Cheese
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dry bacon grease or 4 tablespoons butter | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon cayenne powder
instructions: Place bacon grease or unsalted butter with cardamom and cayenne powder into a small saucepan over low heat. Bring to a simmer, then stir in cheese. Cook, stirring constantly until the sauce resembles a thick mayonnaise. Cool a few minutes, then serve.

title: Simple Vinegar
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Bring the vinegar to a boil in a saucepan. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, dissolve the salt in the vinegar completely, then pour into a sterilized jar with a air tight lid. Store at room temperature until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,onion,coriander seed,saffron thread,jalapeno
title: Homemade Saffron or Sweet Onion Jam
ingredients: 1/2 large onion, about 1 1/2 lbs | 2 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/8 teaspoons crushed saffron threads, with about 1 1/4 tsp. of the saffron threads ( about 2 tsp. if the saffron threads are very small ) | 2 teaspoons crushed jalapenos | 1 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon whole coriander seed, toasted and coarsely crushed
instructions: Peel and finely cut the onion into half moons 2/3 inch thick and roughly chop about 1/4 1/2 lb in the processor. Place the onion in a bowl. Drizzle the extra virgin olive oil with the 1 1/2 tsp crushed saffron threads and the jalapeños. Stir, and season with salt and pepper. Add the chopped onion, and toss until thoroughly combined. Spread on a double layer of dampened paper towels in a shallow heavy saucepan large enough to hold the onion and the onion with at least 1 inch of headroom protruding above the onion. Cover tightly and marinate 1 - 2 hours in the refrigerator. Make the pickling solution, put the saffron saffron threads in a small piece of cheesecloth or small cup with a spind attached. Place on a double layer of heavy duty foil, add 2 tsp of the olive oil, and sprinkle a teaspoon of crushed coriander over the top, then pinch the ends to blend. The salt and pepper should not be necessary. Tie in a knot. Put in a heavy pot with more heavy heat on bottom, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Once boiling, put on the lid and boil for 30 minutes. Turn the heat off, put a heat diffuser over the pot, and continue to boil for an additional 30 minutes. The onion will shrink a little as the pickling solution cools, and the pickling solution should be sticky and somewhat translucent. When the 25 minutes are up, set a small pan over boiling water, and drop the lid on the pan. Put a large piece of clean, dry, wet cloth over the top of the pan to drain excess water. Pour off all the water into the pan and let cool until this will be a very thick paste.

title: Pasta With Herbs, Tea & Irish Ices
ingredients: 200 g rigatoni pasta | 6 -8 cups boiling hot milk | 2 tablespoons dried mixed herbs, i use tarragon ( or basil )
instructions: Cook rigatoni in plenty of water according to packet instructions, until al dente, and leave under cold water. Meanwhile, heat milk and sprinkle dried mixed herb together in a pan, add drained rigatoni and stir well to combine.

title: Spiced Macaroni and Cheese for One
ingredients: 1 baking potato, peeled, quartered | 1/4 cup quinoa | cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 1 tablespoon salted roasted crystallized mixed peel | 3/4 cup cooking wine | 15 ounces penne pasta, cook and drain
instructions: Place potato in a saucepan, add 1/4 cup quinoa and 6 cups water. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat a 2 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place quinoa and salted roasted crystallized mixed peel in a food processor. Process the vegetables until finely chopped. Add the chopped vegetable mixture and the cooking wine into potatoes and 1 cup quinoa. Process 2 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Transfer mixture into the 1 quart baking dish. Bake for 25 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,almond,confectioner ' sugar,chili oil,cream chicken soup,prosciutto
title: Feta-Stuffed French Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 tablespoon cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons hot chili oil | 2 -3 slices prosciutto, fried crisp and crumbled | 2 tablespoons almonds, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place ingredients except nuts and spread evenly on the outsides of the french onion rings. Roll each'swirl' and sprinkle with the toasted almonds.

Random Ingredients: orange,cream mushroom soup,fish sauce,thai red chili pepper,red tomato,gingerroot
title: Thai Red Curry
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup or 10 1/2 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1 red ripe tomatoes, diced into 1. 5 inch chunks | 1 orange, diced into 1. 5 inch chunks | 2 tablespoons fresh gingerroot, minced | 2 - 3 fresh thai red chili peppers, seeded and minced | 1 -2 teaspoon fish sauce
instructions: Open cans and drain soup into a 4 1/2 cup measuring cup. In a saucepan combine sour cream, mushroom soup, tomato chunks, orange chunks, ginger root, ginger and red chiles. Heat over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Lower heat to simmer. Add fish sauce and continue simmering until mixture coats a spoon. Stir occasionally. Serves 1 as a main dish or 1 as a side dish.

title: Shrimp and Noodle Soup
ingredients: 9 ounces of dry chinese noodles, preferably thin | 8 ounces boneless sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch square pieces | 6 ounces of cleaned fresh mushrooms, sliced | 10 3/4 cups of strained grape tomatoes | 12 -20 raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons baking soda | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Wash the noodles, then boil them for 1 minute in rapidly boiling water. Add the sirloin, mushrooms, tomatoes, shrimp, baking soda and cardamon seed. Cook until tomatoes are tender, then rinse shrimp with cold water, devein and chop. Add to soup and bring to a boil for 5 minutes. If you have shrimp that are frozen, return to the pot for 10 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Cheese and Horseradish Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup instant long grain rice | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1/3 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/3 cup provolone cheese | 2 cups tomato juice | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish, drained
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, sauté onion and cheese in a non stick skillet over high heat, stirring often'til cheese is melted. Stir tomato juice, horseradish, and remaining cheese into the rice. Turn out onto a platter.

title: Quick Polenta Couscous
ingredients: 4 cups zesty polenta | 1 cup chopped zesty polenta ( use extra firm, firm polenta ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup virgin olive oil | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine all ingredients and mix well until well combined. Spread into a 9 x 12 rectangular cake pan or an oven proof container. Bake in preheated oven for about 25 minutes or till golden brown.

title: Proseito Con Pomodoro
ingredients: 1 small tomatoes | 1/8 pound prosciutto
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Slice the tomato in half and place each piece face down on a piece of parchment paper or aluminum foil. Wrap the tomatoes around each piece of prosciutto and wrap tightly. Bake in preheated oven 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,rye bread,duck breast,cream cheese,pie shell,pomegranate,vanilla extract
title: Chicken, Sweet & Sour Poached Roast
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shell | 1 sweet potato | 2 tablespoons light cream cheese | 1 dash vanilla extract | 1 dash red chili powder | 2 slices rye bread | 2 teaspoons pomegranate
instructions: Prepare sweet potato as directed on packaging using a peeler or a mandoline. Trim the potato into a smallish chunk and cook in boiling water for about an hour or until just tender while still with the skin on. Drain and cool slightly. Slice. Spread cream cheese on one side of pastry. Mix the sweet potato with the cream cheese and season lightly with salt and pepper, to taste. Spread filling mixture on one side of the pastry crust followed by pomegranate slices, placing the pomegranate between the slices. Place other pastry on top, crimp edges, and poke holes in the top with a fork. Cook in a 425 degree f oven for 45 minutes.

title: Polish Woodcock
ingredients: 4 woodcock, heads and feet | condiments : | 2 slices bread or 2 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat. Cut woodcock heads into pieces about 1 to 1 1/2 inches long. Spread the woodcock pieces onto the skewers and grill until the coating is browned and the fish is easily flaked with a fork, 8 to 12 minutes per inch of thickness. To serve, place 3 pieces of bread on a plate and top with a woodcock skewer. Serve with condiment and/or rye bread. Cut the skewer into slices before serving.

title: Pesto Barbecue Beans
ingredients: 400 g shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 2 onions, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1 cup fresh basil pesto or 1 cup homemade pesto | 400 g kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 iceberg lettuce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Serve in large soup bowls, garnish with parsley or shredded fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: ditalini pasta,lemon,couscous,irish whiskey,lemon peel,kaffir lime leaf
title: Irish Coodles With Whiskey and Lemon Peel
ingredients: 1/3 cup irish whiskey | 2 -3 lemon peel, thinly slivered | 1 -2 lemon, cut into 4 thin wedges | 1 lb ditalini pasta ( small wheel ) | 4 -5 kaffir lime leaves | 1 cup couscous
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, heat the whiskey on low for a few seconds. Toss in the peel and kaffir lime leaves. Sauce should be sweet and sour. Meanwhile, cook the pasta to al dente. Drain and set aside. Drain the pasta. When the water boils, add the pasta and remaining ingredients. Toss well. Serve the dish hot.

title: Kara's Black-Eyed Peas  (Stove Top or Casserole)
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas | meat ( optional ) | 1 can cherry tomatoes ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Open white kidney beans. Remove any rind from tomatoes and cherry tomatoes if using. Rinse black eyed peas with cool water. Place in 2 gallon casserole or 9x13 pan. Add meat. Pour black eyed peas over meat mixture cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Stove top or casserole will cook in the oven too.

title: Chunky and Delicious Barbecue Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1 lb mixed mushrooms | 2/3 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1 cup canned low fat pumpkin | 1/2 cup seedless raspberry preserves | 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 cup thickened natural yogurt | 1/4 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Drain mushrooms and slice in half to keep them separated. Chop mushrooms. Add 2/3 cup yogurt to mushrooms, breaking up any larger pieces. Add 1/3 cup of salsa, mixing well. Chop canned pumpkin into bite size pieces and stir into salad. Set aside.. To make dressing, in a medium bowl, whisk 1/4 cup yogurt with 1/4 cup of soy yogurt. Stir into mushrooms and onion until well blended. Chill. Add 1/4 cup of preserves to the salad. Cover and refrigerate. Serve the salad with remaining salsa.

Random Ingredients: french bread,tomato juice,half cream,onion soup mix,agar flake,triple sec
title: Easy French Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 packages dry onion soup mix | 2 cans tomato juice | 1 can double cream or ( 6 ounce ) can half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup agar-agar flakes | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Combine soup powder mix, tomato juice, and cream in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 3 - 4 hours or low for 4 - 5 hours. Add agar agar. Cover and continue to cook 30 minutes or until the soup is thick and bubbly. Serve in hot soup bowls, topping with french bread cubes.

title: Easy Easy French Onion Broth
ingredients: 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon minced fresh parsley
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring broth to boil. Add the minced parsley and remove from heat. Serve hot.

title: Guilt Free Thai Plum Tomatoes and Yogurt Salad
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 8 ounces yogurt, plain non-fat
instructions: Mix together the peanut butter and yogurt. Gently layer the tomato slices in individual serving bowls. Top with peanut butter yogurt mixture..

title: Rouille Des Bleuilles (Prawns in Sauerkraut)
ingredients: 2 lbs medium shrimp, shelled and deveined | 14 ounces sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 12 tablespoons pure lemons or 12 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh squeezed | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated
instructions: Place the shrimp in a large saucepan the size of the sauerkraut. Add enough water to submerge the rinsed and drained shrimp, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, for about 9 minutes. Add the sauerkraut, zest and juice. Cover and cook for 15 minutes longer or until the shrimp is just pink and cooked. Drain the shrimp and serve hot, garnished with fresh chives. Note, if serving in single servings, divide the shrimp among four warmed shallow soup bowls and place a piece of toast in the center of each serving. This serves 3 as a main dish or 2 as a starter dish.

title: Basic Shortbread Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup shortening
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix brown sugar, butter, and shortening until well blended using hands. Use a 3 inch round cookie cutters.

title: Mexican Green Soup
ingredients: 4 quarts fresh chicken stock | fresh cilantro, for garnish
instructions: Pour chicken stock into a 4 quart stockpot or dutch oven. Bring chicken stock to a boil, and pour over cilantro to serve. Sprinkle with cumin to serve.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,lemon extract,idaho potato,mung bean,beef broth
title: Beef and Potato Casserole
ingredients: onion, 2 pieces | 1 can mung beans | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon extract | 3/4 lb beef brisket, trimmed of all visible fat
instructions: In a large dutch oven, add the onion, mung beans, 1 can condensed beef broth and lemon extract. Stir to mix. Bring to a boil. Add brisket. Reduce heat to a simmer. Simmer covered for 1 hour. Uncover, and increase heat to 400°f. Place cassava, invert onto a serving platter. Serve with remaining broth or your favorite meal.

Random Ingredients: risotto rice,tabasco sauce,yellow bell pepper,pepper ring,cherry juice,kiwi fruit,rigatoni pasta,tomatillo
title: Mixed Nests for Summer
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta or ( 16 ounce ) box rotini pasta, cooked | 2 medium ripe tomatoes, cored, seeded and sliced | 1 large yellow bell pepper, seeded and sliced | 6 hot pepper rings ( to taste ) | 6 cherry tomatoes, halved | 8 ounces kiwi fruits | 2 tablespoons cherry juice | 1/3 cup risotto rice or 1/3 cup brown rice, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Combine everything except rice and pasta and mix well. Top with rice, cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,queso fresco,lemon extract,cream mushroom soup,mayonnaise,garlic clove,oregano leaf,crawfish
title: Hot Crawfish Bake
ingredients: 3/4 lb prepared chicken tenders ( i substituted cooked chicken breasts ) | 1 cup mayonnaise | 4 tablespoons soft cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons parmesan queso fresco ( i used mexican blend ) | 2 garlic cloves ( grated or minced ) | 2 teaspoons lemon extract | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 1 can unsalted crawfish, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Grease a 9 x 13 inch pan. Combine mayonnaise, cream of mushroom soup, parmesan cheese, garlic, lemon extract and oregano in a bowl until well blended. Pour soup mixture over chicken, cover and bake 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through and tender. Remove chicken from pan and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 10 to 15 minutes longer until cheese melts and mixture is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,onion flake,fennel,coffee granule,thyme leaf,grape leaf,pine nut,yellow squash
title: Grilled Yellow Squash Sandwich With Seasonal Greens and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes ( i use the dried equivalent ) | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 3/4 teaspoon ground fennel | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 4 medium yellow squash, scrubbed, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4 inch thick slices | 3/4 cup canned sliced grape leaves, drained | lettuce | toasted pine nuts
instructions: Stir together ground coffee with dry onion and thyme in a small bowl. Add squash slices.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,lemon zest,pork shoulder,cream mushroom soup
title: Hot Mexican Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 1 green chili pepper, chopped ( with seeds ) | 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder ( with skin on ) | 400 g cream of mushroom soup ( undiluted )
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees. Spray baking dish with cooking oil spray. Mix together lemon zest, chile and pork. Place pork mixture in casserole dish and sprinkle with soup. Cover in foil and bake 1 hour 1 hour. Remove foil and bake an additional hour.

title: Smoked Eggs
ingredients: 1 hard-boiled egg | 2 -4 teaspoons horseradish, drained
instructions: Slice the hard boiled egg about 3/4 into half rings. Insert the thin slices into the hot rings in a twist of cheesecloth. Sprinkle with horseradish. Let it set. This is delicious served with steamed veggies. For variations, try adding sliced bacon to the hot rings.

title: Malt Vinegar Pistachio Beef
ingredients: 600 g lean rump steak, cut roughly into 1cm cubes | 600g lean beef chuck | 600 g lean pork | 500 ml malt vinegar | 50 g sweet pistachios | 50 g butter | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon cocoa
instructions: Bring the malt vinegar to the boil in a large pan. Put the mince, beef, pork in the pan, then add the vinegar. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer slowly for about 40 minutes, turning frequently. Toast the pistachios in a dry pan, in a preheated oven for about 10 minutes with 250ml water. Cool slightly before grinding them into a paste. Take a shallow dish and put 1 tablespoon of the pistachio paste and enough boiling water to make a paste. Place 2 tablespoons the paste in this and stir. Leave for 10 minutes. While cooking pour half of the remaining malt vinegar into a separate saucepan. Heat the mixture, stir in the mustard seeds and cocoa to get the flavour through. Cool to room temperature. Slice beef and pork thinly. Drain excess fat from pan, and put into an ovenproof dish. Pour over half of the remaining malt vinegar and simmer, stirring continuously, for 1 hour. Serve the beef and pork with the rest of the pistachio paste and drizzle over the remaining vinegar.

Random Ingredients: gluten,scotch bonnet pepper,pearl barley,pork back rib,tomato basil,blueberry,orange,buckwheat flour
title: Smoked Oven Country Ribs for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking pearl barley | 4 lbs pork back ribs | 1 1/2 cups buckwheat flour | 1 1/2 cups scotch bonnet peppers, chopped | 1 cup orange, juice and zest | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil | 1/2 cup gluten | 1/2 cup blueberries
instructions: Turn the oven on to 300 degrees. Put the pearl barley in to a large bowl. Add the pork back into the bowl along with the buckwheat flour and set aside to allow to chill for a couple of hours. Mix in the peppers, orange juice and zest. Pour contents of the canned tomatoes into the mixture in the large bowl and stir well. Put the ribs into a large roasting pan. Spoon the mixture into the roasting pan then add enough water to come about halfway up the side of the ribs. Turn the whole pan on to the stove top heat the oven to 325 degrees, then put in the lid on the pan and place in the oven. Cook for 5 – 1 1/2 hours. Turn off the oven. Using a sharp knife, cut 3 slashes across the ribs. Allow the ribs to rest in the pan to cool. Slice the ribs thinly and serve with the reserved sauce for gravy or with potatoes and peas or just before serving. The liquid should keep the ribs moist for about 3 days.

title: Habanero Relish
ingredients: 3 habanero peppers | 1 cup lemon juice
instructions: Put the habanero peppers and 1 cup of lemon juice into a glass jar. Cover with a lid and shake to blend. Let sit for 30 minutes before using.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,chicken leg,green onion,navy bean,green bell pepper
title: German Chicken Hotpot
ingredients: 8 chicken legs | 2 cans navy beans, drained and rinsed | 2 green onions, chopped | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds
instructions: In a 3 1/2 or 4 quart slow cooker, combine chicken legs, navy beans, half the green onions, half the bell pepper, and caraway. Cover, and cook on high 1 hour.

title: Tomatillo Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 tomatillos, husked | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake tomatillos uncovered, until softened, 15 to 25 minutes. Remove and discard husks. Transfer to a bowl and mash, using 2 forks, until coarsely chopped. Stir in the whipped topping. Spread tomatillo mixture onto a baking sheet. Bake 30 to 40 minutes until heated through and lightly browned. Spoon topping onto a serving platter.

title: Rabo Vieja With Chilean Beef and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 can cauliflower or ( 16 ounce ) can other small cauliflower | 1 long serrano chili, seeded and minced
instructions: Trim the tough outer leaves of the cauliflower and cut the core off and discard. Cut into 1 inch pieces. Place the cauliflower pieces into a large bowl. Saute the minced chile over medium heat in the skillet for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove chile from heat. Pour chili and vegetables over the cauliflower. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: meat,hazelnut,jasmine rice,anise seed,pea,cream corn,dark brown sugar,apple cider vinegar
title: Apple Sweet and Spice Rice (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1 cup frozen peas | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 cup cooked diced meat | 1 tablespoon hulled hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped | 1 ounce sour cream or 1 ounce creme fraiche
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, heat 1/2 cup of water with the vinegar, brown sugar, and anise seeds over moderately low heat, stirring, until sugar is dissolved and heated through, about 5 minutes. Add meat, peas, and 1 teaspoons salt and stir to combine. Drain cooked rice and combine with remaining ingredients except sour cream and hazelnuts.

title: Aussie Blueberry & Broad Bean Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes or 4 large russet potatoes ( 6 oz ) | 1 1/2 cups dried broad beans or 1 1/2 cups green beans, chopped | 200 g blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Bake or microwave potatoes until tender.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,pecorino romano cheese,turkey sausage,ricotta cheese
title: Italian Turkey-And-Pea Casserole
ingredients: 5 -12 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 4 ounces turkey sausage, cooked and thinly sliced | 1 package yellow peas, frozen thawed
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients until well mixed. Stir in peas and transfer to baking dish. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 - 35 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: italian green bean,potato,cherry tomato,candy,italian sausage,ladyfinger,linguine,pork tenderloin
title: Lloria's Linguine Di Salsiccia
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 1 lb pork tenderloin or 1 lb beef tenderloin, sliced | 1 1/2 lbs hot italian sausage, casings removed | 1 can italian cut green beans | 1 bag italian-style cut ladyfingers | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | purchased italian-style candy sprinkle, for garnish
instructions: Cook linguine as directed on package. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 325 degrees. Parcook sausages. Set aside. Drain spaghetti. Stir sausage, green beans and french style bread into linguine. Cover with plastic wrap. Place in roasting pan with hot water until liquid just covers. Bake until heated through. Meanwhile, to make sauce, combine cherry tomatoes and italian style candy sprinkles. Drizzle over hot sauce. Top with fresh italian style sausage.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crust,halibut fillet,chambord raspberry liquor
title: Grilled Halibut With Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium halibut fillet | 3/4 cup chambord raspberry liquor | 1 graham cracker crust
instructions: Place halibut in pie crust. Drizzle with 1/2 cup chambord and 1/4 cup raspberry sauce. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,russet potato,red wine,plain yogurt,taco seasoning,double cream,sage,broth
title: Lazy Day Potatoes With a Mexican Twist
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup broth | 1 1/2 cups cheap red wine | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: Place the potato slices in a large saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Turn the heat down and simmer, gently shaking the pan and checking when the potatoes start to soften slightly, gently add a splash of lemon juice. Turn off the heat and allow the potatoes to cool for 5 - 10 minutes. Rinse the potatoes under cold water and then dry gently. When you have a good texture, drain most of the liquid from the potatoes and put through a sieve.. Put everything into a 2l microwave safe bowl and add the potatoes. Add the yoghurt, vinegar, taco seasoning and chicken, mix. Leave to sit for 10 - 15 minutes. Pour this over the potatoes in the bowl, cover and microwave on full power about 7 minutes. Turn the heat up to full power for about 5 minutes. Allow to stand for 5 - 10 minutes. Turn the oven on to 400f degrees. Take out the bowls from the microwave and pour the potato mixture over the potatoes.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,saffron thread,bay leaf,rye bread,lemonade concentrate,dark beer
title: Pub Style Sourdough Starter
ingredients: 1/4 cup saffron strands | 1 tablespoon hot red pepper flakes | 3 cups dark beer | 1 can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed ( use 1/4 cup regular milk and 1/4 cup skim milk substitue with 1/4 cup non-dairy milk powder instead ) | 11 1/2 ounces rye bread, rounds cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Combine saffron, red pepper flakes and beer in a 2 1/2 cup measuring cup.

title: Grilled Striped Beef Ribs
ingredients: 2 egg yolks | pita chips | 2 -3 lbs beef short ribs
instructions: In the bowl of a standing mixer, beat all the ingredients together. Trim excess fat from beef and season generously with salt and pepper. Place the rib on the rack of a broiler pan, fat side down, and cook about 10 minutes, or until the surface of the meat is medium brown and well seared. Remove the ribs from the oven and set aside. Brush the rack lightly with oil and arrange the ribs, fat side up, in a single layer on the broiler pan. Broil, fat side up, until the meat is browned to an internal temperature of 145° f/ 155° c, about 2 - 4 minutes. Turn the ribs over and grill until an instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the ribs registers 130° f 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Apple Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Mix together and let sit for at least 30 minutes. Use as a filling for meat.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,bay leaf,extra virgin olive oil,passion fruit,button mushroom
title: Wild Passionfruit Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 5 bay leaves | 1 sweet potato, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 packet frozen sliced button mushrooms | 1/2 bunch fresh passion fruit, chopped
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over a medium high heat. Add the bay leaves and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds. Tip in sweet potato. Stir in mushrooms and passionfruit. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes.

title: Orange Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast meat - cubed | 1 whole orange, juiced
instructions: Place the chicken breasts in a large resealable plastic bag. Squeeze the orange juice around all of the chicken, coating the chicken.

title: Avocado Tarragon Dressing
ingredients: 100 g frozen avocados, thawed and lightly mashed | 2 tablespoons tarragon, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Mix all ingredients in container with metal blade and process until very smooth in blender. Store in covered container for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,salt,vanilla extract,yellow pepper,jalapeno chile,basil pesto,water chestnut
title: Fresh Basil Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups loosely packed basil pesto | 1 cup finely chopped yellow sweet pepper | 2 teaspoons grated fresh jalapeno chiles or 1 teaspoon finely chopped serrano chili | 1/2 cup chopped water chestnut | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: In a large bowl, thoroughly toss all the ingredients together except the cocoa. Using a blender, blend to a smooth paste. If the paste seems to stiff, add up to 1/4 cup water. Cover and chill until ready to use. Serve immediately or transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 5 days.

title: Pumpkin and Pancetta Stew
ingredients: 1 1 piece pancetta | 1 yellow pepper, diced | 1 can pumpkin
instructions: Slice pancetta into 1 inch pieces. Add all ingredients to a large pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 1 hour. When tender, serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,kielbasa,baby red potato,flat leaf parsley,onion salt
title: My Favourite Home Fries
ingredients: 1 can baby red potatoes, drained | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables ( such as red beets, peas, carrots and cauliflower ) | 1 -2 tablespoon onion salt, to taste | 2 ounces kielbasa, sliced thinly | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees and place the potatoes and vegetables into a large roasting tin. Sprinkle the onions into the tin. Season with salt and layer the sliced kielbasa, parsley and chopped flat leaf parsley among the top. Pour enough boiling water into the roasting tin to come about halfway up the side. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are crisp and tender. To serve, slice the kielbasa and place on top of the vegetables in the roasting tin. Serve with crusty bread, a green salad or jacket potato salad.

title: Chunky Hominy
ingredients: 1 can hominy, drained | 1 can tuna fish
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Eat hot or cold.

title: Beer Battered Glazed Fruit
ingredients: 1 lb mixed fresh fruit | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon ginger, grated | 24 ounces light beer ( i prefer bush's ) or 24 ounces sparkling beer ( i prefer bush's )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and mix well. Let stand for 5 minute. Spoon into decorative baking dish or roasting/sauce dishes and serve. Note, depending on the fruit, you may have to put a tablespoon or 2 of beer in each dish and heat in a preheated 350 degree oven. Be sure to stir fruit occasionally so they don't break apart.

title: African Raspberries
ingredients: 500 g frozen raspberries | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: Place raspberries in saucepan and add enough cold water to completely cover them. Bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer uncovered until berries are tender. Drain liquid through a sieve into a bowl and allow raspberries to cool slightly. Return raspberries to saucepan and add crushed cardamom seeds. Simmer for 5 minutes. Cover and remove from heat. Allow to chill for at least 15 minutes before serving.

title: Swedish Beef Kebabs With Grapefruit & Raisins
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks, cut into 2 to 3-inch cubes | 1/4 cup golden raisin, snipped into 3-inch lengths | 1/4 cup seedless grapefruit juice
instructions: Place beef and raisins in a large resealable plastic bag. Add grapefruit juice and seal bag. Marinate in refrigerator 8 hours or overnight. Remove beef from marinade and thread onto skewers. Grill or broil kebabs 3 to 4 inches from heat 10 to 15 minutes or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,curry leaf,sherry,tomato green chilies,allspice,baking soda
title: Mumsma's Masala
ingredients: 2 cups roasted tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon hot red chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda, dissolved in | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 10 curry leaves ( optional )
instructions: Combine the chilli powder, baking soda and curry leaves and mix well. Add tomatoes, chilli powder mixture and sherry and stir to combine. Cover and store in refrigerator for upto half a week.

title: Tamina
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1/4 cup currants
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan.

title: Kiss Me Spinach
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese ( optional ) or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, plus additional for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: Put spinach in a pot and cover with enough cold water to just cover. Bring to a boil, cover and cook over high until just wilted, about 1 minute. Drain well and spread out in a 9 inch square baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese, if desired, and bake in a preheated 400°f oven until cheese is melted and just beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into squares, sprinkling with more cheese if using.

title: Crock Pot Swiss and Green Olives
ingredients: 1 package frozen swiss cheese slices, thawed | 1/2 lb swiss cheese, sliced | 1 1/2 cups green olives, sliced and pitted | 1/4 cup water | 1/3 cup dutch-processed cocoa
instructions: Place swiss cheese, cheese cutlets and sliced olives in crock pot. In small bowl, combine water and cocoa, stir until well combined. Stir water mixture evenly over cheese and top with onions and olives. Cover and cook on low heat for 5 to 6 hours or until cheese is warm, bubbly and onions are tender.

title: Faux "Mushroom and Cheese" With Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 3 tablespoons greek yogurt, plain is best ( or greek cream fraiche ) | 2 ounces marshmallows | 20 -25 small dried small shell pasta
instructions: Heat a skillet with a bit of oil spray on medium, add marshmallows and stir well until all melts and just begins to turn golden. Keep a close eye on them as they suddenly begin to caramelise. When the outer layer doesn't turn a golden color, add the dry pasta, stirring to coat. Serve with additional greek or sour cream.

title: Rotelle in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup tomato puree | 1 cup tomato sauce | 1 large head red cabbage, chopped | 1 package rotelle pasta
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the onion, tomato puree and tomato sauce. Bring to a boil. Mix in the cabbage. Cover and cook over low heat for 45 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside overnight to thicken. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the pasta in the pot and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,basil,parsley flake,coconut extract,pecorino romano cheese,cream cheese,kiwi fruit
title: Quick Key West Fondue
ingredients: 3 packages cream cheese, softened | 4 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese, blend | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 5 kiwi fruits
instructions: Combine cream cheese and pecorino romano cheese. Stir in spices, cheese mixture and kiwifruit. Serve with crackers.

title: Easy No-Layering Lasagna
ingredients: 15 -20 lasagna noodles or 1 lb fresh egg-free egg substitute | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook noodles according to package directions. Stir noodles into sauce. Spoon noodles onto foil lined 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle with ground cinnamon. Bake for about 30 minutes or until sauce is bubbly and hot.

Random Ingredients: white wine,lemon juice zest,celeriac,lemonade,orzo pasta,vegetable oil,tomato,sun tomato oil
title: Gordita's Orzo
ingredients: 6 ounces orzo pasta ( short pasta ) | 2 tablespoons orzo pasta ( short pasta ) | 1 ounce sun-dried tomato oil | 1 teaspoon grated lemon, rind of | 1/2 cup lemonade | 14 ounces vegetable oil | 1 -2 stalk celeriac ( or other softy-type vegetables ) | 1 large tomatoes, chopped | 1/3 cup white wine or 1/3 cup water
instructions: Cook orzo al dente, drain & set aside. In a large bowl, mix orzo w/lemon peel & tomato oil, set aside. Heat oil over medium heat. Add celeriac & cook until well browned. Drain orzo well & add to skillet w/tomatoes & broth. Heat until warmed through. Serve orzo topped w/charpatastic sauce or with other suggested accompaniments.

title: Baked Apricot Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 2 1/2 cups apricot jam | 1 1/2 cups vodka | 1 tablespoon hot chili oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In an 8x8 inch baking dish, stir together the rice and jam until the rice is well coated. Arrange the sliced apricot in a single layer and pour the vodka over them.

Random Ingredients: molasses,zucchini,blueberry,white rice,liquid smoke,flour tortilla,basil pesto,beef stock
title: Blueberry Zucchini Ground Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 large zucchini, sliced | 2 tablespoons white rice, uncooked | 2 teaspoons molasses | 2/3 cup beef stock | 3 tablespoons basil pesto | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1/2 cup blueberries | 8 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Spray a large nonstick wok or skillet with cooking spray. Over medium high heat, add zucchini and cook until browned, about 3 minutes. Add rice, molasses, beef stock, pesto and liquid smoke. Stir to combine and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until zucchini is tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in blueberries. Continue to stir during last 5 minutes of cooking time. Serve immediately with any remaining sauce.

title: Quick and Easy Curry Noodle Bake
ingredients: 500 g lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 -2 tablespoon olive, to season | 1 -1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 package celery hearts, cut in half ( i use frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven 180'c, if you don't have a fan tray, preheat the oven to 180'c. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add lasagna.

title: Cheese on the Grill
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning | 1 package shredded mexican cheese blend | 1 pinch cayenne powder
instructions: Spray griddle with cooking spray. Set a gas grill to medium high heat. In a bowl, mix taco seasoning with the cheese.

title: Slow Cooker Carnitas
ingredients: 1 package extra lean ground beef | 1 lb pork ribs
instructions: Place ground beef in crock, add ribs to crock, add ground beef, making sure ingredients are on and on top of ground beef. Cook on high for 4 - 4 1/2 hours. Take pork ribs out of crock to drain excess fat and serve.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,wheat bread,tomato puree,balsamic vinegar,sun tomato oil,turkey,salad dressing,chicken bouillon
title: Smoked Turkey Club Burgers
ingredients: 180 g cooked chicken or 180 g turkey, diced | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 2 teaspoons tomato puree | 10 slices whole wheat bread, toasted | 1 tablespoon salad dressing | 1 -2 teaspoon low-fat chicken bouillon or 1 -2 teaspoon low-fat chicken broth | 1 cup pinto beans
instructions: Combine chicken or turkey, vinegar, tomato puree, 1 tablespoon of the oil from sun dried tomatoes, pesto, stock and bouillon. Fold together until combined.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,dark soya sauce,bamboo shoot,chicken breast,coconut
title: Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 3 cups shredded cooked chicken breasts | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1 cup cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons dark soya sauce | 1 tablespoon coconut
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Pour into baking dish. Bake in moderate oven for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Finger-Licking Taco Polenta
ingredients: 1/3 cup taco seasoning mix | 3 cups polenta, coarse | 3 cups taco-seasoned crumbled polenta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Liberally spray a 9x13 baking dish. In a small bowl, combine taco seasoning mix and crumbled polenta. Add to the pan.

Random Ingredients: oil,dulce de leche,egg wrap,farina,sourdough bread,oat,worcestershire sauce,cumin
title: Dulce De Leche French Toast With Croutons
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups dulce de leche or 1 2/3 cups other favorite cheese spread | 1 1/2 cups farina ( or other hard style farina ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 egg roll wrap, about 30-40 inches long | oil ( for frying ) | 1/4 teaspoon cumin, toasted | 12 slices sourdough bread | 2 cups dulce de leche or 2 cups other favorite cheese sandwiches
instructions: Place cheese spread, farina worcestershire sauce, cumin and egg roll wrap in a resealable plastic bag and shake well. Remove 1/4 of the bag for each sandwich, leaving about a half inch of hole. Heat 1/4 oil in a large skillet or griddle over medium heat. When oil is hot, add the french toast, coating both sides with the paste. Cook about 3 minutes per side or until cooked through, turning once. When done, remove from heat and sprinkle with cumin.

title: Avocado Balls
ingredients: 2 avocados | 1 cup shredded graham cracker crumbs | herbs | 1 tablespoon grated extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Mash avocados slightly. Add in graham cracker crumbs, mix well. Add additional olive oil to help prevent sticking, mix well. Form into 1 balls and wrap a tooth pick on top. Heat oil in a pan to medium temperature and cook balls until puffed up a bit, they should be golden brown and crispy around the outside. Remove tooth pick and eat them plain, or let cool and serve with your favorite mexican dish.

title: Feta Cheese With a Chilled Chardonnay
ingredients: 1/2 lb feta cheese, cut into cubes | 1/4 white onion, very finely diced | 1 tablespoon crushed cardamom pod | 1 cup dry chardonnay wine
instructions: Over low heat, melt the goat cheese, mashing it into crumbs with a wooden spoon. When the cheese has melted, add the white onion and crushed cardamom pods, stirring well. Turn off the burner. Pour the chardonnay into a serving dish, pour over the melted cheese and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,brandy,balsamic vinegar,watermelon,clove,chipotle pepper,anchovy fillet,tomato green chilies
title: Brunch Watermelon in Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 seedless watermelon, chunks | 1 chipotle pepper, chopped | 3 cloves | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon anchovy fillet, chopped | 5 ounces canned diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Cut watermelon chunks into 1/4 inch cubes. In a small saucepan, combine the chipotle, cloves, vinegar, anchovy, tomatoes with chiles, enchilada sauce, and brandy. Simmer over medium heat until hot.

title: Soufflé Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine or 1 lb other pastas | 2 quinces, peeled and halved | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, salt it and cook the pasta according to package directions. Drain the linguine, reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid and pasta water. Place the halved quince in a sieve and sprinkle with brandy. Combine the reserved reserved pasta cooking liquid, vinegar and cream of tartar until blended. Place the quince, quince brine and sauce in a bowl. Toss gently, serve and enjoy.

title: Sweet Sour Beef
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon jam
instructions: Put meat in large frying pan. Heat for 45 minutes on high heat, adding salt to taste. Stir in soy sauce. Cook 1 minute. Add jam. Cook until thickened.

title: Pepperjack Beef Tenderloin Pie
ingredients: 1 cup frozen mixed berries | 10 ounces beef tenderloin, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons lemonade | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated gingerroot | 1 medium yellow pepper, sliced | 1 package refrigerated pie shells | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Thaw frozen mixed berries according to package instructions. Place berries and beef in saucepan and pour 1/2 cup milk over beef. Cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Add remaining milk, ginger and pepper.

title: Italian Raisin Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon dark raisins ( golden ) | 2 dashes salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together together the cornflour until all of the lumps disappear. Stir in the mayonnaise and raisins. Season with salt, pepper and oregano. Serve.

title: Penne With Korean Pepper Jelly Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 lb penne | 1 serrano pepper, seeded ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons korean red pepper paste ( gochujang ) | 3 eggs | 1/2 cup evaporated milk
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. While the water is coming to a boil, cut the serrano pepper to 1/4 inch thick slices, and set aside. Add the pepper paste to the boiling water and cook for about 2 minutes. Drain the water out, and add it back to the pot. Beat the eggs in a large bowl and add the milk, and add enough of the hot water to the egg mixture to mix well. Cook the egg mixture until it coats the back of a wooden spoon. When it coats the back of the wooden spoon, remove it with a slotted spoon and set aside. When the water boils again, add the penne to the boiling water. Cook the pasta al dente. Drain the cooked pasta, reserve ¾ cup of the pasta water, then add the pasta to the sauce. Add the hot pepper jelly to the sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Bread Machine French Bread
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 can great northern beans ( undrained )
instructions: Place ingredients into the pan of your bread machine in the order specified by your machine. Select white bread setting.

title: Caesar Salad With Chiles and Cactus (Shrimp) Cheese.
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cactus leaves ( small ) | 1 cup thinly sliced pearl onions or 1 cup red onion | 1/8 cup fresh worcestershire sauce | crushed ice cream
instructions: Using a very sharp knife, trim the edges of the cactus leaves. Cut out the core and leaves of the cactus stems. Rinse well. Shred the leaves using two forks. In a salad bowl, toss all ingredients together, then add the crushed ice cream and toss to mix well. Sprinkle on top of the salad just prior to serving.

title: Basil and Canadian Bacon Rice
ingredients: 16 ounces boneless beef roast, trimmed of fat | 1 slice canadian bacon, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1 cup long grain rice | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Rinse beef and place in a large, resealable plastic bag. Add canadian bacon, basil leaves and rice. Seal and place in refrigerator at least 6 hours and up to 2 days. Turn oven control to 325 degrees f. Drain beef, reserving marinade. Place beef mixture in a large roasting pan or roasting pan. Arrange bacon slices over the top and around roast. Bake, covered, for 2 hours, or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. Remove roast from oven and cover tightly with foil. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,monterey jack cheese,white wine,peppercorn,caster sugar,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Colby & Jack Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 125 ml white wine | 125 ml splenda granular ( if your calorie counting ) | 125 ml monterrey jack cheese | 125 ml colby-monterey jack cheese | 125 ml peppercorns | 1 teaspoon caster sugar ( or other raw sugar )
instructions: Put the wine, splenda, monterrey jack & colby monterey cheeses, peppercorns, and sugar in a saucepan & bring to the boil. Reduce the heat & simmer for 5 minutes. Heat a griddle or frying pan to its highest heat & add the hot mixture to the griddle. Cook to the desired doneness, stirring every few minutes to keep the cheese from sticking to the sides & bottom of the griddle. Serve with a side of warm cheese dip and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,asafoetida powder,cider vinegar,blueberry,cocoa powder,mango chutney
title: Mango chutney Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup mango chutney ( i used a blend of mango and apricots ) | 1 cup blueberries | 2 large kalamata olives | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 3 teaspoons asafoetida powder ( i used 1 tsp. if available for personal preference ) | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder
instructions: Start by placing all of the ingredients in a food processor or blender. Pulse the mixture until smooth and creamy. To thin it out, you may add 1 - 2 tsp of sugar at a time, blending in between pulses.

title: Salsa-Fast Version of Nacho Scoop
ingredients: 1 cup salsa | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Using a small bowl, mix together salsa and tomato sauce.

title: Beef Tenderloin Tarkari
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed weight | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 cup yoghurt | 1 small pomegranate | 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: Score the surface of the beef using a sharp, even diamond pattern, about 1/4 inch deep using a sharp knife. Slice across the grain on the diagonal 1/4 inch thick. Marinate the meat in the sesame oil for about 20 minutes at room temperature. Boil yoghurt and pomegranate for 3 - 5 minutes and remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. In a small frying pan heat the sesame oil on high heat for 30 seconds each side or until starting to brown. Place the beef in the frying pan using a metal broiler rack or large oven dish and cook. Cook indirectly for 15 minutes, turning once. Remove pan from heat and turn meat onto a warmed platter. Brush meat with sesame oil. Serve with the yoghurt and pomegranate wedges.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,beef brisket,beer,white flour,cider vinegar,lime juice,thai red curry paste
title: Beer-Braised Brisket
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket | 2 1/2 cups strong cider vinegar | 1/2 cup lemon zest | 1 1/2 cups beer | 6 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 6 tablespoons white flour | 1/2 cup lime juice
instructions: Trim brisket.

title: Sausage, Bacon and Beans With Baked Mashed Banana
ingredients: 350 g bacon | 750 g minced meat | 100 -180 ml beef stock or 100 -180 ml vegetable stock | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 400 g cooked kidney beans | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Cook bacon till crisp. Drain bacon, remove any fat from pan and crumble. Cook mince in bacon fat till browned. Remove with slotted spoon and place in ovenproof casserole/dicottes dish, add stock, sage, cooked bacon and beans and stir over heat till warmed through and hot. Serve with boiled or steamed potatoes and seasonal vegetables.

title: Lamb With Yoghurt and Chilies
ingredients: 5 medium lamb, trimmed and cut small | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 3 small red chilies | 1/3 cup goat cheese, crumbled
instructions: Combine lamb with yogurt and chillies and chill to marinate for a few hours. Toss the lamb with the goat cheese so it is melted. Cook meat on high for 3 mins turning often until brown on outside and cooked. Serve on a bed of vegetables.

title: Brazilian Greens Soup
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock | 8 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper
instructions: Place a skillet over medium heat and add the vegetable stock. Bring to a simmer.

title: Mexican Beans (Pinto Beans or Pinto Beans)
ingredients: 1 box pinto beans | 3/4 cup coconut
instructions: Soak beans in water to cover over night. Drain, place beans, coconut, and salt to taste in crock pot. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Shred with fork or stew meat. Serve with corn chips.

title: Cardamom Mango Cheese (Or Feta) Stacks
ingredients: 2 large pints ripe mangoes, peeled with the pits removed ( you don't need to peel, it works fine ) | 8 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons cardamom seeds, lightly crushed | 6 lemon wedges
instructions: Position two racks in top third of oven and preheat broiler. Cut mangoes crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices and place on two baking sheets lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle each slice evenly with 1/4 cup cheese. Stir crushed cardamom seeds into 1/2 cup mangoes. Place cut side down on the baking sheets, cut side up. Sprinkle tops of slices evenly with remaining cheese. Broil until golden brown, 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: allspice,italian salad dressing mix,coconut,kosher salt,extra virgin olive oil
title: Italian Flavored Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon italian salad dressing mix | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 shredded coconut
instructions: Whisk first 5 ingredients together. Then add coconut and serve.

Random Ingredients: cabbage leaf,pickling spice,farfalle pasta,cumin powder,cocoa powder,soda water
title: Chili, Cabbage, Beer, and Noodle (Sara)
ingredients: 1/2 lb farfalle pasta ( small elbow, bowtie, etc. ) | 4 -6 cups cabbage leaves, chopped finely | 3 tablespoons pickling spices | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 cup soda water | 4 teaspoons cocoa powder ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non reactive pot, cover with a lid, and cook for about an hour or longer. Taste and adjust seasoning. Note, if desired, for a less pungent hot cabbage taste, use non stick spray instead of cayenne pepper.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,chicken broth,cumin,seasoning mix,beef sirloin steak
title: Famous Taco Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak | 1 can tomato and green chilies | 1 container chicken broth | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 package good seasonings mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Slice beef thinly across the grain and put in a large bowl. Add all remaining ingredients except seasoning mix. Mix all ingredients with your hands and form into four loaves. Place each loaf on a large piece of aluminum foil or large baking sheet. Wrap tightly and bake for 20 minutes. Turn foil over and bake for an additional 10 - 12 minutes until meat is no longer pink.

title: Summer Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup cracked wheat couscous | 1/4 lb sliced provolone cheese or 1/4 lb swiss cheese, cut into thin slices | 1/4 lb sliced fresh fruit ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh small basil | 8 fresh medium fresh sage leaves, coarsely chopped | 12 ounces small fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/4-inch slices ( about 1 cup ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped dry roasted peanuts, optional ( optional )
instructions: Put couscous in a bowl, and pour enough boiling water over to cover. Set aside for 5 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed. Cool until lukewarm, about 10 minutes. Add cheese.

title: Pineelles Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1 tablespoon ghee | 3/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 -3 minced fresh thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons finely chopped ghee | 2 1/2 cups fillings
instructions: Cook rice in 2 - 3 cups water until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Heat ghee in a wok and fry the cumin and thyme sprigs till golden. Add the fillings and rice and fry till all the fillings have softened. Serve warm with chillies.

title: Ranch-Style Beans
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups bean sprouts | 2 cups vegetable shortening | 2 dried red chilies, soaked in boiling water for 20 minutes, seeded, and chopped
instructions: Place the bean sprouts in a large bowl. Cut the shortening into 1 to 2 inch chunks. Stir the chilies into the shortening until the lard is melted. Drain the soaked beans and add to the bowl with the chilies. Stir well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,rice vinegar,parsley leaf,thyme leaf,feta cheese,vinegar
title: Mushrooms With Feta Cheese and Herbs (Dvita)
ingredients: 2 ounces fetta cheese, lean, about 1 cup, diced into 1/2-inch pieces | 12 ounces whole button mushrooms, trimmed | 1/4 cup distilled rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves, minced ( optional ) | 1 -3 tablespoon reduced sodium feta cheese, crumbled ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a large nonreactive nonreactive skillet, cook the diced cheese on both sides in 1 tablespoons hot olive oil until it is golden brown. Stir in the mushrooms and cook, stirring, until tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in the remaining ingredients and heat over medium heat until melted. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,vegetable broth,tortilla,cranberry sauce,golden raisin,vegetable oil butter,sugar,apple juice
title: Vegetarian Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 1/3 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 1 1/3 cups apple juice | 1/3 cup vegetable oil ( i've found a combination with other oils if not gluten-free ) | 1/4 cup cashew nuts ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sugar ( sometimes i get splenda ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves ( i usually take it ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh tortillas | 24 ounces hot fat free sour cream or 24 ounces low fat cottage cheese
instructions: Make the enchilada sauce, combine raisins with broth, apple juice, vegetable oil and nuts. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir often to prevent sticking. Remove from heat. Make the tortillas, heat oven to 350°f coat a 13x9x2 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Heat a small amount of oil to sauté cashews and stir until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Spray tortillas lightly with oil. Dip each tortilla into the hot fat, turning until completely covered. Place in the prepared baking dish and spread with the sour cream, if desired, and then sprinkle with sautéed cashews. Pour the enchilada sauce over them and bake until the sauce thickens, about 20 minutes. Top with fresh cilantro.

title: Greek Yogurt Pasta & Caramelized Red Pepper Filling
ingredients: 1 cup plain fat free greek yogurt ( or a non-dairy, low-fat yogurt ) | 1/4 cup apple juice ( preferably organic ) | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( or to taste ) | 3/4 lb wheat pasta, such as kumara ( you can use other spiral shaped pasta )
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions. While the pasta cooks, combine all the dressing ingredients in a small bowl. Toss the pasta with the honey dressing mixture. Serve right away.

title: Cream Cheese and Saffron Soup
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon saffron ( optional ) | 1/2 cup light cream cheese, cut up ( neufchatel ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme ( optional ) | 1/2 cup toasted unsweetened coconut, toasted ( can substitute coconut flakes or flaked almonds )
instructions: Combine stock and saffron in medium saucepan. Bring to boil. Add cream cheese and thyme. Simmer until cream cheese is fluffy. Serve hot.

title: Mango and Cornmeal Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 2 cups grated ripe mangoes | 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray 8x8 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Place all ingredients in a food processor, blender, or blender, and process until smooth. Pour into prepared dish, and press a few mango slices, if desired, on top. Bake 45 to 55 minutes in the preheated oven, until bubbly. Serve warm, warm or chilled. Serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy Beef Sambol Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 16 frozen sweet potato sticks, defrosted, do not use the peeler | 1 can pinto beans, drain the liquid and reserve ( optional ) | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon cumin, ground | 3 ounces quick-cooking oats | 16 medium bamboo skewers
instructions: Prepare the quick cooking oats according to package directions, using the beef broth with the cumin. Dunk the frozen sweet potato in just enough of the beef broth to start steaming, and then just leave them in the broth. I use 4 - 7 in a bag, since they are so soft they will not cook any more than 3 - 5 minutes before removing from the broth. After you have cooked the first batch of quick oats and have drained the pinto beans, stir in the diced sweet potato and continue to cook and stir until the potatoes are tender and warmed through. Mix to combine and continue to cook, stirring for a minute or two, until the sweet potato and the broth have incorporated together. Once the soup is heated through, stir in the oats and cook for a minute or two until the oats are lightly colored and the soup has a nice sour crust. Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight for best results.

title: Blackberry Medley
ingredients: 4 cups blackberries | 1 tablespoon orange zest ( optional )
instructions: Boil the blackberries and zest until they start turning brown, about 1 - 2 minutes. Pour into a 2 cup glass measure and add orange juice if using, the zest is optional, but I find 2 tbsp would make a much prettier medley. Cover with plastic wrap or a dishtowel and set aside to cool slightly. Serve as small snacks or on a bbq for a cold meal.

title: Pierogies
ingredients: 12 large egg roll wraps | 4 whole eggs | 1 tablespoon dried thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat. Open the egg roll wrappers. Place some of them near the tip of the wrapper, and pinch the edges together with your fingers. Whisk eggs and thyme together in a bowl to make a paste, and pour over 1/2 the wrappers. Use all of the egg mixture, if your hands are very wet, you might need the extra. Sprinkle a little more of the paste on top of the egg roll wrapper, patting down lightly, and press the edges together. Transfer to a baking sheet, and repeat until you have used all of the wrapper and the filling. Bake in the preheated oven until top feels springy and filling is golden brown, about 25 minutes. Let cool on a rack for 15 minutes, then wrap tightly in plastic wrap, and refrigerate until ready to use. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Chinese Spice Paste
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons szechuan peppercorns or 1 1/4 teaspoons a combination of the two, depending on your taste
instructions: Mix all the spices together and form into small patties. Saute on a hot frying pan or fryer. Allow them to cool, then transfer them to a storage container and store.

title: Iranian Lamb Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lamb | 4 potatoes, peeled, cut into chunks | 1 1/2 cups broth | 4 tablespoons cashews
instructions: Place lamb, potatoes, 1/2 cup broth, and cashewnuts in large casserole. Cover and cook at 325 degrees for 4 hours. Stew should be thick and browned.

title: Tuna and Shichimi Salad (Korean Fusion)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh basil | 3 large anaheim chilies | 1 can tuna | 1 cup cubed cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons juice, freshly squeezed | 1 teaspoon orange juice | 2 1/2 tablespoons tuna
instructions: Finely chop fresh basil. Wash and dry chilies. Cut each chilies into 1/4 inch slices. Boil in salted water for about 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and rinse in ice water. Remove seeds from chilies. Drain and chop. Mix salad ingredients in a bowl. Mix remaining ingredients together. Add dressing to salad.

Random Ingredients: coffee,confectioner ' sugar,vegetable oil cooking spray,yellow potato,white corn syrup,porcini mushroom
title: Porcini Mushroom & Dried Potato Candy
ingredients: 1 lb small yellow potato, peeled | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup dried porcini mushrooms or 1/2 cup dried shiitake mushroom, chopped | 1/2 cup white corn syrup | 2 -3 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 -3 tablespoon instant coffee
instructions: If you have a porcinni mushroom and dried shiitake mushrooms that are a couple of inches square, the mushrooms should be sliced about a centimeter in width. Coat the outside of the potato slices thoroughly with vegetable oil spray. Place the potatoes on a pan in a single layer and mist them with cooking spray. Bake on a baking sheet in a 450 degree oven until golden brown, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven. While the potatoes are baking, combine the dried mushrooms with the corn syrup in a small sauce pan. Stir continuously until the butter has melted. Remove the pan from the heat and let it cool to room temperature. Then, combine the confectioners' sugar and a couple tablespoons of the hot liquid from the pan until it is a sticky but spreadable consistency. Spread some of the melted butter on the warm potato slices to smooth them.
