When the fries are cooled to the touch, spread one side of each potato slice with about 2 tablespoons of the mushroom mixture and sprinkle with the dried shiitake nut mixture. Fold the potato in half and repeat for the 2nd potato. Coat an empty baking sheet with cooking spray and arrange the potato wrapped potato on the baking sheet in a single layer. Sprinkle any leftover melted butter mixture over the potato covered potato slices and put back in the oven. Bake at 450 degrees for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove from oven, and cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,papaya,coriander,spaghetti squash,beef broth,plain flour,seashell pasta,egg yolk
title: Namur Fritters
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 310 ml beef broth | 1 tablespoon papaya, chopped | 310 ml seashell pasta, broken into 1cm slices | 310 g spaghetti squash, cubed | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped | 90 g rasso's fresh seaweed, shredded
instructions: Stir the egg yolk in a medium bowl with a whisk until pale. Gradually add the oil in a steady stream, whisking constantly. Turn the mixture into a jug. Sprinkle the flour over the surface, stir until well combined, then set aside for 30 minutes at room temperature. Drain the spaghetti squash under a colander until cool. Place the beef broth and the reserved flour in a saucepan. Cook over a medium high heat until the mixture boils, then remove and set aside. Add the papaya and stir until just warmed. Add the pasta and cook, stirring constantly until heated through. Stir in the squash and coriander. Remove from the heat, place half the coconut on a board and spread to cover the base of a heated large, 12 cup capacity texas muffin tin. Spoon half the pasta mixture evenly over the coconut and half the beef mixture. Spread with the remaining coconut. Top with the second mixture and spread evenly. Scheddar cheese and fresh coriander leaves can be sprinkled on top if desired.

title: Simple Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 300 g red curry paste | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Thinly slice the curry paste and dissolve the baking powder in it. Add the curry paste to the baking powder and mix.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,mexican tomato,mascarpone cheese,pico de gallo,maraschino cherry,corn oil,creole seasoning,oil
title: Spicy Mexican Tomato Dip
ingredients: 1 can mexican-style tomatoes, drained ( hunts ) | 2 tablespoons mexican-style stewed tomatoes ( hunts ) | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning ( parma-reis ) | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon maraschino cherry ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon pico de gallo or 1 tablespoon homemade guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Mix all the ingredients except pico de gallo.

title: Grap-Stuffed Potato Pancetta With Pear and Pancetta
ingredients: 6 small baking potatoes | 6 slices pancetta | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 cup red seedless grapes | 1 pear, cored and sliced
instructions: Preheat a grill pan over medium heat and position a rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Lightly grease the grilling pan. Cut off the stems from the potato slices, but leave some of the skin intact if desired. If you want, you can make the potato skins out of the potato skins or cut off the ends from around the inside of the potato skins. Halve the potato slices, then, using a teaspoon, scoop out the pulp and pulp and set aside. Place the pulp in a bowl with some water to help thin the cooking juices. Taste for salt.

title: Truly Jordanian Bread for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 loaf turkish bread ( from a baguette loaf ) | 1 cup golden syrup | 1 cup pitted olive ( you can squeeze a small can of pitted olives over top if you wish ) ( optional )
instructions: Open the baguette out flat and cut into 1 inch chunks. Brush each chunk with olive oil and sprinkle bread with the golden syrup. Place on a grill and cook, with the lid closed until golden on both sides.

title: Skirt Steak Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 fat, lean trimmed of fat and cut into thin strips | 12 fat free monterey jack cheese with cheese, shredded
instructions: Spray a nonstick skillet with a little nonstick spray. Heat skillet on medium high. Add strips of peppery peppery peppery peppery peppery peppery cheese to the skillet. Cook and stir strips until cheese melts, 1 - 2 minutes. Turn over and cook another 10 seconds so both sides are nicely browned. Remove from heat and cut into 5 strips. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,rice krispies,coffee granule,pork chop,pork shoulder,pepper,sesame seed oil,bread crumb
title: Japanese Pork Pudding With Roasted Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 4 cups coarsely chopped pork shoulder or 4 cups other lean boneless pork, | 1/2 cup bread crumbs, dried bread crumbs | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon ground pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon sesame seed oil | 2 slices dry bread crumbs | pork chops or assorted cooked meat of your choice | sesame seeds oil ( for greasing the pan )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Toss the pork shoulder and two bread crumbs together. Add the coffee, pepper, sesame oil and 1 teaspoon of the sesame oil and mix. Place the chops on a jelly roll pan, and flatten slightly. Place the pork chop on top, spacing evenly. Sprinkle evenly with the remaining 6 tablespoons sesame oil and bread crumbs. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned and crisp on top. Cut into 4 servings. Drizzle with the sesame oil and serve with cooked meat and steamed rice.

title: Chocolate French Toast
ingredients: 4 thick slices bread | 1 pinch saffron | 1 teaspoon corn flour | 1 1/3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Place the bread slices on a non stick griddle with 1/3 tablespoon of cocoa in between each slice. Place the griddle and cook over medium high until lightly browned. While the french toast is cooking, add the rest of the ingredients to a blender or food processor and puree until smooth. When the french toast is done, coat with the mixture. Serve.

title: Chicken and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken meat | 1 pound red potatoes, cut into quarters
instructions: Pour half of vegetable oil into a large pot and set heat to medium. Place chicken meat into the pot and place chicken in oil. Cook for about five minutes.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,mascarpone cheese,nutritional yeast,rainbow candy,vanilla sugar
title: Rice Candy Desserts With Cinnamon-Mascarpone (Rice Ball Dessert)
ingredients: 500 g mascarpone cheese ( in the tub or a little over 10 oz ) | 3 tablespoons raw sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast ( optional ) | 8 fluid ounces cider vinegar | 1 cup rainbow sprinkles, cut into squares
instructions: Mix mascarpone, raw sugar, sugar, vanilla sugar and nutritional yeast together until smooth. If using, add vinegar to vinegar and stir to dissolve. Place 2 tbsp of this mixture in palm sized clear glass container lined with plastic wrap, and press in onto the bottom of the mold.. Add 2 tsp of cinnamon sugar to top of mixture, which should give a cinnamon nutty taste, as soon as all liquid has passed around the outside edge of the mold, spread layer of balls with cinnamon sugar in a single layer, sprinkle a little of the remaining cinnamon sugar over top and set aside. Repeat process with remaining mixture until you have used up all the ingredients, and store in refrigerator. Before serving, place rainbow sprinkles around the outside edge of the glasses and serve. If using vinegar, mix all ingredients together to dissolve the cinnamon sugar into the syrup and let it thicken for just a few minutes, then pour over rainbow sprinkles.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,red capsicum,white flour,mayonnaise,palm sugar,liquid smoke,anchovy fillet,raspberry
title: Raspberry Salad With Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup raspberry, halved | 1/2 cup red capsicum, finely diced | 1 tablespoon white flour | 2 teaspoons anchovy fillets | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 pinch liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon palm sugar | 1/2 cup taco sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c or 160°c if fan forced. Line baking tray with baking paper, grease paper, sprinkle with icing sugar. Place raspberries in microwave safe bowl, cover on hi for 1 minutes or until beginning to soften. Cut capsicum into strips. Combine capsicum, flour, anchovy and mayonnaise through food processor. Add liquid smoke and palm sugar, process to combine. Divide mixture among serving bowls. Top with remaining raspberries.

title: Korean Steamed Vegetables and Beef for Soup
ingredients: 1 bunch veg | 1 lb boneless beef chuck
instructions: Wash and cut meat into 2 or 3 pieces, depending on the shape of the beef. Cut the meat of the veg into bite size pieces. Wash the vegetables, and cut them into 3 to 4 pieces, depending on their size. Heat a pan to medium heat. Put a generous pinch of salt on each piece of meat and sear the sides, then turn and sear on the other side. Place the meat in the hot fat. They cook very quickly and will sear well on the outside. Take them out when they have browned lightly.

title: Spinach and Tomato Tortilla Cake by Tyler Florence
ingredients: 500 g baby spinach, washed and drained | 1 can crushed tomatoes | 1 tablespoon pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 fresh lemon, juice of | sea salt, for taste | 3 large ripe tomatoes, thickly sliced, for garnish ( optional ) | 1 large bunch radish, very thinly sliced, for garnish ( optional ) | 3 large ladyfingers, torn into pieces ( optional ) | 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese ( optional ) or 1/2 cup asiago cheese, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Wash and drain the spinach thoroughly. Place in a bowl with 100ml of boiling water and the tomatoes. Leave for 15 minutes until the spinach is just beginning to wilt. Drain well in a colander and squeeze out excess water. Combine the spinach with the romano cheese and add half the pepino cheese. Add the lemon juice, season with salt, and set aside. Arrange half the torn tomatoes onto an oven tray. Top with half the sliced radishes. Remove the spinach mixture from the fridge and toss with the remaining chopped tomatoes, arranging them randomly amongst the tomato layers. Spread the spinach mixture over the tomatoes, then scatter remaining pepino over the top. Set in the oven and bake for 15 minutes until the topping is golden. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly before topping with half the finely grated cheese. Serve while the tortilla is still warm and crisp.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,rum,shallot,rice wine vinegar,chili bean,rock shrimp,parmesan cheese,watermelon
title: Barbecue Spicy Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rock shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/3 cup barbecue sauce | 1/3 cup chopped shallot | 1/2 cup chopped watermelon, divided | 2 tablespoons rum | 2 tablespoons chili beans, chopped | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine shrimp, vinegar, barbecue sauce, shallots, 1/2 cup watermelon, rum and chili beans. Stir to mix and refrigerate 30 minutes. Just before serving, garnish with remaining 1/2 cup watermelon, parmesan cheese, and remaining 1/2 cup watermelon.

title: Sweet and Spicy Black Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon margarine | 2 teaspoons diced serrano chilies | 1 can black bean sauce | 2 cups chopped carrots | 4 ice cubes | crushed ice blocks
instructions: In large skillet over medium heat melt margarine or butter, add chilies and black bean sauce and cook until thick. Pour into blender or food processor and blend until smooth. In a large serving bowl, combine carrots and ice cubes and pour over bean mixture. Serve immediately while croutons are not served.

title: Brussels Sprouts and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 10 brussels sprouts | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Slice cabbage and sprouts into 1 inch lengths, about 8 to 10 cups. Combine cabbage and sprouts in a small bowl. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add cabbage/sprouts.

title: Scottish Gumbo Cookies
ingredients: 3 cups flour | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1 pound peeled and deveined medium shrimp - alive | 1 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the flour, baking soda, and salt. Cut shrimp into small dices and drop into the flour mixture. Stir with a spoon so that the shrimp are thoroughly coated. If they sink to the bottom when they are, you don't need to press them down by any means since they will release their juices during the baking process. On a lightly floured surface or lightly floured cookie sheet, roll out the shrimp dough 1/8 inch thick. Use about 1/2 teaspoon of stuffing per cookie. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the cookies are slightly golden brown. Roll the outside of the cookies in sugar and serve warm.

title: Scottish Scones
ingredients: 4 cups mixed vegetables | barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Pour mixed vegetables in a roasting tin. Pour mixed vegetables evenly over the vegetables. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes. Variation, this type of herb and vegetable mix can also be used as filling for fresh salads.

title: Greek Muesli
ingredients: 1 cup non-fat plain greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Whisk together the yogurt, sugar, and 1 tablespoons of the non fat plain yogurt mixture in a non metallic bowl. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours before serving to allow the flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,black peppercorn,salt black pepper,sun tomato oil,quinoa,green onion,curry powder
title: Quinoa Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 large ripe tomatoes ( about 6-6 ounces each ) | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup crumbled cotija cheese | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 4 green onions | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns, crushed | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat and preheat the broiler. Prepare the tomatoes by scrubbing and chopping off the stems and cores.

Random Ingredients: string bean,sauce,lemon peel,thyme sprig,crescent dinner,hot water
title: Hot Spicy Fruit Tartlets
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, defrosted | 2 cans dried long string beans, drained | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | hot water, as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f using 1/3 cup of the biscuit crumbs, roll dough into a rectangle, and place on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Cut a cross in the top of dough, to stop it from bleeding on the inside, and sprinkle top with 1 teaspoon each hot sauce, thyme, lemon peel, and remaining hot sauce. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, until golden brown and crisp. Let cool 5 minutes in pan.

title: French Canadian Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces seashell pasta | 2 cups milk | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/3 cup soy milk | 1 tablespoon mixed italian spices
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Drain. In a pan, add 1 tbls. Of canola oil. Pour in milk.

Random Ingredients: bucatini pasta,beef broth,yellow pea,pita pocket bread,bell pepper,red bell pepper,parsnip
title: Gigantes (Pepper Soup)
ingredients: 6 large pimiento stuffed pita pockets | 1 lb yellow sweet potato, peeled & cut in 1 inch cubes | 1 cup bell pepper, diced | 1 small parsnip, peeled & halved lengthwise & then sliced | 1 cup red bell pepper, diced | 6 1/2 ounces bucatini pasta or 6 1/2 ounces other pastas, any flavour ( small ) | 1/4 cup beef broth | 2 tablespoons mixed pulses ( pita bread, lentils or french-style lentils )
instructions: Heat a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat.

title: Salsa and Oregano
ingredients: 2 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, seeded | 4 ounces ice
instructions: Peel tomatoes and cut into chunks. Place in a heat proof bowl. Pour in enough ice to cover. Let sit for at least 10 minutes before serving,.

title: Fettuccine Di Fungi (Fettuccine with Fettuccine)
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine or 1 lb spaghetti | 2 cups all-purpose white flour
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse under cold water and drain. While pasta is cooking mix together a medium thick gravy pan over low heat and add one half cup of the flour. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Pour in flour and flour mix. Cook for one minute more, stir. Add a half cup of water and simmer for five minutes. Drain pasta and toss well with gravy.

title: Stir Fried Beef and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 lb potato, cut into small dice | 1/3 cup green onion, sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf | cooked quinoa ( optional )
instructions: In a large frying pan or wok, add the meat and onions and saute a few minutes. Add the potatoes and cook until done to your liking. Add all of your spices, stir to mix well and finish with a lid to keep the mixture from sticking to the pan or to your pot. Serve over cooked pasta for a delicious, quick and tasty meal that is quick, hot and delicious.

title: Pasta with Lettuce and Lime
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups water | 1 cup uncooked penne pasta | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh lime leaves | 8 large leaves iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 8 large tortillas, warmed
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan. Add penne.

title: Spicy Green Beans
ingredients: 2 cups green beans, trimmed | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon tomato puree
instructions: Place beans and chili sauce in an ovenproof dish and drizzle with tahini, sprinkle with tomato puree. Bake uncovered at 180c for 30 minutes or until heated through. Serve topped with a little chopped parsley.

title: Quick Tasty Snow Peas, Risotto and Snow Peas With Risotto
ingredients: 200 g arborio rice or 200 g fresh rice | 300 -300 g snow peas, washed and ends trimmed | chilled yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Wash rice. Cook it in a saucepan of boiling water with a teaspoon of salt until it is fluffy. Meanwhile, cut peas in half lengthways and blanch in boiling water for 2 minutes. When rice is still slightly al dente, remove from heat and place on absorbent paper. Drain well. Warm 3 tablespoons of chilled yogurt on simmering surface. Add peas to yogurt and stir until heated through. Place rice mixture in centre of platter and pour yogurt on top. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican vermicelli
ingredients: 1 lb vermicelli | 5 habanero peppers | 2 whole cloves | 2 teaspoons ground thyme | 1/2 loaf bread ( or bread cubes )
instructions: Bring 1/4 cup water to a boil over medium heat. Add vermicelli and cook, stirring constantly for 10 minutes or until the float. Set aside. Meanwhile, heat a large sauté pan over medium high heat. Add habanero peppers and cloves and sauté, stirring constantly for 3 minutes or until the peppers are slightly charred, about 3 minutes. Turn off heat and pour off all but about 2 tablespoons of the juice into pan. Stir in thyme and vermicelli and allow to sit for about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,spaghetti,nonfat milk powder,chipotle chile adobo
title: Tex-Mex Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 boneless chuck roast, trimmed of fat | 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1 chipotle chile in adobo | 0.5 package spaghetti, broken into 3 inch pieces
instructions: Cut steak crosswise into 4 crosswise slices. Sprinkle meat with nonfat dry milk. Layer with chipotle pepper and broken spaghetti in a skillet with 1/4 cup water. Turn skillet to high, cover, and bring to a boil. Remove the cover. Add the beef and cook over high heat until no longer pink in the center. Reduce heat to low. Cover and continue cooking 8 to 10 minutes or until meat is tender and spaghetti is al dente.

title: Quick Tahini Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons prepared sweet-and-sour mix | 1/8 teaspoon minced ginger juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper
instructions: Combine tahini, sweet and sour mix, ginger juice, adobo seasoning and red pepper in a small bowl. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve.

title: Homemade Ham
ingredients: 1 kg ham | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 bunch coriander leaves
instructions: Cut off the ham in small pieces, so they will stand upright in the mould. Bend the ham so that its flattened slightly. To make marinade, combine all ingredients in a food processor and mix the mixture well. Pour into the mould and allow to mature in refrigerator for 4 hours, or overnight. Thread on to metal skewers. Arrange on a hot grill or barbecue and cook over medium coals, turning often with tongs, until the meat starts to crisp. Turn the pieces over and cook until the other side develops nice colour. Allow to rest for an hour, remove from the skewers and slice into strips. Serve with dipping bread, chutney or tomato ketchup.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,pecan,cooking spray,beef tenderloin,reynolds wrap foil,sugar,mozzarella cheese
title: Beef Pecan Foil Nuggets
ingredients: 1 lb top round beef tenderloin, cut into 1 inch pieces | reynolds wrap foil | cooking spray | 1/4 cup granulated sugar | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1/2 cup grand marnier or 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place beef in the dish. Combine sugar, pecans and grand marnier in a bowl and stir together. Sprinkle the beef evenly over the beef. Add the mixture to the baking dish and bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until meat is tender and juices are bubbling.

Random Ingredients: mountain dew soda,limoncello,shiitake mushroom,oregano,chicken thigh,pearl barley,canola oil,italian parsley
title: Mushrooms & Barley Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 lb uncooked pearl barley | 1 1/2 lbs cooked chicken thighs ( skinned and chopped ) | 1/2 lb smoked shiitake mushroom ( sliced ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano | 4 teaspoons limoncello ( fresh-squeezed from bottle ) | 1 teaspoon mountain dew soda
instructions: Heat oil in a large, heavy nonstick skillet over high heat. Add pearl barley and cook 8 - 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until golden brown. Pour off oil. Add remaining ingredients including soda.

title: Easy Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat salsa until hot. Rinse and drain rice, pour into pan with salsa, stir until all is thoroughly mixed. Cover and remove from heat. Cool for a few minutes. Enjoy.

title: Steak With Red Onion
ingredients: 1 large red onion | 6 whole fresh thyme sprigs | 4 steaks
instructions: Cut the onion in half lengthwise, then cut each half crosswise into two wedges. Place on a small, very heavy baking sheet and place under a hot broiler to broil for about 5 minutes. Turn and broil for 5 minutes. Cover loosely with aluminum foil and keep warm. Spray a roasting pan with nonstick spray. Broil the steaks at low heat for 5 - 6 minutes. Turn them and broil for an additional 10 minutes or until done. Remove from the pan and place on a carving board. Dice the onion. Arrange the thinly sliced onions in a serving bowl. Serve with the onions.

title: Fish Taco Noodles
ingredients: 1/4 cup almond flour | 1 package noodles | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 pound haddock, thawed and cut into pieces | 2 tablespoons almond flour | 12 tortillas, warmed, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine almond flour and noodles in a large bowl. Blend mustard seeds in a small bowl. Dredge fish in almond flour until evenly coated. Fry in a large skillet over medium heat until fish flakes easily with a fork. Arrange on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 20 minutes. Spoon fish onto tortillas, and top with remaining 12 tortillas.

title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 24 ounces pasta sauce | 8 ounces sour cream | 2 teaspoons creamed mushroom | 1/4 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/8 teaspoon basil leaves | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 tablespoon ground meringue | 0.5 envelope marmite
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except merigue.

title: Hot and Cold Prawn Salad
ingredients: 2 cups peeled prawns, tails left on | 2 cups torn romaine lettuce | 2 cups chopped fresh asparagus | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 pint fresh blueberries
instructions: Cook prawns in boiling water with chutney. Just before they turn pink remove from pan and set aside. Place romaine and asparagus on plates and then the prawns on top. Spoon mango chutney on top of the salad. Garnish with blueberries.

title: Creamy Okra With Oranges and Fontina Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup sugar | 1/3 cup medium-grain grated fontina cheese | 1 lb okra, in 1-in. pieces ( about 2 1/2 inches long & 1 1/2 inches wide ) | 1/2 lb pear, ripe
instructions: In a large skillet, heat sugar and 1 1/2 cups water to boiling over medium heat, stirring until sugar melts. Add okra and simmer over medium low heat until okra is tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Mama Mama's Perfect Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 loaf fresh white bread, torn into small pieces | 1 pound chopped mexican oregano, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, toss bread with 1/2 of the oregano. Form into a long roll, and roll in the remaining 1/2 of the oregano. Sprinkle with remaining oregano, and wrap in bacon. Place on the prepared baking sheets. Bake in preheated oven until crumbs are nicely browned and crisp, about 10 minutes. Cool, and remove from baking sheets.

title: Broiled Lobster With Pasta
ingredients: 400 g penne | 1 -2 tablespoon white flour | 400 g lobster, shelled and deveined ( tail ) | 400 g chinese rice wine ( jus jiao ) | 1/2 cup rose water | 400 g lobster meat balls | 200 g fettuccine, uncooked
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil, add pasta and garlic to boiling water. Boil for 15 minutes or until pasta is cooked. Drain pasta and garlic, reserve 1 cup for pasta dish. Pour pasta, lobster and rice wine into hot oil in pan, and cook for another 1 minute. Add reserved pasta and lobster meat and noodles and stir together until boiling point. Serve immediately.

title: Black Sesame Leaf Wraps (Shawrbat Manir)
ingredients: 1/2 cup black sesame seeds | 4 -5 lettuce leaves | cornstarch | fresh cilantro, for garnish
instructions: Lightly toast and grind sesame seeds. Spread evenly on a clean, dry plate. Toast for 2 minutes on both sides, in the toaster or under the broiler. When done, remove to cool enough to handle. Place a leaf of lettuce on a lettuce leaf, drizzle with 1/4th cup sesame seed, spreading thinly. To serve, sprinkle with cilantro.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,green pea,clam,curry paste,beef bouillon granule,peach,white flour,lime juice
title: Peach Curry
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh peaches, halved and pitted | 1 can minced clams, undrained | 1 1/2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry paste | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon chicken stock granules or 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 cup frozen green pea
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In large mixing bowl, stir together peaches, clams, garlic paste and curry paste. Stir in lime juice and flour until well mixed. Add the stock powder and peas. Cover and place in a large baking dish or roasting pan. Bake in preheated oven 40 - 50 minutes or until peas are tender.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,yeast,pastry double crust pie,sesame oil,ice water,corn syrup,sun tomato
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Tart
ingredients: 1 pastry for double crust pie with chilled pastry | 1 tablespoon yeast | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/4 cup ice cold water | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved in half | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, soaked in water for 15 minutes and sliced
instructions: Place the pastry on a baking sheet and allow to rise for 30 - 45 minutes or until the pastry has doubled in size. Preheat oven to 400°f or 180°c. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper and using an electric fan, fan, or alternatively, bake the pastry for 15 minutes. Sprinkle yeast on top and allow to prove until foamy. Whisk in the corn syrup, sesame oil and cold water until dissolved. Spoon the yeast mixture into a bowl and add the cherry tomatoes and sun dried tomatoes. Use your hands to incorporate the ingredients into a thick mixture. Spoon mixture into the pastry case and bake at 400°f for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300°f or 130°c and continue making tart, until the filling has set.

title: Indian Gravy
ingredients: 1 quart nonfat sour cream | 1 cup vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/2 cup water
instructions: In a food processor, combine sour cream, broth, vegetable broth, and asafoetida. Pulse a few times until smooth. Pour water into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,tomato basil oregano garlic,vinegar,cilantro,red bell pepper
title: Portuguese Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, seeded and quartered | vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a shallow dish and stir well. Cover and refrigerate in a cool, dark place for at least 2 hours to develop the flavors. Serve over fresh vegetables and fish.

title: Tomato Curry Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste | 2 -3 tablespoons mild curry | 1 loaf italian bread, cut in half lengthwise ( i cut mine in half with scissors )
instructions: In a medium sauce pan combine the tomato paste and the curry. Simmer for 20 - 30 minutes over medium low heat. Add 1 loaf of italian bread cut into 1 inch cubes and toss with curry mixture to coat and toss. Serve immediately over your favourite pasta and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,black bean,white corn tortilla,oyster sauce,chive
title: Oyster Fish Tacos on the Cob
ingredients: 1 lb white corn tortilla | 2 cans light coconut milk ( light is ok ) | 1 can light crab ( also good with black beans ) | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons fresh chives, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Soak a woody frypan with some water at all times, just enough to keep the tortillas from sticking. Slice tortilla into thin rounds, and fry in hot oil on each side. When crispy, turn as needed to brown. Set aside in a bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients except the sauce. Heat for 2 minutes on medium, stirring all the while to prevent sticking. Serve in a bowl with toppings if desired.

title: Tandoori Masala
ingredients: 500 ml vegetable stock | 150 g ginger-garlic paste | 150 ml whipped topping
instructions: Bring the vegetable stock to a boil. Add the ginger garlic paste, mix and take off the heat. Cool to luke warm. Add whipped topping to, mix. Chill in the refrigerator.

title: Jamaican Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 cup tamarind pulp | 1 cup light corn syrup | 12 ounces stewed salmon
instructions: Clean and cut the meat into cubes. Drain the tamarind pulp and juice the beef in a colander set in the sink. Mix together all ingredients and set aside. Bring to a boil and simmer for 3 minutes. Place the fish into the solution, cover and simmer for 1 hour. After 10 minutes turn off and leave covered for another hour. Strain and store for future use.

Random Ingredients: passion fruit,fettuccine pasta,green cardamom pod,marinara sauce,cornflakes cereal,yellow squash
title: Tasty Fettuccine
ingredients: 500 g fettuccine pasta | 1 medium yellow squash | 300 g passion fruit | 1 container marinara sauce, warmed | 1 green cardamom pod, cut in half | 2 tablespoons cornflakes cereal
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet instructions. Slice squash into 1cm slices. Place squash slices and passionfruit in a pan over a medium heat. Cook, stirring, for around 10 minutes until heated through. Whisk sauce, cardamom and cornflakes together in a bowl until well blended. Add to hot pasta, toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Tikka and Chana Ki Dal
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, washed, spun dry and chopped | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Fry kale and turmeric in oil until dark. Add curry powder and mix. Add the drained kale and cook on low to medium flame. Serve immediately.

title: Pecan-Brown Rice Crockpot and Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 cup brown rice | 1/3 cup pecans, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon anise seed ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon meat or 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1 canned roasting tomatoes, chopped | 1 beefsteak tomato, cut in 4 wedges
instructions: Place the chicken into the bottom of the crockpot, fat side up, and set on stove top over medium high heat until very hot. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. Turn on the broiler, setting the oven control about 6 inches from the heat source. Roast the chicken, skin side up, in a hot skillet, brushing with the olive oil from the roasting chicken, turning frequently with tongs, until the center of the chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 40 minutes, placing it on a jelly roll pan.

title: Candy Corn
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 cups masa harina | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Mix the barley and baking soda and put in a container. Let the corn stand for 20 minutes. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 50 minutes. Turn off the oven. Cool. Dry.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,salmon,chicken leg thigh,beef chuck,green cabbage,lemon juice zest
title: Cabbage-Dusted Salmon With Lemon-Glazed Chicken
ingredients: 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 3/4 lbs salmon, cleaned and scaled | 4 1/2 - 5 lbs boneless chicken legs-thighs | 2 teaspoons cayenne | 1 green cabbage, cored and coarsely shredded | 2 lbs fresh green cabbage, cored and coarsely shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Arrange a sheet of foil on a baking dish. Spread the lemon zest over the top, then toss the salmon around to coat in zest and season with salt. Put the chicken legs in the middle, then sprinkle with cayenne. Arrange the cabbage and green cabbage around the chicken and pour the lemon glaze on top. Bring the edges of the foil together toward the center, and fold to form a sealed packet or seal with a piece of foil. Place the package on the center rack. Roast the packets on a cookie sheet pan or baking sheet in the middle of the oven for 35 - 40 minutes, until the fish is firm. Let the fish cool for a few minutes, then cut into serving portions and serve. A piece of the smoked salmon, or any of the suggested servings is, pick a piece of smoked salmon and place in the center of the warm fish. Pick up, slip out one of the packets, and serve. A piece of smoked salmon may be offered on the side, along with one piece of smoked salmon on the plate.

title: Cashew and Trout Fajitas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons celery seeds | 1 tablespoon cashews | 6 trout fillets | 2 tablespoons picante sauce
instructions: On baking sheet, toast cashew seeds 1 minute, or until fragrant. Place cashews and trout down into small bowl & mix in picante sauce.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,cream chicken soup,chili paste,roast beef,extra large egg,tart apple
title: Tippysaver - Tasty Roast Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 jar sour cream or ( 4 ounce ) jar cream of tartar | 2 lbs rare roast beef | 2 large tart apples, peeled and sliced into thin wedges, reserve juice | 1 tablespoon sriracha chili paste ( optional, add to taste if desired ) | 3 extra-large eggs, beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place roast beef slices in ungreased 9 x 13 inch baking dish or casserole dish. In small mixing bowl combine soup, sour cream or cream of tartar, 2 tablespoons reserved juice, chile paste if using, minced garlic and eggs. Pour over beef slices. Cover and bake 2 hours, basting once or twice with reserved juice. Note, if making ahead, cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake until meat is tender and top is golden brown, and liquid is absorbed, approximately 30 - 45 minutes before end of cooking time. Remove from oven, cover and allow to rest for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Coffee With Smoky Chipotle Salt
ingredients: 6 whole cardamom pods | 2 -6 canned chipotle chiles | 3 cups brewed espresso or 3 cups strongly brewed coffee
instructions: Pour the espresso or brew into a 6 cup shaker glass, cover with a lid and shake vigorously for at least 1 minute or until the espresso is very hot. Place cardamom pods in a dry small fry pan and toast for a few seconds or until lightly browned. Remove the cardamom pods with a slotted spoon from the pan. Place chiles in a spice mill or coffee filter bag with the espresso or brew and add a little bit of the coffee to each one. Wipe the rims with a paper towel and wipe out the empty canning jar with a thin film of coffee. Add cardamom pods to the hot coffee and serve.

title: Tofu on Toast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon garam masala ( dry indian spice mix ) | 1/4 cup minced head iceberg lettuce | 3 slices firm tofu | 1 -2 ear of corn, boiled, husked and cut in half
instructions: Put the beans in a pot and add enough water so that they are just covered and bring to a boil. Stir once, simmer for about 20 minutes. Add 1 tbls. Of garam masala and the lettuce and lower the heat. Cook for a few minutes while stirring continuously. Place the ear of corn in a bowl of cold water. Peel off the skin or cut kernels off a bean, and cut the ear of corn into small cubes. After 30 minutes, drain the water from the bean and beans. Add the tofu to the beans and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in the corn and garam masala. Serve and enjoy.

title: Golden Kiwi Bread
ingredients: 1 kg savoy cabbage, roughly shredded | 300 g guacamole | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup or 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon coriander, chopped or 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon whiskey | 100 g bread flour or 100 g wholemeal bread flour | 2 tablespoons ice water ( optional ) | chopped coriander, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line 2 baking trays or baking tins with baking paper, then place the shredded cabbage in the centre and scatter with guacamole, tomato ketchup, worcestershire sauce, and coriander. Add the bread flour and mix gently. Dampen your hands and mould the mixture into 2cm/ 1in thick, approximately 8x12cm. Transfer to the prepared trays and bake in the oven for 20 minutes or until browned and cooked. To make the topping, place the ice water, if using, into a microwave safe bowl and set aside. Place the biscuits on a wire rack to cool slightly. To serve, pile onto 2 slices, drizzle with the chopped fresh coriander.

title: Papaya and Hoisin Pizza
ingredients: 500 g wholemeal instant yeast | 50 ml hoisin sauce | 100 ml red capsicums, drained | 50 g papayas, roughly chopped | 1 bay leaf | 300 g of fresh mint
instructions: Place the first measure of water into the pot on the stovetop and heat until it boils, stir and leave as it for about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir the remaining measure of water and the mustard. Leave it for 15 minutes to become frothy. Meanwhile, place the rest of the ingredients in a small pan, stir over a medium heat until the ingredients start to bubble and a smooth crust forms. Once the mustard has thickened and risen to the surface, stir in the hoij and mustard mixture. Leave to cool a little, then add the water you've made from the sponge and mix together well. Put the dough on a lightly floured work surface and knead it just enought. You should have a fairly elastic dough, with no dough hook. Place in the refrigerator for about 24 hours until doubled. At this time it will need to chill in the fridge for at least 4 hours. Slice, roll and place on a baking tray. Poke holes at the top of the dough with a fork, brush with half of the glaze and leave for 8 hours to rise again. Bake at 200°c for about 10 minutes, until golden and cooked through. Leave to cool.

title: Italian Creamy Prosciutto Wraps
ingredients: 8 -12 slices prosciutto | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/4 - 1/3 cup marinade | 1/2 cup broth | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Slice prosciutto slices and place under broiler until light golden, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove, wrap in a towel and let drain for just a minute or so. Using a tablespoon, remove slices and blot on paper towel. In a small bowl, mix the molasses, broth, and cream of tartar until well combined and pour over the prosciutto slices. Serve with your favourite dippers, bread or your chosen side. Delicious.

title: Roasted French Fries
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon canola oil ( or a combination of both ) | pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 400. Place paper towel or parchment paper on a baking sheet or parchment paper. Place an oven rack in the upper slot of oven. Place oil into a non stick frying pan over moderate heat. Add 1 to 2 tablespoons. Heat the oil to 180°c. Turn the heat to high. Sprinkle the fries with pepper to taste, and lower the temperature so they don't smoke or brown on the bottom, about 35 - 45 seconds. Transfer them to a rack and roast for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown. You won't need to turn them in half through, but as they cool, they crisp. If you have a convection oven, use a convection oven setting. Allow them to cool before moving to a large bowl. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,tamarind paste,blue curacao,colby cheese,chocolate ice cream,tamarind pulp,tuna oil
title: Frozen Tuna Nachos
ingredients: 2 tuna packed in oil | 4 slices colby cheese or 4 slices monterey jack cheese | 4 teaspoons tamarind pulp | 3/4 teaspoon coconut-flavored liqueur or 3/4 teaspoon amarind extract | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon tamarind paste | 6 -12 pieces tortillas | 2 tablespoons soft unsweetened chocolate ice cream
instructions: Cut the tuna into 4 to 6 pieces. Lay the fillets flat on cutting board and cut them into thin strips then diagonally across into 1 inch segments. Spread 1 teaspoon tamarind concentrate on a piece of waxed paper or plastic wrap, then roll the wrapped tuna tuna, using the waxed paper, to cover. Wrap the tuna in the tortilla bits, pressing as much air out of them as possible. Lay in single layer on a plate or in a resealable plastic bag. Refrigerate while proceeding with the rest of the recipes. After chilling the tuna for at least 1 hour, heat one tablepoon of the liqueur or extract in medium saucepan over low heat. Add tamarind concentrate, and heat for 30 seconds to soften tamarind. Remove from heat. When the mixture is soft and the juice is well mixed, gently stir in the remaining tamarind juice. Add in the shredded colby cheese or monterey jack cheese and toss to coat. Spread one piece of tuna with a quarter of the cheese mixture, and top with another layer of tuna. Using tongs or your hands, roll the tuna in the remaining cheese mixture. Heat one of the toaster oven or grill to melt the cheese into the cheese. Place 2 to 3 pieces of tuna at a time in a toaster or inside an airtight container. Remove from heat, place a piece of toaster or a flat plate on top of each toaster or grill plate. Allow to heat until cheese is melted, 4 to 5 minutes. Turn over halfway through.

title: Thai Lamb Shank Bites
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 1/3 cup honey | 4 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1 tablespoon ground dried shrimp
instructions: Brush each lamb shank with honey and place on a rack on a foil lined baking tray. Place 1/3 cup chili sauce, soya sauce and 1/2 cup coconut on each lamb shank. Bake at 180 degrees c for 1 hour, or until tender and shank is cooked. Place dried shrimp in a saucepan and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,poblano chile,egg substitute,basmati rice
title: Gigurhi (Fish Custard Rice Pudding)
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed | 1 poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 6 eggs | 1 1/4 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 2 tablespoons egg replacer
instructions: Place rice, chille, and 4 tbsp water in a food processor and whiz until smooth.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,vanilla,chow mein noodle,pea,romaine lettuce,adobo seasoning,apple,hard egg
title: Chow Mein Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chow mein noodles | 1 cup chopped romaine lettuce | 1 large apple, chopped | 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 cup cooked peas | 1 can chicken stock | 1/2 teaspoon dried adobo seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon real vanilla
instructions: Cook and stir chow mein noodles according to package directions. Drain and cool completely. In a large bowl, stir together the chow mein noodles, lettuce, apple, eggs, peas, broth, adobo seasoning, and vanilla. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: lemon wedge,pork chop,farfalle pasta,jalapeno chile pepper
title: Jalapeno Poached Pork Chops
ingredients: 3/4 pound pork chop, cut into thick slices | 1 tablespoon lemon wedges | 12 ounces farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 fresh jalapeno chile peppers, seeded and roughly chopped, or to taste
instructions: Rinse the pasta under cold water.

title: Cranberry Chutney
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh cranberries | 2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Toss cranberries with curry powder. Cover loosely and let stand for 1 hour at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,skirt steak,salt,farfalle pasta,queso fresco,veal,red onion
title: Carne Guisada
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 pound lean ground veal | 1 large red onion, sliced | 1 1/2 cups crumbled queso fresco | 1 1/4 teaspoons salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 pound top round steak
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Chinese Spicy Broccoli and Jicama
ingredients: 3 -5 broccoli florets | 1 egg, beaten | 10 -12 wooden skewers | 1 -2 teaspoon tomato paste ( depending on taste preference ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sweet chili sauce ( siracha ) | jicama, slices
instructions: Prepare your chosen kind of fresh salad greens using lots of green onion. If you can find the sweet chili sauce, use it. I like a good sweet jicama, but you could also use other citrus as per your taste preferences, like ketchup or soy sauce depending on your preferences. Dip the broccoli into eggs, then into matzoh skins. Put everything into a pan. Stir on high heat, to heat all the flavors together. Once they start to look cooked and a bit sticky on the outside, but still soft inside, add the tomato paste to the pan. Stir and simmer for few minutes. If your tomato paste is still hot or slightly sour, you'll need to add enough to taste. Pour over the salad greens and serve.

Random Ingredients: catfish fillet,rice noodle,quince,tamarind paste,romaine lettuce,celery,vanilla bean,tomato basil oregano garlic
title: Tomato Basil Catfish Salad
ingredients: 2 cups romaine lettuce | 8 -12 ounces catfish fillets | 1 cup quince, diced | 1/2 cup celery, diced | 3 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon dried oregano and garlic blend | 1/4 cup cooked rice noodles ( optional ) | 1/4 cup tomato basil oregano and garlic blend, drained ( optional )
instructions: Clean linguine and let it drain. In medium bowl, combine all other ingrediants except the tomato and basil oregano. Cut catfish in half and rinse in cold water. Place them in mixture. Add dressing and toss well. Refrigerate for up to 3 days.. Garnish with basil slices as garnish.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,date,brown rice,kalamata olive,green food coloring,palm sugar
title: Brown Rice Skewers
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked brown rice | 1 cup pitted kalamata olives | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 4 walnut-size pieces salmon fillets | green food coloring | dried dates ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly and then place the rice, olives and palm sugar in a large bowl. Lightly mix by hand until the sugar is dissolved. Coat salmon with food coloring, and thread onto skewers with dates and sliced green onions.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,canola oil,asparagus,chili powder,tuna vegetable oil,puff pastry
title: Vegetable Samosas
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1/2 cup quinoa, rinsed & drained | 1/2 lb fresh asparagus, cut into 3-inch pieces | 1 can tuna in vegetable oil, drained | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon canola oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Unfold the pastry sheets and place on baking sheet, overlapping the pastry. Spray tops of pastry with cooking spray and top with the quinoa, asparagus, tuna, chili powder and oil. Bake for 12 minutes or until warm and the bottoms are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,soy sauce,serrano chili,walnut,chicken bouillon cube
title: Walnut Sauce for Chicken, Beef or Fish
ingredients: 1 can sliced walnuts | 1 small red bell pepper, sliced in chunks | 1 small serrano chili, sliced in thin rings | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Drain the walnuts and reserve the walnuts for later. Combine the remaining ingredients and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,serrano chili,tomatillo,asparagus,pea,custard powder,cumin powder,tomato
title: Cheat's Chili Verde
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage or 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 jar tomatillos, drained and chopped | 1 can asparagus, drained | 1 medium tomatoes, chopped | 4 serrano chili, diced ( can use canned ) | 3/4 cup frozen peas | 1 teaspoon garlic-infused custard powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Cook italian sausage according to the package instructions. Drain all liquids from sausage. Set aside. Drain tomatillo, asparagus, and tomato. Combine salsa and tomatillos and stir well. Add sausage and asparagus, peas, custard, and serrano chili.

title: Tequila Steak Margaritas
ingredients: 5 lbs beef eye round, cut 1/4 in thick | 3 tablespoons tequila | 6 plum tomatoes, cut into thirds | 1 can beef broth | fresh raspberry, for garnish
instructions: Arrange half a beef eye round on a tray and brush with tequila. Score the surface of the steak with a sharp knife and place on top of the tequila. Wrap the roast in a heavy bag, tying the roast with a string or kitchen twine. Refrigerate the meat for 2 - 6 hours. Preheat the grill. Remove the roast from the refrigerator and drain off the fat from the bag. Cut meat into 1/4 slices and grill over the hot fire, about 4 minute on each side. When the meat is no longer pink near the bone, remove from the grill and let it stand for 5 minutes before serving. Slice meat thinly against the grain and sprinkle over any remaining marinade. Serve with the raspberries and fresh raspberry.

title: Chipotle Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces tamari soy sauce | 2 ounces chipotle chiles
instructions: Put tamari in a mortar with a small amount of salt. Crush chiles with a mortar and pestle, and then mix into the mortar with the rest of the ingredients. Use over any meat you like this is a great on pork, chicken and fried fish.

title: Banana Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 medium bananas | 2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Peel the bananas and cut them in slices. Place them in a microwave safe bowl with the half and half in it. Heat on high for 15 to 20 seconds or until it starts to thicken. Add the bananas immediately, stirring to coat them with the hot cream sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,vegetable,cabbage,white onion,single cream,pistachio nut,pineapple preserve
title: Smoked Beef & Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 600 g cabbage | 300 g smoked beef brisket | 250 g white onions | 300 ml single cream | 120 g mixed vegetables | 50 g pistachio nuts, cut into slivers | pistachio preserves, to serve
instructions: Shred cabbage, mix cabbage, brisket & onion together. Place cream and cheese in a screw top jar with lid. Close lid on jar & shake until cheese softens & cream and cheese are thoroughly combined. Remove lid, shake well, then place on serving plate and top with sliced almonds/ pistachios.

title: Nova Scotia Cabbage Tea Bread
ingredients: 200 g bread flour | 400 g english cucumbers, chopped | 225 g red cabbage, chopped | 200 ml tea
instructions: Put all ingrediants into a large bowl. Knead until dough feels like bread dough. Preheat oven to 200c. Place dough onto a flat surface. Cut into 4 4cm by 5cm pieces, and place on a baking tray. Mark into squares, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Ww 5 Points - Pineapple Stuffing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crushed peperidge farm cornbread | 12 ounces water packed baby spinach | 2 ounces butterscotch chips | 1/4 - 1/3 cup fresh orange juice or 1/4-1/3 cup pineapple juice, for drizzling | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cornbread crumbs and spinach. In a small bowl, combine butterscotch chips, orange juice and hot pepper flakes. Add to crumb mixture, toss well. Sprinkle evenly into 10 x 6 x 2 inch baking dish.. Bake in 400 degree f oven 20 minutes or until well heated through, stirring twice. Serve with crackers. This recipe can be doubled for a larger quantity. Preparation time does not include refrigeration time.

Random Ingredients: lima bean,caraway seed,oyster sauce,broccoli,pine nut,ancho chile powder,purpose flour,red wine vinegar
title: Ancho and Pine Nut Salad
ingredients: 2 packages frozen broccoli, broccoli, and carrots, thawed to room temperature | 1/2 cup halved ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 teaspoon caraway seed, or more if needed | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 2 cups coarsely chopped fresh ancho chile bean or canned lobsters | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the 1/2 c broccoli and 1/2 cup carrots. Cook until crisp tender, about 3 minutes, then drain. Place the florets into a food processor, then add the anchos, pine nuts, pepper, vinegar and oyster sauce. Pulse to make a coarse paste. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Toss together with the cooked broccoli and carrots to serve.

title: Black Beans and Banana Liqueur
ingredients: 1 package black beans, rinsed | 2 tablespoons banana liqueur | 8 slices bacon, chopped
instructions: Place beans in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, lower heat, and simmer for 1 hour. Drain, and set aside. Place banana liqueur in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and remove from heat. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook bacon until evenly browned. Drain and crumble. Transfer bacon into the skillet with the black beans. Return to a simmer, and allow to bubble for 15 minutes. Top with the bacon before serving.

title: Mexican Chicken Spread
ingredients: 24 ounces mexican cheese, shredded ( a combination of mild and sweet, you can use mozzarella-crescent ) | 30 ounces cream cheese | shredded cheese (, any cheese will do, i use a combo of cheddar and monterey jack ) | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 4 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. You may need to use two forks, depending on how thick or runny your mixture gets. Spoon into a 8x8 pan and spread out. Top with some more swiss cheese. Chill. To freeze, place at least 2 tsp of cheese in a freezer zip lock bag and crush with flat side of large wooden spoon. Place in dish, sprinkle with any cheese remaining in bag and freeze until solid. Place in refrigerator, tightly covered, turning once or twice so that the cheese is melted, about 2 or 3 times a day. This may take a few hours. If you don't remove the mixture from freezer, i usually do this in my crock pot. You know, there's a reason why the cheese makes a bunch of wiggles around you when you make the cheese spread. It's up to your crock pot's appliance. Just keep the cheese in the freezer until solid, about 3 hours or so, then transfer to crock pot. Keep on low setting and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tamari,cardamom seed,nonfat cream,neufchatel cheese,red wine vinegar,poppy seed
title: Quickie (Poppy Seed & Hot Pepper Dip- Dip)
ingredients: 250 g neufchatel cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/3 cup poppy seed ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 teaspoon tamari ( optional ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar ( red wine vinegar ) or 1/4 cup white wine vinegar ( red wine vinegar ) | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor. Process until smooth. Transfer to a bowl and serve. Note, for variety, omit the yogurt, or increase the amount of paprika used.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,cake flour,five spice powder,garam masala,green cardamom,parmigiano reggiano cheese,mango chutney,iceberg lettuce
title: Mango Chutney Bundt Cake
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 4 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, coarsely grated | 1/3 cup mango chutney ( store-bought or homemade ) | 5 green cardamoms, split | 2 1/2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 head iceberg lettuce ( washed ) | parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( freshly grated )
instructions: To make the mint ganache, place the mint and five spice in a small, dry frying pan and simmer over low medium heat until soft, about 5 to 10 minutes. Cool, then coarsely chop. To make the loaf, in a bowl, toss the flour with the raisins and parmigiano cheese. Make sure the flour coats the underside of the bowl. Make a well in the centre and quickly pulse the cardamom, garam masala, and five spice powder into the flour, mashing it into coarse crumbs. Add the chopped mint and five spice and mix all together with hands with a fork. Cut out eight 6 inch diameter squares of fresh lettuce leaves, removing the leaves from the lettuce heads. Place four slices of the loaf on a cutting board and spread each with about 1/4 cup mint ganache, pressing with one hand to press the leaves into the halves of the loaf. Place a few mint leaves on the bottom half of the loaf, top with a lettuce heart slice, and top with a piece of the loaf. Brush the edges of the loaf with the mint ganache, and finish with a few mint leaves, pressing lightly with the other hand. Cut a v or two about 2 inches wide at the top of each bread, then cut a slit down the center of the loaf to give you a nice diamond pattern for the cutout and serve immediately.

title: Kopperjack (Kelse's Easy Beef Taquitos)
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks, thinly sliced ( or london broil beef ) | salt and white pepper ( to taste ) | 4 corn tortillas | ketchup ( optional )
instructions: Brush one side of steak slices with ketchup, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Wrap the tortillas in aluminum foil, and heat in 350f until warm and pliable. Heat a nonstick frying pan or griddle over medium high heat. Remove meat slices with tongs, and sear on both sides until lightly browned on both sides, turning to sear evenly. Place on plate to keep warm. Add a little more oil to pan. When the pan is hot, fry the tortillas in the pan without crowding. They are cooked when they turn golden brown on both sides, about 2 minutes per side. Place fried tortillas on serving plates, and spoon hot beef slices over tortillas. Serve with more ketchup for dipping.

title: Napa Dave's German Meatball Vegetable Bake
ingredients: 1 package frozen meatballs, thawed | 8 cups shredded green cabbage | 1/2 head cauliflower floret, separated into florets and cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place meatballs in a large baking dish. Place cabbage and cauliflower in a steamer and cover with water. Cover, and place in the oven. Bake in oven 10 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,kaffir lime leaf,cooking apple,brandy,corn,espresso coffee,lemongrass,herb
title: Espresso-Roasted Crispy Apples With Lemongrass and Corn
ingredients: 2 large red chile peppers | 2 stalks fresh herb, such as flat-leaf parsley leaves, savory sprigs, and 2 lemongrass, trimmed | 10 kaffir lime leaves, bruised ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs cooking apples, cored | 1 cup freshly brewed espresso or 1 cup strong coffee, chilled | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh herb, such as dill ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons grated kaffir lime leaves | 1 teaspoon chopped lemongrass, paste with 1 tsp. salt ( optional ) | 1/3 cup brandy ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450°f. Roast the red chiles in the oven until charred on all sides, about 20 minutes. Let cool until easy to handle. Peel and discard the stems. Set aside. Rinse the chiles under a stream of boiling water until the water no longer coats the chiles and is soft enough to roll out with your fingers, 2 to 3 minutes. Cut a lengthwise slit into each chile to free some of the seeds. Set aside. Place the chile peppers in a saucepan large enough to hold them over a pan of boiling water and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cook until just softened, about 2 minutes. Drain immediately.

title: Chocolate Chip Spaghetti
ingredients: 13 ounces spaghetti sauce | 12 ounces semi-sweet chocolate squares, melted | 5 eggs
instructions: Boil spaghetti until al dente. While spaghetti is boiling, beat eggs until foamy. Add melted chocolate and mix well. Pour spaghetti sauce into pan and mix with whisk until all ingredients are mixed. Turn sauce off and let chocolate cool. Use spaghetti as a dip.

title: Polpettini Porcini
ingredients: 150 g dried porcini mushrooms | 40 g butter or 40 g margarine
instructions: Rinse dry or leave fresh, and cut into small cubes 1 or 1/ size. Melt the butter or margarine in a pot for about 20 seconds, and fry the porcinis for about 3 minutes. Mix the mushrooms and porcini in a bowl. Add the butter to the mushroom mixture, and mix well. Tear off large pieces of cheesecloth, and put it on your work surface. Dip the cheesecloth in cold water to soften. Wrap the cheesecloth in foil and place in a serving bowl. Add the porcini mushrooms and mushroom mixture to the bowl. Taste, and mix well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,pepperoncini pepper,pecorino romano cheese,gruyere cheese
title: Prawns With Gruyere and Pepperoncini
ingredients: 300 g gruyere cheese ( coarsely grated ) | 400 g parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( coarsely shredded ) | 4 pepperoncini peppers ( thinly sliced ) | pepperoncini pepper ( garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over medium high heat stirring occasionally until cheese is melted. Pour into a small serving dish. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,cider vinegar,peach schnapps,superfine sugar,grapeseed oil,lemongrass
title: Peach Schnapps Sorbet and Sorbet
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/3 cup grapeseed oil | 2 stalks lemongrass, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/3 cup superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons peach schnapps
instructions: In a food processor, combine pecorino romano cheese and grapeseed oil until finely combined. Transfer mixture to a medium bowl and refrigerate until needed, about 1 hour. Strain mixture through a fine sieve into a heavy saucepan. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 2 hours. Slice lemongrass lengthwise in half lengthwise. Working over a bowl, sprinkle 1 tablespoon sugar on each slice of citrus peel. Transfer to a food processor and process until finely chopped. Transfer to saucepan and simmer over medium heat for about 3 minutes, then reduce heat to low. Add pecorino romano cheese and simmer, stirring, for 1 minute, then remove pan from heat. Transfer sorbet to ice cream maker, add 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese and process until smooth. Transfer sorbet puree to a small bowl. Refrigerate Sorbet until firm, at least 1 hour. While sorbet bakes, combine schnapps and remaining 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese in a heavy medium saucepan or skillet. Cook over low heat until slightly reduced, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Set aside until sorbet is ready. Pour sorbet mixture into freezer. Freeze until sorbet is firm, about 5 hours. Remove from freezer and allow to stand at room temperature for about 10 minutes. Cut sorbet into 1 cubes. Transfer sorbet to an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions. Serve sorbet over ice cream.

Random Ingredients: grain mustard,shell pasta,iceberg lettuce,vanilla extract,corn oil,rosemary leaf,buttermilk
title: Vegan-Friendly Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package dry shell pasta ( i like to use angel hair ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce or 1 head romaine lettuce, washed, dried and chopped | 1 bottle buttermilk ( can use light or milk ) | 2 tablespoons low-fat corn oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon dry whole grain mustard ( or more ) | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary leaf, chopped fine
instructions: Cook and drain pasta as directed on package, rinse and drain. Wash, dry and chop lettuce and romaine. Combine remaining ingredients in large bowl and stir thoroughly. Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat. Chill until ready to serve, but before serving, toss well again.

Random Ingredients: mace,tabasco sauce,lager beer,cucumber,horseradish sauce,topping,nutmeg,wide egg noodle
title: Beer Fondue
ingredients: 1 quart strong lager beer, room temperature | 2 tablespoons horseradish sauce | freshly grated nutmeg | 1 teaspoon mace | 3 dashes tabasco sauce | 3 packages frozen medium-sized thin-skinned cucumbers, thawed | 12 small wide egg noodles, cooked and drained | 2 cups frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Whisk the beer, horseradish sauce,meg, mace, and cayenne pepper together in a large saucepan and heat over low heat until the beer reduces by half. Stir in the cucumber, scraping the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon, and cook until tender, about three minutes. Push the cucumber to the side of the pan.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,queso fresco,sun tomato,espresso coffee,barbecue sauce,dijon mustard
title: Tex Mex Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pounds pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 jars barbecued sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 1/4 cups brewed espresso or coffee, divided | 12 ounces crumbled queso fresco, divided | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes, oil packed, drained and chopped
instructions: Cut pork tenderloins crosswise into 1 1/2 inch thick slices, then cut slices crosswise into 1/2 inch strips. Arrange meat slices on a dish and cover with barbecue sauce and marinate in the refrigerator, covered, for 1 hour. Preheat grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Cook pork in the preheated grill until no longer pink in the center and internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f, 5 to 7 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board and tent loosely with aluminum foil. Cut strips crosswise into thirds and arrange on grate. Top each slice with some of the barbecued barbecued sauce, the remaining barbeque sauce, dijon mustard and 1/2 cup espresso or coffee. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Top each slice with 1/2 cup queso fresco and sundried tomatoes and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh oregano. Cover grill for 15 minutes, until cheese is melted and sauce is slightly thickened.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,matzo cake meal,seasoning salt,cooking onion,rigatoni pasta,chocolate ice cream,great northern bean
title: Vegetarian Chocolate Pasta With Faux Brown Butter
ingredients: 1 package matzo cake meal | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 cup quick-cooking onions ( viva madrid ) | 4 cups cooked extra firm white-meat prepared stuffing ( such as beef, turkey or chicken ) | 1 can great northern beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 3 chocolate ice cream | 1 yellow sweet pepper, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch-thick strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in large bowl, blend matzo cake meal, seasoned salt, and onions. Stir in beef, beans, and ice cream. Place 1 sheet of plastic wrap on board. Dip 1 strip of cheesecloth in a glass of cold water. Turn the plastic wrap so the entire cheesecloth is on the top. Carefully lift plastic wrap.

title: Hot Tagliatelle for One
ingredients: 1 pound frozen tagliatelle pasta noodles | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: In a large stockpot of salted water, cook tagliatelle in boiling water for 5 to 6 minutes or until tender. Drain.

title: Thai Beer
ingredients: 6 fluid oz. beer | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Pour the beer into a tall glass. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of thai fish sauce over the top. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,cumin,ginger root,baby spinach,fast rising yeast,self raising flour,poblano chile,yellow bell pepper
title: Easy Sweet Pepper & Spinach Bread
ingredients: 500 g self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon whole grain and wild fast rising yeast | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 teaspoon finely minced fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 medium poblano chile, seeded and minced | 300 g baby spinach | 2 yellow bell peppers, seeded, deveined, coarsely chopped
instructions: Drain excess water from poblanos and peppers and coarsely chop or roughly chop the flesh. Place in a bowl, mix together the yeast, vinegar, ginger, cumin and 1 tablespoon of the flour and set aside to rest for 10 minutes. Add the remaining flour to the yeast mixture in the bowl and make a well in the centre. Pour the yeast mixture into the well. Gather the dough together, knead for 10 minutes until it forms into a smooth ball. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl and cover with a cloth towel. Set aside in a warm place until doubled in size. Grease a 10 inch pie plate. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Roll out the dough as thinly as possible to fit the pie plate. Cut out a circle or oval shape from the top. Cover the dough with the green leaves and place a poblano pepper on the center of the dough. Spoon 2 tablespoons of chopped spinach over the top of the poblano and green pepper. Brush the edge of the dough with water. Seal edges. Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk. Bake at 375 degrees F for 75 to 90 minutes or until loaf tests done. Serve warm.

title: Cucumber, Grapes and Green Grapes
ingredients: 1/2 cup cucumber, minced | 3 cups sliced green grapes
instructions: In a large serving bowl or platter, mix cucumber, grapes and salt and pepper.

title: Teriyaki Rice
ingredients: 4 cups uncooked rice | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 2 cups arborio rice ( or other short grain rice such as nishiki )
instructions: Place rice and teriyaki sauce in a saucepan, cover, bring to a boil, then remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes, until the liquid has been absorbed. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Mom's Tostadas
ingredients: 1 package flour tortilla, warmed and cut into wedges | 3/4 cup sliced nuts | 3 ounces gravy, can
instructions: Spread a small amount of gravy into tortilla wedge, leaving approximately 2 inches clear at edges. Place wedges in a small casserole dish. Brush with remaining gravy. Sprinkle with nuts.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,brown mustard seed,green bell pepper
title: Sauerkraut German Style
ingredients: 8 soft-boiled green bell peppers, halved and seeded | 16 apricot preserves, drained and warmed | 1/2 cup packed brown mustard seed
instructions: Place the bell peppers in a bowl of ice water to remove some of the bitterness. Gently remove the skins, and gently squeeze out and discard the seeds. Place in a bowl with warm preserves and stir to combine. Stir in the mustard seed, and adjust the seasoning.

title: Baked Wild Rice With Fontina Cheese
ingredients: 1 loaf rustic italian bread, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 cups wild rice, cooked, chilled | 1 1/2 cups fontina cheese, shredded
instructions: Place bread slices on a work surface and sprinkle with 1/4 cup wild rice. Scatter 3/4 cup fontina cheese on top. Top with remaining bread. Preheat oven to 450°f. Bake uncovered about 15 minutes or until beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,guacamole,sea bass fillet,lemon peel,self rising flour,tahini,black mustard seed,purpose flour
title: Spicy Tahini Fish
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup tahini | 3/4 cup irish cream | 1/2 cup light guacamole | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 1 tablespoon ground black mustard seeds | 1 pinch sea bass fillets | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour, or as needed
instructions: Whisk self-rising flour, tahini, irish cream, guacamole, lemon peel, mustard seed, and sea bass together in a bowl.

title: Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups green olives | 1 teaspoon freshly grated orange zest ( optional ) | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Cut the olives in half.

title: Native American Melon Balls
ingredients: 2 cups coarse whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 cantaloupe, ripe, peeled, seeded, cubed
instructions: Roll the flour into a 6 to 8 inch long log, and cut into thirds. Roll each piece out to a disk about 1/2 inch thick and 2 inches in diameter. Arrange on a greased baking sheet and bake at 425 degrees f. For 8 to 10 minutes. Remove and cool on a floured board for one minute. Place the cantaloupe in a bowl and break into bite size chunks. Roll the dough into cantaloupe balls. Place in a plastic bag, seal, and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Crock Pot Easy Tortilla Soup Recipe
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable stock, low-sodium | 1/8 cup oregano | crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Dissolve oregano in warm stock. Place tortilla chips on top, add soup and place crock pot on low for 6 - 8 hours. Use for soup or chill and serve as desired with parmesan cheese.

title: Homemade Arepas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground allspice berries | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Place a tea towel on your work surface or a clean, damp towel. Place the arepas into the towel and lightly pat off any excess water. Place the arepas onto the towel and sprinkle each side of the arepas with the ground allspice berries. In a small bowl, mix the jar of picante sauce and the pinch of allspice over the arepas to blend. Let the arepas sit in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours. Turn the arepas and lightly coat with the spicy picante sauce while they are still hot.

title: Karela
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 cup whole milk | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 pinch sesame oil | ice cube
instructions: Cut meat into about 1 cubes. Place milk in a wide pan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add meat and seasoning and simmer until meat is tender, about 20 minutes. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: herb,picante sauce,soymilk,new potato,beef bouillon cube,lime,marjoram,green capsicum
title: Picante Potatoes With Soya Meat
ingredients: 500 g new potatoes | 300 ml soymilk | 2 beef bouillon cubes or 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 lime | 1/2 green capsicum, sliced length ways | salt and mixed herbs | picante sauce, sauce, salsa
instructions: Boil the potatoes till tender drain, reserving cooking water. Dice potatoes once cooked and return to the potato water. Mash and place potato into the potato water. Add stock and marjoram to the potato water. Add salt, mixed herbs, etc. Mix ingredients well and serve hot.

title: Bibing Beef With Pineapple-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, trimmed of fat | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 can pineapple rings, drained and chopped | 1 package mushroom caps, sliced thick | 1/2 cup sliced ripe olives | 1 large head bibb lettuce
instructions: In a large frying pan, cook beef over medium high heat till browned. Sprinkle with sugar, coriander and pineapple rings. Place in medium size casserole. Top with sliced mushrooms and olives. Cover and bake in a 350f oven for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Irish Cream Tea
ingredients: 6 ounces of lipton english breakfast tea ( or other strong tea ) | 24 ounces of tortilla chips
instructions: Mix the teabags for 10 minutes, remove them and pour the tea over the chips in a small bowl with your desired amount of room. Mix everything with a fork once the tea is cold. Serve with crushed fresh mexican pheasant chips.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,rigatoni pasta,nonstick cooking spray,chicken wing
title: Kheer - Indian Chicken Pasta Dish
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta, preferably fresh | 8 chicken wings ( about 5 1/2 lbs total ) or 8 chicken legs ( about 5 1/2 lbs total ) | 4 teaspoons fenugreek seeds ( crushed or to taste ) | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta, cover and cook over low heat for about 12 minutes. Using scissors, make a slit and remove wing tips and discard. Cut wings into 5 - 6 sections and arrange them into 6 bowls. Spray a 9 x 13 baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Transfer cooked pasta into oiled 13x9 inch pan and pat pasta with paper towles to absorb any oil. Then sprinkle fenugreek in a single layer over pasta and then pour on remaining ingredients. Bake uncovered for about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: tater tot,dijon mustard,cauliflower floret,cardamom seed,dark chocolate,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cauliflower and Chocolate Tater Tot
ingredients: 8 ounces tater tots or 8 ounces piza | 1 medium cauliflower floret | 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds ( from 6 to 8 pods ) | 3 tablespoons dark chocolate | 1/2 teaspoon dijon-style mustard
instructions: Spray a deep 13x9 pan with cooking spray. Cook the cauliflower in boiling water for 3 minutes or until just tender. Drain and rinse in cold water. Mash and set aside. Mix all other ingredients in a large bowl. Add the mashed cauliflower. Mix well. Spread in prepared pan. Spray with a pam cooking spray. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until top is lightly browned. Let sit for 10 minutes then cut into wedges. Serve with toffee ice cream, crackers, or spread on crackers.

title: Gourmet French Roast Chicken With Horseradish Mayonnaise
ingredients: 20 -30 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 lb raw chicken | 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 1 tablespoon dried horseradish | 1 cup miracle whip | 1/2 cup sourdough bread, split | 2 tablespoons ground espresso powder | 4 teaspoons grated horseradish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place the thyme sprigs on a cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes or until the thyme becomes fragrant. Turn off oven and let thyme steep in the oven for 45 minutes. Remove thyme sprigs and set aside. Meanwhile, preheat grill or broiler. Remove chicken from the oven. Cut slits in each breast almost all the way through. Brush the cut surface with melted butter. Place the breast in the hot broiler and place under the grill for 5 - 6 minutes. Turn and broil, occasionally brushing the cut surface with butter. For the horseradish mayonnaise, mix together the instant espresso and horseradish. Cover and keep warm. To assemble, spread 3 tblsps of the hazelnut spread on each breast. Spread 1/2 tblsps of the horseradish mayonnaise on each breast, then place the bread on top. Place the chicken on a grill or under the broiler. Cook for 45 minutes, or until the tops of the breast are a light golden brown. To serve, place chicken on serving plate and spoon some of the honey mustard mayonnaise on top. Serve with horseradish mayonnaise on the side.

title: Nanny's Quick Focaccia
