ingredients: 500 g whole wheat flour | 500 g instant potato flakes
instructions: Preheat oven shelf on low. Mix dry ingredients together put in bowl, knead with enough flour to make a firm dough that is smooth and elastic, knead until dough comes together. Shape a ball of dough into a round, place on greased tray, repeat until all dough has been used, cut circle in half and place on tray with dough circle over the bottom, bake at 180c for 25 35mins.

title: Pancetta Baked in Yogurt and Parmesan for one
ingredients: 250 g low-fat pancetta, rind trimmed | 250 g plain yogurt or 250 g sour cream ( 14 oz total weight ) | 100 g parmesan cheese or 100 g romano cheese, grated | salt, to season
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180ºc, and grease a shallow ovenproof roasting pan with some cooking spray. Fry the pancetta in a frying pan, until golden brown and crispy. Drain on paper towel and set aside. Pour the yogurt into the pan, sprinkle with the grated cheese, and stir to combine until the cheese has melted and amalgamated with the yogurt. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, stirring now and then until hot, well combined. Spoon onto the parchment paper in a single layer and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown. Serve with mashed potato.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,garam masala,chive onion cream cheese,white rice flour
title: Creamy Indian White Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice flour | 1/2 cup chive & onion cream cheese | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix. Let it sit for about 20 mins so flavors can combine.

Random Ingredients: steak,daikon radish,sea salt,lime juice zest,curry powder,cream corn
title: Curried Beef
ingredients: 1 cup daikon radish, peeled, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 cups boneless flank steak | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice, plus lime wedges for garnish | 12 ounces cream-style corn
instructions: Cook daikon and flank steak in 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 4 minutes. Add curry powder and sea salt and cook 1 minute, while stirring. Stir in lime juice and corn. Cover skillet and increase heat to high.

title: Wasabi Beef
ingredients: 5 lbs sirloin, cutlets and very thinly sliced | 10 tablespoons wasabi powder | 1 teaspoon baking soda | ice cube | 1 container sour cream | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 box frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. Marinate the beef slices in 5 t wasabi and 1 tsp baking soda until beef slices are completely coated. Place the plastic wrap directly on beef slices. Refrigerate for 1 hour and slice as needed. Baking time can vary depending on thickness of beef slices. Drain beef thoroughly, reserving marinade. Bake in covered roasting pan for 1 hour or so. Drain any remaining marinade. Turn over. Drizzle top with remaining wasabi and 1 tsp baking soda. Bake for 10 minutes more or until cooked through. Combine sour cream, cream and 1 cup of the water. Stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Turn heat back up to medium heat and stir in 1 cup of the cream mixture. Turn off burner and stir constantly. Spread sour cream mixture over sirloin slices and serve immediately.

title: Red Beans with Mint and Orange-Mint Sorbet
ingredients: 6 ounces red beans | 1 tablespoon snipped of fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup light orange juice
instructions: Add red beans to slow cooker. In bowl, combine snipped mint leaves and fresh orange juice. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 9 hours until tender.

title: Greek Feta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons full-bodied red wine ( preferably greek ) | 1/4 cup corn oil | 4 1/2 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Stir wine and corn oil together in a small bowl and refrigerate until cold, about 20 minutes. Stir in cheese and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours to blend flavors. Pour into a shallow dish or pie plate.

title: Indian Shrimp
ingredients: 1 bag shrimp | 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 3 plum tomatoes, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( to taste ) | 1 container plain yogurt or 1 container sour cream
instructions: Place shrimp in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to boil over high heat, then cover and reduce heat to medium. Simmer shrimp for 3 minutes, then transfer shrimp to a medium bowl, add chopped onion, tomatoes, salt, and cayenne. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate shrimp for 30 minutes or until shrimp are cooked.

title: Lamb Gravy
ingredients: 1 3/4 kg lamb shoulder, fat trimmed, boned and diced | 1 1/2 liters clear broth ( or lamb stock ) | 2 teaspoons oil | 3 -4 tablespoons self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons dried oregano, crushed
instructions: Mix the flour with about 2 tsp stock or water. Heat the oil in a large pan, then brown the lamb in batches. Add the flour and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in oregano. Pour in stock or stock, stirring until the gravy boils. Simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Season if desired.

title: Quick, Easy and Tasty Refresher
ingredients: tart green lettuce
instructions: Wash your lettuce leaves and spin dry. Place them in salad bowls or a salad bowl or on lettuce leaves with a few decorative slabs of cheese on top. Place a large scoop of mashed potatoes on top and dig inches.

title: Duck Confit
ingredients: 800 g duck breasts | 1 pinch dried red pepper flakes | 1 1/2 - 2 cups plain flour
instructions: Cut the duck breasts in half and rub inside and outside with the flour. Heat the oven to 220c/fan 180c/gas season the flour with the seasoning and bake at 220degc/fan 220f/gas fry the duck breasts in your oven for about 30 minutes, turn them over and fry for a further 20 minutes. Serve on a bed of couscous. If you have duck stock add to the gravy.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,eggplant,garam masala powder,self raising flour,garlic paste,cornstarch,black eyed pea
title: Creamy Eggplant With Black-Eyed Peas Pies
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1/4 lb black-eyed peas | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 c degrees. Slice eggplant into 1/4 thick slices on the angle. Place them in the oven and cook for 20 mins until nice and crisp. Remove eggplant and place on absorbent paper or newspaper. Take the eggplant out of oven and coat with the cornstarch. Fry in oil until crispy and brown. You may need to do this in batches depending on how thick you like your eggplant. Cut a piece of eggplant into 6 small chunks. Mix together the cream, garlic paste, garam masala and corn starch and mix in a cup at a time until you get a cream like consistancy. Remove eggplant, keep warm on low. In the same pan cook the black eyed peas till the peas are cooked but not mushy. Take out of the heat, drain and put aside. Dip eggplant in the cream and add it to the black eyed peas and peas and bring to simmer. When the peas are heated through take off the heat and add the garlic paste and garam masala powder. Serve with paratha.

title: Aussie Sweet Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons packed brown sugar | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the brown sugar and tabasco.

title: Chili-Coco
ingredients: 5 fresh red chilies | 1/2 white onion, diced fine | 1/2 cup white sugar | hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Remove stems from chilies, reserving the seeds. Devein and slice chilies finely. Place chilies in a blender or food processor with onion and sugar and blend well to combine. Pour into a non metallic bowl and add hot sauce to taste. Serve with your favorite foods. The chillies are a garnish for this recipe.

Random Ingredients: coconut,san marzano tomato,cranberry juice,pork,fennel seed,cauliflower floret,white wine vinegar
title: Cauliflower With Tomatoes & Coconut
ingredients: 1/2 lb cauliflower floret, washed, drained ( medium to small heads ) | 2 -3 medium firm ripe tomatoes, diced | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar ( or as needed ) | 1 can cannola light coconut or ( 12 ounce ) can coconut milk | 6 ounces cranberry juice | 2 -3 teaspoons ground fennel seeds or 2 -3 teaspoons dried fennel seed | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic-flavored dried chipolte red speculao ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling water, lightly steam or microwave the cauliflower until just tender, about 2 mins, depending on size of cauliflower. Drain well and pat dry. In a large bowl, whisk the vinegar, beans, coconut milk, cranberry juice, fennel and crushed red pepper until creamy. Add the seasoned cauliflower, tomatoes and sugar and toss well. Serve immediately or pack in sterilized bottles or plastic containers with a large slotted spoon. Makes 2 or 6 servings.

Random Ingredients: cashew butter,rice wine vinegar,white wine vinegar,ice
title: Cashew Butter Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/3 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup granulated cashew butter | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup crushed ice
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the vinegar, cashew butter, white wine vinegar, and rice wine vinegar until smooth. To assemble, pour the dressing and cashew butter into a serving bowl, and stir in the ice. Chill until very cold, about 3 hours.

title: Antipasto Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 1/2 kg sauerkraut | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs ( parma d'alsoule, tuscan herb mix ) | 1 teaspoon red capsicum, finely chopped | 1/2 cup kalamata olives or 1/2 cup other black olives, chopped | 1 packet puff pastry | 1 cup flour | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon, granule | 1 tablespoon roasted pistachios, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degree celsius. Prepare sauerkraut according to packet instructions or alternatively, rinse with cold water and drain well. Place sauerkraut in a large saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Return to the boil. Cover and reduce heat to simmer for 20 - 25 minutes drain. Dissolve chicken bouillon granules in a little warm water. Coat a 20 cup ovenproof dish with oil. Roll out pastry into a rectangle approximately 6 8inches wide and 8 - 8 inches long. Place sauerkraut over pastry. Top with olives. Roll up pastry around sauerkraut and place on the sauerkraut. Trim edge with a knife. Cover the dish with aluminium foil and bake in preheated oven for about 45 - 50 minutes or until pastry is browned. Remove from oven. Remove foil and sprinkle top with pistachios. Serve as an appetiser or side dish.

title: Snow Peas and Snow Peas
ingredients: 6 tablespoons dried white beans | 6 tablespoons snow peas
instructions: Soak the snow peas and snow peas in cold water for 20 minutes. Rinse well, then gently pat dry with paper towels. Spread the snow peas and snow peas out in several layers of paper towels. Place a heavy cast iron skillet over medium high heat until a bead of water just bounces off the surface, about 1 minute. Lay snow peas and snow peas into the skillet, and cook until the snow peas are golden brown, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Spray a serving platter with cooking spray, then drizzle the sherry over the vegetables. Serve warm.

title: Mango and Bean Sprout Parcel
ingredients: 8 seedless grapes | 1 medium mango, cut into 4 wedges | 4 cups bean sprouts ( or 2 cups baby spinach and 10 ounces chopped mixed sprouts )
instructions: Place a grapefruit ring inside a large serving bowl. Microwave both pints of chopped spinach just until warm. Dice the 1/4 cup of bean sprouts into 1/4 inch squares. When ready to serve, arrange the grapefruit ring on top of the pints of spinach, drizzle with yogurt, and garnish with the mango and bean sprouts.

title: French Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 package part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 1/2 cups canned low sodium chicken broth | 1/4 cup sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f mix all ingredients together except for the parmesan cheese. Spread into lightly greased 9 inch pie plate. Dot with the gated parmesan cheese. Bake in preheated oven 15 minutes or until heated through and top golden brown.

title: Chinese Cabbage
ingredients: 2 medium heads cabbage | 4 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/3 cup golden syrup | 4 tablespoons tamari sauce | 1/2 cup blackberries
instructions: Steam cabbage for 10 minutes. Slice off the top of each head. Remove outer leaves leaving approximately 1 inch of head to make the core. Chop and discard stem. Slice thinly into fine shreds. Combine tamari and sesame oil, then set aside. In a large skillet over medium high heat, sauté cabbage in oil and syrup mixture for about 10 minutes, or until nicely browned and slightly crisp. Taste for seasoning. Spoon half of cabbage over individual servings of rice, then add remaining cabbage. Top with sweet corn and fresh blackberries if desired.

title: Black-Eyed Peas With turbinado sugar and Currants
ingredients: 8 ounces dried black-eyed peas | 2 teaspoons turbinado sugar | 1/2 cup currants ( to taste )
instructions: Soak the black eyed peas overnight. The next day, stir the beans and 2 tsp of turbinado sugar into a small pan and saute until they are glazed. Add more turbinado sugar if using, a pinch of each. Simmer for 2 minutes or so. Remove from heat, stir in the currants and cool for 10 - 15 minutes or so, before serving or refrigerate until completely cold.

title: Easy Peppered Baby Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots, cut on diagonal into 1/4 inch coins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Add carrots to baking sheet and toss to coat. Place carrots into oven and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Italian Sausage Stew
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage, cut in 1 inch cubes | 5 cans whole kernel corn, including juice
instructions: Cook sausage until no longer pink.

title: Texas Style Pulled Beef
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 1 1/2 cups bourbon whiskey | 1 1/2 cups masa harina
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees f. Place the chuck roast in a baking dish, and season with salt and pepper. Cover with bourbon, and set aside. Spread the masa harina on the top of the roast, and place into the preheated oven. Cook until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f, about 1 hour. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 130 degrees f. Remove the meat to a slow cooker, and allow to sit 10 minutes before shredding with 2 forks. Serve with rice gravy or mashed potatoes, or use for tacos.

title: Saffron and Sun-Dried Tomato Guacamole
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/4 cup port wine ( optional ) | 2 small pinches ground saffron | 1 teaspoon guacamole
instructions: Stir together the sun dried tomatoes and port in a small bowl.

title: Fusion Beef and Noodle Skillet
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed | 1 envelope of ramen noodle | 1/4 cup fresh green onion, cut into 2 inch pieces, divided | 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 1 small turnip, cut into thin slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. In a medium bowl, dissolve ramen noodle envelopes in hot water until dissolved, about 10 minutes. Combine with the beef brisket, 1/3 of the green onions, and asafoetd and set aside. Place a roasting pan on oven rack that has been placed in freezer. Arrange the turnip slices around the bottom of the roasting pan. Insert the meat thermometer, if desired, close the turkey or beef pan, and continue roasting until meat thermometer reads 120 degrees f., about 1 hour. While the meat thermometer is resting, bring another roasting pan of water to a boil. Arrange the beef brisket on another roasting pan that has been placed in the roasting pan, then cover and roast until tender, and easily separated from the surface on the outside, 20 to 30 minutes. Uncover and turn oven temperature to 400 degrees f. When the meat thermometer is 120 degrees f, remove the meat brisket from the roasting pan, set on a large plate, and cover with foil. After about 40 minutes, check temperature with fork. Turn oven off, leave cover in the roasting pan, and let meat rest in refrigerator overnight. Slice and serve with vegetables and nuoc cham.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,lime,baking potato,chicken bouillon cube,beef stew meat,linguine pasta,plain flour
title: Spanish Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 teaspoon breadcrumbs or 1 teaspoon plain flour | 2 tablespoons parsley leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons lime rind, grated | 1 can chicken bouillon cubes | 4 baking potatoes | 3 -4 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper. Coat with flour. Put in oven proof casserole or roasting pan. Add a little water. Roast 1 hour at 450, covered. Stir. Simmer 15 to 30 minutes, uncovered. Remove bones, leaving meat in meat. Cut potatoes into 2 inch pieces. Combine 1 1/2 tps parsley and lime rind. Dissolve boullion in the rest of the parsley and add with potatoes. Simmer another 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Presto Vegetable Rolls for Two
ingredients: 1 large cos lettuce, leafs, or | 10 -12 leaves red cabbage | 3 tablespoons mascarpone cheese
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium. Remove and trim the lettuce of large stalk and any excess leaves if preferred. Cut into 4 equal segments. Line a small baking tray with baking paper and scatter a portion of the lettuce onto it. Roll up the remaining portion of lettuce and place into the centre of the tray. Sprinkle with a final layer of lettuce and drizzle with a little olive oil.

title: Yogurt & Fish
ingredients: 2 white fish fillets | 1 cup yoghurt | 1 1/2 cups mexican crema | 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: Pour white fish into hot buttered pan, and cook on both sides for 3 minutes. Turn the fish, and stir in the yoghurt, creme and wine. Serve with salad greens or pasta.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,green onion,double cream,lemon pepper seasoning,bell pepper,chive
title: Leberines in a Pot With Pepper Sauce (Microwave - 3)
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers | 2 green onions, with tops, cut into 3 | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh ground chives | 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/400f/gas 6, and lay the peppers on the rack on a baking tray lined with parchment paper, bake for about 15 minutes or until skin is browned and charred. Remove the peppers from the oven and run a knife over the stem and all the black and white parts under the skin. Once the peppers have cooled, remove the skin and roughly chop the flesh. Add the ginger and remaining ingredients to the pepper mixture and stir, then cook for a few minutes more. Spoon into sterilised jars and seal.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,veal,spearmint,monterey jack cheese,potato,steak,granny smith apple
title: Aunt Ann's Tourtie With Mustard, Veal and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pastry for double crust pie | 1 tablespoon chopped spearmint | 2 granny smith apples | 6 ounces veal | 1 1/2 lbs top round steaks | 4 ounces monterey jack cheese
instructions: Prepare pastry for a double crust pie by spreading on the bottom and sides of a 9 pie plate. Place on top crust and top with strech chopped parsely. Place the top crust on the filling. Cut the steaks into 1 - 2 chunks and put them down into a pie pan with enough water to go half way up the pie plate. The amount of water that you need will depend on the thickness of your steaks. Mix veal, granny smith apples and chopped spearmint together in a bowl. Add a little bit of extra water if you need to. Spread half of the meat mixture onto the first pie crust and the other half on top of the meat mixture. Pour 1 1/2 tbls melted butter at the bottom of the pan and on the top of the other pie crust. Mix the top crust with 1/2 1/2 tin of water in a frying pan and bring it to the boil. Then place on top of the crust and the steam will escape. Let that crust cook for half an hour then turn the oven down to 275 degrees f. And bake for 90 minutes to one hour until the crust is brown and the filling is bubbling about. Remove it from the oven and let rest for about 10 - 15 minutes before serving. Slice it on to your favorite platter and serve with lots of bread to soak up all of the gravy left behind.

title: Green Chili Fajitas
ingredients: 1 small fresh thai green chili, stem removed | garlic salt | shredded lettuce
instructions: Heat grill or skillet. Slice green chiles lengthwise into halves. Sprinkle garlic salt on both sides. Place chili slices on grill or skillet. If there are many peppers in the mixture, place in a paper bag or plastic bag with the garlic salt to dehydrate.

Random Ingredients: bread,spinach leaf,curd cottage cheese,chili pepper flake,yellow pepper,mint leaf
title: Charmie Ki Kheema With Toast
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups small curd cottage cheese ( cottage cheese ) | 1 yellow sweet pepper, sliced in rounds | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons fresh mint leaves, chopped | 4 slices bread | 2 cups fresh spinach leaves, washed
instructions: Boil water in a pan. Add the curds in it. Then remove from flame. Allow the curds to cool. Mix in mint leaves, chile flakes and yellow pepper slices. Soak bread slices in the curd mixture for 2 minutes. Heat in a non stick pan. Saute sliced bread slices until crisp. Drain on absorbent paper. Put 2 tablespoons of the prepared mixture in the centre of each of your serving plates. Garnish with chopped mint leaves. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,green creme de menthe,green pepper,sesame oil,salmon,bulgogi marinade,red pepper green,white flour
title: The English Room Salmon Mousse!
ingredients: 36 ounces salmon, frozen | green creme de menthe | 32 ounces green king salmon fillets, frozen | 1 red peppers or 1 green pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon white flour | 1 teaspoon bottled salted salmon ( optional ) | 4 ounces of boxed frigo salami ( or your favorite salami ) ( optional )
instructions: Place salmon in medium bowl. Dump green creme de menthe over salmon. Chill several hours overnight. Rinse salmon fillet under cold water twice.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,cocoa powder,curry paste,chili sauce,mace,jumbo shrimp
title: Mildly Curried Shrimp
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons hot curry paste | 1 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped, with seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 36 jumbo shrimp ( cooked, peeled, and tails left on )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place shrimp in the refrigerator to marinade while you cook the shrimp.

title: Leek and Bell Pepper Frittata
ingredients: 5 medium leeks, white and light green parts only, washed, trimmed, and cut into 1/4 inch wide slices | 4 sun-dried tomatoes, roughly chopped | 2 romao cheese, leaves, coarsely grated | 2 medium bell peppers, roasted, peeled, and coarsely chopped | 4 lime wedges
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling salted water, blanch the leeks until just limp and drain well. While the vegetables cook, toast the romao and place in a sieve to drain most of the excess water. When the vegetables are cool enough to handle, peel them and chop roughly. Transfer the leeks and chopped olives to a large, deep baking dish or shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with the romao. Add the chopped bell peppers and toss to coat with the romano. Cut the wedges into wedges. Pour the vegetable mixture over the olives. Sprinkle with the grated romano and toss lightly. Bake in a preheated oven at 350°f for about 35 minutes, or until the top is starting to brown, stirring occasionally. Serve hot, warm, or slightly cooled. Variation, alternatively, you could use other grilled vegetables like a chorizo sausage, sausage, peppers, etc.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed,red wine vinegar,cranberry juice,half,double cream
title: Cranberry Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup sunflower seeds | 1/4 cup double cream | 1/4 cup dried cranberry juice | 1 1 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spread out sunflower seeds in a small baking pan and roast until lightly golden, 10 - 15 minutes. Cool in a bowl. Whisk cream, cranberry juice and vinegar in a jug, and season with salt and pepper. Scoop seeds from baking pan and spoon into individual serving glasses. In a small saucepan, combine 1/4 cup of the cream with 2 tbsp of water and bring to simmer, then remove from heat and stir in the remaining cream. Spoon the cranberry mix into bowls and drizzle with the sweetened cream and sprinkle with sunflower seeds. Place on a baking sheet, drizzle with remaining 2 tbsp of cream and roasted seeds. Bake, drizzled with cream and sprinkled with chopped parsley if desired, for about 10 to 15 minutes or until top bubbles and begins to turn golden.

title: Indian Cabbage With Chillies
ingredients: 2 medium heads cabbage, coarsely chopped | 2 green chilies | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Wash the cabbage well, remove any tough outer leaves, cut the core out and separate the cabbage leaves. Wash and slice the green chillies. Heat a little oil in a wok or pot. Add all dry ingredients except cabbage. Stir fry for a minute or two. Add cabbage leaves. Stir fry for a minute or two and add salt. Stir and add hot water, if needed. Cover and cook for 5 minutes or till the cabbage is tender. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,cottage cheese,lettuce,white pepper,french bread,yeast,cannellini bean,oregano
title: Mixed Bean Bread - Rustic Style
ingredients: 250 g strong fresh yeast, divided into 2 equal portions ( use 1/2 tbsp. yeast if you want more flavour, use 1-2 tbsp. oil ) | 1 liter white muslin beans ( white kidney beans ) | 4 slices day old french bread ( thick slices ) | 150 g lowfat cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 500 g lettuce, washed & separated into leaves | 1/4 cup white pepper, freshly ground | 1/4 cup vanilla essence
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in a cup of hot water. Dump in 1 tsp. oil, and stir well to soften the yeast. If you have a yeast sponge, cover & leave for 10 - 15 minutes, or until creamy. While yeast is soaking, cut out & wash your french bread slices w/a tea towel. Slice the bread in half diagonally, then spread the slices w/the cottage cheese, leaving 2 3mm of crust on each slice of bread. Spread the bread w/the cottage cheese mixture. Add the chopped lettuce. Add white pepper, oregano & vanilla. Sprinkle the top w/sugar until the top looks dry. Cover & leave to rise in a warm place until double in bulk. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Brush several round baking pans w/oil. Place bread slices on tray & bake for 10 - 15 mins, or until crisp & light brown. Turn bread over carefully & return to oven for 5 - 10 mins, or just until browned.

title: Italian Tofu Wraps (Pan Fried)
ingredients: 14 ounces firm tofu | 1/3 cup finely ground nuts, or 1/3 cup slivered almonds, or | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped mixed nuts | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 1/2 tablespoon lime juice ( from 1 lime ) | flour or cornstarch | 4 tablespoons mild italian dressing
instructions: Squeeze excess water from tofu and place in a small bowl. Stir in ground nuts, amaretto, and lime. Cover with plastic wrap, and allow to marinate, refrigerated, for 1 - 2 hours. Remove tofu mixture from marinade and roll into 1 balls. Coat with flour or cornstarch. Bring 2 - 3 inches of water to a boil. Put tofu balls into boiling water 3 - 4 minutes, or until browned well, and drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,peanut butter,pineapple juice,white sugar,rice paper,flat leaf parsley,mexican cheese,rosemary
title: Island Pork Papers
ingredients: 1 pork rib, cut into 3/4-inch slices | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 6 sheets round rice paper | 3/4 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 3/4 cup shredded reduced-fat mexican cheese blend | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar or 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place pork slices between two sheets of wax paper. Firmly pound slices to 1/4 inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Place slices on a baking sheet. Place a second baking sheet on top. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 15 minutes. Remove bread from oven and place on a paper towel, dry with more towel, and let drain. When meat is cool enough to handle, slice each piece into about 5 smaller pieces. Place 2 slices onto a dinner plate. Spoon pineapple with juice into a blender with crushed pineapple, and puree until smooth. Spread about 2 tablespoons of mixture over each bread slice, and sprinkle 1/4 cup shredded cheese on top. Fold in 2 more bread slices, and repeat process with remaining sandwich slices, fillingings, and pineapple juice. Spoon the sandwiches onto 2 baking sheets. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup shredded cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until bread slices are crisp and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with rosemary, and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Stove Top Parsnips and Pine Nuts in Egg Roll Wraps
ingredients: 4 large parsnips or 4 large yams | vegetable oil | 1/4 cup apple cider or 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 large egg roll wrap | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts or 1/4 cup walnut pieces
instructions: Preheat oven 400ºf. Cut a circle in the center of each parsnip and, using a potato peeler, peel off the skin from the parsnips and discard the core and peel. Cut the parsnips into 1/4 inch wedges and boil them in boiling water for a few minutes. They should still be firm. Drain the parsnips and let cool. Peel off the skin if desired. Brush the tops of the wedges with vegetable oil and sprinkle with salt if desired. Sprinkle with the pine nuts or walnuts and let cool for 15 minutes. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper and set aside. Brush each wedge of bread with oil and place on the wire rack at a distance from the heat. Cut a small slit down the center of each wedge of bread at the top and place the wedge on the foil. Place the sandwiches on the rack and steam the sandwiches for about 15 minutes, or until very crisp. Carefully remove the sandwiches and set them aside on paper towels. Serve at room temperature with a few napkins.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,breadcrumb,hungarian paprika,tip roast,italian cheese,romaine lettuce
title: Hungarian Grilled Sirloin
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1/2 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1/4 cup peanut oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 2 -3 lbs romaine lettuce, washed well | 1 bag shredded italian cheese, grated
instructions: Trim beef, if necessary. With the sharp edge of a knife, score deeply with diagonal lines about 3/4 inch deep, cutting through the beef about every 3/4 inch to 1/2 inch deep into a diamond shaped breading. Coat beef with bread crumbs, and sprinkle with paprika. Set aside. Heat oil in a large heavy skillet over high heat until hot but not smoking. Working in batches if necessary, fry beef until deep golden brown, turning once, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate, and keep warm. Drain off all but 1 1/2 tablespoons fat from skillet. Bring to a boil. Cook until beef is hot but not crisp, about 3 minutes. Transfer meat to broiler pan, cover and keep warm. Add enough dressing to coat the bottom of the pan to cover. Arrange roast on a platter, and broil, turning once, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Transfer roast to a warmed dish, cover and keep warm. Arrange lettuce leaves on plates. With a slotted spoon, remove and discard lettuce stems. Cover loosely and keep warm. To serve, place a bed of lettuce on each plate, and sprinkle with cheese to taste. Place beef over lettuce.

title: Frozen English Pea Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen green peas, defrosted | 1/2 lemon, sliced into rounds | 6 -7 fresh raspberries | 2 -3 tablespoons sweet sherry | lettuce leaf | 1/2 teaspoon anise seeds
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c. Place peas in a small mixing bowl. Sprinkle on a little lemon rind, cover with sherry, cover and put in fridge for 10 minutes to draw out the flavours. Drain peas. Rinse with cold water and pat dry. Combine peas, lemon with lemon rind, cover and put back in the fridge for 15 - 20 minutes. Toss salad with sesame seeds. Serve at room temperature.

title: Sausage and Peppers for Two!
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs italian sausage | 1 sweet chili pepper | 1 sprig fresh thyme | sparkling wine | 2 teaspoons orange liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 f. Place sausage in a large roasting pan, and cook over medium high heat for 6 to 8 minutes. Add chili and thyme and stir to coat sausage with seasonings. Pour wine over sausage. Cover tightly and bake in the oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes, or until sausage is cooked. Sausages may also be baked on a griddle for a formal finish.

title: Easy Chicken Gravy for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 teaspoon chicken chicken stock
instructions: Put all ingredients into crockpot, stir well. Cook in crockpot on low 7 hours. Remove from crockpot and stir, serve over your favourite vegetables, or as a side dish with salads, rice or noodles. Or as a meal starter.

title: Sicilian Style Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained ( angel hair ) | 2 cups sugar | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1 tablespoon corn | salt and pepper
instructions: Mix together the 1st 3 ingredients. Drain pasta and return to pot. Stir in sugar mixture. Transfer to cookie sheet or plate. Bake at 325 degrees for approx 35 - 45 minutes.

title: Spice Crusted Croissants
ingredients: 3 lbs plain croissants | 2 teaspoons mixed spice
instructions: Butter a large baking sheet. With a sharp knife, trim crust from croissant base. Cut crissant halves in half. Spread croissant halves with the remaining butter and sprinkle with spice blend. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes or until golden brown and cranes are puffed up.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,white flour,grain white rice,oyster sauce,cream chicken soup,salt black pepper,elbow macaroni,turkey
title: Best and Easiest Chinese Rice Casserole (For the kids)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground turkey or 2 lbs ground beef | 3/4 cup uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 can cream of chicken soup ( can use cream of mushroom ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup light soya sauce | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon salt and black pepper | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a pan sprayed with oil, brown ground turkey or beef, breaking apart any small chunks. Pour turkey mixture into a 2 quart casserole. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover and bake for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,breadcrumb,nutmeg,taco sauce,orange zest,basmati rice,italian sausage
title: Spicy Sausage-Lamb Skillet
ingredients: 2 lbs lean boneless leg of lamb, cut into 4 equal portions | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup orange zest | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 16 ounces mild italian sausage ( or hot ) | 2 cups dry bertolli rice or 2 cups long grain rice | 1 jar taco sauce
instructions: Brown sausage for 5 minutes. Remove from skillet, reserving oil. Add olive oil to skillet, reduce heat to low and add lamb, bread crumbs, zest, nutmeg and 1/2 cup of the taco sauce. Simmer until lamb is cooked and is cooked through and sauce is heated through, about 40 minutes. Meanwhile, cook rice according to package directions, and drain. Once cooked, place meat on warmed bertolli rice and top with sauce and rice.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,broccoli,beef chuck roast,wheat pita bread,dark soy sauce,serrano pepper
title: Mongolian Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck roast, trimmed | 2 serrano chilies, halved lengthwise | 1 serrano pepper, seeded | 8 ounces broccoli, stems removed | 8 ounces whole wheat pita bread, halved | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Trim fat off roast. Remove strings and fat from the pepper.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,active yeast,yellow onion,sage,sherry wine,rump roast,phyllo pastry,pumpkin puree
title: Pumpkin Triangles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 teaspoon sage | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 cup canned pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 3 cups shredded peeled rump roast | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 12 sheets phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, stir together the sherry, sage and onion. Place the onion mixture in a warm place and allow to sit until the onion mixture has softened, about 10 minutes. Stir together the yeast and pumpkin in a bowl, pour over the pumpkin and let rest about 5 minutes. In a bowl large enough to hold the roast, combine the pumpkin puree and sherry. Stir in the baking soda and stir to combine. Set the oven rack 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven to 475 degrees f. Line a jelly roll pan with 1 sheet of phyllo. Cut out 8 equal pieces. Spread a piece of dough evenly on the bottom of the prepared pan, then top with 1 more piece of dough and cover with the rest of the dough. Carefully lay the phyllo sheets on the work surface on top of each other over the top sheet of dough. Working with one sheet at a time, pull the left and right corners of a square up and over it make a triangle shape. Repeat with the other sheet and filling. The triangles should make a total of 6 triangles. Place the filled triangle in the oven and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden and puffed. Cool before making more triangles.

Random Ingredients: english mustard,bean,yellow cornmeal,italian salad dressing mix
title: Italian Ham and Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal | 6 cups dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 1 cup prepared italian-style dry salad dressing mix, can add more if needed | 1 english-style mustard
instructions: Combine the cornmeal, salad dressing mix, and mustard.

title: Alfredo Sauce - Spicy Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs raw shrimp, cleaned and peeled | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Rinse shrimp, drain. Add almond extract and shrimp to a large saucepan. Bring to a boil and stir to cover shrimp. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove shrimp from heat and set aside on absorbent paper towel to absorb excess water. Serve over cooked pasta or rice.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,zucchini lengthwise,turmeric powder,sugar substitute,rose water,white vinegar,poblano chile,cake flour
title: Mexican Zucchini
ingredients: 6 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup powdered sugar substitute | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons rose water ( see note below ) | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1 medium poblano chiles, seeded and chopped ( about 1 cup )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Spray a large rimmed baking sheet or a baking sheet with cooking spray. Cut half of the zucchini into 2 lengthwise rounds and then lengthwise into 6 wedges. Transfer the wedges to the baking sheet and season with salt and pepper. Whisk the cake flour, powdered sugar, turmeric, rose water, vinegar and poblanos in a large bowl to make a coarse paste. Spoon 1/4 cup the flour paste onto the zucchini and toss to coat. Arrange the wedges in a single layer on the parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for 20 to 22 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Chutney Dip (Aka Presto Pecorino Cheese)
ingredients: 5 -6 tablespoons chutney | 1/2 teaspoon ginger juice | 1/2 teaspoon pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Blend ingredients in electric blender. Will keep in refrigerator for several days no problem if you buy it at christmastime.

title: Lemon Colada
ingredients: 16 1/2 ounces lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage, chilled | 12 prunes, pitted and sliced | 10 slices prosciutto or 10 slices deli ham | 2 cups chilled fruit or 2 cups mango-flavored carbonated beverages
instructions: Drain prunes and arrange on chilled platter. Break ham slices over fruit mixture. Top with soda. Garnish with slices of prosciutto or deli ham.

title: Green Peas "cheese Filled With" (Cheese Filling for French Fondue)
ingredients: 2 lbs green peas | 1/4 lb pepper, diced
instructions: Prepare peas by washing and removing tough stringy ends. Remove any hard ends but leave the peas whole. Place peas in a pot of well salted boiling water, and cook till done about 6 minutes. Drain and reserve the hot water before adding more water. Scoop out pea shells and set aside. Melt a tablespoon of butter in a saute pan and cook the peas till tender, adding a tablespoon of reserved hot water as needed to keep peas from burning. Stir the peas and pepper into the cheese and heat until cheese melts. Taste to adjust flavor and serve. Makes about 2 dozen fondues.

title: Chocolate-Onion Chili Powder Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup or 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried curry powder | 3 teaspoons dried minced onion | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder, to taste
instructions: Combine the olive oil, cooking oil, chocolate syrup or cider vinegar, curry powder, dried onion, and chili powder in a small jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake well and allow to sit for 10 minutes to infuse the flavors. Store in refrigerator to blend the flavors before storing.

title: Broccoli Pizza, from Leftovers!
ingredients: 1/4 ounce yeast, dry | 1/4 cup irish whiskey, such as guinness | 1 1/2 cups broccoli, cut into small florets | 10 -12 ounces ham, sliced thin | dill weed, pinch of | oregano leaves, pinch
instructions: Dissolve yeast in whiskey and heat gently with 2 cups water. Let sit until frothy, then stir into other liquid. Add remaining ingredients except bread and stir to combine. Pour into greased loaf pans which have been sprinkled with flour. Stretch to fit in your bread maker, and place on pan with lid on top, or on rack in oven to rise about 1 1/2 and 3 1/2 times the size. When doubled in size, baste with melted butter and sprinkle with dill weed, if desired. Bake at 425°.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,poultry seasoning,fruit,pimento olive,cream mushroom soup,baby corn,penne
title: Microwave Pronto Chicken
ingredients: 1 jar marinara sauce | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 package frozen mixed fruit | 1 cup canned baby corn, drained | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, sliced | 1 package uncooked penne
instructions: Place 1/2 jar marinara sauce, cream of mushroom soup, mixed fruit, baby corn, poultry seasoning, olives and penne in the center of a 13x9x2 inch casserole dish coated with cooking spray. Cover and cook in microwave on high 5 to 7 minutes, stir, and continue cooking 3 to 5 minutes more or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: black olive,molasses,water,brown basmati rice,red pepper flake,feta cheese,pork bean,pecan
title: Mediterranean Stuffed Beans
ingredients: 1 can pork and beans | 1 can brown basmati rice | 1 -2 tablespoon molasses | 1 cup frozen pecan pieces ( optional ) | 1 cup feta cheese | 1 cup water | crushed red pepper flakes | 1/3 cup sliced black olives
instructions: Drain and rinse pork beans. Add water to a large skillet, if you need to. Bring to a boil and then simmer on low until liquid is absorbed, about 35 minutes. Meanwhile, microwave pecans until soft, if necessary, for 10 minutes to soften. If you're adding the cheese, combine it with the beans. If not using the feta, place 1/2 the beans and 1/2 the cheese mixture in an oiled oven safe saucepan, and microwave for 15 seconds to make cheese melted, then remove from heat. Add a little oil to the skillet to melt. Pour water into the pan, as per directions on the can. Cover the beans with a large scoop of the rice, then stuff with a heaping tablespoon of the remaining cheese mixture. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 400 degrees. Note, the water should almost fill the pan and steam, creating the stuffing.

title: Paneer
ingredients: 8 cups cold pressed paneer ( or paneer cubes cut from the refrigerator ) | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Crush paneer into fine, thin strands. Add a pinch of nutmeg. Serve with paneer.

title: Cafe Rio Black Beans for the Crockpot
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat or 1 lb ground turkey | 6 cups chicken broth | 7 ounces diced mushrooms | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 tablespoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: If using ground meat, brown it in a medium skillet with a tbsp of olive oil. Once browned, add the broth, mushrooms, beans, onion salt, anise, and marjoram. Mix well. Cover and cook on high 3 to 4 hours.

title: Bamboo Steak Skewers
ingredients: 12 bamboo skewers, soaked for at least 20 minutes and rinsed | 1 piece whole fresh tarragon | 1/2 cup watermelon, chunks | 3 ounces marinated broth | 1 lemon, juice of | 3 chiles, minced
instructions: Thread about 15 of the bamboo skewers onto the skewers. Set aside. Tear the tarragon and watermelon chunks into small pieces and add to the yogurt marinade. Refrigerate for as least 15 minutes or overnight. Preheat grill and lightly oil. Thread remaining bamboo skewers onto the skewers. Combine the broth and lemon juice in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and discard the tarragon or use a flavored liquid. Pour into the pan, and cook for 5 minutes, or until slightly thickened. Place skewers on the grill and brush with the sauce. Grill about 5 minutes per side, or until tender.

title: Chinese Chicken on Red Bell Pepper Quinoa
ingredients: 3/4 cup soya sauce | 3/4 cup chicken leg | 2 cups cooked quinoa | 1/4 cup yellow bell pepper, diced
instructions: Cook chicken legs in 2 cups chicken stock and water until cooked, approximately 20 minutes. Set aside. Meanwhile, prepare rice according to package directions. Serve chicken with soya sauce and hot pepper slices.

title: Creme-Crispy French Bread Sticks
ingredients: 2 tablespoons creole seasoning, or as needed | 2 tablespoons italian flat leaf parsley, or more to taste, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and set an oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Mix creole seasoning and parsley in a small bowl. Remove stems from bread sticks and spread on prepared baking sheet. Broil 5 to 7 minutes, or until just lightly toasted. Cool bread sticks on baking sheet 5 minutes. Turn immediately to a cutting board if desired.

title: Apple Blossom Soup
ingredients: 25 g dried tart apple | 2 free range chicken, cubes chopped | 1 cup light corn | 1/2 cup diced bamboo shoot | 3 slices rye bread, torn in half | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Bake the apple and cut chicken into chunks. Cook chicken cubes and dry corn until chicken browns and vegetables are soft. Put the soup in a large saucepan. Add the corn, bamboo shoots and bread. Cook over medium heat for about 30 mins or until bread is toasted. Serve hot with sour cream and grated coconut.

title: Filling for Mexican Cheese
ingredients: 1 box mexican cheese | 1 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: Mix everything up and use over your grated cheddar and enjoy.

title: Quick Brown Brown Rice Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 6 okra, diced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh sage leaf | 4 zucchini, trimmed and cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place okra, sage, zucchini, and rice in a large casserole dish. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake 30 minutes. Remove foil.

title: Cuban Lamb Leg Filling for Peruvian Tacos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 pound lean leg of lamb | 1 package rotelle noodles
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat and stir in the garlic salt and adobo seasoning. Cook until tender. Remove to a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,wheat bread,cocoa powder,fennel bulb,parsley,arborio rice,salt pepper
title: Caldo de Porco (Rice & Beef Casserole)
ingredients: 3 cups low-fat beef broth or 3 cups low sodium beef broth, warmed | 1 fennel bulb, very thinly sliced ( about 1 1/4 cups ) | 2 -3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | coarse salt and pepper | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon ( or 1 teaspoon granules )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a medium saucepan, heat broth over medium heat. Place fennel bulb into broth and bring to a simmer.

Random Ingredients: white onion,prune,butter,oregano,vanilla soymilk,parmesan cheese,cream tartar,red onion
title: German Onion-Parmesan Cream Cheese Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 1 1/4 cups white onions, chopped ( about 6 medium ) | 2 cups white onions, thinly sliced ( about 3 cups ) | 1 cup prune, sliced | 4 tablespoons pure vanilla-flavored soymilk | 6 tablespoons low-fat sour cream or 6 tablespoons low-fat soy milk | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated ( about 1 1/4 cups )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Butter and flour 9 inch diameter springform pan, tapping it out onto the bottom and sides of the pan. Place in oven and roast 20 minutes remove cover and bake til lightly browned and just beginning to brown, 20 - 22 minutes meanwhile for the onions, melt the butter in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium low heat, add the chopped white parts of the onions and cook stirring occasionally, until softened and brown, about 20 minutes. Transfer the onions to a platter lined with a clean paper towel. Increase oven temperature to 425°f spread the soymilk evenly over the surface of the roasted onions and the onions and sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup of onions, prunes and oregano. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until the topping is brown and the onions are soft and dry. Remove from oven and spread sour cream mixture evenly over the baked onions. Sprinkle with the parmesan and cover with a kitchen towel until the topping cools. Serve warm.

title: Finger Beer Marinated Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1 pound pork ribs | 2 cups stout beer | 1/2 cup fresh basil | 16 ounces fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Coat pork ribs with cooking spray and place in a baking dish. Stir together the stout beer and basil in a small bowl. Pour over the ribs, cover the dish with plastic wrap, and marinate in the refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight. Drain pork ribs and discard marinade. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Discard the remaining marinade. Remove spare or damaged bones from grill or grill and discard. Brush some reserved marinade from the ribs with reserved marinade.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,carrot,maple extract,superfine sugar,mustard green,phyllo pastry
title: Maple Mustard Greens & Carrots on Phyllo
ingredients: 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 8 ounces fresh goat cheese | 1 1/2 cups maple-flavored mustard greens, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups coarsely grated carrots | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1/2 teaspoon pure maple extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lay the phyllo sheets in a large roasting pan. Top with enough boiling water to cover the sheets completely and a baking sheet that has been coated with nonstick cooking spray such as the parchment paper. Bake the phyllo sheets for about 12 - 15 minutes until the pastry begins to turn golden on the edges. Meanwhile heat the goat cheese in a small saucepan over medium heat for 1 - 2 minutes or until it is just melted, stirring every now and then. Add the maple flavoring and mustard greens and cook for about 3 - 5 minutes, or until the greens are tender. Remove the phyllo sheets from the pan and cover with plastic wrap. Set aside. Take 1 sheet in the center of each one. Carefully fold the other sheet over and using a pastry wheel or a 2 - 3 inch round cutter, score the green strips about 2 - 3 times. Spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons filling on half the green strips. Fold the other half of the green strips over and press the edges to seal the filling. Cut the phyllo sheets into 4 - 5 crosswise strips. Tuck the last few strips underneath the filling. Working with 1 strip at a time, place about 1 tbs mixture at ea end of the phyllo strips. Fold in the strips to form a triangle, tucking the tip in as you go along the length of the strip to form an edge. Repeat until all the phyllo and stuffing has been used. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet and set aside while you cook the rest of the phyllo, to wait 10 - 15 minutes. To serve, transfer the pan and dishes to a rack and let rest 1 minute. Using a fork, lightly toss the contents of the pan, plus any accumulated juices, with the maple syrup and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,oregano,sauce,lukewarm water,chipotle chile,cider vinegar,cocoa powder,pork rib
title: Slow Cooker Chile Colorado
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1/3 cup hot sauce | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 lbs country-style pork ribs, trimmed | 1 cup hot sauce | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 cup lukewarm water | 2 whole dried chipotle chiles
instructions: In slow cooker combine the rotel tomatoes, hot sauce, oregano, cocoa powder, and 1 tablespoon of water.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,red pesto sauce,salad oil
title: Pesto Roasted Peppers
ingredients: 4 lbs yellow bell peppers | 1/2 cup red pesto sauce ( jarred is fine ) | 2 cups salad oil
instructions: Wash, remove seeds, cut in 1/2 in long wedges. Roast peppers until blackened on all sides, and skin has loosened. Place peppers in a roaster, and cover with half the pesto, spreading evenly. Drizzle remaining pesto over top of peppers. Cover and roast in a preheated 350°f oven for 20 - 25 minutes, turning and basting. Roast peppers a further 30 minutes, or until tender and glazed. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes before slicing thinly. Tip, when preparing this dish, add 1 - 2 tsp of red pesto to the red pesto in a jar when it is hot, shake up, and pour over peppers before serving.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,beer,hot red chili pepper,potato chip,peanut oil
title: Potato Chips With Chillies
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, cut into 1 by 1/4 inch wedges each | 2 cups peanut oil, for frying | 1 inch fresh gingerroot, peeled and finely minced | 1 cup beer ( i use guinness ) | 1 -2 fresh hot red chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Heat the oil in a large, heavy based skillet. Fry the potato wedges for about 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown on both sides. Remove from the pan. Reheat the oil and quickly fry the ginger for 1 minute. Pour in the beer and add the chilies, stirring. Return the potato wedges and a sprinkling of salt.

title: Quick Nachos
ingredients: 1 package tortilla | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1 cup chopped fresh thai basil | 1 bottle taco sauce
instructions: Remove the green pepper from the jar. Slice the green pepper in half lengthwise, then slice each half into thin strips. Stack up the tortillas on a flat dish. Spread 1/4 of the taco sauce on the tortillas. Add the chili pepper strips, green pepper strips and basil. Roll the tortillas up and serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,italian sausage,ginger garlic paste,white bean
title: Italian White Beans
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon powdered ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Place ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth. If you don't have a food processor, you can just use a blender to blend everything. I use an immersion blender for a bit of texture, but it's not necessary.

title: Kittencal's Mediterranean  Flounder
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flounder fillets, bones removed and meat grated | 2/3 cup kalamata olive, coarsely chopped ( or other brine ) | 12 -12 stoned black olives, coarsely chopped, rinsed in a sieve ( optional )
instructions: Grind all of the ingredients into a puree using a food processor or blender. Place in a shallow baking dish and cover. Bake at 375 f for 1 hour. Remove from oven and place on serving platter. Brush olive brine over fish. Surround with olives and serve.

title: Sparkling Dipping Sauce for Seafood
ingredients: 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup chicken bouillon cube | 1/3 cup sparkling water | 1/4 cup bottled sweet-and-sour dipping sauce ( such as valentina's, ketchop'n herb )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until desired texture is achieved. Store unused portion in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,ha avocadoes,ziti pasta,tomato green chile pepper,turmeric powder
title: Smashy Ziti With Avocado and Blueberries
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 1 ripe hass avocado - peeled, pitted, and diced | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ziti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. In a large bowl, combine the avocado and tomatoes with the chile peppers. Add tumeric and mix well. Stir the avocado mixture to coat the ziti with the mixture. Toss the pasta with half of the avocado mixture. Sprinkle with the blueberries and serve.

title: Sweet Potato Puffs
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes ( about 5 pounds ) | 1/2 cup whole cashews | 1 cup dry instant malted sweetened potato flakes | 1/2 cup ground hazelnuts | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place sweet potatoes in saucepan with cold water to cover. Bring water to a boil.

title: French Foil Wrapped Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium russet potatoes | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 2 celery ribs, cut into large chunks | aluminum foil
instructions: Peel potatoes if using new potatoes. Slice into half moons. Toss with cornflour mixed with a little tarragon. Spread onto a dinner plate. Place in your microwave and cook 8 - 10 mins, until just tender. Stir to coat evenly. Arrange on serving plate.

title: Shrimp in a Creamy Baked French Bread
ingredients: 3 lbs shrimp, cleaned | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Clean shrimp, removing tails if they are large enough to handle easily. Remove the meat from the heads and tails and slice off the dark vein at the base of the shrimp heads. Carefully separate the heads and tails from the shrimp heads. Using a paring knife, remove a wedge of shrimp and cut off the shell and tails. Repeat this on the shrimp then put into a bowl with the tails. Lightly oil a large frypan to medium heat. Carefully add oil to the pan. Fry shrimp, two or three at a time, with heads and tails until golden brown and soft, about 4 - 5 minutes. Lift out with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve with warmed homemade mayo or french bread.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,chicken bouillon cube,vegetable,dark chocolate,fast rising yeast,sea salt
title: Chocolate and Garlic Arugula
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fast rising yeast | 1 teaspoon granulated vegetable or 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup arborio rice | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cube | 1 pinch sea salt, to taste | 3 ounces dark chocolate or 6 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the yeast, vegetable or sunflower oil, and 1/2 cup arborio or frijoles rice. Set aside in a warm place to let it rise until doubled in size about 60 minutes. Preheat oven to 400°f. Boil 2 cups water and 1 bouillon cube. Remove water, then stir in rice and arborio rice. Return to a boil, then cover with an inverted bowl and set in a warm place to rise again, about 45 minutes. Dissolve the remaining bouillon cube in the remaining cup of water and stir into rice mixture. Cook until volume is about 1/2 cup. Remove the bowl from the heat. Dissolve the chocolate in 1/2 cup of the remaining hot chocolate, then stir into the rice mixture. Allow to cool before spreading onto parchment paper lined baking sheets, or refrigerate in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days. Alternatively, transfer to a freezer bag.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,apricot jam,boston lettuce,serrano pepper,cilantro,potato,meat tenderizer
title: Pineapple Meatball Appetizer With Apricot Jam and Cilantro
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground meat ( may use veal or chicken ) | 1 tablespoon meat tenderizer ( from 2 small package ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 1/4 cups coarsely chopped cilantro | 1 cup chopped dried apricot jam, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/maricot-jam-39656 '' > apricot jam < /a > | 1/2 cup loosely packed finely chopped cilantro | 6 fresh large potatoes, washed, unpeeled, boiled and drained
instructions: Use a fork or hands to mash the meat with the tenderizer in a bowl. In a large skillet, heat the peanut oil over medium high heat until shimmering. Add the meat mixture and cook, mashing with the fork, until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside. Add the 2 t of cilantro to the skillet and stir to coat the mixture. Return meat to skillet and mix well. Add the apricot jam and 1/2 cup of cilantro and gently stir to blend with the meat and cilantro. Continue stirring until heated through. Cool to room temperature. While the meatball is cooking, preheat the broiler. Cut each potato lengthwise into 5 slices. Arrange 2 potato slices on a large baking sheet, then top with an equal quantity of the meatball mixture to cover the potatoes and then a further quantity of potatoes. Sprinkle with paprika, if desired. Broil in the middle of the oven until the potatoes are lightly browned. Serve with the remaining cilantro sauce.

title: Italian Seasoned Salt.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning ( i use basil, but fresh basil is also okay to use ) | 1 red chili pepper
instructions: Place in a large container and use as a side dish as a marinade for pork roast.

title: Red Lentil Dal
ingredients: 2 cups red lentils | 4 -5 drops red food coloring | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Rinse and then soak lentils in water overnight. Bring lentils to a boil in medium to high heat. Reduce heat to low, and continue cooking for 30 minutes. Add 1/2 teaspoon of dried sage and food coloring. Cover and cook on medium heat for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally to avoid burning. Serve hot with fresh bread or tea.

Random Ingredients: dill seed,icing sugar,xanthan gum,serrano pepper,coriander powder,peanut oil,coriander leaf
title: Gado Con Cramma
ingredients: 1 cup desiccated dried salted peanuts or 1 cup ground roasted peanuts | 2 1/2 cups icing sugar | 3 -5 tablespoons dill seeds | 2 tablespoons ground coriander powder ( or chilli seeds, or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum | 1 tablespoon ground coriander seeds ( or chilli seeds, or to taste ) | 2 serrano peppers, seeded and finely diced
instructions: Grind the peanuts using a mortar and pestle or the coarse blade of a meat grinder. Place the mince and remaining ingredients in a food processor. Process until well combined. Alternatively add all the ingredients to the ground peanuts and process again until it is the desired consistency. Allow the mince to cool completely before rolling into balls. Store in an airtight container or sealed airtight plastic bag in the fridge.

title: Broccoli and Dill
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret | 1 teaspoon pepper | 1 tablespoon dill weed
instructions: Steam broccoli until just crisp tender. Keep warm if serving cold. When cooked, put broccoli on platter. Add remaining ingredients over the top. Serve at once.

title: Spaghetti Kidney Beans and Eggs
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup italian parsley, minced | 1/2 cup dill, minced | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 sprig italian parsley
instructions: Drain the beans. Put the kidney beans in a medium pot and cover with water. Bring the beans to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and set aside. Strain the cooked beans through a fine mesh sieve. In a large bowl, combine beans with egg, parsley, dill, vanilla, cayenne pepper and italian parsley. Mix well. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: raisin,veal,asparagus spear,red bell pepper,cayenne pepper,mustard seed,red wine vinegar,allspice
title: Mustard-Roasted Veal With Roasted Red Pepper & Raisins
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mustard seeds, cracked away with tip of knife | 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb raisins | 1 small red bell pepper, roasted, peeled and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice | 8 asparagus spears, trimmed
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degress f. In small heavy skillet, heat the mustard seeds over moderate heat, swirling, until they crackle, about 2 minutes. Transfer the seeds to paper towel lined plate. Meanwhile, place the ground veal and raisins in a bowl and add the bell pepper and vinegar. Stir just to mix. Season with salt and pepper and stir in the mustard seeds and 1/4 teaspoon of the cayenne pepper. Spread the veal mixture on a foil lined baking sheet. Roast, stirring once or twice, for about 1 hour. Stir in the remaining cayenne and the allspice, making sure it dissolves. Cool, cover and refrigerate until cool all the way through. Cooks' note, to roast dry red peppers, preheat oven to moderately hot and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the roasted red peppers on paper. Roast the vegetables for about 20 minutes, or until the skin is soft and black. Turn and roast for 30 minutes longer or until well roasted. Remove and cool on a rack, skin side up, before slicing. Keep oven on.

title: Bok Choy Lasagna (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 bunch bok choy ( trimmed, washed, and cut into 1-inch slices ) | 1 can whole low-fat, low sodium beef broth, undiluted | 12 lasagna noodles, cooked, rinsed in just cold water | 1/3 cup dry aged teabags, to coat | 1 -2 teaspoon instant minced mushroom-style tea, i use knorr, if available ( optional )
instructions: Cook bok choy in 1 cup of the broth until tender. Drain off broth. Chop leaves and set aside. Coat a 9 by 13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Fill a medium saucepan with water, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Meanwhile, cut and discard rind from a carrot.

title: Maggie's Prussian Trout
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh asparagus, chopped | 1 head baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 2 heads baby baby red potato, chopped | 12 slices fresh horseradish | 2 pounds fresh trout fillets, fillets cut into portions
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place asparagus, mushrooms, potatoes, horseradish, and trout onto aluminum foil on a baking rack. Bake in the preheated oven until asparagus is crisp tender and potatoes and tomatoes are tender, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,lemonade concentrate,yellow onion,cumin,beef bouillon cube,portabella mushroom,ginger powder,oregano
title: Low Fat Chickpea and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour ( near east brand does not work well ) | 1/3 cup yellow onion ( chopped, i use pre-chopped yellow onion ) | 4 portabella mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1 lemonade concentrate ( can use light or regular ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 teaspoon oregano | 1 dash ground cumin
instructions: Drain any excess moisture from mushrooms. Combine all ingredients, except mushrooms, in crock pot and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours. Stir in mushrooms.

title: Okinawa Egg York Baskets
ingredients: 6 egg yolks | 3 tablespoons mirin | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a pot on medium high flame. Beat well with a whisk. Cook until the mixture thickens. Transfer to a greased bowl. Leave to cool to room temperature. Cut egg halves in halves if it cools too quickly. Brush with warm water.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,accent seasoning,green bean,dark sesame oil,tomato paste
title: Steamed Green Beans With Garlic and Oil
ingredients: 1 quart corn oil | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 2 tablespoons accent seasoning | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 lb fresh green beans, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend lightly. Steam for 2 to 3 minutes or until oil turns bright green and becomes clear. Discard any remaining oil.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,chickpea,chili pepper flake,tuna steak,rice wine,farfalle pasta
title: Pan-Fried Tuna and Chickpeas With Farfalle Pasta
ingredients: 300 g farfalle pasta | 2 tuna steaks, 4cm thick | 400 g chickpeas, rinsed dried | 1 small chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup fresh tomato passata ( see note ) | 1/4 cup sweet rice wine
instructions: Cook farfalle in boiling water & add 3 - 2 tablespoons oil. Tip as pasta is steaming turn so often & cook until tender. Drain farfalle & rinse. Set aside.. Heat 2 tablespoon oil in a heavy based frying pan, add tuna. Fry over medium high heat for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring often. Sprinkle with passata & add chickpeas. Cook 3 mins stirring often. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil & pasta. Toss well, add sweet rice wine & toss. Serve when pasta is ready.

Random Ingredients: rose water,apricot preserve,dijon mustard,chili garlic sauce
title: Apricot Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup apricot preserves | 1 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce | 2 teaspoons rose water
instructions: In large bowl, mix preserves with dijon, chili garlic sauce and rose water. Store, covered, in refrigerator.

title: Crispy Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 large mushroom ( cleaned, stems removed and caps cut into pieces no larger than mushrooms ) | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley
instructions: Fill a small skillet with water and bring to a boil. Place the mushrooms in the boiling water and boil about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. When cool, roughly chop the mushrooms and set aside. Add the parsley to the mushrooms and toss to coat. Place in a clean bowl and stir in the parsley to serve or refrigerate.

title: Makrouta (Soup Powder)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken | 1 1/4 cups orzo pasta | 1 1/4 cups amaretto | 1 vanilla bean, split | 3 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Cut chicken into 10 chunks, removing fat and skin. Reduce heat, and simmer until chicken is cooked and whiteened through, about 45 minutes. While the chicken is cooking, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add orzo, and cook until slightly al dente, about 7 minutes. Drain orzo and reserve the cooking liquid. When chicken is cool enough to handle, chop meat into 1 inch cubes. Place all of the ingredients, except the orzo, in a food processor, and pulse until finely chopped. Add orzo and pulse until well mixed but not liquefied. Add enough of the reserved cooking liquid to attain a soupy consistency you want. Use the reserved cooking liquid as needed to attain a smooth consistency. Serve, or refrigerate your soup at this point for up to 1 week.

title: Spanish Halibut
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets, 1/2-inch thick ( or 1 1/2 lb. sea bass ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped candied citron
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 f. Using a sharp knife, cut two 1/2 inch wide slits through top side of each fish. Insert 2 fillets. Cover with a little water. Place in preheated 450 f oven for 15 minutes. Place the remaining fish on top of the fish. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Meanwhile, sprinkle slits in a small skillet and cook over medium high heat, stirring, until browned, about 2 minutes. Stir cherries into the skillet. Sprinkle fillets with citron. Serve with a crisp tossed green salad.

title: Habanero Chicken
ingredients: 375 g chicken breast fillets, cubed | 6 -8 tablespoons tobasco sauce | 1 habanero pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a frying pan and simmer on heat until the breast is cooked and the sauce is reduced to thicken. Serve hot with jasmine rice and salad.

title: Roast Pork and Vegetable Toasts
ingredients: 4 lbs red potatoes | 8 ounces fresh whole wheat flour ( regular flour can be used ) | 1 small orange peel, finely chopped | 1/4 lb fresh breadcrumb
instructions: Cook the potatoes in boiling salted water for 12 to 15 minutes, or until tender. Drain the potatoes, cool slightly, and slice into 3/4 inch thick rounds. Make the topping, add the flour and pease, mixing well. Add the orange peel and the bread crumbs, mixing well. Spray a baking sheet with oil. Spread the vegetables on the baking sheet in an attractive pattern, about 1/2 inch thick. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Spread both sides of the pork slices with the topping. Bake on the rack for 15–20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Mexican Pulled Pork
ingredients: 5 pounds boneless pork loin, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 cups pecans, coarsely chopped | 2 whole jalapeno chiles, chopped
instructions: Cook pork pieces in boiling water to cover 10 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside. Pour the bouillon into a resealable plastic bag. Add pork and shake to coat. Refrigerate, covered, for 4 hours. In a medium skillet, grind pecans and jalapenos in a food processor. Drain pork and pat dry with paper towels. Arrange in a shallow 1 quart baking dish in a ring around the pork, overlapping slightly. In a medium saute pan, combine remaining pecans and remaining jalapeno mixture, bring to a boil over moderately high heat, cook without stirring, until golden, about 3 minutes. Remove bread from bag. Place bread on a rack in a shallow pan. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Bake pork in preheated oven until well browned, about 1 hour.

title: Mini Philly Pastry Triangles
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1/2 cup graham cracker, finely crushed
instructions: Place thawed pastry sheets in a bowl with a bit of warm water. Using a fork, rub the graham cracker crumbs under the surface of each sheet. Use a clean dry fork. Place crumbs on a clean, dry sheet of pastry and cut into 4 strips. Place a teaspoon of graham cracker crumbs in a pastry bag. Push a chunk of pastry onto the graham cracker crumbs and press the crumbs into the crumbs till well covered. Repeat with 2 more fingers and half the crumbs. Place these fingers of graham cracker crumbs on a sheet thats been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray and place in the freezer for about 20 - 30 minutes. When you are ready to bake this, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove your pastry from the freezer and using the tines of a fork, poke holes all over the pastry, the graham cracker should come out easily. Spray the baking sheet lightly with pam and place pastry in the oven. Bake for 10 minutes, then remove from oven and let cool. Continue with your next steps until all the pastry is gone to make small fingers, then spoon out filling into mini ice cube trays.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,wheat bread,haddock fillet,soy yogurt,picante sauce,golden raisin,apple cider vinegar
title: Fish and Chips
ingredients: 3 lbs haddock fillets, cut into 3/4-inch thick slices | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 3/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin soy yogurt | 1 tablespoon picante sauce | 1/2 cup shredded sesame-seed bread | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a dutch oven over medium high heat, sprinkle both sides of each piece of fish with vinegar. Cover, cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until fish flakes easily with a fork. In a large bowl toss fish with yogurt, picante sauce, sesame seed bread and raisins. Arrange fish in a single layer on an unprepared baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes, until fish is done.

title: Grilled Halibut
ingredients: 1 lb halibut fillet, skin on | 1/4 cup amaretto | 3 chipotle chiles, canned with 1/4 cup juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Brush on salmon. Cook over hot coals for 16 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Guinness Pork Laddle Beer - Beer Can Drunken
ingredients: 2 lbs pork belly | 4 ounces plain yogurt | 1 cup guinness beer | 1/2 cup beer
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°f remove skin and bones of pork and discard. Pour the beer onto a large plate and cover the meat with the beer. Place in the oven and bake for 2 hours. Remove meat from the oven and allow it to cool completely before slicing. Place the pork in a beer can. Fill the pot with beer and let it sit at bottom of can for a few hours. Fill the beer can with beer and let it sit for another hour. Place slices of pork on a clean, dry towel and blot off the dry towel. Dip the pork into flour and then dip in beer. Fry in a little bacon fat until golden brown on all sides. The beer can is a great way of adding flavor from the beer can with the toppings below. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coriander,tomato green chile pepper,white vinegar,pepperoni,romaine lettuce,kiwi,bay leaf,vegetable broth
title: Hot Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable broth, or more if needed | 3 kiwis, peeled & finely diced | 1/2 cup chopped coriander | 1/2 ripe tomato and green chile pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground pepperoni | 1 bay leaf | 1 romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and shredded
instructions: Place the vegetable broth in a saucepan over medium low heat. Cook kiwis and cori in hot broth until warmed, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,fava bean,chili paste,canola oil,chicken breast half,fettuccine pasta,dark chocolate
title: Crispy Chilli Chicken and Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 chicken breast halves, chopped | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 400 g frozen fava beans, defrosted | 400 g basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 100 g dark chocolate, chopped | 500 g fettuccine pasta, cooked
instructions: In a wok heat oil over high heat until hot but not smoking. Add chicken and chilli paste and stir fry until chicken is cooked. Remove from wok. Increase heat to high and stir fry beans for 2 minutes. Add rice, stir through and remove from wok. Stir fry chocolate in the wok and allow to melt. Return chicken and chilli mixture to wok and add noodles and fettuccine pasta. Cook fettuccine in boiling water and drain. Serve with extra fettuccine if desired.

title: Chicken in Syrup (Frying Chicken)
ingredients: 1 frying chicken ( preferably a whole chicken ) | 1/2 cup of dry meat ( not ground )
instructions: Wash chicken thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels, then line with white cloth and put under a preheated 300°f oven for one hour. Remove cloth and discard. Pour off any juice that clings to its walls. Turn chicken over. Turn oven down to 350°f. Bake chicken for 1 hour, then turn over and bake an additional 45 - 60 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Grilled Beef Tenderloin With Espresso  Dip  Recipe
