ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin ( about 3/4-inch thick ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 12 ounces hot strong coffee | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar or 1 teaspoon tamarind flavored liqueur | 1 minced seeded jalapeno chile
instructions: In large metal container, combine coffee and vinegar. Add the sliced chile.

title: Parmesan Oil
ingredients: 8 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 1 ounce vodka, chilled if possible
instructions: Pour the chilled vodka over the parmesan cheese, then shake, shake, shake, shake, shake. Pour into a tall glass and serve.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,beef broth,parsley leaf,dark soya sauce,grain white rice,swiss cheese,roasting chicken
title: Chicken and Rice Parcels-Puff Pastry and Cheese - Easy!
ingredients: 1 jar roasted chicken, drained | 1 medium roasting chicken | 1 cup long grain white rice ( i use basmati rice ) | 1 can beef broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons light soya sauce | 1 tablespoon dark soya sauce | 1 sheet puff pastry ( ready per package instructions ) | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese, plus more for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Remove the chicken meat from any skin and roughly chop into small pieces. Place the chicken pieces into a plastic bag. Pour in the beef broth and allow it to come to a boil. Remove from the heat and add 2 tbsp of the soya sauce to the chicken. Allow to cool until slightly warmer. Remove the chicken meat from the bones and roughly chop it. Place onto a sheet of pizza dough or parchment paper, or the parchment paper used to wrap the dough around the chicken pieces. You can also use the back of a spoon to press the dough down to slightly less than 1/4 inch thickness. Allow the dough to rest for 10 - 15 minute then cut in half. Use the same method as for the chicken and rice, leaving a 1/4 inch border around the edges for a lid to seal. Place the 2 halves on a parchment covered baking sheet. The edges will overlap each other and you will end up with a double layer of dough. Place the dough that you have lined the baking sheets on top of each other over the chicken covered chicken, in two slashes about 1 1/2 inches deep. Make sure the dough is evenly distributed so that it is about 1/2 inch deep. Carefully lift the pastry dough up and press on the edges of the dough to seal. If necessary, repeat this process to get the two halves to meet. Use a pastry brush to paint the tops of the pastry with soya sauce and lightly sprinkle the cheese over each. Place on top of the double layer of dough. Place in the oven and turn when the edges of the crust become very light golden, about 20 - 25 minutes. Slice into squares or diamonds. You can also make 2 stacks of 2 layers using up to 2 - 2 1/2 times. When the parcels are done, remove from the oven when they are golden brown and sprinkle on additional cheese. Serve with your favourite dipping sauce, such as ketchup or mustard.

title: Tuna Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin, cut about 1 inch thick on the diagonal | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons grand marnier or 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh orange juice | 2 cans tuna packed in oil, drained very well, undrained | hot sauce, splash | 2 tablespoons prepared guacamole | ice
instructions: Cut beef steak lengthwise into 1 1/2 inch wide strips | 1/4 inch thick. In a 2 1/2 to 3 quart freezer bag, combine beef, garlic and grand marnier. Seal and freeze 3 to 4 hours or until mixture is firm. Drain tuna.

title: Homemade Pizza Sauce
ingredients: vegetable oil | 1/2 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon meat, minced ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil in a small saucepan over medium heat, and stir in the oregano, red pepper flakes, and meat. Remove from the heat, and stir in the leftover oregano. Cover, and allow to cool to room temperature. Use if desired.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,onion powder,baking chocolate,dark molasses,chipotle chile adobo,tomato green chilies,salt black pepper
title: Mexican Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 3/4 cup italian dressing | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper, or to taste | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 canned chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | 2 tablespoons dark molasses | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 3/4 pound bittersweet baking chocolate
instructions: Combine italian dressing, molasses, salt, pepper, onion powder, chipotle chile, molasses, diced tomatoes with green chilies, and baking chocolate in a blender.

Random Ingredients: pork fillet,baking powder,chili paste,flat leaf parsley
title: Nigerian Baked Pork Fillets
ingredients: 4 pork fillets ( about 750g each ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin or 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder or 1 1/2 teaspoons coarse cooking cajeta | 1/4 cup chili paste ( sambal oelek )
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c or 140°c if fan forced. Place pork fillets in ovenproof baking dish and sprinkle with cumin or cardamon seeds and baking powder. Roast for 25 - 30 minutes until browned. Meanwhile, heat chilli paste in microwave safe bowl on high for 1 2mins, stirring to ensure it does not burn. Stir into pork. Serve.

title: Spiced Mushrooms in Brandy
ingredients: 2 cups cremini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Wash the mushrooms and slice them in half. Put them in a bowl with the cinnamon and leave in the fridge until your guests arrive.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,chipotle chile adobo,white vinegar,beef bouillon cube,vegetable oil cooking spray,barbecue sauce,eggplant,sultana
title: Tasty Fried Eggplant With Pepper & Chipotle
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup sultana ( optional - increase to 1/3 cup ) | 1 large red bell pepper, cut in thin strips | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons red bell pepper, minced | 2 tablespoons chipotle chile in adobo, minced
instructions: Cut eggplant in half lengthwise, removing stem and seeds. Spray nonstick pan with olive oil spray, place eggplant over medium heat. Cook eggplant until the skin has blackened and blistered. Turn the eggplant over and spread eggplant out flat to dry on a clean towel. Set on the towel to absorb excess oil. When eggplant is dry, transfer to a plate and let cool slightly. Remove the skins then tear eggplant into strips with your hands. Set sultanas aside. Meanwhile, heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium high heat. When the oil is hot, saute diced red pepper strips for 3 minutes or until they begin to sweat. Remove from skillet and cut into strips, then add to skillet with sultanas, bell pepper strips, and chipotle peppers. Pour in barbecue sauce and add beef bouillon cubes. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add in roasted eggplant, cover and cook for 5 minutes or until eggplant is soft. Remove from heat. Sprinkle on minced chipotle pepper.

title: Garlicky Halibut With Cream and Variations
ingredients: 1/2 pound halibut | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Rub halibut with cream, and set aside. Place the halibut on the prepared baking sheet, and brush with remaining cream. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until light brown.

title: Diane's Smokies
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes | 1/3 cup wine, such as sauterne | 1 can soymilk | 1/4 cup port wine ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot or skillet, place all ingredients except the wine into a high to boiling and boil until the cabbage is tender, about 10 minutes. Remove the cabbage from the heat and pour off liquid into a clean pot. Dissolve the bouillon cubes in the liquid, then cool mixture slightly. Use the pan liquid as a base for this dish.

title: Green Lentils, Beet and Mushrooms Fritters
ingredients: 4 ounces canned shallots, diced | 1 ounce fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 ounce green lentil | fresh ground black pepper | 4 large cooked beets, slices
instructions: Drain the lentils well and return the lentils to the pan. Add the shallots and mushrooms to the lentils and season well. Serve with freshly grated pepper and a slice of beet.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,spaghetti sauce mix,corn,orange juice,clam,coriander seed,fajita seasoning mix
title: Spiced Fish and Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 4 cloves garlic, crushed | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 8 skinless chicken thighs | 10 tablespoons fajita seasoning mix | 3/4-inch bottle spaghetti sauce mix | 1 can sliced clams | 1 can corn, drained
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine 1/2 cup of orange juice, 4 cloves of crushed garlic, and coriander seeds. Place chicken thighs in the mixture. Place in a resealable plastic bag. Combine fajita seasoning, spaghetti sauce mix, and clams or clam juice. Pour over chicken. Seal bag and refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes. Remove chicken from the mixture to a clean dish. Cut chicken up into bite sized pieces. Discard marinade.

title: Baked Carrots
ingredients: 1 kg carrot, cut into match stick size, about 5 medium size, cut very thin | 1 teaspoon ground mace ( or more )
instructions: Arrange carrots on a buttered 23cm x 23cm baking tin. Sprinkle with finely ground mace or more of italian spices or mixed spices of choice. Sprinkle with finely chopped sweet potato slices. Bake in a pre heated oven, 200°c/400°f/gas mark 2 for about 35 minutes, or until all carrots are tender and coloured. Remove from baking tin and allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,extra tofu,ha avocadoes,rice wine vinegar,sage,green bean,habanero
title: Yummus With Habanero Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb extra firm tofu | 1 head green beans or 1 head butter beans, cut diagonally into 1 inch pieces | 8 habanero, peppers ( about 1/2 lb. each ) | 1/4 lb cremini mushroom, chopped | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried rubbed sage | 2 extra-large ripe hass avocadoes, seeded, peeled and chopped
instructions: Trim the tofu and cut into 1 inch cubes. Peel and chop the habanero chiles. Place in a bowl. In another bowl, combine the mushrooms, vinegar and sage and toss. Drain the tofu, reserving the broth, cut into 1 inch cubes and add them to the bowl, along with the chiles, and toss thoroughly. Place the avocado in the bowl with the tofu. Toss. Let stand 15 minutes and serve the greens at room temperature.

title: Caribbean Ginger Roasted Yellow Sweet Pepper Pizza
ingredients: 2 red hot yellow peppers | 1 orange | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1/2 cup pizza sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Mix all the ingredients together in a covered roasting pan. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Serve with the traditional taco style salsa.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,yellow onion,cashew,sun tomato oil,creme fraiche,burger
title: Grilled Cashew Burgers
ingredients: 180 g sweet hamburger | 1/2 yellow onion, finely chopped ( or grated ) | 20 g creme fraiche | 20 g sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped finely | 1 fresh green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup cashews, flaked
instructions: Preheat a barbecue or griddle over medium high heat. Toast the cashew nuts for 5 minutes or until golden brown, and set aside. Combine the burger, onion, crème fraîche, tomato, chopped chili, and cashew nuts on a plate and shape into 4 burger thick thick patties.

title: Black Beans With Brandy
ingredients: 1 lb black beans, cleaned and washed
instructions: Wash and pick over the beans until dry. Place them in a deep saucepan, cover them with cold water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, bring the beans to boil and reduce the heat. Simmer the beans until cooked, about 1 hour. Drain the beans and return them to the saucepan. Add brandy and heat gently until the brandy is completely incorporated into the beans. Turn off the heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,beef tenderloin,kalamata olive,pumpkin,icing sugar,german chocolate cake mix,quinoa
title: Brioche Greek Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1 box greek yogurt | 1 box german chocolate cake mix | 1 cup ground pumpkin | 1 cup crumbled german sweet chocolate | 1/4 cup finely chopped pitted kalamata olive | 2 tablespoons icing sugar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 degrees f. Place beef in a roasting dish that is big enough to accommodate a single layer of meat. Combine yogurt and cake mix. Mix well. Spoon meat into the pan and smooth top. Bake 45 minutes, or until done. Meanwhile, combine pumpkin, sweet chocolate, olives, and gelatin. Sprinkle evenly over meat loaf. Cool 20 minutes. Cut into 4 slices and arrange on a serving dish.

Random Ingredients: rose water,red curry paste,walnut,italian herb seasoning,beef chuck,seasoning salt,walnut half,margarita mix
title: Slow-Cooker Beef Nuts
ingredients: 2 cans margarita mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon hot red curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 3/4 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of excess fat and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons water | 2 tablespoons rose water or 2 tablespoons asian fish sauce | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped walnut halves
instructions: Mix margarita mix, italian seasoning, curry paste, seasoned salt and half and half in a bowl.

title: Applesauce and Lamb Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb shoulder | 1 liter strained applesauce
instructions: If meat is lean, then freeze for 30 minutes before cooking to solidify. Wash the lamb and pat dry using paper towels. Cut into 5mm cubes and place in a ziploc bag. Add applesauce and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 220°c place lamb in a large ovenproof dish with a lid. Pour some appleauce over meat and then cover with the lid, cooking in oven for approximately 2 hours. If you need to, remove lid and continue cooking to your liking.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,vanilla sugar,red chile,saffron,ginger,mustard seed,italian dressing
title: Hot Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup italian dressing ( i prefer kraft family italian dressing ) | 1 teaspoon ginger | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon crushed saffron | 1/4 teaspoon ground red chile | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon powdered sugar ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients, except powdered sugar, in a food processor. Blend until completely blended. Dressing should be thick and smooth. Store covered in refrigerator.

title: Champinones Rellenos (Breaded Mushrooms)
ingredients: 2 lbs new mexico chiles, stemmed | 3 cups fresh breadcrumbs | 2 lbs small white mushrooms | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | 1/2 teaspoon new mexico chile powder | 2 tablespoons store bought breadcrumbs
instructions: Place the chiles in a bowl of cold water. Place the water in a large skillet and bring to a boil. Place the chiles in the boiling water and reduce the heat to a simmer. Add the chopped mushrooms to the simmering water. Cook the chiles until they have begun to soften, about 5 minutes. Drain and transfer the chiles to a wide mouth bowl. Stir in the peppercorns, mexico chile powder and the 3 cups of bread crumbs until combined. Add 1/2 cup of the fresh bread crumb mixture, and mix well. Add the remaining 1/2 cup fresh bread crumb mixture and mix well. If the mixture is too dry, add a few tablespoons of the remaining bread crumbs. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Roll 1 tablespoon of the cheese mixture into a ball, place in the refrigerator and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight. Serve with the remaining cheese mixture.

title: Fried Coconut Dip With Romesco Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dried sweetened flaked coconut | 1 1/2 lbs fresh ricotta cheese, at room temperature | 2 egg yolks | 1/3 cup water | 3/4 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons of chopped fresh chives
instructions: Place coconut in a large, heavy skillet. Toast coconut over medium heat, stirring occasionally until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and let cool. In a large bowl, combine ricotta cheese, egg yolks and water. Stirring vigorously until blended, slowly add salsa. Add coconut and chives to ricotta mixture. Transfer to a glass or porcelain baking dish and chill in refrigerator until chilled, about 1 hour. Serve with rye crackers.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,tuna vegetable oil,turmeric powder,orange juice,cumin seed,hamburger,gold tequila,plum sauce
title: Grilled Tuna Cabbage and Blackjack
ingredients: 3 tablespoons orange juice | 4 plump hamburger, cut into 2 pieces and crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 4 teaspoons gold tequila | 1 1/2 teaspoons plum sauce | 1 bunch cabbage, chopped | 1 tablespoon tuna in vegetable oil
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the orange juice and next 5 ingredients. Add cabbage and combine well. Coat casserole dish with oil. Toss tuna in vegetable oil with tomato paste, and pour over cabbage mixture. Cover, and refrigerate, for 2 hours or overnight. Remove fish from marinade and grill over medium coals, 5 minutes per side at a high setting, adding some juice as needed. Serve with cilantro, if desired.

title: Simple Beefy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 pound ground chuck | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato pieces, chopped
instructions: Heat the mustard seeds in a skillet over medium heat until the seeds begin to pop, about 3 minutes.

title: Sweet Veal Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 pound ground veal | 1/4 pound ground sirloin steak | 1/4 pound salami | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise extract | 3 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Break the sirloin steak into pieces about 1 pound each, and gently poke the meat with a fork. Sprinkle the sirloin with 1/4 cup confectioners' sugar, and top with a few slices of salami and finally a sprinkling of anise extract. Place rolls on prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 160 degrees f, 7 to 8 minutes. Cool and chill in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,dark soy sauce,cauliflower floret,french bread italian,confectioner sugar,butter
title: Cauliflower Cheese Canapes
ingredients: 1 package frozen cauliflower florets, thawed | 1/3 cup butter | 1 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1 loaf french bread or italian bread, cut into 8 slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the cauliflower in a steamer basket or a large saucepan with enough water to come half up the sides and the cauliflower. Bring water to a boil and add the cauliflower and cook until just tender enough to flake with a fork, about 2 minutes. Drain and plunge into a bowl of ice water. Repeat with the remaining cauliflower and water, then drain and pat dry. Bring butter, sherry, dark soy sauce, and confectioners' sugar to a boil in a skillet over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and gently stir in the cauliflower. Fry the bread until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes each side, then transfer to a serving plate. Cut an x in top of the toast.

title: Griddled Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg salmon fillets, skinned | 6 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Preheat grill to high, and line a large baking mould with aluminum foil. Cut out 12 3cm x 3cm squares of foil, each about 14cm x 1 1/2cm. Place half of the salmon on half of the foil, and top with rice. Repeat with remaining salmon, rice and foil. Spoon remaining filling onto each piece of foil. Wrap tightly to make four parcels. Grill parcels for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked though.

Random Ingredients: black bean,ketchup,italian bread,cooking spray,blood sausage morcilla,orange peel,italian parsley
title: Italian Sausage and Bean Bake
ingredients: cooking spray | 12 thick blood sausage morcilla ( white-meat meat removed from casings- i buy pre-sliced links in the meat aisle ) | 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained ( black beans may be substituted ) | 1/2 tablespoon ketchup ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped italian parsley | 2 teaspoons finely chopped orange peel ( optional ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh italian parsley, leaves from 1/2 bunch ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Remove casing from morcilla casings and discard. Brush casings with oil, place on non stick baking sheet. Bake until beginning to crisp, about 6 minutes, remove from oven and set aside. Spray both sides with cooking spray. Cut morcilla in half lengthwise and sprinkle with salt, if desired. Place cut side down in microwave safe bowl. Cover and microwave on high for 7 to 8 minutes, rotating half a 90 degree angle every minute or so until meat reaches 165 degrees, stirring every minute or so. Spread black beans evenly in the bottom of baking pan. Remove casing from microwave and spray remaining 2 teaspoons oil. Return morcilla halves to microwave oven, rearranging each pair of halves. Top black beans with remaining ingredients in bowl and stir. Sprinkle with parsley, if desired, and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until cooked through, stirring every so often. Sprinkle with orange peel before serving.

title: Swiss Steak Steaks Au Poivre-Crepes Au Poivre-Dijon!
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs lean top sirloin steaks or 4 1/2 lbs top tenderloin steaks | 2 teaspoons green peppercorns or 2 teaspoons allspice | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 cup fat-free broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Mix all the marinade ingredients in a dish. Add the meat and turn to coat. Place the meat in a pan and top with sauce. Bake for 15 minutes. Turn heat down to 350f and bake another 15 to 20 minutes, or until desired doneness is achieved.

title: Tortilla Dessert
ingredients: 120 g baby spinach ( baby greens leaves ) | 150 g sultanas | 1/4 cup thousand island dressing ( for australians ) or 1/4 cup thousand island dressing ( for americans )
instructions: Toss the spinach leaves and sultanas into the dressing as desired.

title: Grilled Hawaiian Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 2 large chicken thighs | 1 can pineapple rings | 6 mint leaves | 1 cup chocolate syrup
instructions: Coat the inside of two 12 x 9 x 2 inch sheets of reynolds aluminum foil with nonstick cooking spray. Using a fork or long handled fork, prick each side of the chicken with a fork several times and place in a gallon size zipper bag, turning over once to get the chicken to spread out. Cover and refrigerate for a total of 24 hours.. Remove chicken from marinade and drain. Place pineapple into a food processor and chop finely. Place chicken on work tray and bake in oven at 450°f for about 10 minutes or until meat is no longer pink and juices run clear. Let cool slightly and remove chicken from the oven if desired. Cut the reserved 1/2 inch of meat from bone. Cut into 1 inch slices and place in large bowl. Pour chocolate syrup over the chicken, turning to coat. Let sit 15 minutes. Spoon the sauce onto plates. Place a toothpick through the center of each slice. Serve with additional chocolates or fruit. Variation,. For a twist, add a 1 cup of crushed pineapple and some chopped, diced pineapple on top with each slice of chicken.

title: Apple Bithin Dressing  for Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 3/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup gorgonzola or 1/4 cup other blue cheese | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1/2 cup gorgonzola, for sprinkling
instructions: Heat your oven to 400 degrees f. Sprinkle salt into a small baking pan. Bake for 30 - 45 minutes or until a thermometer reaches 165 degrees f. Let cool and place in a jar with the vinegar and cheese. In a measuring cup, combine the cider and gorgonzola. Pour into a small saucepan and cook over low heat until the cheese melts, stirring constantly, about 6 to 8 minutes. Cool the mixture and pour over the salad. Sprinkle the cheese over the salad and serve. Note, preparation time does not include refrigerating the salad and giving it several hours to fully blend the flavors before serving.

title: Hungarian Peanuts (Sultskopse)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups white flour, sifted | 1 lb roasted peanuts, shelled ( not a coarsely chopped variety ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 cup finely ground unsalted dry-roasted peanuts
instructions: Adjust an oven rack 8 inches from the heat. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Prepare a baking sheet. Put the flour in a large, resealable plastic bag. Make a well in the middle, add the peanuts and marjoram and mix together until well blended. In a small bowl, make a well in the middle. Add the peanuts and pound with a rolling pin until thoroughly mixed. Pour mixture into the well, shaking the bag vigorously until most of the flour has been absorbed. Remove the bag tightly from the bag and scrape the nuts from the bag with your fingers into the well. Dough will look slightly sticky. Put dough in a large round, oval shaped cookie sheet. Gentle peel off the white crust and cut the pastry into squares. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes, until crisp and browned. Turn out onto a rack and cool. Store in an airtight container. Nuts will keep up to a week when well opened.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,garlic clove,ladyfinger,cannellini bean,beef steak,red apple,flat leaf parsley
title: Lazy Italian Chicken Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef steaks, trimmed and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup chopped parsley | 8 garlic cloves, chopped | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 red apple, cut into cubes | 2 large ladyfingers, split in half lengthwise | 3 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | roasted sweet potatoes, for garnish
instructions: Combine meat, parsley, garlic, cannellini beans, apple and 8 whole ladyfingers in casserole dish. Cover and bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes. Remove lid and bake an additional 20 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Sugared Caramelized Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 3 ounces unsweetened baking chocolate ( or half an ounce of unsweetened milk chocolate ) | 3 lbs chicken thighs ( about 2 1/2 thighs )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Coat a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with no stick cooking spray. In a saucepan, melt the chocolate, stirring constantly with a fork. The chocolate will melt completely and the chicken skin will darken slightly, but will not change color. Coat the chicken with chocolate, cut it crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices, then set aside. Arrange half of the chicken in the dish, and top with remaining chicken. Spread remaining chocolate over the top. Bake on middle rack of oven and bake until chicken is browned and crispy, about 35 to 45 minutes, or about 20 to 25 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,black olive,vanilla essence,half cream,plain yogurt
title: Creamy Black Olive Pastries
ingredients: 2 ounces plain flour, sifted | 2 ounces half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( or flavour of your choice ) | 14 ounces black olives, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 1/4 cups low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Place flour, cream and vanilla essence in a bowl, add olives and stir well. Sift over yoghurt and mix well. Turn onto a lightly floured work surface and shape dough into a 30cm x 20cm patty. Chill for 20 minutes. Pre heat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Heat a frying pan on the stove top, spray lightly with oil, then add patties. Cook until golden, about 4 - 5 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Tortilla Chips with Cointreau Cream
ingredients: 10 -12 tortillas, depending on size | 8 ounces cream cheese | 7 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1 can cottage cheese | 1 -2 potato, sliced into strips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Line baking trays with parchment paper. Mix together the cream cheese, cointreau and cottage cheese. Take tortillas and dip them in the cream cheese mixture. Place them on the baking trays and flatten slightly. Bake on the middle rack of the oven for 10 - 15 minutes until the top is light brown. Turn the oven off, leave the tortillas in in there and leave until all the cheese is melted. Allow to sit for 8 minutes.

title: Thai Sourdough Starter for Canning
ingredients: 8 cups sourdough starter | 1 stalk lemongrass, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, blend sourdough starter with lemongrass. Cut off ends, trimming the tough stalks. Stir in about 1/4 cup water to achieve the right consistency to rinse liquids out of the starter. Cover, and refrigerate at least 8 hours or up to 6 days before using.

Random Ingredients: shallot,rhubarb,italian tomato,sirloin tip roast,fish sauce,tomato paste
title: Shanan's Slow Cooker Pho
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast, trimmed ( about 3 pounds ) | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/4 cup chopped shallot | 1 can italian stewed tomatoes | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 cup frozen rhubarb, thawed
instructions: Place beef in the slow cooker. Mix tomato paste, shallot, stewed tomatoes, fish sauce, and the juice from tomatoes into the slow cooker. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover and cook on high setting 5 - 6 hours or on low setting 10 - 12 hours, until meat easily shreds easily. Transfer to a cutting board and shred using two forks. Skim off fat remaining in the slow cooker. Remove beef mixture to a bowl and mix with reserved juice. Use as a dip for noodles.

title: Bourrage Steak With Mace and Brandy  (Kebab Barg)
ingredients: 2 pounds chuck steaks | 2 tablespoons light baharat, divided | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the baharat in a small skillet over medium high heat. Rub the baharat all over the steaks. Place steaks in the hot pan, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,crouton,polska kielbasa,kosher salt black pepper,linguine,adobo seasoning
title: Pumpkin Smoked Kielbasa and Linguine #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb polska kielbasa, cut into 1/2 thick pieces | 24 cups leftover pepitas ( pumpkin puree ) | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning ( from a packet ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt and black pepper | 1 lb linguine | 1 can pumpkin puree ( not pumpkin pie filling )
instructions: In a large pot of salted water bring to a boil and add the pumpkin purée. Once at a boil add the kielbasa in pieces along with 1 tablespoon of adobo seasoning, 1 teaspoon kosher salt and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Reduce the heat to low and simmer very slowly for about 15 minutes, until the kielbasa is soft and most of the water has evaporated. Meanwhile cook the linguine al dente according to package directions. Drain the linguine and then add it back to the pot with all of the pumpkin puree. Remove the pot from the heat and toss a bit of the sauce in with the linguine. Place in refrigerator until ready to serve. This step should take 1 to 1½ hours if the mixture is too liquid to serve with the pasta.

Random Ingredients: molasses,almond,pepper sauce,golden caster sugar,cayenne pepper,topping,pearl onion,chili paste
title: Aarsi’s Crunchy Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups natural yoghurt | 2 teaspoons molasses | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 cup frozen pearl onions | 1/4 cup sliced almonds | 1/4 cup golden caster sugar | 1 teaspoon molasses | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried sweet chili paste or 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup frozen chopped pecans
instructions: Whisk the yoghurt with the hot pepper sauce, onions, almonds, sugar, molasses, hot pepper, cayenne and chili paste or hot sauce, and pecans in a small bowl to mix. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour. Before serving, shake to mix.

Random Ingredients: greek seasoning,cremini mushroom,pancetta bacon,yellow squash,sesame oil,corn tortilla
title: French Onion Squash Wraps
ingredients: 1 zucchini, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 yellow squash, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1/2 pound cremini mushrooms, halved | 1 tablespoon greek seasoning, plus more for seasoning | 2 -4 tablespoons sesame oil | 12 large corn tortillas, torn into 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a bowl, mix all the ingredients, except the tortillas, together. Spoon some of the mixture into a tortilla, and roll up. Place the wrap seam side down on a baking sheet. Drizzle with more sesame oil, and bake for 7 to 10 minutes, or until the tortillas are hot.

title: Pear Dessert
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can sweet corn kernels, rinsed and drained | 1 can sliced ripe pears
instructions: In small bowl, stir together cream of chicken soup, canned sweet corn kernels and sliced pears. Serve in shallow serving dish.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,cranberry,fish sauce,salt pepper chicken,coconut oil,bay leaf powder
title: Nepalese Salad With Coconut-Cranberry Dressing
ingredients: 1 pint sweet cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup diced dried cranberries | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cherries ( i used craisins, you may also use dried cranberries ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon salt and pepper, as required | 1 tablespoon coconut oil
instructions: To make dressing, place all ingredients in a food processor and blend to a creamy consistency. To make chicken salad, place cherry tomatoes in a bowl of warm water and soak until plump, about 20 minutes. Place cranberries in a bowl and add 1/2 of the cranberries and mix well. Drain cherry tomatoes and add to bowl. Remove tomatoes from water. Dice into small pieces and add to bowl. Place remaining cranberries in separate bowl and add to bowl. Remove and discard bay leaf and add fish sauce. Dice cherry tomatoes into small pieces and add to bowl. Place remaining cranberries and cherry tomatoes in separate bowls and toss with dressing. Serve hot or cold.

title: Toffee-Eidog and Baked Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 400 g beef, cut in slices | 200 g knockwurst | 500 g lamb, cut in slices | 35 g teas | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 6 lettuce leaves | 2 oranges or 2 other oranges, juice of | 80 ml gin
instructions: Marinade with orange juice and cocoa for 2 hours. Place lamb, beef and knockwurst on skewers and grill for 20 minutes. Remove from skewers and serve. To serve, place lettuce, oranges & gin on plate and top with beef and beef kebabs. Pour orange juice over or serve as required and decorate the top with lime leaves.

Random Ingredients: french bread,pepper sauce,fish sauce,chunky peanut butter,caper
title: Peanut Sauce for Vietnamese Seafood Sandwich Toasts
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 tablespoon pickled peppecap pepper sauce | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | crusty french bread or bread
instructions: Measure the peanut butter into a bowl and stir in the remaining ingredients until well blended. The sauce will appear somewhat thin. Spread onto the bread slices, dipping them first in the peanut butter, then in the sauce, coating them well. This dish works best when the bread is served with fish steamed or steamed veggies.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,purpose flour,salad oil,pea carrot,clam juice,rice,oyster sauce,beet
title: Prawn and Clam Salad With Fried Rice
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 1/2-3/4 cup peeled finely diced beets or 1/2-3/4 cup finely chopped beet | 1/2 - 3/4 cup rice, uncooked | 3/4 - 1 cup peas and carrot, finely chopped | 1 -2 1 -2 cup frozen cooked clams in water ( canned in water can be used to measure ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons salad oil | 4 -6 tablespoons cider vinegar | 4 -6 tablespoons bottled clam juice
instructions: In a large bowl, toss shrimp, vegetables, and parsley with flour and salad oil. Toss with rice. Add clam liquor, clam juice, vinegar, or other flavorings to taste.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,xanthan gum,bulk italian sausage,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Baked Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 2 pounds bulk italian sausage | 1/4 cup xanthan gum | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the cauliflower in a large bowl. Mix in the sausage and xanthan gum. Spread the mixture into an 8x8 inch baking dish. Sprinkle monterey jack cheese over the top. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown and crumbly, about 45 minutes.

title: Kiwifruit and Cream Cheese Jaffles
ingredients: 150 g cream cheese | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled
instructions: Beat cream cheese, coconut milk and kiwifruit, until smooth. Cook until cheese is melted and starting to turn dark. Remove from heat and let cool on a wire rack.

title: Peach Cheese Hummus
ingredients: 1/2 cup peach jam | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon cubes | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 cups crushed ice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill for 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: salsa,caribbean sauce,mint leaf,kosher salt,tortilla,italian salad dressing mix
title: Tortilla Tacos
ingredients: tortilla | 2 teaspoons italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon caribbean sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 -3 teaspoons salsa
instructions: Preheat grill. Slice tortilla in half lengthwise. Spread the prepared salad dressing mix evenly on top of tortilla pieces. Stir caribbean sauce, mint, salt and salsa together. Place on grill. Cook 4 - 5 minutes. Serve on tortillas with desired toppings.

title: Sweet Potato Candy
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds sweet potatoes | 1 1/2 cups firmly packed brown sugar | 1 cup sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook sweet potatoes in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm, about 20 minutes. Drain, and cut in half lengthwise. Remove pulp, and place cut side down in a large, shallow baking pan. Sprinkle the tops with brown sugar, and sprinkle with chocolate chips. Bake in the preheated oven until chocolate is melted, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: portobello mushroom,milk chocolate,chicken,yukon gold potato,ra el hanout spice mix,purpose flour,lemon juice
title: Chicken and Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole milk chocolate ( or dark chocolate ) | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour or 1/4 cup couscous | 1 tablespoon ra el hanout spice mix ( optional ) | 1 whole chicken, quartered or 8 pieces each ( about 2 lbs. ) | 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled | 3 cups cubed roasted chicken | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: In a small microwave safe bowl melt chocolate. Stir in flour and chocolates. Place chicken pieces in a 9x13 inch baking dish, top with the chocolate mixture, and bake 35 minutes at 400 degrees f, or until chicken is browned and the sauce is bubbling.

title: Chipped Beef Stock
ingredients: 4 cups fat-free prepared chives | 1 1/2 cups thicken stock or 1 1/2 cups beef stock | catsup
instructions: In a pan with a tight lid, stir all ingredients together. Bring to just a boil, lower heat, and let simmer for at least 1 1/2 hours, to give the beef flavor a chance to be developed. If the mixture becomes too thick, add water.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,green pepper,chicken breast half,puff pastry,arrowroot,vegetable stock
title: Chicken Pies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons arrowroot | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon green pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 2 slices boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 3-inch cubes | puff pastry, frozen thawed
instructions: Place the arrowroot in a medium bowl. Add the ketchup, pepper, and stock.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,cream celery soup,dark molasses,prosciutto,red bean paste
title: Crock Pot French Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown sugar packed dark molasses | 3 lbs beef brisket | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 can red beans paste, undrained | 8 slices thinly sliced prosciutto
instructions: Remove the meat from the brisket.

Random Ingredients: port wine,asparagus,scalloped potato mix,ginger garlic paste,saffron strand,veal,chili oil,italian seasoning
title: Beef and Vegetable Baked in Saffron Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 lb asparagus | 16 ounces thinly sliced fresh veal | 1 -2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon shaoxing port wine | 2 -6 saffron strands | 1 package mashed potatoes mix | 1 cup italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Put the asparagus in a pot of boiling water and blanch for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from pot with a strainer, and keep warm under running water. Drain water. When cool, put asparagus into a large bowl in which to keep warm. Cut your veal into strips 3/16 inch wide and 1/2 inch thick. Put 1 teaspoon of oil in a large pot, or frying pan, on medium heat. Add the ginger garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute. Add the garlic and sauté on medium heat for another minute. Add the chili oil. Add the shaoxing port, or any port wine, and add the saffron. Saute until the sauce is warm and fragrant. Transfer all the veal and vegetable mixture into the bowl with the warm sauce. Mix the prepared potatoes with seasoning, and put in a buttered 9x13 inch baking dish, making sure to stir. The potatoes will act as a preservative after getting added to the dish, so you may want to add 2 - 3 teaspoons of salt. Spread the potatoes evenly across the top of the potatoes. Cover the dish with foil, and bake for 20 - 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.

title: Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 1 medium tomatoes or can tomato sauce | 1/2 cup uncooked long grain rice or 1/2 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1 can creamed corn ( i prefer mexican corn ) | 2 tablespoons dried clams with juice | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 can mexicorn | 3/4 cup chopped cooked chicken or 3/4 cup shrimp | 1 package sliced pepperoni ( i prefer jalapeno ) | 1 package tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large skillet, heat tomato sauce until bubbly. Stir in rice and creamed corn. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Add clams, pepper and mexicorn. Simmer 2 minutes. Arrange the chicken on the bottom of a 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Top with a layer of noodles, then another layer of noodles. Top with pepperoni and some of the tomato sauce. Repeat twice ending with sauce. Cover and bake 40 minutes.

title: Italian Sausage Zucchini Bake
ingredients: 2 pounds italian sausage, casings removed | 2 pounds fresh zucchini, sliced | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup coffee flavored liqueur | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 package imitation crabmeat, chopped
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Spread the sausage onto the bottom of a large baking dish. Layer the zucchini over the sausage, then sprinkle with baking soda. Spoon the coffee liqueur over the zucchini, and top with the xanthan gum. Cover the baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven until zucchini is tender, about 1 hour 30 minutes. Uncover, and bake 10 minutes, or until the sausage juices run clear. Top with imitation crabmeat just before serving, if using.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,feta cheese,prosciutto ham,green cardamom,pinto bean,radish
title: Feta Bean Dip
ingredients: 10 ounces feta cheese | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 3/4 lb prosciutto ham, chopped | 3 green cardamoms, lightly crushed | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | radish, sliced thin ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine feta cheese, taco seasoning and ham in heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil.

title: Turnips (Chinese-style Turnips)
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips, peeled ( i prefer yellow ) | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place a baking dish in the oven and roast turnips for a minimum of 45 minutes, turning often. Do not overcook or they will be mushy. They will be dry but do not burn. When they are done, remove turnips and place in a pot, cover with water. Simmer for about 2 minutes to soften turnips and remove excess water. Turnips are done when they are fork tender. The trick is to make sure that they are done well in the middle of the pot and not too mushy. When you add the cumin and onion powder to the water they were cooked in and it is ready, deglaze with a little bit of the mixture. When the turnips are done, place them in a serving dish and toss with a little bit of oyster sauce or other asian seasoning. Serve warm.

title: Watermelon Kale Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh kale, leaves stripped from stalks | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped watermelon | 2 kielbasa sausage, cut into chunks | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons canned diced tomatoes, drained | 1 tablespoon prepared low-sodium instant coffee granules ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon prepared chopped fresh cherries
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. In a large bowl, toss together the kale, watermelon, kielbasa, tomato sauce, tomatoes, instant coffee, and 1 tablespoon cherry sauce until well combined. Place on the prepared grill, close lid, and cook about 5 minutes, or until heated through. Brush tops with remaining cherry sauce to serve.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,cornflour,velveeta cheese,lemon zest,green onion,mushroom soup,onion flake
title: Cheese Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 1 onion | 1 package of assorted fresh mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 package velveeta cheese ( any flavour is fine ) | 1 jar red enchilada sauce ( i prefer mild, but whatever is on hand is fine ) | 2 cans condensed 98 % fat-free cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 - 1 cup cornflour | 2 -3 tablespoons dried lemon zest ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried minced onion flakes ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degree fahrenheit. In a large bowl, melt one stick of velveeta over medium heat. Chop in onion. Add mushroom soup and canned red enchilada sauces stir and cook for some more. Add cornflour and mix well.. Add lemon zest and dried minced onion. Stir well. Grease an 8x9 glass baking dish. For each enchilada layer, spoon 1 tablespoon mixture into a pastry bag fitted out of the bowl. Pipe or spoon some of the cheesy cheese mixture into the middle of the rolled, rolled enchilada. Roll the side and add the remaining sauce to the enchiladas so that they are completely covered by the sauce, covering as much or as little as possible. Put in the oven and bake 45 minutes. Let it sit for 10 minutes before serving and enjoy note, the cheese will be a little firm when cooled, so be sure to let it sit for at least 20 minutes before rolling. I can also use chicken and shredded cheese. Sometimes i add a bit of jalas or hot sauce.

title: Irish Guiness Salmon Flatbread Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup sliced smoked salmon | 1/2 cup guinness stout or 1/2 cup other dark stout beer | 3 large soft tortillas | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Heat a nonstick frying pan over medium high. Add the smoked salmon and cook until it turns opaque, about 2 - 3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the salmon to a paper towel lined plate and blot it dry with a paper towel. Return the pan to the stove over medium high heat. Add the guinness and heat the mixture until it begins to boil and reduces to half. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the guiness to a small bowl. Meanwhile, warm the tortillas. To serve cut the tortillas into 3 - 4 sections and spread them on a work surface. Top each with the salmon, guiness and any remaining guiness on the side. Serve the tacos accompanied by your favorite dipping accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,vanilla essence,salad oil,red cabbage,pork loin,ketchup,italian flat leaf parsley
title: Polish Pork Loin Salad
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin | 100 ml salad oil | 200 ml salad oil | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 120 ml yoghurt or 120 ml sour cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 cup italian flat leaf parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Cut the pork loin in half lengthways and score the flesh along the scores with a knife at a 45 degree angle. Brush the flesh with salad oil, then roll the meat up on a flat plate. Slice the top half of the loaf in half lengthways. Cut the slices into slices with scissors and serve on a bed of spring onions.

Random Ingredients: cognac,chicken wing,hot paprika,mustard,chicken bouillon powder,jasmine rice,poppy seed
title: Hungarian Fried Chicken
ingredients: 5 -7 chicken wings | 1 1/2 tablespoons poppy seeds ( not dyed ) | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 tablespoon ground paprika | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 tablespoon hot paprika | 3 tablespoons cognac | jasmine rice
instructions: Wash the chicken wings in cold water and dry off the excess water. Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Place poppy and mustard in a bag, and add 2 tbsp of the paprika and 2 tbsp of chicken boullion powder. Shake well to combine. Add this to the bag along with the chicken wings. Close and massage everything close. Refrigerate for 2 - 5 hours or until chicken is done. Cook rice. Slice chicken across the grain and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,cake flour,pineapple juice,pace picante sauce,anaheim chilies,farfalle pasta,pico de gallo,green bell pepper
title: Mexican Macaroni Fritters
ingredients: 1 pismo a la pico de gallo | 2 -3 tablespoons cake flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crumbled | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1/2 large ripe ripe tomatoes, cored and halved | 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1 anaheim chilies, seeded and finely chopped or seeded jalapeno chiles | 6 ounces ground farfalle pasta or 6 ounces penne pasta | 4 ounces pace picante sauce ( optional )
instructions: Stir together the pisco and cake flour in a wide mouthed bowl. Stir in oregano and the pineapple juice until evenly combined, then set the batter aside. Stir in the tomato, bell peppers, and chiles. Fill a large pot with well salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the farfalle until it is partially cooked, about 4 - 5 minutes. Drain the farfalle and rinse in cold water, then return to the pot and add the picante sauce if using. Taste and adjust flavor with salt, if necessary. Stir well, then adjust seasoning with more salsa, if desired.

title: Italian Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 head cabbage leaf ( about a handful ) | 1/3 cup zesty italian dressing ( bottled or fresh, bottled works just as well. )
instructions: Wash cabbage leaves under cold water. Fill a large bowl with cold water.

title: Baby Bok Choy & Ricotta Gratin
ingredients: 2 -3 baby bok choy, sliced | 300 g baby ricotta cheese | 125 ml milk
instructions: Grease an oven proof dish. Layer the baby bok choy in the bottom of dish. Cover with a layer of ricotta. Repeat until all bok choy is used. In a small jug mix the milk with 50g butter and stir until the butter has been absorbed. Pour over tomato mixture in dish. Allow to cool in fridge for 30 minute serve.

Random Ingredients: mussel,mint,seasoning salt,heavy whipping cream,hot red chili pepper,sage,red wine vinegar,mint leaf
title: Spicy Mussels in Red Wine Dressing
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage, crumbled | 1/4 teaspoon season salt | 1 lb fresh mussels, scrubbed or 1 lb frozen mussels, thawed, cleaned and debearded | fresh hot red chili pepper, chopped ( optional ) | fresh mint leaves, to taste
instructions: In a bowl, combine cream, vinegar, sage, and season salt. In a large shallow pan or a heavy large saucepan, steam mussels for about 5 minutes. Place in a serving bowl. Add hot peppers and fresh mint, if using. Pour dressing over mussels and toss well to coat. Season to taste and serve.

title: Pasta with Egg Replacer and Capers
ingredients: 1 pound linguine | 1 cup peanut butter | 1 egg substitute | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1 teaspoon capers | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,cumin powder,cocoa powder,hoisin sauce,taco seasoning mix,spreadable goat cheese
title: Homemade Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 container spreadable goat cheese | 1/2 tablespoon chicken broth | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix ( from a packet ) | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 0.5 can low sodium chicken broth or ( 14 ounce ) can vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Mix together all ingredients until well blended. Place desired amount in a 9x12 baking dish, or other baking dish and cover with a small layer of meatballs. Bake for about 30 minute to flavors mingle. Serve on sourdough tortilla chips with your favorite toppings.

title: Lamb Chops With Chutney and Farina
ingredients: 600 g baby carrots, peeled | 100 g mixed dried fruit chutney | 140 g farina | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 300 g frozen lamb chops
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 1 litre/7 oz water to the boil. Add the carrots and return to the boil. Cook, uncovered, for 3 minutes. Stir in the mixed chutney to separate the carrot pieces if they are large. If they are smaller, stir them together. Meanwhile, place the farina in a large bowl, using a whisk. Add the oil. Mix until the farina is all coated with oil and the grains are well coated. Add a little of the water to the farina mixture, then mix into the farina to form a loose but firm paste. Add the lamb, then stir in the paste until all the meat is coated. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for about 15 minutes, or until the farina is cooked thick and the sauce has thickened slightly and the lamb is cooked. Towards the end of the cooking time, add salt to taste – if desired – then remove from heat. Serve the lamb chops on top of the farina mixture.

title: Spiced Nests & Desserts
ingredients: 1 bag cavatelli ( small gem or angel food cake ) | 4 ounces pecans | 1 cup sweet marsala wine | 1/4 cup sugar-free syrup | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | half-and-half ( optional ) or water ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare spiced nests using cooking spray using cooking spray. Toss with olive oil. Mix marsala, sugar syrup, almond extract and mixed spice in a bowl. Pour half and half into a small dipping dish. Dip spiced nests into the mixture, making sure the pieces are covered. Dip nests again in the warm milk or half and half mixture if using. Cook in preheated oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Pistachio Beer for Baking
ingredients: 150 g shelled pistachios | 750 ml beer
instructions: Heat oven to 160 degrees celcius. Pour out extra beer to make about 2 pints of beer. Pulse pistachios in the food processor until finely ground. Put ground pistachios into a large bowl and pour in enough beer to make a total of 3 pints. Stir well to mix.

title: Sushi Roll
ingredients: 1 cup spinach, washed and chopped | 1 cup steamed sushi rice, cooled | 2 teaspoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 300 ml tomato juice | 2 cups steamed plain flour, for rolling
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/fan 160c/gas line a baking tray with non stick baking paper. Place the cooked sushi rice, spinach, flour, vanilla and tomato juice into a large bowl. Mix well. Roll the mixture into 2 inch long sausages. Roll sausage in flour. Place on prepared tray. Repeat with remaining sausage, rice mixture and rolls. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Barley Broccoli With Chocolate and Veggies
ingredients: 1/4 cup barley | 1 bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 4 broccoli florets, chopped | 2 bananas | 2 tablespoons chocolate curls | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Soak the barley in a cup of water for a few hours. The longer the better, depending on quality of barley. Drain the barley and broth, and cut the barley and bouillon in half. In a skillet, heat 1 tbsp of margarine or butter until the foam disappears. Add the broccoli and stir. Saute until the broccoli is tender. Put all the other ingredients, except the chocabatta, into a crockpot and mix well. Add the barley and broth.

title: Tuna and Herbs
ingredients: 15 1/2 ounces fresh tuna in water, drained | 1/2 teaspoon sodium-free seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Put the tuna, salt and cilantro in a bowl and toss to combine with hands. Let stand, covered, until all the liquid has been absorbed, at least 1 - 2 hours.

title: Easy Caramelized Beer-Battered Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces dry lasagna noodles | 1 bottle dark amber beer | 1 cup cognac
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Add 1/2 of the noodles. Cook al dente. Drain. In a medium bowl, mix beer and cognac until bubbly. Transfer half of noodles to a 9x13x2 inch baking dish. Drizzle with half of beer mixture. Repeat until all noodles are coated. Bake in oven 25 minutes or until top is golden brown.

title: Quince Paste
ingredients: 6 -15 small dried quinces | 2 tablespoons finely chopped garlic paste | 2 tablespoons dried salted quince paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons allspice | 1 tablespoon almond extract
instructions: Wash and core quince. In a bowl add quince paste, garlic, allspice and almond extract. Mix well. Add enough water to paste to completely blend. Keep warm in oven or room temperature. Serve cold on bread slices, crackers or toast.

title: Spicy Cherry Tomatoes With Pistachios
ingredients: 3 large cherry tomatoes ( or 10 grape tomatoes if you can find them ) | 2 tablespoons pistachios, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh sweet red peppers, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees centigrade. Line a 2lb loaf tin with foil and place on the baking tray. Place the tomatos on the tray a half hour before they are ready to be stuffed. Place the pistachios and red pepper into a food processor and process them until they form a paste or a bit smoother. Add the brown sugar stirring until the sugar has dissolved. Dump the tomato mixture into the tin and shake the tin so all the tomatoes and peppers are coated. Sprinkle the pistachio mix evenly over the top. Place in the oven and turn the temperature down to 140 degrees centigrade. Leave the loaf tin in the oven for 90 minutes. When the tomatoes are cooked remove the tin from the oven and take the foil off the loaf tin. Cut the tomatoes and serve straight away with a loaf of your favourite bread or your favourite fillings. These are nice hot, cold and flavoursome.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,plain flour,feta cheese,red pepper,chicken,pork shoulder,dark rum,espresso powder
title: Feta Chicken With Spiced Roast Pot Roast W- Dark Rum and Feta Cheese
ingredients: 1 large chicken, whole | 2 large red peppers ( or similar combination of both ) | 1 teaspoon espresso powder ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder ( optional ) | 6 tablespoons plain flour | 2/3 cup dark rum | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 - 3/4 lb crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Rinse and remove any black or silver netting from the chickens or chicken giblets.. Wash chickens and pat dry. Sprinkle with the salt. Heat oven to 400°f. Place whole chickens on a roasting pan and place in the oven. Set oven to 160f and let chickens cook for approximately 45 - 50 minutes. If desired, remove chicken to wire rack and allow to rest at room temperature for about 10 - 15 minutes before carving. Slice the red peppers in strips and place in a microwave safe dish. If using espresso, bring the water to a boil in a small sauce pan and add the chocolate, remove from the heat. Stir until mixture becomes smooth. Transfer mixture to a microwave safe container with a lid and microwave on high until very hot for 3 - 5 seconds. Stir and microwave 1 minute more or until mixture is completely smooth and hot, or slightly thicker if desired. Pour heated chocolate onto the chicken, spread evenly on the meat, and place chicken on a rack set on a foil lined baking sheet. Let cool slightly, then serve. Slice into small thin strips and serve with red pepper strips for garnish.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,pistachio,thai red chili pepper,egg noodle
title: Chamomile Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked egg noodles ( or linguine ) | 1 ounce red chili pepper, finely chopped ( aji amarillo or jalapeno ) | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios ( or hazelnuts )
instructions: Soak noodles in hot water until soft, about 10 minutes. Drain. Place noodles in food processor, and pulse until fine. Place chili pepper in blender, and pulse until it is finely chopped. Add to noodles, and mix until well blended. Stir in anchovy paste if using. Refrigerate until cold or set. Sprinkle pistachios on top, if using, just before serving.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,snow pea,apple,candy sprinkle,egg,brown rice,lemon leaf,scallion
title: Apple Rice Salad..
ingredients: 1 cup cooked brown rice | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 large apple, peeled & cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup sliced scallion | 1/2 cup snow peas | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lemon leaves | 2 eggs, large, beaten | candy sprinkles
instructions: Steam 2 cups hot cooked brown rice until all the liquids have been absorbed. Stir in raisins, apple, scallions, and peas.

title: Spicy Swiss Chard With Curried Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes or 500 g baby potatoes | 350 g swiss chard ( about 10 oz and 2-1/2 inches long ) | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1/2 cup mild spicy chunky salsa, such as pace | 1 tablespoon capers ( optional ) | 1/2 cup mirin
instructions: Place oven rack to center position and pre heat to 400°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or baking spray. Wash and chop stems and leaves of chard, if using. Cut leaves into chard stems and set stems aside. Cut ends off chard stems and chop the stems if using. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add potatoes. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until tender. Turn potatoes halfway through. Let stand about 5 minutes. Drain and return potatoes to same pot. Slice chard crosswise into 1/2 inch wide strips and drain well. Discard all liquid in the pot. Meanwhile wash and chop leaves of chard leaves. Add chard, chunky salsa, harissa and capers if using. Stir and season with additional salt, if desired. Spoon potatoes into bowls and top with chard stems and chard leaves. Serve immediately.

title: Tropical Bread
ingredients: 1 focaccia bread | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon papaya, peeled cubed | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. Cut loaf in half, creating a total of 4 pieces. Scoop out the inside of your bread. Combine brown sugar, papaya, and chili powder in a bowl. Add the bread and coat. Bake on cookie sheets for about 15 minutes, or until toasted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: white grape juice,italian seasoning,lamb,garlic head,green,mango pulp,walnut,corn oil
title: Aussie Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, cut into 1cm cubes | 250 ml white grape juice | 250 ml mango pulp, pulp of, sliced | 125 g walnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 garlic head, mashed | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon chopped green top green
instructions: Put the lamb in a casserole dish and put in 250ml of grape juice, the juice from the mango, half the mango pulp, half the walnuts, and half the garlic. Cover and cook on the low until ready to serve with couscous or steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,vegetable oil cooking spray,herb,pepper,tortilla chip,nutmeg,garlic
title: Nuts and Bolillos
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup crushed tortilla chips | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh herbs | 3/4 cup coarsely ground peppercorns or 1/4 cup nutmeg | 1 teaspoon finely minced fresh garlic | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1/4 cup dark chocolate, melted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Mix oil and tortilla chips in a large bowl. Add all the remaining ingredients and stir until well combined. Spread on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, stirring once halfway through the cookie cook time. Break into pieces and set on a rack to cool.

title: Potatoes from the Spicy Spicy Spicy Spices
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( i like graceful ) or 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon salt ( i like graceful )
instructions: Peel and wash your potatoes. Cut into 2 x 1/2 inch pieces or so, depending on size. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over medium high heat. Add your whole spices and salt. Cook for about two minutes or until the spices begin to sizzle. While the water is coming to a boil, place potatoes in a large bowl or zip lock bag. Pour spices over your potatoes while potatoes are still hot. Leave to set for 1 hour. Add salt if desired, or serve immediately.

title: Snow Pea Cookies
ingredients: 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons egg whites | 3/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3 ounces snow peas, trimmed and rinsed
instructions: In a small sauté pan, melt the chocolate, stirring with a rubber spatula until smooth. Set aside. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form then fold into chocolate mixture to form soft peaks. Fold in salt and cayenne pepper. Drop by teaspoon full onto a lightly buttered cookie sheet. Flatten lightly with a fork. Refrigerate 2 hours or longer until set and lightly colored. Carefully remove from cookie sheet and transfer to a wire rack or paper towel lined plate to drain.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,chili pepper,cream celery soup,white fish fillet
title: Fish With Celery and Chilli
ingredients: 1 packet white fish fillets | 2 cans cream of celery soup | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 1/4 fresh chili pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a deep frying pan with lid on or grill on medium heat. Stir often until fish is cooked. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: black bean,turkey bacon,pineapple juice,broccoli floret,lettuce leaf,rice vinegar,blue cheese,vanilla sugar
title: Grilled Rice Salad With Grilled Bacon and Black Beans
ingredients: 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/4 cup blue cheese, crumbled ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 cup lettuce leaf, shredded | 2 slices turkey bacon, cooked and crumbled cooked | 1/2 cup frozen broccoli florets
instructions: Heat grill. Combine first 4 ingredients in a small nonreactive bowl. Let stand 10 minutes. Place lettuce leaves on a grill rack coated with cooking spray, grill until browned.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,american cheese,guava nectar,cannellini bean,fenugreek seed,green cardamom pod,brandy
title: Chilli Con Carne (Beef with Guava Nectar)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, about 1-inch thick, trimmed of visible fat if you want to save a pound | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 3 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 3 pods green cardamom pods, split | 12 ounces guava nectar | 1/2 - 3/4 cup american cheese or 1/2-1/2 cup edam cheese, thinly sliced
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add a generous pinch of salt, and then the beef. Boil until it has a very slight degree of resistance on one side, then turn the meat and reduce heat slightly. Remove the meat when cooked to your liking, and reserve 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid. Drain and return to the same pot. Add the canned cannellini beans, brandy, fenugreek, and half of the cardamom pods. Re boil for 1 minute to warm slightly, then remove from heat and set aside. To serve,. If you've got a wooden pick, stuff with a slice of cheese and place on top of the beef when serving. If you didn't, you may need to place a bit of the reserved meat in the pot, and add some of the reserved cooking liquid too. Serve with indian flat bread and/or spiced rice.

title: Homemade Aromatic Celery
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb celery rib | 1 teaspoon arabic spice
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Trim and separate the celery stalks. Make sure they are intact. In a cast iron skillet with a cover, add the celery stalks and the arabic spice mix. Cook over medium heat until slightly softened, about 15 - 20 minutes. Remove and drain. Store in tightly covered container, refrigerated or freeze. Note, you can substitute the celery oil with oil with cooking spray. For a smokey flavor, leave off a small amount of basting oil when cooking the celery, or you may place some on some basted chicken or vegetable oil when cooking the celery.

title: Curried French Fries
ingredients: 6 medium sweet pickle size sweet pickles | 3 tablespoons salad oil or 3 tablespoons oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry powder ( may use 2 packages )
instructions: Using a mandoline, cut the sweet pickles into very thin strips. Combine the reserved sweet pickle strips with the oil, curry and salt and pepper to taste. Arrange the sweet pickle strips on a lined baking dish. Bake at 375 degrees f.  for about 15 minutes or until they are crisp.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,swiss chard,cranberry juice,cabbage,feta cheese,pistachio,egg white,rice noodle
title: Spoonfull of Phyllo  and Vegetables W-Cranberry Sauce (Noodles)
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped cabbage | 1/4 cup chopped swiss chard ( or spinach ) | 1 tablespoon crumbled feta cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pistachios | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat sour cream or 2 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1 egg white | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon reduced-fat cereal or 1 tablespoon cooked rice noodles
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f and lightly spray 2 oven proof dishes with nonstick spray. In a medium bowl, stir together cabbage, chard, cheese and nuts. Spread evenly in dish. In a small bowl, stir together the yogurt and egg white until blended. Fold into cabbage mixture and stir to coat. Spoon into the prepared dishes. Sprinkle with asafoetida if using. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until puffed and golden brown. Serve on a plate and drizzle with low fat cereal or rice noodles.

title: Greek Seasoning for Beef
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dark brown sugar | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 1/4 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Combine brown sugar, thyme, and greek seasoning together in a bowl. Cook in a nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until sugar is dissolved and syrupy, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,lea perrins worcestershire sauce,salt pepper,cantaloupe
title: Cantaloupe With Lea & Cardamom
ingredients: 2 small cantaloupe, pared ( cut in half & de-seeded ) | 6 tablespoons lea & perrins worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 2 teaspoons coarse salt & pepper
instructions: Roast the melon or zucchini over a medium hot grill, or in a grill pan, brushing frequently with the lea & perrins worcestershire sauce. Stir gently & cook over indirect heat, stirring until the melon is tender. Meanwhile, crush the cardamom seeds with the salt, pepper & cardamom. Sprinkle over & serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lemonade,cremini mushroom,spring onion,grand marnier,parmigiano reggiano cheese,meat,macaroni,curd cottage cheese
title: Alfredo with Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 box macaroni, cook al dente and drained | 2 packages cream of mushroom curd cottage cheese or 2 packages reduced fat cottage cheese, divided | 1 cup dry curd cottage cheese, drained | 3 -4 tablespoons lemonade ( to taste, or you may use 1 t. lemon juice ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs fresh meat, trimmed and cut into cubes ( venison, turkey, beef or pork ) | 8 -10 medium cremini mushrooms, thickly sliced (, about 30 ) | 3 -4 spring onions | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. In a bowl, mix cooked pasta with 1/2 1 of the cream of mushroom curd cheese, cottage cheese, lemonade and meat. In a 9x13 baking dish, arrange layer in this order, half of pasta, half of cottage cheese/meat mixture, half of the mushrooms/spring onions, and half of the grated parmigiano reggiano cheese. Repeat two more times. Sprinkle additional grated cheese on top and bake for 40 minutes, or until meat is cooked through and vegetables are heated through. Serve with more grated cheese over top.

title: Palestinian Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, divided | 8 frying chickens | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 carton sour cream | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Place 1/2 cup flour in resealable food storage plastic bag.

title: Homemade Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb meat ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 bunch fresh flat leaf parsley, finely chopped
instructions: To prepare the meat the day before, use a sharp knife to cut the meat and mix in any ingredients of your choice. Store in an air tight container for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: green olive,russet potato,lemon juice zest,leek,beef roast,potato
title: Beef and Potato Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean beef roast, cut 3/4 inch thick | 3 russet potatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 4 leeks, white and light green parts, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup sliced green olives, about 3/8 cup | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, 1 large lemon, zest of | 3 lemons, quartered, about 1 cup
instructions: Cut off any excess fat from the meat. Cut each slice horizontally into 1/4 inch thick slices on the diagonal. Place the meat and potatoes in a dutch oven or other heavy skillet over high heat. Add all the leeks. Cover and shake pan to distribute leeks evenly around. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, partially covered, for about 2 hours or until meat is fork tender. Stir together the lemon zest and lemon juice in a small bowl. Remove meat from the pan and set aside. Skim fat from the surface of the cooking liquid and stir in the lemon infused zest and juice. Remove lid and increase the heat to medium high. Bring liquid to a boil, skimming if necessary. Ladle stew into shallow bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,pimiento,soymilk,monterey jack cheese,orange juice,fontina cheese,italian tomato,saffron
title: Paella Pan (Italian Chicken)
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup plain soymilk | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 jar pimiento, drained and sliced | 1 can crushed italian tomatoes, drained | 1 cup grated fontina cheese | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: In a baking dish, combine the chicken and soy milk and stir. Sprinkle with saffron and pimenton. Top with crushed tomatoes, fontina cheese, monterey jack cheese, and orange juice. Cover, and bake in a 350 degrees f oven 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,white onion,asiago cheese,grain rice,red chilies,italian plum tomato
title: Tomato Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole almond extract | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1/3 cup grated fresh asiago cheese | 3 fresh red chilies, seeded and chopped - or to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 1 small white onion, finely chopped
instructions: Dissolve the almond extract in the rice. Stir in the grated asiago and chiles. Mix in the sun dried tomatoes. Garnish with additional sun dried tomatoes and a sprinkling of onion.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,caster sugar,pecorino romano cheese,pasta,white wine vinegar,lime,corn tortilla,rice noodle
title: Vietnamese Street Noodle Salad
ingredients: 200 g rice noodles | 3 -4 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 180 g of drained corino romano cheese | 120 g of drained dry white wine vinegar | 2 limes | corn tortilla
instructions: Soak rice noodles in hot water for 30 minutes. Drain and dry. Mix soya sauce with 1/2 cup vinegar, sugar and 1 grated romano cheese. Add corino romano in small pieces and set aside. Drain the fried rice noodles and place in a mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well until sugar is absorbed. Taste to check if the dressing is right for you. Pour dressing over the noodles and toss well. Divide into individual bowls. Serve.

title: Indian Curry Blend
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried lemon peel | 4 tablespoons maple flavored syrup | 2 tablespoons raw cashew nuts or 2 tablespoons roasted lemongrass, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 bunch fresh kale, leaves picked and trimmed
instructions: Place in food processor or blender the peel, maple syrup, cashew nuts/lemongrass and garam masala. Blend until smooth and creamy, about 2 minutes. Cover and chill 3 hours. Place kale in large steamer over boiling water. Cover and steam over high heat, 6 to 8 minutes or until wilted but still bright green. Serve immediately with warm maple syrup.

title: Faux Mutton for Soup With Wine and Mint
ingredients: 1 small lamb shoulder or 1 small beef brisket, fat trimmed, cut into 3 | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric ( or more ) | sliced meat ( from a leg of lamb or beef, about 1 cup ) | 3 small red potatoes, cut into wedges ( about 2 ounces each ) | 2 medium cauliflower, cut into florets ( about 1 cup ) | 3 tablespoons marsala wine | 1/2 cup chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Trim meat of any excess fat. Trim and discard sinew from lamb, if available. In a wide soup pot, cover with water.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,orange juice zest,beef broth,rice flour,white bread flour,coriander root
title: Sweet and Sour Spiced Sweet Bread Pies
ingredients: 1 cup white bread flour | 1/4 cup rice flour | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon coriander root, finely chopped | 1 cup beef broth or 1 cup other canned stock
instructions: Place your bread machine in the order that your machine recommends. For best results, follow this conversion recipe directions for your machine. For a less rustic taste, leave the baking feature out. In a bowl, whisk the ingredients together. The mixture should be slightly moist, but not wet. Preheat oven to 200c. Lightly grease six small patty cases. Place 1 cup of the mixture onto your bench or baking tray. Using a spoon, stir together the flour and baking mix to make a smooth, dropping sized ball of dough. Using a rolling pin, roll out the dough in circles. Place them on the greased tins. Press the edges firmly to seal. Bake for 15 mins or until lightly browned. Cool slightly. Remove from tins and serve warm or cold. Store in an airtight container. The bread can be stored in the freezer a few weeks. Reheat in a moderate oven when needed.

title: Spinach and Rice Pilaf for One
ingredients: 500 g rice, such as arborio | 4 tablespoons margarine | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg, freshly grated | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 8 cups boiling water ( or a little more ) | 1 jar pizza sauce ( i prefer kikkoman brand ) | 3 cups baby spinach | 1/2 cup parsley, roughly chopped
instructions: If your rice is cold, use your favourite method and boil the rice for 2 minutes. Rice is ready when it rises to the surface. This could take anywhere from 5 - 7 minutes depending on the texture, but i like to just pop it back in the pot and bring it to the boil. This will make your sauce less concentrated. Meanwhile, melt the margarine in a saucepan, add the spices and cook over a moderate heat for about 4 minutes, stirring often, until fragrant. Taste for seasoning, add a little water if it is too tart, and set to one side. When done, add the rice to the boiling water and stir. Cook the rice for a minute or two more, then add the cheese sauce, spinach and parsley. Stir to combine, then serve over pasta of your choice.

title: Baked Chicken Breast With Raspberry and Artichokes
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate ( optional ) | 1 jar raspberry jam
