instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Score outside of thighs on each side of chicken breast. Dump chocates on a plate and put on cookie sheet in oven. Cook 2 minutes and remove from oven. Dump entire contents of jar onto a plate. Dump artichokes on top of chocates. Put in preheated oven at 350°f for about 20 minutes, then remove from the oven and top with dark chocolate, if using. Put back in oven until chicken is just cooked through, about 40 minutes or so.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,mini chocolate chip,pepperoni,potato starch,five spice powder,bailey irish cream,beef brisket,tabasco sauce
title: Brisket Brisket with Chocolate Chip Chips
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 2 cups salad oil | 1 potato starch | 4 fluid ounces baileys irish cream | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepper | 2 packages mini chocolate chips | 4 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. Mix together beef, potato starch, bailey's irish cream, five spice powder and ground pepper in a shallow baking dish. Bake brisket on a rack at 500 for 15 minutes, then flip and continue to bake for an additional 15 minutes. When meat thermometer registers 135°f remove from oven and cool 15 minutes. Peel the fat and discard. Slice and place on top of the brisket. Drizzle chocolate chips on top and serve.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 3/4 cup quinoa, rinsed under water well & drained | 3/4 cup cottage cheese, low-fat | 2/3 cup low-fat ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 avocado, peeled, seeded and chopped
instructions: In saucepan, place quinoa and place over medium high heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon to prevent burning. Reduce heat to low if needed. While quinoa is cooking, drain cottage cheese & crumble very fine. In small bowl, combine cottage cheese & cheese blend with garlic salt. Add cheese mixture, stirring until smooth. Add avocado & stir until coated. Serve immediately topped with toasted croutons or tostada shell.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,white flour,cornflour,white pepper,curry leaf,taco seasoning mix,romano cheese
title: Cheesy Beef Fingers
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin steak | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon grated romano cheese or 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon curry leaf ( optional ) | 10 -12 pieces ronzon cheese or 10 -12 pieces provolone cheese
instructions: Mix ground sirloin with white pepper and taco seasoning mix. Mix corn flour with cheese and spread evenly on meat. Roll meat up and secure with toothpick or tooth picks. Spray non stick frypan and cook meat on low 5 or more minutes. Serve with tomato sauce or tomato ketchup. Add shredded cheese on top of meat.

title: Beef and Cashew Nachos
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1 jar prepared guacamole | 1 can refried beans | 1 cup italian-style bread crumbs | 2 cups chopped cashews | 1 pound boneless beef top sirloin, thinly sliced | 1 package frozen mixed beans, thawed and well drained | 1 cup water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the ground beef in a skillet over medium high heat, and cook and stir until completely browned and crumbly, about 7 minutes. Drain grease, then stir in the guacamole and refried beans. Mix in the breadcrumbs. Place a piece of beef onto a piece of bread, and coat with bread crumb mixture. Spread the beef with 1/2 cup of the guacamole mixture. Place the uncooked sirloin onto the beef, and place onto a piece of re fried bean. Top with the remaining guacamole and the mixed beans, then drizzle with water. Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then cover, reduce the heat to low, and bake for about 30 minutes. Uncover the pan, and continue baking for about 40 minutes, or until beef is cooked through and no longer pink in the center. Serve on buns with sour cream and salsa.

title: Low Fat English Raisin Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 1 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c or 350°f.

Random Ingredients: spanish mackerel,new mexico chile,sultana,cod,bell pepper,tart green apple,tilapia fillet
title: Mexican Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup sultana | 1/2 cup spanish mackerel | 1/2 cup fish & vege mix ( powder ) | 1/2 cup tart green apple, diced | 1/2 cup fresh crisp bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup tilapia fillet, cut into squares | 12 crisp new mexico chiles ( or 1/2 the size of pablano peppers and 1/2 the size an anaheim peppers )
instructions: In a med. Bowl mix the first 8 and toss with fish. Cover and cool to room temperature or place in fridge until fish is cold and is just firm enough to handle. In a small bowl, mix the stew mix and the apple and stir until completely combined. Arrange on a tray lined with foil so that the foil edges dont touch and store in the freezer until required. Wash and dry your hands and cut chipits into the chips and place in the fridge until needed. Heat your bbq. Place the fish on each chip, sprinkle with bell pepper, and garnish with chilies. Grill until fish is slightly charred and the chilies are soft.

title: Mexican Cotija Bites
ingredients: 1/2 lb cotija cheese | 2 tablespoons whole white flour | 3 dried red chilies
instructions: Break the cheese into small pieces. Place the pieces in a mixing bowl. Add the flour and chiles, then form into rounds using your hands. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow the flour to absorb the flavors. You can also use a spoon, a pastry brush, or a small cookie cutter.

title: Lebanese Lentil and Peanut Soup (Hollow Soup)
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried lentils or 1/4 cup pinto beans | 1 mexican-style stewed tomatoes, diced up | 1 bunch cilantro leaf, chopped fine | 1/4 cup red snipped green olives | 1 teaspoon dried unsalted peanuts or 1 teaspoon dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Rinse the lentils and split them into two 1 1/2 to 2 inch lengths with a knife or small knife. Wash the tomato and onion well.

title: Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1 quart clam juice | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine clam juice and clam bouillon.

title: Chow Dai
ingredients: 8 ounces ketchup or 8 ounces chili sauce | 2 1/2 ounces unsweetened cocoa | 3 ounces bok choy
instructions: Dip shredded bok choy into ketchup or use other prepared ketchup. Add cocoa, chow Dai on the rim of a bamboo bamboo rolling mat. Sprinkle kasu in the middle with shredded bok choy and roll the bamboo until fully coated with the kasu.

title: My Mom's Meatball
ingredients: 4 pounds meatballs | 4 pounds shredded cheese
instructions: Prepare your meatballs according to package directions. To cook, drop your meatballs into a large pot of hot water. Remove when meatballs reach the desired texture drain, and set aside. Spray a large pot with cooking spray. Heat the pot over medium high heat. When it starts to get hot, coat the bottom of the pan with a little milk spray. Stir your meatballs into the boiling liquid, then mix in the cheese. Cook over medium heat until the cheese has melted and started to brown a little. Do not brown.

title: Jalapeno & Red Leaf Lettuce
ingredients: 1 head red leaf lettuce, washed and dried | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh jalapeno chile pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees farenheit. Place the dried lettuce leaves on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil. Sprinkle the coarsely chopped jalapeno peppers ontop. Place the aluminum foil on the cookie sheet so the excess moisture and moisture from the dried lettuce can be absorbed by the vegetables, as this will provide crisp crisp crusts. Roast in the oven for about 12 to 15 minutes or until the tops of the dried lettuce are a bit black. Allow the lettuce to cool slightly or leave in the foil until you are ready to serve them. Best as part of an antipasto by the chef that you are using.

title: Easy Baked Potato Rounds
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour ( i use all purpose flour, but all purpose flour would be fine ) | 1 cup sour cream ( lowfat or non-fat ) | 1 cup mashed ripe banana ( can use 2 or more, depending on how mushy/firm you like your potato ) | 1 can tomato paste ( i use contadina's light tomato paste. it is a bit thick, but i'm sure it's been worth the effort. ) | 1 package of your favourite mashed sweet potatoes ( i use the microwave instructions on the package but use regular potatoes ) | grated fresh fruit ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Mix all ingredients together except the potato slices thoroughly. Divide into two and pat each half into a round about 1/4 inch thick. Spray a large baking sheet with no stick spray. Spray each round with nonstick spray. Make sure one of your rounds is covered with spray. Place in oven on the centre rack and bake for 30 minutes until golden. I like to put mine in the fridge to slightly cool, but be sure to stir it every around. Don't worry if it starts to darken a little around the edges, that's okay. When cool, place a little piece of banana on top, it will be just a bit dry. Sprinkle some grated fresh fruit on top of the banana if using. Enjoy.

title: Prawns With Eggs
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon vegetarian oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chicken stock | 2 teaspoons capers
instructions: Mix parsley, oyster sauce and chicken stock together in a bowl, set aside. Heat a large non stick frying pan over high heat. Add capers and cook until they are softened and just beginning to blacken around the edge, about 1 minute. Remove capers and reserve. Pour the pan contents into the pan and stir fry for a couple of minutes. Remove from heat and stir in reserved capers. Serve with steamed rice and steamed vegetables.

title: Creamy Lime and Mango Grilled Vegetables
ingredients: 1 mango | 2 zucchini | 1 cup bottled marinara sauce ( or your favorite homemade sauce )
instructions: Peel the mango and remove the seed and membrane. Cut it into small cubes. Slice the zucchini lengthwise into half moons. Put the fruit in a microwave safe bowl and cover with water. Microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes or until just tender. Drain the water from the bowl and stir the mango with the zucchini and marinara sauce until well combined. To serve, cut veggies into slices and place in the centre of warm dinner plate. Spoon mango on top.

title: Tho Ruung Som Mel (Potato Salad With Eggplant and Clam)
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 cans chopped clams | 2 cups salad greens | 1/4 cup light coconut milk | 3 tablespoons nasturtium petals, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Heat coconut milk in dutch oven over medium high heat. Stir in eggplant slices.

title: Green Chilies for Zesty French Fries
ingredients: 500 g cornflour ( corn flour is best ) | 4 large ones, cut in half length ways and cleaned of stem | 3 tablespoons grated romano cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped green chilies
instructions: Heat oil to 325°f in skillet. Dip each piece of corn flour into oil and then into corn flour. Fry until golden brown on both sides. Remove from skillet and place in oven while still on the oven rack. When done place a piece of green chilies on cake and sprinkle with grated romano and a little bit of the green chile, serve.

title: Shrimp and Molasses-Spiced Jamaican Style
ingredients: 1/2 cup firm ripe fresh fruit | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed plus extra for sprinkling ( optional ) | 1 lb shelled and deveined shrimp ( tails on if desired ) | 1/3 cup molasses | 1/3 cup molasses | 1 teaspoon prepared whipped topping
instructions: To make a fruity sauce, gently mash the fruit with a mortar and pestle or in a bowl. Stir the chili pepper flakes, coriander seeds and shrimp in 1/3 cup cold water for 15 minutes or until shrimp are just cooked. Drain shrimp. Place remaining ingredients in a small bowl and stir to mix. Sprinkle top of shrimp with molasses or other preferred syrup. To serve, ladle about a 1/8 cup of sauce into the center of each plate, place a shrimp on top, and surround with sauce.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,parmigiano reggiano cheese,white wine,serrano pepper,lemon juice zest,adobo seasoning,venison stew meat
title: Venison Italiano
ingredients: 2 lbs venison stew meat, cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lemon juice | 6 -10 chiles or 6 -10 jalapeno chiles, stemmed | 3/4 cup white wine | 2 tablespoons minced serrano peppers or 2 tablespoons scallion tops ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried adobo seasoning | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crock pot and cook on low until meat is tender. Serve on linguine, spaghetti, or mashed potatoes. Add extra freshly grated cheese when serving if desired.

title: Spinach & Cardamom Spaghetti Pie(Spinach & Nuts)
ingredients: 1/2 lb frozen spinach | 3/4 cup tamari | 3 green cardamom pods, seeds only, cracked | 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 7 -8 unbaked pie shells
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Mix the spinach seeds, tamari and green cardamoms in a medium bowl. Set aside. Spray a 9 inch pie plate with cooking spray and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Plunge the noodles into the boiling water, following package directions. As they are done, drain and put them in the pie plate. Add 1/2 the spinach mixture, and stir to coat the noodles with the tofu mixture evenly. Set the filling aside. Pour the remaining 1/2 the spinach mixture into the dish, cover well and bake 25 - 30 minutes, until the topping is golden. Let cool a bit, and serve, or refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Fried Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 pound potatoes | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise
instructions: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and cool, then cut into wedges. Cover and refrigerate until cold, about 10 minutes. Place the mayonnaise in a small bowl, and stir in the potato wedges. Sprinkle with more mayonnaise to taste.

title: Simple Cheesy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Mix soup and cornstarch. Add water to thin. Add to soups, stirring constantly.

title: Fabulous Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 32 ounces refried beans | filling : | 3 cups cranberry sauce, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread the refried beans into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Dip fingers first into the cranberry sauce, and arrange fingers over the beans. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until bread crumbs are golden brown and bubbly. Cool 5 minutes on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: milk,beef tenderloin steak,spinach leaf,mint jelly,parsley flake,maple syrup
title: Maple Leaf Beef Florentine
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks | 1 cup whole milk | 1/4 cup dried parsley flakes | 6 tablespoons mint jelly
instructions: Mix milk, parsley, and mint jelly blend well. Coat steaks. In large skillet, brown steaks on both sides. Do not turn. Cover and keep warm for 10 - 12 minutes. Stir, cover, and keep warm for 5 - 10 minutes longer or meat can easily come apart. Place steaks on serving platter, spoon sauce on top. Serve.

title: Gravy With Hamburger, Cucumbers and Bacon
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun | 1 cucumber
instructions: Peel the cucumber and cut into four or five pieces with some of the ends still attached so they don't get sliced too small. Wipe the insides of the bun with a little water and rub the inside with some salt and pepper. Cut the cucumber into quarters or wedges. Put a bun face down onto a cutting board with the cut sides facing you. Turn the heat down so that the edges of the bun are facing away from you and they won't touch each other. Grill or broil the vegetables in the skillet or a large skillet for about 3 - 5 minutes on each side, or until done.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,balsamic vinegar,parsley,sage leaf,dijon mustard,cuban bread french,chili flake
title: French Balsamic and Chili Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried chili flakes | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | salt & fresh ground pepper | 1 loaf cuban bread or 1 loaf french bread, thinly sliced, cut in half lengthways, toasted | 12 fresh sage leaves or 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, for topping
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the vinegar, chili flakes, mustard, salt and pepper.

title: Gluten Free Bread for Coffee Break-Time
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low fat whole-milk coffee beans ( i use coffee ) | 2 tablespoons soy sauce or 2 tablespoons honey | 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla powder or 1 teaspoon almond flavoring or 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Put all ingredients in an electric blender and blend on high until a creamy paste forms. You can also use a handheld blender instead of a food processor. If you have a coffee maker, pour the paste into a warm coffee mug and top with warm coffee.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,spanish onion,chili pepper flake,beef chuck roast,lime juice,pepperoni
title: Spicy Italian Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs beef chuck roast | 2 medium spanish onions, sliced thin | 6 large jalapeno peppers or 6 large hot pepperoncini peppers, sliced thin | 16 pepperoni, cubed | 1 1/2 cups parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon lime juice
instructions: Spray slow cooker. Add meat, onions, peppers, cubed pepperoni, salt, pepper flakes, and lime juice. Cover and cook on high 2 1/2 3 hours. You can take it off the heat, and it's ready to go. Serve with tortillas or bread.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,buffalo mozzarella,chicken breast half,rye bread,tamarind chutney,banana
title: Mutt's Caribbean Chicken Sandwich with Chutney
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/8 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1/2 cup light tamarind chutney | 1 1/2 cups sliced bananas | 1 1/2 cups shredded roasted hawaiian mozzarella | 6 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly oil a medium baking sheet. Roll each chicken breast in chutney and place in the prepared baking sheet. Top each chicken breast with a slice of banana, mozzarella cheese, and a slice of rye.

Random Ingredients: white hominy,vanilla ice cream,leek,chili powder,sea bass,accent seasoning,yukon gold potato,sage leaf
title: Sea Bass Enchilada With Potatoes and Chilies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sea bass, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon acent seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 6 medium yukon gold potatoes, quartered | 4 -5 fresh sage leaves ( i like to use the entire head but leave the tail on for added flavor ) | 1 bunch leek, washed, trimmed and sliced | vanilla ice cream or sour cream | 1/2 - 3/4 cup white hominy
instructions: In a large pot on medium high heat, sear the fish pieces in a little oil until lightly browned and flaky. Remove the fish, reserving the pan drippings in the pan. Sprinkle the fish with chili powder, acent seasoning and pepper. Place potatoes into the skillet drippings and cook for 5 minutes until softened and just beginning to turn golden. Arrange the potato around the fish and scatter the sage leaves on top. Add the leeks and bring to a boil. Lower to a simmer to ensure all the broth remains moist. Cover and cook for 15 minutes. Remove the pot from the burner and let sit 15 - 30 minutes. Stir in the hominy until well combined. Serve hot with a dollop of yogurt, a sprinkle of creme fraiche or sour cream and a squeeze of lemon juice if desired.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,tamari,cream cheese,scallop,rice wine,vanilla,triple sec,mexican cheese
title: Seafood Bites
ingredients: 16 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce triple sec | 2 ounces tamari | 3/4 teaspoon vanilla | 32 ounces scallops, fresh, frozen, thawed | 1 lb phyllo dough | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f, and have the following accessories ready, a 9x13 inch pan. In medium bowl, thoroughly blend cream cheese and blend in rice wine, triple sec, tamari and vanilla. Set aside. Lay thawed scallops in a small, single layer on the bottom. Place an equal amount of shrimp lengthwise on scallops. Layer each with 1/2 of the cream cheese mixture. Continue layering, ending with cream cheese mixture. Top with remaining shrimp. Place the phyllo sheets and sheets on a cookie sheet. Brush top with melted butter and cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 35 minutes or until the phyllo is golden.

title: Beer and Noodles
ingredients: 300 -400 g wide egg noodles | 1 liter stout beer ( guinness )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, then add in egg noodles and cook according to package directions. Drain the noodles and return to the pot, and set aside. Add in guinness, bring to a boil, then remove from heat and leave overnight. The next morning, place noodles in cold water for about 15/20 minutes, according to package instructions, then drain and return to pot. This will create a lovely creamy texture. Serve and enjoy.

title: Easy Lasagna II
ingredients: 3 pounds pork pieces | 3 jars tomato soup | 1 package dry egg noodles | 1 package mozzarella cheese, cut into cubes
instructions: Place the pork in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for 2 hours. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the egg noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,pepper sauce,dijon mustard,onion soup mix,italian seasoning
title: Easy Peppered Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 tablespoons peanut oil or 4 tablespoons other vegetable oil | 1 small onion, thinly sliced | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a stockpot over medium high heat, stirring constantly until hot. Add onion & mix thoroughly. Reduce heat to medium & continue cooking until softened, about 5 minute. Pour into blender or food processor & add seasonings. Cover & blend for 1 minute until slightly thickened. This can also be made into a soup & served as a sauce, or serve as an hors d'oeuvre base for your favorite savory dishes.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,mushroom soy sauce,cherry tomato,lemon pepper,white mushroom,chocolate
title: Simple Brown Rice, Mushroom & Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup red rice such as uncle ben's | 1 cup brown rice or 1 cup brown rice ( 1 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 cup mixed mushrooms, sliced | 1/3 cup light cream or 1/3 cup cherry tomatoes, sliced and quartered, with liquid | 1/2 cup sweet soy sauce
instructions: Wash and drain the rice. Place the brown rice, salt, lemon pepper, mushrooms and cherry tomatoes in a pan with some water. Cover and cook over very low heat until the rice is cooked approximately 40 minutes. If using regular brown rice, drain and set aside. In a pot with lid over medium heat, cook the cream until it just starts to simmer. Do not boil. Add the rice to the cream and stir. Add the lemon pepper and soy sauce. Stir well. Let warm until almost hot, but still slightly wet. Serve.

title: Grilled Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon ground fresh asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon powdered new york strip steak seasoning mix or 1/2 teaspoon beef tenderizer | 1/2 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon minced onion powder
instructions: Put asafetida on a large plate, then sprinkle meat with it's seasoning. Mix together the rice vinegar and minced onion powder. Stir this into the meat, coating completely. Let rest covered at least 15 minutes so the flavors can blend.

Random Ingredients: red potato,ancho chile powder,cooking spray,lily bud,rum extract,parsley sprig
title: Lily Bowls (Lily "Biscotti")
ingredients: 1 lb small red potato ( about 8-12 servings ) | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons ancho chile powder ( about 1/2 teaspoon ) | 2 tablespoons light rum extract | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped fresh parsley sprig | parsley sprig ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Coat large rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. Cut potatoes in half and cut into 1/2 inch thick slices, lengthwise. Arrange potato slices on baking sheet in single layer. Spray surface of potatoes with cooking spray. Sprinkle with chile powder. Bake 12 minutes. Remove from oven. Brush rum extract over baked potatoes. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,orange,pork tenderloin,green bean,tart apple,cooking sherry,seasoning mix
title: Cafe Rio Pork and Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 ounce cooking sherry | 1 teaspoon seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon orange rind | 1/2 cup sliced tart apple | 1/2 cup thinly sliced green beans | 1 kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Place pork tenderloin in a greased 2 to 3 quart slow cooker. In a bowl, combine the sherry, seasoning mix, orange rind and apple.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker,artichoke heart,pepper sauce,vanilla sugar,bread,taco seasoning mix,pineapple
title: Huevos Rancheros
ingredients: 2 slices bread, cubed | 1 large canned artichoke heart, drained and chopped | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup crushed pineapple ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup graham cracker, crushed
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Stir the bread cubes or bread into a small bowl, breaking up any lumps. Stir in the artichoke hearts, taco seasoning, hot pepper sauce, pineapple, and vanilla sugar. Spoon into a broiling pan 1/2 cup of crushed graham cracker crumbs, and top with the remaining crumbs and cracker crumbs. Broil 5 - 6 inches from the heat until slightly browned, about 5 minutes.

title: Nepalese Mango Salad
ingredients: 2 large mangoes | 1 can del monte chicken stock | 1 ounce mesclun or 1 ounce pineapple leaves
instructions: Peel mangoes and cut into quarters. Boil chicken stock. Toss mangoes with mangoes to coat. Chill until ready to serve. Garnish with pineapple leaves if desired.

title: Pollo All'ami
ingredients: 1 package frozen pizza crust | 1 cup italian-style stewed tomatoes, drained | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 whole chicken wings, separated and cut into halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Roll out pizza dough thinly on a floured surface. Place dough onto a pizza pan, and spread out to the edges of the pan. Spread tomatoes evenly over crust, and sprinkle with shortening. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, until top is golden brown and bread crust is crispy all the way through.

title: Farfalle with Collard Greens
ingredients: 1 lb collard greens, rinsed and trimmed ( or spinach ) | cooking apple, peeled, cored and sliced thinly | 5 ounces farfalle pasta or 5 ounces penne pasta, cooked according to package directions ( or other small pasta ) | 2 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Wash and dry collards. In a large skillet combine collards with apples and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until collards are tender and apples begin to carmelize, 6 - 7 minutes or so.. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to package directions. As soon as mixture comes to a boil, stir in vinegar and remove from heat.

title: Cod and Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, halved lengthwise and cut into slices | 1 1/2 cups cubed salted cod | 1/3 cup sambal oelek | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1/2 teaspoon fennel
instructions: Fill a large saucepan with water. Place eggplant slices in water.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,bamboo shoot,scallion,seasoning mix,breadcrumb,iceberg lettuce,tabasco sauce,farina
title: Farina Melt
ingredients: 1 lb sliced farina ( or any other type of semi soft bread ) | 1 cup diced canned bamboo shoot | 8 scallions, chopped and lightly sauteed ( or white onion chopped too ) | 1/2 cup shredded iceberg lettuce | seasoning mix | 1 1/4 cups grated asiago cheese | 2 -3 drops tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | 2 -3 cups toasted breadcrumbs
instructions: In a large pan, add the farina or bread crumbs. While working with it, make the filling. Place sliced scallions in a small bowl with just enough water so they are easy to coat. Stir the green onions into the farina mixture. Add seasoning mix and mix well. Once the farina is mixed in, add the can of bamboo shoots and stir it in. Add the shredded asiago and toss to coat. Add the tabasco. Transfer to a greased pan and spread out evenly. Sprinkle evenly with grated asiago and bread crumbs. Add a few pats of butter or margarine on top. Grill or broil until golden brown. Enjoy warm or cold.

title: Soy Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable shortening | 0.5 package frozen spinach leaves | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 1 pinch ground turmeric
instructions: Melt shortening in a pot over medium heat. While the shortening is melting, snap off and discard the loose ends from the spinach. Drain the spinach, keeping 1 tablespoon of the water, and chop into pieces. Stir chopped spinach, tomato puree, and turmeric into the melted shortening.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,olive oil,shortening,rye bread,coriander leaf
title: Grilled Cheese Rounds
ingredients: 8 slices short crust rye bread | 1/4 cup coriander leaves, freshly chopped | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened | 1/3 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: Combine cheddar and coriander leaves in a bowl. Mix softened butter and oil together. Spread a thin layer of butter and oil mixture on 4 bread slices. Top with remaining bread slices, pressing lightly to spread remaining butter. Heat a griddle over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes, turning once. Brush griddle with oil. Place bread on the griddle. Grill sandwich 2 - 3 minutes or until golden brown. Turn sandwiches over and grill 1 minute more or and grill until golden, brushing bread with oil once with remaining butter mixture.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,chicken broth,cocoa,leek,chicken bouillon cube,confectioner sugar,no salt tomato
title: No Time Bomb Swiss Leek Confit
ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 stalk leek, thinly sliced, rinsed, and patted dry | 3/4 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 2 no-salt-added whole canned no-salt-added whole tomatoes, drained, and chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Place the chicken broth, bouillon cube, and sliced leeks in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Thai Red Curry Rice
ingredients: 500 g basmati rice | 200 ml brandy | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste
instructions: Cook the rice in a pan of lightly salted water for 12 - 15 mins or until cooked. Drain well, allow to cool and set aside to finish off cooking in the brandy. In a large pan fry the curry paste to a golden colour, then set aside. Toss in the cooled rice with the oil, adding more if you wish to make a rice dish that’s easy to mould. Pour over the curry sauce and serve.

title: Chilled Rhubarb-Rhubarb Pasta With Red Pepper Crust
ingredients: 2 slices rhubarb | 7 red peppers, cored & trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Cut the rhubarb in half lengthwise. Place rhubarb & red pepper into a large bowl & toss with crushed red pepper flakes, then chill in the fridge for 30 minutes. When ready to serve, spoon rhubarb mixture onto a serving platter & serve it drizzled with red pepper flavored olive oil & chopped fresh parsley for a nice presentation.

title: Alfredo Cheese
ingredients: 18 ounces kasseri cheese, grated | 1 1/4 cups almond milk
instructions: Mix grated cheese and milk together in a bowl. Add about an 1/3 cup of the mixture into the middle of a double boiler over barely hot water. Stir constantly until the mixture thickens and comes to a full boil. Let come to a full boil. Stir every few minutes for about 4 minutes, because the mixture will stick to a spoon. Serve over your choice of pasta.

title: Roast Beef Tenderloin With Celery
ingredients: 1/4 cup paprika | 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 celery ribs, trimmed and cut in half | 2 tablespoons paprika
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the 2 tablespoons paprika, and rub all over the surface of the beef. Place the beef into a resealable plastic bag. Add the 2 tablespoons paprika and marinate for at least 6 hours, but no longer than that. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Insert the celery halves into the trimmed meat, spaced about 1 1/2 inches apart. Sprinkle the tops with 2 tablespoons paprika. Place the meat on a rack in a roasting pan and roast in the middle of the oven for 15 minutes, to cook celery. Reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees f and continue to roast the meat until an instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the meat registers 125 degrees f for medium rare, about 20 minutes longer. Transfer the meat to carving board. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the vegetables to a warmed platter and let rest for 10 minutes before carving.

title: French White Bean Salad
ingredients: 15 ounces navy beans | 6 tablespoons cashews | 3 -5 stalks celery, chopped | 2 tablespoons white rum | 1 cup fresh celery, chopped
instructions: Cook beans overnight then drain, rinse & drain again. Toss all ingredients together adding rum& celery.

title: Aussie Pork Loin - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin roast | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup pineapple, drained and cut in cubes | 2 -3 curry leaves, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the meat and marinate in crockpot for 6 - 24 hours. Remove meat from crockpot and remove skin and fat from the roast. Place meat on grill over medium heat and cook until browned. The longer it rests, the less fat will render. Slice and serve.

title: Cumin Russets (Baked in Potatoes)
ingredients: 5 russet potatoes, peeled | 1 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Cut a 2 inch round hole in the russets and push through a sieve. Remove and discard any excess pulp. Place the russets in a large roasting pan. Add enough water to cover them completely, enough to come 2/3 of the way up the side of the russets potatoes. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour and 45 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender. If you desire to bake in a large cast iron skillet, heat the olive oil in it on medium high and fry the potatoes for 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

title: Tunisian Kefta (Greek Lamb Kabobs)
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 4 -5 kalamata olives | 1/4 cup green olives, pitted | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Mix well. Thread 4 large skewers with lamb. Broil 15 - 20 minutes each side, turning halfway through.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,red chili pepper,rosemary sprig,red cabbage
title: Red Cabbage With Roquefort Cheese
ingredients: 2 red red chili peppers, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary sprigs | 1/2 cup crumbled roquefort cheese | 1 head small red cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Line a roasting tin with foil. Stick pepper into base of each cabbage head. Remove the stems and seeds and chop finely. Mix together the chopped roasted pepper, rosemary and roquefort cheese. Spoon mixture into centre of each head. Wrap roquefort mixture in foil and bake at 180 degrees c for 40 minutes until leaves are springy to the touch and soft. Serve warm with a green salad.

title: Garam Masala Indian Style Cabbage
ingredients: 8 ounces cabbage, shredded | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons corn oil ( or other oil ) | 6 tablespoons finely minced white onions
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. When it shimmers add onion and stir fry until limp. Add the ginger garlic paste and toss well. Add cabbage and fry for 2 - 3 minutes. Add salt, pepper and garam masala. Stir fry for at least 10 - 15 minutes or until cabbage is nicely cooked and onions are tender.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,heavy cream,jalapeno pepper,kidney bean,extra virgin olive oil,sun tomato oil,fenugreek seed
title: Creamy Cauliflower Alfredo With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 cauliflower, chopped | 1 can kidney beans, drained & rinsed shopping bags | 3 jalapeno peppers, diced | 1 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons non-hydrogenated sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons fenugreek seeds | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Cook and stir cauliflower, beans, and diced jalapenos in 2 tablespoons of sunflower oil over medium heat until softened, about 5 minutes. Remove skillet from heat and add cream, 1 tablespoon of fresh oregano, and fenugreek seeks. Heat slowly until hot, whisking often until mixture thickens, about 5 minutes. Taste & adjust seasoning. Place the cauliflower mixture in a bowl & coat with sauce. Serve with freshly made italian bread or pita chips.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,chicken bouillon,bell pepper,kalamata olive,cardamom,peppercorn,potato starch,bacon
title: Lebanese Potato & Pepper Fritters
ingredients: 5 potatoes, cut into 2cm cubes | 1 bell pepper, cut into 2cm cubes | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 3 kalamata olives, chopped | 3 tablespoons potato starch | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 teaspoons peppercorns | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | salt and pepper, as needed
instructions: Place the potatoes and bell pepper into a large saucepan, add cold water, bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes. Drain off any excess water and add the bacon, olives, potato starch, cardamom and peppercorns. Return to the boil and simmer for 1 minute. Add the chicken base and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and remove from heat. Let stand for 1 minute before using. Serve warm.

title: Slow Beef Pot Roast With Sauerkraut & Fresh Herbs
ingredients: 3 lbs rump roast | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 2 cups sauerkraut | 1/4 cup fresh thai basil, chopped | 1 cup frozen pea carrots, quartered
instructions: Place roast in slow cooker. Sprinkle with rosemary, parsley, sauerkraut, and basil. Cover. Cook on low setting 7 - 9 hours. Remove roast. Skim fat from cooking juices. Stir in carrots. Heat through, about 2 mins.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,ginger garlic paste,beer,baking potato,black olive
title: BBQ Sweet Potato (Lebanese Potato) Patties With Black Olive Paste
ingredients: 8 medium baking potatoes | 1/2 cup chopped black olives | ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons beer
instructions: Peel and core the sweet potatoes and cut into wedges about 1cm wide. Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain, return to pot, mash slightly. Remove potatoes from heat and leave to cool. Combine the molasses, ginger and garlic paste in a bowl and add the yoghurt and mix well. Add the cooked sweet potato to this mixture and mix well to mix through the sweet potato. Form into 6 patties and brush or spray with oil. Bbq or fry on the bbq or in a moderate oven. Turn once.

Random Ingredients: artichoke bottom,no salt tomato sauce,pumpernickel bread,guacamole,savory,anaheim chilies,salmon,beef bouillon granule
title: Baked Salmon With Guacamole and Artichokes
ingredients: 2 cans no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1 can whole artichokes ( not drained ) | 1 can muir glen no-salt-added green chilies ( canned ) | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 1 1/2 cups pumpernickel bread, torn into small chunks | 8 ounces salmon, cut into 1 inch pieces ( or salmon fillets, skinned and boned can be used ) | salt-free guacamole ( recommended -- trader joe's ) | avocado dip ( recommended -- guacamole ) | 1/4 cup shredded savory
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray 13x9 glass baking dish with olive oil or butter spray. Using 1/3 cup tomato sauce, spread 1/3 cup tomato sauce over surface of each cap, then layer artichokes over top. Cover artichokes with remaining tomato sauce. Combine water, bouillon granules and remaining tomato sauce in a food processor.

title: Jamaican Stuffing
ingredients: 3 tablespoons light soymilk | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon minced pickled jalapeno, slices | 1 tablespoon corn ( or peas ) | 1 cup salsa | 1/2 cup seedless grapes ( or red grape ) | 4 slices white bread, cut to crumble bread | parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,cilantro leaf,pineapple juice,half,cake flour,butter
title: Pineapple Fried Cream With Coconut
ingredients: 1/2 lb butter | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 3 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: In a saute pan, melt the butter. Add the flour, cook for another minute and add the fresh cilantro, soy sauce and pineapple juice. Stir all together, then add the half and half. Keep on low heat until the sauce thickens a little but do not boil. Turn off the heat.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,cayenne pepper,pizza crust,vegetable oil cooking spray,turmeric
title: Spicy French Fries
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust, crust ( i prefer trader joe's ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 orange bell peppers ( red or green ) or 1 yellow bell pepper ( red or green )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Heat a little vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat. Spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Put 1/2 pizza dough in the pan. Sprinkle with spices and peppers. Place in oven and top with remaining dough. Place in oven. Cook for 15 minutes or until crust is golden and crispy and filling is hot.

title: French Bread With Soya Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 2 french bread, loaf | 1 package frozen cream cheese spread, thawed | 1 cup cashews, toasted, salted | 1 jar spaghetti or ( 28 ounce ) jar macaroni, drained and cooked | 3/4 cup fresh papaya or 3/4 cup canned mango, chopped
instructions: Slice the loaf about 1/8 thick and place it in a shallow baking pan sprayed with veggie spray and set aside. Combine the cashews and spaghetti in a bowl and mash with a fork. Spread cream cheese over the top of the toasted cashews and return to the refrigerator while making the topping. Preheat oven to 350°f. Spread one of the slices of bread with some cashew cream, arrange it on top of the cashew nuts. Cover with another slice of bread and spread with remaining cashew cream. Cover the bread with the third slice of bread and place on top of the fourth slice of bread and spread with remaining cashew cream. Cut the papaya into thin strips about 1 inch long and place them on top of the bread, then put some mango on top. Cover and put in the oven.

title: Peachy Peaches and Chocolate Rocky Road
ingredients: 1 lb potato, peeled, cut into wedges | 1/2 lb peach, peeled, halved, pitted, quartered | 1/4 cup cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and lightly flour a baking sheet. Place potato in a large bowl and cover with cold water. Stir well and let sit until just tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, pat dry and place in a bowl. Toss potato, peaches and soured cream in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on full power for approximately 2 mins until the chocolate has dissolved.

title: Miso Fritters (Gluté Fritters)
ingredients: 1 pound baking potatoes, peeled | 4 tablespoons miso, korean-style ( kochujang ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the potato in a large pot and cover with water.

title: Kecap Manis
ingredients: 4 tablespoons oyster sauce | 4 tablespoons poppy seeds | curry powder | 12 oysters, shelled
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan. Toss the poppy seeds in warm water. Add the curry powder. Drain the oysters and place in the frying pan. Cook for a few minutes on medium heat. Drain on paper towels and serve hot with dipping sauce. Enjoy.

title: Avocado Risotto
ingredients: 3 tablespoons egg wash, see note | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 2 1/4 - 3 cups arborio rice, cooked | avocado, sliced, to serve
instructions: Combine the egg wash and fennel seeds in a bowl, add the rice and gently stir to combine. Remove and discard half the rice, but do not dry as the rest will hold together well. Add the mixture to the remaining rice and toss to combine. Turn into a piping bag and, using a sharp, wet knife, slice each grain into 3 or 4 pieces. To serve, spread the risotto onto a large platter surrounded by a few avocados.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,coriander seed,lime,carnaroli rice,romano cheese,velveeta cheese,dark soy sauce,butter
title: Mexican Cheesebread
ingredients: 250 g carnaroli rice, cooked | 4 tablespoons butter or 4 tablespoons margarine | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | grated romano cheese | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese | 1 lime, grated zest and juice of
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Butter a 12x10 inch loaf pan, and line with baking paper. Put warm, drained rice in a mixing bowl, cover with boiling water, stir a few times until they start to soften. Drain through the fine sieve. Dry fry coriander seeds in the butter over medium heat until fragrant. Add the rice and stir to coat. Stir in the soy, hoisin sauce and the zest and juice. Spread evenly in the prepared pan. Add the cheese, turning over the top. Bake in the oven for about 15 minutes, or until firm and golden. Slice into 8 slices. Serve.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,burrito flour tortilla,tarragon,beef brisket,parsley sprig,kaffir lime leaf,lime,honeydew melon
title: Honeydew and Roasted Brisket on Mexican Flat Iron Fajitas
ingredients: 1 round pickling honeydew melon, trimmed and cut into 8 wedges ( about 3 pounds ) | 1 corned beef brisket ( about 8 pounds ) | 1/2 cup honeydew fresh parsley sprig ( italian flat leaf, plus additional for garnish ) | 2 tablespoons honeydew melon syrup or 2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 3 tablespoons harvey's dark rum | 2 tablespoons harvey's amber syrup or 2 tablespoons dark rum | 12 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Arrange whole pickling honeydew melon wedges in large heavy duty resealable plastic bag. Add corned beef.

Random Ingredients: vanilla vodka,pancetta,chili sauce,mango,herbes de provence,green curry paste
title: French Vanilla Mango Salad or "salad for One"
ingredients: 4 large ripe mangoes, peeled and sliced into rounds | 4 slices pancetta | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce chili sauce | 1 teaspoon green curry paste, more to taste | 1/4 cup vanilla vodka | 1 -2 teaspoon herbes de provence, to taste
instructions: Place a small mound of mango slices into each of 4 bowls. Place a pancetta slice on top of each slice. Drizzle the spicy green curry paste onto the mango slices, spreading it evenly. Top with 1 - 2 teaspoon of herbes de provence. Pour the chocolate syrup over the mango, and serve immediately. Variation, serve this over rice or serve in an ice cream cone for a nice dessert, with a side chilled with some of your chosen fruit.

title: Lamb and Cotija Cottage Cheese Pies
ingredients: 2 lbs ground lamb or 2 lbs ground beef | 1/3 cup cotija cheese | 1/2 cup buttermilk or 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Combine lamb, cheese, and buttermilk until well mixed. Divide mix into 24 equal portions and form into patties. Place patties on a parchment lined or greased baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until the tops are golden brown and patties are tender. Serve hot or cold.

title: Spiced Escarole Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 cup edamame, shelled | 8 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup tomato sauce, heinz
instructions: In a heavy bottomed skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add edamame, mushrooms, and tomato sauce, stir to combine and distribute evenly. Cover, lower the heat to medium low, and let steam steam cook until soft, about 2 minutes. Remove lid, cook 2 more minutes, stir, and serve.

title: Hot Pepper Dust
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coarse kosher salt ( coarse or coarse sea salt ) | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 -2 teaspoon hot sauce ( such as tabasco )
instructions: Dissolve the salt in 2 1/2 cups of hot water. Pour this mixture into a heavy bottomed, heavy duty aluminum foil or baking dish that is just large enough to wrap loosely, and add the seeds. Add enough hot water to cover the ingredients by at least 2 inches over the brine. Bring the brined brine to a simmer over high heat. Stir and simmer vigorously until the temperature is at least 180 f or as needed to dissolve the salt, about 30 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in salt. When ready to proceed, stir in the hot sauce and remove from the heat. Cool for several hours or more until the temperature is 115 degrees f, stirring occasionally. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,lime juice,tabasco sauce,orange marmalade,rotel tomato chilies
title: Easy Low Fat Lime & Orange Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1/2 cup orange marmalade
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Let sit over night for best results serve on whole wheat salad wraps or corn bread in lettuce cups or other salad leaves with fruit.

title: Kathy's Chunky Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes | 5 red chilies | 1/2 cup catsup, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the potatoes in a pan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until easily pierced with a knife. Drain, and cool, then cut into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange on a baking sheet, and spread with the catsup. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until nicely browned on the edges and heated through.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,parsley,basil,dark sesame oil,feta cheese,steak,provolone cheese
title: Poblano Pepper Steak Provolone
ingredients: 4 large poblano chiles | 1/2 cup packed fresh basil | 1/2 lb fresh provolone cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 lb fresh provolone cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 10 slices provolone cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 lb fresh thick-cut boneless steak, pounded to 1/4-inch ( or top-round ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley or 1/4 cup fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat broiler to high. Remove stems from 4 chiles and cut into strips using a vegetable peeler. Remove and discard seeds. Place chiles on baking sheet and broil 3 - 5 inches from heat, turning as needed, 3 - 5 minutes. Remove chiles from heat and set aside. Rinse chiles under cold water and drain on paper towels. Place chiles on a baking sheet and place under a broiler. Broil, turning frequently, 3 - 5 minutes or until blackened. Remove from heat and brush with a little oil. Set aside to cool. Place 2 quarts of water in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until thick, about 10 minutes. While sauce is cooling, spread 2 cheese cubes on a sheet of plastic wrap or parchment paper or foil. Top with 3 chile strips, followed by 3 more chile strips and the 2 cheeses. Broil 2 - 3 more minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbling. Remove from heat, let stand 5 minutes, then serve sprinkled with parsley or cilantro.

title: Spiedies Pockets
ingredients: 6 pita pockets | 1 cup soymilk | 1/2 cup grated swiss cheese ( i used low fat ) | 1/2 cup prune, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Divide soy milk, cheese, prunes and vanilla sugar evenly among pita pockets. Place pita pockets on a baking sheet which has been sprayed with cooking spray. Bake for 15 minutes in preheated oven, or until top is lightly golden. Serve immediately.

title: Broiled French Toast
ingredients: 12 slices white bread | herb ( optional )
instructions: Soak a slice of the white bread with herb.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,baby bok choy,banana liqueur,chili oil,graham cracker crumb,water
title: Banana Bok Choy, Pepper and Chilli Pho (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 pint small shell pasta ( such as rotini, ziti or macaroni, etc ) | 6 -10 slices peeled baby bok choy | 3/4 ounce banana liqueur | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh chili oil | 1/4 cup crunchy graham cracker crumbs ( optional ) | 7/8 cup boiling water
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Cook pasta in boiling water, following the packet instructions. When al dente, drain, mix with bok choy and banana liqueur. If desired, add chili oil and crumbs. Place pasta on a tray and top with hot sauce. Place in oven on a middle rack until heated through. Stir the garlic into sauce just before serving and remove from the heat.

title: Shiitake Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 12 shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup creme fraiche | 1/2 cup muenster cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Drain the mushrooms and cut them into tiny pieces. Heat a small skillet over medium high heat, and add the mushrooms. Cook and stir until the shiitakes release their aroma and release their color. Stir in the creme fraiche and muenster cheese. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving in small bowls.

title: Avocado Dip
ingredients: 2 avocados, peeled, seeded & diced | 1/2 lb feta cheese, crumbled | 1 can chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1 cup frozen whipped topping ( i make my own )
instructions: Chop avocados, and place them through garlic press, or mash until fine. Put all ingredients into food processor. Process until smooth. Put into serving dish. Top with a spoonful of whipped topping, or on the side.

title: Vinho Pastina
ingredients: 1 package thin cookies without crusts | 1 pinch white sugar
instructions: Place the cookies in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until the texture resembles cornmeal. Add sugar and pulse for a while until you have a coarse, fluffy dough you can roll out if you prefer.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,butternut squash,almond,colby cheese,chicken tender,garlic salt,kiwi fruit
title: Chicken Kebabs With Kiwi Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 2 cups cooked rice wine | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and diced | 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 lb chicken tenders or 1 lb chicken wings | 2 cups grated colby cheese
instructions: Slice butternut squash into 1/2 inch chunks. Place in microwave safe dish and cook on high for 3 minutes. Mix in rice wine, kiwi fruit, slivered almonds, garlic salt and chicken tender if using.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,breadcrumb,star anise,white wine,nonstick cooking spray,yellow onion,extra virgin olive oil,caster sugar
title: Onions in Palm Sauce
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry | 4 lbs yellow onions, peeled | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 1 sprig star anise | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | vegetable nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Defrost pastry on paper towels. Trim off excess pastry and unroll onto a lightly floured surface. Cut pastry into 6 portions and place each one on an ungreased nonstick baking tray. Brush the edges of the pastry circles with oil and sprinkle with sugar. Bake in a pre heated oven at 200c/400f/gas 6 for 10 minutes. Meanwhile preheat your oven's highest setting. Cut the onions into thin slices. Toss with olive oil, caster sugar, wine and star anise and allow to marinate for 20 minutes or over night. Place a portion of onions in each pastry circle and roll up until the pastry is completely wrapped. Seal the edges with oil and bake on the centre shelf of the oven for about 1 hour. Remove the pastry from the oven and brush the onion rolls with oil. Allow to drain on kitchen paper and serve with remaining onion fondue.

title: Rigatoni With Sun-Dried Tomatoes and Chocolate
ingredients: 200 g rigatoni pasta | 100 g raspberries | 150 g dark chocolate, melted | 4 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander
instructions: Cook pasta with a splash of olive oil and salt. Drain and set aside. In a large bowl, stir together the raspberries, chocolate, sun dried tomatoes and coriander. Toss well gently together until coated. Heat a large sauté pan, add the remaining olive oil and when hot, toss in the raspberries and cook, tossing, for around 3 - 4 minutes, until the sauce becomes glossy and the raspberries pop. Toss in the riggies and toss, again, for around 2 minutes. Add the chocolate sauce and toss gently. When done, toss in the pasta, stir well and serve hot.

title: Marinara with Chili Pequins, Almonds and Chiles
ingredients: 8 ounces marinara sauce | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 package chile pequins ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a small saucepan over medium heat, combine the marinara sauce, almond extract and chile pequins. Bring to a boil, and remove from the heat. Stip each stuffed chile pepper into the sauce, and place into a small baking dish. Cover with foil, and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven.

title: The Easiest Bread in the World!!
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 1/2-1 cup cornmeal
instructions: Combine all in a bowl and leave to stand for about 5 minutes. Cut into 8 wedges or pieces and bake in a 190c mark 8 deep frying pan until golden brown& crispy.

title: Tortilla Cubano
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fish stock | 1 cup buffalo mozzarella, cubed | 12 ounces sirloin, trimmed cut into thin strips | 4 teaspoons fresh dill pickles, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh sage, chopped | 1/2 cup orange rind, sliced thin | 1 cup mexican cheese, shredded
instructions: Place chicken stock. Bring to boil in medium frying pan large enough to hold mozzarella cubes in a single layer. Add mozzarella cubes and pickles.

title: Mexican Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb monterey jack cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon ground canned chipotle chiles | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange peel
instructions: Slice the cheese with the grain of 1/4 inch, then cut in half lengthwise. Open out the cheese from the top, leaving about 2 to 3 tbls. Of cheese exposed. Using a small, sharp knife, spread the center of the cheese with a thin layer of the coriander, crushed chipotle chiles, and grated orange peel. Re build the cheese with the cheese using the remaining filling, placing it slightly off center in a criss cross pattern. Let rest at room temperature, covered with foil, for 15 minutes to allow cheese to harden. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. When barely beginning to smoke, add 1/2 teaspoon oil and allow to heat for 1 minute. Add the cheese to the skillet and cook, stirring, until well coated with oil. Add the remaining 1/4 teaspoon oil in a slow, thin and slow drip stream. Cook, swirling and rotating the skillet, until the cheese just begins to brown, about 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: galangal,garlic,pistachio nut,cremini mushroom,squid,hazelnut,tomato green chilies,sea salt
title: Napa Goat's Feet Chili
ingredients: 6 large squid, cleaned, tentacles cut off, head cut off, bodies in small rings | 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chilies | 4 tablespoons dried galangal, minced | 12 whole hazelnuts | 1/4 cup shelled pistachio nuts | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 4 tablespoons coarsely chopped garlic | 1 -4 cup canned cremini mushroom, sliced
instructions: In a large soup pot, add tomatoes, galangal, hazelnuts, pistachios and sea salt. If too strong, add more tomatoes along with 1 tablespoon of water. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook for 15 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender. Serve in large soup bowls.

title: Mexican Beet Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chunky salsa, or to taste | 3 bunches fresh beet leaves, rinsed and trimmed | 1 green onion, thinly sliced | 8 slices bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat. Spread the salsa onto the beet leaves. Top with thinly sliced green onion and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,sun tomato oil,hard egg,lemon extract,pesto sauce,greek yogurt,grape tomato,onion
title: Italian Egg Bake
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1/4 cup chopped fresh pesto sauce ( store-bought or homemade ) | 1/2 cup diced grape tomatoes | 1/3 cup diced onion | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup plain fat free greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon grated lemon extract | 1/8 teaspoon grated lemon extract | pesto sauce, for serving tomatoes
instructions: Place the hard boiled eggs, 1 tablespoon lemon extract and pesto on a microwave safe plate. Microwave on high for 20 seconds. Spread the salad dressing on the eggs. Add the plum, onion and grape tomatoes in a thin layer on top of the salad dressing. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 4 minutes, stirring once. Combine yoghurt, 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract and the 1/8 teaspoon grated lemon zest in a small bowl and stir until well combined. Pour over salad in dish and sprinkle with grated lemon extract. Cover and microwave on high for 5 minutes, stir once and microwave for 2 minutes more or until eggs are set and creamy. Place under broiler. Serve garnished with additional grated lemon zest and drizzle with the extra dressing.

Random Ingredients: trout fillet,pasilla pepper,self rising flour,italian tomato,cardamom seed
title: Italian Fish
ingredients: 2 lbs rainbow trout fillets | 2/3 cup self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons whole cardamom seeds, cracked | 1 can italian-style crushed tomatoes | 1 cup shredded sweet pasilla pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400˚f. Dust the fish with flour. Arrange fish in a single layer on a roasting pan. Sprinkle with crushed tomatoes. Heat 1/2 cup of a small amount of oil in a skillet until hot over medium high heat. Saute the fish in hot oil until lightly browned. Turning once, add more oil to the skillet. Cook 4 or 5 minutes on the first side. Arrange the fish on top of the turkey. Spoon remaining tablespoon of the oil around the turkey and tomatoes. Spoon the cardamom seeds all over. Cover and bake 25 to 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 5 minutes more. Sprinkle the top and sides with the pasilla pepper. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,pork,bouquet garni,brown sugar,white flour,table cream,okra,maple syrup
title: Normandy Pork and Okra (Carbonnade)
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs pork loin or 2 1/2-3 lbs blade roast, cleaned and cut into about 1-inch thick chunks | 3/4 - 1 lb chicken cut into about 6 serving pieces ( or a combination ) | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed | 8 ounces whole-maple syrup or 2 -3 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 cups whole natural okra ( optional ) | 3 bouquet garni ( made fresh by your favorite herb, chef's choice, or use fresh thyme ) | table cream
instructions: Place the pork in a large pot of water with the maple syrup and brown sugar. Bring to a boil over medium heat, skimming any scum that rises to the surface and stirring constantly. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover and cook for about 1 hour stirring occasionally. Drain meat into a bowl, reserving the sauce. Discard the solids and keep cooking. Add the okra to the cooking broth, along with the bouquet garni in the pan. Simmer, covered, for approximately 1/2 hour, stirring occasionally and adding plenty of water as needed to keep the okra covered. Remove the okra from the pan and keep warm.

title: Onion Seasoning Seasoning (For Canning)
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Combine dry onion soup mix and mustard powder. Store in a cool. Seal jar.

title: Lebanese Chicken (Sliced)
ingredients: 1 box ricotta cheese ( whole milk works nicely ) | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in very small chunks ( or you can use thighs which are already fat free ) | hummus ( i like greek style! )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together, including the chicken pieces. Pour into a shallow pan over medium heat. Note, if it is too thick for your taste, it can be thinned with a little water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until chicken is cooked, stirring occasionally for about 20 - 25 minutes or until it has thickened a bit and is cooked through. Top with hummus before serving.

title: Beef With Chili Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, sliced into thin strips | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 can or bottle chili, sauce | 4 ounces yoghurt | 2 ounces roasted cashews or 2 ounces peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1 jar maraschino cherries, halved | 1 jar maraschino cherries, sliced ( reserve juice )
instructions: Combine beef, chicken bouillon and chili sauce in a bowl with yoghurt, nuts, cherries and 1/2 of the maraschino cherries. Cover and place in fridge to marinate for 5 hours or over night. Remove beef slices from marinade and grill on bbq. Do not overcook place marinated beef in a 9x13 inch cake pan. Pour reserved marinade over the beef and cook @ 350f for 45 minutes or till meat is medium rare.

title: Apple Ginger Sauce for Veggies or Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 apple, chopped
instructions: Mix ginger garlic paste and chopped apple to form a paste. Add some water to form a sauce. Add a dash of oil or cooking oil to your own frying pan/skillet.

title: Cherry Flank Steak (Shaladi)
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, shaved ( or very thin-cut ) | 2 cans cherry pie filling | 1 teaspoon cumin powder ( to taste )
instructions: Tie steak into one or two inch pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet and sprinkle with cumin. Place cookie sheet in freezer until it freezes. When ready to serve, remove from freezer 15 minutes prior to cooking and remove foil. Scoop out as much juice as possible from steak and place in a medium size zip lock bag. Squeeze out air from bag and place in freezer. Repeat process until all meat is used. Remove from freezer and place beef in a large skillet. Add cherry pie filling and the cumin powder. Bring to boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 30 minutes to 1 hour. Serve over prepared polenta or chapati.

Random Ingredients: marzipan,garam masala,chicken breast half,mint leaf,grape tomato,pumpkin puree,cardamom seed,red chili powder
title: Spiced Chicken with Grape Tomatoes and Chutney
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pumpkin puree or 2 tablespoons grape tomatoes, chopped | 1 teaspoon dry red chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped | 1 cup marzipan, thawed | 5 ripe grape tomatoes, cut in half | fresh dhalibut mint leaves ( to garnish ) or mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken. Toss well to coat. Place chicken in baking dish. Cover, and bake at 375 degrees f for 25 minutes. Arrange halved grape tomatoes over chicken breasts. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in center and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,tomato jalapeno,pecorino romano cheese,sea bass fillet
title: Sea Bass Chips
ingredients: 2 sea bass fillets, skin removed | 2 tablespoons freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup crushed corn tortilla chips | 2 tablespoons minced tomatoes with jalapenos, drained
instructions: Place fish in a nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle with pepper, then add 1/4 cup of the cheese. Cook over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Serve fish with chips and tomato wedges. Note, alternatively, fish can be grilled and baked under a preheated broiler for 15 minutes or until just cooked through. If desired, serve with lime wedges and salad.

title: Mustard Seed, Asparagus & Muff Vinegar
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon mustard seed, lightly roasted | 3/4 lb asparagus, woody ends broken off and the tips trimmed | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar or 1 tablespoon cider vinegar ( or other vinegar )
instructions: In a dry skillet, toast the mustard seeds over medium high heat, stirring frequently until the seeds have popped for about a minute. Remove from heat and mix in the asparagus to coat. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Stir in the vinegar and season to taste with pepper.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,oil,chili powder,angel hair pasta,pita bread,tomato,mushroom,golden raisin
title: Crunchy Salad
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta | 1/4 cup oil | 2 containers fresh salad greens or ( 2 ounce ) containers mixed salad | 2 tomatoes ( ripe ) | 1 cup fresh sliced mushrooms ( or fresh or canned mushrooms ) | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( optional ) | lettuce leaf
instructions: Boil the pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat oil in a large frying pan. Add onions and mushrooms. Cook for 5 minutes on medium high heat. Add dressing ingredients. Cook for 5 - 7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Put pasta in to a large bowl and top with salad greens. Toss gently before serving. Serve with additional dressing and crudites.

title: Barbecue Beef With Sultanas
ingredients: 600 g barbecued beef | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon sultana ( or raisins ) | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 tablespoon arrowroot | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 teaspoon sultana ( or raisins )
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients together. Thread onto skewers. Grill or grill 4 - 5 minutes until cooked to your liking.

title: Salsa con Vino
ingredients: 1 large eggplant ( about 3cm/1oz ) | 3 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c/450°f/gas mark wash the eggplant a few times in hot soapy water. Slice the eggplant lengthways into 1/4 slices lengthways. Arrange the slices on a baking dish. Combine the chilli and vinegar in a small frypan. When bubbling add the crushed chili pepper flakes and mix well. Pour this over the sliced eggplant in the baking dish. Bake at 200c/450f/gas mark 4 for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chili,red lentil,graham cracker crumb,dark soy sauce,spring onion
title: Red Lentil Pie Crumble
ingredients: 1 liter red lentil | 1 red chili | 3 spring onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon coarse graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Put the lentils in a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 45 minutes, or until soft. Drain and leave to cool. Remove the stem, seeds and strings from chilli, then finely chop. Roughly chop the chilli. Mince spring onions and set aside. Place half the graham cracker crumbs in a bowl or serving platter, add half the chilli, half the spring onions and half the soy sauce and mix well. Add the remaining graham cracker crumbs, half the chilli, spring onions and soy sauce and mix well, making sure the crumble doesn't clump up. Spoon in the lentil mixture and spread evenly. Place in the fridge for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove crusts from the bowl or platter and place crumble on top. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: navy bean,lemon peel,carrot,baking potato,garlic salt,white onion,cake flour,yellow bell pepper
title: Bean Potato Lentil Dumplings
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups dry navy beans, soak and drained ( reserve 1/4 cup liquid and discard the rest ) | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1 small white onion, peeled and diced | 1 large carrot, peeled and grated | 1 medium baking potato, peeled and diced | 1/2 small lemons peel, coarsely grated or 1/2 small lime peel, coarsely grated | 1/2 teaspoon grated garlic salt | 4 white onions, peeled and diced ( use the white parts of the onions and not the yellow ) ( optional ) | 1 large yellow bell pepper, diced ( or a combination of all three )
instructions: Day one, place all ingredients in a crockpot, cover, and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours. Day 2, remove the inner cover from the crockpot if there is any liquid that has boiled onto the top of the potatoes and vegetables, and allow to cool. Place the cold potatoes and vegetables in a bowl, and with a hand mixer, blend until fully blended and smooth. Scoop 2 or 3 tablespoons of the lentil batter, about 1 1/2 tablespoons per cup of the mixture, into the hot bowl, and toss to coat the mixture evenly. Transfer to a dish and allow to cool completely, then serve.

title: Sproof
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast, plus | 3 teaspoons active dry yeast, divided | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 12 ounces of thin sliced pepperoni | pepperoni, slices
instructions: In large bowl of a standing electric mixer fitted with dough attachment, dissolve 1 teaspoon yeast in boiling hot water. Mix in the remaining 1 teaspoon yeast with soup, thyme, remaining 3 teaspoons yeast, and pepperoni in large bowl. Beat on low speed, scraping sides of bowl occasionally, until thoroughly mixed, about 5 minutes. Increase speed to medium and beat until dough is smooth, about 6 minutes. Transfer to a greased bowl, cover tightly with clean towels, and refrigerate until chilled. Working with half the dough at a time, unroll the remaining dough and roll it into a 6 to 8 inch long round. With a 3 1/2 inch diameter biscuit cutter, cut the round and transfer to a baking sheet. Cover and let rise in a warm place until double, about 45 minutes. Punch down dough. Cut into 6 wedges. Arrange wedges, crust sides up, on baking sheet.

title: Maurice's Big Batch Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 1 lb vidalia onion, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder | 4 anchovy fillets, chopped ( optional ) | 5 1/2 cups old fashioned oats | 1 can anchovy fillets, with liquid
instructions: To make the anchovies, rinse the anchovy with your hands. Place them into a plastic bag and set aside. Combine the onion, chipotle, and chipotle powder in a large pot over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes, until the onions have softened and turned translucent. Stir in the chopped anchovies, if desired. Spread the onions and anchovy mixture into the bottom of a 9x13 casserole or baking dish. Layer the lasagna noodles on top of the the anchovy mixture. Spread the oats evenly over the noodles and top with the remaining anchovies. Spread 1 can of anchovies over the top and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes, until crumbs are bubbling. Let stand, still covered with foil, for 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: cranberry juice,fast rise yeast,romaine lettuce,kalamata olive,fish sauce
title: Cranberry-Lemon Pizza
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fast rise yeast, or more to taste | 1 cup cranberry juice | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, chopped | 1 romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn
instructions: Pour 2 tablespoons of the cranberry juice into a round ceramic 2 quart casserole dish, and sprinkle in the yeast. Cover with 2 cups of cold water, and sprinkle on the remaining 2 tablespoons of water. Let rise for 10 minutes, or until doubled in volume. Add the remaining cranberry juice, fish sauce, chopped olives, and shredded romaine lettuce. Set over medium low heat, and cook for 15 minutes, or until the pizza is slightly browned on the top. Slice into 4 serving pieces, and serve.

title: Creamy Haroset
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama | 1 bottle kahlua | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 lemon peel, grated | 1 pint half-and-half
instructions: Pre heat oven to 1/2°c in a large baking tray, put the jicama and kahlua in layers. Stir once to mix. When the dish is full pour half and half into baking tray. When cool, sprinkle lemon peel over top. Cover with aluminum foil and refrigerate overnight.

title: Persian Pumpkin Dessert
ingredients: 2 lbs large, tender pumpkin | 2 cups plain greek yogurt | 1/2 lb thick cut sliced bread with crust and middle
instructions: Place the pumpkin in a large pan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and continue to boil over low heat, covered, for 30 mins, or until tender. Drain and allow to cool. Remove skin and pith from pumpkin and place flesh in a large bowl, cut into 1/2 inch dice. Add 2 cups of yogurt and mix well. Place a thick slice of bread on each serving plate and spoon the pumpkin over the bread.

title: Mushroom Pies
ingredients: 200 g button mushrooms, sliced finely | 1 small bay leaf | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1/4 cup crunchy nutella | 2 tablespoons cornflour | breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine mushrooms, bay leaf and coriander in a bowl. Mix cornflour with cold water to form a thinner paste, and add to mushrooms, then gently stir in nutella. Fill each mushroom with the mixture, pressing lightly into tops. Set aside minimum of 2 tbsp of mixture. Sprinkle breadcrumbs on top, and serve.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,cornflour,grain rice,cardamom pod,green chili,kalamata olive,corn husk,mace
title: Kosher Kale and Rice Mix
ingredients: 3 cups light-colored cornhusks, soaked overnight in plenty of water | 1 cup medium grain rice | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom pod | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, sliced | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1/4 cup chopped green chili | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese or 1/2 cup grated vegan sharp cheddar | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated cardamom pod | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup chopped kalamata olive
instructions: Drain cornhusks and place in a large bowl. Add the 4 cups of water. Stir to mix and set aside. Dissolve the 1 teaspoon ground cardamom in the remaining 1/2 cup of cheddar and the 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod. Combine in a small bowl the cheese filling ingredients. Stir lightly with a fork until the cheese mixture is smooth and creamy and it forms a pasty consistency, about 10 minutes. Stir in one cup of the water until the filling is completely incorporated. Add the rice, the 1/2 teaspoon of ground cardamom, chiles, cheddar and 1/2 teaspoon of ground mace. Season to taste with salt and pepper and stir gently to mix well. Set aside to allow the flavors to meld. Preheat the grill for high or low and arrange the soaked cornhusks singly on the grate. Cook, uncovered, until bubbles appear around the edges of the edges, about 2 minutes on each side or until the tops are slightly charred and fragrant. Allow to set slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,wheat germ,veggie crumbles,baking potato,curry powder
title: Curried Spuds
ingredients: 1 medium baking potato | 1 small red chili pepper | 1/8 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon wheat germ | vegetarian crumbles
instructions: Wash and peel potato and cut into chunks. Place potato in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, cut chili pepper in half, remove seeds and white inner ribs, then tear into strips. Measure chili into a bowl and add curry powder and wheat germ and mix well. Add the potato chunks and stir to coat. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Transfer potato mixture to a 2 quart baking dish and sprinkle topping over the potatoes. Bake in the preheated oven until crumbs are lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: halloumi cheese,poultry seasoning,baking powder,cranberry,water,rice,graham cracker crumb,potato
title: Easy Cheesy Potato Curds
ingredients: 1 unbaked graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup water | 2 tablespoons dry instant rice | 1/2 cup chopped dried sweet potato | 2 tablespoons sliced halloumi cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 3/4 cup dried cranberries
