instructions: Place the cracker crumbs in a shallow dish. Mix cold water with instant rice until well blended.

title: Low Fat Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken legs, or 2 chicken thighs, etc | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies ( mild ) | 1 spanish onions or 1 green onion, sliced ( red onion, if your choice, you may add other vegetables )
instructions: Put a large pot of water on to boil. Put chicken in water with salt and place in pot. Once they have begun to rise from the water, place the lid on the pot and simmer for an hour. Once chicken is finished, shred chicken fat with 2 forks or fingers. Put the shredded chicken back in the pot. Cook on low for an hour, then add about 2 cups of water, or if it's not quite enough, add more rotel. Simmer for additional 20 minutes or so.

title: Spiced Raisins
ingredients: 16 ounces dark raisins | 4 large cardamoms
instructions: Soak the raisins in boiling water a few minutes until the plumped liquid has drained. Place the raisins into an extra large mixing bowl, cover with water and leave overnight. Toss the soaked raisins into a clean towel and rinse thoroughly. Place the drained raisins into an ice cream container and pour in the heated chilli liquid. Seal well and leave until a thick paste has formed, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,penne,phyllo pastry,rom tomato,butter,queso fresco,white wine vinegar
title: Penne With Tomatoes and Queso Fresco
ingredients: 24 sheets phyllo pastry | 15 roma tomatoes, small, chopped small | 5 tablespoons butter | 2 teaspoons anise seed | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 8 ounces queso fresco | 1 lb penne or 1 lb other short pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. Do not boil. Melt 3 tbs butter in a sauce pan. Add the aniseed and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until aroma is released but not browned. Watch carefully for any signs of panicking. Remove from heat and set aside. Place the tomatoes and cheese in a blender and blend until smooth. Set aside. Drain pasta and place in a warm place. To assemble, lightly brush one sheet of phyllo with melted butter. Place 1/2 cup cooked pasta on the bottom of a 13x9 inch pan, about 1/3 inch thick. Add a layer of tomatoes and a sprinkle of cheese. Repeat to build a layered, smooth top with the remaining pasta and tomatoes. Spread the remaining melted butter over the top of the queso fresco. Place in the refrigerator for 20 minutes and then remove the pan. Brush the queso fresco on top and bake for another 20 minutes. Cut into slices or triangles when cool.

title: Steak Tartlets
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 steak, trimmed of all fat | 10 sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Unfold pastry sheets and place them on baking paper. Bake on the middle oven shelf for 5 – 10 minutes until they are a pale golden colour and are a nice texture to eat. Trim steak of all visible fat or gristle. Cut into approximately 18 equal pieces. Roll out pastry to about a quarter inch thick. Place meat in the center and press lightly with the heel of your hand to flatten slightly to the shape of pastry, then place all pieces on top of the meat. Place sage leaves in the middle. Serve immediately, or allow to cool completely & enjoy later with tea, cheese or salad.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa sausage,italian breadcrumb,coconut cream,chipotle chile,milk chocolate chip,bay leaf,vanilla
title: Chipotle Creamy Kielbasa
ingredients: 4 sweet kielbasa sausage ( casings removed, with casings removed ) | 1 can unsweetened coconut cream | 2 cups milk chocolate chips | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 bay leaves | 2 canned chipotle chiles | 1 teaspoon instant vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large skillet, brown the sausage for about 10 minutes over medium heat. Once slightly browned drain, then set aside. In a large bowl, mix coconut cream, milk chocolate chips, bread crumbs, bay leaves, chilies, and vanilla. Grease the inside of a large casserole dish with cooking spray. Cut the kielbasa into 1 inch pieces, and add to the coconut mixture. Spread the mixture over the top. Cover and place into the oven for 1 hour. Remove cover, and bake for another hour or so until slightly brown on top and a bit crunchy.

title: Chinese Sesame Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thigh | 10 dried chinese sesame paste | 1/2 cup peanut oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Spray the oven with oil and preheat until smoking hot. Add chicken and stir fry until cooked and golden. Serve with steamed baby bok choy and red hot sauce for dipping vegetables.

title: Baked Beans and Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked cannellini beans, drained | 1 1/2 cups sliced green onions
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Toss the cannellini beans with 1 1/2 cups of the onions. Bake the beans until tender, 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,garlic powder,romano bean,fine semolina,cranberry,corn,chicken broth,cream mushroom soup
title: Cranberry and Cranberry Chowder
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can chicken broth | 1 1/2 cups frozen romano beans | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon fine semolina | 1 tablespoon corn | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 can sweet corn | 1/4 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Combine soup, broth, beans, garam masala, semolina, corn, garlic powder and 1/3 to 1/2 cup each of cranberries and dried cranberries using a blender, or a handheld mixer. Blend on high 15 to 20 seconds or until smooth. Heat to simmer.

title: Santa Fe Chorizo and Avocado Sausage Bake
ingredients: 2 -3 links medium sized chorizo-style links | 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/2 bag miniature store bought chocolate chips | 4 ounces ground pork | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1 ripe avocado, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray a 9 x 13 inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Slice chorizo in half lengthwise and crosswise and remove all excess fat. Place chorizo in a large bowl of cold water, set aside. Place 3 large, heavy skillet sausages in a single layer on a cookie sheet and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Place the baking pan in the preheated oven for approximately 12 minutes or until lightly browned, flipping once. In a separate bowl, combine 1/2 bag of chocolate chips, 1/2 bag of chocolate chips, ground pork, and salt. Add half of the chorizo mixture and shake together. Place the chocolate and pork mixture in the pan and stir to coat. Sprinkle the entire dish of chorizo over the top, making sure it is evenly distributed. Allow the chorizo to cook in the oven for approximately 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,meat,nutmeg,green bell pepper,vanilla flavoring,mushroom stem
title: Sweet Mushroom Stuffed Peppers (Pampered Chef)
ingredients: 2 large green bell peppers | vegetable oil cooking spray | 32 ounces ricotta cheese | 32 small fresh mushroom stems ( i've used canned mushrooms ) | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 1/2 teaspoon vanilla flavoring or 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 lb ground meat or 1 lb italian sausage
instructions: Slice off tops of peppers. Scoop out center of peppers using a spoon to leave stems 1 inch from sides of peppers. You can also use a spoon, toothpicks, etc. Place peppers in a large bowl with a lid so peppers don't pick up liquid in the bowl. Spray all exposed part of peppers with the veggie spray, then add a small spoonful or so of ricotta to the top of each chopped pepper. Carefully stuff one mushroom with a bit of ricotta, another mushroom and a bit of mushrooms, then a bit of nutmeg. Repeat with the second batch of peppers. In a skillet sprayed with veggie spray, brown meats or sausage over medium heat and drain. Mix well with meat/sausage and stuff stuffed peppers. Don't be scared, it's supposed to look that way. When done placing peppers on foil covered casserole dish, bake at 400 degreese for 30 - 45 minutes or until peppers are soft and stuffing is warm throughout.

title: Mexican White Bread Skillet
ingredients: 2 slices white bread ( cubed ) | 1/4 cup chile powder | 1 cup corn kernel | 1 1/2 cups rotini pasta ( thin )
instructions: Combine chile powder and corn kernel in microwave safe bowl, microwave on high, 20 second intervals, until hot and light brown, stirring half way through. Stir in rotini. Arrange bread cubes on plate with bread and spread with corn mixture.

title: Garam Masala (Prawn) With Cashews
ingredients: 1 kg mixed vegetables, cut into wedges ( try not to use the green colour ) | 120 ml sunflower oil | 600 g raw medium shrimp | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 3/4 cup evaporated skim milk powder | 80 g cashews, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat the oil in a non stick pan and fry the mixed vegetables for 5 minutes. Stir in the chopped shrimp, coriander and cashews. Bring to boil and simmer for 5 minutes or until the carrots are cooked and the sauce is thick. Serve garnished with a little lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: avocado,superfine sugar,yellow tomato,taco seasoning,dark sesame oil
title: Smoky Summer Salsa
ingredients: 3 cans yellow tomatoes | 2 cans diced tomatoes | 3 avocados | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Drain the tomatoes and tomatoes in a colander for about 10 - 15 minutes. When you feel they are starting to release their juices, remove from the colander and cut up into very small pieces. Place all ingredients in a blender. Mix and serve. Note, you can make this in a bowl using the same ingredients as above except use 1 1/2 tbs of sugar.

title: Beef Shrimp and Shrimp Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 pounds beef chuck roast | 20 shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Pour beef chuck roast inside a slow cooker. Remove as much excess fat as possible from the roast. Place the beef on top of the shrimp, and secure with a tooth pick. Place the slow cooker on low, and cook for 6 hours. Shrimp should no longer be floating on the top of the roast when done. Remove from slow cooker, and slice in half, and serve on hard rolls with some shrimp and other condiments as desired. These can be frozen, or reheated in a crockpot for a quick meal on the stovetop.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,sea salt,rice wine,dill weed,fish fillet
title: Linguica (Fish With Noodles)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sea salt | 2 lbs of small fresh fish fillet ( such as tilapia or cod ) | 2 1/2 cups wide egg noodles | 2 tablespoons of good rice wine | fresh dill weed
instructions: Cut two fillet lengthwise into four pieces. Set aside. Heat about 1/4 inch oil in a large sauté pan. Place one piece at a time in the frying pan and cook until brown on both sides.. Remove and reserve. Repeat with the remaining fish. Heat 1/4 inch of oil in the pan. Add fish and cook until firm. Drain. Add 1 teaspoon salt and noodles to the heated oil and toss. Add fish and any accumulated juices along with any accumulated juices. Salt to taste. Cover and simmer until the water has almost completely evaporated. Serve immediately.

title: Spinach and Almond Curry for Two
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked frozen peas | 1/2 cup chopped olive | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking cider | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 package fresh spinach ( or fresh, chopped ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a medium saucepan over high heat. Add peas and cook until thawed, about 2 minutes. Drain. Add olives to peas and set aside. Combine cider and spices and set aside. Add spinach to liquid and cook over medium heat until wilted, about 3 minutes. Add to peas and stir. Add cream and mix gently.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,red kidney bean,onion soup mix,garlic paste,stock
title: Hazel Spread
ingredients: 2 cups canned red kidney beans | 2 teaspoons dried onion soup mix | 3 cloves garlic paste | 3 tablespoons hazelnuts, finely chopped | 1 cup stock
instructions: Drain beans, reserving liquid. Combine reserved beans with the liquid into a food processor.

Random Ingredients: bitter melon,hazelnut,mustard,catalina dressing,olive oil cooking spray
title: Rojeh Kabob
ingredients: 3 bitter melon | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 4 tablespoons catalina dressing, to taste | 1 tablespoon mustard, to taste | bitter melon, to garnish | olive oil flavored cooking spray, to drizzle
instructions: Wash bitter melon and remove outer skin. Scoop out the pulp from the pits. Cut into 1/4 inch slices. Grind the bitter melon with hazelnuts in a food processor. Drizzle or spray with salad dressing and mustard, and fold into mixture. Arrange on a baking tray and bake in a 425 degree f oven for 1 hour until dry.

title: Cherry-Black Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 1 bottle pitted black olives | 1 package cherries | 1 capers, drained ( optional ) | 1 pinch coarse salt and pepper
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in large bowl that can sit at room temperature. Mix well with a fork. Transfer to glass container. Cover and chill 4 hours.

title: Prawns, Spam & Bean Mash
ingredients: 400 g smoked sausages, halved | 200 g dried red beans, cut into thick wedges | 2 epazote ( bunches ) | 1 spam ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: Steam the beans until soft. Rinse beans and then pat dry. Grind the soaked beans into a thick paste and transfer to a large bowl. Cook the sausages according to instructions on packet. Add the hot water and simmer for approx 2 minutes. Add the tamari, cayenne & epazote and gently toss until combined. Serve the mitts with a bit of black pepper. Enjoy.

title: Roasted Chilies
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oatmeal | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 3 fresh anaheim chilies, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 400 f or 218 c. Mix all the ingredients together. Transfer to foil lined 2 x 2 or a square pyrex baking tin or oven proof pan. Bake for 45 minutes until tops start to brown. Turn the oven off and allow to cool. Unfold. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,yoghurt,tomato green chilies,galangal,jalapeno chile,candy sprinkle,yogurt,pesto sauce
title: Chile Pesto With Yoghurt
ingredients: 4 large tomatoes, cut into chunks, deseeded if any | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh galangal ( thai ginger ) or 1 tablespoon cayenne chili, finely chopped ( about 1 tbls. ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/4 teaspoons finely chopped fresh jalapeno chiles or 3 teaspoons cayenne chilies, minced | 4 sprigs fresh coriander ( cilantro, about 100g ) | 1 tablespoon yogurt or 1 tablespoon greek yogurt, beaten to blend | 1 tablespoon chopped peeled fresh ginger ( about 2 teaspoons ) | 2 tablespoons chopped purchased greek pesto sauce | pisto-stuffed fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/2 slices
instructions: Combine tomatoes, ginger, chillies, parlsey and coriander sprigs in medium bowl.

title: Simple Chinese Pork
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, fat trimmed and cut into 1 inch chunks
instructions: In a skillet, mix together the dark soy sauce and dark soy sauce. Heat the mixture until the soy starts to bubble, stirring constantly. Add the pork, and cook over medium high heat for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to low, and cover the skillet. Simmer until the pork is tender and beginning to fall apart, about 1 hour.

title: Hot Italian-Style Scalloped Tomatoes and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pound cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 pound super-firm italian plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 green apple - peeled, cored, and diced | 1 package frozen italian-style plums, thawed and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread mushrooms on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until mushrooms are tender and toasted, about 12 minutes.

title: Spicy Pork and Fresh Basil Pasta
ingredients: 1 ounce dried jicama, peeled | 1 lb boneless pork loin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups heavy cream | 1 package dry penne pasta | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaf
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Combine jicama and pork in large skillet over medium to medium high heat, stirring to mix well. Cook, stirring frequently, for 8 to 10 minutes or until pork is brown on all sides. Add cream, mix well and cook, stirring frequently, 1 minute. Toss penne with sauce, and top with basil.

title: Simply Delicious French Fries
ingredients: 12 russet potatoes, unpeeled | 1 jar barbecue sauce | 1 vanilla bean | 1 cup nonfat dry milk, or more as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Wrap unpeeled potatoes in plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: miracle whip,pineapple chunk,cherry tomato,cranberry,chickpea flour,red curry paste,grenadine
title: Sweet and Savory Vegetable Pancakes
ingredients: 225 g canned chickpeas flour | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered | 1/2 cup canned pineapple chunk, drained | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon low fat miracle whip | 1 teaspoon grenadine | 2 teaspoons sweetened cherries and tomato halves, quartered
instructions: Combine chickpea flour, cherry tomatoes, pineapple chunks, curry paste, miracle whip and grenadine in a bowl. Divide between 2 pancakes. Top with cherry and tomato halves. Garnish with cherry and tomato halves.

title: Arugula With Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 lb fresh sauerkraut | vegetable oil
instructions: Wash sauerkraut well. Place in colander set over large bowl. Sauté in 350 degree f oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Place sauerkraut in colander until all liquid liquid is absorbed. Coat bottom and sides of a heavy pot with oil. Place sauerkraut in pot with sauerkraut. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until sauerkraut is soft and well flavored. Serve over noodles. Drain excess fat. If sauerkraut is to soft, cool completely before filling it.

title: Spicy Black Olive Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry mustard seeds | 4 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 can pitted black olives ( drained )
instructions: Toast mustard seeds until fragrant, watch carefully and crush with rolling pin until browned. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Store in air tight container.

title: Mexican Pepperoni Dip
ingredients: 1 packet reduced-fat taco seasoning | 4 slices pepperoni, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare the dip with taco seasoning, pepperoni and pecans. Bake dip uncovered in the preheated oven until heated through and topping is golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Baked Scones
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup red wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, sift together the flour and mix in the wine. Stir the dough lightly until it forms a dough. Lightly work with your hands, and work in just enough of the remaining liquid to bind tightly. Turn the dough onto a floured, cloth covered working surface. Pat out to a thickness of 1/4. Turn the dough out onto the ungreased sheet of baking parchment. Cut into 16 squares using a knife. Place about 1 tablespoon of scone mixture on each square. Sprinkle with a light sprinkling of coarse sea salt if desired. Bake in preheated oven for about 12 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,pork rib,rice wine,brown lentil,cake flour,chipotle chile,juniper berry,lamb shoulder
title: Adobo Ribs With Lentils
ingredients: 3/4 lb split french pork sausage ( smoked or mild ) or 3/4 lb lamb shoulder, diced ( smoked or mild ) | 2 lbs bone-in lamb shoulder ( or 3/4 lb. boned shoulder or lamb cut in 6 to 8 pieces ) | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 1/2 cups dill weed | 2 -3 chipotle chiles, minced ( or to taste ) | 2 -6 jasepino cherries, leaves picked into large pieces ( optional ) | 2 cups brown lentils, washed and sorted ( or red ones ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine ( or water )
instructions: In a medium size saucepan on the stove, bring 7 to 8 cups of water to a boil.. Meanwhile, in a medium sized bowl, combine the pork, lamb shoulder, dill weed, chiles, cherries and 1 tablespoon of the rice wine. Mix thoroughly and place in 3 to 4 1/2 qt crockpot. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours. Remove the lid and thicken the broth with the remaining rice wine. Continue to cook, 1 1/2 to 2 hours on low.

title: Greek Lamb Ribs
ingredients: 4 lbs lamb ribs, fat trimmed, frenched | 1/3 cup almond extract, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line the broiler rack with aluminum foil. Place the lamb ribs on the rack in a large roasting pan in a single layer. Bake until cooked to your liking, about 1 hour. Let the lamb stand at room temperature 15 minutes, then slice across the grain. Spread roasted almond extract all over the top of the ribs, covering completely. Serve warm, room temperature, or cold.

title: Mango Chutney Spread
ingredients: 1 cup mango chutney, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Mix mango chutney with salt and garlic salt until fully combined. Store in an air tight container.

title: Fruit Dip!
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen peas | 2 tablespoons lime juice, fresh | 1 1/2 pints apples, cored and chopped | 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed | 2 tablespoons apple liqueur or 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 teaspoons frangelico ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Stewed Red Onions
ingredients: 4 red onions, cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon ground red chilies | 1/2 cup diced red onion
instructions: Combine onions, chiles, and red onion in large microwave safe casserole dish. Microwave on high 8 minutes or until very tender.

title: Broiled Conch With Butter (Mock Devutre)
ingredients: 2 frozen conch, cleaned and patted dry | 2 cups margarine, melted
instructions: Preheat broiler. Brush a baking sheet with some melted margarine. Brush the outside of the conch with melted butter. Broil for about 3 minutes, or until golden. Let cool, then cut into bite sized squares.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,chili paste,kaffir lime leaf,baking powder,red chili powder,topping
title: Toasted Chili Oil from Chiang Mai Restaurant, CHiang Mai
ingredients: 1 cup fat-free tomato sauce ( kikkoman less sodium tomato sauce ) | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( kochujang ) | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf | topping, as desired
instructions: Boil the water. Remove from heat and leave to cool in refrigerator. Combine the remaining ingredients and place into a blender. Process until smooth, strain into a mug and top with extra topping.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,cointreau liqueur,dark soy sauce,meat,triple sec
title: Sizzling Steakhouse Inspired
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground round | 1 package baby spinach | 1/2 cup cointreau liqueur | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/8 cup triple sec
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Combine meat, spinach, cointreau, soy sauce and triple sec. Shape into 8 patties. Oil and heat grill. Grill patties 15 minutes to desired doneness. Serve on a bun, as an appetizer, or with rice, or a wrap.

Random Ingredients: corn,yukon gold potato,button mushroom,chicken bouillon cube,sultana,topping,almond extract
title: Mushroom and Potato Cottage Pie
ingredients: 500 g yukon gold potatoes or 500 g yukon gold potatoes, thinly sliced | 150 g button mushrooms, sliced | 2 1/2 - 3 cups frozen corn | 1 chicken bouillon cube, crumbled | 2 teaspoons sultanas | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 ounce fresh butter or 1 ounce olive oil | 1 tablespoon smooth low-fat frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 c or 350°f. Place the potato slices and button mushrooms in a large ovenproof dish, and stir over a medium heat until the potatoes are coloured, but still firm. Dissolve the chicken bouillon cube in 3/4 cup hot water and stir to dissolve the cube. Add to the potatoes, followed by the sultanas, almond extract and butter or oil. Stir to combine the ingredients well and cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes, or until the ingredients start to soften slightly in colour. Transfer to a baking dish and spread the topping over. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, or until browned and the filling and potatoes are tender.

Random Ingredients: sugar,spring onion,plain yogurt,onion powder,bell pepper,self rising flour,cooking spray,pea
title: Pea Croquettes
ingredients: cooking spray | 400 g frozen peas | 1 onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 cup coarsely chopped bell pepper | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | 100 g plain low-fat yogurt, beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to c. Spray large baking dish with non stick spray. Defrost peas and put in a bowl with onion and spices. Place flour and yogurt in a food processor and whiz to batter. Put the wet ingredients into a separate bowl. Add yogurt to your dry ingredients to make batter. Fold through the batter and then coat each pancake well with the batter. Spray pan with non stick spray, then sprinkle the batter on top and bake for 25 minutes. Serve with pickle horseradish sauce.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,kosher salt,orange juice,herb,garlic bread,marinara sauce,chickpea,quinoa
title: Italian Quinoa- Chickpea Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/3 cup basil leaves, chopped | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup minced garlic bread | 2 teaspoons dried herbs ( chef's choice ) ( optional ) | kosher salt | harissa's marinara sauce | grated mixed spices or fresh herb ( chef's choice )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss quinoa and basil. Stir in chickpeas, orange juice, garlic, bread, herbs and salt. Form into 6 patties and arrange on baking sheet. Bake at 450°f for 20 minutes or until tender. Serve with harissa sauce or herb garnish.

Random Ingredients: corn,beef steak,balsamic vinegar,liquid smoke,chicken thigh,hard egg
title: Chicken Breast with Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 2 cans chicken thigh pieces, cut ( i use bone-in boneless or skinless ) | 1 can corn ( or 1 2/3 cups frozen corn, thawed ) | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and sliced | 3 boneless beef steaks, pounded thin ( i use sirloin steak, can get both, can sub pork chops ) | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Combine chicken, corn, eggs, and meat in crockpot. Sprinkle with vinegar and liquid smoke. Cover and cook on low for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,chicken stock beef,chive,white flour,sofrito sauce
title: Homemade Chicken Stock for Dogs
ingredients: 3 cups low sodium chicken stock or 3 cups beef stock | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons sofrito sauce | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | 2 teaspoons white flour
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender and pulse to a smooth paste. Store in the refrigerator overnight, or until needed. This will reheat very well.

title: Grilled Refrigerated Ham Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs deli ham, sliced thin | 1/2 cup ground cumin
instructions: Slice ham in half, then arrange on flat serving platter like a stack of paper towels. Sprinkle with cumin. Roll ham into a tight log, secure with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,salad oil,ra el hanout spice mix,lime wedge,rice noodle,melon,cooking oat
title: Rice Noodle Salad With Melon and A Kick
ingredients: 150 g rice noodles ( long noodles ) | 10 leaves melon, finely sliced & seeds removed | 5 -6 tablespoons cooking oats ( quick cooking oats is best ) | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 2 egg yolks, beaten | extra cooking oil ( for frying ) | lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Rinse the rice noodles in a colander & drain well. Toss the noodles in egg yolks then set aside. Heat the cooking oat for one minute on a deep frypan & then add the melon slices. Fry them over a medium heat in plenty of oil until light golden, not blacken. When done, drain & refresh in cold water. Place all ingredients into a bowl & toss well using a fork or wire whisk. To serve, place ras al hanout in a pinch of salt then add some extra olive oil & lime juice before eating.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,onion soup mix,cannellini bean,taco,kosher salt black pepper,hazelnut,spaghetti squash
title: Sweet and Sour Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 800 g spaghetti squash | 1 large onion, finely diced | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons instant onion soup mix | 200 g cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/4 tablespoons toasted hazelnuts | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: To a roasting tin, cut a long trench in the base and side of the squash. Combine the onion, sugar and soup mix in a medium bowl and drizzle over the vegetables in the tin. Add the beans and hazelnuts. Season with salt and pepper. Roast at 180°c for 35 - 40 minutes, or until the squash is tender and the stuffing is heated through. Serve at once with plenty of crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,chipotle chile,creole seasoning,ricotta cheese,beef,lemon peel
title: Roast Chipotle Beef and Ricotta Cheese Braid
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs minced beef | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon kosher salt or 1 teaspoon table salt | 1 packet active dry yeast or 9 cups packed creole seasoning | peel from 1 lemon, rind of | creole seasoning or chipotle chile
instructions: Crumble ground beef into a saucepan and add a little oil and the 3/4 cup water. Mix well. Add the salt, creole seasoning, lemon peel and seasoning to the water in the pan and bring to a boil. Add the drained beef and stir. Cover and cook in a warm place at 200 degrees for 90 minutes. After 90 minutes remove the cover. Cool for 15 minutes. Spread the beef on a work surface and roll into long rolls. Place, seam side down, in a casserole dish. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes. Cool and slice into 1 or 2 slices. This can be made ahead until served the night before.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,anise seed,coriander,pea,beef bouillon cube,chicken wing
title: Chicken Wing Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bone-in chicken wings | 3 teaspoons chili paste | 2 tablespoons instant beef bouillon cubes ( optional ) | 3 1/2 teaspoons ground coriander | 3/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1 -3 cup split peas
instructions: Using your hands, rub the ginger and chili paste into the chicken wings, coating evenly. Add the remaining ingredients, apart from the split peas. Place on tray and let marinate for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Bake at 325°f about 45 minutes until meat turns white on top.

title: Walnut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup walnut oil | 3/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup coconut powder | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry
instructions: Beat walnut oil, vinegar, coconut, and sherry together using the back of a long handled spoon until mixture emulsifies and is light and fluffy.

title: Karai - Japanese Walnut Oil
ingredients: 100 g walnuts ( about 1 oz ) | 1 teaspoon corn oil
instructions: If you're using walnuts, pound them until they appear a little softer. If not, pound until they appear completely softened.. If using walnuts, break into smaller peices. When walnuts are soft, stir them into the oil a little at a time until the mixture begins to darken in color. Stir in the walnuts while still stirring to prevent them from sticking together. Remove from heat, place in airtight container and store in a cool, dark place. It will last 3 - 4 weeks. Note, this oil can be stored in airtight container at fiddling.

title: Curried Orzo Squash Soup
ingredients: 6 cups orzo, cooked | 1 zucchini, sliced and cubed | 1 squash, sliced and cubed | 3 whole fresh sage, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup pastry flour | 3 tablespoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 8 wooden skewers, soaked
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, saute the rind of the zucchini and squash in the curry paste with 1 t dried sage until the zucchini and squash are soft. In a separate bowl mix orzo with the zucchini and squash and add the hot curry paste. To toast skewers, place on a baking sheet and drizzle with oil. Place in 250f oven until bubbly, about 1 hour.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Squash
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 cup chicken stock | 8 ounces yellow squash, cut into 1/8 inch slices and then 1/8 inch slices | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Insert sharp knife under the beef to separate the fibers. Slice each piece into 1/8 inch thick slices. Arrange the slices in a single layer in a casserole. Add 1 cup of stock to the casserole. Add the squash slices. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of the cheese. Top with remaining meat slices. Pour the remaining broth around the meat. Bake for 2 hours or until meat is cooked through. Transfer meat to a cutting board and cover to rest for at least 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Takeout Chicken
ingredients: 8 thick cut bone-in chicken cutlets | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the chicken pieces with soup, place in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and cover with aluminum foil. Bake until the chicken is tender and juices run clear, about 1 1/2 hours. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir the chicken until no longer pink in the center and coating with oil.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,pepper,beef chuck,flat leaf italian parsley,red wine
title: Beef Steak Sandwich -  Authentic Recipe
ingredients: 8 thin slices lean beef chuck | iceberg lettuce, whole leaf | 1/4 cup whole-wheat italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon red wine | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Preheat grill to high and set racks about 6 inches from the heat. Place chuck steaks on one side of each of four dinner plates. Invert onto the rack and poke about 20 holes in each steak. Place skewers on skewers, close cover and grill 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in skillet on medium heat, combine 2 tbsp parsley and 1 tbsp red wine. Cook until sauce is reduced by half to coat bottom of serving plate. Meanwhile, in large bowl, toss lettuce, remaining tsp parsley and 1 tbsp red wine. Cut steak crosswise into 1/4 inch strips. Serve steak over lettuce mixture. Garnish with parsley. Serve remaining wine poured over steak. Note, a note from cookbook, it states that this recipe is for rare beef not round steak.

Random Ingredients: spinach,fish sauce,red apple,plain yogurt,double cream,fenugreek seed,celery salt
title: Easy and Fast Coriander Spinach Balls
ingredients: 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon double cream | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 finely chopped red apple | 3 ounces spinach | 1 pinch of ground astafoetida ( fenugreek powder )
instructions: Put all of the ingredients in a bowl and beat with a fork. If you are adding any herbs, you can use them now. The mixture is to last for up to one day in the frig.

title: Quick and Easy Limeade
ingredients: 1 can beef stock or 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 1 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: Open the can of broth and put in a blender. Add lime zest. Process at high speed for 20 seconds. Strain and serve.

title: Jicama Mousse
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs jicama ( about 3-inch diameter ) | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 tablespoon molasses | 5 anchovy fillets, drained | 6 large egg yolks | vegetables ( of your choice )
instructions: Cut the jicama into 1/4 slices, cut in half, then into thin slices. In a large bowl, mix all the ingredients together, except the egg yolks. Pour into a 9 x13 inch glass baking dish. Bake, covered with foil, in a very slow oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with sifted powdered sugar if desired. Enjoy.

title: Tex Mex Brown Rice Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup tex-mild brown rice flour | 1 tablespoon brown rice flour | 1 package tangerine | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 1 package molasses | 1/2 cup hot sauce
instructions: Cut tangerines into 1/2 slices and put into bowl of cold water to cover. Add salt and a pinch of salt. Let sit for 30 minutes to draw out the bitterness, and then peel the skins off. Cut the tangerines into 1/4 inch dice and place into a shallow container. Drain and place into a third container with ice. Cut the tex mex brown rice flour in half and then cut into large pieces. Put the cornmeal in a large bowl and add wet to dry, mixing all the time until incorporated and dough becomes stiff. Add the hot sauce to taste and knead for a few minutes, then set aside. Dip the wedges into the rice flour then the black rice batter, then into the sherry/picante sauce mixture. Gently roll each wedge into a circle that is about 1/4 inch thick, with the edge of the wedge facing you. Repeat the dipping process with the remaining wedges. Arrange the wedges into an ungreased 10×14 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining tex mex sauce and bake in preheated 350 degree f oven until the tops are golden, about 25 minutes.

title: Italian Chips Mix
ingredients: 1 bag yellow corn chips or 1 bag light chips | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine crushed chip and red pepper flakes in a small bowl. Measure the crushed chips into another bowl. Dip chips into cereal mix. Store in a plastic bag. To use the chip mixture, dip the chips into melted butter or margarine.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,spanish onion,coconut cream,teriyaki sauce,dark brown sugar,bean,seasoning salt
title: Oozy Coconut Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can coconut cream | 2 tablespoons spicy teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 medium spanish onion | 2 teaspoons cooking oil ( or as needed )
instructions: Drain and rinse cans of beans well removing any excess bean juices. Cut onions in half and slice up as desired. Wash and peel onion. Heat cooking oil and fry onions in it until transparent. Add coconut cream, teriyaki sauce and brown sugar to onions. Heat well. Let set in refrigerator for 2 hours. Enjoy.

title: Tuna and Pineapple Spicy Bean Hoagies
ingredients: 4 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise | 1 can of drained canned kidney beans | 1 can tuna, drained and flaked | 1 1/2 cups canned pineapple, drained | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | salt and white pepper | 1 package chinese noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: ha avocado,tart cherry,cooking spray,rye bread,asian basil,bok choy
title: Kok Choy and Burrata Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 teaspoon butter, softened | cooking spray | 18 slices rye bread or 18 slices other soft bread | 12 ounces asian mixed sprouts, drained | 12 ounces kok choy or 12 ounces baby beet leaves, rinsed well and spun dry | 4 ounces asian sweet basil, stemmed
instructions: Place oven rack 2 inches from the heat and preheat to 450 degrees. Using a 9 inch nonstick skillet, spread the butter on both sides of 5 slices of bread. Arrange 4 slices of bread, buttered sides down, on a baking sheet. Spray the bread with cooking spray. Bake on the middle rack of the oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Arrange sprouts on the bread and then top with remaining bread slices, brushing with any leftover melted butter. Return to the oven for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden brown, but crisp. Cut into 4 squares and serve with basil.

title: Mexican Zucchini or Chutney (Vegan, Diabetic)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh zucchini or 1 lb green zucchini, ends trimmed ( about 3 medium ) | 5 -6 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 1 cinnamon stick | 2 tablespoons vanilla
instructions: Rinse and dice zucchini. If using green zucchini skip this step. Place zucchini in a colander and sprinkle with chili flakes. In a skillet, heat cinnamon stick and vanilla until fragrant. Drain zucchini, reserving liquid. Place zucchini in skillet. Add reserved water if required. Heat until almost boiling. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 10 - 15 minutes. Cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,cardamom pod,cumin powder,aubergine,corn chip,wheat toast,green apple
title: Aubergine, Blueberry & Apple Strata
ingredients: 1 medium aubergine, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 medium green apples, peeled, cored & chunked ( i used a combination of apple & canned mac & cheese ) | 1 1/4 cups fresh blueberries or 1 1/4 cups frozen blueberries | 3 tablespoons cracked wheat toast | 2 slices whole grain toast | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 cardamom pods, lightly crushed
instructions: In a large nonstick frying pan, sautee the aubergine and apples in just enough water to cover for about 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the blueberries, crackers, and cumin. Place over medium heat for about a minute. Remove from heat. Place the whole cardamom pods in the pan & toast the whole wheat toast briefly in the frying pan. Take the toast & toast w/a slotted spoon & place on a microwave safe plate, cover & cook in a microwave on high power for about 6 minutes, stirring once or twice. To assemble the streusel, place the raised toast and crumbs in a large bowl. Toss gently with the warm aubergine & apple mixture. Then, place in a large serving bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Note, i prefer the day before serving.

title: Balsamic-Balsamic-Pounded Buns
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry yeast, dissolved in | 1 cup warm water | 9 1/2 cups unbleached breads, at room temperature
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the warm water. Using an electric mixer, beat the yeast mixture to a light foam.

title: The Perfect Italian for the Ribs
ingredients: 1 lb country-style pork ribs | 1 1/2 cups shredded italian cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Cut ribs at a 45 degree angle into three pieces. Place ribs in a deep baking dish. Sprinkle each piece of meat with about 1 cup of shredded cheese. Bake meat to desired taste, about 20 minutes.

title: Whole Wheat, Green Bell Pepper and Wheat Biscuits
ingredients: 6 -8 slices bread, crusts removed | 1 green bell pepper, sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Cut each slice of bread into 3 pieces, and place on cookie sheet that has been turned upside down. Brush or spray with nonstick cooking spray. Bake on middle rackof oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly brown. Remove from oven, and place in oven dish. Meanwhile, spread green pepper on one piece of bread. Place on hot pepper in microwave oven, and cook on high 1 minute, 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until pepper is tender. Remove pepper, and place in a bowl with hot pepper. Stir in flours. Spread over warm bread slices, and return to oven, and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until crisp and bread is lightly browned.

title: Italian Beer Dip (For Sipping)
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 1 red onion, chopped | 16 ounces beer | 6 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Place sausage in a pan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, and cook until no longer pink in the center, about 10 minutes. Drain. Remove sausage from water and set aside to cool. When cool enough to handle, remove casings and crumble. In a large bowl, mix the cooked sausage, onion, beer, horseradish, and honey. Place the sausage mixture into a large oven proof serving dish. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour, or until hot and bubbly. Remove from oven.

title: Kielbasa and Italian Parsley
ingredients: 4 pounds kielbasa, cut into 1-inch slices | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Arrange kielbasa slices in a large, heavy skillet in a single layer. Pour enough boiling water into skillet to cover kielbasa slices by 1 inch. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 45 minutes. Uncover, and simmer until kielbasa is no longer pink in center, about 25 minutes more. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,chili sauce,lemon pepper,button mushroom,cumin seed,flour,chocolate chip
title: Chili Pepper & Chocolate Grilled Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 large poblano pepper, sliced into narrow strips | 8 medium button mushrooms, sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted ( optional ) | 1/4 cup flour | 1/4 cup chocolate chips, divided | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper, to taste
instructions: Coat grill with nonstick spray and set aside. Combine all ingredients in bowl. Toss with veggies to coat well. Grill until mushrooms are heated through, but not browned. Remove and place on serving plate.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad With Dijon
ingredients: 4 cups cottage cheese, grated ( about 8 oz ) | 2 fresh vanilla pods, split | 1/2 lb sauerkraut, rinsed and drained ( approx 2 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup creamy prepared dijon mustard | 1 cup cooked couscous
instructions: Cook the couscous according to the directions. Toss the cottage cheese and the vanilla pods in the hot mustard. When the couscous is done, add it and mix well. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve. Variation, substitute sour cream for the cottage cheese.

title: Fenugreek-Spice Powder
ingredients: 100 ml double cream | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 200 ml nutritional yeast | 180 ml chocolate shavings ( milk chocolate )
instructions: Place the fenugreek seeds in a coffee filter and pour a little boiling water over them and let them get soft. Grind them to a powder with a spice grinder. Place the cream, fenugreek, yogurt powder and chocolate shavings in a bowl and mix well. Serve this on bread, rice, indian bread or with indian curry.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,green pepper,garbanzo bean,garam masala,pearl barley,thyme sprig,french bread
title: Mexican Garbanzo Beans And Barley With Bread
ingredients: 1 cup small pearl barley | 1 can drained garbanzo beans, well drained | 4 green sweet peppers | 1 tablespoon thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 cups mexican cheese, shredded into small pieces | 1 tablespoon garam masala or 1 tablespoon curry powder | 3 slices french bread, cut in about 4 x 2-inch pieces
instructions: Place barley, beans, sweet peppers, and thyme in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until it makes it into a coarse mixture. Pour into a large casserole. In a small bowl sprinkle the cheese with the garam masala. Sprinkle over the bread cubes and gently toss then scatter over the cheese. Bake at 325°f for about 25 minutes or until the bread is lightly toasted.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,sirloin,chinese five spice powder,salt pepper,rom tomato,egg white
title: Korean Hamburgers - Spareribs Style (Yum-Yae)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground sirloin | 4 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 2 roma tomatoes, cut into small slices | 2 egg whites | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup oregano leaves ( about 1 small bunch of fresh chopped ) or 1/4 cup a mixture of dried herbs ( about 1 small bunch of fresh chopped )
instructions: Mix 3/4 tsp of the chinese five spice together in a large bowl. Add the ground sirloin, tomatoes, egg whites, and about ½ tsp of the remaining 1/4 tsp of five spice powder. Form into 8 patties. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Heat a large, lightly oiled skillet on the stove. Cook, turning, until the meat is no longer pink, about 3 minutes per side for medium or 4 minutes per side for dark. Wash, peel and roughly chop the oregano leaves and place into the food. Stir. Serve over white rice.

title: Moussaka (Vegetable Meatball and Hamburger Croissant Toast)
ingredients: 400 g orzo pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 500 g ground hamburger | 1 eggplant | 1/2 bunch coriander leaves | 7 -8 croissants | 200 g broccoli | 200 g raspberries | 2 lemons, juice of
instructions: Cook orzo until al dente. Drain and mix up with other ingredients. Chill for 20 minutes. Slice up orzo and place in a bowl, fill in the middle with the meatball mixture, roll and serve.

title: Tofu and Crab Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 package fully-cooked lobster meat | 1 package firm tofu, drained | 1 bag baby gem fresh cauliflower ( cut into small florets ) | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese
instructions: Slice the lobster meat and make it into a small bite size chunks, then set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and add tofu, and cook for about 10 minutes, until it is soft and al dente. Drain, and set aside. Steam the cauliflower until it is soft but still has a little crunch left, about 3 minutes, and set aside. Drain water from lobster, and set aside. Coat a small baking dish with a little oil. Drain the lobster chunks, and set aside. When water comes to a boil, add the lobster chunks, and let simmer for a few minutes. When the tofu is done, drain, and set aside. Combine sauce with mascarpone cheese in a mixing bowl, and gently mix in the tuna. Set aside 1/2 cup of the cauliflower water, and set aside. Cook tuna mixture in the remaining cauliflower water until it is hot and thick, about 10 minutes, and remove from heat. Stir in the sauce, and heat through. If the sauce is thin, stir in a little water, and adjust with salt and pepper.

title: Onion-Flavored Taco Bell Seasoning
ingredients: 4 teaspoons chili powder | 2 teaspoons msg | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce or 1 tablespoon other hot pepper sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in a container in the refrigerator. Flip after 1 - 2 days in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,rom tomato,lima bean,white onion,half,italian bread,mint,tequila
title: Limas and Rice (Rice-Vegetable Stuffed Tomatoes)
ingredients: 6 small roma tomatoes | 2 cups frozen lima beans | 1/2 small white onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian bread, lightly toasted | 2 cups half-and-half | 1/3 cup grated italian-style bread or 1/3 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon dried mint or 1 teaspoon chopped fresh mint | 3 tablespoons tequila
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place tomatoes in a food processor and pulse until roughly chopped. Transfer to a bowl and add lima beans, chopped onion, chopped italian, 2 cups of the half and half and cheese, mint and tequila. Spoon mixture into the centers of the tomatoes and put on a cookie sheet. Bake for about 45 minutes or until warmed through.

title: Sweet and Spicy Mango Chicken
ingredients: 2 large ripe mangoes | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( gochujang ) | 2 tablespoons minced fresh chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons spanish-style salsa ( sweet or sour ) | 1 packet taco seasoning mix ( mccormick or similar brand )
instructions: Peel and chop the mango into bite sized pieces. Slice the chili pepper flakes in half, removing seeds and membrane from each half along with the seeds. In a medium bowl, combine salsa with the chile pepper flakes and salt. Add mango, mix well. Heat frying pan over med medium high heat and coat with cooking spray. Add the salsa mixture and saute until all the moisture is absorbed and mango is sticky, 8 - 10 minute you can serve hot or cold. You could also do a double batch. I love using my grilled chicken and it works great. You can also saute 1 whole chicken for 2 minutes, then slice into 4 portions and put on a plate and top with a drizzle of your favorite sauce.

title: Homemade Green Onions
ingredients: 1/2 cup simple syrup | 3 large green onions, finely chopped | 1 large red chilies, seeded and finely chopped ( red and green parts )
instructions: In a large, deep frying pan or wok, heat 1/4 cup of simple syrup. Add the scallions. Stir fry over medium heat until the scallions are golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove them from the heat, add the red and green parts of the green onions, green onions, and chiles. Mix well. Return pan to heat and continue cooking 5 - 7 minutes, stirring constantly.

title: Cheese Noodles with Cardamom
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles, uncooked | 1 can beef broth | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup cheese, shredded
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain and rinse with cool water. Bring beef broth and cardamom to boil in large skillet or wok. Add noodles and let simmer for 2 minutes or until hot. Add cheese.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,parmigiano reggiano cheese,black eyed pea,red onion,serrano pepper,center pork chop,rotel tomato
title: Baked Peas With Cheese and Red Onion on Pork Sausages
ingredients: 2 cups rotel tomatoes | 2 -3 serrano peppers, stemmed | 1 red onion, thinly sliced | 6 -8 large links center cut pork chops | 5 ounces fresh gruyere cheese, shredded | 3/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus more for sprinkling | 9 ounces cooked black-eyed peas ( preferably shoepeg )
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack 3 inches from the heat source. Place the rotel tomatoes and serrano peppers into a microwave safe bowl. On the rack, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium high heat, discarding the solids. Saute the onion, stirring, until limp, in about 2 minutes. Add half of the pork chops and continue to cook until golden brown on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer the bread to a baking sheet. Sprinkle each piece with 1/4 cup of the gruyere cheese. Put the remaining chops on top of the gruyere and parmigiano, then top with the black eyed peas. Broil until the tops darken, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,beef stock cube,grapeseed oil,italian seasoning,mayonnaise,mint leaf,pepper,worcestershire sauce
title: Mini Italian Beef Pies With Mint Mayo
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 450 g minced beef or 450 g ground lamb | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 beef stock cube | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise, low fat is fine | pepper, to taste | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Line 6 muffin tins with the dough. Brush the pastry and edges with oil and prick with a fork all over. Remove the dough from the freezer and defrost it slightly. Heat the oil in a large pan and add the beef mince. Cook the mixture for 3 - 4 mins, stirring occasionally, until cooked and browned. Add the worcestershire sauce, italian seasoning and stock cube. Drain off any excess fat and heat until melted. Remove from the heat and cool. Place into tins or freezer bags. To roll out, lay out a piece of dough between your palms to make a little patty, about 8 in diameter, and pinch the edges up to make a triangle. Repeat until pastry/pies are used up. Sprinkle generously with pepper and a few mint leaves. Transfer to the oven and leave to bake for 8 - 10 mins until golden brown on top. Let cool slightly and remove tins from the freezer. When cool, top with mint mayo and serve.

title: Almond Horchata (Lebanese Sweet Soup)
ingredients: 4 cups water | 1/2 cup blanched chopped almonds
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add almonds to boiling water. Cover, and boil for 3 minutes. Pour almond and water mixture into a blender. Cover, and blend for 15 - 20 seconds. Transfer to a bowl.

title: Smoked Mackerel and Bean Salad
ingredients: 4 mackerel, fillets, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 can vegetarian baked beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/3 cup peanuts, roasted and finely chopped
instructions: Mix the fish and beans together and season to taste. Sprinkle with sugar, then peanuts, and serve with steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,lemon juice,green chilies,italian sausage link
title: Sweet Italian Sausages with Chilies
ingredients: 4 italian sausage links or 4 sweet italian sausage links | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 -2 tablespoon tabasco sauce, to taste | 1 -2 fresh green chilies, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan cook the sausage over high heat, breaking apart any larger pieces of sausage. When browned, remove to a plate. Add the remaining ingredients to the pan and bring to a boil, stirring and scraping down the brown bits from the bottom of the pan. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve.

title: Pesto Sauce for Fish
ingredients: 1 box refrigerated pesto sauce, divided | 1 dash white pepper powder
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Brush 1/2 to 1/2 cup pesto on each piece of fish. Sprinkle with white pepper. Place on grill. When bubbly, remove from heat. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Scallops and Sweet Pot Pie
ingredients: 8 large scallops, in one piece | 1 unbaked pie crust | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cumin | 1 unbaked pie crust, for double baked pie shells, chilled
instructions: Place the scallops in a dish with crust and bake in a 400 degrees f oven for 25 minutes, or just until cooked through, turning once. While scallops are baking, prepare your sweet potato topping by combining cream of tartar, cumin and a little water until you have a thin paste. Dip the scallops one at a time into the sweet potato cream mixture on both sides. Place on a flat surface and bake in a 450 degrees f oven until cooked through, turning once, about 10 minutes. Drain the scallops, and place in a bowl with sweet potato sauce. Garnish with a sprinkling of paprika, chopped cilantro and a drizzle of olive oil for color.

title: Chili Cheese Dip (Tiny)
ingredients: 14 ounces can diced green chilies, drained | 4 ounces reduced-fat mayonnaise ( use good quality )
instructions: Stir together chilies, mayonnaise and green chilies in mixing bowl.

title: Pasta With Sausages, Tomatoes and Pancetta
ingredients: 1/2 lb pancetta, cut into 1/2-inch pieces or 1/2 lb bacon, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 cup diced vidalia onion | 1 lb sweet sausage, links or 1 lb hot italian sausage, removed from casing and crumbled | 2 cans diced tomatoes with juice | 2 cans beef broth | 1 cup tomato juice | penne, cooked al dente, drained and kept warm | 1/2 cup chopped onion ( optional )
instructions: Cook pancetta in a large soup pot over medium heat until golden, about 10 minutes. Add diced onion.

title: Cardamom Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole green cardamom pods | 1 bone-in pork loin roast | 2 tablespoons minced rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Lightly grease a shallow roasting dish and set the roast on top of the cardamom pods in the dish. Mix rosemary, chopped red onion and pork broth together in a bowl to marinate the roast. Rub the pork with marinade. Roast the roast in the preheated oven until browned, 45 to 50 minutes. Cool. Trim off excess fat. Slice and serve.

title: Fajitas for Soft-Boiled Pork
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1/3 cup guacamole, or as needed
instructions: Rub pork with guacamole before opening. Allow pork to air dry.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,vanilla essence,cashew half,lime,tomato juice,canola oil
title: Prawns and Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 medium spanish onion | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 can crushed tomatoes with juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 lime, grated rind of | 1/2 kg raw peeled prawns | 1/4 cup cashew halves
instructions: Chop the onion very finely. Heat the oil in a medium sized saucepan. Add the onions and saute until they soften. Add the drained crushed tomatoes, vanilla, and the lime rind. Stir and cook until well blended. Add the prawns and cook until pink, turning to brown all over. Add the cashews, cover and cook for five minutes. Serve hot.

title: Lolly's Chocolate Mango Skillet
ingredients: 600 ml meat broth | 150 g chocolate, chopped | 200 g mango salsa | 12 ounces frozen precooked sea scallops, thawed
instructions: Pour broth into a saucepan and bring to the boil. Add chocolate, remove from the heat, stir to a melt. Add salsa, stir, and set aside. Cook scallops in boiling broth over medium heat 5 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Crispy Pecans
ingredients: 1 cup cornstarch paste | 1 pound pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix cornstarch paste and nuts together in a bowl. Spread pecan nuts over a baking sheet. Bake in a preheated oven until light brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,green food coloring,boston lettuce,ginger,mustard powder
title: Cape Inn Oriental Green Salad Appetizer(Ginger Salad)
ingredients: 1/2 head boston lettuce | 6 green food coloring | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard powder | 2 teaspoons ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Rinse and trim the lettuce. Break it into small pieces. In a small bowl, blend mustard/ground ginger, seasoned salt, and green food coloring until blended. Dice off 1/3 head and coarsely chop the rest. Add greens and mix. Sprinkle on seasoning and mix again.

title: Fish Marsala Sorbet
ingredients: 1 cup sugar, divided | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 1/2 cup fresh chives, chopped
instructions: In a medium nonstick saute pan over medium heat, whisk 1/2 cup sugar with fish sauce until sugar is dissolved. Add chives.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,pork broth,lemon,lime,beef tri tip,dark sesame oil,confectioner sugar
title: Gingered Tri Tip With Pork Broth (Guy Fieri)
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs sirloin beef tri tip | 1 can pork broth ( preferably home-made ) | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons finely grated lime rind | 1 1/4 teaspoons freshly grated lemon rind | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Trim excess fat from tri tip. Cut tri tip lengthwise into 6 slices, each about 2 inches thick. Set aside. In each of two 1 pint shallow bowls combine the pork broth, sesame oil, lime rind, cayenne pepper and 1 tablespoon sugar. Place the tri tips in the broth mixture and turn to coat. Refrigerate for about 3 hours or overnight. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Transfer the tri tips to a large baking sheet. Place in the oven and roast, turning once, until the internal temperature of the tri tips reaches 160 degrees f, 4 to 5 minutes total. Transfer to a plate and allow to rest for a few minutes. Slice diagonally, discarding the white and green parts of the tri tips. Place diagonally on plates. Serve with a dollop of the dipping sauce.

title: Santa Fe Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean | 10 ounces white chocolate chips ( semi sweet ) or 10 ounces milk chocolate chips ( semi sweet ) | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Place the beans in a large sauce pan with enough water to cover, a teaspoon of salt, and a dash of the white chocolate sauce mixture. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cook about 6 minutes, until the beans are just tender. Drain the beans and stir into noodles, return to the sauce, and let stand until the noodles have cooled slightly, about 10 minutes. Put the rest of the ingredients in a microwave safe container with a cover, and cook on high heat until melted and combined.

title: Spinach With Macadamia and Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 2 kg fresh spinach | 200 g macadamia nuts
instructions: Wash and steam the spinach until it is limp, but not wilted. Separate the leaves and cut into 3 equal length wise lengths and remove the stalks. Chop the stalks and put into a bowl. Put the nut pieces in a mortar and pound into a paste with a pestle. Add 5 tblsp of the pestle and pound well. Wash it. When the spinach is ready put this in the bowl with the nut and mix well, but don’t over work the spinach. Put in the fridge.

title: Baked Linguine and Peppers
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 8 large bell peppers | 1 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Cook linguine in large saucepan of boiling water until al dente.

title: Spicy Mexican Citrus Marinade Marinade and Sauce
ingredients: 2/3 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon garlic paste ( go easy on the garlic if you don't like garlic )
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over your meat.

title: Giant-Bundro Cake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1 small jicama, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Butter the sides of a 9 inch pie pan with a removable bottom. Pour chocolate into a medium mixing bowl. Sprinkle in the cheese and jicama. Toss well to coat. Pour into cake pan. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let cool for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Beef Mushrooms in Cheese, Mint and Olive-Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 500 g steak | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 8 button mushrooms | 1 green pepper | 1/2 cup of fresh mint leaves | 1 cup tasty cheese
instructions: Thinly slice the steak into 2 cm rounds. Pour the oil into a non stick pan over medium heat. Add the steak and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes, or until browned. Stir in the mushrooms and green pepper. Cover and cook for five minutes, or until meat is tender and most of the liquid has evaporated. Season if desired. Sprinkle mint and cheese over meat mixture. Serve.

title: Spinach Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup frozen orange juice concentrate | 3 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 6 cups fresh spinach
instructions: Prepare spinach according to package directions, if using fresh spinach. Drain. Place in a blender or food processor. Blend until well blended, adding orange juice concentrate, mustard powder, and spinach until well blended. Chill in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before using.

title: Kahlua Italian Pasta
ingredients: 16 ounces mostaccioli pasta | 1 container kahlua | 16 ounces black olives, sliced | 1 cube chicken bouillon
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil for pasta. Add mostaccioli. Boil pasta until dente drain, and while still hot, add kahlua and sliced olives. Serve with parmesan and grated asiago cheese, if desired.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,juniper berry,lebanese cucumber,barley,mace,nonstick cooking spray
title: Smoky Barley Veggie Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons barley | 1 lebanese cucumber, halved lengthwise | 1/4 cup chopped marinated barley ( or other green salad green ) | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon ground juniper berries | nonstick cooking spray ( vegetable oil is ideal )
instructions: Place the barley in a medium saucepan, and cover with several inches of water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then immediately reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until tender, 25 to 35 minutes. Allow to cool slightly, then drain. Halve the cucumber lengthwise, then cut across into bite sized chunks. Add half the barley to the cucumber chunks in a small bowl, then stir in the remaining barley, mace and juniper, and mix in. Set aside until serving. Spray the top of the salad with nonstick cooking spray and scatter the reserved nutmeg on top. To serve, remove the top slices.

title: Quick Beef and Onions for Oven
ingredients: 3 beef top sirloin steaks | 3 tablespoons kosher salt
instructions: Combine salt into a small bowl.

title: Moroccan Style Lamb Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 jar sweetened chickpeas | 1 jar roasted sweetened almond paste ( see note i use almond food brand ) | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek ( see note i use fenugreek ) | 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, 1-inch thick ( can use lamb loin, lamb steak, etc. )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place drained chickpeas in food processor. Add the almond paste, yogurt and fenugreek. Process until smooth, scraping sides as needed, about 9 seconds. Using fingers, spread about 1 1/2 cup of the cheese mixture in an even layer in the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Spread meatloaf evenly over the cheese sauce. Top with remaining cheese mixture. Bake until meat thermometer registers 125°f, 50 minutes to 1 hour, brushing meatloaf with remaining cheese mixture every 15 minutes and letting excess drip off. Let stand 10 minures, then serve.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,brown sugar,hamburger,onion,tomato puree,puff pastry,spanish onion
title: Toad in the Hole
ingredients: 10 ounces puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup tomato puree ( i like mine at publix ) | 1 large spanish onion, finely chopped | 1/2 bell pepper, finely chopped ( red or green is ok ) | 4 ounces finely chopped cooked hamburger | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped onion
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f roll out pastry to a 12 x 5 inch rectangle on a lightly floured surface. Cut into the length and size of your pie dish or shallow pan, if necessary. Spread the pastry with one third of the tomato puree. Sprinkle half the onion and half the pepper over the puree. Sprinkle with half the ham and half the sugar. Roll the pastry up tightly jelly roll style, jelly roll style. Line with pastry on all four sides and set aside. Top with remaining tomato puree. Sprinkle over remaining chopped onion and sugar and bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until pastry is crisp and golden.

title: Authentic Mexican Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 large flour tortillas | 1 cup soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 roma ( plum ) tomato, sliced
instructions: Put the soymilk, asafoetida powder, tomatoes, and salt in a blender jar. Cover and blend until smooth. Cut each tortilla in half. Spread the quesadilla with the soy milk mixture to within 1/2 inch of the edge. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before cutting and serving.

Random Ingredients: dashi,cornflour,kosher salt,chicken breast half,red fresno chile,salad,iceberg lettuce
title: Chicken Salad With Chilli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 packets dashi or 2 packets vegetarian fish seasoning ( to taste ) | 4 large skinless chicken breast halves ( halved and cut into bite-sized pieces ) | 12 leaves iceberg lettuce ( washed and sliced ) | 8 ounces red fresno chiles ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup crushed iceberg lettuce ( to serve ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour | kosher salt | 1/2 cup salad green ( such as spinach, bibb, mixed greens, etc. ) or 1/2 cup iceberg lettuce ( such as spinach, bibb, etc. )
instructions: Pour enough water into a saucepan to come almost to the top of the chicken pieces. Add the dashi packet and bring to the boil. Lower the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, then remove from the heat. In a serving bowl, toss together the lettuce, chillies, cheese and chicken pieces. Using the dressing, whisk the cornflour into a small quantity of plain water, pour into a saucepan and cook slowly, stirring, until thickened, then add another teaspoonful of the soup mix to the dressing. Stir the cornflour mixture into the chicken and cheese mixture in the serving bowl and serve immediately.

title: Pesto Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 small red bell pepper, stemmed, halved, seeds removed and julienned
instructions: Rinse the pine nuts in a colander until clean. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the pine nuts, bell pepper, and salt to taste. Close the bag and shake to mix. Store, covered, in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. To serve, let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Relish
ingredients: 4 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 cup white vinegar
instructions: Place the cheese in a mixing bowl and set aside. In a skillet, whisk in the vinegar and pour into the cheese bowl. Stir until melted and pour into clean plastic storage jars. Seal and turn upside down on a plate until the cheese is cool.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,salsa verde,rice wine,pumpkin pie spice,peppercorn,sunflower oil
title: Cuban Roast Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 3/4 cup salsa verde or 3/4 cup picante sauce | 3/4 cup rice wine or 3/4 cup dry sherry | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice | 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f trim fat from pork and cut 4 slices from fat lengthwise, then crosswise into 2 inch wide strips. Set pork pieces aside. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil and 2/3 cup of salsa in heavy large ovenproof skillet over high heat until just hot but not smoking. Add pork and sauté until golden brown, turning once, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer to platter, keep warm. Add remaining 2 tablespoons of oil and remaining tablespoon of salsa to drippings over moderate high heat until hot but not smoking and sauté stirring occasionally until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Add the remaining 2/3 cup of salsa, rice wine or sherry, peppercorns, if using and 1/4 teaspoon of pumpkin pie spice. Stir to blend and remove from heat. Transfer meat to platter and keep warm. Transfer liquid to small saucepan and bring to boil over high heat, scraping up browned bits and drippings. Reduce heat, cover tightly, simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until meat is very tender and beginning to shred. Spoon some sauce over pork and serve.

title: Holy Moly
ingredients: 1 large jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Combine the ground jalapeno with the lime juice and graham cracker crumbs in a medium bowl. Form the mixture into little patties and set on wax paper. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the patties on a baking sheet and bake for 8 to 12 minutes before they are completely firm and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: sherry,yellow bell pepper,beer,caraway seed,rice wine vinegar,natural yoghurt,allspice
title: Beer Battered Sweet Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper, seeded and sliced into thin matchstick strips | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons natural yoghurt | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon beer ( not the cheap variety ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: To make sweet pepper salad, bring all to the boil in a small saucepan over high heat and cook until soft, about 5 minutes.

title: Flush
ingredients: 500 g spinach | spices
instructions: Wash the spinach. Wash it in little water. Put 3 cups of water in a pot with a lid and bring it to a boil. Once the water begins boiling remove it from the stove and take 3 cups of water and the leaves of the spinach. Throw away the green parts of the spinach. In a bowl squeeze the rest of the water out and put it in the spinach with all the parts of the spinach. Mix well.

title: Sailors' Pasties
ingredients: 550 g finely chopped lean veal | 550 g finely chopped lean veal | 230 g finely chopped fresh chinese cabbage ( preferably cham ) | 3/4 cup white bread flour ( available at asian food stores or other specialty store ) | 125 g finely chopped cremini mushrooms
instructions: Mix together the mince and veal, making sure there are no lumps. Add the water required for making the mixture into a firm dough. Wrap the dough in cling film and refrigerate for an hour. Punch down the dough and roll one third of it into a sausage shape, slightly flattened, on a floured surface. Spoon the mixture into an 18 x 11cm baking tin or tray which has been lined with baking paper. Sprinkle over the cabbage and mushrooms and evenly distribute them evenly. Top with the other sausage mixture to cover. Fold in the edges of the pastry to seal. Preheat the oven to moderate 180°c. Slash the top with a sharp knife, making sure the scallions are well distributed. Bake for about 1 hour or until golden brown and the pasties are cooked through – you can be very careful when starting to remove them from the oven when the pastry is browning and it has puffed up serve warm or cold.

title: Rajma's Easy Jumbo Shells
ingredients: 16 jumbo pasta shells | 1/8 cup ground meat or 1/8 cup turkey | 1 can jager-style cream of palm, with chipoltes added to taste - 1/4 c. ( i prefer cream of palm ) | nutmeg or cardamom, if you like it ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Cook shells according to package directions. Place meat/turkey and cream/jager in a large frying pan and stir til combined. Stir the cream mixture into the shells, and sprinkle with cardamom if desired. Spread into prepared shells. Bake for 10 minutes, then turn oven temperature down to 350f degrees and bake 5 minutes longer or until the shells are tender.

title: Chilli Parsnips With Nuts and Olives
ingredients: 1 kg prawns | 2 tablespoons olive | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 cup fresh parsnip, chopped | 80 g cottage cheese
instructions: Wash prawns well. Dry with paper towel, place on clean tea towel and put in microwave for 7 minutes. Drain the prawns and put in a bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large non stick frying pan. Add chinese five spice powder. Stir to mix. Add prawns and salt. Fry over medium heat for about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Spread cottage cheese on a warm serving plate. Place parsnip and olives in this.

title: Barley Chicken With Radish and Chilli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon barley | 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 ounce thickly sliced prosciutto | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 4 -5 radishes, sliced
instructions: Place the barley into a bowl, toss into the 2 lbs chicken thighs and coat well with the barley. Sprinkle with the spices and trasifer to a plate. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Line a large roasting tin with foil and place the thighs on it, with about an inch from the outer edge furthest away from you. Roast for 30 mins, or until chicken is cooked through. Allow to sit for about 5 mins before removing the chicken to a carving board. Add the sliced radishes to the sauce, and continue roasting them for a further 5 mins on the shelf.

title: Baby Spinach Sausages
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 cup finely chopped baby spinach | 3/4 cup finely chopped nuts | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup beef stock | 1/4 cup beer | 1 egg, beaten
instructions: Unfold pastry on floured surface. Using 2 sheets of pastry, lightly sprinkle both sides of sheets with bread crumbs. Toss spinach with nutmeg and bread crumbs. Stir spinach mixture in beef stock.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,flour tortilla,rice vinegar,tomato green chilies,baby green,marjoram,rice wine
title: Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 6 6-inch flour tortillas | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup rice wine ( dry ) | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon marjoram or 1 teaspoon rosemary | 2 cans stewed tomatoes and green chilies | 10 ounces baby mixed greens
instructions: Warm soup, vinegar, and herbs in saucepan over low heat. Add tomatoes and mix. Add tortillas and mix. Heat oven to 375°f grease a 12x9 inch baking pan. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the soup mixture in tortillas on the bottom of the prepared baking pan, reserving 1/4 cup for top. Spoon 1/4 cup chicken mixture on the chicken mixture and spread evenly. Top with remaining soup mixture. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 60 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown on the edges.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,monterey jack cheese,broccoli,heavy cream
title: Broccoli Ramekins
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 bunch broccoli, coarsely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon kosher salt ( do not use table salt ) | 2 -4 tablespoons freshly grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pour the cream in a medium skillet, and heat, stirring often, over low heat. Add the broccoli, 1/8 teaspoon salt, and mix well. Transfer the sauce to a baking sheet that has been coated with cooking spray. Add the cheese to the broccoli mixture, and toss well. Arrange broccoli ramekins on a baking sheet, and bake in the oven for about 35 minutes, or until the broccoli ramekins are just tender and the cheese is melted. Serve with a nice green salad.

title: Thai Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 5 tablespoons unsalted walnuts, toasted | 1 box vanilla instant pudding mix | 1/2 cup yellow hominy, drained | 1 -2 thai chile, roasted and peeled
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, combine the nuts and pudding mix. Wash and chop the chiles. Add to the mixture. In a small saucepan, heat the milk to boiling.
