Stirring constantly, add the hot milk to the pudding mixture. Place the saucepan over medium heat and bring the mixture to a boil until the pudding thickens and has a rich, reddish color. Pour hot dark chocolate over, and allow to set before stirring.

title: Quick, Easy, Poached Asparagus Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed | 4 fresh hoagie rolls or 5 -6 hoagie rolls, split | 1 lb thin sliced prosciutto, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 1 whole fresh whole vanilla bean | 1 -2 teaspoon ground vanilla | 1/2 cup short-grain rice
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Slice asparagus into 1/4 inch slices on the diagonal, leaving some of the tips on the ends. Arrange asparagus in a single layer on a platter. Cover the top of the rolls with a few slices of prosciutto, and sprinkle a few slices of vanilla bean all around the asparagus. Heat up the whole vanilla bean in a small skillet over medium heat. Remove bean with a slotted spoon. Place spaghettini on plate and set aside. Toast the rolls and cut in half or quarters. Heat up a tablespoon or two of the reserved vanilla bean juice in a medium frying pan on medium heat. Add a few slices of prosciutto and asparagus and saute for 2 minutes on each side. Serve hot.

title: Gramma's Nane Guisado
ingredients: 3/4 cup dry white vermouth | 1 large bell pepper, cut into long slender strips
instructions: Place vermouth in a small heavy saucepan. Cover and let sit 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Let stand 1 minute, then squeeze out solids, discarding liquid. Cover and set aside. Place bell pepper strips in medium saucepan, cover, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat, pour vermouth liquid through a sieve into saucepan, and stir in vermouth. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups all purpose xanthan gum | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leave
instructions: Whisk the unflavored xanthan gum and thyme leave in a small bowl. Heat a cast iron griddle or large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until smoking. Meanwhile, add the dry ingredients to the hot griddle, stirring constantly, for 1 minute. Transfer spagetti to a medium bowl and sprinkle tops with salt. Turn heat to medium, cover and allow to stand 5 minutes.

title: Moroccan Lentil Salad With Snapper
ingredients: 4 red snapper fillets, skin removed | 1/2 cup lentils, picked over and rinsed | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons hazelnuts | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, finely chopped | 2 1/2 tablespoons coconut, grated | 2 tablespoons double cream or 2 1/2 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Rinse and drain the lentils, then place in a pan with the 3 tbsp hazelnuts, chopped peanuts and coconut. Cover tightly and cook over a moderate heat for approx 30 mins stirring occasionally until the nuts are golden. Whip the cream and add to the lentils, nuts, coconut and vinegar, then gently fold in the cream mixture. Place the snapper in a shallow baking dish and drizzle with a little olive oil. Bake at 190°c for approx 25 minutes, or until the fish is just cooked through. Serve with lots of white fluffy bread and lots of crusty bread.

title: Chipotle Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks, trimmed and cut into 4 equal portions ( about 5 3. 5 oz each ) | 8 whole canned chipotle chiles ( i used 1/2 can chipotles en adobo )
instructions: Place a rack in a large broiler pan and an oven set to 450°f. Place the steaks on a rack and bake 2 to 11 minutes per side. The internal temperature of the steak should be 190°f. Let the juices run clear. Remove the steaks and let them rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Easy Low Fat Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken breast fillets, 4oz each | salt and pepper ( for pepper and salt ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract or 2 teaspoons instant coffee, powder
instructions: Preheat oven to place a non stick skillet on the stove/littleneck clatter that will hold the chicken fillets. Place the whole chicken breast fillets in the skillet, season generously with salt and pepper, and bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through, brown and no longer pink inside. Meanwhile while the chicken is baking in the skillet, combine the vanilla with the coffee powder. Drain the chicken and pour the coffee mixture over the chicken. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green chili,lime juice zest,white tuna water
title: Tuna With Lime, Green Chile & Tuna
ingredients: 2 cans solid white tuna in water, drained | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice, pulp and zest | 2 small green chilies, roasted, seeded & chopped
instructions: Drain the tuna, reserving just a coating of the tail fat. Break the tuna into large chunks, drain the juice, cover & leave for a couple of hours. Whisk in the lime zest & chillies when ready to serve the tuna.

Random Ingredients: beer,chicken thigh,allspice,double cream,walnut,new mexico chile powder,brown rice
title: New Mexican Chicken With Walnuts and Beer
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup coarsely ground walnuts | 1 tablespoon new mexico chile powder | 2 teaspoons light smoked allspice | 2 ounces beer | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: Season meat with salt and pepper. Brown chicken in a hot frying pan. When all the meat is browned, return mixture to pan and add the beer, spices, and walnuts. Bring to a simmer. Simmer for 20 minutes, turning meat occasionally.

title: Irish Coffee
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leaves | 2 tablespoons kahlua
instructions: Put the broth, thyme, and kahlua in a saucepan over medium heat. Let cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir.

Random Ingredients: green onion,pretzel twist,shrimp,fine breadcrumb,cajun seasoning,red potato,puff pastry,phyllo pastry
title: Cajun Shrimp Bites
ingredients: 2 lbs shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground red potato | 1 package puff pastry sheets ( all purpose ) | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed ( all purpose ) | 1/3 cup green onion, sliced juliennely
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees if using a 12 inch pizza pan. Toss shrimp with crummin mixture and 2 teaspoons chajun seasoning. Arrange on top of pastry with a brush. In a small bowl, combine bread crumbs and remaining 1 teaspoon seasoning. Sprinkle over shrimp. Bake until top is golden, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, arrange potato slices on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake in oven about 12 minutes. Remove from oven. Set aside. Cut puff pastry sheets in half. Wash hands and work with one sheet at a time, keeping dough from sticking to fingers. Place 2 to 3 shrimp mixture on each sheet on top of vegetables. Drizzle shrimp with green onions. Serve immediately.

title: Hot and Spicy Barbecue Chicken Seasoning
ingredients: 1/4 cup black pepper | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper sauce | 1/4 cup hot pepper sauce
instructions: Blend the black pepper, cayenne pepper sauce, and hot pepper sauce together in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Rub the mixture into the chicken after marinating.

Random Ingredients: matzo farfel,flat leaf italian parsley,red chili pepper flake,ginger paste,clamato juice,confectioner sugar
title: Spicy Goat Shortbread
ingredients: 4 matzo farfel | 2 cups confectioners'sugar, sifted | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon ginger-ginger paste | 1/2 cup unsweetened clamato juice | 1 tablespoon chopped flat-leaf italian parsley, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Score the farfel into 24 - 2 x 1 inch sticks with a sharp knife. Cut sticks diagonally into 1/4 inch slices. Bake on baking sheet until dry but not browned, 10 to 12 minutes. Spread 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar on a flat plate. Place a thin layer of chili paste and ginger paste in the center of each piece of farfel. Dip the goat shortbread in the remaining confectioners' sugar. Arrange the goat on the sugar and roll up. Arrange the shortbread slices on prepared baking sheet and sprinkle with parsley.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,rib beef,wheat bread,brown rice,oil,poblano chile,flat leaf parsley
title: Costa Rican Rib Roast With Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef ( country-style if possible ) | 2 slices whole wheat bread, crusts removed | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1 poblano chile, seeded and sliced | 6 ounces rice ( brown long-grain rice preferred ) | oil, for searing bread dough ( see method below ) ( optional )
instructions: First, make the brown rice. Heat oven to 300°f. Place the beef on a piece of foil which has been lightly browned and rubbed with salt. Fold the ends of the foil over them, making sure to seal the edges well. Place the beef in a roasting pan and set aside. Remove the foil and wipe the meat clean. Brush the outside of the roasting pan with oil. Sprinkle the bread with parsley, chopped hard boiled eggs and poblano or jalapeño. Cover with foil and put in the hot oven for 90 minutes or until an instant read thermometer reads 160°f.. While the roast is cooking, prepare the filling. Heat a 2 - ½ tablespoons of oil over medium heat in a skillet. Place rice, in batches of 4 and a half, in a sieve lined with paper towels. Drain in a colander until all the water is absorbed. Cut the rice into 3 or 4 bite sized pieces. To serve, spoon rice onto an individual serving platter and top with meat.

title: Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 ripe plum tomato, cored and cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks | 1 cup fresh blueberries or 1 cup frozen blueberries, thawed | 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Heat oil in a small, heavy skillet over medium high heat. Cook tomato chunks in hot oil until lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Stir in the plum tomato wedges and bring to a boil, then simmer 5 minutes.

title: Pear and Peanut Soup
ingredients: 1 quart pear, chopped | 4 cups frozen peas | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 2/3 cup coarsely chopped bell pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and bring to boil.

title: Spiced Mexican Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mexicorn, drained | 1 bottle sauerkraut or ( 8 ounce ) bottle light beer, chilled | 1 tablespoon mild hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground ancho chile | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon swirl bread or 1/4 teaspoon french bread cinnamon stick | 1 teaspoon ground allspice ( optional )
instructions: Combine the mexicorn, rinsed saurkraut, hot sauce and ancho chili in medium mixing bowl. Stir well. Form into a loaf. Place on a cookie sheet and score top with a cross. Bake at 350 for 1 hour, loaf should reach 170 for a loaf. Remove and cool for 1 hour. Serve and enjoy.

title: British Style Puff Pastry
ingredients: 1 teaspoon puff pastry | 2 slices extra lean hamburger
instructions: Use a teaspoon to make a hole in the middle of the pastry and spoon the hamburger onto it place the pastry on top. Brush the puff pastry with a little water and use a sharp knife to cut steam holes in the top of the pastry. Bake the whole thing in a preheated oven 220°c mark 3 for 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Brandy
ingredients: 1 kg chicken breast | 3 tablespoons cornflour or 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1/2 teaspoon beef stock powder
instructions: Mix cornflour/cornflour with brandy, add chicken pieces and marinate overnight. Fry until just cooked, and then serve with noodles.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,spaghetti sauce,mango chutney,red wine vinegar,thai fish sauce
title: Easy Chutney Spaghetti Salad with Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy milk | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons smooth unsweetened soymilk | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarsely chopped mango chutney | 4 teaspoons thai fish sauce, or to taste
instructions: Whisk soy milk, vinegar, soymilk, mango chutney, and fish sauce together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,phyllo pastry,corn oil,green olive,oil,sharp cheddar cheese,yellow pepper
title: Spanish Cheese Phyllo-Wraps-Pastry
ingredients: 1 small yellow pepper, seeded | 1 small green olive | 2 serrano chilies | 12 large sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated, divided | oil, for deep-frying
instructions: Prepare the pepper by roasting it and placing it in a heavy stainless steel or glass skillet. Scatter the green pepper and olives over the top. Remove stems and seeds from the chiles and discard. Wrap the sheets of phyllo in damp kitchen towels and dampen them with warm water. Lay 1 sheet of phyllo on a work surface and brush it with a little oil. Repeat with the remaining sheets. Cut the sheets lengthwise in half to form triangles. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Remove the pepper from the skillet and squeeze it from any excess water. Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons of the grated cheese on each triangle. Lay 3 phyllo triangles in the skillet and roll them over them into a cone shape, about 1/2 inch thick. Arrange them seam side down, in a single layer. Brush them with oil and sprinkle on the rest of the cheese. Bake for 10 minutes, until the phyllo wraps become crisp and the cheese has melted into the phyllo. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mango,liquid honey,chicken breast half,fennel seed,marjoram,chocolate chip,maple syrup
title: Mexican-Style Mango Chicken
ingredients: 1 ounce semisweet chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 mango, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. In medium bowl, melt chocolate chips and maple syrup. Spread evenly over each chicken breast and sprinkle with marjoram and fennel seed. Place chicken in a baking dish. Drizzle top with honey. Bake until chicken is just cooked and the coating is crisp and golden, about 15 minutes. Cut chicken into serving size pieces. Serve over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,flat leaf parsley,mexican oregano,black pepper
title: Mexican Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mexican oregano | 1/4 teaspoon cracked black pepper, or to taste | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Combine vegetable broth, mexican oregano, black pepper, and parsley in a saucepan over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,ciabatta,saffron thread,onion flake,red pepper flake,bulgar wheat,turmeric
title: Bulgur and Spice Bread for Breakfast
ingredients: 1 ciabatta ( loaf is good as well ) | 1/2 cup dried onion flakes ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 teaspoon saffron threads | 2 tablespoons dried chili powder | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, preferably turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric, preferably turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Wash the bread in a fine mesh cloth, remove the crust, and cut into cubes. You should have about 3 cups of cubes. Spread 2 tablespoons of spice powder over each cube of bread, and sprinkle with the dried onion flakes. Dip the bread into the spices on all sides and cover with a lid. Fry the bread in medium heat until the onions are golden, about 3 - 4 minutes. Watch the bread as it cooks, since it can easily burn if there is none of the liquid absorbed. Remove the toast from the pan and let it rest on a cookie sheet. If necessary, cut a slit lengthwise in the top of the bread, just to make it easier to slice it. Place the bread on the serving platter, and remove the lid, making sure to squeeze out any excess liquid from the bread when finished. For breakfast, i put all of the ingredients in a blender and puree them into a fine stew. You can serve this over rice or pasta.

title: Cottage Cheese Rice Cooker Puda Di Zucca
ingredients: 1/2 cup puda daiquo cottage cheese | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sunflower oil | 1 cup white rice or 1 cup brown rice, cooked | canned sunflower oil | 1 vanilla bean, split
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup sunflower oil and 1/4 cup grapeseed oil in a small skillet. Add the rice in a slow, steady stream into the hot pan. When the rice is starting to turn brown quickly stir the rice into the oil and stir for a minute or two to prevent it sticking. The rice should begin to sizzle, but with no grains of rice. Add the vanilla bean and 1/4 cup of cottage cheese in and stir in until the rice is coated with the oil mixture. Stir in the vanilla bean. Transfer the rice cooker to the cook cycle and allow 3 to 5 whistles. Note, if your cooker turns brown before the time is over, give the rice a quick stir and do not re cook. You will lose all of your moisture. After 1 to 2 whistles, remove the lid and give the rice a quick stir. If its still a little wet but creamy, it is cooked.

title: Orange Pudding Madeleines
ingredients: 1 packet vanilla pudding mix | 1 egg, beaten | 1 orange, rind of, chopped
instructions: Place egg and rind into saucepan. Add pudding, cook 3 mins, mix and pour into moulds. Refrigerate overnight. Slice, cut in squares. Place in paper cases. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours, until firm.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1 eggplant | 1/2 yellow pepper | 1 tablespoon tabasco jalapeno sauce | 1/2 dried currant ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 ºc degrees, 200 ºc if cooking on a hob, place all the ingredients into a ceramic baking tray with one quarter cup of water. Cover with plastic wrap and bake for 1 hour. If not baking immediately, leave cooking door open for the eggplant to steam when ready and add the other half cup of water. When the eggplant is ready, remove the foil and bake for 40 minutes to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,cilantro stem,parsley,cream tartar,hokkien noodle,balsamic vinegar,curry powder,green onion
title: Quick Curry Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package hokkien noodles ( or any other flavor dish of your choice ) | 6 tablespoons minced green onions | 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro stems | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Cook noodles until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup of noodles cooking water. Drain cooked noodles. Place remaining ingredients in food processor and process until blended. To serve, place a portion of noodles on plate and sprinkle with minced green onions, parsley, cilantro and curry powder. Top with green onion mixture.

title: Picnic Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 packet taco seasoning, packets | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 roma tomatoes, chopped | 1 head cabbage, chopped | 1 turnip, grated | 1 medium turnip, grated | 1/2 cup chives, chopped
instructions: Mix everything except chives. Simmer for about about 3 hours or until beef is tender.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,pepper flake,grand marnier,pancetta,sage,mozzarella cheese,wine,porcini mushroom
title: Rice and Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups uncooked short-grain white rice | 1 package sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 cup grand marnier | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 ounces pancetta, minced | 1/2 teaspoon pepper flakes, or to taste | 1/2 cup freshly grated mozzarella cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry wine
instructions: Rinse rice well.

Random Ingredients: beer,bok choy,lasagna noodle,red wine,beef,snow pea,italian breadcrumb
title: Beef and Bok Choy Lasagna
ingredients: 20 lasagna noodles, uncooked, cut in half crosswise | 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup soft italian breadcrumbs | 2 heads bok choy, cut leaves and tops sliced | 1 cup dry red wine or 1 cup water | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained | 1/3 cup fresh white wine or 1/3 cup water ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook lasagna noodles for 45 - 50 minutes until al dente and drain. To make sauce add wine, olives, and wine or water and bring to a boil. Lower heat and add salt and pepper, to taste. Cook over low heat until heated through in the oven. Stir fry ground beef with bread crumbs for 5 minutes or until no longer pink. Stir in garlic and cook another 20 - 30 seconds. Stir in sliced bok choy and cook another 5 minutes. Spoon 1/3 of the meat sauce into a glass or ceramic baking dish. Place 1/1 of the bok choy leaves on top of the meat and tomato sauce. Cover with 1/3 of the noodles, then top with 1/3 of meat sauce. Repeat until all ingredients are used up, ending with noodles on top of the meat sauce. Do not stir. Cover with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Place in an oven and cook until top is golden brown. For those on a budget leave the noodles for a few minutes just to get them crispy before cutting.

title: Timbales De Cebola - Carrots and Bread
ingredients: 3 carrots, peeled, thinly sliced | 3 french baguettes, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Slice carrots with a vegetable peeler into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange carrots on a serving platter. Cut baguette slices in half crosswise. Arrange baguette slices cut side up on carrot slices, cut side down, in a circle large enough to fit them comfortably in one pile. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,cream chicken soup,spaghetti,hungarian paprika,russet potato,bread crumb,gruyere cheese,sugar snap pea
title: Lazy Hamburger and Potato Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 packages spaghetti, cooked and drained ( medium ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas, chopped ( 1 can ) | 1 can rotel diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | 2 cups dry bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, sliced thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray 13x9 pan with nonstick cooking spray. Cook and drain spaghetti as directed on the package and set aside. Blend soup and peas in a small bowl. Combine cheese and bread crumbs in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: cashew,poppy seed,self rising flour,golden syrup,green chilies,extra virgin olive oil
title: Indian Cashew Crunch (Vegan)
ingredients: 3 cups self-rising flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 2/3 cups unsalted raw cashews | 3/4 cup golden syrup | 3/4 cup vegan ghee or 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 3 large green chilies ( seeded and seeded and minced ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c and lightly butter 8 x 8 x 2 baking dish. Place flour on a large board, fold in half and make a well in the centre. Stir cashews through the well and add the golden syrup, ghee and chiles. Pour into baking dish and spread evenly. Roast 30 minutes or until tinged brown and crispy. Cool in dish on a rack. Serve sprinkled with poppy seeds.

title: Chipotle Butter Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb unsalted butter beans, cut in 3-inch lengths | 1 chipotle chile in adobo | 1 chipotle scallion
instructions: Preheat a broiler or heavy skillet, and line a baking sheet with a double thickness of aluminum foil. Bring a small saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the butter beans while sizzling vigorously with a wooden skewer. Cook until very soft and beginning to color slightly, about 2 to 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Drain and coarsely chop the chilies, and transfer them to a food processor. Add 1 chipotle and puree. Add about a half cup hot bean mixture to the food processor with the scallion. Process to a paste. Add about 1/3 cup of hot bean mixture plus a few more bean portions if necessary until the mixture becomes pasty. Transfer to a shallow bowl and serve.

title: Santa Maria Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ground sirloin | 1 lb ground asparagus or 1 lb chard | 1 lb ground turkey breast | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon light molasses | 1 whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 cup torn lettuce
instructions: Brown hamburger, sausage, asparagus and turkey in a skillet. Add taco seasoning, molasses and 1 tbsp taco seasoning. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Heat through. Warm wraps in warm oven at 400 degrees for 5 - 10 minutes. Add toppings and roll to enchilada size.

title: Quick Fishy Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh salmon or 1 lb another firm white fish, in 1 1/2 inch cubes ( 2 1/2 lbs or a combination ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves ( optional ) | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 2/3 cup whipping cream | 2 -3 tablespoons coconut powder | shredded lettuce ( optional ) or mixed salad greens ( optional )
instructions: Note, alfredo sauce is a good choice if you intend to use it as a salad dressing add the cream to softened butter. Combine all ingredients in a small sauce pan and place over medium low heat. Stir until mixture has thickened. Add 1/3 cup of the cream, stir well. Remove from heat and serve over pasta, couscous or just plain, with a little shredded lettuce, etc. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: escarole,balsamic vinegar,olive oil cooking spray,beef chuck,salt,broth,lemon juice,pork shoulder
title: Beef and Pork Ragu
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, trimmed, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 6 cups beef broth ( can be made with the beef or chicken stock ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 2 heads escarole, washed, stemmed and cut crosswise into 4 or 6 ribbons | 3/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Coat an oven proof nonstick dutch oven or heavy pot with cooking spray over medium high heat. Add half of beef, pork and shoulder to dutch oven.

title: Herbed Prunes
ingredients: 500 g free range soft prunes | 1 1/2 tablespoons fast rising yeast | fresh rosemary, chopped | 1/4 cup freshly chopped coriander leaves
instructions: Place prunes in a large shallow glass bowl. Sprinkle over yeast and rosemary. Cover and leave in a warm place for 25 minutes or until doubled in size. Punch down and knead with hands, until smooth. Cover. Leave in a warm place for 20 minutes or until doubled in size. Form into 16 patties. Press rosemary leaves through a fine sieve. Brush lightly with glaze. Place on a greased baking sheet and leave to rise in a warm place for 8 minutes or until doubled in size. Preheat oven to 200°c. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Beef on the Skink
ingredients: 20 ounces top sirloin steaks, thinly sliced ( cut in half ) | 8 ounces baby carrots, coarsely chopped | 8 -10 ounces broccoli florets, trimmed
instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add beef and saute until no longer pink, about two minutes per side. Remove beef from pan. Add baby carrots to same skillet. Stir carrots into beef and carrots. Cover and cook until vegetables are softened, about two minutes. Stir broccoli into the skillet. Cover and cook until heated through, 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Chinese Whole Wheat Chapati Pancakes
ingredients: 3 cups whole wheat flour | 1 3/4 cups apple cider vinegar
instructions: Whisk flour and vinegar together until well blended and a paste forms. Pour hot flour mixture in, one cup at a time, into a large, well oiled bowl. Mix with a fork with just enough water to make a smooth batter. When batter is formed, drop onto warm, lightly oiled griddle. Brown on both sides.

title: Prawn and Avocado Farfalle With Prawns
ingredients: 200 g dried farfalle pasta | 50 g green prawns | 2 avocados | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Cook the farfalle until al dente, according to the directions on the pack in your pasta box. Rinse the prawns under cold water, and pat dry. Slice avocados in half and place flesh in a bowl. Mash avocado with the buttermilk. Add buttermilk mixture to the prawns and mix gently to coat the prawns. Cook pasta in a large pan of hot sofrito. Drain pasta, transfer to a heated serving plate, and top with prawn mixture and avocado halves.

title: Curried Cilantro Cookies
ingredients: 3 packages dried cilantro | 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup finely chopped fresh ginger-garlic paste, divided
instructions: Place the dried coriander and chives in a large bowl and cover with very hot tap water.

title: Irish Mocha Fudge
ingredients: 2 cups powdered fresh coffee | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb or 2 tablespoons of chopped fresh italian herbs ( of your choice ) | 1/4 cup oil
instructions: Pour the coffee into a large glass mixing bowl and stir in the powdered coffee. Stir in the kahlua, margarine, italian herbs or butter, oil and or milk if using. Transfer to a foil lined 9 x 13 pan and cut into squares. Store in the fridge until needed.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,oil,vegetable shortening,red pepper flake,vanilla ice cream,cumin powder,picante sauce
title: Mexican Party Pies
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes, crushed | 1 1/4 teaspoons cumin powder | 3/4 teaspoon vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 3/8 - 1 cup vegetable pasilla puff pastry, defrosted | 2 teaspoons oil | 1 cup vanilla ice cream, chilled
instructions: In medium bowl, combine red pepper flakes, cumin and shortening. Stir in picante sauce. Spoon into pie crusts, packing tightly. Top with foil. Freeze 1 hour. Meanwhile, unroll pastry and sprinkle pastry with vegetable shortening. Using sharp knife, cut into 1 squares. Pour 1 tbsp oil into 10 - 12 nonstick skillet. Place over medium high heat until oil just begins to smoke. Lower heat to medium.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,black turtle bean,chili paste,oregano,lamb liver,red wine vinegar,part ricotta cheese
title: Lamb Livers With Black Bean and Dressing
ingredients: 400 g black turtle beans | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 100 g part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 3 tablespoons light brown sugar | 10 slices lamb liver, about
instructions: Rinse the black turtle beans and cut into 4 - 5 cm pieces. Chop the chili paste and make a paste with one tablespoon of light brown sugar. Combine with the other sauce ingredients set aside. In a large saucepan, place the garlic in a hot pan, and fry on low heat for five minutes. Add the black beans then half the wine vinegar. Bring to the boil then simmer for eight minutes. Reduce the heat and add the rest of the wine vinegar. Simmer for five minutes. Add the cooked garlic and tomato paste mix. Mix in the liver slices and reheat over high heat until the liver is cooked though. Serve with a good tomato and a green salad. Garnish with shredded black olives and serve with a salad on the side.

title: Black Eyed Peas Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked black-eyed peas | 2 tablespoons light mayonnaise | 2 1/2 cups cooked long grain rice | 1 package vermicelli, cooked and drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Chill for at least 30 minutes.

title: Crunchy Rice Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 can breaded rice noodles, drained ( see note ) | 1/3 cup panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup dry rye bread, cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix breaded noodles, panko crumbs, and rye bread together. Place breaded noodle mixture in casserole dish in 2 rows. Bake about 45 minutes until breadcrumbs are golden.

Random Ingredients: flax seed,baking potato,cointreau liqueur,mint leaf,cashew,italian parsley
title: Potato Wedges
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes | 6 teaspoons cointreau liqueur | 2 tablespoons ground flax seeds | fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup cashews
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Cut each potato lengthwise into 8 wedges and place wedges on a large nonstick baking sheet, each wedge about 3/4 inch thick. Brush wedges all over with cointreau and sprinkle with salt. Bake wedges for 1 hour, basting often with brine. While wedges cook, combine remaining ingredients with a fork and stir until blended. Set aside. Toss wedges with brine and serve.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,serrano pepper,butternut squash,pizza topping,farfalle pasta,flat leaf italian parsley,sherry,tomato green chile pepper
title: Lorilyn's Minestrone
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chiles and pepper, undrained | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and diced | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 2 1/2 cups chopped cooked butternut squash | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, or to taste
instructions: Cook and stir farfalle pasta in a large pot over medium heat until no longer shiny in the center, about 8 minutes. Drain. Mix in tomatoes and serrano pepper.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,broccoli floret,rye bread,knorr vegetable soup mix,orange peel
title: Broccoli Mousse - Norway
ingredients: 1 package knorr vegetable soup mix | 3 tablespoons grated orange peel | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 4 cups broccoli florets, coarsely chopped | 2 -3 slices rye bread or 2 -3 slices other rye bread, toasted
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until very well blended. Line a serving platter with toasted rye or other toasted rye and other toasted bread. Pour mixture into platter, or refrigerate until firm.

title: Chocolate Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup chicken bouillon granule | 1/4 cup catsup | 12 pieces dried dark chocolate, broken into pieces | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 2 quart baking dish. In a small bowl mix together the chicken bouillon granules and catsup. Roll the chicken pieces in the cheese and bouillon mixture until coated with the cheese. Place them in the prepared baking dish. Bake about 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until no longer pink.

title: Cajun Deviled Shrimp
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 cup canned shrimp, well-shucked or frozen cooked shrimp
instructions: Mix the mayonnaise, chile powder, onion powder, shrimp or canned shrimp with fork. Store in refrigerator. Use within 5 days.

title: Santa Fe Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice | 3/4 cup guacamole | 10 tablespoons of shaved semisweet chocolate | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil leaf | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/8 teaspoon cracked pepperoni | salad greens
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease 13x9 inch baking dish. Combine rice, guacamole, chocolate and basil in medium bowl.

title: Duck Breasts Stuffed With Queso Al Forno
ingredients: 1 duck breast half | 1 tablespoon mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Cut a slit in the skin of the duck breast to make an opening. Poke holes all over the breast with a fork. Place the stuffed breast halves into a baking dish or roasting pan. Stuff the duck with mozzarella cheese. Bake the duck for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the internal temperature of the duck has reached 180 degrees f. Remove from the oven, and slice into pieces if desired.

title: Pasta and Green Chiles(Pampered Chef)
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni | 1 lb chopped green chili pepper
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Chop chilies and cook over medium heat with chilies in a large skillet. Place cooked macaroni on a platter surrounded by fresh green chilies and serve with warm sauce.

Random Ingredients: peach,applesauce,garlic clove,italian bread french,plain flour,cumin powder
title: Baked Peaches With Garlic and Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ripe peaches ( peel off pit and discard, and use a ripe peach ) | 1 1/2 lbs stale italian bread or 1 1/2 lbs french bread, cut into 1 inch cubes, 1 inch cubes | 6 -8 garlic cloves, peeled | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons applesauce or 2 tablespoons soured cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease an ovenproof casserole dish. Arrange bread cubes in the dish, covering the whole base. Place garlic cloves on top, then sprinkle the flour into the mixture and stir well. Gently mix in the cumin and applesauce. Pour the mixture over the bread cubes and press down with hands. Turn over, cover with foil and put in the middle of the oven.. Bake for 1 - ½ hr. Remove cover, reduce heat to 375f, & bake an extra 30 - 40 mins., or until the top is brown and crusty.

title: Snow Peas and Provolone
ingredients: 5 ounces snow peas, sliced | 4 ounces provolone cheese, sliced
instructions: Place a layer of snow peas to cover the bottom of a round frying pan or griddle, then add a layer of provolone cheese over the top. Cover with another layer of snow peas, drizzle lightly with olive oil and grill until heated through.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,cream cheese,italian herb,balsamic vinegar,active yeast
title: Quick Italian Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast, 1 tablespoon | 1 1/8 cups sour cream ( unbleached ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed italian herbs ( i like italian herb bread seasoning ) | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: In bread Machine, dissolve yeast in sour cream. Add remaining ingredients except sesame oil. Bake in a bread pan in a moderately hot oven. After 5 minutes of oven, remove bread from bread machine.

title: Veal & Caramelized Pimiento Bake
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, bonless, sliced about 1/8 inch thick | 1 cup dry sherry or 1 cup marsala | 1 cup soymilk or 1 cup milk | 1 can sweet peppers and onions, drained | 1 jar pimientos, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f with the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat. Line a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with foil or parchment paper and spray with pam. Line a 9 x 13 inch baking pan with foil well. Sprinkle veal evenly with salt and pepper. Place on the foil in rows, not quite to the thickness of the foil. Mix sherry or marsala, pepers, and milk in a large bowl. Stir in veal mixture. Spoon mixture into the baking pan. Bake for 40 minutes or until meat thermometer reads 170°f. The casserole should be browned and the edges have crisped and turned a bit golden. Serve casserole directly from the baking pan.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,stilton cheese,chili flake,tabasco sauce,white chocolate,phyllo pastry
title: Chilli White Chocolate and Stilton Cheese Filling - Phyllo Triangles (Phyllo Triangles)
ingredients: 2 lbs stilton cheese or 2 lbs goat cheese, at room temperature | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed if previously frozen ( about 1/2-1-inch squares or 1/2-1/2 cups ) | 3 -4 ounces white chocolate, melted, to brush pastry, if you're planning on brushing pastry
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix cheese and caraway seeds until finely blended. Set aside at room temperature. Place frozen phyllo squares on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Brush one side of each square with melted white chocolate. Cover with another phyllo square and brush with melted white chocolate, and repeat until you have a stack of phyllo stacked on top, but not touching each other. Sprinkle with caraway seeds and chilli flakes. Keep layered on a flat surface until ready to use. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside. Place three sheets of phyllo in a large bowl and lightly brush with white chocolate. Lay one stack of phyllo in a line parallel to the first sheets. Trim to 3/4 of the way down the pastry rectangle. Place about 1 1/2 tablespoons of cheese mixture along the lower edge of pastry rectangle, but do not cut all the way through. Roll edges towards bottom to enclose cheese mixture, leaving some pastry at the top left of the rectangle. Fold the remaining left and right corners, and carefully roll, seam side down, toward middle until it pleats in the center, and is almost completely enclosed. Cut into 1 triangles. Place on the prepared baking sheets 1 1/2 inches apart, brush with more melted white chocolate with remaining melted white chocolate or use a pastry brush dipped in melted white chocolate on the top and edges. Bake until pastry is puffed and golden brown, 15 - 20 minutes. Transfer to a rack and let cool. This freezes extremely well.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,green chile pepper,brown rice,beet,nectarine,sea salt
title: Nectarine and Green Chile Rice With Beets
ingredients: 3/4 cup brown rice | 1 1/4 cups beets, peeled and cubed | 1/2 cup nectarines, peeled and diced | 1 1/4 cups green chile peppers, seeded and diced | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt, or to taste
instructions: Rinse the beets, nectarines, chiles, and salt in cool water, and pat dry with paper towels. Place the rice in a rice cooker fitted with the quick release. Add the beets, nectarine, chile peppers, salt, and green chile peppers.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,chicken broth,fruit,bean sprout,sage leaf,baby green
title: Cafe Rio Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 cup baby greens | 1 package frozen mixed mixed, mixed vegetables | 1 cup fresh bean sprouts | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage leaves | 3 serrano peppers, seeded and sliced into thin strips | 1 can fat-free chicken broth
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 4 qt crockpot.

Random Ingredients: cheese,chicken stock,matzo meal,lamb,berry,part ricotta cheese,onion powder
title: Baked Matzo Balls With Cheese and Lamb
ingredients: 16 medium soft matzos, approximately 36 pieces each | 1 lb lean ground lamb or 1 lb ground beef | 1 - 1 1/2 cup chopped mixed berries ( approx ) | 2 tablespoons dried chopped onion flakes | 2 cups low-fat chicken stock | 1 cup low-fat cheese | 2 teaspoons gluten free onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Put matzos into large bowl, add meat, berries, onion flakes, fat free cheese and enough chicken stock to make 6 balls. Mix well. Spoon some meat mix into each flour tortilla. Roll tortillas up and place in greased ovenproof dish. Bake at 200 degrees celsius for 30 - 40 minutes or until done.

title: Pork in Port
ingredients: 6 lbs country-style boneless pork loin | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Cut pork into 6 to 8 pieces. Sprinkle paprika over pork. Add bay leaf. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 8 to 12 hours. Remove meat from marinade, reserving marinade. Rinse meat and pat dry. Grill meat on a rack heated to 400°f/190°c for at least ½ hour.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,lettuce leaf,chili oil,active yeast,beef stew meat,poblano chile
title: Grilled Chile Colorado
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 by 2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons chili oil, or as needed | 4 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 10 leaves lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons dark rum, or as needed
instructions: Mix beef cubes, chili oil, poblanos, and yeast in a large bowl. Warm beer in a saucepan over medium low heat, stirring occasionally. Pour beer over mixture. Let stand 2 minutes. Place 3 leaves lettuce in the center of each plate, alternating with each other. Spoon a small amount of rum around leaves on lettuce before serving.

title: Macaroni and Bacon - 2 Ingredients
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni or 1 lb spaghetti | 2 slices bacon | 3 tablespoons sweet marjoram | 1 cup cherries in juice
instructions: Cook pasta per package directions. While pasta is cooking crumble bacon. Cook bacon in dutch oven until crisp. Drain bacon on paper towel and crumble bacon into mixture. Add marjoram and stir to blend. Drain pasta and pour bacon/parmesan mixture over it. Cover and let sauce steam for at least 8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve and top with chopped fresh cilantro.

Random Ingredients: cheese,cake flour,salad oil,plain nonfat yogurt,wild rice,xanthan gum,irish cream,cornflour
title: Wild Rice Cheese and Nogurt Cake
ingredients: 1 cup cooked wild rice | 1 cup shredded cheese | 225 g plain nonfat yogurt | 4 tablespoons cake flour ( or use gluten free flour ) | 1 tablespoon gluten free cornflour | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 100 ml salad oil | 5 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Grease a 23cm springform pan. Put rice in a bowl, add 100ml of water and stir until all the rice is free of lumps and all the water has come to the boil. Let stand for at least 10 minutes. Mix all the dry ingredients together in a bowl. Stir in the rice and cheese and add 1 to 2 tablespoons of yogurt, mixing well between additions. Spoon mixture into prepared pan, spreading it evenly. Bake for 50 - 60 minutes until a wooden toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean. Leave in pan for 10 minutes. Remove the cake from the oven, brush with oil, and swirl around with a palette knife to make random patterns in the cake. Continue to bake and turn the cake over as often as you can until cake is golden and base is set. Allow to cool and make your icing. Pour 1/2 of the icing into a bowl. Add the rest of the cake flour and the xanthan gum & mix well. Add the remaining icing, mixing with a fork, until it is creamy and smooth. Pour onto the cake and set in the fridge for 10 - 15 minutes. To serve, cut the cake into 3 to 4 portions. Arrange on plates and spoon a little cooled wild rice on top. Pour over the remaining icing and serve with a glass of irish cream.

title: Sauruk - Fish Vietnamese Egg Noodles
ingredients: 4 cups egg noodles | 8 white fish fillets, preferably pacific cod or 8 haddock fillets, of your choice, cut into 2 to 3 chunks | fresh coriander root, to garnish
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Drop whole egg noodles into water and cook until just tender but still a few minutes. Drain and transfer to a large mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Lemon Cauliflower With Sherry
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 1 slice bread ( crusty loaf of ) | 1 large lemon, thinly sliced lengthwise ( see photo ) | 1 lime, juiced and zest of | 1/4 cup sherry wine or 1/4 cup white grape juice ( see note )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.

title: Frozen Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 package cream of mushroom soup, any flavor | 1 package shortening or 1 package margarine
instructions: Mix 1 packet of cream of mushroom soup with 1 package of shortening and 1 package of margarine. Put mixture onto wax paper or plastic wrap, and freeze. After freezing, slice into 1/2 inch slices and place back in freezer. This looks pretty in the beginning but it is actually better the next day.

title: Beef and Shrimp Shrimp on the Barbie
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak | 16 jumbo shrimp
instructions: Prepare the grill. Cut steak into 3/4 inch pieces lengthwise and then crosswise in 1/4 inch pieces about 4 inches long. Remove any lumps of fat from the steak and discard. Dry the meat on the grill. Grill shrimp. Place shrimp over the grilled meat and top with steak pieces. Cook on the hot grill for 4 minutes and turn and grill 3 - 4 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,white button mushroom,mayonnaise,tart apple,dill sprig,ginger root
title: Wild Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 5 ounces white button mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 3 tart apples, cored and sliced | 1 pound ricotta cheese | fresh dill sprigs, for garnish
instructions: Place mushrooms into a bowl with ginger. Let the mixture stand at least 30 minutes. Place mayonnaise and apples into a medium bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Drain excess juice from mushrooms, but do not rinse. Layer half the cheese into the bottom of a salad bowl. Top with half the apples, followed by a layer of mushrooms. Repeat layering twice, ending with a layer of apples. Garnish with fresh dill.

title: Pork and Wine Rizogalo
ingredients: 350 g ground lean pork | 1/2 cup rice, finely grated | 1/2 cup white bread, finely crumbs | 1/4 cup red wine | 1 teaspoon instant powdered milk powder | 3 tablespoons vodka ( optional )
instructions: Combine the pork filling ingredients and mix well. Shape the mixture into small balls, roll in the bread crumbs and fry in oil. Drain well.

title: Simple Hot Cocoa.
ingredients: 6 ounces cocoa | 6 ounces louisiana hot sauce
instructions: Heat the cocoa so that it is dark and slightly bubbling on the ends. Stir in the hot sauce. Serve warm.

title: Dried Lobsters and Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown onions, finely chopped | 12 small lobsters, in shell and deveined | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together onions and the other seasonings. Set aside. Place the lobsters in boiling salted water for 10 minutes, then remove from heat, and carefully pull out the lobsters from the shells and chop. Set aside. Return shells to the water, and return to a boil. Cook for 3 - 5 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and serve with the reserved onion.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,green cardamom pod,chicken breast,fettuccine pasta,cooking oil
title: Tikka’s Fettuccine With Chicken & Green-Cardamom Sauce
ingredients: 4 green cardamom pods, bruised at 3-inch intervals | 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking oil | 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts ( or thighs ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 lb firm fettuccine pasta, cooked, drained of any grease
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat the oil over medium low heat. Saute the cardamom pods, 1 at a time, for 30 seconds to 1 minute. The pods should release their aroma and smell as if they were baked in a dry pan. Remove the cardamom pods with a slotted spoon. Sprinkle the chicken with salt. Add the cream of tartar to the oil and cook the chicken, skin side up, for 15 minutes, or until done. Remove the chicken to a platter and sprinkle with the green cardamom pods. Add 1 cup of water and cook the pasta, about 3 minutes. Drain the pasta. Toss with ¾ cup of the sauce. Top with the remaining sauce and serve.

Random Ingredients: salmon,green cardamom pod,coriander seed,ice cream,red food coloring,calrose rice,curry powder,premade puff pastry
title: Easy and Delicious Salmon and Spinach Pie
ingredients: 375 g frozen reduced-fat premade puff pastry or 375 g fresh thawed puff pastry | 1 1/4 cups cooked spiral king salmon, flaked into thin slices | 1/4 cup prepared curry powder | 10 leaves coriander seeds ( optional ) | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 1/4 cups cold milk yogurt | 2 cups steamed cooked calrose rice | 1 1/4 cups cold water | red food coloring
instructions: Set oven to 180°c grease and line a 24cm/22in ovenproof glass baking dish with baking paper. Place thawed puff pastry on baking paper, and then lightly brush top of pastry with water. Using an oven tray measuring 180°c, arrange salmon on pastry in a circle, then scatter over chilli seeds and cardamom pods. In a small bowl combine yogurt, rice, water and food colouring. Spoon onto pastry in pan. Using a knife, carefully pour yoghurt mixture over fish mixture. Sprinkle with coriander seeds before baking for 20 minutes or until golden and cooked through. Note, alternatively if using fresh thawed puff pastry, remove and chill until ready to use. Serve pie with yoghurt cream.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,rice vinegar,oyster sauce,yellow pepper,yeast,red chili pepper,cashew,chocolate
title: Sweet Chili Cashew Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 cup roasted cashews | 1 cup red chili pepper ( roasted or grilled ) | 1/2 cup chopped yellow pepper ( roasted or grilled ) | 1/4 cup chopped roasted salted cashews | 1 cup alfredo sauce | 1 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons yeast | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce
instructions: Put oven rack in middle of oven & warm oven to 425 degrees. Grease cookie sheets. Toast cashews in a dry frying pan in oven until brown, but not burned. Remove skins from chili peppers by rubbing with hands or using food processor or coffee grinder. Heat the olive oil in a small skillet. Add bell peppers & ground cashews. Saute on medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Put roasted cashews and bell pepper in a mixing bowl & mix. Add alfredo sauce, rice vinegar, yeast & soy sauce. Mix well. Pour filling into rolls & bake 20 - 25 minutes, rotating pans so filling will roll up tightly. Serve hot or cold with sauce. Enjoy.

title: Amazing Low Cal Buffalo-Mozzarella Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 packet nutritional yeast | 1/3 cup light corn syrup | 1 jar old el paso salsa | 5 ounces buffalo-mozzarella slices ( i use tyson brand ) or 5 slices mozzarella cheese ( i use tyson brand )
instructions: In the food processor of the food processer, combine the nutritional yeast, corn syrup and salsa. Process 2 minutes until well mixed. Spread about 1/4 cup of the salsa over 1 side of each piece of buffalo mozzarella cheese to create 3 sandwiches. Press with the back of a wooden spoon to make smooth, flat, even crusts. Bake on a non stick cookie sheet. Let cool 5 minutes before eating.

title: German Potatoes
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes ( or 2 smaller ) | butter-flavored cooking spray ( like pam )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Wash the potatoes and poke with a knife a few times. Bake the potatoes on a parchment lined or nonstick baking sheet at 350°f for 1 hour or until tender, turning them half way through. Cool the potatoes completely on the baking sheet. Run the knife around the inside insides of the potatoes and invert. Spray the inside of a medium sized saucepan with butter flavored cooking spray and heat to a low simmer. Serve the potatoes hot or cold. You can also make these the night before and freeze in an airtight t freezer bag.

title: Blueberry and Cranberry Salad With Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh cranberries ( approx ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh blueberries ( approx ) | 1 cup finely chopped pumpkin seeds | 1/8 white pepper
instructions: Roast the cranberries and blueberries at 400°f for 30 minute to an hour or until slightly blackened on the skins and the fruit is tender. Allow to cool completely and put in a mixing bowl. Add the pumpkin seeds and white pepper to the berries and toss gently to coat. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve with chilled or room temperature bread and/or fruit crackers.

title: Baked Roast Turkey
ingredients: 10 -12 cherry tomatoes | 1 - 1 1/2 lb ground lean turkey
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a 2 lb turkey truss pan with foil. Using fingers or 1 t. Fluffly Shells, stuff tomatoes like you would a turkey. Place turkey on foil lined pan in 2 rows and top with any remaining stuffing. Pour any leftover stuffing over turkey. Bake for about 3 hrs or until cooked as desired.

title: Spiced Potatoes
ingredients: 12 small red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 pinch mixed spice | 5 1/3 cups vegetable broth
instructions: In a saucepan, place potatoes and enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer until tender, about 50 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees f. Drain and cut into halves or quarters if potatoes have been frozen. Mix together the mixed spice with the broth until well mixed. Arrange potatoes in serving bowls. Top with mixed spice mixture.

title: Cauliflower with Whipped Cream & Bay Leaves
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whipping cream | 7 ounces cauliflower, small florets | 5 bay leaves
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Add the cauliflower and bay leaves. Leave to cook until cauliflower is tender but firm and falls apart. Drain the cauliflower well and add a little cream. Serve warm with plenty of freshly grated parmesan and fresh flat leaf parsley.

title: Baked Jicama with Pineapple
ingredients: 1 medium jicama | 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 8 tortillas | 5 ounces canned crushed pineapple
instructions: Cut off ends and peel the jicama. Cut each half into 1/2 inch strips. Heat the oven to 400°f. Mix yogurt and chili powder. Place the jicama strips in a baking tray large enough to hold them in a single layer. Spoon the yogurt mixture over the jicama and bake on each rack for 15 - 20 minutes. Add pineapple slices after 15 - 20 minutes and bake a few minutes longer if desired. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,mint,monterey jack pepper cheese,currant,peanut butter
title: Cheesy Mexican Spread
ingredients: 2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter ( natural or imitation ) | 2 tablespoons dried currants or 2 tablespoons raisins,, soaked in | hot sauce ( tobasco, etc. ) | of fresh mint
instructions: In food processor fitted with metal blade, process pepper cheese until finely chopped. Add remaining ingredients and process until smooth. Transfer mixture to a serving bowl and refrigerate for up to 2 hours.

title: Fried Mozzarella
ingredients: 8 ounces mozzarella cheese | 3 medium serrano chilies or 3 small jalapeno chilies, seeded | 1 tablespoon cooking sherry
instructions: Cut cheese into 8 - 8 pieces and set aside. Broil or grill chiles over med/hot heat, turning a few times, until the chiles have turned light green and begin to blister, about 1 minute. Place on paper towels and rub off the black pepper. Toast chiles under broiler until they are blackened, about 2 minutes. Peel chiles. Halve them crosswise and transfer to a small jar with a tight lid. Let cool. Chop chiles finely. In a small bowl, combine the chiles, sherry, cheese and chile mixture. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Garbanzo Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika
instructions: Stir garbanzo beans, dijon mustard, parmesan cheese, and paprika together in a bowl. Refrigerate 1 hour to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive,elbow macaroni,prosciutto,lemon juice,white flour,cooking spray,chipotle powder
title: Spanish Macaroni and Prosciutto
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 quartered and sliced thin italian-style olives ( such as muir glen ) | 3 slices cooked prosciutto | 2 tablespoons grated lemon juice | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray a 10x15 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Cook macaroni according to package directions, drain. Mix olives, prosciutto, lemon juice, flour, and chile powder in a large bowl. Add macaroni, toss to coat. Transfer to baking dish, and sprinkle with additional chopped parsley and fontina cheese, if desired. Bake 30 to 35 minutes, or until golden and bubbly.

title: Oven Baked Beef Strips with Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb boneless sirloin | 1 quart canola oil for frying
instructions: Cut steak into thin strips, about 2 to 3 inches wide by 4 to 6 inches long. Heat 1 quart canola oil in deep fryer to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Add strips to fryer in batches, turning when golden brown, about 3 minutes per batch. Drain onto paper towel lined plate. Meanwhile, heat the carmel sauce until slightly thickened as desired. Spread caramel sauce on one side of the steak strips and the other side of the strips.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,dark brown sugar,lettuce,liquid smoke,white onion
title: Gramma's Rice Pilaf Salad
ingredients: 1 bag shredded lettuce | 1 bag cooked white onion | 1 bag cooked basmati rice or 1 bag brown basmati rice | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Prepare the rice as directed on the package. When the rice is done, combine it in a large bowl. Remove and discard any unopened shells or damaged rice. Combine all ingredients and toss until well combined. Chill several hours. Serve.

title: Peanut Sauce II
ingredients: 1 whole spanish onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground msg | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 bunch creme fraiche | 1/2 lemon peel, julienned
instructions: In a mortar, pound onion and lemon peel with sugar until combined. Mash together peanut butter and olive oil. Stir in the peanut butter cream and lemon peel and refrigerate until serving.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Lamb Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek yogurt ( regular plain greek yogurt can be substituted if you prefer ) | 2 lbs leg of lamb, in 1/2 inches cubes | 8 ounces cashews, unsalted, chopped | 2 -3 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Mix the yogurt and 1/4 cup water in a medium bowl. Add lamb cubes, mixing well to coat. Marinate, covered, in the refrigerator for 6 hours. Drain and discard lamb and reserve marinade. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut 4 sheets of phyllo dough into half, separating them at the edges and beginning to overlap with about a inch between each other. Cut the filo into 2 x 7 inch squares. Dip pieces in reserved marinade then place in a 9x9 baking dish. Repeat with remaining sheets. Brush filo squares with reserved marinade. Bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Cool. When done, transfer filo squares to a serving plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: cheese,bacon dripping,tomato basil pasta sauce,asafoetida powder,chicken meat
title: Dee's Quick & Easy "lasagna"
ingredients: 1 jar tomato and basil pasta sauce | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 8 slices bacon drippings ( bacon must be lean ) | 3 cups cooked chicken meat ( from pre cooked chicken meat. use the extra fat from the cooked meat. ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese ( your choice, we've used italian blend, cheddar, monterey jack )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Spread a little olive oil on the bottom of a 2 quart casserole. In a small bowl, mix together the meat, tomato sauce, and asafoetida. Spread a small amount of this mixture onto the bottom of the prepared casserole. Layer 3/4 cup of cheese over meat, then a layer of meat mixture, alternating when you go to top with the remaining cheese. Bake 20 - 25 minutes, until top is browned and bubbly. Cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,ancho chile pepper,beef chuck roast,beef chuck,romaine lettuce,egg
title: San Francisco Sandwich with Chile Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/3 pounds boneless beef chuck roast | salt and pepper to taste | 1 can or bottle beer | 1 large ancho chile pepper, chopped | 1 baby romaine lettuce, shredded | 2 eggs, beaten
instructions: Season the chuck roast with salt and pepper. Place it in a crock pot and pour beer over it. Cook on high for 1 hour, then let stand 1 hour, then strain the pork and beer mixture to remove the spices. Stir in the ancho chile pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours. While the pork is chilling, arrange the romaine lettuce leaves on a serving platter.

title: Mediterranean Black Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 1 can black olives in tapenade | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 2 tablespoons black olive tapenade, or to taste
instructions: Stir black olives, olive oil, fennel seed, and black olive tapenade together in a bowl.

title: Rosemary Infused Spiced Espresso Coffee
ingredients: 1/4 cup asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons finely chopped rosemary | 1 1/2 cups espresso coffee | 3/4 teaspoon grated fresh ginger root | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Combine asafoetida and rosemary in a skillet.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,egg noodle,gruyere cheese,chicken bouillon,self rising flour,cocoa,corn syrup,english cucumber
title: Maggie Beer's Chicken Nugget Guinness Cake
ingredients: 4 eggs ( or 1/2 cup egg substitute with 1/4 cup egg substitute for half a cup ) | 1/2 cup self rising flour | 2 cups guinness stout | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons dutch-processed cocoa | 1 1/4 cups grated gruyere cheese, ( plus more for top ) | 1/4 cup powdered guinness stout | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 5 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 english cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded, and cut into thin half moons
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Grease and flour a 10 inch bundt pan. Lightly beat the eggs with the self rising flour. Combine 1 1/4 cups guinness, 1/2 cup corn syrup, the other 1/4 cup guinness stout liqueur, the cocoa, cheese, and the 2 tablespoons corn syrup with 1/4 cup chicken bouillon. Gradually add half the batter to the egg mixture, beating constantly for about 2 minutes, or until batter is smooth. Pour half the batter into the prepared pan and sprinkle with half the cucumber slices. Pour the remaining batter evenly over the top. Bake until top is golden and cake tester inserted into center comes out clean, about 30 to 40 minutes. The cake will rise up and fall up in the middle. Remove cake from the oven and let stand 5 minutes.

title: Simple, Easy, Fried
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( uncle ben's ) | 4 flour tortillas
instructions: First, take tortillas and fry them on medium high in a non stick, medium heated skillet until light brown on each side.. Turn and fry until light brown. Meanwhile, in a microwave, cook 1/2 cup rice with water until it is done. Drain rice. Cut into thin slices. Dip slices in cooked rice to coat with the rice. Fry in a little oil until crispy and brown. Serve topped with avocado ranch dressing or salsa.

title: Apple Salad
ingredients: 5 granny smith apples | 1 green pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Cut out as many core shapes as possible from the thick part of the apple before slicing. Slice thin. Arrange on a serving platter. Sprinkle with green pepper. Serve.

title: Slow-Cooker Lamb Shashly
ingredients: 1 pound fresh lamb stew meat | 1 can crushed tomatoes
instructions: Place lamb into a large slow cooker. Stir the crushed tomatoes into the meat. Pour over the lamb. Cover, and set the cooker to high. Cook 1 1/2 hours. Remove lid, and continue cooking on high until the lamb is very tender, and the mixture has thickened.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,lentil,dark rum,black sesame seed,mozzarella cheese,pepperoncini pepper,curd cottage cheese
title: Acapulco Pinto Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 lb curd cottage cheese | 5 tablespoons chopped black sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons chopped pepperoncini peppers | 16 ounces dark rum, divided | 1/4 cup grated mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup small red peppers or 1/4 cup chopped black sesame seed
instructions: Place the beans and cottage cheese in a food processor, and process until well combined. Stir the beans and cottage cheese into the ground cheese. Add the remaining ingredients and process until smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: gruyere,meat tenderizer,raspberry,yellow food coloring,vanilla extract,white flour,cumin
title: Raspberry-Cheese Filled Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon meat tenderizer | 1 teaspoon powdered meat tenderizer | 1/4 cup white flour | 3 tablespoons powdered white flour | 3 tablespoons powdered white flour | 2 tablespoons powdered white flour | 3 tablespoons meat tenderizer | 1/4 cup powdered white flour | 2 tablespoons powdered white flour | 6 -7 drops yellow food coloring or 2 drops yellow food coloring | zest from 1/2 vanilla extract | fresh raspberries ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix and knead flours and spices together very well. Cover dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Roll out 1/4 to 1/3 in thick and cut out shapes using cookie cutters. Bake at 350°, 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Irish Cream Beef Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs lean steaks, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 3/4 cup irish cream, light ( creamy type ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 3 cups hot cooked noodles or 3 cups rice, cooked
instructions: Place beef cubes and spinach in crockpot. Pour irish cream over. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or on high for 3 hours. Remove beef before serving.

title: Roasted Chicken and Onions
ingredients: 1 whole chickens | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried onions | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried maraschino cherries | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place a roasting rack in the middle of the oven to preheat. In a roasting pan put the dried onions and cherries. Drizzle the raisins evenly over the top of the chicken. Roast the chicken for 30 minutes in the prepared oven. Carefully remove the pan of the oven from oven and allow it to stand for 15 minutes. Slice the chicken into 3 pieces and place on a serving dish.

Random Ingredients: dill sprig,greek feta cheese,curry powder,baguette,mango chutney,mexican cheese
title: Grilled Cheese and Chutney Flatbread Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb shredded mexican cheese | 1 cup coarsely grated mexican cheese blend | 1 tablespoon paprika curry powder | 1 package greek feta cheese, crumbled | 2/3 cup mango chutney, room temp | fresh dill sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Combine cheeses in medium bowl. Stir in paprika and curry powder. Spread cheese mixture evenly in a 3 or 4 round on a shallow tray. Grill or broil flatbread 8 to 10 minutes, or until cheese melts & browns lightly. Remove from grill & spread chutney evenly over the flatbread. Sprinkle with dill. Cut into wedges. Serve immediately.

title: Kiel (Sausage and Potato Stew)
ingredients: 2 pounds pork sausage | 2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 cup cherry or apple slices, chopped
instructions: Place sausage in a large pot or dutch oven over medium low heat. Brown, breaking it up with a fork, and stirring frequently until no longer pink. Drain sausage on paper towels, and discard fat. Stir potatoes into the sausage and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned. Push the mixture to the sides of the pan, and pour about 1/2 the hot drippings into the center of the mixture. Cover, and simmer until potatoes are tender and most are beginning to brown, about 30 minutes. Stir cherries or apple slices into the mixture just before removing from the heat. Continue cooking, stirring often, until mixture is thickened, about 5 minutes longer.

title: Cauliflower With Crispy Bacon
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 cup rindless bacon, diced | 1 tablespoon tamari
instructions: Trim stems off cauliflower. Cut into pieces, and set aside. In a medium pot, melt the fat over medium heat. Once the fat has melted, add the cauliflower and bacon. Cook for 10 minutes, until the bacon is golden. Add the tamari and stir and cook for one more minute, and serve immediately.

title: Red Cabbage With Poblano Chiles
ingredients: 1/2 lb red cabbage | 1 poblano chile | 3 tablespoons sultanas | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Cut poblano chiles open and remove seeds and white membrane. Rinse and dry the cabbage very well. Put cabbage and chile in a large pan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, covered. Simmer 2 to 4 minutes, or until cabbage is tender. Drain well. Cool. Cut cabbage into thin slices. Spread sultanas on a large platter. Place cooked chiles around cabbage.

title: Wasabi Queso Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup pickled maraschino cherries | 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon wasabi
instructions: To make wasabi paste combine wasabi and cheese, stir until well blended. Spoon into serving bowl to serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,thyme,walnut,dark molasses,taco seasoning mix,yellow pepper
title: Easy Mexican Yellow Pepper Mix
ingredients: 2 large yellow peppers, cut into squares | 32 ounces chicken broth | 1/3 cup dark molasses ( or light molasses ) | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped walnuts ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme
instructions: Wash and deseed peppers.

title: No-Guilt, Low-Fat Raw "no salt" Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup no-salt-added whole roasted walnuts | 2 cans no-salt-added stewed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon mustard
instructions: Preheat your broiler and a nonstick pan to high. In a medium size bowl, combine all ingredients. Spread mixture evenly onto a cookie sheet lined with foil. Sprinkle with more nuts if desired. Bake for approximately 12minutes or until the nuts are lightly browned, stirring every 5min. Transfer to a bowl and let cool for a few minutes. Store in a tight container. Note i don't make this recipe so tightly, because it can get soggy and i'd be tempted to make this again, but i didn't find it necessary to blend the raw nuts before draining the liquid.

title: Spicy Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegemite | 1 green cardamoms | 1/2 lb jicama, julienne thinly | 1 1/2 lbs apples, peeled and diced | 2 tablespoons cashew nuts | hot mustard, to taste | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: In a non reactive bowl, mix the vegemite, cardamom and 1/4 cup cold water. Add the apple pieces, nuts and mustard and toss. Serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,cardamom seed,nonfat milk,cannellini bean,nori,water,lasagna noodle
title: Pasta in Shell or Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups water | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds, crushed or 3 -4 pods cardamom pods, crushed | 6 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1 can cannellini beans, well drained ( you can also use navy beans ) | prepared lasagna noodle
instructions: Bring water to boil then lower heat to simmer and cook the garlic paste. When garlic paste is slightly browned remove from heat. Add milk, 1 tsp garlic paste, and cardamom powder to the garlic paste and stir for 2 - 3 minutes or until heated through. While sauce is hot add the nori seaweed and cook 1 minute. In a 9x13 baking dish add 1/2 cooked cannellini beans pour 1/2 of hot sauce over the seaweed soaking into the baking dish. Place half of the noodles over the bean mixture in a single layer. Top with 1/2 of remaining prepared bean mixture and repeat with the remaining noodles, bean mixture and bean mixture. Sprinkle remaining garlic paste over top and bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees 40 - 60 minutes or until top is lightly browned. Remove from oven and cut into slices.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,hot red pepper flake,english cucumber,dark sesame oil,chicken bouillon granule,celery rib,liquid smoke,garam masala
title: Cucumber-Orange Pickle I
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons garam masala | 2 tablespoons minced sweet red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel | 1 celery rib, minced ( optional ) | 1 cucumber, peeled, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine chicken bouillon, liquid smoke, sesame oil, garam masala, sweet red chili flakes, orange peel, celery and cucumber in a small bowl.

title: Blueberry Mojito
ingredients: 5 ounces great northern beans | 5 ounces blueberries ( fresh or frozen, frozen and thawed ) | 1/2 ounce rum | 4 ounces dark chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Wash beans as directed on package. If using fresh berries, add them now. Combine well with the rum and let stand 5 minutes. Melt chocolate, stir into coffee/lime juice. Pour into pint glasses, and serve.

title: Crispy Dill Pickles--Beets With Zucchini
ingredients: 4 heads radishes, about 3 pounds total | 8 cups raw rice | 1 large beet, scrubbed, peeled and cut into 6 slices | 6 large fresh basil, leaves only, cut into quarters | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves, crushed | 10 -16 kosher dill pickles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 320°f. Line the bottom of a roasting pan with a double layer of foil. Place the radishes in the pan and set aside. Add the rice to a large pot of boiling water. Stir well, about a minute or two, until it starts to boil. Drain. Carefully place the beet slices in the pot with the rice and cook, uncovered, for 10 minutes until they're crisp tender. Drain. Place them in a bowl, cover with cold water, and let it stand for 5 minutes, then drain and pat dry. Arrange 1 cup of the rice onto each of 4 salad plates. Place 2 pickles slices, 2 basil leaves, and 3 - 3 tbs fresh dill on each plate. Place the remaining cup on each. Serve immediately, or pack hot into zip type plastic bags and freeze.

title: Five-Spice Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Place pork tenderloin on rack in roasting pan.

title: Lazy Jives
ingredients: 3 cups chunky salsa, i use chi chi | 1 teaspoon green peppercorn ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let sit for 15 - 30 minutes before using to allow all of the flavors to meld.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,wedge lime,red pepper,flat leaf parsley,serrano chili
title: Zesty Red Pepper Paste
ingredients: 1 whole serrano chili, seeded and minced | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 3 -4 wedges lime | 1/4 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | fresh hot red pepper, seeded and minced ( optional )
instructions: Roast the chile over medium heat, stirring and burning with a rubber spatula, till blackened all over. Cool, then place in a blender with 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon cumin, 2 tablespoons minced fresh flat leaf parsley, and hot red pepper. Blend, add additional salt, cumin, or hot pepper if desired, until a creamy paste is formed. Transfer to a glass jar and refrigerate at least 8 hours, or overnight before using, and stirring well before using.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,chipotle chile,basmati rice,green,raspberry,liquid smoke
title: Smoky Brown Mustard Rice With Raspberry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons packed light brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 1/2 teaspoons bottled dried chipotle chiles | 2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 1/2 cup thinly sliced green stems and root ends discarded | 1/3 cup fresh raspberry ( optional ) or 1/3 cup frozen raspberries, sliced ( optional )
instructions: In medium skillet over medium heat, stir mustard seeds with liquid smoke until seeds start to pop.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa sausage,vanilla essence,tomato,grenadine,russet potato,hamburger,lemon zest,banana liqueur
title: Kielbasa Burger-Kielbasa and Banana Liqueur Mash
ingredients: 1 banana liqueur | 600 g hamburger | 2 -6 russet potatoes, diced | 1 can crushed tomatoes | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 1 -2 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon grenadine
instructions: Place all ingredients in your kielbasa machine and follow the manufacturer’s instructions. This is how my machine instructs when it reaches its proper consistency. When the machine stops “machine”, remove it from the pan immediately and allow to cool on the counter. Refrigerate until needed. Slice the cooked kielbasa thinly across the grain, place it in a bowl, cover and refridgerate for 6 - 8 hours. In the mean time, you can make the banana liqueur, pour your brandy/marinade ingredients into a small saucepan and bring it to gentle boil. Simmer the liquied mixture for 10 - 12 minutes and check it and taste. Allow to cool down to room temperature and pour into a large serving bowl. Garnish with sliced banana and grated orange zest.

title: Sicilian-Style Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 lebanese cucumber, cut into thick slices | 1 boneless pork loin roast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300f degrees. Insert the slices of loin roast in the cucumber. Wrap the roast with aluminum foil and bake for 2 1/2 hours. Serve with the cucumber salsa.

title: Sliced Dried Peanuts
ingredients: 1 package salted peanuts | 1 dill pickle, sliced thin
instructions: Slice dill pickle into small pieces, and slice slices into very fine pieces before dipping into cold water. The idea is to keep the peanuts whole.
