The idea is that at the end of one sitting, the peanuts should be dry so they will not stick to your fingers. Dry the peanuts on paper towels. When cool, store in airtight containers or ziplock bags.

title: Asparagus Appetizer Salad
ingredients: 1 small cabbage, core removed, slice thinly ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 lb asparagus, cut into 2 inch lengths on a diagonal | 2 medium apples, slices | 2 tablespoons capers, drained well | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon cointreau liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In small frying pan, cook asparagus in boiling salted water for about 15 minutes or till crisp tender.

title: French Style Zucchini Salad
ingredients: 2 zucchini, cut into bite size pieces | 1 dash hot sauce | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1 dash chili powder | 1/2 cup french dressing
instructions: Cook the zucchini in boiling water til tender crisp, drain, and cool. Whisk together all the dressing and sauté the zucchini until golden delicious. Add chili powder and stir. Spoon over salad and toss.

title: Mama's Filipino Onions
ingredients: 5 pounds white sugar | 2 pounds yellow onions, thinly sliced
instructions: In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt sugar. Cook onions, stirring often, until they begin to brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove onions with a slotted spoon and spread on a baking sheet and let drain until cool, stirring once or twice. Spread onions all over a serving dish. Sprinkle sugar all over the onions. Let stand until dry, about 8 hours.

title: Mamma Mia!  (Vegan Yummy Yummy Sweet Sweets)
ingredients: 1 lb yummy cookie dough or 1 lb other cookie dough | 1 bunch fresh strawberries or 1 bunch frozen strawberries | 1 can mixed nuts, coarsely chopped | vegemite | allspice | 1 ripe tomatoes, sliced | bamboo skewer, soaked in water
instructions: Prepare the cookie dough dough per instructions on the package. Dough should be ready to use. Remove dough from the refrigerator to defrost and roll out on a floured board into rectangular shape. Spread the nut mixture in the center evenly along one edge of the dough. Bring the sides of the dough together over the nut mixture and roll up like a jelly roll. Seal the edges with a fork, then cut several slits into the top layer of dough. Sprinkle the top of roll with the allspice, a few drops of vegemite and some sliced tomato. Place the rolls in a preheated oven at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes. Serve immediately or keep warm in the fridge for 2 hours. Remove from the oven immediately and cut each roll in half. Serve them warm.

title: Spicy Baked Prawns
ingredients: 12 large prawns | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Clean the prawns thoroughly and remove any beards. Heat a large frypan over medium heat, add the prawns and sprinkle with the cocoa powder and oyster sauce. Saute for a few minutes before placing the prawns on a baking tray. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked.

title: Cheater's Easy Enchiladas
ingredients: 24 small soft taco size tortillas | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 f. Place tortillas on a dish towel. Place a small amount of sauce on them. Roll each one up and place in oven. Top with remaining sauce. Cook for about 12 to 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Cantonese Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried flat rice noodles or 1/2 lb spaghetti | 1 lb fresh shiitake mushroom, sliced | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 1/4 cup italian parsley or 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Soak noodles according to package directions, cool and refrigerate while preparing rest of dish. In a large heavy skillet, saute mushrooms in 1 tbsp butter over medium heat until mushrooms are tender, about 3 minutes. Remove mushrooms with a slotted spoon and set aside. Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid, chop, and stir into noodles. In a mortar and pestle or blender, combine reserved mushroom liquid, basil and parsley. Place noodles in a serving bowl and add mushroom liquid mixture, tossing to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate about 1 hour until noodles are tender.

Random Ingredients: hamburger seasoning,plain flour,iceberg lettuce,brown lentil,raspberry,cornmeal,parsley sprig
title: Lentils and Rice
ingredients: 250 g brown lentils | 2 teaspoons cornmeal | 1 teaspoon hamburger seasoning ( optional ) | 2 large raspberries | 1 small iceberg lettuce | 1/4 cup low-fat plain flour, divided | 1 teaspoon minced parsley
instructions: Combine lentils and 2 cups of cold water in a saucepan. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes or until tender. Drain, cover and return to pan. Combine 1 tsp of the cornmeal with the burger seasoning and stir until well combined. Set aside. Combine remaining 2/3 cup of the plain flour and the remaining 1 tsp cornmeal in a shallow dish. Dip the lettuce in the flour until the excess is absorbed, then in the cornmeal mix. Place over the lentils and bean mixture and stir gently until everything is moistened through. Serve with the remaining breadcrumbs. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Linguine Alla Checca
ingredients: linguine pasta | 1 package cheese, chevre cheese blend | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add linguine pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Medley of the Summer
ingredients: 1 small cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 16 dried apricots in oil, drained, plus 2 tablespoons for garnish | 1/3 cup fresh fruit, chopped
instructions: Gently mix cucumber, sun dried tomatoes, apricots and fruit together in a medium bowl. Serve garnished with reserved sun dried tomato mixture.

title: Chicken Legs in Rice
ingredients: 1/3 cup cornmeal | 1 can beef broth | 4 skinless chicken legs | 4 lettuce, heads | 1 package chopped coriander ( dried )
instructions: In a large bowl, add first four ingredients. Place chicken legs in a separate large baking dish. Cover chicken legs with marinade. Pour the marinade over. Cover and place into the oven for 25 - 30 minutes. Open lid, remove chicken legs and let sit for 15 minutes prior to serving.

title: Easy Jollof Rice W- Chicken or Shrimp
ingredients: 1 cooked jollof rice or 1 cooked other long grain rice | 1 1/2 cups navy beans or 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1/4 cup shrimp, cooked or 1/4 cup shrimp, cooked & finely chopped | ham, diced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup macaroni, cooked | parsley leaves, chopped | cumin powder ( to taste ) | 1 dash vanilla
instructions: Cook jollof rice according to directions on package. Combine the cooked beans and shrimp in the rice, mix well. Mix in shrimp, macaroni and spices. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Coriander
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1/2 cup hot pepper sauce
instructions: Toast coriander seeds over medium high heat until lightly colored, about 10 to 15 seconds. Cool. Grind coriander seeds in spice grinder until finely or coarsely ground. Stir hot pepper sauce into ground coriander and store in airtight container.

title: Chive and Sultana Truffles for Christmas
ingredients: 1 cup sultana | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 pinch celery salt
instructions: Combine the sultana, chives and cocoa powder with a fork. Add more milk if too thick. Using your hands roll the mixture into small rounds and roll in the coarse sugar.

title: Sushi Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup water chestnut, chopped | 2 tablespoons thousand island dressing | 1/2 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce, sambal oelek | 1/2 tablespoon thousand island dressing | pepper, optional
instructions: Combine ¼ cup water chestnuts, ¼ cup dressing, chili garlic sauce and ¼ teaspoon pepper in a bowl. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Jalisco Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 orange bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Baked Eggplants (Eggplants)
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants | 6 tablespoons lemon rind, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Cut eggplants lengthwise in half. Scoop out the pulp and discard. Toss pulp with grated lemon rind and spread out on a lined baking sheet. Roast for about 15 - 25 minutes, turning once, until soft and slightly collapsed. Serve hot from oven or serve warm, cold, room temperature or room temperature.

title: Beer Batter for Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 cup baking powder | 1 cup beer ( recommended -- coca-cola )
instructions: Preheat the bread machine according to the manufacturer's instructions. Batter should be a little thin on the surface but spreadable. While machine is baking, mix together the baking soda and water. Once it's cooled, add to the bread and spread with a paper towel so that air can circulate. Set onto the baking sheet. After approximately 5 minutes of baking, spread the batter all the while, using your preferred method to spread beer, or spray with a drop of olive oil as desired.

title: Gazpacho
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked quick-cooking broccoli florets | 2 cups fresh broccoli stems or 2 cups baby cauliflower florets | 1 canned chicken bouillon, drained | 1/2 seedless cucumber, cut into cubes | 1 tablespoon apricot preserves ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon preserves ( optional )
instructions: Place the broccoli, broccoli and 1 teaspoon of the chicken bouillon in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Using 2 forks, shred the vegetables. Return broth to the pan, add the cucumber, 1/4 teaspoon of the preserves and the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,dark soy sauce,poblano pepper,fennel seed,beef sirloin
title: Spicy Steak and Chips
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable or 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 pound boneless beef top sirloin or steak, cut into thin strips | 2 poblano peppers, seeded and sliced into thin strips | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seeds
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the meat and cook, stirring, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the meat and set aside. Add the poblano pepper, dark soy sauce, and fennel seeds to the skillet. Stir to combine and then return meat to skillet. Cook and stir until meat is well browned and sauce is syrupy, about 5 minutes longer. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve at once.

title: Quick & Easy Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1 can ro-tel tomatoes ( or tomato jalapenos ) | 3/4 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Heat the oil in a small saute pan over medium high heat. Sprinkle the ro tel tomatoes in the hot oil. The heat from the tomatoes will begin to cook the rinds. The rinds should be lightly browned, but not burnt. Turn the heat to low, and put a lid on top of the can. Simmer for about 20 minutes, until the chiles are soft and have begun to soften. Turn off the heat. Add the celery salt and stir. Let cool to room temperature, and store in a airtight glass jar for up to six months.

title: Spaghetti Sauce (For Can Chicken)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken meat, cubed | 1 can of your favorite pasta sauce with mushrooms
instructions: Mix all three ingredients well. Add to crockpot. Cook on low for 6 hours. Stir occasionally and check to make sure its getting plenty of moisture.

title: applesauce Flavored Granola
ingredients: 1 box xanthan gum ( see note ) | 3/4 cup unsweetened applesauce
instructions: In a large bowl, mix xanthan gum and applesauce. If too dry, add up to 1 tablespoon of water until desired consistency is achieved. Transfer to airtight container and store in refrigerator for up to one week.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,thyme sprig,thai basil,chicken broth,cumin powder
title: Artichoke Hearts Voodoo Roasted
ingredients: 1 cup thai basil, loosely packed | 1 jar artichoke hearts, roughly chopped | 1/2 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 dash thyme sprig ( optional ) | 1 can chicken broth, low sodium
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Mix basil, artichoke hearts, cumin, thyme, and broth into bowl and set aside. Roast in the oven till tender. The artichoke hearts can also be placed on individual foil lined baking sheet lined with parchment or lightly oiled. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,cooking oil,cheese ravioli,grain rice,red onion
title: Rice and Vegetables
ingredients: cooking oil | 1 red onion, chopped | 500 g cheese ravioli | 1 liter long grain rice | parsley leaves, washed and torn ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot. Add finely chopped onion and fry for few minutes, then add rice. Stir frequently. After a few minutes, add sufficient water to cover rice. Lower heat and continue to cook for a few minutes. Cover and continue to cook rice for ten more minutes or until the rice is tender. Remove from heat and stir through coriander and finely chopped parsley. Serve hot.

title: Cranberry-Caramelized Madeira Pizza
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated pizza dough | 12 ounces madeira wine | 2/3 cup baby cranberries, stems removed | 1/3 cup olive, sliced | 3 tablespoons capers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f lightly spray two 8 x 12 inch baking pans with nonstick cooking spray. Unroll pizza dough onto the lightly floured work surface. Cover the dough with a slightly dampened paper towel and let rest 10 minutes. Roll dough into a 6 by 5 inch rectangle on a lightly floured surface. Spread the madeira over the crusts. Arrange cranberries over the pizza crusts. Sprinkle capers over cranberries.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,corn oil,lime wedge,stewing beef,chili flake,red wine vinegar,rock salt
title: Steak Fennel in Spicy Lime Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef | 2 tablespoons rock salt | 20 fennel bulbs, trimmed | 2 dried limes leaves or 2 fresh limes | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 3 teaspoons corn oil
instructions: Cut the beef into 3cm cubes and sprinkle over the rock salt. In a wok, heat oil and fry the beef until well browned. Add the fennel and toss well. Cover the wok and cook until all the juices are released. When all the juices are released, add the remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Simmer for 1 hour and serve with a piece of fried fish. This brings out the spicy flavour of fish.

title: Parmesan Sage Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Stir the parmigiano reggiano into the cheese.

title: Scotch Oat Breakfast With Sausages
ingredients: 3 ounces steel cut oats | 1 teaspoon chili pepper | 1 pinch ground mace | 4 ounces chckpeas | 1/2 ounce dried beef sausage
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 200 degrees c/400°f, gas mark grease 2 baking trays with oil. Put the oats in a large bowl and add the peppers, mace, soaked chiken, mixed dried beef and fresh sausage. Stir well. Sprinkle over the oats and bake in the oven for about 20 mins till the oats are browned and everything is hot.

title: Easy Spring Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower | 8 large baby carrots, washed | 8 -12 fresh spring onions | 1/2 cup fresh maraschino cherry, cut in half
instructions: Separate the cauliflower and carrots. Cut into 2 inch florets. Separate the onion and cherries. Dice the cauliflower and carrots. Toss together in a large bowl. Place the cherry halves on the mix and sprinkle with the onion and cherries. Allow to marinate for 30 - 60 minutes.

title: Pignoli Bread
ingredients: 1 liter pasta sauce ( we use old world brand from costco ) | 4 cups flour | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast ( about 2 tbsp. ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts, roasted ( fresh or dry )
instructions: In a bowl mix the pasta sauce, flour, yeast, and pine nut. If using dry ingredients just add them, stirring until combined well. Cover loosely with plastic wrap. Place in a warm place for about 30 minutes, until dough is risen and smooth. Knead on floured surface, adding water as needed to keep dough from too sticky. Place ball in bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until doubled. Heat oil in a large skillet, or cast iron stove on stove top, over medium heat. Roll dough out, cut into desired sized pieces, and brown on both sides. You can also deep fry them like normal bread.

title: Sizzlin' Beef Appetizers
ingredients: 5 lbs beef tenderloin or 5 lbs sirloin steaks, cut to 1 1/2-inch cubes | 3 cups salsa ( spicy or mexican to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons vegetable or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 5 tomatoes, diced | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables ( ie : ) | 3/4 cup grated asiago cheese ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Combine the marinade ingredients and pour into the center of the beef and marinate over night or for at least 2 hours. Drain beef and place on rack of broiler pan, roast about 7 - 10 minutes per side or until desired tenderness. Drain most of the liquid from the roasting pan. Cool and then place in freezer bag. To prepare the rest of the items, heat canola oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add tomatoes, vegetables, and half of the fresh basil. Cook and stir until vegetables are tender. Add asiago cheese, and cook and stir for one minute. Serve on lettuce leaf or in lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,green cardamom pod,part mozzarella cheese,worcestershire sauce,green olive
title: Shiraziki
ingredients: 3/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 cup green olives, shelled | 2 saffron threads or 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 5 green cardamom pods | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine worcestershire sauce, olives, saffron and cardamom. Mix well. Cut cheese into 1/4 inch slices and coat with a small amount of worcestershire mixture.

title: Chicken and Shrimp in Oil and Wine
ingredients: 1/2 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 lb chicken tenders | 2 ounces radishes, chinese cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon shaoxing wine
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup oil in a skillet. Cook shrimp just until pink, 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from skillet.

title: Chilled Lemongrass and Turnip Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped lemongrass | 2 pinches cumin, a pinch | 4 -5 ripe sweet potatoes, peeled and chopped in half | 200 g uncooked peeled shrimp | natural bran
instructions: Cut lemongrass into 1 inch pieces and crush into a paste with a mortar and pestle. Toss lemongrass paste, sweet potato, shrimp and cumin in a large bowl. Allow vegetables to marinade for an hour or so on the counter. Serve at once into the bowls. Sprinkle with bran.

title: Stewing Beef Au Jus
ingredients: 3 lbs stew meat | 5 tablespoons mild curry powder | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon, crumbled | 2 tablespoons nutmeg | 2 lbs fresh pumpkin or 2 lbs winter squash, cut into thick wedges | 3 lbs fresh chuck roast
instructions: In a large heavy kettle, brown meat in 3 tablespoons mild curry, tarragon and nutmeg. Add beef and pumpkin.

title: Turronade
ingredients: 1 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a small saute pan over medium high heat. To test if the oil is smoking, pour 1/4 teaspoon of smoke into the pan. If the smoke rises from the pan with a slotted spoon, it is very hot. Add the mace. If it does not, pour the oil in a slow stream through the funnel into the hot oil. When the smoke dies down, the oil should have a rich dark red color. As soon as the oil is cooled to warm, use a thermometer to measure the liquid.

title: Baja Bagels
ingredients: 2 ripe papayas, halved and seeded | 1 ripe avocado - peeled, pitted and mashed | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 8 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Slice off the top seed of papayas, and scoop out the pulp with a spoon, leaving the shells intact. Place papaya pulp into a bowl, and mash with a fork. Stir in mashed avocado, and italian seasoning. Place lettuce leaves on the prepared baking sheet, and spoon papaya mixture into the center. Wrap each papaya slice around the edge of the taco shell, and place onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until papaya shells are crispy from the avocado, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,dark sesame oil,hot italian sausage,ham
title: Sausage in Hot Sesame Oil
ingredients: 1 lb thick-sliced ham | 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 3/4 cup dark sesame oil ( available at oriental markets )
instructions: Remove casings from sausage and discard or save for stock. Trim fat from sausage and break meat into bite sized pieces. Heat oil up in a wok and add cooked sausage and brown, making sure sausage is fully cooked. Remove sausage from oil and drain. Add baking powder to oil and fry until it gives off a light, puffy smell. Add sausage to sauce, stir constantly and simmer until heated through. Add dark sesame oil. Sauce can be kept in the refrigerator for several weeks. Taste and adjust for seasoning.. Serve with rice.

title: Rice Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 package lean ground meat | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add rice noodles, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until lightly browned. Drain and rinse noodles in a colander, and set aside. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the ground meat until browned and crumbly, and drain. Remove meat, and return meat to skillet, and stir in the drained cannellini beans. Transfer to the prepared baking dish. Cover and bake 25 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,romaine lettuce,aubergine,breadcrumb,garlic clove,picante sauce,oregano,kosher salt
title: TEX - Aubergine Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried oregano | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 2/3 cup picante sauce, your choice | 1 large egg | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 4 romaine lettuce | 8 ounces sliced fresh aubergines
instructions: Spray grill or indoor grill tray with nonstick cooking spray. Place chicken on grill or tray and grill, uncovered, 4 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,dark brown sugar,heavy cream,baking powder
title: Flourless Black Pepper Cookies (Tisang Manis)
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups dark brown sugar | 3 cups cracked black peppercorns ( or more ) | 12 cups heavy cream, whipped | 3 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Pour sugar and cracked black peppppercorns into a large bowl. Add whipping cream and stir until sugar is completely dissolved. Add baking powder and continue stirring until sugar is completely dissolved. Drop spoonfuls of mixture onto parchment covered cookie sheets. Gather the edges together and make a little depression in the center of each cookie. Place cookie sheets in a plastic bag. Pour heavy cream into pan and turn on to high heat. When cream comes to a boil, take off heat. Using a slotted spoon, remove peppercorns from bag and roll on a floured surface.

title: Overnight Cherry Tomatoes & Tomatoes - Pies
ingredients: 20 fresh cherry tomatoes | 1 1/4 cups cake-and-pastry flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly oil or nonstick cooking spray. Thinly slice the tomatoes. Place the slices in a food processor with the flour and pulse a few times as you add the tomatoes. Dividing evenly. Shape the mixture into 24 small to medium sized tomatoes. Place in an ovenproof bowl or muffin tin that is filled with water. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 - 15 minutes, depending on size of tomatoes. Serve warm or cool and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,rigatoni pasta,herb,orange peel,poblano chile,gingerroot,coriander,white bean
title: Rigatoni With Artichokes, Poblano and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dried white beans, soaked overnight in water to cover and drained ( can substitute white wine ) | 4 ounces poblano chiles, roasted, seeded, peeled and chopped | 2 teaspoons gingerroot, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh herb, chopped | 1 teaspoon oregano and fresh coriander, chopped | 7 ounces artichoke hearts, drained | 2/3 cup rigatoni pasta or 2/3 cup pasta carbonated beverage | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: In a blender, combine beans with water to cover and process until smooth. Return bean mixture, chiles, ginger, herbs and oregano to pan. Bring to boil, then turn heat to very low. Simmer uncovered until slightly thickened, about 30 minutes. Stir in cooked pasta or soda.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,sunflower oil,head garlic,cumin,mexican cheese,tomato green chilies,arbol chile
title: Smoky Tomato Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 head of garlic, finely chopped | 2 medium tomatoes, chopped | 1 -2 arbol chile, chopped small | 2 -3 sunflower oil, for frying | 0.5 can whole tomatoes with chiles | 1 dash ground cumin | 1 dash mexican blend cheese
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a medium saucepan and fry the garlic until brown. Turn down the heat, add fresh tomatoes and stir in all the spices. Simmer for about 30 minutes add the tomato puree and simmer for an additional 10 minutes and check to see how soft or soft the desired consistency should be. Keep warm on low heat. In a separate pan fry the arbol chilies until dark brown, add hot oil to make a thin paste. Put small amount of the paste in the bottom of a greased 9x13 pan. Add an inch of water, spread the cheese over the paste and place under a broiler until the top has a nice brown crust and the chilies are bubbling hot. Serve with rice or as you like with your favorite mexican recipe.

title: Indian Carrots and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 4 cups baby carrots, cut on diagonal into halves lengthwise and washed well | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger paste, washed, peeled and grated | 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla or 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet on high heat. Add garlic paste. When it splutters, add carrots and walnuts, mixing in nicely. Lower heat to medium high. Cover the pan. Saute for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring gently. Remove from heat. Blend in almond and vanilla or almond extract. Toss well. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,taco seasoning mix,maraschino cherry,pork,curry,radish,green peppercorn
title: South American Grilled Pork
ingredients: 1/2 cup curry | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 4 lbs pork | 4 slices mandarin oranges | 6 green peppercorns | 6 radishes, thinly sliced | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained ( optional )
instructions: Mix taco seasoning with 1 cup of water.

title: Black Rum (Pomì Escargots)
ingredients: 12 tablespoons dark rum | 1 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Place rum in a small, heavy, heavy saucepan. Add cracked black pepper. Heat over low heat until bubbles form around the edge of the saucepan. Ladle into shot glasses, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,gingerroot,black bean sauce,pecorino romano cheese,ginger root
title: Ginger Bean Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn | 1/4 cup black bean sauce ( or more ) | 1 piece fresh ginger root or 2 inches piece fresh ginger, peeled | 1/4 cup fresh grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot
instructions: In a bowl, mix together black bean sauce, ginger, pecorino romano cheese and ginger. Set aside. Heat a wok or frying pan over medium high heat. When hot, add more of the black bean sauce, allowing it to thicken slightly.

I combined them all together, and put it back in the crock. This turned out great. Our son loved them. Next time, i'll add more bauerkraut, but they're not needed. Will cook in a slow cooker. I am glad that people like it more spicy. I made this again, and it was a family favorite. This is always awesome over fettuccine. This is a crowd pleaser, and i loved it with a glass of ciabatta bread, and lots of garlic bread fried cheese. This also added good garlic, basil, coriander, and crushed red pepper to the top as a garnish.

title: Chile Poppers
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles or 4 anaheim chilies | 4 slices bacon | 1 teaspoon rye flour ( or 1 tsp cornstarch combined with 1 tsp water )
instructions: Roast the chilies either under the broiler or under a grill on a baking sheet. Toast them quickly, and only for a few seconds on each side. Let them cool a bit, and peel skin off if they're dirty. Make a slit through one end of each pepper. Cook the bacon in a nonstick frying pan, then crumble as you go. Mix together the rye flour and water, and stir into the drippings. Stir well over medium heat until thickened.

title: Prawn and Barley Bread
ingredients: 250 g rice flour | 140 g barley ( dry weight ) | 1 prawns, shell on | 1 slice rye bread | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1 slice chicken meat
instructions: Cook rice flour in a 2 litre saucepan over a medium heat for 1 - 2 mins or until fragrant. Meanwhile bring 4 cups of water to the boil and add barley. Add prawns and return to the boil. Cook for a further 5 mins or until prawns curl when pricked with a knife. Set aside with the barley and place rye bread on a tray. Spray with cooking spray. Place bread in oven and toast for about 5 mins or until the bread puffs up. Remove from the oven, place prawns in the middle and top with cooked rice and breadcrumbs. Return to the oven for a further 5 minutes to heat through.

Random Ingredients: white balsamic vinegar,maple syrup,cheddar cheese,green king prawn,lime
title: Cheesy Maple Shrimp With Balsamic Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lemon, juice of | 10 ounces cooked green king prawns | 10 ounces aged cheddar cheese, finely grated | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 3 drops white balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place lemon juice into screw top jar with cheese and shake until well mixed. Add syrup and vinegar and shake well, again for 1 minute more. Add prawns and shake well, again for 2 - 3 minutes. Divide among serving plates and serve immediately.

title: Chinese Egg Rolls
ingredients: 12 ounces alfalfa sprouts | 6 egg yolks | 6 tablespoons light hoisin sauce | ice cube | 12 -15 pickled jalapenos
instructions: Place about 1/2 cup of sprouts in each ice cube compartment. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored, about 10 to 12 minutes on high, then slowly add hoisin sauce until mixture holds the texture of egg whites. Lightly drizzle ice cubes into each cup of strainer to capture juices that have gathered under. Remove 1 egg yolk from each cup. Sprinkle each with 2 teaspoons of chinese chili sauce. Carefully lift one yolk out of each glass and press a thumb or two of the stem end of one egg into the center of one egg yolk then, using a pastry brush or spoon, dab about 3 tablespoons of sauce mixture in the egg white on the edge farthest away. Press lightly to ensure egg whites don't set. Holding egg yolk in your hand, gently roll egg whites in the sauce until coated, being very careful not to tear. Carefully place in a plastic bag with remaining sauce mixture. Seal the bag, and transfer to a freezer bag. Repeat until all 6 egg rolls are filled. Arrange egg rolls in freezer for about 30 minutes or until frozen. Place all frozen egg rolls in a large serving platter, and garnish with jalapenos.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,italian flat leaf parsley,coriander leaf,star anise,irish cream,cooking oat,brown sugar
title: Oatmeal With Irish Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oats | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 3 tablespoons irish cream | 1/2 medium orange or 2 teaspoons orange extract, mixed with 2 tsp freshly squeezed hot water | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander leaves | 1/2 star anise | 1 teaspoon soft brown sugar | 2 teaspoons soft brown sugar
instructions: Mix the oats, cream, irish cream, orange, coriander, star anise, sugar and brown sugar together. Leave to sit for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir well before serving with fresh vegetables, fish, bread or roast meat.

title: Lamb's New Brunswick Cutlets with Pepper
ingredients: 1 pound beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped peanuts | 1/8 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Score each beef slice on the grain of the beef tenderloin, cutting deep slits almost all the way through. Heat 1/4 cup peanut oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Brown the beef on all sides, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,chunky peanut butter,clam,white sugar,feta,sultana,snow pea,dill
title: Peanut Curry with Clam Salad
ingredients: 100 g sultanas | 100 g thinely sliced chunky peanut butter | 300 g chopped clams | 2 -3 tablespoons white sugar | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 50 g feta ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill
instructions: Mix the first seven ingredients together well. Heat in the microwave for 4 minutes on high. Remove from heat and stir. Garnish with fresh dill. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Quick Tangy Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped red chili ( red can be used in yemen or other asian countries )
instructions: Place all ingredients, except tamarind paste, into a bowl. Mix to combine. Let sit for another 10 minutes or so in the fridge. Stir, then serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red onion,silver tequila,banana liqueur,bell pepper,sage,champagne vinegar,caesar salad dressing,taco seasoning
title: Taquitos Salad
ingredients: 1 small red onion, halved and sliced very thinly | 3 tablespoons champagne vinegar | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon rubbed sage | 1/2 bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 banana liqueur ( or other brandy ) | 1/2 cup silver tequila ( or other brandy ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix the onion, vinegar, taco seasoning, bacon drippings or olive oil, sage and pepper in a large salad bowl.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,achiote paste,raisin,filet beef,anaheim chile pepper,pear
title: Raisin-Crusted Beef
ingredients: 10 lbs fresh round filet of beef, center cut cut | 4 ears fresh pear, peeled and cored | 8 ounces anaheim chile peppers, charred ( or 1 jalapeno ) | 1 tablespoon achiote paste ( i used achiote and chili sauce and oil ) | 1 -2 tablespoon red chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f rub the whole piece of beef with achiote paste and chili powder. Wrap the brisket tightly in heavy aluminum foil. Place on a rack in a roasting pan. Roast for 5 hours, shaking the pan every hour or so to dislodge any brown bits from the pan. Let cool completely. Slice into 1/4 inch thick slices and serve with lots of sauce. These recipes can be doubled.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,orange zest,tabasco sauce,ghee,poppy seed,tangerine,raspberry preserve,jalapeno chile
title: Tangerine Raspberry Bombs
ingredients: 1 lb fresh strawberries | 1/2 lb tangerine | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon ghee | 4 -6 drops tabasco sauce | 3 -4 minced seeded jalapeno chiles | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest
instructions: Clean fruit and cut into 1/2 inch dice. Combine vegetable with oil and ghee stir and set aside. Toss chilies with poppy seeds, orange zest in remaining 1/2 teaspoon of oil. Brush off any excess flour and place the fruit in small paper sack. Place in oven and cook 10 - 15 minutes, until fruit looks dry and chilies darkened. When fruit is done let stand five minutes. Remove seeds and zest from fruit with a slotted spoon and arrange on a platter with a sprinkling of poppy seed mixture. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,beef,bulk pork sausage,white fish fillet,bread,broiler fryer chicken,paprika,beef steak
title: Hamburger Soup With Sausage
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs fresh lean beef ( or up to 1lb. filet mignon ) | 4 large broiler-fryer chickens | 1 lb bulk pork sausage | 6 large fresh jalapenos | 6 large white fish fillets | 8 slices fresh bread | paprika | 2 lbs ground beef
instructions: Rinse beef and chicken well, removing excess fat. Cut chicken into slices.

title: String Beans and Fresh Fruit
ingredients: 500 g string beans, trimmed | 4 tablespoons mango chutney ( i use roland brand ) | 1 water chestnut, sliced
instructions: Fry the string beans in a large frying pan until golden brown. Remove string beans and keep warm. Add mango chutney to pan and mix well with string beans. Add water chestnut slices and cook for a couple of minutes. Serve warm with plain rice.

title: Broccoli - Broccoli "pizza"
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli, chopped | 1 package brown gravy mix | 3 tablespoons reduced-sugar substitute | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup low sodium prepared low-sodium mirin | 1 small orange, cut up ( optional )
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. In food processor, combine gravy mix, parmesan cheese, mirin, orange and broccoli pieces. Pulse until broccoli is evenly mixed. Pour into a 13x9 inch pan, or a 1/2 cup baking dish, and bake at 375ºf for about 25 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,mushroom,mai fun rice noodle,double cream,mango,peanut butter,hoisin sauce,cottage cheese
title: Panda Express Dipping Mango Hoisin Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons mango-flavoured fresh mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons plain bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon double cream | 1 ounce small curd cottage cheese or 1 ounce light cream cheese | 2 teaspoons mango-flavoured fresh mushrooms, chopped | 2 teaspoons hoisin sauce | 3 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter ( crunchy ) | 1 packet mai fun rice noodles
instructions: Heat the grill / oven to hot. Line a 1 pint glass container with baking paper, but leave 2 of the slices in all and put them on the top shelf of the grill / oven to dry out. To make the dipping sauce, mix the sauces ingredients together. Serve the mixture on individual plate surrounded by the crunchy peanut butter. If using mai fun, you may want to make a double batch of mai fun noodles or a bag of mung fun noodles, but this is not a one that you want to have any guests to dip.

title: Paneer-Style French Bread
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1/4 cup tomato puree
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the yeast and the tomato puree. Leave to soften for a few minutes. Place the warm breadmaker on wheat setting, and let the breadmaker rest for about 5 minutes using the suggested method of your breadmaker's manual setting. Place the breadmaker on low, and press start.

title: Banana, Prosciutto and Orange Jam
ingredients: 1/2 kg fresh banana | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Cut peeled bananas into small pieces and place in pan with orange juice and rind and zest. Cook gently until bananas are soft and beginning to soften but not as mushy as you like them. Add the thinly sliced prosciutto and continue to cook until they are glistening. Add any juices that have collected. Remove from heat and stir till smooth with a wooden spoon and let stand for 1 hour and then strain through a cheesecloth. Serve with ice cream.

title: Burgers With Cherry Tomatoes and Clementines
ingredients: 1 bag cherry tomatoes ( with stems ) | 14 slices tomatoes | 4 ounces cooked hamburger | 1 tablespoon minced white onion | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | white pepper | 1/2 clementine, zested and diced
instructions: Place all ingredients except tomatoes and clementine zest in a food processor and process until well blended. Scrape down sides of processor as needed. Blend until thick paste consistency is achieved. Refrigerate and chill in covered container until ready to use. Serve with burgers.

Random Ingredients: watercress,grape,whipping cream,chuck roast,plain nonfat yogurt,ginger root,filling,clove
title: Savory Shredded Beef With Raita
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chuck roast, trimmed of fat and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons ginger root, peeled and grated | 2 tablespoons watercress, chopped | 1 cup seedless grapes | 1 pint chilled whipping cream | 1 pinch ground cloves | filling : | 4 cloves roasted plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Place the beef in a shallow, nonmetal bowl and pour enough water over the beef to cover. Mix in 1 cup of yogurt. In a blender or food processor, process 1 onion and 2 ginger, 1 tablespoon of watercress, grapes and remaining yogurt. Toast the cloves in a skillet over medium heat, stirring, until fragrant and starting to blacken, about 1 minute. Pour the yogurt mixture over beef, and toss well. Transfer to a serving platter, sprinkle with remaining onion and ginger, and chill. Serve with the remaining yogurt.

title: Spanish Roast Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck, jointed | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 2 medium tomatoes, skinned, canned, chopped | 1/2 cup dry panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 2 tablespoons split polished chilies | 1/2 cup soda water | 1 cup tomato puree
instructions: Combine mace in small bowl with tomato, panko and sultanas. Place all ingredients in large bowl and mix well. Put mixture into a large roasting tray and place in oven for two hours, or until thermometer reads 160°c mark remove from oven. Remove roasting tray from oven and place on serving platter. Serve hot with salad.

Random Ingredients: creamy italian salad dressing,bell pepper,ciabatta,celery seed,anise seed,cranberry,cumin powder
title: Tunisian Panini Bread Dip Duo
ingredients: 3 loaves ciabatta 1 3/4 thick slices ciabatta | 4 -6 tablespoons zesty creamy italian salad dressing or 4 -6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 large unpeeled bell pepper, quartered | 1 medium unpeeled sweet onion, quartered | 3 teaspoons dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon anise seed ( i think these aren't so readily available ) | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 f. Lightly oil or coat a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Remove and discard the crusts and set the cut sides aside. Slice the bread into 1/4 thick slices. I usually use a serrated knife and slice them in half to make nice, thin slices. In a large serving bowl combine all the dry ingredients. Place the bread in the bowl and coat with the dry ingredients. Spread the bread out in a single layer on top of the salad dressing mixture evenly. Bake for about 30 minutes or until the bread has a nice crunch to it. Remove and cool slightly.. After about 30 minutes, cut into quarters or six slices if desired. Serve with a nice crusty french or italian bread, salad dressing or crudites. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,goat cheese,pineapple tidbit,egg yolk,pita bread,brandy,red pepper flake,vegetable
title: Sweet Stuffed Pita Bread
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers, split | 2 large egg yolks, beaten | 1/4 cup brandy | 1 1/2 cups fresh pineapple tidbits ( optional ) | 8 tablespoons crumbled soft fresh goat cheese | 1 large red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 pita breads, sliced | vegetables, for stuffing ( optional ) or vegetable oil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Line a medium size baking sheet with parchment paper, or lightly oil the baking sheet. Slice open the entire package of ladyfingers, and make a small slit along the length at one of the wide ends. Split them into halves to form triangles. To stuff, place 2 egg yolks in a bowl, and whip lightly while you whisk in 2 tblsp brandy until mixed. Spoon 1 tblsp brandy mixture into the slit, and top with half of the pineapple tidbits, if using, and 1 tblsp soft gherkins or 1/2 tsp of crumbled soft fresh goat cheese. Close the slit, and place in the oven. Bake for 15 minutes, watching for steam to escape, then remove from oven and open up the package and set aside. Remove the inner perimeter of each triangle from the parchment paper, and spread 2 tblsp of goat's cheese on one side of the triangle and top with the other half of the triangles. Place open pita triangles on a plate. Place a dollop of stuffing in the center of the triangle and place on top of the cheese. Close the top edge of the wrap, and wrap the outside edge of wrap in the center, making a pouch. Brush the outside edges with egg yolks, and place onto a prepared baking sheet, and top with a little vegetable oil. Cover the baking sheet with foil, and bake for 10 minutes. Remove foil, and spread the pita breads out flat. Open the pouch, and carefully open pouch for the last 2 - 3 minutes, to allow steam to escape. Remove from oven, and top with a little grated fresh goat's cheese.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,tomato puree,celery rib,dark raisin,spanish olive,plain flour,sultana,sugar
title: Sultana and Raisins Stuffed Spanish Olives
ingredients: 4 large spanish olives, scrubbed from the green stems | 1 teaspoon dark raisin | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 12 tablespoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 6 tablespoons sultanas, chopped very coarsely
instructions: Heat oven to c. Grease a baking sheet. Place raisins in a bowl of cold water and soak for 6 - 8 minutes until soft. Remove from water, drain and leave in the water. Place raisins, soy sauce and tomato puree in a food processor and blend for 4 - 5 seconds. Add flour, sugar, soy sauce and sultanas. Using about 1/4 cup mixture for each stuffed olive, pipe it about 12 small circles into baking tins or a 25 cm circle on to the baking sheet, leaving a small area for the filling. Leave to cool in the fridge. Heat oven to 200c. Line a 20 x 1 cm lamington tin with baking paper, leaving 3cm overhang so that the olives will stick later. Place olives in the tin and spoon over most of the filling. Put in the oven for approx 30 - 45 minutes, until crisp and golden. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,salt,coconut cream,mango chutney,tomato soup,wheat pasta,asparagus
title: Vegetarian Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 kg whole wheat pasta | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 200 g asparagus, trimmed | 1 tablespoon tomato soup | 100 ml coconut cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons mango chutney | 1 dash salt
instructions: Cook pasta following packet directions. Meanwhile, heat oil in a pan. Add asparagus and cook for three minutes stir in soup, mango chutney and sunflower oil. Add tomato sauce and salt and cook another 3 minutes. Drain pasta and return to pot. Spoon sauce over the pasta and serve.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,chocolate syrup,green chilies,cumin seed,pie crust,ginger paste,pistachio,oyster sauce
title: Pista
ingredients: 1 pie crust | 100 g unsalted pistachios | 500 g green chilies | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 10 g golden raisins | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup | chopped pistachios
instructions: Bake the crust for 10 minutes in a pre heated oven. While the crust is baking heat all the other ingredients in a pan and allow them to cool. After 10 minutes cut the chilled crust into four squares and coat with the cooled pistachios. Once the crust has cooled remove it from the oven and add all the filling to the top. Spread pistachios on the top and serve.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,chicken drumstick,black olive,liquid honey,yellow tomato,black currant,chili,olive oil
title: Ww Chicken Algerian
ingredients: 2 chicken drumsticks ( with or without the skin, or 3 - 10 per serving ) | 1 cup black olives ( drained and chopped, pitted and drained ) | 1/2 cup black currants | 1 tablespoon chili ( finely chopped ) | 3 -4 tablespoons liquid honey | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 cup yellow tomato ( finely chopped ) | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Place chicken in a plastic bag, pour in marinade except the oil and add onions, olives, currants, chilli and honey. Place on a sheet pan, with sides, or on the rack of a grill pan. Grill, covered, over medium heat until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,red bell pepper,baking potato,red pepper,dark rum
title: Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, scrubbed | 2 red bell peppers, cut into thin strips | 3 tablespoons light dark rum | 2 tablespoons fresh peppercorns, crushed | 1 teaspoon red pepper, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Scrub potatoes, prick 2/3 of potatoes with a knife twice and bake at 400f for 40 minutes.. Turn potatoes and bake another 20 to 30 minutes longer or until tender. While potatoes bake make all of the dressing. When potatoes are finished baking, stir rum over potatoes. Heat oven to 450f. Transfer potatoes and dressing to a large baking dish and bake at 450f for 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Tortilla Cheese Rolls (Healthy!)
ingredients: 6 -8 soft tortillas | 1/2 lb fresh cottage cheese | 1/2 cup dark raisin | 1/2 cup fresh basil sprig | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dark raisin, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread out tortillas on a baking sheet. Lightly rub the tops with olive oil. Combine cottage cheese, raisins, soy sauce, and dark raisins in a food processor. Spread a thin layer of cottage cheese mixture across one half of each tortilla. Roll up the tortillas tightly and cut in half. Repeat as necessary to make at least 6 tortillas total. Place rolls on baking sheet and bake about 15 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Microwave Heart and Bacon Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef heart, sliced finely | 1/2 lb gouda cheese, grated | 4 pieces bacon, finely chopped | 1 large corn on the cob, cut into chunks
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, cover and cook in microwave on high for 3 minutes.

title: Soy Wood Wood Polish
ingredients: 1 ounce soy sauce | 1 ounce wood ear cloud tea, coarsley crushed
instructions: Mix together and strain. Pour into hot sterilized jars, seal or freeze, label and serve.

title: Cannellini Beans With Vodka
ingredients: 2 lbs cannellini beans | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 1 vodka
instructions: Wash beans and rinse. Place beans in pot with water and bring to a boil, covered. Add red pepper and simmer about 1 hour until tender.. Remove from heat and add vodka. Cover and let sit for 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,vegetable stock chicken,onion soup mix,vanilla sugar,phyllo pastry,red wine,swiss cheese,sun tomato
title: Beef & Swiss Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups cubed swiss cheese | 1 cup cubed dried sweet onion soup mix | 12 ounces low-sodium vegetable stock ( or chicken stock ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 12 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 tablespoon grated vanilla sugar ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cubed reduced-fat swiss cheese ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons thinly sliced pickled jalapeno peppers ( optional )
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of the cubed swiss cheese and 1/2 cup of the dried onions soup mix in a large bowl. Add one cup of the vegetable stock. Stir until a dry paste is formed. If using chicken stock, add at least one cup of it. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit. Drain and rinse out the spinach. Place 3 sheets of phyllo in the center of a baking sheet. Divide the spinach filling among them. Fold the phyllo wrapped spinach over the spinach filling. Place on top of the other sheets of phyllo. Brush top sheet with oil. Repeat with other sheets, brushing each with oil. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of powdered sugar, one teaspoon of sun dried tomatoes and the remaining 2 teaspoons of powdered sugar. Drizzle evenly over the phyllo wraps. Bake in the preheated oven until all of the filling is bubbly and cooked through, about 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly. Slice in strips, garnish with the remaining 2 to 3 sun dried tomatoes and jalapenos if using. Enjoy.

title: Rose Petals &  Grissini Chips
ingredients: 2 2 cups vegetable or chicken broth | 12 rose petals, sliced thinly | 12 chocolate or 12 chocolate chips
instructions: Put broth in a saucepan with rose petals. Heat for about 2 minutes. Cover and set aside. To make chips, take one sheet of plastic wrap and a few rose petals and slice each into four. Dip melted chocolate in the hot broth and leave them until hard. Spread softened butter over melted butter. Dip the chips into the melted chocolate, then set them on wax paper in a warm place until they are crisp.

title: Bergie's Ziploc Bagels
ingredients: 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon ground black cumin
instructions: Mix paprika, ground cumin. Using your hands, shape smoked bacon into bagels.. Seal bagels, and let sit on the counter for 20 to 30 minutes, shaking the bagels occasionally to make sure bacon is evenly browned.

Random Ingredients: spinach,amaretto almond liqueur,apple,garbanzo bean,cardamom seed,chicken bouillon cube
title: Apple Spinach Hummus
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons apple-flavored instant minced onion and garlic powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon garbanzo beans, dried | 1/4 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup loosely chopped fresh spinach | 1 teaspoon amaretto almond liqueur
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together onion and garlic powder, cardamom, garbanzo beans, and 1/4 teaspoon salt until well blended. Place spinach in a microwave safe measuring cup. Cover, and microwave on high until heated through, about 1 minute. Set aside. Pour the amaretto into the microwave, and stir. Add the apple mixture, and microwave on high until heated through, about 1 minute. Stir. Cover, and microwave on high until heated through, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: korean red chili pepper flake,chinese mushroom,taco seasoning,parma ham,brussels sprout
title: Korean Style Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 lbs brussels sprouts | 1/4 lb parma ham ( sliced thin ) | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning ( i use paul prima prosciutto ) | 2 teaspoons korean red chili pepper flakes ( gochujahng ) | 1/2 cup chinese mushroom, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Slice brussels sprouts into two to three sections. Sprinkle generously with taco seasoning. Cook until sprouts are tender about 5 to 10 minute. Cut parma ham into one inch chunks. Heat wok over high until smoking.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,grain white rice,water chestnut
title: Thai Red Curry Rice
ingredients: 3 cups long-grain white rice | 4 cans water chestnuts, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons thai red curry paste, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place rice, water chestnuts, and curry paste in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring frequently to keep from sticking. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, and liquid has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,daikon radish,tomato garlic,jalapeno,beer,spaghetti sauce,sambal oelek,pasta shell
title: Shiitake and Beer Pasta With Daikon Radishes
ingredients: 5 shiitake mushrooms, thinly sliced | 4 jalapenos, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup tomato-garlic infused beer | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 package of shell pasta shells | 1 medium daikon radish, cut into strips | 3 tablespoons sambal oelek or 3 tablespoons other hot sauce
instructions: Over medium high heat, saute mushrooms and jalapenos in a little bit of oil until they've begun to caramelize a bit. Reduce the heat, and add the tomato garlic infused beer. Simmer. While the pot of vegetables is simmering, cook the pasta as directed on package. Toss hot cooked pasta into the sauce after you put it with the sauteed mushrooms and jalapenos. Toss with the vegetables. Serve topped with a couple of spoonsfuls of sauce.

title: Agnate Fresca (Swiss Cheese Ball)
ingredients: 8 cups shredded swiss cheese blend (,,, swiss, provolone, or other ) | 1 1/2 cups cooked white breadcrumbs ( or other cracker bread )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. On a baking sheet, scatter cheese and cracker bread crumbs evenly on the baking sheet. Bake for 12 minutes. Do not overbake. Remove from oven, spread cheese over crumbs.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,almond paste,teriyaki sauce,onion juice,rhubarb,coconut water,rice wine vinegar,bread crumb
title: Curry Rice Balls With Glazed Sweet Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs rhubarb, sliced into 1/4 inch pieces | 2 cups fresh bread crumbs | 1 cup onion juice | 1 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 can almond paste | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut water | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place rhubarb in a 9x13x2 inch baking dish. Mix together bread crumbs, onion juice, vinegar, almond paste, oil, coconut water, garlic, and teriyaki sauce in a bowl until smooth. Pour seasoned crumbs over rhubarb and bake at 400 for 40 to 45 minutes, until rhubarb is tender.

title: Chilean Blackened Squash
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bitter melon ( halved and seeded ) | 1 yellow squash ( stemmed, seeded, and cut into 1-inch cubes, then cut into 1 inch cubes ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange melon cubes in 3 large ovenproof skillet, 3 inches apart, sprinkle with thyme, then arrange squash over top. Top evenly with cubed bitter melon cubes and sprinkle with parsley. Broil, turning frequently, until squash is very tender, 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer to serving plate. Serve hot, warm, or at room temperature.

title: Green Bean & Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat bran | 1 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 can cut green beans, drained | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Combine bran and chopped onion in a bowl. Drain well. Add green beans, cook and stir 2 minutes or until heated through. Stir in dried cranberries just before serving.

title: Scalloped Watermelon and Pesto Biscuits
ingredients: 125 g pesto | 4 tablespoons watermelon or 4 tablespoons pineapple juice | 250 g scallops | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh rocket or 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh cheese | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 400 g buttermilk biscuits, roughly crushed | 1/4 cup finely chopped lettuce
instructions: Boil the watermelon until just softened and mushy. Meanwhile, place the scallops in a colander and set over a bowl. Dressing, combine the pesto, watermelon, scallops, rocket or cheese, biscuit crumbs and bicarb. Spoon over the scallops and mix well. Press half of the biscuit mixture into the base of a 30cm x 10cm greased baking tray or line with baking paper. Spoon 1/4 of the watermelon mixture into the centre of the biscuit base and top with half the scallop mix. Repeat with remainder of the ingredients. Bake in a moderate oven for 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Venezuelan Green Chili
ingredients: 1/2 cup green chili pepper, pureed | 1/2 cup vanilla bean ( or 2 teaspoons vanilla extract )
instructions: Puree the chilie until smooth. Pour into a heat proof dish or pitcher. Top with vanilla bean. To serve, dilute with 1 - 2 tablespoons of sugar or just 1 teaspoon of vanilla.

title: Chili Gravy Dip  (For  Machine  Me)
ingredients: 1 packet pre-made brown gravy mix | 4 tablespoons finely chopped green chili peppers ( optional )
instructions: Pour the gravy mix into the appropriate pie pan.

Random Ingredients: italian cheese,garlic powder,ginger,papaya nectar,green bell pepper
title: Papaya Nectar Ginger Shredded Vegetable
ingredients: 1 can papayas nectar | 2 teaspoons minced ginger | 1/4 cup italian cheese blend, shredded | 1/4 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a skillet. Cook over medium heat until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: poundcake,tomato paste,cauliflower,soy sauce,grape leaf,radish,monterey jack cheese
title: Vegetable Rollatini
ingredients: 1 pound poundcake, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices | 1 cup grape leaves | 10 large radishes, sliced | 1 package monterey jack cheese blend, shredded | 1 jar grape leaves, drained | 1 can tomato paste | 4 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/2 cup chopped pickled cauliflower
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray cookie sheets with cooking spray. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Arrange cake slices evenly in two horizontal rows of three slices on cookie sheets. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned and dry. Arrange grape leaves and radishes in a narrow strip of waxed paper around outside edge of each slice. Top each rectangle with a sprinkling of cheese. Starting at edge of one long side, roll up long side, jelly roll fashion. Chill roll for 1 to 2 hours. Spread the cheese evenly over roll. Arrange roll in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Bake in oven 15 to 20 minutes, until top is bubbly and lightly browned. Cool slightly. Remove roll from cookie sheet to plates. Spoon tomato paste over roll. Cut roll into 4 servings.

title: Spiced Onion Samosas
ingredients: 2 lbs onions, halved and sliced thin | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Preheat broiler or grill. Put the onions in a baking tray or roasting pan with enough space between them to allow them to dry out. Turn after about 10 minutes, just enough to brown. If they are burning, just let them cook longer. Transfer to a plastic bag or bowl, leaving the onions in pieces. Add the ginger garlic paste. Put into the hot oven for about an hour. The skins should have begun to pop and smell wonderful, but they don't have to cook all that long, as the onions will be done after sitting and cool down for an hour or so before storing in a tightly closed bottle.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,flat leaf parsley,white wine,steak,sultana,active yeast,havarti cheese,purpose flour
title: P Fye Rustica (Havarti Cheese Rolls)
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 cups sifted all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon white wine | 2/3 cup finely chopped havarti cheese | 1/2 cup sliced flat leaf parsley, divided | 1/4 cup sultana ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons finely chopped sultanas
instructions: In large bowl, mix 2 cups flour, yeast and vegetable oil. Mix well until foamy. Add 3 cups flour, 1 tablespoon white wine and 1 tablespoon of parsley to yeast mixture and mix to make a soft dough. Gradually add remaining flour little by little and stir into mix. When dough comes together, turn onto lightly floured surface and knead for 2 or 3 minutes. Place dough in a large greased bowl, turning dough to grease top. Cover with dry cloth and let rise in middle of warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Punch dough down and knead lightly on floured surface. Shape dough into round loaf, about 2 1/2 inches in diameter. Place loaf on greased greased cookie sheet, turning dough so greased side is up. Cover and let rise 20 minutes. Brush top with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, scatter remaining 1 tablespoon of parsley over loaf, and sprinkle tops with sultanas. Allow dough to rise again until doubled, about 40 minutes. Preheat oven to place a baking stone on broiler pan with high sides and heat until it puffs up lightly. Brush top with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil and lightly sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon of parsley. Bake bread until loaf is golden and tinged brown about 35 minutes. Cool on wire rack and cut in 1 inch slices.

title: Portuguese Party Vodka
ingredients: 16 small red chilies | 12 fluid ounces vodka | 12 fluid ounces pepsi or 12 fluid ounces pepsi | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 dash hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Heat the grill. On the grill, place the chilies on the rack in an unlit pan, and char the chilies over medium heat until blackened and charred, turning them frequently. Set the chilies aside to cool, then peel and remove the ribs. Cut the chilies into chunks. Add the vodka to a small saucepan, and warm until it is slightly reduced, about 3 minutes. Pour into the chilies, pour in the Pepsi, and stir a few times to combine. Stir the kidney beans into the pot, and return to the stove. Cook over medium heat until heated through, about 3 minutes, stirring and breaking up the beans with a wooden spoon. Serve either warm or cold.

title: Sushi Nori Appetizing
ingredients: 6 cups fresh mixed chopped vegetables | 1 bell pepper, thinly sliced lengthwise and separated from the other | 1 -2 firm ripe peach, peeled and cut crosswise into 1-inch slices | 6 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Wash asparagus, trim any tough ends, and cut into 3 inch lengths or so. Cut each piece into 2 or 3 inch lengths. Set aside in a bowl or freezer bag. Mix vegetables, pepper strips, and peaches together, or put all ingredients in a plastic bag and put to the side. Add the cayenne pepper. Dry seaweed sheets at regular intervals to prevent sticking. When ready to serve, spread seaweed sheets with a damp cloth or paper towels.

Random Ingredients: green chili salsa,turnip,sardine,vanilla sugar,jalapeno chile,white fish,beef bouillon cube
title: Easy Baked Sardines With Turnips and Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs white fish, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can of chopped turnips | 1 can of chopped jalapeno chiles | 1 pint of green chili salsa | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1 can saardines ( with liquid )
instructions: In a large pot put the green chilies and 1 quart of boiling water. Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes. Add the fish and cook for about 10 minutes. Add the turnips, jalenilla and vanilla. Let simmer for about 10 more minutes and take the cover off. Put the saardines in an oven proof dish. Bake at 425 degrees for about 30 minutes, just until the fish is a little pink. Put the saardines under the broiler to brown. Serve with chili sauce.

title: Chocolate-Pepper Clam Chowder
ingredients: 2 cups bottled clam juice | 7 ounces sweet dark chocolate | 12 ounces frozen asparagus or 12 ounces fresh asparagus tips, thawed and cut in half | 6 canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine clam juice and chocolate over medium heat. Stir until chocolate has melted. Add asparagus tips and chickpeas, bring to boil.

title: Rice and Apricot Balls
ingredients: 1 medium onion, finely chopped | 1/2 lb short-grain rice | 1 jar apricots, drained and chopped | 1 envelope dried italian dressing | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 4 ounces ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups tapioca flour
instructions: In a small saucepan, cook the chopped onion in hot water for 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in the rice and apricots. In a small bowl, combine the italian dressing, onion flakes and 1 cup water. Make a well in the center. Gradually stir in the flour. Turn the mixture into a lightly floured plate. Roll the mixture into small balls about 2 inches larger in diameter. In batches, gently slide the rice balls into the hot broth. Gently brown on all sides. Drain well on paper towels. Serve warm.

title: The Easiest Hawaiian Oats
ingredients: 2 cups quick cooking oats | 3/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together, and make more of each ingredient if using frozen cut oats. Cook about 2 minute or just until you desired browning.

Random Ingredients: pearl sugar,red cabbage,heavy cream,plain flour,manchego cheese,bay leaf
title: Pierogies with Caramelized Red Cabbage
ingredients: 75 g plain flour | 1 bay leaf | 300 ml heavy cream | 250 g manchego cheese, roughly chopped | 300 g red cabbage, shredded | 2 tablespoons pearl sugar
instructions: Blend flour with a bay leaf. Whisk in cream, cheese, cabbage and sugar until almost smooth.

title: Tse-Tse's Flank Steak (Bulgogi)
ingredients: 1 cup thinly sliced steak | 1 cup quick-cooking oil, or as needed
instructions: Combine steak and quick cooking oil in a large plastic bag. Shake to coat. Refrigerate and marinate at least 1 hour. Drain, discarding marinade, and bring a pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Remove steak from marinade and place on a board. Using two dinner forks, pull steak into the boiling water. When the steak floats to the top, cook about 1 minute each side, or until desired doneness.

title: Melon Sausages - Australi Style
ingredients: 1 lb chicken-flied pork fillet, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 lb cantaloupe
instructions: Cut cantaloupe into 1 inch pieces and place in a pan of water with sugar. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer over medium heat for 1 hour or until tender. Cool slightly and remove skin. Cut into 1 inch pieces and toss with 1/4 cup of cantaloupe juice from your pan. Replace skin if needed. If you want to freeze, put in plastic bags and freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Barley Salad
ingredients: 225 g pearl barley | 3 heads aubergines, sliced crossways | 300 g snow peas, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons oil or 2 tablespoons salad dressing | 1/4 cup bottled reduced-fat pimiento, drained | 1/4 cup vinaigrette
instructions: Cook barley in 2 cups boiling water for 8 minutes or until tender and ara until just tender. Drain and cool under running water. Drain reserving 2/3 cup barley and set aside. Cook aubergines in a small non stick frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes or until just tender. Remove from pan and cut diagonally into 4 pieces. Place in a large bowl with the snow peas and vinaigrette and toss to coat. Add dressing to barley and toss or serve at once.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,pine nut,poultry seasoning,red chili powder,gruyere cheese,asparagus,yellow potato,orange juice lime
title: Tangy Sweet Potato & Asparagus Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 4 fresh asparagus, trimmed ( or 1 cup frozen asparagus spears ) | 16 yellow potatoes, such as red bliss | 1/3 cup pine nuts ( optional ) | 4 large lettuce leaves ( optional ) | 8 slices gruyere cheese ( optional ) | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons red chili powder
instructions: In a large pot, bring water to a boil over medium heat and add asparagus. Cover and cook for 7 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Peel potatoes if using fresh potatoes. Dice potatoes into 1/2 inch cubes. Line greased grilling pan or skillet with aluminum foil. Remove asparagus and slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Place potatoes on foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Grill over high heat for 5 minutes to brown. Turn and grill 10 minutes. Remove from heat and cut potatoes into 1/2 inch slices. Place 3 slices of cheese on each of four plates. Place asparagus in a bowl with 3/4 cup orange juice or lime juice and 1 tablespoon red chili powder. Pour 1/4 cup orange juice or lime juice over top. Top with 3 or 4 slices of le gruyere cheese and 1 or 2 slices of asparagus. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon orange or lime juice over top of sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,purpose flour,rigatoni pasta,brandy,garlic powder,golden syrup,monterey jack cheese,pineapple
title: Turtles on the Barbie
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 cup crumbled monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup crumbled pineapple | 2 tablespoons brandy ( or orange juice ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3/4 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup golden syrup ( or brown sugar ) | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Rinse with cool water.

title: Scoop
ingredients: 3 1/2 fluid ounces vanilla extract | 3 3/4 fluid ounces ice water | 3 1/2 ounces marshmallows | 2 navel oranges, washed, pith removed, and pith cut away
instructions: Melt 4 1/2 fluid ounces of vanilla extract in the top of a double boiler over very little scalding water. Stir in the ice water and marshmallows. Place the remaining 3 1/2 fluid ounces of flavoring in a shaker and shake vigorously to blend. Strain into a decorative glass or cup. Garnish each serving with a slice of orange.

title: British Sausages
ingredients: 4 sausages, cumberland | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup whole black olives | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Remove casings from sausages, if necessary and place them on a baking sheet. Bake them on a cookie sheet, covered with foil, for 20 minutes. Turn, spread olive over them, and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until the sausages are golden brown and crispy to the touch. To serve, sprinkle the sausages with graham cracker crumbs and black olives. Add syrup.

title: My Own Caraway Mixture
ingredients: 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening
instructions: Add all ingredients to a medium bowl and mash until it resembles a paste. If needed, add more vegetable shortening. You may need to add more butter.

title: Cranberry-Spiced Cranberry Dip
ingredients: 2 cups cranberry juice | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 2 teaspoons canned cranberry-infused cranberry juice, such as the juice of 2 fresh cranberries
instructions: Pour the 2 cups cranberry juice into a small pot over medium low heat. Add the thyme and bring to a boil. Remove the thyme sprigs. Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes, or until the cranberries have burst. Remove the pot from the heat, add the cranberry flavoring, and stir. Transfer the cranberry mixture to a serving dish and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,liquid smoke,scallion,sharp cheddar cheese,mirin,basmati rice,chili sauce,sesame seed
title: Spicy Japanese Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 1 cup basmati rice | 1/3 cup sesame seeds | 2 scallions, chopped | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup fresh basil | 1/2 cup orange marmalade
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for at least 2 hours. Serve with dressing for dipping a salad.

title: Homemade Chunky Onion Rings
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs medium cooking onions | 2 green onions, chopped
instructions: Wash and pierce the onions in several places with a sharp knife, and place in a large pot. Cover with cold water.

title: Hot Mushroom Hot Sauce
ingredients: 12 dried shiitake mushrooms | 3 teaspoons ground coriander
instructions: Remove the stems and finely slice the caps. Place the mushrooms in a small bowl with the coriander. Toss the mushroom with the hot paprika, place on a plate, and serve.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,tortilla,lime powder,ketchup,beef bouillon cube,cornstarch,lime,white wine vinegar
title: Crispy Chipotle Beef Strips
ingredients: 12 large beef bouillon cubes ( about 3-1/2 lb. ) | 1 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon chopped canned chipotle chiles | 1 tablespoon lime powder | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 36 tortillas ( about 5-inch ) | cooked shredded jalapeno ( or other hot pepper )
instructions: Combine beef boullion cubes, cornstarch, 4 tbsp vinegar and ketchup in a large bowl, stir well. Add chili, lime powder, 1/2 cup vinegar and chopped chipoltes.

title: Red Pepper Relish - Dry
ingredients: 1 lb red pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 lb superfine sugar ( dr. oetker's sugar sugar ) | coriander powder
instructions: Mix well. Store in clean dry glass bottles or jar.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,cream mushroom soup,marmite,pinto bean,cooking onion
title: Crock Pot Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup ( i like cream of celery ) | 1 packet hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing and seasoning mix ( not dry ) | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion | 1 tablespoon marsmite ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon your favourite cheese spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Place on bottom of crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 8 hours. Do not lift lid for last hour to let fat evaporate. Serve over rice of beans or use as a side dish, or just a topping for veggies of your choice. Can add a sprinkle of paprika, minced onion or cilantro for extra kick.

Random Ingredients: fruit,msg,chicken bouillon,thyme sprig,serrano pepper,pickle,farfalle pasta,lime wedge
title: Hot Dog Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs farfalle pasta, about 2 cups | 4 -8 serrano peppers, coarsely chopped | 2 cans chicken bouillon ( or equivalent ) | 3 teaspoons msg ( or other optional msg ) | 4 fresh thyme sprigs | 3 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit, such as raspberries, strawberries, peaches or apricots, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup lime wedge
instructions: In a large pot, bring 2 quarts of water to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine farfalle pasta, serrano peppers, hot dogs, bouillon, msg, thyme and chopped mixed fruit. Cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 to 7 minutes or until pasta is al dente and flavors have mingled.

title: Poached Chicken Wellington (Chicken Tarte Tatin Et Aux Pommes Et Erbette)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons arrowroot | 1 bay leaf | 9 ounces chicken tenders, cut in half lengthwise | 7 ounces whipping cream, warmed | 7 ounces puff pastry, cut into 2 inch squares | 5 large figs, quartered
instructions: Boil the water and add the arrowroot dissolved in it, the bay leaf and the chicken tenders. When the chicken is just cooked, remove it from the pan and set aside for 3 - 4 mins to cool slightly. Then take each piece of chicken off the bone and discard the bones and obvious white fat from the tenders. Add the cream to the pot and simmer for a minute or two to thicken the cream. Line the plate with 1 layer of puff pastry and place over the top of the sheet. Add the chicken and some of the sauce to the pastry. Repeat the layers and top with a final layer of pastry. Dust with sugar and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: sherry,halloumi cheese,cake flour,watermelon,apple cider,whipping cream,cumin powder,wheat pastry flour
title: Fried Halloumi
ingredients: 2 cups sherry ( dry ) | 2 apples ( medium size ) | 2 cups finely chopped walnuts or 2 cups pecans | 1/2 cup sweet sherry | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup sweet sherry ( dry ) | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon grated ibarra cheese or 1 teaspoon bardelle cheese | 1 1/2 cups cooked watermelon, diced
instructions: Chop apples and walnuts. Cook apples and walnuts in half sherry and cumin for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Mix sherry, sherry, cumin and cream into sherry mixture. When well blended, spoon into a greased 15 x 10 x 1 inch jelly roll pan. Dollop equal amounts of fruit mixture onto pan and sprinkle with cheese. Bake in 450 degree oven for 15 minute remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,flax seed,pineapple juice,white onion,chipotle chile,yellow mustard,kalamata olive,purpose flour
title: Sweet Apple Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup yellow mustard | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, sliced | 1/2 cup white onion, finely chopped | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and finely chopped | 1 chipotle chile, finely chopped | 1 ounce flax seed
instructions: In a bowl combine flour and pineapple juice and let sit for 10 minutes stirring a few times. Add mustard, olives, onion, apple, chipotle and flaxseed. Heat over the lowest possible heat for about 5 minutes, stirring all the time to avoid burning the kalatole. Strain mixture from the bowl and serve. Note, for an added kick to the finished product add a pinch of salt and/or sugar.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,pancake syrup,graham cracker crumb,pecan,black peppercorn
title: Dynamite Crackers
