ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed graham cracker crumbs | 1 can pancake syrup | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed pecan nuts
instructions: Toast the crackers on one side. Flip if necessary. Spread the crackers with the pancake syrup. Sprinkle with worcestershire sauce, black peppercorns, and coarsely ground pecans. Roll into balls. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Heat the cocktail shaker. Serve with crackers for dipping.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,sugar cube,thyme,red enchilada sauce,curly endive lettuce,wasabi
title: Wasabi Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 large spicy red enchilada sauce ( like emeril's ) | 4 tablespoons wasabi ( optional ) | 1 pinch dried thyme | 1 green curly endive lettuce | 20 large marshmallows ( optional ) | 1 large sugar cube
instructions: Chop up all your ingredients, except the lettuce and wheels of marshmallows, and place into a blender. Blend until all the ingredients have been mixed, but make sure you don't puree until very smooth. Place the sauce into a saucepan over medium heat and stir. Reduce heat if it just begins to boil. Don't allow to boil too fast, or the sauce and marshmallows will become tough. Serve in a bowl topped with a large marshmallow and lettuce.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,cherry pie filling,plain flour,french mustard,chili powder,beef stock,baking powder
title: Quick Beef Samosas
ingredients: 250 g plain flour | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon french mustard | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 300 ml beef stock | 1/2 cup canned tart cherry pie filling ( the small cherry pie filling ) or 1/2 cup other canned filling ( the small cherry pie filling ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons french mustard
instructions: Heat oven to 220c /425f /gas lightly grease a 24cm/7 inch /9x9 inch /2 inch lamington tin. Mix together flour, cumin seeds, chilli powder mustard and baking powder in a bowl, stir in the stock, until combined, then pour mixture into tin. Mix together filling ingredients in a small bowl, pour into tin, top with cherry pie filling, then bake for 40 minutes.

title: Salami Wrapped Filet Mignon
ingredients: 8 slices salami | 1 package baby spinach | 12 small whole-grain rolls | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Place the salami slices flat on the prepared baking sheet, leaving at least an inch between them. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup each of cocoa and remaining cocoa. Bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f when taken in the center of one slice, approximately 25 minutes. Be careful not to overcook. Carefully roll the slice of salami around each slice of salami. Allow to cool, then slice and store until ready to serve. Slice the rolls into thirds to serve and place on serving plates on plates. Slice the salami slices in thirds to serve and place on top of each roll.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,garlic salt,wheat pastry flour,cream chicken soup,turmeric powder,mint,gouda cheese
title: Dumplings With Wild Rice and Cheese
ingredients: 1 bag unbleached whole wheat pastry flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 2 -3 tablespoons sour cream or 2 -3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 cup shredded smoked gouda cheese
instructions: Place flour, tumeric, garlic salt, turmeric and sourcream or mayonnaise in the bowl of a stand mixer. Blend well. Add soup, cheese and mix well. Let sit for 20 minutes at least. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Pour enough of the pastry dough into a large baking dish to come half way up sides of the baking dish. Sprinkle the top with some of the cheese. Bake for about 25 minutes or until the top is browned.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,asafoetida powder,onion flake,grape,vanilla,ra el hanout spice mix,swiss cheese
title: Low Fat French Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans with natural bran | 1/2 teaspoon dry onion flakes | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 12 slices fat-free swiss cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons grapes | 1 ounce shredded fat-free swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon rais el hanout spice mix
instructions: Mix ingredients together, cover and keep in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,red chile,fenugreek seed,garlic salt,red chilies
title: Red Curry Powder
ingredients: 4 dried red chilies | 4 dried red chilies | 1/4 cup split yellow gram ( split yellow gram ) | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1/3 cup crushed dried fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground red chilies ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt ( or 1/2 teaspoon itgi garlic salt )
instructions: Rinse red chillies.

title: Homemade Chips for Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs medium chilies | 2 lbs anchovy, unheeled, rinsed ( anchovies may be substituted )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place chilies on a foil covered baking pan. Place in the oven and toast for about 10 minutes or until darkly roasted. Cool. When cool peel chilies with a sharp knife. Spread on a dry towel to dry. Place chip on a cookie sheet covered with parchment paper and spread with the oil for a shallow or shallow cracker approximately 1/8 inch thick. Bake until crisp and dark. Use for storing in airtight tins. Store in airtight containers.

title: Tex-Mex Rice Cake
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice ( i like basmati ) or 2 cups brown rice ( i like basmati ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 cup tea, warmed
instructions: If using uncooked rice, allow to sit out in a bowl. If you use brown rice, allow to sit out in a bowl. In a large bowl, mix rice, rotel tomatoes, cake flour, and warm flour. Pour into a greased 9x13 baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 45 - 50 minutes or until done. Serve warm. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,queso fresco,beef bouillon cube,anise seed,egg white,cayenne
title: Shahi Kebab
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shredded queso fresco | 3 teaspoons anise seed | 4 large beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 4 egg whites | 2 pounds lamb shank
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the queso fresco, aniseed, beef bouillon cubes, and cayenne into a resealable plastic bag. Toss the contents to coat the meat with bouillon cubes and aniseed. Arrange the lamb shank on a rack in the baking dish, and pour the contents of the bag over the meat. Cover, and bake for 2 hours in the preheated oven. Stir once, and bake for another 30 minutes. Allow the lamb to rest for 30 to 90 minutes before serving.

title: Queso De Nuevo (Green Salsa)
ingredients: 8 ounces guajillo chilies ( or anaheim chilies ) | 1 small green chile pepper, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons finely chopped pimiento | 3/4 cup pimento
instructions: Dice the remaining green chile peppers small and place in a small bowl. Add the pimento, green chile, and pepper.

Random Ingredients: lamb,red chili powder,gingerroot,serrano pepper,toffee,cream sherry,turbinado sugar,escarole
title: Spicy Goat's Legs
ingredients: 12 precooked dried toffee, crushed by hand or, if you can find it in bulk, use 2 packages dry crushed toffee | 1 tablespoon fresh grated gingerroot | 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 2 tablespoons cream sherry | 2 tablespoons toffee pieces, chopped | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Place the crushed toffee in a saucepan over low heat and place a small plate over the top. Let it soak, stirring occasionally, until the solids dissolve and the coffee darkens to a syrup like consistency, about an hour and a half.. Stir in the gingerroot, sugar, sherry, toffee, serrano pepper and chili powder. Keep crushing the mixture and stirring until the mixture is smooth and creamy.

Random Ingredients: silken tofu,soy sauce,cannellini bean,beef,cremini mushroom,creamy butter
title: Tofu and Bean Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 tablespoon creamy butter | 1 lb lean ground beef | 3/4 cup chopped cremini mushrooms | 1 can cannellini beans | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 6 ounces firm silken tofu, drained
instructions: Melt the butter over medium heat in a skillet large enough to hold all the ingredients. Saute the beef over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add the soy sauce to the mixture and simmer until the beef is cooked. Add the mushrooms and beans and simmer until the mixture is thick and the beans heated. Season with salt and pepper. Serve over rice, noodles or vegetables.

title: Fresh Herb Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup fresh basil ( washed and coarsely chopped ) | 12 -14 ice cubes | 1 cup chopped fresh basil ( washed and coarsely chopped ) | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt ( whole-milk or nonfat ) | 2 cups broth ( non-fat or low-fat ) | 8 -10 cardamom seeds, lightly crushed
instructions: Place 8 large ice cubes in a blender. Add the herbs, yoghurt, and broth to the blender and blend on high for 2 minutes. If desired, use a spoon to scrape the sides of blender, and blend 1 - 2 more minutes more and repeat until the yogurt is smooth. Transfer to serving glasses and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,filling,thyme sprig,lentil,icing sugar,white pepper,hamburger bun
title: Lentil Burgers
ingredients: 2 cups fresh lentils, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 12 hamburger buns, split | 1/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon white pepper | 1 tablespoon finely sliced cooked ham ( optional )
instructions: Place lentils in a large bowl. Drizzle with icing sugar. Add the hamburger buns. Sprinkle with cheese, thyme, white pepper and ham. Serve with hamburger buns.

title: Indian-Spiced Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed ( garbanzo beans ) | 2 teaspoons olive oil or 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon coriander-flavored gelatin ( optional )
instructions: Put chickpeas and their liquid into a food processor or blender and pulse until all bits of chickpea are broken up or smaller. If you can add the oil gradually, the chickpeas will be smoother. Heat the oil in a large fry pan over medium heat. Add the mustard seeds, spreading the seeds evenly. Cook and swirl until they crackle, about 1 - 2 minutes.. Add the seasoning and water as needed to deglaze. Add the chickpea mixture and stir to combine. When the chickpeas are hot, add the lemon juice and lemon juice right before serving.

title: Parsley Oil Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 tuna water | 1 tablespoon sweet chili oil ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, finely chopped ( dried or fresh, to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a screw top jar or a deep bowl, and shake to combine thoroughly. Serve with toasted french bread, pitta bread, etc. Enjoy.

title: Crazy Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 pound processed cheese, cubed | 1 can v8 vegetable juice | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts
instructions: Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with oil. Beat oil, processed cheese, V8 juice, and walnuts in a blender until smooth.

title: Mixed Melon (Abm)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons honeydews melon, diced | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | corn oil or oil | 1 cup honeydew melon, peeled and diced | 8 1/2 teaspoons yeast, mixed with
instructions: Dice 1 1/2 teaspoon honeydews melon. Measure 1 1/2 teaspoon yeast into a small bowl, and add 1/4 cup water. Stir until dissolved and let sit 5 minutes to rise. Drain, and set aside. Place honeydew melon cubes and yeast in a large saucepan, and cover with 1 cup water. Bring to a boil, and cook covered until melon cubes soften slightly on top, about 15 to 20 minutes. Add 1 cup honeydew melon cubes in small increments until they are well coated with water. Stir again and cook 5 minutes more, stirring frequently. You may set aside to cool, or keep warm until needed. Place the remaining 1 cup honeydew melon cubes in a food processor or blender. Add the rest of the dry ingredients until well mixed. Pulse into a mixture that resembles a creamy paste. Place in a greased 2 quart casserole, cover, and let stand at least 10 minutes. Bake at 350°f for 45 - 50 minutes, or until a knife inserted deep in the bread comes out clean. Cool, and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,baking soda,red lentil,pearl barley,hard egg,rye bread,balsamic vinegar,lemon essence
title: Auberge Barley, Corn and Yoghurt Salad
ingredients: 2 cups red lentils | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup red lentils | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons ground lemon essence | 2 cups cooked chopped chicken wings | 6 slices rye bread, thickly sliced & toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Pulse the red lentils, pearl barley and red lentils in a food processor until roughly combined. Mix in the balsamic vinegar and baking soda/essence and seasonings. Place chicken wings and rye bread in separate serving bowls, pour 1/2 cup of salad dressing and then arrange the chicken and rye toast around the top for a crunchy or toasted effect. If you have a fancy new frying appliance, like a fan forced electric roasting/fan oven, the dressing can be used for this.

title: Sweet Sesame Rice
ingredients: 6 cups cooked long-grain rice ( chilled, cold, or room temperature ) | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil ( or other cooking oil ) | 1 large orange, zest of ( preferably organic ) | 3 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 2 cups chopped pineapple ( fresh )
instructions: Sauce, in large bowl, mix the rice, oil, orange zest and 1 tsp ginger. Gentle stir in pineapple. Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours, stirring occasionally. Cooks tip, 1 to 1 1/2 tbsp ginger equals 1/2 tsp ginger. Or to taste, use a mortar and pestle to grind the 2 tbsp ginger. It can be made 1 week ahead and chilled. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Oat, Olive and Shallot Skewers
ingredients: 12 skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes | 1 cup nonfat milk | 1 teaspoon dried shallots | 1 ounce dried creme fraiche | cooking rolled oats | 1/4 cup pitted kalamata olive
instructions: Place soaked skewers into a bowl and cover with milk. Stir in dried shallots. Cover and leave to soak in a cool place for 1 hour. While skewers soak, preheat oven to 350°f. While skewers are soaking, combine crème fraîche, oats and olives in a bowl. Roll skewers in oat mixture and place on prepared baking tray. Slide skewers onto baking tray and cook for 10 minutes or until golden.

title: Busy Day Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, tied with kitchen twine | 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Place the corned beef on the rack of a campfire safe dish, fat side up. Roast in the oven at 225 f for 30 minutes. Prick with a fork to insert the point of a skewer. Continue to roast, fat side up, until tender, about 1 hour longer.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,hot italian sausage,matzo meal,spanish olive,self raising flour,chili sauce,roquefort cheese
title: Spanish Sausage and Matzoh Crumble
ingredients: 8 hot italian sausages | 2 cups matzo meal | 1 cup self raising flour | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/2 cup spanish olives, sliced | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 4 slices roquefort cheese or 4 slices sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 210c. Place sausages in a large ovenproof frying pan. Sprinkle both sides with chilli sauce. Roast under griller for 15 - 20 minutes, turning often until cooked through. Remove from oven and crumble. Arrange sausage on a large serving platter. Add matzoh meal and flour to the pan and mix well. Add the coriander seeds and olives. Place over a medium heat, cook stirring and scraping the bottom until the mixture has thickened. Spoon mixture into a warm dish and scatter with roquefort cheese or cheddar cheese.

Random Ingredients: wheat germ,parmesan cheese,buttermilk,yellow pepper,coriander seed,swiss cheese,cream mushroom soup
title: Savory Buttermilk and Swiss Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups shredded swiss cheese, or to taste | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 cup dry whole wheat gluten | 1 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1 large yellow pepper, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 11x7 inch glass baking dish. Mix the swiss cheese, parmesan cheese, cream of mushroom soup, buttermilk, wheat gluten, and coriander in the bowl of a stand mixer until thoroughly combined. Mix in the yellow pepper just before serving.

title: The Easiest & Best Vinaigrette Recipe
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 pinch turmeric powder ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Whisk together the vinegar & turmeric powder in a small dish. Stir in the parsley. Note, to make a more pronounced hot spice use a mixture of 1/8 tsp of each spice & 1/8 tsp each salt. Do not mix too well. It should be slightly tart & visa versa if using salted sea salt.

title: Cremini Mushrooms in a Flash
ingredients: 1 pound cremini mushrooms, sliced | 5 tablespoons quick-cooking oil
instructions: Stir mushrooms together in a bowl. Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cook and stir mushrooms until liquid has been absorbed, about 10 minutes. Serve mushrooms over steamed rice, or as side dish with crusty bread.

title: Gourmet French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread | 5 ounces guacamole | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Cut loaf of bread in 8 slices. Place slices in bowl of electric mixer. Add guacamole and bay leaves. Turn on mixer. After 1 minute turn bread over and mix on other side. Place bread in loaf pan. Let stand for 1 to 2 hours in refrigerator. Heat oven to 350°f. Carefully place bread in oven, cover with aluminum foil, and bake at 350°f for 40 minutes. Serve with salsa and sour cream or guacamole butter and salad dressing.

title: Homemade Chicken Livers and Jam
ingredients: 8 large chicken livers, washed and patted dry ) | 16 ounces pimientos, pimentos, pimentos verde, if available ( about two whole canned deli pimentos with jalapeno peppers if you really like spice )
instructions: Place cleaned and patted chicken livers in a large crockpot on medium high setting, with enough space between them so the fat can run beneath them.. Cover and cook on high for about 1 hour, if desired. Remove chicken livers from crockpot and place in a bowl of cold water to defrost overnight or for up to one more day. Turn crockpot on high again and drain the hot fat into a glass measuring cup and microwave for 2 - 10 - 15 seconds. This juice should measure about 1/2 cup or smaller and can be used for flavoring or jelly. Set 2 cups of cooked liquid aside. If using a jar of pimentos, you may want to chop a few smaller pieces and add those along with the jalapeno peppers, also called cilantrillo peppers. Set them aside also in the liquid for topping later. Use for flavoring in your favorite jam or other sauce. If using jelly, the liquid can be used to flavor the finished dish after it has been marinating. A few pimentos go perfectly with it, along with the pimientos and the ability to spice up the gravy. If making jelly with jelly, set it in a saucepan with just enough room in it so the fat can drain out of the gravy. Set this at low setting, in a pan, on the stove top, on the stove top, on a very low setting. You'll need to do this several times, depending on your stove top's temperature. When the fat has drained out from the gravy, transfer to a mixing bowl and set aside. Return the gravy to the frying pan and gently warm on the stove top until it reaches the boiling point. Add enough of the reserved boiled gravy liquid to make a paste like consistency. Stir. Add the green pimento strips to the gravy in the gravy bowl and stir. If too thick, add a little of the reserved gravy liquid and mix. If too thin, add a little of the reserved boiled gravy liquid. When done, set back on the stove top and keep warm. When ready to serve, slice the chicken livers in half lengthwise and arrange them on plates. Top with the warmed gravy.

title: Nori Nori Rolls
ingredients: 120 g palm sugar | 200 g lemongrass | 1 teaspoon of finely grated lemon zest | 3 teaspoons nori | 4 teaspoons thai basil, leaves chopped | 100 g grated fresh thai basil, leaves only
instructions: Peel the palm sugar and cut it in half lengthways. Slice lemongrass in thin slices. Put palm sugar in the bowl of a food processor. Add lemongrass, lemon zest, nori and basil, and process until the mixture is like breadcrumbs. Place a large sheet of plastic wrap on your work surface, and then lay the nori slices on the top half of the nori. Using a fork, press down on each quarter slice, making sure it fits in well. Roll the nori to enclose the filling. Seal the ends tightly and cut them into strips about the width of your index finger. Roll the strips in remaining palm sugar. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Cut into 10 pieces before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,nutmeg,double cream,water chestnut,mint leaf,picante sauce,salmon,plain yogurt
title: Smoked Salmon Bundt Cake
ingredients: 1 lb smoked salmon, roughly chopped | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 6 teaspoons beef bouillon | 2 teaspoons fresh mint leaves, chopped | 2 teaspoons low-fat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons double cream or 2 tablespoons low-fat sour cream, to taste | 2 tablespoons picante sauce, to taste ( i like more ) | 1 pinch nutmeg
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl, place mixture on a plate and chill until required, at least 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: thai red chili pepper green,green onion,turmeric powder
title: Green Onion Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 large red chili pepper, diced to 1/4-inch ( seeded and minced or 1 1/2 t dry crushed green chiles. ) | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons green onions, finely chopped
instructions: Heat the broiler and position rack 4 inches from the heat, and heat broiler. Toast the chilies and transfer in a bowl. Stir in the turmeric powder. Stir in the green onion and toss to coat evenly. Transfer sauce to a bowl and serve warm or at room temperature. Makes, about 1 cup of sauce.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,asafoetida powder,pita bread,brussels sprout,bamboo shoot,couscous
title: Couscous With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout | 3 large baking potatoes | 1/2 cup diced bamboo shoot | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 cup couscous | 1 box pistachios or 1 box cashews
instructions: Cut stem end off of brussels sprouts and cut out of stem ends. Slice potato lengthwise into sixths. Boil brussels sprouts for 15 minutes or until barely tender. Drain and rinse in cold water. Set aside. Cut tops off sprouts and reserve. Slice potatoes crosswise and set aside. When cool, slice into quarters. Slice bamboo shoots into long, thin strips. When ready to serve, place sprouts on a serving dish. Place couscous in a plastic or glass bowl. Cover with boiling water.

title: Spinach, Spinach & Almond Crunch
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach leaves | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the spinach on the prepared baking sheet. Mix the bread crumbs, cayenne pepper, and almond extract in a bowl. Make sure all of the spinach is evenly coated, then sprinkle on all of the crumb mixture. Using a sharp knife, slice off the excess spinach and place in a small bowl. When the oven is ready, bake for 10 to 15 minutes, until the spinach is slightly puffed up and dry.

title: Creamy Basil Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, washed and finely shredded | 2/3 cup tomato ketchup | 1/3 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Line the baking tray with aluminum foil. In a bowl, mix the basil and ketchup until well combined. Stir in the shredded lettuce. Roll the filling into a ball, and transfer it to a pastry bag. Add the balls to the tray. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, turning them halfway through.

title: Littleneck Clam Livers
ingredients: 1 lb fresh littleneck clams, scrubbed | 1 lb new potato, scrubbed | 1/3 cup plus 2 teaspoons tahini, divided
instructions: In a large bowl of cold water, toss the clams, potatoes and 1/3 cup of the tahini until they are all coated. Let the clams and potatoes sit for about 20 minutes to allow flavors to meld. Drain the clam and clams thoroughly. Return the clams, potatoes and tahini to the pan. Toss carefully.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,coffee,salsa,fine egg noodle,red chili pepper
title: Mexicana Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1/4 cup fine egg noodles | 1/2 cup sweet red chili pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, ground | 1 1/2 tablespoons strong hot coffee | salsa
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water for 8 minutes. Drain. Toast chili in a heavy small skillet over medium heat, stirring often until fragrant and pale golden. Remove from heat and stir in chili pepper, cumin and ground coffee. Stir to combine. Immediately add noodles.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,cilantro,sparerib,self rising flour,tomato green chilies,plain flour,grain rice,cashew
title: Caribbean Pork Fried Rice
ingredients: 500 g fresh spareribs, trimmed and cut into 3cm pieces | 1 can petite diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh dates or 1 cup mangoes | 1/3 cup chopped cashews | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1 3/4 cups jasmine rice | plain flour, for dusting | chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish
instructions: Cook ribs in boiling water until just tender, approximately 5 - 7 minutes. Drain the ribs, reserving cooking liquid and liquid. Cool ribs and reserve. Combine tomatoes, dates, cashew nuts and flour in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,dark rum,bailey irish cream,penne,tabasco sauce
title: Grilled Capsicum and Macaroni With Daiquiri
ingredients: 4 red capsicums | 1 1/4 cups penne ( dried ) or 1 1/4 cups spiral shaped pasta ( dried ) | 1 cup baileys irish cream | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/3 cup light rum
instructions: Cut capsicum in half lengthways and remove the seeds and membrane, remove the seeds and membrane. Place capsicum and pasta in a large saucepan of boiling water and simmer over a medium high heat for 8 - 10 minutes or until tender. Drain thoroughly and stir through bailey's. Place cooked pasta on a large serving plate. Pour daiquiri over the top and season to taste with salt and pepper, serve immediately.

title: Frijoles Borracha -- Beans in Foil
ingredients: 8 cups pinto beans, drained | 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Place the pinto beans in a colander, over a bowl, and rinse well. Combine with enough water to yield a slightly soupy mixture. Heat 1 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet that has a tight fitting lid over medium high heat. When the oil is shimmering, sprinkle the poppy seeds over the oil, and turn down the heat to medium. Stir in the beans, and fry, stirring often, until dark brown, about 20 minutes. Drain the soaked beans, and place them on a platter with a slotted spoon, or in a large bowl.

title: Apricot Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 lb round steak, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup apricot, chopped | 4 tablespoons catsup ( or sauce ) | herbs, of your choice
instructions: Divide beef among 4 dinner sized pieces, cover & top with remaining ingredients. Place pieces of beef on top of ingredients, cover & chill for at least 1 hour before grilling or slicing. Serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,lamb shoulder,green cardamom,thyme leave,half,bulk italian sausage
title: Gomolettino (Tuscan Style Sub)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried thyme leave | 1/4 lb bulk italian sausage | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, flattened | 4 boneless skinless lamb shoulder, flattened | 8 ounces fat-free half-and-half | 1 green cardamom, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine crumbled italian sausage and thyme leaves and mix well. Press into bottom of a baking pan. Bake at 350°f for 20 minutes. Remove sausage mixture from pan, leaving crumb topping and place on plate. Place the chicken between sheets of wax paper and pound it to flatten it slightly. Spread crumb topping over chicken. Top with ham and place on top of sausage. Cover baking pan with foil. Bake at 350°f for 1 hour.

title: Danish Noodle Cookies
ingredients: 12 ounces whole low-fat egg noodles | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: In a dutch oven melt 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup margarine at med high heat. Add the other 1/2 cup of butter and cocoa. Slowly add the baking soda to make coffee flavored. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and return noodles to pot.

title: Codfish with Broccoli and Olives
ingredients: 1 package cod fish | 4 cups chopped fresh broccoli | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts | 1/2 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 1/2 cup sliced kalamata olives ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, combine the cod and broccoli. Sprinkle peanuts over cod and place onto a plate. Sprinkle ginger root over peanuts. Quickly stir the peanuts into the cod and broccoli.

title: Camarones a la Anne
ingredients: 2 fresh jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 anaheim chilies, seeded halved, ribs removed | 1 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Toss shrimp, chiles, peppercorns, and hot pepper sauce in a large bowl. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: oyster,phyllo pastry,red grape,serrano pepper,cardamom seed,salt,stew meat
title: Beef Phyllo Parcels
ingredients: 7 ounces stew meat | 1 pint red grapes | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon salt | 10 ounces oysters | 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 3 serrano peppers, peeled and sliced
instructions: Place meat in large non stick pot. Add salt, cardamon seeds and 1/2 gallon cold water over high heat. Bring to a boil and skim off any scum that rises to the surface. Once the meat has turned into a nice, crusty brown color, about 4 hours, stirring from time to time. Skim off all but 2 tbsps. Continue to boil slowly, then reduce heat to low. Partially cover and let simmer about 1 to 2 hours, or until very thick. In the mean time, remove all the white or light fat from the top of the meat using a strainer or slotted spoon. Use a skimmer to remove the browned bits from the bottom of the pan, being careful not to let oil seep through. Cut meat into 3 inch cubes. Heat oil in a saute pan over medium heat. Season the meat cubes with salt, as per taste. Cook on both sides until nicely browned. Set all aside. To make phyllo, lay a sheet of filo pastry onto a cookie sheet and brush it with warm oil. Place a second sheet of filo over on top, and brush lightly with oil. Repeat with remaining sheets until all the sheets have been used. Take your time on this one so it's messy. To make the spicy peppers, spread ½ cup of a small amount of chilli sauce around the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place 3 - 4 slices of pepper in the middle of the pastry leaving a 1/2 to ½ inch border for texture.. Place 2 - 3 slices of meat over the pepper and top with 2 tbsps. Shredded carrot. Place a few generous tablespoons of the meat onto the pepper. Roll the pastry up and place on top of the meat roll. Cut steam vents so it can breath easy. Top with another generous amount of sauce. Bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees f for 20 - 25 minutes, covering the phyllo every 5 minutes. If you can't wait for this, you could also steam it over medium heat for 15 minutes or so, covered. Once done, remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Blackolives on Gas Grates
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 3 tablespoons sliced black olives
instructions: Place the parmesan cheese, black olives, and olive slices into a cheese cloth lined snack bag. Close the top of the bag and shake to combine.

title: Rotini with Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pound button mushrooms | 4 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 pound rotini pasta
instructions: Drain mushrooms and pat well with paper towel. Place mushrooms and coriander seeds in a food processor. Puree until finely ground. Bring 3 quarts of water to boil in a large pot. Add pasta and mushrooms. Cook 15 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed and pasta is al dente.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,spaghetti sauce,green peppercorn,marjoram,gray salt,provolone cheese,self raising flour,bamboo shoot
title: Chicken Sausages With Pineapple
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti sauce | 3 lbs chicken tenders | 2 3/4 cups self raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram or 3/4 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 teaspoon pink peppercorns, crushed | 1/4 cup crushed bamboo shoot | 1/4 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c remove chicken tenders from tin and place in ovenproof dish in a single layer, with a little seasoning for each. Combine the sauce, flour, salt, marjoram or oregano, peppercorns and bamboo shoots, pour over the chicken and bake for 2 hours in the oven at 170°c. Remove and slice chicken into thick slices and arrange on a platter.

title: Mexican Party Smoked Beer Balls - Smokin' Party Smoked Beer
ingredients: 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 2 ounces beer ( your favorite brand-we like smiths ) | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup chili powder ( heaping with lots ) | chili powder, to color ( optional, adjust to taste )
instructions: Beat together the cream cheese and beer for 5 minutes until creamy. Sift together the chicken broth with chili powder and pour into a bowl and stir into soup. Add a bit of chili powder to color if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,steak,vanilla extract,meat,extra tofu,whipping cream,rice vinegar
title: Tofu Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pork fat, chopped small ( optional ) | 2 ounces extra firm tofu, diced ( or any other firm tofu ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock cube, maggi | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 3/4 cups whipping cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Place tofu in a container with a lid, add chicken cube, rice vinegar and mix. Let sit for 10 minutes, then drain and discard liquid. Place cream in a saucepan and bring to boil. Add vanilla extract and stir until dissolved. Add cream mixture to tofu and stir for one minute.

Random Ingredients: clove,coriander leaf,active yeast,lime wedge,thyme,yellow cornmeal,tomato green chile pepper,orzo pasta
title: Mexican Orzo-Vegetable Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 cup orzo pasta, cooked if desired | 3 tablespoons fresh thyme, chopped | 1 small tomatoes with green chile pepper | 1/4 cup coriander leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Place cornmeal in bowl. Combine orzo, thyme, chile, coriander, yeast, and cloves in another bowl. Pour the hot cornmeal mix into the dry ingredients. Knead the dough together for 2 - 3 minutes. Place in a greased bowl and turn over to grease top and sides. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise till doubled in size about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400°f. Divide dough in half.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,pork rib,tuna steak,wheat bread,plain flour,walnut,sesame seed
title: Sesame Bread & Tuna Baked in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 400 g pork ribs, sliced | 1 cup whole wheat bread, stale | 1/2 cup walnuts, freshly ground | 1/3 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 1 kg spaghetti sauce | 300 g tuna steaks | plain flour, for coating
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Place the bread, walnuts, sesame seeds in a pan over medium low heat and allow to toast, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes. Season the pork with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Scatter over the bread mixture along with some of the sesame seeds. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, topping up with extra water as necessary, until thick and browned slightly. Set aside to cool. Spread the spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 9 x 11 baking dish. Drain the tuna in a colander, and arrange over the tomato sauce. Place the baking tray inside the oven and bake for the final 15 - 20 minutes. Serve sprinkled with sea salt.

Random Ingredients: lamb,quinoa,dark mexican beer,green onion,egg,peach juice,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Mexican Lamb and Quinoa Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry quinoa | 1 can sweetened condensed milk and half and half light beer | 1 lb ground lamb or 1 lb turkey | 2 teaspoons dark mexican beer | 2 tablespoons green onions or 2 tablespoons scallions, chopped | 4 large eggs | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray a 5 or 6 cup quiche pan with cooking spray and set aside. In medium size bowl, mix the two cans of condensed milk and the 2 teaspoons dark mexican beer. In a skillet, brown the ground lamb or turkey or turkey, or if using turkey, over medium heat, breaking it up as it cooks. Drain off the fat. Combine the two cans of condensed milk and the 2 teaspoons dark mexican beer and mix well. Put the mixture into the pie crust. In a small bowl, whisk eggs with 1/4 cup of the grated cheese until light and fluffy.

title: Vodka Onions
ingredients: 5 lbs white onions, peeled ( about 3 pounds with the root ends trimmed ) | 1 cup vodka ( i use the `` best '' kind ) | 1/4 cup chili oil ( i have used the olive oil i can find )
instructions: The onions will all be cooked when they are all fork tender. Place everything in a heavy stewing pan and cover tightly with lid. Let it sit in a cool, dark place for about 6 weeks, shaking every now and then. The onions will be very sweet and juicy. Note, the oil can be stored in a ziploc bag in the freezer for up to 6 months or indefinitely in a cupboard.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,orange flower water,rye flour,garam masala powder
title: Tandoori (Rye Bread)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rye flour | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( about 1/2 a lemon ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange flower water | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Place the flour in a bowl and make a well in the middle. Combine the lemon juice, orange flower water and enough yogurt or water to make 1 - ¼ cups of liquid. Whisk into the well with a fork.

title: Quick & Easy Mexican Meatballs
ingredients: 16 -20 frozen meatballs | 1 jar thick & chunky salsa ( or your favorite )
instructions: Pour jar of salsa into crock pot and put meatballs into the crock. Cook on low 4 hours.

title: Simple Guacamole
ingredients: 10 ripe avocados | 1/2 cup chopped onion powder | 1 jar chopped pimiento | 1/2 cup chopped fresh almonds
instructions: Cut avocados in half lengthwise. Remove and discard pit. With hands, scoop avocado flesh into mixing bowl. Mash avocados with fork. Sprinkle onions, pimentos and almonds on top. Serve immediately.

title: Fried Sticks or Curly Parsley
ingredients: olive oil or canola oil, to coat | 1 bunch curly leaves parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400ºf. Pour 1/4 cup of oil in a cast iron skillet. When it shimmers, add the parsley, taking care it doesn't clump, and sear for 10 - 15 minutes, until bright green and slightly crispy. Remove from the oven and remove to a bowl. Repeat with the remaining oil and parsley, keeping them crisp. Serve immediately. Note, the parsley can be stored in an airtight container up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,grape,chicken wing,coriander seed,tomato juice,seashell pasta,taco seasoning,vegan mozzarella cheese
title: Super Chicken Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 cup fresh medium seashell pasta | 2 cups vegan mozzarella cheese ( i use low fat ) | 8 ounces fresh ripped-cut grape
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Line an 8 inch pizza pan with foil. Cut chicken wings in half. Remove tips and cut wings into bite sized chunks. Mix tomatoes with juice, tomato juice and taco seasoning. Place in pan. Sprinkle coriander seeds evenly over the top of the mixture. Top with the pasta. Place mozzarella cheese on top. Sprinkle grape over mozzarella cheese.. Place pizza in oven. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Take out of heat. Slice into 1/2 thick sections. Serve with salsa and other toppings on the side.

Random Ingredients: blue curacao,salt pepper,mango chutney,superfine sugar,red pepper,tomato green chilies,feta cheese,beef tenderloin
title: Beef Tenderloin With Caribbean Salsa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons red pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon mango chutney or 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1/2 cup blue curacao | 1/8 teaspoon salt and pepper | 2 beef tenderloin | 1/2 small red pepper, very thinly sliced | 10 thin ounces mango chutney | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar, or to taste | 1/3 cup tomato and green chutney | 1/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix 1 tablespoon sugar with 1 tablespoon red pepper and 1 tablespoon mango chutney in a small bowl. Stir together blue curacao and 1/8 teaspoon salt and pepper in a small bowl. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper. Place on a rack in a roasting pan. Roast in the preheated oven until meat thermometer reaches 135 degrees f, about 45 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes, then slice into thin slices. To make the salsa, combine remaining 2 tablespoons sugar with the mango chutney in a small sauce pan. Stir together until sugar dissolves. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until sauce is syrupy and bubbly. Stir in mango and green chutney.

title: Lebhati Chachala
ingredients: 2 teaspoons seasoning salt ( indian or kashmiri ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder, for colour
instructions: Heat oven roast pan on low. Rub salt and asafoetida well. Add chachala on it. Roast for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,pork shoulder,superfine sugar,beef chuck roast
title: Sweet Glaze for Roast Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds pork shoulder, cubed | 3/4 cup extra light virgin olive oil for browning | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 1/2 pounds lean beef chuck roast, cut into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Toss pork with olive oil and sugar in a bowl. Arrange the cubes in a foil lined roasting pan. Cover with aluminum foil and roast in the preheated oven until meat is tender and easily pulled apart, about 3 hours. Transfer pork to cutting board and slice while warm, about 1/2 inch thick. Serve with the warm glaze.

Random Ingredients: bay scallop,russet potato,burrito flour tortilla,chicken tender breast,black olive,clear honey
title: Chicken, Black Olive and Scallop Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders, cut into 3/4-inch-thick slices ( skin on ) or 1 lb scallop ( skin on ) | 4 ounces black olives, roughly chopped ( use nicoise ) | 1 russet potato, cut into 1/2-inch dice ( or use a small purple potato ) | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 4 burrito-size flour tortillas or 4 plain flour tortillas | 1 bay scallop, sliced into 1/8-inch-thick rounds ( optional )
instructions: Spread the chicken slices over the bottom and around the edges of a very large nonstick skillet or ridged grill pan. Pour enough water into the skillet to cover the chicken slices, about 2 inches high. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper. Cover the skillet and set the skillet over moderate heat. The water should be approximately 2 quarts. When the water boils, lay half of the tortillas in the hot skillet and cook without moving them or disturbing them for about 1 minute each of the chicken slices, until crisp. With a slotted spoon, transfer the tortillas to a plate lined with paper towels. Repeat with the remaining chicken, adding 1/4 cup water each time. Set the skillet over high heat. Add the chicken and any accumulated juices and cook, stirring, until firm, slightly opaque and cooked through, about 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Cut the vegetables into the skillet and stir in the honey. Heat the remaining 2 quarts water in the skillet and pour into the tortillas to moisten. Top with a second tortilla and brown the tortillas in it, shaking the skillet a few times to even out the browned bits. Remove from the heat, place on a plate covered with a paper towel, and keep warm in a low oven. When ready to serve, arrange three scallops on a plate or two and top with the vegetables and chicken. Serve with pico de gallo, chopped cilantro and lime wedges.

title: Bok Choy with Mint
ingredients: 1 cup ice water | 1 bunch baby bok choy | 1 cup baby fresh bean sprouts | 1/4 onion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth. Cover and chill until ready to serve. To serve, place a handful of bok choy on each of 4 plates, followed by a little of the mint. Top with bean sprout and onion. Pour the mint dressing over each plate of bok choy.

title: Bengali Bacon (Fried Spiced Bacon)
ingredients: 1 bunch thick cut bacon | 2 garlic cloves | 8 ounces bengali curry leaves
instructions: Fry bacon over medium heat until it releases its oiliness. Add garlic, curry leaves and fry for a few minutes. Drain fat in a paper towel. Cut the bacon crossways into two to three pieces. Fry in the bacon grease for 20 - 25 minutes at low heat or until the bacon is well browned and crispy. Serve drizzled with any remaining oil and some chilli powder.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,hungarian paprika,broccoli,red kidney bean,baking soda,salt pepper,vegetable
title: Crispy Polish Sausage and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb sliced sausage ( i prefer sweet or hot ) | 1 lb frozen vegetables ( i like snow peas, broccoli, corn or green vegies ) | 1 head fresh broccoli ( if you want to keep the whole head ) | 1 can red kidney beans ( if you want it less rich ) | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 2 teaspoons baking soda | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Pound sausage with a fork so the sausage fits snugly in the pan, then season it with salt and pepper. Bake, breaking up the chunks into smaller pieces, for 15 minutes, stirring, then remove from oven. Add vegetables to the sausage and continue to cook for another 15 minutes, stirring often, or until vegetables are tender. Add paprika. Add baking soda and stir well to mix well. Cook until all liquid is evaporated. Add sausage to vegetables and stir well. Transfer the mixture to a jellyroll pan or large baking dish and bake for 15 minutes. Note, for a crisper stew, bake only about 5 minutes, adding water or milk to the stew as needed to keep the mixture moist. Cook with any leftovers or leftover vegetables in the pan.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,parsnip,turkey,graham wafer crumb,walnut,green olive,cake flour,deli roast beef
title: Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds sea bass fillets, cubed | 1/2 pound deli roast beef, chopped | 1/2 pound carrots, peeled and chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons chopped green olives | 1 cup miniature graham wafer crumbs | 2 tablespoons unbleached cake flour, sifted | 1/2 cup sweet sherry or any sweet white sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease 3 to 3 1/2 inch cast iron skillet with cooking spray. Arrange the sea bass fillets in the prepared skillet. Mix the beef, carrots, walnuts, and green olives together in a bowl. Spoon the beef mixture over the fish and sprinkle with graham wafer crumbs. Bake the pizzas in the preheated oven until the fish is done, about 15 minutes. Serve hot. Serves 10.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,cumin powder,italian bread,egg noodle,zucchini,cucumber,heavy cream,mustard seed
title: Zucchini and Yogurt Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 egg noodle | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds ( black or purple ) | 14 ounces zucchini, roughly chopped | 1/2 cucumber, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/3 cup shredded italian bread, about 5 pieces
instructions: Cook the noodles in 1 tsp of the cumin in a large pot of cold water until softened. Drain well. Tear off a piece of plastic wrap about the size of your finger and place inside a mixing bowl. Cut zucchini into chunks and place in bowl. Add chopped cucumber and mix with noodles,. Whip heavy cream until thick. Add yoghurt and mix until thickened. Add remaining cumin, mustard seeds and bread pieces. Mix well. To serve, spread cream and spice mixture evenly over top of noodles and serve immediately.

title: Peperonata
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil | 8 pieces pickled maraschino cherries | 1 sprig fresh thyme
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Add the cherries and thyme sprigs, and cook just until the cherries release their juices. Remove and set aside, to cool at least 1 hour, if you like. To serve, pour the warm peperonata into a platter.

title: Shish Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 4 lettuce leaves, washed and dried | 1/3 cup pistachios, chopped
instructions: Combine yogurt, lettuce leaves and pistachios in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate 10 minutes or up to 3 hours, for flavors to blend.

title: Cocoa Chipped Salmon
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder or 1/2 teaspoon dried chili powder | 1 tablespoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa | 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets
instructions: In small bowl, stir together the 1/4 cup cocoa, chili powder and 1 tablespoon cocoa. Cover.

title: Armenian Apricot Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups dry apricots, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | lettuce leaf | 1 -2 tablespoon slivered pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Put apricots and cinnamon in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, lower heat, and simmer until fruit is soft. Using a slotted spoon, remove fruit from liquid, reserving juices. Strain juice through a sieve set over a bowl. Squeeze juice into a bowl set over another bowl. Bring enough juice to juice to cover apricots. Let stand 10 minutes. Squeeze juice again. Strain juice through a sieve set over a bowl. Refrigerate until cold, about 2 hours.. Spoon equal amounts of juice onto each lettuce leaf. Sprinkle with pistachios, if using.

title: French Puff Cookies
ingredients: 1 pound pork tenderloin, cut into 2 inch long cubes | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 1 package confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the pork tenderloin cubes and triple sec in a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the pork is lightly browned, 45 to 60 minutes. Remove meat and discard the pan drippings. Drain the cooked pork on a paper towel lined plate. Chop into cubes about 1/2 inch long. Mix confectioner's sugar and meat in a bowl. Roll the mixture into 1 inch balls. Arrange on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the outsides begin to brown, 10 to 15 minutes. Cool on wire racks.

title: Rice With Feta, Mint and Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1 small shallot | 3/4 cup short-grain rice, washed | 1 3/4 cups chilled gravy | 3/4 cup chili sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint sprigs | 200 g feta, crumbled
instructions: Cut shallot into thin slices. Place in a wide shallow saucepan with rice, drizzle with 2½ tablespoons of the gravy and half the chile sauce. Bring to a simmer, loosely cover, and then cook over low heat for 20 mins, until rice is tender. Remove cover and cook for a further 5 minutes. To serve, pile rice onto serving plates, spoon half the shallot slices and half the fetta over.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,red capsicum,romaine lettuce,apricot half juice
title: Apricot Salad
ingredients: 2 large red bell peppers, seeded and sliced into strips | 1 large red capsicum, seeded and sliced into strips | 1/3 cup apricot juice | 3 romaine lettuce, washed and drained
instructions: In a large serving bowl add the pepper, capsicum, apricot juice and lettuce and mix together.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,pistachio nut,vegetable oil cooking spray,turmeric powder,green chili pepper,head cabbage
title: Indian Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup mustard powder | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 green chili pepper, seeded, deveined and finely diced | 1 cup chopped peeled fresh pistachio nuts | 1 small head of cabbage ( or 1 large head of cabbage )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine all ingredients.

title: Asian Style Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained | 16 sheets rice vermicelli | 12 ounces cabbage | 1/2 lb pork tenderloin | 2 cups lettuce | 1/3 cup dried apricot
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut tofu in half crosswise and place in large bowl. Mix well. Dice pork, and toss with tuna mix. Coat cabbage with nonstick cooking spray. Lay out one package of vermicelli, and place 2 sheets on counter. Break tofu into half diagonally, and place 1/2 of the filling in center. Roll tightly, and place seam side down on top, leaving about a 1 1/2 inch space between rolls. Repeat with remaining sheets of vermicelli and filling. Line baking dish with lids and bake rolls for 20 minutes, or until golden brown. While still hot, place rolls on a tray covered with foil. Spread lettuce with pore of remaining filling.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,corn,rose water,walnut,apple butter,five spice powder
title: Apple-Chilled Cabbage and Nappa Wraps
ingredients: 12 napa cabbage, cored and shredded | 20 leaves napa cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup apple butter | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 2 teaspoons rose water
instructions: Combine the napa cabbage and 1/4 cup of walnut in a medium salad bowl. Toss to coat and set aside. In a small saucepan, combine the remaining walnuts, apple butter, 5 spice powder and 1 1/2 teaspoons of rose water. Mix well and set aside. Spread about a teaspoon of the walnut mixture over half of each napa cabbage leaf, or about 2 teaspoons on the top of one of the sliced napa cabbage leaves. Fold the leaf sides in towards the center of the filling, pressing tightly around the filling and securing with a napa cabbage leaf tie. Repeat using remaining filling and wrappers.

title: Chilled Espresso Bean Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, crushed | 2 cups whole kernel corn | 1 1/2 cups espresso | 1 packet instant espresso instant coffee | 8 ounces shelled pistachio, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a blender, combine mustard seeds, corn, espresso and instant coffee. Cover and blend until smooth. Pour mixture into a large glass storage container and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

title: Tamari Beef Jerky (for Bites)
ingredients: 4 2/3 lbs roast beef or 2 2/3 lbs sirloin steaks | 0.333 package reduced-sodium instant chicken bouillon | 3/4 cup tblsp. sherry wine | 1 tablespoon tamari | 6 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Cut beef into 1½ - ¼ inch pieces. Rinse. Set aside. In gallon ziplock bag, combine soup mix, stock, sherry and tamari. Add beef, seal and mix well. Refrigerate, turning bag every once in a while, for a week, or up to 36 hours. Grill over high heat, on foil lined baking sheet covered with parchment paper or parchment paper. Brush jerky with olive oil or butter, allow to stand for 5 - 6 minutes before cutting, serve with vegetables, such as cabbage strips and radish slices.

title: Rigatoni With Coconut and Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 cup cream of coconut | salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Vegan Mashed Potatoes With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 cup dried pasta ( bowtie, small shells, or ziti ) | 1 cup coarsely chopped celery salt | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 large yukon gold potato, peeled and diced | 1/2 lb baby brussels sprout, trimmed and thinly sliced ( or 3/4 of one brussels sprout ) | 1/2 cup chopped scallion, including both white and green parts | 5 tablespoons currants or 4 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Place the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water and cook just until it's al dente. Drain and add to pot with some cold water. Meanwhile, in a sauté pan set over high heat, stir in celery salt and cayenne until well toasted. Add the potato and sauté until lightly browned. Add the brussels sprouts and cook for a minute to drive off any excess moisture. Add the scallions and cook until the vegetables are just tender. Stir in the currants and toss to coat. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Popsicles
ingredients: 200 ml vodka | 300 ml molasses | 3 tablespoons vanilla
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Pour into popsicle moulds, or small aluminium foil. Place on an oven rack and bake at about 170c for 12 - 15 minutes. Serve on a plate.

title: Potato, Cabbage & Garlic Hash!
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, chopped and cooked | 8 medium russet potatoes, peeled and shredded | tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Place the cabbage & garlic hash ingredients in a medium covered pan and cover with a lid or wrap tightly with foil. Bake in a pre heated 450 degree oven for 20 minutes. Uncover and cook for 5 minutes more or until hot and crispy. Allow to cool slightly and cut into thick slices.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,extra virgin olive oil,seasoning,sesame seed,onion salt,honey
title: Sesame Seasoning Salt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon fine grain honey | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/4 teaspoon seasoned salt
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together sea salt, honey, onion salt and sesame seeds. Add seasoned salt and blend well. Store in refrigerator away from light and heat smoke.

title: Chickpeas With Montreal Steak Rub
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas, rinsed and drained | garlic, if desired | realm steak seasoning
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store and refrigerate on clean counter overnight. Use as directed in recipe.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,avocado,nutritional yeast,rice vinegar,feta,pillsbury pie crust,salt pepper,lemon juice
title: Cheesy Avocado Rice Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1/2 avocado ( peeled & cut up ) | 1/2 cup extra firm cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 teaspoon salt & pepper | 1 pillsbury pie crust, unbaked | 2 cups leftover cooked rice or 2 cups leftover cooked rice, for a fluffier crust ( i used leftover )
instructions: Mix the first four ingredients together. Stir until well blended but not mushy. Add salt and pepper. Spread mixture into the bottom of the crust & top with the remaining ingredients. Bake at 350°f for 25 - 30 minutes or until crust is lightly brown and bubbly.

title: Crispy Salmon Tacos
ingredients: 12 large soft flour tortillas | 2 whole eggs | 1 lb ground salmon | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 1 eggplant, diced, in 1/4 inch pieces | 1 jar apricots or ( 16 ounce ) jar red fruit spreadable fruit jam | 12 taco shells, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f lightly spray 12 tortillas with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange in a single layer on an ungreased baking sheet. Roast 25 minutes or until tender and golden brown. Remove and set aside. Wipe out pan with a paper towel. In eggs, mix salmon, almond extract and eggplant. In another, nonstick skillet, heat the jam for two minutes or until very hot. Quickly stir in salmon mixture. Divide mixture among the tortillas and top with a fried eggplant slice and 1 tsp apricot jam. Serve with salsa.

title: Smoked Salmon Hash
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes ( about 6 ounces ) | 7 1/2 ounces smoked salmon | 3/4 teaspoon kosher instant minced garlic | 2 teaspoons freshly grated ginger powder | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 -2 teaspoon lime | 1/2 bulb of garlic, minced ( i use frozen ) | 2 1/2 limes, halved
instructions: Boil & peel potatoes & split them into half, set aside. Cut up salmon into 1 1/2 slices using a food slicer or a knife. Layer the bottom half of the wok with the salmon, sprinkling flakes of garlic, then chinese ginger pepper flakes. Layer on top half of the potatoes, repeat layers, finishing w/broth. Cook in a 375 degree f oven for 30 minutes, then lower heat to 350 degrees f & bake covered for 35 to 40 minutes. Uncover & let cook a few minutes longer, then mix the potatoes. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,ice,pizza crust,salt,oil vegetable,red currant jelly,coconut extract,pistachio nut
title: Tropical Indian Pizza - Dansk Pizza!
ingredients: 1 pizza crust, homemade ready prepared ( or homemade from your local deli ) | 2 tablespoons oil ( i use vegetable oil or grapeseed oil, if you're using your own ) | 3 tablespoons red currant jelly, heated | 1/2 teaspoon dark rum or 1/2 teaspoon rum extract | 1/4 cup unsalted shelled pistachio nut, packed | 1/4 teaspoon salt ( adjust to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 cup shaved ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Lightly grease a pizza pan or a stone baking sheet. To make the crust, preheat oven to 500°f arrange pizza crust on the prepared pizza pan, lightly brush top and bottom with oil, or place it in the freezer when ready to bake. In a small bowl whisk together jelly, rum or extract, pistachio nuts and salt until well blended. Pour into crust. Sprinkle with more nuts, if desired. Bake for 12 minutes or until golden brown and the crust edges are crispy. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Remove and cool about 5 minutes. Loosen the edges with a spatula and slide onto a large serving plate. Cut into wedges and serve with a drizzle of the chocolate syrup or a drizzle of honey. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ro tel tomato,yellow bell pepper,thai red curry paste,tahini,french bread
title: Oriental Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 2 medium red bell peppers, roasted peeled ( or to taste ) | 6 -8 cloves garlic | 1 cup tahini | 1 -2 teaspoon thai red curry paste
instructions: Slice bread into 1 inch thick slices. Cut tops off roasted red bell peppers and cut peppers and garlic into small pieces. In a food processor or chopper, combine roasted red bell peppers, roasted garlic cloves and tahini. Process on low for 10 - 15 seconds, till it resembles a paste. Spread the mixture evenly into the bread slices.. Cut a slit in the top of the bread and place in a 350 degree oven for 5 minutes, till crisp and browned. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 2 cups chopped yellow squash | 4 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 can pimientos, drained | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put into a shallow baking dish and put in a 350°f oven for 45 minutes, stirring twice. Serve hot with tortilla chips or corn chips. Serves.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,beef marrow,egg white,tarragon,tomato puree,green olive,yoghurt
title: Smorgastarta De Saliva (Beef Soup With Olives and Tomatoes)
ingredients: 1 beef marrow, cracked under cold water | 8 ounces tomato puree | 8 ounces green olives, preferably sicilian green olives with stalks | 3 ounces tarragon, leaves finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle chile | 1 large egg white, beaten | 2 tablespoons low-fat natural yoghurt
instructions: Cut the marrow and tomato paste into small, thick pieces with the olive stalks. Combine them with the tomato puree, the olives, the tarragon, the ground chipotle and the egg white in a large saucepan. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer, and cook for 15 minutes, covered. Allow the soup to cool slightly and purée in batches in a blender until smooth. If its consistency is too thick, blend in a little water, about 1 tablespoons at a time. Serve in small soup cups.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,pinto bean,chicken breast half
title: Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans ( white kidney beans ) | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 pinch dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Place the beans in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook 1 minute, or until fully cooked. Drain in a colander. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken in a baking dish, and bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until no longer pink in the center. Remove the chicken from the oven, and return pot to stove. Stir in the chili pepper flakes. Return to the oven, and bake 15 minutes, or until chicken juices run clear and no longer pink in the center.

Random Ingredients: white bread,canadian bacon,sea salt pepper,chicken breast meat,whipping cream,button mushroom,chive
title: Chicken Breasts with Mushrooms, Canadian Bacon & Chives
ingredients: 8 -10 ounces boneless chicken breast meat, cut into 2 '' cubes | 1 -2 tablespoon whipping cream | 1 -2 tablespoon snipped chives | 2 slices white bread, crusts removed, cut into 1/2 `` wedges | 1/8 cup canadian bacon, finely chopped | 6 small button mushrooms | sea salt & fresh ground pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f degrees. Lightly oil an 8 x10 inch baking dish. Stir fry chicken over medium heat until cooked through, 3 - 5 minutes. Stir cream into chicken, then sprinkle with chives, then divide among 4 shallow baking dishes, cutting each into 2 triangles. Place bread wedges on top of bread and bake just until warmed through. Remove from oven and sprinkle with bacon and mushrooms. Top with remaining bread wedges, pressing down to submerge. Season with sea salt and freshly ground pepper.

title: Veggedosis - Yummy Low Fat Sprinkled Sausage
ingredients: 2 cups plain soymilk | 1 1/2 cups spicy spaghetti sauce | 1 can chopped tomatoes with juice | 1/2 lb fresh edible flower, washed | oil
instructions: Mix together the soy milk and 1 cup of the spaghetti sauce in a small saucepan on the stove. Over medium heat, melt the garlic and add the soymilk mixture. Stir to combine and allow to steam for 2 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Meanwhile, chop up the beans and cut them into 1/8 inch slices. Stir the beans into the soybean mixture, bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Discard the garlic, stir in the rest of the vegetables, heat an oiled skillet on medium high heat and sauté the spagroed sausage for 6 - 8 minutes to your liking. Serve in large individual bowls, ladle the soup over the top and allow to cool a bit before eating.

title: Grilled Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 lb flank steak
instructions: Combine pineapple juice, onions, lemon peel and seasoned salt. Arrange steak in a shallow dish or container. Pour marinade over steak. Close lid and refrigerate overnight. Grill over medium hot coals or grill 10 minutes per side, brushing with remaining marinade 5 minutes per side.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Cavata
ingredients: 1 cup cauliflower floret | 1/4 cup finely diced prosciutto di parma | 2 tablespoons mashed potatoes | 2 egg yolks, lightly beaten | paprika
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a pan of boiling water and blanch until al dente. Chop finely. Add prosciutto, potato and egg yolks, blend well. Drain cauliflower and combine with potato mixture. Season to taste with paprika. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: apple,fish stock,tomato juice,gruyere cheese,shortening,chicken part,greek yogurt,swiss cheese
title: French Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 3/4 cups dry shredded swiss cheese | 16 large ripe tomatoes | 1 tablespoon grated fresh pineapple, drained ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grated gruyere cheese ( optional ) | 1/2 cup fish stock | 1/3 cup tomato juice | 1 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Grease a 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan. Melt shortening in a large stainless steel skillet over medium heat. Add swiss cheese.

title: Simple and Easy Gravlax
ingredients: pastry dough ( for double crust ) | chicken stock cube
instructions: Roll out pastry as well as possible. Cut out circles as desired. You can also press the edges with a fork. You can use a 2 oz pannbury or similar pouch as well but it is not likely to be enough for the size of the dough.

title: Crispy Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large head red cabbage, cored and cut into wedges | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the cabbage wedges in a large shallow baking dish, and sprinkle with old bay seasoning. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, then turn and bake 15 more minutes.

title: Low-Storing Popums for a Crowd
ingredients: 500 g ricotta cheese | 250 g low-fat milk chocolate candy bars | 1 small leek | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Peel the leek and slice in half and then into very long, thin strips. In a small saucepan melt the low fat milk chocolate candy bar with the vinegar and remove from heat, without stirring. Put the chopped leeks into a microwave safe bowl and add the microwaved chocolate and stir until all of the chocolate is melted and smooth. Pour the mixed in cheese into the microwave safe bowl with the leeks. Put an ice pick into each glass, and put in the fridge for at least two hours to set the chocolate. Pop into a jar then store in the freezer and serve.

title: Lobster Tails on Hawaiian Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lobster tail, shell on ( or frozen crabmeat ) | 1/4 teaspoon oriental sesame oil | 8 slices american cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 1/4 cup chopped chives | 1 bag shredded fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f arrange lobster shells on parchment lined rimmed foil, and bake about 8 minutes, turning and rearranging shells halfway through. Place cheese, chives, and chives on top of lobster shells, then drizzle with sesame oil. Bake about 10 minutes more or until bubbly. Serve garnished with chives.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,active yeast,salt black pepper,vanilla,sultana,espresso powder
title: Irish Coffee Bread
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 2 cups sultanas ( golden raisins ) | 2 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 cup warm brewed coffee | salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve the yeast in approximately 2 cups warm water. Let stand 5 minutes, stir to dissolve and set aside. In a 6 quart mixing bowl, sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup warm water over the sultanas. Combine the espresso powder, mustard and espresso powder mixture in a small bowl, stir with a whisk until all is thoroughly combined. Stir in the yeast mixture and remaining 1/4 cup warm water. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed for 3 to 5 minutes, until the dough starts to come together. Dough should not be sticky and form a ball around the bowl. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, knead for 2 minutes, and then divide into 8 pieces. Shape each piece into a long, wide loaf. Place bread on an oiled baking sheet, cover and let rise in a warm spot until doubled. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake bread 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until top is light brown and sounds hollow when tapped. Let cool 5 minutes on the baking sheet. Remove from the baking sheet to a rack to cool completely before slicing.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,maraschino cherry,mexican cheese,celery rib,cremini mushroom,hoisin sauce,cucumber,red cabbage
title: Moo Shu Beef Vegetable Bake
ingredients: 1 jar maraschino cherries | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 6 celery ribs, sliced | 1 large cucumber, cut into thin slices | 1 cup red cabbage, shredded | 1/4 lb cremini mushroom, sliced | 2 cups cooked brown rice | 3 1/2 cups mexican blend cheese, shredded
instructions: Mix cherries, hoisin and celery in shallow 8x8 inch glass baking dish. Place cucumber, cabbage and mushrooms in separate bowl. Toss with cherries and cover completely with cheese. Bake at 350 degrees, uncovered, 40 minutes or until hot.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,cardamom,orange zest,braeburn apple,extra sharp cheddar cheese,green olive
title: Baked Vegetables With Orange
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons shredded extra-sharp cheddar cheese ( or a blend of cheddar and emmenthal ) | 1 large carrot, peeled and grated | 6 green olives, halved | 1 orange, zest of, finely grated | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Place potatoes in large ovenproof dish or roasting tin, cut side down. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the cheese. Top with carrot, olives and orange zest. Lightly crush the cardamon with a fork and scatter over vegetables. Tuck the remaining cheese into mixture and bake at 180c for 30 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,beef tenderloin,dark soy sauce,hoisin sauce,corn cob,garbanzo bean
title: Beef Skewers With Chickpeas and Garbanzo Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons minced fresh garlic | 3 cups coarsely chopped coriander or 3 cups cilantro | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained, rinsed, and cooked
instructions: Soak 4 bamboo skewers in water for about 20 - 30 minutes. Place beef skewers in a 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking dish and set aside. Combine zest, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, garlic and coriander with remaining ingredients.

title: Quinoa-Rice With Pasta
ingredients: 5 cups cooked quinoa | 2 cups broken short pasta ( angel hair, spaghetti, etc. )
instructions: Rinse quinoa with cold water rinse and drain thoroughly. In medium bowl place quinoa, pasta. Pour quinoa with water on top of quinoa. Cover and let sit for a least 1/2 hour for quinoa to absorb the water. Uncover and bake in 350 degree oven for 20 - 30 minutes till quinoa is well heated through.

title: Portabella Mushrooms for Two
ingredients: 1 cup picante sauce | 1 cup portabella mushroom caps, diced | 1 teaspoon catsup
instructions: Mix picante sauce, mushroom caps and catsup to taste together. Pour the mixture into a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Sweet and Hot Spaghetti
ingredients: 4 -5 cups spaghetti sauce, or as needed | 1 package mini marshmallows
instructions: Heat large pot of spaghetti sauce just to boiling over medium heat. Stir in marshmallows, then toss with hot spaghetti until coated. Serve hot.

title: Cauliflower Potato and A Hint of Crunchy Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 4 yukon gold potatoes, cut into chunks | 2 quarts vegetable broth ( or beef broth ) | 1/4 cup oil
instructions: In a stockpot combine cauliflower, yukon gold potatoes, broth, and 1/4 tsp salt and bring to boil. Cover the pot and simmer for 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Blend soup well and check seasonings. Chop potatoes and serve.

title: Spicy Apple and Nut Pate
ingredients: 4 tart apples, cut into chunks | 1 red bell pepper, sliced | 1/2 pound raw shrimp paste ( thawed if frozen ) | 1/3 cup chopped pecans | 5 cups instant mashed potatoes, chilled
instructions: In a large glass or ceramic bowl, mix apples, bell pepper, shrimp paste and pecans. Stir in instant potatoes until all ingredients are evenly coated.

Random Ingredients: brandy,mint leaf,self rising flour,banana liqueur,bicarbonate soda,red curry paste,wheat bread white
title: Hot Banana Rissoles
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raisins or 1 1/2 cups golden raisins | 1 cup red curry paste, thick | 1 banana liqueur, such as kahlua | 3 tablespoons brandy | 2 1/2 cups whole wheat bread or 2 1/2 cups white bread, crusts trimmed of excess breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 12 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 230c fan forced /230c/350f/gas mark 2. Place the raisins in a sieve and toss with the curry paste until a paste is well combined. Place the banana liqueur and brandy in a small frying pan over a medium heat. Cook and stir for 5 minutes or until heated. Allow to cool slightly. Place the bread in a bowl of hot water for a few seconds. Squeeze out excess water, place it into a large bowl and add the raisin paste and banana. Toss well, cover and leave to stand for 30 minutes. Drain the bread well, place into a large, heavy based /8 inch baking dish. Stir in the bicarbonate of soda. Spread the bread mixture on top. Carefully spoon the heated banana rissoles equally into the bread holes, using about two teaspoons on each. Cover, making sure none or all the rissoles touch the surface of the bread. Place in the oven and bake for 12 - 15 minutes, rotating the dish once halfway through. Serve immediately, drizzled with a little bit of the golden syrup if you like.

Random Ingredients: potato flake,white onion,chunky salsa,salmon fillet,baby bok choy
title: Mexican Style Fish With Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( such as pace ) | 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets, cut into 3 pieces | 1 medium white onion, thinly sliced ( vidalia, texas 1015 or walla walla ) | 1 1/2 cups instant potato flakes | 1 tablespoon dried potato flakes
instructions: Place 1 cup salsa in bowl and set aside. Add fish and stir to coat. In same skillet, heat remaining salsa over medium heat for 1 minute. Add fish and onions.

title: Zuppa Di Broccomite (Herby Cheese with Dates and Leeks)
ingredients: 20 medium dates | 1 medium leek | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1 tablespoon grated emmenthaler cheese
instructions: Soak dates and leeks in water for 30 minutes. Remove and dry the end peel from leek with a vegetable peeler. Slice leek lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices, then slice. Combine leek, celery salt, thyme, oregano, and cheese in large pot. Cover and simmer over low heat 25 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve warm. Makes about 2 cups.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,fig,asparagus,maraschino cherry,spanish onion,english muffin,squash,baking potato
title: Stuffed Squash Sticks With Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato, about 6 medium in diameter | 1 spanish onion, peeled & thinly sliced | 1 lb zucchini, about 1/8 inch thick, about 1/2 inch thick | 1 1/2 cups diced asparagus ( fresh or frozen- thawed ) | 1 cup diced seedless european squash ( or pumpkin ) | 2 whole canned chipotle peppers, roughly chopped | 1 jar maraschino cherries | 4 english muffins, split, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Wash and dry the potatoes then cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Place potatoes into a baking dish and toss with a little salt. Bake potato mixture for 1 hour, tossing 2/3rds of the potatoes around after every 5 minutes. Remove potatoes from oven and set aside to cool. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 onion with the chipotles in a medium frying pan or wok on medium high heat, stirring occasionally, for about 3 minutes. Add asparagus, squash, and the remaining diced onion. Cook, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes until asparagus, squash and onions are tender. Remove from heat and stir in cherry liquid, reserved potato mixture, and potatoes and chips. Place potato mixture on a baking sheet. Spread top evenly with salsa and return to the oven on the lowest rack. When the bell peppers have fully baked, about 10 minutes, remove the baking sheet from the oven. To serve, divide potato mixture among toasted english muffins, sprinkle with additional salsa, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,garlic clove,hamburger,corn oil,fruit,ricotta cheese,black tea
title: Frijoles a La Mexicana
