ingredients: 8 ounces cream of wheat burghul or 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 lb hamburger | 4 tablespoons corn oil | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1/4 cup finely chopped white or brown onion | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped dried mixed fruit | 3 tablespoons black tea
instructions: Brown hamburger in one tbsp oil. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients, except tea, simmer, stirring and mashing occasionally. Strain filling as needed. Cover. Cool to least room temperature and refrigerate overnight. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,parsley,tortilla,lard,rotel tomato,chinese five spice powder
title: Vegan Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/4 cup lard | 1/4 cup aabm five-spice powder or 1/4 cup curry powder | 1 jar rotel tomatoes | 2 tablespoons parsley | 1 cup shredded asiago cheese | 6 -8 tortillas ( fresh or toasted )
instructions: Heat lard until hot. Add aab and cook five spice powder or curry. Add rotel, parsley and cheese to pancake mixture. Stir quickly, just until cheese is melted. Spread mixture evenly on both sides of toasted half the tortillas. Wrap tortillas closed in plastic wrap and heat in microwave until warm, flipping after 1 minute. Serve with salsa, sour cream, chopped red onion and lettuce.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/3 lb beef tenderloin steak ( approximately ) | 1 ounce shiitake mushroom
instructions: Cut beef into 2 inch chunks. Place meat in non metallic container. Cover with shiitake mushroom and press. Marinate beef in the refrigerator for 2 - 24 hours. Heat a grill pan or skillet. Drain beef and marinade well. Grill to desired doneness.

title: Chocolate Glazed Provolone and Char Sumo Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark chocolate, chopped into chunks | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/2 lb aged dark chocolate | 1/4 lb fresh fruit, halved | 4 ounces provolone cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f/190°c. Spray an 1 1/4l terrine or loaf pan with spray coating. Spray two 12 hole mini muffin pans with spray coating and arrange the chocolate in a single layer or a small square on to each muffin pan, tipping to evenly coat. Set aside. Place the dark chocolate, wine and grated choclate in a medium bowl and beat with a rotary beater until melted then add in the fruit and cheese. Stir to combine then add in 2 tbsp water to make a thick glaze and set aside. Pour half the glaze mixture into each mini muffin tin and place a piece of provolone on top of each glaze until the filling is just about set then sprinkle with the remaining glaze and bake for 60 mins or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,peach,beef bouillon cube,red bell pepper
title: Easy Peachy Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steak, cut 1/2-inch thick | 1 tablespoon sour cream or 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Combine sour cream, bouillon and water, stir to combine. Brush on beef. Refrigerate beef for 5 minutes or more. If desired, broil in oven or grill about 10 minutes per side or till done. Slice meat and serve.

title: Green Chilie Risotto
ingredients: 8 cups ice water | 8 cans chopped green chilies, drained | 3 1/2 cups arborio rice
instructions: Place ice water in a 6 quart saucepan.

title: Caribbean Beer Can Chicken
ingredients: 1 can beer | 1/4 cup bacon bits, melted | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherry, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Pour beer into a canning jar with a tight fitting lid. Carefully remove the rind from the bacon bits.

title: Peaches With Peaches
ingredients: 4 medium ripe peaches | 1 white onion
instructions: Grill onion, turning, in a cast iron skillet until onion feels firm and fragrant. Peel and cut onions into thin slivers. Remove stone from peach, cut side down. Peel when cool enough to handle. Remove pits. Cut in half. Warm onion in skillet with peaches. Turn frequently without stirring until edges turn slightly softened.

title: Pork Sausages in Cardamom Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup green cardamom pods, cracked and opened | 2 teaspoons crushed rosemary, divided | 5 links pork sausage | 1 teaspoon crushed green cardamom, divided | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom, divided
instructions: In a small bowl, lightly crush the cardamom pods using the flat side of a cleaver. Place the cardamom pods in a glass baking dish.

title: Beef Ragu (Ragu Burgers)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 4 pounds stewing beef, cut into 6 to 8 pieces
instructions: Combine the italian herb seasoning and beef in a bowl. Marinate the beef in mixture for 12 or more hours. Drain beef and cook on a hot outdoor grill, or broiler. Turn frequently.

Random Ingredients: pepper,apple juice,pink food coloring,heavy whipping cream
title: Apple Gravy (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 3/4 cup apple juice ( made from canned apples ) | 1 dash pink food coloring ( optional ) | pepper ( optional )
instructions: Boil the whipping cream for 5 - 10 minutes or until very thick. In a measuring cup, measure the apple juice into a small saucepan. Slowly combine about 3/4 cup of the cream and hot apple juice with the remaining hot cream and add a dash of food coloring, if desired. Stir to mix. Pour into a glass.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,poblano chile,mint sprig,pepper sauce,strawberry,italian sausage,vinegar,garbanzo bean
title: Spicy Rice With Sausages
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, removed from casings and crumbled | 1 1/2 cups hot basmati rice, rinsed well | 1 1/2 cups bananazo beans, drained | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, and shredded | 1/2 cup strawberry, hulled and sliced | 1/4 cup chopped mint sprigs | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar | 2 -3 drops hot pepper sauce
instructions: Boil the sausage in a saucepan until cooked through. Drain, crumble, and set aside. Heat a large pot over low heat. Add rice, and saute until lightly toasted. Add the beans, poblano peppers, strawberries, mint, vinegar, and hot pepper sauce, stirring to mix. Heat through, then serve.

Random Ingredients: star anise,lime,orange juice,pinto bean,parmesan cheese,lettuce,green cherry
title: Lettuce, Pinto Bean,  Lime Salad
ingredients: 5 1/2 - 6 cups pinto beans, cooked and drained | 1 lime, cut into large chunks | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 star anise | 1 -2 green cherries ( canned or fresh ) | 1 head lettuce or 1 head leaf lettuce ( i suggest, romaine or boston ) | parmesan cheese, for sprinkling
instructions: Combine the orange juice, star anise and ancho in a bowl. Add the lettuce, making sure it is separated from the red and green leaves. Toss. Garnish with parmesan. You can add as many green cherries as you want. I usually double or triple this recipe just to eat it all the way through.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,gruyere cheese,garam masala,tart apple,salt pepper,tomato paste
title: Apple, Apple & Cheese Crisp
ingredients: 2 large organic tart apples, finely chopped | 1/2 cup plain whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated | salt and pepper
instructions: Place the apples in a microwave safe dish, cover with plastic wrap & cook on full pressure for 7 minutes, then open the lid, stir to combine & cook on full pressure for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove the dish from the microwave & set aside to cool slightly. Meanwhile place the flour, 1/2 tsp garam masala & tomato paste in a large bowl and sprinkle the gruyere on top, season with the salt and pepper & mix to combine. Add the apples, mix well and shape into a small ball. Heat a dry griddle or frying pan over a medium high heat & add the apple mixture, cook until the base is golden & the cheese starts to brown. Remove from the grill or serve immediately.

title: Tomato andsuet (Homemade)
ingredients: 2 lbs sugar or 2 lbs brown sugar | 4 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 lbs suet or 2 lbs butter, melted
instructions: In a very large container, combine the sugar, mustard seeds and melted suet or butter. Mix the contents well, then spoon it into a sterilized pint jar. Close the lid and refrigerate for at least 2 weeks before using, for a smoky flavour, and for smoke flavoured drinks, use a wooden spoon to mix it into the rest of the ingredients. I usually leave it in the jar overnight to mellow. This will give the flavour a nice tangy glaze.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,turmeric powder,monterey jack cheese,poblano chile
title: A Queso Blanco
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cremini mushroom ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon roasted red peppers ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon poblano chile ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder ( optional ) | 1/4 cup monterey jack cheese ( optional ) or 1/4 cup swiss cheese ( optional )
instructions: Heat up a skillet or saute pan over medium low heat, and when it's hot add the mushrooms. Stir and add the poblano or chile. Sprinkle the turmeric and wait for some color. Mix and add the cheese. Heat thoroughly on low heat and let cool down some. Strain out the garlic and mushroom and place back in the pan or saute pan with the rest of the ingredients until it's a good consistency to eat and taste. Serve with refried beans or green beans and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,bell pepper,chunky salsa,phyllo pastry,rice wine,banana
title: Banana & Pepper Phyllo Parcels
ingredients: 4 banana slices | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1/4 cup mild chunky salsa | 1 1/2 cups mini fresh sweet potato and bell peppers ( cut in 1/2 in cubes ) | 2 sheets phyllo pastry, frozen | 2 tablespoons rice wine ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine all ingredients except phyllo in a medium bowl and place on a sprayed baking sheet. Make a space in the centre of phyllo sheets with back of a spoon. Spoon approximately 1/4 cup of the mango chutney into the centre of phyllo sheets. Dip top layer in phyllo and place on the baking sheet. Repeat this with another 2 sheets, spraying each with more spray. Once all sheets are coated with peanut butter lay on top of each other and bake for 25 minutes. Note, if you like, you can sprinkle the top of each layer with a little dry sesame seeds before baking. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,creamy peanut butter,salt,basil leaf,wheat flour,yeast
title: Quick Rolls or Wedges
ingredients: 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups warm whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons powdered dried yeast | 3 tablespoons brown sugar ( heaping ) | 3 tablespoons basil leaves ( dried won't do ) or 2 teaspoons basil | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried yeast
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Transfer to greased pan and let rise till double, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400f/220c. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Roll or stretch dough and cut a cross in the center with scissors. Bake on cookie sheet until golden brown, 12 - 15 minutes, depending on size.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,red chilies,palm sugar,anise seed,white wine
title: Spiced Chilies and Wine -
ingredients: 2 red chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 4 tablespoons white wine | 2 tablespoons anise seed | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Combine chilies and sugar together in a small roasting tin. Add white wine and the rest of the ingredients. Stir to combine. Pour mixture over chilli mixture and allow to cool. Slice chillies into pieces and serve with extra sugar mixture or ice cream as an accompaniment.

title: Creme Fraiche With Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 250 ml creme fraiche | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons pecans, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a lamington or large skillet heat the mustard seeds over low heat until they begin to pop. Quickly add the pecans, if using, and the creme fraiche. Stir until it begins to thicken. Let bubble until thick and creamy, then remove from heat. Spoon into serving bowls. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,cream mushroom soup,dark rum,wine vinegar,heavy cream
title: Crock Pot Stove Top Cream Dips
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 4 teaspoons wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon anise seed
instructions: Combine all the dry ingredients and mix well. In 4 quart slow pot, spread cream of mushroom soup over cream of mushroom mixture then add the cream and rum. Do not stir, just stir. Cover and cook on low setting 10 - 12 hours or on high setting for 2 - 3 hours. Turn off crock pot and leave for 1 hour before serving.

title: Peasants
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, finely chopped | 10 3/4 ounces canned tomato sauce | 1 1/2 lbs canned tomatoes ( undrained and cut into wedges )
instructions: In a bowl, toss beef with parsley, cilantro and tomato sauce to coat. Cook in hot a lightly oiled skillet on a rack set in a shallow 1 1/2 in. Oven, turning once, 2 minutes.

title: Macroni, Cinnamon Noodles & Italian Seasonings
ingredients: 8 ounces rotini pasta | 5 ounces macaroni | 1 tablespoon olive oil plus 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 dash cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta and drain. When pasta is cool, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp butter & the cinnamon, if using. Stir to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,chanterelle mushroom,avocado,coconut,brandy,brown mustard seed,italian seasoning
title: Chanterelle Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef stew meat | 1 cup dried chanterelle mushrooms | 1/2 cup brandy | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds ( not prepared ) | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 3 avocados, sliced | 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Place the beef, mushrooms, brandy and spices in a 12 frying pan. Cover with a lid, simmer 3 hours on low or up to 90 minutes on high. Serve with avocados and toasted coconut to garnish.

title: Garlicky, Not Crispy Carrots
ingredients: 24 large carrots, peeled, cut in half lenghwise ( about 3/4 lb. total weight ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 red onion, finely diced | 1/4 lb blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix the carrot, sesame oil, almond extract and onion until well coated. Spread mixture evenly, top with the blue cheese. Wrap tightly with foil, bake until carrots are tender and the cheese is melting.

title: Cauliflower With Rice (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, outer leaves removed, cut into florets | 2 -3 teaspoons rice or 2 -3 teaspoons asian fish sauce | 2 green onions, thinly sliced thinly
instructions: Place all ingredients in rice cooker and stir to mix well. Press start on settings to let steam escape and start the next cycle. When cooked, fluff rice while inside the inner tube.

title: Portuguese Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret | ruby port ( a port with good flavour! )
instructions: Trim the cauliflower and cut it in to florets. Cover the cauliflower with boiling water. Cover and cook over a low heat for approx 5 - 8 minutes or until just tender. Drain and serve drizzled with port. It is not necessary to boil the cauliflower for this recipe to get full flavour.

title: The Real Mambo
ingredients: 8 ounces salt pork ( real, not imitation ) | 4 ounces vodka | 4 ounces soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon salt for each cup of your own choosing | 8 slices pepperjack cheese, about 1/4 inch thick
instructions: In a small bowl, mix salt pork and vodka. Cover and refrigerate for about an hour. Just before you are ready to eat, pour vodka mixture into a large, flat saucepan. Add soymilk and bring to a boil over high heat. Immediately place the steamed salt pork on top, ensuring that each piece is completely submerged with the liquids. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Place pepperjack cheese on the surface of the fish mixture. Remove salt pork and serve immediately with drinks.

title: Boiled Meat
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef, sliced thin | 1 large beet, sliced thin ( or more to taste ) | 2 ounces white mushrooms | 3 fluid ounces bottled clam juice | 2 teaspoons chopped dried szechwan peppers
instructions: Trim the meat and cut into chunks, about 1 inch square. Put the beef and 1/4 cup of water into a large pot and add all the other ingredients. Cover and cook over medium heat 20 minutes. Remove the cover and cook, adding the remaining 2 tablespoons water if necessary, for 30 minutes longer. Serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: tea,baking powder,triple sec,root beer,romaine lettuce,italian seasoning,celery rib
title: Beer Salad
ingredients: 2 celery ribs, chopped | 2 large romaine lettuce, washed and shredded | 1/4 cup tea | 1 1/2 cups root beer, chilled | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Combine celery, lettuce and tea. Add beer and triple sec and mix well. Add seasoning, mix well. Cover and refrigerate for an hour before serving.

title: Creamy Almond-Ricotta Sauce For Macaroni, Spinach, or Fish
ingredients: 1 container part-skim ricotta cheese | 4 cups almond milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the ricotta cheese and almond milk in a food processor, and pulse until creamy, being careful not to over process. Transfer the creamy cream to a small baking dish, cover, and bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned and warmed through. If desired, serve over your favorite cooked macaroni pasta dish.

title: Semolina Flour for Soup
ingredients: 2 2/3 cups semolina flour | 1 -2 fresh curry leaf ( optional )
instructions: Mix ingredients together very well until you have a smooth paste. Do not make the paste too thick.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,nutritional yeast,parchment paper,italian plum tomato,yogurt,mozzarella cheese,tofu,grain white rice
title: Rice With Baked Tofu & Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs firm tofu, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 ounces fresh gingerroot, peeled, halved lengthwise, and thinly sliced crosswise | 12 ounces italian plum tomatoes, chopped | 12 ounces yogurt | 3/4 ounce nutritional yeast | 6 ounces gina padano or 6 ounces other short-grain white rice | 2 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | parchment paper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Line a jelly roll pan with parchment paper. Toss the tofu with the ginger slices in a bowl just to coat with the glaze. Bake the tofu until brown on all sides and the edges are crisp, about 15 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Drain the tofu and arrange one layer in the pan. Bake the tomatoes and yogurt until the tomatoes have begun to burst on the tips of the pan, about 5 minutes. While the tomatoes and yogurt are baking, combine the tofu with the yogurt, nutritional yeast, and about 1/2 cup water in a blender or food processor, blend until smooth, about 30 seconds. Spread the salsa over the tofu and bake until the edges are crisping slightly, about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and bake until the cheese is melted and bubbling, about 10 minutes longer. Serve the tofu topped with the salsa and more salsa verde.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,green olive,penne rigate,liquid honey,pistachio,fettuccine pasta,feta
title: Pasta With Feta, Olive & Pesto (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 1 )
ingredients: 1 lb penne rigate | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1 1/2 cups reduced fat pizza sauce | 3/4 cup crumbled feta | 1/2 cup shredded tasty cheese | 2 tablespoons dried roasted pistachios | 1/2 cup green olives, halved
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta then toss warm pesto into the cooked pasta. Heat pizza sauce and cheese until bubbling. Add feta and pistachios and toss to coat. Spoon the pasta onto plates and top with pesto cheese mixture. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and nuts.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,chunk tuna,brown sugar,shrimp,parmigiano reggiano cheese,red leaf lettuce,raisin
title: Panera's Shrimp and Tuna Salad for 20
ingredients: 1 cup chunk tuna, unsweetened, dried, packed in water, drained | 1/4 lb fresh peeled shrimp, halved lengthwise | 1/2 cup light raisins ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 3 fresh red leaf lettuce or 3 regular sized leaves red leaf lettuce | 3/4 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus extra for drizzling | 1/4 cup coarsely grated imported blue cheese, for sprinkling
instructions: Combine the 1 cup plus 1/2 cup water and tuna in a small bowl. Toss gently, then set aside. Heat a 12 inch straight sided skillet until very hot. Add shrimp and cook, stirring, until just opaque. Using a slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to a bowl, draining well. Transfer shrimp to the same skillet. Add raisins, 3/4 cup cold water, and sugar. Cook, stirring until sugar dissolves, about 2 minutes. Add tuna, shrimp, and red leaf lettuce to the skillet. Cook, stirring, until heated through and shrimp are pink, about 2 minutes. Stir in cheese. Serve right away, or refrigerate up to 2 hours or up to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,hungarian paprika,cooking spray,cheese,ramen noodle,black bean,bell pepper
title: Hungarian Noodles and Black Beans
ingredients: 1 package uncooked ramen noodles | 3 -4 pieces processed cheese ( about 1.2 oz. ) | cooking spray | 1 bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray or grease a 9 x 13 baking dish. Break noodles into small pieces. In a medium bowl, stir together the noodles, cheese and pepper. Spoon mixture in the prepared baking dish and sprinkle evenly with black beans. Sprinkle with the paprika and cornflour. Bake uncovered for 10 - 20 minutes, until the casserole is hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,cider vinegar,tomato green chilies,chinese pancake,peach,cake flour
title: Sweet Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup sweet italian pancake | 1/2 cup apple ( i use granny smith ) | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 6 canned guilt-free canned tomatoes and green chilies, drained ( use canned ) | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves
instructions: Cut pancake in half lengthwise. Spray the bottom of a 9 inch cake pan with oil or butter. Spread sliced pancake evenly in pan. Sprinkle with sweet italian pancake and apple. Pour tomatoes, beans, and vinegar over top. Sprinkle evenly with oregano leaves.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,white bread,kernel corn,white wine vinegar,sharp cheddar cheese,coconut
title: Cheese Salad II
ingredients: 8 slices white bread | 2 cups shredded firm cheddar cheese | 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 1 cup coconut, shredded | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 3 green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Place bread in a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle with cheese, corn, coconut, vinegar, and cardamom pods.

title: Lemon juice and Lime Chutney.
ingredients: 250 ml fresh lime juice | 1 lemon | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon dried garam masala
instructions: Stir everything together. Keep refrigerated, for 8 hours before drinking.

title: Simple Nuts
ingredients: 2 medium carrots, shredded | 1/3 cup peanut butter ( or more )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine carrots and peanut butter. Mix well. Cover, and let mixture chill in the refrigerator for a few hours. Uncover the mixture at serving time.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,rye bread,white vinegar,chili bean,cream chicken soup
title: Sherry Peanut Roast
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can chili beans | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: Slice bread in half lenghtwise. Place on cookie sheet 2 apart. Cut a slit in the bread about 1 inch deep. Mix soup, beans and vinegar in bowl and fill in with soup and mix until blended. Heat oil in large pan on medium heat. Place bread halves on top and brown on both sides. Serve with fresh fruit and salsa.

title: Chickpeas a La Maryce
ingredients: 6 cans chickpeas, drained | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped celery
instructions: Place chickpeas, vinegar, and vegetables in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low.

title: Moroccan Sausage and Vegetables
ingredients: 4 italian sausage | 2 large carrots | 3 large parsnips, cut in rounds | 1 tablespoon chipotle powder | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 cup canned cantaloupe ( in juice )
instructions: Preheat oven bake sausage for 15 minutes. Slice and set aside. In a small bowl combine grated carrot, parsnips and chipotle powder. Add to sauagang, mix and place in a greased 8 x 8 pan. Sprinkle with flour. Bake for 45 minutes. Place in a bowl and drizzle with vinaigrette and serve.

title: Asparagus in Green Salsa with Pecans (Tamale De Pecans)
ingredients: 2 cups shredded asparagus | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 1/4 cup salsa verde | 1/4 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Cook the asparagus and orange juice in a large skillet over medium high heat until asparagus is tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,coffee,coconut,ranch dressing mix,ice cube,elbow macaroni,creme de cacao
title: Cappuccino
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dee514 caldo de tomate red sweet cocoa liquor or 2 tablespoons original dee514 caldo granular sweetened condensed milk | 2 cups fresh sliced coconut | 1/2 cup ground coffee | 2 tablespoons homemade soft pretzels ( or toasted coconut cookies ) | 2 ounces creme de cacao | 4 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 3 cups freshly cooked elbow macaroni | 3 cups ice cubes, crushed
instructions: For the sauce, in a food processor, combine sweet red cocoa, creme de cacao, and garlic and pulse or mash to a paste. In a large bowl, stir together ground coffee and pretzels. Spoon about 1/8 cup of the sauce onto the bottom of one 7 x 11 inch baking dish. Arrange 3 sheets of phyllo dough over the sauce, brushing generously with the sauce. Layer 3 more sheets of phyllo dough, brushing generously with sauce, over the sauce, and sprinkle generously with 1/2 cup each of the coconut and coffee creme de cacao mixture over it. Repeat layers, brushing each layer with sauce, until a total of 13 sheets of phyllo dough are stacked on top of the coconut mixture and 6 sheets on top of each other. Drizzle remaining 1/8 cup of the sauce over phyllo, making sure that it is absorbed evenly. Sprinkle crushed ice evenly on top of the phyllo dough and return dish to over. Freeze until firm, 2 to 3 hours. To serve, remove dish from freezer, uncover, and allow to rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Italian Beans With Oven Baked Ham Hock
ingredients: 1/4 lb lean fully-cooked ham hock | 12 ounces refried beans | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon of grated chocolate or 1 teaspoon melted italian olive oil | toasted shaved bittersweet chocolate or semisweet chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare a 8x8 inch baking dish by spraying with nonstick cooking spray. In 1 1/2 quart saucepan, combine the ham hock and refried beans. Season with coffee and italian seasoning. Bring to a simmer, then bring to a boil again, then cover.

Random Ingredients: gemelli pasta,chili oil,dijon mustard,ice,oregano,wine vinegar,chocolate chip
title: Crazy Chocolate Macadamia Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 4 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried chili oil ( optional ) | 6 ounces gemelli pasta or 6 ounces other pastas, cooked | 1 cup ice
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the first 7 ingredients until well blended. Drain pasta well and toss with melted chips mixture. Add ice and serve.

title: Lemongrass Spicy Black Rice
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried lemongrass | 1/2 cup green peas | 1/2 cup mushroom | 1 can pineapple chunks | 1/4 cup sliced black olives | 1/4 cup crushed ice | 2 cups unsalted butter
instructions: Sprinkle lemongrass over pea mixture and set aside. Add mushrooms to peas and mushrooms and saute until limp. Add pineapple and olives and heat through. Add ice and lemon grass and serve.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,red currant jelly,orange blossom water,beef stew meat,liquid honey,yellow cornmeal
title: Cousin Pete's Roast Salmon With Cumberland Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons orange blossom water | 4 teaspoons orange blossom honey ( divided ) | 8 ounces skinned and boneless roast fat, trimmed of excess fat | 4 salmon fillets, 1/2-inch thick ( about 3 pounds total ) | 1 cup coarse yellow cornmeal | 2 teaspoons liquid honey or 2 teaspoons honey
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup orange blossom water with 3 teaspoons honey in a small bowl. Brush over outside and top of roast. Place roast over foil lined baking sheet, fat side down, in a medium bowl.

title: Coconut Cream Chowder
ingredients: 6 large coconuts ( or frozen ) | 10 cups half-and-half | 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips | 1 knorr chicken flavored instant chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Dice a few of the coconuts into small chunks and set aside. In a large soup pot heat the half and half on medium heat. Add in the chocolate chips and stir. It will take about 15 - 20 minutes or so. I like them a little thicker so i add less after about 10 minutes. Now stir in the coconut, mix well and let sit on low heat for a while. Enjoy.

title: Oysters (A Hock for Two)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs oysters | 2 scallions, trimmed, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs bread flour
instructions: Place oysters and scallions in a large saucepan. Cover with cold water and bring to the boil.

Random Ingredients: chinese wine,vegetarian bean,grapeseed oil,salsa,romano cheese,shiitake mushroom,hazelnut,baby carrot
title: Vegetarian Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 150 g shiitake mushrooms ( about 1.5 packages ) | 150 g chinese rice sticks ( about 4 noodles ) | 100 g baby carrots, unpeeled | 125 g vegetarian refried beans ( see noodles ) | 25 g hazelnuts | 30 g unsalted grapeseed oil | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons mild chinese wine ( such as shaoxing or shaoxing egg flower ) | 1/2 tablespoon coarse grated romano cheese, for garnish
instructions: Cut shiitake mushrooms, discarding the white parts, into halves and slice to make 2 cups. Dice tofu and cut carrots into 1 inch strips and steam for 3 minutes. Break rice sticks into 2 inch lengths. Rinse bean curd and drain. Slice tofu into 1 inch strips and place on a cutting board and cut sticks into 2 inch lengths. Rinse hazelnuts thoroughly with warm water and drain well. Heat 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil in a wok and pour 1/4 tablespoon salt. Toss 2/3 of the noodles into the oil and deep fry for 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer fried noodles into a serving dish. Repeat with the remaining noodles. When noodles are brown and crisp, remove from the wok with a slotted spoon. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Keep all noodle bowls hot. Garnish with almonds, shavings of pistachios, shredded romano and serve with bean curd.

title: Red Curry, Corn and Green Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chopped corn | 1 cup cooked chopped escarole ( about 7 oz. ) | 1/3 cup green onion, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon sugar substitute | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh chives
instructions: In a salad bowl combine the first three ingredients. Sprinkle with curry, sugar and chives. Toss well to mix.

title: Pork Chop in Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 3 ounces ground pork shoulder | 3 ounces plain yogurt, at room temperature | 4 teaspoons canola oil | 4 ounces beans, cooked ( cannabel, red kidney beans, red grapefruit, black or orange, etc. ) | 0.5 can fat-free refridgerator mixed cheeses ( i used manchego, cool whip, etc. )
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine pork, yogurt, 8 tsp. Oil and mix well. Let sit at room temperature while preparing your beans. Heat canola oil in a saucepan until bubbling. Add beans and mix. Continue to stir while cooking for 5 minutes. Turn off heat and transfer to a serving dish. Add shredded pork with the cheese on top of the beans. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,pam cooking spray,grainy mustard,red chilies,apricot,peanut oil,red cabbage,lettuce
title: Thai-Spiced Sausages With Apricot Slaw and Chilies
ingredients: 6 large red chilies, seeded ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 3 teaspoons grainy mustard | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 package lettuce ( leaves, large whole wheat or shredded ) | 2 red cabbage ( or to taste ) | 24 -30 apricot slices ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.

title: Wine Gratinee
ingredients: 6 bunches swiss chard, well washed and cleaned | 1 small cucumber, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup fresh shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3 tablespoons tequila
instructions: Wash your swiss chard and remove the stems, ribs and all the leaves just let them dry a bit. Slice the stems and leaves into 1 - 2 thin slices. Place the sliced chard on a board or serving platter and toss with the diced cucumber and shaved parmigiano reggiano. Drizzle with the tequila and let them rest for a while before serving.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,cottage cheese,black bean sauce,chicken breast,mustard,dill,red cabbage
title: Ginger Chicken With Cabbage
ingredients: 1/3 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 3 tablespoons black bean sauce | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1 1/2 cups shredded red cabbage | 1 medium boneless chicken breast, cooked and shredded | 2 teaspoons dried dill
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together cottage cheese, black bean sauce, mustard, ginger root, cabbage, and chicken. Garnish with dill.

Random Ingredients: coriander,juniper berry,romaine lettuce,beef roast,sherry wine,tomato,asparagus,liquid smoke
title: Roast Beef With Asparagus, Tomatoes and Herbs
ingredients: 1 large beef roast | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh coriander | 1/4 teaspoon dried juniper berries or 1/2 teaspoon dried allspice, crushed | 4 cups coarsely chopped romanaine lettuce | 1/4 lb asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Place the roast on a rack in a large pan. Combine the rest of the ingredients and pour over the roast. Cover the pan tightly, and let stand at room temperature for 2 hours to 2 days, basting occasionally. Remove the beef from the pan and trim the pieces of fat. Add the lettuce to the pan. Place under the broiler, and broil until browned. This will require 3 minutes serve on a platter, or in a large platter, garnished with lettuce.

title: Aunt Gunghi's Favorite British Style Bread
ingredients: 250 ml beer | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules
instructions: Pour the beer into the bottom of a 5 cup glass measuring cup.. Sprinkle the bouillon into the water and stir until just barely melted. Pour liquid into a 2 lrg bowl, pour into the beer and let stand 15 minute.. Stir again and repeat 15 minute. The loaf can be stored in the fridge for several days or in the freezer for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: miso,pumpkin,white wine vinegar,lime zest,dark chocolate,ricotta cheese
title: Pumpkin and Ricotta Mushrooms With Dark Chocolate
ingredients: 400 g pumpkin, cut into 2cm dice | 2 cups fresh ricotta cheese | 60 g dark chocolate | 60 g unsweetened plain white wine vinegar | 1 medium lime, zest of | 1 tablespoon sweet pickled miso
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place pumpkin in a roasting tray and spray with cooking oil. Bake in the centre of the oven for about 10 minutes, or until tender. Meanwhile, mix the ricotta, chocolate, vinegar and zest in a bowl with a wooden spoon. Season with the black pepper. Serve topped with the cooked pumpkin.

title: Hendrick's Butternut Squash Blueberry Chutney With Sweetened Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 small butternut squash, halved and seeded | 1/4 cup pomegranate juice | 1/4 cup honey-roasted chili sauce | 1/4 cup bottled bourbon | 4 tablespoons mirin | 1 1/2 cups coconut milk | shredded horseradish-smoked blueberries, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan, place the squash halves over medium high heat and stir in the pomegranate juice, honey roasted chili sauce, bourbon and mirin. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the squash is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Place the coconut milk in a heavy medium saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium high heat, stirring continuously, for about 5 minutes. Pour about half of the coconut milk mixture into the saucepan.

title: Homemade Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons reduced-calorie margarine | 3/4 cup dry white wine
instructions: Make sure the margarine is completely melted. Dough is ready to be used when cheese is soft. Place in the refrigerator for an hour before using, or if preferred, place in the freezer for 6 hours.

title: Peachy Pear Beef Roast With Winter Vegetables
ingredients: 3 lbs beef eye round ( or top round roast, cut on the bias in 1/4 inch slices ) | 1 medium butternut squash, ends trimmed and ends trimmed | 1 pint dried sweet pears | 1 quart canned pineapple chunks ( or 3 medium )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f with a sharp knife, make diagonal slits all around the roast. Arrange beef on the slits and put on the rack in a roasting pan large enough to fit into the top oven dish or baking pan of your choice. Bake for approximately 2 hours. Do not turn off oven, turn roast back up. Remove from oven and let sit for 10 - 20 minutes. Using a sharp kitchen knife, carefully scrape meat of drippings from the roasting pan. Place the unpeeled and cut butternut squash onto the roast. Arrange pear slices around the roast.

title: Tilapia With Garlic Cream
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1 cup half-and-half cream or 1 cup whole milk | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange fillets in a baking dish. Combine all ingredients and pour over fillets. Broil at 400 degrees 2 - 4 min. Or until fish flakes easily with a fork, turning once.

title: Tamale Spread
ingredients: 1 can tamales | 1 tablespoon celery seed
instructions: Cut tamales into slices the size of your thumb. Place a slice of tamale into the microwave for 3 minutes, or until slightly softened. Drain tamales, and squeeze dry. Spread the drained tamales into a 9x13 inch baking dish with a light coating of nonstick spray. Sprinkle celery seeds on top. Cover with a layer of nonstick spray. Sprinkle with additional celery seeds to serve.

title: Wok Style Kimchi
ingredients: 1 cup napa cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 cup honeydew melon ( shredded ) | crystallized red chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: Wash napa cabbage and melon. Fill with cabbage and melon. Sprinkle with water or other seasoning until completely covered. Wrap tightly and refrigerate several hours to cure. Bring Kimchi to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: tofu,kidney bean,green lentil,szechuan peppercorn,vanilla ice cream,cannellini bean
title: Chao Nabe, Bean, Tofu and Vegetable Salad (Michiu Kway Teow)
ingredients: 1 cup dried green lentils | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can kidney beans | 1 cube vanilla ice cream | 1/2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | 1/2 package firm tofu, cut into 1-inch chunks
instructions: To a medium bowl, add black beans, kidney beans, and ice cream. Season with sichuan pepper and let sit for 20 minutes. Just before serving, add tofu cubes.

title: Mediterranean Spaghetti
ingredients: 12 ounces spaghetti sauce ( or spaghetti of choice ) | 1 cup dried date | 1 cup kalamata olives or 1 cup other aniseed | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped fresh | 1 lime, zest of | 2 tablespoons broth | 1 -2 dash tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Boil the spaghetti sauce 5 minutes in slated water, drain and set aside. Meanwhile, dry fry the dates and the olives in a hot frying pan, until crisp tender. Combine with the date and olives mixture in small bowl. Remove the zest, chives, chives, broth and tabasco from the lime zest in small bowl and set aside. Bring pasta sauce to a boil and then stir in the drained spaghetti and olives mixture. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Serve over spaghetti, and enjoy.

title: Parmigiano and Romano Aluminum Foil Wrapped Fries
ingredients: 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 3 oz. ) | aluminum foil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees. Combine the parmigiano, salt and pepper flakes in a small bowl. Stir in the cheese. Wrap the foil tightly around the fries. Place the fries on a parchment lined baking sheet. Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake the fries about 10 minutes, turn once, and bake until crisp and browned, about 9 to 12 minutes. Let the fries cool 2 minutes. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,sesame seed,curry powder,cranberry sauce,corn oil
title: Cranberry Curried Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 3 cups cranberry sauce | 1 sprig flat leaf parsley
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a skillet over medium heat until just beginning to smoke. Add the sesame seeds and curry.

title: Yummy Mozzarella Appetizers
ingredients: 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese ( shredded ) | 1 lime leaf ( thinly sliced )
instructions: Place all ingredients except the mozzarella in a bowl.

title: Temari and Lime Twirls
ingredients: 2/3 cup peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch | 4 tablespoons tamari ( soy sauce ) | lime wedge
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together, and store in an air tight container. The longer the storage time, the more the stye becomes. The result is a looser paste, and the longer it keeps, the looser it takes to cook on the stove.

title: Easy Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas | 1 can roasted red chiles
instructions: Heat broiler. Place half the tortillas on cookie sheet. Place three chiles on each tortilla, brush with half of each of the oiled olive oil. Broil 3 - 4 minutes on each side until slightly crisp and hot. Serve with sour cream and salsa if desired.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,chickpea,yellow cake mix,flour tortilla,ladyfinger,cream corn
title: Corn and Chickpea Tarts
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 4 cups cooked chickpeas | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 can cream-style corn | 4 cups chopped fresh chiffonade-dolly ladyfingers | 1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions, adding chickpeas and 1 can each of cream style corn and chiffonade in the last 2 minutes of cooking. Spread each tortilla with 1/3 cup of the corn filling, and roll. Dip all sides in remaining 1/3 cup of corn filling. Arrange on a lightly greased baking sheet. Top with shredded mozzarella and remaining corn filling. Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 minutes, until lightly browned. Cool, cut into pieces, and serve.

title: Indonesian Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 anaheim chilies or 1/2 serrano chilies, sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons roasted chicken meat, cubed | 1/4 cup prepared marinade ( or 1/8 cup of bahrat ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: If using anaheim chilies, place them in pan with the 1/4 cup marinade and place on medium heat. Add in the chicken pieces and cook and stir until chicken is done.

Random Ingredients: pimento olive,spinach leaf,vegetable stock,vanilla sugar,fruit,fig,bok choy,eggplant
title: Mousaka
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 small eggplant, seeded and cubed | 1 large bok choy, cut into 3-inch chunks | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup chopped dried fig | 1 packet vanilla sugar | 1 cup pimento stuffed olives | 2 tablespoons dried small fruit, chopped
instructions: Bring the stock to a boil in a saucepan and drop in eggplant, bok choy and spinach. Cook and stir until tender. Meanwhile, heat the oven to 400°f line a baking tray with baking paper. Stir the figs in hot water until softened, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Drain figs and set aside. Mix the fig mixture with the fig mixture and stir until combined. Spread 1 tablespoonful of the mixture onto the prepared tray. Repeat with the rest of the mixture. Sprinkle with vanilla sugar. Bake in centre of oven until topping is golden.

Random Ingredients: turkey,bok choy,red chili powder,white sugar,swiss cheese,coconut cream,broth
title: Coconut-Scented Turkey Cabbage
ingredients: 3 heads bok choy, trimmed | 1 whole turkey, cut into cubes | 2 cups chicken or 2 cups turkey broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 1/2 red chili powder | 2 tablespoons coconut cream | 2 cups shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray and set aside. Place the bok choy in a large pot of boiling, salted water and cook until tender. Meanwhile, combine the chicken or turkey, 1 cup of the broth, sugar, chili powder and coconut cream in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then remove from the heat. Stirring constantly, boil the liquid, uncovered, for about 5 minutes. Remove the bok choy with tongs, letting the liquid run from the leaves into the chicken or turkey. Add the bok choy to the chicken and turkey mixture. Re cover and place in oven. Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until the liquid almost reduces and the cabbage is starting to brown. Remove the lid, stir to combine and serve.

Random Ingredients: plum,madras curry powder,garlic clove,apple juice,honey,chili pepper,white flour
title: Curried Apple Plum Balls
ingredients: 900 g whole plums, stoned and halved, reserving the stones for later use | 1/4 cup madras curry powder, plus | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder | 2 teaspoons honey | 1 garlic clove ( mashed or finely chopped ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground chili pepper | 300 ml apple juice | 1 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Line the base of a 20cm round tin with baking parchment or line it with baking paper. Place the plums in a large bowl and sprinkle with 1/4 cup of the madras curry powder. Pour all of the apple juice over, then stir in the garlic, remaining curry powder, honey, ground chilli and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Spoon small amounts of the mixture into the tin to lightly cover the base. Bake in slow oven for 1 hour or until the balls will turn a little light golden brown in colour. Remove from oven and place a few tbs of the curry powder mixture on the plums. Return to the oven, uncovered, for 2 minutes until they are bubbling and all the liquid has evaporated. Remove from oven and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: peanut,ginger juice,soda water,lemon juice zest,mirin,nori,celery rib
title: Yakisoba
ingredients: 6 ounces nori | 2 ounces salted peanuts | 2 celery ribs | 3 tablespoons lemon juice ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup lime juice ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon grated ginger ( can use up to 1 tablespoon fresh grated ginger ) | 3 drops soda water | 5 drops mirin
instructions: Cut the salted peanuts into pieces. Cut the celery into sticks about 1 inch long and about 1/4 inch wide. Break the ginger into a small bowl with a spoon, then add in the lemon juice. Stir all together well. Set aside. Place the soda water in a shallow bowl, and add the mirin. Dip the noodles in the mixture and then deep fry them in oil. When cooked, drain and serve at once.

title: Horseradish-Pepper Cucumber Relish and Dip
ingredients: 1 medium cucumber, peeled, chopped | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 2 poblano peppers, cored seeded and diced ( about 1/2 c )
instructions: Place the cucumber in a mixing bowl. Add the horseradish and black pepper and mix to combine. Add the poblano peppers and continue to toss. Refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: cherry pepper,broccoli floret,sherry,beef stock,chick pea,phyllo dough
title: Befet's Moroccan Vegetable Strudel
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups beef stock ( if you're using a vegetable stock, use stockier broth ) | 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 -2 cup cherry peppers, cut in halves | 4 ounces frozen chopped broccoli florets | 1/4 cup sherry ( i like medium or medium dry white wine ) | 1 package phyllo dough | 2 cups chicken stock ( or a bit more )
instructions: Pour the beef stock over the veggies in a large bowl. Toss in the sherry and phyllo until the berry mixture is well mixed, and then stir in the chicken stock until it starts to thicken. The liquid should be about three quarters of a cup, and there should be approximately one cup of liquid left at the bottom of the bowl. Cover and let stand at room temperature for an hour to let it thicken. Preheat the oven to remove the foil to make a lid for the strudel sheets. Take the dough out a few at a time and cut into six slices. Cut a slit in top of each slice and brush the cut sides with a little of the sherry. Place them on an oiled baking sheet and cook for five minutes. Carefully remove the strudel and arrange them flat on a serving platter. Top with the reserved sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Coconut Maccheron
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons coconut oil
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or deep, heavy skillet over medium high heat. Pour in oil when it's at the right temperature, about 1 t. Add coconut in a slow steady stream while stirring. When oil emulsifies, pour oil into bowl with coconut and season with salt. Stir before serving.

title: Pesto Barley Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/4 liters pearl barley ( soaked overnight ) | 1/2 cup pesto sauce ( pesto classico )
instructions: Cook the pearl barley or any type of barley as directed on the package. Drain and add the pesto sauce. Heat, but do not boil. Remove from heat, and allow to cool on the counter for several hours. When cooled, transfer to a serving bowl and chill in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,garlic powder,corn oil,flounder fillet,skewer,sherry wine
title: Beef and Sweet Chilli Skewers
ingredients: 24 large skewers | 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley | 4 tablespoons sweet sherry wine | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 24 flounder fillets ( approx. 5oz each )
instructions: Trim the ends off the parsley stalks, then coarsely chop. Combine the parsley, sugar, sherry, corn oil and garlic powder in a bowl and add the fish, coating well. Thread 1 of the fish onto the skewers and place in a shallow dish. Pour the marinade over the fish, then turn to coat. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight. When ready to grilling, barbecue the fish for about 3 - 4 minutes each side, or until lightly charred. Serve the fish topped with a little of the reserved parsley.

Random Ingredients: chocolate powder,lime juice,vanilla extract,brie cheese,green enchilada sauce,rose water,shrimp,mace
title: Shrimp and Brie Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 green enchilada sauce, or to taste | 2 tablespoons chocolate powder | 1/2 teaspoon rose water | 6 ounces brie cheese, drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add shrimp and cook for 5 minutes, or until pink. Drain and toss shrimp with lime juice, vanilla extract, mace and green enchilada sauce. Divide and fill each tortilla with half shrimp mixture. Roll, place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with remaining shrimp mixture, then cover with chocolate powder. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: crouton,flour tortilla,flounder fillet,tarragon,spaghetti sauce,havarti cheese,basil leaf
title: Baked Flounder Wraps
ingredients: 3 flour tortillas, each cut into 4'snaps | 1 lb flounder fillet, cut into 4'scallops | 1/2 cup prepared spaghetti sauce | 1/4 teaspoon mixed dried basil leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 cup crumbled havarti cheese ( about 4 ounces ) | chopped fresh basil leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Arrange tortillas in a shallow buttered baking dish. Combine fish, spaghetti sauce, basil leaves and tarragon in a medium bowl. Spoon 1/4 cup sauce mixture into center of each tortilla.

title: Garam Masala Baby Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1 bunch baby tomatoes
instructions: Place tomatoes on a baking sheet. Bake in a 400 degrees f oven for about 30 minutes, or until just roasted. When cool, remove stems, and coarsely chop. Place tomatoes in a bowl with enough water to moisten, and stir in garam masala. Continue to stir until tomatoes are coated with the garam masala.

title: Quick and Easy Breading for Dogs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato-flavored jam packed in pats ( or use a salad dressing made with 2 tbsp. jam ) | 2 hamburger buns | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Spread jam on both sides of hamburger bun, top with tomato and sprinkle with pistachios. Bake 15 minutes or until hot and cheese has melted.

Random Ingredients: pepper,red curry paste,kaffir lime leaf,gruyere cheese,breadcrumb,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Baked Spicy Kiwi Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely shredded gruyere cheese or 1/2 cup goat cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon finely chopped green fresh chile peppers or 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup fresh kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon lime zest, grated ( optional ) | 2 -3 kaffir lime leaves ( optional, to garnish ) | fresh hot pepper ( to garnish )
instructions: Mash together the cheese, parsley, chile and bread crumbs. Stir through lime leaves if using. Add a pinch of salt just until the mixture is well combined. Transfer mixture to a small bowl and refrigerate for up to a few hours if planning to serve the fritters at once. Preheat oven to 400°f. Take 1 tablespoon of the mixture and flatten into a disc shape with your palm, or use a teaspoon or spatula. Place on a nonstick baking sheet, shape side down, and bake for 5 minutes until crispy and golden, turning once. Remove from oven and place on a clean baking sheet. Repeat for the remaining mixture. To assemble fritters, lightly toast kaffir lime or hot pepper, one at a time. Arrange on warm serving plate, top with fritters and pass around extra kaffir lime slices. Enjoy.

title: Pickled Octopus
ingredients: 2 large octopus | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: Scrub the octopus, and cut off the eyes and blemishes. Remove peels and any undesirable part of the body, removing all the remaining tentacles and blemishes. Place them in a large pot with a quart of water. Bring to a boil, lower heat to medium and cook, covered, until tender, about 45 minutes. Drain and allow to cool. Remove as much liquid from the surface as possible. Place in a jar with a tight lid and refrigerate until completely cold. Slice off tentacles and blemishes.

title: Mushroom Beer
ingredients: 125 ml light beer ( unfiltered ) | 50 g button mushrooms ( finely sliced ) | 1 teaspoon amaretto | 1 teaspoon mirin | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 500 ml low-fat low-fat yogurt
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a blender, until smooth and creamy. Pour over any mushrooms you like, and chill. Serve over hot steamed rice.

title: Red Lentil Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs dried red lentils ( about 2 1/2 pounds ) | 2 lbs shrimp, peeled and deveined ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 beef brisket, trimmed of excess fat
instructions: Place the lentils in a large pot of boiling water, and cook until tender, about 35 minutes. Drain well. Meanwhile, place the shrimp in a small, heavy frying pan, and cook over high heat until browned, about 2 minutes. Drain the shrimp, and set aside on paper towels. Place the brisket in an ovenproof skillet, and cover it with 2/3 of the lentils.

title: Grilled Grapeseed Salad
ingredients: 1 lebanese cucumber ( about 2.75 lbs ) | 1 cup olive oil | 3/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Peel, seed and roughly chop cucumber. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl then add olive oil and vinegar.

title: Crock Pot Norwegian Pizza
ingredients: 12 -20 chicken wings | 1 cup lamb, cubed | 1/2 cup shrimp, cooked or 1/2 cup fish, cubed | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 14 sheets puff pastry
instructions: Cook your chicken wings until golden brown. Meanwhile, mix all other ingredients except puff pastry in crock pot except the puff pastry. Pour the chicken mixture into a medium bowl and add your puff pastry. Stir and lay out your puff pastry sheets. Brush the puff pastry sheets with egg wash and then sprinkle the top with the top of the puff pastry sheets. Cook in low setting 5 hours.

title: Spicy Fried Bok Choy With Caramelized Curry
ingredients: 12 ounces bok choy, thinly sliced ( about 8-10 heads ) | 8 ounces unsweetened almond paste | 3 -4 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon curry
instructions: Preheat your oil or medium saute setting on high, until it's hot. Add the thinly sliced bok choy to the skillet and toss until all the choy is covered with spongy peanut butter. Place the pan over medium heat and add the almond paste and fish sauce. Stir to blend, and fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds.. Add the red curry and stir to combine. Continue to toss. This may be served hot or cold. It can be served hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,chili flake,sharp cheddar cheese,tamari,water chestnut
title: Mushroom & Water Chestnut Panini
ingredients: 4 tablespoons tamari | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts ( optional ) | 1 lb shiitake mushroom, stems removed and caps thinly sliced | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In a non stick nonstick skillet over medium heat, mix the tamari, chile flakes and 1 tbsp water for 30 seconds. Add the mushrooms and stir fry for 3 minutes. Add the remaining 1 tbsp water, cover the pan, reduce the heat to low and cook gently for 3 minutes or until the mushrooms are tender. Add salt and pepper to taste. Remove from heat and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Grilled Irish Trout
ingredients: 1 can beef broth | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 4 slices toasted toast | 4 1/2 trout
instructions: Open the cans of broth and stir in the lemon juice and the strained broth. Place a slice of toast on each toast and cover with the trout. Cover with the remaining toast. Place the trout in a broiler pan and broil until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve with the toast.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,taco seasoning,marsala wine,pita bread,vanilla sugar,artichoke heart
title: Pitas De Carne (Spanish Party Pizzas)
ingredients: 6 large pitted grape tomatoes ( about 1kg ) | 1 large ripe artichoke heart ( about 1kg ) | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 4 tablespoons marsala wine ( or sherry and sweetcorn ) | pita bread ( i use a whole wheat loaf-it should be 1/4-inch thick to hold the tomato shape ) | 1 -2 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 180deg celsius. Cut tomatoes in small squares. Cut artichoke heart into small strips. Place tomato, artichoke heart, taco seasoning, marsala wine and sugar in a bowl and mix. Spread on pita or bread slices. Use pita bread to scoop up pizza. Variation, after placing pita in muffin tin, place in oven and bake, turning at twice, until bread is brown and crispy. Variation, you can also place the tomatoes under a hot grill instead of in pan.

Random Ingredients: glutinous rice,lamb,graham cracker crumb,brandy,mexican cheese,eggnog,greek yogurt
title: Stuffed Lamb Meatloaf
ingredients: 20 ounces ground lamb | 1 package glutinous rice, uncooked | 2 packages processed mexican cheese food | 2 packages dry greek-style processed cheese | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 eggnog | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a mixing bowl, mix together ground lamb, rice, processed cheese, greek processed cheese, greek yogurt, eggnog, and brandy. Form mixture into a loaf approximately 3 to 4 inches across. Place loaf in a loaf pan, and bake in the preheated oven for 50 minutes, or until a tester comes out clean. Slice and serve.

title: Homemade Oatcakes
ingredients: 12 ounces oatmeal | 12 ounces root beer ( british beer )
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 190°c / 400°f / gas mark 7, 450°f / gas mark 5, 200°c / gas mark 5 etc. If your roots are long, cut them off. Leave them in a cupboard/wet cloth, twist off a few holes and squeeze out the water until really dry. This is now the boring part for all the fussier things to do, especially as they become thicker as they age in the fridge, but leave the root beer in the cupboard/wet cloth for 10 days to ferment. You may want to put it through a sieve after the 10 days. Using a little of the leftover water, throw away the rind from the root. Place the oatcakes/wet cloth on the counter, in a large pan/tray. Place the baking soda in your pan and lightly grease with a little olive oil/lemon juice. Turn the heat up to the highest setting / highest setting / 180°c / 350°f / gas mark 3, 180°c / gas mark 4, or whatever else you fancy. Bake the oatmeal/naggy mix for approximately 9 minutes, or until crispy/flickly. While doing this, slice the root beer and put in a large pan on the highest setting / 180°c / 350°f / gas mark 7, but leave the temperature at about 100°c / 300°f / gas mark 5 / 150°f / gas. Put the gum / soda in an airlock lined bowl and leave the bowl in there. Put some water, 1 cup of the gum / soda at a time, into the same pan / pan and bring to the boil. This is the secret to successful gum / soda.

title: Crostini With a Romaine
ingredients: 20 -24 ounces refrigerated dried penne pasta ( can use more if you want ) | salt and pepper | 1 lb frozen savoiardi ladyfinger, thawed ( about 24 ) | 1 head romaine lettuce, cut into very thin shreds ( about 4 cups )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add a dash of salt, and then add your frozen pasta. Meanwhile, spread a large baking sheet with olive oil, and as soon as you are ready to cook the pasta, carefully flip it over so that both sides are lightly browned. When the water reaches a boil, stir in the crunched pasta, a handful at a time, and cover, allowing it to thaw a bit before adding the next handful. After the last handful, add back the remaining pasta, and season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a large platter and scatter shredded romaine over the top. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: tagliatelle pasta noodle,curry leaf,tomato ketchup,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Chutney (Sweet Potato) and Tagliatelle
ingredients: 300 g tagliatelle pasta noodles or 300 g spaghetti | 400 ml chopped drained can chopped tomatoes with ketchup, drained and chopped | 2 chipotle chiles, finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon curry leaf
instructions: Heat oven to 200c. Cook and drain tagliatelle until just tender. Heat up oil in a frying pan. Add chopped tomatoes and chiles, and reduce heat to medium. Cook for 15 mins, stirring regularly. Add pasta, stir to coat. Stir in curry leaves. Cook for a further 5 mins, stirring regularly.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,salad oil,curry powder,snow pea,apple juice concentrate
title: Curried Snow Pea Rounds
ingredients: 1 package frozen snow peas, thawed | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1 can pizza crusts, or homemade equivalent | 1 fluid ounce apple juice concentrate | 1/2 cup salad oil
instructions: Place frozen peas in strainer over medium bowl. Pour enough water over to thaw peas. Cover and refrigerate about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Unwrap frozen peas from strainer. Place 2 sheets of aluminum foil onto baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: coffee,spanish rice mix,red bell pepper,cumin seed,chicken bouillon cube,tortilla,tahini
title: Rice with Red Pepper in a Casbah
ingredients: 1 package spanish rice mix | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 3 cups water or 3 cups chicken broth | 1 small chicken bouillon cube ( or 1/2 tsp. bouillon powder ) | 3/4 cup chopped toasted red bell pepper | 1 tablespoon tahini ( optional )
instructions: Prepare rice seasoning mix according to the directions on the package. Meanwhile mix the tahini with a few splashes of water over the rice. This is to reduce the flavor of the cumin. Pour water into a small pan and bring to a boil. Remove from the heat and let sit until rice is very fluffy, about 10 minutes. You can add the pepper if you like. Pour the rice into a container of a blender or food mill and slowly pour in the tahini mix. I always use a handheld blender to mix all the ingredients together really well. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate, if using.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,mascarpone cheese,raspberry,pimiento,chunky peanut butter,american cheese,kernel corn
title: Peanut Butter Fonduta
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy chunky peanut butter | 16 ounces mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 1 jar marinated pimentos, drained and rinsed | 1 quart fresh raspberries or 1 quart frozen raspberries | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 1/2 cups frozen tiny whole kernel sweet corn | sliced american cheese, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place peanuts in food processor and process till smooth. Add mascarpone cheese, mix well till well combined. Mix in all ingredients. Add extra fennel seeds if desired. Transfer to fondue pot and warm slowly about 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Braised Lamb and Beef Skewers W. A. E. A.
ingredients: 3 lbs leg of lamb, boned ( i like to ask mum what i mean ) | 1 pint of chicken stock | 1 lb of mixed fresh ingredients ( a.k.a., dried currant or rock sugar cubes ) | 1 lb fine dry breadcrumb | 1 tablespoon of a sherry wine | 7 ounces of beef ribs | 3 ounces of all purpose flour or 3 ounces all-purpose flour | 1/4 pint milk
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 300f degrees. Cut your lamb up and get out the fat, meat tenderizer and most of the fat that has rendered out in the oven, so as to leave about 1 inch of extra fat in the meat. This is not a 'tricky' meat, but not necessary. Trim any visible traces of fat. Put in a large roasting tin. Pour in the stock and sherry, then add some of the breadcrumbs and the meat, reserving the marinade and using about half the marinade for a glaze for basting later. Turn the meat over and pour over the reserved meat marinade. Mix the flour with the milk and add to the roasting tin, stirring it, until it boils and then turn off the heat. Leave for 20 minutes or so, stirring regularly to make sure the meat is covered in the glaze and not over crowed. Put a piece of foil over the top of the pan so the foil will catch any dripping grease and put the meat on a high to high heat and when the top is quite hot but has not begun to blacken, put the meat on the lid and leave it in the oven for 1 hour. The meat will start to brown and then will rise to the surface when you take it out. Remove the lid and continue cooking until you have a meat that is tender enough to slice and then it will have shrunk considerably from its original texture. Meanwhile, remove the meat from the tin and keep the cooking liquid in a large pan or pot.

title: Bouillon Cubes(Oignons)
ingredients: 4 -8 ounces veal | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Cut away all the excess fat from the veal and discard the center, which is where the flavor comes from. Cut the meat in thin strips. Use the vegetable boullion cube to season the meat as preferred. Add more boullion and/or additional bouillon cube to cover the meat. Heat a frying pan to medium heat, and coat with cooking spray. Brown the meat to your liking and then transfer to a plate and allow to cool slightly before serving in the bowls you will be using.

title: Vegetable Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1/2 cup pitted chopped dried apricot preserves | 1/2 cup apple, chopped | 1 cup kalamata olives, chopped | 1 cup diced kielbasa | 3 packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Stir the mixed vegetables, apricot preserves, apples, olives, kielbasa, and spinach together in a large bowl. Spread about 1/2 cup of stuffing mixture on each phyllo pastry sheet. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the filling is hot and bubbly. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Herbed Herb Salad
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces mixed italian herbs, such as dill | 1 tablespoon sliced fresh rosemary | 2 lbs fresh salad dressing, such as ranch dressing | 1 pint half-and-half | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon cracked black peppercorns | 1/2 cup chopped fresh herb such as fresh basil or 1/2 cup fresh parsley | topping, prepared
instructions: In a blender, combine first 5 ingredients.

title: Chili Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 5 tablespoons chili sauce | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 3/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano reggiano cheese
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl and stir to blend. Keep refrigerated until serving time.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,mint,yellow onion,hazelnut,black tea,juice from one lime,cognac,jaggery
title: Koldskål I (Hot, Sweet and Savory Irish Tea)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seeds | 1 tablespoon dried hazelnuts | 1 cup strong black tea, room temperature | 2 tablespoons sweet vodka | 1/2 cup sugar | juice from one lime, to taste | 1 medium yellow onion, thinly sliced | juice from a 1 ( or green )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the mint, caraway seeds, hazelnuts and irish coffee.

title: Granola With Currants and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, thickly slice | 3 -4 tablespoons currants | 4 teaspoons sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Put the cauliflower in boiling water a couple of minutes, then take off the heat and leave in cold water. Squeeze the water out of the cauliflower and cut into small florets. Heat a griddle over a medium heat, add the currants and cook briefly, then stir in the cauliflower when soft. Put the grated cheese in with the cauliflower and serve.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,club soda,beef stew meat,harissa,ice,cocoa powder,saffron strand
title: Beef Kabobs With Cocoa
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat or 2 lbs veal stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1 teaspoon sprig fresh rosemary | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder ( if the meat is very fatty, omit ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand | 1/2 - 1 cup club soda, heated to boiling on high | crushed ice
instructions: Note, if using veal cubes, it might be easier to remove to a separate pot, if you have the necessary extra space. Place the meat on skewers, along with the harissa, rosemary, cocoa, saffron and club soda. If using wooden skewers, soak them in cold water for 2 hours prior to using. Pour a small amount of oil onto your gas grill. Preheat grill to medium high or medium low, or set a rack in a broiler pan. Place the skewers on the hot grill or grill rack, brushing and turning frequently to cook evenly and to help brown the meat evenly. When meat starts to darken, carefully remove from grill and continue cooking until meat is well browned, about 8 minutes, depending on the cut of meat. It might probably not take 5 - 10 minutes. Serve with boiled rice, drizzled with a bit of cocoa, or steamed vegetables.

title: Easy Orange Onion Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces yogurt | 2 tablespoons minced dried onion powder | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Pour into small dish or crockpot. Cover container and let set for 6 to 8 hours. Let cool for approximately 15 minutes. Serve with toasted french roll, pita or pumpernickel bread. You may need to add a little extra yogurt if too thick.

title: Paprika-Almond Appetizer
ingredients: 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 1 teaspoon almond extract ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Mix well and store in refrigerator in a container in which the flavor has been distributed very thinly, up to 2 months. To use, spread a small amount of the flavored topping or dip the tartare into toasted crumbs or drizzle or spread onto crackers.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Parmesan
ingredients: 4 small japanese eggplants | 200 g leivianna firm cheese cream cheese, cut into small chunks | 2 small celeriac, cut into small chunks | 2 slices pepperoni, cut into thin wedges | crushed ice cube
instructions: Halve each eggplant lengthwise, then slice into 1/4 wide slices. Stack the slices between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound with a firm mallet to flatten them a bit. Cut each eggplant slice into 1 - 1 1/2 inch strips, then arrange into a single layer on a tray, or wrap in aluminum foil and freeze for about 15 minutes. The eggplant will also be frozen for another use, this is called mallet time, and is considered a delicacy in puerto rico. Bake in a 450f preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until they're soft, stirring occasionally. Remove the eggplants from the oven and remove the plastic wrap. Sprinkle the entire package of cream cheese with pepperoni, celeriac, and eggplant before serving. Serve with crushed ice.

title: Oriental Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 bag ice water | 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef flank steak | 1 cup italian dressing ( i use newman's own light ) | 2 tablespoons bamboo shoots, strips ( drained on paper towel ( or sliced canned, if desired )
instructions: Place mayonnaise in a small bowl. Drain water from meat. Pierce steak numerous times with a fork to remove as much of the external fat as possible. Place meat in a shallow dish. Pour italian dressing over meat, cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, and no longer than a day. Heat a skillet over high heat. When it is very hot, add steak to skillet. Cook and stir for about 2 minutes to seer. Turn over steak and coat the other side. Transfer to serving platter. Serve with additional italian dressing.

title: Lidia's Easy Hard-Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 6 eggs, very large | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped fine | 4 hard-boiled eggs, shelled
instructions: Gently crack each egg down the center being careful not to pierce the yolk. Place half of the thyme in a small bowl add 1 egg yolk and stir briskly. Repeat with remaining whole eggs. Dip each egg with beaten yolk and place on well greased rack of a broiler pan. Brush under broiler and broil until they start to crack and turn opaque. Immediately remove from broiler and let rest about 5 - 10 minutes before moving to serving plate.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,chicken breast half,grain white rice,pearl barley,mineral water
title: Quick and Easy Slow-Cooker Country-Style Beef, Rice, and Barley
ingredients: 5 pounds boneless sirloin tip roast | 1 cup pearl barley | 4 cups cold water | 1 1/2 cups stone-ground long grain white rice | 3/4 pound bone-in chicken breast halves, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Put the roast and pearl barley in the slow cooker. Pour water and enough cold water into the cooker to reach 3/4 of the way up the roast. Cook on high until the beef falls apart, 5 to 7 hours. Using a slotted spoon, remove the beef.

title: Coconut Wands
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease cookie sheets. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine coconut milk and flour all at once. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.

title: Cheeseburger, Cheese and Honeycomb (Baja Frito)
ingredients: 1/2 lb velveeta cheese | 1/4 lb mozzarella cheese | 1 mango | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 can lychees
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Form into patties. Cook over medium fire.

title: Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 lb asiago cheese | 1 box salted cashews
instructions: Break up cheese with rolling pin. Mold into small balls. Bake on cookie sheet sprinkled with asiago. Sprinkle with chopped nuts while warm if desired. Variation, you can use a combination of cashews, almonds, hazlenuts.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,golden syrup,white wine vinegar,saffron,chicken bouillon,yellow onion,macadamia nut
title: Macadamia Nuts in Wine (Macadamia Syrup) Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces macadamia nuts, chopped | 1 medium yellow onion | 1/3 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 3 cups tomato juice | 2 cans chicken bouillon
instructions: Add all ingredients to pan and add water until covered. Simmer for several hours.

title: Grapefruit Candy
ingredients: 1 pink grapefruit, cut into slices | aluminum foil, for greasing hands
instructions: Using an old, clean, clean grapefruit slice, wrap in a piece of foil with a thin layer of aluminum foil over the slices to prevent sticking. Arrange on a baking sheet. Repeat, using slices as required, until all grapefruit slices are used, about 12 to 16 pieces. Spray each grapefruit slice with nonstick spray and lightly brush with olive oil. Place the baking sheets on a tray and bake in preheated 400 degrees f oven, turning once, for 10 minutes. Remove the grapefruit pieces from the oven and immediately unwrap the entire sheet, keeping the slices covered with foil. Place the foil sheets on a wire rack and allow the grapes to steam as they cool to room temperature. Store in the refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Tiella Italiano
ingredients: 1 pound lean beef sirloin | 4 ounces pancetta, diced | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 1/3 cup shredded fresh cheese
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat and lightly brown the sirloin on all sides. Remove the beef to a plate and cover with aluminum foil. Pour off excess fat from the pan, leaving enough to coat pan. Add the pancetta to the skillet. Cook and stir until the pancetta is just beginning to brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the amaretto to the pancetta and cook until all lumps have melted. Add the beef to the skillet and gently saute until the beef is no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Top with cheese. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lime,cream mushroom soup,brown sugar,sumac,banana pepper,clam,chipotle chile
title: Hot Chipotle Clam Chowder
ingredients: 20 frozen clams | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons finely diced canned chipotle chiles | 1 lime | 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 1 banana pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon dry sumac, or more as needed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the clams in a 3 quart casserole dish. Mix together the soup, ¼ cup light brown sugar, chipotle peppers, lime, and light brown sugar in a bowl until thoroughly mixed. Stir in the chopped banana peppers, and sprinkle with sumac. Pour over the clams, and bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven.

title: Charishma's Savourie
ingredients: 10 dried thai red chili peppers | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped | 6 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 1/2 cups dates, cut into pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add chillies and fry on low medium flame till they turn golden brown. Drain on clean cloth napkins. Mix well with water to make a gravy. Now add corriander and sugar. Cook till water dries. Remove from flame. Serve hot with naan bread, pitta bread or chapati.

title: Barley and Pepper Steamed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 -6 cups floury potatoes ( the kind in the microwave oven, not in the plastic bag. ) | 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( aji or peri-peri-peri ) | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley
instructions: Rinse and scrub potatoes. Dry thoroughly. If your potatoes are in large bowl cut potatoes in half and scoop out the seeds, set aside. Put potatoes in a colander and drain well.
