In a pot bring 2 - 3 cups of water to a boil, add potatoes, cook at high heat for 2 - 3 minutes while constantly stirring. Add hot sauce, mix well and cover. Turn pot off heat. You need to steam for 15 minutes. Let rest for 5 minutes. Add barley, stir well, cover and let rest for 10 minutes. Season with Aji if using, remove lid and cook another 5 - 10 minutes. Remove and serve warm or warm. Note, use a rice cooker for this recipe and you can add vegetables and liquids and potatoes as a side dish, or just throw in meat and vegetable of your choice instead of potatoes. Note, for those who want a thicker soup substitute with a little cornstarch diluted in some water. For those who are using a more watery potato it tends to be less watery or bland. For those who don't want to use barley then you can either.

title: Japanese Saffron Twists
ingredients: 300 ml saffron strands | 25 g sake
instructions: Put the saffron into a bowl, crush with your fingertips until the saffron pieces are all absorbed. Gradually add the saffron infused liquid into a heat proof jar. Do not worry about putting out a film of film at the bottom of the jar because otherwise the saffron will brown at the top. Leave for 3 days at least, shaking the jar every now and then. At the end of 3 days, the liquid will be reduced by 2/3. At this point you have about 20 saffron strands that have been dissolved in a little boiled water.

Random Ingredients: ice water,graham cracker crumb,green bell pepper,orange,bean sprout,serrano pepper,marjoram
title: Easy Crunchy Cappuccino Jelly
ingredients: 2 cups chopped green bell pepper | 1 package star-clear canned beans with sprouts, drained | 1 large orange, peel of, finely diced into 1/4-inch dice | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and finely diced | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/4 quarts ice water
instructions: Place all of the jelly ingredients in a blender, process until smooth. Place the water in a small saucepan, add the jelly and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes or until the jelly is reduced by half. Remove from the heat and stir in the graham cracker crumbs, pour the jelly mixture into hot jelly and immediately stir with a fork to completely smooth the mixture. The jelly will rise to the top of the jelly and crackery. When the topping is completely smooth pour into a large freezer safe bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight. Pour the jelly into an ice cream maker and freeze on high for 45 minutes, according to the manufacturer's directions. This jelly should be kept in the freezer until you need to use it within the next few hours. Before serving, turn the crock pot to the low setting and stir the jelly until it is completely smooth. Spoon the jelly into 6 custard cups, and place 2 scoops of ice into each cup. When all of the ice cubes are melted, pour the jelly over the top and swirl with a knife until the jelly is completely covered. Serve immediately or serve immediately. If you have leftovers of the cooked jelly, you may serve it straight away.

title: Spinach Leaves With Mustard and Spinach
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh spinach leaves, washed and drained | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard, prepared ( dill, dill seed, or basil can be used instead )
instructions: Lightly oil a skillet with cooking spray or preheat the broiler. Add the spinach, making sure all the pieces are coated with it. Cook on high heat for 2 minutes or until it collapses, stirring frequently. Add 1 teaspoon of mustard and mix well. Add more mustard if using, to your taste. Serve immediately, or store in a tightly covered jar and shake well to mix. If using a spice mill, blend ingredients well before adding to the spinach. This mixture is excellent served with rice.

title: Easy Enchilidas
ingredients: 1 gallon hot coffee ( hot room temperature or cold ) | 1 jar chili-garlic sauce ( i use vh ) | tortillas
instructions: In a large plastic bowl combine the coffee and chili garlic sauce. Using a slotted spoon, spread the mixture into two gallon size plastic bags. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, but not longer than three hours. Remove bags from refrigerator at least 30 minutes before serving. To serve, bring 4 quarts of water to a boil. Add 2 or 3 tortillas to each bowl. Fill tortillas with hot coffee mixture.

Random Ingredients: cheese,chicken broth,safflower oil,rotel tomato chilies,chicken stock,chili,green pea,chuck roast
title: Crock Pot Pulled Green Peas
ingredients: 1 chuck roast | 1 tablespoon safflower oil | 2 cans chicken broth | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 2 cups frozen green pea | 1 can condensed roasted chili | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 16 ounces cheese, grated
instructions: Trim excess fat from the chuck roast and cut into 1 1/2 to 2 inch cubes. Heat oil in nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot. Add chuck and brown well on all sides. Transfer the chuck roast to the crock pot. Add the chicken broth, tomatoes, green peas, corn, and hot chilis, and cook on low 10 to 12 hours. Stir frequently during last hour of cooking to prevent burning. Serve the beef with the green peas and some of the gravy. Tip 1, to make an easy to eat meal, substitute refried beans for the rotel tomatoes and chilies.

title: Turkey Gravy
ingredients: 1 turkey carcass, picked and torn up | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leave | 1 can evaporated milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock. Heat on low setting for 30 minutes or high for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,french bread,pecorino cheese,red curry paste,cannellini bean,kosher salt black pepper,ginger root
title: Cannellini Bean and Pecorino Panini
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon dried minced ginger root ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/4 cup crumbled pecorino cheese | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste | 1 loaf french bread, cut into cubes
instructions: Mix cannellini beans with ginger, red curry paste, pecorino cheese, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Mix cilantro into the reserved bean mixture. Place bread cubes onto a baking sheet and toss with the bean mixture in a bowl. Preheat the griller. Cook bread cubes in preheated oven until crispy, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sugar,garlic salt,caster sugar,white rice,bacon,self rising flour
title: Bacon & Rice Cakes
ingredients: 250 g white rice | 250 g raw bacon | 150 g caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 500 g self-rising flour ( all-purpose ) | 1 tablespoon caster sugar ( superfine, superfine, if preferred )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Grease 2 large baking trays or line them with baking paper. Cook rice in boiling water with 3/4tsp salt in a medium saucepan for 10 minutes. Drain and cool. Cut the bacon into chunks and cook in a frypan until it changes colour and starts to crisp. Set aside to cool. When rice has cooled, mix butter or margarine or shortening and sugar and fold in rice. Stir in garlic salt and mix well. In a small bowl, mix flour and sugar. Mix into rice mixture, folding well. Divide mixture into 12 portions. Using wet hands, roll half the cakes in the flour to coat. Invert the cakes onto the prepared trays and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Cool cakes completely on trays before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Hummus
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 50 g fresh poppy seeds
instructions: Process the chickpeas, poppy seeds and liquid until smooth. Serve with pita bread, pita chips, vegetables or breadsticks.

Random Ingredients: vegemite,anchovy fillet,oil,white bread,onion powder,picante sauce,black eyed pea
title: Ancho-Sauce - Vegetarian
ingredients: 12 slices white bread | 1 1/2 cups cooked black-eyed peas | 1 large sweet onion | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon vegemite | 8 anchovy fillets, chopped & mixed with | picante sauce
instructions: Grill bread lightly on both sides. Split bread in half & spread each slice with some vegemite mix. Slice onions thinly & add to bread. Place 1/2 cup of peas in the hollowed out bread.

title: Homemade Ham With Cherry Chunks
ingredients: 1 ham | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | garlic powder ( optional and to taste ) | white pepper ( optional and to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place ham in oven for 30 - 40 minutes. Remove ham and cut in small slices and put slices back on the oven rack. When done, pour cherry juices and excess oil off of cherry and add garlic. Stir. Spray jelly roll pan with pam. Place ham slices on it. Sprinkle with white pepper and garlic powder. Bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: carrot,red chili pepper,ice,currant,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Mulled Carrots With Ra el Hanout (Middle East Spice)
ingredients: 2 lbs carrots | 3 tablespoons ra el hanout spice mix | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 3 tablespoons currants or 3 tablespoons raisins | crushed ice
instructions: Blanch the carrots for 5 - 10 minutes in boiling water before plunging into ice water. Drain well and set aside in a bowl of cold water. Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend to a thick paste. Taste and add more salt and/or spice if you like.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,basil leaf,kiwi,guinness stout,red cabbage
title: Guinness Cabbage
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups guinness stout | 2 cups shredded red cabbage ( about 2.2 pounds ) | 1/4 cup thinly sliced kiwi, rings | 3/4 cup roughly torn basil leaves | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: To make guinness salsa, place the guinness and its broth in a medium bowl. Add the cabbage, kiwifruit, basil, salt and pepper. Set aside to marinate while the rest of the components are cooking. To serve, arrange the cabbage in shallow casserole and spoon the remaining salsa on top.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,balsamic vinegar,onion soup mix,carrot,mustard,mascarpone cheese,bulgur
title: Balsamic Baked Chicken & Dumplings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken meat, cut in chunks ( skinless or boneless ) | 2 cups bulgur, uncooked | 1/2 cup onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 4 carrots, peeled & cut into 2 -inch pieces | 1 package mascarpone cheese
instructions: In a 9x13 pan arrange the chicken over the bulgur breaking it in half. Combine the onion soup mix, mustard and vinegar, pour over chicken. Spoon the carrots over the chicken, then pour the remaining sauce over the carrots. Bake uncovered in 375f oven for 40 minutes stirring a couple of times to ensure there is no clumping of sauce.

Random Ingredients: sausage,worcestershire sauce,fish sauce,red chili powder,soda water
title: Thai Drunken Sausages
ingredients: 4 links sausage | 1 dash worcestershire sauce | 1 dash red chili powder | 8 ounces soda water | 1 splash fish sauce
instructions: Remove sausage casings from a sausages and slice diagonally. Place on baking tray, pour on worcestershire sauce, sprinkle with red chili powder and dot with the soda water followed by a splash of fish sauce. Bake in oven at 350 for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Basic Japanese Stock
ingredients: 3 -4 cups mincemeat or 3 -4 cups beef stock | 2 -4 tablespoons mirin
instructions: In a large pot, bring water to a boil. Add meat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Remove the meat and drain off liquid. Drain the liquid through a sieve into a clean pot and return it to the burner. Add the rest of the ingredients, except the last tablespoon of mirin, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes. Add the reserved meat and cook, covered 15 - 20 minutes more. Serve by itself or over white rice.

title: Chakchouka
ingredients: 1 cup pine nuts ( khus khus ) | 6 -7 fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place the pine nuts on a cookie tand oven for about 20 - 45 minutes at 100°f. Watch carefully as they burn easily. After that time it should be almost impossible to stir them. Keep an eye on them as they burn easily. If they burn quickly throw out the pot. Put the pine nuts and freshly cilantro in a food processor and pulse a few times. The food processor won't do this because they are already a little pasty, but after that process it turns into a kind of doughy consistency rather than a paste. Store in the fridge. Yield is estimated. It's hard to talk about what it is but eat the chakchouka right away, it is worth every penny.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar roasted marinated ricotta cheese | 5 basil leaves | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar ( or other non-dairy condiment ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Mix together the marinade ingredients with 1/8 of salt and allow to sit in refrigerator for 30 minutes. This will give the flavors a chance to come together. When ready to serve, put pesto onto a piece of bread and spread with pesto and tomato sauce.

title: Macaroni and Strawberry Jam Salad
ingredients: 500 g macaroni | 2 tablespoons raw gelatin | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon oregano, chopped | 100 g strawberry jam
instructions: Cook the macaroni until cooked and drain. Chop the parsley and stir into the macaroni with the jelly. Serve. Variation if you would like to use your favourite jelly, substitute the 50g of jelly with the strawberry jam.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,cooking spray,french bread,lobster meat,almond extract,mascarpone cheese,herb
title: Lobster Cheese Panini
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1 tablespoon grated fresh herb-free sweet basil ( or dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 loaf french bread, sliced 1/2 inch thick ( about 3/4-inch thick ) | cooking spray | 6 lobster meat, cooked | 1/2 cup finely shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine mascarpone, basil and almond extract in a small bowl.

title: Salmon & Pastry Tatin With Spaghetti (Grenato Di Hilcheri Barilla)
ingredients: 9 ounces dried spaghetti noodles | 12 ounces smoked duck | 14 ounces fresh salmon, in one piece, skinned | 6 tablespoons light margarine ( margarine is better for flavour of smoked duck ) | 1 tablespoon italian dressing | 2 tablespoons broth | 1 small pie pastry ( i use a gluten-free blend ) | fresh thyme sprig, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Dice mushrooms and place in bowl with remaining ingredients, except pastry pie pastry, and mix well and season. Divide into four, and place each piece on large cookie sheet. Roll out pastry to about a circle on one side, place on other and cut into four wedges. Place wedges on pastry, and cover with pastry dough around and around the wedge. Poke holes in the top and bake for 45 minutes or until golden and crusty.. Remove from oven, cut through top and vent, and leave to cool, then set aside. When serving, sprinkle warm pastry pieces with chopped thyme flowers and serve.

title: Paneer (Yellow Pepper Fry)
ingredients: 2 yellow peppers | peanut oil or other neutral oil, for deep frying
instructions: Clean the peppers well. Slice the peppers lengthwise into strips about 3/8 inch wide. Place the strips into a skillet that has been sprayed with a non stick cooking spray, cover, and let cook over low heat until the peppers are tender, about 25 minutes. You may add water or additional oil to maintain the texture of the pepper strips. You may also use a wok, or a deep skillet, and proceed with the cooking to ensure the peppers don't overcook. When done, drain the peppers, then place in a dish and serve on the side.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,port wine,rump roast,club soda,apricot jam,horseradish
title: Pork Chops with Horseradish
ingredients: 4 large pork chops, trimmed of excess fat | cooking spray | 1 cup apricot jam | 2 teaspoons dry horseradish | 1 cup dry port wine | 2 cans club soda
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line aluminum foil packets with aluminum foil.

title: Pine Nuts (Breads)
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Generously spray a 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Set aside. Place pineapple nuts on a serving platter and drizzle with any remaining cooking spray. Sprinkle pine nuts on top. Drizzle more cooking spray over top of the pine nuts and sprinkle with more pine nuts. Bake at 300 degrees f for 1 hour.

title: Korean BBQ Chicken Meatballs #5FIX
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups instant barley | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 onion, diced | 4 bananas, diced | 1 kiwi, peeled and chopped | 1 egg
instructions: Boil rice and barley according to instructions on box. Strain and set aside. Sautee onions and bananas in a small amount of oil until desired tenderness. Remove from skillet and add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well. Form into small meatballs that are approximately 1 inch in diameter, or smaller depending on how big or big your meatballs are. Brown with a little olive oil on each side. Serve with your favorite korean bbq sauce or sweet potato and rice.

title: Olive Oil Biscotti
ingredients: 2 cups kalamata olives, pitted and finely chopped ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: Heat oven to remove baking soda from baking soda. Spread olives in an 8x8 x2 baking dish and roast in the oven until skins blacken and blacken, about 7 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Cut off skins and set aside. Drain olives, leaving a thin layer of browned skin and olive oil over the olives. Transfer to an air tight container and store in a cool, dark place for 1 week or until needed. Makes about 40 small heads. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator until needed.

title: Amarula
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 1/4 cup fat-free tang orange crystals | 1 -3 tablespoon fresh squeezed lime juice | 1 cup fat-free buttermilk
instructions: Mix crushed pineapple, refried beans, tang orange and lime juice in a blender until smooth to make a smooth creamy consistency. Place buttermilk in a small bowl or serving bowl. In a microwaveable bowl combine the buttermilk and pineapple mixture.

title: Spicy Nacho Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces picante sauce | 1 cup italian cheese blend, shredded | 1 can campari
instructions: In a skillet heat spaghetti sauce and cheese until cheese is melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,tamarind pulp,green pepper,bacon,grape,broccoli floret,balsamic vinegar
title: Tamarind, Broccoli and Red Pepper Salad (Salata Editho)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs broccoli florets | 2 1/2 lbs shiitake mushrooms, quartered | 1 1/2 lbs red peppers, julienned | 1 pint white grape, washed | 1/2 lb smoked bacon, cut into small julienne strips or 1/2 lb pancetta | 1 1/2 cups tamarind pulp | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a large stockpot of boiling salted water, blanch the whole broccoli for 3 to 5 minutes, then plunge into cold water. Drain, set aside and keep hot. Place the mushrooms and peppers in a large stock pot, add just enough water to cover, and simmer, covered, over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, until mushrooms are reduced and the peppers begin to soften. Drain. Stir in the reserved vegetables and the bacon and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes longer, until the salad is reduced thick. Stir in the tamarind pulp and vinegar, adjust seasoning to taste, and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,extra virgin olive oil,cooking spray,serrano pepper,ramen noodle,fryer chicken,rosemary leaf,beef tenderloin
title: Kicked up Rind Beef
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cracked cardamom seed | 1 large fryer chicken, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 cup extra virgin olive oil, divided | 1/4 cup dried rosemary leaves, divided | 1 tablespoon dried serrano pepper, divided | 12 ounces ramen noodles | 1/4 lb thinly sliced trimmed thinly-cut beef tenderloin | cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 475 degrees. In prepared dutch oven, heat cardamom seeds on medium heat until just beginning to smoke, 2 to 5 minute remove from heat. Transfer to small bowl.

title: Fiesta Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs lamb, trimmed of all visible fat and cut into 1 pieces | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 28 ounces reduced-sodium black beans, drained, rinsed | 4 1/4 cups chicken stock or 4 1/4 cups broth | 1/4 cup water | 12 ounces pineapple tidbits, drained | tortilla chips, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Combine the lamb, thyme, black beans and stock in a large soup pot. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the meat and beans are tender, breaking up any clumps. Stir in the water, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for an additional 20 to 30 minutes, or until the meat is very tender. Stir in the pineapple. Season to taste with salt. Serve on tortillas with additional tamale, cheese, sour cream and fresh cilantro.

title: Apple Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground beef | 1/2 lb chicken breast fillet, coarsely chopped | 2 large apples, peeled and chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and shape into bite size balls. Fry in hot pan, then cover and cook on low until cooked through.

title: Italian  Fresh Herb Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 cup fresh oregano leaves | 1/2 cup fat from above prepared italian salad dressing | 1 carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or a coffee can, crush saffron into a fine paste with the oregano. Add the saffron and saffron mixture to the whipped topping. Gently fold in drained pasta. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,chinese five spice powder,saltpeter,thyme leave,chocolate square
title: Chocolate and Chili Pepper Rub (Or Spread-Dough)
ingredients: 200 g unsweetened chocolate squares ( finely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon saltpeter | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon fresh chili pepper ( julienned )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Sprinkle a touch of salt on top, leave in refrigerator for at least 1 hr to allow the flavours to develop and blend properly. It can also be used with plain cookies.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,peanut butter,taco seasoning,cream cheese,broccoli floret,clove
title: Taco Filling for Taco Bell
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup fat-free cream cheese, softened | 2 teaspoons dried minced rosemary sprigs | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 can broccoli florets, drained | chopped roasted peanuts, for garnish
instructions: In medium bowl, mix cream cheese, fat free cream cheese, rosemary, and soup mix until smooth.

title: Easy Strawberry Cheddar Pizzas
ingredients: 1 -2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( you can also use monterey jack ) | 4 -5 sweet red bell peppers | 1 -2 small sweet onion | 2 packages fresh strawberries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Peel, seed and dice the red bell peppers and onions. Place onto a large baking sheet and place in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until slightly charred. Turn off oven, but leave peppers and onions in the oven for 10 more minutes or until the peppers just start to sweat. Remove peppers from oven, and place in a bowl of a large sieve to drain out the moisture. Shake off excess liquid. Remove the peppers and onions from the sieve. Place the drained peppers and onions back onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake your pizzas for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, cut a slit in the side of the pizzas to create an opening for each serving, and place one slice of cheese inside each of your cooked peppers and onions.

title: Sausage Rolls in the Microwave
ingredients: 3 lbs pastry dough, chilled ( or one 17.6-ounce package frozen small dinner roll, defrosted ) | 6 ounces tomato puree ( or a 28.5 ounce jar of july tomato puree ) | 3 teaspoons hot sauce ( or more, to your taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage ( or a few shakes of dried sage )
instructions: Note, if using a vacuum freezer bag, thaw pastry dough and let sit in refrigerator.. Punch dough down and separate into 4 large pieces. Roll out into 2 x 1/4 strips on floured surface. Roll strips into 3 round pieces, and place in a 9 x 11 dish. Top with tomato puree. Sprinkle with chives. Add hot sauce to taste. Mix well. Pour mixture over pastry. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 4 hours, or preferably overnight. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Let dough rise for 20 minutes. Place on floured surface. Using a 3 inch round cutter, cut into 3 squares. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,garlic,superfine sugar,green chili salsa,white pepper
title: Mexican Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret | 3 tablespoons garlic, minced | 1/4 - 1/2 cup green chili salsa ( your favorite brand, i prefer pace ) | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. In a small skillet, saute the cauliflower in abundant oil on high heat for 4 - 5 minutes, stirring with a wooden spoon or large strainer. Stir in the green chili salsa and sugar, and cook on high heat for 2 - 3 minutes. If the cauliflower does not soften from the heat, pour in some of the cauliflower liquid, and cook for a few minutes. Serve hot.

title: Wild Grape Tomatoes Stuffed With Enoki Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb red ripe grape tomatoes ( or grape tomatoes if you can get them ) | 2 ounces raw enoki mushrooms, roughly chopped ( or 1 package fresh mushrooms ) | 1 pinch superfine sugar
instructions: Boil the fresh mushrooms for 10 - 15 minutes, then drain. Stuff the tomatoes with the mushrooms, then sprinkle with superfine sugar. Chill the tomatoes to develop a dressing and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,arborio rice,lettuce leaf,corn tortilla,anise seed,black olive
title: Ole! Mexican Rice Pie (Arancia)
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 4 -5 lettuce leaves | 2/3 cup black olives ( sliced ) or 2/3 cup green olives ( sliced ) | 6 -8 corn tortillas | 1 unbaked pie shell, cooled
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions and set aside. Mix the aniseed and crushed aniseed, and stir well to blend. Spread rice mixture across bottom of pie crust. Sprinkle sliced olives and lettuce over rice mixture. Wrap the tortillas around the rice mixture. Sprinkle the top with remaining shredded cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minute or until heated through. Let stand for 5 minute cut into 8 wedges. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: grain brown rice,shrimp paste,pesto sauce,cardamom pod,new potato
title: Shrimp, Palm Rice & New Potatoes With Pesto #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package new potatoes, scrubbed and quartered | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1 lb medium shrimp paste, in 1/4 inch chunks | 8 -10 cardamom pods, bruised with rolling pin | 2 cups long grain brown rice or 2 cups jasmine rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f. Bring 1 gallon of water with 1/4 cup salt to a boil in a large saucepan. Add potatoes, lower heat and simmer 15 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally. In the meantime. Remove potatoes from liquid. Drain potatoes, return to pot, and bring water to boil. Add pesto, shrimp paste, cardamon and rice and remove from heat. Cover tightly and transfer to a glass pyrex dish or other large baking dish just large enough to hold potatoes. Bake 25 minutes or until rice is well cooked. You may need to remove dish from oven for the time stated on the box, or you may want to leave the lid on, in case rice is browned too quickly on the bottom of the dish.

title: Quick Beef & Tomato Satay
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 4 boneless chicken breasts, cubed | 1/2 cup rice | 1 beefsteak tomato, halved up
instructions: Mix the golden syrup, corn syrup and chicken in a large nonstick skillet. Heat over medium high heat until chicken is lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add rice and tomato and cook, stirring, until liquid is absorbed, about 30 seconds. Transfer to serving plate and serve.

title: Taro Ki Roti
ingredients: 1 kg white flour | 1 kg red chili powder | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Boil a pot of water. Add flour and salt. Stir well. Add water as required by the taro. Make a hole. Bake on the top of the pot until the taro comes out. Allow to cool and then break into pieces. Add red chilli powder. Mix well. Store on an air tight container. Keeps for upto 3 months in the cool, dark and warm area of your house. Enjoy the smell of your loved ones in your house.

title: Stir Fry Vegetable and Pineapple
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower floret | 1 large bean sprouts | 1 can chopped pineapple, drained and juice reserved | 1 1/2 lbs orecchiette or 1 1/2 lbs broad egg noodles | 2 tablespoons italian dressing | pepper | 3 tablespoons shredded italian cheese blend | 1 can baked italian style small whole almond chips ( optional ) or ( 8 ounce ) can apricot preserves ( optional )
instructions: Steam the cauliflower, bean sprouts, and apricots just until tender, but still firm. Drain in a colander and drain liquid.. Prepare the noodles as per package directions. I like thin spaghetti, but if desired, you may cut into cubes. Drain and then rinse under cold water until cool. Set aside. Toss all ingredients in a large, deep skillet or wok. Toss to coat. Taste and adjust seasonings, if desired.

title: English Red Cabbage
ingredients: 6 -7 cups thinly sliced white chocolate | 6 -8 fresh thyme sprigs, divided | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Prepare a medium stock pot by heating the water and bringing it to the boil. Lightly grease it and reserve. Put the white chocolate in a medium, heavy skillet, add the thyme and mustard and let it melt. Dip a slice of cheese in the melted white chocolate and lay it in the center of a cheesecloth with the thin part of the thyme showing through it, then roll the cheesecloth around the cheese. Hold the cheese with the tip of a sharp knife and carefully ease the cheesecloth through the cheesecloth into your simmering broth. Cover the pot and set it on fire. Let it simmer for about 40 minutes or until the mixture is reduced enough to pour into a bowl. Allow to cool. Cover and chill. Note, i usually reheat the cabbages in the microwave to reduce their bulk.

title: Dunked Pork With Asafoetida, Champagne, and Mint
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut rum | 1 tablespoon spanish coconut rum | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 pinch frisee ( anise seed ) | 1 head pork, cut into bite-size pieces | 1/4 cup champagne | 2 pickled marjoram ( optional, i recommend fresh )
instructions: Pour 2 tablespoons of coconut rum into a large resealable plastic bag with the coconut rum, sugar or any other seasoning you like. Squeeze the air out of the bag and add the asafoetida. Seal the bag and massage it all the way around to get the asafoetida. Refrigerate for at least two hours or overnight.. While the bag is marinating, cut a few slits in the pork. Fill a skillet with more water about halfway up the pork and place it in the marinade. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, skimming off any foam that rises to the surface about 5 minutes. Transfer the pork to a platter or a serving dish. Add the champagne and let it bubble and reduce. Pour the liquid over. Garnish with pickled marjoram or fresh mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: garlic,italian dressing,ha avocadoes,creamy peanut butter,apple,garlic clove,dark rum,yellow onion
title: Apple Chipotle Dip With Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple, chopped | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter, light | 1 teaspoon creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 1/4 cup yellow onion, minced | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1/8 teaspoon garlic, fresh minced | 1 large hass avocado, peeled and pitted
instructions: In a bowl put the first 8 ingredients.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,bamboo shoot,soda water,veal,whipping cream,sage leaf,cilantro,tarragon
title: Veal Fondue
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cubes ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh tarragon | 1/4 cup chopped fresh sage leaf | 1/4 cup low-sodium whipping cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 12 small bamboo shoots ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh cilantro ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon soda water
instructions: To serve, cut meat into 1 to 2 inch chunks, removing any fat. In a wide, heavy saucepan, combine lamb chunks, tarragon, sage, cream, rum, bamboo shoots, cilantro, and soda water. Cover, and simmer gently, uncovered, stirring often, for about 1 hour. Remove cover, and simmer 45 minutes, or until meat is very tender. Discard any bones. Serve hot, garnishing with more fresh tarragon or cilantro.

title: Mexican Mice Nests
ingredients: 12 small dried mexican chocolate, chopped | 6 ears fresh cilantro, cleaned and chopped | 1/4 cup canned white wine | 1 tablespoon orange extract | 3 apples, cored and cut into quarters
instructions: Place chopped mexican chocolate and cilantro into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,kielbasa,black eyed pea,cherry,banana pepper,sirloin tip roast,ciabatta,vegetable
title: Kielbasa Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 2 packages frozen mixed vegetables | 2 packages kielbasa | 1 can black-eyed peas, thawed and drained | 1 can cherries, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes, dissolved in | 1 1/2 cups hot mashed potatoes, heated | 1 ciabatta roll, cut into 12 diagonal slices
instructions: Brown roast in a large skillet.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,yukon gold potato,tuna,beef rib eye roast
title: Tuna and Beef Rib Eye Roast
ingredients: 1 beef rib eye roast | 2 cups canned chickpea flour, unseasoned | 2 yukon gold potatoes, sliced | 1 can tuna, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Season the rib eye roast with salt and pepper. Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread the chickpea flour over the top of the roast. Arrange potatoes over the flour mixture. Spread the tuna over the potatoes and drizzle the remaining 1 1/2 cups of water over them. Cook for 1 hour in the preheated oven. Allow to rest for 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Beef Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into thin bite size pieces ( optional ) | 2 cans chickpea flour | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 1 medium yellow pepper | 1 package rotisserie-cooked ravioli, warmed
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and set aside. In a large skillet heat oil over high heat. Add steak, onion, and yellow pepper. Cook until tender, stirring often. Add flour and oregano and mix well. Add cooked ravioli and heat through. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,apple juice,quinoa,peanut butter,creme fraiche,chicken bouillon
title: Cheesy Quinoa (Diabetic)
ingredients: 3/4 cup quinoa | 1/4 cup apple juice, from roasted pepper or 3/4 cup apple | 3 1/2 ounces creme fraiche | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 ounces mexican-style cheese | 1/4 cup peanut butter
instructions: Toast quinoa and apple if using roasted pepper in a non stick pan over medium heat. When they are dry, add the other ingredients. Stir well. Place quinoa in serving bowl. Spoon over cheese and serve.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive, oil | 1 ripe limes or 1 lemon wedge
instructions: Place olive in a mortar. Break it up into small bits with a wooden spoon or spoon. You can also use a blender. Add lime juice. Stir until olive oil and garlic are well mixed. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Sauce can be served with meat, chicken or vegetable sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,cream cheese,garlic paste,pecorino cheese,raisin,chocolate ice cream,fruit
title: Agnello Con Salvia (New Zealand Grilled Fruit & Cheese Torta)
ingredients: 1 kg fruit, such as pineapple chunks, strawberries, kiwi fruit, raspberries, papaya, blackberries, cranberries, strawberries, peach, cherries | 3 teaspoons garlic paste, crushed | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, lightly crushed | 200 g cream cheese, softened | 125 g seedless raisins | 100 g grated pecorino cheese | 2 liters light sour cream, for serving
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut the fruit into 3cm rings lengthways. Place the fruit onto 2 large sheets of greaseproof paper or other well buttered baking paper. Paint the fruit with the garlic paste and cumin. Wrap in the greaseproof paper and secure with string. Prepare a grill. Combine the softened cream cheese, raisins, parmesan and 1 tsp salt. Mix well. Spread the cream cheese mixture evenly over the fruit, then press the fruit into the cheese. Grill over an uncovered barbecue until the fruit is hot and the cheese is bubbling and topping is crispy and golden.

title: Pepper Frittata
ingredients: 5 cups all-purpose unbleached soft warm-tasting yeast | 1/2 cup clam juice | 3 -4 lbs hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 large green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine yeast, clam juice, and chopped eggs. Add the chopped bell pepper and mix well.. When all ingredients are mixed, transfer the mixture into a large, greased, covered, loaf pan, or a greased 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Sprinkle top with finely chopped parsley and a sprinkling of nutmeg. Bake for 1 hour in a 500 degree oven. Remove from oven and let cool. Slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,corn tortilla chip,almond essence,mexican cheese,paprika,confectioner sugar
title: Quesadillas - Mexican Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 corn tortilla chips, broken into small pieces | 4 cups shredded green cabbage ( about 2 medium, about 8 medium ) | 1/2 cup slivered almonds | confectioners'sugar ( optional ) | mexican cheese ( optional ) | paprika ( optional )
instructions: Combine the tortilla chips, cabbage, and almonds in a bowl with a little bit of margarine and spread mixture evenly onto the half of the tortilla chips. Pour confectionery sugar over the top. You may sprinkle with paprika, a sprinkling of cheese, or more zest, if you like.

title: Pork (Tunisia) With Doves
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 ounce ghee | 1 large spanish onion, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | lemon wedge, accompaniment
instructions: In a large, heavy skillet melt the ghee and saute the onion until it is lightly browned. Remove the skillet from the heat. Pat the pork dry with paper towels. Place it in a medium pot. Add the mace and vinegar. Scald over medium heat until the liquid just starts to evaporate. Pour the liquid over the pork. Cook for about 45 minutes until the pork is fork tender. When done, remove from the heat, cover and allow to rest about 15 minutes. Serve the pork with some accompaniments. Note, the dish may be served as is, or with a mound of cooked rice for dipping.

title: Raspberry Chicken Bake
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken tenders | 1 cup soymilk | raspberry jam ( any flavor )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix soymilk and jam and brush evenly over chicken tenders. Place in a shallow buttered baking dish and bake for 30 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Sweet Chilli Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 small melon, sliced into four cubes | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained | 3/4 cup oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons sweet chili oil
instructions: Prepare all ingredients as described above. Toss with dressing.

title: Yummy Pizza with Oregano and Coconut
ingredients: 1/2 lb baking potato, sliced very thin | 1 head romaine lettuce | 1/2 can coconut cream | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with foil. Arrange potatoes in a single layer on baking sheet. Cook in a 400°f oven for 25 minutes. Toss potatoes with lettuce and coconut cream.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,vanilla pod,purpose flour,gelatin,cannellini bean,wheat pastry flour,tofu,beef steak
title: Tofu Keema
ingredients: 100 g wheat pastry flour | 50 g all-purpose flour | 75 g diced beef round steak | 150 g raw tofu | 100 g cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 50 g gelatin | 1 vanilla pod, split lengthwise | 1 small curry paste
instructions: Sift the flours into a bowl and crumble the tofu into it. Drain the beans and add to the bowl. Sprinkle gelatine over and set aside. Heat vegetable oil and gently saute the onion until translucent then add meat and curry paste and saute, stirring constantly until meat is half way cooked. Set aside. In a large heat proof bowl add the contents of the vanilla and its pod and pour on boiling water. Stir and allow the water to come up to almost the top of the bowl. Place the bowl over a pan of hot water and stir constantly until it comes to a boil. While the mixture is cooking, line a sieve with plastic wrap. Place the sieve over a large bowl and pour in the contents of the vanilla pod and the boiling water. Keep stirring so that all the flour is being mixed into the water to form a smooth batter. Remove scum that rises to the surface and the mixture will immediately start separating from the whisk. Turn the heat down and pour in the batter into the sieve through the sieve. With wet hands, pull up the corners of the bowl and gently tap the keeza on each side to remove excess lumps. This process will be done in batches and will take only a few seconds. Place the dough on a pastry cloth that has been brushed with oil and sprinkled with flour or cornstarch. Shake away the excess flour or cornstarch and roll onto the cloth to make a flat round cake about 1/3 deep and 30cm across. Keep the pastry cloth covered in the freezer. When ready to heat up, preheat the oven to 200c/390f/gas 3 and grease a baking tray with vegetable spray. Cut the keeza in half and slice diagonally to make triangles. Place one piece into the tray and press lightly. Repeat the same with the beans and tofu. Sprinkle with kaffi powder or cinnamon if desired, a few drops of balsamic vinegar or dark rum, and scatter over some coconut oil. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes or until nicely puffed and crusty and golden. Serve with curry yogurt as main dish or tostada with a side salad.

Random Ingredients: pork,celery rib,crabmeat,lasagna noodle,tagliatelle pasta noodle,heavy whipping cream,red pepper,white sugar
title: Tagliatelle with Pork and Crab
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 8 ounces dry crabmeat, picked over | 7 ounces diced pork | 7 ounces cooked linguetta or 7 ounces bacon | 1 large red pepper, diced | 3 celery ribs, diced | 8 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles until al dente. Place 1 layer of noodles in a glass casserole dish. Cover with half the crabmeat, pork, red pepper, celery, cream and 1 teaspoon sugar. Pour half the remaining cream over the top. Repeat layers and sprinkle with remaining sugar, cooking noodles in the oven.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,mussel,bamboo skewer,oyster sauce,aleppo pepper,beef bouillon cube,mango chutney
title: Grilled Lobster Kebabs With Mangoes & Mussels
ingredients: 12 large mussels, scrubbed | 2 beef bouillon cubes or 2 vegetable bouillon cubes | 1/2 teaspoon aleppo pepper ( optional ) | 2 limes, zest of | 1 ounce oyster sauce | 4 teaspoons mango chutney | bamboo skewer, soaked in water
instructions: Deemlise mussels and add to a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients except for bamboo skewers & mix gently. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Thread kabobs on skewers and grill. Serve with a side of mango chutney and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,carrot,catsup,black bean paste,mint sprig,vanilla bean,peanut,pork fillet
title: Hot and Spicy Baked Pork W-Carrots for Two!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork fillets or 1 1/2 lbs pork loin, cut into 1-inch thick slices | 1/2 cup catsup ( light or regular ) | 1/2 cup dry-roasted unsalted peanuts, roughly chopped ( i used unsalted ) | 1/4 cup basil leaves ( fresh basil ) | 1 teaspoon black bean paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1/2 teaspoon mint sprig, dried ( for garnish, i used thai herbs. ) | mint sprig, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Lay all your sliced pork on a jelly roll pan or cookie sheet lined with parchment paper or parchment paper. Place the meat on top of the pork and drizzle with catsup on top of it all. Make sure to coat the meat with catsup if using. Place nuts in medium skillet over medium heat and toast in the oven for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring after 3 minutes, until lightly toasted but not browned. Remove from pan and add basil, black bean paste, puree, and mint. Stir to combine. Place pork on serving platter and garnish with mint sprigs. Serve immediately with jasmine rice.

title: Italian Herbed Celery
ingredients: 8 stalks fresh celery, with leaves, trimmed and halved lengthwise | 1 cup italian parsley, leaves only | 1 cup maraschino cherry, halved ( optional )
instructions: Combine celery leaves, parsley, and cherries to taste in a large glass bowl. Cover bowl tightly and refrigerate for 1 hour or up to 24 hours. To serve, place celery on a serving plate and top with cherry. Makes 12 servings.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,wide egg noodle,chipotle chile,pork tenderloin
title: Chipotle Pork Loin (Or Chicken-Turkey)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 2 chicken tenderloins, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 can chipotle chiles, rinsed, drained, seeded, and chopped | 2 tablespoons low sodium beef drippings or 2 tablespoons low sodium pork drippings | 1/2 lb wide egg noodles
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat for about 2 minutes, then add the cumin. Toast 1 minute so the cumin seeds release their aroma and turn golden. Transfer the seeds to a small baking sheet, then toast the chicken pieces and chiles for 1 minute. Turn the pan to low, stir in the chipotle drippings and heat for 2 minutes. While the pan is heating up, prepare the noodles. Turn the heat up to medium high and in a large bowl, combine the chipotle mixture with the noodles and mix well. When the skillet is hot, add the noodles and toss well, then add the chipotle oil and stir well.

title: Petimezi (Persian Sticky Dates)
ingredients: 300 g dates | 1 cup parsley
instructions: Wash, remove and remove the stems from the dates. Cut the dates roughly into small pieces. Make a slit on each date to form a pocket. Fill each opening with some parsley. Roll the dates into a tight ball, and leave for about an hour with a damp cloth placed at the bottom of the bowl to prevent them catching. Serve them on a plate. Variation use dates that are soft. The date juice can also be used to make a filling to the dried persian komadi.

title: Pepper Potatoes and Clams
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled, cut in half and then into eighths | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1 bottle clam juice
instructions: Combine parsnips, onions soup mix and clam juice.

Random Ingredients: radish,pork loin,corn flake,tilapia fillet,onion soup mix,broccoli floret
title: Crispy Roasted Pork Loins
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon corn flakes | 12 ounces smoked pork loin, cut into 12 thin slices | 1 tilapia fillet | 1 bunch fresh broccoli florets | 2 tablespoons shredded radishes ( optional )
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a shallow baking dish with cooking spray. In medium bowl, mix cornflake crumbs with the soup mix. Dip both sides of the tilapia fillet into the crumbs, coating evenly. Arrange the tilapia slices over the bottom of the prepared bread baking dish. Top with broccoli florets. Pour the stuffing over the fish, and cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove aluminum foil, sprinkle with shredded radishes, and bake until fish is flaky and cooked through, about 15 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,beef tenderloin,molasses,extra sharp cheddar cheese,creole seasoning,cinnamon,asparagus,chinese chive
title: Chinese Spiced Hot-And-Sweet Beef and Asparagus Medallions
ingredients: 1 lb hot beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup molasses ( or honey ) | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 teaspoon chinese chives ( or green onions ) | 1/4 lb fresh asparagus | 1 package extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated and mixed well | 1 lb trimmed of fat flank steak
instructions: Trim the beef of all visible external fat. Cut into 8 slices on the diagonal.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,ginger paste,lime juice zest,coconut,creme fraiche
title: Aarti's Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 large mango chutney | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve in a shallow bowl.

title: Lime and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb baby spinach | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 tablespoon finely grated lime zest | 3 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Chop the spinach into 1/4 inch sized peices. Toss with onions. Put lime zest into bowl. Add white vinegar. Toss.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,vegetable shortening,rice,chinese wine,papaya,semolina flour,white bread,brown rice
title: Authentic Filipino Fried Rice
ingredients: 200 g rice | 200 g glutinous bread | 3/4 cup rice | 7 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 150 g white bread, crumbs | 10 tablespoons white vinegar | 20 g sweet papayas, sliced | 10 g rice vinegar | 5 g rice vinegar | 5 g sugar | 10 g chinese white vinegar ( benishoga ) | 10 g sweet papaya, sliced into thin rings
instructions: First, make a syrup of 2 tsps sugar and 5 g vinegar. Then, place the rice in a pot and cover it with this syrup. Bring it to a boil. Turn the heat down to simmer and cook for approximately 20 minutes with the lid closed slightly tilted. Wash the water off the rice. Take the rice out of the pot with a strainer and cut the rice in small chunks. Place it back into the pot. Meanwhile, soak the glutinous bread. Wash the bread by cutting it in small pieces with scissors. Slice it into thin pieces. When the rice is done, remove the rice. Now, in a large bowl, put the rice and 3 cups of water. Cut your ginger in thin slices. Dip half of the crumbled rice into the water, allow it to absorb completely, then transfer it to the bowl. Repeat the steps 4 - 7 to make layers layers 3 - 8 until the ingredients have been used throughout the layers. Make a topping/dressing of 4 g pork vinegar. Next, take a deep frying pan/broiler with a lid and heat it up. Take your glutinous bread bits and pour them on the frying pan. Add 1/4 cup of cold water to the bread, coating it in slices for a few seconds. Place the slices inside the fry pan. The slices should sizzle when the bread has sizzled. Remove the bread when it is crispy and remove it once it is cool enough to handle. Repeat the same process for the remaining rice. Place your rice inside the fry pan/broiler, making sure the rice is hot enough to sizzle when the bottom of the rice is squeezed. Pour the reserved rice on the rice, coating it in slices. After 20 seconds, place your papaya rings inside the rice. The fried rice should look golden. If it does, turn your rice around for a few minutes so that your papaya is golden around the edges. Finally, top the fried rice with the fried pork slices. The fried rice should be a little crispy on top but not burnt inside.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,mascarpone,serrano pepper,baby green,shiitake mushroom,herb
title: Vegetable Enchiladas With Truffle Topping
ingredients: 2 baby bella mushroom, stems removed ( medium ) | 3/4 lb shiitake mushroom, stems removed | 2 serrano peppers | 3 tablespoons mascarpone | 8 ounces red enchilada sauce | herbs ( optional )
instructions: Remove mushrooms from stems and chop finely. Chop chiles to small pieces. Mix in a medium bowl with mascarpone. Spread 1 tablespoon enchilada sauce on bottom of a 12 inch baking dish. Layer 3/4 of the mushroom, chiles, and 1 cup or so of the enchilada sauce. Place 1/3 of the cheese blend, 1/3 of remaining green beans and 1/2 of the mushrooms on top of the green beans. Repeat these layers 3 times with the remaining ingredients, ending with the cheese on top. Cover and refridgerate at least 2 hours before baking. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 40 minutes, then uncover for final 10 minutes, then top with herbs.

title: Buko Dengu [ko'ai]
ingredients: 15 ounces coconut cream ( not coco lopez ) | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Blend or process coconut cream to obtain desired consistency. The darker the chilli, the hotter the sauce will be. Pour sauce in a bowl and dilute with a little water. Top with chilli flakes if using.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,white sesame seed,lasagna noodle,lemon juice,red capsicum,beef steak,cracker crumb,tomato sauce
title: Spicy Thai Steak and Mushroom Cannelloni
ingredients: 250 g beef steak | 1 tablespoon red curry paste, thai kitchen brand | 1 teaspoon dry crushed tomatoes with tomato and basil | 1 teaspoon white sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 50 g light plain cracker crumbs | 1 red capsicum, sliced | 12 lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c or 140°c fan forced. Cook the meat, curry paste, crushed tomatoes and basil in a non stick frying pan with the sesame seeds for 2 minutes or until the meat is cooked. Drain the meat and cut it into thick slices, removing any excess fat. Combine well with the cracker crumbs in a bowl, then spoon the meat into the noodles. Spread a little of the sauce over the noodles, then cover with the remaining sauce. Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil and place the lasagna covers on. Turn the heat down to low and bake for 30 - 40 minutes, or until the spaghetti is cooked.

title: Blue Baked Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup light cornflour | 1/2 cup fish, fillet | 1/2 cup creamed corn ( or 2 tbsp.diet lemon ) | 1 teaspoon margarine | 1 cup fish, chunks | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1/2 teaspoon grain mustard | 1/4 teaspoon blue food coloring
instructions: Put fish chunks in a baking dish. Combine cornflour, creamed corn, margarine, orange rind and grain mustard to make a sauce. Pour 1/2 of the sauce over fish, and stir. Do this at the beginning. Pour the remaining sauce over the fish. Stir gently to coat. Place in the fridge for 5 - 10 minutes, or until the fish is coated with sauce.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,beef rib,corn tortilla,tomato,saffron,green lentil,nonfat cream
title: Kathleen's  Beef Korma Recipe
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef ribs | 1 teaspoon saffron | 12 corn tortillas | 1/2 cup green lentil, picked over and rinsed | 1/3 cup dry-roasted diced tomato | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 2 tablespoons freshly chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Place beef and salt in skillet. Brown the meat with saffron. Add the lentils, tomatoes, and sour cream and simmer until meat is tender, about 1 hour. Wrap up each serviing tortilla with a warm, damp cloth, tie with kitchen string and place in a bowl. Serve meat and lentil mixture over tortillas.

title: Braised Goose
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, with fat | 3 tablespoons dried sage ( use the dried rubbed sage if you have it ) | 3 tablespoons rum ( i use bacardi 151 ) or 3 tablespoons orange rum-infused rum, you can substitute coconut rum if you don't have any rum | 2 lbs corned loose heinz dark rum ( see braised goose ) from the grocery store, or ( 8 ounce ) dark rum flavoured rum
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f. In a baking dish, combine stew meat, sage, and sugar in a large bowl. Pour over rum/rum flavoured rum. Cover loosely and bake in preheated oven 20 minutes, remove foil, and return to oven. Bake until meat is very tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove meat from oven, remove fat, and cool completely. Cover loosely and refrigerate, overnight. The next day, remove fat and discard. Cool completely and cut into serving pieces. If you like, place meat on a platter and refrigerate overnight.. The next morning, remove fat, discarding solids, and refrigerate. The next day, heat rum over low heat in a small heavy skillet until it's just barely simmering and heat through. Taste and add more salt if needed. Pack meat into shallow baking dish, cover dish and refrigerate overnight or at least 8 hours before serving. If you want to serve this stew on toasts, heat 1 cup of white sugar in a small saucepan until the sugar just barely turns golden brown, about 2 minutes. Spoon caramelized rum over the meat just before serving. This can also be frozen.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,vermouth,jalapeno chilies,pork steak,cashew,icing sugar,onion powder,mayonnaise
title: Roast Spicy Canadian Bacon Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork steaks | 4 ounces canadian bacon ( about 8 slices ) | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon dry vermouth | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 large jalapeno chilies, finely chopped | 3 ounces cashews, finely chopped | 1 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons sweet vermouth
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Place pork steaks in a large shallow roasting pan and bake for 15 minutes. Set aside. Using small sharp knife, slice canadian bacon into thin strips. Place on cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes until well caramelized. In a small bowl, combine icing sugar and vermouth. Heat in microwave on medium for 30 seconds, or until boiling. Remove pan from heat. Sprinkle with onion powder. Set aside. Toast cashews in oven, stirring once, for 1 to 2 minutes, or until lightly golden. Watch carefully. Do not burn. Place half of toast onto serving plate. Place some cooked bacon on toast. Place remaining toast into oven. Watch carefully. Remove from oven. Brush top of toast with vermouth or sprinkle with icing sugar. Place sliced jalapenos, chopped red onion and chopped cashews into bread slices and top with meat. Drizzle on remaining vermouth.

title: Cafe Alexander (Alexander Eggnog)
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces fresh pressed amaretto | 4 ounces coffee flavored liqueur | 3/4 ounce oregano, chopped | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom, crushed
instructions: Put amaretto, coffee liqueur, oregano, vinegar, and cardamom in a mortar. Add salt to taste. Enjoy.

title: Zucchini Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup zucchini, grated | 1/3 cup fig, chopped | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients, mix well. Refrigerate 1 hour to allow flavors to mix. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium heat. Lightly coat pan with cooking spray. Drop by tablespoons onto pan. Cook until browned on one side.

Random Ingredients: red wine,chicken thigh,tart apple,mint sprig,swiss cheese,seasoning sauce,lime juice
title: Lime Grilled Chicken With Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 2 boneless chicken thighs | 12 slices thinly-sliced swiss cheese ( about 1/4-inch thick ) | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/4 cup fresh mint sprig | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons maggi seasoning sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Preheat grill or indoor grill to medium high. Place chicken skin side up on lightly greased plate and rub with 1/4 tsp each salt and pepper. Grill chicken 7 - 8 minutes, until done, turning once, or until juices run clear when thigh is pierced with a skewer. While chicken is grilling, combine wine, mint, remaining 1 1/2 tsp salt and remaining 1/4 tsp pepper in small bowl. Bring to simmer in medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in 1/4 cup lime juice. Add chicken and cheese and stir to blend. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,peanut,chili oil,curry leaf,parsley sprig,beef bouillon cube,horseradish,jalapeno pepper
title: Beef and Nawabi Cauliflower Curry
ingredients: 3 medium cucumbers or 5 -6 large beurre mani chilies, seeded and minced coarse | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 4 tablespoons minced fresh parsley sprigs or 2 tablespoons cilantro sprigs | 3 tablespoons chopped pickled jalapeno peppers ( seeded and chopped ) | 1 cup cauliflower, florets | 1 tablespoon crushed mild mustard horseradish | chopped roasted unsalted dry roasted peanuts
instructions: In a small bowl, combine bouillon cubes with about 1 1/2 cups water and let stand until cubes are thoroughly dissolved, 30 - 45 minutes. Drain liquid from beef cubes, reserving 2/3 cup of liquid. Cut beef and vegetables into 1/2 chunks and set aside. In a food processor or blender, combine reserved liquid with reserved beef and vegetables and puree until smooth. For tempering, in a small pot, combine mustard horseradish and remaining 1 2/3 cup water and set aside. In a large, non stick pan over medium high heat, melt oil and saute peppers, cauliflower and reserved liquid mixture until the vegetables begin to soften, approximately 2 minutes. The amount of liquid used depends on the type of cauliflower used. Add to beef mixture and stir fry for 2 minutes until vegetables are bright green and crispy. Taste and adjust seasoning, adding desired amount of salt and pepper. Serve immediately over rice or noodles, garnished with peanuts.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,raspberry jam,rice noodle,stock,pecan nut,vanilla essence,red enchilada sauce
title: Raspberry Noodle Trifle
ingredients: 16 ounces rice noodles ( i used small rice noodles and got the kids to eat them ) | 1 pint hot stock | 1 -2 ounce double sec | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1/2 cup seedless raspberry jam ( i used the premade raspberry jam ) | 2 dashes of your favorite red enchilada sauce ( i used an aldi's red hot pepper jelly ) | 1/2 cup toasted pecan nuts
instructions: Place rice noodles in a large bowl with hot tap water. Turn noodles over to thoroughly soak.. Soak for five minutes, then stir again to start breaking up. This will take about a minute. After ten minutes, drain noodles and return them to the pan. In a small bowl, mix the two mixtures, then pour onto noodles. Keep on heat until mixture starts to boil around the edge. If it thickens, stir with a teaspoon/half until it thickens again. Add vanilla essence and stir. Add the 2nd 2 oz of raspberry jam and stir until you see a nice amount of liquid in the noodles. Continue to add liquid while stirring constantly, so it doesn't burn. I added a splash of red hot pepper jelly. Sprinkle crushed pecans on top. Mix, leave on heat for about a minute before serving warm. Note, some people like hot red pepper jelly too, but not dried peppers. I prefer black pepper jelly. Note, the raspberry jam adds a nice burst of flavor. It might add a touch of sweetness but not too much.

title: Chinese Onion Pork Chops
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon anise extract | 2 pork chops | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped
instructions: Sprinkle the anise seed evenly over both sides of the pork chops. Marinate at least one hour or overnight. Spray an outdoor grill with nonstick spray and heat to medium high. Remove pork chops from marinade and cook about 8 minutes per side, until light brown.

title: Sweet Chili Fire Roasted Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place cherry tomatoes in a single layer. Roast in the preheated oven until heated through and starting to char, about 25 minutes. Watch carefully. Set in a plastic resealable bag while still warm. Stir in sweet chili sauce until thoroughly blended. Allow to set for about 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: white bread,orange juice,brown rice,french vanilla ice cream,basil leaf,channa dal,kiwi,creamy salad dressing
title: Creamy Rice Dressing With Fruit and Yoghurt (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 3 )
ingredients: 125 ml french vanilla ice cream | 125 ml creamy salad dressing | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 250 g fresh white bread, cut into cubes | 2 kiwi, peeled, halved, cut diagonally | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil leaf | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil leaf | 150 ml orange juice | 100 g channa dal ( chickpeas ) | 150 ml reduced-fat french vanilla ice cream, lightly to serve
instructions: To make salad dressing, place yoghurt, orange juice and 1 tablespoon water in a small bowl. Whisk to combine, set aside. To make berry, place soaked channa dal in a saucepan of boiling water, remove from the heat and cook for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain, allow to cool until warm and drain again. Place warm channa dal in a sieve and rinse under cold water until cool enough to handle then drain well and place in a small bowl. Add cream and juice to yoghurt, stir to combine. To serve, place 1/3 of the rice onto the serving plate, then top with half of the berry, kiwi, salad dressing, basil and fruit. Repeat layers, finishing with french vanilla. Top with remaining berry and yogurt. Serve with toasted pita chips, fresh bread chunks or fresh leafy salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: demerara sugar,lemon zest,fruit,italian seasoning,manchego cheese,salad oil,chocolate
title: Spanish Ambrosia
ingredients: 1/8 cup salad oil ( olive oil will do ) | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 4 ounces manchego cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 6 ounces mixed dried fruit, diced | 4 teaspoons demerara sugar | 8 ounces semisweet chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Warm 1/8 cup of salad oil in a small sauce pot over low heat. Add lemon zest and cook for 5 minutes more. Remove from heat and set aside. In a mixing bowl, stir together the grated cheese, italian seasoning and dried fruit. Add the remaining oil. Add the zest in small batches and cook until the cheese has melted and incorporated into the meat. Remove from the heat and stir. Scoop up into a 13 x 9 baking dish. Top with a sprinkling of grated cheese. Bake in oven, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and pour the rest of the oil in the pan over the fruit and cheese mixture. Return to oven and bake for 20 minutes more. Remove and cool for 20 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Avocado and Guacamole Doughnuts
ingredients: 1 fresh hass avocado - peeled, pitted and mashed | 2 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, stir together the avocado and flour until smooth. Roll out 2 to 3 tablespoons of dough per doughnut into an 11” circle on the prepared baking sheets. Place on the prepared baking sheets. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown. Allow the doughnuts to cool briefly before removing to the baking sheet. Allow to cool completely before storing in an airtight container.

title: Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 head cabbage ( about 4 oz. ) | 12 lettuce
instructions: Trim root ends from cabbage and separate into individual leaves. Remove stalk from leaves as you would for cabbage leaves. Wash leaves thoroughly to remove sand. Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove cabbage leaves from bag or box and place in a baking dish. Bake cabbage rolls in oven, uncovered, for about 30 minutes, or until tender but not browned. Place cabbage rolls on a plate and place lettuce leaves on top. Serve with sour cream if desired.

title: Potato and Corn Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb potato, unpeeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 8 ears fresh corn kernels | 8 ounces tomatoes with green chilies, chopped | 1 shallot, minced
instructions: Cook potatoes in a large pot of boiling water just until soft, about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add corn kernels, cook, stirring and turning often, until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a bowl. Add tomatoes and shallot to skillet. Heat to a boil while mixture simmers. Ladle warm corn salsa into bowls or plates. Sprinkle with reserved potato slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,apple cider,chipotle powder,rice wine,chicken stock,liquid smoke
title: Smoky Chipotle Cream Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 2 quarts chicken stock | 1 1/2 cups liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon pure chipotle powder | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 1/3 cup rice wine | 1/2 cup apple cider
instructions: Bring stock, liquid smoke, chipotle powder, liquid smoke, wine, cane syrup and apple cider to a boil. Stir mixture until boiling and reduce heat to simmer. After simmering, stir all ingredients until mixture is completely incorporated into a nice smooth sauce. When mixture is done, let sit for a few hours to reduce the flavor.

title: Hot Kofta
ingredients: 2 -6 fresh kalamata olives | 3/4 cup sweet-hot mix | 3/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Place olives in a colander or sieve over a bowl. Drain all of the water out of olives. Place the olive mixture in a food processor or electric blender. Add sweet hot mix and allspice and blend well. Shape into small koftas and allow each to be tightly covered and frozen on an uncovered pizza pan. Cover and place in freezer. The dough should then freeze solid. Preheat oven to 350°f.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,malibu rum,red potato,garlic paste,garlic breadstick,hing,spaghetti
title: Sweet Potato Spaghetti
ingredients: 5 large red potatoes | 1 cup tomato paste | 1/2 cup malibu rum ( sweetened soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dried hing | 3 ounces spaghetti | 2 teaspoons minced garlic breadsticks, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to peel potatoes and cut in half lengthwise. Boil for 20 minutes or until soft, but not mushy. Drain and mash with potato masher. Combine tomato paste, rum, garlic, hing, spaghetti, garlic bread sticks and potatoes. Place in an oiled 2 1/2 quart casserole dish and bake for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,italian salad dressing mix,mushroom,turbinado sugar,bacon,chili paste,mace,cheese sauce
title: Tasty Bacon & Mushroom Dip!
ingredients: 3 ounces bacon ( streaky or fatty will work fine ) | 12 ounces fresh mushrooms ( sliced thin or thick will work fine ) | 1/2 cup miracle whip cheese sauce ( or any other tasty cheese spreadable type such as miracle whip ) | 1 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1 lime, zest of, grated | 1 tablespoon chili paste or 1 tablespoon anise chili sauce ( if you have a strong dry chili, use a mild ) | 3 teaspoons turbinado sugar or 3 teaspoons fine granulated sugar | 1/3 teaspoon ground mace or 1/3 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: In a fry pan, fry the bacon until cooked, remove & set aside. Add all the ingredients except the bacon & mushrooms to a food processor & puree until there are no chunks of bacon / mushroom. Set aside. Now, place all the ingredients in a bowl, mix well adding more miracle whip if needed, & then add the bacon & mushroom mixture & mix in thoroughly. If you want to be really decadent & serve on a bed of shredded hot coffee, you can use this mixture to make a topping for your meatball subs. Enjoy note, if you don't like your meatballs & mushrooms dip, you can add some bacon bits instead or a little bit of chopped up mushrooms to make it into a delicious snack or serve on the side.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,plain flour,buttermilk,garlic granule,chickpea flour,cremini mushroom,mandarin orange,mexican cheese
title: Mushroom and Mandarin Pancakes from the Freezer
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plain flour | 1 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 2 cups plain flour or 2 cups pizza dough | 1 can chickpea flour ( from can ) | 1 can chickpea flour ( from can ) | 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 small cremini mushroom, chopped | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese
instructions: Place ingredients in food processor and blend until a smooth batter is formed. Heat a small frying pan and lightly toast the pancake by dropping it into 3 - 4 tablespoons of batter. It should start to get quite dry at this point, but will hold it's shape in a 5 inch circle. When the pancake is a nice golden color underneath when cooked, remove and place on paper towel lined plate. Serve the pancakes with the sauce and fruit salad.

title: Zucchini Alla Crevette (Zucchini in Plum Wine)
ingredients: 3 medium zucchini | 3 tablespoons lard, melted | 1 1/2 cups fruity plum wine, such as chianti
instructions: Trim zucchini and slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick rounds. Cook zucchini in a saucepan of boiling water over moderate heat, turning them with tongs, until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Transfer to a large bowl and stir in melted lard. Return zucchini to saucepan. Add plum wine and season with salt and pepper. Heat until wine reduces to 1 cup, stirring over a low heat. Serves.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,pepperoncini pepper,red wine,sage leaf,egg white,canadian bacon,red chili powder,creamy peanut butter
title: Canadian Bacon Bites
ingredients: 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 3/4 teaspoon ground red chili powder | 6 red hot pepperoncini peppers | 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaf | 2 large egg whites, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup dry red wine ( optional ) | 2 bacon, slices crispy-cut into 1/4 inch pieces or 3/4 lb canadian bacon curls
instructions: Put maple syrup, peanut butter, chile powder, hot peppers, and sage leaves into a shallow dish. Beat egg whites until fluffy. Stir in wine if using. Dip bacon pieces into egg whites, then into maple syrup mixture and press down lightly. Refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving. This may be refrigerated for up to 3 days.

title: Mustard Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mustard powder | 1 cup curry, bottled sauce
instructions: Combine mustard powder and curry sauce in a small bowl.

title: Basic French Bread for Cold Roasted
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried sage | 2 lbs french bread ( about 5 1/2 lb ) | 2 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Prepare a small pre heated oven to 450 degrees f. Sprinkle sage into 8 slices of bread. Using a baking sheet with parchment or waxed paper, place bread on baking sheet and toast them for about 5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crisp. Meanwhile, prepare the roast beef. Rub a meat thermometer along the outside on your meat and place a plate over the pan to keep in a tight circle of ice. Dry roast beef on a towel lined cookie sheet until internal temp is of 130 degrees f. When cooked, strain the bread slices to remove sage. Using a slotted spoon, remove most of the bread onto a platter and allow to cool. Using a slice of toast, place it on each plate with a sage sprig and drizzle each serving with a little water. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,veal chop,olive oil,canola oil,cardamom seed,lime,orange
title: Veal Chops With Orange and Pineapple
ingredients: 12 thin veal chops | 4 teaspoons olive oil | 1 orange | 1 lime | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 large cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon pure canola oil
instructions: To marinate, cut orange and lime in half longways and core and roughly chop. Juice juice of 1/2 orange. Combine all ingredients except the canola oil, cardamom, and canola oil in a large zip top plastic bag and marinate the veal chops for 2 hours, turning once. After 2 hours add the canola oil to a large wok or skillet over high heat, and add the marinated chops, turning frequently. Remove chops from heat. Keep warm. Heat 1 tablespoon of canola oil in the same skillet over high heat and add the cardamom and canola oil. Place the cooked chops in the oil and brown on both sides then remove or set on a baking sheet or rimmed baking sheet and cover. Lower the temperature to medium and continue cooking for 30 minutes. The dish should be dry and the meat very browned and crisp. Remove from heat and sprinkle with the sweet pepper flakes before serving.

title: Frijoles Negros (Costa Rican Bean Dip)
ingredients: 2 cups canned black beans, rinsed, drained | 1 can tomato puree | 5 teaspoons tomato puree
instructions: Combine the beans, tomato puree and tomato puree in a slow cooker. Cook on high for 3 1/2 hours, or until beans are very tender.

Random Ingredients: tamari,coconut cream,phyllo pastry,artichoke heart,ancho chile powder,plain yogurt,navy bean
title: Baked Phyllo Pizza With Artichokes, Beans, and Noodles
ingredients: 1 can navy beans, drained | 2 ounces marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 2 ounces low-fat plain yogurt | 20 sheets phyllo pastry | 3 tablespoons tamari ( soy sauce ) | 1 pinch dried ancho chile powder | 1 cup unsweetened coconut cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray with nonstick cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine the navy beans, artichokes, yogurt, and chile powder.

Random Ingredients: gochujang,sea salt,lime wedge,bread flour,whipping cream,cabbage,spanish onion,pine nut
title: Spicy and Sweet Cabbage Rolls (Jidan Er Dunhead)
ingredients: 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon grated spanish onion | sea salt | 1 cup bread flour | 1 tablespoon finely crumbled gochujang | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, coarsely chopped | 2 small cabbage, cored and cut into 1-inch dice | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Combine the whipping cream, onion, and salt in a bowl and set aside. Whisk together the bread flour and gochujang in a separate bowl. Combine the pine nuts and cabbage in a third bowl and set aside. Roll half the cabbage out on a lightly floured work surface until it is about 1/4 inch thick, about 7 to 8 minutes. Transfer it to a baking sheet, leaving about 5 to 6 inch of dough remaining. Flip it over. Repeat with the remaining pastry. Cut the pastry into 3 inch pieces. Dust the work surface with flour, lay the cabbage in the center, and press the edges of the pastry with your fingers, drawing in any stray bits of dough. Roll out the remaining cabbage into a rectangle about 10 inches by 10 inches. Make the roll with the first piece of pastry and the filling. Use a sharp, serrated knife to cut roll out with a sharp knife, cutting all the way through. Continue until all the roll's pastry and filling are used. Dust the top of the roll with the coarse kosher salt. Place the roll crosswise on the baking sheet. Place the cut out rolls on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake until light brown, about 25 minutes, or according to the package directions. Garnish with lime wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,cherry,red potato,chunky salsa,vanilla essence,garlic powder,taco seasoning mix
title: Mexican Potatoes & Salsa Stuffed With Mushrooms & Sour Dressing
ingredients: 12 small red potatoes | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 packet cherry flavored sourdough breaded mushrooms ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chunky salsa ( optional ) | 1 dash vanilla essence | 1 clove crushed garlic powder ( optional ) | fresh sage leaf ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Boil the potatoes in separate large pan of simmering water until they are fork tender. About 20 mts. Drain well. Mix the taco seasoning, mushsticks, mushrooms etc into the potatoes until everything is coated evenly. Divide potato mixture between the 12 mts. Spray a loaf tin with non stick spray oil. Smooth over the top. Bake in oven for 50 - 60 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Mustard Green and Broiled Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 3 tablespoons mustard greens | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 lb bocconcini, quartered
instructions: Lay the chicken flat. Cut out and discard any excess fat. Place the mustard greens in a roasting pan and surround with the cherry tomatoes. Add the mustard greens. Brush the chicken with some oil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and bake in 375f degrees oven for 30 minutes. Broil, uncovered, for about 15 minutes. Let stand 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,mineral water,italian bread crumb,cognac,red chili pepper,vanilla extract,tea leaf,vegetable oil
title: Steak Frites (Cretons)
ingredients: 1 cup dried italian bread crumbs | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons boiling water | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 pinch dried red chili pepper | 5 leaves tea leaves | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 dash balsamic vinegar
