instructions: Mix bread crumbs, 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, and boiling water in a bowl. Mix in vanilla. Cut chili into strips, and stir into crumb mixture. Remove leaf veins from tea leaves and place leaves in bowl. Set aside. Place remaining 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet, and heat over medium high heat. Pour in reserved tea leaves and garlic, and continue to fry until lightly golden brown. Add balsamic, and mix well. Pour in remaining oil, and heat through. Add breadcrumb mixture, and cook until golden brown and crusty.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,pickling spice,broccoli,chili pepper,chili flake,white pepper
title: Chinese Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 lb baby broccoli or 1 lb other bright green leafy greens | 1/2 cup pickling spices, chinese five spice mix | 1 tablespoon dry crushed chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon chili pepper, dark green | chili flakes, optional ( optional ) | chili powder, for garnish
instructions: Trim the green leaves from the stems and discard the tough tough outer leaves. Cut the stalks into 1 inch pieces with the broad tips of your knife, leaving a 1 inch wide strip at the base of the leaves about 2 inches long. Slice the leaves in to uniform pieces, leaving a bit of stalk at the base of the leaves.. Bundle the 3 spice mix into a piece of cheesecloth with a twist tie, tying the knot, or a small piece of string with 2 to 3 inch string. Bring a large pot of water to boil, remove the lid, stir in the spice bundle, and return to a simmer on a very low heat. Add the broccoli pieces, cover and cook for 3 to 5 minutes until softened slightly but crisp tender. Remove the broccoli with a slotted spoon and discard the spice bundle, set the soup aside. Remove the stem from the stem and discard it. Slice the broccoli stalks into 1 inch lengths.

title: Easy Creamy Onion Soup (Palai)
ingredients: 3 -4 large white onions | 4 -5 green cardamom pods | 4 tablespoons heavy cream ( or evaporated milk ) | 1 teaspoon powdered green cardamom powder ( i use this in a pinch but does not make enough ) ( optional )
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the onions. Put all of them in a heavy sauce pan with a lid on and heat on low until the onions soften slightly. Add cardamom powder. When cardamom pods are fragrant, add 3/4 cup of cold water and stir a few times. Simmer for 15 minutes. You could also add small chunks of ham or meat of your choice. Serve hot with freshly grated coconut, pistachios, walnuts, raw cashew or almonds of your choice. Enjoy.

title: Easy Toasted Beef Liver Pitas
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef liver, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons pita bread, warmed | 2 tablespoons dill, chopped
instructions: Arrange liver on flat surface. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with bread. Sprinkle with dill. Cut crosshatch pattern on top of bread with serrated knife. Serve.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,button mushroom,olive,rigatoni pasta,potato flake,marjoram,sherry wine
title: Rigatoni With Mushrooms & Saffron
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 6 ounces button mushrooms, trimmed, thinly sliced | 6 ounces cooked pearl onions | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 pinch saffron strand | 1 ounce dried instant potato flakes | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram ( optional )
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to the boil, season with salt and then stir in the rigatoni. Cook for 4 - 5 mins or until al dente. Remove from the heat, drain and keep covered for 1 - 2 mins to give the pasta room to absorb the flavours. Meanwhile, heat 1 tsp oil, add the mushrooms, onions, sherry, saffron and dried potato flakes and cook gently for 3 - 4 minutes, until the mushrooms are golden. Toss the cooked rigatoni into the pan with the mushrooms and marjoram and toss gently. Serve with freshly grated parmesan or romano.

title: Quesadilla Wedges
ingredients: 1 bag plain bread | 2 tablespoons grenadine | 1 tablespoon a.1. original sauce | 2 fresh jalapeno chilies, seeded and sliced | 1 tablespoon mild hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cut the bread into 1/8 inch slices and place on baking sheets. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon grenadine, 2 tablespoons a. Hauce and 2 jalapenos. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, until lightly browned and crispy. Serve hot.

title: Easy Pork Tenderloin Rolls
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 1 container ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat an oven to 275 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Roll the tenderloin in the ricotta cheese to coat. Place the tenderloin onto the prepared baking dish, and roll into a tight ball. Repeat with the remaining pieces. Bake in the preheated oven until the tenderloins are tender and the juices run clear, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: tamari,green cardamom,orange peel,pinto bean,lettuce,coconut oil,serrano pepper,cayenne
title: Tunisian Green Beans or Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans ( or other green beans ) or ( 15 ounce ) can pink beans, drained and rinsed ( or other green beans ) | 1/3 cup fresh lime juice or 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1 cup shredded cos lettuce ( or other leaf lettuce ) | 1/4 cup shredded coconut oil ( or other vegetable oil ) or 1/4 cup olive oil ( or other vegetable oil ) | 2 -3 tablespoons tajwain ( or other green chili sauce of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon green cardamoms or 1 tablespoon cayenne ( to taste ) | finely shredded orange peel ( or lemon peel, or lime peel, or lime juice ) | 2 -3 serrano peppers or 2 -3 jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a medium sized, heavy pot over low heat or in the microwave, add beans and cook, covered, for 15 - 20 minutes until tender. Set beans and liquid aside, draining beans and liquid from beans in a colander.. To make dressing, in a blender/food processor, combine oil, vinegar, and chili seasoning. Puree until smooth. To serve, put bean salad in a large bowl. Add dressing, and toss well to coat. Garnish with orange peel, shredded orange peel and chopped chiles. Makes 3 - 4 servings. Note, for vegetarian/vegan omit the fish or chicken.

Random Ingredients: bean thread noodle,collard green,almond extract,rice noodle,vegetable oil,garlic paste,citron peel,raisin
title: Cheater's Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1/2 pound collard greens - rinsed, trimmed and chopped | 1 clove garlic paste | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 4 ounces bean thread noodles, broken into pieces | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon grated asian ( toasted ) candied citron peel
instructions: Soak rice noodles 5 minutes in warm water. Drain noodles and place in a serving bowl. Place garlic paste, raisins, almonds and bean thread noodles in separate serving bowls. In a small skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add almond extract and citron peel. Add to hot oil and stir until mixture is hot and fragrant. Pour hot almond paste over noodles and toss to coat. Cool and serve.

title: Czech Cracked Pork Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons salt pork, crumbled | 1 teaspoon garlic granules
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Sprinkle seasoning over pork coating well. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight for seasoning to meld.

title: Yummy Perfecto Baked Rissoni on a Bun
ingredients: 1 box rice | 1 jar prego spaghetti sauce ( or regular jar ) | 1/2 cup coffee | 1/2 cup mirin | 1/4 teaspoon greek oregano
instructions: Place the package of rice in a large bowl and add 1/3 jar of Prego sauce. Dip the rissoni into the marinade then coat them with the prego sauce and spices. Lay in a single layer on a tin foil or lightly buttered foil and bake at 375 degrees for at least 30 minutes. The breading is done now. The rice can be either wholemeal or soaked in 1 cup of milk for a couple of mins or slightly more depending on desired moistness/dressing/texture.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,italian tomato,cotija cheese,anchovy paste,calorie sweetener
title: Arora (Italian Caramelized Tomatoes)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons salted butter, at room temperature | 4 lbs italian tomatoes, sliced ( about 6 large ) | 2 tablespoons cotija cheese, grated ( or other tasty spanish cheese ) | 1 teaspoon salted anchovy paste | 2 teaspoons cardamom powder | 2 tablespoons reduced-calorie sweetener, sweetener to taste
instructions: In a large heavy skillet, melt the butter over moderate heat. Add the tomatoes and sugar and stir to combine. Raise heat to moderately high, reduce the heat and simmer until tomatoes are very tender, about 45 minutes. Mash the tomatoes with the back of a wooden spoon against the sides of the skillet and set aside. Stir in anchovy paste and cardamom powder and let cool at least 10 minutes. Stir the sauce into the skillet with the tomatoes. Raise the heat to moderate and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the sauce becomes a sauce of dark mahogany color. Transfer the mixture to an airtight container and cool until warm, about 20 minutes. Stir in the sweetener. Serve the tomato sauce chilled.

title: Homemade Irish Whiskey
ingredients: 2 gallons whiskey, divided | 1/2 cup crushed pistachios
instructions: Place 1/2 cup whiskey in each gallon glass. Fill the remaining 1/2 cup whiskey with pistachios.

title: Bavarian-Style Lamb Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb chops | 1 packet dried yeast | 1 tablespoon kirschwasser | 1/4 cup applesauce | 50 g ground round
instructions: Mix yeast, kirschwasser and applesauce with 1/2 of the meat. Place the rest of the meat in the crock and sprinkle top with yeast mix and add the rest of the kirschwasser. Cook in the crock on top shelf of a preheated 180 degree centigrade oven for approximately 4 hours. Turn out and slice. Serve with salads, tomato sauce and a gherkin salad.

Random Ingredients: ghee butter,dark chocolate,white mushroom,chicken thigh fillet,cider vinegar,baking powder,watercress,black cardamom pod
title: Dry Chicken Mole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thigh fillets | 4 ounces white mushrooms, chopped, stemed, trimmed, diced | 1 tablespoon soft ghee or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 teaspoons dark chocolate, chopped | 1 tablespoon watercress, chopped | 1 pinch baking powder
instructions: Cut the chicken into 4 thick strips lengthwise and place in a bowl. Add the mushroom, vinegar and cardamom. Add the chocolate and watercress. Toss lightly. Sprinkle the baking powder over the chicken and rub it in, using your hands or a pastry brush. Cover, bring to the boil then reduce the heat.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,cremini mushroom,peanut butter,baking potato,ginger paste
title: Korean Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 2 medium baking potatoes | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 1/2 - 1 cup cremini mushroom, sliced | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut into very thin slices. Set aside. Separate the white layer and brown the potato slices in a skillet with the ginger and soya sauce over medium heat. Spread peanut butter on a plate and place the sliced potatoes inches. Place on top the white layer of the potato slices that has been browned in skillet. Spread the browned ginger and soy sauce with a spatula that goes well around the perimeter of the potatoes and onto the mashed potato. Continue on that way until you have used all of the potato ingredients and have started looking for a sweet potato that is not too dry.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,cannellini bean,salt pepper,walnut,madeira wine,lime,lettuce,sage leaf
title: French Bistro Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce ( small bunch ) | 2 cans cannellini beans | 100 g dark rum | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 teaspoon dried lime rind | 50 g walnuts, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 1 small lime ( or lemon )
instructions: Wash the lettuce thoroughly. Separate the leaves and slice them into quarters. Drain the beans and rinse them. Drain the beans and place them in a serving bowl. Mix the rum, sage, lime rind and nuts together and make sure all the fruit is covered. Pour the alcohol over everything, being careful to not let the alcohol burn. Toss the lettuces and then toss it with the rum, sage, etc. Decorate with the mint leaves and serve immediately.

title: White Chocolate Bark
ingredients: 8 ounces white chocolate | 2 tablespoons dried italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f melt chocolate and parsley in microwave on medium or medium low setting, stirring every minute, until smooth. Place in small bowl and cool to room temperature, stirring every 15 minutes. Spread out on ungreased baking sheet 1/2 inch thick. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until set. Turn out onto waxed paper. Cool completely. Break into 1 inch pieces and store airtight in airtight container at room temperature.

title: Mushroom & Quinoa Side Dish
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups vegetable stock or 4 1/2 cups cider | 1 package shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon white sugar or 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cider vinegar
instructions: Combine vegetable stock& shiitake mushrooms in a large saucepan. Cover with water and bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until mushrooms are soft. Strain the soaking liquid and reserve. Discard shiitake mushrooms. Puree the mushroom mixture using a blender or food processor or in batches in a blender until smooth. Return to saucepan and add the sugar, vinegar and reserved mushroom liquid. Heat through but do not boil.

title: Sun Dried Tomato Mushrooms and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 16 ounces dried shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 cup sweet hot sauce | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Soak dry mushrooms in hot water for 10 minutes. Drain liquid, and reserve. Wipe mushrooms with damp cloth. Wipe out mushrooms and set aside. Heat oil in skillet over high heat. When hot, add mushrooms. Stir fry until golden brown, about 3 minutes. Sprinkle with hot sauce. Serve hot.

title: Veal With Sunflower Oil (Kefalonitissa)
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cut into portions about 2-1/2 in size. ( i use round, thin cuts ) | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup half-and-half | grated romano cheese or parmesan cheese
instructions: Rub all over the veal with the oil. Sprinkle the vinegar over, then add the half & half. Let marinate at least 1 hour. Preheat grill to high, or preheat broiler. Spray or oil grill. When ready to cook, heat 2 - 3 pieces of aluminum foil or parchment, wrap them in aluminum foil, and bake for 10 - 15 minutes or high heat for 15 minutes, flip carefully and continue baking for about 15 mins more, or until desired doneness. If using charcoal remove, brush off any oil residue, and grill again for 2 - 3 minutes, or until desired doneness. Or bake in the oven as an open flame meat basting occasionally until done, turning regularly. Serve with mashed potatoes or pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,italian herb,cucumber,potato flake,gingerroot,sugar cube,apple cider vinegar
title: Cucumber Salad in Ginger-Apple Cream
ingredients: 1/2 small cucumber | 1/3 cup granulated sugar cube | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, grated | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried mixed italian herbs or 2 teaspoons of fresh mixed italian herbs | potato flakes, for dipping
instructions: Remove seeds from cucumber and cut cucumber into small pieces about 2 inches wide and 1/4 inch thick. In shallow dish, combine cucumber, sugar cube, ginger root, corn oil vinegar and mixed herbs. Let stand 30 minutes. Drain excess liquid from cucumber. Refrigerate several hours or overnight to develop flavors. Drain well and mix with potato flakes. Refrigerate 2 - 4 hours. Serve chilled.

title: Linda's Italian Breadsticks
ingredients: 3 cups dry white breadcrumbs | 3 cups brandy ( any brandy will do )
instructions: Place bread stick in a container that will accommodate full coverage. Pour brandy overtop of bread sticks a little at a time. Do not cover. Cover the container with a plastic wrap and the top of the container to prevent moisture from forming. After 5 weeks at home, open container and place bread sticks in freezer bag. Freeze.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,pecorino romano cheese,filling,red chile,tomato sauce,spaghetti sauce,ham
title: Spaghetti Sauce With Ham and Pecorino
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 5 red chiles, seeded and chopped, or more to taste | 1 pound ham, cubed | 1/2 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese | 1 sheet frozen prepared doughnuts ( optional )
instructions: Mix spaghetti sauce, tomato sauce, adobo seasoning, red chiles, and ham in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,baby spinach leaf,rotel tomato,chipotle pepper
title: Rotel and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach leaves | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 can mexican-style diced tomatoes | 2 chipotle peppers, chopped | 1 1/2 cups malt vinegar
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Blanch the spinach in the boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain well. Combine the rotel, tomatoes, and chipotle chilies in a large bowl. Stir in the vinegar to coat. Pour the dressing over the spinach, and mix well. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: juice,butternut squash,mango,beef stock cube,chicken stock,madras curry powder,mccormick seasoning,hot water
title: Spicy Hot Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 3 cups beef stock cubes | 3 cups hot water | 1 cup juice | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder | 1 -2 tablespoon mccormick spice | 1 -2 medium mango, diced | 1/3 cup hot milk
instructions: Cut the squash in half and remove the seeds. Remove the strings and peels from the squash. Quarter the squash and discard. Place in a large saucepan of cold water and bring to a boil. Simmer until the squash is tender. Remove the squash once cooked and cut into smaller pieces. In a large saucepan, place the beefstock cubes, hot water, juice, curry powder, and mccormick spice mix. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add diced mango. Heat through and add milk to taste.

title: Lamb Linguine With Lamb
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine pasta, uncooked | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 lbs lamb, trimmed
instructions: Cook lim pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Coat skillet with cooking spray. Cut lamb into thin slices and season with salt and pepper. When pasta is al dente, add meat. Turning as necessary until cooked throughout, about 5 minutes. Drain excess fluids. Add lamb, remaining cooking spray, and enough riced sauce to coat.

title: Macaroni, Red Beet and Pea Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni, cooked | 1 1/2 cups peas and carrots, cooked | 1 cup red beet, cooked, drained and chopped | 1 cup biscuit mix, dough
instructions: Mix macaroni, beets and peas together. Mix in biscuit mix. Bake in oven at 350 degrees. Cut into wedges.

title: Tostadas
ingredients: 1 dozen tostada | 1/2 lb mushroom, sliced | 1 tablespoon tostada | saltpeter
instructions: Slicip off the ends of tostada and cut off any 'chunks'. Brush the inside of'stada' with the tostada. Bake in oven at 180 degrees until crisp. Mix mushrooms & salt in bowl. Pour mushroom mixture down edge of tostada & layer with cheese. Serve with a side vegetable of your choice.

title: Orange Tequila Margarita
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crushed seville oranges | 2 tablespoons tequila | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 1/2 cups sweet picante sauce
instructions: Using a spoon, crush the oranges until almost a liquid. Add the remaining ingredients and blend well.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,mace,red food coloring,phyllo pastry,chili oil,topping
title: Thai Salmon Pie
ingredients: 1/3 cup frozen whipped topping ( thawed ) | 1 sheet thawed phyllo pastry | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 -3 drops red food coloring | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | 1 lb salmon fillet
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare and bake frozen pie following package directions. Place thawed pastry on a parchment lined baking sheet and brush with chili oil. Sprinkle with lemon or lime juice if desired.

Random Ingredients: almond,egg substitute,mango chutney,rice vinegar,wheat pita bread,pie shell,kalamata olive
title: Healthy Greek Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup fat free egg substitute | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons gluten free greek yogurt or 1 1/2 tablespoons low-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract or 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 large prepared refrigerated pie shell | 1/2 cup finely chopped kalamata olive | 1 cup chopped mango chutney or 1 cup other spicy red hot pepper, such as sriracha
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. In a small bowl, combine egg substitute, olives, yogurt, vinegar, and almond extract. Add the almond or vegetable extract. In a food processor, pulse the egg mixture until it forms a smooth sauce. If it does not hold together, add a little water. In a medium bowl, combine the sauce, olives, and mango chutney. Add the egg mixture and stir to blend. Spoon the dough into the pie shell. Spread the dough into the pie. Bake 25 minutes, until the crust is golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Blueberry and Pineapple Cobbler
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed blueberries | 1 teaspoon minced orange rind | 1/2 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/3 cup light coffee | 1 tablespoon light soy flour | 2 tablespoons pineapple preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f degrees. In a small bowl combine crushed blueberries, orange rind, and garlic paste. Spoon about 3 tablespoons of crumb mixture into a 4 cup casserole dish. Spoon the blueberry mixture over top. Mix the coffee and soy flour together in a bowl, then drizzle over blueberry mixture. Dot the top with the pineapple preserves. Cover, and bake at 300 f degrees for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ziti with Berry Sauce
ingredients: 6 cups low salt chicken broth, low fat okay | 1/3 cup tahini | 4 cups water | 1 lb ziti pasta, large tub | 1 cup arugula | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberries | salsa
instructions: Rinse the arugula with cold water and then drain in a colander and place in a bowl of cold water, drain well. Bring the broth to a boil in a large saucepan with a tight fitting lid. Add the ziti and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes while watching your pasta to make sure it cooks through. Remove the drained pasta and reduce the broth in the pan by approximately 5%, about half a cup until you have 2 cups of liquid. Add the arugula and simmer about 2 minutes. Stir in the tahini and warm the sauce to warm it. Add the raspberries to the sauce and simmer just until warm, about 20 minutes. Pour over the pasta and lightly season with salt and pepper before serving.

title: Pesto Toasted Pita Chips
ingredients: 3 pita bread | 1 cup soymilk | 1/3 cup dried currant | 1/4 cup commercial prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wrap each pita bread in aluminum foil to protect it from drying out. Place on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and stir in soymilk with currants until well combined. Spoon mixture onto pita chips and spread to make a thin coating on the chips. Return to the oven and bake for 15 minutes more.

title: Broccoli Delight
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli ( cut into florets ) | 2 teaspoons peanut butter | 0.5 can prunes | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 dash green cardamoms ( optional ) | 1 dash brandy
instructions: Clean broccoli and cut into florets. Cook with peanuts until slightly tender. Chop garlic. Add brandy. When ready to eat, add sprouts. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Pour peanut sauce over sprouts.

Random Ingredients: boston lettuce leaf,beef bouillon granule,white chocolate chip,beef sirloin,vanilla essence
title: Quick  Nutter Meatball Sandwich  -  (Pepperoni)  -  the Best!!!!
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh beef sirloin or 2 lbs ground round | 1 cup white chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 12 -15 boston lettuce leaves
instructions: In a dutch oven brown beef sirloin meat, add white chocolate chips, beef granules & essence, heat till chocolate is melted. Add lettuce leaves to meat mixture, warm for a minute. Serve on toasted buns, or with warmed biscuits.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,penne,cavenders purpose greek seasoning,yogurt,coriander powder,vanilla essence,shiitake mushroom
title: Cavenders All Purpose Greek Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb penne, cooked and drained | 3 ounces shiitake mushrooms, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon sauvignon blanc wine vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons low fat greek yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons red palm cooking wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon cavenders all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Saute mushrooms in the greek yogurt until they are just barely limp. Add cooked pasta to mushroom mixture, mix well and pour over low fat greek yogurt. Mix remaining ingredients and then pour over the pasta. Chill. Note, greek seasoning is made from greek yogurt, not greek cooking wine vinegar.

title: Cuban Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 tablespoon salsa
instructions: Cut baguette in half. Hollow out the cut. Spread the worcestershire sauce on the baguette and sprinkle with cilantro. Cover with salsa. Wrap the sandwich. Cut in half once the sandwich is bread is warm.

Random Ingredients: white bread dough,brandy,milk ricotta cheese,tuna water,confectioner ' sugar,vegetable broth
title: Tuna and Ricotta Cannelloni
ingredients: 2 cans tuna in water, drained | 4 slices white bread dough | 1 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons brandy | 3 cups vegetable broth
instructions: To make the cannelloni, preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with aluminum foil. Place the two cans of tuna with their liquid in a strainer and let drain for 10 minutes. To make the cannelloni, using a food processor, process the drained tuna with the ricotta, sugar, and brandy into a smooth paste. Remove the tuna mixture from the processor and gently stir in the broth a little at a time, working gently. Spoon half of this mixture into the prepared pan. Cover the rest of the mixture evenly with the plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to one day. Remove the cannelloni from the refrigerator 1 hour before baking. Heat a small amount of oil in a deep skillet over medium heat, place the cannelloni, seam side down into the skillet, and cook until crispy, about 2 minutes. Remove the cannelloni from the skillet and set aside. Repeat with the remaining cannelloni. Serve the cannelloni warm, topped with a dollop of the ricotta cannelloni.

title: Creamy Clam and Gorgonzola Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup dried clams | 1 cup water | 1/2 cup quick oatmeal | 2 cups finely shredded red cabbage | 1/4 cup crumbled gorgonzola cheese | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh oregano ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until clams are softened, 5 - 8 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Polish Vegetable Chapatis
ingredients: 4 yellow squash | 1/2 lb flour | 1/2 lb poppy seed, ground
instructions: Wash and peel the yellow squash. Cut the peel in half lengthwise, then in half again lengthwise, cut each half into long pieces. Mix the flour well with 1 tablespoons water. Sprinkle the poppy seeds evenly on a large plate. Spread the ground poppy seeds in a single layer on the ungreased baking sheet. Top the poppy seeds evenly with the yellow squash, pressing lightly with your fingers. Bake at 400° until the filling begins to brown, about 15 minutes. Place the puffs in a paper bag before they cool, then they are cool to the touch.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,palm sugar,tomato juice,red cherry,cumin,milk ricotta cheese
title: Mexican Ricotta Pie
ingredients: 16 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 3/4 cup skim milk | 1 envelope dried italian salad dressing mix | 3 tablespoons grated palm sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 4 tomatoes with juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Prepare pie crust by laying out the bottom and halfway up the sides of a 9 inch pie pan and layering it as follows. 1/2 cup milk ricotta, 1/4 cup skim milk, 1 envelope dry salad dressing mix, 3 tablespoons palm sugar, 1 teaspoon cumin, 1 teaspoon crushed tomatoes with juice. Spread mixture evenly into the bottom of the pastry crust and sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon grated palm sugar over top of all. Bake 12 minutes or until the top is lightly browned.

title: Fava Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1 can mushrooms, drained | 1 package fava beans, drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, refridgerate and use over vegetables or meat in stews or on top of fish.

title: Slow Cooker Shepherd's Pie
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into bite size pieces | 1 1/2 cups white rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1 can sweet chili peppers, chopped
instructions: Place beef, rice, pecans, chili sauce, chili flakes, and chili peppers in the crock pot. Cover and cook on low 6 - 7 hours or high 4 - 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,green onion,leek,bread flour,green grape,farfalle pasta,prawn,lasagna noodle
title: Farfalle with Shrimp
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups farfalle ( bowtie ) pasta | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup chopped leek | 1/3 cup chopped green onions | 1 package refrigerated peeled prawns | 1/2 cup green seedless grape | 1/2 cup shredded dry bread flour | 12 lasagna noodles
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle pasta and cook for 9 to 11 minutes or until al dente.

title: Cheesy Strawberry Upside Down Phyllo Trios
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup sour cream | 1 cup mixed salad dressing | 1 cup shredded strawberries | 1 package frozen chopped strawberries, thawed and drained | 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Dissolve yeast in sour cream in a large bowl, then stir in the salad dressing until creamy. Stir in the 1 cup of shredded strawberries and the thawed thawed strawberries. Set aside. Lay out the phyllo dough on a flat surface. Cover each one with one sheet of the phyllo dough. Cover with more sheets of phyllo dough and continue layering the phyllo dough, working from side to side, until you have used up all the ingredients. Pile the thawed phyllo dough across the entire layered phyllo. Place all three sheets of phyllo into a large lightly greased baking sheet. Cover the sheets with a towel and let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 40 minutes. Remove and spread the remaining phyllo dough over the top. Return to the oven and bake until golden brown, 10 to 15 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,ginger garlic paste,mustard,russet potato,hot water,pork stew meat,ricotta cheese
title: Swiss Cheese Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes | 2 lbs lean pork stew meat, diced | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons mustard | 3 cups hot water | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Peel potatoes and separate the rinds into two halves. Cut a slit lengthwise into the side of each potato. In a non stick frying pan, brown pork on each side over med high heat until no longer pink. While browning, add a little bit of the sauce mixture into the pot and stir in ricotta, and dry mustard. Once it’s mixed well, remove pork from pan, and add garlic paste. Once the pork is browned, add the hot water. Return pork to pan and stir into ricotta mixture. Heat through. Once potatoes are done, transfer to a medium pot. Add swiss cheese, and stir till cheeses are melted. Fill the potato shells with meat and cheese mixture and close together with toothpicks. Goes well with a salad and crusty bread.

title: Lebanese Mashed Potatoes (Batata Bi Hout)
ingredients: 8 yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed and cut into 1/2 inch to 1/4 inch cubes | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the potatoes and boil until tender but still firm, about 15 minutes. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Add the vegetable oil to a large bowl. Using a fork, mash the potatoes until they are the consistency of mashed potatoes. Add mint and mix well. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Pigs in Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup chopped prosciutto | 2 cups packed dark molasses | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together prosciutto, molasses, and pastry sheets. Fold in prosciutto mixture. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or foil. Bake in the preheated oven until puffs and golden on top, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool to room temperature on a wire rack.

title: Pinchos
ingredients: 1 pound medium head garlic | 1 package biscuit | 1 1/2 cups chili oil for frying
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place garlic flat on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Leave the oven on. Wrap the bag of biscuits in a piece of cheese cloth and set in a bowl with 1 1/2 teaspoon of oil. Firmly press each biscuit ball, one piece at a time, into strips of bread crumbs. Return coated biscuit to the baking sheet. Repeat with remaining fingers. Heat the chili oil in a large skillet or fryer over medium high heat. Sear the biscuits on all sides until golden brown, about 3 minutes. Serve hot with your favorite dip.

title: Baked Scallops
ingredients: 2 golden delicious apples | 4 scallops
instructions: Core the scallops and prick with a fork to make sure the eyes and the meat are removed. Cook for 5 minutes then turn and cook for another 5 minutes or so until they are cooked through. Slice the scallops in half horizontally and scoop out the pulp, leaving about 1 cm of the flesh and just leaving a thick shell. Set the shells aside and serve with a little bit of crunchy bread to dip the shell in.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,mango chutney,jalapeno pepper,italian herb seasoning,sherry wine vinegar,wild rice,margarine
title: Wild Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups wild rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine | 4 tablespoons bertolli's italian herb seasoning or 4 tablespoons any celery and herb salad dressing | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar or 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon mango chutney, in jar | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 3 -4 teaspoons chopped jalapeno peppers, from the jar, chopped fresh seeds if you prefer
instructions: Cook wild rice in boiling water for 15 - 17 minutes or until almost done.

title: Schokolatka (Polish Chocolate Candy)
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 1/2 cups peppercorns, ground fine
instructions: Combine cocoa and peppercorns in a small bowl or plastic bag. Shake off any excess. Place bag in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cocoa mixture. Let mixture set about 4 hours. Use as directed in stifters or other decorative candies.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,cabbage,green chili,beef tenderloin,feta cheese,horseradish root,cake flour,onion soup mix
title: Baked Pork Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast | 1 package onion soup mix | 1/3 cup cake flour | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish root | 10 ounces beef tenderloin | 1/2 head cabbage, finely chopped | 1 can sweet green chili, chopped | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven in a dutch oven or large roasting pan, place pork roast on top of a rack and roast at 325 degrees fahrenheit for 1 1/2 hours or until internal temperature of meat registers at 170 degrees fahrenheit remove roast from pan, and let stand for 10 minutes. When it reaches thermometer remove meat from pan, skim fat remaining in pan and discard. Allow internal temperature of meat to reach 170 degrees fahrenheit before slicing. Cut pork roast into thin slices. To make gravy, whisk together cornstarch and a tablespoon of cold water in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add onion soup mix, mix and cook 3 minutes. Slowly stir cornstarch mixture into the pan, and cook 2 minutes more. Remove from heat, stir in horseradish root, and let cool for 5 minutes. Place cabbage in a large bowl. Add green chili, feta and remaining beef. Pour cabbage mixture over beef and pork, then gently fold in remaining cheese. Arrange sliced roast on top of mixture, and let stand for 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream heavy,rice,cardamom pod,deli roast beef,rice paper
title: Cardamom Roast Beef Roll-Ups
ingredients: 12 -15 sheets rice paper sheets, each approx 24 x 18 inches | 1/4 cup rice sticks ( about 12-15 slices ) | 1/2 cup uncooked regular rice ( about 15 slices ) | 3 cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 1 package deli roast beef, cut into thin diagonal slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Arrange 5 slices of the rice paper over the bottom of a 12x18 inch jellyroll pan or cake pan. Arrange 2 to 3 slices of beef over the top of the rice, then cover beef with rice sticks. In a medium size bowl, whisk together the remaining 5 rye meal ingredients, then drizzle over the top of the roast beef rolls, making sure to coat all surfaces. Bake until the mixture is golden brown and the beef is cooked through, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sausage,lime juice,plum tomato,greek yogurt,onion powder,garlic salt,cider vinegar
title: Tomato Chutney (Chia Chaak Kebabs)
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1 teaspoon minced garlic salt | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped seeded plum tomato | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Heat grill. Mix onion, garlic salt, bread crumbs, plum tomato, vinegar, lime juice, and onion powder together in a large bowl. Dredge each skewer in bread crumbs to coat. Grill for 5 to 8 minutes per side, depending on thickness. Serve with your favorite fruit and vegetable. Enjoy variation #1, substitute honey mustard dressing for the greek yogurt and sour cream for the sour cream.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, if desired ( i use red wine vinegar ) ( optional )
instructions: Place sun dried tomatoes in the bowl of a food processor, or process them according to the package directions. You may use a hand held mixer. Add vinegar, if using, if using, and process until pureed or combined well.

title: Peachy Peaches
ingredients: 4 peaches, peeled, pitted, chopped | 1 teaspoon flour | 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Arrange peaches in a 9x9 inch glass baking dish, cutting into small pieces as necessary. Combine flour and panko, then stir into chopped peaches with 2/3 cup water. Sprinkle mixture over peaches and let stand for 15 minutes. Bake at 425f for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350f and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until tops are browned and crust is puffed.

title: Cauliflower Saute
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower | 3 tablespoons white pepper, chopped
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, remove stems from cauliflower heads. Place cauliflower in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover, and steam 7 to 10 minutes or until tender.

title: Turmeric and Onion Spread
ingredients: 2 lbs small whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 large white onions ( or more depending on preference ) | 1/4 cup turmeric | coarse sea salt
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and place in a container with the salt. Let it chill and become thicker as the sour cream sits and gets softer. Serve cold.

title: Kelp Cocktail
ingredients: 5 ounces ice | 5 ounces white wine | 1 slice canned pineapple
instructions: Combine ice in a cocktail shaker. Add white wine. Shake or stir until ice is crushed.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,saffron,anchovy paste,prosciutto,onion soup mix,chicken meat,ice cube,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Grilled Chicken Provolone
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken meat | 1/2 ounce saffron | 1 1/2 tablespoons onion soup mix | 1/2 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons simple syrup, plus more for drizzling | 12 8 slices monterey jack pepper cheese or 12 slices emmenthaler cheese | 2 ounces crumbled prosciutto | ice cube
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine saffron, onion soup mix, anchovy paste, simple syrup and half the cheese, stir thoroughly. Reserve remaining cheese for garnish. Score a diamond pattern in the center of the chicken, and set aside. In another bowl, combine remaining cheese with prosciutto and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Brush lightly on both sides of the chicken meat. Close one end of diamond and pinch a groove in the center. Place chicken, breast side up, on grill rack that has been coated with nonstick spray, on grill. Close second end and close the other edge on the grill. Grill 15 - 20 minutes, basting every 5 - 7 minutes. Turn chicken over and brush on remaining butter, if desired. Close lid and cook 15 - 20 minutes longer, or until thermometer, inserted in thickest part, reaches 165 or top of chicken in thickest part. Cut chicken into slices using a medium, sharp knife, cutting to serve. To serve, spread the reserved cheese on the surface of the provolone.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,celery rib,kielbasa,soya sauce,stout beer,maraschino cherry
title: Crock Pot Beer and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, halved lengthwise and cut in half | 4 ounces mexican cheese, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 4 ounces stout beer | 1 1/2 tablespoons light soya sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons mexican blend cheese | 4 maraschino cherries, chopped to serve
instructions: In a 3 - 4 qt crock pot, combine the beer, soya sauce and mexican cheese and stir to combine. Stir in the halved kielbasa. Cover and cook on low heat 8 - 10 hours until the meat is very tender. Sprinkle the kellbasa with chopped cherry and serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,rice wine vinegar,seashell pasta,poppy seed
title: Cracked Wheat Cauliflower with Peanuts
ingredients: 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 medium heads cauliflower, trimmed | 1/2 cup poppy seeds | 1 1/2 pounds seashell pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook seashells' campari at a boil, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,limeade concentrate,rye bread,water chestnut,italian seasoning,aluminum foil,red pepper flake
title: Italian Steakhouse Bites
ingredients: 2 tablespoons water chestnuts, chopped and roasted | 1 tablespoon limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 tablespoon light red curry paste, thawed ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 4 slices rye bread ( preferably diagonally cut ) | aluminum foil
instructions: Combine water chestnuts, limeade concentrate, thawed curry paste, italian seasoning and red pepper flakes in a large bowl and season with salt. Add bread slices and coat all sides with liquid. Preheat grill or broiler to high. Place bread on a foil lined baking sheet and grill until puffed up and lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Serve on plates with desired garnish.

title: Easy Delicious Beef Skewers
ingredients: 4 rump steak | 1/2 cup feta cheese
instructions: Rinse the steak very well with hot water to release water. Cut into very long lengths of about 5 inches long and about 3/4 inch wide, or into 1 inch cubes. You can soak them in cold water, and then remove all the liquid before putting them in the crockpot. Turn the crockpot on low, and leave for about 7 hours. You can turn it on high the last hour or so to get rid of as much blood and/or juice and cook like normal. When you are ready to cook, rinse the steak and cut a slits into the meat about 1/4 inch wide and 1/2 inch deep, and put them into the crockpot. Sprinkle the feta over the meat, and stir. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours. When done, remove the meat to a platter. Use fork or spatula to pull the meat from the crockpot, and pull off any fat or undesirable pieces of meat that have run out onto the platter. Serve with boiled new potatoes and tomato slices, or as a vegetarian dish, or serve on it's own. Note, it is important to use a high quality meat product that doesn't need any fat added to your diet. The feta has salt in it and does not have enough salt to flavor the feta.

title: White Sweet Biscuits With Hot Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried hazelnuts | 1/3 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 4 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 3 tablespoons spiced dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: In a small bowl, add hazelnuts and mix into flour and cayenne. Sprinkle mascarpone on top, stir in sherry and molasses. Roll dough into balls the size of walnuts and transfer to parchment lined or lightly floured baking sheets. Bake in a 325° oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until light brown.

title: Fry Beans with Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dried cannellini beans | 2 tablespoons cooking oil ( can use canola or olive )
instructions: The idea is to let the beans soak overnight. The next day, heat the oil in a frying pan. Add the beans and stir well. It should still be a little dry. When the oil is hot, add the water to cover the beans completely. Cover the pan and keep over low heat until the beans have fully absorbed the water and a nice crust of brown. The cooking time is the same for salted tomatoes. The temperature of the oil should be about 300 degrees fahrenheit. The oil should not be higher. Serve with rice and other side dishes as desired.

title: Alcatra-Style Prosciutto Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup polenta | 3 ounces prosciutto, chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup apricot jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread the polenta out on a large sheet pan. Spread the prosciutto all around. Spread apricot jam all over the prosciutto. Bake until the polenta is slightly browned, about 25 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apple butter,egg wrap,red curry paste,thyme,red pepper flake,shallot,orange marmalade
title: Curried Apple Turnovers
ingredients: 2 medium shallots, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 8 large egg roll wraps | 1/4 cup orange marmalade ( store-bought is best ) | 1 tablespoon apple butter
instructions: Preheat a griddle or large frying pan over medium high heat. Combine the shallots, thyme, curry paste and red pepper in a bowl and mix well. Lay out a pastry sheet and evenly brush with oil. Lay the egg roll wraps out on a clean sheet of paper towels and dry them on paper towel for 1 hour. Cut a slit through one side of one of the wraps and spread a small amount of the shallots/thyme mixture down the center of each wrap. Sprinkle the outside with a small amount of the orange marmalade on the mixture. Roll up the wrap and pinch along the top to get a small seal. Tightly enclose the filling, pressing together the seams. Repeat this process with all the wrappers and make the extra rolls. Cook the rolls, one per person, for 2 to 3 minutes on the prepared griddle. Serve at once. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,stewing beef,baby portabella mushroom,jalapeno,mustard powder,pork,candle nut
title: Jerk Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef, cubed | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 1 ounce baby portabella mushrooms | 2 jalapenos | 1/8 cup mustard powder | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1/2 cup candle nuts
instructions: Cube stew beef, beef, and marinate for 30 minutes. Cut cleaned jalapenos in halves. Clean mushrooms, clean and remove stems from marinated beef. Mix mustard powder, garam masala and candlenuts, add beef cubes and mix well. Thread beef cubes and fruit into skewers. Cook on oil in a pan, turning regularly until browned.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,anise seed,vegetable oil cooking spray,tahini,cayenne pepper,vermicelli
title: Tunisian Harissa Fried Shrimp (Somali Bel Laban)
ingredients: 1 jar roasted vermicelli ( this can be found in health food stores, or you can substitute cooked small shrimp ) | tahini ( for frying ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/3 cup sesame tahini | 1 1/2 tablespoons anise seeds | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 lbs medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: In a food processor or blender, process the vermicelli until it resembles fine bread crumbs. Coat a large fry sheet or pan with cooking spray. Scatter the noodles onto the pan and cook over medium heat, using a spatula to turn them, until they are lightly browned and crisp, 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from the pan and set aside. Place the sesame tahini, aniseed, and cayenne in a blender or food processor and process until just smooth. Stir in 2 tablespoons of the hot oil and 1/2 tablespoon of the tahini paste. Add shrimp and puree until the shrimp are thoroughly coated.. Spoon the shrimp and sesame tahini sauce evenly over the fried vermicelli and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sole fillet,grand marnier,pesto sauce,purpose flour,tabasco sauce,oil
title: Roast Sole Fillets With Pesto and Grand Marnier
ingredients: 4 sole fillets | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons grated french grand marnier | oil, for frying
instructions: Place the flour, tabasco, and pesto in a small bowl, then stir in the grand marnier. Coat the sole with the paste, then coat generously with the flour mixture. Heat oil in a 4l deep frying pan over moderately high heat and sear the fillets for 3 - 4 minutes per side. Cook the fillet for 1 - 2 minutes per side or until cooked through. Serve hot, topped with the pesto sauce.

Random Ingredients: butter,shiitake mushroom,rotel,seasoning mix,baby bok choy,habanero pepper,meatball
title: Spicy Turkey Meatballs
ingredients: 20 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 5 baby bok choy | 2 pounds frozen cooked meatballs | 2 packages seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 habanero pepper, chopped | 1 package rotel
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Wrap one sleeve of aluminum foil around the top edge of the foil to keep the foil from touching the meat. Place the mushrooms and bok choy in a bowl of water, and set aside to cover. Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Place the meatballs on the prepared baking sheet, and gently toss to coat with seasoning mix. To transport, place the meatballs in a baking dish or roasting pan. Melt butter in a skillet on the stove over medium heat. Stir in the habanero pepper and cook until the habanero begins to brown, then stir in the rotel. Pour the hot pepper mixture over the meatballs, and toss to coat evenly.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,plum tomato,caster sugar,white wine vinegar
title: Drawn & Tomato
ingredients: 400 g plum tomatoes, seeded & chopped ( about 1 cup ) | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs, lightly toasted
instructions: Place the tomatoes and vinegar in a small pot over a medium heat. Lower the heat and simmer for about 15 - 20 minutes or until the tomatoes have collapsed and reduced. Remove from the heat, cover and sit to cool. Meanwhile, stir together the sugar and breadcrumbs. Put the cooled tomatoes into a blender or magic bullet and process with a few pinches of salt until you have a coarse meal. You can do this by hand also. Take the drained tomatoes and stir in the crumb mixture and mix well. Pour onto a tray, cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. The texture will change by the time the mixture is taken from the fridge time. To serve, gently scoop out the mixture and divide among serving plates. Garnish with a little more crumbs to serve.

title: Apple-Cilantro Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 sweet potato | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tart apple, peeled and sliced into thin wedges | 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Put sweet potato in a steamer over 1 inch of lightly salted boiling water. Cover, and steam until potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a bowl, toss onion soup mix and canola oil together. Stir in apple wedges. Cover, and steam until apple is tender, 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,green cardamom,dark brown sugar,heavy whipping cream
title: Pavlova With Artichokes and Fresh Artichoke Spoon
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 large jar whole artichoke hearts, drained well | 1/2 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon green cardamom
instructions: Pour cream into a medium size, heavy saucepan and bring to boil. Meanwhile, core the artichoke hearts and slice into quarters lengthwise. Slice hearts crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Add artichoke hearts, brown sugar, and cardamom to heated cream. Bring to boil again and then turn down to simmer. Stir for 30 minutes or until thickened slightly, then remove from heat and add the artichokes, stirring to coat with liquid. Cover and chill until serving time.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,cayenne pepper,coconut milk,milk,parmigiano reggiano cheese,green peppercorn,dijon mustard,italian dressing
title: Coconut Cheese Mousse
ingredients: 3/4 cup coconut milk | 1 cup evaporated milk | 1/2 cup light dijon mustard | 1/4 cup creamed coconut ( coco lopez ) | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons green peppercorns | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and whizz until smooth. Transfer to a bowl and cool for 1 hour. Stir to blend well. Cover and chill for 3 hours or overnight. Toss with toasted bread or crackers. Serve with fresh fruit, crackers or toasted rye bread.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,ouzo,kidney bean,ancho chile powder,rice,chili paste,rice wine vinegar,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Vegan Gazpacho with Beans and Cucumbers
ingredients: 1/3 cup ouzo ( can sub low sodium ) | 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar ( or use 1/3 normal vinegar ) | 1/3 cup plain nonfat yogurt, nonfat plain yogurt, low fat okay | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( can use more, to your taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon cucumber, seeded and chopped | 1 cup cooked kidney bean, drained | 4 cups cooked rice ( i use brown rice )
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together in a large bowl. Serve with rice. The flavors of the guajillo may help give an authentic feel to the dish.

title: Thick Vinegar
ingredients: 10 small fresh sage leaves or 2 tbsp dried savory | 4 drops angostura bitters
instructions: Wash sage leaves, then pat dry with kitchen paper if desired. Place in mortar with bitters and add water until the vinegar just covers the leaves. Let stand 1 - 2 hours to mellow the bitter. Strain and serve over ice.

title: Easy Raisin Cookies
ingredients: 6 tablespoons golden raisins | 3/4 teaspoon vanilla ( or extract )
instructions: Whip raisins and vanilla together until very light and fluffy. Form into balls with hands or with cookie cutters. Drop onto baking sheet.. Bake at 300 degrees until crisp and brown, about 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Slow Cooker Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs ( or 4 medium boneless skinless breasts ) | 1 can sliced corned beef stock | 1 container coconut, unsweetened shredded | 8 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 1 ounce unsweetened flaked coconut ( optional )
instructions: Place thighs and stock in crockpot. Cover and cook on low setting for 4 hours or high setting for 3 hours. Remove chicken from slow cooker. Reserve broth. Stir shredded coconut, swiss cheese and flaked coconut into the broth in crockpot. Cover and cook on high setting for 30 minutes or until cheese melts. Place chicken on platter and spoon the coconut sauce over the chicken. Serve with rice if desired.

title: Truffle
ingredients: 1/2 ounce kahlua | 2 ounces boiling water
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into mug.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,lamb chop,egg substitute,black olive,olive oil,green pea,horseradish
title: Lamb Chops With Horseradish
ingredients: 1 egg substitute, such as eggah's | 10 ounces canned sliced black olives | 1/2 cup fresh bread crumb | 2 tablespoons bottled grated horseradish | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 4 lamb chops | 1/2 cup frozen green pea ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix egg substitute, olives, bread crumbs, horseradish and olive oil. Coat chops with mixture.

Random Ingredients: rice,banana pepper,milk chocolate,red enchilada sauce,ladyfinger,savoy cabbage,chuck
title: Betsy's Hot Chocolate & Banana Soup
ingredients: 6 large hot banana peppers, sliced into strips | 12 sweet hungarian sweet hungarian peppers ( hungarian yellow peppers also known as `` hban '' ) | 8 -10 small outer leaves savoy cabbage, torn into small pieces ( or use other sweet potato and savoy cabbage ) | 1 box sweet plain rice ( not instant or fast cooking! ) | 6 cans red enchilada sauce ( brand is available ) | 2 lbs chuck | 1 container milk chocolate ( preferably not bittersweet or milk chocolate ) or ( 8 ounce ) container semisweet chocolate ( preferably not bittersweet or milk chocolate ) | 1 bag ladyfingers | 12 savoy cabbage, sliced into strips
instructions: Place peppers, cabbage, sweet potato and 1 can of enchilada sauce in an electric food processor and process until smooth. Set aside. Wash meat and cut into serving size pieces. Place meat in large stock pot, with enough water to cover, bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes. Simmer for 45 minutes. Remove meat and set aside and allow broth to reduce until about 1 - ½ cups broth remains. Meanwhile melt chocolate in a double boiler, stirring frequently and scraping with a spoon. Add enough of the simmering broth to cream the chocolate, and cook until the chocolate is smooth, about 5 minutes. Then whisk or blend the chocolate mixture back into the broth, add the remaining soup, season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until hot and thickened. To serve and to allow diners to add toppings, spoon some sweet potato and savoy cabbage leaves around edge of serving bowl. Top with the hot chocolate sauce and garnish with slices of avocado and/or nuts. Enjoy your healthy red hot chocolate soup.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,green pea,white sandwich bread,pesto sauce,poultry seasoning,pork fillet,tahini
title: Fried Pork Gyros
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry tahini | 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 1/2 lbs pork fillets, trimmed of fat, cut into thin strips | white sandwich bread, cut into 24 slices | 1/3 cup pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon green peas
instructions: In a small bowl, combine tahini, poultry seasoning and turmeric. Set aside. Put pork in a large skillet and cook over high heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Add enough water to skillet to reach halfway up the side of the pork. Cover tightly and cook over high heat to low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Uncover and continue to cook until the juices run clear and pork is tender when pierced with a knife and just cooked through, 5 to 10 more minutes until internal temperature reaches 155f. While pork is cooking, slice open sandwich bread and spread with pesto sauce. Top with meat.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,black bean,cumin seed,penne pasta,white breadcrumb,shortening,mint leaf,mint
title: Black Bean Penne With Mint Brown Butter
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 6 ounces white breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil or 1/2 cup butter | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder | 3/4 cup fresh white breadcrumb | 1 cup mint, finely chopped | fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine the 3/4 cup wholemeal bread crumbs, the 1/2 cup olive oil or 2 tablespoons melted butter, cumin, cocoa powder and 1/2 cup of the mint into a small bowl and stir well. Drain the beans and reserve liquid and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the 2 tablespoons mint and bread crumb mixture and stir until combined. Using a small spoon, lightly mix the bean mixture into the bread crumbs and mix until well combined. On a greased baking sheet, press the bean mixture into an 8 inch x 2 inch, 12 inch x 2 3/4 inch rectangle. Add the remaining 1 1/4 cups mint and bread crumb mixture on top of the bean mixture. Using a knife, cut the center from each shrimp on the horizontal side. Brush the knife and underside with the melted mint butter and place the shrimp side by side in the greased baking sheet. With a wide, long knife, score the top crust of the cheese covered pasta into 3/4 wide strips diagonally. Spread the cheese on the cheese covered pasta. Bake the pasta uncovered for 15 minutes or until the top is crisp and browned. Cool in the baking pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool. Serve at room temperature.

title: Homemade Pesto for Shrimp or Meat - Shrimp Creole
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach leaves, washed thoroughly | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Drain the spinach well. Place it in a bowl and sprinkle with oregano. Add cold water to taste. Cover, and leave a couple of hours at room temperature, stirring occasionally. Bring to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,flat leaf parsley,marjoram,salad oil
title: Fried Mozzarella and Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, cubed | 2 teaspoons salad oil | 1/8 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried flat leaf parsley
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the mozzarella with the warm marjoram, parsley and oil. Serve immediately.

title: Sour Cream Refreshers
ingredients: 4 red food coloring | 1 vanilla bean, seeds scraped
instructions: Whip the vanilla bean with the food coloring until the desired creamness. Add more or less vanilla bean seeds to your taste. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,herb,salmon,baby bok choy,orange liqueur,fig,pea,bicarbonate soda
title: Prawn and Fig Salad
ingredients: 500 g prawns, shelled | 50 g baby bok choy, julienned | 20 g peas, shelled | 50 g figs, skinned, stalks removed | 25 g orange liqueur, citrus | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/4 cup mild picante sauce | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon light cream or 1 tablespoon white vinegar
instructions: Place prawns, bok choy and peas in a large bowl with figs, orange liqueur and bicarb of soda. Add picante and stir to combine. Make a well in the centre and pour in prawn mixture. Toss gently to combine and season with salt and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, stir through mixed herbs. Serve salad with extra lime juice.

title: Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb meat ( or lamb chops ) | 2 tablespoons harissa | 1 pint olives, pitted and finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon of fresh mint, finely chopped
instructions: Place lamb or chops into a large bowl. Add harissa and mix well. Using a sharp knife or the blade of the knife, squeeze together the ingredients. Alternatively, use a sharp knife from the bowl, and stab lamb or chops with a fork to cut into chunks. Place beef or lamb chunks onto a tray lined with baking paper and spread evenly with the herb mixture. Turn to ensure all pieces are covered. Chill in the refrigerator to marinate for at least an hour. Heat a heavy based barbecue or barbecue pan over a medium high heat and cook the meat for 5 - 7 minutes each side, or until cooked to your liking. Serve as an 'emangna' relish. For those of you who don't like the taste of the marinade, you can store whole olives in a jar or jar with a cap or lid, filled with the cap, and refrigerated. The olives will keep in the fridge.

title: Italian Rice Salad With Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1 medium white onion | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/8 cup cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: Balsamic vinegar, balsamic vinegar and tomato paste can be adjusted to your tastebuds. I use a combination of vinegars. Serve as per your liking.

title: Quickie Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1 package fajita seasoning mix | 2 cups chicken broth | 1 jar diced pimiento | 1 ounce coffee | rocket
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the fajita seasoning and chicken broth with the pimento and coffee. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Bring to room temperature, and serve over fresh rocket.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,black eyed pea,extra virgin olive oil,red cabbage,egg yolk,head romaine lettuce,crescent dinner,cherry tomato
title: Black Eyed Pea and Cabbage Empanadas
ingredients: 1 container crescent dinner rolls | 1 cup shredded red cabbage | 1 can pitted black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 head romaine lettuce, rinsed and chilled thoroughly | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour, or as needed, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread the crescent dough out into a round on the baking sheet.

title: Smoked Salmon Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 1/4 lb smoked salmon | 1 green onion, finely chopped
instructions: Combine brandy and smoked salmon. Serve with green onions.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,pearl barley,chipotle chile adobo,hot dog,kiwi fruit,green onion
title: Quick Irish Sandwich
ingredients: 4 hot dogs | 1 tablespoon kiwi fruit or 1 tablespoon kerry fruit | 1 tablespoon kerry fruit, pared of pared of stem ( such as calabaza ) | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/4 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo | 2 -4 drops red-wine vinegar or 2 -4 drops red wine vinegar
instructions: In a food processor, puree and combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled.

Random Ingredients: jiffy cornbread mix,sage leaf,yellow squash,green pepper
title: Yummy Squash
ingredients: 2 3/4 lbs small yellow squash, halved if too narrow | 1 green pepper | 2 cups jiffy cornbread mix | 1/2 teaspoon sage leaves
instructions: Cut squash lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,pastry crust pie,grand marnier,tapioca flour,radish,almond paste
title: Pastry Tri-Colored with Radis or Almonds
ingredients: 9 inches pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie, thawed if frozen | 1/4 cup instant tapioca flour | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried tartar or 1 1/2 teaspoons anise, crushed | 2 tablespoons almond paste, blanched ( about 3 tablespoons ) | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Roll pastry into 2 inch circle, cut into 8 wedges, place on ungreased foil. Gently press wedges out of center of pastry. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Place 1/2 cup water, tapioca flour and chili powder in large bowl. Add crushed tartar and almond paste.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,plum tomato,lemon,mostaccioli pasta,icing sugar,apple cider vinegar
title: Mostaccioli a La Mimi's!
ingredients: 1 gallon plum tomato, cut in quarters | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons finely shredded lemons | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 8 ounces all-pour baking noodles, cooked al dente ( or spaghetti ) | 2 cups icing sugar
instructions: Place the tomatoes, icing sugar, lemon juice, bouillon granules, and 1 cup hot water in a large saucepan. Stir until the mixture is thick and syrupy. Add remaining water. Simmer vigorously for 1 minute. Stir until all of the water is absorbed, remove from the heat, and set aside to cool for at least 1 hour. Drain noodles and toss through the cooled syrup, allowing the noodles to absorb the flavors. Dust with icing sugar.

title: Spice Biscuits (For Baking)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups unsweetened cocoa | 12 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f or 190c. Combine the cocoa and pastry leaves in a small bowl, and stir in the cocoa mixture all at once. Spread the filling mixture onto the centre of the sheets of filo dough. Roll up the pastry like a jelly roll, then place on a baking tray. Poke each roll all over with a fork, and brush with beaten egg white. Bake for 10 mins, until golden and crisp, and then cool for 5 mins on a rack.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,allspice,white sugar,baking soda,chinese five spice powder,salmon fillet
title: Grilled Balsamic-Glazed Salmon
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon fillets | 4 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 4 teaspoons baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Rinse and drain fish filets. Sprinkle with three teaspoons of five spice powder, then toss to coat. Place salmon in an open 9x13 baking dish and rub in remaining five spice powder. Sprinkle salmon with sugar and balsamic vinegar. Cover and refrigerate for 4 to 24 hours. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,almond extract,italian parsley,romaine lettuce,snow pea,green bell pepper
title: Mexican Salad
ingredients: 1 package fresh or frozen green bell peppers, cut into 1 inch strips | 1 package frozen snow peas, thawed and unpeeled | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley | 1/2 cup chunky salsa, such as pace | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract |  romaine lettuce, about 2 cups
instructions: Cook bell peppers in boiling water for 30 - 60 seconds or until crisp tender. Drain and set aside to cool slightly. Meanwhile, combine snow peas, parsley, salsa and almond extract in medium bowl. Toss with chilled veggies. Just before serving, sprinkle with reserved green peppers and mix well.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,onion soup mix,vanilla sugar,corn oil,baby spinach leaf
title: Chickpea Pinto Bean Spread
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package onion soup mix ( not `` powdered '' ) | 2 packages baby spinach | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Place beans in a mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,yellow squash,pineapple juice,salsa,brown rice,sun tomato oil
title: Brown Rice Stuffed Squash
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons salsa | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 2 cups cooked brown rice- a 'quick'rice mix | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup fresh pineapple juice | 3 cups yellow squash, halved lengthwise cut in half horizontally
instructions: Cook and stir tomatoes in oil and salsa in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat about 2 minutes or until heated through, stirring occasionally. Add rice mix and cook 2 seconds. Remove from heat and stir in cheese and pineapple juice. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon mixture into the center of the squash halves and wrap each with foil. Place stuffed squash on a rack and bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven 40 minutes or until tender and golden. Place squash under broiler for 2 minutes on each side, or until hot all the way through. Transfer squash to a plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,toothpick,white vinegar,nam pla,cream cheese,gingerroot,taco meat,rabbit
title: Crispy Ginger Rabbit
ingredients: 14 ounces prepared taco meat, drained of any fat | 4 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup nam pla | 1/4 cup minced candied gingerroot | 2/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | toothpick | dried triticale toothpick
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pat evenly over rabbit. Place a toothpick through center of each piece of meat to secure. Wrap each rabbit in foil and place in a foil lined baking dish. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour, basting once halfway through cooking. You will need a toothpick for toothpick. Cool and remove toothpicks.

title: Simple Shiitake Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 lb raw shiitake mushroom, stems trimmed | 3 cups buttermilk
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a large saucepan and add enough water to cover them by ¼ inch. Bring to a boil and cook until they are tender, about 30 minutes. Drain and cool to room temperature. When they are cool, split open and stuff each mushroom with a generous dose of buttermilk. Warm a soup pot over medium heat just to get the moisture out of the mushrooms. Add the mushrooms and their broth to the broth, bringing to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,dill,plain flour,poblano pepper,farfalle pasta,pinto bean,wine,chicken
title: Cheesy  Poblano  Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 1 small poblano pepper | 150 g low-fat cream cheese, soften at room temperature | 250 g farfalle pasta, cooked per instructions on box, and mixed with a little wine ( or just plain white ) | 1 1/2 cups low fat chicken, shredded ( or use cooked rotisserie chicken ) | 3/4 cup low-fat sour cream | 1/2 cup fresh dill, chopped ( or more to taste ) | 1 can pinto beans, drained, rinsed, and rinsed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c. Halve and seed poblano pepper. Cut into half and remove the seeds. Cut the pepper in half and set halves aside. In a shallow oven proof dish, mix all the cheese together. Arrange the poblano halves on top of a layer of cheese and spice mixture. Dilute the sour cream with a small amount of wine and add to the sour cream mixture. Sprinkle the fresh dill over the casserole and bake for 30 - 40 minutes at 190°c, or until hot and bubbly. Taste and adjust seasonings. You may also do a béchamel sauce for this, if you wish along with a little fat free cream cheese, but you don't need to beat it all together.

Random Ingredients: beet,bouillon cube,green bell pepper,liquid smoke,italian seasoning,quinoa,seafood cocktail sauce,kaffir lime leaf
title: Easy Veggie Beef and Quinoa Stir-Fry  (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 2 cups zabaglione seaweed, rinsed and drained ( or other fine textured textured wild rice ) | 1 large green bell pepper, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs ground round ( or use half beef and half pork ) | 1 bouillon cube | 2 cups shrimp-nosed dried seafood cocktail sauce ( or other brandy ) | 1 can canned peeled beets, drained and finely shredded | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Slice the block of zabaglione into long, thin strips about 3 or 4 inches long and 2 to 3 inches long. If using dried shrimp and nosedles, rinse in cool water for 5 to 10 minutes prior to tossing, then drain and set aside in medium bowl. Place all ingredients together, and combine well. Prepare large skillet or wok with nonstick spray. Pour in contents of 1 bouillon cube, and heat on low until all ingredients are hot, 1 to 2 minutes or so. If it starts to smell like it might be too bland, add a little more bouillon. To serve, arrange zabaglione in a large, shallow dish, and pour beef and/or shrimp mixture over top.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,chili flake,parsnip,vegetable oil,orange juice concentrate,date,dijon mustard,potato starch
title: Crunchy Parsnip Fries
ingredients: 4 medium parsnips | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon orange juice concentrate | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon hazelnuts, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dates, finely chopped | vegetable oil ( for frying ) | 2 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: Peel and cut the parsnips in 2 inch pices and boil in lightly salted water for about 25 minutes until tender.

title: Finnish Oats
ingredients: 2 cups whole grains lentils | 1 package rolled oats ( not instant or quick )
instructions: Dissolve the oats and lentils in water and let it boil til soft. Add a little water if it becomes too thick. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sugar,brown sugar,asiago cheese,potato starch,artichoke heart,pasta sauce,veal
title: Artichoke Veal & Tomato
ingredients: 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons potato starch | 8 ounces extra thick pasta sauce ( your favorite brand ) | 12 ounces thin thinly sliced veal | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1 box frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 1 tablespoon asiago cheese, grated
instructions: In a large saucepan, mix brown sugar and potato starch. Cut veal into 1/4 inch thick pieces, and add to pan. Stir pasta sauce, artichoke hearts, and cheese with the brown sugar mixture until combined and thoroughly mixed. Do not drain pan juice before adding veal. Cover, and let cook on medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until well heated but not to darken. Serve over pasta.

Random Ingredients: gemelli pasta,beef chuck,brown sugar,tagliatelle pasta noodle,heavy whipping cream,italian tomato,cream cheese,ice cream
title: Beef Ragout With Gemelli
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed of fat | 6 ounces plain sun-dried tomatoes, rehydrated as needed and drained | 6 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup light brown sugar | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 4 ounces gemelli pasta noodles or 4 ounces linguine | 8 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles, broken in half | 2 cups ice cream, to serve
instructions: Cut chuck into 1/4 thick strips, breaking up chunks when stirred in with a fork. Set aside. Puree sun dried tomatoes with reserved oil, cream cheese, sugars, and cream until smooth. Cook half at a time, stirring occasioanlly, and stirring until it begins to thicken. Add beef, and allow to simmer and reduce till beef loses its redness. Add uncooked pasta and any remaining juices. Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes or till pasta is al dente and mixture is bubbly. Stir in cream and heat till it reduces slightly. Scoop 1 1/2 cups of hot pasta water, stirring until most of the pasta has cooked. Serve with additional pasta and warm cream.

Random Ingredients: lime,ice cube,cranberry juice,angel hair pasta,vanilla ice cream,chickpea flour,juniper berry,mirin
title: Quick and Easy Cranberry Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh cranberry juice | 2 2/3 tablespoons garam masala harina mixed spice ( mccormick or similar brand ) | 2 scoops vanilla ice cream, softened | 1 tablespoon fresh lime rind, grated | 2 tablespoons fresh mint, minced | 1 teaspoon fresh juniper berries, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons chickpea flour | ice cube | 1 lime, quartered
instructions: Whisk together cranberry juice, garam masala harina mix and ice cream in a small bowl. Stir in lime rind, mint, fresh juniper berries and chickpea flour. Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving. To serve, serve a cube of vanilla ice cream topped with cranberry ice cream and garnish with a slice of lime.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,swiss cheese,grape leaf,butter,grain white rice
title: Rice Stuffed Grape Leaves (Dairy Free Version)
ingredients: 1/3 cup butter, melted | 9 grape leaves | 1/2 cup water chestnuts, cut in half | 1/2 cup long-grain white rice, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place half of the grape leaves in the center of a large piece of wax paper and brush the bottom with melted butter. Remove from paper and set aside. Repeat with remaining leaves and grape leaves. Bring water and chestnuts to a boil in a microwave safe dish, and cook uncovered for 2 minutes, then remove and drain on paper towels. Reserve the water chestnuts. Spread 1/2 cup rice out in the bottom of one large baking sheet or 9x5x3 inch loaf pan, and arrange the stuffed grape leaves over the rice.
