Sprinkle with 1/2 cup swiss cheese and cover pan with a kitchen towel or two. Microwave on high for 8 minutes, or until swiss cheese melts and begins to turn golden on top. Remove from microwave and let stand 5 minutes, then cut into pieces. Place all of the cooked rice bowls on plates and add about 3/4 cup of the reserved water chestnut water. Top rice with the remaining cheese. Place a grape leaf on top of the cheese, place a piece of stuffed grape leaf on top, cut side up near the cheese and cheese, taking care not to dislodge cheese from edge. Cut a slit in the long side of the roll to form a pocket.

title: Summer Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 cucumbers, peeled, seeds removed | 5 tablespoons pecorino cheese, freshly grated | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 7 tablespoons virgin olive oil
instructions: Cut each cucumber in half lengthwise. Scoop out the seeds and white center, leaving stem intact. Cut cucumbers into 3/4 inch slices. Combine the cucumbers, cheese, chives, and the olive oil with 2 - 3 tablespoons water in medium bowl. Toss salad. Serve.

title: Ancho Chile Powder  (Ancho Chile)
ingredients: 1 ounce ancho chile powder, to taste | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon crushed ice
instructions: Mix all ingredients except ice in a non reactive bowl and put in ice.

title: Wild Mushroom and Salmon
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chili oil ( or to taste ) | 400 ml mixed wild mushrooms, finely chopped | 60 g palm sugar | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 4 salmon fillets
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium size saucepan or frying pan. Add the wild mushrooms and cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until softened. Stir in the palm sugar, parsley, and salmon and cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until done.

title: Danish Rice and Green Beans (Jook)
ingredients: 250 g short-grain white rice | 250 g french style green beans | 100 g smoked salmon, slices thin | 35 g flour | 35 g cocoa
instructions: Wash the green beans and cut them in broad lenghts. Fry the french style green beans in hot ghee for 1 minute, add flour, stir and fry for 2minutes. Add the rice and green beans, stir fry for 2minutes and sprinkle with cocoa powder. Serve immediately.

title: Aqua Verde (Greek Green Chile Sauce)
ingredients: 4 green chilies, small, seeds removed | 8 ounces ouzo | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: Place chiles in bowl of an electric blender. Sprinkle chiles with ouzo and blend on high speed until chile is finely chopped or chopped. Pour in rum and blend again for 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: avocado,seasoning salt,cauliflower,apple butter,tapioca,shiitake mushroom,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Low Fat Veggie Filled Avocados With Apple Butter
ingredients: 3 large ripe avocados ( peeled and cut lengthwise on the cutting board, avocado can be tricky if cut in half, if they are too thick, you can just use a large ) | salt | avocado | 3 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 2 teaspoons apple butter ( or margarine ) | 1/2 cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 cup low-fat plain nonfat yogurt ( or sour cream for vegan ) | seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f slice the avocados at a 45 degree angle and scoop out the stone inside with a spoon to save a wedge. Scoop out the center using a large spoon or a potato masher, then slice across the wedge like you would with a potato. Season to taste with salt. Cut off the stalks or any woody center of your cauliflower florets, then steam for about 1 minute, depending on size of cauliflower. Toss in the mushroom with your apple butter, and set aside. Boil 1 cup of water and the cauliflower for about two minutes, and then toss through the yogurt. When cauliflower and cauliflower are done, toss them through a sieve, let cool to room temperature, then remove the skin. Cut the avocados into wedges and place one in the middle of each serving plate. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the apple butter in the center of the plate, and gently fold in the florets. Drizzle with more apple butter or margarine, and top with chunks of apple butter, followed after the mashed cauliflower and cauliflower/lumps/florets. Enjoy notes, for vegan omit the apple butter and use a low fat sour cream.

title: Tres Leches
ingredients: 1 can coconut cream | 1 loaf unsliced breadcrumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread bread crumbs on a cookie sheet. Spread coconut cream on top, if desired. Spray with cooking spray. Spread on top layer of bread crumbs as evenly as possible. With a large knife, remove bread crumbs and cut off the crusts as you can, creating little cakes. Place between sheets of plastic wrap and press or roll until bread crumbs are covered with a layer of coconut cream. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Turn on grill. Bake on top shelf of oven for 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: My Big Fat Greek Style Fingerling Potatoes
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs fingerling potatoes | 1/2 cup basil leaves, chopped | 3/4 cup raisins | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves
instructions: Put fingerling potatoes into a large pot. Cover with water. Place over medium high heat. Bring to a boil, then turn down to simmer. Cook 10 minutes. Add more water as needed if potatoes feel dry, but not completely cooked. Drain and set aside to cool completely. When cool enough to touch, peel away any fibers about 3/4 from rinsed potatoes. Cut in half and place in a large bowl. Combine basil, raisins and thyme. Add a little cold water to raisin mixture to moisten. Gently stir in drained fingerling potatoes into potatoes. Let stand 1 - 2 hours in the refrigerator, making sure water tastes good. Serve cold.

title: Veal with Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons butter | 4 chicken legs, cut into pieces | 1 pound cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 egg whites
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large 9x13 inch baking dish, heat oil or butter. Add chicken pieces, coating well. Place in oven for 25 minutes. Add cauliflower, turning pieces over to coat with oil and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 20 minutes, or until slightly browned on the outside and soft. In a large bowl, pour just enough boiling water to cover the cauliflower. Dip chicken pieces into egg whites and place on top of cauliflower.

Random Ingredients: french mustard,grape leaf,cardamom powder,maraschino cherry,cocoa powder,thyme sprig,salmon
title: Grilled Mushroom With Cocoa-Stirred Mustard Glaze
ingredients: 1/4 lb fresh mushrooms or 1/4 lb shiitake mushrooms, cleaned | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 pinch of coarsely ground maraschino cherry | 1/4 teaspoon french mustard | 1/4 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: In a small bowl, add the cocoa, thyme, cocoa powder, maraschino cherry, mustard powder, and unsweetened cocoa. Mix well. Place the mushrooms and 1 tablespoon of the glaze in a small, shallow, heavy saucepan and heat gently over a medium flame until the mixture just begins to simmer, about 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from the flame and allow to cool slightly. When completely cool, transfer to a zip lock bag and add the rest of the glaze. Toss with cooked salmon. Grill the salmon for approximately 2 minutes, depending on the thickness of the salmon. Turn once and drizzle the reserved glaze over the salmon and sprinkle with the paprika. Serve at room temperature. To make an authentic maple flavoured glaze, combine 1 1/2 tablespoons of pure maple flavoured butter, 1/4 teaspoon of the cocoa powder and a pinch of cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,cauliflower,white wine vinegar,puff pastry,spring onion,pita bread,horseradish,wonton wrapper
title: Horseradish and Cauliflower Samosas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cauliflower, chopped | 1 1/4 cups sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 cup spring onion, finely chopped | 1/3 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1 package puff pastry sheets, thawed | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons horseradish, coarsely grated | 1 packet wonton wrappers, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/425°f. Combine cauliflower, cheese, onion, vinegar and horseradish in a large bowl, stir to combine. Roll each pastry wrapper between your palms to form a sausage shape, place on a tray and flatten to about 5mm thick. Spread half of the cauliflower mixture on each pastry wrapper. Brush tops of sasides with glaze. Wrap each samosa in a double thickness of foil and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake at 220c/425f for about 20 mins, or until golden. Remove from oven, stand 5 mins, cut into wedges and serve warm.

title: Pasta With Beef Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar pasta, of your choice | 6 lbs chicken wings | 2 yellow onions | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons instant beef bouillon powder
instructions: Rinse chicken wings and put in a large pot with water to cover. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 45 minutes. When cool enough, remove skin and bones and cut chicken wings into chunks. Rinse and cut onions into wedges. In a large pan fry the onion with the bouillon using a low heat but not high heat until the onion is clear but not browned. When the meat is all white, add the beef/onion mixture and cook for another 45 minutes. When cooked, strain out the fat and add the cooked pasta and chicken pieces. Toss well.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,broccoli floret,corn tortilla,italian turkey sausage,deli ham
title: Italian Turkey Sausage Wraps #A1
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian turkey sausage ( i use hot ) | 1 package corn tortillas, torn into long strips | 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed | 1 package deli ham, coarsely chopped | 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine turkey sausage and broccoli in a large dutch oven or other heavy skillet. Cover and cook over medium heat until meat is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Remove casing and stir in ham. Cook until heated through, stirring constantly. Spread 1/2 cup turkey mixture on one side of each tortilla strip and roll up. Sprinkle evenly with cheese. Microwave on high 30 seconds or until cheese is melted and roll is hot.

title: Sausage Toast
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons coarsely-chopped sausage ( your choice ) | 8 slices hearty white bread
instructions: In a large skillet cook the sausage over medium heat until browned about 7 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels about 1 minute. Serve with a salad and enjoy.

title: Indoor Lamb for 2
ingredients: 300 -400 g leg lamb shoulder ( about 32 pounds ) | 6 curry leaves
instructions: Trim all excess fat from lamb and cut into 5 to 6 to 6 to 6 inch squares. Place lamb into a non metal dish. Sprinkle each piece with curry leaves. Press them under the running water of a pressure cooker for 1 minute. You should see a film running down the side.

title: Tomato and Heirloom Appetizer Sauce for Vegetables
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 10 -12 heirloom tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Put all ingredients in food processor and process until smooth. This can take 2 - 4 hours and is usually the right consistency.

title: Chile Spices on Pasta
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds chile peppers | 2 cups heavy cream
instructions: Slit the top of each chile pepper lengthwise into 4 or 5 thin slices. Soak peppers in hot water for 20 minutes and then slip peppers out of water and peel. Place a tablespoon of the cream into each pepper and wrap the pepper around the cream to completely wrap. Secure each pepper in a cheesecloth bag. Bring a large pot of water to boil. In a large bowl, mix together 1 cup cream with the chile peppers and simmer on low heat for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Cook pasta according to package directions. Spoon sauteed vegetables over pasta, and serve.

title: Stout Beer - Beans and More!
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1/2 cup stout beer ( irish )
instructions: Mash the beans coarsely in a large bowl. Add the beer. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight if possible.

title: Jicama-Stuffed Jicama
ingredients: 5 -6 slices jicama, about 3/4 cm thick | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground coffee ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 1/2 - 2 cups hot beef or 1 1/2-2 cups vegetarian ground meat
instructions: Using a serrated knife, cut a lengthwise slit in each jicama about 1/4 inch deep. Fill each slit with 1/3 cup ground coffee and 1/2 tsp vanilla. Close slit with a toothpick. Heat heavy skillet over medium heat until hot, but not smoking. Dollop out about ¼ cup of mixtur onto the soaked jicama and sprinkle with additional sugar. Immediately place the entire stuffed jicama over the surface of the coffee. Add more coffee, 1 tsp sugar and 1 - ½ tsp vanilla if using.

title: Chinese Glass Noodle With Spinach (Sukiyama No Gee)
ingredients: 500 g fresh rigatoni pasta or 500 g prawn pasta | 50 g spinach | 1 -2 ounce szechuan peppercorns | 20 -25 spring onions | 1 red onion | 3/4 cup kimchi
instructions: Boil salted water in a pot. When it boils, add noodles and boil until tender. Cut spring onion into four pieces and cut kimchi into small pieces of varying length. When noodles are ready, add kimchi to boiling water and cook for about 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain pasta well and add to soup and stir to combine. Add kimchi and red onion to soup and heat through.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,corn,lard,corn syrup,black pepper,bell pepper,filling,pepper
title: Carnival Fried Pepper Rings
ingredients: 12 bell peppers | 6 medium corn or 3 medium yellow bell peppers | filling : | 1/4 cup chopped pepper ( from jar ) | 1/2 cup corn syrup | 1/2 cup lard ( or other shortening ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Wash peppers and remove the papery outer skin. Slice peppers in half lengthwise, core, removing seeds and membrane. In a large skillet, heat corn, lard or other shortening, pepper, corn syrup, lime leaf.

title: Mushroom & Squash Jelly for Valentine's Day!
ingredients: 1 kg yellow squash | 1 liter lemon juice or 1 liter white vinegar
instructions: Peel and cut the squash into half. Remove the seeds & stringy bit where the squash was just cut from. Mix the squash & 1 litre of lemon juice together in a saucepan & heat over low heat, stirring occasionally. Do not let the liquid boil at this stage, but leave the lemon juice & squash juices to boil out during the boiling process. Remove from the heat when the mixture has cooled, skim off any fat that rises to the surface if the jelly starts to curdle. Pour the jelly into jars & seal as per your usual method. Note ~the jelly will keep, refrigerated, for up to 3 weeks at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: thyme,red beet,shortcrust pastry,chili sauce,cocoa powder,mexican tomato
title: Chili and Chocolate Pizza Strips
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen shortcrust pastry | 2 red beets | 1 cup chili sauce or 1 cup chipotle chili sauce | 120 g sweet mexican tomato, chopped | 60 g unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 teaspoon thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Line baking tray with baking paper. Slice beet in half lengthways and slice each half into 3/4 pieces. Spread sweet chili sauce over beet slices. Place on baking tray, sprinkle with mexican tomatoes and cocoa powder and bake for 15 minutes oruntil heated through, stir through. Line a 24 hole pizza tin with pastry and bake for 10 minutes or until golden and cooked. Cut into 16 squares and serve either warm or cold with dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,provolone cheese,green chilies,cumin powder,cornbread stuffing mix
title: Brothy Southwest Penne
ingredients: 1 cup cornbread stuffing mix | 1 lb penne pasta | 1/8 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained | 1 cup lowfat provolone cheese, shredded
instructions: Cook penne pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Combine stuffing mix with water and cumin and set aside. Spray a 1 1/2 quart casserole with cooking spray and press penne into mixture so it is 3/4 inch thick. Cut cheese into strips and arrange around the pasta. Pour cornbread stuffing mix over the cheese and cover with the cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,chili pepper flake,tarragon,heavy whipping cream,white sugar
title: Red Curry Sauce II
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 pinch dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Stir curry paste, sugar, tarragon, and tarragon together in a saucepan over low heat until sugar is dissolved, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Classic Welsh Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 pie crust ( the one from the pie crust will do ) | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 8 ounces fontina cheese ( grated )
instructions: In a pie plate place the pie crusts, sprinkle with fontina cheese and grated fontina cheese. Place the lid on top and bake in a hot oven for 30 - 40 minutes until golden.

title: Grilled Chicken With Sweet Basil
ingredients: 4 small boneless skinless chicken breasts | 30 basil leaves | 1 lime | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Wash and pat dry the chicken. Cut away and discard all fat from the inside of the cavity. Cut the chicken in half lengthwise and place on a piece of foil. In a food processor or blender put all the other ingredients as listed except the basil leaves and puree till smooth. Put the basil leaves into a bowl and pour in the sweet basil puree. Wrap the chicken tightly in the foil and marinate in the refrigrator for 4 hours. To cook, put the chicken on a grill pan and cook about 5 minutes per side or till done to your liking. Serve with rice or noodles. Or let it rest and serve it warm on top of salad.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,topping,part mozzarella cheese,chili paste,sage,limeade concentrate,taco seasoning mix
title: Easy Baked Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 can frozen yogurt-free refilling spread, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons mild chili paste with mushrooms ( such as mrs. dash ) | 1 tablespoon bottled juice concentrate | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons low-fat dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Grease an 8 inch square by 2 inch glass baking dish. Using a small spoon, scoop out excess dough from one of the containers and set aside. Place 2 tablespoons of the mozzarella cheese into the dish. Spread with 1/3 cup of the yogurt free refilling spread on the cheese. Set aside 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture for topping. Spoon chili paste into a small bowl, add remaining mixture. Spread a third of the cheese mixture on top of the chili paste, then spread with a third of the remaining yogurt mix, chile paste, juice concentrate, turmeric, and sage. Repeat dipping the dish 3 times, until dish is full. Sprinkle remaining mozzarella cheese on top. Bake uncovered for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lemonade concentrate,creamy butter,bay leaf,monterey jack pepper cheese,pimiento,amaretto,pistachio,chili oil
title: Mexican Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy butter, melted | 1/2 cup pimiento, chopped | 1 can sweetened condensed milk | 1 can almond juice concentrate | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese or 1 1/2 cups pepper jack cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion ( or 1 fresh minced onion ) | 2 drops hot chili oil | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Stir together the melted butter and the pimento. Add remaining ingredients except cheese. Stir thoroughly. Cover and chill for 30 minutes or longer. Spread cheese mixture evenly on the bread. Top with sliced almonds or fresh parsley if using.

title: Feta Cheese Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 medium tomatoes | 1 package feta cheese | 2 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Cut up fresh tomatoes and put in a bowl with feta cheese. Add tomatoes and let stand for 15 - 30 minutes. Toss to combine. Toss in the blueberries last.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,garlic powder,gouda cheese,lemon pepper,almond,black olive,hamburger bun
title: Mexican Cheese Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger buns or 1 lb hamburger bun, sliced | 1 1/3 cups shredded gouda cheese | 1/4 cup sliced black olives | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa or 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1/8 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon almonds, sliced ( optional )
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine lettuce, cheese, olives, salsa or taco sauce, cheese, olives, lemon pepper and garlic powder. Grill hamburger over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted and cheese is browned. Divide meat and lettuce mixture among hamburger halves, top with sliced almonds.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,bok choy,half,taco sauce,lentil,seasoning salt
title: Lentil Cilantro Pate
ingredients: 1 can lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 bunch bok choy or 1 bunch scallion, chopped into 1/4 inch pieces, white part only | 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked bok choy | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 2 tablespoons light cream or 2 tablespoons half-and-half with 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons finely grated lime zest
instructions: Stir lentils in a bowl with 1/4 cup of the cooked bok choy. Set aside. Steam bok choy until just tender, 1 - 2 minutes, then drain in a colander. Chop remaining bok choy stalks into 1/4 inch pieces. Combine bok choy mixture with lentils.

title: Frijoles (Fry Beans)
ingredients: 5 cans white beans | 2 cans low-sodium vegetable soup | 12 ounces pimentos, sliced | 1 beer
instructions: Drain beans from can, and place in a deep pot. Add beer. Simmer on low heat stirring often, about an hour. To serve, place in crockpot. Serve with grated cheese on top, garnish with lettuce, tomato, fresh olives. May be served with hot salsa, sour cream and chips, etc.

title: Riggies
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons tapioca
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Nasturtium (Vermouth Mint Punch)
ingredients: 12 sprigs or 8 sprigs fresh mint | 2 1/2 ounces sweet vermouth, chilled
instructions: Pour vermouth into 4 heatproof glasses. Add mint and serve immediately. Nasturtium will keep for up to 1 week in the fridge.

title: Ancho Fruit Shake
ingredients: 100 ml apple juice | 2 star anise | 2 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Pour 100ml of apple juice onto a flat surface. Place the star anise onto a pestle and mortar. Crush the star anise lightly as you do. Place the two star anise sticks onto you ice block. Spread on 50g of crushed ice. Place in the freezer over a cold shower. Allow to sit for 20 minutes then shake vigorously until the ice blocks soften, about 5 minutes. Remove the ice from the ice, put it in the freezer and allow to harden.

title: Nashi Dango
ingredients: 12 drops green chili | 2 -3 dashes white pepper
instructions: Cut the chillies and the pepper with a sharp knife. You may have to leave the seeds, if you like them. In a shaker, take the chillies and pepper and put the seeds and pepper in, add a drop of white pepper and stir. Take a small glass bowl with a lid and put the lid. Put the bowl in them two more drops of white pepper and continue shaking the shaker from time to time for a moment. Take it out of the shaker. Put the bowl back in the shaker and again shake several times. The color of the color will change and you will start seeing the color of the bowl. This is important take the jar and put it back in the refrigerator. The color will change, it will make the dango less yellow and bitter after a few hours' shaking. When it has returned color to the right color, use a teaspoon and use the juice/spice mixture to make sure you get the right color. When it is used up, it is kept in the fridge in a decorative jar.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,vanilla extract,rice wine,kalamata olive,arbol chile,asafoetida powder
title: Ww 3 Points - Caribbean Flavored Spicy Grilled Pork
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork or 1/2 lb lean pork | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1/4 cup unseasoned rice wine ( or mirin ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder ( a mild-flavored msg powder ) | 20 pitted kalamata olives or 20 other black olives ( 1-2 pcs. olive oil may be used instead )
instructions: For meat mixture and sauce, in a large bowl, stir together meat, ketchup, rice wine, vanilla & asafoetida. Transfer to airtight containers or resealable bags & refrigerate overnight. Dried olives may be added to pork mixture at the end of the grilling. Drain off all liquid during grilling process. Note, this recipe can be prepared a day ahead, refrigerated and reheated later. For an added touch, brush on a dry or toasted bbq grill grate after grilling, or toast under the grill, before turning, as if you were making a traditional bbq sauce on the barbecue. Ww 3 points for each serving, 2 points for each of 3 meats.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,hot red pepper flake,salt,spaghetti,garlic,grape,asiago cheese,brown sugar
title: Capellini--Italian Stuffed Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 8 small asiago cheese ( about 1/2 inch each ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( i use seasoned salt ) | 1 pinch brown sugar | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/8 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | hot cooked spaghetti ( i use whole wheat spaghetti ) | lemon slices ( optional ) or other favorite pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut asiago in half across the stem. Remove seeds by running knife under side of asiago. Remove flesh from shells, then cut the shells in half crosswise. You should have 8 - 8 halves total. Remove shells from bowl, leaving a 1/2 inch space all around. Using the back of a teaspoon, separate tops and bottoms of the 8 halves. With a small spoon, mix together salt, sugar, garlic, celery salt, and red pepper flakes. Stuff each half with 1 tablespoon of stuffing and place in a baking dish. Drizzle each stuffed pepper with an equal amount of lemon. Bake 20 minutes and serve. This can be served as an appetizer, or served as an accompaniment for main dish. The stuffed peppers can also be prepared the same way.

title: Lazy Rice Krispies Snack
ingredients: 1/2 cup crisp rice cereal | 2 cups cold water
instructions: Microwave cereal, water and rice mix for 2 minutes. Take cereal w/water and roll mixture into ball to shape balls that will hold in the freezer. Place on wax paper lined cookie sheet, or on a platter. Cool to room temperature. To store, place in closed container. When cooled, freeze any remaining balls.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,ginger paste,vegetable stock,linguine,garlic clove,mascarpone cheese,veal,liquid honey
title: Linguine With Veggies
ingredients: 400 g linguine | 1 small head of cabbage, shredded | 1 large veal or 1 large onion, diced | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 3 garlic cloves | 125 g mascarpone cheese | 2 tablespoons liquid honey
instructions: Boil your pasta according to the instructions on your packet. Meanwhile heat some oil and fry the onion until a nice brown colour. Put in a bowl with most of the cabbage and veal, fry gently for 5 minutes. Throw in the ginger and blend inches stir in the stock and garlic. Reduce heat and fry for about 25 minutes add the mascarpone cheese and simmer until creamy. Add a pinch of sugar or honey, mix, then add your pasta. Eat it up.

title: Cherry Tomato Vinaigrette for Sushi
ingredients: 15 cherry tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: In a large, shallow dish or bowl, stir together the cherry tomatoes, sugar, and rice vinegar, making sure the sugar dissolves. Sprinkle with oregano. Stir in the cherry tomatoes just before serving.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,herb,wine vinegar,lettuce,sumac,baking soda,pie crust,thai fish sauce
title: Fried Herby Herby Bites (Sauce)
ingredients: 1 pie crust | 2 cups marshmallows or 2 cups pecans | 1/2 teaspoon honey | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 2 -4 drops fresh herb | 200 g good wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon thai fish sauce
instructions: In a small food processor finely crush the marshmallows or pecans, honey, honey, spices and vinegar, vinegar and baking soda together, until well mixed and fine. Stir in fish sauce. Spread mixture in the pastry shell, leaving 1cm at the top and leaving a 1cm rim around the edge all around. Sprinkle any leftover mixture over the top. Bake in a moderate oven for 10 - 12 mins until golden brown, cool, cut into squares and serve warm or cold with fish or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: ice cream,italian seasoning,mustard powder,hummus,red bell pepper,cumin,basil
title: Mediterranean Spread for Fish & Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 cup hummus | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil ( divided ) | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red bell pepper ( diced ) | 1 cup shredded ice cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill in the fridge until ready to serve. Top with remaining chedder cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,lemon zest,shallot,cardamom pod,adobo sauce,chicken breast,saffron thread
title: Easy Ricey Lemon-Zest Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, rinsed and drained | 1 chicken breast, cut into chunks | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread ( more or less to your taste and quantity accordingly ) | 2 shallots, sliced thin | 2 -3 tablespoons adobo sauce, extra | 1 -2 garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon lemon, zest of
instructions: Place chicken in a large skillet with a drizzle of oil, a pinch of saffron, shallots and a dash of adobo sauce. Cook over medium high heat for 5 - 7 minutes, stirring frequently. Add garlic, then cook an additional 5 - 6 minutes. Add lemon zest and saute for another 5 - 7 minutes, then remove from heat. You may need to add additional oil during cooking if too thick. Stir and serve over brown rice. Enjoy.

title: Meyer's  Vegan Chocolate Baked Pita Chips
ingredients: 1 cup mirin ( good quality ) | 1 cup dark chocolate | 1/4 cup vegetable oil ( good quality ) | 2 tablespoons thyme | 6 pita bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Combine the mirin, dark choco, vegetable oil and thyme in a large bowl, set aside in the fridge. Wash and dry the pita bread. Cut into 3 cm squares. Dip each square into the melted chocolate followed by placing on an un greased tray. Bake until the squares are golden brown and crisp, and crisp to your taste.

title: Green Olive Gelato
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups buttermilk | 1 cup pitted green olives ( about 6 olives ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Pour buttermilk into a medium baking dish. Add green olives and cook in a 325f oven, stirring occasionally, until the green olives darken, about 8 minutes. Stir in the vanilla and pour into an ice cream maker. Scoop into a plastic tub or small bowl and freeze for up to 2 weeks, stirring often when completely frozen. To serve, transfer to a bowl.

title: Baked Chilli & Chilli
ingredients: 1 kg pork, jointed | 2 cans hot jalapeno chiles, sliced finely | 1 cup caster sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/fan 160c/gas place pork meat in ovenproof dish. Drain chillies and jalapeños into a separate bowl, pour over sugar and mix well. Spoon over meat. Bake at 200c/fan 160c/gas for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until juices run clear.

title: Homemade Root Beer
ingredients: 3/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 2 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons mild molasses | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice
instructions: Blend everything together, refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,cream,catsup,dill weed,liquid smoke,green bell pepper,self raising flour
title: Smoky Chipotle Pepper Steak
ingredients: 500 g self-raising flour | 1 green bell pepper, sliced ( or a combination ) | 2 teaspoons catsup | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile, from a canned chipotle chile in adobo | 3 drops liquid smoke | 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 teaspoons dried dill weed
instructions: Sift flour in a bowl then mix in pepper, catsup, chipotle chile and liquid smoke. Mix until well blended and add sour cream. Roll the mixture into small patties and fry gently. Serve on paper towels, with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,watercress,gelatin,oat,celery seed,coriander,red kidney bean,horseradish sauce
title: Hot Sausage Pops With Herbed Broth
ingredients: 1/4 cup gluten-free watercress, chopped | 3 teaspoons horseradish sauce | 1 tablespoon coriander, chopped | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 4 hot italian sausages, casings removed ( links if you wish ) | 2 packets fresh gelatin, soaked in | 2/3 cup boiling water
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Put grated gluten free watercress, horseradish, coriander, celery seed, and kidney beans into a medium saucepan and simmer on low. Scoop out casings and discard. Cut sausage into 1/4 strips. Pour gelatin over boiling water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain sausage mixture through a fine sieve. Scoop out warm gelatine/water into a clean saucepan. Heat over low medium heat until gelatine has dissolved and stir constantly. Add gelatin mixture to pan and reheat. Stir until gelatine is smooth. Arrange sausage on the platter. Pour warm broth over and around sausage. Garnish with shredded coriander and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,penne pasta,ice water,asafoetida powder,green enchilada sauce
title: Pasta Con Chile Cheese
ingredients: 1 package dry penne pasta | 3 cups ice water | 1 cup pure green enchilada sauce | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: In a medium pot, pour in the ice water. When it starts to begin to sizzle a bit, add the enchilada sauce and green chilies. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 more minutes. When the time is up, pour the cold pasta into a large bowl. Using the paddle of your hand, mix the pasta until it becomes a smooth and even color. Pour the pasta into the bowl with the cheese sauce. Add salt, pepper, and cayenne pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,bamboo skewer,cranberry,aluminum foil,clove,fish sauce,orange juice,ladyfinger
title: Cranberry and Orange Sticks (Food Network Magazine)
ingredients: 2 cups dried cranberries | 3/4 cup orange juice | 5 whole cloves | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 lbs cake flour, sifted ( or all-purpose flour ) | 8 -18 ladyfingers | aluminum foil or vegetable oil ( for frying ) | crushed dried fruit or fresh fruit, as desired ( optional )
instructions: Combine cranberries, orange juice, and cloves in small bowl. Stir in fish sauce. Set aside. Sift flour into a large bowl. Make a well in the center of the flour and quickly pull in cranberry mixture. Knead dough with hands until it forms a doughy ball. Wrap in foil or plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 20 minutes. Prepare skewers, cutting off any excess dough and adding a little more flour as needed. Dip lady fingers into orange juice/louis glaze and then into dry flour. Transfer onto a lightly floured board. Roll out to about 1/4 thick and cut into strips approximately 3 in length.. Arrange on a lightly floured tray. Cover, refrigerate, and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Cook fruit, in a frying pan or deep fat fryer, fry sticks until lightly brown. Serve with crushed dried fruit or fresh fruit for dipping.

title: Catalan-Style Red Cabbage and Apple Rice
ingredients: 1/2 medium-large red cabbage ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 tart apple, unpeeled, cored, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 cup arborio rice ( about 4 cups uncooked arborio rice ) | 1 can tomato puree or ( 14 ounce ) can basil-garlic soup cans ( 14 1/2 ounce )
instructions: If using fresh tomatoes, cut crosswise into 8 wedges. Bring medium saucepan of water to a boil. Add cabbage.

title: Mung Bean Candy
ingredients: 12 mung beans | 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons rum | 1 small habanero pepper
instructions: Clean mung beans. Place in a pot with some water and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Drain. Place the mung beans in a bowl. Add onion and rum, stir till mixed. Add the pepper, mix well. Grease a 8x8 pan. Line with wax paper and pour mixture on paper, bake in the oven at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Allow to cool completely. Slice and eat as for chips.

title: Spanish Baked Ziti With Broccoli & Olives
ingredients: 500 g ziti pasta or 500 g penne | 2 bunches broccoli, washed, trimmed, trimmed and cut into florets | 200 g green olives, pitted | 75 g roasted ssambo peppers ( or you can substitute crushed pepper flakes ) | 100 g roasted sansho peppers, chopped ( or you can substitute crushed pepper flakes ) | 1/4 cup caster sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Place the pasta in a large roasting pan, add just enough water to cover and cook for 15 minutes or until just tender and al dente. Meanwhile, boil the broccoli for a few minutes, or until just tender, then drain and cut into small florets. Drain the pasta through a fine sieve, return to the pan and gently toss with the broccoli, olives, pepper flakes and sugar. Bake for about 25 minutes, until heated through and golden and the pasta is warmed through. Remove from the oven, scatter with black pepper flakes and serve with extra grated parmesan if desired.

title: Yummy Semolina Snacks
ingredients: 1 cup fine semolina | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1 cup grated grana padano or 1 cup grated semolina | 1 serrano peppers or 2 jalapeno peppers, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups candied fruit choc chips | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Grease and flour a baking sheet. In a dry saucepan, toast the semolina over medium heat, stirring with a wooden spoon until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Add the mint, grated cheese, choc chips and hot pepper, to taste. Stir to mix well, then transfer into a piping bag. Place the snails on a greased baking sheet and bake the snails for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the bottoms begin to darken slightly. Remove from the oven, peel off the foil and cool for at least 20 minutes. Serve them on a roll.

title: Pickled Poanuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet peanuts, shelled | 3/4 cup hot mustard | 1 large jalapeno, seeded, minced
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place peanuts on a large, shallow baking pan so they are just 1 from the head of the peanuts, and broil, turning occasionally, until the outsides are a rich brown, about 10 minutes. Let cool. Dry the peanuts on a clean sheet pan, and spread on hot mustard. Add a few jalapenos, and sprinkle with salt. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Grilled Chili Peppers
ingredients: 4 chilies ( green bell peppers ) | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat grill or broiler. If using fresh chili peppers, wash, dry and slit open on the stem end. Brush with cooking oil and grill or broil until blackened, about 5 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: white flour,salmon steak,beetroot,heavy whipping cream,brown rice,sage leaf
title: Brown and Salmon Steamed in Cream Sauce (Ramserrah) Welsh
ingredients: 1 kg salmon steak | 1 cup white flour | 1 1/2 cups brown rice, uncooked | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 4 fresh sage leaves | 8 beetroots ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degree c, or 160 degrees f with fan assistance. Spread the salmon pieces, with about 5 tablespoons of white flour, onto a lightly floured work surface. Spread out to about 3cm thick, and then using 1/2 of the rice, roll each piece into a sausage shape, using the flour to lightly dust the salmon, and then using 2 tablespoons of heavy whipping cream to lightly coat each salmon, roll the salmon up firmly and place into a lightly greased ovenproof dish. Add the 2 sage leaves to the cream. Place the pan on a low shelf and cook for a couple of hours, until the salmon is just cooked. Remove from the oven and allow to rest for 5 minutes before cutting into slices. Serve the salmon, warm and slightly covered with foil, and the warm cream sauce. Cooks note. The salmon steamed in cream sauce can be frozen without the cream sauce, and will need to be warmed, refrigerated, and reheated before serving. The salmon steamed with cream sauce can be frozen and reheated, covered, and reheated before serving.

title: Duck and Tomato Filo Pie
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry ( purchased by the health food store. ) | 1 cup canned canned whole cherry tomatoes | 1/2 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1/4 lb cooked duck, cut into slices
instructions: Spray a large casserole dish with non stick cooking spray. Place half of the phyllo sheets in the casserole dish and top with half the canned tomatoes. Pour duck slices onto tomatoes. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used. Sprinkle top with remaining phyllo sheets and cut a few slits in top of the pie and bake in a 400 degree oven for about 20 minutes until phyllo is golden.

title: Rabo D'aille (Roast Beef and Pork)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon pepper, divided | steak | leftover pork fat ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, to taste
instructions: Place flour in bowl, season well with pepper. Cut off tip of fat and discard. Rinse meat. Cut into 1/2 inch meat cubes. Heat skillet over medium high. Add oil, about 2 - 3 inches deep and heat it until very hot but not smoking. Add meat, a few pieces at a time, and quickly sear quickly, brown on all sides. Drain on paper towels. Add vinegar, cooking liquid and some seasoning. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer, turning frequently, 20 - 25 minutes or until meat tender. Serve with cooked noodles.

title: Brats
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces italian stewed tomatoes, undrained | 2 pounds ground bratwurst
instructions: Heat the stewed tomatoes in a skillet over medium high heat until well blended and heated through, about 5 minutes. Place the ground bratwurst in a large skillet, and cook and stir until evenly brown. Pour the stewed tomatoes into a slow cooker, and pour in enough water to cover. Cover, and cook on low 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Remove the cover, and cook for 3 to 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: passion fruit pulp,beef stew meat,baby potato,hot red chili pepper,quinoa,cheez whiz,italian sausage
title: Quinoa Stuffed Hot Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1/3 cup dry quinoa, rinsed | 2 tablespoons cheez whiz | 2 lbs beef stew meat | 2 hot red chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 5 garlic cloves, minced | 1 lb mild italian sausage, casings removed and crumbled | 8 medium baby potatoes, halved lengthwise and quartered
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. In a medium bowl, combine the quinoa, cheese, stew meat, peppers, garlic and sausage. Carefully combine the ingredients. On a greased baking sheet, pour in the mixture. Bake for 40 minutes, stirring the stuffed peppers every 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Gizzards
ingredients: 1 pound linguine | 10 pounds chicken gizzards | 2 cans diced tomatoes with juice | 7 spring onions, chopped | 1 pound squash, sliced | 1 can black beans | 2 1/2 fluid ounces kahlua | 1/2 cup chopped fresh spring onions or 1/2 cup scallions
instructions: Prepare and cook linguine as directed on package. While the pasta is cooking, put gizzards through a meat grinder. Combine the tomatoes and gizzards. Remove gizzards with a slotted spoon and place them in a bowl with the black beans. Mash together in a bowl with kahlua. Arrange cooked gizzards in a 13x9 inch baking dish. Top with tomato and gizzards. Sprinkle with onion and any additional green onion.

Random Ingredients: chili without bean,chicory lettuce,strawberry jam,vanilla extract
title: Chicory-Melt Salad Dressing - Microwaveable
ingredients: 7 ounces chicory lettuce | 6 tablespoons strawberry jam | 2 tablespoons vanilla extract | chili without beans
instructions: Put all ingredients into bowl cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or longer until desired consistency is achieved.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,soy sauce,mozzarella cheese,heavy whipping cream
title: Seattle-Style Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 3 pounds salmon fillet
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. In a small bowl, mix the mozzarella cheese and cream. Place salmon fillets in the prepared baking dish. Top with the cheese mixture. Bake in preheated oven until hot and bubbly, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Gluten-Free Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup sour mix | 1 teaspoon stevia, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pour about 1 teaspoon of dough onto a flour tortilla. Roll tortilla into a roll, and place on a baking sheet. Spray the pan with nonstick cooking spray and set aside. Place the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of dough on the baking sheet. Use a fork to poke holes in the dough all over. Sprinkle with baking soda. Bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes, or until risen, and golden brown. Remove from heat, and spread sour mix over the tortillas. Roll tortillas up on a clean, dry towel. Allow to cool. Cut each rolled tortilla into 12 slices.

title: Tomato & Yoghurt Kabobs
ingredients: 2 tomatoes, ripe, peeled and diced | 1 green pepper, minced | 2 teaspoons half-and-half | 2 teaspoons yoghurt | 1 skewer
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cover. Thread onto skewers and grill or broil until tender and lightly browned. Serve over chunky fries.

Random Ingredients: sargento mexican cheese,yogurt,garam masala,cilantro leaf,apricot preserve,rising yeast,salsa,green bean
title: Green Beans with Yogurt and Apricot-Cheese Filling
ingredients: 1/4 ounce quick-rise yeast | 4 cups green beans, trimmed, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch-wide strips | 1 1/4 cups plain fat-free yogurt | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 cup salsa | 10 slices deli-style sargento shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 3 tablespoons cilantro leaves ( from about 3 small bunches )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f spray a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Sprinkle yeast over 1/4 cup of cold water in a small saucepan. Cover and set aside until bubbly and starting to foam, about 5 minutes. Place green beans in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade. Cover and blend until very smooth without browning. Add yogurt and garam masala and process until smooth, about 10 seconds. Scrape down the bowl as needed and slowly stir in salsa. Scrape mixture into the pan and spread evenly. Cover and set aside at room temperature until bubbly, about 1 hour. Bake, covered, in the middlepooof oven 25 minutes. Mix together cheese and preserves and spread over top. Return to the oven, cover and bake 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and edges of filling are bubbly. Garnish with cilantro.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,plain flour,onion powder,onion soup mix,pecorino romano cheese
title: Crock-Pot Chile Con Queso (Cheese Bread)
ingredients: 6 ounces plain flour | 1 ounce dried onion soup mix | 6 ounces chopped green chilies | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 ounce grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together to form a soft dough. Roll dough into a disc and cut into 8 even pieces.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,curry powder,feta cheese,cream chicken soup,garlic,white chocolate,butternut squash
title: Roasted Squash Casserole
ingredients: 3 butternut squash - peeled, seeded and cubed | 1 clove garlic, chopped | 1 package fresh crumbled white chocolate | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup irish cream | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 4 ounces sliced white chocolate | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Prepare squash in a slow cooker, or steam in a microwave until tender, about 15 minutes. Pour squash, garlic, 1 package of white chocolate, cream of chicken soup, irish cream, curry powder, and 1/2 of the crumbled white chocolate into a 2 quart baking dish and mix thoroughly. Sprinkle with 3 ounces of sliced white chocolate. Top with remaining white chocolate. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, until top is browned.

title: Zucchini With Burgundy
ingredients: 6 -7 medium zucchini | 1 medium vidalia onion | 1 small vidalia onion | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups burgundy wine | 4 -6 small slices kielbasa ( optional )
instructions: Remove the zucchini, reserving the peel for another use. Slice the zucchini longwise. Cut the onion in 2 pieces. Put into a roasting pan with the sliced zucchini on the bottom of the pan. Set up the grill/grill, making sure you let it burn on the bottom. If using kielbasa, slice it crosswise in 3 to 4 lengthwise slices then slice into 2 wide strips. Combine the vinegar, wine, and onion and pour over the zucchini. Toss well and cover. Cook for 15 minutes. Remove from grill or grill, uncover and let cool completely. Toss again and serve.

Random Ingredients: egg,creole seasoning,green olive,icing sugar,plain yogurt,asparagus,vegetable broth
title: Irish Asparagus and Omelette
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh asparagus, ends trimmed | 1/4 cup low sodium vegetable broth or 1/4 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 3 -6 green olives or 3 -6 black olives, chopped | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt or 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Wash and snap asparagus into 1 inch pieces. In a medium pot, combine the broth and egg. Cook over medium heat for about 2 minutes, until egg is set. Add the chopped, chopped olives or black olives, asparagus and creole seasoning. Cook until the asparagus just starts to curl, about 3 minutes while stirring it frequently. Remove from the heat. Serve asparagus topped with yogurt sauce.

Random Ingredients: flour,coriander seed,celery leaf,lemon juice,pea,cajun seasoning,cheddar cheese
title: Cheese Salad
ingredients: 4 cups grated cheddar cheese ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 2 cups peas, cooked | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander seeds, crushed | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 teaspoon celery leaves | 3 tablespoons flour
instructions: Toss together the cheese, peas, lemon juice, coriander, cajun seasoning, celery and flour. Chill several hours to develop its flavour.

title: Easy, Low Fat Meal Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 cup green onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cups yogurt, lowfat is good | 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Brown hamburger and bell pepper in a skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes, breaking into larger pieces if necessary. Drain excess fat. Stir in beans, garlic and yogurt. Sprinkle with dill and bake at 350f for 20 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Italian Cheese Cigars
ingredients: 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 3 eggs, slightly beaten | 3 teaspoons dried herb, or more to taste | 3/4 teaspoon italian herb seasoning, or more to taste | 3/4 teaspoon hot sauce, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lay thawed pastry sheets on a baking sheet. Brush two sheets of phyllo dough with beaten egg.

title: Gefilte a la Kronenhalle
ingredients: 12 small white onions, peeled | 750 ml fresh pork fat ( or more ) ( optional ) or 750 ml vegetable fat ( or more ) | 12 large prunes
instructions: Peel and cut each onion into 4 - 5 pieces and cut them into halves. Place in a large heavy bottomed pot with a lid, cover and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer slowly until it is completely dried. If your prunes are very large, you may now wish to boil them for a few minutes until soft and plump. Remove the onion and set aside. Bring the pot to the boil and skim off any scum that rises to the surface. Place the pork fat in the pan and heat through. Turn off the heat. When the fat is quite warm, add the prunes. Cover the pot and leave to infuse for 40 minutes. The prunes will start to swell if left unattended, remove from heat and serve.

title: Mussels Brochettini(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 2 cups small shell pasta ( rigate or gemelli ) | 6 cups water chestnuts, roughly chopped ( canned or fresh ) | 1/2 cup stuffed green olive | 8 ounces grape juice | 4 -6 cups mixed greens ( spinach, swiss chard, tarragon, red lentil ) | 1 -3 teaspoon dried basil | 3/4 cup uncooked small smoked muscatel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees°f. In a large casserole dish, combine 1 cups water chestnuts, olives, sliced green olives, grape juice and herbs. Drain the pasta in a colander. Place the 3/4 cup greens over the greens mixture. Scatter smoked muscasson over the top. Top with remaining greens. Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes until hot and bubbly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,salt,parmesan cheese,chestnut mushroom,dark sesame oil,dark raisin
title: Mushroom and Raisin Pilaff
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock | 225 g chestnut mushrooms | 25 g dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons dark raisins | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | salt
instructions: Combine stock and chestnut mushrooms in a large saucepan. Stir over low heat until stock and chestnut mushrooms are warmed through. Heat the sesame oil in a frying pan, add the raisins and cook a few minutes. Add this mixture to the pot as well as the parmesan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer, loosely covered for 15 - 20 minutes, until tender and thick. Transfer to bowls and serve.

title: Mango Chutney With Chillies, Black Olives and Chillies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1 red chilies, deseeded and chopped or 1 green chilies, deseeded and chopped | 300 g sliced black olives | 1/4 teaspoon mace
instructions: Place mango chutney in a heavy based saucepan with chillies and the remaining ingredients. Cook over medium heat for 8 - 10 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly. Spoon mixture onto plates and serve with other indian flat breads.

title: Tomato-Chili Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 jar tomato paste | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Spray cooking spray into a saucepan, add tomato paste, and bring to a boil. Boil rapidly until thickened, about 5 minutes.

title: Pickled Beets
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped raw beets | 1/3 cup chopped green pepper | 2 tablespoons hot peppers, chopped | 1 cup broth
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes or until beets are tender.

title: Grpa® Italian Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 white onion, coarsley chopped | 12 slices sourdough bread, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Mix the onion in a medium bowl with the bread. Spread the onion mixture on the slices of bread. Sprinkle each slice with salt. Cut and serve.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,noodle,rice vinegar,chili pepper flake,cantaloupe,chili pepper,roast beef
title: Cantaloupe With Beef - Oamc
ingredients: 1 large cantaloupe | 3 pieces roast beef | salt and pepper | chili oil | hot chili pepper | chili oil | steamed noodles
instructions: Preparation, wash melonger, cut into bite size pieces. In a medium bowl put the melonger then put the beef then salt and pepper to taste then drizzle with hot chili oil and set aside. Preparing vegetables, put small amount of oil or chinese mustard oil in wok add celeste lengthwise then toss. Add thinly sliced roast beef then toss.

Random Ingredients: double cream,biscotti,picante sauce,cornmeal,garam masala,chili sauce,baking soda
title: Sweet and Savory Baked Spicy Biscotti
ingredients: 2 cups light biscotti | 1 can sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 2 1/4 teaspoons garam masala | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 3 cups light cream or 3 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine 1 c of the light cream with the jar of sweet chili sauce and 1/2 tsp garam masala. Grate garlic and add to mixture. Add remaining 1 1/2 c of light cream or whipping cream to the mixture. Mix well, and set aside. In a separate bowl, combine remaining 1 1/4 c light cream with baking soda. Set aside. Mix the biscotti and flour until evenly mixed. Spray a 10 x 14 inch glass baking dish with pam or a nonstick cooking spray. Spoon ½ cup of the biscotti mixture in to the baking dish. Use a spatula to distribute the cream evenly. Using your fingers, press the biscotti into a thin layer to cover the cream. Repeat with remaining biscotti mixture and cream until all of the biscotti are used. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 60 - 90 minutes. During the last 5 minutes of the baking time, remove the cover and bake for another 45 - 60 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,fish sauce,creamy peanut butter,monterey jack cheese,orange peel
title: Quick Orange Rice
ingredients: 1 cup plain long grain rice | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 3 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons grated orange peel | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cook rice in 1 tablespoon of the fish sauce in a rice cooker over medium low heat for 18 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,scallion,rosemary,vegetable juice,green cardamom pod,salt black pepper
title: Spicy Indian Vodka (Mchuzi)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons vegetable juice | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 scallions, trimmed and thinly sliced
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a large saucepan and over mid heat until the vodka comes to a simmer. Turn the fire down until the vodka simmers, and simmer for 1 minute. Transfer the vodka to a clean container, cover and refrigerate until needed. When ready to serve, re heat to bring the vodka to room temperature. Serve in a small decorative bowl or rimmed glass with mint sprigs.

Random Ingredients: lobster tail,red potato,extra virgin olive oil,yellow squash,orange
title: Lobster, Squash and Orange Potato Salad
ingredients: 12 small red potatoes, halved | 2 large yellow squash, halved | 1 orange | 1 lobster tail, with shell | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place the potatoes, yellow squash and orange into a bowl, making sure each piece has a tail. Cut the tail into pieces and rub them with olive oil. Place on a griddle or grill, turn once and press down a couple of times. Cook over low heat stirring with a wide metal spatula for about 10 minutes until golden. Place onto another plate while you cook the pasta. Turn the grill down to medium high and leave the vegetables to sweat and warm up. Dice the lobster and place into a bowl. Toss the potato and orange together and season with salt and pepper. Remove the bowl from the grill, take one spoonful of the mixture and place in the centre of a plate. Top it with the lobster. Sprinkle with more oil and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,beef broth,balsamic vinegar,self raising flour
title: Easy Beef Gravy
ingredients: 375 g beef broth | 125 g self raising flour, sifted | 1 beef bouillon cube | 250 g balsamic vinegar
instructions: Pour the broth into a jug and add the oxo. Cover and leave for 3 hours. Use to baste meat.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,hazelnut,chipotle powder,ricotta cheese,orange extract,farfalle pasta,tabasco pepper sauce,ahi tuna steak
title: Italian Ahi Tuna with Hazelnut Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon ahi tuna steaks | 2 tuna steaks | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, toasted | 2 tablespoons ground chipotle powder | 2 teaspoons hazelnuts, finely ground | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 teaspoon chipotle powder | 2 teaspoons orange extract | 1 dash tabasco hot pepper sauce
instructions: Rinse hazelnuts under running water.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,apple juice,white wine,chinese vegetable,chicken bouillon cube,coconut milk,vegetable
title: Chinese Coconut Pork With Chicken
ingredients: 8 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 cups chicken bouillon cubes | 3/4 cup apple juice | 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 2 cups mixed vegetables | 1/3 cup dry white wine | 3/4 cup fresh shredded coconut ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine chicken broth, bouillon cube and apple juice in a large frying pan. Add pork and turn to coat all sides. Cook 5 minutes. Remove to a crockpot set aside. Combine white wine and 3/4 cup coconut milk and heat on low. Add to the crock pot. Cook on low heat 4 hours. Preheat oven to place pork and roasted vegetables in a casserole dish. Add remaining coconut milk and cook until tender. Place pork and vegetables in a larger casserole and cook 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Pork and Swordfish Steak with Crackling Aromatic Platz
ingredients: 1/4 lb pork fat or 1/4 lb clarified butter | 1 lb swordfish steak or 1 lb other steak
instructions: Cut the steak into 6 equal pieces. Cut the fat diagonally into 1 inch wide pieces. Melt the remaining butter in a heavy skillet over high heat. Add the fish and fry it quickly in the hot oil, turning the pieces over several times for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the skin is crisp and transparent. Remove the fish, and drain it on paper towels. Stir fry the meat over high heat until lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes. If necessary, return the fish to the skillet, drizzle with more of the butter. Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of the fat and cook the bread in the skillet for about 5 minutes, or until lightly browned. Turn the fish over, sprinkle with additional butter, and heat over moderate heat for about 30 seconds, or until the fat is melted. Serve the fish over the tzatziki.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,graham cracker crumb,curd cottage cheese,angel hair pasta,philadelphia cream cheese,corn chip,alfredo sauce,baking powder
title: Creamy White Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons dry corn chips | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese | 1 package dry small curd cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh red chilies, toasted and sliced, to taste | 1 jarred alfredo sauce | 1 package angel hair pasta
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs, corn chips, cream cheese, cottage cheese and baking powder. Mix well. Spread 1 1/2 cups of the alfredo sauce to within 3/4 of the edges on all sides of the white chili noodles. Spread half of the spaghetti over each white chili noodle, then top with half of the cream cheese mixture. Repeat layers and sprinkle with chile slices and remaining swiss cheese. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve with additional swiss cheese and reserved sauce.

title: Chinese Style Fried Eggplant
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 3/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Slice eggplant vertically into 3/8 thick slices. Soak eggplant slices in cold water for 10 minutes. Drain eggplant slices on paper towels. Heat wok and add the dark sesame oil and garlic salt. When sesame oil is bubbling, add coated slices. Stir frequently until eggplant are nicely colored. Add bbq sauce and reduce heat. Add the eggplant slices. Cook, covered, on high heat for 7 to 9 minutes until eggplant is tender and crisp.

title: Sour Cream Pots
ingredients: 300 g double cream | 3 slices morton lite salt
instructions: Pour double cream through a fine sieve into a large saucepan, and set over a low heat. Add a pinch of salt, and slowly whisk in the flour. Cook over a medium heat, whisking, for 3 - 4 minutes, or until thickened and a knife begins to pierce several times. Remove from heat. Spoon cream into six small bowls, and place a slice of cheese on top of each. Warn your guests in the microwave for 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted and set. Dust guests with the desired amount of morton croutons. Leave to cool while eating.

title: Simple Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 1 lb beef short ribs | 1/2 cup pearl onion, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pod | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place short ribs in a baking dish. Combine finely chopped onion, cardamom pod and allspice.

title: Glazed New Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary leaves | 2 eggs, lightly beaten
instructions: Trim skin from chicken. Place chicken, rosemary and eggs in large oven proof casserole dish to lightly oil over top and set dish to high. Cook in a hot oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Saffron-Lentils (Shalgam Masala)
ingredients: 2 cups green onions, thinly sliced | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon saffron ( ras el hanout )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let stand 20 minutes. Shape into desired shape, garnish with green onion slices.

title: Tarragon Crusted Beef Tenderloin Sandwich
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin | 2 cans whole italian-style peeled parsnips, drained | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 loaf ciabatta
instructions: Rinse the filets, and trim the fat from the meat. Cut the meat into 3 thin slices, about 2 inches wide. Spread a layer of tarragon on one side of each slice of beef, then a layer of parsnips, tarragon side up. Arrange on a plate with a plastic lid. Sprinkle with balsamic vinegar. Sprinkle with cardamom. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat the broiler. Remove plastic wrap and cut the bread on the diagonal about 2 to 3 inches wide. Arrange on a baking sheet with foil on the rim of the oven. Set the oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Place the sandwiches on a baking sheet and place under the broiler. Broil until meat is rare throughout, about 3 minutes on each side. Let stand 1 minutes, then slice. Serve hot.

title: Simple Cuban Feijoada Beans
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans, canned | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Combine all ingredients into pot and stir. Simmer over low heat for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Soybean Spread
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 tablespoon light soybean oil | 4 cups colby cheese, grated | 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: Whisk egg white until soft peaks form. Add marjoram, soybean oil and cheese and mix well. Transfer to a bowl, cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Spread on flatbread, toast, crackers or spread on toast.

title: Ethiopian Hot Dog Recipe
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into two-inch chunks ( if using a whole chicken, just chop it up into three-inch chunks or shred it with 2 forks ) | 2 large sweet red habanero peppers, stemmed, seeded and minced or 2 medium jalapeno peppers, stemmed, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | salt & pepper | 1 teaspoon dried mint ( optional )
instructions: Place a large pot or dutch oven over medium high heat. Add flour and toss to mix. Add the chicken and chiles. Stir to coat with the flour. Saute, stirring, until the chicken has browned, 7 to 10 minutes. Lower heat to medium, add the whole wheat flour, and stir vigorously until a sticky paste has formed, 2 to 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook, stirring once, until the mixture is thickened, 2 to 3 minutes more. Remove from the heat and stir in the mint.

title: Spiced Creamy Sausages - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 cup plain soymilk | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 6 thick cut sausages | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray a casserole dish with nonstick spray. In a large bowl, combine the soy milk, olive oil and mustard powder. Arrange sausagas in the dish, turning once, then pour sauce mixture over them. Sprinkle pine nuts over the top. Bake covered in the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until golden brown and cheese inside is soft and slightly crisped. Meanwhile, when the meat mixture is almost done, stir in sour cream. Serve immediately.

title: Kielbasa With Hazelnuts and Orange Peel
ingredients: 2 lbs kielbasa, cut into 2 `` lengthwise slices | 1 cup hazelnuts, toasted, coarsely crushed | 8 teaspoons orange peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a small skillet, toast the hazelnuts on the top side of a gas stove or on a foil lined baking sheet until lightly colored and fragrant, about 10 minutes. Spread hazelnuts on a cookie sheet and toast briefly, stirring frequently, in the oven, until fragrant, about 1/2 minute. Move pan from heat. Place kielbasa slices on the cookie sheet. Sprinkle hazelnuts on kielbasa. Place in oven and cook for 40 minutes, basting periodically with pan drippings and turning and rearranging the pieces. The kielbasa will be darkest green and dry. If the hazelnuts are not very fragrant, toast them in a dry skillet over low heat, turning and stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,graham cracker crumb,baby carrot,broccoli,almond milk,sage leaf
title: Mushroom Cheese Ball in a Bowl for One
ingredients: 4 cups almond milk | 12 ounces white mushrooms, sliced ( any variety ) | 10 ounces baby carrots | 2 cups fresh broccoli | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | 8 fresh sage leaves or 1/2 teaspoon sage | 4 -6 fresh sage leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine almond milk, mushrooms, carrots, broccoli, and cracker crumbs. Add sage leaves or sage or sage powder. Mix until combined. Form into 1 ball. Place on a plate. Garnish with chopped sage.

title: Lebanese Golden Raisins With Pecorino and Romano
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs golden raisins | 1 3/8 - 2 1/2 ounces pecorino romano cheese, with enough shaved pecorino to cover the raisins | 1 1/2 - 1 3/4 lbs romano cheese, shaved with a spiral slicer
instructions: Wash and drain the raisins in a fine mesh strainer over a pot of hot water. Transfer the drained raisins to a large bowl, add a few spoonfuls of pecorino romano, and stir to combine. The cheese mixture will foam slightly, but as soon as the cheese mixture starts to solidify, it will gather itself in one compact clump. Divide the cheese mixture between two parchment paper lined coffee cupcake liners. Working fast to compress, press the loaves against one side of each cupcake liner to form a loaf 1/2 inch thick. Cover the loaves loosely with waxed paper, and refrigerate the loaves for at least 3 hours or overnight. Bring the oven temperature to 400°f. Transfer the loaves to a rack in a roasting pan. Roast in the middle of the oven for about 20 minutes, or until the loaves have a golden/brown crust. Turn off the oven, and leave the loaves inside to keep warm. Serve the loaves, cut sides up with shaved pecorino on the side. Note, the cheeses can be made a couple of days in advance, and covered in the refrigerator. The cheese should be quite soft and slightly soft when you remove it from the refrigerator. To reheat, place in a medium oven, and bake until the rusks are golden about 2 1/2 to 3 minutes. Remove the loaves and drizzle them with a little melted, clean melted ghee or olive oil, while still warm, as desired. Variation, the cheese can be eaten in this way when it has been allowed to cool. The flavor sinks in gradually, and the cheese begins to become very smooth after about 40 to 50 minutes, so keep an eye on the cheese, because the melting cheese may quickly turn into a paste. The oil can also be added, or added to taste. A small quantity of pepper can also be added, before being processed.

title: Chickpepper Saute
ingredients: 2 hot peppers | 4 -6 cups fresh spinach leaves, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Put hot peppers into a dry skillet over medium heat. Turn the heat to low and just barely toast the tops of the peppers. Remove the peppers and cool slightly. Slit and seed the peppers. They will be easy to clean up. Add to the skillet. Wash and tear the leaves off the stems and add to the skillet. Simmer for about an hour, or until the spinach is wilted. Taste for salt, add more if necessary. Add more pepper if needed.

title: Green Beans & Soy Milk for Two
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh green beans | 1 1/2 cups soymilk
instructions: Steam beans in a steamer basket over boiling water over high heat for 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain. In a large saucepan, heat soy milk and warm over moderately low heat until hot but not boiling. Stir into beans. Add green beans and cook, stirring, until beans are tender about 4 minutes.

title: Portuguese Pork Rolls
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup brewed coffee | tomatoes | sour cream or mayonnaise | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar ( optional )
instructions: Score the fat on both sides of pork. Slice open and lay flat. Place in a shallow dish. Mix together coffee, and pour over the pork, turning to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Meanwhile, cook pork in a large skillet over medium heat until lightly browned and cooked through, about 20 minutes on each side. If desired, serve with tomato and sour cream, and garnish with a little chopped fresh parsley.

title: Artichoke and Kiwi Salsa
ingredients: 1 kiwi fruit ( i used two small ) or 1 zucchini ( i used two small ) | 1 teaspoon dried fruit, dried plums ( recommended -- jaffrey pina colada ) | 12 small artichoke bottoms, halved ( i didn't add the pits ) | 24 pitted kalamata olives, halved ( recommended -- kalamata olives )
instructions: Cut kiwifruit into chunks. Remove membrane and seeds from artichokes and put halved artichoke bottoms in a large bowl. Juice 2 tablespoons of the kiwifruit juice and add to the kiwifruit and artichoke mixture, working together with your hands. Toss everything together and chill for at least 2 hours or up to 3 hours. Serve with tortilla chips, if desired.

title: Crunchy Peanut Butter Crunch
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups dry italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup corn flakes, crushed
instructions: Mix dry bread crumbs and peanut butter until crumbly. Press into a greased 9 x 12 inch pan. Spread on top of peanut butter crust, tilting edges to seal. Topping, melt corn flakes in microwave or over low heat. Sprinkle over crust. Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes, until bubbling and golden.

title: Chicken with Beets
ingredients: 1 small japanese eggplant, cut in half lengthwise and cut widthwise into 2 or 3 pieces each ( about 5oz ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons vegan butter | 2 tablespoons vegan butter | 1 lb vegetarian chicken, cut into thin strips ( or use 2lb raw shrimp ) | 1 teaspoon ground guajillo chilies or 1 teaspoon fresh ground black peppercorns | 2 fresh japanese dried hot flat anchovies or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle chiles ( more or less to suit heat level of chiles )
instructions: Combine eggplant and vegetable oil in a baking dish and brush with the oil. Bake at 400 f for 20 minutes. Heat a small heavy skillet over medium heat and sauté the tofu for 5 - 10 minutes or until they soften. Heat remaining oil in another heavy skillet. When oil begins to shimmer, add chicken and peppers and sauté for 2 minutes, or until chicken is opaque. Drain excess fat. Add chicken mixture, guajillo or black peppercorns and cook until heated through and chicken is heated through. Serve chicken with flat anchovies or chiles.

title: Bean Sprouts with Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup dried bamboo shoot, soaked in warm water for 10 minutes - drained | 3 ounces fresh mint, cleaned and coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 5 -6 sprigs fresh rosemary leaves | peanut oil ( for frying ) | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups broth, heated
instructions: Soak the bamboo with 2 cups of cold water in warm water for 1 hour.

title: Fish Salad
ingredients: 3 small fish, cleaned and filleted ( salmon, halibut, cod or snapper ) | 3/4 lb firm tofu, cut into 1/3-inch cubes | 1/3 cup ketjap manis ( sweet rice sauce ) | 3/4 cup fish, fish | 1/4 cup dry brandy | 5 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried fennel | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes
instructions: Place the fish in a bowl. Cut the tofu into small pieces and mix it with the tofu, ketjap manis, fish, brandy, vinegar, fennel, and caraway seeds. Let set at room temperature for 20 minutes. Serve this dish with a bowl of rice.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,self raising flour,sherry,anaheim chilies,rump roast,cumin powder,yellow onion
title: Shredded Beef and Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 kg rump roast | 1 cup chopped bell pepper ( use yellow-pepper if available ) | 1 cup chopped yellow onion | 2 dried anaheim chilies | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon sherry | 1/3 cup self-raising flour, and | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour, for dusting
instructions: Cut the meat into very small cubes and place in a saucepan with the onions, red bell peppers, anaheim chilies and cumin, and just enough water to cover. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes until the meat is tender and well cooked. Allow to cool slightly. Drain the meat and reserve 3 cups of the cooking liquid. Mince the meat and return to the pan, adding the sherry and enough of the reserved liquid to just cover. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for a further 15 to 20 minutes until thickened and the meat is tender. Remove the meat from the pan and place in a bowl. To serve, dust the meat with the flour and toss it in the pan for a few minutes or until coated with the flour and browned.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,dill leaf,lettuce leaf,lemon juice,monterey jack cheese,bay leaf
title: The Queen's Salad
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour, approximately | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried minced lemon juice | 2 bay leaves | 2 cups shredded lettuce leaves | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Put the flour into a mixing bowl. Stir in dill, lemon juice, and bay leaves, mixing to make a smooth dough. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside to rest for 5 minutes. Stir in the lettuce and cheese until evenly mixed. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times until smooth.

Random Ingredients: methi leaf,pepper,chinese cabbage,nonstick cooking spray,coleslaw mix
title: Chinese Coleslaw Mix
ingredients: 6 cups coleslaw mix | 1 lb coleslaw mix, sliced ( fresh or frozen ) | 10 ounces coleslaw mix, thinly sliced | pepper | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Lightly brush a nonstick skillet with oil, about 1/2 teaspoon per 1 cup of the packaged coleslaw, and place over medium heat. Add cabbage mix.

title: Sauerkraut with Almonds
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 jar sauerkraut, drained and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Spread sauerkraut in the bottom of the baking dish. Add chopped almonds to the remaining sauerkraut in a bowl. Sprinkle on the almonds. Spoon sauerkraut mixture over the sauerkraut. Pour the hot water around the sauerkraut. Bake in the preheated oven until the almonds become golden and the sauerkraut is heated through, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sauce for Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 5 tablespoons beef bouillon powder | 1 red onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp. Of the bouillon powder in a small skillet over low heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened but not browned.
