Transfer the onion mixture to a medium bowl and mix in the sweet chili sauce. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp. Of bouillon in a small skillet over low heat. Brush the meat with the remaining oil. Turn the meat over and cook on medium, uncovered, for 5 minutes on each side or until it is cooked halfway through.

title: Indian-Style Steak Sandwich (Savoury)
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh bean sprout | 1/2 cup whole wheat bread, split | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon steak spice packets of your favourite curry paste
instructions: Heat a griddle or nonstick fry pan. Spread the wok with a little oil and heat it. Spread a slice of bread with worcestershire sauce, if desired. Place the bean sprouts on the bread, close and spread them with the cooked steak. Sprinkle over the garam masala, the steak spice and the worcestershire sauce. Place the sandwich under the griller and cook for 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: natural peanut butter,yellow squash,mung bean sprout,cardamom,ritz cracker,head garlic,ham
title: Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 bag frozen chopped raw cauliflower sprouts | 1 cup frozen ham, coarsely chopped | 2 cups shredded mung bean sprouts | 1 yellow squash - peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon natural peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 10 ritz crackers
instructions: Place oven rack on the middle rack in the oven and preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix cauliflower, ham slices, and sprouts in a mixing bowl. Mix well and spread in a roasting pan. Bake in the preheated oven until cauliflower is tender and the sprouts begin to crisp, about 25 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients, apart from the crackers, in a bowl, and spread over the sprouts while baking. Bake, uncovered, in the oven until crackers are golden, 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: no boil lasagna noodle,manicotti,five spice powder,cumin seed,guacamole
title: Easy, No-Fail Manicotti
ingredients: 9 no-boil lasagna noodles | 3/4 cup guacamole ( i can find them in the bulk section of the grocery store ) | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 36 manicotti ( frozen or fresh, thawed )
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles in large pot of boiling water 2 minutes, drain. Combine guacamole, five spice powder, and cumin seeds in small bowl. Place whole fresh manicotti in large pot of boiling water until tender but firm, no firm, and drain. Place manicotti into large bowl, and gently stir in the guacamole mixture. Spoon half of the manicotti mixture into the buttered baking dish, placing them within 3/4 of the edge of dish. With spoon, carefully spoon remaining mixture over uncooked manicotti. Sprinkle top with remaining cumin seeds. Cover dish with foil. Bake in a 350 degree oven for about 30 minutes, or until bubbly and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,spanish onion,paneer cheese,taco sauce
title: Tacos (Spiced Onions and Cheese)
ingredients: 6 ounces paneer cheese, cubed | 1 package taco sauce | 1 spanish onion, grated | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Saute onions in pan with taco sauce until soft. Add cheese and spices. Let melt and serve hot or cold.

title: Roasted Chayote Lasagna
ingredients: 1 large chayote ( or green chayote ) | 4 bay leaves | 1 jar catsup | 3 tablespoons dry red wine or 3 tablespoons white cooking wine | 1 1/4 lbs uncooked lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the chayote or green chayote lengthwise into four long strips. Combine with the bay leaves, catsup, wine and salt and pepper to taste. Arrange a layer of uncooked lasagna noodles in an 8x8 baking dish overlapping them slightly. Spread half of the chayote sauce in the dish. Repeat the layers, ending with the sauce on the top. Bake for about 30 minutes, until the sauce is bubbly. Serve warm with more chayote sauce.

title: Rice, Arrabiata, and Pace Picante Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups carnaroli rice | 1 jar pace picante sauce
instructions: In a 9x13 pan place half the arborio rice and cover with the other half and pour the picante on top of that. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 350f for one hour. Remove foil and cook for an additional 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Quick and Easy Tomato Chilies
ingredients: 3 cans tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 1 tablespoon creole-style seasoning
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the tomatoes and green chilies, creole style seasoning, and tomato juice. Cover, and refrigerate in a glass or plastic container.

title: Thai Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Mix 1 t fish sauce into the sour cream if using.

title: Stacks (Toasted Almonds)
ingredients: 2 large italian tomatoes, cut in half crosswise | 6 tablespoons shelled pistachio nuts ( or 1/2 tsp. chopped pistachio nuts per square )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Remove and discard seeds from tomatoes, and cut slices crosswise into thin slices. Place slices into ovenproof dish in single layer with a sprinkling of pistachios. Bake 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Kathy's Spicy Caribbean Limas
ingredients: 1 package lima beans, trimmed | 1/4 cup mild chunky salsa | 1/2 cup brandy | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/8 teaspoon clove | 1/8 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1/4 cup catsup
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine salsa, brandy, coconut extract, and garlic. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Add beans to the saucepan, stir to combine, and heat through, about 1 minute. Serve beans over rice, or add additional salsa if desired.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar extract,milk ricotta cheese,allspice,flat leaf parsley,soymilk,buttermilk
title: Homemade Norwegian Ricotta Dessert
ingredients: 7 ounces fresh whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup whole milk or 1 cup soymilk | 1 buttermilk or 1 low-fat buttermilk | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: If using dairy creamer, add the sugar, vanilla and allspice at the same time. If using cream, mix well, cover and refrigerate until needed. In a blender or food processor, combine ricotta and milk. Process until smooth, adding the buttermilk gradually. Sieve into a serving bowl and stir in the parsley, making sure there are no lumps. Chill well in the refrigerator before serving.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,corn oil,yellow onion,bacon,peanut oil,salt,dark brown sugar
title: Guatemalan Bacon Strips (Sopa De Maiz)
ingredients: 2 lbs bacon, cooked cut into 1/2 inch dice ( preferably thick sliced ) | 1 yellow onion, peeled chopped | 6 ounces dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 4 flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 225 325&deg.

title: Onion Dip - South Beach Diet
ingredients: 8 ounces sweet onions ( i use sweet potatoes ) | 1 teaspoon instant dried onion flakes
instructions: Chop chopped onion into very small pieces. Dip onion into hot water. Add 1/4 teaspoon instant onion powder. Mix onion mixture with a spoon or fork. Cover with plastic and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight before serving. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,french onion soup,chicken bouillon,lemon juice,scallion,rice,cognac,red chile
title: Baked Apple Rice
ingredients: 225 g rice | 1 packet french onion soup | 250 g small tart apples | 4 teaspoons cognac | 1 red chile, sliced | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 2 scallions, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c/350f/gas mark line a large baking tray with greaseproof paper. Place all the prepared ingredients in the baking tray and lightly crush them using your hands. Arrange them in the oven and roast in the oven for about 45 mins or until the rice is cooked and everything is crisp on top. Serve the rice on a large plate and scatter over the scallions.

title: Pasta With Rose
ingredients: 20 ounces tri-colored cheese | 5 ounces pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, then toss with tri colored cheese. Serve immediately. If freezing, cover and return to freezer for no longer than 30 minutes.

title: Spanish Sausage-Peppers
ingredients: 1 package sweet italian sausage, casing removed | 3 large red bell peppers, seeded and cut into 1 inch wide strips | 1/8 cup shortening | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced fresh parsnips | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated lime zest
instructions: Preheat broiler. Brown sausage, peppers, and shortening in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring often, about 10 minutes. Stir in parsnips, zest, and lime juice. Serve warm.

title: Savouries:   Corned Silken Cauliflower
ingredients: 450 g fresh cauliflower florets | 200 ml double cream | 200 ml half-fat cream | 1 liter broth | 300 g bulgur, coarsely grated and rinsed | coriander leaves, to garnish
instructions: Scrub the cauliflower, cut into 2cm cubes and put in a steamer. Cover with water, bring to a boil and steam for 4 - 5 minutes, until just tender. Drain, put cauliflower and remaining ingredients in a blender, cover, and process until puree is smooth. Arrange cauliflower in a shallow serving dish. Pour over puree and sprinkle with coriander. Serve immediately, garnish with some fresh coriander.

title: Smooth Saffron Refrigerator Fillings
ingredients: 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 bunch scallion, white and light green parts only, roughly chopped, white and light green parts separated | 1 teaspoon powdered saffron | 32 ounces pinto beans
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine the cocoa and parmigiano reggiano cheese. Stir to combine until mixture is smooth and creamy and salt to taste. Stir in the scallion whites and saffron. Set aside. Soak 8oz. Rinse the beans in water. Drain once and set aside. Transfer 1 cup of the beans to a food processor. Pulse for 45 seconds or until the beans are chopped into smaller chunks. Transfer the puree to the bowl of the food processor and puree until smooth but not smooth. Taste to see if it’s ready for filling, adjusting the salt. Let sit out at room temperature to allow flavors to blend. Adjust seasoning if necessary. Serve topped with shredded parm. For an interesting variation see recipe #77892 by lindse. Rick rodgers.

title: Gurkensalat (Cumin Cream With Creme Fraîche)
ingredients: 15 fluid ounces heavy cream | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Whip the cream well or leave to stand whilst making the creme fraîche. In a small bowl mix the cumin and cream. Slowly pour the cream into the cumin and cream until the consistency you like is thick. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Italian Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 italian cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon dried whole red chilies, crushed | 3 ounces prosciutto, chopped
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Stir together cheese, chile and prosciutto. Place on grill and grill until mixture resembles thick pancake coating. Spread on bun.

title: Salmon, Apple, Olive & Horseradish Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 1 large green apple, such as granny smith, peeled, cored, finely diced | 1/2 lb ripe kalamata olive, pitted, coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb salmon, boned and skinned
instructions: Mix together horseradish and apple in a medium bowl and set aside. Combine olives, olives & salmon. Pour the horseradish and apple mixture over salad and toss to combine. Serve warm, or chilled.

title: Chicken a la Cuba
ingredients: 1 large roasting chicken | 1 frying chickens | 3 tablespoons corn oil | corn oil, for frying
instructions: To make the sauce, remove the chicken from the thighs and pull off any strings that float. Reserve. Heat 1 cup of oil to 320 degrees f in a deep fryer or large pot to reach 360 degrees f. Cut the chicken into 8 pieces. Remove the skin, then put the pieces in the oil and fry on all sides until golden brown. Place the cooked chicken legs back in the fryer or pot. In a deep frying pan, add just enough corn oil to reach approximately 320 degrees f. Add the pieces of chicken and fry until it turns a tan color. Place in a baking dish.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,egg yolk,pumpkin puree,oyster,yellow mustard,lemon juice,meat
title: Pumpkin Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 4 egg yolks | 1 cup pumpkin puree | 2 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | 200 g dark chocolate, melted | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/2 teaspoon white anchovy ( or to taste )
instructions: Beat the egg yolks and pumpkin with a fork for 30 seconds, then mix with the mustard and lemon juice. Slowly add melted chocolate and oyster sauce until well mixed and smooth. Stir in the anchovy and chill for 20 minutes.

title: Guacamole Relish
ingredients: 4 cups ketchup | 3 tablespoons golden syrup or 3 tablespoons corn syrup | 1/2 - 1 cup shredded guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients into a frying pan and mix well. If using a wooden spoon or other device, push sweetener through with spatula into mix. Enjoy.

title: Lemon and Eggplant Spread
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled & cut into small cubes | 2 eggs, separated | 1 package of softened cream cheese | 1/2 cup freshly squeezed lemon juice | 1 lemon
instructions: Place eggplant in a medium size bowl, add lemon juice & cream cheese & mix well. Beat egg whites until they form stiff peaks, then beat in one cup of stiffly beaten egg yolks until well blended. Fold egg whites into mixture & stir in lemon juice. Transfer mixture to large baking dish lined with a saran wrap. Sprinkle top with additional lemon zest or papery or paprika & refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Basting frequently while baking, allow to chill until serving time. If serving fresh, chill for at least an hour before serving. If serving chilled, remove cover from dish & refrigerate for a few hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pepperjack cheese,asparagus spear,beef rib,chicken wing
title: Asparagus Steak with Garlic and Roasted Red Pepper Relish
ingredients: 4 boneless beef ribs | 1 tablespoon dried red pepper flakes | 4 fresh asparagus spears, trimmed | 1 teaspoon hot pepperjack cheese | 1/4 cup chicken wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f place the beef ribs in a 9x13 inch pan. Season with red pepper flakes, and place on top of the ribs. Cover with foil, and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place the asparagus spears into a skillet over medium high heat, and sprinkle with hot pepperjack cheese. Cook and stir until crisp tender. Spoon the asparagus into a bowl, and set aside. Drain the beef, and return the pan to medium high heat. Place the remaining asparagus spears on top of the beef, and cook until heated through. Spoon the asparagus onto a serving plate, top with the roasted red pepper relish, and sprinkle with additional cheese. Serve.

title: Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 portabella mushrooms | 24 grana padano cheese or 24 rinaldi cheese
instructions: Clean out the mushroom stems and cut the stems into four. To clean mushrooms with a knife, cut the stems through the stems. Set them all on a piece of aluminum foil or baking pan about 1/4 thick. Top each mushroom with two grated cheese or enough to cover each mushroom completely. Fold up the aluminum foil. Bake at 350 for 30 - 50 minutes or until the cheese is golden and bubbly. Serve hot.

title: Tomatoes and Onions-Lasagna
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes with juice | 1 onion soup mix | 9 sheets lasagna noodles, cooked
instructions: Combine tomatoes, onion soup mix and onion soup mix in a saucepan. Bring to simmer over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer, 5 to 10 minutes or until mixture is slightly thickened. Spread 1/3 cup of tomato mixture in center of a 9x9 inch dish. Top with 3 noodles, overlapping each with slightly overlapping edges of each. Spread with remaining tomato mixture. Sprinkle with remaining 1/3 cup of tomato mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 8 hours and up to 2 days before using.

title: Smorgastarta
ingredients: 6 slices white bread, cut into 1/2 -inch cubes | 2 1/4 cups creme fraiche, divided | 1 1/4 pounds cod, divided | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/3 cup cashews, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup pearl barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place bread cubes into a shallow baking dish. Mix 1 cup of the creme fraiche in a small bowl, and spread this over the bread cubes. Arrange half the fish in the bread cubes, sprinkle with sugar, and cover with the remaining fish. Pour in 1/3 cup of creme fraiche, and sprinkle with cashews and pearl barley. Cover the dish, and bake in oven for 1 hour. Serve.

title: A Great Ham Salad
ingredients: 5 cups cooked hamburger | 1/2 lb hamburger, chopped | 1/2 bunch asparagus | 1 package yeast | 1 can green beans
instructions: Preheat on the grill to 450 degrees on a sheet pan. Mix together the ham, hamburg, asparagus and yeast. Pour some hot oil on your hands, and coat the surface with oil. Cover with a cloth, and place the dough in the steamer with a rack on the rack at the top. Cook for 10 minutes. Remove the dough from the steamer, and take it out.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,dill,tomato juice,lemon zest,confectioner ' sugar,romaine lettuce,tia maria,gelatin
title: Tomato and Dill Confit Sandwich Rollups
ingredients: 1 package unflavored gelatin | 1 cup low-fat tomato juice | 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 2 tablespoons dill | 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 4 tablespoons tia maria | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Soften gelatin in tomato juice. Add lemon zest, poultry seasoning, confectioners sugar, and tia maria. Add lettuce to mixture and toss until coated. Chill one hour and assemble as desired.

title: Picante Rojo Cheese Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces picante sauce | 1/2 cup sliced green bell pepper, or more to taste | 1/2 can chopped ripe olives, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons hoisin sauce
instructions: Mix picante sauce, bell pepper, olives, and hoisin sauce together in a large bowl. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,green bean,yellow pepper,white wine,whipping cream,blueberry,fennel leaf
title: Blueberry Chard
ingredients: 32 ounces boneless green beans | 32 ounces blueberries | 2 tablespoons minced fresh fennel leaves | 2 medium yellow sweet peppers, chopped ( i use red ) | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon garlic salt
instructions: Wash the green beans thoroughly and cut in half. Blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes or until bright green. Drain and rinse under cold water. Set aside. In a large pot, steam all ingredients except the green beans for 1 minute. Pour 1 cup of the broth into a blender or food processor and puree or mix well. Add the green beans to the pot of puree and stir well. Heat the green bean mixture over medium heat for approximately 10 minutes or until hot and bubbly stirring often to prevent sticking.. Pour the entire liquid back into the pot and cook for about 10 minutes or until desired consistency. Garnish with fresh fennel leaves and serve.

Random Ingredients: white bread,peanut oil vegetable,pear,paprika,bicarbonate soda,golden raisin
title: Pear and Raisin Bread
ingredients: 4 slices white bread, crusts removed | 2 tablespoons peanut oil ( or use vegetable oil ) | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 1 pear, peeled and diced | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1/2 teaspoon soda ( or use 1/2 tsp baking soda )
instructions: Toast the bread in a toaster. Set aside. Heat oil on medium heat in a large frying pan. Lightly fry the raisins. Add pear and fry a few seconds. Add paprika, soda and sultanas. Stirring frequently, gently toast bread until golden brown, stirring frequently. Squish bread with spatula.

title: Johnny Jalapeno's Easy and Delicious Mexican Polenta
ingredients: 1 can chicken broth | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Stir in cornmeal, reduce heat to medium low, and continue cooking about 10 minutes, stirring often. Stir in tomatoes with green chiles. Continue cooking about 5 minutes, until thickened, stirring constantly, and a knife inserted into the center of the cornmeal mixture comes out clean.

title: Irish Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 medium russet potato | 4 ounces fresh chives, chopped ( or green onions )
instructions: Peel potato and cut into rounds. Cover with cold water.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,rosemary,heavy whipping cream,dijon mustard,gruyere cheese,watercress leaf,cranberry raspberry juice,sauce
title: Gratin Des Roulades
ingredients: 12 ounces portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons fresh minced watercress leaves | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/4 cup cranberry preserves | 1 tablespoon fresh squeezed hot sauce | 1 teaspoon grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Spray the inside of a 6 to 8 cup gratin dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place mushrooms, rosemary and watercress on the bottom of the prepared dish. Sprinkle with the cream and mustard. Cover with cranberry preserves. Top with hot cream. Sprinkle with the gruyere. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 30 to 45 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbling. A mini loaf of fresh bread can also be served with the grated gruyere.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,white vinegar,garlic clove,italian tomato,pimiento,chili sauce,topping
title: Tomato Chili Dip
ingredients: 1 can italian-style tomatoes | 1 jar pimientos, cut into thin strips | 3 garlic cloves, crushed | 1/2 cup sherry wine or 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1 cup fat-free frozen whipped topping | 1/4 cup garlic clove, grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,penne pasta,salt,orange juice,fennel seed,red potato
title: Italian Pork Sausage and Fennel Potatoes
ingredients: 4 -6 pork chops | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 1/2 cups cubed red potatoes | 1 1/2 cups orange juice | 1 lb penne pasta
instructions: Dry fry sausage over med high heat until browned on both sides.

title: Creamy Rice Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 8 ounces rice vermicelli, broken into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, sliced
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to boil in a large pot. Add rice vermicelli.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Seitan (Shankmati) and Olive Toasts
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak | 2 tablespoons seitan ( or your favourite vegetable-flavored meat ) | 1 tablespoon kalamata olive, pitted and halved
instructions: Score the surface of the steak with the sharpest tip of a small, sharp knife. Cut each steak in half horizontally. Place the steak, cut side up, on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Before serving slice each steak crosswise into 1/4 slices. Drain off all excess marinade.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,red chile,pinto bean,rotel,black cardamom pod,baby spinach leaf
title: Tex-Mex Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 container guacamole ( use 1 cup bottled guacamole for mild salsa ) | 2 cans pinto beans | 3 1/2 cups fresh baby spinach leaves | 3/4 - 1 cup canned diced rotel | 1 teaspoon ground black cardamom pod | 5 whole dried red chiles
instructions: Mix the guacamole with the pinto beans, spinach, rotel, and cardamom pods together in a large bowl. Chill at least an hour before serving over rice. It will keep, covered, in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,mascarpone cheese,mango nectar,cherry tomato,pork tenderloin,kernel corn,orange juice,extra beef
title: Spicy Mexican Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin ( about 8 1/2 oz per person ) | 1 cup cherry tomatoes ( cut in half ) | 1 cup mango nectar | 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 cup diced fresh mango | 1/2 cup whole kernel corn ( fresh frozen corn is ok ) | 1/2 head cabbage, cored and shredded ( or any lettuce that will hold up to your sandwich food )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line two cookie sheets with parchment paper. Place the loins onto the cookie sheets. Using the serrated knife of the meat tenderloin, slice the tenderloins to the desired thickness. Place the loins on top of each cookie sheet. Place cookies one at a time in a single layer. Bake until golden on each side, about 11 to 12 minutes. Serve with a side of salsa, sour cream and honey mustard if desired. Or, you can bake the loins in a crock or nonstick pan for about 2 hours. When the loins are fully cooked, remove from the oven and garnish with the cherry tomatoes, mango nectar, mascarpone cheese, orange juice, mango, corn and shredded cabbage. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white flour,za'atar spice mix,curry powder,cremini mushroom,white sugar
title: Wild Mushrooms in Spiced White
ingredients: 1 lb whole cremini mushroom, trimmed | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons za'atar spice mix | 3/4 cup unbleached white flour
instructions: Combine sugar and curry powder in a small bowl. Sprinkle za'atar over mushroom stems. Let stand 20 minutes. Drain well on paper towels. Place flour in a wide, shallow dish about 2 inches deep. Dip mushrooms in flour, one quarter at a time, then press into the flour to coat each side. Repeat with remaining mushrooms. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a heavy nonstick deep skillet over medium high heat. Add mushrooms, cook, turning once until light brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Transfer mushrooms to 4 dinner plates. Spoon mushroom mixture over mushrooms. Serve with raita and yogurt.

title: Spinach and Zucchini Salad
ingredients: 350 g large spinach leaves | 300 g portabella mushrooms | 500 g zucchini | 300 g raspberries
instructions: Chop the mushrooms. Peel, wash and slice zucchini. Slice spinach and raspberries. Chop mushrooms if using. Combine everything in a large bowl. Mix the ingredients together.

title: Sara's Irish Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lamb chop | 12 slices rye bread, toasted ( i use pepperidge farm's black & tan ) | 16 ounces coconut milk ( i use coconut milk ) | 2 lbs kielbasa ( or other spicy sausage, cut into cubes ( or chopped ham )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a crock pot. Cover & cook on low for 8 hours. Serve over buns, egg noodles or rice, topped with shredded cheese, sour cream, etc.

title: Mediterranean Olive Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups halved pitted kalamata olives | 120 g minced red capsicum | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: Preheat griller to high. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Place olives on paper and drizzle with olive oil. Mix olive oil, capsicum, and baking soda together in a bowl. Spoon into a pastry bag fitted with a plain tip. Using a sharp knife, push a skewer through spiral of olive in a 1 1/2 cm wide, even spiral. Cook 10 minutes or until golden and skewer is cooked through. Transfer to a wire rack to cool. Serve warm or cool completely.

title: Onion Tartlets (Kiss Me)
ingredients: 200 g frozen pizza dough ( or prepared pizza dough, use a standard pizza shell, use the premid dough if possible ) | 1 spanish onion ( or normal onion, finely minced ) | 1/4 cup bourbon | 1/4 cup cornflour | 2 tablespoons vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Cut the pizza dough sheet into four equal portions. Take each portion of dough and flatten it with a rolling pin on a lightly floured surface. You may have to work the dough a bit with your rolling pin to get a smooth round or oval shape. Use your fingers and the dough to keep it round. Use a sharp knife to cut a circle from the dough, keeping the centre straight up. Cut the circle in half, keeping the cut surfaces straight down as you go. Place the circles on a baking tray, and leave for 5 minutes. While the dough is in the oven, combine bourbon, onion and cornflour in a medium sized pan. Stir over a low heat for 2 - 3 minutes until the onions are well glazed. Remove from heat. Remove crusts from oven and spoon onto the onion/bour mixture, spreading to fill the centres. Sprinkle with a little vanilla essence, and bake for 25 - 30 minutes, checking to make sure they aren't burning. Leave to rest for 5 minutes before serving. Variations,. Use canned tomatoes, slice/crumble on toast or sliced bread, thinly sliced onion rings or a combination of your favourite vegetables.

title: Lighter Dilled Vegetables Soup (Lomo Costenas con Brodo)
ingredients: 1 package goya sazon goya flavor sazon | 6 cans low sodium chicken broth ( or vegetable broth ) | 1/2 lb medium carrot, sliced diagonally 1/4 inch thick ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 lb fresh strawberries ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot. Add sazon and boil until dissolved, about 1 minute. Add vegetables and reduce heat, uncovered, until vegetables are softened, about 30 minutes.

title: Cashew Creamy Salami (Dip)
ingredients: 1 jar salami | 1 jar roasted salami | 1 cup raw cashews, broken | 1 cup broth
instructions: In a large bowl, mix salami, roasted salami, and cashews. Pour in the broth, and continue mixing until the saltiness is fully mixed in. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,italian seasoning,rosemary,fine breadcrumb,wheat,orange juice,green pepper,beef broth
title: Broiled Swiss Steak With Strawberry and Orange Salad
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut 2 inches thick | 3 teaspoons fresh rosemary | 1 teaspoon fresh ground fine breadcrumb | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons chopped green peppers | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh orange juice | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 2 ounces frozen whole-wheat baguette rounds or ( 12 ounce ) baguette slices, cut crosswise into 12 slices, each about 1 inch thick
instructions: Cut steak diagonally on fat side of steak.

title: Irish Sausage and Snow Peas
ingredients: 600 g kielbasa | 1 leek | 120 g snow peas | 3 tablespoons chopped mixed herbs | 6 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Start by preparing the meat. Finely dice the kielbasa and mix with seasoning. Rinse, wipe dry and slice into bite sized pieces. Cut the snow peas into 3cm lengths. Wash and pat dry the leeks, wash and pat dry. Cut the kielbasa into thick slices, the snow peas into slices, and place in a large freezer bag or colander. Sprinkle the dried herbs on all ingredients. Seal the bag or colander and put it in the freezer for at least 1 hour or up to 2 hours. Remove from the freezer 1 hour before cooking. Place the vegetables into a large serving dish, cover with the meat mixture and sprinkle over the kielbasa and snow peas. Sprinkle over the lime leaves and toss to combine. Serve with fresh bread or boiled eggs.

title: Chipotle's Achili
ingredients: 2 chipotle chiles | 1 teaspoon oil
instructions: Blend ingredients in blender until smooth.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,italian parsley,black bean,irish whiskey,breadcrumb,green onion
title: Easy Black Bean and Riesling Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed | 6 green onions, sliced | 1/3 cup grated italian parsley | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Mash beans in a large bowl. Add green onions, grated parsley, graham cracker crumbs, and whiskey. Mix well. Fill each croissant pan with 3/4 cup bean mixture. Sprinkle with remaining chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,chicken,baby clam,salt pepper,jalapeno pepper,corn,spaghetti sauce
title: Gaelic's Louisiana Clam Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 can baby clams ( optional ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, diced | 1 serrano pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place chicken in a large pot. Cover with water, and heat over high heat until chicken is completely cooked. While chicken is cooking, combine the spaghetti sauce, clams, jalapeno, and serrano pepper. Simmer while the chicken is cooking. Shred chicken if desired. Season with salt and pepper. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Apple and Chicken Liver
ingredients: 1 whole wheat flour | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 1 apple, peeled, cored, thinly sliced | 1 pound chicken livers, rinsed, trimmed
instructions: Whisk the flour and cream together in a bowl. Toss in the apple and livers and season to taste with black pepper.

title: Roasted Garlic and Herb Dip
ingredients: 2 cloves roasted garlic, packed in oil, cooled to room temp | 2 -3 tablespoons balsamic vinaigrette | 2 -3 ounces candied mixed dried fruit ( such as peaches, kiwi apples, plums, pineapple, apple halves, etc. ) | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Shake the cooled garlic with the balsamic vinaigrette and keep in the refrigerator for at least a few hours or overnight. Just before serving, stir in the candied fruit.

title: Butternut Squash With Brisket of Beef in Paprika-Coated Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 1/2 teaspoons minced beef consume ( optional )
instructions: First prepare the brisket of beef. Cut away and discard any fibrous peel attached on the top of the butternut squash. Cut squash lengthwise into quarters. Remove peel and seeds. Cut into cubes. Place in large bowl covered by several inches of water. Toss cubes with grand marnier and if desired, beef consomme.

Random Ingredients: yeast,nigella seed,balsamic vinegar,vinegar,meal flour,lamb,egg yolk,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Italian Lamb Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups whole meal flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons nigella seeds | 1 1/4 teaspoons yeast | 1/4 teaspoon yeast | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 100 g italian flat leaf parsley, chopped | 10 g balsamic vinegar | 1 egg yolk, beaten | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 100 g very lean ground lamb
instructions: Make the topping. Place all the ingredients in a bowl, cover lightly and set aside. Pound the lamb and spread out until thin, so that it's possible they stick together. Sprinkle with the seasoning. On a floured surface, knead the marinade together. Roll out the meat on a floured surface until 1/4 inch thick and spread out with a sharp knife so that it resembles a crust. Place on a baking paper lined baking sheet. Cover with a cloth and leave until the loaf rises, about 40 minutes. Preheat the oven to 200°c, cut a slice about 1/3 inch deep across the loaf to make ridges. Brush the top with the beaten egg white and bake until the loaf is slightly toasty and cooked through, about 30 - 40 minutes.

title: Linguine with Sweet and Sour Dressing
ingredients: 7 ounces linguine | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried red chili pepper, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons salad oil | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Cook the linguine until just tender, about 3 minutes per side. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tbsp of oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium/high heat. Add the caraway seeds and dried red pepper and cook, turning to coat with oil, for about 1 minute. Stir in the salad oil and vinegar. When the linguine is done, drain the pasta and add to the skillet along with the sauce.

title: Roasted Squash With Balsamic Syrup
ingredients: 2 large squash | 1/2 pint double cream | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 40 g balsamic vinegar | 2 cloves
instructions: Pre heat the oven to gas 200c/400f/gas mark slice the squash into 1cm thick rounds. Brush the cut side of each round with cream and then put on a plate and brush with balsamic vinegar and scatter with a little crushed cinnamon and scatter with a little of the cloves. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes then turn and bake on the opposite side for 5 more minutes. To serve transfer the squash to 4 people and scoop out the flesh. Place into a bowl and scatter with the remaining crushed cinnamon and drizzle over a little of the balsamic syrup.

title: Apple Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 -2 sweet apple, cored and peeled | 1/4 cup sugar syrup | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | 1/8 teaspoon ground pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cut apples into chunks. Combine all ingredients. Store tightly covered in refrigerator.

title: Nuts for Chips
ingredients: 1 head baby spinach | 1/2 avocado | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 small onion | 1/2 teaspoon water | 2/3 cup roughly chopped nuts, any kind ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large frying pan on a medium heat. Bring to the boil, turn off the heat, and immediately take the pan off the heat. Use a pair of kitchen scissors, or a sharp knife to carefully tear the pieces of spinach and avocado into bite size pieces. Allow to cool, then put into a freezer bag. Take the bag of spinach out of the bag, mix with the liquid, then let sit for 20 minutes or longer. Squeeze out the liquid and put the spinach in a food processor. Pulse until mixed. Add to the bag of spinach/ocado mixture. Add nuts, if you are using them now.

title: Baked Fish With Fried Shallots
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs firm white fish, about 1.5 lbs, fillets | 2 inches piece gingerroot, thin sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place fish in shallow ovenproof pan or deep roasting pan. Mix 2 teaspoons of salt with 2 tablespoons of water and add to the olive oil with the ginger. Strain the ginger oil into the pan and bring to a boil. Pour the oil mixture over the fish and sprinkle with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, basting occasionally with the pan juices. When done, the fish should be browned and crisp and crusty.

title: Taco Fajitas
ingredients: 20 soft taco-size flour tortillas | 1/4 inch cumin seed, lightly toasted and coarsely ground
instructions: Spread seeds out on a kitchen counter, and lightly grind with a mortar and pestle, or use a rolling pin. Toast or grind the tortillas in a cast iron skillet over medium heat, just til the edges begin to curl a little, as if they were previously ground. This should take no more than 30 seconds. The tortillas should not lose their shape or get hard. Spread the freshly ground tortillas onto a plate. Sprinkle or grind the cumin over the top, and sprinkle with the toasted ground cumin. Serve immediately.

title: Hokey Pokey
ingredients: 1 cup flour | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Mix flour, liquid smoke and mix well with hands until ingredients are incorporated. If mixture is too dry, add a little water to make it moist. Roll into a small ball and press slightly with heel of hand. If needed, add a tablespoon of water. Deep fries have a chance to turn them over in the oil. The more puffy the ball, the more you'll need to play with the dough.

title: Oktoberfest Kielbasa Soup
ingredients: 1 cup diced kielbasa | 2 stalks chopped celery | 1 can cream-style chicken soup or ( 32 ounce ) can mushroom soup | 1 can sliced mushrooms, undrained | 3 cans orange juice concentrate, undiluted | 1 1/2 cups packed red cabbage, thinly sliced
instructions: In large kettle add sausage, celery, soup, mushrooms and orange juice concentrate. Cover and boil about 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add cabbage.

title: Steamed Eggplant With Salted Fish and Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 800 g eggplants | 2 stalks lemongrass | 1 bunch italian mixed herbs | 3 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves | 1 1/2 kg kingfish fillets
instructions: Cut the ends off the eggplants and cut a cross in the top of each one so that some steam can escape. Lay the eggplants on a greased tray and place in the grill and cook for 10 - 15 minutes, turning occasionally until cooked. Remove from your grill, and allow to cool for 5 minutes before removing and discarding some of the flesh. Slice the lemongrass and mix with lime leaves and herb leaves, set aside. Slice the fish into 3 5cm pieces. To steam the fish, place the fish on a rack over boiling water until tender. Remove from the water and set to one side. Heat the wok over medium high heat, add 2 tablespoons of oil and cook the fish until golden. Drain the fried fish on kitchen paper, then place on a serving plate. Spoon over some of the lime herb mixture and serve with the remaining lime sauce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,tilapia fillet,sirloin tip roast,large shrimp,jasmine rice,mushroom stem,dark brown sugar,shiitake mushroom
title: Asian Roast Beef and Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup packed dark brown sugar | 3/4 lb sirloin tip roast, fat trimmed | 1/2 large dried shiitake mushroom | 1/4 lb fresh large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 can canned mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 1 1/2 cups uncooked jasmine rice | 2 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine sugar, 1/2 cup water, and roast in a large dutch oven over medium high heat, stirring constantly with a wire whisk until sugar is dissolved, about 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and shrimp.

title: Spaghetti With Pomegranate Seeds and Rosemary
ingredients: 8 ounces medium shell pasta | 20 ounces frozen mixed mushrooms or 20 ounces fresh frozen mushrooms, thawed | 1/4 cup pomegranate seeds | 1/2 teaspoon coarse salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons instant tea | 3 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary or 3 1/2 teaspoons rosemary flowers | hot paprika, to taste ( optional ) | 6 tablespoons dry medium-grind pasta works best, made with a good-quality pomegranate seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 cup raspberries or 1/2 cup strawberries ( optional )
instructions: Place the pasta, mushrooms and half the pomegranate seeds into a large pot over medium low and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes until the mushrooms are tender. Remove from the heat and stir in instant tea and remaining pomegranate seeds to the mushrooms. Season to taste with salt and pepper. To make ahead, the pasta and mushrooms can be prepared up to 4 days ahead. Drain well and allow to dry completely before using. Keep the heat hot over low the stove. To serve, preheat oven to 400°f. While the pasta is cooking, heat remaining pomegranate seeds in small skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,apricot jam,beef bouillon granule,cornflour,bay leaf
title: Dale's Easy & Easy Microwave Fix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 bay leaf | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules or 1/2 teaspoon beef broth granules, equivalent | 2 tablespoons apricot jam
instructions: Dump all ingredients into ceramic bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and place on microwave for about 15 minutes or until hot. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cindi's Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans green beans, drained and rinsed | 2 1/2 cups sweet corn or 2 1/2 cups corn | 1/2 inch fresh jalapeno chili, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup candy sprinkles
instructions: Mix beans, corn, chili and oregano. Spoon salsa in a bowl and sprinkle with candy sprinkles. Serve immediately, or store in the refrigerator for up to a month.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,beef brisket,avocado,lemon zest,coriander seed,chili oil,palm sugar
title: Kebab (Fried Beef - Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef brisket | 12 -15 saffron strands, soaked in ( optional ) | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 10 -12 tablespoons warm chili oil ( for searing ) | 1/2 cup palm sugar | 4 tablespoons ground coriander seeds, toasted | 1 large ripe avocado
instructions: Trim off any excess fat and silver skin from meat. Trim off some of the excess fat and discard. Trim beef brisket. Cut into serving sized bits, about 1 inch cubes or roughly 1/4 of an inch each. Place onion and lemon in crock pot. Lay beef over onion and lemon. Stir in saffron soaked saffron strands. Sprinkle with coriander seeds.. Pour chili oil and enough water to just cover beef. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Meanwhile mix sugar with enough hot water to make a nice syrup. Stir into beef mixture. Cover and continue cooking for a further hour. To serve, cut up avocado and garnish with avocado slices over the top of beef.

title: Quinoa W-Grape Filling for Sushi
ingredients: 1 cup of loose or loose-packed quinoa, soaked in water | 2 packages of sushi rice cakes
instructions: Wash the quinoa thoroughly then put it in the microwave for 4 minutes. In a small bowl, put quinoa and grape in a jar with a tight lid. Shake until quinoa has completely soaked up all the water. Let stand for at least one hour at room temperature. Cut out 4 inch circles using a cookie cutter. Heat a wok over medium heat and add a drizzle of oil. Once the oil is hot, add the balls of quinoa. Make sure they are well coated then place in the wok stirring them in so they cook evenly. Cook on each side for about 2 minutes or until they have a light golden look. Remove the cooked quinoa onto a platter or serving dish lined with paper towels. If you like using sushi mat, wrap a piece of parchment paper with some mat so they don't break, then cover the top of the wok with a damp cloth and gently pound the quinoa with your hands. Roll the quinoa out into a thick circle or circle about 1/2 inch thick on the edges. You should have about 63 to 75 circles of quinoa. Take one circle and pat dry with paper towels. Roll up the quinoa using damp cloth and place on a bamboo sushi roller. Repeat with remaining balls with remaining dough. Serve sushi on a plate and top with quinoa. Enjoy, jak kelly.

Random Ingredients: black olive,raspberry,salmon fillet,cream mushroom soup,nicoise olive,pimiento,paprika,pork sparerib
title: Pigs in Romaine with Roasted Cuban-Style Pork
ingredients: 1/4 cup neicoise olives ( optional ) | 1/4 cup white pimientos | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted ( campbell's ) | 1/2 cup black olives, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup pimento-stuffed black olives, coarsely chopped | 2 packages smoked salmon fillets, halved | salt and black pepper to taste | paprika to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with vegetable cooking spray, and set aside. Mix 1/4 cup olive, pimentos, cream of mushroom soup and 1/2 cup black olives in a bowl. Place salmon, skin sides up, on prepared baking sheet and evenly spread the seasoned soup mixture. Sprinkle salmon with salt and black pepper to taste. Place 2 stuffed olives on top with a piece of smoked orange from the jar. Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees f. Let cool. Place 2 fillets in each plate, and spoon equal amounts of the remaining soup mixture over top.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,cauliflower floret,radish,vinegar,french bread,kosher salt black pepper,crabmeat,button mushroom
title: Muxi's French Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower florets, broken in florets | 1 can crabmeat, drained and cartilage squeezed out | 12 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 1 medium head cauliflower florets, broken into florets | 1 head radish, cut into 3-inch pieces | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup french bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 1/2 tablespoons vinegar or 2 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread in a large salad bowl. Toss salad and let stand 2 to 3 hours at room temperature.

title: Olympic Antipasto
ingredients: 6 kalamata olives, pitted | 1 can sliced bamboo shoot
instructions: Drain olives, reserving liquid. Arrange olives and bamboo shoots in a shallow baking dish. Pour reserved liquid from olives over top. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,cornflour,cremini mushroom,milk ricotta cheese,vegetable broth,canadian bacon,sesame oil
title: Creamy Mushroom Spinach Soup
ingredients: 400 ml milk ricotta cheese ( or greek yogurt ) | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, chopped | 4 tablespoons canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 6 cups vegetarian vegetable broth or 6 cups chicken broth | 1 cup fresh cornflour or 1 cup light cream
instructions: Blend ricotta, mushrooms, canadian bacon and cornflour. Heat the can of broth or broth and sesame oil in a medium sized pot. Add the cornflour mixture and stir until the cornflour mixture is smooth and shiny. Bring the mixture to a boil, whisking continuously. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes. Add broth slowly, whisking often. Return to heat and simmer for 25 - 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Just before serving, taste and adjust seasonings if necessary. Enjoy.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin ( about ) | parsley leaves, for garnish, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Trim the beef, if using a meat mallot. With the flat of your meat mallet or your rolling pin gently pound the meat in the pan to flatten a little. This will make it easier to turn into a round. It might not be entirely submerged but keep pressing it into the thick side of the piece of meat. Place the meat side down on a rack under the foil and let it rest about 10 minutes. Flip the meat over and let it rest another 10 to 15 minutes. If you get any trouble getting the meat to rest, just take some of the excess out of the foil. If you get any trouble with this rolling, just let it cook until you get the desired doneness. If the meat gets a little stiff with the thick side of the meat you are probably cooking it inches if there appears to be lots of blood oozing out, pour off some of the fat. When the meat has cool enough to handle, it can be sliced or cut into pieces. You can also make these up to two days ahead. Store any leftover trimmings in plastic containers in refrigerator storage bags or freeze. Note, the idea is to provide each person with additional meat to eat. For a party dinner, let the meat rest about 10 minutes or so. If you have time, let it sit that long before serving.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,lemon,red wine vinegar,white flour,baby spinach,honey,ginger garlic paste
title: Ginger and Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 3 tablespoons honey | 1 lemon, juice and peel of | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 400 g baby spinach, washed, dried and roughly torn | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Combine the honey, 1/2 lemon juice and ginger and garlic paste in a bowl. Mix well. Add the baby spinach and toss until evenly coated, then stir through the red wine vinegar. Add the marinara sauce. Place 2 tbsps of mix in the centre of each pastry roll. Roll the pastry around the mix. Pinch to seal. Cut a slit in the top of each roll to allow steam to escape. Place on a lined baking sheet and brush the with a little water. Bake in an oven preheated to 180 degrees c for 20 minutes or until the rolls are golden.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,tahini,poblano chile,almond essence,cremini mushroom,whipping cream,beef bouillon cube
title: Almond Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 red cabbage, chopped | 1 poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon almond essence
instructions: Place the cabbage, poblano chile, cremini mushrooms and bouillon in a saucepan and simmer for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Transfer the mixture to a blender or food processor. Add tahini and whir for 30 seconds. Add whipping cream and almond essence. Pour the soup into a bowl and garnish with croutons.

title: Sweet Sour Beef Tips (Goma-Meshura Sushi)
ingredients: 1 lb beef tip ( sirloin tip ) | 2 cups freshly picked parsley | 2 tablespoons mirin | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 3 tablespoons ricotta salata
instructions: Grill beef tips until done. Allow beef to cool for a few minutes and peel off the fatty part and slice the beef very thinly. Put beef, mirin, rum, and ricotta salata into medium sized pan and cook over low heat until cheese mixture coats beef. Remove from heat and stir in parsley. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper before serving.

title: Roasted Beef Tongue with Red Chili peppers
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef tongues | 1 can tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chilies | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 cup hot sauce | marinade ( or your favorite kind of marinade or gravy, see description )
instructions: Place tongues in a large baking pan. Season with salt and pepper and pour in enough water to cover. Cover and cook over indirect heat about 45 minutes per pound or until tender. Place remaining ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until tongue is tender and can be pulled easily, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove tongues and reduce temperature to low and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until thick, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove tongue from heat. Place tongue in a serving bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 to 24 hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove and discard any tough skin from tongues and place in a roasting pan. Bake, uncovered, until charred on top and sauce has reduced slightly, about 45 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad a La Grecque
ingredients: 10 cups cooked cannellini beans ( drained ) | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 8 ounces linguine ( or pasta of your choice ) | 1 bunch italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta until 'al dente', drain well and set aside. Cook beans according to package directions. Drain and cool in cold water. Cut phyllo into four 4 inch squares and re stack. Combine the vinegar with 3/4 cup water and set aside. Place cooked drained pasta and cooked beans in a medium bowl. Add rice vinegar mixture. Toss gently. Cut phyllo sheets into 4 squares and brush lightly with oil. Place half the pastries on a sprayed cookie sheet. Top with remaining pastry. Score top with knife and brush with oil. Cook in a 375f oven for 30 - 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Gavarilla de Borracha
ingredients: 12 garlic cloves | 1/2 cup wine, any type, fruity | 3 lbs fresh lime zest ( from 1 1/4-1/2 limes )
instructions: Bring all ingredients to boiling in a heavy large covered pot, stirring often. Reduce heat, cover and simmer over low heat for 1 hour. Allow the garlic and wine to infuse for 15 minutes. Transfer the garlic mixture to a mortar and pestle, and mince finely. Transfer the gavarilla to a bowl, drizzle over a little of the remaining infused oil, and stir in a bit more of the infused oil. Chill the guavarilla before serving.

title: Chilled Beef Tenderloin With Spinach and Ginger
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, grated peeled | 1 lb fresh spinach, washed and trimmed | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, minced
instructions: In small saucepan, add 1/2 c water. Boil, uncovered, for 10 minutes or until slightly thickened, remove and discard ginger. Slice steaks diagonally about 1/4 inch thick and season both sides with a bit of papa as desired. Place steak on cutting board and set aside. Combine remaining cilantro, ginger root and beef together. Let sit for 15 minutes, then divide the mixture among 4 serving plates. Serve, passing remaining mixture separately.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,chive,chicken bouillon,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Caui Au Chou-Cauliflower (Cauliflower) and Fresh Herbs
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 15 ounces small cauliflower florets, sliced into 1-inch segments ( about 12 cups ) | 1 - 1 1/2-1 3/4 teaspoons vegetable bouillon or 1 -1 1/2-1 1/4 teaspoons equivalent chicken flavored bouillon | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Coat a 8 inch square baking dish with vegetable spray. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat to medium high heat. Cook cauliflower in batches, stirring occasionally, until it begins to soften, about 4 minutes. Transfer cauliflower to a large bowl and set aside. In the skillet used to cook cauliflower, add vegetable bouillon and chives. Toss until vegetables are coated with bouillon and are warmed through, about 5 minutes. Return cauliflower to skillet and toss thoroughly to coat with dish mixture. Transfer filling to prepared baking dish. Sprinkle top with any remaining chopped vegetables. Bake until hot and bubbly, about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Yum Yum (Thai Chili Paste)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili oil ( or other spicy oil, this is available in the asian section of most supermarkets ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( not light ) | 1/2 teaspoon habanero pepper ( or other mild hot chile ) | nuts, for frying ( optional )
instructions: Put the chili oil in a small skillet. When hot, add the seeds from the habanero peppers, keeping the stem lengthwise. When hot, pour 3/4 inch depth of oil into the skillet. A drop of boiling water will cause it to sizzle, so pour out the water. When the oil is ready, carefully put the habanero pepper in the center of the oil. When the pods are sizzling, add the soy sauce and stir until dissolved. Drop the nuts from the pan into the oil and fry until the color is golden brown. Use an extreme caution when frying, as the oils from the habanero peppers can splatter. Serve hot, as an appetizer with hot fried foods.

title: Spicy Peach and Carrots
ingredients: 2 large sliced peaches, halved and slightly underripe | 2 baby carrots | 2 teaspoons white flour | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 celsius. Toss the carrots with the flour and hot pepper sauce. Place in a baking dish. Add the peaches and cook in the oven for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,kielbasa,bamboo shoot,tomato soup,cumin seed,vanilla pudding mix,red cabbage
title: Sweet and Savory Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package sweet potatoes ( or other variety ) | 3 cans condensed tomato soup | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 bottle grand marnier | 1/4 cup cumin seed ( optional ) | 6 kielbasa ( optional ) | 1 head red cabbage, cut into wedges | 2 cans bamboo shoots ( optional )
instructions: Boil the sweet potato with the kielbasa until tender. Drain and mash with 2 forks. Combine remaining ingredients, and add to kielbasa. Simmer.

title: Brazilian Caramelized Salt Bodybuilder (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 1 cup raw sugar-free steel cut coconut | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 1 container beef stock ( commercial )
instructions: Place the raw sugar free steel cut coconut in a large bowl and set aside. Dissolve 1 teaspoon grated orange peel in the beef stock. Bring the water to a boil over high heat and add 1 cup of sugar free steel cut coconut from the bowl. Shake the bowl gently to combine the salt and coconut in separate pieces and to ensure they absorb the liquid. Add the soaked slices of raw sugar free steel cut coconut from the bowl, and toss to coat evenly. Let caramelize for 30 minutes. Store in your refrigerator or store in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

title: Mexican Red Salsa with Fresh Basil
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky salsa, medium heat | 1 teaspoon rubbed sage ( rubbed with side of blade of knife ) | 1/4 teaspoon basil leaves | 1/8 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 cup chicken broth or 1 cup water | 1/2 cup shredded unsweetened coconut
instructions: Dmix all ingredients well. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. Serve with warm corn chips or fresh french bread slices. Note, prep time does not include chill time.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,peanut oil,apricot preserve,bacon,peanut oil vegetable
title: Apricot Bacon and Barley Tofu
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, diced | 4 tablespoons peanut oil or 4 tablespoons vegetable oil, divided | 3 cups pearl barley | 1 jar apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp, breaking into small pieces. Drain. While bacon is cooking, bring 2 cups of water to boil in a pot. Add barley and stir. Boil 15 minutes, or until al dente. Drain, reserving 2/3 cup of the cooking liquid. Return to pot and add remaining ingredients. Cover, reduce heat to simmer and cook uncovered, adding reserved cooking liquid, if necessary, for 20 minutes. Uncover, remove lid and cook covered for 5 minutes.

title: Grilled Beet and Chayote Burritos
ingredients: 4 whole bok chayote, rinsed and seeded | 4 large beets, rinsed and trimmed | 1 cup sliced pickled beets | 6 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 6 flour tortillas
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cover beats with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium. Cook until tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Remove beets and beetroot to a plate and cut down their length with a sharp knife. Scrape beats with a teaspoon or fork into a bowl, and reserve. Wash bok chayote and beets and trim away the ends so they will sit flat on your cutting board. With a sharp knife, cut beetroots diagonally into 1/4 inch thick slices. Toss bok chayote and beetroot slices with vinegar in a bowl. Season to taste with salt, and cover with plastic wrap. Allow to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes. Preheat a grill until medium high heat. Cook burritos in hot seasoned butter just until beginning to blister, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Low Fat Okra or Spinach
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup okra, chopped, frozen or fresh | 1 cup light soymilk ( soy or lactose-free okra milk may be used if not available ) | 1 teaspoon dried herbs or 1/4 teaspoon dried herbs, mixed | 2 -3 teaspoons chopped fresh hot peppers ( optional ) | herbs from the okra, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Wash okra well but do not remove seed. Melt 1 tablespoon sweet soy sauce or 2 teaspoons oil in a non stick frying pan, add okra. In a small bowl, mix soy or vegetable oil, and herbs. Add to the okra. Cook over high heat, stirring gently, until the okra is just barely tender, about 5 - 6 minutes or until a golden color. Remove from heat, place okra on a serving plate. Spread 2 - 3 tablespoons soy sauce or oil over okra, and garnish with optional herbs of choice. Or if you prefer, serve with grilled fish.

title: French Vanilla Steak
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vanilla vodka | 2 lbs sirloin beef, very thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray a roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray. Place the meat on the pan and turn once. Place in oven and cook for 30 minutes. Turn meat after 20 minutes. Remove meat and continue to cook for 15 minutes, until cooked as desired. Serve with creamy horseradish mustard and a nice green salad and fries.

title: Peach and Beer Fondue
ingredients: 3 lbs frying chickens, cut up | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1/2 cup dried peach slices or 1/2 cup sliced peaches | 1 cup beer or 1 cup ale and a few dashes of pepper | 1 cup loosely packed fresh parsley | 2 medium zucchini, preferably green ( or more )
instructions: Warm bread and butter. Place chicken in a lightly oiled pan, and sprinkle with yeast. Sprinkle with fennel seeds and peach slices. Cover and let stand until slightly bubbly then stir in the beer and a few dashes of pepper. Cover and let stand until liquid is absorbed. Cut zucchini 1/4 inch thick. Place them on a board and cut crosswise into 1/8 slices. Drain onions and cut into 1/8ths. Remove excess fat from chicken. Transfer to crockpot and set crockpot to low. Add onions and zucchini to crockpot. Beat hard with a wire whisk or fork until slightly thickened. Turn crockpot off. Set crockpot to warm for 5 hours.. Add additional beer if desired. Serve hot with crusty bread.

title: Melt Your Bones
ingredients: 6 medium chicken breasts | 1/2 cup shortening
instructions: Heat shortening in a skillet over medium heat. Slip meat from bones, and roll in lard, then place on a cloth covered cookie sheet. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Cover, and bake at 300 degrees f for 45 minutes. Turn, and bake for an additional 45 minutes.

title: Steak Fajita (Cooked Steak Fajitas)
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, cut in 1 inch slices | 1 tablespoon garlic salt, divided | 1 jar roasted garlic salsa or ( 12 ounce ) jar salsa
instructions: Sprinkle each slice of steak with a garlic salt. Place on a foil lined baking sheet. Cook for 15 minutes at 450°f.

title: Beetroot Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup grated carrot | 1/4 - 1/3 cup dried black mushrooms, soaked | 1/2 cup prune, soaked for at least an hour in hot water | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut cream | 500 ml whipping cream
instructions: Cooked the mushrooms in boiling water along with the prunes for 10 - 15 mins or until tender. Drain and set aside the soaking water. Chop the beets and finely dice the rest. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Mix the coconut with the cream. Portion the beets in half or put through a cheese grater, food processor or blender. You want enough to fill you four cups with stuffing. Put caps on the beets and place on medium heat under the grill for about 5 minutes or until they are tender. Serve with toast.

title: Spinach Patties and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb asafoetida powder or 1 lb any ground meat | 1 egg | 16 fluid ounces mexican-style corn, undrained | 1 can baby spinach, drained | 1/2 small anaheim chili, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except the asafoetida, in a bowl. Mix until ingredients are evenly mixed, form patties by hand.

title: Maurice Salad (Shake & Go!)
ingredients: 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup tequila, premium ( not the stuff in a can ) | 1 tablespoon lemon grass, dried ( or 2 teaspoons lemon zest ) | 1 -2 tablespoon fennel ( fresh, dry, fresh chopped, or 1/2 tsp dried, to taste ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Place all ingredients in cocktail shaker shake vigorously until mixed. Pour all over your greens and enjoy.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Place shrimp in a bowl with the bay leaf, and cover with kahlua. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator about 30 minutes. Place bean sprouts in a small dish, and cover with cold water. Allow to soak 30 minutes, or refrigerate overnight. Drain shrimp, and discard marinade. Remove bay leaf, and divide shrimp among 6 cocktail shaker tins. Pour 1/2 cup vodka over each cocktail, and serve.

Random Ingredients: salsa,flat leaf italian parsley,egg white,italian seasoning,kalamata olive,chicken wing
title: Chicken and Kittencal's Easy Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 4 chicken wings, cutlets, tips reserved | 2 tablespoons fresh italian seasoning | 16 large kalamata olives, pitted, roughly chopped | 8 large egg whites, slightly beaten | 2 cups salsa ( we use medium or hot ) | 1 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Preparation, mix the italian seasoning and the minced parsley in a small bowl. Set aside. In a separate bowl, combine the chopped olives. Sprinkle the sausage with the italian seasoning. Add the chicken and coat well. Marinate, in resealable plastic bag, place sausage, olives, egg whites, salsa and the reserved parsley. Shake to coat. Dip the chicken pieces in the coating, shaking off any excess. Heat a large nonstick frying pan or skillet over medium high heat. Add half the chicken and cook until browned for about 1 to 1 1/2 minutes per side or until golden. Repeat with remaining chicken, then turn chicken once. Transfer chicken to a plate, cover and keep warm. Add remaining oil and cook the fajitas until golden brown. Serve with shredded lettuce, tomato and salsa.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,coriander powder,rice vinegar,cooking spray,red pepper,red capsicum
title: Prawns in Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 large prawns ( peeled uncooked ) | 1 red capsicum, chopped ( bell pepper ) | 1/2 cup cooked rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 spring onion | shredded spring onion ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except the shrimp in a large frying pan. Stir fry over medium heat for 5 minutes or until hot and cooked through. Serve immediately, sprinkled with shredded spring onion if desired.

title: Super Easy Feta Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-fat feta | 8 cups chicken broth
instructions: Boil the chicken broth in a soup pot until feta melts. This should take about 30 - 40 mintues, depending on size of bowl you use.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,thai chili sauce,graham cracker crumb
title: Thai Chili Cheese With Rice Crumbs
ingredients: 1 package frozen graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 cup thai sweet chili sauce ( mae ploy brand )
instructions: Combine the crumbs with the cheese. Spread 1/3 of the crumb mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 pan. Spread 1/2 of the chili sauce in the pan, top with 1/3 c cheese. Repeat this until all ingredients are used up. Cover and chill for one hour. Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes or until heated through.

title: Chickpea Quesadillas
ingredients: 2/3 cup canned chickpeas, drained | 150 g white bread flour | 6 flour tortillas | basil leaves, shredded
instructions: Mix well the chickpeas into the bread flour. Dip your tortillas briefly in the bean mixture then place on a large non stick frying pan with a slightly lower heat. When bubbles start to form on the edge of your pan add your tortillas. When the underside is golden on both sides then remove from the pan and place on paper towel. Top with desired amount of the remaining mixture and sprinkle with basil.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,chicken breast half,chile salsa,lettuce leaf,tea,puff pastry,limoncello,vanilla bean
title: Salsa Chicken Breasts Wrapped in Napoleanes
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves ( about 6oz each ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional ) | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed ( about 2 sheets ) | 1/4 cup frozen limoncello ( or other clear soya liqueur ) | 2 tablespoons mild chile salsa ( such as pace ) | shredded lettuce and, if desired, lime wedges | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Place chicken breasts between sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Turn over and pound out onto ungreased baking sheet, leaving 2 inches between them. Sprinkle chicken with vanilla bean and arrange in single layer in single layer. Bake, uncovered, at 400 for 30 minutes. Remove chicken and turn onto baking sheet. Bake, uncovered, for about 15 minutes until thermometer registers 165 degrees. Remove from heat and let sit for 10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chicken to cutting board. Cut into 1 strips. Return all slices to baking sheet. Stir limoncello and salsa in a small bowl into the salsa. Spoon salsa and limoncello onto chicken and serve over chicken.

title: Easy Russian Beef Sandwich (No subsitutes)
ingredients: 1 lb of very thin cut deli roast beef | 1 tablespoon crushed red curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon vodka | 3/4 cup buttermilk, to taste | freshly grated nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix all ingredients together. Place in a pita press or on a piece of wax paper, top with a slice of cheese. Place on a rack or other shallow baking dish if oven is not available. Bake at 350 degrees f. 1 to 2 minutes per side. Watch carefully.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,red wine vinegar,chicken breast half,beef stock,vegetable
title: Sicilian Chicken
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons peppppercorns, cracked | 1 cup beef stock ( or vegetable stock ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar ( or white wine vinegar ) | cooked vegetables
instructions: Combine pepper corns and stock and marinate the chicken in this. Leave it to marinate for 10 minutes. Grill the chicken over a high heat for about 10 minutes till crispy. Serve with the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: ice cream,ginger garlic paste,herb,milk ricotta cheese
title: Homemade Herbed Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups low fat milk ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs, such as parsley, oregano, mint, basil | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons ice cream
instructions: Heat over on a gas stove until hot. In a food processor fitted with a metal blade, combine ricotta, herbs and garlic and process until smooth. With motor running, add ice cream through and process until just incorporated. Scrape down sides when necessary. Store in refrigerator in a tightly sealed container up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,lemon pepper,torn romaine lettuce,tahini,bulk pork sausage,self raising flour,kiwi fruit,red pepper
title: Sausage and Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 250 g kiwi fruits | 1 cup self raising flour | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon tahini | 3 g vanilla essence | 1 pinch ground red pepper | 250 g bulk pork sausage | 2 heads lettuce
instructions: Cut kiwi fruit into quarters. Using food processor, cut the kiwifruit into a uniform, bite sized cubes. Place the flour, lemon pepper and tahini in a bowl. Add the pork sausage, season with a pinch of salt and mix well. Heat a non stick frying pan, large enough to hold everything in one layer, and when it shimmers, add half a teaspoon of olive oil. When the oil is hot, add the kiwi fruit and fry them quickly, turning so it browns on all sides. Remove the kiwifruit from the frying pan. Allow the excess oil to drain from the pan. Using the same frying pan, saute the kiwifruit until just firm and soft. Cut the kiwifruit into 3 or 4 wedges or smaller pieces and, while still warm, mix them into the flour. Add the rest of the oil and vanilla.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,lime,pork chop,italian dressing,cooking wine,green chilies
title: Tuscan Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain fat-free yogurt | 1/4 cup italian dressing | 1/4 cup finely chopped green chilies | 1 tablespoon cooking wine | 2 teaspoons fresh lime rind | 4 pork chops, 1/2 inch thick
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pork.

title: Roast Red Pepper and Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 jar roasted red bell peppers, drained and sliced | 2 french baguettes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. On a large baking sheet lay both peppers on two baking sheets. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes depending on how tender you like them. Remove from the oven and place in a bowl. Squeeze the roasted garlic through a paper towel, then stir into the roasted red peppers. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,red wine,green bell pepper,brandy,baby carrot
title: Italian Steak Supper
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck steaks, cut lengthwise at 1 inch intervals | 1 cup dry red wine | 1 cup sliced green bell pepper | 1 cup baby carrots | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Cover steak with boiling water and bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove steak. Cover and keep warm. Add wine to steak and simmer for 1 minute. Add peppers, carrots and brandy and cook for 3 minutes or until just heated through.

title: Wild Mushroom Biscuits
ingredients: 100 g self-raising flour | 1/3 cup polenta | 1/3 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1 large garlic salt | 1 tablespoon dried wild mushrooms ( use the reconstituted mushrooms too )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400°f. Combine 1/3 cup of the flour, the polenta, yogurt, garlic salt and mushrooms in a food processor and process until smooth. Add the rest of the flour, 1 tablespoon at a time until dough forms. On lightly floured surface knead dough for 5 minutes or until smooth again. Return to a lightly floured surface, knead lightly until smooth. Divide the dough into 24 and shape into balls. Place on greased baking sheet and flatten with the heel of your hand. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until browned. Serve warm with fresh butter, garlic or lemon.

Random Ingredients: lemon verbena leaf,red curry paste,banana,oregano,egg yolk,red pepper flake,coriander seed
title: Spicy Fried Banana
ingredients: 2 ripe bananas | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon lemon verbena leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1/4 teaspoon red curry paste, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Slice bananas lengthwise. Remove the peel and white membrane from the bananas. Slice the bananas thinly crosswise. Beat egg yolk with lemon verbena leaves, coriander seeds, curry paste, red pepper flakes, and oregano in a skillet over medium heat until yolks are thickened, about 5 minutes. Pour yolks into a bowl. Ladle about half of the yolk mixture over the bananas.

title: Fried Spaghetti With Veal
ingredients: 10 slices thin-wheat spaghetti | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed ( optional ) | 1 lb ground veal | 3 tablespoons oil | 2 ounces unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Drain spaghetti in a colander over a bowl, breaking the strands into bite sized pieces. Heat the oil in a large wok, and cook the noodles about 1 minute or until tender. Drain spaghetti and return to the wok and add the soy, dark soy, and crushed cardamom. Toss well until all the noodles have been coated with the soy sauce and heated. Add the ground veal. Mix well. Pour in the hot oil, and cook until heated through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pasta,plum tomato,rose water,coffee granule,cayenne,green cardamom pod,hing
title: Turkish Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs plums tomatoes, seeded and diced or 1 1/2 lbs a combination of fresh varieties such as plum tomatoes, tangerine, papaya ( see note ) | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon fresh ground black peppercorns or 1 teaspoon green cardamom pod, lightly crushed | 1 -2 teaspoon dried hing ( see note ) | 2 green cardamom pods, split down the back the stalk ( see note ) | 1 -3/4 cup hot red hot coffee ( or your favourite hot coffee ) | finely ground cayenne
instructions: In mixing bowl, combine the tomatoes, coffee granulules and black pepper. Place pods on baking sheet and place in oven, turn down heat, and place under broiler. Watch carefully, they can burn quickly so watch carefully, as they are rather hot. When pods are crisp and beginning to blacken, remove pods from oven and place in bowl or plastic bag to keep warm. After 5 - 10 minutes, remove pods to plate with slotted spoon. Continue to cook tomatoes for an additional 20 - 30 minutes or until they are soft, and slightly reduced in size. Using slotted spoon, remove seeds if desired. You may also leave the tomatoes in the bowl for up to an hour or so to get some of their flavor. Meanwhile, toast the cardamom in a small dry frying pan over medium heat, stirring constantly. When they begin to blacken, remove from heat. In a small bowl, combine the peppercorns, cardamom pods and chili flakes. Add to tomato mixture. Cook pasta in rapidly boiling hot water until al dente. Drain pasta well and return to hot pot. Add tomato mixture and any juices and the green cardamon. Heat just until pasta is heated through. Serve over your favourite basmati rice and offer remaining hot chili flakes, if desired.

title: Easy Feta Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 12 ounces feta cheese
instructions: Place all ingredients in fondue pot or crockpot on medium setting and stir frequently until hot and melted well. Serve with french bread and a salad for dipping.

title: Thai Chicken Kebabs
