ingredients: 1 lb skinless chicken, and cubed | 4 cups plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon minced ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon stevia ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dried cilantro, divided | 2 tablespoons dried sage, divided | 3/4 1/2 cup pretzel sticks ( optional and or or or corn chips may be substituted ) or 3/4 cup chopped cooked ham ( optional and or or or or or or or and or or or or and or or or or or and or or or, corn chips may be substituted ) | lime wedge ( optional or to serve )
instructions: Combine yogurt, ginger garlic paste, stevia, about 1 tablespoon cilantro, sage and 1/2 tablespoon cilantro in a large bowl. Add chicken and stir to coat. Cover and chill 1 hour. Combine 1/2 teaspoon cilantro and the remaining cilantro mixture in a small bowl using a fork, then stir into yogurt mix. Set aside 1/4 cup of yogurt mix for garnish. Add remaining yogurt mix to chicken and stir to coat. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 tablespoon cilantro. Serve with pretzel chips, lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,coriander leaf,red food coloring,pine nut,chocolate
title: Tropical Truffles
ingredients: 250 g dark rum | 125 g dark rum | 80 g pine nuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon red food coloring | 125 g shaved chocolate | 20 coriander leaves, extra
instructions: Place the rum and dark rum in a small bowl and stir until the rum dissolves. Spoon about 1 teaspoon of the rum mixture into each truffle shell and allow it to set until set. Preheat the oven to 150 degrees centigrade. Spread the nuts onto a baking tray and bake for about 15 minutes, stirring every now and then, or until golden brown. Break up the shaved chocolate with a wooden spoon and drizzle onto each truffle. Sprinkle over some extra chopped coriander leaves to serve.

title: Cheese Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 cup cottage cheese ( or cottage cheese )
instructions: Melt your bbq or stove top wok and cook jasmine rice in it. When rice is al dente, add your cheese and cottage cheese. Cook on high heat for approximately 5 - 7 minutes, or until cheese is melted and incorporated into rice.

Random Ingredients: grape,pea,vegetarian bean,plum tomato,vegetable oil,pineapple ring,italian seasoning,kosher salt
title: Italian Fruit Salad
ingredients: 3 cups fresh pumpkin seeds | 1 cup dry vegetarian baked beans | 2 cups sliced plums or 2 cups orange sweet potato | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 cup grape flavored tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place pumpkin seeds on a parchment lined cookie sheet. Bake in 500f oven for 5 - 7 minutes until golden. Remove & cool. In a food processor, combine beans, potatoes, peas, italian seasoning, oil, sugar & salt. Puree until smooth. Toss with pureed beans mixture, adding grape flavored tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,potato starch,chicken bouillon,farfalle pasta,irish cream,avocado,gruyere cheese,chicken bouillon granule
title: Guinness Potato Cheese
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 3 cups boiling water | 2 tablespoons potato starch ( potato starch can be used as substitute ) | 3 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 avocado, cut into 1/2-inch dice ( optional ) | 1/4 cup irish cream ( optional ) | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Bring pasta to a boil with water and potato starch. In another bowl, mix together cumin and bouillon. Pour into pasta and mix well. Drain pasta well and stir in cumin and bouillon. Sprinkle avocado and cheese evenly over top of pasta and serve.

title: Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.

title: Sweet Potato and Vegetable Stir Fry (Mixed Spring Rolls)
ingredients: 3 medium sweet potatoes ( about 1 lb/450 g ) | 1 small cauliflower | 1 yellow bell pepper ( or use 1 banana, sliced ) | 1 can chopped beets ( in juice or in salted water ) | 2 stalks lemongrass | 3 cups glutinous-rice, steamed and drained
instructions: Wash sweet potato, cauliflower and bell pepper and cut into 1/8ths. Cut cauliflower into bite size pieces and cut beetroot into 3/4 inch lengths. Cut lemongrass into pieces approximately 1 1/2 inch long, cut in half lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/8 inch pieces. Wash glutinous rice well and soak in water until tender, about 5 hours. Drain and set aside. Heat a wok or large frying pan over medium high heat. When hot, add a few teaspoons vegetable oil. Stir fry sweet potato for about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,orange blossom water,sun tomato pesto,white wine vinegar,plain yogurt,garam masala,dog bun
title: Moroccan Spiced Dogs for One
ingredients: 16 medium hot dog buns, split | 1/2 cup snow peas | 8 sun-dried tomatoes pesto | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon orange blossom water | 1 1/4 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Remove the seeds from the snow peas and cut into 1 inch lengths. In a large bowl, mix the pesto, yogurt, orange blossom water, vinegar and garam masala.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup With Sage
ingredients: 350 g cauliflower, broken into florets | 200 g lean ground beef or 200 g ground lamb | 1 glass beef stock | 1 tablespoon good quality vanilla sugar or 1 tablespoon cardamon, pulverised with a mortar and pestle | fresh sage leaf, for garnish
instructions: Put the water in a saucepan with a good pinch of salt, and bring to the boil. Add the cauliflower, stir and cook gently for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, put the ground and lean ground meat in a frying pan over a medium heat and heat, stirring well to break up the beef. Add the beef, stirring regularly to break up any clumps until evenly brown. Add the stock, whisking thoroughly until smooth and heated through. Add the sugar, and then the vanilla or cardamom, and stir until the sugar has dissolved. Add the basil leaves. When the time for the soup to simmer, take off the heat when the water is just before the time starts to boil again, and leave to cook for a few minute more.

title: Poblano Chiles Queso Dip
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and seeded | 6 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup roasted cashews | 1 teaspoon roasted garlic, minced | 1 cup red food coloring, tinted orange
instructions: Roast the chilies by dropping them into the boiling water for 3 minutes and then removing them from the heat. When cool enough to handle, remove the blackened seeds. Heat the broiler to high. Place the poblanos directly on the broiler rack, cut side down. Broil for about 1 to 2 minutes. Turn them over and broil for another 2 to 3 minutes and remove. Keep warm. Place the swiss cheese, cashews, and garlic in a medium size bowl and mix until well mixed. Drop 1 teaspoon of the pink food coloring along the edges of the cheese mixture. Continue to beat with a spoon while you dip the dip in the food coloring. Transfer to the serving dish, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve. When ready to serve, remove from the refrigerator and tint with food coloring or if you prefer, use an electric torch to melt the cheese. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Panch Phrikas
ingredients: 1 small red capsicum, diced | 1 tablespoon peanut butter
instructions: Dice capsicum into small 1cm cubes. Heat half a cup of water in a frying pan and gently fry the capsicum cubes until the skin is flakey, but the capsicum is not brown. Leave to drain, then place in a bowl and sprinkle with the peanut butter, then stir in as much of the remaining water as you can until the mixture is smooth. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,garlic salt,french green bean,dark rum,red bell pepper,coriander root,onion soup mix
title: Cuban French Green Beans
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds french style green beans | 1 large red bell pepper, cut into chunks | 1 large onion, halved and sliced | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 jar dry onion soup mix | 1 jar dark rum | 1 jar crushed coriander roots
instructions: Place the green beans in a large saucepan with about 1/2 inch of water. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat to medium and simmer, covered, until tender, about 50 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for a few minutes. Meanwhile, place the red bell pepper, onion, garlic salt, onion soup mix, rum and coriander roots in a blender and puree until smooth. Remove the beans from the heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,white sugar,orange bell pepper,red onion,cilantro,golden raisin
title: Citrus and Corn Relish
ingredients: 1 small red onion, thinly sliced | 1 red cabbage, chopped | 1 orange bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup golden raisins | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro ( optional ) | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: Place the onion, cabbage, orange bell pepper, raisins, cilantro, and sugar into a salad bowl. Toss so the sugar can melt into the onion and cabbage.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 6 -7 lbs chuck, chuck steak, cut into 3 to 4 pieces | 2 cans whole clams in juice or ( 5 ounce ) cans littlenecks | 3/4 cup pickle relish | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | fresh mushrooms, sliced or sliced ( optional ) | fresh corn, cut on the cob, canned, well drained
instructions: Trim all of visible fat from meat and cut meat into 3 to 4 parts. Trim excess fat and discard. In a medium bowl, stir together the clam juice and next 5 ingredients, then add meat and any accumulated juices except 1/2 cup additional juice if sauce gets too thin. Marinate in refrigerator for 8 - 12 hours or refrigerate overnight. Drain meat and discard marinade. Place meat on heated grill over hight heat. Close grill and push meat down to coals for 15 to 30 seconds until coals start to smoke. Remove meat and barbecue to desired temperature and serve.

title: Spiced Caponata
ingredients: 1 pound pasta | 5 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 3 tablespoons capers | 1 pinch ground nutmeg
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Cucumber-Lemon Curd
ingredients: 500 g mascarpone cheese | 1 lebanese cucumber, peeled, seeded, trimmed and cut into chunks
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a food processor and process until well mixed. Serve.

title: Baked Fish With Dill (Bukhia Ma Lahme)
ingredients: 1 lb fish fillet, such as cod, haddock, turbot or salmon | 1/2 cup fresh dill ( chopped ) or 1/2 cup fresh parsley ( chopped ) | 1 large yellow onion | 3 tablespoons ghee or 3 tablespoons clarified butter, divided | 3 tablespoons limoncello or 3 tablespoons heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Coat the fillet with 2 tablespoons ghee, spread in one layer in a 9 inch roasting pan. Sprinkle the fillet with chopped dill or parsley and onion. Pour in enough water to just cover fish. Cover tightly with foil and bake for about 30 to 40 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork and the juices run clear. Remove from oven and cover tightly with aluminum foil, allowing it to rest for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, place 3 tablespoons of water in a small skillet, melt over low heat, and stir in limoncello or cream. Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook gently until liquid is reduced and thickened and flavors are blended, 3 to 5 minutes. Uncover and stir gently until sauce is hot if necessary. Remove from heat and refrigerate for at least an hour and up to 24 hours. Spread fillet with cream sauce and garnish with remaining dill or parsley. Note, i prefer to serve this with mashed potatoes as a filling for the center of the meal, which will be good served with bread, or as a side dish to the main meal.

title: Heirloom Tomato, Strawberry and Beans With Spinach and Watermelon Rathos
ingredients: 2 cups frozen chopped spinach | 1 cup hulled broccoli | 1 can sliced watermelon, slices | 1/2 cup chopped green heirloom tomatoes | 2/3 cup pearl barley | 1/3 cup quick-cooking spray | 1/4 cup pure vanilla essence
instructions: Cook broccoli for 3 minutes in microwave. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Blueberry Beef With Banana
ingredients: 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1 lb stewing beef, cut in 2 inch chunks | 1 large banana, finely sliced | 1 red chile pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup blueberries, fresh or 1/4 cup frozen blueberries, thawed | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1 tablespoon fresh minced chives
instructions: Over medium heat, heat the peanut oil in a large wok or frying pay. Add the beef and cook until lightly browned. Remove the beef to a platter and set aside. Reduce the heat to medium and add the banana pieces, chilli, blueberry, and allspice. Cook, stirring often, until the blueberries are heated through. Return the beef to the wok and add the chives. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat reheats through.

title: Pesto Toast
ingredients: 1 slice white bread | 1 stalk lemongrass ( tough outer leaves discarded ) | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Place bread slices on a cutting board and cut off hard ends of the lemongrass. Cut away thick middle rib from lemongrass and discard about 1/2 inch of center. Cut remaining lemon grass lengthwise into 1 inch pieces. In a large shallow dish or bowl, mix the lemongrass, pesto, and sherry vinegar. Place bread slices on a serving platter and drizzle with the pesto vinaigrette.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,tomato green chilies,lettuce leaf,pink grapefruit,pecan,russet potato,tea,egg
title: Mushroom Potatoes Salad
ingredients: 1 small russet potato, peeled and cut into 1/3-inch slices ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/2 medium pink grapefruit, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices ( about 3 cups ) | 2 cups torn lettuce leaves ( or use green leaf lettuce ) | 10 ounces cremini mushrooms, thinly sliced | 7 ounces canned diced tomatoes and green chilies | 5 fluid ounces brewed tea | 2 eggs, beaten | chopped pecans ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Sprinkle salt over potato slices and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain potatoes, cool, and transfer to a large bowl. Add grapefruit, lettuce, and mushrooms. In a small bowl, stir together tea and eggs. Add to potato mixture along with pecans, if using. Chill before serving.

title: Vanilla Bean and Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 12 spring roll wrappers | 1 cup vanilla flavored ice cream or 1 cup vanilla coffee-flavored liqueur
instructions: Using long, thin strips of peel from one end of the vanilla bean using peeler, remove the scraped vanilla pod and scrape the split lengthwise. Repeat with the other ends and slice the vanilla pod in half lengthwise at an angle crosswise into a few pieces. Repeat with the remaining wrappers. Place the ice cream or liqueur in a small bowl and set aside. Place the cut vanilla pods and liqueur between the two scoops of ice cream or coffee and allow to soften for a least 15 minutes or up to 10 minutes. Pour a portion of the ice cream or coffee mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a star tip. Push out the softened vanilla pod and fill into the centre of each wrapper. Fold the sides of the wrapper over the filling. Gently place the filled wrappers one at a time into the freezer for 10 - 20 minutes or until the filling has set. Then carefully place the ice cream or coffee into a freezer bag, expel as much air as possible, and place the wrapped ice cream, coffee or ice cream, coffee, or ice cream freezer bag into the freezer for an additional 1 - 2 hours. Remove the ice cream or coffee and cool in the refrigerator. Serve on serving plates surrounded by ice cream or coffee flavored liqueur.

title: Hot Shrimp Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled deveined and uncooked | 4 taco shells | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Cook shrimp in boiling salted water for 1 minute, toss. Scoop out shrimp, reserve 1/3 cup of shrimp. Cook taco shells according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine shrimp and vinegar in large nonstick skillet. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes or until shrimp are pink. Serve with taco shells. Variation, add 1/3 cup shredded cheese or 2 tablespoons sour cream.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,egg,green chili pepper,cucumber,water chestnut,white fish fillet,icing sugar
title: Egg Roll - Sushi
ingredients: 1/2 cup water chestnut, coarsely chopped | 1 green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 green chili pepper, seeds and membrane removed and finely chopped | 1 1/4 cups fish stock or 1 1/4 cups water | 4 eggs | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 lb white fish fillet, cut into thick slices | 2 tortillas
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the water chestnuts, chilies, and green chili, cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Break the egg into a large bowl. Add the fish pieces and beat the mixture with a fork until the fish is cooked through and the sauce is thick. In a small sausepan, blend the icing sugar with 2/3 cup of the hot water. Stir until the icing is completely dissolved and then gradually stir them into the liquid. Continue to simmer over low heat for one minute. Stir over low heat until the sauce has thickened slightly and remove from the heat. Transfer 1/4 cup mixture to a small bowl and set aside. Stir in the remaining mixture and season to taste with salt and pepper. Set a bamboo sushi rolling mat in the freezer for about an hour. Fill a large glass or bamboo sushi rolling mat with warm water. Roll the mat with your hands, wetting the mat as you roll. Lift the mat from the water, lay it over the bowl and cover with a sheet of plastic wrap. Refrigerate the mat, covered, until set to use, about 15 - 20 minutes. Place the fish strips, cut side down, on the chilled bamboo mat. Using a tablespoon, carefully roll them to make a roll that will fit into your palm. Repeat for each rice cake. Place the rolled rice cakes on a clean dish. Serve with your choice of wasabi.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,confectioner sugar,navel orange,double cream,heavy cream,fish stock
title: Boiled Orange Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/4 cups heavy cream, warmed | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 pint double cream | 1 1/2 - 2 cups fish stock | 2 navel oranges, peeled
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the beef, heavy cream, confectioners' sugar, and double cream. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Drain beef cubes of excess liquid and place in the center of the parchment paper. Top with 1 1/2 to 2 heaping tablespoons of the reserved cream mixture, about 1/2 cup per cube. Fold the parchment paper all around and pinch off strips of beef and place them in the center. Bake in the preheated oven until the beef is fork tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Allow to cool to room temperature, and then refrigerate for at least 3 hours. To serve, garnish with orange slices. Serve chilled.

title: Saffron Soymilk Drink by Sy
ingredients: 600 ml soymilk or 600 ml lactose-free milk | 1 -2 pinch saffron | 3 tablespoons madras curry powder | 3 tablespoons kahlua | 1 -2 stalk celery leaves, with a little stem ( or you can use a leafy beet, celery root )
instructions: Using a blender and food processor, make an 'indian' smooth. Strain into a jug. Add all other ingredients except the celery leaves and/or the ash. Blend with a metal spoon. To serve, place in individual glasses and garnish with a stalk of celery leaves with a little stem or stalk.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,tomato soup,pork loin chop,tamari,chocolate square,beef eye,salami
title: Tropical Grilled Pork Cubes on Sweet Basil Breadsticks
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-sodium tomato soup ( ketchup ) | 2 teaspoons tamari | 2 boneless pork loin chops | 4 soft breadsticks ( see recicpe # 424029 ) | 1 tablespoon light meat-flavored tamari | 1/4 lb deli sliced sweet smoked deli ham ( recommended -- deli ) or 1/4 lb deli ham ( recommended -- deli ) | iceberg lettuce or iceberg lettuce
instructions: In a small bowl whisk together the tomato soup, ketchup and tamari. Set aside. Slice the pork loin to a thickness of 3/4 inch and place in a shallow glass dish. Spread both sides of each chop with a thin layer of the tomato soup mixture and place on top of the sliced pork loin. Cover the loin with plastic wrap, then the plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight, turning several times. Heat an outdoor grill to medium, and lightly oil grate. Remove pork from the refrigerator 10 minutes prior to grilling. Place the breadsticks on the grill and brush both sides of each slice with the tamari mixture and allow them to heat through. Place a piece of the ham on each breadstick and top with a slice of pork, a lettuce leaf or a lettuce leaf, close, close and close grill. Close the grill and let cook until pork is heated through and glazed. Remove from grill and serve.

title: Chicken and Pumpernickel Sandwich
ingredients: 2 large chicken breasts, skin removed | 3 ounces pumpernickel bread | 2 tablespoons pickled jalapeno peppers, drained
instructions: Cut each breast in half lengthwise. Slice the bread crosswise into 2 pieces. Open one piece of plastic wrap so that it is about 1/4 inch thick, place the chicken, open side down, on the plastic wrap closest to you. Spread 2 tablespoons of pickled jalapeños, inside one of the halves of the bread. Wrap the top piece of plastic wrap around the chicken, pressing the slices tightly together. Repeat with the remaining pieces, placing them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Place on a low oven shelf in a 350 degree oven just so that the bread will absorb any oil and seasonings during the cooking process. Bake for 45 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked all through.

title: Low - Fat Onion Leek Salad
ingredients: 3 leeks ( white and pale green parts only if absolutely white ) | 1 jar anchovy paste ( or anchovy paste -or 1/2 tsp anchovy.or 1/2 tsp. anchovy, but we're allergic to anchovies. ) | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar
instructions: Clean and debeard the leeks. Wash and remove the root ends. Slice the leeks lengthwise, then slice into thin 2 x 3 cm sticks. Place the pieces at the bottom end of the pile of onion to form a base layer. Add the anchovy paste or anchovies. Stir in the cider vinegar. Pour the dressing over the leeks, sprinkle with more sea salt or other desired seasoning.

title: Beef Taquitos
ingredients: 1 pound shredded steak | 2 teaspoons burrito flour tortillas, or as needed | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed and drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Stir in steak, and cook 5 to 10 minutes, or until mostly cooked. Dice beef into small crumbs, and stir into meat. Return to boiling water, and add tortillas. Heat 2 to 3 more minutes, or until tortillas float to the surface. Remove from water, and place in a resealable plastic bag. Seal the bag, and chill in the refrigerator at least 2 hours. Remove meat from the refrigerator, and slice thinly to serve. Fill each tortilla with enough leftover meat to make 1 to 1 1/2 cup meat.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,soy sauce,mace,pretzel,creole seasoning,chicken meat,lemon zest,graham cracker crumb
title: Delicious Chicken Gizzards
ingredients: 2 large pretzels | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon minced fresh mace | 1 package frozen cooked boneless chicken - meat, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 package graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Arrange pretzels on a large baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until evenly golden, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: allspice,mexican cheese,vanilla bean,oat,stewing beef,vegetable oil,salmon fillet
title: Lori's Swedish Meat & Cheese Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon allspice | vegetable oil | 2 lbs mexican cheese ( grated and packed ) | 5 scottish cow's cheese | 3 lbs fresh salmon fillets ( skinned & boned ) | 1/2 cup old fashioned oats
instructions: Dry meat with paper towels & place in a pot. Add the spiced meat & cover.. Simmer for 60 - 75 minutes. Meanwhile, boil the mexican cheese until it melts & will be easy to mix up. This should take 3 - 4 minutes. Drain the cheese of its soaking water & set aside. When meat & cheese are done, drain & chill the meat & cheese in the fridge. When ready to serve, prepare the vinaigrette as follows, combine all ingredients, blend well. Tear the cheese & salmon into 1 inch cubes, add them & mix well. Place the meat & cheese cubes to serve on the table and top with the vinaigrette. Goes best with a tossed salad & a beer or ale based beer & a salad.

title: Pisto Ramen
ingredients: 4 slices beef bouillon | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 green pepper, seeded and diced | 1 cup fresh spinach, cleaned, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 12 large pitted prunes, chopped if desired
instructions: Place bouillon and marjoram in a small soup pot. Add green pepper, cook over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Add spinach, vinegar and prunes. Cook, stirring often, until spinach is heated and vegetables are just tender.

title: Linguine With Coriander and Parsley
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 7 ounces linguine, dry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees. Place the coriander seeds in a frying pan with about 1 tablespoon of water. Bake until golden on both sides and fragrant. When cooled, store in an airtight container. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook the linguine in the boiling water for about 7 minutes.

title: Classic French Mushroom Pate
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh button mushrooms | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 lemon, zest of | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Peel and slice the mushrooms. Whip the cream with the sugar. Stir in the sliced mushrooms. Place in a bowl and sprinkle with lemon zest. Using your hands, mix together the basil and the mixture. If no firm peaks form, gently fold in a knife. Transfer to a greased and lightly floured 8 inch square baking dish. Bake at 325 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,half,macaroni,celery salt,graham cracker crumb,pignoli nut,pita bread
title: Pastiera
ingredients: 6 medium baking potatoes, unpeeled | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 cup grated raw pignoli nuts ( about 2 cups ) | 2 1/2 cups dry panko bread, crumbs | 2/3 cup half-and-half | 1 package dried macaroni, with seasoning | additional pignoli nut, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place unpeeled, unpeeled potatoes in a large pot of boiling water.

title: North African Spiced Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon crushed anise seed | fresh thyme sprig ( to garnish ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne, plus salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together mustard, anise & cayenne. Pour hot mustard mixture into a medium bowl and sprinkle pepper over.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,vegetable stock,asparagus spear,catsup,saffron strand,chunky salsa
title: Easy and Quick Asparagus Soup
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand | 1/8 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 5 fresh asparagus spears, chopped | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup thick & chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Tie the saffron strands with kitchen string. Bring vegetable stock to boil in a large pot over med heat. Once hot add the arsteins. Cover and simmer 5 min or until tender crisp. Add salsa and continue cooking until heated through.

Random Ingredients: flounder fillet,pepperoncini pepper juice,green pepper,almond extract,sunflower seed,white flour,asiago cheese
title: Grilled Flounder Salad With Sunflower-Spinach Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup chopped roasted salted sunflower seeds | 1/2 cup roasted red pepper ( from a jar ) | 1/3 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1/3 cup grated asiago cheese | 1 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper juice | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 4 1/2 lbs flounder fillets
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour and pepperoncini peppers.

title: Fresh Tomato Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 32 ounces tomato sauce | 1/2 cup port wine | 7 ounces butter | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill or 1 tablespoon dried dill
instructions: Pour tomato sauce and port into saucepan. Stir to mix. Bring to boil over high heat. Add butter and stir until melted. Sprinkle with chopped dill weed just before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,italian plum tomato,rack baby back pork rib,caper,spaghetti,chile powder,mint,mango
title: Mexican Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1/2 pound beef tenderloin steaks | 2 teaspoons chile powder | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes, diced, juice reserved | 2 tablespoons capers | 2 teaspoons chile powder | 1 pound racks of baby back pork ribs | 1/4 pound mango, chopped | 1/4 pound sprigs fresh mint
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Rub chile powder over the tenderloins. Arrange them in an 11x15 inch baking dish. Pour in the canned tomatoes with their juices and reserve 1/2 cup of the juice. Stir in the capers and 2 teaspoons of chile powder. Arrange the ribs on top of the chile mixture, covering completely. Cover the dish with tin foil and bake for 2 1/2 hours. Place the baby back pork ribs on top of the meat. Cover, return it to the oven and bake for an additional 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and pour off all of the juice from the pan. Cover and set aside to cool slightly. When the pork is cool, remove the meat from the bones. Slice thin on a diagonal. Serve on skewers with mango salsa and mint.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,jalapeno jack cheese,cod,mccormick taco seasoning,lard
title: Baked Fish With Rice (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs cod ( boned and skinned, if preferred ) or 1 1/4 lbs catfish fillets ( boned and skinned, if preferred ) | 1 lb jalapeno jack cheese ( or other favorite flavor cheese ) | 1/8 cup lard ( or more ) | 1 packet mccormick� taco seasoning ( regular size packet ) | 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice
instructions: In a baking dish or dutch oven, mix 2 cups water and seasoning mix. Heat to boiling. Add fish. Top with cheese slices until it barely covers fish. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Stir rice around the fish, and serve with the additional bowl of the original meal.

title: Lamb and Beet Baked on Skewers and Jarls
ingredients: 1 lamb shoulder | 1 ounce sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 ounce beet, raw, cooked | 1 teaspoon beets, fresh, sliced
instructions: Cut the lamb into 1 cubes and remove any excess fat. Wash and dry the lamb and knead, knead and shape the lamb until it is as long as you can handle. Cut the beet or beet leaves into 1 strips, then cut these strips into half. Wrap the lamb with a bunch of beet, tying the joint with string or soaked wooden skewers. Brush the lamb with oil. Place the skewers on a preheated oven tray, then bake slowly in a preheated oven at 325 grades f for 1½ hours or until the lamb is cooked and tender. Sprinkle freshly grated cheese onto toasted skewers before serving.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,liquid honey,salsa,head cauliflower,orange juice zest,icing sugar
title: Crunchy Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into small florets | 3 tablespoons orange juice or 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 teaspoons fresh orange juice or 2 teaspoons zest of, grated
instructions: Steam cauliflower until al dente. Drain well. Combine all dressing ingredients in a screw top jar with a tight fitting lid.

title: Pasta Gomeni
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 6 tablespoons ghee | 1 fresh parsley sprig
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add salt, and add the rigatoni. Bring back to a boil, and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain. In a large skillet melt the ghee over medium heat, and cook the rigatoni until lightly browned. Add the parsley, and stir to coat with oil. Serve immediately, or serve at once.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,grand marnier,white pepper,cilantro,ginger root,red chilies
title: Spicy Beef Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 1/4 cups chopped fresh ginger root | 3 fresh red chilies, minced | 1 tablespoon minced fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | ground white pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain the rigatoni, reserving 1/2 cup pasta cooking liquid. Combine the ginger, red chiles, cilantro, and grand marnier in a bowl. Toss the rigatoni with half of the herb mixture, season with white pepper, and serve at once.

title: Tartar Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs jalapenos, washed, dried, slit lengthwise | 4 pears, peeled, cored, chopped
instructions: Put the jalapenos in a large saucepan of boiling water and boil them for 2 - 3 minutes or until they are tender. Remove from the water with slotted spoon and plunge in cold water. Drain. Place the pears and boiled jalapenos in a blender and puree. Pass the mixture through a fine sieve and return it to the pan. Stir constantly and add water to thin the sauce. Cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: coffee granule,ricotta cheese,pork loin roast,chicken meat,fontina cheese,palm sugar,lamb
title: Cafe Rio Carne (Cuban Sweet Meat and Cheese)
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin roast, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules, dissolved in | 1/2 cup unsalted chicken stock or 1/2 cup water | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 cups fontina cheese, freshly grated
instructions: In a large soup pot over medium high heat, cook the lamb and pork until meat is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Transfer the meat to a plate and add the palm sugar, coffee granules, and stock to the pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to medium.

title: Fresh Tostones
ingredients: 2 packages taco seasoning mix | 8 okra, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Heat a large skillet over high heat. Stir in the taco seasoning packet and okra. Saute vegetables until soft and just starting to brown, about 5 minutes. Remove vegetables from skillet. Stir in zest and italian seasoning. Drop the mixture by tablespoonfuls onto a preheated, lightly toasted, non stick skillet. Turn to brown the other side, and serve with optional toppings.

title: Chocolate-Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate | 1 ounce tahini | cayenne, for sprinkling
instructions: Place a small saucepan over low heat. Add the chocolate & melt it without coloring, about 2 minutes. Stir in the tahini, & bring to warm temperature. Remove from heat & stir in a generous sprinkling of cayenne pepper to taste.

title: Pommes Lyonnaise
ingredients: 1 small baking potato, unpeeled and scrubbed | 6 large mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon peel
instructions: Place potato in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook over high heat until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and cool to room temperature. Once cooled, cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Combine potato, mushrooms, lemon peel, and 1 tablespoons butter in a bowl. Toss well. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 3 days for flavors to develop.

title: A Healthier Falafel
ingredients: 200 g dried cannellini beans ( about 1lb ) | 80 g currants | 4 cups chopped kale | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 egg substitute | 2 tablespoons light lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Place the beans, currants, and kale in a deep saucepan. Cover and stir in the garlic, just enough to coat. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat, and simmer until the beans are tender. Drain the cooked beans, mash them with the rest of the ingredients or mix with your fingers.

Random Ingredients: lemon wedge,chickpea flour,parsley leaf,cantaloupe,cayenne pepper,chicken breast tender,parsley,sugar syrup
title: Moroccan Chicken with Chickpea Nectar
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chickpea flour ( chickpea flour ) | 1 tablespoon sugar syrup | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 cup diced cantaloupe, drained | 4 teaspoons fresh lemon wedges | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded to 1/2-inch thickness | fresh parsley sprig | parsley
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,olive oil,broccoli floret,pita bread,lemon juice zest
title: Moroccan Broccoli Salad on Garlic Croutons
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | coarsely chopped fresh cilantro leaves, for garnish | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 - 1 loaf pita bread, cut into wedges, toasted ( about 8 inches in diameter )
instructions: Cook broccoli in 4 cups water for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain and let cool. Cut into 1/4 inch pieces and steam or microwave. Combine the broccoli with the lemon zest, zest and chopped cilantro in a large bowl. Toss well. Add the oil. Serve on the toasted pita and garnish with coarsely croutons.

title: Lentil-Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb dried brown lentils, picked over, and rinsed well | 1 lb ground beef | 2 bay leaves | 5 cups beef broth | 1 3/4 cups buttermilk, plus | 1 cup buttermilk | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 4 ounces bean sprouts, preferably young
instructions: Soak lentils in 5 cups of boiling water for at least 1 hour. The longer they soak, the more flavorful they become. Drain the lentils well and place them in a mixing bowl with the ground beef and bay leaves. Mix completely. Place beef and the remaining 1 cup of buttermilk and the sherry in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat. Pour into soup bowls. Place bean sprouts on top. Pour broth over all and serve cold.

title: Shrimp in Sun-Dried Tomato Cream
ingredients: 2 lbs raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cup pancetta, pancetta fat, finely chopped | 1 cup sun-dried tomato, sliced | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Cook the shrimp in 4 to 5 cups of heated water for 3 minutes until they turn pink, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a colander. Sprinkle the shrimp with salt and let drain for 1 minute. Rinse the shrimp under cold running water, shake dry and set aside. In a heavy frying pan, heat the pancetta. Sauté over moderate heat until fat has rendered, about 1 minute. Add the sun dried tomatoes and cook another 3 minutes. Add the shrimp and cook, stirring and flipping the shrimp from time to time, 3 to 4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a platter and sprinkle with the grated parmesan.

title: Luxuriously Coconut Cream
ingredients: 180 ml double cream | 2 tablespoons finely crushed aniseed | 280 ml light coconut milk
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.. Serve on ice.

title: Homemade Ricotta
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups ricotta | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce, low salt or 2 tablespoons garlic salt | 3 1/2 - 4 cups flour | 3/4 teaspoon mustard seeds or 3/4 teaspoon ground mustard
instructions: Drain liquid from carton of ricotta through a fine sieve. Cover and refrigerate overnight if using. In a small bowl, stir together dry ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes. Sprinkle ricotta on board and work with board until the mixture forms a ball. Roll out into rectangular shape and put on a lightly floured counter. Dip in flour and coat ricotta with more flour. Heat a heavy frying pan and spread with cooking spray. Roll out with rolling pin into a thin sheet about ½ to ¾ inch thick. Cut or roll out the ricotta into shapes. Serve on a platter.

title: Irish Beef Salad
ingredients: 3 slices suet ( dried wood ear ) | 16 ounces extra lean ground beef | 1 medium yellow squash, sliced | 1/4 cup dried apricots or 1/4 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon dried sage ( or 1 tablespoon freshly chopped sage ) | 4 ounces frozen miniature vermicelli | 1/4 lb grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cover the suet with water and soak for about 30 mins, until soft. Drain. Using two forks, pound the meat out until very crumbly. Add the squash, apricots, sage, cheese and cooled suet and toss. Taste and add seasoning. Serve cold or hot.

Random Ingredients: urad dal,red pepper flake,amarula cream liqueur,vermouth,wheat pastry flour,pepper flake,grape juice
title: Amarula Cream Splash
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1/2 cup urad dal | 1 cup dry vermouth, divided | 1/2 cup cracked pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 6 fluid ounces grape juice | 1/2 cup amarula cream liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Combine flour, urad dal, pepper flakes and 1/2 cup chopped vermouth in food processor and blend until dough forms a ball. Knead dough on floured surface until smooth, about 15 minutes. Place rest of vermouth and cracked pepper flakes in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.

title: Salsa Di Beppo
ingredients: 8 spring onions | 3 large white onions
instructions: Finely chop the white onions and stir fry them in a frying pan until they become slightly soft but not fully cooked. Add finely chopped spring onion mixture.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,wheat macaroni,baking powder,pumpkin,button mushroom,salami,pita bread

instructions: In a microwave safe bowl add the pumpkin or winter squash.

instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile, bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Add peas and cook until crisp tender, about 1 minute. title: Chinese Cabbage and Bean Curd Soup

instructions: In a large stock pot, brown the sautéed cabbage, carrots, onions and garlic at medium heat until cabbage is just limp and tender. Add the fish stock and bring to a boil. Add the cabbage, olives and bean curd. Mix well. Simmer until cabbage and bean curd are ready. Enjoy.

title: Easy Goya® Seasoning for Baking Chips
ingredients: sazon goya seasoning | 1/2 cup margarine
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve sazon goya in margarine. You can also do this by mixing dry ingredients in a small bowl. Add to bag of chips, seal bag tightly, and shake well to combine. Remove bag and allow chips to chill, covered, while making bread, for at least one hour.

title: Tomato Salsa with Sage and Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 medium tomatoes, diced | 2 ounces fresh tomatillo salsa | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Combine tomato and salsa in a large serving bowl. Sprinkle with sage and serve immediately.

title: Mexican Chicken

instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Arrange the chicken pieces in a shallow baking dish or roasting tin and season with salt and pepper. Brush with olive oil. Bake for 25 minutes or until cooked through. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 220°c. Serve the chicken with the spring onions and the chili sauce. Serve with couscous.

title: Papas Al Picon (Smoked Chile and Pepper Bark) - Poblano Chile Bark
ingredients: 1/2 gallon roasted peppers, including all liquid | 1 lb poblano chile
instructions: Roast peppers whole and remove stems. Place stems, seeds and charred white membrane in a small pot, just enough to hold them all in one layer, cover with water and bring to a boil. After boiling, reduce heat so as to leave about 1/2 inch of headspace. Cover and simmer 3 hours, until flesh is very tender. Allow skin to cool.

title: Baked Sweet Basil & Garlic Quiche
ingredients: 1 pie crusts, 1-inch deep | 1/4 cup soymilk | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 -2 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup white wine ( preferably chardonnay ) | 1/4 cup fresh basil ( or 2 teaspoons dried )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper. Place the parchment paper in a large bowl.

title: Homemade Spanish Onions
ingredients: 4 lbs spanish onions, peeled | 4 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: To make a simple life dye, rinse the onions well. Put them in a bowl with cold water and let it sit for about 2 hours. Dry the onions and cut them into 1½ inch or smaller squares. Put them in a deep stainless steel and non reactive pot. Add 2 1/2 cups water and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute and add the spanish onions. Dissolve the thyme in the boiling water. Cover and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes. Strain the onions, and refrigerate overnight. Bring off the water, and wash off the sand and dry the onions. Place the onions in sterilized jars and seal.

title: Spaghettini With Greek Mushrooms and Chicken Wings
ingredients: 32 ounces chicken wings ( skin-on ) | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms | 2 -4 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1 lb dried tubetti pasta or 1 lb ditalini pasta, cooked
instructions: Rinse hands off wings and place wings in slow cooker, skin side up on slow cooker. Sprinkle greek seasoning over chicken wings and sprinkle mushrooms on top of chicken. Pour 1/2 cup water into slow cooker and place lid on cooker. Cook on high 3 to 4 hours or on low 8 to 10 hours. Prepare pasta and serve over hot garlic bread and parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding,rice vinegar,chuck,onion powder,black cardamom pod,flat leaf parsley,italian seasoning,dill
title: Persian Spiced  Meatballs (Meatballs-Ladies or Thighs - Ladies)
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1/2 cup instant rice vinegar | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1/4 cup fresh dill ( finely chopped ) | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley ( finely chopped ) | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dill ( finely chopped ) | freshly cracked black cardamom pod ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dill ( finely chopped ) | onion powder | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup dry instant vanilla pudding | 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: In a bowl combine the ground chuck, italian seasoning, dill, fresh dill, parsley italian seasoning, dill, fresh ground black cardamom, and salt. Combine these together and press into your palms gently. Set aside. In a medium bowl, combine the wet and dry vanilla pudding mixes. Take 1 heaping teaspoon of mixture, or in small balls, roll the balls into meatballs. Insert a toothpick through each roll to help hold in shape. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes. To serve, cut the meat balls into bite sized pieces and serve over the hot cooked noodles or rice.

title: Chinese Steamed Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 lb ground fenugreek leaves, not dried | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Combine the five spice powder, tabasco and fenugreek leaves in a large bowl and mix well. Roll the phyllo sheets into a ball, brushing each surface with a little water as needed. Place a damp paper towel on a sheet of plastic wrap. Lay a large table top on the plastic wrap and use your hands to make a stack of phyllo sheets on it, keeping the plastic wrap completely overhanging the sheets from the top to bottom. Cut the stack into 3 squares, 2 inches thick, by cutting the corners of the square with scissors. Place 3 of the square triangles on the towel, leaving 1 and 1/2 inches of space between them. Cover the phyllo stack with a second plate, then gently roll it away from you, letting each roll rest for at least 20 seconds. Repeat with remaining triangles and stack of phyllo. Place the phyllo stack in a steaming, covered pot with 2 inches of water. Place the pot over high heat. It will steam for 8 to 10 minutes, depending on the heat and temperature of your steamer. Place 1 inch of melted butter in the bottom of a frying pan. Place a few sheets of phyllo on the melted butter, they should not move. When butter is foaming, place the 2 triangles on it, overlapping them in the pan if necessary to cover both sides. Fry for about 25 seconds, then turn and fry the other side for 5 to 7 minutes or until golden. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Repeat with remaining phyllo, placing the drained sheets on a baking tray covered with parchment paper, and then coating them with melted butter. To serve, reheat the boiling pot over med low heat.

title: Pistachio Beef Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated lemon zest | 1/2 cup minced onion | 1 pound ground chuck | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 2 jars baked beans with crunchy peanut butter, undiluted | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup crushed pistachio
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray a 10x15 inch jellyroll pan with cooking spray, and place into oven. While oven is prepping, mix together the ground chuck with the lemon zest, onion, and cardamom in a bowl. Roll into 1 inch thick logs on a floured work surface. Cut into 3/4 inch thick slices. Arrange slices side by side onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, or until nicely browned on the top. Cool for a few minutes, then remove to a serving plate. Spoon a little of the peanut butter over the top to cover the meat, and spread with a spoonful of the remaining peanut butter. Sprinkle on a little confectioners' sugar. Starting with your finger tips, gently dip the meat slices into the glaze to coat. Garnish with pistachios if desired.

title: Chinese Slaw
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix coleslaw mix and brown sugar together in a large bowl. Spread slaw on a baking tray and bake in the oven until lightly browned, about 25 minutes.

title: German Dessert Spice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cinnamon | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram
instructions: In a large bowl, add cinnamon, marjoram. Stir well.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,maple syrup,red bell pepper,filo pastry,farfalle pasta
title: Pastry Crust With Portabella and Maple Syrup
ingredients: 4 filo pastry sheets | 1 cup dry farfalle pasta or 1 cup other medium-grain pasta | 1 red bell pepper, cut into chunks | 4 teaspoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. On a floured surface, roll out the filo pastry into a round about 10 inches across and 1/2 in thick. Transfer the sheet to a floured baking pan. Add the farfalle or other medium-grain pasta, red bell pepper, 2 tsp maple syrup and 3 tbsp. Maple syrup to the farfalle or pasta dough and roll into a log about 10 to 12 inches long. Using a sharp knife, cut into 1/4 rounds. Place the rounds on top of each other on the baking pan, cut side up. Pour enough boiling water into a large roasting pan to come halfway up the side of the pastry slices. Put the pan into the oven and roast until the farfalle are very tender, about 20 minutes for farfalle, or 40 minutes for prawns.

title: Aalu
ingredients: 10 -12 cloves | 1/2 cup coriander | 2 tablespoons cardamom seeds | 2 tablespoons red food coloring ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Grind the coriander seeds with the cardamom seeds and red food coloring as desired. Add garam masala to the ground coriander. Mix and grind it into a fine powder with water to form a coarse paste. Apply this mixture as required. Keep aside for an hour or more until required. This powder is required in bharay. Note, remember to add a few drops of water if you find out that the mixture is to be too dry. You will get a fine, airy powder with a fine consistency. Do not stir it. Place aalu on a tea towel lined sheet and pat it gently with palms. Keep aside to marinate for several hours or overnight. After an hour, place aalu on paper towel lined plates. Decorate with silver sugar and fresh chopped corriander leaves. You can add grated dry coconut to the mix to give a wonderful aroma and colour.

title: Puff up a Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets | 3 tablespoons shortening or 3 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1/2 cup fresh mini marshmallows | 1 cup couscous or 1 cup arborio rice | 1/2 teaspoon sage ( for sprinkling )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 and grease 4 baking trays. Use a pastry brush to coat each fillet generously with shortening or bacon grease. Arrange the fillets in a single layer in the prepared baking trays. Bake for approximately 20 minutes until cooked through and beginning to turn golden brown. While the tops of the fillets are baking, prepare the couscous. Combine the marshmallows and rice in a small heavy based pot. Over medium heat, melt the butter and stir until well mixed. Stir in the sage and pour over the couscous. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes. Fluff up the rice, add more sage if desired, and serve.

ingredients: 1 tablespoon hot chili paste | 3 cups beef stock | 1/2 cup sliced black olives | 1/2 cup finely chopped green chile ( or to taste ) | 1 lb bow tie pasta
instructions: In a large saucepan, saute chili paste in hot beefstock until fragrant. Add olives and green chile and heat through. Meanwhile cook bowtie pasta until just barely tender. Drain cooked pasta well, return to pot and toss with sauteed sauce and serve.

instructions: Cut slits in both sides of the tenderloins.

title: Indian Styled Appetizers

instructions: Preheat oven to mix topping with ginger garlic paste in large bowl. Spread mixtures into wax paper lined glass or ceramic 9 inch pie pan. Bake for about 10 minutes, depending on the thickness of the topping. Cool in pan. Cut into pieces or diamonds with a knife. Serve cold on hot flatbread, or as a snack with yoghurt dip and veg sticks.

title: Italian Tomato Soup

instructions: Stir the tomato soup, celery, basil, oregano, and sugar together in a soup pot.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,cranberry,flat leaf italian parsley,chicken breast half,honey,chili powder,white tequila,couscous
title: Couscous Salad II
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked couscous | 1 tablespoon honey | 3/4 cup white tequila | 3/4 cup rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup chopped dried cranberries | 1 boneless, skinless chicken breast half, cooked and cubed
instructions: Prepare the couscous according to package directions. Meanwhile, whisk together the honey, tequila, vinegar, parsley, chili powder, cranberries, and chicken in a large bowl. title: Spicy Steak Pasta

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Fried Chicken With Arugula (Fritte Di Riso Verdi)
ingredients: 600 g french rolls ( or other thick bread ) | 1 kg arugula | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 400 ml broth | 3 tablespoons yoghurt | 15 dried arbol chiles | 1 small apple, cut into thin slices | 1/2 cup dried apricot, cut int eighths
instructions: Wash arugula. Split the rolls lengthwise and slice 1/4 thick. In a saucepan, cover arugula with very hot water and allow to stand for 5 - 10 minutes until arugula is tender. Drain. Cut the french rolls in half and brush both sides with oil. Heat 1cm oil in a large frying pan and fry arugula until tender and just beginning to colour. Add broth and simmer over a medium high heat for 5 minutes. Remove the arugula and keep warm. Repeat with yoghurt. Spread arugula mixture on top of bread and sprinkle with the dried chilis. Arrange apple slices on top of arugula. Fry until the bread is golden and crisp. Place on serving platter and garnish with dried apricots.

title: Simple Low Fat Fried Chocolate
ingredients: 2 lbs dark chocolate | 1/2 cup oil ( with meat ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic powder ( for frying )
instructions: Melt chocolate and garlic paste together on low, until all the water is evaporated. You may need to add up to 12 cups of water. When the chocolate is melted and it is just beginning to color a bit, remove from heat and enjoy.
