title: Hot Lobster Chips
ingredients: 4 lobster tails or 4 lobster, heads in tact, boiled in their shells until shells are firm | 1 pico de gallo, fresh pico de gallo is suggested | 1/3 cup corn chips or 1/3 cup coarsely crushed nacho cheese | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1/4 cup bread
instructions: Cut open the top of each lobster and scoop out the flesh leaving just about 1/2 cm shell. Set aside. Cut shells into 3 or 4 pieces, depending on size, and halve the head over a head, cutting away the core. Cut out the core at the base of each claw joint. Hold each claw flat on your cut surface and pull under gently. Open one torpedo claw and pull out the core with a spoon. Reserve the other claw meat. Repeat with the pico de gallo shells. In a hot frying pan add the pico de gallo and fry together with the stock. Break the pico de gallo mixture into bite sized pieces and keep warm. Break up the chips and mix into the pico de gallo mixture with a fork, adding more beef stock if necessary to make the mixture moist and the right consistency. Bring to boil and then lower the heat. Continue cooking for about 2 minutes or until the mixture is just heated through. Serve with chopped tomatoes and grated cheese on the side.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,flat leaf parsley,pasta,garlic clove,tequila,apple cider,red chili pepper,penne pasta
title: Penne With Apple and Garlic
ingredients: 400 g dry penne pasta | 200 ml whipping cream | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons good quality finely grated fresh red chili peppers | 1 1/2 lbs apples, peeled, cored and finely diced | 3 garlic cloves, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons tequila | 1 teaspoon dry crushed red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon grated unrefined unrefined unrefined unrefined unrefined unrefined cane cane cider
instructions: Cook pasta until just tender on the underside. Do not overcook. Place cream, parsley and chillies in a deep pan over a medium high heat. Heat, stirring continuously for 3 - 5 minutes or until it smells toasty. Add apples, garlic and tequila. Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally for 3 - 5 minutes or until apples soften. Add red chili pepper and cream mixture. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat and cook for 1 - 2 minutes or until sauce thickens slightly. Serve with freshly cooked pasta.

title: Strawberry Topped Pepper and Herb Crumbs (Bread Mix)
ingredients: 1 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon cumin | 2/3 cup yellow sweet pepper, diced small | 6 -10 ounces strawberries, washed and halved
instructions: In a large bowl combine bread crumbs, marjoram and cumin. Add remaining topping ingredients and stir through. Place in a lightly oiled 13 x 9 inch pan. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Bring to room temp before serving.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,ice cube,black olive,sriracha sauce,radish,guacamole,kalbi marinade
title: Kalbi 'n Chipotle (Smokey Slurpee)
ingredients: 4 ounces kalbi marinade, or more as needed ( kada ) | 3 tablespoons diced black olives | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1/2 cup chopped radish | sriracha sauce, or to taste | ice cube | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Whisk kalbi marinade, olives, tomato puree, and radishes together in a bowl to make dressing. Season with sriracha sauce to taste. Fill a tall glass with ice.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,broth,pecan,cane syrup,orange zest,white bread,watercress,green pepper
title: French Green Peppers & Pecans Filled With Bread and Watercress
ingredients: 3/4 - 1 lb green pepper | 1/4 cup pecan pieces | 4 tablespoons cooking spray | 4 tablespoons fat-free broth | 2 tablespoons unbleached cane syrup | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon fresh ground white bread, cut into 1/3 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons watercress or 2 tablespoons kale, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f place green pepper and pecan pieces on a sheet of aluminum foil large enough to completely wrap around the pepper pieces and bake for 30 - 35 minutes or until tender. Remove from oven, uncover and let stand for 5 minutes until cool. Meanwhile heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium high heat, then add the broth, maple syrup, and orange zest. Bring to a boil and cook until reduced to 5 tablespoons, about 10 minutes. When cool, transfer the mixture to a food processor or blender, blend for about 40 seconds. Spoon 1/3 cup into each bread cube, and cover with 2 tablespoons of the liquid. Cut the pepper pieces into strips about 1/2 inch thick. Spread the strips on a baking sheet, and bake in an oven for about 15 minutes or until crisp and hot, turning once. When all of the pepper fries are crisp in the middle, place on a platter, garnish with watercress.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,plain flour,colby cheese,green lentil,pork shoulder
title: Lentil and Pork Pies
ingredients: 1/3 cup green lentil | 4 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 1/3 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, chopped | 3 3/4 cups colby cheese or 3 3/4 cups brie cheese, coarsely grated | plain flour
instructions: Place lentils and yoghurt in a food processor, process to smooth.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces grape tomatoes, halved | 1 ounce dried currants | 4 cups cooked rice
instructions: Mix tomatoes, currants, and rice together in a serving bowl or salad bowl. Sprinkle with cinnamon and green onions.

title: Cauliflower Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup light lemonade | 1/3 cup garam masala | 1 head cauliflower floret, cut in thin strips | 2 cups rice noodles, cooked al dente
instructions: Combine the lemonade and garam masala in a small bowl and stir until smooth. Place the cauliflower florets in a large bowl, add salt to taste. Toss lightly with the dressing and add water as needed to absorb. Cover tightly and refrigerate until cold, at least 4 hours or up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: deli roast beef,beef sirloin steak,baby corn
title: Crock Pot Roast Beef and Corn
ingredients: 5 -6 -6 lbs beef sirloin or 5 -6 lbs top round roast | 5 -6 lbs deli roast beef | baby corn ( optional )
instructions: Place roast beef in crockpot and pour in the remaining juices. Cook on low 8 - 10 hours or high 4 - 5 hours. Shred the beef with 2 forks and serve with assorted veggies, rice, noodles or mashed potatoes.

title: Santa Fe Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice | 7 -8 marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cook rice according to package directions. Place marshmallows on a baking sheet. Spread rice evenly over marshmallows using a pastry brush. Bake 10 minutes.

title: Buttercotch Tomato Burritos
ingredients: 6 medium tomatoes ( about 1 pound ) | 1/4 cup diced scallion | 3 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 4 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Chop or crumble tomatoes, reserving 6 tomato pieces.

title: Cabbage Rice
ingredients: 1/2 medium head cabbage, shredded | 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Steam cabbage in boiling water for 10 minutes. Remove to a serving platter. Cover with hot water. Let stand 5 minutes. Put rice in a blender. Blend until creamy and liquid. Pour rice into a medium saucepan. Add vinegar, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, covered, over low heat for 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Hogao for Vietnamese Meatballs or Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck ( or other ground meat ) | 1 tablespoon orange flower water | 3 tablespoons dried quinoa | 1 tablespoon grated pecans | 1 tablespoon square scotch ( small piece of cheesecloth or cellophane, wrapped in a kitchen towel )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Prepare the meatball mixture by mixing the ground chuck together with the orange flower water until well blended and form into about 1 inch long balls. Place onto a rimmed baking sheet or pan. Bake at 500 degrees f for 3 to 5 minutes until cooked through. Meanwhile, make the rice by soaking it in salted cold water for 10 minutes. Drain the quinoa in a sieve over a bowl, pressing it with the back of your spoon to extract all of the flavorings. Set aside to cool. Combine all of the meatball mixture with the quinoa. Add the pecans and stir until evenly mixed. Form into 1 inch balls. Wrap the cheesecloth with kitchen towel and place on the steaks to weigh them down. Set the steaks aside. When ready to serve, place the meatballs on a preheated plate and pour the accumulated juices over them. Serve with green jasmine beans and rice.

title: Simple Tabbouleh
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken meat, fat trimmed | 1 cup dried flat-leaf italian parsley, washed | 1 lb dry bulgur
instructions: Rinse the chicken well, place in a large container, cover with water, then pour in enough filtered water to cover chicken. Let stand at room temperature for 24 hours or overnight. Place chicken pieces in a large pot and cover with fresh water. Bring to a boil. Add bulgur. Return to a boil and boil for one hour. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 30 minutes. Cut into serving sized pieces and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock chicken,kraft mexican four cheese,pizza crust,rice vinegar,marsala,chunky salsa
title: Easy Mexican Pizza #2
ingredients: 1 cup of your favorite thick and chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 cup vegetable stock or 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1/8 cup marsala | 2 lbs of any style pizza crust | 1 lb of kraft four cheese
instructions: Bake pizza crust. Combine salsa, vinegar, stock, and marsala in medium saucepan. Simmer over medium heat until mixture bubbles. Add cheese and mix well.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,self rising flour,jalapeno chile,oyster sauce,chili,oil
title: Quick and Easy Sesame Seed Cookies (Gingeh Gook)
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce ( or sub soy sauce if you prefer ) | 2 -3 teaspoons chili ( fresh or jalapenos- or a small jalapeno, depending on your heat tolerance ) | 1 seeded and minced jalapeno chiles | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable oil ( or olive oil for frying )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly spray a small baking sheet with vegetable oil spray, or line with parchment paper. Sift the flour into a medium size mixing bowl. Add the oyster sauce, chili, and jalapenos, mixing together with fingers. Add the chopped chile to the dry ingredients, and then mix in the oil with your fingers until well blended. Stir in just enough of the flour to make a stiff dough, and you've got a soft, slightly sticky dough. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface and knead for 5 minutes. The dough is now ready to be shaped or as you wish. Lightly flour your hands and shape the dough into small walnut size balls. Place the dough on the prepared pan, and then cover tightly with the greased parchment paper. Bake in the preheated 400f oven until they have browned slightly, 10 - 15 minutes. Let cool for a few minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Spanish Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup taco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add noodles, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: honey,seasoning salt,poppy seed,red chilies,no salt tomato sauce,bean,broccoli
title: Low Fat No-Sugar Red Chili Beans
ingredients: 2 cans fat-free refried beans | 2 cans no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1/3 cup honey | 4 medium dried red chilies, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes, stemmed and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 bunch broccoli, chopped ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup lightly packed chopped fresh spinach
instructions: Cook beans and tomato sauce in a large saucepan in simmering, not boiling water until thickened, about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in honey, chilies, salt and broccoli. Bring to boiling.

title: Taquitos De Queso
ingredients: 2 cans vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons guacamole or 3 tablespoons salsa
instructions: Pour the vegetable broth into a bowl. Add the guacamole, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,baking powder,coriander,jalapeno,vodka,corn,dark brown sugar,green onion
title: Pueblo Pork Stew
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 4 tablespoons ground whole coriander | 2 tablespoons good quality vodka | 3/4 cup dark brown sugar | 2 3/4 tablespoons baking powder, preferably dutch-process | 6 green onions, finely chopped with tops ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 medium jalapeno, minced | 2 cups frozen corn
instructions: Place pork shoulder in 2 - 3 qt slow cooker. In small bowl, mix all other ingridients and pour over pork. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 - 8 hours, til meat falls apart using two forks. Remove from slow cooker with a fork and pull apart. Use forks to shred meat. Serve on mashed potatoes with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: butcher kitchen twine,extra virgin olive oil,rack pork sparerib,vermicelli,egg yolk
title: Grilled Italian Sausage Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 24 dry vermicelli | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 rack of pork spareribs | 7 ounces sweet butterworths extra-virgin olive oil, room temperature | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
instructions: Whisk the yolks until pale and fluffy. Set aside. Rinse the spaghetti until it's completely dry and place in a fine mesh strainer. Place a cast iron griddle pan over medium high heat. When the pan is hot, dry all the way to the edge with some of the olive oil. When dry, fill the bowl with hot water with ice water. Place the spaghetti in the bowl and set aside to dry for a few minutes. Remove the strainer and drain. Place the drained spaghetti back into the strainer and rinse with a little hot water until it reaches the desired moistness. Set aside to dry for another few minutes. Remove from the strainer and let dry for a few additional minutes. Heat your grill to high. Oil the sides of the griddle pan with about 1 tablespoon of olive oil and place the sausage rack over the pan. Cook the sausage until browned and crisp on the outside. Remove from the grill and set aside to drain on paper towels. When the sausage is ready to serve, spread the vermicelli flat and using a spatula, poke holes in the noodles as many times and immediately spread each noodle with some of the vermicelli. Spread the cured pork spareribs with the remaining olive oil and place them alongside the vermicelli. Spread the sweet butterworths of the melted butter over the cheese and top with the cured sausage. Close the sandwich and serve with a bread to mop up the juices.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,green cardamom pod,plain yogurt,egg white,marshmallow,dark rum,beef roast,golden raisin
title: Rum Raisin and Mallow Beef Roll-Ups
ingredients: 5 lbs beef rolled beef roast ( rolled in ) | 2 large egg whites | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 4 tablespoons dark rum | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon | marshmallows ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve chicken bouillon in yogurt. Cut beef into 1 1/2 inch cubes add to yogurt, mix well. Form into 16 balls and roll in raisins. Place roll ups in a glass dish. Mix egg whites and cardamom in a small bowl. Dip roll ups in egg whites, then in the egg whites, and finally coat all sides of the roll ups. Refrigerate until ready to make the rolls. Cover with saran wrap and refridgerate overnight. Preheat oven to 325 degf and place rack in middle. Place meat roll ups in baking dish and pour in all but 3/4 cup of water. Cover tightly and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Remove from oven and remove plastic wrap and cover of saran wrap. Continue to bake for 1 hour. Remove from oven and let the roll ups cool before slicing and serving. Serve with gravy. Marshmallows is optional, just sprinkle on top of roll ups when served.

Random Ingredients: millet,beef,garlic paste,corn kernel,shiitake mushroom,mexican chocolate,nonfat milk powder,golden raisin
title: Maggie's Beef in Mole Sauce (For a Crowd)
ingredients: 4 lbs ground beef | 1 packet shiitake mushroom ( optional ) | 4 bags shiitake corn kernels | 2 cups nonfat dry milk powder ( i used the 1/4 packet table cream ) | 2 packages mexican-style chocolate | 1 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon garlic paste ( i think this would have used 1/2 tsp. ) | additional nonfat dry milk powder
instructions: Brown meat on all sides, drain. While meat is browning, mix corn kernels with ¾ cup water. Drain meat and rinse. Wrap meat in plastic wrap and place in crockpot. Sprinkle corn over lid and add the entire package of chocolate and ¾ of the raisins and garlic. When meat is ready, add the corn and all other ingredients and stir well. If the sauce seems to thick, add more water, ¾ cup at a time, stirring well after each addition. Note, i often add 2 tbsp of milk powder to the sauce for a creamy and chunky consistency. Serve with your favorite white or white rice.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,chinese egg noodle,pecan,salt pepper,thyme sprig,extra virgin olive oil,pistachio nut
title: Noodle Salad With Pecans and Pistachios
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw pecans, chopped | 1/2 cup shelled roasted pistachio nut, chopped | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 6 1/2 ounces fresh chinese egg noodles, broken into 2-inch lengths | salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig | 1 sprig fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Toast the pecans in a dry skillet until they begin to darken and smell fragrant about 2 minutes. Transfer them to a food processor and process until ground. Add the pistachios, chopped pecans, and oil and pulse until smooth. Toast, salt and pepper the noodles, then toss with the pistachios and pecans. To serve, snip the thyme sprig into 2 or 3 pieces and scatter them around the table for guests to build their own. Garnish with thyme sprigs and sprigs.

title: Polish Kielbasa and Celery Root (Bisami Kalbasa)
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa
instructions: Cut the polish sausage into ½ inch slices. In a pot add the polish sausage and the celery root. Cook it over medium for approximately 20 minutes, adding water as necessary. This will prevent drying and burning. Serve with butter or sour cream. You can also add grated cheese of your choice.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,hot chili pepper,pistachio nut,quinoa,ricotta cheese,kale,monterey jack cheese,chunky salsa
title: Mexican Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | 6 cups shredded kale | 2 jars chunky salsa ( i used mild ) | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese or 2 cups mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon chunky salsa ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons toasted pistachio nuts, or slivered ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 2 1/2 quart casseroles with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,parsley leaf,meat,dark chocolate,chicken tender,msg,asiago cheese
title: MEXICAN Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 chicken tenders | 2 pita bread | 1/4 cup finely chopped dried meat ( your favorite brand ) | 2 tablespoons shredded asiago cheese | 1 teaspoon salt ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon msg ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh parsley leaves, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place chicken tenders between towels to remove excess moisture. Pat dry. Place each tenders under broiler on ungreased baking sheet. Broil 5 inches from heat until crispy and beginning to turn golden, about 7 minutes.. Turn tenders over and brush top of all with oil. Broil the entire pan until a knife inserted in the thickest portion of each tendered is browned for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, or until no longer pink. Remove tenders to a warm platter. Cut each pita into 4 equal portions, then set aside. Spread the insides of each portion with the sauce ingredients. Sprinkle with the crumbled asiago cheese. Place chicken on top of any remaining sauce in each portion. Sprinkle with parsley leaves. Eat with chips or serve piping hot.

title: Noodles and Tamari
ingredients: 15 ounces ramen noodles | 2 packets cinnamon sugar | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon dried savory | tamari
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain and rinse with cold water. Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 11 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes.

title: Easy Nacho Cheese and Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa, drained | 2 packages neufchatel cheese, softened | 1 1/2 cups cooked whole wheat couscous or 1 1/2 cups uncooked couscous | 2 cups peas ( frozen or thawed )
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, stir together the salsa, cheese & cooked couscous. Mix in the peas to give an even distribution throughout. To prevent sticking, stir the mixture a few times. Cover & refrigerate for at least 3 hours or up to a day. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,chicken breast fillet,panir,cream cheese,raspberry vinegar
title: Phenomenal Chicken
ingredients: 800 g chicken breast fillets, cut into strips | 3/4 cup cream cheese, room temperature | 1/4 cup fresh baby spinach leaves | 1/4 cup thickened cream cheese, room temperature | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 10 small panir ( or any other tasty cheese, eg roquefort cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Line an oven proof dish with breadcrumbs. Mix cream cheese, spinach and cream cheese together. Fold in chicken strips. Drain well. Place in prepared dish. Bake 20 minutes until cooked through. Remove from oven and stir through remaining ingredients. Serve.

Random Ingredients: crisco,lemon,red potato,pancetta,tahini paste,golden raisin,vegetable stock chicken
title: Pommes Chef (Savoury Stuffed Potatoes with Pancetta)
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes, unpeeled and cut in half | 4 tablespoons pancetta fat | 1/2 cup vegetable stock or 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 -2 lemon rind, grated | 1 tablespoon tahini paste | crisco ( as much as you like ) or vegetable oil, for shallow frying ( as much as you like )
instructions: Cut the ends of the potatoes and clean, being careful not to cut all the way through. You do not want them to be perfectly uniform so that the slices sit flat on the board with the rounded end down. With a spoon or spatula, scrape out the centre of the potato slices. Place the potato slices in boiling water and allow to boil for a few mins or until just tender when pierced with a knife. While the potatoes cook, mix all the filling ingredients together in a bowl. To make the sauce, mix the tahini paste with plenty of freshly ground black pepper. Fry the potato slices in small batches until browned and well cooked but still a little crisp. Drain on absorbent paper towels and serve alongside the sauce. Variation, i sometimes add a couple of sprigs of parsley to the filling before frying. The dish can be prepared in the morning and reheated in a 350°f oven if necessary.

title: Spicy Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, chopped ( or other veggie ) | 1 package taco seasoning | 8 -12 ounces marinara sauce ( or a good quality homemade marinara ) | tabasco sauce ( optional ) | seasoning salt ( optional )
instructions: Mix up taco seasoning and place on serving plate. Add more garlic and tabasco to your taste and top with a few extra zaps of tabasco. Pour or add marinara sauce to taste.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,chipotle chile,pizza crust,grainy mustard,lasagna noodle,lemongrass
title: Chef Bevski's Lettuce, Garlic and Chipotle Lasagna
ingredients: 20 lasagna noodles | 1 bunch fresh lemongrass, white part only, peeled and sliced | 3 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 package dry pizza crust sheets | 1 chipotle chile, thinly sliced | 7 tablespoons grainy mustard | 1 cup crushed iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Layer lasagna noodles on a baking sheet and lightly drizzle with oil, tossing to coat noodles. Bake the noodles until tender, about 20 minutes. Place noodles on a medium baking sheet. Bake noodles until completely cool, about 10 minutes. Reserve 1 cup of noodles to dip.

title: Watermelon Smoothies
ingredients: 2 cups chopped fresh watermelon | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk | 1/2 cup low-fat milk | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Pour the watermelon and milk into a blender, adding more milk if needed. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to blend the flavors.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,cilantro leaf,red potato,shallot,chili sauce,sea salt,mango chutney
title: Sweet Potatoes - Thai Style
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs small red potatoes, scrubbed ( i buy spiral cut cut ) | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( may be substituted with round steak ) | 1/4 cup minced shallot | 1 can mango chutney | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt, to tast
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the potatoes, beef, shallots, chutney, sweet chili sauce and cilantro leaves. Toss lightly.

title: Lebanese Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons chicken broth | 1/8 teaspoon browning sauce
instructions: Boil broth with browning sauce until it has reduced. Add syrup and browned chicken to broth. Simmer for about 5 minutes or until chicken is cooked.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,hamburger bun,red potato,granola cereal,green grape,ham,pine nut
title: Ham and Gold Burger
ingredients: 2 large hamburger buns | 30 -35 slices cooked ham | 30 -35 slices cooked sweetened chickpeas | 1 1/2 cups red potatoes, cut into 8 wedges | 1 1/2 cups fresh green grapes, cut into 8 wedges | 3 cups granola cereal | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Top bread with grated cheese, chopped ham, chickpeas, potato and grapes. Sprinkle granola onto the salad. Place on a grid or barbecue. Grill until cereal melts.

title: Sausages Simmered in Brown Sugar
ingredients: 20 -24 lbs hot italian sausage | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Slice sausages about 1/4 thick. Place brown sugar in a 6 qt crock. Place sausages on top, pouring hot water over. Set aside for 6 hours or so, so that the sugar can be absorbed into the sausages. Cook in a very hot oven, broil or oven.

title: Sloppy Gi's Easy Noodles
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta | 1 can refried beans | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 package dried rice noodles
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook angel hair in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Mexican Avocado Pecan Spread With Almonds
ingredients: 5 dried hot chili peppers | 1 medium avocado | 4 tablespoons ground almonds, preferably whole milk | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed ( optional ) | ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon ground anise seed ( optional )
instructions: In a small skillet, roast and deseed the dried hot peppers. Do not peel or remove stems, burns, etc. Cool and use for flavoring. Toast the ground almonds in the oven until golden and fragrant. This will only take about 10 minutes. In a food processor, add the ground cinnamon, anise seeds, almonds and anise peppers. Process to a fine paste. If using anise pepper mixer add one tbsp of ground and 2 tbsp hot pepper, 1/2 tbsp hot coffee, 1 - 2 tbsp of ground anise seeds, ½ - 1 tbsp ground roasted almonds and ½ - 1 tsp ground coriander or ¼ teaspoon ground cayenne pepper.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,baguette,head lettuce,vegetable broth,macadamia nut,habanero pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,stew meat
title: Hawaiian Hot Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, cut into 1/4 inch cubes ( or more if the meat is extremely lean ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 cans condensed vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 2 tablespoons crushed macadamia nuts | 1 tablespoon finely minced habanero pepper ( or more to taste ) | 16 thin baguette slices ( or other hearty flat bread ) ( optional ) | 1 small head of lettuce, chopped crosswise ( optional )
instructions: Spray stew meat with vegetable oil cooking spray. Place in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat.

title: Homemade Curried Chickpea Flour
ingredients: 1 cup chickpea flour | 1/4 cup curry powder | 1/2 cup lemon juice
instructions: Mix the chickpea flour, curry powder and lemon juice to make a paste with just a couple of drops of water to aid the blending. You can then use this paste or place it in the refrigerator for a week or so. If you wish to keep this in your refrigerator for a longer period, the flavours will blend best. Once you are ready to cook, heat the oil in a pan or wok until medium heat. When it is hot, pour in the paste and stir for about 5 mins before flipping it over in the oil to let the bottom crispy. Be sure to flip the floured pieces over in the pan and keep stirring. The batter will start to thicken, and it will look quite thick. Sprinkle the top with sesame seeds just before serving.

title: Queso Dip Sierra Leone (Tex-Mex Dip)
ingredients: 1 cup sour tomato juice | 1 1/4 cups colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons mirin ( optional )
instructions: Heat the tomato juice in a microwave safe bowl in the microwave on high setting for 20 to 30 seconds. Stir in the colby/jack cheese and mirin. Cook until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Pumpkin-Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin, drained | 8 water chestnuts ( slices ) | 1 round rye bread, cut 1/3 inch thick ( about 32 slices ) | 1/2 cup salsa | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Lightly grease a loaf pan. In a bowl, combine pumpkin, water chestnuts& salsa, then spread 1/4 cup of mixture into the loaf pan. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until heated through. Remove from oven. Sprinkle top with nuts& serve warm or at room temp.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,extra virgin olive oil,mirin,cornstarch,barley,vanilla extract,vegetable oil
title: Microwave Barley and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked barley | 1 cup frozen broccoli florets | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup mirin | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Combine the barley, broccoli, cornstarch, 1/4 cup olive oil, vanilla, and 1/2 cup water in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Potato and Pork Bangers
ingredients: 2 packages frozen hash browns | 1 pound pork loin | 1 can water chestnuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the frozen hash browns on a baking sheet in a single layer. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the potatoes are tender, and have a little bit of crusty on them. While the potatoes are cooking, place the pork loin in a skillet with about 1/4 inch of water. Cook over medium high heat until browned, and slightly crusty. Drain the water from the pork loin, and shred the meat as finely as possible. Reserve the cooking liquid. Drain the potatoes, and place into a bowl. Mash the potatoes against the side of the bowl to get all the lumps out. Mix in the water chestnuts. Season with mustard powder. Spread a small amount of the pork filling onto the top of the potatoes, and pinch the top shut with a toothpick. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the potato topping is crispy.

title: BBQ Vegetable Shreds
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh asparagus, trimmed and sliced into thirds | 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved | 1 jar barbecue sauce, more if desired | 1/3 - 1/2 - 1/2-1 cup sliced fresh ginger snaps, chopped | 1/4 cup small curds
instructions: Bbq or grill asparagus until crispy and tender do not overcook.. Set aside. Combine barbecue sauce, ginger snaps and curd mix well. Set aside to cool. When serving, top with shredded asparagus and serve over greens toss.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,kaffir lime leaf,nonfat plain yogurt
title: Swiss Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 lemon leaf
instructions: In a nonstick saucepan, cover cheese with water and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,vegetable oil cooking spray,clear honey
title: Quick and Easy Pizza Chips
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 tablespoons clear honey | 4 tablespoons finely chopped italian flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Line the baking sheet with foil and spray. Add the honey and parsley to a shallow bowl and drizzle over 1 tablespoon of oil into this. Using a wooden spoon apply a small amount of the honey to the pizza base. Bake for approx 12 minutes or until the tops start to become golden and crisp. Turn the chips over and spray again. Replace the foil and continue to bake for approx 12 minutes or until the nuts are crisp and beginning to crisp up. Cool completely on the baking sheet before removing to cool on a wire rack.

title: Frozen Chickpea Soup With a Twist
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 cups canned chickpeas | 1 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 teaspoon caraway | 3 sage leaves | 3 -4 cups hot beef stock or 3 -4 cups strong coffee | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 2 -3 tablespoons liquid honey
instructions: Add oil to 6 cups stock or water. Add the dry spices. Heat on low for 20 - 25 minutes. Pour soup into bowls or plates, mix in honey and berries.

title: Gado De Res (Beef & Broccoli)
ingredients: 500 g sirloin beef ( cut into cubes ) | 300 g broccoli ( small florets ) | 3 -5 jalapenos ( whole ) | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1/4 cup tea, brew of your choice - brew from boiling | 500 g sirloin beef ( chinese style cut into bite sized pieces ) | 1 -2 cucumber
instructions: Take the sirloin steak and cut into cubes. Put aside. Wash broccoli or the broccoli and cut into small florets. Place a small tea pot on the heat it should be boiling and when it starts to boil begin to boil the pieces of steak in it. This will cook the starch from the broccoli. Keep stirring as you go until it starts to boil again. Reduce the heat and start making a stir for about 5 minutes after the 5 minutes turn of the stove. The goal is to prevent burning so watch it not to burn it. You have to look at the stir every 5 minutes stirring the time. Add the broccoli, the beef cubes, the jalapenos, the sugar, 1 tsp of the tea brew and mix them together. Stir for about a minute or two. When the stir is at the right consistency, open the lid and add the whole cucumber slices or the beef cubes. Stir for about 3 - 5 minutes, making sure your vegetables are just starting to cook as well. Serve the gado de res with hot steamed rice and a green vegetable.

title: Lebanese Pepper Salad (Halibut)
ingredients: 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 ounce sliced deli ham | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 lemon, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons brandy or 1 1/2 teaspoons sherry wine | 3 tablespoons light sugar | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Chop the yellow pepper into thin strips or chunks and marinate several hours or up to a day. Combine the chopped pepper strips with the rest of the ingredients and toss to combine. Serve warm.

title: Grape Leaves
ingredients: 5 cups treacle | 1 1/2 cups ground dried cilantro | 1 teaspoon ground peppercorn
instructions: Put treacle, cilantro and water in a heavy pot. Bring to a boil over heat. Cover and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in peppercorns. Pack into jars leaving at least one inch of headspace. Heat jars in a boiling water bath for 10 minutes. Pack in a hot water canner for 10 minutes.

title: Spice Balls (Hot Curry-Fried Spices)
ingredients: 1/8 cup choped wakame seaweed ( optional ) | 1/8 cup mild curry paste ( or more to taste ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 3 -4 tablespoons ghee ( can use oil, which gives the balls a chewy texture ) | 1 tablespoon ghee ( can use oil, which gives the balls a chewy texture ) or 1 tablespoon butter ( can use oil, which gives the balls a chewy texture )
instructions: Add 1/8 cup of choped wakame seaweed to a cup of cold water. Bring to a boil and simmer for about 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from heat and drain if desired. Set aside to cool to room temperature. When ready to use, in a medium bowl, mix all the curry paste ingredients and mix well. If using wakame, add the curry paste to wakame in the bowl and mix well. Add another tablespoon of ghee or canola oil and mix. Using a small ice cream scoop, scoop 1 ball from the bowl and fill with the curry paste mixture. Do not break the ball. Repeat until all the balls are filled. Pour oil into a wok until a light haze is formed. When it is hot, add the balls. After 1 minute, turn to medium high heat. You might not need all the juice from the wakame because they float when added to the oil. Fry until golden brown in color, about 3 minutes on each side. You should have approximately 2 - 3 cups of cooked wakame. Serve hot, straight off the plate, with plain low fat yogurt on top.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,mexican cheese,chicken leg,lasagna noodle,plain flour,dark beer,ham
title: Chili-Carne Chicken Legs
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken legs | 14 ounces dark beer | 9 ounces mexican-style cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 ounce dark rum ( you may not use half if so, i just find it ) | 5 ounces ham or 5 ounces bacon, diced | 12 lasagna noodles, cooked
instructions: Skin chicken if you wish and cut into serving sized pieces. In a large bowl mix the beer with the grated cheese, sifted flour, rum and ham or bacon. Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and leave to marinate overnight. Boil, steam or microwave the lasagne until just cooked. Drain. Rinse under very cold water and pat dry with kitchen paper. Spread some of the marinade on the bottom of an ovenproof dish. Layer the chicken pieces, pouring over the remaining marinade. Cover with grated cheese and grill in the oven on the grill or until the cheese has melted, and chicken is cooked and tender. Serve hot with your favourite green salad.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,mushroom,brown sugar,garlic salt,date,taco seasoning mix,phyllo dough
title: Spicy Fruit Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 cup chopped mushroom | 1 cup chopped dates | 1/3 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 2 cups shredded phyllo dough
instructions: Heat frying pan on high, then add the olive oil to coat. Add chopped mushrooms, cook for about 3 minutes or until the onions are clear then add the dates. Stir until they are beginning to brown, then add the orange juice. Add taco seasoning and let simmer with the vegetables and dates until they are slightly tender. When done, add the brown sugar. Add the cooked and drained phyllo dough to the vegetable mixture to thicken. Take mixture off the heat, and add some of the mixture until you get a spreadable consistency. Enjoy and enjoy i love to serve extra fruit for each meal.

title: Korean Coconut Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 fresh chinese cabbage, washed, trimmed and cut in four lengthwise, then sliced in 2-inch long pieces, lengthwise | 3 tablespoons grated lemon zest | 1/4 cup unsweetened coconut milk
instructions: Place cabbage in a bowl and coat with lemon zest. Pour coconut milk over cabbage and toss with hands until evenly coated. Adjust seasoning with kosher salt and cracked white pepper. Let sit for 5 minutes.

title: Rosemary & Garlic Puree (Raw Recipe)
ingredients: 4 bunches fresh rosemary ( cleaned of stems & heads ) | 1 pinch roasted red food coloring | salt & pepper
instructions: Wash & dry rosemary. Place the rosemary in a large bowl & add enough cold water to cover. Leave the stems for 10 minutes. Rinse under running water. Remove the stems. Place the rosemary & garlic purée in a food processor or blender. Add the roasted water & food coloring. Process, then add salt & pepper to taste. Note, if using a mortar & pestle, be sure to wear rubber gloves to do this & avoid contact with your eyes. Store in a clean, dry jar away from light & moisture. If using a blender, blend until very smooth to the consistency of cream cheese, or run through a fine mesh strainer to remove the lumps. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 months. You may add more or less food coloring to achieve a creamy color.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,baby spinach,chinese rice wine,ketchup,raisin,plain nonfat yogurt,flour tortilla
title: Protein Slamzas
ingredients: 4 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 3 cups baby spinach | 1 cup raisins | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons chinese rice wine | 4 small flour tortillas or 4 small pita bread
instructions: To make the broth, combine all ingredients and refrigerate. Wash and dry the spinach and add it to the yogurt along with the raisins. Chill for at least an hour. To serve, place a heaping tablespoon of the yogurt on a warm flour tortilla and spread thinly with the back of a spoon. Roll up and place on top of the rolled tortilla and serve.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,ancho chile powder,cayenne pepper,apricot jam,apricot,french bread,elbow macaroni,tomato pesto
title: Empanadas with Italian Sausage
ingredients: 2 cans tomato pesto | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 6 links bulk italian sausage | 1 cup apricot jam, warmed and divided | 1 package elbow macaroni, cooked | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1-inch thick slices | 3 cups apricot jam, warmed | 1/4 cup cayenne pepper, or more to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the tomato pesto, cayenne pepper, and ancho chile powder. Remove casings from sausage, crumble sausage into meat, and stir in 1 cup warmed jam. Place macaroni, 9x13 inch baking dish, and 8 ounces of meat on a clean work surface, and spread 2 tablespoons of the prepared sauce over the macaroni. Scatter 2 cups of apricot jam over jam layer, followed by 3 cups of bread, jam, and 2 more tablespoons of jam. Roll up and place the filled appetizers into the marinara. Repeat process with remaining ingredients. Pour the reserved 1 cup warm jam over the appetizer and bread, and spread remaining 1/4 cup of jam over bread. Set a cookie sheet in the refrigerator to keep cool while embilling the embastadas. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake in the preheated oven until the tomato sauce is bubbly and slightly browned on top, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,nutmeg,yellow squash,red capsicum,lime wedge,egg yolk
title: Australian Sweet Vegetables
ingredients: 100 g yellow squash | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg ( optional ) | 8 egg yolks, hard-boiled, peeled and slightly beaten ( optional ) | 1 small red capsicum, sliced ( capsicum ) | 1 teaspoon finely chopped lime wedge
instructions: Cut the squash in halves lengthways. Scatter over 2 tablespoons of the anchovy paste and nutmeg if using. Place the egg yolks on a small plate and beat. Dip the vegetables in the eggs and place on a tray. Broil until golden brown.

title: Blueberry Beef Pie
ingredients: 1 package unflavored gelatin | 3 lbs round steaks, cut into cubes | 2 lt. hot paprika ( not hot enough ) | 4 lbs russet potatoes, cut into chunks | 2 cups blueberries | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | 1 pie crust, baked
instructions: Sprinkle the gelatin over 1/2 cup hot water in a large bowl. Add the steaks a little at a time and allow to soften to room temperature. Bring the remaining jello mixture to a boil, add the potatoes and beat well. Pour the mixture into the pie crust and place into the refrigerator until set, about 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: maple sugar,pork sausage,blueberry,peanut butter,cantaloupe,chili sauce,currant,garlic salt
title: Baked Hawaiian Antelope Steak With Maple Syrup-Pickled Peanut Butter Sauce
ingredients: 1 large cantaloupe ( or other good-quality peach ) | 1 package mild pork sausage | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons maple sugar | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon currants or 1 -2 tablespoon golden raisins | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 cup fresh blueberries ( or frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. Arrange cantaloupe on a baking sheet and brush with some of the peanut butter sauce. In a food processor, puree the whole peach with the remaining dressing ingredients together. Arrange on the tray and bake until tender, about 15 - 20 minutes until puffed and slightly browned. Serve warm with hot maple pickled peanut sauce.

title: Grilled Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tamari soy sauce or 3 tablespoons braggs liquid tamari | 1 1/2 tablespoons brandy or 1 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 lettuce leaves | 1 small pineapple, peeled, pared and cut into 8 pieces | 1 cucumber, pared and sliced
instructions: Whisk tamari, brandy, and oil in a large glass or ceramic bowl until well blended. Toss lettuce, pineapple, cucumber, and pineapple salad with dressing. Season and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,chambord raspberry liquor,mexican cheese,chicken breast half,tofu,pecorino romano cheese,hot salsa
title: Chambord Chicken Quesadilla
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 1 pound zucchini, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 cup shredded cheddar-romano cheese blend | 1/4 cup chambord raspberry liquor | 1/4 cup hot salsa | 1/2 cup crumbled toasted pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place the chicken breasts into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink in the center. Remove from oven and let stand for 15 minutes. Slice the chicken into 1/4 inch thick strips. Place zucchini and montasio cheese into a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle cheddar and cio romano cheeses over mixture. In a small food processor mix chambord, hot salsa, and crumbled toasted pecorino romano cheese. Pour half of the chambord mixture over the cheese mixture and blend together. Spread half chicken over vegetable mixture and top with remaining vegetables. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until cheeses are melted. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: lime leaf,cold water,date,mint,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Easy & Delicious Minted Date Syrup
ingredients: 6 lime leaves | cold water | 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup cooking spray | 1 cup coarsely chopped of fresh mint | 4 dates, seeded and chopped ( about 2 1/2 cups, i use 2 cups of frozen )
instructions: Put lime leaves in a saucepan with cold water and bring to a boil over medium high heat until the water becomes cloudy. Remove from heat and pour into a blender, add oil and mint.

title: Bahama Mama Sweet Potato Pickles
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup water | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot, and fill with water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook about 10 minutes to soften. Drain, but reserve 1/2 cup of the cooking water. Place the chives and can of pineapple into a food processor, and pulse until smooth. Transfer the mixture into a bowl, and mash with a fork until smooth. Combine the chives and the pineapple into the potato mixture. Stir in the vinegar, water, golden syrup, thyme, and cayenne. Continue to stir until well combined. Cover the container with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Gnocchi With Kale and Lime
ingredients: 16 ounces gnocchi ( about 1 1-2 lbs ) | 1 lime, juice of | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke, plus more | liquid smoke, to drizzle | 3 -4 cups fresh kale
instructions: Heat a large saute pan over high heat until the bottom of the pan is smoking, but not too hot. Add the cumin seeds and allow to sizzle for a minute before adding in the liquid smoke. Stir in the gnocchi and continue to toss. When the gnocchi begins to soften, remove from heat and add the lime juice, cumin, and a few tablespoons of the liquid smoke, tossing to coat the gnocchi. Serve on fresh kale leaves.

title: Elegant Sausage Stuffing Sandwich (Low Fat & Free)
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced red onion | 1 avocado, diced ( can use another type if you like ) | 1/4 cup grated lemon zest ( also can use 3 drops lemon juice or 1/2 tsp. s ) | 1 cup light sausage ( your favourite brand or brand with the casings removed ) ( optional ) or 1 cup diced cooked turkey ( your favourite brand or brand with the casings removed ) ( optional ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups whole wheat bread, cubed ( see below )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place a non stick cooking spray on a foil lined cookie sheet. Combine the onion, avocado, zest, and any seasonings you wish to use. Add the sausage or turkey if using. Use one or more of these to generously fill the loaf tins. Add just enough stuffing from the loaf to make a stuffing shape or you can mix it up with a knife as you wish to ensure the stuffing is fully prepared. Put the pan of sausage or turkey mixture into the preheated oven and let bake for 20 - 20 minutes, occasionally stirring the pan, or until a golden brown crust is formed on top. During the last few minutes of baking, toast the bread rounds or toast in the oven. Serve warm or cold.

title: Lamb Kebab and Pasta
ingredients: 2 1/3 lbs lamb meat | 8 ounces bow tie pasta, dried, cooked al dente | 2 tablespoons dark raisins | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons canned sweetened coconut, flaked and softened | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 4 kaiser rolls, split ( your choice )
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 cubes. Thread onto metal skewers making sure they are slightly longer than the meat. Place on skewers in a large shallow baking dish or dish. Mix together the raisins, parsley, coconut, liquid smoke and kraisins. Spread mixture over the meat. To make your kabobs, lightly oil your hands. Cut the open sides of the rolls and place a skewer of meat at the top of the rolls, using your hands and wetting them. Bake, uncovered, in a moderately hot oven about 40 minutes, or until lamb is well browned.

title: Israeli Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 1/4 cup sweet paprika, sweet | 16 ounces israeli couscous | 20 medium marshmallows | 1 1/2 cups miniature marshmallows ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1 cup hot salsa | ice cream or cream
instructions: For dressing, mix mayonnaise and sweet paprika. Cover and chill. For filling, add a dash of salt. Cook in small fry pan with sunflower oil and marshmallows. Cool. Break up couscous. Stir into cooled onion. When cool enough to assemble, coat bowl and top with mayonnaise mix. Arrange the sliced marshmallows on top. You may wish to add 2 tablespoons of water to cover before sprinkling some on top. Enjoy.

title: Japanese Style Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 2 medium russet potatoes, peeled | 2 white button mushrooms, sliced thick | 4 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Wash potatoes well until no trace of sand or grease remains. Cut each potato into 2 inch squares. Place 1 cup water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Add potatoes.

title: Pan De Sal
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 cups hot cooked sausage, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 4 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 1/2 cups chopped unpeeled anchovies | 12 fluid ounces chow mein noodles or 12 fluid ounces chow mein noodles
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sausage and 4 cups of water. Dissolve the yeast in the hot water, then stir in 4 cups of the cooking liquid. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Put the mixture into a very large greased bowl, cover with a towel, and leave it in a warm place until the dough is doubled in bulk, about 1 1/2 2 hours. Dough should not be sticky. If too sticky, increase the amount of cooking liquid. When the dough is risen, punch it down and divide it into six pieces. Shape each piece into a ball. Knead each piece on a lightly floured surface for about 10 minutes, or until smooth and elastic. Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk, about 30 minutes.. Prepare noodles by soaking them for about 7 minutes in warm water. Drain well and pat dry with paper towels. Cover with oiled plastic wrap. Let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes. Preheat the oven to 425°f divide the dough into thirds. To make the chow mein, lay a piece of reynolds wrap on a damp kitchen towel. Tightly roll each piece of dough into a tight roll about 30 inches long. Dip finger tips into cold water if desired. Dip each piece into noodles, then arrange them on the towel, and pat dry again. Transfer to a rimmed baking sheet. Bake until lightly golden, 30 - 40 minutes, switching the position of the pans halfway through.

title: Chickpea Crostini
ingredients: 1 ciabatta bread | 1 can chickpeas | 2 -3 ounces velveeta cheese | 1 ounce simple syrup
instructions: Take the bread. Cube velveeta cheese, add to bread, add a can of chick peas and a couple of shakes of sugar to cover all the chick peas. Broil or roast in a low oven until the cheese has started to melt, watch the bread to see how this is going to thicken. When it is going to melt, cut it to slices. Put toasted slices on a plate with a piece of toasted bread to dip into the chickpea mixture.

title: Minty Bread Salad
ingredients: 500 g vermicelli | 100 g dried figs | 1/4 cup prepared tzatziki, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/simple-tzatziki-953584 '' > simple tzatziki < /a >
instructions: Boil vermicelli in salted water until cooked, drain & cool. Cut into 3cm lengths & place in a serving dish. Cut figs into 3cm lengths & place in a bowl. Toss with tzatziki & serve with the noodles.

title: Hoppel and Beans
ingredients: 2 teaspoons oil | 1 pound black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium high heat and add the peas and black eyed beans. Cook and stir until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: parsley,cilantro leaf,chicken thigh fillet,vegetable broth,black bean,heavy cream
title: Spicy Black Beans
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken thigh fillets, thickly sliced | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained, juices reserved | 1 can fat-free reduced-sodium vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped plus extra to garnish | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped plus extra to garnish | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream, lightly whipped with a splash of cream for garnish
instructions: In a medium size bowl, toss together chicken, beans, broth, parsley and cilantro. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Garnish with extra chopped parsley and cilantro and serve over fettuccine pasta. Variation with cooked fettuccine, you may serve on italian bread, or on a salad.

title: Creamy Italian Crostata With Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 5 ladyfingers
instructions: In bowl stir together italian dressing, cornstarch and italian dressing. Coat ladyfingers in italian dressing. Grill quickly until browned and crispy.

title: Quick and Easy Rotini With Spinach & Parsley
ingredients: 12 ounces rotini pasta ( tri-colored long pasta ) | 1 cup diced parmesan cheese | 3 cups frozen chopped spinach with stems, thawed & well-drained | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 1 tablespoon cider vinegar or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 cup dry white wine or 1/2 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Basic Microwave Poached Desserts
ingredients: 3 cups white wine vinegar, chilled | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Whisk vinegar, tamarind paste and spices together in a small bowl. Serve warm.

title: Ham, Tomato and Greens Salad
ingredients: 1 bag italian bread, sliced | 1 head escarole, chopped into small pieces | 3 -4 heads cherry tomatoes, quartered | 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit | 1 teaspoon caribbean hot sauce ( or other ) | 1 lb fully cooked ham | 1 jar ripe olives
instructions: Tear off about 20 leaves of bread, discard other 1/2 of stems. Cut the bottom part of the bag into about 1 long pieces and set aside until you're ready to use. Slice the remainder of the bag into about 1 wide slices and place into the bottom of a salad bowl. Slice swiss cheese into small pieces and place in bottom of bowl. Dice tomatoes into small pieces and place into bowl. Dice olives and place in bowl. Cut ham into 1 to 1 1/2 cubes and place into bowl with tomatoes. Add remaining ingredients, except bread and olives, to bowl and mix. Place torn bread slices into salad bowl and pour dressing over bread and tomatoes. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving. Serve at room temperature.

title: Spinach, Chicken and Purslane Salad With Quark
ingredients: 150 g mixed frozen spinach, thawed ( or just under 2t pack, packed ) | 3 slices chicken breasts, cooked and shredded | 1/2 cup purslane, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: Toss spinach on a warm serving platter with a sprinkling of soy sauce, salt and pepper. Arrange chicken on top.

title: Cousin
ingredients: 1/2 pound cremini mushrooms, quartered | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 pound penne pasta
instructions: In a saucepan, bring salted water to a boil. Add pasta and salt to boiling water, and cook for 10 to 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,arborio rice,golden raisin,thyme,salt black pepper,peppercorn,apple cider,lemon pepper
title: Apple Bread Pizzas With Pecorino
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups reduced fat italian-style whole apple cider | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 teaspoon ground oregano or 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 5 -6 peppercorns ( more or less to taste ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1/4 cup golden raisin or 1/4 cup dried apricot, chopped ( garnish ) ( optional ) | 3 -4 prepared pizza crusts ( see related recipe )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place the cider in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Add the lemon pepper and cook just until it starts to reduce, but does not boil. You may need to add some more of the apple cooking liquid. If the cider starts to get dry while you are heating, add a little apple liquid to the pan. Cook the arborio rice with the oregano or seasoning in the cooking cider until it is al dente, about 40 minutes. Add the peppercorns, reduce heat and continue cooking until the rice is very soft. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Spread about 1/4 cup of the crumbled cooled italian style pecorino onto 2 pregreased pizza crusts. Divide the cooked rice between the crusts, leaving 1/4 inch of crust in each pizza crust. If desired, garnish the pizza with a little more chopped peppercorns. Top with a sprinkling of the raisins and apricots over the rice mixture. Place crusts on baking sheets lined with parchment paper. Bake about 12 minutes or until pizzas are lightly golden but crisp on the outside and cheese has melted. You may serve the pizzas flat. These will keep well in the refrigerator until ready to make. These can also be frozen.

instructions: Put the shrimps into a large stockpot, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for about 1/2 hour until the shrimp are just pink.

Random Ingredients: white bean,mint leaf,sultana,dark chocolate,pie shell,oven deli chicken,fruit
title: White Bean and Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 oven deli chicken | 120 g white beans, drained and finely chopped | 80 g sultanas, chopped | 1 pie shell, baked as per directions on the package | 1/4 cup dark chocolate, grated | fresh mint leaves, to garnish | 1 -2 tablespoon fruit, diced ( optional )
instructions: Place all filling ingredients into crust, place over the simmering meat and bake at 180°c for approx 20 - 30 minutes or until filling is heated through and golden and crispy. Serve with grated black chocolate or other flavourful melted dark chocolate.

title: Chicken and Red Currant Mexican Gravy I
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs ( bone-in or skinless, about 3 lbs. ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 jar mild salsa | 1 package red currant jelly
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300º. Place chicken thighs in a large non reactive roasting pan along with any other meat that they have been flattened. Sprinkle the cubes with salt and pepper. Spread the jelly over the chicken and place chicken in the pan. Cover and bake, basting occasionally, 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until meat is cooked through and sauce thickens sufficiently.

title: Prawn With Hoisin and Oat Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 kg large fresh mussels, live scrubbed and de-bearded | 300 ml light coconut cream | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons toasted oatcakes, crumbs | 1 tablespoon coconut cream, extra
instructions: Put all the prepared ingredients into a food processor except the coconut cream. Process until the mixture forms small patties with plenty of little bite. Tip onto baking paper lined oven trays. Preheat oven to 200°c grease a baking dish and bake patties for 10 - 15 minutes, or until just cooked through and golden and sticky to the touch. Serve immediately with toasted oatcakes.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,canadian bacon,prawn,chicken thigh,bean,pizza crust,chili powder
title: Canadian Bacon and Prawn Pizza
ingredients: 1 teaspoon canadian bacon, minced | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon dry active yeast | 1/4 cup warm, 105-115 f ( or body temperature ) | 2 lbs prawns, peeled, deveined | 1 lb boneless chicken thighs or 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | instant fresh pizza crust
instructions: Place the dry yeast in a small cup along with warm water. Allow to dissolve slightly, about five minutes. Add the canadian bacon, chili powder and dry active yeast. Transfer the prawns and chicken to a large ziplock bag and shake well to drain excess water. Place the prawns and chicken on a baking sheet and coat with cooking spray. Cut the pizza into wedges.

Random Ingredients: thyme,curry leaf,soya sauce,chicken bouillon granule,feta,tomato paste
title: Feta Cracker

Remove feta dish from oven, stir tomato paste, soya sauce, curry leaves and thyme into feta and bake until heated through, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Curt's Spaghetti Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup parmesan-reggiano cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons cointreau liqueur ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon bread crumbs, for coating | 1/4 cup margarine, melted or 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine melted margarine or butter, cointreau, and bread crumbs. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Add the cheese mixture and stir until mixture just holds together. Add more cheese if necessary.

title: Dolores
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons honey | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla | 1 can pinto beans or ( 16 ounce ) can kidney beans, drained | candlenut, for decorating ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, stir together the honey and vanilla. Add pinto beans and stir until heated through, about 2 minutes. Serve topped with a sprinkling of candlenut, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chocolate pudding mix,pearl onion,parsley flake,icing sugar,lime zest
title: Nama Mama's Chocolate Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 10 ounces frozen pearl onions | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 lime, zest of, grated | 2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes
instructions: Poke holes all over top of each onion using a fork. Cook onions in a non stick skillet. When they are browned a little, remove from pan. Spread chocolate pudding mix over onions and sprinkle with the cinnamon. Top with fresh parsley if desired.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,maple syrup,white mushroom,baby lima bean,kernel corn,thai red curry paste,courgette,steak
title: Beef With Vegetables
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef or 600 g chicken, cut into bite-sized chunks | 1/2 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1 can sliced white mushrooms | 1 cup frozen baby lima beans ( or fresh ones ) | 300 g whole kernel corn, canned | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | freshly grated maple syrup ( to garnish ) or honey ( to garnish ) | shredded carrot ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat oil in a large frying pan on low flame. Add beef and stir around until brown. Remove meat, add thai red curry paste and stir fry on high for 2 minutes. Add sliced mushrooms for 1 minute. Add the frozen lima beans and stir to coat completely. Add the corn and stir briefly, then add a large handful of the cheddar cheese. Stir until the cheese has melted completely, then pour into a shallow serving dish. Sprinkle freshly grated maple syrup or honey over the top of the beef and veggies. Garnish with a few grated carrots. Cover and chill 1 hour or overnight to allow flavours to develop.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,dark chocolate,yogurt,purpose flour,onion powder,shallot,peach
title: Peach and Yogurt Balls
ingredients: 6 small strawberries | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1 tablespoon finely chopped shallot | 8 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate | 1/8 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: Remove the rind from the strawberries and place in a small heavy saucepan and cook over low heat, uncovered, for about 5 minutes or until a small amount of the liquid remains. Remove the berries from heat and remove the berries from the pan and place in a food processor. Add the onion, shallot and yogurt and process until the mixture is smooth. Fold flour, chocolate and food coloring into the batter. Cover and chill for 1 hour or until firm.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,mozzarella ball,mustard powder,yellow squash,celery,sumac,serrano chilies
title: Savoury Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash ( about 2/3 ) | 2 serrano chilies | 3 large mozzarella balls ( about 2/3 pounds total ) | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme or 1/2 teaspoon white mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon ground celery | 1/2 teaspoon toasted mustard powder | chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley ( optional )
instructions: Quarter the squash lengthwise and cut each half crosswise into 3 thin slices using a serrated knife. Slice the 2 chiles into thin narrow strips with a serrated knife. Cut the mozzarella into small slices with a peeler. Place 2 serrano chile triangles, 2 slices mozzarella, and 1/3 cup dressing in a food processor. Pulse until smooth. Add to the food processor mixture and pulse until combined. Place in a large bowl and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder, thyme and celery. Toss with a fork. Serve with chopped parsley if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,black olive,chicken turkey,mint leaf
title: Baked Stuffed Avocados
ingredients: 4 whole roasted chicken or ( 5 ounce ) baked turkey, stuffing ( chicken stuffing ) | 4 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 5 tablespoons finely chopped black olives | 7 medium size avocados
instructions: Make sure you take note of the amount of stuffing. Take a ripe avocado, remove the pit and scoop out the pulp with a spoon. Using an avocado or melon baller scoop out the meat leaving a 3/4 1/2 inch border. Set the shells on a baking sheet or cookie sheet and fill with stuffing. If using turkey in stuffing sprinkle with mint. Make a slit in the avocado to give the stuffing a room to stuffing later. Put stuffing on top of stuffing and cover with olive slices. Place in the oven at 375 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes, or until stuffing is warmed. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Plantain Pancakes
ingredients: 1 medium plantain | 1/4 cup uncooked jasmine rice, coarsely grated ( can use shortgrain brown rice if preferred ) | 2 tablespoons finely ground ajwain | 1 1/4 cups canned chickpeas, well drained | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 dash caraway seed
instructions: Trim the ends off the plantain, and scoop out all the grated pulp and core. Cut the plantain into 1/4 inch slices and spread out on paper towels to dry. Grind the plantain to a crumbly consistency in a grinder. Heat up a nonstick frying pan or griddle over medium heat, and when it is hot lightly brush with cooking oil. Spread a thin layer of oil or margarine on a shallow baking sheet. When the pan is very hot, but not smoking, place the grated plantain in the middle. When the oil is hot, place the plantain slices in a few criss cross patties. Fry for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, or until dark golden. Drain the cooked plantains on paper towels, and keep hot. Repeat until all the cakes have been fried. Combine the rice, ajwain, chickpeas, chili sauce, vinegar and caraway. Drain the excess oil from the frying pan. Serve with plantain pancakes.

title: Red Curry Vinegar
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Combine the red curry paste and red wine vinegar in a small bowl. Stir until evenly mixed.

title: Goats Cheese & Mango Salad With Basil Rollups #5FIX
ingredients: 8 ounces goat cheese, room temperature | 1 medium red english cucumber ( unpeeled ) | 1 medium mango, peeled, seeded and cubed ( seedless ) | 5 ounces mixed salad greens ( i use spring mix greens ) | 1/2 medium spanish onion, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Spread goat cheese on one half of cucumber.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,five spice powder,pizza dough,allspice,spaghetti
title: Spaghetti Bites
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza dough, thawed | 1 can condensed beef stew meat | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 package dry spaghetti
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together pizza dough, beef stew meat, five spice, and allspice until evenly combined. Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cut with a 3 inch biscuit cutter to cut into squares. Arrange the squares on the baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the top of crust is golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chilli Macaroni With Chipotle Pesto
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat pasta | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 red pepper, seeded & diced | freshly ground tabasco brand pepper sauce, to taste | creole seasoning | 1/2 cup fresh basil, minced ( or 1 teaspoon dried ) | 1 teaspoon celery leaves, minced | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar
instructions: Cook pasta according to recipe. Meanwhile, in a food processor, combine scallions, red pepper, chile, tabasco sauce, creole seasoning, basil, celery and sugar. Process until smooth, scraping sides of bowl as needed.

instructions: Slice bok choy head lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Set aside. In a large skillet, add bok choy and bourbon and turn heat to medium. Cook, stirring, until liquid reduces by half. title: Homemade Nut Stuffing
ingredients: 1/2 lb hazelnuts | 1/2 cup italian parsley
instructions: Grind hazelnuts in an electric spice grinder, pulsing once or twice.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,dill,puff pastry,kidney bean,celery,russet potato,greek yogurt
title: Beef & Potato Turnovers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry dill | 1 beef brisket | 4 russet potatoes, peeled | 2 cans kidney beans, drained | 1 container greek yogurt | fresh dill | 2 packages frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees f. Remove the excess fat from the brisket. Cut brisket into 3/4 inch slices. Reserve the fat for another use. Place the potato halves in a medium baking dish. Place the potatoes in a colander, then rinse under cold water to remove salt. Pat the potatoes dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with dill. Set aside. Place the brisket slices between two sheets of wax paper on a solid, level surface. With a rolling pin, press a flat sheet of pastry into a 6x3 inch rectangle. Spread the kidney beans over the crust in 3 even rows, then spread the potato slices over the beans. Top with a thin layer of shredded wheat. Using the back of the table to aid you, roll the pastry up like a jelly roll. With a sharp knife, make several 1 inch slits in the dough. Repeat with the remaining dough, kidney beans, and cheese. With a sharp knife, make diagonal slits along the loaf to make diamond shaped pices. Using a sharp knife, score the top layer of pastry crosswise every 3 to 4 slices. Bake until pastry is golden brown and crisp, about 40 to 45 minutes. Remove from oven. Remove parchment.

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp vinegar and 1 tbsp mustard in a small saucepan. Add the mushrooms and sauté over a low heat for 5 minutes, or until reduced to almost nothing. instructions: In a wok or skillet, saute the asparagus in a little tabasco sauce until slightly woody, about 3 minutes.. instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl, mixing with electric mixer. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours roll and shape into balls, press down firmly. Store in an airtight container.

instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinade for one hour. Thread beef onto skewers and grill 3 minutes per side until seared. Serve over rice.

title: Coco-Tofu in Avocado
ingredients: 300 g mushrooms, sliced | 300 g tofu, cubed | 2 tablespoons lime juice, zest of | 1 ripe avocado, sliced | 1/2 cup roasted sweet basil leaves
instructions: Sauté mushrooms in a little oil until just beginning to soften. Mix in the rest of the ingredients. Serve hot or cold.

title: Hot Sangrita
ingredients: 1 cup dried lentils, rinsed | 2 quarts vegetable stock | 1/2 lb hot italian sausage, coarsely chopped or 1/2 lb hot italian sausage | 1/2 cup chopped banana | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 package icing sugar | 1 bunch clams, to scrub around the outside of the dish | 6 pieces sea bass fillets
instructions: Place the lentils in a large saucepan, and cover with 2 quarts of the vegetable stock. Bring back to a boil over high heat, then add the sausage. Once the sausage is no longer pink in the center, remove the sausage and drain, breaking it up well as you go. Drain the remaining stock from the pan, and use it to bring some to the lentils. Stir in the vinegar and sugar, stirring to dissolve. Set aside. Cover and place in a warm place to double in size. This will take about an hour. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Wash and pick over the clams and then place the bottom of the baking dish upside down in a roasting pan that is just large enough to accommodate the fish fillets. Cut a cross at the top of the fillet to allow for easy handling of clams. Cut a slit in the side of each clam shell just below the eyes. Arrange the small clams into the dish. Cover with the lentil broth and season with salt and pepper. Cover and place in the oven on the middle rack for about 45 minutes. Remove from the oven and remove the fish fillets from the broth. Place the fish fillets into a shallow dish and pour the cooking juices over them. Cover and refrigerate for at least two hours, then serve.

title: Carciofi (Spicy Pasta W-Cilantro and Pistachios)
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces penne pasta, dried | 1 small shallot, minced or 2 tablespoons fresh onion flakes | 2 medium fresh chili peppers, such as hot pepper flakes ( such as jalapeno or serrano ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds ( lightly toasted if desired ) | 2 tablespoons chopped toasted pistachios ( lightly toasted if desired )
instructions: Place pasta in a pan of boiling water and cook according to package directions. Drain, reserving 1 cup of pasta water. title: The Simplest Crumb Topping for Vegetables

instructions: Put sultanas into a microwavable bowl. Cut bread into squares, or into squares, and cover sultanas with sultanas. Microwave on medium high 5 to 7 minutes, or until golden. Allow to cool a little, and then transfer to an airtight container for a snack.

instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions drain. Return ziti to pan and add chili flakes. Stir in well drained, dry pasta. Pour pasta mixture into a 9 x 13 x 2 pan with hot nonstick spray. Sprinkle with a dash of salt and pepper if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Chipotle Pasta

instructions: In 2 quart microwavable casserole, melt shortening over high heat. Remove from heat.

title: Quesadillas II

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the avocado slices onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven, and bake until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

title: Tortilla Espanol (Microwave Peas and Olives)

instructions: Mix well, cover, & cook on hi for 7 minutes or until the peas are tender. Toss with olives before serving.

title: Italian Salsa Dip

instructions: Combine the tomato juice, orange juice, ranch dressing mix, paprika, and vinegar in a pan.

title: Cranberry and Tamarind Raita (Indian Punjabi Dessert)

instructions: Take the cranberries and put them in the blender. Take the cranberry juice and put it into a small bowl or measuring cup. title: Clams Cassoulet in Sherry

instructions: Preheat oven to combine meat and bread cubes. In a bowl, combine pork, sherry and chopped shrimp or lobster. Heat through. Stir fry or microwave lima beans, lima beans and hot cooked pork mixture until heated through. Drain. Spoon meat and shrimp or lobsters evenly into a 13 x9 baking dish or 9 x9 casserole dish.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix yellow cake mix, provolone cheese, coleslaw mix, rosemary leaves, and black mustard seed together in a bowl.

instructions: In a large pot of water, cook pasta per package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, place the beans in a large roasting pan. instructions: Mix together the crumbs, mustard seed, thyme, cabbage and red pepper until everything is well combined. instructions: Spread rice evenly on a clean dry surface. Spread crab evenly over the rice. Cover with a layer of lettuce leaves. Using one of the lettuce leaves, roll the roll up the roll into a log shape and press firmly against the lettuce leaf. Serve immediately.

title: Beef and Asparagus Sandwich -- Giada De Laurentiis

instructions: Cut the sirloin steak in half lengthwise and then crosswise into thin slices about 3/4 inch thick. Heat a grill pan over high heat. In a bowl, combine the asparagus, panko, monterey jack cheese, basil and 1/2 cup water.

title: Quinoa and Taco Bell Tacos

instructions: Rinse the quinoa with cold water. Drain well. Place in medium saucepan and cover or bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and cook, covered. Add yogurt and reduce heat. instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. In a large, shallow heat proof microwave safe dish, fry the sausage, breaking any large pieces up with a rolling pin to ensure they don't stick. Serve with chips and steamed vegetables.

title: Irish Clam Patties

instructions: Combine parsnip, tomato, breadcrumbs and clam juice in a bowl. Stir in egg and mix well.

instructions: Combine sirloin and rice, combine with spices, and divide into four portions. Form into patties on the grill. Brush with sesame seeds while cooking.

title: Sopa De Maiz (Vietnamese Dumplings)

instructions: Add bread flour and 1 cup cold water to a bowl. Gradually add white flour and knead for 8 - 10 minutes until dough is elastic and comes freely from the side of the bowl.
