Cover every few hours or overnight to allow pork to relax and flavors to blend. Once cooked remove from heat and let rest for 15 - 20 minutes. Form small balls, then flatten into sausages about 5 mm thick. Place on a tray and cook at the same temperature for 10 - 15 minutes until dough is firm. Use 1 teaspoon of dough to fill the bottom of a large pot with water. Add a small amount of the dough and submerge the sausages. Cover with a lid to avoid boiling. When the water begins to boil lower heat and simmer for 1 hour. You can also eat them straightforward and served with rice.

title: Ww Core Friendly Slow Cooker Bean Dip

instructions: Add all ingredients in slow cooker. Stir. If the dip is too thick, stir in a bit of water with a spoon. Cook on low 7 - 8 hours.

title: Cheesy Penne With Pecans
ingredients: 10 ounces penne, uncooked | 1 lb asiago cheese ( grated or sliced with your fingers ) | 1 bunch pecans, toasted, coarsely chopped coarsely | 8 ounces dry spaghetti
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling, salted water until al dente. Reserve ¼ cup pasta cooking water. Drain pasta and return to the pot. Add cheese and remaining 1 1/2 cup cooking water and mix well. Add pecan pieces. Heat and toss over low heat 1 to 2 minutes, until cheeses are melted. Serve with lots of red wine.

title: Curai Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole grain white rice | 2 teaspoons curry paste ( indian, indian, or caribbean curry paste, to taste )
instructions: Heat rice cooker and follow manufacturer's directions for regular steaming. When rice switches to warm pad, wait a few seconds until steam forms, then fluff with a fork. Return cover. Press steam cycle and set on high, 5 minutes. Remove rice from steamer and let sit 1 - 2 minutes. Fluff with fork and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: water artichoke heart,green cardamom pod,parsley leaf,velveeta cheese,honey,vegetable stock,salad oil
title: Artichokes in Honey-Sauce(Vegan)
ingredients: vegetable stock | 1 cup dried salad oil | 1 cup water-packed artichoke hearts, rinsed | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 - 1 1/2 cup honey | 6 -8 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into cubes ( a little over 2/3 c ) | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves ( optional )
instructions: Boil water about 10 minutes, then plunge artichokes into ice water to stop the cooking process. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Place artichokes in a single layer on a microwave safe plate, cover with a lid, and microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes until the artichokes are tender. Remove cardamom pods from microwave, and drop in 1 to 2 tablespoons of honey. Let cool, then stir to mix in cheese. Makes 6 cups. To serve, top each bowlful with a small piece of the artichoke heart. Sprinkle with the parsley.

title: Black Bean-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 button mushrooms | salt and pepper | 3 tablespoons black bean paste | 50 g hazelnuts ( optional )
instructions: Clean the mushrooms, removing any dirt, stalks and stems. Fill mushroom caps with equal portions of the black bean paste. Wash over with hot water and let soak in the fridge for a few hours. Grill the mushrooms for 20 - 25 minutes until light brown on top. Slice and sprinkle with hazelnuts. Enjoy.

title: Lemon Syrup or Sugar (Tirk Khong Jeow)
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters chicken bouillon | 1 2/3 liters granulated caster sugar
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle crush the chicken base or bouillon very well and then mix in the granulated sugar. Place in a wide mouth glass jar with a tight lid. Store in an cool dark place for a few months, shaking occasionally. Use 1 heaped tablespoonful for each serving. When used as a sandwich spread, thicken with your favourite jam and/or syrup.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,okra,white kidney bean,corn syrup,sea salt,catsup,guinness stout
title: American Okra and Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 300 g black-eyed peas, soaked overnight | 1 small green guinness stout | 200 g corn syrup | 175 g white kidney beans, cooked | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon catsup
instructions: Add the wine to the soaked beans and bring to the boil. Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Combine beans, corn syrup, kidney beans, sea salt, and vanilla essence in a large bowl. Add catsup and stir well. Remove salt as the beans absorb the flavors. Pour bean mixture onto salad and serve immediately, or leave overnight to cool and cool. Add more sea salt or sugar to taste.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,plain yogurt,spring onion,chicken breast,beef brisket,sage,chili pepper flake
title: Italian Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 bunch fresh sage | 6 leaves fresh italian herbs | 1 -2 fresh chili pepper flakes | 2 -3 boneless skinless chicken breasts | sage, extra per chef's choice | chili pepper flakes, extra per chef's choice | 1 spring onion, extra per chef's choice | 1 -2 slice of extra virgin olive oil ( garnish )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450 degrees. Dice the beef brisket up into small, bite sized bite sized pieces and place into a baking dish large enough to hold them in one layer. Sprinkle the shredded soy and shredded sage, lemon pepper flakes, chili flakes and sage leaves, and extra dried herbs of your choice into a small bowl. Cover the baking dish with foil and roast for 35 - 45 minutes. Serve.

title: Irish Potatoes in Pressure
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 600 g leftover corned beef or 600 g leftover corned beef, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon | 2 teaspoons white pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Dust and flour the corned beef and reserve the rest. In a large heavy based pot pour in water to cover. Add beef and enough water to cover the meat by 2 - 3 inches. Bring to the boil then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour. Add crushed pepper. Allow to stand for 20 minutes before using.

title: Pork Tuna
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon sunflower oil | 450 g pork tenderloin, diced | 200 g diced dried apricots in jam | 3 -4 teaspoons black pepper
instructions: Heat oil in a large frying pan and fry the pork until well cooked. Add all pork and apricots to the pan. Add black pepper and seasoning and cook for 15 minutes or until the pork is tender.

Random Ingredients: edamame,black bean,red wine vinegar,grapefruit,lentil,grain white rice,cream tartar
title: Mediterranean Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice, uncooked, rinsed | 1 cup dry lentils, rinsed | 1 cup edamame ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 cup grapefruit, peeled, segments cut in half | 12 ounces black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Cook the rice as directed on the package. If using dried beans, just soak them for 15 minutes, then drain. Cook lentils in boiling water for 3 minutes then drain. Add all remaining ingredients to rice, toss and chill.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,beer,miso,white fish fillet,orange juice,curry paste,large mushroom
title: The Best Bob's Ocean Grill Fried Fish
ingredients: 2 lbs white fish fillets | 6 large mushrooms, cut in half | 1 3/4 cups orange juice | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 cup beer | 1/2 cup miso
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Line a large sheet pan with foil. Place fish fillets on foil and sprinkle evenly with sliced mushrooms. Spoon equal amounts of orange juice, lime juice and curry paste evenly over fish. Put the foil on top and fold the edges of the foil over the fish. Bake on middle rack of oven for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer fish to a serving platter. Place pan on top rack of oven and raise temperature to 450f. Bake another 10 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. To serve, top fish with miso. Serve and enjoy.

title: Orange Spice Breakfast Item
ingredients: 3 oranges | 2 tablespoons orange-flavored extract flavored syrup or 2 tablespoons orange flavored liqueur | 1 pinch cardamom
instructions: Grate the zest of the oranges and set aside. Juice the oranges, put into a large mixing bowl, add the orange flavored syrup or liqueur, and stir. Sprinkle with cardamom, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate.

title: Ham Hocks With Berries and Shallots
ingredients: 3 lbs ham hocks, cut in half crosswise | 1 lb dried berry ( strawberries, raspberries, peaches or raspberries ) | 2 tablespoons minced shallots
instructions: Preheat oven to 275°f. Place ham hocks in a roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,gold tequila,harissa,cream mushroom soup,cider vinegar,mexican oregano,ham,basil pesto
title: Cauliflower Pizzas
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 tablespoons mexican oregano, divided | 1 tablespoon dried mexican oregano | 2 tablespoons hot harissa ( or other fiery hot chili sauce to taste ) | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 2 ounces ham, sliced thin ( or other lean cut of your choice ) | 2 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup golden tequila | 1/4 cup basil pesto
instructions: Prepare the cauliflower,. Preheat oven to 475°f. Place oven rack in center of oven and heat to 425°f. Prepare sauce,. Combine all ingredients in sauce pan and bring to boil. Cover and simmer until thickened. Arrange on baking sheet and bake for 8 - 9 minutes or until hot throughout. Serve with pita chips, pico de gallo, salsa, cheddar cheese, sliced onions or guacamole on top.

title: Dirty Veges (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 cans vegetarian baked beans | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh chives
instructions: Spread the baked beans in a shallow, microwave safe, ovenproof casserole dish. Sprinkle with chives and microwave until warm, about 1 minute.

title: Low sodium Vegetable Beef and Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey, cooked and drained | 16 ounces frozen peas | 15 ounces chicken stock
instructions: In large soup pot, place ground meat or turkey and frozen peas. Add chicken stock and heat. Stir until warmed through. Serve warm, with dumpling.

title: Green Daiquiri
ingredients: 4 cups dry currants | 4 cans italian stewed tomatoes, in their juice | 1 can green chiles, with liquid, drained | 4 cups palm sugar, or as needed, or to taste
instructions: Place currants, tomatoes, chilies, and sugar into a blender, and puree until completely smooth.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,wheat bread crumb,sirloin,cream chicken soup,asafoetida powder,pomegranate juice
title: Pomegranate Meatballs
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice ( pomegranate seeds can also be used ) | 2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons whole wheat bread crumbs ( optional )
instructions: In mixing bowl, mix soup, pomegranate juice, and ground sirloin with asafoetida. Mix in 1/4 cup salad dressing. Shape into balls a few inches across in size and place on baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 400° for 30 min, or until cooked through. While the meatball are baking, mix bread crumbs with the remaining dressing. Dip the meatballs in the crumbs, coating all sides. Serve with a salad or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,chili paste,orange peel,bean sprout,cream,worcestershire sauce,tomato green chile pepper,escarole
title: Jamaican Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 tablespoon minced orange peel | 1 tablespoon minced fresh tomato and green chile peppers | 2 cans cannellini beans with liquid, drained | 2 medium leaves escarole, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon mild chili paste | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 cups sour cream
instructions: Whisk coconut oil, orange peel, tomato and green chiles, beans, escarole, hot chili paste, worcestershire sauce, and sour cream in a large bowl until well combined. Serve immediately.

title: Tomato Strawberries (Tomates Charentais )
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup onion, minced | 2 tablespoons paprika, sweet smoked | 2 lbs strawberries, fresh or frozen | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/4 cup shortening
instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over low heat. Add onions.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,chili pepper flake,hazelnut,hot chili sauce,dipping sauce,garlic paste,wheat germ,yellow potato
title: Hazelnut & Celery Seed Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb yellow potato, peeled | 1/2 cup wheat germ | 2 tablespoons dried chili pepper flakes | hot chili sauce ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon dry celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon dild hot chili sauce | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, chopped, toasted
instructions: Slice sweet potatoes in half lengthwise and cut into wedges. Combine remaining ingredients in a large microwave safe bowl. Microwave at high for 50 - 60 seconds, stirring after 30 seconds. Serve hot..

title: Blueberry Soup
ingredients: 4 cups low-sodium vegetable broth, divided | 1/4 cup frozen blueberries, thawed | 1/4 cup frozen blueberries, thawed | 1 tablespoon fresh blueberries, for garnish
instructions: Combine 2 cups soup, ½ cup of the frozen blueberries, and ¼ cup of hot water in a slow cooker. Cover with lid, and turn on high for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to low, and continue cooking soup on high for 30 to 40 minutes, or until most of the liquid has been absorbed. Stir in the remaining 8 cups soup and remaining blueberries. Cover, and continue cooking soup for 15 minutes. Garnish with fresh berries.

title: Argentinean Baked Mushrooms on Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 bunch scallion | 8 ounces button mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bring broth and chile flakes to a boil in 2 quart saucepan. Add rice and 1/2 of the scallions. Cook, stirring, until rice turns golden brown. Add mushrooms. Spray 2 - 9 square baking dishes with cooking oil cooking spray. Divide mixture equally among dishes. Bake, covered loosely, 45 minutes. Uncover when liquid in dish has evaporated. Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees. Bake uncovered until tops are light gold, about 15 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,tea,snow pea,peanut oil vegetable,vegetable oil,asparagus spear,red cabbage
title: Spring Beef and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package of asparagus spears, ends trimmed | 1 bunch asparagus spears, ends trimmed | 1 head red cabbage, cut in half vertically | 1/4 cup peanut oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons soy sauce or 3 tablespoons braggs liquid aminos | 1 rump roast, trimmed | 4 cups of your favourite winter vegetable salad such as broccoli, cauliflower and baby carrots
instructions: Chop asparagus tips into 2 inch lengths and separate the tops and bottoms into pieces the size and width of the asparagus stalks. Cut asparagus in half lengthwise and submerge in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp tender. Heat peanut oil in a large frying pan. Add asparagus stalks and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally for about 6 to 8 minutes, or until just starting to wilt. Remove asparagus with a slotted spoon and set aside. Cook cabbage and carrots in boiling water briefly or until tender. Drain in a colander and run under cold water to stop the cooking process. Rinse under running water and dry with a clean cloth. Cut crosswise into thin slices and set aside. Cut remaining end of asparagus into 2 inch lengths. Discard tough outer leaves of asparagus. Place on plate or large platter and cover with cabbage, carrots, asparagus and asparagus pieces. Pour a small amount of soy sauce or braggs and enough vegetable oil to coat the bottom and halfway up the sides of the pan. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes, turning over as needed, until sauce thickens slightly. Season with soy sauce or seasoned salt and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,salad oil,hot sauce,rigatoni pasta,deli ham,garam masala
title: Grilled Prawns #Ragu
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 300 g hamburger | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala | salad oil | 100 g deli ham ( or bocconcini )
instructions: First take your pasta and bring salted water to boil. Once boiling, cook rigatoni al dente according to directions on the package. In a large bowl, mix prawns with hot sauce, garam masala, olive oil and then take into your rigatoni and coat with prawn mixture. Take pan into a hot griller and cook both sides of prawns until they become white and crispy. Keep a side for the top to serve with parma ham.

title: Dill Baked Clams
ingredients: 32 cherrystone clams, with their liquor | 3 slices bacon, diced | 1 cup diced tomato | 3 tablespoons chili paste ( or 1 tablespoon of your own choosing ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 3 teaspoons whole cayenne black seeds or 3 teaspoons crushed chili peppers | 1/2 cup dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. In a large heavy bottomed fry pan, fry the bacon until crisp. Tilt pan constantly, to prevent sticking. Drain onto paper towels and reserve. Add the tomato juice, chili paste and cumin and stir over moderate heat for one minute or until hot. Add clam shells and stir to coat. Transfer the mixture to a cookie sheet and add the dill and tomato wedges. Place the mixture into a roasting pan, cover pan, seal tightly and bake for 30 minutes or until the clam liquid is reduced and thickened. Note, if using a cajun seasoning, a pinch of salt can be added to the tomato paste when stirring. It does not need to be added. Alternatively, the clam liquid can be reduced to approximately 2 1/4 cups.

Random Ingredients: apple,pasilla chile,glace cherry,half cream,chili oil,ajwain,jasmine rice
title: Dee's Rice With Apple & Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 3/4 cup apple, chopped | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon ajwain, seeds only | 1/3 - 2/3 cup half-and-half cream ( or full fat ) | 1/2 cup pasilla chile, sliced | handful glace cherries
instructions: Wash and chop apples into chunks. Saute in hot chili oil in a medium size frying pan until apples are almost translucent. Add apple mixture to jasmine rice. Cover and cook on high for about 15 minutes, stirring regularly to keep from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Add half & half cream and ajwain seeds. Mix well and serve with a sprinkling of chopped fresh chiles, a few cherries, and some chopped pineapple if you like to add a bit of extra flavour.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,italian parsley,ginger garlic paste,ginger ale,brussels sprout
title: Ginger Glazed Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 kg brussels sprout, unpeeled, scrubbed and trimmed | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 liter ginger ale or 1 liter other stout beer, chilled
instructions: Wash and drain sprouts, then toss with ginger, garlic and worcestershire sauce in a saucepan. Place over high heat. Stir and cook for 3 minutes, or until sprouts are tender and coated with ginger garlic paste and garlic. Pour beer over sprouts and cook until heated through.

title: Smoked Salmon Chips
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons onion powder | 1/8 cup crushed corn chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Place salmon fillets in baking sheet. Mix flour, onion powder, and corn chips together in a resealable plastic bag. Place the salmon fillets in the bag with the flour mixture and shake to coat. Arrange the fish on the prepared baking sheet and bake in preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

title: Hominy With Oranges
ingredients: 1 bag hominy ( i use frozen, if not freezing well ) | 2 tablespoons orange juice or 2 tablespoons lemon juice, to taste. i like a lot of zest
instructions: Pour the hominy and the juice into a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, or until hominy is translucent. If you want more sweetness, use a little honey to make a honey glaze if you like. Stir to mix. It should be a little thicker than mashed potatoes though. It should taste a little harder than mashed potatoes. Serve hot, warm or cold. Note, you could also use 3 cups shredded or whole wheat or yellow hominy if you prefer.

title: Faux French Toast (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 1 )
ingredients: 6 slices rye bread, 4 slices, wholemeal
instructions: Heat nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Dip bread in egg substitute until coated. Cook until golden brown and hot, about 2 minutes per side.

title: Homemade Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: Wash chicken breasts with water. Cut each breast in half crosswise, removing vein. Place cut side up in a baking dish. Pour sweet chili sauce over chicken. Cover and chill 4 hours. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake chicken 15 minutes. Turn and bake 5 minutes.

title: Tamari Beef on Toast
ingredients: 600 g rump steak, cut into 4 pieces | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon cream
instructions: Place 1 piece of rump steak in a large frying pan or heavy based pot with 3tbspn tamari. Pour 1 tablespoon of cream over the entire steak and sear slowly over medium heat for 5minutes or until cooked through but still moist, turning once. Serve immediately with steamed greens. Tip, if the beef is not quite tender cut into thin slices. This could easily have been done in advance and stored in the fridge for up to 1 day, but we had to cook it for a few hours and not cook until quite tender before adding any additional ingredients. I could serve this along side steamed cabbage or a vegetable, so that's why most people eat it with toast.

title: Pumpernickel Soup
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock | 1 gherkin | 2 slices pumpernickel bread
instructions: Heat a large pot until bubbly, then add the stock and bring up to the boil. Add the gherkin. Add the pumpernickel slices and cook until tender. Serve hot with pickles or fried bacon.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,ginger,granny smith apple,guacamole,ginger garlic paste,wheat pita bread,bay leaf
title: Apple Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 4 whole wheat pita bread rounds | 4 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 4 teaspoons guacamole | 1 bay leaf | 1 granny smith apple, julienne cut into 4 inch chunks | 1/2 teaspoon minced ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Trim excess fat from stewing beef. Cut into 1 inch cubes. In a shallow bowl, combine beef, spice mix and half the guacamole, tossing to coat. Arrange pita rounds on a cookie sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes or until hot and bread is golden. Spoon meat mixture onto bread, top with remaining guacamole, apple wedges and ginger.

title: Advieh - Yemeni Orange Spice
ingredients: 4 cardamom pods | 1/2 orange peel, finely grated | 4 -6 cups advieh ( homemade yogurt, or homemade lemon yogurt or a mix )
instructions: Place cardomom pods into a small, hot coffee ball and just until they begin to crackle or jump around a few seconds later. If the pods are really brittle, you may need to toast the cardom pods for a couple of seconds. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Once they are cool, gently squeeze the pods to remove the loose seeds.. Place the orange and orange peel into a small bowl, add about 3 cups of yogurt or a mix of your choice, stir thoroughly until the yogurt is incorporated. Serve in cute dollops along with crackers or toasted pita rounds. Goes equally well either with koshihik or other traditional khoubz. Note, this can be eaten immediately after the yogurt is made, or it is stored in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,pork neck,flat bread,serrano pepper,red wine,red chili pepper,triple sec,burrito flour tortilla
title: Sopa De Cerdo Y Frijoles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tri-colored spirals red chili peppers, finely chopped | 5 tablespoons red wine | 1 1/4 lbs pork neck bones | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 1/2 teaspoon dried hot red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon finely chopped roasted garlic | 2 burrito-size flour tortillas | flat bread, for serving
instructions: Combine chili peppers, wine, neck bones, triple sec and ground hot red chili peppers in a glass dish. Cover.

title: Crunchy Toasted Bulgar Wheat
ingredients: 1 packet bulgar wheat | 1 knob butter | 4 slices cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Break up the wheat, or use rice flour if you like it softer. Melt butter over very low heat, stir and allow to set. This should take 15 minutes while still warm. Stir in the grated cheese. Spread toasted bulgur on a baking paper lined baking tray. Top with cheese if desired. Cut into quarters so they resemble 2 triangles. Place in the fridge until all of the crumbs have set, if not, slice and reheat slightly in the microwave if desired before serving.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,vodka,taco seasoning mix,coconut cream,cheese,avocado,liquid honey,table salt
title: Coconut-Avocado Vodka Stuffed French Fries With Smoky Gourmet Gourmet Vodka
ingredients: 4 -6 tablespoons coconut cream, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons vodka ( or to taste ) | 3 tablespoons liquid honey | 1 1/8 teaspoons table salt ( or to taste ) | 8 -12 french fries ( to yield a very light crust ) | 2/3 cup wild rice ( cooked to yield 1 cup ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 4 ounces smoked cheese ( grated or thinly sliced )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Place the 2 tbsp of coconut cream, vodka, and honey in a small bowl and stir until well incorporated. Set in refrigerator. Slice the french fries in half lengthwise almost right through, leaving approximately 1/2 inch of the thick center, to make 8 french fries. Using a sharp knife, cut each strip into 8 equal pieces. Arrange french fries in a 12 cup muffin tin or 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish, then spread 1 tbsp of the coconut honey and 1 tbsp of taco seasoning in each portion. Sprinkle about 1/2 the smoked cheese on top of the french fries. Bake french fries until cheese is slightly browned and beginning to crisp around the edges, 2 - 10 minutes depending on thickness of french fries. Enjoy.

ingredients: 4 tablespoons raw sultanas, chopped | 1 teaspoon lime juice, zest of | 2/3 cup raw white chopped onion | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring | 1 teaspoon rice wine or 1 teaspoon dry white wine
instructions: Add all of the ingredients to a mixing tin and stir to combine. Bake in a 350 degree f oven until the flavors meld. Let cool completely before storing in an airtight container in your pantry or in a cool dry place.

title: Roasted Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb green beans | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon unsweetened applesauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.

title: Pickled Onions

instructions: Place all of the above in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Close and shake well to mix. Store in the fridge for a few days to develop the flavor.

title: Mousaka
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/4 cup saffron | 1 french baguette, cut diagonally into 1/4 inch slices | 1 pound ground beef chuck | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 ounces white chocolate, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together tomato paste, saffron, and bread slices. Stir in ground beef. Spoon beef mixture onto a piece of parchment paper, and cover with another piece of parchment. Wrap the sandwiches individually in the paper. Place sandwiches onto a baking sheet, and brush with vegetable cooking spray. Bake in the middle of the preheated oven 1 hour, until crumbly, browned, and a thermometer inserted into the center reads 350 degrees f.

title: Pork Tenderloins Salad
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 6 cups red leaf lettuce
instructions: Cut pork lengthwise into 6 slices. Place on a plastic cutting board. Using a sharp knife, slice into 6 slices. Place in a 12x8x2 inch glass dish. Using the plastic cutters, lightly pound each slice. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Line bottom of 4 large salad plates with lettuce. Arrange a slice or two of pork on the lettuce. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,sourdough bread,beef bouillon,kosher salt,garlic clove,nonfat beef broth,chicken thigh
title: Garlic Sourdough Stuffed Chicken (Or Steak)
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat beef broth | 2 low-sodium instant beef bouillon | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh minced garlic clove | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt ( or other desired seasonings ) | 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 loaf sourdough bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line the bottoms with foil, parchment paper, a baking sheet. In 3 1/2 4 qt microwave safe bowl combine broth, bouillon, garlic and salt. Microwave on high until bouillon is just dissolved, about 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Add chicken thighs.

title: Cashew Snack
ingredients: 100 g ground dried apricots | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 2 tablespoons cashews | peanut oil
instructions: Combine the apricots and saffron in a bowl and pour some water over them and allow to soak for 20 minutes. Remove from the bowl and gently mash them with a fork. Add the cashews and knead well. The dip should be quite firm. You may need to add some more water if they have absorbed all the liquid. Shape into 1 inch long flat rounds. Heat some peanut oil in a frying pan and fry each round for 3 - 4 minutes on each side. Serve with lemon wedges on the side.

title: Hamburger Phos
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 1 1/2 tablespoons salad oil | 2 green onions, thinly sliced | 1/8 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 40 ladyfingers
instructions: Brown hamburger, and drain off fat. Mix in all other ingredients. Serve with bread.

title: Blueberry Cheese & Salmon Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated fully cooked salmon, drained | 1 package cream cheese, room temperature | 16 ounces commercial low-fat sour cream ( not low fat ) | 1 1/2 cups blueberries, divided | 1/2 cup walnuts, finely chopped | 20 corn tortillas
instructions: Blend cheese and sour cream using an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Spray a 9x13 baking dish and line with 2 corn tortillas. Using a slotted spoon, take 1/2 cup of the cheese sauce off of the can of salmon and stir in the salmon, 1/2 cup blueberries and the walnuts. Mix until all ingredients are incorporated. Place half of the salmon mixture in the center followed by the tortillas, half the remaining sauce, and half of the remaining blueberries. Roll up the tortillas and place seam side down in the baking dish. Cover with the remaining sauce and remaining 1 cup of blueberries and walnuts. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 350°f remove plastic wrap and bake for 40 - 45 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve hot.

title: Fried Potatoes in Tamarind Concentrate
ingredients: 3 medium russet potatoes, cut into uniform pieces | 2/3 - 3/4 cup tamarind pulp, soaked in | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: In a deep skillet set over medium heat, fry the potatoes until they are golden brown in color, turning frequently, about 15 minutes.

title: Sopa De Manicotti

instructions: Cook manicotti.

title: French Onion Dip

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place prepared mustard in a dry skillet, and stir until it thickens. Stir in honey. Spread evenly into a small baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, then serve warm.

title: Mexican Lasagne With Okra and Swiss
ingredients: 6 -8 lasagna noodles | 1 package cheese whiz | 2 packages kraft taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 -3 hot red chili pepper, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 12 ounces frozen sliced okra
instructions: Boil lasagna noodles until just beginning to soften. Drain and transfer to a bowl. Mix cheese whiz with taco powder and seasoning mix. Spread cheese mixture on top of each layer of noodles in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Top with okra and chili. Top with remaining mozzarella. Cover with foil. Bake@ 350 for about 25 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: spinach,pineapple,sharp cheddar cheese,pecorino romano cheese,basmati rice,onion soup mix
title: Italian Rice With Spinach
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pineapple, chopped | 1 package onion soup mix | 4 cups cooked basmati rice, chilled | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup shredded pariet-style pecorino romano cheese | 8 ounces fresh spinach
instructions: Prepare rice per package directions. Stir in soup mix. Spread rice thinly on bottom of a greased 9x13 inch pan. Top with remaining ingredients and spread evenly. Cover and bake at 400°f for 30 to 40 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Italian Dressing Mix Spice Mix Bread Dry Mix
ingredients: 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 packet instant biscotti cookie dough mix
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together italian dressing mix, baking soda and biscotti cookie dough mix until combined. Pour enough dressing mix into to wet ingredients, to fill the 1/2 to 1/2 teaspoon line.

title: Nopalitos
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1 package frozen meatballs, thawed | 1 jar pitted prunes, drained and cut into chunks | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract, or to taste | 1 jar nopales, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking it into small crumbles as it cooks. Pour off any excess oil. Mix in the frozen meatballs, prunes, lemon extract, and nopales. Cover, and bake in preheated oven until thawed, 20 to 30 minutes. Remove lid, place on a serving plate, and let stand for at least 5 minutes before serving.

title: Kansas City Style Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup bacon drippings | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 1/4 cup your favorite barbecue sauce
instructions: In a small skillet, heat the drippings over medium heat until golden brown. Transfer the melted drippings to a bowl. Mix the cream with the ginger and barbecue sauce. When the cream begins to thicken, pour the cream over the mustard. Keep refrigerated until served.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,japanese eggplant,salt black pepper,coconut milk
title: Coconut Eggplant (Aubergine) Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch japanese eggplant | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup coconut milk | hot chili sauce or sriracha hot sauce
instructions: Peel the eggplant and cut into 1/4 inch thick slices. If you plan to use it immediately, cover with water and soak in a sink filled with warm water for about 20 minutes. Drain and place the eggplant in a steaming basket over boiling water. When the slices wilt, take them out, and set them aside. Place the coconut milk and sriracha or hot sauce in a saucepan over high heat and bring to a boil. In a strainer add the drained eggplant and bring to a boil again. Lower the heat, return the eggplant to the pot, and stir. The eggplant is done when it is soft.

title: lima bean dip with shredded lettuce
ingredients: 1 can lima beans, drained and rinsed | 1 bottle taco sauce
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Place lima beans on a small baking sheet, and top with taco sauce. Sprinkle top of dip with cheese, salt, and pepper.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,baby spinach,fine breadcrumb,pork loin chop,tuna,italian breadcrumb,nori
title: Tuna-Steamed Pork
ingredients: 3 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons italian breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons baby spinach | 4 pork loin chops | 6 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 4 tablespoons tuna, well drained | 4 1/2 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Spray a steamer basket with cooking spray and set over the middle and set aside. Whisk 2 teaspoons fine grain bread crumbs, 2 tablespoons fine grain bread crumbs, 2 tablespoons shredded spinach, and 2 tablespoons italian bread crumbs in a bowl. Season with 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract, then add 2 tablespoons tuna and lightly toss to coat. Remove the chops from the plastic steamer basket. Place a sheet of nori on your work surface and place 2 to 3 tablespoons of tuna in the center of the sheet. Add a row of spinach and 2 to 3 slices of pork at one end of the nori, and roll up from the short end toward the opposite end. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Place the rolls seam side down in the steamer basket. Repeat steps 8 and 9 with remaining tuna and spinach. Spoon the tuna mixture into the center of the roll. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Lettuce Cups-Cous Cups
ingredients: 12 spring roll wrappers | 1 cup couscous | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon dry vermouth | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup shredded carrot | 1/2 teaspoon chopped mixed nuts ( optional ) | lettuce leaf
instructions: Place 2 wraps per cup of your chosen base and a teaspoon of vermouth into each cup. Top with a small pinch of chilli powder on top. Place 1/2 cup of cream, half the chopped carrot, mixed nuts and the remaining vermouth into the centre of each wrap, pressing out all the air and filling. Fold the bottom wrapper up towards the centre and top with the rest of the cream mixture. Fold the sides over and tie with kitchen string if needed. Line a 12 hole muffin tin with the remaining wrappers, making sure they are all snug, if necessary. Pour the mixture into the prepared cups and place the tin on top of a trivet of steaming hot water. Steam the cups 3 - 5 minutes, until the bottom feels firm and the tops spring back when pressed. Remove the custards from the steamer. Serve immediately, topped with lettuce leaves and drizzled with cream.

Random Ingredients: pecan,beer,cremini mushroom,pecorino romano cheese,lemon lime beverage,pork tenderloin
title: Pork with Beer
ingredients: 24 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon lemon-lime beverage | 1/4 cup beer | 1 tablespoon pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 large pork tenderloin | 1/4 cup pecans, toasted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. In a 9x13 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray, layer mushrooms, lemon lime soda, beer and cheese. Top with pork. Sprinkle toasted pecans over. Bake uncovered for 35 to 45 minutes or until meat reaches desired doneness. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Stir Fry Shrimp in Sweet Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 1/2 lbs shrimp, cooked | 10 -15 pepitas ( pumpkin seeds )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pan & bring to heat. Add shrimp & cook until done.

title: Steak Burros With Apricot Filling
ingredients: 300 g steak, cut into 1cm cubes | 1 egg roll wrap, defrosted | 1/2 cup corned aubergine, chopped | 1 courgette, sliced into thin rings | 1 teaspoon flour, seasoned to taste | pastry sheets | 2 tablespoons sliced apricots, toasted | lettuce leaf ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine steak, egg roll wrap, corned aubergine, courgette and flour. Place on a lightly oiled griddle pan, cook over high heat, turning until browned. Cook to your liking, this should take about 8 minutes for medium. To assemble place 3 sixth portion of mixture on top of each sheet of pastry and top with apricots and a few spoonfuls of the fritters/meat mixture. Roll up and tuck ends in.

title: Sauerkraut and Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 jar sauerkraut, drained | 1/2 cup water | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped pistachio pudding mix | 1 1/2 cups uncooked couscous | 1 cup chicken broth | 2/3 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine sauerkraut, water, greek yogurt, and pudding mix in a large bowl. Mix in couscous and mix well. Spread onto a lightly greased 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Cover with the miniature marshmallows, and drizzle with dressing.

title: Spicy Cheese Bread (Tex Mex)
ingredients: 3 cups shredded four-cheese mexican blend cheese | 1 cup half-and-half ( or 2 percent )
instructions: Cut rind from ciabatta and place on a baking sheet, sprinkle with a little nonfat plain yogurt. Preheat oven to 400°f. Spread half and half evenly on sliced rind and place on baking sheet. Bake on middle rack of oven until top is brown and bubbly. Note, if desired you may break bread into chunks with a rolling pin so that they cook faster. This bread may also be good with other spices like garlic salsa. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,taco seasoning mix,rigatoni pasta,grain rice
title: Spanish-Style Rice & Caramelized Onions over Rigatoni
ingredients: 300 g cooked rigatoni pasta | 8 large caramelized onions, thinly sliced ( you can put on the onions on the side also ) | 400 g caster sugar | 1 package taco seasoning mix, packet
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/fan 160c/gas cook rigatoni for 10 - 12 minutes or until just tender. Drain and set aside. Fry caramelized onions in a frypan over medium heat until lightly browned on both sides. Add the sugar and taco seasoning. Simmer for 2 minutes. Place cooked rigatoni in a large shallow 1 1/2 to 2 litre ovenproof dish. Pour caramelized onions and caramelized onions over the top. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until topping is firm and browned.

title: Beef Stew with Prawns
ingredients: 2 lbs of peeled and deveined prawns | 2 lbs beef stew meat | 4 teaspoons fine salt | 1 large shallot, chopped
instructions: In a hot ovenproof casserole dish or a pot with a small knob of butter fry the prawns, adding salt, cover and put into a preheated oven. Baking 1 hour, turn the prawns and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes more, or until they are pink and crusty. Prawns do not overcook as they toughen up.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,streaky bacon,five spice powder
title: Chinese five spice powder
ingredients: 12 pieces streaky bacon, rind off, ends trimmed | 5 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 4 teaspoons five-spice powder, or 6 teaspoons allspice
instructions: Place the bacon in the freezer for 20 minutes. Reserve the bacon fat. Briefly fry the bacon until crispy, leaving the fat in the pan. Transfer the bacon to a paper towel to drain. Heat the sesame oil and five spice powder over low heat until the powder thickens and smells aromatic. Stir in the reserved bacon fat and cook 3 to 5 minutes. Spoon the spice mixture into a piping bag fitted with a 1 star tip and decorate with green onions. Serve the bacon with a green vegetable.

Random Ingredients: milk,swiss cheese,red wine,rice wine vinegar,cream cheese
title: Swiss Cheese & Rice On The Side
ingredients: 2 cups swiss cheese, shredded & at room temperature | 1/4 cup cream cheese, at room temperature & at room temperature | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar ( or berry vinegar ) | 2 cups milk | 1 cup red wine | 2 tablespoons sour cream, at room temperature
instructions: Whisk together the cheese and vinegar in a small bowl and set aside. Heat milk, wine & sour cream in a large saucepan over medium heat until it bubbles, then reduce the heat to medium & simmer, stirring frequently, for 3 minutes. Pour cream mixture into the cheese mixture and stir continuously with a whisk. Cook until the mixture begins to thicken, then remove from the heat. Pour wine sauce into an ice cream maker or blender & freeze. When cheese has frozen, uncover and thaw the cheese completely in the fridge, then stir well & return to the freezer for several hrs or until the cheese is firm. Stir the cheese mixture once or twice while it is cold to mix, then spread on a serving dish. Cover with extra milk to serve.

Random Ingredients: orange,vegetable bouillon granule,red chile,corn chip,amaretto,shiitake mushroom,lettuce,sherry
title: Lettuce With Shiitake Mushrooms, Amaretto Rice Balls and Amaretto
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked dried shiitake mushrooms | 2 cups coarsely crushed corn chips | 1/4 cup chopped fresh orange, rind of | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 teaspoon instant vegetable bouillon granules ( optional ) | 1 red fresh chile, deseeded and minced | 4 2 tablespoons amaretto or 4 tablespoons dark rum | lettuce, for serving | chopped fresh red chile, for garnish
instructions: Place the shiitake mushrooms in a medium saucepan, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to a simmer. Place the corn chips in a small bowl, and cover with warm water. Set aside for 5 minutes, or until soft. Drain and set aside. Combine the orange peel, sherry, vegetable bouillon and chile in a small bowl until blended. Stir into the orange mixture. Transfer to a bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour. In a medium bowl, stir together the amaretto and the cornstarch until well blended. To serve, spoon amaretto riceballs onto lettuce leaves and mound a couple of them on each mound. Garnish with a tablespoon of chopped chile.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,garam masala,swiss cheese,mirin,thyme sprig,white wine
title: Swiss Cheese-Burgundy Sprouts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese ( shredded ) | 1 1/2 lbs brussels sprouts ( rinsed and trimmed ) | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar or 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 pinch dried thyme | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 small pinch dried thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: In medium mixing bowl, sprinkle cheese with salt, pepper, vinegar, thyme, and garam masala. Rinse sprouts and pat dry. Sprinkle lightly with salt, pepper, and thyme, if using. Arrange on parchment paper lined jelly roll pan. Bake in 400 degree oven for 10 - 12 minutes, or until hot. Remove from oven and place on a cutting board. Spread remaining cheese mixture on sprouts and return to oven. Bake for another 3 - 4 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly. Top with extra cheese mixture of your choice, and serve.

title: Plantain Chips
ingredients: 6 plantains, sliced lengthwise | 1 small spanish onion, cut into 8 wedges | 1/2 cup apple cider ( optional )
instructions: Arrange the plantains on paper towels and cover with a towel. Place the onion wedges on the plantains. Drizzle with the cider and let drain for 1/2 hour. Arrange the chips on a parchment lined baking sheet. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,bacon,mozzarella cheese,giardiniera cauliflower,mustard powder,garlic,olive oil,marsala wine
title: Giardiniera Florentine
ingredients: 1 container refrigerated ginger-flavored gelatinous | 1/2 cup marsala wine or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 5 slices bacon | 3/4 cup olive oil, or as needed | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 3/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 3/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1 1/4 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, or to taste | 8 ounces jarred giardiniera ( optional )
instructions: Prepare gelatin according to package directions. Chop bacon into small pieces and fry until crispy. Add olive oil and garlic.

title: Lamb Shank With Sausage and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb lamb shank | 8 ounces lamb shanks | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 small banana | 2 ounces fresh mushrooms | 1 sandwich bag hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing | 1 can cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray baking sheet with cooking spray. Trim fat from lamb and shanks. If using meat boneless thighs, use extra lamb to cut into a rectangle about 10 x3. Toss lamb, lamb, and shanks into tumeric. Transfer to parchment paper lined baking sheet. Sprinkle half mushrooms and remaining mushrooms on half meat. Sprinkle with half hidden valley original ranch dressing. Bake about 1 hour. Stir cottage cheese into meat. Continue baking until meat and mushrooms are tender.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,sage leaf,bean sprout,sunflower oil,white vinegar,lobster tail
title: Lobster With Sweet Red Pickled Bean Sprouts And Baked Beans
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 teaspoons sunflower oil | 4 tablespoons packed chopped sage leaves, chopped ( or 1/2 teaspoon dried sage ) | 4 large lobster tails, with shell | 5 -6 cups fresh bean sprouts ( approximately 3-1/2 cups ) | 2/3 cup sugar-coated white sandwich roll doughnuts ( available at asian supermarket ) | 1 cinnamon stick
instructions: Make the pickled beans at least a day ahead and place them under cold, running water to stop the cooking process and prevent the salt from penetrating the shells.. To prepare the pickled beans, bring 2 cups water to boil in medium sized nonstick skillet. Combine vinegar and sunflower oil in a glass measuring cup. Microwave for 3 or 4 seconds on high until hot, remove from microwave and stir in sage. Place lobster tails in a medium size glass bowl. Brush both sides of lobster with vinegar mixture then spoon shrimp/fish mixture over top. Sprinkle top with 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar and cover loosely. Microwave on medium for 7 minutes until shrimp is cooked and lobster is well browned. Top with bean sprouts and cinnamon stick and serve.

title: Chinese Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 2 cups canned low sodium broth
instructions: Wipe the stems and remove the loose stems. Remove the stems and discard them. Cut the caps into quarters. Place mushrooms in a medium saucepan. Add the 4 cups of broth and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is reduced by about a third.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,soy sauce,ginger garlic paste,heavy whipping cream,chicken bouillon,wheat bread
title: Whole Wheat Indian Toast
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste ( or use ginger powder ) | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 2 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: In a medium bowl whisk the yogurt, cream, soy sauce, and garlic paste together. Pour half a cup of this mixture into a bowl and set aside. When ready to proceed crack the bread into pieces and coat both sides of the toast with the reserved yogurt mixture. Grill the bread for 3 minutes on each side or until the cheese has melted and the toasts are slightly crunchy. Enjoy.

title: Edamame-Cornmeal Crackers
ingredients: 4 cups frozen shelled edamame ( cooked weight ) | 1 1/2 cups cornmeal
instructions: Cook edamame according to package directions. Drain edamame and set aside. Microwave edamame in a small bowl on high for 1 - 1 1/2 minutes or until heated well. Stir edamame and cornmeal until fully mixed. Spread onto a sheet of plastic wrap or parchment paper and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes or up to 2 hours until cool. Sprinkle each cracker with additional salt before serving if desired.

title: Italian Bread With Garlic & Fern-Herbs
ingredients: 12 lbs ripe bulbs of garlic | 1/2 lb fresh watercress | 2 packets splenda granular
instructions: Heat 5 lbs of garlic in a sauce pan with 1/2 of the sugar. Strain garlic onto paper towel lined baking sheet making sure the skins are all peeled off. Place on oven rack in oven for 2 to 2½ hours, stirring occasionally until garlic becomes light & soft. Remove garlic from oven, place on bowl & cool. Peel of skins, and break off the cloves and then drop in cloves into boiling water for 20 seconds. Drain garlic and discard skins or skins. Return head of garlic to pan & break apart in small pieces. Add splenda & 1½ c of watercress & boil over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat & strain liquid into bowl with garlic, stirring well. Stir through remaining 1½ c of watercress. Cover.

Random Ingredients: vodka,vanilla bean,orange juice,guacamole,arborio rice,guinness stout,vanilla extract
title: Guacamole-Style Risotto
ingredients: 8 ounces guacamole | 8 ounces guacamole ( not salsa verde brands ) | 1 tablespoon dry guacamole | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed guacamole | 4 ounces guinness stout | 2 1/2 teaspoons vodka | 4 ounces orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | powdered sugar | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Rice, pour 4 cups water into a large saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Add 5 ounces cheesecloth and bring back to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 2 minutes, or until cheese has melted. Remove from heat. Rice, combine all ingredients with your hands in a bowl. The mixture should feel like a loose paste. Let rest in the fridge for at least 6 hours or overnight. Pour rice into bowls and ladle some of the guacamole on top. Sprinkle tops with powdered sugar and serve immediately after the rice is so piping hot and slightly runny. Note, for a different guacamole flavor dimension, add 1/8 teaspoon ground star anise or cinnamon for a darker guacamole taste.

Random Ingredients: pork sparerib,yellow pepper,serrano chilies,extra beef,almond,beef stew meat,salmon,chicken leg quarter
title: Spicy Grilled Beef Ribs
ingredients: 36 -48 ounces beef stew meat, sliced in chunks | 3 -6 lbs beef bone-in pork spareribs | 3 1/2 - 4 lbs skinless chicken leg quarters | 3 1/2 - 4 lbs skinless chicken leg quarters | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs yellow peppers, cut in chunks | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs serrano chilies, sliced | 1 1/2 - 2 cups sliced almonds | extra beef fat, for brushing
instructions: Wipe your grinder with a damp dishtowel and then coarsely grind the beef using the finest shredding disk you have your grinder. Reserve one cup of the meat for another recipe. In the same large bowl you used to grind the beef, add one cup of meat and mix well. Reserve the remainder for another recipe. In a dutch oven bag, add the chopped reserved meat and add one cup of the liquid from the beef. Add a second cup of liquid to the meat. Add two cups of liquid and the jalapeno pieces. Add one cup of the chicken broth to the meat and stir well to combine. Add one cup of green pepper chunks and one cup of the yellow pepper chunks. Add three pieces of the soaked black pepper and one pound each of the soaked serrano chilies and almonds. Add three pieces of the soaked beef. Place in the refrigerator for about two weeks to marinate while you complete all remaining steps. After three days, add the remaining 1/2 cup of marinade liquid to the meat in your dutch oven. Add the remainder of the canned green pepper chunks. Add four more teaspoons of salt. Stir well. Keep heat on high until mixture boils. Now you'll need to start to test the flavor. The flavor will be a bit weaker with the acid balance of your acid balance. Turn heat down until it is quite low when it simmers, about 2 hours, but will keep it on for at least two hours and up to three days, testing the flavor every so often. You can add more liquid, salt or a combination of spices to taste. The amount of salt you will need is up to you. It is about 5 tablespoons of salt per pound of meat. To test, poke holes to the meat by placing a slice of meat in the center of a cutting board. If the meat cracks, it is ready. It won't occupy much of the board. If the meat cracks and cracks again, it needs more salt. Take the reserved beef meat mixture, about one cup, and carefully add to the meat. It should look a bit like you are trying to use up all of the marinade. You want to get a good seal on the meat, making sure you leave it in small pieces. Add the rest of the meat and coat the contents well. Place in a bowl or a plastic zipper bag and marinate overnight or up to two hours, stirring well once. Turn the burner of your stove to high and set off heat. Do not lift the meat on the burner when just a few minutes later, remove the meat from the bowl. Serve.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,flounder fillet,ziti pasta,beef bouillon granule,tea,mint sprig,alfredo sauce,garlic clove
title: Beef Pasta and Pasta With Smoked Livers
ingredients: 1 lb smoked fish, cut into 1 x 1/4 x 1/2-1/4 inch strips | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 cup reduced-fat beef bouillon granules | 1/2 cup strong brewed tea | 1 lb ziti pasta, cooked according to package directions | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked according to package directions | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained | 1/4 cup snipped fresh mint sprig ( optional, optional ) | fresh mint sprig ( optional, for garnish, if desired ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine fish strips and garlic in a large bowl of cold water. Stir in beef bouillon granules and tea. Drain pasta and place in large bowl. Toss with mixture and season with salt and pepper to taste. Divide pasta among 4 serving plates. Top with meat and drizzle with sauce.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,wooden skewer,steak,green pepper,white sugar,hot couscous
title: Spice Flavored Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round steaks, cut 3/4-inch thick | 4 1/2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1 cup white sugar | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked couscous, well drained ( regular, long grain can be used ) | 2 teaspoons ground dried hot peppers or 2 teaspoons thawed fresh hot sauce | wooden skewer
instructions: Cut steak diagonally into 1/2 slices crosswise, 1/4 inch each. Cut slices crosswise into 1/2 inch strips. Thread steak onto wooden skewers, alternating with onion strips. Place on baking sheet. In medium saucepan, stir together sugar and remaining 2 cups boiling water. Bring to boil over medium high heat, stirring frequently, simmer 3 minutes, or until mixture is amber in color. Remove from heat. Stir in hot peppers or hot sauce. Pour over meat in saucepan.

title: Cantonese Bok Choy With Dates
ingredients: 2 bunches bok choy, washed & trimmed | 2 limes, juice of | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped rosemary | 2 teaspoons chopped dates, dried dates, chopped fresh herbs
instructions: Wash the chicen & steam until lightly charred, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat & set aside for 2 minutes then tear it into bite sized segments. In a small bowl, combine lime juice, oregano & rosemary then add to the chicen & mix thoroughly. Serve with warm pappadums, rice, & bread.

title: Puffy Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained
instructions: In medium saucepan, cover with water and bring to boil, then reduce to medium.

title: Curry Paste for Ravioli & Other Dessert
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground savory ( the good stuff ) or 1 teaspoon nutmeg ( the good stuff ) | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon ground curry paste | 2 tablespoons almond flour or 2 tablespoons almond flour
instructions: Mix all together. Take small amounts out of package when serving for dipping. Keep in fridge.

title: Quick Curried Noodles Made With Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked fettuccine | 4 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 large red onion, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons cake-flour
instructions: Place noodles in large heatproof bowl. Stir in curry paste, onion and flour until the noodles are coated. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low.

title: Livers on the Hill
ingredients: 1 lb calf liver or 1 lb swiss cheese | seasoning ( use white pepper if seasoning )
instructions: Thoroughly clean the liver well and place them in a baking dish. Sprinkle with seasoning and place in oven at 375 f for half an hour. Serve hot with rice, french fries, soup or meatballs for a great meal.

title: The Ultimate Gourmet's Fondue
ingredients: 3/4 cup corn flakes | 2 1/2 cups gruyere cheese, grated and divided | 4 tablespoons mixed spice
instructions: In a deep heavy bottomed skillet, heat 1/4 cup of corn flakes. When it starts to look dry, add a teaspoon of the gruyere cheese slowly, stirring constantly, until all the cheese has been mixed inches sprinkle the 1 tablespoon of mixed spice over and continue to stir. Serve with remaining gruyere cheese on top of fondue.

title: Grand Marnier French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 ounce active dry yeast | 9 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 3/4 cups bottled chopped unpeeled frozen mixed pulses ( may use canned and drained canned chickpeas ) | 4 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Dissolve in 9 cups of the flour, then stir in the yeast. When the mixture starts to ferment, add the remaining flour 1/2 cup at a time.

Random Ingredients: tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce,yellow onion,eggplant,peanut,mozzarella cheese,asparagus spear
title: Smokin' Hot Peanut Cheese Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 2 teaspoons tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce | 10 fresh asparagus spears | 2 yellow onions | 1/2 pound fresh mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Brush the tops of the eggplant with a little bit of olive oil and arrange slices around the outside of the eggplant pieces to completely cover the slices. Brush the inside of a baking dish with the chipotle sauce, then scatter chopped asparagus, chopped yellow onion, shredded mozzarella cheese and chopped roasted peanuts over the top. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until the tops are browned and cheese has melted and caramelized a bit.

title: Onion Gravy (To Serve, but not Really!)
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups double cream | 1 small onion flakes or 1 small clove, finely minced
instructions: Pour cream into a small bowl and add onion flakes or minced onion. Stir until mixed well and add more cream if needed.

title: Mexican Green Tea
ingredients: 1 ounce pecan halves ( or more ) | 1 1/2 ounces blue curacao
instructions: Brew tea. Add the rest of the ingredients, stir, and enjoy.

title: Zucchini Tacos
ingredients: 3 medium zucchini, sliced | 1/4 cup meat, shredded | 3 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 large flour tortillas or 2 small corn tortillas
instructions: Place the zucchini slices, brandy and anise on a plate and set aside. Sprinkle the zucchini with salt and let sit 10 minutes. Rinse under warm water to rinse off excess salt. Using damp hands, press the zucchini slices down lightly. Using your hands, remove the zucchini slices to a medium bowl. Add the shredded meat and mix to coat well. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Turn the heat down when the pan is hot, add the zucchini mixture. Cook the mixture 5 - 7 minutes, until the cheese inside the thickened, but still white in the center. Flip the zucchini over, sprinkle with more salt and serve with warm flour tortillas or corn tortillas.

title: Plannys Plannys Plannys
ingredients: 8 ounces cremini mushrooms or 8 ounces wall mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 cups brown basmati rice | 6 ounces mandarin oranges, drained and cut lengthwise in half | 2 cups sour cream, divided
instructions: Spray 11/2 to 13/2 inch straight sided pan with cooking spray. Set aside. Mix mushrooms with 1 1/2 cup of rice, the mandarin oranges, and remaining 1 1/2 cups of rice in large bowl. Mix with spoon until well blended and set in refrigerator. Divide mixture among 6 - 9 inch serving bowls. Serve sour cream in reserved bowl over plannys plannys. Serve plannys plannys with dollop of sour cream and garnish with orange slice.

title: Blue Cheese and Chilled Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unflavored gelatin | 1/4 cup cold beef stew meat, cut into pieces about 1 inch by 1 inch | 1 tablespoon blue cheese, crumbled | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 4 pita breads, each cut diagonally in half
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in a 1/4 cup of cold water until the mixture is creamy. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove the meat from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking. Thread the meat onto skewers. Preheat a gas grill or broiler and cook for 6 to 8 minutes on each side, or until meat no longer pink. Serve with a sprinkling of grated cheese and warm pita bread.

title: Chicken Liver Pate
ingredients: 4 ounces of dried chicken livers | 4 ounces egg yolks | 1 ounce ground chicken liver
instructions: Soak chicken livers in a jug of cold water. Mix egg yolks and ground livers together and set aside for 10 minutes. Combine egg mixture and chicken liver mixture together in a saucepan with a little water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 mins, then remove from heat and stir well. Pour into the fridge for at least an hour before serving.

title: Spanish Date Balls My Way
ingredients: 4 cups pitted dates | 1/2 cup pitted green olives | 1/8 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Place dates and olives into a food processor. Process till pulverized. Add half and half and process till smooth. The amount will vary on how much liquid you add. Pour into 2 plastic storage bags or medium mixing cups. Place in freezer. Break apart as needed. When ready to bake, turn oven on to broil. Spoon balls onto baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 300°f for 5 to 8 minutes or till edges are lightly browned. Roll in desired amount of confectioners sugar and serve hot.

title: Barley Corn for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Place barley and corn into crock pot, stir. Cover and cook on low 6 hours. Stir the corn before serving.

title: Lite Herbed Ham and Corn
ingredients: 1 ham, thickly cut | 2 cans creamed corn | 1 tablespoon mixed garden herbs | 3 tablespoons celery seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Prick ham with a skewer if liked and bake ham in oven until browned. Remove ham, turn oven to 400 deg f, and cook corn for approx 10 minutes. After 10 minutes add mixed herbs and celery seeds to corn. Continue to cook for a further 30 minutes, until thick. Remove ham from oven, wrap each ham piece in aluminium foil and put back in the oven to warm through. This will be a little less than normal so i don't really need to bake it.

title: Roquefort Cauliflower With White Star Anise
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 1/2 teaspoon ground star anise | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine ( or sweet sherry ) | 1 -2 tablespoon crumbled roquefort cheese
instructions: Trim the base of the cauliflower. Cut larger stems off the stem and florets. Break up the florets and place them in a steamer with the star anise and sherry and steam over rapidly boiling water for about 5 minutes. Place the steaming vegetables on a heatproof serving dish and drizzle over a little olive oil to lightly coat. Sprinkle over the roquefort cheese and bake in a low oven for about 25 minutes or until the cheese has melted and begun to bubble, stirring occasionally.

title: Pineapple-Stuffed Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh pineapple juice | 1 cup coarsely chopped american cheese | 1 cup low-sodium barley | 2 whole beef tenderloin steaks
instructions: Preheat pan for direct heat. Open beef steaks carefully and spread evenly with pineapple juice. Spoon in cheese and then roll up. Secure with tooth picks or skewers if desired. Brush with remaining 1/2 cup pineapple juice. Place steaks on an ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle with sugar if desired. Bake at 400 degrees for 45 minutes or until done. Baste with pan juices every 15 minutes.

title: Lebanese Masala Paste
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh mint, chopped | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp, soaked in | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a bowl and mix until smooth. Let it sit in the refrigerator for at least an hour to allow the flavors to develop. Keep in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate juice,chili oil,wheat flour,flat leaf italian parsley,green pea
title: Fenochi (Split Pea Soup)
ingredients: 1 cup split green peas | 6 tablespoons wheat flour | 1 1/2 - 2 cups pomegranate juice | 3 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 2 dashes chili oil
instructions: Place peas, 2 tbsp water and split peas in a saucepan with a lid and bring to a boil, skim the froth and simmer uncovered for about 15 minutes until the peas are tender. Add the flour gradually, stirring with a wooden spoon to separate the grains. Cover partially and simmer over very low heat for another 10 to 15 minutes until the soup has thickened slightly. Just before serving add a little water if the soup seems too thick. Add it to 4 cups cold water for a few minutes until the soup is thick. Add the pomegranate juice and mix well to blend. Season to taste with salt. Serve immediately, garnished with parsley, if desired.

Random Ingredients: meatball,cider vinegar,tamarind paste,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Tamarind-Scented Meatballs for Tamarind Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen meatballs, thawed | 1 cup vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 cup tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place meatballs in a glass baking dish. Spray with cooking spray and bake 12 to 16 minutes, until browned. Meanwhile, combine tamarind paste, vinegar and 1 teaspoon salt in a mortar and grind into a coarse powder. Shake out and discard excess fat. Transfer meatballs to a bowl of the tamarind mixture and coat with tomato paste mixture, coating meatballs evenly. Bring to a boil and simmer, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are browned, about 15 minutes.

title: Pine Nut Spread (Lebanon)
ingredients: 1 cup pine nuts | 20 drops grenadine
instructions: Place pine nuts in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain and place the nuts in a blender or food processor. Add the grenadine and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,tart apple,beef stew meat,cointreau liqueur,tortilla chip
title: Apple Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 tart apple | 1/3 cup cointreau liqueur | 3/4 cup walnut oil | tortilla chips
instructions: Cut the stew meat into 1/2 inch cubes.

title: Artificial Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 3 cups eggplants | 1 cup fat free artificial sweetener | 1 bunch bok choy
instructions: Cut the ends off the eggplants, cut off each eggplant stem and then cut the eggplants into 1 cubes.. Combine the eggplants, sweetener, bokchoy and some salt. Microwave for about 30 seconds or until hot. Serve.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,vanilla,bay leaf,avocado,purpose flour,red potato,macaroni,lumpia skin
title: Avocado Potato and Macaroni Samosas
ingredients: 1 box macaroni | 1 lb lumpia skins, thawed | 2 avocados, peeled, pitted and sliced ( or use 1 pound ) | 3/4 cup unbleached all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup fresh coriander powder | 2 bay leaves | 2 tablespoons red potatoes ( about 7 large ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla or 2 teaspoons almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Cook your macaroni according to the package directions. Drain and pat dry with a paper towel. Line a large baking sheet with a parchment paper liner or other flat baking dish with plastic wrap that has been slightly dampened with a little cold water. Place the potato slices on the liner in a layer, cutting in slices with a knife if necessary, to make them bite size. Mix together the flour, coriander powder, and bay leaves in a large bowl. Add sliced potatoes and mash with a fork. Add your avocado slices and mash well with a fork, until you have a sticky mixture. Add vanilla and mix well. Dump macaroni into dish and gently toss with potato mixture, making sure it is not getting mushy. Cover dish and refrigerate until needed. Cook samosas on the prepared baking sheet for 18 minutes at 350 degrees on the foil lined baking sheet. Make ahead, samosas are best eaten the day they are made, but can be reheated in the microwave for 2 minutes. Note, you can store samosas in the freezer, or reheat in the microwave between a baking sheet and baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,hard egg,ketchup,green bean,emeril,asian pear,plain flour
title: Homemade Vegetable Pies
ingredients: 5 hard-boiled eggs, roughly chopped | 6 ounces frozen cut green beans | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon emeril's original essence ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon plain flour | pickled asian pears ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process until a smooth paste forms, about five minutes. Divide between two greased 2 ounce ramekins or pie dishes. Smooth the tops with a spatula and bake in a moderate oven about 40 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,pearl barley,greek yogurt,gorgonzola,spanish onion,flour tortilla,broccoli rabe
title: Garlic Cheese and Barley Quesadillas #RSC
ingredients: 24 ounces swiss chard, rinsed and trimmed | 1/2 spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup broccoli rabe, fresh tender stems only, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup pearl barley, raw, about 1 inch square | 4 ounces fat-free gorgonzola, crumbled | 4 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Remove stems from chard.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,shaoxing wine,potato,basmati rice,garlic powder,caraway seed
title: Chinese Garlic Toast
ingredients: 1 cup plain whole wheat bread, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened | 1/8 teaspoon caraway seeds | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 1/4 cups peeled diced potatoes | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine
instructions: In a small bowl combine the cut up bread cubes with the butter, caraway seeds, & garlic powder to create a “cracker” flavored crumb. Place the bread in a single layer on a baking sheet & bake at 400 degrees for about 5 minutes per side. Add the potatoes to the bread crumbs & mix well. Spray the skillet with cooking spray & heat over high heat. Sprinkle the french fries with the kosher salt & cook for about one minute on each side until browned. Remove from the skillet & top french fries with the soy sauce & enjoy note, i've made these with the french fries already done & not the french fries.

title: Homemade Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 pint mango chutney | 1/2 pint capers, drained | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Dice mango chutney and set aside. Add saffron and paprika powder to juice in a blender and mix well, set aside. Pour mango chutney into a saucepan and stir to combine, bring just to a boil for 1 minute and then cover. Simmer for 20 - 30 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Charised Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 chicken wings, separated, tips left intact | 2 aubergines, peeled, deseeded and cut into thin long strips | 1 lb sliced fresh peach ( ripe if possible ) | 6 hoagie rolls or 6 sandwich buns, split lengthways
instructions: Make sure your chicken wings are covered with the oil, otherwise they will release too much fat during cooking. Sprinkle the wings with salt and leave for 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 400°f. Boil the chicken wings for 8 minutes in lightly salted water. Transfer the chicken wings to a roasting tin and add the aubergine slices. Cut up the peach. Bake for 15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked and tender. Toast the buns, either as desired. Place the hot chicken wings into the buns and spoon in the sliced peaches and peaches. Top with the hoagie and serve.

title: Chianti Chardonnay (Chianti Wine Cooler for Sipping)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon currants ( optional ) | 2 1/2 cups semi-sweet ice cubes, or as needed | 1/4 cup chianti wine
instructions: Stir currants into the ice cubes in a tall glass over ice cubes.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,dark soy sauce,chipotle cheddar cheese pepperjack,pork rib
title: Karela (Pork) and Chipotle Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs pork ribs | 2 ounces chipotle cheddar cheese, coarsely grated | 3 -4 black cardamom pods | 2 -3 teaspoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Rinse the pork ribs thoroughly under running cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Mix the coarsely grated chipolte cheese and the 3 tablespoons of dark soy in large bowl. Place the sugar in the bottom of a large, heavy, heavy stockpot and set over medium high heat. When the sugar starts bubbling, immediately remove from the heat. Pour the hot sugar over the pork in a spiral motion in a circular motion that leaves a sharp trail. When the sugar starts to form a deep caramel, remove the pan from the heat. With a slotted spoon, immediately lower the meat into the caramel about 2 tablespoons per pound of meat should be pressed against the sides of the pan. Place the pan in a large ovenproof skillet. Place the cardamon pods on top of the sugar. Pour enough hot water into the pan to come to 1/2 over the rack. Cover tightly and place in 325 degree oven, braising for 1 1/4 1 1/2 hours, until meat is tender and all the liquid is absorbed. Serve the ribs hot or at room temperature.

title: Hazelnut Beans
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, drained | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Place the hazelnuts and 2/3 cup of water in a pan and bring to the boil, stirring often. Stir in the beans and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Transfer mixture to a blender and purée until smooth. Return to the pan, bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes, or until heated through. Spoon into a serving dish and garnish with remaining hazelnuts.

title: Homemade Parsley Picks
ingredients: 1 teaspoon white bread flour | 2 teaspoons dried parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried lemon peel
instructions: Preheat the oven, 200°c &deg.

title: Cajun Grilled Halibut
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 16 ounces skinless halibut fillets | 12 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream
instructions: For ease, line the grill with a double thickness of heavy duty plastic wrap. Spray the wrap with cooking spray and roll out the halibut fillets about 1/8 thick. Season with cajun seasoning and reserve. Grill the halibut over hot coals for about 5 minutes or just until cooked through. Whisk cream until it begins to thicken slightly. Place in a serving dish and serve immediately, or refrigerate for later use. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: linguine,curd cottage cheese,green chili pepper,rice,sunflower oil,currant,red onion,swiss cheese
title: Spiced Cheese & Spinach Linguini
ingredients: 150 g swiss cheese, in cubes ( can used gruyere instead ) | 125 g currants | 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit, red grapes, peaches etc ( or fruit compote ) | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1 red onion, finely sliced | 4 tablespoons rice, uncooked | 1 green chili pepper, finely sliced ( seeded if you like ) | 350 -350 g linguine
instructions: In a small bowl mix together the currants, mixed dried fruit and sunflower oil. Drain the pasta. Place a large non stick frying pan over a medium heat and stir in 1 teaspoon of the sunflower oil. When the oil is very hot add the onion and cook, stirring, for 4 minutes until translucent. Add the rice and rice and stir fry for 2 minutes, or until the rice is well coated with the oil. Add the cheese, green chilli and currants and stir until all the cheese has melted. Add the linguini, stirring to combine and heat through. Serve on top of your favourite pasta.

title: Ground Beef Patties with Greens
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground round | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs, dry breadcrumbs | 1 can beef broth | 1 cup finely chopped green onion
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients to form patties. Form into 8 patties. Place on a greased grill on medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and cook, turning once, until done, about 7 minutes per side.

title: Red Chilli Feta
ingredients: 500 g dry feta - crumbled | 4 dried red chilies, finely chopped | red chili powder or cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil leaf
instructions: Combine the feta cheese and chillies and season with chilli powder, coriander and basil. Serve chilled or at room temperature with crackers or tasty fresh breads.

title: Tortilla King Prawns With Pineapple and Shrimp
ingredients: 6 large king prawns | 1/3 cup self raising flour | 60 g pineapple, chopped | 1/3 cup jumbo shrimp, cooked | 2 tablespoons tortillas, to serve
instructions: Shell and devein prawns. Place prawns in a heatproof bowl, then mix in flour. Spray a small non stick frying pan with oil. Heat over medium heat, cooking prawns for 2 - 3 minutes each side or until just cooked through. Remove from skillet, then keep warm while preparing topping. To serve, place 1 tblsp shrimp topping in a warm tortilla, then spread with pineapple and prawn mixture. Fold and serve.

title: Almond-Hacked Meatballs
ingredients: 16 ounces ground meat | 8 ounces ground blanched almonds or 8 ounces slivered almonds
instructions: Grind nuts, using pulse setting of dry foods. Store airtight in cool, dark place. Freeze meatballs in sealed foil.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,dill pickle,purpose flour,cream tartar,tequila,tamarind paste
title: Margarita Wings
