ingredients: 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 3 cups shredded rotisserie-cooked chicken drumsticks | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/8 cup finely chopped dill pickle | 1 tablespoon tequila | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a small bowl, blend together tamarind paste until smooth. Toss chicken with flour to coat. Sprinkle with pickle.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,cannellini bean,chipotle chile adobo,bacon dripping,mushroom stem
title: Sour Cream Mushroom Nests
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 2 cups mushrooms stems, finely chopped ( from 2 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle chile in adobo | 4 - 4 1/2 ounces cannellini beans, drained and rinsed well
instructions: In 4 to 6 quart pan, heat bacon drippings over medium heat. Add mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,buttermilk,mint leaf,oyster sauce,ham steak,rigatoni pasta,tomato,baking potato
title: Honduran Style Spiced Beef (Papas Y Moros) and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/2 teaspoon baking potato, grated | 2 boneless ham steaks, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 medium baking potatoes, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 medium tomatoes, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat bbq to medium low heat. Mix golden syrup, oyster sauce and grated potato in a shallow bowl. Add ham and toss to coat. Add baking potatoes and toss to coat. Set aside. In same shallow shallow bowl, mix rigatoni pasta with buttermilk until well mixed. Dip potato bowls into buttermilk and then into baking dish, overlapping as necessary. Pour pasta mixture on top, coating evenly. Bake 30 - 45 minutes until golden brown. Remove from foil. Top with tomato wedges and serve. Tips, if using lamb, roast until tender, about 135 degrees in all.

title: Romanov Beef Rissoto With Mushrooms (Romanov)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef mince, cut into 1 1/2 - cm cubes | 6 slices prosciutto | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 ounce fresh italian mushrooms, cut into small dice | 1 small new potato, cut into small dice | 2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Pour soya sauce into a bowl and put the beef in it then cover completely with mushrooms. In a pressure cooker, put the potato and the broth and follow this up with the soy sauce. Stir to mix everything well and add the meat cubes so fully covered with the mixture. If all the ingredients start to stick, just add a bit of water or some more broth. Pressure cook at medium high until the pot starts to hiss. Take off the heat and leave under the lid for 1 - 2 minutes. Serve. It takes a small amount of pressure to get the best results.

title: Smokey Smoked Beef Brisket
ingredients: 6 lbs beef brisket ( preferably a large whole brisket ) | liquid smoke
instructions: Place brisket in a large dutch oven and rub with liquid smoke. Refrigerate 24 hours. Prepare smoker, gas or charcoal. Bring brisket to room temperature as smoker requires. Place brisket in smoker box or large roasting pan. Pour 1 cup water into roasting pan, close lid and cook over medium coals 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,pizza crust,vanilla ice cream,chickpea,tomato paste
title: Chickpea Pizza
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1 frozen pre-prepared pizza crust, thawed | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 pint light vanilla ice cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread tomato paste and liquid smoke evenly on pizza crust. Sprinkle chickpeas on top of tomato paste. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and filling is hot, about 20 minutes. Slice ice cream into wedges. Top with toppings of your choice.

title: Lemongrass Zucchini Chips and Lemongrass
ingredients: 3/4 lb zucchini, sliced thin | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried lemongrass | 1/2 teaspoon dried lemon grass | 1/2 cup dry red wine, of your choice | 1 can lemongrass, packed and cut in 4 pieces | 8 pretzels
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pretzels in a very large salad bowl and toss to combine. Place 1 tortilla at a time in a microwave safe bowl. Cook uncovered at high for 30 seconds. Remove from microwave, spread on heated tortilla and sprinkle with 1/4 each of the lemon grass and pretzels, if using. Microwave at high for one minute or until lemongrass is crispy. Cut into wedges & serve with your favourite chutney.

title: Chicken Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed chicken soup ( i prefer amy's ) | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar ( or other favorite vinegar )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend until smooth. This can also be made without using broth instead of soup. Serve over cooked pork or shrimp, chicken, pork or chicken wings, etc.

title: Okra from Saveur Magazine
ingredients: 1 small white okra | 1 lemon peel, grated | 2 small brown onions, very finely chopped or 2 small yellow onions | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Prepare okra and rinse under cold water and set aside. Mix all ingredients together in a large frying pan and cook over medium heat until okra is soft on the inside but still tender and the coating is a little bit sticky at the edges. Turn the heat up and add okra mixture in pan. Cook about 10 minutes or until okra is heated through and golden. Do not overcook. Serve with rice or indian breads and a salad.

title: Lemon-Caramel Pork  (Rouladen)
ingredients: 2 lbs roasting chickens, cut into quarters | 1 cup currants | 2 packages caramels ( or 1/2 cup melted liqueur of your choice and 1/2 cup liqueur of your choice ) | 2 lemons, zest of, minced | 1 jar hot caramel sauce
instructions: Bring to a boil, add the currants, chicken, lemon zest, and caramels. Cover and simmer slowly slowly, basting with the simmering liquid often to make sure nothing sticks to the meat. When the meat is tender, remove the chicken and vegetables. Make sure to thicken the sauce while turning the meat. Remove the chicken pieces and vegetables to a platter. Pour the hot caramel sauce over the meat and vegetables and place in the refrigerator. Cook time is general. If the sauce is too thick, stir in a little water.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,dill,hot pepper,chocolate curl,allspice,scallion,lamb shank,taco seasoning
title: Momma's Shredded Salmon and Spicy Lamb Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb shanks, split horizontally | 1/2 lb buttery ground round or 1/2 lb lean ground turkey | 1 package taco seasoning ( or use prepared ) | 1/4 cup chili powder or 1/4 cup dried hot pepper | 3 tablespoons dried dill or 2 fresh dill, minced | 1 dash ground allspice | 1 large scallion, finely chopped | chocolate curls ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Toss kabobs with butter and season with salt, pepper, and allspice. Let sit for 5 minutes. Place on a baking tray. Roast, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Turn to get even browning. Remove from oven and cool 5 minutes. Place on a cutting board. Cut in half crosswise. Divide and evenly distribute cooked meat over meat. Top each with 1 tbls. Of spiced butter. Sprinkle with dill and allspice. Garnish with chocolate curls. Can be served either at room temperature or the next day.

Random Ingredients: half,cashew nut,date,cremini mushroom,pita bread,serrano chilies,miracle whip
title: Tasty Mushroom & Date Dip
ingredients: 2 serrano chilies ( or any other chili you like ) | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, finely chopped ( approx. 5oz ) | 7 ounces cashew nuts, finely ground | 1/8 cup miracle whip | 1 cup half-and-half | 2 ounces dates, finely chopped | pita bread, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c remove stem from chilies and seed them, removing seeds and membrane. Slice the chillies and mushrooms in half or quarters, depending on size of mushrooms, and place in a shallow ovenproof dish. Add the cashew nuts to the nuts. Combine the mushrooms, nuts, & miracle whip, and stir to combine well. Pour over the mushrooms in the dish. Bake on the centre shelf for approximately 30 minutes, until mushroom and nuts have completely melted and mixture is smooth.

title: French Herb Stock
ingredients: 1 kg fresh ground meat, ( poultry, beef, pork, or veg are all really good ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: Place ground meat in a pan that has an oven shelf that is about 3/4 deep. Sprinkle with rosemary. Pour stock into the pan, making sure it is all absorbed. Cover tightly and leave in a warm place for 2 1/2 hours. Remove cover and leave in a warm place for a further 30 minutes to develop the flavour. Discard the solids. If using broth for soup, add vegetables, to taste. If used as an unusual flavoured liquid, this can also be sautéed in butter.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,cherry brandy,topping,pork hock,red cabbage,oriental sesame oil,cranberry,wine vinegar
title: Red Cabbage Salad With Pork Hocks and Lingons
ingredients: 500 g red cabbage | 300 g cherry brandy ( or 2 bottles of lingons brandy ) | 500 g pork hocks | 600 g red cabbage | 150 ml red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 2 tablespoons cranberries, chopped ( or 1/2 cup chopped pecans )
instructions: Clean red cabbage and cut into 2 inch strips. Wash hocks. Slice into pieces with cleaver or scissors. Place pork hocks in a large pot with enough water to cover for about one hour. Bring to a boil and continue boiling for about 1 hr, or until meat is tender and falling off the bone. Allow to cool slightly. Cut cabbage into wedges. Cut mustard green and lingons into 3 inch lengths. Dressing, place vinegar, vanilla and sesame oils in a blender or a food processor with a few drops of vanilla. Add some spices and pulse to taste. Add 2/3 cup of warm liquid from the pot and pulse. Transfer to a bowl, chill and refrigerate. Place in the refrigerator leftovers for at least 1 hour and up to 2 days. Stir in cranberries just before serving. Taste as you add it improves with time.

title: Polish Eggplant Rolls
ingredients: 3 medium eggplants | 8 radishes | 2 packages sliced kielbasa | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 cup matzo crackers, broken | 3/8 cup soymilk | 1 carton plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Slice the eggplant lengthwise on a mandoline at 1/4 inch/thick slices, resulting in eight 10 x 15 inch sheets. Place slices in a shallow dish and cover with boiling water. Turn heat to high and boil for 3 minutes or until the eggplant collapses and the water is clear. You should not hear it boil. Drain and rinse well. Place drained eggplant in a colander.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,dark rum,pork tenderloin,baby spinach leaf
title: Spanish Pork Tenderloin With Spinach (Sbd P3 Ww)
ingredients: 1 boneless pork tenderloin | 1/3 cup dark rum ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 head baby spinach leaves
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450 degrees. Place pork and marinade in a zip lock bag for about 10 minutes. Remove tenderloins from bag.

title: Lentil Crock Pot Pull-Apart Pizza
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast, cut into 3/4 & quot, cubes | 1 can baked lentils | 1 1/2 cups quick oats ( not instant ) | 1 package medium crescent roll dough ( not pam ) | 1 package firm tofu | 2 tablespoons cinnamon ( or to taste ) | 1 package shredded oat ( or to taste )
instructions: Brown roast and lentils in a skillet. Remove the meat mixture to a crock pot or dutch oven and add the oats. Stir to mix. Top the meat mixture with crescent roll dough. Mix tofu and cinnamon and sprinkle some over the layer of bread. Cover with the remaining crescent dough. Cook on high for 1 1/2 hours on high or on low for a total of 3 hours.

title: Spaghetti Sauce II
ingredients: 2 cans tomato paste | 2 cups chopped onion | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the tomato paste, onion, red pepper flakes, and enough water to make one 28 ounce can. Stir well and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat, and simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Tilapia or Grilled Fish
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 cup cheese spread
instructions: Combine bicarb and about 1/4 cup cheese spread in a shallow dish. Spread bicarb mixture onto fish and chill for 2 hours before grilling is complete. Brush fish with extra cheese spread before grilling.

title: Arabic Saffron Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup shelled whole blanched almonds, lightly salted | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads, very finely crushed
instructions: Place the almonds in a bowl in a single layer. Sprinkle with a little of the saffron. Sprinkle with the rest of saffron. Spread the toasted almonds on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 300°f until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,apple juice,cream celery soup,green chilies
title: Apple Dhal
ingredients: 1 can green chilies, drained and chopped | 3/4 cup red lentil, rinsed and drained | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 3 tablespoons apple juice ( optional ) or 3 tablespoons water ( optional )
instructions: In a 2 quart casserole dish, combine chiles, lentils, cream of celery soup and apple juice or water. Cover and bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Cherry Brown Chip Crisp
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon serrano chili, from a jar, finely minced | 1 tablespoon sourdough starter | 1 1/2 cups miniature semisweet chocolate chips | 8 -12 cherries, halved
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch pan with a pastry brush or grease with a little oil. Stir together the mustard powder, serrano chili, sourdough starter, and chocolate until well combined. Spread mixture into the pan. Place cherries in a single layer atop the mustard powder mixture. Stir to coat the cherries with the mustard powder and chillies.

title: Cod With Parsnips
ingredients: 1 medium parsnip, peeled and cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 large sweet potato, peeled, cut into thick diagonal slices | 12 ounces cod fillets, cut into 2 inch flake strips | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained | 1 -2 teaspoon dried garlic granules
instructions: In a medium size sauce pan, cook parsnips in boiling water until tender crisp. Drain. Meanwhile, place fish in a greased baking dish or pan. Add parsnips, sweetpotatoes and olives to the fish and turn to coat. Sprinkle with garlic granules, cover with foil, and bake at 400 for 20 - 25 minutes, stirring every now and then.

title: Scallop Baklava
ingredients: 2 packages shirataki-style ramen noodles | 1 box frozen cooked scallops (, such as sea scallops ) | 1/4 cup basil pesto | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary | 4 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place Ramen noodles in a large pot over high heat, and bring to a boil. Cover noodles with water, and bring water to a boil again.

title: Rice With Cream
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked white basmati rice, rinsed | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 1 1/2 ounces mascarpone cheese | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon poppy seeds ( optional )
instructions: Combine the rice and water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until all the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Remove pot from the heat. Let stand covered for 5 minutes. Stir in cream and cheese. Season with sesame seeds, if desired. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,vodka,feta cheese,asparagus spear,tuna vegetable oil,za'atar spice mix
title: Spaghetti With Asparagus & Tuna
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh asparagus spears, trimmed | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 can canned canned tuna in vegetable oil, drained | 3/4 cup vodka | 1 envelope za'atar spice mix, divided ( found in middle eastern specialty store ) | 1 package feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cook asparagus and spaghetti according to package directions then drain reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Return the asparagus to the pan and add the remaining ingredients except the cheese and cook until warmed through but not browned. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | oil for frying | 2 ounces prosciutto, diced | 3 teaspoons packed fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring cold water to boil over high heat. When mixture bubbles, add oil, proscuitto and basil. Stir to combine. Simmer until sauce has thickened to your desired consistency. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,yoghurt,flat leaf parsley,ziti pasta,bow tie pasta,turnip,cardamom
title: Bow Ties and Turnips With Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta, cooked and drained | 1 lb bow tie pasta, cooked and drained | 1 cup yogurt | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup turnip, peeled and cut diagonally into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Combine pasta and yogurt in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Eggplant & Pinto Bean Plauta
ingredients: 2 red eggplants, about 1 1/2 pounds total weight | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 3/4 cup pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 3/4 cup dry red wine | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint sprigs or 1/4 teaspoon chopped fresh mint
instructions: Cut the eggplant lengthwise into 3/8 inch thick slices crosswise about 1/4 inch thick. Heat 3 tablespoons of the oil in a 12 inch sauté pan over medium heat and cook the slices, turning once, until deeply golden, about 4 minutes total. Transfer the browned pieces on a paper towels and keep them warm in a 200 degree f oven while you continue to cook the remaining pieces. Heat the remaining tablespoon of oil in a 12 inch heavy skillet over medium to high heat. Add the beans, wine, nutmeg and thyme and toss to combine. When the liquid boils, spoon over the sliced eggplant then bake the plauta, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Transfer to a warm serving dish, sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of parsley, and serve piping hot.

title: Cajun Style Beans
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cooking oil, or to taste | 2 cans pinto beans | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning ( optional ) | 1 package dry pasta
instructions: Drain excess moisture from beans, and set aside. Heat the oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Stir in the beans and cajun seasoning, and mix well. Cover, and cook 2 to 3 minutes, or until hot. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Chicken With Oranges With a Rosemary Sauce
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 2 rosemary sprigs | 2 medium oranges, zest of, grated | 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, cubed | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 sprig fresh rosemary or 1 sprig fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Remove and discard the neck and giblets from the chicken. Rinse the chicken under cold running water. Pat dry with a paper towel. Cut into 3 or 4 pieces. Insert the rosemary sprigs into the chicken by carefully cutting along one side of the breast and the other. Season well with salt and pepper. Arrange the chicken pieces in an ovenproof casserole dish, or large roasting pan sprayed with cooking spray. Place the pan in the oven and roast the chicken for 1 hour or until the juices run clear when a thigh is pierced. While the chicken is cooking, combine the orange zest and butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir and cook 30 seconds or until the butter is browned and foaming, then remove from the heat and set aside. Add the half and half, rosemary, or basil to the pan and stir to combine. Cook and stir for about 5 minutes until slightly thickened. Pour the pan mixture over the chicken and stir to coat. Return the baking dish to the oven and continue cooking until the sauce is completely reduced, 30 to 45 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Piperade
ingredients: 300 ml mayonnaise | 200 ml oil mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped ripe olives | 1 teaspoon crushed baking powder | 1/4 cup cooking wine | 2 teaspoons toasted peanuts
instructions: Mix the mayonnaise and oil in a bowl. Stir in the mayonnaise mix, celery, olives, baking powder and wine. Mix well to cover. Spoon into a glass dish, cover and chill for half an hour. Remove from the fridge 15 minutes before serving sprinkle top with ground nuts before serving.

title: Quick Coconut Cola
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup red snipped dry sherry wine ( can use white rice wine if desired ) or 1/2 cup white wine ( can use white rice wine if desired )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer 5 - 10 minutes. Serve over ice.

title: Italian Hot Chocolate (White)
ingredients: 5 cups mayonnaise | 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Blend mayonnaise and superfine sugar and cocoa. Pour into small heat proof glasses and set. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,pork baby back rib,rosemary,black bean,red chili,tomato sauce,liquid smoke,sage leaf
title: Slow-Cooker Smoked Smoked Pork for Two
ingredients: 1 pound baby-back ribs | 2 pounds pork baby-back ribs | 15 fresh sage leaves | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 4 medium hot dried red chili, crushed | 1 can black beans | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke, or to taste
instructions: Place ribs in a 3 1/2 quart slow cooker. Mix baby back ribs with sage, rosemary, chili, black beans, tomato sauce, beef stock, and liquid smoke together in a bowl. Cook on low heat for 1 hour. Turn slow cooker to high.

title: Pancake-Fernchen
ingredients: 1 boneless tri-tip steak, cubed | 1 teaspoon ground fenugreek | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 2 granny smith apples, sliced
instructions: Place the beef in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with fenugreek and cayenne. Cover the dish with plastic wrap or aluminum foil and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 3 days. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Remove the meat from the refrigerator, shaking the dish. Spray with non stick cooking spray and rub with a little olive oil. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes. Serve with your favorite salad greens and tomato puree.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,chinese five spice powder,worcestershire sauce,kaffir lime leaf,salmon fillet,beef
title: Asian Style Barbecue Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets ( skin-on, ie. a whole fish that is a smallish size ) | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper ( red or green ) | 1/8 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Prepare barbecue grill. Place salmon in a single layer and sprinkle all over with five spice powder, five spice powder, worcestershire sauce, red or green onion, and a little pepper. Grill over high to heat for 10 to 15 minutes on each side or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.. Transfer to serving platter and sprinkle hot pepper over salmon.

title: Vegetarian Lasagne
ingredients: 500 g lasagna noodles | 2 small aubergines | 3 cups hot water | 1 cup hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Boil the aubergines in the hot water until soft, then peel. Cut the aubergines in half lengthwise and cut into 5 pieces lengthwise. Put the noodles in a bowl, and pour over boiling water. Leave to soak for about 15 minutes, then drain and rinse with cold water. Drain again. Spread half the slices of aubergine on the bottom of a small rectangular oven proof dish, then cover with 3 noodles. Sprinkle with half the hoisin sauce, then pour over the rest of the sauce. Next, lay the noodles over the guo sauce and cover with the rest of the sauce. Sprinkle with the golden syrup and leave to stand for 45 minutes. Heat in the oven at 160 degrees c for about 25 minutes, or until bubbling and golden brown. Variation, this dish can be made vegetarian by pouring 2 cups of water in with the pasta, then draining the aubergines and set aside with the hot water.

Random Ingredients: capicola,yellow bell pepper,granny smith apple,ham steak
title: Somerset Grilled Ham With Capicola Apples
ingredients: 4 ham steaks ( about 1 1/2 inches thick ) | 12 ounces capicola ( or other crisp cured ham of your choice ) | 6 ounces yellow bell peppers, cut into 3-inch pieces ( or other crisp-sauté green bell pepper ) | 1 granny smith apple, cored and cut in wedges
instructions: Spread Capicola on cut sides of ham, place on grill over med coals. Grill covered, 10 - 18 minutes or until meat is to your liking. Meanwhile, toss apples with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper in large skillet and cook, tossing, over med coals for about 10 minutes or until tender. Spoon apple mixture onto ham and serve with green vegetables.

title: Quick and Easy Tandoori Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, cut in 3/4-inch cubes | 1/2 cup tandoori paste | 1/2 teaspoon white sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Place the bread cubes into a large bowl, toss with the tandoori paste, and coat well. Sprinkle sesame seeds over the bread mixture. Spread evenly into the prepared pan, and place the pan into the refrigerator. Bake in the preheated oven until bread is puffed and light golden brown, about 40 minutes.

title: Easy Marinated Eggplant
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled and cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices | 1/3 cup orange juice from orange zest, reserve one to save zest for a drizzle | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: Place eggplant slices in a colander and sprinkle liberally with the reserved orange zest. Let sit about 10 minutes. Meanwhile in a small bowl, mix the dijon and reserved orange juice zest. Drain the eggplant, pat dry with paper towels, and brush top of slices with the dijon mixture. Grill over hot coals 3 - 5 minutes per side, until tender and lightly golden.

title: Hard Salami (Algerian Breakfast)
ingredients: 1 hard salami, sliced into half-moons | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon pine nuts
instructions: Slice the salami into slices about 1/4 inch thick. Beat egg white and add to sliced salami. Sprinkle pine nuts on top of egg white and put under a hot grill until nuts just begin to turn golden. Pile onto a plate.

Random Ingredients: black olive,cardamom powder,rice wine,corn kernel,red curry paste,coriander,parmesan cheese
title: Corn and Black Olive Raita
ingredients: 8 frozen corn kernels, thawed and drained | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/3 cup diced black olives - drained | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom powder | fresh coriander ( for garnishing ) or fresh mint ( for garnishing ) ( optional )
instructions: Process all ingredients, except for the garnishes, in a food processor to your preferred consistency. Add the garnish. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,masa harina,baking potato,kidney bean,salt black pepper,candy sprinkle,grain white rice,cheese
title: Riz Gruntos (Rice Snack)
ingredients: 1 whole potato, scrubbed clean and chopped | 4 bolillos sausage, casings removed ( or mexican chorizo ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup long-grain white rice, such as basmati | 1 1/3 cups mexican-style brandy, such as chardonnay | 1 cup finely grated cheese, such as emmentaler ( about 1 cup ) | 15 cups fresh masa harina ( corn tortillas ), warmed | salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil over high heat. Add potato, and cook until just tender, about 6 minutes. Drain in a colander set in the sink, and allow to cool until easily handled, about 15 minutes. Heat a skillet over medium heat, and cook chorizo until golden brown and crisp, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside. Drain the chorizo, and slice in half lengthwise. Place the chorizo into a bowl with the cooked potatoes, kidney beans, rice, and brandy. Cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving. Place 1 masa harina cup in a large bowl. Stir in 1 cup water, and season with salt and black pepper.

title: Spicy Tuna With Parsley and Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb tuna steak | 1/3 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1/3 cup mild salsa ( i use pace medium for less sodium ) | 1/4 cup fat-free low-sodium tuna steak, minced | 2 tablespoons fat free italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 dash pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the minced parsley and salsa. In a hot pan, cook the tuna until firm and opaque. While the tuna is cooking, combine the diced prawn, the parsley, the pepper, and the rest of the salsa. Mix well and keep warm. Serve this salad with a simple green salad.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,lump crabmeat,farfalle pasta,head cabbage,gingerroot,green olive,liquid honey
title: Slow Cooker Corned Beef and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 teaspoon finely grated fresh gingerroot | 1 can lump crabmeat, drained and cartilage removed | 1 package uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 lbs rump roast, chopped ( about 6 cups, or more if desired ) | 2 cups large-diced peeled green olives | 7 cups coarsely chopped red cabbage | 1/2 cup liquid honey | 1/2 cup chopped black pitted greek olive
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine gingerroot, crabmeat, pasta, and 2 cups of the chopped green olives in a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker. Pour half of the pasta mixture into the slow cooker.

title: Homemade Italian Pizza Dough
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces bread flour | 5 tablespoons tomato paste | 7 -9 drops hot sauce | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 50 g hazelnuts ( or similar nuts )
instructions: Combine the tomato paste and hot sauce in a shallow dish and then rub onto the bread flour. Stir, cover and leave for 10 minutes. Stir through the honey and hazelnuts, then shape into a loaf.. Bake in a pizza press according to instructions then sprinkle with grated nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: tuna steak,cornstarch,vinegar,red chili powder,phyllo pastry,vegetable oil,sirloin
title: Beef and Tuna Tatin Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 sirloin, trimmed ( a rib steak works best ) | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder ( more or less, to taste ) | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 32 -32 sheets phyllo pastry ( or use 2 filo cups ) | vegetable oil, for frying
instructions: Combine marinade ingredients in a small bowl. Cut meat into 1/4 inch pieces and set aside in the marinade while preparing the filling. Heat oil in a small pot over medium high to high heat. Dip meat quickly in batter, cooking in batches if necessary. Fry until golden brown and cooked through. Drain well on paper towels. When all meat is cooked, remove from pan and keep warm while making the roll ups. Lay filo pastry on clean work surface. Cover with a damp paper towel. Sprinkle with more sugar to avoid unpleasant smell from oven while cooking. Place 2 or 3 tablespoons of meat on work surface along with some of the warm drippings from meat. Roll out to approximately 10 x 18 wide rectangle. Make sure to roll it tight to avoid crumbling. Place roll ups, seam side down, on clean work surface. Dont use the back of a spoon to remove all air pockets from the roll ups. Cover with damp paper towel. Place 2 or 3 tblsp of warmed melted butter on lower rack of the oven. When the butter has melted begin brushing your lower rack with oil. Use tongs to spread the melted butter across the lower and lower half of the roll ups, to ensure even coating of melted butter throughout. Place in lower rack of oven and lower heat to 300 degrees f. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the internal temperature of your steak reaches 180 degrees f. After 20 minutes remove from oven and allow to cool. After 10 minutes remove from oven and allow to cool completely before slicing. Serve with green salad, french fries or your favourite salad and enjoy.

title: Southwestern Bacon Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb bacon | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 6 small fresh thyme sprigs | 2 cups shredded medium-jack cheese or 2 cups grated monterey jack cheese | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Cook bacon over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon. Press bread crumbs into skillet. Add thyme. Sprinkle with cheese. Fill with bacon, pressing and turning to compact bread crumbs. Remove thyme sprigs and thyme. Roll up jelly roll fashion, pinching ends. Chill rolls while you make salsa. Serve in deep bowl with salsa in middle.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,tomato green chilies,extra virgin olive oil,mayonnaise,black bean,double cream,almond extract
title: Spanish Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups medium grain rice | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 can black beans, drained | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 1/2 fluid ounces double cream | 3 -4 pinches extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Bring large pan of water to boil, and reduce heat to simmer. Add rice, stirring to coat the grains with water. Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Turn off heat, remove from heat, leave covered for 10 minutes. Fluff up rice with fork and stir in tomatoes and green chillies. Allow to cool for 10 minutes, stir in beans, mix in mayonnaise, almond extract and cream. Add olive oil in a slow or steady stream, stirring until smooth. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,pistachio,extra virgin olive oil,self rising flour,panko breadcrumb,chili sauce,lemon peel,lamb
title: Flamenco Lamb Rissoles
ingredients: 8 ounces minced lamb | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons shaved lemon peel | 1 teaspoon panko breadcrumbs | 2 1/2 cups cooked arborio rice, warm ( about 110 degrees ) | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1/3 cup shelled pistachios, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c/400°f. Mix together garlic, lemon peel, panko, and rice until well combined. Shape mixture into 4 large balls then place on a baking tray and bake until well coloured, about 20 minutes. Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a non stick frying pan. Add meat balls and cook over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through. Remove lamb balls from the oven & keep warm. Stir remaining olive oil into rice in frying pan & add rice. Continue to stir rice until hot. Spread the rice around the base of a medium size, warm serving bowl. Place a heaped teaspoonful of mixture in the centre of the rice & press gently to form a slight dent in the centre of the ring. Repeat steps 7 - 9 until all the lamb is used up. Spoon hot rice into bowls, top with lamb balls and sprinkle with pistachios.

Random Ingredients: splenda granular,tabasco sauce,plum tomato,dark chocolate,turmeric,tomato sauce,penne rigate
title: Spicy Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 6 plum tomatoes, cut into 1/4 rounds | 1/2 cup splenda granular, sugar substitute | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 4 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce, low sodium | 1/2 lb dry penne rigate, cooked
instructions: In a 3 quart saucepan, simmer tomatoes over low heat. Meanwhile, in saucepan over medium heat, stir splenda, turmeric and tabasco until blended. Add tomato sauce, stirring to blend well. Simmer for 5 minutes. In large pot of boiling water, cook pasta until just al dente, about 8 minutes.

title: Chive and Chive Rolls
ingredients: lettuce, shredded | fresh chives, chopped | icing sugar | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Wash and dry the lettuce and chives. Divide the leaves evenly among serving plates. Sprinkle lightly with icing sugar, then top with fresh ground pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Tortillas With Pork or Cheese
ingredients: 12 -20 flour tortillas | 3 lbs lean pork or 3 lbs cheese, of choice | 1/2 cup dried pork fat, from the loin roast or 1/2 cup currant jelly | 1 medium onion, finely diced | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Cut the roasts into slices or chunks. Mix the meat with the dried oregano leaves. In a skillet, fry the pork or cheese until it's browned and crumbly. Set meat aside. Wrap all the tortillas with the meat or cheese and place in a large, heavy casserole or oven proof dish. Pour the jelly over them, covering evenly. When the cheese begins bubbling, add the onion. Cover the dish and let it cook for 20 more minutes, or until the tortillas start to soften. Remove the casserole from the oven. Allow to cool slightly then serve.

title: Chef John's Tamarind-Corn Chutney
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn ( or half a small can of cream of potato corn ) | 1/2 cup dry white wine or 1/2 cup water | 2 -3 teaspoons tamarind paste, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or more to taste
instructions: Stir cream style corn, wine/water, and tamarind paste together in a saucepan. Stirring the mixture occasionally, bring to a boil. Boil over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 more minutes. Stir in cinnamon. Stir in a spoonful of cold water and serve warm.

title: Swiss Berry Spinach
ingredients: 1 bag fresh baby spinach | 1 bag orange peel | 1 bag fresh blueberries
instructions: Heat a pan of boiling water on the stovetop. When it's hot, add bag of spinach to water and cook, in the same water, until spinach wilts. When it's cool, drain spinach and transfer to bowl. Toss with orange peel and blueberries. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Cheese
ingredients: 250 g gruyere cheese | 250 ml milk
instructions: Wash your hands. Remove the base and top layer of gougères from the cheese bag. Pour the milk/water onto the bottom and sides of the bag to ensure that it penetrates evenly. Then press with your finger as far to the sides of the bag. The idea is to create air bubbles and to coat the cheese with some of the milk/water mixture. This is optional, it makes the cheese even better. Allow the milk/water mixture to sit in the cheese bag in the sink for about 30 minutes before putting to the work surface. The mixture can then be put back into your preheated oven at 200c/400f/gas mark 3 and eaten straight away. This is meant to let the flavors develop, but can be stored in the fridge for up to one week. If you can get the desired hang, then leave it in the fridge for at least 2 hours or more. When ready to eat, simply mix the remaining milk with your cheese. I recommend adding a little cornstarch dissolved in a little water to give a good texture for stews or toasted breads, etc.

title: Italian Pesto Bites
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups italian style breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( the powder, not the garlic, it should look like a paste with some of the flavor but is not overpowering, and will also give the finished product a 'crumbier'texture )
instructions: Put all ingredients in your foodprocessor in the order given. Turn machine on and process for 30 seconds and check your pulse.

title: Smokin' Irish (Dry)
ingredients: 1/4 cup beef bouillon | 8 boneless chicken thighs | 4 strips rye bread
instructions: Combine the beef bouillon and bouillon in a medium bowl. Lightly butter the inside of a large slow cooker. Place the chicken, cut side up in the bowl, and sprinkle with salt. Cook in cooker for 8 hours on low. Remove meat to serving platter, and shred or chop meat. Slice rye bread horizontally while still warm. Spoon warm meat into bread bowls.

Random Ingredients: avocado,monterey jack pepper cheese,sauce,oregano leaf,butter,pico de gallo
title: Baja Grill Style Avocado Dip
ingredients: 2 avocados | 3/4 lb monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup butter, melted | 1/2 cup salsa ( mild to hot, we like our own homemade ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: Cut avocados in half and remove pit and skin. Cut halves in half again and scoop out pulp while holding halves together. Put in a medium bowl and mash in half of shredded chees until everything looks creamy. Add rest of ingredients. Put in a shallow dish or pie plate that has been coated well with papertowels. Place in a low heat oven to warm and get all the flavours really good, serve right away or refrigerate until serving.

title: Crispy Sun Dried Tomato Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, undrained | 1/4 cup fresh gingerroot, peeled and cut in very thin matchsticks | 1 teaspoon pumpkin seeds, coarse
instructions: Put all the ingredients except the seeds in a food processor. Blend until smooth. Place sun dried tomato seeds and ginger in a dry frying pan and fry over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes turning often until fragrant.

title: A Very Versatile Vegetable Chowder
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped leeks ( spring onions ) | 1 can chopped tomatoes with juice | 8 ounces choc pudding mix | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Combine everything except cauliflower in a food processor, blend until no lumps remain. Add cauliflower and process again until mixture looks chunky. Pour into large bowl and chill 2 - 4 hours before serving at room temperature. Variation, for a richer flavor, add 1 cup vegetable broth or water while blending, and add half an equivalent amount of cream. Serve in bowls with a dollop of unsweetened vanilla yogurt.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,chicken bouillon cube,tomato green chilies,italian parsley
title: Cheater's World Famous  Chili Verde Con Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 15 ounces diced mild tomatoes with green chilies, undrained ( i use contadina ) | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon italian parsley | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Put in large freezer bag. Shake all ingredients together and dump in crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Serve with favorite toppings.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,beef bouillon cube,mint,white sugar,almond,meatball
title: Nate's "raisin and Mint Meatballs"
ingredients: 1 kg meatballs | 5 teaspoons dried mint | 2 teaspoons dried mint | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 large beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup blanched slivered almond | 2 teaspoons white sugar
instructions: Put the meatballs, mint, parsley, bouillon cube and almonds in a large pot. Pour water over it, or enough to cover the meatballs. Cover pan and bring to the boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer very gently, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are soft and meatballs are cooked through, about 30 - 40 minutes. When meatballs are done, remove meatballs and keep warm in the oven. Skim fat off remaining fat in pot. When hot enough for your taste, remove meatballs from the cooking liquid and cool.

title: Hazelnut Beef and Pork Rolls
ingredients: 1 large shortcrust pastry | 500 g pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into 2 cm cubes | 500 g beef steaks, trimmed and cut into 2 cm cubes | 1 celery rib, trimmed and chopped | 200 g ground hazelnuts | 1 ripe papaya, peeled and cubed
instructions: Use a rolling pin to roll out the pastry to fit a 23 x 23cm cake tin. Trim the edges to fit if necessary. Roll out the pastry into the tin as thin as possible. Remove excess pastry. Place all the pork into a large bowl. Add the beef and the celery, season and mix until well combined. Using your hands, mix in the nutella. Spread half the nut mixture over the pastry. Place the pork on top, pressing lightly. Spread to cover with nutella mixture. Top with remaining pastry, pressing lightly. Trim excess overhanging pastry as possible. Using sharp scissors, cut a slit in the centre of each roll. Seal the top and bottom with the tip of a knife. Cook in oven for 45 minutes. Turn and cook for a further 45 minutes. Carefully remove from the oven and allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving with whipped cream or yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,asparagus,cream chicken soup,liquid honey,purpose flour,rigatoni pasta,rice noodle
title: Rigatoni With Asparagus and Creamy Barley
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces cream of chicken soup | 3/4 cup liquid honey | 2 1/2 - 3 cups uncooked regular pearl barley or 2 1/2-3 cups other long grain white rice noodles, such as arborio | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta, such as tubetti with leaves | 6 ounces firm asparagus, trimmed, cut diagonally into 1/2-inch slices | 1 3/4 cups hot cooked pearl barley ( see note )
instructions: Whisk soup, honey and 1 cup water in a 3 quart saucepan until blended. Add half of the cooked rice noodles and the flour. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture is thickened and coats back of spoon, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Cook remaining ingredients in saucepan over medium heat about 4 minutes or until heated through. Stir in barley, adding the remaining soup mixture. Serve hot with sliced asparagus and remaining hot barley.

title: Peaches and Blue Cheese Terrine
ingredients: 25 g blue cheese | 1 tablespoon lemon gelatin | 6 large ripe peaches, peeled, halved and sliced thin | 2 green chili peppers, seeded and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 125 g rocket, rinsed and tailed
instructions: Place the blue cheese and the ginerr in a bowl, cover and leave to stand for 10 minutes. Dissolve the gelatine in 2 teaspoons cold water. Add the remaining ingredients, mix, and set aside. Cut the basil into 1 cm cubes and add to the base of a terrine dish. Spoon in the blue cheese mixture. Cover and set aside for 1 hour at room temperature. Turn out onto a serving platter and cut into squares, serve warm or cold.

title: Curried Toast With Coconut Paste
ingredients: 4 slices white bread, unsliced | 1 tablespoon coconut paste | 1/4 cup vegetable or 1/4 cup chicken broth, divided | 4 slices french baguettes | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: Combine bread and 1/4 cup broth in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: walla onion,creme fraiche,cayenne,eggplant,black peppercorn,catsup,iceberg lettuce,cottage cheese
title: Eggplant Aubergine (Aubergine) Rollatini
ingredients: 2 eggplants, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise into very thin slices | 1 cup cottage cheese, drained | 1 ounce walla walla onions ( sweet onion chopped ) or 1 ounce leeks, minced ( sweet onion chopped ) | iceberg lettuce, torn | 3 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 pinch cayenne | 2 black peppercorns | crushed iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the egg plants on paper towels lined baking sheet and brush with a little olive oil, sprinkle with salt and let to dry about 30 minutes. In a bowl or serving bowl, mix the cottage cheese and minced onions. Combine the eggplant slices and a sprinkle of salt, if using, in a colander and squeeze out excess water then place in a colander. Using a spatula, lightly pat the excess moisture from each piece of eggplant and gently pat dry. Place the eggplant, overlapping, on the same baking sheets and top each one with chopped onion. Sprinkle lightly with salt. Place a row of torn lettuce on each of the eggs. Place in the oven and bake until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. In a small bowl, combine all the dipping sauce ingredients, reserving 1 tablespoon of the dip sauce for another use. Spoon off and discard the excess liquid in the baking sheet. In a small saucepan, combine the reserved dip sauce with the crushed iceberg lettuce, reserving 2 or 3 tablespoons of the cheese sauce. Boil until the mixture is reduced by 1/ stir in the remaining cheese sauce and heat until warmed through. Serve rolled up the eggplant aubergines with dipping sauce and garnish with remaining cheese and lettuce.

title: Quick and Easy Cheesy Onion Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the graham cracker crumbs and cream of chicken soup together in a bowl. Mix into the crumb mixture. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Pour mixture into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle the top with extra graham cracker crumbs, if desired. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 15 minutes.

title: Confetti Burritos
ingredients: 6 tortillas | 1/2 cup broccoli rabe, finely chopped | 1 can broccoli florets, drained | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: To assemble, fry 6 tortillas in a little peanut oil, until crispy. Remove from oil and place on paper towels. Heat remaining oil in skillet and saute broccoli until tender. In blender or food processor, add 1/2 cup rice and broccoli rabe to pan and blend until smooth. Add salt and vegetable mix to skillet and cook over medium heat until heated through. Spoon about 1/6 of rice/broccoli mix on each tortilla and roll up, place on waxed paper. To store, wrap each tortilla tightly in foil. Store in refrigerator for up to 4 weeks.

title: Mexican Chopped Romaine on Bacon
ingredients: 1 loaf romaine lettuce, with the ribs removed | 4 slices very thin slice prosciutto | toppings, for frying the bacon | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 1/2 orange, zested and juiced | generous seasoning salt, to taste
instructions: To serve, tear off the romaine from the inside of the pan. Wrap each slice of prosciutto around a thin slice of bacon and secure with a toothpick. Add 1 tablespoon of toppings to frying pan, and fry bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon slices from the pan and drain on paper towels. Spread toasted bacon with 1 tablespoon toppings on a platter, garnish with more pimentos and orange zest, and season with salt to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Mint Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1 shallot | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon coriander | 1/2 cup shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Place pesto in a small bowl and set aside. Place shallot in a small saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.

title: Sausage and Pasta With No-Salt Tomatoes and Rice
ingredients: 1 lb penne, fresh | 9 ounces italian sweet sausage | 1 cup rice flour | 1 fresh orange, quartered | 2 mushrooms | 6 medium tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Rinse pasta under cool water and drain. Set aside. Meanwhile, slice sausage into very thin 3/4 inch slices, about 1 1/2 inches long. Cut orange in half, then crosswise into 1/8 inch wide strips. Set aside. Place rice flour in shallow dish, or pie pan, and coat sausage with flour. Sprinkle 1/4 cup cold water over meat. Submerge sausage in flour.

title: Home Herb Stock
ingredients: 11 sprigs fresh sage | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place the sage leaves in a heavy saucepan and add cold, freshly drawn water. Bring to a boil over medium low heat and simmer until the leaves are just tender. Remove from heat and allow the leaf stock to cool slightly. When the sage leaves have cooled enough to handle, remove the sprigs, reserving the water, and chop finely. Discard the sage leaves. Place the reserved sage water in a sealable jar. Drain the bay leaf and stir in the chopped sage. Seal the jar, pressing on the leaves with the flat of a table knife to release any bubbles. Discard the bay leaf. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,celery salt,pork loin roast,vodka,dark rum,black olive,extra sharp cheddar cheese,dough
title: Caledonian Pork Loins
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 3/4 lb extra lean ground beef or 3/4 lb pork loin roast | 1/2 lb extra lean ground mild pork loin or 1/2 lb bacon | 16 ounces canned black olives | 1 cup shredded dark rum ( optional ) | 1 cup vodka | 1 teaspoon dijon celery salt | 2 packages refrigerated fresh bread crumbs ( about 3 pkg )
instructions: Trim off any rinds visible as follows. Coat rack of oven safe frying pan with nonstick cooking spray. Heat oven to 350°f. Spray rack with nonstick cooking spray and set aside. Preheat oven to 425°f in large bowl, mix remaining ingredients well. Place pork loins, fat side down, in baking pan and cover with about 2/3 cup fat mixture. Bake uncovered until meat thermometer registers 155f for thickest part of loin, about 15 to 20 minutes. Remove loins from oven and let stand 5 minutes before slicing diagonally into 1/2 inch slices. Return sliced loins to roasting pan. Cover and bake until pork is no longer pink in center, about 45 minutes. Serve pork with sauce and enjoy,.

title: Mango Paddle
ingredients: 150 g mixed vegetables, in chunks | 1 mango | 2 tablespoons port wine
instructions: Peel, chop and cut mango into small pieces. Fry mango with port over a moderate heat until the mangoes are tender, but not falling apart. In a food processor or blender, blitz vegetables, mango, butter and port until smooth. Serve and pass extra port at the table.

title: Sweet Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried chili beans | 3 tablespoons brandy | 8 sprigs fresh rosemary | 6 corn tortillas, 4 inches in diameter
instructions: Wash the beans and place them in a saucepan. Add enough water to cover by two inches over the beans. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for an hour. Remove the rosemary sprigs and discard. Remove 2 tablespoons of the beans and discard. Strain the liquid off of the beans and place them in a bowl. Mash the beans at the same time. Dissolve two tablespoons brandy in the liquid and keep the mixture at a boil. As soon as the beans come from the boiling water, ladle into bowls and allow guests to scoop up the hot mixture by dipping a wooden spoon into it and then turning it over.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,halibut,mushroom,bamboo shoot,nutmeg,button mushroom,baby spinach,pepperoni
title: Spinach, Halibut and Mushrooms Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 lb baby spinach | 1/2 lb halibut, cut in 8 servings | 1/2 lb fresh mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 2 tablespoons green enchilada sauce | 1 package sliced pepperoni | 1 canned bamboo shoots, sliced and drained | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 can sliced mushrooms | 1 can baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease an 11x9 inch baking dish. Rinse spinach under running cool water, swish to remove excess water and drain well. Set aside. Place halibut and mushrooms in a medium bowl. Add enchilada sauce, stir until mixed. Transfer to dish.

title: Granita Shells
ingredients: 4 cups soda water | 12 graham crackers | 2 pounds shell pasta
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring soda water to a boil. Stir graham crackers in for several seconds over low heat. Ladle soda water into graham cracker mixture so that the crackers are completely submerged. Cover with lid and let cook for at least 15 minutes.

title: Japanese Navy Beans with Nuts
ingredients: 4 ounces dried navy beans | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon mirin
instructions: Place bean and worcestershire sauce in a medium bowl. Cover and let stand at room temperature. Soak for 8 hours, or overnight, shaking the bowl often to get rid of excess water. Add water as needed in the cooking process. Keep the beans covered, or transfer to a pot, and gently simmer over medium heat until tender, about 2 hours.

title: Barley Jelly
ingredients: 4 lbs raw barley | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 1 lemon, zest of | 3 -4 serrano peppers | 1/4 cup sugar ( or more ) | 1 teaspoon almond essence
instructions: Boil barley in water. While barley is boiling add all other ingredients to the boiling bermole and boil for 20 minutes. Pour into jelly jars. When cool, seal and store in a cool dry place.

title: Spicy Pomegranate Seeds
ingredients: 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds, lightly toasted | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Place pomegranate seeds in a nonstick frying pan. Toss with caraway seed and toast over medium heat, shaking pan often, until fragrant, about 10 minutes. Cool to room temperature and store cool in an airtight container.

title: Spinach and Dill Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fresh spinach leaves, washed | 2 1/2 lbs fresh bread, crusts removed | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon ground dry thyme sprigs
instructions: Place the spinach in a large shallow dish. Cut the breads lengthwise into 5 6inch lengths. Using your fingers rub the cumin and thyme in the spinach. Toss the spinach with the bread and then sprinkle on the cumin and thyme. Serves warm. The bread can also be sliced and served as a vegetable accompaniment.

title: Easy Italian Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds hamburger | 1 can tomato sauce, or as needed
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir meat in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 9 minutes.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,shallot,apple cider,chili,red currant jelly,chinese five spice powder
title: Apple Cider Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shallot, diced | 1 tablespoon red currant jelly | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon chili | 1 -2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon chili
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine shallots, red currant jelly, heavy whipping cream, 1/2 tsp of chili, and 5 spice powder. Over medium heat, gently stir and bring to boil. Lower heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove to medium sized bowl and stir occasionally to prevent bubbles from forming.

title: Vegetable Idlis
ingredients: 4 green capsicum, sliced | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 4 -6 crushed ice | vegetable oil, as required
instructions: First, make long strips of aluminium foil by putting a little oil on a plate. Dip each slice of green pepper into the oil then drain on clean paper napkins. Add sun dried tomatoes and turmeric to the drained sun dried tomatoes and stir. Tie each fried slice of green capsicum with a piece of aluminium foil. To keep the idlis warm, line two idli cups with aluminium foil. Pour some water over the foil, place another piece of foil on top and keep aside at all time. When the idlis are almost cooked, drain them on clean paper napkins and keep aside. In a small skillet, add 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil. Fry the golden brown onion rings, crispy bits of green capsicum and bits of sun dried tomatoes. Remove the fried idlis from the pan, drain on clean paper napkins, add 3 tablespoons of sun dried tomatoes and stir. Serve hot, garnished with finely chopped cilantro or corriander leaves.

title: Sweet and Spicy Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 bottle sweet potatoes-flavored sweet potato starch | 1/3 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons instant coffee powder, dry-roasted
instructions: Spray skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Mix sweet potatoes and yogurt with a fork. Mix hoisin sauce and coffee powder. Pour into skillet, stirring to mix. Reduce heat to medium. Let cook about 5 minutes, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: green olive,nutmeg,rose water,hard egg,cream cheese,red chili pepper
title: Lebanese Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 8 hard-boiled eggs | 2 tablespoons cream cheese ( or 2 tablespoons yogurt if you like ) | 1 small red chili pepper ( or green ) | 1/3 cup chopped pitted green olives ( or black olives if you like ) or 1/3 cup kalamata olive, finely chopped ( or black olives if you like ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, grated ( or more ) | 1 drop rose water
instructions: Mash the eggs into a smooth paste with a fork or food processor until blended.. Chop the chile and olives, if desired. Sprinkle on top of the lebanese paste. Dot with a teaspoonful of olive oil to keep it from sticking. Add 1 teaspoon rose water to each egg and mix well. Garnish with remaining rosewater and/or additional parsley, if desired. Serve on italian bread with fresh bread sticks.

Random Ingredients: rose water,anchovy paste,taco seasoning mix,prosciutto,brandy,barley,sun tomato oil,canadian bacon
title: Low Carb Taco Barley Wraps
ingredients: 400 g smoked canadian bacon, diced into chunks ( canadian bacon is also good ) | 150 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped coarsely ( not oil packed ) | 1 tablespoon canadian bacon, finely diced and well drained of all but 2 tbsp | 1/4 cup brandy, cognac, cognac has a very similar effect in this recipe ( use cognac if preferred ) | 6 tablespoons rose water | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/2 ounce rose water | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste
instructions: In a large sauté pan add the diced bacon and diced sun dried tomatoes. Cook over medium heat until the diced bacon bits have turned into a nice crispy brown color. Turn up the heat, add the brandy, cognac, rose water, and taco seasoning mix. Cook and stir over medium heat for 2 minutes or until almost all of the alcohol has evaporated. Add the sautéed bacon back in and let this simmer until the meat loses some of its redness. Let cool slightly. Using a slotted spoon, break up the cooked meat into smaller bits. Spoon the meat onto the warmed tortillas and fold the tortillas in half. Serve with salsa and guacamole.

title: Lebanese Baked Almond Paste
ingredients: buttermilk, enough to make a little | cooking spray | almond paste, for topping
instructions: Warm buttermilk in microwave oven. Spread almond paste on baking sheet. Spray or brush almond paste on top. Place in microwave on high for 20 seconds to dry. Place in fridge to set for about 15 - 20 minutes. Cut into 2 slices, and roll up. Eat immediately.

title: Sauerkraut, Blueberry and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup drained sauerkraut | 3/4 cup finely shredded red cabbage | 1/4 cup blueberries ( fresh or frozen, thawed & finely chopped ) | 1/4 cup red currants ( fresh or frozen, thawed & finely chopped ) | 2 -4 teaspoons salsa ( i use herdez mexican-style )
instructions: In a serving bowl, thoroughly combine the sauerkraut, cabbage, blueberries, currants & salsa.

title: Sweet Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground veal | 1/2 pound ground pork | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup golden raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine ground veal and pork with the sugar and mix thoroughly. Shape into 1 inch balls and place them in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir the maraschino cherries and golden raisins into the meatballs. Cover loosely with foil and bake in the preheated oven for 90 minutes. Allow meatballs to cool for a few minutes. Serve with rice pilaf or as a side dish.

title: Prawns (Shrimp) Pakoda
ingredients: 300 g prawns, peeled & deveined | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Place prawns in a bowl and toss with enough flour to coat. Dip prawns into batter, then quickly into prawn oil. Place in oven and cook for about 5 minutes until golden. Remove from oven and keep warm. Combine fish sauce & remaining flour, pour over prawns and serve.

title: Linguica
ingredients: 1 package raspberries | 1 turnip, chopped | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon grated fresh turmeric | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 2 packages dry rice noodles | 4 eggsnog, for dipping
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook raspberries and turnip in boiling water for 20 minutes, then drain. Combine tamari, turmeric, and mirin together in a small bowl, then add to the boiling water. Place noodles in a bowl of cold water, and set aside to soften. Place peas in a microwave safe bowl, and cook on high for just a few seconds, until tender. Drain, and transfer to a bowl. Place noodles in a bowl of cold water, and set aside. Whisk eggs together in a separate bowl, and pour into a skillet over medium high heat. Spray with non stick cooking spray, and place a few drops of water on the oil. Place a few raspberries and turnip in in, and fry for about 2 minutes. Gently fold in the eggnog, and serve immediately, or refrigerate overnight for best results.

title: Vegetarian Tofu
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, liquid drained | 1 can mixed beans, liquid drained | 1 can sliced ripe peaches, with juice | 1 cup pineapple, chunks drained | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 teaspoons light golden syrup | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 package dry tortellini | 1/4 cup chopped and fresh mint
instructions: Soften tortellini in a large pot of boiling water for about 5 minutes, until al dente. Rinse with cold water and drain. Combine kidney beans, mixed beans and bananas in food processor or blender container and process until smooth. Stir in peaches, pineapple, maple syrup and golden syrup. Add oyster sauce and process again until smooth. Add tortellini and chopped mint. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: galangal,salad green,salmon fillet,cooking oil,dark red kidney bean,candy corn
title: Salmon with Field Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 kg salmon fillet | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 60 g galangal, peeled chopped | 1 bunch english field mushroom, halved halved | 1 can dark red kidney beans, rinsed | 1/2 cup light salad greens
instructions: Preheat oven 190c fan forced. Line the base of a 15 x 10 x 1cm ovenproof tray with foil. Place the salmon fillets in a bowl and add the oil, ginger, mushrooms, beans and corn. Arrange the salad leaves and corn on the prepared tray. Top with the salmon and drizzle with the pan juices. Place on a baking tray and bake in preheated oven for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,barbecue seasoning,black pepper,rice wine vinegar,cinnamon sugar,orange peel
title: Easy and Delicious Sweet Glaze for Pork or Beef
ingredients: 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar or 1/3 cup brown rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt or 1 tablespoon salt | 1 tablespoon fresh coarse ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons brown sugar or 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar | 1 slice orange peel, 3/8-inch-thick | 3 dashes barbecue seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all ingredients. Set aside in refrigerator.. Mix 1/2 cup glaze with enough reserved glaze to make up 2 tbls. Lighley pour over pork or beef, and allow to marinate 1 hour or more in refrigerator. Turn meat occasionally during marinating to coat with glaze, turning to coat evenly. Allow to stand at room temperature for 2 hours or longer for glaze to spread, turning occasionally.

title: Greek Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 3 cups greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons honey mustard
instructions: Place greek yogurt in a covered container, and put it in the refrigerator. In the morning, remove from refrigerator and whisk vigorously until it has a smooth, creamy consistency. This usually takes about five minutes. Stir in mustard. Serve as a dipping sauce for your favorite vegetables, or sprinkle with fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,chicken bouillon granule,pork shoulder,monterey jack cheese,cardamom pod,balsamic vinegar
title: Shrimp Stuffed Roast Pork Carnitas (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 6 -9 lbs boneless pork shoulder ( or pork tenderloin ) | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup hot chicken bouillon granules or 1/3 cup granular | 1/3 cup ground cardamom pod | 1/4 cup finely shredded monterey jack cheese | 3 -5 cups cooked shrimp ( preferably cooked raw )
instructions: Place shoulder or pork in 6 - 6 cup crock pot. Mix remaining ingredients together and sprinkle evenly over top of pork. Cook on low setting for 5 - 6 hours, until meat thermometer reaches 160 165°f. Serve with rice and beans, if desired.

Random Ingredients: coriander,plum sauce,pomegranate juice,mexican chili powder,kidney bean,horseradish mustard,orange peel,egg white
title: Spiced Spiced Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 orange peel | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped coriander | 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish mustard | 100 g plum sauce | 1 teaspoon mexican chili powder | 1 egg white
instructions: Combine beans with orange peel and coriander. Press through a sieve using your hands to extract all liquid. Stir through pomegranate juice, horseradish, plum sauce, chili powder & egg white. Serve with freshly prepared crackers or fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,nonfat milk,vegetable broth,almond liqueur,pie crust
title: Spiced Almond Korma
ingredients: 2 cups sliced almonds ( white or brown ) | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 4 green cardamom pods, smashed | 1 frozen pie crust, partially uncooked | 2 tablespoons nonfat milk
instructions: Toast the almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat, shaking the pan frequently, until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Cool on a plate. Process the almonds to a smooth paste in a blender or food processor. Put the broth, cardamom pods, and remaining 3/4 cup of the blanched almonds in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour in the almond paste and return to a boil. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,cumin powder,palm sugar,snow pea,chocolate chip,grain brown rice,pea,ancho chile powder
title: Brown Rice Salad
ingredients: 225 g long grain brown rice | 225 g fresh peas or 225 g frozen peas | 225 g broccoli florets, halved | 225 g snow peas, halved | 3 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 150 g semi-sweet chocolate chips | 3 teaspoons palm sugar
instructions: Sauté rice in a pan containing a small amount of water over medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes, until it is dry. Add peas, broccoli, snow peas and chilies. Continue to simmer, covered, for 6 - 8 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in cumin, chocolate bits and sugar. Cover.

title: Tamarind Pudding
ingredients: 150 ml double cream | 150 ml tamarind paste, puree | 1 loaf italian bread
instructions: Cut bread in half lengthwise, spread a layer of tamarind powder on the cut surface, then put two layers of bread on top. Now pour cream over the top. Place loaf on top, then chill for a few hours. To serve, cut a cross in the top, and squeeze a wedge of warm cream around each slice.

title: Vegan Mexican Puff Pastry Snack
ingredients: 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 dash chili powder | 3 sheets puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup tomato juice in a small saucepan. Stir in 2 teaspoons chili powder.

title: Watermelon, Shallot & Ginger Gratin
ingredients: 2 lbs watermelon, peeled, seeded, cut into 1-inch cubes, chilled | 2 cups shallots, peeled, and coarsely chopped | 2 cups water-packed fresh ginger, coarsely chopped | 8 fresh thyme sprigs | cinnamon-sugar blend, for sprinkling | 3 -4 medium slices american cheese, such as velvetta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Remove the green leaves from the watermelon and dice enough to measure 4 cups. Toss the watermelon, shallots, ginger, and thyme in a 1 1/2 quart glass baking dish and sprinkle with cinnamon/sugar blend, stirring to combine. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until the topping is bubbly and beginning to darken. Serve warm or cold with slices of cheese.

Random Ingredients: basil,white pepper,elbow macaroni,emmentaler cheese,kidney bean,white mushroom,red wine vinegar
title: Pasta Salad II
ingredients: 4 cups cooked elbow macaroni | 1 cup diced white mushrooms | 1 can white beans | 8 ounces diced pickled red wine vinegar | 1 cup crushed tomatoes with basil | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 cup grated emmentaler cheese
instructions: Mix pasta, mushrooms, and red wine vinegar together in a large bowl. Stir crushed tomatoes and basil into pasta mixture. Sprinkle cheese over top. Cover bowl, and chill 6 hours before serving.

title: Scallops With Celery (Camarao)
ingredients: 2 ounces dried bay scallops | 1 bottle red wine | 1 lb celery | hot pepper sauce, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 3 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Wash and dry the scallops. Soak in cold water until completely soft and then in the cold water. Drain, cut into 4 - 6 sections, discarding any muscle bits. Place scallops in a bowl and cover with cold water so as to cover them by an inch or two. Soak at least 2 hours in refrigerator. Drain the scallops. Cover the scallops loosely with kitchen towel and put in a preheated oven in a preheated 450 degree oven for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, make the sauce. Heat the wine and celery in a medium saucepan until boiling. Stir in the hot pepper sauce. Add sugar and stir until dissolved to make a smooth sauce. Remove from the heat. Dip the scallops in the sauce and place on a platter. Serve with reserved sauce.

Random Ingredients: salami,great northern bean,cocoa,lemon peel,tamari,anaheim chilies,scallion,cauliflower floret
title: Mexican White Bean and Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans, drained | 1 cup cauliflower floret, rinsed | 1/4 lb salami, chopped | 2 anaheim chilies, chopped | 8 scallions, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon cocoa, sifted | 1 teaspoon tamari or 1 teaspoon indian light soy sauce | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Place beans in a large bowl, cover with water and bring to a boil.

title: Japanese-Style Stacked Eggplant & Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb japanese eggplant, sliced | 1 can petite diced tomatoes with puree | 1 1/2 cups cremini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat ove on broiler setting with rack 4 - 5 inches from heat. Lightly brush both sides of the eggplant slices with oil, then arrange slices in single layer, side by side on baking sheet. Broil on high, about 5 - 7 minutes, or until golden brown outside.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,beef consomme,mint,green chili pepper,noodle,green bean,sesame seed oil,dark rum
title: Beef Stew With Chiles and Mint
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beef consomme | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 3 1/2 lbs kielbasa, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seed oil | 1 1/2 lbs green beans, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 package noodles, broken into 3/4-inch pieces | 1 jar packed chopped green chili peppers, drained ( can sub drained canned hot green chile peppers, such as hot sauce to taste ) | 16 leaves chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Bring consomme to a boil in a heavy large skillet over medium high heat. Add rum and simmer 2 minutes. Add sausage to skillet. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat.

title: Chinese Four-Ingredient Oil (Nabe)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon anise seed | 3/4 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Put a teaspoon aniseed on the surface of each square of bread. Spread it lightly with a spoon. Place the soy sauce in a small bowl. Pour over half of the aniseed in the top of one of the squares. Cover with a square of bread. Press firmly firmly. Cut with a sharp knife into 2 triangles. Let stand 3 days, refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: lamb roast dripping,self raising flour,coffee,thyme leaf,wheat flour,balsamic vinegar
title: Lamb Roast With Whole Wheat Pasta
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs lamb roast or 2 1/4 lbs leg of lamb, trimmed of any visible fat and chopped into 3/4 inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves, plus more for garnish | 4 tablespoons strong coffee | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 3/4 cup whole wheat self raising flour | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour
instructions: Combine lamb, thyme, coffee, vinegar and wholemeal flour in a mixing bowl, season with pepper and mix well. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in an oven proof frying pan over a high heat. Place roast in frying pan, reduce heat to medium, and cook for 15 minutes at 1/2 temperature or until browned, turning meat twice during cooking. Transfer to a plate and cover loosely with foil. Set aside. Place ovenproof frying pan over a medium heat. Once hot, add the 1/4 tablespoon oil, 1 tablespoon oil, 2 tablespoons flour and enough cold water to form a sticky dough that forms a 'crust', around 1 ounce each of flour and dripping. Bring to the boil and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes, then remove from the heat and stir through the remaining flour until a thin paste forms. Return to the pan. Cover loosely and place in an oven heated to 250°f on a trivet. Cook for 1 - ¼ hours, checking for doneness towards the end of cooking, or until the gravy has thickened and reduced. Slice and serve with a selection of roasted vegetables as described above.

title: Frogmicks
ingredients: 20 frog legs, rinsed and dried | 2 lemons | 1 cup corn | 1 cup kalamata olives or 1 cup other black olives, pitted and chopped finely | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Place frog legs, lemons and olives in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove lemon and olives. Place corn in a bowl. Pour hot fig mixture over the corn and toss to coat. Serve with lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock powder,almond extract,tagliatelle pasta noodle,mango,nonfat cream
title: Tagliatelle With Mango and Almonds
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken stock powder | 500 g tagliatelle pasta noodles ( dried ) | 1/2 large ripe mango, peeled and diced | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon slivered almonds ( optional )
instructions: Combine stock powder with a splash of water and let stand for 1 hour. Cook pasta in a large saucepan of boiling water following instructions on the packet. Drain and return to pan, along with a small amount of boiling water if necessary. To serve, mix with almond extract and sour cream. Top with slivered almonds if using.

title: Thai Noodles, Shrimp & Tofu (Soyabean)
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 500 g shrimp | 1 tablespoon red bell pepper | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, crushed | 3 cups egg noodles ( thin ) | 3 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Cut tofu into sticks 1 cm wide and 3 cm long. Set aside. Rinse shrimp. Cut into 3 cm lengths. Soak shrimp in cold water to cover for 20 minutes. Rinse well. Slice tofu into sticks 1 cm wide and 2 cm long. Heat wok over high heat. Remove tofu from water. Slice tofu thinly. Wipe out wok with a paper towel. Heat 2 tbs oil in wok. Remove shrimp from water. Drain. Cut tofu into sticks about 5 cm long. Cook tofu in hot oil on high for 2 minutes. Remove. Heat 1 tbs oil in wok. Stir fry tofu 5 minutes or until brown. Set aside. Heat 2 tbs oil in wok. Remove shrimp from water and set aside. Wipe wok clean. Heat 1 tbs oil in wok. Stir fry red bell pepper and lemon grass for 20 seconds. Add shrimp, tofu and the bell pepper. Stir fry for another 2 minutes. Add noodles. Stir fry until noodles are tender stir in sugar. Top with tofu and shrimp. If you prefer the crunch, mix a bit of rice wine with water before serving.

title: Texas Hot Wings
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken wings, separated at joints and tips discarded | 1 jar thick & chunky salsa | 1 jar grape-infused chchampagne | 1/2 onion, grated | 3 tablespoons port wine | 1/3 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup sliced shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Arrange chicken wings in a large roasting pan. Add salsa, chChampagne, onion, port, sour cream and mushrooms. Stir to blend well and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours, and preferably 3 - 4 hours if using refrigerate uncovered, turning often so the garlic is not stuck. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Transfer chicken wings to roasting pan. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour.

title: Easy Microwave Dried Apricot Soup
ingredients: 4 apricots | 1 can cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup half-and-half ( light or non-fat ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a microwave safe bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 11 minutes. Stir, adjust cooking time if necessary to ensure even cooking.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,plum tomato,ginger garlic paste
title: Tomato-Ginger Vegetable Melt (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 14)
ingredients: 2 lbs plum tomatoes, chopped ( australian tomatoes ) | 1 teaspoon bottled ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated
