instructions: Preheat the broiler. Combine tomato, ginger garlic paste and half the cheese in a large non stick oven proof dish. Sprinkle over remaining cheese and broil in a preheated 325f oven about 6 from heat source until cheese is bubbling, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,squash,salsa,white wine vinegar,almond extract,seashell pasta,pearl barley,chicken
title: Chocolate Almond Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package seashell pasta | 1 cup pearl barley | 6 ounces chicken | 8 ounces mixed dried fruit ( orange rind, dates, mango, pineapple is good too ) | 8 ounces salsa | 3 ounces dark chocolate, melted ( or use regular milk chocolate ) | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the salt. Add the barley and boil over high heat until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain well. While the barley is cooking, cut the chicken into bite size pieces and set aside or refrigerate. Once the barley is tender, drain, return it to the pot and add the chicken, beans, and fruit. Stir well. Add the chocolate and mix well. Add the vinegar and almond extract, and mix well. Taste and adjust the seasonings to your liking, and serve. You may also use unsweetened, unsweetened chocolate chips.

title: Moroccan Raisin Patties
ingredients: 1 lb golden raisin | 3/4 cup sherry or 3/4 cup water | 1/2 cup flour | 1/2 cup cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Soak raisins in sherry or water for 30 minutes. Drain raisins.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,romaine lettuce,grape tomato,lemon extract,chili,zucchini lengthwise
title: Zucchini Wedges With Grape Tomatoes, Lemon and Chiles on a Garlic Flatter
ingredients: 1 lb grape tomatoes, halved | 10 -12 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh chilies ( such as serrano or hot chiles ) | 2 tablespoons lemon extract or 2 tablespoons agave nectar | 1 teaspoon chili ( preferably ancho ) ( optional ) | 1 head romaine lettuce, cut into 2 pieces
instructions: Soak tomatoes, zucchini, chilies and lemon extract in large bowl of ice water for 15 to 30 minutes, then drain and pat dry. In a food processor, pulse tomatoes and zucchini until roughly minced. With machine running, drop zucchini mixture through feed tube and process until well mixed, about 1 minute. Transfer mixture to large sieve through same medium mesh strainer and let drain 30 minutes. Working over bowl of ice water to catch liquid, toss tomatoes until evenly coated. Transfer tomatoes and zucchini wedges to rimmed parchment paper lined baking sheet. Bake at 375° f and toast garlic wedges 2 to 3 minutes, stirring midway between flips, until golden brown and slightly crisp. Serve with the warm tomatoes and garlic wedges.

title: Tropical Appetizer Tray
ingredients: 200 ml single cream | 200 ml pineapple tidbits
instructions: Pour the single cream into a glass bowl. Drain the pineapple and pineapple and reserve. Pour the pineapple tidbits into the bowl. Mash the pineapple and pineapple with a fork, gradually adding the reserved pineapple juice and blending well with the cream. Pour into a container with a lid and refrigerate for 1 hour, stirring the cubes of ice cream in between chilling until they are set. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chive,romaine lettuce leaf,spinach leaf,orange bell pepper,fine sea salt,allspice
title: Spinach Cakes With Grated Oranges
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced fresh chives | 1 tablespoon minced orange bell pepper | 2 tablespoons fine sea salt, plus more for seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 medium oranges, peeled, quartered lengthwise, seeded, coarsely grated ( about 16 ) | 2 cups fresh spinach leaves, coarsely chopped ( about 8 ounces ) | 12 fresh crisp romaine lettuce leaves ( about 12 )
instructions: For the oranges, in a 12 inch nonstick skillet, combine the chives, orange bell pepper, sea salt and allspice. Over moderate high heat, warm the chive mixture, 2 tablespoons of the salt, and the allspice mixture, stirring until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Stir 1 cup of the spinach in a large colander or food storage container just until wilted, about half the amount of water clinging to the spinach. Remove the colander or slotted spoon and drain the oranges, pressing out all excess liquid. Transfer the grated oranges to a bowl and toss with the remaining tablespoon of salt and orange juice. Stir in the remaining chopped spinach. Let the mixture rest while you make cocktail or salad. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. To make cocktail or salad, in serving bowl, toss together the grated oranges, the remaining 1 tablespoon of salt, and the chopped spinach leaves. Serve the oranges with the cocktail or salad.

title: Asian Inspired Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 4 tablespoons chili paste with garlic
instructions: Wash the salmon. Pat dry. Slice into four pieces. Coat the salmon with 1/2 tbsp of chili paste and 1/2 tbsp of salt. Place on a sheet of foil and wrap tightly in foil. Place in the freezer for 15 20min to thaw. Heat the oven to 450&deg.

Random Ingredients: butter,chicken breast,green cardamom pod,porcini mushroom,pea carrot,confectioner ' sugar,red cabbage
title: Chicken, Pea Cabbage and Porcini Ravioli
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried instant peas and carrots, washed | 1/2 cup dried porcini mushrooms ( small portugese mushrooms ) | 1 small head fresh red cabbage, shredded | 4 chicken breasts, cubed | 8 tablespoons unsalted butter | 6 green cardamom pods, cracked | 8 large green cardamom pods, cracked
instructions: Place peas and carrots in a small bowl and cover with hot water to cover. Let stand for 15 minutes until softened, then drain. Mince the mushrooms and set aside. Drain the pea mixture reserving about 1/2 cup soaking liquid. Place the dried porcins in a medium, dry skillet with just enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,wheat flour,lemon lime beverage,peanut oil vegetable,coconut,duck breast
title: Lemon and Coconut Duck Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut | 1 cup sweet whole wheat flour | 3 tablespoons palm sugar | 1/3 cup lemons, juice of or 1/3 cup lime beverage | 5 -6 duck breasts | peanut oil or vegetable oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Place duck breasts in shallow dish & pour over the mixture. Let sit at room temperature to marinate, about an hour, or overnight. Heat up your oil/margarine/spice barbeque to 450 degrees. Place marinated duck breasts in a single layer on the oil or margarine in the pan. Let cook for about 15 minutes on each side, or until fish is cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,heavy whipping cream,mango,pearl barley,grain mustard,vodka,yukon gold potato,pork tenderloin
title: Mustard Pork Tenderloin With Mango Chutney and Pearl Barley
ingredients: pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 teaspoons whole grain mustard | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/8 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 container mango chutney | 8 medium yukon gold potatoes, quartered and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices | 2 jars sliced pared fresh mango | 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon-style prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons vodka ( optional )
instructions: Combine 2 teaspoons of mustard and 1/4 cup mango chutney in small bowl. Cover and refrigerate. Place pork tenderloin in heavy large dutch oven. Cook over medium high heat until just cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer pork to platter. Add cream to pan and bring to a boil. Add remaining 1/4 cup mango chutney and 2 tablespoons of mustard and cook until hot. Add potatoes and cook until tender crisp and brown, about 10 minutes. Cover and heat through. To serve, spoon pork and reserved sauce onto plates. Top with mango chutney and maple syrup. Pass remaining sauce at table. Top with mango chutney and maple syrup.

title: Simple, Healthy and Delicious Broccoli Chips With Capers
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli floret | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | corn chips, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the florets well in cold salted water. Cut the stems off the broccoli florets and break the leaves into chunks. In a small bowl, add the sherry and capers. Dip each chip into the sherry and capers and place in a serving dish. Pour the remaining sherry and capers over top. Serve immediately with a few chips for dipping.

title: Brazilian Pecorino Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 1/2 cups thick coconut cream, whipped
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the cheese and coconut cream until smooth. Serve with crusty bread slices.

title: Italian Herb Beer Breaded Spinach and Fennel Pitas
ingredients: 4 pita pockets, halved | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup minced fresh italian parsley | 1 teaspoon minced fennel bulb | 3/4 cup canned italian style beer ( such as corona or pacifico ) | 16 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and water squeezed out
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly oil baking sheet. Set pita, cut sides up, on baking sheet and bake until lightly browned, about 8 to 10 minutes. In medium bowl, combine bread crumbs, parsley, fennel and beer. Cut stack into 8 wedges and divide spinach among wedge halves. Sprinkle spinach with crumb mix. Bake until heated and filling are warmed, about 8 to 10 minutes. Slice stack into 8 pieces.

title: Moroccan Chili Powder
ingredients: 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 tablespoons chopped green olives
instructions: Mix cocoa with onion salt and turmeric. Add finely chopped olives and mix well. Store in a closed container.

title: French Onion Soup With Mustard Greens
ingredients: 1 can french onion soup | 1/2 cup apple cider or 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 can broccoli with lentils | 2 pints fresh berry halves or 2 pints frozen mixed berries | 1/3 cup canned onion soup | 1/3 cup prepared mustard greens
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f mix soup, cider and cumin in a large baking dish. Add the lentils and berry halves. Mix to combine. Stir in the mustard greens. Cover and bake for 30 minutes, stirring once or twice.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,yellow bell pepper,lamb,kosher salt,bamboo shoot,celery rib,chicken bouillon,chicken stock cube
title: Lamb and Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lamb, cubed | 1/2 tablespoon salt | 2 tablespoons tomato soup | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup finely diced celery rib | 1/4 cup finely diced yellow bell pepper | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 can bamboo shoots, chopped | 1 liter chicken stock ( i use organic )
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the lamb meat and cut it into cubes about 1 1/2 to 2 inches square. Rinse out any unwanted cubes, especially the extra fat. Put the lamb meat into the bottom of your pressure cooker on the salt, then stir in all of the ingredients except the bamboo shoots. Do not stir. Let the pressure cooker cook at high pressure for 25 minutes when the pressure indicator clicks to high. Let the pressure cooker go back down to stabilizer the pressure cooker. Use a long handled wooden spoon to break the meat while the cooker is cooking. Then let the cooker cook a further 5 minutes. Then check the consistency. You want the stew to be medium soft but you have to be firm. When the meat is done, strain all of the liquid you'll have left and discard the vegetables, except the bamboo shoots, and save it to thicken the broth. You'll use the reserved liquid to further thicken the stew. You'll also have to use the reserved liquid a second time. Add the bamboo shoots to the broth and simmer for 5 minutes, then serve. You can either serve this stew with rice if you like, or make a rice porridge by serving it over the broth and then adding it to the broth.

title: Simple Vegan Mexican Wedding Cakes
ingredients: 200 g ground veal | 300 g ground whole wheat flour | 300 g pure vanilla sugar | 100 g ground jalapeno pepper | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Mix the ground meat with dry ingredients and form into 1 - 1 1/4 inch round or 6 inch diameter rounds on a parchment paper with a little bit of flour showing. If you are using 1 large round cake pan, you may need less flour. Set oven to 180°c. Spread the meat/veal mixture out evenly on the parchment paper / paper. Using a 3mm round glass, cut a circle from your left hand & right hand the meat. Continue cutting in lines & turning until all of the meat has been used. Use a spatula to cover the meat w/the meat & ensure that it is well coated. If you find it is a bit dry, add some more flour, then remaning the meat mixture. Place the circle on top of your baking pan & brush with pam. Repeat & dust w/pam again. Bake in the oven approx 30 minutes or until golden brown & the top is firm. Let the meat cool slightly before cutting into 12 equal sized portions & serving. Variation, try using a good quality vanilla & kahlua, for those of you who didn't use real vanilla, use a good quality coconut based coffee liqueur for added flavor, or you may use a good quality chocolate ganache for a different effect.

title: Grilled Beets
ingredients: 1 cup marinara sauce | 1 beet, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 green onion, sliced
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Combine the marinara and beets in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Cook, stirring often, for about 5 minutes, or until beet tender. Spread beets out on the hot grill, and grill for 20 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned. Place beets on a plate while still hot, and sprinkle with green onion.

title: Guava Nectar Chips
ingredients: 2 cups guava nectar | 2 cups corn tortilla chips
instructions: In a sauce pan, combine nectar, & tortilla chips. Bring to a boil then remove from heat & cover. Let stand for 2 minutes. Place in plastic bag & refrigerate for 1 hour. After it is chilled, drain nectar chips, place in a single layer over a lined baking dish and allow to cool completely.

title: Homemade Buttermilk
ingredients: 2 cups buttermilk | 1 large habanero pepper, halved, seeded, and membrane removed
instructions: Warm buttermilk in a bowl set over a bowl of ice cubes until very warm, about 5 minutes. Remove from the bowl and mash with a fork. Return the mashed buttermilk to the bowl and stir in the habanero pepper. Use as you would regular buttermilk.

title: Kartoffel Poached in Mango Lime Syrup #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 container mango-flavored soba noodles ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 1 cup orange juice ( from an orange, about 2 oranges ) | 1 onion, halved, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon minced onion, from jar for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cook simply potatoes diced potatoes with 1 cup of orange juice in an 8 quart pan, over medium heat until potatoes are golden brown, stirring occasionally and breaking apart any clumps. While potatoes are cooking, break soba noodles from the box into half inch pieces and boil in a pot large enough to accomodate the noodles in 2 1/2 cups of water, covered, for an hour. Drain noodles and return potatoes to heat in another large skillet. Add chopped onion and minced onion with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,curry powder,tomato puree,lime,chicken breast fillet,portobello mushroom cap,plain yogurt
title: Curried Chicken With Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 400 g beef broth, low sodium | 1 3/4 teaspoons curry powder | 600 g chicken breast fillets, skinless, boneless, cubed | 1 3/4 portobello mushroom caps, cut into 1cm slices ( white button mushrooms may be used too ) | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 400 g canned tomato puree or 400 g peeled canned tomatoes, roughly chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Stir together beef broth, curry powder & marinade paste, set aside until needed. Place chicken & mushrooms in non stick frying pan, add about 2 3/4 tablespoons of oil, over a high heat, brown chicken, set aside. Stir the sauce mixture together, add remaining 3 tablespoons of oil, then pour it all over the chicken, stir to coat. Return chicken to a plate, cover and keep warm in preheated oven, 180c. Return frying pan to a high heat and add remaining marinade paste, stir until combined. Add tomato puree/canned tomatoes, lime juice and mix well. Stir constantly, simmer 2 minutes, remove from heat. Transfer chicken & mushroom to 4 serving bowls and spoon curry sauce over top.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,savoy cabbage,worcestershire sauce,marjoram,dark brown sugar,couscous
title: Couscous Corn (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 1 )
ingredients: 200 g couscous | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/3 cup corn kernel | 1/3 cup reduced sodew worcestershire sauce | 1 savoy cabbage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c / 400°f / gas grease and line a 20cm x 30cm loaf tin with baking paper. Combine the couscous, sugar, marjoram and corn in a bowl. Sprinkle with worcestershire sauce. Slice the cabbage and arrange over the couscous mixture. Cover and place in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes – until cooked.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,mozzarella cheese,mint,saffron strand,onion flake,oatmeal,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pineapple ring
title: Onion Breakfast Burritos (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 1 small onion, finely diced ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried mint, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons oatmeal ( or quick cooking oats ) | 6 -8 fresh pineapple rings ( optional ) | 1/2 - 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded ( or more ) | 1/2 - 1 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded
instructions: Brown meat in a bit of olive oil, add onion to meat and toss until clear. Add saffron and stir a couple of times while browning the meat. Cook the oatmeal or quick cooking oats with pineapple rings until oats are crispy. It can be made with either quick or old fashioned oats, which is quite a bit more fibre dense than old fashioned. A quick soak of oats adds a nice breakfast flavor. Spread oaty mixture on paper towel to cool slightly.

title: Fajita Snack Mix
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 3 tablespoons poultry seasoning | 1 1/2 cups guacamole, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Whisk the flour, poultry seasoning, and guacamole together in a bowl using a fork until thoroughly mixed. Dump the mixture onto a floured surface.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,beef brisket,cream sherry,cheese,nutmeg,habanero pepper,half cream
title: Mexican Corned Beef With Barley
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked pearl barley | 1 lb beef brisket | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and minced | 4 cups cheese, divided | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/3 cup sour cream
instructions: Cook and drain the barley according to package instructions. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, toss together the beef brisket in the corn sherry and 2/3 cup of the cheese. Sprinkle with the nutmeg. Preheat the oven to 300° and heat the remaining cheese in a large skillet over medium heat until melted, about 2 minutes. Remove the beef brisket from the pot and toss with the cheese. Spread the beef on a greased baking sheet and rub it with the reserved 2/3 cup of cheese. Broil, covered tightly with foil, for 15 minutes, or until the brisket is medium rare and the internal temperature of the brisket reaches 130°. Serve hot.

title: Pomegranate Bacon Roll
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread stick dough | 2 cups pomegranate, seeded, diced pieces ( about 15 small pomegranate ) | 4 -6 slices bacon drippings or 4 -6 slices other fatback | cooking oil | 3 tablespoons orange liqueur, such as grand marnier
instructions: Place frozen bread stick dough, pomegranate pieces, bacon slices if using, and a few tablespoons of fatback stick fat in a bowl. Add enough cooking oil to moisten. Divide dough in half, shape each half into a long log. Wrap log in a plastic log or foil and refrigerate for at least one hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. On a non stick cookie sheet, roll out each half into a rectangle with a smooth surface. Place on the tray and brush with cooking oil. Bake for 15 to 25 minutes until top is golden and crisp.

title: Braised Beef Shanks in Lemon and Thyme
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef shank | 10 fresh thyme sprigs | 3/4 lb penne ( about 8 ounces )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f and set rack in a shallow roasting pan. Add beef shanks to a large roasting pan in single layer and stud side with thyme. Roast uncovered 15 minutes per pound. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f and add pasta to pan. Cook 25 - 30 minutes per pound for medium rare. Use cooking thermometer to check for doneness. Remove from oven and sprinkle with a little more salt. Serve with crusty italian bread.

Random Ingredients: peach half,red cabbage,apple juice,manchego cheese,salmon fillet,liquid smoke,yellow pepper
title: Smoked Salmon Bake
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup unsweetened apple juice | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke, or more to taste | 1/2 cup thinly sliced red cabbage | 1/2 cup thinly sliced yellow pepper | 2 tablespoons grated manchego cheese | 4 ounces smoked salmon fillets, cut into 1/2 inch strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pour 1/4 cup apple and 1/2 cup apple juice into a shallow baking dish. Stir apple juice, apple juice, and liquid smoke into the apple juice mixture. Add cabbage, yellow pepper, cheese, and salmon, respectively, and toss to coat. Cover baking dish with aluminum foil, and bake in preheated oven until salmon is easily flaked with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salsa,fettuccine,strawberry,cardamom seed,chinese rice wine,thyme sprig,cornflour,russet potato
title: Fettuccine With Salsa and Fresh Thyme
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons sweet chinese rice wine ( shaoxing wine ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed ( ground ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig, chopped | 1 cup fresh salsa | 4 cups fresh strawberries, hulled and quartered | 1 lb dry fettuccine, cooked
instructions: Place potatoes in a large saucepan and fill with enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, partially cover, and simmer gently 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside to cool slightly. While potatoes cook, in a small frying pan, heat cornflour and rice wine over moderate heat until just bubbling. Season with cardamom, thyme, and salsa. Add potatoes and simmer, partially covered, stirring and breaking up potatoes, about 10 minutes or until heated through. Transfer potatoes and salsa to a serving bowl and sprinkle with strawberries. Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,sea salt,almond,brown rice,egg noodle,pie crust,godiva milk chocolate
title: Brown Butter and Noodle Baked in One Pot
ingredients: 4 ounces brown rice, uncooked | 1 refrigerated pie crust, plus 2 sheets that come with 2 to 3 inches of uncooked noodles | 4 ounces godiva milk chocolate, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian flat-leaf parsley ( or 1 teaspoon dried parsley ) | 1/2 cup toasted slivered almonds | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 6 large free range eggs or 6 large egg substitute equivalent, well beaten ( such as ener-okin )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Spray a 9 inch baking pan with no stick cooking spray. Spread cooled rice in a 9 inch circle on the bottom of prepared pan. Arrange noodles in a spoke fashion over the rice using the circular lines to form a spoke pattern. Melt chocolate and milk of your choice in top of a double broiler. Sprinkle with parsley and almonds. Whisk with a wire whisk over a pan of simmering water. Place egg whites in a bowl and whisk until they begin to froth. Whisk yolks 1 at a time into chocolate mixture. Pour egg mixture into prepared pan of noodles. Bake, uncovered, about 40 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,parsnip,plain flour,onion powder,tomato juice,baby spinach,lime wedge,bread crumb
title: Portuguese Snack Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1/2 cup fresh parsnip, cooked and chopped | 1/2 lb fresh tomato-flavored tomato, chopped | 4 ounces baby spinach, cleaned and chopped | 1 tablespoon ground onion powder | 4 ounces plain flour, approximately | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley or 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 2 tablespoons bread crumbs
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Put each ingredient on a plate and mix well. Roll each piece on a lightly floured board 1 deep into a circle the size of your breadpan. Gently put the breadpan into a 350f oven. Place in the centre of the preheated oven for 15 minutes, remove the breadpan from the oven and increase oven temperature to 400f. Remove 1/2 the breadpan and spread 2 tbsp of crumbs on a baking tray lined with parchment paper, place the breadpan back into the oven and bake the breadpan for 10 minutes or until golden and bubbly. Remove from oven and leave to cool completely. Remove and place the sandwich in a warm oven for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,lettuce,white rice,white miso,soy sauce,rice noodle,broccoli,ice
title: Miso Broccoli Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 cups cooked white rice | 2 cups diced broccoli | 1/2 cup canned red pepper, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup cooked rice noodles, if you want them small | 2 tablespoons white miso | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce | ice, for serving
instructions: Cook all together in a medium bowl in a microwave oven until the broccoli is tender crisp. Dice the lettuce and stir into the rice noodles. Serve with any remaining dressing on the side.

Random Ingredients: black tea,cumin seed,miracle whip,black olive,tomato puree,garlic powder,biscuit mix
title: Delicious Black Olive Mini Biscuit Cups
ingredients: 1 cup biscuit mix | 1 tablespoon miracle whip | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 pinch garlic powder | 1 pinch black tea | 1/2 tablespoon black olives | 1 tablespoon tomato puree
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, combine biscuit mix, miracle whip, cumin seeds, garlic powder and black tea. Stir until it resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add olives and tomato puree.

title: Easy Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup crushed kalamata olives
instructions: Mix all together. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kale,chicken stock,vegetable oil cooking spray,raspberry vinegar
title: Citrus Sauteed Kale
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, stemmed or 1 bunch swiss chard, stemmed, stemmed, and chopped | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar ( optional but recommended ) or 1/4 cup champagne vinegar | 2 tablespoons chicken stock
instructions: Wash greens thoroughly, trim stems, and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch wide ribbons with a chef's knife. Set aside. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Add kale and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until tender. Stir in vinegar, and cook, stirring often, 1 minute longer. Add greens to skillet with vinegar stir well to coat, add stock and cook, stirring occasionally, 1 minute or until kale is just wilted. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,green capsicum,self rising flour,fruit,turkey,lettuce
title: Turkey Barmies
ingredients: 600 g ground turkey | 1/2 green capsicum, finely chopped | 1/2 cup dried fruit, finely chopped | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 cups self rising flour | lettuce, shredded to serve
instructions: Place everything in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Dunk a spoonful into the flour.

title: Indian Spiced Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas, picked over | 1/2 cup white onion, minced | 4 teaspoons prepared mustard | 3/4 teaspoon garam masala | 2 ripe avocados, peeled, cut into slices | 3 tablespoons olive, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare the beans, if using, and allow them to soak overnight. Transfer the beans and soaking liquid to a saucepan, bring to a boil and cook over medium heat until the liquid is reduced to small amount, about 10 minutes. Drain, return to the bean pot and bring to a simmer. Add the onion and mustard to the beans and mix well. Stir in the garam masala and cook until the mixture is very dry. Layer the avocado slices evenly among the bean mixture. Pour olive into a glass baking dish to serve, or place in a covered casserole dish to keep warm while baking. Bake the beans, covered with foil and served.

title: Cauliflower Wrapped in Mozzarella & Vinegar
ingredients: 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/2 cup cauliflower, chopped into small florets | 1 lime, halved | 2 1/2 cups unseasoned pizza dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the vinegar in a small, microwave safe bowl set over a saucepan of simmering water.

title: Kittencal's Perfect Lamb Excess Seasoned for Your Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg boneless leg of lamb | garlic paste or fresh garlic, to taste | celery seed ( optional )
instructions: Cut the lamb into ¼ inch slices, and then into ¼ inch cubes. Toss well in a mixing bowl with any other marinade ingredients. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for 3 days prior to cooking as it will get hotter. You can leave it in the refrigerator for 2 - 3 days to make it more digestible. Bring to room temperature and bring lamb to room temperature before grilling or cooking as required for best results, turning frequently. Grill the lamb.

title: Chicken and Beef Rollatina
ingredients: 250 g beef cubes ( shin or sirloin, about 8cm long ) | 2 cans fruit, juice and pulp ( i use orange juice ) | 300 g soft nori | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 1/2 cups extra lean ground beef or 1 1/2 cups ground turkey | chinese plastic wrap or plastic wrap, for rolling the roll
instructions: Chop the beef finely. Put equal amounts of these pieces on the roll and roll to enclose the meat. If the rollattines are more than 1 cm thick, it may be easier to roll them slightly longer. If they are more than another 1/2 inch thick, it will probably be easier to roll them slightly shorter and thinner. Cut the roll in slices about 1 inch wide. For the beef rollatina, fry the meat at the edge of a pan. They should be well browned and slightly crisp. As soon as the meat is done, wrap them in a clean wet tea towel and place into your kitchen sink. Set aside on a plate and allow them to drain while you make the dipping sauce. To make dipping sauce, mix the fruit juice with the chinese plastic wrap and cocoa powder. Set aside for 15 to 30 minutes or until it thickens to a paste. To prepare rollatina, remove the rolls from the plastic wrap and place them, cut side up, into a piping bag and spoon a little of the filling on each piece. Seal the dough to ensure you seal the filling completely. To plate, place a plate with the rollatina on top of the rollatina in front of you on your left palm. Cut the roll and serve with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: head garlic,mint sprig,quinoa,vegetable juice,chinese five spice powder,arrowroot,yellow squash,plum
title: Chinese Five-Spice Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup canned plum, diced drained ( fresh ) | 1 small yellow squash | 1/2 small head garlic, minced | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 1 can v8 vegetable juice | 1 teaspoon arrowroot, mixed with enough water to thin | 3 tablespoons minced of fresh mint sprigs
instructions: In a small saucepan, add quinoa, canned plum, yellow squash, and minced garlic. Sprinkle with 5 spice powder. Bring to boil over high heat and boil until liquid is absorbed. Stir in v 8 juice and arrowroot mixture. Cool to room temperature.

title: American Fontina Cheese Spread
ingredients: 6 ounces fontina cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup stone ground mustard
instructions: Beat all ingredients together. Serve with crackers.

title: Salsa Chipotle - Shredded Beef for Tacos
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast, fat removed | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles, chopped | 1 teaspoon hot red chili powder | 1/4 cup nuts ( optional )
instructions: Place beef roast in slow cooker. Sprinkle with chipotle chilies. Sprinkle with red chili powder. Cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours or on high 4 - 5 hours. When tender, shred beef with two forks, add water if mixture is too moist. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,green chili pepper,almond,maraschino cherry,cardamom pod,baking potato,hot pepper
title: Kashmiri Aloo (Potatoes in Spicy Almonds)
ingredients: 6 medium baking potatoes | 1 -2 teaspoon whole cumin seed | 3 cardamom pods | 1 large hot pepper, chopped ( jalapeno, habanero or other hot pepper can be substituted ) | 2 tablespoons chopped almonds | 1 small fresh green chili pepper, finely chopped ( optional ) | 3 -4 tablespoons sliced maraschino cherries ( optional )
instructions: Slice potatoes into quarters or fourths. Place them in a large pot of water and sprinkle generously with salt. Bring to a boil, lower heat to medium and cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Turn potatoes over, cover again and continue cooking for about another 20 minutes, or until skins are soft. Remove from heat and uncover potatoes and peel them. Place in a mixing bowl, cover with a plate covering and allow to cool for 20 minutes. Rinse off the potatoes. Heat a large non stick frying pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, cardamon pods and hot pepper. Saute for about 45 seconds. Turn stove to low and add the almond. Let it toast for 2 minutes. Add a small handful of almonds to pan and carefully toast. You want them to be golden brown and fragrant at the aroma. Keep stirring as you toast them so that nothing burns or starts to stick to the bottom. Remove nuts from the pan and place onto a cutting board. Place into a food processor, food proc or blender and pulse until all ingredients are finely chopped. If your food processor runs into a crumb stage or a crumbles stage, do so in a short burst. Place all chopped ingredients in a mixing bowl and stir. Once ingredients are mixed, put through a fine mesh strainer into a mixing bowl. Reserve in a medium sized bowl, covered,. Pour yogurt onto mixture and gently mix. Sprinkle with more of the reserved, if desired. The yogurt will thicken as it sits so it is a good consistency for dipping your potato slices inches if you feel adventurous, chill and remove before serving.

title: Baked Mixed and Fried Okra
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, chopped | 1 pound fresh okra, trimmed | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the broccombs and okra in the oven, and bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until just tender. Sprinkle with cumin, then remove from the oven, and serve.

title: The Blueberry and Sweet On The End of All Things!
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, cleaned | 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries | 1 -4 cup blueberries
instructions: Shred the romaine and sweeten with blue juice. Combine the berries. Serve.

title: Chocolate Chipped Beef for the Grill
ingredients: 3 lbs pot roast or 3 lbs round roast | 2 ounces dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: Mix well. Marinade in refrigerator for at least 6 hours or overnight. Use 2 tbsp on a foil lined, hot griddle. Grill or broil as desired.

title: Spiced Almond Macadamia Coffee
ingredients: 1/4 cup ground blanched almonds | 3 tablespoons ground aniseed | 1 teaspoon instant coffee
instructions: Toast the almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Cool, and stir into coffee. Store in a cool dry place, tightly covered, up to 1 month.

title: Fry Things
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 1/2 teaspoons orange zest
instructions: Heat oil in a fryer or large saucepan or deep fryer to 325 degrees f. Line a bowl of cold water with nonstick cooking spray. Squeeze orange peel into bowl. Dry fry orange peel until golden brown, then transfer peel to bowl. Add orange peel to bowl with peel. Dry fry until crisp, about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove skillet from heat, but do not wipe out. Add a few teaspoons of oil to fryer and fry until very hot, 30 to 45 seconds. Remove and transfer hot strips to paper towels. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,vegetable stock,lasagna noodle,green,pizza dough,horseradish,spinach,granny smith apple
title: Spinach and Apple Lasagna (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock | 6 ounces uncooked rice noodles | 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach, stems removed | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 9 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 6 ounces green ( yellow ) mushrooms, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 2 sheets prepared low-fat frozen pizza dough
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the vegetable stock and gently simmer the rice noodles until tender. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spread 1 1/2 cups of the spinach onto the bottom of a 13x9inch baking dish. Sprinkle with the noodles and top with 1/3 of the apple slices. Top with 1/3 of the horseradish. Arrange half of the noodle noodles over the greens and top with the remaining spinach, the remaining noodles, and apples, then top with the second layer of horseradish. Top with the mushrooms. Bake 40 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and golden. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting. Serve.

title: Roasted Sole And Turkey
ingredients: 1/2 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, fresh finely chopped | 2 lbs fresh sole roasts | 1 lb deli turkey
instructions: Remove fat from turkey if serving at room temperature. Place raisins in microwave safe bowl and add turmeric powder, lime leaves and turkey. Microwave on full power for 1 - 1 1/2 minutes turning turkey over after 1 minute so both side are golden. Let soak for about 10 minutes. Place turkey back in microwave and re set power setting to high. Microwave turkey for another 10 minutes, turning turkey around once every 4 - 5 minutes till turkey is cooked. Remove turkey and let rest while you make the gravy. Sauce, cook turkey on top of stove till slightly charred in spots.. To serve, place turkey on serving dish, drizzle with gravy and enjoy.

title: Cheesy Beef and Cabbage Rolls With Red Pepper Spread
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 4 cups coarsely shredded red cabbage | 1 cup shredded red pepper | 1 cup low-fat ricotta cheese
instructions: Cook ground sirloin over medium high heat until halfway cooked, about 3 minutes. Drain of any excess juices. Stir in cabbage, red pepper and ricotta cheese. Scoop up cabbage rolls and place on a baking sheet. Bake in oven until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla yogurt,salad green,vanilla essence,white wine vinegar
title: Salad Greens Salad with Vanilla Yoghurt
ingredients: 125 ml vanilla flavored yogurt | 150 ml good quality white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 300 -400 g mixed salad greens
instructions: Place yogurt, vanilla essence and vinegar in a large bowl. Place salad greens in a bowl, toss just until mixed. Pour over the yogurt mixture and toss well. Serve with cream cheese spread enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,topping,bay scallop,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Spicy Scallops
ingredients: 8 fresh bay scallops | 1 - 1 1/2 lb fresh boneless chicken breast, cubed | 1 cup shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Cook scallops or other thick meat in large skillet until browned on outside, 4 - 6 minutes per side. Remove scallops to a plate. Put cheese in the bottom of a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Place sliced scallops on top of cheese and top with meat. Sprinkle with mozzarella and pour a small amount of gravy over meat and scallops. Microwave on high for 1 minute or until cheese is bubbly. Spoon remaining gravy on top.

title: Cherry Can Be Roasted Flounder
ingredients: 1 lb flounder fillet, 1 inch thick | 1 ounce maraschino cherry, halves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Combine maraschino cherries with some water drippings in a heavy small baking dish. Place fish on top of cherries and drizzle with more hot maraschino cherry water. Roast the fish for 20 minutes. Turn the fish halfway through roasting time.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,bread flour,confectioner sugar,poblano pepper,peanut oil vegetable,green prawn,cointreau liqueur
title: Green Prawns With Cointreau and Peanuts
ingredients: 2 poblano peppers | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 cup plain flour, sifted | 1 cup bread flour | confectioners'sugar, for dusting | 12 prawns, raw | 1/2 cup cointreau liqueur
instructions: Trim the green prawns and remove the head and shells and discard. Using a sharp knife, remove the prawn heads and tail and chop away the tough membrane that forms during the grilling process. Cut the white membrane from the prawn. Chop the prawn meat into smaller pieces. Cut the peppers in half, remove the green flesh, seeds and ribs, and dice roughly. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the prawn pieces over high heat until they change colour. Remove them from the pan and set aside. In a mixing bowl, sift the flour and bread flour together and gently rub the flour into one side of the prawn meat. Roll the meat with your hands so the oil can cover it all. Heat a griddle or frying pan on medium, lightly butter the griddle. Put two large handfuls of the mix into the griddle and brown lightly. Repeat for each pile, or make them the size of a patty and scatter over the confectioners' sugar. Leave to cook a minute, then turn the prawns over. Spread the cointreau over a little bit of the prawn meat, then scatter over the prawn meat. Cook for a minute or two, then remove from the griddle and place under a hot grill for 3 minutes until it has set. To finish, place a plate on top, turn the prawn heads over, then scatter over the cointreau. Serve with sour cream.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,cranberry,arborio rice,white rice flour,ginger root
title: Green Rice and Cranberry Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup white rice flour | 3 cups green enchilada sauce | 1 bunch fresh ginger root, peeled and diced | 1 jar dried cranberries
instructions: Place white rice flour in a pot, and mix in enough water to form a dough. On a floured surface, bring 1 cup rice flour to a rolling boil. Cook rice for about 15 minutes, until it has lost its raw look and feels firm. Dough should be very thick. Remove dough from the boiling water and allow to cool slightly. Whip green enchilada sauce until it is thick. Place ginger into a large bowl, and place green rice on top. Spread the rice onto a cutting board, and roll into a flat rectangle shape about 1/8 inch thick. In a separate bowl, beat some of the enchilada sauce into about 1/2 cup of the rice liquid. Fold the dough into the sauce, cover tightly, and set aside at room temperature for 1 hour. Heat olive oil in a cast iron skillet or a regular skillet over medium heat. Carefully place rice into the pan with the sauce, and sprinkle some of the cranberries into the rice. Cover, and cook until the rice is tender, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,purple onion,dark brown sugar,beef bouillon granule,caster sugar
title: Steamed Golden Onion Rings
ingredients: 150 g dark brown sugar | 1 purple onion, halved, then sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules or 1 teaspoon instant minced onion | 1 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a heavy bottomed pan and stir slowly over a low heat until they dissolve and the liquid has thickened slightly. Add more water to cover the onions if necessary. Transfer to the steamer basket over a saucepan of boiling water and leave for 30 minute or more. Toss the onions gently with the warm onion and serve warm or cold.

title: Tortilla Chips - Yummy Cheap & Elegant!!
ingredients: 2 teaspoons gluten free chili paste or 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 loaf white bread | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum
instructions: If using chili paste, it is optional. If using garlic paste, it is optional. Cut bread in halves/thirds and then cut each half in half again and you get 3 halves. Use a mortar and pestle full of your favourite tortilla chips i recommend this method of eating them, they are much easier to work with this recipe. You can also dip your finger in warm water and then dip the bread into the spiced chile paste/garlic paste. Sprinkle the gluten free lime or tamarind and xanthan gum on the top of the slice.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,turmeric,brandy,peanut butter,kielbasa,molasses,elbow macaroni,chicken bouillon granule
title: A Unique American Indian Macaroni and Kielbasa
ingredients: 1/2 pound kielbasa, cut into cubes | 2 tablespoons olive oil or butter | 5 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 can chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon beef sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons molasses | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 bottle kraft mexican style chili & three meat chili
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 5 quart baking dish. Place the kielbasa into a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg white,red pepper powder,coconut milk,dark rum,lychee
title: Lychee Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 cans lychees, drained and rinsed | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk | 1 egg white | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper powder | 1 - 1 1/4 tablespoon dark rum
instructions: Whisk egg white in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Chill.

title: Beef Filets Continental
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs round steaks | 2 1/2 cups brandy ( or to taste ) | 2 1/2 cans rotel tomatoes
instructions: Thoroughly clean round steak. Pat dry with paper towels. Rub beef with brandy. Put the whole tomatoes into a large, heavy plastic bowl or ziplock bag with the rinsed out sides. Seal. Put the bag containing both cans of tomatoes inside of beef. Put over high heat on a burner on medium high heat for about 2 minutes to warm tomatoes through. Turn down heat to low. Cook covered, at medium heat for 1 to 2 hours or until you feel pressure is barely coming out of the lid. Turn off burner and let sit for 10 minutes or until it reaches the level of your choice, and serve hot..

title: Asian Beef Cubes
ingredients: 3/4 lb trimmed beef brisket | 1 package unflavored gelatin | 1 1/3 cups rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons oil | 1 bunch scallion, cut into 3 `` lengths
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat. Cut across the grain into 1/4 pieces lengthwise. Mix gelatin, vinegar and oil in saucepan. Heat to boiling over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Add meat and set aside. Drain meat and reserve liquid. Cut into chunks. Wipe the saucepan clean. Heat liquid until it barely simmers. Add meat and scallions. Cover and boil about 20 minutes or until meat is tender, basting frequently. Remove from heat. Drain meat and discard scallion oil. Allow to cool. Cover and refrigerate meat for 3 hours. Shape into small meatballs, removing most of bones and gristle. Reserve meat and scallions. Heat reserved liquid and gelatin mixture in saucepan, stirring constantly until gelatin is dissolved. Cook and stir until mixture thickens slightly. Remove from heat. Add meat, reserving liquid. If desired, garnish with reserved scallions. Heat, stirring occasionally, until meat and scallion are heated through.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,greek seasoning,sauce,white mushroom,purpose flour,prawn,parsnip,texas toast bread
title: Crispy Baked Shrimps With Garlicky Bread and Veggies
ingredients: 24 large prawns, shelled, cooked and tails removed | 1 lb white mushroom | 1 lb parsnip | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons texas toast thick bread, toasted to taste | 4 teaspoons hp steak sauce, warmed | 2 teaspoons garlicky hot sauce, from the hot bottle
instructions: For the shrimps, cut the mushrooms in half, capsisee, wash and cut the parsnips into quarters. Rinse well. Heat half the oil in a wok over moderate heat, fry the mushrooms for 5 mins or until soft and cooked through. Drain off any excess oil and set the mushrooms aside. Toss the prawns and mushroom mixture together, season and pile onto a plate. Make the garlicky toast spread a slice of texas toast bread, top the toast with a few drops of steak sauce. Spread the creamed toast on one side of the toast. Place the trimmings in a small saucepan and add the rest of the oil with the hot sauce, bring to the boil and simmer 3 mins or till the garlicky sauce is reduced and the shrimp is cooked. Spoon the shrimp over the toasted toast and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder roast,chunky peanut butter,french bean,lime zest,mandarin orange segment,beef
title: Peanut Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1 pork shoulder roast | 1 bone-in beef | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 can mandarin orange segments, drained | 1 can french-style beans
instructions: Preheat grill. Remove skin from pot roast. Place beef, pork and chunky peanut butter in a resealable plastic bag. Shake to coat evenly. Reserve seasoning for stew. Pour reserved seasoning into a dutch oven or other large pot with a lid or lid large enough to accomodate the meat. Add reserved seasoning bag. Heat over medium heat until hot. Slice meat in half, then slice each half in half again and into 1/2 inch slices. Place cooked meat, pork and chunky peanut butter in a bowl. Add mandarin orange segments and french style beans to meat and stir to combine. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,lime,star anise,chicken,cornflour,half cream,italian plum tomato,champagne
title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 kg cubed chicken | 2 liters half-fat cream | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon asti sprig sesame or 1 teaspoon poppy seed powder | 1 italian plum tomato, diced | 4 glasses champagne | 2 limes
instructions: Pre heat oven to 160 degrees centigrade. Mix the chicken, cream, cornflour, coriander powder, sesame powder and a bit of the tomatoes in a casserole dish. Cover with remaining tomatoes. Pour wine over. Cover with foil and cook for 2 hours.

title: Pork Green-Olive Pizza
ingredients:
1 package refrigerated prepared green giant frozen green giant frozen mixed green giant mixed green giant frozen mixed green giant frozen mixed green giant frozen mixed green giant frozen mixed green giant frozen mixed green giant frozen mixed green giant frozen mixed green giant frozen mixed green giant frozen mix red pepper
