instructions: Heat oven to uncover large frozen green giant frozen mexican®® fiesta® style green giant green giant® mixed green® and green giant® frozen green® in the microwave and stir. Microwave 1 minute longer, stirring after 1 minute. Prepare pizza crust recipe as directed on package and set aside. Spread dough on a lightly oiled pizza pan or baking sheet. Sprinkle monterey jack cheese onto dough. Cover with foil. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or till golden brown. Remove from oven. Remove foil. Stir together green giant® frozen green® and green giant® mixed green® and green giant® frozen green on the edge of a pie plate, in a small bowl. Spoon green giant® mixed green® and green giant® green® green on hot pizza. Top with olives.

title: Salmon Steak with Orange-Marzetti Stuffing
ingredients: 2 lbs tender boneless pork, with fat in it | 1/2 lb salmon steak or 1/2 lb pork shank, in 1 in cubes | 3 tablespoons olive, divided | 1/2 cup dried marzipan or ( 12 ounce ) package mixed dried fruit preserves | 3 packages seasoning mix | 4 tablespoons cracked white peppercorns | 1 tablespoon orange extract
instructions: Place marzipan in a zip lock bag and add a tiny piece of orange peppercorns to the bag. Place the salmon steak in the bag and add the olive, salt, and pepper. Massage or toss to coat all of the meat. Lay on a rack in the roasting pan and roast at 325º for 15 minutes for rare.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,beef chuck roast,duck breast,coriander,white pepper
title: Beef and Barbecue Pot (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 20 ounces coriander, stems removed | 8 tablespoons light-colored cooking wine such as dr. watkins digestive digestive recipe | 4 teaspoons white pepper | 100 g soft lettuce leaves | 4 duck breasts, from lrg grocery stores, sliced into strips
instructions: Trim excess fat from roast and sprinkle meat with coriander. Place in roasting pan, skin sides down, in a single layer. Roast in a hot oven for 12 - 14 hours, turning roasting pan occasionally. Stir coriander & wine into beef. Place beef on wire rack and allow to stand for 3 mins before carving thinly.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,bean sprout,white mushroom,orange peel,taco seasoning,creole seasoning,ginger root
title: Easy Chinese Pork Chop
ingredients: 1 bone-in pork loin chops, with excess fat trimmed | 1/2 cup creole-style seasoning, divided | 1 can white mushrooms, drained | 1/2 cup chopped fresh bean sprouts | 1/4 cup orange peel, finely shredded | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rub 1/2 cup creole style seasoning onto both sides pork chops. Place in a roasting pan large enough to hold chops in a single layer. Drizzle pork chops with remaining 1/2 cup creole style seasoning. Mix mushrooms, bean sprouts, orange peel, ginger, taco seasoning, and a generous sprinkling of remaining creole style seasoning into the pork chops in the pan. Place pan in the preheated oven. Bake in the preheated oven until internal temperature of pork chops is 145 degrees f, about 1 hour. Remove from oven. Serve with a side of fluffy rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,turmeric,gorgonzola cheese,cold water,apricot,shrimp paste,sun tomato oil
title: Soup Gorgonzola
ingredients: 15 lbs good quality chicken stock, preferably organic ( about 2 1/2 quarts ) | 2 tablespoons shrimp paste ( sun dried shrimp ) | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric | 3/4 cup cold water | 4 ounces fresh goat cheese or 4 ounces gorgonzola cheese, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2/3 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1 ounce chopped dried apricot, dried in hot soya oil
instructions: Bring stock to boil in a heavy large pot over high heat. Reduce heat to moderate, cover, and simmer until reduced and about 3 1/2 cups liquid is made, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Strain stock through a fine sieve set over a bowl. Skim any impurities off the surface and discard. Strain stock through a cloth, pressing out any solids.

title: Skewered Fish
ingredients: 8 thick slices bacon | 8 skin-on salmon fillets | 8 kitchen twine
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Place one piece of bacon on each piece of salmon, then wrap each piece up lengthwise with a toothpick. Secure with kitchen twine to secure the salmon, then place on a large, greased baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, then turn once.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,carrot,grainy mustard,gruyere cheese,white mushroom,red bell pepper
title: Creamy Mustard Carrots
ingredients: 2 cups thinly sliced carrots | 1 large red bell pepper, finely sliced | 1/2 cup chopped white mushrooms | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, cubed | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon dry french-style ground mustard | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add carrot.

title: Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 6 scallions, diced | 2 leeks | 1/4 cup cinnamon | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot paprika
instructions: Clean leeks and cut into 1 inch lengths. Combine all ingredients and blend, then place in large shallow glass bowl. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Serve over salads. This would be nice with lamb as well.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,pine nut,prosciutto,molasses,premade puff pastry,calf liver,pizza crust,lime
title: Sarasota's Cafeteria Spanish Pizza (Djemput's Pizza)
ingredients: 3/4 lb deli sliced deli pancetta or 3/4 lb prosciutto | 3/4 lb alf liver | 1 package premade puff pastry sheets, such as boboli | 1 lime, cut into wedges | 8 slices parma mozzarella or 8 slices swiss cheese | 1 1/2 ounces pine nuts | 1 pizza crust | 4 leaves basil leaves
instructions: Drain the pancetta slices on a paper towel, then slice very thin, about 1/8 thick. Lay out the puff pastry sheets on a flat surface. Cut a 1 inch slice off the edge of the puff pastry, then use the cut piece to press up the edge with fingers. Place a slice of liver in the middle of each pastry roll. Sprinkle with lime juice and about 1/2 cup of mozzarella cheese. Lay two slices of parma mozzarella on top of the mozzarella and top with pine nuts. Wrap the edge of the pastry around the mozzarella, starting from a side that touches the outside of the roll, then turn the outside around the mozzarella and other side to seal the outside edges. Press each edge to seal, and lay the dough top pastry down. Trim excess pastry and cut off extra pastry. Repeat this procedure with the remaining 2 additional slices and mozzarella. Place on pizza buns. Slice into 6 to 8 slices.

title: Easy Shredded Peach
ingredients: 3 large ripe peaches | 10 ounces picante sauce | 10 ounces barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot. Cook on low for 8 hours.

title: Vanilla Bean Polenta
ingredients: 200 g polenta | 3 small red chilies | 4 -5 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: First, take the polenta and chop it into very fine small dice. Next, add the chillies, sherry and freshly ground pepper to taste. Drain your vanilla bean, add it to the polenta with the vanilla bean. Let the polenta sit for an hour at room temperature, then spread it out on a clean, dry surface using the tip of a sharp knife. At this point you can either spread the polenta out into a rectangular or oval cake tin, or you can bake or pan with the polenta in it. Put it in a preheated oven at 175c / 400f / gas mark 6 and bake for about 25 minutes or until the polenta turns a golden brown colour around the edges. Let it cool, then dig in.

title: Pigs Irish Style
ingredients: 6 small russet potatoes, boiled peeled, peeled and cubed | 2 cans sliced beets, drained and reserve liquid | 1/2 lb boneless pork chop | 1 tablespoon celery seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the potatoes and beets in a food processor and pulse to coarsely chop. Season with salt. Transfer to a medium bowl. Toss pork chops with 1 tablespoon celery seed until coated. Mix in potato and beet mixture. Pour potato mixture into 2 greased 9x13 pan. Top with remaining pork chops. Drizzle reserved beet liquid over top. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees f until breadcrumbs are golden brown and potatoes are tender, about 1 hour.

title: Homemade Beef Stock
ingredients: 3 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 1/4 ounce ground allspice berries
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in a cool, dark area.

title: Wild Mushroom and Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces wild mushrooms | 2 g dried breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon white miso
instructions: Wash your mushrooms and cut off the ends. Using a knife break or finely chop them. Place the mushrooms in a bowl with the breadcrumbs, miso and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Red Wine Glazed Cranberry Sausages With Cognac
ingredients: 4 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons cognac or 2 teaspoons brandy | 1/4 cup cranberry juice | 10 -12 slices bacon, cooked and sliced into 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a small bowl, combine vinegar, cognac and cranberry juice then stir well. Heat a wok over high heat. Add 2 tablespoons of the wine vinegar mixture to the pan and swirl to coat. Add the bacon and toss with the remaining vinaigrette to coat and heat through. Remove and discard the bacon and set aside to drain.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,thai chili sauce,wild rice,chile sauce,parsley sprig,pimento olive,salt black pepper
title: Tex-Mex Wild Rice, Fish or Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, cooked and cooled | 1/4 cup chile sauce | 1 teaspoon pimento stuffed olive, sliced | 2 tablespoons sweet thai sweet chili sauce | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley sprigs, chopped | 1 dash salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Spray a non stick skillet with non stick spray. Over medium heat, stir fry the rice, chile sauce, olives, chili sauce, parsley, salt, and pepper for 1 minute, or until heated through. Serve warm.

title: Beef With Cornmeal (Dry Beef)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, peeled, cut into thin strips | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon | 2 cups cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place beef strips in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with bouillon. Stir together cornmeal and water. Pour over beef. Cover and bake for about 1 hour. Uncover and bake until beef is very tender about 1 hour more.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,chili oil,mango,black pepper,red bell pepper,parmesan cheese
title: Barbecue Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 mango, cut into chunks | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and diced
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in a large bowl. Let sit at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours until flavors combine. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,linguine,chickpea,corn tortilla chip,nonfat beef broth,navy bean
title: Warm Chunk Spanish Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage ( i used mild, but you can use your favorite ) | 1 cup nonfat beef broth ( can use reduced fat or fat free ) | 32 ounces canned fat-free chickpeas, drained | 8 -10 ounces frozen corn tortilla chips, broken into pieces ( optional ) | navy beans, drained ( optional ) | shredded nonfat sharp cheddar cheese ( or mexican blend )
instructions: Brown meat with garlic. In a 3 - 4 quart crock pot, add meat, soup and chick peas to crock pot. Cover and cook on low heat for 30 - 60 hours. Serve with chips, or nannies, or any other toppings to dip.

title: Mushroom-Rubbed Onions
ingredients: 500 g white onions ( sliced thin ) | 1/2 cup kosher salt ( himalayan preferred ) | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Cut the onion in half, and slice each half on the diagnol into thin slivers, the slices should be about 3/4 of an inch thick. Sprinkle half the salt over the sliced onions and set aside for 10 minutes. In a small bowl, mix oregano with oregano and olive oil, adding a little bit of both sherry and vinegar as needed, and then pour this over the sliced onion. Arrange the onions in a dish and rub the olive olive oil mixture all over the top. Serve warm or at room temperature. Note re, you can use sliced meat as well, but the onions shouldn't be too soft.

title: Easy One Serve Fondue
ingredients: chocolate chip | 5 1/2 ounces dried farfalle pasta or 5 1/2 ounces other pastas | 5 1/2 ounces green beans or 5 1/2 ounces other fresh green beans, washed | 2 tablespoons snipped chives
instructions: Preheat broiler. Heat chocolate in large skillet over medium heat until melted and smooth. Stir in farfalle noodles or other pastas and sprinkle with chives. Serve immediately. Makes 1 serving.

Random Ingredients: beef,purple onion,farfalle pasta,ladyfinger,flour,salt pork,pecorino romano cheese
title: Gorky's Meatball Sub Dinner
ingredients: 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 lb salt pork ( optional ) | 1/3 cup chopped purple onion | 1/3 cup cheese, grated | 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese | flour | 1 package farfalle pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix cooked and drained pasta well.

title: Pasta, Beans and Sausage
ingredients: 350 g sausage | 150 -300 g cannellini beans
instructions: Boil the beans in lots of water for about 20 - 25 minutes or until they are well cooked and have a thick sauce. While the beans are cooking, heat up a pot of olive oil over a high heat for a couple of minutes and fry the sausage, and drain. When the sausage is cooked and browned, throw the cans of beans out onto the skillet and toss, add the sausage and bean mixture into the pot and bring to boil again. Reduce the heat to medium, add pasta and toss it until everything is incorporated.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,black salt,veggie burger,spinach leaf,ice,phyllo pastry,cayenne pepper
title: Spinach and Herb Samosas
ingredients: 2 lbs veggie burgers ( burgers ) | 1 tablespoon black salt | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3/4 teaspoon dried tarragon or 3 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried hibachi spinach leaves | 8 sheets fresh spinach leaves ( approximately ) | 1 box phyllo pastry | 3 tablespoons crushed ice, approx ( just enough to thaw a few sheets in the refrigerator. not to defrost the pastry sheets too soon, you might want to add a little more before rolling. )
instructions: Slice burgers into 3/4 inch thick slices. Place between sheets of plastic wrap.

title: Quick & Easy Tiramisu
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking rice | 1/2 cup brewed kidney beans | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 cup smoked sweet pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup cornstarch | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 cup brewed tea
instructions: Rinse rice thoroughly under running water and drain. In large bowl, combine cooked rice, undrained kidney beans, golden syrup & sweet pepper. In small saucepan, combine cornstarch & 2 tablespoons of the brewed tea. Stir cornstarch mixture into remaining tea in medium saucepan, cook over medium heat, bring to boil, stirring constantly, add to rice mixture. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Make ahead, this can be made hours ahead and chilled. When ready to serve, cool completely before assembling assembled tiramisu.

title: Vanilla Soured Rice Wine Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 1 1/4 cups rice wine ( dry-aged ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking pan. Mix together dry ingredients in a medium sized bowl until completely mixed, adding icing sugar and vanilla as you mix. Press evenly into baking pan. Sprinkle generously with confectioners sugar. Slice into 1/2 inch pieces after removing from pan. Bake in oven for 40 minutes or until light brown and set. Cool completely and enjoy.

title: Chile and Soy Sauce Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dashi stock | 1 teaspoon sofrito sauce | 2 fresh red chile peppers, chopped
instructions: Pour the dashi and sofrito into a pot over medium heat. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 10 minutes. Add the red chiles, and simmer for a 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: potato flour,red pepper flake,shallot,pineapple juice,soymilk,tortilla chip,palm sugar
title: Dynamite Nachos
ingredients: 1/4 cup light soy milk | 1/4 cup unsweetened pineapple juice | 1/4 cup minced shallot | 2 tablespoons potato flour | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup crushed tortilla chips | 1 tablespoon palm sugar, or to taste
instructions: Whisk soy milk, pineapple juice, shallots, potato flour, red pepper flakes, and tortilla chips in a bowl until sauce is thickened. Stir in palm sugar. Spoon about 1/2 cup of sauce in a tortilla.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,beef broth,pork fillet,half cream,vegetable oil
title: Mustard Pork for Two
ingredients: 2 teaspoons black mustard seed | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork fillets, trimmed and cut into 2 cm pieces | 14 ounces beef broth | 1 1/3 cups half-and-half cream
instructions: Heat the mustard seeds in the oil over moderate heat for 3 minutes, until they pop. Add the pork and cook, turning with a slotted spoon, for 3 minutes or until golden. Add the beef broth and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer over the lowest possible heat, skimming any foam that rises to the surface. Cook for 10 minutes or until the pork is tender. Add the cream and cook for 4 minutes or until thickened. Serve at once.

title: Lime-Cured Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup dry white wine or 1/2 cup beef broth | 2 teaspoons lime zest, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f combine ground beef, tomatoes, wine and lime peel in a large bowl. Season to taste with salt. Shape mixture with hands into 15 meatballs. Arrange on a baking sheet. Bake until no longer pink in center, about 40 minutes remove from oven and cool slightly. Transfer to paper towel lined plate. Increase oven temperature to 450°f. Dip meatballs into warm, sterile grape juice. Place on baking sheet, then bake until meatballs are browned, 5 - 7 minutes longer.

title: Groundnut Almond Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 4 cardamom pods | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed dried beef broth
instructions: Toast the almonds in 1 1/2 to 2 tbsp olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat for about 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown. Set aside and keep warm. While the almonds are toasting, make the soup, crush the cardamom pods with a mortar and pestle. When the almonds are golden, add the crushed tomatoes along with the beef broth and cook, stirring, over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add the almonds and cook until heated through.

title: Copenhagen Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground chuck | 1/2 lb ground carrot | 1 lb meatballs | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 tablespoon kale | 8 -10 spinach leaves | fried beets | rye bread or bread, as accompaniment
instructions: Meat and meat mixture,. Mix meat, carrot, and flour together thoroughly. Bring to a boil slowly. Lower heat and simmer for half an hour. Add kale, spinach, beets, and rice and simmer for about 15 minutes longer. Serve with fried beets served separately.

title: Easy Green Curry Beef
ingredients: 1 lb round green curry paste | 12 ounces cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Heat up soup. When heated add curry paste and stir with soup heat just a minute or so or your taste.

title: Homemade Soft-Boiled Cakes
ingredients: 3 lbs soft unripe large size soft unripe lumps such as butter or 1 1/2 lbs margarine | 1 1/2 cups heavy flavored ice water | 3 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Note, the baking powder is not necessary for this recipe. Using an electric mixer, beat together the soft butter and ice water, until well blended. The mixture will gradually solidify into a paste. The ice water will thicken quickly. Scoop out the paste from the block of ice water with a teaspoon and stir it into the butter and egg mixture. Add baking soda to about 1/3 of the mixture and beat for about 2 minutes. Drop the mixture by spoonfuls on to parchment paper lined baking sheets. Place in the freezer until hard about 1 hour. Turn out on a wire rack and cool completely.

title: Cold Mustard
ingredients: 1 can black tea ( herbal, organic or other is fine ) | 3 cups boiling water | 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 4 tablespoons quick-rise prepared grain mustard ( or wholegrain mustard ) | 1 bunch fresh greens, cut into 2-inch lengths
instructions: Bring the tea and water to a boil in a saucepan. Add the farfalle pasta and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, until al dente. Add the mustard, and heat through. Taste for salt. Stir in the greens. Pour into a warmed soup bowl.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,lemon zest,anise seed,baking potato
title: Kabob
ingredients: 6 medium baking potatoes, peeled & cut into chunks ( about 3 1/2 pounds ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 3 large lemon zest, thinly sliced ( about 2 tbls. )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the potatoes directly on the broiler rack. Broil 12 minutes, or until tender. Cool, then coarsely chop the potatoes into smaller pieces. Meanwhile, stir together the baking powder, anise seeds and lemon zest in a medium bowl. When the potatoes are cool enough to handle, drain the moisture. Add the lemon zest mixture, toss to coat the potatoes, and spread the mixture all over the tops of the kabob. Place on a metal baking sheet and broil until the tops are dark brown and crusty, 8 - 10 minutes.

title: Chickpea Patties
ingredients: 200 g beef mince ( finely ground mince ) | 1/2 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Combine ground mince, chickpeas, worcestershire sauce, coriander and pepper. Slightly flatten into patties. Cook at c for approx 8 minutes each side, basting once or twice. Serve with your favourite burger sauce.

title: Tomato and Caraway Seeds-Vegan Dip
ingredients: 400 g plum tomatoes, vine-ripened | 1 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional, you can also use ground mustard or a dry one if you don't have caraway seeds ) | 1 tablespoon low-fat natural yoghurt | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Using a sharp knife, dice the tomatoes into even pieces. Using a mortar and pestle, pound the tomato cubes with the caraway seeds to a coarse paste. Add the yoghurt and the oil and gently mix together. Transfer into a serving bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,cranberry,pomegranate juice,creme de cassis,enchilada sauce,vanilla essence
title: Cran-Pomegranate Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cups ricotta cheese | 2 cups creme de cassis | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 cup cranberries ( can also use blueberries ) | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice ( may need more )
instructions: Drain cranberries and drain juice from tin. Mix all ingredients and put in casserole dish with lid. Seal. Bake @350 for 30 - 35 minutes.

title: Italian Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs round steaks | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded ( i use a mild feta cheese ) | 1 teaspoon rosemary, dried
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees. Spray large rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. Brush meat evenly with oil. Combine remaining ingredients and spread over steaks. Bake 25 - 30 minutes or untill sauce begins to bubble.

title: Classic Noodle Rolls
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1 pound cellophane noodles | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Dissolve yeast in about 1/2 cup of warm water in a large bowl. Combine tomato paste and noodles in a separate bowl. Combine thyme and remaining warm water in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: double cream,chicken bouillon,butter,ghee,flour tortilla,plum,almond milk,broccoli floret
title: Indian Vegetable Burritos
ingredients: 3/4 cup almond milk | 1/4 cup double cream | 2 tablespoons butter | 9 ounces broccoli florets | 1 tablespoon shredded blanched almond ( or other almond ) | 3 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon flour tortillas, burrito-type | 2 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine, softened
instructions: Mix almond milk and cream in small saucepan set over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until milk just begins to come to a bubble. Reduce heat to medium low.

title: Mokkatakuriko (Pork in Lemony Soup)
ingredients: 500 g pork loin | 4 tablespoons potato starch | 2 tablespoons lychee, concentrate
instructions: Cut the pork into long, thin slices. Combine all ingredients in a large stockpot. Bring it to the boil. Reduce heat to simmer. Cook for 3 hours adding more water while cooking with a fork, or until pork is tender.

title: Cheryl's Caponata
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cilantro, leaves only ( i prefer the curly kind ) | 4 ounces capers ( packed )
instructions: Finely chop the cilantro leaves. If you must keep the capers, slice them about 1/8 inch thick. Pack the capers tightly into a jar, tightly, with capers showing in an even layer around the cap. Cover and shake the capers until the capers are evenly coated. Store capers in the refrigerator. Note, capers take longer to absorb the flavor than almonds as they get puffed up and can cause them to brown. Don't worry about losing some flavor.

title: English Burnt Beef for Muffins
ingredients: 2 ounces stew meat | 300 g currants or 300 g raisins | 2 teaspoons smoked paprika | 3 tea leaves, to serve on the side
instructions: Trim the meat then cut into large chunks, if necessary.

title: Quick and Easy Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish, or to taste | 1 package frozen peas, thawed | 1 golden delicious apple - peeled, cored, and diced
instructions: Mix the horseradish into the peas just until coated. Add the apple and toss to coat. Sprinkle with more horseradish if desired.

title: Flat Tortilla
ingredients: 6 whole wheat tortillas | 1/4 cup sour cream ( or coconut cream ) | 1/3 cup shredded low-fat wheat bran
instructions: Warm 1 tortilla at a time in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Spread sour cream on top. Sprinkle with cereal and shredded bran. Place other tortilla on top of sour cream. Lightly press into pan, cooking until lightly browned and tortilla can be flicked or removed..

title: Peach and Lentil Pasta Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces penne ( or spaghetti ) | 1 cup lentils, rinsed, cooked ( green or yellow ) | 1 cup broccoli, chopped ( fresh or frozen ) | 3 fresh peaches, sliced and chopped | 1/2 cup chili sauce ( or more to taste ) | 3 tablespoons tap water | lettuce leaf, thinly sliced ( optional ) | crumbled feta, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again. While the pasta cooks, steam or microwave other vegetables. When pasta is cooked, drain well and toss with vegetable mixture. Add chili sauce, and warm through. Serve topped with lettuce leaves and crumbled feta.

title: Caper and Cocoa Pour
ingredients: caper | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 7 -12 slices whole wheat bread, good quality for soaking
instructions: Place the drained capers in a heatproof bowl, and leave to macerate overnight. Sprinkle the capers over two slices of bread, then sprinkle with half of the cocoa powder and then cover with the bread. Place in a dry heavy frying pan or in a saucepan, cover, and warm through until very thick and golden.

title: Applesauce Ladyfingers
ingredients: 4 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups packed brown sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the vinegar and brown sugar. Add the lady fingers, and gently stir to coat with the mixture. Let them sit at room temperature for 20 minutes, then refrigerate about 20 minutes for the flavors to blend. Line a baking sheet with waxed paper and lightly grease it with oil. Arrange the lady fingers on the baking sheet, and bake at 350 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown and crusty.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,chorizo sausage,green cardamom pod,white sugar,kidney bean
title: Kidney Bean Gumbo
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground chorizo sausage | 1 can kidney beans | 1 green cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the chorizo sausage in a skillet over medium heat. Cook until evenly browned, and crumbly. Drain excess grease, and stir in the drained kidney beans, cardamom pods, and sugar. Cover partially, and bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 30 minutes. Stir in the cream, and continue baking until warmed through, about 10 minutes.

title: Blue Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 6 teaspoons spanish sweet smoked paprika, plus 2 tablespoons ( or cayenne ) | 6 tablespoons crumbled natural blue cheese
instructions: Crush half of the smoked paprika into a bowl with the remaining paprika.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,vegetable stock,vanilla extract,yellow pea,rice vinegar,golden syrup,pork loin
title: Sweet & Savory Pork Rissoles
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin | 5 lbs boneless pork stew meat | 2 cans yellow split peas ( drained ) | 1/2 cup vegetable stock ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sugar ( or cinnamon sugar ) | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Slice pork loin & stew meat. Heat large pot of water to boiling. Add peas to it, turn heat down & simmer until peas are soft, about 5 - 10 minutes, drain. Add peas to meat & simmer about 10 minutes to heat thru. Add stock, sugar& vinegar and combine well. Simmer covered about 2 hours or until meat is very tender. The meat mixture should be very thick & rich, but if necessary add cornstarch/water mixture. Serve over hot rice.

title: Lemon Noodles With Lemon and Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice noodles | 3 lemons, zest of, finely grated
instructions: Rinse rice noodles with cold water until water runs clear. Soak the rice noodles in iced water until softened, about 15 minutes drain the noodles then place noodles on a kitchen towel and pat dry. Place a kitchen towel on top and squeeze noodles to remove excess water. Place noodles on a kitchen towel covered with more towels. Place a cutting board, sharp chef's knife and or scissors in your hands and press the garlic into the noodles until the noodle begins to firm. Drain noodles to soften. Divide noodles among serving plates. Sprinkle with zest.

Random Ingredients: chicken,orange juice,purpose flour,hot red pepper flake,cremini mushroom
title: Mushroom Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/8 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup cremini mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked chicken
instructions: In a large, resealable plastic bag, stir together the flour and red pepper flakes. Remove 1/4 cup of the zest from the orange juice. Whisk the remaining juice, orange zest, and mushrooms into the flour mixture. Add the chicken and reseal. Squeeze out excess air. Refrigerate for up to 24 hours.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,champagne,garam masala,lemon peel,hot pepper,white vinegar,yellow bell pepper,red chile
title: Spicy Chickpea Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 clove garlic, crushed | 2 cups self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons ground dried red chile | 1 1/2 cups chilled champagne | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 fresh lemon peel, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 2 1/2 cups hot peppers, finely chopped
instructions: To make dressing, place vinegar, lemon peel and chillies in a bowl. Heat oil over medium heat and add peppers. Cook, stirring for 1 minute. Add vinegar mixture and peppers and heat for 3 - 5 minutes. Cool completely. Place flour in a bowl and pour the hot water into the dry ingredients. Make a well in the center of flour and fill with the oil mixture, 1 teaspoon at a time, stirring the mixture with a fork until smooth. Drain excess water from mixture and slowly add to the flour in 4 batches. Add vinegar mixture back into the hot oil and stir well. Cook for 1 minute or until mixture thickens. Heat a large non stick frying pan and add mixture. Turn as needed to brown both sides. Drain on paper towels, arrange on a serving platter and serve topped with salad dressing or chilli.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,beef tenderloin,dill weed,tomato soup,orange juice
title: Steakhouse Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef tenderloin | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Cut the beef in 1 1/2 pieces & brown in skillet. When cooked remove from skillet & set aside. Add remaining ingredients except for beef. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Foolproof cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb cannellini beans | 1 can water chestnuts, cut finely ( optional )
instructions: Wash the beans and soak several hours or overnight in cold water, drain and rinse the beans. Combine the water chestnuts and cannellini beans in a slow cooker. Simmer on high for 2 hours, stirring every 30 minutes.

title: Miso, Mint and Watercress Salad
ingredients: 125 g monterey jack pepper cheese, cut into strips | 1 cucumber, cut into strips | 1 small water chestnut, sliced | 1 tablespoon sliced watercress | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced mint | 1 tablespoon miso | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 drop watercress, to taste | 3 -4 tablespoons toasted almonds, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except for the nuts together. Serve with toasted toasted almonds, garnished with toasted nuts.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,sherry,rice wine vinegar,flat leaf parsley,palm sugar
title: Sherry and Palm Sugar Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup sherry | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup palm sugar | 1/2 cup maraschino cherries, cut into slivers or 1/2 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, minced
instructions: For a sweet and tart salad, cover, and refrigerate 3 hours. When ready to serve, stir sherry into the vinegar. To serve, toss salad with reserved syrup, cherries and parsley, or serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: milk,rice noodle,puff pastry,liquid honey,almond extract,beef brisket,vanilla bean paste
title: Honey-Glazed Brisket
ingredients: 1 lb beef brisket, cut into 1-inch-thick slices ( i use brisket and slice it across the grain. ) | 8 ounces puff pastry, thawed ( i use 2 sheets ) | 2 cups skim milk | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 3 tablespoons almond extract ( i use almond flavoring ) | 1 package rice noodles, cooked, buttered, drained and rinsed ( i use a gluten-free variety. )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Layer the brisket slices with a thin layer of the pastry.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,tagliatelle pasta noodle,kidney bean,cola,egg white,whipping cream,sherry wine,cornmeal
title: Tagliatelle With Kidney Bean Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups cooked kidney beans | 1 package tagliatelle pasta noodles | 6 large egg whites | 2 cups cornmeal | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil with herbs ( or 1/4 cup sun dried tomatoes ) | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°. Combine the beans and pasta throughly in a bowl. In a large non stick frypan, combine the egg whites until frothy. Add the cornmeal and continue to beat at low speed until the mixture is smooth. Add the sherry and continue beating on medium speed. Continue beating for another minute on medium speed. Turn off the stove, add the cream and beat well. Put about 1/2 cup of the bean mixture on a lightly grease paper towel or cookie sheet. Dot with a spoon or two of the egg white mixture. Sprinkle the top with pine nuts. Bake until golden brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sauce,orange zest,black pepper,beef brisket,ancho chile powder,tomato ketchup,chili pepper
title: Crock Pot Spicy Beef Brisket
ingredients: 3 -3 lbs beef brisket | 1 cup hot sauce | 1/2 cup canned tomato ketchup | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons orange zest | 2 teaspoons chili peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Place brisket in a 12 inch frying pan or dutch oven. Insert metal blade, meat thermometer, and whole chiles into each slit. Combine ketchup, ketchup, hot sauce, ancho powder, orange zest, chili peppers and pepper and pour over brisket. Cover tightly and place in crock pot. Turn on warm for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Quick Garlic Wrap - Garlic Fajitas
ingredients: 1/2 cup italian hoagie bun, warmed | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 6 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Preheat grill pan. Combine hoagie bun and capers in medium bowl. Add garlic.

title: Slow Cooker Coquet Brod
ingredients: 1 large onion, sliced | 1 bunch kale, leaves only, chopped
instructions: Pour onion slices on a plate. Place kale on top. Sprinkle kale with salt. Cook on low for 10 hours.

title: Porcini Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb baby spinach | 1/4 lb mixed sprouts | 1/2 cup frozen pea pieces | 1 medium parsnip, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup frozen beet, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemonade concentrate | 3 tablespoons chili powder | chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Blanch spinach and pat dry. Add mixed sprouts, parsnips and beet. Mix well. In a small bowl, mix together lemonade concentrate, chili powder and lemonade. Add to greens, mix well and serve.

title: Egyptian Water Artichokes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, lightly crushed | 20 fresh can water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine water artichokes and coriander in a small bowl. Sprinkle mixture evenly over both pans. Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,lemongrass,cardamom seed,white bean,burdock root,almond extract,chipotle pepper,coconut milk
title: Coconut White Bean Soup (Ranjani)
ingredients: 1 piece almond extract | 1 teaspoon apple cider | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, crushed | 3 cardamom seeds | 5 cans small white beans | 1/4 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 chipotle pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon curry powder ( to taste )
instructions: Blend almond extract, apple cider, lemon grass, and cardamom seeds in blender until smooth. Pour pureed almond extract mixture in large saucepan. Add white beans and coconut milk.

Random Ingredients: white wine,pimiento,bacon,thai red curry paste,mace,chicken quarter,pie shell
title: Coco's Red Curry Chicken Pastry and Pies
ingredients: 14 slices thick sliced bacon, cut into 1/2 pieces | 4 skinless chicken drumsticks with thigh | 14 pie shells, lightly thawed | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 cup sweet unsalted pimiento | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Fry bacon pieces in nonstick skillet on medium high heat until lightly browned, approx 10 minutes. Using slotted spoon, transfer bacon to paper towels. Pour off drippings from skillet and add the chicken. Cook until lightly browned, approx 6 - 7 minutes depending on size. Remove chicken with spatula and set aside to cool. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Spray bottom of pastry shells with nonstick cooking spray. Press pie pastry shells into pan and lightly moisten with water. Line the bottom and sides with a couple of biscuit or a circle of parchment paper. Spoon about 1 tablespoon of the curry paste all the way into pastry, leaving 1/2 of pastry exposed. Stir pimentos into mixture. Spoon in 1/2 of the reduced bacon. Arrange chicken evenly over bacon, making sure that each portion has been covered in paste. Spoon 1/2 of the pimento mixture over chicken, then 1/2 of the white wine. Top with remaining paste, pimento mixture, and 1/2 of the reserved bacon bits. Spoon remaining pimento mixture on top of pie. Do not bake pie shell. Bake pie shells for 10 - 15 minutes until pastry is golden brown and cooked through and chicken is piping hot and the sauce thickened. Allow to cool 5 minutes before serving.

title: Pigs in Syrup
ingredients: 1 package phyllo dough | 1/4 pound smoked sausage, cut diagonally into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups lime sherbet, chilled
instructions: Combine sausage, and sherbet in a bowl, and let stand 20 minutes. Divide evenly between 24 miniature muffin cups. Heat in microwave for 1 minute. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before removing from muffin cups. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Brandy Dressing (No Condensed Milk)
ingredients: 1 cup low fat custard | 1 tablespoon tamari | 3/4 cup low-fat creamy prepared custard | 2 teaspoons brandy or 2 teaspoons sherry wine vinegar | lettuce leaf, salad to serve ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients except salad and store in a covered container, in the fridge. Shake and whisk until smooth before using,. Place salad on a lettuce leaf, drizzle with dressing, top with dressing and serve.

title: Roasted Eggplants (Boulabais-Eggplant)
ingredients: 1 small eggplant | 2 cups bottled roasted bread flour | egg substitute
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Coat the eggplant with a bit of olive oil or cooking spray. Bake in the oven until tender, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool slightly, then slice into 1/2 inch slices. Brush each slice with a little of the bread flour and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, about 15 minutes.

title: White Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup icing sugar | 1 cup white sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, sift together the icing sugar and the white sugar until smooth. Gradually start adding the icing, one teaspoon at a time, beating well after each addition. Drop the cookies by teaspoons onto a lightly greased cookie sheet, spacing them about 1/2 inch apart. Bake at 350 degrees f for 16 to 18 minutes. Cool slightly, and roll in the icing sugar again.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,garlic powder,cardamom seed,chunky salsa,barbecue sauce,rigatoni pasta,taco seasoning mix,parmesan cheese
title: Aka Spaghetti, Spanish Style
ingredients: 5 lbs rigatoni pasta | 1 can tomato sauce | 4 cups barbecue sauce | 3/8 cup barbecue sauce ( from an can of beef, or pork ) | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 3/8 cup chunky salsa or 3/8 cup picante salsa | 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese, shredded
instructions: Cook rigatoni in boiling water until done, about 12 minutes. Drain and set aside. In one frying pan, cook spaghetti, stirring and breaking into small bits with back of spoon, until just barely a few strands remain. In a large casserole dish, mix together tomato sauce, barbecue sauce, taco seasonings, garlic powder, cardamom and 1 cup of pasta water or as needed to cover. Add cooked rigatoni and cover dish. Cook in 300 degree oven for 20 minutes. Add all salsa and top with cheese.

Random Ingredients: white wine,mace,artichoke heart,chickpea,egg yolk,parsley,glutinous rice,pie shell
title: Chickpea and Artichoke Risotto Pie
ingredients: 1 pie shell, unbaked | 1 can canned artichoke hearts, drained | 1 1/4 cups dry white wine ( not water ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 egg yolk | 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | chickpeas, filling, warmed | 3 tablespoons glutinous-rice, soaked in warm water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line the bottom of the pie shell with a piece of parchment paper and set aside. Slice the artichokes in half horizontally, cutting away the choke, and slice across the slices into thin slices. Place the artichoke hearts into a large bowl with the wine.

title: Cheesy Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle | 1 cup taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1 head butter lettuce | 8 cups shredded carrots ( i would throw a few whole baby carrots in before serving, but they don't make enough cheese for this )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain noodles, rinse in cold water and set aside. Combine taco sauce and salt. Spread half of sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 casserole dish. Layer with half of noodles and half of lettuce. Repeat, ending with sauce and half of cheese. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake 30 - 40 minutes. Remove foil and cook uncovered another 15 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Beef Steak Kabobs At Home
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs sirloin steaks or 1 1/4 lbs top round steaks | 3/4 cup maraschino cherries | white, bbq or charcoal grill
instructions: Cut each steak lengthwise about 5 - 8 inches in width. Remove stalks and fat. Soak each steak in a plastic bag that has been sprayed with a nonstick coating of pam cooking spray for 8 hours or overnight. Trim and discard fat. Toss steak with maraschop cherries. Heat grill to medium low. Lightly oil grill grate. Grill steak about 10 minutes for medium rare or about 7 minutes for medium, or to desired doneness. If cooking for longer, use a gas grill or broiler. My note, i have been told that if i use a skirt steak like mine with the medium rare/medium rare, the result is that the med rare take the tougher cuts out of the steaks, and the rare get more tender. The marinade is very simple and we never skimp on the quality of the marinade, but it turns out very fresh and beautiful when served.

title: Best Ever Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 boneless pork roast | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon cube | 1 can fat-free half-and-half cream
instructions: Pierce roast several times with a fork, and place in crock pot on low or low heat for 8 - 10 hours. When done, remove the pork roast, and shred using 2 forks. Return the meat back to the crock pot, and add another cup of half and half or desired juice. You may add a little more fat to the sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,chili flake,cheddar cheese,taco flour tortilla,feta cheese,grand marnier,lamb
title: Lamb and Mango Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 slices ground lamb | 1/4 cup mango chutney ( we use thai kitchen brand brand ) | 1/4 cup grand marnier ( i use 1/2 tsp if you can't find grand marnier ) | 2 slices cheddar cheese | 3/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 4 4 ounces feta cheese or 4 ounces other cheese | 10 -12 soft taco-size flour tortillas
instructions: Combine chutney and grand marnier in small bowl. Set aside. Coat grill with cooking oil spray. Cook lamb, mango and chili flakes in 1/4 cup chutney mixture over medium heat until lamb is cooked through and chutney has thickened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Toss lamb with cheeses and taco sauce. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add a single tortilla and top with 1/4 cup lamb mixture. Layer top with another tortilla, pressing with back of a spoon to make a 3/4 inch thick tortilla. Top with remaining lamb mixture, drizzle top with grand marnier and serve. Note don't use a heavy knife. Instead, slice meat to make individual quesadillas. You could also slice it up and mix the filling and toppings in a bowl. The meat filling should be very hot and meat toasty and tangy when served along with the cheese and your favorite toppings. Make sure your guests sample and adjust ingredients accordingly. Also, i try my own spinache. I usually don't put the amount of cheese i use in the filling. It's my personal creation. We use 3 ounces of feta cheese and about 2 ounces of cheddar cheese. That makes this quesadilla very moist. We bake in a moderate to hot oven for 10 minutes until lightly browned and cheese is bubbly. Serve with mango chutney.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,hard egg,cream coconut,chili paste,manicotti,beef broth,grapeseed oil,polenta
title: Spiced Polenta and Sweet Corn Pudding Bake
ingredients: 1/2 cup rapeseed oil | 1 package manicotti, cooked and drained ( about 1.5-1.5 m pi ) | 2 cups reduced-sodium beef broth | 1 cup frozen sweet corn kernels, thawed | 1 can cream of coconut | 2 tablespoons sweet chili paste or 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper | 6 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1/4 cup polenta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Heat oil in 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add manicotti.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,double cream,farfalle pasta,romaine lettuce leaf,white hominy,russet potato
title: Truffle Potato and Hominy Salad
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-in. dice ( about the same as the potatoes ) | 1 can white hominy, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cup double cream | 1 romaine lettuce leaf, washed and dried | 1 cup fresh white hominy, drained and rinsed
instructions: Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat partially, cover, and simmer until tender, about 45 minutes. Drain and chill well. In a large bowl, combine the russet potatoes, hominy, and vanilla.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,biscuit,cumin seed,italian plum tomato,chicken breast,beef chuck,vanilla essence,phyllo dough
title: Beef Empanadas
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 lb lean boneless skinless chicken breast | 2 tablespoons red pepper | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes | 2 1/4 teaspoons vanilla essence | 12 sheets phyllo dough | 6 ounces small bread crumbs and 1 cup biscuit mix
instructions: Boil the beef together until it is tender, approximately 2 hours. Drain the beef and debone. Save the broth and shred using 2 forks. Remove the beef and shred. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a baking pan mix the beef, 1 teaspoon cumin and 1 1/2 pint of the reserved broth in a large mixing bowl. Mix together the chicken with red pepper and let marinate in the refrigerator while preparing the filling. Pour the reserved broth into a large saucepan along with the tomatoes. Add 2 1/4 teaspoons vanilla and bring to boil over high heat, stirring. Reduce the heat and simmer over low heat for approximately 1 hour. Combine the bread crumbs and biscuit mix in a food processor and add 1 cup of the beef mixture and mix well. Drop a spoonful of the filling in the center of each phyllo square. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Bake until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: mushroom soup,cottage cheese,green tea,thai basil,jalapeno pepper
title: Homemade Mushrooms and Green Tea
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 box green tea | 3 cans condensed 98 % fat cottage cheese, drained well | 1 container jalapeno pepper | 1 can condensed 98 % fat-free cream of mushroom soup, undiluted ( j & b light is good )
instructions: First you should be able to get a large and heavy pot ready to boil your mushrooms and green tea. After you have gotten the pot boil then drain your mushrooms and green tea. Now drain your water from the jar of mushrooms and green tea. Pour your green tea and mushrooms into the pot and allow to boil for 30 - 40 minutes or until all moisture has been extracted from the mushrooms and green tea. Add the can of condensed cream of mushroom soup to your pot and turn off your burner. Turn contents back into the pot and allow to sit 5 - 10 minutes so your sauce reduces a bit bit. Remove from stove. Allow to cool. Then start making your green tea. First, wash your mushrooms and green tea with hot water. Chop the green tea stems into 2 long pieces. Once you have your green tea straining, pour 1 cup of cold water on the bowl. You will need to repeat the steps 4 - 7 until you have strained the mixture and returned to the pot. Add the green tea and mushroom soup to your green tea straining mixture and mix well. Add your green tea mixture and mix well again. Serve at once or refrigerate up to 2 weeks. I can put the mixture in the refrigerator for a week so the flavors develop a bit.

title: Tiger Prawns With Amaretto Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 500 g tamarind tiger prawns | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon amaretto or 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees centigrade. Place the prawns in a large oven proof dish. Add mustard seeds and coat for about 20 seconds before pouring over the amaretto or sugar and tossing well to coat. Bake for about 1 hour or until just cooked through and the prawns are tender. Serve immediately with hot steamed rice and salad.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,golden syrup,chicken bouillon cube,bell pepper,green tomato,chicken broth
title: Low Fat Ricotta, Peppers & Tomatoes
ingredients: 300 g low fat chicken broth | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( or 1 packet of maggi 1/2 oz. maggi cube ) | 400 g baby bell peppers, cut into 3 | 400 g green tomatoes, halved ( cherry tomatoes or grape tomatoes ) | 400 ml skim evaporated skim milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup golden syrup ( dark brown sugar )
instructions: Place chicken in bowl, add broth and bouillon cubes or maggi. Cover and shake to dissolve the cubes. Leave to marinate at least 1 hour, overnight if possible. Add green tomato chunks, capsicum's and evaporated milk ricotta cheese, brown sugar and syrup. Stir well to combine and enjoy.

title: Arepas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 teaspoon flour tortilla | 1 ounce cremini mushroom, sliced
instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon dry spice in nonstick skillet over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,green chili,pinto bean,red onion,urad dal
title: Bhari Mashtida
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans or 2 cups kidney beans, soaked in water for 10 to 15 minutes | 1 red onion | 1 bunch green chili | 1 bell pepper | 1/2 cup urad dal, split ( small red chilis ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon green chili
instructions: Boil the beans with red onion and bell in water to cover for about 10 to 15 minutes until the beans are cooked, but not fully soft. Remove from heat, strain the beans through a strainer, and set aside to cool down. Dissolve the green chilis in a cupful of water, wash and finely chop the red onion and green chili separately. Set aside and grind the soaked red chilli, onion and green chili together in a blender. Alternatively, you can make your mashed potato masher according to package directions. Add this mixture to the cooled beans and mash thoroughly with a potato masher. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately, or allow to cool completely and make into small balls the size of a ping pong ball. Serve in small bowls and serve with bread and pickles. Note, this recipe should make at least 50 little sized balls.

title: Hot & Sour Orange Ginger Soup
ingredients: 1 red chili pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, minced | 8 cups hot broth | 2 teaspoons golden syrup | 2 oranges, juice of ( or to taste )
instructions: Saute chili and ginger in a little bit of oil in a large pan. When fragrant, add hot broth and syrup. Boil for 15 minutes. Serve hot with a few grated orange rind and a squeeze of fresh orange juice or lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: cumin,maraschino cherry,raspberry,pork belly,corn oil vegetable,french,snow pea
title: Chinese Inspired Pork
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb pork belly | 3 lbs french rolls, split diagonally | 1 lb fresh snow pea, trimmed | 2 cans raspberries | 1 tablespoon corn oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained, juice reserved
instructions: Place roast in a slow cooker. Add other ingredients and stir well. Cover and cook on low setting 8 - 10 hours or high setting 2 - 3 hours until meat falls apart. Pull meat out and shred with two forks. Place on warmed platter, cover and keep warm.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,avocado,cool whip,greek olive,scallion,cardamom,white sugar,cream corn
title: Quick Italian Pasta Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces angel hair pasta, cooked | 8 ounces frozen cream-style corn, thawed | 1 medium avocado, chopped | 1/2 cup diced scallion | 4 ounces white sugar | 2 tablespoons sliced greek olives | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 4 cups cool whip, thawed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pasta, corn, avocado, scallions, sugar, olives and cardamom. Toss with cool whip.

Random Ingredients: banana,orange juice zest,beef tenderloin,dill,french bean,barbeque sauce,rhubarb,beer
title: Beef Tenderloin Medallions With Crock Pot Barbeque Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces beer | 1 lb trimmed beef tenderloin | 1 tablespoon orange juice, finely grated | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh dill | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 cup french beans, 1/2-inch diagonally sliced | 1 cup diced banana | 1/2 cup diced rhubarb
instructions: Rinse beef and pat dry.

title: Black Pepper Peppercorn Cream
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 pinch dried oregano | 1 teaspoon ground black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon ground dried szechuan peppercorns
instructions: Combine the cream, oregano, black peppercorns, and szechuan peppercorns.

title: Stuffed Sausages
ingredients: 8 large mild sausages | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 cup cooked chopped sausage | 1 piece halloumi cheese, cut into 16 long, thin slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Make a slit on each end of the sausage, and stuff with plenty of stuffing. Tie the ends of the slices of cheese together with kitchen string. Place them on a lightly greased baking sheet. Mix the cinnamon and sausage together, and cover with foil. Bake for 25 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve hot, or cold as an appetizer.

title: Spanish Onions
ingredients: 8 cups spanish onions, unpeeled, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons whole white peppercorns | 1 1/2 quarts water | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Place onions in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle with peppercorns. Pour water over onions. Cover tightly, and marinate in refrigerator at least 4 hours and up to 3 days. Drain and discard marinade.

Random Ingredients: cool whip,mandarin orange,green chili pepper,pork loin chop,lamb
title: Mexican Pork and Stamp Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crushed mandarin oranges | 1/4 cup green chili pepper, chopped | 2 lbs boneless pork loin chops, cut 2 x 1-inch strips | 2 packages plain plain cool whip, thawed | 1 cup cool whip, thawed | 12 hamburger roll outs ( optional )
instructions: Combine oranges, chile pepper and pork in large bowl. Chill well. Remove pork mixture from bowl. Reserve 1/2 cup of orange mixture. Using hands or scissors, snip away any remaining fat from pork. Stir orange mixture into pork mixture. Cover and chill overnight or up to 1 month. Remove pork mixture from plastic.

title: Chilled Pinto Beans for Two
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can diced tomatoes, undrained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 1/2 tablespoons active dry yeast
instructions: Place the drained pinto beans in a large pot and cover with enough water to cover. Let soak overnight. Drain, reserving 1 1/2 cups of the reserved bean water. Place drained beans and reserved 2 cups of the reserved bean water into a blender, cover, and blend until smooth. Transfer to a small saucepan, cover, and set aside. Place the diced tomatoes and 1 cup reserved bean water into a saucepan with the basil and minced ginger root. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer the sauce, stirring occasionally, until thick, about 1 minute. Stir in yeast, and remove from the heat. Allow to cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes. Pour the bean bean mixture through a fine mesh strainer into a large mixing bowl. Add the bean puree and blend with a potato masher or hands until well combined. Cover, and refrigerate until the flavors are melded, at least 1 hour. Pour the chilled tomato sauce into an 8 inch square baking dish. Arrange the baked pinto beans in rows on the sauce, cover with the remaining tomato sauce, and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. This will help prevent the beans from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Cover the dish with a lid, place a baking sheet in the center of the oven, and broil until the top is golden brown, about 10 minutes. Place the baking sheet on a cooler part of the oven, and allow to cool. Once cool, slice into squares.

title: Nif's Almond Chicken (Peshka)
ingredients: 1 slice blanched almond | 1 chicken, cut into 8 pieces | 5 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 package dry dry fried buurdock root
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring just enough water to cover the almond to a boil. Dip each piece of chicken in boiling water for about 3 minutes. Sprinkle with bouillon granules and set aside for 15 minutes. Drain fried buurdock root, and pat dry with paper towels. Arrange in a steamer over a clean pot of boiling water, and cover.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,brandy,baking soda,whipping cream milk,pickling salt,penne pasta
title: Ricardo's Famous Beef in Cream
ingredients: 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1/2 cup whipping cream ( whole milk ) | 1/2 tablespoon coarse pickling salt | 1 whole roast beef | 1 package dry penne pasta | 1 pint beef stock, made with a bouquet garni | 1 pint whipping cream, whipped
instructions: Bring a small potful of salted water to a boil. In a small pan place baking soda and 1/2 cup of whipping cream. Let cream cook over high heat until it begins to boil. Pour cream into a plastic tub and add baking soda, whipping cream. Cover and turn on the heat. Do not boil. Cook for 90 minutes. Set aside. Trim beef and cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Place in a large pot and add wine, beef broth, chopped pickling salt. Cover and simmer. Cook the pasta according to package instructions. Drain the pasta and add to the beef mixture. Turn onto a serving platter and garnish with whipped cream.

title: Chinese Cabbage with Tomatoes (Gui Tzu)
ingredients: 2 lbs chinese cabbage | 2 lbs tomatoes ( peeled seeded, and quartered ) | 6 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 orange twists ( garnish )
instructions: Simmer the tomatoes for 30 minutes, then place the tomatoes and the cabbage in a bowl. Cover with cold water and leave for 2 hours, or until cooked but not mushy. Drain, wash away excess water and slice the tomatoes into slanted pieces. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a medium size deep frying pan. Stir fry the tomatoes for a couple of minutes until softened, and remove them from the pan. Heat the remaining oil, add the cabbage, and stir fry for 5 minutes, until it is lightly browned on the edges. Tip in the tomato puree and fry for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with the orange rind and serve hot, chilled. Variation, when added the tomatoes at the end of the sauce after adding the tomatoes, reduce the tomatoes by half. Variation, add 1 lb of chopped ham, or a little of the diced ham. If you wish a stir fry instead of ham, add 1/3 lb of ground ham. Variation, add the cabbage a few minutes before you are happy with the addition of the tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,butter,chicken strip,hazelnut,green pepper,peanut oil,dark brown sugar
title: Chinese Style Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 1 lb chicken strips | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/2 green pepper, chopped | 1/2 yellow pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts
instructions: Rinse and dry chicken strips. Place the butter, brown sugar, peanut oil, and chopped vegetables into a large saucepan and simmer together for 10 minutes. Add the chicken strips and heat through. Do not boil. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,splenda sugar substitute,oregano leaf,egg noodle,brussels sprout,cannellini bean,cooking sherry,tamari
title: Zucchini & Bean Cakes With Pasta Filling
ingredients: 225 g small zucchini | 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 350 g brussels sprouts, halved lengthways | 125 g egg noodles, cooked | 4 tablespoons cooking sherry, warmed | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves, dried | 1/4 cup cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | tamari or soy sauce, extra
instructions: Cook the zucchini for 3 - 5 minutes until tender. Place the zucchini, sprouts, noodles and sherry in a large mixing bowl. Add the oregano leaves, bean and tamari. Taste, season and add extra tamari and soy or tamari if desired. Add seasoning then mix well until the vegetables are covered with the sauce. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Danish Spiced Beer
ingredients: 12 ounces dark beer | 6 ounces mandarin oranges, in syrup with | cloves, if desired
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a glass with ice. Stir. Garnish with a whole clove.

title: French Peaches With Tamarind Sherbet
ingredients: 8 ounces peach schnapps | 4 ounces swiss cheese | 3 tablespoons tamarind paste
instructions: Open can of peaches and unpeeled and cut into 2 - 4 oz portions, discard pits. Combine all ingredients and pour into a tall glass. Serve with ice.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,garlic,pico de gallo,tarragon leaf
title: Pico de Gallo- Flour Tortilla Filler
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast | 1 can pico de gallo | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon leaves, minced ( about 1/2 teaspoon ) | garlic, minced ( garlic powder is good substitue with a bit of onion powder )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Using a sharp knife, cut the roast into 1 inch slices. Insert a few strands of herb mixture into each piece of roast. Place tortillas onto 2 baking sheets. Bake on middle rack of oven 30 to 45 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool slightly before serving.

title: Cousin Pete's Blueberry, Crab and Mussel Stuffed Prouts
ingredients: 1 lb crabmeat, shell or 1 lb lobster, shell removed ( i use sea bass ) | 1 lb fresh mussels, cleaned | 1 1/2 cups baby new baby bleached pine nuts | 1 package quick-cooking pasta noodles, any style ( i use old english ) | 1/2 cup bread, crumbs ( seasoned with salt and pepper ) | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries, sliced ( you can also use frozen chopped berries as well )
instructions: Prepare all shells according to package directions. Drain and discard last shells of fish. Set aside. Cook the pasta of your choice, but you can also bowtie if you prefer. Preheat broiler. Mix crabmeat, mussels, pine nuts, and pasta in a large bowl. Sprinkle bread crumbs, garam masala, and salt and pepper over mixture until it is just slightly moistened. Spoon 1/5 of pasta mixture into each shell. Arrange shells upright on a greased, foil lined baking sheet. Spoon 1/2 cup blueberries over the top of each stuffed prout, spacing them slightly apart. Broil in a 425°f oven for 12 - 15 minutes, until golden brown. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,bicarbonate soda,plain flour,vanilla,marshmallow,poblano chile,marzipan,hot chili sauce
title: Poblano Mushrooms and Marshmallow Muffins - Vegan
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 500 g fresh mushrooms | plain flour | marshmallows | marzipan | hot chili sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Slice mushrooms and poblano chiles thinly. Lightly toss the sliced mushrooms and poblanos around the hole and remove skins. Place the mushrooms in a non stick frying pan. Melt a couple of tablespoons of plain flour in another frying pan and add a couple of tablespoons of hot water. Mix well and add flour and water/water until desired consistency. Mix. Add the mix to the mushroom caps and poblanos, stirring to coat. Place in the oven and bake 5 - 10 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika and decorate with mazerella and/or marshmallows. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,pearl barley,cherry tomato,tomato juice,plain yogurt,mozzarella cheese
title: Moorish Barley Salad
ingredients: 3 cups frozen pearl barley | 1 1/2 cups grated mozzarella cheese | 10 cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger root | 1/3 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Place barley in a large bowl and cover with several inches of hot water.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,chambord raspberry liquor,rice wine vinegar,heavy whipping cream,cremini mushroom,carrot,shrimp
title: Wild Rice Neptune
ingredients: 36 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup light cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup sweet rice wine vinegar | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/8 cup chambord raspberry liquor ( optional ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In 1 cup measure, stir cream of chicken soup into water to soften, and set aside. Place mushrooms, soup, chambord and heavy cream into large crock pot and stir. Add shrimp and gently stir to mix. Heat on high for 3 hours, stirring occasionally. Stir in rice wine vinegar and set aside for 15 minutes. Serve over spaghetti or angel hair pasta.

Random Ingredients: potato,chipotle chile,white potato,cocoa powder,tuna vegetable oil,heavy whipping cream,cumin powder,olive oil
title: Patacones Enchiladas (Patacones W- Spicy Baked Chips)
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 2 lbs white potatoes, unpeeled | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chiles | 1 can tuna in vegetable oil, drained of any oil | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup canola oil
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Dice potatoes into 1/2 inch chunks. Peel the unpeeled potatoes leaving the skin on and roughly dice. In large bowl toss the potato cubes with the remaining ingredients. In a 9x13 baking dish, place a small patty on top of each patty. Use 1/2 cup of heavy whipping cream. Place in oven, bake 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Marinated Radish and Orange Pepper Relish Salad
ingredients: 4 lbs radishes, washed, ends trimmed and root end trimmed | 3 oranges, bell peppers or 3 green bell peppers, cleaned and quartered | 1/2 cup sugar | 1 1/2 cups mineral water | 3/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 6 -8 peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Toss all the ingredients in mixing bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 3 to 6 days..

title: Caramelized Arepas (Grilled Arepas)
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 4 tablespoons amaretto | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Mix ingredients in a bowl. Add a little water if necessary. You should have a good mixture that is very pliable.

title: Fettuccine Filling for a King Paper
ingredients: 5 slices bacon | 3 -4 lbs pork roast | 2 bunches fettuccine pasta | 1/3 cup tabasco sauce | filling
instructions: In a skillet cook sliced bacon until browned. Remove bacon and set aside. Place pork roast in a crock pot on the high setting and add tabasco sauce. Cook on high setting for 3 hours, or low setting for 10 to 12 hours. Remove the roast from the crock pot, shred and set aside. Strain liquid into a saucepan and set aside. Cook the fettuccine according to the package directions. Once the meat is cool enough to handle, cut it into about 1 chunks, removing most of the fat. In a separate frying pan, over a medium high heat cook the cubed meat until no longer pink and starts to render some fat on top. While waiting for it to boil, remove bacon from the skillet using slotted spoon, leaving the bacon fat in the skillet. Serve with the warm pasta. Sprinkle with cheese and/or bacon bits before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,sun tomato oil,chicken broth,bay leaf,italian salad dressing,pork roast,corn oil,pineapple
title: Italian Pork With Pineapple (Pork Daube a la Espanola)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork loin | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 2 tablespoons pineapple, flakes | 1 bay leaf | 1 package italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1/4 cup chicken broth
instructions: In medium size pot bring the chicken broth to a boil, and add sun dried tomatoes. Bring back to boil and reduce heat to low. Cut pork into 1/2 inch cubes. Add pork and all seasonings. Cover and simmer, turning occasionally, for at least 2 hours. Add the pineapple and stir to coat. Continue cooking for at least 20 minutes longer, until the meat is tender. Remove pork to a serving platter and keep warm. Pour off all the liquid remaining in the pot, but return liquid to a boil. This may take 1 and 1/2 hours if you stick a wooden spoon under the meat, to thicken the sauce. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Rigatoni and Brown Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 9 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked, drained | 4 ounces salami, chopped | 2 ounces soft brown rice | 4 drops hot sauce
instructions: Lightly grease a frypan with oil. Add the sausage. Cook until it has changed colour, then crumble over the pasta and salami. Stir in the rice and hot sauce. Serves.

title: Jalapeno Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 can sliced jalapenos, drained | 1 cup italian seasoned bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the cream cheese and jalapenos in a bowl. Stir in the bread crumbs until well blended. Shape the mixture into 3/4 inch balls. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,pistachio,broth,tomato vegetable juice cocktail,red onion
title: Pistachio Vinaigrette (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1/2 cup pistachios or 1/2 cup almonds | 1/2 cup dried red onion, minced | 2 tablespoons vegetable juice cocktail | 2 tablespoons lemon peel, grated | 3/4 - 1 cup canned diced tomato with vegetable juice cocktail
instructions: Combine pistachios and red onion in small bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients until well combined.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,dill,red pepper flake,raspberry,cooking oil,chicken breast

title: Chef John's Italian Pork Patties

instructions: Place the ground pork in a bowl, and mash it with a fork into crumbs with any remaining meat mixture, crumbling it as it cooks.
