instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and spray 8 cup casserole with non stick cooking spray. In a large bowl stir together the vegetarian baked beans, frozen corn, sliced ancho peppers, vegetable shortening and chopped spring onions. Sprinkle on 1 tsp crushed ancho powder.

title: Beef Steak With Sweet Potatoes and Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck | 3 tablespoons oil | 2/3 cup dry white sugar | 4 medium sweet potatoes, peeled, halved lengthwise and sliced about 1/4 inch thick | 5 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees. Pat the steak dry. In a 12 inch skillet, heat the oil over med high heat. Sprinkle the steak with salt and pepper and brown on both sides, about 4 minutes an side. Remove from the skillet. Cut the steak into 1 1/2 inch slices. Sprinkle each slice with sugar. In the same skillet, cook the potatoes, stirring occasionally, until evenly browned and tender but still tender and beginning to caramelize, about 30 seconds. Remove to a platter. Pour off most of skillet drippings except 2 tbsp. Add the cream and cook just until the cream has reduced slightly. Dip the hot steak into the warm cream and arrange around the inside of a deep 2 quart ovenproof baking dish. Pour caramelized onions over them. Place the baking dish in the oven and bake until the onions are bubbling around the edges of the dish, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cuban Salpicon
ingredients: 2 cans water chestnuts, drained | 1 package imitation crabmeat, chopped | 12 tablespoons guacamole | 1/3 cup crushed dry mexican oregano | 1/2 cup chopped dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Place water chestnuts, imitation crabmeat, guacamole, oregano in a bowl. Mix well and spread onto a baking sheet. Roast in a 350 degree f oven for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with peanuts.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,basil leaf,pasta,kosher salt,pearl barley,orange peel,yellow pepper,white pepper
title: Pasta With Orange Marmalade and Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 small yellow pepper | 1 1/2 lbs chicken meat, cut into bite-size pieces | 1/2 orange peel | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped or 1/4 cup fresh parsley | kosher salt | white pepper | 1 lb pasta
instructions: Bring 6 cups salted water to a boil in a 2 quart heavy saucepan. Add in the barley and chopped yellow pepper and cook until the pepper has softened, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat. Rinse the rice gently under cold water. Drain in a strainer and place in a bowl of ice water for about 10 minutes. Drain, cool and chop coarsely. Meanwhile, cut into 1/4 inch pieces the orange peel. Put the chicken pieces in a 12 inch skillet. Add 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon white pepper on the chicken, then drizzle with 1/4 cup orange marmalade. Cover and cook over medium low heat, stirring occasionally and mashing the chicken in the skillet with a fork, until no longer pink and the chicken is lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Take the chicken off the skillet, add the pasta and basil and toss to coat with the marmalade. Cook until the pasta is al dente, about 2 minutes. Spoon the pasta onto a warm platter. Toss the chicken in the sauce and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oil,yeast,kosher salt,wheat flour,parsnip,beef broth,chicken stock cube
title: Kosher Jewish  Whole Wheat  Parsnip  Rye Bread
ingredients: 16 ounces whole wheat flour, 1 liter ( about a cup, or use a 1lb of bread flour, 1/2 to 1 cup plus ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 1/4 ounces yeast, 200 grams ( or use a 1gram container ) | 1 tablespoon oil | 8 ounces beef broth or 8 ounces vegetarian broth ( optional ) | 3 ounces chicken stock cube ( optional ) | 1 small parsnip, peeled and roughly chopped ( i had no problem with a vegetarian bouillon ) ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh parsley, finely chopped
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, sift the flour with the salt and add the yeast, oil and enough broth to make a firm dough. Knead for 2 - 3 minutes until smooth and elastic, adding more broth as necessary. If you have a mixer, do the mixing, mix it until the dough is very well convinced you have a cohesive dough with no rough or sticky residue. Place dough in a large greased bowl covered with baking paper, and leave to rise in a warm place for 1 hour.. The dough will be quite wet. At first this should take about an hour, but eventually an hour and a half will do. Meanwhile, make your filling. If you are making a beef, pork, or veggie stir fry, preheat the oven to 375°f. Get as much or as little oil into the pot you're going to cook your bread. If you're using broth, add it to the pot for the broth, then add whatever meat you're using. Add the stock cube and the parsley, and if you want the kosher broth to be really salty, add it now too. Mix until it comes to a boil. If you're using meat, don't add it yet. But if it doesn't, dump out a few tbs of fat and whisk it vigorously in to a small bowl so there are no lumps, then you're on the right track. If you don't have this, leave it out. Add the rest of the broth/broth to the risen dough. Knead very briefly to form a stiff, elastic dough. Dip your finger into water halfway you've had the dough, then it should feel quite tacky. It's easier to do once it's fairly smooth. Place on to a lightly floured surface, cover with oiled plastic wrap, and allow to rise in a warm place for 1 hour or so. This may take as long as a half an hour.. Make sure the dough is slightly too crumbly and you don't want your dough to rise too much. Punch the dough down, divide in half, and place each half in to a greased or parchment lined or greased baking tray. Gently press out the air bubbles that form. Score a cross on top of the dough to allow a steam escape during baking. Bake for 30 minutes, then turn the oven down to 350 and continue baking for 25 - 40 minutes for a crisp crust, and about 25 - 40 minutes for a darker crust. It depends on the oven, you may need to cover the bread with foil to keep it warm. Allow breads to cool at room temperature for 10 minutes before eating or storing them in your freezer for several days before eating.

title: Salt-free Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 3/4 teaspoons salt substitute, for seasoning ( we like penzey's or similar flavour ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Heat 1 1/2 tbsp curry powder & 1 tsp turmeric in small pot on medium heat.

title: Camembert Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 -8 large grape tomatoes | 3/4 lb camembert cheese
instructions: Quarter a cheese slice and arrange tomatoes on it. Put the rest of the cheese on top of the tomatoes. Heat under grill until cheese is completely browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,barley,ginger garlic paste,asparagus spear,flat leaf parsley
title: Asparagus and Barley Side Dish (Indian Style)
ingredients: 2 cups fresh asparagus spears, ends trimmed | 1 1/2 cups barley ( or wheat ) | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add asparagus and barley and cook according to the manufacturer's instructions, about 5 minutes. Drain asparagus and barley and return to pot. Add orange juice and ginger garlic paste and combine. Cover and continue cooking for about 8 minutes. Toss asparagus to coat well. Top with chopped parsley and serve.

title: Diced Moroccan Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried minced chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons harissa
instructions: Fry chili pepper flakes in oil until the aroma of the flakes is released. Add harissa. Continue to fry until liquid begins to run.

title: Veggies in the Pesto
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh mushroom stems | 1/4 cup fresh low-fat cottage cheese | 1/3 cup tahini | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract ( optional ) or 1/8 teaspoon almond essence ( optional )
instructions: Combine the pesto ingredients in small saucepan. Cook over medium heat for about 3 - 5 minutes, or until hot. Serve warm over toasted pita crisps, or use immediately to dip veggies.

title: Sushi Bowl
ingredients: 6 cups prepared sushi rice | 1/3 cup sliced poblano pepper | 1/3 cup chopped broccoli ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups diced cooked asparagus
instructions: Prepare sushi rice according to package directions. Place poblano pepper on a paper towel lined plate and pound with a meat mallet until finely chopped. Prepare broccoli according to package directions. While the sushi rice cooks, spread poblano pepper on a cutting board and flatten, removing seeds, as needed. Rolled peppers should be about 1/4 inch thick. In a 9x13 inch casserole dish, arrange asparagus on the rice, along with the broccoli and poblano pepper. Pour sushi rice over top, spreading evenly. Top rice with poblano pepper slices and bake in a preheated oven until poblano pepper is crisp and rice is browned, about 1 hour.

title: Baharat Aka Garam Masala
ingredients: 2 lbs raisins | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Put raisins into a plastic bag. Pour 75 to 100 pints boiling water over the raisins and let sit for 20 minutes or until the water is absorbed. Drain the water, and add cardamom and mix thoroughly. Take the bag off the raisins. Dry the raisins on a towel and coat with the masala. Store the bag in the fridge. Note, a note on spices, i often find these make a subtle, subtle taste that mellow after being allowed to mature for up to 2 weeks.

title: Homemade Sausages (Gramma Brown)
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs sausages, sliced into thick slices | 4 slices bread, crusts removed ( crusty or firm )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400&deg.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard,fontina cheese,lemon juice,icing sugar,loaf ciabatta,bay leaf,beef,ginger
title: Sweet Mustard Glazed Beef
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon icing sugar | 1/8 teaspoon yellow mustard | 1/8 teaspoon bay leaf | 2 tablespoons minced fontina cheese | 1 loaf ciabatta, large, cut in 1/4 inch slices
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the beef, lemon juice, ginger, icing sugar, mustard, bay leaf and cheese.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,salad leaf,cream cheese,rice vinegar,coconut milk,pine nut,gelatin,salsa
title: Pine Nut and Swirly Mac & Cheese Salad!
ingredients: 1 ounce unflavored gelatin, powder ( use 1 tbsp ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar ( use 1/2 tsp. ) | 1 1/4 cups light coconut milk | 3/4 cup farfalle pasta, cooked ( or other small macaroni, shell, or small bowtie ) | 1 tablespoon toasted pine nuts ( or cashews or walnuts ) | 3 ounces fat free cream cheese ( room temperature ) | 4 ounces salsa | salad leaves, such as cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: Prepare the gelatin according to package directions, adding the vinegar. Mix in the coconut milk. Stir in the cooked pasta, then gently fold in the cashews and pine nuts. Top with the cream cheese and salsa and scatter with cilantro.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,ricotta cheese,eggplant,red cabbage,white wine vinegar,cooking spray,green,black pepper
title: Smoked Hazelnut and Lengua (Lengua) Salad
ingredients: 6 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 4 ounces fat free ricotta cheese | 1 eggplant, cut into slices | 2 green, long ( diagonally about 1-inch diameter ) | cooking spray | 3 cups sliced red cabbage | 4 green, red, and yellow leaves separated | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper, to taste | 1/4 cup fresh hazelnuts, finely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together vinegar and the ricotta, set aside. Cut eggplant slices in half lengthwise, then crosswise into thin slices lengthwise. Scatter slices over a medium bowl with 2 tablespoons of the olive oil. Cover with a plate and weight with another plate. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Lightly spray with cooking spray. Cook eggplant and peppers in the skillet just until tender, but not overcooked, about 2 minutes per side. Set aside to cool slightly. Cut a lengthwise slit about 1/2 inch deep into each radish. Set aside. Arrange the green and red cabbage leafs on 4 small serving plates. Cut the cabbage leaves into thin strips. Serve the stuffed cabbage leafs along with the grilled eggplant and pepper dressing. Drizzle with remaining olives.

title: Grilled Ara Hass Avocado With Salt and Pepper
ingredients: 1 ripe hass avocado | salt and pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place ripe avocado on the grill and grill for about 5 minutes on each side until cooked but not slimy. Let avocado cool a bit, peel and put into a serving bowl, season with salt and pepper if desired. Serve with salsa.

title: Mexican Queso Fresco
ingredients: 2 red apples, cored and sliced thin | 1/4 cup crumbled queso fresco
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange apple slices on foil. Sprinkle queso fresco evenly over the apple. Place baking sheet on top of the oven. Bake in preheated oven until cheese is melted and bubbly, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Blackened Halibut With Fresh Blackberries
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast | 1 teaspoon cracked blackberry | 2 cups chopped fresh blackberries | 1 tablespoon minced fresh cilantro | 1 can beef stock | 2 slices oranges, cut in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. Rub salt into roasting pan.

title: Taco Seasoning (Lebanese)
ingredients: 2 serrano chili | 1 tablespoon dried thyme, crumbled
instructions: Heat the chili over high heat. The chilli should be slightly blackened. Once the chili stops popping, remove the chili from the heat. Immediately sprinkle with the thyme. Cool for 1 hour before consuming.

title: BBQ Pears With Pecans and Swiss
ingredients: 12 slices rye bread | 1 ripe pear ( or other sweet pear ) | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | freshly crushed walnuts, to serve | ice ( optional )
instructions: Heat barbecue on medium high, place the bread slices on a foil lined baking sheet and toast lightly if you like. Cut the pear into four wedges. Place on toasted bread, drizzle with sweet chilli sauce, sprinkle with finely chopped walnuts and cut a few slits in the slice.

title: Mexican Cowboy Caviar
ingredients: 14 ounces black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 2 ounces silver tequila | 1 pinch tabasco sauce | 1 small parsnip, peeled and chopped
instructions: Place the rinsed and drained black eyed peas into a microwave safe bowl.

title: French Coconut Strudel
ingredients: 1 can sweetened sliced white coconut, thoroughly drained | 1 cup french dressing | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 9x12 inch baking dish with plastic wrap. Place coconut and French dressing in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on medium high, stirring every minute, until heated through, approximately 15 seconds. Lay two phyllo sheets on work surface, open and lay one sheet on top of the other. Spread 1/3 of the coconut mixture evenly over the phyllo sheets. Spoon 1/2 peanut butter evenly over the phyllo sheets.

title: Lentil and Pear Pasta
ingredients: 1 package corkscrew macaroni | 1 package dried lentils | 1 cup prepared horseradish | 1 cup dry spaghetti | 1 large anjou pear ( optional )
instructions: In a pot of lightly salted water, lightly cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine the corkscrew macaroni, lentils and horseradish in a large bowl to blend. Add the pasta and the Anjou pear, if using. Cook and stir until sauce is well blended.

Random Ingredients: string bean,chicken leg,basil,cotija cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,pecan,bread flour
title: Mama's Chicken Picnic Loaf
ingredients: 2 chicken legs, skinless or 1 large whole chicken leg, bone in | 2 lbs fresh string beans, trimmed | 8 ounces cotija cheese | 12 ounces flat bread flour ( or 1 cup bread crumbs ) | 1 cup pecans, toasted, and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup basil, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, cut into 3/4-inch chunks | 1/2 lb pecan pieces or 1/2 lb walnut pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Put the legs in a 9x5x3 inch loaf pan and sprinkle the legs with salt. Mix it around so the legs are all covered. Bake them whole for 45 minutes. Remove the legs from the pan and cool on a wire rack. When cool, remove the skin and bones, removing any visible fat. Set aside the meat and vegetables. Set a small pan of water to boil over high heat. Add the beans and cook until tender, about 7 minutes. Drain and cool. Take out the bones, leaving them all there. Using a food processor or vingegar, puree the beans and liquid in the pan, until smooth. If you have a hand held immersion blender, whir in the cheese chunks and basil and process them to your desired consistency. Put the mix into a bowl, cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Mix or pulse the bread crumbs and pecans together. Remove the chicken from the loaf pan or tray and spread a few pans over the top. Dip each chicken leg in the bread mix and then put in another loaf pan, so the bread mix is in the pans. The bread crumbs spread over the top, but not to the edges, of the bread. Cook the chicken until the breadcrumbs turn light tan on the top, about 10 to 12 minutes. Remove the bread crumbs and nuts, put them on a platter and top with the shredded cheese. Serve with a tossed green vegetable salad and a glass of chilled white wine.

title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 3 cups broth ( beef, chicken, vegetable, pork, or other short cut of you choice ) | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 2 -3 tablespoons vodka ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork roast, cut into 1-inch pieces ( or boneless chuck steak ) | romaine lettuce ( washed and torn into leaves ) | 2 -3 serrano chili ( whole or chopped, remove seeds and ribs )
instructions: Combine broth, zest, and vodka, if using, in slow cooker. Add meat and coat with liquid. Cover and cook on low setting 5 to 6 hours.

title: Roasted Greens
ingredients: 2 bunches kale, trimmed | 2 tablespoons catsup, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon catsup, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place kale in a roasting pan. Roast in the preheated oven until tender and bright green, about 30 minutes. Transfer kale to a bowl, and stir 2 tablespoons catsup into the kale until coated.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,golden raisin,white button mushroom,tarragon,sesame seed
title: Mushroom Beef
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless beef chuck, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 5 white button mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 3 drops hot pepper or 3 dashes dried tarragon, crumbled
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set over medium high heat. Add half of the beef.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,icing sugar,mascarpone cheese,ladyfinger,prosciutto,liquid stevia,button mushroom,chive
title: Faux-Muffins
ingredients: 14 ounces mascarpone cheese | 1 1/2 ounces finely chopped prosciutto | 8 button mushrooms, finely sliced and sautéed | fresh chives ( to garnish ) | 1/4 lb button mushroom, finely sliced | 7 ounces ladyfingers, sliced ( ladyfinger biscuits size ) | 2 tablespoons liquid stevia | 1 1/4 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, thinly sliced, and cut into 20 slices ( preferably using red skin ) | icing sugar, to dust, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine cheese, proscuitto, prosciutto, and mushroom slices in a bowl. Spoon a quarter of the cheese mixture into each russet potato cavity. Spoon half of the sliced mushrooms over cheese. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients. Season the russets with fleur de sel. Sprinkle with sifted icing sugar and transfer to a baking sheet. Bake until browned and hot, about 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Canned Banana Smoothie
ingredients: 2 bananas, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce
instructions: Place the banana slices in the pan of a food processor. Using the pesto, gradually stir in a little oil until smooth. Scrape the bottom of the food processor bowl to remove any bits of banana. Pour into a clean liquid measuring jug and fill halfway up the food processor bowl with water. Swirl until the water starts to form in a thin film, then pour this mixture back into the food processor bowl. Swirl for 1 minute, then pour this back into the food processor bowl with the bananas. Blend until smooth. Pour into clean liquid storage container. Store in the refrigerator until the bananas are to your liking. You may use this recipe in place of pesto, but it's delicious straight from the blender.

title: Lamb and Walnut Risotto
ingredients: 50 g uncooked barberries or 5 ounces arborio rice | 400 500 g ground lamb or 450 g ground lamb | 50 g walnuts ( or hazelnuts or pecans ) | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns | 2 teaspoons salt & pepper | 1 bunch fresh coriander
instructions: Soak barberries in warm water for 20 mins. Rinse them, bring back to the boil and add the ground lamb or lamb. Drain well and add the herbs. Season generously with salt and pepper and knead well, drawing in some water if needed. Shape into small balls, roll in flour to coat, then set aside. Cook rice according to the packet directions. Drain and rinse the barberries under the tap and add to meat mixture, stir well. Add the barberries and stir again. To serve, divide the risotto between four warmed individual serving plates. Top with a little chopped coriander. Serve immediately.

title: Baby Bok Choy Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb baby bok choy, washed and very finely chopped | 1 3/4 cups chicken stock or 1 3/4 cups broth
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the bok choy, stock or broth and finely chopped bok choy. Increase heat to medium high, bring soup to a boil, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Transfer to a food processor or blender and puree until smooth.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,fish sauce,spinach,orange juice concentrate,rice wine vinegar,ice cube,tomato green chilies
title: Soup Palapa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 2 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 teaspoons cayenne | ice cube | 2 ounces frozen chopped spinach
instructions: In a small pot over medium heat, whisk together the rice vinegar, orange juice concentrate, tomatoes with green chilies, fish sauce, cayenne and ice cubes. Bring to a boil, and stir to blend. Transfer the soup and any liquid to a blender, and blend until smooth. Return soup to the pan, stir in the spinach, and serve.

Random Ingredients: white cheddar cheese,white fish,flat leaf parsley,baking potato,cocoa powder,lime wedge,tzatziki
title: White Fish Fondue for 2
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 lbs firm white fish, such as halibut, red snapper, haddock or 2 lbs sole, cut into 5 3- to 6 wedges | 2 large baking potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 12 medium taco-size taco-size tzatziki | 1 1 bunch flat leaf parsley, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup fresh lime wedge, cut into thin matchstick-size wedges | white cheddar cheese or mexican blend cheese, grated, garnish
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Lightly oil a nonstick heavy bottomed baking sheet. Combine the cocoa powder and 3 cups water in a small bowl. Mix with a whisk to blend until the salt and cocoa powder dissolve. Lightly oil a nonstick skillet, then add the fish and 1/2 cup water. Cook the fish until fish turns golden brown, about 3 minutes, then transfer to a plate. Return your skillet to medium heat, then add the potatoes, taco meat and 2/3 cup water. Stir fry the vegetables until the tortilla chips begin to soften, about 3 to 5 minutes, then transfer to the plate. Toss the fish with the cocoa mixture, then sprinkle over the parsley. Serve with warm tortilla chips.

title: Beef and Mango Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1/2 cup mango, finely chopped | 1/4 cup lettuce leaf, torn | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon mirin ( or substitute with 1 tablespoon rum or half-grain bicarbonate of soda and 1 tb sugar )
instructions: Divide the ground beef into 24 serving sized portions, each with equal portions of mangos and lettuce, then roll into a log that is at least 12 inches long and 5 inches wide. Place on a flat surface and flatten slightly with your palm. Place roll in a non stick pan, and cook over medium high heat, turning so both side are cooked through. Remove roll from pan to a board and cut rolls into 4 pieces, and wrap in plastic wrap, placing back on pan. Repeat process with remaining portions of meat and lettuce. Whisk together vanilla and mirin and spoon over wraps, if desired.

title: Chicken Naan (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 7)
ingredients: 1 egg roll wrap | 1 small chicken breast | 1/2 cup skim milk | 1 small orange | 1/4 teaspoon dried orange rind
instructions: To wrap chicken, place between plastic wrap and pound until about 3/8 inch thickness. Cut into 1/4 inch thick slices. Lay on end of plastic wrap and flatten with a rolling pin. Cut into 5 strips. Place 2cm apart on lightly greased baking sheet.. Brush with egg wash.

title: Balsamic-Glazed Dates
ingredients: 20 large pitted dates | 1 teaspoon margarine | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh chili pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 4 teaspoons plain dried breadcrumbs | 2 medium yellow split peas | 6 radishes, sliced | 2 teaspoons dried currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Remove pits from dates, if desired. Place dates in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet, then brush with margarine. Sprinkle with chili and drizzle with balsamic vinegar. Bake in the preheated oven until skins are tender, about 20 minutes. Place peas in a heatproof serving bowl, and cover with boiling water. Let stand 15 min, or until slightly softened. Arrange peas in a single layer on a platter. Sprinkle with dates. Arrange radishes on top. Dollop some currants over dates. Place dates under broiler for 3 minutes, or until glaze is bubbly.

title: Ajiaco
ingredients: 2 ripe peaches, about 2 pounds | 1/2 cup jam | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/8 teaspoon ground aniseed | 7 ounces cherry tomatoes | 5 ounces mixed dried fruit
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place peaches in a glass pie dish. Stir jam, cheese, and anise into the peach slices.

title: Russian Style Ketchup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ketchup | 1 can tomato puree, preferably heinz
instructions: In a bowl, whisk all ingredients together. Allow the flavors to mesh together during cooking. Bring ketchup to a simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Orange Chile Pepper Bread
ingredients: 4 large eggs | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate | 2 serrano peppers, seeded | 1 cup maraschino cherry, stems removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place eggs in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven. Pour orange juice concentrate into a blender.

title: Capsicum's Greek Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt | 4 cups broth ( homemade or from deli ) | 1 cup shredded peeled apple | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Add yogurt, broth, diced apple and yeast to a large pot. Mix well using a fork. Cover with a clean cloth, letting it settle to the bottom of the pot for an hour. Once the mixture begins to froth, strain the mixture through cheese cloth. This is a thick, yet thinner, soup. If you haven't tried to strain the soup through a strainer it will work. Add the strained bread to the soup, and stir. The soup will eventually become thicker and more creamy. Let the soup cool slightly, and serve. To reconstitute the soup, heat the soup on the stove or in the microwave for about a minute or so in order to thin it out a bit.

title: Pistachio Mushroom Portobello
ingredients: 500 g portabella mushrooms | 1 - 1 1/2 cup prepared guacamole | 2 -3 slices swiss cheese, for serving | 2 -3 slices dried fruit | 2 tablespoons pistachio nuts, for garnish
instructions: Clean mushrooms and slice into pieces the size around the size of a golf ball. Place in a food processor and process until it just starts to form a ball. In a small baking dish, spread the guacamole on it. Layer the ham and cheese evenly on top of the guacamole. Sprinkle with the chopped nuts. Set in a 350°f oven and bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve hot with fruit or sour cream.

title: Shrimp & Egg Stuffed Rice
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp ( preferably in the shell ) | 1 egg ( yolk only ) | 1 cup long grain white rice | 8 ounces cream cheese, cut into chunks
instructions: Steam shrimp until pink and firm, about 8 to 10 mins or until pink mostly gone, remove to a board and let cool a minute or two. Squish shrimp around the shrimp. Place the rice in a small bowl and cover with boiling water and let stand about 20 mins so rice cooks.. Put the shrimp in a bowl and beat the egg yolk. Stir in half of the rice and cream cheese and mix well. Add in rest of the rice and shrimp and mix well. Fill a 9 x 13 inch pan half full but not completely full, spread rice mixture in pan to form a lid while pressing together the rice. Cover with a lid or parchment paper and bake in oven at 350 until top is golden brown, about 40 min. Or bake in small oven for about 15 - 20 min or until the liquid is absorbed and rice is cooked a bit softer. Do not overcook rice. The rice can also be eaten straight from the pan.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,lobster meat,beef steak,paprika,barbecue sauce,sun tomato oil,french bread
title: Grilled Lobster Sandwiches With Sun-Dried Tomatoes and Beef
ingredients: 2 lobster meat | 8 ounces steak | 8 ounces french bread | 8 ounces focaccia bread | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced | 6 ounces beef steaks | 2 1/2 tablespoons paprika | 2 1/2 tablespoons barbecue sauce
instructions: Pre heat grill or broiler. Place steaks in a non stick skillet over high heat. Cook for 2 minutes per side. Place sandwich, bread and tomato on plate. Top with steak slices then cover with barbecue sauce. Sprinkle with paprika and grill for an additional 2 minutes or until steaks are cooked to your liking. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,crisco,tri tip steak,hard egg,white bread,lettuce,marjoram
title: Baked Tri-Tip Steak
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 8 ounces extra lean ground beef | 9 ounces tri-tip steak | 2 hard-boiled eggs, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 4 tablespoons crisco | lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: Trim the crusts of the bread and lay them flat on the counter. Place 2 slices of bread on the bread, then spread approximately 2 tbs of meat onto the bread. Sprinkle over 1/2 tsp of marjoram. Roll the meat up and fasten with string. Repeat a few more times making sure that each slice is well coated. Lay the rolled steaks on a cutting board and slice the steaks into 1/4 inch thick slices and place them in a baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and put in the refrigerator for at least 8 hours or overnight. Beat eggs with the remaining marjovaram until they are very smooth. Pour over the steaks. Refrigerate for up to 2 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake for 25 - 35 minutes until the meat is cooked and the egg is firm, turning and brushing with crisco as it cooks. Serve immediately or cover with foil and keep warm until serving time. Slice or shred the remaining 2 slices of bread and sprinkle on the pile of meat.

title: Stilton & Parsley Cheese for Fish
ingredients: 1/3 cup parsley leaves, fresh, chopped, packed | 100 g stilton cheese, crumbled
instructions: Process parsley in processor until fine. Add cheese and process until well combined. Divide into 4 portions and form into patties of desired size. Place each on well greased foil and grill on bbq plate for approx 3 - 4 mins per side or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: fast rising yeast,rice wine,cod fish fillet

title: Almagro

instructions: Preheat oven on the convection setting on your oven's lowest setting. Measure the dry ingredients into a bowl and whisk vigorously with a fork. Use your hands to incorporate the creams. Cover with plastic wrap. Cut into squares with a serrated knife. The easiest way to cut in your knife is with a very sharp knife in the center, but if it does not cut in half horizontally to the opposite, you have cut the square into pieces with your knife. Do not cut horizontally. Remove the plastic wrap. Cut the squares into smaller squares.

Mince 1/4 cup cheese and 1/2 tsp of dry yeast in a coffee or spice grinder. Put syrup ingredients in the pan of a bread machine in the order listed. Put in the first cheese cube followed by the zucchini. Set bread machine on quick or crust setting. When the first loaf cycle is completed, remove from bread machine and put on a rack to cool before turning out on a rack.

title: Polpette Di Pomodori (Prosciutto Wrapped in Parma)
ingredients: 4 slices prosciutto ( prosciutto ) | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Place prosciutto slices on a piece of a cutting board. Place 1 parsley leaf on each slice and roll up tightly. Wrap prosciutto in a piece of prosciutto and tie with kitchen string. Arrange wrapped prosciutto wrapped prosciutto in a baking dish and add parsley leaves. Refrigerate, covered, for at least 2 hours. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,active yeast,pre mozzarella cheese,rib eye steak,egg,savory
title: Italian Robust Steak Sandwich With Savory Bread
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 10 -12 cups pre-shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup shredded savory | 8 eggs, well beaten | 24 slices sandwich buns ( mozzarella, pumpernickel or other variety ) or 24 sandwich buns ( mozzarella, pumpernickel or other variety ) | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs short rib eye steaks
instructions: Dissolve yeast in ½ cup warm water.. Heat 1 - ½ inch of water and cook until foam subsides and dissolved. Add cheese and savory.

title: Okra Pockets
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen okra | 2 packets pectin
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f in a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish combine okra and pectin.

title: Ginger Paste (Sichuan)
ingredients: 1 pint fresh gingerroot | 1 -2 teaspoon rock salt
instructions: Peel the ginger root and grate it about 1/4 inch thick and put it in a mortar or food processor or grinder along with the rock salt, using a pestle to grind and getting it finely grated. Store the paste in a clean, dry container.

title: Yummy Haddock
ingredients: 4 haddock fillets | 1 mango, cut into thick slices
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Lightly grease your grill. Arrange the haddock fillets on the grill and grill them for about 8 minutes on each side. Sprinkle mango slices on and serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,prune,nonfat milk powder,cilantro stem
title: Red Pepper and Prune Salad
ingredients: 1 whole sweet red pepper or 1 whole red pepper, chopped small | 2 ounces pitted prunes or 2 ounces walnut pieces, drained | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro stems
instructions: Put a little water and chopped vegetables into a blender and blend until completely smooth about 30 seconds or so. Place puree into medium sized bowl. Add the chopped prunes and the non fat dry milk powder and mix well. Let stand 30 minutes or so. Stir in the cilantro just before serving. Serve at room temperature or chilled. If served the next day, let stand for at least five minutes to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,frank red sauce,raspberry,vegetarian fish sauce
title: Grilled Vietnamese Style Raspberries and Fish Sauce
ingredients: 12 cups raspberries | 2 teaspoons vegetarian fish sauce | 1 bay leaf | 1 teaspoon frank's red hot sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place berries into a blender or food processor, and add enough fish sauce to cover tops. Cover, and process until pureed. Strain through a fine mesh strainer into another pitcher, keeping raspberries strained to remove seeds. Pour pureed berries into a bowl, and stir in the fish sauce. Place bay leaf in a saucepan over medium high heat, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, and stir in hot sauce. Serve warm.

title: Easy Peasy Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 12 ounces pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips ( i use ghirardelli brand ) | 1 loaf round wheat bread or 1 loaf other loaf
instructions: Trim off any extra fat from pork tenderloins. Slice the pork tenderloins diagonally across the grain.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chili sauce,pearl barley
title: Lite Barley Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir until thoroughly combined. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,tortilla chip,marinara sauce,cauliflower,pepperoni,rom tomato
title: Italian Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 1 roma tomato | 10 ounces tortilla chips | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 4 ounces shredded pepperoni | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Grate cauliflower in a food processor. Toss with salt, pepper, vinegar and tomato. Top with pepperoni. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,pork tenderloin,active yeast,jumbo shrimp,sherry wine
title: Peking Stuffed Jumbo Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs jumbo shrimp, peeled, deveined ( large shrimp ) | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup sherry wine, divided | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 16 1 inch round unpeeled butterflied pork tenderloins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a large glass bowl, mix the shrimp with 2 teaspoons of the yeast and 1/2 teaspoon of the sherry. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let stand 15 minutes for the shrimp to absorb the yeast. Squeeze excess moisture from the shrimp.

Random Ingredients: bacon,spicy brown mustard,maple syrup,ice water,egg,kale,vegetable stock
title: Maple and Thyme Ice Cooker Breakfast
ingredients: 1 package maple honey mustard ( available at canadian markets ) | 450 g kale, washed, stems removed | 1 cup vegetable stock ( or chicken or beef flavour ) | 375 g fresh maple-flavoured bacon, diced | 3 eggs, beaten | 1/2 cup ice water | 3 tablespoons spicy brown mustard
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a rice cooker. Start cooking in the rice cooker. For an extra tasty and heartier breakfast dish, mix everything together. Serve with a tossed salad.

title: Cannellini Grill Supper
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground sirloin | 1 package frozen chopped broccoli cuts, thawed | 1 tablespoon low-fat italian style bread crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 cup chopped celery leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, thawed broccoli, bread crumbs, cinnamon, and celery.

title: Faux Fried Rice with Strawberries
ingredients: 3 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 package frozen fresh strawberries, thawed | 1 cup sliced black olives ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning, divided | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Gently stir in rice, and cook, stirring constantly to coat with oil. When the rice has turned a light golden color, remove from heat, and gently mix in the strawberries and olives with your hands. Stir in the seasoned half teaspoon of seasoning, and spread the rice into a circle in the skillet. Place on a plate, and let cool to room temperature. Dust with confectioners' sugar, and serve.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,queso fresco,lime juice,red food coloring,anise seed,grain white rice,cauliflower,spice
title: Rice with Cauliflower in a Creamy Limeade
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole grain white rice | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup queso fresco | 1 lime, juice and rind | 1/4 cup aji dulces mild mexican creole spice ( such as annatto or cascabel ) | 1 dash red food coloring | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 small head cauliflower, cored and cut into florets
instructions: Make the rice by placing it in a small saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and immediately turn off heat. Let sit until cool enough to handle, about 20 minutes, then drain. Place the rice in a food processor with 1 cup of lime juice, queso fresco, lime rind and aji dulces. Process until smooth and creamy. Stir in remaining lime juice and liquefied liquid smoke. Pour into a shallow dish, cover and refrigerate. Bring a pot of water to a boil over high heat and add the cauliflower. Cover and gently steam until easily florets burst from the cauliflower, about 5 minutes. Remove cauliflower and place in a bowl of ice water to cool.

title: Crispy Shrimp
ingredients: 16 large shrimp, in shells or 16 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 6 tablespoons icing sugar
instructions: Toss shrimp in icing sugar until coated. Place about 1 inch of oil in a large non stick fry pan. Heat for a few minutes until smoking. Transfer shrimp to pan and cook for 3 - 4 minutes depending on size of shrimp. Turn the shrimp over and cook for another 2 - 3 minutes so all shrimp are cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Ouzo Beef and Walnut Salad
ingredients: 1 english cucumber, sliced | 1 can chopped walnuts | 1 pound extra-lean ground beef | 1 cup ouzo ( greek dressing ), or to taste | ice water, or as needed
instructions: Mix the onion, cucumber, and nuts together in a bowl. Cover with ouzo.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,cooking oat,fava bean,chicken bouillon cube,white flour,belgian endive
title: Broccoli, Belgian Endive and Fava Bean Soup (Greece)
ingredients: 500 g fresh fava beans, shelled | 3 belgian endive, sliced thinly lengthways | 3 cups sliced broccoli florets | cooking oats ( toasted ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Dice up the fava beans and place in large saucepan. Steamfry endive over medium low heat for 3 - 4 mins or until softened. Add broccoli, cook for 2 - 3 mins or till just soft. Place in blender and add the cooking oats, broth and boullion cube. Season with salt and pepper. Puree till smooth. Gradually stir in half cup of water, mix thoroughly. Cover and return to heat. Place in a 200°c oven for 20 minutes or until aromatic and the soup thickens. Sprinkle with rest of the toasted oat and serve with a crusty bread.

title: Blue Cheese    Panna Cotta Balls
ingredients: 1 cup plain soymilk | 2 tablespoons aged cheddar cheese, finely grated | 1 tablespoon golden raisin, finely snipped ( a large handful ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder ( or use a pinch of each ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Knead with hands until ingredients are smooth and sticky, adding more soymilk if mixture is too dry. Cover and chill 1 hour at room temperature. Form mixture into 1 balls. Refrigerate 1 hour. Turn balls over before serving.

title: Lime, Fennel, and Limes
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole fennel seed, coarsely crushed | 2 limes
instructions: Stir together fennel seed, lime zest, and ground lime peel on a rimmed baking sheet. Store in a cool, dry place. To prevent smoking, heat a grill pan over medium heat. To prepare the juice, squeeze 2 lime wedges into a bowl.

title: Algerman Style Schnitzel
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond paste | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 pound hamburger | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place almond paste, chicken stock, and meat into a baking dish.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,purpose flour,pesto sauce,pappardelle pasta,dill pickle,ha avocadoes
title: Pesto-Avocado Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 cups dried pappardelle pasta or 2 cups other small pasta, such as ditalini | 24 ounces refrigerated prepared pesto sauce ( about 1 1/4 cups. ) | 3 hass avocadoes or 1 large hass | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup freshly dill pickle | 1/4 cup prepared crumbled dried shiraz dill pickle ( with parsley )
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions or to the package directions. Rinse under cold water.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,broth,vegetable broth,tart apple,brown sugar,chili pepper
title: Quick Apple and Brown Sugar Soup
ingredients: 4 cups reduced-sodium vegetable broth | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil leaf | 2 canned mild chili peppers, cut into chunks ( or 1/2 tsp chili powder ) | 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 1 medium tart apple, chopped | 2 tablespoons sliced basil leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients except basil in slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 10 - 12 hours.

title: Quick and Easy Pizza Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Combine yogurt, coconut milk, pepperoni and half and half in a medium microwave safe serving dish. Microwave on high for 1 minute, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: catsup,cider vinegar,wheat,phyllo dough,pineapple,cardamom seed,chicken stock,habanero pepper
title: Spicy Pineapple Phyllo Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh pineapple, cubed | 1 tablespoon hot habanero pepper, minced | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 8 sheets phyllo dough | 1/3 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon catsup ( or tamari ) | 1 tablespoon whole wheat ( optional )
instructions: Preheat over to 400 degrees f. Sprinkle bamboo skewers or metal skewers with salt. Thread 3 strips of phyllo on each wooden skewer making sure to keep 3 strips parallel to the center to make a double layer stack. Bamboo skewers will cause the phyllo to soak up any excess water. Place the pineapple with the spices into a large serving bowl. Stir in the chicken stock and vinegar. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes. Drain the pineapple and discard the spice mixture. Unwrap the phyllo sheets and cut them across the width of the bamboo skewers so they will fit inside the bowl. Brush the top of the sheets with vegetable oil spray and then arrange one piece of phyllo at a time. Carefully roll the phyllo in the vegetable oil, being careful not to cut all the way around the sides. Remove the unused stack. Sprinkle remaining phyllo sheets and the pineapple bundle on top of the phyllo. Arrange the bundles on a serving platter or a platter and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with warm harissa sauce or a drizzle of sweet yogurt.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,anaheim chilies,chili sauce,chinese vegetable,green onion,beef roast,graham cracker crumb,barbecue sauce
title: Shredded Beef Barbecue
ingredients: 10 lbs beef roast ( chuck or round ) | 12 ounces green onions | 1 1/2 ounces cans chili sauce | 2 ounces frozen limeade concentrate | 14 ounces hot barbecue sauce | 2 cups prepared rice and vegetables ( like rice vermicelli squash-your favorite ) | 3 anaheim chilies ( optional ) | 9 graham cracker crumbs | 1/3 cup chili sauce
instructions: Shred meat and toss with green onions. Combine the chili sauce, limeade concentrate, hot barbecue sauce and rice, vegetables, and shredded beef in a 6 quart crockpot and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Remove meat and vegetables. Stir and let cool slightly, and serve with remaining barbeque sauce. Note can sub 1 cup of chicken broth. This will thicken the meat juices.

Random Ingredients: butterscotch chip,buttermilk,vegetable oil cooking spray,grand marnier,red potato
title: Buttermilk White Rice With Caramelized Red Potatoes
ingredients: 8 red potatoes or 8 yams, red, white potatoes, 3 1/2 lb | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1/2 cup butterscotch chips ( optional )
instructions: Scrub the potatoes. Cut them into 2 thick slices. In a medium saucepan over medium high heat, bring about 1/2 inch of water to a boil. While water is coming to a boil, add the remaining potatoes and whole potatoes. Partially cover and reduce heat to a simmer. Cook until potatoes are soft, 20 minutes at most, but not fully cooked. Drain the potatoes and reserve the cooking water in a bowl. Dry the potatoes on a paper towel then slice into 1/4 inch rounds. Coat a nonstick or lightly floured nonstick skillet with cooking spray.

title: Pastry With Fresh Tomatoes
ingredients: 16 -20 tomatoes, sliced | 1/4 - 1/2 cup salad oil | 1 sheet pastry shell, thawed | salt and freshly ground pepper | 4 -5 slices fontina cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Spread the pastry on the bottom and sides of a 10 pie plate or other baking dish that has been well sprinkled with a bit of olive oil. Spread the tomatoes out and spread them out so they are almost entirely flat on the surface. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place a piece of fontina on top of the tomatoes, and top with a piece of cheese. Repeat for the other 10 pies. Bake until crust is golden, about 16 - 20 minutes, or until the cheeses are lightly browned. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: sardine,dark sesame oil,red cabbage,filling,tomato green chilies,chicken stock,peach schnapps
title: Sardine Calzone
ingredients: 1 can sardines, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 large red cabbage, coarsely shredded | 1 ripe tomato-burgers peach schnapps | 1 -2 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger or 1 teaspoon jarred gingerroot | 8 pieces salted sardines ( for decoration )
instructions: Arrange half the cucumber in a large platter. Arrange half the sardines on top. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Spoon the dressing over the salad, and garnish with the salted sardines.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,escarole,asparagus,bicarbonate soda,bread crumb,wide egg noodle
title: The Escarole from the Farmhouse
ingredients: 1 bunch escarole ( or a little more if needed ) | 1/2 bunch asparagus ( i have used a lot of different kinds and i use lots ) | 1 banana pepper | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 package wide egg noodles, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Trim most of the very ends of any green leaves and then tough leaves from the stems. Slice the ends into 1/4 wide strips. Trim the stems of the asparagus and cut each into 4 lengths. Trim the ends and slice diagonally into 3 or 4 rounds. Cut the banana pepper into 1 1/2 pieces. Boil the egg noodles according to the package directions. Drain. Place the cut vegetables on a serving platter and sprinkle with the bread crumbs. Pour the hot noodles on top. Sprinkle the garlic or ginger on top. Enjoy with a bowl of chilled chutney.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,wild mushroom,icing sugar,ice water,cumin,ancho chile,snow pea,taco seasoning
title: Mushroom and Snow Pea Tostadas
ingredients: 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 fresh rosemary sprigs | 4 tablespoons ice water | 4 ounces wild mushrooms, coarsely chopped ( buttons ) | 2 tablespoons canned unsweetened dried ancho chiles, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 12 crisp rosemary sprigs | cumin | taco seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the icing sugar and cumin, then brush one side of each cookie with the olive oil. Stir together the remaining rosemary. Sprinkle the icing on top of the sliced mushrooms, then set aside. Wipe out the frying pan, add the remaining oil, and add the mushrooms. Fry for 3 - 4 minutes over medium low heat, stirring often, until nicely browned, releasing any excess moisture. Stir in the remaining ancho chili, then remove the pan from the heat. Add the icing sugar mixture to the mushrooms, and stir until smooth. Spoon the mushroom mixture on top of the tostada slices, and garnish with a sprig of cumin or other desired garnishes. Serve immediately. Note, for a less chunky finished dish, drizzle in a little more ice water, stirring until all the frost is absorbed, then freeze in an airtight container for up to 3 months.

title: Homemade Becel (No Flour) French Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups warm dry yeast | 3 cups all purpose flour
instructions: The night before baking in the morning, in a large bowl, dissolve yeast in 2 cups warm water. Add in 3 cups all purpose flour and stir until smooth.

Random Ingredients: chuck,topping,salt cod fish,plain nonfat yogurt,ketchup,beef bouillon cube,self raising flour,anise oil
title: Baked Cod Fillets
ingredients: 1 kg white steaks ( i prefer to use lean beef steaks from costco ) | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 pinch salt | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour, sifted | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 3 tablespoons anise oil ( or any oil that's ok to substitute ) | 3 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 300 g frozen chopped topping, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 190c. Place the fillets in a shallow ovenproof dish.

title: The Simplest Cheese Bread Ever
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 12 ounces dark beer ( i recommend guinness ) | 1 -2 large plum tomato | 3 -4 ounces grated emmenthaler cheese
instructions: First, heat your oven to 350 degrees f. Toast your french bread in the oven for 8 minutes at 275 degrees f, to help break apart the bread. Remove the bread from oven and spread some of the cheese on top. Cover the cheese with the beer, plum tomato, and some more cheese. Place under the broiler for 2 - 3 minutes to brown the top. I serve this with a side salad of baby greens and red cabbage. The recipe also says a drizzle of fresh lemon juice if you decide to do so. Also, if you have any bread chunks left, break some apart with the tips of your fingers, and then serve this cheesy bread sandwich.

title: Creamy Apricots
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups apricots, finely chopped ( about 12 to 14 ounces ) | 1 1/3 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn, freshly ground | 1 1/2 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: In a mixing bowl with a hand mixer, combine the apricots and flour. Add the peppercorns.

Random Ingredients: basil,chervil,lemon extract,corn tortilla chip,chili bean paste
title: Chili Bean Chili
ingredients: 2 cans chili beans in sauce | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/2 teaspoon basil | 1/2 teaspoon chervil | 1/2 teaspoon corn tortilla chips
instructions: Heat bean juice in a saucepan to boiling. Add all remaining ingredients and allow chili to simmer. Serve with warm tortillas.

title: Chilli Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 small aubergine ( a firm eggplant ) | 450 g mixed vegetables, chopped | 3 raspberries in liqueur | 400 ml hot chili sauce | 1 -2 medium red chili pepper, seeded and sliced | 100 ml sweet chili sauce ( mild )
instructions: Cube aubergine and place on a tray and bake under a hot grill until golden. Cool and then chop into bite size pieces. Combine the remaining ingredients and pour over the aubergine. Refrigerate for a few hours to marinate.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,chickpea flour,potato starch,gruyere cheese
title: Creamy Cottage Cheese Rosti
ingredients: 900 g potatoes ( small, scrubbed clean of starch and dry ) | 50 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil ( dry ) | 2 tablespoons potato starch ( sifted ) | 100 g gruyere cheese ( grated )
instructions: Gently boil the potato until just tender. Drain well and mash, adding all the other ingredients except the grated cheese. Grease a roasting pan or a shallow roasting tin and scatter over the potatoes. Press it down and make a well in the centre of the potatoes. Smooth the top. Sprinkle the cheese over the top smoothing evenly. Bake at 190c/fan180c/gas mark 2 or 150c for 35 - 40 minutes, until the top is crisp and golden brown and the cheese is melted.

title: Crock Pot Mango Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 tablespoon molasses | 4 -6 ounces kielbasa, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 box buttermilk pancake mix ( mccormick ) | 2 cups vegetable broth | 1 cup mango, peeled and diced ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar
instructions: In large nonstick skillet, combine molasses and kielbasa. Cook over medium high heat until sausage is lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Transfer to slow cooker. Stir buttermilk, pancake mix, broth, mango and vinegar into the pan. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 5 - 7 hours or on high heat setting for 4 - 6 hours. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,greek oregano,cumin powder,five spice powder,baking soda,slab bacon
title: Irish Bacon Sausages
ingredients: 2 thick slab bacon ( or thick canadian bacon ) | 1 tablespoon whole cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon greek oregano | 2/3 cup fat-free irish cream | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: In a lrg skillet cook bacon until crisp, stirring often. Remove bacon & set aside. Using sml skillet, pour drippings into skillet, & add remaining spices. Cook until fragrant, stirring. Add bacon into hot skillet. Reduce heat. Simmer until bacon is cooked & fat absorbed, 5 - 8 min., stirring often.

title: Parsnips Hash With Lemon and Thyme
ingredients: 6 tablespoons unsalted pearl barley, rinsed | 2 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 large white onion, peeled and quartered | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon cornmeal | 1/2 lb lox
instructions: Preparation, place barley in heavy lidded saucepan and add enough cold water to cover barley. Bring to a boil over med low heat. Cover and cook for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare prawn,. Remove tails from lox. Cut into 5 pieces and set aside. Cut parsnips in half lengthwise and then into 1/2 pieces. Peel onion and cut into half slices. Remove seeds from thyme and sprinkle chopped parsnips with dried thyme. Set aside. Preheat oven to 250 degrees. In a large bowl, lightly toss barley with barley. Add parsnips, onion slice, parsley mixture, 2 tablespoons cornmeal and lox. Season with salt and pepper if desired. Transfer to 2 quart baking dish. Bake, covered, for 1 hour or until bubbly around edges. Remove from oven and allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,rice wine vinegar,baby bok choy,red bell pepper,clear honey,taco sauce,beef bouillon cube,steak
title: Sweet N Easy Beef and Peppers
ingredients: 1 kg flank steak, cut in thin strips | 1 teaspoon clear honey | 1 beef bouillon cube, crumbled | 1 red bell pepper, sliced thinly | 5 baby bok choy, cut into 2 inch lengths | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon zest, finely grated | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 4 teaspoons clear honey
instructions: Place the beef strips in a wide shallow dish with a lid. Sprinkle the honey and beef bouillon cube over the beef and turn to coat. Cover and leave in fridge for 4 hours or overnight if possible. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine red bell pepper, baby bok choy and lemon zest. Add rice wine vinegar, taco sauce and honey. Mix to combine and set aside for 15 minutes. Place the beef strips on two baking trays. Top with the onion mixture. Top with red bell pepper mixture. Bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until beef is cooked and vegetables are tender. Serve with rice.

title: Fusilli Con Champignones
ingredients: 600 g fusilli ( spiral shaped ) | 1 steak | 3 tablespoons fusilli, cooking shredded ( dry weight ) | 3 tablespoons brown rice flour | 1 cooking apple, chopped | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Cook fusilli for 11/2 minutes, then drain and allow to cool. Trim steak of any visible fat. Cut into thin strips. In a small bowl, combine fusilli with 3 tablespoons of brown rice flour. In the pan heat half the oil. Add steak and cook over medium high heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from heat and set aside. Cook chopped apple in remaining oil. Return steak and any juices and accumulated juices to the pan. Add the fusilli and caraway seeds and cook over high heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,runner bean,plantain,beef broth,tabasco sauce,farina,fennel,red onion
title: Aunt Gunagrone's Farina Soup With Plantains
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked farina | 2 cups cooked beans | 1 large red onion, diced | 2 -4 cups beef broth | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 - 1/2 small plantain, sliced and cut in 1/4 dice | fresh ground fennel ( as desired ) ( optional ) | tabasco sauce ( as desired )
instructions: Prep vegetables and cut meat into 1/4 dice. Soup, bring oil to medium high heat. Saute onion and plantain until translucent, about 5 minutes, stirring often. Pour broth over vegetables and bring heat to medium high. Cover and lower heat to low. Gently simmer about 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Remove from heat. Add farina and beans and stir thoroughly to separate the ingredients. Season to taste with tabasco sauce.

title: Queso Dip With a Twist
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 -2 cup beef stock
instructions: Place ground beef in a pan and add about 1/2 cup of water. Once beef is mostly browned, add tomato chiles and let boil for 5 minutes, then drain beef. Add beef stock to beef in pan and turn down to about a half simmer. Add cheese and let melt and add salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,elbow macaroni,chinese five spice powder,sesame oil,bacon grease,golden syrup,mandarin orange,broccoli floret
title: Chinese 'Rice' and Mandarin Fried Salad
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni, uncooked | 1 tablespoon bacon grease | 1/2 cup sesame oil, dark | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 3 tablespoons canned mandarin oranges, drained, rinsed, and julienned | 1 can broccoli florets, drained, and chopped | 6 large crispy tortillas, cut into thin triangles, for dipping
instructions: In 3 qt or larger skillet, cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain water from pasta.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,peanut oil,hoisin sauce,green olive,extra beef
title: P F Chang's Orange Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 teaspoon dried red chilies | 6 ounces extra lean ground beef | 2 ounces green olives, chopped
instructions: Whisk together hoisin sauce and oil. Add chilies and ground beef and stir fry until lightly browned. Remove from heat. Add olives and toss well. Serve hot over jasmine rice.

title: The Best Riss-It Frencher Toasts
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups skim milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons pizza sauce | 9 ounces greek yogurt
instructions: Whisk together 1/4 cup milk and the rice wine vinegar.

title: Chicken in Phyllo
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken breasts, boneless legs with thigh attached | 1/2 teaspoon fresh clove | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 3/4 cup thawed chicken breast ( from a rotisserie chicken ) | 8 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Place chicken, garlic, pepper, and salt in a large zip top plastic bag. Pound chicken to about ¾ inch thickness. Place two sheets of phyllo in a 13 x 9 baking dish, and spread half of chicken mixture evenly on half of phyllo. Place one sheet of phyllo over chicken mixture, and roll up to enclose chicken filling, leaving at least one inch of phyllo exposed at the edges. Top with another sheet, and cover with plastic wrap. Repeat 2 more times, placing 5 sheets of phyllo over phyllo to cover phyllo. With scissors, cut phyllo into 24 - 4 inch squares. In a small bowl, combine chicken, half of liquid from chicken, and 1 teaspoon chicken breast juice, and pour half over. Cover, and refrigerate chicken mixture 4 - 6 hours or overnight. Transfer phyllo to a cutting board and spread evenly with remaining chicken mixture. Cut phyllo squares in half crosswise, and arrange in a 12 by 9 inch shallow baking dish. Repeat with remaining phyllo, chicken, and liquid mixture in step 8, using as few squares as possible. Cover, and let stand 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove plastic wrap, cut squares of dough into strips, and carefully transfer to baking sheets, then place the strips flat side down on top of the phyllo squares. Brush or spray with cooking oil. Bake until browned, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Canadian Bacon Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons smoked canadian bacon | 2 tablespoons diced yellow peppers | 3 tablespoons ground beef | 2 slices yellow pepper ( optional ) | 8 small flour tortillas or 8 small corn tortillas
instructions: Preheat your oven to in a medium skillet cook each vegetable, except green peppers, in canola oil. Wrap each with a slice of bacon. Heat up another skillet over medium high heat and pan fry the wrapped tortillas about 2 - 3 minutes per side. You may use two spatulas or a cookie sheet to wrap each wrap. Serve with your favorite sides and salsa.

Random Ingredients: peanut,grain rice,shiitake mushroom water,saffron,plum tomato,egg substitute,salt pork
title: Mushroom Rice Balls
ingredients: 3/4 lb salt pork, finely julienned | 1 can shiitake mushrooms with water | 1 egg substitute | 1 plum tomatoes or 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried tomatoes | 1/4 cup dry-roasted peanuts | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, dissolved in | 1/4 cup warm water
instructions: In a skillet, brown salt pork, remove from skillet and discard all but 1 tablespoon of fat. Add mushrooms, stir fry for 1 minute. Add tomato, pepper, and 2 cups boiling water. Cover and simmer 2 minutes or until mixture boils. Drain and set aside. In a large bowl, lightly beat egg substitute with fork, add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Cover. Chill completely and roll into balls. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Flatten slightly, using your hand. Bake 30 minutes at 450 degrees.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,manchego cheese,polenta,sage,tomato sauce,almond extract
title: Mexican Polenta Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups finely shredded polenta ( i use coarse ground yellow cornmeal for this ) | 1/2 cup finely shredded manchego cheese ( can sub monterey jack or mild cheddar ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 1/8 teaspoon sage | 1 tablespoon finely chopped mixed black sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. In a medium size bowl, combine all ingredients except seeds. Season topping with salt and pepper if desired. Transfer half of mixture to a 9x13 in. Baking dish. Sprinkle topping over batter. Sprinkle tops with sliced almonds. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until topping is golden brown. Serve warm. Make ahead, can be made up to 24 hours ahead. Keeps well in the refrigerator.

title: Basic Shortbread Bites
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups peanut oil | 1 cup good-quality grated chocolate | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line cookie sheets with foil. Place a plate upside down on a baking sheet. Beat together oil, chocolate, and vanilla in a small bowl until smooth. Scoop down a heaping tablespoon of the softened mixture and then roll it into a ball. Dip the ball into the chocolate mixture, flipping it once with a small amount of the reserved cookie mixture. Gently twist the ends of the balls, then place on the foiled cookie sheet. Repeat with the rest of the balls. Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from the oven and immediately, if desired, allow cookies to cool completely. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,basil leaf,curry powder,confectioner ' sugar,extra virgin olive oil
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Quesadillas
ingredients: 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil ( or evoo ) | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder, or to taste | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves | 1/2 cup finely chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and patted dry | 3 -4 cups confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients thoroughly in a blender or food processor. Process until it's well blended. Add more oil if necessary. Place a small spoonful of the vinaigrette in the center of a tortilla. Add 1 or 2 tablespoons of the pesto. The pesto will spread all over the tortilla. Top with the remaining 1 or 2 tablespoons pesto. Heat a lightly oiled griddle or skillet over medium heat for about 30 seconds, or until lightly marked. Turn the tortilla over and cook to desired browning, about 30 seconds per side or until lightly toasted on the underside. Remove to a platter and slice into wedges. Serve warm.

title: Dairy Free Brown Lentils
ingredients: 400 g brown lentils | 100 ml basil leaves ( roughly chopped )
instructions: Boil the lentils for 25 to 30 minutes depending on size. This should not take long to cook, but if they aren't cooked enough then they will fall apart. If it is the texture you prefer then the cooking involved will lessen slightly. You want to keep a close eye on them to ensure they don't stick to the bottom of the pan at the end. Stir the lentils every 5 minutes or so and stir. The amount of water and spices required will vary according to the size of the lentils and the length of time the lentils cook. They cook very quickly, so be aware that some will get mushy and some more liquid.

title: Sangrita
ingredients: 1/2 ounce chipotle chile in adobo | 1 ounce strawberry preserves | spritzed sprite
instructions: Shake ingredients with ice.

Random Ingredients: date,pork shoulder,rice wine,green chile pepper,savory,italian sausage,green apple
title: Spanish Pork Loin
ingredients: 3 pounds pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 pound italian sausage | 1/2 cup rice wine | 2 green apples - peeled, cored, and sliced | 6 dates, sliced | 1 tablespoon snipped savory | 1 can chopped green chile peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place pork, sausage, rice wine, apples, dates, savory, and green chile peppers in a roasting pan. Roast in the preheated oven until meat is well browned and vegetables are tender, about 3 1/2 hours.

title: Spicy Lemongrass
ingredients: 1 cup chopped lemongrass | 1 cup chopped green onion | 2 tablespoons toasted pine nuts | 2 tablespoons mixed spice
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts and spices and mix until well blended. Add nuts to mix and allow to sit, covered, in the refrigerator until serving time.

title: Sesame Soybean Dip
ingredients: 1 can soybeans, drained | 1 tablespoon black sesame seeds | 1/2 cup good quality pisco ( japanese seven-spice flavored liquor ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chile powder
instructions: Drain the soybeans and place them into a food processor or blender. Add the black sesame seeds, pisco, and crushed red chile powder. Process until well incorporated into a smooth, chunky dip. Serve with pak choi toasted asparagus, asparagus, or asparagus sticks.

title: Pork and Tofu Sandwiches With Pineapple-Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1 lb fresh ciabatta, split lengthwise | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 - 3/4 cup red cabbage | 1/2 cup green ( with green parts ) or 1/2 cup white cabbage
instructions: Combine the meat, pork shoulder, ciabatta, pineapple juice, and red cabbage as directed on package. Place on foil covered rack in large shallow baking pan and bake at 375 until pork is no longer pink outside, about 50 minutes. Meanwhile heat grill in large skillet over medium high heat. Slice the pork and toss with slaw and remaining slaw.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,chile sauce garlic,water chestnut,rice wine,harissa
title: Spicy Brie Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces brie cheese, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup warm water chestnut, chopped | 2 tablespoons roasted chile sauce, i used roasted garlic | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce ( garlic ) | 1/2 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f mix together the brie, water chestnuts, roasted chili sauce and sweet chili sauce. Roast until bubbly. Combine with the dip. Place in a shallow baking dish, cover tightly with foil and bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until hot.

title: Chili Sauce for Chicken Fingers, Dogs or Meats
ingredients: 1 jar tzatziki | 1 chili pepper flakes
instructions: Heat grill so it's medium high heat. In a small bowl, mix the tzatziki, chili pepper flakes and olive oil. Place chicken fingers or the meat of your choice on the grill, and rub the sauce. Grill about 4 minutes per side, or until chicken is done. Serve with bread and salad.

Random Ingredients: beef stock vegetable,coconut extract,sesame seed,black olive,crescent dinner,yeast
title: Coconut French Onion Pie
ingredients: 5 cups coarsely grated unpeeled fresh coconut or 5 cups coarsely grated thawed frozen coconut, unbroken fresh-grated | 1 1/2 ounces dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups beef stock or 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock, unfiltered | 2 teaspoons coconut extract | 1 can sliced black olives, drained and cut into fourths | 3/4 cup coarsely grated unpeeled fresh coconut or 3/4 cup thawed frozen coconut | 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
instructions: In bowl of electric mixer, combine the grated coconut or thawed frozen coconut, yeast, beef stock, and coconut extract and beat well, adding the olives, stirring to blend. Cover and let rest at least 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees and position rack in lower third of oven. Unroll cresent dough, and press out dough to one inch thickness on lightly floured work surface. Cut into 4 wedges. Arrange wedges in a round casserole dish. Brush tops with vegetable oil. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 40 minutes. Bake pie uncovered, 30 minutes, or until golden brown. Transfer to a rack. Serve warm or cool.

title: BBQ Chicken With Raspberry Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 large frying chicken | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split | 3/4 cup raspberry | 1 cup barbecue sauce ( or bbqs barbecue sauce ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped walnuts | 1 lime
instructions: Rinse chicken well under cold water, then shake to remove excess water. Place chicken on a baking sheet and pat dry. Place in a 350 degree f oven for 20 minutes, turn, then roast for another 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, remove chicken from oven and pull skin from chicken. Allow the chicken to cool on a cutting board. In a food processor or blender, combine the barbeque sauce, chopped walnuts, and the peeled vanilla bean seeds. Puree or whiz to your desired consistency.. Stuff the chicken with the sauce and bake in a 400 degree f oven until cooked, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,graham cracker crumb,active yeast,icing sugar
title: Baked Marshmallow Pudding
ingredients: 1/4 cup warm water | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 4 cups icing sugar | 1/3 cup grand marnier
instructions: In a mixing bowl, place warm water, sprinkle in yeast and stir to dissolve. Stir in graham cracker crumbs and mix well. Spread batter into a greased 8 inch square cake pan and set aside in a warm place until the pudding has spayed and is bubbly. In a large bowl, mix together icing sugar and grand marnier. Carefully spoon icing over pudding and allow to set. Cut into 20 squares and let stand several hours before serving. If you like a more puffed pudding you can either use toothpicks to hold the bread longer or a sharp knife to create a puddler design. Enjoy with a glass of coffee.

title: Smoked Salmon Won Tons
ingredients: 1/2 lb smoked salmon, sliced thin | 1/2 cup onion, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine | salt and pepper, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon almond flavoring | 20 wonton wrappers
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix first 4 ingredients except for wrappers. Place 2 tablespoons of mixture in each wonton wrapper. Brush edges of won tons with water and fold in half making sure to make sure edges don't overlap or they will dry out. In a large non stick skillet, cook approximately 2 minutes each side or until golden brown. Can be served with maple syrup or sweetened and/or fruit sauces.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,strawberry,half cream,golden raisin,serrano pepper
title: Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 quart half and half cream or 1 pint creme fraiche | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 8 strawberries, diced ( optional ) | 1 serrano pepper, finely diced ( optional ) | salt and black pepper
instructions: Combine the half and half, raisins, strawberries, and serrano pepper in a bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Quickly pour in half the sauce to coat the bottom of the pan, swirling to distribute evenly, then swirl the entire mixture in the pan, being careful not to dislodge the pan from the raisins. Cook over low heat for 15 minutes, or until the sauce thickens slightly. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,hot dog bun,beef stock,kirsch,sauce,beef chuck roast,icing sugar,cocoa powder
title: Guinness® French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef chuck roast | sauce : | 1/2 cup kirsch | 1/2 cup hot dog bun | cocoa glaze : | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 teaspoons kirsch | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 large egg yolks
instructions: Place chuck roast, 1/2 cup kirsch, and 1/2 cup hot sauce in a large pot over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,chili sauce,red wine,parmigiano reggiano cheese,white bread,corn syrup,soymilk
title: Warm Wine and Soymilk Toasts
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy milk | 2 tablespoons white bread, crusts cut off or 1/2 cup white bread | 1 teaspoon corn syrup or 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 teaspoon crushed dried chili sauce | 1 teaspoon chopped dried red wine or 1 dash sherry | cooking spray, for greasing | parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees if using non stick spray, place parchment or waxed paper under the parchment. In a 1 quart saucepan combine soy milk, bread, corn syrup, chili sauce and red wine or sherry. Bring mixture to a boil over medium high heat, stirring and breaking up any lumps with a wooden spoon. Turn heat down to low and cook mixture for 4 - 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. While cooling off the liquid, spray a 13x9 inch baking dish with cooking oil. Spread the cooled bread mixture evenly and bake until it is slightly browned, approx 6 8hrs or overnight, stirring once about halfway through baking time. Remove from oven and spoon cooled bread mixture on. Sprinkle with grated cheese if desired. Slice into pieces and serve warm. Note, if using the grated cheese, sprinkle it on top before placing in warm oven to make the toast crisp.

title: Apple Green Chili Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 medium apples, cored, peeled, and thinly sliced | 12 small green enchilada sauce, purchased | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1/3 cup chopped fresh coriander | 12 low-fat ladyfingers, split | additional walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Arrange the apple slices on large plates. Arrange the enchiladas overtop. Combine the remaining ingredients in a small bowl, stirring to blend. Pour over the enchiladas. Garnish with the additional walnuts. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,cumin powder,red bell pepper,accent seasoning,radish,black vinegar,tea,salt pepper
title: Steamed Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 large chicken wings | salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons black vinegar | 1 tablespoon accent seasoning ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dried tea | 4 radishes, thinly sliced | 1/2 red bell pepper, cut into 12 slices
instructions: Place chicken wings in baking dish, cover with water and sprinkle salt and pepper over. Place in steamer over boiling water and cook until done. Remove wings from heat, drain well and arrange on platter or rice dishes. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl and pour over chicken. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,green enchilada sauce,milk,red food coloring
title: Green Chile Enchiladas
ingredients: 8 ounces diced green enchilada sauce | 7 ounces evaporated milk | 1/8 teaspoon ground bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring
