instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the enchilada sauce, evaporated milk, bay leaf and food coloring until smooth.

Random Ingredients: au jus mix,curry paste,corn chip,banana,red chili pepper,garlic,baby green
title: Tropical Manchego (Sweet Corn) Chips
ingredients: 2 packages baby green | 1 medium banana, cut into bite-size chunks | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 packet sau jus mix | 1 cup chopped medium-hot banana ( banana may be substituted ) | 1 teaspoon hot red chili pepper | 1/4 cup finely crushed corn chips
instructions: Cook green giant.

title: Pista-Pista - Rice Paper Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh shelled pistachios | 2 cups lettuce leaves | 1 cup bean thread noodles | 2 cups caramel sauce
instructions: First take 1/2 cup pistachios on piece of parchment paper. Place one tablespoon on the end of a sheet of paper. Keep a napkin in your hand. Place 1/2 teaspoon of caramel sauce on it. Place 1/2 cup lettuce on the paper. Place 1/2 cup noodles around the caramel sauce. Add 1/2 teaspoon pistachi to the noodles. Make a roll with the paper until it is rolled. Remove from paper. Place in serving bowl.

title: Mars Bars
ingredients: 1/2 cup honey mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey mustard powder | 3/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 cube steaks, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 cups miniature marshmallows
instructions: Blend 1/2 cup honey mustard and 3/4 teaspoon garlic powder in a bowl. Place meat in a resealable plastic bag. Spread 1/4 cup mustard mixture over meat.

title: Pickled Watercress
ingredients: watercress | 1 1/4 cups white wine, room temperature ( white-wine )
instructions: Wash and remove the stems from the watercress, then remove the center root end of the leaves. Cut the leaves into thin strips. Soak in cold water for 3 minutes then drain. Drain. Put the watercress in layers in a large clear glass bottle with a tight fitting lid and add the wine. Cover with a piece of plastic wrap and put in the refrigerator to marinate for 6 days. The watercress can then be refrigerated for up to 3 weeks.

title: Basic Moroccan Sugar Body Polish or Mazurka
ingredients: 3 -4 cups vegetable oil | 1 pinch saffron or 1 pinch ground turmeric
instructions: Heat oil to 300 degrees. Do not heat it too high. Add saffron and stir. Immediately remove from heat and slowly pour mixture into large bowl. Stir and repeat until all contents of mixture are mixed thoroughly. Refreeze and allow to cool to room temperature. The resulting paste will stay refrigerated well.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,papaya,oyster sauce,white bread,cherry,tomato green chilies,parmesan cheese,table cream
title: Cherry Peppers With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 yellow sweet peppers, sliced | 1/4 cup reduced-fat parmesan cheese, plus 2 tsp. for serving | 2 tomatoes and green chilies, cored and cut into chunks ( about 1 cup ) | 3/4 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup low-fat bread | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons table cream | 2 cups papayas, cut into strips
instructions: Set oven to 400°f butter 12 x 1 1/2 inch baking dish. Spread sweet peppers on baking sheet.

title: Nectarine Nuts (Chilli Fruit Chutney)
ingredients: 2 lbs nectarines | 2 cups sweet cherries tomatoes | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons soy milk | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | barbecue sauce ( i use my own kikkoman sweet & sour sauce )
instructions: Halve nectarines and remove any pith. Slice into chunks and discard seed for garnish. Cut nectarines into quarters and scoop out pulp. Pour 2 cups chopped flesh from nectarines and reserve. Reserve juice for basting, and set aside remaining juice. Combine reserved juice, nectarines, raisins and reserved juice in a heavy pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in soy milk, ginger root, fennel seed and barbecue sauce. Cover and chill. Serve in tall wide mouthed glasses with drinks.

Random Ingredients: honey,french bread,green cardamom pod,irish cream,cheddar cheese
title: Cheddar and Irish Cream Toasts with Honey Crackers
ingredients: 8 slices french bread, cut 1 inch thick | 4 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/8 cup honey | 1/8 cup irish cream ( creme fraiche or sour cream ) | 6 green cardamom pods, split
instructions: Heat oven to 300'f. Place bread slices on cookie sheet, bake for 2 - ½ minutes, turning until golden and crisp. Remove to wire rack to cool. Place cheese, honey and cream in bowl and stir to blend. Spoon cheese mixture into 4 slices of toasted bread and top with remaining toasted bread. Chill for 2 hours, serve with irish cream for dipping. Serve with cookies.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,beef roast,coriander powder,apple juice,red chile,egg substitute,green olive,tarragon
title: Portuguese Pork-Eggs
ingredients: 1 beef roast | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 6 -8 red chilies | 6 ounces chicken/4 ounces apple juice | 1/8 cup raw egg substitute with 1 tbsp water | 1/8 cup raw egg white | 1 green olives, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon tarragon
instructions: Rinse the roast under cold water. Trim the outer white layer of all visible fat, then tear it into 2 inch long strips. Put the roast in a large dutch oven or crockpot and add the coriander and chillies. Add the chicken or poultry. Add the apple juice and cook on high for 4 hours stirring often. Beat the egg and water together and stir into the sauce. Remove from the heat and stir in the olives. Cook for 20 minutes longer over low heat. Add the tarragon and serve hot over boiled white rice and white, wild rice.

title: Pork, Chorizo and Spinach
ingredients: 1 chorizo sausage | 1/2 lb pork, boneless, skinless, cut into thin 2-inch sticks | 1 lb spinach | 1/2 cup canned pineapple tidbits with juice | 3 serrano peppers | pear, wedges for garnish ( optional ) | mustard, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Spray a skillet with cooking spray and add the chorizo and fry until browned. Remove chorizo and set aside. Add pork and brown over med. Heat until cooked through. Stir in spinach and simmer until just wilted. Add the pineapple, serrano peppers, mustard and chorizo. Simmer for 2 minutes, until heated through.

title: Spanish Chilli and Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried chili beans | 1/4 lb pancetta, chopped | 4 ounces raisins | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 tablespoon fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Soak the beans and pancetta in cold water for 20 minutes, then drain and discard the excess water. Place the beans, pancetta, raisins, parsley and stock in a pot. Cook on medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes, until the beans are soft. Serve sprinkled with the fresh parsley.

title: Tropical Hot Shanghi Shrimps
ingredients: 1 kg large shrimp ( peeled, deveined & with tails left on ) | 1 ketchup-piri-piri sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon teap manis ( sweet soy dipping sauce ) or 1 tablespoon sweet soy sauce
instructions: Prepare a preheated hot schai tea or stir fry pan. Put the first four ingredients in a small saucepan. Bring to the boil& simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour mixture into an airtight container, cool& set aside to chill for 10 minutes. Remove shrimp from saucepan& serve on a platter.

title: Blackberry Mushrooms With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package cremini mushrooms | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/4 cup monterey jack pepper cheese ( or cheddar cheese ) | 3/4 cup blackberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Cut the mushrooms in half, but do not remove the stems. Slice the mushrooms and mix with 3/4 1/2 cup of the black pepper jack cheese. Dip the mushrooms in the eggs and then in the remaining pepper cheese. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minute or until tender and starting to brown. Serve warm with sliced blackberries.

title: Mexican Cauliflower and Roasted Red Pepper
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, rinsed and cut in florets | 2 roasted red peppers, drained | 1 envelope taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange cauliflower in an oven safe baking dish or roasting pan. Toast in the preheated oven until just tender, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: turnip,london broil beef,yukon gold potato,sherry,peanut butter
title: Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs london broil beef or 2 1/2 lbs flank steaks, cut 2 1/2 x 2 1/2 x 1-1/4 inch slices | 6 yukon gold potatoes, cut in 6 wedges | 3 turnips, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2/3 cup peanut butter | 2/3 cup dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Rub beef with salt and pepper. Arrange potato wedges around edge of a shallow roasting pan. Arrange turnips, turnips, and meat on top. In a food processor, process peanut butter, and sherry until smooth. Pour over meat. Cover pan tightly and bake for 15 minutes. Remove cover and bake until meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours more. Serve over couscous.

title: Alfredo Filled Cupcakes
ingredients: regular bread flour | 1 cup mix | 1/8 cup pesto ( alfredo sauce ) ( optional ) | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/8 teaspoon orange peel, coarsely grated | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease cookie tray. Mix flour and mix together well. Make sure batter is well incorporated. Using wet/dry hands, begin to stretch dough into 12 balls. With floured hands, press the dough into 12 cupcake size, lightly greased, muffin tins with a floured fork. Spray with cooking spray. The key is making sure the batter is well mixed and uniform. Carefully place the muffin tin from front to back on your counter. Place each prepared cupcake on the lined tray. Fill each cupcake with alfredo sauce. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven, and cool in the pans on a wire rack for 10 minutes. Enjoy. To make alfredo pesto sauce, place pesto and italian seasoning in a small sauce pot and boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. When cold fill the pint cans with alfredo sauce. To fill your cupcakes add a teaspoon of pesto, or a spoon of cold water. Place each cupcake in the jar with the sauce and turn to coat evenly. The sauce may be kept warm. Use a funnel to pour sauce into each cupcake one time.

Random Ingredients: arugula,ketjap manis,tahini,veal,ice cube,extra virgin olive oil
title: Arugula Nestl
ingredients: 2 packets tahini ( sesame paste ) | 2 packets ketjap manis ( sweet soy sauce ) | 4 lbs ice cubes | 1 lb ground veal | 1 container arugula or 1/2 cup baby spinach
instructions: Place the sheets of tahini and kecap manis in the middle of a plastic wrap or waxed paper, place plastic wrap directly on the surface of the tahini mixture, then press in the ice cubes with a wooden spatula or hands into desired thickness, spacing them about 1/2 inch apart. Lay the ground veal into a freezer bag. In a large bowl, mix the sesame paste with 1 lb of the ice water until smooth. Add the frozen meat and stir to coat. Let sit for 20 minute. Divide the arugula among four dinner plates, then divide the meat among the plates over top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,tomato basil pasta sauce,yellow pepper
title: Sweet Peppers Provencale
ingredients: 6 yellow sweet peppers, halved and seeded | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 can tomato and basil pasta sauce
instructions: Slice peppers, discarding seeds and membranes. Heat shortening in a saucepan over medium high heat.

title: Awesome Poppy Seed Poppy Seed
ingredients: 2 cans white hominy, drained | 1 cup creamy peanut butter | 12 1/2 ounces guinness stout
instructions: Mash the hominy into a mush by hand. Transfer to a blender along with the peanut butter and the guinness. Cover and process until the guinness is thoroughly incorporated.

title: Red Beans & Oat With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 ounces dried red beans | 3 stalks lemongrass, ends trimmed and finely chopped | 11 ounces enoki mushrooms, sliced | 7 ounces walnuts, toasted | 1 1/4 teaspoons sugar | 1 ounce rolled oats
instructions: Place red beans in a large saucepan.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,green bell pepper,plum tomato,pine nut,lemon,red cabbage
title: Tomato Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 red cabbage, thinly sliced | 4 plum tomatoes, sliced or 4 halved cherry tomatoes | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 green bell pepper, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 2 grated fresh lemons or 2 lemons, zest of
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss lightly to mix well. Serve.

title: Raspberry Pork Tenderloin Salad
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin ( trimmed of all fat ) | 2/3 cup old fashioned oats | fresh raspberries ( to garnish ) | 1 english cucumber ( sliced into thin wedges ) | 3 cups mixed fresh raspberries ( or other fresh berries )
instructions: Cut the pork in thick slices and place on serving platter. Cover with raspberries and cucumber. Let each person open his own raspberry or other fresh raspberries, and sprinkle with fresh or powdered raspberries to taste. Enjoy great at room temperature.

title: The Bestest Ever Greek Cheese With Feta Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup of crumbled feta cheese | 8 ounces of grated pecorino romano cheese | 4 ounces chocolate ( i usually use ghiradelli or vialone nano flavored ) | 32 ounces vegetable broth ( a must if using vegetable broth. please use 1 can if not using broth. i don't )
instructions: If you are using a cheesecloth, gently squeeze the whey out of the cheesecloth. Add the feta and romano cheeses to a small, heavy casserole or baking dish. Add the broth. Cover and bake at 350°f. For 1/2 hour. Remove from the oven and spoon onto a serving plate. Put back in the oven until the cheese is well melted. This will take about 20 - 30 minutes or longer depending on how thick the cheese is. Watch as the cheese tends to melt as it dissolves. You don't want it to be too runny. Remember though that sometimes the cheese will go rancid. Take the cheese off the dish. The cheese will get very dense. Serve piping hot.

title: Prawns
ingredients: 2 kg fresh prawns ( shelled ) | 1 1/3 cups orange juice | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Place prawn heads in a bowl and cover with cold water. Remove any gills and any white beak pieces. Leave to stand for 1 - 2 hours until the shells have opened. Drain the shells and rinse under running water. Place the shells, heads and all, into a saucepan. Stir in the orange juice and enough of the cornflour to make a runny paste over the prawns. Bring to the boil, simmer gently, stirring until the prawns are just cooked, about 10 minutes. Serve with plain rice or a tossed salad.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,apricot preserve,tamarind paste,sherry wine
title: Dulce De Leche Ricotta
ingredients: 500 g whole milk ricotta cheese, drained | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 100 g drained apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200º c, and lightly grease a shallow baking dish. Mix together the ricotta, sherry, apricot preserves and tamarind paste. Put the mixture in the prepared baking dish and bake for about 45 minutes, or until the mixture is golden.

title: Charishma's Asparagus, Parsnips & Cashews
ingredients: 500 g parsnips, peeled, sliced into matchsticks | 4 medium roma parboiled cashews, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup cashews, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup soymilk ( see soy milk basics ) | 1/3 cup table cream ( for vegan alternative ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons pine nuts, ground
instructions: In a large heavy bottomed frying pan, fry parsnips over medium heat until golden, about 7 minutes. Add cashews, nut and cream. Stir until combined. Reduce heat to very low. Cook for another 5 minutes. Serve hot, warm or at room temperature with any other dip.

title: Welsh Rarebit
ingredients: 2 slices sourdough bread | 1 tablespoon flour | salt | 4 ounces dark chocolate chips | salt | worcestershire sauce
instructions: Brush slices of sourdough bread with some flour, then roll into bread using a rolling pin. Sprinkle with salt. Melt the chocolate chips in a bowl over boiling water, then stir in worcestershire sauce. Add crispy bread and serve.

title: Maraschino Vinegar
ingredients: 1 pound maraschino cherries | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar
instructions: Wash the cherries and remove the pits. Place them in a plastic tub full of cold water, and soak for 1 hour. Drain cherries, and pat dry with a clean cloth. Transfer cherries to a container, cover, and refrigerate for 2 days. Pour vinegar into a clean jar, and add cherries, and any remaining vinegar. Seal, and store in refrigerator for at least 2 days. The vinegar will be absorbed by the cherries within a few weeks. Shake off excess vinegar, and pour hot vinegar into bottles, allowing some to spill over.

title: Steamed Leeks
ingredients: 3 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 10 1/2 - 12 cups unbleached all-purpose white-firm leeks, cleaned ( about 8 pounds ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in the 1 1/2 teaspoons of oil. Add the leeks and 2 - ½ cups of the all purpose flour.

title: Mexican Lime Candy
ingredients: 1 lime, quartered | 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f on a baking sheet. Squeeze the juice from the lime into a small bowl. Cut the lime in half and set aside. Dip your hands into a glass of cold water and rub the inside of the bowl with the lime. Stir the sugar into the water using the back of a spoon. Dip each lime half into the sugar, one half at a time, patting it onto your fingers. Arrange them in a single layer on the baking sheets. Bake in the middle of the oven for approximately 40 minutes, until the chocolate has melted and the sugar has become dark and crisp. Remove from the oven.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,cumin powder,head cabbage,greek seasoning,cauliflower,corn,marsala wine,basil
title: Mexican Cabbage and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head of cabbage ( shredded ) | 1/2 head of cauliflower ( cubed ) | 1 jar taco sauce | 1/4 cup marsala wine ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon greek seasoning ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon basil ( or to taste ) | 1 cup crushed corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large crockpot or dutch oven with enough water to cover. If you don't have a crockpot, just stir everything together in the bowl, and place on high. Stir every ten minutes for one to two hours. The cabbage and cauliflower should be well cooked, and the cauliflower still a bit crisp. You may need to cook the cauliflower a bit longer to get it to the right texture. Serve over your favorite rice or pasta.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,cumin,ra el hanout spice mix,thai basil
title: Easy Moroccan Spices
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 1/2 tablespoons cumin | 1 1/2 tablespoons khtirakh curry ( or other curry powder ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons hanout spice mix ( see my other spices website )
instructions: In a bowl, combine ingredients.

title: The Easiest and Best Indonesian Caramelised Spicy Curry Onions #A1
ingredients: 1/3 cup orange packed in oil ( such as a small orange ) | 1 tablespoon sherry | 1/4 teaspoon curry leaf ( i use fresh curry leaves in the asian aisle ) | 1/4 teaspoon brown sauce, such as kikkoman ( or palm palm sauce )
instructions: Heat 1 1/3 tablespoons oil in a pan. Add the orange flesh and fry for 10 seconds. Add the sherry, curry leaves and brown sauce and stir to combine. It will sizzle and clump up and you should have a slightly orange colour. When it starts to bubble up add the onions into the pan and stir until they are golden brown. Pour into your favourite mould and serve immediately with other indonesian dishes for dipping or as an accompaniment to satay.

Random Ingredients: hawaiian,pepper flake,brown rice,bay leaf,cider vinegar,orange juice lime,vegetable stock,gorgonzola
title: Arroz a La Gorgonzola
ingredients: 8 ounces green giant gorgonzola ( half a box ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 cup packed light brown rice, rinsed ( can use quick to measure ) | 1 tablespoon orangejuice or 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon bacon-crumbled hot pepper flakes | 2 1/2 cups hot vegetable stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar ( or to taste ) | 1/2 - 2/3 cup freshly squeezed orange juice or 1/2-2/3 cup lime juice | ground pepper flakes
instructions: Cut the cheese into 1/2 inch cubes and set aside. Place the stock, bay leaf, and rice in a large non reactive bowl. Add the orange juice, hot and bacon sauce.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,horseradish sauce,beef broth,celery,tuna steak,romaine lettuce
title: Crock Pot Norwegian Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lbs rump steak, cut into serving size pieces | 1 head cabbage, cut in 6 wedges | 2 -3 baking potatoes, cut into 6 wedges | 1 can tuna in oil, drained | 1 can reduced-sodium beef broth | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped celery
instructions: Set oven control to broil. Heat 1 t olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook steak until brown, about 4 minute per side. Spray 2 qt slow cooker with no stick cooking spray. Set meat aside and place in slow cooker. Place cabbage wedges, potatoes wedges, tuna, beef broth, horseradish sauce and celery in slow cooker. Cover and cook on high 5 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally. Add reserved meat and vegetables to juices in slow cooker. Discard lettuce. Cover and cook on high 5 minutes or until liquid is reduced to about 1 1/2 cups.

Random Ingredients: thyme,white wine,mango chutney,za'atar spice mix,breadcrumb,cider vinegar,fish fillet,chicken bouillon powder
title: Saucy Chicken Cakes With Mango Stuffing
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw chicken fillets ( approx 1 ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mango chutney ( or other fruit chutney ) | 1/2 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | 1 -2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 2 tablespoons white wine, such as kern's or 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 1 1/2 cups fresh breadcrumbs ( or sourdough preferred ) | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar
instructions: Prep all ingredients before starting the stuffing. In a large bowl, add all ingredients and mix well. Stir in breadcrumbs and chicken, making sure they are evenly distributed throughout the mixture. Mix well before serving. Cooks note, i prefer using a foreman type of grill, which i find to be a reliable source of these for me. I prefer medium grilling for this. Grill time depends on your heat, grill temperature, etc. Of course this is personal preference and as long as you marinate the fish and sauce thoroughly before grilling, but you want to avoid overcooking the fish while grilling it for a while on the grill. Note, i love making the stuffing my own, as it is sooooo tasty and much much easier to make, and i also love to marinate my fish in the mango stuffing, or you can leave the stuffing as is. But, you will be looking for a fresh sweet, smoky pulp, which tastes quite vinegary and flavorful. If you do that, you don't have to add any water, because the fruit will just be added to the stuffing anyway. But, cooking time reflects about 20 to 30 minutes grilling time. Grilling time reflects prep time.

title: Swiss Chard With Peas.
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh swiss chard, stemmed, washed and trimmed, washed well, spun dry, and chopped coarsely | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 10 ounces frozen peas, thawed | 1 teaspoon ground sumac | 1 chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: In a large skillet melt the shortening. Add the swiss chard and cook, stirring, over moderate heat until tender crisp. Stir in the soup, then stir in the peas. Season with sumac and chile pepper.

title: Stew in Crock Pot
ingredients: 400 g stewing beef, in cubes | 400 g stewing meat, in cubes
instructions: Put all ingredients into crockpot. Cook on low 8 hours or on high 4 hours,. Serve on boiled buns with butter and onions.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,pesto sauce,chinese cabbage,white wine,lasagna noodle
title: Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 bunch chinese cabbage, large outer leaves, trimmed and cut into 2-inch slices on the diagonal | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 18 lasagna noodles, cooked | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce
instructions: Cook cabbage to desired tenderness and remove any excess moisture. Drain. Coarsely chop. Heat wine and stir to loosen all particles that rise to the surface. Stir in flour, stirring until smooth and hot over medium heat. Add cabbage and cook 2 minutes. Fill each noodle with about 2 tablespoons cheese, 2 tablespoons pesto, and 2 leaves of cabbage. Roll up and place in 13x9 baking dish. Spread remaining pesto over rolls. Cover with remaining leaves of cabbage.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,beer,rice noodle,lemon,chicken stock,pork loin chop,pak choi,green olive
title: Pork Chops Kebabs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1 lemon, juice of | 4 pork loin chops | 1 cup pak choi, chopped | 1 cup pimentos or 1 cup green olives, chopped | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 cup rice noodles | 1/2 cup light beer
instructions: Dissolve cinnamon in lemon juice and marinate chops for an hour at room temperature. Put chops in a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand in a warm place for 30 mins covered, turning once. After 30 mins put meat aside. Add pak choi, olives and stock to wok and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and cook over very low heat for 15 mins, stirring occasionally. When done, remove meat from the wok and set aside. Heat oil in pan and sauté the pork about 5 mins on each side until cooked through. Put rice noodles into a large bowl and cover with boiling water. Let stand until softened, then drain and rinse with cold water. Pat dry and break into bite sized pieces. Add to wok with beer, cook 5 mins until beer is absorbed. Put over medium heat and stir until thickened, serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: italian bread crumb,onion salt,apple cider vinegar,oregano leaf
title: Grpa's Italian Onion Salad Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup dry italian seasoned bread crumbs | 4 tablespoons chopped onion salt | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 1 cup apple cider vinegar, or more if desired
instructions: Mix the ground crumbs, onion salt, oregano, and vinegar together in a bowl. Stir in more vinegar or hot water to coat. Taste to make sure it's the right balance of acidity and/or flavor. Transfer to a serving bowl and let cool slightly.

title: Homemade Meat Paste
ingredients: 500 g spice ( spice mix for london broil or similar ) | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce ( peri-peri or peri-peri, to taste )
instructions: Place all the above spices in a food processor or blender and process until finely chopped. Refrigerate in closed container.

title: Curry Powder - Simple Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground coriander
instructions: Mix well. Store in airtight container on top of double layer of parchment paper.

Random Ingredients: chocolate ice cream,mexican cheese,mexican tomato,bread,msg,green chilies,curd cottage cheese
title: Double Chocolate Mousse - Cholentosos Y
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 4 tablespoons mild green chilies | 1 1/2 cups small curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup small dry bread, toasted and broken into pieces | 1/8 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1 cup mexican blend cheese, grated ( kraft brand ) | chocolate ice cream, scoops ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine the stewed tomatoes, green chilies, cottage cheese, sour cream, bread, msg, and cheese in a large bowl. Combine evenly. Sprinkle with additional cheese of choice.

title: Jolly Parsnips in Pasta
ingredients: 4 small parsnips, peeled and cut into bite size pieces | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Cook parsnips in boiling water to cover for 10 seconds. Drain and set aside. Boil parsnips in unsalted water for three minutes. While parsnips are cooking, combine ground allspice and sherry in small saucepan.

title: Charmen's Raisins and Chives Appetizer: Herbs
ingredients: 1 kg red capsicums, cut into 3 cm x 1/4 inch strips ( capsicum ) | 6 large chives, trimmed, cut into 3 cm lengths ( parsley ) | 3/4 cup raisins
instructions: Toss each of the chives and raisins together in a bowl and toss to combine well, then press one end of each chive and raisin onto a chopping board to prevent cracking. Use the blunt edge of your knife to slice each piece into fine chunky strips. Repeat until all strips are thinly and evenly coated with chive and raisin. Pack the chive and raisins into a flat disc and wrap each disc in plastic wrap, securing the ends with twine. Store in the fridge and leave to mature at room temperature for 3 days before using. Note, the chives are used to make fresh herb salad dressing.

title: Puck (Beef) Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 jars oyster sauce | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | fresh thyme sprig, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the oyster sauce and heavy cream. Pour the cream mixture into a saucepan along with the thyme sprigs. Bring to a boil over high heat, and boil until reduced to about 1/ serve hot with any meat dish that holds its shape. Variation, use fresh thyme for the thyme.

title: Catch of the Day
ingredients: 32 ounces canned garbanzo beans | 3 ounces brandy | 12 ounces cooked peeled crab | 2 ounces chopped cilantro | 2 ounces white flour
instructions: Combine remaining ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth. Pour into a large casserole dish and bake at 350ºf. For 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,cooking sherry,beef broth,yellow bell pepper,prosciutto,green onion,garam masala
title: Beef Sizzler
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top sirloin or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut 1 inch thick | 3 tablespoons white vinegar or 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 cup low sodium beef broth | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 8 slices thin prosciutto, about 5 x 1/4 inch | 1 large yellow bell pepper, halved lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices | 4 green onions, sliced diagonally
instructions: Place beef in a bowl, cover with water and let stand at room temperature while making sauce to preserve meat. In a blender, combine vinegar with broth.

title: Shakespearean Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops, 1-inch thick, about 1 lb ( bone in, i use the cheaper dark chops which are usually imported from the supermarket ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala ( i use lots and lots and lots ) | 2 tablespoons blueberries ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tangerine segments, soaked in 3-4 cup boiling water
instructions: Spray a 12 inch skillet with cooking spray. Place chops in skillet, sprinkle with garam masala, and sear chops on one side for about 5 - 7 minutes per side or until nicely browned. Turn chops over and pour in boiling water. When it is nearly all absorbed, add berries. Cover and simmer for about 15 - 20 minutes on low heat. Serve on a wide buttered bed of rice and sprinkled with a nice amount of tangerine.

title: Shrimp and Napa Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage, cut into thin wedges | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 lb large shrimp, cooked
instructions: Place cabbages about 1/2 inch apart, in a greased 5x9x2 inch baking pan. Combine the soup, spinach, and vanilla.

title: Rose Water and Sour Cream
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sour cream ( reduced fat ok ) | 1/4 cup rose water
instructions: Put sour cream in blender bowl and add rose water. With blender running slowly pour in a thin stream from the bottom of the bowl into the bowl. After a few seconds add sour cream mixture. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to use. If you have a sweet tooth, fill with this and serve with french fries, hot baby carrots and fresh spinach as a dip.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 4 teaspoons dried basil | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried peaches, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to in large bowl combine beans, basil, celery seeds, paprika and peaches. Spoon bean mixture into well buttered 2 quart baking dish. Bake in oven for 20 minutes, then cover loosely with foil. Bake 10 minutes longer, or until beans are fork tender.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,salt,bratwurst,red curry paste,apple schnapps,bread crumb,hickory liquid smoke
title: Red Curry Brats
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds bratwurst | 1/4 cup red curry paste | salt to taste | 1/2 cup bread crumbs, divided | 1/2 cup apple schnapps | 1/4 cup hickory liquid smoke | 1/4 large jalapeno, seeded and minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place bratwurst into a large skillet over medium heat and sprinkle with curry paste. Cook and stir until slightly browned, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels, season with salt and place into a 13x9 inch baking dish. Place breadcrumbs into a shallow bowl. Combine apple schnapps, liquid smoke, chile, and 1/2 cup bread crumbs in a small bowl. Spread bread crumb mixture over bratwurst. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, basting occasionally, until lightly browned and crunchy.

Random Ingredients: meatball,hot chili sauce,ice,peanut butter,farfalle pasta,tomato juice,asparagus,italian sausage
title: Elegant Meatball Pasta
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 lb italian sausage, hot | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 package frozen meatballs, thawed | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce | 4 cups hot cooked spinach-style pasta noodles | steamed ice
instructions: Prepare farfalle according to package directions, adding sausage and remaining ingredients in a large saucepan. Cover, and simmer about 30 minutes. To serve, divide pasta among 4 serving bowls and top with sauce.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,frying oil,shiitake mushroom,tomato puree,white pepper,ice water,red curry paste
title: Spicy Japanese Curry
ingredients: 1 lb butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 4 shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 2 tablespoons red curry paste, can use mild | 1 can tomato puree | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan, except the water, cover & bring to a boil. Once soup comes to a boil, reduce heat & simmer until squash is tender, and the liquid is reduced, about 10 minutes. If using fresh shrimp, shell and devein, then set aside in a bowl. Add the shrimp to soup. Cook until shrimp turns pink, about 3 - 5 minutes. Pour soup into serving bowls, then top with shrimps.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed,dark brown sugar,cumin powder,irish cream,cottage cheese,salt pork,pepperoni,prawn
title: Baked Prawns With Cottage Cheese and Chocolate
ingredients: 300 g cottage cheese or 300 g ricotta cheese | 150 g sliced pepperoni | 80 g sunflower seeds | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 125 g dark brown sugar | 300 g prawns, rinsed and cooked ( i used only prawns ) | 80 ml irish cream
instructions: Sauce, in a blender, mix together the cottage cheese, pepperoni, sunflower seeds, cumin, salt, sugar, prawns and irish cream. Grease the ovenproof dish with oil. Spoon most of the mixture into the dish and spread to fill it. Sprinkle with the remaining pepperoni slices and bake at 150°c for 35 minutes. Serve hot with the saauce.

title: Fruit and Salisbury Sushi
ingredients: 16 ounces mixed dried fruit ( your choice ) | 4 cups long-grain white basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup morton lite salt | 1 3/4 cups seasoned prepared sweet-and-sour mix
instructions: Rinse the fruit.

title: Naked Beans (Zwt II)
ingredients: 1 can navy beans | 1 can tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup beef broth
instructions: Drain beans and rinse with cold water. Place in a large oven proof pan, cover with 1/2 c tomato juice, saffron and beef broth. Place in oven, cook 2 hours at 300° and serve. Note, you can substitute any tomato juice other than the saffron and can of tomato juice or you can use a combination of beef broth.

title: Tacos
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped roasted peanuts | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 package frozen, thawed phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Pour the peanut and taco seasoning into a large mixing bowl. Stir in about 1/4 of the phyllo, then cut in half. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, then lightly spray with nonstick spray. Place a sheet on the foil, and spray the sheet with nonstick spray. Repeat with another sheet, and remove the pan. Lay each phyllo sheet on top of each other in a tidy package, and spray each one generously with nonstick spray. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown. Serve the peanuts straight from the baking sheet for dipping.

Random Ingredients: fine sugar,pistachio,bisquick,bean,gruyere cheese,dark molasses,tomato green chilies,beef sirloin
title: Cousin Pete's Mexican Beef and Bean Croquettes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef sirloin | 1/2 lb lean cremini beans | 2 tablespoons dark molasses | 2 tablespoons fine sugar | 1 teaspoon coarse-ground dijon-style fine sugar | 1 medium tomatoes and green chilies, seeded and chopped | 1 1/4 cups bisquick | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios or 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the roast and cut it into 1 cubes. Place the meat in a large pot, add water to cover, and add the cremini beans. Bring to a boil.

title: Green Chile and Smoked Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 pound salt-cured smoked salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon bacon grease | 1 jar chopped green chiles | 5 tablespoons bacon grease, divided
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the salmon fillets and cut into 2 inch chunks. Place the chunks into a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, and reduce the heat. Simmer for 10 minutes, then drain, flake with a fork, and return the fish chunks to the pot. Meanwhile, heat the 2 tablespoons of bacon grease, and the green chile in a skillet over medium heat until the oil is hot but not smoking. Remove the green chile and stir into the salmon. Cook until the salmon is just cooked through, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,salt black pepper,red wine,white chocolate chip,peach,black olive,carrot,monterey jack cheese
title: Black and White Queso Fundido With Grilled Peaches and Artichokes
ingredients: 1 package white chocolate chips | 10 marinated artichoke hearts | 1 package shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded carrots | 10 sliced black olives | 1 can sliced ripe peaches, drained | 1 3/4 cups red wine | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil grate. Place the white chocolate chips in a microwave safe bowl, and cook until smooth, about 1 minute. Arrange the artichoke hearts on the grate, and set aside. Wrap each artichoke heart with a slice of cheese, and place them on a heated grill, and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Place artichoke hearts on a warm serving platter with the monterey jack cheese, and top with olives, carrots, black olives, and peaches.

Random Ingredients: cheddar monterey jack cheese,curry powder,peanut butter,kosher salt,cherry tomato,self rising flour,onion,soba noodle
title: Peanut Butter Veggie Cake
ingredients: 10 cherry tomatoes, halved ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup curry powder | kosher salt | 1/2 small onion, grated | 1 cup cheddar-monterey jack cheese, shredded ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1 package soba noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f and lightly oil a 13 x 9 inch metal cake pan or a 12 inch glass baking dish. Line baking dish with a large, round piece of foil, lightly tied with kitchen twine to keep foil from touching the tops of the pan or the edges of the foil. Open out the cherry tomatoes and scoop out seeds with a teaspoon. Place the tomatoes cut side down on foil lined pan. Mash together peanut butter, flour, curry powder and salt to form a smooth creamy paste. Stir in grated onion. Stir half of the coconut cheese into the peanut butter mixture until well blended. Mixture should be thick and creamy. Spread half of the sauce over the tomatoes. Sprinkle half the tomato mixture with half the onion, half the remaining cheese and the rest of the coconut cheese. Repeat layers, ending with cheese. Bake until center sets, about 1 hour. Cool 15 minutes, then invert onto a plate, cut into squares and serve.

title: Easy Spaghetti & Vanilla
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a medium sized casserole dish and place in the oven to warm through. Serve warm with butter and a sprinkle of cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,cremini mushroom,korean red pepper paste,pistachio nut,brown onion,mango chutney
title: Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped brown onion | 1/2 cup chopped black olives or 1/2 cup white onion | 4 ounces cremini mushrooms ( regular if you have fresh ) | 2 tablespoons low-sodium spiced korean red pepper paste | 1/2 cup pistachio nut ( or 1/4 cup salted pistachio ) | 2 tablespoons korean rice konbu chutney | 4 ounces cornmeal
instructions: Saute onion and mushrooms in a little bit of oil. When onion and mushrooms are soft, stir in other ingredients except cornmeal. Place cornmeal in 2 quart bowl. Sprinkle cornmeal over veggies and mix. Make sure cornmeal is completely covered with cornmeal. Dump mixture into bowl and spread into one inch of pan. Bake at 375°f for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Baja Green Chilies - Stuffed Jalapenos
ingredients: 6 ounces fresh anaheim chilies | 1 1/2 cups firmly packed dark brown sugar | 2 ripe avocados, halved, pitted
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with nonstick spray. Place the chiles on the foil. Bake, stirring occasionally, for 8 to 10 minutes or until the skins blister. Allow to cool. Remove the stems and seeds from the chiles, removing the ribs and seeds. Remove and discard the seeds. Make the chile sauce, heat the sugar in a small skillet over medium heat, until the mixture boils and is hot. Stir in the chile pulp and cook for a minute, then remove from the heat. Let the mixture cool, then refrigerate until the sauce is cold and set, about 20 minutes. Cut out and discard the seeds from the avocados and toss with the warm chile sauce. Fill the chiles with the avocado mixture, packing snugly. Serve warm or let them cool completely before storing, or refrigerate.

title: Sea Scallops and Rosemary Pizza
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust ( boboli ) | 12 -14 large sea scallops ( sliced into bite size pieces, or use 10 each of the above ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup apple cider | 3/4 - 1 cup tropical comfort ( or orange blossom water mixed in a bit of sugar ) | 1 tablespoon lime juice ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary, dried ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare your crust and coat with olive oil or cooking spray. Arrange scallops on the prepared pizza crust. In a small bowl, whisk cider, sweetener, and lime juice, season with rosemary. Pour over scallops. Bake at 400 degrees for 8 - 10 minutes, or until crust is golden brown. Place pizza on a plate, and sprinkle with sweetener mixture. Serve with a side of fruit and/or greek yogurt, and/or fresh fruit.

title: American Kitchen Classic Ribs with Raspberry-Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons aged balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 4 lbs country-style pork ribs, rinsed well | 1 lb fresh raspberries ( about 2 1/2 lbs )
instructions: Combine the italian seasoning, balsamic vinegar, and salt in a large resealable plastic bag, making certain that each rib is well coated with the marinade. Add the ribs, turning to coat, and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Heat oven to 300°f. Transfer the ribs and marinade to a foil lined roasting pan and roast, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender and a bit more charrant, about 45 minutes. Transfer the ribs to large platter and keep warm. Cooks' note, can be made 2 days ahead and kept chilled in fridge. Bring to room temperature. Bring back to room temperature before serving.

title: Tropical Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs red cabbage, chopped | 2 cups sultanas ( about 3/4 cup ) | 4 cups mixed pecans, toasted & peeled | 3/4 cup roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f mix cabbage, sultanas, pecans, and peanuts in large bowl. Add extra roasted nuts if using. Bake, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes or until fruit is hot and crunchy.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,grape juice,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Grape Juice(Ww 5 Points)
ingredients: 1/2 cup grape juice, divided | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup grape juice and vinegar in small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until vinaigrette dissolves. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 15 - 20 minutes. Set aside to cool. Refrigerate in airtight container up to 2 weeks. Stir before serving. Serve over your favourite green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: sugar syrup,pork chop,chicken chunk,mint leaf,chunky salsa
title: Mexican Pork Lovers
ingredients: 4 pork chops ( about 1 1/2 inches thick in all parts ) | sugar-free syrup | fresh chunky salsa | fresh mint leaves | 1/2 cup sugar-free syrup
instructions: Place pork chops on a foil lined baking sheet. Mix sugar free, salsa, mint leaves and half of the mint leaves together and sprinkle over the pork. Bake for 3 hours or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: red onion,anise seed,golden raisin,italian sausage,yogurt,red chile pepper,linguine,cardamom seed
title: Baked Noodle Pizzas
ingredients: 1/2 pound linguine | 1/2 pound sweet italian sausage | 1/2 red onion, halved and thinly sliced | 1/3 cup raisins | 1/4 cup golden raisins | 1/4 cup red chile peppers, drained and minced | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon sesame seed seeds | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add linguine and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Beer Salad!
ingredients: 50 ml red ale | 20 g salad leaves, washed | 1/4 medium hot red pepper, sliced thin ( optional ) | 1 pinch cracked pepper ( optional )
instructions: Prep and clean the red ale. Mix the ingredients together, put aside. Chill the salad leaves for several hours serve with the beer and dressing.

title: Creamy Parsnips and Parsnips
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips, peeled and cut lengthwise into 1-inch dice | 3 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Combine the vegetable and cilantro in a 6 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle with dill. Cover and cook on high setting 3 1/2 hours until fork tender and parsnips are tender.

title: Acapulco and Queso Fresco
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets, 1 1/2 inches thick | 8 teaspoons gurego cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 6 teaspoons queso fresco, crumbled ( couscous )
instructions: Wash and dry fish. Rub grated cheese, vanilla, and queso fresco over the fish. Place fillets under broiler, skin side down, and broil for 2 - 3 minutes. Turn fillets over. Brush top of fillets with remaining 1 - 2 teaspoons of gurego cheese, then broil until cheese is browned, about the same time. Cut into 4 - 6 large squares, and serve immediately.

title: The Perfect Meatballs
ingredients: 1/8 cup ice water | 1 lb ground veal | 1/3 cup nuts or 1/3 cup breadcrumbs, seasoned with | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: In a shallow bowl mix meatballs ingredients together. Make golf ball sized meatballs.

title: Spaetzle
ingredients: 9 cups yellow cornmeal | 5 cups all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine cornmeal, flour, mustard seeds, and pepper in a large bowl. Stir in desired amount of water and knead into a dough. Transfer dough to a floured table. If necessary, knead 1 or 2 times. Wrap dough tightly in waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: ciabatta bread,pork roast,monterey jack cheese,salmon,chili paste,tarragon
title: Salmon & Chilie Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2/3 cup chili paste ( such as chili-lime ) | 1/2 lb pork roast, shaved | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 loaf ciabatta bread | 6 ounces salmon, slices | 1/2 lb monterey jack cheese, sliced thinly and fried crispy
instructions: Combine the chili paste, pork, tarragon and cheese. Spread onto the crusty side of the ciabatta bread. Place the remaining slices of bread over the top. Heat a small fry pan over medium low heat. Add 2 oz. Of pork mixture and cook until heated through and golden brown. Cut the sandwich diagonally, diagonally, and top with the salmon slices. Serve directly from the bread.

title: Italian Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 can black olives, drained and chopped | 1 can of chopped italian vegetables ( i use diced tomatoes, spinach, or fennel or pesto )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mash with a potato masher or a wooden spoon. Serve with bread, crackers, or as a topping for your favourite sandwiches.

title: Smoked Salami & Chilli Relish
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked salami | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 bunch white sour cream or 1 bunch soft sour cream | 2 fresh chili peppers, seeds removed, finely chopped or 2 -3 dashes chilli pepper
instructions: Cut the boiled salami into strips 1/2 inch wide by ½ inch long. Place in the container of a food processor with the vinegar. Toss to combine. Add the chillies and purée. Spoon the liquid into a bowl or plastic container. Chill to allow the flavours to develop. When ready, use as required or keep chilled until served.

title: Brazilian Chicken Soup
ingredients: 2 cups orange juice | 2 cans condensed vegetable broth
instructions: Heat orange juice in a saucepan over medium heat until heated, about 3 to 5 minutes. Pour broth into a small bowl, and stir in soup. Strain liquid through a strainer into the bowl with orange juice.

title: Raspberry Chutney
ingredients: 1 pint fresh raspberries | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: In a blender combine the raspberries with the cardamom seeds, garam masala and salt. Cover and puree for 10 to 15 seconds. Scrape into a glass bowl and keep in the fridge or freeze for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,rice noodle,chili bean,red wine,onion powder,japanese beech mushroom
title: Asian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces uncooked rice noodles | 1 can chili beans, drained and julienned | 1/2 cup chopped japanese beech mushrooms | 3/4 cup red wine ( optional ) | 1/4 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rice noodles, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: bratwurst,lemon peel,rice,plain yogurt,pepper sauce,green grape cluster
title: Bratwurst on Rice
ingredients: 1 lb fresh bratwurst, thinly sliced on bias | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, fine grated | 1 jar green grape cluster | 2 cups cooked rice, cold | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 -3 drops hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange bratwurst on large plate. Sprinkle with grated lemon peel and grape cluster. Gently stir together rice with yogurt and hot pepper sauce. Spoon over bratwurst. Broil bratwurst 2 - 3 inches from heat until heated through, approximately 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,confectioner sugar,linguine,beef brisket,salmon fillet,red curry paste
title: Curry Salmon With Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs salmon fillets, skin removed | 6 ounces smoked salmon fillets, skinned ( or any other firm-fleshed fish ) | 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 cup plain heavy cream | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 2 teaspoons heavy cream | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 2 teaspoons heavy cream
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the salmon. Cut the fish in 1/4 inch thick slices crosswise. On a serving dish, arrange the salmon slices, skin sides down, in an overlapping pattern. Spread 1 tablespoon of red curry paste evenly over the salmon. Set aside at least 1/4 cup cream. Whip remaining cream in a small, heavy saucepan and cook over medium heat, just until it begins to boil. Remove from heat and whisk in the confectioners' sugar and curry paste. Let cool for a few minutes, whisking occasionally until thoroughly mixed. Pour the cream over the salmon and gently toss until well coated. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: tamari,red cabbage,ketchup,salt pepper,white breadcrumb,curry powder,fish,white onion
title: Thai Fish Balls
ingredients: 3 lbs firm white fish | 1 lb sweet white fish | 1/2 cup tamari | 3/4 cup red cabbage, finely shredded | 3/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup white onion, finely minced | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1/4 cup fresh white breadcrumb | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut fish into small pieces and put to one side. Mix tamari, sugar and curry powder together in a bowl. Pour some tamari mixture into a deep pan which has a lid, or in a bowl of water and put your fish pieces into this mixture. You may also put fish into the refrigerator to marinate. When you are ready to cook, dip fish in the mixture, being careful to keep the mixture inside the fish. When your fish is cooked, remove from pan. Remove the fish from the mixture and dry. Roll each piece in the breadcrumbs, coating well. Serve with green onion sauce.

title: Mexican-Style Broccoli Sprout Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup pimento-stuffed rice bubbles | 1/2 cup frozen broccoli florets, thawed ( pre-boiled ) | 1/2 cup frozen raspberries | 1/2 cup frozen mexican crema ( creme fraiche ) | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 1/2 bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Spray 2 qt casserole with cooking spray. Spread rice bubbles over the bottom of the casserole dish. Spoon peas, raspberries, and crema over rice bubbles. Top with bell pepper. Sprinkle with ground cloves. Cover and bake 25 minutes, uncover, sprinkle with diced tomatoes, and continue cooking 1/2 hour, or until rice bubbles are lightly browned.

title: Zucchini Tomato Chilies
ingredients: 1 zucchini | 1 small red onion | 1 -2 tablespoon diced tomato | 2 -4 canned diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Cut zucchini and red onion in thin slices. Place in a large frying pan with zucchini, red onion, diced tomato and green chilies. Add a little water and bring to the boil. Let it boil for five minutes. Lower temperature and cover. Let this cook for five minutes. Turn down heat to low, cook for an hour or two, stirring occasionally. Let the zucchini and other vegetables cool. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,kale,ice cube,poultry seasoning,red bell pepper,bratwurst
title: Grilled Bratwurst
ingredients: 1 lb raw bratwurst, diced | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup chopped red bell pepper | ice cube | 2 cups fresh kale, shredded | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning, blend
instructions: Combine bratwurst, cheese, and bell pepper in a medium bowl. Top with ice cubes. Prepare grill for direct cooking over medium high heat. Lightly salt kale. Place kale on grill rack 3 inches from heat. Close lid, and cook 2 minutes, or until kale is crisp tender. Remove from grill and sprinkle with poultry seasoning.

title: Dynamite (Vietnamese Cocktail)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/8 teaspoon black cardamom pod
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine ketchup, thyme, and cardamom.

Random Ingredients: japanese noodle,poblano chile,pizza sauce,ginger garlic paste,potato chip,parchment paper
title: Potato Chips Ramen
ingredients: 5 japanese dried potato chips, peeled | 1 bunch poblano chile, seeded and cut into thin slices | 1 tablespoon peeled grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1 package plain sliced napa ( about 16-20 ounce packages ) ramen noodles | parchment paper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Line 2 1/2 3x9 inch baking sheets with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Arrange potato chips in a single layer in a single layer on prepared baking sheets. Place chilies in a single layer on baking sheets. Bake chips 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned and puffed.

title: Thai Quickie
ingredients: 1 cup cauliflower floret | 1/2 cup thai sweet chili sauce | 2 teaspoons baking cocoa | 1 mango, cut in 6 wedges
instructions: Place cauliflower in a microwave safe dish and cover with foil. Cook on high power 4 minutes or until crisp tender. Stir cauliflower florets and sweet chili sauce into pan.

title: The Easiest Shrimp and Beef Kebabs in the Food Processor
ingredients: 1 can large shrimp | 1 1/2 lbs lean beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 10 ladyfingers | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: In a food processor, process shrimp, beef, and garam masala until fine particles are formed. Transfer to a bowl and stir in 1 cup of cheese. Thread three shrimp onto each skewer. Place skewers onto a rack over a baking sheet covered with foil. Place baking sheet in the freezer for about 30 minutes or until set. Remove shrimp and set aside to cool. Preheat grill. Remove shrimp from freezer and place on skewers, with marinade. Grill kebabs for 5 to 6 minutes, or until pink and opaque. Serve on buns.

title: Pumpkin Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons pumpkin puree | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 cup chopped cashews | 2 tablespoons fresh grape leaves, lightly toasted
instructions: Combine pumpkin and anise seeds.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,red potato,chicken stock,sugar snap pea,phyllo dough,wood chip
title: Vegetable Phyllo Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/4 lbs small red potatoes ( about 2-1/2 lbs. total ) | 24 sheets frozen phyllo dough ( about 15 sheets ) | 1 lb sugar snap pea ( about 1 cup ) | 14 ounces chicken stock | 1 large green cardamom pod, crushed | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/2 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the unpeeled potatoes in a large saucepan and pour in enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and transfer to a mixing bowl. Stir in 1 1/4 lbs of the phyllo dough, followed by 1 1/2 lbs of the snow peas. Sprinkle 1/2 cups of the sugar snap peas on top. Spread on the remaining phyllo dough on top. Working with one sheet at a time, spray a 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray. Place remaining 5 sheets, covered with a clean napkin, in a third round layer over the phyllo dough and trim overhanging sides. Repeat with the remaining sheets and snow peas. Divide and spread 1/4 cups of the chicken stock and 1/4 cup of sugar in the baking dish. Place the whole cardamom pods, cut sides up, on top of the stock and sugar. Dot with nuts. Dot generously with remaining phyllo dough. Bake the casserole for 15 minutes or until the top is golden brown and crisp.

title: Asian Steamed Bun
ingredients: 1 head fresh lettuce, such as arugula or lettuce hearts | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Line a 2 cup steamer basket with leaves of lettuce, shiny side down. Place a large plate on top of the lettuce, and mound the steamed buns in the plate. Lightly press the tops of the buns together to seal in any steam. Steam for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the bud is golden brown and firm to the touch. Transfer to a serving platter and carefully remove the steamer basket and serve immediately. You can also steam a long handled bamboo rolling pin with a little water for a grip. I prefer this method as the oil oozes out of the rolled buns when i remove them from the steamer.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,orange blossom water,cilantro,radish,green bean,grain white rice
title: Green Beans Rice Pilaf (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 13)
ingredients: 500 g long grain white rice | 1 tablespoon orange blossom water ( or other flavourless orange liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 1/2 bunch cilantro, leaves only | 200 g fresh green beans, cleaned | 1 small radish, peeled and chopped
instructions: Boil your rice in lots of lightly salted water until the rice is cooked, then drain any excess water, then stir it through the orange blossom water. Set aside to cool slightly. Pile your cooked rice, cilantro leaves and radishes onto 4 x 5 serving dishes that have been sprayed with cooking spray. Sprinkle over any remaining orange blossom water, and mix thoroughly. Serve cold.

title: Pesto Spread
ingredients: 1 cup fresh basil pesto | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Prepare your spread recipe to the correct flavor, using a food processor or blender. If a spread is too thick, add a little milk or water. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,tomato juice,pineapple chunk,chinese five spice powder,chicken breast half,chive,yeast
title: Chilled Chinese Chicken Baked in Sunflower
ingredients: 1 can tomato juice | 1 3/4 cups tomato juice | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 8 ounces spaghetti | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Cover a large bowl of water with tomato juice. Combine the tomato juice and yeast.

Random Ingredients: oil,sesame seed,grain white rice,cake flour,vegetarian bean,pearl barley,white wine vinegar
title: Japanese-Style Rice & Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 package vegetarian refried beans | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 cup pearl barley | 1/3 cup oil | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 cups short-grain white rice | 1 3/4 cups cake flour
instructions: Combine the beans and sesame seeds in a large bowl. Cook the rice if in a saucepan, in boiling water until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and let cool. Place the rice in a large bowl. Toss with the refried beans and sesame seeds. To make the dressing, whisk together the oil, vinegar, and sugar in a small bowl. Add the rice to the dressing and toss to combine. The dressing should be slightly tart. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly flour an 8x8 inch baking dish and set aside. Pour the rice and bean mixture into the baking dish and bake for 20 minutes, or until heated through and slightly browned. Serve immediately or cool and refrige for several hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,pappardelle pasta,chili powder,garlic powder,chocolate,lettuce leaf,pink grapefruit
title: Chili Pappardelle with Grapfruit Truffles
ingredients: 1/2 cup pappardelle pasta or 1/2 cup other tubular pasta | 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate, coarsely chopped | 6 tablespoons thick coconut cream, cut into thin strips | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 8 green colored grapefruit pieces, halved | 6 lettuce leaves or 6 red leaf lettuce leaves, separated | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons sweet papardelle-infused chili powder, for sprinkling on finished cookies
instructions: Cook the linguine or pappardelle in a large pot of water with the chocolate shavings, until just tender. Drain, rinse, and set aside. Meanwhile in a heatproof bowl set over a pan of simmering water, melt the coconut cream. Stir the hot chocolate into the coconut cream. To serve, transfer to a serving bowl, drizzle with the pappardelle and drizzle with the spicy coconut mixture.

title: Easy Mexican Ranch Appy
ingredients: 3 -4 lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons ranch dressing
instructions: Place lettuce leaves on a platter and dress with ranch dressing.

title: Lobster Crepes (Lobster Crepes)
ingredients: 20 mange-touts peas ( dried lobster ) | 6 tablespoons margarine | 12 -16 cooked lobster tails
instructions: Place the mange tout peas on a plate and microwave them on medium high 3 - 4 minutes then flip them over and repeat same 2 minutes. When they are just cooked remove them from microwave and place them on a plate and cut them into thin slices. Heat 1/2 tablespoon margarine in pan over med heat. Add lobster and saute 3 - 4 minutes. Remove lobster from pan and top with mange tout pea slices. Sprinkle with cajun spices of your choice.

title: Garlic Paste (For Recipes Needing Almonds)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1 can almond paste
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a food processor. Store in an airtight container.

title: Nonna's Easy Orange and Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 1 orange | 16 fresh mint leaves | crouton ( as much as desired, but lots of use in the salad dress ) ( optional )
instructions: Peel the orange and grate the zest from both halves. Using a juicer, zest the orange and mince the orange. You can also use a mini food processor with a small amount of juiced juice but remember to keep the juice in the fridge until you're ready to serve it. Once the juice is extracted from the zest, add the mint leaves to each bite and keep in mind that they will be served chilled. Remove the rind from the orange and finely chop. Toss the orange and mint with the croutons. Garnish with mint sprigs and/or mint sprigs if desired.

title: White Beans With Crab, Jackassons and Cashews (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 3 cans white beans, drained and rinsed | 8 ounces fresh crab, cleaned, dried, and flaked | 3/4 yellow onion, diced | 1/3 cup raw cashews, chopped | 8 -10 toothpicks | 1/4 cup dried breadcrumbs | toast and cashews, for serving | 2 quarts guinness
instructions: The night before you need to prepare this, preheat your oven broiler to high. Put the beans, crab, onion, cashews, bread crumbs on to metal or glass baking sheets and press lightly into the beans with your hands to cover them evenly. Put the tray of beans under the broiler until they are hot, approximately 2 minutes or so. About 1 - 5 minutes. Place one toothpick into each of 8 bowls. Ladle the bean/sauce mixture into the bowls, spreading it into the corners of the bowls so that it makes a nice rounded top. Serve warm. Top with more dried bread crumbs, if desired. Enjoy, note that this is very hot and you can add fish sticks and serve with crackers, if you wish.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,yellow onion,soho lychee liqueur,stuffing mix,phyllo dough,savory,green pepper
title: Mini Phyllo Pastry Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tarragon, chopped small | 1 tablespoon savory, chopped small | 1 cup mixed salad green pepper, chopped small | 1/2 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 1/2 cups seasoned stuffing mix | 1/3 cup soyho lychee liqueur | 20 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Mix seasonings and vegetables thoroughly. Set aside. Take a piece of phyllo dough and brush lightly with egg white, and place a tablespoon of the stuffing mixture on the bottom of a large baking dish, and place the phyllo sheets on top of the stuffing mix. Take another phyllo sheet and brush generously with egg white, and place a third sheet on top of the first, and repeat layering until all the dough is used. Bake in 375 degree oven for 15 - 15 minutes. After 10 minutes, remove from oven, and cut each in half diagonally. Place each half diagonally on a plate, cover, and allow to sit. After 10 - 15 minutes, cut one in half diagonally. Take out one half of phyllo dough to create a 'case' for each roll. Open, and spoon some stuffing mix length down the centre, and spread out flat. Continue until all phyllo has been used, then sprinkle a little more stuffing mixture onto the centre. Wrap this half of phyllo on top. You should have 6 - 8 'laps'. Repeat this process until you have made 6 'pops'. Place the baking dishes on a baking rack, and place over medium heat. Once they are heated, place each quarter pent into a cup, and with a toothpicks or two, poke a small steam hole all over the tops, or you can use a fork to cut a hole in the bottom of the phyllo, and then place in the oven. Allow them to cook for 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from oven, and cut each quarter diagonally to serve.

title: Italian Marinated  Beet Salad With Fresh Salsa
ingredients: 3/4 cup blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( i used homemade ) | 1/2 cup mild pepperoni, sliced ( deli-style ) | 1/2 cup red pepperoncino pepperoni | 1/2 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup onion, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh sweet tarragon ( or 1 t. dried ) | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon orange peel, grated
instructions: Combine well, chill for an hour or so. Just before serving, combine all ingredients in a bowl. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: green olive,juniper berry,garlic paste,garlic clove,nonstick cooking spray,sugar snap pea,passion fruit
title: Spanish Panna Cotta With Peas and Prosciutto
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces garlic paste ( to taste ) or 2 1/2 ounces garlic powder ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 ounces onions ( to taste ) or 1 1/2 ounces shallots, diced | 1/2 ounce green olives, preferably chamottes, preferably stuffed with chamottes | 1/2 ounce juniper berries ( preferably juniper berries ) | 7 large garlic cloves, very finely chopped | nonstick cooking spray | 1 teaspoon sugar snap pea, trimmed | 1 -2 canned passion fruit
instructions: Combine garlic paste, onion, green olives, garlic, and juniper berries in a food processor or mortar and pestle and mash very coarsely, with the metal blade attached. Add the chopped garlic and process again until smooth.. Spray a 2 to 2 1/2 quart souffle or round baking dish with nonstick spray coating. Cover with plastic wrap and cook in a small preheated 325°f oven until a thermometer registers 210°f remove plastic wrap and let sit just to cool. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Using tongs, dip your hands in the water and then quickly drop the dough into the boiling water. Cook, stirring, until the panna cotta is just firm to the touch but slightly crumbly, 1 to 2 minutes. Drain on a large plate. To serve, top with the passionfruit pulp and panna cotta. Garnish with a sprinkling of sliced french toasted gouda cheese.

title: Banana Curry With Chicken
ingredients: 4 large bananas, sliced | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 cups arborio rice | 6 -8 boneless skinless chicken breasts, flattened | 1/3 cup grand marnier or 1/3 cup cointreau liqueur ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Saute banana in a large skillet or wok over medium heat for about 1 min or until crisp.

title: Molly's Broccoli Potato Hazelnut Soup
ingredients: 4 tablespoons potato flour | 2 cloves chicken bouillon cubes | 1 lb broccoli, cut into florets | 1/2 cup hazelnuts or 1/2 cup almonds
instructions: Heat flour and bouillon in pot. Add broccoli and hazelnuts or almonds. Bring to boil. Boil 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust pie,grape tomato,rye bread,apple juice,pistachio,rom tomato
title: Grape tomato tomato and Pistachio Pie
ingredients: 1 pastry for a double-crust pie | 85 grape tomatoes | 85 g roma tomatoes | 120 ml apple juice | 1 tablespoon chopped pistachios | 1/2 crusty rye bread
instructions: Place half the grape tomatoes on the base of a small greased baking, or tart tin, then top with the chopped roma tomatoes, cut side down, and spoon over most of the apple juice. Top with the other half of the pie crust. Combine the pistachios and half the butter and half the water, and brush generously over the top of the pie. Bake in a moderate oven for approximately 40 minutes, or until golden and bubbly. Remove from the oven and cool for a few minutes. Cut a cross into the the top of the pie through the top crust and serve. Garnish with minted pistachios and sliced roma tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,egg,spinach,white corn,extra virgin olive oil,caster sugar,peppercorn
title: Spinach With Pepper Frittata (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 250 g spinach, fresh washed, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 120 g of fresh white corn, shucked ( or 2 cups frozen chopped spinach ) | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons peppercorns, cracked | 3 eggs | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Heat the oven to 170c. Put all the vegetable ingredients into a food processor, and process until you have a paste. Put the mix into an ovenproof dish large enough to fit all of the ingredients, and sprinkle with the grated cheese and some freshly cracked peppercorns. Drizzle over a little olive oil just to give it a good coating of olive oil. Bake in the oven for about 90 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Beef Stew With Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow potatoes, sliced | 24 ounces sliced canned artichokes, drained | 12 ounces sliced bamboo shoots, drained, reserving juice | 2 cups beef broth or 2 cups mushroom broth | 16 dill pickles, rinsed and quartered
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pickles. Cover and cook over low heat until potatoes are tender and broth reduces to about 2 1/8 cups. Serve with dill pickle wedges.

title: Aar-Punjab Kabob With a Nutty Apple Teaser!
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons extra vigin'natural oats | 1 1/2 tablespoons walnuts | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried cherries | 3 tablespoons roasted peanuts ( optional ) | 1 medium ripe mango | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 medium sized red shallot | 1 fresh jalapeno, thinly sliced
instructions: First take the oats and ground walnuts in a food processor or blender. Process them with the cherries and almonds. Add the mango, oil, asafetida, and chopped shallot and pulse it together to blend them into a semi smooth chunky puree. Add more oil if needed for the mixture to be really thick. Taste for seasoning and correct for salt if needed. Serve with pita or nan bread.

title: Flounder With Salsa (Bread and Cocoa)
ingredients: 4 ounces flounder fillets | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa, divided | 1/4 cup salsa ( your favorite ) | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa ( for dusting ) | 1/4 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa ( for dusting ) | 4 slices italian bread thick french
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line broiler pan with foil, spray with non stick cooking spray. If the fillets are thicker than an inch or so, you may need to use a knife to cut the length of them. Place the fillets in a single layer in a shallow baking dish. Set aside. In a small bowl, stir 2 tablespoons cocoa with the salsa. Brush the salsa mixture evenly on both sides of the fillets. Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup cocoa evenly over the top of the fillets. Broil the fillets, 2 or 3 inches above the heat for 6 or 8 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. To serve, place a piece of loaf on a plate. Place 2 or 3 fillets on top, and spoon some salsa onto the side.

title: Bundi
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 4 bananas, sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon banana liqueur | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander powder
instructions: Roll out pastry onto lightly floured surface. Cut out 4 circles and place on lightly floured cookie sheet. Bake at 170c/375f/ gas mark 2 for about 20 - 25 minutes or until pastry is firm. Remove from oven and let stand for 5 mins, then brush pastry with liqueur. Return to oven and bake for 15 minutes or until light golden. Cut into 4 triangles and scatter over filling. Return to oven and bake for an remaining 15 min or until fruit is just turning golden.

title: Italian Peppers
ingredients: 8 medium bell peppers | 1/2 cup italian-style parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease large baking sheets. Cut tops off bell peppers. Cut off stem and top halves to form 2 boats. Place on baking sheets. Sprinkle bell peppers with parsley and crumbs. Bake in preheated oven until peppers are tender and lightly browned, about 25 minutes.

title: Beetroot Tacos
ingredients: 12 large, leafy lettuce - rinsed, dried, torn up, and refrigerated | 1 jar chunky salsa
instructions: Arrange lettuce on a rimmed baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: stock,yellow cornmeal,butternut squash,clam juice,pearl barley,yellow squash,stewing beef
title: Beef & Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 large yellow squash, chopped | 2 large yellow squash, chopped | 1 cup frozen pearl barley | 1 large butternut squash, peeled and cubed ( about 1 3/4 cups ) | 2 cups tomato-flavored clam juice or 2 cups tomato juice | 2 cups stock | 2 teaspoons yellow cornmeal ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons coarsely ground porridge seed ( optional )
instructions: In a dutch oven, brown meat and vegetables in tomato soup base or stock. Add water to almost cover, about 1 1/2 cups, and bring to boil. Skim foam as it rises. Lower heat, cover, and simmer 30 - 35 minutes or until meat is tender, adding more water if necessary. If using broth made from left over meat, simmer on top of heat for 15 minute stir in cornmeal or porridge. Serve over brown rice.

title: Nuoc Leo-Yukon
ingredients: 10 small dried red chilies | 1 tablespoon soya sauce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place chiles through a food mill or coffee grinder. Stir soya sauce into chiles and grind into fine bread crumbs. Serve as a snack or as a sweeten condiment.

title: Gravlax Pork Burger
ingredients: 4 lean pork chops | 2 italian sausages | 2 large red capsicums | 1/4 red low-fat asiago cheese, finely grated
instructions: Place your pork chops into a large bowl. Add the sausagemeat and peppers and mix together gently in a bowl. Grate the cheese into your bowl and press the mixture into the surface of the meat. Place the pork onto a tray lined with baking paper and flatten it out out slightly. Cover with cling film and refrigerate for 15 minutes, then remove the cling film and slice them into thick slices using a sharp, shallow knife. Preheat the grill to its highest point and set the tray inside. When the tray is ready, remove the meat and peppers from the bowl and place them on a chopping board. Use your fingers to pound them into a flat patty shape about 1 1/2cm thick. Arrange them on a tray lined with baking paper and grill them for 4 - 5 minutes on each side, or until they are nice and brown about 10 minutes. Serve the meat and peppers on a bun, with asiago on the side.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,celery,lemon,bulk italian sausage,vegetable oil,salsa,self raising flour
title: Sausage Sausage Fiesta
ingredients: 200 g bulk italian sausage | 200 g yellow bell peppers, halved ( or regular bell pepper ) | 1 1/2 cups vegetables ( of your choice, such as corn, peas, peppers, carrots etc. ) | 1 red lemons or 1 orange | 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 1/4 cup salsa | 1/2 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Cook italian sausage, peppers and onion in a frying pan. Drain and add 3 cups of water and let it simmer for 15 minutes. You may also cover with a lid for a couple of minutes. Once cooked put aside to cool. Topping, mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl. Pour the sausage mix into individual, but large, loaf tins. Bake for 1 hour or until it is browned on top. It should feel nice and crusty in the middle.

title: Homemade Strawberry Jam Cookies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crystal sugar | 1 tablespoon tahini | 2 tablespoons self rising flour ( unbleached, unsifted ) | 5 ounces strawberry jam
instructions: Sift the flour onto a floured board, make a well in the centre, and add the sugar and tahini. Mix with your hands until you have mixed. Wrap in waxed paper and leave to rest in a cool place for 30 minutes. Melt the jam and mix into the dough using your hands.
