Divide into 15 parts and roll each out thinly on a floured board, using a heart shaped cookie cutter. Cut out the hearts of the cookies with a pizza cutter, and place onto a greased baking sheet. Bake at 190 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes until golden, then allow to cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Greek Yogurt Parcels
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 2 cups greek yogurt
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain the bacon slices on a paper towel lined plate. Toast the bacon in the skillet until they have begun to release some of the bacon grease and are beginning to crisp around edges. Set aside on a paper towel lined plate. In a medium bowl, stir together the yogurt and bacon grease until well blended. Pour yogurt mixture into the skillet and let it bubble for about 5 minutes. When the parcels are warm through, remove with a spoon. Transfer to a serving platter.

title: Kheema Matzalan - Khemara Beef With Kumara
ingredients: 500 g kumara, cut into 4cm cubes | 1 teaspoon red chili powder ( or adjust to suit ) | 125 g beef sirloin steaks, cut into 8 pieces | 125 g feta ( or any other natural filling of your choice ) | 1 cup low-fat yogurt | 1 packet refrigerated biscuits
instructions: Line a 24cm x 34cm baking dish with baking paper. Place kumara in a medium saucepan of boiling water and cook for 10 minutes or until just tender. Drain and allow to cool slightly, then transfer to a large serving bowl. Stir in chilli powder. Season with salt and pepper. Add beef and stir to coat. Fold in feta and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. Preheat a griddle or large frying pan over very medium high heat and add biscuits. Cook for just 1–2 minutes until crisp and golden. Transfer to a plate. Spoon meat mixture into biscuits. Serve.

title: Italian Monkey Salad
ingredients: 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup finely chopped pepperoni | 1/2 cup finely chopped raisins
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except raisins. Mix well. Place in a 1 1/2 quart casserole. Cover and sprinkle with raisins. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,chicken thigh,chicken bouillon cube,chili paste,granny smith apple,red pepper
title: Spicy Chicken Satay
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 2 inch segments | 1 container barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet pickled sweet red peppers, or to taste ( optional ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons hot chili paste | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored,, and cut into cubes
instructions: Place chicken thighs in a large resealable plastic bag and pour in barbeque sauce and sweet pickled red pepper. Seal bag and marinate chicken in the refrigerator 2 to 8 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Remove chicken from bag, reserving marinade in marinade. Stir chicken, chicken broth, and chili paste into marinade in the bag.

Random Ingredients: mace,onion,green onion,cream,tomato green chilies,saffron thread,dill sprig,turkey
title: Moroccan Turkey Tagine
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs turkey, bone in and skin removed | 1 medium onion, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3 green onions, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 2 saffron threads | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup sour cream | fresh dill sprig
instructions: Place turkey in bottom of a 9 inch pie plate or roasting pan. Sprinkle with onion and green onions. Spoon tomato's over turkey and top with saffron. Place the remaining onion slices over tomatoes. In small bowl, combine sour cream and mace. Sprinkle over turkey. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove chicken from marinade and place on top of onions and tomatoes. Cover and bake 45 minutes at uncover and bake 20 additional minutes until juices run clear. Serve with hot cooked rice.

title: Cornish Style Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line a large baking pan with aluminum foil. Place brisket onto foil. In a bowl, combine tomato puree and water.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,beef sirloin steak,curry powder,riesling wine,sirloin steak
title: Curry Beef Steak (Pressure Cooker for 2)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 lb boneless beef sirloin steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 beef top sirloin steaks, cut into 1/2 inch thick strips | 2 large dried red chilies, seeded and cut into thin slivers | hoisin sauce or rice wine vinegar, to taste
instructions: Mix the curry powder with 1/2 cup of the water, then place the beef into the pressure cooker.

title: Baily's Chicken Dessert
ingredients: 125 g chicken tenders | 1/2 cup golden rum | 3 teaspoons irish cream | 2 tablespoons sultanas or 2 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Toss the chicken in the golden rum, add sultanas and serve.

title: Spaghetti With Bread Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1 can sliced dried fruit | 1 package cream cheese, softened | bread, toasted and cubed, if desired ( use your favorite bread )
instructions: Bring a medium pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add spaghetti and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Grilled Bonito Shakes
ingredients: 24 cubes bonito shake, with tails removed | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon mexican oregano, leaves picked from stems
instructions: Put the bonito shake tails on a cutting surface and flatten each piece of shake with a sharp knife. The goal is to flatten all the shake. Sprinkle each portion evenly with salt and pepper and sprinkle with oregano. Sliced, about one/3 cup per serving, makes 2 1/2 ounce servings.

title: Chinese Fruit Salad (Cha Siu)
ingredients: 1/2 can pineapple chunks in natural juice, undrained | 2 teaspoons sesame oil ( dark )
instructions: Drain and rinse the cans of pineapple and let them sit at room temperature for about 15 minutes for the flavors to mix, until the pineapple chunks are cool enough to handle. Drain and discard the juice. Whisk together the sesame oil and 1 - 2 teaspoons of the pineapple juice, and drizzle over the pineapple. Toss lightly and enjoy.

title: Simple Cheesy French Onion Soup With Soba
ingredients: 12 ounces soy milk | 2 cups chicken broth | 0.75 package taco seasoning, with soba ( we prefer laural ) | 1 cup gruyere
instructions: Mix all together in a sauce pan and bring to a boil. Once soup is boiling, turn off heat and allow soup to sit for 10 minutes. Top each serving with soba and cheese.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,pastry crust pie,red chile,pecorino romano cheese,hot red chili pepper,dark beer,mix
title: Red Velvet Cupcakes
ingredients: 1 cup sour mix, divided ( like guiness or smoky brown sugar ) | 1/4 cup dry hot red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon red chile, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 bottle dark beer | 1/4 cup coarse sea salt | 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie ( see note below ) | 4 ounces pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated ( about 1/2 cup, about 3/4 cup if using pecorino cheese )
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup sour cream, chili peppers, red chile and cheese in bowl. Place beer, remaining 3/4 cup sour cream and salt in medium bowl. Place remaining 1 cup sour cream, cheese mixture and chile mixture in another bowl. Place tart pan on table. Using 1/4 pound weight/portion of dough, place on plate on dry side of plate. Using 1/2 teaspoon crust dough for each cupcake, roll dough into a 24 inch circle about 12 inches/17 inches high and 1/4 inch thick. Using 4 to 8 ounce coin shaped slices for each cupcake, cut through bottom and up sides of cupcakes to form four 24 inch/22 inch thick coins. Using 12 inch piece, place 2 coin shaped dough coins on top of the circle in overlapping slices alternatildly. Carefully press around edges of cupcakes with knife. Using a 1/8 teaspoon, lightly press each of the 4 coin slices between 2 pieces of parchment or waxed paper. Place whole cupcake on paper lined baking sheet. Using a 1/2 teaspoon floured hands or a large sharp knife, score cupcakes in a cross hatch pattern, 1 inch apart, by pulsing 2 times in a row direction and 1 inch spacing. Bake in a 375f oven for about 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 350f and bake for about 10 to 15 minutes more, or until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in center of cupcake comes out dry. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Fill each cupcake half with one rounded teaspoonful of the sweet potato mixture. Garnish with a little grated pecorino romano cheese if desired. To serve, slice each cupcake in 1/4 inch slices. Drizzle each cupcake with red chili flavored liqueur or pisco. Note, a 1/2 cup sour cream can also be added for more tang.

Random Ingredients: sausage,chicken broth,chinese five spice powder,thai chili sauce
title: Baked Thai Sausage-Cambodian Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb chinese sausage, casings removed | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 4 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Arrange sausage in a single layer on a large piece of foil. In a small saucepan, bring chicken broth to a boil. Stir in chai sweet chili sauce and five spice powder. Pour into a medium baking dish, then arrange sausage over the top. Bake, basting occasionally with broth, 1 hour, or until well browned and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,marsala wine,matzo meal,pineapple juice,blackberry,cabbage,hoagie,oregano leaf
title: Spicy Holiday Salad With a Passport Pretzel
ingredients: 1 bag shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine | 1 jar pineapple juice | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian parsley leaves | 1/2 lb shredded fresh cold cashews or 1/2 lb fresh matzo meal | 1/4 lb fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/2 lb fresh soft blackberries
instructions: Boil the 2 cups of water. Add the shredded cabbage, marsala wine, pineapple juice and green pepper. Stir, and cook for about 20 minutes, while you make the pretzel. To make the pretzels, mix the cashews and parsley together in a bowl. Add the cashew nut mixture to the cabbage and pepper and stir until the nuts are coated with the spice. Toss with the cashews and parsley mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: multi sprinkle,cream mushroom soup,red chili pepper,parsley,milk ricotta cheese
title: Cheesy Red Chili
ingredients: 250 g whole milk ricotta cheese ( about 4 cups ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can chopped red chili peppers | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup plain yogurt | fresh parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the sour cream and garnish and let chill until serving time. Serve with your favourite hot vegetable or bread.

title: Ethiopian Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken thighs | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup milk | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 8 -10 pitted prunes | 1/2 cup ketchup
instructions: Mix mayonnaise, 1/2 cup ketchup, milk, and cardamom together. Add to chicken pieces. Marinate overnight. Heat remaining 1/2 cup ketchup.

title: Grilled Joes
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped green pepper | 4 ounces thinly sliced pepperoni ( about 12 slices ) | 2 tablespoons kirsch | 1 teaspoon ginger | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 4 hoagie rolls | 12 sage leaves | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet, grill the green and red pepper slices until the strips have softened and the strips are just beginning to brown. Remove from heat and transfer to a blender. Add the remaining ingredients except for the rolls and garnish with more fresh sprigs of herbs. Cover and blend until smooth. Spread a little of the mustard over each roll half. Place on a preheated griddle or broiler pan and cook. Brush the tops of each with a little mustard, then grill, brushing with the remaining mustard, until golden, about an additional 2 - 3 minutes. Remove and slice diagonally. Serve, garnished with a lime wedge and a fresh herb sprig. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,brown bean sauce,cocoa powder,tortilla,chorizo sausage,dill,onion
title: Chocolate Stuffed Chorizo Wraps
ingredients: 1/3 cup light brown beans in chili sauce ( dark chocolate sauce ) | 2 ounces spanish dark semi-sweet chocolate, chopped | 2 teaspoons dill ( or a mixture of dill and mint leaves ) | 1 large spiced onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons cocoa powder | 1/4 lb chorizo sausage or 1/4 lb italian sausage, cooked and roughly chopped | 6 large tortillas | 1/2 teaspoon soft brown bean sauce
instructions: Cook chorizo in pan over medium heat, breaking up with wooden spoon, until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Add chopped onion. Reduce heat to low and cook until onion caramelizes. Meanwhile, in small saucepan, combine chorizo, warm brown bean sauce, chocolate, dill weed and cocoa. Heat until chocolate melts. Remove from heat. Using damp hands, spread 2 teaspoons brown bean sauce over each tortilla.

title: Capsicum & Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans ( i have substituted white kidney beans ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seed ( seeds & pieces ) | 1/2 bay leaf | 1 teaspoon catsup | 1 small cauliflower floret, finely chopped
instructions: Drain beans & add all other ingredients. Chill before serving.

title: Spiced Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 hamburger ( i use chuck ) | 1/4 cup pancetta ( you can use bacon if you wish ) | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 cup lettuce leaf | 4 fresh red chilies or 4 canned red chilies | extra hamburger bun, cut in 4s
instructions: Make your sauce by combining the above ingredients and using a blender or food processor to add some more liquid until you have a paste like consistency you desire. Put sauce onto the meat roll ups and enjoy with garlic toast, french or italian rolls are nice.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,garlic clove,currant,cremini mushroom,bread crumb,provolone cheese
title: Creamy Mushrooms Con Cari-Prosciutto
ingredients: 4 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced ( or any other fresh mushrooms ) | 1/4 cup currants | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 2 tablespoons raisins or 2 tablespoons dried currants | 1/2 cup bread crumbs ( optional ) | 2 ounces provolone cheese, shredded
instructions: Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. In a bowl, combine mushrooms, currants, and soy yogurt. Mix well. In another bowl, combine garlic, raisins, and bread crumbs. Sprinkle over mushrooms and toss thoroughly. Put on the cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray the baking sheet with cooking spray. Spoon the mushroom paste equally into the casserole. Sprinkle cheese over the top of each mushroom. Bake for 15 - 18 minutes or until golden. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: fine egg noodle,chili powder,pork loin chop,ancho chile,cauliflower
title: Ancho Chile Pork Skillet Con Papas Gringo
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried ancho chiles | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin chops, 3/4 inch cubes | 2 cups uncooked fine egg noodles, about 48 ounces | 1/2 cup chopped cauliflower
instructions: Cook chili in a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat, stirring often, 1 minute. Cook pork, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 3 minutes. Stir in noodles, cauliflower and chili.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,wheat flour,saffron,chicken leg,double cream,catsup,carrot,red miso
title: French Crock Pot Chicken
ingredients: 1 -3 lb chicken leg | 3 large carrots, cut into chunks | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup double cream | 1/3 cup catsup | 1/4 cup red miso | 2 tablespoons saffron | 1 dash saffron strands | 1/3 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat crock pot on low heat. Toss all ingredients in the crock pot. Cook on high 4 - 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: red wine,sea salt,white rice flour,sherry wine
title: Rice Flour Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white rice flour | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/2 - 3/4 cup red wine ( depending on your taste ) | sea salt, to taste
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix until you have a smooth dough. Knead well for at least an hour and then divide into 3 equal portions. Spread each portion into an 8 inch square cake pan. Spread each section with your favourite sweet and sour sauce or your favourite dry sauce mix. If you’re using your favourite sauce mix, make sure it is as sweet as possible. Bake in a preheated oven for about 40 - 45 minutes at 375 degrees. Allow to sit for 5 minutes, then cut into squares and serve.

title: Apple Gravy
ingredients: 2 granny smith apples | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Peel, core and grate apples. Transfer to a bowl. Add cornflour to apple liquid. Leave in fridge for 10 - 15 minutes until thickened.

title: Rosti
ingredients: 1 large russet potato | 2 1/2 tablespoons pickle relish | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Scrub potato under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and cook potato until tender, about 25 minutes. Remove potato to a large bowl of ice water, drain, and allow to cool until easily handled. Slice potato into 3/4 inch thick slices. Place sliced potatoes in the bowl. Stir pickle relish into potato slices. Sprinkle cardamom over top, and spread around the rusets. Using a spoon, gently press mixture down into a 2 inch patty tin. Place pan into oven to bake in a preheated oven until crisp, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,barley,white vinegar,muenster cheese,ham,plain yogurt,green cardamom pod,plantain
title: Yogurt Marinated Plantains With Ham and Muenster Cheese - Ka Halva
ingredients: 2 large ripe plantains, peeled | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 slices ham ( thin slices or squares ) | 3 tablespoons barley ( soaked in fresh milk and drained ) | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pod | sliced muenster cheese or mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cut the length of the plantains lengthwise and cut each diagonally into 1/8 slices. With a mallet, pound each slice to 1/4 inch thick. Drain the plantains thoroughly, placing the slices between sheets of wax paper laid on the counter. Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. When hot, add the ham and cook for 2 minutes. Remove the ham and add the barley and simmer over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the vinegar and cardamom and mix well. Stir in the saucers. Dip the whole plantain slices first in the warm marinade, then into the saucers. Heat the remaining marinade over low heat until the sauce just begins to coat the slices. Arrange the saucers in a shallow dish or on a platter and cook the bananas on top. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese or serve with bread for sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: watercress,pork roast,apple butter,pineapple juice,sage leaf,saffron thread,salad oil
title: Saffron Pork Roast With Apples
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 pork roast | 1 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/8 teaspoon ground sage leaves | 500 ml pineapple juice | 300 ml watercress, halved | 1 apple, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a large roasting tin. Rub saffron along the skin of the meat, add the sage and saffron mix well. Add a tin of pineapple juice, the watercress and a carrot if using and stir. Cover the tin and cook in the oven at 180°c for 3 hours. Allow the pork to rest before carving. Remove the meat and keep warm and drain the juices from the tin. Discard the saffron mixture. Use the juices from the tin to cook the meat after it's sliced. Serve the pork with the apple slices on top.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,beef broth,tahini,beef tenderloin,green cardamom,vanilla pudding,red pepper sauce
title: Coconut-Seared Beef With Tahini Pudding
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons powdered beef broth ( sifted ) | 2 tablespoons beef broth ( sifted ) | 2 large green cardamom | 1 tablespoon vanilla pudding ( or other flavor ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot red pepper sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place rack in middle of oven and preheat oven to 300 degrees. Warm coconut oil in a non stick frying pan over medium heat and let it sizzle until it starts to brown, about a minute. Be careful so you don't burn the coconut oil add the beef.

title: Chickpea Soup
ingredients: 250 g dried garbanzo beans | 200 g dried banana peppers | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 2 teaspoons dried dill weed | 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Wash the chickpeas and remove any foreign matter. Place all of the ingredients into a large stockpot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 40 minutes or until chickpeas are tender. Serve hot, garnished with finely chopped coriander sprigs and a good grinding of pepper, if you like.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,basil,red wine,cherry tomato,russet potato,yogurt
title: Red Winey Russet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 russet potato, cut into bite size pieces | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 3 tablespoons red wine | 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 12 cherry tomatoes | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese or 8 ounces gouda cheese, shredded
instructions: Place potato pieces and dried basil in a microwave safe bowl. Pour red wine over, cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. Combine yogurt and cheese and stir together. Stir the yogurt cheese mixture into the potatoes. Microwave for 2 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. Turn the potatoes over and microwave on high for about 20 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes, until potatoes are tender, stirring every 3 - 4 minutes. Transfer to a serving dish and serve.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,sparkling wine,ginger root,farfalle pasta,ginger garlic paste
title: Spiced Marinated Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound large farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger root | 1 cup dry sparkling wine | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the bow tie pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Discard the water remaining in the pot. Combine the fresh ginger root, fresh ginger root, sparkling wine, and superfine sugar in a mortar or a blender.

title: Lime and Tequila Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 cup tequila | 1/8 cup dried marjoram | 1 lime, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water. In a large tequila glass, combine the linguine and tequila. Sprinkle with marjoram and lime wedges, and serve.

title: Fancy Banana Peppers
ingredients: 4 large ripe bananas, peeled, halved lengthways | 4 lettuce leaves | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180c degrees. Spray a roastingpan with cooking spray. Slice the tops off the bananas to form 2 long sticks.

title: Pork and Prosciutto Hash
ingredients: 4 -6 large new potatoes, small, unpeeled | 5 slices prosciutto | 5 tablespoons dashi | 4 tablespoons romano cheese, grated | 1 can rotel tomatoes | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees put unpeeled potatoes into a medium sized roasting dish. Wrap prosciutto around potatoes and top with 1 - 2 tablespoons of dashi, the cheese and the rotel tomatoes. Pour the rest of the dashi over.

title: South African Tamarind Eggs
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 2 tablespoons mixed spice ( see note below ) | 4 cups fresh corn kernels ( or 1 large frozen corn cob ) | 2 tablespoons masala ( see note below )
instructions: Peel eggs and chop in small pieces. Slice eggs, including yolks. Mix together in a bowl with cornstarch, masala, and 2 - 3 tablespoons water. Place yolks in small pot, cover with a tea towel to keep them cold, and bring to boil over high heat for 5 minutes, stir, and then continue boiling for about 6 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes then squeeze out and discard white foam left in bowl. Beat egg whites to stiff peaks and fold into yolk mixture. Makes about 10 servings.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,beef stock,custard,chicken stock powder,potato,green onion,espresso,tomato soup mix
title: Sausage & Potato Casserole (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt ( i used low fat ) | 1 cup low fat beef stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso | 1 tablespoon instant chicken stock powder | 2 teaspoons instant espresso | 2 1/2 cups potatoes ( peeled and cubed, skins left on if desired ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons low-fat custard ( i used low fat ) | 1/3 cup diced green onion | 1 teaspoon instant espresso | 1 envelope instant chicken stock powder | 1 envelope instant fat-free whipped topping cereal ( i used gluten free )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. In a bowl, stir together greek yogurt, beef stock, 1 1/2 tsp espresso powder, 1 tsp instant coffee and 1 tbsp stock powder. Mix thoroughly. Mix potato, custard, 1 tsp espresso powder and 1/3 cup green onions together, pour into a 1 1/2 cup pie dish. Bake for 25 minutes. Topping, mix together 1 tsp espresso, 1 tsp instant expresso powder and 1/3 cup green onions, spread over the sausage, and return to oven until top is brown, 12 - 15 minutes.

title: Sante Steak With Mango Salsa
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mango salsa | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes | 3 teaspoons capers | 2 -3 green beans, ends trimmed, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Put salsa, bouillon cubes, capers in bowl. Sprinkle steaks with salt. Heat olive or canola oil over medium high flame in a non stick skillet. Brown steaks. Add salsa, remove from skillet and top with green beans.

Random Ingredients: club soda,kosher salt,coconut powder,chipotle powder,hard egg
title: Anu's Chipotle Fried Eggs
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1 cup club soda | 1 cup coconut powder | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle powder
instructions: Pit the eggs and cut in half lengthwise. Carefully remove the yolks and mash them with a fork. Beat them, one at a time, together with the club soda. Add the coconut, salt and ground chipotle powder. Taste to see if it is to your liking. Heat a large, nonstick frying pan over high heat. Lightly oil the pan. Drop in the egg halves and fry each one, a few pieces at a time until almost cooked through, but not hard. Using tongs, transfer the eggs to paper towels.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,lime wedge,pasta shell,ranch dressing,garam masala,natural bran
title: Shiitake and Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup natural bran or 1/4 cup cornmeal | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/4 cup tra shiitake mushroom ( shiitake ) | 3 ounces shiitake mushroom caps ( sliced into 1/4 inch rings ) | 4 large cooked medium pasta shells | 12 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat over to 425 degrees. Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Combine bran, masala, and salt in a bowl. Set aside. Place mushrooms and shiitakes in a bowl. Dry any excess water off. Spread bran mixture over pasta shells, top with mushrooms, and drizzle with lime wedges to serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,vanilla yogurt,tortilla,green olive,apple juice
title: Moroccan Sweet and Sour Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces vanilla yogurt | 9 -10 ounces chicken bouillon cubes ( with or without herbs ) | 14 ounces pitted green olives, juice drained | 1 apple, cored, chopped | tortilla
instructions: Put the yoghurt, chicken, vegetables, olives, and apple in a saucepan and mix well. Place a few leaves of lettuce in the bottom of each soup bowl and fill with soup. Pass toppings at table.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,chive,rump roast,dark corn syrup,parsley sprig,habanero
title: Rump Roasted Chile Verde
ingredients: 4 lbs rump roast, cleaned with fat trimmed | 6 tablespoons dark corn syrup | 4 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon ground habanero | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f. Place roast on rack in roasting pan or other pan fitted with tight fitting lid. In medium bowl, combine corn syrup, stock and habanero. Stir until blended. Pour over roast. Cover roast and refrigerate for 8 hours. Remove roast from pan and pat dry. Turn over roast. Insert roast in large roasting pan. Roast uncovered, 1 1/2 hours or until meat thermometer registers 145 f for medium rare meat. If necessary, tent with foil. Transfer roast to serving platter and cover loosely with foil or warm tent of foil. Transfer meat to cutting board and chop, discarding fat. Return meat and juices to roasting pan. Stir in parsley and chives. Serve with white rice.

title: Spicy  Peppers for a Crowd!
ingredients: 2 large red bell peppers | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon iced tea or 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Cut stems off bell peppers and discard. Bend peppers and remove seeds and ribs. Toss peppers with bouillon in a large nonstick skillet then heat over medium low heat until hot but not burning, about 10 minutes. Pour sweetened condensed milk into skillet. Stir and cook, stirring constantly, until heated through, about 2 minutes. This should be a thick liquid as well as have a strong pepper flavor. Stir well.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,fish fillet,pine nut,bicarbonate soda,italian tomato
title: Pine Nut Fish
ingredients: 600 g italian fish fillets | 1 can crushed italian stewed tomatoes | 1 can chopped tomato and green chile peppers | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/4 cup pine nuts, chopped
instructions: Cut fish into 8 slices and arrange in a shallow baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over both sides of the fish. Turn fish so both sides are well coated. Bake in a moderate oven for 30 minutes or until fish cooks and is cooked through.

title: Rosemary Split Pea
ingredients: 250 g split peas | 4 sprigs fresh rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Place peas, rosemary sprigs and 1 tsp salt in a small, non stick saucepan. Cover with boiling water and bring to boil, cover and boil for 5 minutes or until beans are just tender, drain and remove rosemary sprigs. Spread split peas on a lightly greased oven tray. Bake, uncovered in the preheated oven for 10 - 15 mins until heated through and dry. Remove from oven and let stand 5 mins before serving.

title: Lazy Banana Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups guacamole ( homemade or store-bought ) | 9 -10 lasagna noodles | 5 bananas leaves, halved lengthwise
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. On a baking sheet, layer lasagna sheets in one layer. Spread the guacamole on top. Bake 20 - 25 minutes, or until lasagna is golden. Top with bananas and serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,salsa,red chilies,tamari soy sauce,fenugreek seed,red chili pepper,fettuccine pasta
title: Red Spicy Noodle-Fettucine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine pasta or 1 lb spaghetti | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 hot red chili pepper | 1 2/3 cups of fresh salsa | 1 1/3 teaspoons crushed dried red chili peppers | 1 1/3 tablespoons red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Cook noodles according to package, drain, return to pan, toss with tamari, fenugreek, garlic powder, and chiles.

Random Ingredients: meat,liquid smoke,mace,virgin olive oil,curry powder,sherry wine vinegar
title: Simple Curried Beef
ingredients: 12 ounces leftover stew beef, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Drain grease from the meat mixture. Combine the oil, vinegar, liquid smoke, curry powder and mace in a small skillet. Turn heat to medium high, and cook for about 2 minutes. Add the steak and brown quickly on all sides, and then reduce heat to low and continue to cook and stir for about 12 minutes or until the meat is browned and tender.

title: Fancy Stir-Fry Peaches
ingredients: 2 cups peeled cored and sliced yellow squash, cut in 1/2-inch pieces | 1 cup peeled cored and sliced pale peach | 1 medium parsnip, peeled and sliced with a mandoline and coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons bottled bean sauce, such as a & b | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 orange, peeled and sliced into 1/4-inch crosswise rounds
instructions: Heat a large skillet over high heat. Add vegetables and hot oil. Stir fry vegetables for 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Add bean sauce and worcestershire.

title: Simple Green Beans & Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups fresh green beans, sliced ( about 2 cups ) | 1/3 cup uncooked long grain rice, i use uncle bill's | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 4 pita bread, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly spray a 10 x 15 baking dish with nonstick spray. Layer the green beans, dry rice and chili oil in one bowl. Sprinkle the rice mixture over the top. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until the green beans are tender and the rice is firm. Serve in the bread or crumbs of your choice. Great to serve with tzatziki sauce.

title: Fantastic Banana Chip Cheese Ball Salad
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 2 - 2 1/2 cups crumbled tortilla chips, divided | 1 medium banana, sliced | 1/3 cup sliced almonds, toasted | tortilla chips ( to garnish )
instructions: In large bowl combine cream cheese, mayonnaise, chili oil, italian seasoning and italian seasoning. Mix well. Stir in 1 cup crushed tortilla chips and 1/3 cup sliced banana. Fold in remaining 3/4 cup tortilla chips. Cover and chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,italian salad dressing mix,tahini,escarole,almond meal
title: Quick and Easy Escarole Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 package frozen italian salad dressing mix | 2 cups almond meal ( ground almonds work too ) | 1 lb head young escarole, washed and patted dry, then cut in half | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb, to sprinkle on top
instructions: Place olive oil in 12 in skillet, heat and allow to warm, do not let oil smoke. When oil reaches temperature, combine tahini, salad dressing mix, almonds and green salad mix in medium mixing bowl until well blended. Add escarole, toss, add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Fiery Clam Soup
ingredients: 7 cups cooked clams, any size | 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Rinse and rinse the clams thoroughly. Place the clams in a bowl and sprinkle with salt. Sprinkle the cornstarch over them and toss to coat. Heat a wok over high heat. Add two cups of the clam broth and swirl to warm it up. Place the clams into the broth, and stir to blend. Pour the clams into the hot stock and bring to a boil.

title: Japanese-Style Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup minced cauliflower ( can use broccoli or turnips instead of cauliflower ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 3 tablespoons asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped bamboo shoots | 2 drops tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup grated aged asiago cheese or 1/4 cup grated kefalotiri
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a large bowl combine the panko crumbs, cauliflower, raisins, asiago, bamboo shoots and tabasco sauce. Set up your fire in a charcoal grill. Brush the patties lightly with oil from a spoon. Grill the burgers for 2 - 3 minutes each side or until desired doneness.

title: Italian Sausage Ladyfingers
ingredients: 2 packages ladyfingers, thawed | italian dressing, to taste | sausage, to taste | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 container frozen whipped topping
instructions: Cut lady fingers in half. Spray baking sheet with nonstick spray. Arrange 4 of them on dish. Top with 1/3 of sausage. Sprinkle with anise seed. Top with 1/3 of whipped topping. Repeat layering with remaining lady fingers and sausage. Spray tops of stacked rolls with nonstick spray. Bake at 350 degrees covered about 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: A Differentiable Individual Horlicks Burritos
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen phyllo pastry ( thawed ) | 2 cups arborio rice | tortilla
instructions: If not using thawed phyllo pastry, then proceed as directed above. Preheat oven to 325°f remove phyllo sheets to a damp towel lined baking sheet. With clean spray or olive oil mist mist, lightly mist both sides of the phyllo dough. Pour a small amount of the rice onto the sheet and spread it out evenly. Place 2 sheets together and mist and repeat with the remaining sheets. Spray with olive oil and then spray with olive oil. Cut a circle from each phyllo sheet, then place 1/2 tablespoon of rice on top. Fold over and press. Repeat the process with remaining phyllo and rice. Take a small pot and brush with olive oil. Heat over medium high heat until it's warm. Use a wooden spoon to move 1 inch of water around the perimeter of the phyllo until water becomes sticky. Turn the heat down to medium and add another 1 - 2 tablespoons of rice on top. Allow rice to cook and turn slightly brown. Use a spatula to keep rice from sticking and to spread the rice evenly. Continue until all ingredients are cooked and rice is used up.. Place burritos on a parchment lined baking sheet so they don't burn. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes. Allow time for liquid cooling down so it will absorb more of the moisture. Serve with sour cream and/or cheese.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,wheat lasagna noodle,fruit,kosher salt,bok choy,french green bean,tabasco sauce
title: Veggies and Chilies Lasagne
ingredients: 5 cups assorted fresh cut green beans, trimmed | 1 cup bite sized bok choy, finely chopped | 3/4 teaspoon hot chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 cup french style green bean, thinly sliced diagonally | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 9 whole wheat lasagna noodles | 2 tablespoons fruit or 2 tablespoons dried fruit, snipped into small pieces ( optional )
instructions: Steam green beans and bok choy for 4 minutes or until tender crisp. Place green beans, bok choy, hot chili flakes and salt in a large bowl. Toss with green beans mixture.

title: Easy Triple Crusted Chocolate Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups of coarse grained baking chocolate, such as lindt or lindt | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dry rubbed sage leaves | 1 1/2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Place grated chocolate in a bowl and add dry mustard and rubbed sage. Make sure the chocolate is well coated. Gently roll a handful of the chocolate mixture into small balls and place on paper lined cookie sheet. Press gently to flatten into patties 2 - 3 inches across. Repeat with remaining chocolate mixture and patties. Place biscuit in preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes. Remove and cool cookies on rack. When cooled, sandwich cookie with crème fraîche or your favourite fillings. Store in airtight containers in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,sunflower oil,broccoli,beef bouillon cube,vanilla extract,nonfat milk,icing sugar
title: Chinese Style Broccoli Beef and Pistachios
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil ( or more if you wish ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 4 large heads broccoli, cleaned, chopped, about a 7cm x 2 1/4in x 2 2in | 500 ml nonfat milk or 500 ml whole milk | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | icing sugar, for dusting | 1/2 cup pistachios ( shelled, roughly chopped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c or 160c fan forced. Grease a large shallow ovenproof dish. Heat the oil in a large saucepan and add the oxo cube. Cook stirring for 2 minutes add the broccoli and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until broccoli is just tender, drain and place in a bowl. Blend the milk or milk and add to the pan and bring to the boil. Stir in the vanilla. Pour hot mix over the broccoli and stir to coat. Transfer to the prepared dish. Dust with icing sugar and bake for 20 minutes or until set and golden.

title: Dave's Chili Nests
ingredients: 2 cans vegetarian duck fat | 1 can chili peppers
instructions: Empty cans of duck fat into a saucepan and heat on low until fat starts to float to top, but not long enough to burn. Carefully drain fat from heat and discard. Heat chili peppers in a skillet or saute pan over medium heat until soft and warm, but not burnt. Serve warm with dippers.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,feta cheese,half,yellow bell pepper,onion powder,vanilla,macaroni
title: Feta Macaroni and Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni ( i use whole wheat ) | 1 lb feta cheese | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1 teaspoon dried onion powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup half-and-half ( i use 2 % ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, minced ( optional )
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain. While pasta is cooking, in large skillet, cook feta cheese in peanut oil until slightly golden. Stir frequently, breaking up whole cheese with a wooden spoon while cooking. Add dried onion powder and vanilla. Cook 2 minutes. Stir in half and half. Drain pasta, and toss with cheese mixture. Serve warm or warm. If desired, add chopped yellow pepper, and some minced fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,dark rum,bell pepper,red cabbage,pumpkin puree,vanilla extract,currant,orange juice
title: Orange Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 red cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/4 cup currants | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 medium bell pepper, seeded and sliced into strips | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 -2 tablespoon low-sodium pumpkin puree
instructions: In a small bowl combine the cabbage, currants, rum, oil and vanilla. Toss to coat. Transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with bell pepper strips and orange juice. Serve.

title: Mint Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 kg whole pork shoulder | 5 liters raspberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 liter mace | 5 liters pork fat or 5 liters pork fat | 1 liter mint leaf
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a pot and heat on the stove, stirring occasionally until the meat has fallen off the bone. Remove from the heat. Cover the pot and set aside for 2 days, stirring occasionally to ensure the meat has not fallen apart during this step. You should be able to taste the liquid from the berries. Serve with boiled rice, noodles and fried rice, as an accompaniment to salads and with bread and bread of your choice.

title: Spinach and Meat Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 lb lean ground sirloin | 2 -3 leaves fresh spinach ( can also be mixed ) | 1 dash smoked garam masala | 4 slices cinnamon-swirl bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Mix beef, and chopped veggies in large bowl. Form meat mixture into 4 oblong patties, 1 - 2 inches in diameter. Sprinkle tops with garam masala. Spray both sides of patties lightly with oil and place on baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,sea salt,double acting baking powder,salt pepper,marsala,reynolds wrap foil,pimiento
title: Truffled Pineapple (Truffles of Haiti - Bridges Restaurant)
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh pineapple, stems, ends trimmed off, washed and sliced about 1/4 inch thick ( can use canned or fresh for other flavor ) | 3 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained ( canned is optional ) | 1/4 cup sliced pimiento, drained of excess liquid ( can use jarred diced pimientos or fresh chopped green onions ) | 2 teaspoons double-acting baking powder | 2 tablespoons marsala ( can use table wine or other dry white drinking wine ) | 2 -4 tablespoons sea salt | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Arrange the pineapple slices in a 2 or 3 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle the sliced pimiento over the pineapple, then sprinkle the parsley over all. Cut the pineapple slices into half or quarters lengthwise, depending on the size of the pineapple. Sprinkle the baking powder over the pineapple, stirring to combine evenly. Top with the marsala or other dry wine, then season the top side of the pineapple with some salt and salt. Put the dish in the oven on a preheated 425 degrees fahrenheit fahrenheit. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until the pineapple is tender and the juices are bubbling. Remove the dish from the oven, let stand for 5 minutes, uncover, and let rest for 5 minutes longer. Serve on a platter with assorted fresh or slightly damp fresh fruit cut into 6 sections. Garnish with fresh parsley or minced green onions drizzled over top.

Random Ingredients: rabbit,filo pastry,caster sugar,mango chutney,mustard,green cardamom pod,sugar,black vinegar
title: Sangria rabbit
ingredients: 12 sheets filo pastry ( see note below ) | 6 green cardamom pods, seeded and crushed | 300 g rhubarb, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons black vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 teaspoons granulated sugar
instructions: Prepare the ginger ale. Place a small pan of boiling water on the hob to preheat. Arrange the cardamom pods in a tea towel and bash with a rolling pin to bruise them. Set aside. Place four sheets of filo on a baking sheet and bash lightly with your motarin or a hammer. Using the back of a wooden spoon, push and crush the cardamom seeds along with the chutney to make a fine paste. Cut the rhubarb into 5 6cm lengths and place into a saucepan with about 5 tablespoons of the juice. Add the sugar, black vinegar and mustard, season and stir well until mixed. Cut the rabbit into portions, place each piece on the syrup and turn the heat low. Cook for about three hours, stirring occasionally, until well cooked and the meat is golden brown in colour and crisp. Spoon the ginger ale into a large warm jug. Arrange the rabbit pieces around the base and add the rest of the syrup, stirring to combine. Serve with fresh breadcrumbs and fresh fruit or pitta breads.

Random Ingredients: red grape,pea,white wine vinegar,bean,celery rib,phyllo pastry
title: Red Grapes Tripped in Phyllo
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas, defrosted according to package | 1/2 1/2 cup frozen sweet peas, defrosted according to package instructions or 1/2 cup sweet peas, defrosted according to package directions | 1 large celery rib, finely diced | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets ( thawed if frozen ) | 1 cup red grapes, halved | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: To make thawed phyllo, thaw phyllo in refrigerator. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a bowl, mix peas, sweet peas and celery. Place 1 sheet of phyllo in a 9x13 baking dish or 2 sheets on a work surface with about a 1/2 to 1 inch thickness facing you. Fold it in half to make about 1 1/2 inch long rectangles. Place one quarter of the phyllo rectangles onto the phyllo in a cross over the peas and celery mixture. Fold in the other half and then the entire other side to create the triangle. Fold the bottom half of the phyllo rectangles over that and gently pull the phyllo into the dish. Cover with foil and let rest for five to ten minutes. Make grape berry dressing by whisking the vinegar and white wine together. Brush generously over the grape blossoms. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and top with grape berry dressing. Let rest for 5 to 10 minutes then serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yeast,poundcake,gouda cheese,large shrimp,beef steak,chicken thigh,spinach leaf,currant
title: Flemish Beef and Shrimp Buns
ingredients: 500 g frozen poundcake | 2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined ( tails on ) | 12 large spinach leaves, cleaned washed and stemmed | 1 tablespoon fresh yeast | 10 slices gouda cheese ( thin slices ) | 10 slices gouda cheese ( thin slices ) | 1/2 kg beef flank steak | 1 lb chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c / 400f / gas place the poundcake and shrimp on a baking tray and bake for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until golden. Transfer to a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Bake for up to 10 minutes longer or until crust is a deep golden brown, shaking the tray occasionally. Remove from the oven and turn oven onto an oven tray. Place spinach leaves and the shrimp in another baking tray and bake for 1 - 2 minutes, or until just beginning to soften. Rinse and dry the beef, then brown on all sides in a little oil. Transfer to the bowl that contains the shrimp, spinach and onion mixture and set aside. To make the buns, place the slices of cheese on a separate baking tray and place on the tomato rack over the tomato rack. Lay the cooked buns in an oven and heat until all the cheese is melted. Assemble the buns in stacks by topping with the meat, spinach and shrimp first, then another of the cheese and then the meat and the shrimp then another of the cheese. Place on the grill and turn over once to brown. Serve hot and fresh salad with a side salad.

title: Creamy English Cabbage Lamb
ingredients: 6 racks lamb, trimmed- 6 to 8 lb. loin total | 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons lemons, juice of | 2 tablespoons mixed pecans, toasted | 2 cups sugar-free steamed cabbage | 1/2 cup sake | 1/2 cup irish cream or 1/2 cup sweet cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Combine dijon, lemon juice and pecans in a plastic bag. Add lamb, coat well with the mixture.

title: Miriam's Thai Tamarind Popsicles
ingredients: 1 liter coconut milk | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp or 2 ounces chopped fresh coconut | 1 -2 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon tomato juice | 1 lime, cut into wedges, to garnish
instructions: Combine the coconut milk, tamarind pulp or chopped fresh coconut, sesame oil, tomato juice, then add the lime wedges. The prawns will float in the liquid and be very soft when cooked. Serve with soy sauce.

title: Tartar (Applebee's Crunch)
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, head separated into rings | 3 tablespoons bacon bits | 1/2 - 3/4 cup iceberg lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Pull the romaine lettuce apart to get all of the lettuce. Remove leaves from iceberg. Cut in half at the stem end and set aside for garnish. Combine bacon bits with the rest of the dressing in a small bowl. Drizzle over lettuce and serve immediately garnished with a dash of cheese if desired.

title: Mustard and Pecans
ingredients: 24 ounces mustard | 24 ounces pecan nuts
instructions: Mix the mustards and nuts in a food processor or with a hand held blender. Store in a sterile container in the refrigerator, this is the best way to know when they have been out of the house and are to your palate. They are so much better after mature. When i picture this in making this today, i plan to buy a clear glass jar. I have also used pecan and pecan chips which the mustards and nuts can be stirred inches.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,tomato green chile pepper,chili oil,sage sprig,cremini mushroom
title: Mushroom-Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 2 pounds cremini mushrooms, sliced | 8 fresh sage sprigs | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1/3 cup rice flour | 1/2 cup chili oil
instructions: Place mushrooms in a large resealable plastic bag. Arrange sage sprigs over mushrooms. Squeeze mushrooms to remove excess moisture, and place mushrooms on a plate. Heat chili oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook mushrooms in hot oil until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,red onion,red snapper fillet,sunflower oil,parsnip,red chili powder,romaine lettuce,cilantro leaf
title: Spicy Snapper
ingredients: 1 lb red snapper fillets ( or any orange flesh ) | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 red onion, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 1/2 lbs red birds eye chorizo sausage | 1/2 medium parsnip, peeled, halved lengthwise, and chopped into 3/4-inch pieces | romaine lettuce, torn into 3-inch length ( or other seasonal lettuces )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut snapper into 4 equal pieces. Season with salt and pepper. Heat 1 teaspoon of oil over medium high heat in a 10 inch nonstick skillet. Add chorizo and cook, stirring, 2 minutes. Remove beef with a slotted spoon and set aside. Heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil in skillet. Add onion.

title: Chocolate Chip Hot Dogs
ingredients: 5 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips, or more to taste | 1/4 cup red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Melt chocolate chips in a bowl in the microwave.

title: Persian Spiced Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron, pulverized | 2 tablespoons mint leaves
instructions: Place saffron in a small piece of cheesecloth. Cover with boiling water. Seal the bag, and shake until the saffron is well coated. Drain. Store saffron in a jar and use for flavoring.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,splenda sugar substitute,panela cheese,garam masala,cream tartar,pasta sauce,phyllo pastry,red curry paste
title: Baked Chicken and Cheese Triangles
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed if frozen ( if frozen, defrost ) | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 1/2 cup shredded panela cheese | 1 cup low-fat ready-made pasta sauce | 1/4 cup cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon red curry paste | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a 9x9 inch pan with parchment or foil. Line a 9x13 inch pan with sheets of filo to prevent sticking. Use a sharp knife, brush filo lightly with panela on one side and a second on the other. Place a chicken breast between 2 sheets of filo and lightly pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Repeat until all chicken has been used. Lay the filo sheets over the edges of the pan a few inches apart. Cover with the remaining sheets of filo and place on top of the filo sheets. Cut the pastry in half crosswise, creating a total of 8 sheets total. Spread the 1/2 cup of the cream of tartar evenly on each sheet. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of the garam masala and 1/8 teaspoon of the red curry paste on top. Arrange the chicken in a single layer on top and press on it lightly using your hands. Spread the 1/2 cup of the sauce on top of the chicken slices in the pan and bake for 1 hour. Remove the chicken slices from the oven and place on a cooling rack. Allow to cool completely. While the chicken is cooling, prepare the cheese sauce. Place ½ cup of the cheese sauce in a medium saucepan. Cook for 15 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine remaining cheese sauce, remaining garam masala, cream of tartar, ½ teaspoon of the curry paste, splenda and remaining ¼ cup of cream of tartar. Add chicken slices and allow to sit for 5 minutes. Spread cheese sauce over chicken and top with remaining ½ cup of cheese sauce. Bake until heated through, about 15 minutes.

title: Quick Kids' Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 20 ladyfingers | 1 ripe banana
instructions: Cut the banana into chunks, then peel it and cut into chunks. Mix all together and store in the fridge. Kids' fondue is good for about 3 hours to mellow. Note, you can store this in the fridge for up to four days. Kids like the taste.

title: Tapanese Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 package shredded coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup sweet miso | 1 tablespoon bread flour | 1 banana, peeled and sliced lengthwise
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together shredded coleslaw mix, miso, bread flour, and sliced bananas. Cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Spread the prepared coleslaw into the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is browned and the edges are firm, about 15 minutes.

title: Salsa Rice
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, cored and thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 3 cups prepared sushi rice or 3 cups jasmine rice | 1/4 cup hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f coat a baking pan or roasting pan with cooking spray. Place fennel bulb slices on the prepared pan. Bake 25 minutes until golden and tender. Remove fennel from oven and set aside. In a medium saucepan over medium high heat, mix sauted fennel with salsa. Cook 4 minutes until heated through. Place rice in a large bowl, pour hot fennel mixture over rice, and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,poppy seed,chicken turkey,rice vermicelli,phyllo dough
title: Baked Chicken and Noodle Rolls
ingredients: 30 sheets phyllo dough, thawed to room temperature | 2 cups cooked chickpea flour | 1/4 cup rice vermicelli | 3/4 cup boneless, skinless chicken cutlets | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the phyllo sheets on waxed paper, and stack them until all of the sheets are stacked in a single layer on a baking sheet. Spread flour on a plate or other flat surface. Set up 3 of the phyllo sheets on top of one another, and lightly coat each in flour. Gently lay a second phyllo sheet on top of the first one so the sheets don't touch the meat and water. You want them all the way to the sides, about 5 inches below the first one. Set up another phyllo sheet that has been coated with flour just like this, and repeat the process two more times. You will have 4 sheets stacked in a row, but stack them in a row as you stack them together to make 7 more sheets layered. Spread the chickpea flour over the dough, and spread it over the vermicelli. Place one chicken breast onto the chickpea flour, and flatten it with the palm of your hand to make a 1/4 inch thick rectangle. Spread about 1/3 of the vermicelli in the center of the chicken breast, and about 2 tablespoons water. Fold the dough over the vermicelli, and tuck in the sides as best you can. Gently roll up each roll starting at the long side, pressing out any excess flour as you go. Lay the rolled up chicken breasts onto the prepared baking sheet, seam side down. Use the waxed paper or plastic wrap to enclose the rolls.

Random Ingredients: arugula leaf,lime zest,pine nut,granny smith apple,rigatoni pasta,matzo meal,chow mein noodle,pistachio nut
title: Passover Apple Noodle Salad With Parsley & Pesto (Food Network's Easy Passport Noodle Salad)
ingredients: 3 cups rigatoni pasta or 3 cups other long grain, uncooked pasta, cooked and drained | 3/4 cup pine nuts | 3/4 cup toasted, chopped pistachio nut, divided | 2 tablespoons fresh lime zest, divided | 1 1/2 lbs granny smith apples, peeled, cored and cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 2 cups torn arugula leaves, packed | 3/4 cup matzo meal | 1/4 cup fresh lime zest, divided | 1 cup chow mein noodles, soaked in hot water for 2 minutes
instructions: Place the pasta in a large bowl and add 1/3 cup pine nuts, 3/4 cup pistachio nuts, zest, and 1/4 cup lime juice. Toss well until evenly coated. Add the apples and arugula. Add the remaining 1/4 cup pistachio nuts, 1 1/2 teaspoons lime zest, and 3/4 cup lime juice and toss. Place on a platter and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup pistachio nuts and 2 teaspoons lime zest. Serve immediately or let chill for up to 2 days in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,red chili powder,green food coloring,yellow squash,rice wine,pinto bean,egg,brown sugar
title: Spicy Yellow Squash and Pumpkin Pastries
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry sheets | 1 can white pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups cubed yellow squash | 3 cups chopped cooked pumpkin or 3 cups cubed winter squash | 1 green food coloring ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 3 egg, beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Roll out one sheet of pastry into a 12 x 4 rectangle and set aside. Using the second sheet of pastry, spread the beans on the top of the dough and then sprinkle the squash over all. Fold in the top and bottom edges of the pastry with the back of a spoon, to form a crust about 15inches across the whole. Brush the crust with egg and bake for 20 minutes or until nicely browned on top and bottom. Remove from oven and set aside. Scoop out the seeds from some of the squash and transfer it to a medium bowl or pie plate. Add enough water to the squash to just cover it. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the yellow squash and cook until tender, around 5 minutes. Drain off excess water and transfer to a blender. Add the green food coloring, sugar and rice wine. Blend until smooth. Stir the mixture into the prepared squash mixture and set aside. Place the pastry on a large baking sheet and spread remaining dough over top. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes. Spread some of the pumpkin or squash mixture over the pastry and then continue with the remaining filling. Bake for 15 more minutes or until the pastry is browned and the filling is hot, bubbling and starting to bubble up the sides of the pastry. Serve warm.

title: Smoothies
ingredients: 1/2 fresh broccoli, chopped | 1/2 can albacore tuna, drained and flaked | 1 can black turtle beans, drained | 1 can broccoli florets, drained | 1 can sliced strawberry, drained | 1 can canned sauerkraut, drained | 1/4 cup raw cashews, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Mix the ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: pork liver,cider,guacamole,rice wine vinegar,chihuahua cheese,mascarpone cheese,sun tomato,vanilla essence
title: Creamy Guacamole Pork Liver With Sun Dried Tomato, Mascarpone Cheese, and Smoked Mozzarella
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 1/3 cup smoked gouda cheese or 1/3 cup edam cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup chihuahua cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1 tablespoon cider, for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. Heat sun dried tomatoes in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring, until softened, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Place a single layer of paper towels over a baking sheet to absorb excess water. Spread the shrimp out on the paper towels, leaving about 1/8 inch thick walls of paper towels at the bottom. Dry the shrimp to remove some of the excess moisture. Set aside. Combine the chihuahua, mascarpone, sun dried tomatoes, and chihuahua cheese in a mixing bowl. Sprinkle evenly with the rice wine vinegar. Mash the mixture with a fork or fingers until smooth. Stir in the sun dried tomatoes, guacamole, and cider. Spoon the mixture into a serving bowl or a baking sheet. Dip each liver in the mixture to cover, and refrigerate for an hour or longer. Serve with warm tortillas, if desired.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,yellow bell pepper,molasses,flour,wild rice,sesame seed,vanilla sugar
title: Wild Rice and Pepper Nuggets
ingredients: 16 ounces sour rye bread ( i use gluten-free bread ) | 1/3 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | flour | 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, diced | 8 ounces frozen wild rice, thawed | 1/2 cup toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven and place rack in middle of oven. Grease and flour a jelly roll pan. In a medium bowl, combine bread, molasses and vanilla sugar. Cut in half and place on cookie sheet. Bake 40 - 45 minutes, or until crusty on top. In a large bowl, combine pepper, wild rice and sesame seeds. Remove bread from oven and crumble into crumbs until it resembles coarse crumbs, not powdery. Allow to cool 5 - 10 minutes, then spread evenly over crumb mixture. Return to oven and bake an additional 10 - 15 minutes, or until lightly browned. Let cool and break into pieces. Store in air tight container.

title: Roasted Lemongrass
ingredients: 12 -15 small lemongrass | 3 lbs rump roast | 2 medium green peppers, sliced into rings | ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 and place lemongrass on a board or rimmed baking sheet. Using a sharp knife and removing both ends of the peel, cut 1/2 inch off the top and bottom of the lemongrass. Try to cut each length so that it does not slip off when sliced, and then slice this across the grain in very thin slices. Wash and thinly slice the green peppers into rings. Cut all fat from the roast as well. Place the cut roast on top of the lemongrass slices, and season with salt. Place into a roasting pan and pour enough boiling water into pan to come half up the side of the roast. Bake for two to five hours, or as long as overnight. Turn a fork inside and out, and check for doneness. Check that a fork is done before it reaches the desired level of doneness for rare or medium well done. Once done, remove from oven, and keep warm. Cut into 2 or 3 slices to serve. If preferred, cut a piece of pastry off of top of roasting pan and place on a serving platter and place the slices around it. Place a few slices of lemon and green pepper around the lemongrass slices, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,anchovy paste,grape leaf,pineapple juice,coca cola
title: Spicy Granny Smith Applesauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 cup coca-cola, original flavor | 1 cup grape leaves | 2 medium granny smith apples, peeled and roughly chopped
instructions: Put the pineapple juice, cola, and apple into a saucepan and stir until the sugar has dissolved, then bring to a boil over high heat, stirring frequently so the sugar does not burn. Cook for about 10 minutes, then remove from the heat. Add the anchovy paste and cook 5 more minutes, then remove from the heat. Stir the sauce until completely melted and then pour the sauce into an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's directions.

Random Ingredients: ice water,green grape,tabasco sauce,vanilla bean,feta cheese,shiitake mushroom,paprika
title: Feta Cheese-Stuffed Grape Leaves (Veggies)
ingredients: 2 lbs green seedless grapes, trimmed and halved | 2 cups fresh shiitake mushrooms, cleaned, stemmed and torn into pieces or 2 cups dried white button mushrooms | 1 1/2 lbs feta cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup ice water | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 cup good sweet paprika ( such as hungarian ) | 5 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Place grape leaves in a large kettle. Fill with barely boiling water and cover. Let stand 1 hour. Strain through a fine mesh strainer and place in bowl of ice water. Cool completely. Remove the strings from grape leaves. With a pastry brush, brush each piece of grape with paprika and sprinkle with paprika, cheese, then a few drops of tabasco. Bring a large pot filled with 1 inch of water to a boil. Add grape leaves and steam 5 to 8 minutes, just until softened. Lift out onto a large platter with slotted spoon and drain well on paper towels. Serve immediately.

title: Kisakei (Sweet Potato Pastry)
ingredients: 3 cups sweet potatoes, sweet | 1 1/8 cups pine nuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon potato starch
instructions: Heat oven to 350f degrees. Peel sweet potatoes. If using fresh sweet potatoes cut into 1 inch cubes. Place sweet potatoes and pine nuts in microwave dish. Cover with 1 1/2 cups water. Microwave on high power for 5 minutes. Drain and reserve sweet potato water. Combine potato starch and potato water in a saucepan. Add sweet potato water, bring to boil, stirring constantly until starch is dissolved. Remove from heat immediately. Pour mixture into a 10x15 inch jelly role pan lined with aluminum foil. Cover with plastic wrap. Let rise in large bowl for 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°f. Remove plastic wrap from pan. Bake sweet potato for 20 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,mango chutney,creamy peanut butter,tahini,maraschino cherry
title: The Gambia's Mango Chutney Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup dry-roasted sesame oil | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, chopped | 1 dash dark sesame oil
instructions: Shake contents of pan on the stove and continue heating over medium heat. To make dip, make peanut butter, in a food processor, combine peanut butter, sesame oil, tahini, cherries, and dark sesame oil. Process until smooth. Transfer to a serving dish and serve warm with toasted pita breads.

Random Ingredients: broth,balsamic vinegar,creamy peanut butter,pear,grain white rice,butter,sponge
title: Pear and Pear Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 4 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 can sliced pears, drained | 1 chicken stock cube, dissolved in | 1 1/4 cups broth | 1 teaspoon butter
instructions: Place rice and vinegar in a bowl, and stir to combine. Set aside to allow to rest for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat peanut butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in pears, and cook until heated through. Add chicken stock cube, stirring well. Remove the soup from heat, and stir in blended rice. Set aside until ready to serve.

title: Sour Oysters in Jelly
ingredients: 8 ounces canned oysters in syrup, drained, shaken and mashed | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped, or more to taste
instructions: Stir the oysters and jalapeno pepper in a noncurded saucepan over medium heat just until hot, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Basil Rice With Fragrant Rice for One
ingredients: 350 g long grain rice | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( known as bicarbonate of soda in the uk ) | 1 small basil, roughly torn
instructions: Place the rice and sugar in a large saucepan with enough cold water to come almost to the boiling point and bring to the boil. Stir over gentle heat until the sugar is dissolved, then reduce the heat and leave for 10 minutes or until all the water has evaporated and the rice is tender. Break up the beans with a fork and stir into the rice. Return to the boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover and leave for 20 minutes or until all the water has absorbed. Remove the lid and fluff the rice with a fork. Add the basil and leave for 5 minutes longer if you want to serve it warm with fresh cream or icecream.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,ladyfinger,prosciutto,soymilk,red wine vinegar,cashew,beef chuck,arborio rice
title: Saucy Beef and Cashews Risotto With Sweet Potato Filling
ingredients: 24 ladyfingers | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup toasted cashews | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 3/4 cups soymilk | 3 cups arborio rice or 3 cups carnaroli rice | 1/2 lb thinly sliced prosciutto
instructions: Arrange ladyfinger on a plate, place a beef cube in the center, and arrange the pieces around it in a spiral. Sprinkle the beef with a few tablespoons each of cashews, red wine vinegar, and garam masala. Spoon about 1 cup of soy milk over the beef. Sprinkle some of the rice over the top, and press it into the liquid with your fingers. Bring all four points of the meat together in the center of a large stock pot, and pour 3 cups of soymilk over. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low. Cover the pot and simmer for 35 minutes. Remove the lid and stir once or twice, adding 1/2 cup of soymilk a few drops at a time if the sauce begins to thicken. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Place the ham and prosciutto in the pan.

Random Ingredients: double cream,cucumber,german chocolate,beef steak,cream cheese,grain mustard
title: Steak Roulades With Cucumber & Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 cucumber | 600 g beef steaks | 150 g cream cheese, room temp | 500 ml double cream | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard | 2 tablespoons pickledger's red hot chocolate
instructions: Pre heat oven to 220c/200f. Cut cucumber lengthways into 8 slices and finely grate the flesh using a fork or your hands. Cut steaks lengthways through centre of each strip, and cut into 4 8cm thick strips. Put the meat and juices into a pan and add 120g cream cheese, stirring to combine. Bring to a boil, and then remove from heat and add mustard, choclate and remaining 125g cream and stir until well combined. Slice the cucumber thinly and then spread each slice with a thin layer of cheese mix and top slices with the cucumber. Heat a griddle or heavy frying pan and fry the roulades for 15 - 20 minutes turning to brown evenly.

title: Ethiopian Fried Onions
ingredients: 6 red onions ( about 8oz ) | vegetable oil
instructions: Wash and dry the onions. Cut them into thin rings. Separate a few pieces and flatten them between your palms. Heat a little vegetable oil in a large, heavy non stick skillet, and fry the onion rings in batches, tossing gently, for about 10 minutes, until they are deep gold on all sides. Remove them with a slotted spoon and drain on clean paper towels. Arrange them on a deep heated platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,bulk hot italian sausage,vodka,cajun seasoning,curry powder
title: Cajun Spiced Spiced sausage
ingredients: 1 lb bulk hot italian sausage | 3/4 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Brown sausage in large frying pan. Add all other ingredients except the vodka. Mix well and reduce heat. Simmer, covered, for 45 minutes, stirring regularly.

title: Fantastic Beef and Noodles
ingredients: 4 cups uncooked egg noodles | 1 (.25 ounce ) package active dry yeast
instructions: Boil noodles in a large pot of lightly salted water until tender, about 6 minutes. Drain. Mix noodles, and sprinkle with yeast, and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,brown rice,red chile,vegetable oil,beef stock,bird eye chile,cream tartar,anaheim chilies
title: California Chili Dog
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 fresh red chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1 fresh birds eye chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1 anaheim chilies or 1 new mexico chile, seeded and finely chopped | 3 cups beef stock | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 1/2 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, cream of tartar and chiles. Set aside. In a large skillet, heat oil over high heat. Add chili and beef stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 8 minutes or until the beef is cooked through. Add rice to rice, stirring well and then return to a boil. Cover and cook over high heat for 1 minute or until hot and bubbly. Spoon hot chili mixture onto a warm platter and serve hot.

title: Philly Cheezy Meat Turnovers
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 8 cubes | 1 lb frozen mixed black-eyed peas or 1 lb white kidney beans | 1 tablespoon ground dried marjoram | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked rice and noodles | 1 cup sliced radish | 8 -12 toothpicks ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons strong brewed coffee ( optional ) | 1 lb tortillas or 1 lb corn flakes, crumbled
instructions: If using peas, add all ingredients into crock pot.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,bean sprout,mushroom,sunflower seed,key lime juice,dill,savory,raisin
title: Savoury Ham Haters Salad
ingredients: 200 g savory, ham haters | 400 g swiss chard | 100 g bean sprouts | 50 g raisins | 100 g sunflower seeds | 1 onion | 2 tablespoons figleaf pulp, mixed | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped
instructions: Cut ham haters in rounds and boil till they start to open. Put in the savoury ham haters and cover until they are all cooked. Wash the swiss chard and swiss chard, cut in two lenghtwise and then into 2 thin strips. Put the bean sprouts in a pan of boiling water and boil for 2 minutes and then drain. Wash and dry the onion and the figleaf pulp, and remove the stems, and cut into small squares or squares and put into a salad bowl. Put the mustard in a bowl and mix with 1 tbsp of chopped dill and add to the salad. Put the sprouts in bowls and put on the top of the salad. If not eating right away, keep it for 30 minutes in a pre heated oven and serve hot and cold.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,chocolate chip,lemon juice zest,barbecue sauce,purple onion,green bell pepper
title: Quick and Easy Sweet and Sour Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chocolate chips ( or more if desired ) | 1/3 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup purple onion, diced | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( zest of 1 lemon ) | 1 cup barbecue sauce, of your choice
instructions: Sauté the bell peppers, onions, vinegar, zest in a small non stick skillet until crisp tender. Add the barbecue sauce and heat gently, but do not boil. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green pea,taco seasoning,rye bread,cantaloupe,ancho chilies,tuna water
title: Ancho Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb tuna in water, drained completely | 1/2 cup taco seasoning blend ( taco bell mexican seasoning mix ) | 0.5 jar cantaloupe, cut in 1/4 inch thick slices | 1/4 cup canned green pea | 1 can sliced ancho chilies, drained | 1/4 - 1/2 cup taco-seasoned french's french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place all ingredients in a large bowl with a wire whisk or fork and stir or mash until fully incorporated. Dip bread slices on both sides into fish sauce. Place on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 20 - 25 minutes or until heated. Cut into squares with pizza cutter.

title: Cucumber & Mustard Phyllo Pie
ingredients: 1 gallon sour cream | 16 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 1 package thick-cut catsup | 2 cups flour | 2 cups corn oil | 2 cucumbers, peeled and mashed | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: In a medium size bowl, blend together sour cream, catsup and flour. Place over low heat until sauce is hot and beginning to thicken, about 5 minutes. In a large oven safe baking dish, spray with nonstick cooking spray. Layer 1 sheet of phyllo in the bottom of dish. Dollop 1/3 of the sour cream mixture over phyllo in dish and spread evenly with a rubber spatula, spreading it over the sour cream in several layers. Layer with approximately 3 - 4 sheets of phyllo and spread another 1/3 of sour cream mixture over phyllo in dish, using a rubber spatula. Repeat one more time, and spread 2 - 4 sheets of phyllo in a thin layer on top of sour cream in dish. Layer 1 1/2 of the cucumber mixture over phyllo in dish. Spread the rest of the cucumber mixture over the cucumber layer. Layer with approximately 2 - 4 sheets of phyllo, and spread remaining sour cream mixture over phyllo completely covering the cucumber. Sprinkle with about 1/2 of the shredded cheese. Repeat layering of phyllo, cucumber mixture and cheese. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 of the shredded cheese over the pie. Bake in a preheated 375 degree oven for 30 - 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Noodles for Ramen
ingredients: 2 -3 cups chinese wheat noodles | 1/2 cup baking powder
instructions: Take a wok and pour enough hot tap water into it to cover the noodles. Wipe the wok with a damp cloth and preheat to 300 degrees. If the noodles are wide, lay them on the paper towel. Put the noodles into the oil and fry them quickly so they stay crisp but not dark. Remove noodle pieces and set aside. After the noodles are in the oil, drain them and spread them in a colander so they won't be sticky. Dip the noodle pieces into the soda solution to coat. Let them drain for 10 - 15 minutes, then transfer them into a bowl and set them aside until ready to serve. Pour hot tap water into wok until the wok is 3/4 inch of water, then bring it to a boil over high heat and boil the noodles for 3 minutes. Turn off the heat and toss in the baking powder, stirring very gently. Then, pile the noodles into a large bowl and fill them with cold, crisp noodle pieces.

title: Guisado De Dude
ingredients: 1 -8 lb chuck, cut into uniform sized cubes | 1 -2 envelope onion soup mix | 2 medium hass avocadoes, peeled, flesh removed, cut in half, then sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 -2 teaspoon steak sauce | 1/2 teaspoon maggi seasoning, original steak sauce
instructions: In large freezer container brown chuck cubes with onion soup mix. Stir in sliced avocados. Add steak sauce. Cover and freeze in freezer.
