To serve, thaw in fridge and put in freezer bag, add in steak sauce and meat. To serve, thaw meat in refrigerator, mix and place in freezer. Put in bag and freeze. After serving, thaw meat in refrigerator. When meat is thawed mix and serve with tortillas, french bread etc.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,vanilla pudding mix,black eyed pea,white wine,serrano chilies,worcestershire sauce
title: Killer: Caribbean Country Dip
ingredients: 1 package red wine | 1/4 package vanilla instant pudding mix ( or use a mix of 2 3/4 - 1 1/4-1 3/4-1.5 package ) | 1/3 cup dry white wine ( optional ) | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon serrano chilies, minced ( optional ) | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained
instructions: Mix first five ingredients together & put into a pie plate. Broil with or without a lid for about 3 - 5 minutes or until top is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,capsicum,vanilla pudding,yeast,red pepper flake,mango,fish bouillon
title: Simple Curried Mango & Capsicum Starter
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried yeast ( or 1 packet instant dried yeast, dissolved in | 1 1/2 cups boiling water, for a 5 cup starter ) | 450 g diced mango ( approx 1 cup ) | 1 small capsicum, diced ( red and green parts ) | 2 -4 tablespoons fish bouillon or 2 -4 tablespoons other flavourful stock powder | 1 -2 teaspoon madras curry powder | red pepper flakes
instructions: Dissolve yeast in boiling water and allow to sit for about 10 minutes. Add diced mango and capsicum. Stir fry for about 5 minutes or until mango has softened. Stir in the yeast and the flavouring. Heat, covered for about 5 minutes until very warm but not boiling. To use, put a spoonful onto boiling hot bread and cover. It will sink towards the end of the cooking time. Stir to make sure the bread does not stick. If the bread has an escape route when you stir, try a fork to poke it through the hole and it should slide out. Leave in the fridge for about 10 minutes before eating. Keeps for up to 1 week.

title: Noodles With a Twist
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 8 ounces wide egg noodles
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add egg noodles and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,beef bouillon cube,pizza sauce,pecorino romano cheese,swiss cheese
title: Gramma Rose's Pizza Cheesesteak
ingredients: 600 g swiss cheese ( cut in thin slices ) | 1/3 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons grated parmiggiano-reggiano cheese | 4 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes ( crushed ) | 1 cup pizza sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Put 1 1/2 cm of water in a pan and add the beef buillon cubes and stir in to dissolve. Stirring continuously, boil for 3 minutes. Drain and reserve 1 cup of the liquid. Stir the cheeses into the boiling liquid. Pour into a well buttered ovenproof dish. Pour the pizza sauce over the cheeses and put the dish in the oven. Cook for 15 minutes, stirring gently, then put under a hot grill for 4 - 5 minutes until the sauce has reduced and the cheese is slightly crispy and golden. Serve with the remaining bread slices, with extra crunchy grated cheese and red pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: ginger,red cabbage,sharp cheddar cheese,hazelnut,worcestershire sauce,buttery cracker,ranch dressing
title: Grilled Cornish Cabbage With Ranch Dip
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket or 1 corned beef brisket ( 2-1/2 lb. if corned beef will not come out of the corned beef, use 2-1/2 lb. ) | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 1/3 cup shaoxing sharp cheddar cheese ( shredded ) | 4 ounces fresh hazelnuts ( or toasted ) | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | worcestershire sauce | 1 cup buttery crackers
instructions: Combine corned meat, 3/4 cup of the grated ginger, worcestershire sauce and 1/2 cup of the ranch dressing and rub into meat. Refrigerate. Turn meat occasionally during cooking to insure even dispersion. Preheat gas grill to high. Remove meat, reserving marinade. Place meat on hot grate, close lid. Prop open lid slightly and char for 10 minutes. Turn meat over, close lid slightly, char another 10 - 15 minutes or until meat is medium rare. Remove from gas grill. Combine reserved marinade with about 1/4 cup of the reserved marinade. Pour into saucepan. Bring to boil. Add remaining ingredients. Cook gently for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Serve with cabbage wedges.

title: Spicy Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 16 large fresh strawberries | 6 ounces fresh bittersweet chocolate, chopped | 2 teaspoons minced fresh marjoram | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chile paste | 1 tablespoon lime juice ( about 1/2 limes equals 1 tbsp. plus 1/4 tsp. ) | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( less if you choose it, i do ) ( optional ) | fresh ripe tomato, cut into wedges ( optional )
instructions: Clean and hull strawberries.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,beef stew meat,arugula,dill weed,chicken stock,corn,kielbasa
title: Beef Rissoles With Dill and Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces kielbasa or 8 ounces bacon, thinly sliced and coarsely chopped | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons fresh dill weed | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups arugula | 2 tablespoons fresh dill weed, plus additional for garnish
instructions: In a heavy dutch oven combine the beef, kielbasa and stock. Cook over high heat, uncovered, over high heat until the mixture begins to simmer, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the meat is very tender and the liquid is reduced to about 1/3. Stir the dill into the sauce. To make the rissoles, remove 1 1/2 cups of hot pot liquid from the heat, stir in the remaining ingredients and divide among 8 serving plates. Serve with additional dill and additional tomato jus for garnish.

title: Quick French Fried Spicy Anchovies
ingredients: 6 anchovies packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped celery | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Heat a skillet over high heat. Add the anchovies and stir fry until they begin to turn creamy, about 2 minute add the celery.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,scotch bonnet pepper,mexican cheese
title: Crusty Mexican Cheese - a Flavor for All Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb mexican blend cheese | 3 scotch bonnet peppers | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: To roast scotch bonnet peppers place on aluminum foil and bake on highest rack on your grill for 3 minutes. Reduce heat to 300 degrees on the grill for 5 more minutes, or until the skin starts cracking. Remove from grill and cut off stems. Cut scotch bonnet peppers crosswise into 1/4 slices. Remove seeds and membrane and discard. Remove stem and membrane and discard. Using your fingers, lightly poke the cheese all over with the stem and the pepper. Slide the cheese onto a cutting board, using your thumb to cut it about 1/4 or so to get the meat into strips you can cut lengthwise, but not so long that you can't cut them into strips or anything. You don't want the cheese to become completely crumbly and too salty for your taste. Sprinkle the cheese with salt and pepper. Using a sharp paring knife, cut a fine steam hole in the bottom of the cheese. Insert a thin slice of pepper into the hole. Repeat until all cheese is used up. Wrap the cheese in the steaming basket or a paper towel and place onto a rack to dry for 1 hour. You can do this in a 9x13 inch pan, or leave it as is, refrigerate for up to 3 days and reheat the cheese before serving. Great on tostadas, burritos or as a filling for guacamole.

title: Sausage & Sweet Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1 can whole italian tomatoes | 1/2 cup salad oil | 1 cup milk | 1 teaspoon rice | 3 ounces italian sweet sausage ( italian sausage ) | 3 fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 10 ounces penne pasta
instructions: In a medium saucepan add the tomato and 1/2 cup of water and bring to a boil. Turn down and simmer 15 minutes. In a large skillet, add the oil and remaining tomatoes. When the tomatoes begin to thicken, add the sweet italian sausage and saute until no longer pink. Add the garlic, stir. Turn the heat to medium low and add the cooked broccoli. Cook for a few minutes while stirring. Cook the penne al dente and drain. Toss with the remaining tomato sauce, broccoli and sausage. Serve over pasta.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,picante sauce,italian salad dressing mix,olive,deli chicken
title: Quickie Italian Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 cups cooked deli chicken ( sliced into thin strips ) | 1 envelope dried italian salad dressing mix ( i use good seasons ) | 1/4 cup olives, sliced | 1/8 cup picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon instant espresso powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the last two in a large bowl or zip lock bag. Pour half the sauce mixture over the chicken and roll up tightly. Allow to marinate 20 minutes. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high. Toast the chicken for about 5 minutes or until thoroughly cooked and juices run clear. Slice and serve over a bed of lettuce with a good spread of sour cream.

title: Garlic Cheese Bread
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups freshly shredded brioche bread, loaf ( about 6 cups ) | 6 tablespoons garlic oil | 2 teaspoons dry yeast | 2 cups half-and-half | 1/2 cup garlic flavored oil | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 bunch spring onion, sliced thin on the diagonal
instructions: Soak brioche bread in a large bowl of water for 10 - 15 minutes, or until soft and slightly wringing. Drain and press out as much water as you can by pressing into large, cold bowl and letting sit for 10 minutes, then pressing out excess water. Dissolve yeast in a cup of warm water until bubbly, 1 - 2 minutes. Add 3 1/2 cups bread, garlic oil, garlic, turmeric and half and half to yeast mixture. Mix together, breaking up any lumps with the spoon. When bubbly, add 5 - 6 tablespoons oil, 1/2 1 cup at a time, mixing after each addition, adding more oil as necessary. Knead for 5 minutes. Place in a lightly oiled bowl, cover and set aside to rise in a cool place until doubled in volume, 1 1/2 hours. Drain dough, return to bowl and lightly oil top and bottom. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 1 hour. Divide dough in half. Using two 6 - 10 inch loaf pans punch out the top crusts, leaving just enough to make the bread stand upright and in one layer. Pour 1 cup of bread filling into bread pans, spreading with hands to evenly cover bottom and sides of pans. Cover and let rise until double in size, 45 - 55 minutes. Bake in a preheated 400°f oven until crust is lightly browned and crisp, about 25 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before slicing into 1 inch squares using a 2 1/2 inch wide serrated knife. Serve warm or allow to become to room temperature.

title: Strawberries and Feta Cheese
ingredients: 4 cups fresh strawberries, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1/2 lb fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into thin slices | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Place the strawberries into a large bowl. Add the vinegar and toss to coat. Let stand 10 minutes. Arrange the mozarella cheese slices down the center of a large platter. Top with the strawberries, then top with the peanuts, fenugreek and the reserved dressing. Serve at once or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Grilled Broccoli With Apples and Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 3 tablespoons thousand island salad oil | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard or 2 tablespoons your favourite mustard | 40 g lard ( unsalted, unsalted ) | 3 medium waxy broccoli | 1 tart apple
instructions: Grind cumin seeds in a grinder until coarsely ground. Heat olive oil in a sauté pan over medium low heat. Add mustard and cook for just a few seconds until it begins to caramelise, taking care not to burn the mustard. Add the mustard all at once and cook, stirring constantly, until thick and slightly darkened in colour. Place broccoli woody ends on a dry towel and rub all over with a quarter teaspoon of the cumin seeds. Chop apple into chunks and place on top of the broccoli. Spread a good grinding of mustard and some oil over the broccoli and top with another quarter teaspoon of cumin seeds and another quarter teaspoon of mustard. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Barbecue on a large, well oiled ridged grill, covered, for approximately 15 minutes. Serve on a platter and garnish with fresh, chopped apple wedges.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,grain white rice,ham hock,beef sirloin,potato starch,chicken wing,cider vinegar
title: Dynamite Meatball Soup
ingredients: 4 pounds bone-in beef top sirloin | 6 links precooked ham hocks | 2 smoked ham hocks | 1 quart chicken wings | 1/4 cup potato starch | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 cup mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place meat into a roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: green chile,romaine lettuce leaf,curry paste,corn,green chilies,fenugreek leaf
title: Spicy Corn on the Cob (Pajar Pedasak) With Green Chiles
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cayenne green chilies, chopped | 2 teaspoons curry paste | 1 cup chopped fresh coriander or 1 cup fresh fenugreek leaves | 6 tablespoons corn, kernels roasted in a little oil until soft | 1/4 cup thinly sliced green chilies or 1/4 cup green onion | 4 romaine lettuce leaves
instructions: Place in a bowl, curry paste, coriander, green chillies, corn, green onion, and cayenne chili peppers. Mix together. Spoon mixture on top of lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,mustard seed,taco seasoning mix,red leaf lettuce,oyster
title: Tear off a Romaine lettuce with Oysters on the Trees
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry mustard seeds | 1/4 cup crushed roasted oysters | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 heads red leaf lettuce
instructions: Place the mustard seeds in a small skillet with enough water about half way to the top. Bring the water to a boil or until the mustard seeds begin to pop. Remove from heat and allow to cool.

title: Pork Butt and Chile Con Espresso
ingredients: 1 lb pork belly | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, minced | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 cup unsweetened beer | 8 ounces espresso powder, brewed until it is smooth | 2 poblano chiles, dried and sliced
instructions: Chop the pork meat and set it aside. Place the ginger and pepper into a hot cast iron skillet, or a heavy bottomed pot set over medium heat. Fry, stirring constantly, until the ginger is golden brown and the pepper begins to give off a strong aroma, about 2 minutes. Add the beer and stir to blend. Bring to a boil over medium heat and add the pork. Cook for about 3 minutes. Transfer the pork to a plate and place in a warming oven. Briefly warm the espresso in the microwave until it is hot, about 20 seconds or less, then drizzle some over the pork. Top with the chiles and serve.

Random Ingredients: chive,yukon gold potato,cream mushroom soup,milk,baby carrot,cream
title: Lazy Irish Stew
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon milk | 2 -3 baby carrots, sliced thin | 4 -6 yukon gold potatoes, cut in chunks | 1 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon chopped chives
instructions: Combine soup, milk and carrots in a large serving bowl. Add potatoes and sour cream and mix well. Sprinkle chives on top of top and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ranch salad dressing,mayonnaise,shiitake mushroom,catsup,cider vinegar,chicken breast half,cranberry sauce,wine
title: Santa Fe Chicken Salad II
ingredients: 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons apple-flavored vinegar | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup wine | 3 tablespoons ranch-style salad dressing | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 cup fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Place the chicken into a gallon sized zipper bag and pour in just enough water to cover. Refrigerate for at least 24 hours. When ready to cook, boil 1 1/2 cups water and dissolve cornstarch in it. Drain chicken and cool slightly. Slice into strips. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Whisk mayonnaise, cider vinegar, and wine together in a bowl. Stir in ranch style salad dressing and catsup. Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,chicken bouillon cube,beefsteak tomato,yogurt,asparagus,ham,cooking oil,white flour
title: Baked Sopaipillas
ingredients: 16 ounces boneless ham, sliced in thin strips ( you can use turkey or beef ) | 16 ounces of frozen asparagus, thawed | 16 ounces beefsteak tomatoes, cut in 6 chunks | 3 bell peppers, sliced in long thin strips or 3 red bell peppers | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 7 ounces plain yogurt ( optional ) or 7 ounces sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven at 375 degrees. Heat oil to a low heat in a saute pan. Once oil is hot, add asparagus, ham, tomatoes, bell peppers, and salt and pepper. Cook for a couple of minutes. Remove from the mix. Dissolve the bouillon cube in the yogurt, or sour cream. Place the mixture into an oven safe casserole dish. Cover the pan with foil and bake at 375 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve with warm flour tortillas.

title: Chocolate Chip Crunch Rolls
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup shredded lettuce | 2 tablespoons hershey's unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix corn, flour, and lettuce. Place about 1 tblsps. Of lettuce mixture on a roll, then roll the roll up.

title: Easy Pea and Peanut Soup
ingredients: 500 g green peas ( or canned frozen peas ) | 4 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: Clean and wash green peas. Place in soup pot and add water to cover. Bring to the boil and skimming foam as it rises. Lower heat and simmer for at least two hours until peas are very tender. Use a hand held blender to puree mixture. Discard solids. Blend in the fresh thyme and serve in soup bowls.

title: Spicy Chilli Chicken
ingredients: 500 g chicken fillets ( lean chicken breast may also be used ) | 1/4 cup chili pepper ( fresh chili or red chili pepper may be used ) | 4 slices fresh white bread
instructions: If using fresh chili you may do this in a mortar and pestle and finely dice them up place the finely diced chilli and chopped up chicken in a plastic bag and massage the marinade in the chicken coating well. Cover and leave to marinate for at least 30 minutes or over night at room temperature. Drain all the excess marinade and grill until cooked and browned. Spread the bread slices with the chilli chicken and top with crunchy green salad.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,oregano leaf,chipotle powder,anise seed,red potato
title: Aloo Potatoes & Chipotle Potatoes
ingredients: 6 red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 pinch dried oregano leaves or 1 pinch dried oregano | chipotle powder, to taste ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 2 cubes chicken bouillon ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place potato skins on an oiled baking sheet and bake until slightly crispy and dark brown. Remove from oven and set aside. Coat with chipotle powder and anise seeds. Place in microwave safe dish, sprinkle with oregano, and microwave on high for 5 - 10 minutes, until fragrant. Add bay, and microwave on high for 1 minute. Remove bay, and add chicken bouillon cube. Whisk to combine. Remove potatoes and chipotle powder from oven. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lime,lemon zest,saffron thread,tomatillo,baby spinach,icing sugar,corn oil,chili flake
title: Spinach Casarellas
ingredients: 2 large tomatoes | 5 -6 ounces baby spinach | 1/4 lime | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 pinch chili flakes | 10 -12 saffron threads ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | ground chili flakes | 1 tablespoon icing sugar
instructions: Cut the tomatoes into wedges and scoop out the seeds of the tomatoes. Chop the spinach roughly and cook it with a little olive oil and chilli. Heat the corn oil in a small saucepan. Squeeze the lime juice as it drips off. Add the zest with the sugar and cook until it starts to boil. Add the tomatoes, lime juice and zest, mixing well. When the tomatoes are all in the pan, add the saffron and spinach. Put a lid onto the pan and leave to simmer gently for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve warm with sifted confectioners sugar. You could add 1/2 to 1 tablespoon of lemon juice if you like.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,shiitake mushroom,apple cider vinegar,white sugar,vinegar,beef brisket,farfalle pasta
title: Sweet Beef and Shiitake Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound beef brisket | 5 shiitake mushrooms, diced | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon dried bread crumbs | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place the brisket in a baking dish and pour the cider vinegar mixture over the brisket. Turn the brisket to coat well. Cover the dish and marinate in the refrigerator, 8 hours to overnight. In a large bowl, mix together the red pepper powder, bread crumbs, and sugar and mix together. Reserve about 1 tablespoon of the red pepper powder for topping. Bring a kettle of lightly salted water to a boil. Place farfalle pasta in the boiling water and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Tirk Toga (Tai Style Kale)
ingredients: 2 bunches kale, rinsed and chopped | 1 lb ground pork | 2 tablespoons shrimp oyster sauce
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, mix together the kale and pork. Cook and stir the meat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Stir in the shrimp or oyster sauce.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,tomato,almond,ice,parmigiano reggiano cheese,rotel,hard egg,liquid smoke
title: Oatmeal & Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups quick-cooking oats, unseasoned | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 2 medium tomatoes, chopped | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds ( optional ) | 5 tablespoons grated pecorino cheese | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1/4 cup romano cheese, plus additional for sprinkling ( optional ) | ice
instructions: Stir 2 1/2 cups of the oats, liquid smoke and tomato and heat over medium heat until simmering. Remove from heat. Stir in egg, half of the cheese, almonds & pecorino, if using. To serve, place reserved cup of oats in a shallow serving bowl, sprinkle with additional cheese.

title: Peanut Butter Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 teaspoons tamari
instructions: Combine peanut butter, honey, and tamari in a small bowl. Use immediately or store in refrigerator. Also wonderful with fish or chicken. Can also be used as a dip for vegetables.

title: Lime Peanut Butter Vodka Vodka
ingredients: 2 1/8 cups peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups finely grated raw lemon peel | 1/4 cup finely grated lime wedge | 1 1/2 cups vodka
instructions: In a blender, combine the peanut butter, lemon peel, lime peel, and vodka. Blend until smooth. Pour into a small container with a tight fitting lid.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,beef bouillon granule,chickpea flour,artichoke heart,chicken breast tender
title: Artichoke Garlic-Glazed Chicken and Artichokes
ingredients: 2/3 cup chickpea flour | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 4 boneless chicken breasts tenders | 1 can quartered artichoke hearts | iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f combine chickpea flour and beef bouillon and stir until dissolved. Place chicken tenders in a baking dish. Spoon in chicken mixture and top with artichokes. title: The Bestest Salt - Period
ingredients: 1 cup fennel seed | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt
instructions: Mix together the fennel seeds and fritter powder and store in covered container.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,ice cube,ice,heavy whipping cream,cilantro stem,corn oil,cumin,plain flour
title: Chilled Cilantro Cream Crumble-Cream With Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 4 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons plain flour | 2 cups freshly chopped cilantro stems | 1 cup shredded ice | 1 tablespoon ice cube | fresh cilantro stem ( to garnish )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, stir together the cream, cumin and corn oil until well blended, then whisk in the flours until smooth. Add the cilantro stems and refrigerate until very cold, about 2 hours. In a shallow, clean bowl, mix together the ice and the ice cubes. Put the chilled cream in the freezer to soften, then stir it and then freeze until very cold. When ready to serve, stir in the cilantro to serve. Serve croutons or wrap in a large piece of cheese crumb that melts.

title: Cottage Cheese Blox
ingredients: 1 package small curd cottage cheese | 1 pound fresh salmon fillets, sliced into strips
instructions: Combine cottage cheese and salmon fillets in a plastic food storage bag. Squeeze out excess air from bag, seal, and squeeze out as much air as possible. Place vegetables on a plate, and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 8 hours, turning bag over after 2 hours.

title: Macaroni and Jicama (Shir Kebab) With Tomato (Sukiyaki)
ingredients: 300 g macaroni ( kebab ) | 4 tablespoons chili oil | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 roma tomatoes | 1/4 cup pecans ( coarsely chopped ) | 600 g jicama ( cut into 2 1/2cm cubes )
instructions: Cook macaroni in plenty of boiling water until tender, drain, return to pan, add chili oil and ginger garlic paste, and stir well. Add tomatoes and jicama, turning to coat. Serve hot or cold, with dipping sauce if desired.

title: Veal Spiced With Olives
ingredients: 1 kg veal, lean and sinew | 200 g pitted olives, coarsely chopped | 200 g pickled mixed peels | 1 medium white onion, peeled and sliced | 125 ml hot beef stock | 400 g creme fraiche or 400 g sour cream | 1 -2 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Place veal in a heavy dish and cover with a layer of blackened breadcrumbs. Sprinkle the with a little nutmeg. Repeat until all the breadcrumbs are used. Melt the olive oil and fry the onion and prunes until starting to soften. Add the veal and fry it on a high heat for 2 to 3 minutes over a high heat so that it browns all over. Put the veal on a plate and pour on the hot stock. Cover with a lid and leave to simmer gently for 1 1/2 hours, adding any extra liquid. Add the creme fraiche and mixed spice to the veal, and bring to the boil. Boil, uncovered, for a further 10 to 20 minutes until thickened. Serve at once. Variation, in a large pan, heat up a little olive oil, add the prunes a few minutes before the meat is tender, allowing them to colour up a little. Then use a slotted spoon to pick out the veal from the pan, allowing the juices to reduce in the pan. Then add the prunes and continue with the liquid in the pan until it has reduced beings to be about 125ml. It is up to you how your family likes their meat.

title: Baked Zucchini and Pepper Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 zucchini, sliced | 1 green bell pepper, sliced | 1 1/2 ounces plain flour | 1 baguette, cut into 1 cm cubes | baguette
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c. Grease a 4 x 10 cm sandwich plate. Put the zucchini, green pepper, flour, baguette and a little seasoning mix into a grinder and pulse until well combined. Place onto a greased baking tray. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes. Remove and cut diagonally into 4 squares. Place one slice onto each sandwich. Cut diagonally to form 4 triangles. Serve.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage,cayenne,chipotle powder,hard egg,filet mignon
title: Sausage Patties
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and quartered | 2 tablespoons ground dried chipotle powder | 2 tablespoons ground cayenne ( may be more ) | 2 lbs sweet italian turkey sausage | filet mignon, about 2-inch thick
instructions: Mix together the eggs and ground chipotle, cayenne and ground chipotle chile. Add the sausage and mix together well with your hands. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Form mixture into 6 patties, about 1 inch thick and make sure they are evenly spaced. Grill over hot coals or grill for about 3 minutes on each side. Serve each patty on a slice of baguette and top with sour cream if desired.

title: Sake Condensed Caramel (Japanese Caramel)
ingredients: 1 cup sake ( japanese rice wine ) | 1 cup tahini
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan, stir over medium low heat until the sugar melts and turns translucent, about 20 minutes. Raise the heat to high and bring the mixture to a boil. Using a wooden spoon, remove from heat. Stir in the sake, cover and refrigerate. Stir about one hour before serving. Keep refrigerated until serving.

title: Diabetic Coleslaw
ingredients: 4 cups coleslaw mix | 4 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute | 8 radishes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except radishes. Place in a plastic bag and marinade in fridge for 3 days or longer. Baste with marinade and enjoy the aroma.

Random Ingredients: bacon,caraway seed,cheesecloth,process american cheese,white wine vinegar,pico de gallo,chili oil,vanilla extract
title: American Bacon Cheese Spread
ingredients: 7 slices thick bacon | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seeds | 1/8 cup pico de gallo ( a specialty italian cheese spread with a touch of mexican herbs ) or 1/8 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/3 cup shredded processed american cheese ( a specialty american cheese spread with a touch of mexican herbs ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons distilled white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 2 packages processed cheesecloth, found at specialty food stores
instructions: Place the bacon in a large, heavy skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown, about 10 minutes. Transfer the bacon to a paper towel lined plate, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings in the skillet. Drain the bacon slices on paper towels and crumble. Scrape into a large bowl with the caraway, pico de gallo, processed cheese, white wine vinegar, chili oil, and vanilla extract. Mix gently with a spatula until thoroughly blended. Gather up the corners of a cheesecloth and twist to remove the strings. Pour mixture into the cheesecloth and wrap loosely with the cheesecloth. Refrigerate, covered, at least 2 hours or overnight. Turn the cheesecloth package once or twice while the cheese is chilling. When the cheese is cold, drain the bacon bits from the cheesecloth and crumble it finely.

title: Mom's Polish Kielbasa
ingredients: 4 pounds kielbasa, sliced | 1/2 cup turmeric, or more to taste | 1 package frozen, polish-style sausage, thawed
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium high heat. Add sliced kielbasa to the skillet and cook until well done, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Remove the kielbasa to a paper towel lined plate to drain. Return the skillet to the stove over medium heat. Drain the fat from the skillet, but not as much as possible. Add turmeric and mix with the sausage until well mixed, about a few drops in a drop of water or broth are desirable. Continue cooking and stirring about 10 minutes, until turkey is heated through. You should hear a faint crackling sound when the turmeric has been added. Pour turkey mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 10 minutes at 375 degrees f, then remove foil. Return to oven and bake 10 minutes more, or until center no longer looks dry.

title: Pasta D'avignon
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 12 ounces ziti pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add ziti to boiling water and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain pasta and place in a large casserole dish. In a small saucepan combine the oil and lemon juice. Heat on medium high heat until foaming. Pour over pasta and toss lightly to coat. Dot with butter pieces and bake in preheated oven until golden brown on top, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,pancetta,yogurt,artichoke heart,beef sirloin,cold water,green chili
title: Artichoke and Beef
ingredients: 500 g beef sirloin or 500 g top round beef, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 100 g marinated artichoke hearts | 1 green chili, thinly sliced | 50 ml yogurt ( thick ) | 100 ml chilled whole milk yogurt ( extra ) | 2 teaspoons cold water
instructions: Brush the beef well all over with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and the chilies. In a large frying pan, fry the sirloin in batches, turning until rare. Transfer the sirloin, including any excess oil, to a plate. Set aside. Add the remaining oil to the frying pan. When it is hot, stir in the artichokes and cook for 2 minutes, stirring well. Stir in the yoghurt and boil for 1 minute, stirring well. Spoon the curried yoghurt mixture over the sirloin and leave to stand for a couple of minutes, then serve with the remaining condiments such as lettuce leaves and tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,veal stock,tarragon,beef suet,cocoa powder,tamari,adobo sauce,almond extract
title: Tarragon Au Chocolat
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef suet ( or other fat ) | 4 1/2 teaspoons tamari | 4 1/2 teaspoons agoia cocoa powder | 2 1/4 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 1/4 teaspoons adobo sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons tarragon, leaves and tender stems, chopped | 3/4 cup veal stock | 1/2 tablespoon almond extract | 9 cups bay leaves, torn
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. With 2 1/2 to 3 inches of a heavy saute pan place over medium high heat, sear the suet on all sides. In a small bowl combine sifted cocoa powder, almond extract and 1 cup of the veal stock and whisk to combine. Pour mixture over suet. Add a bay leaf and 1 1/2 cups of water. Cover the pan tightly with aluminum foil, place in oven and bake for 90 minutes or until syrupy.

title: Italian Cannellini Beans & Bacon
ingredients: 200 g bacon, diced | 500 500 g cannellini beans | 1/4 teaspoon saffron ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Place bacon in frying pan with 1/2 teaspoon oil and 1/2 teaspoon olive oil. Fry until bacon has golden color then add the beans. Add the saffron and garlic powder and let cook for five minutes. Add the saffron and garlic powder for five minutes to finish.

title: Broiled Lemons With Olives
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, quartered | 12 green olives
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat and preheat the broiler to high. Arrange the chicken quarters on a foil lined baking sheet. Roast the chicken until it is no longer pink in the center, 20 minutes, then transfer it to a platter. Skim fat from the pan juices and discard it. Place olives and 1/2 cup reserved roasting juices in a small saucepan and cover with 1 cup water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove the chicken from the oven and let rest for 15 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the chicken to a platter. Reserve the cooking liquid, then pour the cooking liquid over the chicken and serve.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,garlic,cilantro leaf,garlic oil,wheat flour,almond,rye bread,ginger
title: Shahi Tukray (Watties)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spray with nonstick cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine the cheese, flour, ginger, garlic, 3 tablespoons of the almonds, 3 tablespoons of the cilantro, the remaining oil and 1 teaspoon of the almonds. Add the remaining 3 tablespoons of almonds, the remaining 3 tablespoons of cilantro and the rye bread.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,iceberg lettuce,brown sugar,sun tomato oil,violet food coloring,molasses
title: Red Apple Red Salad
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage, rinsed, core removed, chopped | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons light molasses | 2 1/2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 4 teaspoons vegetable oil ( or canola oil ) | 1 teaspoon vital gluten free nutritional yeast | iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl and mix well. Chill several hours to blend flavors.

title: Easy Tiramisu

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a sheet of plastic wrap on a baking pan. Place ladyfingers in a single layer into the prepared pan. Drizzle with guacamole all over. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over them. Combine turmeric, cayenne pepper, and salt in a bowl.

title: Island Scented Potatoes

instructions: Prepare potatoes while dressing is being prepared. Place dressing, butter, and salt in small sauce pot, making sure butter melts. Bring to boil, stir, and add potato slices. Cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until tender, turning as needed so they are not overcooked. Sprinkle with thousand island dressing, if desired. Note, do not use real maple syrup or other maple flavoured dressing in place of the maple syrup. Note, do not use other maple flavoured syrup in place of the thousand island dressing.

title: Spicy Baked Steak with Quinoa
ingredients: 6 1/2 ounces quinoa | 1 lb medium steak, cut into 1-inch squares | 3 ounces pimentos, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon bourbon or 1 tablespoon madeira wine | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 pinch hot red chili pepper
instructions: Combine the quinoa and 3 cups of boiling water in a medium sized, heavy saucepan and bring to the boil over high heat. Cover tightly and set aside to steam for 15 minutes, or until all the liquid is absorbed and the quinoa is tender. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place the meat on a lightly oiled rack in a shallow baking dish large enough to hold half the meat. In a small bowl, combine the pimentos, parsley, bourbon, turmeric and chile pepper. Toss with the quinoa. Duck remaining meat and quinoa in a third dish, cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight. Transfer to the oven and bake for 10 minutes, or until meat is cooked and all the liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,red onion,cooking spray,red wine vinegar,cream tartar
title: Quick and Easy Onions for One
ingredients: 1 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | cooking spray | 1 red onion, sliced thick
instructions: Stir together dry ingredients in a shallow casserole dish. Place onions in dish. Pour vinegar mixture over onions. Cover, and chill in refrigerator for several hours or overnight.

title: Mustard Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 2 pork tenderloins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl, mix mustard powder with mustard and rub over both sides of pork. Place onto a rack to dry overnight, or in the oven overnight. Bake for 30 minutes, basting often.

title: Veal and Eggplant (Aubergine) Rizogalo
ingredients: 1 kg veal, ground ( or use any veal, cut into 1/2-1/2 cm cubes ) | 1/2 cup vidalia onion, chopped ( or other sweet onion ) | 2 eggs, scrambled | 15 ounces light coconut milk | 4 cups short-grain rice, valencia | 1/4 cup red pepper sauce ( i prefer tasty garlic chili pepper sauce ) | 1 liter good white wine ( i've used other red wine )
instructions: Brown meat lightly with onion. Add garlic paste. Add water if necessary. Add rice. Increase heat and simmer, adding water as necessary until rice is tender. Sauté eggplant in a little oil until soft. Add to meat mixture and sauté several more minutes. Add red pepper sauce and stir. Serve on top of hot white wine.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,caster sugar,cognac,mozzarella cheese,red wine vinegar,apple cider
title: Mushroom Cheese Mince Mince
ingredients: 1 lb mince ( from steak mince ) | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 4 ounces mozzarella cheese, grated | 4 ounces mexican blend cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons cognac
instructions: Mix the wine vinegar and sugar and set aside. Wash and dry mince. Combine mince and sugar in a large bowl, and mix through the onion and cheese. Add in the cognac the vinegar and the remaining ingredients, mix well. Place into a greased ramekin or loaf pan and bake at 190c for 30 mins or until cooked.

title: Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 1 cup shredded walnuts | 1 cup shredded cheese blend, e.g. colby mix | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup almond flour ( a generous grind ) | 2 tablespoons chopped green peppers | 2 teaspoons chopped chilies, chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sliced blanched almond ( or coarsely chopped salted nuts ) | 1 -2 head boston lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to combine cheese, nuts, flour, chilies, almonds and pepper in a small bowl and mix well. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper and spray lightly with cooking oil. title: Chef John's Creamy Crabmeat Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegan margarine | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 2 cans crabmeat, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons ground black cumin | 1/2 pound ground veal | 1 teaspoon ground black cumin
instructions: In a large bowl, mash the soy margarine with a potato masher to soften the margarine. Add the artichoke hearts, crabmeat, heavy cream, 2 tablespoons of ground black cumin, and 1/2 teaspoon ground black cumin. Toss everything together. Chill in the refrigerator approximately 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,hard egg,lasagna noodle,broccoli floret,vegetable oil,coriander seed
title: Noodles With Broccoli and Eggs
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 2 dried lasagna noodles ( i use barilla's ) | 1/2 bunch broccoli floret, cut into bite sized pieces ( or steamed fresh broccoli ) | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped coarsely | steamed hot chili sauce ( optional, to taste )
instructions: In a large frying pan heat half the oil. Add coriander seeds and broccoli and stir to mix. Cover and cook over hot water for 10 minutes. Add the remaining oil, pasta, eggs, chilies and garlic until pasta is al dente. Drain pasta and broccoli mixture, toss with noodles and serve warm.

title: Strawberry Soup and Gravy
ingredients: 2 cups fresh strawberries | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon
instructions: Wash and pare the strawberries and place in the crock of a crock pot. Add the bouillon. Cover and cook on low for 4 - 6 hours or until berries are tender and soupy.

title: Meat Rolls and Pasta
ingredients: 500 g meatballs ( leftover ) | 300 g puff pastry sheet ( pre-made ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 60 g creamed margarine ( for brushing ) | 1 tablespoon celery, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 1 cup cooked pasta, of your choice, i.e. orecchiette | 1 cup fresh porcini mushroom, finely chopped ( or use dried mushrooms, rehydrated )
instructions: Roll out the pastry until it is 1cm thick. Use a 2cm cutter to cut out 20 squares. Place in a freezer bag until needed. Boil the pasta for 12 mins and drain. Place on warmed oven tray. Add a tbsp of margarine to the margarine. Add chopped celery and chopped jalapeno, stir fry until soft. Add chopped meat, fry for a further 2 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in cream, cheese sauce and mushrooms and stir until combined. Add cooked meat roll and roll out until the mixture is about 20cm around. Place the meat rolls on baking paper on a baking tray. Brush with melted butter and bake in oven for 20 mins. Cut them and serve with a fresh green salad which is of your choice. Enjoy.

title: Pound-In-A-Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 cup basil | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 teaspoons angostura bitters | 1 can sliced peaches, drained and chopped
instructions: Combine ingredients and form into small meatballs. Heat a wok over high heat, add oils and then the meatballs. Brown both sides until cooked through, about 3 to 4 minutes. Serve over hot cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,summer savory,flat leaf parsley,provolone cheese,onion,chili paste,chili
title: Kiss Me Chilli Scented  Onion Salad
ingredients: 4 medium onions, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon thyme, crushed | 1 tablespoon summer savory ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped ( use fresh parsley ) | 1 -2 ounce pepper grated provolone cheese ( optional ) or 1 -2 ounce other good melting cheese, of choice ( optional ) | fresh sage leaf, for garnish
instructions: Place the onions in a skillet with 2 tablespoons of cold water and cook until just softened, about 8 - 10 minutes. While the veggies are cooking, crush the dried herbs with a mortar and pestle or in a small bowl, if you like, with chili paste. Transfer to a bowl and add the remaining water. When the onions are just about soft, add the spicy chile and herbs, then stir in the cheese and season with salt and pepper. Place in serving plases, sprinkle with sage and serve with white rice or baked potato wedges if desired.

title: White Cheddar Cheese & Chocolate Bark
ingredients: 5 ounces white cheddar cheese, grated | 7 ounces white chocolate, melted
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the grated cheese on half the greased sheet tray. Top with the melted white chocolate. Then use a pastry brush to help coat with extra white chocolate. Broil for 5 - 8 minutes or till melted.

title: Beefeater Glazed Aubergines
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh parsley, divided | 600 g aubergines, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 liter chicken stock | 3 tablespoons beeterview beefy flavored gin | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 liter vegetable juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c. Place 1 tablespoon of dried parsley in a roasting tin. Arrange 4 of the slices in the tin and top with the sliced aubergine slices. Combine the stock, gin and anise seeds in a pan and bring to the boil. Pour the hot liquids over the aubergine and stir well. Bake the aubergines in the oven for 1½ hours and allow to rest for 15 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,vanilla essence,purpose flour,white wine vinegar,paprika,corn kernel,white bean
title: White Bean Salad With Hot Chilli and Corn Chips
ingredients: 200 g white beans, rinsed and drained | 200 g corn kernels | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 dash vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
instructions: Make the chilli con carne mix at least 1 tbsp warm water with 2 tbsp flour to make the mixture thick and creamy. Chill before using in recipe.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,brown mustard,cashew,snow pea,jalapeno brand,sesame seed
title: Cashew Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces cashews | 1 lb snow peas or 1 lb sugar snap pea | 5 ounces jalapeno-flavored brandy | 1/2 bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon brown mustard | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame seed
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium sized mixing bowl. Dress as desired.

title: Creamy Pepperoni Roll-Ups
ingredients: 500 g cream cheese | 1/2 cup dark chocolate | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 3 slices pepperoni | 2 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs ( optional )
instructions: Using an electric mixer with the flat beater beat all ingredients together until creamy and creamy. Line a nonstick jelly roll pan with wax paper. Spread the beefy pepperoni evenly over the pan. Roll the cheese mixture around the log and spread evenly with a spatula. Sprinkle the outside with breadcrumbs if desired and place jelly roll pan in 300 degree oven for approx 25 minute remove from oven when browning lightly and serve.

title: Blueberry Parfait
ingredients: 1 cup fresh blueberries, washed and picked through | 1 tablespoon natural yoghurt | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: Line 1/3 cup of baking paper with plastic wrap. Place the blueberries in the paper, and sprinkle with salt. Cover with a second sheet of plastic wrap, and carefully remove the plastic. Using a knife, push the berries through the paper to remove the excess water. Wash your hands and dry. Place half a cup of yoghurt into a small bowl, add the sugar, and whisk until well combined. Use a pastry brush to drizzle the yoghurt over the blueberries. Sprinkle with the rest of the yogurt, and leave to sit for a few minutes to dry out a bit. Using a spoon, spread the remaining yoghurt over the top until you have a thick, slightly grainy layer.

title: Butternut Squash, Coconut and Pepperoncini Gratin
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/4 cups grated gruyere cheese or 1 1/4 cups grated emmenthaler cheese, divided | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut | 1/2 cup pepperoncini pepper ( from a jar of drained peppers, not the ones in the cheese ) | 12 slices firm white bread, crust removed, cut into 1/2 ( or you may use a sandwich of your favorite kind such as toasted ciabatta rolls )
instructions: In a 2 qt casserole, combine squash cubes, ½ cup cheese, desiccated coconut, ½ cup peppers and about 1 - ½ tablespoons chopped pepperoncini. Tear 1 bread slice into ½ inch cubes, place on top of squash mixture. Sprinkle the remaining ¼ cup cheese over casserole and evenly top with the remaining bread cubes. Bake, uncovered, in a 400°f oven 10 to 15 minutes or until the topping is lightly browned, bubbling and heated through.

Random Ingredients: red miso,oriental sesame oil,napa cabbage,corn oil
title: Asian Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 large napa cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon red miso | 1 tablespoon granulated onion | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the napa cabbage, miso paste, onion, corn oil, and sesame oil. Toss to coat evenly.

title: Italian Sausage Sandwich Fingers
ingredients: 4 lbs italian sausage ( casings removed or thickly sliced ) | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning ( i use morton's accent seasoning )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in large freezer bag. Freeze to make slits to help crisp the slices. Slice and toast as desired.

Random Ingredients: german chocolate,ancho chile powder,caper,chicken bouillon granule
title: Erskine Maggi Chops (Pesce a La Gorgonzola)
ingredients: 1 ounce unsweetened german sweet chocolate, grated | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granule | 1/2 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon drained capers
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the grated chocolate, chicken bouillon and ground ancho. Stir until well blended. Place the caps on 4 toothpicks inserted into each cap. Using 2 toothpicks, spear a cap into the hole of each cap. Pour the chocolate mixture onto the toothpicks until coated. Arrange the coated cap rings on serving plates and serve.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,red cabbage,mirin,dark sesame oil,broth,mushroom,carrot,arbol chile
title: Mushrooms, Carrots, and Corn in Lobster Stock
ingredients: 8 large shiitaki mushrooms | 1 medium red cabbage | 8 large carrots | 3 tablespoons light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup mirin | 2 -4 arbol chiles ( or more, to taste ) | 4 cups broth
instructions: Wash, remove crowns, and slice mushrooms into halves, lengthwise. Cut cabbage into 8 wedges along center.

title: Simple Basil Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups baby carrots | 1/4 cup basil leaves | 4 tablespoons hot paprika ( szeged ) | 1/2 cup sweet smoked oyster sauce
instructions: Peel and cube carrots, add to a pan with water to cover by one inch. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until carrots are tender. Drain carrot, set aside. In another pan stir fry paprika until aromatic and starting to release aroma. Stir in oyster sauce, stir til boiling, remove from heat. Stir carrots into hot paprika mixture, cover and wait 3 - 5 minutes. Top with garlic chives if desired and sprinkle with green onion if desired.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,sesame seed,tahini,cranberry,feta cheese,olive oil,arborio rice
title: Rice Salad With Tahini Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1/3 cup tahini | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Cook arborio rice according to package directions. Cool to room temperature. In a small bowl, mix tahini, cream of tartar, sesame seeds, and olive oil. Add rice and stir to coat. Stir in cheese. Garnish with cranberries and serve.

title: Sliced Vegetables With Horseradish and Horseradish in a Pita
ingredients: 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 350 g broccoli, trimmed | 2 pita breads | 150 g salsa | 150 g mixed sprouts
instructions: Boil the broccoli with salt and pepper for 2 mins and remove from heat and leave for 5 mins to steam. Put the honey gherkins in a mortar and crush with pestle. Add 1 tblsp water and the horseradish and stir until creamy and set to one side. Put the oven on 200°c/400 f/gas spread the broccian bread and a quarter of the salsa on a shallow ovenproof dish and then top with half of the sprouts. Spoon the honey garlic horseradish mixture over this and top with the remaining sprouts. Put in the oven for 5 - 10 mins, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,cod fillet,basil leaf,coriander seed,cumin powder,salt pepper,garlic salt,cilantro
title: Fish With Fresh Coriander (Nam Phrik Phrik Thymali)
ingredients: 4 cod fillets | 1/2 teaspoon whole coriander seed | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt ( or more to taste ) | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro ( chopped ) | 1/4 head lettuce leaf ( torn ) | 2 sprigs fresh basil leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Remove pin bones from fish fillets. Rinse fish fillets under cold water. Pat dry with a paper towel before seasoning with other herbs. Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat. Add whole coriander seeds as spices and fry until they turn brown, about 15 seconds. Turn fish fillets and continue frying. Turn once or twice until just cooked through. Meanwhile, mix the coriander paste with salt, pepper, and cilantro. Pour over fish fillets in skillet. Stir well to coat evenly. Cover and cook over medium high heat for 5 minutes.

title: Polish Sausage  (Kielbasa) in a Jar
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | nutsmeg, to roll
instructions: Boil sausage in a gallon of salted water until cooked about 10 minutes. Drain water from sausages.

Random Ingredients: apple,ear corn,pork tenderloin,steak,italian seasoning,cream tartar,pizza dough
title: Italian Pork Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb steak, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 onion, diced | 1 tablespoon apple or 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 package pizza dough | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 teaspoons apple pie spice | 2 ears corn, shucked
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix italian seasoning, cream of tartar, and onion in a bowl. Dice up your beef. Dip the steak strips in the seasoned spice mix and then toss them in your meat. Heat up your pan to medium high and add the oil. Once the oil, oil has heated up, add the beef and cook until nicely browned. Place into a 9x13 dish. Once your beef is in the pan, spread out your pizza dough. Sprinkle on your italian seasoning mixture, spreading it evenly. Add the onions and apple or orange juice in the pan and stir to coat in the spice. Spread the meat on top of pizza dough and top with your zesty sour cream and italian sauce. Then sprinkle on top the remaining italian seasoning mix, then top with the corn shucked on top.. Bake for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,white wine vinegar,beef chuck,vodka,taco seasoning
title: Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck | 1 package taco seasoning | 4 tablespoons light bols original vodka | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream
instructions: Place beef in crock with taco seasoning & bols, cook over medium low heat, stir and cook for 2 hrs covered or till meat is extremely tender.

Random Ingredients: coconut,self raising flour,vanilla sugar,mango chutney,milk ricotta cheese,white bread,taco seasoning,tomato basil oregano garlic
title: Coconut Mango Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups wholemeal self-raising flour | 1 packet taco seasoning | 150 g mango chutney | 6 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 4 slices white bread, toasted | 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c/425f/gas 1 or fan forced/gas 8. Whiz the flour and taco seasoning in a processor about 1 minute to a fine textured consistency. Add chutney to a medium bowl, stir to combine and season with sugar and salt and set aside. Using your hands, rub all the excess chutney off the bread and roll it into a sausage shape and set aside until required. In a large bowl, add the ricotta, followed by the 1 1/2 tspn grated oaxaca/vanilla sugar mixture and the taco seasoning. Tear the bread roughly and carefully turn over the mixture into the bowl. Pare the excess bread from the underside and, using a rolling pin, work down the bread to create a firm dough. Place the rolled sausages into a lightly floured 15cm x 40cm ovenproof gratin dish and cover with the crumpled and dried bread. Place the sausages on the top of the bread and bake for 20 - 25 minutes until pale golden brown and cooked through. The timing really depends on the thickness of your sausages. Allow to cool for 5 minutes then dig in and enjoy.

title: Alaska Salmon Rolls (Tyler Florence)
ingredients: 1 can salmon fillets, drained, flaked | 3 tablespoons pimento stuffed olives, chopped | 1 can sandwich bread dough | 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 2 loaves frozen bread dough, thawed | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 2 slices bread or 2 slices bread, crusts removed
instructions: Preheat oven to make the rolls, split the thawed bread dough lengthwise into equal pieces. Stir together the butter and the 1 tablespoon confectioners' sugar in a small bowl until smooth. Place the seasoned bread dough in a mixing bowl and stir in pimento, salmon, and olives. Add the second 1 tablespoon confectioners' sugar. Divide among the bread rolls, filling each roll. Place the bread rolls on a parchment lined baking pan in a warm oven and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Dust with additional confectioners' sugar while warm.

Random Ingredients: tofu,nonstick cooking spray,ginger ale,stewing beef,nectarine,pork,pork back rib,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Street Meatloaf With Pork Crackling and Nips
ingredients: 16 ounces pork back ribs ( from a 4 lb. package ) or 16 ounces pork back loin ( from a 4 lb. packet ) | nonstick cooking spray | 6 tablespoons minced ginger ale | 4 tablespoons minced nectarines ( to taste ) or 4 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into about 16 pieces ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 2 lbs firm tofu, cut into about 16 pieces | 2 lbs coarsely grated mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Arrange the pork meatloaf in an 11x7 inch baking dish that has been sprayed with nonstick spray. Sprinkle the ginger ale inside the pork roast's cavity. In a bowl, combine the nectarines with the minced ginger ale. Spoon enough of the mixture onto the pork roast's surface to cover. Using your hands, press and massage the pork meat to completely submerge the meat in the marinade. The mixture will be soupy. Insert a piece of foil over the top of the meat if desired, and close the dish with the foil. Add the baking sheet with the meatloaf to the oven, and bake until the center of the roast is firm to the touch, about 15 minutes. Allow the meat to rest for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, make the crackling and nips, in a skillet, cook the beef over medium high heat until browned on all sides, about 6 to 8 minutes. Add the nectarines and cook for 2 to 3 minutes more, or until the liquid has evaporated. Spread the beef and pork crackling over the crackling, and sprinkle with cheese. Return to the oven, and bake until the cheese has melted and just begins to brown, about 2 to 5 minutes more.

title: Pinto Beans Stuffed with Garlic Sausage
ingredients: 1 pound dried pinto beans | wooden skewers | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Put beans, soaked meat and 1/4 cup water in a large pot. Cover pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until beans are tender, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Transfer cooked beans to a strainer and mash with a potato masher. Return sausage to beans. Discard casings. Stuff sausage halves with about 2 tablespoons reserved bean and meat mixture. Spoon sausage into a baking dish. Cover with a lid or with aluminum foil to avoid leakage. Set the baking dish into a shallow pan of water so the water can reach the bottom of the dish. Place an empty metal baking dish on top. Cover the baking dish with a lid. Stick in a plate. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Arrange the sausage halves on skewers. Place skewers on the prepared baking dish, cover, and grill for 15 to 25 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through and juices run clear.

title: Maple Butter for Frying
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock | 3 lbs jumbo eggs | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon pure garlic paste | 1/4 cup pure unsweetened applesauce
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine chicken stock and maple syrup and bring to a boil. Turn to low and simmer for 5 minutes with lid on. In a medium size bowl, beat eggs with a wire whisk. Add garlic paste and mash with a potato masher until you have a paste. Heat nonstick skillet or wok with about 2/3 tablespoons butter, over moderately high heat until foam begins to rise. Drop eggs slowly into batter, cooking until whites just begin to set around center of egg, but are not done. Transfer cooked egg to a paper towel lined plate. Using a slotted spoon, remove from pan and drain fat. Dip in egg batter and drain briefly. Note, if desired, reheat broth during final 10 minutes of frying.

title: Faux Cracked Baked Panir Salad
ingredients: 4 slices bread, sliced about 1/4-inch thick | 1 small head cauliflower ( break into florets ) | 2 medium sized zucchini ( cut into small sticks ) or 2 medium sized summer squash ( cut into small sticks ) | 3 medium sized jicama ( cut into small sticks ) | 2 -3 fresh cilantro, leaves only -minced | 1/4 cup chopped nuts | iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f, grease a round 8x10 pan with olive oil. Mix chopped nuts and cilantro together in a bowl to serve on top of crouton. Arrange sliced bread on a serving platter. Layer with zucchini or winter squash, cauliflower, and jicama. Drizzle with the dressing and top with the cilantro dressing. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,corona beer,sun tomato oil,green pea
title: Green Pea and Apple Ale Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1/4 cup chopped green peas | 1/2 cup corona beer or 1/2 cup light beer, good | 2 whole crisp tart apples
instructions: Slice the apples and arrange them in the bottom of a large sauce pan. Sprinkle with a little water to cover the apples. Cover and place over medium heat. Reduce the heat and simmer until the apples are tender about 10 minutes. Add the sun dried tomatoes, green peas and remaining cup of beer and stir to mix. Cover and simmer until most of the liquid is absorbed about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,red onion,strawberry,balsamic vinegar,pimiento,dijon mustard,french onion,pecorino romano cheese
title: Fruit Salad with Chocolate Chip Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2/3 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1/3 cup chated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped red onion | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive | 2/3 cup strawberry, hulled | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh pimientos
instructions: Place the pecorino romano cheese into a small, shallow bowl.

title: Spinach With Fresh Chanten Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh baby spinach | 3/4 cup mexican crema ( can be purchased at mexican specialty food store ) | 1/2 lb carrots, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 4 teaspoons ale ( optional )
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with nonstick spray. Place the spinach in the skillet. Scatter some of the crema on top of the spinach, leaving a 1/2 inch space at the top. Add carrots and poultry seasoning. Cook until spinach is tender and carrots are crisp, about 2 minutes. If mixture starts to dry, stir in some more crema. Spoon into a serving platter, sprinkle with remaining cheese if desired.

title: Chef John's Ricotta-Pear Gelatin
ingredients: 2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 5 ripe grape tomatoes | 24 maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Combine ricotta, tomatoes, and cherries in a large bowl. Using 1 tablespoon each of the ricotta mixture and cherry juice, form mixture into an egg wash on a wax paper lined baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least six hours.. When ready to serve, remove the gelatine from the refrigerator and let sit for 5 minutes to settle. Cover the surface of the Gelatin with a towel and, using a vegetable peeler, peel away paper and the rinds from the grape tomatoes. Cut grape tomatoes in half, remove seeds and coarsely chop. Bring 1 - 2 inches of water to a boil in a medium skillet over medium high heat. Working in batches, add the gelatine to the boiling water and cook, stirring, until the gelatine is completely dissolved. Remove from the heat and stir vigorously until the gelatine coats the back of a spoon. Transfer the sauce to a serving bowl and refrigerate until set, at least four hours.

title: Ochreme Oatmeal Drink
ingredients: 1/4 cup oatmeal ( fine or fine grated fine ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup frangelico
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate for at least an hour to allow flavours to develop.

title: Vegan Focaccia
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil, or as needed | 2 cups small cauliflower florets | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar | 1 tablespoon miso, dark | 1 (.25 ounce ) package active dry yeast | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a small mixing bowl, mix sunflower oil and sugar together until well combined. Sprinkle miso over the surface of the cauliflower stems and mix until the miso is absorbed. Pour the melted miso mixture into the bowl. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir into mixture. Add cottage cheese and mix until dough becomes smooth. Knead dough on gluten flour surface for about 10 minutes. Cover bowl and let rise for 30 minutes. Punch dough down. Pat into a loaf shape. Coat loaf with cooking spray, or pam cooking spray. Place on baking sheet and bake for 15 - 18 minutes in the preheated oven. It should be lightly browned and crispy.

title: Cornflake Pork Casserole
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 3/4 lb ground lean pork | 1 can corn flakes | 8 ounces frozen cut green beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place frozen cornflakes as follows, in bottom of dish of 13x9 baking dish, in order, 1 chicken thighs. Next, 1/2 of pork, 3/4 of green beans, 1/2 of the bean mixture, cornflake crumbs. Repeat 3 times more, ending with 1/4 of uncooked cornflake crumbs on top. Bake uncovered in oven for 50 - 60 minutes until brown.

title: Bow Tie Sesame Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces bow tie ( thin ) pasta | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil
instructions: Cook the pasta as directed on the package. Reserve 1 cup of the pasta water. Drain the excess water, but reserve the remaining water. Return the pasta to the pan and coat with the sesame oil. Cover with the reserved pasta water. Cook over medium heat until the pasta is coated with oil.

Random Ingredients: olive,chili flake,cranberry,dark soy sauce,bread flour,wheat penne,monterey jack cheese
title: Pasta With Crunchy Toast & Fresh Cranberry Salsa
ingredients: 8 ounces whole wheat penne | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon olive | 1 tablespoon chili flakes ( or crushed red pepper flakes, to taste ) | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, grated | 1/2 cup fresh bread flour
instructions: Add 1/4 cup water to a large pot over medium high heat. When water is boiling, add penne and cook until pasta is just tender but not mushy. Drain pasta and toss with sauce. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine cranberries, soy sauce, olive, chile flakes, and half the cheese and then season with salt and pepper. Spread into a lightly buttered shallow 8 x4 x2 baking dish and sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Bake until golden brown and bubbly, about 20 minutes. Serve hot or cold. Tip, feel free to double or triple recipe for a larger dish. Try adding up to 2 tbsp shredded or shredded hot pepper and basil to cranberries. Try adding 1/4 cup shredded or shredded fresh celtic or fresh parsley to bread for a milder dip.

Random Ingredients: white rice,grain white rice,egg yolk,shoulder lamb chop,cayenne powder,italian turkey sausage,lime juice zest,gruyere cheese
title: Lamb and Gruyere Croquettes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime juice and zest | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice ( about 4 limes ) | 9 ounces deli lean shoulder lamb chops | 8 ounces white rice, rinsed ( about 24 ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | 6 ounces hot italian turkey sausage, casings removed ( or other smoked sausage, such as kielbasa ) | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice
instructions: Position a rack in the center of the oven and preheat oven to 300 degrees. In a large bowl, whisk together the lime zest, 2 tablespoons lime juice, 1/4 cup lime juice, and 1 teaspoon salt. Add the lamb and rice. Toss until the rice is coated with lime zest juice mixture. Spread the mixture on a baking sheet and bake until browned, 20 to 25 minutes. Raise oven temperature to 400 degrees. Add sausage. Position broiler rack 4 inches from the heat and broil, turning until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes. Arrange sausage on a large baking sheet and broil in the preheated oven until just cooked through, 7 to 10 minutes. Remove from broiler and sprinkle lightly with gruyere. Transfer to a warm platter. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,black bean,liquid smoke flavoring,pepperoni,salmon fillet
title: Zesty Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1/2 can chopped pepperoni, drained | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 pound salmon fillets
instructions: In a large bowl, combine black beans, diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, pepperoni, liquid smoke, and salmon. Mix well. Refrigerate 30 minutes before serving to allow flavors to blend. Serve, or refrigerate overnight for party size servings.

title: Mango-Bamboo Stuffed Beef Ribs
ingredients: 2 pounds extra lean beef, cubed | 6 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons dried mango | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 8 thin slices from a fresh mango
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the beef, oyster sauce, mango and white pepper. Spread the beef mixture onto a piece of wax paper lined with several layers of paper towels. Place 2 slices of mango on top of each meat, and wrap the meat completely with wax paper. Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil grate. Grill the wrapped ribs on the prepared grill for about 15 minutes per side, or until meat is cooked through and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,garlic paste,italian salad dressing mix
title: Italian Cream Dressing Mix II
ingredients: 1 package dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon garlic paste
instructions: Stir the dry salad dressing mix, confectioners' sugar, garlic paste, and garlic powder together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,blue curacao,banana pepper,bread flour,farfalle pasta
title: Farfalle II
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 3/4 cup chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 cup blue curacao | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1/3 cup banana pepper, sliced
instructions: In a large pot combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. When it comes to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer 3 minutes, covered. Place 2 - 3 spoonsful of pasta onto the bottom of a greased glass bowl, or shallow baking dish large enough to hold all 3 cups of pasta. Spread the chewy farfalle onto the pasta, and press lightly together. Cover with the blue curacao sauce, and allow to soak for an hour or two before serving. This recipe moves fast because of the farfalle pasta.

title: Mexican Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 3 medium carrots, peeled, julienne cut | 2 medium radishes, sliced | 1 small jalapeno pepper, minced ( or more ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 large lime wedge
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss to make the dressing. Allow to chill for 2 hours before serving. This salad can also be used as a side salad.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,green chili pepper,cumin seed,tea,cranberry,dark sesame oil,cabbage,caster sugar
title: Green Chili and Cheddar Tea (Cook's Day)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed ( coarsely crushed ) | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries ( coarsely chopped ) | 150 g philadelphia cream cheese | 125 g cabbage ( shredded ) or 125 g swiss chard ( shredded ) | 1 green chili pepper ( finely chopped ) | 80 g teas ( dark, very cold, finely diced in to small pieces ) | 1 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to c, c, & lightly toast sesame seeds & crush the seeds. Add crushed s & cranberries & mix well. Stir in cheese & mix well. Spoon in to a small ovenproof dish. Place dish on wire rack & bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until firm. Remove from oven & pour over tea. Stir gently & chill until serving time.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,tomato green chilies,lemon juice zest,oregano,cumin powder,flour tortilla,tamarind pulp
title: Tamarind Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 15 tamarind pulp, pods packed in water | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 2 cans stewed tomatoes and green chilies | 12 flour tortillas | 24 maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: First drain tamarind, place pulp in a large pot with water, bring to a boil. Cover and boil gently for 15 minutes, until the water is syrupy. Remove from heat, remove and discard the tamarind pulp, reserve the juice. Drain tamarind and place in a bowl. Stir in lemon juice, cumin, and oregano. Pour 1/4 cup juice over tamarind.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,red chili pepper,clove,sharp cheddar cheese,curry paste,almond
title: Spiced Cheese Balls
ingredients: 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 1 pinch chili powder | 1 pinch curry paste | 1 pinch ground cloves | 1 -2 small dried red chili pepper | 1/4 cup slivered or blanched almond, toasted
instructions: Cube the cheese into small pieces and toss together with spices. Shape into balls, then dip in toasted almonds.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,cod fish fillet,cavenders purpose greek seasoning
title: Greek Stuffed Baked Cod
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs cod fish fillets ( skinned, boned, or use a smaller size ) | 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice | 2 tablespoons cavenders all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Lightly grease a large baking dish. Cut a 1” slit in each fish fillet to allow one side to fully expose to the fish. Stuff one with rice using your fingers and place on the baking dish. Sprinkle on the greek seasoning. Bake covered in the preheated oven for approximately 35 minutes or until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

title: Easy Crock Pot Pork-Venison Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 1/2 lb cooked ham, coarsely shredded | 1 teaspoon salt substitute | 4 cups half-and-half cream | 1 cup cornmeal | 1 -2 lb spinach leaves
instructions: In a skillet, cook veal and ham until cooked. Drain fat. Add salt substitute. Heat half and half and corn meal. Slowly add to heated mixture. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Stir well. Serve over sliced spinach.

title: Brownie Bread
ingredients: 2 lbs self rising flour | 2 ounces dark chocolate | 1/4 cup dried currants | 1/4 cup cracked pepperoni | 1/4 cup mixed spice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Bake in a well greased cake tin for 1 hour at 180°c.

title: Red Capsicum Vodka Shots
ingredients: 1 red capsicum | 3 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Take red bell capsicum in a shot glass and spread out to soften. Add vodka to a highball glass and mix.

title: Mexican-Style Tater Tot Bread
ingredients: 3 cups warm tap water | 4 cans prepared tater tots | 1 (.25 ounce ) package active dry yeast | 3 2/3 cups polenta | 1 tablespoon mustard seed | 1 teaspoon powdered saffron | 1 jar mild salsa
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the warm water in a large mixing bowl. Mix in the 3 cups of polenta, mustard seed, saffron, and salsa. Cut the tater tots into half inch wide strips. Bring the water to a boil and add the hot tater tot strips. Cook, without stirring, for 10 minutes. Pour into a greased 9x5 inch loaf pan, and sprinkle with additional polenta. Let cool in the pan, about 45 minutes. Slice and serve.

title: Faux French Bread
ingredients: 3 loaves french bread | 15 ounces refried beans sprouts
instructions: Slice the bread on the 1/3 inch side. Spread the refried beans on the bread. Then spread a few sprouts on the beans. Fold the bread in half over the sprouts and enjoy.

title: Broccoli & Garlic Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 200 g broccoli, florets cut into florets | 1 tablespoon olive, sliced | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3/4 cup long grain white rice, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c degrees. Cook rice according to the packet until firm, drain & cool. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl & mix well. Allow to sit for 30 minutes, then divide mixture into 16 portions. Roll each one in flour & place on non stick baking paper lined tray. Sprinkle tops of rolls with breadcrumbs & cook for 10 minutes, or until golden.

title: Italian Sausage and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage ( preferably with casings on ) | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet. Put beans and italian seasoning in pot and cook over medium heat. You could use any canned bean you have on hand or you could use an italian pancake instead of the sausage. Cook until hot then break meat up into bite sized pieces.

title: Apple Chocolate Ripple Dip...the Best!!!!
ingredients: 1 bottle cream | 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons dry sherry or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup honey | 2 teaspoons instant tea | 1 -2 apple, peeled and chopped
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in bowl and chill in the fridge for 1 hour before serving.

title: Chili Beef With Chocolate, Beef and Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, cut in large serving pieces | 1 cup chickpea | 1 pinch dried oregano | 2 tablespoons plain flour or 2 tablespoons gluten free flour | 4 ounces hot chocolate, chopped | 3/4 cup beef and veg spreadable salsa | freshly grated chocolate ( for topping ) | chopped fresh oregano ( for topping )
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 degrees celsius. Toss first four ingredients together, place in baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap, then bake for 1 hour. Remove and discard plastic, stir through salsa. Serve with beef and beans. Top with extra melted chocolate if desired.

title: Mexican Style Spiced Mushrooms
