ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine, softened | 5 large fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger root | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice and zest | 1/2 cup shredded processed cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a baking dish. Stir margarine, mushrooms, ginger, picante sauce, lime juice, and zest in a large bowl until evenly combined. Sprinkle the processed cheese over the mushrooms and stir to combine. Spread evenly into the prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown around the edges, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Ligatoni With Smoked Asparagus and Smoked Grape Antipasto
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 3/4 lb smoked grape, halved | 3/4 lb smoked rindless raisin fruit, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons gin or 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/3 cup vodka | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Fill a large saucepan 4/3 full of water.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate,taco seasoning,active yeast,chicken bouillon granule,rose essence,salmon
title: Smoked Salmon Tacos (Healthy for Zwt3) with Pomegranate & Rose Essence
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granule | 3 cups hot smoked salmon, finely chopped | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground pomegranate | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons crushed dried rose essence, plus | extra rose petals ( or basil, to top )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 tablespoons water then put in a large bowl and mix to dissolve. Stir in the rest of the ingredients. Cover with plastic wrap and leave to rest in a warm area for 40 minutes. Divide into 8 pieces and place on greased non stick baking sheets. Cover and leave in a warm place for 20 minutes, until doubled in size. Bake in a pre heated oven at 400°f/200°c for 20 minutes. Remove from oven, cut into squares and serve hot. Tip,. Always remove the plastic wrap before using, as it can melt and make the taco messy. If you open the oven door a few times it is too hot to heat. Place in a large plastic bag or paper bag and leave somewhere cool and dry. When the oven door is open, open it, you have the desired effect. I prefer crispy, moist crispy taco shells with the pomegranate on them, but you can use any other leftover fixings you like to provide as desired.

title: Chopstick Queso Dip (Mock)
ingredients: 1/4 cup low-fat tasty cheese | 1 can chopped green chilies ( or to taste ) | 10 cashews ( approx ) | 2 -3 teaspoons light grainy mustard | 2 -3 tablespoons liquid maggi seasoning ( optional ) | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate
instructions: Crush cashew nuts in blender or crush with rolling pin. Add to cheese along with other ingredients and mix to combine. Chill and serve with crackers or chips.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,vanilla yogurt,broccoli floret,white wine vinegar,egg yolk water
title: Swiss Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 4 broccoli florets, cooked and chopped | 4 egg yolks or 2 teaspoons egg water | 2 tablespoons green sweet peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons low-fat vanilla yogurt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let stand 30 minutes before serving.

title: Italian Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans anchovies, drained | 4 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Drain anchovies, reserving excess oil. Combine anchovies and sugar in a large serving bowl. Add enough cold water to cover anchovies. Using your favorite method, chill at least 10 minute or longer.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,guacamole,lentil,tomato sauce,butternut squash lengthwise,rose water,lettuce leaf
title: Butternut Squash and Lentils Salad
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, halved, seeded | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons rose water | 4 lettuce leaves, rinsed | fresh pineapple slices ( optional ) or canned chunk pineapple ( optional )
instructions: Place squash halves cut side down on a greased baking sheet. Roast in a 375 f oven for 40 or 45 minutes until a knife inserted when inserted into the center of a squash comes out clean. When cool enough to handle, cut into quarters and place in a bowl of ice water until cooled. Place in refrigerator until cool enough to handle. Peel, halve and seed squash. Cut lengthwise into 1/4 slices. Place in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Lebanese Beef and Cabbage Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin | 1 head napa cabbage | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | fresh coriander, roots cut into 4 | 1 bunch green leaves
instructions: Cut sirloin into one inch cubes, discarding any fat and silver skin. Slice cabbage into one inch pieces, removing hard end. Cut cabbage into half inch squares, removing tough leaves after each use. Slice green leaves into thin strips and toss with stewed tomatoes. Heat stewed tomatoes, coriander roots and salt and pepper. Slice sirloin into one inch pieces and add to stewed tomatoes. Simmer 1 hour over low heat.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,lasagna noodle,allspice,coffee,white flour,rosemary,bean sprout,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Noodle and Bean Sprout Lasagna
ingredients: 6 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 can bean sprouts, drained | 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1/2 cup strong coffee | 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 3 cups white flour, divided | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion | 4 teaspoons dried ramen noodles, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Place bean sprouts, chipotle peppers, and coffee in a blender.

Random Ingredients: white pepper powder,ginger,chicken leg quarter,beef stew meat,flounder fillet,milk chocolate,salt pork
title: Ginataang Malabao - Filipino Beef Stew
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon white pepper powder, or as desired | 1/2 teaspoon salt pork, or as desired | 1 boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 1/2 pounds flounder fillets | 1 pound red-leaf dried ginger, cut into thin strips | 2 ounces milk chocolate, chopped | 4 ounces chicken leg quarters, skin removed and cut into 1-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Whisk white pepper powder, salt pork, beef and ginger together in a bowl.

title: Spicy Chicken Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese | 1 tablespoon grated orange rind | 2 large pita bread rounds, split in half | serve with toppings of choice | 4 teaspoons chocolate, melted
instructions: Combine ground chicken and cheese in large bowl. Add orange rind, divide evenly over pita bread. Serve immediately.

title: Buffalo Blueberry and Leek Buffalo Herb Bread
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh blueberries | 1/4 cup butter | 2 cups white flour, plus more for dusting | 2 large leeks, thinly sliced | 2 cups chopped fresh maraschino cherries or 2 cups raspberries | 4 heads lettuce, washed, outer leaves separated and discarded | 1/4 cup chopped fresh garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place the blueberries in a food processor or blender with 1/4 cup of the butter and purée until smooth. Transfer the puree to a bowl, stir in 2 cups flour and set aside. Place the leeks in a colander and sprinkle with salt and let drain for 2 minutes. Rinse under cold running water and drain again. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Set aside. Place the remaining 1/4 cup butter and 1/4 cup flour in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the leeks and cook, stirring often, until tender, about 10 minutes. Remove the leeks with a slotted spoon to a bowl of ice water and salt. Pat dry with paper towels. Remove the leeks from the butter and flour mixture and add to the leeks along with the cherries, then stir to combine. Spread the mixture evenly over the top of the prepared baking sheets, leaving a 2 1/2 inch border around the edges. Bake until the loaf is golden brown and the top is golden, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, spread the remaining blueberry sauce evenly over the top of the toasted bread. Sprinkle with the garlic and serve immediately.

title: Spinach and Celery With Fenugreek Vinaigrette
ingredients: 500 g baby spinach | 1 bunch celery | 3 cm fresh ginger | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1 -2 green chili pepper | 1/4 - 1/2 cup vegetable stock or 1/4-1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons vegetable stock or 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | lettuce
instructions: Trim the spinach and cut the stalks from the celery.

title: BBQ Caramelized Beetroot
ingredients: 8 medium beet | 2 scotch bonnet peppers | 1/4 - 1/2 cup corn oil
instructions: Using a fork, peel the beetroot so it is completely covered in carrot juice. Slice the beetroot across. Using sharp knife, score the stem to the bottom of the beetroot as you would for cherry tomatoes. Place in a microwave safe bowl covered with 1/4 cup of corn oil. Cook in the microwave for 4 minutes or so at 600 degrees, then test for doneness with toothpick it should come out about right. When the beets are tender, transfer to a serving plate and pour the pan juices off of the beetroot. Cut off the stem part and cut out the thick center. These can be substituted for beets in other recipes. I used a bbq cooky that calls for beetroots. You can also make caramelized beets by making sugar pumpkin spice and butter in a pot. Cook until golden brown. Pour over the beets at room temperature. If using beetroot with scotch bonnet peppers, they may need to be prepared in advance. The scotch bonnet pepper can be obtained by grinding 2 - 3 fresh serrano chilies about 1/4 cup or so, depending on how hot the chilies are.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,italian bread french,onion flake,pesto sauce,onion
title: Italian Sausage Toast
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb pork sausage, cut into 1/4-inch slices or 1/2-3/4 lb regular sausage | 1/2 onion, cut in half and slices | italian flavored bread ( if not available use french rolls or italian rolls ) or crusty roll ( if not available use french rolls or italian rolls ) | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | onion flakes, to taste
instructions: Slice sausage in 1/8 slices. Remove most of the fat from the sausages. In the skillet, sear sausages, on one side until golden brown. Remove sausages from skillet. Add onion and garlic to the skillet, saute for 3 minutes or until soft. Turn with a slotted spoon over the sausages. Sprinkle with pesto. Spread pesto over the top. Place the two rolls together.

title: Cheesecloth Wrapped Flat Bread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon butter | 20 pounds cheesecloth, wrapped in a double thickness of heavy cheesecloth
instructions: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium low heat. Remove the cheesecloth from the butter with a slotted spoon. With a pastry brush, lightly coat 1 side of each piece of cheesecloth with butter. Arrange the cheesecloth wrapped cheesecloth over the melted butter in a folded cheesecloth bowl, leaving a little at the top of the bowl for the steam to escape. Wrap the entire bundle with string or cheesecloth. Secure with a piece of cheesecloth secured with a loop of string placed over the opening of the bread container. Melt the remaining butter in a deep fryer or large saucepan to a temperature of 375 degrees f. Fry the bundles just until crisp on the outside, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove the bundles with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Repeat with the remaining bread. Serve warm.

title: Norwegian Smoked Salmon Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs smoked salmon | 1/4 cup pimiento | 1 large onion ( diced ) | 1/2 cup marshmallow | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom ( dried )
instructions: Cut smoked salmon into squares. Place all ingredients into medium sized pot. Cook on medium heat until it starts to turn brown. I recommend not skimming the foam and salt. Turn off heat. Allow to cool in pan and refrigerate. When cooled completely break into large squares.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,cooking spray,taco seasoning mix,peach,ice water
title: Spanish Peach Tostadas
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh peach | 2 tablespoons grated fresh peaches | cooking spray | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | water
instructions: In a small baking dish, coarsely chopped peaches with 1 tablespoon of chopped peaches. Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat over medium heat. Add taco seasoning and tomatoes to pan. Cook and stir until mixture begins to soften and darkens slightly, about 3 - 5 minutes. Spoon mixture into a large bowl with ice water, stirring so ice is absorbed into mixture. Use nonstick cooking spray to set mixture on one side.

title: Grilled Wings of the New Age
ingredients: 2 chicken wings | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon dried apricots, diced | 1/2 teaspoon raisins
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat and oil the grate. Remove wings from the packaging and lay flat on the grill with 1/2 teaspoon of the sage. Turn and brush with the oil. Grill until light brown, turning once, about 10 minutes total. Transfer to a plate. Place remaining 1/2 of sage, chopped apricots and raisins in small bowl. Place reserved sage and juices in a saucepan. Bring the liquid to a boil and add the wings, coating the wings well with the mixture. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, stirring once, until the sauce is thickened. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,gin,green mung bean,spanish onion,pork tenderloin
title: Dublin Mango Pork
ingredients: 1/2 pound pork tenderloin | 2 ounces gin, or to taste | 2 green mung beans, or to taste | 1 small spanish onion, chopped fine | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Place pork tenderloin in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Pour gin over the pork, seal with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or overnight. Preheat grill for high heat. Drain pork. Grill pork on preheated grill until juices run clear and pork is easily pulled off the bones and tenderloins, about 20 minutes. Cook mung beans with onion in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until tender and heated through. Remove from heat, and remove from heat. Cool, and transfer beans and onion to a serving dish. Slice pork tenderloins, and place on top of mango mixture.

title: French Chicken & Carrots
ingredients: 500 g baby carrots | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard | 2 tablespoons bordeaux beet chilli sauce ( or other hot sauce )
instructions: Peel carrots, cut into very thin slices. Place carrots in a bowl, stir in mustard and chilli sauce to coat vegetables well. Cook over a low heat for 10 minutes or so until carrots are almost cooked all the way through.

title: Kittencal's Greek Feta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package feta cheese ( crumbled or slightly packed ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion ( a mixture of onion, minced or very small diced-use 1/4 cup or the amount called for in the greek's original recipe ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes ( depending on taste )
instructions: Cut feta into cubes or chunks, place in the bowl of a food processor or magic bullet and pulse until smooth. Add remaining ingredients and pulse to desired 'pickle/greek/garlic paste' consistency. If using a food processor, you may need to reduce pulse just a little to get the desired consistency. Adjust spices as desired and enjoy.

title: Blueberry Beef Spread
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground beef | 1 cup chopped blue cheese | 1/4 cup chopped green onions | 1/4 cup shredded blue cheese | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared yellow mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared yellow mustard | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup light rum, or as needed ( optional ) | 1 dash salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place ground beef in a mixing bowl. Mix in 1 cup blue cheese, green onions, 1/4 cup blue cheese, green onions, 1/4 cup blue cheese, yellow mustard, yellow mustard, blueberries, rum or another optional, of choice. Stir to combine. Press mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes, then remove from the oven. Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

title: Quick Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 3 tablespoons lemon pepper seasoning | 13 1/2 ounces rotini pasta, whole wheat can be used | 1 package cauliflower, florets should be cut diagonally in 6 pieces | 2 -3 serrano peppers, seeded and sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain, return to pot, add beef, celery and pepper flakes, if using, simmer on low until beef is tender. Stir occasionally. Drain pasta if desired and add to beef mixture. Simmer 3 - 5 minutes to heat everything through and serve.

title: Crab Roulards
ingredients: 1 small rib-eye steak | 1 package fresh cranberries, coarsely chopped | 1/2 package imitation crabmeat, drained, flaked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Slice steak into 1/4 inch thick, 2 inch wide strips, and place onto a large baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 12 minutes, turning once, or until cooked to desired doneness. Meanwhile, combine cranberries and imitation crabmeat in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,chili pepper flake,olive,catsup,cocoa
title: Spanish Hot Dogs
ingredients: 4 -6 hot chili peppers ( can leave seeds in if you like ) | 1 packet ras el hanout spice mix | 1 teaspoon cocoa | 1 teaspoon catsup | 1 tablespoon olive
instructions: Put the chillies in a large frying pan with a lid. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt. Crush with a potato masher and heat slowly. Add the spices and catsup. When boiling, reduce heat and allow to simmer for 1/2 an hour. This is when you add the olives. These dogs will only be good to eat after 2 - 3 hours though. To freeze, freeze in a single layer and cook as required.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,oregano leaf,dressing,baby spinach,green pepper,chinese five spice powder,mustard powder,red bean
title: Five-Spice Beef Salad for Crock Pot (Diabetic Diet)
ingredients: 1 red beans, small ( or red beans ) | 1 jar baby spinach ( or 3 cups baby kale ) | 1 green pepper, small | 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon-style mustard powder | 6 tablespoons fat-free ranch dressing ( or litehouse dressing or equivalent. you may also substitute other brands of low fat dressing, though i think the fat free ones really work ) | 1 pinch chinese five spice powder ( optional ) | 1 pinch oregano leaves ( optional )
instructions: Drain red beans, split the beans vertically in half, remove the ends, and then put each half into a crock, or use a crockpot liner if available with a liner. Add all ingredients to crock. Stir, and transfer to a crock pot for 2 hours on low. Serve on a bed of greens, or as a side dish. Note, i sometimes use 1 cup of red beans instead of whole beans and the spinach can be chopped into the salad before serving as well.

Random Ingredients: honey dijon mustard,chili pepper flake,quinoa,beef bouillon granule,lemon leaf,thai red curry paste
title: Quick and Easy Thai Red Curry
ingredients: 2 cups couscous or 2 cups quinoa | 1/4 cup thai red curry paste ( more or less to taste ) | 3 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon honey dijon mustard | saffron strand ( see note ) | 2 -3 lemon leaves | 1 teaspoon mild chili pepper flakes
instructions: In a large pot bring 2 cups water. Add rice. Stir to blend and heat until the water is absorbed.. Once the water is absorbed, add curry paste and remaining ingredients. Stir to mix. Reduce heat and simmer covered 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and let sit at least 5 minutes. Top and serve with lemon wedges for squeezing in.

Random Ingredients: pepper,bulk italian sausage,vanilla extract,mace,salt black pepper,dark molasses
title: Southern Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark molasses | 1/2 teaspoon coarse salt ( kosher or sea salt, if possible ) | 12 links sweet italian sausage or 12 other bulk italian sausage, casing removed | 1 teaspoon freshly grated fresh nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon coarse salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the grill. In a small bowl, combine the molasses, salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: rump steak,raisin,pork loin,turkey,pizza sauce,hot italian sausage,rotel
title: Spicy Sausage & Raisin Pork Roll
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin, thinly sliced into long strips | 1 lb hot italian sausage, mild | 1 lb wild oats or 1 lb ground pork loin | 1 lb hot italian sausage, mild | 8 ounces raisins | 8 ounces rotel | 1 jar pizza sauce, any flavor
instructions: Cook all meats over medium heat in large skillet until lightly browned. Drain and rinse meats, return to skillet. Spread 1/2 jar of pizza sauce evenly on bottom of baking dish. Place sausage, raisins and rotel over sausage mixture. Roll up each sausage slice. Tie with skewers if desired. Place meat rolls in baking dish and cover with remaining sauce. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Serve with cooked pasta, mashed potatoes, noodles, or spaghetti.

title: Pancake Cheese Danish
ingredients: 1 package fat free cream cheese | 1 package shredded cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix cream cheese and cheese thoroughly. Stir in 1/4 of the bread mix, then mix in the rest.

title: Sliced Chili Red Rice Krispies
ingredients: 3 cups rice krispies | 3 fresh red chili peppers, seeded and de-seeded
instructions: Place the rice in a pan. Fill the pan with 5 cups of water. The water will just cover the bottom of the pan. Bring to a boil, then turn down heat and cover. Leave to simmer for about 15 minutes. Remove the cover, stir the rice to mix, and cook for five more minutes.

title: Tamina
ingredients: 2 cardamom seeds, cracked into fine threads | 1 teaspoon orange peel, coarsely chopped | 1 whole orange, zest of | 8 ounces tea
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan and use to heat through. Note, the cardamom seeds may cause bitterness, but the cardamom will not be completely lost. Alternatively, you can use an oil type fry pan to heat up tea, add tea mixture to pan, stir and heat. Garnish with orange curls and a twist of orange zest.

Random Ingredients: oriental sesame oil,black pepper,mung dal,artichoke heart,water artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Artichokes (Dees)
ingredients: 1/2 cup mung dal ( masoor dal ) | 2 tablespoons water-packed artichoke hearts packed in brine | 1 can sliced water-packed artichoke hearts, drained | 6 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarse black pepper, divided
instructions: Place moong dal in a medium bowl, stir in 1 cup water, artichoke hearts and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Cover, refridgerate overnight or up to 4 hours before rolling out on a lightly floured surface. If making this dish from dry pulses, pulse pulses in a food processor until they turn into smooth paste.

title: Kebabs
ingredients: 1 fresh green chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons of chopped white bread, soft textured bread ( optional )
instructions: Mix the ground green chilli with the chopped bread. The quantity will depend on the size of the kababs. If using soft textured bread, heat a large heavy based saucepan, add a knob of butter, stir in the mixture and simmer gently until the bread is very soft and beginning to stick together with your hands. Break off bits of the bread and stir them into the kebabs. If the mixture sticks before the bread is soft and sticky, add a few pieces at a time of water. Serve hot with indian chapatis.

Random Ingredients: garlic,italian sausage,dark brown sugar,mustard powder,pimiento,tarragon,white fish fillet
title: Simple Italian Fish
ingredients: 2 cans good quality white fish fillets, drained and halved | 1 jar diced pimientos | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard powder | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon or 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon, crushed | 1 teaspoon hot crushed garlic ( or to taste ) | 2 ounces italian sweet sausage ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange fish/pimento/rosemary/tarragon halves on a well greased, rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle fish with mustard, brown sugar or tarragon. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, turning once cook to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: lemon wedge,cashew,salt black pepper,accent seasoning,xanthan gum,grenadine,red bell pepper,mint sprig
title: Grenadine Granita
ingredients: 1/4 cup sugar or 1/4 cup splenda granular | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 2 -3 drops grenadine | 1/2 cup roasted cashews ( or raisins ) or 1/2 cup chopped peanuts ( or raisins ) | 1/4 cup finely diced red bell pepper | 1 1/2 - 2 cups chopped mint sprigs | salt & freshly ground black pepper | lemon wedge, to serve
instructions: First you need to make the granita mixture. Put the sugar, xanthan gum and a splash of grenadine into a small frying pan over medium low heat, stir until blended, stir constantly until combined, about 2 minutes. Add the cashews, red pepper and mint. Stir to combine, stir until combined, about 3 more minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Set mixture aside until ready to use. To serve, spoon 3/4 cup granita into the palm of your hand and spread to form a 1 in. Rise, or mound into a 4 in. Flatten cake pan.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,ouzo,yellow bell pepper,star anise,grape leaf,cream,chicken wing,salt pepper
title: Quick Moroccan Chicken
ingredients: 6 tablespoons ouzo | lemon juice, to taste | salt and pepper | 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings or 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings with a drumstick | 1 yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 star anise ( or 2 pods ) | 1/2 pint grape leaves | whipped cream, a few to serve
instructions: Add the ouzo to a frying pan, add the salt and pepper and whisk until emulsified, add the wings and toss until well coated and heated through. Transfer to a shallow casserole dish cover and marinate in a warm place for at least 1 hour. When ready to bake, remove the chicken from the marinade and fry in a non stick frypan, turning once until browned all over and cooked through. Drain on absorbent paper. While the chicken is cooking, fry the chile pepper until soft. Remove the pepper from the oil and cut into 1 cm cubes. Add the pepper to the frying pan and fry for a few min until fragrant. Remove. Add the star anise and the grapes and cook for a further two minutes. Remove from the heat, stir in the chile pepper and the cream, season with salt and pepper and heat through, just right before serving. Spoon the chicken onto plates and top with the pepper and chilli mixture. Serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,ricotta cheese,marinara sauce,oat,rosemary,cooking oatmeal,red potato
title: Oatmeal Vegetable Pies
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking oatmeal ( fine or medium ) | 1 lb red potato, cut into small pieces | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup yellow pepper, finely chopped ( any colour ) | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Drain potatoes in colander under cold water and drain well. Mix together oats, pepper, ricotta, parsley, and rosemary and set aside. Add potato mixture to oat mixture and mix well. Pour 1/4 cup marinara sauce into a lightly grease 13x9 casserole dish. Pour mixture in and cover with a second layer of oat mixture, and repeat until oat mixture/potato mixture is used up. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 24 hours. When ready to bake, remove foil, discard remaining marinara sauce and bake at 350 degrees for 30 - 40 minutes until browned on top.

title: Paleo Beet Rouladen
ingredients: 4 beets, halved and quartered | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons plain dried bread crumbs | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 1 teaspoon lard, or as needed
instructions: Place the beets into a large saucepan with enough water to cover the beets by 1 inch. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender but still firm, about 20 minutes. Drain, then place in a bowl, and cover with water. Let steam for 15 minutes. Remove the beets, and set aside. Place the stock and bread crumbs into a bowl. Mix in the coriander, lard, or olive oil. Return the beets to the pan, and gently fry over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Thai Wontons
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 7 tablespoons jalapenos, minced ( seeded if desired ) | 3 tablespoons ground lamb ( finely minced ) | 2 tablespoons instant black tea ( regular white or decaf ) | 1 package wonton wrappers
instructions: For best results use a food processor, a mortar and pestle, a blender or food processor. For a smoother wonton, finely chop jalapeños. To finely chop, mix all ingredients together. Place a few tablespoons worth of mixture on a wonton wrapper and gather to make a triangle.

title: Chilli Fish Burritos With Chilli Oil
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets or 4 white fish fillets | 1 -2 teaspoon chilli oil | 4 flour tortillas
instructions: Trim both sides of the fish and cut into strips. Mix together the chilli oil with the flour until it is all coated. Dip each piece of fish in this mix and leave to marinate for 30 minutes until it turns white. Fry in the pan until firm and slightly charred on the outside. Serve with a squeeze of lime juice.

Random Ingredients: bouillon,corn kernel,olive oil,tomato juice,lamb stock,anise seed,fruit,italian tomato
title: Tomato, Corn and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1200 g lamb bones ( leg or shoulder ) | 5 cups lamb stock | 2 cans chopped italian tomatoes | 1 package frozen mixed fruit, thawed ( such as zuccini, macaroni, cranberry or berry berries ) | 1 tablespoon chicken stock | 1 tablespoon bouillon, chicken base, or ( 1 1/2 to 2 tsp ) beef base
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the seeds for one minute. Add the meat and fry for 6 to 7 minutes until browned. Meanwhile, in a large stock pot, bring the lamb stock, tomatoes and their juices, the bouillon and aniseed to the boil. Simmer uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes or until the mixture has thickened slightly. Season with salt and pepper and puree in a blender or using a stick blender. Return the soup to the pan and return it to a boil. Stir in the mixed fruit and cook for 5 minutes. Then ladle into soup bowls, garnish with chopped fresh herb sprigs and serve.

Random Ingredients: oat,black tea leaf,natural yoghurt,bell pepper,olive oil,lemon juice zest
title: Yoghurt, Pepper & Olive Oil Breakfast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon lemon juice & zest of | 2 tablespoons low-fat natural yoghurt | 2 tablespoons cracked black tea leaves | peppers ( to garnish ) | 1 small bell pepper, finely diced
instructions: Place the oil, lemon juice & zest in a microwave safe bowl, microwave on high for 1 - 2 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds until combined. Add the yoghurt and stir well. Cover with plastic wrap & set aside in the fridge for around 2 hours or until it's time to use. Stir in cracked black tea leaves, peppers & diced bell pepper and serve.

title: Chinese Style Macaroni
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni | 2 1/2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Place noodles in a large bowl and cover with very hot tap water. Let marinate for 25 minutes. In a small bowl, stir together oil, cornstarch, ginger garlic paste, and 2 cups water until a smooth paste is formed.

title: Homemade Sourdough Crumpets
ingredients: 1 package small curd cottage cheese ( or any brand prepared with dairy-free milk ) | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and shape into small meatballs/dumplings. Bake on baking sheet in 400 degree oven for 12 minutes.

title: Barbecue Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato paste | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | salt | 1 3/4 lbs beef rib eye steaks or 1 3/4 lbs beef tips of stew meat | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, oil packed, patted dry, slivered | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 medium ripe mango, peeled, pitted, halved lengthwise, sliced
instructions: Stir tomato paste, chutney and salt together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: mace,parsley leaf,scallion,mix,baby back rib,kahlua,beef stock chicken
title: Kahlua Beef Ribs
ingredients: 1/4 cup kahlua | 2 scallions, chopped | 1/4 cup beef stock or 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 3 lbs baby back ribs | 2 tablespoons parsley leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons sour mix
instructions: For the rib rub mixture mix all ingredients in a bowl and then spread onto each rib. Seal the ribs and marinate for 18 - 24 hours in the fridge or for up to 4 days. Remove the ribs from marinade. Reserve the marinade, place ribs on paper towel lined baking sheet and let sit for at least 1 hour. Bake at 450f for 45 - 50 minutes.

title: Chutney-Steamed Fish and Mango Meat
ingredients: 600 g beef, steamed and sliced | 150 g green bell peppers, deseeded and sliced into strips | 1 teaspoon chili, crushed | 2 teaspoons paprika | 175 g mango chutney | fish fillet
instructions: Divide and line 4 - 6 ceramic cups with foil, allowing the foil to extend over the sides of the cups. Place beef, peppers, chilli, paprika, mango chutney and fish in the prepared dish. Cover tightly with foil and bake in a preheated oven for 30 minutes. Allow to stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Lingonberry Kidney Beans With Yogurt
ingredients: 3 cups canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons fresh lingonberries ( optional )
instructions: Place beans and vinegar in a food processor and process until smooth. Add remaining ingredients and process until well combined. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve. Garnish with whole lingonberry.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,grape,italian sausage,italian seasoning,oregano leaf,half cream,coleslaw mix
title: Italian Sausage Salad II
ingredients: 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 4 bay leaves | 4 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 4 cups coleslaw mix | 1 pint half-and-half cream | 1 package grape flavored frozen rapini | 1/2 cup italian-style seasoning
instructions: Place sausage into a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir until evenly brown. Add bay leaves and oregano.

Random Ingredients: celery,lima bean,cabbage,feta cheese,rice noodle,grapefruit,cooking oil,pizza sauce
title: Greek Rice Bowl With Lemon and Feta Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup cooked lima beans ( or canned ) | 1/3 cup chopped celery | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 packages rice noodles | 3/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup pizza sauce | 1/2 cup grapefruit, juiced
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet, and stir fry the cabbage, lima beans and celery for 3 minutes or until the cabbage loses its bite. Remove from heat, drain. While the cabbage is cooking, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the noodles, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes or until al dente. Drain, and cool. Remove the rice bowls from the heat and transfer to a serving bowl. Top the rice bowls with the drained noodle mixture, and drizzle with pizza sauce and feta cheese.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,picante sauce,sun tomato oil,coconut milk,brandy
title: Tex Mex Coconut Macaroon
ingredients: 1/2 quart coconut milk ( not skim ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | 3 -4 tablespoons dried sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 2 -4 tablespoons grated swiss cheese or 2 -4 tablespoons monterey jack cheese | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: In medium saucepan, bring coconut milk and brandy to a boil. Add dried tomatoes and continue to boil about 5 - 7 minutes. Remove from heat& stir in macaroni until macaroni is completely cooked. Stir in cheese.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,cornmeal,chorizo sausage,french bread,worcestershire sauce,red wine
title: Spanish Bread With Chorizo and Cornmeal
ingredients: 50 g chorizo sausage ( or other hot fat ) | 1 chili pepper, sliced into strips | 200 ml red wine | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon cornmeal | 2 slices french bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c/gas. Slice the bread very thick and line the base and sides of a greased ovenproof dish with it so that it fits snugly into the dish. To cut out a'mexican' style bread that breaks up, make sure all of the bread has been cut in half. Place the chorizo, chili and chili onto 1 slice of the bread and add the wine, worcestershire sauce and cornmeal. Pour over the bread mix. Dot with the other slice of bread, try not to add too much of the cornmeal. Cover the dish with foil and bake for 1 hour, turning the bread over towards the end of the cooking time. When ready to serve, remove the foil and turn off the oven. Leave the top crisp on. Leave the bread in until you serve it.

title: Roasted Green Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds green peppers | 1/4 cup butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Remove stems from peppers and discard. Place peppers into a 9x13 inch pan. Drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with salt. Roast in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Stir peppers halfway through.

title: Green Chili-Lover's Chicken Empanadas
ingredients: 12 ounces shredded rotisserie-cooked chicken | 1/2 cup green chili salsa ( hot ) | 1 unbaked pie crust ( refrigerated )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray a 13x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Mix shredded rotisserie cooked chicken and hot green salsa together. Roll into 11 inch circles. Place one circle on bottom of baking dish. Pile 3 tablespoons of chicken mixture evenly over circle. Cover with top. Bake at 400°f for 20 to 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Repeat with remaining chicken and chile mixture. Sprinkle tops with powdered cheddar cheese.

title: Chili-Flavored Beef Steak
ingredients: 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 lb sirloin steak | 2 tablespoons ground chiles
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside till foamy. Cut meat into 1/2 inch thick slices. Sprinkle both sides of slices with chilies and brown lightly in a non stick skillet. Cover and let rest 10 minutes.

title: Walnut Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 1 package ranch dressing mix | 4 tablespoons walnut halves
instructions: Dissolve the ranch mix and walnuts in a small bowl. Chill. Serve.

title: Lavage Hot Spot Barley
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley, rinsed and drained | 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate syrup | 1 tablespoon fresh lovage, snipped | dried lavage | chocolate syrup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the barley in a large bowl and toss with 2 ounces of chocolate syrup. Gently toss the barley with the syrup until coated with the chocolate syrup. Transfer the barley to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside until no longer warm to the touch, about 10 minutes. While the barley is roasting, combine the remaining 1 ounce of chocolate syrup with the lovage in a small bowl. Remove the parchment paper from the oven. When the barley is almost cool, whisk in the chocolate syrup mixture. The hot Spot bakes in the preheated oven until puffed and fragrant and slightly darkened around the edges, 10 to 12 minutes depending on the thickness of your barley. Transfer the hot spot to a serving plate and garnish with fresh lavage.

title: Czech Party Cracker Mix
ingredients: 1 lb chuck, ground | 2 cups dijon-style prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Place ground chuck in a large bowl. Using your fingertips, rub the horseradish through the meat until all the ingredients are thoroughly moistened. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Use 2 teaspoons of the horseradish per pound, or about 1/2 cup mix for crackers. Roll the meat mixture into 6 patties. Sprinkle the crumbs on top. Chill well before serving.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,balsamic vinegar,cremini mushroom,flat leaf parsley,spring onion,broccoli slaw mix,coconut milk,beef broth
title: Coconut Mushroom and Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk, light | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 1/4 cups low sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 spring onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup broccoli slaw mix | 12 fresh cremini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Place coconut milk in a blender and purée until creamy, about 45 seconds. Whisk tomato paste into coconut milk. Add broth, parsley, onions, and vinegar.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,farfalle pasta,limeade concentrate,baby carrot,dark chocolate,cake flour
title: Chocolate Noodle Cake(Karela)
ingredients: 16 ounces dry fenugreek seeds | 4 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 14 ounces frozen limesade concentrate, thawed | 4 cups baby carrots | 1 1/2 cups cake flour ( approximate ) | 16 ounces farfalle pasta
instructions: Place dried fenugereek in a small bowl. Break off 1/2 a tablespoon per noodle if desired and set it aside. Place chocolate, limeade concentrate, and about ¾ cup of the carrot’s cooking liquid into a sauce pan and cook over low heat. Let the chocolate mixture cool, but do not boil. Place noodles into a colander, stir in sugar, and let drain for about 10 minutes. Put noodles in a large bowl. Add remaining carrots, and 1 - ½ cups of reserved cooking liquid. Mix well. Add flour and mix. Let mixture cool before adding pasta, mixing well. Put ½ cup into 9x13 baking dish. Take a circle of parchment paper, about 12 x3 inches. Put noodles into the pan, spreading them out evenly in a circular motion. Put the baking dish in a larger pan of ice cubes. Preheat oven to 300f, put baking dish with noodles onto a cookie sheet that has been sprayed with pam. When the oven is hot, put baking dish and noodles into the 350 degree oven for 55 - 60 minutes. Take out of oven and set aside. Remove paper from foil, carefully place noodles into a serving dish, and serve right away.

title: Mexican Spaghetti Strips
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1/3 cup sweet pickle relish | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile, minced | 2 scallions, minced | 3 slices bacon, minced | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup shredded coconut, toasted
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti as directed on package. Mix relish, chipotle and scallions, then mix in bacon. Drain spaghetti, reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Combine with bacon mixture. Add almond extract and coconut, stirring until well combined. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Anchovy, Peaches Dip
ingredients: 9 small ripe peaches | 8 anchovies ( a good one, my way )
instructions: Peel the peaches, remove stones, and roughly chop the peaches into quarters, and place them in a mixing bowl. Add the anchovies, and mash the anchovies on the peaches with a wooden spoon or potato masher. Stir in 2 tbsp of boiling water, then taste and serve immediately.

title: Parsnip Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb parsnip, peeled and cut on a bias | 1 cup soymilk, for dipping | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 8 teaspoons grated swiss cheese | 1/2 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 0.5 can frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Grate the parsnip and set aside. Combine all of the ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate at least one hour. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 4 fresh poblano chiles | 12 slices fresh white bread
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Brush or spray the outsides of the poblano chiles with nonstick cooking spray. Slit the chiles open and carefully remove the skin. Peel the stems, remove the seeds and white membrane. Place the poblanos on a foil lined baking sheet, about 1/4 inch high. Slit the tops of the chiles all the way to the bottom so they are close to the center. Place the chiles under the broiler for 3 minutes. Move the chiles up the side of the broiler. Be careful, they are not going to burn. Remove from the oven, and place one slice of bread on top. Broil for 1 to 2 minutes until you can see the top of the poblano. Remove the chiles from the pan. Spread the tops with the remaining slice of bread and top with the poblanos. Repeat with the other slice of bread before serving.

title: Swiss Cheese Salad With Plantains #SP5
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 cup drained pineapple juice | 2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cranberries | 1/2 cup thinly sliced plantain, unpeeled | 2 teaspoons minced garlic powder | 1 lb kielbasa | 1/4 cup lard, cubed
instructions: Combine all ingredients except kielbasa and lard. Place in bowl and toss lightly. Add cubed kielbasa and toss lightly. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Scotch Shortbread
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | salt and pepper
instructions: Mix together the flour salt and pepper mix with your hands making sure it doesn't clump together.. Roll into balls and place on lightly greased baking sheets. Leave for 15 - 20 minutes or until slightly browned and firm. I cut them in half to make them round. Bake in a hot oven or on a greased cookie griddle.

title: Healthy Wake Up Cereal
ingredients: 1/4 cup fat-free margarine or 1/4 cup butter | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup orange juice
instructions: Use a non stick pan, melt the margarine on medium to medium low. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Enjoy.

title: Lemon-Vanilla Brisket
ingredients: 1/2 lb corned beef brisket | 1 tablespoon lemon rind | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Score fat of brisket and sprinkle with lemon rind. Sprush the outside of the brisket with vanilla. Place brisket in a slow cooker. Pour 1/4 cup water into cooker. Cover and cook on low until fork tender, about 5 hours. Remove brisket and cover to keep warm. Remove brisket when cooked to your liking, place brisket on serving plate. Pour remaining liquid in cooker, cooking on high until it simmers, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Pour liquid over brisket.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,chicken thigh,corn oil,cream chicken soup,urad dal
title: Chicken and Lentil Curry
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into bite size pieces | 2 cups urad dal, washed and drained | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 pinch dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: In a large dish or skillet, put 2 tbs oil and 1/2 cup water. Stir fry chicken for a few minutes on all sides over medium high heat. Add the lentils, corn oil, and soup and stir. Turn heat down to medium. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes. Turn off heat. Cool for 10 minutes. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: salami,corn flake,ice,taco seasoning mix,ice water,sage leaf
title: Taco Filling for Tacos or Aspic
ingredients: 3 cups crushed ice | 2 cups crushed tortilla chips, divided ( i use rice crackers in a box ) | 1/2 cup minced salami | 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup crushed corn flakes | 8 fresh sage leaves ( can use dried sage )
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl combine 1 1/2 cups crushed ice, 2 cups tortilla chips and 1/2 cup salami. Microwave till hot and melted, about 3 minutes. Stir well, then let sit till cool. Stir in taco seasoning, corn flakes and sage. Mix well. If using a mortar and pestle mix well into mixture. If making for a party, simply stir well and then refrigerate till ready to use. Serve with your favorite tacos and chips.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,golden syrup,asparagus spear,vanilla extract,celery salt,nonfat milk,tea,sunflower oil
title: Irish Asparagus Pancakes
ingredients: 500 g asparagus spears, trimmed, washed | 4 tablespoons cold water ( use low salt water only or low fat ) | 1 tablespoon tea | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 3 teaspoons cake flour ( or gluten-free flour ) | 1 pinch celery salt | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon nonfat milk
instructions: Put asparagus in a pan on the stove. Add cold water, tea and vanilla. In another pan, combine flour, celery salt and water, add this to the pan, mixing quickly until you have a batter of thick, sticky batter. The batter will turn lighter when cooked. While its cooking, add the oil to a skillet and warm it on medium heat. Pour the pancake batter on the skillet in your pancake dispensers and cook until bubbles appear, turn and cook until other side turns golden brown. This is great with a salad and fruit salad.

title: Peanut Stew With Beef
ingredients: 800 g beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 spring onion, very finely sliced
instructions: Cut the beef into slices, 1cm thick and 2cm wide. Spread 1cm of the peanut into each slice of beef. Top with two slices of spring onion. Roll up and tie each with kitchen string, making sure the secure ends go in the peanut butter.. Heat a large frying pan over a high heat and stir fry the beef until browned. Stir in the chunky peanut butter and cook for 1 minute. Serve hot.

title: Cabbage, Goat Cheese and Coconut Milk Stir Fry-Low-Fat.
ingredients: 4 tablespoons gorgonzola or 4 tablespoons other blue cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 200 ml coconut milk | 200 ml skim milk or 200 ml skim milk | 500 g ground meat | 1/2 head cabbage, shredded ( or 1/2 of each, if very large, shredded ) | 200 g bok choy
instructions: Pour coconut cream sauce into large pan on low medium and stir to prevent sticking. Add corn starch and stir, allow to cook and thicken, then immediately add gorgonzola cheese and stir. Add meat.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,red enchilada sauce,beef sirloin steak,green pepper,peanut,vanilla sugar
title: Beef With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 3 green peppers, cut into 1-inch squares | 2 lbs beef sirloin steaks ( about 1 1/2-pound ) | 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 2/3 cup green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 3/4 cup dry roasted salted peanut
instructions: Line a 9 x 12 x 2 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Line foil with foil and spray the top of the foil with nonstick cooking spray. Combine the steak, peppers and enchilada sauces in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low. Partially cover and cook until meat is tender, turning occasionally. Transfer meat mixture to a slow cooker.

title: Nepalese Green Chilie Puffs
ingredients: 6 large green chili, seeded and chopped ( the green chilie can be bought at most latin american stores, they don't sell quite as long in the packaged as they're sold ) | 3 lbs boiling potatoes, peeled and sliced | salt and ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a 12 cup muffin tin with 24 paper towels. Line the ends of the paper towels over a bowl, placing a paper towel between each mound to dry out. Sprinkle chiles on the un lined towels. Fill the paper lined muffin cups with potato slices.

title: Beef Broccoli and Pork Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb beef short rib roast, cut into 1 1/2 '' pieces | 1 bunch fresh broccoli, chopped | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: Prepare beef boullion cube according to directions on package, dissolve bouillon cube in boiling water. Add vegetables.

title: Cabbage Roll-Ups
ingredients: 4 ounces serrano ham ( from a tube-shaped ham ) | 1 bunch fresh rosemary, leaves picked off and chopped | 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon dry ground cumin | 1 sprig fresh maraschino cherry, washed and toasted | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste ( to taste )
instructions: Slice ham in to short slices about 1/4 in thickness. Combine remaining ingredients and spoon about 1 tablespoon of each herb mixture on to each piece of ham. Starting at the outside rim of a greased jelly roll pan roll ham slices. Pour remaining marinade over the rolls and place roll ups on top of the marinade and cover. Let sit at room temperature for 3 hours. To serve, place rolls in a deep serving bowl and surround with vinaigrette and some marmalade.

title: Smokin' Hot Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 500 g taco seasoning | white pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Sprinkle all over the inside of a large frying pan or wok. Mix together and store in an airtight container until required.

title: Cham-Tamari Rugelach (Tamari Spread)
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/2 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon finely chopped garlic, or to taste | 1 jar alfredo sauce
instructions: Mix cream cheese, water chestnuts, tamari, garlic, and alfredo sauce together in a bowl until well blended, 1 to 2 minutes. Refrigerate 3 hours before serving to allow flavors to blend, serve over seafood, chicken, vegetables, or crackers.

title: German Kebab
ingredients: 7 lbs pork sausage | 2 1/2 cups red wine vinegar | 2 cloves
instructions: Cut the sausages links at 4, 3 or 4 intervals each. Put the sausages in a large, heavy bottomed saucepan, pour hot water into barely enough water to cover and sprinkle the whole contents with salt. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes. Remove from the heat and skim any remaining water that rises to the surface. Add the vinegar and cloves and boil for a further 35 minutes. The liquid should be syrupy. When it is, remove the cloves and add it to the sausage. Leave to cool down to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 4 days or, up to 3 days, up to a month.

title: German Style Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage | 1 cup elbow macaroni | 1 cup sunflower seeds | 1 cup dill | 1 cup beer | 1/2 cup dill ( garnish )
instructions: Grate raw cabbage. Chop sunflower seeds coarsely. Combine all ingredients together in a salad bowl. Garnish with dill.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,lemon,catsup,mango chutney,pea,beef rib,red chilies,bouquet garni
title: Lennie & Donna's Curried Ribs
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs beef short ribs, trimmed | 10 red chilies, seeded & chopped | 6 red bell peppers, deseeded & chopped | 1 lemons or 1 lime, juice of or 1 lemon, juice of | 4 tablespoons catsup | 3 tablespoons mango chutney or 3 tablespoons relish | 3 bouquet garni, thyme ( or all herbs )
instructions: Cut the short ribs into four pieces & remove the excess fat. Trim the excess fat & membrane from the ribs & cut them into a large roasting tin. Mix the chillies, red chilies, peppers, lemon or lime juice, the catsup & chutney together in a bowl & add the meat & marinade for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator, or up to 24 hours, shaking occasionally. Remove the meat from the marinade.

Random Ingredients: salsa verde,vodka,sage,russet potato,heavy whipping cream,rice,yellow squash,mint leaf
title: Grilled Squash Fonduta
ingredients: 1 lb yellow squash, halved and seeded | 2 russet potatoes, halved | 1/2 cup chopped fresh sage | 2/3 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup salsa verde | hot cooked rice | fresh sage, for garnish
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Place squash and potatoes in a bowl and sprinkle with 1/4 cup sage and 1/2 cup mint. Let stand 15 minutes, then squeeze the excess moisture from the vegetables. Cut the reserved leaves from the remaining sage and mint leaves into small pieces. Stir the cream and salsa verde in a small bowl and set aside. Remove the squash from the bowl and cut into chunks. Discard tips and cores. Add the squash to the cream and stir to coat and set aside 4 hours or overnight. Remove from the grill and allow to cool for 1 hour. Strain the stock and squeeze any excess liquid back into the bowl. Return the squash to the stock. Let stand 15 minutes. Remove the pits and add remaining sage and mint. Taste adjust salt and lime juice if needed. Serve with hot rice and fresh sage.

title: Pineapple Avocado Smoothie
ingredients: 1 avocado, peeled ( with skin on, in natural juices ) | 1/2 pineapple, juice of | 1/4 cup yoghurt, smooth
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender, and blend on highest setting, until all ingredients are smooth. Pour into glasses, and top with sour cream if you wish to use it.

title: Homemade Chicken and Dumplings (Tseau)
ingredients: 2 chicken, cut into pieces | 1 lb red chili, seeds and membrane removed | 1 inch piece fresh sage leaf | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 1 lb spaghetti, medium size
instructions: Place chicken pieces onto baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt and pepper while chicken is soaking. Remove from heat. Let chicken sit at room temp 1 hour. Drain chicken. Place soaked chicken into a large mixing bowl, add sugar, chillies, sage and chicken. Mix well. Place bowl over open coals or coals of your choice until chicken is completely submerged. Cover bowl tightly with aluminum foil and grill or broil chicken 6 minutes per side for medium or longer depending on your taste.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,shell pasta,rosemary,chicken bouillon granule,broccoli,date
title: Quick and Easy Broccoli Pasta
ingredients: 4 cups fresh broccoli, cut up in bite size | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granule | 1/4 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1 1/2 cups uncooked small shell pasta
instructions: Cook broccoli in small amount of boiling water until tender crisp.

title: Koshary
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vermouth ( dry white wine ) | 1 cup almond milk | 1 bunch baby spinach ( trimmed and cleaned, preferably baby greens ) | 4 tablespoons lobster, cooked, minced ( such as mussel or clam ) | crushed cinnamon stick | 12 frozen dinner rolls, thawed if frozen | 1/2 cup crumbled cooked fresh sweet potato sticks
instructions: In a saucepan, combine vermouth, almond milk, spinach, and lobster.

title: Camarao (Shrimp) Con Gambas
ingredients: 24 shrimp, cooked, peeled and deveined | 2 cans tomato paste | 1 bottle beer
instructions: Heat the tomato paste in a large sauce pan. Add the shrimp to the pan, stir, and pour beer over all. Cover the pan and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes.

title: Rigatoni Con Shiitake & Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 shiitake mushrooms ( or more ) | 1/4 - 1/2 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Wash and remove tough stems from mushrooms. Remove and discard blackened mushroom caps. Wash, dry and slice into quarters. Cook pasta as directed on package. Pour hot water over the pasta until it is tender. Remove from heat and add sliced mushrooms. Cover until cooled. Do not drain the pasta. Add salt and pepper if needed.

title: Ziploc Tomato Fritters for Indian Meals
ingredients: 1 bag ziploc | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground xanthan gum | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 cup dry sherry
instructions: Using a food processor, finely grind the ziploc bags to make fine crumbs.

title: Couscous Crusted Beef & Beet Tenders
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck ( trimmed of all visible fat and cut into 1/4-inch x 1 1/4 inch chunks ) | 1 teaspoon finely ground cajun seasoning, divided | 1/2 large red potato, cut into 1/4-inch x 1 1/4-inch strips | 8 white rum, divided ( about 2 1/2-ounce bottles ) | 1 lb beet, trimmed and cut into 1/4-inch x 1 1/4-inch strips ( about 3-6 medium beets ) | 2/3 cup couscous, prepared according to package instructions
instructions: Place chuck chunks in bowl and sprinkle with 1/4 tspn of the spice mix. Toss the cubes in the remaining 1 1/2 tspn spice mix, stirring to coat. Heat 1 1/4 cups rum in large nonstick skillet over high heat until bubbles form. Add half of the beef and stir fry until browned. Remove from heat and drain off any accumulated juices. Repeat with remaining beef. Return the all but 1/2 tspn rum to the same skillet. Add potato sticks and remaining 1/2 tspn spice mix and stir fry over high heat until golden. Stir in the beet strips. To serve, mound couscous on serving platter and spoon beef and beet mixture onto it. Garnish with remaining sprigs of sprigs of sprigs of sprigs.

title: Lebanese Pea & Lentil Casserole
ingredients: 1 large onion, finely chopped | 2 1/2 ounces butter or 2 1/2 ounces margarine | 1 1/2 cups brown lentils or 1 1/2 cups red lentils | 1 cup milk | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Heat the butter in a saucepan, and add the onion. Sauté until onion is browned. Add the lentils, milk, and dried mint. Bring to the boil, then simmer until the lentils are well cooked.

Random Ingredients: kahlua,plain yogurt,wheat flour,creamy italian dressing,baby red potato,vegetable,lemon peel,cheese ravioli
title: Potato Potato Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups plain yogurt | 1/4 cup creamy italian dressing ( i prefer heinz ) | 3 tablespoons kahlua or 3 tablespoons other coffee liqueur | 6 cups mixed vegetables ( such as potatoes, zucchini, etc. ) | 1 1/2 lbs small whole wheat flour or 1 1/2 lbs all-purpose flour, plus extra to dusting | 1/2 cup sliced lemon peel | 12 ounces cheese ravioli, or small fresh cheese ravioli, quartered | shredded cheese ravioli, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f coat the large baking sheet with cooking spray. Stir yogurt and french dressing together in a large bowl. Add kahlua/flavored liqueur and mix well to combine. Add vegetables of your choice to this and stir well to combine. Add flour and lemon peel, stir until well blended. Add half of the dry ingredients, and stir until just combined. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and divide into half. Shape each half into a round about 12 inches long and 7 inches wide. Place dough on prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle top of dough with shredded cheese. Bake on center rack of the oven approximately 25 minutes, until crust is golden brown, crusty edges begin to pull away from the side of the baking sheets slightly, and toppings have formed. Cut in 4 sections and serve warm.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 32 ounces lobster meat | 32 ounces broth
instructions: Bring all ingredients to boil and then lower heat to simmer. Cook for about a day. When done, remove from heat and allow to cool slightly before opening the can. The lobster and broth will be separated and the lobster butter will have thickened.

title: Sweet, Sour and Creamy Turnip Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon italian salad dressing mix ( good seasons brand or similar ) | 2 lbs small turnips, peeled and quartered
instructions: In a large bowl mix salad dressing mix and turnips. Microwave on high for 2 minutes, stirring once. Cover and cook on high for 1 minute more or until turnips are tender.

title: Cafe Rio Carnitas
ingredients: 4 large tortillas | 1 package frozen pork baby back ribs | 2 -3 lbs beef | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 can jalapenos | 1 package of spaghetti
instructions: Brown ribs in oil, then throw out when finished. Brown the frozen ribs, chop up, set aside & drain. Saute the ground beef & ground beef together and throw out any excess fat. When ready to make and serve, mix with 1 cup of whipping cream, mix well & let simmer while making your carnitas. Boil 3 packages of spaghetti or your preferred amount of meat. Add meat to crockpot & cook on low to medium heat for 5 hours. Serve carnitas with tortillas, salsa, & guacamole.

Random Ingredients: mix,apple juice concentrate,lime juice zest,kalamata olive,sugar snap pea
title: Spanish Snap Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen sugar snap peas, thawed | 1/3 cup apple juice concentrate ( i use concentrate and i get this out frozen but it's not necessary ) | 1 tablespoon lime juice ( lime juice ) | 1/4 cup sliced kalamata olive ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sweet and sour mix
instructions: Shake everything but the olives with half the olives in a bowl and then refrigerate for 2 hours. Right before serving, scatter the remaining olives over the top.

title: Guacamole Mix
ingredients: 12 -15 ounces vodka | 5 ounces chives ( fresh minced, not dried ) | 4 tablespoons parsley | 1 1/2 ounces italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cilantro
instructions: Put all in a jar, cover and shake. Put into the refrigerator for 2 weeks before use.

title: Spicy Mini Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 spring onion, chopped | 500 g fresh salmon fillets, skinned, pin bones removed ( about 6 large bones ) | 1 lb small whole wheat pasta, cooked
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together sauce, extract and chopped onion, set aside. Cut 6 slices salmon into four portions crossways, rub 1/2 of the onion mixture onto the outside of each piece of salmon. Place onto oiled baking tray, drizzle with remaining onion mixture and cook in 350f oven for 12 - 15 minutes or until cooked through. Meanwhile, cook spiral of pasta and toss with remaining onion mixture. When the skewers are ready and the sauce is bubbling serve 3 skewers per person.

title: American Mango Barbecue
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mango | 1 large bell pepper, chopped | 1 large vidalia onion | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/3 cup molasses, extra-virgin | 3 tablespoons red chili powder | 2/3 lb dry macaroni ( or elbow macaroni )
instructions: Dice the mango and sweet onion into 1/2 inch cubes, then rinse and dry, if required. Bring 1/2 inch water to a boil in a large nonstick skillet. Add the mango and sweet onion and cook until the mango is just tender and translucent, 4 to 6 minutes. Drain off any excess water if necessary. Mash the mango with a fork or potato masher to a coarse puree. Heat the molasses or maple syrup in a 1 quart heavy saucepan over moderate heat and, stirring, cook for 5 minute. Add the red chili powder and stir to blend. Add the mango mixture and cook until heated through, about 3 minute stir in the macaroni. Transfer to a platter. Serve warm.

title: Macaroni and Polenta Salad (Kima Nueyos Kebab)
ingredients: 400 g elbow macaroni | 2 stalks lemongrass, bruised | 4 large poblano chiles | 1 bunch cashews | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds ( toasted ) | 150 g instant polenta ( polenta crystals )
instructions: Rinse pasta and set aside. Place lemon grass stalk in saucepan of boiling water, lower heat and allow to cook for 2 minutes strain and set aside to cool slightly. Wash chilies, remove stalk and seed and coarsely chop chilies. Place macaroni in large bowl, add the chillies, cashew nuts and sesame seeds and mix well. Add the chilli paste and mix. Dilute polenta in a bit of boiling water and slowly add to macaroni mixture, stirring as it boils. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring continuously until the mixture is thick and creamy and all of the water has evaporated. Remove from heat and stir in sesame seeds until well blended. Store in refrigerator but shake off excess fat.

title: Pears Poached With Asiago and Pasilla
ingredients: 3 cups diced pears | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | salt and pepper | 1/2 cup asiago cheese or 1/2 cup romano cheese, grated | 1/4 teaspoon chili
instructions: In a medium sauté pan heat a bit of oil until shimmering. If it smokes, add more oil and if it ignites add more oil. Add the pears and fennel seeds and sauté until the pear is just soft and the fennel seeds have begun to pop a little, about 2 to 3 minutes. Add the asiago cheese and chili. You may see small bubbles, this is all because i let it cook while the cheese is cooking, so you may need to add more oil. Serve immediately before eating.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,celery seed,apple,dark chocolate,romaine lettuce,cocoa,rice noodle,italian tomato
title: Chili and Chocolate Lettuce Wrapped Noodles (Chokladbollar)
ingredients: 3 italian tomatoes, cut into wedges | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 tablespoon rice noodles, broken into individual triangles | 1 teaspoon celery seeds | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 8 leaves romaine lettuce ( optional ) | 1/2 cup packed dark chocolate
instructions: Preheat barbecue. For chili, broil tomatoes 8 minutes on each side or until tender. Remove from heat. Set aside 30 minutes or until cool. For noodle, in medium bowl, combine noodles, celery seeds, mustard seeds and cardamom seeds,. Place in large mixing bowl. Add cooked noodles, tomatoes, and cheddar cheese. Mix well. Divide among lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: elderflower cordial,sauce,cooking spray,mango chutney,table salt,heavy whipping cream,coriander powder
title: AIP Creamy Fruit Chutney
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 tablespoons minced elderflower cordial | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 2 teaspoons hot sauce ( such as tabasco ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place rack in center of oven. Preheat to 300 degrees. Prepare a large, heavy duty rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray coating it well. In a small bowl, stir all ingredients well. Use a small spoon to spoon 2 cups of mixture into prepared pan. Using a knife, spread evenly to cover. Add any remaining fruit to pan, then cover with cream, mashing as you go. Cover and bake in center of oven until fruit is warmed through and reduced to 1 1/4 cups, about 1 hour. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Homemade Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup italian cheese, shredded | 1 cup sour cream | 7 1/2 cups flour, divided
instructions: Mix italian cheese, sour cream, and 3 cups of flour together in a large bowl. Knead dough until a smooth, elastic ball forms. Cover bowl with moist kitchen towel and continue kneading dough until ball is 1/2 inch thick, approximately 7 1/2 3 1/2 hours. Roll out dough thinly to about a 1/8 inch thickness on a floured work surface.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,no salt tomato,tabasco sauce,coffee,chinese five spice powder,scallion
title: Chinese Coca-Cola-Free Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 can no-salt-added crushed tomatoes | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 bunch scallion, chopped | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a blender, and process until mixture is pureed. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with homemade french rolls or corn tortillas.

Random Ingredients: beef,espresso powder,cardamom powder,scallion,deli roast beef,meat,red chili pepper
title: Vietnamese Coffee Pot Roast
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 1/2 cups shaved deli roast beef ( may sub any size deli roast also desired ) or 1 1/2 cups leftover cooked beef ( may sub any size deli roast also needed ) | 4 thinly sliced scallions | 1 cup shaved fresh red chili pepper | 1/2 cup instant espresso powder | 1 tablespoon grated cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon ground red chili pepper | coarsely chopped fresh scallion ( optional )
instructions: Mix, beef, 1 1/2 c shaved roast beef, scallions, red chili pepper, espresso powder, cardamom, and chili pepper. Shape into 4 patties about 3/4 in diameter. Broil or grill patties 5 to 7 inches from heat until no pink remains, about 3 - 5 minutes per side for med rare or 7 to 10 minutes per side for well done. If desired, garnish with finely sliced scallions. Note, i also have been known to broil or grill beef on an aluminum foil covered cookie sheet for 3 minutes, flipping once, and removing after 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,cardamom,ketchup,green pepper,chipotle chile powder,white wine vinegar
title: Cabbage ‘n Chipotle’
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage | 1 large green pepper | 1 can chipotle chile powder | 3 -4 teaspoons ketchup | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon of minced chipotle chile powder | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Cut a slice from top of cabbage and core leaving root pieces. Cut the leaves lengthwise and place in a small bowl, removing the hard outer leaves. Wash head and core under cold water, drain and trim the outer leaves with scissors. Slice green and finely chop. Peel and mince pepper, set aside. Combine chipotles, ketchup, chile powder, vinegar, cardamom, and pepper in a small bowl place the oil in a pan of medium high heat and add the chipotle mixture, stir to blend well add the cabbage and stir frequently until the cabbage is just heated through. This will take about 5 - 8 minutes. Serve either warm or cold and enjoy.

title: Salsa Rolled Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon juice, fresh | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 4 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: In lg bowl, combine lemon juice, golden syrup, thyme, rosemary.

title: Chilaquiles
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1 container shredded mexican cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together ground beef, shredded cheese and shredded cheese until thoroughly combined. Shape ground beef mixture into 8 meat patties. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and cook the patties until browned, about 5 minutes per side.

title: Easy Chana Gumbo
ingredients: 1 bag chana chickpeas | 3 3 lbs garlic sausage or 3 lbs hot italian sausage | 8 cups chicken broth | 1 teaspoon chili pepper ( i don't add it ) | cooked whole chickpeas
instructions: Cut bag of chana chana into bite sized pieces. Place in a 3 quart saucepan and cover with water.

title: Szechuan Green Chocolate
ingredients: 6 ounces dark chocolate | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro
instructions: In a heat proof bowl melt chocolates together over boiling water until smooth. Pour in cilantro and stir until evenly dispersed. Refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour. Note, after a few minutes it can still be taken out and removed.

title: Oatmeal Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef flank steak | 3/4 cup quick-cooking oats | cooking spray or butter
instructions: Score the beef in the usual manner and sprinkle with salt. Prepare quick cooking oats per package directions. Spray the cooking rack with oil and put it under the rack. Bake for 15 minutes on high. Lower the temperature to medium and bake, covered, for 30 minutes to a hour or more, until a meat thermometer registers 120 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,green olive,grape leaf,clam juice,garlic paste
title: Chipotle Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint clam juice | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon finely chopped chipotle chile in adobo | 12 -16 large green olives | 10 -15 grape leaves
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black red pepper,corn kernel,orange marmalade,dashi,chickpea,chicken broth
title: Spicy Corn Soup
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 4 cups chicken broth | 1 can corn kernels, drained | 1 orange marmalade | 1 teaspoon black and red peppers blend seasoning ( i used lawry's dijon ) | 1 cup dashi
instructions: In a large pot, combine all ingredients except dashi. Bring soup to a simmer, then cover and simmer until the vegetables are just about tender. Remove soup from heat and stir in dashi.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,great northern bean,thai basil,porcini mushroom,onion ring,tomato sauce,beet,salmon
title: Creamy Salmon & Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 large onion ring, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil | 450 g salmon, skin on | 450 g great northern beans | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup fresh flat field mushrooms, sliced or 500 g sliced dried mushrooms | 50 g porcini mushrooms | 25 g self raising flour
instructions: Arrange the onion rings and basil in the base of a lightly greased 3 litre pudding basin. Place the salmon on top, skin side down. Scatter any remaining herbs and dried mushrooms over the salmon. Pour the tomato sauce into the bottom of the basin to depth of 2cm. Cover, and gently place into a preheated oven. Set the watered tray in the bottom of the oven. Bake the fish for 1 hour, check when the water has evaporated and the salmon feels cooked. You may not need to cook it long enough, depending on the size of your seafood. Remove the fish and set aside. Turn the heat down slightly and stir in the flour until smooth and pale, approx 2 mins. Pour back into the watered tray. Cover and cook for another 20 mins, checking the consistency of the stew. The stew should be thick. Serve with fresh crusty bread and veggies.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,navy bean,pasta,coconut oil,bicarbonate soda,ginger garlic paste
title: Lebanese Pasta Salad
ingredients: 200 g uncooked pasta or 200 g couscous | 225 g drained navy beans | 4 cm piece ginger-garlic paste | 200 g shredded lettuce leaf | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet instructions. Meanwhile steam beans with ginger in a steamer, covered, for 2 - 3 minutes or until beans are cooked. Drain well and add back to beans and mix. Place in a bowl and add remaining ingredients, mix well and serve.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,chicken tender,anchovy fillet,liver,caster sugar,bread machine yeast,guacamole
title: Guacamole Bread Machine Chicken Stuffed and Dipping Salads
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders | 1/4 cup guacamole, store bought | 3 slices bread, 1/2 inch thick | 1 teaspoon anchovy fillet, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon pickled jalapeno, finely diced | 1 1/2 tablespoons anchovy fillets, minced | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons pickled jalapenos, minced
instructions: To make the salad starter, combine all ingredients in food processor and process until creamy.

title: Satay
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thai peanut sauce | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace, or to taste | 1 tablespoon oil, or as needed, divided
instructions: Mix peanut sauce, honey, and mace together in a small bowl.

title: Mustard French Toast With Easy Twist
ingredients: 4 tablespoons prepared dijon mustard | 2 cups vanilla ice cream | 4 -8 slices french bread
instructions: Combine mustard in bowl, add ice cream, stir until well combined, refrigerate for an hour if desired. Heat griddle. Soak bread in mustard mixture, turning and cooking until golden brown on both sides. Serve with cool mustard and dipping sauce.

title: Hara Masala
ingredients: 500 g canned chickpeas | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 2 tablespoons canning salt
instructions: Rinse chickpeas and put them in a large saucepan. Add the canning salt, peppercorns and canning sauce. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat, simmer for 1 hour or until chickpeas are soft.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,seasoning salt,roux,curry paste,chipotle chile adobo,taco sauce
title: Thai Chicken - Ww
ingredients: 1 -2 lb ground chicken breast | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry paste | 1/2 tablespoon seasoning salt ( i use johnnie's ) | 1 -2 tablespoon of minced chipotle chile in adobo | 1 -2 tablespoon taco sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon quick-cooking roux
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a food processor and pulse just enough to a rough paste. If it seems dry adding more sauce. That is it.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,mint,italian sausage,tomato paste,orange zest,chicken broth
title: Minty Sausage Chili With Italian Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 2 cans chicken broth or ( 14 ounce ) cans beef broth | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 3 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1 1/2 cups shredded reduced-fat monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Cut sausage into bite size pieces.

title: Indian Bread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon yeast | 1 cup warm 100 % whole wheat germ | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Use the bread machine method and start the machine, but the bread should be a little crumblier than normal. Place the warm greek and cardamom seeds in a small bowl. Sprinkle the yeast over the seeds and let it foam for a few minutes. Add the yeast to the breadmaker bowl and add wheat germ, cardamom and more of the kosher salt. If using a bread machine, combine 1 lb of ingredients in a mixing bowl and knead, adding more or less of the salt as needed. Grease a loaf pan. Place the loaf in the pan, cover and let rise.
