Bake in a 325 degree oven for 90 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 190 degrees.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,apricot preserve,graham cracker crumb,cake yeast
title: Danish (French) Apricot Crumb Cookies
ingredients: 1 package cake yeast | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup peanut oil | 1 jar apricot preserves
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Set aside. To bread flour mixture, add graham cracker crumbs and peanut oil in two batches. Knead dough on floured surface. Put in a greased bowl, cover with a clean cloth, and place in a warm, dry place. Set in a warm, free place. For baking, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease two cookie sheets. Roll dough into 2 1/2 inch diameter balls. Place on cookie sheets about 3 inches apart. Press 2 1/2 inch graham crackers into the middle of each cookie, leaving an inch around the edge. Place a apricot preserves in the center of each cookie. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from sheets immediately, and cool on wire racks. Store in a dry, closed container.

title: Homemade Beef in the Crockpot
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place steak in crockpot. Add worcestershire sauce. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Remove steak from crockpot and slice across the grain. Slice, pour worcestershire sauce over slices and serve. Note, use sirloin tip beef roast. It can be frozen for upto 12 days.

title: Thai Steamed Green Herb Ojak
ingredients: 4 large fresh mushrooms, thick stems trimmed | 3 lemongrass, ends trimmed | 3/4 teaspoon ground savory ( thai savory ) | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 3 tablespoons light-colored espresso | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram
instructions: Place mushroom caps on kitchen towel and dry. Turn towel over mushroom caps and let stand 10 minutes. Turn stems and rub all over with herbs, using kitchen towel to squeeze out excess dry liquid residue. Discard soaking liquid. Coat steamer rack with cooking spray and line spinach leaves in steaming basket over boiling water. Cover steamer and steam 14 minutes, or to desired consistency, turning once. Do not worry if stems are not all curled but should remain intact. Remove from steamer and slice crosswise. Serve topped with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,pine nut,red potato,coriander,red chili powder,vegetable stock try chicken,veal,linguine
title: Veal and Potato Patties
ingredients: 2 medium red potatoes, cut into 6 thin discs | 8 ounces ground veal | 2 ounces pine nuts, coarsely chopped | 4 ounces egg substitute | 2 teaspoons coriander | 2 teaspoons mild red chili powder | 1 3/4 cups vegetable stock, try to use as per your packet instructions
instructions: Place potatoes into boiling water then cook for about 5 - 6 minutes until just softened. Drain in a colander and toss with the meat and nuts. Make a well in the center of the potato mix and add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Shape into 4 small patties. Cook gently in a little oil for a couple of minutes each side or until browned and cooked through. Serve with your favourite condiments.

title: Maple Roasted Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup maple syrup ( may need more or less ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared mustard ( i prefer dijon )
instructions: Cut roast into 2 or 6 serving sized pieces. Combine 1/2 cup maple syrup with mustard. Spread evenly on the roast. Cover tightly with heavy duty aluminum foil, and wrap tightly. Place in a 9 x 13 baking dish or roasting pan with at least 2 inches of hot water on the bottom. Roast, uncovered, in a preheated 325 degree oven for 3 hours. When the roast is done, it will be falling apart and very thickly sliced. Allow to cool. Note, this recipe may also be frozen. Remove from freezer and thaw in refrigerator 24 hours. Shred with your fingers or shredding using a fork. I prefer to do this in a medium sized bowl, but you can use anything you like, ie., a roast beef that has been shredded and left whole. This is good as a meal or as a side dish, especially if you have leftover gravy from the roast. Serve over your favorite cereal if desired.

title: Easy Beef Chuck Stew
ingredients: 1/2 pound lean ground beef chuck | 1/4 cup organic carrots, sliced | 1/2 head outer leaves cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Place the beef chuck into a large, nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Add carrots and cauliflower to the top of the chuck. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low. Cover the pan and simmer until beef is very tender, about 2 1/2 hours.

title: Apple Apricot Spread
ingredients: 3/4 cup apricot jam, heated and strained | 1 large apple, peeled, cored and diced | 1/2 cup sour cream | marinara sauce, see note ( optional ) | chopped of fresh mint ( optional )
instructions: Combine jam and apples and mix. Serve in small bowls sprinkled with marjoram. Note, marinara sauce can be stored in covered container in refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Roasted Leg of Lamb W-Caramelized Onions and Cilantro
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs leg of lamb, bone in if possible | 1/4 cup tamarind juice | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup rice, preferably red
instructions: Trim any visible fat from the lamb and cut into 2 1/2 inch cubes. Using a meat mallot, or several smaller pieces of lamb, make four slits all over the lamb. Insert skewer through the lamb. Put tamarind juice, maple syrup, cumin and cilantro in a small bowl. Mix well. Pour 2 tablespoons of tamarind mixture into a small roasting pan. Put lamb in the pan and set aside. Put the remaining tamarind liquid and kidney beans in a microwave safe bowl. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and microwave on high power for 40 to 50 minutes, stirring after 5 to 10 minutes. Discard the liquid. Stir the rice into the lamb, spread in a circle, and then cover with foil. Put the lid on the pan and cook on low power for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the lamb is tender. Serve meat and drippings separately.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,avocado,onion flake,pine nut,peanut butter,green cardamom pod,tomato puree,romano cheese
title: Smooth Sweet Onion Smorgastro (Passover) from Chez Jose
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 tablespoon onion flakes ( or 2 1/2-inch chunks from a jar of a jar ) | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/4 cup fresh pepioo-free maple syrup | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed in a mortar | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons crushed dried onion flakes | 1/4 - 1/2 cup shredded oaxaca romano cheese | 2 -3 extra ripe avocados, peeled, pitted and diced | 1 tablespoon fresh finely chopped onion ( about 4 tablespoons ) ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted
instructions: In a bowl, mash peanut butter with a fork until creamy. Add sweet onion flakes, puréed tomato puree, tomato puree, pepio and crushed onion flakes. Stir in pepio cheese and cheese until smooth. Place the avocado, stirring gently once or twice to ensure all mixture gets coated in the avocado. Add the remaining ingredients, including the pecans just to heat through. Serve immediately. Serve with extra paprika on the side. Note, make sure to stir in the cheese last.

title: Oysters Rockefeller
ingredients: 1 pound oysters, shucked | 1 serrano chile pepper, chopped
instructions: Pour oysters into a deep skillet. Cook over high heat until any shells have popped and are beginning to darken the edges. Stir in serrano pepper and cook for 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: chicken,apricot preserve,peanut oil,liquid egg substitute,nori,grand marnier,vidalia onion
title: Low Fat Chicken and Apricot Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 4 sheets nori | 3 cups cooked chicken ( diced or julienned ) | 12 ounces commercial apricot preserves | 1/2 cup liquid egg substitute ( or use egg beaters ) | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 3/4 cup green onion ( minced ) | 2 teaspoons peanut oil
instructions: Prepare chicken or marinate meat and vegetables according to package directions. While the meat and vegetables are cooking, melt 2 t. Peanut oil in a medium frying pan or wok and add marinated meats and cooked veggies. Continue cooking on low for 10 minutes, flipping over the meat once or twice so it cooks evenly. In a small bowl, mix 2 t. Grand marnier and the remaining 2 1/2 t. Pound ingredients to make a paste. Add 1 - 2 t. Grand marnier mixture and stir for a few seconds to combine ingredients. When chicken and vegetables are finished cooking, remove the meat to a warmed plate. Using a very clean, flat surface, spread 1/3 cup of preserves on one side of each sheet of nori, followed by 1/4 cup of the meat and veggies. Top with another spread of jam and 1 1/2 t. Grand marnier.

title: Crispy Kiwi Pears
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh kiwi, finely minced | 3 very thin slices kiwi ( optional ) | 3 very thin slices canned pear ( optional )
instructions: Combine the kiwi, pear, and 1 tablespoon of the kiwi juice, if using in a large bowl.. Stir well to mix. Cover tightly, allow to chill until ready to use.

title: Steamed Beef Tampiquena Appetizer
ingredients: 12 slices beef tamales, 1 inch thick | 12 strawberries, 2 inch diameter | 3 tablespoons apple cider | 1 tablespoon soybean paste with fennel | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Combine vinegar, soy bean paste with fennel in microwave safe bowl. Microwave 30 - 45 seconds on medium high. Cool and slice tomatoes. Arrange beef in steamer over boiling water. Cover and steam until tender. Combine remaining ingredients and serve as desired.

title: Crispy Scallops
ingredients: 5 1/2 ounces scallops | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/4 cup chicken broth ( low sodium ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons rice vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the scallops, pat dry if necessary and place in small ovenproof saucpan. Add the remaining ingredients, cover with lid. Bring to a boil, uncovered, over medium high heat. Reduce heat and cook for 10 minutes, turning once. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,celery rib,french green bean,tomato soup,japanese eggplant,maple syrup,part mozzarella cheese
title: Eggplant, Tomato, and French Green Bean Bake
ingredients: 1 japanese eggplant, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 2 celery ribs, sliced | 16 ounces french style green beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 1/2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, combine the cubed eggplant and celery.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,caraway seed,harissa,extra virgin olive oil
title: Moroccan Spiced Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds | 1 teaspoon harissa or 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 200 g dark chocolate
instructions: Heat the olive oil, spices and harissa well, simmer until chocolate has melted. Cool slightly and add chocolate, stirring to heat through. Transfer to an airtight container and chill for 3 - 4 hours.

title: Crunchy Sweet Potato Wedges
ingredients: 3 medium sweet potatoes | 1 can diced green peppers | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/4 cup hot pickle relish ( any flavour ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg, toasted
instructions: Microwave sweet potatoes on high approximately 6 - 10 minutes or until soft.

Random Ingredients: english pea,breadcrumb,artichoke heart,tuna fish,mustard powder,chocolate chip
title: Tuna Melt (From the Chinesey)
ingredients: 1 can canned tuna fish, drained | 1/3 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup chopped english pea | 1/4 cup grated semisweet chocolate chips | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 12 marinated artichoke hearts, drained and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place tuna in a bowl and stir in the bread crumbs, pea, chocolate chips and mustard powder. Spoon mixture into an 8 x 8 inch glass pan. Top with artichokes and marinated artichoke slices, if desired. Cover loosely with foil. Bake 20 mins or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate seed,serrano pepper,caraway seed,ginger garlic paste,english muffin,coffee ice cream,salt black pepper
title: Maine Ginger Sandwich - Chomeur
ingredients: 2 teaspoons caraway seeds, roughly ground | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 fresh serrano peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 2 cups brewed coffee ice cream | 1 teaspoon salt-free black pepper | 4 english muffins | pomegranate seeds, to garnish
instructions: Toast the caraway seeds in a dry frying pan over medium high heat, cooking, stirring frequently, until they begin to release their aroma. Remove the pan from the heat, let them cool slightly, and set aside. Place the garlic paste and chiles toasted in a mortar, and grind to a smooth paste with the ground coffee. Add the ground coffee ice cream, season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Spread a thin layer of coffee ice cream on the english muffins, and top with the grated ginger garlic mixture. Sprinkle with piped pomegranate seeds.

title: Spiced Cornmeal(Cookin' for 2)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups whole wheat cornmeal | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup chopped nuts ( optional )
instructions: Place cornmeal in large bowl. Blend spices and garlic paste in blender, then stir into dry ingredients. Mix very well.

title: Easy Crawfish Etoufee
ingredients: 1 can whole peeled crawfish tails, drained | 1 cup cut green beans | 2 cansapplesauce
instructions: Combine crawfish tail, green beans, and applesauce in 2 quart dutch oven. Heat to boiling.

title: Grilled Duck With Pesto Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups prepared bottled prepared pesto sauce ( i prefer prepared pizza style ) ( optional ) | 12 ounces duck fat, fully cooked, skin on ( very thinly sliced, 3/4-inch thick ) | 1 red long, thin cut green stringy peas | 2 yellow summer squash, thick, sliced in 3/4-inch cubes | 1 orange, cut in 16 wedges | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Combine pesto sauce if using and spread on a grill rack. Place duck fat on grill rack over medium coals. Cook until lightly browned on both sides. Turn and continue to cook until internal temperature reaches 170°f remove to a cutting board to cool slightly and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Tear off 3 inch sections from the veal bone. Using a very sharp knife, cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Place in a large bowl. Toss with pesto. Arrange the peas, green peas, orange, and grapefruit in a small serving bowl. Sprinkle with oregano. Serve in salad bowls with orange wedges.

title: Strawberries and More
ingredients: 32 ounces fresh strawberries, cleaned, hulled and sliced | 1 cup unseasoned bread flour | 2 1/2 cups chicken broth
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, and cook, stirring constantly to prevent burning, until thickenredrebs of sugar are formed. Stirring occasionally, boil until thickened, about 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: szechuan peppercorn,cremini mushroom,worcestershire sauce,chipotle chile,red wine vinegar,harissa,panir
title: Chipotle Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces panir, cubed | 2 ounces cremini mushrooms ( portobello ) | 5 ounces red wine vinegar, cider canner strength is available ( red, blush, or white ) | 2 ounces worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon smoked szechuan peppercorns, roasted, ground | 1 teaspoon chili padi paste or 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, chopped | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon harissa ( cayenne )
instructions: Dice the mushrooms. Dissolve the cayenne in 1/2 cup of red wine vinegar. Add this to the sauce. Stir until incorporated. Add the worcestershire sauce, sichuan peppercorns, chile mixture, mushrooms and harissa. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Enjoy.

title: Greek Filling for the Pastry
ingredients: 1 cup fenugreek seeds | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar or 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 1/2 cups sifted or crushed greek spices | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Place dry ingredients in a large resealable plastic bag. Toast the fenugreek in a 400 degree oven until they darken and smell fragrant, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Using your hands, scrape the seeds and excess fat from the inside of the bag. Grind the seeds with a mortar and pestle. Stir the ground seeds and remaining liquid into the cooled paste just to heat up. Refrigerate for several hours to form a thick paste. When ready, stir it into the pastry. Allow to set before cutting.

title: Italian Salad Dressing
ingredients: 3/4 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs | 1 -2 teaspoon mixed italian salad dressing
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,beef brisket,poblano pepper,lemon extract,cooking spray,white chocolate,curly endive lettuce
title: Sinful Roast Beef Brisket in White Chocolate
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 2 teaspoons lemon extract | 1 tablespoon dried curly endive lettuce, or to taste | 2 poblano peppers, seeded and thinly sliced | 2 lean beef brisket, trimmed | 2 ounces white chocolate, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray. In a bowl, combine tomato paste, lemon extract, and curly endive. Spread tomato mixture evenly over beef, and season with pepper. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to overnight. When ready to roast beef, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place beef brisket onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for about 30 minutes, or until a meat thermometer registers 140 degrees f. Baste every 10 minutes with a small amount of tomato paste mixture. When beef is done, remove from oven, and slice to desired serving size. To serve, slice into a 1/2 inch thick slice, or into serving pieces. Spoon white chocolate equally over beef slices, and sprinkle with a little more white chocolate.

title: Almond-Glazed Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb fresh rhubarb ( cut into 3/4 inch pieces ) | 3 apples, peeled, halved and cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger powder | 1/3 cup dried bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons shallots, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons blanched almonds or 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, coarsely chopped | 1 package rice vermicelli or ( 20 ounce ) package egg roll wraps
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Toss rhubarb, apples, ginger, bread crumbs, liquid smoke and shallots in a large bowl. Shape the meat mixture into 4 logs and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 60 - 70 minutes, or until meat thermometer inserted in centre of loaf reads 160°f remove from oven. Meanwhile, toast almonds. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,brown onion,philadelphia cream cheese,tomato soup,sugar apricot jam,poblano chile
title: Refreshing Mexican Inspired Dip
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup chopped brown onion ( i add a little of each, then keep chunky to use on the side ) | 1/3 cup chopped poblano chile ( i buy the pre-seeded ones out of a can ) | 1/3 cup brown sugar-free jam ( i always use a 1/3 cup ) | 1 can condensed tomato soup | pistachios, chopped to serve ( optional, but oh sooo good ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees farenheit. In a medium sauce pan add the cream cheese, onions, chile, beans, and jam. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Stir in tomato soup and heat through. Place dip in an ovenproof bowl or serving dish. Sprinkle with additional chopped pistachios if desired. If you don't have all of the desired quantity, you can use the entire can of cream cheese.

title: Oyster Sauce Rice (Paleo)
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice, rinsed | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the rice, oyster sauce and parsley. Heat over medium heat until hot. Pour cream into saucepan and quickly mix together, stirring constantly until heated through. Pour cream mixture over rice and stir once or twice just before serving.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,onion soup mix,white pepper,taco seasoning mix,red pepper
title: Taco Bell Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained ( or to taste ) | 1 bottle golden syrup ( or to taste ) | white pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well before using.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,gruyere cheese,sugar syrup,brown ale,whipping cream,peanut butter
title: Swiss Caramel Mousse
ingredients: 1 cup sugar syrup | 1/2 cup brown ale | 1/2 cup whipping cream or 1/2 cup milk | 1 1/2 cups grated gruyere cheese or 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, preferably sharp | 1 cup peas and carrots | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Mix the sugar syrup and the beer and heat until boiling. Simmer for about 5 minutes until slightly thickened. Pour the cheese back into the sauce and boil for another 3 minutes. Mix the whipping cream with a little of the hot cheese mixture. Whip the cream again.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,double cream,red wine,salmon fillet,crabmeat,demerara sugar
title: Salmon With Crab and Sherry
ingredients: 2 kg fresh salmon fillets | 1 red wine | 300 g unsweetened soya sauce | 300 g double cream | 150 g roasted sweet red capsicums or 150 g pimiento-stuffed dried pimientos | 50 g demerara sugar
instructions: Heat the butter in a large frying pan. Add the bacon and fry until golden brown. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the salmon to the pan and fry for 5 minutes per side. Meanwhile pour the soya sauce into the pan and stir until smooth. Lower the heat and add the sugar stirring for a minute. Add the red wine and simmer for 5 minutes without colouring. Return all the salmon to the pan. Cover and simmer over a very low heat for 5 to 7 minutes, until salmon flakes easily when pierced with a fork.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,thai peanut sauce,banana,egg substitute,dill sprig,lemon zest,sultana,meatball
title: Tropical Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground lamb shoulder | 1 lb minced meat of lamb meat ( ground lamb ) | 2 bananas, sliced | 2 eggs substitute | 1/2 cup sultana, sliced | 1 cup chopped dried fruit ( raisins can be substituted ) | 2 -3 lemon zest, thinly sliced | 2 1/2 tablespoons thai peanut sauce | 3/4 cup chopped fresh dill sprigs ( or parsley can also be used )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f coat a 9 inch round pan with cooking spray. In a large bowl, mix together the ground lamb, ground meat, banana, eggs, sultanas, dried fruit, and lemon zest. Roll mixture into small meatballs, 1/2 inch in diameter, placing them in prepared pan. Cover, and bake for approximately 45 - 55 minutes, until lamb is cooked. Remove cover, and sprinkle fruit mixture over meatballs and bake for an additional 15 - 20 minutes, until fruit is cooked. Remove from oven, sprinkle with dill and serve.

title: My Polish Sausage Salad (Zupa Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 cup whole milk | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons dill pickles, finely chopped
instructions: Preparation time includes sausage marinade. You may have to do this in two batches. Grill sausage and let warm slightly. Remove to mixing bowl and sprinkle generously with salt & pepper, add milk, parsley and chopped pickles. Toss. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Eat warm. This can be made 1 - 2 days ahead. Use a loaf pan for sandwich buns, or small cookie sheet for serving the salad. If you want to freeze the sausage, place all of the marinade in a food processor, and process until smooth. Put sausage in a freezer bag and freeze for several hours, until very firm.

title: Filled Salmon Pie
ingredients: pastry dough, for a double-crust pie | 1 whole red salmon | 1 white onion, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Roll out two thirds of the pastry to fit a 9 inch pie dish. Cut out 3 or four circles with a sharp knives. Place the salmon on top, then cover salmon with the chopped onion and remaining pastry circles. Place the crusts on the top of the pie, seal edges with fork or pastry brush, and poke a few steam holes in the top.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,dark soy sauce,extra virgin olive oil,chili oil,yellow bell pepper,plain flour,orange cake mix,chunky salsa
title: Beef Sirloin Bake
ingredients: 500 g lean sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon chili oil, extra virgin olive oil | 1 ounce yellow bell pepper, deseeded & cut into strips | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon orange cake mix | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c/fan 160c. Place steaks in a casserole dish. Combine the flour, chilli oil & 1tbsp of water and season well. Cut sirloin into thin slices & toss with the flour mixture. Pour over the olive oil mixture and scatter over the red pepper strips. Bake for 15 - 20 mins on top shelf until cooked and the meat is browned. Combine ketchup, ketchup, soy sauce, 1 tbsp of the orange cake mix and 1/3 cup of the salsa. Pour over the meat and serve with the orange cake or the orange slice.

title: Fresh Swiss Chard with Apples
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, trimmed and cut into 3/4-inch wedges | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 4 large tart apples, cored sliced 1/4 inch thick | 4 ounces fish fillets
instructions: Cook chard under hot broiler or in toaster oven until softened and beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Place chard in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: catsup,walnut oil,nutritional yeast,lamb,cardamom pod,salt pepper,cake flour
title: Lamb Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb or 1 lb ground turkey | 1 cup cake flour | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 1/2 cup catsup ( optional ) | 1/3 cup walnut oil ( or vegetable oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 1/2 cardamom pods
instructions: Mix everything well together, except cardamom. Roll into 1 large meatballs. You can fry these or bake them at 375f for 20 - 30 minutes until done but have much more control over fry, whichever you cook them inches they're delicious as they freeze well.

title: Chipotle-Apple Nachos
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt or 2 cups sour cream | 2 tablespoons tarragon, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile, chopped | 10 -12 pretzels | 3 cups apple juice | 1 large yellow pepper, cut lengthwise ( about 1 pound )
instructions: Mix the yogurt with the tarragon, chipotle chilies, pretzels and apple juice. Taste, cover and refrigerate overnight. Break off pieces of the yellow pepper and slice in half. Spread the pepper slices out on a tray, cover and refrigerate for a couple of hours. Bring to room temperature before serving. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: penne,yukon gold potato,iceberg lettuce,adobo seasoning,chili powder
title: Easy  Mexican Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup thinly sliced iceberg lettuce, shredded | 3 yukon gold potatoes, peeled, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 6 cups cooked rotisserie-cooked chicken or 6 cups cooked turkey, chopped
instructions: In a large serving bowl, toss together the cabbage, potatoes, adobo, and chili powder. Toss with the chopped meat of your choice. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,cilantro,italian bread,chili pepper flake,mint leaf,quinoa,bratwurst,lentil
title: Quinoa and Turkey Dogs With Herb Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, cooked and drained | 1/3 cup lentils, cooked and drained | 1/3 cup fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, minced | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried chili pepper flakes ( or more to taste ) | 8 bratwursts, thinly sliced | 1 loaf crusty italian bread ( or 2 loaves italian, cut 1/2-inch-thick sections of your choice )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the quinoa, lentils, mint, parsley, cilantro, chili flakes and bratwurst. Toss to coat evenly.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,radish,orange juice,green bell pepper,fig,oil,napa cabbage,liquid smoke
title: Fig and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 350 g dried rice noodles | 1 orange, juice of | 1 1/2 tablespoons oil | 1 large green bell pepper, deseeded and thinly sliced | 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 3/4 cup sliced radish | 2 cups napa cabbage, sliced and shredded
instructions: Soak rice noodles in a large bowl of cold water for 15 minutes. Drain and rinse well with cold water, then drain again. Combine rinsed noodles with orange juice, oil, green pepper, cucumber, liquid smoke and radishes. Toss well and let stand for 20 minutes to develop flavours. Serve sprinkled with chedder or plain rice and salad greens.

Random Ingredients: italian salami,rosemary,guinness stout,chili oil,tabasco sauce,mustard green,salt pepper,baby spinach leaf
title: Guinness and Pepper Potatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs baby spinach leaves | 12 -14 slices italian salami | 1 pint guinness stout ( or other dark beer ) | 2 tablespoons sweet mustard greens | 2 -3 teaspoons mustard, and green blend ( i used dijon mustard and it was just fine ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | salt and pepper | tabasco sauce or hot pepper sauce, to serve
instructions: Wash, trim, and clean the spinach leaves. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the spinach leaves and cook them until wilted but still crisp. Drain and set aside to cool, about 10 minutes at the most. Squeeze the spinach dry before using. Wrap up the salami slices well and place them at the bottom of a large pot along with the spinach. Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour over the salami and spinach. Cook on medium heat for 15 minutes, turning the potatoes so that the salad is evenly distributed. If the bottom has a light crust, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mint,lentil,peanut butter,ginger garlic paste,vanilla bean,ice water,rosemary
title: Curried Lentils
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dried lentils | 6 cups water | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary ( optional ) | 2 sprigs fresh mint | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | ice water, or as needed
instructions: Place lentils and water in large bowl. Cover, and let soak overnight. The next day, remove the vanilla bean pod and scrap, discard the pulp. Return to the lentils, cover, and refrigerate. The next day, bring lentils to a boil in a pot with a lid. Continue cooking for about 2 hours, until the lentils are tender and water has been absorbed. Remove the vanilla bean. Discard vanilla bean pod and return to the pot. Remove rosemary, mint, and mint sprigs. Stir in the peanut butter until melted.

title: Peppercorn Cocktail
ingredients: 8 ounces pecorino cheese | 4 ounces good quality baileys original sauce ( e.g. heinz ketchup ) | 1 egg white | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Place ingredients in blender and blend thoroughly. Pour into cocktail mugs when serving.

title: Tomato and Lemon Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice, freshly squeezed | 2 plum tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Place the shredded cabbage in a strainer set over a bowl and sprinkle with lemon juice and finely chopped tomatoes. Toss the cabbage to coat well and let the excess liquid drain out.

title: Spaghetti With Meatballs from the Freezer
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal or 1 lb lamb | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Shape into walnut sized balls, and place on a paper towel lined cookie sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f for about 15 minutes, or until they are browned, no longer pink, and slightly firm in the center. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pot roast,cocoa powder,cornflour,oregano leaf,cumin,heavy cream,iceberg lettuce
title: Chocolate-Flavored Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 6 small sandwich steaks | 1 teaspoon cornflour, crushed | 4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 teaspoon cumin | 2 tablespoons oregano leaves | 1 cup heavy cream or 1 cup light cream | iceberg lettuce, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400°f lightly grease a shallow ovenproof dish or roasting tin. Place the steaks in the dish. Combine the cornflour, cocoa, cumin and oregano. Pour cream over steak. Spread evenly. Bake for 3 hours or until meat has just cooked and sauce has thickened. Serve with iceberg lettuce, if using, and crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,cantaloupe,celery,spinach,serrano chili,marinara sauce,basmati rice,italian bread
title: Italian Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta, cooked | 1 lb baby spinach | 1 lb cantaloupe, cubed | 1 lb baby spinach | 1 serrano chili, minced | 1 serrano chili, minced | 2 cups marinara sauce | 2 cups breadcrumbs | 1 cup italian style bread, crumbs
instructions: Mix all the salad ingredients together in a large bowl. Combine the two, adding additional bread crumbs to coat. Serve over italian bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: hard salami,vegetable stock,dark chocolate,dijon mustard,brown mustard seed
title: Mustard and Hot Chocolate Sauce for Ham
ingredients: 400 g dark chocolate, good quality | 100 ml hot vegetable stock, hot | 100 g swiss fried hard salami | 5 tablespoons dijon mustard, fresh | 5 tablespoons brown mustard seeds, dry roasted
instructions: Bring all the ingredients to the boil in a small pan. Simmer for 15 minutes. Pour sauce over ham and leave to set before serving.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,oil,soya sauce,amaretto,chipotle chile adobo sauce
title: Easy Chipotle Adobala
ingredients: 4 teaspoons oil | 1 pinch fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons all purpose amaretto | 1 chipotle chile in adobo sauce | 1/2 teaspoon pure soya sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a small saucepan. Add fenugreek and chipotles and stir fry for a few seconds or until golden and aromatic. Add the amaretto, pure soya sauce and chipotles. Stir until smooth.

title: Fajita Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 cup chili | 1 red bell pepper | 3 -4 tablespoons tomato soup
instructions: Place in a sealable bag and add chili, pepper, and tomato soup. Seal tightly, and place in refrigerator. This tastes best when freshly made fajitas from left over veggies from day old.

title: Cucumber and Cauliflower Salad I
ingredients: 2 tablespoons agave nectar | 1/2 cucumber, peeled, seeded and finely diced | 2 teaspoons sweet chili paste | 1 cup fresh cauliflower florets, packed | 2 teaspoons ice water
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the agave nectar, cucumber and sweet chile paste. Add cauliflower and toss well to coat. In another medium bowl, add the water and ice. Add the cucumber mixture and toss with the other ingredients until all the ingredients are coated and serve. Cooks note, you may want to adjust the saltiness of the chile paste with the amount of sugar it has in it.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,egg yolk,purpose flour,spinach leaf,tomato ketchup,fingerling potato,spinach,beet
title: Spinach and Beet Dumplings
ingredients: 2 lbs fingerling potatoes, boiled | 2 pints spinach leaves, chopped | 1 lb beet, chopped | 1/4 cup spinach ketchup | 4 cups all-purpose flour | 2 egg yolks | 2 teaspoons cilantro | 2 teaspoons tomato ketchup
instructions: Gently boil potatoes in salted water until tender. Drain and allow to cool. Peel potatoes and dice. Chop beet. Combine the potatoes with the spinach in a bowl. Add the ketchup, spinach, beet, spinach, beet juice, egg yolks, cilantro and tomato ketchup. Mix well. Put mixture in a large pan, stirring constantly. Reduce heat and cook for 20 minutes until mixture thickens. Serve warm with bread.

title: Lebanese Chicken in Spritz
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1/2 cup orange juice | 12 ounces low fat cottage cheese | 4 cardamom seeds or 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom | 1 ounce semisweet chocolate, melted
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken, cheese and chocolate and pour over chicken and marinate in refridgerator, covered, overnight, stirring occasionally and turning over several times. Bake at 350ºf, uncovered, for 45 minutes or until brown and tender. Top with melted cheese and serve.

title: Warm Sun Dried Tomato and Garlic Spread (Pensala)
ingredients: 5 cups packed sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 4 cloves peeled garlic
instructions: Bring sun dried tomatoes, garlic, and 2 quarts of water to a simmer in a 6 quart pan.

title: Warm Red Cabbage and Honey Salad
ingredients: 4 cups grated red cabbage | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice or 1 1/2 cups short-grain rice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 3 tablespoons clear honey
instructions: Soak rice for 20 minutes in enough boiling water to cover. Drain and rinse in cold water. Drain again and allow to dry overnight. In a large bowl, toss together all ingredients. Serve at once.

title: Italian Porcini and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh porcini mushrooms | 1 ounce dry yeast | 2 ounces canola oil
instructions: Wash and dry mushrooms and place in a large bowl with a good amount of freshly boiled water. Leave for 30 minutes. Drain and add 2 tbspnn of the oil. Mix well. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise for a further 30 minutes or until nearly double in size. When ready, place a large piece of aluminium foil on a surface that will go well over the bowl. Place the mushrooms on this and press any excess moisture from the mushroom with your hands. Sprinkle the mushrooms with more salt and pepper. Keep over low heat, covered, for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove foil and mix again. Allow to sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve in warm bread bowls.

Random Ingredients: white bean,heavy cream,marinara sauce,sage leaf,cream tartar,pork tenderloin,hot salsa,rice vinegar
title: Pork Tenderloin with White Bean Rice
ingredients: 1 whole pork tenderloin | 2 cups cooked white beans ( such as dried cranberry beans ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream, whipped with | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 fresh sage leaves | 1 jar marinara sauce | hot salsa, for serving
instructions: Pound tenderloin with a meat mallet, until very thin and about 1 inch thick.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,cream cheese,tortilla chip,fire tomato,mexican cheese,pork chop,milk powder,hazelnut
title: Cream Cheese and Roasted Tomato Chili
ingredients: 3 tablespoons creamy cream cheese, room temperature | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion | 2 teaspoons low-fat milk powder | 2 teaspoons instant minced turkey chilies or 2 teaspoons canned chili powder | 1 can fire-roasted tomatoes, drained and minced | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/3 cup finely crushed tortilla chips | 1/2 cup ground toasted hazelnuts
instructions: Combine cream cheese, instant minced onion, butter, and milk in a bowl.

title: Faux Italian Calzones
ingredients: 3 tablespoons egg whites, stiff beaten | 1 pinch white pepper | 14 ounces pizza dough
instructions: In a pie plate, mix the egg whites and white pepper until foamy. Stretch cheese slightly in the palm of your hand. Then pinch the mixture into a circular motion using the palms of your hands, lifting up the dough to make an even rectangle, working clockwise with your finger tips. Pinch the dough once again to make a circle and crimp the edges. In a 10 springform pan with a rim, brush the rim with the beaten egg white and sprinkle with the white pepper. Add the dough mixture onto the pan. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,mexican cheese,half,sea salt,veal cutlet,white pepper powder
title: Beef Pinwheels (Quesadillas)
ingredients: 1/2 lb veal cutlet ( i usually use 1/3 pound of veal cutlets and 1/3 pound of each cutlet ) | 1/4 cup half-and-half or 1/4 cup milk | 1 pinch white pepper powder | 2 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 pinch sea salt | 1 pinch instant minced white pepper powder
instructions: Put veal cutlets in microwave until cooked very quickly and fat has drained from meat and other veggie and meat. Remove cutlets to plate. Strain fat from pan. Bring fat from skillet to boiling. Add half and half and season with salt and white pepper. Cut warm tortillas into 1/2 inch crumbs and dip each tortilla into the fat. Allow them to absorb the fat for about a minute per side of flipping the tortilla. Then, flip over each crumb to get the other side on paper towels to drain extra fat. Repeat until all tortillas are fried and coated. Serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Hazelnut Bread With Chickpeas(Breechtsalat)
ingredients: 350 g whole hazelnuts | 1 medium spanish onion, finely chopped | 350 g raw chickpeas, drained and rinsed in hot water | 4 teaspoons rye flour or 4 teaspoons other bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c and line a baking sheet with non stick baking paper. Spread hazelnuts on dry paper baking tray and leave to cool. Peel husks from nuts by immersing them into a bowl of cold water. Heat a heavy based pan over medium heat and add the chopped onion. Cook, stirring for 3 - 5 minutes or until light golden brown. Add chickpeas and stir over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Add hazelnuts and stir into the chickpeas. Remove from the heat. Transfer mixture into a blender and process to a smooth paste. Pour mixture into a clean bowl. Stir the rye flour in and combine thoroughly with a small quantity of water in the same pan. Bring to the boil, stirring until mixture thickens slightly. Place the mixture in a large bowl of hot water. Whisk constantly over gentle heat until mixture boils and has thickened to your desired consistency. Pour the bread mixture onto the bread mixture and stir until all ingredients are well coated. Bake in oven for about 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Peanut Butter and Chicken broth
ingredients: 1 cup peanut butter | 6 cups chicken broth
instructions: Boil chicken pieces with peanut butter for about 5 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Drain and serve with lots of peanut butter..

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,dark chocolate,brandy,cube steak,fish sauce,green chili paste,clove
title: Steak With Brandy and Chilli Chile - Indonesian Style
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless cube steaks or 8 ounces sirloin steaks | 2 -3 tablespoons green chili paste ( or 1 green chili pepper and 1 tablespoon chilli powder ) | 2 fluid ounces brandy | 2 -3 tablespoons fish sauce, to taste | 1 whole clove | 1 -2 curry leaf | 8 -10 dark chocolate
instructions: Cut meat into 1/4 inch cubes. Mix chile paste, brandy, fish sauce, and cloves and marinate meat for 15 minutes. Thread onto skewers and grill or broil until browned. Meanwhile, melt chocolate in a large skillet or wok over low heat and stir frequently until smooth. Add meat and stir until just cooked. To assemble, spread cooled chocolate on the plate and place steaks on top. Spoon the meat onto the plate and serve immediately.

title: Yam Stew Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup shallot, sliced 1 inch | 1 cup water | 1 red chilies or 1 dried chili pepper flakes, crushed | 1 medium yellow squash, sliced
instructions: Saute shallots and chili in oil until garlic is transparent. Add water, cover and simmer 35 minutes or until all of the water is absorbed. Add squash and cook until tender. Salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,chicken drumstick,rice noodle,gruyere cheese,turmeric,broccoli,leg lamb,pearl barley
title: Newfoundland Laben
ingredients: 30 chicken drumsticks, bone-in ( or 8 whole chicken legs ) | 15 chicken drumsticks | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 1/2 lbs leg of lamb, bone-in or 1 1/2 lbs cross-cut lamb, boned | 2 cups frozen corn, defrosted | 1/2 lb frozen chopped broccoli | 1/2 lb gruyere cheese, shredded | 16 ounces sour cream-style corn | hot cooked rice noodles
instructions: Cook barley in boiling water until tender, but not mushy. Remove from heat. Sprinkle lamb, barley, and legs with salt and pepper. Cook, in batches of drumsticks or chicken in a large skillet with 2 cups reserved cooking liquid over moderate heat, turning, 5 minutes, or until brown and meat is tender and no longer pink inside. Remove from skillet and keep warm. Cover. Melt cheese in small saucepan over moderate heat. Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream. Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,ale,pork sausage link,red chilies,thai chile pepper,adobo seasoning,anchovy
title: Chile Dogs
ingredients: 1 large dried red chile pepper | 12 ounces pork sausage links, cut into 1 inch chunks | 4 1/2 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 12 anchovies, roughly chopped | 2 1/2 cups beer | 1 teaspoon ground red chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the chile pepper on a piece of foil. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of water and wrap tightly. Season with 1 tablespoon of adobo seasoning, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 2 anchovies with 1 teaspoon of water, and a pinch of salt. Place on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until peppers are very tender and beginning to brown. Place the sausage in a large, heavy skillet. Cook over medium heat until evenly browned. Transfer peppers and 1 tablespoon of adobo seasoning to a food processor and process until chile is minced. Drain off grease. Place the chile pepper and the remaining adobo seasoning into a medium bowl or measuring cup. Stir in the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons soy sauce and the beer.

title: Oriental Fried Plantains
ingredients: 2 fresh plantains ( each about 6 in length ) or 4 slices eggplants ( each about 6 in length ) | 4 teaspoons fish sauce, for basting | 1 habanero pepper
instructions: Preheat the grill, broiler, and position the rack 5 - 6 inches below the heat source. Brush the plantains with a little fish sauce and place on the grill rack. Close the lid, close the cover, and let cook about 10 minutes or until plantains are charred and very tender. Turn the plantains over using a wide spatula or a spatula. Turn them with tongs while browning them for 3 - 5 minutes more. Serve hot.

title: Quick and Easy Thai Style Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of thinly sliced spring onions | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh chili ( red, green or black )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a screw top jar and shake vigorously. The dressing can be kept, covered, for up to 1 week.

title: Irish Whiskey Tea (Cocktail)
ingredients: 1 cup strong irish tea | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Pour tea and cranberries into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Cover and shake vigorously for 10 minutes. Pour into irish cups, add a few spoons of sweetened sugar and serve.

title: Tabbouleh Pasta Focaccia
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces rotini pasta, small thin noodles | 4 tablespoons tahini | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 4 ounces salami, sliced very thin | 3 ounces fresh shaved italian parsley | 3 scallions, minced | 1 sprig rosemary | 1 sprig mint leaf
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until tender yet firm. While pasta cooks, mix tahini, flour, salami, parsley, scallions, rosemary and mint in a bowl. Drain pasta, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water. Place into skillet with tahini mixture and toss. Place pasta onto a serving platter and sprinkle with remaining herbs to serve.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,red pepper paste,sherry,bisquick baking mix,hot pepper,red lentil
title: Macadamia Nut & Red Pepper Biscuits
ingredients: 1 cup coconut macadamia nuts, chopped | 1 jar red lentils | sherry | hot pepper | 4 ounces red pepper paste ( i like cholula, peixe is good ) | 2 cups bisquick baking mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix macadamia nuts, lentils, sherry, pepper paste and baking mix in an 18 x 32 pan. Spread evenly on the bottom and up the the sides of the pan, to form an even circle that is 2'' thick. Bake in the oven until golden brown. If the top is not quite brown yet, bake for 15 or 20 minutes more to reduce the texture.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,wine,chuck steak,onion soup mix,french bread
title: Mom's French Dip (Beef Burgundy)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck steaks | 2 1/4 ounces dry dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup wine ( i use red ) | 2 kaffir lime leaves, fresh, chopped | 2 french rolls, split
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Coat bottom and sides of 12 cup baking dish with cooking spray. Trim any fat from meat, cut in 1 inch cubes and place in large bowl. Add soup mix and wine to beef. Stir to blend. Tie kaffir leaves in with wooden picks. Insert skewers in meat.

Random Ingredients: sea salt pepper,rice,pizza sauce spaghetti,chicken breast,large shrimp,sun tomato oil,garlic salt,coconut cream
title: Spicy Chicken with Shrimp (Gobby Bamella)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained of oil & chopped | 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into thin slices | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | sea salt and fresh cracked pepper to taste | 1 jar spaghetti sauce with spaghetti | 1 cup prepared pizza sauce with spaghetti | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 4 ounces peeled and deveined large shrimp
instructions: Place the sun dried tomatoes in a small bowl and pour enough water over to cover.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,orange juice zest,lime,chicken bouillon,yeast,catsup,red wine,cremini mushroom
title: Spanish Style Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup medium grain white rice, uncooked | 8 cups cooked chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 small fresh lime, quartered | 2 tablespoons cremini mushrooms, sliced, with stems left on | 1 tablespoon dry red wine | 1/2 teaspoon lime rind, minced
instructions: Place all ingredients except rice in a pan of simmering water and cook until water has almost evaporated, about 35 minutes. Remove from heat, add rice, and allow to sit for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the rice. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve it hot.

title: Pumpkin Delight
ingredients: 1/3 cup chili paste | 2 packages instant vanilla pudding, instant | 8 ounces fresh pumpkin, cooked, peeled and cut in 1 inch cubes | 4 green onions, sliced | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine chili paste and the pudding powder in a bowl and mix. Add pumpkin stir until coated. Add green onions and wine and stir until well mixed. Dump into a 3 - 4 quart baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray. Drain pumpkin and sprinkle breadcrumbs on top followed by the bread crumbs. Bake in preheated 350 degrees oven for about 15 minutes. If desired, a few sprigs of fresh mint may be added. Cool before serving.

title: Panera Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs mutton or 1 1/2 lbs lamb meat, with bone | 3 ounces panir | 6 slices pine nuts | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning | 4 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 1/2 lb crisp fried crisp onions ( see notes ) or 1/2 lb fried onions ( see notes )
instructions: Soak the lamb in cold water, drain well, and pat dry with absorbent paper towel. Trim any extra fat or gristle. Remove and discard the neck, feet, and silverskin. Cut into 3/4 inch cubes, discarding the fat. Cut the meat into bite size pieces and soak in plenty of cold water, ideally overnight. Trim and wash the meat well in cold water. Break into chunks or smaller pieces depending on the size of the chunks.

title: Japanese Onion Picky Baste
ingredients: 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1/3 cup mirin
instructions: Combine the first four ingredients in medium saucepan over medium heat. Bring to boil, stirring to dissolve bouillon. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Pour hot picky into large, hot coffee cups. Cover and refrigerate until very cold and bubbly, 2 to 24 hours.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,flat leaf parsley,lemongrass,oyster sauce,black bean
title: Black Bean With Lemongrass
ingredients: 1 cup prepared black beans, rinsed | 1 cup lemongrass, chopped | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Combine beans, lemon grass, and parsley in a food processor. Process until finely chopped. Add oyster sauce and cheese and process until smooth. Chill.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,black bean sauce,harissa,tomato sauce,green cardamom pod,red curry paste
title: Spicy Thai Red Bean Salad (Tom Ka Sali
ingredients: 125 g punnet strawberries ( or other bright berries ) | 15 g red curry paste | 1 tablespoon harissa ( or paste ) | 400 g tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1/16 teaspoon green cardamom pods or 1/16 teaspoon anise pod | 300 g punnet black bean sauce
instructions: Dice the strawberries into small cubes.

title: Crispy Ricotta Linguine
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 3/4 cups ricotta cheese or 1 3/4 cups plain greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 loaf wheat bread
instructions: Cook linguine, follow the package directions, al dente. Drain and set aside. In a small bowl combine ricotta, and liquid smoke. Cut bread into small pieces and tear apart. Pour 1/2 cup of water into a large pot and bring to a boil. Add a pinch or two of salt and pasta and cook 5 minutes. Place pasta in a serving bowl, stir in ricotta mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,sherry wine vinegar,bay leaf,amarula cream liqueur,jalapeno pepper
title: Dynamite
ingredients: 2 packages dry mustard powder | 1 bottle amarula cream liqueur | 1 jalapeno pepper, chopped | 1 fresh bay leaf | 1 cup sherry wine vinegar
instructions: In a mixing bowl, dissolve mustard and dry mustard powder in sherry vinegar. In a blender, mix mustard mixture with the amarula cream and jalapeno pepper. Blend at top speed until fairly smoothly blended. Pour in canning jars and process in boiling water, to seal.

title: Blueberry Honeydew Wedges
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs honeydew melons, seeded cut into 1/2-inch wedges | 6 tablespoons corn oil, plus more for brushing | 12 fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Combine melon wedges and 2 tablespoons of oil in large bowl, tossing to coat. Transfer wedges to paper. Using pastry brush, brush coated wedges with oil. Grasping one side of wedges, carefully transfer wedges to prepared baking sheets. Bake wedges until just wedges are dry, about 6 minutes. Top wedges with blueberries.

title: Beef Roulades
ingredients: 2 boneless beef top sirloin steaks | 1 package grana padano
instructions: Combine 2 pkg. Of grana padano with 2 pound of beef sirloin steak. Cover and let sit 15 minutes. Preheat grill. Thread roulades on skewers, dividing each among 4 skewers. Oil grill grate. Grill roulades 3 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,rye bread,salsa,chuck steak,olive oil,asiago cheese,yogurt,white sauce
title: Beef on Rye With Salsa and Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck steaks | 1 package plain toasted rye bread | 1 lb shredded italian cheese blend | 2/3 cup unsweetened asiago cheese, grated | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3 tablespoons creamy natural yogurt | 1 cup salsa | 2 cups white sauce | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Toast the rye bread under the broiler until golden brown on both sides. Slice the bread into 1/2 inch thick slices, set aside. Cut the steak into 1 inch cubes and trim off any excess fat. Spray a 12 inch nonstick skillet with olive oil cooking spray or oil. Heat oil over medium high heat and cook the steak, stirring occasionally, until cooked to your liking. Remove from heat and cool. Stir together the asiago, parmigiano and asiago into the cooled beef. Remove each slice of toast to a serving plate and top each with a slice of beef and salsa. Sprinkle top with asiago cheese and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,brussels sprout,panko breadcrumb,cooking oil,chili sauce,cauliflower
title: Brussels Sprouts With Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/2 cauliflower | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 4 panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Wash sprouts and pat dry with paper towels. Trim stems and leaves. Slice stem and leaves into half or quarters if larger then slice diagonally to fit on large platter. Place leaves and sprouts on platter, set aside. Saute cauliflower in cooking oil until golden. Set aside. Drain off fat from skillet and add tomato soup. Heat for 1 minute. Add chile sauce. Return vegetables to skillet. Sprinkle panko over all. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,pearl barley,fruit,parsnip,lasagna noodle,orange peel
title: Cheddar, Parsnip and Barley Lasagna
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs swiss alpine sticks or 1 1/2 lbs lee piccolini macaroni | 1 1/2 lbs parsnips | 1 cup dried fruit | 2 tablespoons orange peel ( candied peel ) | 9 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( about 7/8 cup ) | 1 1/2 quarts roasted plain rolled barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut zest from orange peel if preferred. Squeeze 3/4 of peel into orange peel. Tear 3/4 of orange peel into small pieces. Coarsely chop. Peel parsnips if preferrably peeling. Coarsely chop dried fruit. Toss parsnips, zest, and chopped orange peel in large bowl of cold water to coat. Add 1/2 lb. Of each cheese. Drain vegetables, saving about 1/2 cup. Mash the rest of the cheese over medium heat until light and smooth just a few min. Remove from heat. Arrange 1/3 of noodles in bottom of 13 by 9 by 2 inch glass baking dish. Spread 1/3 of nut mixture on top of noodles. 1/3 of grated cheese. Repeat layers, topping with a last of grated cheese. Add 1 1/2 quarts of roasting vegetables, spread remaining nut mixture over noodles and top with 3/4 lb. Of remaining cheese. Bake 70 - 75 minutes or untill hot. Let stand 10 minutes. Note, cook time will vary on oven.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,cilantro leaf,vegetable,italian herb seasoning,vegetable oil cooking spray,strawberry preserve,vegetable broth
title: Mexican Chorizo and Vegetable Skillet
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb chorizo sausages, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3 cups sliced assorted fresh vegetables ( such as broccoli, carrots, cauliflower, peppers, parsnips, or a combination ) | 4 cups vegetable broth | 3/4 cup strawberry preserves | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Coat a heavy large skillet with cooking spray. Over medium high heat, add chorizo to pan and cook without stirring until browned and crisp, about 4 minutes. Meanwhile, stir together vegetables in a medium saucepot using 2/3 cup vegetable broth. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat, cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit until slightly cooled. Combine jam and italian herb seasoning in a small bowl. Serve over vegetables.

Random Ingredients: bonito flake,shrimp paste,pork shoulder,bacon dripping,hamburger bun,parsnip,mustard powder
title: Sukiyaki
ingredients: 4 pounds pork shoulder, diced | 4 cups pared parsnips | 4 tablespoons pork grease | 2 tablespoons pork drippings | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 2 tablespoons dry gin or 2 tablespoons scotch whisky | 3 teaspoons shrimp paste or soy sauce
instructions: Place pork shoulder, pared parsnips, and 2 cups of water in a saucepan over medium heat and cook until tender, stirring occasionally, about 45 minutes. Set aside to cool. Discard skin and bones and return the remaining water to the saucepan. In a skillet, heat pork drippings over medium heat and cook until fragrant, then stir in remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,tortilla,green,caster sugar,mozzarella cheese,cream cheese,gnocchi,vegetable bouillon cube
title: Gnocchi With Beef and Cheese, Vegetables and Tortillas
ingredients: 1 packet low-fat plain tortillas | 1 package grated mozzarella cheese | 1 3/4 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 2 vegetable bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons condensed cream cheese | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 3/4 cup mixed vegetables ( sliced ) | 1 cup mixed greens
instructions: Cut the tortillas into four strips widthways and widthways. Place them on a lightly greased tray, cover and cook at 150c/330°f for 15 to 20 minutes, turning over halfway through to prevent burning. After they are cool, pile them on a serving platter. To make the sauce, in a small bowl, crumble the beef into a large frying pan. Cook over a high heat for 3 to 4 minutes or until it changes colour and starts to break down. Stir well, then add the cube of cream cheese and stir until dissolved. Add half the sugar and the vegetables and stir until coated. Pour the sauce over the vegetables and sprinkle on the rest of the sugar. Serve straight away with the warm tortilla strips.

Random Ingredients: cherry,bacon bit,coconut milk powder,italian sausage,garlic clove,salt black pepper
title: Ondrob Flammekuech
ingredients: 500 g bacon bits ( or bacon fat ) | 100 g good quality sweet italian sausage ( italian i used italian ) | 4 dried cherry pieces | 1/2 cup coconut milk powder | 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup coconut milk powder | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Dice the bacon and sausage into bite sized pieces.

title: Chinese Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | fresh cilantro stem
instructions: Preheat broiler. Using a sharp knife, cut slits all over the meat, to within 1 1/2 inches of the edges. Insert slips into the slits. Place in a roasting pan. Combine all other ingredients in a small bowl, and pour over the meat. Cover with foil, and place in broiler. Broil 15 minutes or until a thermometer reads 145 degrees, turning once. Let stand 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Note, the meat can also be cooked in a clay cooker. If you use a large roasting pan, you may need to cook them in a crockpot. If your pan used is large, cook them as normal, about 8 hours. Note, you could also use a slow cooker for this if you want to maximize the gravy, or to roast the meat in the oven, such as roasting and thicken it with cornstarch mixed with cold water just before you serve it..

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,flat leaf parsley,shortcut bacon,poblano chile
title: Quick Sausage With Bacon, Parsley, Chiles, and Poblanos
ingredients: 8 poblano chiles, halved lengthwise and seeded | pasta sauce, from a jar, heated | 6 thin slices shortcut bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Heat a gas grill or grill pan. Brush poblanos with oil and grill over medium heat, turning often, until charred, about 5 minutes. Serve poblanos immediately with pasta and a large spoonful of sauce.

title: Green Beans With Lemon and Lemon
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, cleaned and trimmed | 9 tablespoons lemon juice or 9 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Place the beans in a large saucepan filled with cold water. Bring to a boil, blanching them for about 3 minutes, then plunge them into cold water and blanch. Drain the beans and run over a serving dish with a small spatula. Squeeze the beans to remove the moisture. Put 6 tbsp. Fresh lemon juice at intervals over the beans and serve warm.

title: Easy Oriental Parsley Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dried chopped italian parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let flavors meld, stirring now and again.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,kosher salt black pepper,black sesame seed,cream cheese
title: Kiss Me Green Devil Food
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese, softened | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/3 cup black sesame seed | 2 tablespoons kosher salt or 2 tablespoons sea salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 225 degrees. Combine all the ingredients and mix very well. Pour into a pie dish that has been lightly lined with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Place the dish on a baking sheet. Cut into four or eight wedges and bake until the center is set and the edges are browned, about 30 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lentil,tamari soy sauce,lemon extract,parmigiano reggiano cheese,hazelnut,bean,channa dal
title: Nut N Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsalted dry split lentils ( channa dal ) | 3/4 cup fresh beans ( rinsed ) | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts ( or walnuts ) | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce or 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/2 cup shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup channa dal
instructions: Add lentils to pot, bring to boil and reduce heat to medium. Simmer until tender. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain and return lentils to pot. Blend or process other 3/4 cup of lentils, beans, hazelnuts, tamari, lemon extract and 1/4 cup shaved parmigiano reggiano cheese to desired texture. Add to lentils and mix well. Place in serving bowl and garnish with remaining shaved parmigiano reggiano and hazelnuts. Serve with fresh bread for an outstanding taste, or serve with other condiments of your choice.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,mustard,wasabi paste,whiskey,french onion,peanut butter,american cheese
title: Pub Style Wasabi Dip
ingredients: 1 package soft french-fried onions | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 1 lb american cheese | 1 lb peanut butter | 1 cup whiskey | 8 pieces kaffir lime leaves ( or 4 slices fresh lime ) | 1 tablespoon mustard
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. In large bowl, mix fried onion, wasabi paste, american cheese, peanut butter and whiskey. Add in lime leaves. Mix well and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Spread mixture on bread and toast or crackers. Serve with other dipping accompaniments such as jasmine or other grainy fruit cocktail.

title: Yemeni Onion Salad
ingredients: 6 purple onions, halved lengthways | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds, crushed | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, finely chopped | 7 ounces half-and-half
instructions: Put onions, half and half and cumin seeds in a large saucepan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until onions are very soft. Allow to cool and use to store. Use to dress salads and garnish with chopped mint. Variation, add 1/2 cup of fresh mint to the onion, mix well and serve.

title: Homemade Horseradish
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons horseradish | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons white flour | 2 teaspoons dried parsley
instructions: Thoroughly mix the horseradish, creole seasoning and flour into a liquid paste. Place into a resealable plastic bag and squeeze out extra air.

title: Grilled Apple and Cinnamon Saute
ingredients: 2 lbs apples ( i used 2 large ) | 2 -4 kaffir lime leaves or 1 teaspoon dried lime leaves
instructions: Core and thinly slice apples.

title: Smoked Salmon Fillets
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks | plain flour, plus extra for dusting | 2 tablespoons tamari, plus extra for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade or 180 degrees celsius. Season the salmon steaks with salt and sifted flour and lightly coat with flour. Melt the 2 tblsp. Of tamarind in a saucepan over low heat. Bring to the boil and gradually add the warm tamarind mixture. Reduce the heat and simmer until reduced by half, about 5 - 8 minutes. Place a non stick ovenproof griddle or frying pan over a high heat. Place the salmon in the griddle. Cook the salmon for 4 minutes each side until it flakes easily when tested with a skewer. Serve the salmon with plain to serve, with dipping sauce and a salad of mixed lettuce, baby radishes and sliced red onion.

title: Mexican Layered Tomato & Cashews
ingredients: 300 g roma tomatoes, chopped | 4 leaves salad greens | 3 tablespoons tomato paste ( your authentic tomato sauce ) | 300 g roasted cashews, roughly chopped | mixed salad green | rom tomato, slices to serve
instructions: Cook roma tomatoes & cashews in a frying pan until soft, remove & set aside. Chop tomatoes & basil & lay on a serving platter next to the greens. Put the tomato sauce in a bowl & mix extensively & pour over tomatoes & beans. Add a pinch of sea salt or pepper. Place salad on top & garnish w/romatoes. We usually eat with a dollop of sour cream, guacamole & lime zest.

Random Ingredients: sparkling water,cremini mushroom,mayonnaise,mint leaf,chickpea flour,chili oil,cabbage,double cream
title: Creamy Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 250 g cabbage, finely shredded | 175 g cremini mushrooms, sliced | 125 g canned chickpea flour ( gram flour if not available ) | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 cup double cream | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 4 mint leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Mix chilli oil in a bowl and add the flour and mix well to combine. In another bowl, add the cream, mayonnaise, mint, and mint. After the salad has been served over salad plates, add the shredded cabbage and mushrooms and mix lightly. Pour over the sauce and serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,dijon mustard,asadero cheese,radish,white wine,greek yogurt
title: Guilt-Free Pepperoni Appetizers
ingredients: 8 slices asadero cheese | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 tablespoon red onions or 1 tablespoon a mixture of both of the above | 8 radishes, sliced thin
instructions: Heat nonstick skillet. Spread one side of each slice of cheese with dijon mustard. Spread a small amount of yogurt on a cheese slice, add 2 slices of cheese on top of that. Place onion slices on top of cheese mixture and spread another cheese slice on top. Invert over skillet, and brown sandwich slightly on each side. When cheese mixture is browned, slice it into 8 squares and place them on a plate with a spatula on top to keep warm. Place a piece of red onion on each square of cheese. Wrap a piece of cheese around the red onion and wrap around the cheese. Secure and store in the fridge.

title: Cumin Stems for Lamb or Fish
ingredients: 4 stalks fresh curry or 1 tablespoon dried curry leaves | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed
instructions: Make the curry powder, mix the curry powder with the oil and leave to stand for 2 hours, stirring or squeezing occasionally. Then mix lightly with a knife to break up the lumps. Grill on the bbq, turning once or twice, until well browned and dried. Store the curry powder in the jar for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed,italian seasoning,butter,arugula,vanilla extract,self rising flour,pearl barley,marinara sauce
title: Quick and Easy Marinated Italian Veggie Barley Crunchies
ingredients: 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup stone-ground pearl barley | 1 teaspoon butter or 1 teaspoon margarine, softened | 1 teaspoon sunflower seeds | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 cup chopped fresh italian vegetables or 1 cup fresh zest from 1/2 t orange
instructions: Place the flour, barley and seasonings in the bowl of a food processor or combine them by hand. Add the softened butter and process until smooth. Pour the marinara sauce into a bowl and stir in the chopped vegetables. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celcius. Shape the mixture into small, even balls with your hands or roll them in flour to coat. Place them on an oiled baking tray and bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until well risen and golden brown on all sides.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,red wine vinegar,mexican cheese,meat,vegetable oil,almond meal,lemon juice zest,garlic
title: Mexican Meatball (Shrimp) Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ripe cooked shrimp, medium size | 1 lb ground mirliton steaks or 1 lb any lean ground meat | 1 box mexican cheese blend | dipping sauce ( ritz or any other mexican cheese flavor ) | olive oil | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 large lemon, juice and zest of | garlic | almonds, toasted
instructions: Cut cheese into 1 cubes. Mix with meat, a little bit of olive oil, sugar or spices from above and stir. Let set in refrigerator. After it's chilled a few hours, serve on a lettuce leaf or a large platter.

title: Bow Ties and Cornflour
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 400 g bow tie pasta | 1 tablespoon fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook the bow tie pasta according to packet instructions. Mix cornflour and a little salt and pepper in a measuring jug and stir in the parsley. Drain the bow tie pasta and return to the pan. Add the corn flour mixture to the pasta and stir until well combined. Place in a warm serving dish and serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti Sauce with Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 2 red pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano
instructions: In a large saucepan, mix soups with oregano and sauteed red peppers over medium low heat. When sauce becomes bubbly, reduce heat to low and simmer until bell peppers become soft. Do not burn.

title: Brown Rice (A.k.a. Red Rice)
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, dry ( or white ) | 2 cups mustard ( such as french's essence ) | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Soak the brown rice in boiling water until the water has been absorbed. While the rice is soaking, heat a large skillet over medium high heat, add mustard and freshly ground nutmeg. Stir the mixture well. Add the rice and fry the mixture in the mustard, stirring regularly, until the grains begin to wilt. Remove from heat and add more of the mustard until the grains are coated with the spice. If necessary, mix in a little water.

title: Crock Pot Pork Gravy
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 3 cans cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Wash pork and shred. Place pork in crock pot. Combine cream of mushroom soup with shredded pork. Cook on high for 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: potato,parsley,orange juice zest,cake flour,chuck,peanut oil,english cucumber,cinnamon red hot candy
title: Moroccan Beef Skewers With Spiced Potato Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 3/4 cup parsley | 3/4 teaspoon cinnamon red hot candies | 1 lb ground chuck | 2 teaspoons orange juice, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1 package potato sticks ( i suggest yukon gold potatoes ) | 2 english cucumbers, halved lengthwise and cut vertically in half ( about 1/2 large )
instructions: To make the topping, stir together the flour, parsley and cinnamon. Season with red hots and mix well with the ground chuck. Dredge the potato sticks in the flour mixture, tapping off excess. Heat the oil in a grill pan. Brown the meat on all sides, and drain on paper towels. Set aside. Grill the potato sticks until tender, about 5 minutes, turning once. Transfer the toasted crumbs to a plate and set aside. Grill the cucumber halves on both sides until golden, about 3 minutes per side. Keep the hot fries warm. Combine the topping ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Thread the potato sticks onto the skewers. Cook the skewers on a rack set in a rack set in the upper third of the oven until the top is lightly browned, 8 - 10 minutes. Serve the skewers with the topping.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,asiago cheese,rice wine vinegar,walnut,jicama,dill,prune,dill pickle
title: Fantastic Japanese Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chopped dill | 1 cup chopped walnuts | 2 cups uncooked jicama | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh dill | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh dill | 1 jar pitted prunes, coarsely torn
instructions: Toss the chopped dill and walnuts with the jicama, rice wine vinegar, tomato juice, and cheese. Sprinkle with dill and dill. Stir to blend.

title: Quick and Easy Black Tea Mix for Breakfast or Poultry
ingredients: 1 cup instant rice | 3/4 cup black tea | 1/2 cup tamari or 1/2 cup soy sauce | 8 1/2 ounces imitation crabmeat ( finely chopped ) | 1/2 cup fresh basil ( slivered or thinly sliced ) or 1/2 cup savorele basil, slivered and finely slivered ( slivered or thinly sliced ) ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix instant rice with tamari and mix well. Add the chopped crabmeat and continue mixing. Add the slivered or thinly sliced basil or savorele basil, if using. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: belgian endive,thai red curry paste,almond meal
title: Cousin Style Endive With Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 cup almond meal | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 25 -35 belgian endive, stems scored crossways
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c and lightly flour a large baking tray. In a bowl, combine almond meal and curry paste. Remove a small amount of almond flour from the side of the baking tray so as to get a thinner mixture. Place the bowl onto the tray with the flour and curry mixture and mix it around until just the right texture. Add almond flour until mixture resembles a firm custard. Sprinkle more almond flour over the top if desired and place on the tray with the endive. Bake for 20 minutes or until tender. Remove from the oven and cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,date,swiss chard,cooking oil,white cabbage
title: Swiss Chard and Date Sauteed Beef With Cabbage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 lb swiss chard, cut into 1-inch pieces ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 2 medium dates, thinly sliced | 1 medium white cabbage, cut into 1-inch wedges | 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, 1/4-inch thick and 1/4-inch thick
instructions: Melt the oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the chard and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the dates to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the cabbage and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 2 minutes. Return steak to the skillet and pour in the chard mixture. Stir to combine. Cover and cook until the beef is slightly rare, about 5 minutes.

title: Beer with Endives
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs endives | 6 ounces beer ( such as corona ) | 1/2 teaspoon aleppo pepper
instructions: Rinse endives under cold water and dry them in a clean cloth. Cut them in half lengthwise and then into 1 inch chunks. Place all of the ingredients into a large dutch oven or heavy pot over medium high heat. Allow the alcohol to cook off about three minutes, then add the beer and aleppo pepper, stirring, to combine. Cover and return to the kitchen at medium low heat until the alcohol has cooked off and the meat is slightly browned at the edges, and the endives are very tender, about 2 hours. If necessary, add a little extra beer at a time.

title: Faux Phaal
ingredients: 8 ounces dried farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 8 -10 cabbage leaves, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 mango, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 -2 tablespoon ground red rosemary | 1 -2 cube chicken bouillon, dissolved in | 2 cardamom pods, split in half | 2 teaspoons ground mustard
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, or according to package directions. Rinse with warm water, drain and set aside. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine carrots, mango and 1 tsp mustard. Dissolve bouillon in remaining 1 1/2 cups of water, and stir into salad, along with the rest of the spices, and mix well. Set aside 1/4 c over the salad and let it rest, then toss together. Add pasta and salad to the salad and toss.

title: Spicy Green Grapes and Chili Oil(Pulao Parfait)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green seedless grape, stems and all, in small pieces | 1 tablespoon chili oil, such as sambal olek or 1 tablespoon hot chili powder | 1 -2 tablespoon oil, of choice i use extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Wash the grapes thoroughly and shake off all excess moisture. Dry the grapes on paper towels. Place the grapes onto a baking sheet covered with parchment paper.
