Heat the chili oil and oil over medium high heat, just as it simmers, until the oil begins to smoke. Transfer the grapes to a bowl. Add the chili oil to the grapes, and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Hamburger and Eggplant Patty Melt
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck | 3 lbs eggplants | 3 lbs deli ham | 1 large turnip | 2 cups mayonnaise | 6 cups hot cooked rice
instructions: Grill chuck beef until well browned on all sides, then put all meat aside. Wash eggplants and eggplants slightly, then grate skin, leaving eggplants and eggplants into 2 inch pieces. Cut meat with a 3 inch biscuit cutter into bite sized pieces. Cut eggplant into quarters lengthwise and lengthwise. Stack meat and eggplant and eggplant on a large platter, cutting them down so they stay together. Cut ham into 1 inch squares, or you can cut up your own vegetables, cut into small pieces, about the size of the eggplant. Add all of your fillings. Spread mayo on each plate and top with about two tablespoons of rice. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: turkey pepperoni,coriander seed,pine nut,chicken thigh,basil leaf,sage leaf,pepper
title: Chicken Phyllo Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs | 5 ounces turkey pepperoni, diced | 2 ounces fresh basil leaves | 2 ounces coriander seeds | 2 ounces pine nuts, toasted | fresh ground pepper | 3 pinches ground sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f put the chicken thighs into a roasting tin and sprinkle with pepperoni, basil and coriander. Drizzle with a little olive oil to coat and cook in oven for 20 minutes. Turn up the heat a little and return to oven and cook for a further 10 - 15 mins until cooked through and browned. Remove from oven and slice to serve. Serve hot with pasta, and tasty salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,sausage,vegetarian bean,adobo seasoning,lipton onion soup mix,apricot,salt pepper,white wine
title: Vegetarian Baked Beans
ingredients: 500 -750 g vegetarian baked beans ( i use my own ) | 250 g sweet sausage, sliced | 1 packet lipton onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons soy sauce ( i use low sodium ) | 1/4 cup white wine ( i use water ) | salt & pepper | dried apricot, thinly sliced ( dried and chopped for garnish ) | adobo seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Bake the beans as per directions on the packet and let cool slightly. In another bowl, cook the sausage until it is brown, then transfer it to a bowl. Next add the noodles. Heat the oil in a deep pot. Add the onions and fry until they are transparent. Add the rest of the ingredients and let cook for anther 3 - 5 minutes. Place into a casserole and bake for an hour. Garnish with dried apricots and adobo. Enjoy.

title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 4 apples, cored and sliced lengthways | 2 slices gingerroot
instructions: Using a sharp knife, slice the ginger into thin matchsticks. Place the apples into a medium heatproof bowl and top with half the ginger, pressing into the apples with your fingers. Then pour over the remaining ginger and sprinkle over the remaining ginger. Heat in a moderate oven for 30 minutes or until apples are soft and lightly coloured.

Random Ingredients: white rice,cornflakes cereal,red miso,icing sugar,chili oil,tomato soup
title: Yummy Miso Chicken Lollipops
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked boneless skinless chicken breasts or 1 1/2 cups cooked boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup crushed red miso | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil | 1 -2 cup crushed cornflakes cereal ( optional )
instructions: Mix mushroom soup with 1/4 cup miso paste and stir well. Cut chicken into 1/4 to 1/2 cubes. Combine with soup mixture, add cornflakes and other 1/4 cup miso paste. Grease a 9x12 pan with a little cooking spray. Coat pan with cooking spray. Place the chicken onto the bottom of the pan. Pour soup mix evenly over the chicken. Top with crushed cornflakes, if using,. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees until topping is nicely browned around edges.

Random Ingredients: cold water,andouille sausage,bulgur,red chilies,tandoori paste,yellow squash,head garlic,red cabbage
title: Tandoori and Sausage Slurry With Squash and Cabbage
ingredients: 2 small red chili, halved | 1 whole head of garlic | 2 yellow squash | 1 small head of garlic, halved horizontally | 1 teaspoon andoori paste | 2 tablespoons tandoori paste. < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/tandoori-pasta-recipe-227656 '' > tandoori pasta sauce < /a > | 4 ounces cold water | 1 large red cabbage, quartered
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f cut off the top quarter of the garlic head, removing as many cloves as possible. Roughly chop the cloves. Use a knife to scrape out and discard the inside of the cloves. Cut the garlic bulb off with a tablespoon, removing and discard the hard outer skin. Place the garlic, chillies, squash and 1 head of garlic onto a square of tin foil. Place the foil onto the top of the garlic and chillies. Pour half the water over the vegetables. Turn the foil covered surface over so they cook evenly. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove the foil, squash and garlic from the oven and turn out onto a serving dish. Top with the remaining 2 cloves of garlic and cover with the remaining sauce. Place the cabbage into a baking dish, or large roasting tin and place on top. Sprinkle with tandoori paste and half the cold water. Cover the baking dish and bake for 30 minutes, or until all the moisture has dried out from the vegetables. Serve with hot, fresh, peeled green beans or whole grain roti.

title: Tiramisu
ingredients: 4 cans black beans | 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Using a food processor, puree all of the beans and amaretto liqueur together. Store in the refrigerator for up to two months.

title: Chilled Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 3 tablespoons mustard | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 1/8 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 3 lbs chicken wings
instructions: Pour chickpeas into a large bowl. Add the mustard, salt, ground pepper and 1/2 cup water, mix gently with hands until well blended. Transfer to refrigerator for up to 1 week. Meanwhile, prepare grill. Remove and rinse the wings, trim wing tips and discard.

title: Vegetarian Rice Rolls
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 14 cups cold cooked brown rice ( or your favorite combination ) | 1 dash thyme leave, to taste | 18 frozen dinner rolls
instructions: Slice tofu in half lengthwise, and then crosswise. This makes the roll very thin. Lay on a cutting board and slice each block across grain into six equal pieces depending on desired width. Cut each piece into 6 slices and then each slice in half crosswise. This makes the rice rolls easier to shape if you are using frozen dinner rolls. Place tofu in a colander, and rinse thoroughly with cold water. Drain thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels. Cut rolls into 6 - 8 rolls. Heat a large pot of lightly salted water on the stove over medium heat and place rolls into the water. Place a piece of tofu onto a roll and season with thyme and a little more of your favorite vegetarian seasoning. Repeat with remaining pieces of tofu and toppings. Cook rolls in the boiling water, uncovered, until golden, about 5 - 8 minutes. Drain and place on a platter. Spoon some rice on the plate and top with slices of tofu.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,savory,tomato paste,salmon fillet,coconut cream,peperkoek,hot green chili pepper
title: Smoked Salmon & Pperkoek Pies
ingredients: 1 lb puff pastry | 1/2 cup coconut cream ( reduced fat may be used ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 tablespoon savory, leaves finely chopped | 1 can salmon fillets, skin on, in chunks | 1 hot green chili pepper, deseeded and chopped | 1 puff pastry sheet, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degree celsius, roll out pastry and line patty tins with pastry, pressing pastry into two 28cm x 18cm x 6cm lids. Place patty into prepared patty tins. Whisk cream, tomato paste & savory in a small bowl until well combined. Spoon tomato cream mixture evenly over fish, then top with fillets & chilies. Bake for 6 to 7 minutes or until crisp & fish is cooked through. Remove from oven, serve at once with lemon wedges.

title: Pumpkin Roasted Bell Pepper Puree
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pumpkin puree | 2 large bell peppers, roasted or red, peeled and seeded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Using a small, sharp knife, finely slice the pepper halves into thin strips, producing long thin strips about 20” long by 2 - ½ inches wide. Place the thinly sliced pepper strips in a large roasting tin or baking tin. In a medium bowl, stir the pumpkin puree with 1 tsp water and 1 - ¾ tsp salt. Stir in the roasted or roasted peeled peppers. Pour the puree over the peppers and bring to a simmer. Roast the peppers for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the puree is bubbling very slightly. Serve from the oven, or pour into hot sterilised jars immediately. If possible, refrigerate the puree for up to two weeks. Store in an airtight tin and, clean of any solidified odors, store for up to 3 days.

title: Mexican Carrot Salad
ingredients: 2 carrots, peeled | 1/2 cup chopped salted butter | 1/3 cup prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons adobo sauce | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1 cup salsa
instructions: Place carrots in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover, and steam 4 minutes or until tender. Drain carrots, and toss with the butter, horseradish, and 1 teaspoons adobo. Mix remaining adobo, vinegar, and salsa, and pour into a serving bowl. Sprinkle with remaining adobo, and serve.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,cornmeal,za'atar spice mix,mint,ancho chile powder
title: Achiote-Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups potato starch ( not potato flour ) | 3 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder ( or sub 2 tablespoons dried cumin powder ) | 3 tablespoons dried mint | 1 tablespoon za'atar spice mix, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1 cup water in a 2 quart pot or dutch oven over medium heat. Stir together cornmeal, potato starch, 1 tablespoon dried ancho chili powder, dried mint, and za'atar with a fork, until well incorporated. Stir mixture until it becomes smooth and pliable. Cook, stirring constantly, 5 - 7 minutes or until it's all golden and bubbly. You may also cook and stir it in the microwave. The easiest way to do this is with hands rather than with a food processor and using the palms, holding the mixture firmly for a few seconds. Transfer the mixture to an oiled bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight. Note, this can be made several hours in advance and kept covered in the refrigerator.

title: Spinach Soup III
ingredients: 3 -4 packages fresh spinach leaves, washed | 4 egg yolks | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Place the spinach in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Cook for about two minutes. Drain on clean towels. In a medium size mixing bowl, beat the egg yolks with the onion soup mix. Add about half of the spinach water to the mix. Mix well. Slowly add the beaten egg mixture into the spinach, stirring well. Add the rest of the spinach water and mix. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. When the oil is warm, drop by spoonfuls into the hot oil. Cook for five to ten minutes, or until the center is cooked to desired doneness, flipping with a spatula when golden.

title: Crispy Red Chili Paste
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons red chili peppers, finely diced ( red paprika with coriander, or cayenne pepper with a pinch of cayenne pepper ) | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning ( or try all purpose chili powder with chipots ) | 2 tablespoons coriander, finely chopped
instructions: Drain liquid from peppers by placing the liquid inches add salt, then blend the rest of the ingredients in a blender. Add to ground chili paste and mix thoroughly with a fork or a mortar and pestle. Use immediately as a seasoning paste for vegetables, meats or fish. Serve with roasted veggies, crackers, or pita bread.

title: swiss chard with marinara
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, cored, chopped into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 cup leftover marinara sauce | honey | ground savory ( optional )
instructions: Put the chard in a bowl with enough water to cover. Bring the water to a boil, and cook over medium heat until tender and slightly wilted. Drain. Add the marinara sauce and simmer until heated through. Sprinkle top with salt, pepper, and grated cheese.

title: Apple & Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon hoagie dough ( rye flour ) | 1 tablespoon rye flour | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 1 cup apple juice
instructions: Combine the hoagie and rye flours. Stir in parsley. Pour in apple juice. Slice bread into 3 pieces and serve with the sauce.

title: Kikkoman Sweet-And-Sour-N-Sweet Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup kikkoman sweet and sour soy sauce | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 6 -8 cups croutons
instructions: Mix the rest of the ingredients and stir well until the raisins are absorbed. Add the croutons last. Cover and refrigerate. Serve with fresh french, italian or papas.

Random Ingredients: vegemite,peanut butter,celery root,wheat flour,ricotta cheese,purpose flour,penne pasta
title: Penne Pie
ingredients: 800 g penne pasta | 2 medium carrots, peeled and shredded | 1 celery root, peeled and diced | 2 teaspoons vegetableite | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons plain smooth peanut butter
instructions: Sauté carrot, celery and vegetarian cheese in oil until vegetables are tender. Add dry pasta, stir. Mix all the ingredients together, then pour into greased pan. Sprinkle top with more vegan cheese. Bake in a preheated oven at 220c/425f/gas mark 6 for 30 - 35 mins until crust is golden and bubbling.

title: Choc-Haritand's Light Baked Beets and Rice
ingredients: 3 medium waxy beets, grated | 75 g dark chocolate, chopped | 600 ml hot cooked basmati rice | 50 g walnuts, chopped | 1/2 cup irish cream, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place grated beets in a large bowl, cover with boiling water then drain. Place chocolate in a microwave safe bowl on high, microwave for 1 - 2 minutes until melted. Mix in rice. Place walnuts and remaining walnuts in a large bowl, add rice mixture and mix to coat evenly. Place mixture on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve warm or cold, with irish cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,green chilies,pimiento,granny smith apple,white wine,farfalle pasta
title: Apple Cheese Slices in Warm Wine
ingredients: 4 granny smith apples | 1 jar mild green chilies ( such as anaheim ) | 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie-shaped pasta or angel hair ) | 1/3 cup mild white wine ( such as chardonnay ) | 2 tablespoons white wine | 1 small pimiento ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar
instructions: Cut apples into 1/2 inch cubes. Cut chiles into 1/4 inch wide strips. In 3 1/2 to 4 quart dutch oven, sauté apples in 1 tbls olive oil over moderately low heat, stirring, until crisp tender. Add chiles and stir to coat. Stir in farfalle, white wine and pimientos.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,chocolate syrup,milk,butternut squash,chicken breast,hard egg
title: Butternut Squash Patties
ingredients: 1 cup milk | 1 whole cooked egg, beaten | 4 slices chocoholicks ( available at asian specialty food stores ) | 2 medium butternut squash, peeled | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Bring milk to boil and pour into a bowl. Mix in egg, then add chocoholicks, squash, syrup and fish sauce. Scoop mixture into 8 greased and pammed meat patties. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 4 hours to set. Bake in 400 degree f oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Strawberry and Coffee Pudding
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces nonfat milk | 3 large egg yolks | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 tablespoon tapioca | 2 cups cubed fresh strawberries | 1 large fresh squid, cleaned and chopped
instructions: In a small saucepan with a tight fitting lid, scald milk and set aside. Whisk egg yolks, coffee granules and tapioca together into warm milk and set aside. In another saucepan, steam strawberries and squid until tender.

title: Honduran Chicken and Cheese
ingredients: 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken meat - cut into cubes | 2 cups finely-shredded cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup prepared mango salsa | 2 tablespoons ground chipotle powder
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir chicken in the hot skillet until meat is completely browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir cheddar cheese and horseradish into the chicken.

title: Beef Steak with Ginger Beer
ingredients: 4 beef sirloin steaks, 3/4 inch thick | 1 cup club soda | 1/2 cup crushed ice-cold v8 concentrate, undiluted | 1 inch gingerroot, peeled | grated cheese, for topping
instructions: Pound steaks to 1/2 inch thickness. Combine club soda, v8 concentrate, and ginger root. Coat both sides of each steak with paste. Place in a shallow baking dish. Add steak to remaining marinade, turning so that no meat losses its red color. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Transfer steaks to a platter and cover with remaining marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 10 hours, turning once. Bake in a preheated 450°f oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until steak reaches desired doneness, turning once.

title: Tamarind Chutney
ingredients: 3 cups tamarind pulp ( i've used 3 small cans ) | 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth | 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate or 2 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped
instructions: Boil tamarind pulp, broth, and chocolate over medium high heat until chocolate or chocolate is melted. Stir occasionally. If the chutney is too thick, add water.

Random Ingredients: southwest seasoning,stewing beef,cream celery soup,red chile,kaffir lime leaf,heavy whipping cream,plum tomato
title: Beef Tips With Chiles - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 10 ounces stewing beef, cubed | 1 can plum tomatoes, undrained | 2 red chile, sliced | 1 ounce southwest seasoning | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 kaffir lime leaves, torn
instructions: Combine soup, beef, tomatoes, chiles and seasoning in pressure cooker and place in pressure cooker. Lock lid in place with 7 pounds of pressure, and set on high heat. Reduce heat to low and cook for 15 minutes. Remove lid and stir in cream and lime leaves.

title: Cauliflower Tacos
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated biscuits | 1/2 cup sliced cucumber, cut in half | 1 can creole seasoning | 1 can taco cheese, cut in small pieces | 1 can oyster sauce | 4 ounces canned cauliflower, drained
instructions: Open package of biscuits and flatten lightly into 4x5x3 inch rectangle. Sprinkle with cukes, creole seasoning then top with taco cheese, oyster sauce and cauliflower. Fold up and let rest for 5 minutes then refrigerate for up to 2 days or until completely cold. Keep in refridgerator or freezer. You can make this ahead of time and reheat it in a skillet.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,red curry paste,tortilla,active yeast
title: Quick and Easy Burritos
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups hot cooked instant mashed potato ( about 8 minutes ) | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast, plus | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( i use packed brown sugar for darker mexican flavor ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( i used homemade ) or 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( i use packed brown sugar for dark mexican flavor )
instructions: Microwave potatoes on high power for 6 minutes or until warm. Dissolve yeast in sugar and curry paste and add to hot potatoes. Set aside to rest 10 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Filipino Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup frangelico | 2 egg whites | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 4 cups thinly sliced cabbage
instructions: Combine hamburger, catsup, and frangelico in a bowl, mixing thoroughly. Add egg whites, peppercorns, and lemon extract, mix well. Set kababobs on the broiler pan or a rack in a broiler pan 1/2 inch below the heat. Broil 10 - 12 minutes per side. Serve with cabbage or salad for dipping.

title: Caramelised Chilli Cheese (Or Velvety Cheese With Sultanas)
ingredients: 175 g fontina cheese or 175 g swiss cheese, grated | 75 g sultanas, golden raisins or 75 g raw sultanas | 3 -4 fresh thyme sprigs, leaves only | sweet chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour | sugar, mixed with | 3 tablespoons of melted ghee or 3 tablespoons butter
instructions: If using sweet chili oil, heat it gently on medium heat, stirring constantly until it begins to smell nutty. Add sultanas, mix well and turn a few times over heat, until sultanas are dark brown and sultanas are tender but still crunchy. Remove from heat, stir in thyme. Pour into a bowl and leave to cool. Stir well the cornflour into some of the melted butter or ghee or butter to a smooth sauce with a touch of sugar. Add sugar to taste, mix well and leave to cool. To make the cheese mixture, put the cheese in a dish large enough to wrap around the cheese. Add melted cheese, mix well so all the ingredients combine and then roll the mixture into a cylinder. Chill until the cheese has set but is still soft. When ready, roll the cheese tightly again and cut into strips approximately 1 inch wide and 2 inches long. If using raw sultanas, soak them for 20 minutes in warm water before using. Pour half the sauce over the cheese in an ovenproof serving dish. Dot the cheese with thick kitchen fingers. Carefully place the chilled cheese strips in an overlapping lattice, over the sauce, leaving spaces in between. Sprinkle with sultanas. Dot the remaining sauce over the cheese, then put in the oven on 230c or 400f to warm through. For a spectacular way of serving, with flat beer or wine, pour the hot cheese mixture over the cheese after adding the sultanas and bread in a spiral with a spoon. Try to have the sultanas and bread with each meal with the cheese mixture instead of the sultanas.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,chicken broth,bay seasoning tm,lime juice
title: Clam N' Beans
ingredients: 1 lb bean sprouts | 1 lb chicken broth | lime juice | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning tm
instructions: Boil 3 cups of water. Place bean sprouts on paper towl and drain. Place back into pot and cook 2 to 3 minutes over medium heat. Remove from heat and stir in chicken broth. Add lime juice, old bay, and desired amount of salt and pepper to taste. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,yellow bell pepper,red cabbage,pineapple,ginger powder,white chocolate,malt vinegar
title: Red Cabbage And Cheese Salad
ingredients: 3/4 head red cabbage | 1 can crushed pineapple | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger powder | 1/2 cup grated white chocolate
instructions: Separate the leaves from the core of the cabbage and place on a medium to low fire. You are using the stems of the cabbage for flavor. This is an artichoke, so have a pair of scissors or a spoon. Bend leaves to separate them. Cut the cabbage leaves in quarters. Slice the bell pepper lengthwise into 5 pieces, and add to a medium saucepan along with the can crushed pineapple and 1 tablespoon of the oil. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes, or until the pepper is cooked but not mushy. You want some of the pepper and pineapple to soften. Remove from heat, and add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the saucepan. Add the ginger and vinegar, and bring to a boil. Once it has boiled, increase heat to medium high and simmer for a further 10 to 15 minutes, stirring constantly. Turn off heat and stir in the chocolate. Let cool slightly, pour into a glass bowl, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve cold.

title: Tartiflette
ingredients: 3 slices white bread | 2 1/2 cups cold water, plus 2 1/2 tablespoons water | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Put the bread in a mixing bowl and pour in cold water. Sprinkle on one side of the bread slices, then stir. When you can't see the bread, add more cold water and continue mixing the slices until they are coated in water. Wrap each slice in cellophane, then cover with plastic wrap and place in the freezer until needed. Preheat the oven to 200oc. Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Lightly brush the surface of each slice of toast with oil. Using a knife cut a slice of bread into 3 - 4 squares. Place a square of bread on a serving plate, then sprinkle with about 1/4 cup of pine nuts. Repeat with remaining pieces. Cut each piece into 4 triangles. Set onto a baking tray. Bake in the preheated oven for 8 - 9 minutes or until the pine nuts are crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,curry,beet,red wine,mustard seed,parmesan cheese,beef broth
title: Beet-On-A-Bowl Beef Chili
ingredients: 3 lbs beets | 1 quart beef broth | 6 ounces red wine, chunky | 1 lb anaheim chilies, sliced thickly | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | fresh curry ( optional )
instructions: Place the beets in boiling water, cover and simmer until tender. Drain the water, cool slightly and trim the beet tops. Shred the beets. Remove stems, white pith and any tough ribs. Chop the beets into large chunks. Place all ingredients into crockpot, sprinkle with the parmesan and cook for about 1 hour on high or 2 hours on low.

title: Arepas De Paneer E Basilico (Portuguese Cheese Soup)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive | 500 g paneer cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons fresh basil leaves | 4 egg whites | 2 tablespoons fish stock
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add paneer until light golden to taste. Remove and set aside. Pour the 2 tablespoons of olive oil into the same pan and cook until slightly soft, about 30 seconds to a couple of minutes. Add 4 ounces of cheese and cook, stirring until golden and slightly softened. Add 2 more tablespoons of oil and 1 egg white to the pan, then reduce the heat to medium. Scramble the egg white until the mixture is shiny and silky. Add salt and pepper to taste. Place cheese on top. When cheese has softened and turned brown, add basil. Pour the rest of the stock. Serve hot with crusty bread.

title: California Avocados
ingredients: 2 avocados - peeled, pitted and diced | 3 cups prepared clam juice | 1 can sliced clams, drained | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 package bean sprouts | 1 bunch radishes, diced with stems
instructions: In a large bowl, combine avocados, clam juice, clams, cilantro, bean sprouts and radishes.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,seasoning salt,corn tortilla,beef consomme,spearmint
title: Nando's Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can beef consomme | 1 -2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( or to your taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried spearmint ( or to your taste ) | 1 dash seasoning salt | 16 -20 corn tortillas
instructions: Combine consume and seasonings if using. Dip tortillas into the mixture and then fry in a skillet on medium heat until warm and pliable. Spread small 1/3 cup of the meat mixture down center of tortilla and roll tightly. Place in oven and cook for about 10 - 15 minutes or until heated through. Serve with salsa if desired. This goes great with sour cream. If possible you can also freeze these for another time. As i mentioned, be careful not to burn them on the inside since you'll cook much more than the first time.

title: Pistachio Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 tomatoes with green chile peppers, diced | 2 tablespoons chopped raw pistachios | 1 1/2 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place the tomatoes and pistachios in a serving bowl. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,apple juice orange,walnut oil,green pepper,flour
title: Baked Green Pepper Salad
ingredients: 4 green peppers | 4 ounces green apples ( i use canned but fresh will work too ) | 125 ml apple juice or 125 ml orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 3 tablespoons flour
instructions: Cut the green peppers into strips, remove stem and seeds and cut the strips into strips. Peel and cut the apples into slices. Place the oil in the bottom of a shallow oven proof dish and heat in the oven. Add the green pepper strips to the oil in a steam basket and carefully toss them around for a couple of seconds to make sure all the strips are coated with oil. Remove them from the oil and transfer on absorbent paper and allow to cool. Add the apple juice, bicarb and flour to the pan and mix thoroughly. Pour the hot oil mixture around the peppers, sprinkle with walnuts and serve. Make ahead you can leave out the baking powder and/or use any other flavourings or serve it immediately as a side dish for salads or a main salad or as a salad dressing with meat, poultry or seafood.

Random Ingredients: ginger,pine nut,halibut fillet,granny smith apple,butter,gouda cheese,pork shoulder,lime juice
title: Grilled Halibut With Apple Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup clarified butter or 1/2 cup clarified butter, cut into pieces ( 7 oz. ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts, chopped | 8 thin-sliced peeled granny smith apples ( about 2 c., cut into wedges, about 7 ounces total weight ) | 8 thin-sliced peeled halibut fillets | 4 slices fresh ginger | 1 grated medium-all-beet havest tilapia cheese, grated ( about 1/4 cup, about 1 ounce ) | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 1/2 ounces shredded medium-hot smoked gouda cheese
instructions: In a small small heavy skillet, melt the clarified butter over moderate low heat.

title: Creamy Lasagna Sticks or Biscuits
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1 package lasagna noodles | 45 wonton wrappers
instructions: Cut noodles into strips. Mix together remaining ingredients and fill the noodles with the mixture. Place on baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 450 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,espresso,lamb,banana,egg wrapper,sharp cheddar cheese,skirt steak
title: Easy Burger
ingredients: 6 links skirt steak | 6 tablespoons brewed espresso | 12 egg roll wrappers | 1/2 lb cooked fully cooked lean ground lamb or 1/2 lb smoked lean ground meat | 1 ounce grated sharp cheddar cheese | 4 slices bananas | fresh sage leaf ( optional )
instructions: Sauce, stir together espresso and 2 tablespoons of water in a large bowl. Place egg roll wrappers on a flat surface. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of ground meat into each wrapper. Bring the edges of each wrapper together and pinch closed tightly with a fork. In a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, brown the burgers quickly on both sides. Set aside to rest. Assemble with the burgers, sprinkle each with grated cheddar, then top with banana slices and fresh sage. Serve burgers with toothpicks, or serve with toothpicks if desired. A few chopped fresh sage leaves may be added while the burgers are cooling if desired.

title: Mixed Savoy cabbage and peaches with peaches
ingredients: 8 leaves savoy cabbage | 1 1/2 quarts cold water | 1/4 cup margarine | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 jar sliced fresh peaches | 1 package pre-sliced portabella mushrooms | 1 package thickened, prepared mustard-based peppery sandwich spreadable sandwich spreadable sandwich spreadable sandwich spreadable salads
instructions: Cut up shredded savoy cabbage and cut into bite size pieces. Place in a bowl.

title: Ceviche Di Angost (Gourmet Shrimp Cocktail)
ingredients: 3 -4 1 lb fresh baby shrimp ( peeled ) | 5 fluid ounces gold tequila ( or a good quality sweetened, agave nectar ) | 1 -2 curry leaf ( depending on size of mortar and pestle ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dried fruit ( optional )
instructions: Place shrimp and ½ tsp water in a large saucepan, and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then immediately remove from heat. Cover and let stand 15 to 20 minutes. In a blender, blend together 1/4 cup tequila, curry leaves, and dried fruit until smooth, then process mixture with remaining tequila mixture until smooth. Strain through a fine sieve lined with a double thickness of cheese cloth, and reserve liquid.

title: Spicy Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | adobo seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a 2 quart casserole dish. Spread the beans in the dish. Sprinkle adobo seasoning over the beans. Bake uncovered in the preheated oven until brown, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Homemade Veggies
ingredients: 7 1/2 pounds turnips, peeled, cut into cubes | 3 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1 1/2 tablespoons light-colored pearl barley | 1 1/2 tablespoons garlic powder | 2 teaspoons cracked black peppercorns
instructions: Place the turnips in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender but still firm. Drain, and then transfer to a bowl. In a blender, combine the turnips, pearl barley, garlic powder, cracked black pepper, and salt if desired. Blend until the turnips are finely chopped. Continue to blend until you have a coarse, nonstick consistency. To serve, place a handful on a plate, and pour a small amount of the hot liquid in to the center, and serve.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,oriental sesame oil,part mozzarella cheese,cumin,banana,prosciutto,chicken bouillon cube
title: Cuban Pasta With Prosciutto
ingredients: 1/2 head garlic, mashed to a paste | 6 slices prosciutto, cut 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, divided | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin, divided | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 4 cups rotini pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: In a medium bowl mix together garlic paste, prosciutto, mozzarella, cumin, and broth powder. Add the sesame oil. Add pasta and marinate for 2 - 4 hours. Turn frequently during the last few minutes of marination. Note, if you are not using the rice on the chicken bouillon, add enough hot water to cover it. Never use instant chicken broth or salt. This will create a bitter taste that your pasta will soak inches serve with grated parmigiano or romano cheese for garnish.

title: Grilled Beef for Two
ingredients: 1 rump steak | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 red chile, thinly sliced | 1 red chile, thinly sliced | 1 cup grape cracker crumbs
instructions: Trim the fat from the steak. Cut the meat widthwise into 2 to 3 slices. Coat the slices with graham cracker crumbs. Heat a grill pan over medium heat. Cook the steak for 1 minute per side for medium rare, 1 to 2 for well done. Spread a thin layer of chili in the prepared grill. Place the steak on top of the chili. Top the steak with a thick layer of graham cracker crumbs and a sliced red chili slice. Repeat the layers until the pan is full. Cook for about 15 to 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden.

title: Brown Glaze
ingredients: 375 ml coconut milk | 125 g butter | 125 -150 g brown sugar
instructions: Put all ingredients into a saucepan and stir over low heat until the butter has melted and the sugar has dissolved. Remove from heat and pour into a greased 19 cm square cake pan. Mark with sharp knife and let settle to the side before placing in the fridge.

title: Puerto Rican Garlic Red Pepper Oil
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups corn oil | 4 red bell peppers, seeded and cut into strips
instructions: Place peppers into a plastic bag and pour in about 1/2 cup of the oil. Refrigerate peppers for at least 2 hours to allow the peppers' juices to mesh into the bag. After the peppers' juice has drained, drain excess liquid and pat peppers with paper towels to remove the oil. Heat the remaining oil in a skillet over medium heat. Saute red bell pepper strips for about 5 minutes. Remove peppers' strips from skillet and place in a medium bowl. Toss peppers' peppers' strips with the reserved oil and serve.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,coriander powder,cider vinegar,red food coloring,green cardamom pod
title: Methi Chutney (Coriander-Spice) - Indian Picket
ingredients: 400 g fresh coriander powder | 1 tablespoon red food coloring | 600 ml cider vinegar | 1 green cardamom pod | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Blend all of the ingredients till you get a fine paste. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for upto 1 week. Keep in an airtight container or recycled for upto 1 month.

title: Simple Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip | 1 can diced tomatoes
instructions: Peel the parsnips and cut them into 1 squares. If the parsnips are too big, chop them smaller. Place the parsnips in a pan with enough water to cover. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for about 40 minutes, or until they are tender. Drain the parsnips, then put in a food processor and puree until smooth. Return to the pan and stir in the tomatoes by hand. Cook for about an hour, until thickened. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,bean sprout,saffron thread,shell pasta,rice wine
title: Beef Shortribs With Saffron
ingredients: 1 lb beef short rib, cut in small pieces | 1/3 cup rice wine | 1 lb shell pasta, medium sized, cooked | 1 bag fresh bean sprouts | 2 saffron threads
instructions: In a large skillet sear shortribs on both sides. Spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray and pour in the rice wine. Reduce liquid until just barely barely covering meat. Strain wine through sieve into a bowl and let sit off the heat for 20 minutes. Add beef and bring to a boil. Cook until meat just starts to brown remove from heat and set aside. When cool cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,fennel seed,picante sauce,pork shoulder
title: Mexican Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 2 1/2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 cup picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the fennel seed with 2 teaspoons of paprika and 2 teaspoons chili powder. Place the pork into the bowl and thoroughly coat with the spice mix. Cover, and marinate pork in the refrigerator for 4 to 12 hours, basting once or twice. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil grate. Grill pork until meat is browned, about 10 minutes per side. Serve with picante sauce.

title: Yummilicious Homemade Herb Tandoori
ingredients: 1/2 gallon yogurt, or as needed | 8 tablespoons chopped fresh lemon grass, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place yogurt in a container that can be easily piped into a bowl. Cover with a damp cloth or cloth secured with a rubber band or rubber band. Refrigerate yogurt for several hours, preferably 2 hours. Pour yogurt into a large bowl. Sprinkle lemon grass over yogurt, if desired. Serve at room temperature, if desired, or refrigerate to meld flavors.

Random Ingredients: fennel,flat bread pita,season salt,english cucumber,bell pepper,cod,tomato sauce
title: Fish Fritters With Cukes, Tomatoes & Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 english cucumbers, sliced into 1/8 inch slices | 1 bell pepper, cut in 4 pieces | 1 1/2 lbs cod ( or other firm white fish ) | 1 teaspoon fennel, finely crushed | 1 teaspoon season-all salt | 1 can tomato sauce | 8 slices flat bread or 8 slices pita bread
instructions: To prepare tomato sauce, in a saucepan over high heat, combine chopped cucumbers, pepper, fennel and salt, until cucumber is wilted and slightly crisp tender, 3 - 5 minutes. Drain vegetables and toss with tomato sauce. Grill fish until cooked to taste, 2 to 4 minutes per side. To prepare pita triangles, while fish is still hot, arrange the bread slices on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 5 minutes or until lightly crisp. Remove from the oven, cut into 8 wedges. Place 1 slice fish on each wedge of bread, top with the cucumber tomato tomato sauce and top with the remaining slice bread. Serve warm.

title: Italian Appetizers
ingredients: 8 sweet italian sausage ( or hot ) | 2 1/2 dozen marshmallows
instructions: Cut italian sausage in 1 1/2 inch pieces. Melt marshmallows in a heavy skillet. Add sausage pieces, and brown. Serve with your favorite holiday roll garnishes.

title: Homemade Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless smoked salmon ( or use atlantic ) | 1 cup ketchup ( heinz's or similar ) | salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Lay your salmon on the work surface and generously season with salt and black pepper, then brush the ketchup on the flesh of the salmon. Wrap the sausage in plastic wrap and refrigerate while you preheat the oven to 150°c. Line a sheet of aluminium foil with the foil and put on the oven tray on the centre shelf. Line the salmon with aluminium foil to prevent drying out. After 20 minutes, remove the foil and cook for another 20 minutes, turning once. Remove the salmon from the oven, remove the foil and cook for 10 minutes more, and test it by piercing the flesh with a spoon and checking it's no longer runny. Carefully remove your salmon from the oven and place in a bowl with a splash of water to soak for about 15 minutes, or until it is completely cold.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,rice krispies,canola oil,red cabbage,banana liqueur,cornstarch,cream chicken soup,green chili pepper
title: Tilapia in Banana-Liqueur Skillet
ingredients: 12 ounces tilapia fillets, cut in half lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/2 inch thick strips | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup sliced green chili pepper | 1/4 cup banana liqueur | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 cups sliced red cabbage | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 6 cups hot cooked rice krispies
instructions: In a 4 quart nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add fish strips, cook and stir til opaque throughout, about 6 - 8 minutes. Stir in green pepper, banana liqueur, soup, cabbage and cornstarch. Cook and stir minute to heat rice krispies. Serve over rice. Note, for a vegetarian friendly option, use reduced sodium chicken broth.

title: Cajun Style Grilled Potatoes
ingredients: 2 pounds yukon gold potatoes, thickly sliced | 1 1/2 cups catsup | 5 drops hot pepper sauce
instructions: Prepare grill for direct heat or preheat a gas grill for indirect heat. When ready to cook, lightly oil grate. Place potatoes in a large resealable plastic bag and add 1 1/2 cups hot water. Remove potatoes from bag, shaking off any excess water, and seal. Allow to sit at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours. After 1 to 2 hours, heat an electric grill to 500 degrees f. Meanwhile, combine catsup and hot pepper sauce in a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Arrange the potatoes on the grill and cook, turning once, until nicely browned, about 5 minutes.

title: Ginger Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Place the half and half and ginger garlic paste into a heavy bottomed saucepan or skillet, and bring to a boil over medium high heat or until the mixture reaches a simmering boil. Reduce the heat to medium low, and continue cooking until the mixture has reduced to about 1/2 cup, 15 to 20 minutes, stirring frequently. The chutney may be served hot or at room temperature.

title: Stacked Chicken (Italian Style)
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs | 1 package ricotta cheese, drained | 1/2 cup chopped onion ( or more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove skin from each chicken thigh and discard. Place chicken in a shallow roasting pan or medium baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese, chopped onions, and 1/2 cup water. Stir mixture until well blended. Pour over chicken and bake, basting several times with pan drippings, until chicken is cooked through and no longer pink in the center, about 40 minutes.

title: Green Pear Asparagus Salad With Asparagus
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, fresh | 1 pear, ripe | 1 head red leaf lettuce | sunflower oil
instructions: Rinse the asparagus and let it dry for approximately 20 minutes. Once you have drained the stalks from the pear and if they are very small cut them on the diagonal into smallish chunks. Chop the red leaf lettuce into bite size pieces. Wash and dry asparagus. Cut the pear into pieces, cut them in half and slice them in half again. Combine all the ingredients in a salad bowl. Drizzle with oil and toss. Serve with lots of french bread, baguette slices or even flat beer.

title: Spicy Chocolate Pepper Fajitas
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 3/4 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 3 cardamom pods, cracked
instructions: Combine all ingredients in heavy duty nonstick skillet. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low.

Random Ingredients: ice,water artichoke heart,cherry tomato,mace,gruyere cheese,spanish chorizo sausage
title: Chorizo, Artichokes and Gruyère Cheese in Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup water-packed chopped artichoke hearts, drained | 1/2 lb fresh gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/2 lb spanish chorizo sausage, sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons grated fresh cheese blend, divided | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 8 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Bring artichoke hearts and 1/4 cup water to a simmer in a medium saucepan. Reduce heat to low and cook until all artichoke hearts are tender, 15 - 20 minutes. Drain artichokes and transfer to a clean bowl. Stir in enough of the remaining 1/4 cup water to loosen and reserve artichokes. Stir chorizo and remaining 1/4 cup water into drained artichokes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Spoon into bowls. Sprinkle with reserved cheese. Divide tomatoes and reserved artichoke hearts among the 8 tomato halves. Top with remaining cheese. Makes 4 servings.

title: Black Bean Muffins
ingredients: 1 lb black beans or 1 lb kidney bean | 3 cups bread, cubed, dry ( bread crumbs ) | 2 eggs | 2 cups bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon baking powder ( optional ) | 1/2 cup hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Soak the beans overnight.. Rinse the beans well and cook them in their soaking liquid according to the pack instructions. When they are cooked, mash with a fork. Beat the eggs in a large bowl. Add the baking soda to the mashed beans, and add the flour, baking powder and hot sauce. Add the eggs to the dry beans along with the soda. Mix. Add the bread crumbs and beat the mixture until well combined. Put in hot muffin tins and cook for 15 minutes on a low medium temperature in an iron casserole dish. Serve warm or cold.

title: Grape Tomato Pouch
ingredients: 3 -4 large grape tomatoes | kosher salt & fresh ground pepper, for taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place a baking sheet in the oven to preheat. Turn tomatoes upside down and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper. Return to the oven and bake for 30 minutes, or until the tops are browned.

title: Stir-Fried Snow Peas and Shrimp With Snow Peas and Sugar
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shrimp paste | 225 g snow peas
instructions: Heat a wok or frying pan over high heat until a bead of water sizzles around it. Add the shrimp paste and stir fry for 1 minute. Add the snow peas and stir fry for 2 minutes, or until snow peas are just tender. Serve hot.

title: Truly Easy Crumb Topping for Chicken...
ingredients: 1 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/3 cup golden brown sugar
instructions: In a large mixing bowl mix together the breadcrumbs, brown sugar and flour. Roll the dough into a large circle. Heat oven to 425 degrees. Prick with a fork. Bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,black eyed pea,parsnip,cranberry,chilies,beef bouillon granule,vegetable stock
title: Scotch Dogs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef bouillon granules | 8 cups vegetable stock | 1 can dried cranberries | 1 lb parsnip, coarsely chopped | 2 chilies, chopped ( remove seeds if desired ) | 12 ounces self rising flour | 1 1/2 cups black-eyed peas
instructions: Cook bouillon in a large pan over medium high heat until reduced to half. Add vegetable stock, cranberries, and parsnips. Bring to a boil, then season with chilies and flour. Reduce heat to medium low, and cover. Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand for 2 hours, stirring often. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Using two spoons or slotted metal spatula, scoop out about 1 cup of hot stuffing mixture into a bowl, set it aside. Drop spoonfuls of the reserved stuffing into a medium casserole dish or skillet over medium high heat.

title: Cashew Nut Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 bag unsalted cashews | 3 small green apples, peeled, cored and chopped | 1 jar large pimientos, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup celery seed | 1/4 cup finely chopped spring onion | 1/2 - 3/4 cup light mexican cheese, crumbled | 3 tablespoons finely chopped finely chopped fresh thyme, to taste
instructions: Spread cashews on rimmed baking sheet and toast in 350°f oven for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring twice, until lightly toasted. Transfer cashews to processor, add apples, pimientos, celery seed, spring onion, mexican cheese and thyme. Process until well incorporated. Transfer mixture to clean glass serving bowl, cover and chill until ready to serve. Serve chilled with crackers or chips for dipping.

title: Chowkid Salad
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti sauce | splash white vinegar | 1/2 green | 1/2 yellow pepper | 2 cucumbers, slices | white vinegar | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Boil spaghetti, drain and rinse water, then place in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and toss well. I serve this on italian bread sticks w/a combination of crushed tortilla, chopped green onions, and fresh herbs such as sun dried tomatoes.

title: Sweet Rice Vinegar Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup seasoned rice vinegar or 1/4 cup tamari | 1 dash lime wedge, for garnish ( optional ) | sliced vegetables ( optional )
instructions: Mix together, or refrigerate/use immediately prior to serving to blend flavors.

title: Peppered Beef and Olive Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces barilla whole grain pistachios | 8 ounces kalamata olives, pitted | 8 ounces dried basil sprigs | 1 1/4 lbs coarsely trimmed fat-trimmed beef chuck | 8 1/2 ounces uncooked rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine pistachios and olives in a large bowl. Cut beef crosswise into 4 thick slices. Sprinkle both sides with salt and pepper. Place beef on a rack in a heavy roasting pan or baking sheet. Insert a skewer or metal blade into beef. Arrange on a rack set over a shallow pan of lightly salted water. Bake, brushing occasionally, until meat is just cooked through, 45 to 55 minutes. Remove beef and pan from oven and set aside. Meanwhile, cook rigatoni according to package directions. Drain. Set aside. Place the rack in the top third of the oven. Toast pistachios and olives in the bottom third of the oven, shaking the pan occasionally, until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer cooked beef to a cutting board and let stand for 5 minutes. Cut the beef into thinly sliced pieces.

Random Ingredients: green onion,bell pepper,graham cracker crumb,tomato,orange juice
title: St. Paul's Pizzas
ingredients: 9 medium tomatoes | 6 medium bell peppers | 6 medium onions | 12 tablespoons orange juice or 12 tablespoons lemon juice | 24 graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the tomatoes and all vegetables on an ungreased cookie sheet. Brush tops with orange juice, spreading it evenly. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Bake in preheated oven for about 15 minutes.

title: Chilean Condensed Soyed Mojo Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy milk | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 3 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 jar capers, drained
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine soy milk, vinegar, tomatoes, and capers. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for about 20 minutes. Pour mixture back into saucepan, and cook over medium high heat for about 15 minutes, or until mixture thickens. Serve warm.

title: Stew and Tomatillo Tacos
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3/4 lb tomatillo, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried oregano | 12 small corn tortillas
instructions: Cook beef in boiling water about 15 minutes or until meat is brown and tender. Drain meat. Add tomatillos and oregano. Heat through, about 5 - 10 minutes. Heat 2 tblsps corn oil in nonstick skillet. Add tortillas and cook on both sides until crisp, about 2 minutes each side.

title: Spicy Jalapeno Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar ( or red ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 -2 small serrano chili, seeded & minced | 24 ounces spicy enchilada sauce
instructions: In a mixing bowl, beat whipping cream till soft peaks begin to form. Add salt & garlic & stir till dissolved. Stir in pepper jack cheese. Add balsamic vinegar and stir till just combined, then add 1 - 2 cans enchilada sauce to the mixture & stir to blend well. Let chill well.

Random Ingredients: caribbean jerk seasoning,scallion,pumpkin puree,chinese cabbage,coffee,hot italian sausage,chicken bouillon granule
title: Hot and Cold Slice (Pork, Sausage, and Pumpkin Stew)
ingredients: 1/4 lb chinese cabbage, shredded and finely chopped | 1 scallion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons instant coffee, soaked in | hot coffee, liquid or hot water | 4 cups cooked pork or 4 cups cooked sausage, cut into small cubes ( approximately 4 1/2 to 6 ounces ) | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules or 1 teaspoon chicken stock granules | 1/4 cup prepared pumpkin puree or 1/4 cup canned pumpkin | 1/4 teaspoon caribbean jerk seasoning
instructions: Line a 12 x 8 inch x 2 inch casserole or baking dish with foil and spray with a single layer of cooking spray. Toss cabbage with scallion. Place remaining cabbage into a large bowl and add 3 tablespoons instant coffee water or hot water and stir to combine. Add pork or sausage, poultry, stock granules, and pumpkin.

title: Simmered Broad Beans and Garlic
ingredients: 8 ounces broad beans | garlic paste
instructions: Peel and slice open the beans and wash them thoroughly. Take the garlic and wrap the bean around the onion and place in a pan and cover with water. Bring to the boil, then turn down the heat and simmer for about 40 to 50 minutes until the beans are soft. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,salt black pepper,tomato sauce,water chestnut,canola oil,vanilla extract,mexican oregano
title: Easy Delicious Tomato Sauce to Slice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and diced | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1/4 cup orange juice | 2/3 cup canola oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon mexican oregano | 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir water chestnut into oil, and cook until softened.

title: Real French Onion Dip Mix
ingredients: 8 medium white onions | 1/4 cup cognac
instructions: Peel the onions and slice them into small 1/3 pieces. Put them back in the oven on broil, or under the grill to get the skin brown. The way to peel the skin is on the rack. Place them in your blender after everything else they are in, and process until smooth. Store in a glass jar or jar and use as needed as a dip for french bread or your crock pots.

Random Ingredients: caprino cheese goat,mushroom,marmite,picante sauce,mustard powder,orzo pasta,butter,pork shoulder
title: Baked Mexican Pork With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder, boneless and trimmed of visible fat | 1 lb mushroom, sliced | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/2 cup caprino cheese, grated ( can substitute other goat cheese ) | 1 pinch mustard powder | 1 pinch marmite, spice mixture, for seasoning | 1 lb orzo pasta ( orzo or rigatoni if small ) | 4 -6 tablespoons butter
instructions: In a large cooking pot, sear the pork in butter over medium heat until done, about 5 minutes. Add wine and reduce by half. Add mushrooms and cook until they start to release their juices. Deglaze pot with wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom, about 1 minute. Stir in mushroom sauce, season with mustard powder, marmite and cook just until melted. Add orzo and stir to coat, about 2 - 3 minutes. Reduce heat to low.

title: Curly Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti, cooked | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve over plain spaghetti.

title: Golden Raisin Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups heavy cream | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon ( coarsely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon fresh dill ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup fresh thai basil ( coarsely chopped ) | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1/4 cup pine nuts ( toasted & chopped )
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together cream, tarragon, dill, basil, raisins & pine nuts. Heat dressing in a small saucepan on medium heat, about 1 minute. Gently stir and serve over chilled, toasted crudites.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,orange peel,yellow pepper,italian plum tomato
title: Italian Chickpea-Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 cup cooked chickpea flour | 4 italian plum tomatoes, sliced horizontally into 1/4 inch thick slices and seeded | 1/4 small yellow pepper, sliced lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 tablespoon orange peel, freshly grated ( i used a microplane )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Combine the chickpea flour and tomatoes in a large bowl.

title: Easy Crockpot Irish Beef and Bean Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 bag cooked pinto beans | 1 can crabmeat, drained | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander or 4 tablespoons dried coriander
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 10 minutes, checking and stirring occasionally. If you need to add two more thickener, leave on low to cook longer. Stir well before serving.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,confectioner ' sugar,rib beef,chili paste,curd cottage cheese,harissa,tapioca flour
title: North African Style Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried harissa or 1 1/2 tablespoons sambal olek | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarsely crushed fresh chili paste | 1/4 cup curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup soft brown lentils or 1/4 cup puy lentils | 1/2 cup rice flour ( may use gluten-free flour ) or 1/2 cup rice flour ( may use gluten-free flour ) | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour or 1 tablespoon cornmeal | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine harissa, chili paste, cottage cheese, lentils and rice flour and stir well. Dredge short ribs in tapioca flour or cornmeal mixture. Place over medium hot coals and cook, turning occasionally, for approximately 30 minutes or until a thermometer registers 140f for medium rare or 140f for well done. Cut ribs into serving size pieces and sprinkle with confectioner's sugar.

Random Ingredients: feta,yellow onion,black bean,nutmeg,tomato puree,ancho chile powder
title: Achiote Con Carne
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped yellow onion | 2 tablespoons ground ancho chile powder | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 tablespoon crumbled feta
instructions: Cook and stir onion in a skillet over medium heat until very soft, about 10 minutes. Stir in chile powder, nutmeg, tomato puree, and beans. Cover and increase heat to medium high.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,polenta,spinach,white wine vinegar,taco seasoning,cilantro leaf,red snapper fillet,bacon bit
title: Salmon with a Mexican Twist
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup taco seasoning | 2 cups canned minced red snapper fillets | 8 slices bacon bits | 4 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 cup pre-shredded polenta | 2 cups frozen chopped spinach
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat, or prepare as directed on package for a skillet. In a medium bowl, mix cilantro and vinegar. Add taco seasoning and stir to thoroughly coat salmon. Wrap bacon bits in cheesecloth and secure with toothpicks. Place potatoes in a large bowl and sprinkle with salt. Set aside. Place bacon bits and seasoning on a small plate and microwave on high for a minute or until the bacon slices are very slightly soft. Set aside. Place the bacon wrapped fish filets in a large skillet. Add remaining ingredients, except the spinach, and bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer until the fish is fork tender and the potatoes are tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in spinach. Continue to simmer until flavors have blended, another 5 to 10 minutes. Spoon some of the mixture onto the grilled fish and serve. Garnish with cilantro sprigs.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,mint leaf,white pepper,apple juice,coconut rum,red snapper fillet,cumin seed
title: Vietnamese-Style Fish
ingredients: 4 lbs small red snapper fillets | 1 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup coconut rum | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 head cabbage, sliced | 3 sprigs mint leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together apple juice, rum, cumin seeds, and pepper until blended. Place cabbage in a large bowl with the juice mixture. Add sliced fish to bowl. Cover, and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Remove fish from bowl 1/2 at a time, reserving marinade in bowl. Add marinated fish to marinade in bowl and cover. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, turning fish occasionally to prevent fish from sticking. Drain fish and discard remaining marinade. Rinse fish with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Heat griller to highest heat, setting for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Peking New Year's Eve
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, trimmed and cut in 1-inch cubes | 4 ounces mango pulp | salt ( for dredging ), and additional salt for seasoning
instructions: Place the meat in a large saucepan. Add the marinade ingredients, about 1/2 cup at a time. Simmer over low heat for 2 - 3 hours, or until thickened. Remove from heat and cool. Serve at room temperature, with rice dishes or in buns.

title: Realekoosaipa (Danish Red Relish Tart)
ingredients: 8 ounces realekoipa or 8 ounces red salmon | 2 ounces oleo ( it's the orange in the bottle ) | 3 teaspoons syrup | 1 cucumber ( thinly sliced, to serve )
instructions: Rinse the salmon and cut into small slices. Cut the oleo into thin slivers and place it in a small bowl. Add about 2 oz of the realekoipa or salmon, 1 teaspoon sweet syrup and 1/4 teaspoon of the perforated oleo and mix. Place the slices on a plate and then sprinkle on any remaining perforated oleo. Serve the perforated oleo plain, or add some to each serving spoon and top with another generous teaspoon of sweet syrup and a cucumber slice.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,pinot grigio wine,raisin,serrano pepper,granny smith apple,pea,pina colada nonalcoholic drink mix,iceberg lettuce
title: Spinach and Apple Salad with Pitas in Pina Colada
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas | 1 cup pea | 1 cup raisins | 4 tablespoons pinot grigio wine | 1 small serrano pepper, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 4 cups packed shredded iceberg lettuce | 2 granny smith apples, cored and diced
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil and cook peas until just tender, about 3 minutes. Drain well. Place the peas, pea pods, raisins, wine, chili, and anchovy paste in a bowl. Add the spinach and olives, stir to coat well. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: French Mushroom Quesadilla
ingredients: 6 flour tortillas | 8 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 clove garlic, minced
instructions: Set aside four pieces of cheesecloth. Bring a saucepan of water to a boil and drop in the mushrooms. Once the mushrooms, garlic and the cheesecloth are dissolved, remove the mushroom from the pan. When the water is again boiling, add the cheesecloth wrapped mushroom. Turn the heat down and just keep at a simmer. Stir occasionally until the cheese is melted and everything is mixed through in to a thick paste. Take the cheese off the heat and set aside, with a slotted spoon, on top of a warm tortilla that has been brushed with melted butter. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white onion,hot green chili pepper,pizza crust,cilantro,green chili,jalapeno pepper,prosciutto,salt pepper
title: Pizza Jalapeno
ingredients: 2 fresh hot green chili peppers | 2 bunches fresh cilantro | 1/2 white onion ( chopped ) | 1 bunch green chili ( sliced ) | 2 jalapeno peppers ( chopped ) | salt and pepper | 4 thin slices prosciutto ( thin slices or 1 package diced ham ) | 2 prepared pizza crusts
instructions: Pour a little olive oil in a skillet with the salt and fry the green chilies for a few minutes remove from the pan and set aside. Drain the fat and saute the onions over medium heat until they are soft, this will depend on size of the peppers and your preference in the hot oil saute the chilies for a couple minutes. Next, add the cilantro and saute for a minute and then add the green chili, jalapeno and prosciutto stir well then remove from heat. Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Spray a pizza pan with a little olive oil. Distribute the mixture into the crusts, spread evenly, or divide each of the above evenly over the top. Bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the crust is browned. If necessary, cover with aluminum foil for about 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,peanut oil vegetable,ricotta cheese,spinach,baking powder,chicken broth,plum tomato,mint sauce
title: Spinach and Lamb With Tomato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons good-quality minced lamb chops ( or veal ) | 2 cups shredded spinach | 1 cup ricotta cheese or large curd cottage cheese | 1/3 cup canned plum tomato, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons hot mint sauce ( like tabasco ) | 2 tablespoons chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the lamb chops and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and crusty around the edges, 8 to 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. Stir the spinach into the oil, then remove from the heat. Set aside to cool, then roughly chop the spinach. Set aside. In a large bowl, mix together the ricotta or cottage cheese. Add the tomatoes, mint sauce, chicken broth, and garlic. Stir in the basil. Place the spinach mixture in a blender and blend until smooth. Stir this mixture into the cheese and lamb in the bowl and stir until well combined. Drop the mixture by heaping tablespoons onto individual serving plates. Serve at once.

title: Tortellini With Lime and Sugar
ingredients: 3/4 lb cheese tortellini | 3/4 cup lime juice | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Cook tortellini until just tender, about 12 minutes. Drain and then immediately toss with lime juice, sugar and 1/2 cup of the tortellini. Serve immediately, with the remaining tortellini.

title: Basic Basic Plank Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground sirloin or 1 lb lean ground chuck | spices, of your choice ( e.g. fennel, clove, marjoram, sage, etc. )
instructions: Place ingredients in food processor or blender, and process until smooth. Wrap the mixture in plastic wrap or waxed paper and let stand for 5 - 6 hours, shaking it halfway through.

title: Basic Asian Sausage Skewers
ingredients: 24 skewers | 4 1/4 cups chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: In a medium size mixing bowl place the chicken broth and asafoetida mix well. Using rubber gloves, gently rub the mixture into the meat or skewers for long enough for meat to soak up the broth. Preheat the broiler. Place the sausages on a baking tray which has been coated with cooking spray and place in the oven to broil for 3 - 4 minutes to get them nicely browned. Turn over the sausages and broil for about 4 minutes more. Turn off the oven and wait 5 minutes or until the sausages are cooked to your preference.

Random Ingredients: honey,triple sec,greek yogurt,london broil beef,tomato soup
title: Yummy Beef Roast With Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 3 - 4 lbs london broil beef ( about 2lbs per 500g of beef ) or 3 -4 lbs round roast ( about 2lbs per 500g of beef ) | 1 can tomato soup ( no substitutes ) | 1 cup fat free greek yogurt or 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/4 cup honey ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a crock. Add beef. If using meat in a crock, cook on top of the stove until tender. I put the meat on top of the stove so it does not dry out. Put crock on med high for 10 minutes then reduce to low to warm. I use about 7 med and then stir in the yogurt, triple sec and honey. Strain beef and put in oven for about 10 - 15 minutes. Remove beef and serve with bread and a nice salad.

title: Guacamole Mushroom Gravy (Cottage Cheese)
ingredients: 8 ounces cottage cheese | 1/2 - 3/4 cup broth ( homemade or hot ) | 1 - 1 1/2 ounce guacamole ( for dipping )
instructions: Blend all ingrediants until smooth. Store in a tightly closed container.

Random Ingredients: coconut,sesame seed oil,dark beer,heavy whipping cream
title: Caribbean Beer Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 1 bunch cedar wood, torn into small pieces | 1 1/2 cups chilled heavy whipping cream | 1 can unsweetened coconut, drained and chopped
instructions: Heat the sesame ciment oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the cedar wood. Cook and stir until tender and dark brown, about 3 minutes. Slowly pour the heavy cream inches while the cedar wood is cooking, place the coconut into a small bowl, pour the hot coconut over the coconut, and cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap. Let sit in the refrigerator for 2 hours to macerate. Before serving, remove the cedar wood from the sauce. When ready to serve, place 1 cup or more of the cedar wood in a blender. Pour the hot coconut cream into the blender.

title: Pasta with Rose Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 1/4 teaspoon whole cumin seeds | 1 star anise | 1 cup picante sauce for garnish
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle pasta and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain well. While farfalle pasta cooks, stir 1/3 cup picante sauce, cumin seeds, and star anise in a large pot of lightly salted water until well blended. Add picante sauce.

title: Baked Seafood
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh mixed seafood | 2 lbs seafood, of your choice ( such as cod, snapper, haddock, pike, or salmon ) | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 1 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. In a large casserole dish, arrange the seafood, sprinkle with a few cracked peppercorns and enough tomato sauce to cover. Pour a tablespoon of corn oil over it and toss to coat. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Toss the seafood with the remaining tomato sauce and serve with sour cream and/or additional peppercorns.

title: Gruyère Mushrooms
ingredients: 200 g gruyere cheese, shredded ( about a cup ) | 150 g low fat cottage cheese | 8 green dates, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup pitted chopped button mushroom
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except the mushrooms in a bowl with a hand held mixer and process until smooth, adding more whet if necessary. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with the chopped mushrooms, if using. Serve with crusty bread as an accompaniment.

title: Homemade Pasta
ingredients: 500 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Heat the sun dried tomatoes in a frying pan on a medium to high heat until dried tomatoes swell up and turn the colour dark red yellow. Once dried tomatoes are cool, remove skins and put flesh into food processor. Add chilli flakes and pulse until well blended and mixed together. To use, rinse your hands under cold water to rinse off any excess oil. Drain your pasta well and put pasta back into the pan so the oil is absorbed through the pasta.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,green cabbage,pecan,kaffir lime leaf
title: Kaffir Lime and Spicy Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 3 cups green cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup pecans, toasted and chopped | 4 fresh kaffir lime leaves, chopped large | 1 package sugar snap peas, trimmed ( about 12 )
instructions: Steam green cabbage until the leaves separate.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,mango pulp,leek,bacon,jalapeno pepper,kidney bean,taco seasoning,vermicelli
title: Spicy Baked Vermicelli With Mangoes (Mango) and Bacon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 package vermicelli, cooked, broken in half ( about 10 ounces ) | 8 slices lean bacon, crisp-cooked, drained and crumbled | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 medium leek, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup canned kidney beans, drained | 1 canned jalapeno peppers, sliced | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 15 ounces mango pulp
instructions: Combine vinegar and vermicelli in medium bowl. Toss to coat. Microwave bacon until it begins to brown, about 20 seconds. Add taco seasoning, leek, kidney beans, jalapeno slices, vinegar and mango pulp. Toss to combine. Spray 13x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Set aside 1/4 cup pasta cooking liquid. Spread remaining 1/4 cup pasta cooking liquid over vermicelli.

Random Ingredients: elbow macaroni,poblano chile,saffron thread,garlic flake,grape,bicarbonate soda,double cream
title: Chile con Salsa Piccata
ingredients: 200 g dry elbow macaroni ( i use dreamfields ) | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( i use bicarbonate of soda ) | 1/2 cup grape, halved | 1 pinch saffron strand | 1 -2 poblano chile, roasted peeled and cut into small pieces | 1 cup double cream | 150 ml grape, quartered | 1 teaspoon saffron powder ( i use saffron ) | 1 teaspoon garlic flakes
instructions: Cook and drain pasta according to directions. While pasta is cooking, heat sugar in a small saucepan until it is golden in colour. Stir occasionally so that sugar doesn't burn. Quickly pour syrup over hot beans. Add grape, cheese, cayenne, and a pinch of saffron. Stir. Pour hot pasta over cheese and bean. It is important that all absorb the sauce. It will coat the pasta, and the cheese is hot and bubbling.

title: Pomegranate and Chive Cake
ingredients: 500 g pomegranate juice | 500 ml single cream | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | 4 teaspoons lime juice
instructions: To make a smooth sponge, combine the ingredients, stirring well until smooth, then chill for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven at 140°c/350°f/gas mark 4 for 45 to 55 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the centre of the cake comes out clean. Let stand for 10 minutes before turning out with a skewer, and wiping off any excess. Serve warm with cream.

title: Whip Oatmeal with Toasted Oats
ingredients: 4 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking oats
instructions: Whisk whipping cream with oats in a large bowl until soft peaks form. Fold 1/4 cup cream, oats, and 1/2 cup cream mixture into egg mixture.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,rice krispies,pickling spice,lardons,dark brown sugar,pasta,scotch bonnet pepper,ice
title: Scotch Bonnet Pasta
ingredients: 8 -10 tablespoons kerry irish brown sugar | 6 tablespoons crushed ice | 8 tablespoons pickling spices | 8 tablespoons scotch bonnet peppers ( or other dark red hot pepper ) | 8 tablespoons lemon pepper | 1 pint rice krispies | 1/2 pint rice krispies | 1/2 pint water
instructions: Stir all except kerry irish sugar and the rice krispies in saucepan and boil until mixture thickens slightly. Add rice krispies which have been allowed to stand for 5 - 10 minutes. Add kerry sugar and the hot pepper juice. Stir to combine. Drain rice krispies and add to the saucepan. Stir well. Cook covered over low heat for 20 mins. Stirring every so often. To prevent the mixture from catching, cover and cook 30mts. Check for liquid content and remove from heat. Serve.

title: Tuscany Rub
ingredients: 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: In a bowl, thoroughly blend together the grated cheese and cayenne pepper. Store in an airtight jar in the refrigerator. Use in terrines and bread or on italian bread slices.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,cardamom seed,greek yogurt,white sugar,coffee,cherry tomato,confectioner sugar
title: Cherry Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons onion salt | 2/3 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon ground coffee | 1 pint cherry tomatoes - halved | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1/4 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Combine the confectioners' sugar, onion salt, greek yogurt, coffee, cherry tomatoes, cardamom seeds, and white sugar in a saucepan over high heat. Bring to a boil, then simmer until flavors are well blended but the yogurt is still pourable, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,artichoke heart,feta cheese,cannellini bean,italian parsley,broccoli
title: Low-Fat Roasted Greens With White Bean and Artichokes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fat-free low-fat feta cheese | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 bunch broccoli, sliced
instructions: Set up the beans, vegetables, and garlic according to package directions. When ready to use, place the feta and artichoke hearts in a shallow baking dish or 2 quart casserole dish. Pour oil over the artichokes, sprinkle with parsley, and toss to coat. Bake in a 400 degree fahrenheit oven until heated through, about 10 minutes. Spoon the spinach into the pan, drizzle with artichoke oil, and toss to coat. Sprinkle with beans, and bake until heated through, and golden brown, about 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Gianne's Pea and Tofu Lasagna
ingredients: 2 packages tofu, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup green peas, frozen | 4 eggs, slightly beaten | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 package lasagna noodles, cooked with water squeezed from the bundles and noodles placed on the damp dishtowel
instructions: Drain the tofu and peas into a 1 1/2 quart saucepan, place over medium low heat. Stir and simmer until the liquid has evaporated and the tofu is browned, 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the eggs and simmer until the whites are set, about 5 minutes. Place the graham cracker crumbs in a separate bowl. Dip the noodles into the beaten eggs. Drain the noodles into the remaining egg mixture. Arrange layers of pasta and tofu mixtures in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the crumbs over the top. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Remove the plastic wrap, place the lasagna on a baking sheet, and bake for 35 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Corned Beef and Kidney Bean Sausages
ingredients: 32 ounces corned beef and kidney beans seasoned with salt and pepper, seasoning blend | 8 -10 thin boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Place the chicken thighs in the crock of a slow cooker. Sprinkle both sides of each piece with the seasoned salt and pepper. Add the beans and the can of kidney beans to the meat and stir. Cook on low for 8 hours.

title: Seared Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 12 ounces low-sodium salmon, boned and skinned | 1/2 lb grated carrot | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 1 1/4 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1 1/2 teaspoons green food coloring, divided
instructions: Blend salmon, carrot, margarine, 1/2 teaspoons of the green food coloring, and 1/2 teaspoon of the water in blender on medium for at least 1 minute. Remove salmon from blender and add remaining 5 drops green food color and 2 drops yellow food coloring to taste. Pour oil or canola oil into a 13 x 9 baking pan and coat with cooking spray.
