Add salmon mixture, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 30 minutes or up to 4 hours before baking. Cut into 8 skewers. Preheat oven to 180 degrees f. Remove skewer from pan and bake for 15 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked to desired doneness. Let stand 10 minutes before removing, reserving 1 cup cooking liquid. Serve with salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,pineapple juice,mozzarella cheese,feta cheese,green cardamom pod,green chilies,roast beef
title: Spicy Roast Beef Sandwiches Ww 3 Points
ingredients: 1/2 lb thinly sliced lean top round roast beef | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 3 tablespoons pineapple juice | 4 green cardamom pods, smashed | 1 green chilies, green parts only, finely chopped | 8 slices mozzarella cheese | 1 medium cauliflower, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place beef in a large nonstick skillet. Cook over medium high heat until browned. Add cheese, pineapple juice and cardamom pods and heat through. Sprinkle with chiles and pour over beef. Add cauliflower pieces and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Serve on warm.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,picante sauce,anise seed,green cardamom pod,yoghurt,frangelico
title: Oriental Rice Noodles - Raita
ingredients: 500 g fresh rice noodles | 1 tablespoon yoghurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons frangelico | 4 green cardamom pods | 4 black anise seeds | 1/8 cup sizzling picante sauce
instructions: Place rice noodles in a large bowl. Cover with cold water and leave to soak until softened, about 20 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water. Drain, place in a food processor and process until finely ground. Add yoghurt, frangelico and cardamom seeds and process until smooth. Spread the noodle mixture over a large platter and top with the crispy noodle base. Sprinkle with sizzling picante sauce.

Random Ingredients: radish,tart apple,cilantro leaf,yellow onion,red bell pepper,white pepper powder,brandy
title: Apple Salad With Onion and Red Pepper
ingredients: 1 -2 tart apple | 1 medium yellow onion, peeled | 1 red bell pepper, seeded | 2 tablespoons sarsacha brandy or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Peel, core and dice the apple, onion and red bell pepper into 3/4 inch pieces. Grate the fresh cilantro leaves in a mortar and pestle or in a spice grinder. In a small bowl, combine the white pepper and hot pepper flakes, if using. Toss the apple mixture with salt and pepper. Add the sargento brandy and mix well. Serve cold.

title: Fruited Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices | 1 container molasses | 1 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1 package jicama
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place bread slices in a single layer in a jelly roll pan. Stir molasses, brown sugar, and jicama together in a bowl until well combined.

title: Huevos Manchego Bananas
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower | 3 bananas
instructions: Place the cauliflower on the coals of a grill. Grill them until it becomes crisp, then turn over and grill them until it gets crisp. Once the cauliflower is crisp remove it from the grill and cut it into medium size pieces. Use a sharp knife to cut it into medium size pieces. Take a medium sized pan, pour in a little bit of water, and add the banana pieces. Simmer them in it until they are soft. Add a few drops of sesame oil or other spices to taste.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,coriander powder,thyme sprig,bread,ancho chile powder
title: Ancho Chutney
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs ( optional ) or 3 tablespoons ghee ( optional )
instructions: Fry the chutney in a heavy skillet over medium low heat until hot and fragrant. Do not brown. Pour off excess oil. Stir in the ancho, thyme and corriander powder and cook until aromatic. Stir in the garam malasa. Pour into hot chutney. Let cool to room temperature then cover and let sit for 20 minutes before serving warm/hot.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,black bean,cilantro leaf,yellow bell pepper,serrano chili,lemon pepper,ice
title: Black Bean and Yellow bell pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 fresh serrano chili, seeded and finely chopped | 1 small yellow bell pepper | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed with cold water | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaf | 8 cups finely diced ice | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Cook the chile, peppers and lemon pepper in a medium saucepan of boiling salted water until the peppers are tender.

title: Crispy Onion-Chicken Bites
ingredients: 12 ounces chicken or 12 ounces duck | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup ground cumin seed | 2 scallions, chopped | 6 small slices white bread or 6 small pita bread, of your choice | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place chicken in a shallow 9x13 inch pan coated with cooking spray and cut a slit down the length of the chicken at a 45° angle and discard the knife. Cut the meat into thin slices, 1 inch wide and 2 inches long. Cut each slice in half if large. In a small saucepan, combine the brown sugar, ground cumin seeds and sliced scallions. Bring to a boil and cook over low heat until the candy begins to set around the edges, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the warm chie sauce until a thermometer inserted in the thickest part of the thigh registers 160f, about 1 minute. Spoon half the mixture into the chicken slices. Place the bread on plates and top with the chicken, coating thoroughly. Arrange the chicken on top of the candy and sprinkle with the chopped cilantro.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,fennel seed,marjoram,dark brown sugar,golden brown sugar
title: Mildly Brown Sugar and Spice Paste
ingredients: 1 ounce dark brown sugar ( for baking, walnut, piloncillo ) | 1 ounce brown sugar ( for coating and drizzling ) | 12 ounces fennel seeds, in brine | 8 ounces marjoram | 2 slices lime zest | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a medium sized tin and stir well. Allow to stand overnight to solidify. Transfer the mixture to a pestle and mortar and mix thoroughly. Store in an airtight container, stirring every so often. Use in any recipe.

title: Guacamole Drink
ingredients: 4 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons ice water | 3 tablespoons guacamole ( i use miracle whip )
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl. Stir until well blended. Chill for at least 2hours, or a bit longer if you have time. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,brown rice,amaretto liqueur,clam,turkey,bay leaf,turnip,tamarind paste
title: Flaming Clam Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked brown rice | 8 canned minced clams, drained | 1 can tamarind paste ( found in asian food section ) | 1 small turnip, peeled and chopped | 1/2 yellow onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur ( found in asian food section ) | 2 bay leaves | 1 pound lean ground turkey, or to taste
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Drain. Place clams, tamarind paste, turnip, onion, amaretto, and bay leaves into a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth. Heat a large dutch oven over high heat. Cook and stir pork and ground turkey in the hot dutch oven until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Salmon Gratin
ingredients: 1 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 1/4 cup finely grated fresh swiss cheese, divided | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 lb thick-sliced fresh salmon
instructions: Preheat the oven to in a bowl, combine the gruyere, 2 tablespoons of the cheese, and the lemon juice. Coat the salmon filets with the cornstarch. Melt the remaining cheese in a medium saute pan over medium heat.

title: Faux Baked Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 cup frozen peas | 1/2 cup diced cooked shrimp
instructions: Combine rice and peas in a casserole dish.. Sprinkle shrimp over the rice. Cover dish with plastic wrap and bake at 350ºf. Cook 10 minutes then check and cook until rice is tender, another 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,red pepper,baking soda,fruit apricot,red pepper flake,almond milk
title: Almond-Dipped Fruit Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup almond milk ( unsweetened ) | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup dried mixed fruit ( such as peaches or apricots, currants or grape tomatoes ) | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon red-wine roasted sweet red pepper, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together oil, milk, flour, baking soda, fruit and red pepper flakes. If desired, stir in 1/4 cup hot water, blending as you progress.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,chicken,chicken turkey,rom tomato,vanilla bean,almond extract,spinach leaf,red bell pepper
title: Spinach & Almond Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 chicken, skin removed ( use 1 chicken and 1 turkey, 2 spinach & 1 bean ) | 8 -10 large spinach leaves | 2 roma tomatoes | 1 red bell pepper | 1/4 cup blanched almond | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla bean | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Roast almond extract in a frying pan at medium heat and then pour off the fat. Remove chicken skin and chicken carcass, if necessary, then set chicken aside. Cut the bell pepper into thin slices and remove seeds by using a vegetable peeler. Cut the tomatoes into thin slices and arrange in a serving bowl alongside the bell pepper, sliced tomatoes and almonds. Chop cooked chicken into strips and add chicken to the salad. Wash and tear spinach thoroughly and place in a serving bowl. Heat small amount of oil in a skillet over high heat and cook chicken in small batches until chicken is cooked and white. Remove from pan, pour off fat and set aside. To the same skillet, add sherry and stir to loosen any browned bits of chicken, then add the vanilla bean and almond extract. Remove from heat, season with salt and pepper to taste, then transfer the dressing to a bowl. When finished, add the chicken to the salad and mix well. Serve immediately.

title: Okra Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 pound okra, washed | 1 container plain fat-free yogurt
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in okra, cook and stir until okra is tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove okra mixture from skillet and spread onto a plate. When skillet looks dry, mix in yogurt until no lumps remain. Transfer okra mixture to a serving dish and refrigerate, covered with plastic wrap, for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,young ginger root,honey,oat,wheat flour,cherry tomato
title: Mustard Gingerbread
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups old-fashioned rolled oats | 4 cups old-fashioned rolled wheat flour | 3 tablespoons oat | 1/4 cup grainy mustard | 2 teaspoons ground cherries or 2 teaspoons crushed cherry tomatoes | 2 teaspoons grated young ginger root
instructions: Cream rolled oats or old fashioned whole wheat flour. Sift in grated ginger or peel of ginger, oats or old fashioned whole wheat flour mixed with ground or cracked wheat in a kitchenaid mixing bowl. Mix with a large fork or 2 knives. Mix together well using your hands, mixing by hand about 10 minutes until the dough has pulled away from the side of your bowl. Add a little water to your hands if needed, and then knead. Roll dough into a long roll, about 1 1/2 inches long and 2 inches wide. Cut into 12 wedges. Place on a well greased baking sheet. Bake in a 350f degrees oven for 20 minutes, until firm, and lightly browned. Turn wedges a few times while baking. Allow to cool to warm to room temperature, a little less than 90 degrees.

title: Chile Sage Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces dry pasta, cooked and drained | 2 ounces baby carrots | 2 ounces walnut halves | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 medium red chile pepper, halved
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a medium bowl, toss the carrots, nuts, and herbs with the pasta. Season with salt and pepper. Place in a shallow buttered baking dish and broil for 3 - 4 minutes to lightly brown and soften the nuts.

Random Ingredients: sage,chicken bouillon,dark red kidney bean,crescent dinner,vegetable oil,egg tomato,cream cheese,plum tomato
title: Italian Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 egg tomatoes, diced | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 can cream cheese, softened | 3 tablespoons sour cream or 3 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1 can plum tomatoes, drained with liquid reserved | 5 cups cooked dark red kidney beans, or cannelloni bean ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chicken bouillon, granules
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Unroll crescent dough, separate into 4 rectangles, separating each piece into 4 triangular sections to make 2 triangles and 6 equal points per rectangle. Place triangles in ungreased 13x9 inch baking dish. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Spread cream cheese over cut crusts, and sprinkle with diced tomatoes, oil, yogurt, sage, and beans. Bake about 10 minutes longer or until golden golden brown.

title: Mexican Flank Steak (Haitian)
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 2 pounds top round steak, cubed | 1 1/2 cups peanut butter | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 can whole green chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons mild-tasting bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Place the bacon in a large, deep skillet, and cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until evenly brown, about 10 minutes. Drain the bacon slices on paper towels. Meanwhile, in a large covered skillet, fry the steak cubes until evenly browned, 4 to 6 minutes per side. Drain the meat on paper towels, and reserve the rendered grease. Place the bacon strips in a blender or food processor, and process until finely chopped. Spread the peanut butter over the bottom of a skillet, and stir in the bacon.

Random Ingredients: tahini paste,buttermilk,taco sauce,strawberry preserve,enchilada sauce,cheddar cheese,meat,macaroni
title: Taco Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni | 16 ounces meat, cooked | 1 jar enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons tahini paste | 7 ounces shredded cheddar cheese ( i use my own, but i think it would be too strong ) | 12 ounces frozen strawberries in syrup | 1 bottle kraft buttermilk | taco sauce
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed but i only cook for 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grape,buttermilk,rigatoni pasta,jeera powder,sage leaf,israeli couscous,triple sec
title: Rigatoni With Grape and Parsley
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh sage leaves | 2 teaspoons finely grated jeera powder | 9 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1 cup grapes, washed and finely chopped | 3/4 cup israeli couscous, soak and drained | 2 cups buttermilk
instructions: Start by making the spice paste. Chop the sage into thin, slivers, 1/4″ thick slices. Combine the sage in a small pot with the jenar’s spice paste. Over medium heat, bring 2 quarts of water with 2 tbsp salt to a boil. Add the rigatoni and stir continuously with a large spoon, stirring so the rigatoni doesn’t stick, for 3–5 minutes or until pasta is barely firm. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Add the grape and parsley and stir well. Cover and cook for 20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the couscous is tender. Stir the couscous into the hot broth and continue cooking for 5–6 more minutes. Remove the from heat and stir in 3/4 cup of the buttermilk, stirring well. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Stir again and adjust seasoning.

Random Ingredients: russian salad dressing,beef brisket,sherry,kalamata olive,chicken meat,garlic salt,veal
title: American Kitchen Classic Russian Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup kalamata olive, chopped | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 2 boneless beef brisket, trimmed | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 12 slices veal, cut into 1-inch slivers | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup crumbled cooked chicken meat
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Arrange the olives on a baking sheet and toast in preheated oven 30 minutes, or until lightly browned and roasted. Remove from the oven, and add the salad dressing. Set aside. Sprinkle brisket with garlic salt. Place brisket on the prepared baking sheet, fat side up. Bake, covered, in the preheated oven for 3 hours or until tender. Remove from oven, and let stand 15 minutes. Reserve the cooking juices. Remove meat from the brisket, and shred with 2 forks. Heat the sherry in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly. When the sherry has stopped bubbling, stir in the ground beef. Cook and stir until the meat is heated through, about 3 to 5 minutes. Spoon beef over the beef. Replace the cover, and bake 10 minutes longer, or until the internal temperature of the brisket reaches 160 degrees f.

title: Easy Potato Squash Hash
ingredients: 2 cups hash brown potatoes, shredded | 2 cups yellow squash, chopped | 1/4 cup scallion, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to brown potatoes in medium size skillet and mash in the skillet until slightly crispy.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,english muffin,chili powder,garlic powder,graham cracker crumb
title: Baked English Muffins
ingredients: 6 english muffins, split | 1 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup chili powder | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place split english muffins in bottom of baking dish. Combine vinegar, chili powder, garlic powder and graham cracker crumbs. Pour dressing over muffins.

title: Oat Biscuits #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef rump | 1 package oat bars | 1 beaten egg
instructions: Combine all ingredients and shape into one or 2 logs. Wrap in wax paper and freeze until solid. Bake on cookie sheets at 300 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mari's Clams
ingredients: 24 large clams ( or smaller ) | 3/4 cup marsala | 1/2 cup unsweetened apple juice | 2 tablespoons sweet cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Remove any scum or impurities that rise to the top of the clams. Mix together the wine vinegar, garlic powder, cinnamon, marsala, apple juice, cocoa powder and marjoram. Pour the mixture into a pan. Cover and leave in a warm place for an hour. When ready to use remove all the sand which collects on the edge of the pan. Seal and heat. This can be eaten at once with clams.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,jalapeno pepper lengthwise,golden syrup,rice wine vinegar,topping,coriander,cumin
title: Chilli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons ground coriander | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon minced jalapeno pepper, seeds and veins removed | 1 1/2 cups frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Stir golden syrup, vinegar, chili sauce, coriander, cumin, and jalapeno together in a saucepan until well blended. Serve chilled with whipped topping.

title: Chile Con Queso (Cheese Balls)
ingredients: 11 ounces cheese, white, mild, aged farm-style, grated | 6 -12 ounces jalapeno chilies, small, roasted ( canned or fresh- roasted ) | 1/4 cup jalapeno puree, chipoltes ( or other mild jalapeno dip )
instructions: Pulse half of the cheese to a coarse paste, the other half in a food processor until very well combined, about 10 pulses. Add the chiles in adobo and puree in a blender until smooth. You need to pulse about 1/4 at a time, so the bottom of the chile will blend into the paste.. Add the puree into the cheese paste and stir to combine. Chill 1 hour or overnight, or chill up to 1 day ahead. Shape into small balls using about 2 rounded teaspoons per ball. Roll in additional jalapenos.

Random Ingredients: corn,black pepper,fennel bulb,plain white flour,cream mushroom soup,half,chickpea
title: Vegetable Fritters on Pumpkins, Corn and Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, trimmed and finely chopped | 2 cans creamed corn | 140 g chopped chickpeas | 300 ml cream of mushroom soup | 600 ml low fat half-and-half | plain white flour | black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place fennel bulb in a roasting tin with the chopped chilli flakes and half the cream of mushroom soup. Put the corn, chickpeas and chickpeas into a large pan and bring to the boil. Stir in the remaining cream of mushroom soup and half of the flour, stir and bring mixture to the boil. Simmer for five minutes. Season. Put fritters, one by one, into the fritters in the tin and place into preheated oven for 12 - 15 minutes, until golden.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,water,rye bread,chinese cabbage,grain rice,coconut cream,cornflour
title: Arroz Con Jitomate (Pancakes in Coconut Milk)
ingredients: 2 cups finely shredded chinese cabbage | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 cup grated mexican cheese ( mild, sharp cheese like monterey jack ) | 1/2 cup light coconut cream, not canned milk ( coco lopez ) | 1/2 cup water | rye bread ( rye bread, for dipping, or pita triangles )
instructions: Combine cabbage and cornflour in a medium bowl.

title: Indian Spiced Noodle (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti | 3 cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Combine all other ingredients in crock pot. Cook on high for 5 to 6 hours,.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,chicken meat,pork shoulder,jalapeno pepper,graham cracker crumb,white wine,mexican cheese,oregano
title: Pork Pot Roast with Chile Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of any loose fat | 1 lb boneless pork shoulder ( trimmed of loose fat ) | 2 1/2 cups white wine | 1 can mexican-style cheese, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh jalapeno peppers or 1/4 cup pickled jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place pork in 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Combine white wine and canned chiles in saucepan and heat on high until hot. Pour hot chile mixture over pork.

Random Ingredients: seasoning mix,torn romaine lettuce,bouillon cube,mozzarella cheese,ginger paste
title: Spicy Italian Salad
ingredients: 1 head packed torn romaine lettuce | 2/3 cup crumbled mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon ground ginger paste | 1 tablespoon hot gravy seasoning
instructions: Mix together lettuce, cheese, bouillon, ginger paste and gravy seasoning in a clear glass bowl or dish.

title: Chipotle Fig and Olive Salad (Abuela)
ingredients: 4 dried chipotle chiles, stemmed, seeded, and sliced | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, whole | 1 1/2 lbs mixed small figs | 1/3 cup kalamata olive
instructions: Place the chiles in a dry heavy skillet over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,frangelico,yoghurt,extra virgin olive oil,celery rib
title: Striped Frangelico Topped Chocolates
ingredients: 6 1/2 ounces fat-free yoghurt | 9 ounces extra virgin olive oil | 9 ounces chocolate chips | 3 celery ribs, stalks cut into thirds | 4 teaspoons frangelico, or to taste
instructions: Mix together the yoghurt and olive oil in a bowl, and cover. Put the chocolate into a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 1 minute, or until melted. Chop the celery into 1/2 inch pieces. Add the melted chocolate to the yoghurt and olive mixture, stir until smooth. Transfer to a small, shallow baking dish and chill for one hour before cutting into wedges.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola cheese,bulk pork sausage,turmeric powder,parsley leaf,farfalle pasta
title: Pasta Toss
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk pork sausage | 2 tablespoons gorgonzola cheese | parsley leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 lb farfalle pasta
instructions: Drain pasta and put in large skillet. In a bowl, mix gorgonzola cheese, parsley leaves and spices together. Slice into thin pieces. Add meat mixture, reduce heat and simmer covered for 15 mins, stirring occasionally and cook over fairly low heat until meat is cooked. If using immediately, cover and refrigerate until ready to eat.

title: German Style Red Cabbage. Diabetic Version
ingredients: 2 lbs red cabbage | 3 large vanilla beans ( or 1/8 cup sugar ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard ( i use dijon ) or 1/2 teaspoon french's mustard ( i use dijon )
instructions: Core finely shredded red cabbage. Slice into 1/2 inch wide strips. Place in a large ziploc bag or bowl and crush one of the vanilla beans with the back of a teaspoon. Add 1/2 cup boiling water. Let steep 20 - 20 minutes. Remove seeds and fiber. Add remaining ingredients and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Freezes well.

Random Ingredients: sea salt black pepper,icing sugar,white hominy,strawberry jam
title: Lupita's Strawberry and Jam En Papillote
ingredients: 3 lbs good quality white hominy | 2 1/2 tablespoons icing sugar ( white ) | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper, for seasoning | 1 pint fresh strawberries or 1 pint frozen strawberries, divided | strawberry jam ( optional )
instructions: Place the hominy in a large saucepan, cover with water, and bring to boil. Remove lid and simmer over the lowest heat for 2 hours or until the hominy is tender and translucent. Drain, discard the water, and let the hominy continue to simmer. Stir in the icing sugar. Season to taste with salt and black pepper. To serve, spoon a few handfuls of the hot hominy into each glass. Top with a spoonful of the strawberry topping. Top with a dollop of a drizzle of strawberry jam, if desired. If your making your own jam use some fresh strawberries or frozen strawberries. You can also use other flavor jam. Variation, a handful sliced bluberge raspberries, halved lengthwise, placed in a bowl of cold water to hydrate or thaw, and then chopped to the same size as the berries. Variation 1, use blackberry jam instead of strawberry jam.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,olive,chicken tender,linguine pasta,plain nonfat yogurt,maple syrup,yellow cornmeal,plum tomato
title: Chicken Linguini With Maple-Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders or 1 lb flank steak | 12 ounces linguine pasta ( or other thin spaghetti ) | 2 cans plum tomatoes | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate | 1 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/4 cup chopped olive
instructions: Rinse and wipe out saucepan. Cook and drain chicken tenders in olive oil in a large skillet. Stir fry for 1 - 2 minutes. Stir in orange concentrate, tomatoes, and maple syrup. Bring to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes, stirring often. Remove from heat. Cook linguini according to package directions and drain. Stir into mixture. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Toss with tomato sauce. Garnish with olives.

Random Ingredients: milk,pork tenderloin,green bean,red potato,red lentil,dark soy sauce,iceberg lettuce
title: Potato and Lamb Ties With Dried Pork & Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, thinly sliced ( from two shoulder loin slices ) | 1 iceberg lettuce, rinsed and dried | 6 medium red potatoes, cut into 1-inch chunks | 8 ounces canned red lentils, rinsed and drained | 4 ounces canned green beans | 6 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/3 cup milk
instructions: In a large non metallic bowl combine the pork with the lettuce rinsed and dried potatoes and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and up to 1 day. In a small bowl combine the red lentils and green beans with the soy sauce and mix well. In two separate bowls combine the pork and lettuce rinsed and dried lentils with the milk and stir well to combine then set aside. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Put the pork and lettuce mixture onto a foil lined baking sheet and top evenly with the red lentils and green beans mixture. Bake until the potato is brown on the inside and the lentils are tender and crisp and cooked through, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Let stand for about 10 minutes then serve.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,pork fillet,orange,cream celery soup,green chili pepper,almond extract,pinto bean
title: Pork and Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can reduced-fat cream of celery soup | 1 teaspoon ground orange peel | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped green chili pepper | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 lbs boneless pork fillets ( about 3 cutlets )
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients. Place the pork in a large nonstick skillet. Cook over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, about 12 minutes. Add the bean mixture and cook until it is hot throughout, about 5 more minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350°f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place the pork in the baking dish. Spoon the soup mixture over the top. Bake the beans in the middle of the oven until the meat is just tender, about 35 minutes.

title: Kabocha-Japanese Garlic Bread
ingredients: 3 cups fresh shiitake mushrooms, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dry yeast | 1 medium-hot red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 -2 french baguette, cut in half
instructions: Put the mushrooms into a bowl and add the yeast and mix the ingredients together with your hands until no lumps of yeast remain, about 10 - 15 minutes. While the yeast is working in the flour, make the kabocha dough. Put the garlic in the bowl of a food processor, pulse briefly, then put the dough in the food processing bowl and pulse until it forms a ball around the blade. Turn the dough out of the bowl onto a floured work surface and knead it gently with your hands. Put the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with saran wrap, and let it rest for about 20 minutes. When ready to bake, preheat your oven to 200 degrees f. Cut three 4 inch deep slits in the baguette and brush with oil. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Slide the dough onto the lined baking sheet and brush with oil. Bake until well colored and crisp, about 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and cool for 5 minutes. Slice the bread in half diagonally and serve with kabocha sauce for dipping.

title: Asparagus With Chorizo and Chorizo
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed, woody ends snapped off ( about 12-13 spears ) | 4 ounces chorizo italian sausage, sliced into 1/4-inch slices ( about 1 3/4 ounces ) | 1/2 ounce sugar ( to taste )
instructions: Trim asparagus of woody ends. Cut asparagus crosswise into thirds each and then crosswise into 3/8ths on each side. Cook sausage, sugar and chorizo in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over low heat, stirring, until sausage is cooked through, about 4 minutes. Add asparagus and cook 2 - 3 minutes until heated through. Serve.

title: Indian Fried Spicy Peanuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 package chili seasoning mix | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in seasoning mix and cardamom. Stir fry peanuts 3 to 4 minutes or until fragrant.

title: Baked Salmon Mousse
ingredients: 350 g raw salmon, skin removed | 1 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c or 220°c if using salted salmon. Remove from the oven, and put in a large baking tray. Mix salt, and onion salt together. Sprinkle over the entire salmon. Put into the oven for about 30 minutes, or until flaky and nicely browned. Serve with potato chips.

Random Ingredients: herb,white bread,curry paste,tomato green chilies,chicken broth,baby bok choy,beef broth
title: Curried Cutlets in Broth
ingredients: 2 slices day old white bread, or more to taste | 3 cups chicken broth | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon mild curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs, or more to taste | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 2 baby bok choy, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven broiler. Place bread slices on a cookie sheet and broil in the preheated oven until toasted and crusty, about 5 minutes. Set aside to cool a few minutes. Break off chunks of bread, and return to broiler. Crush with hands or wooden spoon, making a fine powder. Transfer crumbs to a medium bowl, and mix with chicken broth, beef broth, curry paste, and dried herbs. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with toasted bread slices. Place tomatoes and bok choy on top. Pour sauce over crumbs and tomatoes. Cover, and bake in the preheated oven 20 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,sauce,onion powder,chicken bouillon granule,salmon fillet,alfredo sauce,coriander,pasta
title: Easy Pasta with Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups hot sauce | 1 cup creamy prepared alfredo sauce ( store-bought or homemade ) | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 6 ounces salmon fillets, bone-in | pasta ( for 4 servings ) | 1 medium onion ( sliced in half rings )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. In a medium bowl, mix hot sauce, alfredo sauce, chicken bouillon, coriander and turmeric. Spread half of the sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish, then fill with one third of the salmon. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Bake uncovered in the center of the oven for 45 minutes. Remove from oven then top salmon with the remaining sauce.

title: Spice Islands Black Olives
ingredients: 12 black olives, pitted | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the olives on a baking sheet. Sprinkle them with allspice. Broil the olives until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.

title: Lazy Irish Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh lasagna noodles, no boil | 2 lbs potatoes, peeled, quartered
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water just until tender but still crisp. Drain and set aside. Rinse potatoes under cold water. Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and allow potatoes to cool slightly. In a large pot of boiling, salted water cook lasagna noodles until just tender.

title: Canadian Bacon Wrapped in Puff Pastry
ingredients: 1 pastry sheet | 1 green chili, diced | 1 1/2 lbs canadian bacon, diced
instructions: Roll out 2 1/2 inch squares of pastry. Prick pastry with a fork. Mix the chilies and canadian bacon in a bowl. Lay a piece of the bacon on the pastry square. Roll pastry so the bacon is encased by the chilies and canadian bacon. Carefully move the wrapped pastry up around the chilies. Wrap the entire pasty square in the pastry. Prick the pastry with a fork. Spray the top of the pastry with oil and bake at 425f for 15 minutes or until golden on top.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,meat,onion soup mix,tortilla,kielbasa,kalamata olive,large shrimp
title: Meat and Shrimp Jambalaya
ingredients: 20 large shrimp, cooked, peeled, and deveined | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs. kielbasa, cut into 1/4 thick slices | 1 lb meat | 1 can tomato juice | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, sliced | tortilla
instructions: Fry or pan fry kielbasa until lightly brown. Add meat, tomato juice, onion soup mix, olives and meat to 1 1/2 qt slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours. Serve over tortillas.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,cracker crumb,sauerkraut,beef bouillon cube,green zucchini
title: Easy Buckeyes
ingredients: 1 medium green zucchini | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon crushed cracker crumbs or 1 teaspoon crushed plain cracker
instructions: Slice zucchini in half lengthwise, then cut lengthwise into thin 2 inch lengths. Set aside. Combine all ingredients except zucchini. Stir well. If mixture is too wet, add more bread crumbs or cracker crumbs. Drop mixture in greased 8 x 8 inch glass baking dish, coating evenly. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator. Remove plastic wrap, about 30 minutes before serving time. Turn oven to 400 degrees f. Place on lowest rack in oven. Cook, uncovered, 40 - 45 minutes. Remove plastic wrap, then continue to cook until dark brown in color. Turn off oven, cover loosely with foil, and set aside for another 10 minutes to cool slightly. Cut into 1 x 1 inch squares.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,garlic red chile paste,vegetable stock,sesame seed oil
title: Spiced Red Cabbage With Garlic
ingredients: 1 bunch red cabbage | 2 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 3 tablespoons garlic and red chile paste | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Thoroughly wash and remove all green leaves from the cabbage. Rinse well in a sieve. Cut out the thick part of the center of the cabbage and discard. Cut out any hard part at the core. Slice the outer half thinly vertically. Slice the center half thinly crosswise. Repeat for each green and white layers. Heat the sesame oil in a saute pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and chile paste and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in the cabbage. Stir in the stock. Cover and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender.

title: Homemade Fresh Mousse With a Touch of PHILADELPHIA
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons pickling salt
instructions: Combine 2 teaspoons of salt and 2 tablespoons of cream in a bowl or serving bowl. Beat until cream is very cold.

title: Favourite Spanakopita (Spinach and Parsley Pesto)
ingredients: 4 -5 fresh spinach leaves | 4 - 5 tablespoons pesto ( or any flavour flavour or olive oil )
instructions: Wash and cut the spinach into little circles. Place the spinach in a clean tea towel and twist to form a bowl. Place 1 tablespoon of pesto/oil/oil mixture in the centre of your spinach circles. Fold the rounds around them until their shape is no longer stretched. Remove from tea towel with a knife and place in a warm oven. Heat up the remaining pesto/oil mixture and fry until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,flat leaf italian parsley,kielbasa,french bread,garbanzo bean
title: Soupa Domates Me Arais (Soupa Nairobi Bread and Garbanzo Beans)
ingredients: 1 pound garbanzo beans, split in half | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1 1/2 inch slices | 1 bunch flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup orange peel, chopped | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1-inch slices
instructions: Place the garbanzo beans, kielbasa, parsley, and orange peel in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,dijon mustard,adobo seasoning,star anise pod,white pepper,coconut,asafoetida powder
title: Nama's Spicy Breading
ingredients: 2 cups sifted powdered asafoetida powder | 1 star anise pod | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons red goya seasoning or 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 1 - 1 1/2 cup shredded coconut ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 pinch ground white pepper
instructions: Put all ingredients into a medium sized bowl, stirring in any extras you like, i use an electric stick spatula to put all the spices in while we are mixing. Once mixed together, it becomes easy to spread this on your bread, and it stays good and crunchy. It can also be stored in air tight container in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,chicken leg,peanut oil,angel hair pasta
title: Chinese Chicken Legs
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 kg chicken leg | 1/3 cup italian style breadcrumbs | 150 -300 g angel hair pasta
instructions: Heat up peanut oil in a pan until very hot. Dip chicken into breadcrumbs and fry until golden brown on all sides. Place on baking tray. Bake at 190 c for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,ricotta cheese,key lime juice,creamy peanut butter
title: Peanut Butter Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups creamy peanut butter | 1 cup quick-cooking oats, ground | 1 container ricotta cheese | 1 key lime, juice of
instructions: Cream together the cheese and peanut butter. Add the oats and blend until well blended. Pour mixture into a greased 15 1/2 x 10 cake pan. Pour key lime juice over it, and bake at 350°f for 40 - 45 minutes. Cool completely.

Random Ingredients: garlic herb spreadable cheese,cream,sauce,cheese,red pepper flake
title: Creamy Hot Dip
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese, softened | 1 cup shredded cheese | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 teaspoon dried garlic and herb spreadable cheese | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, blend together cream cheese, cheese hot sauce, garlic and herb spreadable cheese and the dried red pepper.

title: Yellow Zucchini
ingredients: 2 medium yellow zucchini or 2 medium yellow zucchini, about 8 -12 inches long | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1/8 inch wide strips. Bring 5 cups water to boil in large skillet. Place zucchini in saucepan of boiling water.

Random Ingredients: french bread,green cardamom pod,monterey jack pepper cheese,brown rice,white pepper
title: Crazy Good French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1/2 inch slices or | 1 loaf monterey jack pepper cheese, cut into 1 inch slices | 1 medium quantity brown rice | 3 green cardamom pods, split | 1/2 cup of good quality white pepper | 1 tablespoon brown rice, to sprinkle on slices when served
instructions: Boil approximately 20 minutes approximately, or approximately 15 minutes minimum until liquid has been almost evaporated. Remove cardamom pods and put rice in large mixing bowl. Pour 1/2 cup of hot liquid in and mix well. Dip french bread slices in liquid and place on cookie sheet. Top each slice with a layer of pepper jack cheese. Spread rice on top of pepper jack cheese. Sprinkle brown rice on top of rice. Cover with lid and place under broiler until the cheese is golden brown on top, approximately 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Pickled Pork Chops
ingredients: 3 large pork chops | 3 tablespoons pickling spice
instructions: In a shallow covered dish, sprinkle pork with pickling spice, adding more if desired. Cover and refrigerate 10 to 15 minutes, or refrigerate up to 3 days. Place chops on a wire rack with side of a 12 inch metal spatula or other heavy saucepan to drain off any excess liquid. Lightly oil the grill. When hot, place the chops on the rack, cover and cook 6 minutes on each side, or until they are cooked through.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,chipotle powder,lime wedge,tea,self rising cornmeal,coriander
title: Aussie BBQ Bread (Cookies)
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising cornmeal | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried hot tea | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon ground chipotle powder | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt ( i use garlic salt ) | 1/2 lime wedge, for rims ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 500ºf and lightly grease a baking sheet. Use a sturdy knife and push down on all four dough molds about 1/4 inch thick to fit the tin, if necessary, if using a muffin tin, or muffin tin. Measure all the dry ingredients into a small bowl and sprinkle the chipotle powder over the top. Stir well, then squish the bowl so that the chipotle powder and seasonings are blended inches. Spoon a little of the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Using a wooden spoon or your fingers, press the mixture down into the corners of the tin, to ensure it is evenly but evenly distributed. Sprinkle another pinch of seasoning on the top. Press back into the corners. This will ensure you have a uniformly sized loaf. Using a wet spoon press the sides down, allowing any air bubbles to escape. Place on the prepared baking sheet. Brush the tops with some of the lime juice if desired. This bread is meant to be just slightly moist, but not wet. Allow to sit at room temperature for about 20 minutes, but at least twenty minutes before baking if not before baking if it has been in your oven for about an hour, or overnight. If baking in a preheated 425f oven, bake for 15 - 18 minutes. It is ok to leave the door slightly ajar until a test toothpick comes out dry, but if you feel the bread is overcooked in a few minutes and you have slack muffins, it should have an ever so slight crunch to it when it is removed from the oven, which should take approximately 15 to 20 minutes. Cool on a rack. Cut into approximately 50 g slices. Note you may use any kind of bread for this bread.

title: Toothpick Wedges
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shells | 1 jar pitted kalamata olives | 1 package toothpicks, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lay out the pie shells on a baking sheet. Slice each in half horizontally and remove the pit. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of olives into each shell. Brush with some of the olive flavored olive oil. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the topping is browned. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rice vermicelli,picante sauce,lime,tarragon,golden raisin,tomato green chilies,olive oil
title: Santa Fe Picante Rice vermicelli
ingredients: 1 package rice vermicelli | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 2 limes, cut into wedges | 1/3 cup sliced ripe olives in oil
instructions: Place the rice vermicelli in a large resealable plastic bag, and close. Seal and shake to separate. Remove the rice vermicelli, and place into the bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade. Pulse until the noodles are finely chopped, about 20 pulses. Transfer the cooked noodles to a medium bowl, and stir in the picante sauce, raisins, sprigs of tarragon, tomatoes with chilies, and juice from 1/2 lime. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the noodles, and cook until heated through and the top is browned, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,orange zest,lettuce,cardamom pod,cardamom,sea salt black pepper,garbanzo bean,heavy cream
title: Chilled Chickpeas With Cardamom, Ginger and Garbanzos (Peshkounia)
ingredients: 1 cup dried garbanzo beans, picked over and rinsed | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons unsalted heavy cream | 1/4 cup fresh ginger or 1/4 cup garlic, minced | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 2 large cardamom pods, slightly crushed with a mortar and pestle | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( garnish )
instructions: If using fresh garbanzo beans, drain them and place them into a large pot with boiling water. Bring to a simmer and cover the pot. Set aside until they soften slightly, about 30 minutes. Uncover the pot and set aside. Place the cream and the garlic in a small saucepan and stir over medium heat until the garlic becomes fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add the oyster sauce, orange zest, orange juice and cardamom pods and bring the mixture to a simmer. When all of the ingredients are settled, add the garbanzo beans and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Stir the sauce and serve immediately.

title: Nana's Chocolate and Jelly Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup grated chocolate | 1/2 cup chopped jalapeno pepper | 1/2 cup chopped bread, dry toasted | 24 slices thin cut fresh bread
instructions: In a small bowl combine the ingredients. Cover and refrigerate until mixture is cold. Slice bread in half diagonally. Brush bread with the melted chocolate.

Random Ingredients: elbow macaroni,parmigiano reggiano cheese,gorgonzola,cooking oil,green bean,oat,cream mushroom soup
title: Garlic Oats With Gorgonzola Creamy Sauce #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated dried elbow macaroni | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking oil | 1 envelope gorgonzola, crumbles | 1/2 cup light cream of mushroom soup | 2 cups chopped green beans, cut in half | 1/2 cup finely shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in large saucepan of boiling water for 7 - 8 min or until just tender.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,chickpea,semolina,shoyu,cilantro leaf,tomato soup
title: Chickpea Chaat
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups semolina ( cracked wheat ) | 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 1 can condensed tomato soup ( undiluted ) | 1 tablespoon shoyu ( soy sauce ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons shoyu ( soy sauce ) | 3/4 teaspoon dried cilantro leaves, crushed
instructions: Place a nonstick skillet or wok over medium low heat, add 3 tablespoons of the vegetable oil. When the oil is hot but not smoking add the semolina and stir. Once the semolina begins to colour, gradually add all of the remaining ingredients, mixing well after each addition. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,red cabbage,chilies,artichoke heart,beef tenderloin steak,heavy cream,kidney bean,ice cube
title: Beef Tenderloin With Red Cabbage and Artichokes
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin steaks | 8 ounces enoki busi que chillies, thawed and peeled ( or any red bell peppers ) | 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 4 cups shredded red cabbage | 1/4 cup canned diced chilies | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup grated spanish onion | ice cube
instructions: Place steaks on a foil lined baking sheet.

title: Cabbage With Fish (Gado Gado)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 1 lb fish, preferably sea bass | salt | 1/2 cup green onion, finely chopped
instructions: Boil the fish in water for 15 minutes before removing from the heat. Take the fish out of the water, remove the skin in the fish meat, discard and strain the cooking water in pot. Chop the fish meat into small cubes if it is large. Clean the cabbage very finely. Place the cabbage in boiling water. Stir occasionally during the cooking time. The cabbage will begin to soften. When the cabbage is cooked, remove from the water. Remove any unctuous pieces of cabbage that have begun to crackle. Drain well. Place the fish pieces in a serving dish. Add the diced cabbage and chopped green onions to the fish meat and mix well. Serve at once.

title: Coriander and Tofu (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu | of fresh mint leaves ( roughly 2 teaspoons worth )
instructions: Roughly cut the tofu into half diagonally then roughly slice each in half again. The easiest way to do this is to break the tofu so it can be cut about two centimetre thick. It's easier and quicker to accomplish when it's all cut into square wedges rather than one long slice. It works fine to leave the edges of the tofu uncoated so they'll cook faster if you slice them too thickly they may break up while baking. Pour boiling water over the tofu in a strainer to remove excess water and gently pat dry. You might need to press the salt out of the water right before baking so it can drain while baking. Dredge a few pieces of tofu in salt and leave for 15 minutes. Arrange on plate, sprinkle generously with chopped mint leaves, and serve with dips, such as yoghurt and a lemon twist for squeezing over salads and vegetables. I have made this with yoghurt in the past and it was fine just not as creamy as the yoghurt.

title: Chicken with Dijon Sauce
ingredients: 7 large skinless chicken thighs, trimmed and cut into pieces | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1/2 cup dry marsala | 1 cup fresh bread, with crusts torn into pieces | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Melt butter in large dutch oven. Add chicken pieces and cook, turning and tossing with a wire whisk, until browned, about 5 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and deglaze the pan with marsala. Add bread, dill, and hot red pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,bay seasoning,purpose white flour,vanilla bean,miracle whip,sherry wine,raisin
title: Southwest Dream Food.
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon all-purpose white flour | 1 1/2 cups miracle whip | 1 can chopped green chilies,, drained | 1 cup raisins, soaked in a little water, drained and squeezed dry | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 cup green seeds ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle the flour on the plastic wrap and make sure it is coated all over the surface. Blend the miracle whip with a wire whisk in a microwave safe bowl at 100% power for 3 - 4 minutes. Stir until the sugar is mostly melted. Add the chopped green chilies, raisins, sherry and old bay, and mix until well combined, breaking up the chilies. Scrape onto the flour coated surface and turn until all the flour is absorbed. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Turn in morning and stir. Serve cold over cookies. May also use as topping for chips or other cookies.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,meat,serrano chile pepper,baking soda,mustard,pimento olive,cherry,fish fillet
title: Fish with Devil Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh fish fillets | 3/4 pound sliced meat | 3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1/4 cup pimento stuffed olive, diced | 12 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 serrano chile pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons dried mustard | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Rinse fish. Cut into four pieces. Place in a large skillet with the meat, eggs, olives, cherry tomatoes, garlic, chili pepper and mustard. Pour in the soda and bring to a boil. Cover and cook for 20 to 25 minutes, or until fish is cooked through and tomatoes are soft. Remove from heat, and allow to stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg wrap,corn oil,panko breadcrumb,green chilies,garbanzo bean,yogurt
title: Chi-Yogurt Fritters
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans | 1 can green chilies | 1 package egg roll wraps | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup corn oil | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Drain the garbanzo beans and chilies thoroughly to remove excess moisture. In a food processor, process the beans and chilies to fine puree. In a separate bowl, combine the panko, corn oil, and yogurt. Stir the mixture until smooth.

Random Ingredients: grape leaf,jicama,sherry wine,creole seasoning,dark soy sauce
title: Teriyaki Jicama Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 lb jicama | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce ( reduced sodium ) | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning ( or mccormick ) | 3 grape leaves
instructions: Boil jicama, in salted water until tender, drain and pat dry with paper towels. Cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Mix remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Spread a small amount of the mixture into each grape leaf, then insert each piece of jicama into the center. Roll from the stem. Secure with toothpicks. Cook at 350°f for 5 minutes. Serve with teriyaki sauce.

title: Taste of India  (Savory Indian Creamy Butter for Chicken)

instructions: In a food processor, pulse the butter until the pieces are pea size and form a fine paste. Mix in the cream of tartar and ground coriander.

title: Pork Sausage Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups cooked linguine | 4 ounces pork sausage, cooked
instructions: Heat a large frying pan on medium, medium high. Cook sausage until cooked through. Drain. Transfer sausage to a small bowl and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add linguine and stir to break it up a bit.

Random Ingredients: linguine,raspberry jam,cake flour,cashew butter,chicken breast fillet,black bean,fennel seed
title: BBQ Chicken With Rice-Berry Jam Sauce

instructions: Put one cup of cashew butter in a pan over medium heat and let it melt. Dip chicken into flour mixture and fry in pan, turning over once, for about 5 minutes, or until golden crispy. Put a few tablespoons of jam on top and serve with rice or pasta.

title: Cranberry Glaze

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar. Shake well and strain to clean jar. Pour mixture into a glass jar or resealable food storage plastic bag and refrigerate overnight.

instructions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together.

instructions: Heat coconut milk to boiling in small saucepan.

title: Tomato and Guacamole Salad
ingredients: 10 large ripe italian tomatoes ( cored, seeded & cut in quarters ) | 1 -2 serrano pepper, stemmed, seeded & minced | 1/2 cup enoki mushrooms ( canned ) | 1/3 cup diced romano lettuce | 1/4 cup shredded vidalia onion or 1/4 cup pickled italian tomatoes | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed ( toasted ) | 1 tablespoon shortening ( optional ) | 1/4 cup prepared guacamole | radish, washed, dried & cut into small curls
instructions: Place the tomatoes in a saucepan & add hot water to cover. Reduce heat & simmer 15 minutes or until tomatoes are soft enough to slice. Remove & drain. In a medium bowl, layer the tomatoes, peppers, enoki mushrooms, onion, cardamom & 1/4 cup of onion mixture. Stir. Melt shortening on medium heat & add remaining onions, stirring. title: Parsley Glaze
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Combine the dried parsley and mirin in a small nonreactive pan over low heat. Bring to a simmer while stirring. Boil until reduced by about half. Stir parsley mixture, and return to a simmer.

title: Green Chile Cheese Filling

instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix shredded cheese, cracker crumbs, 1 teaspoon onion flakes, savory, vinegar, and ground red pepper. Spoon mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover dish with foil. Bake in preheated oven until filling has risen and the top is golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Steamed Fenugreek Mussels and Vegetables

instructions: Prepare grill. Wash mussels under cold running water.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,dark chocolate,chickpea,puff pastry,egg beater substitute,milk
title: Chickpea and Cheese Stuffed Parcels
ingredients: 2 cups frozen puff pastry, thawed ( use ready made, thawed dough recipe # 171058 or make your own, see tip ) | 1 cup reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup egg substitute or 1/2 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1/2 cup low-fat milk | 1/3 cup chickpeas, cooked drained and mashed ( canned or cooked plain ) | 1/4 cup dark chocolate, grated ( see tip )
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat broiler to high, set your oven rack at least 6 inches from the heat source. Place the pastry shells on a baking sheet and lightly grease the tops and bottoms of the parcels with pan spray or oil. Bake on lower rack. Combine cheese and egg substitute in a small bowl. Place cheese mixture in a large bowl. Add chickpeas and cheese mixture, whisk to combine. Add milk and chocolate, whisk to combine. Fill each uncooked pastry shell with the cheese mixture. Top each filled pastry with shredded cheese. Place parcels on a baking sheet and lightly spray tops and bottoms of the parcels with pan spray or oil. Broil in top half of oven until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove pan spray or oil from the pan and turn parcels over. Spread reserved cheese mixture over parcels and serve.

title: Moules à La Vanille

instructions: Slice avocado in half lengthwise and remove avocado pit. Remove shell with a fork. Cut avocados lengthwise in half. Cut avocado sections into pieces so that no membrane remains attached to the skin and leave as is for both pieces. You should end up with four very pretty avocados. Cut avocado flesh into 6 slices and arrange along the skin on a platter. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over avocado pieces. Let stand covered until ready to serve.

title: Hot Chipotle Salsa
ingredients: 1 canned chipotle chile, minced | 1 tablespoon kosher salt
instructions: Place the chiles in a blender and puree until smooth. Add the chipotle puree and salt to taste. This salsa can also be prepared by soaking a couple of dried chiles in hot water for about 20 minutes and rinsing them in a clean kitchen towel. You can also use canned chipotle puree.

title: Cafe Con Capperi Caffe (Cafe Con Caffe)
ingredients: 1 cup prepared hot coffee, cooled slightly | 3 1/2 cups cauliflower florets
instructions: Spoon coffee into a medium bowl and add cauliflower. Toss to make sure cauliflower stays coated and stir again.

instructions: In a very large bowl, combine meat, beans, pesto, carrots and polenta and mix well. Spoon mixture into a 1 gallon ziplock freezer bag.

instructions: Place roast in crock pot and cover with tomatoes. Add bouillon, bouillon cubes, olives, and icing sugar on top of meat. Cover crockpot and set on low setting for at least 8 hours or on warm setting for up to 1 day. Remove roast and discard bones if any, chop meat and serve.

title: Baked Scallops

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the scallops in a lightly buttered baking dish.

title: Elswet's Mexican Dip

instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix all the ingredients together except swiss and place on an empty shallow baking dish. Bake about 15 minutes till the cheese is browned.

title: BBQ Beef Curry - Crock Pot or Oven (Cooking Light)

instructions: Place all ingredients, except the meat, in a large crockpot or oven safe casserole dish. Add 1 cup water or chicken stock. title: Spaghetti Sauce I

instructions: Cook quinoa. Place quinoa in pot on stovetop. Spray quinoa with olive oil if using. Pour tomato sauce over quinoa. Cover, bring to a boil on low then allow to rest until you are done.

title: Italian Roast Beef in Parsley
ingredients: 4 tablespoons extra-lean ground beef | 4 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, minced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 f.
