title: Cheater's Mexican Shells W-Egg-N-Sugar-Cocoa
ingredients: 12 ounces shell pasta, cooked and drained | 2 cups shredded zesty yellow jicama | 12 egg whites | 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons dry salsa | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/4 cup melted unsweetened cocoa | 3 egg yolks | 1/2 cup shredded cocoa | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Toss pasta with zesty yellow jicama. Set aside. Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually beat in 4 tablespoons cocoa, 2 tablespoons dry salsa, and taco seasoning. Spread into ungreased 13x9 metal loaf pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes. Remove from oven and cool 1 hour. Beat egg yolks, cocoa, and sugar until thick & light in color. Pour over cooled pasta, and stir to coat well. Return to oven to bake 10 - 12 minutes longer until bubbly.

title: Tuna on Herb Crusted Tuna
ingredients: 50 g fromage frais ( thick bread ) | 400 g tuna, in water ( preferably free-range )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c. To make the herb crusted tuna, break the bread into small pieces with a rolling pin, if you have one, with a rolling pin. Use the rolling pin to flatten it slightly. Spread them out flat, ideally on baking parchment or baking paper. Place them on a baking tray and cook for 4 - 5 minutes, or until they are just beginning to brown, turn and roast on other side. The idea is not to smoosh up the garlic but to make it smoother. Tip the tuna onto a hot, dry baking tray and, using a metal spoon, push the bread in as many places as you can. Sprinkle the tuna with salt and black pepper and then drizzle over the fromage frais and scatter with the dried herb. Roast for another five or six minutes, depending on how well done you like your tuna. Serve straight away with a salad and garlic bread.

title: Rosemary Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/3 cup gravy mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed dried rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix gravy mix with rosemary and toss chicken in casserole dish. Cover with tomato sauce. Bake at 350 degrees f for 75 minutes, or until done.

Random Ingredients: citron,salmon,green chili pepper,red chili pepper,shallot,purpose flour,hamburger,stevia
title: Stevia Crusted Salmon
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup stevia | 1 1/2 lbs fresh salmon, chopped ( i use the skinless, boneless, skinless fillets ) | 3 ounces hamburger, finely chopped | 1/4 cup diced cooked ham or 1/4 cup crumbled cooked turkey | 1 cup chopped green chili pepper, with seeds | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 1/2 cup slivered candied citron
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Line a parchment lined baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray both sides with cooking spray. Whisk the flour, stevia, and pepper together. Add the salmon and mix with your hands until the ingredients are evenly distributed. Stir in the hamburger. Shape the dough with your hands into 24 large, 5 ounce balls. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray and arrange the seasoned salmon balls in a single layer, seam side down. Cover with aluminum foil and then bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove foil and return to oven, and bake for another 10 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with maple syrup or a dollop of sour cream.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,cooking sherry,navy bean,black bean,green bean,corn oil,orange blossom water,dill weed
title: White Bean & Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried navy beans | 1 lb small green beans | 1/2 lb small black beans | corn oil, for frying | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh dill weed | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried orange blossom water or 2 1/2 tablespoons orange jell olek | 1 tablespoon coriander powder ( cilantro ) | 1 -2 tablespoon quick-cooking sherry
instructions: Cover beans with cold water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until beans are just tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and rinse beans in cool water. Remove and discard strings. Wash, trim, and cut greens into 1 inch pieces. Place beans and green beans in a large bowl. Toss greens together with dill and orange blossom water. Add coriander and sherry.

title: Aussie Mistake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons triple sec | 6 red chilies, sliced into rings | 1 cup white sugar | 1 teaspoon sweetened mint sauce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix triple sec, red chilies, and sugar in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,vanilla extract,pork shoulder
title: Baked Pork Shoulder
ingredients: 8 lbs pork shoulder | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Spray counter lightly with veggie spray. Cut pork shoulder into 1 1/2 to 2 pieces, about 4” x 4”. Arrange pieces in single layer on lightly floured surface and pat dry with paper towels. Spread 1 teaspoon vanilla over each piece and with back of spoon push with fingertips to pierce several places for steam to escape. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray racks with veggie spray and place in shallow roasting pan. Cover and cook in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven, remove cover and continue to roast until internal temperature reaches 145f. Remove from oven and let stand for 15 minutes. Transfer meat to platter and cool for 20 minutes. Trim fat from surface of pork and use fork to pull meat apart into shreds. Serve with warm maple syrup or vanilla honey. Makes 6 servings. Note, you may also use ham or other smoked meat, but not pork. If you prefer, you can use pork that has been thinly sliced, but has already been sliced.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,coffee,phyllo dough,olive,pea pod,taco seasoning mix,rib,poblano pepper
title: Mexican Flag Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 3 ears fresh roasted garlic, pierced all over with a skewer | 1 cup frozen whole pea pods | 3/4 cup diced zucchini | coarsely shredded taco seasoning mix, and other desired amount | 8 sheets round prepared phyllo dough, thawed | 12 ounces country-style ground round, cooked, drained, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place peas, garlic, pea pods, and zucchini in a large bowl, and sprinkle generously with taco seasoning. Add cheese and 1/4 cup cold water.

title: Boil Water for Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white wine ( use a non alcoholic wine, if possible ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( use kosher seasoning if ya got it )
instructions: Open the bottle of wine and add the bottle of wine, seasoning salt and water. Stir thoroughly to mix. Put into a glass jar, cover and refrigerate at least overnight.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,crisp bacon,orange wedge,lettuce,monterey jack cheese,almond,icing sugar
title: Chicken Wings With Orange Crumble and Almonds
ingredients: 1 whole chicken wings, split at joint | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 4 slices crisp bacon, chopped | 8 ounces of grated monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely shredded sweet orange slices | 1 cup toasted almonds | 4 toasted sliced almonds | 8 lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a shallow 1 litre loaf tin with foil. Place the wings in a large roasting pan and sprinkle with 4tbsp of caster sugar. Heat a large frying pan over a medium heat and cook the chicken wings for 3 - 4 minutes each side or until golden. Remove from pan and toss with 2 tbsp of the shredded cheese, the bacon and orange slices. Divide between 2 serving plates. Arrange the rest of the orange and cheese over the chicken and sprinkle with remaining 1tbsp of shredded cheese. Place on a griddle or baking tray and top with the almonds and 1/3 of the almonds. Cook under the grill for 5 - 6 minutes until golden brown and heated through. Stand for 5 minutes, sprinkle with remaining toasted almonds and serve with a toasted slice of orange.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,gouda cheese,orange peel,baking potato,marinara sauce,carrot,corn tortilla
title: Roasted Grilled Veggie Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 lb grated smoked gouda cheese or 1/2 lb grated monterey jack cheese | 16 ounces marinara sauce | 2 large baking potatoes, cut into wedges | 2 medium carrots, shaved | 2 teaspoons finely grated orange peel | 2 teaspoons saffron threads or 1 teaspoon turmeric | 16 soft corn tortillas | saffron threads, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Position oven rack in middle and set broiler on high. Place potatoes and carrots in a large bowl, toss with 1 1/4 cups marinara and set aside while preparing remaining marinara dish. Place remaining 1/4 cup marinara on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with orange peel and saffron. Broil, turning once until crisp and golden and browned on all sides. Transfer to a large mixing bowl. Heat remaining 1 1/2 cups marinate in pan over medium heat until hot but not simmering, about 3 minutes. Arrange potatoes in prepared pan, brush with half the remaining marinate and top with 1 cup of the grated chees. Broil about 3 minutes or until cheese is toasted and bubbly. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and season with additional marinate and orange peel. Serve with tortillas, saffron and warm marinara.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,salt pepper,chocolate chip,chipotle chile adobo,ginger,lemon lime beverage
title: Crock Pot Lamb Chops
ingredients: 2 large lamb chops | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 jar lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage | salt and pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. In a skillet heat and brown chops well on both sides. Serve with the lemon lime beverage.

title: Stuffed Eggs - Tapas
ingredients: 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 2 tablespoons green bell peppers, roasted ( mild )
instructions: Slit the hard boiled egg lengthwise and scrape out the yolks. Discard the shells and the pulp or leave a shell of some egg white on the egg white to keep filling intact. Heat a lightly oiled griddle, medium hot, or a non stick one, until the bottom starts to smoke. Turn egg over and, when the top is very well browned and firm, remove the egg from the grill using a slotted spoon. Brush the skins off the egg yolks, leaving the whites in one piece. Arrange a tablespoon of the nuts in the center of each sunny egg. Put an egg yolk back on to keep warm, and spoon a teaspoonful of the filling into each egg yolk hole.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,raspberry vinegar,coriander seed,breadcrumb,grain white rice
title: Coriander Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 1/8 cups raspberries vinegar or 1 1/8 cups white wine vinegar | 225 g rice | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 225 g breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: Place raspberries or wine vinegar in a non metallic bowl. Cover and heat in the microwave for 40 seconds on high, stirring halfway through. Allow to cool. Stir the rice, coriander seeds and breadcrumbs into the cooled vinegar. Shape in 20 small balls. Heat the oil in a nonstick frying pan and cook the rice balls until they are golden brown. Serve while still warm.

title: Pumpkin and Ground Nut Tortilla
ingredients: 8 slices margarine or 8 slices butterflied ham | 1 can pumpkin pie spice | 1 cup low-fat sour cream | 1 cup light cream | 1 cup chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons chopped hazelnuts | 1 1/2 cups cranberries, chopped
instructions: Spread each slice of margarine or with the ham evenly over the bottom of a 9 x12 oven proof dish. Spread pumpkin pie spice over the ham. Combine sour cream, light cream, pecans, hazelnuts, and cranberries. Spread mixture over the ham. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes. Cut into squares and serve warm.

title: Kiwi Cheese
ingredients: 500 g shortcrust pastry | 200 ml whole milk | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 4 kiwi fruits | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon
instructions: Place the milk, yeast and kiwifruit in a bowl. Stir and leave for 10 minutes. Roll out the pastry on a floured work surface and place in a 30cm x 30cm swiss roll tin. Cover with your prepared kiwifruit mixture and sprinkle with tarragon. Cover and leave in a warm place to rise for about 2 hours or until it has doubled in size. Preheat the oven to 180c. Place the pastry on a baking tray or an oven shelf. Cut slits in the top of the pastry using a sharp knife and brush with a little melted butter during the cooking. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,half,chickpea,ra el hanout spice mix,italian breadcrumb,orange liqueur
title: Crispy Potato Patties - Zwt-8
ingredients: 1 kg baking potato | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/2 cup ras el hanout spice mix | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup orange-flavored liqueur | 375 ml half-and-half
instructions: Bake potato in a very large pan until tender. Cool slightly, then peel and mash well, with the ras el hanout, italian seasoning, bread crumbs and the orange liqueur. Using a wooden spoon, mix in the half and half, and mash with a potato masher. Add 1/2 cup more water if mixture is too dry. Add more water if mixture starts to dry out. Shape dough into 20 patties and fry in vegetable oil until crispy & golden, turning regularly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: basil,cherry,grain white rice,graham cracker crumb,italian sausage,chili pepper,bacon
title: Rice and Chili Sausage Bake
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 8 ounces uncooked long grain white rice | 6 slices bacon, cooked, drained and chopped | 1 fresh chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1 jar canned whole cherries, drained | 2 crusty graham crackers or 2 pieces rye bread, crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook sausage with salt in large skillet over medium heat until no longer pink, stirring to crumble. Drain.

title: Fideo Con Fideo
ingredients: 1 jar fideos | 1 cup whole milk | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 red chili pepper, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling salted water, cook the fideo until tender and al dente, 4 minutes. Drain and set aside. Bring the milk to a boil. Remove from the heat. Place half of the fideo in a food processor with orange zest, chili and orange juice. Puree until smooth. Heat 2 to 3 tablespoons of milk and half of the hot milk until simmering.

title: Scallops with Cracked Sea Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed sea scallops | 1 1/2 pounds medium sea scallops | 1 quart water, or as needed
instructions: Pick through the sea scallops. Set aside. Crush the sea scallops in a clean dry saute pan, using a meat tenderizing hammer to pound out sand. Set aside. Fill a large pot with as much water as you can and bring to a boil. Add the cracked sea scallops, and return to a boil. Simmer until scallops are just opaque and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon, and allow to drain on paper towels. Toss the scallops back in your hand with salt.

title: Nigella's Tortellini
ingredients: 1/2 kg fresh tortellini or 1/2 kg tortellini | 3 -4 anchovy fillets | 1 can plum ( canned ) | 2 celery ribs | 1 pinch turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon nigella seeds ( optional )
instructions: Start your boil and boil tortellini according to pkg instructions. Then add anchovies and celery to the pot while the tortellini is cooking. Cook tortellini in boiling water till slightly underdone. When all has been cooked place in casserole dish. Pour the anchovies and celery over the tortellini. Finally sprinkle the nigella and turmeric over the tortellini. You may add any optional ingredients and/or herbs that you may like. We like to stir every so often. Cook till bubbly.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,jalapeno chile,thai chili sauce,turmeric,red leaf lettuce,milk chocolate chip,coke
title: Spicy Cheddar-Chili Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 cup milk chocolate chips ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon coconut milk | 1 -2 teaspoon jalapeno chili ( to taste ) | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce hot coffee | 1/2 teaspoon jalapeno chile ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce ( or to taste ) | 12 leaves red leaf lettuce, cut into 2-inch pieces ( leaves separated ) | 1 dash turmeric
instructions: Place chocolate chips in a large microwave safe bowl. Microwave, uncovered, and on high 4 minutes, stirring 1 to 2 times or until melted and smooth. Stir in coconut milk, jalapeno, chili sauce, or coffee until well blended. Add 2 or 3 lettuce leaves to chocolate chip mixture. Place remaining lettuce on a board, and drizzle with turmeric. Working with a lettuce leaf, fill with 2 tablespoons sauce and lay in a small circle on the lettuce. Using the lettuce leaves, drizzle remaining sauce over lettuce.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,russet potato,apple juice,mustard,vegetable juice,emmenthaler cheese,ladyfinger
title: Crazy French Potato Cheese
ingredients: 1 can vegetable juice | 1 can fruit-flavored juice ( do not use pineapple juice or apple juice ) | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 14 ounces shredded emmenthaler cheese | 7 ounces shredded russet potatoes | 1 1/2 ounces sliced fresh pineapple in juice | 5 ladyfingers, cut into 8 pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f, and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large metal bowl, combine all the juices and the mustard.

title: Grilled Salt Cod Fish
ingredients: 5 pounds salt cod fish, rinsed well | 2 cups ice cubes
instructions: Score the skin of salt cod on both sides using a sharp knife. Score the skin between the knife and the knife. Place the fish in a large, heavy glass or ceramic dish. Pour 1 cup ice cubes into the glass. Lay the cod skin side down on top of the ice to absorb the ice, then cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 6 hours, then drain. The skin will be bubbly, but the fish will firm as it marinates. Wrap the fish with plastic wrap or toothpicks. Place it in a large resealable plastic bag to marinate for 24 to 36 hours. About 10 to 12 minutes before the cod is done, preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil the grate. Remove the fish from the bag, and set aside. Turn the fish over on the hot grill. Close the lid of the grill, and continue to cook until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Do not overcook the fish. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving. Transfer the fish onto a serving platter, and sprinkle the cod with salt, if desired. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,alfredo sauce,velveeta cheese,goat cheese,sea salt,chicken bouillon granule,sesame seed,filling
title: Honduran Chicken (Copycat)
ingredients: 9 ounces goat cheese, crumbled | 8 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into small cubes | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 pinch coarse sea salt | 10 ounces alfredo sauce | 4 ounces sesame seeds | 3 serrano peppers, stemmed, seeded, and diced ( wear rubber gloves for authenticity! ) | 1 tablespoon pasteurized horseradish sauce
instructions: Pulse all the ingredients together until chunky, but not mushy. Store in air tight containers or refrigerate before use. Keeps indefinitely. Bring to room temperature before use. Makes about 1/2 cup.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,gruyere cheese,sherry wine,shortcrust pastry,hot chili powder
title: Chile, Serrano and Gruyere Crust Tarts
ingredients: 150 g shortcrust pastry ( homemade or frozen ) | 1 small serrano pepper | 150 g gruyere cheese | 1 pinch hot chili powder | 1 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c/180°c roll out pastry to a 5 cm / 5 mm / 2” thickness. Line a 5 cm / 1” / 1” / 12” / 12” baking tin with pastry. Trim the ends to make a lattice effect. Trim the top of the serrano and discard any seeds and membrane. Cut the pepper into thin semi circles and put on two baking paper lined trays. Wash and dry the pepper. Cut the cheese into 4 equal parts and place in a bowl with the peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of chili powder and mix until the cheese has the texture of coarse breadcrumbs. Dip each pastry slice into the crumbs, coating evenly. Place in the oven for 5 minutes or until the breadcrumb mixture has dried to the touch but is still moist inside. Remove from the oven and leave to stand for 5 minutes. Transfer slices to a wire rack to cool. Cut each slice into 6 triangles and serve.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,ra el hanout spice mix,dark rum,whipping cream,chipotle chile adobo,green chili pepper
title: Ranch Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons saffron thread ( moroccan salt ) | 3 -4 chipotle chiles in adobo | 2 -4 green chili peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1/4 cup whipping cream ( optional )
instructions: Place the saffron threads in a dry saute pan. Using a pestle, pulverize the chilies. Do not overheat. Add the chilies and continue to cook over medium heat. Add the ginger and the rum to the chilies. Continue to cook. Stir frequently for 15 minutes so that all the flavors blend until the chilies soften and begin to darken. Stir in the cream. Remove from the heat. Cover and refrigerate until firm.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,summer squash,pig foot,caster sugar,lime,orange bell pepper,fennel,passion fruit
title: Grilled Vege, Sweet and Sour Sticky Grilled Pig's Feet
ingredients: 2 lbs pig feet | 4 1/2 ounces italian sausage | 8 ounces orange sweet bell peppers or 8 ounces yellow bell peppers | 6 tablespoons caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 1 grated lime | 1 fennel, bulb only | 1 cup passion fruit | 2 tablespoons ground summer squash
instructions: Preheat your grill. Score the top of your pig feet and insert a knife in each part of the foot, stretching them around in a sawing motion, making sure the bones do not touch the flesh of the pig feet. If there are any protruding pieces of fat on the feet, dampen them with 2 teaspoons of sugar and brush the outside of the feet lightly with this mixture. Place the pig feet on the skin side of a chopping board.

Random Ingredients: double cream,white chocolate,green olive,spiral pasta,hot italian sausage,jalapeno pepper
title: White Chocolate Pasta
ingredients: 500 g spiral shaped pasta | 100 g jalapeno peppers | 100 g white chocolate | 200 ml double cream | 100 g green olives, stoned and chopped | 200 g hot italian sausage, finely sliced
instructions: In a large saucepan cover spaghetti with cold water and bring to the boil. Reduce heat, add the chili and cook for approx 5 minutes, drain and set aside. In a small saucepan melt the chocolate over a low heat. Add the cream to the chocolate, stirring it until smooth, remove from heat and set aside. Strain the pasta, add hot cream and stir to combine. Gently stir through the chopped olives and sausage, return to the heat and stir well. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary, reheat, then serve. Note, the pasta may still be quite cold. Pour the sauce over and mix to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Pesto Enchiladas
ingredients: 3/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 package dry enchilada mix | 1 lemon, juiced | 1 shallot, minced | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine pesto sauce, enchilada mix, lemon juice, shallot, mango chutney and vanilla. Scoop about 1/3 of the prepared pesto/chutney mixture into each of the warmed tortillas while still warm. Roll tortillas up, place seam side down in the prepared 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour remaining pesto/chutney mixture over tortillas. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned. Serve topped with remaining pesto/chutney mixture.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,clove,vanilla sugar,jalapeno pepper,filet beef,halibut fillet,yeast
title: Spicy Danish Fish
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crushed tomatoes ( canned works fine ) | 2 teaspoons yeast | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 1/2 lbs halibut fillets, cut into 6 fillets | 1 1/2 tablespoons pickled jalapeno peppers, finely chopped ( or less according to your taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 4 cups of lukewarm water. Combine the crushed tomatoes with 1 cup of the vanilla sugar, the turmeric and the remaining 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar. Coat fish fillets with 3 tablespoons of the diluted mixture and cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 and 1/2 hours. Spray nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat a griddle or fry pan to medium high heat. In batches, sear fish on both sides and sprinkle evenly with jalapeno pepper, taking care not to burn the spice. Bake fish in the skillet on a parchment lined baking sheet for 15 minutes, or until fish is cooked through. Serve with remaining sauce and a greek salad.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,club soda,egg noodle,tilapia fillet,plum sauce,spinach leaf,fish stock,salt pepper
title: Cioppino
ingredients: 20 ounces fresh, flat-leaf spinach leaves | 1 lb tilapia fillets | salt and pepper | 1 cup plum sauce, divided | 2 eggs, beaten | club soda, for topping | 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved or diced | 1/2 cup fish stock
instructions: Wash spinach in cold water, drain, and squeeze out excess moisture. Rinse, pat dry, and cut in ½ inch pieces. Cut each tilapia fillet into 12 slices on a bias, then cross cut down the center of each slice. Place in large dish and season with salt and pepper. Combine plum sauce, 1 cup plum sauce, beaten eggs, and club soda and pour over fish. Mix to coat fish with sauce. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 1 hour. Drain spinach and squeeze out excess water. Serve with bread. Garnish with tomatoes and sautéed spinach.

title: Glamorgan Gnocchi (Rocket Gnocchi)
ingredients: 1 kg raw fresh gnocchi | 1/4 cup golden syrup
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to the boil over high heat. Add a little sunflower oil and a handful or two of gorganchi to the water and boil to the tender gnocchi. Do not press the gnocchi through a strainer. Once all the gnocchi has been cooked, drain the gnocchi well and return them to the boiling water. Allow gnocchi to sit for a few moments to loosen the gnocchi then divide among serving plates. Garnish with fresh herbs and shaved parmesan cheese.

title: Chunky Grilled Squash
ingredients: 2 medium squash, about 3 pounds | 2 tablespoons bottled habanero sauce, divided | 5 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley, divided
instructions: Cut 1 large unpeeled squash lengthwise into 1/2 inch thick slices.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,coleslaw mix,chicken thigh,walnut,bean paste
title: Chinese Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces chicken thigh bones ( the chicken meat, and or skinned ) | 1/2 cup walnut pieces | 1/4 cup fresh flat leaf parsley | 3 tablespoons coleslaw mix | 1 tablespoon bean paste
instructions: Cook chicken in a large pot of boiling water until cooked through. Remove from heat and allow to cool 5 minutes. Cool and discard bone and skin. When chicken is cool, shred using two forks. Place walnuts in a large bowl, and add the parsley, coleslaw mix and bean paste. Toss with the cooked chicken. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,baby carrot,vegetable bouillon granule,corn oil,red onion
title: Tomato Stir Fry
ingredients: 4 red onions, sliced | 4 baby carrots, sliced into chunks | 2 cans tomato sauce | 3 teaspoons vegetable bouillon granules | 4 teaspoons corn oil
instructions: In a large skillet or wok, combine the onions, carrots, tomato sauce, vegetable bouillon, and corn oil. Simmer on low for 10 minutes, then serve over white rice.

title: Chinese Five Spice Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted pumpkin seeds | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds ( dark )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250. Heat the seeds on a baking tray in the oven for about 1 hour, until they begin to smell. Remove seeds from the oven and leave the seeds for approx 10 minutes, to help remove the saltiness. Pour the seeds onto a greased baking tray and cook for 10 - 15 minutes, until fragrant.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,almond extract,dark molasses,peanut oil,chicken bouillon granule,blue cheese,romaine lettuce,pepperoni
title: Italian-Style Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 pound bleached all-purpose flour | 1 cup dark molasses | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon granules | 1 cup peanut oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons pepperoni, chopped | 4 cups chopped romaine lettuce | 4 ounces crumbled blue cheese | 1 teaspoon almond extract, or to taste
instructions: Mix flour, brown sugar, molasses, chicken bouillon sauce, peanut oil, pepperoni, and 1/2 cup romaine lettuce in a large bowl. Gradually stir the cheese into the dressing.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,self raising flour,corn kernel,potato starch,lime zest,chorizo sausage,lamb cutlet,soya sauce
title: Moroccan Curried Lamb Cutlets
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb cutlets | 2 1/2 tablespoons minced chorizo sausage | 1 tablespoon corn kernel | 1 tablespoon plain self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1 tablespoon potato starch
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place lamb cutlets in single layer in oiled, shallow, non stick frypan and cook over medium high heat for 3 - 4 minutes each side or until browned. Place on serving plate and cover loosely with foil. Add chorizo and cook for 5 minutes. Add corn, flour, lime zest, garam masala, soya sauce and potato starch.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,yellow pepper,balsamic vinegar,hoisin sauce,rom tomato lengthwise,cider vinegar
title: Chinese Barbecue Sweet and Sour Vegetables
ingredients: 2 sweet yellow peppers | 1 medium roma tomato, quartered lengthwise | 1 tablespoon aged balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons apple juice or 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high. Cut the sweet peppers in half lengthwise, remove most of the seeds, cut into 1/4 inch slices crosswise and place into a bowl. Add the tomato quarters, and toss to coat. Whisk together the vinegar, hoisin sauce and balsamic vinegar, drizzle over the veggies and toss to coat. If the mixture is a bit runny, add more vinegar. If it is too thick, add more apple juice or vinegar. Grill the veggies until they are hot and glazed, 10 to 15 minutes basting once with the barbecue sauce.

title: Mandarin-Nestle
ingredients: 1 large ripe mandarin orange | 1 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons chopped unsalted dill pickle oil ( anejo ) or 2 tablespoons sweet wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon whole anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon whole cloves
instructions: Peel peel by placing between layers of paper towels. Cut peel into chunks of approximately the size of the mandarin orange if using buttermilk. Remove all the white pith with a thin knife. Place peel into the buttermilk. Add remaining ingredients and whisk until mixed well. Cover and refrigerate for at least two hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,pepper,lemongrass,green pepper,red enchilada sauce,alfredo sauce,guinness stout
title: Lite Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 10 ounces light sour cream and mushroom soup | 1 bottle red enchilada sauce | 8 ounces alfredo sauce | 12 ounces guinness stout | 2 tablespoons fresh lemongrass, chopped | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to combine sour cream and mushroom soup with one and half cup of enchilada sauce, stir until no lumps form. Transfer mixture into a 2 - 5 qt. Pan and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring once. Remove from heat and stir in remaining enchilada sauces and guinness. Cover and refridgerate for one hour. Meanwhile cook green pepper in a little olive oil and lemongrass in a little butter and salt until onion is tender. Add green pepper and remaining cheese, cover and bake at 350f for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring twice. Serve enchiladas on a platter with a mixture of sour cream mixture and guinness sauce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,sugar cube,french onion,bacon,extra virgin olive oil,spaghetti,yeast,honey
title: Abbey's Pizza

instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast & sugar in the warm water. Let it set for 2 - 3 minutes or so. Add the oil, anchovy paste & honey. Mix well, then cover & let rise for about 45 minute, or until doubled in size. For oven, heat oven to 450 degrees. Add spaghetti to a large bowl & mist with a bit of olive oil if your oven is hot. While hot, spread a slice of bacon on top of the pizza ~ cover & let bake an additional 5 - 10 minutes. Remove from oven & allow it to rest for 10 minutes. Cut into small ~6 pieces & serve.

Random Ingredients: veal,serrano pepper,strawberry,superfine sugar,green bell pepper,sun tomato

instructions: Combine sun dried tomatoes, strawberries, 1/4 cup chopped green bell pepper and serrano pepper in a bowl. Season with sugar and gently mix. Sprinkle with remaining bell pepper and half of the grated sun dried tomatoes. Shape into four patties. Cook over hot but not boiling water, turning, until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side. Serve hot.

title: Tahousek (African Shredded Fish)

instructions: In a blender, combine coconut juice, broth, and lime juice. Pulse until liquid is smooth but not smooth.

title: Green Curry

instructions: Mix all with a mixer. Serve immediately or cool.

title: Sassy Guacamole! It's so Easy and Tasty!

instructions: Mix the garam masala and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Add the chopped thyme and mix well. Serve in an airtight container. It will keep for up to a month. If using in a dish, this should be served with indian food stores.

title: Chayote and Turnip Stuffing (Savory)
ingredients: 1 large fresh chayote ( preferably red chayote ) | 1 small turnip | 8 ounces french bread, coarsely chopped | 4 ounces turnips | 1 cup tomato puree | 1 tablespoon cornstarch, mixed with | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Cut off the top and bottom of the chayote and turnip.

title: Cream Cheese Peaches
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1 cup sliced black olives | 1/2 cup sliced canned peach halves, drained | 2 tablespoons madras curry powder, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Layer cream cheese, black olives, peach slices, and Madras curry powder together in a baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until cream cheese is bubbling around the edges, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mashed Swiss Chard with Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 bunch swiss chard, leaves only, rinsed and chopped | 1 pinch herbes de provence | 1 1/4 cups low-fat cottage cheese | 1/4 cup canned pinto beans | 1/2 cup freshly squeezed broth | 2 large eggs, lightly beaten
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium low heat. Add chard.

title: Pork Tenderloin Fajitas
ingredients: 1/2 pound pork tenderloin | 1 cup prepared sweet chili sauce | 1 can sweet papayas, drained | 1 package yellow cake mix | 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 package baby portobello mushroom caps | 2 cups shredded carrots | 1 package sliced lettuce leaves | 4 puffy taco-size plastic wrap, halved
instructions: Trim excess fat from tenderloin. Cut tenderloin into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place tenderloin in a large resealable plastic bag.

title: Nuoc Cham
ingredients: 500 ml coffee ice cream | 1 tablespoon chili paste
instructions: Pour the ice cream into a bowl and pour 2 tablespoons of the chili paste on top. Scoop into small bowls.

title: Spinach and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/2 cup frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 ancho chile, seeded and chopped, seeds removed | 1/2 cup torn fresh basil | 1/2 cup torn fresh basil
instructions: Cook rice in water according to package directions. Drain well, reserving 1 cup of the broth. Cool the rice under cold water until warm and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Return the rice to the rice cooker and press or stir to fluff and mix. Add spinach, raisins, chili, chopped basil, and torn basil.

Random Ingredients: walnut,vegetable oil cooking spray,zucchini,fennel bulb,anchovy paste,deli roast beef
title: Roast Beef With Zucchini and Walnuts
ingredients: 2 lbs zucchini | vegetable oil cooking spray | 5 lbs deli roast beef or 5 lbs sirloin steak, trimmed of excess fat | 1/4 cup anchovy paste, minced or 2 tablespoons sambal oelek | 4 tablespoons chopped walnuts | 1 teaspoon fennel bulb, powder for sprinkling
instructions: Cut zucchini into 1/2 inch slices. Lay slices on a platter and spray with oil. Put a weight over the zucchini slices so that the zucchini does not dry out. Set aside. In a very large nonstick frying pan or griddle, cook the zucchini over medium heat, stirring and flipping them frequently with a metal spatula, until most of the zucchini can be squeezed off of them with the spatula. Transfer to a clean plate and let cool. Pat and dry the roast with paper towels and sprinkle with minced anchovy paste, salt, and fennel powder. Heat a grill or two pan on medium high, or preheat a large skillet on high. When the pan is very hot, sear the roast on all sides. Cover pan tightly with foil, let stand 5 minutes. Uncover pan and slice the meat thinly across the grain into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange on a platter. Serve the zucchini with the slices of meat accompanied by walnuts, if desired.

title: Meatball Appetizer
ingredients: 42 -48 meatballs | 1 -2 cup apricot jam
instructions: Mix jam with meat until smooth. Deep fry in hot oil or grease. Put paper towel under towel to absorb excess oil. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.

title: Mussel Balls on a Stick
ingredients: 500 g mussels, scrubbed and debearded ( discard the beards if dried ones were used ) | 50 g plain flour | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 3 -4 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Mix the flour and mustard powder together. Using your fingers widen the jar a little and then rinse the mussels in plenty of water. Mix with the dry ingredients. Spoon the dough onto a clean, dry surface or in the palms of your hands. Form the mixture into balls, approximately the size of a large walnut, and then flatten them slightly to shape balls slightly larger than a walnut. Place the mussels on the prepared stick and press gently. Leave the balls to stand for 15 minutes before eating for your favourite style.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,vodka,sauce,coffee granule,southwestern chicken strip,cannellini bean,oregano sprig
title: Homestyle White Chili
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups inexpensive white shoepeg frozen southwestern chicken strips | 1 3/4 cups hot coffee granules | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon oregano sprig | 3 dashes hot sauce
instructions: In a 4 quart slow cooker, combine chicken strips, 2/3 cup hot coffee, 1/2 cup vodka, chopped onion, 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules, onion powder and oregano. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours, or on high for 4 to 6 hours. Stir well. Stir in remaining hot coffee and hot sauce. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes..

Random Ingredients: anise seed,vegetable bouillon cube,tomato juice,orange juice,coconut oil,sea scallop,white flour
title: Sea Scallops from Madagascar
ingredients: 1 cup dry white flour | 1/2 cup vegetable bouillon cube | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed anise seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1/2 lb sea scallops, sliced crosswise
instructions: Sift the flour into a bowl. Add all remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Turn mixture onto a floured surface and knead for 10 - 15 minutes or until smooth. Preheat the grill to medium high heat. Coat with a little oil and cook the scallops for 6 - 8 minutes or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Wood Furniture Polish
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups frozen mixed vegetables ( v8, vh-hg, or other combination of vegetables eg., corn cobs - peeled, cleaned, and cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1/2 cup molasses ( optional )
instructions: Place ingredients in a large pot and place over high heat. When hot, stir, and allow to boil. Decrease heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Set a large sieve over a large bowl. Pour the liquid and vegetables into the sieve. Rinse clean the bowl from the vegetables as you squeeze them. Stir the liquid into the spice bag. Cover with a cloth cloth. Allow to drain for 45 minutes at room temp. If using molasses, pour the liquid through the cloth as directed.

Random Ingredients: onion,broccoli,potato flour,hot red pepper flake,soda water
title: Potato Flour Soup
ingredients: 4 potatoes flour or 4 potato flour | 1 onion ( chopped ) | 250 g broccoli ( chopped ) | hot red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | soda water ( optional )
instructions: Bring 6 cups of water with a teaspoon of salt add 4 or 5 potato flour mixed with a small onion in a pot. Turn heat on low and cook for about 10 minutes until tender. While this is cooking boil 3 cups of water. In separate pan add 2 tablespoons of potato flour and 1 onion and fry for 5 mins till soft. Add garlic or chopped fresh broccoli and cook for 5 mins or until cooked. Remove from heat. Drain water and combine with 2 or 3 cups of boiled potato flour mixture and mix. Chill for about an hour before serving. This is great served with garlic bread or other winter meal.

title: German Pork Tenderloin Rolls
ingredients: 6 pork tenderloins | 12 ounces frozen phyllo pastry, thawed according to package instructions | 4 cups half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup seasoned vinegar
instructions: Cut the tenderloins lengthwise into 2 inch strips with a very sharp knife. Cut each strip lengthwise into about 4 equal strips. Place 1 strip of meat on each pastry strip. Cover with 1 cup of the cream and 1/2 cup of the vinegar. Starting at the top, roll up the pastry to enclose the meat, tying with a piece of butcher's twine. Refrigerate for a minimum of 30 minutes and up to 5 hours. Lightly oil grill and preheat to medium. Place the rolls on the grill, and grill until browned on the bottom, about 5 minutes. Turn and grill until desired doneness, about 15 more minutes. Transfer to a platter and brush with remaining cream and vinegar. Allow to cool and serve.

title: Pineapple Hawaiian Party Appetizer
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1 can pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce, from can | 2 toothpicks | 20 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large bowl, mix together garbanzo beans, pineapple juice, and adobo sauce. Fill a pie plate or baking dish with equal amounts of the mixture. Place the toothpicks in the center of the mixture and secure with a toothpick. Place the pineapple wrapped toothpicks into the dish. Bake 45 to 60 minutes. Remove the toothpicks from the dish and slice on the bias. Serve warm.

title: Pasta With Olive Relish
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces medium firm red and green olives, drained | 14 ounces sachet medium hot pasta ( or any other type you prefer ) | 6 -10 drops tabasco sauce, to taste | 3 star anise ( i used about 1/4 tsp ) | 2 pinches cardamom seeds
instructions: Put your hot pasta in the pasta pot. Pour the olives in to the hot pasta. Bring pasta to a boil over medium heat, while constantly stirring so the olive water doesn't stop boiling. After 3 minutes, add the star anise, cardamom and a few drops of tabasco. The liquid will reduce to a thick paste. Serve hot from the bowl or in a soup bowl. This would also be good with other stews at the table.

title: Emeril's Espresso Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 bag rice noodles | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 1/2 cups warm espresso
instructions: Place the rice noodles in a large bowl and cover with salted tap water. Allow to sit for 30 minutes. Drain. Place the cumin in a mortar and pestle over medium heat. The aroma of espresso will waft through the coffee. While the coffee is brewing, place the espresso in a small saucepan. If you would like more flavor, add a little more coffee to balance the amount of fat in the coffee. Heat the coffee in the coffee to a simmer, then remove from heat and pour over the noodles. Let sit 4 more minutes, then stir. Serve immediately.

title: Hot Blueberry Asiago Cheese Spread
ingredients: 6 ounces blueberries, picked over and washed and rinsed | 1 package dry onion soup mix ( or your favourite dry soup mix ) | 2 tablespoons grated asiago cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1/4 cup minced onion ( optional )
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine asiago cheese, cardamom, onion and blueberries. Blend until smooth. Transfer to a serving bowl. Refrigerate uncovered for at least 1 hour before serving or for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: squash,stewing beef,torn salad green,shortbread cooky,italian sausage
title: Italian Vegetable Hero
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut in 1 inch strips | 1 lb mild italian sausage, sliced | 1 jar torn salad greens ( i used romaine mixed ) | 1 package round shortbread cookies | 1 can crushed italian-style sausage in tomato paste
instructions: Brown stew beef and sausage. Add salad greens and cool. Stir in sugar until dissolved. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 9x13 casserole dish. Bake at 350°f for 30 - 45 minutes. While hot spread top with crushed italian style sausage.

Random Ingredients: rice krispies,hazelnut,sage leaf,green curry paste,dill weed,tamari soy sauce
title: Thai Green Curry for ZWT-9
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons green curry paste ( i used taste of thai green curry paste mix ) | 300 g rice krispies, broken ( i used freedom foods's pad kee brand ) | 1 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped | 1/2 cup dried dill weed, coarsely chopped | 2 -3 fresh sage leaves | 2 -3 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh dill weed ( for sprinkling )
instructions: Place curry paste and remaining ingredients into a food processor and process until smooth. Taste, if it is salty or sweet, add 1 - 2 tsp additional tamari. Pour spice paste over rice and toss to coat evenly. Store in refrigerator. To serve, place rice krispies in a serving dish, sprinkle with dried dill and top with curry mixture.

Random Ingredients: white onion,creme de cacao,currant,monterey jack cheese,kitchen bouquet,bread,chicken leg quarter
title: Deb's Chicken Legs in Manchego
ingredients: 1/2 white onion, chopped | 1/4 cup dried currants | 1/4 cup dry bread, crumbs | 3 tablespoons kitchen bouquet | 4 chicken leg quarters | 10 fluid ounces creme de cacao | 1 package monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix onion, currants, bread crumbs, kitchen bouquet, chicken legs,. Creole or other brandy flavored crumbs, and cheese. Coat both sides of the chicken legs with. Creole or other brandy flavored crumbs. Place in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Caribbean Hot Dogs
ingredients: 4 hot dog buns | 1 cup sliced cucumber | 1 cup sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 cup thai basil | 1/2 cup currants | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Fill buns with hot dogs. Add remaining ingredients and spoon on brandy or sherry. Serve on bun.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,green chili pepper,pork roast
title: Chinese Sweet Chili Pork
ingredients: 1 large green chili pepper ( use fresh or jar ) | 2 -4 lbs pork roast | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Cut pork into 1 cubes or slivers and place in crockpot. Combine 2 - 3 tblsp of dark soy sauce with 1/4 cup water, stir to mix well. Pour over pork and cook on high on high for 2 hours or low for 6 - 8 hours. Remove pork from crockpot and add remaining dark soy sauce. Stir well. Cook on low for 10 minutes and serve.

title: Taro-Root Coffee
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable juice | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, crushed | 3 -4 cups brewed coffee ( or espresso ) | 2 -3 taro root, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/2 lb ground pork or 1/2 lb grated lean pork meat | chopped roasted salted almonds ( ) ( optional ) or slivered almonds ( optional )
instructions: Put the vegetable juice in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Lower the heat and simmer, partially covered, for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender but not mushy. Meanwhile, in a skillet, stir together the fennel seeds and the pepper. When the soup is simmering, add the coffee and the taro root. Simmer, covered, until it has dissolved, about 15 minutes. Stir the ground pork into the soup and cook for 5 minutes or until slightly browned at the edges. Serve the soup over a handful of blanched, slivered almonds and toasted slivered almonds mixed with the roasted salted pine nuts or slivered almonds if you wish.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,chicken breast half,mango chutney,confectioner sugar,tart apple,italian spice,grape leaf,beef brisket
title: Quick Beef-Apple Brisket
ingredients: 1/4 cup grape leaves | 1 boneless beef brisket | 1 cup dried sweetened apple slices | 1 can or bottle beer | 1/3 package dried beef stew seasoning mix with poultry seasoning | 1 jar mango chutney | 2 tablespoons italian-style dried minced onion | 1 teaspoon ground dried italian-style spices | 4 bone-in chicken breast halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place grape leaves in the cavity of a large sealable plastic bag.

title: Peanut Cheese Colcannon
ingredients: 6 ounces canned evaporated milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup ketchup | 1 cup whole milk or 1 cup skim milk | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 green cabbage, shredded | 1 celery rib, diced ( optional ) | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a blender and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, about 4 hours.

title: Red Bell Pepper Molasses Tea - Microwave

instructions: Place peppers in a microwave safe dish with a lid. Pierce peppers several times with a fork or skewer. Microwave on high for 30 seconds. Remove peppers from microwave. Add brown sugar to peppers. Cover loosely. Cook on high for 1 minute. Remove from microwave and let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Nutty Chilli Sauce

instructions: Dissolve the catsup and water chestnuts together. Mix in the vanilla essence and pumpkin seeds. Stir in the brandy.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup marsala wine | 1 cup apricot preserves | 3 lbs baby portabella mushrooms, stems removed
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk the marinade ingredients together. Place the mushrooms in a large ziplock baggie, pour the marinade over, seal the bag, and stir the bag until the mushrooms are well coated with the marinade. Refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight. Skewer the mushrooms, if desired. Brush the mushrooms with the glaze and place on a rack. Discard the glaze after cooking. Turn the heat down to 325 and bake, tightly covered, for 3 hours. Slice the mushrooms to serve.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,lettuce leaf,herb,white wine vinegar,rigatoni pasta,nutmeg
title: Rigatoni Fajita Bread Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained | 12 large lettuce leaves | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons herbs, of your choice chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon herbs, chopped ( i use oregano for a change )
instructions: Toss cooled pasta into salad dressing and mix well. Place lettuce leaves on top, then toss with nutmeg and mixed herbs. Tear off large chunks of rocket and mix with the salad.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,jumbo shrimp,yellow potato,fish stock,red kidney bean,white breadcrumb,catsup
title: French Dip & Chips - Kidney Beans, Seafood, Tomatoes & Jars
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yellow potatoes, peeled and halved | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 can jumbo shrimp, raw | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence ( or 1 tblsp. dried herbes de provence flakes, crushed ) | 4 slices firm white bread, cut into thick slices ( i use french loaf bread ) | 2 cups fish stock or 2 cups chicken stock | 2 -3 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Place sliced potatoes in a large saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, turn heat down and simmer. When potatoes are tender, drain, add to potato pot. Heat beans through then mash with a potato masher. Add the shrimp, herbes de provence and bread slices. Stir in the stock. Stir mixture together. If the dip is too thick, add a bit of extra stock. Top with more bread slices. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight to get flavors together and adjust seasoning.

title: Crock Pot Guiness
ingredients: 1 can guinness stout, or other stout beer | 1 -2 jalapeno chile, chopped | 1 medium yellow squash, chopped | 1 -2 can whole kernel corn
instructions: Put everything in crock pot, stir, and cook on low for 4 - 5 hours or on high for 2 - 3 hours. Serve over rice, or as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,currant,black eyed pea,pecorino romano cheese,mozzarella cheese
title: Black-Eyed Peas with Spinach & Pecorino Romano
ingredients: 1 package sliced fresh spinach leaves, thawed | 1/2 cup dried currants | 1 jar sliced black-eyed peas, undrained | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking dish with aluminum foil. Place spinach in a microwave safe bowl with currants. Cook in microwave on high until hot, about 1 minute. Place black eyed peas in a bowl with warm water. Mix well until heated, about 2 minutes. Set aside. Spread spinach mixture in baking dish.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,tomato soup,fettuccine pasta,granny smith apple,oregano leaf,red wine vinegar,molasses
title: Sweet Granny Smith's Apple Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs granny smith apples, peeled, cored, and cut into chunks | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 4 ounces dry fettuccine pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, and cook pasta for 9 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain well. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine the shredded apples, tomato soup, red wine vinegar, molasses, oregano, and lime juice. Toss to coat, and chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes. In a large serving bowl, toss cooked pasta with the apple mixture, and serve.

title: Trout on Parmigiano-Reggiano Cheese
ingredients: 3 pounds skinless trout fillets | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place trout in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with parmigiano reggiano cheese. Bake in preheated oven until cheese has melted and fish is opaque in the center 15 minutes, 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Pork, Eggplant and Shrimp Breakfast Rollatas
ingredients: 2 pork chops, skin on | 2 eggplants, halved lengthways | 50 g jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined ( optional ) | 3 cups cooked rice
instructions: Cut pork chops into 1cm x 2cm sticks.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,pumpkin puree,savoy cabbage,gingerroot,masa harina,beef rib
title: Crock Pot Road Smoked Beef Rib Eye Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs pork ribs, with bone in | 1/2 lb pumpkin puree | 3 tablespoons masa harina ( a paste made with a little water, cornstarch and a pinch of salt ) | 1 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1 large peeled and roughly chopped savoy cabbage | 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f place the ribs into the base of a large roasting tin. Combine all the other ingredients in a medium bowl, mix well and pour into the tin. Stuff a big piece of foil into the centre of the pan, scrunch up the edges and place underneath the meat. Add the vegetables, give them a stir and place in the oven. Cook for 2 hours. Remove the foil and cook for a further 15 - 20 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,chunky tomato basil pasta sauce,beef,cherry tomato,limeade concentrate,macaroni,mustard powder
title: Cabbage Beef Bowl #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package boxed macaroni | 1 1/3 lb lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon limeade concentrate | 1 package frozen cherry tomatoes | 1 -2 cup chopped cabbage | 1/4 cup chunky tomato basil pasta sauce | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Meanwhile combine ground beef in a skillet sprayed with no stick cooking spray. Add limeade concentrate and stir to combine. Cook over medium heat until no pink remains. Stir in cherry tomatoes and cabbage.

title: Mama's Grilled Caribbean Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs rump steak, sliced very thin into pieces about 1-inch long | 3 -4 tablespoons grated cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup grated lime rind | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon orange zest | 0.5 package frozen green beans
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a resealable plastic bag. Add steak and marinade in fridge overnight or for at least 2 hours. When ready to cook, remove chicken from bag and discard marinade. Grill meat on outdoor grill for about 3 minutes per side depending on the thickness of the meat. Turn meat and grill other side. Serve with rice or fresh vegetables.

title: Italian Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 fluid ounce soft butter | 1/2 - 3/4 fluid ounce aromatic salad dressing ( commercial )
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, cream together butter and salad dressing. Pour into container of an electric blender, cover, and blend until smooth, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: filling,rye flour,monterey jack cheese,caster sugar,icing sugar
title: Cheesy Rye Crackers (Scottish)
ingredients: 8 ounces rye flour | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 lb grated monterey jack cheese | icing sugar, to serve ( optional ) | filling, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c and line 2 large baking trays with baking paper. Place the rye flour, sugar and cheese into a food processor and pulse until crumbly. Turn mixture into a mixing bowl and sprinkle over a little icing sugar if using. Stir the dough until mixed well and divide into 4 equal portions and roll each piece into a sausage shape. Place onto prepared trays spaced well apart.. Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until crisp. Remove from the oven when lightly marked on the first side and cool slightly. Serve with a little extra icing sugar if desired.

title: Cantaloupe With Turmeric and Cilantro
ingredients: 1 large cantaloupe ( yellow finger ) | 1/2 cup fresh coriander or 1/2 cup fresh cilantro
instructions: Pound the melon with a mallet until the shell starts to crackle, shaking off any excess moisture. Cut away the top third of the cantaloupe. Cut out a cone, scoop out flesh to remove the shell and leave intact. Combine the seeds and liquid in a small skillet and bring to just under a simmer. Cook for 30 seconds over low heat. Do not allow to boil. Remove from heat, discard the seeds, and set the melon shell aside. Place a scoop of filling in the center of each cantaloupe shell. Roll the stuffed melon up into a tight cylinder. Repeat for the rest of the cantaloupe. Serve chilled. To serve, place the stuffed melon shell on a serving platter.

title: Venison Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs venison ( you can substitute ground beef or ground turkey for the venison, or substitute other ground meats ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3 stalks celery, chopped | 1/2 loaf crusty bread, cut into small cubes | 12 hot sauce
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cut the venison into small pieces, not too fine and not over crowder meat. Cook until browned on all sides and no pink remains. Add the turmeric, celery and meat back to pan and cook for about 5 minutes over medium heat. Turning the vegies over in the pan. Add more water and cook for about 2 - 3 minutes until meat is no longer pink, stirring frequently. Serve the meat with sauce while warm.

title: Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground beef chuck | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 1/2 cup fruit preserves, divided | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the ground chuck and oats. Stir in 1/2 cup preserves and pine nuts. Roll into small meatballs, and place on a baking sheet. Bake meatballs in the preheated oven 20 minutes, turning after 15 minutes.

instructions: Cook spaghetti acc to package directions. Pour cherry syrup into a large bowl. Drain cooked spaghetti and toss to coat. Stir in crumbs. Serve in bowls.

title: Radish Ceviche

title: Spaetzle II

instructions: Trim all traces of fat. Cut chuck into 1/2 inch cubes, place, in 3 quart saucepan. Fill with water to cover. Bring to boil, then simmer, covered, stirring once, for 1 hour. instructions: Preheat oven to 180degc. Take your chicken, and using two fingers, pound the breasts with the heels between two sheets of baking paper to make flat rectangles of about 20cm x 20cm. title: Basmati Rice With Whipped Cream

instructions: Wash rice until water runs clear. In a large saucepan, melt butter or margarine over medium heat. Add rice.

instructions: Peel, wash and rinse the potatoes until water runs clear, then dry them in a linen cloth overnight in a cool, dry place or a cool place. Cut off the skins and cut them lengthwise into strips about 1/4 inch wide slabs. Sprinkle the potatoes with salt and allspice.

title: Baked Potato Crackers
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes, unpeeled | 1/3 cup white flour | 2 fluid ounces apple cider vinegar | 2/3 cup pitted chopped green olives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Butter a cookie sheet or jelly roll pan and line it with parchment paper. Peel the potatoes, cut into quarters lengthwise, then into thin 2 inch wide wedges. Place in a large saucepan and add enough water to cover them by 1 inch. Bring to boil over medium high heat and cook until tender when pierced with a fork, about 25 minutes. Drain and shake the potatoes over the water to soak up any excess water and set aside. Meanwhile, whisk together the flour and vinegar in a bowl. Gently stir in the olives. Spoon 1/2 cup of potato mixture in the prepared pan and sprinkle with a heaping teaspoon of the flour mixture, then stir with a fork and make sure the mixture breaks apart. Scatter the remaining potato mixture over the top and bake in the preheated oven until the top is browned and crisp and the topping is puffed up, 15 to 20 minutes.

instructions: Place onion in pan. Coat with vinegar.

instructions: Cut a deep slit in the top edge of the bread and remove the bread from it's wrapper. instructions: Pour guinness into heavy small saucepan, bring to boil, add 2 tbls. Sherry, stir.

title: Chunky Tomato Sauce

instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a large saucepan. Simmer, uncovered, on low heat, stirring occasionally, until thickened.

title: Korean-Asian Salmon With a Yoghurt Sauce

instructions: Mix ingredients, except the salmon pieces, until they are covered with the dressing.

title: Green Peppers

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cut the loaf of bread into 1/2 inch slices. Place slices on an ungreased baking sheet and cook for 20 minutes or until golden, turning once.

title: Tatties (Beef Tenderloin)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 4 teaspoons hungarian sweet paprika | 1/2 cup apple pie filling | 1 tablespoon chives | 1 tablespoon capers | 1/2 cup champagne | 1 cup water | 2 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Preparation of the meat. Combine the paprika, 1/2 cup water and 1 teaspoon cornstarch in a gallon size plastic bag. Add the beef tenderloin and marinate overnight, turning a few times. Drain the beef and discard the marinade. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Cut a slit on each side of the tenderloin about 1/2 inch wide, and score 4 diagonal slits at the thickest part of the tenderloin to make a diamond pattern. Insert a small dab of the remaining 2 teaspoons of cornstarch along the slit. Dribble the remaining 1/2 cup water on top and rub it onto the cut surfaces, making sure there are no pockets, or else they will stick. Place the tenderloin on a rack in a roasting pan and roast for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done, basting occasionally with the pan juices. When the meat is done, remove from the oven and let rest in the juices for 20 minutes. To make the glaze. Combine the apple pie filling, chives, capers, and capers in a small bowl, and combine with the champagne and water. Pour the glaze over the meat and serve.

Random Ingredients: double cream,streaky bacon,rigatoni pasta,chicken stock cube
title: Maggie Beer's Rigatoni, Bacon and Chicken Soup
ingredients: 150 g streaky bacon | 150 ml double cream | 375 g rigatoni pasta | 500 ml chicken stock cube, plus extra
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c. Slice the streaky bacon into thin, narrow strips and brown them in a frying pan until they start to curl up. Then add the cream and cook until it becomes a light sauce. Rinse the rigatoni under cold water and drain. Put in a baking dish, pour over the bacon cream sauce and chicken stock cube and stir to combine. Bake for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve with grated parmesan cheese.

title: Pumpkin Vegetable Pies
ingredients: 4 pumpkin pie spice, pumpkin pie spice cases | 4 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Place pumpkin pie spice cases and vegetable stock in a saucepan. Pour stock over. Heat to boiling.

title: Ajiaco (Sweet Pepperoni Rounds)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pepperoni | 1/2 cup granulated sugar substitute | 1/2 cup sugar substitute | 1/3 cup honey
instructions: Combine all the ingredients.

title: Fish Fillet and Coconut Pie
ingredients: 125 g shredded coconut | 125 g phyllo pastry | 1/4 fennel bulb, thinly sliced | 30 ml lime juice | 60 ml mayonnaise | 4 cod fillets, cut into 1 cm cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Line a large baking tray with baking paper.

title: Crunchy Rye Bread
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 2 teaspoons cornstarch
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan on medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until very hot, but not smoking. Remove from heat. Place the rye bread slices in the hot frying pan, and sprinkle with cornstarch. Turn each piece of bread over, and cook until bottom is browned and crisp, and bread is heated through. Slice into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,rhubarb,beef stock,leek,prosciutto,chicken meat,graham cracker crumb
title: Rack of Lamb Rissoles
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red lentils | 500 g rhubarb, thinly sliced | 500 g ground beef or 500 g ground lamb | 12 garlic prosciutto, thinly sliced | 3 leeks, washed, white part only, sliced thinly lengthways | 1/2 cup instant gluten-free instant rhubarb | 10 graham cracker crumbs, coarsely crushed
instructions: Cook the lentils in a large pan of boiling, salted water until tender, about 20minutes. Meanwhile, drain the rhubarb, reserve any juices in a bowl. Place the ground lamb in a large non stick frying pan and cook over a high heat, stirring to break up any clumps, for 5 minutes, breaking up any lumps with the back of a large spoon, until browned. Stir in the leeks, rhubarb juice, and half the crumbs, scraping the pan to loosen any lumps. The rissoles will be done when the meat is cooked through all the ingredients. Serve the rissoles at once in a bowl and sprinkle over the remaining crumbs.

title: Tamarind Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons ground cumin or 2 teaspoons paprika
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store in an airtight container. To use, use to make chili powder over hot butane beans. Use as directed in chili recipes, chili powder, meat or meat.

title: Coconut Milk
ingredients: 6 cups unsweetened coconut oil | 2 -3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 large red-skinned vanilla beans
instructions: Place the coconut oil and vinegar together with the vanilla beans in a double layer of aluminum foil. Wrap tightly in a double layer of cheesecloth or plastic wrap and place in a freezer. Check every 30 minutes to make sure the oil is good and hot. This will give you about two days. Note, the coconut milk will keep indefinitely in the refrigerator. Beans should be thawed and heated through as soon as you remove the cheese cloth or the sachet from the freezer in the beginning.

title: Simple Guacamole
ingredients: 1 avocado, diced small | 1 teaspoon ground chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Mix avocado, chile and 1/2 tsp taco seasoning together in small bowl. Place in medium serving bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 30 minutes until firm and chilled. Stir with fork to separate. Stir in remaining 1/2 tsp taco seasoning. Place lettuce on plate, top with avocado mixture.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,cayenne pepper,chunky peanut butter,fettuccine pasta,vinaigrette dressing,scallion
title: Thai Barley Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup vinaigrette dressing ( i use good seasons ) | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 package of dry fettuccine pasta ( can use any shape, pasta, linguine etc ) | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 cup pearl barley
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions. While pasta is cooking, in a small bowl, mix the peanut butter, vinaigrette ingredients, and cayenne. When the pasta is done, drain. Add to peanut butter mixture. Garnish with scallions, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,semolina flour,jalapeno pepper,italian herb seasoning
title: Pumpkin Seed and Herb Farfalle
ingredients: 1 cup semolina flour | 1 tablespoon ground jalapeno pepper | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 1/4 cups canned pumpkin seeds
instructions: Place semolina flour and 1 tablespoon of the italian seasoning in a food processor fitted with the metal blade and pulse until it has the texture of coarse meal, about 1 minute. With machine running slowly add the remaining italian seasoning. Remove from processor.

title: California Roll Noodle Bowls
ingredients: 1 package beef-flavor ramen noodles | 1 ripe hass avocado - peeled, pitted, and mashed | 1 jar toasted pecan pieces | 6 garnishes :
instructions: Prepare the ramen noodles and the avocado at the same time, so they are all hot before serving. Cover a large glass bowl with plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,cottage cheese,parsley root,bay leaf,tagliatelle pasta noodle,curry powder
title: Yummy Pumpkin Pasta and Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin puree ( the kind with skin ) | 1 tablespoon curry powder ( medium or hot ) | 1 tablespoon parsley root, finely chopped | 2 bay leaves | 1/2 lb tagliatelle pasta noodles | 1/3 cup low fat cottage cheese ( optional )
instructions: In a large covered pot heat up the pumpkin and its juices, pumpkin seeds, curry and parsley roots to boiling in 3 tbsp water.. Lower heat and simmer for approx 10 minutes until pumpkin is soft and starting to smell richly roasted. Drain off fat and discard. Return pot to stove, add pasta, cover, and simmer for approx 15 minutes until pasta is cooked. Stir, remove bay leaves and then stir in cottage cheese if using.

title: Irish Potatoes With Herbs
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes or 6 medium all potatoes, scrubbed and sliced as for regular potatoes | 1/4 cup instant tea ( or more )
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large dutch oven or non stick pan. Drizzle the tea over the potatoes. Cover with just enough cold water to come up 1/2 inch above the surface of the potatoes. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer, covered, 20 - 60 minutes. When potatoes are tender, fluff with fork while still warm.

title: Glazed Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup short vermicelli | 3 zucchini, sliced | 2 small zucchini, sliced | 4 tablespoons olive, halved | 200 g minced pancetta | 1 cup cooked brown rice | 1/16 - 1/4 cup sun-dried fruit | 3 tablespoons mirin | 20 wonton skins
instructions: Heat broiler. Cook vermicelli according to package directions, then rinse under cold water. Set aside. Meanwhile, spray a baking tray with cooking spray. Dice zucchini. Add zucchini to the bowl of a food processor fitted with the chopping blade, add the olives, pancetta and rice. Pulse until evenly mixed. If too dry, add water, 1 tbsp at a time. Cut dough into 3 x3 squares. Brush each square with a little olive oil, then place a tbsp of zucchini mixture across the middle of each circle, fold into triangles, then seal. Place pastries on the prepared baking tray, brush tops with more oil, and bake at 180c for 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Dipping Sauce For Fish Pieces
ingredients: 12 ounces picante sauce | 4 teaspoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Mix everything together. Chill several hours or overnight for flavors to meld.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,monterey jack pepper cheese,new potato,cayenne
title: Indian Style Stove Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium new potatoes | 1 tablespoon cayenne | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 tablespoon monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to cut potatoes into 6 wedges each or into pieces to make 2 wedges per potato. Place potato wedges into a non stick saucepan with water. Bring to boil, partially cover and simmer for about 15 - 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Quickly stir in curry paste and cayenne then add potatoes. Cover and cook for about 5 mins until potatoes are tender. Mix in cheese. Serve with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: mussel,red capsicum,green chilies,marinara sauce,vanilla ice cream
title: Yummy Chilli Grilled Mussels
ingredients: 300 g fresh mussels | 1 red capsicum, cut into chunks | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 cup marinara sauce | 3 cups vanilla ice cream, to serve
instructions: Bring all ingredients to the boil in a large saucepan. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve mussels in a bowl with plastic wrap over side of steaming hot marinara.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,pork butt,vanilla,rosemary,pine nut,harissa,golden mushroom soup,hoagie
title: Hoisin Baget
ingredients: 4 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed of all visible fat | 3 1/2 lbs pork butt, trimmed of all visible fat | 1 1/2 cups canned condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa or 1 1/2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves or 1/2 teaspoon rosemary, crumbled | 1 tablespoon unbleached cane syrup or 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed dried rosemary or 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary, crushed | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Make baguettes with scissors with scissors. Remove beef between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Place cut beef on cutting board. Using 1 inch knife, cut diagonally across the grain into 2 - ½ inch thick chunks. Remove meat from plastic wrap and pat dry with paper towels. Slice pork into strips about 1 - ¼ inches wide and 2 - ¼ inches long. Place meat on cut surfaces of beef.

title: French Canadian "Tayl" Seasoning
ingredients: 1 cup celery salt | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Sprinkle over any kind of meat.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 4 cups half-and-half | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 sprig thyme | 20 water chestnuts, coarsely chopped | 12 ounces cooked lobsters, drained | 1 cup madeira wine | 1 cup vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Deglaze a large saucepan with half and half and tamari. Add water chestnuts, lobster, and madeira. Over medium heat, simmer gently, stirring occasionally until heated through. Pour half and half into hot sterilized jars and seal immediately for up to 6 months. Allow to mature in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,green bell pepper,soy sauce,chive,green grape,taco seasoning mix
title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup snipped fresh chives | 1/4 cup finely chopped green bell pepper | 1/4 cup finely chopped green seedless grape
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the cream cheese, soy sauce, taco seasoning, chives and green peppers. Mix well to blend. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Add the grapes. Cover and chill. Store covered in the fridge.

title: Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning ( use your favourite taco flavor ) | 1 cup beef broth | 1/2 cup red wine ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in freezer until ready to use. When ready to use, make the tacos using 1/3 or less of the taco seasoning to moisten and mix well. Store leftovers in refrigerator.

title: Korean Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup sherry | 1/4 cup soy sauce
instructions: For best results, allow an hour or two marinating time for the flavors to marry.

title: Easy Japanese Style Steak Marinade
ingredients: 1 1 lb flank steak | 1 medium onion, diced | 1 -2 tablespoon mirin | 2 -3 dashes pepperoncini ( optional )
instructions: Brown onion and add the steak and allow to rest/brown at least 15 minutes. Combine all ingredients over the top and stir well to coat. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Smoked Salmon and Corn on the Cob With Mexican Cheese
ingredients: 600 g smoked salmon | 50 g baby corn ( canned corn may also be used ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon dried chilies ( from a jar ) | 1/2 teaspoon mexican cheese ( mexican mexican blend preferred ) | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat a barbecue plate on medium high heat. Place the smoked salmon, a good sized handful of baby corn and seasoning into the barbeque plate, seasoning as required. Brush onto the smoked salmon with the barbecue smoke mixture and cook for 6 - 7 minutes each side. The smoked salmon is the favourite part. Serve with the mexican cheese.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,orange zest,honey,liquid smoke,lime wedge,vanilla,italian parsley
title: Texas-Style Orange Smoked Mojo
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened orange juice ( preferably organic preferred ) | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/2 lime wedge, to serve | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian parsley | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange zest, or | 1/2 teaspoon ground orange zest, or | 1/8 teaspoon honey | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla ( optional )
instructions: Place a small saucepan over medium high heat. Add all the ingredients except for the orange zest, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the honey is melted and syrupy, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly, then stir in the orange zest. Scoop the contents of the saucepan into a small bowl and serve at once. Goes great with grilled meats, pita wedges or crackers.

Random Ingredients: baking cocoa,watercress,cauliflower,gruyere cheese,salt black pepper,creme fraiche,pecorino romano cheese,pear
title: Cauliflower and Pear Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 small pear, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, grated | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons baking cocoa | 2 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 1 cup creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon watercress or 1 tablespoon coriander, finely chopped | freshly grated pecorino romano cheese or asiago cheese rind
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f remove and discard the stalk and outer leaves of the cauliflower. Cut the florets into 2cm dice. Put all but the cauliflower in a large roasting tin, sprinkle with the pear slices and toss around the cauliflower lightly to coat in pear juice. Season liberally with salt and pepper and bake for 35 minutes until crisp. While the cauliflower is roasting, make the au gratin.

title: Grecian Edible Rice With Meat
