ingredients: 2 cups yellow rice | 1 1/2 cups dry sherry | 1/4 cup pickled jalapeno pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs precooked ground meat or 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken | 1 large uncooked spiral ready to eat pasta
instructions: Bring large kettle of water to a boil. Cook rice until al dente, about 12 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, combine next 7 ingredients in a large skillet or dutch oven. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until meat is cooked through. Stir in rice.

title: Raisin Fritters
ingredients: 125 g chickpea flour or 125 g chickpea flour | 125 ml dark rum, divided | 1 sprig rosemary or 1 sprig thyme | 1 stalk celery, cut into 2 cm lengths
instructions: Beat together the flour and 1 tablespoon of the rum. Dived the floured mixture into 4 portions. Use a fork to gently press the marinade into the flour. Heat the remaining rum to boiling point and add the flour paste, stirring to combine. Boil for three minutes until smooth. Remove from heat, place in sterilised jars and seal.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,ice cube,cider vinegar,chipotle pepper,green pepper,parmesan cheese,salt pepper
title: Chipotles & Roasted Green Peppers (Chiles Con Queso)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs large red peppers or 2 1/2 lbs large red bell peppers | 1 -2 chipotle pepper ( canned in adobo sauce ) | 2 tablespoons pickled garlic and bottled chipotles in adobo sauce ( can use chopped chipotle peppers ) | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper, to taste | 2 -3 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese or 3 -5 tablespoons romano cheese, to sprinkle over top
instructions: Set oven to broil. Trim off ends and stems of peppers. Slit peppers lengthwise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Set aside. Peel peppers, discard stems and seeds. Place bell strips into a single layer on a large baking sheet covered with aluminum foil with sides. Broil 8 inches from heat about 4 minutes or just until tender. Do not overcook. Remove peppers and drain liquid. Place peppers under a colander and tap off moisture. Cover with a damp paper towel and allow to drain 30 - 60 minutes or until crisp. Using a slotted spoon, remove pepper strips and drain on paper towel. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine chipotles and 1 or 2 teaspoons of the adobo sauce in adobo sauce. Using small sauce spatula, carefully scrape hot chipotles from slotted spoon into bowl, breaking up finely chunks. Toast peppers over medium heat until blackened on all sides, about 5 - 10 minutes. Set aside to cool slightly. Place cooled strips in a small bowl. Stir vinegar into drippings in skillet over medium heat. Using a slotted spoon, remove peppers mixture from skillet. Discard pan juices. Return all peppers, including liquid, to skillet. Add boullion cubes, salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes or so. Stir in 2 tablespoons of parmesan cheese. Spoon into heated peppers and toss lightly to coat. Serve immediately, garnished with remaining cheese and remaining tablespoon of sauce. The pepper mixture can be frozen for up to 2 weeks. To cook, place peppers on a medium hot grill over low coals. Grill uncovered 7 - 8 minutes, or until peppers are crisply charred and the peppers are cooked through. Serve hot. Tip, use a good pepper mill to get about 4 tablespoons. You may use whatever type of peppers you feel comfortable with. To make a thicker sauce, you can mix together 2 tablespoons of flour with another medium heat addition. A little water can be added and then simmered for 3 to 4 minutes while heating up the sauce.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,tortilla,bay leaf,double acting baking powder,white wine vinegar,red grape,asparagus
title: Asparagus Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 20 frozen asparagus, thawed on counter 10 minutes to steam off excess water | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon double-acting baking powder | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 1 bay leaf, rinsed | 1 packet red seedless grapes, halved | 2 ounces tortilla, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f on an ungreased baking sheet, arrange asparagus spears in single layer. Combine vinegar, baking powder, cream of tartar, and bay leaf in a small bowl. Pour vinegar mixture over asparagus, tossing lightly to coat. Spread asparagus with grapes on the baking sheet. Bake 30 - 40 mins, turning halfway through. Serve warm or at room temperature with bagels.

title: Hot Mexican Chocolate Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 3 lbs velveeta cheese | 3 cups unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Shred cheese using a cheese grater, or a fine shredding disc. Melt the velveeta on a paper towels in a lighlt 2 litre microwave safe bowl or microwave on high power until it starts to get crispy, about 30 seconds. Remove cheese and cocoa from microwave with a slotted spoon, onto a board. Cut into pieces 1 wide by 2 wide. Dredge cheese to coat on all sides and set aside. Roll into a ball or two and then use as directed in recipe#433385 or as recommended in recipes #433385 and can be frozen for up to 2 months.

title: Grilled Honey Mustard Sandwich - Honey Mustard and Lingonberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons honey mustard | 2 cans british hamburger | 1 cup liquid honey ( you may need more if you want the honey mustard sauce to be runny )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the honey mustard and british hamburger meat. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Place on a hot grill. Grill for 2 to 3 minutes or until the meat is crisp and the sauce is bubbling. Serve with warmed buns.

title: Spanish Orzo Pilaf
ingredients: 1 package orzo pasta, cooked | 1 -2 tablespoon green chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cook orzo according to instructions, in a large skillet, saute the green pepper with the orzo, adding hot water, until liquid is absorbed. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: half,sherry wine,chestnut,corn syrup,ricotta cheese,chili oil,cannellini bean
title: White Bean and Ricotta Cannellini Bean Roulades
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 1 cup fresh ricotta cheese ( can be sub with half fat milk ) | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon corn syrup or 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon good extra dry sherry wine ( optional ) | 1/3 cup sweet chili oil | 1/3 cup diced dried sweet chili oil, for garnish if you wish (, if you don't care for it, omit the sherry )
instructions: In a large serving bowl or serving platter, stir together your cannellini beans, ricotta, half and half, corn syrup, sherry, and chili oil. Sprinkle top with chili oil, if using. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Cooks note, i like my ricotta to be slightly browned and creamy, but not soupy. If you want a thicker roulade with a thicker roulade, just mix all the ingredients together and pour into serving dishes. Serve with toasted baguette slices.

title: Guinness Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 500 lbs stewing beef, cut in 1 � inch cubes | 3 lbs pork shoulder roast | 3 lbs guacamole | 6 tablespoons amaretto | 4 tablespoons ginger | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 2 lbs avocados
instructions: Add all the ingredients to the crockpot and mix well for at least 4 hours. The next day, remove the string from the meat and discard. Cut into 4 serving size pieces. Serve with tortillas and sour cream, if desired.

title: Italian Girl's Faux Easy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | fresh ladyfinger, for dipping
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 425 degrees. Mix half of the ground beef with half of the ladyfinger in the bowl until well combined. Shape mixture into approximately 8 to 10 hot dogs. Bake in oven until well cooked, about 10 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,green chili pepper,beef sirloin,cooking oat,cumin seed,alfredo sauce
title: Mexican Piggy Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless beef sirloin ( cut into strips ) | 1 jar beef gravy or ( 10 ounce ) jar alfredo sauce | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 -3 cups quick cooking oats | 1 jar of chopped green chili peppers ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray 9 x 13 inch casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine beef and gravy mix in a bowl and stir to blend. Mix together oats, chili peppers, cumin and cumin seeds.

title: Crab Jollof
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 1 can crab boil | 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: In a 10 inch skillet, arrange steak in one layer. Sprinkle with half of the crab boil. Repeat layering.

title: Spätzle ( Brussels Sprouts Salad)
ingredients: 200 g brussels sprouts, washed and trimmed | 1 yellow onion, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence ( or 1 teaspoons vanilla extract ) | 1 cup of shredded lettuce
instructions: Wash and cut the sprouts. Slice onion and fry in butter until slightly golden. Add vanilla. Add brussels sprouts. Simmer till they are cooked. Remove from heat. Garnish with chopped fresh tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,bread,black sesame seed,raspberry vinegar,marshmallow,green pea
title: Raspberry Pudding With Gruyere Cheese
ingredients: 5 cups cooked white and wild rice pudding ( or whatever you do at home! ) | 1 package medium marshmallows | 2 cups grated gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup frozen green pea, thawed | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 1/3 cup raspberry vinegar
instructions: Prepare rice pudding according to package directions. Line a large platter with parchment paper or damp cookie sheets. Set aside. Melt marshmallows in microwave on high power until warm. Mix together with cheese until melted. Spoon over rice pudding, then sprinkle with pepper. Sprinkle with green peas, sesame seeds and vinegar. Serve warm.

title: Japanese Eggplant Fans (Fettucini Con Nigiri)
ingredients: 2 lbs japanese eggplants ( peeled ) | 9 large eggs ( poached ) | 2 cups water ( or as needed ) | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Put cleaned eggplant in a steamer basket that will fit inside a large saucepan, and steam over high heat until the eggplant collapses, about 10 minutes. Drain water from the steamer, and squeeze eggplant to remove the excess moisture. Cut an x into the bottom of each eggplant to allow steam to escape. Hold the x at the base of each eggplant, and carefully slip the eggplant into the steamer basket with the eggplant. Set the basket over simmering water, and steam until the eggplant is soft and the edges are light brown, about 15 minutes. Remove the basket. Pour a thin layer of cold or hot water over the eggplant to halt the cooking, and allow it to steam for 5 more minutes. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the water. Set aside. When the eggplant is cooked, remove the basket and drain it, and place into a bowl of ice water to cool. Carefully slice into 1/2 lengthwise slices. Place slices back into the bowl, and set aside. Cut 1 or 2 slices into a fan shape, then carefully fan the slices, cut side down, into 1/2 inch slices. Serve the fan topped eggplant Fans warm.

title: Swiss Cheese and Jalapeno Cornbread
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn ( about 4 1/2 lbs. ) or 4 corn on the cob ( about 4 1/2 lbs. ) | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons chili jelly | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded swiss cheese or 1/2-3/4 cup gruyere cheese | 3 tablespoons liquid honey | fresh ground pepper jelly, garnish | jalapeno chile, for garnish
instructions: Cut off and discard the silks and remove the kernels from the cobs, leaving in the cob. Remove the husks. If the corn is not large, cut up about 4 large kernels as above. With a mallet, or other large heavy frying pan, lightly pound the corn kernels or corn with a heavy metal mallet until coarsely ground. Set aside. In a bowl, combine the bread crumbs, chili jelly and cheese. Stir in the corn until well combined and thoroughly mixed. Stuff the corn kernels or corn on the cob. Place the corn in a large, nonstick skillet or griddle over medium high heat. Add enough water to cover the top of the corn. Reduce the heat to low. Cover the griddle and let steam for about 1 1/2 minutes. Turn the cornbread and push down with a wooden spoon, tilting the griddle to evenly spread the corn all over the surface. Let the cornbread cook, uncovered, for 30 - 45 minutes until tender and golden. Turn the cornbread over and sprinkle with ground pepper jelly. Serve immediately.

title: Spanish Quinoa Phyllo Salad
ingredients: 9 ounces quinoa | 12 ounces jar mandarin oranges, drained | 12 ounces spanish onions, drained | 8 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 4 tablespoons sugar, plus extra for sprinkling ( see note )
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and oranges, and then soak them in very hot water for at least 1 hour. Drain the orange rind with hands and cut the strips into thin strips. If any left over oranges are still liquidy, rinse them and remove the peel. Wash and dry the onions, remove the strings and any hard white ends. If the peel is large, cut off both ends and cut the root into thin strips. If you are using oranges that are whole, remove the peel, including membrane and heads. Add the oranges to the quinoa, the onions, and mandarin oranges. Arrange the sheets of phyllo on a clean, flat tray or in a very clean, lightly oiled bowl. Lightly brush the phyllo with oil and scatter with sugar. Place a piece of parchment or plastic wrap on top. Place the package of phyllo sheets on top. You could also use a sheet of brown paper. Bake the phyllo on a baking sheet at 325 degrees until the edges are golden but the phyllo still wiggles as it cools. Remove the package of phyllo from the baking sheet and place on a cutting board. Cut into 3 equal squares, then place the triangles on top of each other, and cut through the triangles at the cutting board.

title: Taco Dip
ingredients: 2 cups salsa | 1 can green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Warm the salsa and chopped green chilies with the oregano. Place the half and half in a bowl. Mix a bit of the cooled salsa mixture into the half and half. Spoon the mixture into a crock. Cover with the other half and sour cream. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Pepperon's Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1 cup low fat ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup diced green onion tops | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high, for easy sealing. Rub the tenderloin with the vinegar and place on grill rack. Cook to desired doneness, for about 20 minutes for medium rare. Let stand for 5 minutes. Slice against the grain of the meat and serve. Garnish with green onions and lime wedges.

title: White Kidney Bean Masala
ingredients: 1 can white kidney beans, dry | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 teaspoon ground coriander, or to taste | 2 teaspoons minced fresh galangal
instructions: Stir white kidney beans, garam masala, coriander and galangal in a saucepan over medium low heat. Cook until the flavors blend, stirring occasionally, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Savory Egg Noodle Curd
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1 cup egg substitute
instructions: Blend all ingredients until well mixed. Refrigerate until needed.

title: Saudi Spiced Tea - Pickum or Al
ingredients: 2 cups strong hot coffee, i use coffee brew mix, i use very close fat | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/8 teaspoon saffron ( optional ) | 1/2 tablespoon catsup ( optional )
instructions: Place ingredients in a small pot with a tight fitting lid.

title: Ww 5 Points - Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 fluid ounces vodka ( the good stuff ) | 1 lb button mushroom, halved if large
instructions: Pour the vodka into the sink, into a tall glass. Add the mushroom, cover with plastic wrap, and leave to sit in the refrigerator until ready to use. To serve, heat a match or a matchstick of small kitchen shears on a wooden skewer or a small piece of foil wrapped in a kitchen towel to keep it from sticking. Warm the mushroom on the grill or in the oven until the mushrooms are just beginning to curl slightly, 1 to 1½ minutes per side. Transfer mushrooms to a serving plate and drizzle with 1/4 teaspoon of olive oil. Wrap a piece of foil around each mushroom and serve.

title: Basic Oregano Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup oregano leaves, dried | kitchen bouquet
instructions: Combine oregano and kitchen bouquet, and store in refrigerator. Will keep in refrigerator for several months.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,chorizo sausage,tomato soup,green chilies,green food coloring
title: Mexican Chorizo Spiders
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chorizo sausage | 6 green chilies, halved lengthways | 8 ounces condensed tomato soup | 8 ounces apple juice ( heinz is best, but heinz brand is also okay. ) | green food coloring
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Mix the chorizo and chiles in a large bowl to break up any lumps. Stir in the rest of the contents of the ingredients and divide into 15 small patties. If you have any leftover sausage, place into a ziplock bag and brown in the oven for about 10 - 12 mins, depending on how thick or soft the sausage is. When browned, remove from the oven and allow to cool for 10 - 15 mins before cutting into small fingers. Serve with your choice of condiments, tortillas, cheddar cheese, or whatever else strikes your fancy.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,skewer,blueberry,spring onion,madras curry powder
title: Baked Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 2 chicken breast halves | 4 spring onions | 4 teaspoons madras curry powder | 1 pint fresh blueberries | 12 skewers
instructions: Put chicken, spring onions, curry powder, and blueberries on a large platter. Spoon blueberry mixture onto skewers and coat well.

title: Quickie Rice Bowl
ingredients: 6 cups cooked rice ( any type will do ) | 1 jar picante sauce ( i prefer `` medium '' heat ) | 7 large white mushrooms, sliced | 2 packages cheese, white cheddar and `` chesse blend cheese blend '' or ( 8 ounce ) package vegetarian cheddar and '' cheese blend blend | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 bunch fresh white mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Set oven to 375°. Prepare rice according to directions given. Stir cheese into prepared rice then spread in a very thin layer over the rice. In a small bowl, mash the cardamom with a fork or spoon to release the fragrance. Lightly brush cheese over the top. Arrange the white mushrooms over the cheese and place pepper of choice on top of the cheese. Cover in a 9x13x2 pan or large casserole dish, sprayed with oil and bake about 30 minutes. Top with mushroom slices and serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: french baguette,papaya,salsa,andouille sausage,brandy,strawberry jam,chipotle chile,beet leaf
title: Ww and G
ingredients: 1 french baguette, cut into 1/4-in slices | 1/2 cup brandy | 1/4 teaspoon papaya, minced | 1 1/2 cups peeled and sliced fresh strawberries or 1 1/2 cups papayas | 3 ounces andouille sausage, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons strawberry jam | 1 fresh chipotle chile, minced | 2 2 tablespoons strawberry jam or 2 tablespoons strawberry jam
instructions: Arrange bread slices on baking sheet.

title: Rice Noodle Parcels
ingredients: 300 g rice noodles | 150 ml double cream | 1/4 cup of fresh mint | mint, to serve
instructions: Cook rice according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, place cream and mint in saucepan over low heat and simmer 2 minutes or until reduced by half. Combine rice noodles and cream mixture in a large serving bowl and stir to combine. Divide between 4 serving plates, sprinkle with mint and serve immediately.

title: Pineapple Crackers
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornmeal ( not quick or fast ) | 2 tablespoons cornmeal, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. In a bowl, mix cornmeal and dry ingredients. Make a well in the middle of the dry ingredients and add water as required to mix well. Use a fork or spoon to flatten dough evenly. Place on cookie sheet and bake about 20 minutes or until golden in color.

title: Irish Whiskey Glögi
ingredients: 1 jalapeno pepper | 1 1/2 pints vegetable stock ( made with salt ) | 1 ounce irish whiskey ( made with a mixture of a pinch of black pepper, cloves, and salt )
instructions: Chop the pepper into thin strips, then put it in a large saucepan with 5 cups cold water and bring slowly to a boil. Meanwhile, bring the vegetable stock to the boil and add the jalapeno, cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes or until the peppers are tender. Remove from heat and reserve. Strain the poaching liquid through a fine sieve into a jug, pressing hard to extract all the juice. Return the strained stock to the pan, season with salt, then bring to the boil. Pour the mixture into a heatproof jug. Pour the whisky over the top, return to the boil and boil rapidly for 3 minutes, then pour into 4 warmed coffee mugs. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,apricot half,dill pickle,dark rum,corn oil,cayenne pepper sauce
title: Calypso Apricot Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 3/4 cups apricot halves, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 fresh dill pickle, minced finely | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 dash cayenne pepper sauce ( to taste )
instructions:
Dice apricots into a small bite size pieces. Mix remaining ingredients together with crushed apricots. Sour cream is good on the side as a dip wi 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Sauce can be made hours ahead. Keep refrigerated and reheated. Also delicious on sandwich buns.

title: Swiss Prosciutto & Chive Dipp
ingredients: 1/2 lb prosciutto or 1/2 lb italian bacon, chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, ground in mortar & pestle | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped ( or 2 tsp dried )
instructions: In a small skillet, sauté the ham pieces in a single layer of oil or butter over a medium heat until lightly browned. Spread a large plate on the ham to capture drippings. Add mustard seeds to mustard seeds and return to heat. Cook until they start to pop, pressing with a rubber spatula or spatula. Lower the heat, add chives, and cook until lightly darkened, about 1 - 2 minutes more. Sprinkle with salt & pepper to serve.

title: Potato Croquettes with Bacon and Peppers
ingredients: 8 small red potatoes, peeled and cut into quarters | 2 slices bacon drippings | 8 slices pepperoni
instructions: Place the potatoes in a saucepan and cover with salted water. Bring to boiling and then reduce the heat to low and simmer until tender, about 30 minutes. Drain and pat dry with cooking paper. While potatoes are cooking, heat the drippings in a skillet over medium heat. Crumble bacon into the skillet to make a crumbly mixture, add pepperoni slices and cook to warm through.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,soda water,brown mustard seed,cumin powder
title: Tandoori Biscuits
ingredients: 2/3 cup soda water | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Mix soda water, mustard seeds, and cumin together in a saucepan. Add enough soda water to give the mixture a thick consistency like biscuit dough consistency. Heat on low flame. Keep stirring biscuit dough until it become transparent and it has a deep reddish colour. When it cools on its own, transfer balls to a clean bowl and let them cool. Break or cut biscuits and toss them in the bowl with the biscuits. Store biscuits on an airtight tray in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,soymilk,mushroom,lettuce leaf,dill weed,white chocolate
title: White Chocolate and Soymilk Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 100 g white chocolate, finely chopped | 100 g fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup low-fat soymilk | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 3 teaspoons dill weed or 3 teaspoons dried dill weed | 2 large lettuce leaves, to serve
instructions: Place the chocolate, mushrooms and soy milk in a small bowl, season to taste with salt and pepper and mix together until the chocolate is melted and smooth. Add the oil and dill weed and mix together until all ingredients are just combined. Divide among the lettuce leaf wraps and serve with crunchy bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,cucumber,salt pork,chive,soy sauce,watercress,spanish onion,carob powder
title: Crazy Hot Taters
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb salt pork, cut into strips | 1/2 bunch chives, chopped ( optional ) | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon carob powder | salt and ground black pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup chopped watercress | sliced cucumber, for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinate pork in mixture for 3 to 4 hours. Serve on your favorite meal with bread or rice.

title: Mango and Onion Gravy
ingredients: 2 large mangoes, halved and seeded | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 liter vegetable stock
instructions: Cut mangoes into small pieces. Place the mango into a large pan or saucepan with the vanilla bean and 1/2 of the soup mix. Pour in the vegetable stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Turn off heat. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,chicken bouillon cube,pepper sauce,fennel seed
title: Dakota's African Dry Spices
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to combine all ingredients and shake well.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,lemon,sirloin,yellow onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese,sesame seed,salmon steak,parsley
title: Grilled Salmon With Peppered Onion Rice
ingredients: 2 salmon steaks | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh lemons or 1 tablespoon lime juice, to taste | rice wine ( to taste ) or dry vermouth ( to taste ) | 1 yellow onion, sliced | 1 1/2 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1 1/2 ounces mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Rinse the salmon under cold running water.

title: Caramelised Peach and Chile Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 red chilies, deseeded and finely sliced or 1 green chili, deseeded and finely sliced | 1 tablespoon light molasses | 200 g baby carrots | 1 small bunch spring onion, trimmed and cut into wedges | 1 fresh peach, halved and pitted
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a large bowl. Toss together gently until all ingredients are evenly coated. Cover.

title: Cherry Fizz With Pasta Fresca
ingredients: 375 g short-cut pasta ( penne or fettuccine, small stars ) | 1/2 cup soda | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and halved
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the directions on the pack, and drain. When cool enough to handle, cut into 1cm chunks. Arrange in a shallow dish. Combine the soda and cherries in a small, non stick frying pan. Heat gently, drop by drop, until all the surface is coated with soda. Add half the pasta pieces to the pan, and toss until golden. Turn into an individual serving plate. If using fettuccine, cook a few at a time in boiling water for 5 to 10 seconds, then drain. Top with the cherry mixture.

title: Baked Okra and Peas
ingredients: 1 lb frozen whole shelled peas | 8 ounces frozen okra | 2 -4 scotch bonnet peppers ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup margarine, melted | 12 slices provolone cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped fresh lime juice ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place frozen peas in a plastic freezer bag and microwave on high power, 1 minute increments, until defrosted and thawed. Set aside. Meanwhile, remove stem and seeds from okra and cut them into 1/2 pieces. Coat a 13x9 baking dish with butter or margarine and set aside. Place the frozen okra, peas and chile in the baking dish. Top with the cubed cheese. Drizzle with lime juice, and dot with butter. Bake 5 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly hot.

title: Broccoli Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, peeled | 3 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/4 cup crushed broccoli, defrosted
instructions: Cut potatoes into 1 x1 inch pieces. Place in a large nonstick fry pan. Pour hot sauce over potatoes and place under broiler. Broil uncovered for 7 - 9 minutes. Garnish with fresh crushed broccoli.

title: Tortillas Con Poblano Chiles
ingredients: 1 poblano chile, with seeds | 1/3 cup pimiento, diced ( optional ) | 3 plum tomatoes, sliced into thin slices | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | tortilla, cheese or sour cream, to serve
instructions: Roast the poblano directly over a medium flame and allow to blacken. Remove from flame, but leave in the flame for 3 to 4 minutes. Drain, pat them dry and remove the stems and seeds. Place the poblano in a bowl and stir in the pimientos and tomatoes. Toss well and set aside. Heat the tortillas in a dry frying pan for about 1 minute. Place the tortillas on plates and top them with the chile mixture. Garnish with the eggs and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,fajita seasoning mix,mushroom,farfalle pasta,chunky salsa
title: Southwest Mac 'n' Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta, cooked al dente ( bowtie ) | 2 cups mild chunky salsa ( i like medium or hot ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 1/2 - 2 cups chopped bell peppers ( i like medium or hot ) | 1 1/2 - 2 envelopes fajita seasoning mix
instructions: In large nonstick skillet, bring large pot of water to boil. Meanwhile, bring large pot of heavily salted water to boil. Add pasta to boiling water. Cook until almost al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, combine salsa and next 4 ingredients in bowl of an electric mixer. Beat on medium to medium high for about 3 minutes or until hot and butter foams in skillet. Add pasta to salsa mixture and stir well. Cover and refrigerate about 2 hours..

title: Spanakorean-Spinach
ingredients: 400 g fresh spinach, cleaned and finely sliced | 1 big pinch turmeric
instructions: Heat a little oil in a pot of a medium heat. When the oil is hot add the spinach. Do not stir, just shake the pot of spinach to keep it from sticking to the bottom of the pan. When the spinach starts to release its juices, stir the spinach once or twice. Add a pinch of turmeric and stir. Stir. When the pan of spinach starts to get slightly cooked, turn the heat off. Serve over white rice or with other indian dishes. Enjoy.

title: Mujadarra
ingredients: 1 cup white rice | 2 cups vegetable juice ( v8 ) | 3 scallions, chopped into strips
instructions: Bring all ingredients to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat and simmer covered tightly for 15 minutes. Remove from heat, then stir in scallions.

title: Champignones (Champurrado Con Champignones)
ingredients: 1 lb ham, cut into thin slices | 1 lb button mushroom | 1 lb fresh button mushroom, blanched | 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: Combine the ham slices, mushrooms and wine in a heavy 12 skillet. Cover and simmer over moderate heat until tender, about 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Fusion Mix, Moroccan Chickpea
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried chickpeas | 1/2 cup paprika | 3/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight in 8 cups cold water. Drain chickpeas, reserving soaking liquid. Place in large pot and cover with 4 cups of hot water.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,champagne vinegar,leaf spinach,chicken breast,tomato juice,beef consomme,hot paprika
title: Chicken in Spanish Sauce
ingredients: 8 whole chicken breasts | 2 containers beef consomme | 1 jar pimiento, drained and cut into thin slivers | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1 tablespoon champagne vinegar | hot smoked paprika | 6 leaves escarole ( cremolata or green leaf lettuce )
instructions: Rinse chicken and remove excess fat and tendons under cold running water. Dry chicken on paper towels and place in a shallow 8 x 11 baking dish or dutch oven. In a medium size cooking arrangement, combine broth ingredients and simmer over medium low heat, covered, for about 20 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear. Remove chicken to platter and cover to keep warm. Pour off all excess fat from pan. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees. Add hot smoked paprika slivers. Arrange chicken slices evenly in pan and cook about 10 minutes, turning once, or until golden brown and slightly crispy.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,black olive,whipping cream,italian seasoning,cream chicken soup,guinness stout,chicken stock cube,red chili pepper
title: Guinness Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 12 ounces guinness stout | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 chicken stock cube, crumbled | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup black olives | 1 long red chili pepper, seeded, chopped ( leave seeds if you're using it )
instructions: Sprinkle the inside of a large pan with the italian seasoning. Brown the meat in a pan, drain and return pan to the heat. Meanwhile combine the soup, guinness, cream of chicken and italian seasoning and pour on to the meat. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until the meat is cooked. Mix the black olives together to make it stick together. Add the sliced chili and simmer for another couple of minutes, taking care not to let it burn. I just remove the chili and allow it to cool down before i dig inches stir in the sour cream. Serve over noodles.

title: Meatball and Rice Soup
ingredients: 350 g dried noodles | 150 g ground meatballs | 400 g medium grain rice ( cooked )
instructions: Wash rice well with water and leave in a clear teatowel. Drain water and then boil the noodle for about 10 minutes. Rinse with hot water and drain thoroughly. Add ground meat to the noodles and combine well. Then place in a covered bowl and either put in refrigerator or leave in the fridge for an hour or so. Bring to boil the 4 litre stockpot and when boiling, add noodles and rice and mix well. Cover and bring to the boil again and then reduce to a simmer for about 20 minutes.

title: Beef Tenderloin with chilies
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin ( or 3 slices of loin ) | 3 tablespoons shortening, softened | 1 3/4 cups canned diced tomatoes with ketchup | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded italian cheese blend
instructions: In a skillet, melt shortening, add tomatoes, lemon pepper and meat tenderloin. Cover and cook over mediun heat 15 - 20 min or until internal temps rise to the doneness of your liking. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and return to heat until cheese melts and starts to melt.

title: Kellymama (Greek Wedding Soup with Chicken)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken meat, preferably breast or 1 1/2 lbs lamb meat | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 1 lb fresh kellymama, peeled
instructions: Cut meat into 1/2 inch pieces. Put maraschino cherries, in a glass bowl, pour chicken or lamb fat over them and marinate for at least 8 hours, preferably overnight. Add the kellymama to the soup and simmer gently for 30 minutes. Serve at once, or refrigerate up to 3 days. Note, a good rule of thumb is 1/2 oz chicken fat and 1/2 oz lamb fat.

Random Ingredients: topping,champagne,lemon juice zest,tequila,jiffy corn muffin mix,white wine vinegar
title: Champagne Pie
ingredients: 1 box jiffy corn muffin mix | 1 cup white wine vinegar ( not seasoned ) | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice ( not the bottled kind, just the bottled kind ) | 1 cup champagne | 1 cup grated low-sodium tequila | 1 carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Prepare the dry corn muffin mix and set aside. In a large bowl, mix the dry corn mix with the vinegar, lemon juice, cheese nosedly, and champagne. Transfer the mixture to a sprayed 9 inch pie plate or a 8 inch square baking dish that has been lined with wax paper. Distribute the frozen whipped topping evenly over the top of the corn batter. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 30 minutes, or until lightly browned and bubbly, or serve warm.

title: Hot and Spicy Sausage Toast
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 2 slices bread ( texas toast or other dense bread of your choice ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 1 teaspoon coarsely chopped serrano pepper | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Remove the casings from mild italian sausage and finely grind with a mortar and pestle. If using texas toast toast break into pieces, but leave to soak for 45 minutes. Remove the casings from the hot italian sausage. Cut the sausage into thin slices and arrange them in a flat layer on a serving platter. Sprinkle with the lemon peel, serrano pepper, and vanilla and lightly salt. Dip both sides of the toast into the sausage mixture and allow to soak for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator. Serve.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,apricot,tuna fish,horseradish,beef bouillon granule,apple,dark rum,yellow bell pepper
title: Cherie's Spicy Tuna Fish Casserole
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dark rum, divided | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 beef bouillon granules | 16 ounces tuna fish, drained | 1 large yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 apple - peeled, cored and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine 1 tablespoon rum, garam masala, and beef bouillon granules in a bowl, and stir to combine. Toss tuna, yellow bell pepper, apple slices, horseradish, and remaining rum mixture with the remaining 1 tablespoon rum mixture. Press mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish or coat with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 35 minutes.

title: Tuna, Squash and Orange Salad
ingredients: 200 g tuna, cut into 1cm pieces | 1 yellow squash | 1/2 cup orange juice, fresh preferably | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons bacardi bacardi rum
instructions: Steam the squash for about 4 – 5 minutes, or until just softened. Remove squash from microwave and let cool slightly. Grate the skin and flake the flesh. Squash should have about 2 3mm/1/4 inch cubes. Peel and cut the yellow squash into half lengthways, remove the cores and seeds and chop into 1 cm cubes. Rinse the tuna and pat dry. Place in a bowl with the chopped squash mixture and add the orange juice to bind. Pour over the tuna and mix. Serve with lots of chutney i use tabasco guacamole dressing.

title: Baked Mango Chutney Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mango chutney ( major grey's chutney ) | 2 teaspoons horseradish | 4 heads romaine lettuce | 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Stir the mango chutney and horseradish together. Set aside. Roast the lamb on a rack in a roasting pan, seasoned with salt and pepper, for 40 minutes, turning at least once. Baste as you roast and cook 20 minutes more, or until it reaches a temperature of 375 degrees f. Meanwhile, shred the romaine lettuce. Set aside. When the lamb is finished, drain off excess olive oil. Transfer to a plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,malt extract,peanut,nut,lemongrass,ricotta cheese,flat leaf parsley,pepperoncini pepper
title: Lemongrass and Lemongrass Torte  (Rice Vegetable Salad)
ingredients: 4 ounces sweet rice wine or 4 ounces dry sherry | 1 cup fresh flat leaf parsley | 1 fresh lemongrass, inner part only, bruised and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons peanuts, lightly salted and coarsely ground | 1 -2 teaspoon malt extract or 1 -2 teaspoon vegetable extract | 8 -10 medium pepperoncini peppers, thinly sliced ( about 32 ) | fat, to coat | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese or 1/2 cup cottage cheese, cut into chunks
instructions: Combine the rice wine, parsley, lemongrass, peanuts, and a pinch or two of the salt in a large bowl. Add the extract or vegetable extract and stir well. Add pepperons and cheese in batches, reserving some cheese. Cover and chill for two hours to marinate. Bring to room temperature before serving. Serve warm or cold.

title: Green Chilies - Lal Mirch Ki Ka Ray
ingredients: 2 pinches fenerated green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/4 cup green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Heat some oil in a pan.

Random Ingredients: lite olive oil,asparagus,catsup,chipotle chile,dark sesame oil,swordfish,caraway seed
title: Smoked Swordfish and Asparagus
ingredients: 1/4 cup lite olive oil | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, in adobo sauce | 1 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 8 ounces thinly sliced asparagus | 2 swordfish ( about 1 lb. )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, mix together the oil, sesame oil, catsup, and chipotle. Season the fish with salt and pepper, and then divide the mixture evenly among 4 pieces of parchment paper. Top with the asparagus. In a large skillet over medium high heat, combine all the ingredients for the sauce. Cook 2 minutes, or until the sauce boils and thickens slightly. Transfer the steaks to the plates, and top with the asparagus.

title: Avocado and Pesto Dip
ingredients: 4 large ripe avocados, peeled, halved and stoned | 1 cup creme fraiche | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Place the avocado flesh and remaining ingredients in a food processor or blender, pulse or blend, until smooth. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and refrigerate overnight to develop flavours. Serve with fresh vegetables, such as grated or croutons.

title: Homemade Ginger Paste
ingredients: 1 cup fresh ginger, chopped | 1 cup fresh parsley root, chopped ( roots should be cleaned and outer leaves removed. )
instructions: Place ginger in a medium bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 2 hours. The longer it is refrigerated and the sharper the flavor the ginger will be, the faster it will be sold. After about 3 hours stir the ginger into the parsley root and let sit in the refrigerator for 1 - 2 hours. Strain the ginger out of the bowl through a fine mesh cheesecloth or a coffee filter and discard the vegetables. Enjoy note, the idea is to soften the ginger in the bowl and let it firm up a bit. Also, it won't taste the same after sitting for 1 - 2 hours as it will become a bit more pronounced.

title: Beef Kebabs With Tzatziki Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb boneless sirloin steak | 1 -2 tablespoon liquid smoke, for basting | 1/2 cup tzatziki ( to garnish ) | 2 cups basmati rice or 2 cups whole grain rice, cooked
instructions: Spray a grill rack or broiler rack with veggie spray or lightly oil the grill. Cut sirloin steak across the grain into 1/4 wide strips. Place pieces on grill and grill on high for 20 minutes for rare, about 10 minutes for medium or longer and the longer the grill time, the more tender they will be. Transfer beef to a cutting board to rest. Dice the beef into very thin strips if desired. Combine the liquid smoke and tzatziki in a small bowl. Cut the cooked beef into thin slivers. Taste tzatziki sauce and adjust seasoning. Place 1/4 of the beef on each serving plate, top with spicy tzatziki sauce and top with remaining beef.

title: Nuoc Cham (Curried Spiced Rub)
ingredients: 1/2 cup curry powder | 2 tablespoons ground chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 2 teaspoons lime, rind of
instructions: Stir together curry powder, ground chipotle powder, ground cardamom powder, cardamom powder and lime peel in a medium bowl. Cover and set aside at room temperature for 24 hours. Rub the spice mixture onto your work surface and work your way up the bowl with the spices. Store covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Fusilli With Cod and Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb cod ( fresh or frozen and thawed, about 1 1/2 pounds ) or 2 1/2 lbs bass fillets ( fresh or thawed, about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 jar pimientos, drained and cut in half | 1 teaspoon garlic granules ( or use garlic powder or salt mixture of garlic and onion powder to make your own ) | 1 lb fusilli
instructions: Place the fish in a sauce pan with 2 quarts salted water. Cover. Bring to a near boil. Decrease the heat. Boil, covered, for 10 minutes. While the fish is cooking, put the garlic and pimentos into a food processor and blend into a paste with 1/2 cup water, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder and salt. In a large pot of boiling water, cook the pasta until al dente. Drain and place into a large bowl. Add the cod to the boiling water and cook for no more than 1 minute. Drain the pasta well and add to the drained cod and pimento mixture. Stir well to combine. To serve, place 2 - 3 slices of pasta on 4 plates or bowls, top with the cod mixture and serve.

title: Mushroom Cakes
ingredients: 1 cup white mushroom, chopped | 1 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon tahini
instructions: Combine and mix well. Form into small cakes about 1 - 2 inches tall at once. Dip in melted butter, coat well and fry. Serve as a side dish for casserole or on as a burger bun.

Random Ingredients: green olive,seasoning salt,red chili powder,half cream,self rising flour,italian seasoning,flat leaf parsley,chicken stock cube
title: Crazy Oven Fried Shrimp With Olives
ingredients: 3 tablespoons self rising flour | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 sprigs flat leaf parsley | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 1/2 cups half & half cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 cup green olives, pitted and sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to mix the flour, red chili powder, seasoning salt and parsley in a large mixing bowl. Heat a small fry pan over medium heat. Add 2 tablespoons olive oil to the pan and swirl around the base of the pan. Pour in the half & half cream to the pan. Heat gently for approximately 90 secs until the cream is quite thick, stirring intermittently. Stir in the italian seasoning. Transfer the mix to a large oven proof dish. Place the shrimp on top of the cream mixture and pour over the half & half mixture. Scatter the olives around the edge of the pan. Cover with foil and bake for 10 - 12 minutes. Remove foil and bake under the oven for 15 minutes, or until bubbling around the shrimp. Serve over white rice.

title: Baked Cardamom Fontina Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fontina cheese | 2 teaspoons whole cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a mixing bowl, combine the fontina cheese and cardamom seeds. Stir in the cheese until it is thoroughly coated. Spread the mixture evenly onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool on a wire rack.

title: Sweet Onions
ingredients: 1 large bermuda onion, halved | 2 teaspoons granulated sugar | tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the onions on a broiler pan broiling on the rack 3 inches below the heat. Broil about 5 minutes for medium rare, or as close to the heat as the broiler allows. Turn them over, and broil 3 minutes more. Remove the onions from the oven, and place them in a large resealable plastic bag. Paint with the sugar. Press the bag lightly into the onion. Turn the bag over so the onions are in a single layer, and broil 5 minutes longer, or until onions are golden and caramelized. Serve warm, topped with tortilla chips.

title: Zucchini With Banana
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini | 3 tablespoons lime juice ( about 3 limes ) | 1 banana, sliced
instructions: Prepare grill, setting the rack 3 to 4 inches from the heat. Wash the zucchini and cut off stem ends. Cut each into half lengthwise into 4 wedges. Arrange the zucchini halves in a shallow baking dish. In a small bowl, stir 2 tablespoons lime juice with 1/4 cup water. Place the wedged zucchini into the lime water and let stand for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the banana. When ready to serve, spread the zucchini wedges on a baking sheet and grill, turning once, until slightly charred, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Serve the zucchini hot with the banana.

title: Somali Rice
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous rice ( known as `` soya '' in hindi ) | 1 1/2 cups water, more according to package directions to prepare rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 1 ripe tomatoes puree, finely diced ( known as `` soya '' in hindi ) | 2 tablespoons sweet roasted pistachio nuts ( known as `` kaala '' in hindi ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed asafoetida powder
instructions: Heat a pan on medium flame. Pour some oil in it. Carefully stir in asafoetida. Stir fry it until it leaves the sides of the pan. Remove from flame. Pour the 1 1/2 cup water in a large, wide pan. Add rice. Add more water if rice looks dry. Add asafoetida, tomato puree, and pistachios. Stir fry for a few minutes on medium flame. Remove from flame. Serve hot with fresh mint chutney and/or kulcha leaves.

title: Cranberry Tarragon Meringues
ingredients: 4 large egg whites | 1/3 cup finely minced cranberries | 3 tablespoons dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f. Have all your ingredients chilled and ready to use. Using a pastry brush, paint the inside of each cookie with the tarragon. Place the meringue on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake until the center is just browned, about 25 minutes.

title: French Classic Melting Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, leaves, outer leaves removed | 3 tablespoons grated lowfat gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup whiskey, double strength | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice, plus a little more | onion or lemons, thinly sliced, to serve | crushed iceberg lettuce, for serving | 12 ounces cooked ham, thinly sliced to serve
instructions: Place a large heatproof serving plate on your stove and set over a low heat. Heat 1 tablespoon of the grated cheese until hot but not bubbling. Remove from the heat and quickly sprinkle over the cheese, stirring in until melted. Stir in the whiskey. Remove the cheese from the heat and stir in the fresh lemon juice. Toss the dressing with the lettuce leaves until all of them are coated completely. Arrange the warm cheese salad on warmed plates and sprinkle with ham slices. Serve immediately.

title: Pounded Cheese (Antilles or Gruyere)
ingredients: 12 ounces gouda cheese, about 6 1/2 ounces ( or substitute swiss or gruenster ) | 1/4 cup finely dry-roasted mustard
instructions: Cut cheese into 5 cubes. Spread or brush outside of cheese with mustard. Place in a shallow 1 1/2 quart microwavable microwavable baking dish. Coat dish in a slow oven or oven set to high. Microwave about 5 1/2 tablespoons of cheese at a time, stirring after every minute throughout cooking, until cheese is melted and smooth, about 7 minutes total.

title: Ranch Tostadas or Beans
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans ( navy beans ) | 7 ounces mexican cheese ( shredded, if desired ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 2 chopped fresh saffron chilies
instructions: Rinse and rinse beans, discarding the beans that are attached to the rib bones. Place beans in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: wheat pastry flour,veal,corn tortilla chip,beef chuck roast,graham cracker crumb
title: Texas Lasagna With Beef
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 28 ounces of shredded reduced-fat graham cracker crumbs | 16 ounces of deli sliced deli corned beef slices | 2 packages of corn tortilla chips | 1 cup of crushed graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Brown meat on all sides in a small amount of oil or a combination of the two mixtures. Drain. Arrange meat into a lightly buttered rectangular pan. To crack cracker crumbs sprinkle the bottom layer of graham cracker crumbs evenly over the meat. Place a layer of beef slices over cracker crumbs. Top with a layer of cracker crumbs. Cover with sliced deli corned beef slices. Repeat steps 710 with tortillas, beef and cheese until all ingredients are used. Sprinkle top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350 degrees in a preheated oven for 1 hour. Remove from oven and let sit for 10 minutes then serve piping hot. These are delicious with fresh salsa, guacamole, sour cream, and cheddar cheese. Note, if you use an 11x17 pan, you can use the 13x9 baking pan in place of an 11x5 pan. If you use a 9x13 dish of same size, you can add 1 can of the chili sauce in the can before serving, plus add the amount of the chili sauce needed before topping the meal. The 2 x11 pan makes 3 lasagna portions, about 3 - 4 servings per serving. Note, you should be able to buy 11 x 7 pan instead of 3 baking pans. A 13x9 baking pan also makes a good for leftovers.

title: Homemade Mallow Chips
ingredients: 8 ounces sweetened marshmallows | 3 cups malt vinegar
instructions: Combine the marshmallows and vinegar in a large bowl. Leave to cool to room temperature. Add the marshmallow mixture in a food processor or blender along with the malt vinegar. Process until the mixture has the texture of coarse breadcrumbs. Store in an airtight container until needed.

title: Dark Chocolate Spiced Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup long grain basmati rice ( i use long sushi or long brown rice ) | 6 -8 ounces dark chocolate ( i don't really measure this ) | 1/4 cup shredded sage leaf
instructions: Heat the rice in a pot, covered, with boiling water for about 10 minutes. It will take at least a 20 minutes. Meanwhile cut the chocolate into small chunks. Drain the rice into a bowl using a colander into a pan of boiling water. Leave it for 1 minute. Drain the rice into a sieve, pressing with a spoon to extract excess water. You could use the back of a spoon to press out as much water as possible, but it will be difficult to do once your hands go wet. Set a large bowl over medium heat. Make sure the bowl is big enough to hold all of your rice balls and is set as well, or it will melt into mush for the rice balls. When the rice balls have cooled slightly, add about 1 tablespoon of the melted chocolate to them. Sprinkle 2 handfuls of the rice onto your hands, squeezing with your fingers to moisten and soften the grains. Fold the rice lightly together with your finger tips. Make the dough into 10 balls and roll each ball between your palms until the outsides are smooth and well sealed. Place the rice balls on a lined tray, and chill until firm. Sprinkle the remaining 1 handful of melted chocolate around the rice balls. Place the tray into your refridgerator for 6 hours, so the chocolate will be set at this point.

title: Easy Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 4 canned chopped apricots, drained | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 dash hot pepper sauce to taste
instructions: Stir the onion, apricots, picante sauce, and hot pepper sauce together in a bowl. Refrigerate at least 1 hour to marinate.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,chive,fire tomato,sirloin,wild rice,anise seed,red chile pepper,marsala wine
title: Randy's Steamed Beef & Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 pound ground sirloin or other lean ground beef | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1 dried red chile pepper, seeded | 1/2 pound wild rice, cleaned and cut into 2 inch pieces | 1/4 pound salt pork, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 can fire-roasted tomatoes in tomato sauce | 4 chopped fresh chives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a mixing bowl, mix together the ground sirloin with the marsala wine, anise seeds, red chile pepper, wild rice, and salt pork. Stir in the tomatoes with their sauce, chives, and chives. Divide the meat mixture into 8 portions. Place them close together in a large disposable foil roasting pan, or a glass baking dish, and pour 1/2 cup of water around the meat. Roast for 30 to 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until no longer pink. Serve with more brown sauce, if desired.

title: Simple Brown Rice
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces white pearl brown rice | 1 1/2 ounces simple syrup ( maple syrup )
instructions: Rinse brown rice in strainer. Combined brown rice and syrup.

title: Spanish Rice With Olives and French Bread
ingredients: 300 g short-grain rice ( arborio rice preferred ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 3 1/4 cups green olives, coarsely chopped ( about 12 large ones, pitted ) | 2 cups bread, cut into chunks ( about 60 long slices ) | 2 tablespoons hoagie roll ( i use gluten-free ) | 1 teaspoon sage ( optional ) | 8 small sachets french bread | hoagie roll, for serving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/400°f/gas wash and soak the rice in hot water, about 30 minutes, then drain. Combine the dried thyme, chili oil and olives in a small bowl and mix well. Sprinkle over the rice in a large baking dish. Cook in the oven for 15 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 140°c/120°f/gas bake for 30 minutes, or until just firm to the touch. Remove from the oven and let stand for 15 minutes. In a large, deep skillet, toast the bread pieces for a few minutes or so on each side. Divide the bread into two. Break apart the rice with two large forks and add to the bread along with the sage and olives. Top the rice mixture with the remaining bread chunks and the roll. Serve in a shallow bowl with plenty of crusty bread for dipping.

title: Bratwurst Burger
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground beef sirloin | 1 pound hot italian sausage | 1 large egg, whisked | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 teaspoon ground balsamic vinegar, or as needed
instructions: Heat a grill for high heat. Add ground beef, sausage, and egg to the work bowl of a food processor.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,vegetable oil cooking spray,tomato green chilies,chili oil,english cucumber,leg lamb,crouton,oregano
title: Pueblo Indian Grilled Lamb
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless leg of lamb, cut into 2-inch cubes | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups diced peeled mild italian cucumbers | 1 large english cucumber, halved lengthwise, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 teaspoons dried oregano, crushed ( mexican oregano ) | crouton ( optional )
instructions: Season lamb with salt and pepper and lightly coat with cooking spray. Place on a rack set in a baking dish coated with cooking spray.

title: Prawns Omelette (Australian)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb fresh shelled prawns | 8 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/3 cup quick-cooking sherry | 6 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Cook prawns in large frying pan in 1 1/2 tbsp oil over medium high heat, turning once, until they turn opaque, about 2 minutes in all. Remove prawns from pan, and set aside to cool slightly. Halve the eggs lengthwise. With a slotted spoon, break yolks into bowl, set aside. Remove from cooking pan and set aside. Add remaining oil to pan and heat, and then add reserved prawn mixture. Turn heat down to medium. Cook until shrimp are pink and cooked, around 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sherry, and serve over the egg slices.

Random Ingredients: cooking tapioca,pumpkin seed,tamari,red kidney bean,eggplant,sausage meat,tomato sauce,spaghetti
title: Tropical Spaghetti and Sweet Potato
ingredients: 1 eggplant, sliced ( about 1 lb. ) | cooking tapioca | 1 lb sweet potato, peeled and diced | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 6 ounces smoked sausage meat, chopped | 1.5 cans spaghettini ( or other short pasta )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease casserole dish or large rimmed baking sheet. Place eggplant in a bowl.

title: Ciabatta & Peanut Tea Bread
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 stale ciabatta, sliced thinly | 1 -2 cup peanut oil | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 2 cups brewed tea, cold | fresh cilantro, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Remove bread from crusts and cut into 1 inch cubes. Dust with cold water and set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes. Pour oil into a roasting pan about 3/4 inch thick. Heat to 350 degrees. Add bread, turning occasionally, into hot oil. Fry bread until golden in color, about 5 minutes, turning and adding more oil as necessary. Sprinkle toast with cornstarch. Add the golden syrup and hot tea. Cover and transfer to oven. Bake until hot through and toasted about 25 minutes. Serve warm, warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,corn syrup,golden syrup,red chili,beef chuck,bread flour
title: Nee's Favourite Beef Satay (Satay)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, trim off most fat | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 3/4 cup dark sesame oil | 6 tablespoons bread flour | 2 tablespoons red chili, finely chopped ( i prefer jalapeno or cayenne pepper )
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Slice beef in half, then cut each half in 2 pieces. Place in a non reactive large bowl and pour over golden syrup. Marinate at least 1 hour or overnight. Mix corn syrup, dark sesame oil, and bread flour. Place the beef in the oil mixture. Dredge each piece of beef in the thick mixture. Put the meat on to a rack in a foil covered baking pan and bake until it starts to brown, about 1 and 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,french dressing,glace cherry,american cheese,chunky salsa,green cardamom
title: Mini Southwestern Cheesecakes
ingredients: 150 g american cheese | 1/4 cup italian dressing | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 green cardamoms ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili sauce, such as tabasco | 2 tablespoons green glace cherries, chopped, optional
instructions: Place the cheese on a baking tray. In a bowl, combine the dressing, salsa, cardamom, chilli& pepper. Stir this mixture into the melted cheese. Add the chumpen cherries and mix lightly together. Spoon the mixture into mini muffin tins. Chill until firm.

title: Angel Hair Pasta Al Pomodoro (Angel Hair Pasta With Caramelized Caramelized Caramelized Caramelized Carrots)
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup fresh oregano leaves, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces angel hair pasta, cooked and drained | fresh oregano leaves ( for garnish )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 4 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: head romaine lettuce,coriander seed,black bean,ice cube
title: Ranch-Style Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 3 cups drained canned black beans | 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces | 1 tablespoon coriander seeds, crushed | 5 ice cubes
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together black beans, romaine lettuce, and coriander seeds. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or overnight. Once chilled, shake well to crush and stir into salad.

title: Chinese Peas
ingredients: 1 lb peas, shelled | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Pick through the peas and discard any damaged or stones you may find them in. If they can be picked through just make a couple of taps on the counter. Heat the oil in a frying pan and add the peas and sesame oil. Stir fry until the peas are tender, remove from the pan and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,tortilla,beef stew meat,jam,brown sugar
title: Spicy Chipped Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 jars jam | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper flakes | 5 tortillas
instructions: Place beef in crock pot. Add remaining ingredients stir. Cook on high for 6 hours. Roll tortilla and place on warm serving platter and cut in 4 wedges. Spoon beef mixture over tortillas. Serve with salad.

title: Homemade Sweet and Sour Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sweet and sour italian dressing, bottled or 6 tablespoons other light flavor italian dressing, bottled or, bottled | 1 can coconut, unaged, shredded or 1 cup sweetened flaked coconut | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Drain all the sweet and sour dressing through a fine sieve, discarding the solids. Shake or blend coconut in a bowl with the sweet and sour dressing and mix well. Heat a small nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Sprinkle the coconut with the chili oil and then drizzle the coconut mixture onto the pan, allowing an even coating of coconut. When the coconut begins to turn golden, stir the coconut occasionally for 2 minutes.

title: Honeydew Melon With Parsley & Fontina
ingredients: 2 lbs navy beans, soaked and drained | 1 cup honeydews melon, seeded, sliced into 2 rounds & boiled until tender | 1/2 cup matzo meal | 4 ounces fontina cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place the beans, salted water, and honeydew melon spears in a 2 qt casserole dish. Sprinkle with matzo meal. Top with fontina cheese & bake until cheese melts. Serve with bread.

title: Green Chili Onions
ingredients: 2 pounds frozen pearl onions, thawed and drained | 1 can chopped mild green chile peppers | 1 strip lime peel
instructions: Place the onions, green chiles, and lime peel in a stockpot. Pour in enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook for 30 minutes, or until onions are tender.

title: Frugal Gourmet Broccoli and Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons currants, plus | 1/2 tablespoon currants, for garnish ( gourmet version ) | salt pork ( bob evans is a supermarket brand ) or salt shrimp-flied bacon, diced ( bob evans is a supermarket brand ) | 4 cups broccoli florets, cut into bite size pieces | 1 tablespoon grated peeled fresh gingerroot | 1 teaspoon packed brown sugar
instructions: Place currants in a shallow dish. Bring a kettle of salted water to a boil, cook the currants until tender, about 3 minutes. Drain. Heat a large wok over high heat. Add the pork, and sear until no longer pink, abot 20 seconds. Add the broccoli, sprinkle with gingerroot and sugar, and toss. Garnish with currants.

title: Baked Black Olive Bruschetta
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pitted black olives, chopped | 1 loaf italian bread, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the olives onto the cut side of the italian bread. Arrange the slices of italian bread in an 8x8 inch baking dish. Pour the remaining olive tapenade over the slices. Cover loosely with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes.

title: Spicy Hot Corned Beef and Stampkraut
ingredients: 1/4 cup seedless strawberry jam | 1/4 cup rosemary | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 2 tablespoons chili flakes ( or to taste ) | 2 pounds corned beef brisket | 1/4 cup stoned stampkraut rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place jam, rosemary, chili flakes, corned beef and 3 or 4 round sheets of waxed paper in a large, heavy duty plastic bag. Seal and toss to evenly coat. Place corned beef on top and seal bag. Arrange about 1/2 cup ginger slices on top of the brisket, then 1/2 cup seedless jam and 1/2 cup seedless jam on top of that. Wrap bag with another sheet of waxed paper. Place bag on top of roasting rack. Place roasting rack in a large roasting pan. Cook in preheated oven for 5 to 6 hours, or until fork tender when pierced with a fork. Check internal temperature before slicing into 1/2 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,celery rib,honey,pea,vegetable stock,cream mushroom soup
title: Rosemary Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 lb dried peas, soaked overnight and drained | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon chopped rosemary leaf | 1/2 teaspoon honey | 2 celery ribs, diced
instructions: In skillet, combine soup, stock, rosemary, and honey. Heat through. Serve hot with a side of celery.

title: Korean Spicy Crabmeat Balls
ingredients: 1 lb crabmeat | 1/4 lb chopped chile ( red and green ) | 1/4 cup palm sugar or 1/4 cup packed light palm sugar | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( or more if desired ) | 1 teaspoon chile sauce ( i prefer garlic ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and work into meat ball size pieces. Refrigerate covered until ready to use as the flavors mellow away. Drain and serve as a snack. Can be frozen for up to 1 month.

title: Mexican Orzo With Chipotle
ingredients: 1/2 cup orzo pasta ( arborio rice ) | 1 cup sultana | 1/2 cup diced onion ( spanish onion is what we like best ) | 2 large chipotle chiles in adobo ( can find in latin or mexican food food section of store ) | 2 tablespoons cinnamon | 1 can diced tomatoes with jalapeno peppers | 1/4 cup vanilla bean
instructions: Boil orzo with 3 cups of water, until done, about 15 minutes, until water is absorbed. While the orzo is cooking combine the 1/2 cup orzo, sultanas, diced onion and diced chipotle peppers in a large bowl. Stir in the cinnamon and minced tomatoes. If you want, mix in the 1/4 cup of vanilla bean. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,cooking oat,poblano chile,monterey jack cheese,kaffir lime leaf,coriander powder
title: Mexican Oatmeal (Aka Oatmeal)
ingredients: 1/4 cup ground poblano chile, in the powder type | 1 kaffir lime leaf, torn | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 1 teaspoon coriander powder ( i use 1/2 t., but if you use a pinch of turmeric then it can be adjusted ) | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat up the oil in a large skillet and add the ground poblano. Sprinkle with the sesame oil and chopped lime leaf, tossing until the poblanos are softened. Add the oats and coriander powder and toss until well mixed. Add the cheese and toss until the cheese starts to melt. Pour onto a plate and serve warm or cool.

title: Prawns in Chocolate-Papaya Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup jumbo shrimp, shelled deveined and deveined | 2 poblano peppers | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/4 cup soymilk | 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate morsels, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f peel peppers, removing membrane from pobs and seeds. Place in a large bowl. Combine cream, milk, and chocolate morsels. Pour over peppers. Mix with a fork until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or longer. Spray a cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray. Put 1/2 cup of pan mixture in bowl. Place shrimp on top of 1/2 cup of mixture. Top with remaining pepper mixture. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup chocolate morsels to serve.

title: Lidia's Mediterranean Slices
ingredients: 16 ounces black olives, pitted and coarsely crushed | sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, crush the olives with a fork. Dredge the olives in salt and pepper. Set them aside to dry for about 10 minutes.

title: French Beans
ingredients: 1 can french beans | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Empty can of beans into blender, add 1 cup of broth, and blend on high for 5 seconds. Pour into large bowl containing liquid, stir in molasses and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,poblano chile,cooking oat,cilantro stem,quinoa,wheat flour
title: Quinoa Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 2 poblano chiles, minced | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/2 cup dried quinoa | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh cilantro stems
instructions: In large bowl, stir together oats, flour, chiles, pine nuts, and quinoa until well blended.

title: American Kitchen Classic Veal and Beet Pie
ingredients: 5 ounces ground veal or 5 ounces beef | 1 lb ground beet, cooked, peeled and chopped fine | 1 can canned beets, well drained and finely chopped | 4 cups cooked matzo rice, well drained | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup basmati rice, prepared as directed on package
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a large bowl, mix ground veal, beets and beets. Stir in matzo rice, baking powder and remaining 1/4 cup of mayo. Gently stir in as much remaining 1/4 cup mayonnaise as needed to moisten. Spread in prepared pan. Bake 40 - 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,white wine,anchovy,egg,kaffir lime leaf,chunky salsa,phyllo pastry,pepper sauce
title: Spicy Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 2 packages philadelphia cream cheese, cubed | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa, divided | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 3 kaffir lime leaves | 1 tablespoon white wine | 4 slices egg, lightly beaten | 1/8 teaspoon pepper sauce | 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed and frozen
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. In medium bowl, beat cream cheese with hot sauce, 1 tablespoon salsa and one tablespoon salsa. Spread 3/4 cup chunky salsa over a 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Unroll phyllo, covering all sides and leaving about 1/2 inch at the edges. Brush phyllo with beaten egg. Starting on one end, roll up crosswise, jelly roll style with seam to seal. Using a sharp knife, spread each sheet with about 1/2 cup cream cheese mixture and roll up. Arrange 2 phyllo wraps seam side down on foil coated baking sheet. Spread remaining 1/4 cup chunky salsa over tortillas. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until pastry is golden. Serve with remaining salsa and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,chicken meat,nutmeg,parsley flake,mint leaf,italian salad dressing mix
title: Cilantro Mint Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken meat | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix ( dry envelope ) | 3/4 cup fresh cilantro stems, chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley flakes | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves
instructions: Cut chicken into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Place chicken in medium bowl, sprinkle with salad dressing mix, cilantro, parsley, nutmeg and mint leaves. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours and as long as overnight. Bring to room temperature 30 minutes before serving. Dip in marinade and let sit 30 minutes before serving, turning to coat.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,chunky salsa,garlic salt,basil,spinach,bread flour
title: Spinach Salsa Focaccia
ingredients: 1 can spinach, drained and squeezed dry | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, diced | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a medium bowl, combine all the ingredients. Mix well. Transfer to a baking sheet. Bake at 375f for 20 minutes, or until bubbly and warmed thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,mung bean sprout,nonfat milk,miracle whip,masa harina,cayenne,celery,cajun seasoning
title: Creamy Masa Sprout Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb mung bean sprouts | 1 celery, diced | 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup masa harina | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning
instructions: In a large pot cook the sprouts. Drain.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,rice vinegar,double cream,vegetable oil,cream,sun tomato oil
title: Broccoli Risotto With Sun-Dried Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 12 ounces broccoli florets | 5 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons cream | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil ( drained and chopped ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar ( or white vinegar ) | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: Drain and wash broccoli florets and blanch in rapidly boiling water for 1 minute, drain. Cook broccoli in 2 tablespoons of hot water for the last minute of cooking. Drain and cool completely. Heat the oil in a large, heavy saucepan and stir in the tomatoes and their juice and the vinegar. Cook, stirring over low heat for 5 minutes. Stir in the cream and cook until thick and creamy. Toss the drained broccoli with half of the dressing in a bowl or warmed serving dish. Spoon the other half of the dressing over the vegetables and serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,mandarin orange,marjoram,arborio rice,onion flake,beef stew meat,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Beef Risotto with Orange
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 4 ounces beef stew meat, cubed ( i like the sweet red pepper, but it can also be use brown ) | 2 tablespoons onions, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried red pepper | 4 ounces mandarin oranges, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 cup arborio rice, long-grain or 1 cup medium grain rice
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet. Add beef and cook until browned. Add onion and saute for 3 minutes. Add marjoram, red pepper, and mandarin orange and stir to combine. Add rice and stir to coat, about 30 seconds. Add enough water to cover rice.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate molasses,parsley leaf,parsley flake,serrano chilies,chicken thigh,chuck,phyllo pastry,green cabbage
title: Spicy Chicken Parcels on the Grill and Thighs, With Crisp Phyllo Pudding
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, boneless, skinless | 8 sheets phyllo pastry ( thawed if frozen ) | 1/3 cup parsley flakes | 4 serrano chilies, thinly slice, seeds removed | 1 head green cabbage, thinly slice | 1 cup pomegranate molasses | 1/3 cup flat-leaf parsley flakes, leaves | 16 ounces of chopped pomegranate molasses | 4 sprigs parsley ( for garnish )
instructions: For the phyllo pastry, place thawed phyllo sheets on a board lined with plastic wrap and place over a board with plastic wrap. Lightly butter one sheet and spray it with cooking oil. Repeat wrapping the phyllo sheets under plastic wrap until all sheets have been painted and coated with oil. Place 2 chicken thighs in each phyllo sheet, placing them about 1 inch apart. Sprinkle each stack lightly with parsley flakes. Using sharp knife or very sharp knife, cut the chilies lengthwise into 1/4 inch wide slices and place them on a piece of plastic wrap, overlapping the slices slightly so they are parallel and not overlapping the chicken. Arrange the chilies in a single layer on 4 sheets of phyllo. Brush with a bit of pomegranate molasses. Sprinkle each stack with 2 more chilies, then top with another sheet of phyllo and brush with pomegranate molasses. Repeat layering ingredients, using the plastic wrap between stacks. The phyllo and chicken stack should almost fit in a rectangle. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight. Preheat the grill at medium high heat and oil the grill grate. Place the stack of phyllo on the grates, close the lid and press down to remove excess moisture. Grill the stacked stacks of phyllo stacks about 3 to 6 minutes per side, until crisp and lightly browned. Remove from the grill and cut into 4 squares. Place 1 square stack of phyllo on a dinner plate and top with 1 to 2 more squares of phyllo. Continue with 4 more squares of phyllo. Continue with the remaining stacks, brushing stacks with pomegranate molasses and 4 more squares of phyllo. Grill the 4 stacks under medium high heat until the phyllo is browned and the tops are bubbling. Top with the chopped parsley and serve as part of a natural side dish. Tips, you can replace the chicken thighs with bacon. You could also use beef, shrimp, or chicken breast instead of chicken. These could also be used on the chicken or fish.

title: Braised Beef with Fresh Ginger (Gado Gado)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh ginger root, minced | 1/4 cup fish stock | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh mint | 2 pounds boneless bottom round steak, cut into 3-inch strips
instructions: To make the ginger wine, place a skillet over medium heat and stir often until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Stir in the ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in the fish stock and mint.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,fish sauce,mineral water,chili flake,cream chicken soup
title: Mexican Fish Sauce - Like Taco Bell's Copycat Recipe
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 ounce taco seasoning | 3 teaspoons chili flakes | 1/2 cup mineral water | fresh fish sauce ( i like blue lion brand ) or chili sauce ( i like blue lion brand )
instructions: Mix the above ingredients in a large saucepan and bring it to boiling. Once boiling it can cook longer, or it will get soggy. When the fish sauce is to your liking and the desired balance of flavors is achieved remove from heat and take a bowl and dip the bowl into the boiling fish sauce, you can use it to make burritos as your burrito/cacao filling to save time i did not use fish sauce, it was just because i liked the flavor.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,lemon juice,ginger,pumpkin,rigatoni pasta,white flour,grand marnier,chicken breast
title: Chicken and Macadamia Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white flour | 500 g pumpkin, canned | 250 g rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1 tablespoon ginger, fresh | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemongrass, chopped fresh | 300 g chicken breasts, chopped into chunks | 3 tablespoons lemongrass, chopped fresh | 5 teaspoons grand marnier | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice
