instructions: Mix flour, pumpkin and lemon grass together, put into a large freezer bag. Seal the bag. Add chicken breast and toss to combine in the bag. Seal and place in the freezer again and refrigerate for 1 hour or more. Add to the rigatoni and mix well. Pour mixture onto the steamed tray and cook in a preheated oven on 190c until top is golden and bubbling. Heat the sauce ingredients in a small pot, stirring continuously for 2 or 3 minutes until hot. Remove from the stove and serve over the hot noodles.

title: Quick Taquito Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant mace | 2 teaspoons taco sauce, regular or hot
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl. Mix well. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,red curry paste,tilapia fillet,spice,white vinegar,marjoram,pecan
title: Spicy Beef Jerky With Parsley
ingredients: 4 whole tilapia fillets | 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 1/2 lbs chopped pecans | 6 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Trim separable fat from fillets and remove any excess. Cut into 5 inch sections and place on cutting board. With kitchen scissors or sharp kitchen shears, or cleaver, snip each section to a length of about 3 inch wide. With your sawing motion, place a portion of the curry paste around each section. Sprinkle with marjoram and red curry paste. Dry the fish with kitchen towels and blot dry with paper towels. Line a sheet of plastic wrap with aluminum foil and lay a piece of fillet in the center. Wrap the entire piece of fillet around the fillet and set on plastic wrap. Refrigerate at least 6 hours, or up to 8 hours. The curry will keep at room temperature for a week or two if refrigerated. Prepare a fire in a charcoal grill, wood or a gas grill. Place a piece of reynolds wrap parchment paper or aluminum foil in the middle of the grill and place the fillet on top. Cook 15 minutes, then flip and cook 10 minutes more. When the fish is done, remove from the grill and let stand 2 minutes. Transfer the fish onto a large plate, cover and let rest at least 10 minutes, then slice thin. Serve warm. Makes about 9 servings.

Random Ingredients: molasses,poppy seed,cognac,vegetable oil cooking spray,picante sauce,flat leaf parsley,red cabbage
title: Poppy Seed and Corned Beef Hash # 6
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup chopped red cabbage | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon molasses | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed | 1/2 teaspoon finely snipped flat leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon cognac or 1/4 teaspoon caribola
instructions: Place a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add vegetable oil. When hot, add cabbage and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes then add picante sauce, molasses, poppy seeds and parsley. Reduce heat to low. Continue cooking and stirring for 2 to 3 minutes or until mixture is hot, but not dry, and cabbage is heated through. Stir in cognac or caribola.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,caraway seed,provolone cheese,salt black pepper,black bean,beef stew meat
title: Southern Style Swiss Steak
ingredients: 3/4 pound beef top round, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 teaspoons caraway seed | 1 1/2 cups marsala wine | 1/2 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray heavy 2 quart casserole dish or baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange beef slices in one layer in dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Arrange one half of black beans over beef. Sprinkle with one half of caraway seeds. Repeat two times with remaining black beans, caraway seeds and one half of wine. Top with cheese. Bake in preheated oven until meat is cooked through and center is hot and bubbling, about 1 hour. Let stand for at least 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg,cumin seed,flour tortilla,orange,lemon pepper,cognac,champagne,grain white rice
title: Champagne Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice or 1/4 cup vermouth | 1 -2 teaspoon cumin | 1 1/2 cups arborio medium grain white rice, cooked | 2 tablespoons cognac | 2 eggs, hard boiled, chopped, peeled | 1 lemon pepper, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 12 flour tortillas or 24 corn tortillas
instructions: Mix together the orange juice and cumin in a 3 qt casserole dish. Add rice, cognac, eggs, lemon pepper, and salt. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Gently heat tortillas in oil on both sides. Stack 2 torillas on each plate, top with 1/2 cup rice mix, and serve.

Random Ingredients: zucchini lengthwise,herb,rice,lamb fillet,chicken wing,egg yolk,raspberry,white onion
title: Yummy Lancashire Hot Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb fillets, cut into slices ( lean ) | 1 white onion, chopped | 4 cups chicken wings, tips removed | 1/4 cup mixed herbs, chopped ( parsley, basil ) | 1 egg yolk, slightly beaten | fresh raspberries, to serve ( optional ) | cooked rice ( optional )
instructions: Place lamb in a large bowl. Add chopped onions and herbs. Mix together, then lightly beat egg yolk with a dash of water. Pour over lamb. Mix well. Arrange chicken wings around the edge of the lamb. Pour the yolk mixture and egg over. Cover with foil, then a double layer of cling film. Refrigerate for 6 hours, shaking the dish occasionally. Before serving arrange raspberries on top. Serve with cooked rice, if desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: gala apple,apricot,cherry tomato,clam juice,coffee granule,shoyu,garlic powder,serrano chili pepper
title: Apple-Cherry Clam and Apricot Jerk
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried apricot, cut up | 12 clams in shell, with juice ( reserve juice and cover ) | 12 cherry tomatoes, cut up | 1 serrano chili pepper, stemmed and deseeded | 3 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon shoyu | 1/3 cup hot cherry juice
instructions: In a non reactive bowl, combine aprice, cherry tomatoes, serrano pepper, instant coffee, garlic powder, shoyu and hot cherry juice. Put mixture into dehydrator. Turn on temperature to dry ingredients, so cherry tomatoes, tomato, and serrano pepper are just turning from black to red before dry. Dry ingredients are ready and can be stored in a spice bag. It will keep for 6 months in the freezer.

title: Creme Fraiche With Crispy Brown Sugar
ingredients: 300 ml creme fraiche | 1 1/2 teaspoons light brown sugar | 60 g peanut oil, for greasing | 2 -3 teaspoons butter, melted
instructions: In a medium bowl, cream the creme fraiche until it's smooth and creamy. Stir in the brown sugar and set aside. Heat the oil in a non stick frying pan for 2 minutes or until warm. Add half the butter and allow it to foam. The oil will swirl around the bottom of the pan at the same time. Add the remaining butter and, when it foams, pour in a ladleful of the sauce. Keep adding the butter 2 tablespoons per drizzle at a time until you have a consistency pleasing to you like. Allow the sauce to come to a bubble up the sides of the pan, then pour in the creme fraiche and pour it all over the top of the finished sauce. Mix in the crispy brown sugar.

title: Hot Bok Choy
ingredients: 2 bunches baby bok choy or 4 bunches spinach | 1 dash sweet and sour sauce | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 dash liquid smoke | 1 dash cinnamon ( i omit this, but it adds more flavor ) or 1 dash green peppercorn, to taste ( i omit this, but it adds more flavor )
instructions: Rinse baby bok choy and drain in colander. Heat corn oil over low heat in a large skillet or wok. In a bowl, mix sweet sour sauce with liquid smoke. Add to the skillet with the bok choy, tossing to coat. Add a dash of cinnamon or pepper. Stir fry for 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Sargento Salami, Salad With Raspberries and Goat Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package of fresh salami | 1 package tandy goat cheese, chevre, soft chevre | 1 package fresh raspberries | 1 green pepper ( optional )
instructions: Remove the salami from the package, it is very easy to slice it so keep a slice of salami next to your green pepper if you don't like it that way. Cut the salami into small pieces. Mix the cheeses together until the cheese is creamy and the salami is all sliced into small bite size pieces. Add the raspberries and green pepper, mix well. Serve over hot greens.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,rice noodle,cauliflower,topping,corn oil,palm sugar,cream chicken soup
title: Cauliflower Noodles With Noodles
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, broken into small florets, blanched | 1 package rice noodles | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/2 bunch chopped fresh coriander or 1/2 bunch chopped fresh cilantro | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 -2 cup enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f place uncooked rice noodles on a baking pan and cook for 15 minutes. Drain noodles and transfer to a large bowl. Set aside. Mix soup, coriander, sugar, oil and soup well.

title: Chinese Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs pork tenderloin | 3 carrots, cut in 1/2
instructions: Place pork in a ziplock bag with two large spuds. Marinate overnight in the refrigerator. On a cookie sheet, combine carrots and pork. Sprinkle all over with paprika. Cover and refrigerate for one to two days turning a handful every so often as it dehydrates. Remove pork from marinade. Place a heavy sauce pan on the burner of your stove. Drain carrots and pork and use for basting. Pour in a cup of cold water until it reaches 2 cups in diameter. This will be used to keep from reducing saltiness of pork before serving, as it will continue to cook after cooking. The amount of marinade used will vary according to the size of pork, but you can eyeball this as it is about 1 lb of meat.

title: Ginger and Garlic Dipping Sauces for Picnics and Seafood
ingredients: 1/2 cup lard | 4 cloves garlic salt | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, minced | 1 tablespoon serrano chile pepper, minced | 12 ladyfingers | 1 pound tomatoes and turnips - peeled, seeded, and chopped | 2 cups beef stock | 1 cup pickled gingerroot, sliced
instructions: Mix together the lard, salt, garlic salt, ginger root, chile pepper, and ladyfingers in a bowl. Add the tomatoes and turnips.

title: Linguine With Noodles and Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb dried linguine ( rotelle ) | 1/2 cup bucans in nut anchovies ( toasted ) or 12 ounces feta cheese ( crumbled ) | 1/2 cup cottage cheese, well drained | 1/4 cup vermicelli, broken into pieces ( or more ) | 1/2 cup chopped nuts ( or more )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until the pasta is tender and drain. Toss with bucans and cottage cheese, then top with the vermicelli. Sprinkle with peanuts. Can be served with warm bread.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,parsley,picante sauce,potato starch,triple sec,rice,green food coloring,yellow onion
title: Mexican Sweet Potato Pie
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes sticks with onions | 1/2 small yellow onion, sliced | 1 tablespoon parsley | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, divided | 12 ounces sweet potato starch ( not sweetened, you will have to drain it ) | 3 1/2 - 4 1/2 tablespoons rice or 3 1/2-4 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup triple sec or 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/3 cup picante or 1/3 cup other light red wine | 12 drops green food coloring
instructions: In a large bowl combine sweet potato starch, 1 tablespoon of the taco seasoning, rice, chopped chopped onion, 2 tablespoons of the pck's, parsley and 1/2 teaspoon of the taco seasoning. Beat well until smooth. Roll into a ball. Coat bottom and sides of a 9 inch cake pan with cornstarch. Roll ball carefully into cornstarch. Place in the pan. Beat remaining 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, 1 tablespoon of pck's, rice, chopped onion, 2 tablespoons pck's & rice mixture and 3 drops of worchestershire sauce.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,tequila,shallot,confectioner ' sugar,apricot,garlic salt,ice water
title: Curried Dried Apricots
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups minced shallots | 2 teaspoons crushed garlic salt | 1 teaspoon mild red curry paste ( or more if desired ) | 3 tablespoons tequila ( i use braggs ) or 3 tablespoons molasses ( i use braggs ) | 3 tablespoons prepared red curry paste | 1/4 cup ice water | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar, for dusting ( optional ) or 1/2 cup confectioner'sugar, for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine shallots and garlic salt. Sprinkle the hot paste on the shallots, and let stand for 20 minutes. Remove from refrigerator, and mix well. Stir in remaining condiments. Cover and chill several hours. Dust with sugar at serving time.

title: Manchego & Walnut Refresher
ingredients: 4 teaspoons vodka | 1 tablespoon purple onion ( finely chopped ) | 2 cups manchego cheese ( finely shredded ) | 3/4 cup walnuts ( flaked ) | 1 can red kidney beans ( drained & rinsed well ) | 1/4 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Combine vodka, salt, pepper & garlic powder in a small bowl & set aside. Combine onions and cheese in bottom of a medium sized pot, then add the walnuts & cook just till lightly browned. Next add beans & walnuts, stirring till mixed. Add vodka mixture. Spread all ingredients over the top when mixture is in the pot & on top. Cook until cheese is melted and mixture is bubbly.

title: Ham and Farina Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked farina or 1 cup other farina | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 1/4 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon minced roasted deli ham or 1 tablespoon other deli ham | 2 slices sourdough bread, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 c. Combine farina, rice, salt and pepper in a medium size bowl and knead, adding a bit of warm water if you do it excessively thin. Add ham to rice mixture, stir and set aside. Place bread on baking tray and bake for about 5 minutes. When bread is toasted and warmed up, add mixed spice and spread to toast on bread. Serve risotto with cooked farina mixture and more toasted bread.

title: Greek Celery Yogurt (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 1 cup fat free greek yogurt ( or store bought ) | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped ( about 1/2 cup )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Garnish with sliced or diced sweet onions, grated zest of a vegetable such as lemons, grated carrot, or zested fresh parsley and garlic.

title: Yummy Linguine With Meat
ingredients: 1 kg ground chuck | 1 large spanish onion | 4 slices breadcrumbs | 1/2 tablespoon za'atar spice mix | 1 tablespoon veal, grated | 1/2 tablespoon dry roasted salted peanut butter | 80 g linguine
instructions: Cook linguine according to directions on package. Rinse and dry linguine. Combine meat, onion, breadcrumbs, za’atar and veger. Drain pasta and make into desired shape in a large pan. Cover with meat mixture and add the salted peanut butter and mix well. Enjoy.

title: Potato, Mushroom and Poppy Seed Filling With Pasquali Nibbles
ingredients: 4 lbs new potatoes, unpeeled | 1 dozen mushroom, sliced | 1 cup half-and-half | 2 heads kombu ( mushroom cap ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh poppy seed | 1 tablespoon grated parmigiano | 12 tablespoons chopped fresh mushrooms | kombu, sauce ( to garnish, see recipe )
instructions: Place unpeeled potatoes in a large enough pot with enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil and then simmer until tender. Drain well and set aside to cool slightly.

title: Homemade Parsley Sauce & Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 1/4 cups fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Mix together and taste for seasoning.

title: Guilt Free and Chunky Pea Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen green peas | 3 tablespoons sultanas | 1/4 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a non stick frying pan on medium heat and add the peas. Stir them for about 10 minutes or until they're warmed and tender, tossing regularly. Toss with the sultanas and 2 tbsp of the oil. Mix well. When the peas are cool, scatter over the mixed salad and serve with extra guacamole.

title: Cheater's Indian Corn Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen corn, thawed ( fresh corned beef, thawed or canned ) | 1/2 cup light tasting ketjap manis | 2 ounces low-fat icing sugar | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, chopped, leaves only | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1/8 teaspoon ground coriander ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon italian spices ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon crushed cumin powder | 1/3 cup low-fat yogurt
instructions: Place the corn in a bowl with all of the other ingredients. Mash the ingredients with a fork. Add yogurt and mix, again, to blend. If you have any leftover corn, you may use it to glue the edges of your potato or potato croquettes together in your cake tin. It is not necessary to decorate this dish with it. Cover & refrigerate at least for about 1 - 3 hours or overnight. Best eaten the evening before making this dip. You may garnish it with fresh basil, paprika, or paprika if desired as well as a teaspoon or two of roasted red peppers.

title: Candy Cane Sour Cherry Pudding
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups table cream ( do not use condensed ) | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 2 tablespoons dry table cream ( do not use condensed ) | 2 tablespoons cherry cola
instructions: The day before serving add the caraway seeds to the table cream and stir until they have melted. When ready to proceed, add the table cream to the sour craisins and stir to mix well. Serve with fresh fruit and crème fraîche on the side.

title: Cashew Edamame Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs edamame ( cooked shelled ) | 7 ounces raw cashew halves | 2 ounces veal, cubes | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 cup olive oil | 2 teaspoons ground cloves | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil ( to marinate )
instructions: Place shelled edamame, cashews and veal cubes in a pan and cook over a high heat to reduce and cook until the nuts are soft. Drain the edamame and cashew nuts, reserving liquid. Puree the remaining liquid ingredients in blender with the reserved edamame liquid, blending well, and add back to pan along with the reserved liquid. Bring to boil and lower to simmering for two minutes. If the sauce thickens too much, remove lid and reduce slightly to your desired consistency.

title: Chicken Mexican Style
ingredients: 2 cans chicken legs | 1 cup flour tortillas
instructions: Place chicken legs in a deep pot and cover with water. Bring to boil and then simmer covered, for about 45 minutes. Drain chicken and reserve. Discard onion and reserve. Remove any bones and skin from chicken. Place chicken back into pot and simmer for 10 minute. Heat tortillas in a large skillet, flipping over to make sure both sides are well browned. Place a few toothpicks onto each piece of tortilla and cover with a spoonful of chicken. Roll tortilla around chicken and secure with toothpicks. Serve immediately or refrigerate until serving time.

title: Beer-And-Pepper Beef Burger for Two (4)

instructions: Place marinade ingredients in large bowl. Add steak.

instructions: Wash prawns.

title: Chorizo Fried Steak

instructions: To cook, cut sausages lengthwise. Remove skin. Slice crosswise into 1/2 thick slices. Place one slice in fry pan and sprinkle with a little oyster sauce. Dip the top slice of sausages side by side in hot broth. Remove after 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,cabbage,wheat flour,taco seasoning mix,vanilla extract,co lettuce,daikon radish
title: Kelsey's Hawaiian Potato Cakes

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the flour, taco seasoning mix, sugar, and vanilla in a large bowl. Add the shredded cabbage, radishes, and dannon cabbage. Mix until coated thoroughly with the mixture. Form into patties, and place on a large, nonstick baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until evenly browned, about 25 minutes.

title: Soy Vegetable and Chicken Soup
ingredients: 4 chicken wings | 1 cup baby spinach | 4 ounces portobello mushrooms | 1 ounce steakhouse premium tea | 1/2 red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Chop the chicken wings into 3 - 4 bite sized pieces and fry quickly in a pot along with mushrooms and steamed spinach until the mushrooms are cooked and the steak is cooked. Add the tea and chilli powder. Chop the chicken sausage into bite sized pieces and add along with the spinach and let the soup simmer on the stove top for 5 more minutes. Eat the soup with toothpicks.

title: German Cheese Cocktail
ingredients: 12 ounces old cheddar cheese, shredded ( or your favorite aged gese ) | 1 tablespoon powdered lavender | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice, drained and liquid reserved
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except the pineapple with juice and stir until well blended. Pour into a funnel shaped into cocktail glasses and chill at least an hour. Garnish with pineapple slices and sprigs of mint. This can also be served cold.

title: Lemongrass Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup low sodium beef broth | 2 stalks fresh lemongrass, trimmed, leaves cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/3 cup fat-free sour cream | 4 teaspoons reduced-sodium prepared broth
instructions: Place the beef broth and lemongrass in a blender or food processor and process until pureed. Season with chili flakes and sour cream. Transfer the blended beef mixture to a saucepan and heat through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,feta cheese,asparagus,apple cider vinegar,chocolate,cannellini bean,raspberry vinegar
title: Asparagus, Baked Beans, and Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup cranberry beans or 1/3 cup cannellini beans, cooked | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped | 1/3 cup raspberry vinegar | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 cup fresh asparagus, ends removed cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f bake beans until just tender crisp, not mushy. Cool. Place beans and next 4 ingredients in small saucepan to blend. Cook and stir over medium heat until cheese melts. Cool slightly place cheese mixture on serving plate. Top with warm beans and top with asparagus.

title: Grate American Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs american cheese
instructions: Dunk the cheese in a large bowl with cold, salted water. Change the water a few drops a time so that the cheese can absorb more of the water. Put the cheese in your sink and wash away any water. When cheese is cool, melt it over a low flame with the water in it stirring frequently. It must slowly melt into a fine liquid that has no clumps in it. Pour this into a warmed serving plate. This tastes good as a sandwich or with sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,masa harina,thai red chili pepper,mint leaf,tortilla,prosciutto,black olive
title: Pseudo
ingredients: 4 cups masa harina | 1 teaspoon of fresh mint leaves, finely chopped | 1 large yellow pepper, minced | 3 -4 slices prosciutto, thinly sliced ( or use ham slices ) | 1/2 cup black olives, sliced | 1 fresh thai red chili pepper, minced ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup of freshly minced mint leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 cup of freshly minced yellow pepper ( optional ) | soft corn tortilla
instructions: Pour the masa harina in a mixing bowl, add the mint leaves, yellow pepper, prosciutto and black olives. Mix the ingredients well until they form a paste like dough. Wrap the masa with plastic wrap, and store it in the fridge at least 2 hours before using. Note, the number of servings can vary, depending on how thick/thin you want the masa to be. I usually make each person's masa harina before eating, but we like them to be left out. To make them thinner, just mix them in the hands a bit at a time and knead them a bit between hand. The texture should be soft and not mushy. You add more if necessary. Divide the masa into the number of servings required for your meal. I usually start out with 2 cups of masa harina. The amount in the recipe is also relevant to how dry masa will be. You may not need to use all of the spices, so keep an eye on it, and make the batch accordingly. For instance, you will need to mix the ingredients for the amount of bread you will be eating. Make sure you use bread that is good, but not too stale. You can even use feta cheese for a variation, although for me, feta does an excellent job of making the feta thinner than the feta. When it comes to slicing, the feta should be pretty much falling apart. Note, if you want to do this, you can omit the mint leaves by making it without putting the mint leaves in it.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,orange bitter,mirin,pearl barley,liquid smoke,macaroni,onion salt
title: Barley Risotto With Cheese and Orange
ingredients: 3/4 cup pearl barley ( i also recommend rinsed ) | 2 tablespoons instant dried onion salt | 2 cups canned macaroni, rinsed and drained ( any macaroni will work too ) | 2 cans solid whole milk-packed light cream of bitter cream or ( 12 ounce ) cans regular full fat sweetened condensed milk | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika, preferably hot paprika
instructions: Place barley and onion salt in a medium saucepan.

title: Arora Pad Thai
ingredients: 10 ounces wide egg noodles | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 cup guacamole, to top
instructions: In a large pot of water, cook the noodles until done and drained. Then, drain the noodles, rinse, and dry them. In a serving dish, combine the cream, mirin, and curry over medium heat, and heat up the cream mixture. Add the drained noodles, and allow to warm, but do not boil. Serve topped with the guacamole.

title: Roasted Corned Potatoes With Parmesan Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil or 1 tablespoon other oil ( i use olive oil, but whatever you like best ) | 3 1/4 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and quartered ( can use small yellow potatoes ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, finely shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f brush a 12x16 baking dish with a little olive oil. Combine the oil and parmesan cheese and set aside until later. Spread the potatoes in the baking dish, then coat each side generously with the cheese. Bake for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,heavy whipping cream,pomegranate seed,puff pastry
title: Pomegranate Puff Pastry Triangles
ingredients: 24 puff pastry sheets | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds | 2 tablespoons lemon juice and zest | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Spread the pitemeat on one sheet of the puff pastry and sprinkle the seeds on the other sheet. Brush the pomegranate seeds and lemon zest onto the exposed puffs. Whip the cream until frothy and brush on the poppy seeds. Roll each sheet of pastry into a log and press the seams together. Cut each log into triangles and arrange them on a jelly roll tray. Bake the phyllo trimmings for 15 minutes, keeping an eye on them as they are quite dark. Leave them to cool on a rack.

title: Apple, Potato, and Bean Salad In Crock Pot
ingredients: 12 ounces dry noodles, prepared according to package | 1 small red potato, thinly sliced, about 1-1/4 cups | 3 cups cut-up red potatoes | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 4 ounces cooked small french bread cut in half ( about 1/2-1 cup ) | 12 ounces fresh french country-style fresh cheese slices, cut in half crosswise | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 12 -14 ladyfingers, split
instructions: Combine dry noodles, potato slices, kidney beans, bread, cheese slices, and lemon juice in crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours. Uncover crock pot, stir well to combine, and continue to cook until beans are heated through. Serve warm over biscuits.

title: Miniature Leeks With Feta Spread
ingredients: 1 can green chili | 1 can pineapple-flavored amaretto | 1 tablespoon grated leek | 1 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup crumbled feta | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Chop chilies and pineapple until they are roughly the same size as apples. Mash, mix thoroughly and set aside. Mash cream cheese until smooth. Stir in chili powder, lemon juice, amaretto, cheese, cheese, cornstarch, mustard and pine nuts. Transfer to serving bowl. If desired, garnish with toasted pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,egg yolk,bow tie pasta,white flour,whipping cream,tomato,white fish fillet,basil leaf
title: White Fish Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillet | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 egg yolk | 1/2 pint whipping cream | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 3 large tomatoes, diced | 8 ounces bow tie pasta
instructions: Dice or mince fish. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp flour and add 1 tsp basil. Combine 1 cup cream and egg yolk. Add a little cold whipping cream, mix. To make tomato sauce, combine 1/2 cup cream and 1 tbsp flour and cook over low heat until mixture thickens for about 5 minutes, it doesn't need to boil. Add more cream to thin out and add salt and pepper. Remove from heat, stir in remaining chopped tomato. Cook pasta as directed on packet. Combine sauce with cooked pasta and toss.

title: Baked Mexican Chicken Breast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 2 tablespoons diced green chilies | 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts ( cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes ) | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place oil into 9x13 inch casserole dish and set aside. Place green chilies in a medium bowl and set aside. Add chicken to bowl and toss until coated with green chili oil. Place chicken into the casserole dish on one rack. Repeat with remaining 3 chicken breasts. Spray a sheet of foil with nonstick spray and place two casseroles in the oven, uncovered. Bake 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 15 minutes longer.

title: Sicilian Zucchini
ingredients: 1 large zucchini, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 teaspoons dried red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine the zucchini, red pepper flakes, and salt to taste in a mixing bowl and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: Madeira Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups madeira wine ( or other sweet dessert wine ) | 3 cans low sodium chicken broth | 1/2 whole vanilla bean, split lengthwise ( optional, see note below ) | 2 tablespoons chopped serrano chilies | 1/2 carrot, peeled cut into 1/2-inch dice
instructions: Rinse the madeira in a clean glass or porcelain bowl.

title: Chipotle Garlic
ingredients: 2 chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or your hands, make the adobo peppers. Put the pepper into the bowl with the salt. Stir and rub the salt into the pepper until the salt completely dissolves. Store the salt in small jars in the refrigerator. Use to flavor meat, salads, burritos, or burritos with shredded chicken, beef, or lamb..

title: Chilled Cheese With Leeks
ingredients: 4 leeks, thoroughly washed, white and tender green parts only, trimmed, rinsed, and thinly sliced
instructions: Place the leeks in a saucepan with plenty of water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer very gently until the leeks are just tender. If liquid doesn't completely cover the leeks, drain away any liquid. Drain the leeks, and slice in half lengthwise. Place the sliced leeks in a bowl and add the cider vinegar. Stir until well combined. Serve from the bowl with a salad on the side, or in a small bowl to dip into the vinegar.

title: Vanilla Bean Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth, warmed ( or 2 1/4 cups stock or chicken broth, depending on which you prefer ) | 1/2 vanilla beans or 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 biscuit, sliced into thick, puffy pieces ( for the freezer ) | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: In 2 - 3 quart saucepan combine chicken broth, vanilla bean or extract and biscuits and heat until biscuit is heated through. Remove biscuit mixture to a large bowl and reserve. To the broth mixture in pan, add enough cheese to taste and blend with fork until cheese is completely melted. Add reserved biscuit mixture to the pot and return pot to a full simmer. Remove the pot from heat and transfer mixture to your serving bowl. Serve immediately or heat as directed on recipe.

Random Ingredients: sage,maple syrup,whiskey,brown lentil,thyme sprig,fine sea salt
title: Lentils With Whiskey and Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown lentils, picked over | 2 cups whiskey, chilled ( such as baily's ) | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 2 fresh sage herbs, roughly chopped | 1/2 teaspoon thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 teaspoons fine sea salt
instructions: Place the lentils and whisky in a medium saucepan. Add the maple syrup and herbs. Heat gently until boiling, then simmer gently for 20 - 25 minutes until the dish is reduced by half. Discard the herbs, season with salt, and keep warm. To serve, remove the herbs and serve with irish rolls.

title: Jaggery-Korean Grilled Buns
ingredients: 8 kaiser rolls | 1 -2 tablespoon jaggery, grated
instructions: Heat grill. Toast kaiser rolls. Spread grated jaggery on kaiser rolls. Place on grill. Grill 5 minutes or until browned.

Random Ingredients: brown gravy mix,turmeric powder,graham cracker,baby spinach,wheat bread,garlic clove
title: Spinach and Rice Crumb Topping for Vegetarian Supper
ingredients: 2 packages baby spinach, washed well | 9 ounces whole wheat bread, crust removed | 3/4 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 garlic clove | 3/4 cup brown gravy mix | 2 ounces graham crackers ( approx, depending on size and thickness desired ) ( optional )
instructions: Cut bread into bite sized chunks. Dump them into microwave safe bowl with turmeric. Microwave on medium power for about 30 seconds uncovered until they are bready and soft, stirring occasionally. This should be about 2 - 6 minutes. You can remove the microwaved bread chunks to cool off if you like. Take bowl from microwave for about a second, then turn it upside down on it's side to cool it off. This takes about a minute or two. Squeeze out any excess water. Chop the garlic and add to it. Stir in gravy powder and microwave for just a couple of seconds to mix it up and make sure it's good and hot. Add spinach and mix through. You should be able to smell the spinach and smell garlic. If it smells very spicy, microwave for a few seconds until it smells like that. If it's too dry, microwave for a few more seconds. Take a piece of bread and moisten it with your hands, coating some of it with gravy. If it breaks, microwave it for just a few more seconds until you hear it breaking. This should result in a wet, but not too wet, crumbly topping. You can either put it in a baggie and crush it with your hands or take the dough out and add 1+ minutes to the mix, tasting for seasoning. The bread should be moist and dry. Put spinach mixture into bread bowl and flatten with fork or a rolling pin to about 1/4 thick. Put bread crumb mixture on top and spread evenly. Put in pre heated oven at 350°. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes to lightly brown, stir, then take out with a large spatula and let cool for 5 - 10 minutes. You can serve with any main dish, or with rice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,mint leaf,garlic,red bell pepper,extra virgin olive oil,flour tortilla,tabasco sauce
title: Crispy Pepper Wrapped Fajitas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 garlic, minced | 3 small red bell peppers, halved, seeds removed | 1 1/2 cups frozen mixed vegetables or 1 1/2 cups fresh mixed vegetables | 10 flour tortillas | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves ( or 1/4 cup dried mint )
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add tabasco sauce and saute for 1 minute. Transfer hot oil to a measuring cup or small bowl. Add garlic and peppers to skillet and saute for two minutes then set aside. Add vegetables and saute until tender crisp, stirring frequently. Place on paper towel lined plate and drizzle with remaining oil. Serve with tortillas and mint leaves to taste.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,cayenne pepper,kidney bean,pork butt
title: Easy Cajun Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork butt, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 can whole canned kidney beans | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Add olive oil to skillet with pork, cook on medium heat until pork is browned. Add all ingredients, reduce heat, cover and simmer on low for 90 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1/3 cup salted peanuts ( finely roasted ) | 1 teaspoon caster sugar ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( optional )
instructions: Put peanuts together with remaining ingredients into a food processor and pulse until everything is roughly chopped and smooth. Store in an airtight container. Note, nut butter is also sold at craft stores that make peanut butter balls. Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,scallop,garlic infused olive oil,watercress,chili oil,serrano chilies
title: Salt Cod, Chilean Scallops and Garlic Oil
ingredients: 12 ounces scallops, sliced in half | 1 tablespoon salt | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped argentinean chile powder ( aji amarillo ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili oil, or as needed | 1 teaspoon garlic-infused olive oil | 1 cup watercress, chopped
instructions: Place scallops in a small bowl of cold water. Pour 1/4 cup salt into a wide mouthed skillet, and let stand 10 minutes. Transfer scallops to a plate and repeat coating with the same salt. Heat the chili oil in a saucepan over medium low heat.

title: Scallion Oatmeal for Breakfast With Mint & Mint
ingredients: 3 scallions, trimmed, finely chopped | 1/2 cup mint leaf, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons brown sugar, packed | 1/2 cup milk | 2/3 cup quick-cooking oats
instructions: Place the scallions, mint, brown sugar and milk in a blender or food processor and process until smooth, stopping to scrape down sides. Transfer to a medium size mixing bowl and add the oats. Stir to combine and let stand. This can be made into patties in a frying pan or baking tray and kept in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,green cardamom pod,biscuit,red food coloring,strawberry,coriander seed,marsala wine,cumin powder
title: Strawberry Stacks
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups strawberries, washed and quartered | 2 -3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 4 -6 biscuit, crushed | 2 3/4 cups red food coloring | 1 1/2 cups marsala wine | 4 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 3 drops red food coloring | 1 cup corn chips, crushed
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and beat for 2 minutes to blend everything well. Line a baking tray with parchment paper on the baking tray. Pour the mixture into a large clear measuring cup. Dip the strawberry quarters in flour and then in crushed biscuit. Pour the red batter evenly along the base of the baking tray. Sprinkle the crushed biscuit evenly over the batter. Place in a preheated oven at 180c/375°f for 20 minutes. Remove tray from oven and sprinkle with the crushed biscuits. Return to oven and continue to bake for another 10 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown on top. Let stand for 5 minutes, then cut into squares and serve.

title: Roasted Grilled French Bread Salad Sandwiches
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 loaf french bread, sliced | 1 cup grapefruit juice | 1 tablespoon skim milk | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional ) | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat grill for 10 - 12 minutes, or until very hot. Coat grill with cooking spray. Place bread on grill, and toast for 2 minutes per side, or until very hot. Spread grapefruit juice over toast. Add milk and cayenne. Drizzle lightly with additional skim milk if desired. Top french bread with romaine leaves and serve.

title: Green Beans in the Dark
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 0.5 can tomato juice | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried anomoto
instructions: Add all ingredients except green beans to a 2 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low heat for 6 to 7 hours.

title: Quick and Easy Lentil and Grated Cheese Quiche
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 2 cups grated low-fat sharp cheddar cheese or 2 cups grated low-fat sharp cheddar cheese | 1 orange, rind-pounded on | 1 store bought pre prepared crust 9-inch deep dish pie shell, unbaked
instructions: In a large bowl gently place brown lentils and grated cheddar cheese and the orange rind. Mix well. Add enough water to the lentils just to cover and mix well. Transfer to baking dish. Cover with the prebaked pie crust and bake in a 350°f oven for 20 - 30 minutes until lightly browned. Serve warm and enjoy.

title: Guar gum
ingredients: 1 tablespoon guar gum
instructions: Blend all of the ingredients together using an electric mixer. Store in an airtight container.

title: Causage Gravy
ingredients: 1 package bulk italian sausage ( or your sausage of choice ) | 2 tablespoons oleo
instructions: Brown italian sausage and drain. Mix oleo and the 2 packages at a time into the finished mixture. Simmer on the stovetop over low heat until thickened and flavors meld.

title: Pork and Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 pound boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 3 yellow peas | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Place pork in a dutch oven or deep heavy pot. Sprinkle with salt. Add enough water to cover pork. Bring to a boil over high heat, and boil gently for 2 hours, skimming the foam off as necessary. Add yellow peas, and season with thyme. Continue to simmer over low heat for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until tender. Serve with lots of freshly ground white pepper.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,red cherry,pork,gouda cheese,cumin seed,curry powder,cold water,chuck
title: Curried Gouda (Soup)
ingredients: 500 g ground chuck | 350 g ground pork | 150 g grated gouda cheese | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 500 ml cold water | 1 small red cherry | 1 gouda cheese
instructions: Blend and chill beef and pork. Add all spices and water and mix well. Wrap in wax paper and freeze overnight. Remove the block of gouda and cut in half and then again into 8 triangles. Roll each wedge lengthwise in a cube shaped mixture, pressing firmly against the curve of the gouda. Repeat for each piece. Melt the stick of gouda and mix with the rest of the soup to make your soup. Serve cold. Tip, if you don't have a fancy cooking utensil, use two bamboo skewers. If you use a metal skewers, use just a bit of flour in your hands instead of lining the skewers with wet hands and using a skewer as a support. These can then be baked or grilled in a pan or broiler. The pan will be a little sticky, and the gouda may stick to them, so feel comfortable and use your judgement.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,chicken,head cauliflower,cilantro,sauerkraut,french onion soup mix,prosciutto
title: Lulu's German Cauliflower and Rice
ingredients: 2 boxes french onion soup mix | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 3 -4 cups cooked long-grain rice ( or brown rice ) | 3 slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro | 1 can sauerkraut - drained and rinsed well | 1 3/4 ounces thick-cut deli-style sliced deli cooked chicken ( or cut up cooked chicken meat )
instructions: Pour soup mix into large soup pot. Add cauliflower pieces and bring to boil. Turn down heat and cover. Cook for 9 minutes. Rinse and drain thoroughly. Place rice on a heated platter. Arrange 1/2 of the cauliflower pieces on the rice, top with 1/2 of the prosciutto slices, 1/2 of the cilantro, 1/2 of the crumbled cheese, 1/2 of the sauerkraut slices, 1/2 of the sliced deli food, and 1/2 of the chicken. Repeat layers. Serve warm.

title: Pancake Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup rice vinegar or 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon chili oil ( adjust to your taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan. Heat over low heat until melted, stirring occasionally. Pour into fondue pot set over hot water to cool slightly before using. Stir often to prevent lumps. Serve warm or at room temperature. Makes about 2 cups.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,beef tenderloin,chili sauce,dill weed,pork loin,salmon fillet
title: Beef, Pork, or Salmon Tenderloin with Cream Sauce
ingredients: 6 ounces tenderloin or 6 ounces beef fillets | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/4 lb salmon fillet | 16 ounces salmon in cream sauce or 16 ounces other smoked salmon | 1 cup heavy cream | 2 teaspoons dried dill weed
instructions: Combine both the beef tenderloin/beef fillets with 1 cup heavy cream, 1/2 cup chili sauce and one third of the salmon in a large plastic bag set over a bowl of ice cubes. Pound to tenderize and refrigerate for at least an hour. Remove meat from the mixture and pat dry with paper towels. Remove skin and bones from salmon. Cut salmon into 1/2 inch pieces. Cut salmon with a serrated knife into the pieces of fillet. Combine the cream and dill weed in a small bowl and set aside. Heat remaining cream in saucepan. Remove pan from heat and cook sauce over low heat for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Spoon sauce over salmon fillets, garnish with reserved cream and serve.

Random Ingredients: catsup,turmeric powder,italian turkey sausage link,yellow squash
title: Spicy Sausage and Squash
ingredients: 3 italian turkey sausage links | 5 yellow squash ( medium ) or 5 zucchini, sliced | catsup, to taste ( optional ) | turmeric powder, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Spray a pan with non stick cooking spray. Cut the zucchini in half lengthwise and remove the peel leaving about half an inch of thick flesh.

Random Ingredients: green olive,dark chocolate,dark soy sauce,worcestershire sauce,spinach leaf,seasoning salt,lemon juice zest
title: Welsh Green Prawns With Chocolate (Shrimp & Spinach)
ingredients: 2 kg large raw shrimp, shelled, deveined and tails left on | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | seasoning salt | 10 -12 fresh spinach leaves, washed, trimmed and finely chopped ( spinach can also be used ) | 2 ounces dark chocolate, broken into chunks or 2 ounces semisweet chocolate pieces ( 250g )
instructions: Whisk together the soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, seasoning salt and lemon zest in a small bowl. Fold in the spinach. Set aside to marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes. Place the prawns on a medium heatproof platter. Heat about 1 cm of oil in a wok or deep frying pan. Stir fry the prawns in a separate pan for 1 minute. Remove and drain on paper towels. Return the wok to heat and fry the remaining prawns until they turn pink. Drain on paper towels. Add the chocolate and bubble for a further minute. Taste and adjust seasoning with seasoning if necessary.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,bibb lettuce,green onion,sea salt black pepper
title: Thai Hot Lettuce
ingredients: 2 large heads bibb lettuce | 1 cup thinly sliced green onion | 3 tablespoons thai sweet hot chili sauce | 1 teaspoon sea salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Rinse the lettuce well.

title: Speedy Rice Mix
ingredients: 4 cups long-grain white rice ( not instant ) | 2 1/2 cups frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 2 1/2 cups tea ( i prefer decaf )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a rice cooker or tight fitting lid and select the 'dough setting' according to its manufacturer's instructions. When the 'dough' cycle is complete, remove the rice from the cooker or lid. Place rice on a greased tray or individual serving dishes and allow to cool. Variation, if you want to freeze the leftovers, put rice in plastic freezer bags. Cover and place in freezer for about 3 hours, or until solid. To serve, place the frozen rice on a serving dish and top with tea.

title: Southern Okra
ingredients: 1 pound okra, trimmed | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground celery salt
instructions: Cook okra in a skillet over medium heat, turning occasionally, until just tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Stir celery pepper powder into okra and season with salt. Cook and stir 5 more minutes.

title: Coleslaw
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil, or as needed, divided | 3 tablespoons buttermilk | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 3 tablespoons diced, peeled apples | 3 tablespoons chopped green onions and red cabbage, or to taste | 1 jar pimientos - drained, liquid reserved
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together 1 tablespoon grape and buttermilk with vinegar and pour into a skillet over medium high heat, swirling to coat the bottom and sides with oil. Heat until the mixture starts to boil. Add apples and green onions.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,half,almond extract,pickapeppa sauce,pepper,corn,rice wine,white mushroom
title: Baked Mushrooms With Rice Wine Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 cup thinly sliced white mushrooms | 1 1/2 teaspoons corn or 1 1/2 teaspoons barley starch | 2 tablespoons pickapeppa sauce | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | pepper, to taste | steamed sweet corn, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Coat pan with cooking spray. Place mushrooms on a baking dish, and sprinkle with dry starch. Bake 10 minutes or until the mushrooms are tender, stirring after 5 minutes. Stir together rice wine, almond extract, and pepper. Drizzle mixture over mushrooms. Place in a baking dish. Continue baking 15 minutes. Garnish with steamed sweet corn.

title: Spinach With Star Anise
ingredients: 1 bunch spinach leaves, washed | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 3 star anise, crushed
instructions: Wash and clean the spinach leaves thoroughly. If the leaves are large, cut them in half. Put the spinach, pepper and star anise in a heavy bottomed vessel. Cover with a tightfitting lid. Allow it to cook on a slow flame with continuous stirring all the time, until it is completely cooked. Reduce flame immediately and place the steamed spinach in a tea towel. Serve hot.

title: Sausages and Peas(Sausage and Peppers)
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 2 lbs frozen whole peas, thawed if frozen
instructions: Place the sausage in a large skillet. Sprinkle the peas on the sausage. Over low heat, cook sausage, while stirring, until browned and slightly crispy, about 10 minutes. Reduce heat to low and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until peas are tender and sausage is hot throughout, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,spinach leaf,corn oil,salmon steak,grain rice
title: Salmon With Spinach and Rice
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 32 ounces salmon steaks, cubed | 1 1/2 cups medium uncooked long grain rice | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Add rice.

Random Ingredients: anchovy,salt black pepper,chicken bouillon cube,tortellini,soya sauce,egg noodle
title: Crock Pot Chicken Tortellini with Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/2- to 2-inch pieces | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 6 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 lb egg noodles, preferably fettucine | 1 can anchovies, drained, chopped, and oil reserved
instructions: Place chicken and 1/2 cup water in 4 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Set aside for at least 2 hours. Preheat grill. Dissolve boullion cube in 1 cup hot water. Place noodles on the rack of a gas grill. Cook, covered, on medium for 5 - 7 minutes or until tender but firm. Drain in colander and pat dry with paper towels. Discard broth. Remove chicken from braising liquid and drain if needed. Combine soya sauce and remaining chicken broth in a bowl. Add salt and pepper. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer over low heat, uncovered, stirring once or twice, until chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Discard bone in chicken and set aside to cool slightly. Discard bones. When ready to serve, add noodles and drained anchovies. Toss to combine. Divide mixture among 4 serving bowls. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: courgette,chicken bouillon cube,iceberg lettuce,red currant jelly,turnip,wheat pasta,cremini mushroom,peanut oil vegetable
title: Vegetable Pasta Salad
ingredients: 7 ounces whole wheat pasta, dry | 1 small turnip, diced | 1 small fresh sweet potato, chopped | 125 g cremini mushrooms, quartered | 1 medium courgette, quartered | 125 g red currant jelly | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 3 tablespoons peanut oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water according to packet instructions. Drain & set aside, meanwhile, cook, stirring, the turnip, potato and mushrooms in a heavy based saucepan over a medium heat until the vegre is just tender. Dissolve the jelly in a little lukewarm water, then add to the vegetables along with any liquid from the pan. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes, until the jelly has thickened slightly. Add the pasta & season generously with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serve in warmed bowls with some fresh shredded lettuce.

title: Swiss Rye
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup finely diced leeks | 1 tablespoon finely diced pimento | 1/4 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 6 slices rye bread ( i used my swiss bread for this )
instructions: Heat the broiler. In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients. Using your hands rub the mixture together. Arrange a few slices of rye on each of 2 plates, pressing slightly. Heat the broiler. When a few slices of rye are bubbling, place 2 teaspoons of the mixture at a time over the tops of the rye slices and broil until golden brown about 2 minutes. Remove from broiler. Serve immediately.

title: Quick Herbed Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mixed herbs ( or your favourite herbs ) | 2 teaspoons sweet chili sauce ( such as heinz )
instructions: Remove the stems from herbs, if using dried herbs. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and chill till ready to serve. Serve with your favourite vegetables and crackers to keep them hot while slurping up the spicy juices, or alternatively, add to fresh herbs when you fry a few small potatoes or potatoes.

title: Irish Shrimp with Onions and Cashews (Camarao
ingredients: cooking onion | 1 pound jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 smoked salt cod fish fillets ( torpedo ) or bay scallops, cut into chunks ( torpedo ) | 2 pimento-stuffed dark-hein beer or rum-flavored lollies | 1/4 cup cashew halves | 1/2 cup whole peeled radish | 1/4 cup whole raw shelled radish | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce or more to taste
instructions: Cook and stir onion in 1 teaspoon olive oil in a skillet over medium heat until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,savory,agave nectar,brown lentil,ice water,hungarian paprika,thyme sprig,self raising flour
title: Brown Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup black lentils, rinsed, drained | 1 teaspoon gluten free agave nectar, such as treacle or 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 2 tablespoons shaved greek dried sweet paprika | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon dried savory, dried | 500 ml ice water ( optional ) | 1 cup grated coconut, toasted | fresh thyme sprig (, to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place lentils in a large saucepan, and cover with water. Bring to the boil, lower heat and simmer until lentils are tender. Drain, and allow to cool slightly before hand. Place lentils, agave nectar, paprika, thyme, savory and ice water in a saucepan, and bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until heated through. Cool slightly, then stir through coconut and thyme. Serve hot, garnished with a fresh thyme sprig.

title: Barb’s Muesli
ingredients: 2 lbs brown sugar ( see note ) | 4 cups cornmeal | 3 cups canadian bacon, chopped ( bacon grease ) | 4 tablespoons caraway seeds, coarsely crushed | canadian bacon ( optional )
instructions: Pre oven to 400°f. Line a deep 8x12 inch casserole or loaf pan with foil. In a saucepan, melt brown sugar over medium low heat, stirring frequently until it caramelizes and gives off some of its aroma, about 5 minutes and should be a deep amber colour. Stir in cornmeal and cook, stirring constantly until it begins to whiten, about 5 minutes. Increase heat to medium and stir constantly until it reaches a soft, grainy consistency, about 5 - 10 minutes. Remove from heat. In a bowl, mix together coarsely chopped bacon, caraway seeds and some of the caramelized sugar. Pour over the muesli and mix well. Spread in prepared pan and place in a preheated oven.

title: Crunchy Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread | tia maria or vanilla pudding mix | 1/4 cup chopped roasted peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Cut out your bread loaf and cut out any large chunks of the bread from inside to create the scoop. Place the scoop on a flat surface of wax paper. Top bread scoop on the rye and spread with tia maria. Sprinkle the peanuts on top of the tia maria.

title: White Kidney Beans With Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 bag dried white kidney beans | 16 cherry tomatoes ( or grape tomatoes, if they are small )
instructions: Soak kidney beans in enough water to cover at least 6 hours, or overnight. Drain beans, and place in a large saucepan. If using fresh tomatoes, cut them in half. Add water to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 30 minutes, until beans are tender and sauce is thickened. Stir occasionally. If using grapes tomatoes, slice them in half, if whole, before serving. Serve over rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,basil pesto,vanilla,beef eye,green curry paste,red potato,rice vinegar,radish
title: Thai Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs beef eye rounds, cut 1/2 inch slices | 1 1/2 cups green curry paste | 3/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dried basil pesto | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 5 -7 large red potatoes, cut into chunks, with peel left on | 1 cup radish, thinly sliced, for garnish
instructions: Spray grill pan with vegetable spray.

title: Pasta With Avocado and Cucumber
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast, package at room temperature | 2 1/2 cups small red potatoes ( about 1 pound ) | 2 teaspoons salt | 3/4 cup small cucumber, thinly sliced crosswise | 1 cup large shell pasta | 3/4 cup avocado, sliced cut lengthwise into 4 thin slices and patted dry | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, sprinkle yeast over 1/2 cup of the potato water and let stand for 5 minutes until foamy. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan of boiling water, cover and cook potatoes with salt for 25 minutes, or until tender.

title: Creamy Fettuccine With Orange Peel
ingredients: 250 g dried fettuccine pasta | 4 oranges, peeled, seeded, finely sectioned | 1 teaspoon maple extract | 3 teaspoons capers ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely ground coriander | 30 g fresh coriander, roughly chopped | 3 ladyfingers, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the pasta and garnish. Toss lightly and serve.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,mascarpone,boston lettuce,tomato green chile pepper,stewing beef,red pepper,baking powder,french bread
title: Tortas
ingredients: 1 cup mascarpone | 1/2 cup shredded french style breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 loaf white bread, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1 bunch fresh italian-style breadcrumbs | 1 pound stewing beef, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 3 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 small red pepper, chopped | 12 sprigs fresh italian-style lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Heat half of the mascarpone in a skillet over medium heat. Add the breadcrumbs, and let toast for a minute. Stir in the baking powder. Transfer the meat to a bowl, and stir in the bread crumbs. Spread the mixture evenly over the entire top of the toast. Layer with 1/2 the tomatoes and 1/2 the chile peppers. Top with the remaining cheese in an 8 x 4 inch casserole dish. Sprinkle with 1 cup of the white breadcrumbs, the remaining breadcrumbs, the remaining chile peppers, and the remaining white breadcrumbs. Bake for about 1 hour. When the tortas are done, place the romaine leaves on top, and replace the lid so that the leaves aren't stuck to the casserole dish's bottom. Allow to get heated through before removing from the oven. Serve hot.

title: Easy Overnight Baked Wings
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs chicken wings, drumsticks/ribs on the bone | 1/2 cup rum ( your favourite brand ) | 1 pint half-and-half | 1 pint vanilla ice cream ( softened ) | 1 cup dried fruit ( sliced in your favourite fruit compote, you can use any fruit ) | 1 bag pitted prunes | finely crumbly breadcrumbs ( for dredging )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and line 12 heavy duty baking sheets with parchment paper. Place chicken wings in a large bowl of water or ice water. Set aside until ready to cook. Remove chicken from water and place in the freezer. Drain any remaining water from the chicken wings, then place back into the bowl with ice and water. Beat together half and half, rum and vanilla in a large microwave safe bowl or glass measuring cup for about a minute until blended. Pour half the rum mixture into the bowl and whisk vigorously until well combined. Pour half the vodka mixture into the bowl and whisk vigorously until well combined and mixture is smooth. Pour half the half and half mixture into the same plastic bowl and whisk until thoroughly combined. Pour half of the vodka mixture into the same plastic bowl used to mix. Place half of the prunes and prunes into the plastic bag and shake to coat. Add the rest of the vodka mixture to the bowl with the prunes and prunes. Set aside. Remove the chicken wing drumsticks from the freezer and place them on the prepared baking sheet. Using a tooth pick, gently toss the chicken drumsticks to coat them with the rum marinade. Place the coated drumsticks in the oven on the middle rack. Check occasionally to see if they are being cooked through, if they have been, stir them back into the baking. When done, remove the chicken drumsticks from the oven. Using a large sharp knife, score top of a drumstick in a diamond pattern and score in a criss cross pattern. To serve, cover chicken and prunes with plastic wrap and place on serving dish. Garnish with crumbs of your choice. Serve at room temperature or slightly warmer.

title: Quick and Easy Meatball Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb ground round ( or other ground meat substitute ) | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 4 kaiser rolls or 4 hamburger buns, split
instructions: In large bowl, combine ground round and salt. Add meat, and combine well using your hands. Shape into 1 inch meatballs. Brown in hot skillet, about 2 minutes on each side.

title: Grilled Zucchini With andouille Sausage
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini ( about 2 1/4 pounds ) | cooking spray | 2 teaspoons sliced fresh mint leaves | 1/2 lb andouille sausage, sliced ( about 4 links ) | 2 containers low-fat ricotta cheese
instructions: Cut ends off zucchini to expose striped leaves.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,ginger juice,bean sprout,horseradish,tomato sauce,star anise pod,chicken liver
title: Portuguese Chicken Liver
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken livers, halved lengthwise | 2 star anise pods | 1 jalapeno | 3 tablespoons ginger juice | 1/4 cup horseradish, grated | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 4 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons ginger juice
instructions: Place the chicken livers, star anise pods and chile in a large bowl with 1 teaspoon jalapeno rind and 1 teaspoon minced ginger. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon grated ginger, 2 tablespoons horseradish, 1 tablespoons tomato sauce and 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,hot red chili pepper,allspice,halibut fillet,lemon peel,shrimp,penne,pork shoulder
title: Linguine With Halibut, Pork and Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 lb halibut fillet or 1/2 lb other firm white fish fillet, cut into 1-inch by 1/4-inch strips | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 12 shrimp, cleaned with tails left on | 1/2 lb thin-sliced pork shoulder | 4 ounces crumbled gorgonzola or 4 ounces goat cheese | hot red chili pepper, slices | 1 lb penne
instructions: Place the halibut in a shallow baking pan, drizzle with 1 tablespoon of lemon peel, and spread with the allspice. Season with salt and pepper. Dredge in a bowl with the shrimp and set aside. Wash and pat dry the work surface with paper towels. Grill the fish over moderately high high heat, turning once, until lightly charred and just cooked through outside, 20 to 25 minutes. Cut into strips lengthwise, then in half crosswise. When finished, transfer halibut, patted dry, to a serving platter and sprinkle with crumbled gorgonzola or goat cheese. Top with fresh chili slices and garnish with pepared chile slices.

title: Spinach Tacos
ingredients: 1 container baby spinach | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 12 small flour tortillas
instructions: Microwave spinach on high 1 minute or until softened and warm, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,self raising flour,butter bean,chow mein noodle,coriander powder,coconut flake
title: Chow Mein Loaf
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces butter beans | 6 ounces chow mein noodles | 3 1/2 ounces self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 1/2 ounces desiccated coconut flakes
instructions: Line a shallow, non stick tray with greaseproof paper. Put the butter beans, chow mein, flour, coriander and cummin in a food processor and blend on high until combined. Spoon about 1/4 cup mixture into the middle of prepared tray. Smooth the top with the back of a spoon. Smooth the top, then spread the coconut flakes over the chow mein mixture. Bake at c for 40 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Homemade Corned Beef With Lime
ingredients: 3 lbs corned beef ( can use beef roast ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Trim fat. If you can find corned beef with a thick layer of fat underneath, trim excess fat. Dry meat and reserve in a container covered by cheese cloth for about a week. Use as directed above and let refrigerate for at least 1 1/2 weeks before serving. Note, you can also use any desired meat type such as chicken or beef. I recommend you use the usual cuts of chicken or pork. Remove meat from the container and drain excess liquid off. Use this meat for the next time as it can burn during the cooking process and make it less tender. Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes. Lightly butter a grill. Remove bones from meat. Slice meat thinly across the grain. Put meat on skewers and place kebabs on grill and roast at medium low temperature for about 45 minutes, turning frequently. Remove kebabs from grill and place on platter and let rest for 15 minutes serve with lime wedges as garnish.

Random Ingredients: chocolate pudding mix,dark soy sauce,balsamic vinegar,kosher salt,russet potato,coconut
title: Sweet Potato With Chocolate Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 box instant chocolate pudding mix | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 large russet potato, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 piece coconut ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare the chocolate pudding mix according to pkg directions. Drain potatoes and set aside. Stir together soy sauce, vinegar and salt in small saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Add potatoes and let simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Transfer the potatoes and broth to a small bowl to serve. You can also serve the potatoes on a platter. Drizzle with sauce and coconut and dip briefly.

title: Schweizer Beer
ingredients: 4 cups beer ( i used corona blue, but it was up to you ) | 1 tablespoon cracked black peppercorns
instructions: Pour beer into a pint glass and add cracked peppercorns. Drink. Alternatively, fill the remaining pint glass with ice, fill it up, and top with beer and a twist of pepper.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,mango chutney,orange peel,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Moroccan Spiced Salsa
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped orange peel | 1/4 cup chopped dill weed | 8 tablespoons ra el hanout spice mix ( made by baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix ) | 1/2 cup mango chutney
instructions: Mix all ingredients well.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,graham cracker crumb,corn syrup,salmon,lime juice,saffron thread,skirt steak
title: Steamed Grilled Tilapia
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1 tablespoon minced fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons prepared saffron threads | 2 pounds tilapia fillets | 4 slices fresh salmon
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs, corn syrup, lime juice, and saffron threads in a bowl and coat tilapia fillets. Thread 2 skewers each with a slice of salmon, and place fish in a large, deep skillet. Pour 1/4 cup of the crumb mixture evenly over the fish. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Place in the refrigerator during the morning to help thicken the gravy.

title: Lard-Zucchini With Zucchini
ingredients: 1 zucchini | 4 tablespoons lard | 6 egg yolks | 6 egg yolks
instructions: Cut the zucchini in very thin slices, then put in a colander and run under cold water. Sprinkle with salt and drain very well. Heat the lard over medium heat in a skillet. When hot, fry the zucchini very slowly just until tender but not brown, about 15 minutes. When done, remove with a slotted spoon and set aside on paper towels. In a medium bowl, beat the 6 egg yolks together with the 6 egg whites. Fold in the remaining 1 egg yolk, and set aside. Melt a little lard in a deep 10 inch skillet over medium heat. When hot, dip the zucchini in the egg fat and fry in the hot lard. Turning carefully so the zucchini is golden on all sides. When browned on both sides, remove from the pan and drain on paper towels. When all cooked, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: manchego cheese,prosciutto,curry leaf,stewing beef,mirin,taco sauce,tortilla,white pepper
title: Beef and Cheese Enchiladas from the Crock Pot
ingredients: 6 slices prosciutto | 1/4 cup mirin | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry leaves ( or 1 tsp. if using regular curry leaves ) | 3 lbs stewing beef, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 cup taco sauce | 1 cup shredded manchego cheese ( or other tasty cheese ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons white pepper | 16 soft tortillas
instructions: Place the tortillas in the bottom of the slow cooker and spread over 1/2 cup water. Heat on high 5 minutes or until tortillas are limp. Transfer the tortillas to a plate and let cool. While tortillas are cooling down, mix together the mole sauce ingredients. Sprinkle half of the tortillas with half the spice mixture. Add 1/3 of the beef to tortillas, layer with 1/2 of the sauce, and roll. Place the enchiladas in the slow cooker and add the remaining sauce and meat. Cook on high 3 hours. To serve, serve with more sauce and cheese on top and more cheese.

title: Green Beans With Raisins
ingredients: 8 ounces canned stewed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh ginger ( optional ) | 1 package frozen cut green beans | 1 ounce golden raisin ( optional )
instructions: Cook the tomatoes according to pkg directions.

title: Peanut Butter Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon peanut butter
instructions: Stir yogurt and peanut butter together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,cardamom pod,philadelphia cream cheese,bell pepper,jasmine rice,cauliflower
title: Baked Phyllo Cheesecake
ingredients: 4 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1 cauliflower | 4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons cardamom pods | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees. Grease 9x13 baking pan. Thinly slice cauliflower. Place cauliflower in a large sauce pan. Cook and stir over medium heat, until tender crisp. Cool. Place drained rice in a large bowl. Grate cream cheese into bowl and add to bowl with cooked rice. Stir in bell pepper, cardamom, feta cheese until well blended. Place mixture in prepared baking dish, filling almost to the edge. Dot with remaining butter. Cover and let set in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes, until it is golden.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,active yeast,sesame seed,trout,maraschino cherry,dijon mustard
title: Spiked Trout With Dijon and Toasted Sesame Seed Filling
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 3 - 3 1/2 cups quick-cooking oats ( not instant ) | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 3 - 3 1/2 cups smoky cooking smokehouse smoked trout, finely chopped into 1/2-inch dice ( about 1 pound ) | 1/2 cup dried maraschino cherry, finely chopped | 1 1/2 - 1 2/3 cups dijon mustard
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine yeast and 3 1/2 cups oatmeal or quick cooking oats. In a 5 to 6 cups boiling water, combine the rye meal and remaining 3 1/2 cups oatmeal or quick cooking oats. Bring just to a boil and immediately remove from heat. Gradually invert the cooled oat mixture into a 13 x 14 inch cake pan and let cool for 10 to 12 minutes, then turn out onto the counter and quickly knead to combine, about 10 seconds each time, until smooth and elastic. Using a large fork or fingers, stuff the turkey pieces with the turkey's mustard and then spread evenly in the pan, spreading the top and corners slightly. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Bake in preheated 450 degree oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until a thermometer registers 140 degrees when inserted in center of turkey. Let cool completely, then slice into 8 slices. Serve warm.

title: Flour tortilla Receipe #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated flake taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees, and spray a 9x13 or 9x9 baking dish with a nonstick cooking spray. In a small bowl, mix taco seasoning and garlic powder until combined. Pour into large bowl, and fill with about 1/4 teaspoonfulls of the taco mixture, making sure it is evenly coated. Repeat, then repeat until all tortilla mixture is used. Place the sprayed baking sheet in the oven, and begin baking for approximately 20 minutes. Let it cool 5 - 10 minutes, then carefully unmold onto plate. Enjoy.

title: Caffe-Spiced Coffee
ingredients: 3 -5 pieces canned red chiles | 6 ounces cafe du caffe instant coffee
instructions: Put the red chillies in a bowl and pour coffee over them. Leave for 20 - 25 minutes before serving. Variation to speed up the coffee, leave out the chillies and puree the coffee in a blender or spice mill. The coffee may also be drunk as a beverage.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,vanilla,cocoa powder,sharp cheddar cheese,white vinegar,brandy,dark rum,white wine vinegar
title: Creamy Baked Chocolate
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup distilled white vinegar | 1/4 cup brandy | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 tablespoon dry white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon baking potato salt or 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/8 teaspoon white salt or 1/8 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Grease a 9 inch cake pan with some of the cooking spray. Line the bottom of the prepared cake pan with the cheese. Mix the rest of the ingredients except the cheese and the glaze, in a bowl in order given.

title: Golden Raisin and Pecan Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red seedless golden raisins | 2 1/2 cups crunchy peanut oil | 1 1/4 cups peanut oil for frying
instructions: Place the raisins in a plastic bag, and stir in 2 1/2 cups peanut oil. Sift together the golden raisin and pecan bits. Refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: date,vanilla sugar,semolina flour,spanish olive,corn,peanut oil,white pearl onion,beer
title: Fried Olives With Dates and Corn (Tapas)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons corn oil, plus extra for sprinkling | 3 tablespoons semolina flour | 1/2 small white pearl onion, quartered | 1 cup pitted pitted dates | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts, roughly chopped | 1 liter beer, plus extra for drizzling | 1/2 cup white pearl onion, sliced at an angle | coarse salt | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Whisk the corn oil in a 1 pint glass measuring cup with a pinch of salt until the corn and oil are combined. Add the pearl onions and dates. Stir and let stand 5 minutes. In a large, deep nonstick skillet, heat half the beer until just sizzling. Stir in the sliced onions and sugar, adding another tablespoon of oil if necessary, until the sugar has dissolved, then stir in the flour and the date mixture. Cook over medium heat, stirring to form thick clumps, until it begins to brown. Add the remaining beer all at once and stir. Keep stiring until the mixture has the consistency of oatmeal. If it is dry, add additional beer. When the mixture reaches the stage where it thickens and is smooth and creamy, stir in the vanilla sugar. Continue cooking and stirring 10 minutes. The pan should become quite dry but not soupy. The tapas should still be rather wet. Using either a slotted spoon or kitchen tongs, dip the olives into the sauce, letting any excess sizzle drip back into the sauce, then fry briefly just until the oil begins to run across and the outside is golden brown, turning and shaking the pan several times. Serve at once. If you need to store them in the refrigerator, leave the remaining sauce in the pan it was cooked in and reheat in the microwave to thicken.

title: Spanish Fish With Beans and Rotellini
ingredients: 1 can fat-free, reduced-sodium veal ( can also use another brand if desired ) or ( 12 ounce ) can white fish fillets ( can also use another brand if desired ) | 3 cans fat-free refried beans ( i usually use black beans with good results ) | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning, divided | 1 lb rotelle pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package other small shell pasta, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 baking dish. Mix both cans of beans together and spread 1/4 of the beans onto each plate, leaving one of the beans free side. Layer both the fish fillets and the fish fillets on top of the beans. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning over each, reserving the other tablespoon or so. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until fish are just barely cooked and fish juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,cod fish,brandy,hard egg,lemon juice zest
title: Eggs Roman Style
ingredients: 20 small hard-boiled eggs, shelled, quartered | 200 g cod fish, cut into thick slices, and cut into four pieces each | 2 lemons, juice and zest of, grated | 1/2 cup brandy or 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Heat a shallow frypan, add the eggs and toss them around so that they cover the bottom of the pan. Cook for five minutes over a moderately high heat, stirring, until the egg slices turn lightly golden.

title: Fiesta Rice & Bread
ingredients: 2 cups half-and-half or 2 cups low-fat whipping cream | 1 1/4 cups long-grain white rice, uncooked
instructions: In a 2 1/2 to 3 qt casserole combine all ingredients. Heat until hot throughout, stirring occasionally.

title: Pineapple in a Honey Sauce
ingredients: 1 pineapple, peeled and chunked | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 cups buttermilk
instructions: Place the pineapple chunks and honey in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring often, until the pineapple is soft and the honey has turned honey brown, about 10 minutes. Stir the buttermilk into the pineapple simmering syrup.
