Cook, stirring, until thickened, about 3 minutes. Spoon onto a serving dish, and top with a sprinkling of more honey.

title: Ginger and Ginger Butter for Chicken Rolls or Shish Kabab
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine | 1/4 cup ginger paste
instructions: Place margarine and ginger paste in a small bowl. Mix well until the ingredients are completely blended together. Poke holes in the chicken pieces with a fork. Rub the spice mixture into the meat by spreading on the side of the meat. Place on a baking sheet for about 30 minutes at 350 degrees, or until the internal temperature reaches 180 degrees.

title: Gluten Free Sour Cream Barbecue Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup non-hydrogenated soymilk ( or soy milk ) | 3/4 cup soymilk ( or soy milk ) | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 7 -8 cups unbleached rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Add the soy milk to the soymilk/soymilk in a large nonmetal bowl, sprinkle 1 teaspoons of the paprika on the soy milk. Add the uncooked rice vinegar, add the remaining teaspoon of paprika, the rest of the sweet paprika and the sour cream to the bowl and stir until well blended. Turn the liquid up until the mixture is no longer carbonated. Add the yeast and mix thoroughly. Cover with plastic wrap place and allow the bread to warrn about 45 minutes to rise. Punch the dough, put the mixture in a pan and bake at 300 f for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,egg noodle,red potato,mint leaf,pineapple juice,tarragon leaf
title: Noodles and Pineapple With Red Potatoes and Herbs
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 3 small red potatoes, cut into thin wedges | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon leaves | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon leaves | 2 tablespoons fresh pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon chopped of fresh mint leaves
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions. Place the red potatoes in a bowl. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons of tarragon and 1 1/2 teaspoons of parsley.

title: The Best Cashews
ingredients: 2 cups cashews | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon lime juice
instructions: Wash the cashews, then place in a nonstick frying pan. Place on high heat and toast cashews until golden brown. Set aside on a plate lined with a paper towel. Sprinkle cardamom and anise over them and then add lime juice. Add a little water if necessary.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,green pepper,ancho chile powder,garlic salt
title: Mild Chilt Con Queso
ingredients: 1 teaspoon finely chopped green pepper | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds, crushed | garlic salt
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and transfer to bowl. Can also be frozen.

title: Vermicelli Salad
ingredients: 200 g rice vermicelli | 2 1/4 - 3 lbs asparagus, trimmed | 2 -3 anchovies, drained
instructions: Cook the vermicelli in boiling water until tender and drain. Remove and cool. Cut the asparagus spears lenghtways into 6 florets of 2 cm diameter. Cook the asparagus until tender crisp and drain. Place noodles in a bowl with 2 tbsp oil and sprinkle over a little of the anchovies. Mix well. Add the cooled asparagus and toss. Just before serving, sprinkle remaining anchovies over top.

title: Plum Clamato
ingredients: 7 large purple plums | 1 jar prepared marinara sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Poke holes in plum with a knife. Place plum onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Turn plums over, and bake an additional 15 minutes. If using marinara sauce, pour 1/2 jar of marinara over the tops of the plum, and bake 5 minutes. Be careful not to puncture the skins. These can be boiled in the oven too, right before serving.

title: Filipino Pork and Chicken Adobo - Adobukado
ingredients: 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, thinly sliced | 1 orange, quartered | 1 1/2 lbs oranges, sectioned
instructions: In a large glass bowl, combine vinegar, sugar and salt. Add sliced pork into the mixture and let sit for half an hour. Add orange cut into quarters and stir to mix. Cover and marinate for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator. Thread the orange slices onto skewers and grill with some salt and sugar/salt mixture as desired. Turning after 15 minutes, when the pork is cooked, remove from the skewers and serve as desired. Serve with rice and garnish with chopped fresh vegetables.

title: Lamb Chops With Satay
ingredients: 4 lbs lamb chops | 8 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 1 hour
instructions: Dry the chops and remove any excess fat. Soak the skewers in cold water for 20 - 30 minutes. Remove chops from skewers and drain. Trim off all excess fat from the chops. Soak the skewers with your favourite oil, vinegar and maggi. Place the skewers into a shallow metal pan or glass bowl. Sprinkle the top with salt. Bake the skewers at 400 degree f. For 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bread,green chilies,hot italian sausage,radish,grain white rice,wheat bran,rotini pasta
title: Green Chile Sausage Rice Salad With Whole Wheat Pasta and Salsas
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausage, casings removed | 1 cup whole wheat bran | 3 cups uncooked rotini pasta, cooked and drained | 8 ounces green chilies, seeded and chopped, bottled roasted, sliced green chilies | 2/3 cup uncooked long grain white rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup radish, chopped fresh, red or green | warm bread, to serve
instructions: Heat grill to medium. Place sausage in a 4 to 6 quart nonstick skillet. Top with bran, spreading in an even layer. Cook over medium heat, stirring and breaking up sausage until completely crumbled. Stir in rotini. Cover and cook over medium low heat, stirring occasionally until hot, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in green chiles, rice and radishes and transfer to a large bowl. Stir in sausage mixture just before serving.

title: Chilean Black Mission Bakery Bakery
ingredients: 1 jar mild tequila | 1/2 cup chopped green onions | 2 tablespoons coarsely crushed nitrate | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 12 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Prepare grill for direct/medium heat. Combine first 3 ingredients in a glass/cozy bowl, then add nitrate, tabasco, and 1/2 pastry sheets. Brush each sheet with 2 - 3 tablespoons of remaining marinade. Place on grill rack and grill, 1 minute on each side, basting with remaining marinade during final 30 seconds of browning. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool completely.

title: Lentils and Coconut
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 3 green chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 3/4 cup grated coconut | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Boil the lentils and chilies in water until soft. Drain. Return lentils and chilies to pan. Mix well. Stir in the coconut. Sprinkle with parmesan. Serve hot.

title: Fresh Mushrooms for Sizzling
ingredients: 8 -10 medium fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1 dash fresh oregano leaves or 1 dash dried oregano
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the pan. Heat to a boil. Serve immediately.

title: BBQ Potatoes and Herbs (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 1 potato, cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs ( basil, rosemary, sage, parsley ) | 1 teaspoon baking potato, diced ( potato buds ) | 4 fluid ounces chicken stock ( or vegetable stock ) | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 teaspoon barbecue sauce | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs ( herbs for spice ) | 2 teaspoons white flour | 1 pinch cardamom ( spice for spice )
instructions: Preheat bbq to 180°c. Line bottom half of a medium size bowl with baking paper. Add potato wedges, then sprinkle with mixed herbs. Toss to coat in potato mixture. Place on prepared baking paper. Cook for 30 minutes or until tender. Stir chicken stock and potato buds into the bbq mixture and simmer until tender. Blend catsup and barbecue sauce in a small bowl. Add to bbq mixture. Whisk together well. Remove cover from bbq and sprinkle with mixed herbs. Serve topped with potato wedges. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,texas toast bread,self rising flour,savory,rice,mustard
title: Jalapeño Toast
ingredients: 2 lbs self rising flour | 3 1/2 ounces texas toast bread | 1/4 teaspoon ground savory | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 2 teaspoons jalapeno peppers | cooked rice
instructions: Place bread in a large mixing bowl. Stir in rest of ingredients, knead for 8 - 10 minutes. Place onto a floured board, knead lightly. Cut into six wedges. Place in a greased 9x13 pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, or until golden brown, turning once.

title: Beef Phyllo Pie
ingredients: 2 cups canned navy beans, drained | 1/4 cup tequila | 1/2 lb beef chuck, thinly sliced | 14 sheets phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Combine the navy beans and tequila in a pot, bring to a boil and simmer for about 30 minutes or until beans are fairly tender. Stir the beef into the beans. Cover and chill in the refridgerator for 20 minutes. Boil up the sheets of phyllo pastry at least 7 times, to use later on. Remove the beef mixture from the refridgerator and slice the beef into long strips about 1 1/2 inch thick. Cover the beef slices with a layer of beef slices to prevent them drying out. Brush the sheets of phyllo dough with some of the bean mixture and stack them together. Cut the phyllo stack crosswise into 2 equal slices and set them aside. Keep all the stack of phyllo covered with plastic wrap. Fold a phyllo square in half, leaving a 3/4 inch border on each side, and then cut the half into 3 strips lengthwise to make triangles. Repeat with the remaining phyllo triangles, then cut the triangles in half again and set them aside once you have assembled your pies. You will have extra beef mixture and phyllo. Heat your oven to 350°. Bake the pies for about 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown. The pies are done when the top is puffed and golden and a toothpick tests dry. Remove from the oven and serve hot. This will also make wonderful sandwiches for a meal.

title: Cheese and Corn Chips Chips (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 1/2 lb gruyere cheese ( about 2 cups, if you can't get it ) | 20 -25 large corn tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Slice cheese into 3/4 inch squares and set aside. Place chips on a plate. Layer cheese evenly on unaged chips, leaving a 1/4 inch overhang in the center. Starting with the entire chip, lay out a few chips so that the chips will cover the cheese. Layer chips with a few more chips until they reach the full width of the cheese. Top with remaining cheese. Place on a cookie sheet and place in the oven. Bake until browned, approximately 15 - 20 minutes depending on the quality of cheese. Let cool 5 minutes before removing the cheese from the cookie sheet.

title: Hot Chili Sausages
ingredients: 4 hot red chili peppers | 8 links kielbasa
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small pot. Cover and simmer over low heat until hot.

title: Roasted Red Capsicum, Tomato and Rum Canapes
ingredients: 2 large red capsicums, halved lengthways | 8 -10 fresh grape leaves | 1 tablespoon pure pure dark rum | 2 teaspoons cumin | 3 -4 tablespoons tomato puree
instructions: Wash the capsicums, and then cut into halves or quarters. Place a spoonful of the plum mixture onto the middle of each grape leaf. Slightly press out any excess stuffing/coconut. Spoon on a little oil, then sprinkle the rum over the stuffing. Sprinkle with the cumin. Roast in a hot oven at 170°c for 15 - 20 minutes or until the pulp has turned very dark and soft. Serve warm or hot, with a sprig of mint.

title: Beefy Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs steak, 1 1/2 to 2-inch cubes | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 cans frozen strawberries, thawed | 2 -3 teaspoons ground pecans, slightly crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray 11x7 glass baking dish with cooking spray. Using your hands, mix together ricotta and ground pecans. In a small bowl, combine steak, strawberries, and 2 tsp of salt and pepper. Spread mixture over meat mixture in pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,serrano chilies,cider vinegar,egg yolk,thyme,chocolate pudding mix,mint
title: Chocolate Mint Jelly Roll (Mint Jelly Roll)
ingredients: 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix ( 3 3 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 cup rice flour | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 serrano chilies, minced | 3 large egg yolks | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar ( low sodium ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons mint, finely chopped
instructions: Place pudding mix, rice flour, thyme and chilies in a mixing bowl. Beat egg yolks in a separate bowl with a whisk until thick and frothy. Fold one third of egg yolk mixture into the dry pudding mix. Beat the remaining egg yolk mixture into the egg yolk mixture and gradually stir in the vinegar. Repeat twice with remaining egg mixture and pudding mixture. Spoon into jelly roll mold or lined with wax paper. Chill 3 hours to overnight. Sprinkle with mint before serving.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,hot chili powder,green olive,chicken leg,chicken meat
title: Arroz Brasileiro
ingredients: 1 lb chicken leg | 1 lb chicken meat | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon hot chili powder | 1 cup green olives, pitted and halved
instructions: Rinse, pat dry, and remove any large bones or thick skin pieces. Cut legs in 6 to 8 pieces each, then add, chicken meat, cumin powder, and chili powder. Mix thoroughly to coat the items. Tie off excess string or fat. Marinate in refrigerator for at least 3 to 4 hours or at least overnight. Drain the chicken pieces into a covered dish or aluminum foil roaster that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Preheat oven to 450°f and carefully place lid on roasting pan. Place roasting pan on middle rack, and place roasting pan in oven. Bake for about 1 hour, or until chicken is tender.

title: Fried French Onions
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups thinly sliced french onion | 2 tablespoons dark rum, or liqueur | 1 bunch fresh dill, leaves picked
instructions: Mix onion and rum together in a large skillet over medium heat until onions are translucent, about 5 minutes. Scrape into a bowl, and gently peel and discard roots from dill, then set aside. Place onions in a colander, and sprinkle with dill sprigs. Allow to drain until onions are limp enough to peel and toss with a fork, about 25 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: thyme,red chili pepper,black eyed pea,dark rum,greek yogurt,tomato green chilies
title: Cuban Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 jar black-eyed peas or ( 16 ounce ) jar navy beans, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 teaspoon ground thyme | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh red chili pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 cup greek yogurt, plain style, lightly beaten | 1 tablespoon dark rum
instructions: Place black eyed peas, tomatoes, thyme, chilies, and chili pepper in a skillet over low heat and simmer for about 10 minutes, or until the mixture is very tender. Remove from heat and stir in yogurt and rum. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to develop.

title: Napa Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 bagged napa cabbage | 2 flour tortillas
instructions: Cut cabbage into bite size pieces. Stack tortillas between a large salad bowl. Layer napa cabbage on tortillas, making sure each tortillas are covered. Refrigerate for 4 hours to set. Serve with salsa and guacamole.

Random Ingredients: carrot,coriander seed,lard,beef brisket,bamboo shoot,salt white pepper,baby carrot
title: Beef and Vegetable Hash
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 5 -6 large carrots, peeled | 2 large baby carrots | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/2 lb bamboo shoot | 1 tablespoon salt-free white pepper ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup lard or 1/2 cup canola oil
instructions: Dry roast the coriander seeds over low heat and dry completely with a paper towel with a paper towel. Trim any thick or light silver rind from the brisket. Remove the meat from the fridge and cut into chunks. You can discard the spices or use the amount of ginger and garlic desired. If you wish to freeze your hash, scrape them out. Slice the carrots into 1/4 inch coins or thin matchsticks. Place in a bowl with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Dice the 1/2 pound carrots into 1/4 inch coins. Set aside. In a separate bowl, coarsely crush the 1/2 pound carrots, 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/8 teaspoon pepper and 3/4 teaspoon of the black pepper. Add the 1/2 cup of lard or canola oil to a medium sized frying pan and heat the pan. Add the meat and stir fry until browned on all sides. Add the carrots to the meat. Add the coriander seeds. Cover and cook for 1 minute. Turn the heat to low and cook for 45 minutes. While the contents of the pan are cooking, prepare the soup, slice the remaining 2 carrots into ¼ inch pieces. Set aside. When the brisket is done, drain the fat and place in a second small frying pan. Add a little of the fat to the pan. If you are using a skillet, you can heat it over medium high heat until the fat turns a light caramel color. Add all the carrots to the pan. Cook for a few minutes until slightly softened. If not using a blender or food processor, puree the cooked meat in the pan. When that has thickened, stir in the carrots and cooked meat. Keep stirring for about 5 minutes until all the carrots are soft but not mushy. Serve with iranian rice.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,mochi rice cake,cilantro leaf,cranberry,italian turkey sausage link
title: Crazy Rice Cakes
ingredients: 1 package mochi rice cakes | 1 lb sweet italian turkey sausage links ( casing removed ) | 1 tablespoon ginger paste ( bottled ) | 3/4 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare mochi rice cakes according to package directions. Meanwhile, brown sausage in skillet. Remove sausage from skillet.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,sea salt,romaine lettuce,thai peanut sauce
title: Aioli Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup thai peanut sauce | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream | 1/3 cup finely shredded romaine lettuce | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Whisk creamy peanut sauce and irish cream together in a small bowl. Set aside. Place romaine lettuce into a salad bowl and toss with sauce. Top with sea salt.

title: Danish Style Cheese for Breakfast
ingredients: 500 g cottage cheese | 12 pieces thick slab bacon, chopped
instructions: Blanch a piece of bacon in boiling water using a large wood spoon. Using a strainer removes as much of the bacon oil as possible, then add all four pieces of cheese to the bacon and shake it gently to coat both sides of each piece of cheese with oil. After a few minutes the bacon should be completely saturated in fat.

title: Marinated Pears (Appetizer Style)
ingredients: 4 medium firm tomatoes, peeled, seeded and finely minced or 4 medium pears | 4 teaspoons finely grated orange zest | 2 teaspoons finely minced green onions
instructions: Arrange a rack in the lowest third of your oven. Place a baking sheet or broiler tray on the rack. Line a baking sheet with foil. On the rack, arrange the tomatoes loosely over the foil and broil for 1 1/2 minutes, turning the tomatoes frequently, until the bottoms are blistered and the skins are blackened around the edges. Place the tomato in a deep bowl. Sprinkle with 2 teaspoons lemon zest, 2 teaspoons garlic granules, and 1 teaspoon green onion. Stir and repeat as you do. Taste to adjust seasonings. Cover and leave to sit for 20 minutes. Unwrap and serve at room tem.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,red wine vinegar,mayonnaise,white zinfandel wine
title: Olive Garden Ripened Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons dry fruity-red wine vinegar or 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup white zinfandel wine
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small saucepan over moderate heat. Cook and stir until heated through. Serve warm or allow to cool to room temperature. Store in refrigerator.

title: Thai Spice Mix
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon, i use the knorr | 3 thai peppers ( or other mild red pepper )
instructions: Mix all ingredients well, store in airtight container. To use, combine 1 - 1 lb chicken or vegetable. If making for fish.

title: Greek Baked Shrimp (Bake or Grill)
ingredients: 1 package frozen shortcrust pastry, thawed ( 1.25 oz. pouch pastry shells, thawed ) | 6 tablespoons minced green bell pepper ( about 2 green bell peppers ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano or 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh oregano | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning mix, of your choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove 1 pastry pouch from pouch and place on a pastry board. Pat pastry thin using a meat mallet to even coat. Place 1 cup of the seafood and bell pepper mixture in the center of each pastry crust. Fold pastry over filling. Transfer to a parchment lined baking sheet. Coat tops with water and sprinkle with nutmeg or other desired spice topping. Bake until golden brown, 40 to 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,chicken bouillon,chocolate syrup,vidalia onion,italian bread,beef bouillon cube
title: Cafe Rio Sandwich
ingredients: 1 large vidalia onion | 1 teaspoon meat tenderizer or 1/2 teaspoon instant minced onion | 7 ounces chicken bouillon ( can use more ) | 10 ounces beef boulion cubes ( can use more ) | 1 cup chocolate syrup ( or use other favorite flavor ) | 2 ounces grand marnier ( or other good bourbon ) | 1 loaf italian bread, cut into slices
instructions: Heat the broiler. Peel and slice the onion. Put the onion slices, bullion cubes, onion slices, hot chocolate syrup, and cognac in a medium saucepan or crockpot. Add enough boiling water to cover the meat. Cover and simmer for at least 1 1/2 hours or up to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,catsup,coconut cream,colby monterey jack cheese,garlic red chile paste,demerara sugar,mutton,serrano chilies
title: Baked Mince Pies
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh ground mutton | 24 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 4 teaspoons garlic and red chile paste | 1/2 cup kraft coconut cream | 6 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons demerara sugar | 3 small serrano chilies
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix together all ingredients and work into a dough. You may need to use your hands. Pat into mini muffin pan and place on your greased broiler tray. Cook at 350 degrees for 40 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. If using a non stick pan, you may need to cover the tops of the pies with a towel to help prevent them from drying out during baking bake 20 minutes remove from oven and cover with foil and cool for 5 minutes. Remove the foil and cut a slit in the top of each pie.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,cranberry sauce,salsa,agave nectar,jasmine rice,simple syrup,monterey jack cheese
title: Easy Caribbean Chicken Rice Bowl With Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup salsa | 1/3 cup agave nectar | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 2 tablespoons cranberry sauce | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice, uncooked | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice & cheese in medium saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, or until rice and cheese are tender. Stir in rice, cover and let it sit about 5 minutes. Fluff rice with fork & serve.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,caster sugar,szechuan peppercorn,molasses,tomato ketchup,beef chuck,spaghetti sauce,potato reg
title: Czech Beef Stew
ingredients: 800 g lean beef chuck | 800 g spaghetti sauce | 4 tablespoons spicy sweet potato & reg ; mashed potatoes | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 1 tablespoon molasses | 4 tablespoons molasses | 1 1/2 cups cream cheese | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 cup tomato ketchup | spaghetti or mashed potatoes
instructions: Slice the beef thinly across the grain. Cut the spiced sweet potato into thin slices. Mix the spicy sweet potato in a pan with just enough water enough to give it a thick, smooth batter. Pour 1 tablespoon of molasses into the pan to keep the cake moist and add the sliced beef. Sprinkle the sichuan peppercorns and the whole can of tomato ketchup onto the beef then mix the spicy potato mixture well to make the batter. Heat the beef mixture until it is piping hot and pour in the spaghetti or mashed potatoes. Stir thoroughly and pour in the rest of the tomato ketchup, sichuan peppercorns, and caster sugar. Keep stirring until it becomes a nice sauce. Taste for seasonings and see if you need to add salt or sugar. Serve with boiled rice and/or noodles, if desired.

title: Hearty Pizza Crust - Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups warm ( room temp ) warm half-and-half ( room temp ) | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 1/4 cups all-purpose prepared pizza crust | 1 tablespoon cake and half, dry or 1 tablespoon half-and-half mixed with 1 tablespoon water | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup creamed cornstarch | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup dried curly endive lettuce | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: In a medium size bowl, using the paddle of a standing mixer or a light mixer, combine 2 - ½ cups warm half and half or half, 1 teaspoon yeast and 2½ cups flour, mixing until smooth. Pour into the pan and set in a warm spot. In the bowl of a stand mixer, stir together 1 tablespoon cake and ½ cup warm water, 1 teaspoon yeast and 1 teaspoon cake and ½ cup warmed half and half mixed with diced tomatoes and creamed cornstarch. Let stand, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ¼ cup whole and half and 1 teaspoon yeast. Mix well. Place dough in 3 round baking pan or two lightly greased pizza pans. Carefully and generously sprinkle top with 1 teaspoon cornstarch. Loosely cover with parchment paper and let rise for 30 minutes in a warm place. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes, or until crust is golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes. Spread pizza filling on crust with 2 tablespoons tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,white chocolate chip,food coloring,fontina cheese,fennel seed
title: Fennel and Fontina Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup white chocolate chips | 3/4 cup fontina cheese | 3/4 cup fresh parsley flakes | 3/4 teaspoon fennel seed | food coloring ( optional ) | food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Place the dry chips in a microwave safe bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave the cheese in the microwave for 3 - 4 minutes until it melts. Add the rest of the ingredients, except for the food coloring and drop the food coloring into the mixture. Cover and keep in the back of a microwave safe bowl at the lowest setting for about 3 minutes.

title: Coconut Macadamia Milk
ingredients: 1 can light coconut milk | 10 blanched almonds
instructions: Blend well the coconut milk and the almonds until you get a creamy consistency. Serve cold with ice cream or milk.

title: Cheese and Tuna Parcels in Vermicelli Crepes
ingredients: 185 g tuna | 1/3 cup vermicelli | 1/4 cup oats, medium grain | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon grated cheese | 1 teaspoon oats, extra virgin ( fine )
instructions: Drain tuna, and finely chop. Cook tuna, vermicelli and oatmeal in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring until they're hot and have absorbed most of the liquid. Toss through tuna mixture, mustard seeds, allspice, cheese and extra rolled oats. Heat a crepe pan over medium heat, brush with oil. Spoon 1 teaspoon of tuna mixture into the centre of each crepe and roll up. Serve immediately.

title: Fish and Leek
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet, skin on | 2 leeks | 1 package mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat baking sheet with cooking spray. Rinse fish, removing excess skin. Cut leeks lengthways in half, and sprinkle with salt, cooking spray, and white cheese. Place on sheet, and bake 8 minutes, or just until flesh flakes easily.

title: Chinese Bok Choy
ingredients: 2 bunches bok choy | 6 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes, divided | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Wash bok choy with water to remove some of the sand/garden dirt. Cut off any woody stem end of the bok choy that doesn't close when punctured with a knife. Remove 1/3 head of bok choy until there are 8 or 10 leaves, then slice off the remainder for about 1/4 inch length. Wash about 5 or 6 leaves individually before beginning to use. The leaves should be removed at the end of each leaf. Rinse and drain excess water on a napkin covered tray until all the bok choy is removed. Place a large wok, one with a high surface area, over medium high heat.

title: Fruity Indian Radish & Coriander Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 4 teaspoons salt-free garlic & herb seasoning blend | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 small radish, peeled & cored
instructions: Bring the vegetable stock to the boil then add the garlic & herb seasoning blend. Remove the boil then add the coriander & radish. Leave the broth to simmer for 5 minutes then remove the soup from heat. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,serrano pepper,mint leaf,chinese five spice powder,rice wine vinegar,saffron strand,asadero cheese,cream tartar
title: Asadero Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 pinch saffron strand | 6 tablespoons italian dressing | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon light sour cream or 1 tablespoon greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon asadero cheese, grated ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons mint leaves, chopped | 5 drops chinese five-spice powder ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated rind of an asadero cheese
instructions: Dissolve saffron in 2 tablespoons of italian dressing, stir into the remaining ingredients. Chill the mixture in a glass container. To serve, place a small piece of cheese on the bottom 1/2 cup of salad and drizzle on the remaining italian dressing.

title: Maurice's Spanish Onion and Beef Soup
ingredients: 2 large white wall onions | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 can beef stock
instructions: Grate or thinly slice onions. Heat vinegar in soup pot. Add onions. Add beef stock. Let simmer about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ice water,mace,button mushroom,beef consomme,extra virgin olive oil
title: Beef Consommé With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 8 cups sliced button mushrooms, with liquid | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 can beef consomme, undiluted | 1/4 cup hot water
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat. Add mushrooms.

title: Frugal Gourmet's Indian Eggplant
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 package sugar snap peas
instructions: Cut up zucchini into rounds and fry them on medium heat. Mix cream of mushroom soup with turmeric and add 2 1/4 cups of water. Stir in zucchini, cook for 15 minutes. Stir in sugar snap peas and cook for another 5 minutes.

title: Chicken on a Bun
ingredients: 4 6 inch pieces chicken thighs or 4 chicken breasts | 4 whole wheat hamburger buns
instructions: Grill or bake to your liking.

title: The Ultimate Filling for Beef
ingredients: filling : | 3/4 pound lean ground sirloin | 1/4 cup fenugreek, or to taste | 1 1/2 cups mango chutney | 3/4 cup unsweetened pineapple juice or 3/4 cup pineapple chunk juice | filling : | 3/4 cup double cream | 1/2 cup canned apricots, drained, chopped | 4 ounces american cheese, finely diced
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place ground sirloin in a large skillet and cook over medium high heat until evenly browned and crumbly, stirring often. Drain beef on paper towels. Place beef in a medium bowl with fenugreek. Add mango chutney and pineapple juice and mix well. Set aside. In a medium bowl, stir cream with apricots and cheese until thoroughly blended. Pour cream mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2 inch tip. Pipe filling into pastry bag. Place pastry bag over 1/2 inch of simmering wine or water. Place an inverted baking dish with the beef inside the pan. Place pan in broiler and broil for about 5 minutes or until hot.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,tart apple,ranch bean,chinese cabbage,red wine vinegar
title: Sweet and Sour Cabbage  (Cabbage) Salad
ingredients: 1 large tart apple ( such as a mcintosh or gala ) | 1 head chinese cabbage, finely shredded | 1 bag fresh ranch beans ( or other flavorful ) | 1/3 cup good quality red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons good quality irish cream
instructions: Core apple and cut into chunks. In large salad bowl, mix apples, cabbage, and beans in a large bowl. Place vinegar in a separate bowl. Dressing should not be runny but should have almost a liquid consistency. Add the dressing and stir until smooth. Serve and enjoy note, i like to garnish this with a dab of sour cream or mayo or ketchup or other asian style dijon dressing.

title: Spicy Fried Rice
ingredients: 3 cups potatoes, diced and unpeeled | 1 yellow sweet peppers, diced | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno chile, minced | 2 cups of finely shredded cabbage | 2 cups plain white breadcrumbs | 1 package linguine ( can also use cooked spaghetti ) or ( 10 ounce ) package spaghetti, cooked
instructions: Cook the linguine just until it's al dente and drain it. In a large, deep skillet, brown the potato with the chile, pepper, and cabbage stirring until the vegetables are very soft. Remove from heat. Drain the linguine well, then combine with the vegetables. Add the bread crumbs and stir. Put the skillet back on the heat and add enough bread crumbs to make the bread dough and crunch together. If the dough is too crumbly, return to heat and heat through. Do not burn the bread crumbs. Serve right away or store in an air tight container for up to 7 days. If you don’t have any bread crumbs, toast a baguette or cracker of bread crumb by placing it on your counter and rolling it in your palms. Place the bread crumbs in a small plastic bag and shake around to mix it in. It’s worth it to have some crunch.

Random Ingredients: agave nectar,graham cracker,bean sprout,pork loin chop,rye toast,dough
title: Sloppy Joes With Pork Chops, and Rice Casserole (Kraut Frugal)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin chop, cubed | 2 tablespoons agave nectar | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 4 ounces sliced rye toast | 12 ounces frozen miniature marshmallow pecan halves | 1 cup fresh bean sprout, packed ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Combine pork cubes, agave nectar, and breadcrumbs. Spread mixture evenly in ungreased jelly roll pan. Bake for 15 minutes or until pork is no longer pink, stirring halfway through.

title: Halibut and Country Grain Salad
ingredients: 1 whole chicken leg | 1 1/2 pounds frozen mixed vegetables | 4 ounces dry barley | 1 1/2 tablespoons salt | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 1 can or bottle beer
instructions: Place chicken leg in a large pot with enough water to cover | 2 tablespoons barley, salt, vegetable and beer. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer about 75 minutes. Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil. Remove chicken from pot and cut into pieces. Return chicken and any accumulated juices to the pot. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cover, and simmer until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain, and cool. Remove skin and bones, if desired. Shred.

title: Thai Cornbread
ingredients: 4 1/4 cups yellow cornmeal | 2 cups coarsely ground rye bread | 2 tablespoons minced fresh mint | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f, and butter a 9 inch square baking dish. In a medium bowl, stir together cornmeal and rye bread. Stir in mint until evenly distributed. Spread mixture in prepared baking dish and bake in preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center of the bread comes out with moist crumbs, about 30 minutes. Cool 15 minutes, and cut into pieces.

title: Ranch Barley and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 4 large tomatoes, seeded ( about 1� pounds ) | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup small curds ( not whipped cream )
instructions: Cut the tomatoes into very small pieces and mix with the barley. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Divide among serving bowls and garnish with whipped cream.

title: Easy Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 package monterey jack cheese | 3 tablespoons seasoning
instructions: Spray a medium skillet with olive oil spray. Heat over medium to medium high heat. In each cup of cheese add a small can of enchilada sauce. You may have to use more depending on how strong you prefer the sauce. Add the seasoning. Once the sauce is warmed to warm, add another handful of cheese to the bowl and heat. Mix the sauce. Pour the sauce over the cheese when it is melted.

title: Pork and Chicken Paillards
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless pork shoulder, very lean | 1 - 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, cut into 2 pieces each
instructions: Put a piece of fatback in a large, heavy skillet over medium heat. When the fat begins to smoke, add the pork, turning it in the fat several times. The meat will turn to a crusty brown in color. When the pork and pork are cooked, add the chicken breast. Stir well to combine. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for at least 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked. Serve hot.

title: Sheena's Sheena's Salsa of Three Bean, Lamb & Broccoli
ingredients: 200 g dried white beans | 200 g dried pinto beans | 200 g sheena's salsa verde ( or more if you have to ) | 200 g braised chicken breasts ( or meat of your choice. ) | 100 ml double cream, to mix slightly to help thin it | chili flakes, to garnish
instructions: Firstly, start by soaking the dried beans according to the directions on your packet. If you don't have any soaked beans you can put the beans right into a blender and process a few seconds until you have a coarse puree. If you don't have a blender, use a potato masher and gradually mix in the salsa verde, blending all the while. Next, cut your chicken into thin strips and fry in some oil until crispy. You should see some fat floating on the top of the chicken and if it is no longer pink, put aside. Drain your beans and mix thoroughly with the cooked, fried chicken and the spicy salsa. Pour in a glass dish or bowl, mix in a little of the cream and refrigerate until ready to serve, and then top up with a little extra cream or a little a bit more chili flakes.

title: Easy Steak with Maple Gravy
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak | 1 cup creamy mushroom soup | 1/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: Place sirloin steak between two pieces of plastic wrap. Using a meat hammer, pound to about 1/2 inch thickness with mallet. Place in 9x13 inch pan. In medium saucepan heat soup and syrup together and pour over steak. Cover and cook on low heat for at least an hour. Let stand 30 minutes before serving.

title: Cheesy Gin and Garlic-Garlic Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 cup gin
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut around the edge of the cheese rind creating a ragged top that can be exposed. Rinse cheese with water and drain. Mix spices together and use as topping for the cheese on top of your cheese.

title: Indian-Style Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 pint plain yogurt | 1 red chile pepper, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup dried fruit | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: In a large bowl, gently mix together the yogurt, chili, raisins, and dried fruit. Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Tilapia Roll-Em-Ups
ingredients: 600 g tilapia fillets, cut into chunks | 2 pimientos | 2 tablespoons minced fresh sage | 1 tablespoon ranch dressing | 5 kaffir lime leaves | assorted meat ( optional ) or seafood ( optional )
instructions: Cut the tilapia fillets into bite sized pieces. Combine the lime leaf, and kaffir lime leaves, minced sage and pepper seasoning mix in a bowl. Place the tilapia in a shallow frying dish. Pour enough oil to cover the surface of the fish well. Fry the fish for 5 minutes on both sides. If desired, add a little meat or shrimp to the cooked fish. Turn when the fish is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,maple syrup,limeade concentrate,monterey jack cheese,grape leaf,blueberry,chili sauce,soy sauce
title: Buffalo Blueberry Chili
ingredients: 6 cups fresh blueberries, quartered | 2 tablespoons limeade concentrate, frozen concentrate | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 jar grape leaves | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Combine blueberries, limeade concentrate, bouillon, chili sauce and soy sauce in a large pot. Cover and let simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until berries are tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover, and let stand for approximately 5 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup blueberry juices. Place grape leaves in a bowl and fill with the reserved blueberry juice. Rinse grape leaves by rinsing quickly in a colander and pat dry. Slice remaining leaves into strips and arrange 1 on a plate. Cover and chill. Pour reserved pan juices over the berry mixture and season with reserved blueberries, limeade concentrate, and chili sauce. Serve top individual servings with monteray jack cheese.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,italian dressing,stout beer,beef sirloin,cherry tomato
title: American Kitchen Classic Steak for Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef sirloin, trimmed of all fat ( with steak-pound or other thin cut pieces ) | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 can of russet beer | 1 jar of your favorite italian dressing | 1 can italian stewed tomatoes, drained
instructions: In a 6 to 8 qt slow cooker, combine steak, cherry tomatoes, italian dressing, and stewed tomatoes. Cover tightly and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. After removing from cooker, allow meat to rest for 10 minutes. Slice meat and serve on a plate, with the tomatoes and remaining dressing as you wish.

title: Maggie's "Queso"
ingredients: 6 pieces veal | salt and red curry paste | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crumbled queso fresco
instructions: Thoroughly cut veal bones. Use as many bones as needed to fit on a baking sheet. Sprinkle the veal with red curry paste mixed with a little water until the paste is evenly distributed over the meat. Bake the veal in a slow oven, 425f for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Slice very thinly. Arrange slices on a platter. Sprinkle with crumbled cheese and a drizzle or two of fat.

title: Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 2 large boneless lamb shanks | cooking spray | 1 eggplant ( aubergine ), cut into 2-inch-thick lengthwise strips | 2 limes, juice of
instructions: Preheat grill to high and lightly oil the grate. Place lamb shanks on the hot grill and spray with cooking oil. Cook, turning once, until browned, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Slice eggplant crosswise into slabs 1/4-inch thick. Remove lamb from grill. Add eggplant to the same skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Stir in lime juice. Serve.

title: Spicy Rum Drizzle
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark rum | topping | 4 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small cup and microwave for about 45 seconds or until sesame is very fragrant. Pour into glass for dipping.

Random Ingredients: lemon,paprika,chicken stock,jalapeno pepper,graham wafer crumb,thai tea,parmesan cheese,cumin powder
title: Smoked Jalapeno Pepper Nuts
ingredients: 16 jalapeno peppers, sliced thin | 1 cup graham wafer crumbs | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock, heated | 1 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 lemon, juice and grated zest & juice of | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon thai tea
instructions: Place the chile peppers, grated cheese, lemon zest, paprika, & chili sauce in a bowl. Add in the tea, mix well & set aside.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,red pepper sauce,mascarpone cheese,angel hair pasta
title: Spicy Red Pepper Fettuccini
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta, broken into small pieces | 1 jar hot red pepper sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta to desired consistency.

title: Vanilla Daube (Kebabs)
ingredients: 1 bottle vanilla vodka | 4 lbs beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 6 quart plastic bag. Refrigerate, turning bag frequently, for 2 days, turning bag over every once in a while. Be sure to remove the plastic from the bag.

title: Baked Pig & Sheep's Feet
ingredients: 1 pig shank | 2 tablespoons molasses | 5 teaspoons dried savory | 4 teaspoons dried ground mixed spice ( thyme, marjoram, sage or whatever spices you choose ) | 1 teaspoon hot water | 1/4 cup walnut oil
instructions: Clean the pig shank well to remove the loose bone, place shank in a large oven proof cooking pot, then add the molasses, savory, mixed spice, crushed juniper berries etc. Add the hot water. Cover and bake at 325°f for about 1 1/4 hours or until the meat falls off the bone. Remove the shank from the pot, then use a slotted spoon to remove most of the excess fat from the pot. Set aside to cool. In a small bowl, stir the nuts to combine and spread on the top of the meat. Return the shank to the pot, then add the nut mixture. Cover and bake at 325°f for an hour or until the meat is tender.

title: Mika's Egg Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces cream of chicken soup | 12 ounces egg substitute | italian herbs
instructions: Combine soups and egg substitute and pour into large sauce pan. Add herbs. Bring to boil and let simmer on low heat 5 minutes. Serve over cooked egg noodles.

title: Sweet Gingerbread
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups bread flour | 1/2 cup vegetable broth ( your choice ) or 1/2 cup dry white flour ( your choice ) | 1/4 cup dark golden syrup | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 medium inch fresh gingerroot, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f combine bread flour, broth, syrup and grand marnier in a large bowl, mixing well to blend. Add ginger and combine thoroughly. Add 1 3/4 of the flour mixture and knead gently with your hands until dough forms a ball. Form dough into a ball, then shape into a smooth ball. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet, cover, and form into a 3/4 inch thick round on the cookie sheet. Using a sharp knife, cut a cross in the top of the dough, cutting 6 slits in the top from stem to top, cutting 1/2 inch deep crosshatch.. Sprinkle top of loaf with remaining flour. Bake for 25 minutes. When cool, dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Spaghetti with Jellied Cranberry Sauce, and Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 6 pita pockets | 1/2 cup uncooked spaghetti | 1 jar jellied cranberry sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Place pita pockets on baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until crispy, about 5 minutes. Break the pieces apart into smaller pieces. Place spaghetti in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring water to a boil, and stir in jellied cranberry sauce, or more if needed. Cook until pasta is al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain, and serve warm with bread crumbs, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red bean,vegetable oil cooking spray,wooden skewer,egg wrap,turkey,cointreau liqueur,button mushroom,pear
title: Roast Pork and Vegetable Egg Rolls
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package mixed dried pears | 10 fresh button mushrooms, halved | 1 can red beans, rinsed, drained | 1/3 cup cointreau liqueur | 12 egg roll wraps | 1 lb ground turkey | 12 frozen wooden skewers ( or you can use metal skewers )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Coat roasting pan with cooking spray.

title: Fluffy Baked Rice
ingredients: 1 cup cooked brown rice | 1 1/2 cups dry breadcrumbs or 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped toasted bread | 1/2 cup ground cinnamon or 1 1/2 teaspoons ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Stir rice, bread crumbs and cinnamon or nutmeg in a bowl until well blended and rice is evenly distributed. Spread mixture in a casserole dish and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,cashew nut,muenster cheese,five spice powder,flat leaf italian parsley,eggplant,jam,red pepper flake
title: A Unique Eggplant Salad With Cashews and Five-Spice
ingredients: 3 large eggplants, unpeeled | 1/8 cup extra-virgin extra virgin olive oil, plus extra | extra virgin olive oil, for sauteing eggplant | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1/2 handful flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 ounce shelled cashew nuts, salted | 4 ounces muenster cheese, grated ( or other cheese of your choice ) | 8 -10 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Place a sheet of aluminum foil on a work surface and put it on your work surface. Place half the eggplants on the foil and mist with olive oil. Sprinkle with a pinch of crushed red pepper flakes. Sprinkle with five spice powder and then top with remaining eggplant. Starting from the short end, tightly roll up the eggplants and slice, creating a cylinder shape about 2 in diameter and 2 1/2 feet long.. Repeat until all the eggplant slices are rolled out and cut into approximately 1 1/2 inches long slices. Pour enough olive oil into a heavy large sauté pan to come just up to a depth of 1 1/2 inches, and put on a medium to high heat. When oil is hot, add half the eggplants, pressing them down several times to keep the slices as flat as possible. When they start sizzling, add another tablespoon or two of extra virgin olive oil, and toss over high heat to soften the eggplant slightly, but not burn them. When the bottom begins to turn golden brown, remove from pan and immediately stir the eggplant slices around so that the slices cook evenly, moving them around a little. When all the slices are golden brown, remove from heat. Pour on more olive oil, and sprinkle with remaining crushed red pepper flakes. To serve, arrange the roasted eggplant on a plate evenly, and mound on a mound of roasted nuts on top of the eggplant slices. Repeat with remaining ingredients, laying each in a reverse spiral. Sprinkle with greek parsley and garnish with a handful of grated cheese. Note, roasted peanuts can be purchased from asian shops and they can be prepared several hours in advance and eaten right away.

title: Real Simple Pizza Dough
ingredients: 500 g fresh yeast | 500 g fresh american cheese or 500 g mozzarella cheese, about | 2 packets dry yeast, in | english bags
instructions: Mix yeast, yeast, and the 4 1/2 cups of 4 cups of water and put into 2 cups of large zip lock lases. Place on medium heat, stirring constantly. When liquid begins to bubble and the yeast starts to foam, remove from heat. Stir in the flour and continue to stir until dough is smooth and elastic. Let set for 10 minutes, until doubled. Transfer dough to a large bowl and put in refrigerator to rise for 40 minutes, until doubled. Preheat oven to 550° f. Punch dough down. Roll out on lightly floured bench to make circle. Use pizza pans as a guide for dough, or you can use a jelly roll pan, cookie sheet, or pizza stone for a flat surface. Poke slits all over with a sharp knife and sprinkle with oregano/pimento before baking. Bake for about 10 minutes, until crust is lightly browned.

title: Butterscotch Crispy Roast Pork
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast | 3 cups butterscotch chips, crumbled | 6 ounces pork fat packed with 1/4 cup melted butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Rinse pork.

title: Mascarpone Fondues
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mascarpone, cubed | 4 tablespoons cream | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 4 slices bread, crusts removed | 1/2 tablespoon finely grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 tablespoon coarsely ground sumac
instructions: Make the mascarpone cubes by combining mascarpone chunks, cream, and asafoetida in a bowl. Set aside. Bring a small saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Working in batches, place the bread slices in, one slice at a time, and slip off the bread slices as the slices are dipped. Dip the bread into the cheese mixture, turning once, and transfer to a baking dish lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle with the pecorino cheese and sumac, and set aside. Repeat with the remaining bread slices.

title: Oven French Toast
ingredients: 1 package french bread | 1/2 cup golden brown sugar | 1/4 cup teapsoon frozen tea ( or your favorite tea ) | 4 slices stale bread
instructions: Cut french bread in half lengthwise. Remove bread from package. Stuff bread with tea, and sprinkle with brown sugar. Close with bread. Cook @350 for 35 minutes to 1 hour, or until bread is golden and bubbly.

title: Crock Pot Easy Corned Celery
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup sweet cornstarch | 1 teaspoon water | 1 stalk celery, cut into 3 pieces
instructions: Place celery in crockpot. Mix cornstarch with water.

Random Ingredients: cod,irish cream,pistachio,farfalle pasta,soy sauce,sausage,vegetable broth,canola oil
title: Smoked Cod With Creamy Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 10 ounces smoked sausage, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 12 ounces farfalle pasta or 12 ounces penne pasta | 14 ounces smoked cod, cut into bite-size chunks ( flake off any bones ) | 8 ounces smoked salmon, cut in 1/4-inch slices | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 cup vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1 cup roughly chopped pistachios, toasted, plus additional, for garnish
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: garlic,black pepper,canola oil,vegetable,green cardamom pod,walnut,creole seasoning,sage leaf
title: North African Dukkah Kebabs (Vegetarians)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning ( korma ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves or 1 teaspoon fresh sage | 1/2 teaspoon freshly cracked black pepper | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 large ripe vegetable, such as zucchini, cut into 1/4-inch slices, peeled, lengthwise ( such as zucchini ) | 3/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped garlic
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the oil, seasoning, sage, pepper, 2 pods cardamom, and 1/2 cup water. Stir to combine. Add the vegetable slices and walnuts, and toss to combine. Season with salt and pepper if necessary. Cover, and let stand for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: caper,fennel powder,vegetable stock,stewing beef,vegetable oil peanut,caraway seed,ricotta cheese
title: Paneer(Beef Stew)
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes and as tough as possible. | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 2 tablespoons fennel powder ( ground mixed well ) | 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( ground well ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 carton vegetable stock ( from the carton ) | 1 bag ricotta cheese and a little sugar
instructions: Combine the beef, capers, fennel powder, caraway and vegetable oil. Pour in the stock, cover tightly and simmer on the stove for 1 3/4 hours or until meat is tender. Mix ricotta and sugar. Stir thoroughly and heat until hot.

title: Pan Fried Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork chops | 1 jar rag� pasta sauce with poultry seasoning
instructions: In a slow cooker, place the pork chops and the pasta sauce and stir to combine. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours, or until the pork chops are cooked through. Serve over a tossed green salad.

title: Farmer Cheese With Hints of Corn (Farmer's Cheese)
ingredients: 1/2 gallon farmer cheese | 8 ounces firm whole kernel corn | 3 -4 black mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons juniper berries
instructions: If your farmer cheese is not already in season, then buy it. If you choose to use this cheese in an ingredient packet, preheat the oven to 450° fahrenheit. To make the pickle, place the stem side of the farmer cheese on the corn. Scatter the mushrooms around the cheese, and sprinkle with juniper berries. Dot with about half of the cheese. Repeat the process with the rest of the cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, or until cheese just begins to turn golden. When the corn is bubbling, remove the pickle from the oven and let cool to room temperature, about 10 to 15 minutes. Enjoy note, this cheese is not at all the same. It should be soft and slightly sticky, rather than too crunched. It can be eaten warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: salad green,lime zest,chicken breast tender,cake flour,kiwi fruit
title: Soy and Lime Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cake flour, plus extra for dusting | 250 g boneless skinless chicken breasts tenders, cut into 16 salad leaves | 1 tablespoon lime zest, grated | 4 kiwi fruits, peeled and cut into 16 wedges | salad greens ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Combine flour and zest in a shallow bowl. Dip chicken into flour, then press into juice. Place in greased ovenproof dish and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until crispy and cooked through. Remove from oven and toss with lime zest, kiwi, salad leaves, if using and serve.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,red chili pepper,onion powder,celery,semolina flour,coriander seed
title: Quick and Easy Kiwi Fruit Mince Pies
ingredients: 1 cup semolina flour | 1 tablespoon dried coriander seeds | 1 tablespoon criander seeds | 1 tablespoon dried onion powder | 1/2 cup minced celery | 1/2 cup diced fresh kiwi fruit, and pulp removed ( i used 2 of these )
instructions: Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl, and then rub in the kiwi pulp. Add your sweetener and knead until you get a firm dough. The longer it is made, the better this mixture will be. Place into muffin tins and fill about to half way full with the mixture. Bake at 190°c for 20 minutes.

title: Cherry Flour Crusted Tuna
ingredients: 400 g tuna fillets ( fresh or frozen and thawed ) | 2 cups cake flour ( all purpose flour )
instructions: Place tuna into a food processor. Puree, then add 1/2 cup of cake flour. Blend or process til mixture is fairly smooth and creamy. Place remaining cake flour on a separate plate or tray. Shape the tuna into a ball, then roll out to a thickness of 1/4 inch. Using your fingers, poke a series of holes all over the tuna for a decorative pattern. Dust tuna with the remaining flour. Heat a non stick frying pan with just enough liquid from cooking fish to cover the surface of the pan. Place the tuna carefully into the pan. Turn the heat down to medium. Cook for about 5 - 10 minutes, uncovered, until the flakes are slightly crisp and a deep golden brown. Transfer pan onto a cooling rack. Use as required.

title: Parsley and Grand Marnier Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1/3 cup grand marnier
instructions: Combine the parsley and grand marnier in a small saute pan. Stir over medium heat until the liquid evaporates. Cool until the sauce can be stirred. To serve, stir in about 1/4 cup of the parsley.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,veal,green,vegetable stock,corn,green chili salsa
title: Tasty Fried Rice for One!
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice, uncooked | 5 cups vegetable stock, for a non stick fry pan ( or stock cubes ) | 1 green chili salsa ( i used hatch green chili salsa ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup vege-tuna cooked, cube, cube-cut, and drained ( i used the small can of solid, diced tofu ) | 1/4 cup canned corn, drained | 1 tablespoon finely chopped green chilis ( i used red chilis ( or to taste ) | finely grated vegetarian crumbles, such as cheddar-jack or feta cheese
instructions: Heat oil in a large frying pan or wok on medium heat. Saute rice until golden, then stir in hot stock. Add the salsa, fish, and meat. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 20 minutes, until liquid is absorbed. Serve immediately. Note, if the rice has allowed time, use 2 - 3 tbsp of stock or water instead. I just didn't have nor had any vegetable stock, so i took this recipe from my wok for a quick dinner.

title: Balsamic Glazed Beef Liver
ingredients: 3/4 lb liver, cut in to 3-inch slices | boiling water | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon caramel | 2 1/2 tablespoons lowfat canned condensed milk
instructions: In a small bowl whisk together vinegar, worcestershire sauce and caramel. Sprinkle liver with mixture and toss to coat. Bake, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring halfway through. Add condensed milk and simmer, stirring until thickened.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,dill,sun tomato oil,caraway seed,mexican oregano
title: Dried Beef, Caraway seed and Tomato Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground caraway seed | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1 pound beef stew meat, cubed | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 ounce sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped
instructions: Add caraway seed, oregano and beef to stew. Stir to coat and cook on low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Add dill and sun dried tomatoes. Cover and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.

title: Hot Garlic Scallops
ingredients: 4 medium scallops | 1 tablespoon minced chili pepper flakes | 1/2 baguette
instructions: Arrange scallops on a large sheet of plastic wrap and sprinkle with chili flakes.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,ginger garlic paste,knorr chicken bouillon,peanut butter,rhubarb,chicken breast half
title: Rhubarb Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into chunks | 1 container peanut butter | 3 tablespoons knorr chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup minced fresh ginger garlic paste | 1 tablespoon asparagus, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped rhubarb
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken in a 1 quart casserole dish. Mix peanut butter, bouillon, ginger sauce, and asparagus into a smooth paste. Pour peanut sauce over chicken. Cover and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Mix rhubarb into the chicken for the last 15 minutes of baking.

title: Miso Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 medium button mushrooms | 3/4 cup white miso, to taste | 1/4 cup dried mostaccioli pasta, cooked ( approx 5.5 cups ) | 1/4 loaf crusty white bread, cut in small cubes | 1/4 cup white miso, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f remove excess stems from mushrooms and rinse the mushrooms slightly under running water. Remove some of remaining stems to make the stuffing easier to stuff, if desired. Mince the caps. Slice the bread into small pieces and place in a baking dish or pie pan. Remove some of the bread from the crust, if desired, and break into small chunks. Drizzle miso over bread chunks. Sprinkle mushroom caps with crumbled bread pieces and remaining bread. Bake in oven for about 25 minutes or until crust is lightly golden.

title: Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef | 1 2/3 cups burgundy wine | vegan mozzarella cheese, shredded ( preferably dairy )
instructions: Place beef in crock pot. Combine all remaining ingredients and stir until well blended. Pour into crock pot. Cook on high for 3 hours or low for 9 hours. Serve over egg noodles.

title: Flaming Chicken Bake
ingredients: 4 lbs frying chickens | 2 red onions | 1 bunch spring onion | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese | 2 -3 cups cornmeal
instructions: In large saute pan or electric skillet heat 3 of onions in butter or margarine. When translucent, add spring onions. When golden brown reduce heat to low. Coat chicken with cornmeal. Place chicken into the heated pan or electric skillet. Add the rest of the onions, onions, and swiss on top. Cover, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. When done remove cover, and cook until cheese melts. Put chicken under broiler, and cover until cheese melts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,cooking onion,yogurt,garlic clove,white breadcrumb,milk,polenta,beer
title: Polenta & Beer-Battered Baked Onions
ingredients: 2 loaves white breadcrumbs | 1 1/4 lbs boiling, skinned boneless polenta, cut into 3 1/2-inch cubes | 1/3 cup finely chopped toasted white breadcrumbs or 1/3 cup finely chopped toasted pine nuts | cooking onion, cut into wedges | 2 hot red chili peppers, seeded and minced | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 3/4 cup low-fat milk | 1 1/2 cups low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250°f and sprinkle the inside of a 13 x 9 glass baking dish with the toasted bread crumbs. Combine the chopped onions, bread crumbs, pine nuts, and a pinch of salt in a large bowl and toss with your hands to mix. Spread half of the polenta cubes over the bottom of the baking dish. Sprinkle the polenta mixture over the polenta, spread evenly. Bake for 25 minutes, stirring the polenta with a fork in between. Reduce the oven oven temperature to 300°f and bake for 25 minutes longer or until the sauce is nicely caramelized to a creamy consistency. Remove from the oven and allow to cool for 10 minutes for a better crust, remove from the oven and allow to cool thoroughly. To prepare the yogurt sauce, combine the yogurt and milk in a bowl and stir with a whisk. Store in the refrigerator. The sauce can be made 2 days in advance, covered and refrigerated, covered. Reheat the polenta as directed on the package. This recipe works well with a jarred batch of polenta, but it is easier to slice when cold.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker,flounder fillet,clove,fine semolina,beef bouillon cube,caper
title: Steamed Fish With Crushed Whole Fennel
ingredients: 1 whole flounder fillet | sugar cube | 1 teaspoon capers | 1/2 cup fine semolina | 10 whole cloves | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Mix all ingredients except fish. Pour into a steaming pan. Place fish in the pan, pour boiling water over fish and simmer covered on a steamer rack on high for 15 minutes or until opaque when dorsal fin is jiggled. Serve with fresh flatbread. Serve immediately with fresh crisp salad.

title: Yogurt Capsicum
ingredients: 250 g puff pastry ( or similar filling, see my related recipe ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1/4 cup currants | 2 tablespoons yogurt | 1 teaspoon tequila
instructions: Combine cumin, turmeric, hot pepper flakes and currants. Stir in yogurt. Divide mixture into four. Place one portion on each pastry sheet. Roll out into long 1cm wide strips. Cut strips into 5 cm lengths. Place on a lightly oiled baking tray. Brush tops with oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 180ºc for 12 minutes, or until just cooked. Remove from oven. Carefully remove pastry strips. Transfer to a cooling rack. Using a slotted spoon, remove any excess oil from baking tray. Keep warm. Increase heat to 220ºc. Place pastry strips on paper towel, towel covered, for about 20 minutes. When pastry strips are cool, remove excess paper. Place 1 cm apart, on a floured surface. Knead quickly to get a pliable, smooth pastry shape using a rolling pin. Divide evenly between two pastry sheets, keeping the corners straight. Spread each with about 1/2 tsp currant mixture, 2 tsp yoghurt and a sprinkling of cumin. Roll up tightly. Cut capsicum in half and place on a lightly floured board. Carefully push a tighly open end of pastry, a little at a time, towards you leaving 2cm of dough in the pastry shell. Gently stretch pastry to form a 7cm circle. Repeat with the remaining pastry, filling, currants and tumeric pastry. Lightly brush tops with reserved oil. Bake for 2 hours, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mung bean overnight,cumin powder,carrot,vodka,granny smith apple,cardamom pod,chickpea,fish sauce
title: Smoky Mung Bean Soup - Mae Khiyar
ingredients: 500 g mung beans, soaked overnight & drained | 400 ml fish sauce | 1 granny smith apple, finely chopped | 1 pinch ground cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 50 ml potatoato passata ( see note ) | 100 ml vodka ( see tip ) or 100 ml brandy ( see tip ) | 3 carrots, shredded
instructions: Simmer soup in a large saucepan over medium heat until beans are just tender. Puree soup through batches in a food processor.

title: Red Wine-Braised Plums
ingredients: 2 lbs plums, halved | 2 cups red wine | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup canola oil | paprika
instructions: Place plums in a large bowl. Pour the red wine over plums. Cover and refrigerate until ready to cook. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet, over medium high heat, until just smoking. Add plums and sauté for two minutes, turn until they can be covered. Add paprika and sauté one more minute. Cover skillet and remove from heat. Cool in liquid for 10 minutes. Remove plums, saving liquid. Discard paprika and oil. Place plums in serving bowl. Spoon reserved liquid over plums.

title: Homemade Stock I
ingredients: 5 quarts filtered water | 2 quarts black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Soak peppercorns in water in a large container and let sit out overnight. Do not drain after soaking. In the morning, rinse the liquid from the peppercorns and place them in a large pot. Add the peppercorns and mace and pour them in. Simmer over medium low heat for 4 hours. Do not boil. After 4 hours, remove from heat and let stand for 3 hours.

title: Pasta With Orange Zest and Zest
ingredients: 7 ounces penne pasta | 3 orange zest ( zest of 1 orange )
instructions: Cook pasta in 2 quarts boiling, salted water. Meanwhile, heat zest in small skillet until it turns golden brown.

title: Chinese Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti or 1 lb any other small pasta, cooked to al dente | 2 tablespoons a.1. original sauce | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste, heaped | 2 eggs | 2 tablespoons cilantro, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, dissolved in | 1 cup hot sauce | 1 medium red capsicum, diced small
instructions: Cook pasta in 2 quarts boiling, salted water as directed on package. Add the rest of the remaining ingredients, except the bell pepper, and cooked drained pasta. Drain pasta and return to pot. Turn pasta over and add the bell pepper. Cover and cook 2 minutes or until cooked through. Serve hot with a large spoonful of extra sauce over if desired.

title: Grpa's Sun Dried Tomato and Eggplant Lasagna (Low Fat Recipe)
ingredients: 2 small eggplants | 1 lemon, juice of | 50 -75 ml sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup pine nuts or 1/4 cup walnut pieces | 1 bunch fresh cilantro | 1 bunch fresh sage | 24 sheets lasagna noodles | 1 lemon, juice of, only | 1/2 cup pine nuts or 1/2 cup walnuts, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut a lengthwise slit about 1/2 thick and in the middle of each eggplant slice the eggplant into 1/4 inch slices. Place sliced eggplant slices on a cookie sheet and bake until light brown and tender. In a bowl mash the sun dried tomatoes and pour the oil over the tomatoes. Set aside. In a small mixing bowl combine the sage and cilantro. In a separate bowl toss together the sun dried tomato mixture with the cilantro and sage mixture, add the pine nuts and set aside. Cook lasagna according to package directions, drain and divide the sauce evenly between the 4 lasagna sheets. Layer the 2 sheets on top of each other in this order, 3 lasagna sheets, 3 tomato halves, 3 eggplant slices, 1/2 of the pesto mixture on each, 1/2 of the pesto mixture. Repeat the layering process and top with the remaining 3 lasagna sheets the remaining pesto and chopped pine nuts. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, depends on how thick you slice the lasagna sheets.

title: Simple Bacon Dressing
ingredients: 2 slices real thick-cut bacon | 2 tablespoons tapioca
instructions: In a bowl, fry bacon in a microwave oven until crisp. Break bacon into pieces and combine with tapioca.

Random Ingredients: pork,baby spinach,radish,white corn syrup,salt pork,oregano,shortcrust pastry,coffee creamer
title: Sweet Pork and Cheese Pie
ingredients: 600g lean ground pork | 1/4 cup shredded pork fat ( i use lean ground pork fat, i'm guessing just use less fat ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped smoked salt pork ( can use more, i've used pork fat ) | 1/3 cup white corn syrup | 1/2 cup brewed coffee creamer or 1/2 cup strong coffee | 225 g baby spinach or 225 g fresh baby leaves | 2 fresh coriander leaves, finely shredded
instructions: Mix meat, herbs, salt and coffee creamer together. Roll out crust and cut into 6 slices, marking the outside of the pie in 5. Fill pie with filling. Top with spinach or leaves. Dot the top with cheese. Bake at 220°c for about 30 minutes till the pastry is browned and golden. Note, you can bake it as pie as a pie as the filling is then refrigerate at least 20 - 30 minutes before serving.

title: Coffee-Stir-Fry (With Pork)
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style lean pork ribs | 1 tablespoon instant espresso ( or other instant coffee ) | 2 green bell peppers, cut into 1-inch strips
instructions: Trim excess fat from ribs and fat.

title: Grilled Chorizo and Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bean sprouts | 1/2 cup peanuts
instructions: Mix together the sprouts and peanuts in a bowl. Heat a grill pan over medium heat. Use a fork to cook for about 3 - 5 minutes, until the peanuts begin to brown. Brush with oil, and flip. Place the sprouts on a plate and grill until the rest of the sprouts have begun to brown, about 3 - 4 minutes per side. Cut into strips, and serve.

title: Turnip and Pudding
ingredients: 1 kg turnip ( i like yellow, but i use other sweet white of choice ) | 3 cups fresh fruit, sliced ( i use a mixture of strawberries, mango and peaches )
instructions: Wash and peel the turnip and cut into half or quarters. Cook in boiling water until tender. Place in a saucepan, add the juice from the turnips. Cover and bring to the boil. Simmer until tender. Taste and add more juice as necessary. Add fruit and simmer for approximately 4 minutes until heated through. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,phyllo pastry,no boil lasagna noodle
title: Simple Lasagna
ingredients: 8 sheets frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles | seasoning salt to taste
instructions: On a lightly floured surface, roll each strip of dough into a 12x8 inch rectangle. On a lightly floured surface, roll each strip into a 12x15 inch rectangle. With a serrated knife, cut into three 6 inch squares. Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add lasagna squares, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until crisp. Drain on paper towels, and season with salt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green bean,coffee,wild rice,parsley flake,pea pod,apple,wheat penne pasta
title: Wild Rice Skillet (Diabetic)
ingredients: 2 cups dry whole wheat penne pasta or 2 cups rotini pasta | 1/4 cup low-sodium instant coffee, liquid reserved | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried apple, bits ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked wild rice | 1 1 cup fresh green beans, sliced | 1/4 cup frozen peas and pods, cut in half
instructions: Cook pasta in 3 quarts boiling water about 11 minutes or until al dente.

title: Spicy Dipping Sauce for Vegetables and Chicken
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces dry crushed tomatoes and red pepper powder | 1 teaspoon ground coriander leaves or 1 teaspoon cilantro leaf | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon nut powder
instructions: Mix the crushed tomatoes with the crushed red pepper mix with the coriander and white pepper powder. Refrigerate for 2 - 3 hours to allow the flavours to develop and the vegetables to blend. Serve with roasted or grilled vegetables and crackers of your choice.

title: Simple Bistro Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses | 2 tablespoons beef broth | 2 tablespoons salsa
instructions: Place in a saucepan the molasses, broth and salsa, and bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat. Stir. Reduce heat to low. Cover, and continue cooking for about 10 minutes to thicken the sauce. Remove and discard the vegetables and/or beef from the saucepan and stir into the saucepan. Cover, and increase heat to medium low. Simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring frequently.

title: Baby Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 2 teaspoons honey | 2 tablespoons mixed baby corn
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Brush barbecue grates with oil. Place baby corn on the grill, and cook 3 to 4 minutes, or until corn is tender. Remove corn from the grill, and season with honey. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: shallot,flour tortilla,yellow onion,creole seasoning,pumpkin,chipotle chile adobo,kitchen bouquet
title: Crock Pot Chipotle Pot Delights
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1 cup canned pumpkin | 1 tablespoon chopped chipotle chile in adobo | 1/2 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 shallots, chopped or 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 2 tablespoons kitchen bouquet | 16 flour tortillas ( use low for diet )
instructions: Cook pumpkin in a skillet to boiling and then remove and place flesh in a bowl. Place pumpkin in a crock pot, with the chile, creole seasoning, chopped shallot, and kitchen bouquet. Add remaining ingredients and stir to mix well. Pour mixture into a 9 x 13 pan and cover with aluminium foil. Cook on high for 1 hour then reduce to low for another 9 to 10 hours. Carefully remove foil and sprinkle with chopped fresh cilantro or oregano. Serve with flour.

title: Sukiyaki (Japanese Pickled Red Cabbage)
ingredients: 1/3 cup tamari | 1/3 cup finely chopped red cabbage | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon powder | 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh grated nutmeg | 2 tablespoons shredded swiss chard ( or other cabbage leaves )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and stir well.

title: Curry Dip (Vindaloo)
ingredients: 3 green onions, chopped | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons mixed spice
instructions: Finely chop green onions and place in a clean saucepan. Add all remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 10 minutes, until the mixture thickens slightly.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,active yeast,banana flower lengthwise,white bean,kiwi
title: Blackened Sea Beet Baked in Foil
ingredients: 1/2 cup white beans, drained | 1 teaspoon kalamata olive, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 cups ripe bananas with blossoms, peeled, halved lengthwise | 2 kiwi, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded, and sliced lengthwise ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss beans with olives. Sprinkle with yeast.

title: Pasta With Smoky Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 400 g macaroni | 200 g ripe olives ( kalamata or other black olives ) | 200 g smoky paprika smoky tomatoes ( or your favourite brand ) | 2 tablespoons good quality white vinegar | 5 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander | 2 punnets fresh strawberries or 2 punnets cherry tomatoes
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c, gas mark cook pasta for 6 minutes, drain and return to the pan to keep warm. Drain olives and put into a blender with tomato, olives and vinegar and mix well. Melt margarine in 10c /180c / gas mark mix in the coriander and cook over a low heat for two minutes until fragrant. Combine the pasta with dressing and sprinkle over toasted coriander.

Random Ingredients: meat,mozzarella cheese,stewing beef,white breadcrumb,beef sirloin steak,liquid honey,chuck roast,steak
title: Beef Steak Parmesan
ingredients: 4 beef sirloin steaks, 4 ounces each | 2 beef top sirloin steaks | 1 lb fresh white breadcrumb | 1 lb mozzarella cheese or 1 lb italian cheese, 8 oz | 1 1/2 lbs leftover stewing beef, sliced into 8 pieces | 1 lb leftover stewing beef, sliced into 8 pieces | 2 cups beef bouillon or 2 cups beef liquid, 3/4 cup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse out a roasting pan and pour the hot water into the pan. Turn the meat over and rub with 1/2 the salt and freshly ground pepper.
