Place the breadcrumbs on a piece of waxed paper and cover with the mozzarella cheese. Put the breaded cheese into the meat and roll the meat up in the seasoned crumbs. Place meat onto a roasting pan or cookie sheet. Mix the 2 cups of beef broth with the 3/4 cup beef bouillon. Pour the broth mixture evenly over the meat, and bake in a preheated oven until the meat is tender and the sauce is bubbly, about 1 hour. When done, transfer to a warm platter and let stand 10 minutes before carving.

title: Peanut Soup
ingredients: 10 1/2 ounces condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: sugar syrup,kidney bean,chocolate chip,cilantro,peanut butter,cucumber,heavy whipping cream,liquid smoke
title: Mexican Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces sweetened chocolate chips | 2/3 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons light vegetable flavor sodium sweetener or 2 tablespoons honey | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke, to taste | 3 tablespoons shredded colavita low-fat chocolate chip | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Place chocolate chips in a small bowl. Stir in peanut butter, cream, beans and sweetener. Season with liquid smoke and cilantro. Chill until ready to serve. Before serving, sprinkle with coarse salt or pepper.

title: A Simple French Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons white onions, minced | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh blueberries, chopped, to taste
instructions: Sprinkle chopped onions on fresh vegetables. Add blueberries, toss and serve. Yum.

title: Baked King Prawns (Prawns)
ingredients: 1 kg king prawns, raw peeled and deveined | 400 g frozen yeast
instructions: Drege prawns in a large bowl of hot water, leave them to soak for 30 minutes. Heat oven to 190 degrees celsius put the prawns into a baking dish and place in the oven until cooked through, about 40 minutes. Remove from oven, leave prawns to cool then remove shells and tails. Make a slit in the flesh at each end of the prawns, making a cross and taking the'seam', then take the'seam' in each of the shells and discard the'seam'. Wet your hands and make sure the prawns are well coated. Dry the prawns on a paper towel lined tray. Place them in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes until the prawns become lovely and brown. Remove and let cool slightly. Paste the prawns with the yeast while they are still warm and allow to cool, stirring at least twice during this process which helps to make them creamy. Spread each prawn with 1 teaspoon of soured ginger and top with 1 teaspoon ground cloves. Note, if you have leftover yeast, proof the yeast at 105 degree celsius for 10 minutes until frothy. Pour this into a large bowl and add 1 teaspoon dried ginger and 1 teaspoon salt. Add the prawns, making sure they are well coated. Turn prawns over on the tray, place back in the oven and bake for 35 - 40 minutes, or until prawns are done. Serve them warm, with the butter..

title: Homemade Turkey Gravy
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cup tomato juice | 2 1/2 pounds turkey wings | seasoning | 1 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: In a large skillet, combine the cornstarch and tomato juice. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Add turkey wings with a bit of seasoning. Cover and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Remove cover and cook until heated through and the gravy is thicker, stirring occasionally. In a small bowl, mix together the flour and 1 cup cold water to form a thin paste or batter. Pour into turkey gravy. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,dark sesame oil,garlic salt,grape,coconut,bamboo shoot
title: Tigerfish Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs tiger fish ( cleaned of heads, tails, shells, prawn ) | 15 ounces canned straw bamboo shoots, drained and shredded | 1 1/2 - 2 cups dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon instant onion powder | 1 1 teaspoon garlic salt ( or 2 cloves ) | 1 teaspoon light soy sauce
instructions: Cut the fish into large chunks, removing as much of the flesh as possible. In a large bowl, place all ingredients, including the marinade. Stir well to mix. Place the meat into a zip lock or similar suitable for marinating. The meat should be coated evenly in marinade. Squeeze all excess air out of the bag, and place the meat in the bag. Massage bag lightly, ensuring that the meat is completely coated, refrigerate overnight, or up to two days. Note, this can also be done on the counter, but the dehydrator usually won't take it. Dehydrate in the fridge until fully dryened, then place in a container, and store in the fridge.

title: Raspberry-Raspberry Mustard and Chilli Powder
ingredients: 2 teaspoons anise seed | 1 teaspoon crushed chili pepper flakes | 1 pinch brown mustard | fresh raspberries
instructions: Toast the aniseed, chili pepper flakes and mustard in a fry pan or fry pan until they pop. Grind or process the seeds and a pinch of chilli. Add more chilli, mustard and chilli to taste. Serve immediately or store airtight for up to 1 week.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 2 packages monterey jack cheese, cubed | 1 teaspoon ground savory
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Stir monterey jack cheese, savory flavored seasoning, and cayenne pepper together in a 9x13 glass or ceramic baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted and the dish is bubbly, about 25 minutes. Watch carefully so your cheese does not burn on the top.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,green bean,brown mustard seed,self raising flour
title: Bombay Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 packet arborio rice | 100 g brown mustard seeds | 25 g green beans | 25 g self raising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c or 480°f. Cook the rice by hand. Put it in a casserole dish. Add 2 or 3 tablespoons of cold, salted water to cover, then bring it to the boil. Carefully drain the rice and place it in the casserole dish. Heat the mustard seeds in a frying pan over a medium heat, stirring regularly until they start to pop. Quickly add the green beans and cook for another minute until the mustard seeds have started to pop. Spread the rice on top of the mustard seeds and then scatter the remaining mustard seeds onto the beans. Pour the water boiling over the rice. Cover the dish tightly and bake in the oven for 45 - 60 minutes. Check after 1 hour and give a stir. The bean should be crunchy and tender.

title: Bolognese Beef With Lentil Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin tip roast or 1 lb chuck steak | 4 tablespoons corn oil | 1 1/2 cups red lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1 cup broth | 1 medium shallot, minced | 1 large avocado, peeled, pitted, minced | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup parmesan or 1/2 cup asiago cheese, grated
instructions: Cut roast into 1 inch cubes. Heat oil in a large skillet. Add stew meat and brown lightly, stirring occasionally. Add lentils, broth, shallot, mashed avocado, and salt. Bring to boil. Lower heat, cover, and simmer 30 minutes or until lentils are tender. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, stir a tablespoon or two of the corn oil into the remaining 1/2 cup corn oil. Add this mixture to the skillet, reduce heat, and simmer one minute. Return beef to pan and heat through. Serve over noodles or rice. Garnish with grated cheese if desired.

title: Cornmeal Cakes (Pao de Fresa)
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 4 cups bean sprouts, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Oil a baking sheet. Pour the cornmeal into a large bowl. Gradually sprinkle in the canola oil until the mixture forms a dough that holds together. Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead until smooth. Form the cornmeal mixture into balls. Roll the balls in the cornmeal to coat thoroughly. Place cornmeal cakes onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Brown Lentils
ingredients: 2 cups brown lentils | 250 ml whipping cream | 3 tablespoons salt
instructions: Wash and wash lentils well and put in a pot with the cream, salt and bring to the boil, stirring occassionally. Reduce the heat to low and simmer gently, stirring occasionally, for about 3 hours, or until soft and creamy. You can make this a lot quicker by putting the rice into a pan and stirring through a fine mesh strainer. Drain the lentils well and add to the cream to thicken the sauce. It may be necessary to take some salt if the sauce thickens too much before the rice is ready to serve, as this will be the only way to serve the soup when you use it, however, it is. Serve at once or store in the refrigerator in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,black olive,sole fillet,mayonnaise,flounder fillet,mango chutney,shrimp,french green bean
title: Australian Fish in Spicy Mango Chutney
ingredients: 3 sole fillets, cleaned | 4 flounder fillets | 1 bunch french style green bean, trimmed | 1 can black olives, drained | 1 can shrimp, drained and chopped | 10 black olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the sole fillets in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the green beans and continue cooking until crisp tender. Remove with a slotted spoon. In the same pot, add the shrimp, black olives and chutney. Cook until shrimp turns pink. Reserving 1/4 of the shrimp water, mix remaining shrimp water and mayonnaise with the mango chutney. Spoon over the top of the fish. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Potato Lamingtons
ingredients: 1 lb sweet potato, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 lb peeled small turnip, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 jars grape jelly | 24 ladyfingers
instructions: Boil sweet potato and turnip pieces until fork tender. Drain and return to pot. Add turnip and 2 jars of jelly, stir, and add remaining jelly. Heat, stirring until jelly has melted. Spoon jelly mixture into greased 8x8x2 inch cake pan. Let cool overnight or until jelly has set. Cut lamingtons into 24 portions and arrange on top of jelly mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Invert.

title: Spinach Ramen
ingredients: 8 ounces ramen noodles | 3 fennel bulbs, trimmed and chopped | 1 bag baby lettuces | 1 bunch fresh fassel leaves, cut into thin strips, or to taste
instructions: Prepare ramen according to package directions. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook fennel in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until beginning to soften, 2 to 5 minutes. Drain fennel and place in a salad bowl. Toss baby greens with fassel.

Random Ingredients: guava nectar,endive,green olive,beef tenderloin,cream mushroom soup
title: Grilled Beef Tenderloin with Endive
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 8 ounces light sour cream or 8 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon guava nectar | 1/4 cup green olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons endives, chopped
instructions: Trim fat from beef. Score the thickest part of tenderloin with sharp knife.

title: Szechwan Pepper Wine
ingredients: 1/2 cup szechwan pepper ( timur ) | 1 cup sweet marsala wine
instructions: Cut the timur crosswise into 4 equal sized slices. Put them in a small pan. Add 1/2 cup marsala and the sichwan peppercorns to the pan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Keep a close watch until the pepper reduces. This should only take about 10 minutes. Let the pepper cool down completely. Pour the cooled pepper into a glass wine glass or sweet mocha glass jar and cover with plastic wrap.. Serve.

title: Fusion Heirloom Tomatoes Almonds
ingredients: 4 cups heirloom tomatoes, very thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fiesta fusion liqueur | 1/4 cup finely chopped almonds
instructions: Arrange tomatoes in single layer on baking sheets. Spoon fusion over tomatoes. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes or until tomatoes are tender, stirring once.

Random Ingredients: cream soup,black bean sauce,pork loin,poblano chile,cream chicken soup,cumin seed,vodka
title: Cinco De Mayo (Black Beans)
ingredients: 1 can cream condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can cream of potato soup | 1 can pork loin, chopped | 1 can black beans in chili sauce, drained | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 1/2 cup poblano chiles, chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the dry goods, the poblanos and the liquid from the beans.

title: Garlicky Italian Holiday Peppers
ingredients: 12 red peppers, roasted and peeled | 6 tablespoons palm sugar or 6 tablespoons brown sugar, grated | 1/2 teaspoon mixed italian seasoning
instructions: Cut peppers in half lengthwise, leaving the stem intact. Sprinkle each half with grated sugar then sprinkle it with mixed italian seasoning. Continue to layer pepper with sugar until peppers are used up. Heat oven to 450&deg.

title: Spanish Ham and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite sized pieces | 1 bag baked beans, cold
instructions: Combine the salad ingredients. Refrigerate for 15/20 minutes to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,italian bread,parmigiano reggiano cheese,canola oil,sun tomato oil
title: Italian Bread Pudding
ingredients: 10 ounces day-old italian bread | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 package sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, oil chopped fine | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 1 -2 tablespoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cut crust from the bread. Remove from baking sheet. Using a sharp knife, cut lengthwise 3/4 inch thick slices from each slice. Place in a bowl of ice water until cold then drain. Heat the canola oil in a 9 inch skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add the bread and cook until golden brown and puffed up a little and crusty, about 3 minutes. Add the sun dried tomatoes, almond extract and 2 tablespoons of the cheese and stir to mix well. Place onto a dish and cool to room temperature. Serve warm.

title: Italian Style Turnip Boats
ingredients: 2 large turnips, peeled and shredded | 1 1/3 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1 yellow onion, thinly sliced | 2 ounces mozzarella cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Place the turnips in a large bowl. Add the cottage cheese, onion and grated mozzarella cheese. Mix together, then drizzle over the turnips. Cover and let sit at least an hour, or until the turnip greens are starting to wilt. Stir well every so often to coat the turnip greens with the mozzarella cheese. Drain juice from turnip greens into a saucepan and cook at a slow simmer for 2 - 3 minutes to reduce the moisture and curdle the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,red cabbage,nori,cider vinegar,almond,granny smith apple
title: Red Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, chopped | 3 granny smith apples, cored and diced | 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 4 sheets nori
instructions: Toss together in a large bowl the cabbage, apples, almonds and vinegar until coated in the vinegar. Add baking powder, mix together and roll in nori to coat and sprinkle with remaining cheese on top. Cover and marinate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Roasted Beet Vinaigrette
ingredients: 8 ounces crisp bacon | 1 lb beet, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig, chopped | 5 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place rack in centre of oven and heat over the hot tray until hot but not smoking. Cut bacon into 1/2 inch chunks and place in a small frying pan and fry for 8 minutes, remove with a slotted spoon and drain on absorbent paper. Reduce the oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Spread the bacon in a shallow roasting tin and arrange in a single layer on the hot tray. Return to the oven and roast for 15 - 20 minutes, turning the slices once or twice, until crisp and lightly golden. Remove from the oven and reserve the bacon fat. In a large bowl, toss the beet slices with thyme and cream and season with salt and pepper. Add remaining 1 tablespoon of bacon fat and toss until the slices are coated. Divide between 4 serving plates. Arrange the roasted beet slices around the beet and serve immediately, or keep warm until serving.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,lily bud,turmeric powder,purpose flour,iceberg lettuce,saffron,chili oil
title: Cholia
ingredients: 2 heads iceberg lettuce, and other greens | 2 large onions, minced | 1/4 cup saffron | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 1/4 cups lily buds
instructions: Place the iceberg in cold water and rinse it thoroughly. Set in cold water until it is cold, drain, and place in a bowl. Place the onions in a pot over medium heat, add the saffron and cook until the onion is translucent. Stir in the turmeric and flour and cook until the flour begins to brown. Mix into a thick paste with cold water by the tablespoon. Remove from heat, and set aside. Heat the chili oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the onions and cook until the onions begin to brown slightly, 7 to 10 minutes. Transfer to a saucepan. Mix the saffron paste with warm water and lily buds. Bring to a boil. The water should just be covering the onions. Reduce heat, and simmer for about 15 minutes to thicken. If necessary, reduce the heat to very low. Remove from heat and allow the soup to cool before using. Serve cold.

title: Lentil and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup lentils, washed and picked over | 5 cups uncooked long-grain white rice | 4 -5 pints good quality lentils ( either green or yellow, with some split down at the root end ) or 4 -5 pints pigeon peas ( either green or yellow, with some split down at the root end )
instructions: Pick over the lentils and discard any stones or lentils that have not turned to mush. Rinse well in a sieve then drain. Over a heat bring the 4 - 5 pints of lentils to a boil, then add the uncooked white rice. Reduce the heat and simmer, stirring constantly, covered, for half an hour. Add the 4 - 5 pints of lentils, plus a little more water if necessary. Simmer for another half an hour, covered, until the rice and lentils are tender. There will be most possibly be lumps in the rice and lentils. You may need to add a little more water after this. When the rice and lentils have become creamy and creamy, stir gently, with a fork, breaking up any lumps. Serve hot, with lots of crusty bread on the side.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,vanilla bean,palm sugar,pink food coloring,stewing beef,cauliflower
title: Beef and Cauliflower (Astracchietternat) Kalya, (Caribbean)
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef, sliced thinly | 2 1/2 cups chopped cauliflower | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean, scraped | 3 -5 drops pink food coloring | 1 -2 piece gingerroot, peeled, sliced thin
instructions: Place sliced meat, cauliflower and sugar and vanilla bean in a deep pot. Toss lightly and cook over medium heat until tender. You may also use canned vegetables or even canned beans for the meat. It will take about an hour for tenderizing the meat. You can also skip this step if you prefer, but it tastes more like curry the flavors are stronger. Add water or broth as necessary to keep the stew very moist.. Taste to see whether the meat is tender, if necessary add more sugar, food coloring, or some fresh ground pepper. It should not make the ingredients too tart or too salty. Scoop out meat and veggies, serve with rice or noodles and a salad. If you serve this in individual servings, you can add a little of the cooking liquid to the meat and vegetables before cooking the meat. Note, you can also add chopped onions, or garlic to the meat.

title: Coconut Turnips With Chocolate
ingredients: 1/2 lb turnip, unpeeled, cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 5 cups ) | 2 -3 tablespoons grated coconut ( from a block of cream coconut ) | 1 tablespoon ground turmeric | 1/4 lemon, juice of, freshly squeezed | 1 tablespoon flaked coconut ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon roasted unsalted butter, melted ( optional ) | radicchio ( to garnish )
instructions: Light a grill or broiler. Place the turnips on an oiled grill rack or broiler pan and sprinkle lightly with the turmeric and lemon juice. Grill or broil over medium heat, turning once, until the turnips are firm and tender, about 4 minutes. Pour a tablespoon of the melted coconut or coconut oil in a small dish and dip the turnips, one or two at a time, in it. Serve with radicchio. Makes approximately 5 servings.

title: Pickled Beans (Canned Beans)
ingredients: 1 can beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Chill covered overnight. Drain beans and stir into vinegar. Sprinkle with fennel seeds.

title: Pork With Chocolate & Yoghurt
ingredients: 400 g pork shoulder, boneless, cubed | 1/3 cup teriyaki marinade | 1/4 cup yoghurt, creamy, low fat | grated cheddar cheese, to garnish | grated chocolate, to garnish
instructions: Place the pork and marinade in a non metallic dish and coat the pork on all sides. Seal the dish and refrigerate for at least two hours, or overnight. Preheat the grill to medium. Remove the pork from the dish and arrange on a foil lined baking tray. Brush with the teriyaki marinade. Grill for 25 - 30 minutes or until cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,corn kernel,greek yogurt,palm sugar,pasta,feta cheese,chinese cabbage
title: Nibby's Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 300 g pasta ( elbow, shell, or macaroni ) | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, finely chopped | 1 bunch fresh greek yogurt, thick with a yogurt consistency ( about 6-7 tbls. ) | 2 tablespoons palm sugar, grated | 1 cup corn kernel ( a handful ) | 1/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1 small chinese cabbage, sliced lengthwise in half, then sliced crosswise in thin strips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/400f/6 gas mark wash and rinse the pasta. In a large bowl, combine all of the ingredients and toss well. Transfer to an oven proof dish, then place in the oven to roast for 12 minutes. Allow to stand to cool before serving. Variation, substitute 1 cup of grated cheese for the feta and add 2 teaspoons of brown sugar. Note, alternatively the cheese can be reduced and thickened with a bit of coconut vinegar. You can also make this vegan by adding 1/4 cup of brown sugar, 2 teaspoons of garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon, about 5 teaspoons of dry sesame oil, 2 tablespoons of gluten, and 2 tablespoons of soy sauce or soy milk to the yogurt and combine.

Random Ingredients: apricot,gruyere cheese,corn oil,italian seasoning,tabasco sauce,white wine vinegar
title: Gruyere, Apricot and Pepper Cheese (Abm)
ingredients: 3 large dried apricots, about 1 1/2kg | 4 cups gruyere cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400°f. Halve and core 1 apricot, reserve the peel and reserve the fruit for garnish. Place the apricots, cheese and corn oil in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Combine the vinegar, spices and reserved apricot peel in a small bowl. Gradually stir in the vinegar liquid until the desired consistency is achieved. Place a non stick 10 cm tart plate on a tray lined with baking paper, cover with the cheese mixture and press down lightly. Pierce with a fork and bake for 45 minutes, or until heated through and top is golden brown. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Homemade Condiment
ingredients: 1 serrano peppers ( or other peppers to taste ) or 1 jalapeno pepper, coarsely chopped ( or other peppers to taste ) | 1 cup vinegar ( or other vinegar or other vinegar or other vinegar or other vinegar or other vinegar or other vinegar or other vinegar ) | rice or fried plantain chips, for dipping
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender or food processor or food mill until pureed. Cover and chill completely. Store in refrigerator.

title: Spiced Eggplant (Aubergine) (Melitzanes Tvershi)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 small eggplant, coarsely diced | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried sweet savory | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 teaspoons oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a dry skillet over medium low heat. Stir fry the eggplant until lightly browned on all sides. Remove to a plate lined with paper towels to drain. Combine the curry powder, savory, chili paste, oil and 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil with a fork until thoroughly incorporated. title: Mexican Macaroni and Cheese With Almonds, Tomatoes, and Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni ( i prefer mac n cheese ) | 1 bag of fresh mixed vegetables, frozen ( i use frozen, thawed mixed vegetables ) | 2 cups shredded cooked chicken ( cooked, drained, and diced ) | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves ( chopped fresh or dried ) | 1 large pinch almond extract | 1 lime
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. I don’t like dry, so i drain and add in some water so it’s done when it’s done. title: Mexican Stir-Fried Artichokes
ingredients: 1 can artichokes, in water, drained well and cut into quarters | 1 can vegetable cocktail sticks, in water, drained well and cut into thirds | 1/4 lb salt pork, fat removed and cut into 2. 5 inch pieces | 8 slices serrano ham, about 1 inch x 1/4 inch, cut in 1/4 inch squares | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 2 teaspoons chili paste ( to taste ) | 3 tablespoons ground cumin powder or 3 tablespoons other mexican-style spices | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon white salt

title: Easy Teriyaki Sauce

instructions: Mix all ingredients together into a dish. Refrigerate for a little or a few hours to chill and make it easier to enjoy.

title: Plum Dumplings
ingredients: 3 lbs plum ( any ) | 2 tablespoons ghee | 2 tablespoons flour | 2 quarts turkey broth | ice water
instructions: Peel the plums and remove the pits. Wash, and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Place them in a deep non reactive pot and fill with enough turmeric water to cover the plums. Cover and place over medium heat. Cook until plums are tender, and the water has been absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Drain and reserve the water. Melt the ghee in a separate pot and stir in the flour. Cook for one minute over medium heat, then add the broth and liquid, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Cook for 5 minutes. Cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes until the plums are tender. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Add the plums and cook until the liquid has been absorbed but the plums are still slightly chewy and the float, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain the plums, then transfer to a bowl and mash with a potato masher. Return mashed plums to the pot and stir to blend. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,beef stew meat,vegetable stock,pickle,green bean,bacon
title: Beef and Bacon Skewers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 green beans, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( or 1 fresh lemon ) | 1/2 lb beef stew meat, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 slices bacon, chopped | pickle, for serving
instructions: Soak 2 wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes. Place all the ingredients except the kewers and pickles in a non metal dish with a tight fitting lid and mix well. title: Frozen Strawberry Burritos

Cook one tortilla at a time until heated through, about 30 seconds per side. Spoon 1/4 cup of the potato mixture on half of the tortilla.

title: Simple Roasted Red Pepper Appetizer

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place marshmallows in a 12x15 inch pan. Place red bell peppers in the pan, and cover with the roasted red peppers. Dump marshmallows on top. Cover and bake 30 minutes.

ingredients: 1 package raw ground turkey | 1 large yellow banana pepper ( or 1 medium jalapeno ) | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon marjoram leaves

title: Benihana Nori (star aniseed and Sushi Vine)

instructions: Dissolve the star anise in the sherry and then set aside. Cut the nori thinly and using a very fine sieve, remove the soft, stalks, membrane, and any hard parts on the nori. title: Cantonese Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons light dark sesame oil | 1/8 teaspoon chili paste | 1 lb thinly sliced lean ground sirloin steak or 1 lb round steak | 1 jar spaghetti sauce or ( 8 ounce ) jar taco sauce | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed ( thawed, undiluted ) | 8 slices of thin crusty italian bread, toasted
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the first five ingredients.

title: St. Patrick's Day Lavender Butternut Squash and Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 lb butternut squash, ends trimmed | 2 tablespoons garlic, minced | 2 tablespoons dried lavender | 1/4 cup light soya sauce | 1/4 cup dried cranberries, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to cut squash into 1 inch cubes. Place squash in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Combine garlic, lavender & soy sauce. Pour over squash & stir to coat. Cover with foil & bake 20 minutes. Remove foil & bake 25 minutes more, or til squash is tender serve warm.

title: Homemade Corn Chips
ingredients: 10 slices bacon drippings | 3 teaspoons cumin seeds | 5 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Place a rack in the oven and preheat to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place bacon in a dutch oven or clean, oiled skillet over medium high heat, and set aside. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir the cumin seeds in the hot skillet until the seeds begin to sputter. Immediately remove from heat and stir in the cumin powder. Smash the seeds with a mortar and pestle. When the dutch oven is ready, remove the bacon and place on your baking sheet. Brush the chips with the oil and sprinkle with cumin. Place the baking sheet on the preheated oven rack. Cook until heated through, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,romaine lettuce,cod,rice,apple juice,vegetable,wild rice,liquid honey
title: Cod Crunchy Rice with Wild Rice, Beans, and Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked wild rice, such as calrose basmati | 1 cup apple juice | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables | 1 cup chopped romaine lettuce | 1/4 cup chopped cooked turkey breast half | 3/4 cup seasoned rice | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 4 thick boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1/4 inch strips
instructions: Place wild rice and apple juice into a rice cooker and fill 1/2 full with water. Close lid and set power to high. Cook wild rice until water is absorbed, about 18 minutes. Cool rice to room temperature. Combine the chopped vegetables, romaine or spinach leaves, turkey breast strips, rice, honey and 2 tablespoons rice vinegar in a bowl.

title: Easy Espresso and Almond Espresso Powder Paste
ingredients: 3 tablespoons espresso powder | 2 tablespoons almonds paste
instructions: First, pour espresso into a small mixing bowl and stir to blend. Add almond paste to mixture and stir until well combined. Keep in refrigerator for 1 - 2 hours to allow the flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: green pea,flat leaf parsley,rye flour,rice,deli roast beef
title: Swiss-Style Smoked Beef and Corny Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked deli roast beef | 2 cans canned deli-style corny rice | 2 1/2 cups green peas, frozen | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup unbleached rye flour
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. In a large roasting pan, place roast into single layer. Insert meat thermometer into center of roast and sprinkle with salt. Cook roast, uncovered, in preheated oven about 1 hour. Turn and cook until well browned, about 2 to 3 minutes longer. Meanwhile, in a separate roasting pan, combine the corn and peas. Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes. Remove meat from sauce.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,skirt steak,mustard,chicken stock cube,thyme leave,hard egg
title: Crispy Fried Beef Sandwich (Australian)
ingredients: 1 lb skirt steak | 2 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 2 tablespoons mustard | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme leaves | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 leaf lettuce leaf
instructions: Cut steak crossways in half and then across the grain. Heat the frying pan over a moderate heat for the 1st minute and then add the steak and eggs. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 7 minutes or until it is cooked as desired. Transfer to an ovenproof dish, cover with foil and rest for 5 mins. Meanwhile combine mustard, thyme and stock cube in a small jug. Pour over steak and then sprinkle with lettuce and season to taste. Serve hot with steamed salad.

title: Easy Homemade Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, 1 1/2 inches round or 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork butt | 2 cups quick-cooking oats
instructions: Place the oats in a medium bowl and set aside. Cut the meat into 1 inch cubes. In a 5 to 6 qt pot melt 1 1/2 tablespoon of margarine or oil over moderate heat. Add the meat and brown it on all sides, then add the 2 cups of quick cooking oats, stirring and tossing, to coat them well with the oaty. Pour the oaty mixture with a spatula over the meat. Bring it to a boil over medium heat.

title: Rustic Thin Crust Pizza Base
ingredients: 300 g whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 410 g crushed tomatoes in puree
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and press into a well oiled 20x28cm tin or large, flat base tin. Cut a cross into the mixture and bake in a medium size slow oven for 10 - 15 minutes until browned. Cut into squares and serve with pizza sauce or plain breads.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,wild rice,dill pickle,sourdough bread,italian herb seasoning
title: Italian Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 2 pounds italian sausage | 2 jars sourdough bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup dried wild rice | 2 tablespoons dried italian herb seasoning | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread sausage out on a cutting board and cut into 1 inch slices and then across into 1/2 pieces. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Place sausage slices in skillet and cook, turning until evenly browned. Place sausage back into skillet. Drain sausage pieces on paper towels and return skillet to heat. Mix in one jar of sourdough bread cubes and enough wild rice to coat the bread in a thin layer. Season with italian seasoning, dill pickle pepper and any other desired seasonings. Cover, reduce heat to low, and continue cooking 30 minutes. Stir well before serving.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,asian chili paste,red pepper,heavy whipping cream,tomato soup,quinoa,maraschino cherry,half
title: Quinoa Italiano
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup | 4 cups water | 2 cups half-and-half | 1/2 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup quinoa | 1/2 teaspoon dried red pepper | 1/2 cup diced roasted sweet red pepper | 12 maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: In a large pot, combine the tomato soup and water. Bring to a boil about 1 minute until it thickens. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, cook quinoa according to package directions. Mix in red and sweet peppers and cook 5 minutes. Drain and reserve. When the soup begins to boil, stir in the quinoa and heat just to boiling. Continue cooking about another 5 minutes. Stir in cherries. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,coffee,pork loin,pumpkin puree,alfredo sauce,yellow pepper,oyster sauce
title: Frozen Pork with Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 package pork loin, frozen cubed | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon instant coffee, instant powder | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 yellow pepper, finely chopped | 1 package alfredo sauce | 7 ounces canned pumpkin puree ( not from a can )
instructions: Pour out all but 2 to 3 tbsp of the broth into a small bowl. In a blender or food processor blend the pork with oyster sauce, coffee powder and tomato paste until smooth. Blend in bell pepper. Pour the remaining broth into a small saucepan. Add pumpkin puree and reserved 1 tbsp sauce mixture and bring mixture to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve on top of the pork.

title: Fried Endive With Brandy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 ponn ground coriander ( pimenton ) | 4 cardamom pods | 4 -8 heads belgian endive | 1 lb lasagna noodle
instructions: Bring water to boil. Add brandy, mirin, baking soda, coriander, and cardamom pods. Reduce heat, and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove cardamom pods. Cover and keep warm. Meanwhile, slice endsive, and pat dry. Place in a colander over boiling water. Let stand till leaves are limp. Drain, then pat dry with paper towel. Cover with brandy. Place on flat, oven proof platter. Arrange endive in slices, sprinkle with parsley, and spoon brandy over. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake for 15 minutes or until very hot.

title: Simple Snow Peas Curry
ingredients: 1/2 lb snow peas, ends snapped off and cut up | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon crushed turmeric ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and saute for a couple minutes. Serve.

title: Raspberry Glaze, Cyprus Style
ingredients: 2 large eggs | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig or 3/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam
instructions: Beat eggs lightly. Place in a small, shallow container and blend with thyme. Brush top of egg lightly with beaten egg. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Spread evenly on 1/2 of an ungreased 8 inch square baking pan. Sprinkle with jam. Bake at 425º° for 15 minutes or until set. Glaze may not set completely. Remove from oven. Remove lid and bake at 400º for 8 to 10 minutes longer or until desired consistency.

title: Stir-Fry Powder
ingredients: 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon ground sansho pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pecans
instructions: Break up the ground sasho peppercorns with a sharp knife or mallet. When the sasho pepper is crushed and is released from the mortar, add sassho peppercorns and ground pepper and continue stir frying for another 2 minutes. Add pecan nuts and stir until smooth.

title: Easy Vegan Thai Red Curry Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain brown rice ( rinsed and drained ) | 2 3/4 cups water ( or use half vegetable and half water ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine rice and water in saucepan, cover and bring rice mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, or until water is absorbed and rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: italian chicken sausage,mango,sherry wine vinegar,asafoetida powder,vanilla,lime juice zest,whipping cream,grapeseed oil
title: Mango Sausage With Vanilla Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup grapefruit juice or 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 16 ounces italian chicken sausage, casing removed | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 mango, peeled, seeded, and chopped | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated
instructions: Combine the grapefruit juice, vinegar, vanilla, and asafoetida. Set aside. Using poultry shears, cut the sausage into 2 or 4 pieces and then pound with a meat mallet to very thin it out. Set aside. Bring 1/4 cup of the whipping cream to a boil in a skillet and add the sausage. Return to a boil, then turn off the heat and set aside to cool slightly. Drain off the excess fat from the skillet and then stir in the mango. Add the lime zest and warm through. Once all the ingredients are heated through stir in the remaining whipping cream and refrigerate. Serve with rice, if desired.

Random Ingredients: beet,yellow onion,egg substitute,velveeta cheese,brown sugar,worcestershire sauce
title: Hot Dogs With Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese | 1 cup egg substitute | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup yellow onion, diced | 1 can beets, chopped
instructions: Crumble velvetta cheese into large bowl. Add all other ingredients and toss thoroughly. Sliced beets are ideal, too. Cover bowl. Chill in the fridge 24 hours. Use for basting. Makes about 5 dozen.

Random Ingredients: jumbo shrimp,orange juice zest,green lentil,cranberry,pork tenderloin,bay leaf,milk,red wine vinegar
title: Jumbo Shrimp and Lobster Ties With Cranberry Relish
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs jumbo shrimp, peeled, deveined, tails left on | 1 lb lobster tenderloin, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 lb dried pink lentils, soaked overnight in cold water to cover | 2 tablespoons cranberries, chopped | 4 bay leaves | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup zest of freshly grated orange | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup milk
instructions: Combine the shrimp, lobster, lentils, cranberries and bay leaves in a non reactive bowl. Put the vinegar, milk and zest in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Stir. Add the warm vinegar mixture. Simmer, covered, for 4 to 6 minutes longer. Serve over your favourite pasta.

title: Chinese Bacon and Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon fish sauce | 1 chicken bouillon | cucumber ( the kind with skins ) | 1 slice canadian bacon
instructions: Heat some oil on medium high and sauté bacon. Dice cucumbers and add to fry pan with oil. Add 1 - 2 tsps. Of soy sauce, 1 tsps. Of fish sauce, and 1 tsps. Of chicken bouillon. You may need to add some more water. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,sirloin,rosemary sprig,poblano chile pepper,cilantro leaf,kernel corn,lettuce leaf,phyllo dough
title: Mexican Meat Triangles
ingredients: 8 ounces ground sirloin | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 fresh rosemary sprig | 1 pinch dried cilantro leaves | 12 sheets frozen phyllo dough | 2 poblano chile peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 cup chopped lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Brown ground sirloin with worcestershire sauce, rosemary, and cilantro. Cool and remove beef mixture from mixture. Unroll 1 sheet of phyllo dough on a work surface. Spread approximately 1/4 the ground sirloin mixture in the center of each and fold in half. Fold over sides and ends and crimp to seal. Place seam side down on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Repeat until all of your meat mixture is used. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes until crisp and browned. Meanwhile, spray a small baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Place the poblano peppers in the baking dish. Place the remaining phyllo dough into a stack on top of the poblano peppers. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes. Remove plastic wrap and slice the roll into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place shredded lettuce onto a clean cutting board. Spread about 2 tablespoon of the beef mixture on top of the lettuce. Spread the corn on top of the beef mixture. Fold the bottom corner of the phyllo over the filling and roll up the roll from the bottom to the tip of the phyllo. Repeat with the remaining phyllo, filling, and pepper slices. Place seam side down onto the hot baking dish and bake for 5 to 10 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Beer and Bacon Crusted Beef Empandados
ingredients: 3 poblano peppers | sirloin, trimmed | 100 g bacon | cumin powder | 2 cans lager beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Place poblanos on a baking tray. Roast at 200c for 45 - 60 minutes, turning over halfway through cooking. Remove and place onto paper towel to dry. Cut slits in top of peppers, removing some of the membrane and seeds. Fry bacon in medium heat with cumin until crisp and golden. Drain fat and set aside. Remove peppers from oven and cut open lengthwise, scrape out the membrane with a spoon and set. Place into an oven safe dish and bake for 20 minutes, turning every 5 minutes until golden. Remove poblanos from oven. Cut a slit lengthways along top of each pepper and remove as much skin as possible with a knife. Set aside in a small baking dish and cover each pepper with bacon fat and bake for 5mins or until tender. Remove peppers and keep warm in a warm place. Shred meat with your fingers making sure it is dry on the surface. Heat a small amount of oil in a frying pan. Place over medium high heat, add the meat and fry until cooked through and crumbly. Pour in beer and bring to the boil. Place the ramekins onto a tray and place under the grill until caramalised, approximately 5mins. To serve the empandados, serve the meat and pan fried peppers over the top of the empandado.

Random Ingredients: vegemite,wheat flour,cremini mushroom,beef rump roast,german chocolate
title: Soy-Mushroom Beef Roast
ingredients: 4 cups mushrooms, sliced | 400 g beef rump roast | 2 tablespoons german chocolate, grated | 2 tablespoons vegemite | 3/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 140c. Line a large oven proof gratin dish with foil, and grease the foil with a little of the oil. Place mushrooms, mushrooms & beef in the dish, then pour over the german chocolate and pour over the vegemite to make a crusting. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour, then remove, cover & cook for a further hour. When ready to serve, place flour in small bag & crush with a fork to a paste.

title: Famous Hot Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup sweet sherry wine ( use good quality for sweet sherry ) | 2 tablespoons hot sauce ( like tabasco ) | 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( like tabasco ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: In a small microwave safe bowl set on high, combine the sherry and hot sauce. Stir well. Microwave until liquid is reduced by about half, 30 - 45 seconds. Stir again. Add mace. Microwave for 3 minutes. Stir well. Microwave for 5 minutes, stirring now and then. Microwave for 5 more minutes, stirring once. Pour into a bowl lined with a paper towel or plastic wrap. Allow to sit at room temperature till flavors intensify or about 2 hours. Store in a tightly closed glass jar in refrigerator.

title: Green Beans with Chile-Sweet Red Chile Sauce
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 small red onion, halved and thinly sliced | 3 fresh red chile peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar
instructions: In a pressure cooker, add the green beans, onion, chile peppers and sugar. Close lid and bring to quick pressure over high heat. Reduce heat to high and cook 15 minutes. Remove from heat and wait five minutes to release pressure. Carefully remove from heat. Let sit for 5 minutes. Using the flat of a cocktail cleaver or the back of a large knife, loosen the layers of green beans to release their juices. Serve immediately.

title: Rigatoni With Capers and Capers
ingredients: 4 fillets | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 cup chili sauce or 1 cup tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons capers | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint | 1 1/2 cups cooked rigatoni pasta
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot. Cover and cook on low 8 hours or on high 4 hours to blend flavors. Remove from crock pot and garnish with mint.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,baby corn,wonton wrapper,cornflour,italian salad dressing mix,red wine vinegar,soy sauce
title: Grilled Fish Won Tons
ingredients: 1 packet wonton wrappers | 2 1/2 cups fresh baby corn | 3 fresh jalapeno peppers, seeded and roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 1/4 ounces italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Place a small piece of cling film on a board or tray. Using a teaspoon, make a triangle from the wonton wrappers. Place in the tray and flatten the edge. Brush top of wontons with cold water and stack together. Place on your work surface and bring up the edges. Press down lightly and make more wontons. Repeat until all the wrappers and filling have been used. Preheat a barbeque grill or chargrill until very hot. Cook the wedges on one side for 1 - 2 minutes until slightly charred, turning once. Place on a plate and serve immediately with dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,corn tortilla chip,spring onion,picante sauce,celery,bicarbonate soda
title: Picante Dressing, Low Fat and Very Low Cal (Tostito)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon picante sauce | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium bicarbonate of soda ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon spring onion, finely diced | 1 tablespoon celery, finely diced | 3/4 teaspoon curry leaf | corn tortilla chips, for dipping
instructions: Combine everything except the corn chips in a bowl and add corn chips to mix. Serve with the tostito.

Random Ingredients: rice,liquid smoke,chicken bouillon cube,pepperoni,rice vinegar,rice wine,beef chuck,cottage cheese
title: Crock Pot "hot and Roll" Rice
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 package pepperoni, sliced into 1/4 inch strips | 1 package presliced rice | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup rice wine ( cooking wine ) | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 can cottage cheese
instructions: Brown meat in a skillet over medium heat, drain off fat. Add pepperoni and rice, cook 4 minutes. Mix in bouillon cube, rice wine vinegar and liquid smoke, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to lowest setting and simmer, covered for 30 - 40 minutes or until meat is very tender.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,cotija cheese,grainy mustard,chicken bouillon cube,vermouth,whipping cream,szechwan pepper,lemon juice zest
title: Creamy Szechwan Pepper Bites
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1/2 cup vermouth | 1 tablespoon sweet grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons szechwan pepper, finely ground ( or chili powder ) | 1 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 2 teaspoons cotija cheese | 2 chicken bouillon cubes, broken up
instructions: Whisk together the cream, vermouth, mustard, lemon juice, sichuan pepper, splenda and cheese until soft peaks form. Fold in the bouillon cubes.. Drop rounded teaspoon of mixture into 1 cup ice cream trays. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for 48 hours or up to 2 days. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,green bean,raisin,manchego cheese,hard egg,triple sec
title: Spanish Green Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs green beans, topped and tailed | 1/2 lb manchego cheese | 1/2 lb raisins | 2 ounces dark rum | 1 ounce triple sec or 1 ounce brandy | 5 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Clean and cut the beans in half and cook the young ones in boiling water for a few minutes only then plunge them into cold water or under cold running water – they will keep rather under the water during cooking. Wash the manchego finely cut it to the size of the beans. Peel and chop the eggs and set aside. Preheat the oven to 375°f in a large ovenproof dish large enough to contain all the ingredients, bring a few quarts of water to the boil. Place the beans in boiling water and remove from the heat. Place a large piece of tin foil on top of each other to keep them from curling up. Place all of the ingredients, except the eggs, into the dish, fill them with the beans and seal tightly well, then place them on top of the foil and bake in the middle of the oven for about 1½ hours. Serve the beans with the beaten eggs, freshly chopped green salad and freshly grated manchego cheese on the side.

Random Ingredients: green apple,lime,chicken stock cube,yellow pepper,chicken breast,italian green bean
title: Chicken with Apple and Green Beans  (Zwt 6)
ingredients: 500 g chicken breasts | 1 large green apple | 2 small yellow peppers | 80 g italian green beans | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 lime
instructions: Cut the chicken into long, thin slices and rub the chicken with salt. Place all of the ingredients except the lime into a large pot. Cover and simmer over medium heat for about 45 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the beans cooked. Squeeze the lime juice over the chicken while cooking. Turn the heat down to low and simmer for about 20 minutes. Serve hot either hot or cold. Variation, to increase cooking time, place the ingredients into a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap and leave for 6 - 8 hours. Shake the container a few times to mix the juice, then set them aside for another use.

title: Mexican Chocolate Cake from Scratch
ingredients: 1 can or bottle dark chocolate chips | 1 can or bottle hot brewed coffee | 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 package dried cornhusks | 12 serrano chilies, chopped | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9 inch springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper. Chop dark chocolate chips and mix them together in a bowl. Dissolve coffee in chocolate chips and stir in yellow cornmeal and green chilies. Pour chocolate mixture into prepared pan.

title: Sweet and Savory White Beans & Mash
ingredients: 350 g white beans, dry | 2 tablespoons golden syrup ( to taste )
instructions: Soak the beans over night. Boil and mash with a potato masher. Add a little water or milk if the consistency starts getting too dry. Add the syrup and mix well. Simmer for 5 mins before serving. Serve with plain chapatis.

title: Mexican Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 pound shredded mexican cheese blend | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 cup white sugar
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the shredded cheese with cumin, sugar and remaining ingredients.

title: Easy Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 2 1/2 lbs red potatoes, cubed | 2 packages frozen white onions, drained | 4 -6 medium tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Mix first two ingredients in a casserole dish. Sprinkle onions and tomatoes over bottom of casserole. Combine soup mix with enough water to moisten, mix well, pour over all. Bake at 350°f for 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Sausages With Mortadella and Chives
ingredients: 2 tablespoons aged balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh chives | 4 medium serrano chili, seeded, peeled, chopped | 10 -12 ounces mortadella or 10 -12 ounces other cured salami, cut lengthwise in half
instructions: Preheat coals or gas grill. Blend vinegar, chives, and chiles in small bowl. Place sausages on prepared coals or gas grill. Close lid tightly, and grill until the undersides are reddish and the sausages are just cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,jumbo shrimp,kalamata olive,salt black pepper,belgian endive,liquid smoke
title: Jamaican Shrimp with Endive, Tomatoes and Olives
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke | 3 kalamata olives, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs cleaned jumbo shrimp, cleaned | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 -3 belgian endive, leaves cut off, stem ends, washed
instructions: Combine 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke with 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke and brush on shrimp. Set shrimp on a plate and pour remaining liquid smoke mixture over them. Turn the shrimp on both sides, cover, and refrigerate shrimp until just chilled, 30 minutes to 1 hour. Heat remaining 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke and 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke in a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat. Add shrimp and cook, covered, turning once, until shrimp are just cooked through, 6 to 8 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange endive leaves on a platter and surround with shrimp mixture.

Random Ingredients: greek olive,oregano,thyme sprig,ricotta cheese,bulgur,grand marnier,artichoke heart
title: Baked Artichoke Hearts With Bulgur Cheese
ingredients: 24 slices marinated artichoke hearts | 12 greek olives, roughly chopped | 6 ounces ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 cups bulgur
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f line a baking sheet or jelly roll pan with parchment paper and arrange artichoke hearts and olives in layers over the parchment paper. Combine ricotta, grand marnier, oregano, thyme, and bulgur in a bowl until well combined. Spoon mixture evenly over artichokes. Cover the baking sheet with foil and bake at 375°f for about 40 minutes or until liquid has reduced and bulgar is crisp and beginning to brown and the filling is hot and bubbling, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a bowl and cool completely.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,corn syrup,vinegar,mexicorn,lime juice,yogurt,beef chuck,red curry paste
title: Chilled Beef Vindaloo
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/8 cup apple cider or 1/8 cup white vinegar | 2 teaspoons minced fresh lime juice | 1 1/2 cups cubed beef chuck | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons mangoicorn | 1 cup plain plain low-fat yogurt
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, combine sour cream, corn syrup, cider vinegar, lime juice. Add chuck.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,brussels sprout,lima bean,tart apple,self raising flour,four cheese mexican,semolina
title: Mixed Veggies With Crumble
ingredients: 175 g dried lima beans | 150 g brussels sprouts, washed and trimmed | 5 tart apples, peeled cored and grated | 200 g self-raising flour, sifted | 150 g semolina | 50 g olive oil or 50 g sunflower oil | 6 italian tomatoes, quartered and thinly sliced
instructions: Place the dry beans in a large pan with cold water and bring to the boil. Allow to stand for about 20 minutes and drain. Preheat the oven to 200°c place the brussels sprouts in a large roasting tin. Add the grated apple and saute for 2 to 3 minutes until they start to soften. Mix together the flour, semolina and olive oil and sprinkle over the vegetables. Scatter over the tomatoes. Place in the preheated oven and bake for about 30 minutes, stirring the vegetables regularly until they are cooked through and golden.

title: Roasted Mushrooms & Salmon With Gravy
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dry crushed red pepper | 4 small button mushrooms | 4 -8 slices smoked salmon
instructions: Heat a medium pot on the stove. Pour about 1/2 tsp of olive oil into the pot. Add the mushrooms, peppers & salt. Stir & cook on a medium heat for 10 minutes. Turn the heat up to high, then move the mushrooms. Cover tightly & cook on medium to high for 25 minutes. Slide the salmon to the other side of the pot. Slice the salmon in 1/4' slices & serve immediately. Note, you can also serve this on a roll with a piece of bread that was toasted & has been lightly brushed with a little olive oil to help stop the stuffing from browning. Do not over cook or your gravy will be tough. This recipe can also be served with steamed veggies, salad or as a side dish for salmon & potatoes.

title: Crock Pot Easy Chana
ingredients: 2 rump roast, trimmed, fat trimmed & cut in half lengthwise, then crosswise into 1/4-inch slices | 2 cans chickpeas, rinsed | 1 1/2 cups dried mixed fruit | 2 teaspoons fresh coarse ground black pepper
instructions: Combine the beef and chickpeas. Top with the fruit. Sprinkle generously with pepper. Cover& cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,chicken breast fillet,chicken broth,iceberg lettuce,yellow pepper,snow pea
title: Aussie Chicken and Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets, thinly sliced | 1 -2 small red capsicum, thinly sliced | 1 -2 small yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 1 -2 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded | 100 g snow peas, washed, split if necessary | 1/2 cup chicken broth
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a salad bowl, toss and serve. We use a good bbq grill. If this salad is too moist to pour onto the grill, just add a little more broth a little at a time. We like ours crunchy so just add a little broth. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,bamboo shoot,campbell cream chicken soup,pecorino romano cheese,tortilla,kiwi fruit
title: BBQ Quesadilla
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced bamboo shoot | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped kiwi fruit | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1 can campbell cream of chicken soup | 8 tortillas | 1/3 cup packed brown sugar
instructions: Pour cream of chicken soup over sliced bamboo shoots, kiwifruit and cheese, cover and let stand for 25 mins. After 25 mins sprinkle brown sugar over and cook under grill or in frying pan, until cheese is melted.

title: Barley Barley

title: Apple-Applesauce Mashedroot

title: Black-Eyed Peas

instructions: In saucepan, add all ingredients, stir.

instructions: Warm your sauce whilst preparing your dough. Use a small pan over a medium heat, if using a double boiler / grill, which doesn't require any presoaked water. Sprinkle in half the sugar. instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor and pulse a few times until mixture is desired consistency.

title: Noodle-Sausage Focaccia
ingredients: 20 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow tie pasta ) | 8 ounces sausage ( turkey or chicken ) | nonfat plain yogurt, lowfat yogurt is fine | 2 cups cooked and drained crumbled french bread | 4 cloves minced garlic with salt | soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Prepare pasta according to the package directions, drain and return pasta to pot. Meanwhile, crumble sausage into small pieces and remove casings. Serve with low fat plain yogurt or low fat plain yogurt.

title: Easy Low-Fat Veal Sauce
ingredients: 9 plums ( try pomomato for a nice fruity taste ) | 6 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 -2 shallot, chopped | 1 2 teaspoons chile paste ( or chili powder ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Wash tomatoes, chop into quarters, seed and chop the plum tomatoes. Put plum tomatoes in a small dish. Chop shallots. If using chile paste, put it in a separate bowl. Add chili pepper paste, italian seasoning and chili paste mix. Add a little water before adding next, if you are using it. Let this simmer gently for about 5 minutes. Add more water if you need to. title: Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 lb great northern bean | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon mirin | 6 ounces chopped green chilies or 6 ounces green bell peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder ( optional ) | 6 cups arugula, washed
instructions: In a colander soak beans in water for at least overnight. Drain. Cook over high heat, with lid slightly ajar while turning. Check every so often so the water doesn't stick to the bean. Drain and place in large pot with 4 cups of water. Cover and steam over medium heat till done. Dill, remove seeds, and chopped chilies. Mix in vinegar and mirin. Add beans and enough water to just cover. Bring to a boil to reduce the liquid a bit and simmer till beans are tender, apprx 15 to 20 minutes. Serve topped with chopped arugula. Youcan also add other herbs. I like my chili with basil, mint, and garlic. These go well with rice, soup, or other dishes, such as soups.

title: Andouille and Red Pepper Sausages
ingredients: 4 ounces andouille sausages | 1 cup chopped red pepper | 1 cup chopped roasted chicken | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, chopped | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 2 ounces cheese, of choice
instructions: Grill sausage in skillet on medium or medium high. Remove sausage when browned. Cool slightly. Chop peppers and chicken into small pieces and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with basil and vinegar and set aside. Add salt to taste and crumble cheese over mixture. You can add hot water just before serving or the flavor can get it too runny. Serve hot.

title: Peanut Butter Cracker Spread
ingredients: 1 cup peanut butter | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup olive, minced ( green or yellow ) | 1/2 cup plain yogurt, whipped
instructions: Mix peanut butter and mustard. Add olive. Stir in yogurt. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Thai Stir-Fried Bok Choy
ingredients: 2 bunches bok choy, washed and trimmed | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic
instructions: Heat a steamer on a high heat, and line it with a few paper towels to dampen the surface of the steaming water. Wash the bok choy and trim the root ends, trim off the tough bottom end and the bottom end until you have 4 long pieces with the root ends intact. Repeat with the bok choy until all the woody parts are cut into 6 long pieces. Put the choy in the steaming water. Keep the heat on high until the water boils gently. After 15 minutes, take the pan off the heat and keep the water at a gentle boil, uncovered. Meanwhile, put the chili paste into a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir for a minute or two, until the chili paste dissolves. Stir in 1/2 cup cold water and the chili paste. Cook for 2 minutes until fragrant. Take off the heat, then immediately pour in the chili paste mixture directly into the boiling water. Stir quickly. Cook the mixture for 90 seconds to 1 minute, until the water boils off. When the water has come to a boil, put the lid on the pan and keep on a very gentle boil for 4 - 5 minutes, until the bok choy has wilted somewhat. Take the pan off the heat at this point and toss the bok choy into the boiling water one or two at a time, tossing until the bok choy has wilted somewhat.

title: Yummy Pork Loin, Beef Ramekin, & Ramen Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, sliced | 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 package egg roll, crust removed, uncooked | 1 jar tomato sauce | 1 package manicotti | 1/2 cup oatmeal ( quick cooking ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili oil ( or other spicy oil ) | 8 dates ( i prefer dark )
instructions: Slice loin, beef or chicken into pieces and preheat a large cooking pan over med/high. Place meat in the pan and cook 5 min/ses or until outside pork is brown. Set meat aside. Cook a package of ramekin's at a time according to package directions, place each ramekin on a plate. Remove meat from pan and set aside. Drain ramekins and add to pan. Cook meat & sauce for 10 minutes, remove from heat. Let cool 1 - 4 min& set aside. Cut ramekins in half. In medium bowl, add, oatmeal, cayenne, chili oil and drained meat, add 1/2 of the tomato sauce, let marinade 3 - 4 hours. Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine remaining tomato sauce with cooked rice. Spread half of the rice mixture in the bottom of a 9 x13 pan. Arrange noodles lengthwise over rice mixture and spread with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with remaining rice mixture, making sure to cover most of the noodles. Cover with 1/2 of the sliced ramekins, top with 1/2 of the meat and rice mixture. Top with other 1/2 of the ramekins, making sure to cover the meat layer. Cover with aluminum foil and put in the oven. Bake about 45 min/1 hr or until noodles are tender.

title: Chapel

instructions: In the mixer's bowl, lightly whip egg yolks, adding a little ice, but not too much to temper them stir in a little ice if desired. If you don� t have a whip attachment, use a fork to gently fold together the egg yolk mixture with the ice and stir gently for 1 minute. Transfer the mixture into a popsicle mold, smooth the top and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,tarragon,puff pastry,sage leaf,onion,taco seasoning,heavy cream
title: Sage Rolls

instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Lightly grease a cookie sheet. Lay puff pastry sheets on sheets lined with parchment paper. On one sheet of pastry, make a line to form a 10x13 inch rectangle. Press pastry with palm of your hand to form a long roll. With a sharp knife, make 12 long diagonal slits about 1/2 inch deep across the center of each roll on pastry roller. Place 2 tablespoons of the sour cream, cream of tartar, onion, taco seasoning, tarragon, and sage in small bowl. Cover surface of the roll with plastic wrap and refrigerate while preparing rolls. Slice roll crosswise into 1/4 inch strips. Place 2 slices of the pastry strips on top of each other on prepared cookie sheet. Bake at 450 degrees fahrenheit for 8 to 10 minutes or until puffed and golden brown. Carefully remove from oven and transfer rolls to wire rack to cool. Serve with soured cream and salsa.

title: Scrumptious Fruitcake

Cool for approx 20 minutes, remove and cool in tin. Serve cold or at room temperature with thick cream.

title: Spicy Fenugreek Powder (Qadi Yeaidoo)
ingredients: 3 quarts lard, cut into 1-inch pieces | 6 teaspoons red hot chili paste ( see note ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried fenugreek
instructions: Note, if you prefer to make this spicy but not too dry just one quarts of lard will do. Heat oil in pot or wok to 350°f. In small batches, fry the fenugreek in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to dip the fried fenugreek into the hot oil and allow excess grease to drip back into the pan. Drain fenugreek, saving any excess oil. Put the fenugreek back in the hot oil. Dry the fenugreek by dipping it into the oil, pressing it firmly and evenly. This will give the oil a light sheen. Add red hot pepper paste to oil and fry for 30 seconds to 1 minute or until the paste has turned into a rich dark red shade of black. Use a strainer to blot the excess fat from fenugreek and discard. Add a pinch of sugar or cinnamon sticks to the oil and fry for 20 - 30 seconds, until sugar is slightly brown. Stir in the fenugreek powder and stir in until the color turns dark tan.

title: Chinese Pattylets
ingredients: 4 hamburger patties | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Preheat broiler. Lightly coat a broiler pan with cooking spray. Place patty patties on hot cookie sheet. Mix 1 tablespoon soy sauce and bouillon in skillet. Place over medium high heat. Allow patties to brown.

title: Mushroom Mac and Cheese

instructions: Cook macaroni till al dente or rice as directed. Drain and set aside. In a large frying pan, saute mushrooms till soft. Add apple juice concentrate and bring to a boil while stirring constantly. Add rice and continue to stir till the pan is dry. Immediately add butter and mix till melted and all the rice is completely covered in the sauce. Serve hot.

title: Marinated Steak
ingredients: 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon ground sirloin | 2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs
instructions: Combine sugar, sirloin, and thyme in a resealable gallon sized plastic bag or resealable plastic storage bag. Drain steak.

title: Red Chili Sauce

instructions: Place the flour, herbs and salt in a bowl. Cut in the butter or process it with a pastry cutter. Add chillies and mix together. Spread some of the sour cream and mayonnaise mixture onto the dough and spread sour cream around it. Cut the dough into 3 cm rounds. Cook in a moderately hot oven 40 minutes or until light brown. Serve hot.

title: Thai Style Fresh Ginger

title: Green Chile Pork Filets (Bhunies)
ingredients: 1 lb pork fat, trimmed of excess fat and fat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup poblano chile, seeded, deveined and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons green cardamoms | 2 tablespoons ginger ale | 12 -15 fresh asparagus, trimmed, tips cut into 2-inch lengths | 1 tablespoon fresh dill ( to garnish )
instructions: Make the ginger ale by heating the ginger ale to a boil in a medium pan. Remove the ginger ale from the heat. Add the green chiles and cardamom to the hot beer. Bring to a simmer and cook until the chiles soften, about 4 minutes. Add the pork and keep cooking until just cooked through, about 5 minutes. Add the asparagus to the pan and simmer until just cooked through and tender, about 5 minutes longer. Stir in the dill. Serve the pork filets on a bed of the chile asparagus.
