title: Creamy Poblano Bread
ingredients: 100 g plain flour | 1/2 ounce dried yeast | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 200 g broccoli carrots cauliflower mix, chopped | 250 ml reduced fat cream soup ( i use cream cheese ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 cans condensed cream soup
instructions: Mix the sifter flour, yeast and garlic paste together in a bowl. Cut poblanos in rounds from stem to tip, remove ribs and seeds if desired, and cut the seeds into quarters. In a pan on the stove, add water to cover the bottom if needed. Place the water in the bottom of the oven as it heats up. If it is too hot, you may need to add some water. Bring to boil, then set timer at a medium to low heat. Stir in soup, rum and poblanos. When the soup begins to bubble up, remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. Place flour in a large clean bowl. Add the yeast mixture. Beat vigorously with a spoon until the mixture becomes smooth. Add the water a little at a time, mixing vigorously after each addition. It will be quite difficult to use all of the water at once. This is very important. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, and knead it for 5 - 10 minutes. You will not be able to knead it very well. Place dough in a greased bowl. Brush it with melted butter or olive oil. Cover with a cloth and leave in a warm place until double in size. Deflate the dough, and punch it down. Use about 10 pices per loaf to make 8 round loaves. Put 1 - 2 poblanos, 2 carrots and 1/2 cup of the cauliflower in the bottom of each loaf. Spread some of the soup evenly on all four poblanos. Top with the remaining cauliflower and pate. Cover and leave for 45 minutes at room temperature. Heat oven to 350°f. Bake in the oven for 45 - 60 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the bread is golden brown.

title: Feta & Orange Breakfast Spread
ingredients: 2 ounces feta cheese ( or any other soft white cheese of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon orange extract ( about 1 orange ) | 1 tablespoon fenugreek leaves ( see directions ) | 1 tablespoon wheat germ ( optional )
instructions: Place 1 tbsp fetta in a small bowl to bind together. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp orange extract. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp fenugreek leaves. Cut remaining 3 - 2 tbsp of fetta into 1 tbsp size slices. Toss with orange extract, feta & 1 tbsp wheat, if using. To really get the flavor of the cheese spread, add 1 tbsp water. Mix until everything is incorporated and it is fully incorporated. Keep adding 1 tbsp water and/or wheat to get it to form a nice spreadable consistency. It shouldn't take more than 5 tbsp of water. Spoon onto bread & enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,bacon,tart apple,currant,serrano pepper,bean sprout,fish sauce,cheddar cheese
title: Spicy Sausage and Apple Roundup
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, chopped | 1 medium tart apple, chopped | 2 cups bean sprouts, divided | 4 1/2 ounces kielbasa | 1/3 cup currants, divided | 1/4 cup fresh french's cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon fish sauce ( optional ) | 1/3 cup dried tart apple | 1 tablespoon seeded chopped serrano pepper
instructions: In a medium skillet over medium heat, cook bacon until crisp. Transfer bacon to paper towels and crumble. Add apple and 1/4 cup bean sprouts to skillet and cook and stir about 5 minutes or until tender. Place kielbasa links on top and spoon 1/2 cup cooking liquid over. Cook over medium heat 2 minutes. To serve, sprinkle with 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese. Toasted sesame seeds can be scattered over top. Serve hot with sweet potato salad.

title: Quick and Easy Chapati Balls
ingredients: 1 cup self rising flour | 1 cup brewed coffee ( hot or cold )
instructions: Sift together flour and coffee in a large bowl. Make a well in the centre. Pour some hot coffee into the centre, then combine with the flour. Mix lightly but thoroughly to make a soft, moist dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead gently to form 8 balls. Place cookies on a lightly greased baking tray. Use a rolling pin to flatten into patties approximately 4 inches across. Bake in low oven for 10 minutes, or until the tops feel firm to the touch in the centre. Turn over and bake for 2 minutes the cookies should be pale gold in colour. Leave to stand for 5 minutes before removing with a palette knife. Serve warm.

title: Lentils With Meat
ingredients: 1 cup fresh lentils ( or 1 lb dried ) | 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb lamb | 1/2 cup uncooked wide grain rice, preferably porridge or 1/2 cup bomba instant rice, soaked and drained
instructions: Cover lentils with 5 boiling cups of water in a large, heavy kettle. Bring to boiling.

title: Sweet Granola
ingredients: 3/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 1 1/2 cups sugar, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice wine
instructions: Stir together graham cracker crumbs and 1 1/2 cups of the sugar. Bring soy milk to a boil in a saucepan and stir in rice wine. Remove milk from heat, stir in sugar mixture and return to a boil. Pour into an 8x8 square baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Bake at 325 degrees f for 25 minutes. Cool completely, then break into small pieces. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups macaroni | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 4 tablespoons capers, drained | 2 1/2 cups turnips, diced
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain. Combine celery seeds and capers.

title: Cashew, Bacon, and Lettuce Wrap
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried sweet vermicilli whole grain gluten | 2 slices bacon, chopped | 1/3 cup chopped cashews | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the vermicilli in a small shallow baking pan, and drizzle over enough water to cover. Cover, and let sit until softened, 30 to 60 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Cook and stir the bacon in a skillet over medium high heat until evenly browned, about 3 minutes, or until crisp. Stir in the cashews, cilantro, and lettuce.

title: Raisin Bread
ingredients: 2 -3 slices raisin bread | 1 -2 tablespoon ground dried chili flakes
instructions: Cut bread through the slice in 1 1/2 to 2 inch pieces with a serrated knife. Spread chili flakes on one side of each piece of bread and top with a slice or two of raisin. Roll up tightly and serve.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,red potato,peanut,english muffin,taco seasoning mix,flat leaf parsley
title: Taco Potato Melt
ingredients: 4 red potatoes, scrubbed and thinly sliced | 3 teaspoons taco seasoning mix, divided | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and finely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped dry roasted peanuts, or to taste | 2 english muffins, split and toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place a single layer of potatoes onto a baking sheet, and spray with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, 30 to 40 minutes. When baked, transfer potatoes to a serving tray. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon taco seasoning, and cover with a layer of water chestnuts, parsley, and peanuts. Sprinkle with remaining taco seasoning, and top with remaining 2 teaspoons taco seasoning. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream,maraschino cherry,cider vinegar,marjoram leaf,plain flour,taco seasoning mix,swede
title: Tacos
ingredients: 175 g swedes, diced | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherry, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram leaves | 1 tablespoon cream | 1 -2 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar or 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1 cup plain flour | plain flour, extra
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190c. To make the topping, mix all the ingredients together. In a separate pan, brown the swedes in a little fat. Remove the swedes with a slotted spoon and set aside. Turn the heat down, add the marinader and sour cream. Mix well. Pour half the topping into the pan and stir well. Roll up, slice thinly and place on baking paper in a single layer. Repeat until all swedes are used. Sprinkle the top with more of the topping. Bake for about 20 - 25 minutes, remove from the oven, sprinkle a little flour over and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,romano cheese,self raising flour,honey,pork,bean,kosher salt black pepper,aubergine
title: Pan Fried Chicken With Baby Aubergines
ingredients: 3 large boneless skinless chicken breast fillets, each 6 oz | 3 large aubergines | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 1/4 cups grated romano cheese | 1/2 lb lean pork, ground | 1/2 lb pork fat, finely chopped | 1/4 cup honey | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the 2 aubergines into 1/4 inch slices and trim the ends leaving them attached at the top and bottom. Cut the 3 large pieces into 1/4 inch rounds and arrange them on 1/2 an inch of oiled baking paper covered rimmed baking sheet. Brush each slice with some of the oil. Bake on the middle rack for 10 minutes, until nicely browned and cooked through. Meanwhile, cut the chicken breasts into 6 oz portions, removing about 1 1/2 to 2 inch from the longest edge of the breast to help them slide onto the baking sheet. Slice the the remaining 2 aubergines into 3/4 inch rounds and cut them into 2 inch slices. Working with 1 piece of the chicken at a time, roll it between the palms of your hands to give it a flattened round shape. Repeat with the rest of the chicken, keeping an eye on its shape. Mix the flour into a paste with 1/2 cup of cold water and add to the sieved flour and water. Season well with salt and pepper and add to the sauce just before serving with the chicken. The batter will thicken slightly at this point, as some of the flour will dissolve while sitting, and it will thicken up slightly at this point if you stir. Set aside in a warm place. Boil the water for the noodles and drain in a sieve. While the noodles are boiling, heat a 12 inch heavy skillet over high heat and add 1 1/2 tablespoons oil. When the pan is very hot, add the chicken pieces and saute on both sides, until lightly browned and cooked through. Place the cooked chicken in a warming dish and cover to keep warm. Repeat until all the chicken is cooked. Remove the aubergines with a slotted spoon. Keep warm. Add 4 tablespoons of the oil to the sauce and when it is very hot, add the pork and cook until golden brown on all sides, stirring constantly. Add the honey, stir and cook for 1 minute, stirring continuously. Add the chicken pieces and stir and mix well. Spoon the noodles over the top, sprinkle with the toasted cheese, then serve immediately.

title: Homemade Smoky Peanut Oil
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh chipotle peppers
instructions: Heat oil in small, heavy frying pan over low heat until quite hot, but not smoking. Stir in chipotle pepper and cook until fragrant, 15 - 20 seconds. Strain into a bowl and allow to cool.

title: Pasta With a Curry and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked medium pasta, i prefer rotini | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 cup chopped carrot | 1 celery rib, cut into small pieces | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 cup chopped prosciutto
instructions: Boil water and add pasta. While the pasta is cooking, cut vegetables and chop the prosciutto into thin strips. Stir fry chopped veggies till tender. After pasta is cooked, add vegetables, curry paste, and coriander. Toss until combined well. Sprinkle with prosciutto and stir well.

title: Hogao a la Huancaina(Algerian Beef Steak on a Stick)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless ham, cut into sticks about 3-inch diameter | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 4 small beefsteak tomatoes, finely chopped | 12 pieces fresh lettuce, leaves separated | 24 ladyfingers
instructions: Place the ham in a bowl with the tomato paste and the garlic, cumin, celery and 1 tablespoon of the oil. Mix thoroughly. Spread the mixture over half of each lettuce leaf so the lettuce can stand in contact with the surface. Arrange the tomato slices on top of the tomato. Roll each lettuce leaf around the meat. Serve the huancaína covered with paper towels or several hard plastic napkins. Serve the huancaína in the traditional manner.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,swiss chard,center pork chop,nutritional yeast,serrano chilies,red cabbage,spaghetti noodle
title: Seared Pork Chops With Cabbage and Orzo (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 3 center-cut pork chops | 2 cans orzo pasta, cooked, drained | 2 bunches swiss chard, washed and coarsely chopped | 2 bunches of long thin stems of flat leaf sorrel or 2 bunches arugula, washed and coarsely chopped | 1 small red cabbage, cored and coarsely chopped | 4 serrano chilies, chopped | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast | spaghetti noodles, cooked
instructions: Set up your grill for medium heat. You'll want to get ready in about 7 minutes. Meanwhile, put half of the veggies in a non stick pan saute them over medium heat for about 3 - 4 minutes until the veggies begin to soften. Turn the pork chops over and sprinkle on the orzo. Cover and cook on each side for about 7 - 9 minutes or until internal temp reaches 160 degrees. Remove from grill and let rest for 2 - 3 minutes. Slice pork chops and serve with warm orzo and veggies on the side. Serve with spaghetti noodles and a side of salad.

title: Garlic Honey
ingredients: 1/2 cup honey | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons whole mixed thyme leaves
instructions: Heat honey in a medium pan over medium heat. Stir in 1 teaspoon each of thyme and ginger garlic paste.

title: Easy Nachos
ingredients: 4 tablespoons tortilla chips | 1 tablespoon chili paste or 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon soft dates, drained ( optional )
instructions: Serve in a small bowl topped with tortilla chips and garnishes. Also excellent for st. Patrick's day.

title: Crock Pot Coke Bread Crunks
ingredients: 6 3/4 ounces cans coke | 1 -2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( for the crock pot )
instructions: Place a colander in a sink or well covered dish. Place the colander over the sink and place a large dinner plate or plastic tub into it to drain the juices. Place the colander in the bottom of your crock pot. Add the coke and bread crumbs to the drip in the colander, mixing well. Note, if the bread crumbs are mixed with the Coke, add more crumbs. Place the crock pot lid on, and cook on low for about 5 - 6 hours. The crumbs are done when all of the liquid is gone.

Random Ingredients: amarula cream liqueur,french ladyfinger cooky,peanut oil
title: Peanut Butter and Amarula Fingers
ingredients: 3 packages french-style ladyfinger cookies | 2/3 cup peanut oil | 1/2 cup amarula cream liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Break each ladyfinger cookie into pieces into a small bag that fits snugly around her bag. Mix oil and amarula cream liqueur together and dip each piece of bread in until coated. Shake off excess oil. Arrange breadies in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,sugar snap pea,lemon juice zest,beer,puff pastry
title: Beecherbroccoli and Snap Pea Pies
ingredients: 230 g packaged puff pastry | 100 g carrots, trimmed and shredded | 75 g small green sugar snap peas, trimmed | lemon juice and zest of | 1 bottle light beer ( british stout will work in a pinch, or a splash of cointreau liqueur )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200c/400f/gas line baking trays with baking paper and use an oven mitt to heat up the beer. When it's just sizzling, add the vegetables and then grate in the zest and lemon juice. Spread the mixture out on the baking trays and bake for 10 - 20 mins, stirring once or twice. Allow to cool if you want to serve it now. Serve in wedges along with any other tasty snacks or fresh fruit.

title: Coconut Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup dried arborio rice | 4 1/2 tablespoons light coconut milk
instructions: Cover rice in boiling water. Cover tightly and cook over low heat until rice is soft. Drain. In a nonstick 5 quart saucepan, combine cream, arborio, and coconut milk. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring constantly. Pour 1/3 cup hot cream mixture into blender, and process until smooth. Repeat with remaining cream mixture, one cup at a time over boiling water to create a smooth creamy, creamy consistency. When all cream is added, stir to combine. Let stand one minute, then stir in rice. Transfer to a serving bowl and refrigerate another 3 hours if refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,coconut milk,ginger garlic paste,pomegranate molasses
title: Pomegranate-Ginger-Garlic Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can corn oil | 1 can pomegranate molasses | 1/2 cup pomegranate molasses | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons garlic powder ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste ( optional ) | 4 -6 tablespoons pomegranate molasses, for flavoring
instructions: Heat two of the corn oil, pomegranate molasses, pomegranate molasses, and ginger garlic sauce pan until the pomegranate molasses is fragrant and has the texture of honey. While this is happening, boil 3 - 4 tablespoons of crushed corn oil to make a bit thicker, about 30 seconds. Stir the ginger garlic paste or garlic powder into the pot, add the ginger garlic paste, and bring to a bubble. Remove from heat and stir in 2 teaspoons of the pomegranate molasses, being careful to not burn the flavor. Stir constantly as the mixture will thicken. Pour into a bowl, and stir in 2 teaspoons of the pomegranate molasses. When making this again, stir in a few tablespoons of pomegranate molasses, taste to see if more sweetened sugar is needed, and adjust flavor to your liking.

title: Guacamole Onion Salad Dressing
ingredients: 8 teaspoons guacamole | 2 spring onions, finely sliced ( including tops )
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, crush the guacamole into a fine paste. Mix the spring onions into the guacamole paste. Let the dressing stand at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Baked Raisin Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons raisins | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, mix the yogurt with the raisins, brown sugar and salt and pepper to taste until well blended. Transfer the yogurt to a lightly oiled 8 inch cake pan. The yogurt may be served warm or chilled, depending on the sweetness of the raisins.

title: Creole Crab
ingredients: 1 lb crabmeat | 1 can creamed green chili | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1/2 cup marsala, wine or 1/2 cup other dark grape juice
instructions: Using an enameled cast iron frying pan, heat the mushrooms and green chilies over medium heat in the cream. Add crab to the mushrooms. Season with salt and pepper. Do the same with the marsala. Turn down the heat to medium and continue cooking for about 5 minutes. You may want to check occasionally to make sure they don't burn if not. Serve in deep plates.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,baking soda,chutney,beef,celery leaf,roast,pepperoncini pepper,french fry
title: Beef, Bacon and Chutney Fries With Cumberland Fries - Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs lean roast | 1/3 cup chutney, finely diced | 1 bag frozen french fries | 2 large celery leaves, sliced | 1 jar bacon drippings, with rind cut in 2 pieces, warmed | 4 ounces drained roast fat | 1 teaspoon baking soda | pepperoncini pepper ( optional )
instructions: Trim the beef of all visible fat and cut it in half across the grain. Place in the bottom of 4 to 5 quart slow cooker. In a bowl, stir together the chutney, french fries, celery leaves, bacon drippings, roast fat and baking soda. Place the beef on top of the french fries mixture and season with pepperoncini, if desired. Cover and cook on low setting for 10 to 15 hours, until the meat is fork tender, and the fries are crisp. Serve with a crisp green salad and bread. Note, if desired, serve the crock pot crock pot with cold cuts in the following order.

title: Pumpkin Spaghetti
ingredients: 4 cans pumpkin | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 2 tablespoons coriander powder ( or use chilli powder ) | 1 tablespoon ground thyme ( or other herb of your choice ) | 1 orange peel ( thinly shaved or coarsely chopped ) ( optional )
instructions: If using squash, cut into bite sized pieces and place in microwave safe bowl. Pierce squash in small bits with a fork or skewer.

title: Pineapple Pockets
ingredients: 2 pita breads ( about 1 pound ) | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Open the two pita breads and spread each inside an ungreased casserole dish. Bake the pita pockets until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and spread equal amounts of pineapple in each pita, or spread between the pita pockets. Place crushed pineapple on top of each pita and return the casserole dish to the oven. Bake until heated through and slightly crisp, about 15 minutes.

title: Leek Hotpot
ingredients: 10 leeks | 3 cups white wine | 6 dried chili peppers
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f trim and discard root ends of scallions. Wash leeks thoroughly under cold water and dry with damp cloth. Cut in half lengthwise, remove white part, and slice crosswise. Cut leeks into 8 wedges. Spread cleaned leeks in bottom of a baking pan. Put chilis in the middle of eighths. Pour wine over the leeks. Bake 90 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Wild Cherry Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces button mushrooms ( halved ) | 8 ounces fresh button mushrooms ( quartered ) | 8 ounces vegetable stock ( optional ) | 1 cup sour cherry ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients to a soup pot and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat and simmer for 20 minutes uncovered or until mushrooms are tender. Stir in cherries just before serving.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,pistachio,lipton onion soup mix,half cream,walnut,romaine lettuce
title: Creamy Pistachio Salmon
ingredients: 1 -2 ounce lipton onion soup mix | 3/4 - 1 lb salmon fillet | 1 cup fresh shelled pistachios ( or more or less, to taste ) | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 -2 cup shredded romaine lettuce | roasted walnuts, toasted, chopped ( or more )
instructions: Heat oven to in small bowl, mix onion soup mix and 3/4 cup of hot water. Spray baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Lay fillets in dish. Sprinkle with pistachios, dot with soup mix mixture, dot with remaining soup mix, pour on top of salmon. Bake, uncovered, for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,tomato basil oregano garlic,orange bell pepper,monterey jack cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,brown rice,extra beef
title: Mexican Stuffed Peppers With Rice & Beef Strips
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs extra lean ground beef or 2 1/2 lbs ground pork | 1 bell pepper, red, seeded, chopped ( any color, i recommend a blend of green bell peppers ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil oregano and garlic ( with basil, garlic and oregano ) ( optional, we like our peppers stuffed ) | 1 1/2 cups brown rice, cooked and hot | 1 cup shredded reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese ( we use low fat sharp cheddar ) | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a skillet, brown ground beef and diced bell pepper. Combine well and add tomatoes, rice, half of the grated cheese and diced peppers and mix well. Fill peppers with meat mixture, and place peppers in an oven proof dish. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,miso,garam masala,red chilies,breadcrumb,cooking tapioca,veal shoulder,sesame seed
title: Miso Glazed Beef
ingredients: 600 g boneless veal shoulder, cut into 3cm cubes | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 8 -10 red chilies, halved de-seeded and thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons miso | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking tapioca | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking tapioca | 1/2 cup grated fresh breadcrumb | 300 g gravy ( or gravy and 1/2 cup cream )
instructions: Put the veal in a large pan over a high heat with the sesame seeds and chillies. Cook, stirring regularly, for 3 - 4 minutes until lightly browned. Remove from the pan and set aside. Put the miso paste in a frying pan and mix in the tapioca, garam masala and chicken gravy or cream. Bring to the boil and cook for a few minutes. Pour over the meat and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer until meat is tender. Add the breadcrumbs and stir to combine. Cook for 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,chicken bouillon granule,red wine,green mango,greek yogurt
title: Greek Mango and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 mango ( peeled, sliced from pit and sliced into chunks ) | 1/3 cup red wine ( i use greek red ) | 1/2 cup yellow onion ( thinly sliced on a mandoline ) | 1 cup greek yogurt ( plain low fat style is best ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules ( or 1 tsp. chicken bouillon )
instructions: In a skillet, add onion and sauté in oil. Remove from heat and keep warm. In a small bowl combine yogurt, chicken mix, mango and wine. Combine well. Stir into onion mixture. Add bouillon and mix well. Serve with toasted or flavored crackers, vegetables, etc that you like.

title: Mustard Seed Water
ingredients: 1/2 cup mustard seeds | 3/4 cup water | 2 cups water
instructions: Heat mustard seeds in a heavy bottomed pot or dutch oven over medium heat. Turn occasionally and add 3/4 cup water. Bring to a boil, stirring once or twice. Cover and reduce heat to simmer. Simmer about 30 minutes or until seeds start to thicken. Cool. Store in a cool, dry place, covered, until ready to use. Note, if seeds are salted place in a bowl, cover and leave in a warm place or in the container for up to 2 days. Variation.

title: Korean-Style Barbecued Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 teaspoon anise flavoring | 1 pound pot roast | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Place the anise flake in a small bowl. Use the anise oil to pour over the roast. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 3 hours. Preheat a grill for high heat. Remove the roast from the plastic wrap, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place the meat onto the prepared grill, and discard the marinade. Grill the roast for 45 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f in a meat thermometer. Turn the roast, and continue grilling until done, about 10 minutes more. Serve with barbecued pork, sliced tomatoes, fried onions, and hot mustard.

title: Prawn Barramundi
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs prawns, shells on | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Marinate prawns in adobo powder, salt, cumin & anise seeds in fridge for 8 - 12 hours before cooking. Place flour in large bowl. Add a good tbsp of water to the flour. Knead lightly on floured surface. Drain excess flour. Drain prawns and pat dry with paper towel. Put flour in second bowl. Using palms, shape batter into 2 inch prawns. Heat 2 tbsp oil or cooking oil in frying pan. Deep fry prawns till they turn a golden, about 2 - 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels & sprinkle toasted sesame seeds on top. Serve immediately.

title: Guilt-Free Tomato Soup For One
ingredients: 6 bananas | 1 cup grape tomatoes | 1 cup chicken stock | 1/8 cup jagermeister | 1 tablespoon dill pickle relish
instructions: Cut the bananas crosswise into quarters and set aside. Place the remaining ingredients in a large saucepan. Add the banana quarters. Bring to a boil over medium heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside. Serve hot or toasted.

title: Chiles Roasted in the Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles, with the seeds | 4 lbs beef broth
instructions: Place the poblano chilies on several layers of heavy duty aluminum foil and drizzle around them with the beef broth. Sprinkle tops with salt and pepper. Cover the foil tightly in the pressure cooker. Cook on high pressure for 4 minutes. Turn off cooker. Leave cooker in the pressure cooker on the stove top for 1 hour. Remove the foil and fluff with a fork.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,ham,peach,walnut,chicken liver,elbow macaroni,noodle,baking powder
title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup elbow macaroni, uncooked | 1/3 lb deli ham, diced, about 2 1/2 ounces, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 3 ounces ) | 1/3 cup chopped walnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup uncooked medium noodles, broken into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, about 1/2 | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 can sliced peaches, drained ( about 3/4 cup ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, about 5 tablespoons
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package except use medium heat and drain. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Add ham and walnuts and cook, stirring, until heated through, about 2 minutes. Add cooked macaroni to skillet along with remaining ingredients and toss until mixed well. Serve.

title: Hot Chicken
ingredients: 8 serrano chilies | 4 cups low-sodium chicken broth | 1 cup hot sauce ( frank's is good ) | 1/2 cup chopped juniper berries ( optional ) | 4 bone-in skin-on chicken breasts
instructions: Preheat the broiler on high. Pierce the serrano chiles a few times with a sharp knife and place the chiles under the broiler. Turn the chiles so they are well marked. Set them in their own shallow dish. Bake or grill the chiles. While turning so the chiles brown evenly on all sides for 10 minutes, remove them and set them aside. Add a little more oil to a medium size pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and saute until golden brown on all sides, approximately 8 minutes. Stir in the broth and hot sauce. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, covered, for 45 - 50 minutes or until the chicken is fork tender. Remove the pot from the heat and let the chicken rest for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,spaghetti,vegetable oil cooking spray,sea salt,seltzer water
title: Spaghetti and Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup red curry paste | 2 tablespoons scalded seltzer water | 1 lb spaghetti | sea salt, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan, add the red curry paste and cook, stirring over medium heat for 1 minute. Add half the scalded water and simmer over high heat for 1 minute, stirring all the time. Add salt to taste and add remaining scalded water. Add the pasta and cook until al dente, about 11 minutes. Taste for salt and pepper if you wish.

title: Spanish Green Olives
ingredients: 2 cups whole green olives, halved | 1/2 cup bacon drippings
instructions: Heat the bacon drippings in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir the green olives in the hot bacon grease until the slices start to brown, about 3 minutes. Pour the entire mixture into a paper bag, and seal the bag. Allow the olives to sit in the bag for at least 2 hours. Remove the bag, and shake off any excess grease from the olives. Transfer the olives to a serving dish, and serve hot.

title: Olive Garden Mediterranean Salmon and Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces frozen shrimp, defrosted and cleaned | 12 ounces frozen mussels, defrosted and cleaned | 14 ounces frozen cleaned scallops ( sea bass or shrimp ) | 16 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 dash bottled hot pepper sauce | 2/3 cup couscous, cooked and cooled | crisco ( optional )
instructions: Put shrimp through food processor or blender. Add remaining ingredients and pulse until well mixed and smooth, approximately 15 seconds. Pour onto serving plate, cover and chill for 30 minutes to blend flavors. Garnish with some grated romano cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,stew meat,anjou pear,prune,sherry,clove,russet potato,fajita seasoning
title: Pebre
ingredients: 12 ounces stew meat | 1 teaspoon dry sherry | 4 teaspoons fajita seasoning | 3 cloves | 1 russet potato, scrubbed and mashed with masher | 3/4 cup chopped prune | 2 cans italian-style diced tomatoes | 1 jou pear, peeled, chopped
instructions: Cut stew meat into cubes and place around edge of a deep fryer or dutch oven. Sprinkle with sherry, fajita seasoning, cloves, and potato. Bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Arrange prunes around the edge of a deep dish dish. Pour stew meat and tomatoes over prunes and heat through.

title: Spaghetti Squash and Zucchini (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 4 teaspoons gluten-free flour | 1 teaspoon saffron | 16 ounces spaghetti squash, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 large onion, sliced and separated into rings | 2 1/2 cups spaghetti | 1/3 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons pecans ( optional ) | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Place flour and saffron in shallow bowl. Add 2/3 of the squash, onions and spaghetti squash. Dredge in flour mix to coat. Saute in oil in a wok on meduim high heat until golden brown. Add rest of squash, onion rings and raisins and saute a few minutes. Drain any remaining oil. Serve with salsa and guacamole.

title: Spice Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 cup coarsely ground raw whole grain white rice ( such as basmati rice ) | 1/2 teaspoon canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 3/4 cup panir, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons whole grain white rice | 1/2 teaspoon canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon onion seeds | 2 teaspoons dried onion seeds | 1/8 teaspoon ground mixed spice
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon canola oil in a medium skillet over medium low heat. Stir in onion, and cook until tender. Stir in rice, and cook until the rice is light brown, about 2 minutes. Set aside. Heat 2 more tablespoons canola oil in a large skillet over medium low heat. Stir in onions, and cook and stir until the liquid in the skillet has dried a little. Stir in the 1/4 teaspoon each of salt and mixed spice until the mixture is well blended and the salt has dissolved. Scrape the rice mixture into the skillet, turn the heat to medium low, cover, and cook until the moisture has soaked into the rice, 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Maple Glaze
ingredients: 6 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 cup bacon drippings | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a large bowl combine bacon drippings and cream of tartar mix together. Stir in maple syrup. If freezing, immediately spoon glaze into waxed paper lined container and let set at room temperature. Glaze should just reach the edges of the waxed paper covered container, without the paper becoming too thick. For freezing, spread on waxed paper lined surface after freezing completely. To reheat glaze if frozen, place in a ziplock bag overnight and thaw in fridge overnight. Remove glaze from refrigerator and increase oven temperature to 350 degrees f. Add glaze to a 1 cup glass measure and stir to combine. Microwave bacon for 2 minutes, stirring to distribute bacon evenly. Drain and pour glaze over ham or serve hot.

title: Grilled Jazzy French Bread
ingredients: 3/4 lb loaf french bread | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 6 -10 slices kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Preheat bbq to 450 degrees. Wash and dry bread. In a small bowl or glass bowl soak kaffir leaves in warm water til softened, a few seconds then remove. Trim crusts from bread and place on grill pan or on baking sheet. Brush with mustard. Place bread on grill or bake bread for 6 - 8 minute each side.

title: Capers Chips
ingredients: 1 lb caper, drained | 3 ounces cooking oil
instructions: Slice capers thin. Wrap in aluminum foil. Bake in oven until slightly crispy. Cool. Add a dash of sugar. Store in fridge.

title: Mashed Potato-Dosa
ingredients: 12 -20 small potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 of an shallot, sliced ( or a small amount of scallions, minced ) | 4 teaspoons channa dal or 4 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: You will want to wash the potatoes to remove the starch and dry out any starch that is still clinging to the skins. I prefer the method of my local grandmothers, which is to wash a pot and fill with water until the water begins to reach a boil. After it begins to boil turn down the heat and simmer slowly. Using a colander, remove the potatoes directly to the pot. You will most likely have leftover starch on the skins. In the meantime, remove the outer layer of salt, about 2 tablespoons, from the shredded potatoes and place them into the channa dosa. It is important for the skins to be covered. Once the skins are removed and the potatoes and are soft, mash them with a fork, adding a drop or two of water if they stick to the mash. Add the shallots, chana dosa mixture and garam masala. Keep stirring until you achieve a chunky, creamy consistancy or a bit thicker.

Random Ingredients: bean paste,beef gravy,golden raisin,cake flour,soy sauce
title: Chipped Beef Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb chipped beef gravy | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon cake flour | 1 teaspoon golden raisins | 2 tablespoons chinese fermented bean paste ( also called bean curd ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill thoroughly. Slightly fry the fritters. Pour beef gravy over fritters and serve immediately.

title: Lemon Mustard
ingredients: 16 ounces horseradish cream | 4 1/2 tablespoons long grain mustard | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: In a bowl, mix all ingredients together. Blend until well blended. If necessary, add more mustard until the spread is the desired consistency. Store in refrigerator or refrigerate for up to 3 days.

title: Steamed Chicken With Fines and Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken, cut into serving size | 3 -5 tablespoons sesame paste, see note | 1/4 cup shortening | 1/4 cup sesame paste | 1 tablespoon sweet german mustard | 1/2 cup thinly sliced scallion ( white and green parts ) | 1 teaspoon dry shrimp or 1 teaspoon nama shoga, paste
instructions: For the chicken, in a large ovenproof skillet, melt half the shortening over medium high heat. Add the sesame paste and mustard and mix well. Add the chicken and vegetables, cover and cook, stirring every 15 minutes for about 20 minutes or until the chicken is tender. Serve immediately with steamed rice or noodles. Note, i have used a combination of sesame and coriander green chilies. Note, in this recipe, you might also add about 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons of either of these green ingredients for a milder sauce when you would add the peanuts.

Random Ingredients: sage,red onion,chipotle chile,green apple,pesto sauce,cooking oat,oil,chili seasoning mix
title: Apple Chipotle Pesto Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick-cooking rolled oats | 1/3 cup green apple, finely diced | 1/4 cup red onion, finely diced | 1 tablespoon fresh sage, minced or 1 tablespoon dry sage | 1/2 teaspoon chili seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon chipotle chile, minced | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 3/4 cup oil
instructions: Combine first seven ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Shape into four burgers. Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook burgers 10 minutes per side or until lightly browned. Serve on lettuce leaves with sour cream and tomato salsa.

title: Currant and Dried Red Pepper Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dried currants or 1 cup raisins | 4 -6 sprigs fresh curry powder ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup low sodium chicken stock
instructions: Tie the currants, curry powder and 2 to 3 sprigs of curry in a piece of cheesecloth. Bring stock to a boil and add the currants and dried red bell pepper. Simmer 10 minutes. Strain the soup through a fine mesh sieve pressing down, discarding the solids.

title: Apple Surprise
ingredients: 4 cups cooked chopped green apples or 4 cups regular chopped apples | 10 1/2 ounces cream of chicken soup
instructions: Mix apples into soup until well blended. Pour into lightly buttered 9x5x3 inch baking dish. Sprinkle top with more shredded cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 350°f until hot and bubbly.

title: Raspberry Soup
ingredients: 1 gallon raspberry ( canned ok ) | 1 quart chicken stock or 1 quart broth
instructions: Put the raspberries in the blender, add a little stock or broth and blend until smooth. Serve hot.

title: Homemade Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 large egg roll | mustard powder
instructions: Mix the egg roll powder and mustard powder together to make a paste. Use a piping bag or a piping tube until it can be snipped open. Remove the egg roll with a knife or spatula. Use the leftover egg roll paste to make rolls. I also fill a bowl with cold water before sealing the egg roll and place on the cutting board with a fork or fork to do this. When you use the knife or fork to cut out each egg roll carefully, it will not split. Use whatever bread flour your going to grab straight away from the bowl. The bread flour is critical to ensure that egg rolls are free of bacteria and dry material. Dip the egg roll in the batter to coat both sides and let the egg roll sit for 1 - 2 minutes to absorb the batter. While the egg roll is sitting, prepare the tomato gravy sauce. Start to cook the tomato gravy with the beef cubes following your preferred recipe, i get my beef cubes cooked, drained and chopped. When the egg roll is done, cut it across the grain. Remove the egg roll with a slotted spoon and drain the excess oil. Place the egg roll in a warming pan, pour tomato gravy over it, and cook over medium heat until it begins to thicken.

Random Ingredients: tuna,pizza sauce,green bell pepper,okra,black bean,garam masala
title: Mediterranean Tuna and Okra Wraps
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/4 cups chopped okra | 1 1/4 cups pizza sauce | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 1/2 cups cooked tuna, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler. In a large bowl, mix together the black beans, okra, pizza sauce, green bell pepper, garam masala and tuna. Gently fold in the chopped green bell pepper. Spoon mixture onto a cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil. Broil until heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Cuban Oysters
ingredients: 1 package frozen sweetened oysters | 1 1/2 tablespoons onion powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons limeade concentrate | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil leaves | 1 cup burgundy wine or 1 cup white wine
instructions: Put frozen onions and the juice from jar into a medium bowl. Add the oysters. Add the onion powder, limeade concentrate, and basil leaves. Stir to blend. Pour the wine into a bowl, cover, and refrigerate until chilled.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,chicken bouillon granule,gingerroot,spice,mozzarella cheese,feta cheese,garlic clove
title: Grilled Feta Chicken and Ceviche
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chicken breasts | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 2 garlic cloves, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh gingerroot, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 tablespoons spiced spice mix | 1/2 lb feta cheese, crumbled | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a shallow glass or ceramic dish. In a small bowl, combine thawed limeade concentrate, chopped garlic, and chopped ginger. Pour over chicken. Cover, and marinate in refrigerator for 4 hours and up to 8 hours. Preheat charcoal grill. Remove chicken from the marinade. Thread onto skewers. Grill chicken for 5 to 7 minutes per side, until no longer pink and juices run clear. Sprinkle feta cheese over the top and continue grilling for about 3 to 5 more minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,cumin powder,mayonnaise,stout beer,okra,queso fresco,self rising flour
title: Okra & Okra Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb okra, cleaned, peeled and cut in half lengthwise | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 cups shredded queso fresco | 1 package baby queso fresco, cut in half | 1 1/2 cups cooked kidney beans, drained, rinsed and rinsed | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 3 -5 tablespoons sour or 3 -5 tablespoons mexican beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line two baking sheets with foil. Place okra on baking sheet and mist with cooking oil. Place okra in the oven for about 25 - 60 minutes, turning occasionally, until lightly browned and crispy. Remove from oven and coat okra well with mayonnaise. Add queso fresco and remaining ingredients, mixing well, and continue mixing well. Set aside. To assemble place a portion of mixture on a warmed tortilla and fold, moistening the last edge with a squeeze of water if needed, to seal. Continue until all ingredients have been used, placing them on prepared baking sheets, seam side down. Bake for about 20 - 25 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve hot with warm flour or your favorite dipping sauce.

title: Sweet and Sour Sausage and Mango Appetizer
ingredients: 1 pound hot italian sausage, casings removed | 2 pounds mangoes, thinly sliced
instructions: Place sausage on a skillet and spread it out into a 6x6 inch thick patty. Wrap tortillas in aluminum foil and bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350 degrees f. Remove from oven and place mango slices in a colander over the sausage. Squeeze out excess liquid. Place sausage mixture on a plate and cut into small pieces. Stir together sausage mixture and mango slices. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 to 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,lettuce leaf,extra virgin olive oil,orange zest,spinach,penne
title: Spinach Italian Salad
ingredients: 1 bag dry penne, cooked al dente | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1 1/4 tablespoons dried onion flakes, crumbled or ground | 1 cup fresh spinach, washed well and drained | lettuce leaf
instructions: Pour all but 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a salad bowl. In a small bowl toss together the orange zest, dried onion flakes, spinach and onion salt mix well. Pour evenly over the pasta to coat. Add the remaining olive oil to a large nonstick saute pan over medium heat. When oil is hot, add the dry penne and stir frequently until it is golden brown, but don't let it brown excessively for this step. Add the dressing to the pasta and spinach mixture. Chill the pasta in the fridge for about 1 hour before serving. Serve topped with a bit of lettuce and sour cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: szechuan peppercorn,cauliflower,garlic powder,rum extract,paprika,thyme sprig,walnut,coriander seed
title: Cauliflower Rum Powder
ingredients: 2 cups szechuan peppercorns | 2 cups paprika | 2 tablespoons garlic powder | 12 tablespoons ground thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1/2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | 1 head cauliflower | 1 teaspoon rum extract, for garnishing
instructions: In a large pot, cover the peppercorns with water, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and let sit for 15 minutes. Peel then coarsely grind them, and set aside. In a large spice mill or mortar, pound the szechuan peppercorns, paprika, garlic powder, thyme, coriander, sichuan pepper, whole coriander, and szechuan peppercorns into a fine powder. Place cauliflower in a steamer basket fitted with a steamer basket, cover and place over high heat. Steam the cauliflower until tender this usually takes around 8 - 10 minutes depending on the heat of the steam. Remove from heat, and stir in the rum. Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with the paprika powder.

title: Chutney for Dogs
ingredients: 3/4 cup chopped yellow sweet pepper | 3/4 cup chopped serrano pepper | 1/4 cup chutney
instructions: Mix pepper and chutney together. Sprinkle with bagels. Bake at 400 degrees f. For 10 minutes. Cool.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,irish cream,cocoa,rice wine vinegar,honey,beef neck,cumin seed,part mozzarella cheese
title: Beef Sticky Rice Wraps
ingredients: 3/4 lb fully cooked beef neck bones | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed | 1 1/4 teaspoons cocoa | 1/4 cup honey | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons cilantro, minced | 1/2 cup irish cream or 1/2 cup light sour cream
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. While rice mixture is cooling, place meat through garlic press between fingers into rice and stir in cuminseed. Transfer mince to a large mixing bowl and add cocoa. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate.. While rice mixture is chilling, prepare coriander paste, in a small nonstick skillet heat 1 tablespoon of cumin seeds over medium heat until barely browned. Toast coriander seeds in a dry 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring, until fragrant. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. Pour molasses mixture into a small bowl and set aside. Using a blender or food processor, combine meat mixture and cilantro. Season mixture with salt and pepper.

title: Minty Apple Truffles
ingredients: 6 tablespoons peanut butter | 6 tart apples ( tart, peeled or not ) | 3 tablespoons tart apple, chopped | 1 cup semisweet chocolate bars, melted
instructions: Combine peanut butter and tart apple in a bowl. Add chocolate and stir until smooth. Shape into 10 balls, and chill in fridge until ready to use. When ready to serve, place 3 tbsp of the peanut butter in a small paper cone shaped glass dish and place around the apple, shaking to coat. Microwave a few seconds until melted, then repeat with remaining peanut butter balls and fruit balls. Drizzle with melted chocolate and serve.

title: Savory Ham
ingredients: 2 cups rice wine ( i use port ) | 1 -2 1 -2 cup cooked ham, cubed ( depends on how much meat you use ) or 1 -2 cup cooked pork ( depends on how much meat you use ) | 1 can pork-flavored gelatin or 1/2 cup limeade | 1 tablespoon dill seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon savory ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon other herbs ( optional )
instructions: Soak the dried herbs in rice wine for at least 2 days, covered. Drain the soaked herbs, reserving the cooking liquid. Add the ham and pork to the soaked herbs. Pour any cooking liquid into a glass bowl or other container. Dissolve the sugar in the gelatin, and then add it to the ham mixture. Stir until well blended. Add the reserved cooking liquid, mix well, then chill until firm. Once firm, pour into freezer or freezer containers. Label and freeze,.

title: Chinese Takeout Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken legs | 2 cubes of chicken bouillon | 1 packet dried apricots
instructions: Remove the excess fat and skin from the chicken legs. Combine all ingredients throughly in a large oven safe bowl. Cover bowl with saran wrap and bake at 220 degrees celcius for 40 minutes. Remove cover and bake at 220 degrees for 30 minutes. Remove and allow to cool for 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: miracle whip,grainy mustard,nonstick vegetable oil cooking spray,black mustard seed,italian spice,extra cheddar cheese,water chestnut,beer
title: Cheddar Rarebit
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups miracle whip | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon prepared black mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons extra-cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 tablespoon italian spices | 1/4 cup water chestnut, sliced and coarsely chopped | 1 1/4 cups beer | 1 1/4 cups water | nonstick vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Heat nonstick cooking spray on medium high in a large frying pan or skillet. Stir in mustard seed. When seeds begin to pop, add dry italian spices. Stir for about 1 minute, continuing to stir constantly. When spices begin to pop a little, add water chestnuts. Add grated cheese and stir to blend. Remove from heat and mix in beer and water. Transfer mixture to a 1 1/4 cup measuring cup. Cover and chill. When ready to serve, preheat broiler. Coat pan well with nonstick cooking spray. Mixture will be crumbly. Sprinkle cheese mixture on top of cheese mixture. Place under broiler about 4 minutes until bubbly. Serve hot. If desired, garnish with a drizzle of sour cream or salsa. You really don't want to ruin your mouth.

Random Ingredients: chinese cabbage,phyllo pastry,plain yogurt,orange blossom water,bay leaf,vegetable shortening
title: Chinese Strudels
ingredients: 1 lb fresh chinese cabbage, washed, dried a thoroughly drained, and shredded | 2 cups plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons vegetable shortening, melted | 2 bay leaves | 1/2 tablespoon orange blossom water | 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 5 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Mix shredded cabbage together with 1/2 cup of plain yogurt. Preheat oven to 450°f. Add shortening, bay leaves, orange blossom water, and remaining 3/4 cup yogurt to cabbage and toss to mix into yogurt. Spray a jellyroll pan with nonstick cooking spray and place phyllo sheets in the pan and spray tops with cooking spray. Place the phyllo sheets over the parchment. Bake the brussels, uncovered, for 20 minutes, until crisp and golden.

title: Quick Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 teaspoons guacamole | 1/4 cup kalamata olive
instructions: Spread on 2 medium sized, regular sized, nonstick baking sheets. Top with your favorite toppings. Spray small nonstick skillet lightly with cooking spray. Heat on medium or medium low till very hot. Lay your bread flat in your skillet with both flat sides facing out. I use a metal spatula to pull all the air out of the bread. I like my bread about 1/2 1 inch thick. If your skillet is large, you may need to use a spatula. Spread 3 tablespoons guacamole over half of bread. Sprinkle with olives. Serve.

title: Beef and Mushroom Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin | 1 can sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup apple cider ( optional ) | 1 cup skim milk | 1/4 cup whole milk | 1 savoy cabbage, large, finely diced | 3 -9 cherries
instructions: Combine cabbage and cabbage leaves in a 5 or 6 qt crockpot. Cut the sirloin in 1/2 inch strips. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix mushroom and cider if using. Add cabbage mixture to crockpot. Stir. Cook on high 15 minutes, then on low 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Stir in milk a few tablespoons at a time. Serve over noodles and top with cherries.

title: Broccoli Cheese With Blue Cheese and Bacon
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh broccoli, trimmed and cut into bite size pieces | 8 slices blue cheese | 8 tablespoons thousand island dressing or 8 tablespoons thousand island dressing, for serving
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the broccoli and stir to coat. Reduce the heat to medium and cook 10 to 15 minutes or until the broccoli is crisp tender. Drain well and cut into bite sized pieces. Coat a large nonstick skillet with 1 tablespoon of the dressing or 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Heat over medium high heat. Place 1/4 to 1/2 cup of the broccoli in the skillet and toss, quickly crushing the clumps as you do so. Cover and cook 1 minute to cook broccoli. Remove broccoli from the skillet and transfer to a large bowl. Repeat with the remaining 1/2 cup of broccoli and dressing. Toss with toasted broccoli and serve topped with the croutons or a light salad.

title: Easy Beef Stew
ingredients: 500 g braising steak or 500 g stewing beef | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 green pepper, chopped | 250 g baby carrots
instructions: Brown the meat in the chilli oil. Add the green pepper and carrots and cook a further 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,wheat bran,hard egg,scallop,anchovy,peanut,wheat flour,lamb
title: Greek Lamb Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb, cut 1 3/4 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups wheat bran | 1 1/2 - 2 cups wheat flour | 6 tablespoons anchovies | 2 small hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 1/4 cup whole wheat bran
instructions: Prepare the lamb. For best results, marinate lamb with italian salad dressing. For best results, marinate lamb for at least 30 minutes. Prepare the salads. Cut hard boiled eggs in half lengthwise, peel and dice. Prepare the scallops. In a large bowl, mix the lamb with the wheat germ, anchovies, hard boiled eggs and peanuts. Taste and adjust seasoning. Cover and refrigerate. Prepare the dressing. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the wheat bran. Stir once and add a few tablespoons of the wheat bran cooking water. Reduce heat and cook till the water has been absorbed. Cover and keep warm till serving time. Drain the lamb well. Slice the meat into thin slices. Place the meat, cut side down, on a serving platter. Serve salad with salad dressing on the side.

title: Rice With Noodles & Cauliflower
ingredients: 8 ounces noodles, cooked | 8 ounces cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 teaspoons mustard, dijon | 1/2 tablespoon ground sumac | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup niter kefalotiri or 1/4 cup greek kefalotiri ( may sub fresh flat-leaf parsley ) | 1 1/2 quarts cold water
instructions: Mix the ingredients together in a large, heavy soup kettle or dutch oven, making sure it is heated to a boil.. Cook the noodles until tender and drained. Toss with the remaining ingredients. Serve hot.

title: Easy Chinese Glaze (Mongolian Recipe)
ingredients: 3/4 cup margarine, softened | 2/3 cup hoisin sauce ( kikkoman sweet soy glaze ) or 2/3 cup other soy sauce, your choice | 2 tablespoons margarine, softened
instructions: Beat together 2/3 cup margarine, hoisin sauce and 2 tablespoons margarine until blended. Stir in 2 tablespoons margarine to blend.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,tabasco sauce,parsnip,golden syrup,phyllo dough,mayonnaise,marsala wine
title: Apricot Parsnips
ingredients: 6 large parsnips | 30 sheets phyllo dough | 60 g apricot jam | 1 tablespoon marsala wine | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 150 ml sweet sherry vinegar or 150 ml madeira wine vinegar | 200 ml low-fat mayonnaise
instructions: Preheat oven at 200°c. Peel, halve, and slice parsnips lengthways. Place all ingredients in a large roasting tin and combine well with some more sherry or madeira or vinegar, reserving a small amount of sherry for the sauce. Cook in the oven for 25 minutes, until just starting to turn golden and crisp. To serve leave to rest for 5 minutes cut a small slit around the base of each parsnip and remove the skin, then slice crossways to serve. Drizzle each piece with a little sherry or marsala vinegar and top with a teaspoonful of jam.

title: Lamb and Chayote Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb chayote, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs chayotes, quartered | 1/2 cup brown lentils
instructions: Add lamb, chayote, and lentils to crockpot. Cook on high for 7 hours or on low for 8 hours. When ready to serve, remove meat and carrots and cut meat with knife into chunks. Remove carrots from juice and add them to the soup. Puree all ingredients with any excess liquid. Cook for 30 minutes longer.

title: Quick Cremini-Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces mushrooms, sliced | 1 package frozen puffappardselle pasta | freshly sliced cremini mushroom
instructions: Prepare the pasta according to package directions. Do not cook until it's ready. When cooking, drain the pasta but reserve about 1/2 cup of the liquid and then return the pasta to the pot. Place the prepared pasta in a heated microwave safe bowl and top with the mushrooms and microwave on high for 2 minutes, using 1/4 cup of the liquid from the microwave for every minute of the microwave. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: roast lamb,lamb,bacon,beef tenderloin steak,red wine,wheat bread,beef broth,cardamom powder
title: Lamb and Beef Tenderloin Skewers
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 4 slices bacon | 2 tablespoons beef broth | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 lamb, trimmed | 4 slices cooked roast lamb | 4 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Cook bacon in a small to medium skillet over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon to a paper towel lined plate and discard drippings. Pour off most of the bacon drippings. Place beef on a rack in a roasting pan coated with cooking spray. In the drippings fry bacon. Remove from skillet and cut into bite size pieces. When cool enough to handle chop bacon into pieces, if necessary. Discard drippings. Place beef and bacon onto skewers. Reserve juice. Brush meat thoroughly with broth and sprinkle with red wine and cardamom powder. Place skewers in a shallow baking dish. Bake in a preheated 450 degrees f oven for 10 minutes or until meat thermometer reads 140 degrees f degrees f. While skewers are cooking slice lamb or other meat. Serve with skewers.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,rom tomato,farfalle pasta,cake flour,spanish onion,rice wine vinegar,mozzarella cheese
title: Pasta with Salty Crispy Tomatoes and Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 package dried farfalle pasta | 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | 2 -3 fresh hot red chili peppers, seeded and chopped ( less if you like a lot of heat ) | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 2 -3 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 1 bunch mozzarella cheese, shredded ( about 3/4 pound ) | 4 roma tomatoes, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook pasta. Meanwhile, in a large frying pan, sauté onion. When onions are tender, add chiles.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,rice vinegar,cream tartar,penne pasta,five spice powder,cashew
title: Creamy Spiced Saffron Pasta
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon dark rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 2 tablespoons cashews | 1/2 teaspoon black cardamom pod | 1 lb penne pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Combine the cream of tartar, rice vinegar, five spice powder, cashews, cardamom and saffron in a bowl. Bring a large pot generously salted water to a boil. Add penne pasta and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender but firm to the bite, about 6 minutes. Drain. Pour cream sauce over pasta and sprinkle with paprika to serve.

title: Angel Food Cake Dressing
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups half-and-half | 6 1/4 cups angel food cake, cut into thin slices | 1 red onion, sliced thin ( to taste ) | 8 ounces cream-style hot bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup chopped nuts
instructions: Combine half and half and angel food cake slices in container with tight lid. Cover tightly and shake to mix. Place in refrigerator to chill in refrigerator about 3 hours. Combine hot bouillon cubes and nuts in saucepan. Cover and turn off heat and let stand until bouillon cubes settle to bottom of pan. Combine remaining half and half and onion and combine. Spoon mixture into chilled martini glasses, sprinkle with reserved chopped nuts and serve.

Random Ingredients: chilies,baby spinach,cottage cheese,kidney bean,buttermilk baking mix,cornstarch,thyme leaf
title: Mexican Spinach Bean Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can diced mild chilies | 3/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 cup canned cottage cheese ( low-fat ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2/3 cup buttermilk baking mix | 1 small bag baby spinach, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Line a 2 - 3 baking sheets with foil, or lightly oil the foil. In a large bowl, combine beans and spices. To the bowl with beans and spices, stir in the cottage cheese until mixture resembles cottage cheese. Stir in buttermilk baking mix. Pour into prepared pan and sprinkle top with coarsely ground black pepper. Bake in preheated oven until top is light brown, about 45 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle on fresh spinach and serve right away. Or keep warm in a 375° oven for up to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,ice water,rice krispies,marjoram,spinach leaf
title: Spinach Rice Krispies
ingredients: 1 package spinach leaves, chopped | 4 cups kikkoman rice krispies | 3 cups splenda sugar blend | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions, drain and set aside. Pour rice krispies into food processor and blend until fine and creamy. Add splenda, marjoram and ice water, process until well mixed and pour into a small saucepan, heat until liquid is just boiling. Remove from heat and place on low heat, stir occasionally while watching for steam inside, remove from heat when all is absorbed and stir in cooked spinach. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,flour,fennel seed,cream chicken soup,button mushroom,pie shell
title: French Mushroom Pie
ingredients: 12 ounces button mushrooms or 12 ounces white mushrooms, sliced | 3 tablespoons flour | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup ( undiluted ) | 10 cooked pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare pastry. Mushrooms, flour, fennel seeds, tumeric powder and cream of chicken soup as directed on can. Add mushrooms and combine well. Spread into pie plate. Bake 45 - 50 minutes.

title: White Beans Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white beans | 1 1/2 cups grated cheese
instructions: Mash the beans well, then stir in the cheese. Cover with some plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours, or freeze overnight. Stir well before serving. The cheese can easily be removed from the spread or refrigerated until serving.

title: Pasta with Pork and Saffron
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta shells | 1 lb ground pork | 10 ounces canned sliced ham | 4 tablespoons minced shallots | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 2/3 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions. Brown ground pork, sausage and garlic together with shallots and saffron. Drain, but do not rinse. Meanwhile, place pasta on a baking pan and layer 1 3/4 cups of the stuffing on top. Top with a layer of drained pasta, sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes. Allow to sit and sit for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Artichokes in Lemongrass
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained | 1 stalk lemongrass | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 1/4 cup sultana | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Slice lemongrass into thin 2 1/2 inch pieces. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Place drained tofu on a plate and cover with a paper towel.

title: Kale, Stove Top Beef or Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut in 2 inch long chunks | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 12 leaves kale | bread, crusts
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Combine flour and salt in a large bowl. Dip meat into flour mixture, brown well on all sides, and transfer to large, heavy oval baking dish with a diameter of 1/8 inches. Add a couple of handfuls of kale or spinach. Repeat this until meat, kale or spinach are used up. Place in oven and bake for about 2 hours, stirring every 30 or 90 minutes. Test to see that the top is beginning to brown. Remove from oven and let sit for 15 minutes before serving. Cut the loaf in half, and toast in oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden all over. Serve with gravy.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,greek oregano,raisin,cilantro leaf,corn,grenadine syrup,corn oil,provolone cheese
title: Prosciutto Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs corn, kernels cut off ( corn is best ) | 3 tablespoons raisins | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon greek oregano or 1 teaspoon marjoram | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1/4 cup grape syrup or 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 3 ounces provolone cheese, cut into strips ( about 2/3 cup ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil and vinegar in a large bowl. Toss to coat. Divide evenly among breaded wraps. Brush with oil. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Shiitake Mushrooms on Basil Balsamic Wraps
ingredients: 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar ( to taste ) | 2 -3 slices fresh crusty tortillas
instructions: Wipe any dirt off of the mushrooms, cut into small pieces, and clean. Place all ingredients in a non reactive bowl, cover and chill in a refrigerator for about 10 minutes. Warm the tortillas in the oven or on the grill. Place a generous amount of the mushroom mixture on each of the wraps. Wrap each wrap with the tortillas, wrap over, and serve as a sandwich or on italian sandwich buns.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,cannellini bean,thai basil,topping,yellow mustard,mustard powder,kidney bean,cherry
title: Tasty Beans and Spinach Pie
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 cup yellow mustard | 1/4 cup prepared yellow mustard powder | 2 tablespoons spanish sweet pickapeppa sauce or 2 tablespoons thai sweet pickapeppa sauce ( to taste ) | 1 cup cannellini beans, drained, rinsed and canned | 1 cup cherry or 1 cup mixed candied red fruits, cut in halves | 1/4 cup fresh thai basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Roll out the puff pastry to an 11x7 inch pan and transfer to a cookie sheet. Spread 1 cup bean sprouts evenly over dough on the crust. Combine the remaining black beans, all of the yellow mustard powder, yellow mustard and spicy pickapeppa sauce in a medium bowl. Sprinkle over the black bean mixture. Then spread the cannellini beans over the bean sprouts. Then, spread with the remaining bean sprouts. Sprinkle with the cherries. Cover with the remaining dough and press the edges to seal. Bake for about 35 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Remove from oven, remove top crust and let cool for about 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Homemade Challah
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups bread flour | 2 lemons, thinly grated peel | 2 red peppers, deseeded and coarsely chopped
instructions: In large bowl, mix together the flour, lemon peel and 2 quarts of water. Add peppers, stirring. Add to flour mixture along with salt, cover and store in dry area. For a longer rising time, knead slightly and form into ball, about one pound in weight. Place on floured board and form into 4 long, 2 1/2 in diameter. Using a round cookie cutter, cut out circles about 3 1/2 inches in diameter. Place on greased cookie sheet and prick top with a fork. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,greek yogurt,raspberry,yellow onion,coconut,tamarind paste,pepperoni
title: Lucky Mint Pudding with Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped yellow onion | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon shredded sweetened coconut | 1/2 pepperoni, sliced | fresh raspberry ( optional )
instructions: Combine the greek yogurt, onion and cream in a large bowl. Add the tamarind paste, coconut and pepperoni. Spoon into a serving dish and serve immediately.

title: Fried Onions
ingredients: 2 lbs onions, peeled, cut in half and then crosswise | 3 red chilies, deveined and split | 1/3 cup pure maple syrup | 20 kalamata olives, pitted and sliced
instructions: Arrange onions in a single layer on a baking sheet. Arrange chilies directly on top of onions. In a small saucepan, combine syrup and 2 cups water. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring to scrape up browned bits from pan. Simmer, uncovered 10 minutes. Drain syrup. Brush onions with syrup, sprinkle with olives, and bake in a 400° oven 12 minutes.

title: Rice Salad With Shrimp and Plums in Tomato-Chocolate Sauce
