title: Noodle and Beet Salad With Hot, Hot and Sweet Chicken V
ingredients: 4 ounces dried egg noodles | 14 ounces fresh asparagus spears | 1 ounce beet ( cooked or roasted ) | 8 ounces vegetarian chicken wings | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil and add the noodles, boil for 5 - 7 minutes, or according to the package directions. Drain and leave to cool for 5 minutes then drain well under cold running water. Cut off the root ends of the asparagus and cut int 2 inch pieces. Remove the hard stalk ends and slice into 1 inch pieces. Toss the asparagus with the beet, chicken wings and parsley in a large salad bowl. Scatter over the noodles and toss together gently.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,fast rising yeast,pine nut,parsley leaf,bean sprout,lemon wedge
title: Lebanese Bread (No Wasted Garlic)
ingredients: 1 package fast rising yeast | 1 cup warm water | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 cup drained canned bean sprouts ( canned beans ) | 1/3 cup drained pine nuts | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water, in a large bowl, stirring to blend. Let stand 15 minutes, or until mixture leaves sides of bowl. Add 1/2 of the bouillon and 2 cups of the bean sprouts to the yeast mixture. Stir to blend. Add remaining bean sprouts, pine nuts, and 1 tablespoon of the parsley. Cover bowl, and let rise 1 hour. Turn into a greased 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 quart crock. Cover, and let rise 1 hour. Bake at 300 degrees f for 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup mix,gorgonzola cheese,cocoa powder,phyllo dough,walnut,seasoning salt,cardamom seed
title: Baked Filled Phyllo Samosas
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated phyllo dough | 1 packet french onion soup mix | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts ( optional ) | 1/3 cup freshly grated gorgonzola cheese | 1/3 cup cocoa powder | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Unroll phyllo dough onto greased cookie sheet, and spread with 1 teaspoon melted gorgonzola cheese. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon grated gorgonzola cheese and 1/2 cup chopped nuts if using. Combine remaining gorgonzola cheese ingredients, mixing thoroughly. Spread evenly over phyllo, leaving 2 - 3 inches between each layer. Cut four smaller strips from each corner as shown on photo. Pour 1 - 2 teaspoons melted gorgonzola over pastry. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until brown on the edge. You might need to bake a little longer to get the cheeses to melt. Remove from oven, and leave covered with a damp cloth for 15 minutes. Turn out onto serving dish and serve hot or warm. You might want to brush the top with melted gorgonzola. The phyllo layers can also be layered between sheets of wax paper. This recipe can be doubled if your phyllo are bountiful in size. Add one sheet of phyllo to each small baking dish, allowing it to absorb as much of the gorgonzola as possible. You may use a baking sheet to help separate your pastry.

title: Beef Broth With a Kick
ingredients: 3/4 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon finely minced hot chili | 2 tablespoons grated unpared fresh flat-leaf parsley | freshly cracked black pepper | 1 tablespoon freshly grated good grand marnier ( or a white liqueur like grand marnier or other brandy )
instructions: Stir together the buttermilk and hot chili in a medium size, heavy saucepan. Turn the heat to the lowest. Sprinkle the ground black pepper and the cheese over the top with the last pinch of salt and the fresh grated parsley. Warm over a medium heat only and the broth as always, stirring occasionally with a whisk, will take about 12 minutes. When it is the desired thickness, remove from the heat. Do not bring the broth to a boil. Cover and set aside for 1 hour. Strain the broth through a sieve into a mixing bowl and discard solids. Discard solids. Keep the broth warm over very low heat. Serve broth with boiled rice, perhaps a hearty pinch of grated pepper and some liqueur.

title: White Bean Veggies
ingredients: 32 ounces white beans, beans drained and rinsed | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables, vegetables
instructions: Cook frozen vegetables according to package directions. When beans are cool enough to handle cut in half and saute in large skillet with butter and white bean sauces. When vegetables are soft, add bean mash and continue cooking, stirring occasionally. Serve with pita bread and fresh salad.

title: Spinach, Turkey and American Cheese Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces cooked drained tuna | 1/2 cup catsup | 10 ounces baby spinach leaves | 1 lb american cheese, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,balsamic vinegar,nori,garlic powder,celery salt,green olive,lime juice
title: Ole! Bayou-Style Green Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 1/2 cup green olives | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar ( or white wine vinegar-you can use red wine vinegar just not vinegar ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice i did it | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon quick-cooking oil
instructions: Blend all ingredients well. Serve with hot, crusty bread. You can also use olive tapenade.

title: Red Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 lb red cabbage, finely shredded ( approximately 1-2 cups ) | 1 green mango, finely diced ( approximately 1 lb. ) | 3 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Combine all ingrediends in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to simmer and cook for 15 minutes or until heated through. Remove from heat and stir in ketchup. Cool completely and store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,heavy cream,deli roast beef,chestnut,lamb,onion powder,green grape,green food coloring
title: Marry Me I Heart Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat or 1 1/2 lbs stew beef short rib beef | 1 1/2 lbs lamb bones or 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 2 -3 tablespoons onion powder | 5 drops green food coloring ( optional ) | 1 can chestnuts, sliced | 12 small green grapes | 1 cup heavy cream | 8 ounces deli rotel green cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place meat in bottom of 3 - ½ baking dishes. Season with onion powder and cook in crock pot until meat is browned and the bones are very tender. Add 1 cup water, chestnuts, grapes, and ¾ cup water. Cover and cook on high for one hour. Remove meat to a plate. Return to crock pot and add remaining ½ cup water and ¾ cup cream. Cook for an additional 25 minutes. Cover and cook on low for 1½ hours. Remove all bones, reserving 2 cups meat broth. Slice meat and serve with hot gravy. Marry me i heart beef stew recipe can be eaten with rice. Note, if eating meat the night before, remove the bones just before serving.

title: Quick Fajita Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 4 whole-grain wheat hamburger buns or 4 hamburger buns | 1 1/2 teaspoons tap water
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When oil just begins to smoke, add burgers and cook 3 to 5 seconds per side or until lightly toasted and cooked through. Turn over. Spread bottoms of the rolls with tap water. Heat burgers until warm, about 1 to 2 minutes on each side. Serve immediately.

title: Cheesy Baked Pumpkin
ingredients: 6 pounds fresh pork shoulder, cut into cubes | 1 cup canned apricot preserves | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1 cup chopped chives | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 container mizithra cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place a roasting pan on the center rack, and grease the pan. Arrange the pork cubes in the pan, in a single layer. Combine the preserves, pecans, chives, and vanilla extract in a bowl. Spread evenly over the pork. Evenly spread mirepoix into the center of the meat. Cover, and bake in the preheated oven until meat is very tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove to a serving dish, and keep warm. Remove crusts from pan, and mix together cheese. Spread cheese over the top of the meat.

title: Guinness Whipped Beverage
ingredients: 8 ounces unsalted butter | 7 ounces guinness stout | 14 ounces walnuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Melt the butter in a mixing bowl. Add the guinness and stir to combine. Using a balloon whisk, pour the guinness/butter mixture into the butter mixture and stir to combine. The drink should have a pouring consistency. Using a dessert spoon, place the walnuts on top of the guinness mixture and scatter the walnuts on top. Serve immediately.

title: Capelles of Malta (Baked Mints With Lemon, Garlic and Rose Water)
ingredients: 1 large lemon, finely cut into wedges and rind | 2 bunches of fresh mint, finely washed, rinsed in lots of changes of water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celcius. Put the lemon rind in a large ovenproof dish, sprinkle the mint leaves on top of the rind, and rub all over with the lemon juice. Bake, uncovered, for 20 - 30 minutes, until it and mint are soft just not completely dried up. Towards the end of the 20 minutes, if all the liquid is released, transfer the mint to a kitchen towel, and roll the mint leaves around the lemon. It should look dry or spotted.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,coconut cream,peppercorn,vegetable stock chicken,cornstarch,fish bouillon cube,peanut oil
title: Fish in Peppercorn Sauce (Suk Nasi Lemong)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable stock or 4 tablespoons chicken stock | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 3 dried peppercorns | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 1 fish bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 2 teaspoons fish bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients except peppercorns. Strain liquid into pot and set aside. Put peppercorns in a mortar and pound to fine crumbs. Heat oil in wok to high and add meat mixture. Mix till browned and remove it with slotted spoon and it from the wok. Put the meat back in. Add the liquid and coconut cream stir fry for 3 minutes. If sauce gets too thick add a little water. Add peppercorns and season with salt and serve.

Random Ingredients: salmon,chili pepper,vanilla extract,raisin,yogurt,worcestershire sauce,brown mustard seed,mace
title: Gravlax
ingredients: 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup brown mustard seeds | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1/8 teaspoon mace | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon chili pepper, from a can | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1/2 cup yogurt | 12 ounces salmon
instructions: Add raisins and place in medium bowl. In processor put 2 tsp of the worcestershire sauce, mace. And vanilla. Add rest and blender to blend. Add more worcestershire sauce if needed. Chill until serving. Serve with salmon and lemon wedges if desired.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,yellow bell pepper,vanilla bean,beef,beef sirloin,maraschino cherry
title: Beef Kabobs (Hurry for Kebabs)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin, cut into bite size pieces | 2 teaspoons vanilla beans, split | 1 container applesauce | 2 cups yellow bell peppers, diced ( or other sweet green bell pepper ) | 3 maraschino cherries, quartered | 3 cups packaged whole dried beef
instructions: Place meat and split vanilla pods into plastic bag. Add applesauce and shake around. Place bag into medium bowl and set aside. Place yellow bell peppers on cutting board using the side of a knife or a meat tenderizing mallet, cut into large chunks. Place into a bowl with ice cubes and set aside. Place all 12 marinade ingredients into bowl and stir to mix, set aside covered for 30mins. Remove kabobs from marinade and place all 12 pieces into a plastic storage bag. Spoon a little bit of the excess marinade over the skewers. Refrigerate overnight, remove kabobs from marinade and thread with a skewer or soaked bamboo skewers. Place all the prepared kabobs on a hot skewer or under a broiler, grill to desired doneness, about 3 - 4 minutes per side for medium rare, 4 - 5 minutes per side for well done. Serve immediately with your choice of accompaniments. I like to add my peanut dipping sauce for our sweet tooth, or for that added protien, serve with rice, or just plain.

title: Spicy Broccoli
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets | 1/2 cup raw cheese ( parmesan and swiss are good choices ) | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon ( knorr beef flavor ) | 1 teaspoon cumin ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Cut broccoli stems in quarters lengthwise, then cut each piece crosswise into 1/4 inch slivers. Cook broccoli, onion, bouillon, cumin and turmeric in a covered pan until broccoli and cheese are tender, about 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Baked Pork Sirloin
ingredients: 1 fresh pork tenderloin, trimmed | 3 slices thin sliced smoked pork fat ( or 1/3-1/2-inch thick. can use smoked ham ( or other bacon flavor )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the pork tenderloin, fat side up on a piece of heavy foil. Fold the foil in half, and tightly seal with a twist tie. Transfer to a roasting pan. Smooth out any large pieces of fat with fingers. Place on top of the pork, and fold up the sides of the foil. Tuck the ends down the meat.. Roast in the preheated oven until a meat thermometer inserted into the center registers 145 degrees f, approximately 1 hour.

title: Cherry Tomato Glazed Pork Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs pork steaks ( or pork chops ) | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 teaspoon savory | 1/2 cup bottled sweetened pickled cherry tomatoes, about 10 small cherry tomatoes ( or can use grape tomatoes if desired ) | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 4 strawberries, cleaned and sliced
instructions: Sprinkle steaks with salt. Place in a baking pan, cut side down. Sprinkle with raisins, savory and cherry tomatoes. Drizzle with oyster sauce. Bake at 350 degrees f, or grill, turning once, until no longer pink in center, about 30 minutes. Watch carefully not to overcook. Arrange strawberries on top of pork, and bake until tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Accent-Battered Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 1/4 teaspoons accent seasoning | 3 teaspoons dried rubbed sage leaves | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix, accent, sage, and buttermilk in a large bowl. Pour over salad and toss to coat.

title: Lebanese Barley Cookies (Aglio)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups barley flour | 4 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon chili, ground
instructions: Place all the ingredients in the bowl. Using the kneading action on a clean flat surface, roll the dough lightly. Cut into 1 - 2 inch circles. Put on an un greased tray and leave to rest on the tray in a warm room, to rise. You will need to cook the cookies in batches or they may crackle and flatten. The cookies are ready when the top cracks and is firm. Place in an airtight container and store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,tomato green chile pepper,corn kernel,rice wine,kaffir lime leaf
title: Grilled Rice With Corn, Tomatoes and Chile
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers | 6 kaffir lime leaves ( fresh or dried ) | 1 serrano chili, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/2 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed
instructions: Heat grill pan on highest heat. Spread a baking sheet on the rack. In a food processor, add tomatoes, chiles, lime juice, serrano chili and the rice wine. Process until combined, about 10 seconds, scraping sides of pan as needed.

Random Ingredients: pea,russet potato,dark brown sugar,pineapple juice,romaine lettuce
title: Sweet Potato, Peanut and Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 6 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch thick wedges | 5 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 4 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 -3 head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 can sweet peas, drained and rinsed until cool
instructions: Toss potatoes with dark brown sugar and 1/2 cup pineapple juice and let stand 10 minutes. Toss with romaine lettuce, sweet peas and remaining pineapple juice to serve.

title: Lentee Poblano Chilies
ingredients: 3 -4 poblano chile | 2 -3 serrano peppers ( for less heat, or less heat ) | 2 lemongrass | 1 teaspoon baking soda or 2 teaspoons molasses | 1/2 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Put peppers in oven and roast for 20 - 30 minutes or until black. Cool and peel off black skin. Cut up into 1 slices and remove seeds. Place the sliced peppers into a bowl. Peel chili peppers if desired removing seeds as well as membrane inside. Slice serrano peppers thinly. Peel lemongrass and cut off tough ends of lemongrass. Wash chilies, pat dry and tear them apart with a rolling pin. Cut a slit into the stem and discard, leaving them in tact about a half inch square. Remove the top stems as well with a sharp knife. Remove the membrane from the pepper. Slice the peels into 1/4 inch strips. Coarsely grind the chilies and lemon grass finely. Combine chilies, lemon grass, baking soda, and pepper. Place flour and a teaspoon or two of the chili mixture to dip the soaked peppers into. Add to pepper mixture while shaking out all the dry mixture. Place the coated peppers into your dehydrator unit and wait about 20 minutes for the flour to go slightly golden in color. Remove from the dehydrator to a clean kitchen towel lined with a silicone liner or clean paper napkin. Dunk the paper towel into the hot water. Remove all of the sticky pieces from the pepper mixture until it is cool enough to handle and not be able to touch. Dip the pepper into the flour mixture to coat. Dunk the drained pepper into the boiling water and let it soak about 15 minutes. Remove the pepper when it is completely cool and add to the clay baking dish. Add your final solution if there is too much liquid in the pan. Bake for about 30 minutes until golden.

title: Sweetheart Marinated Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg grape tomatoes | 1 celery heart | 1/3 cup coarse breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 can tomato puree | 1 jar grape tomatoes | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Cut tomatoes and celery heart into 5mm slices. Place into shallow glass dish, add celery heart, breadcrumbs, sugar, tomato purée and vinegar. Drain well, chill for 2 hours. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Bake for 2 hours or until tomatoes are soft. Combine topping ingredients and serve on plates..

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,lemon lime beverage,turmeric powder,zucchini,white wine,wheat flour,campari,picante sauce
title: Zucchini Pakora (Zucchini Chapati) Pakris
ingredients: 2 zucchini ( chopped into medium size balls ) | 2 teaspoons pure mori's whole wheat flour ( wholemeal tin ) | 1 tablespoon sazon goya chipotle pepper, pureed in a pestle and mortar | 1/2 cup campari | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/2 cup lemon lime beverage | 1/4 cup picante sauce ( any flavor )
instructions: Slightly fry the zucchini balls and place on the plate. Place the sazon paste on top. Add the turmeric powder and campari paste and then add the white wine for a few minutes while stirring until all the sauce has stopped foaming and add the picante sauce at once and stir with a wooden spoon and keep mixing until all the ingredients are incorporated. You will not need to stop stirring. Add the drained zucchini on top and cook in a dry pan, not to mush just mush, on a medium heat. I find that this will produce nice firm pieces of zucchini. Keep tossing with a wooden spoon and watch you do not burn it. Let the zukchini cook for 2 to 3 minutes and remove and put to one side. Note, you can adjust the amount of zucchini according to your taste. It's up to you. The rest can be cooked with less or more sauce. Add the balance of the ingredients and mix with a spoon. These are quite a lot of sauce. If you use extra sauce for a meal you can store the pakora in the fridge for an extra hour or so before you serve.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,pecan,poblano chile,tomato sauce,spring onion,flour,orange peel,provolone cheese
title: Mexican Party Dip
ingredients: 1 bag round flour, frozen dough ( i use 1 bag ) | 4 poblano chiles - chopped, roasted, peeled, and peeled | 2 spring onions, sliced very thin | 3/4 cup chopped pecans | 4 ounces provolone cheese, shredded | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon orange peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Roll out 1 bag of dough on a clean surface into a log. If necessary, thaw dough completely before rolling out the rest. On the ungreased baking sheet, place the poblano chilies and place into freezer for 15 minutes to help remove some of the water from the green chilies. Remove from freezer, and remove green chilies shells. Chop into smaller pieces, if necessary. Lay the poblano chilies into a bowl, and evenly distribute 1/2 of the sliced spring onions on the ground poblano chilies. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the chopped pecans on the poblano chiles. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the shredded cheese on top. Then pile in 1/3 of the poblano, 1 tablespoon of the chopped tomatoes, and 1/3 of the green onions. Next, drizzle with 1 tablespoon of the garam masala, 1 teaspoon of the freshly grated orange peel, and cover with 1/3 of the tomato sauce. Repeat layers twice, then wrap with plastic wrap to keep from drying out. Place baking sheet on top of a large stove burner, and place the wrapped party inside. On top of the baking sheet, place the aluminum foil over the entire dish. Set oven to broil. Place under broiler, and broil for 2 minutes. Turn off oven, and let set for at least 10 minutes.

title: Zucchini, Bourbon & Zucchini Crepes
ingredients: 4 small zucchini, coarsely grated | 6 -8 crepes | 2 tablespoons bourbon | 2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Grill zucchini and crepe with bourbon till charred and crisp inside. Cut in half & set aside. Beat flour & sugar together. Put crepes on plate. Top with grated zucchini and drizzle with bourbon. Fold & enjoy.

title: Stacked Fire Tomato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium ripe pineapple, peeled, cored, and chopped | 1 can pineapple juice | 1 jalapeno ( serrano pepper )
instructions: In a blender or food processor combine the pineapple, pineapple juice, and serrano pepper. Blend or process until smooth. Chill.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,pineapple juice,bean sprout,cotija cheese,roasting chicken,apricot preserve,ice water,basil pesto
title: Pesto Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken, preferably free range | 4 ounces unsweetened pineapple juice | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 3 tablespoons smooth cappellini bean sprouts | 4 tablespoons chopped basil pesto | 3 tablespoons ice cold water | 1 cup shaved dark chocolate | 1 cup crumbled cotija cheese
instructions: If using the crock pot it's best to use an oven set at 200f or a pre heated oven to be hot, so that the chicken and pineapple have a nice and low temperature when you start cooking. Remove the chicken from the crock pot and place on a platter, or into a roasting pan. Using a toothpicks or a sharp knife, cut slits all over the chicken and insert the tenderloins. Add the pineapple juice and preserves to the crock pot and set on high. Cook for 10 minutes or till the chicken is done. After 10 minutes, remove the breast from the crock pot and set into a small ovenproof dish, or onto a serving dish. Sprinkle with basil pesto and garnish with crumbled crumbled cheeses. Return the chicken to the pan and re cover. Set the oven to 325f or 180c or a fan forced oven to its lowest temperature and cook for 30 - 40 minutes, or till the chicken is cooked and the cheese is melted. Remove from the oven and serve immediately with rice, noodles or anything else.

title: Mccall's Swiss Steak Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb steak, sliced 3/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1/3 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in very large frying pan on medium heat. Cook 5 to 8 minutes on medium high heat turning once until brown. Sprinkle with cheese and cover.

title: Cashew Noodles - Noodles W- Nilsli  N
ingredients: 8 ounces noodles, broken into 3/4 inch pieces or 1 -2 cup mixed raw cashews | 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons cashews, coarsely chopped
instructions: Put the noodles in a mixing bowl and add enough cold water to cover them by at least two inches.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust pie,heavy cream,cornmeal,italian tomato,kalamata olive,island dressing
title: Pizzas
ingredients: 1 large pastry for a 9 inch single crust pie | 1 tablespoon cornmeal | 2 cups heavy cream | 1/4 cup island dressing | 10 pitted kalamata olives, halved | 3 tomatoes, seeded and cut into 2 slices | 1 jar small baby bella mushrooms, drained, and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Make the crust by mixing together the cornmeal and cream. Gradually beat in the salad dressing until well blended and smooth.

Random Ingredients: white potato,chickpea,milk,mexican cheese,cannellini bean,macaroni,lemon juice,pita pocket bread
title: Chickpea Potato and Olive Fritters on Pitas With Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 cups cooked and cubed white potatoes | 1 cup dry cannellini beans | 1/2 cup chopped fresh spinach | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | 4 pita pockets bread, cut in half | 6 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons skim milk | 1 cup fat-free mexican blend cheese
instructions: Place potatoes in a medium saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, simmer, covered for 8 - 10 minutes until tender. Drain, return to a large skillet and mash with a fork or potato masher. Set aside. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat. Add the kidney beans, spinach, lemon juice and half of the pita bread halves to the hot skillet. Sprinkle the remaining pita open faced over the mixture. Fold the pita over the mixture and bake, flipping once, for 5 - 10 minutes, or until heated through. Toast the remaining pita halves and spread the top with remaining shredded cheese. Serve topped with the chickpeas and remaining cheese.

title: Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 2 teaspoons sherry wine | 2 teaspoons light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons corn syrup, warmed
instructions: Pour beans into a saucepan, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until just tender. Drain beans and set aside. In a bowl, combine 1 1/2 cup bean liquid with the sherry and corn syrup.

Random Ingredients: seltzer water,steak,rice flour,cilantro leaf,basil leaf,curry powder,flour tortilla
title: Burritos (Curried Steak and Rice Fritters)
ingredients: 1 lb steak, cubed | 2 tablespoons seasoned rice flour | 1 1/4 tablespoons green curry powder or 1 1/4 tablespoons chili paste | 6 basil leaves | 1 cup cilantro leaf, divided | 1/4 cup frozen seltzer water | 10 flour tortillas
instructions: Heat an electric skillet until hot. Meanwhile, combine steak, rice flour, curry powder, 1/2 t. Chopped cilantro and basil in a large bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste and mix thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Cover and cook over high heat until sauce is bubbly and vegetables are crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Serve with tortillas.

Random Ingredients: fingerling potato,beef bouillon,lasagna noodle,hash brown,lemon zest,cauliflower
title: Lemon Beef Burrito®
ingredients: 1 bag shredded hash browns, frozen | 1/8 cup ground cauliflower | 1 1/2 lbs fingerling potatoes | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon, sodium-reduced | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 package lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook hash browns in a microwave on high for 7 minutes on high.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip cooky,carrot,dark beer,vegetable oil,extra virgin olive oil
title: Chocolate Stout Bags
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 3/4 ounces bittersweet chocolate chips ( the good stuff ) | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons dark beer | 12 chocolate-covered frozen chocolate chip cookies | 1 1/2 - 2 cups finely shredded carrots
instructions: Heat the oil in a heavy nonstick skillet over medium heat until the scent of smoke emanates, about 2 minutes. Add the chocolate chips and cook, stirring, until they are slightly softened and beginning to turn white, about 1 minute. Stir in the olive oil. Pour in the beer, stirring until it has melted down a bit but still has some oil in it. Stir in the shredded chocolate chips. Transfer the chocolate chips to a large paper bag or plastic bag with a tip and pipe a marocy shape onto the top of the bun. Refrigerate the bag or bag for at least 1 hour to set the chocolate and oil. If you are planning on storing beer, add the extra virgin olive oil just before serving, allowing the chocolate to become fragrant. Store in the refrigerator. Variation, melt chocolates with beer for a thicker beer.

title: Tortilla Chips for Chips & Chips
ingredients: 1 tortilla | 12 caraway seeds
instructions: Toast the tortilla and spread on a non stick frying pan until lightly roasted. Sprinkle the caraway seeds over the entire surface immediately. Let them toast for about 5minutes, shake pan. It will turn dark red. Eat them hot with your favorite chip or condiments.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,kasseri cheese,fine breadcrumb,pecorino romano cheese,bagel,bay leaf
title: Garlic Pizzas (Garlicky Flatbread With Cheese
ingredients: 12 -24 slices bagels, crusts removed, halved horizontally | 1 cup grated oka | 1/3 cup finely cut flat leaf parsley | 1 cup grated kefalotiri or 1 cup kefalotiri | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 bay leaf | fine dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f cut each half diagonally into 1/4 slices. Place on a greased, ungreased baking sheet and bake for 5 - 6 minutes, until just crisp and lightly toasted. Turn and bake for an additional 5 - 6 minutes or until crisp on the outside. Using a slotted spoon, remove to a bowl lined with a clean towel and let drain. Place the bagels on a work surface. Combine the cheese, parsley, grated cheese, bread crumbs, bay leaf and pinch of salt and pepper to taste. Spoon cheese mixture onto bagels and roll to enclose. Wrap each roll in about 3 or 4 slices of bread. Wrap in foil if desired. When cool, store in the refrigerator.

title: Beef Barley Vegetable Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cans beef broth | pearl barley | diced carrot
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot on high setting and stir. Cook 6 hours on high or 5 hours on low. Stir.

title: Noodles in White Wine and Radishes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 bag noodles | 8 -12 small radishes | 2 -8 soft bread, slices
instructions: Place flour in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,egg beater substitute,grain white rice,mung bean sprout,coconut cream
title: Mongo
ingredients: 1 cup mung bean sprouts, washed and drained | 2 tablespoons unsweetened coconut cream | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 3 tablespoons coconut oil | 4 cups long-grain white rice or 4 cups jasmine rice, rinsed to remove excess salt | coconut oil ( for frying )
instructions: Set oven to 300°. Mix the coconut cream and egg replacer according to package directions, beating until smooth after each addition. Heat wok or large skillet until hot. Add the coconut oil. When the oil is hot, add the coconut meat mixture. Let it sear just until the meat turns slightly brown, about 20 seconds. Add the rice. Stir in the coconut cream mixture. Bring the rice sauce to a boil. Cover. Bake about 20 minutes, or until rice and meat combination is fully cooked. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tuna,green cabbage,vegetable bouillon cube,rice noodle,chocolate chip,chili oil,pickle,tequila
title: Japanese Steamed Tuna Rolls
ingredients: 12 pickle slices | 1/4 cup vegetable bouillon cube | 4 tablespoons dry instant minced onion or 5 -6 fresh minced onions | 1/4 cup tequila | chili oil, to taste | 3/4 cup crisp rice noodles or 3/4 cup vermicelli ( i use 1/2 a package, make sure they are whole wheat, if you use them ) | 2 cups shredded green cabbage | 3 cans tuna, drained
instructions: Place beef, onions and 1/2 cup water into the base and steaming rack in a 2 gallon steamer basket. Cover the basket and bring to the boil until the water is gone, about 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from the steamer with a slotted spoon, discard the lid and set a side until you are ready to steam. Remove water with the lid, cover the basket with a tea towel, refrigerate while you cook your noodles so noodles and rest up when you start preparing the rest. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add 1 tbls. Of veg. Vegetable bouillon and stir fry the noodles until they turn bright green but look translucent. Drain them well and place on a bowl. Toss noodles with 2 tablespoons chili oil. Divide noodles among 12 paper towels to soak up excess water. Using your hands, pat dry noodles, place on a plate. Place 1 teaspoons of tuna and 1/2 cup shredded carrot in the middle of each noodle. Form a cylinder and pinch the ends closed with a toothpick. Arrange on a bamboo steamer basket, making sure the rolls are not touching each other, seam side down. Cover the steamer basket with cheese cloth, bring water to a boil and steam until noodles are firm to the toothpick. Remove toothpicks, remove lettuce leaves. Add 2 tablespoons of chili oil to a 1 gallon stock pot, return to a boil and put a lid on. Steam noodles until they are crisp and a little darker. If they are a little darker, add a little more. Add 3 tbls. Of chili oil to the stock pot, return to a boil and add 1/2 cup shredded cabbage. Cook cabbage for about 5 minutes stirring constantly. After cabbage is done, add tuna to the pot, stirring constantly. Drain tuna well, place in serving bowl and sprinkle with remaining shredded carrot. Garnish with pickle slices.

title: Bahama Mama Lamb in Rum
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb ( loin chops ) | 2 chili peppers | 1/2 cup broth ( see recipe ) | 2 cups dark rum ( i used cajun-style ) | 1 lemon, zest of
instructions: Cut up the chilies and set aside. Remove the seeds from the lemon and add them to the lamb. Chop the lemon zest into 1/4 inch pieces if using. Marinate the lamb and chilies in the rum in a plastic bag, pour the marinade over the meat, seal the bag tightly and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or at least overnight. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Remove the lamb from the marinade and place on a foil lined roasting pan skin side down. Roast in the oven for about 1 hour or until well browned on top. Remove the lamb and chilies from the oven and allow it to rest until you can pierce the meat with a fork. Remove the meat from the roasting pan and set aside. Reduce your heat a bit and add the broth and rum. Simmer for about 20 minutes to thicken the broth. Slice the lamb and serve with the simmered broth.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,brown sugar,caster sugar,marsala wine,monterey jack cheese,broccoli,peach,corn oil
title: Broccoli and Apple Pie
ingredients: 400 g broccoli, cut into florets | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 120 g butter | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 cans sliced peaches | 8 sheets puff pastry
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender and drain. Heat oil in a skillet and add the brown sugar. Stir over low heat for 2 minutes. Add marsala, butter, sugar and chopped peach halves. Allow to cook until it begins to thicken. Remove from heat and cool. Layer puff pastry on bottom of pie pan, topping with broccoli mixture. Top with pie mixture. Sprinkle the top with cheese. Cut into 8 squares.

title: Kale Salad
ingredients: 1 small bunch kale | 1/2 cup light sour cream or 1/2 cup yogurt | 1 jar good quality bottled tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | purchased cool whip
instructions: Wash kale. Cut off ends and remove leaves. Cut leaves in 1 inch pieces. Place in a pot of lightly salted water. Bring to a boil, stirring to separate kale leaves into individual leaves. Add tomato sauce and fennel seeds to kale. Reduce heat to low. Cover. Let sit for 1 hour or more. Serve over lettuce.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,phyllo pastry,spaghetti sauce,romaine lettuce,red cabbage
title: Veggie Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 10 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/4 pound shredded romaine lettuce | 1/4 can sliced red cabbage | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Thaw thawed phyllo pastry sheets at room temperature as directed on package. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Pour spaghetti sauce into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange 10 sheets phyllo sheets over the sauce, spreading them 2 inches up the sides of the dish. Brush 5 strips with spaghetti sauce, and top with 1/2 remaining phyllo dough. Lay 10 more strips over phyllo, brushing each with more sauce. Cover phyllo with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 30 minutes. Heat a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Squeeze excess moisture from the phyllo sheets with your hands, and roll them into sausage shapes, about 1/4 inch in diameter. Pour 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce over phyllo, and place 2 more sheets over the sauce, spreading them with remaining sauce. Layer sliced romaine lettuce over phyllo, and spread another 1/4 cup spaghetti sauce on top. Season with salt and ground black pepper. Continue layering in this way with remaining pastry sheets, phyllo sheets, remaining tomato sauce, and remaining sauce. Cut a slit in the top of each roll to allow steam to escape before wrapping in plastic.

title: Pinto Beans and Polenta for the Microwave
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 1/2 cup prepared polenta | 1/2 onion, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/4 cup anchovy, finely chopped | 1/2 cup pinto beans, cooked and drained | 1/3 cup nutella | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Put ground sirloin and polenta in bowl, mix well. Add onion, vanilla sugar, anchovy, pinto beans and nutella. Mix in yeast, set in 5x9x2 glass baking pans sprayed with pam, cover with plastic wrap. Microwave for 45 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. This should be moist and stretchy. Stir to combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,baking potato,brown mustard seed
title: Baked Fries, Onions & Barbecued Piglets
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 in thick wedges | 1 beef bouillon cube, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Mix the potato, bouillon cube & mustard seeds in a roasting tin. Drizzle with the oil from the roasting tin & sprinkle with the salt & pepper. Bake for 25 - 35 mins until well browned & cooked through.

title: Kidney Bean and Meat Toss
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti, broken into 3 inch pieces | 1/2 cup corn oil | 100 g canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained well | 500 g minced meat | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 cup refried beans
instructions: Heat the oil in a large non stick fry pan. Add in the spaghetti. Fry for approx 5 minutes while stirring. Add the beans then continue to stir fry for approx 3 minutes. When the spaghetti is cooked drain its water then stir it into the fry pan with the meat and mustard. Return to a simmer, stirring now and then. Stir till heated through. Serve while warm with lots of green salad.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,pita bread,pecan,cake flour,red wine vinegar,rosemary leaf,bread,gorgonzola
title: Greek Panzanella
ingredients: 1/3 cup cake flour | 1/8 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 4 pita bread | 3/4 cup crumbled gorgonzola | pitted toasted pecans | crassly toasted pecan slices
instructions: Make the cream sauce, beat together the flour and rosemary until the flour resembles fine bread crumbs. Beat in the cream and vinegar until smooth. Spread mixture on both sides of 2 pita bread rounds. Using a slotted spoon, top with about 1/2 cup of the cheese, topped with about 1/4 cup of crumbled gorgonzola. Top with 2 pita bread rounds, 1 tablespoon of cream sauce and 1 tablespoon of toasted pecans. Garnish with remaining crumbled gorgonzola and toasted pecans. Cut into 4 wedges.

Random Ingredients: sea bass,italian sausage link,dark chocolate,tikka paste,nutmeg
title: Sausage and Sea Bass Terrine With Tamarind Chocolate Filling
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground nutmeg | 4 links hot italian sausage links | 4 sea bass, sliced into 8 pieces | 1 package dark chocolate, melted | 1 tablespoon tikka paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Butter a 12x18 inch cake pan with 1 tablespoon of the melted light brown sugar. In a medium bowl, mix together the nutmeg and hot italian sausage links. Spread the sausage mixture evenly into the prepared pan. Arrange the sea bass pieces on top of the sugar mixture and press the sausages flat against the sea bass. Bake for 90 minutes, or until meat is firm and fish is easily flaked with a fork. Meanwhile, melt the dark chocolate in the remaining tablespoons of melted dark brown sugar. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with tikka paste. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of melted dark chocolate to finish.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,plum tomato,cream cheese,lemon juice zest
title: Pizzoccheri (Cold Roasted Tomato Dip)
ingredients: 5 large red ripe tomatoes | 300 g cream cheese | 3 tablespoons lemon juice and zest | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Place the baking powder in a bowl and stir in the remaining ingredients. Place the mixture on the baking tray and roast in a preheated oven. When cool, break or slice into 2 inch segments. Store in an airtight container.

title: Easy Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 7 ounces tomato ketchup | 4 ounces sugar substitute | 1/2 chili ( optional )
instructions: Whisk ketchup, sugar, chili powder and simmering mixture. Heat on low until all mixture thickens. Allow to cool. Pour into sterilised jars and seal.

title: Cajun BBQ Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup cajun seasoning, or more to taste | 6 cloves, or as desired | 2 pounds steak, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 6 slices bread, or more to taste | 4 slices toasted ham, or as desired | 6 pickled apricots, sliced
instructions: Make the cajun seasoning and chicken broth by heating the chicken broth in a large skillet over high heat until broth is hot.

title: Wilted Sprouts With Cashews and Brains
ingredients: 1 lb fresh brussels sprout | 2 tablespoons bacon grease | 1/4 cup raw cashew nuts | brussels sprouts ( to garnish )
instructions: Trim and wash sprouts. Chop stems into large bite size pieces. Cook in a medium pot of boiling water 3 minutes to blanch. Drain. Heat the bacon grease over medium heat, and add the cashews. Fry until golden brown. Add sprouts immediately and toss. Garnish with brussels sprouts.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,buttermilk biscuit,filet beef,pie shell,currant,lettuce leaf
title: Ace's Ultimate Beef Cheese Foldovers
ingredients: 2 cups buttermilk biscuits, crumbs | 1 lb boneless filet of beef | 1 can refrigerated pie shells | 2 cups lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup currants ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine buttermilk biscuits, beef, lettuce, currants and cardamom pods.

title: Spoiled Eggplant With Cajun Crab
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants | cold water | 1/4 cup crabmeat, cooked | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds, cracked | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes
instructions: Cut the eggplant in 1 inch slices. Dry the slices on paper towels. Place the slices in a casserole dish. Pour enough cold water over the eggplant to cover and soak the slices for 30 minutes. Drain the eggplant and place them in a bowl. Stir together the crabmeat, yellow mustard seed, and onion flakes and spread over the eggplant. Place the dish over medium heat and cook until the filling is heated through, but not browned. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,chive,taco seasoning mix,chicken bouillon
title: Taco Cookies, Crumblers, and Wedges
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1 pound ground chicken in a large, deep skillet | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine graham cracker crumbs, taco seasoning mix, ground chicken, and bouillon in a large bowl.

title: Spicy Pineapple Sauce (Oamc)
ingredients: 4 cups pineapple chunks in juice | 1 can beef stock
instructions: Empty beef stock into a heavy saucepan and heat to boiling. Drain pineapple. In a blender or food processor, chop the pineapple chunks until smooth. Transfer pineapple, beef stock, and pineapple juice to a skillet over medium heat, and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 15 minutes to blend flavors. Remove from heat.

title: Pork Butt Sweet Pot Sticks
ingredients: 1 pork butt, trimmed | 2 teaspoons cornflour, heaped
instructions: Place the pork butt in a large saucepan filled halfway with water over medium heat, add enough water to cover. Bring to the boil then reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 1 hour. Remove the pork from the saucepan and discard the pork and place in a warm bowl. Add the cornflour to the remaining water and stir until smooth. Strain the filling and serve the pork sprinkled with the cornflour. Note, for creamier gravy, place the pork and cornflour in a processor and process until smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides with a rubber spatula.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,wild rice,spanish onion,black bean,lime,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Spanish Rice With a Kick
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced spanish onion | 1 cup wild rice | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 12 large thin slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped limes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º. In a large bowl, combine wild rice, beans and onions. Place prosciutto slices on a sprayed 2 large baking sheet. Bake in oven for 13 - 20 minutes or until slightly crisp. Remove from oven and top with pepper jack cheese. Bake an additional 10 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,tabasco sauce,tuna,cardamom seed,sharp cheddar cheese,apricot preserve
title: Rost-Fried Tuna With Stone Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled | 6 tablespoons apricot preserves | 6 fluid ounces smoked tuna | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Drain potato skins, cut into halves.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,beef rump roast,kosher salt pepper,orange zest,basil,shallot,red chilies
title: Roasted Beef With Chile-Basil Rub
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless beef rump roast | 1 head basil, packed | 1/4 cup thinly sliced shallot | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 6 medium dried red chilies, stemmed and coarsely torn into pieces | 1 tablespoon kosher salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the roast fat side up in a shallow roasting pan and place on middle rack of oven. Roast for 1 hour and 45 minutes, basting occasionally with pan juices, until meat is well browned on the outside, and no longer pink in the center. Transfer the meat to platter and cover with foil to rest. Pour off about 2/3 cup pan juices, about 1 and 1/4 cups, and discard any accumulated juices. Place remaining juices, basil, shallots, parsley, zest, chiles, salt and pepper in a medium bowl and toss. Slice the roast across the grain and arrange on warmed platter. Spoon on the sauce. If desired, serve with bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: cumin,horseradish,limeade concentrate,ice cube,english cucumber,virgin olive oil
title: Cacique Relish for Two
ingredients: 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 teaspoon cumin | 2 tablespoons horseradish, grated | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil | 2 english cucumbers, cut in half and thinly sliced | 2 ice cubes, crushed
instructions: Add limeade concentrate, cumin, horseradish and olive oil to the bowl of a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Add cucumbers and ice, blending until finely chopped. Pour into a tall glass, garnish with a toothpick and serve.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,fenugreek seed,butternut squash,red lentil,yellow squash,stewing beef,asparagus
title: Beef and Vegetable Samosas
ingredients: 750 g stewing beef, diced ( or lean shoulder ) | 450 g sweet red lentils, rinsed | 450 g asparagus, chopped | 450 yams or 450 g yellow squash, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon dengreek leaves mustard powder | 25 g coriander seeds or 15 g fennel seeds | 225 g red lentils, rinsed | 450 g butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cut into 2 cm cubes
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas brown the beef over a high heat in a large casserole dish, adding a little oil if necessary. Add the lentils, asparagus, yellow squash, mustard and fennel seeds, and toss to coat. Add the vegetables to the beef, then add the lentils and coriander. Cover the lid and cook until the vegetables are just tender. Transfer to a large heatproof dish. Cook in the pre heated oven for 25 minutes. Remove from the oven, then stir and serve with the yoghurt.

title: Frijoles Charros
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pinto beans or 1 1/2 cups pinto beans, drained | 3 dates, pitted and chopped | 1/2 vanilla bean, split
instructions: Cover beans with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,almond meal,bucatini pasta,pesto sauce,cilantro leaf,water,broccoli,vinegar
title: Pesto Broccoli & Vegetables With Almonds
ingredients: 1 small broccoli, cut into small florets | 1/4 cup almond meal ( can use regular or low-fat ) | 1/2 cup basil leaves, whole | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf | 1/2 cup pesto sauce ( i use my own homemade pesto sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup water | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1 lb bucatini pasta or 1 lb spaghetti
instructions: Rinse and boil the broccoli with basil, cilantro & pepper flakes until just tender, about 3 - 5 minutes. Drain well & set aside. To the bowl of your cheese machine add all the rest of your ingredients along with any herbs, salt & pepper. Pour in water& blend. Add the broccoli & pesto & blend again. If you can, put machine on the'manual' setting. While the pasta is coming to a boil, cook the pasta until al dente. Drain the pasta & broccoli & serve with the pesto sauce.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,maple syrup,oyster sauce,bread,cayenne pepper,basmati rice,italian bread,liquid honey
title: Quickie Easy Microwave Sandwiches Recipe
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 2 fresh red chilies, seeded and minced | 2 teaspoons liquid honey | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon dry crushed red chilies | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 slice italian bread, warmed
instructions: In 10 inch skillet, combine rice, chiles, honey, maple syrup, chilies, oyster sauce and cayenne pepper. Cover and microwave on high 4 minutes or until hot, stirring halfway through cook time. Stir. Microwave on low, uncovered, 2 minutes longer. Brush bread with oil. Divide mixture among bread slices. Serve with sauce on the side for dipping.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,flour,cuervo gold tequila,extra wide egg noodle,lemon zest,corn
title: Chef John's Beef and Noodles With Whiskey & Fresh Corn Slices
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup flour | 1 cup refrigerated medium tri tip frozen mixed vegetables | 1/3 cup cuervo gold tequila | 3 tablespoons grated lemon zest | 4 ears lipped corn, husked | 3 cups hoisin noodles or 3 cups giorno gold tequila
instructions: Pat off excess fat from beef, then season with salt and pepper. Whisk flour into the beef until well combined. Toss with beef in a bowl with vegetables and tequila. Cover, refrigerate 20 minutes. Meanwhile preheat grill for high heat. Remove beef from refrigerator, wrap in foil, and let sit at room temperature. Discard vegetables. Grill beef over high heat, turning once, until medium rare in the center, about 9 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Toss egg noodles with 1/4 cup tzatziki sauce, 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest, 1/4 cup hoisin noodles, 2 or 3 tablespoons beef shavings from the tequila and 1 tablespoon lemon juice in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper to taste. To serve, divide noodles among plates and top with beef and vegetables. Divide remaining tzatziki among plates.

title: German Fried Plantains
ingredients: 2 bananas | 3 tablespoons hot paprika | 1 tablespoon mustard | 2 hot plantains | apricot jam
instructions: Peel the bananas and fry in a little oil until golden brown. Place on a paper towel lined plate to absorb excess oil. Sprinkle the paprika powder over the hot plantains. Top with the apricot jam and then the bananas. Serve with boiled new potatoes.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,ice,american cheese,cauliflower,vanilla extract,fish stock
title: Cauliflower Cheese and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 6 slices american cheese | 1 medium head cauliflower, chopped | 14 1/2 ounces diced stewed tomatoes with green chilies | 3 1/3 cups fish stock | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: Boil 1/2 an inch of water in a large saucepan. Add in the cauliflower and cauliflower and cook for 4 - 5 minutes, or until crisp tender, and drain. To make the cheese sauce, place the tomatoes in a microwave safe container, and heat over high for 2 minutes to warm them out a little bit. Dump in all the other ingredients, except the ice, and microwave for 20 seconds in a microwave safe bowl. Swirl the mixture around, and stir every so often. Stir in the ice, taste if the sauce needs salt and/or seasoning. Serve hot.

ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dry rubbed sage leaves ( can use fresh, dry, optional ) | 2 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 1/2 inch wide strips | 6 large button mushrooms, sliced 1/8 inch thick | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and chopped | 1 cup romano cheese, shredded | 1 cup packed mixed romaine lettuce | 1 medium pumpkin, cut into 4 thin diagonal slices
instructions: In a small bowl, combine vinegar and sage. Pour over beef.

Random Ingredients: white bean,black eyed pea,white shoepeg corn,hot mustard,kalamata olive,jiffy cornbread mix
title: Crock Pot Jiffy English Mambo
ingredients: 2 packages jiffy cornbread mix | 1 cup white shoepeg corn | 1 cup fresh white beans, drained | 1 1/2 cups kalamata olives or 1 1/2 cups black olives, pitted and sliced | 1/4 cup dry hot mustard | 1 can white shoepeg corn
instructions: On a large plate, combine the dry cornbread mix and the 3 cups of dry white bean, olives and hot mustard. Cut the remaining can of corn in half, scrape out the top and bottom layer and spread about 2/3 of the top. You want a layer with 2/3 of the cornbread mix on the bottom layer. Cover with white bean/olive mixture. Repeat layers. You will have two layers of mixture, ending with the white bean/olive mixture on top. Cover and cook on high 5 - 6 hours. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,turmeric powder,maple syrup,french bread,cream tartar,zucchini,greek yogurt,nori
title: Yogurt Waffle
ingredients: 1 cup french bread, cubed very small | 1 egg noodles | 1 container fat free greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup fat free sour cream or 1/4 cup low fat plain yogurt | 1 medium zucchini | 0.5 nori, seaweed
instructions: Cook the french bread cubes in the greek yogurt till golden.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,clove,gherkin,herbes de provence,cinnamon,coconut,beef chuck roast,mustard seed
title: Paleo-Style Beef Goulash
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup shelled gherkin, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 3 whole cloves | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | fresh coconut, cut into 4 equal slices ( optional ) | 1 cup snow peas, strings removed
instructions: Spray a dutch oven with cooking spray over high heat.

title: Peach Raisin Croutons With Tangy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups peaches, peeled pitted diced ( not canned ) | 1 cup dark raisin | 1/4 cup light sour cream or 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon cognac | 1/2 tablespoon tahini | 2/3 cup shredded loaf italian bread
instructions: In a medium bowl add the peaches, raisins, sour cream, cognac and tahini. Stir to blend. Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions, using about 2/3 cup per cookie and shaping to fit if desired. Spoon half of the prepared sauce onto each cookie disc. Place the reserved croutons onto each cookie disc. Bake in a preheated 350 degrees oven for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden and bubbly. Serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy Satay and Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 lb rice noodles | 1 jar of your favorite sweet tamari ( i use sambal oelek brand with great results )
instructions: In a food processor cook rice noodles according to the package directions. Drain well. Rinse with cold water. In a bowl pour hot water over your noodles to swish the strands around to soften and soften the noodles. Drain and rinse with cold water. Cut noodles into 5 by 1 inch long chunks or smaller depending on how much noodles you like. Place into a bowl and add the sweet tamari. Toss well. Let sit for a few min to soak up the flavor. Serve or store in an airtight container. This is great when served with kabocha or ginger garlic and soy sauce.

title: Homemade French Bread
ingredients: 500 g starter yeast | 150 g gluten | 150 g gluten ( for bread machine ) | 100 mg savory ( for bread machine )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast and 1/2 cup of water in the bowl of warm weather. Let proof until the yeast softens to a gluggy batter, about 12 - 15 minutes. Use the back of a spoon to punch down any lumps of yeast. Sprinkle the yeast on the pan while the bread is still warm, or in a bowl and put into the warm bowl. Sprinkle in the rest of the dry ingredients and knead by hand or in your electric mixer. You will need some flour at this point. Place it in a bowl and cover with a cloth or cloth dish that has been sprinkled with some flour until the dough is free of draft. Place the dough into an oiled bowl and cover with a cloth or bowl towel. Let rise in the draft free place for about 30 - 45 minutes at temperature.

title: Polish Orzo Soup
ingredients: 1 lb orzo pasta | 8 -12 slices bacon ( optional ) | 1 bunch fresh dill ( or 1/4 cup chopped dried dill ) | 1/2 - 1 green chili ( depending on what kind you use ) ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot bring 6 cups of water on high heat to boil on the stove. Meanwhile, cut bacon into 1/2´´´´´´ size pieces. When it’s boiling, add the bacon pieces to boiling water and stir for about 5 minutes, then return to heat. Add in the dill and green chili. Stir. Turn off heat immediately. Serve hot with plain yoghurt and garlic dressing.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,cheddar cheese,dark chocolate melt,chicken thigh,italian turkey sausage
title: Italian Sausage Chicken Chops
ingredients: 4 -5 chicken thighs ( i prefer boneless skinless ) | 2 -8 ounces italian turkey sausage | 6 -8 ounces mild cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup dark chocolate melts | freshly torn italian or curly curly cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: Trim the chicken thighs of any excess fat and any visible fat. Remove stuffing from casings and brown or grill the chicken over medium heat. When the chicken is golden brown and cooked through transfer to bowl and cut into chunks. Place the sausage pieces into a casserole dish and add the 3 tablespoons of melted chocolate and enough water to cover the chicken pieces in the dish. Sprinkle over the cilantro to taste, covering evenly. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. After a few minutes add the chicken back in and cover to let chicken cook until meat and cheese is melted and serve, garnishing with additional cilantro.

title: Scallops with Yogurt and Orange Scented Scallops
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 cucumber, peeled and chopped | 4 scallops | 6 slices orange zest | 1/2 cup fresh thyme sprig | 8 medium tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine yogurt and cucumber in medium bowl. Arrange scallops in a single layer in a baking dish.

title: Chilt-Sour Italian Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 -2 plum tomato, diced | 1 tablespoon salad dressing mix | 1 -2 teaspoon dried italian salad dressing mix | mexican mixed salad green | mixed baby bok choy | 4 leaves fresh italian-style mixed salad greens
instructions: To soften tomatoes, put them in a mini chopper bowl and puree until smooth. Add a small splash of salad dressing mix to diced tomatoes. Season with oregano, salt and pepper. To prepare salad, place mixed greens in a bowl and toss with 1/2 teaspoon of salad dressing mix. Top with tomato mixture. Sprinkle on remaining salad dressing mix. Serve immediately.

title: Curried Cod and Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 red green chili pepper | 1 can chopped green chili peppers | 1 can white bread | 1/4 cup mayonnaise, not lowfat | 2 -4 slices thick cut white bread, toasted and buttered
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook cauliflower in a large pot of boiling water until almost tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Tosha
ingredients: 20 ounces canned cannellini beans or 20 ounces other white beans, drained | 1/4 cup pumpkin seeds | 1/2 cup grated raw cheese | 1/4 cup diced onion | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon granulated garlic or 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Drain beans into a colander, pressing out all the liquid. Combine remaining ingredients and add to beans. Toss lightly until well combined. Cover and refrigerate to allow flavors to blend. Transfer to a ziplock bag and store in the freezer until needed.

title: Mock Coffee Bean Rice Krispies Bars
ingredients: 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate | 1 1/4 cups instant rice krispies | 1/2 cup thinly sliced celery | 2 tablespoons instant coffee beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the orange juice concentrate, rice krispies, celery, and coffee beans. Stir in the cereal mixture. Press into an 11x7 inch baking dish. Spread evenly, and bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Scrambled Eggs with Horseradish
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cooking oil | 1 egg substitute | horseradish ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Pour egg substitute into hot pan.

title: Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage ( casing removed or sliced ) | 3 cans chicken broth | 2 packages capicola
instructions: In a large stock pot, brown sausage, drain. Stir in broth. Cover and simmer slowly for 15 minutes. Add capicola and continue cooking over medium low heat until sausage is cooked.

title: Easy Thai Coconut Soup Dip
ingredients: 1 can unsweetened coconut milk | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1 bunch fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts | fresh parsley leaves, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Pour the coconut milk into a bowl and set aside to chill. Bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, pour the chopped parsley into a small bowl. Stir in the chopped parsley into the coconut milk, then return the entire contents of the bowl to the pot. Scatter the peanuts over the top and place a small plate on top of the bowls so that the peanuts do not burn. Serve with fresh parsley leaves for garnish if desired.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,golden syrup,canadian bacon,chicken bouillon cube,cherry tomato,shrimp,leek,basil
title: Cherry Tomato and Canadian Bacon Soup
ingredients: 2 cans of good canadian bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces ( canadian bacon if you can ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 leeks, chopped | 2 tablespoons light gold syrup | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 lb medium shrimp, cleaned deveined and shelled ( i like pink shrimp ) | 1/4 cup fresh basil | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved ( cherry tomatoes are nice in this recipe, but i like lots of tomatoes ) | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Heat oil over low heat in a large stockpot or dutch oven. Cook the 2 cans of sliced american bacon until crisp and the color darkens slightly, about 5 or 6 minutes. Add the leeks and cook another 5 minutes. Add the 2 tablespoons of dark syrup, stir and reduce heat to low. Cook for approximately 20 minutes, stirring constantly, stirring occasionally so it doesn't stick to the bottom of the pot. Add the cube of chicken and add the shrimp. Cook for just 3 minutes. Add the basil and stir. Cook for another 5 minutes. Pour into bowls and garnish with cherry tomatoes and cocoa powder.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh thyme honey | 8 lettuce leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the coleslaw mix and thyme honey together. Divide the mixture evenly between the lettuce leaves. Eat.

Random Ingredients: rump steak,corn muffin mix,pasta,yellow bell pepper

ingredients: 1/4 cup dry rump steak or 1/4 cup other lean cut beef, cut in 1/4 in. slices | 1 package dry corn muffin mix | 1 tablespoon minced yellow bell pepper | 2 cups cooked pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f grease 12 cup muffin pan. Stir together steak and corn muffin mix in large bowl, stir in bell pepper. Spoon half of muffin batter into each muffin cup.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,rye flour,cremini mushroom,carrom seed,cheese,graham cracker pie crust,cornflour,taco seasoning mix
title: Vegetable Cheesecakes With Beer

instructions: Mix all ingredients for the beer together with a whisk. Stir in the mushrooms, cover and refrigerate about 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400°f. Shape the cooled beer mix into small, 1/3 inch diameter cakes. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on a rack. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: currant,red chile,plain yogurt,salt,garlic salt,double cream,celery,red pepper
title: Celery Soup
ingredients: 1 head celery ( or 2 lbs ) | 1 lb currants | 6 ounces plain yogurt ( to taste ) | 1 cup double cream | salt, to taste | red pepper, to taste | garlic salt, to taste | couscous, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Cut the celery across the stalk. Cut it into chunks.. In a saucepan over a medium heat, toast the currant pieces until they're softened. You want them golden brown, but not burned. You can add a little more cream to the currant liquid if needed. Stir in all of the remaining veggies, season with salt, garlic salt and red pepper. If you like your soup slightly thicker, you can add a little more cream. The soup shouldn't be too thin. If it's too thick, you can add more yogurt. Serve in warmed bowls or on the side of a mound, with rice.

title: Beer and Pilsner
ingredients: 1 bottle pitman's beer with corona ( corona ) | 10 peppers
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,lamb chop,white shoepeg corn,red enchilada sauce,red chilies,bean sprout
title: Chilli Con Carne

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celcius. Heat a small saucepan of water, add the enchilada sauce & set aside. Remove the foil & re cover the oven. Carefully remove the lamb from the oven & drain off any excess fat then add the corn along with any juices & cook for 10 mins, taking care not to overcook the corn & actually thicken it a little. Serve immediately on a warm plate.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,dark chocolate,pea,broccoli floret,parmigiano reggiano cheese,lemon wedge
title: Creamy Green Chard and Broccoli Puree (Rachael Ray)

instructions: Cook broccoli and peas in boiling salted water 15 minute or until tender. Drain. Cook cardamom pods until fragrant about 30 seconds or less. Using slotted spoon, remove cardamom pods. title: Baked Bananas
ingredients: 2 bananas | 1 baguette
instructions: Remove all peels the bananas should peel off easily. Cut the bananas in slices approximately 1/4 thick and place into greased baking dish. Cut the baguette in to thick slices approximately 1/4 thick and place onto bananas. Sprinkle the baguette slices evenly on top of the bananas. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake at 300 degrees f for about 20 minutes. Allow to cool slightly. Cut into small squares and serve immediately.

title: Scotch Crisps

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Grease a 9 x 13 inch baking pan, or line with parchment paper. Arrange half the bread slices in the prepared pan. Place the remaining bread in a large bowl. Mix salmon and syrup well, and spread it over the bread. Sprinkle with remaining bread. If desired, dust with additional italian to taste.

instructions: Prepare barbecue for direct grilling. In medium bowl, combine pineapples and spinach. In large metal bowl or small plate, beat egg whites, half and half, 1/2 teaspoon red pepper sauce and green bell pepper.

instructions: Place the beef boullion in a wide, shallow dish. Place slices of bread in the dish. Sprinkle beef on the bread, then add honey, water, allspice, coriander, and hot sauce. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Next day, remove bread from refrigerator.

title: Eggplant Dip in Rice and Aromatic Breadsticks
ingredients: 250 g baby eggplants | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 100 ml mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons mustard | 300 g arborio rice
instructions: Cut out the ends and the peel from the eggplants, then cut into 3 cm long sticks using scissors. Place the sticks in a pan of boiling water and boil for 5 minutes. Drain well and place into a large bowl. Mash the eggcurd in a bowl, adding the mayonnaise and mustard. Add the rice and mix well. Spoon the mixture into the breadsticks and chill for at least two hours in the fridge. The dip can also be eaten cold as a snack.

title: Cheesy French Carrots
ingredients: 4 ounces baby carrots | 2 ounces american cheese, diced | 1 egg white | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/8 teaspoon fennel
instructions: Peel baby carrots. Slice the carrots into 1/4 pieces. Combine shredded cheese, egg white, mustard powder and fennel mix well. Pour mixture into a greased shallow baking pan and bake at 400 degrees for about 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: nigella seed,shell pasta,vegetable stock,lemon juice,sunflower oil vegetable,active yeast
title: Sunflower Magazine's African-Spiced Pasta

instructions: In a large mixing bowl place the yeast, vegetable base, hot stock and lemon juice and stir well. The mixture should be like honey. Place your pasta in a large pan of boiling water. Heat to the boil and cook according to the packet directions. Drain the pasta and add it to the mixture along with the nigella seeds and oil. Mix well to combine and cook for 5 minutes over medium heat or until pasta is heated through. Serve warm with lots of plain yoghurt and lots of chopped spring onion.

title: Baked Shrimp Alfredo
ingredients: 1 can ortega chopped green chilies | 1/3 cup chopped white onion, or | 1/4 cup chopped green onion | 1 chopped fresh white onion, or | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/2 cup chopped imitation crabmeat ( optional ) | 12 ounces alfredo sauce | 1 head iceberg lettuce, chopped | 12 ounces cooked shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: In a small bowl combine chilis, 1/4 cup onion, and 1/4 cup onion.

title: Shredded Cilantro Spinach
ingredients: 4 large fresh spinach leaves | 1/2 cup canola oil | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 3 packages cream of chicken soup, reduced-sodium | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 2 tablespoons white tequila
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions. Drain well, squeeze dry and set aside. While spinach is cooking heat canola oil and sesame oil in a 4 qt dutch oven. Add soup, bell pepper, tomato paste and chile paste and simmer over low heat 1 minute. Add shredded spinach, simmer, stirring constantly, until spinach is heated through, about 10 minutes.

title: Ham Knuckle With Green Grapes - Saudi Arabia
ingredients: 2 lbs string beans, trimmed, snapped at 1-inch intervals and soaked overnight in cold water | 2 1/2 lbs ham knuckles, cut crosswise into 1-inch lengths | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, lightly chopped | 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/8 cup heavy cream | 1/8 cup saffron | 2 cups fresh green grapes
instructions: Place the ham shkaifters in a large nonstick skillet and add enough water to cover them by 1/2 inch.

title: Tofu and Baked Bean Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 can baked beans | 0.5 can cream of mushroom soup | 7/8 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 loaf white bread, sliced | 1 package firm tofu
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add all other ingredients. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Zest Pasta Salad
ingredients: 3 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 lb spiral shaped penne | 3 spring onions, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup tahini | 3 tablespoons fresh marsala | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 3 cups shredded lettuce
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and boil until cooked al dente, reserving some cooking water. Drain and cool. When cool, drain pasta and toss with fennel seeds to coat. Coat a large nonstick skillet with an oven proof coating of cooking spray and add chicken. Cook on both sides until cooked. Drain. In a large bowl, whisk together the ingredients for the dressing, add the pasta to the dressing and toss well. Serve warm or chilled. This dish can be made a couple hours in advance and stored covered overnight in the refrigerator or in the freezer.

title: Roast Fried Wild Rice and Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 cup poblano pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh bread, diced | 1/2 lb veal, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 cups hot cooked wild rice, chilled | 1 teaspoon fresh mint, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small dry skillet cook poblano in 2 tablespoons water until lightly browned. Transfer poblano to a medium bowl and cover with foil to keep moist. Add bread to pan and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until browned. Transfer to a plate and spread on a paper towel to cool. When cold squeeze out any excess water. Crumble bread and set aside. Arrange veal slices on a broiler tray. Broil, turning once, for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and drain on paper towels. Drain any excess liquid in skillet and return to stove. Reduce heat to low. Stir in 1 tablespoon confectioners sugar. Remove from heat. In a medium bowl, stir rice and mint until well blended. Place poblano slices on a cookie sheet and top with rice mixture. Sprinkle with remaining confectioners' sugar. Broil for 1 to 3 minutes or until golden.

title: Lebanese Tabil - Ham and Vegetables, Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 1 kg ham ( leg, breast, breast ) | 1 kg lamb shank | 1 large pumpkin ( kabocha squash ) | 1 can fat and sugar ( or both )
instructions: Slice ham into thick 1cm squares. Trim lamb shank into 1cm square pieces. Cut pumpkin in half or thirds crossways and cut into wedges. Cut kabocha squash into 3cm chunks. Cut kabocha squash into 1cm cubes. Trim fat of ham shank. Put ham, shanks and vegetables into a large saucepan and add 1½ cups of salted water or chicken stock. Season well. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour until lamb and vegetables are tender and meat is tender. While ham and vegetables cook, remove the ham meat from the pan leaving the fat in the fat. Use two forks to separate the meat from the stringy fat and shred meat in batches. Serve ham and vegetables over baked couscous.

title: Foolproof Salad, North Seas
ingredients: 1 head mixed peel, washed in lots | 1 cucumber, washed in lots | 1 pint mixed fresh berries | 1/2 cup currants | 1 pint oil | salad oil
instructions: Wash peel and set aside. Dice cucumber add mixed peel & cucumber to water in a large jar & shake thoroughly to combine. Remove from water & place a layer of washed, dried greens on the bottom of a shallow, glass or ceramic dish. Arrange mixed peel on top. Add a layer of mixed berries on top. Add currants. Add oil & cover with plastic wrap. Marinate in fridge 4 - 5 days. Turn over once in a while & then shake again. Store in tightly covered glass jar in a dark place w/the lid & refrigerate until needed.

title: Leek and Coconut Ketchup
ingredients: 500 ml thick coconut cream | 4 tablespoons ketjap manis | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 large leek | 600 ml heavy cream | 150 -200 g mashed ripe bananas
instructions: Place all ingredients, except the bananas, in a heavy based saucepan and bring to the boil. Turn down heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in bananas just before serving and allow to cool completely. To serve, put on a serving platter and pour around the ketchup.

title: Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 5 ounces colby cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom
instructions: Combine the colby cheese, cardamom, and ground cardamom in a small bowl. Serve at once as a dip. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Simple Fat-Free Tuna Spread
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained | 1/3 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Empty the tuna into a bowl, breaking up any chunks of tuna with a fork.

title: Simple Chilli Powder.
ingredients: 1/4 cup coriander leaves, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder or 1/4 teaspoon brown mustard powder
instructions: Mix mustard powder and coriander in a small bowl or small food processor. Add remaining ingrediants and mix well. Serve with plain boiled vegies, prawns or fried fish.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,taco sauce,kaffir lime leaf,corn tortilla,coriander seed,avocado
title: Kaffir Lime and Avocado Tacos
ingredients: 3 kaffir lime leaves or 3 limes, minced | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 ripe avocado, peeled halved, pitted and cubed | 8 corn tortillas, warmed | 1 cup taco sauce, warmed | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese or 1/2 cup asiago cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat grill or broiler. Place lime leaves on grill. Place kaffir lime leaves in mortar with coriander. Grind to a powder. Place the ground chili powder, avocado cubes and corn tortillas in separate bowls. To assemble, sprinkle half of the cheese mixture on each tortilla. Roll tortillas up. Brush tops with remaining olive oil. To broil, place tortillas on grill or broiler pan. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat for about 1 minute or just until cheese is melted. Divide taco sauce among tacos.

title: Enchilada Sauce with Dipping Ingredients
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 red onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon red pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Heat a small pot of water to boiling. Add 1 tspn red pepper and onion and bring to boil. Add enchilada sauce, cook 2 minutes, stirring well. Top with more red pepper and onion if desired. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,raspberry jam,paprika,celery rib,tomato soup,walnut oil,white wine vinegar,tart apple
title: French Apple Rind Salad With Tomato-White wine Vinaigrette
ingredients: 7 tart apples | 150 g smoked paprika | 6 tomatoes ( i use a small rosé type, but a rosé type apple may be used if you prefer ) | 150 g raspberries and 100 g apricots | 1 celery rib | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 100 g walnut oil
instructions: Tear the apple into bite size pieces. Do not shake before serving. Place the salad ingredients in to a serving bowl and pour dressing over the salad. Enjoy.

title: Rock Salted Cashews
ingredients: 450 g roasted cashews | fresh rock salt
instructions: Dry fry the cashewnuts in a pan over medium heat for 8 minutes or until golden brown. Drain on paper towel and leave to cool slightly. Season to taste with rock salt on top.
