title: Crunchy Beef Salad
ingredients: 2/3 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut into thin strips | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon low sodium taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon sugar | 7 cups torn bibb lettuce | 1 package fresh pasta, cooked | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper. Add beef.

title: Sour Cream Mushroom Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 500 g white button mushrooms | 15 tablespoons cream of coconut | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Wash the mushrooms and finely chop. Beat all ingredients together, except the cornflour, together on a low speed for 3 minutes, using just enough speed to soften. Mix the cornflour with 2 tsp hot water, till its creamy consistency. Add in mushrooms, blend and gently mix. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: savory,grain wild rice,aubergine,white pepper powder,shrimp,beef chuck
title: Beef and Aubergine With Wild Rice, Shrimp and Aubergines
ingredients: 8 ounces beef chuck, lean or boneless, cut into 2-inch cubes ( or a mix of beef and veal ) | 10 -12 ounces uncooked long grain and wild rice blend | 1 tablespoon white pepper powder | 2 teaspoons savory ( fresh or dried ) or 2 teaspoons thyme ( fresh or dried ) | 10 ounces uncooked shrimp | 6 aubergines, cubed ( or 2 cups baby squash halved or sliced lengthwise, can use orange sections instead )
instructions: Prepare wild rice according to package directions using 4 cups water and a little salt.

title: Sticky Maple Glaze
ingredients: 10 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 10 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Stir maple syrup and raisins together in a bowl. Stir until combined and pour over bread. Lightly drizzle bread with glaze, if desired.

title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
ingredients: 12 egg yolks | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 1/3 cups golden raisins | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1 3/4 cups dried mixed fruit, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease cookie sheets. In a bowl, mix the egg yolks, oil, raisins, nuts, and mixed fruit until well blended. Drop spoonfuls of the dough onto the prepared cookie sheets. Bake in preheated oven until golden, 7 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,sunflower oil,rosemary,chocolate curl,sushi rice,meat,rye bread
title: Meat and Rice Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 pound ground meat | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil, divided | 1 cup sushi rice | 5 slices rye bread | 1/4 cup fresh rosemary | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | chocolate curls for garnish
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Break up the bread, and toast in the hot skillet for about 3 minutes, then set aside. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil in the skillet over medium heat. Brown the ground meat, breaking apart the pieces as necessary, but do not cook all the way through. Set the meat aside and cover to keep warm. In a separate large skillet, heat the remaining oil in the skillet over medium heat. Cook the rice according to package directions, omitting salt and margarine, and mashing the rice with a fork and heating through. Pour cooked rice into a bowl, and stir in the ground meat, rosemary, and whipped cream, until just mixed. Put the rye on a cutting board, and slice into 1/4 inch rounds. Place the round, cut side down, onto a baking sheet with parchment paper between each slice. Garnish with chocolate curls before serving.

Random Ingredients: saffron,white flour,turkey breast,orange juice zest,salsa,lamb shank,corn flake
title: Baked Turkey Shanks with Salsa
ingredients: 8 lamb shanks, about 2 1/2 pounds, cut in half | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 5 cups salsa | 4 cups orange juice and zest of | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 2 cups white flour | 6 cups corn flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place lamb shanks in a large, heavy baking pan. Sprinkle with saffron. Cover with 3 cups salsa and 1 cup orange juice. Pour out water to 1 inch from the top. Add orange zest and orange juice. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes. Turn off oven. Uncover and put pan on oven floor. Bake for an additional 25 minutes, basting occasionally with pan juices. Mix flour and remaining salsa in 1 cup baking pan. Stir in 1 cup orange juice and 1 cup orange juice. Cook and stir until thick. Remove from heat and stir well. Place lamb shanks on oven tray, and bake for 30 minutes, basting occasionally. While the shanks bake, make the salsa. In a 1 1/2 quart saucepan, cook 1 cup orange juice and 1 cup orange juice over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced. Stir in the zest and 1 cup orange juice. Bring to a boil and boil for an additional minute. Remove from heat. Pour into an 8 inch by 8 inch glass baking dish. Cover with foil. Bake for an additional 10 minutes, basting occasionally. Serve with salsa.

title: Pork Chops with Shallot Relish
ingredients: 1 package lean pork loin chops | 1 package trimmed shallots | 1 package sprinkle rolls with shallots | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium size baking dish arrange pork chops in a single layer. Sprinkle pork chops with 2 teaspoons of salt on each chop. Bake in the preheated oven 15 to 20 minutes, or until meat is lightly browned and tender.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,sherry,cocoa powder,self raising flour,golden raisin,pear,dark rum
title: Pear and Raisin Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 1 1/4 cups shredded unsweetened coconut | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 teaspoons cocoa powder | 1/2 cup vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 1/4 cup white rum | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 2 pears
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Beat first 5 ingredients in a large bowl with electric mixer 2 - 3 minutes or until very well combined. Stir in rum and rum. Spoon into a 2 x 2 1/2 3 1/2 or 9 x9 pan. Spread with fruit mixture. Bake 1 hour. For an alternative, use electric whisk or a wooden spoon to mix the first 5 into the raisins. Or use your hands and work in the raisins into the batter with a knife. Slice pears vertically around the loaf and spread with the rum glaze. Serve loaf warm, cold or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,seasoning salt,salmon fillet,tamarind paste,green tomato,tart apple,peach,lasagna noodle
title: Apple and Pear Cream Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat lasagna noodle | 2 cups frozen small chopped green tomatoes | 8 medium firm tart apples | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamarind paste ( see note in description ) | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 large fresh oranges ( about 3-1/2-inch-thick ) or 2 large pears, peeled, cored, and chopped | 2 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets, cut into 3/4-inch-thick slices
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, steam tomatoes, apples, tamarind paste, and 2 tablespoons water over medium heat until very tender, about 8 minutes. Transfer tomatoes to bowl of food processor, add remaining ingredients and process to a smooth paste. Set aside. Cook salmon in oil in a large nonstick skillet until brown on both sides, about 3 minutes per side. Arrange over vegetables in bottom of baking dish. Cover with tomato mixture. Sprinkle with pasta. Spread with remaining tomato jam. Preheat broiler. Broil salmon slices 3 inches from heat until just cooked through, about 3 minutes.

title: Roast Pork in Sandwich Crisps
ingredients: 1/3 cup roast pork, thin sliced | 2 slices roast pork ( thin slices ) | 4 crusty rolls or 4 rye rolls
instructions: Lay the bottom halves of your bread slices with the fat on one side. Spread about two tablespoons of roast pork slices evenly in the middle of your bread slices. On the fat side of the bread place a thin slice of roast pork on top of the roast pork, being careful to leave a little of the fat on the outside. Take the bread slice open and spread the meat on top of the roast pork. Close the top halves of your sandwich and secure with a tooth pick. Wrap the outside of one of your rolls with aluminum foil and place on a cookie sheet. Cook on 425 for about 15 minutes, until the internal temp of your sandwich reaches 140°f. Remove toothpick, slice into small pieces and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,risotto rice,taco sauce,pecorino romano cheese,farfalle pasta,seasoning
title: Noodle Taco Pasta
ingredients: 5 6 ounces risotto rice or 5 6 ounces romano cheese, diced | 5 5 2 cups purchased taco sauce | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning, of your choice and i prefer lawry's season herb seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 1/2 cups grated pecorino romano cheese or 1 1/2 cups parmesan cheese | 9 ounces farfalle pasta ( cooked al dente )
instructions: Cook the pasta as directed but do not overcook. In a large bowl, add the cooked rice, taco sauce, lawry's seasoning, and cream of tatrar. Using an electric mixer, blend everything together well. Add the grated cheese and mix with an additional minute or two on medium high to mix evenly and set aside. Drain pasta and toss with taco mixture and serve immediately.

title: Garam Masala Noodles (Chana Masala)
ingredients: 1 package wide egg noodles | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1/4 cup minced fresh cilantro
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the egg noodles, cook for 2 minutes, and then drain. Meanwhile, combine the garam masala, baking powder, peanuts, and cilantro in a deep skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture darkens in color, about 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Pour the noodles into hot sauce, and stir to heat through for about 1 minute. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,egg yolk,picante sauce,tomato puree,vodka,white flour
title: Tomato-White Sauce for Seafood
ingredients: 2 ripe tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup vodka | 4 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup white flour | 2 cups picante sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato puree
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix vodka and tomatoes. Add egg yolks and fold in flour. Cover and refrigerate over night. Before serving, bring picante sauce to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in tomato puree. Serve over cooked fish or chicken.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,risotto rice,brown rice,dill weed,cardamom,orzo pasta,avocado,black pepper
title: Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package dry rice noodles | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and cubed | 3/4 cup uncooked rice noodles | 1/2 package arborio rice or other short-grain rice noodles | 2 teaspoons ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/2 cups prepared orzo-style pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rice noodles and stir. Return to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until tender, about 20 minutes. Rinse noodles with cold water. Drain well and cut in half. In a bowl, toss together the rice noodles, avocado and arugula. Sprinkle rice noodles with black pepper, dill, cardamom and mix. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 2 days. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Grilled Cheese with Prosciutto and Proscuitto
ingredients: 2 ounces prosciutto or 2 ounces bacon, thinly sliced | 2 ounces aged gouda cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the grill. Place all of the ingredients on the grill rack, cover and grill until the cheese has melted.

title: Seared Buns : Apricots and Green Chiles
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger buns ( i use toufayan brand ) | 1/4 cup reduced-fat yogurt | 3 tablespoons chopped scallions | 2 tablespoons chopped dried apricots | 3 tablespoons green chili, finely chopped ( red, green or white parts ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 1/3 tablespoons mirin or 1 1/3 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Drain meat from can. Mix the yogurt and next 5 ingredients and divide among the buns to serve. Top with scallions, apricots and chili.

title: Rutabaga, Broccoli and Apricot Salad
ingredients: 1 large rutabaga, about 3 1/2 pounds | 4 cups broccoli florets | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: Trim the rutabaga.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,rice noodle,brown rice,almond paste,american cheese,vanilla pudding,marjoram,chicken stock
title: Arroz Verde (Spicy Rice Noodle Soup)
ingredients: 1 liter chicken stock | 2 packages vegetarian instant rice noodles | 1 ounce almond paste ( amarula brand ) | 3 ounces vanilla instant pudding | 12 ounces american cheese, sliced ( or other good melting cheese ) | 1 cup brown rice ( long, short cooking in the usa ) | 1 dash marjoram | 6 -8 sprigs fresh marjoram ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine the chicken stock and noodles in a large, heavy saucepan. Bring to boil. Cover and simmer on just until noodles are tender, about 8 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile, combine almond paste, pudding, cheese and rice until smooth. Cover and keep soup warm. Add hot soup to soup and stir to mix. Add marjoram and simmer 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and garnish with parmesan.

Random Ingredients: red apple,rice wine,italian plum tomato,pesto sauce,water chestnut,lemon
title: Pesto Rice With Italian Plums, Apples, and Water Chestnuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( from a bottle of pesto and herbs ) | 1/2 cup chopped red apple ( about 1 large ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian plum tomato ( about 1 large ) | 1 1/4 cups water chestnuts, drained and chopped ( about 1 cup ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 2 lemons, quartered and thin sliced ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine pesto, apple, and tomatoes with 1 1/2 cups water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until apples are softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in remaining 1 1/4 cup water chestnuts, and cook 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat and stir in wine, lemon slices. Stir rice mixture.

title: Sante's Hot & Spicy Calzone - Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 2 cups red roasted red chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup blanched slivered almond, chopped
instructions: Add the ingredients to the pan of your bread machine as it is written, or if not, press the dough program. Start the bread machine and if it does not fit immediately, move to a dough setting. Start the dough cycle.

title: Nam Pla (Nimply Thyme French Bread)
ingredients: 1 bread, slice | 1/4 cup oil | 1/4 cup nam pla | 12 sprigs fresh thyme
instructions: Remove crusts from bread with a knife and cut each loaf in half crosswise. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Drain bread pieces on paper towels. Stir in nam pla and thyme. When bread is hot through, but before bread becomes soggy, remove from heat. Cool for about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white cake mix,tomato green chilies,cilantro,almond extract,spinach,cheese tortellini,chicken stock vegetable
title: Tortellini and Spinach Soup
ingredients: 1 package fresh cheese tortellini ( about 1 3/4 cups ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon almond extract, or more to taste | 1 bag fresh spinach, washed, stemmed, drained, and chopped | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 package fresh sliced almonds, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the tortellini, diced tomatoes with green chilies, chicken broth, and almond extract until well blended and mixed, about 10 minutes. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tortellini are tender and the liquid is almost completely cooked, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place spinach in a colander and shake out excess water. Combine spinach with cooked tortellini in a large pot. Stir in fresh chopped spinach, the almond slivers, slivered almonds, and cilantro until thoroughly combined. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: shortening,french bread,rocket,green moroccan olive,vanilla bean,salmon fillet,cheese,greek yogurt
title: Salmon Casserole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 loaf french bread, sliced | 1 carton greek yogurt | 8 ounces smoked salmon fillets | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthways | 2 tablespoons green greek garam masala | 4 ounces feta cheese | 10 -20 stuffed green greek olives | 20 -20 rocket
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Cut a slice of french bread in half and then cut the bread into slices. In a large mixing bowl, melt the shortening and stir in the yoghurt, then add the salmon. Place bread into a large ovenproof dish. Spoon sauce around the sides of the bowl then top with salmon. Split the floured vanilla bean lengthways and scrape the seeds into the bowl. Add the garam masala and stir to combine. Pour the spiced yoghurt over the salmon. Spread feta over the salmon then top with the olives and rocket. Cover with foil and bake for 30 mins until the olives are warm. Remove foil and serve with the warm dish.

title: Baked Clams in Garlic & Sultanas (Australia)
ingredients: 6 fluid ounces heavy cream | 6 fluid ounces bottled clam juice | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 5 fluid ounces olive oil, extra | 1 cup sultana ( golden raisins )
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°. Heat the oil in a large pan and gently fry the sultanas for about 3 minutes. Add the cream, bring to the boil then simmer for a few minutes. Add the garlic and cummin. Stir very quickly until the garlic is golden and the sultanas soft. Place the clams in an ovenproof casserole dish and cover with the sultana cream sauce. Cover and bake for 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white cabbage,almond paste,radish,cornstarch,grand marnier,caraway seed,shiitake mushroom
title: Mushroom Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 red cabbage, about 2 lbs | 3/4 cup shiitake mushroom, sliced | 2/3 cup roasted almond paste | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 2 -5 radishes, cut in to 1 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Cut cabbage in half. Cut large wedges about 1/4 inch long. Remove leaf with stem intact and wash. Separate each wedge into 4 sections, discard remaining leaf stems. Set aside large portion for sauce. Remove remaining cabbage wedge. Remove and discard outer leaves from bottom half of core. Cut wedges in quarters from top of wedge. Stack leaves on cutting board. Stack wedges on cutting board. Place mushrooms and almond paste in a medium bowl. Mix cornstarch with grand marnier. Stir into mushroom mixture and gradually stir in blended cornstarch mixture until well blended. Add radish pieces. Spoon 1 1/4 cup filling onto each section of torn cabbage. Roll up and tie with string. Place cabbage rolls side by side in a 2 qt. Slowly pour boiling water over cabbage rolls until completely covered. Cover pan. Boil 3 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pepper,cumin seed,plain yogurt,greek yogurt,red chili pepper,plantain,mace,italian breadcrumb
title: A Simple Fried Plantains
ingredients: 3 medium ripe plantains | 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, lightly crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili peppers, crushed ( or 1-2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon crushed ground pepper | 1/4 cup italian style breadcrumbs
instructions: Slice a very thin layer off the top third of the plantain, so around the center of the plantain's surface it will stand vertically like the original. Cut the plantain slice into 1/4 slices, then diagonally across the top 1/4 inch of plantain. Dredge slices in the bread crumbs to coat, set aside. Place the bread crumbs in a shallow dish. Heat skillet or wok on medium high heat.. Dip each slice of plantain in the crumbs and then place on the hot skillet or wok. Turn the slices so they are browned. Flip them over when they are browned to brown other side. Remove from skillet, place on plate and repeat with remaining pieces to make four servings. Serve with tomato sauce, guacamole, etc. Enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Shrimp or Lobster Gumbo
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( knorr ) | tortilla
instructions: Add bouillon cube to shrimp/chicken/shrimp cook on med high. Serve with tortillas.

title: Lentils and Orange zest
ingredients: 250 g green lentils | 2 -3 oranges, zest of
instructions: Wash the lentils thoroughly. Drain well. Pare oranges and cut the zest into thin slices. Place lentils in the bottom of a large saucepan, add enough water to barely cover the lentils. Cover with a close fitting lid, bring to the boil and boil gently for 2 minutes. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, covered, for 20 - 25 minutes until the lentils are tender and the fruit is cooked through. Remove from heat and leave covered for 5 - 10 minutes or until cool enough to handle. Uncover and fluff gently with a wooden spoon and season with salt. Leave to cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: mussel,puff pastry,kalamata olive,tarragon,white peppercorn,soy sauce,parmigiano reggiano cheese,red cabbage
title: Mussel and Fresh Mozzarella Appetizer
ingredients: 18 ounces fresh mussels, scrubbed | 1/4 cup dry-roasted kalamata olives, chopped ( not kalamata ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 2 tablespoons dry crushed white peppercorns ( not ground ) | 1 tablespoon soy sauce ( gluten-free if needed ) | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheet, thawed ( 3 sheets ) | 8 ounces shredded light domestic mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus more for sprinkling on top
instructions: Cook mussels in a heavy large pot of boiling water, covered, until mussels open, about 5 minutes. Scrub, remove and discard any beards and discard beards, reserving cooking liquid until later. Combine olives, tarragon, peppercorns, and soy sauce in heavy large saucepan, stirring on high until well combined. Bring to boil over high heat. Add mussels and 1/2 cup cooking liquid. Boil until liquid is reduced and mussels open, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, unfold each frozen puff pastry sheet on an ungreased, floured surface. Cut into four 5 inch slices. Place 1 pastry slice on a pizza cutter and roll slightly. Cut four more slices and add to cheese mixture. Spoon 1/2 cup mussels into each crust. Sprinkle each with 1/4 cup cheese, reserving 3/4 cup for tops. Slightly moisten edge of each with water. With sharp knife, cut four decorative slits along edge of each crust. Cut slits in top crust for venting. Cook on each side until golden brown, 8 minutes total. Serve with reserved mussels.

title: Veal Bavarian
ingredients: 1 lb veal, sliced very thin | pepper | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Put them on a hot grill or boiler and grill or fry them in the fat that has rendered. If necessary, add water and sprinkle with pepper. When done, the veal slices should be tender. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: fennel,apple cider,iceberg lettuce,new mexico red chile powder,cilantro,apricot jam,red wine vinegar
title: Chile-Apricot Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dried fennel | 1 can apricot jam | 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed and separated into cups | 1 medium head new mexico red chile powder or 1 small serrano chile, stemmed, seeded and coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup extra virgin apple cider | minced fresh cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: Prepare grill to high. Stir together vinegar, fennel, jam and chile powder in medium bowl. Divide lettuce and apricot jam mixture among 4 salad plates, mound among salad plates, sprinkle with cilantro and garnish with minced cilantro.

title: Chocolate Butter Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup butter | 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 2 -4 ounces unsweetened baking chocolate, cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Melt butter and chocolate together over low heat, stirring until smooth and heated through. Wrap each nori sheet with plastic wrap, shiny side down, to prevent drying out. Place a sheet in another bowl of very cold water, and squeeze the sheet to remove water.

title: Slow Cooker Poached Hominy
ingredients: 2 cans stewed tomatoes with juice, undrained | 1 can hominy, rinsed and drained | 2/3 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup apple cider
instructions: In 4 - 6 1/2 to 5 quart slow cooker combine the first seven ingredients. Cover, and cook on low for 5 - 6 hours, or on high for 5 1/2 to 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,bacon,baking soda,tomato paste,plantain,red wine vinegar
title: Plantain Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup dry yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 firm ripe plantains, peeled and thinly sliced | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 2 cups canned yellow sweet bell peppers, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups tomato paste | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Pour boiling water over baking soda. Blend in yellow bell peppers and plantains. Let stand overnight. Add bacon and cook until lightly browned. Stir in tomatoes and vinegar. Bring to boiling, then reduce heat. Simmer until plantains are tender, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,vegetable oil cooking spray,cream corn,pistachio,green curry paste,wheat bread,pesto sauce,basil
title: Green Curry Pesto Corn
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray, for pan | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 2 teaspoons pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon cream-style corn, undrained | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh basil | 1 teaspoon roasted pistachios or 1/4 teaspoon crushed cashews | 3/4 cup low fat sour cream or 3/4 cup low fat yogurt | 2 slices light-carb whole wheat bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a 9x5 inch loaf pan with vegetable spray. Combine green curry paste, pesto, corn, basil, and nuts in a bowl until well blended. Spread over bread slices. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until heated through.

title: Coriander Penne
ingredients: 1 cup penne | 1 cup fresh coriander
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on box. While pasta is cooking, combine the coriander and minced sweet potato in a small bowl. Toss and serve in a bowl. Serve as a side for cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,mexican cheese,brown rice,mustard powder,rice wine,ginger powder,turmeric
title: Aebleh
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 2 ounces mild mexican cheese ( shredded ) | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 2 teaspoons dry mustard powder ( dry ) | 2 teaspoons ground ginger powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mexican herb seasoning | 2 tablespoons rice wine ( dry )
instructions: In large microwave safe bowl, microwave brown rice until mostly heated up and rice is tender for 2 - 3 minutes. While rice is cooking, in separate dish, combine ground turmeric, mustard powder, ginger and other dry mix. Mix well and add to rice. Allow to sit about 2 minutes. Stir in cheese, and allow to sit another 2 - 3 minutes. Microwave for another 2 minutes or so. Enjoy.

title: Cherry Mango Chutney Pastry Shells
ingredients: pastry shells | 1 1/2 cups mango chutney | 1/4 cup red wine | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine mango chutney, red wine, and vanilla bean in a small bowl. Divide pastry into 24 portions. Pour chutney mixture into each pastry shell. Place each shell on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until pastry shells are golden brown, and fragrant, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: escarole,white vinegar,chicken broth,raspberry jam,red potato,cucumber,red enchilada sauce
title: Italian Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes, peeled, quartered | 3 cups small escarole, cored, leaves separated | 4 ounces cucumbers, chopped | 1 cup canned red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 can chicken broth | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam
instructions: In a saucepan, steam half the potatoes for 20 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,chicken breast half,plum,turmeric powder,basil,fontina cheese
title: Pollo Con Calabacin Con Cheesy Chicken Breasts with Basil
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, halved | 1 package shredded fontina cheese | 3 tablespoons chopped plumatoes | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 1 tablespoon ground turmeric powder | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken breasts onto a baking sheet, or broiling pan, and place in the preheated oven. Broil for 10 minutes, or until juices run clear. Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix together the fontina cheese, plumatoes, basil, turmeric, and monterey jack cheese. Spread the cheese mixture over the tops of the chicken breasts in a layer. Broil for 5 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly.

title: Chile-Tossed Cabbage and Snow Peas
ingredients: 6 whole dried red chilies, stemmed and seeded | 1 can canned chipotle chiles, coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb cabbage, halved lengthwise | 3 1/2 cups napa-style slivered snow peas, trimmed | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained ( 10 ounces ) | 2 teaspoons cardamom
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f place whole chilies in a single layer on medium high rack of roasting pan, and roast until beginning to blacken, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board, and let cool until they reach room temperature, about 30 minutes. Peel and split chilies open. Spread both chilies evenly over the bottom of a 13 by 9 inch baking dish just large enough to hold the cabbage and snow peas. Arrange cabbage and snow peas in rows, or divide among top of chilies. Add chipotle chiles and remaining 3/4 cup water.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,dark creme de cacao,cottage cheese
title: Cottage Cheese Spread
ingredients: 300 g cottage cheese | 4 ounces dark creme de cacao | 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds
instructions: Place cottage cheese and creme de cacao in a food processor and process until smooth. Add pumpkin seeds and process again until smooth. Place in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Portuguese Yams and Yams
ingredients: 4 yams, peeled and cut into wedges | 6 cubes chicken bouillon | 1 cup dry penne pasta
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Cook and stir yam wedges until almost tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Sauce for French Fries
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons lemon zest | 2 teaspoons hot sauce or 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Mix the zest with the hot sauce. Add salt and pepper to taste and stir to coat fries.

title: Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 8 pork tenderloin | 2 cups skim milk | 2 tablespoons sparkling water ( or sugar cube ) | 2 tablespoons vanilla pudding mix ( instant or regular ) | pomgranate
instructions: Slice the tenderloins into thin rounds. Place them in a medium size baking dish. In a saucepan, scald milk.

title: Basic Nisha's Shahi Halwa
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat milk ( you can skim and not use fat ) | 2 teaspoons ghee | pepper ( optional )
instructions: Take a glass bowl and put in half the milk. Put the bowl on your microwave and go with it for a minute. Then put in the rest of the milk and microwave, 2 seconds a minute a a a while until it is boiling and bubbly. Pour this over the khewnsa, stir and enjoy. This might be used as a marinade for veggies or prawns.

title: Shrimp Kebabs With Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 12 jumbo shrimp, peeled cut in half lengthwise ( i use the small 1/8-inch tails to make them less sri ) | 1/2 cup shredded low fat cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup reduced-fat dill reduced fat mayonnaise | 0.5 package italian sausage, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon dried italian spices ( i use parsley, basil, oregano, thyme,... ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds | 1 cup quick-cooking oats
instructions: Thread each shrimp onto metal skewers. Divide cheese among skewers. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over kebabs. Marinate kebabs for 15 minute. Cook over hot grill rack about 6 minutes per side or until shrimp turns pink and cheese is melted. Serve with salsa.

title: Mexican Mashed Potatoes

instructions: Combine potatoes and jalapeno chile in a pot.

title: Soy Sauce - Sriracha!
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons broth or 2 tablespoons water | 2 teaspoons serrano peppers, seeded or 2 dried chiles, crushed
instructions: Combine soy sauce, broth and chilies in a pan. Simmer, covered about 5 minutes until the sauce thickens a little. If the sauce becomes too thickened, stir in a little water. Serve hot.

title: Spookyooky Funnel Clam Balls for Halloween
ingredients: 24 clams, well scrubbed | 1 cornmeal | white cheddar cheese or candy cane | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1/4 cup pineapple preserves | 2 teaspoons galliano | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/2 cup vegetable broth
instructions: Using a spoon full of cheese stick size clams, carefully place a clamped clam onto a cornmeal sprinkled or the bottom of a glass container or a tall glass bowl. Sprinkle or coat the whole clamped clams with the white cheddar cheese. Dredge the clams in the sifted cocoa to cover the clam and then place them in the refrigerator to harden. Fill a large mixing bowl with ice and fill with ice until it reaches the top of the clamped clams. Then, dip the clam in the ice and coat with cornmeal, shaking off any excess. Add the crushed ice to bowl and mix until well crumbly. Add the chopped pineapple to the bowl. Melt the glazes in a saucepan and add the cornmeal to the pan, stirring until smooth. Add the vegetable broth and beat vigorously with a whip or large spoon until the mixture is smooth. Remove from heat and slowly add the blended glaze to the clams, whisking briskly until it coats the meat and clams well. Place the clams in the chocolate coated ice cream buckets or a decorative cookie tray to chill until hard. Store in the freezer until hard.

title: Rice Balls With Snow Peas and Amaretto
ingredients: 1/2 cup farfalle pasta | 1 cup arborio rice | 2 teaspoons amaretto liqueur | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped snow peas | 2 teaspoons amaretto liqueur | 1/4 cup freshly made amaretto liqueur
instructions: Place the water on to boil in a medium saucepan. Add the farfalle, rice, amaretto and snow peas. Heat to boiling over high heat, stirring occasionally, then cover and reduce to medium. Cook until the rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Remove the rice and the amaretto from heat and stir in the amaretto liqueur until well combined. Cover and chill to serve. Make ahead, the meal can be prepared up to 1 day ahead of time. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate.

title: Swedish Grilled Rye Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, or to taste | 1 loaf rye bread, sliced into 1-inch thick slices, or as needed
instructions: Stir sugar and lemon juice together in a glass bowl.

title: Tex-Mex Spicy Spinach Dip
ingredients: 10 fresh sausages | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 package linguine | 1 package shredded cottage cheese | 8 fresh caciocavito chilies, sliced, divided | 1 teaspoon minced dried ancho chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons confectioners' sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut sausages into 1/2 inch slices. Reserve 1 slice of sausages and cut remaining slices in half. Transfer slices to a resealable plastic bag. Remove air from bag, seal, and refrigerate about 30 minutes, or up to 1 day. Slice pasta in half lengthwise. Reserve 1 cup spaghetti cooking liquid.

title: Crispy Beef With Broth
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 5 lbs sirloin, cut into bite-sized pieces | 5 cups thick flavorful chicken broth, canned ok | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 4 cups rich flavorful broth
instructions: Heat oil in heavy large pot over high heat. Sprinkle beef with salt. Working in batches, deep fry until lightly browned on outside and cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes per batch. Transfer to plate lined with paper towels. Pour off all but 2 tbs. Oil from pot. Add beef and brown well on all sides. Transfer beef with slotted spoon to bowl. Add 3 cups broth and rosemary to pot. Bring to boil. Boil 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Transfer beef to bowl with accumulated juices and broth.

title: Pistachio Brownie Cake
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup unsalted shelled pistachios, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f spray pan with vegetable cooking spray, or use pam for best results. Mix rice, flour, nuts and vanilla. Pour into pan and bake. Turn out and cool before cutting. Enjoy.
